1: अ The first letter of the alphabet, and inherent short vowel.
2: अ ind. 1 No, not. 2 A privative, prohibitive, and diminutive particle. 3 An interjection of pity. It also implies degrees of difference, and similarity. As a negative prefix to words beginning with a vowel, अ is changed to अन्, as अ and अन्त form अनन्त.
3: अ m. (अः) A name of VIṢṆU.
4: अऋणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिणी-णि) Free from debt or obligation; also अनृणिन्. E. अ neg. ऋणिन् a debtor.
5: अंश r. 10th cl. (अंशयति) To separate or divide. See अंस.
6: अंश m. (-शः) 1 A share or portion. 2 A part. 3 A shoulder, the shoulder blade. 4 (In arithmetic) a fraction. 5 The numerator of a fraction. 6 A degree of latitude or longitude, &c. See अंस. E. अंश to divide, अच् affix.
7: अंशक m. (-कः) A kinsman, a relation, a coheir. n. (-कं) a day. E. अंश to separate or divide, and वुन् affix.
8: अंशभाज् mfn. (भाक्) An heir, a coheir, one who has a share or portion. E. अंश and भाज् who possesses.
9: अंशन n. (-नं) Dividing, sharing. E. अंश and युच् aff.
10: अंशनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be divided, divisible. E. अंश and अनीयर aff.
11: अंशमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dividing, sharing. E. अंश and शानच् aff.
12: अंशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत्) Dividing, sharing. E. अंश and यति affix.
13: अंशयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Divisible, to be divided. E. अंश and तव्य aff.
14: अंशयितृ mfn. (-ता-ची-तृ) Dividing, sharing. E. अंश and शतृ aff.
15: अंशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, stout, lusty. See अंसस्न.
16: अंशहर mfn. (-रः रा-री-रं) A sharer, a divider, a coheir. E. अंश and हर who takes.
17: अंशहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) A sharer, a coheir. E. अंश and हारिन् who takes.
18: अंशांश m. (-शः) Part of a portion or share. E. अंश repeated.
19: अंशांशि ind. Share by share. E. अंश repeated and इ aff.
20: अंशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Divided, portioned, shared. E. अंश and क्त aff.
21: अंशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) A sharer, a coheir. E. अंश and इनि poss. aff.
22: अंश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Divisible, to be shared or divided. E. अश and यत् aff.
23: अंशु m. (-शुः) 1 A ray of light, a sun-beam. 2 Light, splendor, effulgence. 3 Dress, decoration. 4 A small filament or end of thread. 5 The sun. 6 A minute particle or atom. E. अंश to divide, कु aff.
24: अंशुक n. (-कं) 1 Fine cloth, muslin. 2 A mantle, a wrapper, a robe, a linen garment worn round the upper part of the body. 3 Cloth in general. 4 White cloth. 5 A leaf. E. अंश and कन् added.
25: अंशुजाल n. (-लं) 1 A collection or blaze of light. 2 A parcel or pencil of rays. E. अंशु and जाल a net.
26: अंशुधर m. (-रः) The sun. E. अंशु and धर who holds.
27: अंशुभर्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The sun. E. अंश and भर्तृ lord.
28: अंशुमत् mfn (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Radiant, luminous. 2 Acuminated, pointed. m. (-मान्) 1 The sun. 2 A prince of the solar race, son of ASAMAÑJAS, grandson of SĀGARA. (-ती) (A plant, (Hedysarum Gangeticum.) E. अंशु and मतुप् poss. aff.
29: अंशुमत्फला f. (-ला) The plantain, (Musa paradisiaca.) E. अंशुमत् and फल fruit.
30: अंशुमाला f. (-ला) A garland of light, a halo. E. अंशु and माला a garland.
31: अंशुमालिन् m. (-ली) The sun. E. अंशुमाला and इनि aff.
32: अंशुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Radiant, splendid. E. अंशु and लच् aff.
33: अंशुवाण m. (-णः) The sun. E. अंशु and वाण an arrow.
34: अंशुहस्त m. (-स्तः) The sun. E. अंशु and हस्त the hand.
35: अंस r. 10th cl. (अंसयति) To separate of divide; also written अंश.
36: अंस m. (-सः) 1 A shoulder, a scapula. 2 A part, a portion. E. अंस to divide, अच् aff. it is also written अंश.
37: अंसकूट m. (-टः) A bull's hump, the protuberance between the shoulders of the Indian ox. E. अंस the shoulder, and कूट a peak.
38: अंसल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, stout, lusty. E. अंस the shoulder, and लच् aff. also written अंशल.
39: अंहति f. (-तिः) 1 A gift, a donation. 2 Sickness, disease. 3 Leaving, abandoning. 4 A gift. E. अहि to go, क्तिन् affix or अंह for हन to kill, and अति Uṇādi aff.
40: अंहती f. (-ती) A gift or donation. E. See अंहति, इ being made long.
41: अंहस् n. (-हः) Sin. See अङ्घस्. E. अम to go, and the Uṇādi affix, असुन्.
42: अंहिति f. (-तिः) A gift or donation. E. See अंहति, इट् being inserted.
43: अंह्रि m. (-ह्रिः) 1 A foot. 2 The root of a tree. E. अहि to go, and क्रिण् Uṇādi affix: also अङ्घ्रि.
44: अंह्रिप m. (-पः) A tree. E. अंह्रि the root, and प from पा to drink.
45: अंह्रिस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) The heel. E. अंह्रि the foot, and स्कन्ध the shoulder.
46: अक r. 1st cl. (अकति) To wind or move tortuously. With an indicatory इ। अकि (अंकति) 1 To mark or bespot. 2 To go. See अङ्क.
47: अक m. (-कः) 1 Moving tortuously. 2 One who goes crookedly. 3 Pain, affliction. 4 Sin. E. अ priv. and क happiness, or अक to move crookedly, aff. अच्.
48: अकच m. (-चः) Name of KETU, the dragon's tail, or descending node. mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Bald, destitute of hair. E. अ priv. and कच hair: this applies to KETU, as the symbol of the asterism is a headless trunk.
49: अकण्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Free from thorns, literally or metaphorically. E. अ priv. कण्टक a thorn.
50: अकथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) Not to be mentioned or spoken of; also similar forms as अकयनीय &c. E. अ neg. कथ to speak, with the participial affixes यत् अनीयर् &c.
51: अकनिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A deified saint according to the Bauddhas. mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Elder, superior. E. अ priv. and कनिष्ठ youngest.
52: अकनिष्ठग m. (-गः) A deified saint according to the Bauddhas. E. अकनिष्ठ superior and गम to go; affix ड.
53: अकम्पित m. (-तः) The name of a Jaina saint, one of the pupils of the last Tīrthakara. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Firm, unshaken, not agitated or trembling. E. अ priv. कपि to tremble; the participial affix क्त, and इट् inserted.
54: अकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Maimed, handless. 2 Privileged, exempt from tax or duty. 3 One who does not act. E. अ priv. and कर the hand, tax, duty. f. (-रा) Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) E. अ priv. and कृञ to injure, अन् affix.
55: अकरणि m. (-णिः) Failure, disappointment, (it is used only as an imprecation,) as तस्याकरणिरेवास्तु may he fail. E. अ priv. कृञ to do, and अनि affix.
56: अकरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be done, improper or impracticable. E. अ neg. करणीय to be done.
57: अकरुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Unfeeling, void of compassion or tenderness. E. अ neg. करुणा tenderness.
58: अकर्क्कश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Soft, not hard. E. अ priv. and कर्क्कश hard.
59: अकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Deaf. E. अ priv. and कर्ण the ear.
61: अकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Not to be done, improper, impracticable. E. अ neg. कर्त्तव्य to be done.
62: अकर्म्मण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Not to be done, improper. E. अ neg. कर्म्मन् act, यत् aff.
63: अकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Idle, unoccupied, without work. 2 Degraded, no longer performing essential rites. n. (-र्म्म) 1 Absence of occupation. 2 Loss or neglect of essential observances. 3 Improper act, crime, offence. E. अ neg. कर्म्मन् act.
64: अकर्म्मकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Free from action, necessary as vital, or essential as religious. E. अ neg. कर्म्म act, कृत् who does.
65: अकल्क mfn. (-क्लः-ल्का-ल्कं) 1 Clear, clean. 2 Pure, sinless. 3 Free from sediment. f. (-ल्का) Moonlight. E. अ priv. and कल्क dirt.
66: अकल्कन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Humble, not proud, (this word is sometimes written अकल्कल.) E. अ priv. कल्क pride, and न or ल aff.
67: अकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Natural, not artificial, not made. E. अ neg. कल्पित made.
68: अकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Faultless, sinless. E. अ priv. कल्मष sin.
69: अकल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Sick, diseased. E. अ priv. कल्य well.
70: अकल्याण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Unlucky, inauspicious. E. अ neg. कल्याण prosperous.
71: अकस्मात् ind. 1 Immediately, instantly, presently. 2 Without a cause, without a wherefore. E. अ neg. कस्मात् from what.
72: अकाण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Sudden, unexpected. E. अ neg. काण्ड a stem.
73: अकाण्डजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suddenly born or produced. E. अकाण्ड and जात born.
74: अकाण्डपातजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perishing suddenly after birth, dying as soon as born. E. अकाण्ड, and पात perishing, जात born.
75: अकारण n. (-णं) Absence or non-existence of a cause. (Used adverbially,) Causelessly. E. अ neg. कारण cause.
76: अकारणोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born or produced without a cause. E. अकारण and उत्पन्न born.
77: अकार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Improper not to be done. n. (र्य्यं) An improper act. E. अ neg. कार्य्य to be done.
78: अकाल m. (-लः) Irregular or unusual, as time or season. E. अ neg. काल time.
79: अकालकुसुम m. (-मंः) A flower budding out of season. E. अकाल and कुमुम a flower.
80: अकालज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Unseasonable, produced out of time or season; also अकालजात, अकालोत्पन्न and similar compounds. E. अकाल with ज or जात &c. born or produced.
81: अकालजलदोदय m. (-यः) 1 A fog, or mist. 2 Unseasonable gathering of clouds. E. अ priv. and काल time, जलट् a cloud, and उदय rising.
82: अकालमेघोदय m. (-यः) 1 Unseasonable cloudiness. 2 A fog or mist. E. अकाल with मेघ a cloud, and उदय rising.
83: अकालसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Impatient, premature, not waiting for the proper season. E. अ neg. कालसह time-enduring.
84: अकिञ्चन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, indigent. E. अ priv. and किञ्चन any thing, something.
85: अकिञ्चनता f. (-ता) Voluntary poverty, one of the duties of a Jaina ascetic. E. अकिञ्चन and ता affix.
86: अकिल्विष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Faultless, free from sin. E. अ priv. किल्विष fault.
87: अकीर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Infamy, disgrace. E. अ reverse, कीर्त्ति fame.
88: अकुत्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unreproached, respectable. E. अ neg. कुत्सित bad.
89: अकुप्य n. (-प्यं) Gold or silver. E. अ neg. and कुण base metal.
90: अकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Low, mean, of low family. E. अ neg. कुल family.
91: अकुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Low, mean, of low origin or race. E. अ neg. कुलीन of family.
92: अकुशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Unlucky, inauspicious. 2 Clumsy, not clever. E. अ neg. कुशल lucky, clever.
93: अकूपार m. (-रः) 1 The sea or ocean. 2 A tortoise. 3 The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world. 4 A stone or rock. E. अ neg. कू the earth, and पृ to cherish, or अ neg. कू for कुत्सित contemptible, vile, and पार bank, boundary: there are other etymologies, and वृ being substituted for पृ, the word is sometimes written अकूवार.
94: अकूर्च्च m. (-र्च्चः) A deified saint, according to the Bauddhas. mfn. (-र्च्चः-र्च्चा-र्च्चं) Void of guile. E. अ priv. and कूर्च्च fraud.
95: अकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undone, neglected, incomplete. n. (-तं) Any act unperformed. E. अ neg. कृत done.
96: अकृतज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Ungrateful. E. अ neg. कृतज्ञ grateful.
97: अकृतज्ञता f. (-ता) Ingratitude. E. ता added to अकृतज्ञ.
98: अकृतज्ञत्व n. (-त्वं) Ingratitude. E. त्व added to अकृतज्ञ.
99: अकृतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Not identified or made one with oneself, especially in a spiritual sense, not one with spirit, or God. E. अकृत unmade, आत्मन् self.
100: अकृतित्व n. (-त्वं) Awkwardness, clumsiness, unfitness. E. अकृतिन् and त्व aff.
101: अकृतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Awkward, stupid, incapable of or unfit for doing any thing. E. अ neg. कृ to do, इन् aff. and त augment.
102: अकृत्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Natural, inartificial, not made. E. अ. neg. कृतिम artificial.
103: अकृप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Unmerciful, unkind. E. अ neg. कृपा mercy.
104: अकृपण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Liberal, not miserly. E. अ neg. कृपण miserly.
105: अकृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Full, entire. 2 Strong, fierce. E. अ neg. कृश little.
106: अकृष्णकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Innocent. E. अ neg. and कृष्णकर्म्मन् guilty.
107: अकेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Bald, hairless. E. अ neg. कश hair.
108: अकोट m. (-टः) The betel-nut tree. (Areca faufel or catechu.) E. अ neg. and कुट to be crooked, because it grows with a straight stem.
109: अकोविद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Stupid, ignorant. E. अ neg. कोविद् clever.
110: अक्का f. (-क्का) A mother. E. अक pain, कै to sound.
111: अक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तां) 1 Joined, combined. 2 Gone. 3 Spread abroad. 4 Anointed. E. अञ्ज to go, and क्त affix.
112: अक्तु f. (-क्तुः) Night, (on the authority of the Vedas.) E. अञ्ज to go, and क्तु affix.
113: अक्रम m. (-मः) Want of order or arrangement, confusion, irregularity. E. अ priv. and क्रम order.
114: अक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Unpassed, unsurpassed. 2 Unconquered. f. (-त्तः) The egg-plant. (Solanum melongena.) E. अ neg. and क्रान्त passed.
115: अक्रोध m. (-धः) Dispassionateness, restraint of anger, one of the ten duties of an ascetic. mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Dispassionate. E. अ meg. and क्रोध anger.
116: अक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Inactive, dull, torpid. 2 Abstaining from religious rites. f. (-या) Inactivity, neglect of what ought to be done. E. अ neg. किया act.
117: अक्रियत्व n. (-त्वं) Inactivity, torpor. त्व added to the preceding. also अक्रियता.
118: अक्रूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Gentle, not cruel. m. (-रः) The paternal uncle and friend of KṚṢṆA. E. अ neg. क्रूर cruel.
119: अक्लेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Incapable of distress or pain. 2 Unfit to be pained or distressed. E. अ neg. क्लेद्य to be pained.
120: अक्लम m. (-मः) Absence of weariness or fatigue. E. अ priv. and क्लम fatigue.
121: अक्लान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Unwearied. E. अ neg. and क्लान्त wearied.
122: अक्लिष्ट mfn. (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Unvexed, not distressed or annoyed. 2 Unwearied, indefatigable. E. अ neg. क्लिष्ट wearied.
123: अक्लेश m. (-शः) Absence of weariness or vexation. E. अ neg. क्लेश distress.
124: अक्लिका f. (-का) The indigo plant. (Indigofera tinctoria.)
125: अक्ष r. 1st and 3d cl. (अक्षति अक्ष्णोति) 1 To reach or obtain. 2 To pervade. 3 To accumulate.
126: अक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A die, cubic or oblong, for playing with. 2 Part of a car. 3 A wheel. 4 A car. 5 A snake. 6 Law suit, legal proceedings. 7 Sacred knowledge. 8 The soul. 9 A seed of which Rosaries are made, in which sense it occurs mostly in composition, as, Rudrākṣa, Indrākṣa. 10 A Karṣa or weight of sixteen māṣas. 11 A tree bearing a medicinal fruit. (Terminalia belerica.) 12 A proper name. the son of RĀVAṆA. 13 A name of GARUḌA. 14 A person born blind. 15 Terrestrial latitude. n. (-क्षं) 1 An organ of sense. 2 Sea salt. 3 Blue vitriol. E. अशु to pervade, Uṇādi affix स.
127: अक्षक m. (-कः) A tree. (Dalbergia Oujeiniensis, Rox.) E. अक्ष Beleric myrobalan, and क affix: from its resembling that plant; or the termination being a pleonastic affix, the word may have all the senses of the preceding: also read अक्षिक.
128: अक्षकर्ण n. (-र्णः) 1 The hypothenuse, especially of the triangle formed with the gnomon of a dial and its shadow. 2 (In astronomy.) Argument of the latitude.
129: अक्षत n. (-तं) 1 Fried grain, (in this sense it is also used in the mas. plu. -ताः). 2 A eunuch. 3 Whole grain. f. (-ता) A plant, named also Kāṅkarasriṅgī. mfn. (-त-ता-तं.) 1 Uninjured, unhurt. 2 Whole, unbroken. E. अ neg. and क्षत torn, broken, &c.
130: अक्षतयोनि f. (-निः) A virgin. E. अक्षत and योनि pudendum.
131: अक्षदर्शक m. (-कः) A judge. E. अक्ष a law suit, दर्शक who sees; from दृश to see.
132: अक्षद्यू m. (-द्यूः) A gambler, a dicer. E. अक्ष dice and द्यू who plays.
133: अक्षद्यूत m. (-तः) A gambler, a dicer. n. (-तंः) Gambling. E अक्ष and द्यूत play or who plays: also अक्षद्यूत्.
134: अक्षद्यूतिक n. (-कं) Dispute at play. E. अक्ष and द्यूत with ठक् aff.
135: अक्षदृश् m. (-दृक्) A judge. E. अक्ष a law suit, and दृश् who sees.
136: अक्षदेविन् m. (-वी) A gamester. E. अक्ष a dice, and देविन् a player.
137: अक्षधर m. (-रः) A plant, (Trophis aspera.) See साखोट. mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) One who holds dice &c. E. अक्ष and धर what holds.
138: अक्षधूर्त्त m. (-त्तः) A gamester, a gambler. E. अक्ष dice, and धूचै a rogue.
139: अक्षधूर्त्तिल m. (-लः) A bull, an ox. E. अक्ष a cart, धूर् its forepart, or धुर् a load, and तिल affix.
140: अक्षपाट m. (-टः) An arena, a boxing or wrestling ground; also read अक्षवाट.
141: अक्षपाटक m. (-कः) A judge. E. अक्ष law suit, and पाट to arrange, affix वुन्.
142: अक्षपाटिक m. (-कः) A judge. E. as before with टक् aff.
143: अक्षपाद m. (-दः) A follower of the Nyāya system of philosophy. E. अक्ष contest, and पाद who goes; the Nyāya is the logical school; also आक्षपाद.
144: अक्षभाग m. (-गः) A degree of latitude. E. अक्ष and भाग a part.
145: अक्षम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Impatient, intolerant. 2 Unable, incompetent, impotent. f. (-मा) 1 Impatience, intolerance. 2 Envy, impatience of another's success. 3 Inability, incapacity. E. अ neg. क्षमा patience.
146: अक्षमता f. (-ता) Impatience, &c. See the last.
148: अक्षमाला f. (-ला) 1 A rosary, a string of beads, especially of the seeds of the Eleocarpus. 2 The name of ARUNDHATĪ, wife of VAŚIṢṬHA, (from her wearing a rosary.) E. अक्ष a kind of seed or bead, and माला a necklace.
149: अक्षय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Durable, permanent, imperishable. f. (-या) The seventh day of a lunar month, which happens on a Sunday or Monday, and the fourth, which falls on a Wednesday. E. अ neg. and क्षै to waste or decay, aff. अच्.
150: अक्षयता f. (-ता) Durability, imperishableness. E. ता added to the preceding.
151: अक्षयतृतीया f. (-या) The third day of the lunar half of the month Vaiśākha. (April-May.) E. अक्षय durable, and तृतीया the third day: the consequences of meritorious actions performed on this day being permanent, as it is the first day of the Satya Yuga or the anniversary of creation.
152: अक्षयत्व n. (-त्वं) Imperishableness. E. त्व added to अक्षय.
153: अक्षयलोक m. (-कं) Heaven, the imperishable world or region. E. अक्षय and लोक world.
154: अक्षर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. n. (-रं) BRAHM, the supreme being, (in this sense it is sometimes mas.) 2 Eternal beatitude, or exemption from further transmigration. 3 Religious austerity. 4 Moral merit. 5 The sky or atmosphere. 6 A letter of the alphabet. 7 A plant. (Achyranthes aspera.) 8 Water (in the dialect of the Vedas.) mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Unalterable. 2 Unperishable, undecayable. E. अशू to pervade, and सर Uṇādi affix.
155: अक्षरचञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A scribe, a writer. E. अक्षर letter, and चञ्च affix.
156: अक्षरचण m. (-णः) A scribe. E. अक्षर a letter, and चण affix.
157: अक्षरचन m. (-नः) A scribe. E. See the last word.
158: अक्षरचुञ्चु m. (-ञ्चः) A scribe, a writer. See अक्षरचञ्च.
159: अक्षरजननी f. (-नी) A pen. E. अक्षर a letter, and जननी a mother.
160: अक्षरजीवक m. (-कः) A scribe. E. अक्षर a letter, and जीवक who lives, i. e. who gets a livelihood by letters; also अक्षरजीविक and अक्षरजीविन्.
161: अक्षरतूलिका f. (-का) A pen. E. अक्षर a letter, and तूलिका a brush.
162: अक्षरविन्यास m. (-सः) 1 Scripture, a writing. 2 The alphabet. E. अक्षर a letter, and विन्यास assemblage.
163: अक्षरमुख (-खः) A scholar, a student. E. अक्षर a letter, and मुख commencement.
164: अक्षरसंस्थान n. (-नं) Scripture, a writing. E. अक्षर a letter, and अंस्थान placing, collecting.
165: अक्षवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a die, &c. f. (-ती) Gaming, playing with dice. E. अक्ष a die, and मतुप् possessive affix.
166: अक्षवाट m. (-टः) An amphitheatre for wrestling, the arena of a gymnasium. E. अक्ष contest, and वाट an enclosure, an area.
167: अक्षविद् mfn. (-वित्) Versed in law, or in play. E. अक्ष law or dice, and विद् who knows.
168: अक्षसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A rosary, a string of elaeocarpus seeds so used. E. अक्ष and सूत्र a thread.
169: अक्षांश m. (-शः) A degree of latitude. E. अंक्ष and अंश a part.
170: अक्षाग्र n. (-ग्रं) 1 The fore part of a car. 2 The axle or bar to which the wheels are attached E. अक्ष and अग्र fore part.
171: अक्षाग्रकीलक m. (-कः) The pin of the axle of a carriage, the linchpin, also one at the extremity of the pole. E. अक्ष a cart, अग्र fore part, and कीलक a pin or bolt.
172: अक्षान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Impatience, intolerance. 2 Envy, impatience of another's superiority or success. E. अ neg. and क्षान्ति sufferance.
173: अक्षारलवण n. (-णं) Such food as may be eaten during a season of mourning, religious observance, &c. as cow's milk, ghee, rice, kidney-beans, barley, sesamum, and sea or river salt. E. अ neg. क्षार alkali, लवण salt.
174: अक्षि n. (-क्षि) The eye. E. अश to pervade, and सि affix.
175: अक्षिक m. (-कः) A tree, (Dalbergia Oujeiniensis.) See also अक्ष.
176: अक्षिकूटक n. (-कः) The eye-ball. E. अक्षि the eye, and कूटक a globe, or ball.
177: अक्षिगोल m. (-लः) The ball or globe of the eye. E. अक्षि and गोल ball.
178: अक्षिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hateful, hated, disliked. E. अक्षि the eye, and गत gone.
179: अक्षितारा f. (-रा) The pupil of the eye. E. अक्षि and तारा a star.
180: अक्षिपक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) The eye lash. E. अक्षि and पलक्ष्मन् lash.
181: अक्षिपटल n. (-ल) A coat of the eye. E. अक्षि and पटल a coat.
182: अक्षिभेषज m. (-जः) A tree, (Pale Lodh.) See गालव. n. (-वं) Any medicament or collyrium for the eye. E. अक्षि the eye, and भेषज a remedy.
183: अक्षिव m. (-वः) A plant. (Morunga). n. (-वं) Sea-salt. See अक्षीव.
184: अक्षिविकूशित n. (-तं) A glance or side look; one with the eye lids partly closed. E. अक्षि the eye, and कूशित from कूश to contract, with वि prefixed.
185: अक्षीव m. (-वः) A plant. (Guilandina or Hyperanthera morunga.) n. (-वं) Sea-salt. E. अक्ष to pervade, ईव aff: it is also written अक्षिव and अक्षीव. mfn. (-व-वा-वं) Sober, not intoxicated. E. neg. and क्षीव intoxicated.
186: अक्षुण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 1 Unpared, uncut, not comminuted. 2 Inexpert. 3 Unconquered. E. अ neg. क्षुण्ण cut.
187: अक्षुण्णता f. (-ता) 1 Entireness, fulness. 2 Want of practice or conversancy. E. अ neg. क्षुण्णता spareness.
188: अक्षुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Unshaken, undisturbed, unagitated. E. अ neg. क्षब्ध shaken.
189: अक्षोट m. (-टः) 1 A tree, (described as a Pilu, growing in the hills.) See पीलु. 2 A walnut. 3 A tree bearing an oily nut, (Aleurites triloba.) Also written आखोट. E. अक्ष to pervade, and ओट aff.
190: अक्षोड m. (-डः) See the preceding word, also आखोड. E. अक्ष to pervade, and ओड aff.
191: अक्षोडक m. (-कः) See अक्षोड. E. अक्षोड and कन् aff.
192: अक्षोभ m. (-भः) 1 Firmness, absence of agitation. 2 The post to which an elephant is tied. mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Unshaken, unagitated. E. अ priv. क्षोभ shaking.
193: अक्षोभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unshaken, unagitated, firm. E. अ neg. क्षोभित shaken.
194: अक्षौहिणी f. (-णी) A complete army, consisting of 1,09,350 foot, 65,610 horse, 21,870 chariots, and 21,870 elephants. E. अक्ष a carriage, ऊहिणी assemblage.
195: अक्ष्ण n. (-क्ष्णं) Time. E. अश to eat, and क्स्न Uṇādi aff.
196: अखट्टि m. (-ट्टिः) Childish fancy, whim, caprice. E. अ neg. and खट to desire, undesirable by the wise.
197: अखण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) All, entire. E. अ neg. and खण्ड a part.
198: अखण्डन n. (-नं) 1 Time. 2 Leaving entire. 3 Admitting, non-refutation. E. अ neg. खडि to break, and ल्युट् aff.
199: अखण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unbroken, undivided. 2 Undisturbed, uninterrupted, continuous. 3 Unrefuted. E. अ neg. खण्डित divided.
200: अखण्डितर्त्तु mfn. (-र्त्तुः-र्त्तुः-र्त्तु) Fruitful, bearing fruit in due season. E. अ neg. खण्डित broken, and ऋतु season.
201: अखात mn. (-तः-तं) 1 A natural pond or lake. 2 A pool before a temple. Sometimes written आखात. E. अ neg. and खात dug.
202: अखाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Improper to be eaten. E. अ neg. खाद्य to be eaten.
203: अखादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uneaten. E. अ neg. खादित eaten.
204: अखिन्न mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unwearied, indefatigable. E. अ neg. खिन्न wearied.
205: अखिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) All, entire. E. अ neg. and खिल separated.
206: अख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unknown, obscure, not famous or notorious. E. अ neg. ख्यात famed.
207: अख्याति f. (-तिः) Disrepute, want of fame. E. अ neg. ख्याति fame.
208: अग r. 1st cl. (अगति) To wind or move tortuously. See अक. With an indicatory इ। अगि (अंगति) To go, move or approach.
209: अग m. (-गः) 1 A tree. 2 The sun. 3 A mountain. 4 A snake. 5 Moving crookedly, twining, twisting. E. अ neg. and ग who goes, from गम to go, or अग to go tortuously, अच् aff.
210: अगच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree. E. अ neg. and गच्छ, from गम to go.
211: अगज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Mountainous, produced on a mountain. 2 Vegetable, produced from a tree. E. अग and ज born.
212: अगणनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be numbered or reckoned, also अगण्य, अगणितव्य, &c. E. अ neg. गणनीय to be numbered.
213: अगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not reckoned, uncounted. E. अ neg. गणित counted.
214: अगद m. (-दः) A medicament, a medicine, a drug. mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Well, healthy, free from disease. 2 Wholesome, salubrious. E. अ neg. and गद disease.
215: अगदङ्कार m. (-रः) A physician. E. अगद well, healthy, and कार who makes.
216: अगन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Not to be visited or approached, also अगमनीय, अगम्य, &c. E. अ neg. गन्तव्य to be gone.
217: अगम m. (-मः) 1 A tree. 2 A mountain. E. अ priv. and गम who goes.
218: अगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Not to be visited or approached. 2 Difficult of acquirement, unattainable. 3 Unequalled, unsurpassable. E. अ neg. गम्य to be gone to.
219: अगम्यरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Of superior and unequalled form or nature. E. अगम्य and रूप form.
220: अगरी f. (-री) A kind of grass, vulg. Deotar. See देवताड. E. अ neg. and गर poison: an antidote.
221: अगरु mn. (-रुः-रु) Agallochum, (Aquilaria agallocha, Rox.) See अगुरु.
222: अगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Modest, humble, void of pride. E. अ neg. गर्व्व pride.
223: अगस्ति m. (-स्तिः) 1 The name of a saint, celebrated in Hindu mythology, more usually entitled AGASTYA, the son of both MITRA and VARUṆA, by URVAŚĪ; he is represented of short stature, and is said by some to have been born in a water jar: he is famed for having swallowed the ocean, when it had given him offence; at his command also, the VINDHYA range of mountains prostrated itself, and so remains; hence his present appellation: he is also considered as the regent of the star Canopus. 2 The name of a tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) E. अग a mountain, and स्ति, with an adventitious meaning, to fix, or in the second instance, to be fixed; also अग as before, and स्ति Uṇādi aff.
224: अगस्तिद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) See अगस्ति. E. अगस्ति, and द्रु a tree.
225: अगस्त्य m. (-स्त्यः) 1 The name of a saint. 2 A tree. 3 The star Canopus. See अगलि.
226: अगात्मजा f. (-जा) A name of PĀRVATĪ, the daughter of the mountain or Himālaya. E. अग a mountain, and आत्मजा daughter.
227: अगाध n. (-धः) A hole, a chasm. mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Very deep, bottomless. E. अ neg. गाध fixed place.
228: अगाधजल m. (-लः) A lake. E. अगाध deep, जल water.
229: अगाधता f. (-ता) Depth. E. अगाध and ता aff.
230: अगाधत्व n. (-त्वं) Depth. E. अगाध and त्व aff.
231: अगार n. (-रं) A house. See आगार. E. अग a mountain, and ऋ to go; rising like a hill.
232: अगिन m. (-नः) The sun. E. अग to go, इन aff.
233: अगिर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 A demon. E. अग to go, and इर aff.
234: अगुण m. (-णः) A defect, a fault. mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Void of good qualities, bad. 2 Void of attributes. E. अ neg. गुण qualities.
235: अगुणता (-ता) Absence of all good qualities; also अगुणत्वं. E. अ neg. गुण with ता or त्व aff.
236: अगुणवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Censorious, pointing out defects. E. अगुण and वादिन् declaring.
237: अगुरु mn. (-रुः-रु) 1 A fragrant wood, aloe wood, or agallochum, (Aquilaria agallocha, Rox.) 2 Another tree which produces Bdellium, (Amyris agallocha.) 3 A timber tree, commonly Sisū, (Dalbergia sisu, Rox.) mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रू or-र्व्वी-रु) Light, not heavy. E. अ priv. and गुरु heavy.
238: अगुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Unhidden, unconcealed. 2 One who cannot keep a secret. E. अ neg. गुप्त concealed.
239: अगुरुशिंशपा f. (-पा) A timber tree, (Dalbergia sisu.) The best authorities consider this as formed of two distinct words. See अगुरु and शिंशपा.
240: अगूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Unhidden, unconcealed, manifest, evident. 2 One who is not secret. E. अ neg. गूढ hidden.
241: अगूढगन्ध n. (-न्धं) Asafoetida. E. अगूढ and गन्ध smell.
242: अगूढभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Open, honest, candid; one whose purpose or inclinations are evident. E. अगूढ and भाव nature.
243: अगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Covert, unseen, unwitnessed. n. (-रं) 1 Absence, unconsciousness; not being witnessed or known. 2 Any act or event not the object of the senses. 3 The imperceptible, BRAHMA, or the invisible Supreme. E. अ neg. गोचर object of sense.
244: अगौकस् m. (-काः) 1 A bird. 2 A lion. 3 The Śarabha, a fabulous animal with eight legs. E. अग a tree or mountain, ओकस् a house.
245: अग्नायी f. (-यी) 1 A goddess, the wife of AGNI, the deity of fire, and presiding over prayers accompanied with burnt offerings. 2 The Tretā or second age of the Hindus. E. अग्नि fire, and fem. aff. ङीप्, with आय substituted for ऐ inserted.
246: अग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 Fire, always associated with the idea of the deity presiding over it, and who is worshipped by the Hindus. AGNI is also regent of the south-east quarter. 2 A consecrated fire. 3 The fire of the stomach, the digestive faculty, appetite. 4 Bile. 5 Gold. 6 A plant of which the fruit has escharotic properties, (Semecarpus anacardium.) 7 Another plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.) E. अङ्ग to mark, and नि Uṇādi aff, ङ being dropped.
247: अग्निक m. (-कः) An insect of a scarlet color, the lady-bird. E. अग्नि fire, and क aff. resembling fire.
248: अग्निकण m. (-णः) A spark. E. अग्नि fire, and कण a small particle.
249: अग्निकारिका f. (-का) Maintaining a sacrificial fire, &c. E. अग्नि fire, and कारिका making, from कृ to do.
250: अग्निकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Caused by fire. E. अग्नि and कारित caused.
251: अग्निकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Maintaining a sacred fire. E. अग्नि and कार्य्य act.
252: अग्निकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Agallochum. See अगुरु. E. अग्नि fire, and काष्ठ wood.
253: अग्निकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A firebrand, a lighted wisp of straw. E. अग्नि fire, and कुक्कुट a wisp of lighted straw.
254: अग्निकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done with or made by fire, offered with fire. E. अग्नि and कृत done.
255: अग्निकोण m. (-णः) The east. E. अग्नि and कोण corner.
256: अग्निक्रीडा f. (-डा) Illuminations, fireworks, &c. E. अग्नि and क्रीडा play
257: अग्निगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 The sun-stone, crystal, or a fabulous gem; supposed to contain and impart solar heat. 2 A plant. f. (-र्भा) The name of another plant. E. अग्नि and गर्भ the womb.
258: अग्निचित् m. (-चित्) A householder who has placed and consecrated a sacrificial fire. E. अग्नि fire, and चित् who collects.
259: अग्निचित्या f. (-त्या) Maintaining a sacred fire. E. अग्नि and चित्या collecting.
260: अग्निज m. (-जः) A plant used in medicine, of stimulant properties. mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Produced by or producing fire, also अग्निजात. 2 Digestive. E. अग्रि fire, and ज who or what is born, from जन.
261: अग्निजार m. (-रः) A medicinal plant. See अग्निज.
262: अग्निजाल m. (-लः) A medicinal plant. See अग्निज.
263: अग्निजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) 1 A medicinal plant. See लाङ्गलिकी. 2 A flame of fire. E. अग्नि, and जिह्वा the tongue, growing like a flame of fire.
264: अग्निज्वाला f. (-ला) 1 A flame of fire. 2 A plant bearing red blossoms used by dyers, (Grislea tomentosa, Rox.) 3 Another plant, commonly Jalapippalī. E. अग्नि and ज्वाला flame, from the fiery colour of its blossoms.
265: अग्नित्रेता f. (-ता) The aggregate of the three fires maintained by the Brahman householder, the Gārhapatya or domestic, Ahavanīya or consecrated, and Dakṣiṇa or southern. E. अग्नि and त्रेता triad.
266: अग्निद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Setting on fire, incendiary. 2 Supplying with fire. 3 Stomachic, tonic, digestive. E. अग्नि and द what gives.
267: अग्निदमनी f. (-नी) A medicinal plant, of narcotic properties, (Solanum jacquini.) See कण्ठकारिका. E. अग्रि bile, and दमनी what tames.
268: अग्निदग्ध m. (-ग्धः) A Pitṛ or progenitor to whom oblations are made. mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Burnt. E. अग्नि and दग्ध burnt.
269: अग्निदीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Blazing, on fire. 2 Digestive. f. (-प्ता) The name of a plant. E. अग्नि and दीप्त inflamed.
270: अग्निदेव m. (-वः) 1 AGNI, the god of fire. 2 A worshipper of fire. f. (-वा) A name of the third lunar mansion, identified with the Pleiades: AGNI being the ruling deity of the constellation, Also अग्निदेवता.
271: अग्निदैवत्य n. (-त्यं) The supremacy or divinity of fire. E. अग्नि and दैवत्य divinity.
272: अग्निनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) The name of a plant, also अग्निजार. E. अग्नि and निर्य्यास decoction or extract.
273: अग्निपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Cooked or dressed with fire. E. अग्नि and पक्क mature.
274: अग्निपरिच्छद n. (-दं) The implements and apparatus used in oblations to fire. E. अग्नि and परिच्छद accompaniments.
275: अग्निपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) The fiery ordeal, by a heated iron or boiling oil, or passing through fire. E. अग्नि and परीक्षा trial.
276: अग्निप्रस्तर m. (-रः) Fire-stone, flint, or any stone producing fire. E. अग्नि and प्रस्तर a stone.
277: अग्निभ m. (-भः) Gold. E. अग्नि and भ for भा lustre, brilliant as fire.
278: अग्निभू m. (-भूः) A name of SKANDA, the Hindu deity of war. See कार्त्तिकेय and स्कन्द. E. अग्नि and भू being; being, or born, from fire. ŚIVA having cast his seed into flame, for the purpose of generating a warrior, able to subdue TĀRAKA, a demon, SKANDA was produced. n. (-भु) Water, which is generated, in the Hindu cosmogony, from fire.
279: अग्निभूति m. (-तिः) A proper name. One of the pupils of the last Jaina saint. E. अग्नि and भूति superhuman power: equal to AGNI.
280: अग्निमणि m. (-णिः) The sun-stone. E. अग्नि and मणि a jewel or gem, brilliant as fire.
281: अग्निमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत) 1 Having a consecrated fire. 2 Having fire in general. E. अग्नि and मतुप् poss. aff.
282: अग्निमन्थ m. (-न्यः) A small tree, (Premna spinosa.) E. अग्नि and मन्य churning, because fire is produced by friction of two pieces of its wood.
283: अग्निमारुति m. (-तिः) A name of the saint, AGASTYA. E. अग्नि fire, i. e. the fire of the stomach, the digestive faculty, and मारुति a name of HANUMĀN; because the saint could digest as well as the monkey: the epithet alludes to a story of his devouring and digesting VĀTĀPI, a demon, who had assumed the form of a sheep.
284: अग्निमुख m. (-खः) 1 A deity. 2 A Brahman. E. अग्नि and मुख the mouth; oblations to the gods passing through fire as their mouths. 2 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.) 4 Marking nut, (Semecarpus anacardium.) (In this sense it is also fem. -खी.) E. as before, from its marking like fire.
285: अग्निरक्षण n. (-णं) Maintenance of a sacred fire; preserving a fire in a family for perpetuity, which supplies that lighted on occasions of worship. E. अग्नि and रक्षण preserving.
286: अग्निरक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Maintaining a sacred fire. E. अग्नि and रक्षित preserved.
287: अग्निरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Being without fire, especially a sacred fire. 2 Devoid of appetite. E. अग्नि and रहित lost.
288: अग्निरजस् m. (-जाः) An insect of a scarlet color. E. अग्नि and रजस् dust or farina.
289: अग्निरुहा f. (-हा) The name of a plant.
290: अग्निवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Hot, scalding, scorching. E. अग्नि and वर्ण quality; of the property of fire.
291: अग्निवर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Tonic, stomachic. 2 Feeding or exciting fire. E. अग्नि and वर्द्धक what augments.
292: अग्निवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Exciting fire. 2 Improving the appetite. m. (-नः) A stomachic or any thing improving the appetite. E. अग्नि and बर्द्धन increasing.
293: अग्निवल्लभ m. (-भः) Resin, pitch. E. अग्नि and वल्लभ a friend, from its exciting or befriending fire.
294: अग्निवाण m. (-णः) A fiery arrow, a rocket.
295: अग्निवाह m. (-णः) Smoke. E. अग्नि and वाह what bears.
296: अग्निवाहु m. (-हुः) Smoke. E. अग्नि and वाहु the arm.
297: अग्निविसर्प m. (-र्पः) Pain from a boil. E. अग्नि and विसर्प a boil.
298: अग्निवीज n. (-जं) Gold. E. अग्नि and वीज seed.
299: अग्निवीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Gold. E. अग्नि and वीर्य्य power.
300: अग्निवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Improved digestion, appetite. 2 Increase of fire. E. अग्नि and वृद्धि increase.
301: अग्निशिख m. (-खः) 1 A lamp. 2 An arrow. 3 A fiery arrow, a rocket. 4 The Safflower plant, (Carthamus tinctorius.) mn. (-खः-खं) Saffron, the plant and die. f. (-खा) 1 Flame. 2 A plant. (Gloriosa superba.) 3 A medicinal plant, (Menispermum cordifolium.) E. अग्नि and शिखा a crest or flame or splendor.
302: अग्निशेखर m. (-रः) Saffron. E. अग्नि and शेखर a crest.
303: अग्निष्टुत् f. (-ष्टुत) An expiatory sacrifice. E. अग्नि and ष्टु to sacrifice, aff. क्विप् with तुक् added.
304: अग्निष्टोम m. (-मः) A sacrifice, or rather a series of offerings to fire for five days, to be celebrated in the spring. E. अग्नि and स्तोम oblation, burnt-offering.
305: अग्निष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) An iron frying-pan. mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Placed in or on fire. E. अग्नि and ष्ठ what stays or remains, from स्था to stand.
306: अग्निष्वात्त m. pl. (-त्ताः) Demigods or manes to whom funeral oblations are presented. They are said to be the sons of MARĪCI, and progenitors especially of the gods. E. अग्नि, स्व own, and आत्त taken, who receive what is offered them by fire as their own.
307: अग्निसंस्कार m. (-रः) Any ceremony performed with the consecrated fire. E. अग्नि, संस्कार purification.
308: अग्निसख m. (-खः) The wind. E. अग्नि and सखि friend.
309: अग्निसम्भव m. (-वः) Wild safflower. mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Originating from fire. E. अग्नि and सम्भव born.
310: अग्निसहाय m. (-यः) 1 A pigeon. 2 The wind. E. अग्नि and सहाय a friend.
311: अग्निसार n. (-रं) A medicinal application to the eyes, a collyrium from the calx of brass. E. अग्नि and सार strength, essence.
312: अग्निहोत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Maintenance of a perpetual or sacred fire. m. (-त्रः) 1 Fire. 2 Ghee. E. अग्नि and होत्र oblation with fire, burnt offerings.
313: अग्निहोत्रिन् m. (-त्री) One who maintains a perpetual and sacred fire; this is sometimes read अग्निहोतृ. nom. (-ता) E. अग्निहोत्र, and णिनि, or हु to sacrifice, तृन् aff.
314: अग्नीध् m. (-ग्नीत्) A priest who attends the fire. E. अग्नि, ईन्ध to excite, क्विप् aff.
315: अग्नीध्र m. (-ध्रः) An officiating priest, whose duty is to attend the fire. f. (ध्रा) Exciting the sacrificial fire. E. अग्नि and ईन्ध, to light or kindle; and the aff. रन्; the न of इन्ध being dropped.
316: अग्नीन्धन n. (-नं) Exciting a sacrificial fire. E. अग्नि and इन्धन kindling, exciting.
317: अग्न्यभाव m. (-वः) 1 Loss or extinction of the sacred fire. 2 Loss of appetite. E. अग्नि, अभाव non-existence.
318: अग्न्यस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Fire-arms; in poetry, it is usually applied to a superhuman power over the element of fire, but occasionally indicates, apparently, a rocket. E. अग्नि, अस्त्र a weapon.
319: अग्न्यागार m. (-रः) A fire-temple; a chamber or building where the sacred fire is kept. E. अग्नि, आगार house.
320: अग्न्याधान n. (-नं) Maintenance of a perpetual and sacred fire. E. अग्नि and आधान preserving.
321: अग्न्याधेय n. (-यं) Consecration of a perpetual fire. E. अग्नि, आधेय placing.
322: अग्न्यालय m. (-यः) 1 A place in which consecrated fire is kept. 2 A hole, with compartments of prescribed dimensions and shape, for the several sacred fires. E. अग्नि and आलय an asylum.
323: अग्न्याहित m. (-तः) A householder who maintains a perpetual fire; also आहिताग्नि. E. अग्नि, आहित preserved; by whom.
324: अग्न्युत्पात m. (-तः) A fiery meteor, a falling star, a comet. E. अग्नि and उत्पात् portent.
325: अग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 Chief, principal. 2 Prior, first. 3 Excessive, more, much. 4 Excellent, best. n. (-ग्रं) 1 Front, fore part. 2 Top, summit, upper part. 3 End, point. 4 Goal, resting place. 5 Assemblage, multitude. 6 A weight equal to one Pala. 7 Limited alms, (four mouthfuls.) 8 (In astronomy) the sun's amplitude. E. अगि to go, and the Uṇādi aff. रन् the nasal of the derivative is dropped.
326: अग्रकर m. (-रः) 1 The tip of the extended hand. 2 The right or better hand. 3 The extremity of a ray of light; the focal point. E. अग्र, कर hand or ray.
327: अग्रगण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be reckoned or considered as first or best. E. अग्र and गण्य to be counted.
328: अग्रगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Preceding; going before. E. अग्र, गामिन् who goes.
329: अग्रज m. (-जः) 1 An elder brother; the first-born. 2 A Brahman. mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) First-born or produced. E. अग्र first, ज who is born.
330: अग्रजङ्घा f. (-ङ्घा) The fore part of the thigh. E. अग्र the first part, and जङ्घा thigh.
331: अग्रजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) 1 A priest or Brahman; a man of the sacerdotal tribe. 2 An elder brother or first-born. 3 BRAHMĀ, the first-born of the gods. E. अग्र first or best, and जन्मन् birth.
332: अग्रजातक m. (-कः) A Brahman; a man of the first class. E. अग्र, and जातक who is born.
333: अग्रजाति m. (-तिः) A Brahman; a man of the first class. E. अग्र and जाति race, class.
334: अग्रज्या f. (-ज्या) (In astronomy) Sine of the amplitude.
335: अग्रणी mfn. (-णीः-णीः-णि) First, principal. E. अग्र and नी, from णीञ् to lead, aff. क्विप्.
336: अग्रतःसर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Going before, preceding. m. (-रः) A leader. E. अग्रतस्, and सर, who goes, from सृ with अच् or ट aff. to go.
337: अग्रतस् ind. 1 Before, in front. 2 Before in rank, &c. E. अग्र and तस् aff.
338: अग्रदानिन् m. (-नी) A degraded Brahman; one who receives the presents of Śūdras, or things first offered to the deceased. E. अग्र, दान gift, इनि poss. aff.
339: अग्रनिरूपण n. (-णं) Determining beforehand, prophecy, predestination. E. अग्र, निरूपण declaring.
340: अग्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, cowage, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. अग्र, पर्ण leaf.
341: अग्रपाणि m. (-णिः) 1 The tip of the hand. 2 The right hand. E. अग्र, पाणि the hand.
342: अग्रभाग m. (-गः) 1 Part of the top or end. 2 Fore or top part. 3 (In astronomy) Degree of amplitude, also अग्रांशः. E. अग्र, भाग part.
343: अग्रभूमि mf. (मिः) A goal, an object, the place or thing to be attained. E. अग्र before, भूमि earth.
344: अग्रमांस n. (-सं) The heart. E. अग्र principal, and मांस, flesh.
345: अग्रयान n. (-नं) Advancing before an army, for the purpose of defiance; military ardor or daring. E. अग्र and यान going.
346: अग्रवीज m. (-जः) A viviparous plant, as the Gomphroena globosa, &c. E. अग्र in front, and वीज seed.
347: अग्रसन्धानी f. (-नी) The register of human actions, kept by YAMA, the judge of the dead. E. अग्र first, and सं, preposition, with धा to take; recording all actions from the original birth.
348: अग्रसर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Preceding, going before, a leader. E. अग्र and सर who goes.
349: अग्रह m. (-हः) An anchorite, a man who has retired from the world. E. अ neg. and ग्रह a house, being no longer a householder.
350: अग्रहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be taken, accepted or acquired. E. अ neg. ग्रहणीय to be taken.
351: अग्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) 1 The tip of the extended hand. 2 The tip of an elephant's trunk. 2 The right or better hand. E. अग्र, हल hand, &c.
352: अग्रहायण m. (-णः) The name of a month; the eighth of the lunar year of the Hindus, when the moon is full near the head of Orion, or about November-December. E. अग्र and हायन, year; according to the ancient system, the first month of the Hindu year: also आग्रहायण.
353: अग्रहार m. (-रः) 1 An endowment of lands or villages conferred upon Brahmans. 2 A field of corn. E. अग्र chief (tribe), हृ to take, घञ् aff.
355: अग्रांशु m. (-शुः) The extreme ray or point of a ray of light, the focal point. E. अग्र, अंशु a ray.
356: अग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Not fit or proper to be accepted. 2 Not to be attained. 3 Not to be trusted or consented to. E. अ neg. ग्राह्य to be taken.
357: अग्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Chief, principal, best. 2 Elder, elder born. f. (-मा) The name of a fruit, (Annona reticulata.) See लवनी. E. अग्र and डिमच् aff.
358: अग्रिय m. (-यः) An elder brother. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) chief, principal. E. अग्र and इय or ईय aff. whence also अग्रीय.
359: अग्रु f. (-ग्रुः) A finger. E. अग to go, and रु aff.
360: अग्रेगा m. (-गाः) A leader, a preceder. E. अग्रे in front, गा who goes.
361: अग्रेगू m. (-गूः) A leader. E. अग्रे, ग from गम to go, and ऊ Uṇādi aff.
362: अग्रेदिधिषु m. (-षुः) A man of either of the three first classes, whose wife has been before married, and has borne him children. E. अग्रे principal, and दिघिषु the husband of a twice married woman. f. (-षुः) A younger sister married before her elder; also अग्रेदिघिषू.
363: अग्रेवन n. (-नं) The skirts of a wood. E. अग्रे the fore-part, and वन a wood.
364: अग्रेसर m. (-रः) A leader. mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Preceding, going before. E. अग्रे in front, and सर who goes.
365: अग्रेसरिक m. (-कः) A leader. E. अग्रे in front, and सरिक who goes.
366: अग्र्य mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं) Chief, principal. m. (-ग्र्यः) An elder brother. E. अग्र, and यत् aff.
367: अघ r. 1st cl. With an indicatory इ। यघि (अंघति.) 1 To go. 2 To go swiftly. 3 To begin moving. 4 To begin. 5 To blame or censure. r. 10th cl. (अघयति) To sin, to commit sin.
368: अघ n. (-घं) 1 Sin. 2 Pain. 3 Passion. m. (-घः) Name of a demon; the general of KAṂSA. E. अघ to go, and अच् affix, removed by charity, &c.
369: अघनाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Purifying, freeing from sin. E. अघ, and नाशक what destroys.
370: अघनाशन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Purifying, freeing from sin. m. (-नः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 An expiator. E. अघ and नाशन destroyer.
371: अघमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sinful, identical with or fruitful in sin. E. अघ and मयट् aff.
372: अघमर्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) An expiatory prayer: reciting mentally a particular passage from the Vedas, while a little water, in the palm of the right hand, is held to the nose; this forms a part of the daily ceremonies of the Brahmans. m. (-णः) The author of the passage recited upon the above occasion. E. अघ sin, and मृष to bear with, or to sprinkle, युच aff.
373: अघर्म्म mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मा-र्म्मं) Cool, not warm. E. अ neg. घर्म्म hot.
374: अघर्म्मधामन् m. (-मा) The moon, as the source of coolness. E. अघर्म्म cool, धामन् vesture.
375: अघवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wicked, vicious, sinful. E. अघ sin, मतुप् aff.
376: अघाह n. (-हः) Time or day of impurity, consequent on the death of a relative, &c. E. अघ and अहन् day.
377: अघृण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Unkind, cruel. E. अ neg. घृणा compassion.
378: अघोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Formidable, terrible. m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A worshipper of ŚIVA and DEVĪ in their terrific forms. f. (-रा) The fourteenth day of the dark half of the month Bhadra, upon which ŚIVA is worshipped. E. अ implying resemblance, and धोर formidable.
379: अघोरपथिन् m. (-पन्थ) A worshipper of the terrific forms of SIVA and DURGĀ. E. अघोर and पथिन् a road.
380: अघोष mfn. (-ष-षा-षं) 1 Without noise. 2 Without cowherd, (a country.) E. अ neg. घोष noise, &c.
381: अघोस् ind. A vocative particle: the final स is usually dropped in composition, as अघोयज, ho, pay worship. E. अ neg. हन to kill, and ओस् aff.
382: अघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-घ्ना) A cow. घ्न f. (घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) 1 Inviolable, not to be slain. E. अ neg. हन to kill, and अक Uṇādi aff.
383: अङ्क (क, त) r. 10th cl. (अङ्कयति) 1 To number or count. 2 To mark.
384: अङ्क n. (-ङ्कं) 1 A mark or spot. 2 The flank or part above the hips. 3 A species of dramatic entertainment. 4 The act of a play, &c. 5 Fault, offence. 6 A line, a stroke. 7 Mimic war or conflict. 8 Ornament, decoration. 9 Place, abode. 10 Proximity, proximate. 11 A chapter or section. 12 The body. 13 A cypher, an arithmetical sign. E. अञ्च to go, and the Uṇādi affix क; or अङ्क to stain or spot, अच् aff.
385: अङ्कति m. (-तिः) 1 A Brahman who maintains a sacred fire. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 Fire. 4 Air, wind. E. अञ्च to go, and the Uṇādi aff. अति; च being changed to क.
386: अङ्कन n. (-नं) 1 Cyphering, writing or making cyphers. 2 Stamping, impressing, making marks. E. अङ्क to mark, ल्युट् aff.
387: अङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be marked. 2 To be numbered. E. अङ्क to mark, अनीयर् aff.
388: अङ्कपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Turning on the side. E. अङ्क and परिवर्त्तन turning.
389: अङ्कपालिका f. (-का) An embrace, embracing. E. अङ्क the flank, and पालिका or पाली, nourishing.
390: अङ्कपाली f. (-ली) 1 An embrace, embracing. 2 A nurse. 3 A plant, (Piring or Medicago esculenta.) E. See अङ्कपालिका.
391: अङ्कभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Resting or placed upon the side or hip. E. अङ्क and भाज् possessing.
392: अङ्कयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be marked. 2 To be numbered. E. अङ्क to mark, तव्य aff.
393: अङ्कविद्या f. (-द्या) Arithmetic. E. अङ्क and विद्या science.
394: अङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Marked, spotted. 2 Counted, numbered. E. अङ्क to mark, and participial aff. क्त.
395: अङ्की f. (-की) A small oblong drum. E. अङ्क the hip or flank, being carried upon that part.
396: अङ्कुट m. (-टः) A key. E. अकि to go, उटि aff.
397: अङ्कुर m. (-रः) 1 A shoot or sprout. 2 The hair of the body. 3 Blood. 4 Water. E. अङ्क to stain, and Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
398: अङ्कुरक m. (-कः) A nest. E. अङ्कुर a shoot, and कन् aff.
399: अङ्कुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Budded, sprouted, germinated. E. अङ्कुर and इतच् aff.
400: अङ्कुश mn. (-शः-शं) The hook used to drive an elephant. E. अक to go, and उशच् Uṇādi aff. with नुम् inserted.
401: अङ्कुशग्रह m. (-हः) An elephant-driver. E. अङ्कुश् --, and ग्रह who takes.
402: अङ्कुशदुर्द्धर m. (-रः) A restive elephant. E. अङ्कुश, and टुर् bad, difficult, धर who holds: who is ill restrained by the goad.
403: अङ्कुशी f. (-शी) One of the twenty-four female deities peculiar to the Jainas, supposed to preside more immediately over human beings. E. अङ्कुश, and ङीप् fem. aff. having or holding a hook.
404: अङ्कूष m. (-रः) A sprout, a germin. E. See अङ्कुर, उ being made long.
405: अङ्कूष mn. (-षः-षं) The hook or goad for driving an elephant. E. See अङ्कुश, उ being made long.
406: अङ्कोट m. (-टः) A plant: also अङ्कोठ. E. अङ्क to mark or stain, ओट aff.
407: अङ्कोठ m. (-ठः) A plant, (Alangium hexapetalum.) E. See अङ्कोट, ठ being used for ट.
408: अङ्कोल m. (-लः) A plant. See अङ्कोट; also अङ्कालक.
409: अङ्कोल्लसार m. (-रः) A kind of poison, probably prepared from the plant अङ्कोल, or अंकोट. E. अङ्कोल, and सार essence.
410: अङ्कोल्लिका f. (-का) Embracing, an embrace. E. अङ्क the side, उत् pre. and ल, from ला, to take.
411: अङ्क्य mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं) 1 To be counted. 2 To be marked. m. (-ङ्क्यः) A small oblong drum. See अङ्की. E. अङ्क to mark, aff. यत्; or अङ्क the hip, and य aff.
412: अङ्ग (क, त) r. 10th cl. (अंगयति) 1 To mark. 2 To count. See अङ्क.
413: अङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A limb or member. 2 A division of Hindu learning, comprehending such science as is considered dependant upon the Vedas, hence also called Vedāṅga; works on six subjects come under this description, viz. pronunciation, grammar, prosody, explanation of obscure terms, description of religious rites, and astronomy. 3 The body. 4 An expedient, a means of success. 5 Mind, understanding. 6 A term in grammar, the inflective root, with the affix subjoined-7 (Sing. only,) Chief, principal. 8 Inferior, secondary. 9 All  the dramatis personoe of a play, except the hero and heroine, the body of the characters. 10 (In rhetoric.) An incidental passion or figure, illustrative of, but subordinate to the main object of the description. 11 A scriptural work in the Jain religion; there are twelve works so named. m. (ङ्गः) A country, Bengal proper, including Bhāgalpur. mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Corporeal, embodied. 2 Near, proximate. Ind. 1 A vocative particle. 2 Again, further, the rather. 3 A particle of assent used in composition, with ई substituted for the vowel termination, as in अङ्गीकरण, &c.
414: अङ्गक n. (-कं) 1 The body, &c. See the preceding. f. (अङ्गिका) A bodice or jacket. mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) Relating to the body, &c. E. अङ्ग, कन् added.
415: अङ्गग्रह m. (-हः) Bodily pain. E. अङ्ग, and ग्रह what seizes.
416: अङ्गज (-जः) mfn. (-जः-जा-जं). 1 Produced or born of the body. n. (-जं) 1 Blood. 2 Love, desire. 3 The hair of the head. 4 Sickness, disease. 5 A son. f. (-जा) A daughter. E. अङ्ग the body, and ज what is born; also similar compounds, as अङ्गजात, अङ्गजन्म, &c.
417: अङ्गण n. (-णं) A court, or yard. See अङ्गन.
418: अङ्गति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A name of KṚṢṆA. 3 Fire. 4 A Brahman, who has preserved a sacred fire. E. अगि to go, and अति aff.
419: अङ्गद m. (-दः) 1 The name of a celebrated monkey, one of the heroes of the Rāmāyaṇa, the son of BĀLI. n. (-दं) A bracelet worn upon the upper arm. f. (-दा) The female elephant of the south. E. अङ्ग the body, and दे to nourish, or दै to cleanse, aff. ड.
420: अङ्गन n. (-नं) 1 A court or yard. 2 Going, moving. f. (-ना) 1 A woman, a female. 2 The sign Virgo. 3 The female elephant of the north. E. अगि to go, and यच् aff.
421: अङ्गनागण n. (-णं) A number of women. E. अङ्गना and गण troop.
422: अङ्गनाजन m. (-नः) A female, a female person. E. अङ्गना and जन a being.
423: अङ्गनाप्रिय m. (-यः) A plant, (Jonesia asoka.) See अशोक. E. अङ्गना a woman, and प्रिय, beloved; worship being performed by women to this plant.
424: अङ्गन्यास m. (-सः) Touching various parts of the body, as a religious ceremony. E. अङ्ग, and न्यास arrangement.
425: अङ्गपालि m. (-लिः) Embracing, an embrace. E. अङ्ग, and पाल to nourish, इन् aff.
426: अङ्गप्रायश्चित्त n. (-त्तं) Expiation for bodily impurity, especially the oblation offered by the heir at the first funeral obsequies, to remove the impurity contracted during the period of mourning. E. अङ्ग body and प्रायश्चित्त expiation.
427: अङ्गमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A servant, whose business it is to rub and knead the body. E. अङ्ग, मृद् to rub, and अच् aff. Also अङ्गमर्द्दकः and अङ्गमर्द्दन.
428: अङ्गरक्त n. (-क्तं) A plant, vulg. Śuṇḍārocanī. See रक्ताङ्ग. E. अङ्ग, and रक्त red, giving a red dye.
429: अङ्गरक्षिणी f. (-णी) 1 Armour, coat of mail, thick quilting, or an iron netting worn upon the body. 2 A garment. E. अङ्ग, and रक्षिणी what preserves.
430: अङ्गराग m. (-गः) Perfuming the body after cleansing; smearing it with unguents of sandal, &c. E. अङ्ग, and राग colouring.
431: अङ्गराज् m. (-राट्) A name of KARṆA, king of Aṅga, the son of KUNTĪ by SŪRYA. See कर्ण. E. अङ्ग the country so named, and राज् a king; also अङ्गराजा and अङ्गराज.
432: अङ्गरुह n. (-हं) Hair of the body, wool, fleece, down. E. अङ्ग, and रुह what rises on.
433: अङ्गलोड्य m. (-ड्यः) Ginger, (Amomum zinziber.) See चिञ्चाटक. E. अङ्ग, and लोड, to be mad, aff. यत्; exciting or stimulating the body.
434: अङ्गस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A subdivision of a branch of science or philosophy. E. अङ्ग a part of science, and स्कन्ध division.
435: अङ्गव m. (-वः) A dried or withered fruit. E. अङ्ग and य, from वै to dry or wither.
436: अङ्गविकृति m. (-तिः) Syncope, apoplexy. E. अङ्ग, and विकृति change of condition.
437: अङ्गविक्षेप m. (-पः) Gesture, gesticulation. E. अङ्ग, and विक्षेप throwing, moving.
438: अङ्गवैकृत n. (-तं) Sign, token, hint. E. अङ्ग, and वैकृत change of form, &c.
439: अङ्गसंस्कार m. (-रः) Embellishment of person, dressing, cleansing or perfuming it. E. अङ्ग, and संस्कार making perfect.
440: अङ्गसंहति f. (-तिः) Bodily strength, or symmetry. E. अङ्ग, and संहति compactness.
441: अङ्गसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Bodily union or contact, coition. E. अङ्ग, and सङ्ग union.
442: अङ्गहार m. (-रः) Gesture, gesticulation. E. अङ्ग, and हार taking, moving; also अङ्गहारि.
444: अङ्गहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mutilated, maimed, defective. E. अङ्ग a limb, हीन deprived of.
445: अङ्गाङ्गि ind. Body and body, implying contact or co-operation. E. अङ्ग repeated with इ aff.
446: अङ्गाङ्गिभाव m. (-वः) Personal relation or co-operation. E. अङ्गाङ्गि, and भाव nature.
447: अङ्गाधिप m. (-पः) A name of KARṆA, king of Aṅga. See कर्ण. E. अङ्ग the country, अधिप a ruler.
448: अङ्गार mn. (-रः-रं) Charcoal, whether burning or not, but more usually the latter. m. (-रः) A name of the planet Mars; from his fiery colour. E. अगि to go, and आरन् aff.
449: अङ्गारक m. (-कः) 1 The planet Mars. 2 Charcoal, burning or extinguished. 3 Yellow or white amaranth. See कुरुण्ठक. 4 Another plant, (Eclipta or Verbesina prostrata.) See भृङ्गराज. n. (-कं) A medicated oil, prepared by boiling turmeric and various vegetable substances in common oil. E. अङ्गार and कन् affix; resembling a burning brand.
450: अङ्गारकमणि m. (-णिः) Coral. E. अङ्गारक, and मणि a gem.
451: अङ्गारधानिका f. (-का) A small portable fire-place or fire-pan. E. अङ्गार, and घानिका what holds, from धा root, with the affs. ल्युट्, कन् and टाप्.
452: अङ्गारपरिपाचित n. (-तं) Roasted food. E. अङ्गार, and परिपाचित cooked.
453: अङ्गारपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A name of CITRARATHA, chief of the Gandharbas.
454: अङ्गारपुष्प m. (-पः) A plant, vulg. Ingua. See इङ्गुदी. The seeds are used for rosaries, &c. E. अङ्गार, and पुष्प a flower; the flowers supposed to resemble coals.
455: अङ्गारमञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) A tree, or shrub, (Cesalpinia bonducella.) E. अङ्गार, and मञ्जी a pedicle, compared to a coal.
456: अङ्गारवल्लरी f. (-री) 1 A species of Karanja, (Galedupa arborea.) 2 Another plant, (Ovieda verticillata, Rox.) E. अङ्गार and वल्लरी a compound pedicle.
458: अङ्गारशकटी f. (-टी) A small portable fire-pan. E. अङ्गार and शकटी a little cart.
459: अङ्गारि f. (रिः) A small portable fire-pan. E. अङ्गार and इन् aff.
460: अङ्गारिका f. (-क) 1 The stalk of the Sugarcane. 2 The bud of the Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.) E. अङ्गार, and कन् and टाप् affs.
461: अङ्गारिणी f. (-णी) 1 A small portable fire-place. 2 The quarter from which the sun has departed. E. अङ्गार, and णिनि poss. aff. and fem. ङीप्.
462: अङ्गारित n. (-तं) The early blossom of the Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa). mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Burnt. 2 Charred. E. अङ्गार, and इतच् aff.
463: अङ्गिका f. (-का) A kind of bodice or jacket. E. अङ्ग the body, and इकन् aff.
464: अङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) 1 Corporeal, bodily. 2 Limbed, having limbs or members. 3 Chief, principal. E. अङ्ग and इनि aff.
465: अङ्गिरस् m. (-राः) The name of a Ṛṣi or saint, born of BRAHMĀ, one of the seven principal sages; in one legend identified with fire, and apparently an astronomical personification, having for, his sons UTATHYA and VṚHASPATI, and for daughters Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Rākā, and Anumati. E. अगि to go, and असि Uṇādi aff. with इरक् inserted.
466: अङ्गीकरण n. (-णं) Promising, agreeing, assenting. E. अङ्ग a particle of assent, करण doing, च्ची inserted.
467: अङ्गीकार m. (-रः) An agreement, a promise. E. अङ्ग a particle of asseveration, and कार making, from कृ to do. घञ inserted.
468: अङ्गीकृत n. (-तः-ता-तं) Agreed, promised. E. अङ्गी as before, and कृत participle of कृ.
469: अङ्गुरि f. (-रिः) 1 A finger. 2 A toe, also written अङ्गुरी. See अङ्गुलि. E. अङ्ग to count, and उरी Uṇādi aff.
470: अङ्गुरीय mn. (-यः-यं) A finger-ring. See अङ्गुलीयक. E. अङ्गुरी a finger, and य aff.
471: अङ्गुरीयक mn. (-कः-कं) A finger-ring. See अङ्गुरीयक. E. कन् affixed to the preceding.
472: अङ्गुल m. (-लः) 1 The thumb. 2 A finger. 3 A measure of eight barley corns. 4 The name of a saint. See वत्स्यायन. 5 A digit, or one-twelfth part of any dimension. E. अङ्ग to count, and उल aff.
473: अङ्गुलि f. (-लिः) 1 A finger. 2 The tip of an elephant's trunk. 3 A toe; also अङ्गली. E. अङ्ग to count, and उलि Uṇādi aff.
474: अङ्गुलितोरण n. (-णं) Three semicircular lines drawn across the forehead, with sandal, &c. a sectarial mark, especially of the followers of Śakti. E. अङ्गुलि a finger, and तोरण the ornamented arch of a gateway, to which the mark made by the fingers upon the forehead may be compared.
475: अङ्गुलित्र n. (-त्रं) A guard for the finger, applied to the bowstring used by archers. E. अङ्गुलि, and त्र what protects.
476: अङ्गुलित्राण n. (-णं) See the last. E. अङ्गुलि, and त्राण what protects.
477: अङ्गुलिमुख n. (-खं) The tip of the finger. E. अङ्गुलि, and मुख end.
478: अङ्गुलिमुद्रा f. (-द्रा) A seal ring. E. अङ्गुलि, and मुद्रा a seal; also अङ्गुलिमुद्रिका.
479: अङ्गुलिमोटन n. (-नं) Cracking, or snapping the finger joints. E. अङ्गुलि, and मोटन rubbing, from मुट aff. ल्युट्.
480: अङ्गुलिसन्देश m. (-शः) 1 Snapping the finger joints. 2 Making signs, talking with the fingers. E. अङ्गुलि, and सन्देश information.
481: अङ्गुलिस्फोटन n. (-नं) Snapping the fingers. E. अङ्गुलि, and स्फोटन bursting.
482: अङ्गुली f. (-ली) 1 A finger. 2 The tip of an elephant's trunk. See अङ्गुलि.
483: अङ्गुलीक mn. (-कः-कं) A finger ring. E. अङ्गुली, and कन् aff.
484: अङ्गुलीपञ्चक n. (-कं) The five fingers collectively. E. अङ्गुली, and पञ्चक a five.
485: अङ्गुलीयक n. (-कं) A finger ring. E. see अङ्गुरीयक.
486: अङ्गुलीसम्भूत m. (-तः) A finger nail. E. अङ्गुली, and सम्भूत born, produced.
487: अङ्गुष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The thumb. E. अङ्गु here said to be the hand, and ष्ठ, from स्था to stay.
488: अङ्गूष m. (-षः) 1 An ichneumon. 2 An arrow. E. अगि to go, and ऊषः Uṇādi aff.
489: अङ्घस् n. (-घः) Sin. E. अघि to go, and असि aff.
490: अङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) 1 A foot. 2 The root of a tree. E. हन to kill, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff. the formative is irregular. See अंह्रि.
491: अङ्घ्रिनामक m. (-कः) The root of a tree, being named from a foot; every synonym of a foot, being also that of the root of a tree. E. अङ्घ्रि, and नामक name.
492: अङ्घ्रिनामन् n. (-म) The root of a tree. E. अङ्घ्रि a foot or root, and नामन् a name. See the last.
493: अङ्घ्रिप m. (-पः) A tree. See अंह्रिप. E. अङ्घ्रि a root, and प, from पा to drink.
494: अङ्घ्रिपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant. See अङ्घ्रिवल्लिका. E. अङ्घ्रि, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीप्, the leaves rising from the root.
495: अङ्घ्रिवल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides, Rox.) E. अङ्घ्रि, and वल्लिका a pedicle.
496: अच r. 1st cl. (उ) or (ञ-इ) (अचति) (अंचति अंचते) 1 To go, to go to or towards. 2 To worship. 3 To speak indistinctly. See अञ्च.
497: अचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) A bad or contracted eye. mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्ष) Eyeless, sightless. E. अ priv. or dim, and चक्षुस् the eye.
498: अचण्ड mfn. f. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डी-ण्डं) Gentle, not passionate. (-ण्डी) 1 A tractable cow. 2 A mild and gentle woman. E. अ neg. and चण्डं passionate.
499: अचपल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Steady, not fickle. E. अ neg. चपल unsteady.
500: अचल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fixed, immoveable. m. (-लः) 1 A mountain. 2 A pin or bolt. f. (-ला) The earth. E. अ not, and चल who goes, from चल and अच् aff.
501: अचलकीला f. (-ला) The earth. E. अचल a mountain, कील a bolt.
502: अचलत्विष् m. (त्विट्) The Koil or Indian cuckoo. E. अचल mountain, and त्विष् light.
503: अचलाधिप m. (-पः) The king of mountains, the personified Himālaya; also analogous compounds, as अचलेन्द्रः, अचलेश्वरः, &c. E. अचल and अधिप king.
504: अचलभ्रातृ m. (-ता) The name of a Jaina saint, one of the eleven pupils of the last pontiff. E. अचल and भ्रातृ brother.
505: अचापल्य n. (-ल्यं) Firmness, steadiness, consistency: also अचपलता, &c. E. च neg. चापल्य in constancy.
506: अचिन्त mfn. (न्तः-न्ता-न्तं-) Insensible, inanimate. E. अ neg. चिन्ता reflexion.
507: अचिन्तता f. (-ता) Insensibility, want of sense or intellect. E. ता added to the last.
508: अचिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Disregard, absence of thought or consideration. E. अ neg. चिन्ता thought.
509: अचिन्तित mfn. (-त-ता-तं) 1 Unthought of, unexpected. 2 Disregarded. E. अ neg. चिन्तित considered.
510: अचिन्त्य mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं) Inconceivable, unimaginable, incomprehensible. E. अ neg. चिन्त्य conceivable.
511: अचिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Brief, momentary, not long. (-रा) A proper name, the mother of ŚĀNTI, the sixteenth Jaina saint. E. अ neg. चिर long.
512: अचिरद्युति f. (-तिः) Lightning. E. अ neg. चिर long, and द्युति light.
513: अचिरप्रभा f. (-भा) Lightning. E. अचिर as before, and प्रभा light.
514: अचिररोचिस् f. (-चिः) Lightning. E. अचिर as before, and रोचिस् light.
515: अचिरांशु f. (-शुः) Lightning. E. अचिर and अंशु a ray.
516: अचिरात् ind. Directly, without delay. E. अ neg. and चिरात् from length of time.
517: अचिराभा f. (-भा) Lightning. E. अचिर as above, and भा light, with आङ prefixed.
518: अचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Insensible, unconscious, devoid of reason or feeling. E. अ neg. चेतना consciousness.
519: अचैतन्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Unconsciousness, insensibility. 2 The material universe, as opposed to spiritual being or God. 3 Ignorance, especially spiritual. E. अ neg. चैतन्य intellect.
520: अच्युत m. (-तः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU; also of KṚṢṆA, as a form of VIṢṆU. 2 A shrub (Morinda tinctoria.) mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fixed, permanent. E. अ neg. and च्युत participle of च्युङ to go.
521: अच्युतवास m. (-सः) The religious fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. अच्युत VIṢṆU, वास abode.
522: अच्युताग्रज m. (जः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA. 2 A name of INDRA. E. अच्युत KṚṢṆA as VIṢṆU, and अग्रज elder born.
523: अच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) Clear, transparent. m. (-च्छः) 1 A bear. 2 Crystal. ind. Fronting, before, in presence of. E. अ neg. or comparative, and च्छो to cut, aff. ड.
524: अच्छभल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A bear. This is sometimes considered as two words. See अच्छ and भल्ल. E. अच्छ in front of, and भल्ल to kill.
525: अच्छेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Not to be cut, incapable of injury or comminution. E. अ neg. छेद्य to be cut.
526: अज r. 1st cl. (अजति) 1 To go. 2 To blame, or censure: the root is irregular, वी being substituted for it before many of the inflections, as विवाय, वीयात्, &c. with an indicatory इ। अजि r. 10th cl. (अञ्जयति) To shine.
527: अज m. (-जः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 Also of VIṢṆU. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 Also of KĀMA or CUPID. 5 A proper name, the son of RAGHU, and father of DĀŚARATHA. 6 A he-goat. 7 A sheep. 8 A mineral substance. See माक्षिक. f. (-जा) 1 A she-goat. 2 Illusion, the unreality of the universe, personified as Śakti. mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Unborn. E. अ neg. and ज born, unborn; or अज to go, aff. अच्.
528: अजकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The ear of a goat. 2 A tree, (Terminalia alata tomentosa, Rox.) See असन. E. अज a goat, कर्ण an ear; the leaf being compared to the ear of a goat.
529: अजकर्णक m. (-कः) A tree, vulg. Śāl, (Shorea robusta, Rox.) See शाल. E. क affixed to the preceding, denoting resemblance.
530: अजकव m. (-वः) The bow of ŚIVA. See अजकाव अजगव, &c. E. अज VIṢṆU, and क BRAHMĀ, with ब aff. BRAHMĀ being placed in the centre, and VIṢṆU on the upper part.
531: अजकाव m. (-वः) See अजकव. E. as before, अ being made आ.
532: अजगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Ocymum gratissimum.) E. अज a goat, and गन्ध small; smelling like a goat.
533: अजगन्धिका f. (-का) A plant, (Ocymum gratissimum.) See अजगन्धा.
534: अजगन्धिनी f. (-नी) A plant. See अजशृङ्गी. E. See अजगन्धा.
535: अजगर m. (-रः) The Bor, or Boa, a large serpent. (Boa constrictor.) E. अज a goat, and गर who swallows, from गृ with अच् aff.
536: अजगव n. (-वं) The bow of ŚIVA. See अजकव, &c.
538: अजजीविक m. (-कः) A goatherd. E. अज, and जीविक who lives or gets a livelihood by goats.
539: अजटा f. (-टा) The name of a plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) Also written अञ्झडा and अञ्झटा. E. अ neg. and जट a fibrous root; or अ and जड foolish, brightening the intellects.
540: अजथ्या f. (-थ्या) A plant, (Yellow jasmin.) E. अज, and थ्यन् aff. of propriety or fitness.
541: अजनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One not a parent or producer, unproductive, ungenerative. E. अ neg. जनक generator.
542: अजननि m. (-निः) Privation of birth, used as an imprecation. See अकरणि, &c. Ex. अजननिरस्तु तस्य may he cease to exist. E. अ priv. and जननि birth.
543: अजन्त m. (-न्तः) (In grammar) A noun ending in a vowel. E. अच् the syllable including all the vowels, and अन्त end.
544: अजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Unborn. E. अ neg. जन्मन् birth.
545: अजन्य n. (-न्यं) A portent, an omen; any natural phenomenon, as an earthquake, &c. so considered. mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Not to be born or produced. E. अ neg. and जन्य birth.
546: अजप m. (-पः) 1 A reader of works considered heterodox. 2 A goatherd. f. (-पा) 1 A particular mantra or mystical formula employed by the Tāntrikas, the essence of which is in the letters H and S, whence it is termed the Haṃsa mantra. 2 ŚIVA and ŚAKTI combined, to which form, the mantra is particularly addressed. mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Who or what does not perform the Japa. 1 Cherishing or feeding goats. E. अ not, and जप silent prayer; or अज a goat, and प who protects.
547: अजमीढ m. (-ढः) A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA; the friend of AJA, i. e. E. अज VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, and ईह to seek, to love, with the participial क्त, the termination of the accusative is retained.
548: अजमोदा f. (-दा) 1 Common carroway, (Carum carui.) 2 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.) 3 A sort of parsley, (Apium involucratum;) this latter application is the one used in the dialects. E. अज a goat, and मोद what pleases, from मुट्.
550: अजय m. (-यः) Defeat. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unsurpassed, unsubdued, over whom or which no triumph is obtained. f. (-या) Hemp. E. अ neg. जय victory.
551: अजय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Invincible, not to be subdued or surpassed. E. अ neg. जय्य conquerable.
552: अजर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Friendship. 2 Imperishableness, exemption from infirmity or decay. mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Imperishable, undecaying. E. अ neg. and जर्य्य from जॄ to decay.
553: अजर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Imperishable, undecaying. f. (-रा) Aloes. E. अ neg. जरा decay.
555: अजलोमन् m. (-मा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. अज, and लोमन् the hair of the body, hair, wool.
556: अजशृङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant; described as a milky and thorny plant, with a fruit of a crooked figure, like a ram's horn, and used as a medicine for the eyes; vulg, Mera Śṛṅgī, and Kaṅkara Śṛṅgī. See कर्क्कटशृङ्गी. E. अज a ram, and शृङ्गी a horn.
557: अजस्र n. Adverbial. (-स्रं) Eternally, continually. E. अ neg. जस to let loose, and र aff.
558: अजहत्स्वार्था f. (-र्था) A figure of speech, metonymy, one name being put for another, as ‘the spears enter’ for the spearmen. E. अ neg. जहत् leaving, स्वार्थं sense.
559: अजहल्लिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) In grammar, a noun that does not vary its gender; even when it is used attributively. E. अजहत् not leaving, लिङ्ग gender.
560: अजहा mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Not relinquishing, not leaving. f. (-हा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. अज and ह, from हा to abandon.
561: अजागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Not wakeful, not awake. m. (-रः) A plant, (Eclipta or verbesina prostrata.) E. अ neg. and जागर wakeful.
562: अजाजी f. (-जी) Cumin seed. E. अज, a goat, and अज to go, affix ङीप्.
563: अजाजीव m. (-वः) A goatherd; also अजाजीविन् अजापालकः, &c. E. अजा a she goat, and जीव who lives.
564: अजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unborn, unproduced. E. अ neg. जात born.
565: अजातशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. अजात unborn, and शत्रु an enemy, who never made an enemy.
567: अजादनी f. (-नी) A small species of prickly nightshade. E. अज a goat, and अदन eating.
568: अजानेय m. (-यः) A horse of a good breed. See अजानेय. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearless, undaunted. E. See अजानेय the initial being made short.
569: अजान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) See female, छगलान्त्री. E. अज, and अन्त्र an entrail.
570: अजापालक m. (-कः) A goatherd. E. अजा a she goat, पाल to nourish, and वुन् aff.
571: अजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unconquered. 2 Unexcelled, unsurpassed. m. (-तः) 1 The second of the twenty-four principal Jaina Tīrthakaras or deified sages. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 A name of BUDDHA. 4 A name of ŚIVA. E. अ neg. and जित, participle of जि to conquer.
572: अजिन n. (-नं) A hide used as a seat, bed, &c. by the religious student; generally the hide of an antelope. E. अज to go, and the Uṇādi aff. इनच्.
573: अजिनपत्रा f. (-त्रा-त्री) A bat. E. अजिन a hide, and पत्र a wing.
574: अजिनयोनि m. (-निः) A deer, or antelope. E. अजिन a hide, and योनि place or origin.
575: अजिर n. (-रं) 1 A court or yard. 2 Air, wind. 3 The body. 4 An object of sense. 5 A frog. E. अज to go, and किरन् aff.
576: अजिह्म mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं) Straight, not crooked, literally or metaphorically; upright, sincere, honest, direct. m. (-ह्मः) A frog. E. अ neg. and जिह्म crooked.
577: अजिह्मग m. (-गः) An arrow. mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going or moving in a straight line. E. अजिह्म straight, direct, and ग what goes.
578: अजिह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Tongueless, having no tongue. m. (-ह्वः) A frog. E. अ neg. and जिह्व from जिह्वा a tongue.
579: अजीगर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A Ṛṣi, the father of ŚunaḥŚepha.
580: अजीर्ण n. (-र्णः) 1 Flatulency, indigestion. 2 Vigour, absence of old age or decay. mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Undigested. 2 Undecayed, unimpaired. E. अ neg. and जीर्ण old, digested.
581: अजीव m. (-वः) 1 Death. 2 Non-existence. mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Lifeless, dead. E. अ neg. and जीव life.
582: अजीवनि f. (-निः) Non-existence; used as an imprecation. See अकरणि, अजीवनिस्तस्य भूयात्. E. अ neg. जीव and अनि aff.
583: अजेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Invincible, not to be conquered or overcome. E. अ neg. जेतव्य conquerable.
584: अजेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Invincible, insuperable, not to be overcome or surpassed. E. अ neg. जेय to be conquered.
585: अजैकपाद m. (-दः) One of the eleven Rudras or deities so named, forms of ŚIVA. Sometimes read अज एकपाद. E. अज ŚIVA, एक one, and पाद a quarter, a part.
586: अज्जुका f. (-का) A courtezan, (in theatrical language.) E. अज to go, or here, to gain, and उकन् affix; sometimes read अर्ज्जुका, from अर्ज to earn, to gain.
587: अज्झटा f. (-टा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. अत् particle of surprise, and भट to be entangled.
588: अज्झल n. (-लं) A shield. E. अभ् to join, and अलच् aff.
589: अज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Ignorant, unwise, foolish. E. अ priv. and ज्ञ who knows.
590: अज्ञता f. (-ता) Ignorance; also अज्ञत्व. E. ता added to अज्ञ.
591: अज्ञत्व n. (-त्वं) Ignorance. E. अज्ञ and त्व aff.
592: अज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unknown. 2 Unknowing. E. अ neg. ज्ञात known.
593: अज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 Ignorance. 2 Spiritual ignorance, wordly illusion or belief in external appearances. mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, unwise. E. अ neg. and ज्ञान knowledge.
595: अज्ञानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Ignorant, unwise. E. अ neg. ज्ञानिन् knowing.
596: अज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Incomprehensible. E. अ neg. ज्ञेय to be known.
597: अञ्च r. 1st cl. (उ.) (अञ्चति) 1 To adore, to worship, to treat with respect, (ञ, उ.) (अंचति-ते) 2 To go, to approach. 3 To ask or beg. 4 To speak indistinctly. With प्र, to move in an eastern direction; with प्रति, to go westerly; with उत्, to go northerly; with अव, to move southerly; with परा, to turn aside or away. r. 1st and 10th cl. (अंचति अंचयति) To discriminate, to individualize, to possess especially. See अच.
598: अञ्चति m. (-तिः) Air, wind. E. अञ्च to go, and अति Uṇādi aff.
599: अञ्चल m. (-लः) The end or border of a cloth, veil, shawl, &c. E. अञ्च to go, and अलच् aff.
600: अञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Worshipped, revered. 2 Admired. 3 Gone. E. the participial derivative of अञ्च to worship, &c.
601: अञ्चितभ्रू f. (-भ्रूः) A woman having beautiful eye brows. E. अञ्चित, and भ्रू the brow.
602: अञ्ज r. 7th cl. (ध, ऊ, ञि.) (अनक्ति) 1 To make clear. 2 To anoint. 3 To be beautiful. 4 To go: with अभि, to anoint: with वि, to make manifest, to call into being, to create, to mark or designate.
603: अञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Anointing. 2 Going. 3 Making clear, distinct. 4 A collyrium or application to the eye lashes, to darken and improve them; a universal article of the eastern toilet. 5 Particular applications, as lamp black, antimony, and another kind. See रसाञ्जन. 6 Night. 7 Ink. 8 A term in rhetoric; the use of a word of several meanings in one specific sense, which is determined by the context. m. (-नः) 1 The elephant of the west. 2 A species of lizard. f. (-ना) 1 The mother of HANUMĀN. 3 A green lizard. (-नी) 3 A woman perfumed with sandal, &c. 4 A medicinal plant. See कटुका. E. अञ्ज to beautify or anoint, and ल्यु or ल्युट् aff.
604: अञ्जनकेशी f. (-शी) A vegetable perfume. See हट्ठविलासिनी. E. अञ्जन collyrium, केश hair, and ङीप् fem, affix; the fibres being like the crystals, perhaps, of antimony.
605: अञ्जनाधिका f. (-का) A kind of lizard. E. अञ्जन, and अधिक much, excessive.
606: अञ्जनाम्भस् n. (-म्भः) Eye-water, liquid collyrium. E. अञ्जन collyrium, and अम्भस् water.
607: अञ्जनावती f. (-ती) The female elephant of the north-east. E. अञ्जन, and वतुप् poss. aff.
608: अञ्जनिका f. (-का) 1 A species of lizard, (Lacerta anjaneya.) 2 A small mouse. E. अञ्जन, and इकन् affix, with the fem. termination: also read अञ्जलिका.
609: अञ्जलि m. (-लिः) 1 The cavity formed by putting the hands together, and hollowing the palms: being in this form carried to the forehead, it forms the appropriate salutation from inferiors of respectability to their superiors. 2 A measure, a Kuḍava. See कुडव. E. अञ्ज to go, and लिच् Uṇādi aff.
611: अञ्जलिकारिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of sensitive plant, (Mimosa natans,) or according to some, a different plant, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) E. अञ्जलि, and कारिका making; from the shape or closing of the petals, like the hollowed palms of the hand. 2 A doll, a puppet. E. as before.
612: अञ्जलिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Making salutations, civility, respect, E. अञ्जलि, and कर्म्मन् act.
613: अञ्जलिबन्धन n. (-नं) Making a salutation with the hands joined and applied to the forehead. E. अञ्जलि, and बन्धन binding.
614: अञ्जस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Straight, even, upright, (in morals.) E. अञ्ज to make clear, असच् aff.
615: अञ्जसा ind. 1 Soon, instantly. 2 Truly, justly. E. अञ्ज as before, षे to destroy, and क्विष् aff.
616: अञ्जि m. (-ञ्जिः) A superior, a commander, a sender. E. अजि to go, and कि aff.
617: अञ्जिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The sun. E. अञ्ज to make manifest, and इष्ठन् Uṇādi aff.
618: अञ्जीर n. (-रं) The fig tree, also its fruit. In Bengal, the word derived from this implies the Guava; the term has, possibly, been borrowed from the Persian انجير E. अञ्ज to make clear, and ईरन् aff.
619: अट r. 1st cl. (अटति) To move, to go or approach: with परि prefixed, to go round about, to roam, to rove, to ramble, to wander about, especially as a religious mendicant. 10th cl. (अटयति) To slight.
620: अट mf. (-टः-टा) 1 Going. 2 Roaming, wandering. E. अट, and अच् aff.
621: अटन n. (-नं) 1 Going. 2 Roaming about, leading a vagrant life. E. अट, and ल्युट् aff.
622: अटनि f. (-निः or नी) The notched extremity of a bow. E. अट to go, अनि affix, also with ङीष fem. termination.
623: अटरुष m. (-षः) A tree, (Justicia adhatoda.) E. अट here, disease, from अट to go, and रुष to destroy; destroying disease.
624: अटरूष m. (-षः) See the last word.
625: अटवि f. (-विः) A forest, or wood. E. अट to go, and अटि affix, or ङीष् being added अटवी ut infra; birds, &c. resting there.
626: अटविक m. (-कः) A wood-man, a forester. E. अटवि a wood, ठक aff.
628: अटवी f. (-वी) A forest, or grove. See अटवि.
629: अटाट्या f. (-ट्या) Roaming about as a devotee or religious mendicant. E. अट to go, frequentative form, affs. अच् and यप्
630: अट्ट r. 1st cl. (उ.) (अटृते) 1 To surpass or excel, to transgress or exceed. 2 To kill or hurt. 10th cl. (अट्टयति) 1 To slight. 2 To be small.
631: अट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 1 A room on the top of the house; but it is also applicable to other structures; as the back of an edifice, a fortified place in front of a building, a room on the top of a temporary hall, or a particular kind of building. 2 Much, excessive. n. (-ट्टं) Food, boiled rice especially. mfn. (-ट्टः-ट्टा-ट्टं) Dry, dried. E. अट्ट to go, surpass, or transcend, and घञ् aff.
633: अट्टन n. (-नं) A circular weapon, a kind of discus. E. अट्ट to kill or hurt, ल्युट् aff.
634: अट्टहास m. (-सः) Violent laughter, a horse-laugh. E. अट्ट excessive, and हास a laugh.
635: अट्टहासक m. (-कः) A plant, (Jasminum multiflorum.) E. अट्टहास, and कन्; resembling a laugh or smile on beauty's countenance; the comparison is common to the poets.
636: अट्टहासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Laughing, loudly and violently. m. (-सी) A name of ŚIVA. E. अट्टहास, and णिनि poss. aff.
637: अट्टाल m. (-लः) An upper room or pavilion, on the flat roof of an Indian house. E. अट्ट much, and अल to adorn.
638: अट्टालक m. (-कः) A room on the top of the house. E. अट्ट much, अल to adorn, and कन् aff.
639: अट्टालिका f. (-का) A palace, an upper-roomed house. E. as before, fem. form.
640: अट्टालिकाकार m. (-रः) A bricklayer, a mason, a builder; born of a Śūdra mother and painter father. E. अट्टालिका, and कार who enables.
641: अट्या f. (-ट्या) Wandering as a beggar or devotee. E. अट्ट to go. See अटा.
642: अठ r. 1st cl. (अठति) With a redundant इ। अठि (अंठते) To go, to go to or towards.
643: अड r. 1st cl. (अडति) To strive or endeavour. 5th cl. (अड्नोति) To occupy or possess, (peculiar to the Vedas.)
644: अड्ड r. 1st cl. (अड्डति) 1 To connect. 2 To solve, or demonstrate. 3 To strive, to endeavour. The radical penultimate is द, and the root is also written by VOPADEVA, अद्द.
645: अण r. 1st cl. (अणति) To sound, (ङ,) 4th cl. (अण्यते) To breathe, to live; with प्र, to exist, to live. See अन.
646: अणक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Inferior, low. E. अण to sound, अच् affix; and कन् affix of depreciation; also written अणक, and आणक.
647: अणव्य n. (-व्यं) A field bearing panic. E. अणु panic, and यत् aff.
648: अणि m. (-णिः) 1 A pin or bolt, at the extremity of the pole of a carriage, the pin of the axle. 2 The edge or point of a sharp weapon. 3 A limit, a boundary; also अणी. E. अण to sound, and इन् aff.
649: अणिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Subtility, infinite minuteness, moleculism. 2 The same considered as a superhuman faculty, to be acquired by austere devotion and the performance of magical rites, or as possessed by a deity. E. अण an atom, and इमनिच् aff.
650: अणीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very small. E. अणु small, and इयसुन् superlative aff.
651: अणु m. (-णुः) 1 An atom, a minute and elementary particle of matter. 2 A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum, Rox.) m. or mfn. (-णुः-ण्वी-णु) 1 Atomic, small, minute. E. अण to sound, and उ Uṇādi aff.
652: अणुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Skilful, clever. 2 Small, minute. E. अणु small, and कन् aff.
653: अणुत्व n. (-त्वं) The state or being of an atom, also अणता.
654: अणुभा f. (-भा) Lightning. E. अणु minute, and भा light.
