655: अणुरेणु f. (-णुः) Small particles of dust, a dust of atoms. E. अण, and रेणु dust.
656: अणुरेणुजाल n. (-लं) The moats in a sunbeam. E. अणुरेणु, and जाल assemblage.
659: अण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 1 An egg. 2 A testicle or the scrotum. 3 Semen genitale. 4 The musk bag, regarded as the scrotum of the deer. E. अम to go, and ड Uṇādi aff.
660: अण्डक m. (-कः) The scrotum. E. अण्ड scrotum, and कन् aff.
661: अण्डकोटरपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A plant, (perhaps Convolvulus argenteus.) See अजन्त्री.
663: अण्डकोष m. (-षः) 1 The scrotum. 2 The testicle. 3 A boundary. 4 The rind of a fruit. 5 Fruit. E. अण्ड a testicle, and कोश or कोष a sheathe.
664: अण्डकोषक m. (-कः) The scrotum. E. कन् added to the last.
665: अण्डज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Oviparous. m. (-जः) 1 A serpent. 2 A fish. 3 A bird. 4 A lizard. f. (-जा) Musk. E. अण्ड an egg, &c. and ज what is born, from जन.
666: अण्डाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Egg-shaped, oval, elliptical. m. (-रः) An oval, an ellipsis; also अण्डाकृति, &c.
667: अण्डालु m. (-लुः) A fish. E. अण्ड, and आलु, aff.
668: अण्डीर m. (-रः) 1 A man. 2 Strong, powerful. E. अण्ड, and ईर aff.
669: अण्वी f. (-ण्वी) A finger, (from the Vedas.)
670: अत r. 1st cl. (अतति) To go, to move or approach progressively and continually. With an indicatory इ। अति (अंतति) To bind.
671: अतएव ind. Even, thus, or hence, so, from this cause, &c.
672: अतट m. (-टः) A precipice. E. अ neg. and तट a bank.
673: अतथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) Untrue, false, unreal. E. अ neg. तथ्य true.
674: अतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः न्वी-नु) Large, great, not small or slight. E. अ neg. तनु minute.
675: अतन्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रः) Awake, active, alert. E. अ neg. तन्द्रा sloth.
676: अतन्द्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smart, active, energetical. E. अ neg. तन्द्रित slothful.
677: अतप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Cool. 2 Unanxious. 3 Unemployed. 4 Unostentatious. E. अ neg. तप ardor.
678: अतप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Cool, not heated. E. अ neg. तप्त heated.
679: अतर्क m. (-र्कः) Absence of reasoning, want of consideration. E. अ neg. तर्क consideration.
680: अतर्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unconsidered. 2 Unexpected, unweighed. adv. n. (-तं) Unexpectedly, suddenly. E. अ neg. अर्कित considered.
681: अतर्क्य mfn. (-र्क्यः-र्क्या-र्क्यं) Unsearchable, incomprehensible, inscrutable. E. अ neg. तर्क्य to be investigated.
682: अतर्पणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Insatiable. E. अ neg. तर्पणीय to be satisfied.
683: अतर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unsatisfied. E. अ neg. तर्पित satisfied.
684: अतल n. (-लं) A particular hell or division of the infernal regions, the portion immediately below the earth. E. अ neg. and तल bottom.
685: अतलस्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Very deep, bottomless. E. अ neg. तल bottom, and स्पर्श the touch.
687: अतस् ind. 1 Hence, therefore, from this cause. 2 An interjection of command. E. एतद this, and तस् affix; irregular formation.
688: अतस m. (-सः) 1 Wind, air. 2 The self, the soul. 3 Cloth made from bark. 4 A weapon. f. (-सी) 1 Common flax, (Linum usitatissimum.) 2 Śaṇa, Bengal sun, a kind of flax, (Crotolaria juncea.) E. अत to go, and the Uṇādi affix असच, when fem. with ङीष् added.
689: अति ind. Over, beyond, exceeding, much, very much, &c. it implies general excess, or preeminence. E. अप्त to go, and इन् aff.
690: अतिकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Incredible, unworthy of belief or trust. 2 Erring, deviating from the duties of a profession or cast. f. (-था) Idle or unmeaning speech. E. अति excess or exceeding, and कथा speech: some works substitute for this word, इतिकथ q. v.
691: अतिकन्दक m. (-कः) A tree. See हलिकन्द.
692: अतिकाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Gigantic. E. अति, and काय body.
693: अतिकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रः) 1 A kind of penance, eating a handful of food a day for six days, and fasting three. 2 Extreme pain or suffering. E. अति, and कृच्छ्र penance.
694: अतिकृति f. (-तिः) A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with twenty-five syllables to each line. E. अति, and कृति another metre.
695: अतिकृश mfn. (-शःशा-शी-शं) Very thin, emaciated. E. अति, and कृश thin.
696: अतिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Going over or beyond, lit. or fig. 2 Surpassing, excelling. 2 Transgressing. 4 Contrariety, opposition. 5 Neglect, aversion, disregard. 6 Privation. 7 A groundless demand. 8 A gallant attack, advance of an army in front of an enemy. See अभिक्रम. E. अति over, beyond, and क्रम to go; going beyond duty or daring.
697: अतिक्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) 1 Transgressing. 2 Exceeding, surpassing. E. अतिक्रम, and इनि aff.
698: अतिक्रम्य ind. Having gone over or beyond. i. e. Exceeded, transgressed, surpassed, overcome, &c. E. अति before, क्रम to go, यत् aff.
699: अतिक्रश mfn. (शः-शा-शी-शं) Thin emaciated. E. अति, and क्रश spare; ऋ changed to र.
700: अतिक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Transgressed, exceeded, passed the proper bounds. 2 Excelled, surpassed. 3 Passed in time. 4 Attacked, assaulted. 5 Excessive, unlimited. 6 Prolix, diffuse. 7 Disregarded, disliked. E. अति, and क्रम to go, aff.
701: अतिक्रामक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Exceeding, one who oversteps due bounds. E. अति and क्रम to go, ण्वुल् aff.
702: अतिगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The sixth of the twenty-seven astrological yogas.
703: अतिगन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 A fragrant grass, lemon-grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) 2 Champac, (Michelia champaca.) 3 A kind of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) 4 Sulphur. mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Of strong or exceeding odour. E. अति, and गन्ध smell.
704: अतिगन्धालु m. (-लुः) A creeper. E. अति, and गन्धालु a plant.
705: अतिगर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Arrogant, proud. E. अति very, गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.
706: अतिगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Despicable, vile. E. अति before, गर्हित reproached.
707: अतिगुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्त) Very secret, closely hidden or concealed. E. अति, and गुप्त hidden.
708: अतिगुहा f. (-हा) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) See पृष्णिपर्णी. E. अति surpassing, and गुहा a hole; rising above the ground.
709: अतिचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Going over or beyond, lit. or fig. f. (-रा) A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) See पद्मचारिणी. E. अतिचर to go beyond, अच् and टाप् affs.
710: अतिचार m. (-रः) 1 Going quickly. 2 Going over or beyond. 3 Surpassing, excelling. 4 The passage of a planet from one zodiacal sign to another, in a shorter than common period. E. अति before चर to go, घञ् aff.
711: अतिच्छत्र m. (-त्रः) A mushroom. f. (-त्रा) 1 Anise, (Anethum pimpinella.) 2 Barleria longifolia. E. अति, and च्छत्र an umbrella.
712: अतिच्छत्रक m. (-कः) A mushroom. E. कन् added to the last.
713: अतिजगती f. (-ती) A form of metre, a stanza of four lines, with thirteen syllables in each line. E. अति, and जगती another metre.
714: अतिजव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Marching fast or fleet. E. अति, and जव quick.
715: अतिजागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very wakeful, restless. m. (-रः) The black curlew. E. अति, and जागर wakeful.
716: अतिजीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Very old. E. अति, and जीर्ण old.
717: अतिडीन n. (-नं) Very lofty, or very rapid flight of birds. E. अति, and डीन flying.
718: अतितराम् ind. Much, excessively, exceedingly. E. अति, and तरान् aff.
719: अतितीव्र mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं) Very sharp or pungent. f. (-ब्रा) Doob grass. E. अति, and तीव्र sharp.
720: अतितीक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) Very pungent, sharp, hot or acrid. E. अति, and तीक्ष्म sharp.
721: अतिथि mfn. (-थिः-था) A guest, a person entitled to the rites of hospitality. m. (-थिः) 1 A proper name, the son of KUŚA, and grandson of RĀMA. 2 Wrath. E. अत to go, and इथिन् Uṇādi aff.
722: अतिथिक्रिया f. (-या) Hospitality considered as a religious duty. E. अतिथि, and क्रिया act.
723: अतिथिद्वेष m. (-षः) Inhospitality. E. अतिथि, and द्वेष dislike.
724: अतिथिपूजन n. (-नं) Hospitality considered as one of the principal sacraments of the Hindus. E. अतिथि a guest, and पूजन worshipping.
725: अतिथिसत्कार m. (-रः) The rite of hospitality, hospitality. E. अतिथि, and सत्कार pious rite.
726: अतिथिसेवा f. (-वा) Service of a guest, hospitality. E. अतिथि, and सेवा service.
727: अतिदातृ m. (-ता) A liberal man. E. अति, and दातृ who gives.
728: अतिदान n. (-नं) Munificence, giving largely. E. अति, and दान gift.
729: अतिदाह m. (-हः) 1 Greatheat. 2 Violent inflammation. E. अति, and दाह burning.
730: अतिदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Substituted, supplementary. E. अति over, and दिष्ट enjoined.
731: अतिदुःसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Intolerable, unbearable, not to be borne or endured. E. अति, and दुःसह painful.
732: अतिदुर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) In great difficulty or distress. E. अति, and टुर्गत badly off.
733: अतिदुष्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Very arduous, very difficult. E. अति, and टुष्कर difficult.
734: अतिदूर n. (-रं) A great distance, afar off. E. अति, and दूर afar.
735: अतिदेश m. (-शः) Substitution, supplement. E. अति, and देश direction.
737: अतिधृति f. (-तिः) A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with nineteen syllables in each line. E. अति, and धृति another metre.
738: अतिनौ mfn. (-नौः-नौः-नु) Landed from a boat. E. अति over beyond, and नो a boat.
739: अतिपतन n. (-नं) Exceeding, going beyond bounds. E. अति beyond, and पत to go, ल्युट् aff.
740: अतिपथिन् m. (-पन्था) A good road. E. अति, and पथिन् a road, a very road.
741: अतिपर m. (-रः) 1 A great enemy. 2 One who has conquered his enemy. E. अति, and पर a foe.
742: अतिपात m. (-तः) 1 Neglect of duty. 2 Transgression, deviation from laws or customs. 3 Contrariety, opposition. 4 Going beyond bounds. E. अति beyond, and पात, from पत to go.
743: अतिपातक n. (-कं) Heinous sin, the worst of the great sins. E. अति, and पातक crime.
744: अतिपातकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) A great sinner, flagrantly criminal. E. अतिपातक and इनि aff.
745: अतिपारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Very capable, of great abilities. E. अति, and पारक who traverses.
746: अतिपेशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very dexterous or clever. E. अति, and पेशल clever.
747: अतिप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Frequent repetition, uninterrupted continuance. E. अति, and प्रसङ्ग connexion.
748: अतिबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, powerful. m. (-लः) An active soldier. f. (-ला) A plant, (Sida cordifolia, and rhombifolia.) See वाट्यपुष्पी. E. अति, and बल strong.
749: अतिभार m. (-रः) A great or excessive burden. E. अति, and भार a load.
750: अतिभारग m. (-गः) A mule. E. अतिभार, and ग who goes with.
751: अतिभी m. (-भीः) Lightning, the flash accompanying thunder. E. अति, and भी dread.
752: अतिभूमि f. (-मिः) 1 Something more than was expected or aimed at. 2 Extensive land or limits. 3 Improper conduct, exceeding proper bounds. E. अति, and भूमि land.
753: अतिभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Carefully cherished or protected. E. अति, and भृत cherished.
754: अतिमङ्गल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Very auspicious. m. (-ल्यः) A fruit, (Ægle, or Cratoeva marmelos.) See विल्व. E. अति, and मङ्गल auspicious.
755: अतिमर्य्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) or adverb m. (-द्रं) Much, excessive, unlimited, unbounded. E. अति, and मर्य्यादा a limit.
756: अतिमर्त्त्य mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं) Superhuman, divine. E. अति, and मर्त्त्य mortal.
757: अतिमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) or adverb n. (-त्रं) Much, excessive. E. अति, and मात्रा a minute quantity.
758: अतिमानुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) 1 Superhuman, more than mortal. 2 Immortal, divine. E. अति, and मानुष human.
759: अतिमाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Free from illusion. 2 Entirely liberated or freed. E. अति, and माया delusion.
760: अतिमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dry, not wet. 2 Over measured, exceeding. E. अ neg. तिमित moist, or अति and मित meted.
761: अतिमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Seedless, barren. 2 Entirely liberated or freed. m. (-क्तः) 1 A creeping plant, (Goertnera racemosa.) See माधवीलता. 2 A tree, (Dalbergia oujeiniensis.) E. अति, and मुक्त liberated.
762: अतिमुक्तक m. (-कः) 1 A tree, (Dalbergia oujeiniensis.) 2 Mountain ebony. See तिन्दुक. 3 A creeper. (Goertnera racemosa, &c.) E. See अतिमुक्त.
763: अतिमोदा f. (-दा) A tree, (Jasmimum arboreum.) E. अति, and मोद delight.
764: अतिरथ m. (-थः) A warrior of a particular order fighting in a car. E. अति, and रथ a chariot.
765: अतिरथिन् m. (-थी) A warrior of a particular class, fighting in a car. E. अति before रथ a car, and इनि aff. also अतिरथ.
766: अतिरसा f. (-सा) A creeper. E. अति, and रस flavour.
767: अतिरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Excessive, exceeding. E. अति, and रिच to flow, with the participial affix क्त.
768: अतिरिक्तता f. (-ता) Increase of bulk or quantity, expansion, enlargement, elevation, &c. E. ता added to the preceding.
769: अतिरेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Much, excessive. E. अति, and रिच to flow, affix घञ्.
770: अतिरेकिन् mfn. (-की-किणी-कि) More, superior. E. अतिरक and इनि aff.
771: अतिरोग m. (-गः) Consumption, (Phthisis pulmonalis.) E. अति, and रोग disease.
772: अतिरोमश m. (-शः) A wild goat, or according to some, a large monkey. mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Very hairy. E. अति and रामश hairy.
773: अतिलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Very covetous. E. अति, and लुब्ध covetous.
774: अतिलोमश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Very hairy. E. अति, and लोमश hairy.
775: अतिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) An accident, a circumstance not capable of being prevented or guarded against. E. अति, and वर्त्तन being.
776: अतिवर्त्तुल m. (-लः) A kind of grain. E. अति, and वर्त्तुल round.
777: अतिवात m. (-तः) A storm, a hurricane. E. अति, and वात wind.
778: अतिवाद m. (-दः) Opprobrious or unfriendly speech, See अभिवाद. E. अति overcoming, वद to speak, and घञ् aff.
779: अतिवालक m. (-कः) An infant. mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Childish. E. अति, and वालक a child.
780: अतिविकट m. (-टः) A vicious elephant. mfn. (टः-टा-टं) Very fierce, very formidable. E. अति, and विकट large or formidable.
781: अतिविष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Antidote, exceeding or subduing poison. f. (-षा) A tree used in medicine, the bark is also employed in dyeing; it is of three kinds; white, red, and black. (Atis or Betula.) E. अति overcoming, and विष poison.
782: अतिवृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Heavy rain. E. अति, and वृष्टि rain.
783: अतिवेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) or adverb n. (-लं) Much, excessive, unlimited. E. अति, and वेला a limit.
784: अतिव्यय m. (-यः) Extravagance, great expenditure. E. अति, and व्यय expenditure.
785: अतिव्ययिन् mfn. (यी-यिनी-यि) Extravagant, spendthrift. E. अतिव्यय, and इनि aff.
786: अतिव्यथा f. (-था) Excessive pain, agony. E. अति, and व्यथा pain.
787: अतिव्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Extreme pervasion or extension. 2 Going beyond the mark, drawing an inference unwarranted by the premises. E. अति, and व्याप्ति spreading.
788: अतिशक्करी f. (-री) A kind of metre; of four lines, with fifteen syllables to the line. E. अति beyond, शक्करी another metre.
789: अतिशक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Very powerful. E. अति, and शक्त powerful.
790: अतिशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Great power. E. अति, and शक्ति power.
791: अतिशक्तिता f. (-ता) Heroick valor, prowess. E. अति, शक्ति power, and ता aff.
792: अतिशक्तिभाज् m. (-क) A man of gigantic power. E. अतिशक्ति, and भाज् who possesses.
793: अतिशय If an adj. mas. only. (-यः) If an adverb n. (-यं) Much, excessive. E. शीङ् to sleep; अति being prefixed, to excel; aff. अच्.
794: अतिशयनं adv. n. (-नं) See अतिशय. E. ल्युट् added to the preceding.
795: अतिशयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Superior, exceeding. 2 Increased, improved, &c. E. अतिशय, and इनि aff.
796: अतिशयोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Hyperbole. 2 Verbosity, prolixity. E. अतिशय excess, and उक्ति speech.
797: अतिशयन adv. n. (-नं) adj. mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Much, excessive. E. अतिशय, and ल्युट् the ante-pen. lengthened.
798: अतिशायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Exceeded, surpassed, excelled. 2 Increased. E. अति before शीङ्, and क्त aff.
799: अतिशोभन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Excellent. 2 Chief, principal. 3 Beautiful, splendid. E. अति, and शुभ to shine, ल्युट् aff.
800: अतिसञ्चय m. (-यः) A hoard, a great accumulation. E. अति, and सञ्चय heap.
801: अतिसंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cheated, deceived, imposed upon. 2 Explained, declared. E. अति, before संहित combined.
802: अतिसन्धान n. (-नं) Falsehood, deceit, fraud, cheating, overreaching. E. अति, before सन्धान combining.
803: अतिसर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Liberality, giving. 2 Appointing, engaging. 3 A gift, a donation. 4 Slaughter, killing. E. अति, and हृज to create, ल्युट् aff.
804: अतिसान्तपन n. (-नं) Severe penance or expiation, especially for the guilt of eating unclean animals; taking as food nothing but cow's urine, cowdung, curds, milk, and ghee, each two days in succession. E. अति, and सान्तपन penance.
806: अतिसार m. (-रः) Diarrhoea or dysentery. E. अति, and सार what goes; from सृ to go, with घञ् affix; also अतीसार.
807: अतिसारकिन् mfn. (-की-किणी-कि) Dysenteric, afflicted with dysentery. E. अतिसार, and the affixes इनि and कुक्.
808: अतिसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Afflicted with dysentery. 2 Cathartic. E. अतिसार, and इनि aff.
809: अतिस्फिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very tremulous. E. अति, and स्फिर trembling.
810: अतिहसित n. (-तं) Violent laughter. E. अति, and हसित laughing.
811: अतिहास m. (-सः) A horse-laugh, violent laughter. E. अति, and हास laughter.
812: अतीन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Imperceptible, unattainable by the senses. E. अति beyond, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
813: अतीक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) Blunt, not sharp, dull, obtuse. E. अ neg. तीक्ष्ण sharp.
814: अतीक्ष्णता f. (-ता) Bluntness. So अतीक्ष्णत्व n. (-त्वं) E. ता or त्व added to the preceding.
815: अतीच्छ mfn. (-छः-छा-छं) Very desirous, eager, ardent. E. अति, and इच्छा wish.
816: अतीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Passed, gone. 2 Passed away, deceased, dead. 3 Liberated from worldly restraint. 4 Surpassed, gone over or beyond. E. अति, and इत gone.
817: अतीतकाल m. (-लः) In gram. the preterite tense. E. अतीत, and काल time.
818: अतीव ind. Much, very much, much indeed. E. अति, and इव as, so.
819: अतीव्र mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं) Blunt, dull, insipid. E. अ neg. तीव्र sharp.
820: अतीसार m. (-रः) Diarrhoea or dysentery. See अतिसार.
821: अतुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Short of stature, a dwarf. 2 Low. E. अ neg. तुङ्ग tall or high.
822: अतुन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Lank, thin. E. अ neg. तुन्द fat.
823: अतुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unequalled. m. (-लः) A plant that has an oily seed, (Sesamum orientale.) E. अ neg. तुल to be like, क aff.
824: अतुलनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Incomparable. E. अ neg. तुलनीय comparable.
825: अतुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Unequalled, unparalleled. E. अ neg. तुल्य to be equalled.
826: अतुहिनरश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The sun, whose rays are not cold, i. e. hot: also analogous compounds, as अतुहिनधाम, अतुहिनरुचि.
827: अतृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Unsatisfied. E. अ neg. तृप्त satisfied.
828: अतृप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Insatiableness, voraciousness. E. अ neg. तृप्ति satisfaction.
829: अतेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Dark, dim, dull. n. (-जः) 1 Shade, shadow. 2 Insignificance, feebleness, imbecility. E. अ neg. तेजस् light or spirit.
830: अतेजस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Void of splendour or energy. E. अ neg. तेजस्विन् splendid.
831: अतोषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Implacable, not to be appeased. E. अ neg. तोषणीय to be pleased.
832: अत्क m. (-त्कः) A limb, a member of the body. mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) A traveller. E. अत to go, and कन् Uṇādi aff.
833: अत्ता f. (-त्ता) 1 A mother. 2 An elder sister. 3 A mother's elder sister. E. अत to go, अच, and टाप् aff.
834: अत्ति f. (-त्तिः) In theatrical language, an elder sister. E. अत to go, क्तिन् aff.
835: अत्तिका f. (-का) In theatrical language, an elder sister. E. अत्ता a mother, and कन् affix, who is, as it were, a mother; it is also written अन्तिका and अर्विका.
836: अत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्वी-त्तॄ) A feeder, one who eats. E. अद to eat, शतृ aff.
837: अत्नु m. (-त्नुः) The sun. E. अत to go, क्नु Uṇādi aff.
838: अत्य m. (-त्यः) A horse, from the Vedas. E. अत to go constantly, यत् aff.
839: अत्यजनीय mfn. (-यः-था-यं) Not to be abandoned. E. अ neg. त्यजनीय to be abandoned.
840: अत्यन्त mfn. or adv. n. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Much, excessive. E. अति beyond, and अन्त end, or boundary.
841: अत्यन्तकोपन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Very passionate. E. अत्यन्त, and कोपन passionate.
842: अत्यन्तगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) What goes much or quickly. E. अत्यन्त, and गामिन् who goes.
843: अत्यन्तसुकुमार m. (-रः) A species of grain, (Panicum Italicum.) E. अत्यन्त, and सुकुमार very soft.
844: अत्यन्ताभाव m. (-वः) (In logic) absolute negation or non-existence. E. अत्यन्त much, अभाब not being.
845: अत्यन्तिक m. (-कः) One who rambles much, a great rover. mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Much, exceeding, E. अत्यन्त, with ठक् aff.
846: अत्यन्तीन m. (-नः) One who goes quickly or actively. E. अत्यन्त much, and ईन for गामिन् who goes.
847: अत्यम्ल mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं) Very sour. m. (-म्लः) A tree, (Spondias mangifera.) f. (-म्ला) Another plant and fruit; a species of citron. See मातुलुङ्गी. E. अति, and अम्ल sour.
848: अत्यम्लपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A creeper and medicinal plant. E. अति excessive, अम्ल sour; and पर्ण a leaf, with the fem. aff. ङीप्.
849: अत्यय m. (-यः) 1 Death. 2 Distress. 3 Transgression. 4 Vice, fault, guilt. 5 Punishment. 6 Going over or beyond. 7 Absence. 8 Loss, destruction. E. अति beyond, away, इण to go, and अच् aff.
850: अत्ययित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Exceeded, surpassed. 2 Outraged. E. अति before इण to go, क्त aff.
851: अत्यर्थ n. adv. mfn. adj. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Much, excessive. E. अति, and अर्थ substance.
852: अत्यल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Very small, very little. E. अति very, and अल्प small.
853: अत्यष्टी f. (-ष्टी) A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with seventeen syllables to the line. E. अति beyond, अष्टी another metre.
854: अत्यसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Very rough, uneven, craggy. E. अति, and असम unequal.
855: अत्याकार m. (-रः) Censure, blame, contempt. E. अति and आङ prefixed to कृ to do, वज् aff.
856: अत्याचार m. (-रः) Deviating from prescribed observances, contemning religious and moral laws. E. अति, and आचार observance.
857: अत्याचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Transgressing. E. अत्याचार, and इनि aff.
858: अत्याज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Not to be abandoned. E. अ neg. त्याज्य to be abandoned.
859: अत्याशा f. (-शा) Unreasonable hope or desire. E. अति, and आशा hope.
860: अत्याहार m. (-रः) Excessive food. E. अति, and आहार food.
861: अत्याहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Eating excessively, a glutton, a gormandizer. E. अत्याहार, and इनि aff.
862: अत्याहित n. (-तं) 1 Great dread. 2 Desperate or daring action. E. अति, with धा to have; आङ prefixed, and the participial क्त; हि is substituted for धा; what engrosses the mind.
863: अत्युक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Idle or excessive talk. 2 Expatiating, enlarging. 3 A figure of rhetoric, description of any thing surprising or extraordinary, hyperbole. E. अति, and उक्ति speech.
864: अत्युक्था f. (-क्था) A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with two syllables to the line. E. अति, and उक्था another kind: it is also read अत्युक्ता.
865: अत्युत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Extreme, exceeding great. E. अति, and उत्कट much.
866: अत्युत्कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टां-ष्टं) 1 Most excellent, best. 2 Most valuable, precious. E. अति, and उत्कृष्ट excellent.
867: अत्यूह m. (-हः) A gallinule. f. (-हा) A plant, (Jasminum villosum, Rox. or in Bengal, Nyctanthes tristis.) See शेफालिका. E. अति, and ऊह to reason.
868: अत्र ind. In this place, here, herein. E. त्र being substituted for the termination of the seventh case of इदम् this.
869: अत्रप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Shameless, immodest. E. अ neg. त्रपा shame.
870: अत्रभवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Respectable, venerable, (especially in theatrical language.) E. अत्र here, भू to be, and the participial affix शतृ; being present or principal.
871: अत्रास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Fearless. E. अ neg. त्रास fear.
872: अत्रि m. (-त्रिः) The name of one of the seven Ṛṣis or saints, born from the eye of BRAHMĀ, married to ANASŪYĀ, daughter of KARDAMA MUNI, and the father of DATTA or DATTĀTREYA, DURVĀSAS and CANDRA. E. अद to eat and त्रिप् Uṇādi aff. The correct reading is अत्त्रि, but the word is always written with one त.
873: अत्रिजात m. (-तः) 1 The moon. 2 A man of the three first classes. E. अ neg. त्रि three, and जात born, not thrice born; born twice. The moon, from the eye of ATRI, and from the ocean. The Brahman &c. from the womb and investiture.
874: अत्रिदृग्ज m. (-जः) A name of CANDRA or the moon. E. अत्रि a saint, दृश् the eye, and ज born, produced. Born from the eye of ATRI, “a flash of light from the eye of ATRI, was received by space, a goddess, the via lactea personified, who bore SOMA.” The following and other similar names refer to this legend.
875: अत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A muni. See अत्र. E. अद to eat, Uṇādi aff. त्रिन्; also अत्त्रिन्.
879: अत्रिभारद्वाजिका m. (-का) The marriage union of ATRI and BHĀRADVĀJĪ. E. अत्रि, and भारद्वाजी; affix वुञ्, implying in this and similar compounds, union.
880: अतुर mfn. (-रः-रा-र) Deliberate, not in haste. E. अ neg. तुर for त्वरा haste.
881: अत्त्रि m. (-त्त्रिः) A sage. See अत्रि.
882: अत्त्रिन् m. (-त्त्री) A sage. See अत्त्रि.
883: अथ ind. An auspicious and inceptive particle; it serves to introduce a remark, a question, an affirmation, &c. and corresponds to, 1 After. 2 And. 3 Now, (inceptive or premising.) 4 What, (interrogatively.) 5 All, (comprehensively.) 6 Therefore, thus, further, moreover. &c. It also implies doubt or command, and is frequently redundant. E. अर्थ to ask, ड affix, and र is dropped, also अथो.
884: अथकिम् ind. A particle of assent, how else, what else, assuredly.
886: अथर्व्वण m. (-णः) A name of ŚIVA. E. अथर्व्व the name of a Veda, and ण aff.
887: अथर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) 1 A Brahman. 2 A name of VASIṢṬHA. n. (-र्व्व) The name of the fourth Veda. E. अथ an auspicious particle, ऋ to go, and वनिप् aff.
888: अथर्व्वणि m. (-णिः) 1 A Brahman versed in the Atharva Veda. 2 A family priest. E. अथर्व्व the Veda, and णि aff.
889: अथवा ind. Or. E. अथ, and वा sometimes.
890: अथो ind. The same as अथ, q. v.
891: अद (औ) r. 2d cl. (अत्ति) To eat. The root is imperfect; घस being substituted for it in several inflections; as जघास, &c. Implying injury, it is not conjugated in the middle voice, although the action be reciprocal: as व्यत्यदन्ति they bite, or devour each other. With an indicatory इ, अदि (अन्दति) To bind.
892: अदक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Awkward, unskilful. E. अ neg. दक्ष clever.
893: अदक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Not clever, unskilful. 2 Not comprehending the fee given to the Brahmans, a sacrifice, &c. E. अ neg. दक्षिण clever, or दक्षिणा a fee.
894: अदग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Unscorched, not burnt. E. अ neg. दग्ध burnt.
895: अदण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Unpunished. n. (-ण्डं) Impunity. E. अ neg. दण्ड punishment.
896: अदण्ड्य mfn. (-ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं) Unpunishable, unworthy of or exempt from punishment. E. अ neg. दण्ड्य to be punished.
897: अदण्डनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unpunishable, unfit to be punished, exempt from punishment. E. अ neg. दण्डनीय to be punished.
898: अदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Not given. f. (-त्ता) An unmarried girl. E. अ not, दत्त given.
899: अदन n. (-नं) 1 Food. 2 Eating. E. अद to eat, and ल्युट् aff.
900: अदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be eaten, what may be eaten. E. अद to eat, अनीयर aff.
901: अदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Toothless. So अदन्तक (-कः-का-कं) E. अ neg. दन्त a tooth.
902: अदम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Uncontroulable, untameable. E. अ neg. दम्य to be tamed.
903: अदभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं) Much, many. E. अ neg. दभ्र little, few.
904: अदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unfeeling, unmerciful, destitute of pity. E. अ neg. दया clemency.
905: अदर्शन n. (-न) Disappearance, not being visible or present. E. अ neg. दर्शन sight.
906: अदल m. (-लः) A plant, (Eugenia acutangula.) See हिज्जल. f. (-ला) Socotrine aloe, (Aloes perfoliata.) See घृतकुमारी. mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Leafless. E. अ neg. and दल a leaf.
907: अदस् mfn. (असौ असौ अदः) 1 This. 2 That.
908: अदहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Incombustible; so अदाहनीय. E. अ neg. दाहनीय or दहनीय to be burnt.
909: अदातृ m. (-ता) A niggard, a miser. E. अ neg. दातृ who gives.
910: अदान n. (-नं) Not giving, withholding. E. अ neg. दान gift.
911: अदान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Untamed, unsubdued, undaunted. E. अ neg. दान्त daunted.
912: अदायिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Unclaimed, as inheritance, lapsed. 2 Not relating to inheritance. E. अ neg. दाय heritage, ठक aff.
913: अदाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Inconsumable by fire, incombustible. E. अ neg. दाह्य to be burnt.
914: अदिति f. (-ति.) 1 The daughter of DAKṢA, wife of KAŚYAPA, and mother of the gods. 2 The earth. 3 Being entire. E. अ neg. दा to give, and दिति affix, not giving pain; or अ, and दो to cut or break, क्तिच् aff.
915: अदितिनन्दन m. (-नः) A deity, a divinity. E. अदिति, and नन्दन, a son of ADITI.
916: अदुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Unspoiled, unvitiated. 2 Good, virtuous. E. अ neg. टुष्ट bad.
917: अदूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Undefiled, unvitiated. 2 Virtuous, good. E. अ neg. दूषित corrupted.
918: अदृश् m. (-दृक्) Blind. E. अ priv. and दृश the eye.
919: अदृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 Invisible, not to be seen. 2 Improper to be beheld. E. अ neg. दृश्य to be seen.
920: अदृष्ट n. (-ष्टं) 1 Casual and unseen danger, (as from conflagration, inundation, &c.) 2 Fortune, destiny, fate. 3 (In logic) Virtue or vice, as the eventual cause of pleasure or pain. mfn. (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Unseen, unforeseen. 2 Unknown, unfelt, not experienced. E. अ neg. and दृष्ट seen.
921: अदृष्टपुरुष m. (-षः) A form of treaty, in which the parties treat direct, without any mediator or surety, also अदृष्टनर and similar compounds. E. अदृष्ट unseen, and पुरुष, &c. man.
922: अदृष्टपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Unseen previously, unseen till now. E. अदृष्ट, and पूर्व्व before.
923: अदृष्टवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत) 1 Enjoying or undergoing good or bad fortune, more usually the former, fortunate. E. अदृष्ट, and मतुप् aff.
924: अदृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A look of displeasure, evil eye. E. अ bad, and दृष्टि look.
925: अदृष्टिका f. (-का) An angry or displeased look, evil-eye. E. अदृष्टि, and कन् aff.
926: अदेय mfn. (-यः-या-पं) Improper or unfit to be given. E. अ neg. देय to be given.
927: अदेयदान n. (-नं) Giving what ought not to be given, what is not one's own, &c. E. अदेय, and दान giving.
928: अद्ग m. (-द्गः) Oiled butter. E. अद to eat, and गम् Uṇādi aff.
929: अद्धा ind. Truly, verily. E. अत going constantly, धा to have, and विच् aff.
930: अद्भुत n. (-तं) 1 Surprise, astonishment. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wonderful, surprising. E. अत a particle of surprise, भू to be, and उतच् Uṇādi aff.
931: अद्भुतश्वन m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA. E. अद्भुत astonishing, and श्वन who sounds.
932: अद्मनि m. (-निः) Fire. E. अद to eat, Uṇādi affix अनि, and म inserted.
933: अद्मर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Gluttonous. E. अद to eat, and क्मरच् aff.
934: अद्य ind. To-day. E. इदम् this; an irregular formation.
935: अद्यतन m. (-नः) The period of a current day, from midnight to midnight in the usual acceptation, but sometimes considered to begin and end with sun-set. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Of or belonging to the current day, of to-day. E. अद्य, and द्युल् aff.
936: अद्यतनभूत m. (-तः) In grammar, the aorist past. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Past or gone to-day, i. e. any time previous to to-day. E. अद्यतन of to-day, भूत been.
937: अद्यापि ind. Even now, still. E. अद्य, and अपि certainly.
938: अद्यावधि n. (-धि) Beginning or ending with the current day, from or till to-day. E. अद्य, and अवधि limit.
939: अद्यश्वीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Near to any event, at the point of death &c. f. (-ना) A woman or any female animal near the time of delivery. E. अद्य, and श्व to-morrow, affix स्व, what will happen to-day or to-morrow.
940: अद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) A worthless or good for nothing object. E. अ neg. द्रव्य thing.
941: अद्रि m. (-द्रिः) 1 A tree. 2 A mountain. 3 The sun. 4 A measure. E. अद to eat, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
942: अद्रिकीला f. (-ला) The earth. E. अद्रि a mountain, and कील a pin or bolt.
943: अद्रिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced or found in the hills. n. (-जं) Red chalk. f. (-जा) A name of PĀRVATĪ or DURGĀ, the daughter  of HIMĀLA, ruler of the HIMĀLAYA mountain, and hence this her appellation, mountain-born. E. अद्रि, and ज, from जन to be born.
944: अद्रितनया f. (-या) A name of PĀRVATĪ, the daughter of the mountain HIMĀLAYA. E. अद्रि, and तनया daughter.
945: अद्रिनन्दिनी f. (-नी) PĀRVATĪ. See the last.
946: अद्रिपति m. (-तिः) Hima, lord of mountains: also similar compounds, as अद्रीन्द्र, अद्रिराज्, &c.
947: अद्रिभिद् m. (-भित्) A name of INDRA. E. अद्रि, and भिद who breaks; the splitter of mountains, (with his thunderbolt.)
948: अद्रिभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountaineer, mountain-born. m. (-भूः) A plant, (Salvinea cucullata.) E. अद्रि, and भू born.
949: अद्रिराज् m. (-राट्) The king of mountains, the HIMĀLAYA mountains; the snowy range on the north of Hindustan, confounded with the mythological ruler of them, and the father of PĀRVATĪ. E. अद्रि, and राज् a king, the king of mountains, deservedly so called, being the loftiest in the world.
950: अद्रिवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) Fire on a mountain, a volcano. E. अद्रि, and वह्नि fire.
951: अद्रिशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A peak, the horn or summit of a mountain. E. अद्रि, and शृङ्ग a horn.
952: अद्रिसार m. (-रः) Iron. E. अद्रि, and सार essence.
953: अद्रीश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Also of HIMĀLAYA, as king of mountains. E. अद्रि, and ईश a master.
954: अद्रोह m. (-हः) Mildness, moderation, the absence of tyranny or oppression. E. अ neg. द्रोह tyranny.
955: अद्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Innocuous, mild. E. अ neg. द्रोहिन् violent.
956: अद्वय m. (-यः) A Bauddha. E. अ neg. द्वय two.
957: अद्वयवादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A Bauddha. 2 A unitarian. E. अ neg. द्वय two, and वादिन् who speaks, one who acknowledges but one principle.
958: अद्वितीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Only, sole, without a second. E. अ neg. द्वितीय second.
959: अद्वेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Harmless, not malicious. E. अ neg. द्वेष malice.
960: अद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Harmless, inoffensive. E. अ neg. द्वेषिन् who hates.
961: अद्वैत n. (-तं) Unity, not duality. E. अ neg. द्वैत duality.
962: अद्वैतवादिन् m. (-दी) A unitarian, one who maintains the existence of but one principle in the universe. E. अद्वैत unity, and वादिन् who speaks.
963: अधःकाय m. (-यः) The lower part of the body, the lower extremities. E. अधस्, and काय body.
964: अधःकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrown or put down. E. अधस्, and कृत made.
965: अधःक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Precipitated, thrown down. E. अधस् down, and क्षिप्त participle past of क्षिप् to throw.
966: अधःपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fallen down. E. अधस्, and पतित fallen.
967: अधःप्रस्तर m. (-रः) A seat or bed, made of grass. E. अधस्, and प्रस्तर a couch.
968: अधःपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, (Hieracium.) E. अधस् downwards, and पुष्प a flower.
969: अधःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Below. 2 Inferior. E. अधस्, and स्थ what stays.
970: अधम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Inferior, low. 2 Vile, despicable. E. अब to preserve, अम Uṇādi affix, and व changed to ध.
971: अधमभृतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A porter, a bearer of burdens. 2 Low, servile, E. अधम low, and भृतक a servant.
972: अधमर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) A debtor. E. अधम low, and ऋण debt.
973: अधमर्णिक m. (-कः) A debtor. E. अधम, and ऋण debt, with ठक added.
974: अधमर्णिन् m. (-र्णी) A debtor. E. अधम, and ऋण debt, with इनि added.
975: अधमाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A foot, E. अधम low, and अङ्ग a limb.
976: अधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Low, inferior, below. 2 Low, vile. 3 Silenced, refuted, overcome in abuse or controversy. f. (-रा) The lower region. m. (-रः) The lower lip. (dual. -रौ) The lips. mn. (-रः or -रं) Pudendum muliebre. E. अ neg. धृ to have or hold, and अच् aff.
977: अधरतस् ind. Underneath. E. अधर, and तस् aff.
978: अधरमधु n. (-घु) The moisture of the lips. E. अधर the lower lip, and मधु honey.
979: अधरस्तात् ind. Below, behind. E. स्तात् added to अधर.
980: अधरस्मात् ind. Below, underneath. E. the form of the ablative.
981: अधरात् ind. Underneath. E. अधर, with the termination आत्.
982: अधरामृत n. (-तं) The moisture, honey or nectar of the lips. E. अधर, and अमृत nectar.
983: अधरावलोप m. (-पः) Biting the lip. E. अधर, and अव before लुप to cut, affix धञ्.
984: अधरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contradicted, invalidated. E. अधर, and कृत made with च्ची inserted.
985: अधरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Reproached, censured. E. अधर, and ख aff.
986: अधरीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contradicted, invalidated. E. अधर, and भूत become, with च्ची inserted.
987: अधरेण ind. Underneath. E. अधर, and the affix एन.
988: अधरेद्युस् ind. A future day, the day after the morrow. E. अधर, and एद्युस् irregular aff.
989: अधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Unrighteousness, injustice, all behaviour contrary to the Śruti and Smṛti, or religious and legal institutes. E. अ priv. and धर्म्म virtue, &c.
990: अधर्म्मचारिन् mfn. (-रीः-रिणी-रि) Unrighteous, wicked. E. अधम्म, and चारिन् who follows.
991: अधर्म्मता f. (-ता) Unrighteousness; also अधर्म्मत्व n. (-त्वं) E. ता or त्व added to अधर्म्म.
992: अधर्म्मात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Wicked, unrighteous. E. अधर्म्म, and आत्मन् spirit.
993: अधर्म्मिन् mfn. (र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) Wicked, sinful, unrighteous. E. अधर्म्म, and इनि aff.
994: अधर्म्मिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very wicked. E. अधर्म्म, and इष्ठन् aff.
995: अधश्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Going. m. (-रः) A thief. E. अधस् low, vile, and चर who goes down or below.
996: अधश्चौर m. (-रः) A house-breaker. E. अधस् below, and चौर a thief.
997: अधस् ind. 1 Down, downwards, below. 2 The lower or infernal regions. 2 Pudendum muliebre. E. अधर with असि affix, and र dropped.
998: अधस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Below, underneath. E. अधस्, and ट्युल् aff.
999: अधस्तात् ind. 1 Down, downwards, underneath. 2 Behind. 3 Pudendum muliebre. E. अधर or अधम्, and तात् aff.
1000: अधामार्गव m. (-वः) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. अधम vile, मार्ग a road, and व from वा to gain or possess.
1001: अधार्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unjust, unrighteous, wicked. E. अ neg. and धार्म्मिक virtuous, &c. from धर्म्म, affix ठञ्.
1002: अधि m. (-धिः) Anxiety, mental pain; more usually आधिः. E. आङ before, धा to have, कि affix; आ is made short.
1003: अधि ind. Over, above, upon, &c. a preposition and prefix to verbs implying superiority in place, quality, or quantity; as अधिष्ठातुं to stand in or on, अधिकर्त्तुं to rule over, अधिशयितुं to exceed: also used in the figurative sense of the same, as अधिगन्तुं to go to or attain; अधिकर्त्तुं to do over again, to repeat or recall; अधीतुं to go over or through, as a book; अधिवस्तुं to reside in or on, to continue in or on, to persevere: forming also indeclinables with nouns, as अधिरात्रि in the night; अधि ग्रहं in or over the house: and compounds with nouns, as अधिदेवप्ता, &c. q. v. E. अ neg. धा to have, कि aff.
1004: अधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Exceeding, more, over, more than, in addition to. n. (-कं) A figure in rhetoric, (Hyperbole.) E. अधि and क, from कै to sound.
1005: अधिकतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) More, comparatively more. E. अधिक and तरप् aff.
1006: अधिकतम mfn. (-मः-मा-भं) Most, superlatively more. E. अधिक, and तमप् aff.
1007: अधिकता f. (-ता) Excess, addition; also अधिकत्वं. E. ता or त्व added to अधिक.
1008: अधिकन्तु ind. Moreover. E. अधिक, and तु but.
1009: अधिकरण n. (-णं) 1 Superiority, supremacy. 2 Title, right. 3 In the Mīmāṃsā philosophy, a case or topic, comprehending five members, the subject, the doubt, the first side or prima facie argument, the answer or conclusion, the application. 4 (In the Vedānta.) A case or question. 5 (In grammar) Location, the sense of the seventh or locative case, defined to imply four kinds. 1 Proximity, as, ‘a village on the Ganges.’ 2 Inclusion, as, ‘the gods in heaven.’ 3 End or object, as, ‘versed in the Śāstras; and 4 Integral existence, as, ‘the spirit is in all.’ E. अधि over, कृ to do; and ल्युट् aff.
1010: अधिकर्द्धि mfn. (-र्द्धिः-र्द्धिः-र्द्धि) Prosperous, every way happy. E. अधिक excessive, and ऋद्धि prosperity.
1011: अधिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Superintendence, supervision. E. अधि, and कर्म्म business.
1012: अधिकर्म्मिक m. (-कः) 1 Clerk or prefect of the market or fair. 2 An overseer, a superintendent. E. अधि over, कर्म्म business, and इक् aff.
1013: अधिकाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Having more members than natural or common. n. (-ङ्गं) The girdle over the coat of mail, worn as a kind of scarf. E. अधिक exceeding, and अङ्ग the body.
1014: अधिकार m. (-रः) 1 Authority. 2 Supremacy. 3 Rule, government. 4 Right, title. 5 Property, ownership. 6 Privilege. 7 Duty, office. 3 A chapter, a section. 9 The use of royal insignia. 10 (In grammar) Government, the dependance of a form on a previous one. E. अधि over, and कार what makes, from कृ with घञ् affix; what gives or exercises preeminence.
1015: अधिकारिता f. (-ता) 1 Ownership, lordship. 2 Right, title. E. अधिकारिन् with ता affix.
1016: अधिकारित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Ownership. 2 Right, title. E. see the last, affix त्व.
1017: अधिकारिन् m. (-री) 1 A superintendent, a ruler, a director. 2 A master, an owner. 3 A sage, one who is perfect in the principles and practice of the Vedānta. mf. (-री-रिणी) (In law) The possessor of a right or title, as, धनाधिकारी heir to property; संस्काराधिकारी one who has a right to the essential ceremonies of the Hindu religion. E. अधिकार, and इनि aff.
1018: अधिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Superintended, guided. 2 Claimed or held as a right. 3 Set over, superintendent. m. (-तः) 1 A superintendent in general. 2 Inspector of receipts and disbursements, an auditor of public accompts. E. अधि over, and कृत made.
1019: अधिक्रम m. (-मः) Invasion, assailing. E. अधि over, and क्रम to go.
1020: अधिक्रमण n. (-णं) Invading, assailing, overrunning. E. अधि, and क्रमण going.
1021: अधिकृति f. (-तिः) A possession, a right. E. अधि, and कृति doing.
1022: अधिक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Censured, reviled, detracted from. 2 Sent, dispatched. 3 Placed, fixed. E. अधि, and क्षिप्त participle of क्षिप to send or throw.
1023: अधिक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Detraction, censure. 2 Sending, despatching. E. अधि, and क्षेप throwing.
1024: अधिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Obtained. 2 Gone through or over, lit. or fig. as read, studied. E. अधि, and गत gone.
1025: अधिगम m. (-मः) 1 Obtaining, attaining, acquiring. 2 Going through or over, lit. or fig. 3 Overpassing, overflowing: also अधिगमन n. (-नं) &c. E. अधि, and गम or गमन going.
1026: अधिगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Unattainable, not to be reached or acquired. So अधिगमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) and अधिगन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) E. अधिगम with यत्, अनीयर or तव्य participial affs.
1027: अधिजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A tumor on the tongue. E. अधि, and जिह्वा the tongue.
1028: अधिज्योतिष n. (-षं) The luminous parts of the creation. E. अधि supreme, ज्योतिष् light.
1029: अधित्यका f. (-का) Land on the upper part of a mountain. E. अधि over, above, and त्यकन् aff.
1030: अधिदन्त m. (-न्तः) A tooth growing over another. E. अधि, and दन्त a tooth.
1031: अधिदेव m. (-वः) 1 A supreme or superior deity. 2 A tutelary deity. E. अधि, and देव a deity.
1032: अधिदेवता m. (-ता) A tutelary or presiding divinity. E. अधि, and देवता a deity.
1033: अधिदैव n. (-वं) 1 The ruling deity, the active principle in creation: also अधिदैवतं. 2 The collective body of gods, and superhuman beings. E. अधि, and दैव divine being.
1034: अधिप m. (-पः) 1 An owner, a lord or master. 2 A king. E. अधि, and प who preserves, from पा.
1035: अधिपति m. (-तिः) A master, an owner, a ruler. 2 A king. E. अधि, and पति a master.
1036: अधिप्रज n. (-जं) Continuation of the world by procreation. E. अधि, and प्रजा progeny.
1037: अधिभू m. (-भूः) A master, a ruler. E. अधि, and भू who is from भू to be, affix विच्.
1038: अधिभूत n. (-तं) An essential element of matter, perishable matter, that of which the presence involves eventual dissolution. E. अधि over, and भ्रूत an element.
1039: अधिमन्थ m. (-न्थः) Acute pains in the balls of the eyes, with pain and swelling of one side of the head. E. अधि over, मन्य what agitates.
1040: अधिमांस m. (-सः) Fleshy excrescences on the eye, cancer of the eye. E. अधि, and मांस flesh.
1041: अधिमांसक m. (-कः) Inflammation of the tonsils. E. अधि, and मांस flesh, कन् added.
1042: अधिमात्र n. (-त्रं) A knowledge of the properties of the letters forming the word for the Hindu triad ओम्. E. अधि, and मात्र the whole.
1043: अधिमास m. (-सः) An intercalary month, formed of the aggregate days omitted in reckoning the lunar year. E. अधि, and मास a month.
1044: अधिरथ m. (-थः) A charioteer. E. अधि, and रथ a car.
1045: अधिराज् m. (-राट्) A supreme king, an emperor. So अधिराज m. (-जः) E. अधि, and राज् राजन a king.
1046: अधिराज्य n. (-ज्यं) Empire, supreme sway. E. अधि, and राज्य kingdom.
1047: अधिराज्यभाज् m. (-क्) An emperor, a paramount sovereign. E. अधिराज्य, and भाज् who possesses.
1048: अधिरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Elevated, exalted, surmounting. E. अधि, and रूढ mounted.
1049: अधिरोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Placed over, lit. or fig. E. अधि, and रोपित raised.
1050: अधिरोह m. (-हः) Surmounting, overtopping, elevation. E. अधि, and रोह mounting.
1051: अधिरोहणी f. (-णी) A ladder, a pair of steps. E. अधि, and रुह to mount, with ल्युट् affix, and fem. ङीष.
1052: अधिरोहिन् mfn. (-हि-हिणी-हि) Who rises on or above. f. (-णी) A ladder, a staircase. E. अधिरोह, and इनि aff.
1053: अधिलोक m. (-कः) The universe, the material world. E. अधि, and लोक world.
1054: अधिवचन n. (-नं) A name, an appellation. E. अधि, and वचन speech.
1055: अधिवास m. (-सः) 1 A house, an abode. 2 Place, situation. 3 Continuance, perseverance. 4 Perfuming the person, &c. 5 A neighbour. 6 Neighbourhood. E. अधि, and वस to dwell, with घञ् affix; or पास to fumigate, with अच्.
1056: अधिवासन n. (-नं) 1 Perfuming or scenting the person, &c. 2 Abiding, staying. 3 A religious ceremony; touching a vessel containing perfumes, flowers, and other things previously presented to an idol, or offering perfumes, &c. to idols, as a preliminary ceremony. E. अधि, and वास to fumigate, ल्युट aff.
1057: अधिवासिता f. (-ता) Residence, staying or abiding in one place. E. अधिवास, with ता affix, and इट augment; also with त्व, अधिवासित्वं.
1058: अधिविद्या f. (-द्या) The collective means and end of acquiring knowledge. E. अधि, and विद्या knowledge.
1059: अधिविन्ना f. (-न्ना) A wife whose husband has subsequently married others; a superseded wife. E. अधि, and विन्न obtained.
1060: अधिवेत्तृ m. (-त्ता) A man marrying other than his first wife. E. अधि before विद to obtain, तृच् aff.
1061: अधिवेदन n. (-नं) Marrying again, whilst a former wife is living. E. अधि before विद to obtain, affix ल्युट्.
1062: अधिवेदनीया f. (-या) A wife deserving or proper to be superseded. E. अधि before विद to obtain, अनीयर aff.
1063: अधिश्रय m. (-यः) A place, a receptacle. E. अधि before श्रि to serve, अच् aff.
1064: अधिश्रयणी f. (-णी) A furnace or fire-place. E. अधि, and श्रिङ to cook, ल्युट् affix, and fem. termination.
1065: अधिश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Placed, deposited, received, included. E. अधि, before श्रि to serve, क्त aff.
1066: अधिष्ठान n. (-नं) 1 Abiding, resting. 2 Site, situation. 3 Prescribed rule, fixed practice. 5 A town. 6 A wheel. 4 Dignity. E. अधि, श्या to stand, and ल्यट् aff.
1067: अधिष्ठातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Governing, directing, fixing. m. (-ता) A ruler, a governor, a director. E. अधि before स्था to stay, शतृ aff.
1068: अधिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fixed, determined, established; literally or figuratively, as a house or a practice. 2 Supervised, overlooked. 3 Guarded, surrounded. 4 Appointed. E. अधि, and स्थित stationed.
1069: अधीकार m. (-रः) Superintendence, authority, &c. See अधिकार.
1070: अधीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Read, read through. E. the participial deriv. from अधी to read over, or study.
1071: अधीतवेद m. (-दः) A Brahman, who has read the Vedas; a student who has finished his course of study. E. अधीत, and वेद the Veda.
1072: अधीति f. (-तिः) Study, perusal. E. अधी to read, and क्तिन् aff.
1073: अधीतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) A scholar, one who has finished his studies. E. अधीत, and इनि aff.
1074: अधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Docile. 2 Dependant. E. अधि, and इन a master.
1075: अधीनता f. (-ता) Subjection, dependance, slavery: so अधीनत्व (-त्वं) E. ता or त्व added to the last.
1076: अधीयान m. (-नः) A student, one going over or reading the Vedas, &c. E. अधि before इ to go, शानच् aff.
1077: अधीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Confused, perplexed. 2 Unsteady, (lit. or met.) f. (-रा) 1 Lightning. 2 An offended, cross or capricious mistress or wife. E. अ neg. and धीर firm, steady.
1078: अधीरता f. (-ता) Fickleness, unsteadiness; also अधीरत्वं. E. ता or त्व added to the last.
1079: अधीश m. (-शः) A master, a lord. E. अधि, and ईश master.
1080: अधीश्वर m. (-रः) An emperor, a king paramount over all the neighbouring princes. E. अधि superior, and ईश्वर a lord.
1081: अधुना ind. Now, at present. E. इदस् this, irregularly formed.
1082: अधुनातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Of or belonging to the present. E. अधुना, and द्युल् aff.
1083: अधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unheld, undetained. m. (-तः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. अ neg. धृत held.
1084: अधृति f. (-तिः) 1 Laxity, want of firm hold. 2 Want of steadiness or firmness. E. अ neg. धृति holding.
1085: अधृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ashamed, modest, humble. E. अ neg. धृष्ट proud.
1086: अधृष्टता f. (-ता) Modesty, diffidence: also अधृष्टत्व n. (-त्वं) E. ता or त्व added to the last.
1087: अधृष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Proud, vain. f. (-ष्या) The name of a river. E. अ neg. and धृष to be proud; than whom nought is prouder.
1088: अधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be held or taken. E. अ neg. धा to have, ण्यत् aff.
1089: अधैर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Unsteady, feeble, irresolute. n. (-र्य्यं) Instability, want of firmness. E. अ not, धैर्य्य firmness.
1090: अधोऽंशुक n. (-कं) A lower garment. E. अधस् beneath, and अंशुक clothes.
1091: अधोक्षज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. अधस, अक्ष an organ of sense, and ज who is produced; being produced by, or produced to, such as have subdued or cast down their passions.
1092: अधोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Descended, gone down. E. अधस् down, गत gone.
1093: अधोगति f. (-तिः) Going downwards, lit. or fig. descent, degradation. Also अधोगमः and अधोगमनं. E. अधस् and गति, &c. going.
1094: अधोगामिन् n. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Descending, going downwards. E. अधस्, and गामिन् who goes.
1095: अधोघण्टा f. (-ण्टा) A plant, (Acheranthes aspera.) See अपामार्ग. E. अधस्, and घटि to hurt, with अच् aff.
1096: अधोङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 The anus. 2 Pudendum muliebre. E. अधस् and अङ्ग member.
1097: अधोजिह्विका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. E. अधस् below, and जिह्वा the tongue.
1098: अधोदृष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Downcast, one who looks down. E. अधस्, and दृष्टि sight.
1099: अधोपर n. (-रं) 1 The anus. 2 Pudendum muliebre.
1100: अधोबन्धन n. (नं) An under girth or strap. E. अधस्, and बन्धन binding.
1101: अधोभव n. (-वः-वा-वं) Placed below, inferior. E. अधस् and भव produced.
1102: अधोभाग m. (-गः) The bottom, the lowest part. E. अधस्, and भाग part.
1103: अधोभागहर n. (-रं) Purging. E. अधोभाग the lower part (of the body,) हर what affects.
1104: अधोभुवन n. (-नं) The regions below the earth. E. अधस् beneath, and भुवन a world; the world below.
1105: अधोमर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The anus. E. अधस्, and मर्म्मम् a member.
1106: अधोमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) 1 Down-looked, looking downwards. 2 Inverted, turned upside down. 3 Headlong. f. (-खा) A plant, (Premna esculenta.) E. अधस्, and मुख the face.
1107: अधोयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A still, or the lower of two vessels luted together for distilling, sublimation, &c. E. अधस्, and यन्त्र a vessel.
1108: अधोलम्व m. (-म्वः) A perpendicular. E. अधस् below, लम्व a straight line.
1109: अधोलोक m. (-कः) The regions below the earth. E. अधस्, and लोक world.
1111: अधोवश m. (-शः) 1 Bottom of a thing. 2 Pudendum muliebre. E. अधस्, and वश dependance.
1112: अधोवायु m. (-युः) The vital air that passes downwards. E. अधस्, and वायु air.
1113: अधोस्रपित्त n. (-त्तं) Discharge of blood from the anus, urethra, &c. E. अधम्, अस्रपित plethora.
1114: अध्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Perceptible, present to the senses, 2 Superintending, presiding over. m. (-क्षः) 1 A superintendent in general, one of receipts and disbursements. 2 A plant, (a species of Mimusops.) See क्षीरिका. E. अधि, and अक्ष to pervade, with अच् aff.
1115: अध्यक्षता f. (-ता) Superintendence: also अध्यक्षत्व. n. (-त्वं) E. ता or त्व added to the last.
1116: अध्यक्षर n. (रं) The mysterious word Om. E. अधि, and अक्षर letter: above all others in importance or in place; being often put at the head of various writings.
1117: अध्यग्नि ind. Gifts made to a woman at the time of her marriage. E. अधि near, over, &c. and अग्नि fire, being presented at the time that burnt offerings are made.
1118: अध्यण्डा f. (-ण्डा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. अधि, अम to be diseased, and ड affix; superior to disease. See अव्यंगा.
1119: अध्यय m. (-यः) A lecture, a chapter or section. E. अधि before इक् to go, अङ् aff.
1120: अध्ययन n. (-नं) Study, reading, especially of the sacred books; one of the six duties of a Brahman. E. अधि, इङ् to go, and ल्युट् aff.
1121: अध्यवसाय m. (-यः) Effort, exertion, determined application. E. अधि, and अव before षो to destroy, with the affixes घञ् and यक्.
1122: अध्यवसायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undertaken, attempted, as a difficult task. E. अधि, and अव before षो, affix क्त.
1123: अध्यवसायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Resolute, determined. E. अध्यवसाय, and इनि aff.
1124: अध्यशन n. (-नं) Eating too often, taking food before that previously eaten is digested. E. अधि, and अशन eating.
1125: अध्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Substituted. 2 Placed over. E. अधि, and अस्त thrown.
1126: अध्यस्थि n. (-स्थि) Bony exfoliation or deposit. E. अधि, and अस्थि a bone.
1127: अध्यात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 The soul, individuated spirit, or that which belongs to and presides over the body. 2 The supreme spirit. E. अधि, and आत्मन् self or soul.
1128: अध्यात्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Spiritual, relating to the supreme spirit. E. अध्यात्मन् and ठक् aff.
1129: अध्यात्मदृश् m. (-दृक्) A holy sage, one who knows the nature of inherent spirit. E. अध्यात्मन, and दृश् who sees.
1130: अध्यात्मरति m. (-तिः) An anchorite, one who diligently meditates on the supreme spirit. E. अध्यात्मन्, and रति pleasure.
1131: अध्यापक m. (-कः) A teacher, one who instructs in the sacred books. E. अधि, and इङ् to go, in the causal form, and वुन् aff.
1132: अध्यापन n. (-नं) Instructing, teaching the sacred books; one of the six duties of a Brahman. E. अधि, इङ to go, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
1133: अध्यापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught. E. अधीङ and क्त aff.
1134: अध्याय m. (-यः) 1 The section, or division of a book. 2 A chapter or lecture of the Vedas. E. अधि, इङ to go, and घञ् aff. proper to be gone through or read.
1135: अध्यारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Mounted on, riding upon. 2 Exceeding, very much. E. अधि, and आङ before रुह to become manifest, affix क्त.
1137: अध्यारोपण n. (-णं) 1 Fixing in or upon. 2 Transferring. 3 Attaching erroneously the predicates of one object to another, as of eternity to matter, &c. E. अधि before रुह to grow, causal form ल्युट् affix, also with घञ् affix अध्यारोपः.
1138: अध्यारोह m. (-हः) Mounting or ascending. E. अधि, and आङ before रुह to rise, affix घञ्.
1139: अध्यारोहण n. (-ण) Ascending, mounting on or upon. E. अधि and आङ before रुह to rise, ल्युट् aff.
1140: अध्यावाहनिक n. (-कं) A woman's marriage portion, a dowry of such property as has descended to her lineally. E. अधि and आङ before वह to convey, ल्युट् affix, and ठक added.
1141: अध्यास n. (-सं) 1 Inhabiting as chief, residing in, presiding over or ruling. 2 Sitting on or upon. 3 Transferring. 4 Attributing erroneously the nature of one thing to another, as of eternity to matter, &c. E. अधि before, आस sit, affix घञ्.
1142: अध्यासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seated in or on. 2 Presiding over. 3 Inhabited. E. अधि before, आस to sit, क्त aff.
1143: अध्यासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Seated in or on. 2 Placed or presiding over. E. अधि before, आसीन seated.
1144: अध्याहरण n. (-णं) 1 Supplying an ellipsis. 2 Reasoning, discussing. E. अधि, आङ prefixed to हृञ to convey, with ल्युट् aff.
1145: अध्याहार m. (-रः) 1 Adding a word or words to complete a sentence, supplying an ellipsis. 2 Reasoning, argument. E. See अध्याहरण, घञ् being the aff.
1146: अध्याहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Investigable. 2 Requiring an ellipsis to be supplied. E. अधि, and आङ before हृ to take, ण्यत् aff.
1147: अध्याहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Supplied as an ellipsis. 2 Argued, discussed. E. अधि and आङ before हृ to take, क्त aff.
1148: अध्युषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inhabited, settled. E. अधि before वस to dwell, affix क्त.
1149: अध्युष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A litter drawn or carried by a camel. E. अधि, and उष्ट्र a camel.
1150: अध्यूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Very prosperous, thriving. 2 Much. m. (-ढः) A name of ŚIVA. f. (-ढा) A superseded wife, one whose husband has married others. E. अधि, and ऊढ borne, from वह to bear, affix क्त.
1151: अध्येतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A student, reading, studying. E. अधि before इङ to go, शतृ aff.
1152: अध्येषणा f. (-णा) 1 Request, solicitation. 2 Asking, begging. E. अधि, इष to wish, and ल्यु aff.
1153: अध्रुव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Unstable, unfixed, uncertain, transient, perishable. E. अ neg. ध्रुव fixed.
1154: अध्वग mf. (-गः-गा) A traveller. m. (-गः) 1 A camel. 2 The sun. f. (-गा) A name of the river Ganges. E. अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes, from गम, with ड aff.
1155: अध्वगमन n. (-नं) Journeying, travelling. E. अध्वन, and गमन going.
1156: अध्वगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Travelling, a traveller. E. अध्वन and गामिन् who goes.
1157: अध्वगभोग्य m. (-ग्यः) A tree, (Spondias mangifera.) E. अध्वग a traveller, and भोग्य to be enjoyed by.
1158: अध्वन् m. (-ध्वा) 1 A road. 2 Fixing, placing. 3 Time. 4 Assault. 5 Correcting viscidity, dilution of the phlegm and marrow. E. अत to go constantly, क्वनिप् affix; ध substituted for त.
1159: अध्वनीन mf. (-नः-ना) A traveller. E. अध्वन्, and त्व aff.
1160: अध्वन्य mf. (-न्यः-न्या) A traveller. E. अध्वन्, and यत् aff.
1161: अध्वर m. (-रः) 1 A sacrifice. 2 A Vasu, or a kind of demigod. 3 Intent, attentive, careful. E. अ neg. ध्वृ to bend or make crooked, and अच् affix; or अध्व a road, and र from रा to give; leading to heaven.
1162: अध्वरथ m. (-थः) A travelling carriage or cart. E. अध्वन् a road, and रथ a carriage.
1163: अध्वर्य्यु m. (-र्य्युः) A Brahman versed in the Yajurveda. E. अध्वर a sacrifice, क्यच् and उ affix, अ being dropped.
1164: अध्वशल्य m. (-ल्यः) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) See अपमार्ग. E. अध्वन्, and शल्य a stake.
1165: अध्वान्त n. (-न्तं) Gloom, twilight. E. अ neg. ध्यान्त darkness.
1166: अध्वान्तशात्रव m. (-वः) A plant, (Cassia fistula.) See पत्रोर्ण. E. अ neg. ध्वान्त darkness, शावव inimical; blossoming in the shade.
1167: अन (घ) r. 2d cl. (अनिति) Also of 4th cl. (ङ) (अन्यते) To breathe, to live See अण.
1168: अनंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Portionless, not entitled to a share or portion. E. अन neg. अंश a part.
1169: अनंशुमत्फला f. (-ला) A plantain, (Musa sapientum.) See अंशुमत्फला.
1170: अनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Inferior, low. See अणक.
1171: अनक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-का-क्षं) Blind, eyeless. E. अन् neg. अक्षि the eye, the final dropped.
1172: अनक्षर n. (-र) 1 Blamable discourse, what is unfit to be uttered. 2 Abuse. E. अन् neg. and अक्षर a letter.
1173: अनक्षि mfn. (-क्षिः-क्षिः-क्षि) Having bad eyes. E. अन् neg. and अक्षि the eye.
1174: अनगार m. (-रः) A saint, an anchorite. E. अन् neg. and अगार a house; living in woods.
1175: अनग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman who has not maintained his household fire. E. अन् neg. अग्नि fire.
1176: अनघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) 1 Clean, clear. 2 Pure, sinless. 2 Handsome, pleasing. E. अन् neg. and अघ fault, faultless.
1177: अनङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Bodiless, incorporeal. m. (-हृ) A name of KĀMA, the Hindu deity of love. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Heaven, aether or the atmosphere. 2 The mind or faculty of reasoning. E. अन् neg. and अङ्ग body; as applicable to KĀMA, it alludes to his having been reduced to ashes, by the eye of ŚIVA, for having disturbed his devotions, and rendered him enamoured of PĀRVATĪ.
1178: अनङ्गक n. (-कं) The mind or faculty of reasoning. E. अनङ्ग, and कन् aff.
1179: अनङ्गासुहृद् m. (-हृद or -हृत्) A name of ŚIVA. E. अनङ्ग KĀMA, अ neg. and सुहृद् a friend, the foe of KĀMA.
1180: अनच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) Turbid, muddy. E. अन् neg. and अच्छ clear.
1181: अनञ्जन n. (-नं) The sky, atmosphere, aether. E. अञ्ज to go, with the neg. prefix अन्, and affix ल्युट्.
1182: अनडुह् m. (-ड्वान्) A bull or ox. f. (-डुही or -ड्वाही) A cow. E. अनस् a cart, वह to bear, and क्विप् affix, with ड inserted: after अनस्, व is changed to उ in the mas., optionally in the fem.
1183: अनणु m. (-णुः) Small grain. E. अन् neg. अणु an atom.
1184: अनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Erect, not bowed down. 2 Proud, haughty. E. अ neg. नत bowed.
1185: अनतता f. (-ता) 1 Erectness, stiffness. 2 Pride. also अनतत्व n. (-त्वं) E. ता or त्व added to the last.
1186: अनतिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Moderation, mediocrity, equality, not over. stepping certain limits, not surpassing certain qualities, &c. 2 Propriety, decorum. E. अन् neg. अतिक्रम exceeding.
1187: अनतिक्रम्य ind. Not having transgressed, &c. mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्य) Incapable of being transgressed or exceeded. E. अन् neg. अतिक्रम्य having surpassed, &c.
1188: अनतिक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Unsurpassed, unexceeded. 2 Untransgressed, &c. E. अन् neg. अतिक्रान्त surpassed, &c.
1189: अनतिरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Equal, not exceeded in quantity or quality. E. अन् neg. आंतक्त more.
1190: अनधिकार m. (-रः) Absence of right, claim, interest or concern. E. अन् neg. अधिकार right.
1191: अनधिकारचर्च्चा f. (-र्च्चा) Officiousness, meddling with other people's business. E. अनधिकार, and चर्च्चा investigation.
1192: अनधिकारिन् m. (-री) A non-heir, one who has no right or claim. E. अन् neg. अधिकारिन् an heir.
1193: अनधिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uninherited, unclaimed. 2 Not set over, or appointed. E. अन् neg. अधिकृत claimed, &c.
1194: अनधिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Not acquired. 2 Not learnt or studied. E. अन् neg. अधिगत gone over.
1195: अनधिगम m. (-मः) 1 Non-acquirement. 2 Non-perusal. E. अन् neg. अधिगम obtaining, &c.
1196: अनधिगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Unattainable. 2 Incapable of being known. E. अन् neg. अधिगम्य to be attained.
1197: अनधिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Absent, not present. 2 Not placed over, not appointed. 3 Not ordered or enjoined. E. अन् neg. अधिष्ठित placed over.
1198: अनधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Independent. E. अन् neg. अधीन dependant.
1199: अनध्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Imperceptible, unperceived, absent. See अप्रत्यक्ष. 2 Having no superintendent. E. अन् neg. and अध्यक्ष perceptible, &c.
1200: अनध्याय m. (-यः) Intermission of study. E. अन् neg. अध्याय reading.
1201: अनध्यायदिवस m. (-सः) A day on which it is improper to study. E. अनध्याय, and दिबस a day.
1202: अननुज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Denied, refused, not assented to. E. अन् neg. अनुज्ञात assented to.
1203: अनन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Eternal, endless. 2 Unbounded, illimitable. 3 Infinite, innumerable. m. (-न्तः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 2 BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. 3 The chief of the Nāgas or serpent race, that inhabit the infernal regions: the couch and constant attendant of VIṢṆU. 4 The king of serpents, confounded with VĀSUKI. See वासुकि. 5 The fourteenth of the Jaina Tīrthakaras or deified Saints: also called अनन्तजित्. f. (-न्ता) 1 A name of PĀRVATĪ, the wife of ŚIVA. 2 The earth. 3 A synonym of several plants, (as Hedysarum alhagi.) 4 A kind of potherb. See विशल्या. 5 Bent grass, (Agrostis linearis.) 6 Another plant, (Echites frutescens, Rox.) See श्यामा. Or according to others, (Asclepias psoudosarsa, Rox.) See शारीवा. 7 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia citrina.) 9 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 9 Another plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) See गुडुची. 10 Long pepper. See कणा. n. (-न्तं) Sky or atmosphere, aether. E. अन् neg. and अन्त end.
1204: अनन्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Endless, eternal. E. कन् added to the preceding.
1205: अनन्तचतुर्दशी f. (-शी) The fourteenth lunation of the light half of Bhadra, when ANANTA is worshipped. E. अनन्त, and चतुर्दशी the fourteenth.
1206: अनन्तजित् m. (-जित्) The fourteenth of the twenty-four Jaina deified Saints: also called अनन्त. E. अनन्त endless, and जित् who conquers, who gains eternity.
1207: अनन्तता f. (-ता) Eternity: also अनन्तत्व n. (-त्वं) E. ता or त्व added to अनन्त.
1208: अनन्ततीर्थकृत् m. (-कृत्) The fourteenth Jaina Saint, also अनन्त, &c. E. अनन्त endless, तीर्थ pilgrimage or virtue, and कृत् who has made.
1209: अनन्तमूल m. (-लः) A plant, (Periploca Indica.) E. अनन्त, and मूल root.
1210: अनन्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Next, immediately following. 2 Next of kin or in succession. 3 Close, compact. n. (-रं) Extreme propinquity. E. अन् neg. and अन्तर between; having nothing intermediate.
1211: अनन्तरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born of the next in order; as of a Kṣatriya woman, by a Brahman; of a Vaiśya woman, by a Kṣatriya. E. अनन्तर, and ज born.
1212: अनन्तराशि f. (-शिः) In arithmetic; infinite quantity. E. अनन्त endless, राशि quantity.
1213: अनन्तरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Multiform. E. अनन्त, and रूप form.
1214: अनन्तवात m. (-तः) Rigidity or paralysis of the muscles of the face and neck. E. अनन्त, and वात wind.
1215: अनन्तविजय m. (-यः) The shell of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. अनन्त, and बिजय victory.
1216: अनन्तवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The twenty third Jaina Tīrthakara of a future age. E. अनन्त endless, and वीर्य्य power.
1217: अनन्तव्रत n. (-तं) A ceremony performed in honour of VIṢṆU, on the day of the full moon in Bhādra. E. अनन्त, and व्रत a religious observance.
1218: अनन्तशीर्षा f. (-र्षा) The wife of VĀSUKI, the king of serpents. E. अनन्त many, and शीर्ष a head; many headed.
1219: अनन्त्य mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं) Infinite, unbounded, eternal. n. (-त्य) 1 Immortality. 2 Eternity. 3 Infinity. E. अन् neg. अन्त्य final.
1220: अनन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 One, sole, without any other. 2 Same, identical. E. अन् neg. अन्य other.
1221: अनन्यगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Having but one refuge. f. (-तिः) One only refuge or asylum. E. अनन्य, and गति motion.
1222: अनन्यगतिक mfn. (कः-का-कं) Having one refuge or hope alone. E. कन् added to the last.
1223: अनन्यज m. (-जः) A name of KĀMA or love. E. अन् neg. अन्य. other, and ज born; produced only in the heart.
1224: अनन्यता f. (-ता) 1 Singleness. 2 Identity. E. अनन्य, and ता or त्व affix; also अनन्यत्वं.
1225: अनन्यपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Intact, virgin, never in the prior possession of another. f. (-र्व्वा) A virgin, a girl not previously wedded. E. अन् neg. अन्य another, पूर्व्व prior; also with कन् added अनन्यपूर्ष्वक.
1226: अनन्यभव mfn. (वः-वा-वं) Produced or effected by one particular person or thing. E. अनन्य, and भव born.
1228: अनन्यमनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Intent, attentive, having the mind fixed on one subject, not absent. E. अन् neg. अन्यमनस् or अन्यसनस्क thinking of some thing else.
1229: अनन्यवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Closely attentive, having the mind fixed on one object. E. अन् neg. अन्य other, वृत्ति profession.
1230: अनन्यहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not stolen or taken, safe. E. अन् neg. अन्य another, हृत taken.
1231: अनन्यहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Incapable of being taken or stolen. E. अन् neg. अन्य another, हार्य्य to be taken.
1232: अनन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unconnected with, irrelevant. 2 Devoid of, not possessing. E. अन् neg. अन्वित possessed of.
1233: अनपकरण n. (-णं) 1 Non-requital, not retaliating. 2 Non-resumption. 3 Not doing ill. E. अन् before अपकरण evil doing.
1234: अनपकर्म्म n. (-र्म्म) 1 Non-retaliation. 2 Non-resumption, (of a thing given or paid, &c.) 3 Abstaining from evil. E. अन् before अपकर्म्म; also अनपाकर्म्म, अनपक्रिया, &c.
1235: अनपकार m. (-रः) Harmlessness, freedom from hatred and malice. E. अन् neg. अपकार evil doing.
1236: अनपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Innecuous. E. अनपकार, and इनि aff.
1237: अनपक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Non-requital, non-retaliation. 2 Non-acquittance (as of debt, &c.) 3 Non-resumption. 4 Abstaining from offence or evil. E. अन् before अपक्रिया offence, &c.
1238: अनपचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dishonoured, disregarded. E. अन् neg. अपचित honoured.
1239: अनपत्य mfn. (-कः-त्या-त्यं) Childless, having no progeny: so अनपत्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) E. अन् neg. अपत्य offspring.
1240: अनपर m. (-रः) Name of BRAHMĀ. E. अन् neg. अपर another.
1241: अनपराध m. (-धः) Innocence. mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Innocent, sinless. E. अन् neg. अपराध offence.
1242: अनपराधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Innocent, sinless. E. अन् neg. अपराधिन् offending.
1243: अनपाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undiminished, unceasing. m. (-यः) Permanence, absence of loss or diminution. E. अन् neg. अपाय loss.
1244: अनपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Firm, constant, durable, imperishable. 2 Increasing. E. अनपाय permanence, इनि aff.
1245: अनपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Disregarding, unheeding. f. (क्षा) Carelessness, indifference, disregard. E. अन neg. अपेक्षा regard.
1246: अनपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unheeded, disregarded. E. अन् neg. अपेक्षित regarded.
1247: अनपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Present, not passed or gone. 2 Possessed of, not devoid of. E. अन neg. अपेत gone away.
1248: अनभिमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disagreeable, unpleasant, disastrous, unlucky. E. अन् neg. अभिमत liked.
1249: अनभिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञ) Unwise, stupid. E. अन् neg. अभिज्ञ wise.
1250: अनभिभव m. (-वः) Freedom from obstruction or defeat. E. अन् neg. अभिभव defeat.
1251: अनभिभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unsubdued, unsurpassed. 2 Unobstructed. E. अन् neg. अभिभूत subdued.
1252: अनभिलाष m. (-षः) Indifference, absence of desire. E. अन् neg. अभिलाष desire.
1253: अनभिलाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-वि) Indifferent. E. अनभिलाष, and इनि aff.
1254: अनभिव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Indistinct, dim. E. अन् neg. अभिव्यक्त clear.
1255: अनभिष्वङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Detachment, disconnection, freedom from affection or attachment. E. अन् neg. अभिष्वङ्ग connection.
1256: अनम mfn. (-मः) A Brahman, one who does not salute a Brahman, making obeisance to the gods only, and returning salutations with his blessing. E. अ neg. and नम who salutes.
1257: अनमस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Unworthy of being saluted. E. अ neg. नमस्य to be saluted.
1258: अनय m. (-यः) 1 Fate. 2 Ill-luck, bad-fortune. 3 Calamity, distress. 4 Vice, transgression. E. अन् neg. and अय good fortune.
1259: अनयङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fallen into misfortune. E. अनय, and गत gone.
1260: अनर्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Self-willed, unrestrained. E. अन् neg. and अर्गल a bolt or bar.
1261: अनर्घ्य mfn. (-र्ध्यः-र्ध्या-र्ध्यं) Invaluable, priceless, not to be bought. E. अन् neg. अर्य्य price.
1262: अनर्घ्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Absence of price or cost, invaluableness; also अनर्ध्यता. E. त्व or ता added to the last.
1263: अनर्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unworshipped, unreverenced, disrespected. E. अन् neg. अर्च्चित worshipped.
1264: अनर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Unmeaning, fruitless, nonsensical. E. अन् neg. अर्थ use.
1265: अनर्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unmeaning, idle, fruitless. n. (-कं) Unmeaning or nonsensical discourse. E. अन् neg. अर्थ meaning, and कन् aff.
1266: अनर्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Unfit, unworthy, unsuitable. E. अन् neg. अर्ह fit.
1267: अनल m. (-लः) 1 A name of AGNI or fire. 2 One of the eight Vasus or demigods so called. 3 Bile. 4 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica and rosea.) E. अन् to be, and कलच् aff.
1268: अनलप्रिया f. (-या) The wife of AGNI. E. अनल, and प्रिया beloved.
1269: अनलम् ind. Insufficient, unequal, unable, not enough. E. अन् neg. अलम् enough.
1270: अनलि m. (-लिः) A plant, (Æschynomene grandiflora.) See अगस्तिद्रु.
1271: अनवगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Excellent, good, uncensured. E. अन् neg. अघगीत disparaged.
1272: अनवग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Resistless, not to be obstructed or impeded. E. अन् neg. अवग्रह obstruction.
1273: अनवद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Blameless, irreproachable. 2 Unobjectionable, allowable. E. अन् neg. अवद्य censurable.
1274: अनवधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Careless, inattentive. n. (-नं) Inadvertence, inattention, carelessness. E. अन् neg. अवधान care.
1275: अनवधानता f. (ता) Inadvertence, inattention. E. ता affix, subjoined to the preceding; or with त्व, अनवधानत्वं.
1276: अनवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Equal or superior, not younger nor inferior. E. अन् neg. अवर inferior.
1277: अनवरत adj. mfn. or adv. n. (-तः-ता-तं) Eternal, eternally, continually. E. अन् neg. अवरत stopped, ceased.
1278: अनवरार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Chief, principal. E. अन् neg. अवरार्द्ध inferior.
1279: अनवलम्व mfn. (-म्वः-म्वा-म्वं) Without support or dependance. E. अन् neg. अवलम्व support.
1280: अनवसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Occupied, busy, having no leisure. 2 Unseasonable, inopportune. m. (-रः) 1 Want of leisure or opportunity. 2 Unseasonableness, inopportuneness. E. अन् neg. अवसर leisure.
1281: अनवस्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Clean. E. अन् priv. and अवस्कर dirt.
1282: अनवस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Unstable, unsteady. 2 Incontinent. f. (स्था) 1 Instability, absence of fixed state or condition. Uncertainty, doubt. 3 Incontinence, dissoluteness. 4 (In logic,) the abstract nature of a thing, independent of its existence. E. अम् neg. अवस्था condition.
1283: अनवस्थान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unsteady, mutable, variable, not stationary. n. (-नं) 1 Instability. 2 Wrong situation or direction. 3 Misconduct. m. (-नः) Wind. E. अन् neg. अवस्थान fixture.
1284: अनवस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unfixed, unsteady, unstable, inconstant. 2 Loose, abandoned, violating moral and legal restraint. E. अन् neg. अवस्थित steady.
1285: अनवस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Unsteadiness, instability. 2 Dissoluteness, profligacy. E. अन् neg. and अवस्थिति stability.
1286: अनवाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Unobtained. E. अन neg. अवाप्त obtained.
1287: अनशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) One who fasts. n. (-नं) A fast, fasting. E. अन् neg. and अशन eating.
1288: अनश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Eternal, imperishable. E. अ neg. and नश्वर transient.
1289: अनस् n. (-नः) 1 A cart. 2 Boiled rice. 3 A mother. 4 Birth. 5 Life, breath. E. अन् to live, and असुन् aff.
1290: अनसूय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not envious. f. (-या) 1 The wife of the sage ATRI. 2 Exemption from envy. E. अन् neg. असूया envy.
1291: अनसूयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unenvious. E. अन् neg. असूया, and कन aff.
1292: अनसूयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Free from envy. E. अन् neg. असूय to envy, उस aff.
1293: अनहङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Absence of pride, humility. 2 The absence of the pride of individuality: one of the elements of creation, according to the Vedānta system. E. अन् neg. अहङ्कार pride.
1294: अनहङ्कारिन् mfn. (-री-रणी-रि) Philosophical, humble, not proud, not selfish. E. अन् neg. अहङ्कारिन् proud.
1295: अनहङ्कृति f. (-तिः) Content, satisfaction, the absence of care or vanity. E. अन् neg. and अहङ्कृति pride.
1296: अनाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Shapeless, without form. E. अट् neg. आकार form.
1297: अनाकाल n. (-लं) Scarcity, famine. E. अन् neg. आङ before काल time.
1298: अनाकालभृत m. (-तः) A slave, one who has given himself to slavery, in a season of scarcity, for support. E. अनाकाल, and भृत nourished.
1299: अनाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unperplexed, collected, composed, E. अन् neg. and आकुल perplexed, confused.
1300: अनाक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Unsurpassed, unsubdued. f. (-न्ता) A sort of prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini. VILD.) See कण्ठकारी. E. अन् neg. आक्रान्त surpassed.
1301: अनाक्षारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not calumniated, free from reproach or censure. E. अन् neg. आक्षारित censured.
1302: अनागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Not come, not arrived: (of a person, absent;) future, (of time.) 2 Unknown, undistinguished. 3 Not acquired, learned or obtained. E. अन् neg. आगत come, &c.
1303: अनागतार्तवा f. (-वा) A young girl, one not arrived at puberty. E. अन् neg. आगत arrived, and आर्तव from ऋतु the menstrual flux, who has not menstruated.
1304: अनागम m. (-मः) 1 Non-arrival of person or time. 2 Non-acquisition. mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Not arrived, not present. 2 Not having or obtaining. 3 Not scriptural. 4 Not having vouchers or deeds. E. अन् neg. आगम arrival, &c.
1305: अनागम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Unapproachable, inaccessible. 2 Unobtainable. E. अन् neg. आगम्य to be approached.
1306: अनाचरण n. (-णं) Improper or immoral conduct. E. अन् neg. आचरण moral rule or practice.
1307: अनाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Immoral, ill behaved, indecent. m. (-रः) Impropriety, violation of moral or civil rule or institute. E. अन् neg. आचार moral rule.
1308: अनाचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Immoral, indecorous, indecent. E. अन् neg. आचारिन् decent.
1309: अनाढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) Poor, without wealth. E. अन् neg. आढ्य rich.
1310: अनातप m. (-पः) 1 Shade, shadow. 2 Coolness. E. अन् neg. and आतप heat, moral or physical.
1311: अनातुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Well, vigorous, free from sickness or pain. E. अ neg. आतुर diseased.
1312: अनात्मनीन mfn. (-नः-ता-नं) Disinterested, liberal, not regarding self alone. E. अन् neg. आत्मनीन selfish.
1313: अनाथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Without a master or protector, without a husband, &c. E. अ neg. नाथ master.
1314: अनादर m. (-रः) Disrespect. E. अन् neg. and आदर respect.
1315: अनादि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Eternal, without any beginning, unborn, uncreate. E. अन् neg. आदि beginning.
1316: अनादित्व n. (-त्वं) Eternity, exemption from commencement or birth. Also अनादिता. E. ता or त्व added to the last.
1317: अनादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Denied, refused, dissented. 2 Not directed, advised or commanded. E. अन् neg. आदिष्ट directed.
1318: अनादीनव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Pure, faultless. E. अन् neg. आदीनव faulty.
1319: अनादृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected, despised. E. अन् neg. and आदृत respected.
1320: अनादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Inadmissable, unacceptable, not to be taken or received. E. अन् neg. आदेय to be taken.
1321: अनाधृष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Unconquerable, indomitable. E. अन् neg. आधृष्य to be tamed.
1322: अनापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Unobtained, unattained. E. अन् neg. आपन्न obtained.
1323: अनाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Unskilful, unapt. 2 Uneffected, unobtained. E. अन् neg. आप्त fit.
1324: अनामक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Nameless, noteless. m. (-कः) The intercalary month. n. (-कं) Piles or hoemorrhoids. E. अ bad, नामक from नामन् a name, with कन् aff.
1325: अनामन् m. (-मा) The ring finger. See अनामिका.
1326: अनामय n. (-यं) Health. E. अन् neg. and आमय sickness.
1327: अनामिका f. (-का) The ring finger. E. अ neg. and नामिका deriv. of नामन् a name, having no other name.
1328: अनायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unchecked, unrestrained. 2 Close, continuous, unseparated. 3 Unextended, having no length. E. अन् neg. आयत restrained.
1329: अनायत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Independent, uncontrolled. E. अन् neg. आयत्त dependant.
1330: अनायत्तवृत्तिता f. (-ता) Independence, self subsistence. E. अनायत्त, and वृत्ति or वृत्तिता business.
1331: अनायास m. (-सः) Exemption from pain or difficulty, facility, ease. 2 Absence of exertion, idleness, neglect. E. अन् neg. आयास effort.
1332: अनायासकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done readily or easily. 2 In medicine, prepared extemporaneously, simply decocted, (medicine or drugs.) E. अन् neg. आयास effort, pains, and कृत made, made without trouble.
1333: अनार्जव n. (-वं) 1 Crookedness, moral or physical. 2 Disease. E. अन् neg. आर्जव straightness.
1334: अनारत adj. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) adv. n. (-तं) Eternal, eternally. E. अन् neg. and आ prefixed to रम to be pleased, क्त affixed; having no rest.
1335: अनारम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Defect of commencement, being without a beginning. 2 Non-commencement, not attempting or undertaking. E. अन् neg. आरम्भ beginning.
1336: अनारोग्य n. (-ग्यं) Sickness. E. अन् neg. आरोग्य health.
1337: अनारोग्यकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Unwholesome, unhealthy, causing sickness. E. अनारोग्य, and कर what makes.
1338: अनार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Unworthy, inferior, bad, vile. E. अन् neg. आर्य्य respectable.
1339: अनार्य्यक n. (-कं) Agallochum or aloe wood, (Aquila agallocha, Rox.) See the next.
1340: अनार्य्यज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Of vile or unworthy origin. n. (-जं) Agallochum or aloe wood, (Aquila agallocha.) See अगुरु. E. अन् priv. आर्य्य respectable, and ज produced; the perfume being brought from the country of Mlecchas or barbarians.
1341: अनार्य्यता f. (-ता) Vileness, unworthiness, baseness; also अनार्य्यत्वं. E. ता or त्व added to अनार्य्य.
1342: अनार्य्यतिक्त m. (-क्तः) A medicinal plant, a kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.) E. अनार्य्य inferior, and तिक्त bitter.
1343: अनालम्ब mfn. (-म्वः-म्वा-म्वं) Unsupported, without stay or support. E. अन् gen. आलम्व support.
1344: अनालाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Silent, taciturn. m. (-पः) Taciturnity. E. अन् neg. आलाप conversing.
1345: अनालोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unseen, unbeheld. 2 Unweighed, unconsidered, rash, imprudent. E. अन् neg. आलोचित seen.
1346: अनाविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Clear, clean, pure. E. अन् neg. and आविल turbid.
1347: अनावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uncovered, undressed. 2 Open, uninclosed. E. अन् neg. आवृत covered.
1348: अनावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Not stirred or turned round. 2 Not retreating. E. अन्, and आवृत्त whirled.
1349: अनावृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Drought. E. अन् neg. आ before वृष्टि rain.
1350: अनाश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Indestructible. E. अ neg. नाश्य to be destroyed.
1351: अनाश्रय m. (-यः) Detachment, absence of attachment or dependance. E. अन् neg. आश्रय asylum.
1352: अनाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Detached, disengaged, unconcerned in or unconnected with. E. अन् neg. आश्रित dependant.
1353: अनाश्वस् mfn. (-श्वान्-शुषी-श्वत्) Fasting, not eating. E. अन् neg. आश्वस् eating.
1354: अनासादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not occurred, not having happened, non-existent. E. अन् neg. आसादित effected.
1355: अनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Noseless. E. अ neg. and नासिका the nose.
1356: अनास्था f. (-स्था) 1 Disrespect. 2 Want of fixity or condition. E. अन् neg. आस्था station.
