1357: अनाहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unhurt, unbeaten, unwounded, intact. 2 New and unbleached, (as cloth.) m. (-तः) The fourth of the mystical Cakras or circles of the body. E. अन् neg. and आहत beaten.
1358: अनाहार n. (-रः) 1 Abstinence, starvation. 2 Non-production. 3 Non-seizure. E. अन् neg. आहार food, &c.
1359: अनाहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Not seizing. 2 Fasting. E. अन्, and आहारिन् who takes food.
1360: अनाहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Not to be seized or taken, not producible. 2 Not to be eaten. E. अन् neg. आहार्य्य to be taken, &c.
1361: अनाहुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uncalled, unbidden: also अनाहूत. E. अन् neg. आहुत called.
1362: अनिक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A sort of long grass or reed, (Saccharum spontaneum). E. अन् neg. and इक्षु sugar-cane; not it, but it's like.
1363: अनिगीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-णं) Unuttered, unsaid. E. अ neg. निगीर्ण uttered.
1364: अनिग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-क्षं) Unrestrained, unconfined. E. अ neg. निग्रह restraint.
1365: अनिच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) Undesirous, averse, indifferent: so अनिच्छक. E. अन्, and इच्छा wish.
1366: अनिच्छा f. (-छा) Indifference, absence of wish or desire. E. अन् neg. इच्छा desire.
1367: अनिछु mfn. (-छुः-छुः-छु) 1 Disliking, not wishing. 2 Indifferent. E. अन् neg. इच्छु who wishes: also अनिच्छक.
1368: अनित्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Transient, not everlasting. 2 Occasional, incidental. 3 Irregular, unusual. E. अ neg. नित्य constant.
1369: अनित्यक्रिया f. (-या) An occasional act of worship, sacrifice for a special purpose. E. अनित्य occasional, not constant, and क्रिया rite, also अनित्यकर्म्म, &c.
1370: अनित्यता f. (-ता) Transient or limited existence: also अनित्यत्व. E. ता or त्व added to the last.
1371: अनित्यसम m. (-मः) Arguing by illustration, not by logical rule. E. अनित्य unusual, and सम same.
1372: अनिदान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Causeless, groundless. E. अ neg. निदान.
1373: अनिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Awake, sleepless. E. अ neg. निद्रा sleep.
1374: अनिन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pious, virtuous, free, unreproachable. E. अ neg. and निन्दित reproached.
1375: अनिन्द्य mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्य) Faultless. E. अ neg. निन्द्य blamable.
1376: अनिपुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Unskilled, unlearned, not conversant. E. अ neg. निपुण clever.
1377: अनिबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Unproduced, unseized. 2 Unasked. E. अ neg. निवद्ध attached.
1378: अनिभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unsteady (as the mind), agitated. 2 Tremulous, moving. E. अ neg. निभृत held firmly.
1379: अनिमिष m. (-षः) 1 A god. 2 A fish. 3 A person whose eyes are fixed, (as in disease, &c.) E. अ neg. and निमिष what twinkles; the eyes being always fixed.
1380: अनिमिषाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. अनिमिष a deity, and आचार्य्य a teacher; the preceptor of the gods.
1381: अनिमेष m. (-षः) 1 A deity. 2 A fish. 3 A demon. 4 A spirit or ghost. 5 A person whose eyes are fixed. See अनिमिष.
1382: अनियत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Transitory, perishable. 2 Unrestrained. 3 Undefined, unprescribed. E. अ neg. नियत restrained.
1383: अनियम m. (-मः) 1 Uncertainty, doubt. 2 Absence of moral or religious obligation. 3 Indecorous or improper conduct. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undetermined, undefined, unprovided for, by any rule or law. E. अ neg. नियम fixed observance.
1384: अनिराकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unchecked, unobstructed. E. अ neg. निराकृत opposed.
1385: अनिरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 A spy, a secret emissary. 2 Self willed, ungovernable, headstrong. 3 Unobstructed, unrestrained. m. (-द्धः) The son of PRADYUMNA, a form of KĀMA, and husband of UṢĀ. n. (-द्धं) The rope for fastening cattle. E. अ neg. निरुद्ध restrained.
1386: अनिरुद्धपथ n. (-थ) 1 The atmosphere, aether. 2 An unobstructed path. E. अनिरुद्ध unobstructed, and पथिन् a road.
1387: अनिरुद्धभाविनी f. (-नी) A proper name. See उषा. E. अनिरुद्ध, and भाविनी a wife; the wife of ANIRUDDHA.
1388: अनिर्णय m. (-यः) Uncertainty. E. अ neg. निर्णय certainty.
1389: अनिर्णीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unascertained, undetermined. E. अ neg. निर्णीत ascertained.
1390: अनिर्णेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undecidable, incapable of being decided. अ E. neg. निर्णेय decidable.
1391: अनिर्दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Unexplained, undefined. E. अ neg. निर्दिष्ट explained.
1392: अनिर्देश m. (-शः) Absence of demonstration or direction. E. अ neg. निर्दिश instruction.
1393: अनिर्द्धारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unascertained, undetermined, undefined. E. अ neg. निर्द्धारित defined.
1394: अनिर्भर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Little, slight, light. E. अ neg. निर्भर bulky.
1395: अनिर्म्मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Dirty, foul. अ E. neg. निर्म्मल clean.
1396: अनिर्माल्या f. (-ल्या) A plant, (Medicago esculenta, Rox.) See पृका. E. अ not, निर् out from, and माल्य from माला a necklace; not used in garlands.
1397: अनिर्वचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be mentioned or described, indescribable. E. अ neg. निर्वचनीय describable.
1398: अनिर्व्वाह m. (-हः) 1 Incoherence, want of connexion or consistency. 2 Want of means of subsistence. 3 Incompleteness. E. अ neg. निर्व्वाह connexion.
1399: अनिर्व्विण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 1 Disgusted. 2 Poor, needy. E. अ neg. निर्व्विण्ण satisfied.
1400: अनिर्व्विद mfn. (-वित्) Free from pain or trouble. E. अ neg. निर्व्विद what annoys.
1401: अनिर्व्वृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Discontented. 2 Unquiet discomposed. 3 Unaccomplished, unfulfilled. E. अ neg. निर्व्वृत effected.
1402: अनिर्व्वृति f. (तिः) 1 Poverty. 2 Discontent. 3 Incompleteness. E. अ neg. निर्व्वृति completion.
1403: अनिल m. (-लः) 1 Air or wind, considered also as a deity. 2 A subordinate deity, forty-nine of whom form a class, ANILAS or winds. 2 One of another class of demigods or Vasus. 4 Wind, as one of the humors of the body. 5 Rheumatism, paralysis, or any affection referred to disorder of the wind. E. अन to breathe, इलट् aff. f. (-ली) The fifteenth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion. See स्वाति. E. अनिल and the fem. termination: the wind being the ruling deity of the constellation.
1404: अनिलघ्नक m. A large tree, (Terminalia belerica.) E. अनिल, घ्न what removes, कन् added.
1405: अनिलपर्य्यय m. (-यः) Pain and swelling of the eyelids and outer parts of the eye. E. अनिल, and पर्य्यय pervasion.
1406: अनिलसख m. (-खः) A name of fire. E. अनिल, and सखि a friend, the friend of the wind.
1407: अनिलात्मज m. (-जः) The son of the wind, HANUMAN or BHĪMA. E. अनिल, and आत्मज son.
1408: अनिलामय m. (यः-) 1 Flatulence. 2 Morbid affection of the wind, rheumatism, &c. E. अनिल, and आमय sickness.
1409: अनिलाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिणी-शि) Fasting, lit. feeding on the wind. E. अनिल, and अशिन् who eats.
1410: अनिलोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unconsidered, inconsiderate, imprudent. E. अ neg. निलोचित regarded.
1411: अनिलोडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unconsidered, ill judged, undiscriminated. E. अ neg. निलोडित revolved.
1412: अनिवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unchecked, unimpeded, unopposed, unforbidden. E. अ neg. निवारित checked.
1413: अनिश n. (-शः) Eternally, eternal, (not employed as an adjective.) E. अ neg. and निश from निशा night; having no night or end.
1414: अनिश्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unascertained, not certain. E. अ neg. निश्चित ascertained.
1415: अनिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Unwished, undesirable, bad, unlucky. f. (-ष्टा) A plant, (Sida alba.) E. अन् neg. इष्ट wished.
1416: अनिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Unsteadfastness, unsteadiness. E. अ neg. निष्ठा fixedness.
1417: अनिष्णात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unskilful, ignorant. E. अ neg. निष्णात clever.
1418: अनिष्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Imperfect, incomplete. E. अ neg. निष्यन्न completed.
1419: अनिषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Unprohibited, unforbidden. E. अ neg. निषिद्ध prohibited.
1420: अनिसर्ग mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) Unnaturally elated or depressed. E. अ neg. निसर्ग natural condition.
1421: अनिस्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Unanswered, unrefuted. 2 Not set aside or got over. E. अ neg. निस्तीर्ण replied to.
1422: अनीक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 An army, forces. 2 War, combat. E. अन् to live, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
1423: अनीकस्थ m. (-स्थः) 1 An armed or royal guard, a centinel. 2 A warrior, a combatant. 3 The trainer of an elephant, an elephant driver. 4 A mark, a sign, a signal. 5 A military drum. E. अनीक battle, and स्थ what stays.
1424: अनीकिनी f. (-नी) 1 An army, a host, forces. 2 A certain force; one-tenth of an Akṣauhiṇī, containing two thousand, one hundred and eighty-seven elephants, and as many cars, six thousand, five hundred and sixty-seven horse, and ten thousand, nine hundred and thirty-five foot. 3 A lotus. E. अनीक an army, इनि aff.
1425: अनीच mfn. (चः-चा-च) Decent, respectable. E. अ neg. नीच low.
1426: अनीचानुवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Not keeping low or improper company. m. (-र्त्ती) A faithful lover or husband. E. अ neg. नीच low, अनुवर्त्तिन् following.
1427: अनीचदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) A Bauddha saint. E. अ neg. नीच low, दर्शिन् who sees.
1428: अनीति f. (-तिः) 1 Impropriety, immorality. 2 Impolicy, ill conduct. E. अ neg. नाति good conduct.
1429: अनीदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Unlike, dissimilar. E. अ neg. ईदृश like.
1430: अनीश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) One who has not a lord or superior. m. (-शः) VIṢṆU. E. अन neg. ईश lord.
1431: अनीश्वर mfn. (रः-रा-रं) 1 Without a superior. 2 Unchecked, uncontrolled. 3 Without power, powerless, unable. 4 Atheist. E. अन् neg. ईश्वर a supreme.
1432: अनीश्वरता f. (-ता) Absence of a supreme ruler. E. ता or त्व added to the last: also अनीश्वरत्वं.
1433: अनीश्वरवादिन् m. (-दी) An atheist, one who denies a supreme ruler of the universe. E. अनीश्वर, and वादिन् who asserts.
1434: अनीह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Careless, indifferent. E. अन् neg. ईहा wish.
1435: अनीहा f. (-हा) Indifference, apathy, disinclination. E. अन् neg. ईहा wish.
1436: अनीहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disagreeable, displeasing, unwished. n. (-तं) Displeasure. E. अन्, and ईहित desired.
1437: अनु ind. A preposition and prefix, implying 1 After. 2 Like, in same manner. 3 Under, inferior to. 4 Along, lengthwise. 5 With, together with. 6 In part of. 7 Severally, each, by each. 8 Near to. 9 In regard to. 10 To, out to, (calling.) 11 Orderly, methodical. As अनुकर्त्तुं to act like; अनुगन्तुं to follow; अनुकमितुं to proceed in order; अनुशयितुं to repent, &c.; also, अनुरूपं according to the form; अनुविष्णु according to VIṢṆU; अनुगं गं upon or along the Ganges. See also the following words. E. अन् to live, and ज aff.
1438: अनुक mfn. (-कः-का-क) Lustful, libidinous. E. अनु, and क from कम to desire.
1439: अनुकथन n. (-नं) Discourse, conversation. E. अनु, and कथन speaking.
1440: अनुकम्पा f. (-म्पा) Tenderness, compassion. E. अनु before कपि to tremble, and affix अच्, and टाप्.
1441: अनुकम्प्य mfn. (-म्प्यः-म्प्या-म्प्यं) 1 Swift, expeditious. 2 Pitiable, worthy of tenderness or compassion. E. अनु before कपि to tremble, य aff.
1442: अनुकरण n. (-णं) 1 Imitation, making or doing any thing like or in imitation of another, following an example. 2 Resemblance, similarity. E. अनु, and करण making.
1443: अनुकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Imitation. 2 A subsequent rite or ceremony. E. अनु, and कर्म्मन् act.
1444: अनुकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 The bottom of a carriage. 2 Invoking, summoning by incantation. 3 Attraction, drawing. E. अनु before कृष to drag or furrow, and घञ् aff.
1445: अनुकर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Invoking, summoning by incantations. 2 Attracting, attraction. 3 Including a subsequent in a preceding rule. E. अनु, and कृष to draw, ल्युट् aff.
1446: अनुकर्षन् m. (-र्षा) The bottom of a carriage. See अनुकर्ष.
1447: अनुकल्प m. (-ल्पः) 1 An alternative, a substitute. 2 A secondary, subsidiary or succedaneous injunction; as, instead of Kuśa grass use Dūrbbā. E. अनु after, and कल्प a principal precept.
1448: अनुकामम् ind. According to wish or inclination. E. अनु, and काम desire.
1449: अनुकामीन m. (-नः) 1 One who goes as he lists. 2 One who acts as he pleases. E. अनुकामं and ईन, for गामिन् who goes.
1450: अनुकार m. (-रः) 1 Imitation. 2 Resemblance. E. अनु like, and कृञ् to do, with अण् aff.
1451: अनुकारिन् mfn. (-री-रणी-रि) Imitating, an imitator. E. अनुकार, and इनि aff.
1452: अनुकूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Friendly, well disposed to, favourable or conformable to. m. (-ल) A faithful husband. f. (-ला) Croton polyandrum. n. (-लं) Favour, kindness. E. अनु, and कूल race, family.
1453: अनुकूलता f. (-ता) Concord, good will, consent. E. अनुकूल, and ता affix; also with त्व, अनुकूलत्व.
1454: अनुकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Copied, imitated, made like or done in like manner. E. अनु, and कृत made.
1455: अनुक्रकच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Serrated, dentated. E. अनु like, क्रकत्र a saw.
1456: अनुक्रम m. (-मः) Order, method. E. अनु methodically, and क्रम to go, with घञ् aff.
1457: अनुक्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Proceeding methodically or in order. 2 Following. E. अनु and कसण going.
1458: अनुक्रमणिका f. (-का) A table or chapter of contents. E. कन् fem. form added to the last.
1459: अनुक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Done methodically, passed over, read, &c. in due order. E. अनु, and क्रान्त gone.
1460: अनुक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Imitation, doing any thing subsequently or in like manner. 2 A subsequent rite or ceremony. E. अनु, and क्रिया act.
1461: अनुक्रोश m. (-शः) Tenderness, compassion. E. अनु, क्रुश to bewail, घञ् aff.
1462: अनुक्षण n. adv. (-णं) Momentarily, perpetually. E. अनु, and क्षण a moment.
1463: अनुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Following. 2 A follower, a servant. m. (-गः) A husband, a master. E. अनु after, and ग who goes.
1464: अनुगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Followed, literally or figuratively, as by a dependant, &c. 2 Following, a follower or a dependant. 3 Acquired, obtained. 4 Determined, defined. E. अन, and गत gone.
1465: अनुगम m. (मः) 1 Following, going after in life or death. 2 Imitating, approaching. E. अनु, and गम going.
1466: अनुगमन n. (-नं) 1 Going after, following. 2 Dying after, as of a widow. See अनुमरण. E. अनु, and गमन going.
1467: अनुगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Worthy of being followed or imitated. E. अनु, and गम्य to be gone.
1468: अनुगवीन m. (-नः) A cowherd. E. अनु, and गवीन belonging to kine.
1469: अनुगामिन् m. (-मी) 1 A companion, a follower. 2 One who goes behind or after. E. अनु after or with, and गामिन् who goes.
1470: अनुगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-ण) According or suitable to, according to merit or property. E. अनु, and गुण quality.
1471: अनुगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Favoured, obliged. E. अनु, and गृहीत taken.
1472: अनुग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Calm, gentle, not violent. E. अन्, neg. उग्र fierce.
1473: अनुग्रह m. (-हः) Favour; conferring benefits, promoting good, and preventing ill. E. अनु afterwards, ग्रह to take, and अच् aff.
1474: अनुग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Gracious, favourable. E. अनु, and ग्राहिन् who takes.
1475: अनुचर m. (-रः) 1 A companion, a follower. 2 A servant. f. (-री) A female companion. E. अनु with or after, and चर to go, ट aff.
1476: अनुचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Following, attending. E. अनु before चारिन् who goes.
1477: अनुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Improper, wrong. E. अन् neg. उचित proper.
1478: अनुचिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Thinking of, meditating upon, recalling, recollecting. E. अनु subsequent, चिन्ता thought.
1479: अनुचिन्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Recollected, recalled, thought of. E. अनु and चिन्तित thought.
1480: अनुच्च mfn. (-च्चः-च्चा-च्चं) Low, not high, humble. E. अन neg. उच्च high.
1481: अनुच्छिष्ट mfn. (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pure, purified by austerity and devotion. E. अन् neg. and उच्छिष्ट rejected.
1482: अनुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born after, later, younger. m. (-जः) A younger brother. f. (-जा) A younger sister. E. अनु after, ज born.
1483: अनुजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Younger, junior. E. अनु after, and जन्मन् birth.
1484: अनुजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) After-born, later, younger. m. (-तः) A younger brother. f. (-ता) A younger sister. E. अनु after, जात born.
1485: अनुज्झित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Undiminished, unimpaired, not left or lost. E. अन् neg. उज्झित left.
1486: अनुजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Servant, dependant. 2 A companion, a follower. E. अनु after or with, and जीविन् who lives.
1487: अनुज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) 1 An order or command. 2 Assent. E. अनु according to, ज्ञा to know, and क्विप् aff.
1488: अनुज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ordered, directed, instructed. 2 Assented to, permitted, allowed. 3 Accepted. 4 Acknowledged, recognised. E. अनु, and ज्ञात known.
1489: अनुज्ञापक m. (-कः) One who commands or enjoins. E. अनु, and ज्ञापक who makes known.
1490: अनुतप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Heated. 2 Filled with regret or repentance. E. अनु, and तप्त heated.
1491: अनुतर n. (-रं) Fare, freight. E. अनु, and तर what crosses.
1492: अनुतर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Thirst. 2 Wish, desire. 3 A drinking vessel, one used to drink spirituous liquors from. See अनुतर्षण. E. अनु and तष, from तृष to thirst, and घञ् aff.
1493: अनुतर्षण m. (-णं) 1 A vessel from which spirituous liquor is drunk. 2 Distributing liquor. E. अनु before तृष to be thirsty, and ल्युट् aff.
1494: अनुताप m. (-पः) 1 Repentance. 2 Heat. E. अनु afterwards, and ताप heat, pain.
1495: अनुतापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Penitent, regretting. E. अनुताप and इनि aff.
1496: अनुत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Free from regret, possessed of self-complacency. E. अन् neg. उत्क sorry.
1497: अनुत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Inferiority. E. अन् neg. उत्कर्ष superiority.
1498: अनुत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Chief, principal, best. 2 Worse, inferior, not best. E. अन् neg. and उत्तम best.
1499: अनुत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Chief, principal. 2 Best, excellent. 3 Unable to answer, silent. 4 Fixed, firm. 5 Low, inferior. 6 South, southern. n. (-रं) A reply which is incoherent or evasive, and is therefore held to be no answer. E. अन् neg. and उत्तर subsequent, &c.
1500: अनुत्तान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lying with the face to the ground. E. अन neg. उत्तान sleeping, supine.
1501: अनुत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Failure. 2 Non-production. E. अन् neg. उत्पत्ति production.
1502: अनुत्पन्न mfn. (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Uneffected, unaccomplished. 2 Unborn, unproduced. E. अन् neg. उत्पन्न produced.
1503: अनुदग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 Very lofty. 2 Not lofty, low. E. अन्, neg. उदग्र lofty.
1504: अनुदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Thin, lank. E. अन् neg. उदर belly.
1505: अनुदात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Unaccented. m. (-त्तः) One of the three accents to be observed in reading the Vedas, the grave accent. E. अन् neg. उत् high, and आत्त pronounced, from दा to give, with आङ prefixed, to speak, and क्त affixed: pronouncing the vowels in a low and full tone.
1506: अनुदार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Liberal, munificent. 2 Niggardly, mean. 3 Adhered to or followed by a wife. E. अन् neg. उदार liberal, or अनु, and दार wife.
1507: अनुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unrisen. 2 Unsaid, unuttered. E. अन् neg. उदित risen or said.
1508: अनुदिन adv. n. (-नं) Daily. E. अनु, and दिन day.
1509: अनुद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unsurpassed, unequalled. 2 Unopposed. 3 Humble. E. अन् neg. उद्वत proud, &c.
1510: अनुद्धरण m. (-ण) 1 Non-removal. 2 Not offering. 3 Not establishing or proving. E. अन् neg. उद्धरण taking away.
1511: अनुद्धार m. (-रः) 1 Non-partition, not taking a share. 2 Non-removal. E. अन् neg. उद्धार partition.
1512: अनुद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Non-removed, not taken away. 2 Uninjured, undestroyed. 3 Unoffered. 4 Undivided, unpartitioned. 5 Unestablished, unproved. E. अन् neg. उद्धृत removed.
1513: अनुद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inactive, idle, destitute of perseverance. E. अन् neg. उद्यत active.
1514: अनुद्योग m. (-गः) Absence of exertion or effort, laziness. E. अन् neg. उद्योग effort.
1515: अनुद्योगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Lazy, indifferent. E. अनुद्याम, and इनि aff.
1516: अनुद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Followed, pursued. n. (-तं) A measure of time in music, half a Druta, or one-fourth of a Mātra or time taken to articulate a short vowel. E. अनु after, and द्रुत gone, escaped.
1517: अनुद्वाह m. (-हः) Celibacy. E. अन् neg. उद्वाह marriage.
1518: अनुद्विग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Easy, free from apprehension or perplexity. E. अन् neg. उद्विग्न anxious.
1519: अनुद्वेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Free from anxiety. m. (-गः) Freedom from anxiety. E. अन् neg. उद्वेग anxiety.
1520: अनुधावन n. (-तं) 1 Chasing, pursuit, running after. 2 Pursuit of any object, as of a mistress, &c. E. अनु, and धावन running.
1521: अनुधावित mfn. (-तः-ता-त) Pursued, run after, literally or figuratively. E. अनु, and धावित run.
1522: अनुनय m. (-यः) 1 Salutation, courtesy, civility, shewing respect or adoration to a guest or a deity. 2 Regulation of conduct, discipline, tuition. E. अनु and नय, from णीञ् to guide or lead, and अच् aff.
1523: अनुनयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Courteous, humble. E. अनुनय, and इनि aff.
1524: अनुनाद m. (-दः) Sound, consequent sound, vibration, echo. E. अनु, and नाद noise.
1525: अनुनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Nasal, uttered through the nose. E. अनु and नासिका the nose.
1526: अनुनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Trained, disciplined. 2 Obtained, acquired. 3 Taught. 4 Respected. 5 Pleased, pacified, appeased. E. अनु, and नीत brought.
1527: अनुन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Sane, sober, not wild, not mad: so अनुन्माद. E. अन् neg. उन्मत्त mad.
1528: अनुप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Watery, marshy; more usually अनूप.
1529: अनुपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Not assisting, neglecting, ungrateful. E. अन् neg. उपकारित assisting.
1530: अनुपकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unassisted. E. अन् neg. उपकृत assisted.
1531: अनुपतन n. (-नं) 1 Falling on or upon. 2 Following. E. अनु, and पतन falling, &c.
1532: अनुपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fallen, descended. 2 Followed. E. अनु, and पतित fallen.
1533: अनुपदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Untaught, uninstructed. E. अन् neg. उपदिष्ट advised.
1534: अनुपदम् ind. 1 Following. 2 Step by step. 3 Upon the foot. n. (-दं) A burthen, a word or passage repeated. E. अनु, and पद a foot.
1535: अनुपदिन् m. (-दी) A searcher, an inquirer, one who follows or seeks for. E. अनुपदम् following, and इनि aff.
1536: अनुपदीना f. (-ना) A boot, a buskin. E. अनुपद upon the foot, and ख aff.
1537: अनुपन्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Undetermined, not established. E. अन् neg. उपन्यस्त fixed.
1538: अनुपन्यास m. (-सः) Failure of proof or determination, uncertainty, doubt. E. अन् neg. उपन्यास ascertainment.
1539: अनुपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Not supporting an assertion by good argument, inconclusive argumentation. 2 Non-completion, not effecting or accomplishing, failure. E. अन् neg. उपपत्ति demonstration.
1540: अनुपपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Not done, unaccomplished, uneffected. 2 Unproved, undemonstrated. E. अन् neg. उपपन्न effected.
1541: अनुप्रपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Following, conforming to. E. अनु, and प्रपन्न done.
1542: अनुपभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unenjoyed, unpossessed. E. अन् neg. उपभुक्त enjoyed.
1543: अनुपम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Excellent, best. f. (-मा) The female elephant of the south-east, or of the north-east. E. अन् neg. and उपमा resemblance; above comparison.
1544: अनुपमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Incomparable: so अनुपमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं.) E. अन् neg. उपमित compared, or उपमेय comparable.
1545: अनुपयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Useless, unnecessary, unserviceable. E. अन् neg. उपयुक्त serviceable.
1546: अनुपयोग m. (-गः) Unserviceableness, uselessness. E. अन् neg. उपयोग utility.
1547: अनुपलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unmarked, undiscriminated. E. अन् neg. उपलक्षित marked.
1548: अनुपलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Unperceived, unascertained. 2 Unobtained. E. अन् neg. उपलब्ध obtained.
1549: अनुपशय m. (-यः) Any aggravating thing or circumstance, (in medicine) what increases the disease. E. अन् neg. उपशय a palliative.
1550: अनुपस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Undressed, unprepared. 2 Unfinished, unpolished. 3 Unrequited. E. अन् neg. उपस्कृत finished.
1551: अनुपस्थान n. (-नं) Absence. E. अन् neg. उपस्थान vicinity.
1552: अनुपस्थापन n. (-नं) Not producing, not offering, not placing, not having ready or at hand. E. अन् neg. उप near, स्थापन placing.
1553: अनुपस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-त) Not ready, not at hand, not offered or produced. E. अन् neg. उपस्थापित placed near.
1554: अनुपस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Absent, distant. E. अन् neg. उपस्थायिन् near.
1555: अनुपस्थिति f. (-तिः) Absence. E. अन् neg. उपस्थिति vicinity.
1556: अनुपात m. (-तः) 1 Falling subsequently upon, alighting or descending upon in succession. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 Following. 4 A degree of latitude opposite to one given, the antoeci. 5 Proportion, (in arithmetic.) 6 Arithmetical progression. E. अनु, and पात falling, &c.
1557: अनुपातक n. (-कं) A heinous crime, as, falsehood, fraud, theft, adultery, &c. E. अनु, and पातक crime.
1558: अनुपान n. (-नं) A fluid vehicle in medicine; drink taken with or after medicine. E. अनु after or with, and पान a drink.
1559: अनुपार्श्व mfn. (-र्श्वः-र्श्वा-र्श्वं) Lateral. E. अनु by or upon, पार्श्व the side.
1560: अनुप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Obtained, attained, arrived at. E. अनु, and प्राप्त obtained.
1561: अनुपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.) E. अनु before पुष्प to put forth flowers, and अच् aff.
1562: अनुपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Regular, orderly, successively, from the preceding. E. अनु after, पूर्व्व prior.
1563: अनुपूर्व्वशस् ind. In regular order or succession, from the first, from above downwards. E. अनुपूर्व्व and शसि aff.
1564: अनुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Unsown, (as seed.) E. अन् neg. उप्त sown.
1565: अनुप्तशस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Fallow, meadow, (ground, &c.) E. अन् neg. उप्त sown, शस्य grain.
1566: अनुप्रस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Latitudinal. E. अनु neg. according to, प्रस्थ extending.
1567: अनुप्रास m. (-सः) Alliteration, repetition of similar letters, syllables and words. E. अनु and प्र before अस् to be, affix चञ्.
1568: अनुप्लव m. (-वः) A companion or follower. E. अनु, प्लु to go, and अप् aff.
1569: अनुबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound to, connected with. E. अनु, and बद्ध bound.
1570: अनुबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 The inseparable adjunct or sign of any thing, the indication of guilt, symptom of disease, &c. 2 An element of language, root, affix, &c. 3 An indicatory letter not sounded or dropped in composition, but marking some peculiarity in inflecting the word to which it is attached; for instance, an indicatory इ, denotes that verbs require the insertion of a nasal before their final consonant. 4 A child or pupil, who imitates an example set by the parent or preceptor. 5 A child or infant in general. 6 Commencement, beginning. 7 Binding, confining. 8 Any thing small or little, a part, a small part. 9 The connexion between the agent and the cause or motive. 10 Circumstance, case. 11 The junction of fractions. 12 A secondary or symptomatic affection, one supervening on the principal disease. f. (-न्धी) 1 Hickup. 2 Thirst. E. अनु after, and बन्ध to bind or confine, with घञ् affix; and in the fem. ङीष्.
1571: अनुबन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Connected with, attached. E. अनुवन्ध and इनि aff.
1572: अनुबन्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या-न्ध्यं) Principal, primary, what may receive an adjunct, as a root, a disease, &c. E. अनु, and बन्ध्य to be attached to or by.
1573: अनुबोध m. (-धः) 1 Reviving the scent of a faded perfume. 2 Replacing perfumes removed by bathing, &c. 3 An after-thought. E. अनु, and बुघ understand, with घञ् aff.
1574: अनुबोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Informed or convinced by reflection. E. अनु, and बोधित made known.
1575: अनुभव m. (-वः) 1 Conclusive judgment, understanding, impression, the exercise of the intellect, independent of memory; also अनुभूति. 2 Result, consequence. E. अनु, भू to be, and अच् aff.
1576: अनुभाव m. (-वः) 1 Indication of passion, by look or gesture. 2 Dignity, authority, consequence. 3 Firm opinion, belief, knowledge. 4 Certainty, ascertainment. E. अनु, and भाव the essence or being; according to the internal feelings.
1577: अनुभाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Judging, knowing, understanding. 2 Indicative of passion or feeling. E. अनु, and भाविन् perceiving, or अनुभाव and इनि aff.
1578: अनुभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Understood, judged, apprehended. 2 Resulted, followed as a consequence. 3 Perceiving, understanding. E. अनु, and भूत been.
1579: अनुभूति f. (-तिः) 1 Judgment; knowledge, from four sources, perception, inference, comparison and verbal information; or any source except memory. 2 Dignity, consequence. E. अनु, and भूति being.
1580: अनुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Accepted, assented to. 2 Agreeable, pleasant. 3 Loved, beloved. 4 Concurred with, being of one opinion. E. अनु, and मत minded.
1581: अनुमति f. (-तिः) 1 Order or command. 2 Assent, permission. 3 A fifteenth day of the moon's age, on which she rises one digit less than full. E. अनु with, before मन to respect, and क्तिन् affix; in the last acceptation, because offerings made to the manes on this day are especially accepted.
1582: अनुमन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Consenting to, concurring in, permitting. E. अनु, and मन to mind, तृच् aff.
1583: अनुमरण n. (-णं) Dying with or following in death; the term usually denotes the cremation of a Hindu widow, whose husband's corpse is not on the spot, and with part of whose dress she, therefore, ascends the pile: this is prohibited to Brahman women. It is also synonymous with सहमरण burning with the body. E. अनु with or after, and मरण dying: dying with her husband.
1584: अनुमा f. (-मा) Inference (in logic,) drawing a conclusion from given premises. E. अनु after or according to, and मा from माङ to measure, affix अङ् and टाप.
1585: अनुमान n. (-नं) See अनुमा. E. अनु, and मा to measure, affix ल्युट्.
1586: अनुमानोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Reasoning, logic. E. अनुमान, and उक्ति saying; speaking from inference.
1587: अनुमित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Inferred. E. अनु, and मित measured.
1588: अनुमिति f. (तिः-) Inference, conclusion from given premises. E. अनु, and मिति measuring.
1589: अनुमृता f. (-ता) The woman who burns with a part of her husband's dress. E. अनु, and मृता deceased.
1590: अनुमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Inferable. E. अनु, and मेय to be measured.
1591: अनुमोदन n. (-नं) 1 Pleasing. 2 Assent, acceptance. 3 Sympathetic joy. E. अनु, with मोदन rejoicing.
1592: अनुमोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased, delighted. 2 Agreeable, acceptable. E. अनु, and मोदित pleased.
1593: अनुयात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Followed, pursued. 2 Practised. E. अनु after, यात gone.
1594: अनुयायित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Succession. 2 Subsequence. E. अनुयायिन्, and त्व added.
1595: अनुयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Following, consequent upon. 2 A follower, a dependant or attendant. E. अनु, and यायिन् who goes.
1596: अनुयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Asked, inquired. 2 Reprehended, censured. E. अनु, and युक्त joined.
1597: अनुयोक्तृ m. (-क्ता) A hired teacher. E. अनु, and योक्तृ who joins.
1598: अनुयोग m. (-गः) 1 A question. 2 Asking, solicitation. 3 Censure, reproof. 4 Religious meditation, spiritual union. E. अनु with, and योग union.
1599: अनुयोगकृत् m. (-कृत्) An Ācārya or spiritual teacher. E. अनुयोग, and कृत् who makes.
1600: अनुयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Reproving; or a reprover. 2 What combines or unites. 3 Connected or combined with, situated in or on. E. अनुयोग, and इनि aff.
1601: अनुयोजन n. (-नं) A question. E. See अनुयोग; the affix being ल्युट्.
1602: अनुयोज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Bad, censurable. E. अनु, and योज्य to be joined.
1603: अनुरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Fond of, attached to, liking, esteeming, loving. 2 Pleased. E. अनु, and रक्त affected.
1604: अनुरक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Affection, love. E. अनु, and रक्ति affection.
1605: अनुरञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Gratifying, pleasing. E. अनु, and रञ्जक what pleases.
1606: अनुरञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Loving, being attached to. 2 Pleasing, giving delight to. E. अनु, and रञ्जन delighting.
1607: अनुरञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased, delighted. 2 Inspired with affection. E. अनु. and रञ्जित pleased.
1608: अनुरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fond of, attached to. 2 Beloved. E. अनु, and रत attached.
1609: अनुरति f. (-तिः) Love, regard, esteem, attachment. E. अनु with, रम to play, and क्तिन् aff.
1610: अनुरस m. (-सः) 1 (In poetry) a subordinate feeling or passion. 2 (In medicine) a secondary flavour, as a little sweetness in a sour fruit, &c. E. अनु and रस flavour.
1611: अनुराग m. (-गः) Attachment, love. E. अनु with, and रञ्ज to stain or colour, घञ् aff.
1612: अनुरागवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Loving, affectionate, in love with. E. अनुराग, and मतुप् aff.
1613: अनुरागिणी f. (-णी) One of the personifications of musical notes. E. अनु subsequent, रागिणी a musical mode.
1614: अनुरागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Passion, impassioned, loving, in love. E. अनुराग, and इनि aff.
1615: अनुराधा f. (धा) The seventeenth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion, designated by a row of oblations; (stars in Libra.) E. अनु, and राध to accomplish, अन् affix, and टाप् for the fem; an auspicious sign for any thing to be undertaken in.
1616: अनुरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Soothed, pacified. 2 Checked, opposed. E. अनु, and रुद्ध opposed.
1617: अनुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Like, resembling. 2 Fit, suitable. 2 According to. n. (-पं) 1 Conformity. 2 Assistance. 3 Mediation, friendly interposition. 4 Hindrance, check. E. अनु like, and रूप form.
1618: अनुरूपचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Endeavouring to act becomingly. E. अनुरूप, and चेष्टा effort.
1619: अनुरोध m. (-धः) The accomplishing of a desired object for another person, obligingness, service. E. अनु, and रुध to confine, affix घञ्.
1620: अनुरोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Complying with, complaisant. E. अनु before, रुध with, वुन् aff.
1621: अनुरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) 1 Compliant, complaisant. 2 Adverse. E. अनुरोध obliging, इनि aff.
1622: अनुलाप m. (-पः) Tautology, repetition. E. अनु, and लप to speak, affix घञ्.
1623: अनुलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Smeared, anointed. E. अनु, and लिप्त smeared.
1624: अनुलेप m. (-पः) Unction, anointing. E. अनु, and लेप anointing.
1625: अनुलेपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Anointing, who or what anoints. E. अनु, and लेपक who anoints.
1626: अनुलेपन n. (-नं) 1 Anointing the body with unguents. 2 Unguent so used. 3 Oily or emollient application. E. अनु, and लेपन anointing.
1627: अनुलेपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Anointing the body with unguents. E. अनुलोम, and इनि aff.
1628: अनुलोम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Regular, successive, with the hair or grain. E. अनु, and लोमन् hair of the body.
1629: अनुलोमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced or born in due gradation; applied especially to the mixed tribes; as the offspring of a Brahman man and Kṣatriya woman, a Kṣatriya man and Vaiśya woman, and so on. See प्रतिलोमज. E. अनुलोमन, and ज born.
1630: अनुलोमन n. (-नं) (In medicine) Following the natural course or direction. E. अनुलोम used as a nominal verb, and ल्यूट् aff.
1631: अनुवचन n. (-नं) 1 Concordance, conformity to or concurrence with a previous text or authority. 2 Subsidiary or similar doctrine. E. अनु, and वचन speech.
1632: अनुवत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. अनु, and वत्सर a year.
1633: अनुवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Obliging or serving another. 2 Consequence, result. E. अनु, and वर्त्तन profession.
1634: अनुवाक m. (-कः) 1 A chapter of the Vedas, a subdivision or section. 2 A compilation from the Rich, or Yajur Vedas. E. अनु, वच to speak, affix घञ्.
1635: अनुवाक्या f. (-क्या) A prayer or formula from the Vedas. E. अनु, and वाक्या a formula.
1636: अनुवाद m. (-दः) 1 Abuse, reviling. 2 Tautology, repetition. 3 Conformity to what has been previously said or explained. E. अनु low, or after, and वाद from वद to speak, with धञ् aff.
1637: अनुवादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Consenting to, replying. 2 Conformable to, concurrent, corroborative. E. अनु, and वादक what says.
1638: अनुवादत्व n. (-त्वं) Consent, conformity, concurrence. E. त्व or ता added to अनुवादत्व; also अनुवादता.
1639: अनुवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Consenting to, concurring with, conformable to. अनुवाद and इनि aff.
1640: अनुवाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be conformable or correspondent to. n. (द्यं) The subject of a predicate. E. अनु before वद to speak, ण्यत् aff.
1641: अनुवारम् ind. Repeatedly. E. अनु, and वार time.
1642: अनुवास m. (-सः) 1 Scenting, perfuming. 2 An oily enema. E. अनु, and वास to perfume, affix घञ्.
1643: अनुवासन n. (-नं) 1 Affection, attachment. 2 Perfuming the clothes, especially dipping the ends of the cloth in perfumes. 3 Perfuming, scenting in general. 4 An oily enema. 5 Administering oily enemata. E. अनु after, वास to fumigate, and ल्यट् aff.
1644: अनुवासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Scented, perfumed. 2 Fumigated. 3 Prepared or administered as an enema. E. अनु before, वास to fumigate, क्त aff.
1645: अनुवास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be scented or fumigated. 2 Requiring an enema. E. अनु before, वास and य aff.
1646: अनुविद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Variegated, ornamented. 2 Obstructed, checked. 3 Full of, abounding in. 4 Set (as a jewel.) E. अनु, and विद्ध penetrated.
1647: अनुविधायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Conformable, compliant, obedient, attentive to. E. अनु, and विधायिन् observing rules.
1648: अनुवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Complaisance, obliging or serving another. See अनुरोध. 2 A subsequent or supplementary rule, completing what a preceding one has left to be explained. 3 Imitating, doing or acting in like manner. E. अनु before, वृत to serve, and क्तिन् aff.
1649: अनुवेल्लित n. (-तं) Bandaging, securing with bandages, &c. (in surgery.)
1650: अनुव्रजन n. (-नं) Complimentary attendance on a departing guest, following him to a given distance; also अनुव्रज्या. E. अनु after, व्रजन or व्रज्या going.
1651: अनुशय m. (-यः) 1 Repentance, regret. 2 Ancient enmity. 3 Hatred, resentment. 4 Attachment to or pursuance of any object. f. (-यी) 1 A disease of the feet, a boil or abscess on the upper part. 2 A pimple on the head. E. अनु, शीङ् to sleep, and अच् aff.
1652: अनुशयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be repented or regretted. E. अनु before शीङ् and तव्य affix; also अनुशयनीय, &c.
1653: अनुशयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Devotedly attached to, faithful, adoring. 2 Repentant, penitent, sorry for. E. अनुशय, and इनि aff.
1654: अनुशर m. (-रः) A Rākṣasa, a sort of demon. E. अनु repeatedly, शृ to injure, and अच् aff.
1655: अनुशस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A supplementary or subsidiary weapon or instrument. E. अनु, and शस्त्र a weapon.
1656: अनुशासक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Ruling or one who governs or directs. E. अनु, and शासक what governs.
1657: अनुशासन n. (-नं) Command, order, precept, law. E. अनु, and शासन ruling.
1658: अनुशासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Directed, governed. E. अनु, and शासित् governed.
1659: अनुशासितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Ruling, governing, commanding, directing, a ruler, &c. E. अनु, and शासितृ who rules.
1660: अनुशास्ति f. (-स्तिः) Order, command, precept. E. अनु, and शास्ति order.
1661: अनुशास्तृ m. (-स्ता) A governor, director, teacher. E. अनु, and शास्तृ who directs.
1662: अनुशीलन n. (-नं) Repeated and devoted service. E. अनु according to, शीलन behaving.
1663: अनुशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Taught, revealed. 2 Done conformably to law, &c. 3 Nearly completed. E. अनु according to, शिष्ट taught.
1664: अनुशुचिका f. (-का) Any ceremony enjoined by the Vedas.
1665: अनुशोक m. (-कः) Sorrow, repentance, regret. E. अनु after, शोक sorrow.
1666: अनुशोचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Grieving, one who repents. E. अनु, and शोचक who sorrows.
1667: अनुशोचन n. (-नं) Sorrow, repentance. E. अनु before, शृच to grieve, and ल्युट् aff.
1668: अनुशोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Regretted, repented of. E. अनु before, शुच to sorrow, क्त aff.
1669: अनुषङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Tenderness, compassion. 2 Conjunction, coalition, connexion of word with word, or effects with causes. 3 Necessary consequence, the connexion of a subsequent with a previous act. E. अनु, and षंज to embrace, with घञ् aff.
1670: अनुषङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Consequent, following as a necessary result. 2 Connected with, adhering to, inherent, concomitant. E. अनुषङ्ग, and ठक् aff.
1671: अनुषङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्की-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 1 Addicted or attached to. 2 Embracing. 3 Connected with. 4 Common, prevailing. E. अनुषङ्ग, and इनि aff.
1672: अनुषञ्जन m. (-नं) Connection with what follows, concord. E. अनु before, षञ्ज to embrace, ल्युट् aff.
1673: अनुषिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Re-watered or sprinkled. E. अनु, and षिक्त sprinkled.
1674: अनुषेचन n. (-नं) Watering or sprinkling over again. E. अनु, and षिच to sprinkle, ल्युट् aff.
1675: अनुष्टुभ् f. (-ष्टुप्) 1 A measure of verse, the stanza consisting four lines of eight syllables each, or three lines of eight, twelve, and twelve, making, in either case, thirty-two. 2 A name of SARASVATI. E. अनु, and ष्टुभ् to stop, क्विप् aff.
1676: अनुष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) 1 Lazy, sluggish. 2 Cold, chilly. E. अन् neg. and उष्ण warm, alert.
1677: अनुष्ठातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be done or accomplished. E. अनु according to, स्था to stay or be, तव्य aff.
1678: अनुष्ठातृ m. (-ता-) The undertaker of any work. E. अनु before, स्था to stay, तृन् aff.
1679: अनुष्ठान n. (-नं) 1 Commencement or course of proceeding. 2 Fixing, establishing, proof. 3 Propriety, fitness. 4 Doing or engaging in any thing. E. अनु according to, स्था to stay, ल्युट् aff.
1680: अनुष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Effected, accomplished. 2 Done, practised. 3 Followed, observed. 4 Appointed. E. अनु before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
1681: अनुष्ठेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be proved or established, demonstrable. 2 To be effected or accomplished. E. अनु before स्था to stay, य aff.
1682: अनुसन्धान n. (-नं) Inquiry, investigation, searching. E. अनु, and सम् before धा to have, affix ल्युट्.
1683: अनुसन्धानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Investigating, searching; so अनुसन्धायिन् E. अनुसन्धान and इनि affix, or अनु and सम् before धा, and णिनि aff.
1684: अनुसन्धेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Investigable, worthy of inquiry or scrutiny. E. अनु, and सम् before धा to have, य aff.
1685: अनुसरण n. (-णं) 1 Custom, habit, usage. 2 Conformity to, consequence of. 3 Following, going after. E. अनु before सृ to go, ल्युट् aff.
1686: अनुसार m. (-रः) 1 Custom, usage. 2 Nature, natural state or condition of any thing. 3 Prevalence, currency. 4 Received or established authority, especially of codes of law. 5 Conformity to usage, &c. 6 Consequence, result. E. अन according to, सृ to go, घञ् aff.
1687: अनुसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Following. 2 According with or to. E. अनुसार, and इनि aff.
1688: अनुसूचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Indicative of, pointing out. E. अनु before षूच to point out, वुन् aff.
1689: अनुस्मृति f. (-तिः) Cherished recollection, recalling some idea to the exclusion of all others. E. अनु before स्मृति memory. Also अनुस्मरणं.
1690: अनुस्वार m. (-रः) The nasal letter (.) or dot above the line. E. अनु before, स्वर to sound, घञ् aff.
1691: अनुहार m. (-रः) 1 Imitation. 2 Resemblance. E. अनु like, हृञ to convey, and घञ् aff.
1692: अनुहार्य्य m. Monthly obsequies. E. अनु before हृ to take, ण्यत् aff.
1693: अनूक m. (-कः) A former state of existence. n. (-क) 1 Race, family. 2 Disposition, temperament. E. अनु, उच to associate, and क aff.
1694: अनूचान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Well-behaved. m. (-नः) A learned Brahman; one versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. E. अनु, and वच to speak: the form is irregular.
1695: अनूच्च mfn. (च्चः-च्चा-च्चं) Short, low. E. अन् neg. and ऊच्च tall, high.
1696: अनूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Unmarried. E. अन् neg. ऊढ married.
1697: अनूदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unuttered. E. अन् before ऊदित said.
1698: अनूद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Not to be addressed or spoken to. 2 To be spoken to afterwards or in reply to. m. (-द्यः) A spiritual teacher, &c. E. अ before वद, to speak, यत् affix form irregular, it is improper to address a Guru, &c. by name.
1699: अनून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Whole, entire. 2 Not less, not inferior. E. अन् neg. ऊन to diminish, and अच् aff.
1700: अनूनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the preceding. E. कन् affixed to अनून.
1701: अनूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Watery, wet. m. (-पः) A buffalo. E. अनु near or with, and आप् water; ऊ is substituted for आ, and अच् is added.
1702: अनूपज n. (-जं) Ginger. E. अनूप, and ज born.
1703: अनूरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Thighless. m. (-रुः) The charioteer of the sun, the dawn. E. अन् priv. and ऊरु a thigh; being represented without legs.
1704: अनूरुसारथि m. (-स्थिः) The sun. E. अनूरु, and सारथि a charioteer, whose coachman is ANŪRU.
1705: अनृजु mfn. (-जुः-जुः-जु) Wicked, perverse, crooked, not straight, physically or morally. E. अन् neg. and ऋजु straight.
1706: अनृण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Free from debt. E. अन् neg. ऋण debt.
1707: अनृणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Unindebted, free from debt. E. अन् neg. ऋणिन् a debtor.
1708: अनृत n. (-तं) 1 Falsehood. 2 Agriculture. E. अन् neg. and ऋत truth.
1709: अनृतवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking falsely, lying, a liar. E. अनृत, and वादिन् who speaks.
1710: अनेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Many, much, not one. E. अन् neg. एक one.
1711: अनेककाल adv. n. (-लं) A long time. E. अनेक, and काल time.
1712: अनेकज m. (-जः) A bird, born more than once; or in the shell, and upon being hatched. E. अनेक more than one, and ज what is born.
1713: अनेकता f. (-ता) Muchness, manifold condition; also अनेकत्वं. E. अनेक, and ता or त्व aff.
1714: अनेकाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Multiform. E. अनेक and आकार form.
1715: अनेकप mfn. (-पः-पा) An elephant. E. अनेक various, from अन् neg. एक one, and प from पा who drinks, who drinks with his trunk, and with his mouth.
1716: अनेकरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Multiform. 2 Of various kinds or sorts. 3 Fickle, of variable mind. E. अनेक, and रूप form.
1717: अनेकविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Various, of many kinds, in different ways. E. अनेक, and विध sort.
1718: अनेकश ind. By large numbers or quantities. E. अनेक, and शसि aff.
1719: अनेकधा ind. In various ways. E. अनेक and धाच् aff.
1720: अनेडमूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Deaf and dumb. 2 Wicked, fraudulent. E. अन् here implying similarity, ण्ड deaf, and मूक dumb. See एडमूक.
1721: अनेनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Blameless, sinless. E. अन् neg. एनस् fault.
1722: अनेव ind. Otherwise, or. E. अन् neg. एव so.
1723: अनेहस् m. (-हाः) Time. E. अन् neg. हन to kill or hurt, एहच् substitute, and असि Uṇādi aff.
1724: अनैक्य n. (-क्यं) 1 Plurality, the existence of many. 2 Want of union, anarchy. E. अनेक, and घञ् aff.
1725: अनैकान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Variable, unsteady. 2 (In logic) Occasional, as a cause not invariably attended by the same effects. E. अनेक, अन्त end, and अण aff.
1726: अनैकान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unsteady, variable, having many objects or purposes. E. अनेक, अन्त end, and ठक् aff.
1727: अनो ind. No, not; also नो.
1728: अनोकह m. (-हः) A tree. E. अनस् a cart, उक going, and ह what injures; from हन with ड aff.
1729: अनोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unquestioned, unaddressed, not spoken to. E. अन् neg. ओदित spoken to.
1730: अन्तःकरण n. (-णं) The internal and spiritual part of man, the seat of thought and feeling, the mind, the heart, the conscience, the soul. E. अन्तर् within, and करण an organ.
1731: अन्तःपुर n. (-रं) 1 The female apartments. 2 A queen. 3 A palace. E. अन्तर् inner, and पुर a house.
1732: अन्तःप्रकृति f. (-तिः) The heart, the soul, the internal nature or constitution of man. E. अन्तर्, and प्रकृति nature.
1733: अन्तःप्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Acquainted with the heart, knowing one's self. E. अन्तर, and प्रज्ञा knowledge.
1734: अन्तःशरीर n. (-रं) The internal and spiritual part of man, the conscience, the soul. E. अन्तर् within, शरीर the body.
1735: अन्तःशल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Having some extraneous body, (a wound, &c.) E. अन्तर्, and शल्य a thorn, &c.
1736: अन्तःसंज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Internal consciousness. E. अन्तर्, and संज्ञा sense.
1737: अन्तःसत्त्वा f. (-त्त्वा) 1 A pregnant woman. 2 Marking nut, (Semecarpus anacardium.) E. अन्तर् inner, and सत्त्वा having life or being.
1738: अन्तःस्वेद m. (-दः) An elephant. E. अन्तर् inner, and स्वद warmth.
1739: अन्त mn. (-न्तः-न्तं) 1 End, term. 2 Final, ultimate, (continuing M. N. even with a fem. noun.) mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Near. 2 Handsome. m. (-न्तः) 1 Death. 2 A boundary, a limit. 3 Certainty, ascertainment. 4 A limb, a member. n. (-न्तं) Nature, disposition. E. अम to go, and तन् Uṇādi aff.
1740: अन्तक m. (-कः) A name of YAMA. E. अन्त death, and क affix of agency. YAMA is the king or angel of death.
1741: अन्तकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Causing death, mortal, destructive. E. अन्त, and कर what makes.
1742: अन्तकाल m. (-लः) Time of death, death. E. अन्त end, and काल time.
1743: अन्तग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Dead, departed. 2 Traversing, crossing, going to the end. E. अन्त, and ग who goes.
1744: अन्ततस् ind. 1 From the end, from the term. 2 Similarly, like. 3 In part. 4 Lastly, finally. E. अन्त, and तस् aff.
1745: अन्तर् ind. 1 Within, between, amongst. 2 To the end. 3 Certainly, very well, a particle of assent. E. अन्त end, रा to receive, and क्रिप् aff.
1746: अन्तर (noun and adverb) n. (-रं) 1 Interval, intermediate space. 2 Period, term. 3 Clothing. 4 Covering. 5 Difference. 6 Sake, behalf. 7 A hole or rent. 8 Own, the self. 9 Without, except. 10 Without, outside. 11 Opportune time. 12 Midst, the midst. 13 The supreme soul. 14 Like, similar. 15 Other. 16 (In arithmetic) Remainder, difference. E. अन्त end, and र from रा to obtain, and क aff. In consulting the meanings of this word, it is to be recollected, that vocables which are adverbs in English, are often nouns of the neuter gender in Sanscrit; this word is also a pronoun, in the 3d and 10th acceptations. when the latter means, without, or out of, any thing but a house or town: the whole of the interpretations may be referred to the ideas of, within and without.
1747: अन्तरङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Own, belonging to. 2 Internal, interior. 3 Of kin. E. अन्तर, and ग what goes.
1748: अन्तरतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मत्) 1 Immediate, intimate, internal. 2 Like, analogous. m. (-मः) A congenial letter, one of the same class. E. अन्तर inner, and डतम aff.
1749: अन्तरज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Prudent, provident, foreseeing. E. अन्तर midst, and ज्ञ who knows.
1750: अन्तरप्रभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Of mixed origin or caste. E. अन्तर different, प्रभव birth.
1751: अन्तरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Internal, inward. 2 Separate, apart. E. अन्तर, and स्थ what stays.
1752: अन्तरा ind. 1 Without, except. 2 In the middle, among, amidst. 3 Near at hand.
1753: अन्तरात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 The soul, the inherent spirit. 2 The internal feelings, the heart or mind. E. अन्तर्, and आत्मन् soul.
1754: अन्तरापत्या f. (-त्या) A pregnant woman. E. अन्तर, and अपत्य offspring.
1755: अन्तराय m. (-यः) Obstacle, impediment. E. अन्तर between, इण to go, and घञ् aff.
1756: अन्तराल mn. (-लः-लं) Included space: also अन्तरालक. E. अन्तरा in the midst, ला to obtain, and क aff.
1757: अन्तरिक्ष n. (-क्षं) The sky or atmosphere. E. अन्तर within, and ऋक्ष a star; in which are the stars: or ईक्ष to see; seen by the world; the word is properly written with the long vowel, as अन्तरीक्ष, but the short is substituted in poetry.
1758: अन्तरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead, departed, concealed, lost. 2 Separated, detached. n. (-तं) Remainder, (in arithmetic.) E. अन्तर, and इतच् aff.
1759: अन्तरीक्ष n. (-क्षं) 1 Sky, heaven. 2 Talc. E. see अन्तरिक्ष.
1760: अन्तरीप mn. (-पः-पं) An island. E. अन्तर in the midst of, and आप water; आ changed to ई.
1761: अन्तरीय n. (-यं) A lower garment. E. अन्तर inner, छ aff.
1762: अन्तरे ind. Amidst, among, between. E. अन्तर् with इण् to go, and विच् aff.
1763: अन्तरेण ind. 1 Except, without. 2 Amidst, between. E. अन्तर्, इण to go, and न aff.
1764: अन्तर्गडु mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु) Unprofitable, vain, idle. E. अन्तर amidst, गडु to drop or distil, and उ affix: what runs to waste.
1765: अन्तर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Forgotten. 2 Intermediate, interposed. 3 Inner, internal, within. E. अन्तर् within, and गत gone, part. past of गम.
1766: अन्तर्गृह n. (-हं) An inner apartment. E. अन्तर् within, and गृह a house.
1767: अन्तर्जठर n. (-रं) The stomach. E. अन्तर्, and जठर the belly.
1768: अन्तर्ज्वलन n. (-नं) Internal heat, inflammation. E. अन्तर्, and ज्वस्तन burning.
1769: अन्तर्जात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inborn, inbred, innate. E. अन्तर्, and जात born.
1770: अन्तर्दहन n. (-नं) The distillation of spirituous liquor.
1771: अन्तर्दाह m. (-हः) Internal heat, or fever. E. अन्तर्, and दाह burning.
1772: अन्तर्दुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्ट) Internally bad, wicked, vile. E. अन्तर्, and दुष्ट bad.
1773: अन्तर्द्वार n. (-रं) A private door within the house. E. अन्तर् inner, and द्वार a door.
1774: अन्तर्द्धा f. (-र्द्धा) Disappearance, concealment, covering. E. अन्तर within, धा to have or hold, क and टाप् affs.
1775: अन्तर्द्धान n. (-नं) Concealment, disappearance. E. as before, with ल्युट् aff.
1776: अन्तर्द्धि f. (-र्द्धिः) See the preceding. E. as before, with कि aff.
1777: अन्तर्ध्यान n. (-नं) Profound inward meditation. E. अन्तर्, and ध्यान meditation.
1778: अन्तर्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Inward, internal, generated internally. E. अन्तर्, and भव being.
1779: अन्तर्भाव m. (-वः) Internal or inherent nature or disposition. E. अन्तर्, and भाव disposition.
1780: अन्तर्भावना f. (-ना) Inward meditation or anxiety. E. अन्तर्, and भावना meditation.
1781: अन्तर्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Internal, inner, being within. E. अन्तर, and भूत been.
1782: अन्तर्मनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Sad, perplexed. E. अन्तर्, and मनस् the mind.
1783: अन्तर्यमन n. (-नं) Inward restraint, mental controul. E. अन्तर्, and यमन restraining.
1784: अन्तर्यामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Checking or regulating the internal feelings. 2 Heart-searching or pervading. m. (-मी) 1 The soul. 2 Providence, the Supreme Spirit, as regulating and guiding mankind. 3 Conscience. E. अन्तर् within, and यामिन् who stops or refrains.
1785: अन्तर्लम्ब m. (-म्बः) An acute angular triangle. E. अन्तर् within, and लम्व the perpendicular.
1786: अन्तर्वंशिक m. (-कः) Superintendent of the women's apartments. E. अन्तर् within, वंश a race, and ठक aff.
1787: अन्तर्वत्नी f. (-त्नी) A pregnant woman. E. अन्तर् within, मतुप् possessive affix, with an irregular formation of the fem. In the Vedas अन्तर्व्वती occurs.
1788: अन्तर्वमि m. (-मिः) Flatulence, indigestion. E. अन्तर् inner, and वमि vomiting.
1789: अन्तर्वर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Internal, included. E. अन्तर्, and वर्त्तिन् what abides.
1790: अन्तर्व्वाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Skilled in sacred sciences. E. अन्तर् inner, and वाणि speech: containing the essence of all knowledge.
1791: अन्तर्वासस् n. (-सः) An inner garment. E. अन्तर्, and वासस् clothes.
1792: अन्तर्विगाहन n. (-नं) Entrance, entering. E. अन्तर् within, and वि before, गाह to agitate, affix ल्युट्.
1793: अन्तर्वेग m. (-गः) 1 Internal uneasiness or anxiety. 2 Inward fever. E. अन्तर्, and वेग agitation.
1794: अन्तर्वेदी f. (-दी) The name of a country. E. अन्तर् between, and वेदी level earth. The Doab or district beween the Gaṅgā and Yamunā rivers.
1795: अन्तर्वेश्मन् n. (-श्म) The inner apartments, the interior of a building. E. अन्तर्, and वेश्मन् a house.
1796: अन्तर्हास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Laughing inwardly. m. (-सः) Self-satisfaction, conceit. E. अन्तर् inner, and हास laughter.
1797: अन्तर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Concealed, covered, hidden, disappeared. E. अन्तर् within, and धा to hold with क्त affix; हि substituted for धा.
1798: अन्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Finite, having a term or end. E. अन्त and मतुप् aff.
1799: अन्तवासिन् m. (-सी) A pupil. See अन्तेवासिन्.
1800: अन्तशय्या f. (-य्या) 1 Death. 2 A bed or mat on the ground. 3 The place for burial or burning. E. अन्त end, and शय्या a sleeping place.
1801: अन्तावसायिन् m. (-यी) 1 A barber. 2 A man of a low tribe or cast, the offspring of a Niṣāda woman by a Caṇḍāla, whose business is to attend in places where dead bodies are burned. 3 The name of a saint. E. अन्त the end, अव and षो to cut, who pares the nails, &c. or षै to decay, णिनि aff.
1802: अन्ति f. (-न्तिः) An elder sister, (in theatrical language.) ind. Near.
1803: अन्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Near, proximate. f. (-का) 1 An elder sister, (in theatrical language.) See अत्तिका. 2 A fire-place. See अन्दिका. 3 A plant, (Echites scholaris.) See सप्तला. n. (-कं) Vicinity. E. अन्त the end, and कन् affix, इ inserted.
1804: अन्तिकतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मत्) Very near. E. अन्तिक, and डतम superlative aff.
1805: अन्तिकता f. (-ता) Nearness, vicinity, contiguity: also अन्तिकत्वं. E. अन्तिक with, ता or त्व aff.
1806: अन्तिकाश्रय m. (-यः) Contiguous support, (as that given by a tree to a creeper, &c.) E. अन्तिक, and आश्रय support.
1807: अन्तिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Final, ultimate, last. 2 Very near. E. अन्त, and डिमच् aff.
1808: अन्तेवासिन् m. (-सी) 1 A pupil. 2 A Caṇḍāla, or man of a low cast. mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Final, ultimate. E. अन्त in the locative case, near or final; वस to abide, and णिनि affix: who dwells near his teacher, &c. See अन्तवासिन्.
1809: अन्त्य mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं) 1 Last, ultimate. 2 Inferior, low. m. (-न्त्यः) 1 A man of low caste. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) See मुस्ता. n. (-न्त्यं) A measure of number, two Sāgaras, a very large number. E. अन्त, and यत् aff.
1810: अन्त्यकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Funeral rites. E. अन्त्य, and कर्म्मन् act; also अन्त्यक्रिया, &c.
1811: अन्त्यज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Younger, latest born. m. (-जः) 1 A Śūdra or man of the fourth tribe. 2 A man of one of seven inferior tribes; a washerman, currier, mimic, Varūra, fisherman, Meda or attendant on women, and mountaineer or forester. E. अन्त्य inferior, and ज who is born: born from the feet of BRAHMĀ; also अन्त्यजात.
1812: अन्त्यजन्मन् mf. (-न्मा) A man or woman of the Śūdra or fourth tribe, &c., see the last. E. अन्त्य, and जन्मन् birth.
1813: अन्त्यजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sprung from the last or lowest class. E. अन्त्य last, जाति class, affix छ.
1814: अन्त्यभ n. (-भं) 1 The sign Pisces. 2 The asterism Revatī. 2 The last star or constellation. E. अन्त्य last, and भ a constellation.
1815: अन्त्यवर्ण mf. (-र्णः-र्णा) A man or woman of the fourth tribe. E. अन्त्य, and वर्ण a tribe.
1816: अन्त्यावसायिन् mf. (-यी-यिनी) A man or woman of low caste, especially one of seven classes: a Caṇḍāla, a Śvapaca or executioner, a Kṣattā or insect hunter, a charioteer, a bard, and a Vaideha or attendant on women. 2 A man or a woman of a particular caste living by the chase. See अन्तावसायिन्.
1817: अन्त्येष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A funeral sacrifice. E. अन्त्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.
1818: अन्त्येष्टिक्रिया f. (-या) Obsequies. E. अन्त्येष्टि, and क्रिया rite.
1819: अन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) An entrail. E. अम to be sick, and त्र Uṇādi aff.
1820: अन्त्रकूज m. (-जः) Grumbling of the bowels, borborygmi. E. अन्त्र, and कूज murmuring: also अन्त्रकूजनं.
1821: अन्त्रवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Inguinal hernia, rupture. E. अन्त्र, and वृद्धि increase.
1822: अन्त्राद m. (-दः) A worm, ascarides, &c. E. अन्त्र, and द्यद what eats.
1825: अन्दुक m. (-कः) 1 A ring or chain worn on the ancle. 2 The chain for an elephant's feet. E. अदि to bind, कु affix, and कन् final.
1826: अन्दू f. (-न्दूः) 1 An ornament worn round the ancles. 2 The chain for an elephant's feet. 3 A chain, a fetter, a bond or tie. E. अदि to bind, and कू Uṇādi aff. or with कु affix अन्दु.
1827: अन्दूक m. (-कः) The chain for an elephant's feet. See the last.
1828: अन्दोल (त) r. 10th cl. (अन्दोलयति) To agitate, to swing.
1829: अन्ध (त) r. 10th cl. (अन्धयति) To be or become blind.
1830: अन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Blind. n. (-न्धं) 1 Darkness. 2 Water. E. अन्ध to be blind, and अच् aff.
1831: अन्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Blind. m. (-कः) 1 The name of a country, apparently Behar. 2 The name of a king. 3 Of a Muni. 4 Of an Asura. E. अन्ध to be blind, and कन् aff.
1832: अन्धकरिपु m. (-पुः) 1 A name of ŚIVA, the enemy of the demon ANDHAKA. E. अन्धक a demon so named, and रिपु an enemy.
1833: अन्धकार mn. (-रः-रं) Darkness. E. अन्ध blind, and कार what makes.
1834: अन्धकासुहृद m. (-द) A name of ŚIVA. E. अन्धक, and असुहृद् the enemy. See अन्धकरिपु.
1835: अन्धकूप m. (-पः) A blind well. E. अन्ध, and कूप a well: one of which the mouth is hidden.
1836: अन्धतमस n. (-सं) Great darkness. E. अन्ध to make blind, and तमस darkness: also written अन्धतामसं, अ being made long.
1837: अन्धता f. (-ता) Blindness. Also n. अन्धत्व. E. ता or त्व added to अन्ध.
1838: अन्धतामिश्र n. (-श्रं) 1 A division of Tartarus, the second of the twenty-one hells. 2 The doctrine of annihilation after death. E. अन्ध blind, great, and तामिश्र darkness.
1839: अन्धमूषा f. (-षा) A small covered crucible, with a hole in the side. E. अन्ध, and मूषा a crucible.
1840: अन्धमूषिका f. (-का) The name of a grass. See देवताड.
1841: अन्धस् n. (-न्धं) Boiled rice. E. अद to eat, नम् inserted, and असुन् Uṇādi affix, द changed to ध.
1842: अन्धालजी f. (-जी) A blind boil, one that does not suppurate.
1843: अन्धाहि mf. (हिः-हिः) A kind of fish, vulg. kūñciyā; a species of eel? E. अन्ध blind, and अहि a snake: from its form and the smallness of its eyes.
1844: अन्धिका f. (-का) 1 Night. 2 Gambling. 3 A small kind of mustard. See सर्षप. 4 A woman. 5 A disease of the eye. E. अन्ध dark or blind, and कन् affix in the fem. form.
1845: अन्धीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made or become blind. E. अन्ध, and कृत made, च्ची augment.
1846: अन्धीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become blind. E. अन्ध, and भूत become, च्ची augment.
1847: अन्धु m. (-धुः) A well. E. अम to go, and तुक् Uṇādi affix; घ is substituted for त.
1848: अन्धुल m. (-लः) A tree, (Mimosa sirisa, Rox.)
1849: अन्ध्र m. (-न्ध्रः) A hunter, one who lives by killing game; a man of low caste, the offspring of a Vaideha father and Kārāvara mother; not allowed to reside within a village or town. 2 A country, modern Telangana; also आन्ध्र.
1850: अन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Eaten. n. (-न्नं) 1 Boiled rice. 2 Food in general. 3 Corn. E. अद to eat, and क्त affix of the part. past, त becoming न.
1851: अन्नकाल m. (-लः) Meal time, proper hour for eating. E. अन्न, and काल time.
1852: अन्नकोष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A cupboard, a granary. E. अन्न, and कोष्ठ or receptacle.
1853: अन्नकोष्ठक m. (-कः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The sun. m. (-कः) A granary, a cupboard. E. अन्न food, कोष्ठक a repository.
1854: अन्नगन्धि m. (-न्धिः) Dysentery, diarrhoea. E. अन्न food, गन्ध smell.
1855: अन्नज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Springing from or occasioned by food. E. अन्न, and ज born.
1856: अन्नजल n. (-लं) Support, subsistence. E. अन्न, and जल water, meat and drink.
1857: अन्नद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who gives food. f. (-दा) A goddess, a form of DURGĀ. E. अन्न, and द who gives.
1858: अन्नदातृ m. (-ता) One who gives food, a charitable man. E. अन्न, and दातृ donor.
1859: अन्नदान n. (-नं) The giving of rice or food, the maintenance of a person. E. अन्न, and दान giving.
1860: अन्नद्वेष m. (-षः) Want of appetite, dislike of food. E. अन्न, and द्वेष dislike.
1861: अन्नपरिवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Change of diet. E. अन्न, and परिवर्त्त revolution.
1862: अन्नपूर्णा f. (-र्णा) A goddess, a form of DURGĀ. E. अन्न, and पूर्ण who fills with.
1863: अन्नपूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A goddess, a form of DURGĀ. E. अन्न, and पूर्व्व prior.
1864: अन्नप्राशन n. (-नं) A religious ceremony, in which after presenting oblations to fire, a little rice is, for the first time, put into the child's mouth; it should take place between the fifth and eighth month. E. अन्न, and प्राशन feeding.
1865: अन्नब्रह्म n. (-ह्म) The deification of food, considering it in the light of BRAHMA, as the pervader and supporter of existence. E. अन्न, and ब्रह्म the Supreme.
1866: अन्नभूमि f. (-मिः) A large collection of food. E. अन्न, and भूमि a heap.
1867: अन्नमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Composed of food, containing food. 2 Derived or made from food. m. (-यः) The body. E. अन्न and मयट् aff.
1868: अन्नमयकोष m. (-षः) The gross material body, that which is sustained by food. E. अन्नमय, and कोष sheath, (of the spirit.)
1869: अन्नमल n. (-लं) Spirituous liquor, the excrement or ferment of rice, &c. E. अन्न, and मल foecula.
1870: अन्नरस m. (-सः) Chyle. E. अन्न, and रस juice.
1871: अन्नलिप्सा f. (-प्सा) Hunger, craving. E. अन्न, and लिप्सा desire.
1872: अन्नवाहिस्रोतस् n. (-तः) The oesophagus. E. अन्न, and वाहि what conveys, स्रोतस् canal.
1873: अन्नविकार m. (-रः) The seminal secretion. E. अन्न, and विकार change of form.
1874: अन्नशेष m. (-षः) Leavings, offal. E. अन्न, and शेष remainder.
1875: अन्नाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Feeding, eating. 2 The partaker or eater of another's food. m. (-दः) VIṢṆU. E. अन्न, and अद who eats.
1876: अन्नायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Hungry; desiring food. E. अन्न nominal verb to want food, णिनि aff.
1877: अन्नाहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Eating, feeding. E. अन्न, and आहारिन् who eats.
1878: अन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यत्) 1 Other, different. 2 Unlike. E. अन to live, and यक् aff.
1879: अन्यत् ind. Otherwise. E. See the last.
1880: अन्यगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Adulterous. 2 Going to another (place, &c.) E. अन्य another (husband or wife), गामिन् who goes to.
1881: अन्यच्च ind. 1 Again, moreover, 2 On the contrary. E. अन्यत्, and च and.
1882: अन्यज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born of another (family, &c.) of a different origin. E. अन्य, and ज born.
1883: अन्यजन्मन् n. (-न्म) Another birth, being born again, the metempsychosis. E. अन्य, and जन्मन् birth.
1884: अन्यतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मत्) 1 Either, any, any one of many. 2 Different, distinct from many. E. अन्य, and डतम aff.
1885: अन्यतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रत्) 1 Other, different. 2 Either of two. E. अन्य other, and डतर affix; applied to words that refer to but two things.
1886: अन्यतरेद्युस् ind. Either of two days. E. अन्यतर, and एद्युस् affix, derived from द्युस् a day.
1887: अन्यतस् ind. Elsewhere. E. अन्य, and तसि aff.
1888: अन्यत्र ind. 1 Elsewhere, in another place. 2 Except, unless, without. E. अन्य, and त्रल् aff.
1889: अन्यथा ind. 1 Otherwise, in a different manner. 2 Inaccurately, untruly. 3 Badly. E. अन्य, and थाल् affix, referring to manner.
1890: अन्यथाख्याति f. (तिः) Erroneous conception of spirit. E. अन्यथा and ख्याति declaring.
1891: अन्यथात्व n. (-त्वं) An opposite or different state of the case. E. अन्यथा and त्व aff.
1892: अन्यथासिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Disproving a cause or argument, by giving it a different effect or application, coming to a different conclusion from the same premises. E. अन्यथा otherwise, and सिद्ध्रि proving, establishing.
1893: अन्यदा ind. Another time. E. अन्य, and दा affix, referring to time.
1894: अन्यपुष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The koil or Indian cuckoo, supposed to be reared by the crow. E. अन्य, and पुष्ट nourished.
1895: अन्यपूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A girl previously promised or betrothed to one and married to another. E. अन्य, and पूर्व्व prior.
1896: अन्यभृत् m. (-त्) A crow. E. अन्य another, and भृत् who nourishes: the crow is supposed to sit upon the eggs of the kokila: from भृ root, and क्विप् aff.
1897: अन्यभृत m. (-तः) The kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. अन्य, and भृत nourished, from भृ with part. affix क्त; this bird, like the  English cuckoo, being supposed to leave its eggs in the nests of other birds.
1898: अन्यमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) 1 Fickle-minded. 2 Absent. E. अन्य, and मनस् the mind.
1899: अन्यमनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) 1 Absent, thinking of something else. 2 Fickle, versatile. E. अन्य, and मनस्क minded.
1900: अन्यमानस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Fickle-minded, otherwise minded. E. अन्य, and मानस mental.
1901: अन्यवर्द्धित mfn. (-सः-ता-सं) Brought up by a stranger, fostered. E. अन्य, and वर्द्धित part. past of वृध् to grow.
1902: अन्यवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking inconsistently; (in law) prevaricating or a prevaricator. E. अन्य otherwise, and वादिन् who speaks.
1903: अन्यशाख m. (-खः) An apostate. E. अन्य another, शाखा a branch or sect, or with कन् affix अन्यशाखकः.
1904: अन्यादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Of another kind, like another. E. अन्य, दृश to see, and क्विप् aff.
1905: अन्यादृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) See the preceding. E. as before, with कञ् aff.
1906: अन्याधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Subject to others, dependant. E. अन्य, and अधीन dependant.
1907: अन्याय m. (-यः) 1 Impropriety, indecorum. 2 Irregularity, disorder. E. अ neg. न्याय propriety.
1908: अन्यायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Unjust, unreasonable. 2 Indecorous. 3 Illogical. E. अ neg. न्यायिन्.
1909: अन्यायवृत्त mfn. (-त्त-त्ता-त्तं) Following evil courses. E. अन्याय improper, ष्टत्त practising.
1910: अन्याय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Improper, indecorous, unbecoming, unfit. E. अ neg. न्याय्य right.
1911: अन्यासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Absent, intent on something else. E. अन्य, and आसक्त intent on.
1912: अन्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Complete, entire. E. अ neg. and न्यून defective.
1913: अन्येद्युस् ind. Another day. E. अन्य, and एद्युस् affix, from द्युस् a day.
1914: अन्येद्युस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Daily, diurnal, occurring every other day. m. (-स्कः) A quotidian fever. E. अन्येद्युस् and कत् added.
1915: अन्योत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Begotten by another, the progeny of another than the reputed parent or husband. E. अन्य, and उत्पन्न born.
1916: अन्योदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A stepmother's son. E. अन्य, and उदर belly, यञ् aff.
1917: अन्योन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Mutual. E. अन्य repeated.
1918: अन्योन्यकलह m. (-हः) Mutual quarrel. E. अन्योन्य, and कलह strife.
1919: अन्योन्यघात m. (-तः) Mutual conflict, striking, wounding or killing one another. E. अन्योन्य, and घात striking.
1920: अन्योन्यभेद m. (-दः) Mutual aversion or enmity. E. अन्योन्य, and भद difference.
1921: अन्योन्यापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken or secreted from one another, taken severally. E. अन्योन्य, and अपहृत removed.
1922: अन्योन्याभाव m. (-वः) Mutual negation, relative difference. E. अन्योन्य, and अभाव non-existence.
1923: अन्योन्याश्रय m. (यः) Mutual or reciprocal connexion or dependance. E. अन्योन्य, and आश्रय support.
1924: अन्वक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Following. E. अनु after, and अक्षि the eye.
1925: अन्वञ्च् mfn. (-न्वङ्-नूची-न्वक्) Following. E. अनु after, अञ्च to go, and क्विन् aff.
1926: अन्वय m. (-यः) 1 Race, lineage, succession. 2 Connexion, acquaintance, intercourse. 3 The natural order or connexion of words in a sentence or stanza. 3 The logical connexion of cause and effect, or proposition and conclusion. E. अनु after, इण to go, and अच् aff.
1927: अन्वयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A genealogist. E. अन्वय, and ज्ञ who knows.
1928: अन्वयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Following, agreeing with. 2 Belonging to race or family. E. अन्वय and इनि aff.
1929: अन्ववाय m. (-यः) Race, lineage. E. अनु after, अव prefixed to इण to go, and अच् aff.
1930: अन्वष्टका f. (-का) A Śrāddha or funeral ceremony performed on the ninth day of the months Pauṣa, Māgha, Phālguna, or Āśvina. It is the maternal Śrāddha for those who preserve the sacred fire. E. अनु after, and अष्टका the eighth day.
1931: अन्वहम् ind. Every day, daily. E. अनु, and अहन् a day.
1932: अन्वाचय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Connecting, uniting. E. अनु, and आङ् before चि to collect, अच् aff.
1933: अन्वाधि f. (-घिः) 1 A bail or deposit to be delivered to a third person. 2 Repentance. E. अनु according to, and आधि a pledge.
1934: अन्वाधेय n. (-यं) Property presented after marriage to the wife by her husband's family. E. अनु subsequently, and आधेय to be taken or received.
1935: अन्वायतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Latitudinal. E. अनु, and आयतन breadth.
1936: अन्वारोहण n. (-णं) Mounting the funeral pile after or with the body of the husband. E. अनु, and आरोहण ascending.
1937: अन्वासन n. (-नं) 1 An unctuous or cooling enema. 2 Service. 3 Regret, affliction. 4 A place where work is done, a manufactory, a house of industry. E. अनु before, आस to sit, and ल्युट् aff.
1938: अन्वाहार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 The monthly Śrāddha, or funeral repast in honour of the manes, held on the day of new moon; it should be, according to Menu, of meat eaten after the presentation of a piṇḍa or ball of rice. 2 The monthly obsequies performed during the first year after the death of a parent. E. अनु after, and आहार्य्य to be taken or eaten; from हृ with आङ् prefixed, and ण्यत् aff.
1940: अन्वाहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Daily, diurnal. E. अन्वह daily, ठञ् aff.
1941: अन्वाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deposited with a person to be delivered ultimately to another. E. अनु, and आहित placed.
1942: अन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined, connected with. 2 Having as an essential or inherent part, possessed of, possessing. 3 Connected as in grammar, or construction. E. अनु with, and इत gone, part. of इण; also अन्वीत.
1943: अन्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sought. E. अनु after, and इष desire, with the part. affix क्त.
1944: अन्वीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joined, connected with. See अन्वित. E. अन with, and ईत from ई to go.
1945: अन्वेषण fn. (-णा-णं) 1 Research, investigation of duty by reasoning. 2 Research, enquiry in general. E. अनु, इष to desire, and ल्यु aff. and in the fem. टाप्.
1946: अन्वेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought. E. the part. past of इष, with अनु prefixed, and इ inserted before क्त.
1947: अन्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking, inquiring after. E. अनु before, इष to wish, णिनि aff.
1948: अन्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) An enquirer, a searcher. E. अनु before इष, and तृच् affix of agency.
1949: अपःसान्त n. (-न्तं) The offering or performance of sacrifice.
1950: अप् f. pl. only, (आपः) Water. E. आप to obtain, and क्विप् Uṇādi affix; the vowel of the radical becomes short.
1951: अप ind. A particle and preposition implying 1 Inferiority, (below, worse.) 2 Privation, (from.) 3 Separation, (away from.) 4 Contrariety, (against, opposite to.) 5 Difference, (from.) 6 Dishonesty. 7 Exultation: as अपकृष्टुं to revile, अपहर्त्तुं to take away, अपकर्त्तुं to do wrong, अपवक्तुं to contradict, अपकीर्त्ति infamy, &c. E. अ neg. and प from पा to preserve.
1952: अपकरण n. (-णं) 1 Acting improperly, doing wrong. 2 Ill treating, offending, injuring. E. अप before, कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.
1953: अपकर्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्री-र्तृ) Injurious, offensive, hostile, inimical, an enemy. E. अप before कृ to do, तृच् aff.
1954: अपकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Evil doing, wickedness. 2 Oppression, violence. 3 Laziness, incompetence. 4 Any impure or degrading act or rite. E. अप before, कर्म्मन् act.
1955: अपकलङ्क m. (-ङ्क) An indelible disgrace. E. अप before, कलङ्क a stain.
1956: अपकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Pulling down, bringing low, lowering, depressing. 2 Inferiority, infamy, degradation. So अपकर्षण n. (णं.) E. अप before, कृष to attract, घञ् or ल्युट् aff.
1957: अपकार m. (-रः) 1 Injury, offence, wrong, mischief. 2 Wickedness. 3 Tyranny, oppression. 4 Hatred, enmity. E. अप ill, and कार what does.
1958: अपकारक mfn. (-कः-का-क) Injuring, pernicious. E. अप before, कृ to do, ण्वुल् aff.
1959: अपकारगीर् f. (-गीः) Reproach and menace. E. अपकार hatred, and गीर् speech.
1960: अपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Offensive, oppressive. 2 Wicked, doing ill. 3 Mischievous, malicious. 4 Inimical. E. अपकार, and इनि aff.
1961: अपकारार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Malicious, malevolent. E. अपकार and अर्थिन् who aims at.
1962: अपकीर्ति f. (-र्तिः) Infamy, disgrace. E. अप before, कीर्त्ति fame.
1963: अपकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done wrong, maliciously, offensively, or wickedly committed. 2 Who does wrong. 3 Ill treated. 4 Observed or practised as a degrading or impure act, as servile duties, funereal rites, &c. E. अप before, कृ to do, क्त aff.
1964: अपकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Oppression, wrong, injury. 2 Enmity, opposition. 3 Any degrading or impure act or rite. E. अप before, कृ to do, क्तिन् aff.
1965: अपकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Low, vile, inferior. 2 Perplexed, distressed. 3 Depressed, lowered, brought down. E. part. past of कृष, with अप prefixed.
1966: अपकृष्टता f. (-ता) Inferiority, vileness. So अपकृष्टत्व n. (-त्वं.) E. तल् or त्व added to the last.
1967: अपक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Immaturity. 2 Indigestion. E. अ neg. पक्ति ripeness.
1968: अपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Unripe, immature. E. अ neg. पक्व ripe.
1969: अपक्वता f. (-ता) Immaturity. E. अपक्व, and तल् affix: also with त्व, अपक्वत्वं.
1970: अपक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Flight, retreat. 2 Passing off or away. E. अप from, and क्रम to go, with अच् aff.
1971: अपक्रमण n. (-णं) Retiring, passing off or away. E. अप before, क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.
1972: अपक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Oppression, offence. 2 Evil doing, wickedness. 3 Any impure act or rite. E. अप, and क्रिया action.
1973: अपक्रोश m. (-शः) Reviling, abusing. E. अप against, क्रुश to call out, and घञ् aff.
1974: अपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Adverse, opposed to, not of the same side or party. E. अ neg. पक्ष a party.
1975: अपक्षता f. (-ता) Opposition, hostility. E. अपक्ष, and तल् affix: or with त्व affix अपक्षत्व.
1976: अपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead, deceased. 2 Gone, departed, remote, gone off. E. अप away, and गत gone.
1977: अपगम m. (-मः) Departure, separation, death. E. अप, and गम to go, affix अच्.
1978: अपगा f. (-गा) A river. E. अप down, below, or अप् water, and thence the sea; and गा what goes downward or into the sea; also आपगा.
1979: अपघन m. (-नः) A limb or member. E. अप, and घन from हन् to kill or hurt.
1980: अपघात m. (-तः) Striking or cutting off, killing. E. अप, and घात striking.
1981: अपघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Murderous, killing. E. अपघात, and इनि aff.
1982: अपचय m. (-यः) 1 Loss, privation. 2 Respect, obeisance. E. अप opposite to, and चय from चि to collect, with अच् aff.
1983: अपचायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Saluted, reverenced. E. अप here implying much or highly; and चायित part. past of चाय to reverence.
1984: अपचार m. (-रः) 1 Impropriety, defect, wickedness. 2 Observing unwholesome or improper regimen. E. अप before, त्तर to go, घञ् aff.
1985: अपचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wicked, bad, one who acts wickedly. E. अपचार, and इनि aff.
1986: अपचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Saluted, honoured. 2 Diminished, expended, wasted. E. अप before, चाय to reverence, or चि to collect, क्त aff.
1987: अपचिति f. (-तिः) 1 Loss. 2 Expense. 3 Annihilation. 4 Worship, reverence. E. अप before, चाय or चि, and क्तिन् aff.
1988: अपची f. (-ची) 1 Enlargement of the glands of the neck, &c. 2 Any indolent tumor. E. अ neg. पच to ripen, अङ् and ङीप् aff.
1989: अपचीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wasting, perishing, departing. E. अप before, चि to collect, शानच् aff.
1990: अपचेतृ m. (-ता) A spendthrift. E. अप, चि to collect, तृच् aff.
1991: अपच्छाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Shadowless, having no shadow, as a deity or celestial being. 2 Having a bad or unlucky shadow. f. (-या) An unlucky shadow, a phantom. E. अप priv. छाया shadow.
1992: अपञ्चीकृत n. (तं) Simple elementary substance, not compounded of the five gross elements. E. neg. पञ्च five, कृत made, च्ची augment.
1993: अपटान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Adjoining, contiguous. E. अ neg. पट a screen, and अन्तर between.
1994: अपटी f. (-टी) A screen or wall of cloth, especially the kenāt or screen surrounding a tent. E. अ priv. and पट to go, with fem, termination ङीप्; preventing admission.
1995: अपटीक्षेप m. (-पः) Precipitate entrance on the stage, indicating hurry and agitation: also read अपटाक्षेप. E. अपटी curtain, and क्षेप tossing.
1996: अपटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-ट्वी-टु) 1 Sick, diseased. 2 Awkward, not clever, uncouth. 3 Ineloquent. E. अ neg. पटु clever.
1997: अपटुकरण n. (-णं) A defect in any of the senses. E. अपटु, and करण doing.
1998: अपण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unlearned, ignorant. E. अ neg. पण्डित learned.
1999: अपतन्त्रक m. (-कः) Spasmodic contraction of the body, emprosthotonos. E. अप away, तन्त्र will, कन् aff.
2000: अपतर्पण n. (-णं) Fasting, (in sickness.) E. अप bad, and तर्पण satisfaction.
2001: अपतानक m. (-कः) Spasmodic contraction: see the last. E. अप down, तन to spread, ण्वुल् aff.
2002: अपत्य n. (-त्यं) Offspring, male or female. E. अ neg. वत to fall, and यत् affix; the family being upheld by them.
2003: अपत्यदा f. (-दा) A midwife. E. अपत्य offspring, and दा fem. deriv. who gives.
2004: अपत्यपथ m. (-थः) The vulva. E. अपत्य, and पथ the road.
2005: अपत्यविक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A father who receives a gratuity from his son-in-law, a seller of his offspring. E. अपत्य, and विक्रयिन् who sells.
2006: अपत्यशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A crab. E. अपत्य offspring, and शत्रु an enemy. The crab being said to perish on producing young.
2007: अपत्रप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Bashful, modest. 2 Immodest. f. (-पा) 1 Bashfulness. 2 Want of shame, immodesty. E. अप, and त्रपा shame.
2008: अपत्रपिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Bashful. E. अप before, त्रप to be ashamed, and इष्णुच् aff.
2009: अपथ n. (-थं) The absence of a road. E. अ priv. and पथ for पथिन् a road.
2011: अपथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) 1 Unsuitable, inconsistent. 2 (In medicine) Contra-indicated, unfit as food or drink in particular complaints. E. अ neg. पथ्य suitable.
2012: अपद mfn. (-दः-दा or -दी-दं) 1 Footless, having no feet. 2 Having no place, no station. adv. n. (-दं) Unseasonably, inopportunely. m. (-दः) A reptile. E. अ neg. पद a foot.
2013: अपदान n. (-नं) 1 Approved occupation. 2 Work well or completely done. E. अप before, दा to give, and ल्युट् aff.
2014: अपदानक n. (-कं) See the above. E. कन् added.
2015: अपदान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Adjoining, contiguous. n. (-रं) Proximity, close, contiguity. E. अ neg. पद a foot, and अन्तर between.
2016: अपदार्थ m. (-र्थः) Nonentity. E. अ neg. पदार्थ a thing.
2017: अपदिश n. or ind. (-शं) Intermediate space, half a point of the compass. E. अप, and दिश to shew, क aff.
2018: अपदिश्य ind. 1 Dispersing, going or having gone to various quarters. 2 Having shewn or stated. E. अप before, दिश to show, व aff.
2019: अपदेवता f. (-ता) An evil spirit, a goblin. E. अप, and देवता a deity.
2020: अपदेश m. (-शः) 1 Evasion, prevarication. 2 Disguise by dress, &c. 3 Place, quarter. 4 A butt or mark. 5 Cause. 6 Fame, reputation. 7 A contrivance, a pretence, a pretext. E. अप ill, badly, &c. and दिश to shew, with धञ् aff.
2021: अपद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 An impurity, any bad thing. 2 Alloy, adulteration. E. अप, and द्रव्य thing.
2022: अपध्वंस m. (-सः) Degradation, disgrace. E. अप, and ध्वंस loss.
2023: अपध्वंसज m. (-जः) A man of a mixed or impure cast. E. अपध्वंस and ज born.
