2024: अपध्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Cursed, reviled. 2 Abandoned. 3 Pounded. E. अप implying contempt, &c. part. past of ध्वस to go, also अवध्वस्त.
2025: अपध्यान n. (-नं) Evil thoughts, wickedness. E. अप, and ध्यान meditation.
2026: अपनयन n. (-नं) 1 Taking away, withdrawing, removing. 2 Destroying. 3 Dying. 4 Acquittance of a debt or obligation. E. अप from, णी to take, ल्युट् aff.
2027: अपनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken away, removed. 2 Paid, discharged. E. अप from, णी to take, क्त aff.
2028: अपनीय ind. 1 Having taken away. 2 Having discharged. E. अप before, णी to take, य aff.
2029: अपनुत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Removing, taking or sending away. E. अप, नुद to send, क्तिन् aff.
2030: अपनोद m. (-दः) Removing, taking away. E. अप, and नुद to send, affix घञ्.
2031: अपनोदन n. (नं) 1 Removing, destroying. 2 Expiating. E. अप before, नुद to send, ल्युट् aff.
2032: अपपात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Of low caste, using separate vessels. n. (-त्रं) A separate vessel, one from which no one else will eat. E. अप apart, पात्र a vessel.
2033: अपपात्रित m. (-तः) A person who has lost caste, one with whom his kindred will not eat or drink, from a common pātra or vessel. E. अपपात्र, and इतच् aff.
2034: अपभी mfn. (-भीः-भीः-भि) Fearless, undaunted. E. अप away, भी fear.
2035: अपभ्रंश m. (-शः) Ungrammatical language. E. अप from, भ्रंश to fall, and अच् affix; also अपभ्रंस.
2036: अपम m. (-मः) Declination, (in astronomy.) E. अप, मा to measure, ड aff.
2037: अपमान n. (-नं) Disrespect, disgrace. E. अप reverse, and मन to respect, affix घञ्.
2038: अपमानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespect, disgraced. E. अपमान disgrace, इतच् aff.
2039: अपमान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Disreputable, dishonourable. E. अप before, मन to mind, ण्यत् aff.
2040: अपमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Neglected in dress or person, unadorned. 2 Disrespected, disgraced. E. अप before, मा to measure, क्त aff.
2041: अपमित्यक n. (-कं) Debt. E. अप from, मि to throw, and त्यकन् aff.
2042: अपमृत्यु m. (-त्युः) Sudden death, dying of some casualty, not of sickness or decay. E. अप, मृत्यु death.
2043: अपयशस् n. (-शः) Disgrace, infamy. E. अप before, यशस् fame.
2044: अपयशस्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Disgraceful, occasioning infamy. E. अपयशस्, and कर what makes.
2045: अपयान n. (-नं) Retreat, flight. E. अप from, and यान going.
2046: अपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Other. 2 Opposite, contrary. 3 Posterior, (in place or time.) 4 Similar, same. 5 Friendly, not adverse. n. (-रं) The hind quarter of an elephant. f. (-रा) 1 The womb. 2 Suppressed menstruation in pregnancy. 3 The west. E. अ neg. and पर from पृ to nourish or fill, and अच् affix; or अ neg. and पर other.
2047: अपरञ्च ind. Again, moreover. E. च the particle added to the last.
2048: अपरत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Opposition, contrariety. 2 Posteriorly, (in place or time;) also अपरता f. (-ता.) E. त्व or तल् added to अपर.
2049: अपरति m. (-तिः) Stopping, ceasing. E. अप from, रम to please, and क्तिन् aff.
2050: अपररात्र m. (-त्रः) The end of the night, the last watch. E. अपर the end, रात्र from रात्रि a night.
2051: अपरलोक n. (-कं) Another world, paradise. E. अपर, and लोक world.
2052: अपरव m. (-वः) 1 Contest, dispute. 2 Discord. E. अप, and रव sound.
2053: अपरवक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) A kind of metre of four lines, having every two lines the same.
2054: अपरवोज्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undisturbed, undisputed. E. अपरव, and उज्झित free from.
2055: अपरस्पर adj. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) or adv. n. (-रं) 1 Continued, uninterrupted. 2 Continually, (applied to action.) E. अ neg. and परस्पर mutual.
2056: अपराङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Not having the head downwards or reverted. 2 Presenting a firm front in battle or danger. E. अ neg. पराङ्मुख reverted.
2057: अपराजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unconquered, unsurpassed. m. (-तः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Also of VIṢṆU. 3 A sage. f. (-ता) 1 A name applied to several plants. 2 (Clitoria ternatea,) see गिरिकर्णी. 3 Aeschynomene sesban, see जया. and, 4 Another plant, see अशनपर्णी. 5 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. 6 A species of the शर्करी metre of four lines, with fourteen syllables in each line. 7 The north-east quarter. E. अपर another, अ neg. and जित conquered, excelled, &c.
2058: अपराजेय mfn. (यः-या-यं) Unconquerable, invincible. E. अपर, and अजेय unconquerable.
2059: अपराद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Criminal, guilty. 2 Erring. E. अप before, राघ to accomplish, क्त aff.
2060: अपराद्धपृषत्क m. (-त्कः) An archer or arrow always missing the butt. E. अपराद्ध erring, and पृषत्क an arrow.
2061: अपराद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्ध्री-द्धृ) Offending an offender. E. अप before, राध, with तृच aff.
2062: अपराध m. (-धः) Offence, transgression, fault. E. अप badly, and राध to accomplish, घञ् aff.
2063: अपराधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Criminated, condemned. E. अपराध and क्त aff.
2064: अपराधिता f. (-ता) Criminality, guilt. So अपराधित्व n. (-त्वं) E. तल् or त्व added to अपराध.
2065: अपराधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Offending, culpable, criminal. E. अपराध, and इनि aff.
2066: अपराधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Independent. E. अ neg. पराधीन dependant.
2067: अपराह्ण m. (-ह्लः) Afternoon, the last watch of the day. E. अपर last, and अह्ण for अहन् a day.
2068: अपराह्णतन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging to or produced in the close of the day, also अपराह्लेतन. E. अपराह्ल the end of a day, with द्यु, or द्युल् aff.
2069: अपरिकलित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) 1 Unknown. 2 Unseen. E. अ neg. परिकलित seen.
2070: अपरिक्लिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Dry, not moist, not liquid. E. अ neg. परिक्लिन्न moist.
2071: अपरिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unknown, unobtained. E. अ neg. परिगत obtained.
2072: अपरिग्रह m. (-हः) Non-acceptance. E. अ neg. परिग्रह taking.
2073: अपरिग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्मं) Unfit or improper to be accepted, not to be taken. E. अ neg. परिग्राह्य to be taken.
2074: अपरिचयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Without acquaintance. 2 Misanthropic. E. अ neg. परिचयिन् acquainted.
2075: अपरिचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unacquainted with, unknown to. E. अ neg. परिचित known.
2076: अपरिचेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unsociable. E. अ neg. परिचेय to be combined.
2077: अपरिच्छद n. (-दं) Absence of clothing, nudity. E. अ neg. परिच्छद covering.
2078: अपरिच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Uncovered, unclothed. So अपरिच्छादित. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं.) E. अ neg. परिच्छन्न or परिच्छादित clothed.
2079: अपरिच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Continuous, connected without interval. E. अ neg. परिच्छिन्न intersected.
2080: अपरिच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 Want of arrangement or order. 2 Want of distinction or division. E. अ neg. परिच्छेद section.
2081: अपरिच्छेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unarranged, not distinguished or divided. E. अ neg. परिच्छेदित intersected.
2082: अपरिणयन n. (-नं) Celibacy. E. अ neg. परिणयन marrying.
2083: अपरिणीता f. (-ता) An unmarried woman. E. अ neg. परिणीत married.
2084: अपरिपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्व) Not quite mature. E. अ neg. परिपक्व ripe.
2085: अपरिपाटि f. (-टिः-टी) Want of order, disarrangement. E. अ neg. परिपाटि order.
2086: अपरिपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unripe, immature, imperfect. E. अ neg परिपूत perfect.
2087: अपरिमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Without measure, immense, immeasurable. E. अ neg. परिमाण measured.
2088: अपरिमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unmeasured. 2 Unlimited, unbounded. E. अ neg. परिमित measured.
2089: अपरिमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unbounded, illimitable. E. अ neg. परिमेय measurable.
2090: अपरिम्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Pure, clean. E. अ neg. परिम्लान dirty.
2091: अपरिवाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Not to be reprimanded. E. अ neg. परिवाद्य to be reproved.
2092: अपरिवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uninclosed, unsurrounded. E. अ neg. परिष्टत surrounded.
2093: अपरिष्कार m. (-रः) Coarseness, rudeness, want of polish or finish, moral or physical. E. अ neg. परिष्कार polish.
2094: अपरिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Coarse, rude, unpolished, unadorned, morally or physically. E. अ neg. परिष्कृत finished.
2095: अपरिसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Distant, not contiguous. E. अ neg. परिसर near.
2096: अपरिहरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be abandoned or lost. E. अ neg. परिहृ to leave, अनीयर् aff.
2097: अपरिहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Not to be avoided, inevitable. 2 Not to be abandoned. 3 Not to be degraded. E. अ neg. परिहृ to leave, ण्यत् aff.
2098: अपरीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Untried, unproved. E. अ neg. परीक्षित tried.
2099: अपरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) Ugly, deformed, ill-looking, ill-made, monstrous. n. (-पं) Monstrosity, deformity. E. अप bad, रूप form.
2100: अपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Leafless. f. (-र्णा) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. अ not, and पर्ण a leaf: the goddess not having even leaves for food, during her performance of religious austerities.
2101: अपर्य्याप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Unlimited, unbounded. 2 Incompetent, unable, insufficient. 3 Incomplete, not enough. E. अ neg. पर्य्याप्त extended.
2102: अपर्य्याय m. (-यः) Want of order or method. E. अ neg. पर्य्याय order.
2103: अपल n. (-लं) A pin or bolt. E. अप below, and ला to take, ड aff.
2104: अपलाप m. (-पः) 1 Denial or concealment of knowledge, evasion. 2 Affection, regard. 3 Concealing, hiding. E. अप away or kindly, and लप to speak, घञ् affix; also अपलपन n. (-नं.)
2105: अपलापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) One who denies or evades. E. अपलाप and इनि aff.
2106: अपलाषिका f. (-का) Thirst. E. अप, लष to desire, कन् aff.
2107: अपवन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Without air, sheltered from wind. n. (-नं) A garden, a grove. E. अप, and वन a wood, or अ neg. पवन wind.
2108: अपवरक m. (-कः) An inner apartment, the lying-in chamber. E. अप before वृञ to hide or choose, अच् and कन् affs.
2109: अपवरण n. (-णं) 1 Covering, screening. 2 A garment, a mantle. E. अप before वृ to screen, ल्युट् aff.
2110: अपवर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Final beatitude, the delivery of the soul from the body, and exemption from farther transmigration. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 3 The fruit or consequences of any completed act. 4 The completion of any act. 5 Any act brought to a conclusion. 6 End, completion. E. अप from, वृज to forsake, घञ् affix, and ग substituted for ज.
2111: अपवर्गद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring final beatitude. E. अपवर्ग, and द who gives.
2112: अपवर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Gift or donation. 2 Final emancipation or beatitude. 3 Abandoning, abandonment. E. अप before वृज to forsake, and ल्युट् aff. See अपवर्ग.
2113: अपवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, quitted, got rid of, given or cast away. E. अप before, वृज to forsake, क्त aff.
2114: अपवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Taking away. 2 A common measure in algebra. E. अप away, वृत्त being.
2115: अपवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Agitating, shaking. 2 Taking away, removal, resumption. 3 Transferring, removing from one place to another. 4 Abbreviation, abridging. 5 Division by a common measure, reduction of a fraction to its lowest terms. E. अप away, वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
2116: अपवाद m. (-दः) 1 Censure, blame. 2 An order, a command. 3 Difference, distinction, exception. 4 Contradiction, opposition, denial. E. अप implying aversion, and वाद speech, from वद with घञ्; also अववाद.
2117: अपवादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Censuring, accusing. 2 Opposing, objecting to. 3 Excepting, excluding. E. अप before वद to speak, ण्वुल् aff.
2118: अपवादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Accused, censured. 2 Opposed, objected to. E. अप before वद to speak, causal form, क्त aff.
2119: अपवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Accusing, defaming. 2 Opposing, objecting to. E. अपवाद and इनि aff.
2120: अपवारण n. (-णं) Disappearance, concealment, covering. E. अप before वृञ् to hide, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
2121: अपवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered, concealed, disappeared. E. अप before वृञ् to hide, क्त affix, and the vowel is made long.
2122: अपवार्य्य ind. 1 (In theatrical language,) Apart, aside. 2 Having concealed. E. अप before वृञ् to hide, ण्यत् aff.
2123: अपवाह m. (-हः) An inference or deduction. E. अप before वह to bear, घञ् aff.
2124: अपवित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Impure, unclean. E. अ neg. पवित्र pure.
2125: अपवित्रता f. Impurity, uncleanness. So अपवित्रत्व n. E. तल् or त्व added to the last.
2126: अपविद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Rejected, dismissed, removed. 2 Thrown, sent. 3 Broken to pieces. E. अप before ट्यध to strike, क्त the part. affix, and the semivowel changed to its corresponding vowel इ.
2127: अपविद्धपुत्र m. (-त्रः) A son rejected by his natural parents, and adopted by a stranger; one of the twelve objects of filiation in Hindu law. E. अपविद्ध as before, and पुत्र a son.
2128: अपविषा f. (-षा) A species of grass, (Kyllingia monocephala.) E. अप, and विष poison.
2129: अपवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Reversed, inverted, overturned. 2 Deprived of. 3 Uncovered. E. अप, and वृत्त established.
2130: अपवेध m. (-धः) Piercing any thing in the wrong direction. E. अप, and वेध perforating.
2131: अपव्यय m. (-यः) Prodigality. E. अप, and व्यय expense.
2132: अपव्ययमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Squandering. 2 Denying a debt. E. अप away, व्यय expenditure, used as a verb, शानच aff.
2133: अपव्ययिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Squandering, wasting, prodigal, E. अपव्यय and इनि aff.
2134: अपशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless, having no fear or hesitation. adv. n. (-ङ्कं) Fearlessly. E. अप, and शङ्क fear.
2135: अपशद m. (-दः) A low man. See अपसद.
2136: अपशब्द m. (-ब्दः) 1 Ungrammatical language. 2 Common or vulgar speech, any form of language not Sanscrit. E. अप bad, and शब्द sound.
2137: अपशुच् m. (-शुक्) The soul. E. अप, and शुच् sorrow.
2138: अपशोक m. (-कः) A tree, (Jonesia asoca.) E. अप, and शोक sorrow.
2139: अपष्ट n. (-ष्टं) The end or point of the hook for driving an elephant. E. अप before ष्टे to surround, and ड aff.
2140: अपष्टम m. (-मः) The point of the hook by which elephants are driven.
2141: अपष्ठु m. (-ष्टुः) Time. mfn. (-ष्ठुः-ष्ठुः-ष्ठु) 1 Contrary, opposite. 2 Left, (not right.) ind. 1 Well, properly. 2 Handsomely. 3 Contrary, perversely. E. अप badly, स्थ what stays, with कु Uṇādi affix; स्थ becomes ष्ठ.
2142: अपष्ठुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opposite, contrary. E. अपष्ठु contrary, and र from रा to obtain, affix ड.
2143: अपष्ठुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Opposite, contrary. E. as before, ल substituted for र.
2144: अपस् n. (-पः) Sacrificing. E. आप to obtain, असुन् Uṇādi aff.; the radical vowel made short.
2145: अपसद m. (-दः) A low man, an outcaste; it especially applies to the children of six degrading connexions, or of a Brāhmaṇa with the women of the three lower classes; of a Kṣatriya with women of two, the Vaiśya and Śūdra; and of a Vaiśya with one of a lower class or a Śūdra. E. अप low, सद to abide, and अच् aff.
2146: अपसर m. (-रः) The removal of any thing from one place to another. E. अप before सृ to go, अच् aff.
2147: अपसर्जन n. (-नं) 1 A gift or donation. 2 Killing. 3 Final emancipation. 4 Abandonment. E. अप before सृज to leave, and ल्युट् aff.
2148: अपसरण n. (-णं) Going out, egress. E. अप before सरणं going.
2149: अपसर्प m. (-र्पः) A secret emissary or agent, a spy. So अपसर्पक m. (-कः) E. अप bad, &c. सर्प who goes; from सृप with अच् aff.
2150: अपसलवि ind. The space between the thumb and the forefinger.
2151: अपसव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Opposite, contrary. 2 Right, (not left.) n. (-व्यं) The space between the thumb and the forefinger. E. अप, and सव्य left.
2152: अपसव्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the above. E. कन् added.
2153: अपसार m. (-रः) 1 Egress, passage for going forth. 2 Going out or away. E. अप before, सार a going.
2154: अपसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone out, got out, escaped, fled. E. अप before, सारित gone.
2155: अपस्कर m. (-रः) 1 Any part of a carriage. 2 The anus. 3 Faeces. E. अप, and कर from कृष to furrow, or कृ to do; स is inserted for the sake of euphony.
2156: अपस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bathed or bathing after mourning, or upon the death of a connexion. 2 Bathed after death, (the corpse,) preparatory to other ceremonies. E. अप, and स्नात bathed, from ष्णा, and क्र aff.
2157: अपस्नान n. (-नं) 1 Funereal bathing, upon the death of a connexion, after mourning, &c. 2 Impure bathing, or bathing in water with which a person has previously washed. E. अप, and स्नान bathing.
2158: अपस्पश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Being without spies or emissaries. 2 Wanting the introduction or explanation, (grammar.) E. अप with स्पश a spy, or अ and पस्पश the first section of the Bhāṣya.
2159: अपस्मार m. (-रः) Epilepsy, falling sickness. E. अप privation, स्मृ to remember, and घञ् affix; loss of memory or sense.
2160: अपस्मारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Epileptic, convulsed. E. इनि added to the last.
2161: अपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed. E. अप, and उत killed.
2162: अपहरण n. (-णं) 1 Taking away, carrying off, stealing, &c. 2 Taking back, resuming. E. अप before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
2163: अपहरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be taken away, carried off, stolen, &c. 2 To be taken back or resumed. E. अप before हृ to take, अनीयर affix; also अपहर्त्तव्य, and अपहार्य्य.
2164: अपहस्त n. (-स्तं) 1 Taking away or off. 2 Stealing, plundering. E. अप, and हस्त the hand.
2165: अपहस्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lost, gone, parted with or deprived of. E. अप, हस्त the hand, इतच् aff.
2166: अपहानि f. (-निः) 1 Exception, exclusion. 2 Quitting, leaving. 3 Leaving off, stopping. E. अप, and हानि abandoning.
2167: अपहाय ind. Having left or abandoned. 2 Except, excepting. E. अप before हा to abandon, य aff.
2168: अपहार m. (-रः) 1 Loss. 2 Taking away. 3 Theft, stealing. 4 Secreting. 5 Spending another person's property. E. अप before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
2169: अपहारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who takes away, seizing, taking a thief. E. अपहृ to take away, ण्वुल् aff.
2170: अपहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) One who takes away, who seizes, steals, &c. a plunderer, a thief. E. अपहृ to steal, णिनि aff.
2171: अपहास m. (-सः) Silly or causeless laughter. E. अप before, हास laughter.
2172: अपहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken away, carried off, stolen, &c. 2 Taken back, resumed. E. अप before हृत taken.
2173: अपह्नव m. (-वः) 1 Denial or concealment of knowledge. 2 Affection. E. अप before, ह्नङ to conceal, and अच् aff.
2174: अपह्नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Concealed, denied. E. अप before, ह्नु and क्त aff.
2175: अपह्नुति f. (-तिः) 1 Denial, or concealment of knowledge. 2 A figure of rhetoric, applying a description or simile to other than its obvious application. E. अपह्नङ and क्तिन् aff.
2176: अपह्नोतृ mfn. (-ता-त्रणी-नृ) One who conceals or denies. E. अपह्लुङ् and तृच् aff.
2177: अपाक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Immature, raw, undressed or unripe. 2 Undigested. m. (-कः) 1 Immaturity. 2 Indigestion. E. अ neg. पाक ripeness.
2178: अपाकरण n. (-णं) 1 Payment, liquidation. 2 Removal, abstraction. E. अप and आङ् before कृ to make, ल्युट् aff.
2179: अपाकशाक n. (-कं) Ginger. E. अपाक indigestion, and शाक herb.
2180: अपाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken away, removed, destroyed, void of. 2 Paid. E. अप and आ before कृत made.
2181: अपाकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Removal, taking away. 2 Change of form or condition. E. अप and आ before कृति doing, or अप with आकृति form.
2182: अपाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Present, perceptible. E. अप before, and अक्ष an organ of sense, or अक्षि the eye.
2183: अपाङ्क्त mfn. (-ङ्क्तः-ङ्क्ता-ङ्क्तं) 1 Not in a line or row. 2 Not in the same degree or class, unworthy, inadmissible into society, excluded. E. अ neg. पंक्ति a line, अण् affix; also similar derivatives as अपांक्तय, &c.
2184: अपाङ्क्तेय mfn. (-यः-यी-य) 1 Not in a line or row. 2 Not in the same degree or order of society. E. अ neg. पङ्क्ति a line, ढक aff. see अपाङ्कृ.
2185: अपाङ्क्त्योपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Defiled or contaminated by the presence of impure or improper persons. E. अपाङ्क्त्य excluded, उपहत affected by.
2186: अपाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 The outer corner of the eye. 2 A sectarial mark or circlet on the forehead. mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Maimed, crippled. E. अए before अगि to go, and अच् affix, or अङ्ग a limb.
2187: अपाङ्गक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Maimed, mutilated. m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 The outer angle of the eye. E. अप before अङ्ग the body, and क aff.
2188: अपाङ्गदर्शन n. (-नं) A side glance, a leer, a wink. E. अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye, and दर्शन looking.
2189: अपाच् or अपाञ्च् mfn. (अपाङ् अपाची अपाक्) South, southern. E. See अवाच्.
2190: अपाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 Southern, southerly. 2 Not to be ripened or digested. E. अपाच्, and यत् affix or अ neg. पाच्य to be ripened.
2191: अपाचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 South, southern. 2 Opposite. E. अपाच् and ख aff.
2192: अपाठव n. (-वं) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Awkwardness, inelegance. E. अ priv. and पाटब strength, cleverness, &c. see पटु.
2193: अपाणिग्रहण n. (-णं) Celibacy. E. अ neg. पाणिग्रहण taking the hand, as in marrying.
2194: अपात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A worthless or common utensil. 1 An inferior or worthless person. E. अ neg. पात्र a vessel.
2195: अपात्रीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Acting unbecomingly, doing degrading offices, as for a Brāhmaṇa to receive wealth improperly acquired; to trade, to serve a Śūdra, and to utter an untruth. 2 Excommunication, disqualification. E. अ neg. पात्र a vessel, कररं making, च्ची augment; disqualifying a person from eating out of the same vessel as another.
2196: अपादान n. (-नं) 1 Removal, ablation, the sense of the fifth or ablative case. 2 Taking away. E. अप from, आदान taking.
2197: अपान n. (-नं) 1 The anus. 2 A fart, one of the five vital airs. E. अप below, अन to breathe, घञ् aff.
2198: अपान्नाथ m. (-थः) The ocean. E. अपाम् of water, नाथ lord.
2199: अपान्निधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. अपां of water, निधि receptacle.
2200: अपाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Sinless, virtuous, pure. So अपापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि.) E. अ neg. and पाप sin or पापिन् sinner.
2201: अपामार्ग m. (-र्गः) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. अप, मृज to clean, with आङ् prefixed, and घञ् affix; the ashes are used in washing linen.
2202: अपाम्पति m. (-तिः) 1 The ocean. A name of VARUṆA. See अप्पति, E. अपाम् genitive case of अप water, and पति master.
2203: अपाम्पित्त n. (-त्तं) Fire. E. अपाम् of water, and पित्त bile; drying it up.
2204: अपाय m. (-यः) 1 Destruction, annihilation. 2 Separation, disunion. 3 Loss, injury. 4 Departure, going away. 5 Retreat, flight. E. अप away, अय going.
2205: अपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Going away, departing, perishing. E. अपाय and इनि aff.
2206: अपार n. (-रं) The opposite bank of a river. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unbounded, boundless, interminable. E. अ neg. पार shore.
2207: अपारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Incompetent, impotent. E. अ neg. पारक who gets through or over.
2208: अपार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Useless, unprofitable. 2 Unmeaning. E. अप without, अर्थ object, also with कन् added अपार्थक.
2209: अपार्थकरण n. (-णं) A false plea in a law suit. E. अपार्थ, and करण making.
2210: अपावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning away or from. 2 Retreat, repulse. 3 Returning. E. अप and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
2211: अपावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Self-willed, unrestrained. 2 Covered, concealed. 3 Surrounded, inclosed. 4 Opened. 5 Driven away. adv. (-र) Immoderately, unreservedly. E. अप priv. वृञ to hide, with आङ prefixed, and क्त aff.
2212: अपावृति f. (-तिः) 1 Enclosing, surrounding. 2 Covering, screening. E. अप and आङ् before वृ to hide, क्तिन् aff.
2213: अपावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Retreat, repulse. 2 Returning. E. अप and आङ् before वृत to be, क्तिन् aff.
2214: अपावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Rolling on the ground, (as a horse.) 2 Uncovered. 3 Driven back or to the rear, repelled. E. अप before वृत to stand, and क्त aff.
2215: अपाश्रय m. (-यः) An awning spread over a court or yard. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Helpless, destitute. E. अप, and आश्रथ protection.
2216: अपासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A quiver; also उपासङ्ग.
2217: अपासन n. (-नं) 1 Quitting, foregoing, discarding. 2 Killing, slaughter. E. अप, अस to be, and ल्युट् aff.
2218: अपासरण n. (-णं) Departing, departure, removal. E. अप and आङ्. before सृ to go, ल्युट् aff.
2219: अपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrown or cut down, injured, destroyed. E. अप with अस to throw, क्त affix and इट् augment.
2220: अपासृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, departed, gone away. E. अप, and आङ् before सृ to go, क्त aff.
2221: अपास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Thrown off, set aside. 2 Driven away, expelled. 3 Discarded, abandoned. 4 Disregarded, contemned. E. अप and अस to throw, क्त aff.
2222: अपास्य ind. 1 Having quitted or left. 2 Having thrown away. 3 Disregarding. E. अप, and अस to throw, य aff.
2223: अपि ind. A preposition and particle corresponding to even, though, yet, assuredly, &c. and implying 1 Interrogation. 2 Earnest interrogation or enquiry. 3 Doubt. 4 Possibility. 5 Reproof; and, 6 Conjunction. 7 It is often an expletive. E. अ neg. and पि to go, with क्विप् aff.
2224: अपिगीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Praised. E. अपि before, गीर्ण part. past, irregularly formed from गॄ to sound.
2226: अपिच्छल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Clear, free from sediment or soil. E. अ neg. पिच्छल muddy.
2227: अपितु ind. If, if indeed, yet, but yet. E. अपि, and तु but, and, &c.
2228: अपितृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the next. E. अ neg. पितृ a father, कव् added.
2229: अपित्र्य mfn. (-त्र्यः-त्र्या-त्र्यं) Uninherited, acquired, not ancestral or paternal. E. अ neg. पितृ a father, क्यप् aff.
2230: अपिधान n. (-नं) Covering, concealment, disappearance. E. अपि before धा to have or hold, and ल्युट् aff. See पिधान.
2231: अपिनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Clothed, accoutred. E. अपि, and नद्ध part. past of नह to bind.
2232: अपिशुन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Upright, honest. E. अ neg. पिशुन dishonest.
2233: अपीडन n. (-नं) Gentleness, kindness, giving pain to nothing. E. अ neg. पीडन paining.
2234: अपीनस m. (-सः) Dryness of the nose, want of the pituitary secretion and loss of smell, cold. E. अ neg. पीनस the mucus of the nose.
2236: अपुच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) Tailless. f. (-च्छा) A tree, (Dalbergia sisu.) See शिंशपा. E. अ neg. पुच्छ a tail.
2237: अपुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Wicked, bad. E. अ, and पुण्य virtuous. So अपुण्यशील.
2238: अपुण्यकृत् mfn. (-त्) Acting wickedly, wicked, bad. E. कृत् who does, with अपुण्य. So अपुण्यवत्.
2239: अपुत्र m. (-त्रं) A man who has no son. E. अ neg. पुत्र a son, also with कन added, अपुत्रकः.
2240: अपुनरावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Final exemption from life. E. अ neg. पुनरावृत्ति renewed practice.
2241: अपुनर्भव m. (-वः) Final beatitude, exemption of the soul from further transmigration. E. अ neg. पुनर् again, and भव being.
2242: अपुराण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Modern, new. So अपुरातन. E. अ neg. पुराण old.
2243: अपुरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Unmanly. E. अ neg. पुरुष a man.
2244: अपुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Lean. E. अ neg. पुष्ट nourished.
2245: अपुष्प mfn. (-ष्पः-ष्पा-ष्पं) Not flowering. E. अ neg. पुष्प a flower. So अपुष्पक and अपुष्पित.
2246: अपुष्पफलद m. (-दः) Any tree which bears fruit without flowering, as the jack tree. E. अपुष्प, फल fruit, and द what gives.
2247: अपूजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Irreligious, irreverent. E. अ neg. पूजक a worshipper.
2248: अपूजा f. (-जा) Irreverence, disrespect. E. अ neg. पूजा worship.
2249: अपूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contemned, disregarded, not reverenced or worshipped. E. अ neg. पूजित worshipped.
2250: अपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Impure. 2 Not having received the invocatory rite. E. अ neg. पूत pure.
2251: अपूप m. (-पः) 1 Cake of flour, meal, &c. 2 Wheat. E. पूय to split with अ neg. prefixed; प affixed, and य dropped.
2252: अपूप्य m. (-प्यः) Flour, meal. E. अपूप a cake, and यत् aff.
2253: अपूरणी f. (-णी) The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
2254: अपूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Incomplete, not full or entire, m. (-णः) A fraction. 2 An incomplete number. E. अ neg. पूर्ण full.
2255: अपूर्णकाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Premature. m. (-लः) Incomplete time. E. अपूर्ण, and काल time.
2256: अपूर्णकालज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Abortive, born before the proper time. E. अपूर्ण, and काल time, and ज born.
2257: अपूर्णता f. (-ता) Incompleteness. E. अपूर्ण and तल् affix; also with त्व, अपूर्णत्वं.
2258: अपूर्व्व mfn. (-व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) 1 Wonderful, extraordinary. 2 Unprecedented, unpreceded. 3 Excellent, not exceeded. 4 Not easterly. n. (-र्व्वं) The remote or unforeseen consequence of an act, as heaven of religious rites, a consequence not immediately preceded by its cause. E. अ neg. पूर्व्व prior.
2259: अपूर्व्ववत् ind. Singularly, unlike any thing else. E. अपूर्व्व and वति aff.
2260: अपृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unmixed, uncombined. m. (-क्तः) (In grammar) an affix of a single letter. E. अ neg. पृक्त combined.
2261: अपृथक् ind. With, together with, collectively. E. अ not, पृथक severally.
2262: अपृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Unasked, unaddressed, not spoken to. E. अ neg. पृष्ट asked.
2263: अपेक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Expecting. E. अप before ईक्ष to see, ण्वुल् aff.
2264: अपेक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be regarded or considered. 2 Desirable. E. अप before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.
2265: अपेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Expectation, hope. 2 Regard, reference, consideration. 3 Connexion of cause and effect. 4 Absolute connexion, as of an individual with its species. 5 Necessity, need, occasion. E. अप, ईक्ष to see, अङ and टाप् affs.
2266: अपेक्षाबुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Clearness of understanding, the faculty of arranging and methodising a variety of considerations. E. अपेक्षा, and बुद्धि intellect.
2267: अपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Regarded, considered, referred to. 2 Wished, hoped. 3 Connected. E. अप, ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
2268: अपेक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be regarded or considered. 2 Desirable, estimable. E. अप and ईक्ष to see, तव्य aff.
2269: अपेक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) 1 Expecting, hoping, an expectant. 2 Looking to. E. अपेक्षा and इनि aff.
2270: अपेक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 To be regarded or considered. 2 To be wished or desired. ind. Having considered, having, or with, regard or reference to. E. अप, ईक्ष to see, यत् or य aff.
2271: अपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, departed. 2 Lost. 3 Open, apart. E. अप, and इत gone.
2272: अपेशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Inexpert. E. अ neg. पेशल clever.
2273: अपैशुन n. (-नं) Integrity, honesty, uprightness. E. अ neg. पैशुन roguery.
2274: अपोगण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Deformed, having a limb too many or too few, &c. 2 Flaccid. 3 A child or infant. 4 Timid, fearful. E. अप before गम to go, affix ड, deriv. irr.
2275: अपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Removed, carried off. 2 Lost, deprived of, taken away. 3 Discussed, established by argument. E. अप, and ऊढ borne.
2276: अपोदिका f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella, rubra or lucida.)
2277: अपोह m. (-हः) 1 The removal of doubt by the exercise of the reasoning faculty. 2 Reasoning, arguing. E. अप reverse, ऊह to reason, and घञ् affix; opposed to doubt or deliberation.
2278: अपोहन n. (-नं) Reasoning, exercise of reason. E. अप, and ऊह to reason, ल्युट् aff.
2279: अपोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Removed, taken away. 2 Lost, deprived of. 3 Established by reason. E. अप, and वह to bear, क्त aff.
2280: अपौरुष n. (-षं) Unmanliness, cowardice. E. अ neg. पौरुष manhood.
2281: अप्तस् n. (-प्तः) Sacrificing, offering oblations. E. आप to obtain, असुन् affix, and त inserted.
2282: अप्तु m. (-प्तुः) 1 The body. 2 A limb or member. E. आप to obtain, and तुन् Uṇādi aff.
2283: अप्नस् n. (-प्नः) Water, (in the language of the Vedas.) E. आप to obtain, असुन् affix, and नुम् inserted.
2284: अप्पति m. (-तिः) A name of VARUṆA. E. अप् water, and पति lord; regent of the water, also अपांपति.
2285: अप्पित्त m. (-त्तः) Fine. E. अप water, पित्त bile; see अपाम्पित्त.
2286: अप्युत ind. Also, indeed. E. अपि, and उत or.
2287: अप्रकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Unmanifested, unapparent. E. अ neg. प्रकट evident.
2288: अप्रकम्प mfn. (-म्पः-म्पा-म्पं) 1 Unshaken, literally or figuratively, firm, steady. 2 Unanswered, unrefuted. E. अ neg. प्रकम्प trembling.
2289: अप्रकम्पता n. (-ता) 1 Firmness, stability. 2 Unanswerableness. E. तल् added to the preceding, also with त्व, अप्रकम्पत्व.
2290: अप्रकर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Not exceeded, not more than. 2 Unsurpassed. E. अ neg. प्रकर्षित bettered, exceeded.
2291: अप्रकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Hidden, private, not public or displayed, not manifest or evident. E. अ neg. प्रकाश light.
2292: अप्रकाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not manifested, undivulged, unrevealed, not evident or public. E. अ neg. प्रकाशित manifested.
2293: अप्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unusual, uncommon, occasional or incidental to. E. अ neg. प्र before कृत made.
2294: अप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Accidental property or nature, not the inherent or inseparable property. 2 Spiritual being. E. अ neg. प्रकृति nature or matter.
2295: अप्रकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Low, vile. m. (-ष्टः) A crow. E. अ neg. प्रकृष्ट excellent.
2296: अप्रखर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Dull, obtuse. 2 Bland, mild. E. अ neg. प्रखर sharp.
2297: अप्रगल्भ mfn. (-ल्मः-ल्मा-ल्मं) Modest, unassuming. E. अ neg. प्रगल्भ arrogant.
2298: अप्रगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Confounded, perplexed. E. अ neg. प्रगुण direct.
2299: अप्रचुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Little, few. E. अ neg. प्रचुर much.
2300: अप्रचोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Undesired, not bidden or commanded. 2 Undeclared, not said. 3 Not promised. 4 Unasked, declared. E. अ neg. प्रचोदित directed.
2301: अप्रच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Observing, following, not fallen or deviating from. E. अ neg. प्रच्युत fallen.
2302: अप्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Childless, without progeny. 2 Unpeopled, destitute of subjects. E. अ neg. प्रजा offspring.
2303: अप्रजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Childless. f. (-ता) A barren woman. E. अ neg. प्रजात generated.
2304: अप्रणीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unconsecrated, profane, common. E. अ neg. प्रणीत sacred.
2305: अप्रणोद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Not to be turned away. E. अ neg. प्रणोद्य to be dismissed.
2306: अप्रतर्क्य mfn. (-र्क्यः-र्क्या-र्क्यं) Not to be discussed, incomprehensible by reason. E. अ neg. प्रतर्क्य to be investigated.
2307: अप्रताप m. (-पः) 1 Meanness, want of dignity. 2 Dulness, want of brilliancy. E. अ neg. प्रताप splendor.
2308: अप्रतिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Trusted, confidential. 2 One who does not requite or retaliate. E. अ neg. प्रति again, कर who does.
2309: अप्रतिकार m. (-रः) 1 Non-requital, non-acquittal. 2 Non-retaliation. 3 Not remedying. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Helpless, defenceless. 2 Irremediable. E. अ neg. प्रतिकार rendering again or the like.
2310: अप्रतिग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Not to be taken, unacceptable. E. अ neg. प्रतिग्राह्य to be taken.
2311: अप्रतिघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Favourable, friendly. E. अ neg. प्रतिघ adverse.
2312: अप्रतिपण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Not to be bartered or exchanged. E. अ not, प्रति again, पण्य to be sold.
2313: अप्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Non-ascertainment. 2 Non-performance, failure. 3 Neglecting. disregard. E. अ neg. प्रतिपत्ति effecting.
2314: अप्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Unascertained. 2 Unaccomplished. 3 Neglected. E. अ neg. प्रतिपन्न effected.
2315: अप्रतिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Modest, bashful. 2 Confounded, perplexed. 3 Unreflected, (as an image.) E. अ neg. प्रतिभा light, reflexion.
2316: अप्रतिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Unequalled, incomparable. E. अ neg. प्रतिमा similitude.
2317: अप्रतियत्न m. (-त्नः) Natural or spontaneous state or condition. E. अ neg. प्रतियत्न fabrication.
2318: अप्रतियत्नपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Natural, not made or artificial. E. अ neg. प्रतियत्न fabrication.
2319: अप्रतिबन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) 1 Unobstructed, undisputed. 2 Absolute, direct, (as inheritance,) not collateral or presumptive. E. अ neg. प्रतिबन्ध obstacle.
2320: अप्रतिरथ n. (-थं) 1 A march or procession. 2 The Sāma Veda. 3 Auspicious, well, right. m. (थः) A warrior. E. अ neg. प्रति against, रथ a car.
2321: अप्रतिरूप mfn. (पः-पा-पी-पं) Unequalled, incomparable. E. अ neg. प्रति against, रूप kind, form.
2322: अप्रतिरूपकथा f. (-था) Unanswerable or incomparable discourse. E. अप्रतिरूप, and कथा speech.
2323: अप्रतिकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unimpeded, unobstructed. E. अ neg. प्रतिकारित hindered.
2324: अप्रतिविधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Natural, unartificial. E. अ neg. प्रतिविधान fabrication.
2325: अप्रतिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्टं) 1 Infamous, disreputable. 2 Thrown away, unprofitable. 3 Undecided, fluctuating. E. अ neg. प्रतिष्ठा credit, &c.
2326: अप्रतिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unconsecrated. 2 Obscure, uncelebrated. 3 Unsettled, unfixed. E. अ neg. प्रतिष्ठित celebrated &c.
2327: अप्रतिषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Unprohibited, unforbidden. E. अ neg. प्रतिषिद्ध forbidden.
2328: अप्रतिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unaffected, uninjured, unimpaired. 2 Not disappointed. 3 Unobstructed, uninterrupted. E. अ neg. प्रतिहत hurt.
2329: अप्रतीकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Unresisting, defenceless. 2 Irremediable. m. (रः) 1 Non-retaliation. 2 Want of remedy or relief. E. अ neg. प्रतीकार counteracting.
2330: अप्रतीति f. (-तिः) Mistrust, want of confidence. E. अ neg. प्रतीति faith.
2331: अप्रतुल m. (-लः) Necessity, want. E. अ neg. प्रतुल sufficiency.
2332: अप्रत्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Invisible, imperceptible, not present. E. अ neg. प्रत्यक्ष present.
2333: अप्रत्यय m. (-यः) Doubt, distrust, disbelief. E. अ neg. प्रत्यय trust.
2334: अप्रत्ययिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Doubtful, mistrusting, sceptical. E. अप्रत्यय and इनि aff.
2335: अप्रत्याख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Assented to, uncontradicted, unrefuted. E. अ neg. प्रत्याख्यात denied.
2336: अप्रत्याख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be contradicted, undeniable. E. अ neg. प्रत्याख्येय deniable.
2337: अप्रथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unpublished. 2 Unnoted, unknown. E. अ neg. प्रथित celebrated.
2338: अप्रधान n. (-नं) Subordinate, secondary. E. अ neg. प्रधान principal: (always neuter.)
2339: अप्रधानता f. (-ता) Inferiority, subordination. E. तल् added to the last, also with त्व, अप्रधानत्वं.
2340: अप्रबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Weak, inefficacious. E. अ neg. प्रबल potent.
2341: अप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Dull, obscure. 2 Mean. E. अ neg. प्रभा radiance.
2342: अप्रभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Insufficient, inadequate. E. अ neg. प्र before भूत been.
2343: अप्रमत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Careful, attentive, vigilant. E. अ neg. प्रमत्त careless.
2344: अप्रमाद m. (-दः) Care, vigilance. E. अ neg. प्रमाद carelessness.
2345: अप्रमादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Careful, cautious, steady. E. अप्रमाद and इनि aff.
2346: अप्रमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unbounded, unmeasured. E. अ neg. प्रमित measured.
2347: अप्रमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unbounded, immeasurable. E. अ neg. प्रमेय measurable.
2348: अप्रयत्न m. (-त्नः) Indifference, laziness. mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Indifferent, apathetic, making no effort. E. अ neg. प्रयत्न energy.
2349: अप्रलम्व mfn. (-म्वः-म्वा-म्वं) Quick, expeditious. E. अ neg. प्रलम्ब slow.
2350: अप्रवत्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Abstaining from action, inert. 2 Not exciting to action. E. अ neg. प्रवर्त्तक what excites.
2351: अप्रवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Refraining from, not engaging in. 2 Not exciting to. E. अ neg. प्र before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
2352: अप्रवीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Unskilful. E. अ neg. प्रवीण skilful.
2353: अप्रवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Abstaining from action, inertion. 2 Nonexcitement. 3 (In Medicine) Suppression of the natural evacuations, constipation, ischury, &c. E. अ neg. प्रवृत्ति active exertion.
2354: अप्रशक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Moderate, temperate. E. अ neg. प्रशक्त intent or fond of.
2355: अप्रशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Moderation. mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Moderate, temperate. E. अ neg. प्रशक्ति addiction to any thing.
2356: अप्रशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Bad, worthless. E. अ neg. प्रशस्त excellent.
2357: अप्रसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Turbid, muddy. 2 Displeased, dissatisfied, unfavourable. E. अ neg. प्रसन्न pleased.
2358: अप्रसाद m. (-दः) Disfavour, disapprobation. E. अ neg. प्रसाद favour.
2359: अप्रसाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Not to be propitiated. 2 Unappeasable, implacable. E. अ neg. प्र before षद to go, यत् aff.
2360: अप्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Unusual, uncommon. 2 Uncelebrated. E. अ neg. प्रसिद्ध famous.
2361: अप्रसूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not having offspring, barren, childless. E. अ neg. प्रसूत bearing.
2362: अप्रस्तुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uncommenced, not begun. 2 Unconnected with, unattached to. 3 Uncommon, unusual. 4 Unpraised, not celebrated. 5 Confounded, not prompt. E. अ neg. प्र before ष्टु to praise, क्त aff.
2363: अप्रहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unhurt, intact. 2 Untilled, waste, fallow. E. अ neg. प्रहत broken.
2364: अप्राकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Special, particular, not common or generic. 2 Not vulgar, (especially as dialect or speech.) E. अ neg. प्राकृत common, vulgar.
2365: अप्राग्र्य mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं) Secondary, subordinate. E. अ neg. प्राग्र्य principal.
2366: अप्राचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Modern, recent. E. अ neg. प्राचीन old.
2367: अप्राज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Unlearned, ignorant. 2 Unconscious, unwitting. E. अ neg. प्राज्ञ who knows.
2368: अप्राज्ञता f. (-ता) 1 Unconsciousness. 2 Ignorance. E. तल् added to the last, also with त्व, अप्राज्ञत्वं.
2369: अप्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Lifeless, inanimate. m. (-णः) Death. E. अ neg. प्राण life.
2370: अप्राणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Lifeless, inanimate. E. अप्राण and इनि aff.
2371: अप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Unobtained. 2 Unarrived. E. अ neg. प्राप्त acquired.
2372: अप्राप्तकाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Inopportune, out of season. 2 Under age. E. अप्राप्त, and काल time.
2373: अप्राप्तव्यवहार m. (-रः) A minor. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Under age, not of years to engage in law or public business. E. अ neg. प्राप्त attained, व्यवहार legal affairs.
2374: अप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Non-attainment, non-acquisition. E. अ neg. प्राप्ति acquisition.
2375: अप्राथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Unobtainable, unattainable. ind. Not having obtained. E. अ neg. प्राथ future or past part.
2376: अप्रामाणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unauthentic, unauthoritative. E. अ neg. प्रामाणिक of authority.
2377: अप्रामाण्य n. (-ण्यं) Absence, or insufficiency of proof or authority. E. अ neg. प्रामाण्य proof.
2378: अप्रावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uncovered, unclothed. E. अ neg. प्रावृत covered.
2379: अप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Disliked, disagreeable. 2 Unkind, unfriendly. m. (-यः) A foe, an enemy. f. (-या) A sort of skeat fish, (Silurus pungentissimus.) E. अ neg. प्रिय beloved.
2380: अप्रियकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Unfriendly, ill-disposed. 2 Disagreeable. E. अप्रिय, and कर what makes.
2381: अप्रियम्वद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who speaks harshly or unkindly. E. अ neg. प्रियम्वद kind spoken.
2382: अप्रियवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking unkindly. E. अप्रिय, and वादिन् who speaks; also अप्रियभाषिन, &c.
2383: अप्रीति f. (-तिः) 1 Dislike, aversion. 2 Unfriendliness, enmity. E. अ neg. प्रीति love.
2384: अप्रीतिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Unkind, adverse. 2 Disagreeable, offensive. E. अप्रीति and कर what makes.
2385: अप्रेमन् n. (-म) Dislike, aversion. E. अ neg. प्रेमन् affection.
2386: अप्रौढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Timid, gentle. 2 Immature. f. (-ढा) An unmarried girl, or one very recently married, and not come to womanhood. E. अ neg. प्रोढ arrogant.
2387: अप्सरस् f. plur. always (-राः) The nymphs of Svarga, attendants on INDRA. E. अप water, सृ to go, and असि Uṇādi affix: or अप्स in the waters, and रस flavour: from their fondness for bathing, or from their being produced at the churning of the ocean.
2388: अप्सरा f. (-रा) An Apsarā or heavenly nymph. E. अप and सृ as before, with अच् aff.
2389: अफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Unfruitful, barren. 2 Vain, unproductive. f. (-ला) 1 The aloe plant, (Aloes perfoliata.) 2 Another plant, (Flacoartia cataphracta.) E. अ neg. फल fruit.
2390: अफलता f. (-ता) Barrenness, unprofitableness. E. अफल with तल् affix; also अफलत्वं.
2391: अफलाकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि) Disinterested, indifferent, not looking to beneficial consequences. E. अ neg. फल fruit, and आकाङ्क्षिन् who desires.
2392: अफल्गु mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) Productive, profitable. E. अ neg. फल्गु worthless.
2393: अफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Unblown. E. अ neg. फुल्ल flowered.
2394: अफेन n. (-नं) Opium. mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Frothless, without scum or foam. E. अ dim. and फेन froth; the word in the first sense is, no doubt, of modern date and foreign introduction.
2395: अब r. 1st cl. with an indicatory इ, अबि (अंबते) To sound.
2396: अबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Unmeaning or nonsensical discourse. 2 Unbound, at liberty. E. अ neg. and बद्ध bound, connected.
2397: अबद्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the preceding. E. as before, वुन् being added, which leaves क.
2398: अबद्धमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Foulmouthed, scurrilous. E. अबद्ध unbound, and मुख the mouth.
2399: अबध m. (-धः) Not killing. f. (धा) The segment of the base of a triangle. E. अ neg. वध what kills.
2400: अबध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Unmeaning or nonsensical, (as discourse.) 2 Sacred, not to be put to death. E. अ neg. बन्ध to bind, or बध to kill, and यत् aff.
2401: अबध्यभाव m. (-वः) Immunity, sacredness of character, as that of an embassador. E. अबध्य, and भाव quality.
2402: अबन्धुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unlovely, displeasing. E. अ neg. बन्धुर handsome.
2403: अबन्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या-न्ध्यं) Fruitful, productive, not barren. E. अ neg. and बन्ध्य bound, barren.
2404: अबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Weak, feeble, infirm. m. (-लः) A plant, (Tapia cratoeva.) see बरुण. f. (-ला) A woman. E. अ neg. and वल strong.
2405: अबाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Unobstructed, unrestrained. 2 Free from pain. f. (-धा) 1 Segment of the base of a triangle. 2 Indistinctness, perplexity. E. अ neg. and बाध to oppose, अच् aff.
2406: अबाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Not obstructing or opposing. E. अ neg. बाधक what opposes.
2407: अबाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Improper to be pained or opposed. E. अ neg. बाध to oppose, यत् part. affix, also with अनीयर् and तव्य, अबाधनीय and अबाधितव्य.
2408: अबान्धव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Having no relation or kindred, lone, unacknowledged, unowned. E. अ neg. बन्धु kindred, अण् aff.
2409: अबुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Ignorance. mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Ignorant, stupid. E. अ neg. बुद्धि understanding.
2410: अबुद्धिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Unwise, ignorant, foolish. E. अ neg. बुद्धिमत् wise.
2411: अबुध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Stupid, foolish. a fool. E. अ neg. बुध wise.
2412: अबोध m. (-धः) Ignorance, stupidity. mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Ignorant, stupid. 2 Puzzled, perplexed. E. अ neg. बोध knowledge.
2413: अबोधगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Incomprehensible. E. अ neg. बोध knowledge, गम्य to be attained by.
2414: अबोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Unintelligible. 2 Not to be awakened or aroused. E. अ neg. बोधनीय to be understood, &c. also अबोधितव्य and अबोध्य.
2415: अब्ज m. (-ब्जः) 1 The moon. 2 A kind of tree, (Barringtonia acutangula.) 3 The physician of the gods. See धन्वन्तरि. mn. (-ब्जः-ब्जं) A conch. n. (-ब्जं) 1 A lotus. 2 A large number, a million of millions. E. अव् for अप् water, and ज who is born; from the situation of the things named, or their production at the churning of the ocean.
2416: अब्जज m. (-जः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. अब्ज a lotus, and ज born; BRAHMĀ, being said to have sprung at the creation from the lotus, which arose from the navel of VIṢṆU.
2417: अब्जनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having fine eyes. E. अब्ज, and नयन the eye.
2418: अब्जनेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Having fine eyes. E. अब्ज and नेत्र eye.
2419: अब्जदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Lotus-eyed, having large fine eyes. E. अब्ज, and दृश् eye.
2420: अब्जभोग m. (-गः) The root of a lotus. E. अब्ज, and भोग enjoyment.
2421: अब्जयोनि m. (-निः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. अब्ज, and योनि the vulva; see अब्जज.
2422: अब्जवाहन m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA. E. अब्ज the moon, and वाहन a vehicle: carrying or wearing the moon on his forehead.
2423: अब्जहस्त m. (-स्तः) The sun. E. अब्ज a lotus, and हस्त a hand: SŪRYA is represented holding this flower in one hand.
2424: अब्जिनी f. (-नी) A multitude of lotus flowers. E. अब्ज and इनि aff.
2425: अब्जिनीपति m. (-तिः) The sun. E. अब्जिनी, and पति a lord.
2426: अब्द m. (-ब्दः) 1 A cloud. 2 A year. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 4 The name of a mountain. E. अप् water, प changed to ब, and द what gives; or अब to preserve, &c. and दन् Uṇādi affix; hence the word is also written अब्द.
2427: अब्दशत n. (-तं) A century. E. अब्द, and शत a hundred.
2428: अब्दसहस n. (-स्रं) A thousand years. E. अब्द, सहस a thousand.
2429: अब्दार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) A half year. E. अब्द, and अर्द्ध half.
2430: अब्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Annual, yearly. E. अब्द and ठन् aff.
2431: अब्दुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A fortress surrounded by a moat or lake. E. अप् water, and दुर्ग fort.
2432: अब्धि m. (-ब्धिः) The ocean. E. अब् substituted for अप् water; धि from धा to have, and कि aff.
2433: अब्धिकफ m. (-फः) Cuttle fish bone. E. अब्धि, and कफ phlegm; being considered as the froth of the sea.
2434: अब्धिज m. du. (-जौ) The two sons of SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga. f. (-जा) Wine. E. अब्धि, and ज born: the former are more usually termed the sons of AŚVINI, see आश्विनेय.
2435: अब्धिद्वीपा f. (-पा) The earth. E. अब्धि, and द्वीप in the fem. form; an island surrounded by the ocean.
2436: अब्धिनगरी f. (-री) A name of Dvārakā, the capital of KṚṢṆA, see द्वारका. E. अब्धि, and नगरी a city: the ocean-city.
2437: अब्धिनवनीतक m. (-कः) The moon. E. अब्धि, नवनीत fresh butter, and क affix; produced by churning the ocean.
2438: अब्धिमण्डूकी f. (-की) A pearl oyster. E. अब्धि the ocean, and मण्डूकी a female frog.
2439: अब्धिशयन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. अब्धि, and शयन sleeping; sleeping on the ocean at the periods of the destruction and renovation of the world, having the serpent ANANTA for his couch.
2440: अब्ध्यग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Submarine fire. E. अब्धि, and अग्नि fire. see और्व्वस्.
2441: अब्भक्ष m. (-क्षः) A snake. E. अब for अप् water, and भक्ष to eat: living upon water.
2442: अब्भ्र m. (-ब्भ्रः) The ocean. see अभ्र.
2443: अब्भ्रि n. (-ब्भ्रिः) 1 A baling vessel. 2 An iron hoe. 3 A stick tipped or shod with iron. see अभ्रि.
2444: अब्रह्मचर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Incontinence. 2 Coition. E. अ neg. and ब्रह्मचर्य्य the duty of the religious student, i. e. chastity; also with कन् added अब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं.)
2445: अब्रह्मण्य n. (-ण्यं) Sacred, not to be killed, (in theatrical language.) E. अ not, ब्रह्मण्य proper for a Brahman, i. e. death; also अब्राह्मण्य.
2446: अभ r. 1st cl. with an indicatory इ, अभि (अंभते) To sound, (not generally admitted.)
2447: अभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Not believing, not attached to. E. अ neg. भक्त attached.
2448: अभक्तच्छन्द m. (न्दः) Want of appetite. E. अ neg. भक्त food, छन्द inclination.
2449: अभक्तरुच् f. (-रुक्) Want of appetite. E. अ neg. भक्त food, रुच् inclination.
2450: अभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Incredulity, unbelief, want of devotion to. E. अ neg. भक्ति faith.
2451: अभक्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Unbelieving, undevoted to. E. अ neg. भक्तिमत् believing.
2452: अभक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Abstaining from, not eating any thing. 2 Fasting. E. अ neg. भक्षण eating.
2453: अभक्ष्य mfn. (क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Not to be eaten. E. अ neg. भक्ष्य to be eaten.
2454: अभक्ष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Unfitness as food. E. अभक्ष्य and त्व affix; also अभक्ष्यता.
2455: अभग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Entire, unbroken. 2 Uninterrupted. E. अ neg. भग्न broken.
2456: अभङ्गुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Unbroken, entire. 2 Undisturbed, uninterrupted. E. अ neg. भङ्गुर what breaks.
2457: अभय n. (-यं) 1 Absence or removal of fear. 2 The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) f. (-या) Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia citrina.) mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearless, undaunted. E. अ neg. and भय fear; the plant removing the dread of disease.
2458: अभयडिण्डिम m. (-मः) A war-drum. E. अभय, and डिण्डिम a drum: inspiring courage.
2459: अभयद m. (-दः) A protector, a defender. mfn. (दः-दा-दं) Removing fear or danger. E. अभय fearlessness, द who gives; also with प्र prefix अभयप्रद.
2460: अभयदक्षिणा f. (णा) Promise or present of protection from danger E. अभय, and दक्षिणा a gift to a Brahman, which, in this case he may receive from even a Śūdra.
2461: अभयदान n. (-नं) Assurance of safety or protection. E. अभय and दान gift.
2462: अभयप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who grants safety. E. अभय fearlessness, प्रद who gives.
2463: अभयप्रदान n. (-नं) Assurance of safety, protection. E. अभय, and प्रदान giving.
2464: अभयवाच् f. (-वाक्) Assurance of safety, encouragement. E. अभय, and वाच् speech.
2465: अभव m. (वः) 1 End of the world, liberation from the world. 2 Non-existence. mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Non-existent. E. अ neg. भव being.
2466: अभवितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is not to be, what will not be. E. अ neg. भवितव्य to be.
2467: अभवितव्यता f. (-ता) Fate, predestined non-occurrence. E. अ neg. भवितव्य what is to be, तल् affix; also अभवितव्यत्वं.
2468: अभव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Not to be, not predestined. 2 Improper, what ought not to be. E. अ neg. भव्य what is to be, also अभवनीय, &c.
2469: अभाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Not sharing or dividing. E. अ neg. भाग a share.
2470: अभाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Unfortunate, wretched. E. अ neg. भाग्य fortunate. So अभाग्यवत् (-वान्-वती-वत्)
2471: अभाव m. (-वः) 1 Non-existence, annihilation. 2 Death. 3 (In logic) Negation of two kinds, संसर्गाभाव universal negation, and अन्योन्याभाव relative or mutual negation. 4 (In rhetoric) Absence of the essential parts of poetical description of character, want of the properties or temperaments. E. अ priv. भाव being.
2472: अभावना f. (-ना) 1 Absence of judgment or right perception. 2 Absence of religious meditation or contemplation. E. अ neg. भावना perceiving.
2473: अभावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be contemplated or inferred, uninferrible, inconceivable, unintelligible. E. अ neg. भावनीय to be perceived.
2474: अभाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 What is not to be, what will not be. 2 Void of temperament or natural disposition. E. अ neg. भाविन् future, or having disposition.
2475: अभाषण n. (-णं) Silence. E. अ neg. and भाषण speaking.
2476: अभि ind. A preposition and particle implying, 1 Superiority in place, rank, or power, (over, upon, against, above:) 2 Proximity, (near:) 3 Separation, (severally:) 4 Wish, desire: 5 Conjunction, particularizing, (to, with respect to.) Thus अभिक्रमितुं to overpower; अभिगन्तुं to approach; अभिख्यातुं to speak to; अभिभव disgrace; अभिलाष desire; अभ्यग्निं on the fire, &c. E. अ neg. भा to shine, and कि aff.
2477: अभिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Lustful, libidinous. E. अभि, and क from कम to desire.
2478: अभिकाङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्गा) Wish, desire. E. अभि, and काङ्क्षा desire.
2479: अभिकाङ्क्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. E. अभि and काङ्क्षित.
2480: अभिकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि) Wishing, desirous. E. अभि, and काङ्क्षिन् who wishes.
2481: अभिक्रम m. (-मः) Assault, attack, invasion. 2 Mounting, ascending. E. अभि before or beyond, क्रम to go, and घञ् affix; see अतिक्रम.
2482: अभिख्या f. (-ख्या) 1 A name or appellation. 2 Calling, addressing. 3 Beauty. 4 Fame, glory. E. अभि, ख्या to speak, अङ् affix, and टाप् fem. aff.
2483: अभिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Approached. E. अभि near to, गत gone.
2484: अभिगम m. (-मः) Approach, proximity. E. अभि to, गम going.
2485: अभिगमन n. (-नं) Approaching, going near to. E. अभि, and गमन going.
2486: अभिगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Approaching. E. अभि, and गामिन् who goes.
2487: अभिग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Overcome, subdued. E. अभि, and ग्रस्त seized.
2488: अभिग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Attack, onset. 2 Challenge, going to fight. 3 Plundering, robbing. 4 Celebrity. E. अभि before, in presence of, ग्रह to take, and अप् aff.
2489: अभिग्रहण n. (-णं) Robbing, seizing any thing in presence of the owner. E. अभि before ग्रह to take, and ल्युट् aff.
2490: अभिघर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 Possession by an evil spirit. E. अभि before घृष to pound, ल्युट् aff.
2491: अभिघात m. (-तः) 1 Striking, wounding, beating. 2 Touching, contact. 3 Pain, infliction, torture. 4 Remedy, removal. n. (-तं) The combination of the fourth letter of any class with any of the other three preceding it. E. अभि before हन to strike, affix घञ्.
2492: अभिघातिन् m. (-ती) An enemy. mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Hostile, an assailant. 2 Inflicting injury. 3 Remedial. E. अभि before हन to strike or kill, and णिनि aff.
2493: अभिघार m. (-रः) Ghee or clarified butter. E. अभि, घृ to scatter, घञ् aff.
2494: अभिचर m. (-रः) A servant. E. अभि after, and चर who goes.
2495: अभिचार m. (-रः) Magic for a malevolent purpose, the spells and diagrams of the Atharva Veda and some of the Tantras, supposed to produce mental aberration, love, hatred, loss of feeling or paralysis, and death. E. अभि before चर to go, and घञ् aff.
2496: अभिचारमन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A formula or prayer for working a charm, an incantation. E. अभिचार, and मन्त्र a formula.
2497: अभिचारिक m. (-कः-की-कं) Magical, magician, relating to spells or magic. E. अभिचार and ठक् aff.
2498: अभिचारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inchanted, charmed. E. अभिचार and क्त aff.
2499: अभिचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Magical, done by magic. 2 Magician or one employing spells, a conjuror, a witch, &c. E. अभिचार, and इनि aff.
2500: अभिचैद्य m. (-द्यः) A name of ŚIŚUPĀLA. E. अभि over, चैद्य the people of Cedi.
2501: अभिजन m. (-नः) 1 Family, race. 2 Native country. 3 The head or ornament of a family. 4 Fame, notoriety. E. अभि before जन who is born, from जन to be born, घञ् affix, the vowel remaining short.
2502: अभिजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Noble, well born. 2 Wise, learned. 3 Fit, proper. 4 Handsome. 5 Respectable. E. अभि before जात produced.
2503: अभिजित् f. (-जित्) 1 One of the Nakṣatras or lunar asterisms. 2 The eighth muhūrtta or hour. 2 An expiatory sacrifice. E. अभि, and जित् what conquers.
2504: अभिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Skilful, clever. 2 One who knows or understands. E. अभि, and ज्ञ who knows, from ज्ञा to know, क affix leaving अ; आ is dropped.
2505: अभिज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Detected, discovered. E. अभि, and ज्ञात known.
2506: अभिज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 A mark, a spot or stain. 2 A sign, a token. 3 Ascertaining, knowledge. E. अभि before ज्ञा to know, and ल्युट् aff.
2507: अभितप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Scorched, burnt. 2 Afflicted. E. अभि, and तप्त burnt.
2508: अभितस् ind. 1 Quickly. 2 Entirely. 3 Before, in presence of. 4 On both sides. 5 Near. E. अभि and तसिल् aff.
2509: अभिताप m. (-पः) 1 Extreme heat. 2 Agitation, affliction, emotion. E. अभि, and ताप heat.
2510: अभिद्रोह m. (-हः) 1 Oppression, cruelty. 2 Abuse. E. अभि, and द्रोह violence.
2511: अभिधा f. (-धा) 1 A name, an appellation. 2 (In logic,) the power or sense of a word. 3 The chief or common acceptation of a word. E. अभि before धा to have, क affix and टाप् fem.: what any thing is obtained by.
2512: अभिधान n. (-नं) 1 A name, an appellation. 2 Speaking, speech. 3 A vocabulary, a dictionary. E. as before, ल्युट् aff.
2513: अभिधायिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Denominative, relating to. E. अभिधायिन् with कन् added.
2514: अभिधायिन् mfn. (-यौ-यिनी-यि) Denominative, appellative. E. अभि before धा to have, णिनि aff.
2515: अभिधावन n. (-नं) Pursuit, chase. E. अभि, and धावन running.
2516: अभिधित्सा f. (-त्सा) Direction, injunction. 2 Desire, wish. E. अभि before धा to have, desiderative form, क and टाप् affs.
2517: अभिधेय n. (-यं) 1 A name or appellation. 2 A significant word. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be named or mentioned. E. अभि before धा, and यत् aff.
2518: अभिधेयरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unmeaning, nonsensical, having no sense nor meaning. E. अभिधेय, and रहित void of.
2519: अभिध्या f. (-ध्या) 1 Coveting another's property. 2 Desire, longing for in general. E. अभि, ध्ये to think, and अङ् aff.
2520: अभिध्यान n. (नं) 1 Coveting, desiring, longing for. 2 Meditation, profound thought. E. अभि before ध्यै to think of, ल्युट् affix, or ध्यान contemplation.
2521: अभिनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound, tied round, fastened on or upon. E. अभि over, नद्ध tied.
2522: अभिनन्दन m. (-नः) The fourth Jaina Tīrthakara or deified saint. n. (-नं) Delighting, rejoicing. E. अभि before नदि to please, ल्युट् aff.
2523: अभिनन्दा f. (-न्दा) Wish, expectation. E. अभि and नदि to please, affix अच् and टाप्.
2524: अभिनन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, made happy. E. अभि, and नन्दित pleased.
2525: अभिनय m. (-यः) 1 Indication of a passion or purpose by look, gesture, &c. 2 Acting, dramatic personification. 3 Ornament, decoration. 4 Civility, kindness. E. अभि, णीञ् to guide, and अच् aff.
2526: अभिनव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 New. 2 Young. E. अभि before नव new.
2527: अभिनवोद्भिद् m. (-द् or -त्) A germin, a new bud. E. अभिनव new, and उद्भिद् produced.
2528: अभिनिर्म्मुक्त m. (-क्तः) One asleep at sun-set. mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Left, quitted. E. अभि always, निर्म्मुक्त released.
2529: अभिनिर्याण n. (-णं) Invasion, march of an assailant, or march in general. E. अभि, and निर् prefixed to या to go, and ल्युट् aff.
2530: अभिनिर्वृत्ति (-त्तिः) Accession of disease. E. अभि, and निर्वृत्ति inaction.
2531: अभिनिविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Conversant or familiar with, studied in. 2 Attentive, engrossed. E. अभि, and निविष्ट entered.
2532: अभिनिवेश m. (-शः) 1 Intentness, application, perseverance, determination to effect a purpose, or attain an object. 2 Tenacity. 3 Study. 4 Ignorant fear causing death. E. अभि and नि before विश to enter, घञ् aff.
2533: अभिनिष्क्रमण n. (-णं) Going forth or out, issuing, exit. E. अभि and निर् before क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.
2534: अभिनिष्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Gone out or forth. E. अभि, and निष्क्रान्त gone out.
2535: अभिनिष्पतन n. (-नं) Sallying, issuing, going forth. E. अभि before निष्पतन going out.
2536: अभिनिष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) End, termination. E. अभि, and निष्पत्ति discontinuance.
2537: अभिनिष्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Finished, completed. E. अभि, and निष्पन्न done.
2538: अभिनिष्ठान m. (-नः) 1 The soft aspirate. 2 A letter of the alphabet. E. अभि and नि before ष्ठा to stay or stand, affix ल्युट्.
2539: अभिनीत mfn. (तः-ता-तं) 1 Fit, proper. 2 Friendly, kind. 3 Highly finished, or ornamented. 4 Patient. 5 Impatient. 6 Passionate. E. अभि and णीञ् to guide or obtain, क्त aff.
2540: अभिनीति f. (-तिः) 1 Friendship, civility, kindness. 2 Gesture, expressive gesticulation. E. अभि, and नीति conduct.
2541: अभिनेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be represented dramatically. E. अभि before नी to guide, यत् aff.
2542: अभिनेतृ mf. (ता-त्री-) An actor, an actress. E. अभि before नी to guide, तृच् aff.
2543: अभिन्न mfn. (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Same, identical. 2 One, undivided. 3 Unchanged, unaltered. 4 Uncut, unbroken. m. (-न्नः) An integer, a whole number. E. अ neg. भिन्न other.
2544: अभिन्नता f. (-ता) Identity, wholeness. E. तल् added to the last, or with त्व, अभिन्नत्वं.
2545: अभिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Guilty. 2 Unfortunate, calamitous. 3 Subdued. 4 Flown, fugitive. 5 Seeking refuge. E. अभि before पद to go, in the part. past.
2546: अभिप्रणय m. (-यः) 1 Propitiation. 2 Affection, favour. E. अभि and प्र before णी, affix अच्.
2547: अभिप्रणीत mfn. (तः-ता-तं) 1 Invoked, propitiated. 2 Consecrated. 3 Brought, attracted. E. अभि and प्र before णी to conduct, क्त aff.
2548: अभिप्राय m. (-यः) 1 Meaning, intention, wish, purpose. 2 Meaning, a sentence, sense. 3 The main purport of a book. E. अभि, and प्रिञ् to satisfy, घञ् aff.
2549: अभिप्रेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Meant, intended. 2 Wished. 3 Wishing, desirous, ambitious of, pretending to. E. अभि, and प्र before इण to go, क्त aff.
2550: अभिप्रेत्य ind. Intending, meaning. E. अभि and प्र before इण to go, क्यप् aff.
2551: अभिप्रोक्षण n. (-णं) Sprinkling, affusion. E. अभि and प्रोक्षण sprinkling.
2552: अभिप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Overflowed, overrun, filled with. 2 Attacked or affected by, labouring under. E. अभि before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
2553: अभिभव m. (-वः) 1 Defeat, subjugation. 2 Humiliation, disgrace. E. अभि implying inferiority, and भव being; from भू to be, and अप् aff.
2554: अभिभवन n. (-नं) 1 Overpowering, overcoming. 2 Being overpowered. E. अभि, भू to be, ल्युट् aff.
2555: अभिभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Humbled, surpassed, defeated, subdued. 2 Ignorant. 3 Overcome with feelings or wants, with passion, with hunger, &c. 4 Injured, aggrieved. E. अभि, and भूत been, being; part. past.
2556: अभिभूति f. (-तिः) Disrespect, disgrace, humiliation. E. अभि before भू to be, and क्तिन् fem. aff.
2557: अभिमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Agreed, accepted. 3 Admitted, assented to. E. अभि over, मत thought.
2558: अभिमतता f. (-ता) 1 Desire, love. 2 Agreeableness, desirableness. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, अभिमतत्वं.
2559: अभिमन्त्रण n. (-णं) 1 Calling to, addressing, inviting. 2 Counselling. 3 Consecrating any thing by a special formula. E. अभि in presence, मन्त्र to speak, and ल्युट् aff.
2560: अभिमन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Charmed, consecrated, had a certain formula pronounced over it. E. अभि, मन्त्र to charm, affix क्त.
2561: अभिमन्तृ m. (-न्ता) 1 A counsellor, a monitor. 2 Conscience. mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Who or what admonishes or advises. E. अभि, and मन to mind, तृच् aff.
2562: अभिमन्थ m. (-न्थः) Ophthalmia, disease of the eyes. E. अभि, and मन्थ to agitate, घञ् affix; also read अधिमन्थः.
2563: अभिमन्यु m. (-न्युः) The son of ARJUNA by SUBHADRĀ. E. अभि, and मन wrath.
2564: अभिमर m. (-रः) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 War, combat. 3 Binding, confinement. 4 Treachery, danger from one's own party or friends. E. अभि before मर from मृ to die, and अप् aff.
2565: अभिमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 Devastation of a country, &c. by an enemy. 3 War, battle. E. अभि, and मृद् to tread down, अच् aff.
2566: अभिमर्शन n. (-नं) Touching, rubbing. E. अभि before मृश to rub, with ल्युट् aff.
2567: अभिमर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Sprinkling upon or over. 2 Licking the lips as an indication of guilt or prevarication. E. अभि, and मृष to sprinkle, ल्युट् aff.
2568: अभिमाति m. (-तिः) An enemy. E. अभि against, and सा to measure, क्तिन् aff.
2569: अभिमान m. (-नः) 1 Pride, haughtiness. 2 Knowledge. 3 Affection. 4 Injury, hurting, killing. 5 Requesting. E. अभि, and मन to know, with घञ् affix, or मी to injure, and ल्युट्.
2570: अभिमानता f. (-ता) Pride, arrogance. E. तल् added to the last: also अभिमानत्वं.
2571: अभिमानवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Proud, arrogant. f. (-ती) Pride. E. मतुप् poss. affix; added to अभिमान.
2572: अभिमानित n. (-तं) Copulation. E. अभि, and मन to know, in the causal form, and क्त aff. f. (-ता) Pride, arrogance. E. अभिमानिन्, and तल् aff.
2573: अभिमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Proud, arrogant. E. अभिमान and इनि aff.
2574: अभिमाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Subdued, reduced, broken or worn down. 2 Stupid, ignorant. E. अभि before माया ignorance, illusion.
2575: अभिमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) Present. 2 Near to, in front of. n. adv. (-खं) In front or presence of. E. अभि before, and मुख the face.
2576: अभिमुखता f. (-ता) Presence, proximity. E. अभिमुख, and तल् affix or with त्व, अभिमुखत्वं.
2577: अभिमृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Touched, rubbed, brought or passed close. E. अभि, and मृष्ट rubbed.
2578: अभियाति m. (-तिः) An enemy. E. अभि against, या to go, with अति affix, see अभियातिन्.
2579: अभियातिन् m. (-ती) An enemy. E. अभि against, यत् to strive, and णिनि affix, see अभिघातिन्.
2580: अभियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Attacked by an enemy, assaulted, assailed. 2 Diligent, intent. 3 Said, spoken. 4 Blamed, rebuked. 5 (In law) Charged, prosecuted, defendant. E. अभि, and युक्त joined.
2581: अभियुक्तता f. (-ता) 1 Diligence, application. 2 Accusation, prosecution. E. अभियुक्त and तल् affix; also with त्व, अभियुक्तत्वं.
2582: अभियोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Blamable, to be reproved or rebuked. 2 To be prevented or prohibited. 3 To be prosecuted, indictable. 4 To be pursued diligently. E. अभि before युज to join, तव्य aff.
2583: अभियोक्तृ m. (-क्ता) A plaintiff, an accuser. mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) One who assails another in any way. E. अभि before युज to join, तृच् aff.
2584: अभियोग m. (-गः) 1 Attack, assault. 2 Challenging to fight. 3 War, battle. 4 Energetic effort, exertion, perseverance. 5 Reprimand, reproof. 5 Prohibition, prevention. 7 Contact, conjunction. 8 (In law) A plaint, a charge, an accusation. E. अभि, युज to joint, and घञ् affix, ज being changed to ग.
2585: अभियोगिन् m. (-गी) A plaintiff, a prosecutor. mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) One who assails another in any way. E. अभियोग and इनि aff.
2586: अभिरक्षा f. (-क्षा) Universal protection, wide benevolence. E. अभि, and रक्षा preserving.
2587: अभिरक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Guarded, preserved, kept. E. अभि, and रक्षित preserved.
2588: अभिरक्षितृ m. (-ता) 1 A guardian. 2 A controller. mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what keeps or preserves. E. अभि, रक्षितृ who preserves.
2589: अभिरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased or contented with, satisfied. 2 Performing, practising, engaged in, attentive to. E. अभिरम to sport, क्त aff.
2590: अभिरति f. (-तिः) 1 Pleasure, delight. 2 Practice, occupation. E. अभि, and रति pleasure.
2591: अभिराद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Propitiated, (by penance, &c.) E. अभि, and राद्ध accomplished.
2592: अभिराम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Beautiful. E. अभि before रम to sport, and घञ् aff.
2593: अभिरामता f. (-ता) Beauty, splendour. E. तल् added to the last: also अभिरामत्वं.
2594: अभिरुचि f. (-चिः) 1 Ambition, desire of fame. 2 Desire in general. 3 Taste, relish. 4 Splendour. E. अभि, and रुचि light.
2595: अभिरूप m. (-पः) 1 A learned Brahman, a Paṇḍita. 2 A name of KĀMA. 3 Of the moon. 4 Of ŚIVA. 5 Also of VIṢṆU. mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 1 Learned. 2 Pleasing. 3 Handsome. E. अभि before रूप to have form, affix क.
2596: अभिलषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Desirable. E. अभि before लष to wish, अनीयर aff.
2597: अभिलषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Desired, wished. n. (-तं) Desire. E. अभि before लष with क्त part. aff.
2598: अभिलाप m. (-पः) 1 Speech, speaking. 2 Declaration of the object of a vow or religious obligation. E. अभि before लप to speak, घञ् aff.
2599: अभिलाव m. (-वः) 1 Reaping. 2 Cutting. E. अभि, and लूञ् to cut, aff. घञ्.
2600: अभिलाष m. (-षः) Wish, desire. E. अभि, and लष to like, घञ् aff; also अभिलास.
2601: अभिलाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing, desiring. E. अभिलाष and इनि aff.
2602: अभिलाषुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Covetous, greedy. 2 Desirous, wishing. E. अभिलष to desire, उकन् affix, and the antepen. lengthened.
2603: अभिलास m. (-सः) Wish, desire. E. See अभिलाष; the root being लष, or लस.
2604: अभिलिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inserted in writing. E. अभि, and लिखित written.
2605: अभिलेखन n. (-नं) Writing or inscribing. E. अभि, and लेखन writing.
2606: अभिवन्दन n. (-नं) Saluting respectfully. E. अभि before वदि to praise, affix युच्.
2607: अभिवाद m. (-दः) 1 Reverential salutation. 2 Opprobrious, or unfriendly speech, abuse. E. अभि against, or adverse, and वाद speech.
2608: अभिवादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Civil, polite. 2 Uncivil, abusive. E. अभि to, or against, वादक who speaks.
2609: अभिवादन n. (-नं) Respectful salutation, a bow or prostration; including sometimes the name or title of the person so addressed, and followed by the declaration of the person's own name. Salutation of a superior or elder, by a junior or inferior, and especially of the teacher by his disciple. In general it is merely lifting the joined hands to the forehead, and saying, अहममिवादये I salute. E. अभि in presence of, and वादन speaking.
2610: अभिवाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be saluted. E. अभि, and वाद्य to be addressed.
2611: अभिवाह्य n. (-ह्यं) 1 Presentation, offering. 2 Conveyance, transmission. E. अभि to, बाह्य to be borne.
2612: अभिविनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pious, pure, devout. E. अभि, and विनीत well-behaved.
2613: अभिव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Plain, distinct, evident, manifest. 2 Declared, revealed. E. अभि, and व्यक्त plain.
2614: अभिव्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Co-extending, pervading, omnipresence. E. अभि every where, and व्याप्ति spreading.
2615: अभिव्याहार m. (-रः) An articulate and significant word or phrase. E. अभि, and व्याहार speech.
2616: अभिशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Frightened, alarmed. E. अभि, and शङ्कित alarmed.
2617: अभिशपन n. (-नं) False accusation, calumny. See अभिशाप.
2618: अभिशप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Falsely accused, calumniated. 2 Cursed, accursed. E. अभि before शप with क्त aff.
2619: अभिशंसन n. (-नं) 1 Calumny, abuse, calumniating, abusing. E. अभि reverse, शंस to praise, affix; ल्युट् aff.
2620: अभिशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Calumniated, falsely accused. 2 Defamed, infamous. 3 Sinful, wicked. 4 Asked, wanted. E. अभि- implying opposition, शस to praise, and affix of the part. past क्त; the nasal being dropped.
2621: अभिशस्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Calumniating, a calumniator. E. अभिशस्त, and कृ to make, affix अच् or ट.
2622: अभिशस्ताङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A brand, a mark of infamy on a criminal. E. अभिशस्त infamous, अङ्क mark.
2623: अभिशस्ति f. (-स्तिः) 1 Calumny, scandal, defamation. 2 Asking, begging. E. अभि before शंस to praise or ask, and क्तिन् aff.
2624: अभिशब्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Declared, announced. E. अभि, and शब्दित sounded.
2625: अभिशाप m. (-पः) 1 False accusation, calumny. 2 Charge, accusation. 3 Suffering from anger or passion. 4 Curse, imprecation. E. अभि, and शप to curse or swear, affix घञ्; or with ल्युट् affix अधिशपन.
2626: अभिशापन n. (-नं) Pronouncing a curse or malediction. E. अभि with शप causal form, affix ल्युट्.
2627: अभिषङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Curse or imprecation. 2 An oath. 3 Defeat. 4 False accusation, calumny. 5 Association, company, connexion. 6 Embracing. 7 Possession by evil spirits. 8 Accession of passion. E. अभि against, along with, &c. षञ्ज to embrace, to unite, and घञ् aff.
2628: अभिषव m. (-वः) 1 Religious bathing, ablution preparatory to religious rites. 2 Sacrifice. 3 Bathing in general. 4 Drinking the juice of the acid Asclepias. 5 Ferment, yeast, any substance producing vinous fermentation. n. (-वं) Sour gruel. See काञ्जिका. E. अभि, and सु to mix, to stir, अप् affix; and स is changed to ल.
2629: अभिषवण n. (-णं) 1 Bathing, ablution. 2 Sacrificing, &c. See अभिषव. E. as before, ल्युट् aff.
2630: अभिषह्य ind. Insolently, violently, by force. E. अभि, षह to bear, यत् aff.
2631: अभिषिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Anointed, installed, inaugurated, enthroned. E. अभि before सिच् to sprinkle, क्त aff.
2632: अभिषुत n. (-तं) 1 Sour gruel. See काञ्जिका. 2 The juice of the acid Asclepias. E. अभि before सु to mix, affix क्त.
2633: अभिषेक m. (-कः) Bathing, sprinkling. E. अभि before सिच to sprinkle, and घञ् affix; the word is often used for initiation, royal unction, &c. sprinkling with the water of the Ganges, or water in which various articles have been immersed, being an essential part of the rites: also for a religious ceremony, including the presentation of a variety of articles, fruits, gems, &c. along with water or fluid substances, for the bathing of the deity to whom worship is offered.
2634: अभिषेकशाला f. (-ला) The hall of coronation. E. अभिषेक, and शाला a hall.
2635: अभिषेचन n. (-नं) 1 Initiation, inauguration. 2 Sprinkling. E. अभि before षिच् to sprinkle, affix ल्युट्.
2636: अभिषेणन n. (-नं) March to repel an enemy. E. अभि against, सेना an army, used as a verb, and ल्युट् aff.
2637: अभिष्टुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised. E. अभि before स्तु to praise, and क्त aff.
2638: अभिष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Great increase or enlargement. 2 Oozing or flowing. 3 Weakness of, or running at the eyes. E. अभि before स्यन्द to ooze or drop as a liquid, affix घञ्.
2639: अभिष्यन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) 1 Oozing, trickling. 2 Having weak eyes. 3 Causing defluxions or serous effusion. E. अभिष्यन्द and इनि aff.
2640: अभिष्यन्दिरमण n. (-णं) A suburb, a smaller city appended to a larger.
2641: अभिसंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attached to, interested, following any object eagerly. 2 Agreed, contracted. E. अभि, and सम् before धा to have, क्त aff.
2642: अभिसन्ताप m. (-पः) War, battle. E. अभि much, and सन्ताप pain, heat, &c.
2643: अभिसन्धान n. (-नं) 1 Cheating, deceiving. 2 Attachment or interest in any object. 3 Special agreement. 4 Making peace or alliance. E. अभि, and सम् before धा to have, affix ल्युट्.
2644: अभिसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) 1 Cheating, deceit. 2 Purpose, object. 3 Special agreement. 4 Making peace or alliance. 5 Joint junction. E. अभि, and सन्धि agreement, &c.
2645: अभिसम्पात m. (-तः) 1 War, battle. 2 Curse, imprecation. E. अभि before सम्पात going or falling; from पत to fall, with सं prefix, घञ् aff.
2646: अभिसर m. (-रः) A companion, a follower. E. अभि after or near, and सर who goes; from सृ to go, and अच् aff.
2647: अभिसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Relation, connexion. 2 Sexual connexion. 3 Contact, conjunction. E. अभि intensitive, सम्वन्ध connexion.
2648: अभिसर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Killing. See अतिसर्ज्जन.
2649: अभिसायम ind. About evening, at sunset. E. अभि towards, साव evening.
2650: अभिसार m. (-रः) 1 Strength. 2 War, battle. 3 A companion, a follower. 4 The instrument or agent. 5 An assignation, an appointment. E. अभि before सृ to go, affix घञ्.
2651: अभिसारण n. (-णं) 1 Coming to or near, visiting, attending, following. 2 Importuning, haunting. E. अभि, and सारण going.
2652: अभिसारिका f. (-का) A woman who makes or keeps an assignation. E. अभि before सृ to go, वुन affix which leaves क, and टाप् fem. do. also अभिसारिणी.
2653: अभिसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Going to or near to, visiting, attending. 2 Going to an appointment or assignation. E. अभि, and सारिन् who goes.
2654: अभिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Humbled, subdued, broken down. 2 Killed. E. अभि and हत part. past of हन to kill or hurt.
2655: अभिहार m. (-रः) 1 Robbing, seizing any thing in the owner's presence. 2 A brisk attack. 3 Arming, taking up arms. E. अभि before हृ to take, and घञ् aff.
2656: अभिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said, declared. E. अभि before धा to have, the part. affix क्त, and हि substituted for the root.
2657: अभिहितत्व n. (-त्वं) Text, authority, declaration. E. अभिहित said, त्व aff.
2658: अभीक m. (-कः) 1 A poet. 2 A husband. mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Lustful, libidinous. 2 Anxious, desirous. 3 Cruel. 4 Fearless. E. अभि before क, from कम to desire: the इ being made long irregularly.
2659: अभीक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) 1 Repeated, frequent. 2 Constant, perpetual. ind. (क्ष्णम्) 1 Repeatedly, again and again. 2 Perpetually, constantly. E. अभि before क्ष्णा to whet, डम् affix, and the इ of अभि made long.
2660: अभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fearless, undaunted. E. अ neg. भीत afraid.
2661: अभीति f. (-तिः) Fearlessness. E. अ neg. भीति fear.
2662: अभीप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. E. अभि, आप to obtain, in the desiderative form, and क्त affix, इट् inserted.
2663: अभीप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing, desirous. E. अभि before ईप्सु wishing.
2664: अभीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Causing no fear or terror, unterrific. So अभीषण and अभीष्म and अभैरव. E. अ neg. भीम fearful, &c.
2665: अभीमान n. (-नं) Pride. E. See अभिमान, the इ being made long.
2666: अभीर m. (-रः) A cowherd. E. अभि, and ईर to send, अच् affix; also अभीर.
2667: अभीरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Fearless, undaunted. m. (-रुः) A name of BHAIRAVA. f. (-रुः) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) See शतमूली. E. अ neg. भीरु timid: as applied to the plant, not fearful of breaking, from the number of its roots.
2668: अभीरुपत्री f. (-त्री) A plant. See the preceding.
2669: अभीलु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Fearless. E. अभीरु, र being changed to ल. Also अभीलुक.
2670: अभीशु m. (-शुः) 1 A ray of light. 2 A rein. f. (-शुः) A finger. E. अभि before अशू to pervade, उ affix, derivative irregular, See अभीषु.
2671: अभीषङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Curse, imprecation. See अभिषङ्ग. E. as before, the इ being here long.
2672: अभीषु m. (-षुः) 1 A ray of light. 2 A rein. 3 Love, lust. 4 Passion. E. अभि before इष to desire, and उ affix or अश to pervade, &c. whence, अभिशु.
2673: अभीषुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Splendid, brilliant. 2 Enamoured, amorous. E. अभीषु and मतुप् aff.
2674: अभीष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Wished, desired. f. (-ष्टा) A perfume. See रेणुका. E. अभि repeatedly, and इष्ट wished.
2675: अभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Uneaten. 2 Unenjoyed, unused, unexpended. 3 One who has not eaten. 4 One who has not enjoyed or possessed. E. अ neg. भुक्त eaten.
2676: अभुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Straight, not bent. 2 Well, free from disease. E. अ neg. भुग्न broken.
2677: अभुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Armless, maimed. E. अ neg. भुज the arm.
2678: अभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Non-existent, absent, what is not or has not been. E. अ neg. भूत been.
2679: अभूमि f. (-मिः) Want of place of refuge or support, destitution, privation. E. अ neg. भूमि site.
2680: अभूयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Few, scanty. E. अ neg. भूयिष्ठ many.
2681: अभूरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Few, some, several. E. अ neg. भूरि many.
2682: अभूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unadorned. E. अ neg. भूषित adorned.
2683: अभृशम् ind. A little, a few. E. अ neg. भृशम् much.
2684: अभेद m. (-दः) Identity, absence of difference or distinction. mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Alike, identical. E. अ neg. भेद distinction.
2685: अभेद्य n. (-द्यं) A diamond. mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Hard, solid, not to be broken or divided. 2 Not to be pierced, indivisible. 3 Impenetrable. E. अ neg. and भेद्य to be broken.
2686: अभेद्यता f. (-ता) 1 Indivisibility. 2 Impenetrability. 3 Inseparability. E. तल् added to the last, also with त्व, अभेद्यत्वं.
2687: अभोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Not to be used or enjoyed. 2 Not to be eaten. E. अ neg. भुज to eat, &c. तव्य aff.
2688: अभोक्तृ m. (-क्ता) An abstemious person. mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Not enjoying, not using. E. अ neg. भोक्तृ who enjoys.
2689: अभोग m. (-गः) Non-enjoyment, not making use of. E. अ neg. भोग enjoyment.
2690: अभोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Not to be used or enjoyed. E. अ neg. भोग्य to be used.
2691: अभोजन n. (-नं) Abstinence, fasting. E. अ neg. भोजन food.
2692: अभोजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Not to be eaten. 2 Not to be used. E. अ neg. भोजनीय to be eaten, &c.
2693: अभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Fasting. E. अ neg. भोजिन् who eats.
2694: अभोज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Impure, prohibited as food, not to be eaten. E. अ neg. भोज्य to be eaten, &c.
2695: अभ्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Oiled, anointed. E. अभि, and अञ्ज to anoint, affix क्त.
