2696: अभ्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Rubbing the body with unctuous substances; smearing the body with oil, inunction. 2 Unguent, liniment, oily application. 3 Applying collyrium to the eyes. 4 Sediment of oil, cake. E. अभि, and अञ्ज to anoint, घञ् aff.
2697: अभ्यञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Oil. 2 Smearing the body with oil, inunction; see the preceding. 3 Applying collyrium to the eyelashes, decorating the hair, &c. or any personal embellishment. E. अभि, अञ्ज to anoint, and ल्युट् aff.
2698: अभ्यधिक mfn. (-कः-का-क्रं) Exceeding, surpassing (in number, power, or kind, &c.) E. अभि, and अधिक more.
2699: अभ्यधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dependant. E. अभि, and अधीन dependant.
2700: अभ्यनुज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) 1 Order, command. 2 Assent, permission. Also अभ्यनुज्ञानं E. अभि, and अनुज्ञा order.
2701: अभ्यन्तर n. (-रं) 1 Included space. 2 Inner part, middle. E. अभि and अन्तर within.
2702: अभ्यन्तरायाम m. (-मः) Curvature of the spine by spasm; emprosthotonos. E. अभ्यन्तर middle, and आयाम length.
2703: अभ्यनुज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ordered. 2 Permitted. E. अभि and अनु before ज्ञा to know, क्त aff.
2704: अभ्यमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sick, diseased. E. अभि, अम to be sick, part. affix क्त.
2705: अभ्यमित्रीण m. (-नः) A soldier who faces the enemy valiantly. E. अभि before, or against, अमित्र an enemy, and ख affix; the affix being छ or यत्, the word is also written अभ्यमित्रीय or अभ्यमित्र्य.
2706: अभ्यर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worship, reverence. E. अभि before अर्च्च to worship, affix ल्यट्.
2707: अभ्यर्च्चा f. (-र्च्चा) Respect, worship. E. अभि, and अर्च्च reverence.
2708: अभ्यर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Near, proximate. E. अभि near, and अर्ण irr. part. past, of अर्द to go.
2709: अभ्यर्थना f. (-ना) Petition, request. E. अभि before अर्थ to ask, युच् aff.
2710: अभ्यर्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asked, invited. E. अभि, and अर्थित asked.
2711: अभ्यर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fit, proper, becoming. E. अभि, and अर्हित proper.
2712: अभ्यवकर्षण n. (-णं) Extraction, drawing out. E. अभि, and अव prefixed to कृष to draw furrows, affix ल्युट्
2713: अभ्यवस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Striking so as to disable an enemy. 2 Facing an enemy. E. अभि and अव before स्कन्द to go, affix घञ्; also with ल्युट् affix, अभ्यवस्कन्दनं.
2714: अभ्यवहरण n. (-णं) Eating. E. अभि and अव before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
2715: अभ्यवहार m. (-रः) Eating. E. अभि and अव before हृ to convey, घञ् aff.
2716: अभ्यवहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. अभि and अव before हृ to convey, and the part. affix क्त.
2717: अभ्यसन n. (-नं) Frequent repetition, use, exercise, especially of the memory, learning by rote. E. अभि frequently, अस to throw or send, ल्युट् aff.
2718: अभ्यसूय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Angry, vexed. f. (-या) Detraction. Also असूया. E. अभि before असूया envy.
2719: अभ्यसूयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Detracting, a detractor, a calumniator. E. अभि before असूय to envy or detract, वुन् aff.
2720: अभ्यस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be studied. Also अभ्यसनीयं. E. अभि before अस to throw, affix य or अनीयर.
2721: अभ्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Exercised, practised. 2 Learnt by heart. 3 Repeated as the radical syllable of a verb. E. अभि frequently, अस to throw or send, क्त aff.
2722: अभ्याकाङ्क्षित n. (-तं) A groundless complaint, a false accusation. E. अभि, and आकाङ्क्षित desired.
2723: अभ्याख्यान n. (-नं) A false accusation. E. अभि, and आख्यान saying.
2724: अभ्यागत m. (-तः) A guest, a visitor. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Arrived. E. अभि, and आगत come.
2725: अभ्यागम m. (-मः) 1 War, battle. 2 Striking, killing. 3 Enmity. 4 Vicinity. 5 Rising, getting up. 6 Coming, arrival, visit. E. अभि near, or before, &c. गम to go, with आ prefixed, and अच् affixed.
2726: अभ्यागमन n. (-नं) Arrival, visitation. E. अभि, and आगमन coming.
2727: अभ्यागारिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Diligent in supporting a family. E. अभि before आगार a house, ठक् aff.
2728: अभ्याघात m. (-तः) Assault, attack. E. अभि, and आघात assailing.
2729: अभ्यादान n. (-नं) 1 Beginning, commencement. 2 First beginning. E. अभि, and आदान taking.
2730: अभ्यान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Sick, diseased. E. अभि before अम to be sick, and the affix क्त.
2731: अभ्यापात m. (-तः) Calamity, misfortune. E. अभि and आङ् before पत to go, घञ् aff.
2732: अभ्यामर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) War, battle. E. अभि and आ before मृद to tread down, अच् aff.
2733: अभ्याश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Near, proximate. m. (-शः) Constant repetition. See अभ्यास.
2734: अभ्यास m. (-सः) 1 Practice, exercise. 2 Learning by rote. 3 Practising archery. 4 (In arithmetic,) Multiplication. 5 (In grammar,) The reduplicate syllable of a verb. mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Near, proximate. E. अभि before, अस to go, &c. घञ् aff.
2735: अभ्यासता f. (-ता) Constant practice, use, habit. E. अभ्यास and तल् affix, also with त्व, अभ्यासत्वं.
2736: अभ्यासयोग m. (-गः) The practice of frequent and repeated contemplation on any deity or abstract spirit, repeated recollection, &c. E. अभ्यास, and योग religious exercise.
2737: अभ्यासादन n. (-नं) 1 Striking so as to disable an enemy. 2 Facing an enemy. E. अभि and आङ् before सद to go, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
2738: अभ्यासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Practising, exercising, repeating. E. अभ्यास and इनि aff.
2739: अभ्याहार m. (-रः) 1 Robbery. See अभिहार. 2 Eating. E. अभि and आङ् before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
2740: अभ्याहार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An eatable. mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Eatable, to be eaten. E. अभि and आहार्य्य to be eaten.
2741: अभ्युक्षण n. (-णं) Sprinkling, wetting. E. अभि and उक्ष to moisten, ल्युट् aff.
2742: अभ्युक्ष्य ind. Having sprinkled. E. अभि, and उक्ष to moisten, ल्यप् aff.
2743: अभ्युत्थान n. (-नं) 1 Fame, reputation. 2 Rising from off a seat, &c. Rise. 3 Elevation. 4 Sun-rise. E. अभि and उत् before स्था to stay, ल्युट् aff.
2744: अभ्युत्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, arisen. 2 Elevated, exalted. E. अभि, and उत्थित lifted up.
2745: अभ्युदय m. (-यः) 1 Prosperity, increase. 2 Accident, occurrence. 3 A festival, any religious celebration. E. अभि, and उदय rise, prosperity.
2746: अभ्युदाहरण n. (-णं) An example or illustration of a thing by its reverse. E. अभि, and उदाहरण example.
2747: अभ्युदित m. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Asleep at sun-rise. 2 Celebrated as a festival. 3 Risen, (as the sun.) 4 Elevated, exalted. 5 Arisen, happened. E. अभि, उत् up, and इत gone; part. past, of इण to go.
2748: अभ्युदीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrown over or upon. E. अभि and उत् before ईरित gone.
2749: अभ्युद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought or given unsolicited. E. अभि towards, उद्यत exerted.
2750: अभ्युद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken up, delivered. E. अभि, and उद्धृत taken.
2751: अभ्युपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed, assented. 2 Gone near to, approached, arrived at. 3 Inferred, probable. 4 Similar, analogous. E. अभि, उप over, गत gone.
2752: अभ्युपगम m. (-मः) 1 A promise, an agreement, a contract. 2 Approaching, going near to. 3 Probable ascertainment. 4 Analogy, affinity. E. अभि and उप implying association or vicinity, and गम going.
2753: अभ्युपगमित m. (-तः) A slave for a fixed term. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Obtained by assent or free will. E. अभ्युपगम and इतच् aff.
2754: अभ्युपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Favour, affection. 2 Defence, protection. 3 Agreement, assent. 4 Impregnation of a woman, as of a brother's widow, as an act of duty. E. अभि and उप before पत to go, affix क्तिन्.
2755: अभ्युपपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Agreeing to. E. अभि and उप before पद to go, affix क्त.
2756: अभ्युपाय m. (-यः) 1 An agreement, a promise, an engagement. 2 A means, an expedient. E. अभि and उप before इण to go, अच् aff.
2757: अभ्युपायन n. (-नं) A bribe, an inducement. E. अभि and उप before इण to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
2758: अभ्युपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Contracted, promised, agreed. 2 Approached. E. अभि and उप before इण to go, क्त aff.
2759: अभ्युपेत्याशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) A head or title of law, disputes between master and servant. E. अभ्युपेत्य having engaged, अ neg. शुषूषा service.
2760: अभ्युष m. (-षः) 1 Grain, &c. half dressed, slightly scorched, or parched so as to be eaten from the hand. 2 Bread. E. अभि before, उष to burn, क affix; the vowel may be made also long, which gives अभ्यूष, or may be changed to ओ, and form अभ्योष; some consider the root to be ऊष, to be sick.
2761: अभ्युषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dwelling with. E. अभि before वस to dwell, क्त aff.
2762: अभ्युह m. (-हः) 1 Discussion, reasoning. 2 Supplying an ellipsis. E. अभि, and उह to reason, क aff.
2763: अभ्युह्य ind. 1 Having concluded or inferred, having reasoned. 2 Having supplied as an ellipsis. E. अभि, उह to reason, ल्यप् aff.
2767: अभ्रंलिह m. (-हः) Wind. mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Cloud-touching, cloud-sweeping. E. अभ्र a cloud, लिह to lick, खश aff.
2768: अभ्र n. (-भ्रं) 1 The sky or atmosphere. 2 A cloud. 3 Gold. 4 Talc. E. अभ्र to go, or अप् water, and भृ to have, क aff.
2769: अभ्रक n. (-कं) The mineral substance called talc. E. अभ्र the same, and कन् aff.
2770: अभ्रङ्कष m. (-षः) Air, wind. E. अभ्र the sky, कष to plough, and खच् aff.
2771: अभ्रपिशाच m. (-चः) A name of RĀHU, the descending node personified. E. अभ्र the sky, and पिशाच a goblin; from the mischief he does to the moon, as the cause of its eclipse.
2772: अभ्रपिशाचक m. (-कः) See the preceding. E. कन् added to the former.
2773: अभ्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A kind of tree or cane. See वेतस. E. अभ्र a cloud and पुष्प a flower; flowering in the cloudy or rainy season. n. (-ष्पं) Water. E. as before; put forth as a flower from the clouds.
2774: अभ्रम m. (-मः) Steadiness, composure. mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Steady, clear, not blundering. E. अ neg. भ्रम confusion.
2775: अभ्रमातङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) INDRA'S elephant. E. अभ्र a cloud, and मातङ्ग an elephant. The cloud-elephant, or that of the cloud-compelling king.
2776: अभ्रमाला f. (-ला) A line or succession of clouds. E. अभ्र, and माला a garland.
2777: अभ्रमु f. (-मुः) The female elephant of the east. E. अ neg. भ्रम to wander, and उ aff.
2778: अभ्रमुप्रिय m. (-यः) The male elephant of the east, also INDRA'S elephant. E. अभ्रमु, and प्रिय beloved.
2779: अभ्रमुवल्लभ m. (-भः) See the preceding. E. अभ्रमु, and वल्लभ beloved.
2780: अभ्ररोह n. (-हं) The lapis lazuli. E. अभ्र a cloud, रोह what mounts.
2781: अभ्रातृक mf. (-कः-का) Brotherless. E. अ neg. भ्रातृ a brother, कन aff.
2782: अभ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Clear, composed, unperplexed, not mistaken or in error. E. अ neg. भ्रान्त misled.
2783: अभ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Absence of perplexity or error. E. अ neg. भ्रान्ति error.
2784: अभ्रावकाश m. (-शः) Fall of rain. E. अभ्र cloud, अवकाश occasion.
2785: अभ्रावकाशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Exposed to the rain. E. अभावकाश and ठक् aff.
2786: अभ्रि f. (-भ्रिः) A wooden scraper or shovel for cleaning a boat. E. अभ्र to go, and इन् affix, also अभ्री.
2787: अभ्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to or produced from clouds. E. अभ्र a cloud, and इय affix, or technically घ.
2788: अभ्रेष m. (-षः) Fitness, propriety. E. अ neg. and भ्रेष impropriety.
2789: अभ्रोत्थ n. (-त्थं) INDRA'S thunder-bolt. E. अभ्र a cloud, उत् before स्था to stand, to rise up, क aff.
2790: अम r. 1st cl. (अमति) 1 To go, to go to or towards. 2 To serve or honour. 3 To sound. 10th cl. (अमयति) To afflict with sickness or pain from disease.
2791: अम ind. (-अम्) 1 Quickly. 2 Little. mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Unripe, (as fruit, &c.) m. (-मः) Sickness. E. अम to go or to be sick. अच् aff.
2792: अमङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Inauspicious, unlucky, evil. n. (-लं) Inauspiciousness, ill luck. m. (-लः) The castor oil plant. E. अ neg. and मङ्गल auspicious: the wood has no sap, and is useless.
2793: अमङ्गल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Inauspicious, unlucky, productive of evil. E. अ neg. मङ्गल्य auspicious.
2794: अमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis.) E. अ neg. मडि to adorn, and अच् aff.
2795: अमण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unadorned. E. अ neg. मण्डित adorned.
2796: अमत m. (-तः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Death. 3 Time. E. अम to be sick, and अतच् Uṇādi aff.
2797: अमति m. (-तिः) 1 Time. 2 The moon. 3 A cheat, a rogue. f. (-तिः) Unconsciousness, ignorance, absence of knowledge or intention. E. अम to go, and अति Uṇādi affix, or अ neg. मति understanding.
2798: अमतिपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Unconscious, unintentional. E. अमति ignorance, पूर्व्व before.
2799: अमत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Sober, not inebriated. 2 Sane, not mad. E. अ neg. मत्त crazy.
2800: अमत्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel, a utensil. E. अम to go, अत्रन् Uṇādi aff.
2801: अमत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unenvious, charitable. E. अ neg. मत्सर envious.
2802: अमनि f. (-निः) A road. E. अम to go, अनि Uṇādi aff.
2803: अमन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Not to be regarded, inadmissible, unknowable. Also अमननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं.) E. अ neg. मन्तव्य or मननीय to be regarded.
2804: अमनुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Unmanly. E. अ neg. मनुष्य a man.
2805: अमनुष्यन्ता f. (-ता) Unmanliness. E. तल् added to the last: also with त्व, अप्तनुष्यत्वं.
2806: अमनोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unthought of, unknown. E. अ neg. मनोगत thought of.
2807: अमनोज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Disagreeable, disliked. E. अ neg. मनोज्ञ agreeable.
2808: अमनोनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disapproved. 2 Reprobate. E. अ neg. मनस् the mind, नीत led.
2809: अमनोयोग m. (-गः) Inattention. E. अ neg. मनोयोग attention.
2810: अमनोयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Inattentive. E. अ neg. मनोयोगिन् attentive.
2811: अमनोहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Disagreeable, displeasing, unattractive. E. अ neg. मनोहर pleasant. So अमनोरम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) and अमनोहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि.)
2812: अमन्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं) Unentitled to, or unaccompanied by holy texts, as a Śūdra, a female, certain ceremonies, &c. E. अ neg. मन्त्र a text of the Vedas.
2813: अमन्त्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unentitled to, or unaccompanied by holy texts. E. अ neg. मन्त्र a text, कन् added.
2814: अमन्द m. (-न्दः) A tree. (E. अम sickness, and द from दो to cut, or destroy.) mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) 1 Fierce, violent. 2 Active. E. अ neg. मन्द tardy or dull.
2815: अमम m. (-मः) One of the Jaina saints of a future age. mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Devoid of all selfish or worldly attachment or desire. E. अ neg. and मम mine.
2816: अममता f. (-ता) Disinterestedness, indifference. E. अमम and तल् aff.
2817: अममत्व n. (-त्वं) Disinterestedness, philosophy, stoicism. E. अमम and त्व aff.
2818: अमर m. (-रः) 1 A deity, an immortal. 2 A plant, (Heliotropium indicum.) See अस्थिसंहार. 3 Also, (Euphorbia tirucalli, &c.) 4 Quicksilver. f. (-रा) 1 The residence of INDRA. 2 A house post. 3 The womb. 4 The umbilical cord. 5 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) See गुडूची. 6 Bent grass, (Agrostis linearis.) mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Immortal. E. अ neg. and मर what dies, from मृ and अच् aff.
2819: अमरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) What cannot die, immortal. E. अ neg. मरणीय perishable.
2820: अमरणीयता f. (-ता) Immortality. E. तल् added to the last; also अमरणीयत्वं.
2821: अमरता f. (-ता) Immortality. E. अमर and तल् aff.
2822: अमरत्व n. (-त्वं) Immortality. E. अमर and त्व aff.
2823: अमरदारु m. (-रुः) Name of a tree, (Pinus longifolius.) E. अमर, and दारु a tree.
2824: अमरद्विज m. (-जः) A Brahman who lives by attending a temple or idol. E. अमर a god, and द्विज a Brahman.
2825: अमरपति m. (-तिः) INDRA. E. अमर, and पति lord; also similar compounds, as अमराधिपतिः, अमरेशः, &c.
2826: अमरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. अमर, and पुष्प a flower; also with कन् added, अमरपुष्पकः.
2827: अमरपुष्पिका f. (-का) A kind of anise, (Anethum sowa.) E. अमर perpetual, and पुष्पिका having flowers.
2828: अमरभर्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) INDRA. E. अमर, and भर्तृ lord.
2829: अमरलोक n. (-कं) Heaven, the abode of the gods. E. अमर, and लोक world.
2830: अमरलोकता f. (-ता) Heaven. E. तल् added to अमरलोक.
2831: अमरस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) An Apsarā, or nymph of heaven. E. अमर, and स्त्री a female.
2832: अमराङ्गना f. (-ना) A nymph of INDRA'S heaven. E. अमर, and अङ्गना a female.
2833: अमराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) Mount Sumeru or Meru. E. अमर a deity, and अद्रि a mountain; being the residence of the gods.
2834: अमरापगा f. (-गा) The heavenly Ganges. E. अमर, and अपगा river.
2835: अमरावती f. (-ती) The capital of INDRA. E. अमर a deity, and मतुप् aff.
2836: अमरुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Calm, without wind. E. अ neg. मरुत wind.
2837: अमरेश m. (-शः) INDRA the king of the gods. E. अमर, and ईश lord.
2838: अमरेश्वर m. (-रः) INDRA. E. अमर, and ईश्वर chief.
2839: अमर्त्य m. (-र्त्यः) A deity. mfn. (-र्त्यः-र्त्या-र्त्यं) Immortal, divine. E. अ neg. मृ to die, क्यप् aff.
2840: अमर्त्यभुवन n. (-नं) The heaven of INDRA, or Svarga, a kind of Mohammedan paradise. E. अमर्त्य a deity, and भुवन a world.
2841: अमर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unthreshed, unsubdued, not trodden down. E. अ neg. मर्द्दित trampled on.
2842: अमर्य्यादा f. (-दा) 1 Impropriety of conduct. 2 Disrespect. E. अ neg. मर्य्यादा limit.
2843: अमर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Anger, passion. 2 Impatience, impetuosity. E. अ neg. मृष to bear with, घञ् aff.
2844: अमर्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Passionate, wrathful. E. as before, ल्युट् aff.
2845: अमर्षवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Hasty, impetuous, impatient. 2 Wrathful, passionate. E. अमर्ष and मतुप् aff.
2846: अमर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-षिणी-र्षि) 1 Passionate, wrathful. 2 Impetuous. E. अमर्ष and इनि aff.
2847: अमल n. (-लं) Talc. f. (-ला) 1 The goddess LAKṢMI. 2 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 3 The umbilical cord. mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Clean, pure. 2 White. E. अ neg. and मल dirt.
2848: अमलपतत्रिन् mf. (-त्री-त्रिणी) The wild goose. E. अमल white or grey, and पतत्रिन् a bird.
2849: अमलिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Clean, pure. E. अ neg. मलिन dirty.
2850: अमस m. (-सः) 1 Time. 2 Stupidity. 3 Disease. E. अम to go, or be sick, and अस Uṇādi aff.
2851: अमसृण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Harsh, hard. 2 Violent, intense. E. अ neg. मसृण soft.
2852: अमस्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Headless. E. अ neg. मस्तक the head.
2853: अमांस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Feeble, thin. E. अ neg. and मांस flesh. Also अमांसल.
2854: अमा ind. 1 With, together with. 2 Near. f. (-मा) Day of conjunction or new moon. E. अ neg. माङ् to measure, क्विप् affix, and टाप् fem. do.
2855: अमातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Motherless. E. अ neg. मातृ a mother, कन् added.
2856: अमात्य m. (-त्यः) A minister, a counsellor. E. अमा near, त्यप् aff.
2857: अमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) 1 Not whole or entire. 2 Not elementary. E. अ neg. मात्र whole, &c.
2858: अमात्रवत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) 1 Spirit, spiritual essence. 2 Deficiency, defect. E. अ neg. मात्रवत् like elementary, त्व added.
2859: अमानन n. (-नं) Disrespect. E. अ neg. मन to mind, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
2860: अमानव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Not human, animal. 2 Superhuman. E. अ neg. मानव mortal.
2861: अमानस्य n. (-स्यं) Pain. See आमनस्य. E. अ neg. मनस् the mind, and ण्यत् aff.
2862: अमानिता f. (-ता) Modesty, humility. E. तल् added to अमानिन्, also with त्व, अमानित्वं.
2863: अमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Humble, modest. E. अ neg. मान pride, इनि affix. Also अमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं.)
2864: अमानुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Not human, animal, superhuman. E. अ neg. मानुष human.
2865: अमानुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्यी-ष्यं) Superhuman. E. अ neg. मानुष्य human.
2866: अमान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) To be disrespected. E. अ neg. मान्य to be respected. Also अमाननीय and अमानितव्य.
2867: अमामसी f. (-सी) The day of new moon. E. अमा with, मस to measure, अच् affix, and ङीप् fem. do or with घञ् affix; अमामासी.
2868: अमावसी f. (-सी) Day of new moon. E. अमा with, and वस to abide, अच् affix; being with, or in the same quarter as the sun; also अमावासी.
2869: अमावास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Produced in the day of new moon. E. अमावास्या and अ aff.
2870: अमावास्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced on the day of new moon. E. अमावास्या and वुन् aff.
2871: अमावास्या f. (-स्या) Day of conjunction or new moon. E. अमा with, (the sun and moon,) वस to abide, ण्यत् affix: or with the penult. vowel short, अमावस्या; also अमावसी, &c.
2872: अमाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 True, wise. 2 Sincere, guileless, free from error or deceit. f. (-या) 1 Absence of delusion, knowledge of the truth. 2 Sincerity, honesty. E. अ neg. माया deceit, delusion.
2873: अमायिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) True, real, honest, void of trick or guile. E. अ neg. मायिक deceptive.
2874: अमायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यी) Acting without illusion or deceit. E. अ neg. मायिन् deceitful.
2875: अमार्ग m. (-र्गः) Want of a road. mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) Without a road. E. अ neg. मार्ग a road.
2876: अमार्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unsought, not hunted after. E. अ neg. मार्गित sought.
2877: अमार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uncleansed. 2 Unadorned. E. अ neg. मार्ज्जित cleaned.
2878: अमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unmeasured, boundless, infinite. 2 Neglected, unpolished, unclean. E. अ neg. मित measured.
2879: अमितौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Mighty, all-powerful, almighty. E. अमित boundless, ओजस् strength.
2880: अमित्र m. (-त्रः) An enemy, an adversary. mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Unfriendly, hostile. E. अम to go, and इत्र Uṇādi affix, or अ neg. and मित्र a friend.
2881: अमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Sick, diseased. E. अम sickness, इनि aff.
2882: अमिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Unmixed, unmixing. E. अ neg. मिश्र mixture.
2883: अमिश्रणीय mfn. (-यः-यां-यं) Immiscible. E. अ neg. मिश्रणीय to be mixed.
2884: अमिश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unmixed. E. अ neg. मिश्रित mixed.
2885: अमिष n. (-षं) 1 Luxury. 2 Honesty, simplicity. E. अम to be sick, इषन् Uṇādi aff.
2886: अमीमांसा f. (-सा) Absence of reasoning or investigation. E. अ neg. मीमांसा investigation by reason.
2888: अमुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A certain person or thing, any thing or person referred to without a name. E. अमु for अदस् this, and वज added.
2889: अमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Not loosed, not let go. 2 Not liberated from birth and death. n. (-क्तं) A weapon that is always grasped to be used, as a knife, &c. See मुक्तामुक्त, यन्त्रामुक्त, &c. E. अ neg. and मुक्त released.
2890: अमुक्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Sparing, frugal, prudent. E. अमुक्त not loosed, हस्त the hand.
2891: अमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Confinement, want of freedom or liberty. E. अ neg. मुक्ति liberation.
2892: अमुख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Inferior, ordinary. E. अ neg. मुख्य principal.
2893: अमुतस् ind. Hence, from this. E. अमु for अदस् and तसिल् aff.
2894: अमुत्र ind. In the next life. E. अमु from अदस् this or that, and त्रल् aff.
2895: अमुत्रत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Belonging to a future state, being of the next world. E. अमुत्र and त्य aff.
2896: अमुष्यपुत्र mf. (-त्रः-त्री) 1 Of a good family, of known origin. 2 The son or daughter of such a one. E. अमुष्य the irr. gen. of अदस् this, and पुत्र a son, &c.
2897: अमुष्यायण mf. (-णः-णा) 1 Of respectable birth, of known origin. 2 The offspring of such a one, of a certain person, &c. E. अमुष्य as in the last, and फक् affix, also आमुष्यायण.
2898: अमूदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Of such form or kind. E. अमू for अदस् this, and क्किप् affix; also अमूदृश and अमूदृक्ष.
2899: अमूदृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Of such a form or kind. E. see the last.
2900: अमूदृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Such, like, of such form or kind. E. see अमूदृश.
2901: अमूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Formless, shapeless, unembodied. E. अ neg. मूर्त्ति form; the final changed.
2902: अमूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Shapelessness, absence of shape or form. E. अ neg. मूर्त्ति form.
2903: अमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having no root. Also अमूलक f. (-ला) A plant. See अग्निशिखा. E. अ neg. and मूल a root.
2904: अमूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Invaluable, not to be purchased. E. अ neg. मूल्य price.
2905: अमृणाल n. (-लं) The root of a fragrant grass, used in India for taties or screens against the hot winds, commonly called Kas kas, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. अ like, as it were, and मृणाल a fibrous root; also मृणाल.
2906: अमृत n. (-तं) 1 The food of the gods, Ambrosia or Nectar. 2 Water. 3 Butter, rice, &c. the residue of a sacrifice. 4 Oiled butter or ghee. 5 Unsolicited alms. 6 Boiled rice. 7 Food. 8 Wealth, property. 9 Gold. 10 Buttermilk. 11 Any thing sweet, a sweetmeat. 12 Milk. 13 Poison. 14 A drug or medicament. 15 Quicksilver. 16 Final emancipation. m. (-तः) 1 A god, an immortal. 2 DHANVANTARI, the physician of the gods. f. (-ता) 1 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 2 The yellow sort, (Terminalia citrina.) 3 Another plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 4 Long pepper. 5 Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) 6 Spirituous liquor. It also occurs amongst the synonyms of several plants besides those enumerated. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Beloved, desired. 2 Beautiful. 3 Immortal, imperishable. E. अ neg. मृङ to die, and क्त affix; what is immortal, or what makes so; what supports life, &c.
2907: अमृतकुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A vessel of nectar. E. अमृत and कुण्ड a hole.
2908: अमृतता f. (-ता) Immortality. E. अमृत and तल् affix; also with त्व, अमृतत्वं.
2909: अमृततरङ्गिणी f. (-णी) Moonlight. E. अमृत, and तरङ्गिणी a sea.
2910: अमृतदीधिति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. अमृत ambrosia, and दीधिति a ray.
2911: अमृतद्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Shedding ambrosia. E. अमृत, and द्रव dropping.
2912: अमृतधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Shedding or distilling ambrosia. E. अमृत, and धारा a drop.
2913: अमृतप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Drinking ambrosia. m. (-पः) A deity. E. अमृत, and प who drinks.
2914: अमृतरस m. (-सः) Nectar, ambrosia. E. अमृत, and रस juice.
2915: अमृतवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A fall of ambrosia from heaven. E. अमृत, and वर्ष rain.
2916: अमृतवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A species of moonseed, (Menispermum glabrum.) See गुडूची. E. अमृत, and वल्ली a pedicle; the plant flourishing for a long time.
2917: अमृतसारज m. (-जः) Raw sugar, molasses. E. अमृत ambrosia, सार essence, and ज produced.
2918: अमृतसू m. (-सूः) The moon, as the producer of ambrosia. f. (-सूः) A Mātṛ or a divine mother. E. अमृत the ambrosia, and सू who brings forth; from सूड् to bear, and क्विप् aff.
2919: अमृतस्रुत् mfn. (-स्रुत्) Shedding ambrosia. E. अमृत, स्रु to distil, क्विप् aff.
2920: अमृतसोदर m. (-रः) A horse. E. अमृत, and सोदर brother: born with nectar at the churning of the ocean.
2921: अमृतान्धस् m. (-न्धाः) A deity. E. अमृत, and अन्धस् food; whose food is ambrosia.
2922: अमृताफल m. (-लः) The fruit of the Trichosanthes. E. अमृता, and फल fruit.
2923: अमृताशन m. (-नः) A deity. E. as before, अशन eating.
2924: अमृतासङ्ग n. (-ङ्गः) A collyrium, extracted from the Amomum anthoriza. See कर्परी.
2925: अमृताहरण m. (-णः) A name of GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU. E. अमृत, हृ to convey, with आङ् prefixed, and ल्युट् affix; GARUḌA having upon one occasion stolen the Amṛta.
2926: अमृतोत्पन्ना f. (-न्ना) A fly. E. अमृत, and उत्पन्न born.
2927: अमृतोद्भव m. (-वः) A kind of collyrium. See अमृतासङ्ग. E. अमृत, and उद्भव born.
2929: अमृत्यु f. (-त्युः) Immortality. E. अ neg. मृत्यु death.
2930: अमेघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Cloudless. E. अ neg. मेघ a cloud.
2931: अमेधस् m. (-धाः) A fool, an idiot. E. अ neg. मेध to understand, and अमुन् aff.
2932: अमेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Impure, foul. n. (-ध्यंः) Faeces, excrement. E. अ neg. and मेध्य pure.
2933: अमेध्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Foulness, filthiness. E. त्व added to अमेध्य, also with तल, अमेध्यता.
2934: अमेध्ययुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Filthy, foul. E. अमेध्य, and युक्त joined.
2935: अमेध्यलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Smeared with ordure, foul, defiled. E. अमेध्य, and लिप्त smeared.
2936: अमेध्यलेप m. (-पः) Smearing with ordure. E. अमेध्य, and लेप plastering.
2937: अमेध्याक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Soiled by ordure. E. अमेध्य, and अक्त smeared.
2938: अमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Immense, immeasurable. E. अ neg. मेय to be measured.
2939: अमेयात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Magnanimous, possessing extraordinary powers of mind. E. अमेय, and आत्मन् self.
2940: अमोक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 Bondage, confinement. 2 Confinement to life. mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Unliberated, unloosed. E. अ neg. मोक्ष liberation.
2941: अमोघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Productive, fruitful, not vain or barren. m. (-घः) The name of a river. f. (-घा) 1 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 A plant of which the seed is used as a vermifuge, (Erycibe paniculata, Rox.) See बिडङ्ग. 3 Yellow myrobalan. See हरीतकी. E. अ not, मोघ vain, barren.
2942: अमोचन n. (-नं) Non-liberation, not loosing or letting go. E. अ neg. मोचन loosing.
2943: अमोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Confined, not liberated. E. अ neg. मोचित loosed.
2944: अम्ब r. 1st cl. (अंबति) To move, to go.
2945: अम्बक n. (-कं) 1 The eye. 2 Copper. E. अम्ब to go, and वुन् aff.
2946: अम्बर n. (-रं) 1 The sky or atmosphere. 2 Clothes, apparel. 3 A perfume, (Ambergris.) 4 Cotton. 5 Talc. E. अम्ब to go, and अरन् aff.
2947: अम्बरयुग n. (-गं) The two principal female garments, or upper and lower cloths or mantles. E. अम्वर, and युगं a pair.
2948: अम्बरान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The horizon. 2 The end of a garment. E. अम्बर, and अन्त end.
2949: अम्बरिष mn. (-षः-षं) A frying pan. See the next.
2950: अम्बरीष mn. (-षः-षं) 1 A frying pan. 2 War, battle. m. (-षः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Also of VIṢṆU. 3 A young animal, a colt, a boy. 4 The name of a king of the solar race, celebrated as a worshipper of VIṢṆU. 5 A division of hell. 6 The sun. 7 Repentance. 8 A tree, (Spondias mangifera.) E. अबि to sound, and ईषन् Uṇādi affix, but irregularly formed.
2951: अम्बष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) 1 The name of a country, stated to be in the eastern division of India, and supposed by Mr. WILFORD, to be the abode of the AMBASTOE of Arrian. 2 The offspring of a man of the Brahman, and a woman of the Vaiśya tribe, a man of the medical cast. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 A sort of jasmin, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 2 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) See बनतिक्तिका. 3 Woodsorrel, (Oxalis corniculata, Rox.) E. अम्बा a mother, स्था to stand, and क affix, what cherishes-like a mother.
2952: अम्बष्ठकी f. (-की) A creeper, (Cissampelos hexandra.) Also अम्बष्ठा and अम्बष्ठिका.
2953: अम्बा f. (-म्बा) 1 A mother. 2 The same, (in theatrical language.) 3 A name of DURGĀ. See अम्बिका. E. अबि to sound, अप् and टाप् affs.
2954: अम्बालिका f. (-का) 1 A mother. 2 The mother of PĀṆḌU.
2955: अम्बिका f. (का) 1 A mother. 2 A name of PĀRVATĪ. 3 The mother of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. 4 One of the female domestic deities of the Jainas. 5 A medicinal plant. See कटुकी. E. अम्बा a mother, and कन् affix; like a mother.
2956: अम्बिकेय m. (-यः) 1 GAṆEŚA, or KĀRTTIKEYA, both sons of PĀRVATĪ. 2 A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. अम्बिका as above; and ढक affix, implying family decent.
2957: अम्बिकेयक m. (-कः) 1 GAṆEŚA. 3 DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. as the preceding, कन् being added.
2958: अम्बु n. (-म्बु) Water. E. अबि to sound, and उ aff.
2959: अम्बुकणा f. (-णा) A drop of water. E. अम्बु, and कण a particle.
2960: अम्बुकण्ठक m. (-कः) The short-nosed alligator. E. अम्बु water, and कण्ठक a thorn.
2961: अम्बुकिरात m. (-तः) An alligator. E. अम्बु, and किरात a savage.
2962: अम्बुकीश m. (-शः) A porpoise, especially of the kind common in the Ganges, (Delphinus gangeticus, Rox.) E. अम्बु, and कीश, the water-monkey.
2963: अम्बुकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) A porpoise, especially the gangetic. E. अम्बु, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.
2964: अम्बुचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Aquatical. E. अम्बु, and चर what moves in.
2965: अम्बुचामर n. (-रं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) See शैवाल. E. अम्बु, and चामर the Indian chowrie; the water-chowrie.
2966: अम्बुचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Aquatical, as a fish, &c. E. अम्बु, चर to go, णिनि aff.
2967: अम्बुज m. (-जः) A plant, (Eugenia acutangula.) See हिज्जल. n. (-जं) 1 A lotus, (Nymphaea nelumbo.) 2 The thunderbolt of INDRA. mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, water-born. E. अम्बु, and ज what is produced; water-born.
2968: अम्बुजन्मन् n. (-न्म) A lotus. E. अम्बु, and जन्म birth.
2970: अम्बुद m. (-दः) A cloud. mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Shedding or giving water. E. अम्बु, and द what gives.
2971: अम्बुधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. अम्बु, and धि what possesses; from धाञ् with कि affixed.
2972: अम्बुनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. अम्बु, and निधि a treasure.
2973: अम्बुप m. (-पः) A plant, (Cassia tora, or alata.) mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Drinking or imbibing water. E. अम्बु, and प what drinks.
2974: अम्बुपत्रा f. (-त्रा) A fragrant grass, (perhaps a Cyperus.) See उच्चटा. E. अम्बु, and पत्र a leaf.
2975: अम्बुपद्धति f. (-तिः) Current, stream, flow of water. E. अम्बु, and पद्धति distinction.
2976: अम्बुप्रसादन m. (-नः) The clearing nut tree, (Strychnos potatorum.) E. अम्बु water, प्रसद to cleanse, घञ affix. The nuts of this plant are generally used in India, for purifying water: they are rubbed upon the inner surface of the vessel, and occasion the precipitation of the impurities of the fluid.
2977: अम्बुभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A cloud. 2 The ocean. 3 A grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) E. अम्बु, and भृत् what nourishes, from भृञ् with क्विप् aff.
2978: अम्बुमत् m. (-मान्) The side of a river, or a bank, a shore. mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Watery, having or containing water. E. अम्ब and मतुप् aff.
2979: अम्बुमात्रज m. (-जः) A bivalve shell. E. अम्बु water, मात्र all, every kind, and ज produced.
2980: अम्बुमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud. E. अम्बु, and मुच् what lets go.
2981: अम्बुर m. (-रः) The lower limb of a door frame, the threshold. E. अम्बु, and राज to shine, affix ड.
2982: अम्बुराशि m. (-शिः) The ocean. E. अम्बु, and राशि a heap.
2983: अम्बुरुह m. (-रुहः) 1 Any aquatic plant. 2 A lotus. E. अम्बु, and रुह् what grows on or in.
2984: अम्बुरोहिणी f. (-णी) A lotus. E. अम्बु, and रोहिन् what grows, or rises on or in.
2985: अम्बुवाची f. (-ची) Four days in Āṣārha, the 10th to the 13th of the dark fortnight, when the earth is supposed to be unclean, and agriculture is prohibited. E. अम्बु, and वाच् speech, with ङीष added.
2987: अम्बुवासिनी f. (-नी) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. अम्बु before वस to abide, णिनि and ङीप् aff.
2988: अम्बुवाह m. (-हः) 1 A cloud. 2 The cyperus. 3 A water carrier. E. अम्बु water, and वाह what bears.
2989: अम्बुवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Carrying or conveying water. f. (-नी) A wooden baling vessel. E. अम्बु, and वाहिन् what bears.
2990: अम्बुवेतस m. (-सः) A kind of cane or reed growing in water. See वेतस.
2991: अम्बुसर्पिणी f. (-णी) A leech. E. अम्बु before सृप् to go, णिनि affix; and डीष् fem. do.
2992: असाद न n. (-नं) The nut of the Strychnos. See अम्बुप्रसादन.
2993: अम्बुसेचनी f. (-नी) A vessel used for baling water out of a boat. E. अम्बु, षिच् to sprinkle, णिनि aff.
2994: अम्बूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sputtered, (speech, discourse.) E. अम्बु water, and कृत made.
2995: अम्ब्ल m. (-म्ब्लः) Sourness. E. अम्ब to go, and क्ल Uṇādi aff.
2996: अम्भस् n. (-म्भः) Water. E. अप् water, before असुन Uṇādi affix; नुम् is inserted, and प becomes भ.
2997: अम्भस्स्थ mfn. (-स्स्थः-स्स्था-स्स्थं) 1 What holds or contains water. 2 Abiding in water. E. अम्भस् and स्थ what abides or where it abides.
2998: अम्भस्सू m. (-स्सूः) Smoke, cloudiness. E. अम्भस् water, and सू what produces.
2999: अम्भोज n. (-जं) A lotus. m. (-जः) 1 The moon. 2 The Sāras or Indian crane. mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, water-born. E. अम्भस्, and ज produced.
3000: अम्भोजजनि m. (-निः) BRAHMĀ, being born secondarily from a lotus. E. अम्भोज, and जनि birth.
3001: अम्भोजयोनि m. (-निः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. अम्भोज, and योनि womb.
3002: अम्भोजिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers, or a place where they abound. E. अम्भोज a lotus, णिनि and डीप् affs.
3003: अम्भोद m. A cloud. E. अम्भस्, and द what gives.
3004: अम्भोधर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. अम्भस् water, and धर what has.
3005: अम्भोधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. अम्भस्, and धि what possesses, from धा with the affix. कि.
3006: अम्भोनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. अम्भस्, and निधि a treasure.
3007: अम्भोराशि m. (-शिः) The ocean. E. अम्भस्, and राशि a heap.
3008: अम्भोरुह n. (-हः) A lotus. E. अम्भस्, and रुह what rises or grows, from रुह with अच् affix; also with क्किप् affix. अम्भोरुह nom. (रुट्.)
3009: अम्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Watery, formed from, or consisting of water, (as froth, &c.) E. अप् water, and मयट् affix; म is changed to प, and the fem. takes ङीप्.
3010: अम्र m. (-म्रः) The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) n. (-म्रं) A mango. E. अम to eat, and र aff.
3011: अम्रात m. (-तः) A species of spondias or hog plum, (Spondias mangifera). E. अम्र the mango, and अत to go, अच् affix; resembling that fruit, also अम्रातक.
3012: अम्रातक m. (-कः) A tree, see the preceding. E. as before, कन् being added.
3013: अम्ल mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं) Sour, acid. m. (-म्लः) Sourness, acidity. f. (-म्ली) Wood sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.) n. (-म्लं) Sour curds. E. अम to be sick, क्ल Uṇādi affix, and ङीप् for the fem.
3014: अम्लता f. Sourness. E. अम्ल and तल् affix, also with त्व aff. अम्लत्व n. (-त्वं.)
3015: अम्लक m. (-कः) A plant, (Artocarpus lacucha.) See लकुच. E. अम्ल sourness, and क affix; having a sour taste.
3016: अम्लकेशर m. (-रः) The citron. E. अम्ल, and केशर a filament.
3018: अम्लपित्त m. (-त्तः) Acidity of stomach. E. अम्ल, and पित्त bile.
3019: अम्लफल m. (-लः) The tamarind tree. n. (-लं) The fruit. E. अम्ल, and फल fruit.
3020: अम्लरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Sour, having a sour taste. m. (-सः) Sourness, acidity. E. अम्ल, and रस flavour.
3021: अम्ललोणिका f. (-का) Wood sorrel, (Oxalis corniculata,) also अम्ललोणी and अम्ललोलिका.
3024: अम्लवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class of plants with acid leaves or fruit, as the lime, orange, pomegranate, tamarind, wood apple, sorrel. Lakucha, Spondias and others. E. अम्ल, and वर्ग a class.
3027: अम्लवेतस m. (-सः) A kind of dock or sorrel. (Rumex vesicarius.) E. अम्ल sour, and वेतस a kind of reed; sour grass.
3028: अम्लवासुक n. (-कं) A kind of sorrel.
3029: अम्लवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The tamarind tree. E. अम्ल, and वृक्ष a tree.
3030: अम्लशाक n. (-कं) A sort of sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius,) commonly used as a potherb. E. अम्ल, and शाक a potherb.
3031: अम्लसार n. (-रः) Rice water after fermentation. m. (-रः) 1 The lime. 2 A sort of sorrel. E. अम्ल, and सार essence.
3032: अम्लाक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Acidulated. E. अम्ल, and अक्त mixed.
3033: अम्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Clean, clear. 2 Bright, unclouded. m. (-नः) Globe amaranth, (Gomphrena globosa.) E. अ neg. and म्लान dirty.
3034: अम्लानि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) 1 Vigorous. 2 Unfading. f. (-निः) 1 Vigour. 2 Freshness, verdure. E. अ neg. म्लानि soil.
3035: अम्लानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Clean, clear. f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. अ neg. म्लानिन् soiled.
3036: अम्लिका f. (-का) 1 The tamarind tree. 2 Wood sorrel, (Oxalis corniculata.) 3 A sour taste in the mouth, acidity of stomach. E. अम्ल sour, कन् and टाप् affixes; इ being substituted for अ; also अम्लीका and आम्लका.
3038: अम्लोद्गार m. (-रः) Sour eructation. E. अम्ल, and उद्गार bringing up.
3039: अय r. 1st cl. (अयते) To go, to go to or towards. With प्रति to believe, to rely on. A preposition containing र substitutes ल before this root, as प्र and पर make प्लायते, पलायते to fly, to run away.
3040: अय m. (-यः) Good luck, favourable fortune. E. इण to go, and अच् affix; happiness proceeding by it.
3041: अयज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Not offering sacrifice. E. अ neg. यज्ञ sacrifice.
3042: अयज्ञक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfit for sacrifice. E. अ neg. यज्ञक sacrificial.
3043: अयज्ञिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not sacrificial, common, profane. E. अ neg. यज्ञिय sacrificial.
3044: अयतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Incontinent, of unsubdued appetite. E. अ neg. यतिन् self-restraining.
3045: अयत्न m. (-त्नः) Absence of effort or exertion. E. अ neg. यत्व effort.
3046: अयत्नकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Idle, indifferent, making no exertion. E. अ neg. यत्न effort, and कारिन् who makes.
3047: अयत्नकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spontaneous, readily or easily produced. E. अयत्न, and कृत done. So अयत्नभूत (-तः-ता-तं.)
3048: अयत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Idle, inactive, indifferent. E. अ neg. यत्नघत् active.
3049: अयथा ind. Unsuitably, unfitly, inconsistently, incongruously. E. अ neg. and यथा as, (it should be.)
3050: अयथातथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Unprofitable, useless, vain. 2 Unfit, unsuitable, incompatible. E. अ neg. यथा as, तथा so.
3051: अयथातथ्य n. (-थ्यं) Unprofitableness, unsuitableness, incompatibility. E. अयथातथ and ष्यञ aff.
3052: अयथार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Not according to the sense or object, incongruous, nonsensical, unmeaning. 2 Improper, unfitting. 3 False, untrue. E. अ neg. यथा as, अर्थ sense.
3053: अयथावत् ind. Inaccurately, erroneously. E. अ neg. यथा as, and वति aff.
3054: अयथाबलम् ind. Unsuitably, imperfectly. E. अयथा, and वल strength.
3055: अयथाशास्त्रकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Irreligious. E. अ neg. यथा according to, शास्त्र scripture, and कारिन् who acts.
3056: अयथेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Insufficient, not enough. 2 Disliked, disapproved of. E. अ neg. यथेष्ट wished.
3057: अयन n. (-नं) 1 A road, a path. 2 The half year, that is, the sun's road north and south of the equator. See उत्तरायण, &c. 3 The equinoctial and solstitial points. 4 A Śāstra or inspired writing. E. इण to go, and ल्युट् aff.
3058: अयनकाल m. (-लः) The interval between the equinoxes. E. अयन, and काल time.
3059: अयनभाग m. (-गः) See अयनांश. E. अयन, and भाग a part.
3060: अयनांश m. (-शः) The arc between the vernal equinoctial point, and the beginning of the fixed zodiac or first point in Aries. E. अयन, and अंश a part.
3061: अयन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unrestrained, self-willed. E. अ neg. यन्त्रित restrained.
3062: अयवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Lucky, fortunate. E. अय and मतुप aff.
3063: अयशस् mfn. (-शाः-शाः-शः) Infamous. n. (-शः) Infamy. E. अ neg. यशस् fame.
3064: अयशस्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Disgraceful, degrading. E. अयशस् and कर what makes.
3065: अयशस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Infamous. So अयशस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि.) E. अयशस् and य or विनि aff.
3066: अयस् n. (-यः) Iron. m. (-याः) A name of VAHNI or fire. E. इण to go, and असुन् Uṇādi aff.
3067: अयस्कान्त m. (-न्तः) A precious stone, the loadstone. E. अयस् and कान्त beautiful, implying a gem, after this word and others, as सूर्य्यकान्त, &c.
3068: अयस्कार m. (-रः) 1 The upper part of the thigh. 2 A blacksmith. E. अयस्, and कार an agent.
3069: अयस्कुम्भ m. (-म्भः) An iron pot or boiler. E. अयस् and कुम्भ a jar.
3070: अयाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who does not ask or solicit. E. अ neg. याचक who solicits.
3071: अयाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unasked, unsolicited. m. (-तः) The name of a Muni or saint, also उपवर्ष. E. अ neg. and याचित asked, solicited.
3072: अयाज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Outcaste, degraded, not competent to offer sacrifice. E. अ neg. याज्य to be sacrificed; by whom.
3073: अयातपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-ब्वो-र्व्वं) Following, subsequent to, succeeding. E. अ neg. यातपूर्व्व preceding.
3074: अयाथार्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Improper, unjust. 2 Absurd, incongruous. E. अयथार्थ and ठञ् aff.
3075: अयाथार्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) 1 Impropriety, unfitness. 2 Absurdity, nonsense. E. अयथार्थ and य्यञ् aff.
3076: अयान n. (-नं) 1 Natural disposition or temperament. 2 Halt, stop. E. अ neg. and या to go, ल्युट् affix; what never departs.
3078: अयानयीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Produced in, or brought from Ayānaya. E. अयानय and ख aff.
3079: अयावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unstained with lac-dye, naturally red. E. अ neg. यावक of lac.
3080: अयि ind. A particle of encouragement, and asking; also a vocative particle. E. इ to go, and इन् affix, by which one goes; what leads or calls.
3081: अयुक्च्छद m. (-दः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) See सप्तपर्णः. E. अयुज् separate, and छद a leaf.
3082: अयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Separate, disjoined. 2 Improper. E. अ neg. युक्त joined.
3083: अयुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Disunion, separation. 2 Unreasonableness, want of conformity to correct principles or to analogy. 3 Impropriety, unfitness. E. अ neg. युक्ति union.
3084: अयुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Single, separate. 2 Odd. E. अ neg. युग a pair.
3085: अयुगपत् ind. Gradually, seriatim, not at once. E. अ neg. युगपत् at once.
3086: अयुगल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Single. E. अ neg. युगल a pair.
3087: अयुगार्च्चिष् m. (-र्च्चिः) Fire. E. अयुग uneven, (seven) अर्च्चिष् ray.
3088: अयुग्म mfn. (-ग्मः-ग्मा-ग्मं) 1 Separate, divided, single. 2 Odd, uneven. E. अ not, युग्म a pair.
3089: अयुग्मछद m. (-दः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) E. अ neg. युग्म double, and छद a leaf.
3090: अयुज् mfn. (-युक) 1 Separate, single. 2 Odd, uneven. E. अ neg. युज् what joins.
3091: अयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disjoined, detached. n. (-तं) Ten thousand. E. अ neg. and यत joined, counted.
3092: अयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Peace, absence of war. E. अ neg. युद्ध war.
3093: अये ind. Oh! ah! &c. an interjection of; 1 Recollection. 2 Fatigue; 3 Fear; 4 Passion; and 5 Calling. E. इ to go, एच् aff.
3094: अयोग m. (-गः) 1 Separation, disjunction. 2 A widower, an absent lover or husband. 3 Unfitness, unsuitableness. 4 Medical treatment, counter to the symptoms. 5 Consistent treatment, non-mixture of opposite qualities. 6 Dislike, aversion to any thing. 7 Vigorous effort, exertion. 8 An iron hammer. E. अ neg. and योग union; or अयस् iron, and ग what goes, or is.
3095: अयोगव mf. (-वः-वा-वी) The offspring of a Śūdra man, and Vaiśya woman. E. अयोग disjoined, and व from बा to go; being one of the lowest castes or tribes.
3096: अयोगुड m. (-डः) 1 A chalybeate pill, one made of some preparation of iron. 2 An iron ball. E. अयस्, and गुड a ball.
3097: अयोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 Unfit, unsuitable. 2 Useless. E. अ neg. योग्य fit.
3098: अयोग्यता f. (-ता) 1 Unfitness, unsuitableness, incongruity, impropriety. अयोग्य and तल् affix; also अयोग्यत्वं.
3099: अयोग्र n. (-ग्रं) 1 A pestle for cleaning grain. 2 A mace of club tipped with iron. 3 A hammer, a forge hammer. E. अयस्, and अग्र the end.
3100: अयोघन m. (-नः) A hammer, a forge hammer. E. अयस्, and घन what strikes, from हन् to kill or strike.
3101: अयोजन nf. (-नं-ना) Disunion, separation, distinctness. E. अ not, योजन uniting.
3102: अयोदत् mfn. (-दत्-दती-दत्) Iron-toothed. E. अयस्, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
3103: अयोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Not to be warred against. f. (-ध्या) The capital of RĀMA, Ayodhya, the modern Oude. E. अ neg. युद्ध to make war, and ण्यत् aff.
3104: अयोनिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Generated equivocally, not born from the womb. E. अ neg. योनि the womb, and ज born.
3105: अयोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of iron. E. अयस् and मयट् aff.
3106: अयोमल n. (-लं) Rust of iron. E. अयस, and मल dirt.
3107: अयोमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Tipped or pointed with iron. m. (-खः) A kind of goblin with an iron face. E. अयस्, and मुख a mouth.
3108: अयोहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Stern, unrelenting, iron-hearted. E. अयस्, and हृदय the heart.
3109: अर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Swift, speedy. n. (-रं) 1 The spoke or radius of a wheel. 2 adv. Swiftly. m. (-रः) 1 A Jaina division of time, the sixth of an Avasarpiṇī or Utsarpiṇī. See अवसर्पिणी, &c. 2 The eighteenth- Jaina Tīrthakara, or deified saint. E. ऋ to go, अप् aff.
3110: अरक m. (-कः) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) See शैवाल. E. अर what goes, and वुन् aff.
3111: अरक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Not preserved, not kept. 3 Unprotected, undefended. E. अ neg. रक्षित kept.
3112: अरग्वघ m. (घः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) See आरग्वघ.
3113: अरघट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 1 A machine for raising water from a well. 2 A deep well. E. अर quickly, and घट्ट to move, affix अच्.
3114: अरघदृक m. (-कः) 1 A wheel for drawing water with. 2 A deep or large well. E. कन् added to the preceding.
3115: अरङ्गर m. (-रः) Factitious or made up poison. E. अरम् quick, and गर poison.
3116: अरजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Free from the quality of passion. 2 Free from desire, &c. f. (-जाः) A young girl. E. अ neg. रजस् the menstrual flux, or passion, &c.
3117: अरटु m. (-टुः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) See अरलु. E. ऋ to go, and अटच् aff.
3118: अरणि mfn. (-णिः-णी) Wood used for kindling a fire, exciting it by attrition. m. (-णिः) 1 The plant of which especially the wood is used for this purpose, (Premna spinosa, &c). See गणिकारिका. 2 A flint. 3 The sun. E. ऋ to go, and अनि Uṇādi aff.
3119: अरण्य nf. (-ण्यः-णी) A forest. m. (-ण्यः) Kayaphal, a drug so named. See कट्फल. E. ऋ to go, and अन्य Uṇādi aff.
3120: अरण्यकदली f. (-ली) The wood or wild plantain. E. अरण्य, and कदली the plantain.
3121: अरण्यकार्प्पासी f. (-सी) The wild cotton. E. अरण्य, and कार्प्पासी cotton.
3122: अरण्यचटक m. (-कं) A wood sparrow. E. अरण्य, and चटक a sparrow.
3123: अरण्यज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced or born in a forest. E. अरण्य, and ज born; also similar compounds, as अरण्यजात, अरण्योत्पन्न, अरण्यभव, अरण्यसम्भव, &c.
3124: अरण्यजार्द्रका f. (-का) Wild ginger. E. अरण्यज, and आर्द्रका ginger.
3125: अरण्यधान्य n. (-न्यं) Wild rice. E. अरण्य, and धान्य grain.
3126: अरण्यमक्षिका f. (-का) The gad fly. E. अरण्य, and मक्षिका a fly.
3127: अरण्यरक्षक m. (-कः) Keeper of a forest, superintendent of a forest district. E. अरण्य, and रक्षक who protects.
3128: अरण्यवायस m. (-सः) A raven. E. अरण्य, and वायस a crow.
3129: अरण्यवास m. (-सः) A hermitage. E. अरण्य a wood, and वास abode.
3130: अरण्यवासिन् m. (-सी) A hermit, an anchorite. E. अरण्य, and वासिन who resides.
3131: अरण्यशालि m. (-लिः) Wild rice. E. अरेण्य, and शालि rice.
3132: अरण्यशूकर m. (-रः) The wild hog. E. अरण्य, and शूकर a hog.
3133: अरण्यश्वन् m. (-श्वा) A wolf. E. अरण्य, and श्वन् a dog, the forest dog.
3134: अरण्याध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) Keeper or ranger of the forests, a headman or superintendent of a forest district, an officer in the old Hindu government. E. अरण्य, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
3135: अरण्यानी f. (-नी) A large forest. E. अरण्य, आनुक and ङीष aff.
3136: अरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dull, languid, apathetic. 2 Disgusted, discontented. E. अ neg. रत interested.
3137: अरतत्रप m. (-पः) A dog. E. अ neg. रत copulation, and त्रप ashamed.
3138: अरति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Dull, languid. 2 Discontented, unhappy. m. (-तिः) Anger, passion. f. (-तिः) 1 Dissatisfaction, discontent. 2 Dulness, languor. 3 Absence of pleasure, pain. 4 Anxiety, distress. E. अ neg. and रति pleasure, or ऋ to go, and अति Uṇādi aff.
3139: अरत्नि m. (-त्निः) 1 A cubit of the middle length, from the elbow to the tip of the little finger. 2 The elbow. E. ऋ to go, and कत्नि Uṇādi aff.
3140: अरम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Low, inferior. See अवम.
3141: अरम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Disagreeable. E. अ neg. रम्य pleasing.
3142: अरर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 A door. 2 A covering, a sheathe. 3 The sheathe of the shoot of a bamboo. E. अर, from ऋ to go, and अरण Uṇādi affix, ङीष् in the fem.
3143: अररि mn. (-रिः-रि) A door. E. ऋ to go, and अरिन् aff.
3144: अररु m. (-रुः) An enemy. E. ऋ to go, अरु Uṇādi aff.
3145: अररे ind. A vocative particle, expressing haste.
3146: अरलु m. (-लुः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) See शोनाक. E. ऋ to go, अरु affix, and र is changed to ल, also अरटु.
3147: अरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Silent. E. अ neg. रव sound.
3148: अरविन्द n. (-न्दं) 1 A lotus, (Nymphaea nelumbo.) 2 Copper. E. अर quickly, and विन्द to obtain, श affix; with reference to the lotus, as of quick growth.
3149: अरविन्दनाभि m. (-भिः) VIṢṆU. E. अरविन्द, and नाभि the navel, from which sprung the lotus that bore BRAHMĀ at the creation.
3150: अरविन्दिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. अरविन्द, इनि and ङीप् affs.
3151: अरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Insipid, tasteless. 2 Dull, flat, (as a composition.) E. अ neg. रस flavour.
3152: अरसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Unfeeling, dull, devoid of taste. 2 Flavourless, insipid, liter. or fig. E. अ neg. रसिक flavoured.
3153: अरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having, possessed of. E. अ neg. रहित left.
3154: अराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Cool, unimpassioned. E. अ neg. राग passion.
3155: अरागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Cool, unimpassioned. E. अ neg. रागिन् impassioned.
3156: अराजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Anarchical, having no king or governor. E. अ neg. राजन् a king, कन् aff.
3157: अराति m. (-तिः) An enemy. E. अ neg. and रा to give, with ति affix; who does not give pleasure.
3158: अरातिभङ्ग m. (-ङ्कः) Defeat or destruction of a foe. E. अराति, and भङ्ग breaking.
3159: अराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crooked. m. (-लः) 1 Resin. 2 An elephant in rut. 3 A bent or crooked, arm. f. (-ला) 1 A modest woman. 2 A disloyal or unchaste one. E. अर what goes, आ before ला to take or give, and क aff.
3160: अरि m. (-रिः) 1 An enemy. 2 A wheel. 3 A species of Khadira or Mimosa. E. ऋ to go, अच् affix, and इ substituted for अ.
3161: अरिकुल n. (-लं) Family of an enemy. E. अरि, and कुल family.
3162: अरिक्थभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Not entitled to a share of the property, a non-heir. E. अ neg. रिक्थभाज a co-heir.
3163: अरिता f. (-ता) Enmity, hostility. E. अरि and तल् affix, also with त्व, अरित्वं.
3164: अरित्र n. (-त्रं) A rudder. E. ऋ to go, and इत्रन् aff.
3165: अरिनन्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Gratifying an enemy, affording triumph to an enemy. E. अरि, and नन्दन what delights.
3166: अरिन्दम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Conquering, victorious. E. अरि, and दम to tame, affix खच्.
3167: अरिपुर n. (-रं) An enemy's town or country. E. अरि, and पुर a city.
3168: अरिमित्र m. (-त्रः) An ally or friend of an enemy. E. अरि, and मित्र a friend.
3169: अरिमेद m. (-दः) A fetid Mimosa, (M. Farnesiana.) E. अरि an enemy, and मेद what injures.
3170: अरिराष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रंः) An enemy's country. E. अरि, and राष्ट्र a country.
3171: अरिलोक m. (-कः) A hostile tribe or an enemy's country. E. अरि, and लोक a country.
3172: अरिष m. (-षः) 1 Disease arising from meat and drink. 2 A stream of water from the clouds.
3173: अरिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus saponaria, &c.) 2 Garlick. 3 The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.) 4 A crow. 5 A heron. 6 The name of an Asura or infernal spirit. n. (-ष्टं) 1 A woman's apartment, the lying-in chamber. 2 Good fortune, happiness. 3 Bad or ill luck, misfortune. 4 Buttermilk. 5 Vinous spirit. 6 Sign or symptom of approaching death. 7 A portent, some natural phenomenon considered as indicating calamity. E. अ neg. and रिष्ट bad or good fortune.
3174: अरिष्टक m. (-कः) The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus saponaria, &c.) E. अ neg. and रिष्ट affliction, क affix; relieving sickness, &c. See the preceding, of which it may have all the meanings.
3175: अरिष्टताति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Auspicious, making fortunate or happy. E. अरिष्ट, तन to spread, and डाति aff.
3176: अरिष्टदुष्टधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Apprehensive of death, alarmed at its approach. E. अरिष्ट sign of death, टुष्ठ disturbed, and धी understanding, mind; whose is so.
3177: अरिष्टनेमि m. (-मिः) The twenty-second of the twenty-four Jaina Tīrthakaras or saints. Also नेमि.
3178: अरिष्टसूदन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. अरिष्ट the Asura so named, and सूदन who destroys; having killed the demon ARIṢṬA.
3179: अरिष्टानक n. (-कं) Consternation, defeat. E. अरि, and स्थानक being in place.
3180: अरिहंसक m. (-कः) An avenger. E. अरि, and हिंसक who injures.
3181: अरुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Healthy, well. E. अ neg. रुग्न sick.
3182: अरुचि f. (-चिः) 1 Aversion, dislike. 2 Want of appetite, disrelish, disgust. E. अ neg. रुचि light.
3183: अरुचिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Disagreeable, disgusting. E. अ neg. रुचिर agreeable.
3184: अरुच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Disagreeable. E. अ neg. रुच्य to be liked.
3185: अरुज् mfn. (-रुक् or -रुग्) Sound, healthy, free from disease. E. अ neg. रुज् sick.
3186: अरुण m. (-णः) 1 A name of the sun. 2 Also of his charioteer, or the dawn personified as the son of KAŚYAPA by VINATĀ. 3 The colour of the dawn, dark red, or the mixture of red and black. 4 Tawny, (the colour.) 5 The redness of sun-set. 6 A kind of leprosy, with red spots and insensibility of the skin. 7 A dumb man. f. (-णा) 1 A plant, (Betula.) See अतिविषा. 2 Madder, (Rubia manjith.) 3 Another plant, commonly Tëori. See त्रिष्टत्. 4 A black kind of the same. 5 Colocynth or bitter apple. 6 The plant that yields the red and black berry from which the jeweller's weight, the Ratti, is derived. See गुञ्जा. mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Tawny, dark red, &c. E. ऋ to go, and उनन Uṇādi aff.
3187: अरुणकमल n. (-लं) The red lotus. E. अरुण, and कमल a lotus.
3188: अरुणलोचन m. (-नः) A pigeon. E. अरुण, and लोचन the eye.
3189: अरुणसारथि m. (-थिः) The sun. E. अरुण, and सारथि a charioteer; whose charioteer is ARUṆA.
3190: अरुणाग्रज m. (-जः) GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU. E. अरुण, and अग्रज first born; having ARUṆA as his elder brother.
3191: अरुणात्मज m. (-जः) A name of JAṬĀYU, a fabulous bird: said by some to be the son of ARUṆA, but more generally of GARUḌA. E. अरुण, and आत्मज the son.
3192: अरुणावरज m. (-जः) A name of GARUḌA. E. अरुण, अवर after, and ज born; the younger brother of ARUṆA.
3193: अरुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reddened. 2 Dyed red, impurpled. E. अरुण and इतच् aff.
3194: अरुणिमन् m. (-मा) Redness. E. अरुण and इमनिच् aff.
3195: अरुणीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reddened, turning or become red. E. अरुण, and कृत made, च्ची augment.
3196: अरुणोदय m. (-यः) Break of day, dawn, the period preceding sunset. E. अरुण dawn, उदय rise.
3197: अरुणोपल m. (-लः) A ruby. E. अरुण dark red, and उपल a stone.
3198: अरुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unwept, unlamented. 2 Not weeping. E. अ neg. रुदित wept.
3199: अरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Free, unobstructed. E. अ neg. रुद्ध obstructed.
3200: अरुन्तुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Sharp, corrosive. 2 Acrimonious, sharp, sour. (as disposition.) E. अरुस् a sore, and तुद what torments, from तुद and खश affix; the final of अरुस् is dropped, and नुम inserted.
3201: अरुन्तुदत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Infliction of pain. 2 Acrimoniousness, causticity. E. त्व added to the last. Also अरुन्तुदता.
3202: अरुन्धती f. (-ती) The daughter of KĀRDDAMA and wife of VASIṢṬHA, one of the seven Ṛṣis; she is also one of the Pleiades. E. अ neg. रुध to confine, तन् and ङीप् affixes; who does not confine or hinder good works. ARUNDHATĪ is considered as a pattern of conjugal excellence, and is invoked at the marriage ceremony by the bridegroom.
3203: अरुन्धतीजानि m. (-निः) VAŚIṢṬHA, one of the seven Ṛṣis or saints, and stars in the great bear. E. अरुन्धती and जानि from जाया a wife; whose wife is ARUNDHATĪ.
3204: अरुन्धतीनाथ m. (-थः) A name of VASIṢṬHA, as above. E. अरुन्धती and नाथ a lord or husband.
3205: अरुश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Smooth, liter. or fig. E. अ neg. रुश rough.
3206: अरुष्क m. (-ष्कः) The marking-nut plant, see the next word. E. अरुस् a sore, and क what makes.
3207: अरुष्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Corrosive, caustic, acrid. m. (-रः) The marking-nut plant, (Semecarpius anacardium.) n. (-रं) The nut. E. अरुस् a sore, कृ to make, ट aff.
3208: अरुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Calm, not angry. E. अ neg. रुष्ट angry.
3209: अरुस् mfn. (-रुः) A sore or wound. m. (-रुः) The sun. ind. A joint. E. ऋ to go, and उसि Uṇādi aff.
3210: अरुसिका f. (का) Eruptions on the scalp, with acute pain. E. अरुस् a sore, कन् added.
3211: अरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 1 Formless, shapeless. 2 Ugly, ill formed, misshapen. 3 Dissimilar, unlike. E. अ neg. रूप beauty.
3212: अरूपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Literal, without figure or metaphor. E. अ neg. रूपक figurative.
3213: अरूपता f. (-ता) 1 Ugliness. 2 Shapelessness. 3 Dissimilarity. E. तल् added to अरूप, also अरूपत्व.
3214: अरूपवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Ugly, shapeless. E. अरूप and मतुप् aff.
3215: अरूष m. (-षः) 1 A kind of snake. 2 The sun. E. ऋ to go, ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.
3216: अरे ind. Interjection of calling to inferiors.
3217: अरेरे ind. 1 Interjection of calling to inferiors. 2 Also of calling angrily.
3218: अरोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Obscured, dimmed, darkened. E. रुच् to be light, घञ् affix; अ neg. prefix.
3219: अरोकदत् mfn. (-दत्-दती-दत्) Having black or discoloured teeth. E. अरोक, and दत् for दन्त a tooth, also अरोकदन्त.
3220: अरोकदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Having bad teeth; see the last.
3221: अरोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Well, healthy, free from disease. m. (-गः) Health. E. अ neg. रोग sickness.
3222: अरोगिता f. (-ता) Health. E. अरोगिन् well, तल् affix, or with त्व अरोगित्वं.
3223: अरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Well, in health. E. अ neg. रोगिन् sick.
3224: अरोचक f. (-कः) Indigestion, loss of appetite. E. अ neg. रोचक digestion.
3225: अरोचिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Disagreeable. 2 Dark. 3 Ugly. E. अ neg. रोचिष्णु splendid, &c.
3226: अरोदन n. (-नं) Not weeping. E. अ neg. रोदन weeping.
3227: अरोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Unobstructed, unobstructable. E. अ neg. रोध्य to be hindered.
3228: अरोपण n. (-णं) Not planting or fixing. E. अ neg. रोपण setting up.
3229: अरोष m. (-षः) Calmness, gentleness. E. अ neg. रोष wrath.
3230: अरौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Not formidable or fierce. E. अ neg. रोद्र formidable.
3231: अर्क r. 10th cl. (अर्कयति) 1 To praise. 2 To heat or warm.
3232: अर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 The sun. 2 Crystal. 3 Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea.) 4 Copper. 5 A name of INDRA. 6 A Paṇḍita or learned man. 7 An elder brother. 8 Sunday. E. अर्च to worship or respect, क Uṇādi affix, and the च is dropped; what is worshipped or respected: or अर्क to heat, affix अच्.
3233: अर्कज du. m. (-जौ) The two sons of SŪRYA and AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga. E. अर्क the sun, and ज who is born.
3234: अर्कतनय m. (-यः) The son of SŪRYA or the sun, applicable to YAMA, to SANI, to the Munis VAIVASVATA and SĀVARṆI, to REVANTA, and to KARṆA. f. (-या) The daughter of the sun, applied to the river goddesses YAMUNĀ and TAPATĪ. E. अर्क, and तनय a son.
3235: अर्कत्विष् f. (-त्विट्) 1 A ray of light. 2 The light of the sun. E. अर्क, and त्विष् radiance.
3236: अर्कदिन n. (-नं) A solar day. E. अर्क, and दिन a day: also अर्कदिवसं, &c.
3237: अर्कनन्दन m. (-नः) YAMA, &c. see अर्कतनय. E. as before, and नन्दन a son.
3238: अर्कपत्र m. (-त्रः) Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea.) f. (-त्रा) A kind of birth wort, (Aristolochia Indica.) E. अर्क the swallow wort, and पत्र a leaf: the leaves of the two plants being similar.
3239: अर्कपर्ण m. (-र्णः) Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea, or Calotropis.) E. अर्क the sun, and पर्ण a leaf.
3240: अर्कपादप m. (-पः) The Nimb tree, (Nimba or Melia azadirachta.) E. अर्क, and पादप a tree.
3241: अर्कपुष्पिका f. (-का) A plant, vulgarly Arkahuli, (Cleome pentaphylla). Also अर्कपुष्पी.
3242: अर्कबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the BAUDDHA sect of Hindus. E. अर्क the sun, and बन्धु a kinsman, being of the Sūrya Van's, or line of the sun.
3243: अर्कबान्धव m. (-वः) See the preceding. E. as before, बान्धव a kinsman.
3244: अर्कमण्डल n. (-लं) The disc of the sun. E. अर्क, and मण्डल a circle.
3246: अर्करेतोज m. (-जः) REVANTA the son of SŪRYA. E. अर्क, रेतस् the semen, and ज born.
3247: अर्कवर्ष m. (-षः) A solar year. E. अर्क, and वर्ष a year; also अर्कवत्सर, &c.
3248: अर्कव्रत n. (-तं) 1 Levying taxes, subjecting the people to heavy imposts, drawing their wealth as the sun evaporizes water. 2 Periodical worship of the sun. E. अर्क the sun, and व्रत observance.
3249: अर्कसूनु m. (-नुः) YAMA, regent of the dead. E. अर्क, and सूनु a son: the son of SŪRYA. See अर्कतनय.
3250: अर्कसोदर m. (-रः) The elephant of INDRA. E. अर्क, सोदर kinsman, from स with, and उदर womb; from their being alike engaged in maintaining the universe.
3251: अर्कांश m. (-शः) A digit or twelfth of the sun's disc. E. अर्क, and अंश a part.
3252: अर्काश्मन् m. (-श्मा) 1 A crystal lens. See सूर्य्यकान्त. 2 A ruby. E. अर्क, and अश्मन् a stone.
3253: अर्काहू m. (-हूः) Swallow wort. E. अर्क, and अक्व appellation: bearing all the synonyms of the sun.
3254: अर्केन्दुसङ्गम m. (-मः) The instant of conjunction of the sun and moon. E. अर्क the sun, इन्दु the moon, and सङ्गम union.
3255: अर्कोपल m. (-लः) 1 The sun-stone. 2 A ruby. 3 A crystal lens. E. अर्क, and उपल a stone.
3256: अर्गल nf. (-लः-ला or -ली) A wooden bolt or pin for fastening a door. mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A surge or billow. E. अर्ज to gain, कलच् affix, ज becomes ग, and the fem. takes both टाप् and ङीप्.
3257: अर्गलिका f. (-का) A small door pin, a bolt. E. as before, कन affix, टाप् for the fem. and इ substituted for अ.
3258: अर्घ r. 1st cl. (अर्घति) To hurt or injure. r. 10th cl. (अर्घयति) To cost, to be worth.
3259: अर्घ m. (र्घः) 1 Price, cost. 2 Mode of worship or reverence. 3 An oblation of various ingredients to a god or Brahman. E. अर्घ to cost, or अर्हं to worship, ह being changed to घ, affix अच्.
3260: अर्घदान n. (-नं) Presentation of a respectful offering. E. अर्घ, and दान giving.
3261: अर्घबलाबल n. (-लं) Rate of price, proper price. E. अर्घ, and बल strength, अबल weakness.
3262: अर्घसंख्यापन n. (-नं) Fixing the price of commodities, appraising, assize. E. अर्घ, and संख्यापन fixing together with: it is the act of the king or ruler, in concert with the traders, and should be done once a week or once a fortnight.
3263: अर्घार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Worthy of or requiring a respectful offering, a superior. E. अर्घ, and अर्ह worthy.
3264: अर्घीश m. (-शः) A name of ŚIVA. E. अर्घ oblation, and ईश lord: the lord of offerings.
3265: अर्घ्य mfn. (-र्घ्यः-र्घ्या-र्घ्यं) Venerable, deserving worship. n. (-र्घ्यं) A respectful oblation to gods or venerable men, of rice, dūrbbā grass, flowers, &c. with water, and of water only in a small boat-shaped vessel. n. (-र्घ्यं) Wild honey. E. अर्घ, and य or यत् aff.
3266: अर्च r. 1st cl. (अर्चति) Also 1st and 10th cls. (अर्चति-ते अर्चयति-ते) To worship, to honour or treat with respect: with सम् prefixed, to worship. This root and its derivatives are also read अर्च्च, &c. doubling the consonant after र.
3267: अर्चक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A worshipper, one who worships. E. अर्च and वुन् aff.
3268: अर्चना mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) An article of worship. nf. (-नं-ना) Worship, the homage paid to deities and to superiors. E. अर्च to worship, युच् and टाप् aff.
3269: अर्चनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Venerable, respectable. E. अर्च, and अनीयर् affix, also अर्च्य and अर्चयितव्य.
3270: अर्चा f. (-र्चा) 1 Worship, see अर्चना. 2 An image. E. अर्च to worship, अच् affix, and टाप् fem. do.
3271: अर्चि f. (-र्चिः) Flame. E. अर्च to worship, इन् aff.
3272: अर्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipped, respected, saluted. E. अर्च in the part. past.
3273: अर्चिष्मत् mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मती-ष्मत्) Brilliant, resplendent. m. (-ष्मान्) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. E. अर्चिस् flame, and मतुप poss. aff.
3274: अर्च्चिस् m. (-र्चिः) 1 Flame. 2 A ray of light. 3 Light, lustre. E. अर्च to worship, and इसि Uṇādi aff.
3275: अर्च्य mfn. (-र्च्यः-र्च्या-र्च्यं) Reverend, respectable, worshipful. E. अर्च to worship, and यत् aff.
3276: अर्ज r. 1st cl. (अर्जति) To earn, to gain or acquire, (commonly used with उप prefixed.) 10th cl. (अर्जयति) 1 The same, and: 2 To work or manufacture. 3 To make or prepare. This root and its derivatives are also read अर्ज्ज, &c. doubling the consonant after र.
3277: अर्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An acquirer, one who gains or acquires. m. (-कः) Basil, the white sort, (Ocymum villosum.) E. अर्ज to gain, and वुन् aff.
3278: अर्जन n. (-नं) Gain, acquisition of wealth, &c. E. अर्ज, and ल्युट् affix, also written अर्ज्जन.
3279: अर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained, acquired. E. अर्ज to gain, क्त affix, also written अर्ज्जित.
3280: अर्जुन m. (-नः) 1 The third of the Pāṇḍavas, the son of INDRA and friend of KṚṢṆA. 2 The name of a king with a thousand arms. See कार्त्तवीर्य्य. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 4 A peacock. 5 The only son of his mother. 6 White, (the colour.) nf. (-नं-नी) 1 Grass. 2 Slight inflammation of the conjunctiva or white of the eye. f. (-नी) 1 A cow. 2 UṢĀ, the wife of ANIRUDDHA. 3 The Karatoya river in the north of Bengal. 4 A procuress, a bawd. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) White. E. अर्ज to gain, उनन् Uṇādi affix, fem. ङीप्, also read अर्ज्जुन.
3281: अर्जुनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Belonging to ARJUNA. E. अर्जुन and वुन् aff.
3282: अर्जुनतस् ind. On the side or party of ARJUNA. E. अर्जुन and तसि aff.
3283: अर्जुनच्छवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) White, of a white colour. E. अर्जुन white, and छवि light.
3284: अर्जुनध्वज m. (-जः) The monkey HANUMĀN. E. अर्जुन, and ध्वज a banner, being ARJUNA'S symbol.
3285: अर्जुनोपम m. (-मः) The teak tree, (Tectona grandis.) E. अर्जुन a tree, &c. उपम like.
3286: अर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The teak tree. 2 A letter.
3287: अर्णव m. (-वः) The ocean. E. अर्णस् water, व affix, and स is dropped: the ण in this and similar words is optionally doubled, as अर्ण्णव, &c.
3288: अर्णवज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Sea-born, marine. mn. (-जः-जं) Cuttle fish. E. अर्णव, and ज born.
3289: अर्णवमन्दिर m. (-रः) VARUṆA, regent of the water. E. अर्णव the ocean, and मन्दिर a house; whose dwelling is the deep.
3290: अर्णवपोत m. (-तः) A boat or ship. E. अर्णव, and पोत a boat.
3291: अर्णवयान n. (-नं) A boat or ship. E. अर्णव, and यान vehicle.
3292: अर्णस् n. (-र्णः) Water. E. ऋ to go, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and नट् inserted.
3293: अर्णोद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. अर्णस्, and द what gives.
3294: अर्णोभव m. (-वः) A shell. E. अर्णस्, and भव being.
3295: अर्त्तगल m. (-लः) Blue barleria, (B. caerulea.) E. आर्त्त exhausted, and गल to drop, the आ is made short, also आर्तगल.
3296: अर्त्तन n. (-नं) Censure, reproach, abuse. E. ऋति to blame, a sautra root, and ल्युट् aff.
3297: अर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Pain. 2 The end of a bow. E. अर्द to hurt, and क्तिन् aff.
3298: अर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Diseased, pained. m. (-कः) A kind of cake. E. अर्त्ति pain, and कन् added.
3299: अर्त्तिका f. (-का) An elder sister, (in theatrical language.) See अत्तिका.
3300: अर्थ r. 10th cl. (अर्थयते sometimes- ति) To ask or beg.
3301: अर्थ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Rich. 2 Learned. m. (-र्थः) 1 Wealth, property, substance. 2 Meaning, signification. 3 Thing. 4 Fruit, consequence. 5 Prohibition. 6 A material substance or object of sense. 7 Cause, origin. 8 Request, asking, begging. 9 Kind, sort, manner. 10 Well, well being. 11 (In law) A suit, an action. E. ऋ to go, and थन् Uṇādi aff.
3302: अर्थकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Producing or yielding wealth, what enriches. E. अर्थ, and कर what makes, also similar compounds, as अर्थकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं,) अर्थकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) and अर्थजनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं,) &c.
3303: अर्थकाम m. (-मः) Avarice, desire of wealth, E. अर्थ, and काम desire.
3304: अर्थगरीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Significant, meaning. E. अर्थ with गुरु heavy, ईयसुन superlative aff.
3305: अर्थघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Wasteful, extravagant. E. अर्थ, and घ्न who or what destroys.
3306: अर्थज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Wise, discriminating, understanding the various significations of a word, &c. E. अर्थ meaning, and ज्ञ who knows.
3307: अर्थतस् ind. According to the sense. E. तसि added to अर्थ.
3308: अर्थतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Truth, the real object, nature or cause of any thing. E. अर्थ, and तत्त्व truth.
3309: अर्थद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Liberal, munificent. 2 Compliant, favourable. E. अर्थ wealth or object, and द who or what gives. Also similar compounds, as अर्थदायक, अर्थदायिन् and अर्थदातृ, &c.
3310: अर्थदूषण n. (-णं) Waste, prodigality, extravagance. E. अर्थ, and दूषण spoiling.
3311: अर्थना f. (-ना) Begging, asking. E. अर्थ to ask, and युच् aff.
3312: अर्थपति m. (-तिः) 1 KUVERA, the Hindu PLUTUS. 2 A king. E. अर्थ wealth, and पति lord.
3313: अर्थपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Intent on gaining wealth. 2 Parsimonious, niggardly. E. अर्थ, and पर intent.
3314: अर्थप्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Application of wealth, as to trade, usury, &c. 2 The profession of usury. E. अर्थ, and प्रयोग application.
3315: अर्थप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Acquisition of wealth. 2 Attainment of an object. E. अर्थ, and प्राप्ति gaining.
3316: अर्थभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) A servant who has high wages. E. अर्थ, and भृत maintained.
3317: अर्थभेद m. (-दः) Distinction, difference of meaning. E. अर्थ meaning, and भेद dividing.
3318: अर्थलाभ m. (-भः) Acquisition of wealth. E. अर्थ, and लाभ acquiring.
3319: अर्थलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Greedy of wealth, covetous, niggardly. E. अर्थ, and लुब्ध desirous.
3320: अर्थलेश m. (-शः) A little wealth. E. अर्थ, and लेश a little.
3321: अर्थलोभ m. (-भः) Avarice, desire of wealth. E. अर्थ, and लोभ desire.
3322: अर्थवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Wealthy, rich. 2 Significant, having sense or meaning. 3 Designed, intentional, having an object. E. अर्थ, and मतुप् poss. aff.
3323: अर्थवाद m. (-दः) 1 Praise, eulogium. 2 Declaration of purpose or object, speech or expression having a certain object, as स्तुत्यर्थवादः speech implying praise, निन्दार्थवादः speech implying censure. 3 Amplification. E. अर्थ substance, thing, and वाद speaking.
3324: अर्थविज्ञान n. (-नं) One of the six exercises of the understanding, the comprehension of meanings. E. अर्थ meaning, import, and विज्ञान knowledge.
3325: अर्थविद् mfn. (-वित् or -विद्) Sagacious, sensible, wise. E. अर्थ, and विद् who knows.
3326: अर्थवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Accumulation of wealth. E. अर्थ, and वृद्धि increase.
3327: अर्थवैकल्प n. (-ल्पं) Prevarication, evasion, deviation from truth, perversion or disguise of fact. E. अर्थ object, वैकल्प alteration.
3328: अर्थव्यय m. (-यः) Expenditure. E. अर्थ, and व्यय expenditure.
3329: अर्थव्ययज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Liberal in giving and using. E. अर्थ wealth, व्यय expense, and ज्ञ who knows.
3330: अर्थशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The science of polity or moral and political government. E. अर्थ possession, property, and शास्त्र institutes of a science.
3331: अर्थशौच n. (-चं) 1 Honesty. 2 Acquisition of wealth. E. अर्थ purpose or wealth, शौच purity.
3332: अर्थसंग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Accumulation of wealth. 2 A treasure. E. अर्थ, and संग्रह a collection.
3333: अर्थसंस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Accumulation of wealth. 2 A treasury. E. अर्थ, and संस्थान assemblage.
3334: अर्थसञ्चय m. (-यः) Accumulation of wealth. E. अर्थ, and सञ्चय heap.
3335: अर्थसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Connexion of the sense with the word or sentence. E. अर्थ, and सम्बन्ध connexion.
3336: अर्थसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Effected by wealth. 2 Successful, one whose aim is accomplished. E. अर्थ, and सिद्ध accomplished.
3337: अर्थसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Success. E. अर्थ, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
3338: अर्थहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Inheriting or taking wealth. E. अर्थ, and हर who takes. So अर्थहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि.)
3339: अर्थहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Poor. 2 Failing, disappointed. 3 Unmeaning, nonsensical. E. अर्थ, and हीन wanting. So अर्थशून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) E. अर्थ, and शून्य empty.
3340: अर्थागम m. (-मः) 1 Receipt or collection of property. 2 Acquisition of wealth. E. अर्थ wealth, and आगम coming.
3341: अर्थाधिकार m. (-रः) Stewardship, treasurership, charge of money or property. E. अर्थ, and अधिकार superintendence.
3342: अर्थाधिकारिन् m. (-री) A treasurer, a paymaster. E. अर्थ, and अधिकारिन् superintendent.
3343: अर्थान्तर n. (-रं) 1 Difference of meaning or purport. 2 Another or second sense. 3 Opposite or antithetical meaning. E. अर्थ, and अन्तर difference.
3344: अर्थान्तरन्यास m. (-सः) Antithesis. E. अर्थान्तर, and न्यास position.
3345: अर्थान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rich. 2 Significant. E. अर्थ wealth, and अन्वित possessed of.
3346: अर्थापत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 A figure of speech, a quibble, the use of one word in a double sense. 2 An inference from circumstances. E. अर्थ, and आपत्ति gaining.
3347: अर्थार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 One who solicits wealth. 2 One endeavouring to gain any object. E. अर्थ, and अर्थिन who seeks or solicits.
3348: अर्थिक m. (-कः) 1 A crier, a watchman, a minstrel, a servant whose duty it is to announce by song or music, fixed periods of the day, or those of getting up and of repose, &c. 2 A beggar, a solicitor. E. अर्थि a rich man, and क from के to call or sound.
3349: अर्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asked, begged, sought. E. अर्थ to ask, क्त aff.
3350: अर्थिता f. (-ता) Asking, begging. Also n. (-त्वं) E. तल् or त्व added to अर्थिन्.
3351: अर्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 One who asks or begs for any thing. 2 One who seeks to effect or gain a purpose or object. m. (-र्थी) 1 A servant. 2 A follower, a companion or partisan. 3 A plaintiff, a prosecutor. 4 A beggar, a petitioner. E. अर्थ asking, &c. इनि aff.
3352: अर्थोपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquiring wealth. E. अर्थ, and उपार्ज्जन acquiring.
3353: अर्थोष्मन् n. (-ष्म) Wealth, the condition of being wealthy. E. अर्थ, and उष्मन् warmth. So, anglice, a warm man.
3354: अर्थ्य mfn. (-र्थ्यः-र्थ्या-र्थ्यं) 1 Intelligent, wise. 2 Wealthy. 3 Right, proper. 4 Fit to be asked or sought. n. (-र्थ्यं) Red chalk. E. अर्थ and यत् aff.
3355: अर्द r. 1st cl. (अर्दति) 1 To ask or beg. 2 To go. 1st and 10th cls. (अर्दति-ते अर्दयति-ते) To kill or to hurt.
3356: अर्दना f. (-ना) 1 Begging, asking. 2 Giving pain. 3 Killing. 4 Going. E. अर्द to ask, &c. युच् and टाप् affs.
3357: अर्दनि m. (-निः) 1 Fire. 2 Asking, begging. 3 Sickness, disease. E. अर्द to pain, इनि aff.
3358: अर्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Asked, requested, begged. 2 Killed, injured. 3 Pained, afflicted. 4 Gone. n. (-तं) A disease, Hemiplegia, paralysis of the muscles on one side of the face and neck. E. अर्द to go, to ask, &c. affix, क्त and इट् inserted.
3359: अर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Half, halved. m. (-र्द्धं) A part. n. (-र्द्धं) A half. E. ऋध to increase, and घञ् aff.
3360: अर्द्धकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Halved, divided equally. E. अर्द्ध, and कृत made.
3361: अर्द्धखार nf. (-रं-री) A measure, half a khārī. E. अर्द्धं, and खारी a measure so called.
3362: अर्द्धगङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Kāverī river, in the peninsula. E. अर्द्ध half, and गङ्गा the Ganges; being a sacred stream, having half the virtues of the great Ganges.
3363: अर्द्धगुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A necklace of twenty-four strings. E. अर्द्ध, and गुच्छ a bundle.
3364: अर्द्धचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A crescent or half moon. 2 The hand bent into a semicircle or the shape of a claw, as for the purpose of seizing or clutching any thing. 3 The semicircular marks on a peacock's tail. 4 An arrow, with a head like a crescent. 5 The semicircular scratch of the finger nail. f. (-न्द्रा) A plant, vulgarly Teori, the black kind. E. अर्द्ध half, and चन्द्र moon, or with कन् added अर्द्धचन्द्रकः.
3365: अर्द्धचन्द्राकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Of the shape of the half moon. m. (रः) A meniscus. E. अर्द्धचन्द्र, and आकार form.
3366: अर्द्धचन्द्राकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Half mooned, of a crescent-shape, convex and concave. f. (-तिः) A meniscus. E. अर्द्धचन्द्र, and आकृति shape.
3367: अर्द्धचोलक m. (-कः) A short bodice. E. अर्द्ध, and चोलक a bodice.
3368: अर्द्धजाह्नवी f. (-वी) The Kāverī river. See अर्द्धगङ्ग, जाह्नवी being the Ganges.
3369: अर्द्धधार n. (रं) A knife or lancet with a single edge, the blade two inches long, the heft six. E. अर्द्ध, and धारा an edge.
3370: अर्द्धनारीश m. (-शः) A name of MAHĀDEVA. E. अर्द्ध, नारी a woman, and ईश master; one of the forms of ŚIVA, to which this name applies, being half male and half female.
3371: अर्द्धनाव m. (-वः) A boat's half. E. अर्द्ध, and नाव, from नौ a boat, and टच् aff.
3372: अर्द्धनिशा f. (-शा) Midnight. E. अर्द्ध, and निशा night.
3373: अर्द्धपण n. (-णं) Half a Paṇa. E. अर्द्ध, and पण a measure of four Kākiṇīs.
3374: अर्द्धपारावत m. (-तः) 1 A pigeon, (with a spotted or painted throat.) 2 The francoline partridge. E. अर्द्ध, and पारावत a pigeon.
3375: अर्द्धपुलायित n. (-तं) A half gallop, a canter. E. अर्द्ध, and पुलायित a gallop.
3376: अर्द्धप्रहर m. (-रः) Half a watch, a period of an hour and a half. E. अर्द्ध, and प्रहर a watch.
3377: अर्द्धभाग m. (-गः) A half. E. अर्द्ध, and भाग part.
3378: अर्द्धभाज् mf. (भाक्) Taking or sharing half. E. अर्द्ध half, and भाज who possesses.
3379: अर्द्धभागिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Taking or sharing half. E. अर्द्धभाग a half, ठक aff.
3380: अर्द्धभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Sharing or taking half. E. अर्द्धभाग and इनि aff.
3381: अर्द्धमाणव m. (-वः) A necklace of twelve strings. Also अर्द्धमाणवक. E. अर्द्ध, and माणव one of twenty-four strings.
3382: अर्द्धयाम m. (-मः) Half a watch, an hour and a half. E. अर्द्ध, and याम a watch, also अर्द्धयामक.
3383: अर्द्धरथ m. (-थः) A warrior, who fights on a car with another. E. अर्द्ध, and रथ a car, having half a car.
3384: अर्द्धरात्र m. (-त्रः) 1 Midnight. 2 The period from two and a half to three and a half watches of the night. E. अर्द्ध, and रात्र night.
3385: अर्द्धर्च mn. (-र्चः-र्चं) Half a verse of the Vedas. E. अर्द्ध, and ऋच् a verse of a Veda.
3386: अर्द्धवीक्षण n. (-णं) A side look, a glance, a leer. E. अर्द्ध, and वीक्षण looking.
3387: अर्द्धशत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fifty. 2 One hundred and fifty. E. अर्द्ध, and शत a hundred, in the second sense it is more usually सार्द्ध शत, &c. So अर्द्धपञ्चाशत्, अर्द्धसहस्र, &c.
3388: अर्द्धशन n. (-नं) Half a meal. E. अर्द्ध, and अशन eating, also अर्द्धाशन.
3389: अर्द्धसफर m. (-रः) A small fish, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM:) E. अर्द्ध, and सफर another fish, to which it is compared.
3390: अर्द्धसीरिन् m. (-री) A cultivator, a ploughman who takes half the crop for his labour. E. अर्द्ध, and सीर a plough, इनि aff.
3391: अर्द्धहार m. (-रः) A necklace of sixty-four strings. E. अर्द्ध, and हार a necklace.
3392: अर्द्धांश m. (-शः) A half. E. अर्द्ध, and अंश a share.
3393: अर्द्धांशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Sharing a half. E. अर्द्धांश and इनि aff.
3394: अर्द्धाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गः) Half the body. E. अर्द्ध, and अङ्ग the body.
3395: अर्द्धार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Sharing equally. m. (-र्द्धः) A quarter. E. अर्द्ध repeated.
3396: अर्द्धावभेदक m. (-कः) Pain of half the head, hemicrania. n. (-कं) Dividing in equal parts. E. अर्द्ध, and अवभेदक cutting off.
3397: अर्द्धाशन n. (-नं) Half a meal. Also अर्द्धशन.
3398: अर्द्धासन n. (-नं) 1 Exemption from censure. 2 Greeting kindly or with respect, placing on the same seat. E. अर्द्ध, and आस to remain, affix ल्युट्.
3399: अर्द्धिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Measuring a half. 2 Relating to a half. E. अर्द्ध and टिठन aff.
3400: अर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिणी-र्द्धि) Entitled to or sharing a half. E. अर्द्ध and इनि aff.
3401: अर्द्धेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A half moon or crescent. 2 The impression of a finger nail. 3 The hand expanded in a semicircular form like a claw. 4 An arrow with a crescent-shaped head. E. अर्द्धे, and इन्दु the moon.
3402: अर्द्धोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Half uttered, said imperfectly or indistinctly. E. अर्द्ध, and उक्त said.
3403: अर्द्धोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Speaking indistinctly or incompletely, broken or interrupted speech. E. अर्द्ध, and उक्ति speech.
