3404: अर्द्धोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Half risen. 2 Half uttered. E. अर्द्ध, and उदित risen.
3405: अर्द्धोरुक n. (-कं) A short petticoat. E. अर्द्ध, and उरु the thigh, कन् aff.
3406: अर्पण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Delivering, entrusting. 2 Placing in or upon. E. ऋ to go, in the causal form, युच् aff.
3407: अर्पणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be delivered, deliverable. E. ऋ to go, causal form, अनीयर aff.
3408: अर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Delivered, consigned. 2 Placed in or upon. E. ऋ to go, in the causal form, क्त aff.
3409: अर्पितकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Extending or giving the hand. 2 Married. E. अर्पित, and कर the hand.
3410: अर्पिस m. (-सः) The heart. E. ऋ to go, in the causal form अर्प, and इसन् Uṇādi aff.
3411: अर्प्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be delivered, consignable. E. ऋ to go, causal form, य aff.
3412: अर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (अर्ब्बति) 1 To go, to go to towards. 2 To kill or hurt. See अर्व्व.
3413: अर्ब्बुद mn. (-दः-दं) 1 Ophthalmia. 2 A hundred millions. m. (-दः) 1 The name of a mountain in the west of India, commonly Abū, a place of pilgrimage, especially to the Jains. 2 An indolent swelling. E. अर्ब to injure, उदच् affix; the root and derivative are also written with the dental letter.
3414: अर्भ mfn. (-र्भः-र्भा-र्भं) Destitute of splendour. m. (-र्भः) 1 A child, a pupil. 2 Dew. 3 Herbs. E. ऋ to go, and भन् Uṇādi aff.
3415: अर्भक m. (-कः) 1 A child, the young of any animal. 2 A fool, an idiot. 3 Small, minute. 4 Emaciated. 5 Like, similar. E. ऋध to grow, वुन् Uṇādi affix, and भ substituted for ध.
3416: अर्म्म mn. (-र्मः-र्मं) A disease of the eyes. E. ऋ to go, and मन Uṇādi affix, also read अर्म्मन्.
3417: अर्म्मण m. (-णः) A measure of one Droṇa.
3418: अर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) A disease of the eyes. E. ऋ to go, मनिन् aff.
3419: अर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Excellent. m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A master. 2 A man of the third tribe, the Vaiśya. f. (-र्य्यः) 1 A woman of the third tribe. 2 The wife of a Vaiśya. E. ऋ to go, यत् affix, and टाप् or ङीप् for the fem.; ङीष् is affixed, when the word is fem. with reference to the male.
3420: अर्य्यमन् m. (-मा) 1 The sun. 2 A class of the Manes or deified progenitors. 3 The asclepias plant. E. ऋ to go, कनिन् Uṇādi affix, and माङ् inserted.
3421: अर्य्यर्य्याणी f. (-णी) A multitude of women of the Vaiśya tribe.
3422: अर्य्याणी f. (-णी) A woman of the Vaiśya tribe. E. अर्य्य, ङीप् affix, and आनुक inserted. See अर्य्य.
3423: अर्व्व r. 1st cl. (अर्व्वति) To kill or hurt, also written अर्ब्ब.
3424: अर्व्वट n. (-टं) Ashes. E. अर्व्व or अर्ब्ब to injure, hence the word may be also written अर्ब्बट.
3425: अर्व्वन् mfn. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्) Low, inferior, vile. m. (-र्व्वा) 1 A horse. 2 A name of INDRA. 3 A short span. f. (-र्वती) 1 A mare. 2 A bawd, a procuress. E. ऋ to go, and वनिप् Uṇādi affix; it is sometimes derived from अर्ब्ब to go, and is then written अर्ब्बन्.
3426: अर्व्वाच् mfn. (-वाङ्-वाची-वाक्) Following, subsequent. ind. (वाच् or वाक्) 1 After, in time. 2 Behind, in place. 3 Near. E. अवर behind, अञ्च to go, and क्विप् affix; the formation is irregular.
3427: अर्व्वाचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Reverse, contrary. 2 Recent, modern. E. अर्व्वाच् and ख aff.
3428: अर्व्वाचीनत्व n. (-त्वं) State of reverse. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, अर्व्वाचीनता.
3429: अर्श n. (-र्शं) Hoemorrhoids, piles. Also अर्शस.
3430: अर्शस् n. (-र्शः) Hoemorrhoids, piles. E. ऋ to go, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and शुट् inserted.
3431: अर्शस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Afflicted with hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शस् and अच् aff.
3432: अर्शसान m. (-नः) Fire. E. ऋ to go, शानच् affix, and शुट् inserted.
3433: अर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Afflicted with hoemorrhoids. E. अश, and इनि aff.
3434: अर्शोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) Destroying the hoemorrhoids. m. (-घ्नः) An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.) f. (-घ्नी) A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.) E. अर्शस्, and घ्न what destroys, from हन to kill.
3435: अर्शोरोग m. (-गः) The piles or hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शस, and रोग disease.
3436: अर्शोरोगयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Afflicted with hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शोरोग, and युत affected by.
3437: अर्शोरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Having hoemorrhoids. E. अर्शोरोग and इनि aff.
3438: अर्शोहित m. (-तः) The marking-nut plant, (Semecarpus anacardium.) E. अर्शस्, and हित proper.
3440: अर्ह r. 1st cl. (अर्हति) 1 To worship or honour. 2 To be fit or worthy: in the first sense it is also r. 10th cl. (अर्हयति.)
3441: अर्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 1 Proper, fit, becoming. 2 Deserving, entitled to, worthy. m. (-र्हः) INDRA. f. (-र्हा) Worship. E. अर्ह to worship, to be fit, अच् aff.
3442: अर्हण nf. (-णं-णा) Worship, adoration, respect, courtesy, treating with veneration or respect. E. अर्ह to worship, and युच् aff.
3443: अर्हत् mfn. (-न्-न्ती-त्) 1 Venerable, respectable. 2 Praised, celebrated. m. (-न्) 1 A Jina or Jaina saint and teacher. 2 A Jain or follower of the doctrines of Jina. 3 A religious mendicant of that sect. E. अर्ह to worship, &c. and शतृ affix, of the present participle.
3444: अर्हत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Best, most worthy. E. अर्हन् respectable, डतम aff.
3445: अर्हत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) More worthy, better. E. अर्हत् and डत्तर aff.
3446: अर्हन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A Saugata or follower of the doctrines of Buddha. 2 A religious mendicant of the same sect. 3 A name of ŚIVA. E. अर्ह to worship, &c. and अन्त irregular aff.
3447: अर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Saluted, honoured, worshipped. E. अह to worship, &c. and क्त aff.
3448: अर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Venerable, respectable, right, fit. E. अह and यत् affix: also with अनीयर affix, अर्हणीय.
3449: अल r. 1st cl. also read अलं (अलति-ते) 1 To adorn. 2 To be competent or able. 3 To prevent.
3450: अल n. (-लं) 1 The sting in the tail of the scorpion. 2 Yellow orpiment. E. अल to adorn, &c. and अच् aff.
3451: अलक mn. (-कः-कं) A curl. m. (-कः) A mad dog. See अलर्क. f. (-का) 1 Alakā, the capital of KUVERA. 2 A young girl from eight to ten years of age. E. अल to adorn, &c. वुन् affix, and fem. टाप्.
3452: अलकनन्दा f. (-न्दा) 1 A young girl from eight to ten years old. 2 A river, the Alakanandā, a stream that runs from the Himālaya mountains, and falls into the Ganges near Srīnagar. It is also a name of the terrestrial Ganges. E. अलका, and नन्दा who delights, the final of the first dropped.
3453: अलकप्रभा f. (-भा) The capital of KUVERA. E. अलका and प्रभा what shines.
3455: अलकसंहति f. (-तिः) Rows of curls. E. अलक, and संहति collection. So अलकावली.
3456: अलकाधिप m. (-पः) A name of KUVERA. E. अलका the city, and अधिप a ruler.
3457: अलकाधिपति m. (-तिः) KUVERA. E. लका, and अधिपति ruler.
3458: अलकान्त m. (-न्तः) A ringlet, the end of a curl. E. अलक, and अन्त end.
3459: अलक्त m. (-क्तः) Lac, the red animal dye so called. E. अ neg. रक्त red, र being changed to ल; than what nothing is redder.
3460: अलक्तक n. (-कं) Lac, the dye; see the preceding. E. as before, कन् being added.
3461: अलक्तरस m. (-सः) Liquefied lac dye. E. अलक्त, and रस juice.
3462: अलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Unfortunate, ill fated, having no good marks on the person. 2 Undefined. n. (-णं) 1 The absence of auspicious marks. 2 Misfortune. 3 The want of any predicate or definition. E. अ priv. and लक्षण a mark.
3463: अलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unmarked, having no particular mark. 2 Unobserved, unseen. 3 Undefined. E. अ neg. and लक्षित marked.
3464: अलक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मीः) Misfortune, poverty. E. अ priv. and लक्ष्मी fortune.
3465: अलक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Undistinguishable, undefinable. So अलक्षणीय.
3466: अलगर्द m. (-र्दः) 1 The black variety of the Cobra de Capello, (Coluber naga.) 2 A large black leech. E. अ neg. लग to be with or near, and क्विप् affix अलक; again अर्द to go, and अच् affix; not trailing its whole length upon the ground: also अलगर्द्ध.
3467: अलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Not joined or connected. E. अ neg. लग्न attached to.
3468: अलघु mfn. (-घुः-घुः-घ्वी-घु) 1 Heavy, weighty. 2 Serious, solemn. 3 Violent, intense. E. अ neg. लघु light.
3469: अलघुप्रतिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Solemnly pledged or promised. E. अलघु, and प्रतिज्ञा agreement.
3470: अलघूपल m. (-लः) A rock. E. अलघु, and उपल a stone.
3471: अलघूष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) Intense heat. E. अलघु, and उष्मन् heat.
3472: अलङ्करण n. (-णं) Ornament, decoration. E. अलम् ornament, and करण what makes.
3473: अलङ्करिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Ornamented. 2 Fond of ornament. E. अलम् ornament, कर from कृ, and इष्णुच् aff.
3474: अलङ्कर्तृ mfn. (-र्ता-र्त्री-र्तृ) Ornamented, ornamenting. E. अलम् as before, and कर्तृ who makes.
3475: अलङ्कर्म्मीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Competent to an act, skilful, clever. E. अलम् able, fit for, कर्म्म act, business, ख aff.
3476: अलङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Ornament (of dress), trinkets, jewels, &c. 2 (Of language,) A figure or rhetorical expression. 3 The art of composition. E. अलम् ornament, कार what makes.
3477: अलङ्कारहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unadorned. E. अलङ्कार, and हीन void of.
3478: अलङ्क्रिया f. (-या) Adorning, ornamenting. E. अलस्, and क्रिया act.
3479: अलङ्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ornamented, adorned, lit. or fig. E. अलम् as before, कृत made.
3480: अलङ्घन n. (-नं) 1 Not transgressing. 2 Not passing over or beyond. E. अ neg. लङ्घन crossing.
3481: अलङ्घनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Impassable, not to be crossed. 2 Venerable, inviolable, not to be transgressed. E. अ neg. लङ्घनीय to be passed, also अलङ्घ्यः.
3482: अलङ्घनीयता f. (-ता) 1 The state of not being passable. 2 Inviolability, respectability. E. तल् added to the last, also अलङ्घमीयत्वं.
3483: अलङ्घ्य mfn. (-ङ्घ्यः-ङ्घ्या-ङ्घ्यं) 1 Inviolable. 2 Impassable. E. अ neg. लङ्घ्य to be crossed.
3484: अलङ्घ्यता f. (-ता) 1 Impassability, inaccessibility. 2 Superiority. 3 Authoritative or absolute rule. E. अलङ्घ्य not to be crossed or transgressed, तल् affix, also अलङ्घ्यत्वं.
3485: अलज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Shameless. E. अ neg. लज्जा shame. So अलज्जित.
3486: अलजी f. (-जी) Inflammation of the eye, at the edge of the cornea.
3487: अलञ्जर m. (-रः) An earthen water jar. E. अलम् able, and जॄ to decay, also अलिञ्जर.
3488: अलति m. (-तिः) A kind of song. E. अलम् ornament, and अति Uṇādi aff.
3489: अलन्तराम् ind. Quite enough, amply sufficient. E. अलं and तराम् aff.
3490: अलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Unobtained. E. अ and लब्ध attained.
3491: अलन्धूम m. (-मः) A great smoke. E. अलम् much, and धूम smoke.
3492: अलभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Unattainable, unobtainable, E. अ neg. लभ्य to be got.
3493: अलम् ind. 1 Ornament. 2 Enough, abundance. 3 Able, adequate or equal to. 4 Prohibition, no, not. 5 Unnecessary, no need of. It is chiefly used in composition, as अलञ्जीविकः having enough for subsistence; अलन्दत्वा refusing to give; इत्यलम् enough; अलङ्कार ornament, &c. E. अल to adorn, &c. and अम् aff.
3494: अलम्पुरुषीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fit for a man, becoming a man. E. अलन्, पुरुष a man, and ख aff.
3495: अलम्बुष m. (-षः) 1 The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. 2 Vomiting, sickness. 3 The name of a Rākṣasa or goblin. f. (-षा) 1 One of the Apsarasas or nymphs of Svarga. 2 Madder, (Rubia manjith.) 3 A sort of sensitive plant. 4 A barrier, a line or any thing not to be crossed. E. अलम्, and बुस to injure, affix क.
3496: अलय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Houseless, homeless. E. अ neg. and लय place of refuge.
3497: अलर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 White swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea alba.) 2 A mad dog or one rendered furious. 3 A fabulous animal, like a hog with eight legs. 4 An Asura changed to such an animal. Also अलर्क्क. E. अल to adorn, &c. क्विप् affix, and अर्क to inflame or heat.
3498: अलले ind. A word of no import, occurring in the dialect or gibberish of Piśācas, a class of imps or goblins, when they are introduced in plays, &c.
3499: अलवाल n. (-लं) A basin for water at the root of a tree. E. अ neg. लू to cut, and आल affix; also आलवाल.
3500: अलवालक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. as before, कन् added.
3501: अलस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Lazy, idle, indolent. m. (-सः) 1 Swelling of the feet in elephantiasis. 2 Chaps between the toes. 3 Name  of a tree. f. (-सा) A creeping plant, (Cissus pedata.) E. अ neg. and लस to work, affix अच्.
3502: अलसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Indolent. m. (-कः) Flatulence, Tympanitis, intumescence of the abdomen, with constipation and wind. E. कन् added to the last.
3503: अलसता f. (-ता) Idleness. E. अलस and तल् aff.
3504: अलसत्व n. (-त्वं) Idleness. E. अलस and त्वं aff.
3505: अलसेक्षणा f. (-णा) A woman with languishing looks. E. अलस idle, and ईक्षणा looking.
3506: अलात n. (-तं) A fire brand, whether burning or extinguished. E. अ neg. ला to take, and क्त aff.
3507: अलाबु f. (-बुः) A long gourd. See the next word.
3508: अलाबू f. (-बूः) The bottle gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaris.) E. अ neg. लब to sink, ऊ Uṇādi affix; म् is dropped, and the preceding vowel lengthened: what does not sink in water; floats, &c. are made of this gourd, especially when hollowed: also अलाबु and आलाबु.
3509: अलाबूकट n. (-टं) The down of the gourd. E. अलाबू and कटच् aff.
3510: अलाभ m. (-भः) 1 Non-acquirement, not getting. 2 Loss. E. अ neg. लाभ gain.
3511: अलार m. (-रः) A door. E. अल able, and ऋ to go, अच् affix; by which one may go.
3512: अलास m. (-सः) Inflammation and abscess at the root of the tongue. E. अ neg. लास saliva.
3513: अलि m. (-लिः) 1 A large black bee. 2 A scorpion. 3 The sign Scorpio. 4 A crow. 5 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 6 Spirituous liquor. E. अल to be able, &c. and इण Uṇādi aff.
3514: अलिक n. (-कं) The forehead. E. अल to adorn, &c. and इकन् affix; also अलीक.
3515: अलिकुल n. (-लं) A flight or a number of bees. E. अलि, and कुल a number.
3516: अलिगर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A snake, the black Cobra. E. अलि, and गर्द्ध to sound, affix अच्; hissing like the scorpion.
3517: अलिङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) An impostor, a pretended ascetic or student, one wearing the usual marks, as the frontal marks, skin, staff, &c. without belonging in reality to a religious order. E. अ neg. लिङ्ग sectarial mark, इनि aff.
3518: अलिजिह्वा f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. Also अलिजिह्विका.
3519: अलिञ्जर m. (-रः) An earthen water jar. E. अलिम् strength, acc. of अलि and जॄ to waste, अच् aff.
3520: अलिन् m. (-ली) 1 A large black bee. 2 A scorpion. E. अल a sting, and इनि aff.
3521: अलिन्द m. (-न्दः) A terrace before a house. E. अल to adorn, &c. and किन्दच् affix; also आलिन्द.
3522: अलिपक m. (कः) 1 A large black bee. 2 A scorpion. 3 A dog. Also read अलिम्पक and अलिमक.
3523: अलिपिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Ignorant of reading and writing. E. अ neg. लिपि writing, ज्ञ who knows.
3524: अलिप्रिय n. (-यं) The red lotus, (Nymphoea rubra.) f. (-या) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. अलि a bee, and प्रिय beloved, the object of the bee's affections: the lotus especially is so described by the poets.
3525: अलिप्सा f. (-प्सा) Freedom from desire or cupidity. E. अ neg. and लिप्सा wish.
3526: अलिमक m. (-कः) 1 A frog. 2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 3 A large black bee. 4 The filaments of the lotus. 5 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. अलि from अल to adorn, मकच् affix; also अलिपक.
3527: अलिमाला f. (-ला) A flight of bees. E. अलि, and माला a necklace.
3528: अलिम्पक m. (-कः) 1 A bee. 2 The Kokila. 3 A dog. 4 The filaments of the lotus. E. अ neg. लिपि to smear, वुन् affix; also read अलिवकः and अलिम्बकः.
3529: अलिविराव m. (-वः) The hum of bees. E. अलि, and विराव sound.
3530: अलिविरुत n. (-तं) The song or hum of the bee. E. अलि, and विरुत sound.
3531: अलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 False. 2 Unpleasing. 3 Small, little. n. (-कं) 1 Falsehood, untruth. 2 Any thing displeasing. 3 Heaven. 4 The forehead. E. अल to adorn, &c. and कीकच Uṇādi aff.
3532: अलीकता f. (-ता) Falsehood, vanity: also अलीकत्व. E. तल् or त्व added to the last.
3533: अलीकमत्स्य m. (-त्स्यः) A cake of beans fried with Sesamum oil. E. अलीक unreal, मत्स्य fish.
3534: अलु f. (-लुः) A small water pot. E. ऋ to go, and उच् affix, र becomes ल; also आलु.
3535: अलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Moderate, content, not covetous. E. अ, and लुब्ध covetous.
3536: अलून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Uncut, unshorn. E. अ neg. लून cut.
3537: अले ind. An unmeaning word in the dialect of the demons or Piśācas, when they are introduced in plays, &c. also अलले.
3538: अलेले ind. See the preceding word.
3539: अलेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Much, large. adv. n. (-शं) Not at all. E. अ neg. लेश small.
3540: अलेशैज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Firm, steady. E. अलेश not at all, एज what shakes.
3541: अलोकन n. (-नं) Disappearance, invisibility. E. अ neg. लोकन seeing.
3542: अलोकनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Invisible, imperceptible. E. अ neg. लोकनीय visible.
3543: अलोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unseen. E. अ neg. लोकित seen.
3544: अलोभ m. (-भः) Moderation, content, absence of cupidity. E. अ, and लोभ desire.
3545: अलोभिन् mfn. (-भी-भिनी-भि) Not wanting or desiring any thing, free from desire. E. अ, and लोभिन् desirous.
3546: अलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Firm, steady, tranquil, unagitated. E. अ neg. लोल moving.
3547: अलोलु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Indifferent to sensual objects. E. अ neg. लोल to desire, affix उ.
3548: अलोलुप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Free from desire. E. अ neg. लोलुप libidinous.
3549: अलोलुत्व n. (-त्वं) Indifference to sensual objects. E. अलोलु and त्व affix: also अलोलुता.
3551: अलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Supernatural, not relating, to this world. 2 Not common, not current in the world. 3 Indifferent to the world, unworldly. E. अ neg. लौकिक mundane.
3552: अल्क m. (-ल्कं) 1 A tree. 2 A member of the body.
3553: अल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) 1 Little, small. 2 Inferior, low. E. अल to be able, &c. प affix or with कन् added अल्पक.
3554: अल्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Small, minute. E. अल्प and कन् added.
3555: अल्पकेशी f. (-शी) The root of sweet flag. E. अल्प small, and केशी having filaments, &c.
3556: अल्पगन्ध n. (न्धं) The red lotus. E. अल्प, and गन्ध smell.
3557: अल्पज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Ignorant, shallow, superficial. E. अल्प and ज्ञ who knows.
3558: अल्पतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Small, short, thing, pigmy, having a little body. E. अल्प, and तनु the body.
3559: अल्पता f. (-ता) 1 Smallness, minuteness. 2 Inferiority, insignificance. E. अल्प and तल् affix, or with त्व, अल्पत्वं.
3560: अल्पदक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Defective in presents, (any ceremony, &c.) E. अल्प, and दक्षिणा gift to Brahmans.
3561: अल्पधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of little wealth, not affluent. E. अल्प, and घन wealth.
3562: अल्पधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Ignorant, foolish, of little sense. E. अल्प, and धी understanding.
3563: अल्पपत्र m. (-त्रः) A species of the Tulasi. E. अल्प, and पत्र a leaf.
3564: अल्पपद्म n. (-द्मं) The red lotus. E. अल्प small, and पद्म lotus.
3565: अल्पप्रभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Insignificant, of little weight or consequence. E. अल्प, and प्रभाव authority.
3566: अल्पप्रमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Of little authority. 2 Of little weight or measure. E. अल्प and प्रमाण authority, &c.
3567: अल्पप्रमाणक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Credulous, resting on little evidence. 2 Of little weight or authority. 3 Of short measure. m. (-कः) Common cucumber, (Cucumis sativus.) E. अल्प, and प्रमाण authority, &c. कन् added.
3568: अल्पबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Feeble, of little strength. E. अल्प, and वल strength.
3569: अल्पबाध m. (-धः-धा-धं) Causing little annoyance or inconvenience. E. अल्प, and बाधा pain.
3570: अल्पबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Ignorant, silly, unwise. E. अल्प, बुद्धि understanding.
3571: अल्पमात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A little, a little only. 2 A short time, a few moments. E. अल्प, and मात्र only.
3572: अल्पमारिष m. (-षः) A kind of amaranth, (Amaranthus polygamus.) E. अल्प, मृष to hurt, and इमच् aff.
3573: अल्पमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Small, diminutive. f. (-र्त्तिः) A small figure or object. E. अल्प, and मूर्त्ति form.
3574: अल्पमेधस् mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः) Ignorant, silly, of little understanding. E. अल्प, and मेधस् apprehension.
3575: अल्पवयस् mfn. (-याः-याः-यः) Young, of few years. E. अल्प, and वयस् life.
3576: अल्पवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Taciturn: also अल्पभाषिन्. E. अल्प and वादिन् or भाषिन् who speaks.
3577: अल्पविषय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Meaning or directing a little. E. अल्प, and विषय object.
3578: अल्पविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Ill taught, uneducated, ignorant. E. अल्प and विद्या knowledge.
3579: अल्पशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Weak, feeble. E. अल्प, and शक्ति power.
3580: अल्पशस ind. 1 A little. 2 To a few. E. अल्प and शसि aff.
3581: अल्पसरस् n. (-रः) A basin, a small pond, one which is shallow or dry in the hot season. E. अल्प, and सरस् a pool.
3582: अल्पाकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Contented, satisfied with little. E. अल्प, and आकाङ्क्षिन् who desires.
3583: अल्पायुस् mfn. (-युः-युः-युः) 1 Short lived. 2 Young, of few years. m. (-युः) A goat. E. अल्प, and आयस् life.
3584: अल्पाल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) 1 Very little, minute. 2 Grandual, little at a time. E. अल्प repeated.
3585: अल्पाहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Moderate, abstemious. m. (-रः) Moderation, abstinence. E. अल्प, and आहार food.
3586: अल्पाहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Abstemious, moderate. E. अल्प, and आहारिन् who feeds.
3587: अल्पिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Least, smallest, very small. E. अल्प, and इष्ठच् affix of the superlative.
3588: अल्पीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reduced, comminuted, made little or few. E. अल्प and कृत with च्चि inserted.
3589: अल्पीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reduced, diminished, become little or few. E. अल्प, and भूत become, च्चि inserted.
3590: अल्पीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very small. E. अल्प and ईयसुन् affix. Also अल्पिष्ठ.
3591: अल्पोन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Defective, not quite finished, not wholly entire. E. अल्प a little, ऊन less.
3592: अल्ला f. (-ल्ला) A mother, in dramatic language.
3593: अव r. 1st cl. (अवति) 1 To keep, protect or defend. 2 To please. (The following meanings, although found in lists of roots, are rarely used:) 3 To move. 4 To excite affection or be lovely. 5 To satisfy. 6 To know or apprehend. 7 To enter. 8 To be near. 9 To own, to have a right. 10 To obey. 11 To act. 12 To desire. 13 To shine or be splendid. 14 To obtain. 15 To embrace. 16 To kill or hurt. 17 To take. 18 To be. 19 To grow. In place of 9, 17, and 18 as above, some read; 9 To be able. 17 To burn, and 18 To divide or share.
3594: अव ind. A preposition and prefix to words, corresponding to off, from, down from, out, away, &c. and implying; 1 Diminution. 2 Depreciation. 3 Diffusion. 4 Support, resting. 5 Commanding. 6 Purifying, correcting. 7 Knowledge. 8 Disrespect. 9 Nourishing. As अवगन्तुं To go away; अवज्ञातुं To disrespect; अवतरितुं To come down, to descend; अवस्थातुं To remain in or on; अवहर्त्तुं To take off or away; also अवमः a low man; अवाक् reverse, behind; अवकोकिलः a koïl with a bad voice, &c.
3595: अवकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Opposite, contrary. 2 Backwards. 3 Downwards. n. (-टं) Opposition, contrariety, reverse. E. अव down, and कठच् aff.
3596: अवकम्पित m. A Buddha. E. अव, and कम्पित shaken.
3597: अवकर m. (-रः) Dust or sweepings. E. अव spreading, and कर what makes.
3598: अवकर्त्तन n. (-नं) Excision, cutting off. E. अव and कर्त्तन cutting.
3599: अवकर्षण n. (-र्णं) 1 Taking or pulling out, extraction, expulsion. 2 Pulling, dragging. E. अव, and कर्षण pulling.
3600: अवकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen. E. अव and कलित part. past of कल to sound, &c.
3601: अवकाश m. (-शः) 1 Leisure, opportunity. 2 Interval, space. 3 An open or wide space. 4 A receptacle, a repository, a place in which any thing is kept. 5 A place, a spot, a situation. E. अव between, &c. काश to shine, अच् aff.
3602: अवकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Coarsely pounded. 2 Scattered. 3 Disregarded, violated. E. अव implying separation, कॄ to scatter in the irregular part. past.
3603: अवकीर्णिन् mfn. (-र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) Violating a vow or engagement to be chaste, abstemious, &c. m. (-र्णी) The religious student who has committed an act of incontinency. E. अव before, कॄ to scatter, क्त the part. past, and इनि aff.
3604: अवकीर्णिव्रत n. (-तं) Penance for an act of incontinency. E. अवकीर्णिन् and व्रत religious obligation.
3605: अवकुञ्चन n. (-नं) Bending, curving, flexure, contraction. E. अव and कुञ्चन curving.
3606: अवकुटार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Opposite, contrary. 2 Backwards. 3 Downwards. n. (-रं) Reverse, contrariety. E. अव and कुटार aff.
3607: अवकुट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Vexed. 2 Inflamed. 3 Cut off. E. अव, and कुट्ट to heat, &c. क्त aff.
3608: अवकुण्ठन n. (-नं) 1 Investing, surrounding. 2 Attracting. E. अव, before कुठ to surround, ल्युट् aff.
3609: अवकुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Affected. 2 Surrounded, attracted. E. अव before कुठ to surround, क्त aff.
3610: अवकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Expelled, turned out. 2 Removed, sent away, drawn aside. 3 Extracted. 4 Pulled. 5 Inferior, low. 6 Degraded, outcaste. m. (-ष्टः) A servant who performs the lowest office, a sweeper, a waterman, &c. E. अव out of, and कृष्ट drawn.
3611: अवकृष्य ind. 1 Having drawn out or extracted. 2 Having drawn together or contracted. E. अव, and कृष to draw, यत् aff.
3612: अवकेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Barren. E. अव privative, केश properly hair, in this instance fruit, and इनि aff.
3613: अवक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Not to be said, improper. 2 Indescribable. E. अ neg. वक्तव्य to be said.
3614: अवक्र mfn. (-क्रः-क्रा-क्रं) 1 Straight. 2 Upright, honest. E. अ neg. वक्र crooked liter. and metaph.
3615: अवक्रन्दन n. (-नं) Weeping aloud. E. अव, and क्रन्दन crying.
3616: अवक्रय m. (-यः) Price. E. अव, and क्री to buy, अच् aff.
3617: अवक्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Descent, descending. 2 Approaching, going near to. E. अव, and क्रान्ति passing.
3618: अवक्रिया f. (-या) Neglect, omission, non-performance of prescribed acts. E. अव priv. क्रिया act.
3619: अवक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sounded ill or badly. 2 Reviled, abused. E. अव, and क्रुष्ट sounded.
3620: अवक्रोश m. (-शः) 1 A disagreeable noise. 2 A curse, an imprecation. 3 Abuse. E. अव and क्रुश to sound, घञ् aff.
3621: अवक्लेद m. (-दः) 1 Ichor, malignant or fetid discharge. 2 Trickling, descent of moisture. E. अव, and क्लेद what wets.
3622: अवक्लेदन n. (-नं) Trickling, falling as dew or moisture. E. अव and क्लेदन wetting.
3623: अवक्वण m. (-णः) A discord, a false note. E. अव, and क्वण a sound.
3624: अवक्वाथ m. (-थः) Imperfect digestion or decoction. E. अव and क्वाथ a decoction.
3625: अवक्षय m. (-यः) Loss, waste, destruction. E. अव, and क्षय waste.
3626: अवक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Said sarcastically, imputed, insinuated. 2 Ill thrown. 3 Thrown down. E. अव, and क्षिप्त thrown.
3627: अवक्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Emaciated, wasted. E. अव, and क्षीण wasted.
3628: अवक्षुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sneezed upon. E. अव, and क्षुत sneezed.
3629: अवक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Sarcasm, irony. 3 Throwing wrong or improperly. 3 Throwing down. E. अव, and क्षेप throwing.
3630: अवगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disregarded, despised. E. अव, गण to count or reckon in the past. part.
3631: अवगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A boil or pimple upon the face. E. अव, गडि to affect the cheek, अच् aff.
3632: अवगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Gone, gone off or away. 3 Assented, promised. E. अव implying knowledge, and गत part. past of गम to go.
3633: अवगति f. (-तिः) 1 Knowledge in general. 2 Departure, removal. E. अव, गम to go, and क्तिन् aff.
3634: अवगथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Bathing or bathed early in the morning. E. अव, ग from गम to go, and थक् aff.
3635: अवगदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unsaid, unuttered. E. अव reverse, गदित said.
3636: अवगन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Meant, intended to be known or understood. 2 To be quitted. So अवगम्य. E. अव and गन्तव्य to be gone.
3637: अवगम m. (-मः) 1 Knowledge, certainty. 2 Removal, departure. E. अव, and गम going.
3638: अवगाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Immersed, plunged, bathed. 2 Deep. E. अवगाह and क्त aff.
3639: अवगाढवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Bathing, plunging, diving. E. अवगाढ and वतुप् aff.
3640: अवगाद m. (-दः) A small wooden bason for baling water out of a boat. E. अव for अप water, ग from गम to go, and आदक् aff.
3641: अवगाह m. (-हः) 1 Bathing. 2 Bathing place, bath. E. अब before, गाह to agitate: also वगाह.
3642: अवगाहन n. (-नं) Bathing. E. अवगाह and ल्युट् aff.
3643: अवगाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bathed, immersed. E. अवगाह, and क्त affix, with इट् augment.
3644: अवगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reproached, abused, censured. 2 Wicked, vile. 3 Sung depreciatingly, satirised in song. 4 Sung badly. n. (-तं) 1 Reproach, blame. 2 Satire in song. 3 Bad singing. E. अव bad, &c. गीत sounded, sung.
3645: अवगुण्ठन n. (-नं) 1 A veil. 2 Sweeping. 3 Hiding, veiling. E. गुठि to enclose, with अव prefixed, and ल्युट् aff.
3646: अवगुण्ठिका f. (-का) See the preceding. E. as before, with वुन् and टाप् aff.
3647: अवगुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Concealed, covered, veiled, screened. E. अवगुठ to enclose, क्त aff.
3648: अवगुण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pounded, ground, pulverulent. E. अव prefixed to गुण्डित pounded.
3649: अवगोरण n. (-णं) Assailing with weapons, assaulting with intent to kill. E. अव, गुर् or गूर् to assault, ल्युट् aff.
3650: अवग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Taking, acceptance. 2 Taking off or away, seizure. 3 Disrespect. 4 Drought. 5 Obstacle, impediment. 6 An elephant's forehead. 7 A herd of elephants. 8 Nature, original temperament. 9 A sort of knowledge, a false idea. 10 An imprecation or term of abuse. E. अव before, ग्रह to take or seize, अप् affix: also अवग्राह.
3651: अवग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Obstacle, impediment. 2 Disrespect. E. अव, ग्रह to take, and ल्युट् aff.
3652: अवग्राह m. (-हः) 1 An imprecation or term of abuse, as अवग्राहस्ते स्यात्, may disappointment befall you. 2 Drought. 3 Disgrace, discomfiture: see अवग्रह. E. as before, and घञ् aff.
3653: अवगृह्य n. (-ह्यं) An inflection, an inflective termination. E. अव before ग्रह to take, क्यप् aff.
3654: अवघट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A hole in the ground, a cave, a cavern. E. अव down, low, घट्ट to move, अच् aff.
3655: अवघर्षण n. (-णं) Rubbing, scrubbing. E. अव, and घर्षण rubbing.
3656: अवघर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rubbed, scrubbed. E. अव, and घर्षित rubbed.
3657: अवघात m. (-तः) 1 Threshing corn, by bruising it with a wooden pestle in a mortar of the same material. 2 Sudden or violent death. 3 Strinking, killing. 4 A violent or fatal blow. E. अव, and घात struck.
3658: अवघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Striking, killing. E. अव before हन to strike, णिनि aff.
3659: अवघुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Proclaimed, denounced. E. अव, and घुष्ट cried.
3660: अवघूर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A whirling round. 2 A whirlpool. E. अव before घूर्ण to roll round, अच् aff.
3661: अवघूर्णन n. (-नं) Rolling or whirling round. E. अव, and घूर्णन rolling.
3662: अवघूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Whirled round. E. अव, and घूर्णित whirled.
3663: अवघोषण n. (-णं) Crying, proclaiming, denouncing. E. अव, and घोषण proclamation.
3664: अवचन n. (-नं) Silence, not speaking. E. अ neg. वचन word.
3665: अवचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be spoken, improper. E. अ neg. वचनीय to be said.
3666: अवचनीयता f. (-ता) Impropriety of speech. E. अवचनीय and तल् affix; also अवचनीयत्वं.
3667: अवचय m. (-यः) Gathering, especially flowers, fruits, &c. E. अव, and चय collecting; also अवचाय.
3668: अवचस्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Silent, not speaking. E. अ neg. वच speech, कर who makes.
3669: अवचार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be cast down. 2 To be given. 3 To be put on or applied. E. अव, चर to go, causal form, यत् aff.
3670: अवचूड m. (-डः) The crest or ornamented top of a standard, hanging downwards. E. अव, चूडा a crest; also अवचूडक and अवचूल.
3671: अवचूर्णन n. (-नं) 1 Pounding, grinding, reducing to powder. 2 Sprinkling absorbent powders on sores. E. अव, चूर्ण to pound, ल्युट् aff.
3672: अवचूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Coarsely pounded. E. अव, चूर्ण to pound, in the part. past.
3673: अवचूल m. (-लः) 1 The ornamented head of a standard, when the ornaments, streamers, peacockś tails, &c. hang downward. 2 A chowri. E. अव inferior, and चूडा crest, ड changed to ल.
3674: अवचूलक n. (-कं) A chowri or brush formed of a cow's tail, peacock's feathers, &c. for fanning off lies. E. कन् affixed to the preceding.
3675: अवच्छात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Emaciated by abstinence. 2 Reaped. 3 Cut off. E. अव before छो to destroy, क्त aff.
3676: अवच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Cut off. 2 Divided, separated, detached. 3 In logic, predicated. i. e. separated from every thing else by the properties especially predicated of any thing. 4 Bounded. E. अव affix, छिन्न cut.
3677: अवच्छुरित n. (-तं) A horse laugh. E. अव, छुर to cut or split, and the affix of the part. past: what splits, (one's sides.)
3678: अवच्छुरितक n. (-कं) A horse laugh. E. see the preceding word, कन् being added.
3679: अवच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 A predicate, the property of a thing by which it is distinguished from every other. 3 A part, a portion. 3 A boundary, a barrier. 4 Amputation, excision. E. अव off, छेद cutting.
3680: अवच्छेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Peculiar, distinguishing, that which separates. 2 Bounding, separating one thing from another. m. (-कः) 1 A predicate, a property. 2 A barrier, a boundary. E. कन् added to the last.
3681: अवच्छेदन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting off. 2 Separating, dividing. 3 Discriminating, distinguishing. E. अव, and छेदन cutting.
3682: अवच्छेदावच्छेद m. (-दः) Generalising, removing distinctions. E. अवछेद a distinction, and cutting off.
3683: अवजनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Born. E. अव, and जनित born.
3684: अवजय m. (-यः) Overcoming, victory. E. अव, and जय conquer.
3685: अवजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Conquered. 2 Contemned, disregarded. E. अव, and जित conquered.
3686: अवज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Disrespect. E. अव, ज्ञा to know, अङ् affix, and टाप for the fem.; also अवज्ञता.
3687: अवज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected. E. अव, ज्ञात part. past, of ज्ञा to know.
3688: अवज्ञान n. (-नं) Disrepect. E. अव before ज्ञान knowledge.
3689: अवज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Contemptible, disreputable, to be treated with disrespect: so अवज्ञातव्य. E. अव, and ज्ञा to know, यत् aff.
3690: अवज्ञोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Degraded, humiliated. E. अवज्ञा, and उपहत wounded.
3691: अवट m. (-टः) 1 A hole, a vacuity. 2 A hole in the ground, a chasm, a pit. 3 Any depressed part of the body, a cavity, a fosse, a sinus. 4 A well. 5 A juggler. E. अव to preserve, अटन् aff.
3692: अवटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A mart; also अवटङ्ग.
3693: अवटि m. (-टिः) 1 A hole in the ground. 2 In anatomy, a sinus. a hollow, a cavity. E. as before, अटिन् aff.
3694: अवटीट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Flat-nosed. E. अव implying lowness, flatness, and टीटच् aff.
3695: अवटु f. (-टः) 1 The back of the neck. 2 A hole in the ground. 2 A well. 4 The name of a tree. E. अव down, and टीक to go, irregular affix डु; or अ neg. वट to surround, and उ aff.
3696: अवटुज m. (-जः) A hind curl, the hair on the back of the head. E. अवटु, and ज born.
3697: अवडीन n. (-नं) The flight of a bird, or a particular act of such flight; flying down. E. अव down, &c. and डीन flying: see प्रडीन, उड्डीन, &c.
3698: अवतंस mn. (-सः-सं) 1 An ear-ring. 2 A crest. E. अव, तसि a Sautra root to adorn, अच्, aff.
3699: अवतंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Having an ear-ring. 2 Crested. E. अवतंस and इतच् aff.
3700: अवतति f. (-तिः) Stretching, extending. E. अव, and तन to spread, क्तिन् aff.
3701: अवतमस n. (-सं) Slight darkness, obscurity. E. अव implying deficiency, and तमस् darkness, अच् aff.
3702: अवतरण n. (-णं) 1 Descending, alighting. 2 Crossing. 3 Translating. 4 Quoting, citing. E. अव down, तॄ to cross, ल्युट् aff.
3703: अवतान m. (-नः) Stretching, extension. E. अव before तन to stretch, affix ण.
3704: अवतार n. (-रं) 1 Descent, especially of a deity from heaven; the appearance of any deity upon earth, but more particularly the incarnations of VIṢṆU in ten principal forms which are well known, viz. 1 The fish. 2 The tortoise. 3 The boar. 4 The man-lion. 5 The dwarf. 6 and 7 The two RĀMAS. 8 KṚṢṆA. 9 BUDDHA. And 10 KALKI. A pious or distinguished person, in the language of respect or flattery, is also called an Avatāra, a descent or incarnation of the deity. 2 A Tīrtha or sacred place. 3 Translation, translating. 3 Descent. 4 Crossing. E. अव before, तॄ to cross, affix घञ्.
3705: अवतारण n. (-णं) 1 Possession by an evil spirit. 2 The ends or border of a garment. 3 Worship, adoration. 4 Taking out. E. अव, तॄ to pass, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
3706: अवतारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken off or out, laid down or aside. 2 Descended. E. अव and तॄ causal form, क्त aff.
3707: अवतीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Descended, alighted. 2 Crossed, passed over. 3 Translated. E. अव and तॄ with क्त aff.
3708: अवतोका f. (-का) A cow miscarrying from accident. E. अव, implying censure, and तोक offspring.
3709: अवदंश m. (-शः) A relish, or what excites thirst. E. अव, दंश to bite, to be pungent, अच् aff.
3710: अवदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Given away. 2 Finished, accomplished. E. अव before दा to give, क्त aff.
3711: अवदात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 White. 2 Yellow. 3 Clean, clear. 4 Beautiful. m. (-तः) White, (the colour.) E. अव, दै to cleanse, क्त affix of the part. past.
3712: अवदातक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) As above. m. (-कः) White. E. कन् added to the last.
3713: अवदान n. (-नं) 1 Approved occupation. 2 An act accomplished. 3 Achievement, a great or glorious act. 4 Breaking, dividing. 5 The root of a fragrant grass; see अवदाह. 6 An oblation. E. अव, दै to cleanse, to purify, or दा to give, and ल्यट् aff.
3714: अवदारण n. (-णं) 1 A spade or hoe. 2 Tearing, dividing. E. अव down, दॄ to tear or rend, ल्युट् aff.
3715: अवदारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Torn, rent. E. अव before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.
3716: अवदाह n. (-हं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). E. अब reverse, and दाह heat, burning, heat-preventing, from its being used in Tātis or screens, placed before doors, &c. and kept constantly wet: the air passing through these, blows into a room cool and refreshing.
3718: अवदाहेष्टकापथ n. (-थ) See अवदाह. See also इष्टकापथ.
3719: अवदीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Melted, fused, liquefied. 2 Torn, rent, sundered. E. अव, दॄ to separate, irregular part. past.
3720: अवदून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Regretted. E. अव, दु to be sorry, affix क्त.
3721: अवदोह m. (-हः) Milk. E. अव, दुह to milk, घञ् aff.
3722: अवद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Low, inferior. 2 Disagreeable, disliked. n. (-द्यं) Sin, vice. E. अ neg. वद to speak, and यत् affix of the part. future; not to be spoken.
3723: अवद्रङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A market or fair.
3724: अवधातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be attended to, deserving attention and care. So अबधानीय and अवधेय. E. अव before धा to have, तव्य, अनीयर or यत् aff.
3725: अवधान n. (-नं) 1 Attention, attentiveness, intentness. 2 Care, carefulness. E. अव, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
3726: अवधानता f. (-ता) Attentiveness. E. अवधान attention, तल् added, also with त्व, अवधानत्व n. (-त्वं.)
3727: अवधारण n. (-णं) 1 Determining, certainty, ascertainment. 2 Emphasis. E. अव before धृ to hold, ल्युट् aff.
3728: अवधारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be ascertained. E. अव before धृ to hold, causal form, अनीयर aff.
3729: अवधारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, known, ascertained. E. अव before धृ to hold, causal form, क्त aff.
3730: अवधार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be ascertained or known. E. अव before धृ to hold, causal form, यत् aff.
3731: अवधावन n. (-नं) 1 Running after, pursuing. 2 Taking, seizure. 3 Cleaning. E. अव, धाव to run, affix ल्युट्.
3732: अवधावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be run after. 2 To be seized. E. अव after, धाव to run, अनीयर aff.
3733: अवधावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Chased, pursued. 2 Cleaned. E. अव before धाव to run, affix क्त.
3734: अवधि m. (-धिः) 1 Limit, division. 2 Period, time. 3 A hole, a pit. 4 Agreement, engagement. 5 Conclusion, termination. 6 Attention, application. 7 Care. E. अव, धा to have, कि aff.
3735: अवधिता f. (-ता) Limit, limitation. E. अवधि with तल् affix; also with त्व, अवधित्वं.
3736: अवधीर r. 10th cl. (अवधीरयति) To disregard, to disrespect.
3737: अवधीरण n. (-णं) Treating with disrespect. E. अवधीर and ल्युट aff.
3738: अवधीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected, disregarded. E. अवधीर and क्त aff.
3739: अवधूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Compelled. 2 Discarded. 3 Shaken, removed, tossed. 4 Trodden upon. 5 Separated from worldly feeling and obligation. E. अव, and धूत shaken.
3740: अवधूनन n. (-नं) 1 Shaking, causing to shake. 2 Expelling. 3 Being in agitation, trembling. 4 Trampling on, treading on E. अव before धूनन shaking.
3741: अवध्वंस m. (-सः) 1 Censure, blame. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 3 Pounding, grinding. E. अव before ध्वंस to go, घञ् aff.
3742: अवध्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Pounded coarsely. 2 Abandoned. 3 Censured. E. अव separate, &c. ध्वस to go, part. affix क्त.
3743: अवन n. (-नं) 1 Satisfaction, (given or received.) 2 Preserving, protecting. 3 Kindness. 4 Speed. 5 Going. 6 Obtaining. 7 Asking. 8 Seizing. 9 Killing. 10 Strength, power. 11 Increase. 12 Existence, being. 13 Doing. 14 Desire. 15 Beautifying, adorning. 16 Embracing. 17 Bearing. 18 Entrance. E. अव to go, to preserve, &c. ल्युट् aff.
3744: अवनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bending, stooping, bowed. E. अव down, नम to bow, क्त aff.
3745: अवनति f. (-तिः) 1 Bowing, stooping. 2 Setting. E. अव, and नति bowing.
3746: अवनद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound on, tied, fastened. n. (-द्वः) A drum: see आनद्ध. E. अव, and नद्ध bound.
3747: अवनय m. (-यः) Causing to descend, throwing down. E. अव down, नय for नाय causing to get: see अवनाय.
3748: अवनाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Flat-nosed. E. अव flatness, नाटच् affix, in this sense.
3749: अवनाम m. (-मः) Causing to bend, bending, bowing. E. अव before नम to bow, घञ् aff.
3750: अवनामक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What depresses or causes to bow or bend. E. अव and नम in the causal, वुन् aff.
3751: अवनामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Bending or bowing down. E. अव, and नामिन् what bends.
3752: अवनाय m. (-यः) Causing to descend, throwing down, precipitating. E. अव down, णीञ् to obtain, in the causal form, घञ् aff.
3753: अवनायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Causing to descend. E. अव before नी to obtain, causal form, वुन् aff.
3754: अवनाह m. (-हः) Binding, girding, putting on. E. अव before नह to bind, घञ् aff.
3755: अवनि f. (-निः) The earth. E. अव to preserve, अनि Uṇādi affix; it is also written अवनी.
3756: अवनिपति m. (-तिः) 1 A king. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. अवनि, and पति lord.
3757: अवनिपाल m. (-लः) A king. E. अवनि, and पाल who protects.
3758: अवनिरुह m. (रुट) A tree. E. अवनि, and रुह् what mounts.
3759: अवनिष्ठीवन n. (-नं) Spitting upon. E. अव, and निष्ठीवन spitting.
3760: अवनी f. (-नी) The earth: see अवनि.
3761: अवनीपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign. E. अवनी the earth, and पति a master.
3762: अवनीश m. (-शः) A king. E. अवनी and ईश् lord.
3763: अवनीश्वर m. (-रः) A king, an emperor. E. अवनी, and ईश्वर lord.
3764: अवनेजन n. (-नं) Washing. E. अव, and नेजन ablution.
3765: अवन्ति m. (-न्तिः) 1 The name of a city, the modern Oujein. 2 The name of a river. E. अव to preserve, Uṇādi affix झिच्; the derivative is irregular. Avanti, is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus, to die at which secures eternal happiness: the word is also written अवन्ती and अवन्तिका.
3766: अवन्तिसोम n. (-मं) Sour gruel, prepared from the fermentation of rice water. E. अवन्ति the city, षू to produce, मन् aff.
3767: अवन्ती f. (-न्ती) A city: see अवन्ति.
3768: अवपतन n. (-नं) Alighting, descending. E. अव down, पतन falling.
3769: अवपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Alighted, descended. 2 Fallen on or into. 3 Thrown down. E. अव, and पन्न gone.
3770: अवपात m. (-तः) 1 A hole or pit for catching game in. 2 Descent, descending. E. अव below, पत to go or fall, घञ् aff.
3771: अवपातन n. (-नं) Felling, knocking or cutting down. E. अव down, पातन causing to fall.
3772: अवपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Neglected, not protected. E. अव, before पालित protected.
3773: अवपीड m. (-डः) A sternutatory, any drug producing sneezing. E. अव, पीड to pain, affix क.
3774: अवबधा f. (-धा) Segment of the base of a triangle. E. अव, and बध what kills.
3775: अवबोध m. (-धः) 1 Judgment, discrimination, knowledge. 2 Waking, being awake. 3 Teaching. E. अव, and बोध knowledge.
3776: अवबोधक m. (-कः) 1 A teacher. 2 An awakener. E. अव before बुध to be wise, causal form, वुन् aff.
3777: अवबोधकत्व n. (-त्वं) Instruction, guidance, explanation. E. अवबोधक who teaches, and त्व aff.
3778: अवभास m. (-सः) 1 Light. 2 Manifestation. E. अव, and भास light.
3779: अवभासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Illumined, lighted, radiant. 2 Evident, manifest. E. अव, and भासित splendid.
3780: अवभासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Shining, bright. f. (-नी) The outer skin or cuticle. E. अव, and भासिन् what shines.
3781: अवभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Broken, pierced, divided. E. अव affix, भिन्न cut or broken.
3782: अवभुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Contracted, bent. E. अव, and भुग्न bent.
3783: अवभृथ m. (-थः) 1 A supplementary sacrifice made to atone for any defects in a principal and preceding one. 2 Bathing after a sacrifice. E. अव भृ to screen, क्थन् Uṇādi aff.
3784: अवभृथस्नान n. (-नं) Bathing after any sacrifice or ceremony. E. अवभृथ as before, and स्नान bathing.
3785: अवभ्रट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Flat-nosed. E. अव and भ्रटच् aff.
3786: अवम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Low, vile, inferior, base. n. (-मं) A lunar day, exactly coinciding with a solar one. E. अव to preserve, &c. अम Uṇādi aff.
3787: अवमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Despised, disregarded, contemned. E. अव implying contempt, and मत known, minded.
3788: अवमताङ्कुश m. (-शः) A restive elephant, or one in rut. E. अवमत disregarded, and अङ्कुश the goad.
3789: अवमति m. (-तिः) A master, an owner. f. (-तिः) 1 Aversion, dislike. 2 Disregard, contempt. E. अव, मन to heed, and क्तिन् aff.
3790: अवमन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be contemned, to be treated with disrespect. E. अव before मन and तव्य affix. So अवमन्य.
3791: अवमन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Proud, contemptuous, disrespectful. E. अव before मन, with तृच् aff.
3792: अवमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Devastation, inflicting pain or punishment on an enemy, by laying his country waste, &c. 2 Giving pain E. अव, मृद to tread down, घञ् aff.
3793: अवमर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Intolerance, impatience. 2 Effacing, obliterating. 3 Banishing from recollection. E. अव away, &c. मृष to endure, ल्युट् aff.
3794: अवमान n. (-नं) Disrespect, contempt. E. अव before मान् respect.
3795: अवमानता f. (-ता) 1 Dishonourableness. 2 Contempt. E. तल added to the last; also with त्व, अवमानत्वं.
3796: अवमानना f. (-ना) Disrespect. E. अव before मन to mind, युच् affix and टाप् fem. do.
3797: अवमाननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be disrespected, to be contemned. E. अव before मन, with अनीयर् aff.
3798: अवमानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected, despised. E. अव before the part. past of मन to respect.
3799: अवमानिता f. (-ता) Disrespectfulness. E. तल् added to अवमानिन्; also with त्व, अवमानित्वं.
3800: अवमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Behaving disrespectfully, contemning, despising. E. अवमान and इनि aff.
3801: अवमान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) To be treated with disrespect. E. अव before मन with ण्यत् aff.
3802: अवमूत्रयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Urining upon. E. अव on, मूत्र nominal v. to make water, शतृ aff.
3803: अवमूर्द्धशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Prostrate. E. अव down, मूर्द्धन् the forehead, शय who sleeps.
3804: अवमोचन n. (-नं) Letting forth, emitting. 2 Setting at liberty. E. अव before मुच to set free, ल्युट् aff.
3805: अवयव m. (-वः) 1 A limb, a member. 2 A part, a portion. 3 Division of a logical argument or syllogism. E. अव, यु to join, अच् aff.
3806: अवयविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Limbed, having limbs. 2 Having portions or subdivisions. m. (-वी) A syllogism, a logical argument. E. अवयव and इनि aff.
3807: अवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Posterior, hinder, last. 2 Younger. 3 Inferior. n. (-रं) The hind thigh of an elephant. f. (-रा) A name of DURGĀ. E. अ neg. and वर preferable; not the best, or than which nothing is better.
3808: अवरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Younger, junior. 2 Inferior, of low birth. m. (-जः) A younger brother. E. अवर after, and ज born.
3809: अवरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, ceased, desisted from. E. अव, रम to sport, affix क्त.
3810: अवरतस् ind. Hinder, posterior. E. अवर and अतसुच् aff.
3811: अवरति f. (-तिः) Stopping, ceasing, cessation, end. E. अव bad, &c. रम to play, and क्तिन् aff.
3812: अवरवर्ण mf. (-र्णः-र्णा or -र्णी) A Śūdra, a man or woman of the fourth tribe. E. अवर last, and वर्ण a tribe.
3813: अवरवर्णक mf. (-र्णकः-र्णिका) See the preceding. E. कन् added to अवरबर्ण, also अवरबर्णज.
3814: अवरव्रत m. (-तः) The sun. E. अ neg. वर best, than what nought is better, and ब्रत worship: whose worship is of the first importance.
3815: अवरस्तात् ind. Hinder, posterior. E. अवर and अस्तात् aff.
3816: अवरार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) The last half. E. अवर and अर्द्ध half.
3817: अवरार्द्ध्य mfn. (-र्द्ध्यः-र्द्ध्या-र्द्ध्यं) Belonging to the last half. E. यत् affix to the last.
3818: अवरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Censured, blamed. E. अव, री to flow, the irregular part. past.
3819: अवरुग्ण mfn. (-ग्णः-ग्णा-ग्णं) Broken, torn. 2 Diseased. E. अव, before रुज to be sick, affix क्त.
3820: अवरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Checked, stopped, hindered. 2 Shut up or in, inclosed. 3 Secluded, as in a haram. E. अव, and रुद्ध hindered.
3821: अवरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Descended, alighted. E. अव down, रुह to go, क्त aff.
3822: अवरोध m. (-धः) 1 The seraglio of a palace, the queen's apartment. 2 A queen. 3 A palace. 4 A covering. 5 Hindrance, obstruction. 6 A fence, a pen, an inclosure, confinement. 7 Restraint. E. अव, रुध to inclose or shut up, घञ् aff.
3823: अवरोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What impedes or obstructs. m. (-कः) A guard. f. (-धिका) A female of the haram. n. (-कं) A barrier, a fence. E. अव before रोधक what opposes.
3824: अवरोधन n. (-नं) The inner or women's apartments in a royal palace. 2 Hindering, obstructing. 4 Obstacle, impediment. E. अव, रुध to enclose, ल्युट् aff.
3825: अवरोधायन n. (-नं) A seraglio. E. अवरोध hindrance, and अयन going.
3826: अवरोधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Obstructive, impeding. m. (-कः) A guard of the queen's apartments. E. अवरोध with ठक् aff.
3827: अवरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिणी-धि) Obstructing. E. अवरोध and इनि aff.
3828: अवरोपण n. (-णं) 1 Taking away, depriving, diminishing. 2 Descending. 3 Setting, (as of the sun.) E. अव affix, and रोपण placing.
3829: अवरोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deprived of, curtailed, diminished, lost. E. अव aff. रोपित placed.
3830: अवरोह m. (-हः) 1 Mounting, ascending. 2 Descent, passing from or over. 3 The growth of a creeping plant or vine. 4 A pendant branch, one that strikes fresh root into the earth, as those of the Indian fig tree. 5 Heaven or Svarga. E. अव up or down, &c. रुह to mount, घञ् aff.
3831: अवरोहण n. (-णं) 1 Alighting, descending. 3 Mounting. E. अव before रुह to mount, ल्युट् aff.
3832: अवरोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 What descends. 2 What ascends. m. (-ही) The Indian fig tree. E. अवरोह a branch, &c. and इनि poss. aff.
3833: अवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णीं-र्णं) 1 Colourless. 2 Bad, low, destitute of good qualities. m. (-र्णः) Censure, blame. E. अ neg. and वर्ण praise, colour, &c.
3834: अवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Non-existent. 2 Not present. E. अ neg. वर्त्तमान existing.
3835: अवर्द्धमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Not increasing, not growing. E. अ neg. वर्द्धमान increasing.
3836: अवलक्ष m. (-क्षः) or attributively, mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) White: see वलक्ष. E. अव and लक्ष to mark, affix घञ्.
3837: अवलग्न mn. (-ग्नः-ग्नं) The waist. mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Placed contiguously, impressed, attached, &c. E. अव, and लग्न part. past of लग to be near or with.
3838: अवलम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 Asylum, dependance, support. 2 Depending, hanging on or from. 3 A prop, a stay. 4 A suspender. 5 A perpendicular. E. अव before लवि to go, &c. अच् affix; also अवलम्बनं.
3839: अवलम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Depending upon, dependance. 2 Hanging on or from. 3 A prop. E. अव before लवि and ल्युट् aff.
3840: अवलम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Quick, expeditious. 2 Alighting, descending. 3 Protected, cherished. 4 Hanging on or upon, suspended from, clinging to. 5 Depending upon, trusting to, supported by. E. अव, and the part. past of लवि to go, to fall, &c.
3841: अवलम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) Depending on. E. अवलम्ब and इनि aff.
3842: अवलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Anointed, plastered, smeared. 2 Proud, arrogant. E. अव before लिप्त smeared.
3843: अवलिप्तता f. (-ता) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Unction. E. अवलिप्त plastered, smeared, and तल् affix; also with त्व, अवलिप्तत्वं.
3844: अवलीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Licked. 2 Devoured, destroyed. E. अव, and लीढ licked.
3845: अवलीला f. (-ला) Sport, play. E. अव, and लीला sport.
3846: अवलुञ्चन n. (-नं) Tearing, tearing or cutting off. E. अव, लुच to separate, affix ल्युट्.
3847: अवलुण्ठन n. (-नं) Rolling on the ground. E. अव, and लुण्ठन rolling.
3848: अवलुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolled on the ground. E. अव, and लुण्ठित rolling.
3849: अवलून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cut off. E. अव, and लून cut.
3850: अवलेप m. (-पः) 1 Pride. 2 Smearing, anointing. 4 Ornament. 4 Union, association. E. अव, लिप to smear, &c. अच् aff.
3851: अवलेपन n. (-नं) 1 Daring, proud or arrogant purpose. 2 Anointing. E. अव, लिप and ल्युट्.
3852: अवलेह m. (-हः) An extract, an electuary, confection. E. अव, and लेह licking, what is to be licked with the tongue, not masticated or drank.
3853: अवलेहन n. (-नं) Licking with the tongue. E. अव, and लेहन licking.
3854: अवलेह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Thick, viscid. E. अव, and लेह्य to be licked with the tongue.
3855: अवलोक m. (-कः) Sight, seeing. E. अव, and लोकृ to see, अच् aff.
3856: अवलोकन n. (-नं) Sight, seeing. E. अव, लोकृ to see, ल्युट् aff.
3857: अवलोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen. m. (-तः) A Bauddha. E. अव, and the part. past, of लोक to see.
3858: अवल्गुज m. (-जः) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica:) see सोमराजी. E. अ neg. वल्गु handsome, and ज produced.
3859: अववाद m. (-दः) 1 A command, an order. 2 Censure, reproach. 3 Trust, confidence. E. अव implying disrespect, and वाद speech.
3860: अवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Independent, unsubjected, unrestrained. 2 Necessary, certain. E. अ neg. वश subjection.
3861: अवशक्थिका f. (-का) A cloth tied round the legs and knees of a person sitting on his hams: see अवसक्थिका.
3862: अवशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Left, rest, remainder. E. अव, and शिष्ट left.
3863: अवशीन m. (-नः) A scorpion. E. अव before श्यै to go, क्त aff.
3864: अवशीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unrestrained, independent. 2 Uninfluenced by magic. E. अवश and भूत been, with च्चि inserted.
3865: अवशेष m. (-षः) 1 Leavings, remainder. 2 End, close, termination. E. अव, and शेष remainder.
3866: अवश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Untameable, ungovernable. ind. (-श्यः) Certainly, necessarily. E. अव, श्ये to go, डम् affix; irregularly formed: it occurs in composition with or without the nasal, as अवश्यङ्कारी who does what is necessary, अवश्यपाच्यः to be necessarily cooked, &c. E. अ neg. वश to subdue, affix यत्.
3867: अवश्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Necessary, inevitable, indispensable. E. अवश्य and कन् aff.
3868: अवश्यकता f. (-ता) 1 Necessity, obligation. 2 Certainty. E. तल् added to अवश्यक; also अवश्यकत्वं with त्व aff.
3869: अवश्या f. (-श्या) A fog or mist. E. अव, श्यै to go, ड affix and fem. टाप्.
3870: अवश्याय m. (-यः) 1 Frost. 2 Pride. E. अव, श्यै to go, and यङ् aff.
3871: अवष्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow that bears a calf after a long interval: see वष्कयणी.
3872: अवष्टब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Near. 2 Protected, supported. 3 Surpassed, overcome. 4 Bound, tied. 5 Opposed. 6 Wrapped up, enfolded. 7 Hanging from or upon. 8 Stopped, stayed. 9 Paralysed. E. अव, लभि to stop, to stand, in the part. past.
3873: अवष्टभ्य ind. 1 Leaning upon, holding. 2 Stopping, arresting. E. अव before लभि to stop, ल्यप् aff.
3874: अवष्टम्भन n. (-नं) 1 Supporting, protecting. 2 A pillar, a post. 3 Stopping, staying. 4 Paralysing. E. अव before स्तभि to stay, ल्युट् aff.
3875: अवष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Gold. 2 Commencement, beginning. 3 A post or pillar. 4 Excellence. 5 Impediment. 6 Support, stay. 7 Paralysis. E. अव, स्तभि to stay or stop, अच् aff.
3876: अवष्वाण n. (-णं) Eating. E. अव, स्वन to sound, घञ् aff.
3877: अवस ind. (-वस) Without, on the outside. m. (-सः) 1 A king. 2 The sun. n. (-सं) Preserving, protecting, (in the language of the Vedas.) E. अव to preserve, &c. असच् Uṇādi aff.
3878: अवसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Attached to or by, in contact with. 2 Engaged or eager. 3 Bound round, begirt. 4 Placed or thrown upon. E. अव, and सक्त joined.
3879: अवसक्तिका f. (-का) A wrapper, a girth or band. E. अव about, सक्त joined, कन् affix, and the fem. form.
3880: अवसक्थिका f. (-का) 1 A wrapper, a mantle. 2 A cloth drawn round the knees and legs of a person sitting on his hams. E. अव round, सक्थि the thigh, कन् aff.
3881: अवसज्जन n. (-नं) Embracing, clinging. E. अव before सज्ज to embrace, ल्युट् aff.
3882: अवसथ m. (-थः) 1 A village. 2 A college, a school. n. (-थं) A house. E. अ neg. चस to dwell, and अथच् affix; than which there is no other or better abode.
3883: अवसथ्य m. (-थ्यः) A college, a school. E. see the preceding.
3884: अवसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Melancholy, dispirited, unhappy. 2 Ended, terminated. 3 Languid, enervated. 4 Separated. 5 Bowed, bent. 6 Non-suited. E. अव before सन to faint, क्त aff.
3885: अवसन्नता f. (-ता) Low spirits, affliction. 2 Termination, completion. E. तल् added to अवसन्न; also with त्व affix अवसन्नत्वं.
3886: अवसर m. (-रः) 1 Occasion, opportunity. 2 Rain, raining. 3 Consultation in private. 4 A year. 5 A moment. E. अव, सृ to go, अच् aff.
3887: अवसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Following one's own inclinations. E. अव, सृज to create, घञ् affix; ज becomes ग.
3888: अवसर्प m. (-र्पः) A spy, a secret emissary: see अपसर्प. E. अव सृप to go, अच् aff.
3889: अवसर्पिणी f. (-णी) A Jaina division of time; ten Crores of Crores of Sāgaras or oceans of years. E. अव, सृप to go, णिनि and ङीप् aff.
3890: अवसव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Right, (not left.) E. अव reverse, सव्य left; also अपसव्य.
3891: अवसाद m. (-दः) 1 Lassitude, want of energy or spirit, especially as proceeding from doubtful or unsuccessful love. 2 Exhaustion, fatigue. 3 In law, badness of a cause. 4 End, termination. E. अव, षद to go, to sink, घञ् aff.
3892: अवसादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Exhausting, wearisome. 2 Ending, finishing. E. अव before षद to go, &c. causal form, वुन् aff.
3893: अवसादन n. (-नं) 1 Finishing. 2 An escharotic. 3 Removing proud flesh by escharotic applications. E. अव before षद to go, a ल्युट् aff.
3894: अवसादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Languid, exhausted, faint. E. अव, षद to go, क्त aff.
3895: अवसान n. (-नं) 1 Conclusion, termination, cessation. 2 Death. 3 Boundary, limit. 4 In grammar, disjunction of letters. E. अव, षो to finish, ल्युट् affix; ओ is changed to आ.
3896: अवसाय m. (-यः) 1 End, conclusion. 2 Termination, completion. 3 Certainty, ascertainment. E. अव, षो to finish, affix ण, and युक् inserted.
3897: अवसारण n. (-णं) Removing, causing to move. E. अव before सृ to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
3898: अवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ended, terminated. 2 Finished, completed. 3 Known, understood. 4 Stored, (as grain, &c.) E. अव, षो to finish, and क्त part. aff.
3899: अवसेक m. (-कः) Sprinkling. E. अव, षिच to sprinkle, घञ् aff.
3900: अवसेकिम m. (-मः) A kind of cake, pulse ground and fried with oil or butter. E. अव, सेकृ to sprinkle, इमच् affix; what is sprinkled with oil, &c.
3901: अवसेचन n. (-नं) 1 Sprinkling. 2 Bleeding. E. अव before षिच to sprinkle, affix ल्युट्.
3902: अवसेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be destroyed, destructible. E. अव before षो to destroy, affix यत्.
3903: अवस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 A camp. 2 Assault, attack, storm. 3 Bathing. 4 Going down, descending. E. अव against, &c. स्कन्द to go, अच् aff.
3904: अवस्कन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Attacking, assaulting, storm. 2 Bathing. 3 Descending. E. अव before स्कन्दन going.
3905: अवस्कन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Attacked. 2 Bathed, bathing. 3 Gone down. E. अव, स्कन्द to go, क्त aff.
3906: अवस्कर m. (-रः) 1 A privity, a part to be concealed. 2 Ordure, faeces. 3 Dirt. 4 Sweepings E. अव down, away, &c. क to throw, अप् affix, स prefixed to क.
3907: अवस्करक m. (-कः) 1 A sweeper. 2 A brush, broom, &c. E. अवस्कर and वुन् aff.
3908: अवस्तात् ind. 1 Posterior, latter. 2 Finally. E. अव and स्तात् aff.
3909: अवस्तार m. (-रः) A screen or wall of cloth surrounding a tent, &c. E. अव round, स्तृ to spread, घञ् aff.
3910: अवस्तु n. (-स्तु) Insubstantiality, the unreality of matter. E. अ priv. वस्तु thing.
3911: अवस्तुता f. (-ता) Insubstantiality, unreality. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, अवस्तुत्वं.
3912: अवस्था f. (-स्था) State, condition, situation, circumstance of age or position. E. अव, स्था to stand or stay, अङ् and टाप affs.
3913: अवस्थाचतुष्टय n. (-यं) The periods of human life, viz. childhood, youth, manhood, and old age. E. अवस्था, and चतुष्टय four-fold.
3914: अवस्थाद्वय n. (-यं) Two states of life, viz. happiness or misery. E. अवस्था, and द्वय two.
3915: अवस्थान n. (-नं) Situation, station, abode, place or period of abiding or staying. E. अव before स्था to stay, affix ल्युट्.
3916: अवस्थापन n. (-नं) Fixing, settling. E. अव, स्था to stay, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
3917: अवस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fixed. E. see the last, क्त aff.
3918: अवस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Staying, residing in. E. अव before स्था to stay, णिनि aff.
3919: अवस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Occupying place or period, abiding, residing, remaining firm or fixed, &c. 2 Firm of purpose, steady. 3 Engaged in, prosecuting, following. E. अव before स्था to stay, affix क्त.
3920: अवस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Abiding. 2 A residence. 3 Following, practising. E. अव, and स्थिति staying.
3921: अवहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bruised, beaten. 2 Threshed, winnowed. E. अव, and हत struck.
3922: अवहरण n. (-णं) 1 Redeeming, taking back. 2 Fining, mulcting. 3 Taking away, stealing, plundering. E. अव, and हरण taking.
3923: अवहस्त m. (-स्तः) The back of the hand. E. अव reverse, &c. and हस्त the hand.
3924: अवहार m. (-रः) 1 A shark. 2 A water elephant. 3 A thief. 4 Truce, suspension or cessation of gambling, fighting, &c. 5 Summoning, inviting. 6 Any approximatable object, fit or able to be brought near. 7 Apostacy, abandoning a sect or cast. 8 Re-delivery. E. अव, हृ to take or convey, घञ् or ण aff.
3925: अवहारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who stops fighting, &c. m. (-कः) A shark, a marine monster. E. अवहार, कन् aff.
3926: अवहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Recoverable, redeemable. 2 Finable, punishable. E. अव, and हार्य्य to be taken.
3927: अवहालिका f. (-का) A wall, a bound hedge.
3928: अवहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, celebrated. 2 Done with care. 3 Careful. 4 Attentive. E. अव, धा to have or hold, part. affix क्त; ध becomes ह and इट् is inserted.
3929: अवहित्थ nf. (-त्थं-त्था) Dissimulation. E. अ neg. वहिर् outer, स्था stand; an irregular form: what does not shew outwardly.
3930: अवहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken off, back, or away, seized, stolen. 2 Fined. E. अव off, हृत taken.
3931: अवहेल nf. (-लं-ला) Disrespect. E. अव, हेड to despise, घञ् affix; ड becomes ल.
3932: अवहेलन n. (-नं) Disrespect. E. as अवहेल, affix ल्युट्.
3933: अवहेलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disrespected. n. (-तं) Disrespect. E. अवहेल and इतच् aff.
3934: अवाक्पुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, (Pimpinella Anisum.) E. अवाक् downwards, and पुष्पी having flowers.
3935: अवाक्शिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-राः) Having the head downwards. E. अवाक् down, and शिरस् the head.
3936: अवाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Who protects or defends, a guardian, a keeper. E. अव under, and अक्षि the eye, अ final.
3937: अवाग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Stooping, bending, bowed. E. अव reverse, and अग्र front.
3938: अवाङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Downlooked, headlong. E. अवाच् and मुख the face.
3939: अवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Dumb. E. अ priv. वाच् speech.
3940: अवाच् or अवाञ्च् mfn. (-वाड्-वाची-वाक्) 1 Downlooked, headlong. 2 South. ind. (-वाक्). 1 South, southern. 2 Downwards. f. (-वाची) 1 The south quarter. 2 The lower regions. E. अव down, downwards, अञ्च् to go, क्विप् affix; the south being considered as below.
3941: अवाचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 South, southern. 3 Downlooked, headlong. 3 Descended, gone down. E. अवाच् and ख aff.
3942: अवाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 Vile, bad. 2 Improper to be uttered. 3 Southern, southerly. E. अ neg. and वाच्य to be spoken, or अवाच् and यत् added.
3943: अवाच्यता f. (-ता) 1 Reproach, calumny. 2 Impropriety. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, अवाच्यत्वं.
3944: अवाच्यदेश m. (-शः) The vulva. E. अवाच्य not to be named, देश a place.
3945: अवाज्ज्ञान n. (-नं) Disrespect. E. अवाच, and ज्ञान knowledge.
3946: अवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) One who does not speak, who does not dispute, who does not bring an action, peaceable. E. अ neg. वादिन् who speaks, &c.
3947: अवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dried, dry, (fruit.) E. अ neg. and वान dry: than which nothing is drier.
3948: अवान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Included, involved. E. अव, and अन्तर inner.
3949: अवापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unsown, (as grain,) planted. E. अ, and वापित sown.
3950: अवाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Received, got, obtained. E. अव before आप to obtain, क्त aff.
3951: अवाप्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Receiving, obtaining, taking. 2 Entertaining, (as a belief.) E. अवाप to get, क्तवतु aff.
3952: अवाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining, getting, receiving. E. अव, and आप to attain, क्तिन् aff.
3953: अवाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Unattainable, unobtainable. ind. Having obtained. E. अ neg. वाप्य procurable, or अव before आप to obtain, ल्यप् aff.
3954: अवार n. (-रं) The near bank of a river. E. अव down, ऋ to go, घञ् aff.
3955: अवारपार m. (-रः) The ocean. E. अवार the near and पार the opposite bank; embanked.
3956: अवारपारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Crossing a river. E. अवारपार both banks, and ख aff.
3957: अवारिका f. (-का) Coriander seed; also अवरिका.
3958: अवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unimpeded, unobstructed. 2 Innumerable. E. अ, and वारित hindered.
3959: अवारितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Not to be impeded. E. अ, and वारितव्य to be hindered; also अवारणीय and अवार्य्य.
3960: अवारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Crossing a river. E. अवार and ख aff.
3961: अवार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Unrestrainable, irresistible. E. अ neg. वार्य्य to be hindered.
3962: अवावट m. (-टः) The son of a woman by any other man than her first husband.
3963: अवावन् m. (-वा) A thief. E. ओण to take away, वनिप् aff.
3964: अवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Naked. E. अ priv. वासस् clothes.
3965: अवास्तव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Unsubstantial, unreal. 2 Unfounded, irrational, (as an argument.) E. अ, and वास्तव substance.
3966: अवास्तविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Insubstantial, unreal. 2 Unfounded, (as an argument.) E. अ, वास्तविक substantial.
3967: अवि m. (-विः) 1 The sun. 2 A mountain. 3 A sheep. 4 A master. 5 A blanket. 6 A rat. 7 A wall or enclosure. 8 Air, wind. 9 The shawl goat. f. (-विः) A woman in her courses; also अवी. E. अव to go, to preserve, &c. इन् aff.
3968: अविक n. (-कं) A diamond. E. अवि the sun, &c. कन् aff.
3969: अविकच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Closed, shut. E. अ neg. विकच open.
3970: अविकचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unblown. E. अ neg. विकचित blown.
3971: अविकट m. (-टः) A flock of sheep. E. अवि a sheep, कटच् aff.
3972: अविकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Not boasting, not talking vainly or idly. E. अ, and विकथा boasting.
3973: अविकथन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) One who does not boast. n. (-नं) Not boasting. E. अ neg. विकथन talking idly.
3974: अविकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Entire, perfect, unimpaired. 2 Regular, orderly, consistent. E. अ, and विकल defective.
3975: अविकल्प m. (-ल्पः) Positive act or precept, absence of doubt or alternative. E. अ neg. विकल्प alternative.
3976: अविकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Immutable, permanent. E. अ neg. विकार change.
3977: अविकार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Immutable, unchangeable. E. अ neg. विकार्य्य liable to change of form.
3978: अविकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unchanged, permanent. E. अ neg. विकृत changed.
3979: अविक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Powerless, feeble. m. (-मः) Cowardice. E. अ neg. विक्रम prowess.
3980: अविक्रय m. (-यः) Want of sale. E. अ neg. विक्रय sale.
3981: अविक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Unsurpassed. 2 Feeble, powerless. E. अ neg. वि before क्रम to go, क्त aff.
3982: अविक्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unsold. E. अ neg. विक्रीत sold.
3983: अविक्रेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unsaleable, not to be sold. E. अ neg. विक्रेय to be sold.
3984: अविक्लम m. (-मः) Vigour, freshness, absence of fatigue. E. अ neg. विक्लम fatigue.
3985: अविक्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Calm, composed, firm. E. अ neg. विक्लव confounded.
3986: अविक्लान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Unwearied. E. अ neg. विक्लान्त wearied.
3987: अविक्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Entire, undiminished. 2 Unhurt. E. अ neg. विक्षत wounded.
3988: अविक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Attentive, composed. 2 Retained. E. अ neg. विक्षिप्त tossed, agitated.
3989: अविक्षोभ m. (-भः) Quiet, quiescence. E. अ neg. विक्षोभ agitation.
3990: अविक्षोभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tranquil, undisturbed. E. अ neg. विक्षोभित agitated.
3991: अविगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Retained, present, unseparated. E. अ neg. विगत gone away.
3992: अविगम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Unseparated, unremoved. m. (-मः) Presence, inherence, association, non-separation. E. अ neg. विगम separation.
3993: अविगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unreproached. E. अ neg. विगर्हित reproached.
3994: अविगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unreproached. E. अ, and विगीत censure.
3995: अविगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Compatible, consistent with, not contrary to. 2 Worthy, good. E. अ neg. वि without, गुण property.
3996: अविग्न m. (-ग्नः) A fruit tree, commonly Caronda, (Carissa Carondas.) E. अ neg. विज to fear, part. past, irr.
3997: अविग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bodiless, incorporeal. E. अ neg. विग्रह body.
3998: अविघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) Unimpeded, uninterrupted. E. अ neg. विघ्न obstacle.
3999: अविचक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Unlearned, ignorant. E. अ neg. विचक्षण learned.
4000: अविचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Undiscriminating, ill-judging, unwise. 2 Prompt, unhesitating. m. (-रः) 1 Want of judgment or discrimination, error, folly. 2 Promptitude. E. अ neg. विचार discussion.
4001: अविचारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill-judged or investigated, unconsidered. 2 Determined, certain, clear, not requiring deliberation. E. अ neg. विचारित discussed.
4002: अविचालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Victorious, triumphant. 2 Unmoved. E. अ neg. विचालित shaken, resisted.
4003: अविच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Undeviated from, observed, followed. 2 Eternal, permanent. E. अ neg. विच्युत fallen.
4004: अविछिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Unseparated, undivided. E. अ neg. विछिन्न cut off.
4005: अविछेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Entire, whole, undivided. 2 Uninterrupted. m. (-दः) 1 Entireness. 2 Connexion, continuity. E. अ neg. विछेद separation.
4006: अविजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the same species. E. अ neg. विजातीय of a different kind.
4007: अविज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Clumsy, stupid. 2 Ignorant, untaught. E. अ neg. विज्ञ wise.
4008: अविज्ञता f. (-ता) Ignorance, fully. E. अविज्ञ, and तल् affix; also अविज्ञत्वं.
4009: अविज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unknown. 2 Undistinguished. E. अ, and विज्ञात known.
4010: अविज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undiscernible, not to be recognised or known. E. अ neg. विज्ञेय to be known.
4011: अविडीन n. (-नं) A direct flight. E. अ neg. विडीन flying deviously.
4012: अवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preserved, protected. E. अव to preserve, क्त affix of part. past.
4013: अवितथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) True. n. (-थं) Truth. E. अ neg. and वितथ untrue.
4014: अवित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Unknown. 2 Poor. E. अ neg. वित्त known, or wealth.
4016: अविथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) Fit for or suited to a sheep. E. अवि and थ्यन् aff.
4017: अविदग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Unlearned. 2 Stupid. E. अ neg. विदग्ध clever.
4018: अविदाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Imperfectly digested, producing heartburn. E. अ neg. वि free from, दाहिन् what burns.
4019: अविदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unknown. E. अ neg. विदित known.
4020: अविदूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Near, contiguous. E. अ neg. विदूर distant.
4021: अविदूरतस् ind. Near, not far off. E. अविदूर and तसि aff.
4022: अविदूस n. (-सं) The milk of a ewe. E. अवि and दूस aff.
4023: अविद्धकर्णा f. (-र्णा-र्णी) A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. अ neg. विद्ध broken, divided, and कर्ण the ear; the leaf being compared to the ear; also अविद्धकर्णी and विद्धकर्णी.
4024: अविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Foolish, unwise. 2 Not relating to knowledge. f. (द्या) 1 Ignorance. 2 Spiritual ignorance. 3 Illusion. 4 Personified illusion or Māyā. E. अ priv. and विद्या knowledge.
4025: अविद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Non-existent. 2 Not present, absent. E. अ, and विद्यमान being.
4026: अविद्वस् mfn. (-द्वान्-टुषी-द्वः) Unwise, unlearned. E. अ neg. विद्वस् learned.
4027: अविधान n. (-नं) Irregularity, deviation from or absence of fixed rule. E. अ, and विधान rule.
4028: अविधानतस् ind. Irregularly. E. अविधान and तसि aff.
4029: अविधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) Irregular, void of or contrary to rule. f. (-धिः) Irregularity. E. अ, and विधि rule.
4030: अविन m. (-नः) A sacrificer, one who makes a sacrifice or causes it to be made. E. अव to preserve, इनच् Uṇādi aff.
4031: अविनय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Indecorous, ill-behaved. m. (-यः) 1 Indecorum, impropriety, fault. 2 Incivility, disrespect. 3 Offence, crime. E. अ, and विनय modest behaviour.
4032: अविनश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Indestructible: so अविनाश्य. E. अ neg. विनश्वर destructible.
4033: अविनाभाव m. (-वः) Inherent and essential character. E. अ, and विना without, भाव property.
4034: अविनिगम m. (-मः) An illogical conclusion. E. अ neg. विनिगम accurate deduction.
4035: अविनिवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति) Holding on, advancing, one who does not turn back. E. अ neg. विनिवर्त्तिन् who retreats.
4036: अविनिर्मोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Without an exception. E. अ neg. विनिर्मोक exception.
4037: अविनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Misbehaving, acting ill or improperly, wicked, vile. f. (-ता) An unchaste or disloyal woman. E. अ neg. विनीत virtuous.
4038: अविपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Unopposed, having no adversary. E. अ neg. विपक्ष an adversary.
4039: अविपट m. (-टः) Wollen cloth. E. अवि a sheep, and पटच् aff.
4040: अविपद् f. (-पत्) Prosperity, ease. E. अ neg. विपद् misfortune.
4041: अविपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Uninjured, unhurt. 2 Not soiled or contaminated, pure, clean. E. अ neg. विपन्न destroyed.
4042: अविपश्चिद् mfn. (-श्चित्) Unwise, ignorant. E. अ neg. विपश्चिद् learned.
4043: अविपाक m. (-कः) 1 Immaturity. 2 Not suffering the consequence of actions in a former life. 3 Indigestion. E. अ neg. विपाक ripening.
4044: अविपुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Small, insignificant, slender. E. अ neg. विपुल large.
4045: अविप्रकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Near, not remote. E. अ neg. विप्रकृष्ट remote.
4046: अविप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Undeviating, following or observing steadily. 2 Observed, unviolated. E. अ neg. विप्लुत transgressed.
4047: अविफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fruitful, productive. E. अ neg. विफल unfruitful.
4048: अविफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Unblown. E. अ neg. विफुल्ल blown.
4049: अविभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Undivided, unpartitioned. 2 Joint, unseparated, (as coparceners.) E. अ neg. विभक्त divided.
4050: अविभाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Unportioned, unpartitioned. m. (-गः) Undivided inheritance. E. अ neg. विभाग division.
4051: अविभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 One who does not share. 2 Not sharing, not dividing. E. अ neg. विभागिन् who divides.
4052: अविभाज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Not to be divided, not to be partitioned. E. अ neg. विभाज्य particle.
4053: अविभाज्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Indivisibility, unfitness for partition. E. अविभाज्य and त्व affix; also with तल्, अविभाज्यता.
4054: अविभावन nf. (-नं-ना) Disappearance, imperceptibility. E. अ neg. विभावन perception.
4055: अविभावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Imperceptible, undistinguishable. E. अ neg. विभावनीय.
4056: अविमरीस n. (-सं) The milk of a ewe. E. अवि and मरीसच् aff.
4057: अविमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Foul, turbid. E. अ neg. विमल clear.
4058: अविमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unloosed, not quitted. m. (-क्तः) A name of Benares. E. अ neg. and विमुक्त loosed: the last is never to be lost view of by those seeking salvation.
4059: अविमुक्तेश्वर m. (-रः) A celebrated Śiva Liṅga, at Benares. E. अविमुक्त, and ईश्वर lord.
4060: अवियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Undivided, conjoined. 2 Not separated or absent. E. अ neg. वियुक्त disjoined.
4061: अवियोग m. (-गः) 1 Conjunction, association. 2 Presence, not being parted or absent. E. अ neg. वियोग disunion.
4062: अविरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Interested in, attached to. E. अ neg. विरक्त unattached.
4063: अविरत adj. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eternal, continual, uninterrupted. 2 Abandoned, or adv. n. (-तं) Eternal, continual. E. अ neg. विरत, stopping.
4064: अविरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Coarse, gross, substantial. 2 Close, contiguous. 3 Uninterrupted. E. अ neg. and विरल fine.
4065: अविराम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Continuous, uninterrupted. m. (-मः) Continuance, Uninterrupted succession. n. adv. (-मं) Uninterruptedly. E. अ neg. विराम rest.
4066: अविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Unimpeded, unobstructed. 2 Allowed, permitted, proper. 3 Compatible, consistent with. E. अ neg. विरुद्ध hindered.
4067: अविरेचन n. (-नं) Constipating, stopping dejection. E. अ neg. विरेचन purging.
4068: अविरेच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Improper to be purged. E. अ neg. विरेच्य to be purged.
4069: अविरोध m. (-धः) 1 Absence of impediment. 2 Assent, concurrence, non-opposition. 3 Consistency, compatibility. E. अ neg. विरोध hindrance.
4070: अविरोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unimpeded, unobstructed. E. अ neg. विरोधित hindered.
4071: अविलङ्घन n. (-नं) Not exceeding, not trespassing. E. अ neg. विलङ्घन trespassing.
4072: अविलङ्घनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Prescribed, fixed, not to be transgressed or exceeded. E. अ neg. विलङ्घनीय to be passed over or beyond.
4073: अविलम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Prompt, quick, without delay. E. अ neg. विलम्ब delay.
4074: अविलम्बन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Quick, expeditious: also अविलम्बित.
4075: अविलम्बित mfn. adj. (-तः-ता-तं) Quick, expeditious. n. adv. (-तं) Quickly, expeditiously. E. अ neg. and विलम्बित slow, tedious.
4076: अविलम्बितक्रम m. (-मः) Going quickly, a swift pace. E. अविलम्बित and क्रम motion.
4077: अविला f. (-ला) A sheep, a ewe. E. अ neg. विल to break, अच् and टाप् affixes; not able to wound, &c. having no horns.
4078: अविलास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Faithful, constant. E. अ neg. विलास sport, caprice.
4079: अविवक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unasserted, undeclared. E. अ neg. विवक्षित said.
4080: अविवाद m. (-दः) Concurrence, consent, non-disagreement. E. अ neg. विवाद dispute.
4081: अविवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Quiet, peaceable. E. अ neg. विवादिन् contentious.
4082: अविवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unmarried. E. अ and विवाहित.
4083: अविवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Interdicted as to marriage. 2 Not relating to marriage. 3 Single, not marrying. E. अ neg. विवाहिन् marrying.
4084: अविविक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Uninvestigated, undiscriminated. 2 Indiscriminate, confounded. 3 Common, public. E. अ neg. विविक्त discriminated.
4085: अविवेक m. (-कः) Ignorance, absence of discrimination or judgment. E. अ neg. and विवेक discrimination.
4086: अविवेकता f. (-ता) Inconsiderateness, imprudence, want of judgment. E. अविवेक and तल् added: also अविवेकत्वं.
4087: अविवेकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Ignorant, undiscriminating, defective in judgment, superficial, short sighted. E. अविवेक as above, and इनि aff.
4088: अविवेचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Ignorant, undiscriminating. E. अ, and विवेचक who judges.
4089: अविवेचना f. (-ना) Want of judgment. E. अ neg. विवेचन discriminating.
4090: अविशङ्का f. (-ङ्का) Unapprehensiveness, confidence, certainty. E. अ neg. विशङ्का fear.
4091: अविशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Confiding, trusting, unapprehensive. E. अ neg. विशङ्कित alarmed.
4092: अविशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pure, clear, free from fault or defect. 2 Valid, perfect, unimpeached. E. अ neg. विशुद्ध faulty.
4093: अविशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Uniform, alike, without any difference. n. (-षं) Equality, uniformity. E. अ neg. विशेष variation.
4094: अविशेषज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Indiscriminating, not perceiving the difference in things. E. अ neg. विशेष, and ज्ञ who knows.
4095: अविश्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Unwearied. E. अ neg. विश्रान्त tired.
4096: अविश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Suspected, doubted, not trusted. E. अ, and विश्वस्त trusted.
4097: अविश्वास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Mistrusted. m. (-सः) Suspicion, mistrust. E. अ neg. विश्वास trust.
4098: अविश्वासा f. (-सा) A cow calving after long intervals. E. अ neg. विश्वास trust.
4099: अविश्वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Mistrustful, unbelieving. E. अ neg. विश्वासिन् who trusts.
4100: अविष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Anti-venomous, antidote, not poisonous. E. अ neg. and विष poison. m. (-षः) The ocean, sky. f. (-षी) 1 A river. 2 The earth. 3 Heaven. E. अव to go, &c. टिषच Uṇādi aff.
4101: अविषक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unchecked, unopposed, unimpeded. E. अ neg. विषक्त restrained.
4102: अविषय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Unperceived, invisible. 2 Insensible, disregarding objects of sense. m. (-यः) 1 Disappearance, absence. 2 Disregard of objects of sense. E. अ neg. विषय an object of sense.
4103: अविस् m. (-विः) An extender or enlarger.
4104: अविसर्गिन् mfn. (र्गी-र्गिणी-र्गि) Adhering to, retaining, not quitting. m. (-र्गी) A continued fever. E. अ neg. विसर्गिन quitting.
4105: अविसोढ n. (-ढं) Ewe's milk. E. अवि and सोढ aff.
4106: अविस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compact, compressed, close. E. अ neg. विस्तृत spread.
4107: अविस्पष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Obscure, not clear or plain. n. (-ष्टं) Indistinct speech. E. अ neg. विस्पष्ट plain.
4108: अविस्मरण n. (-णं) Remembering, not forgetting. E. अ neg. विस्मरण forgetting.
4109: अविस्मृति f. (-तिः) Remembering, recollection. E. अ neg. विस्मृति forgetfulness.
4110: अविहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Undone, uneffected. 2 Unprescribed, not directed or ruled. E. अ neg. विहित established.
4111: अविह्नल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Calm, composed, unagitated. E. अ neg. विह्नल agitated.
