4112: अवी f. (-वी) A woman in her courses: see अवि.
4113: अवीक्षण n. (-णं) Not regarding, not looking at. E. अ neg. वीक्षण seeing.
4114: अवीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unseen, unbeheld. E. अ neg. वीक्षित seen.
4115: अवीचि m. (-चिः) A hell. mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Waveless. E. अ neg. वीचि a wave.
4116: अवीचिमय m. (-यः) A hell, the place of punishment for liars. E. अवीचि without waves, मयट् aff.
4117: अवीज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Seedless. n. (जं) Bad seed. 2 Absence of seed. E. अ neg. वीज seed.
4118: अवीजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Seedless. E. अवीज and कन् added.
4119: अवीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Weak, impotent, helpless. f. (-रा) A woman who has neither husband nor son. E. अ neg. वीर strong.
4120: अवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unselected. 2 Uncovered. 3 Unprotected. E. अ neg. वृत chosen, &c.
4121: अवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Inadequate support, absence of subsistence or allowance. E. अ neg. वृत्ति maintenance.
4122: अवृथा ind. Successfully, profitably. E. अ not, वृथा vainly.
4123: अवृथार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Succeeding, gaining one's object. E. अवृथा not in vain, अर्थ object.
4124: अवृद्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Not bearing interest. 2 Not augmentative. E. अ neg. वृद्धि increase, ठक् aff.
4125: अवेक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Seeing. 2 Attention, observation. E. अव and ईक्षण seeing.
4126: अवेक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Inspecting, examining. E. अव, ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.
4127: अवेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Attention, observation. 2 Seeing, looking at. 3 Agreement, engagement. E. अव upon or to, ईक्ष to see, अ affix, and टाप् feminine.
4128: अवेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, regarded. E. अव before ईक्ष and क्त aff.
4129: अवेदयान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Not enquiring or ascertaining. E. अ neg. विद to know, शानच् aff.
4130: अवेदविद् m. (-विद्) A Brahman who has not studied the Vedas. E. अ neg. वेद and विद् who knows.
4131: अवेदविहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unscriptural, not enjoined in the Vedas. E. अ neg. वेद and विहित declared.
4132: अवेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Unascertainable, secret, not to be known. 2 Not to be pained or hurt. m. (-द्यः) A calf. E. अ neg. वेद्य to be hurt or known.
4133: अवेल m. (-लः) Denial or concealment of knowledge. f. (-ला) Chewed betel. E. अव and इला speech.
4134: अवैध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Irregular, heterodox, contrary or not conformable to rule. E. अ neg. विधि rule, अण् aff.
4135: अवोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Wet, moist. E. अव ill, उन्द to moisten, and क aff.
4136: अव्द m. (-व्दः) 1 A cloud. 2 A year. E. अव to preserve, दन् Uṇādi affix, see अब्द.
4137: अव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Indistinct, unapparent, invisible, imperceptible. 2 In algebra, unknown as quantity or number. m. (क्त) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 ŚIVA. 3 KANDARPA or CUPID. 4 A fool. n. (-क्तं) 1 The Supreme Being or universal spirit. 2 Any invisible principle according to the Sāṃkhya philosophy. 3 The soul. 4 Nature, temperament. E. अ neg. व्यक्त evident, distinct.
4138: अव्यक्तक्रिया f. (-या) Algebraic calculation. 2 Any act of an indistinct character or aim. E. अव्यक्त and क्रिया act.
4139: अव्यक्तराग m. (-गः) Dark-red, the colour of the dawn. E. अव्यक्त indistinct, and राग colour.
4140: अव्यक्तराशि f. (-शिः) An unknown number or indistinct quantity, (in algebra.) E. अव्यक्त and राशि quantity.
4141: अव्यक्तसाम्य n. (म्यं) Equation of unknown quantities. E. अव्यक्त and साम्य equality.
4142: अव्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 Steady, cool, deliberate. 2 Indifferent, undisturbed. E. अ neg. व्यग्र hurried.
4143: अव्यङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Plain, not figurative. 2 Perfect, not mutilated. f. (-ङ्गा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens, Rox) E. अ neg. वि priv. and अङ्ग the body, or व्यङ्ग figure of speech.
4144: अव्यङ्गाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Well made, symmetrical, perfect, entire. E. अव्यङ्ग not defective, अङ्ग a limb.
4145: अव्यञ्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Indistinct. 2 Plain, not figurative. m. (-नः) An animal without horns, though of an age to have them. अ neg. व्यञ्जन a mark or figure.
4147: अव्यतिकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Distinct, specific, separate, unmixed. E. अ neg. व्यतिकीर्ण confounded, mixed.
4148: अव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Free from pain. 2 Merciful, not inflicting pain. m. (-थः) A snake. f. (-था) 1 Yellow myrobalan. 2 Another plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) See पद्मचारिणी. E. अ neg. व्यथा pain.
4149: अव्यथि m. (-थिः) A horse, (in the dialect of the Vedas.) E. अ neg, व्यथ to pain, and इन् affix; who does not tire in war, &c.
4151: अव्यथिन् mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि) Free from pain. 2 Not inflicting pain. E. अ neg. व्यथा pain, इनि aff.
4152: अव्यथिष m. (-षः) 1 The ocean. 2 The sun. f. (-षी) 1 The earth. 2 Midnight. E. अ neg. व्यथ to suffer pain, and टिषच् Uṇādi aff.
4153: अव्यथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) 1 Free from pain. 2 Not paining, not giving pain. E. अ neg. व्यथ to feel pain, and क्यप् affix irr.
4154: अव्यभिचार m. (-रः) Steadiness, consistency, constancy. E. अ neg व्यभिचार irregularity.
4155: अव्यभिचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Constant. 2 Virtuous, moral. 3 Steady, permanent, faithful. E. अ neg. व्यभिचारिन् variable.
4156: अव्यय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Economical, parsimonious. 2 Unexpended, unwasted. 3 Imperishable, immutable, eternal. m. (-यः) A name of VIṢṆU. mn. (-यः-यं) An indeclinable word, a particle. E. अ neg. and व्यय expenditure.
4157: अव्ययात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Eternal, imperishable. m. (त्मा) Soul, spirit. E. अव्यय undecayed, आत्मन् self.
4158: अव्ययीभाव m. (-वः) 1 Imperishableness. 2 An indeclinable compound. E. अव्यय and भाव disposition, with च्चि inserted.
4159: अव्यर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Profitable, fruitful. 2 Effectual, efficacious. E. अ neg. व्यर्थ useless.
4160: अव्यलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) True, veracious. E. अ neg. व्यलीक false.
4161: अव्यवधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Close, contiguous. 2 Careless. E. अ neg. व्यवधान any thing interposed, or carefulness.
4162: अव्यवधानता f. (-ता) 1 Contiguity. 2 Carelessness. E. तल् added to with the last; also with त्व, अव्यवधानत्वं.
4163: अव्यवसाय m. (-यः) Negligence, inactivity. E. अ neg. व्यवसाय employment.
4164: अव्यवसायवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Negligent, remiss in practice. E. अ neg. व्यवसाय practice, profession, मतुप् poss. aff.
4165: अव्यवसायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Negligent, inactive, remiss. E. अ neg. व्यवसाय business, इनि aff.
4166: अव्यवस्था f. (-स्था) 1 Irregularity, deviation from established rule. 2 Incorrect legal opinion. E. अ neg. व्यवस्था law.
4167: अव्यवस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Not conformable to law or practice. 2 Unacquainted with the law or custom. 3 Ill regulated. 4 Displaced, disordered E. अ neg. and व्यवस्थित ordained.
4168: अव्यवहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Unactionable, not to be discussed in law. E. अ neg. व्यवहार्य्य actionable.
4169: अव्यवहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adjoining, contiguous. E. अ neg. and व्यवहित divided.
4170: अव्यवहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Not determined or investigated by law. 2 Not spoken. E. अ neg. व्यवहृत tried.
4171: अव्यसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Moral, correct, free from vice. E. अ neg. व्यसन evil practices.
4172: अव्यसनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Free from evil practices, steady, correct. E. अ neg. व्यसन evil practices, इनि aff.
4173: अव्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Simple, undecomposed. 2 Undispersed, collected. E. अ neg. व्यस्त scattered.
4174: अव्याकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Calm, firm, composed. E. अ neg. व्याकुल flurried.
4175: अव्याकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undecomposed, simple. n. (-तं) Elementary substance from which all things were created, considered as one with the substance of BRAHMA. E. अ neg. व्याकृत separated, decomposed.
4176: अव्याख्या f. (-ख्या) Obscurity, want of clearness or explanation. E. अ neg. आख्या explanation.
4177: अव्याख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unexplained, obscure. E. अ neg. व्याख्यात explained.
4178: अव्याख्यान n. (-नं) Absence of explicitness, want of explanation. E. अ neg. व्याख्यान explanation.
4179: अव्याख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Unintelligible, inexplicable. 2 Easy, not requiring to be explained. E. अ neg. व्याख्येय to be explained.
4180: अव्याज m. (-जः) Absence of fraud, simplicity, honesty. E. अ, and व्याज disguise.
4181: अव्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Special, individual, peculiar. E. अ neg. व्यापक generick.
4182: अव्यापकत्व n. (-त्वं) Speciality, individuality, non-comprehensiveness or generalization. E. अव्यापक special, and त्व affix; also अव्यापकता.
4183: अव्यापार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Inexpert, inexperienced. m. (-रः) Business not practised or understood. E. अ not, व्यापार business.
4184: अव्यापित्व n. (-त्वं) Speciality, non-generalization. E. अ neg. व्यापिन् what pervades, त्व affix; also अव्यापिता.
4185: अव्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Special, individual. 2 Limited, partial, not comprehensive. E. अ neg. व्यापिन् pervading.
4186: अव्याप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Peculiar, individual, limited. E. अ neg. व्याप्त diffused.
4187: अव्याप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Peculiar, not to be extended generally. E. अ neg. व्याप्य to be extended.
4188: अव्याप्यष्टत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः) In logic, A category of individual application, and influenced by place and time, as pain, pleasure, love, hatred, virtue, vice, &c. E. अ neg. व्याप्य diffusive, general, and वृत्ति being.
4189: अव्यायाम m. (-मः) Absence of lassitude or fatigue. E. अ neg. व्यायाम exertion.
4190: अव्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Not returning, not coming back, not circulating. E. अ neg. व्यावर्त्तन returning, revolving.
4191: अव्याहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unresisted, unimpeded. 2 Not disappointed. E. अ neg. व्याहत baffled.
4192: अव्याहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undisputed. E. अ neg. व्याहित disputed.
4193: अव्रण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Sound, unhurt, unscarred. E. अ neg. व्रण a wound.
4194: अव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not observing religious rites or obligations, uninitiated. E. अ neg. व्रत a vow, &c.
4195: अश r. 5th cl. (ऊ.) अशू (अश्नुते) 1 To pervade or occupy. 2 To heap or crowd. r. 9th cl. (अश्नाति) To eat, to eat hungrily. With प्र prefixed, to begin to eat.
4196: अशक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unable, incompetent. E. अ neg. शक्त able, strong.
4197: अशक्तता f. (-ता) Weakness, inability. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, अशक्तत्वं.
4198: अशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Inability, incapability, weakness, impotence. E. अ neg. शक्ति power.
4199: अशक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 1 Impossible, impracticable. 2 Not to be made. E. अ neg. शक्य possible.
4200: अशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) 1 Fearless, undaunted. 2 Secure, certain. E. अ neg. शङ्का fear.
4201: अशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, undoubted. 2 Fearless. E. अ neg. शङ्कित alarmed.
4202: अशठ mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं) Virtuous, good. E. अ neg. शठ wicked.
4203: अशत्रु mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु) Friendly. m. (-त्रुः) A name of the moon. E. अ neg. and शत्रु an enemy; who has.
4204: अशन m. (-नः) A plant, (Pentaptera tomentosa, Rox.) n. (-नं) 1 Food. 2 Eating: also असन. E. अश to eat, ल्युट् aff.
4205: अशनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant: also असनपर्णी.
4206: अशनाया f. (-या) Hunger. E. अशन food, क्यच् affix, अ and टाप् added, and the penultimate made long: wishing for food.
4207: अशनायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungry. E. as before इतच् added.
4208: अशनि mfn. (-निः-निः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. अश to eat, अनि Uṇādi affix; what eats or consumes rocks, &c.
4209: अशरीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Bodiless, incorporeal. m. (-रः) A name of KĀMA or love. E. अ neg. शरीर body.
4210: अशरीरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Incorporeal. E. अ neg. शरीरिन् embodied.
4211: अशर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Pain, affliction. mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Unhappy, afflicted. E. शर्म्मन् happiness, &c. with the priv. prefix.
4212: अशान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Restless, anxious, unresigned. E. अ neg. शान्त tranquil.
4213: अशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Anxiety, restlessness. E. अ neg. शान्ति tranquillity. So अशान्तता f. (-ता.)
4214: अशाम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Unappeasable, not to be pacified. E. अ neg. शम to appease, ण्यत् aff.
4215: अशारीरिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Not relating to or endowed with body. E. अ neg. शरीरिक bodily.
4216: अशाश्चत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perishable, transient, temporary. E. अ neg. शाश्वत eternal.
4217: अशासन n. (-नं) Want of government, anarchy, disorder. E. अ neg. शासन governing.
4218: अशासनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Ungovernable: so अशास्य. E. अ neg. शासनीय or शास्य to be ruled, &c.
4219: अशासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ungoverned, undisciplined. E. अ neg. शासित governed.
4220: अशास्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Not conform able to sacred authority, heterodox, unscriptural. E. अ neg. शास्त्र scripture.
4221: अशास्त्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not conformable to sacred authority, heterodox, immoral, irreligious. E. अ neg. शास्त्रीय scriptural.
4222: अशिक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Untaught, ignorant. E. अ neg. शिक्षित taught.
4223: अशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eaten. 2 Satisfied. E. अश to eat, क्त aff.
4224: अशितङ्गवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formerly grazed by cattle, (a field, &c.) E. अशित eaten, and गवीन relating to cattle; also आशितङ्गवीन.
4225: अशित्र m. (-त्रः) A thief. E. अशू to pervade, इत्र Uṇādi aff.
4226: अशिथिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Firm, tight, hard. E. अ neg. शिथिल loose.
4227: अशिर m. (-रः) 1 A name of the sun. 2 Fire. 3 A goblin or demon. f. (-रा) The wife of a goblin. n. (-रं) A diamond. E. अश to eat, and इर affix; what eats sacrifices, &c.
4228: अशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Headless. E. अ neg. शिरस् the head.
4229: अशिरःस्नान n. (-नं) Bathing the body with exception of the head. E. अ neg. शिरस् the head, स्नान bathing.
4230: अशिव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Unlucky, unfortunate. E. अ neg. शिव propitious.
4231: अशिवी f. (-वी) A female demon or goblin.
4232: अशिश्विका f. (-का) See the following. E. कन् added to अशिश्वी.
4233: अशिश्वी f. (-श्वी) A childless woman. E. अ priv. शिशु a child, and ङीप् fem. affix; उ becomes व.
4234: अशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ill regulated, ill behaved, rude, barbarous, profligate. E. अ neg. शिष्ट regulated.
4235: अशिष्टता f. (-ता) Rudeness, &c. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, अशिष्टत्व.
4236: अशिष्टाचार m. (-रः) Rudeness, profligacy. E. अशिष्ट, and आचार practice.
4237: अशीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Warm, hot. E. अ not, शीत cold.
4238: अशीतकर m. (-रः) The sun. E. अ neg. शीत cold, and कर a ray, and similar compounds, as अशीतदीधिति, अशीतमरीचि, &c.
4239: अशीति f. sing. always. (-तिः) Eighty. du. (-तीः) Two eighties. pl. (-तयः) Many eighties.
4240: अशीतिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Octagenarian, of eighty years of age, &c. E. अशीति and कन् added.
4241: अशीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Undecayed, unimpaired. E. अ neg. शीर्ण decayed.
4242: अशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Ill behaved, vulgar, offensive. 2 Indifferent. E. अ neg. शील polite.
4243: अशुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Green, fresh, moist. E. अ neg. शुष्क dry.
4244: अशुचि f. (-चिः) 1 Impurity. 2 Disgrace, degradation. mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Foul, impure. E. अ neg. शुचि purity.
4245: अशुचित्व n. (-त्वं) Impurity. E. त्व added to अशुचि; also अशुचिता.
4246: अशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Impure. 2 Inaccurate. 3 Unknown, unascertained. E. अ neg. शुद्ध pure.
4247: अशुद्धवासक m. (-कः) A vagrant, a suspicious character. E. अशुद्ध unknown, वास abode, कन् added.
4248: अशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Impurity. mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Impure. E. अ neg. शुद्धि purity.
4249: अशुभ n. (-भं) 1 Sin. 2 Misfortune. mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Unlucky. E. अ priv. शुभ good.
4250: अशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Inattention, neglect of service or respect. E. अ neg. शुश्रूषा service.
4251: अशृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unripe. E. अ neg. and शृत ripe.
4252: अशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Entire, all, the whole. 2 Infinite, endless. E. अ neg. and शेष remainder.
4253: अशेषतस् ind. Entirely, wholly. E. अशेष whole, तसि aff.
4254: अशोक m. (-कः-का-कं) Cheerful, not sorrowful. m. (-कः) A tree, commonly Aśoka, (Jonesia Asoca.) n. (-कं) Quicksilver. f. (-का) 1 A medicinal plant, see कटुकी. 2 One of the female domestic deities of the Jainas. E. अ neg. and शोक sorrow.
4255: अशोकरोहिणी f. (-णी) A medicinal plant, see कटुकी. E. अशोक, and रोहिणी the same.
4256: अशोकारि m. (-रिः) A tree, (Nauclea Cadamba:) see कदम्ब. E. अशोक, and अरि an enemy: choking the Aśoca.
4257: अशोच m. (-चः) Content, tranquillity, the absence of care or vanity. E. अ priv. शोच sorrow.
4258: अशोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Not to be sorrowed for. E. अ neg. शोच्य to be regretted; also अशोचनीय and अशोचितव्य.
4259: अशोधन n. (-नं) 1 Uncleanness. 2 Inaccuracy. E. अ neg. शोधन cleaning, &c.
4260: अशोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unclean, uncleansed. 2 Inaccurate, unrevised, uncorrected. E. अ neg. शोधित purified.
4261: अशोष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Not to be dried up. E. अ neg. शौष्य to be dried up; so अशोषणीय &c.
4262: अशौच n. (-चं) 1 Foulness, impurity. 2 Legal impurity, contamination, defilement contracted by the death of a relation, the commission of prohibited acts, &c. E. अ neg. शौच purification.
4263: अशौचत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Impure or abandoned nature or disposition. 2 Defilement, contamination. E. त्व added to अशौच.
4264: अशौर्प्य n. (-र्प्यं) Want of heroism, cowardice. E. अ neg. शौर्य्यं valour.
4265: अश्म m. (-श्मः) 1 A mountain, a rock. 2 A cloud, (in the language of the Vedas:) see अश्मन्.
4266: अश्मकुट्ट m. (-ट्टः-ट्टा-ट्टं) Who or what breaks with a stone. 2 Bruised or broken by stones. E. अश्म and कुट्ठ what bruises or breaks.
4267: अश्मकुट्टक mfn. (-कः-का-क्रं) Breaking or bruising any thing with a stone. E. अश्म and कुदृक who breaks.
4268: अश्मगर्भ m. (-र्भः) An emerald. E. अश्मन् a stone, and गर्भ the womb; the primary stone.
4269: अश्मगर्भज n. (-जं) An emerald. E. अश्म and गर्म्भ before ज produced.
4270: अश्मज n. (-जं) 1 Red chalk. 2 Iron. E. अश्मन् a stone, &c. and ज produced.
4271: अश्मजतुक n. (-कं) Bitumen. E. अश्म and जतुक lac.
4272: अश्मदारण m. (-णः) An axe or crow for breaking stones, &c. n. (-णं) Splitting stones or rocks. E. अश्मन् a stone, &c. द to split, ल्युट् aff.
4273: अश्मन् m. (-श्मा) A stone or rock. E. अश to spread, &c. मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
4274: अश्मन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Unbounded, unlimited. 2 Inauspicious, unlucky. n. (-न्तं) 1 A fire-place. 2 Death. 3 A field, a plain. E. अश्मन् a stone, &c. and अन्त the end; it is also written अश्वन्त and अस्मन्त.
4275: अश्मन्तक n. (-कं) 1 A fire-place. 2 A shade for a lamp. 3 A species of oxalis. E. कन् added to the preceding.
4276: अश्मपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Benzoin, (Styrax benzoin.) E. अश्मन् a stone, and षुष्प a flower: supposed to exude from rocks.
4277: अश्मभाल m. (-लः) A mortar of stone or iron. E. अश्मन् a stone, and भाल the skull.
4278: अश्मभिद् m. (-द्) The name of a plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides, Rox.) E. अश्मन a stone, and भिद् what breaks.
4279: अश्मभेद m. (-दः) See the preceding. E. as before, अश्मन् and भेद.
4280: अश्ममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of stone, stony. n. (-यं) A mineral. E. अश्म and मयट् aff.
4281: अश्मयोनि m. (-निः) An emerald. E. see अश्मगर्भ.
4282: अश्मर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Stony, rocky, appertaining to stone or rock. E. अश्मन् and र aff.
4283: अश्मरी f. (-री) 1 Strangury. 2 Stone or gravel, (the disease.) E. अश्मर stony, and ङीप् fem. aff.
4284: अश्मरीघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A tree, (Tapia cratoeva.) E. अश्मरी gravel, and घ्न what destroys; a lithonthriptic.
4285: अश्मरीहर m. (-रः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. see the last word, हर from हृ to carry away.
4286: अश्मसार mn. (-रः-रं) Iron. E. अश्मन् a stone, and सार essence, &c. the hardest stone, &c.
4287: अश्मान्तक m. (-कः) A plant, from the fibres of which the girdle of a Brahman may be made; also अश्मन्तक.
4288: अश्मीर mn. (-रः-रं) Stone or gravel, (the disease.) E. अश्मन् a stone, ईर aff.
4289: अश्र n. (-श्रं) 1 A tear. 2 Blood. E. अश्रू to spread, &c. and र affix: see अश्रु and अस्र.
4290: अश्रद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Unbelieving. f. (-द्धा) Unbelief. E. अ neg. श्रद्धा faith.
4291: अश्रद्धधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unbelieving, incredulous, having no faith. E. अ neg. श्रद्धधान believing.
4292: अश्रद्धेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Incredible, not to be believed. E. अ and श्रद्धेय worthy of faith.
4293: अश्रप m. (-पः) A fiend, a cannibal. E. अश्र blood, and प who drinks.
4294: अश्रवण n. (-णं) Deafness, loss of hearing. E. अ neg. श्रवण hearing.
4295: अश्रम m. (-मः) 1 Freshness, freedom from fatigue. 2 Laziness, want of exertion. E. अ neg. श्रम fatigue.
4296: अश्राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Not performing exequial rites, not entitled to them, not belonging or relating to them. m. (-द्धः) Nonperformance of exequial rites. E. अ neg. श्राद्ध funereal ceremony.
4297: अश्रान्त adv. n. (-न्तं) adj. mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Eternal, continual. 2 Unwearied. E. अ neg. and श्रान्त wearied, part. past of श्रम.
4298: अश्रि f. (-श्रिः) 1 The edge of a sword. 2 A corner, the angle of a room or house. E. श्रिञ to serve, आङ् prefixed, आ becomes अ; also अश्री and आश्रि.
4299: अश्रीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unlucky, unpropitious. E. अ neg. श्री fortune, and कन् aff.
4300: अश्रीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Inglorious, unfortunate. E. अ neg. श्रीमत् fortunate.
4301: अश्रील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unlucky, unprosperous. E. अ neg. श्री prosperity, ला to have, affix क.
4302: अश्रु n. (-श्रु) A tear. E. अ neg. श्रि to serve, डुन् Uṇādi affix; it is also written अश्र.
4303: अश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unheard. 2 Not directed by or contrary to the Vedas. E. अ and श्रुत heard, &c.
4304: अश्रुनाली f. (-ली) Fistula lacrymalis. E. अश्रु and नाली a channel.
4305: अश्रुपात m. (-तः) A flow of tears. E. अश्रु, and पात fall.
4306: अश्रेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Worthless, useless, unprofitable, bad. 2 Inferior, worse. E. अ neg. श्रेयस् excellent.
4307: अश्रेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठ) 1 Inferior, worse. 2 Bad, vile. E. अ neg. श्रेष्ठ best.
4308: अश्रोत्रिय m. (-यः) A Brahman who has not read the Vedas. E. अ neg. श्रोत्रिय a learned Brahman.
4309: अश्लाघ्य mfn. (-घ्यः-घ्या-घ्यं) Worthless, undeserving of honour or praise. E. अ neg. श्लाघ्य to be praised.
4310: अश्लाघनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undeserving of honour or praise, base, mean, worthless. E. अ neg. श्लाघनीय to be praised.
4311: अश्लीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unlucky, unpropitious. E. as अश्रीक, the र being changed to ल.
4312: अश्लील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Coarse, vulgar. 2 Abusive, blackguard. n. (-लं) 1 Rustic language. 2 Untruth. 3 Low abuse. E. अ neg. श्लील elegant.
4313: अश्लेषा f. (-षा) 1 The ninth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion, containing five stars. 2 Disunion, disjunction. E. अ neg. and श्लष union.
4314: अश्लेषाभव m. (-वः) A name of KETU or the dragon's head: see केतु. E. अश्लेषा the asterism, and भव born, born under the sign Aśleṣā; or अश्लेषा disjunction, and भव produced; as KETU was formed of the lower extremities which had been sundered by VIṢṆU from RĀHU.
4315: अश्लेषाभू m. (-भूः) A name of KETU. E. as the preceding, भू to be born, with क्विप् aff.
4316: अश्व m. (-श्वः) 1 A horse. 2 A set or cast of men horse-like in strength. (-श्वौ) A horse and a mare. f. (-श्वा) A mare. E. अश to pervade, क्वन Uṇādi affix, and टाप् fem. aff.
4317: अश्वक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Horse-like, acting like a horse, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A bad horse, a hack. 2 A stray horse, one whose owner is not known. 3 Any horse. E. अश्व and कन् added in different senses.
4319: अश्वकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A timber tree, commonly Sākva or Śāl, (Shorea robusta.) E. अश्व a horse, and कर्ण an ear, the leaves being compared to the ears of a horse.
4320: अश्वकर्णक m. (-कः) The Śāl-tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. कन् added to अश्वकर्ण.
4321: अश्वकिनी f. (-नी) The first Nakṣatra or lunar mansion. E. अश्वक a horse, इनि and ङीप् affixes: see अश्विनी.
4322: अश्वखुर m. (-रः) 1 A horse's hoof. 2 A perfume, apparently a dried shell-fish: see नखी. f. (-रा-री) A plant, (Clitoria ternatea.) E. अश्व and खुर his hoof: which the perfume and leaves of the plant are supposed to resemble.
4323: अश्वगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. अश्व, and गन्ध smell; having the smell of a horse.
4324: अश्वगोयुग n. (-गं) A pair of horses. E. अश्व and गोयुगच् affix implying a pair, a brace, &c.
4325: अश्वगोष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A stable. E. अश्व, and गोष्ठ abode, place.
4326: अश्वग्रीव m. (-वः) The name of a demon, more commonly named Hayagrīva. E. अश्व and ग्रीवा a neck; horse-necked.
4327: अश्वघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Oleander, (Nerium odorum.) E. अश्व and घ्न what kills or hurts, from हन; horse-destroying.
4328: अश्वचिकित्सक m. (-कः) A farrier. E. अश्व and चिकित्सक who heals.
4329: अश्वचिकित्सा f. (-सा) Farriery. E. अश्व and चिकित्सा medical treatment.
4330: अश्वतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Swift, speedy. mf. (-रः-री) A mule. m. (-रः) 1 One of the chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent race, inhabiting the regions under the earth. 2 A Gandharba or celestial quirister. 3 A male calf. E. अश्व and तर from तृ to pass, to go, affix अप्; or ष्टरच् diminutive aff.
4331: अश्वत्थ m. (-त्थः) 1 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiousa.) 2 The fruit of the tree. 3 The time at which it bears. f. (-त्था) Day of fullmoon. E. अ neg. श्व a future period, and थ from स्था to remain; of less duration than the Vaṭa or Indian fig; there are several other etymologies.
4332: अश्वत्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) To be given, to be done, &c. when the Aśvattha tree bears. n. (-कं) The petals of the Arabian jasmine. E. अश्वत्थ and वुन् aff.
4333: अश्वत्थामन् m. (-मा) The name of a saint and warrior, the son of DROṆA. E. अश्व, स्था to stand or stay, and मनिन् affix; the story is that at his birth he made a noise like a horse; also with a final vowel अश्वत्थाम.
4335: अश्वन्त n. (-न्तं) 1 Death. 2 Termination, limit. 3 A fire-place. 4 A field. 5 Unlucky, inauspicious. E. अशु vital air, अन्त end; also अश्मन्त.
4336: अश्वपाल m. (-लः) A groom. E. अश्व, and पाल who takes care of.
4337: अश्वबाल m. (-लः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 2 Horse hair. E. अश्व and बाल a tail.
4339: अश्वमहिषिका f. (-का) The natural enmity of a horse and a buffalo. E. अश्व, महिष a buffalo, वुन् affix of enmity.
4340: अश्वमार m. (-रः) Oleander, (Nerium odorum.) E. अश्व and मार what kills; the plant is conceived to be deleterious to the horse.
4342: अश्वमाल m. (-लः) A kind of serpent.
4343: अश्वमुख m. (-खः) A Kinnara or celestial quirister. E. अश्व and मुख a face; this kind of demigod being represented with a horse's head.
4344: अश्वमेध m. (-धः) The actual or emblematic sacrifice of a horse. E. अश्व and मेध sacrifice; this sacrifice is one of the highest order, and performed a hundred times, entitles the sacrificer to the dominion of Svarga or paradise: it appears to have been originally typical; the horse, and other animals being simply bound during the performance of certain ceremonies; the actual sacrifice is an introduction of a later period. See As. R. Vol. viii. p. 442, COLEBROOKE on the Vedas.
4345: अश्वमेधिक m. (-कः) A horse fit for the sacrifice called Aśvamedha. E. अश्वमेध as above, कन् added, and इ inserted.
4346: अश्वमेधीय m. (-यः) A horse fit for an Aśvamedha. E. अश्वमेध and छ aff.
4347: अश्वयुज् f. (-युक्) The first lunar mansion: see अश्विनी. m. (-युक् or -युजः) The month Aśvin, (Sept.-Oct.) see आश्वयुज. E. अश्व, युज to join, affix क्विप्; also with अ added in the last sense.
4348: अश्वरक्ष m. (-क्षः) The keeper or rider of a horse. E. अश्व and रक्ष who preserves.
4349: अश्वलाल m. (-लः) A kind of snake. E. अश्व and लाल spittle, whose foam is like that of a horse.
4350: अश्वलोमन् m. (-मा) 1 A kind of snake. 2 Horse hair. E. अश्व and लोमन् hair.
4351: अश्ववक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A chorister of Svarga, a Kinnara or Gandharba. E. अश्व and वक्त्र face, horse-faced: these demigods being so represented.
4352: अश्ववडव n. (-वं) A stud of horses and mares. m. du. or plu. only. (-वौ-वाः) 1 A horse and a mare. 2 Horses and mares. E. अश्व and वडवा a mare.
4353: अश्ववह m. (-हः) A horseman. E. अश्व and वह what bears; whom a horse carries.
4354: अश्ववार m. (-रः) A horseman. E. अश्व and वृञ to nourish, अण् aff.
4355: अश्ववारण m. (-णः) The Gayal, a sort of ox, (Bos gavoeus.) E. अश्व, वृ to skreen or hide, in the causal form, युच् aff.
4356: अश्वविद् m. (-वित्) 1 A name of NALA, a king and hero of several poems. 2 A jockey. E. अश्व and विद् who knows.
4357: अश्ववैद्य m. (-द्यः) A farrier, a horse doctor. E. अश्व and वैद्य physician.
4358: अश्वशाला f. (-ला) 1 A stable. 3 A riding house. E. अश्व and शाला a hall.
4359: अश्वशाव m. (-वः) A foal, a colt. E. अश्व and शाव young.
4360: अश्वशृगालिका f. (-का) The natural enmity between a horse and a jackall. E. अश्व and शृगाल a jackall, affix वुन् implying hostility.
4361: अश्वषङ्गव n. (-वं) A set of six horses. E. अश्व and षङ्गवच् a set of six.
4362: अश्वसादिन् m. (-दी) A horseman, a rider, a horse-soldier. E. अश्व and सादिन् who goes.
4363: अश्वसारथ्य n. (-थ्यं) Management of horses and cars, coachmanship, charioteership. E. अश्व and सारथि a driver, घञ् aff.
4364: अश्वसेन m. (-नः) A proper name, a king.
4365: अश्वसेननृपनन्दन m. (-नः) A king and saint; also SANATKUMĀRA. E. अश्वसेन a proper name, नृप a king, and नन्दन a son: the son of the king AŚVASENA.
4366: अश्वस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Of to-day, not of or for to-morrow. E. अ neg. श्वस् to-morrow, द्यु aff.
4367: अश्वस्तनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Not of or for to-morrow. E. अश्वस्तन and ठक् aff.
4368: अश्वहारक m. (-कः) A horse stealer. E. अश्व and हारक who takes away.
4369: अश्वहृदय n. (-यं) Horsemanship. E. अश्व and हृदम heart, affection.
4370: अश्वारि m. (-रिः) A buffalo. E. अश्व and अरि an enemy.
4371: अश्वारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted, set on horseback. E. अश्व and आरूढ mounted.
4372: अश्वारोह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Riding or carried on a horse. m. (-हः) A horseman. f. (-हा) A plant; also Aśvagandhā, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. अश्व and आरोह what mounts.
4373: अश्वावरोहक m. (-कः) A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. अश्व, अव on, &c. रोहक what grows; growing to the length of a horse.
4374: अश्वारोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Mounted or riding on horseback. E. अश्व and आरोहिन् what mounts.
4375: अश्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Drawn by horses, carried by horses, &c. E. अश्व and ष्ठन् aff.
4376: अश्विन् m. du. (-नौ) The twin sons of AŚVINĪ by SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga. E. अश्विनी and अण् affix, the fem. termination is dropped.
4377: अश्विनी f. (-नी) 1 The first of the twenty-eight Nakṣatras or constellations in the moon's path, hence considered its mansions. 2 In mythology, a nymph, the asterism personified. 3 The wife of SŪRYA, who concealed herself in the form of a mare. E. अश्व a horse, इन् and ङीप् affix; the symbol of the Nakṣatra is a horse's head, figured by three stars in the head of ARIES.
4378: अश्विनीकुमार m. du. (-रो) The twin sons of SŪRYA the sun, by his wife SAṂJÑĀ transformed to a mare; they are endowed with perpetual youth and beauty, and are the physicians of the gods. E. अश्विनी the wife of SŪRYA, and कुमार a youth.
4379: अश्विनीपुत्र m. du. (-त्रौ) The Aśvins: see the last. E. अश्विनी and पुत्र a son.
4380: अश्विनीसुत m. du. (-ता) The twin sons of AŚVINĪ by SŪRYA. E. अश्विनी and सुत a son.
4381: अश्विसालोक्य n. (-क्यं) The heaven or station of the Aśvins, to which the giver of a horse is raised. E. अश्विन् and सालोक्य interview.
4382: अश्वीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Distant a day's journey for a horse, more usually आश्वीन.
4383: अश्वीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a horse. n. (-यं) A number of horses. E. अश्व and छ aff.
4384: अश्वोरस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Broad chested. E. अश्व and उरस् the breast, टच् aff.
4385: अष r. 1st cl. (असति-ते) 1 To go or move. 2 To take or receive. 3 To shine: see अस.
4386: अषडक्षीण m. (-णः) A secret. E. अ neg. षट six, अक्षि an eye, and ख affix; what is not seen by six eyes, that is, known or determined by two persons to the exclusion of a third.
4387: अषाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Produced or occurring in the month Āṣārha. m. (-ढः) 1 The month Āṣāḍha, commencing with the sun's entrance into Gemini, (June-July.) 2 A student's staff. f. (-ढा) A name common to the twentieth and twenty-first lunar mansion: see पूर्ष्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा. E. see आषाढ, the initial being made short.
4388: अषाढक m. (-कः) The month Āṣāḍha; also आषाढक.
4389: अष्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Eight. 2 Eighth. n. (-कं) The eight sections of PĀṆINI'S Grammar. m. (-कः) 1 The formulae of the Rig Veda as collected into eight portions, thence called Aṣṭakas. 2 One acquainted with PĀṆINI'S rules or the formulae of the Veda. E. कन added to अष्ट.
4390: अष्टकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. अष्ट eight, and कर्ण an ear; eight-eared, being four-headed.
4391: अष्टका f. (-का) 1 Worship of the manes or progenitors performed on certain days. 2 The eighth day of three months on which the progenitors are worshipped. E. अश to eat, and तकन् affix; vegetables, flesh, and cake, being severally offered upon these occasions, and the Brahmins feasted; in this sense it is also अष्टिका.
4392: अष्टकाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A kind of board or cloth for playing with dice on. E. अष्टक eight, and अङ्ग body, having eight divisions.
4393: अष्टकोण m. (-णः) An octagon. E. अष्ट and कोण angle.
4394: अष्टगाध् m. (-ट् or -त्) 1 A fabulous animal supposed to have eight legs: see शरभ. 2 A spider.
4395: अष्टगव n. (-वं) A flock of eight cows. E. अष्ट and गव kine.
4396: अष्टगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Eight fold. E. अष्ट eight, गुण number.
4397: अष्टदिक्पाल m. plu. (-लाः) The regents of the cardinal points, as INDRA of the East; VAHNI of the S. E.; YAMA of the South; NAIRṚTA of the S. W.; VARUṆA of the West; MARUT of the N. W.; KUVERA of the North; and ĪŚA of the N. E. अष्टदिश् the eight points, and पाल who protects.
4398: अष्टदिश् f. (-दिक्) The eight cardinal points of the compass collectively. E. अष्ट eight, and दिश् quarter.
4399: अष्टधा ind. Eight fold, eight times. E. अष्ट eight, धा aff.
4400: अष्टधातु n. (-तु) The eight metals collectively, as, gold, silver, copper, tin, lead, brass, iron and steel. E. अष्ट and धातु a mineral.
4401: अष्टन् mfn. plu. only (अष्ट or अष्टौ) Eight. E. असू to pervade, कनिन Uṇādi affix, and तुद् inserted.
4402: अष्टपाद m. (-पात् or -पाद्) 1 A spider. 2 A fabulous animal with eight legs: see शरभ. (-दः) A kind of spider with a small body and long legs. E. अष्ट eight, and पाद a foot.
4403: अष्टी f. (-ष्टी) A metre consisting of four lines, and having sixteen syllables in each; there are nine species of it. E. अष्टन् eight, ङीप् fem. aff.
4404: अष्टम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Eighth. f. (-मी) 1 The eighth day of the fortnight. 2 A medicinal plant: see क्षीरकाकोली, the last of a class of eight medicinal plants: see अष्टवर्ग. E. अष्टन् with डट् affix and मट augment.
4405: अष्टमङ्गल m. (-लः) A horse with a white face, tail, mane, breast, and hoofs. n. (-लं) A collection of eight lucky things to be assembled on certain occasions, as at a coronation, &c. as a lion, a bull, an elephant, a water jar, a fan, a flag, a trumpet, and a lamp; or a Brahman, a cow, fire, gold, ghee, the sun, water, and a king. E. अष्ट eight, and मङ्गल auspicious.
4406: अष्टमांश m. (-शः) An eighth. E. अष्टम and अंश a part.
4407: अष्टमान n. (-नं) A measure, one Kuḍava. E. अष्ट eight, and मान measure.
4408: अष्टमिका f. (-का) A weight of four tolas. E. अष्टम eight, कन् added fem. form.
4409: अष्टमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. अष्ट eight, and मूर्त्ति form: evident in the earth, water, &c.
4410: अष्टमूर्त्तिधर m. (-रः) A name of ŚIVA. E. अष्टमूर्त्ति an assemblage of eight forms, and धर who has, being identical with the five elements and with the mind, individuality and crude matter.
4411: अष्टलोहक n. (-कं) A class of eight metals: gold, silver, copper, tin, lead, and iron of three sorts, including steel. E. अष्ट eight, लोहक metal.
4412: अष्टवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class of eight principal medicaments, they are mostly the roots of plants from the hills, which have not been determined, and are named: Ṛṣabha, Jīvaka, Meda, Mahāmeda, Ṛddhi, Vṛddhi, Kākolī and Kṣīrakākolī. E. अष्ट eight, and वर्ग a class.
4413: अष्टविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Eight fold, of eight kinds. E. अष्ट eight, and विध sort.
4414: अष्टश्रवस् m. (-वाः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. अष्ट and श्रवस् an ear; eight-eared.
4415: अष्टाकपाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Prepared in eight pans. m. (-लः) 1 A sacrifice in which ghee is offered in eight vessels. E. अष्ट and कपाल the convexity of a jar.
4416: अष्टागव n. (-वं) A car or wain, one drawn by eight oxen. E. अष्ट and गो a cow, अण aff.
4417: अष्टाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Eight parts of the body, the hands, breast, forehead, eyes, throat and middle of the back; or four first, with the knees and feet; or these six, with the words and mind. 2 Any whole consisting of eight parts or members. 3 The eight parts of a court, or the law, the judge, assessors, scribe and astrologer, gold, fire and water. 3 A die, dice. E. अष्ट eight, and अङ्ग a limb.
4418: अष्टाङ्गनय m. (-यः) See the above. E. अष्टाङ्ग and नय taking.
4419: अष्टाङ्गपात m. (-तः) Prostration as in reverence. E. अष्टाङ्ग eight members, and पात falling, touching the ground with the hands, knees, and feet, forehead and breast.
4420: अष्टाङ्गप्रणाम m. (-मः) Profound reverence, prostration with the hands, feet, thighs, breast, eyes, head, words and mind. E. अष्टाङ्ग and प्रणाम bowing.
4421: अष्टाङ्गार्घ्य m. (-र्घ्यः) An offering of eight articles, water, milk, Kusa grass, curds, ghee rice, barley and mustard: or honey, red oleander flowers, and sandal, are substituted for the three last. E. अष्ट eight, अङ्ग member, अर्घ्य offering.
4422: अष्टादशन् mfn. plu. only (-दश) Eighteen. E. अष्ट eight, and दशन् ten.
4423: अष्टापद mn. (-दः-दं) 1 A kind of chequered cloth or board for drafts, dice, &c. 2 Gold. m. (-दः) 1 A spider. 2 A fabulous animal with eight legs, the Śarabha. 3 The mountain Kailāsa or abode of KUVERA. 4 A worm. 5 A pin or bolt. f. (-दी) A wild sort of jasmin. E. अष्ट eight, and पद a quarter, place, foot, &c. अ being made long.
4424: अष्टापदपत्र n. (-त्रं) gold leaf, a sheet of gold. E. अष्टापद and पत्र a leaf.
4425: अष्टापाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Quartered by eight, having eight for the root. E. अष्टन् and पाद a quarter.
4426: अष्टारचक्रवत् m. (-वान्) A Jaina saint and ruler. E. अष्ट, अर a period, and चक्रवत् a ruler; such for eight Aras.
4427: अष्टास्र n. (-स्रं) An octagon. E. अष्ट and अस्र angle.
4429: अष्ठि f. (-ष्ठिः) A kernel, a stone. E. अ neg. स्था to remain, इन् aff.
4430: अष्ठीला f. (-ला) 1 A round pebble or stone. 2 A globular swelling below the navel, produced by wind. 3 Contusion. E. अस्थि a bone, ला to bring, (to resemble,) क aff.
4431: अष्ठीवत् mn. (-वान्-वत्) The knee. E. अस्थि a bone, and मतुप् poss. aff.
4432: अष्ठीलिका f. (-का) A pebble. E. कन् added to the last, fem. form.
4433: असंयम m. (-मः) Absence of check or restraint, especially of the senses. E. अ neg. संयम restraint.
4434: असंयोग m. (-गः) Absence of union or connection. E. अ neg. संयोग connection.
4435: असंलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Disjoined, detached, separate. E. अ neg. मम् with लग्न connected.
4436: असंविदान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Ignorant, unwise. 2 Not promising or contracting. E. अ neg. सं before विद् to know, शानच् aff.
4437: असंवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uncovered, exposed. E. अ neg. संवृत covered.
4438: असंशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Free from doubt, certain. n. adv. (-यं) Certainly, verily. E. अ neg. संशय doubt.
4439: असंश्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Out of hearing. E. अ neg. सं with श्रव hearing.
4440: असंसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Indifferent to, not attached to. E. अ neg. सम् with सक्त attached.
4441: असंसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Unmixed with. 2 Separate, not living in common. E. अ neg. संसृष्ट united.
4442: असंस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Not perfect, unpolished, rude, common. 2 Unintiated, not having gone through the proper rites of caste, state, sex or age. E. अ neg. संस्कृत perfect.
4443: असंस्तुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unknown, unacquainted, not known as acquaintances. 2 Not friends. E. अ neg. संस्तुत known.
4444: असंस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Want, destitution. 2 Disorder, confusion. E. अ neg. मंस्थान station.
4445: असंस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disordered, irregular, not arranged or arrayed. 2 Not collected or assembled. 3 Destitute. E. अ neg. संस्थित placed together.
4446: असंस्थिति f. (-तिः) See असंस्थान. E. as before, स्थिति stay.
4447: असंहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Scattered, loose, straggling, uncompressed. m. (-तः) A form of array, loose or open order of troops. E. अ neg. संहत compact.
4448: असंहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Irresistible, insuperable. E. अ neg. संहार्य्य to be repelled.
4449: अस (ञ) r. 1st cl. (असति-ते) 1 To go or move. 2 To take or receive. 3 To shine. (ल) r. 2d cl. (अस्ति) To be. (य, उ, इर) r. 4th cl. (अस्यति-ते) To throw or direct. With अनु prefixed, to sit down: with अप, to quit or abandon: with नि, to deposit: with निर्, to expel: with परि and उप, to sit around: with प्र, to throw away, to reject, to confute: with वि, to divide: with वि and आङ्, to class, to arrange: with सम and नि, to abandon the world: with सम, to collect, to combine or compound.
4450: असकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Part, not all, unentire. E. अ neg. सकल all.
4451: असकृत् ind. Repeatedly, again and again. E. अ neg. and सकृत् once.
4452: असकृद्गर्भवास m. (-सः) Repeated birth. E. असकृत् repeatedly, गर्भ the womb, वास abode.
4453: असक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Detached, disunited. 2 Not interested in, indifferent to, unattached to. 3 Detached from worldly feelings and passions. E. अ neg. सक्त united.
4454: असक्थ mfn. (-क्थः-क्था-क्थं) Without thighs. E. अ neg. सक्थि a thigh, अच् affix; also without the affix, असक्थि.
4455: असखिन् m. (-खा) An enemy, an adversary. E. अ neg. सखिन् a friend.
4456: असगोत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Of a different family. E. अ neg. स with गोत्र family.
4457: असङ्कल्प mn. (-ल्पः-ल्पं) 1 Sincerity. 2 Absence of predetermination. E. अ neg. सङ्कल्प will, vow.
4458: असङ्कल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not purposed, not resolved or determined on. E. अ neg. सङ्कल्पित purposed.
4459: असङ्कसुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Firm, steady. E. अ neg. सङ्कसुक mutable.
4460: असङ्कीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Uncompounded, uncollected, unmixed. E. अ neg. मङ्कीर्ण collected.
4461: असङ्कुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Clear, open, broad. m. (-लः) A broad road. E. अ neg. and सङ्कुल crowded.
4462: असङ्केत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not appointed, not agreed upon. E. अ neg. सङ्केत an agreement.
4463: असङ्ख्य mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्य) Innumerable, exceedingly numerous. E. अ neg. and सङ्ख्य to be numbered.
4464: असङ्ख्यता f. (-ता) Innumerability, immensity, infinity. E. तल् added to the preceding; or with त्व, असङ्ख्यत्वं.
4465: असङ्ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uncounted. E. अ neg. सङ्ख्यात numbered.
4466: असङ्ख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Innumerable. E. अ neg. सङ्ख्येय to be counted.
4467: असङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्का-ङ्गं) Solitary, unassociated. E. अ neg. सङ्ग with.
4468: असङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uneven, unequal. 2 Unattached. 3 Unpreferred, disesteemed. 4 Improbable, inconsistent. 5 Unaccompanied, unassociated with. E. अ neg. सङ्गत connected.
4469: असङ्गति f. (-तिः) 1 Improbability, incongruity. 2 Not associating with. E. अ neg. सङ्गति congruity.
4470: असङ्गम m. (-मः) 1 Separation, disunion. 2 Inequality. 3 Incongruity. 4 Not associating with. E. अ neg. सङ्गम union.
4471: असच्छास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Heretical or heterodox doctrine. E. असत् untrue, शास्त्र a scripture.
4472: असज्जन m. (-नः) A wicked or contemptible person. E. असत् bad, जन a person.
4473: असज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Insensible. E. अ neg. सज्ञा sign of life.
4474: असत् mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्) 1 Non-existent, not being. 2 Untrue, unreal. 3 Bad, vile. E. अ neg. and सत् being, &c.
4475: असतायी f. (-यी) Wickedness. E. असत् bad, ङीप् affix, and आय inserted.
4476: असती f. (-ती) A disloyal or unchaste woman. E. अ neg. and सती virtuous, &c.
4477: असतीसुत m. (-तः) A bastard. E. असती and सुत a son.
4478: असत्कर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked. n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness. E. असत and कर्म्म act; also असत्कार्य्य, असत्क्रिया, &c.
4479: असत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill done, done from improper motives, or in an unbecoming manner. E. अ neg. सत् good, कृत done.
4480: असत्ता f. (-त्ता) 1 Non-existence. 2 Untruth. 3 Wickedness. E. असत् and तल् added; also with त्व, असत्त्वं.
4481: असत्पथ m. (-थः) 1 A bad road. 2 Evil practice or doctrine. E. अ neg. सत् good, and पथिन् a road.
4482: असत्परिग्रह m. (-हः) Receiving unfit presents, or from improper persons. E. असत् and परिग्रह acceptance.
4483: असत्पुत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A childless man. 2 A wicked or disreputable son. E. असत् and पुत्र a son.
4484: असत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 False, untrue. 2 Lying, a liar. n. (-त्यं) Untruth. E. अ neg. सत्य true.
4485: असत्यवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) A liar, speaking falsely, giving false evidence. E. असत्य and वादिन् who speaks.
4486: असत्यसन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Treacherous, base, wicked. E. असत्य untrue, सन्धि combination, अच् aff.
4487: असत्यसन्निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Improbable, unlikely. असत्य and सन्निभ like.
4488: असत्संसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Evil company. E. असत् wicked, and संसर्ग association.
4489: असद् m. (-द् or -त्) A name of INDRA.
4490: असदध्येतृ m. (-ता) A heterodox student. E. असत् untrue, bad, अधि before इङ् to go, to read or study, and तृच् aff.
4491: असदाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wicked, following evil practices. m. (-रः) Evil practice. E. असत् and आचार observance.
4492: असदाचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wicked, vile, one who follows bad or heterodox practices. E. असदाचार and इनि aff.
4493: असदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Unlike, dissimilar. E. अ neg. सदृश् like.
4494: असद्ग्रह m. (-हः) Caprice, idle or childish desire. E. अ neg. सत् good, wise, &c. and ग्रह what is taken.
4495: असद्भाव m. (-वः) 1 An evil temperament or disposition. 2 Nonexistence. E. असत् and भाव nature.
4496: असद्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Low or degrading occupation or profession. 2 Wickedness. E. असत् wicked, वृत्ति practice.
4497: असद्व्यवहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Following evil practices. m. (-रः) Evil practices. E. असत् and व्यवहार practice.
4498: असद्व्यवहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Following evil courses. E. असद्व्यवहार and इनि aff.
4499: असन m. (-नः) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) n. (-नं) Throwing, sending. E. अस to expel (disease), to send, to throw, ल्युट् aff.
4500: असनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) The name of a plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. असन and पर्ण a leaf; having leaves like the Asana.
4501: असन्तति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Childless. f. (-तिः) Want of posterity. E. अ neg. सन्तति descendants.
4502: असन्तान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Childless, having no posterity. m. (-नः) Want of posterity. E. अ neg. सन्तान progeny.
4503: असन्तुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Displeased. E. अ neg. मन्तुष्ट pleased.
4504: असन्तोष m. (-षः) Displeasure. E. अ neg. मन्तोष pleasure.
4505: असन्दिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Undoubted, unsuspected. 2 Certain, confident. E. अ neg. सन्दिग्ध doubted.
4506: असन्दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Unapprised. 2 Uncommunicated. E. अ neg. सन्दिष्ट informed.
4507: असन्धान n. (-नं) 1 Want of an aim or object. 2 Disjunction. E. अ neg. सन्धान holding together.
4508: असन्धि f. (-न्धिः) Want of union or connection. E. अ neg. सन्धि junction.
4509: असन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Untied, unbound, at liberty, loose. E. अ neg. सन्धित tied.
4510: असन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Affecting knowledge, conceited as a Paṇḍita or teacher. 3 Proud. 4 Unarmed. E. अ neg. सम with, &c. नद्ध the part. past, of नह to bind.
4511: असन्निकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Non-perception of objects, not bringing them to the mind. 2 Remoteness. E. अ neg. सन्निकर्ष attraction.
4512: असन्निकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Unperceived, undistinguished. 2 Remote, not near. E. अ neg. सन्निकृष्ट drawn near to.
4513: असन्निधि f. (-धिः) 1 Absence, distance. 2 Confidence, absence of doubt. E. अ neg. सन्निधि proximity.
4514: असन्निहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Far, not near. E. अ neg. सन्निहित placed near.
4515: असन्मान n. (-नं) 1 Disrespect. 2 Impropriety. E. अ neg. सन्मान respect.
4516: असपिण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Unconnected by obsequial offerings. E. अ neg. सपिण्ड offering a common cake.
4517: असभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) 1 Unfit for an assembly. 2 Vulgar, low. E. अ neg. सभ्य belonging to a company.
4518: असम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Unequalled, individual, without a fellow or equal. 2 Uneven, unequal either in surface or number. m. (-मः) A name of Buddha or a Buddha. E. अ neg. and सम like, same.
4519: असमक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Absent, not present or visible. E. अ neg. समक्ष before the eyes.
4520: असमग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Part, partial, incomplete, unentire. E. अ neg. समग्र all.
4521: असमञ्जस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Unequal, unlike. n. (-सं) Unconformity, disparity, difference. E. अ neg. समञ्जस equal.
4522: असमय m. (-यः) 1 Unseasonableness. 2 Unfit or unfavourable time. E. अ neg. समय season.
4523: असमवायिकारण n. (-णं) (In logic,) Incidental cause, as the simple conjunction of two different objects. E. असमवायि and कारण cause.
4524: असमवायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Accidental, not inherent and inseparable. E. अ neg. समवाय intimate union, इनि aff.
4525: असमर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Unable, incompetent. 2 Feeble, weak. E. अ neg. समर्थ able.
4526: असमर्पण n. (-णं) Non-delivery, not committing or intrusting any thing to another. E. अ neg. समर्पण delivering.
4527: असमर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unconsigned, unintrusted, undelivered. E. अ neg. समर्पित delivered.
4528: असमस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Separate, several, uncollected, uncompounded. 2 Incomplete, imperfect. E. अ neg. समस्त assembled.
4529: असमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Different. 2 Unlike. 3 Unequal. E. अ neg. समान same.
4530: असमापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unfinished, unaccomplished. E. अ neg. समापित completed, simple.
4531: असमाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Unfinished, incomplete. E. अ neg. समाप्त finished.
4532: असमाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Incompleteness. E. अ neg. समाप्ति completion.
4533: असमावर्त्तक m. (-कः) A religious student, whose studies are not completed. E. अ neg. समावर्त्तक who compleats his course.
4534: असमाहार m. (-रः) 1 Non-recovery of any thing. 2 Disjunction, disconnection. E. अ neg. सम् and आङ् before हृ to take, affix घञ्.
4535: असमाहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Irrecoverable. 2 Not to be combined or united. E. अ neg. सम and आङ् before हृ to take, ण्यत् aff.
4536: असमीक्ष्य ind. Not having considered. E. अ neg. समीक्ष्य having seen.
4537: असमीक्ष्यकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Acting inconsiderately. E. अस मीक्ष्य and कारिन् who acts.
4538: असमीचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Improper, incorrect. E. अ neg. समीचीन proper, right.
4539: असमृद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Unfortunate. f. (-द्धिः) Non-increase. E. अ neg. समृद्धि increase.
4540: असम्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Ill luck, non-increase. 2 Non-accomplishment, failure. E. अ neg. सम्पत्ति prosperity.
4541: असम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Uneffected, unaccomplished. E. अ neg. सम्पन्न effected.
4542: असम्पर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं) Destitute of connexion or relation. E. अ neg. सम्पर्क connexion.
4543: असम्पर्कीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unconnected with, not belonging to. E. अ neg. सम्पर्कीय related to.
4544: असम्पूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Incomplete, not entire. E. अ neg. सम्पूर्ण complete.
4545: असम्बद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Unconnected, unmeaning, incoherent, (discourse, &c.) 2 Improper, wrong. E. अ neg. सम् with, and बध to bind, affix of the part. past.
4546: असम्बन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Unconnected, not relating or belonging to. E. अ neg. सम्बन्ध connexion.
4547: असम्बाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Open, accessible. f. (-धा) A species of the Śarkarī metre. E. अ neg. सम्बाध contracted.
4548: असम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Improbable, unlikely, inconsistent. 2 Non-existent. nf. (-वं-वा) 1 Any extraordinary event. 2 Nonexistence. E. अ neg. सम्भव production.
4549: असम्भावना f. (-ना) Difficulty or impossibility of conceiving or comprehending. E. अ neg. सम्भावना conception.
4550: असम्भावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Inconceivable, incomprehensible. E. अ neg. सम्भावनीय conceivable.
4551: असम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-त) Unproduced. E. अ neg. सम्भूत born.
4552: असम्भोग m. (-गः) Non-enjoyment, not using or enjoying. E. अ neg. सम्भोग enjoyment.
4553: असम्भ्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Cool, composed. m. (-मः) Calmness, steadiness. E. अ neg. सम्भ्रम flurry.
4554: असम्मत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dissentient, differing from. 2 Averse, contrary. E. अ neg. सं with, मत minded.
4555: असम्मति f. (-तिः) 1 Dissent, difference of opinion. 2 Dislike, aversion. E. अ neg. सम् with, मति mind.
4556: असम्मान n. (-नं) Disrespect, disgrace. E. अ neg. सम् with, मान respect.
4557: असम्मूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Clear-seeing, judging well, cool, calm. E. अ neg. सम्मूढ beguiled.
4558: असम्मोह m. (-हः) Steadiness, calmness, composure. E. अ neg. सम्मोह fascination.
4559: असम्यक्कारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Inexpert, incompetent. 2 Ill conducted, profligate. E. अ neg. सम्यक् properly, कारिन् who does any thing.
4560: असम्यञ्च् mfn. (-म्यङ्-मीची-म्यक्) 1 Improper, incorrect. 2 Imperfect, incomplete. E. अ neg. सम्यञ्च् right.
4561: असरु m. (-रुः) The name of a medicinal plant, vulg. Kukūrsoṅga, (Conyza lacera.) E. अस to reject or be rejected, अरु affix; thrown away from its bad smell.
4562: असल n. (-लं) 1 Iron. 2 Arms. 3 A mantra. E. अस to be, लच् aff.
4563: असवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Of a different caste. 2 Of a different colour. E. अ neg. सवर्ण of one caste, &c.
4564: असह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Impatient, intolerant, not enduring. E. अ neg. सह who bears.
4565: असहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unable to endure. m. (-नः) An enemy. n. (-नं) Intolerance, impatience. E. अ neg. सह to bear ल्युट् aff.
4566: असहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unbearable, insufferable. E. अ neg. सहनीय to be borne; also असहित्तव्य and असह्य.
4567: असहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Impatient, not bearing, not enduring. E. अ neg. सहमान bearing.
4568: असहाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Lonely, solitary, friendless. E. अ neg. सहाय an associate.
4569: असहायता f. (-ता) 1 Loneliness, solitude, the life of a hermit. 2 Friendlessness, being without a friend or patron. E. असहाय and तल् affix; also असहायत्वं.
4570: असहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unassociated, unaccompanied. E. अ neg. सहित accompanied.
4571: असहिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Impatient, unenduring. E. अ and सहिष्णु bearing.
4572: असह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Intolerable, unbearable. E. अ neg. सह्य to be borne.
4573: असाक्षात् ind. 1 Invisible, imperceptible. 2 Not present. E. अ neg. साक्षात् before one's eyes.
4574: असाक्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unattested, unwitnessed. E. अ neg. साक्षिन् a witness, ठक् aff.
4575: असाक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Incompetent as evidence. E. अ neg. साक्षिन् a witness.
4576: असाक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Want of evidence, sufficient evidence. E. अ neg. साक्ष्य testimony.
4577: असात्म्य mfn. (-त्म्यः-त्म्या-त्म्यं) Unwholesome, disagreeing with, (as food, &c.) E. अ neg. सात्म्य suitable.
4578: असाधन mfn. (-तः-ना-नं) Without means. n. (-नं) 1 Non-accomplishment. 2 Not proving or establishing. E. अ neg. and साधन implement or means.
4579: असाधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Unaccomplishable, not to be effected or completed. E. अ neg. साधनीय to be effected; also असाध्य.
4580: असाधारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Special, specific, not common. n. (-णं) 1 Speciality, species. 2 Special property. E. अ neg. साधारण common.
4581: असाधित mfn. (-तः) Unaccomplished. E. अ neg. साधित accomplished.
4582: असाधु mfn. (-धुः-धुः-ध्वी-धु) Wicked, bad. f. (-ध्वी) An unchaste wife. E. अ neg. साधु virtuous.
4583: असाधुता f. (-ता) Wickedness. E. असाधु and तल् affix; or with त्व, असाधुत्वं.
4584: असाधुवृत्ता f. (-त्ता) An unchaste woman. E. असाधु impurity, and वृत्त professed or practised.
4585: असाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Not to be effected, not proper or able to be accomplished. 2 Incurable, irremediable. 3 Not susceptible of proof. E. अ neg. साध्य to be done.
4586: असान्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रं) Fine, delicate but with interstices. E. अ priv. and सान्द्र coarse.
4587: असामयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unseasonable. E. अ neg. ससय time, ठञ् aff.
4588: असामान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Peculiar, not common. n. (-न्यं) Peculiar or special property. E. अ neg. सामान्य common.
4589: असाम्प्रतम् ind. Unfitly, improperly, inopportunely. E. अ priv. and साम्प्रतं fitly, &c.
4590: असाम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 Difference, dissimilarity. 2 Unsuitableness, (in medicine or diet,) unwholesomeness. 3 Disagreeableness. E. अ neg. साम्य sameness.
4591: असार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Sapless, pithless. 2 Vain, unprofitable. 3 Weak, feeble. n. (-रं) The castor oil tree. E. अ priv. and सार juice, sap, &c.
4592: असावधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Careless, inadvertent. E. अ neg. सावधान careful.
4593: असावधानता f. (-ता) Carelessness. E. तल् added to the last, or with त्व, असावधानत्वं.
4594: असाहस n. (-सं) Gentleness, absence of violence. E. अ neg. साहस violence.
4595: असाहसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Gentle, peaceable, not violent. E. अ neg. साहसिक violent.
4596: असाहाय्य n. (-य्यं) Want of assistance or co-operation. E. अ neg. साहाय्य alliance, friendship.
4597: असि m. (-सिः) A sword, a scymitar. E. अस to cast, and इन् Uṇādi aff.
4598: असिक n. (-कं) The part of the face between the under lip and the chin. E. अस to throw, to shine, &c. and इकन् aff.
4599: असिक्निका f. (-का) A woman servant: see असिक्नी.
4600: असिक्नी f. (-क्नी) 1 A girl attending upon the inner or women's apartments. 2 A river. E. अ neg. and सित white, because her hair is not whitened by age: क्न is substituted for त, and the affix is ङीप्.
4602: असित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Black or dark blue. m. (-तः) 1 Black, (the colour.) 2 A name of the planet Saturn. 3 The dark fortnight of a lunar month. f. (-ता) 1 The indigo plant. E. अ neg. and सित white.
4603: असिताभ्रशेखर m. (-रः) A Jaina or Buddha saint. E. असित black, अभ्र a cloud, and शेखर a crest: cloud-crested.
4604: असिताम्बुरुह n. (-हं) The blue lotus. E. असित black or dark blue, and अम्बुरुह a lotus.
4605: असितार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) A name of VAHNI or fire. E. असित dark, smoky, अर्च्चिस् a ray of light.
4606: असिताश्मन् n. (-श्म) 1 The lapis lazuli. 2 Any black or dark blue stone. E. असित black, and अश्मन् a stone.
4607: असितोत्पल n. (-लं) The blue lotus. E. असित and उत्पल lotus.
4608: असितोपल n. (-लं) The lapis lazuli. E. असित blue, उपल stone.
4609: असिदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A marine monster, the Makara, considered as the emblem of KĀMADEVA. E. असि and दंष्ट्र a tooth: swordtoothed.
4610: असिदंष्ट्रक m. (-कः) See the preceding. E. as before कन् added.
4611: असिदन्त m. (-न्तः) A crocodile: see मकर.
4612: असिधारा f. (-रा) The edge of a sword. E. असि and धारा edge.
4613: असिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Unripe. 2 Imperfect, incomplete. 3 Unaccomplished, uneffected. 4 Unproven. E. अ neg. and सिद्ध perfect.
4614: असिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Failure, imperfect or incomplete accomplishment. 2 (In logic,) Want of proof, conclusion not warranted by the premises. E. अ neg. सिद्धि completion.
4615: असिधाव m. (-वः) An armourer, a furbisher, a sword or tool cleaner. E. असि and धाव who polishes; धाव to clean, अच् aff.
4616: असिधावक m. (-कः) See the preceding. E. कन् added to the above.
4617: असिधेनु f. (-नुः) A knife. E. असि and धेनु a bow; the sword-like bow.
4618: असिधेनुका f. (-का) See the preceding. E. as before.
4619: असिपत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 The sugar cane. 2 A hell paved with swords. n. (-त्रं) 1 A sheathe, a scabbard. 2 The blade of a sword. E. असि and पत्र a leaf; sharp as a sword, or enclosing it.
4620: असिपत्रक m. (-कः) The sugar cane. E. as the preceding.
4621: असिपत्रवन n. (-नं) A hell where the trees have leaves as sharp as swords. E. असि and पत्र a leaf, वन a wood.
4622: असिपुच्छक m. (-कः) The gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus gangeticus, Rox.) E. असि, पुच्छ a tail, and कन् affix; sword tailed.
4623: असिपुत्रिका f. (-का) Aknife. E. असि and पुत्रिका a daughter, an infant sword; from its smallness.
4624: असिपुत्री f. (-त्री) A knife. E. see the preceding.
4625: असिमेद m. (-दः) A fetid Mimosa: see विट्खदिर. E. असि and मेद marrow, essence; the plant being described with many thorns, and a decoction of it being demulcent.
4626: असिहेति m. (-तिः) A swordsman or soldier armed with a sword. E. असि and हेति a weapon.
4627: असु m. pl. always, (असवः) The five vital breaths or airs of the body. n. (-सु) 1 Reflexion, thought, or the heart as the seat of it. 2 Affliction. E. अस to be, &c. and उ Uṇādi aff.
4628: असुकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult, arduous. E. अ neg. सुकर easy.
4630: असुख n. (-खं) Sorrow, pain, affliction, &c. E. अ neg. and सुख pleasure.
4631: असुखावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Producing unhappiness. E. असुख and आवह what bears.
4632: असुखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Unhappy, sorrowful, afflicted. E. असुख and इनि aff.
4633: असुखोदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Causing or ending in unhappiness. E. असुख and उदय rising.
4634: असुखोदर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं) Productive of or ending in unhappiness. E. असुख and उदर्क subsequent.
4635: असुगम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult of attainment or accomplishment, hard, unattainable. 2 Difficult to be understood. E. अ neg. सु easily, गम going.
4636: असुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Childless. E. अ neg. सुत a son, &c.
4637: असुधारण n. (-णं) Life, existence. E. असु vital air, and धारण possession.
4638: असुनिरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Disagreeable, unpleasant, offensive. E. अ neg. सुनिरस agreeable.
4639: असुन्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Plain, ugly. 2 Improper, unbecoming. E. अ neg. सुन्दर handsome.
4640: असुभृत् mfn. (-मृत्) Living, alive. E. असु and भृत् possessing.
4641: असुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Living, breathing. m. (-मान्) Life, the principle of vitality, the portion of spirit connected with the attributes of existence. E. असु vital air, and मतुप् posses. aff.
4642: असुर mf. (-रः-रा) An Asura or demon: the Asuras are children of DITI by KAŚYAPA; they are demons of the first order, and in perpetual hostility with the gods. m. (-रः) The sun. f. (-रा) 1 Night. 2 A zodiacal sign. 3 A prostitute. f. (-री) 1 Black mustard, (Sinapis ramosa.) 2 The wife of an Asura. E. अ neg. and सुर a deity; or अस् to send, to cast, &c. and उरन् Uṇādi affix, टाप् and ङीप् for the fem.; or अ neg. and सुरा spirituous liquor, personified as a damsel produced at the churning of the ocean, who was rejected by the demons and received by the gods.
4643: असुरक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Perishable, volatile, transitory. E. अ neg. सु easy, रक्षा preservation.
4644: असुरक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Difficult of retention or preservation. E. अ neg. सु easily, रक्ष्य to be kept.
4645: असुररिपु m. (-पुः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. असुर and रिपु an enemy, the foe of the Asuras.
4646: असुरसा f. (-सा) A sort of basil, (Ocymum pilosum.)
4647: असुराह्व n. (-ह्वं) Bell metal. E. असुर and आह्वा a name: named after an Asura; struck at seasons of worship, and deterring his approach.
4649: असुलभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Difficult of attainment. E. अ neg. सुस्तभ easily got.
4650: असुसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Dearly beloved. m. (-मः) 1 A husband. 2 A lover. E. असु life, सम equal to.
4651: असुस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Unwell, uncomfortable. E. अ neg. सुस्थ well.
4652: असुहृद् m. (-हृत्) An enemy. E. अ neg. सुहृत् a friend.
4653: असूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Calumnious, scandalous, detracting, depreciating. E. असूञ् to calumniate, वुन् aff.
4654: असूक्षण n. (-णं) Disrespect. E. अ implying modification, सूर्क्ष to disrespect, affix ल्युट्, the र is rejected; it is also written असुक्षण and असूर्क्षण.
4655: असूक्ष्म mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं) Large, thick, gross. E. अ neg. सूक्ष्म fine.
4656: असूति f. (-तिः) 1 Non-production, obstruction, removal. 2 Barrenness. E. अ neg. सूति bringing forth.
4657: असूयन n. (-नं) Calumny, detraction. E. असूय to detract from, ल्युट् aff.
4658: असूया f. (-या) Calumny, detraction. f. (-या) The wife of the sage ATRI. E. असूञ् to detract from, a nominal root, and यक् aff.
4659: असूयु m. (-युः) Calumny. E. असूय to calumniate, उ aff.
4660: असूर्क्षण n. (-णं) Disrespect. E. See असूक्षण; it is also written असुर्क्षण.
4661: असूर्य्यम्पश्या f. (-श्या) The wife of a king or a great man. E. अ neg. सूर्य्य the sun, and पश्या who sees; who never sees the sun; being shut up in the Zenana.
4662: असृक्कर m. (-रः) The juice or essence of the body, lymph, serum, &c. E. असृज् blood, and कर what makes.
4663: असृक्प mf. (-क्पः-क्पा) A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin of malicious propensities. E. असृज् blood, and प who drinks: these demons eat flesh, human or animal.
4664: असृक्पात m. (-तः) Drops of blood, as from a wound. E. असृज् and पात falling.
4665: असृक्श्राव m. (-वः) Bleeding, letting blood. E. असृज् and आब causing to flow.
4666: असृक्श्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Bleeding, who or what takes away blood. E. असृज् and श्राविन् what causes to flow.
4667: असृग्दरा f. (-रा) Irregular or excessive menstruation, menorrhagia. E. अतृज्, दृ to tear, affix अप्.
4668: असृग्धरा f. (-रा) The skin. E. असृज् and धरा what contains: blood-containing; also असृग्धारा.
4669: असृग्धारा f. (-रा) 1 The skin. 2 A stream of blood. E. असृज् and धारा a stream.
4670: असृग्वहा f. (-हा) A blood vessel. E. असृज् and वह what bears.
4671: असृग्विमोक्षण n. (-णं) Bleeding. E. असृज् and विमाक्षण letting.
4672: असृज् n. (-सृक्) Blood. E. अ neg. सृज् to create, क्विप् aff.
4673: असृपाट mf. (-टः-टी) A stream of blood. E. अ neg. सृप to go, काटः aff.
4674: असृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Uncreated. 2 Undistributed, not presented. E. अ neg. सृष्ट created, &c.
4675: असेचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Charming, lovely. E. अ neg. सेचव satisfaction.
4676: असेवन n. (-नं) 1 Disregarding, neglecting. 2 Avoiding, shunning. 3 Disobedience, inattention. E. अ neg. सेवन service.
4677: असेवा f. (-वा) 1 Avoiding, not following or practising. 2 Disregard. 3 Disobedience. E. अ neg. सेवा service: see the last.
4678: असेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Neglected, unattended to, disobeyed. 2 Abstained from, disused. E. अ neg. सेवित served, used.
4679: असेव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Not to be served or attended to. 2 Not to be used or practised, not to be eaten, drank, &c. E. अ neg. सेव्य to be followed.
4680: असौन्दर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Ugliness. E. अ neg. सौन्दर्य्य beauty.
4681: असौम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Ugly, unlovely. 2 Disagreeable, displeasing. E. अ neg. सौम्य pleasing.
4682: असौम्यस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having a bad or croaking voice. E. असौम्य disagreeable, and स्वर a note or sound.
4683: असौष्टव n. (-वं) 1 Ugliness, deformity. 2 Demerit, worthlessness. E. अ neg. सौष्टव beauty, &c.
4684: अस्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Permanent, durable. E. अ neg. स्कद to flow, affix क्त.
4685: अस्खलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Firm, permanent, unshaken, unyielding. 2 Not slipping or fallen. 3 Undeviating. E. अ neg. स्खलित slipped.
4686: अस्त Sautra root. 10th cl. (अस्तयति) To obscure or eclipse.
4687: अस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Thrown, cast. 2 Sent, dispatched. 3 Set, obscured. 4 Removed, set aside. m. (-स्तः) 1 The western mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to set. 2 Sun-set. n. (-स्तं) Death, end. E. अस्त to obscure or eclipse, अच् affix, or अस to throw, &c. and क्त aff.
4688: अस्तक m. (-कः) Beatitude, eternal felicity. E. अस्तम् disappearance, and कन् aff.
4689: अस्तगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set, as the sun. E. अस्त and गत gone.
4690: अस्तगिरि m. (-रिः) The western mountain. E. अस्त and गिरि a mountain.
4691: अस्तब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Unconfounded. E. अ neg. स्तब्ध astounded.
4692: अस्तब्धत्व n. (-त्वं) Self-possession, not being confused or confounded. E. त्व added to the last.
4693: अस्तम् ind. Disappearance, setting, vanishing. E. अस to send or cast, तम् aff.
4694: अस्तमती f. (-ती) A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum:) see सालपर्णी. E. अस्तम् the mountain, and अत to go, अच् and ङीप् affixes; abounding in the west.
4695: अस्तमयन n. (-नं) Disappearance, setting. E. अस्तम्, अयन going.
4696: अस्तमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set, (as the sun.) E. अस्तम् and इत gone.
4697: अस्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Obstructed, hindered, opposed. 2 Set. E. अस्त thrown, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.
4698: अस्तव्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Confused, disordered, irrelevant. E. अस्त and व्यस्त scattered.
4699: अस्तसङ्ख्य mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्यं) Innumerable. E. अस्त gone, सङ्ख्या number.
4700: अस्ताघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Very deep: see अस्थाघ.
4701: अस्ताचल m. (-लः) The western mountain. E. अस्त, and अचल a mountain.
4702: अस्ताद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The western mountain. E. अस्त, and अद्रि a mountain.
4703: अस्तावलम्बन n. (-नं) The resting of a heavenly body on the western part of the horizon. E. अस्त and अवलम्बन depending.
4704: अस्तावलम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) Setting as the sun, on the point of setting. E. अस्त and अवलम्बिन् impending.
4705: अस्ति ind. Now being, existent, present. E. अस to be, and क्तिन affix, or the third person sing present tense, it is, used as a particle.
4706: अस्तिनास्ति ind. 1 Doubtful. 2 Partly true and partly not. E. अस्ति and नास्ति it is not.
4707: अस्तिनास्तित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Uncertain or doubtful existence. 2 Partial existence. E. त्व added to the last; also अस्ति नास्तिता.
4708: अस्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Wealthy, opulent. E. अस्ति what is, and मतुप् poss. aff.
4709: अस्तु ind. Be it so, let it be, implying assent, also reluctance and pain. E. अस to be, तुम् affix or the third person sing. imperative used as a particle.
4710: अस्तुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not praised. E. अ neg. स्तुत praised.
4711: अस्तेन n. (-नं) Honesty. E. अ neg. स्तेन theft.
4712: अस्तेय n. (-यं) Honesty. E. अ neg. स्तेय theft.
4713: अस्त्यान n. (-नं) Reproach, blame. E. अ deteriorative, and स्त्ये to sound, ल्युट् aff.
4714: अस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 A weapon in general. 2 A sword. 3 A bow. 4 A missile weapon. E. अस to throw, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
4715: अस्त्रकण्ठक m. (-कः) An arrow. E. अस्त्र and कण्ठक a thorn, a thorn-like weapon.
4716: अस्त्रकारक m. (-कः) An armourer. E. अस्त्र and कारक who makes: so अस्त्रकारः and अस्त्रकारिन् m. (-री.)
4717: अस्त्रचिकित्सक m. (-कः) A surgeon, E. अस्त्र and च्चिकित्सक healing; who uses instruments as means of cure.
4718: अस्त्रचिकित्सा f. (-त्सा) Surgery. E. अस्त्र a knife, a lancet, and चिकित्सा healing.
4719: अस्त्रजीव m. (-वः) A soldier, a warrior. E. अस्त्र a weapon, and जीव who lives by.
4720: अस्त्रधारिन् m. (-री) A soldier. E. अस्त्र and धारिन् who bears; so अस्त्रधारक m. (-कः)
4721: अस्त्रनिवारण n. (-णं) Guarding off a blow. E. अस्त्र and निवारण guarding.
4722: अस्त्रमार्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) An armourer, a sword or tool cleaner. E. अस्त्र and मार्ज्ज who cleans, from मृज and अण् affix; also अस्त्रमार्ज्जक m. (-कः)
4723: अस्त्रयुद्ध m. (-द्धः) Fighting with weapons. E. अस्त्र and युद्ध battle.
4724: अस्त्रविद्या f. (-द्या) The military science. E. अस्त्र and विद्या knowledge.
4725: अस्त्रवेद n. (-दं) The science of arms and war. E. अस्त्र a weapon, and वेद a Veda or scripture.
4726: अस्त्रसायक m. (-कः) An iron arrow. E. अस्त्र, षो to destroy, वुन affix; what destroys all other weapons.
4727: अस्त्रहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unarmed, defenceless. E. अस्त्र and हीन deprived of.
4728: अस्त्रागार m. (-रः) An arsenal, an armoury. E. अस्त्र and आगार house.
4729: अस्त्राघात m. (-तः) A wound, a cut. E. अस्त्र and आघात a blow.
4730: अस्त्राहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, wounded, killed. E. अस्त्र and आहत struck.
4731: अस्त्रीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having no female. E. अ neg. स्त्री female, कन् added.
4732: अस्थाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Very deep. E. अ neg. स्था to stand, with क्विप् affix, and ग from गम to go; where there is no proceeding to an end; it is also written अस्ताग, अस्थाघ, अस्थान and अस्थार.
4733: अस्थाघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) See the preceding. E. as before, with घ, from हन to kill or hurt, and अप् aff.
4734: अस्थान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) See अस्थाग. n. (-नं) A place where there is no firm footing. adv. Unsuitably, unseasonably. E. अ neg. end, स्थान stopping.
4735: अस्थाने ind. Unseasonably, inopportunely. E. अ neg. स्थाने in place.
4736: अस्थाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) See अस्थाग; also अस्थाव and अस्थास.
4737: अस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Perishable, transient. E. अ neg. and स्थायिन् staying.
4738: अस्थार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) See अस्थाग. E. अस्था as above, and र from रा to obtain.
4739: अस्थावर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Moveable, moving, not fixed. 2 (In law) Personal, (as property) money, cattle, &c. opposed to land. E. अ neg. स्थावर stable.
4740: अस्थि n. (-स्थि) A bone. E. अस to throw, &c. and क्थिन् aff.
4741: अस्थिक n. (-कं) A bone. E. कन added to the last.
4742: अस्थिकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Marrow. E. अस्थि a bone, and कृत् what makes.
4743: अस्थिज m. (-जः) Marrow. E. अस्थि and ज what is produced.
4744: अस्थिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Marrow. E. अस्थि and ज्ञ what knows.
4745: अस्थिति f. (-तिः) Want of place or condition, want of firm continuance. E. अ neg. स्थिति staying.
4746: अस्थितुण्ड mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डा) A bird. E. अस्थि and तुण्ड a mouth; whose mouth or beak is of bone.
4747: अस्थितोद m. (-दः) Pain in the bones. E. अस्थि and तोद torturing.
4748: अस्थित्वच् f. (-त्वक्) The periosteum. E. अस्थि and त्वच् skin.
4749: अस्थिधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A name of ŚIVA. E. अस्थि, धनु a bow, and अच् aff.
4750: अस्थिपञ्जर m. (-रः) A skeleton. E. अस्थि and पञ्जर a cage.
4751: अस्थिभक्ष m. (-क्षः) A dog. E. अस्थि and भक्ष who eats.
4752: अस्थिभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Fracture. 2 A plant of supposed efficacy in fractures, (Cissus quadrangularis.) E. अस्थि and भङ्ग a breaking.
4753: अस्थिभुज् m. (-भुक्) A dog. E. अस्थि a bone, भुज् who eats.
4754: अस्थिभेद m. (-दः) 1 Fracturing, breaking or wounding a bone. 2 A sort of bone, a bone. E. अस्थि and भेद breaking, &c.
4755: अस्थिभेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A bone-breaker, who or what breaks bones. E. अस्थि and भेदक what breaks.
4756: अस्थिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having bones, vertebrated, &c. E. अस्थि and मतुप् poss. aff.
4757: अस्थिमाला f. (-ला) A necklace of bones. E. अस्थि and माला a garland.
4758: अस्थिमालिन् m. (-ली) A name of ŚIVA. E. अस्थि a bone, माला a garland, इनि affix; ŚIVA is commonly represented with a necklace of skulls.
4759: अस्थिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Trembling, shaken, unsteady. 2 Uncertain, unascertained. 3 Unworthy of confidence. E. अ neg. and स्थिर firm.
4760: अस्थिरता f. (-ता) Unsteadiness, fickleness, mutability. E. अस्थिर and तल aff.
4761: अस्थिरत्व n. (-त्वं) Unsteadiness, mutability. E. अस्थिर and त्व aff.
4762: अस्थिवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Bony, osseous. E. अस्थि and वतुप् aff.
4763: अस्थिविग्रह m. (-हः) A name of BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S attendants. E. अस्थि and विग्रह a part, &c. who carries ŚIVA'S decorations.
4764: अस्थिशोष m. (-षः) Dryness and decay of the bones. E. अस्थि and शोष drying up.
4765: अस्थिसंहार m. (-रः) A plant, a species of turnsole, (Heliotropium indicum): see हस्तिशुण्डी. E. अस्थि and सं before हृ to take, to collect, seize, &c. (it is an ingredient in philtres, &c.) अण aff.
4766: अस्थिसंहारक m. (-कः) The adjutant bird. E. अस्थि and संहारक who seizes.
4767: अस्थिसञ्चय m. (-यः) Collecting the bones or their ashes after burning a corpse. E. अस्थि and सञ्चय assemblage; also अस्थिसञ्चायनं.
4768: अस्थिसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) 1 A joint, an articulation. 2 Uniting of a broken bone. E. अस्थि and सन्धि connection.
4769: अस्थिसमर्पण n. (-णं) Throwing the bones of a dead body into the Ganges. E. अस्थि and समर्पण consigning.
4770: अस्थिसार m. (-रः) Marrow. E. अस्थि bone, and सार essence.
4771: अस्थिस्थूण m. (-णः) The body, or that of which the bones are the supporters. E. अस्थि and स्थूण a post.
4772: अस्थूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Small, delicate. E. अ neg. स्थूल gross.
4773: अस्थैर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Instability, unsteadiness. E. अ neg. स्थैर्य्य steadiness.
4774: अस्निग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Harsh, hard, dry. 2 Harsh, unkind. E. अ and स्निग्ध unctuous.
4775: अस्नेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Harsh, unkind. 2 Harsh, hard, dry. m. (-हः) 1 Unkindness, want of affection. 2 Absence of oiliness. E. अ neg. स्नेह affection, &c.
4776: अस्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) What does not touch or is not touched. m. (-र्शः) Not touching, non-contact. E. अ neg. स्पर्श contact.
4777: अस्पर्शन n. (-नं) Non-contact, avoiding the contact of any thing or person, especially of one who is impure. E. अ neg. स्पर्शन touching.
4778: अस्पर्शनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Impure, not to be touched. E. अ neg. स्पर्शनीय to be touched.
4779: अस्पर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Untouched. E. अ neg. स्पर्शित touched.
4780: अस्पष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Indistinct. E. अ neg. and स्पष्ट clear.
4781: अस्पृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Not to be touched. E. अ neg. स्पृश्य tangible.
4782: अस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Untouched. E. अ neg. स्पृष्ट touched.
4783: अस्पृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Not touching, avoiding contact. अ neg. स्पृष्टि touching.
4784: अस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Undesirous, content, indifferent. E. अ neg. स्पृहा desire.
4785: अस्पृहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undesirable. E. अ neg. स्पृहनीय desirable.
4786: अस्फुट n. (-टं) Indistinct speech. mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Indistinct, obscure. 2 Invisible. 3 Unblown. E. अ neg. and स्फुट open, clear.
4787: अस्फुटफल n. (-लं) 1 Indistinct result. 2 (In Geometry,) Gross area of a triangle, &c. E. अस्फुट and फल fruit.
4788: अस्फुटवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Lisping, speaking indistinctly. E. अस्फट and वाच् who speaks.
4789: अस्मद् First person pronoun, (अहं) I. (आवां) We two. (वयं) We. E. अस to be, and मदिक् Uṇādi affix: the inflexions of this pronoun are very irregular.
4790: अस्मदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Our, ours. E. अस्मद् I, and छ affix in the sense of the second case plur.
4791: अस्मन्त n. (-न्तं) A furnace or fire-place: see अश्मन्त.
4792: अस्मरण n. (-णं) Forgetfulness, forgetting. E. अ neg. स्मरण remembering.
4793: अस्मरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not to be recollected. E. अ neg. स्मरणीय to be remembered.
4794: अस्मार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ती-र्त्तं) 1 Immemorial, not within memory. 2 Illegal, not according to law. 3 Not belonging to the Hindu institutes. E. अ neg. स्मार्त्त relating to law, &c. from स्मृति with अण् aff.
4795: अस्मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Forgotten. E. अ neg. स्मृत remembered.
4796: अस्मृति f. (-तिः) 1 Want of memory, forgetfulness. 2 Not being part of the institutes. E. अ neg. स्मृति memory or code of law.
4797: अस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Not one's own. E. अ neg. स्व own.
4798: अस्वक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Not one's own, belonging to another. E. अ neg. स्वक own.
4799: अस्वकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Not one's own, belonging to another. E. अ neg. स्वकीय own.
4800: अस्वच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) Opake, not clear. E. अ neg. स्वच्छ clear.
4801: अस्वच्छन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) 2 Docile. 2 Dependant. E. अ priv. स्व own, and च्छन्द intention; not self-willed.
4802: अस्वजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Of a different caste. 2 Of a different species. E. अ neg. स्व own, जाति caste.
4803: अस्वतन्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं) 1 Docile, humble. 2 Dependant, subject. E. अ neg. स्वतन्त्र self-willed.
4804: अस्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Want of claim or right to any thing, having no indefeasible property in it, absence of ownership. E. अ neg. स्व own, with त्व affix: also with तल, अस्वत्ता.
4805: अस्वन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Ending ill, leading to or having an unfavourable close. 2 Approaching the end of life. m. (-न्तः) A fire-place: see अश्वन्त. E. अ neg. and सु good, or असु breath, and अन्त end.
4806: अस्वप्न m. (-प्नः) A deity. E. अ neg. and स्वप्न sleep; who never sleeps.
4807: अस्वभाव m. (-वः) Unnatural or unusual character or temperament. mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Of a different nature. E. अ neg. स्वभाव nature.
4808: अस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having a bad or croaking voice. E. अ neg. and स्वर a note or the voice.
4809: अस्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Essentially different or unlike. E. अ neg. स्वरूप of one nature.
4810: अस्वर्ग्य mfn. (-र्म्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) Not leading to heaven. E. अ neg. स्वर्ग्यं paradisiacal.
4811: अस्वस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Unwell, indisposed. 2 Unfortunate, badly off. E. अ neg. स्वस्थ being well or happy.
4812: अस्वादु mfn. (-दुः-दुः-दु) Tasteless, insipid. E. अ neg. स्वादु sapid.
4813: अस्वाध्याय m. (-यः) 1 A Brahman who has not made his studies, who has not read the Vedas previous to his investiture. 2 Interruption or interval of study, prohibited on certain days of the moon, at eclipses, &c. E. अ neg. स्व own, and अध्याय a lecture.
4814: अस्वामिक m. (-कः-की-कं) Unowned, unclaimed. E. अ neg. स्वामिन् a master, ठक् aff.
4815: अस्वामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Having no right or title to anything, not being master of it. 2 That which has no master or owner. E. अ neg. स्वामिन् a master.
4816: अस्वामिविक्रय m. (-यः) Sale without ownership. E. अ neg. स्वामिन् a master, &c. विक्रय sale.
4817: अस्वाम्य n. (-भ्यं) Absence of right or title to property. E. अ neg. स्वाम्य ownership.
4818: अस्वार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Not for one's self. 2 Not for a proper object. 3 Having a different meaning. E. अ neg. स्व own, अर्थ end or sense.
4819: अस्वास्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) Indisposition, discomfort, indigence. E. अ neg. स्वास्थ्य well-being.
4820: अस्वीकार m. (-रः) Dissent, non-acquiescence. E. neg. स्वीकार promise.
4821: अस्वीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dissented from, refused, not promised. E. अ neg. स्वीकृत promised.
4822: अस्वेद m. (-दः) Suppressed perspiration. E. अ neg. स्वेद sweat.
4823: अस्र m. (-स्रः) 1 A corner, an angle. 2 Hair. n. (-स्रं) 1 Blood. 3 A tear. E. अस to cast or throw, &c. affix रक्.
4824: अस्रकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) An arrow. E. अस्र and कण्ठ throat.
4825: अस्रज n. (-जं) Flesh. E. अस्र blood, and ज produced.
4826: अस्रजित् m. (-जित्) A plant, commonly Kabātabentu.
4827: अस्रप mf. (-पः-पा) A Rākṣasa or goblin. f. (-पा) A leech. E. अस्र blood, and प who drinks.
4828: अस्रपित्त n. (-त्तं) Plethora, haemorrhage, epistaxis, involuntary discharge of blood from the mouth, nostrils, anus, &c. E. अस्र and पित्त bile: both humors being supposed to be affected.
4829: अस्रमातृका f. (-का) Chyle, chyme. E. अस्र blood, मातृ the parent, कन् affix of similitude.
4833: अस्रु n. (-स्रु) A tear. E. अस to cast or reject, and रु aff.
4834: अस्रुव n. (-वं) A granulation, (of flesh.) E. अ neg. स्रु to distil, अप् aff.
