5508: आपराह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Occurring in the afternoon, &c. E. अपराह्न and ठञ् aff.
5509: आपव m. (-वः) A name of VASIṢṬHA.
5510: आपस् n. (-पः) 1 Water. 2 Sin. E. आप to obtain, असुन् aff.
5511: आपस्कार n. (-रं) The root or extremity of the trunk or body. E. अपस्कर filth, अण् aff.
5512: आपस्तम्व m. (-म्वः) The name of a sage and legislator.
5513: आपाक m. (-कः) 1 A potter's kiln. 2 A baking oven. E. आङ्, पच् to bake, घञ् aff.
5514: आपाण्डुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Slightly pale, palish. E. आङ् dimin. पाण्डुर pale.
5515: आपात m. (-तः) 1 Throwing down, causing to descend. 2 Falling, descending. 3 The instant, the current moment. E. आङ् पत to go, to fall, घञ् aff.
5516: आपाततस् ind. Immediately, instantly. E. तसि added to the last.
5517: आपान m. (-तः) A tavern, a liquor shop, a place for drinking in society. E. आङ्, पा to drink, ल्युट् aff.
5518: आपालि m. (-लिः) A louse. E. आङ्, पल to go, इन् affix; the penultimate irregularly long.
5519: आपी f. (-पी) The twentieth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
5520: आपीड m. (-डः) 1 Squeezing, compressing. 2 Giving pain, hurting. 3 A chaplet tied on the crown of the head. E. आङ् before पीड to pain, अच् aff.
5521: आपीडन n. (-नं) 1 Squeezing, compressing, tying or drawing tightly. 2 Embracing, clasping. 3 Giving pain, hurting. E. आङ् before पीड to pain, affix ल्युट्.
5522: आपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Squeezed, compressed. 3 Bound tightly. 3 Embraced. 4 Hurt. E. आङ् before पीडित pressed.
5523: आपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drank up. 2 Very yellow. n. (-तं) A pyritic mineral. E. आङ् before पीत drank or yellow.
5524: आपीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Stout, fat. m. (-नः) A well. n. (-नं) An udder. E. आङ् and पीन fat, large.
5525: आपूपिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A baker. 2 A confectioner. 3 One who eats cakes, one for whom they are good, &c. n. (-कं) A multitude of cakes. E. अपप a cake, ठक् or ठञ् aff.
5526: आपूप्य m. (-प्यः) Flour, meal. E. अपूप a cake, यञ् aff.
5527: आपूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Filling. 2 Satisfaction, fulness. E. आङ् before पूर्त्ति fulness.
5529: आपृच्छा f. (-च्छा) Conversation, speaking to or with. E. आङ्, प्रच्छ to ask, अङ् and टाप् affs.
5530: आप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Trusted, confidential. 2 Gained, obtained. 3 True. 4 Apt, fit. 5 A friend. 6 Appointed. 7 Authentic. 8 Accused, prosecuted. f. (-प्ता) A twisted band or lock of hair. n. (-प्तं) 1 Quotient. 2 Equation of a degree. E. आप to obtain, क्त aff.
5531: आप्तकारिन् m. (-री) A trusty agent, a confidential servant. E. आप्त trusted, and कारिन् who acts.
5532: आप्तगर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Proud, arrogant. E. आप्त and गर्ब्ब pride.
5533: आप्तगर्भा f. (-र्भा) A pregnant woman. E. आप्त and गर्भ embryo.
5534: आप्तवचन n. (-नं) A received text, an authority. E. आप्त and वचन text.
5535: आप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Gain, acquisition. 2 Binding, joining. 3 Connexion, relation. 4 Fitness, aptitude. E. आप to obtain, क्तिन् aff.
5536: आप्तोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 An augment or affix, (in grammar.) 2 A word of received acceptation, and established by usage only. E. आप्त received, उक्ति speech.
5538: आप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 Watery, consisting of water, as froth, &c. 2 Obtainable, to be obtained. n. (-प्यं) A plant, a kind of costus. E. अप water, यञ् affix; or आप to get, यत् aff.
5539: आप्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Stout, robust. 2 Fat. E. आङ् before स्फाय to grow, क्त aff.
5540: आप्यायन n. (-नं) 1 Pleasing, satisfying. 2 Satiety, satisfaction. 3 Advancing. 4 Corpulency, growing or being fat or stout. E. आङ् before स्फाय to increase, ल्युट् aff.
5541: आप्यायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased. 2 Satisfied. 3 Increased, improved. 4 Stout, fat. E. आङ् before स्फाय to increase, क्त aff.
5542: आप्रच्छन n. (-नं) Civility upon receiving or parting with a visitor, welcome, adieu, &c. E. आङ्, प्रच्छ to ask, ल्युट् aff.
5543: आप्रपद n. (-दं) A dress reaching to the feet. E. आङ् and प्र before पद a foot.
5544: आप्रपदीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) A dress reaching from the shoulders to the feet. E. आङ् and प्र prefixed to पद a foot, ख aff.
5545: आप्रपदीनक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. कन् added.
5546: आप्लव m. (-वः) 1 Bathing. 2 Sprinkling with water. E. आङ्, प्लु to swim, अप् aff.
5547: आप्लवन n. (-नं) 1 Sprinkling with water. 2 Bathing. आङ् before प्लु to swim, affix ल्युट्.
5548: आप्लवव्रतिन् m. (-ती) An initiated householder, one who has passed through the first order, that of the Brahmacārī, and is admitted into the second. E. आङ् before प्लव bathing, व्रतिन् performer of a व्रत, or religious obligation; bathing being part of the prescribed ceremony.
5549: आप्लाव m. (-वः) 1 Bathing. 2 Sprinkling, wetting. 3 A submerging. 4 A flood, an inundation. E. आङ्, प्लुङ् to swim, घञ् aff.
5550: आप्लावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inundated, overflowed. E. आङ् before प्लु to bathe, causal form, affix क्त.
5551: आप्लाव्य ind. Having wetted or sprinkled. E. आङ् before प्लु to swim, ध्यण् aff.
5552: आप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bathed. 2 Wetted, sprinkled. m. (-तः) An initiated householder: see आप्लवव्रतिन्. n. (-तं) Bathing. E. आङ्, प्लुङ् to bathe, affix of the participle past.
5553: आप्लुतव्रतिन् m. (-ती) See आप्लवव्रतिन्. E. आप्लत bathed, &c. as before.
5554: आप्लुत्य ind. Having bathed. E. आङ् before प्लु to bathe, ल्यप् aff.
5555: आप्वन् m. (-प्वा) Air, wind. E. आप to obtain, वुन् Uṇādi aff.
5556: आबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Tied, bound. m. (-द्धः) 1 A binding. 2 A yoke. 3 Ornament. 4 Affection. E. आङ् before बन्ध to bind, affix क्त.
5557: आबन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Bound or tied firmly. m. (-न्धः) 1 The tie of a yoke, that which fastens the ox to the yoke, or the latter to the plough. 2 Affection. 3 Ornament, decoration. 4 A tie or bond. E. आङ्, बन्ध a binding.
5558: आबाधा f. (-धा) Segment of the base of a triangle.
5559: आबुत्त m. (-त्तः) A sister's husband, (in theatrical language.) E. आप to obtain, क्विप्, उत् and तन् to stretch, ड affix, प is changed to ब; according to another etymology the word is आवुत्त.
5560: आबोधन n. (-नं) 1 Knowledge, understanding. 2 Instructing, informing. E. आङ्, बुध to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
5561: आभरण n. (-णं) 1 Ornament, decoration, as jewels, &c. 2 Nourishing. E. आङ्, भृञ् to fill or nourish, ल्युट् aff.
5562: आभा f. (-भा) 1 Light. 2 Splendour. 3 Beauty. E. आङ् before भा to shine, अङ् and टाप् affs.
5563: आभाति f. (-तिः) 1 Shade. 2 Light. E. आङ् before भा to shine, affix क्तिन्.
5564: आभाष m. (-षः) Introduction, preface. E. आङ् before भाष to speak, affix अच्.
5565: आभाषण n. (-णं) Addressing, speaking to. E. आङ्, भाष to speak, ल्युट् aff.
5566: आभास m. (-सः) 1 Light. 2 Reflexion. 3 Intention, purpose. 4 (In logic) Fallacy, semblance of a reason, an argument that is erroneous though plausible: it is classed as of various kinds. E. आङ् before भास shining.
5567: आभास्वर m. (-रः) A demigod, of a class consisting of sixty-four. E. आङ्, भास to shine, वरच् aff.
5568: आभिजन n. (-नं) Loftiness of birth. E. अभिजन family, अण् aff.
5569: आभिजात्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Birth, family, rank. 2 Learning. E. अभिजाति family, &c. यञ् aff.
5570: आभिधा f. (-धा) Sound. E. अभिधा a compound root, to name, अङ् and टाप् affixes, and आङ् prefix.
5571: आभिधातक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. as before, क्त and कन् aff.
5572: आभिधानीयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to a name or word. n. (-कं) The property of a name, &c. E. अभिधानीय and वुञ् aff.
5573: आभिमुख्य n. (-ख्यं) Presence, being in front of or face to face. E. अभिमुख and ष्यञ aff.
5574: आभिहारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Taken by force or fraud. E. अभिहार seizure, ठञ् aff.
5575: आभीक्ष्ण adj. mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) or adv. n. (-क्ष्णं) 1 Much, exceeding. 3 Eternal, eternally. E. अभीक्ष्न frequent, and अण् aff.
5576: आभीर m. (-रः) A cowherd, sprung from a Brahman and female of the medical tribe or the Ambaṣṭha. f. (-री) A cowherd's wife, or a woman of that tribe. E. आङ्, अभि and ईर to send, affix अच् and fem. ङीष्, or without the first prefix अभीर.
5577: आभीरपल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) a station of herdsmen, a village inhabited by them only, an abode of cowherds, &c. E. आभीर a cowherd, and पल्लि a house, a village, &c. also with the final long पल्ली.
5578: आभीरपल्ली f. (-ल्ली) See the preceding. E. as above.
5579: आभील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Formidable, fearful. 2 Suffering pain. n. (-लं) Bodily pain. E. अभि before इल to sleep, क affix; अ is made long.
5580: आभेरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs or modes of music, femininely personified. E. आङ्, भेरी a drum.
5581: आभोग m. (-गः) 1 Completion, fulness. 2 Enjoyment. 3 Effort, pains. 4 The expanded hood of the Cobra capella, used by VARUṆA as his umbrella. E. आङ्, भुज to eat, घञ् aff.
5582: आभ्यासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Resulting from practice, practising, repeating. E. अभ्यास and ठक् aff.
5583: आभ्युदयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to prosperity, &c. 2 High, exalted. 3 Important. n. (-क) A Śrāddha or offering to ancestors on occasions of rejoicing. E. अभ्युदय elevation. prosperity, ठक् aff.
5584: आम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Raw, undressed, unripe. 2 Unbaked, unannealed. m. (-मः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Constipation, passing hard and unhealthy excretions. 3 Grain freed from the chaff. E. अम to be sick, घञ् aff.
5585: आमकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A water jar of unbaked clay. E. आम and कुम्भ a jar.
5586: आमगन्धि n. (-न्धि) A bad and cadaverous smell, like that of raw meat or a burning corpse. E. आम raw, &c. and गन्धि smell.
5587: आमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The castor oil plant. E. आङ् dim. मडि to adorn, अच् aff.
5588: आमनस्य n. (-स्यं) Pain. E. अ priv. मनस् the mind, यत् affix and the first vowel made long.
5589: आमन्त्रण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Calling or calling to. 2 Courtesy, welcome, adieu, &c. 3 Inviting, invitation. 4 Interrogation. 5 The vocative case. E. आङ्, मत्रि to consult, affix युच्.
5590: आमन्त्रयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Asking, inviting, calling. m. (-ता) An inviter, an entertainer, especially of Brahmans. E. आङ् before मन्त्रि to counsel, causal form, तृच् aff.
5591: आमन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Invited, summoned, called. E. आङ्, मत्रि to consult, क्त aff.
5592: आमपीनस n. (-सं) Running at the nose, defluxion. E. आम and पीनस pituitary excretion.
5593: आममांस m. (-सः) Raw flesh. E. आम and मांस flesh.
5594: आममांसाशिन् m. (-शी) A cannibal. E. आममांस and आशिन् who eats.
5595: आमय m. (-यः) Sickness, disease. n. (-यं) A grass, (Costus.) E. अम to be sick, घञ् affix; आम, and य, from या to obtain.
5596: आमयाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Sick, diseased. 2 Affected with indigestion, dyspeptic. E. आमय, अव to go, and णिनि aff.
5597: आमयावित्व n. (-त्वं) Dyspepsia, indigestion. E. आमयाविन् and त्व aff.
5598: आमरक्त m. (-क्तः) Dysentery. E. आम and रक्त blood.
5599: आमरणान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Lasting for life, continuing till death. E. आङ् before मरण dying, and अन्त end, ठक् aff.
5600: आमरस m. (-सः) Imperfect chyme. E. आम and रस juice.
5601: आमर्श m. (-र्शः) Advice, counsel. E. आङ् before मृश to advise, affix घ्यञ्.
5602: आमर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Wrath or rage. 2 Impatience. E. अ before मृष to bear, affix घञ्, the prefix made long: also अमर्ष.
5603: आमर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Rubbing, wiping. 2 Anger. E. आङ् before मृष to rub, &c. युच् aff.
5604: आमलक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) m. (-कः) Another plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.) n. (-कं) The fruit of the myrobalan. E. आङ् and मल to hold, वुन् affix, fem. ङीष् having all medicinal virtues.
5605: आमवात m. (-तः) Constipation or torpor of the bowels, with flatulence and intumescence. E. आम and वात wind, the wind being supposed to be chiefly affected.
5606: आमशूल m. (-लः) The cholic, pain arising from indigestion.
5607: आमातिसार m. (-रः) Dysentery, the excretion being mixed with hard and foetid matter. E. आम and अतिसार dysentery.
5608: आमात्य m. (-त्यः) 1 A minister, a counseller, an adviser. 2 A general. E. see अमाव्य.
5609: आमाद् mfn. (-मात्) Eating raw food. E. आम, अद to eat, ञिट् aff.
5610: आमानस्य n. (-स्यं) Pain. E. see आमनस्य, the antepen. being made long.
5611: आमान्न n. (-न्नं) Undressed rice. E. आम and अन्न boiled rice.
5612: आमालक mn. (-कः-कं) Land near a mountain.
5613: आमावास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Occurring on the day of conjunction, &c. E. अमावास्य and अञ् aff.
5614: आमाशय m. (-यः) The stomach. E. आम hardness of the faeces, &c. and आशय a station.
5615: आमिक्षा f. (-क्षा) Curd of two milk whey. E. आङ्, मिष to sprinkle, सक् affix; also आमीक्षा.
5616: आमिक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Made of curds, &c. E. आमिक्षा and यत् affix; also with छ, आमिक्षीय.
5617: आमिष mn. (-षः-षं) 1 Flesh. 2 Enjoyment. 3 An object of enjoyment, a pleasing or beautiful object, &c. 4 A bribe. 5 Coveting, longing for. 6 Form. 7 Lust, desire. 8 Food. E. अम to be sick, to go, ष्टिसच् Uṇādi affix and the antepen. lengthened.
5618: आमिषप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Carnivorous, fond of flesh meat. m. (-यः) A heron. E. आमिष flesh, and प्रिय fond of.
5619: आमिषभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Carnivorous. E. आमिष and भुज् what eats.
5620: आमिषाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Carnivorous, eating flesh and fish. E. आमिष flesh, अश to eat, and णिनि aff.
5621: आमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Loosed, let go. 2 Discharged, cast, shot. 3 Put on as clothes or armour. 4 Dressed, accoutred. E. आङ्, मुच् to release, unbind, &c. क्त aff.
5622: आमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Liberation, being let loose. 2 Final liberation. ind. (-क्ति) To the end of existence. E. आङ् and मुक्ति liberation.
5623: आमुख n. (-खं) 1 Prelude, prologue. 2 Commencement. ind. To the face. E. आङ् before मुख face or beginning.
5624: आमुप m. (-पः) A thorny kind of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa, Rox.)
5625: आमुष्यायण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Of an illustrious family, well born, well descended. E. अमुष्य the genitive of अदस् this, and कक् aff.
5626: आमूल adv. n. (-लं) To the root, by the root, entirely, radically. E. आङ् particle, and मूल root.
5627: आमृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Wiped, rubbed. E. आङ् before मृज to wipe, क्त aff.
5628: आमोचन n. (-नं) 1 Loosing, liberating. 2 Emitting, shedding, letting forth or out. E. आङ् before मुच to liberate, ल्युट् aff.
5629: आमोद m. (-दः) 1 A fragrancy, a diffusive perfume. 2 Strong smell. 3 Pleasure. E. आङ्, मुद to be pleased, घञ् aff.
5630: आमोदन n. (-नं) Delighting, rejoicing. E. आङ् before मुद to please, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
5631: आमोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased, delighted. 2 Fragrant. E. आङ् before मुद with क्त aff.
5632: आमोदिन् mfn. (-दी-दनी-दि) 1 Fragrant. 2 Happy, delighted. m. (-दी) A perfume for the mouth, made up in the form of a pill or bolus of camphor, &c. E. आमोद and णिनि aff.
5633: आमोषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) A thief, who or what steals. E. आङ् before मुष to steal, घिनुण् aff.
5634: आम्नाय m. (-यः) 1 A Veda, or the Vedas in the aggregate. 2 Received doctrine, traditional and right. 3 Traditional usuage, family or national customs. 4 Advice, instruction in past and present usage. 5 A Tantra. 6 An element of being. a property of substance. E. आङ्, म्ना to learn, to remember, घञ् and युक् affs.
5635: आम्नायसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Pious, observing the Vedas and national customs. E. आम्नाय and सारिन् who goes.
5636: आम्बिकेय m. (-यः) 1 A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. 2 Also of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. अम्बिका the mother of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA or a name of DURGĀ, and ढक् aff.
5637: आम्भसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Aquatic. m. (-कः) A fish. E. अम्भस् water, ठक् aff.
5638: आम्र m. (-म्रः) The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) E. अम to be sick, रक् Uṇādi affix, and अ made आ.
5639: आम्रपेशी f. (-शी) A piece of dried mango. E. आम्र and पेशी a piece of flesh, &c.
5640: आम्रमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of mangoes, (sauce, &c.) E. आम्र and मयट् aff.
5641: आम्रात m. (-तः) The hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.) E. आम्र the mango, and अत to go, the affix अच्; the fruit resembling the mango: also आम्रातक.
5642: आम्रातक m. (-कः) See the preceding. E. as before, कब् added.
5643: आम्रावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Inspissated mango juice. E. आम्र and आवर्त्त stirring.
5644: आम्रेडन n. (-नं) Tautology, reiteration of words or sounds. E. आङ् before म्रेड to be mad, ल्युट् aff.
5645: आम्रेडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reiterated, repeated. n. (-तं) Repetition of a sound or word. E. आङ्, म्रेडृ to be mad, क्त aff.
5646: आम्ल mfn. (-म्लः-म्ली-म्लं) The tamarind tree. n. (-म्लं) Sourness, acidity. E. अम्ल sour, with आङ् prefixed, or अम्ल sour and अण् aff.
5647: आम्लवेतस m. (-सः) A plant, (Rumex vesicatorius.) E. आम्ल sourness, and वेतस a cane.
5648: आम्लिका f. (-का) 1 The tamarind tree. 2 Sourness in the mouth, acidity of the stomach: see अम्लिका. E. आम्ल sour, and कन् aff.
5649: आम्लीका f. (-का) The tamarind tree. E. अम्ल and ठक् affix, the pen. made long: otherwise अम्लिका, as before.
5650: आय m. (-यः) 1 Income, revenue. 2 Gain, profit. 3 The guard of the women's apartments. E. आङ् before या to obtain, ड aff.
5651: आयःशूलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Active, diligent, indefatigable. E. अयस् iron, शूल a sharp weapon, affix ठञ्.
5652: आयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Coming, approaching. E. आङ् before इण to go, शतृ aff.
5653: आयत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Long. 2 Diffuse, prolix. m. (-तः) An oblong figure, (in geometry.) E. आङ् before यम to cease, affix क्त.
5654: आयतच्छदा f. (-दा) The plantain tree, (Musa sapientum.) E. आयत long, and छद a leaf, long-leaved.
5655: आयतस्तू m. (-स्तूः) A panegyrist. E. आयत diffuse, ष्टू to praise, and क्विप् aff.
5656: आयतार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) (In geometry,) half an oblong. E. आयत and अर्द्ध half.
5657: आयतन n. (-नं) 1 Abode, house. 2 An altar, also a shed for sacrifices. 3 A ground plot, the site of a house, &c. 4 The cause of disease. E. आयत nominal root, to lengthen, affix ल्युट्; extending from the house.
5658: आयताक्षी f. (-क्षी) A woman with large eyes or long eyelids. E. आयत and अक्षि the eye, fem. affix ङीप्.
5659: आयतायति f. (-तिः) Long continuance, remote futurity. E. आयत and आयति future time.
5660: आयति f. (-तिः) 1 Future time. 2 Majesty, dignity. 3 Restraint of mind. 4 Length. 5 Meeting, junction. 6 Obtaining. E. आङ्, यम to cease, affix क्तिन्.
5661: आयतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Long, extended. 2 Stately, dignified. 3 Self-restrained. E. आयति and मतुप् aff.
5662: आयतेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Long-eyed, having large eyes. E. आयत and ईक्षण sight.
5663: आयत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Docile, tractable, dependant. E. आङ्, यम to restrain, and क्त aff.
5664: आयत्तता f. (-ता) 1 Docility, tractableness, humility. E. आयत्त and तल् affix of the abstract; also with त्व, आयत्तत्वं.
5665: आयत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 A day. 2 Affection. 3 Subjection, subjecting. 4 A boundary, a limit. 5 Power, strength. 6 Continuance in the right way, steadiness of conduct. 7 Sleeping. 8 Length. 9 Majesty, dignity. 10 Future time. E. आङ्, यति to endeavour, and क्तिन् aff.
5666: आयथातथ्य n. (-थ्यं) Unfitness, unsuitableness, incompatibility. E. अयथातथ and घ्यञ् aff.
5667: आयम्य ind. Having restrained or suppressed. E. आङ् before यम to restrain, ल्यप् aff.
5668: आयव्यय m. (-यः) Receipt and disbursement, income and expenditure. E. आय and व्यय expense.
5670: आयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) 1 Of iron, iron. 2 Armed with an iron weapon. 3 Zealous. n. (-सं) 1 Iron. 2 A weapon. f. (-सी) Armour for the body, a breast-plate, a coat of mail. E. अयस् iron, अण् and ङीप् affs.
5671: आयस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Sharpened, whetted. 2 Thrown, cast, sent. 3 Pained, distressed. 4 Vexed, angry. 5 Hurt, killed. 6 Managed or effected with difficulty. 7 Labouring, toiling, making effort or exertion. E. आङ्, यस to endeavour, क्त aff.
5672: आयागभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Obtained by sacrifice. E. आङ् before याग sacrifice, भूत become.
5673: आयाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Urgently requested or desired. E. आङ् before याच to ask, क्त aff.
5674: आयात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come. E. आङ् before यात gone.
5675: आयान n. (-नं) 1 The natural temperament or disposition. 2 Coming, arrival. E. आङ्, या to obtain, affix ल्युट्.
5676: आयाम m. (-मः) 1 Length, either in space or time. 2 Breadth, (in mensuration.) 3 Restraint, restraining. E. आङ् before यम to cease, घञ् aff.
5677: आयामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Long in space or time. 2 One who restrains. E. आयाम and इनि affix or आङ् before यम and घिनुण् aff.
5678: आयास m. (-सः) 1 Fatigue, weariness. 2 Effort, exertion. 3 Trouble, labour. E. आङ् before यस to endeavour, to make exertion, and घञ् aff.
5679: आयासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Making exertion, active, laborious. 2 Exhausted by labour, wearied. E. आङ्, यस to endeavour, घिनुण् aff.
5680: आयुःशेष m. (-षः) End of life, death. E. आयुस् and शेष end.
5681: आयु mn. (-युः-यु) Age, duration of life. E. अय to go, Uṇādi affix डु.
5682: आयुक्त m. (-क्तः) A minister, an agent or deputy. E. आङ्, युज to join, and क्त aff.
5683: आयुध m. (-धः) A weapon in general. E. आङ्, युध to fight, क aff.
5684: आयुधधर्म्मिणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Aeschynomene sesban): see जयन्ती. E. आयुध a weapon, and धर्म्मिणी possessing virtue: having the virtues of a weapon against disease, &c.
5685: आयुधागार n. (-रं) An arsenal, an armoury. E. आयुध and आगार a house.
5686: आयुधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to arms. m. (-कः) A soldier, a warrior. E. आयुध a weapon, and ठक् aff.
5687: आयुधीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to or connected with weapons. m. (-यः) A warrior. E. आयुध and छण् aff.
5688: आयुर्द्रव्य n. (-व्यं) A medicament. E. आयुस् life, and द्रव्य thing.
5689: आयुर्वेद m. (-दः) 1 The science of medicine. 2 The collective writings of authority on medicine, or medical Śāstra. E. आयस् life, and वेद a Veda.
5690: आयुर्वेदमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Acquainted with medical science. E. आयुर्वेद and मयट् aff.
5691: आयुर्वेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Belonging to medicine, of the medical profession, medical, medicinal, &c. m. (-दी) A practiser of physic, a physician or surgeon. E. आयुर्वेद and इनि aff.
5692: आयुष्मत् mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मती-ष्मत्) 1 Alive, living. 2 Long lived. m. (-ष्मान्) One of the twenty-seven Yogas or divisions of the ecliptic. E. आयुस् age, and मतुप् possessive aff.
5693: आयुष्टोम m. (-मः) A sacrifice to obtain longevity. E. आयुस् and ष्टोम a sacrifice.
5694: आयुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Vital, preservative of life, for the sake of life, relating or belonging to it. E. आयुस् and यत् aff.
5695: आयुस् m. (-युः) Age, duration of life. E. इ to go, उसि Uṇādi affix, the pen. lengthened.
5696: आयुस्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Promoting longevity, supporting life. E. आयुस् and कर what makes.
5697: आये ind. An interjection of calling, expressive of affection.
5698: आयोग m. (-गः) 1 Presenting or offering flowers, perfumes, &c. 2 Action, the performance of an act. 3 A shore or bank. E. आङ्, युज to join, घञ् aff.
5699: आयोगव m. (-वः) A man of a mixed tribe sprung from a Śūdra man and Vaiśya woman; his business is carpentry, &c. f. (-वी) A woman of the tribe.
5700: आयोजन n. (-नं) Effort, exertion. 2 Taking, seizing. 3 Collecting. E. आङ् before युज to join, ल्युट् aff.
5701: आयोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Collected together. E. आङ् before युज to join, क्त aff.
5702: आयोधन n. (-नं) 1 War, battle, slaughter. E. आङ्, युध to make war, affix ल्युट्.
5703: आर m. (-रः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 The planet SATURN. n. (-रं) 1 An angle, a corner. 2 End, extremity. 3 Brass. 4 Oxide of iron. f. (-रा) 1 A shoe-maker's awl or knife. 2 A probe. E. ऋ to go, affix घञ्.
5704: आरकूट mn. (-टः-टं) Brass. E. आर what goes, and कूट a heap; composed of various materials.
5705: आरक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Preserved, defended. 2 Proper or worthy to be preserved, &c. m. (-क्षः) 1 Protection, guard, preservation. 2 The junction of the frontal sinuses of an elephant. E. आङ्, रक्ष to preserve, &c. घञ् aff.
5706: आरक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what guards or protects. m. (-कः) 1 A watchman, a patrole. 2 A village or police magistrate. E. आङ् before रक्ष to preserve, वुन् aff.
5707: आरग्वध m. (-धः) A plant, (Cassia fistula.) E. आङ्, रुज् sickness, बध what destroys.
5708: आरट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The name of a country, north-west of India.
5709: आरट्टज m. (-जः) A horse from the Āraṭṭa country. E. आरट्ट and ज born.
5711: आरण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्यी-ण्यं) Forest, wild, forest-born, &c. E. अरण्य a wood, अण् affix of derivation.
5712: आरण्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Forest, wild, forest-born or produced. m. (-कः) A forester, an inhabitant of the woods. E. आरण्य and कन् added.
5713: आरण्यपशु m. (-शुः) A wild or forest animal, as a buffalo, a monkey, &c. E. आरण्य forest, and पशु an animal.
5714: आरण्यराशि m. (-शिः) The sign LEO. E. आरण्य a forest beast, and राशि a sign.
5715: आरति f. (-तिः) 1 Stopping, ceasing. 2 Waving lights before an image. E. आङ्, रम to play, क्तिन् aff.
5716: आरनाल n. (-लं) Sour gruel made from the fermentation of boiled rice. E. आर what goes, from ऋ to go, and नाल smell.
5717: आरनालक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. as before, कन् added.
5718: आरब्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Begun, commenced. E. आङ् before रभि to commence, affix क्त.
5719: आरभट mfn. (-टः-टी) Boldness, confidence. f. (-टी) A branch of the dramatic art, the machinery of the drama, the representation of magical incantations, &c. E. आर quickly, भट to nourish, अच् and ङीप् aff.
5720: आरभमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Beginning, beginning resolutely with a determination to finish. E. आङ् before राभि to commence, शानच् aff.
5721: आरम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A beginning, a thing begun. 2 Haste, speed. 3 Effort, exertion. 4 Pride. 5 Killing, slaughter. 6 An introduction, a prologue, &c. E. आङ, रभि to commence, घञ् aff.
5722: आरभ्य ind. Having begun, beginning from. E. आङ् before रभि to commence, ल्यप् aff.
5723: आरव m. (-वः) Sound. E. आङ्, रु to sound, अप् aff.
5724: आरस्य n. (-स्यं) Insipidity, want of flavour or spirit. E. अरस and यञ् aff.
5725: आराग्र n. (-ग्रं) The edge of a semicircular arrow head. E. आर what goes, and अग्र edge, &c.
5726: आरात् ind. 1 Near. 2 Distant, far from. E. आङ् before रा to get, आत् aff.
5727: आराति m. (-तिः) An enemy. E. आङ् before रा to take or receive, आति aff.
5728: आरातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Remote. E. आरात् and छ aff.
5729: आरात्रिक n. (-कं) Waving lamps at night before an image. E. आङ् before रात्रि night, कन added.
5730: आराधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what worships, a worshipper. E. आङ् before राध and वुन् aff.
5731: आराधन n. (-नं) 1 Accomplishment. 2 Acquirement, attainment. 3 Gratifying, propitiating. 4 Worshipping. 5 Cooking. f. (-ना) Service. (-नी) Worship, adoration, propitiation of the deities. E. आङ्, राध to finish, ल्युट् aff.
5732: आराधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be worshipped or adored. E. आङ् before राध to finish, अनीयर् affix; also with तव्य and य, आराधितव्य and आराध्य.
5733: आराधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Worshipped, honoured, reverenced. 2 Propitiated, pleased. 3 Accomplished, effected. E. आङ् before राध to finish, क्त aff.
5734: आराध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being worshipped, receiving worship, &c. 2 Being in course of fulfilment. E. आङ् before राध and शानच् aff.
5735: आराम m. (-मः) A garden, a grove. E. आङ्, रम to please, घञ् aff.
5736: आरालिक mf. (-कः-की) A cook. E. अराल crooked, ठक् affix; always bending over the dishes, &c.
5737: आराव m. (-वः) Sound. E. आङ्, रु to sound, affix घञ्; also आरव.
5738: आरु m. (-रुः) 1 The name of a tree, (Lagerstroemia regina.) 2 A crab. 3 A hog. 4 A pitcher. E. ऋ to go, उण् affix, the pen. made long.
5739: आरुक n. (-कं) A drug brought from the hills, of cooling properties.
5740: आरुरुक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous to rise or ascend, to advance, &c. E. आङ् before रुह to rise, desiderative form, उ aff.
5741: आरू mfn. (-रूः-रूः-रु) Of a tawny colour. m. (-रूः) Tawny, (the colour.) E. ऋ to go, ऊ aff.
5742: आरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Mounted, ascended, risen. 2 Raised up, elevated on high. E. आङ् before रुह to grow, क्त aff.
5743: आरूढवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Mounting, rising. E. आङ् before रुह to mount, क्तवतु aff.
5744: आरेवत m. (-तः) A plant, (Cassia fistula.) E. आङ् before रेव, आरेव trust, तन् to stretch, ड affix; inspiring confidence during sickness.
5745: आरोग्य n. (-ग्यं) Health. E. आङ् reverse, रुज to be sick, यञ् aff.
5746: आरोढृ mfn. (-ढा-ढ्री-ढृ) Who or what mounts or rides, &c. E. आङ् before रुह to mount, affix तृच्.
5747: आरोप m. (-पः) 1 Placing in or on. 2 Assigning or attributing to. E. आङ् before रुह to mount, causal form, घञ् aff.
5748: आरोपण n. (-णं) 1 Trusting, delivering. 2 Placing or fixing in or on. 3 Elevating. 4 Planting. 5 The bending of a bow. E. आङ् before रुह to ascend, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
5749: आरोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deposited, intrusted. 2 Placed, fixed. 3 Made. 4 Raised, elevated. 5 Consecrated. 6 Accidental, adventitious. E. आङ्, रुह to ascend, causal form, part. past.
5750: आरोह m. (-हः) 1 Length. 2 A woman's waist. 3 Ascent, rising. creeping up. 4 Mounting, riding. 5 The rider of a horse or elephant. 6 Weight. 7 A measure. 8 The buttocks. 9 A mine. E. आङ्, रुह to rise, to mount, affix घञ्.
5751: आरोहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Lifting or raising up. E. आङ् before रुह, affix वुन्.
5752: आरोहण n. (-णं) 1 Rising, ascending. 2 The rising or growing of new shoots. 3 A ladder, a staircase. 4 Riding on. E. आङ्, रुह, to ascend, affix ल्युट्.
5753: आरोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) One who mounts or rides. E. आङ् before रुह to mount, णिनि aff.
5754: आर्कि m. (-र्किः) A son of the sun, as SANI and the rest. E. अर्क the sun, and इञ् aff.
5755: आर्क्ष mfn. (-र्क्षः-र्क्षी-र्क्षं) Stellar, regulated by the stars or constellations. E. ऋक्ष and अण् aff.
5756: आर्क्षवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A stellar year, or revolution of a constellation. E. आर्क्ष and बर्ष a year.
5757: आर्गल mf. (-लः-ली) A bolt or bar: see अर्गल.
5758: आर्ग्वध m. (-धः) A plant, (Cassia fistula.) E. ऋ to go, and बध to destroy or prevent, deriv. irr: see आरग्वध.
5759: आर्घा f. (-र्घा) A sort of yellow bee.
5760: आर्घ्य n. (-र्घ्यं) Wild honey. E. आर्घा and यत् aff.
5761: आर्च्च mfn. (-र्च्चः-र्च्ची-र्च्चं) 1 Devout, worshipping. 2 Relating to the Ṛc or Ṛk Veda. E. अर्च्चा worship, and ण affix or ऋच् and अण्.
5762: आर्च्चिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the Rig Veda, &c. E. ऋच् and ठक् aff.
5763: आर्जव n. (-वं) 1 Straightness. 2 Rectitude, propriety of act or observance. 3 Sincerity. E. ऋञ् straight, अण् aff.
5764: आर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Pained, afflicted. 2 Disturbed, confounded. E. ऋत to hate, to move, participial affix क्त.
5765: आर्त्तगल m. (-लः) A plant, blue Barleria, (Barleria coerulea.) E. आर्त्त pained, गल to eat, अच् aff.
5766: आर्त्तनाद m. (-दः) A cry of pain. E. आर्त्त and नाद sound. So आर्त्तस्वर m. (-रः.)
5767: आर्त्तव mfn. (वः-वा or -वी-वं) 1 Menstrual, relating to or produced by this discharge. 2 Seasonable, produced in season. n. (-वं) 1 The menstrual discharge. 2 A flower. f. (-वी) A mare. E. ऋतु the menses, or a season, अण् aff.
5768: आर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Pain. 2 Sickness. 3 The end of a bow. E. आङ् before ऋत to move, क्तिन् affix; also अर्त्ति.
5769: आर्त्त्विज्य n. (-ज्यं) The office of a sacrificing priest. E. ऋत्विज् a priest, and यञ् aff.
5770: आर्त्त्यपहरण n. (-णं) Consoling or relieving distress, pain, &c. E. आर्त्ति and अपहरण taking away.
5771: आर्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Wise. 2 Rich. 3 Significant. E. अर्थ and ठञ् aff.
5772: आर्द्र mfn. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्रं) 1 Wet, moist, damp. 2 Fresh, not dry. 3 Loose, flaccid. 4 Tender, soft. f. (र्द्रा) The sixth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion. E. अद to go, रक् Uṇādi affix, and the pen. lengthened.
5773: आर्द्रक n. (-कं) Ginger in the undried state. E. आर्द्र moist, and वुन् aff.
5774: आर्द्रकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Green wood, timber not dry. E. आर्द्र and काष्ठ wood.
5775: आर्द्रता f. (-ता) 1 Moisture, wetness. 2 Tenderness, softness. 3 Freshness, greenness. E. आर्द्र and तल् affix; also आद्रत्वं.
5776: आर्द्रनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Weeping, suffused with tears. E. आद्र and नयन the eye.
5777: आर्द्रमाषा f. (-षा) A leguminous shrub, (Glycine debilis.) E. आर्द्र moist, and माष a sort of bean.
5778: आर्द्रशाक n. (-कं) Ginger. E. आर्द्र and शाक a potherb.
5779: आर्द्रालुब्धक m. (-कः) The dragon's tail or descending node. E. आर्द्रा the lunar mansion, and लुब्धक who desires.
5780: आर्द्धद्रौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought with half a Droṇa, containing it, &c. E. अर्द्ध, द्रोण a measure, ठञ् aff.
5781: आर्द्धधातुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a part of a verb, (the inflexions of six tenses.) E. अर्द्ध and धातु a root, ठक् aff.
5782: आर्द्धप्रस्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought, &c. with half a Prastha. E. अर्द्धप्रस्थ a measure, and ठञ् aff.
5783: आर्द्धमासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Lasting, &c. for half a month. 2 Observing or practising (Continence, &c.) for a fortnight. E. आर्द्धमास and ठञ् aff.
5784: आर्द्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Sharing half, an equal partner. 2 Relating to half. m. (-कः) One who ploughs the ground for half the crop. E. अर्द्ध half, ठञ् aff.
5785: आर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Of a good family. 2 Respectable, venerable. 3 Apposite, proper. 4 To be sought or obtained. m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A master, an owner. 2 A name of BUDDHA. 3 A friend. f. (-र्य्यां) 1 A name of PĀRVATĪ. 2 A kind of metre, measured by feet, each foot being equal to four short syllables, or two long and two short; there are seven and a half feet in each verse of the couplet, equal to thirty and to twenty-seven syllabic instants: the regular form consists of alternate long and short verses, but it admits of eighty principal variations. E. ऋ to go, ण्यत् affix; also अर्य्य.
5786: आर्य्यक m. (-कः) 1 A grandfather. 2 Any respectable man. n. (-कं) The vessel, &c. used in sacrifices made to the manes. f. (आर्य्यका or आर्य्यिका) A respectable woman. E. आर्य्य respectable, &c. and वुन् aff.
5787: आर्य्यगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Decorous, respectable, right. E. आय्य and गृह्य to be accepted by.
5788: आर्य्यपुत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A husband, (in theatrical language.) 2 The son of a spiritual preceptor. E. आर्य्य a respectable person and पुत्र a son.
5789: आर्य्यप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding with respectable persons. E. आर्य्य and प्राय quantity.
5790: आर्य्यमिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Distinguished, respectable. m. (-श्रः) A gentleman, a man of consequence. E. आर्य्य and मिश्र mixed, joined.
5791: आर्य्यरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) A hypocrite, an impostor. E. आय्य and रूप semblance.
5792: आर्य्यलिङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) A hypocrite, an impostor; a Śūdra, wearing the dress of a Brahman, &c. E. आर्य्य and लिङ्गिन् who bears insignia.
5793: आर्य्यवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Good, pious, virtuous. E. आय्य and वृत्त practised.
5794: आर्य्यवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Well clothed, fine. E. आर्य्य and वेश vesture.
5795: आर्य्यागीति f. (-तिः) A variety of the Āryā metre, containing eight equal feet or thirty-two syllabic instants in each verse of the couplet. E. आर्य्यां and गीति another metre.
5796: आर्य्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The holy land, the country extending from the eastern to the western sea, and bounded on the north and south, by the Himāla and Vindhya mountains. E. आय्य venerable, आवर्त्त abode.
5797: आर्व्वाक् ind. 1 After, afterwards. 2 Behind. E. अर्व्वाक् and अण् pleonastic aff.
5798: आर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-र्षं) Relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi. m. (-र्षः) A form of marriage, the father of the bride receiving one or two pair of kine from the bridegroom. n. (-र्षं) The Vedas. f. (-र्षा) One of the orders of the metres of the Vedas. E. ऋषि and अण् aff.
5799: आर्षभि m. (-भिः) A name of BHARATA, emperor of India. E. ऋषभ excellent, and इञ् aff.
5800: आर्षभ्य m. (-भ्यः) A steer fit to be let loose. E. ऋषभ an ox, ञ्य aff.
5801: आर्षेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi. 2 Venerable, respectable. E. ऋषि a sage, ढक् affix; also आर्ष and आर्ष्य.
5802: आर्षोढा f. (-ढा) A wife married according to the Ārṣa form. E. आर्ष and ऊढ married.
5803: आर्हत m. (-तः) A Jaina, a follower of the doctrines of a Jina or Arhat. E. अर्हत् a Jina, अण् aff.
5804: आर्हत्य n. (-त्यं-न्ती) The quality or practice of an Arhat or Jain saint. E. अर्हत् ष्यञ् affix fem. ङीष् with the nasal inserted.
5805: आल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Large, extensive. n. (-लं) Yellow orpiment. E. अल to adorn, in the causal form, अच् aff.
5806: आलगर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A species of Cobra. E. see अलगर्द्द.
5807: आलभ्य ind. Having received or obtained. E. आङ् before लभि to gain, ल्यप् aff.
5808: आलम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Slaughter, killing. 2 Embracing. E. आङ्, लभि to kill, affix धञ्.
5809: आलम्भ्य mfn. (म्भ्यः-म्भ्या-म्भ्यं) 1 Fit or proper to be killed. 2 Obtainable, to be obtained. E. आङ् before लभि with ण्यत् aff.
5810: आलम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A receptacle. a prop, an asylum or support. 2 Depending on or from. 3 A perpendicular. E. आङ् before लम्बि to go, affix घञ्.
5811: आलम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Depending on or resting upon, hanging from. 2 The natural and necessary connexion of feeling with the cause by which it is excited. 3 Supporting, sustaining. E. आङ् and लवि to go, ल्युट् aff.
5812: आलम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pendant, suspended, hanging from or on. 2 Supported, upheld. 3 Protected. E. आङ् before लवि to go, affix क्त.
5813: आलम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) 1 Depending on or from, hanging from, &c. 2 Supporting, maintaining. E. आलम्ब support, and इनि aff.
5814: आलय m. (-यः) A house, a dwelling, a receptacle, an asylum. E. आङ्, लीङ् to enfold, धञ् aff.
5815: आलवण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Ugliness. 2 Insipidity. E. अ neg. लवण handsome, affix यञ्.
5816: आलवाल n. (-लं) A basin for water round the root of a tree. E. आङ् before लू to cut or dig, and आलच् aff.
5817: आलस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Idle, slothful, lazy. E. अलस idle, अण् affix: see अलस.
5818: आलस्य mfn. (-स्यः-सी-स्यं) Idle, slothful, apathetic. n. (-स्यं) Idleness, sloth. E. अलस idle, and यञ् aff.
5819: आलात n. (-तं) A firebrand, a coal burning or extinguished. E. अलात and अण् aff.
5820: आलान n. (-नं) 1 The post to which an elephant is tied. 2 The rope that ties him. 3 A fetter, a tie. 4 Tying, binding. 5 A rope or string. E. आङ् before ला to take, आला to tie or fasten, affix ल्युट्.
5821: आलाप m. (-पः) 1 Speaking to, addressing, conversation. 2 Enumeration of the questions in an arithmetical or algebraic sum. E. आङ्, लप to speak, affix घञ्.
5822: आलापन n. (-नं) Speaking to, conversing with. E. आङ् before लप to speak, ल्युट् aff.
5823: आलापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be said or spoken. 2 To be spoken to or addressed. E. आङ् before लप to speak, अनीयर् affix; also आलाप्य.
5824: आलापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Who speaks or converses. E. आङ् before लप to speak, णिनि aff.
5825: आलाबु f. (-बुः) A pumpkin gourd: also आलाबू, अलाबु and अलाबू, q. v.
5826: आलावर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) A fan made of cloth. E. आल orpiment, and आवर्त्त abode: stained or painted with some such substance.
5827: आलास्य m. (-स्यः) A crocodile. E. आल wide, large, and आस्य a mouth.
5828: आलि mfn. sub. (-लिः-लिः) or ली-लि 1 Pure, honest, sincere. 2 Useless, idle, unmeaning. f. (-लिः-ली) 1 A woman's female friend. 2 A row or range, a continuous line. 3 A ridge or mound of earth, crossing ditches, dividing fields, &c. 4 A line, a race or family. m. (-लिः) 1 A scorpion. 2 A bee: see अलि. E. अल to adorn, to be able, &c. affix इण and the pen. made long; also आली, affix ङीप्.
5829: आलिङ्गन n. (-नं) Embracing, an embrace. E. आङ् before लिगि to approach, ल्युट् aff.
5830: आलिङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Embraced. E. आङ् before लिगि to approach, क्त aff.
5831: आलिङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Embracing. m. (-ङ्गी) A small drum shaped like a barley corn, and carried upon the breast. E. आलिङ्ग an embrace, and इनि affix; also आलिङ्गी fem. ङीप् aff.
5832: आलिङ्ग्य mfn. (-ङ्ग्यः-ङ्ग्या-ङ्ग्यं) To be embraced. m. (-ङ्ग्यः) A small drum: see the preceding. E. आलिङ्ग and ण्यत् aff.
5833: आलिञ्जर m. (-रः) A large clay water jar. E. अलिञ्जर a jar. अण् aff.
5834: आलिन् m. (-ली) A scorpion. E. see. आलि, affix इनि.
5835: आलिन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 A terrace before a house. 2 A raised place or terrace for sleeping upon. E. अलिन्द the same, and अण् affix: see अलिन्द, also आलिन्दक.
5836: आलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Smeared, plastered, anointed. E. आङ् before लिप to smear, क्त aff.
5837: आलिम्पन m. (-नः) Whitening or painting the floor, wall, &c. on festival occasions. आङ्, लिपि to plaster, and ल्युट् aff.
5838: आली f. (-ली) 1 A female friend. 2 A row or range. 3 A field, boundary or mound: see आलि.
5839: आलीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Eaten. 2 Licked. n. (-ढं) An attitude in shooting, the right knee advanced, the left leg retracted. E. आङ्, लिह to lick, क्त aff.
5840: आलीढक n. (-कं) The frolicking of a calf. Sometimes written आढीलक.
5841: आलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Melted, fused. E. आङ् before ली to melt, क्त aff.
5842: आलीनक n. (-कं) Tin. E. आलीन and affix वुन्.
5843: आलु f. (-लुः) A pitcher, a small water jar. mn. (-लुः-लु) 1 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum:) in the modern dialects this name is applied to the yam, potatoe, &c. 2 A raft, a float. m. (-लुः) An owl. E. ऋ to go, and उण् affix, आरु what goes, (in the earth, water, &c.) the initial is lengthened, and र is changed to ल.
5844: आलुक m. (-कः) 1 A name of the chief of the Nāgas or serpent race: see शेष. 2 An esculent root: see आलु. E. कन् added to the preceding.
5845: आलून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cut, cut off. E. आङ् before लून cut.
5846: आलेखन n. (-नं) 1 Writing. 2 Painting. f. (-नी) A brush, a pencil. E. आङ् before लिख to write, affix ल्युट्.
5847: आलेख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) 1 To be written. 2 To be delineated or painted. n. (-ख्यं) 1 A painting. 2 A writing. E. आङ् before लिख to write, ण्यत् aff.
5848: आलेख्यशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Dead, deceased. E. आलेख्य painting. writing, and शेष final.
5849: आलेप m. (-पः) 1 Smearing, plastering, anointing. 2 Liniment. E. आङ् before लिपि to anoint, घञ् aff.
5850: आलेपन n. (-नं) 1 Smearing, plastering. 2 Liniment. E. आङ्, before लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.
5851: आलोक m. (-कः) 1 Sight, seeing, looking. 2 Light. 3 Flattery, complimentary language, panegyric. E. आङ् before लोकृ to see, घञ् aff.
5852: आलोकन n. (-नं) Sight, seeing, looking. E. आङ्, लोकृ to see, ल्युट् aff.
5853: आलोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. आङ् before लोक to see, क्त aff.
5854: आलोचक n. (-कं) The faculty of vision or the cause of sight. E. आङ् before लोच and वुञ् aff.
5855: आलोचन nf. (-नं-ना) Sight, seeing. E. आङ् before लोच to see, ल्युट् aff.
5856: आलोचित mf. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, beheld. 2 Considered. E. आङ् before लोच to see, क्त affix.
5857: आलोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be seen thought of or considered; also आलोचनीय. E. आङ्, लोच to see, यत् aff.
5858: आलोडन n. (-नं) 1 Mixing, blending. 2 Strirring, shaking, agitating. E. आङ् and लुड to stir, affix ल्युट्.
5859: आलोडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, blended. 2 Shaken, agitated. E. आङ् before लुड to stir, affix क्त.
5860: आलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Shaken, agitated. m. (-लः) Trembling, agitation. E. आङ् before लुड to shake, affix घञ, ड changed to ल.
5861: आलोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated. E. आङ् before लुल to shake, affix क्त.
5862: आवनेय m. (-यः) The planet MARS. E. अवनी the earth, ढक् patronymic aff.
5863: आवन्त्य m. (-न्त्यः) 1 The offspring of a degraded Brahman. 2 An inhabitant, &c. of Avanti or Ougein. E. अवन्ती and ण्यत् aff.
5864: आवपन n. (-नं) 1 Any vessel. 2 Weaving. 3 Sowing seed. E. आङ् वप to sow, ल्युट् aff.
5865: आवरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A cover, a veil, what covers or conceals. E. आङ् before वृ with वुन् aff.
5866: आवरण n. (-णं) 1 Covering. 2 A covering, a garment. 3 A shield. 4 An outer bar or a fence, a wall. 5 An obstruction. 6 Mental blindness. E. आङ्, वृ to skreen, ल्युट् aff.
5867: आवरणशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The power of illusion, that which veils the real nature of things. E. आवरण and शक्ति power.
5868: आवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Revolving, turning round. 2 A whirlpool. 3 A lock of hair that curls backwards, especially on a horse. 4 Deliberation, revolving. 5 A mineral substance, pyrites, marcasite. E. आङ्, वृत to choose, घञ् aff.
5869: आवर्त्तका f. (-का) 1 A revolution, a whirl. 2 A whirlpool. 3 A curl of hair, especially on a horse. 4 Revolution of the mind from the influence of the senses. 5 The depression above the frontal ridge or over the eyebrows. f. (-की) The name of a creeping plant. E. कन added to the last.
5870: आवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning, turning round. 2 Churning. 3 Stirring any thing in fusion. 4 Melting metals together, alligation. 5 The time when shadows are cast in an opposite direction. 6 Repeating, doing over again. 7 Study, practising. f. (-नी) A crucible. E. आवर्त्त, ल्युट् affix; and ङीप् for the fem.
5871: आवर्त्तनमणि m. (-णिः) A gem of a secondary order, commonly Rājāvartta. E. आवर्त्तन the same, and मणि a jewel.
5872: आवर्त्तनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be whirled or turned round. 2 To be reversed. 3 To be repeated. E. आङ् before वृत to be, अनीयर् aff.
5873: आवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Advancing, proceeding. 2 Revolving, going round. E. आङ् before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
5874: आवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) What whirls or turns upon itself. m. (-र्त्ती) A horse having curls of hair on various parts of his body: it is considered as a lucky mark. f. (-नी) A whirlpool. E. आबर्त्त and इनि aff.
5875: आवर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eradicated, plucked up by the roots. E. आङ्, वर्ह to hurt, affix क्त.
5876: आवलि f. (-लिः) 1 A row, a range, a continuous line. 2 A series, dynasty, a lineage. E. आङ्, वल to move, इन् affix; also आवली, taking ङीप्.
5877: आवल्य n. (-ल्यं) Weakness. E. अवल weak, यञ् aff.
5878: आवश्य n. (-श्यं) Necessity, inevitable act or conclusion. E. अवश्य and अण.
5879: आवश्यक n. (-कं) Necessity, inevitable act or conclusion. E. अवश्य certain, affixes अण् and कन्.
5880: आवश्यकत्व n. (-त्वं) Necessity, inevitability. E. त्व added to आवश्य, also with तल्, आवश्यकता.
5881: आवसथ mn. (-थः-थं) 1 A house. 2 A fire temple or place where sacrificial fire is preserved. m. (-थः) 1 A treatise on the poetical metre called Ārya. (आर्य्याकोषः) see आर्य्या. 2 A particular religious observance. E. आङ् before वस to dwell, अथ Uṇādi aff.
5882: आवसथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Inhabiting a house, household, domestic. E. आवसथ and ष्ठल् aff.
5883: आवसथ्य n. (-थ्यं) A house. E. आवसथ and ञ्य added.
5884: आवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stored, (as grain.) 2 Winnowed. 3 Ripe, full grown. E. आङ् and अब reverse, and षो to destroy, participial affix क्त; also अवसित.
5885: आवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) What bears or conveys. m. (-हः) One of the seven winds. E. आङ् before वह to bear, अच् aff.
5886: आवहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Obtaining, receiving. E. आङ् before वह to hear, affix शतृ.
5887: आवहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Followed, succeeded, come in succession. E. आङ् before वह to hear, शानच् aff.
5888: आवहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rooted up, extirpated. E. आङ् before वह to bear, क्त aff.
5889: आवात् mfn. (-वान्-वान्ती-वात्) Blowing. E. आङ् before वा to blow, affix शतृ.
5890: आवाधा f. (-धा) 1 Pain. 2 Distress. 3 Segment of the base of a triangle. E. आङ् before वाधा the same.
5891: आवाप m. (-पः) 1 A basin for water round the root of tree. 2 A bracelet. 3 Hostile purpose, intention of going to war, (as a king.) 4 Throwing, casting, directing. 5 Sowing seed. 6 Throwing additional ingredients into any compound, (in pharmacy, &c.) in course of preparation. 7 Mixing, inserting. 8 Uneven ground. 9 A vessel. 10 Principal sacrifice with fire. E. आङ्, वप to sow, घञ् aff.
5892: आवापक m. (-कः) A bracelet of gold, &c. E. कन् added the last.
5893: आवापन n. (-नं) 1 A loom, an implement for weaving. 2 A reel or frame for winding thread. E. आङ्, वप to weave, ल्युट् aff.
5894: आवारि m. (-रिः) A shop, a stall. E. आङ् before वृ to nourish, in the causal form, इ aff.
5895: आवार्य्य ind. Covering, hiding, concealing. E. आङ् before वृ to screen, ल्यप् aff.
5896: आवाल n. (-लं) A basin for water round the foot of a tree. E. आङ् before वल to move, घञ् affix; also आलवाल.
5897: आवाल्य n. (-ल्यं) Age or time ending with infancy. E. आङ् unto, बाल्य childhood.
5898: आवास m. (-सः) A house, a dwelling. E. आङ्, वस to dwell, affix घञ्.
5899: आवाहन n. (-नं) 1 Calling. 2 Inviting. 3 Offering oblations with fire. f. (-नी) A particular position of the hands or the palms put together, and the thumbs put at the root of the ring finger. E. आङ् before वक्त to bear, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
5900: आवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Invoked, invited. E. आङ् before वह to bear, causal form, क्त aff.
5901: आविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Woollen, &c. or any thing relating to or derived from a sheep. m. (-कः) A blanket, woollen cloth. E. अवि a sheep, वुञ् aff.
5902: आविकसौत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of woollen thread. E. आविक and सूत्र a thread, ठञ् aff.
5903: आविग्न m. (-ग्नः) A small fruit tree, vulgarly Caronda, (Carissa carondas.) also अविग्न.
5904: आविद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pierced, wounded. 2 Crooked. 3 Cast, thrown, sent. 4 Disappointed. 5 Stupid, foolish. E. आङ् before व्यध to hurt, क्त aff.
5905: आविद्धकर्णी f. (-र्णीं) A plant, (Aknidhi:) also आविद्धकर्णिका f. (-का.)
5906: आविध m. (-धः) An awl, a drill, a kind of gimblet worked by a string. E. आङ्, व्यध to pierce, घञ् or क aff.
5907: आविर्भाव m. (-वः) Manifestation, presence, becoming visible. E. आविस् manifestly, and भाव condition.
5908: आविर्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Appeared, manifest, become visible. E. आविस् and भूत become.
5909: आविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Foul, turbid. E. आङ्, विल to break, and क aff.
5910: आविष्करण n. (-णं) Manifestation, making visible. E. आविस् an करण making.
5911: आविष्कार m. (-रः) Becoming or making visible. E. आविस् and कार making.
5912: आविष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made or become visible, evident, manifest. E. आविस् apparent, and कृत made.
5913: आविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered. 2 Possessed, (by a demon, &c.) 3 Possessed, engrossed, (by any sentiment or feeling.) E. आविश to enter, affix क्त.
5914: आविस् ind. Manifest, evident. E. आङ्, उङ् to sound, इर् aff.
5916: आवीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Passed, gone. 2 Placed, hung. m. (-तः) The sacrificial cord worn in any particular manner. E. आङ् before वीत gone.
5917: आवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman who wears the cord in any particular manner. E. इनि added to the last: see प्राचीनावीतिन्.
5918: आवूक m. (-कः) A father, (in theatrical language.) E. अव to preserve, ऊकन् affix, and the initial lengthened.
5919: आवृत् f. (-वृत्) Order, method. E. आङ् before वृत to choose, affix क्विप्.
5920: आवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Enclosed, surrounded, (by a ditch, wall, &c.) 2 Covered, screened. 3 Invested, inclosed, involved. 4 Spread, overspread, overcast. 5 Filled with, abounding with. m. (-तः) A man of mixed origin, the son of a Brahman, by a woman of the Ugra caste. E. आङ्, वृ to nourish, affix क्त.
5921: आवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Whirled, stirred, turned round. 2 Reverted, averted. 3 Retreated, fled. E. आङ् before वृत to be, क्त aff.
5922: आवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Reversion, turning back or from. 2 Flight, retreat. 3 Revolving, going round. 4 Wordly existence, the revolution of births. 5 Use, employment, application. E. आङ् before वृत, क्तिन् aff.
5923: आवेग m. (-गः) 1 Hurry, haste. 2 Flurry, agitation. f. (-गी) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) E. आङ् before विज to be alarmed, घञ् and ङीप् aff.
5924: आवेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who makes known. m. (-कः) 1 An appellant, a suitor. 2 An informer. E. आङ् before विद to know, causal form, वुन् aff.
5925: आवेदन n. (-नं) Representing, addressing or apprising respectfully. E. आङ् and वेदन informing.
5926: आवेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made known, communicated, represented. E. आङ् before विद to know, causal form, क्त aff.
5927: आवेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be represented or made known. Ind. Having made known. E. आङ् before विद् to know, causal form, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
5928: आवेद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Stating, representing. E. आङ् before विद to know, causal form, शानच् aff.
5929: आवेश m. (-शः) 1 Entrance, entering. 2 Pride, arrogance. 3 Indistinctness of idea, apoplectic or epileptic giddiness. 4 Absorption of the faculties in one wish or idea, devotedness to an object. 5 Demoniac frenzy, possession, &c. E. आङ् before विश to enter, घञ् aff.
5930: आवेशन n. (-नं) 1 Entrance, entering. 2 A house in which work is carried on, a workshop, a manufactory, &c. 3 Possession by devils, &c. 4 Passion, fury. 5 The disk of the sun. E. आङ्, विश to enter, ल्युट् aff.
5931: आवेशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A guest, a visiter. 2 Entering into. 3 Own, peculiar, unparticipated. 4 Inherent. E. आङ्, विश to enter, ठक् aff.
5932: आवेष्टक m. (-कः) A wall, a fence, an enclosure. E. आङ्, वेष्ट to surround, वुन् aff.
5933: आवेष्टन n. (-नं) 1 Wrapping round, binding, tying. 2 A wrapper, an envelope, a bandage. 3 An inclosure. E. आङ् before वेष्ट to surround, ल्युट् aff.
5934: आवेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, enveloped, inclosed, bound or tied. E. आङ् before वेष्ट to inclose, क्त aff.
5935: आशंसन n. (-नं) 1 Expecting, wishing. 2 Declaring, asserting. E. आङ् before शसि to wish, &c. ल्युट् aff.
5936: आशंसा f. (-सा) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Speech, declaration. E. आङ्, शसि to desire, अङ् and टाप् aff.
5937: आशंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, expected. 2 Declared, said. E. आङ् before शसि to desire, क्त aff.
5938: आशंसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Wishing, desiring. 2 Asserting. E. आङ्, शसि to wish, तृच् aff.
5939: आशंसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Wishing, desiring. E. आङ्, शसि to wish, and उ aff.
5940: आशक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Able, powerful. E. आङ् and शक्त able.
5941: आशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Power, ability, might. E. आङ् before शक्ति power.
5942: आशङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be doubted, questionable. 2 To be apprehended. E. आङ् before शकि to doubt, अनीयर् aff.
5943: आशङ्का f. (-ङ्का) 1 Fear, apprehension. 2 Doubt, uncertainty. E. आङ्, शकि to doubt, अच् and टाप् affs.
5944: आशङ्कान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Afraid. 2 Doubting, uncertain. E. आशङ्का and अन्वित having.
5945: आशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Feared, dreaded. 2 Doubted. E. आङ् before शकि to doubt, क्त aff.
5946: आशन m. (-नः) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) see असन and आसन.
5947: आशय m. (-यः) 1 Meaning, intention. 2 Free will or pleasure. 3 A asylum, an abode or retreat. 4 A receptacle, a recipient. 5 Any recipient or containing vessel or viscus of the body, as रक्ताशय the heart, आमाशय the stomach, &c. 6 The stomach in particular. 7 The mind. 8 Property, possessions. 9 A miser, a  niggard. 10 Virtue and vice. 11 Fate, fortune. 12 The Jack, a kind of bread-fruit tree. E. आङ्, शीङ् to rest, अच् aff.
5948: आशयाश m. (-शः) A name of fire: see आश्रयास.
5949: आशयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Feeding, a feeder, one who gives food. 2 Protecting, a protector. 3 Recipient, a receiver. E. अश to eat, causal form, affix शतृ or आङ् before शीङ् to rest, with the same aff.
5950: आशर n. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 An imp, a goblin. E. आङ् before शृ to injure, अप् affix; also आशिर.
5951: आशल m. (-लः) A tree: see जीवक.
5952: आशव n. (-वं) A spirit distilled from molasses: see आसव.
5953: आशा f. (-शा) 1 Hope, desire. 2 Length. 3 A quarter, a region. E. आङ् before अशू to expand, अच् and टाप् affs.
5954: आशाढ m. (-ढः) 1 The month Āśāḍha, (June-July.) 2 A staff of Palāśa wood carried by ascetics. f. (-ढा) The name of two of the lunar mansions: see पूर्व्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा.
5955: आशान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having hope. E. आशा and अन्वित possessed of.
5956: आशाप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Successful, possessing the object hoped for. E. आशा and प्राप्त obtained.
5957: आशाबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Confidence, trust, expectation. 2 A spider's web. E. आशा hope, &c. and बन्ध a binding.
5958: आशाभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Disappointment. E. आशा and भङ्ग breaking.
5959: आशावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hoping, having hope. E. आशा and मतुप् poss. aff.
5960: आशाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Desponding, despairing. E. आशा and हीन destitute of.
5961: आशिञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tinkling, applied to the ornaments worn on the hands and feet. E. आङ् before शिजि to tinkle, क्त aff.
5962: आशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. आङ् before अश to eat, affix क्त; also अशित.
5963: आशितङ्गवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formerly grazed by cattle. E. आशित eaten, गवीन irregular derivative of गो a cow, and खश् affix; also अशितङ्गवीन.
5964: आशितम्भव n. (-वं) Food, victuals. m. (-वः) Satisfaction, satiety. E. आशित and भव produced by, from भू and खश् aff.
5965: आशितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Voracious, gluttonous, eating excessively. E. अश to eat, and तृच् affix, इ inserted.
5966: आशिर m. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 A goblin or imp. E. आङ् before अश to eat, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
5967: आशिस् f. (-शीः) 1 Blessing, benediction, bestowing or wishing a blessing upon others. 2 A serpent's fang. E. आङ् before शास to rule, क्विप् affix, and आ is changed to इ.
5968: आशी f. (-शीः) 1 Wishing or bestowing a blessing. 2 A serpent's fang. 3 A kind of venom, the venom of a snake. E. आङ् before अश to eat, अच् and ङीप् affixes: see the preceding.
5969: आशीर्वचन n. (-नं) A blessing, a benediction. E. आशिस् and वचन speech.
5970: आशीर्वाद m. (-दः) A blessing, a benediction. E. आशिस् and वाद
5971: आशीविष m. (-षः) A snake. E. आशी a fang, and विष poison; in whose fang is venom.
5972: आशु mfn. (-शुः-शुः-शु) Going quickly, fleet, fast. mn. (-शुः-शु) Rice ripening in the rainy season. n. adv. (-शु) Quick, quickly. E. अशू to pervade, उण् aff.
5973: आशुकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Doing any thing quickly, smart, active. 2 (In medicine) Operating speedily. E. आशु and कारिन् what acts.
5974: आशुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going or moving quickly, swift, fleet. m. (-गः) 1 The wind. 2 An arrow. E. आशु quick, and ग who goes.
5975: आशुपत्री f. (-त्री) A tree which yields frankincense, (Boswellia serrata). see शल्लकी.
5976: आशुव्रीहि m. (-हिः) Rice ripening in the rainy season. E. आशु quick, and व्रीहि rice; that is, of rapid growth; also आशु. so आशुधान्य n. (-न्यं) and other compounds.
5977: आशुशुक्षणि m. (-णिः) 1 Fire. 2 Wind, air. E. आशु before शुष to dry in the reiterative form, and अनि Uṇādi aff.
5979: आशौच n. (-चं) Impurity. E. अशुचि impure, अञ् aff.
5980: आश्चर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Astonishing, wonderful. m. (-र्य्यः) Surprise, astonishment. E. आङ् before चर to go, deriv. irregular.
5981: आश्चर्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Wonderfulness. 2 Wonder, astonishment. E. आश्चर्य्य and त्व; or with ता, आश्चर्य्यता.
5982: आश्चोतन n. (-नं) 1 Aspersion, sprinkling. 2 Applying ghee, &c. to the eyelids. E. आङ् before श्चुत to sprinkle, affix ल्युट्.
5983: आश्म mfn. (-श्मः-श्मा-श्मं) Stony, made of stone, &c. E. अश्मन् stone, and अण् affix: with the final rejected.
5984: आश्मन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Made of stone, stony, stone. E. अश्मन् and अञ aff. m. (-नः) A name of ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. E. अश्मन् stone, अण् affix: immoveable as a stone, having no legs.
5985: आश्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of stone, consisting of stone, &c. E. अश्मन् and ठक्.
5986: आश्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dried partially, consolidated, coagulated. E. आङ् dimin. श्यान dry.
5987: आश्रम m. (-मः) 1 A religious order, of which there are four kinds referable to the different periods of life, 1st, that of the student or Brahmacārī; 2d, that of the householder or Gṛhastha; 3d, that of the anchorite or Vānaprastha; and 4th, that of the beggar or Bhikṣu: see ब्रह्मचारी, &c. 2 A college, a school. 3 A hermitage, the abode of retired saints or sages. 4 A wood or thicket. E. आङ् before श्रम to perform religious austerities, affix घञ्.
5988: आश्रमगुरु m. (-रुः) The head of a religious order, a preceptor, a principal. E. आश्रम a convent, and गुरु senior.
5989: आश्रमधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The special duty or duties of each order of life. E. आश्रम and धर्म्म duty.
5990: आश्रमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to one of the four orders, see आश्रम. E. आश्रम as above, and ठक् aff.
5991: आश्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) 1 Belonging to one of the four orders. 3 Belonging to a hermitage, a hermit, an anchorite, &c. E. आश्रम and इनि aff.
5992: आश्रय m. (-यः) Being inclined or addicted to, following, practising. 2 A recipient, the person or thing in which any quality or article is inherent, retained or received. 3 An asylum, a  place of refuge. 4 A patron, a protector. 5 Having recourse to a protector or asylum. 6 A dwelling. 7 Contiguity, vicinity. 8 Source, origin. 9 A plea, an excuse. 10 Appropriate act, one consistent with the character of the agent. E. आङ् before श्री to serve, अच् aff.
5993: आश्रयण n. (-णं) Refuge, asylum, means of protection or security. आङ् before श्रि to serve, ल्युट् aff.
5994: आश्रयणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be had recourse to. 2 To be practised or followed. E. आङ् before श्रि to serve, affix अनीयर्.
5995: आश्रयभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protecting, supporting, one who is the refuge of any other. E. आश्रय and भूत become.
5996: आश्रयाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) A forfeiter of an asylum, one who by misconduct, &c. loses patronage or protection. m. (-शः) A name of fire. E. आश्रय a house, &c. अश to eat, or consume, and अण् affix: similar compounds occur frequently, as आश्रयध्वंसिन्, आश्रयभुज्, &c.
5997: आश्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Compliant, obedient. m. (-वः) 1 A promise, an engagement. 2 Distress, fatigue. 3 Fault, transgression. E. आङ्, श्रु to hear, अच् aff.
5998: आश्रि f. (-श्रिः) The edge of a sword: see अश्रि.
5999: आश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Inhabiting, dwelling in, resorting to as a retreat or asylum. 2 Following, practising, observing. 3 Using, employing, having recourse to. 4 Receiving any thing, as an inherent or integral part. 5 Taking one's station at or on, as at a window or a seat, &c. 6 A dependant. E. आङ् before श्रि to serve, क्त aff.
6000: आश्रित्य ind. 1 Having sought or obtained an asylum. 2 Having recourse to, employing, practising. E. आङ् before श्रि to serve, ल्यप् affix, तुक् augment.
6001: आश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Heard. E. आङ् before श्रु to hear, क्त aff.
6002: आश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Embraced. 2 Embracing, who or what embraces. 3 Connected, interwoven, blended. 4 Attaching to, joining, who or what adheres to. 5 Invested, spread. 6 Connected as a consequence, deduced, concluded. E. आङ् before श्लिष to fold, क्त aff.
6003: आश्लेष m. (-षः) 1 Embracing, an embrace. 2 Site of any act. 3 Intimate connexion. E. आङ्, श्लिष to fold, घञ् aff.
6004: आश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वी-श्वं) Relating to a horse, drawn by horses, equestrian, &c. n. (-श्वं) 1 A number of horses. 2 A chariot drawn by horses. E. अश्व a horse, and अण् aff.
6005: आश्वत्थ m. (-त्थः) The fruit of the holy fig tree. E. अश्वत्थ and अण् aff.
6006: आश्वत्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to or produced by the Aśvattha tree. 2 Flowering of the Aśvattha (the time when.) E. अश्वत्थ and ठक् aff.
6007: आश्वयुज mfn. (-जः-जी-जं) Belonging to or occurring in the same month of Āśvina. m. (-जः) The month Āśvina. (September- October.) f. (-जी) The day of full moon in Āśvina. E. अश्वयुज the first lunar mansion, affix अण् and fem. ङीप्.
6008: आश्वरथ mfn. (-थः-थी-थं) Belonging to a chariot. E. अश्वरथ and अञ् aff.
6009: आश्वलक्षणिक m. (-कः) A farrier, a groom. E. अश्व, लक्षण a mark, ठक् aff.
6010: आश्वलायन m. (-नं) The name of a sage and legislator, &c. E. अश्वलायन and अण् patronymic aff.
6011: आश्वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Breathing, alive. 2 Recovering, reviving. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.
6012: आश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Encouraged, cheered, consoled. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.
6013: आश्वास m. (-सः) 1 Completion, cessation. 2 A chapter or section, the division of a book. 3 A probable story. 4 Breathing. E. आङ्, श्वस to breathe, to live, घञ् aff.
6014: आश्वासक m. (-कः) Clothing. mfn. (-कः-सिका-कं) Consoling, comforting. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, वुन् aff.
6015: आश्वासन n. (-नं) Consoling, encouraging, reviving. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
6016: आश्वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Encouraged, comforted. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, क्त aff.
6017: आश्वास्य ind. Having recovered or revived. E. आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
6018: आश्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Equestrian, cavalier, relating to a horse, drawn by horses, &c. E. अश्व and ठञ् aff.
6019: आश्विन m. (-नः) The month Āśvina, (September-October.) E. अश्विनी the constellation, अण् deriv. affix: when the moon is in Āśvinī.
6020: आश्वीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) A day's journey for a horse. E. अश्व a horse, and खञ् aff.
6021: आश्विनेय m. du. (-यौ) The two twin sons of AŚVINĪ, by SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga; one of them is named NĀSATYA, the other DASRA: or the patronymic may be used in the singular to designate either one of them. E. अश्विनी and ढक् aff.
6022: आश्वीय n. (-यं) A number of horses. E. अश्व a horse, and छ aff.
6023: आषाढ m. (-ढः) 1 The name of a month, (June-July.) 2 A staff of the wood of the Palāśa, carried by an ascetic in the month Āṣāḍha. 3 The Malaya mountain. E. आषाढा the constellation, and अण् affix. f. (-ढी) The day of full moon in the month Āṣāḍha. f. (-ढा) The twenty-first and twenty-second lunar mansion; it is most commonly compounded with पूर्व्व and उत्तरः see पूर्व्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा. E. अ neg. सह to bear, अण् and टाप् aff.
6024: आषाढक m. (-कः) The month Āṣāḍha: see the preceding, also अषाढक.
6025: आषाढभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in the month Āṣāḍha. m. (-वः) The planet MARS. E. आषाढ the month, and भव produced, from भू and अच् aff.
6026: आषाढाभू m. (-भूः) See the preceding. E. आषाढा the sign, and भू produced, from भू to be, affix क्विप्.
6027: आष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) Æther, the sky or atmosphere. E. अस to throw, to send, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
6028: आस r. 2d cl. (आस्ते or आसते) 1 To sit. 2 To be present. 3 To be or exist. With अधि prefixed. 1 To inhabit, to dwell in. 2 To sit over or upon. 3 To mistake or err by taking one thing for another from similarity of appearance. With अभि, to sit or apply to, to study, to learn. With उत्, 1 To leave, to abandon. 2 To shake, agitate, &c. (as wind.) With उप, to worship, to do homage. With निर्, to expel. With प्र and निर्, to reject, to refute, to invalidate.
6029: आस् ind. (आः) An interjection, ah! oh! &c. implying. 1 Recollection. 2 Anger. 3 Menace. 4 Pain. 5 Affliction.
6030: आस m. (-सः) A bow. E. अस to send or throw, affix घञ्.
6031: आसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Zealously following or pursuing, intent or attached strongly to. 2 Trusting to, confiding in. 3 Eternal. adv. n. (-क्तं) Eternally. E. आङ्, षञ्ज to embrace, to move, participial affix क्त.
6032: आसक्तचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Of a fixed mind, intent on, devoted to, absorbed in. E. आसक्त and चित्त mind.
6033: आसक्तचेतस् mfn. (-ता-ताः-तः) Having the mind fixed or intent on any object. E. आसक्त and चेतस् the understanding.
6034: आसक्तमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Having the mind fixed upon any object. E. आसक्त and मनस् the mind.
6035: आसक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Attachment to one object or pursuit, diligence, application. E. आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, क्तिन् aff.
6036: आसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Attachment to any object. 2 Association, connexion. 3 Proximity, contact. adv. n. (-ङ्गं) Eternally. adj. mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Eternal. E. आङ् always, षञ्ज to move, अच् aff.
6037: आसङ्गत्य n. (-त्यं) Detachment, disunion. E. अ neg. सङ्गति union, ष्यञ् aff.
6038: आसङ्गिनी f. (-नी) A whirlwind. E. आसङ्ग eternal, इनि and ङीप् affs.
6039: आसज्जन n. (-नं) Putting on dress, armour, ornaments, &c. E. आङ् before षज्ज to dress, ल्यट् aff.
6040: आसज्ज्य ind. Having put on. E. आङ् before षज्ज to dress, affix ल्यप्.
6041: आसत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Intimate union, meeting, junction. 2 Gain, profit, acquirement. 3 In logic, connexion or relation between two or more proximate terms and the sense they convey. E. आङ्, षद to go, affix क्तिन्.
6042: आसन n. (-नं) 1 A stool, a seat. 2 Maintaining a post against an enemy. 3 The withers of an elephant, the part where the driver sits. 4 Halting, stopping. 5 Sitting in some peculiar posture, as in the custom of devotees, &c. eighty-four kinds are enumerated: see पद्मासन, &c. m. (-नः) A tree, (Pentapheca tomentosa.) also असन f. (-ना-नी) Stay, abiding, sitting. (-नी) 1 A shop, a stall. 2 A small seat, a stool. E. आस to abide, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.
6043: आसन्द m. (-न्दः) A name of VIṢṆU. mfn. (-न्दः-न्दी) A small couch or oblong chair, having the seat made of basket work. E. आस sitting, and द what gives.
6044: आसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Near, proximate. m. (-न्नः) A setting sun. E. आङ्, षद to go, and क्त aff.
6045: आसन्नकाल m. (-लः) Hour of death. E. आसन्न and काल time.
6046: आसव n. (-वं) 1 Rum, spirit distilled from sugar or molasses. 2 Spirituous liquor in general. E. आङ्, षूञ् to be generated, and अप् aff.
6047: आसवद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The palmyra tree. E. आसव spirit, and द्रु a tree; the juice of the palmyra upon fermenting affording a spirituous liquor.
6048: आसादन n. (-नं) 1 Obtaining, attaining. 2 Accomplishing. 3 Going to or toward. E. आङ् before षद to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
6049: आसादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Obtained. 2 Reached, gone to. 3 Spread, extended, overspread. 4 Effected, completed. E. आङ् before षद to go, in the causal form, affix क्त.
6050: आसाद्य ind. 1 Having attained or reached. 2 Having obtained. E. आङ् before षद to go, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
6051: आसाधन n. (-नं) Accomplishment, attainment. E. आङ् before षाध to succeed, ल्युट् aff.
6052: आसार m. (-रः) 1 A hard shower. 2 Surrounding an enemy. 3 The army of an ally, or of a king whose dominions are separated by other intervening states. E. आङ्, सृ to go, घञ् aff.
6053: आसाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be born. E. षु to bear, affix ण्यत्.
6054: आसिक m. (-कः) A swordsman. E. असि a sword, and ठक् aff.
6055: आसिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who sits. E. आस to sit, ण्वुल् aff.
6056: आसिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Sprinkled. E. आङ् before विच to sprinkle, क्त aff.
6057: आसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sat down. 2 Who sits or is seated. n. (-तं) 1 Place of abode, a city. 2 A seat. E. आस to sit, क्त aff.
6058: आसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Accomplished, effected. 2 Put under restraint: see आसेध. E. आङ् before षिध to go, &c. affix क्त.
6059: आसीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sitting, seated. E. आस to sit, शानच् affix, form irr.
6060: आसीनप्रचलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Nodding, rocking as seated, falling asleep. E. आसीन and प्रचलायित set in motion.
6061: आसुति m. (-तिः) Distilling, distillation. E. आङ्, षूञ् to produce, affix क्तिन्.
6062: आसुतीबल m. (-लः) 1 A sacrificer at the full and change of the moon. 2 A distiller. E. आसुति and बलच् aff.
6063: आसुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Infernal, demoniac, belonging or relating to the Asuras. m. (-रः) 1 An Asura or demon. 2 A form of marriage, in which the bridegroom gives to the bride, her father and paternal kinsmen, as much as he can afford. n. (-रं) Black salt. f. (-री) 1 A division of medicine, surgery, curing by cutting with instruments, applying the actual cautery, &c. 2 Mustard. E. असुर a demon, अण् and in the fem. ङीप्.
6064: आसेक m. (-कः) Sprinkling. E. आङ् before षिच to sprinkle, affix घञ्.
6065: आसेचन n. (-नं) Sprinkling. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Beloved, desired. E. आङ्, षिच to sprinkle, ल्युट् affix; also आसेचनक.
6066: आसेचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the preceding. E. आङ्, षिच to sprinkle, ल्युट् and कन् aff. also असेचनक.
6067: आसेद्धृ m. (-द्धा) One who confines or arrests another. E. आङ् before षिध to go, and तृच् aff.
6068: आसेध m. (-धः) Arrest, legal restraint of four kinds; कालामेधः limit of time, स्थानामेधः confinement to a place, प्रवासासेधः prohibition against removal or departure, कर्म्मासेधः restriction from employment. E. आङ् before षिध to go, घञ् aff.
6069: आसेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be interrupted, prohibited or restrained. E. आङ् before षिध to go, यत् aff.
6070: आस्कन्दन m. (-नं) 1 Going, going to, approaching. 2 Effacing, destroying. 3 Reproach, abuse. 4 War, battle. 5 Drying. E. आङ् before स्कन्द to go, ल्युट् aff.
6071: आस्कन्दित n. (-तं) The walk of a horse. E. आङ, स्कन्द to go, क्त aff.
6073: आस्तर m. (-रः) 1 A covering, a coverlet, a blanket thrown over the back of a horse or elephant. 2 Spreading clothes, &c. 3 A carpet, a bed. E. आङ्, स्तृञ् to spread, and अप् aff.
6074: आस्तरण n. (-णं) 1 A carpet, a rug, a quilt, bed clothes. 2 A bed. 3 A layer of sacred grass spread out at a sacrifice. 4 An elephant's housings, a painted cloth or blanket worn on his back. E. as the preceding, affix ल्युट्.
6075: आस्तिक m. (-कः) The name of a Muni or saint. E. अस्ति who is, and वुञ् affix; from an expression of his father, (he is in the womb,) pronouncing his conception to have taken place before there were any external indications of it. mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A believer, pious, faithful. E. अस्ति as before, saying that there is a GOD, &c. in opposition to the नास्तिक an atheist, and ठक् aff.
6076: आस्तिकता and f. (-ता) Belief in GOD. E. आस्तिक and तल् affix; also with त्व affix आस्तिकत्वं.
6077: आस्तिकार्थद m. (-दः) A name of a king, also called JANAMEJAYA. E. आस्तिक the Muni, अर्थ a request, and द who gives or grants; having at his request spared the Nāga, TAKṢAKA, from the destruction to which he had devoted the race.
6078: आस्तीक m. (-कः) The name of a Muni or saint, the son of JARATKĀRU, also a Muni: see आस्तिक. E. अस्ति and ठक् aff.
6079: आस्तीकजननी f. (-नी) The wife of JARATKĀRU, a saint. E. आस्तीक as above, and जननी a mother, the mother of that saint.
6080: आस्तीक्य n. (-क्यं) Belief in Providence and a future world. E. आस्तिक a believer, and यञ् aff.
6081: आस्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Spread, strewed, scattered. E. आङ् before स्तॄ to spread, क्त aff.
6082: आस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread. 2 Covered. E. आङ् before स्तृ to spread, affix क्त.
6083: आस्था f. (-स्था) 1 Prop, stay, place or means of abiding. 2 An assembly. 3 Effort, pains, care. 4 Consideration, regard. E. आङ् before स्था to stay, to stand, आङ् and टाप् affs.
6084: आस्थान nf. (-नं-नी) An assembly. n. (-नं) 1 Place, site. 2 Staying, abiding. 3 Pains, care. E. आङ्, स्था to stay or stand, ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.
6085: आस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Placing, fixing, causing to stay or remain. 2 An enema of oil, ghee, &c. E. आङ् before स्था to stay, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
6086: आस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stayed, dwelt, abiding, abode. 2 Applied to, having recourse to. 3 Occupied, engrossed by, engaged in. 4 Spread, overspread. 5 Obtained. 6 Observing, adhering to, following, practising. E. आङ् before स्था and क्त aff.
6087: आस्पद n. (-दं) 1 Business, affair. 2 Office, rank, station. 3 Dignity. 4 Authority. 5 Place, site. E. आङ् before पद to go, deriv. irr.
6088: आस्पन्दन n. (-नं) Trembling, throbbing. E. आङ् before स्पदि to shake, ल्युट् aff.
6089: आस्पर्द्धा f. (-र्द्धा) Emulation, rivalry. E. आङ् before स्पर्द्ध to vie with, अच् and टाप् affs.
6090: आस्पर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) Emulous. E. आस्पर्द्धा and इनि aff.
6091: आस्फाल m. (-लः) 1 Striking, rubbing, causing to move gently. 2 Flapping, clapping. 3 The flapping motion of an elephant's ear. E. आङ्, स्फल to move, causal form, घञ् aff.
6092: आस्फालन n. (-नं) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Rubbing, stirring, moving gently. E. आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, affix ल्युट्.
6093: आस्फालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck gently, rubbed, touched, stirred. 2 Flapped, clapped, struck together. E. आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, क्त aff.
6094: आस्फुजित् m. (-जित्) A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet VENUS, and teacher of the Asuras.
6095: आस्फोट m. (-टः) 1 A plant, (Swallow wort.) 2 The sound of striking on the arms, as made by combatants, wrestlers, &c. f. (-टा) A wild variety of jasmin. E. आङ्, स्फुट् to expand, and अच् affix; also आस्फोत and आस्फोता.
6096: आस्फोटक m. (-कः) A tree, (Careya arborea.) E. आङ्, स्फुट् to blow, &c. and वुन् aff.
6097: आस्फोटन n. (-नं) 1 Blowing, expanding. 2 Contracting, closing. 3 Slapping the arms, or the noise made by it. f. (-नी) A gimlet or auger. E. आङ्, स्फुट to blow or expand, and ल्युट् aff.
6098: आस्फोत m. (-तः) 1 Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) 2 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) 3 A kind of echites or savanna flower, (E. dichotoma, Rox.) f. (-ता) 1 A wild variety of jasmin. 2 Clitoria ternatea. E. आङ्, स्फुट to blow or expend, अच् affix and ट changed to त; or स्फै to encrease, with क्त affix, and आ converted to ओ; also sometimes आस्फोट and आस्फोटा.
6099: आस्य n. (-स्यं) 1 The face. 2 The mouth. mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Belonging or relating to the mouth or face. E. अस to throw or direct, and ण्यत् affix, or आङ् before स्यन्द to go, and ड affix; to which food goes or is directed. f. (-स्या) Stay, abiding, resting. E. आस to sit, and ण्यत् aff.
6100: आस्यपत्र n. (-त्रं) A lotus. E. आस्य a face, and पत्र a leaf; this flower is commonly compared to a beautiful face.
6101: आस्यलाङ्गल m. (-लः) A hog, a boar. E. आस्प and लाङ्गल a plough; whose face is as it were a plough.
6102: आस्यलोमन् n. (-म) The beard. E. आस्य and लामन् hair; the hair of the face.
6103: आस्यासव m. (-वः) Spittle, saliva. E. आस्य the mouth, आसव liquor.
6104: आस्रप m. (-पः) The nineteenth lunar mansion. E. आस्रप a Rākṣasa or goblin, and अण् aff. one of this race being the deity of the asterism.
6105: आस्रव m. (-वः) 1 Distress, pain, affliction. 2 Flow, running, discharge. E. आङ्, स्रु to go, and अच् aff.
6106: आस्राव m. (-वः) 1 Pain, affliction. 2 Flow, issue, running, discharge. E. आङ्। स्रु to ooze, ण aff.
6107: आस्वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded. E. आङ्, स्वन to sound, क्त affix, with इट् augment.
6108: आस्वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Sounded. E. आङ् before स्वन to sound, क्त aff.
6109: आस्वाद m. (-दः) 1 Tasting, eating. 2 Enjoying. 2 Flavour. E. आङ् before ष्वद to taste, affix घञ्.
6110: आस्वादन n. (-नं) 1 Tasting, eating. 2 Enjoying. E. आङ् before ष्वद and ल्युट् aff.
6111: आस्वादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tasted. 2 Enjoyed, possessed. 3 Eaten. E. आङ् before ष्वद to taste, affix क्त.
6112: आह ind. An interjection, aha! ah! implying, 1 Casting, sending. 2 Severity, reproof. 3 Commanding.
6113: आहक m. (-कः) A disease of the nose, inflammation of the Schneiderian membrane.
6114: आहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, beaten. 2 Injured, killed. 3 Multiplied. 4 Known, understood. 5 Uttered falsely. n. (-तं) 1 Old.  cloth or raiment. 2 New cloth or clothes. 3 Assertion of an impossibility. m. (-तः) A drum. E. आङ्, हन to hurt or injure, affix क्त.
6115: आहतलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Noted for good qualities. E. आहत known, and लक्षण a mark.
6116: आहर m. (-रः) 1 Breath inspired, inspiration. 2 Taking, seizing. E. आङ् before हृ to take, अप् aff.
6117: आहरण n. (-णं) 1 Taking, seizing. 2 Causing, inducing. 3 Extracting, removing. E. आङ् before हृ to take, affix ल्युट्.
6118: आहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) One who takes or seizes. m. (-र्त्ता) (In law,) A copy-holder. E. आङ् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
6119: आहव m. (-वः) 1 War, battle. 2 Sacrificing. E. आङ् before हु to sacrifice or ह्वेञ् to call, and अच् aff.
6120: आहवन n. (-नं) Sacrifice, offering sacrifice. E. आङ् before हु to sacrifice, ल्युट् aff.
6121: आहवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be offered as an oblation. m. (-यः) A consecrated fire taken from the householder's perpetual fire, and prepared for receiving oblations. E. आङ्, हु to offer oblations, and अनीयर् aff.
6122: आहवनीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fit for a burnt offering. m. (कः) A consecrated fire. E. कन् added to the last.
6123: आहार m. (-रः) 1 Food. 2 Taking, conveying. E. आङ्, हृ to convey, घञ् aff.
6124: आहारसम्भव m. (-बः) The juice of the body, chyle, lymph, serum, &c. E. आहार food, and सम्भव what is produced.
6125: आहारार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Begging or seeking for food. E. आहार and अर्थिन् who asks.
6126: आहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Adventitious, accessory, incidental. 2 To be taken or seized. 3 To be eaten. m. (-र्य्यः) The ornamentative part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c. E. आङ् before हृञ् to convey, ण्यत् aff.
6127: आहार्य्यशोभा f. (-भा) Adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but the effect of pain, ornaments, &c. E. आहार्य्य incidental, and शाभा splendor.
6128: आहाव m. (-वः) 1 A trough near a well for watering cattle. 2 War, battle. 3 Calling. E. आङ् before ह्वे to call, घञ् affix, deriv. irr.
6129: आहिक m. (-कः) 1 A name of the inspired grammarian PĀṆINI. 2 The descending node. E. अहि a snake, or the constellation Aśleṣā, and ठक् aff.
6130: आहिण्डिक m. (-कः) A man of mixed origin, the son of a Niṣada father and Vaidehi mother, employed as a watchman on the outside of jails, &c.
6131: आहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, deposited. 2 Entertained, felt. 3 Comprising, containing. 4 Made, done. E. आङ्, धा to have or hold, part. affix क्त, form irr.
6132: आहितलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Noted for good qualities. E. see अहतलक्षण.
6133: आहितव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Pained, grieved. E. आहित felt, व्यथा pain.
6134: आहितस्वन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Noisy, uttering or making sound. E. आहित made, स्वन a sound.
6135: आहिताङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Marked, spotted, stained. E. आहित made, अङ्क a spot.
6136: आहिताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman who has preserved a sacred fire kept alive perpetually in a family, &c. E. आहित placed, and अग्नि a fire; by whom.
6137: आहितुण्डिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a snake-catcher. E. अहि a snake, तुण्ड a mouth, and ठक् affix; playing with the mouth of a snake: the poisonous fangs being extracted, the snakes are suffered to bite their exhibitors.
6138: आहुत n. (-तं) The nourishment of all created beings, considered as one of the five sacraments or principal sacrifices of the Hindus. E. आङ्, हु to offer oblations, and क्त aff.
6139: आहुति f. (-तिः) 1 Offering oblations with fire to the deities. 2 Any solemn rite accompanied with oblations. E. as the preceding, affix क्तिन्.
