6141: आहूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Called, summoned, invoked, invited. E. आङ् before ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
6142: आहूतप्रपलायिन् m. (-यी) A defendant or witness absconding, or not appearing when summoned. E. आहूत and प्रपलायिन् who runs away.
6143: आहूति f. (-तिः) Calling. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, affix क्तिन्; ए is dropped, and व is changed to its analogous vowel उ.
6144: आहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought, taken collected. E. आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
6145: आहृव्य ind. Having taken or received, having brought. E. आङ् before हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
6146: आहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging, or relating to a snake. E. अहि a snake, and ढञ् aff.
6147: आहो ind. 1 An interjection of doubt; 2 Of asking.
6148: आहोपुरुषिका f. (-का) Boasting, military vaunting. E. आहो, पुरूष a man, and affix कन्; doubting another's manhood, &c.
6149: आहोस्वित् ind. A particle implying doubt. E. आहो and स्वित् aff.
6150: आह्न n. (-ह्नं) Many days. E. अहन् a day, and अण् aff.
6151: आह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Daily, diurnal, of or belonging to a day. n. (-कं) 1 Constant occupation, daily work. 2 The division or section of a book. 3 Food. E. अहन् a day, and ठक् aff.
6152: आह्निकाचार m. (-रः) Daily observance, the prayers and practices necessary for bodily and mental purification. E. आह्निक and आचार observance.
6153: आह्लाद m. (-दः) Joy, delight. E. आङ् before ह्लद to be pleased, affix घञ्.
6154: आह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, rejoiced. E. आङ्, ह्लद to be delighted, क्त aff.
6155: आह्व m. (-ह्वः) A crier, who or what calls. f. (-ह्वा) 1 A name, an appellation. 2 A call, a summons. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, क aff.
6156: आह्वय m. (-यः) 1 A name or appellation. 2 A lawsuit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cockfighting, &c. E. आङ्, ह्वेञ् to call, अच् aff.
6157: आह्वान n. (-नं) 1 Calling, a call or summons. 2 Legal summons. 3 A name, an appellation. 4 Invocation, invitation. E. आङ्, ह्वेञ् to call, ल्युट् aff.
6158: आह्वानदर्शन n. (-नं) Day of trial. E. आह्वान summons, and दर्शन seeing, investigating.
6159: आह्वाय m. (-यः) 1 A name 2 A summons. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, घ aff.
6160: आह्वायक m. (-कः) A messenger, a courier. E. आङ्, ह्वे to call, ण्वुल् aff. इ
6161: इ The third vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to I short, and pronounced as that letter in kill, &c.
6162: इ m. (-इः) A name of KĀMADEVA. Ind. An interjection 2 Of anger. 2 Of calling. 3 Of sorrow or distress. 4 Of compassion. E. इ to go, क्विप् aff.
6163: इ r. 1st cl. (अयति) To go, to go to or towards: with उत् prefixed, to rise or ascend, as the sun, &c. with अभि and उत् the same, or to rise in the world, to prosper. (ङ) इङ् and अधि always prefixed अधीङ r. 2nd cl. (अधीते) To study, to learn, to read over or through. (क) इक and अधि prefixed r. 2nd cl. (अध्येति) To remember, to think of. (ण) इण् r. 2nd cl. (एति) To go. This root takes many prefixes, implying with अति, 1 to surpass, to surmount. 2 To pass, to spend time or to elapse as time. With अनु, 1 To go after, to follow. 2 To go like, to imitate in going. 3 To succeed. With अभि, 1 To obtain, to get. 2 To proceed, to go on. 3 To go. 4 To approach. 5 To serve or worship. With अप 1 To go away, to depart. 2 To perish. With अभि and उप, To arrive. With उप, 1 To receive. 2 To aid or assist. 3 To approach or go near to. With निर्, to go forth or out from. With प्रति, 1 To trust, to confide. 2 To follow, to be added or subjoined to. 3 (In the passive verb,) To become evident or manifest. With वि, To expend, to waste, to depart. With सम and उप, To obtain, &c.
6164: इक्कट m. (-टः) A kind of reed: see इत्कट.
6166: इक्षु m. (-क्षुः) The sugar cane. E. इष to desire, and क्सु affix or ईक्ष to see, असुन् affix and ई made short.
6167: इक्षुकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A species of sugar cane, (Saccharum munja, Rox.) see मुञ्ज. 2 A sort of grass, (Kās,) (Saccharum spontaneum.) 3 The stem or cane of the Saccharum officinale, the sugar cane. E. इक्षु and काण्ड a stem.
6168: इक्षुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 1 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 2 Barleria longifolia, (this and its synonyms are also applied to Capparis spinosa and Tribulus lanuginosus: see कोकिलाक्ष and गोक्षुरक.) 3 Convolvulus paniculatus: भूमिकुष्माण्ड. E. इक्षु and गन्ध smell; having the odor of the sugar cane.
6169: इक्षुगन्धिका f. (-का) Convolvulus paniculatus. E. see the preceding.
6170: इक्षुतुल्या f. (-ल्या) A species of grass or reed. E. इक्षु and तुल्या like, like sugar cane.
6171: इक्षुदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The stem or cane of the Saccharum officinale, the sugar cane. E. इक्षु and दण्ड a staff.
6172: इक्षुदर्भा f. (-र्भा) A kind of grass; also वंशमूल, &c.
6173: इक्षुनेत्र (-त्रं) A kind of tree. E. इक्षु and नेत्र an eye.
6174: इक्षुपत्र m. (-त्रः) A species of grain, Jowar, (Panicum spicatum). E. इक्षु and पत्र a leaf.
6175: इक्षुप्र m. (-प्रः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum sara.)
6176: इक्षुबालिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of reed: see इक्ष्वालिका. 2 Saccharum spontaneum. E. इक्षु and बालिका an infant; a young sugar cane, from its smaller size.
6177: इक्षुभक्षिका f. (-का) A meal of sugar or molasses. E. इक्षु, भक्ष to eat, ण्वुच् aff.
6178: इक्षुमती f. (-ती) The name of a river in Bengal. E. इक्षु and मतुप् aff. in this sense.
6179: इक्षुमूल n. (-लं) 1 A sort of tree; also इक्षुनेत्र. 2 The root of sugar cane. E. इक्षु and मूल a root.
6180: इक्षुमेह m. (-हः) Diabetes, or D. mellitus. E. इक्षु and मेह urine.
6181: इक्षुमेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Diabetic. E. इक्षुमेह and इनि aff.
6182: इक्षुयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A sugar mill. E. इक्षु and यन्त्र a machine.
6183: इक्षुयोनि m. (-निः) The common sugar cane. E. इक्षु and योनि origin.
6184: इक्षुर m. (-रः) 1 Sugar cane. 2 Barleria longifolia or Tribulus lanuginosus. 3 Saccharum spontaneum. E. इक्षु sugar, and र what gives, from रा and ड aff.
6185: इक्षुरक m. (-कः) 1 Saccharum spontaneum. 2 Barleria longifolia: see the preceding, कन् being added.
6186: इक्षुरस m. (-सः) 1 The juice of the sugar cane. 2 Molasses, unrefined sugar. 3 A sort of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. इक्षु and रस juice.
6187: इक्षुरसक्वाथ m. (-थः) Raw or unrefined sugar, molasses. E. इक्षुरस and क्वाथ a decoction, the boiled or inspissated juice.
6188: इक्षुरसोद m. (-दः) The sea of syrup. E. इक्षुरस and उद water.
6189: इक्षुवाटिका f. (-का) A kind of sugar cane, the common yellow cane; also इक्षुवाटी; see पुण्ड्र.
6190: इक्षुविकार m. (-रः) 1 Sugar, molasses. 2 Any sweetmeat. E. इक्षु and विकार change of form.
6191: इक्षुवेष्टन m. (-नः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum munja.) E. इक्षु and वेष्टन surrounding.
6192: इक्षुशाकट n. (-टं) A field of sugar cane. E. इक्षु and शाकट a field.
6193: इक्षुशाकिन n. (-नं) A field of sugar cane. E. इक्षु and शाकिन a field in this compound.
6194: इक्षुसार m. (-रः) Molasses, raw or unrefined sugar. E. इक्षु and सार essence, the essence of the sugar cane.
6195: इक्ष्वाकु m. (-कुः) The son of the Menu VAIVASVATA, the son of SŪRYA or the sun, and first prince of the solar dynasty: he reigned at Ayodhya in the commencement of the second Yuga or age. f. (-कुः) A bitter gourd. E. इक्षु and अक to obtain, and कु or उण् aff.
6196: इक्ष्वालिक m. (-कः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) f. (-का) Another sort, (Saccharum fuscum;) the native pens are made from its stem. E. इक्षु and आलिका for आली a line; it grows like the sugar cane.
6197: इख r. 1st cl. (एखति) and (इ) इखि (इंखति) To go.
6198: इग r. 1st cl. (इ) इगि (इंगति) 1 To go, to go to or towards. 2 To move or agitate.
6199: इङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Moveable, locomotive. 2 Surprising, wonderful. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A hint or sign, an indication of sentiment by gesture, &c. 2 Knowledge. E. इगि to go, affix क.
6200: इङ्गित n. (-तं) 1 Hint, sign, gesture. 2 Going, motion. 3 Intention, purpose E. इगि to go, affix क्त.
6201: इङ्गितज्ञ mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Understanding signs. E. इङ्गित and ज्ञ who knows.
6202: इङ्गुद mf. (-दः-दी) The name of a plant, commonly Iṅguä. E. इङ्गु going, and द what gives; the pen. अ is changed to उ. and the fem. affix is ङीष्.
6203: इङ्गुल mf. (-लः-ली) See the preceding. E. as before, द being changed to ल.
6204: इच्छक mfn. (-कः-का-क) Wishing, desirous. m. (-कः) 1 Citron, (Citrus medica.) 2 (In arithmetic,) Demand, the sum sought. E. इच्छा wish, and वुन् aff.
6205: इच्छत्व n. (-त्वं) Desire, wishfulness. E. इच्छा and त्व affix; also with तल, इच्छता.
6206: इच्छन् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छंती-च्छत्) Wishing, wishful, desirous. E. इष to wish, शतृ aff.
6207: इच्छा f. (-च्छा) Wish, desire. E. इष to desire, affixes श and टाप्.
6208: इच्छानिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Suppression of desire. E. इच्छा and निवृत्ति cessation.
6209: इच्छान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having desire, wishing, wishful. E. इच्छा and अन्वित possessed of.
6210: इच्छावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wishing, wishful, desirous. f. (-ती) A woman desirous of any thing. E. इच्छा, मतुप् poss. affix, and ङीप् fem.
6211: इच्छावसु m. (-सुः) A name of KUVERA. E. इच्छा and वसु wealth.
6212: इच्छु mfn. (-च्छुः-च्छुः-च्छु) Wishing, desiring. E. इष to wish, and उस् affix, deriv. irr.
6213: इच्छुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Wishing, desirous. E. कन् added to the last, or इच्छ and उकन् aff.
6214: इज्जल m. (-लः) A small tree growing in wet and saline soil, or on low grounds near the sea, (Barringtonia acutangula.) see हिज्जल. E. इण to go, क्किप् affix, and जल water.
6215: इज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) A teacher. m. (-ज्यः) VṚHASPATI, the teacher or Guru of the gods. f. (-ज्या) 1 A gift, a donation. 2 Sacrificing, making offerings to the gods or manes. 3 Worship, reverence. 4 Meeting, union. 5 A cow. 6 A bawd or procuress. E. यज to sacrifice, &c. क्यप् aff.
6216: इज्याशील m. (-लः) A frequent sacrificer. E. इज्या sacrifice, and शील to be frequent, अच् aff.
6217: इञ्चाक m. (-कः) A shrimp or prawn. E. इ love, चक to satisfy, and घञ् aff.
6218: इट r. 1st cl. (एटति) To go, to go to or towards.
6219: इट्चर m. (-रः) A bull or steer allowed to go at liberty. E. इष् to wish, क्विप् affix, and चर who goes, going at will; also इड्वर.
6220: इडा f. (-डा) 1 The wife of BUDDHA, daughter of IKṢVĀKU. 2 The earth. 3 A cow. 4 Speed. 5 A tubular vessel, one of the principal channels of the vital spirit, that which is on the right side of the body. 6 Heaven. 7 The goddess of speech. E. इल to direct or send, क affix, and टाप् fem. ल and ड are interchangeable: see इला.
6221: इडाचिका f. (-का) A wasp. E. इडा the earth, चर to go, and ड्वन् aff.
6222: इडिका f. (का) The earth. E. इल to direct, and वुन् affix; ल becomes ड.
6223: इडिक्क m. (-क्कः) A wild goat. E. इडिक् an imitative sound, and क who utters, from कै, affix ड.
6224: इड्वर m. (-रः) A bull fit to be let at liberty. E. इष् to wish, affix क्विप्, and वृ to choose, अप् affix: see इट्चर.
6227: इतःइतस् ind. Here here, come here. E. इतस् repeated.
6228: इत् ind. A grammatical term, implying a letter in the inflective particles that is to be rejected.
6229: इत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Remembered. 3 Obtained. E. इण to go, affix क्त.
6230: इतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Other, different. 2 Low, vile. E. इ desire, तृ to pass over, and अप् aff.
6231: इतरथा ind. In another manner, otherwise, differently. E. था added to इतर.
6232: इतरेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Mutual, one with another. Respective, several. E. इतर repeated.
6233: इतरेतरकाम्या f. (-म्या) Respective or several fancies or inclinations. E. इतरेतर and काम्य to be desired.
6234: इतरेतराश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Affecting or concerning mutually. E. इतरेतर and आश्रय object or receptacle.
6235: इतरेद्युस् ind. Another or different day. E. इतर and एद्यस् aff.
6236: इतस् ind. Hence, from hence. E. irr. deriv. from इदम् this, with तसिल् aff.
6237: इतस्ततस् ind. Here and there, hither and thither. E. इतस् hence, ततस् thence.
6238: इतश्चेतस् ind. Hither and thither. E. इतस् repeated, with च and, inserted.
6239: इति ind. A particle implying, 1 Cause, (thus, therefore.) 2 Manifestation, (lo! behold!) 3 Something additional, (et cetera.) 4 The meanings of एव, (so thus, even, in this manner) 5 Conclusion, enough, (finis.) 6 Reference, (so says, this is, &c.) It also implies, 7 Order, arrangement, specific or distinctive, and 8 Identity (of this or similar form.) 9 A grammatical copulative, indicating a preceding sound or sense, to be again intended. E. इ to go, क्तिच् aff.
6240: इतिकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Unworthy of trust, not fit to be credited. 2 Wicked, lost. f. (-था) Unmeaning or nonsensical discourse. E. इति this, so, and कथा a saying.
6241: इतिकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is proper or necessary to be done. E. इति so, कर्त्तव्य to be done.
6242: इतिकर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Proper and right measures. E. इतिकर्त्तव्य with तल् added, or with त्व, इतिकर्त्तव्यत्वं.
6243: इतिह ind. Traditional instruction, advice, &c. mutually imparted. E. इति so, thus, and ह tidings.
6244: इतिहास m. (-सः) History, traditional accounts of former events, heroic history, as the Mahābhārata and Rāmāyaṇa. E. इतिह traditional instruction, अस to be, and घञ् aff.
6245: इत्कठ mf. (-टः-टा) A kind of reed or grass; also वहूमूल. E. उत् and कठ to go, उ is changed to इ.
6246: इत्किला f. (-ला) A perfume: see रोचना. E. इत obtained, and किल to play.
6247: इत्थम् ind. Thus. E. इदम् this, deriv. irr. with थमु aff.
6248: इत्थम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become thus or in such manner. E. इत्यम् and भूत become.
6249: इत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be gone to or towards. f. (-त्या) a litter, a palankeen. E. इत् to go, क्यप् aff.
6250: इत्यादि ind. Et cetera, and so forth.
6251: इत्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Low, vile. 2 Cruel, harsh. 3 A traveller. 4 Poor, indigent. 5 Going, moving, what goes. f. (-री) A disloyal or unchaste woman. E. इत and क्वरप् aff.
6252: इद r. 1st cl. (इ) इदि (इन्दति) To have supreme power and superhuman faculties.
6253: इदम् pron. mfn. (अयं इयं इदं) This. E. इन्द to have power, कमिन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical न rejected.
6254: इदंकार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi?) E. इदम् this, and कार्य्य business; applied to this and that use.
6255: इदानीन्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Present, momentary, of the present moment. E. इदानीम् and द्यु aff.
6256: इदानीम् ind. 1 Now, at present. 2 An expletive, affecting however slightly the sense. E. irr. deriv. from इदम् this, with दानीम् aff.
6257: इदावत्सर m. (-रः) A year, one of the five sorts of years in which gifts of clothes and food are productive of great rewards.
6258: इद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Lighted, alight. 2 Shining, glowing, blazing. 3 Clean, clear, bright. 4 Wonderful. 5 Obeyed, unresisted. n. (-द्ध) 1 Sunshine, light, heat. E. इन्ध to shine, affix क्त.
6259: इध्म n. (-ध्मं) Fuel. E. इन्धी to kindle, to burn, मक् Uṇādi aff.
6260: इध्मप्रव्रञ्चन m. (-नं) A hatchet, an axe. E. इध्म and प्रव्रच्चन what cuts.
6261: इन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 A master, a lord. 3 A king. 4 The asterism Hasta. E. इण् to go, नक् Uṇādi aff.
6262: इनसभ n. (-भं) A royal court or assembly. E. इन and सभा assembly.
6263: इन्दम्बर n. (-रं) The blue lotus, (Nymphaea coerulea.) E. इन्दं from इदि to possess great power, and वर what chooses, preeminent above other flowers: see इन्दीवर.
6264: इन्दिन्दिर m. (रः) A large bee. E. इदि to possess great power, deriv. irr.
6265: इन्दिरा f. (-रा) A name of LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU. E. इदि as above, and रा who gives.
6266: इन्दिरालय n. (-यं) The lotus, (Nymphaea lotus.) E. इन्दिरा LAKṢMĪ, and आलय an abode; this goddess issued at the creation from the petals of the flower.
6267: इन्दिरावर n. (-रं) The blue lotus. E. इन्दिरा the goddess, and वर what is best; a flower beloved by LAKṢMĪ.
6268: इन्दिवर n. (-रं) The blue lotus, (Nymphaea coerulea.) E. इन्दि for इन्दिरा q. v. the rest as in the preceding; also इन्दीवर and इन्दीवार.
6269: इन्दीवर n. (-रं) See the preceding. f. (-री) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus). E. as before.
6271: इन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. उन्द to wet or moisten; उ Uṇādi affix, and the initial changed to इ.
6272: इन्दुकमल n. (-लं) The white lotus. E. इन्दु the moon, and कमल the lotus.
6273: इन्दुकला f. (-ला) A digit of the moon. E. इन्दु and कला a digit.
6274: इन्दुकलिका f. (-का) The Ketakī flower. E. इन्दु and कलिका a bud.
6275: इन्दुकान्त m. (-न्तः) The lunar gem, the moon-stone. E. (-न्ता) Night. E. इन्दु and कान्त a master or husband.
6276: इन्दुजनक m. (-कः) The ocean. E. इन्दु and जनक a parent; the moon was produced amongst other things at the churning of the ocean.
6277: इन्दुजा f. (-जा) The Narmadā or commonly Nerbudda river in the Dekhin. E. इन्दु and जा born; the daughter of the moon.
6278: इन्दुदल m. (-लः) A portion of the moon, a digit, a crescent, &c. E. इन्दु and दल a leaf.
6279: इन्दुपुत्र m. (-त्रः) A name of BUDHA, regent, of the planet MERCURY. E. इन्दु and पुत्र the son: the son of CANDRA or the moon.
6280: इन्दुभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of ŚIVA. E. इन्दु and भृत् who nourishes; ŚIVA wears a half moon on his forehead.
6281: इन्दुमण्डल n. (-लं) The orb or disc of the moon. E. इन्दु and मण्डल sphere.
6282: इन्दुमती f. (-ती) 1 Day of full moon. 2 Name of a princess married to AJA the son of RAGHU. E. इन्दु and मतुप् poss. affix, fem. ङीप्.
6283: इन्दुर m. (-रः) A rat. E. उन्द to moisten, उरच् affix, the initial is changed to इ.
6284: इन्दुरत्न n. (-त्नं) A pearl. E. इन्दु and रत्न a gem.
6285: इन्दुरेखा f. (-खा) A digit of the moon. E. इन्दु and रेखा a line.
6286: इन्दुलेखा f. (-खा) 1 A digit of the moon. 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 4 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen:) see यमानिका. E. इन्दु and लेखा a line.
6287: इन्दुलोहक n. (-कं) Silver. E. इन्दु and लोह iron, कन् added.
6288: इन्दुवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. इन्दु and वल्ली a creeper.
6289: इन्दुव्रत n. (-तं) A religious observance depending on the age of the moon; diminishing the quantity of food by a certain portion daily, for a fortnight or a month, &c. E. इन्दु and व्रत a religious obligation.
6290: इन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 The deity presiding over Svarga or the Hindu paradise, and the secondary divinities; he is also regent of the east quarter, and is more particularly the deity of the atmosphere, corresponding in many respects with the Grecian JOVE. 2 The Supreme Being, (according to the Vedānta,) or the deity INDRA in that capacity. 3 Supremacy, supreme power or authority. 4 An Āditya, one of the twelve demigods so called. 5 One of the Yogas, or divisions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic. 6 The human or animal soul, the portion of spirit residing in the body. 7 Night. 8 A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica, &c.) see कुटज. 9 An organ of sense. 10 (In composition) Best, excellent. 11 The 14th lunation of the month Jyeṣṭha. 12 One of the nine divisions of Jambu Dvīpa, or the known continent. f. (-न्द्रा) 1 The name of a plant, (Marjoram?) see फणिम्भक. 2 The wife of INDRA. E. इदि to possess supreme power, and रन् Uṇādi aff.
6291: इन्द्रक n. (-कं) An assembly-room, a hall. E. इन्द्र excellent, and क what sounds, from कै and ड aff.
6292: इन्द्रकील m. (-लः) The mountain Mandara, a fabulous mountain with which the ocean was churned. E. इन्द्र and कील a pin or bolt.
6293: इन्द्रकुञ्जर m. (-रः) INDRA'S elephant. E. इन्द्र and कुञ्जर an elephant.
6294: इन्द्रकोष m. (-षः) 1 A platform, a scaffold. 2 A projection of the roof of a house, forming a kind of balcony or terrace. 3 A pin or bracket projecting from the wall. E. इन्द्र best, and कोष a place.
6295: इन्द्रगोप m. (-ग्रः) An insect, (Coccinella of various kinds.) E. इन्द्र best, गो light, and प from पा who nourishes or possesses.
6296: इन्द्रछन्दस् n. (-न्दः) A necklace of a thousand strings. E. इन्द्र best, and छन्दस् a necklace, &c.
6297: इन्द्रजाल n. (-लं) 1 Conjuring, juggling. 2 Deception, cheating. 3 Trick or stratagem in war. E. इन्द्र an organ of sense, and जाल a net.
6298: इन्द्रजालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A juggler, a conjuror. 2 Deceptive, unreal. E. इन्द्रजाल illusion, and ठक् aff.
6299: इन्द्रजित् m. (-जित्) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. इन्द्र and जित् who conquers: the conqueror of INDRA.
6300: इन्द्रजिद्विजयिन् m. (-यी) LAKṢMAṆA, the brother of RĀMA. E. इन्द्रजित् and विजयिन् a victor, the conqueror of INDRAJIT.
6301: इन्द्रतूल n. (-लं) A flock of cotton, a flocculent seed, &c. blown about in the air. E. इन्द्र and तूल cotton: INDRA'S cotton.
6302: इन्द्रतूलक n. (-कं) See the preceding. E. as before, कण् added.
6303: इन्द्रदारु m. (-रुः) A tree, (Pinus devadaru.) E. इन्द्र and दारु tree.
6304: इन्द्रद्रु n. (-द्रुः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna, Rox.) E. इन्द्र and द्रु a tree; a staff of which is fit to carry the banner of INDRA.
6305: इन्द्रद्रुम m. (-मः) See the preceding. E. as before.
6306: इन्द्रनील m. (-लः) A sapphire. E. इन्द्र best, and नील blue.
6307: इन्द्रनीलक m. (-कः) An emerald. E. see the preceding.
6308: इन्द्रपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A medicinal plant; also अग्निजिह्वा. E. इन्द्र and पुष्पा a flower: also इन्द्रपुष्पिका.
6309: इन्द्रपुरोहिता f. (-ता) The asterism Puṣya. E. इन्द्र and पुरोहिता priest, INDRA presiding over it.
6310: इन्द्रप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Ancient Dehli. E. इन्द्र the deity, and प्रस्थ who presides.
6311: इन्द्रप्रहरण n. (-णं) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. इन्द्र and प्रहरण a weapon.
6312: इन्द्रभेषज n. (-जं) Dried ginger. E. इन्द्र best, and भेषज medicament.
6313: इन्द्रमहकामुक m. (-कः) A dog. E. इन्द्र, मह a sacrifice, and कामुक desirous.
6314: इन्द्रमूल n. (-लं) A flock of cotton: see इन्द्रतूल.
6315: इन्द्रयव mn. (-वः-वं) The seed of the Wrightea antidysenterica. E. इन्द्र the plant, and यव seed: it is used medicinally in cases of diarrhoea, dysentery, &c.
6316: इन्द्रलुप्त mn. (-प्तः-प्तं) Morbid baldness, falling of the hair of the head: according to some authorities, loss of beard. E. इन्द्र best, लुप्त lost.
6317: इन्द्रलुप्तक m. (-कः) See the preceding. E. as before, वुन् aff.
6318: इन्द्रलोक m. (-कः) Svarga or paradise, the heaven of INDRA. E. इन्द्र and लोक world.
6319: इन्द्रलोकेश m. (-शः) 1 INDRA. 2 A guest, hospitality to whom secures paradise. E. इन्द्रलोक and ईश lord.
6320: इन्द्रवारुणिका f. (-का) Colocynth, a wild bitter gourd, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. कन् added to इन्द्रवारुणी.
6321: इन्द्रवारुणी f. (-णी) See the preceding. E. इन्द्र and वरुण the two deities so called, affixes अण् and ङीप्; the favourite plant of INDRA and VARUṆA.
6322: इन्द्रवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A kind of fir: see देवदारु. E. इन्द्र for any god, वृक्ष a tree.
6323: इन्द्रव्रत n. (-तं) One of the duties of a king, to distribute gratification, as INDRA pours down rain. E. इन्द्र and व्रत observance.
6324: इन्द्रवृद्धा f. (-द्धा) A sore, an ulcer.
6325: इन्द्रशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) INDRĀṆĪ, the wife or personified energy of INDRA. E. इन्द्र and शक्ति power.
6326: इन्द्रसावर्णि m. (-र्णिः) The last of the fourteen Menus. E. इन्द्र and सावर्णि the son of the sun.
6327: इन्द्रसुत m. (-तः) The monkey king BĀLĪ. E. इन्द्र and सुत a son; the son of INDRA: the epithet is also applied to ARJUNA and JAYANTA.
6328: इन्द्रसुरस m. (-सः) A shrub, the leaves of which are used in discutient applications, (Vitex negundo;) also सिन्दुवार. E. इन्द्र best, सु good, and रस juice; whose juice is excellent.
6329: इन्द्रसुरिस m. (-सः) See the preceding. E. as before, the pen. being changed to इ.
6330: इन्द्रसूनु m. (-नुः) The son of INDRA: see इन्द्रसुत.
6332: इन्द्राणिका f. (-का) Vitex negundo: see इन्द्रसुरस. E. कन् added to the next word.
6333: इन्द्राणी f. (-णी) 1 The wife of INDRA. 2 A plant, (Vitex negundo:) see the preceding. E. इन्द्र, ङीष् affix, and आनुक augment.
6334: इन्द्रानुज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. इन्द्र and अनुज younger born: the younger brother of INDRA.
6335: इन्द्रायुध m. (-धः) The rainbow. f. (-धा) A kind of leech of various tints on the back. E. इन्द्र and आयुध a weapon; INDRA'S weapon.
6336: इन्द्रारि m. (-रिः) An Asura or demon. E. इन्द्र and अरि an enemy.
6337: इन्द्रावरज m. (-जः) VIṢṆU. E. इन्द्र and अवरज after-born: the younger brother of INDRA.
6338: इन्द्राशन m. (-नः) 1 Hemp, dried and chewed. 2 The shrub which bears the seed used as jeweller's weight, (Abrus precatorius). E. इन्द्र and अशन food: the food of INDRA.
6339: इन्द्रासन n. (-नं) 1 The throne of INDRA. 2 Any throne. E. इन्द्र and असन a seat.
6340: इन्द्रिय n. (-यं) 1 An organ of sense divided into three classes, Jñānendriyas, Karmendriyas, and Antarindriyas, or organs of perception and action, and the internal organs; the first are the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; the second, the organ of speech or larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; the last are, Manas the mind or organ of thought; Buddhi the organ of apprehension; Ahaṅkāra the organ of selfishness; and Citta the heart or organ of feeling. 2 Semen virile. mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Done, seen, given, &c. by INDRA. E. इन्द्र the soul or self, and इयच् affix, deriv. irr. what is with difficulty restrained by the soul, or इन्द्र the deity, and घ aff.
6341: इन्द्रियगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Perceptible, capable of being ascertained by the senses. E. इन्द्रिय and गोचर perceptible.
6342: इन्द्रियग्राम m. (-मः) The senses or organs of sense collectively. E. इन्द्रिय and ग्राम here, assemblage.
6343: इन्द्रियज्ञान n. (-नं) The faculty of perception, sense, consciousness. E. इन्द्रिय and ज्ञान knowledge.
6344: इन्द्रियनिग्रह m. (-हः) Restraining the organs of sense. E. इन्द्रिय and निग्रह restraint.
6345: इन्द्रियबुद्धि f. (द्धिः) Perception, the exercise of any sense, the faculty of any organ. E. इन्द्रिय and बुद्धि knowledge.
6346: इन्द्रियबोधन n. (-नं) Any excitement of sense, an object of perception, a stimulus, &c. E. इन्द्रिय and बोधन waking.
6347: इन्द्रियवर्ग m. (-र्गः) The organs of sense collectively. E. इन्द्रिय and वर्ग a class.
6348: इन्द्रियविप्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Erroneous or vicious perception. E. इन्द्रिय and विप्रतिपत्ति perversion.
6349: इन्द्रियस्वाप m. (-पः) 1 Unconsciousness, insensibility. 2 The end of the world. E. इन्द्रिय and स्वाप sleep.
6350: इन्द्रियागोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Imperceptible. E. इन्द्रिय and अगोचर imperceptible.
6351: इन्द्रियायतन n. (-नं) The body. E. इन्द्रिय and आयतन a mansion: the residence of the senses.
6352: इन्द्रियार्थ m. (-र्थः) An object of sense, as sound, smell, &c. E. इन्द्रिय and अर्थ an object.
6353: इन्द्रियासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Stoicism, philosophy, detachment from sensual objects. E. इन्द्रिय and असङ्ग detachment.
6354: इन्द्रेज्य m. (-ज्यः) The name of VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods. E. इन्द्र and इज्य to be worshipped; venerable to the deities.
6355: इन्ध r. 7th cl. (ई and ञि) ञिइन्धी (इन्धे) 1 To shine. 2 To kindle.
6356: इन्धन n. (-नं) Fuel; wood, grass, &c. used for that purpose. E. इन्ध to kindle, and ल्युट् aff.
6357: इन्वका f. plu. (-काः) Stars in the head of Orion. E. इवि to please, क्वुन् affix: see इल्वला and इल्वका.
6358: इभ r. 10th cl. (इ) इभि (इम्भयते) To collect or accumulate.
6359: इभ m. (-भः) 1 An elephant. 2 Best (in composition.) E. इण to go, भन् Uṇādi aff.
6360: इभकणा f. (-णा) A plant with an aromatic seed, (Pothos officinalis.) E. इभ an elephant, and कणा pepper; being considered by Hindu writers, as a large species of pepper: see गजपिप्पली.
6361: इभदन्ता f. (-न्ता) A plant: see नागदन्ती. E. इभ and दन्त a tooth: this and similar names are given, from its supposed resemblance to an elephant's tooth.
6362: इभनिमीलिका f. (-का) Smartness, shrewdness, wittiness. E. इभ and निभनिमीलिका winking; winking knowingly like an elephant.
6363: इभपालक m. (-कः) The driver or keeper of an elephant. E. इभ, पालक a nourisher.
6364: इभपोटा f. (-टा) A young elephant, a cub. E. इभ and पोटा any young animal.
6365: इभमाचल m. (-लः) A lion. E. इभ an elephant, in the second case, आ and चल who attacks.
6366: इभयुवति f. (-तिः) An elephant's cub. E. इभ and युवति young.
6367: इभाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea:) see नागकेशर. E. इभ and आख्या an appellation; named from the elephant.
6368: इभोषणा f. (-णा) A kind of aromatic plant: see इभकणा. E. इभ and उषणा pepper.
6369: इभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Wealthy, opulent. f. (-भ्या) 1 A female elephant. 2 The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. इभ an elephant; here also implying excellence, and यत् affix of appropriation or fitness.
6370: इयत् mfn. (-यान्-यती-यत्) So much, thus much. E. इदम् this, and वतुप् aff.
6371: इयत्ता f. (-त्ता) Fixed measure or quantity, so much. E. इयत् and तल् affix; also with त्व, इयत्त्व.
6372: इरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Desert. 2 Salt or barren, (soil:) E. see इराण.
6373: इरम्मद m. (-दः) 1 A flash of lightning, or the fire attending the fall of a thunderbolt. 2 Submarine fire. E. इरा water, here also watery clouds, and मद what plays or shines.
6374: इरा f. (-रा) 1 The earth. 2 Water. 3 Speech. 4 The goddess of speech, &c. 5 Ardent spirits. E. इण to go, and रन् Uṇādi affix, fem. affix टाप्.
6375: इराचर m. (-रः) Hail. mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Earth-born, terrestrial. 2 Aquatic. E. इरा water, &c. and चर what goes.
6376: इराज m. (-जः) A name of KANDARPA, the Hindu CUPID. E. इरा water, and ज born.
6377: इरावत् m. (-वान्) 1 The ocean. 2 A cloud. 3 A king. mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Watery, having or yielding water, &c. E. इरा and मतुप् aff.
6378: इरावेल्लिका f. (-का) Pimples or pustules on the head.
6379: इरिण n. (-णं) 1 A desert, an inhospitable region. 2 Salt or barren soil. E. ऋ to go, इनन् Uṇādi affix, and the initial changed to इ.
6380: इरिमेद m. (-दः) A fetid mimosa: see विट्खदिर. E. see अरिमेद, अ being changed to इ.
6382: इरेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A king, a sovereign. 3 VARUṆA. E. इरा SARASVATĪ, &c. and ईश lord.
6383: इर्व्वारु mf. (-रुः-रुः) 1 A cucumber, (Cumumis utilatissimus, Rox.) 2 Another kind, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. इरु a seed, and आरु what goes to or gets, from ऋ and उण् affix, or आलु, र becoming ल; also written इर्व्वालु, ईर्व्वारु, उर्व्वारु, &c.
6384: इर्व्वारुशुक्तिका f. (-का) A kind of melon; commonly Sphuti or Sphut, (Cucumis momordica.) E. इर्व्वारु and शुक्तिका an oyster-shaped cucumber.
6386: इल r. 6th cl. (इलति) 1 To sleep. 2 To go. 3 To throw, send or direct: in this last sense, it is also r. 10th cl. (एलयति.)
6387: इलविला f. (-ला) The mother of KUVERA.
6388: इला f. (-ला) 1 The wife of BUDDHA, and daughter of IKṢVĀKU. 2 The earth. 3 A cow. 4 Speech. E. इल to send, क and टाप् affixes; also इडा.
6389: इलागोल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe. E. इला and गोल a sphere.
6390: इलातल n. (-लं) 1 The fourth place in the circle of the zodiac. 2 The surface of the earth. E. इला and तल below.
6391: इलावृत n. (-तं) One of the nine Varṣas or divisions of the known world, comprehending the highest and most centrical part of the old continent. E. इला the earth, and आवृत chosen: the fairest part of the globe.
6392: इलिका f. (-का) The earth. E. इल to go, कन् and टाप् affixes.
6393: इली f. (-ली) A cudgel, a stick shaped like a sword or a short sword: see ईली.
6394: इलीश m. (-शः) A fish, commonly the Hilsa or Sable, (Clupea alosa.) E. इल to go, (in the water,) and ईश chief, principal. The fish being one of high flavour, and very abundant at certain seasons, it is generally eaten both by the natives of Bengal, and by Europeans residing there.
6395: इल्लल m. (-लः) A bird. E. इल to go, and अल who is able.
6396: इल्लिश m. (-शः) The Hilsa fish: see इलीश; also ईल्लीश.
6397: इल्वका f. plu. (-काः) Stars in Orion's head: see इल्वल.
6399: इल्वल m. (-लः) 1 The name of a demon. 2 Of a fish. f. plu. (-लाः) Stars in Orion's head. E. इल to send or go, and वल Uṇādi affix; the last is also written इल्वका ut sup.
6400: इव r. 1st cl. (इ) इवि (इंवति) 1 To pervade. 2 (According to some,) to please. 3 To be satisfied.
6401: इव ind. So, even, as, like, in the same manner.
6402: इशीका f. (-का) An elephant's eye-ball: see इषीका.
6403: इष r. 4th cl. (इष्यति) To go. r. 6th cl. (इच्छति) 1 To wish, to desire. 2 To accept, to receive. With अभि, to desire: with प्रति, to engage, to promise. r. 9th cl. (इष्णाति) To repeat an act, to do any thing again and again. With अनु prefixed, to search after, to investigate or enquire.
6404: इष m. (-षः) The month Āśvina, (September-October.) E. इष to go, क affix; also ईष.
6405: इषिका f. (-का) 1 An elephant's eye-ball. 2 A painter's brush, &c. also इषीका.
6406: इषिर m. (रः) Fire. E. इष to go, किरच् aff.
6407: इषीका f. (-का) 1 An elephant's eye-ball. 2 A painter's brush, &c. also इषिका. 3 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. इष to go, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
6408: इषु mf. (-षुः) 1 An arrow. 2 A versed sine. E. इष to go, and उ Uṇādi aff.
6409: इषुधर m. (-रः) An archer. E. इषु and धर who bears.
6410: इषुधि mf. (-धिः) A quiver. E. इषु and धि what holds, from धा root, and कि aff.
6411: इष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Cherished, beloved. 3 Worshipped, reverenced, respected. m. (-ष्टः) 1 A lover, a husband. 2 The Castor-oil tree. n. (-ष्टं) 1 An act of sacrifice, an oblation, &c. 2 An essential ceremony, as ablution, investiture, &c. Ind. (-ष्टम) Voluntarily. E. इष to desire, or इष substituted for यज to sacrifice, and क्त aff.
6412: इष्टकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) (In arithmetic,) Rule of supposition, operation with an assumed number. E. इष्ट wished, and कर्म्मन् act.
6413: इष्टका f. (-का) A brick; also इष्टिका. E. इष to wish, तकक् Uṇādi aff.
6414: इष्टकान्यास m. (-सः) Laying the foundation of a house. E. इष्टका and न्यास order.
6415: इष्टकापथ n. (-थं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). E. इष्ट wished, and कापथ a bad road, growing in or preferring unfrequented places: this word is sometimes divided, कापथ being one name, and इष्ट added to अवदाह, another name: see अवदाहेष्ट and अवदाह.
6416: इष्टकाराशि f. (-शिः) A pile of bricks. E. इष्टका and राशि a heap.
6417: इष्टगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Fragrant, any fragrant substance. n. (-न्धं) Sand. E. इष्ट and गन्ध a smell; of a desirable odor.
6418: इष्टतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Beloved, best beloved, dearest, most desired. E. इष्ट and तमप् aff.
6419: इष्टतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dearer, more dear, more desired. E. इष्ट and तरप् aff.
6420: इष्टत्व n. (त्वं) 1 Desirableness. 2 Reverence, &c. also इष्टता. E. तल् or त्व added to इष्ट.
6421: इष्टदेव m. (-वः) A tutelary deity, one particularly worshipped. E. इष्ट and देव a deity.
6422: इष्टदेवता f. (-ता) A person's chosen or tutelary divinity. E. इष्ट and देवता divinity.
6423: इष्टापूर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) Any religious duty, a oblation, sacrifice, penance, holy study, digging a well, planting a tree, &c. E. इष्ट a sacrifice, and पूर्त्त liberal act, religiously considered; आङ् prefixed to the latter.
6424: इष्टार्थोद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Zealously active, diligent for a desired object. E. इष्ट wished, अर्थ intention, and उद्युक्त diligent.
6425: इष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Wish, desire. 2 A sacrifice, any sacrificial rite. 3 A compendious verse easily committed to memory. E. इष to wish, or इष substituted for यज, to sacrifice; affix क्तिन्.
6426: इष्टिका f. (-का) A brick. E. more usually इष्टका.
6427: इष्टिन् mfn. (-ष्टी-ष्टिनी-ष्टि) Who wishes or desires, desirous, wishing. E. इष्ट and इनि aff.
6428: इष्टिपच m. (-चः) A demon. E. इष्टि a sacrifice or oblation, and पच who digests: stealing oblations to the deities, and eating them.
6429: इष्टिमुष् m. (-मुट्) A demon. E. इष्टि an oblation, and मुष् who steals; from मुष root, and क्विप् aff.
6430: इष्टु f. (-ष्टुः) Desire, wish. E. इष to wish, तु aff.
6431: इष्ट्वा ind. 1 Having sacrificed or worshipped. 2 Having wished. E. इष with क्त्वा aff.
6432: इष्म m. (-ष्मः) 1 Love or the deity KĀMA. 2 Spring. E. इष to desire, and मक् Uṇādi aff.
6433: इष्य m. (-ष्यः) The spring season. E. इष to wish, and क्यप् aff.
6434: इष्व m. (-ष्वः) A spiritual preceptor. E. इष to wish, वन् Uṇādi aff.
6435: इष्वास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) A thrower of arrows. m. (-सः) 1 A bow. 2 An archer, a warrior. E. इषु an arrow, and आस who throws.
6436: इस् ind. (-इः) An interjection of anger, pain, or sorrow.
6437: इह ind. 1 Here, in this place. 2 Now, at this time.
6438: इहकाल m. (-लः) This life. E. इह and काल time.
6439: इहलोक m. (-कः) This life, this world. E. इह and लोक world.
6440: इहामूत्र ind. Here and there, in this world and in the next. E. इह here, अमूत्र there or in that. ई
6441: ई The fourth letter of the alphabet, corresponding to I long, having the sound of ee in feel, and distinguished by an accent from the former, as ī.
6442: ई m. (-ईः) A name of KANDARPA. f. (ईः) A name of LAKṢMĪ. Ind. An interjection of. 1 Pain. 2 Anger. 3 Consciousness or perception. 4 Consideration. 5 Compassion.
6443: ई r. 2nd cl. (एति) 1 To go. 2 To pervade. 3 To conceive or become pregnant. 4 To desire. 5 To throw or direct. 6 To eat. This root is not generally admitted, though it occurs in composition, as with उत् (उदीते) To appear. r. 4th cl. (ङ) ईङ (ईयते) To go.
6444: ईक्ष r. 1st cl. (ईक्षते) To see. It most usually occurs compounded with one or other of the prepositions, as with अप, to expect; with अभि, to gaze at; with अव, to inspect; with उत् or उप, to expect or await; with उप, to abandon; with निर्, to see; with परि, to try, to test, to assay; with प्र, to see, to resemble, or look like; with वि, to inspect; with प्रति, 1 to look for, to expect, 2 to venerate; with सम, to compare, to contrast, to select; with प्रति and उत्, to look up at.
6445: ईक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 An eye. E. ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
6446: ईक्षणिका f. (-का) A female fortune-teller. E. ईक्षण seeing, वुन् aff.
6447: ईक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Looking at, surveying. E. ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.
6448: ईक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. ईक्ष and क्त aff.
6449: ईख r. 1st cl. (ईखति) To go; also (इ) ईखि (ईखति.)
6450: ईज r. 1st cl. (ङ) (ईजते) 1 To go. 2 To blame or censure; also (इञ) ईजिञ् (ईंजति-ते.)
6451: ईड r. 2nd cl. (ईट्टे) also 10th cl. (ईडयति) To praise.
6452: ईडण n. (-णं) Praising. E. ईड and ल्युट् aff.
6453: ईडा f. (-डा) Praise. E. ईड to praise. क and टाप् affs.
6454: ईडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended. E. ईड to praise, क्त aff.
6455: ईड्य mfn. (-ड्यः-ड्या-ड्यं) To be praised, to be glorified. E. ईड to praise, क्यप् aff.
6457: ईत r. 1st cl. (इ) ईति (ईंतति) To bind.
6458: ईत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone. E. ई to go, क्त aff.
6459: ईति f. (-तिः) 1 Calamity of season, as drought, excessive rain, rats, foreign invasion, &c. 2 Travelling in foreign countries, sojourning. 3 An affray. E. ईङ to go, affix क्तिन्.
6460: ईदृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Such. E. ई for इदम् this, दृश to see, क्विन् aff.
6461: ईदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such, so like. E. ई for इदम् this, दृश with क्विप् aff.
6462: ईदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Such, so like. E. as the last, with कञ् aff.
6463: ईप्सन n. (-नं) Desiring, wishing to obtain. E. आप to obtain, desiderative form, ल्युट् aff.
6464: ईप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. E. आप to obtain, desiderative form, क्त aff.
6465: ईप्सु mfn. (-प्सः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous, wishing to get or obtain. E. आप to obtain, desiderative form, उस् aff.
6466: ईर r. 2nd cl. (ईर्त्ते) 1 To go. 2 To shake. r. 1st and 10th cls. (ईरति, ईरयति) 1 To go. 2 To throw or direct, to drive or force on; with उत् prefixed, to say or speak: with प्र, to send, to make to go; with सम्, to go like the wind.
6467: ईयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वस्) 1 Gone, having gone. 2 Having obtained. E. इण to go, क्वसु aff. form irr.
6468: ईरिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Desert. 2 Saline and barren (soil.) E. ऋ to go, and इरन् aff.
6469: ईरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Said, uttered. 3 Gone. 4 Made. E. ईर to send, affix क्त.
6470: ईरिताकूत n. (-तं) Declared purpose or intention. E. ईरित and आकूत purpose.
6471: ईर्क्ष्य r. 1st cl. (ईर्क्ष्यति) To envy, to feel impatient at another's prosperity.
6472: ईर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) A sore or wound. E. ईर to send, and मक् aff.
6473: ईर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Wandering about as a religious mendicant. E. ईर to go, affix क्यप्.
6474: ईर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus;) also ईर्व्वालु and इर्व्वारु, &c.
6475: ईर्षा f. (-र्षा) Impatience, envy of another's success; more properly read ईर्ष्या.
6476: ईर्षालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Impatient of another's success, envious. E. ईर्षा and आलुच् affix: see ईर्घ्यालु.
6477: ईर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Envied. n. (-तं) Envy. E. ईर्षा and इतच् affix, or ईर्ष with क्त aff.
6479: ईर्ष्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं) Envious, envying. f. (-र्ष्या) 1 Envy or impatience of another's success. 2 Spite, malice. E. ईर्ष्य to envy, and अच् and टाप् affixes; also, but according to the best writers, inaccurately written ईर्षा.
6480: ईर्ष्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Envious, envying. E. ईर्ष्यं and वुन् aff.
6481: ईर्ष्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Envying, envious. E. ईर्ष्य and शानच् aff.
6482: ईर्ष्यालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Envious. E. ईर्ष्य and आलुच् affix; also written ईर्षालु.
6483: ईर्ष्यावश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Being overcome with envy. E. ईष्या and वश subjection.
6484: ईर्ष्यिन् mfn. (-र्ष्यी-र्ष्यिणी-र्ष्यि) Envious, spiteful. E. ईर्ष्या and इनि affix. So ईर्ष्यावत् (-वान्-वती-वत्) and ईर्ष्यामय (-यः-यी-यं.)
6486: ईलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised. E. इड to praise, affix क्त, and ड changed to ल.
6487: ईली f. (-ली) A weapon, sometimes considered as a cudgel, and sometimes as a short sword, or a stick shaped like a sword. E. ईर to go, &c. क and ङीप् affixes, and र changed to ल; see इली; also ईलि, &c.
6488: ईश r. 2nd cl. (ङ) ईशङ् (ईष्टे) To possess power, property, or authority.
6489: ईश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Also of the same deity as regent of the north-east quarter. 3 A ruler, a master. f. (-शा) The shaft of a plough. E. ईश to rule, क aff.
6490: ईशसखि m. (-खा) A name of KUVERA. E. ईश ŚIVA, and सखि a friend.
6491: ईशादन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 An elephant with large tusks. 2 The tusk of an elephant. E. ईशा and दन्त a tooth; whose tooth is of the size of a plough-shaft, or the tooth which is so.
6492: ईशान m. (-नः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Also of the same as regent of the north-east quarter. 3 One of the Rudras. 4 The sun as a form. of ŚIVA. mf. (-नः-नी) The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum). n. (-नं) Light, splendor. f. (-नी) A name of DURGĀ. E. ईश a master, &c. and आनच् affix, and fem. ङीष्
6493: ईशिता f. (-ता) Superiority, supremacy, one of the eight attributes of divinity. E. ईश a master, and तल् abstract affix; also ईशित्व.
6494: ईशितृ m. (-ता) 1 A master, an owner or proprietor. 2 A king. E. ईश to rule, and तृच् aff.
6496: ईश्वर m. (-रः) 1 The supreme ruler of the universe, GOD; it is therefore applied to all the different divinities, but mostly designates ŚIVA, in mythological and popular acceptation. According to the Sāṃkhyas, Īśvara is the liberated spirit; finite, according to KAPILA; in finite, according to PATAÑJALI. In the Nyāya system, Īśvara is also a finite spirit endowed with attributes. In the Vedānta, Īśvara is infinite and universal spirit,  the cause and substance of creation. 2 A name of ŚIVA, especially in a compound, when the form of the deity implied is a Liṅga, as, Viśveśvara, Someśvara, Rāmeśvara, &c. 3 KĀMADEVA. mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 An owner, a proprietor, a chief or head. 2 Able, competent. f. (-रा or -री) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 Of LAKṢMĪ, or of any other of the Śaktis or female energies of the deities. E. ईश to rule, and वरट् or वरच् affix, consequently ङीप् or टाप् for the feminine.
6497: ईश्वरभाव m. (-वः) Royal or imperial nature. E. ईश्वर a sovereign, and भाव disposition.
6498: ईश्वरसभ n. (-भं) A royal court or assembly. E. ईश्वर and सभा an assembly.
6499: ईश्वराधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Subject to a king, dependant, on A master or on GOD, &c. E. ईश्वर, अधि over, ख aff.
6500: ईश्वराधीनता f. (-ता) Dependance upon GOD, subjection to a ruler. E. ईश्वराधीन and तल् added; also with त्व, ईश्वराधीनत्व.
6501: ईष r. 1st cl. (ङ) ईषङ (ईषते) 1 To go or move. 2 To kill or hurt. 3 To see. 4 To give. (उ.) ईषु (ईषति) To glean.
6502: ईष m. (-षः) The month Aśvin: see इष.
6503: ईषज्जल n. (-लं) Shallow water, a little water. E. ईषत् and जल water.
6504: ईषत् ind. A little. E. ईष to go, अत् aff.
6505: ईषत्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Diminutive, delicate. 2 Doing little. 3 What little is done to or made of. E. ईषत् a little, and कर what makes.
6506: ईषत्पान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) What is little drank or drank little of. E. ईषत् and पान drink.
6507: ईषत्प्रलम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) What is little gained of. E. इषत् and प्रलम्भ profit.
6508: ईषदुष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Tepid, slightly warm. E. ईषत् and उष्ण warm.
6509: ईषद्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Of little merit. E. ईषत् and गुण quality.
6510: ईषत्पाण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A pale or light brown colour. E. ईषत् a little, and पाण्डु pale.
6511: ईषत्पुरुष m. (-षः) A mean man. E. ईषत् and पुरुष a man.
6512: ईषदून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Not quite complete or entire. E. ईषत् and ऊन less.
6513: ईषद्दर्शन n. (-नं) A glance at, a slight inspection. E. ईषत् and दर्शन seeing.
6514: ईषद्धास m. (-सः) A smile. E. ईषत् a little, and हास laughter.
6515: ईषद्रक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Of a pale red (colour.) E. ईषत् and रक्त red.
6516: ईषन्निमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Exchanged for a little. E. ईषत् and निमय barter.
6517: ईषल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) What little is or can be gained of. E. ईषत् and लभ what gets.
6518: ईषा f. (-षा) The pole or shaft of a plough. E. ईष to go, affixes क and टाप्; also ईशा.
6519: ईषादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The handle of a plough. E. ईषा the staff, and दण्ड a stick.
6520: ईषादन्त m. (-न्तः) An elephant with a large tusk or tooth. E. ईषा and दन्त a tooth: see ईशादन्त.
6521: ईषिका f. (-का) 1 An elephant's eye-ball: see इषीका. 2 A painter's brush, &c. see ईषीका. 3 A weapon, a dart or arrow. E. ईष to hurt, किकन् aff.
6522: ईषिर m. (-रः) Fire. E. ईष to injure, and किरच् aff.
6523: ईषीका f. (-का) 1 A painter's brush, a fibrous stick used as one. 2 An ingot mould. 3 A dipping-rod, or something cast into a crucible to examine if the metal it contains is in fusion: see ईषिका. E. ईष to go, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
6524: ईष्म m. (-ष्मः) 1 KĀMADEVA. 2 Spring: see इष्म.
6525: ईह r. 1st cl. (-ङ) ईहङ् (ईहते) To endeavour, to aim or attempt. With सम् prefixed, to wish, to desire.
6526: ईहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Performing, undertaking. E. ईह to make effort, शानच् aff.
6527: ईहा f. (-हा) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Effort, exertion. E. ईह to desire. अङ् and टाप् affs.
6528: ईहातस् ind. Diligently, energetically, by or with labour or exertion. E. तसि substituted for the regular case.
6529: ईहामृग m. (-गः) 1 A wolf. 2 A division of the drama. E. ईहा wish, and मृग a deer.
6530: ईहार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-थिनी-र्थि) 1 Aiming at any object. 2 Seeking wealth. E. ईह to seek, अर्थ wealth, इनि aff.
6531: ईहावृक m. (-कः) A wolf. E. ईहा and वृक a wolf.
6532: ईहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sought, attempted, made effort for. 2 Wished, desired. E. ईह to wish, क्त aff. उ
6533: उ The third short vowel of the Sanskrit alphabet, corresponding to the letter U, and pronounced as that is in the word full.
6534: उ r. 1st cl. (उ) उङ (उवते) To sound, to make a particular sound or noise.
6535: उ ind. An interjection, 1 of assent; 2 calling; 3 of compassion; 4 anger; and 5 of command. 6 An expletive. m. (-उः) 7 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Of BRAHMA.
6536: उकनाह m. (-हः) A horse of a red and yellow, or red and black colour, a bay or chesnut horse.
6537: उकुण m. (-णः) A bug. also उत्कुण.
6538: उक्त n. (-क्तं) A sentence. nf. (-क्तं-क्ता) A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, one long or two short syllables in each. mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Spoken, said. E. वच to speak, affix क्त and व changed to उ.
6539: उक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Said, was saying. E. वच to speak, क्तवतु affix of the past part.
6540: उक्तवाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) One who has borne testimony or given an opinion. n. (-क्यं) A dictum, a decree. E. उक्त and वाक्य dictum.
6541: उक्ति f. (क्तिः) Speech, speaking. E. वच to speak, and क्तिन् aff.
6542: उक्तोपसंहार m. (-रः) Any brief or compendious phrase or description. E. उक्त what is said, उपसंहार compendiousness.
6543: उक्त्वा ind. Having spoken or said. E. वच् to speak, क्त्वाच् aff.
6544: उक्थ n. (-क्थं) The second or Sāma Veda. f. (-क्था) A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines of one syllable each, the syllable may be one long or two short in quantity. E. वच to speak, and थक् Uṇādi aff.
6545: उक्ष r. 1st. cl. (उक्षति) 1 To sprinkle or wet. 2 To clean.
6546: उक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Cleansed, washed. 2 Wet, moist. E. उक्ष to wet, affix अप्.
6547: उक्षतर m. (-रः) A large bull or ox. E. उक्षन् an ox, and तरप् aff.
6548: उक्षन् m. (-क्षा) An ox or bull. E. उक्ष to sprinkle, and कनिन् Uṇādi aff.
6549: उक्षाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Swift. 2 Excellent. 3 Terrible. 4 High. 5 Much. m. (-लः) A monkey.
6550: उक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Cleansed, perfumed. E. उक्ष to wet, and क्त aff.
6551: उख r. 1st cl. (ओखति) (इ) उखि (उंखति) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To dry, to wither. 3 To adorn. The first retains the diphthong with a prefix ending in अ, as प्र and ओखति make प्रोखति.
6552: उखर्व्वल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
6553: उखल m. (-लः) A kind of grass, a sort of Andropogon.
6554: उखा f. (-खा) A pot or saucepan, &c. E. उख to go, क affix, and टाप्, also उघा.
6555: उख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Boiled, dressed in a pot, (flesh, &c.) E. उखा a pot, and यत् aff.
6556: उग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 Angry, wrathful. 2 Hot, sharp, pungent, acrid. 3 Formidable, terrible. 4 Cruel, fierce, savage. m. (-ग्रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of a mixed tribe, from a Kṣatriya father and Śūdra mother: the employment of this caste, according to MANU, is the killing or catching of animals that live in holes, as a snake-catcher, &c.; according to the Tantras, the Ugra is an encomiast or bard. 3 A tree, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) 4 A class of asterisms, Maghā, Bharaṇi, Pūrvaphalgunī, Pūrvāṣāḍhā, Pūrvabhadrapada. 5 A name of Malabar. f. (-ग्रा) 1 Orris root. 2 A medicinal plant. 3 An Ugra woman. n. (-ग्रं) Wrath, anger. E. उच to accumulate, रन् Uṇādi affix, च is changed to ग.
6557: उग्रकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Fierce, violent, cruel. E. उग्र and कर्म्मन् act.
6558: उग्रकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A sort of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) E. उग्र and काण्ड a stem.
6559: उग्रगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Strong smelling. m. (-न्धः) 1 A plant, (Michelia champaca.) 2 Garlic. n. (-न्धं) Asafoetida. f. (-न्धा) 1 Common carraway, (Carum carui, &c.) see अजमोदा. 2 Orris root. 3 A medicinal plant. E. उग्र violent, &c. and गन्ध scent.
6560: उग्रगन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Strong smelling. E. उग्रगन्ध and इनि aff.
6561: उग्रचय m. (-यः) Desire. E. उग्र fierce, चय a heap.
6562: उग्रत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Violence, passionateness. 2 Pungency, acrimony. E. उग्र angry, and त्व; also with तल् affix. उग्रता f. (-ता.)
6563: उग्रदण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Relentless, remorseless. E. उग्र and दण्ड punishment.
6564: उग्रधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A name of INDRA. E. उग्र fierce, and धन्वन् a bowyer.
6565: उग्रनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Large-nosed. E. उग्र formidable, and नासिका a nose.
6566: उग्रम्पश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 Frightful, hideous, fierce looking. 2 Malignant, wicked. E. उग्र fierce, पश्य looking.
6567: उग्रशेखरा f. (-रा) A name of GAṄGĀ. E. उग्र ŚIVA, and शेखरा a crest.
6568: उग्रसेन m. (-नः) 1 The name of a prince, the father of DEVAKĪ and KAṂSA, and king of Mathurā. 2 The name of another prince, the son of PARIKṢIT. E. उग्र fierce, and सेना an army.
6569: उग्रसेनज m. (-जः) A name of KAṂSA, the uncle and enemy of KṚṢṆA. E. उग्रसेन and ज born; also उग्रमेनतनयः, उग्रसेनपुत्रः, उग्रसेनसुतः, &c.
6570: उङ्कुण m. (-णः) A bug: see उत्कुण. E. उ fear, and कुण a sound.
6571: उच r. 4th cl. (उच्यति) To be conglomerate, to be gathered or assembled together, to unite or associate with.
6572: उचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proper, suitable, convenient. 2 Receivable, fit or right to be taken. 3 Known, understood. 4 Intrusted, deposited. 5 Measured, adjusted, accurate. E. वच to speak, and कितच् Uṇādi aff.
6573: उच्च mfn. (-च्चः-च्चा-च्चं) High, tall. m. (-च्चः) The apex of the orbit of a planet. E. उत् upwards, चि to gather, and ड aff.
6574: उच्चकैस् ind. Excessively lofty, tall, loud, &c. E. उच्च high, कैस् aff.
6575: उच्चघन n. (-नं) Laughter in the mind not expressed in the countenance.
6576: उच्चटा f. (-टा) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Habit, usage. 3 A kind of garlic. 4 A species of grass, (a cyperus.) 5 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 6 A sort of sorrel. E. उत् and चट to injure, अच् and टाप् affs.
6577: उच्चण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Quick, expeditious. 2 Passionate, violent. E. उत् implying excess, चडि to be angry, and अच् aff.
6578: उच्चतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Highest. E. उच्च and तमप् aff.
6579: उच्चतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Higher, more lofty. E. उच्च and तरप् aff.
6580: उच्चतरु m. (-रुः) 1 The cocoanut tree. 2 Any lofty tree. E. उच्च and तरु a tree.
6581: उच्चता f. (-ता) Height; also n. (-त्वं). E. तल् or त्व added to उच्च.
6582: उच्चताल n. (-लं) Music and dancing at feasts, drinking parties, &c. E. उच्च high sounding, and ताल tune.
6583: उच्चदेव m. (-वः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. उच्च high, above, and देव a deity.
6584: उच्चदेवता f. (-ता) Time personified, Chronos. E. उच्च high, and देवता divinity.
6585: उच्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The end of the night, the last watch of the night. E. उत् priv. and चन्द्र the moon; moonset.
6586: उच्चभाषण n. (-णं) Speaking loud. E. उच्च and भाषण speaking.
6587: उच्चमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be said. E. वच to speak, pass. v. शानच् aff.
6588: उच्चय m. (-यः) 1 The knot of the string or of the cloth which fastens the lower garments round the loins tied in front. 2 The opposite leg of a triangle. E. उत् up, above, चि to gather, अच् aff.
6589: उच्चरण n. (-णं) 1 Uttering, articulating. 2 Going up or out. E. उत् before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.
6590: उच्चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uttered, articulated. 2 Gone up or out. E. उत् before चर to go, क्त aff.
6591: उच्चल n. (-लं) The mind, the understanding. E. उत् above, and चल what goes.
6592: उच्चलन n. (-नं) Going off or out. E. उत् before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.
6593: उच्चललाटा f. (-टा) A woman with a high or projecting forehead. E. उच्च high, and ललाट a forehead; also उच्चललाटिका.
6594: उच्चलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone up or out. 2 Winnowed. E. उत् before चल to go, क्त aff.
6595: उच्चाटन n. (-नं) 1 Eradicating as a plant. 2 Ruining, (as an individual.) 3 Causing a person's ruin by magical incantations. E. उच्च up, and अटन going.
6596: उच्चार m. (-रः) 1 Foeces, excrement. 2 Pronunciation, utterance. E. उत्, चर to go, and घञ् aff.
6597: उच्चारण n. (-णं) Articulating, enunciation. E. उत् before चर to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
6598: उच्चारणज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A linguist, one skilled in languages or sounds. E. उच्चारण and ज्ञ who knows.
6599: उच्चारणस्थान n. (-नं) The part of the throat, &c. whence certain sounds, as nasals, gutturals, and the like proceed. E. उच्चारण and स्थान place.
6600: उच्चारणार्थ mfn. (-थ-र्था-र्थं) Necessary for pronunciation, a superfluous letter, &c. उच्चारण and अर्थ object.
6601: उच्चारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pronounced, uttered, articulated. E. उत् before चर to go, causal form, क्त aff.
6602: उच्चार्य्य ind. Having spoken or uttered. mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken, to be pronounced. E. उद before चर to go, causal form, affix ल्यप् or यत्.
6603: उच्चार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being uttered or pronounced. E. उच्चर, causal form, शानच् aff.
6604: उच्चावच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 1 Various, multiform. 2 Uneven, irregular, undulating. 3 High and low. E. उदक् upper, and अवाक् lower, great and small, &c.; the compound is irregular.
6605: उच्चिकीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Desire or wish to collect. E. उद before चि to collect, desiderative form, अ and टाप् affs.
6606: उच्चिङ्गट m. (-टः) 1 A sort of cricket. 2 A passionate man. E. उत् like, and चिङ्गट a shrimp.
6607: उच्चूल m. (-लः) The flag or pennon of a banner. E. उत् above, and चूड to be high; ल is substituted for ड.
6608: उच्चैःश्रवस् m. (-वाः) The horse of INDRA. E. उच्चैस् high, and श्रवस् an ear, long-eared; it is sometimes written with a final vowel, nom. (-सः.)
6609: उच्चैःस्वर m. (-रः) A loud sound or voice. E. उच्चैस् and स्वर sound.
6610: उच्चैर्घुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Making a loud noise, clamour. E. उच्चैस् high, loud, and घुष्ट sound.
6611: उच्चैस् ind. High, loud, great, much, &c. E. उत् much, चि to collect, डैसि Uṇādi aff.
6612: उच्चैस्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Very high, tall or lofty. 2 Very loud. E. उच्चैस् and तमप् aff.
6613: उच्चैस्तमाम् ind. 1 Loudly, aloud. 2 On high, high. E. आसु added to the last.
6614: उच्चैस्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Loftier. 2 Louder. E. उच्चैस् and तरप् aff.
6615: उच्छ r. 1st and 6th cls. (इ.) उच्छि (उञ्छति) 1 To glean. 2 To gather little by little. (ई.) उच्छी (उच्छति) or usually with वि prefixed, (व्युच्छति) 1 To end or terminate, to leave off. 2 To finish or conclude. 3 To pass or quit. 4 To bind. With प्र, to wipe off.
6616: उच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Destroyed. m. (-न्नः) Peace obtained by ceding valuable lands. E. उत् before षद to go, affix क्त.
6617: उच्छलत् mfn. (-लन्-लंती-लत्) Going or moving on or against. E. उद, शल to go, शतृ aff.
6618: उच्छलन n. (-नं) 1 Going upon. 2 Having over, or above, or against. E. उद before शल, ल्युट् aff.
6619: उच्छादन n. (-नं) Cleaning with perfumes. E. उत्, छद to cover, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
6620: उच्छालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Waved, waved above. 2 Gone, went. 3 Shaken. E. उद and शल to go, causal form, क्त aff.
6621: उच्छास्त्रवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Transgressing, deviating from the ritual. E. उद् before शास्त्र scripture, वर्त्तिन् who abides.
6622: उच्छिख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Flaming, blazing up. 2 Radiant. 3 High crested. E. उद् up, शिखा a flame.
6623: उच्छिङ्घन n. (-नं) Breathing through the nostrils, snuffing, snoring. E. उत् and शिघि to smell, ल्युट् aff.
6624: उच्छिद्य ind. Having cut off, destroyed, killed, &c. E. उद् before छिद to cut, ल्यप् aff.
6625: उच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Cut, cut off or cut. 2 Destroyed, killed. E. उद् and छिन्न cut.
6626: उच्छिलीन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) A mushroom. E. उत् and शिलीन्ध्र.
6627: उच्छिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Left, rejected as food; (i. e. spit out of the mouth, or orts, crumbs, fragments, &c.) 2 Left, abandoned. E. उत् up, शिष to leave as a residue, and क्त aff.
6628: उच्छिष्टभोजन m. (-नः) 1 One who eats another's leavings. 2 The attendant upon an idol, whose food is the leavings of the deities. E. उच्छिष्ट orts, and भोजन food.
6629: उच्छिष्टभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Who eats the remains of a meal. E. उच्छिष्ट and भोजिन् who eats.
6630: उच्छिष्टमोदन n. (-नं) Wax. E. उच्छिष्ट and मोदन pleasing.
6631: उच्छिष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Leaving, offal. E. उच्छिष्ट and अन्न food.
6632: उच्छीर्षक n. (-कं) A pillow. E. उत् upon, and शीर्षक the head: on which rests the head.
6633: उच्छुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Dry, dried up, withered. E. उद् before शुष्क dried.
6634: उच्छूडा f. (-डा) The head of a banner or part above the flag with erect ornaments. E. उत् up, छूडा crest.
6635: उच्छून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Swollen, turgid. 2 Lofty, high. 3 Fat, bulky. E. उत् up, श्वि to increase, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
6636: उच्छृङ्खल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Unrestrained, perverse, self-willed. 2 Irregular, desultory, unmethodical. E. उत् priv. and शृङ्क्षला a chain.
6637: उच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 Cutting off or out. 2 Destroying, destruction. 3 Cutting short, putting an end to. 4 Excision. E. उद् and छिद cutting.
6638: उच्छेषण n. (-णं) 1 Rest, remainder. 2 Leavings. E. उत् and शेषण remaining.
6639: उच्छोषण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) What dries up or withers. n. (-णं) Drying up, parching. E. उद् and शोषण drying.
6640: उच्छ्रय m. (-यः) 1 Height, elevation of a tree, mountain, &c. 2 Rising of a planet, &c. 3 Upright side of a triangle. E. उत् up, श्रिञ् to serve, च्यच् aff.
6641: उच्छ्राय m. (-यः) Height, elevation. E. उत् before श्रि to serve, घञ् aff.
6642: उच्छ्रायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) High raised, lofty. E. उच्छ्राय and इनि aff.
6643: उच्छ्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 High, tall. 2 Lifted up, raised. 4 Prosperous, advancing, increasing, rising. 5 Left, abandoned. 6 Increased in size or bulk, grown. E. उत्, श्रिञ् to serve, क्त aff.
6644: उच्छ्रिति f. (-तिः) 1 Height, elevation. 2 The upright side of a triangle. E. उत् before श्रि to serve, क्तिन् aff.
6645: उच्छ्रेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) High, lofty. E. उत् before श्रि to serve, यत् affix.
6646: उच्छूसन n. (-नं) 1 Breathing. 2 Sighing. E. उत् before श्वस to breathe, affix ल्युट्.
6647: उच्छूसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown, expanded. 2 Breathed, inspired. 3 Sighing. E. उत् much, &c. श्वसित breathed, blown.
6648: उच्छूस m. (-सः) 1 Breath, breathing, inspiration. 2 A sigh. 3 Consolation, encouragement. 4 Division of a book. E. उत् up, and श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
6649: उज्जयनी f. (-नी) Ujjayanī or Oujein, a city so called in Mālava, formerly the capital of VIKRAMĀDITYA. It is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus, and the first meridian of their geographers: the modern Oujein is about a mile south of the ancient city. E. उत् much, जयनी victorious or place of victory; from the military character of its people; also अवन्ती and उज्जयिनी.
6650: उज्जयन्त m. (-न्तः) The name of a mountain, part of the chain in the west of India, part of the Vindhya range: see रैवत. E. उत् priv. and जयन्ति a banner, or जयन्त the son of INDRA.
6651: उज्जयिनी f. (-नी) The city Oujein. E. see उज्जयनी.
6652: उज्जासन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. उत्। जस to kill, and ल्युट् aff.
6653: उज्जिहीर्षा f. (-र्षा.) Wishing to take or seize. E. उत् before हृ to take, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
6654: उज्जृम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Blown, expanded. 2 Open, apart. E. उत् up, and जृभि to gape, अप् aff.
6655: उज्जृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown, expanded. 2 Opened, stretched. n. (-तं) Effort, exertion. E. उत्, जृभि to yawn, क्त aff.
6656: उज्ज्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Luminous, splendid, light. 2 Lovely, beautiful. 3 Clean, clear. 4 Blown, expanded. 5 Burning, blazing. m. (लः) Love, passion. n. (-लं) Gold. E. उत् much, ज्वल् to shine, अच् aff.
6657: उज्ज्वलता f. (-ता) 1 Splendour, radiance. 2 Beauty. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, उज्ज्वलत्वं.
6658: उज्ज्वलन m. (-नं) Burning or shining. E. उत् before ज्वल to shine, affs. ल्युट्.
6659: उज्ज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, shining, flaming, &c. E. उत् before ज्वल to shine, affix क्त.
6660: उञ्छ n. (-ञ्छं) Gathering grains. E. उछि to glean, and घञ् aff.
6661: उञ्छन n. (-नं) Gathering grains of corn in market places, &c. gleaning. E. उछि to glean, ल्युट् aff.
6662: उञ्छवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) A gleaner, one who lives by gleaning. E. उञ्छ and वृत्ति practice.
6663: उञ्छशिल n. (-लं) Gleaning corn or grains. E. उञ्छ gathering grain, and शिल gleaning corn.
6664: उञ्छशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who lives by leaning, &c. E. उञ्छ and शील who practices.
6665: उञ्झ r. 6th cl. (उञ्झति) To quit or abandon. This is some. times read उद्झ्. With प्र, to escape or avoid.
6666: उञ्झ m. (-ञ्झः) Abandoning, leaving. E. उञ्झ and क aff.
6667: उञ्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned. 2 Left off, discontinued. E. उञ्झ to leave, affix क्त.
6668: उञ्झितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what leaves. E. उञ्झ and तृच् aff.
6669: उट m. (-टः) Leaves, grass, &c. used in making huts, thatches, &c.
6670: उटज m. (-जः) 1 A hut made of leaves, the residence of hermits or saints. 2 A house in general. E. उट thatch, &c. and ज made.
6671: उठ r. 1st cl. (ओठति) To strike or knock down; also ऊठ.
6672: उडु fn. (-डुः-डु) A lunar mansion or constellation in the moon's path. n. (-डु) Water. E. उत् above, डीङ् to go or fly, डु aff.
6673: उडुप mn. (-पः-पं) A raft or float. m. (-पः) The moon. E. उडु as above, and प from पा to preserve, affix ड.
6674: उडुपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. उडु and पति lord.
6675: उडुपथ m. (-थः) The firmament. E. उडु a constellation, and पथ a path.
6676: उडुम्बर m. (-रः) 1 Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) 2 The threshold of a house. 3 A eunuch. 4 A species of leprosy with coppery spots. 5 A kind of worm, supposed to be generated in the blood, and to produce leprosy. n. (-रं) 1 Copper. 2 A Karṣa, a measure of two Tolas. E. उडु a constellation in the second case, वृ to screen, and अप् affix; it is also written उडुम्बर and उटुम्बर.
6677: उडुम्बरपर्णी f. (-र्णी) The name of a plant: see दन्ती. E. उडुम्बर and पर्ण a leaf: whose leaves are of the color of copper.
6678: उडूप mn. (-पः-पं) A raft, a float. m. (-पः) The moon: see उडुप.
6679: उड्डयन n. (-नं) Flying, soaring. E. उत् before डी to fly, affix ल्युट्.
6680: उड्डामर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent, respectable, of rank or consequence.
6681: उड्डीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flown up, flying up. n. (-नं) 1 Flying as a bird. 2 Flying up, soaring. E. उद् up, and डी to fly, क्त aff.
6682: उड्डीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flying, soaring, who flies or soars. E. उत् up, डी to fly, शानच् aff.
6683: उड्डीश m. (-शः) 1 A work so called, containing charms and incantations. 2 A name of ŚIVA. E. उत् up, and डी to fly, Uṇādi affix श.
6684: उण्डेरक m. (-कः) A ball of flour, a roll, a loaf.
6685: उण्डेरकस्रज् f. (-स्रक्) A string of rolls, balls of meal or flour upon a string. E. उण्डेरक and स्रज a chaplet.
6686: उढ्र m. (-ढ्रः) 1 Water. 2 The China rose.
6687: उत् ind. An interjection of, 1 asking, (how, what?) 2 of deliberation, (either, or;) 3 of extreme doubt, (hey! what!) 4 Up, above. on, upon; see उद्.
6688: उत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sewn, woven. E. ऊय to sew, affix क्त. Ind. A particle of, 1 doubt, (what!) 2 of interrogation, (what, how?) 3 Of connection, (also, and;) 4 of deliberation, (either, or.) 5 It is also an expletive. E. ऊङ to sound, क्त aff.
6689: उतथ्य m. (-थ्यः) The name of a Muni, son of AṄGIRAS.
6690: उतथ्यानुज m. (-जः) A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of the planet Jupiter. E. उतथ्य and अनुज younger born; the younger brother of UTATHYA.
6691: उतथ्यानुजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) VṚHASPATI: see the preceding.
6692: उताहो ind. A particle implying, 1 deliberation, (either, or;) 2 asking, (how, what?) E. उत् and आहो meaning as before.
6693: उताहोस्वित् ind. A particle of doubt or deliberation.
6694: उत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) 1 Regretting, sad, sorrowful. 2 Absent, thinking of something else. 3 Wishing for, desirous of. m. (-त्कः) Opportunity, occasion. E. उद् up, away, and कन् aff.
6695: उत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Much, excessive. 2 Drunk, mad, furious. 3 Proud, haughty. 4 Uneven. 5 Difficult. 6 Superior, high. m. (-टः) 1 Intoxication, pride. 2 An elephant in rut. 3 Sara  grass, (Saccharum sara.) n. (-टं) 1 Woody cassia or its bark. 2 Sarsaparilla. E. उत् high, great, and कटच् aff.
6696: उत्कटुकासन n. (-नं) Sitting on the hams, squatting.
6697: उत्कण्ठा f. (-ण्ठा) Regretting, missing any thing or person. E. उत् much, कठि to be sad, अङ् and टाप् affs.
6698: उत्कण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Regretting, wishing or sorrowing for, distressed, sorrowful. f. (-ता) A woman whose husband or lover is absent. E. उद् much, कठि to be sad, affix क्त.
6699: उत्कता f. (-ता) 1 A plant with aromatic seeds, (Pothos officinalis, Rox.) see गजपिप्पली. 2 Regretting, sorrowing for. E. उत्क regretting, and तल् abstract aff.
6700: उत्कन्धरं ind. Bending back the neck. E. उद् up, कन्धर the neck.
6701: उत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 What lifts or raises. 2 What piles or heaps, what makes up. m. (-रः) A heap, a pile, a stack, &c. E. उत् up, and कर what makes, from कृ and ट or अप् aff.
6702: उत्करिका f. (-का) A sort of sweetmeat made with milk, treacle, and ghee. E. उत्कर and कन् added.
6703: उत्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating or belonging to a heap, &c. E. उत्कर and छ aff.
6704: उत्कर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting over or on. 2 Cutting to pieces. 3 Cutting off. E. उद् कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.
6705: उत्कर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) 1 Superior, eminent. 2 Much, excessive. 3 Attractive, drawing. m. (-र्षः) 1 Excellence, eminence. 2 Excess. 3 Increase. 4 Pulling, pulling up or to. E. उत् much, कृष to mark, घञ् aff.
6706: उत्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A porter, one who travels with a burden or load. m. (-लः) 1 A country in the south of India, part of Orissa. 2 A fowler, a bird-catcher. E. उत् and कल to go, अच् aff.
6707: उत्कलिका f. (-का) 1 Regretting, missing any thing or person. 2 A bud, an unblown flower. 3 A wave. 4 Wanton sportfulness, dalliance. E. उत्, कल to go, वुन and टाप् affs.
6708: उत्कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Regretting, grieving for. 2 Prosperous, rising, increasing. E. उत् up, and कल to go or count; part. affix क्त.
6709: उत्काका f. (-का) A cow calving every year. E. उत्क regretting, and अक to go, अच् and टाप् affs.
6710: उत्कार m. (-रः) 1 Winnowing corn. 2 Piling it up. E. उत् up, and कॄ to scatter, घञ् aff.
6711: उत्कारिका f. (-का) A poultice. E. उत् before कृ to make, causal form, वुन् aff.
6712: उत्कासन n. (-नं) Hemming, clearing the throat of mucus. E. उत् up, and कासन coughing.
6713: उत्कुञ्चिता f. (-ता) Kalonji, (Nigella Indica, Rox.) E. उत् up, कुञ्च to go crookedly, क्त affix, or with वुन् affix उत्कुञ्चिका.
6714: उत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Praising, celebrating. 2 Crying, proclaiming. E. उत् before कीर्त्त to praise, ल्युट् aff.
6715: उत्कीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Praised, renowned. 2 Proclaimed, promulgated. E. उत् aloud, कीर्त्त to praise, क्त aff.
6716: उत्कुट n. (-टं) Sleeping with the head erect. E. उत् neg. and कुट to be crooked, क aff.
6717: उत्कुण m. (-णः) A bug. E. उत् high, loud, and कुण to call, क affix; also उङ्कुण.
6718: उत्कूट m. (-टः) An umbrella or parasol. E. उत् priv. कूट to heat, क aff.
6719: उत्कूलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought to the bank or shore. E. उद्, कूल a bank, nominative verb, affix क्त.
6720: उत्कृति f. (-तिः) 1 Cutting up. 2 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of twenty-six syllables each. E. उत् and कृति another metre.
6721: उत्कृत्य ind. Having cut out, off, or up. E. उद् before कृत to cut, ल्यप् aff.
6722: उत्कृत्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being cut to pieces. E. उत् before कृत to cut, शानच् aff.
6723: उत्कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Excellent, eminent. 2 Superior, best. 3 Much, most, excessive. 4 Drawn, attracted. E. उत् before कृष to drag, क्त aff.
6724: उत्कृष्टता f. (-ता) Excellence, superiority, eminence. E. उत्कृष्ट with तल् added; also with त्व, उत्कृष्टत्वं.
6725: उत्कृष्टभूम m. (-मः) A good soil. E. उत्कृष्ट excellent, and भूमि earth, अण् aff.
6726: उत्कृष्टवेदन n. (-नं) The best or most respectable form of marriage. E. उत्कृ and वेदन marrying.
6727: उत्कोच mf. (-चः-चा) A bribe. E. उत्, कुच to be crooked, क aff.
6728: उत्कोचक m. (-कः) 1 The receiver of a bribe. 2 A bribe. E. उद्, कुच् to be crooked, वुन् affix or कन् added to the last.
6729: उत्क्रम m. (-मः) 1 Going up or out. 2 Progressive increase. 3 Going astray, acting improperly, deviation, transgression. E. उत् before क्रम to go, अच् aff.
6730: उत्क्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Going up or out. 2 Surpassing, exceeding. E. उत् before क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.
6731: उत्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Passed, surpassed, gone over or beyond. 2 Gone forth or out. 3 Trespassing, exceeding. E. उत् before क्रम to go, affix क्त.
6732: उत्क्रान्तिन् mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिनी-न्ति) Passing, passing away, gone, departed. E. उत्क्रान्त and इनि aff.
6733: उत्क्राम m. (-मः) 1 Opposition, contrariety. 2 Going, going above, surpassing. 3 Going from or out. 4 Deviating from propriety, transgressing. E. उत् out, क्रम to go, घञ् aff.
6734: उत्क्रामत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 1 Going over or above, surpassing. 2 Going out. E. उत् before क्रम to go, शतृ aff.
6735: उत्क्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Crying, speaking out or aloud, (who or what does so.) n. (-ष्टं) 1 Crying out, calling, exclaiming. 2 Conversation. E. उत्, क्रुश to cry, क्त aff.
6736: उत्क्रोश m. (-शः) 1 An osprey. 2 Clamour, proclamation. E. उन् loud, कुश to cry, affix घञ्.
6737: उत्क्लेद m. (-दः) Nausea, sickness. E. उत् and क्लेद moisture.
6738: उत्क्लेश m. (-शः) Nausea, sickness. E. उत् before क्लेश distress.
6739: उत्क्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Thrown upwards, tossed. 2 Thrown out, ejected. 3 Vomited. 4 Rejected, dismissed. m. (-प्तः) Thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.) E. उत् up, and क्षिप्त thrown; in the last sense it alludes to the intoxicating qualities of the plant.
6740: उत्क्षिप्तिका f. (-का) An ornament in the shape of a crescent worn in the upper part of the ear. E. उत् up, क्षिप to send, affix क्तिन्; to which कन् and टाप् are then added.
6741: उत्क्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Throwing or tossing up. 2 Throwing away. 3 Sending, dispatching. 4 Bringing up, vomiting. E. उत् before क्षिपि to throw, घञ् aff.
6742: उत्क्षेपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Throwing, a thrower, what or who elevates or raises. 2 Who sends or orders. m. (-कः) A stealer of clothes, &c. E. उत् before क्षिप to throw, ण्वुस्त aff.
6743: उत्क्षेपण n. (-णं) 1 A fan. 2 A kind of basket or bowl used for cleaning corn. 3 Throwing upwards, tossing. 4 Sending, sending away. 5 Vomiting. 6 Taking up. 7 A measure of sixteen Paṇas. E. उत् up, क्षिप to throw or send, ल्युट् aff.
6744: उत्खला f. (-ला) A kind of perfume: see मुरा. E. उत्, खल to gather, अच् and टाप् affs.
6745: उत्खात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eradicated, pulled up by the roots. 2 Destroyed, annihilated. E. उत् up, खन to dig, and क्त aff.
6746: उत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Wet, moistened. E. उन्द to wet, affix क्त.
6747: उत्तंस mn. (-सः) 1 An earring. 2 A crest. E. उत् much, and तसि a Sautra root, to ornament, affix अच्.
6748: उत्तप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Burnt, seared. 2 Bathed, washed. 3 Anxious, excited. n. (-प्तं) Dried flesh. E. उत् much, or in the last sense priv. and तप्त heated.
6749: उत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Chief, principal, first, best. 2 Greatest, highest. m. (-मः) 1 The third Menu, son of PRIYAVRATA. 2 The best kind of lover or hero. f. (-मा) 1 An excellent woman: one who is handsome, healthy, and affectionate. 2 A plant. (Asclepias rosea.) E. उत् much, तम to desire, affix अच्.
6750: उत्तमपुरुष m. (-षः) 1 The first person, (in grammer.) 2 An excellent man. E. उत्तम and पुरुष man.
6751: उत्तमफलिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Asclepias rosea, Rox.) see टुन्धिका. E. उत्तम best, फल fruit, इनि affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
6752: उत्तमर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) A creditor. E. उत्तम chief, and ऋण a debt.
6753: उत्तमर्णिक m. (-कः) A creditor. E. उत्तम, ऋण a debt, and ठक् aff.
6754: उत्तमर्णिन् m. (-र्णी) A creditor. E. उत्तम, ऋण a debt, इनि aff.
6755: उत्तमलाभ m. (-भः) Great profit, a double return. E. उत्तम and लाभ gain.
6756: उत्तमसंग्रह m. (-हः) Intriguing with another man's wife, addressing her privately, casting amorous looks, &c.
6757: उत्तमसाहस n. (-सं) 1 The highest of the three fixed mulcts or fines; a fine of 1,000 or of 80,000 Paṇas. 2 Capital punishment, branding, banishment, confiscation, mutilation and death. E. उत्तम the best or greatest, साहस infliction.
6758: उत्तमाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The head. E. उत्तम chief, and अङ्ग member.
6759: उत्तमार्द्ध्य n. (-र्द्ध्यं) The best half. E. उत्तम, अर्द्ध half, and यत् aff.
6760: उत्तमाह m. (-हः) A fine day, a lucky day. E. उत्तम best, अहन a day, ट aff.
6761: उत्तमोपपद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Best, good. E. उत्तम and उपपद secondary term, to whom or what the best term is applicable.
6762: उत्तमौजस् m. (-जाः) A proper name, one of the warriors of the Mahābhārata. E. उत्तम and ओजस् strength.
6763: उत्तम्भन n. (-नं) 1 Upholding, supporting, staying. 2 Stopping, arresting. E. उद् before ष्टभि to stop, ल्युट् aff.
6764: उत्तम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Upheld, supported. 2 Stopped, arrested. 3 Erect, (as the hair of the head,) standing on end. E. उत् before ष्टभि to stop, affix क्त.
6765: उत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Superior, high, lofty. 2 Northern. 3 Best, excellent. 4 (In composition) Fit, appertaining to. 5 Subsequent, posterior. n. (-रं) 1 An answer, a reply. 2 (In law) A defence, a rejoinder. 3 A consequence, a result. 4 Remainder, difference, (in arithmetic.) m. (-रः) 1 The son of VIRĀṬA. f. (-रा) 2 The wife of ABHIMANYU, the son of ARJUNA. 3 The north. E. उत् above, and तर from तृ to pass, affix अप्.
6766: उत्तरकाल m. (-लः) Future time. 2 Time reckoned from full moon to full moon. E. उत्तर subsequent, काल time.
6767: उत्तरकुरु mn. (-रुः-रु) Uttarakuru, the country about the north pole. E. उत्तर northern, and कुरु the northern part of the globe.
6768: उत्तरकोशला f. (-ला) The city Ayodhyā, the modern Oude. E. उत्तर north, कोशला a district so called.
6769: उत्तरक्रिया f. (-या) Obsequial ceremonies. E. उत्तर last, क्रिया rite.
6770: उत्तरङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Flooded, inundated, washed under by waves. n. (-ङ्गं) A wooden arch surmounting the door frame. E. उत्तर above, ग what goes, affix खश्; or उत् and तरङ्ग a wave.
6771: उत्तरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born subsequently or afterwards, posterity. E. उत्तर and ज born.
6772: उत्तरज्या f. (-ज्या) The versed sine of an arc. E. उत्तर and ज्या an arc.
6773: उत्तरण n. (-णं) 1 Crossing, rivers, &c. 2 Coming forth or out of, (especially water,) landing. E. उत् over, तरण passing.
6774: उत्तरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Crossing, going over. 2 Coming out of (water.) E. उत् before तृ to cross, शतृ aff.
6775: उत्तरतस् ind. 1 Northward. 2 Afterwards. 3 Behind. E. उत्तर and अतसुच् aff.
6776: उत्तरत्र ind. 1 After, subsequent. 2 Northward. E. उत्तर and त्रल् aff.
6777: उत्तरदायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Replying, answering. E. उत्तर and दायक a giver.
6778: उत्तरदिश् f. (-दिक्) The north quarter. E. उत्तर and दिश् region.
6779: उत्तरधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be done subsequently. E. उत्तर afterwards, धि to have, यत् aff.
6780: उत्तरपक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A demonstrated truth, a direct conclusion. 2 Course of argument, according to established truths. 3 Second part of an argument, reply, refutation. 4 The minor proposition in a syllogism. E. उत्तर subsequent, and पक्ष subject of an inference; also adding. क, उत्तरपक्षक.
6781: उत्तरपक्षता f. (-ता) 1 Conclusion, demonstration. 2 Replication, reply. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, उत्तरपक्षत्व.
6782: उत्तरपद n. (-दं) The last member of a compound word. E. उत्तर and पद word.
6783: उत्तरपदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to the last word or term. E. उत्तरपद and ठक् affix; also with छ added उत्तरपदकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं.)
6784: उत्तरपाद m. (-दः) A division of legal practice, that part which relates to the reply or defence. E. उत्तर a reply, and पाद a quarter; four divisions being admitted in every suit.
6785: उत्तरपुरुष m. (-षः) (In grammar,) The third person. E. उत्तर last, and पुरुष man.
6786: उत्तरप्रच्छद m. (-दः) A coverlid, a quilt. E. उत्तर and प्रच्छद what covers.
6787: उत्तरफाल्गुनी f. (-नी) The twelfth lunar mansion containing two stars, figured by a bed. E. उत्तर subsequent, and फाल्गुनी or फल्गुनी an asterism; hence it also occurs उत्तरफल्गुनी.
6788: उत्तरभाद्रपद् f. (-द्) The twenty-seventh lunar mansion, figured by a couch, and comprehending two stars, of which one is α Andromedae. E. उत्तर subsequent, and भाद्रपद properly the constellation; also with a final vowel, उत्तरभाद्रपद्रा.
6789: उत्तरमात्र n. (-त्रं) Any reply, some reply. E. उत्तर and मात्र only.
6790: उत्तररहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unable to reply, having no answer. E. उत्तर and रहित devoid of.
6791: उत्तरलक्षण n. (-णं) The indication of an actual reply. E. उत्तर and लक्षण mark.
6792: उत्तरवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) A small syringe, a urethra injection pipe. E. उत्तर best, वस्ति syringe.
6793: उत्तरवादिन् m. (-दी) A defendant, a replicant. उत्तर a reply, and वादिन् who speaks.
6794: उत्तरसंज्ञित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Designated in the reply, (a witness, &c.) E. उत्तर and संज्ञित named.
6795: उत्तरसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) Witness for the defence. E. उत्तर reply, and साक्षिन् a witness.
6796: उत्तरसाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Befriending, assisting, a help, a friend. 2 Who or what establishes a reply. E. उत्तर and साधक what accomplishes.
6797: उत्तरा ind. North, northerly, northward. E. उत्तर and आच् aff.
6798: उत्तरात् ind. Northward. E. उत्तर and आति aff.
6799: उत्तराधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Superior and inferior, higher and lower. E. उत्तर upper, अधर lower.
6800: उत्तराधिकार m. (-रः) Right to property, &c. in succession to another person, heirship, inheritance. E. उत्तर and अधिकार right.
6801: उत्तराधिकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) An heir, a claimant, subsequent to the death, &c. of the original owner. E. उत्तराधिकार and इनि aff.
6802: उत्तराधिकारिता f. (-ता) Right of succession. E. तल् added to उत्तराधिकारिन्; also with त्व, उत्तराधिकारित्व.
6803: उत्तरापथ m. (-थः) The north, a northern road or direction. E. उत्तर and पथिन् a road, the final of उत्तर lengthened.
6804: उत्तराभास m. (-सः) A false, indirect, or prevaricating reply, (in law.) E. उत्तर a defence, and आभास what resembles: apparently a defence, but not so in fact.
6805: उत्तराभासता f. (-ता) Inadequacy of a reply, the semblance without the reality. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, उत्तराभासत्वं.
6806: उत्तरायण n. (-णं) The period of the sun's progress to the north of the equator, the summer solstice. E. उत्तर the north, and अयन going, progress.
6807: उत्तराशा f. (-शा) The north. E. उत्तर and आशा region.
6808: उत्तराशाढा f. (-ढा) One of the lunar mansions, see उत्तराषाढा.
6809: उत्तराशापति m. (-तिः) A name of KUVERA. E. उत्तर, आशा a quarter, and पति a master; regent of the north.
