6810: उत्तराषाढा f. (-ढा) The twenty-first of the lunar mansions, figured by an elephant's tooth or a bed, and containing two stars, one of which is β in Sagittarius. E. उत्तर subsequent, and आषाढा the constellation; to distinguish it from asterism twentieth: see पूर्व्वाषाढा and आषाढा.
6811: उत्तरासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An upper and outer garment. E. उत्तर upper, आङ् prefixed to षञ्ज to surround, and घञ् aff.
6812: उत्तराहि ind. Northerly, from the north, implying distance. E. उत्तर and आहिच् aff.
6813: उत्तरीय n. (-यं) An upper or outer garment. E. उत्तर upper, and छ aff.
6814: उत्तरेण ind. Northward, posterior, subsequent. E. उत्तर with एनप् aff.
6815: उत्तरेद्युस् ind. A subsequent day, a day following to-morrow. E. उत्तर subsequent, and एद्यस् aff.
6816: उत्तरोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) More and more, further and further. &c. n. (-रं) 1 A rejoinder, a reply to an answer. 2 Excess, exceeding quantity or degree. 3 Succession, gradation, descending. E. उत्तर repeated.
6817: उत्तान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Shallow. 2 Sleeping supinely or with the face upwards. 3 Upright. 4 Concave. E. उत् upwards, तन to stretch, and घञ् aff.
6818: उत्तानक m. (-कः) A species of grass, (a cyperus:) see उच्चटा. E. उत् much, तन to spread, वुज् aff.
6819: उत्तानपाद m. (-दः) 1 A prince, son of SVAYAMBHU the Menu. 2 One of the stars of the little bear, (β Ursi minoris.)
6820: उत्तानपादज m. (-जः) A name of DHRUVA. E. उत्तानपाद, ज born: the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA.
6821: उत्तानशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) One who sleeps with the face upwards. mf. (-यः-या) An infant. E. उत्तान and शय who sleeps.
6822: उत्ताप m. (-पः) 1 Great heat. 2 Affliction, distress. 3 Anxiety, excitement. 4 Effort, energy. E. उत् before तप to be hot, घञ् aff.
6823: उत्तापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heated, made hot. 2 Pained, distressed. 3 Roused, excited. E. उत् before तप to be hot, causal form, क्त aff.
6824: उत्तार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent, pre-eminent. m. (-रः) 1 Vomiting. 2 Passing away, instability. 3 Ejecting, getting rid. of. E. उत् above, and तार who passes, from तृ and घञ् aff.
6825: उत्तारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Unsteady, changing, shaking. 2 Sick. E. उत्, तृ to go, णिनि affix; or उत्तार and इनि aff.
6826: उत्तार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be ejected, to be thrown up by vomiting. E. उत्, तृ to pass, ण्यत् aff.
6827: उत्ताल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Arduous, difficult. 3 Formidable. 4 Swift, speedy. 5 Lofty, tall. m. (-लः) An ape. E. उत् before तल् to fix, affix घञ्.
6828: उत्तिष्ठामान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Getting up, rising. 2 Increasing, augmenting. E. उत् before स्था to stay शानच् aff.
6829: उत्तीरम् ind. On the bank, ashore. E. उत् and तीर a bank.
6830: उत्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Crossed, traversed. 2 Loosed, liberated. 3 Thrown off. E. उत् over, तीर्ण crossed.
6831: उत्तुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) High, lofty, tall. E. उत् very, and तुङ्ग high.
6832: उत्तुङ्गता f. (-ता) Height, elevation. E. तल् added to the last, or with त्व, उत्तुङ्गत्वं.
6833: उत्तुण्डित n. (-तं) The head of a thorn, &c. which has entered the skin. E. उत् before तुडि to hurt, क्त aff.
6834: उत्तुष m. (-षः) Fried grain. E. उत् priv. and तुष husk.
6835: उत्तेजन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Sending, dispatching. 2 urging, driving. 3 Whetting, sharpening, polishing. 4 Exciting, animating. 5 An inspiring or exciting speech. E. उत् and तेजन giving light or energy.
6836: उत्तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Animated, excited. 3 Whetted, sharpened, polished. m. (-तः) Moving in the longe, sidling, one of a horse's five paces. E. उत्, निज to sharpen, and क्त aff.
6837: उत्तेरित n. (-तं) A horse's walk, one of his five paces in Hindu jockeyship. E. उत्, तृ to pass, क्त irr. aff.
6838: उत्तोलन n. (-नं) Lifting up, raising, elevating. E. उत् and तोलन weighing.
6839: उत्तोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Raised, lifted up. E. उत् before तुल to be equal, causal form, क्त aff.
6840: उत्त्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Abandoned, left. 2 Thrown, tossed. 3 Free from passion or affection. E. उत् and उत्त्यक्त abandoned.
6841: उत्त्याग m. (-गः) 1 Abandonment, quitting. 2 Throwing, throwing, up. 3 Secession from worldly feelings. E. उत् and त्याग leaving.
6842: उत्त्रास m. (-सः) Fear, terror. E. उत् much, and त्रास fear.
6843: उत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Standing or being up. E. उत् and स्था to stay, क aff.
6844: उत्थान n. (-नं) 1 Effort, exertion. 2 Manhood, manly exertion. 3 An army. 4 War, battle. 5 A book. 6 Joy, pleasure. 7 Rising, getting up. 8 A court yard. 9 A shed where sacrifices are made. 10 A term, a limit. 11 Evacuating by stool, &c. 12 Business of a family or realm, as the care of subjects or dependants. 13 Reflexion. 14 Proximate cause of disease. E. उत् above, स्था to stand, and ल्युट् affix, स is dropped.
6845: उत्थानैकादशी f. (-शी) The eleventh lunation of the light half of Kārttika or Agrahāyaṇa, when VIṢṆU rises from his sleep. E. उत्थान rising, एकादशी eleventh.
6846: उत्थापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Lifting, causing to get up, who or what raises, &c. 2 Exciting, animating. E. उत् before स्था to stay, causal form, वुन् aff.
6847: उत्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Raising, elevating. 2 Causing to rise or get up. 3 Exciting, instigating. 4 (In arithmetic) Substitution of a value. E. उत् and स्था causal form, affix ल्युट्.
6848: उत्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, lifted up, elevated. 2 Made to get up, aroused from a seat, a bed, &c. 3 Instigated. E. उत् and स्था causal form, क्त aff.
6849: उत्थाप्य ind. 1 Having raised or caused to rise. 2 Having roused or instigated. E. उत् before स्था to stay, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
6850: उत्थाय ind. 1 Having risen (from a seat, &c.) 2 Having risen (in rank, &c.) E. उत् before स्था to stand, affix ल्यप्.
6851: उत्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Endeavouring, striving. 3 Happened, occurring. 4 Increasing, advancing, rising. 5 High, risen or rising as from a seat, &c. E. उत् up, स्था to stay, and क्त aff.
6852: उत्थिताङ्गुलि m. (-लिः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. E. उत्थित increased, and अङ्गुलि a finger.
6853: उत्थिति f. (-तिः) Elevation, rising up. E. उत् before स्था to stay, क्तिन् aff.
6854: उत्पत m. (-तः) 1 A bird. 2 Going upwards, or up. E. उत् up, and पत who goes, from पत to go, and अच् aff.
6855: उत्पतन n. (-नं) 1 Birth, production. 2 Going up, rising, ascending. E. उत्, पत to go, and ल्युट् aff.
6856: उत्पतितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Jumping up, rising, going upwards. E. उत्पत to rise, and तृच् aff.
6857: उत्पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Risen, ascended. E. उत् up, पत to go, क्त aff.
6858: उत्पतिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Rising, jumping up. E. उत्पत and इष्णुच् aff.
6859: उत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Producing as an effect or result, giving rise to or generating as a consequence. 3 Production in general. E. उत् up, पत to go, and क्तिन् aff.
6860: उत्पत्तिप्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Purport, meaning. 2 Production by the joint operation of cause and effect. E. उत्पत्ति and प्रयोग act.
6861: उत्पत्तिव्यञ्जक m. (-कः) A type of birth, (as investiture.) E. उत्पत्ति and व्यञ्जक figurative indication.
6862: उत्पथ m. (-थः) Error, bad way, evil. E. उत् from, पथ for पषिन a path.
6863: उत्पथम् ind. Astray, on the wrong road. E. उत् from, पथिन a path, अ aff.
6864: उत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Known, ascertained. 3 Risen, gone up. 4 Acquired, gained. 5 Effected, accomplished. 6 Occurred, happened. E. उत्, पद to go, क्त aff.
6865: उत्पन्नतन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) Having progeny. E. उत्पन्न and तन्तु line; descendants.
6866: उत्पल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Thin. n. (-लं) 1 A blue lotus, (Nymphaea caerulea.) 2 A plant, (a Costus:) see कुष्ठ. 3 A water lily in general. 4 A flower in general. f. (-ली) A kind of cake made with unwinnowed corn. E. उत् up, पल to go or grow, अच् affix, and fem. टाप् or ङीष्.
6867: उत्पलगन्धिक n. (-कं) A species of sandal of the colour of brass, and very fragrant. E. उत्पल the lotus, गन्ध a smell, कन् affix of similitude.
6868: उत्पलचक्षुस् mfn. (-क्षूः-क्षूः-क्षूः) Lotus-eyed, fine-eyed. E. उत्पल and चक्षुस् the eye.
6869: उत्पलपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The leaf of the lotus. 2 The impression of a female nail. 3 The Tilaka or mark on the forehead, made with sandal, &c. by the Hindus. 4 A broad bladed knife or lancet. E. उत्पल a lotus, and पत्र a leaf; similarly shaped, &c. also कन् added उत्पलपत्रक.
6870: उत्पलशारिवा f. (-वा) A plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. उत्पल a flower, शारिवा irregular deriv. of शृ to harm: whose flower injures or destroys, (disease.)
6871: उत्पलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Lotus-like, resembling a lotus. E. उत्पल and आङ् before भा to shine, ड aff.
6872: उत्पलिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. उत्पल a lotus, इनि affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
6873: उत्पवन n. (-नं) 1 Straining liquids before using for domestic or religious purposes. 2 Sprinkling ghee or other fluids on the sacrificial fire, with two blades of Kusa grass, the ends of which are held in either hand, and the centre dipped into the liquid, which is then dropped upon the fire. E. उत् above, &c. पुङ् to purify, affix ल्युट्.
6874: उत्पश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Looking up or upwards. E. उत् up, and ग्रश्य looking, irr. formative, from दृश to see.
6875: उत्पाट m. (-टः) 1 Pulling up by the roots. 2 Destroying. E. उत् up, पट to go, causal form, घञ् aff.
6876: उत्पाटन n. (-नं) 1 Eradicating, pulling up by the roots. 2 Destroying. E. उत् before पट to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
6877: उत्पाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eradicated, pulled up by the roots. E. उत् up, or out, पट to go, in the causal form, and क्त aff.
6878: उत्पाटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Eradicating, extirpating. E. उत्पाट and इनि aff.
6879: उत्पात m. (-तः) 1 A portent, some natural prodigy or phoenomenon. 2 Any public calamity, as an eclipse, a meteor, an earthquake, &c. E. उत् accidentally, पत to happen, and घञ् aff.
6880: उत्पातवात m. (-तः) A whirlwind, a hurricane. E. उत्पात a portent, and वात wind.
6881: उत्पादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A producer, a generator. 2 What gives origin or production to, causative. m. (-कः) A fabulous animal with eight legs: written also उत्यातकः. n. (-कं) Origin, cause. f. (-दिका) 1 A white ant, (termes.) 2 A potherb, (Hilancha repens.) 3 Also, Basella, (rubra or lucida.) E. उत् much, पद a foot, or पद to go, in the causal, and वुन् aff.
6882: उत्पादन n. (-नं) Producing, generating, begetting. E. उत् before पद to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
6883: उत्पादशयन mfn. (-नः) The Francoline partridge. E. उत् upon, पाद a foot, शयन sleeping.
6884: उत्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Produced, effected. 2 Generated, begotten. E. उत् before पद to go, causal form क्त aff.
6885: उत्पाद्य ind. 1 Having begotten. 2 Having produced, having inspired. E. उत् before पद to go, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
6886: उत्पाली f. (-ली) Health. E. उत् before, पल to preserve, अञ् and ङीष् affs.
6887: उत्पाव m. (-वः) Purifying ghee, &c. see उत्पवन. E. उत् before पू to make pure, घञ् aff.
6888: उत्पिञ्जर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Uncaged, unconfined. E. उत् out of, पिञ्चर a cage; also उत्पिञ्जल, ल being substituted for र.
6889: उत्पिञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Confounded, confused. 2 Uncaged. E. see the last.
6890: उत्पित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Desirous of going, going, proceeding. E. उत् before पत to go, desiderative form, उ aff.
6891: उत्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ground, rubbed. n. (-ष्टं) A disease, a grating of the bones of the joints upon each other. E. उत and पिष्ट ground.
6892: उत्पीड m. (-डः) Froth. E. उत् on, पीड to go, क aff.
6893: उत्प्रासन n. (-नं) 1 Ridicule, derision. 2 Hurling, throwing afar. E. उत् and प्र before अस to throw, affix ल्युट्
6894: उत्प्रेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Indifference, carelessness. 2 Ironical comparison. 3 Comparison in general, poetical or rhetorical. E. उत् and प्र prefixed to ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.
6895: उत्प्लवन n. (-नं) Taking up oil or ghee when it has been defiled in any way, by dipping a blade of Kusa grass into it, and dropping it from them upon the fire. 2 Jumping, springing upon. E. उत् over, प्लवन jumping, &c.
6896: उत्प्लवा f. (-वा) A boat. E. उत् over, प्लु to go, अच् and टाप् aff.
6897: उत्प्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Jumped upon, approached suddenly. E. उत् before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
6898: उत्प्लुव्य ind. Having sprung or jumped upon. E. उत् before प्लु to go, ल्यप् aff.
6899: उत्फल n. (-लं) Excellent fruit. E. उत् and फल fruit.
6900: उत्फाल m. (-लः) A jump, a leap. E. उत् and स्फुल to move, affix घञ् the vowel and final changed.
6901: उत्फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Blown, as a flower. 2 Swollen, encreased in bulk. 3 Sleeping supinely. E. उत् and फुल्ल blown.
6902: उत्स m. (-त्सः) A fountain, a spring. E. उन्द to wet, and स Uṇādi aff.
6903: उत्सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The haunch or part above the hip. 2 The acclivity or slope of a hill. 3 Association, union. 4 Embrace. 5 The bottom or deep part of an ulcer. E. उत्, षञ्ज to embrace, affix घञ्.
6904: उत्सङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Associated, combined, joined. E. उत् षञ्ज before to be joined with, क्त aff.
6905: उत्सङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) Associating or combining with, an associate, a partner. m. (-ङ्गी) An ulcer, a deep sore. f. (-ङ्गिनी) Pimples on the inner edge of the eyelids. E. उत्युङ्ग and इनि aff.
6906: उत्सन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Destroyed. overturned. 2 Decayed, in ruins. 3 Risen, increased. E. उत् before षद to go, affix क्त.
6907: उत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Abandoning, quitting. 2 Resigning, retiring from. 3 Giving, donation. 4 Any precept or rule. 5 Presentation of any thing promised to a god or Brahman, with suitable ceremonies. 6 A particular ceremony preparatory to a course of the Vedas. 7 Dejection, excretion, voiding by stool, &c. E. उत् before सृज to quit, to leave, घञ् aff.
6908: उत्सर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Abandoning, leaving, &c. E. उत् before सृज to leave, and ल्युट् affix: see the preceding.
6909: उत्सर्पिणी f. (-णी) A Jaina division of time, a long period described as 10 crores of crores of oceans of years; this period alternates with one of similar duration: see अवसर्पिणी. E. उत् much, सृप to go, णिनि and ङीष् affs.
6910: उत्सर्प्प m. (-र्प्पः) 1 Going or gliding upwards. 2 Swelling, heaving. E. उत् before सृप to go, घञ् aff.
6911: उत्सर्प्पण n. (-णं) 1 Gliding upward. 2 Swelling, heaving. E. उत् before सृप to go gently, ल्युट् aff.
6912: उत्सर्प्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heaving, heaved, undulating. 2 Gliding or going upwards. E. उत् before सृप to go, क्त aff.
6913: उत्सर्प्पिन् mfn. (-र्प्पी-र्प्पिणी-र्प्पि) 1 What glides upwards, 2 Rising gently, heaving, &c. E. उत्सर्प्प and इनि aff.
6914: उत्सर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A cow fit to take the bull. E. उत्, सृ to go, and ण्यत् aff.
6915: उत्सव m. (-वः) 1 A festival, a jubilee. 2 Height, elevation. 3 Impatience. 4 Wish. 5 Passion, wrath. E. उत्, षू to bear, to bring forth, affix अच्; happiness, &c. is produced by it.
6916: उत्सादन n. (-नं) 1 Going up, ascending, rising. 2 Raising, elevating. 3 Destroying, overturning. 4 Cleaning the person with perfumes. 5 Rubbing or chafing the limbs. 6 Ploughing a field twice or thoroughly. 7 Healing a sore, causing it to fill up. E. उत् much, षद to destroy, in the causal form, affix ल्युट्.
6917: उत्सादनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be gone up or ascended. 2 To be effected. 3 To be destroyed. n. (-यं) Any application to a sore producing granulations. E. उत् before षद to go, causal form, affix अनीयर्; also उत्सादितव्य and उत्साद्य.
6918: उत्सादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, ascended. 2 Raised, elevated. 3 Destroyed. 4 Cleansed, purified with oil, perfumes, &c. E. as above, affix क्त.
6919: उत्सारक m. (-कः) 1 A doorkeeper, a porter. 2 A guard, a guardian. E. उत्, सृ to go, in the causal, and वुन् aff.
6920: उत्सारण n. (-णं) 1 Removing, keeping at a distance. 2 Moving, causing to move. E. उत्, सृ to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
6921: उत्साह m. (-हः) 1 Effort, perseverance, strenuous and continued exertion. 2 A thread. 3 Happiness. 4 Firmness, fortitude. E. उत् much, सह to bear, to be able, affix घञ्.
6922: उत्साहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Active, energetic, persevering. E. उत्साह and वतुप् aff.
6923: उत्साहवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Heroism. E. उत्साह exertion, and वर्द्धन increasing, from वृध and ल्युट् aff.
6924: उत्साहसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Active, persevering. E. उत्साह and सम्पन्न effected.
6925: उत्साहिन् mf. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Active, persevering. E. उत्साह and इनि aff.
6926: उत्सिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Haughty, proud, rude. 2 Elevated, raised. 3 Enlarged, increased. 4 Sprinkled. 5 Disordered, disturbed (in mind, &c.) m. (-क्तः) A king's wrestler. E. उत्, षिच to sprinkle, and क्त aff.
6927: उत्सिच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Augmenting, growing. 2 Sprinkling. E. उत्, षिच to sprinkle, शानच् aff.
6928: उत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Zealously active, making exertions for a gratifying object. 2 Regretting, missing, sorrowing for. 3 Fond of, attached to. E. उत् much, सु to produce, क्विप् and कन् affs.
6929: उत्सुकता f. (-ता) 1 Sorrow, regret. 2 Attachment, affection. E. उत्सुक and तल् affix; also with त्व, affix उत्सुकत्वं.
6930: उत्सूत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) 1 Loose, detached, unstrung. 2 Irregular, out of rule. E. उत् before सूत्र a thread, &c.
6931: उत्सूर m. (-रः) Evening, twilight. E. उत् priv. सूर the sun; sunset.
6932: उत्सृज्य ind. Having quitted. E. उत् before सृज to leave, ल्यप् aff.
6933: उत्सृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Left, abandoned. 2 Given, presented. 3 Cast into or upon. E. उत् and सृज to leave, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
6934: उत्सृष्टपशु m. (-शुः) A bull set at liberty upon particular occasions, as a marriage, &c. and allowed to go about at will. E. उत्सृष्ट loosed, and पशु an animal.
6935: उत्सेक m. (-कः) 1 Increase, enlargement. 2 Pride, haughtiness. 3 Casting water, &c. on any thing, sprinkling. 4 Flying out or up, foaming or spouting over, showering. E. उत् on, षिच् to sprinkle, घञ् aff.
6936: उत्सेचन n. (-नं) 1 Showering or spouting upwards. 2 Boiling or foaming over. E. उत् and सेचन sprinkling.
6937: उत्सेध m. (-धः) 1 Height, elevation. 2 The body. 3 Fatness, obesity. 4 Intumescence. 5 Thickness. n. (-धं) Killing, slaughter. E. उत् up, षिध to go, affix घञ्.
6938: उत्स्मय m. (-यः) A smile. E. उत् and स्मय a smile.
6939: उद् or उत् ind. A particle and prefix to words implying, 1 Superiority in degree; (over, above.) 2 In place, (Over, above, on, upon.) 3 Pride: 4 Publicity: 5 Power: 6 Separation, disjunction, (off, from, out of:) 7 Emancipation: 8 Binding. 9 Helplessness, weakness.
6940: उद n. (-दं) Water. E. उन्द to wet, deriv. irr.: see उदक.
6941: उदक् ind. Northern, upper, subsequent: see उदच.
6942: उदक n. (-कं) Water. E. उन्द to wet, deriv. irr.; this is sometimes considered as two words, उद and क, each having the same meaning.
6943: उदकक्रिया f. (-या) Presentation of water to ancestors as far as the fourteenth degree. E. उदक and क्रिया rite; so उदकर्म्म, &c.
6944: उदकद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) A giver of water, yielding water, offering water to the manes, &c. m. (-दः) An heir, a near kinsman. E. उदक and द who gives; also उदकदातृ and उदकदायिन्.
6945: उदकदान n. (-नं) Gift of water, especially to the manes, as a religious or obsequial rite. E. उदक and दान giving.
6946: उदकदायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Giving water. m. (-यी) An heir or kinsman, one who presents libations of water. E. उदक and दायिन् who gives.
6947: उदकपूर्व्वकम् ind. Pouring water on the hand as preparatory to or confirmatory of a gift or promise. E. उदक and पूर्व्वक prior.
6948: उदकप्रतीकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Watery, fluid like water. E. उदक and प्रतीकाश what resembles.
6949: उदकमेह m. (-हः) A variety of Diabetes, passing watery urine. E. उदक and मेह urining.
6950: उदकशाक n. (-कं) Any aquatic herb. E. उदक and शाक a potherb.
6951: उदकस्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः) 1 Touching different parts of the body with water. 2 Touching water in confirmation of a promise, &c. E. उदक and स्पर्श touch.
6952: उदकाधार m. (-रः) A reservoir, a cistern, a well, &c. E. उदक and आधार receptacle.
6953: उदकार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Thirsty, desirous of water. E. उदक and अर्थिन् who seeks.
6954: उदकीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्जक. E. उद water, and कॄ to scatter, अच् aff.
6955: उदकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A water jar. E. उद and कुम्भ a jar; also उदककुम्भ.
6956: उदकोदञ्जन m. (-नः) A water jar. E. उकक and उदञ्चन what goes up.
6957: उदकोदर n. (-रं) Dropsy. E. उदक् and उदर the belly.
6958: उदक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Gone up, risen, ascended. E. उद before अञ्च to go, क्त aff.
6959: उदक्या f. (-क्या) A woman in her courses. E. उदक water, and यत् affix of fitness: requiring water for purification.
6960: उदगद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himālaya mountains on the north of Hindustan. E. उदक north, and अद्रि a mountain.
6961: उदगयन n. (-नं) The sun's progress north of the equator: see उत्तरायण. E. उदक् north, and अयन going.
6962: उदग्भूम m. (-मः) Good soil. E. उदक् north, भूमि earth, अण् aff.
6963: उदग्भूमि m. (मिः) Fertile soil: see the preceding.
6964: उदग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 High, tall. 2 Large, vast. 3 Projecting. 4 Pointing upwards. 5 Fierce, intense. E. उत् up, and अग्र end, point.
6965: उदग्रदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Large toothed. m. (-दन्) An elephant with a large tusk. E. उदग्र large, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
6966: उदङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खा-खं) Facing the north. E. उदच् and मुख face.
6967: उदच् or उदञ्च् mfn. (उदङ् उदीची उदक्) 1 North, northern. 2 Upper, upwards. 3 Subsequent, posterior. f. (-दीची) The north. E. उद् up, अञ्च to go, affix क्विप्; the neuter is used as a particle: see उदक्; the noun is irregular.
6968: उदज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, watery, produced in or by water. m. (-जः) Driving cattle. E. उद water, and ज born, or उद् up, and अज to go, affix अप्.
6969: उदञ्चन n. (-नं) 1 A lid or cover. 2 Directing or throwing upwards. 3 Rising, ascending. E. उद above, अञ्च to go, and ल्युट् aff.
6970: उदञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown up, tossed. 2 Worshipped. E. उद् up, अञ्च to go or worship, affix क्त.
6971: उदण्डपाल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of fish. 2 A sort of snake. E. उद् much, अण्ड an egg, and पाल what nourishes; laying many eggs at once.
6972: उदधि m. (-धिः) 1 The ocean. 2 A water jar. 2 A cloud. E. उद् water, and धि having, from धा, with कि aff.
6973: उदधिक्रम् m. (-क्राः) A voyager, a mariner. E. उदधि, क्रम to go, विट् aff.
6974: उदधिमल m. (-लः) Cuttle fish bone. E. उदधि and मल soil.
6975: उदधिमेखला f. (-ला) The earth. E. उदधि and मेखला a girdle.
6976: उदधिसुता f. (-ता) 1 LAKṢMĪ. 2 Dvārakā, the capital of KṚṢṆA. E. उदधि the ocean, and सुता daughter.
6977: उदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A pure and virtuous man. 2 Tidings, intelligence. 3 One who gets a livelihood by a trade, &c. E. उद् disjunctive, and अन्त end, term.
6978: उदन्तक m. (-कः) News, tidings, intelligence. E. कन् added to the preceding.
6979: उदन्तिका f. (-का) Satisfaction, satiety. E. उद् complete, अन्त end, कन् aff.
6980: उदन्या f. (-न्या) Thirst. E. उदक् water, क्यच् affix, the final क is changed to न.
6981: उदन्वत् m. (-न्वान्) The ocean. E. उद् water, and मतुप् possessive aff.
6982: उदपात्र n. (-त्रं) A water cup, a ewer. E. उद् and पात्र a vessel.
6983: उदपान mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A well. E. उद् water, पा to drink, and ल्युट् affix; the place where water is drunk.
6984: उदपेष n. (-षं) A paste, any thing ground with water. E. उद and पेष grinding.
6985: उदभार m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 A water carrier. E. उद and भार a load.
6986: उदमन्थ m. (-न्थः) Barley water. E. उद and मन्थ scum; also, उदकमन्थ.
6987: उदमेघ m. (-घः) A watery cloud. E. उद and मेघ a cloud.
6988: उदय m. (-यः) 1 The rising of the sun and planets in general. 2 The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to rise. 3 Rising, ascending. 4 Light, splendor. 5 Prosperity, good fortune. 6 Creation, the rising of the world. 7 (In law) Income. E. उद् up, इण to go, and अच् aff.
6989: उदयन n. (-नं) Rising, ascending. m. (-नः) 1 A name of AGASTYA: see अगस्त्य. 2 The name of a sovereign, king of Kauśāmbī, and hero of the Vāsavadattā, a dramatic poem; also, of part of the Vṛhat Kathā. E. उद् above, इण to go, and ल्युट् aff.
6990: उदयपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The eastern mountain behind which the sun rises. E. उदप and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as उदयगिरिः, उदयशैलः, उदयाचलः, उदयाद्रिः, &c.
6991: उदयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Rising, ascending. 2 Prosperous, flourishing. E. उदय and इनि aff.
6992: उदर n. (-रं) 1 The belly. 2 War. 3 Any morbid abdominal affection, as liver, spleen, &c. f. (-री) Enlargement of the abdomen from dropsy or flatulency. E. उद् up, ऋ to go, अप् affix; what goes up or swells with food, slaughter, &c. or उद् prefixed to दृ to burst, and अच् or अल् Uṇādi aff.
6993: उदरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Rubbing the belly, &c. 2 Abdominal. E. उदर and कन् aff.
6994: उदरग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) The spleen, (the disease; a chronic affection of this organ not uncommon in India.) E. उदर abdomen, and ग्रन्थि a knot.
6995: उदरत्राण n. (-णं) 1 A cuirass, armour covering the front. 2 A girth, a belly band. E. उदर the belly, and त्राण what preserves: see उदरस्त्राण.
6996: उदरथि m. (-थिः) 1 The ocean. 2 The sun. E. उद् freely, ऋ to go, and अथिर् Uṇādi aff.
6997: उदरपिशाच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) A glutton, voracious, one who devours every thing, flesh, fish, &c. E. उदर and पिशाच a demon, who is a devil for his belly.
6998: उदरम्भरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Selfishly voracious, gluttonous. E. उदर, भृ to nourish, इन् affix, and मुम् is inserted.
6999: उदरशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sleeping on the face or belly. E. उदर and शय who sleeps.
7000: उदरामय m. (-यः) Dysentery, diarrhoea. E. उदर the belly, and आमय sickness.
7001: उदरावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The navel. E. उदर and आवर्त्त whirl.
7002: उदरावेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Tape worm. E. उदर and आवेष्ट what surrounds.
7003: उदरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Fat, corpulent. 2 Abdominal. f. (-णी) A pregnant woman. E. उदर the belly, इनि possessive aff.
7004: उदरिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fat, corpulent. E. उदर to belly, and इलच् aff.
7005: उदर्क m. (-कः) 1 Future or remote consequence. 2 Future time. 3 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa:) see मदन. E. उद् much, ऋच् to praise, affix घञ्.
7006: उदर्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Luminous and ascending. m. (-र्च्चिः) 1 A name of VAHNI or fire. 2 ŚIVA. 3 KANDARPA. E. उद upwards, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
7007: उदर्द m. (-र्दः) Erysipelas. E. उद् up, अर्द to go, अच् aff.
7008: उदर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) Scarlet fever. E. उद and ऋध to increase, अच् aff.
7009: उदलावणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Salted, prepared with brine. E. उद water, लवण salt, and ठक् aff.
7010: उदवज्र m. (-ज्रः) A thunderbolt of water, a water spout. E. उद and वज्र a thunderbolt.
7011: उदवसित n. (-तं) A house. E. उद water, and वसित covered, defended, deriv. irr.
7012: उदवास n. (-सं) 1 A house in the margin of a stream or pond. 2 A marine grotto, &c. E. उद् and वास a bode.
7013: उदवाहन m. (-नः) 1 A cloud. 2 Any water vessel. E. उद and वाहन vehicle.
7014: उदविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A drop of water. E. उद and विन्दु a drop.
7015: उदश्वित् n. (-श्वित्) Buttermilk, with an equal proportion of water. E. उद water, श्वि to increase, affixes क्विप् and तुक्.
7016: उदस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Cast, thrown. 2 Expelled, cast out. 3 Cast up. 4 Humbled, shamed. 5 Scattered. 6 Removed. E. उद् before अस to throw, क्त aff.
7017: उदस्थाली f. (-ली) A caldron, a kettle. E. उद and स्थाली a pot.
7018: उदस्य ind. 1 Having taken pains, made an effort, &c. 2 Having thrown, having cast up or tossed. 3 Having scattered. 4 Having expelled. E. उद् before अस to be or throw, ल्यप् aff.
7019: उदहार m. (-रः) 1 A water carrier. 2 A cloud. E. उद् and हार who takes.
7020: उदाज m. (-जः) Commanding, directing bodies of men. E. उद before अज to go, घञ् aff.
7021: उदात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Generous, gentle and bountiful. 2 Giving, a donor. 3 Great, illustrious. 4 Dear, beloved. 5 Accented. m. (-त्तः) 1 The acute accent, a high or sharp tone. 2 Gift, donation. 3 A musical instrument, a large drum. 4 An ornament, (in rhetoric.) E. उद high, up, and आत्त pronounced, sounded; or from दा, to give or have, with आङ् prefixed, affix क्तः see अनुदात्त.
7022: उदान m. (-नः) 1 One of the five vital airs, that which rises up the throat and passes into the head. 2 The navel. 3 A snake. 4 An eye-lash. E. उद् above, आङ् prefixed to अण् to breathe, to be, affix घञ्.
7023: उदार mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Generous, liberal, munificent. 2 Great. 3 Unperplexed. 4 Gentle. 5 Upright, honest, sincere. 6 Eloquent. 7 Proper, right. E. उद् well, आङ् prefixed to ऋ to go, and अप् affixed.
7024: उदारचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) High-minded, magnanimous. E. उदार and चेतस् the mind.
7025: उदारधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Wise, sagacious, noble-minded. E. उदार and धी Understanding.
7026: उदावत्सर m. (-रः) A year, one of the five sorts of years astrologically considered. E. उद् and आङ् before वत्सर a year.
7027: उदावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A disease of the bowels, iliac passion. f. (-ता) Difficult menstruation. E. उद् upper, आवर्त्त abode.
7028: उदास m. (-सः) 1 Throwing or directing upwards. 2 Elevation, being above or over. 3 A stoic, a philosopher. 4 Stoicism. mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Indifferent, unconcerned, apathetic. E. उद् and आस who casts.
7029: उदासितृ mfn. (-ता-त्रै-तृ) Indifferent, disregarding, void of concern or affection. E. उद् before आस to cast, तृच् aff.
7030: उदासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Indifferent, disregarding, m. (-सी) A stoic, a philosopher, one who has no passion nor affection for any thing: in popular acceptation, a religious mendicant in general, or one of a particular order. E. उदास and इमि aff.
7031: उदासीन mfn. (नः-ना-नं) 1 Indifferent, free from affection. (In law) One not involved in the dispute. m. (-नः) A stranger, a neutral, a common acquaintance, a person neither a friend nor a foe. E. उद् above, आसीन seated.
7032: उदास्थित m. (-तः) 1 A spy, an emissary. 2 A doorkeeper. 3 A superintendent. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set over. E. उद् over, आङ् before स्था to stay, affix क्त.
7033: उदाहरण n. (-णं) 1 An example or illustration, an apposite argument, one of five modes of logical reasoning. 2 Declaring, saying. E. उद् over, आङ् before हृ to convey, and ल्युट् affix, or with घञ् affix उदाहार.
7035: उदाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Called, named, entitled. 2 Said. 3 Illustrated. E. उद् and आङ् before हृ to take, affix क्त.
7036: उदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, spoken. 2 Bound, tied. 3 Risen, ascended. 4 Grown, augmented. 5 Born, produced. 6 Incurred, experienced. 7 High, tall, lofty. E. वद to speak, and क्त affix; or उद् up, and इत gone, past part. of इण to go.
7037: उदितोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well acquainted with the Śāstras. E. उदित said, (by law and religion,) and उदित risen, &c. eminent.
7038: उदीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Seeing, beholding. 2 Looking up. E. उद् and ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
7039: उदीक्ष्य ind. Having seen. E. उद् and ईक्ष to see, ल्यप् aff.
7040: उदीचि f. (-ची) The north: see उदच.
7041: उदीचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Northern. E. उदच north, खः aff.
7042: उदीच्य m. (-च्यः) The country to the north and west of the river Sarasvatī, the northern region. n. (-च्यं) A perfume: see वाला. E. उदीची the north, and यत् aff.
7043: उदीरण n. (-णं) Speaking, saying. E. उद् up, out, ईर to go, and ल्युट् aff.
7044: उदीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, uttered. E. उद् and ईर to go, affix क्त.
7045: उदीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Generous, great, excellent. 2 Intense. E. उद् above, ऋ to go, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
7046: उदीर्णवेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Impetuous (as a torrent), violent. E. उदीर्ण and वेग speed.
7047: उदीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be spoken. E. उद before ईर to go, यत् aff.
7048: उदीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Speaking. 2 Spoken. E. उद् before ईर to go, शानच् aff.
7049: उदुम्बर m. (-रः) 1 The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.) 2 A kind of leprosy. 3 A threshold. 4 A eunuch. n. (-रं) Copper; see उडुम्बर, it is also written ऊडुम्बर.
7050: उदुम्बरपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant: see दन्तिका; also उडुम्बरपर्णी and ऊडुम्बरपर्णी.
7051: उदूखल n. (-लं) A gum-resin, Bdellium. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 A wooden mortar used for freeing rice from the husk, by pounding it with a pestle. 2 Any mortar. E. उदू for उद् up, and खल what goes, affix अच्; also उडूखल and उलूखल.
7052: उदूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Married. 2 Coarse, gross, heavy. 3 Material, substantial. 4 Much, exceeding. E. उद् up, वह to bear, and क्त affix, deriv. irr.
7053: उदेजय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Shaking, making tremble. E. उद before एज to tremble, श aff.
7054: उद्ग r. 6th cl. (उद्गति) To cast off or quit.
7055: उद्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, ascended. 2 Vomited, cast up. 3 Departed, gone. 4 Proceeded forth or from. E. उद् up, and गत gone.
7056: उद्गता f. (-ता) A stanza of four lines, with ten syllables in the three first, and thirteen in the last.
7057: उद्गतासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Deceased, dead. E. उद्गत gone, असु breath.
7058: उद्गति f. (-तिः) 1 Going up, rising, ascending. 2 Bringing up, vomiting. E. उद् and गति going.
7059: उद्गम m. (-मः) 1 Going up, rising, ascending. 2 Bringing up, vomiting; also उद्गमनं. E. उद् up, गम or गमन going.
7060: उद्गमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be gone up, or ascended. n. (-यं) A pair of bleached clothes. E. उद् up, गम to go, and अनीयर् aff.
7061: उद्गाढ n. adv. (-ढं) or adj. mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Much, excessive. E. उद् excess, and गाढ much.
7062: उद्गातृ m. (-ता) A reciter of the prayers, &c. of the Sāma Veda. E. उद् up, and गातृ who sings, (the prayers being chaunted,) from गै to sing, and तृच् aff.
7063: उद्गाथा f. (-था) A variety of the Arya measure, the same as the Gīti, a stanza of four lines containing alternately 12 and 18 instants.
7064: उद्गार m. (-रः) 1 Vomiting. 2 Ejecting any thing from the mouth. 3 Sound. 4 Speaking in the throat. E. उद् up, गॄ to vomit, &c. घञ् aff.
7065: उद्गिरण n. (-णं) 1 Vomiting. 2 Ejecting any thing, as saliva, &c. from the mouth. E. उद् before गॄ to vomit, ल्युट् affix; also उद्गारणं.
7066: उद्गीति f. (-तिः) A variety of the Arya metre, a verse of four lines containing 12, 15--12, and 14 feet.
7067: उद्गीथ m. (-थः) 1 A portion of the Sāma Veda. 2 Designation of the triliteral name of God. 3 Chaunting the Sāma Veda. E. उद् up, aloud, गै to sing, and थक् Uṇādi aff.
7068: उद्गुर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Raised, lifted, held up. 2 Erected. 3 Excited. E. उद् up, गुर to make effort, irr. participle past.
7069: उद्ग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Taking up. 2 An object that may be accomplished by religious or other acts. E. उद् before ग्रह to take, अच् aff.
7070: उद्ग्रहण n. (-णं) Taking up, lifting up. E. उद and ग्रहण taking.
7071: उद्ग्राह m. (-हः) 1 Taking up. 2 Replying in argument. E. उद् up, ग्रह to take, and घञ् aff.
7072: उद्ग्राहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Excellent, exalted. 2 Bound, tied. 3 Seized. 4 Deposited, delivered. 5 Taken or lifted up. 5 Recalled, remembered. E. उद् up, and ग्राहित taken.
7073: उद्घ m. (-द्घः) Excellence, happiness. E. उद much, घण to shine, affix ड or उद before हन to strike, अप् aff. and the final rejected.
7074: उद्घन m. (-नः) A carpenter's work-bench, a plank on which he works. E. उद् above, हन to injure, अप् affix, ह changed to घ.
7075: उद्घट्टन n. (-नं) Opening, opening up as a lid. E. उद् up, and घट्टन fastening.
7076: उद्घट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Opened, unlocked. E. उद up, and घट्टित fastened.
7077: उद्घर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Rubbing, rubbing up. 2 Rubbing the skin with hard substances, as vitrified brick, &c. E. उद् and घर्षण friction.
7078: उद्घस n. (-सं) Flesh. E. उद, घस substituted, for अद to eat, affix अप्; what is eaten.
7079: उद्घाट m. (-टः) A watch or guard house. E. उद up, घट to endeavour, &c. घञ् aff.
7080: उद्घाटक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A key. 2 A bucket, &c. see the next. 3 An opener, the instrument or agent of opening any thing.
7081: उद्घाटन n. (-नं) 1 The rope and bucket of a well, a leather bucket used for drawing water. 2 Opening, unlocking. 3 An opener, the instrument or means of opening, a key, &c. 4 Hosting, raising, lifting up. E. उद up, घट to strive, affix ल्युट्; also with वुञ् affix उद्घाटक.
7082: उद्घाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done with effort, exerted. 2 Opened. 3 Raised, hoisted or lifted up. E. उद much, घट to exert, affix क्त.
7083: उद्घाटितज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Wise, intelligent. E. उद् much, घट to endeavour, affix क्त, and ज्ञ who knows.
7084: उद्घाटिताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Intelligent. 2 Naked. E. उद्घाटित and अङ्ग the body.
7085: उद्घात m. (-तः) 1 A beginning, a thing begun. 2 A weapon. 3 A club, a mallet. 4 Striking, wounding, inflicting a hurt. 5 A wound, a blow. 6 The division of a book, a chapter, a section. 7 Breathing through the nostrils as a religious exercise. 8 Slipping, tripping. 9 High, tall. E. उद before हन to kill or destroy, and घञ् affix, त is substituted for न.
7086: उद्ज r. 6th cl. (उज्जति) To be straight: see उज्ज.
7088: उद्घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sounded out. E. उद before घुष् to sound, affix क्त.
7089: उद्दंश m. (-शः) A bug. E. उद् much, and दंश who bites, from दशि and अच् aff.
7090: उद्दण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Raised on a staff or pole. E. उद and दण्ड a stick.
7091: उद्दण्डपाल m. (-लः) 1 A sort of snake. 2 A kind of fish. 3 A punisher, whether king or magistrate. E. उद् above, दण्डपाल a punisher.
7092: उद्दन्तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 High, tall. 2 Terrific, formidable. 3 Large toothed. E. उद high, long, and दन्तुर large toothed.
7093: उद्दान n. (-णं) 1 Binding, confinement. 2 Taming, subduing. 3 A fire place. 4 Submarine fire. 5 The middle, the waist. 6 The entrance of the sun into a sign of the zodiac. E. उद reverse, and दा to give, affix ल्युट्.
7094: उद्दान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Energetic. 2 Humble. 3 Elevated. 4 Vomited by an elephant. E. उद and दान्त tamed.
7095: उद्दाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Set free, unbound. 2 Unconstrained, self-willed. 2 Large, great. 4 Proud, haughty. m. (-मः) A name of VARUṆA. E. उद priv. दम to tame, and घञ् aff.
7096: उद्दाल m. (-लः) 1 A plant, (Cordia myxa or latifolia.) 2 A kind of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.) E. उद high, large दल to pierce, affix घञ्; also उद्दालक, क being added.
7097: उद्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied. E. उद up, दो to cut, and क्त affix; also उदित.
7098: उद्दिन n. (-नं) 1 Mid-day. 2 Every day. E. उद् and दिन day.
7099: उद्दिश्य ind. 1 Having shewn or explained. 2 Stipulating for, demanding. E. उद्, दिश to show, य aff.
7100: उद्दिष्ट mf. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Mentioned, particularised, described. 2 Promised. E. उद् before दिश to show, affix क्त.
7101: उद्दीप n. (-पं) A gummy and resinous substance, Bdellium. m. (पः) 1 Inflaming, lighting. 2 An inflamer. 3 Animating, or who or what animates. E. उद्, दीप to shine, क aff.
7102: उद्दीपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Exciting, inflaming, rendering more intense. 2 Lighting, setting alight. E. उद् and दीपक what lights.
7103: उद्दीपन n. (-नं) 1 Exciting, inflaming a passion. 2 Illuminating. 3 Burning of a body, &c. 4 Any aggravating thing or circumstance, calculated to give poignancy to feeling or passion. E. उद् much, दीप to inflame, ल्युट् aff.
7104: उद्दीपमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lighting up, brightening, becoming light. E. उद before दीप and शानच् aff.
7105: उद्दीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Lighted, set on fire or alight. 2 Inflamed, aggravated, as passion. E. उद् and दीप्त lighted.
7106: उद्दीप्र n. (-प्रं) Bdellium. E. उद् before दीप to shine, रक aff.
7107: उद्देश m. (-शः) 1 Illustration, explanation, exemplification. 2 Search, enquiry. 3 Stipulation, bargain. 4 An object, a motive. mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Relative to. E. उद् and देश showing.
7108: उद्देशक mf. (-कः-का-कं) What explains or shows, illustrative, explanatory. m. (-कः) 1 An illustration, an example. 2 An illustrator. 3 A guide. E. उद् before दिश to show, वुन् aff.
7109: उद्देश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be illustrated or explained. E. उद्, दिश to show, ण्यत् aff.
7110: उद्देहिका f. (-का) The white ant, termes; also उत्यादिका.
7111: उद्द्योत m. (-तः) Light, lustre. E. उद्, द्युत to shine, aff.
7112: उद्द्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flight, retreat. 2 Going upwards. E. उद् up, द्रु to run, and घञ् aff.
7113: उद्द्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-त) 1 Fled, retreated, run away. 2 Ascended, gone up or upwards. E. उद् and द्रुत gone.
7114: उद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rude, ill behaved. 2 Haughty, vain, puffed up. 3 Raised, elevated. 4 Excited, intense. m. (-तः) A king's wrestler. E. उद् above, हन to hurt or injure, affix क्त; ह becomes घ.
7115: उद्धतमनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Haughty, proud, high minded. E. उद्धत raised, मनस्क minded.
7116: उद्धतमनस्कत्व n. (-त्वं) Pride, arrogance. E. उद्धत, मनस्क having a mind, and त्व abstract aff.
7117: उद्धति f. (-तिः) 1 Pride, haughtiness. 2 Elevation. E. उद् before हन to strike, affix क्तिन्.
7118: उद्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Who or what blows. m. (मः) 1 Breathing hard, panting. 2 Blowing, sounding. E. उद् before ध्मा to blow, affix श.
7119: उद्धय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who or what drinks. E. उद् before धे to drink, श aff.
7120: उद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) 1 Who raises or lifts up. 2 A sharer, a coheir. 3 Who recovers property. E. उद् before हृ to take, तृन् aff.
7121: उद्धरण n. (-णं) 1 Raising or lifting any thing. 2 Eradicating a tree, &c. 3 Exterminating, destroying. 4 Taking a part or share. 5 Vomiting, bringing up. 6 Final emancipation. E. उद् up, हृ to take, and ल्युट् aff.
7122: उद्धरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be raised up. 2 To be given up. E. उद् before हरणीय to be taken.
7123: उद्धर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 A festival, especially religious. 2 Great joy. E. उद् much, हर्ष happiness.
7124: उद्धर्षण n. (-णं) Erection of the hair of the body. E. उद् much, हृष to be happy, and ल्युट् affix; occasioned by great pleasure.
7125: उद्धव m. (-वः) 1 A festival, a holiday. 2 Sacrificial fire. 3 The name of a person, the friend and councillor of KṚṢṆA. E. उद् reverse, धु to feel pain, घञ् aff.
7126: उद्धान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Gone up, ascended. 2 Vomited. n. (-नं) A furnace or fire place. E. उद, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
7127: उद्धान्त mfn. (-त्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Vomited. m. (-न्तः) An elephant out of rut. E. उद् up, and ध्मा to breathe or blow, affix क्त.
7128: उद्धार m. (-रः) Raising, elevating, lifting up. 2 Debt, especially a debt not bearing interest. 3 A portion, a share. 4 A deduction, a part to be set aside. 5 Recovering property. 6 Extracting, quoting. n. (-रं) A fire place. f. (-रा) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडूची. E. उद् up, धृ to have, घञ् aff.
7129: उद्धारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what raises or lifts. E. उद् before हृ to take, वुञ् aff.
7130: उद्धारण n. (-णं) 1 Raising, elevating. 2 Sharing, dividing. E. उद् before धृ to have, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
7131: उद्धारविभाग m. (-गः) Partition, division of shares. E. उद्धार and विभाग dividing.
7132: उद्धुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Heavy. 2 Thick, gross. 3 Firm. E. उद् and धुर a burden.
7133: उद्धूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken off, fallen from or off. 2 Tossed up, scattered above. E. उद् and धूत trembling.
7134: उद्धूषण n. (-णं) Horripilation. E. उद् up, धूष to shine, ल्युट् aff.
7135: उद्धृत mfn. (तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, drawn up, as water from a well, &c. 2 Pulled up or out, eradicated or broken off. 3 Lifted up. 4 Raised, elevated. 5 Thrown up or upwards. 6 Vomited. 7 Separated, set apart. 8 Divided, partitioned. 9 Recovered. 10 Uncovered. 11 Dispersed, scattered. 12 Extracted, selected, taken from or out of. 13 Holding, containing. E. उद् up, धृ to take, and क्त. aff.
7136: उद्धृतोद्धार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 One who has received his share. 2 That from which a share has been deducted. E. उद्धृत and उद्धार a share.
7137: उद्ध्य m. (-द्ध्यः) A river. E. उञ्झ to go, क्यप् affix, deriv. irr.
7138: उद्ध्यान n. (-नं) A furnace or fire place. E. उद्, ध्मा to blow, and ल्युट् aff.
7139: उद्बन्धन n. (-नं) Tying up, hanging. E. उद् and वन्धन tying.
7140: उद्बाहु mfn. (-हुः-ह्वी-हु) 1 Having the arms lifted up. 2 Having the trunk upraised (as an elephant.) E. उद् and वाहु the arm.
7141: उद्बुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Blown, budded. 2 Reminded, made to think of or recalled. 3 Awaked. E. उद् forth, up, and वुद्ध known.
7142: उद्बुद्धसंस्कार m. (-रः) Association of ideas recalling any thing to remembrance. E. उद्वद्ध and संस्कार faculty.
7143: उद्बोध m. (-धः) 1 Incipient knowledge. 2 Awaking. 3 Reminding. E. उद् and बोध knowledge.
7144: उद्बोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Discovering, exhibiting. 2 What reminds, or calls to remembrance. E. उद and बोधक making known.
7145: उद्बोधन n. (-नं) 1 Recalling, reminding. 2 Awaking, arousing. E. उद् before बुध to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
7146: उद्भट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Excellent. 2 Exalted, magnanimous. m. (-टः) 1 A tortoise. 2 The sun. E. उद् lofty, भट to desire, and अच् affix; high-minded.
7147: उद्भव m. (-वः) Birth, production. E. उद् forth, भू to be or become, अच् aff.
7148: उद्भवकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Productive. E. उद्भव, and कर what makes.
7149: उद्भाव m. (-वः) 1 Production, generation. 2 Magnanimity. E. उद् भाव causing to be, &c.
7150: उद्भावन n. (-नं) 1 Inattention, neglect, disregard. 2 Saying, speaking. E. उद् away or up, भावन observing.
7151: उद्भावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Neglected, disregarded. 2 Said, declared. E. उद् and भावित made known.
7152: उद्भास m. (-सः) Radiance, splendor. E. उद् and भास shining.
7153: उद्भासयन् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Lighting up, irradiating. E. उद् before भास to shine, शतृ aff.
7154: उद्भासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Lighted up, illuminated, splendid. 2 Ornamented, graced, beautified. E. उद् before भास to shine, क्त aff.
7156: उद्भिज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Sprouting, germinating, (as a vegetable.) E. उद्भिद a vegetable, and ज produced; also उद्भिज one ज being dropped; also उद्भिद.
7157: उद्भिद् mfn. (-द्भिद् or -द्भित्) Sprouting, germinating. E. उद् up, भिद to break or burst, affix क्विप्, or with क affix उद्भिद (-दः-दा-दं.) n. (-दं) Culinary salt. E. उद् forth, भिद to break, and क affix; breaking from the soil.
7158: उद्भिद n. (-दं) Sprouting, &c. see the last.
7159: उद्भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Opened, burst. 2 Budded. E. उद् up, and भिन्न broken.
7160: उद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Lofty, literally or figuratively. 3 Visible, perceptible, present. E. उद् before भू to be, affix क्त.
7161: उद्भूतरूप n. (-पं) Visible shape or form. E. उद्भूत and रूप form.
7162: उद्भ्रम n. (-मं) 1 Regret. 2 Whirling, flourishing. E. उद् much, भ्रम to wander, धञ् aff.
7163: उद्भ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Agitated, bewildered, distressed. 3 Whirled, flourished, waved (as a sword). E. उद् and भ्रान्त revolved.
7164: उद्य m. (-द्यः) A river. E. उद् water, and य what goes, from या to go, and ड aff.
7165: उद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, held up. 2 Active, persevering, labouring diligently and incessantly. 3 Trained, exercised, disciplined. m. (-तः) A section, a chapter, the division of a book. E. उद् before यम to cease, affix क्त.
7166: उद्यम m. (-मः) 1 Strenuous and continued effort, exertion, perseverance. 2 Taking or lifting up. E. उद् reverse, यम to cease, affix घञ्.
7167: उद्यमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Persevering, active, making effort. E. उद्यम and इनि aff.
7168: उद्यम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Requiring exertion. ind. Having lifted or taken up. 2 Having made exertion. E. उद् before यम to cease, यत् and ल्यप् affs.
7169: उद्यान n. (-नं) 1 A garden. 2 A royal garden, a park. 3 Going forth, exit. 4 Purpose, motive. E. उद् up, या to go, affix ल्युट्.
7170: उद्यानपाल m. (-लः) A gardener. 2 The master or owner of a garden. E. उद्यान and पाल who takes care of.
7171: उद्याव m. (-वः) Mixing, joining. E. उद् before यु to mix, affix घञ्.
7172: उद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Zealously active, labouring for some desired end. E. उद्, युज to join, क्त affix; also उद्यत.
7173: उद्योग m. (-गः) Exertion, perseverance, strenuous and continued endeavour. E. उद्, युज to join, घञ् aff.
7174: उद्योगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Active, laborious, persevering, one who makes effort. E. उद्योग and इनि aff.
7175: उद्र (-द्रः) An otter. E. उन्दी to wet, and रक Uṇādi aff.
7176: उद्रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An imaginary city, one floating in the air. E. उद् above, and द्रङ्ग a town, one द rejected; also read उद्रङ्क, see हरिश्वन्द्रपूर.
7177: उद्रथ m. (-थः) 1 The pin of the axle of a carriage. 3 A cook. E. उद् up, and रथ a carriage.
7178: उद्राव m. (-बः) A loud noise. E. उद् before रु to cry, affix घञ्.
7179: उद्रिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Distinct, evident. 2 Increased, augmented. E. उद्, रिच् to flow, affix क्त.
7180: उद्रुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Destroying, breaking down. E. उद् on, रुज to injure, क aff.
7181: उद्रेक m. (-कः) 1 Commencement. 2 Increase. 3 Excess. E. उद्, रिच to flow, घञ् aff.
7182: उद्वत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. उद्, वत्सर a year.
7183: उद्वमन n. (-नं) Vomiting, bringing up. E. उद् and वमन vomiting.
7184: उद्वर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Abundant, plentiful. 2 Left over. m. (-र्त्तः) A remainder, a surplus. E. उद् much, वृत to be, क्त aff.
7185: उद्वर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Rubbing and cleaning the body, (who or what does so.) 2 Causing increase. m. (-कः) (In algebra,) An assumed quantity. E. उद् over, वृत to be, ण्वुल् aff.
7186: उद्वर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Going up, rising, ascending. 2 Grinding, pounding. 3 Rubbing or kneading the body. 4 Rubbing and cleaning it with fragrant unguents. 5 Unguents used for that purpose, or to relieve pains in the limbs, &c. 6 Rising, (figuratively) prosperity, elevation. 7 Misbehaving. 8 Springing up of plants or grain, &c. 9 Drawing out metal, laminating, wire drawing, &c. E. उद् up, and वर्त्तन abiding, &c.
7187: उद्वर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, scented. 2 Risen, elevated. 3 Sprung up. 4 Drawn out. E. उत् before वृत to be, क्त aff.
7188: उद्वर्द्धन n. (-नं) A sly or suppressed laugh. E. उद् priv. वृद्ध to increase, and ल्युट् aff.
7189: उद्वर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, drawn or lifted up. 2 Eradicated. E. उद् up, and वर्हित injured; also उद्वाहित, from वाह to endeavour.
7190: उद्वह mf. (-हः-हा) A son or a daughter. m. (-हः) 1 The vital air that conveys nourishment, &c. upwards. 2 A chief, a leader, the head of a family or force. mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Who or what takes up or away. 2 Best, most eminent. E. उद् further, वह what bears; carrying on one's name, &c.
7191: उद्वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Upholding, supporting, bearing, containing. 2 Having, possessing, assuming. E. उद् before वह to bear, शतृ aff.
7192: उद्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Vomited. E. उद् up, वम to vomit, क्त affix: see उद्वान्त and उद्वान.
7193: उद्वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Vomited. m. (-न्तः) An elephant out of rut. E. उद्, वम to vomit, affix क्त, deriv. irr. see उद्वान्त.
7194: उद्वाप m. (-पः) (In logic,) non-existence of a subsequent consequent on the absence of an antecedent. E. उद् before वप to sow, affix घञ्.
7195: उद्वास m. (-सः) 1 Abandoning, letting loose or free. 2 Exile. 3 Killing. E. उद् away, वस to abide, causal form, घञ् aff.
7196: उद्वासन n. (-नं) 1 Quitting, abandoning. 2 Expelling, banishing. 3 Killing, slaughter. E. उत् forth, out, वस to abide, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
7197: उद्वाह m. (-हः) Marriage. E. उत् up, वह to bear, घञ् aff.
7198: उद्वाहकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मं) The marriage ceremony. E. उद्वाह and कर्म्मन् act.
7199: उद्वाहन n. (-नं) 1 Marriage. 2 Ploughing a field twice. 3 Anxiety, anxious regret. f. (-नी) The small shell used as a coin, a Cowri. E. उत् up, वाह to endeavour, ल्युट् affix, and ङीष् fem. do.
7200: उद्वाहिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to marriage, matrimonial. E. उद्वाह marriage, and ठक् aff.
7201: उद्वाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, lifted or pulled up, &c. 2 Eradicated. E. उत् before वह to bear, causal form, affix क्त.
7202: उद्वाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 What raises or draws up. 2 Who or what marries, relating to marriage. f. (-नी) A rope. E. उत्, वाह to endeavour, णिनि and ङीष् affixes, or उद्वाह and इनि aff.
7203: उद्विग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Sorrowful, anxious, grieving for an absent lover, &c. E. उत्, विज to shake, क्त aff.
7204: उद्विग्नमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Sorrowful, depressed in spirits, anxious, distressed. E. उद्विग्न and मनस् the mind.
7205: उद्वीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Looking up or upwards. 2 Seeing, looking at. E. उद् and वि before ईक्ष to see, affix ल्युट्.
7206: उद्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Raised, elevated. 2 Exalted, prosperous. 3 Unrestrained, ill behaved. 4 Vomited. 5 Left, as a remainder. E. उत् above, and वृत्त placed.
7207: उद्वेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 One going swiftly, a runner, a courier, &c. 2 Steady, composed, tranquil. m. (-गः) 1 Regret. 2 Fear. 3 Anxiety, agitation. 4 Distress occasioned by separation from a beloved object. 5 Admiration, astonishment. 6 Ascending, mounting, going up or upwards. 7 An ascetic whose arms, by long habit, continue always raised above his head. n. (-गं) The fruit of the Areca Catechu, the betel nut. E. उत् up, विज to fear, to shake, &c. घञ् aff.
7208: उद्वेगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Suffering distress, anxious, unhappy. E. उद्वेग and इनि aff.
7209: उद्वेजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Distressing, annoying, what causes pain or sorrow. E. उत् before विज to fear, causal form, वुन् aff.
7210: उद्वेजन n. (-नं) 1 Anxiety, distress, regret, sorrowing for one absent. 2 Corporal infliction, mutilation, torture. E. उत् before विज to shake, affix ल्युट्.
7211: उद्वेजनकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Inflicting pain, punishing, torturing. 2 Painful. E. उद्वेजन and कर what makes.
7212: उद्वेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Garieved, pained, afflicted. E. उत् before विज to fear, causal. क्त aff.
7213: उद्वेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) What surrounds, &c. m. (-ष्टः) 1 Investing a town, besieging or surrounding it. 2 Capturing, taking. 3 Surounding, enclosing. E. उत् before वेष्ट to surround, अच् aff.
7214: उद्वेष्टन n. (-नं) 1 Surrounding. 2 An enclosure. 3 Pain in the buttocks. E. उद् before वेष्ट to surround, ल्युट् aff.
7215: उद्वेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, invested, enclosed. E. उत् before वेष्ट to surround, क्त aff.
7216: उधस n. (-सं) An udder: see ऊधस.
7217: उध्य m. (-ध्यः) Name of a river.
7218: उध्रस् r. 9th cl. (उध्रस्नाति) r. 10th cl. (उध्रामयति) 1 To glean or gather by little at a time. 2 To throw or cast upwards. The initial उ is considered by some as an indicatory letter, the root being then ध्रस; q. v.
7219: उन्द r. 7th cl. (ई,) उन्दी (उनत्ति) 1 To wet or moisten. 2 To be or become wet.
7221: उन्दुर m. (-रः) A rat: see the next.
7222: उन्दुरु m. (-रुः) A rat. E. उन्दी to wet, and उरु affix; it is also written उन्दरु, उन्दर, as above, and उन्दुरु, &c.
7223: उन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Wet, moist. 2 Kind, humane. E. उन्द to be moist, क्त aff.
7224: उन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 High, tall. 2 Raised, held or lifted up. 3 Plump, full. 4 Great, eminent. E. उत् high, नत bent.
7225: उन्नतनाभि mfn. (-भिः-भिः-भि) Corpulent. E. उन्नत high, and नाभि the navel.
7226: उन्नतशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Holding up the head, carrying the head high. E. उन्नत and शिरस् the head.
7227: उन्नतानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uneven, undulating, wavy. E. उन्नत high, and आनत low.
7228: उन्नति f. (-तिः) 1 Increase, advancement, prosperity. 2 Rising, ascending. 3 The wife of GARUḌA. E. उत् up, नम to bend, क्तिन् aff.
7229: उन्नतीश m. (-शः) A name of GARUḌA. E. उन्नति and ईष husband: the husband of UNNATI.
7230: उन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Swelled, increased. 2 Tied upon or over. 3 Unbound. E. उद् before नह to bind, क्त aff.
7231: उन्नमन n. (-नं) Raising, lifting up. E. उत् before नम to bow, ल्युट् aff.
7232: उन्नमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Raised, elevated, lifted or pulled up. 2 Heightened, increased. E. उत् before नम to bow, क्त affix, with इट् augment.
7233: उन्नमय्य ind. Having raised. E. उत् before नम to bow, ल्यप् aff.
7234: उन्नम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Lofty, high, elevated. E. उत् before नम to bow, रक aff.
7235: उन्नय m. (-यं) 1 Raising, elevating, hoisting. 2 Analogy, resemblance. E. उत् up, नी to obtain, and अच् aff.
7236: उन्नयन n. (-नं) 1 Deliberation, discussion, logic, reasoning. 2 Inference. 3 Raising, elevating, lifting up. E. उत् up, नी to obtain, affix ल्युट्.
7237: उन्नस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Having a prominent nose. E. उद् up, नस for नासिका the nose.
7238: उन्नाम m. (-मः) Raising, lifting up. E. उद् and नम to bow, घञ् aff.
7239: उन्नाय m. (-यः) Raising. E. see उन्नय, affix घञ्.
7240: उन्नायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What raises. 2 What leads to an inference or conclusion. E. उद् before नी to get, causal form, वुन् aff.
7241: उन्नाह n. (-हं) Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice. E. उद् and नह to bind, affix घञ्.
7242: उन्निद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Awake. 2 Blown, expanded as a flower. E. उद् priv. and निद्रा sleep.
7243: उन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Insane, frantic, mad. 2 Drunk, intoxicated. m. (-त्तः) 1 The thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.) 2 A plant, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) E. उत् much, मत्त drunk or mad: applied to the plants, it alludes to their deleterious properties.
7244: उन्मत्तता f. (-त्ता) Insanity, intoxication. E. तल् added to the last; also उन्मत्तत्वं.
7245: उन्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Mad, furious, extravagant, intoxicated. m. (-दः) Insanity, either morbid or as the effect or temporary excitement, intoxication, ecstasy. E. उत् very, मद to be mad, अच् aff.
7246: उन्मदिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Mad, insane, crazed. 2 Intoxicated. 3 In rut, (as an elephant.) E. उन्मद to be mad, इष्णुच् attributive. aff.
7247: उन्मनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Regretting, missing, sorrowing for a lost or departed friend, &c. E. उत् up, upset, disturbed, and मनस् the mind.
7248: उन्मन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Agitation. E. उत् before, मथि to kill, affix घञ्.
7249: उन्मन्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What moves or stirs. 2 Throbbing, beating. m. (-कः) Inflammation of the outer ear. E. उद् before मथि to hurt, वुन् aff.
7250: उन्मन्थन n. (-नं) 1 Shaking, agitating. 2 Hurting, killing. 3 Probing, stirring a weapon, &c. lodged in the body. E. उद् before मथि to hurt, ल्युट् aff.
7251: उन्मन्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Moved, agitated, distressed. E. उद् and मन्थित agitated.
7252: उन्माथ m. (-थः) 1 A snare or trap. 2 Killing, slaughter. 2 A killer, a slaughterer. 4 Pride, disdain. E. उत्, मथ to agitate, and घञ् aff.
7253: उन्माद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Mad, insane, extravagant. m. (-दः) 1 Madness, extravagance. 2 (In medicine,) Mania. E. उद् much, मद to be mad, affix घञ्.
7254: उन्मादन m. (-नः) 1 Maddening, exciting, intoxicating. 2 One of five arrows borne by KĀMADEVA, the Hindu CUPID. E. उत् before मद to be mad or intoxicated, causal form, ल्यट् aff.
7255: उन्मादवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Mad, insane, wild, extravagant. E. उन्माद madness, &c. and मतुप् poss. aff.
7256: उन्मादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Mad, intoxicated. E. उन्माद and इनि aff.
7257: उन्मान m. (-नः) A measure of size or quantity. E. उद् and मा to measure, ल्युट् aff.
7258: उन्मार्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A wrong road. 2 Improper conduct, an evil course, error. E. उद् and मार्ग way.
7259: उन्मार्गगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Erred, erring, going wrong. E. उन्मार्ग and गत gone.
7260: उन्मार्गगमन n. (-नं) 1 Going a wrong road. 2 Following evil courses. E. उन्मार्ग and गमन going.
7261: उन्मार्गगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Going wrong, erring, following evil courses. 2 Taking a wrong road. E. उन्मार्ग and गामिन् who goes.
7262: उन्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Meted, measured. E. उद् before मा to measure, क्त aff.
7263: उन्मिषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Opening the eye, drawing up the eyelid, looking at, seeing. E. उद् before मिष to scatter, शतृ aff.
7264: उन्मिषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opened, (as the eye.) 2 Blown as a flower. E. उद् up, मिष to scatter, affix क्त.
7265: उन्मीलन n. (-नं) 1 Winking, twinkling of the eye. 2 Blowing, expanding. E. उद् and मील to twinkle, affix ल्युट्.
7266: उन्मीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opened, (as the eyes.) 2 Blown as a flower. E. उद्, मील to wink, affix क्त.
7267: उन्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Looking upwards. E. उद् up, मुख the face.
7268: उन्मुद्र mfn. (द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Blown as a flower. 2 Unsealed, opened. E. उद् up, open, and मुद्रा a seal.
7269: उन्मूलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eradicated, pulled up by the roots. E. उद् up, मूल nominal verb, to take root, क्त aff.
7270: उन्मृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Worn off, blotted out. E. उद् out, मृष्ट rubbed.
7271: उन्मेदा f. (-दा) Corpulency, fatness. E. उद् much, मिद to anoint, अच् and टाप् affs.
7272: उन्मेष m. (-षः) 1 Winking, twinkling of the eyelids, the upward motion. 2 Opening the eye, looking at. E. उद् up, मिष to scatter, affix घञ्.
7273: उप ind. A particle and prefix to verbs and other words implying, 1 Excess, (over, above, &c.;) 2 Vicinity or assemblage, (near, by the side of, with, together with;) 3 Inferiority, (lesser, secondary, &c.;) 4 Likeness, resemblance; 5 Disease, extinction; 6 Ornament; 7 Command; 8 Reproof; 9 Astonishing; 10 Giving; 11 Killing; 12 Diffusion; 13 Wish, desire; 14 Effort, exertion, &c. as उपर्कत्तुं, to assist; उपगन्तुं to approach; उपदेष्टं to advise; उपलब्धुं to revile; उपस्थातुं to worship; also उपपुराणं. an inferior or minor Purāṇa, उपकुम्भं near the water pot, उपगङ्गं upon the Ganges, उपकान्तं near or with a lover, उपाग्नि in the vicinity of fire.
7274: उपकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) Near, proximate. n. (-ण्ठं) 1 Space near a village or its boundary. 2 One of a horse's paces, his walk. ind. (-ण्ठं) Upon the neck, near the throat. E. उप near, कण्ठ the neck.
7275: उपकरण n. (-णं) 1 Apparatus, paraphernalia, as the vessels and offerings at a sacrifice. 2 Implements, machines. 3 The insignia of royalty. 4 Sauces, condiments. 5 Helping, assisting. 6 Object of art or science, fabricating, composing, &c. 7 Means of subsistence, any thing supporting life. E. उप implying command or help, कृ to make, ल्युट् aff.
7276: उपकर्णम् ind. Close to the ear, into the ear, (whispered, &c.) E. उप near, कर्ण् the ear.
7277: उपकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Assisting, befriending, one who helps or befriends. E. उप before कृ to do, affix तृन्.
7278: उपकल्पन n. (-नं) 1 Preparing articles of food, medicine, &c. 2 Fabricating, making. 3 Substituting. E. उप and कल्पन making.
7279: उपकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Prepared, made. 2 Secondary, substituted. E. उप and कल्पित prepared.
7280: उपकार m. (-रः) 1 Favour, protection, help, assistance. 2 Use, advantage. 3 A flower, &c. full blown. 4 Garlands suspended, at gateways, as an embellishment on festivals. E. उप near or over, कृ to make, घञ् aff.
7281: उपकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A friend, a protector, one who befriends. E. उप and कृ to do, ण्वुल aff.
7282: उपकारकत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Protection, assistance. E. उपकारक and त्व aff.
7283: उपकारपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Beneficent, diligent in doing good. E. उपकार and पर diligent.
7284: उपकारिका f. (-का) 1 A protectress, a governess. 2 A palace, a caravansera. 3 A kind of cake. E. उपकारी as below, &c. कन् affix, and the fem. form, or the fem. of उपकारक.
7285: उपकारिता f. (-ता) Aid, succour, protection. E. तल् added to उपकारिन्; also with त्व, उपकारित्व.
7286: उपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Helping, assisting, a benefactor. 2 Subsidiary, subservient. E. उपकार and इनि aff.
7287: उपकारी f. (-री) A palace, a caravansera. E. उपकार aid, asylum, affixes अण and ङीप्.
7288: उपकार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Deserving assistance or favour. f. (-र्य्या) 1 A king's house, a palace, a caravansera. 2 A tent. E. उपकार aid, &c. and ण्यत् aff.
7289: उपकुञ्चि f. (-ञ्चिः) A plant, (Nigella Indica.) E. उप very, कुञ्च to be small, and कि aff.
7290: उपकुञ्चिका f. (-का) 1 Small cardamoms: see एला. 2 A sort of fennel flower, (Nigella Indica, Rox.) E. वुन् affixed to the last.
7291: उपकुम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Solitary, lonely, retired. n. or ind. (-म्भं) Near the water jar. E. उप and कुम्भ a jar.
7292: उपकुल्या f. (-ल्या) 1 A canal, a trench, a ditch. 2 Long pepper, (Piper longum.) E. उप near, कुल to accumulate, and क्यप् affix, fem. टाप्.
7293: उपकुश m. (-शः) Gum-boil. E. उप before कुश to enclose, क aff.
7294: उपकूपजलाशय m. (-यः) A trough near a well for watering cattle. E. उप near, कूप a well, and जलाशय a place for water.
7295: उपकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Benefited, assisted. 2 Done kindly or beneficently, rendered as assistance. n. (-तं) A favour, a benefit. E. उप before कृ to do, क्त aff.
7296: उपकृति f. (-तिः) Aid, assistance, kindness. E. उप and कृ to do, क्तिन् aff.
7297: उपक्रन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Beginning, one who begins. E. उप before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.
7298: उपक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Deliberate commencement or undertaking; providing means, and anticipating consequences. 2 A beginning in general. 3 A particular ceremony preparatory to reading the Vedas. 4 A stratagem. 5 A means, an expedient. 6 Trying the fidelity, &c. of a counsellor or friend. 7 Valor. 8 Practice of medicine, physicking. 9 Flight, retreat. 10 Approach. E. उप over, &c. क्रम to go, affix घञ्.
7299: उपक्रमणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Necessary, to be commenced or undertaken. 2 To be gone to or near. E. उप before क्रम to go, अनीयर् aff.
7300: उपक्रमितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) One who begins, &c. see उपक्रम. E. उप before क्रम to go, तृच् affix, with इट augment; also उपक्रत्तृ.
7301: उपक्रोश m. (-शः) Censure, reproach. E. उप reproach, inferiority, क्रुश to cry, to sound, affix घञ्.
7302: उपक्रोष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) 1 An ass. 2 A reviler, a reprover. E. उप implying censure, क्रुश to cry, तृन् aff.
7303: उपकॢप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Consecrated, dedicated, prepared or set apart for use. E. उप and कॢप्त made.
7304: उपक्वण m. (-णः) The sound of a lute. E. उप well, क्वण to sound, affix अपे or with घञ् affix उपक्वाण.
7305: उपक्षय m. (-यः) Loss. E. उप before क्षि to lose, affix अच्,
7306: उपक्षेप m. (-पः) Poetical or figurative style or composition. E. उप and क्षिप to throw, affix घञ्.
7307: उपगण m. (-णः) A small number, less than a troop or number. E. उप and गण a troop.
7308: उपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Near, approached, gone to. 2 Feeling, suffering, entertaining. 3 Becoming, being, become 5 Having, obtained. E. उप with, गत gone, part. past of गम to go.
7309: उपगतवत mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Going to, gone to. 2 Feeling, suffering, (as sorrow, &c.) 3 Promising. 4 Possessing. E. उप before गम to go, क्तवतु aff.
7310: उपगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Perfume. E. उप and गन्ध smell.
7311: उपगम m. (-मः) 1 Agreement, promise. 2 Approach, approximation. 3 Suffering, feeling. 4 Acquaintance, society, intercourse. 5 Getting, having, obtaining. E. उप near, गम to go, and अच् aff.
7312: उपगिरि ind. Near a mountain; also with टच् added उपगिरम्.
7313: उपगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Celebrated, proclaimed, sung, (by bards, &c.) E. उप and गीत sung.
7314: उपगीति f. (-तिः) A variety of the Arya metre, a stanza of four lines, containing 12--15 and 12--15 syllabic instants.
7315: उपगीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sung. ind. Having sung. E. उप before गै to sing, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
7316: उपगूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Hidden, concealed. 2 Lulled, suppressed. E. उप before गुह to hide, affix क्त.
7317: उपगूहन n. (-नं) 1 An embrace, embracing. 2 Astonishment, surprise. E. उप near, गुह to hide, affix ल्युट्.
7318: उपग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A prisoner, a man or animal in confinement. 2 Favour, encouragement. 3 Assistance. 4 Peace purchased by the cession of every thing. 5 Seizure. 6 The presiding spirit or cause directing a planet's motion. 7 A minor planet or any heavenly body of a secondary kind, as a comet, a meteor, a falling star, &c. 8 A heap of kusa grass. E. उप near, ग्रह to take, अप् affix or ग्रह a planet, &c.
7319: उपग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Taking, seizing. 2 Holy study, reading the Vedas after initiation. E. उप much, ग्रह to take, affix ल्युट्.
7320: उपग्राह्य m. (-ह्यः) A present, an offering to a king or great man, a Nezer. E. उप much, &c. ग्रह to take, affix ण्यत्.
7321: उपघात m. (-तः) 1 Disease, sickness. 2 Touch, contact, especially with an intent to injure. 3 Personal violence, assault. E. उप much, हन to injure, घञ् aff.
7322: उपघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 Contiguous support. 2 Support, stay, protection. 3 What rests upon or is supported by. E. उप near, हन to destroy, and अप् aff.
7323: उपचक्र m. (-क्रः) A variety of the ruddy goose. E. उप minor, and चक्र the Cakra.
7324: उपचतुर m. plu. (-राः) Almost four. E. उप and चतुर four.
7325: उपचय m. (-यः) 1 Quantity, heap. 2 Elevation. 3 Prosperity. 4 Excess. 5 The third, sixth, tenth, and eleventh degrees from the first of a zodiacal sign. E. उप above, चि to collect, अच् aff.
7326: उपचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Served, adored. E. उप near or with, चर to go, affix क्त.
7327: उपचर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be served or waited on. f. (-र्य्या) 1 Service, attendance. 2 Practice of medicine, physicking. E. उप implying help, चर to go, क्यप् and टाप् affs.
7328: उपचाय्य m. (-य्यः) A place for holding sacrificial fire, a hearth, an altar. E. उप, चिञ् to collect, ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.
7329: उपचार m. (-रः) 1 Service, attendance. 2 Physicking, the practice of medicine. 3 Practice, profession, usage. 4 A present, a bribe. 5 Presenting delicacies or necessaries, water, betel.  &c. 6 Tending the sick, nursing. 7 Solicitation, request. 8 Incomplete, act, one in progress. 9 A form of speech, a phrase that leaves something to be inferred, ellipsis, &c. E. उप well. much, &c. चर to go, घञ् aff.
7330: उपचारकरण n. (-णं) Offering presents, especially of perfumes. flowers, &c. attention, service. E. उपचार and करण making; also उपचारकर्म्मन्, उपचारक्रिया, &c.
7331: उपचारपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Waiting upon, serving diligently. E. उपचार service, and पर diligent.
7332: उपचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Practice of medicine. E. उप, चर in the causal form, and ण्यत् affix, deriv. irr.
7333: उपचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Collected, assembled. 2 Heaped. 3 Thriving, increasing. 4 Burnt. 5 Plaistered, smeared. E. उप much, and चित collected, from चिञ् to gather, affix क्त.
7334: उपचित्रा f. (-त्रा) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.) see मूषिकपर्णी E. उप much, चित्र variegated.
7335: उपचूलन n. (-नं) Heathing, burning. E. उप much, चूर to burn, affix ल्युट्, र changed to ल.
7336: उपचेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be collected or heaped up. E. उप before चि to gather, ण्यत् aff.
7337: उपछन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Secret, concealed. E. उप and छद to cover, क्त aff.
7338: उपजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Produced, engendered, aroused. E. उप and जात born.
7339: उपजाति f. (-तिः) A metre or stanza of four lines, with eleven syllables in each.
7340: उपजाप m. (-पः) 1 Disunion, separation. 2 Treason, treachery. E. उप separation, जप to meditate, ण aff.
7341: उपजापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A mischief-maker, one who foments quarrels. 2 A traitor, treacherous. E. उप before जप to meditate, ण्वुल् aff.
7342: उपजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) 1 A kind of insect. 2 The uvula or soft palate. 3 Enlargement of the tongue. E. उप privation or similitude, and जिह्वा the tongue.
7343: उपजिह्विका f. (-का) 1 A species of insect. 2 The soft palate: see the preceding.
7344: उपजीवक n. (-कं) 1 Act, object. 2 Means of subsistence. E. उप before जीव to live, वुन् aff.
7345: उपजीविका f. (-का) Subsistence, livelihood. E. उप and जीविका the same.
7346: उपजीवन n. (-नं) Subsistence, means of living. E. उप and जीवन living.
7347: उपजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Dependant, living by or on. E. उप and जीविन् who lives.
7348: उपजीव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Affording a livelihood. n. (-व्यं) Cause. E. उप before जीव to live, य aff.
7349: उपजोषम् ind. An expression indicative of joy. E. उप much, जुष to be kind, and अम् affix; also उपयोषम्.
7350: उपज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Untaught knowledge. E. उप near, with ज्ञा knowledge, from ज्ञा to know, अङ्, and टाप् affs.
7351: उपढौकन n. (-नं) A respectful offering or present, a Nezer. E. उप and ढौकन seeking.
7352: उपतप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Heated, parched. 2 Distressed, pained. E. उप and तप्त heated.
7353: उपतप्तृ m. (-प्ता) 1 Morbid heat. 2 Any cause of heat, burning or inflammation. E. उप excess, तप to heat, तृच् aff.
7354: उपताप m. (-पः) 1 Disease. 2 Haste, hurry. 3 Heat, heatedness. 4 Pain. 5 Misfortune. E. उप much, तप to heat, घञ् aff.
7355: उपतापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Inflaming, exciting. 2 Heating. 3 Suffering heat or pain. 4 Sick. E. उपताप and इनि affix, or उप before तप with णिनि aff.
7356: उपत्यका f. (-का) Land near the foot of a hill or mountain. E. उप near, त्यकन् aff.
7357: उपदंश n. (-शः) 1 A relish, or something to promote drinking. 2 The venereal disease, chancre. 3 Biting, stinging. 4 A tree, the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish, (Morunga hyperanthera). E. उप much, &c. दंश biting.
7358: उपदर्शक m. (-कः) 1 A doorkeeper. 2 A guide. E. उप and दर्शक who shews.
7359: उपदर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perceived, distinguished. E. उप before दर्शित seen.
7360: उपदा f. (-दा) A present, an offering to a king or great man, &c. a Nezer. E. उप, दा a gift, from दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.
7361: उपदानक n. (-कं) A present, &c. see the preceding. E. उप implying help, &c. दान a gift, and क affix: a gift which is for the purpose of procuring favour or protection.
7362: उपदिश्य ind. Having advised or instructed. E. उप before दिश to shew, ल्यप् aff.
7363: उपदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Instructed, advised. 2 Initiated. 3 Specified, particularised. 4 Assigned as a plea or reason. n. (-ष्टं) Council, advice. E. उप before दिश to shew, क्त aff.
7365: उपदेवता f. (-ता) A minor divinity, as a Yakṣa, Gandharba, Apsaras, &c. E. उप and देवता a divinity.
7366: उपदेश m. (-शः) Advice, information, instruction. 3 Plea, pretext. 4 Specification. 5 Initiation, communication of the initiatory Mantra or formula. 6 (In grammar,) An elementary term. E. उप before दिश to shew, affix घञ्.
7367: उपदेशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Giving instruction, instructing, instructive. m. (-कः) An instructor, a guide, specially a spiritual guide. E. उप before दिश to shew, ण्वुल् aff.
7368: उपदेशन n. (-नं) Advising, instructing. E. उप before दिश to shew, affix ल्युट्.
7369: उपदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Advising, an adviser. E. उपदेश advice, and इनि aff.
7370: उपदेष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be advised, (fit, proper, &c.) E. उप before दिश to shew, तव्य affix; also उपदेश्य, उपदेशनीय.
7371: उपदेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) One who points out, who orders or advises. m. (-ष्टा) A Guru, a spiritual guide. E. उप prefixed to दिश to shew, affix तृच्.
7372: उपदेह m. (-हः) 1 Liniment, ointment. 2 A minor or secondary body. E. उप and दिह plaster, or देह the body.
7373: उपदेहिका f. (-का) A kind of insect. E. उप with, &c. देह the body, affixes कन् and टाप्; also उत्पादिका.
7374: उपद्रव m. (-वः) 1 Tyranny, oppression. 2 National distress, whether the act of the seasons or the king, famine, exaction, &c. 3 National commotion, rebellion. 4 Violence. 5 A supervenient  disease, one brought one whilst a person labours under another. E. उप, द्रु to go, अच् aff.
7375: उपद्रविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Tyrannical. 2 Violent, factious. m. (-वी) 1 A tyrant, an oppressor. 2 A rebel. E. उपद्रव and इनि aff.
7376: उपद्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Supervisor, inspector, overseeing, overlooking. E. उप before दृश to see, तृच् affix, the vowel changed to र.
7377: उपद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tyrannized over, oppressed, visited by calamities, &c. E. उप before द्रु to go, क्त aff.
7378: उपधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 A heretic, a schismatic. 2 A minor or inferior duty. E. उप and धर्म्म duty.
7379: उपधा f. (-धा) 1 A false pretence. 2 Trial or test of honesty, &c. of four kinds, of loyalty, disinterestedness, continence, and courage. 3 A penultimate letter. E. उप, धा having, from घा, to have, with अङ् and टाप् affs.
7380: उपधातु m. (-तुः) 1 An inferior mineral, a semi-metal: seven are specified; pyrites, sulphate of copper, talc, antimony, red orpiment, yellow orpiment, and calx of brass. 2 Secondary secretion, as the milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph. E. उप minor, and धातु mineral, &c.
7381: उपधान n. (-नं) 1 A pillow. 2 Kindness, affection. 3 Poison. 4 Religious observance or obligation. 5 Excellence, excellent quality. 6 Resting or placing upon. E. उप, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.
7382: उपधानीय n. (-यं) A pillow. E. उपधान a pillow, and छ aff.
7383: उपधाय ind. Having placed or rested upon. E. उप before धा to hold, ल्युप् aff.
7384: उपधाशुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Approved, tried, of approved loyalty, &c. E. उपधा and शुचि pure.
7385: उपधि m. (-धिः) 1 Fraud, circumvention. 2 The wheel of a carriage. 3 Fear, terror. E. उप, धा to have, and कि aff.
7386: उपधिक m. (-कः) 1 A cheat, a knave, especially one who extorts money by threats. 2 Fraud. E. उपधि and कृ to make, ड aff. or कन् pleonasm.
7387: उपधूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Being at the point of death. 2 Suffering extreme pain. E. उप near or much, धूपित pained.
7388: उपधृति f. (-तिः) A ray of light. E. उप much, धृ to have, क्तिन् affix.
7389: उपनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Approached, approximate, near, (either in time or place.) E. उप near, नम to bow, affix क्तः.
7390: उपनय m. (-यः) The initiation of the three first classes; investiture with a peculiar thread or cord worn over the left shoulder, and under the right: the cord of the Brahman is of cotton, Munja, or Kusa grass; of the Kṣatriya, of Śaṇa or flax; and of the Vaiśya, of wool: the youths should be invested, respectively, from eight to sixteen, from eleven to twenty-two, and from twelve to twenty-four years of age. n. (-नं) 1 Attaining, gaining. 2 Bringing to. E. उप over, णीञ् to obtain, अच् affix; also with घञ् affix उपनाय, and with ल्युट् affix उपनयन.
7391: उपनयन n. (-नं) See the preceding. E. as before affix ल्युट्; also with अण् added उपनायन.
7393: उपनाह m. (-हः) 1 A plaster, an unguent applied to a wound or sore. 2 The tie of a lute, the lower part of the tail piece where the wires are fixed. 3 Inflammation of the ciliary glands, stye. E. उप, नह to bind, घञ् aff.
7394: उपनाहन n. (-नं) Unction, anointing, plastering. E. उप before नह to tie, ल्युट् aff.
7395: उपनिक्षेप m. (-पः) A deposit, sealed or in a cover, so that the contents are unknown. E. उप and निक्षेप the same.
7396: उपनिधान n. (-नं) A deposit: see the next. E. उप and नि before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
7397: उपनिधि m. (-धिः) A deposit, a pledge, property put into the care of a creditor, friend, &c. E. उप and नि before धा to have, कि affix; in law this word ordinarily implies more especially a sealed or enclosed deposit, but according to some, it is any article entrusted to a friend which he may use whilst in his keeping.
7398: उपनिषद् f. (-षत् or -षत्) 1 A portion of the religious writings of the Hindus; the theological part, and the Vedānta or argumentative part of the Vedas, either detached from or comprised in the principal work. 2 Virtue, moral merit. 3 Truth as the principle of divine being. 4 A neighbouring mansion. 5 A lonely place. E. उप and नि prefixed to षद to go, affix क्विप्; in which abide the essential parts of religion, &c.
7399: उपनिष्कर n. (-रं) 1 A street. 2 A principal or royal road. E. उप and नि before कृ to make, affix अप्, and स inserted.
7400: उपनिष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 1 A main or royal road. 2 An instituted observance or Saṃskāra, taking a child in the fourth month of its age into the open air. 3 Going forth. E. उप and नि before क्रम to go, affix ल्युट्, and स inserted.
7401: उपनिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deposited with, entrusted to. 2 Placed near to. 3 Offered, presented. E. उप and नि before धा to have, क्ति aff.
7402: उपनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Brought near to, approximated. 2 Obtained, attained. 3 Citing, adducing. 4 Presented. 5 Known. m. (-तः) The youth invested with the characteristic string: see उपनय. E. उप before नी to obtain, affix क्त.
7403: उपनीय ind. 1 Having brought. 2 Having invested. E. उप before नी to bring, ल्यप् aff.
7404: उपनुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Sent or dispatched. 2 Wafted, driven, (by the wind.) E. उप before नुद to send, क्त aff.
7405: उपन्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Pledged, deposited. 2 Given, communicated. 3 Brought forward, (as an example, &c.) adduced. 4 Placed near to, or in, or upon. E. उप and नि before अस to throw, affix क्त.
7406: उपन्यास m. (-सः) 1 A pledge, a pawn, a hostage. 2 An exordium or introduction. 3 A precept, a law. 4 Giving, imparting. 5 Juxtaposition. 6 A suggestion, a hint. E. उप and नि prefixed to अस, to throw or send, affix घञ्.
7407: उपन्यास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be pleaded. E. उप and न्यास्य to be adduced.
7408: उपपति m. (-तिः) A paramour, a gallant. E. उप in place of, पति a husband.
7409: उपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Association, connexion. 3 Fitness, propriety. 4 Cessation, end. 5 Possessing, having. 6 Ascertained or demonstrated conclusion. 7 Cause, reason. 8 Effecting, doing. 9 Religious abstraction. 10 (In arithmetic or geometry,) Proof, demonstration. E. उप before पद to go, क्तिन् aff.
7410: उपपत्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Right, fit, reasonable, proper. 2 United, associated. E. उपपत्ति and मतुप् poss. aff.
7411: उपपद n. (-दं) 1 Small, diminutive. 2 The subsidiary term in a compound word. 3 The first member of a compound word. 4 An aptote, a word sometimes used as an adverb and sometimes as an inflected noun. 5 A secondary noun in a sentence in conjunction or apposition. E. उप before पद a foot, or an inflected word.
