7412: उपपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Manifested. 2 Fit, suited to the occasion, adequate. 3 Done, shewn, proved, effected. 4 Endowed with, possessed of. 5 Produced from or by. 6 Physicked, cured. E. उप before पद to go, क्त aff.
7413: उपपातक n. (-कं) A great crime, as killing a cow, selling a daughter, atheism, &c; it is considered as criminality in the second or third degree, and is of various kinds: see महापातक. E. उप much, and पातक a crime.
7414: उपपातकिन् m. (-की) A sinner in any but the first degree. E. उपपातक and इनि aff.
7415: उपपादन n. (-नं) 1 Effecting, doing. 2 Giving, delivering, presenting. 3 Proving or establishing by argument. E. उप before पद to go, causal. form, ल्युट् aff.
7416: उपपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done, effected. 2 Given, delivered, presented. 3 Proved, accomplished. E. उप before पद to go, causal form, क्त aff.
7417: उपपादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Shod. m. (-कः) 1 A superhuman being, a god, a demon, &c. 2 Hell. E. उप before पद to go, उकञ् aff.
7418: उपपाप m. (-पः) A heinous crime, as killing a cow, &c. E. उप excess, and पाप sin.
7419: उपपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, nurtured. E. उप and पालित protected.
7420: उपपीडन n. (-नं) 1 Pain, agony, torture. 2 Inflicting pain. 3 Devastating, laying waste. E. उप before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.
7421: उपपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tortured, pained, distressed. 2 Devastated. E. उप before पीड to give pain, क्त aff.
7422: उपपुर n. (-रं) a suburb. E. उप near, पुर a city.
7423: उपपुराण n. (-णं) A Purāṇa, one not included in the eighteen principal: a similar number is reckoned, or 1 Ādi. 2 Nṛsiṃha. 3 Vāyu. 4 Śivadharma. 5 Durvasa. 6 Nārada. 7 Nandikeśvara. 8 Uśanas. 9 Kapila. 10 Varuṇa. 11 Sāmba. 12 Kālikā. 13 Maheśvara. 14 Padma. 15 Deva. 16 Parāśara. 17 Mārīca. 18 Bhāskara. E. उप minor, पुराण a Purāṇa.
7424: उपपुष्पिका f. (-का) Yawing, gaping. E. उप much, पुष्प to flower, to open as a flower, वुन् aff.
7425: उपप्रदान n. (-नं) A bribe. E. उप for assistance, प्रदा to give, affix ल्युट्.
7426: उपप्लव m. (-वः) 1 Rāhu, the ascending node. 2 A portent or natural phaenomenon so considered. 3 An affray or assault, a conflict without weapons. 4 Eclipse. 5 Misfortune. E. उप over &c. प्न to go, अप aff.
7427: उपप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Distressed, pained. 2 Harassed (by Rāhu, &c.) eclipsed. 3 Assailed, beset. 4 Marked by prodigies. 5 Wet, moistened. f. (-ता) Morbid sensibility of the uterus. E. उप before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
7428: उपभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Used, enjoyed, possessed. E. उप before भुज to enjoy, क्त aff.
7429: उपभुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Using, enjoying. E. उप before भुज to enjoy, शानच् aff.
7430: उपभृत् f. (-भृत्) A cup of a round shape, made of the wood of the banian tree, and used in sacrifices. E. उप, भृ to fill, क्विप् and तुक् affs.
7431: उपभोग m. (-गः) 1 Pleasure, satisfaction. 2 Enjoyment, use. 3 Cohabitation. 4 Use, usufruct. E. उप excess, भुज् to eat, &c. affix घञ्.
7432: उपभोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) To be used, to be enjoyed. E. उप before भुज् to enjoy, य affix; also उपभोजनीय and उपभोक्तव्य.
7433: उपमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Reproach, abuse. 2 Refuting a charge. E. उप, मृद to tread down, अच् aff.
7434: उपमर्दक m. (-कः) The refuting of a charge. E. कन् added to the last.
7435: उपम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Like, (but used only in composition.) f. (-मा) 1 Resemblance, a resemblance as a picture, an image, &c. 2 A simile. E. उप like, मा to measure, affixes, अङ् and टाप्; also with ल्युट् affix, उपमान.
7436: उपमातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) An image maker, a portrait painter. E. उप before मा to measure, तृच् affix. f. (-त्री) 1 A wet nurse. 2 A near female relative. E. उप like, मातृ a mother.
7438: उपमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compared. E. उप and मा to measure, क्त.
7439: उपमिति f. (-तिः) 1 Resemblance, comparison, a likeness, a picture, image, &c. 2 Analogy. 3 Knowledge of things derived from analogy or resemblances. E. उप like, मा to measure, क्तिन् aff.
7440: उपमेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compared with. m. (-तः) The Śāl, a timber tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. उपम like, इत gone: high as a mountain, &c.
7441: उपमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be compared with or to. n. (-यं) The subject of a comparison, as the face is of the moon. E. उप before मा to measure, य aff.
7442: उपमेयोपमा f. (-मा) The resemblance of any object to that compared with it, as of the moon to a beautiful face. E. उपमेय and उपमा likeness.
7443: उपयन्तृ m. (-न्ता) A husband, a master. E. उप, यम to cease, तृच् aff.
7444: उपयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A small instrument or implement. 2 An application of a similar nature, as actual cautery, escharotics, &c. E. उप and यन्त्र instrument.
7445: उपयम m. (-मः) Marriage. E. उप and यम to stop, affix अप्.
7446: उपयाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A present solicitor, one who asks or begs. E. उप before याच to beg, वुन् aff.
7447: उपयाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Requested, solicited. 2 Offered, especially to the deities to render them propitious. E. उप much, याच to ask or beg, affix क्त, or with कन् added उपयाचितक.
7448: उपयाम m. (-मः) Marriage. E. उप, यम to refrain, affix घञ.
7449: उपयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Proper, right. 2 Adapted to, suitable, appropriate, useful. 3 Touched by. 4 Taken. 5 Eaten. E. उप before युज to join, affix क्त.
7450: उपयुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Taking, appropriating, attaching. E. उप before युजि to join, शानच् aff.
7451: उपयोग m. (-गः) 1 Good conduct, observing established practices. 2 Any act tending to effect a desired object. 3 Fitness, suitableness. 4 Service, utility. 5 Use, application. 6 Contact, proximity. 7 Administration of medicines. 3 Preparation of them. E. उप before युज to join, घञ् aff.
7452: उपयोगिता f. (-ता) 1 Fitness, suitableness. 2 Usefulness. 2 Occasion, need. 4 Favour, propitiousness. E. उपयोगिन् and तल् affix, or with त्व, उपयोगित्वं.
7453: उपयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Appropriate, suitable. 2 Conducive or contributing to, serviceable, useful. 3 Favourable, propitious. 4 Touching, in contact with. E. उपयोग and इनि aff.
7454: उपयोषम् ind. A word expressing great pleasure: see उपजोषम्.
7455: उपरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Afflicted with pain or calamity. m. (-क्तः) 1 Eclipsed, (the sun or moon.) 2 Rāhu, (the ascending node.) E. उप implying distress, रञ्ज to colour, and क्त aff.
7456: उपरक्षण n. (-णं) A guard, an outpost. E. उप, रक्ष to defend or protect, affix ल्युट्.
7457: उपरचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made, prepared. E. उप and रचित made.
7458: उपरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stopped, ceased. 2 Dead. E. उप before रम to please, क्त aff.
7459: उपरतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Void of desire. E. उपरत and स्पृह desire.
7460: उपरति f. (-तिः) 1 Stopping, ceasing. 2 Refraining from sensual enjoyment. 3 Abstaining from prescribed acts. 4 Great or exquisite pleasure. 5 Death. E. उप reverse or excess, रम to please, क्तिन् affix; also with घञ् affix उपरम or उपराम.
7462: उपरमण n. (-णं) Abstaining from ceremonial acts or from the pleasures of sense, &c. 2 Ceasing, discontinuance. E. उप before रम to please, affix ल्युट्.
7463: उपरस m. (-सः) 1 A secondary mineral, as red chalk. bitumen, &c. 2 A secondary passion. 3 A subordinate flavour. E. उप minor, रस flavour, &c.
7464: उपराग m. (-गः) 1 An eclipse of the sun or moon. 2 Rāhu or the ascending node. 3 Calamity, affliction. 4 Misbehaviour, ill conduct. 5 Reproach, abuse. E. उप, रञ्ज to colour, घञ् aff.
7465: उपराम m. (-मः) Stopping, ceasing: see उपरति. E. उप, रम to please, घञ् aff.
7466: उपरि ind. On, upon, above. E. उप and रि aff.
7467: उपरिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone up, ascended. E. उपरि and गत gone.
7468: उपरिचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Piled over or above. E. उपरि and चित collected.
7469: उपरिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) High, elevated, produced above. E. उपरि and ज born.
7470: उपरिष्टात् ind. Up, above. E. उप and रिष्टातिल् aff.
7471: उपरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Obstructed, impeded. 2 Covered, spread. 3 Favoured, protected. E. उप and रुद्ध checked.
7472: उपरोध m. (-धः) 1 Impediment, opposition, check, refusal. 2 Favour, protection. 3 Surrounding, blockading. 4 Binding, tying. 5 Taking hold of. E. उप before रुध to hinder, affix घञ्.
7473: उपरोधक n. (-कं) An inner room, a private apartment. E. उप near, रुध to enclose, वुन् aff.
7474: उपर्य्युपरि ind. 1 Over, upon, above, what is above. 2 Near, neighbouring. E. उपरि repeated.
7475: उपल m. (-लः) A rock or stone, a precious stone or jewel. f. (-ला) Refined or candied sugar. E. उप near, ला to give or take; affix ड.
7476: उपलक्ष्य mfn. (क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Inferable. m. (-क्ष्यः) 1 A prop, a stay, a support, an asylum. 2 An inference. E. उप near, लक्ष्य to be marked or sought.
7477: उपलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Designating or implying any analogous object where only one is specified, using a term in a generic sense. 2 Metaphorical or elliptical expression. E. उप comprehensive, लक्षण a mark or designation.
7478: उपलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Comprehended, included, implied, understood. E. उप before, लक्ष to designate, क्त aff.
7479: उपलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Obtained, received. 2 Understood, known. 3 Perceived. E. उप before लभ to get, क्त aff.
7480: उपलब्धार्था f. (-र्था.) A tale, a true or probable story. E. उपलब्ध understood, अर्थ meaning.
7481: उपलब्धि f. (-ब्धिः) 1 Mind, understanding. 2 Knowledge, especially religious. 3 Gain, acquisition. 4 Perceptibility, appearance. E. उप, लभ to obtain, क्तिन् aff.
7482: उपलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Apprehension, conception, comprehension otherwise than from memory. E. उप near, लभि to obtain, घञ् aff.
7483: उपलभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) 1 To be obtained. 2 To be understood. ind. Having observed. E. उप before लभ to get, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
7484: उपलम्भ्य mfn. (-म्भ्यः-म्भ्या-म्भ्यं) Commendable, praiseworthy, respectable. E. उप before लभ to get, ण्यत् affix, and म augment.
7486: उपलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A portent, a natural phaenomenon considered as announcing evil. E. उप over, लिगि to go, affix घञ्.
7487: उपलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Smeared, plastered. E. उप and लिप्त smeared.
7488: उपलिप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wishing to take or seize. E. उप before लभ to gain, desider. form, क्त aff.
7489: उपलेप m. (-पः) Plastering, smearing, anointing. E. उप, लिप to smear, affix घञ्.
7490: उपलेपन n. (-नं) Smearing, plastering with cow dung, &c. E. उप, लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.
7491: उपवन n. (-नं) A garden, a grove. E. उप like, and वन a wood.
7492: उपवर्णन n. (-नं) Minute description. E. उप and वर्णन describing.
7493: उपवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 A country inhabited or not. 2 An uninhabited country. 3 A division, a district or Pergana. 4 A kingdom. E. उप, वृत to abide, ल्युट् aff.
7494: उपवर्ष m. (-र्षः) The name of a saint.
7495: उपवर्ह m. (-र्हः) A pillow. E. उप over, वर्ह to excel, &c. घञ् aff.
7496: उपवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. उप, वस to abide, थक् Uṇādi aff.
7497: उपवस्त n. (-स्तं) A fast, fasting. E. उप, वस to abide, क्त affix; or with घञ् affix उपवास.
7498: उपवास n. (-सः) 1 A fast, fasting: when observed as a religious act, it comprises abstinence from all sensual gratification, from perfumes, flowers, unguents, ornaments, betel, music and dancing, &c. 2 A fire altar. E. उप before वस to abide, घञ् aff.
7499: उपवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Fasting, one who observes a fast. E. उपवास and इनि aff.
7500: उपवाहन n. (-नं) Carrying, bringing back. E. उप and वाहन bearing.
7501: उपवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) 1 A king's elephant. 2 Any royal vehicle. E. उप above, वह to bear, ण्यत् aff.
7502: उपविद्या f. (-द्या) Profane science, inferior sort of knowledge. E. उप and विद्या knowledge.
7503: उपविष n. (-षं) 1 Factitious poison. 2 A narcotic, any deleterious drug, as opium, Datura, &c. E. उप like, विष poison. f. (-षा) A plant, Atis. E. उप reverse, and विष poison: an antidote.
7504: उपविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Seated, sitting. 2 Arrived, entered. E. उप upon, विष्ट placed, entered.
7505: उपवीत n. (-तं) The thread or cord worn by the three first classes of Hindus, over the left shoulder and under the right. E. उप much, वी to shine, affix क्त; see उपनय.
7506: उपवीतिन् m. (-ती) The Brahman who wears the string in the usual manner, or on the left shoulder and under the right arm. E. उपवीत and इनि aff.
7507: उपवृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Collected from, possessed of. E. उप and वृंहित collected.
7508: उपवेद m. (-दः) A minor Veda, or which four are reckoned, treating of the military art, medicine, music, and mechanics. E. उप and वेद a Veda.
7509: उपवेश m. (-शः) 1 Sitting, resting. 2 A seat. 3 Voiding by stool. E. उप before विश to enter, affix घञ्.
7510: उपवेशन n. (-नं) 1 Sitting, resting. 2 Voiding by stool. E. उप before विश to enter, active or causal form, ल्युट् aff.
7511: उपवेश्य ind. Having seated or caused to sit. E. उप before विश to enter, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
7512: उपव्याघ्र m. (-घ्रः) The hunting leopard. E. उप and व्याघ्र a tiger.
7513: उपशम m. (-मः) 1 Tranquillity, calmness, patience. 2 Intermission, cessation, relaxation. E. उप much, शम to be tranquil, अप् aff.
7514: उपशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Productive of happiness or rest. m. (-यः) 1 Ascertainment of disease or diagnosis by the effect of certain articles of food or medicine. 2 Allaying disease by diet, regimen, &c. E. उप before शी to sleep, अञ् aff.
7515: उपशल्य n. (-ल्यं) A space near a village. E. उप near, शल to go, यत् aff.
7516: उपशान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Calm, tranquil. 2 Appeased, pacified. 3 Diminished, intermitted. E. उप before शम to be tranquil, क्त aff.
7517: उपशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Tranquillity, calm. 2 Appeasing, allaying. 3 Cessation, intermission, remission. E. उप before शम to be quiet, क्तिन् aff.
7518: उपशान्तिन् mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिनी-न्ति) Tranquil, calm, appeased, tame. (-न्ती) A tame elephant. E. उपशान्त and इनि aff.
7519: उपशाय m. (-यः) Watching and sleeping alternately. E. उप alternately, -शी to sleep, घञ् aff.
7520: उपशायिता f. (-ता) 1 Tranquillizing, calming. 2 Secondary means of cure, as diet, &c. E. उपशायिन् and तल् affix; also with त्व, उपशायित्वं.
7521: उपशायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Allaying, tranquillizing, what calms, &c. 2 (In medicine,) Composing, narcotic. E. उप before शी to sleep, causal form, णिनि aff.
7522: उपशोभित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Adorned. E. उप and शोभित beautified.
7523: उपश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Promised, agreed. E. उप with श्रु to hear, affix क्त.
7524: उपश्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 Promise, assent. 2 Judicial astrology, aspect of the stars, fortune-telling. E. उप above, श्रु to hear, क्तिन् aff.
7525: उपसंक्षेप m. (-पः) An abstract or compendium. E. उप and संक्षेप abridgement.
7526: उपसंख्यान n. (-नं) (In grammar,) A substitute in form or sense, a consignificant term or affix. E. उप near, संख्या to number, ल्युट् aff.
7527: उपसंग्रह m. (-हः) Obeisance, civil address, respectful salutation of a person by name. 2 Taking, holding. E. उप near, सम् with, ग्रह to take, affix घञ्, or with ल्युट् affix उपसंग्रहण.
7528: उपसंग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Respectable, venerable. 2 To be saluted reverentially. E. उप and सं before ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
7529: उपसंगृह्य ind. Having taken, holding. E. उप and सं before ग्रह to take, ल्यप् aff.
7530: उपसंव्यान n. (-नं) A lower garment. E. उप and सं before व्येञ् to cover, ल्युट् affix; what covers the body.
7531: उपसंहरण n. (-णं) 1 Refusing, withholding. 2 Excluding. 3 Taking away. 4 Attacking, invading. E. उप and सम् before हरण taking.
7532: उपसंहरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Taking away. 2 Refusing, excepting. 3 Going against, invading. E. उप and सं before हृ to take, शतृ aff.
7533: उपसंहार m. (-रः) 1 Witholding, refusing. 2 Taking away. 3 Excepting, excluding. 4 Destruction, death, end. 5 Collection, assemblage. 6 A compendium. 7 Brevity, conciseness. 8 Attacking, invasion. 9 (In logic,) Refutation. E. उप and सम् before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
7534: उपसंहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Withheld, denied, refused. 2 Excepted. 3 Compressed, comprehended, excluded. E. उप and सम् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
7535: उपसंहृति f. (-तिः) 1 A compound expressive of various meanings. 2 Comprehension. 3 Seizing, taking. E. उप and सम् before हृ to take, क्तिन् aff.
7536: उपसत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Meeting, union. 2 Service. 3 Gift, donation. E. उप with, षद to go, &c. क्तिन् aff.
7537: उपसद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who goes near to. m. (-दः) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Approach. E. उप and षद to go, affix अच्.
7538: उपसदन n. (-नं) A neighbouring abode, a neighbourhood. E. उप near, and सदन a dwelling.
7539: उपसन्ध्यम् ind. Near evening. E. उप near, सन्ध्या evening.
7540: उपसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Approached, approximate. E. उप over, षद to go, affix क्त.
7541: उपसन्नता f. (-ता) Proximity, approach. E. उपसन्न and तल् affix; also उपसन्नत्वं with त्व aff.
7542: उपसमाधान n. (-नं) Placing, putting in or on. E. उप and सम् with आङ् before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
7543: उपसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Dressed, cooked. 2 Immolated, sacrificed, (as a victim, &c.) 3 Dead, deceased. 4 Gained, obtained. 5 Enough, sufficient. 6 Perfected, finished. E. उप and सम् prefixed to पद to go, affix क्त.
7544: उपसर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 The first pregnancy or impregnation of a cow, &c. 2 Who or what approaches. E. उप, सृ to go, and अप् aff.
7545: उपसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A portent, a natural phaenomenon supposed to announce future evil, an eclipse, &c. 2 A particle prefixed to roots, &c. a preposition. 3 A disease, possession by an evil spirit. 4 Change occasioned by any disease. 5 A disease brought on whilst a person labours under another. 6 Indication or symptom of death. E. उप near or with, सृज to go, घञ् aff.
7546: उपसर्जन n. (-नं) 1 A representative, a substitute, any person or thing subordinate or subsidiary. 2 Portent, eclipse. 3 Approaching. E. उप inferior, सृज to go, ल्युट् affix. In the first. sense, though used as an attributive, it is always neuter.
7547: उपसर्पण n. (-णं) Approaching, advancing to. E. उप near, सृप to to, ल्युट् aff.
7548: उपसर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A cow, (fit for the bull.) E. उप, सृ to go, यत् affix, deriv. irr.
7549: उपसार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be approached or gone to. E. उप, सृ to go, ण्यत् aff.
7550: उपसुन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a demon. E. उप, and सुन्द another demon.
7551: उपसूर्य्यक n. (-कं) The disk of the sun or moon. E. उप near, or with, सूर्य्य the sun, कन् affix of identity.
7552: उपसृत्य ind. Having approached. E. उप before सृ to go, ल्यप् aff.
7553: उपसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Attended by or accompanied with, jointed. attached, connected, to or with. 2 Eclipsed, (as the sun or moon.) 3 Seized by, possessed by, (evil demons, &c.) n. (-ष्टं) Coition, copulation. E. उप, सृज to create, &c. affix क्त.
7554: उपसेवन n. (-नं) 1 Service. 2 Addiction to. E. उप and सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.
7555: उपस्कर m. (-रः) 1 A condiment, a spice or seasoning, mustard, pepper, &c. 2 An article of household use, as a broom, a basket, &c. 3 Blame, censure. E. उप complete, and कर what makes, स inserted.
7556: उपस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blamed, censured. E. उप and कृत made, स inserted.
7557: उपस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) Support of life, as food, sleep, and government of the passions. E. उप and स्तभि to stop, घञ् aff.
7558: उपस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A concubine. E. उप and स्त्री a female, a wife.
7559: उपस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Near, proximate. m. (-स्थः) 1 The male or female organs of generation. 2 The haunch or hip. 3 The anus. E. उप near, and स्थ what is or stays, ड affix after स्था.
7561: उपस्थनिग्रह m. (-हः) Continence. E. उपस्थ an organ of generation, and निग्रह restraining.
7562: उपस्थातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A servant. E. उप, स्था to remain, तृच् aff.
7563: उपस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Proximity, nearness. 2 Obtaining, getting. 3 An assembly. E. उप near, स्था to stay, ल्युट् aff.
7564: उपस्थानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be stayed with or near. 2 What ought to be near or with. E. उप, स्था to stay, अनीयर् aff.
7565: उपस्थापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Placing or bringing near to. 2 Explaining, teaching, a teacher. 3 Causing to obtain. E. उप before स्था to be, causal form, वुन् aff.
7566: उपस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Placing near. 2 Attendance, service. E. उप and स्थापन placing.
7567: उपस्थापयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be placed near. E. उप before स्था to stay, causal form, तव्य affix; also उपस्थापनीय.
7568: उपस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed near to. 2 Attended. E. उप before स्था to stay, causal form, क्त aff.
7569: उपस्थाय ind. 1 Having approached. 2 Having brought near to or assembled. E. उप near, and स्था to stay, ल्यप् aff.
7570: उपस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Standing near, being present. E. उप before स्था to stay, णिनि affix, युक् augment.
7571: उपस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Approached, arrived. 2 Staying by or near to. 3 Caused, occasioned. 4 Got, received. 5 Felt. 6 Clean, cleansed. 7 Done, accomplished. 8 Known. E. उप, स्था to stay, affix क्त.
7572: उपस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Proximity. 2 Obtaining, getting. 3 Effecting, accomplishing. 4 Arrival. 5 Knowledge. E. उप before स्था to be, affix क्तिन्.
7573: उपस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 Touching, contact. 2 Bathing, ablution. 3 Rincing the mouth, sipping water and ejecting it. E. उप like, स्पर्श touch, from स्पृश to touch, and अच् affix; or with ल्युट् affix, उपस्पर्शन.
7575: उपस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Touched. 2 Sipped. E. उप and स्पृष्ट touched.
7576: उपस्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Revenue, profit, what is derived from land or other capital. E. उप and खत्व ownership.
7577: उपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Destroyed. 2 Injured, impaired, evilly affected by. 3 Struck by lightning, &c. 4 Pained, hurt. 5 Impure. 6 Infected, polluted, vitiated. E. उप and हत struck.
7578: उपहतदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Dazzled, blinded. E. उपहत struck, दृश the eye.
7579: उपहतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्मं) Agitated, affected as by passion, &c. E. उपहत and आत्मन् the soul.
7580: उपहरण n. (-णं) 1 Offering gifts to superiors. 2 Presenting victims. 3 Distributing or serving out food. 4 Taking, seizing. E. उप and हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
7581: उपहर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be offered as a victim. 2 To be presented. E. उप before हृ to take, तव्य affix; also उपहरणीय.
7582: उपहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Offering victims, serving out food, &c. E. उप before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
7583: उपहव m. (-वः) 1 Calling to. 2 Summoning, invoking. E. उप before हृ to call, अप् aff.
7584: उपहसित n. (-तं) Laughter, laughing. E. उप up, हसित laughing.
7585: उपहार m. (-रः) 1 A complimentary gift, a present to a superior, &c. 2 A victim, an offering to a deity. 3 Tribute, indemnification, presents as the price of peace. 4 Food distributed to guests, &c. E. उप, हृ to convey, घञ् aff.
7586: उपहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Giving, presenting. 2 Sacrificing E. उपहार and इनि aff.
7587: उपहालक m. (-कः) The name of a country, part of the peninsula: see कुन्तल. E. उप, हाल a king so named, affix कः, the country over which HĀLA reigned.
7588: उपहास m. (-सः) Ridicule, laughing at any one. E. उप and हस to laugh, affix घञ्.
7589: उपहास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Ridiculous, laughable. E. उप and हास्य to be laughed at.
7590: उपहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, deposited, placed in or upon. 2 Laid aside. 3 Joined. 4 Mixed. E. उप before हा to quit, क्त aff.
7591: उपहूय ind. Having called or addressed. E. उप near, ह्वे to call, ल्यप् aff.
7592: उपहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, collected, gathered. 2 Offered, presented. 3 Immolated, offered as a victim. 4 Served out as food. E. उप before हृ to take, क्त aff.
7593: उपह्वर n. (-रं) 1 Solitary, private. 2 Near. m. (-रः) A car, a carriage. E. उप, ह्वृ to bend, अप् aff.
7594: उपांशु m. (-शुः) Muttering prayers, reciting them in a low voice so as not to be overheard. ind. 1 Solitary, private. 2 Secretly, in a whisper. E. उप, अंशु a ray.
7595: उपाकरण n. (-णं) 1 Performance of a preparatory rite before reading the Vedas. 2 Immolation, sacrifice of an animal duly consecrated. E. उप and आङ् prefixed to कृ to do, affix, ल्युट्.
7596: उपाकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Preparation. 1 A ceremony performed before reading the Vedas. 2 Beginning to read the Vedas. E. see the preceding, the affix being मनिन्.
7597: उपाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attended with evil omens, disastrous, calamitous. m. (-तः) 1 A victim slain or to be slain. 2 A portent, a phaenomenon announcing calamity. E. उप and आङ् before कृत made.
7598: उपाख्यान n. (-नं) 1 A tale, a narrative. 2 Telling, narration. E. उप and आख्यान a tale.
7599: उपागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Suffering, feeling. 2 Promised. 3 Approached, arrived. 4 Occurred, happened. E. उप and आङ् before गम to go, affix क्त.
7600: उपागम m. (-मः) 1 Promise, agreement. 2 Approach. 3 Occurrence, arrival. 4 Feeling, suffering. E. उप near, आङ् before गम to come, अच् aff.
7601: उपाग्रहण m. (-णं) Reading the Vedas after initiation. E. उप and आङ् before ग्रह to take, ल्युट् affix: see उपाकरण.
7602: उपाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The sectarial mark made with Sandal, &c. on the forehead. 2 Any minor limb or member. 3 Secondary portion of science. E. उप and अङ्ग the body.
7603: उपाञ्जन n. (-नं) Plastering the ground with cow dung, &c. E. उप and अञ्जन anointing.
7604: उपात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Taken, received, gained, got. m. (-त्तः) An elephant out of rut. E. उप near, आत्त taken, seized.
7605: उपात्तरंहस् mfn. (-हाः-हाः-हः) Quick, fleet. E. उपात्त acquired, रंहस् speed.
7606: उपात्तशास्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Armed, taking up arms. E. उपात्त and शास्त्र a weapon.
7607: उपात्यय m. (-यः) 1 Neglect or disobedience of ordinances or customs. 2 Disorder or disorderly behaviour. E. उप and अति prefixed to इण to go, अच् aff.
7608: उपादान n. (-नं) 1 Taking away, abduction, taking. 2 Abstraction, restraining the organs of sense and perception. 3 Cause, motive. 4 Immediate or proximate cause. 5 The formal or distinct form, the material cause. 6 A double meaning, an expression conveying a sense besides that which appears intended. 7 Saying, speaking. E. उप near, आदा to take, ल्युट् aff.
7609: उपादानकारण n. (-णं) A proximate cause. E. उपादान and कारण cause.
7611: उपादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Acceptable, admissible, to be taken or received. 2 Excellent, admirable. E. उप and आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
7612: उपाधि m. (-धिः) 1 Virtuous reflection. 2 A discriminative or distinguishing property, an attribute. 3 Deception, disguise. (In the Vedānta this is especially applied to certain natural forms or properties, considered as disguises of the spirit.) 4 A title, a discriminative appellation, a nickname. 5 Careful or diligent for the support of a family, (always masculine, though with a feminine or neuter substantive.) 6 A purpose, an occasion, an object. 7 (In logic,) A special cause for a general effect. 3 (In rhetoric,) The natural character of species, quality, or action. E. उप and आङ् before धा to have, affix कि.
7613: उपाध्याय m. (-यः) A spiritual preceptor. f. (-या) A female preceptor. (-यी or -यानी) The wife of a teacher. E. उप and अधि before इण to go, घञ् affix, for the fem. टाप् affix in the first instance, in the second ङीष् with or without आनुक inserted.
7614: उपानह् f. (-नत्) A shoe. E. उप and आङ् before नह to bind, affix क्विप्.
7615: उपान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Near. m. (-न्तः) The angle of the eye. E. उप near, अन्त end.
7616: उपान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Near, proximate, neighbouring. E. उपान्त and ठञ् aff.
7617: उपान्त्य m. (-न्त्यः) The corner of the eye. n. (-न्त्यं) Vicinity. E. उप and अन्त्य end.
7618: उपाय m. (-यः) 1 A means, an expedient, a way. 2 A means of success against an enemy; four are usually enumerated as, sowing dissension, chastisement, conciliation and gifts. 3 Approaching, approach. E. उप and आङ् before इण to go, affix घञ्.
7619: उपायज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Fertile in expedients, contriving, providing for. E. उपाय and ज्ञ who knows.
7620: उपायन n. (-नं) 1 A present, a complimentary or respectful gift. 2 Approaching, going near to. 3 Engaging in a religious observance. E. उप, अय to go, ल्युट् aff.
7621: उपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Expert in the use of means. E. उपाय and इनि aff.
7622: उपाययोग m. (-गः) Application of means, or combination of expedients. E. उपाय and योग union.
7623: उपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquiring property, earning. E. उप and अर्ज्जन gaining.
7624: उपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained, acquired, earned. E. उप and अर्ज्जित gained.
7625: उपारत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Engaged in, occupied by. 2 Frequenting, resorting to. E. उप and आङ् before रम to sport, क्त.
7626: उपारम m. (-मः) 1 Engaging in. 2 Going to or in. E. उप and आङ् before रम to sport, affix अच्.
7627: उपालब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Reproached, reviled. E. उप and आङ् before लभि to hurt, affix क्त.
7628: उपालम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Abuse, reviling. 2 Deferring, delaying. E. उप and आङ्, लभि to injure, अच् aff.
7629: उपावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning round, revolving. 2 Ceasing. 3 Turning back, returning. 4 Approaching. E. उप and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
7630: उपावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Rolling on the ground. 2 Ceased, ceasing, refraining. m. (-त्तः) A horse rolling himself on the ground. E. उप and आङ् before वृत to be, affix क्त.
7631: उपाश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Asylum, support. 2 Reliance, dependance upon. E. उप and आङ् before श्री to serve, affix अच्.
7632: उपाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Supporting, (literally or figuratively,) bearing, holding, protecting. 2 Relying or depending upon. E. उप near, and आश्रित giving support.
7633: उपासक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Worshipping, a worshipper. 2 Serving, a servant. 3 A Śūdra. E. उप before अस to be, वुन् aff.
7634: उपासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A quiver. E. उप and आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, घञ् aff.
7635: उपासन n. (-नं) 1 Archery. 2 Service. 3 A seat. 4 Assembling. 5 Injuring, hurting. f. (-ना) 1 Service. 2 Worship, adoration. E. उप, आस to sit, or आङ् before उस to throw or send, affix युच् and fem. टाप्.
7636: उपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Served, honoured, worshipped. 2 Serving, paying worship or service. E. उप inferiority, आस to sit or remain, affix क्त.
7637: उपासितृ m. (-ता) A worshipper. E. उप and आङ् before आस to sit, तृन् aff.
7638: उपासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Sitting with or near to. 2 Occupying. E. उप and आसीन seated.
7639: उपास्ति f. (-स्तिः) Service, especially of a deity, worship. E. उप and आस to sit, क्तिन् aff.
7640: उपास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be worshipped or served. ind. 1 Having served or worshipped. 2 Having associated or called together. E. उप before आस to sit, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
7641: उपास्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being served or worshipped, receiving homage. E. उप before आस to sit, शानच् aff.
7642: उपाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined, annexed. 2 Deposited, placed. 3 Put on, worn. 4 Agreed upon, made or done mutually. (-तः) A fiery portent, a meteor, a comet. E. उप and आङ् before धा to have or hold, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
7643: उपाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Prepared. 2 Taken, seized. E. उप and आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
7644: उपेक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining. 2 Patient, enduring. E. उप before ईक्ष to see, वुन् aff.
7645: उपेक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Leaving, abandoning. 5 Disregarding, neglecting, disdaining. E. उप and ईक्षण seeing.
7646: उपेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Trick, deceit, one of the minor expedients in war. 2 Abandoning, leaving. 3 Dissent. 4 Negligence, neglect. 5 Endurance, patience. 6 Contempt, disdain. E. उप, ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् affs.
7647: उपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disregarded, disesteemed, neglected, disdained. E. उप, and ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
7648: उपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Endowed with, possessed of, having, possessing. 2 Arrived at, come to, come near to. 3 Invested. E. उप and इत gone.
7649: उपेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Contriving, a contriver, one who employs expedients. 2 Approaching, going near to. E. उप before इण to go, तृच् aff.
7650: उपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. उप after, इन्द्र INDRA: born subsequently to INDRA.
7651: उपेन्द्रवज्रा f. (-ज्रा) A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.
7652: उपेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be sought, to be had recourse to. 2 To be gone to or approached. 3 To be effected by any means. E. उप before इण to go, यत् aff.
7653: उपेयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वत्) 1 Accompanied or followed by, associated with, united. 2 Obtained, got. E. उप near, इण to go, क्वसु aff.
7654: उपेयुस् mfn. (-यूः-यूः-युः) Arrived at, gone to. E. उप before इण to go, उस् aff.
7655: उपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Married. 3 Arrayed, arranged. E. उप before, वह to bear, affix क्त.
7656: उपोती f. (-ती) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.) E. उप much, उद water, deriv. irr.
7658: उपोदिका f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella rubra or lucida.) E. उप and उद water, कन् and टाप् affixes, and इ substituted for the pen. or ई being substituted उपोदीका.
7659: उपोद्घात m. (-तः) 1 A beginning, a thing begun. 2 An introduction, a preface. 3 An example, an apposite argument or illustration. 4 Analysis, the ascertainment of the elements of which a thing consists. E. उप before हन to injure, affix घञ्.
7660: उपोषण n. (-णं) A fast, fasting. E. उप, वस to abide, affix ल्युट्.
7661: उपोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fasted, fasting. (-तं) Fast, fasting. E. उप before वस to abide, क्त aff.
7662: उप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sown, (as seed.) E. वप to sow, affix क्त.
7663: उप्तकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ploughed after sowing. E. उप्त and कृष्ट ploughed.
7664: उप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Sowing seeds. E. वप to sow, क्तिन् aff.
7665: उप्तिविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) An agriculturist. E. उप्ति and विद who knows.
7666: उप्तिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Sown, cultivated. E. वप to sow, क्त्रि affix, and मम् added.
7667: उब्ज r. 6th cl. (उब्जति) To be straight: with नि prefixed, (न्युब्जति) To be crooked: this root is also written उब्ज and उद्ज.
7668: उभ r. 6th cl. (उभति) To fill; also उम्भ.
7669: उभ pron. m. and dual only, (उभौ) Both.
7670: उभय pron. (sing. and plu. only,) (-यः-ये) Both. E. उभ and य from या to obtain, affix ड.
7671: उभयतस् ind. On both sides. E. उभय both, and तसि aff.
7672: उभयतोदत् mf. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Having a double row of teeth, (man, animal, &c.) E. उभयतस् and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
7673: उभयतोमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking either way, two-faced. E. उमयतस् and मुख face.
7674: उभयत्र ind. In both places, on both sides. E. उभय and त्रल् aff.
7675: उभयथा ind. In both ways. E. उभय and थाल् aff.
7676: उभयद्युस् ind. Both days, the day past and to come. E. उभय both, द्युस् affix; or with एद्युस् affix, उभयेद्युस्.
7677: उभयभागहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Applicable to two purposes. 2 Taking two shares or parts. n. (-रं) A medicine that acts in two ways, as an emetic and a purge. E. उभय, भाग a part, and हर what takes.
7678: उभयवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Serving two masters, being in the pay of both. E. उभय and वेतन wages.
7679: उभयसम्भव m. (-वः) A dilemma. E. उभय both, (conclusions,) सम्भव production.
7680: उभयानुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agreed to or accepted mutually, or on both sides. E. उभय and अनुमत assented to.
7681: उभयार्थम् ind. For a double object, (as for prosperity in earth and happiness in heaven.) E. उभय and अर्थ an object.
7682: उम् ind. An interjection, 1 Of anger. 2 Interrogation. 3 Promise or assent; and 4 Of cordiality or pacification.
7683: उम m. (-मः) 1 A city, a town. 2 A wharf, a landing place, f. (-मा) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ or DURGĀ. 2 Light, splendor. 3 Fame, reputation. 4 Turmeric. 5 Flax, (Linum utilatissimum.) 6 Quiet, tranquillity. E. उ particle of calling, and मा prohibition: i. e. “Practise not austerities,” the exclamation addressed to DURGĀ by her mother: in the other senses it may be derived from मा to measure, or मा lustre.
7684: उमाकट m. (-टः) The cluster of flax. E. उमा flax, कच् aff.
7685: उमागुरु m. (-रुः) The mountain Himālaya. E. उमा the goddess, and गुरु a spiritual teacher: in mythology the personified mountain is the father of UMĀ.
7686: उमापति m. (-तिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. उमा and पति master; the husband of UMĀ.
7687: उमावन n. (-नं) A name of Vanapura or Devī Koṭa, (Devi Cote.) E. उमा and वन a grove; the residence of UMĀ.
7688: उमासुत m. (-तः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. उमा and सुत a son, the son of PĀRVATĪ.
7689: उमेश m. (-शः) A title of ŚIVA. E. उमा and ईश a lord: see उमापति.
7690: उम्भ r. 6th cl. (प) (उम्भति) To fill; also उभ.
7691: उम्य n. (-म्यं) A field of linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.) E. उमा flax, and यत् affix; also औमीन.
7692: उम्वर m. (-रः) The upper-timber of a door frame. E. उद् up, above, वृ to screen, अप् aff.
7693: उम्वी f. (-म्वी) The stalks of wheat or barley friend over a fire of wet grass, considered as a tonic.
7694: उरःक्षत n. (-तं) Injury of the lungs, breaking a blood vessel, consumption. E. उरस् and क्षत lesion.
7695: उरःस्थल n. (-लं) The breast, the bosom. E. उरस् the breast, and स्थल place.
7696: उरःसूत्रिका f. (-का) A pearl necklace. E. उरस् the breast, सूत्र a thread, टच् aff.
7698: उरग m. (-गः) A snake. E. उरस् the breast, and ग who goes, from गम to go, affix ड; also उरङ्ग and उरङ्गम.
7699: उरगस्थान n. (-नं) The infernal regions below the earth. E. उरग and स्थान a place or country; the abode of the Nāgas or serpents.
7700: उरगारि m. (-रिः) 1 GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. 2 A large crane. E. उरग a snake, and अरि the enemy.
7701: उरगाशन n. (-नं) 1 A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. 2 The gigantic crane. E. उरग and अशन food; whose food is of serpents.
7702: उरगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The king of snakes, ŚEṢA or VĀSUKI. E. उरग and इन्द्र chief.
7703: उरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A snake, a serpent: see उरग, the affix being खच्; also उरङ्गम.
7704: उरण m. (-णः) 1 A ram. 2 A cloud. f. (-णी) A ewe. E. ऋ to go, क्यु affix, leaving ण, and उ substituted for the antepenultimate.
7705: उरणाक्ष m. (-क्षः) Cassia, (Alata.) E. उरण ram, अक्ष an eye: the flower being so compared: क being added, also उरणाक्षक.
7706: उरणाख्य m. (-ख्यः) Cassia: see the preceding. E. उरण and आख्या a name; named from the ram; also उरणाख्यक, क being added.
7707: उरभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A ram. E. उरु much, भ्रम to wander, ड affix, and the final of उरु dropped.
7708: उररी ind. A particle implying, 1 Assent. 2 Expansion: (it chiefly occurs in composition.) E. वे to weave, ररीक aff.
7709: उररीकार m. (-रः) A promise, an agreement. E. उररी, कार what makes.
7710: उररीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed. 2 Spread, diffused. E. उररी and कृत made.
7711: उरश्छद m. (-दः) Armour, mail. E. उरस् the breast, and छद a covering.
7712: उरस् mfn. (उराः-उराः-उरः) Best, excellent. n. (-रः) The breast, the bosom. E. ऋ to go, Uṇādi affix असुन्, the pen. changed to उ; also उर a Sautra root, to go, and असुन् as before.
7713: उरसिज m. (-जः) The female breast. E. उरस् the breast, in the 7th case, ज produced.
7714: उरसिरुह m. (-हः) The female breast. E. उरसि on the breast, and रुह what grows.
7715: उरसिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Broad-chested, having a full or broad breast. E. उरस् and इलच् aff.
7716: उरस्कट m. (-टः) The sacrificial thread hung round the neck and upon the breast, as it is sometimes worn. E. उरस् the breast, कट to encompass, अल् aff.
7717: उरस्तस् ind. From the breast. E. उरस् and तसि aff.
7718: उरस्त्राण n. (-णं) Mail, the breastplate or cuirass. E. उरस्, त्रै to preserve, affix ल्युट्.
7719: उरस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) From the breast. mf. (-स्यः-स्या) A legitimate son or daughter, that is, one born from a married couple of the same tribe or cast. E. उरस the breast, and यत् aff.
7720: उरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Broad-chested, full-breasted, strong. E. उरस् and मतुप् poss. aff.
7721: उराह m. (-हः) A horse of a pale colour, with dark legs.
7722: उरी ind. A particle, implying, (especially in composition,) 1 Promise, assent. 2 Expansion; also उररी and ऊरी.
7723: उरीकार m. (-रः) 1 Promise. 2 Extension. E. उरी, and कार what makes.
7724: उरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised. 2 Expanded, spread. E. उरी and कृत made; also उररीकृत and ऊरीकृत.
7725: उरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-र्व्वी-रु) 1 Large, great. 2 Much, excessive. 3 Long. 4 Valuable, precious. E. ऊर्णु to cover, कु Uṇādi affix; ऊ is made short, and ण dropped by special rule.
7726: उरुकाल m. (-लः) A creeper, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. उरु and काल time, of long growth; also with कन् added उरुकालकः.
7727: उरुगाय m. (-यः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. उरग a snake, इ to go, and अच् aff.
7728: उरुतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, larger. E. उरु and तरप् aff.
7729: उरुतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Greatest. E. उरु and तमप्.
7730: उरुताप m. (-पः) Great heat. उरु much, ताप heat.
7731: उरुत्व n. (-त्वं) Magnitude, vastness. E. उरु and त्व affix; also उरुता.
7732: उरुमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A long road. E. उरु and मार्गं a road.
7733: उरुरी ind. A particle, of, 1 Assent. 2 Expansion: see उररी.
7734: उरुवुक m. (-कः) The castor-oil tree, (Palma christi or Ricinus communis). E. उरु great or much, (disease,) वै to wither or dry, affix उक deriv. irr. or with ऊक affix उरुवूक.
7736: उरुव्यचस् m. (-चाः) A malignant sprite, an imp or goblin. E. उरु much, व्यच to deceive, असुन् Uṇādi aff.
7737: उरुसत्त्व mfn. (-त्त्वः-त्त्वा-त्त्वं) Magnanimous, of a lofty nature. E. उरु and सत्त्व disposition.
7738: उरुहार m. (-रः) A valuable necklace. E. उरु and हार a necklace.
7739: उरोगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Creeping, crawling, going on the belly as a reptile. E. उरस् and गामिन् who goes.
7740: उरोग्रह m. (-हः) Pain of the chest, pleurisy. E. उरस and ग्रह what seizes.
7741: उरोघात m. (-तः) 1 Striking or beating the breast. 2 Pain in the chest. E. उरस and घात a wound.
7742: उरोज m. (-जः) The female breast. E. उरस् the breast, and ज produced.
7743: उर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left. E. वर्ज्ज to abandon, क्त affix, and the vowel substituted.
7744: उर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider. E. उर्ण wool, नाभि a navel, affix ड.
7745: उर्णा f. (-र्णा) 1 Wool, felt, the hair of camels, &c. 2 A circle of hair between the eye-brows. E. उर्णु to cover, ड affix; the word is properly ऊर्णा, q. v.
7746: उर्द r. 1st cl. (उर्दते) 1 To measure. 2 To play. 3 To be easy or cheerful.
7747: उर्द्र m. (-र्द्रः) An otter. E. उर्द to play, रन् aff.
7748: उर्व्व r. 1st cl. (ई,) उर्वी (उर्वति) To kill or hurt.
7749: उर्व्वट m. (-टः) A year. E. उरु much, and अट to go, अच् aff.
7750: उर्व्वरा f. (-रा) 1 Fertile soil, yielding every kind of crop. 2 Land in general. E. उरू much, ऋ to go, अप् and टाप् affs.
7751: उर्व्वशी f. (-शी) The name of one of the courtezans of Svarga or INDRA'S heaven. E. उरु great, वश to tame, अच् and ङीष् affixes; also उर्व्वसी and ऊर्व्वसी.
7752: उर्व्वशीरमण m. (-णः) The name of AILA or PURŪRAVAS, the second king of the line of the moon. E. उर्व्वशी, and रमण the gallant or husband of the Apsaras URVAŚĪ.
7753: उर्व्वशीवल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of AILA: see the preceding. E. as before, वल्लभ a friend, a lover, &c.
7754: उर्व्वारु m. (-रुः) A kind of cucumber, (cucumis utilatissimus:) see इर्व्वारु.
7755: उर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) The earth. E. उरु great, ङीष् aff.
7756: उर्व्वीधर m. (-रः) 1 A mountain. 2 The serpent ŚEṢA. E. उर्व्वी the earth, and धर what holds.
7757: उर्व्वीरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. उर्व्वी and रुह what grows on.
7759: उलप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A creeping plant, a spreading creeper. m. (-पः) A kind of grass or reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. वल to be strong, अपच् affix; also उलुप्.
7760: उलिन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a country. E. उल to burn, किन्दच् aff.
7761: उलुप mn. (-पः-पं) A spreading creeper. m. (-पः) A reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. वल to be strong, उपच् affix; also उलप and उलूप.
7762: उलुपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise, or fish resembling it. E. उ for उत् up, लुप to disturb, &c. णिनि affix; also उलूपिन्, ऊलुपिन्, उल्लुपिन्, &c.
7763: उलूक m. (-कः) 1 An owl. 2 A name of INDRA. 3 One of the heroes of the Mahābhārata. n. (-कं) A kind of reed, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. वल to be strong, ऊकः aff.
7764: उलूखल n. (-लं) 1 A wooden mortar used for cleaning rice. 2 Bdellium, a gummy substance. E. उद्, up ख empty, and ल what takes: or उदू for उद्, and खल what goes; द is changed to लः see उदूखल.
7765: उलूखलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Pounded in a mortar, cleansed. E. उलूखल and ठक् aff.
7766: उलूखलक m. (-लः) A name of Bdellium, a gummy substance, or the plant which produces it. E. कन् added to the preceding.
7767: उलूत m. (-तः) A large snake, the Boa. E. उद् much, लू to cut, and क्त aff.
7768: उलूप m. (-पः) A spreading creeper. n. (-पं) A sort of grass. f. (-पी) A nymph of Pātāla married to ARJUNA. E. see उलुप.
7769: उलूपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise, or fish resembling it: see उलुपिन्.
7770: उल्का f. (-ल्का) 1 A firebrand. 2 Fire falling from heaven, a meteor, &c. 3 Flame. 4 Fire. E. उष to burn, कक् Uṇādi affix, ल substituted for ष; or the root is a Sautra root, उल to burn.
7771: उल्कामुख m. (-खः) A ghost or goblin, with a face of fire, who eats what is vomited, and who was a negligent Brahman in his lifetime. f. (-खी) A fox. E. उल्का a flame, मुख a mouth, ङीष् affix; the latter from the redness of his mouth.
7772: उल्मुक (-कः) 1 A firebrand, wood burning or burnt as charcoal. 2 The name of a prince. E. उष to burn, मुक Uṇādi affix, घ is changed to ल.
7773: उल्लकसन n. (-नं) Horripilation, erection of the hair of the body. E. उद् up, लष to injure, ल्युट् affix, and क inserted.
7774: उल्लग्न m. (-ग्नः) The Lagna of any particular place. E. उत् over, लग्न the entrance of the sun into a sign.
7775: उल्लङ्घन n. (-नं) 1 Leaping or passing over or beyond. 2 Exceeding, transgression. E. उद् before लघि to go, ल्युट् aff.
7776: उल्लङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Passed over or beyond, jumped across. 2 Exceeded, transgressed. E. उद् before लघि to go, क्त aff.
7777: उल्लङ्घ्य mfn. (-ङ्घ्यः-ङ्घ्या-ङ्घ्यं) 1 To be crossed, to be passed over or beyond. 2 To be disregarded or neglected. E. उद् before लघि to go, and यत् aff.
7778: उल्लङ्घितशासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Refractory, rebellious, disobedient. E. उल्लङ्घित and शासन order.
7779: उल्लल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Shaking, trembling. E. उद् much, लल to tremble, अच् aff.
7780: उल्ललत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Shaking, trembling. 2 Moving irregularly or convulsively. E. उद् before लल to tremble, affix शतृ.
7781: उल्ललित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling, agitated. E. उद् much, लल to tremble, affix क्त.
7782: उल्लस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Bright, shining. 2 Sporting, merry, happy. 3 Going out, issuing. E. उद् before लस to shine, अच् aff.
7783: उल्लसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Brilliant, shining. 2 Sporting, wantoning. E. उद् before लस to shine, शतृ aff.
7784: उल्लसता f. (-ता) 1 Splendor, brilliancy. 2 Mirth, happiness. 3 Going forth, issuing. E. उल्लस what shines, तल् aff.
7785: उल्लसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bright, splendid, shining. 2 Happy. 3 Ejected, brought to the top or surface. 4 Drawn up. E. उद् before लस to shine, क्त aff.
7786: उल्लाघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) 1 Recovered from sickness, convalescent. 2 Dextrous, clever, intelligent. 3 Pure. 4 Happy, delighted. E. उद् much, लाघ to be able, अच् aff.
7787: उल्लाप m. (-पः) Change of voice in grief, sickness, &c. E. उद् implying alteration, लप to speak, घञ् aff.
7788: उल्लास m. (-सः) 1 Joy, happiness. 2 Light, splendor. 3 Increase. 4 The division of a book, a chapter, a section. E. उद् much, लस to shine, &c. घञ् aff.
7789: उल्लासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, rejoicing. E. उद् before लस to shine, causal form, क्त aff.
7790: उल्लिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्) 1 Painting, writing. 2 Making lines or streaks, above or on high. 3 Scratching, scraping. 4 Bearing, raising. E. उद् before लिख to write, शतृ aff.
7791: उल्लिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown up, tossed. 2 Pared, made thin. 3 Scraped, scratched. 4 Painted, delineated. 5 Written over or above. E. उद् and लिखित written.
7792: उल्लिङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Discriminated, distinguished, known. E. उद्, before लिगि to mark, and क्त aff.
7793: उल्लुञ्चन n. (-नं) 1 Plucking out hair. 2 Cutting the hair. E. उद् up, लिचि to cut, affix ल्युट्.
7794: उल्लेख m. (-खः) 1 Utterance, pronunciation. 2 Speaking. E. उद् before लिख to write, घञ् aff.
7795: उल्लेखन n. (-नं) 1 Raising up, elevating. 2 Vomiting. 3 Digging. 4 Scraping, paring. 5 Uttering, utterance. 6 Writing, painting. E. उद्, लिखि to write, &c. ल्युट् aff.
7796: उल्लोच m. (-चः) An awning, a canopy. E. उद् above, लोच to see, अच् aff.
7797: उल्लोल m. (-लः) A surge, a large wave or billow. E. उद् up, लोड to be furious, अच् affix, and ड becomes ल.
7798: उल्व n. (-ल्वः) 1 The womb. 2 The embryo. 3 The membranes investing the foetus. 4 A cavity. E. उच to accumulate, कन् Uṇādi affix, and च becomes ल.
7799: उल्वण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Apparent, evident. 2 Much, exceeding. n. (-णं) An excess of either of the humors of the body, bile, phlegm or wind. E. उद् up, ल्वी to join, deriv. irr.
7800: उव्ज r. 6th cl. (उव्जति) To be straight: see उब्ज.
7801: उशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती-शत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse.) E. उव to burn, शतृ part. affix; also उषत्.
7802: उशनस् m. (-नाः) A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet Venus. E. वस to wish, कनसि Uṇādi aff.
7803: उशिज् m. (-शिक्) 1 Fire. 2 Ghee or boiled butter. E. वस to wish, Uṇādi affix इज्, and व changed to उ.
7804: उशी f. (-शी) Wish, desire. E. वश to wish, ई Uṇādi aff.
7805: उशीनर m. (-रः) 1 The name of a country, (Candahar.) 2 A king, the father of ŚIVA. E. उशी desire, नर a man.
7806: उशीर mn. (-रः-रं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). f. (-री) A sort of grass, a small sort of Saccharum. E. वश to desire, ईरन् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added उशीरक.
7807: उष r. 1st cl. (ओषति) To burn. (उ,) उषु (ओषति). To kill or injure: with प्र prefixed, this root makes प्रोषति, &c.
7808: उष m. (-षः) 1 Early morning, dawn, day-break. 2 A libidinous man. 3 Bdellium. 4 Saline earth. f. (-षा) 1 A cow. 2 Burning, scorching. 3 A proper name, the wife of ANIRUDDHA. 4 Night. 5 A pot; also उखा. ind. The end of night or day-break. E. उष to burn, क affix and fem. do. टाप्; the affix of the particle is का.
7809: उषण n. (-णं) Black pepper. f. (-णा) 1 Long pepper. 2 Chai, (Piper chavya.) 3 Dried ginger. E. उष to burn, कनच् aff.
7810: उषत् mfn. (-षन्-षती-षत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse:) see उशत्.
7811: उषप m. (-पः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. उप to burn, पच् aff.
7812: उषर्बुध m. (-धः) Fire. E. उषस् dawn, बुध to know, क aff.
7813: उषस् n. (-षः) 1 The dawn, morning. f. (-सी) The end of the day. twilight. E. उष to burn, असि Uṇādi aff.
7814: उषस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Belonging to the dawn. E. उषस् and य aff.
7815: उषाकल m. (-लः) A cock. E. उषा dawn, कल to sound, अच् aff.
7816: उषापति m. (-तिः) A name of ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMADEVA. E. उषा and पति a lord, a master: the husband of UṢĀ.
7817: उषारमण m. (-णः) ANIRUDDHA: see the preceding. E. उषा and रमण a husband, &c.
7818: उषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stale. 2 Burnt. 3 Quick, expeditious. 4 Fixed, remaining in or on. 5 Inhabited, dwelt. E. उष to burn, or वस to abide, affix क्त.
7819: उषितङ्गवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formerly inhabited by cattle. E. उषित inhabited, गवीन appertaining to cattle, from गो with खश् affix: see अशितङ्गवीन.
7820: उषित्वा ind. Having resided in. E. वस to abide, क्त्वा aff.
7821: उषीर mn. (-रः-रं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. वश to desire, ईरन affix, श becomes षः see उशीर.
7822: उषेश m. (-शः) A name of ANIRUDDHA. E. उषा and ईश lord, husband: see उषापति.
7823: उष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Fit to be dressed in a pot, or boiled, (meat, &c.) E. उषा a pot, यत् affix; also उख्य.
7824: उष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A camel. 2 A cart, a vehicle of burthen. f. (-ष्ट्री or -ष्ट्रिका) An earthen vessel. 2 A she camel. E. उष to burn, and ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix, fem. ङीष्, or ठाप् with इक् inserted.
7825: उष्ट्रकाण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A flower of a red colour.
7826: उष्ट्रक्रोशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Making a noise like a camel. E. उष्ट्र and क्रुश to cry, णिनि aff.
7827: उष्ट्रगोयुग n. (-गं) A pair of camels. E. उष्ट्र and गोयुग a couple.
7828: उष्ट्रग्रीव m. (-वः) Hemorrhoids. E. उष्ट्र and ग्रीवा the neck.
7830: उष्ट्रपादिका f. (-का) Arabian jasmin. E. उष्ट्र and पाद a foot: from the shape of its flowers.
7831: उष्ट्रयान n. (-नं) A camel litter, a vehicle drawn or borne by camels. E. उष्ट्र and यान a carriage.
7832: उष्ट्रशिरोधर m. (-रः) Piles, hemorrhoids, bleeding piles. E. उष्ट्र a camel, शिरस् head, and धर what has.
7833: उष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) 1 Hot, warm. 2 Pungent, acrid. 3 Sharp, active. 4 Impetuous, warm, passionate. m. (-ष्णः) 1 The hot season, (June and July.) 2 Heat, warmth. 3 Sunshine. 4 An onion. 5 A sigh. f. (-ष्णा) 1 Consumption. 2 Bile. E. उष to burn, णक् aff.
7834: उष्णक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sharp, smart, active. 2 Suffering pain. 3 Bent, inclining, stooping. 4 Warming, heating. m. (-कः) 1 The hot season, two months about June and July. 2 Revolving, turning round. E. वुन् added to the preceding.
7835: उष्णता f. (-ता) Heat, warmth. E. तल् added to उष्ण; also with त्व, उष्णत्व.
7836: उष्णनदी f. (-दी) The river of hell. E. उष्ण hot, नदी a river.
7837: उष्णरश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The sun. E. उष्ण and रश्मि a ray.
7838: उष्णवारण mn. (-णः-णं) An umbrella or parasol, a Catta. E. उष्ण heat, and वृ to screen, affix ल्युट्.
7839: उष्णवाष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 Hot vapour, steam. 2 Tears. E. उष्ण and वाष्प vapour.
7840: उष्णवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 The gangetic porpoise. 2 Any hot or pungent substance. E. उष्ण heat, वीर्य्य power, strength.
7841: उष्णांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. उष्ण and अंशु a ray.
7842: उष्णागम m. (-मः) The hot season, consisting of two months, about June and July. E. उष्ण heat, and आगम arrival.
7843: उष्णाभिगम m. (-मः) The hot season, as above. E. उष्ण and अभिगम approach.
7844: उष्णालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Suffering from heat. E. उष्ण and आलु aff.
7845: उष्णासह m. (-हः) The cold season. E. उष्ण warmth, असह intolerant.
7846: उष्णिका f. (-का) Rice gruel. E. उष्ण warm (rice,) वुन् aff.
7847: उष्णिह् f. (-ष्णिक्) A verse of four lines, each line being of seven syllables: it is used chiefly in the Vedas. E. उत् prefixed to ष्णिह to be unctuous or bland, क्विन् aff.
7848: उष्णीष mn. (-षः-षं) 1 A turban. 2 A diadem. 3 A distinguishing cognate mark. 4 The curly hair with which a Buddha is born, and which indicates his future sanctity. E. उष्ण heat, ईष to oppose or injure, क aff.
7849: उष्णीषधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Turbaned. E. उष्णीष and धारिन् who wears.
7850: उष्णोदक n. (-कं) Warm or hot water. E. उष्ण and उदक water.
7851: उष्णोपगम m. (-मः) The hot season, summer. E. उष्ण, उपगम arrival.
7852: उष्म m. (-ष्मः) 1 The hot season, (June and July.) 2 Spring, (April and May.) 3 Heat. 4 Anger, warmth of temper. 5 Ardor, eagerness. E. उष to burn, मक् affix; also with कन् affix उष्मक, also उष्ण and उष्णक.
7853: उष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) 1 The hot season. 2 Heat. E. उष to burn, and मनिन् aff.
7854: उष्मपा m. (-पाः) A heavenly spirit of an inferior order.
7855: उष्मभास् m. (-भाः) The sun. E. उष्म and भास् what shines.
7856: उष्मस्वेद m. (-दः) A vapour bath. E. उष्ण and स्वेद sweat.
7857: उष्मागम m. (-मः) The hot season: see उष्णागम.
7858: उस्र m. (-स्रः) 1 A bull. 2 A ray of light. f. (-स्रा) 1 A cow. 2 A plant, (Anthericum tuberosum, Rox.) E. वस to dwell, रक् Uṇādi aff.
7860: उह r. 1st cl. (इर) उहिर् (ओहति) or (इ) उहि (उंहति) 1 To hurt or give pain. 2 To kill, to destroy. With वि and अप pre, to destroy, to remove.
7861: उहान m. (-नः) The name of a country. ऊ
7862: ऊ The sixth vowel of the Sanscrit alphabet, corresponding to U long, and having the sound of that letter in the word rule.
7863: ऊ ind. 1 An incipient particle. 2 An interjection of compassion. 3 Of regard. m. (ऊः) The moon. E. अव to go, क्विप् affix, व becomes ऊ.
7864: ऊढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Married. 2 Carried as a load or burthen. f. (-ढा) A bride, a wife espoused according to the ritual. E. वह to bear, क्त aff.
7865: ऊढकङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Armed, mailed. E. ऊढ borne, कङ्कट armour.
7866: ऊत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Woven. E. वेञ् to weave, affix क्त.
7867: ऊति f. (-तिः) 1 Preserving, protecting. 2 Sewing, weaving. 3 Distilling. 4 Speed. 5 Sport, play. E. वेञ् to weave, &c. affix क्तिन्.
7868: ऊधन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Produced from the udder, milk, &c. E. ऊधस, यत् affix, and न substituted for स.
7869: ऊधस् n. (-धः) An udder. E. वह to bear, असि affix, deriv. irr.
7870: ऊधस्य n. (-स्यं) Milk. E. ऊधस् and यत् aff.
7871: ऊन r. 10th cl. (न) ऊनत् (ऊनयति) 1 To deduct or lessen. 2 To mete out in small quantities. 3 To measure.
7872: ऊन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Less in number, size or degree, as fewer, smaller, inferior, &c. E. ऊन to deduct, &c. affix क.
7873: ऊम ind. An interjection of. 1 Interrogation. 2 Anger. 3 Reproach, abuse. 4 Arrogance. n. (-मं) A city. E. अव to preserve, &c. मन् Uṇādi aff.
7874: ऊय r. 1st cl. (ई) ऊयी (ऊयते) To sew, to weave.
7875: ऊररी ind. 1 A particle of assent. 3 Of expansion. E. ऊय to sew, &c. ररोक affix: see उररी.
7876: ऊरव्य m. (-व्यः) A man of the third cast or tribe, the merchant or husbandman, the Vaiśya. E. ऊरु a thigh, and यत् affix; being born from the thighs of BRAHMĀ.
7877: ऊरी ind. A particle of, 1 Assent. 2 Of expansion: see उरी.
7878: ऊरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised. 2 Expanded. E. उरी and कृत made: see उरीकृत.
7879: ऊरु m. (-रुः) The thigh. E. ऊर्णु to cover, कु aff.
7880: ऊरुग्लानि f. (-निः) Weakness of the thigh. E. ऊरु and ग्लानि debility.
7881: ऊरुज m. (-जः) A Vaiśya or man of the third tribe. E. ऊरु and ज born; from the thigh of BRAHMĀ.
7882: ऊरुदध्र mfn. (-ध्नः-ध्नी-ध्नं) As high as the thigh. E. ऊरु and दध्नच् affix; also ऊरुद्वयस and ऊरुमात्र, with द्वयसच् and मात्रच् affs.
7883: ऊरुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) The knee. E. ऊरु and पर्व्वन् a joint.
7884: ऊरुरी ind. A particle of, 1 Promise. 2 Of expansion: see ऊररी.
7885: ऊरुस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Paralysis of the lower extremities. 2 Rheumatism of the thigh. f. (-म्भा) The plantain tree. E. ऊरु and स्तम्भ a post.
7886: ऊर्ज् f. (-ऊर्क्) Strength, vigour. E. ऊर्ज to be strong, क्विप् aff.
7887: ऊर्ज r. 10th cl. (ऊर्जयति) 1 To be strong. 2 To live.
7888: ऊर्ज m. (-र्जः) 1 The month Kārttika, (Oct.-Nov.) 2 Effort, exertion. 3 Power, strength. 4 Breath, breathing. 5 Procreative power. n. (-र्जं) Water. E. ऊर्ज to live, क aff.
7889: ऊर्ज्जस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Strong, vigorous. E. ऊर्ज्ज and मतुप् affix, with स inserted.
7890: ऊर्जस्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, powerful. E. ऊर्ज strength, वलच् affix, and स inserted.
7891: ऊर्जस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Very strong. n. (-स्वि) Speaking of any thing with disdain, (a figure of rhetoric.) E. ऊर्ज and विनि affix, स inserted.
7892: ऊर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Powerful, mighty, great, excellent. 2 Exceeding, much. E. ऊर्ज्ज to be strong, क्त aff.
7893: ऊर्ज्जिताश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Spirited, magnanimous. E. ऊर्ज्जित great, आश्रय receptacle.
7894: ऊर्णनाभ m. (-भः) A spider. E. ऊर्ण wool, नाभि the navel, ड affix; also ऊर्णनाभि, the final being retained.
7895: ऊर्णा f. (-र्णा) 1 Wool, felt, &c. the hair of sheep, deer, camels, &c. 2 A circle of the hair between the eye-brows, considered as a token of greatness. E. ऊर्णु to cover, ड and टाप् affs.
7896: ऊर्णामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Wollen, made of wool. E. ऊर्णा and मयट् aff.
7897: ऊर्णायु m. (-युः) 1 A woollen blanket. 2 A ram. 3 A spider. E. ऊर्णा wool, युस् aff.
7898: ऊर्णु r. 2nd cl. (ञ) ऊर्णुज ऊर्णौति ऊर्णोति or ऊर्णुते) To cover, hide, conceal, &c. with प्र prefixed प्रोर्णौति.
7899: ऊर्णुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered. E. ऊर्णु and क्त aff.
7900: ऊर्द्दर m. (-रः) 1 A hero, a champion. 2 A Rākṣasa, a goblin or fiend. E. ऊर्ज to be strong. दरल् Uṇādi affix; ज is dropped.
7901: ऊर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) 1 Above, upper. 2 High, elevated. 3 Abandoned: see ऊर्द्ध्व.
7902: ऊर्द्धक m. (-कः) A kind of drum: see ऊर्द्ध्वक.
7903: ऊर्द्ध्व mfn. (-ऊर्द्ध्वः-ऊर्द्ध्वा-ऊर्द्ध्वं) 1 Above, superior, upper. 2 High. 3 Abandoned. 4 After, subsequent. E. ऊर् substituted for उद् above, हा to leave, and ड्व affix, or with ड only ऊर्द्ध्वं.
7904: ऊर्द्ध्वक m. (-कः) A kind of drum. E. ऊर्द्ध्व or ऊर्द्ध्व up, and क what sounds; from its making a loud noise, or being elevated in playing; also ऊर्द्धक.
7905: ऊर्द्ध्वकाय m. (-यः) The upper part of the body. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and काय body.
7906: ऊर्द्ध्वग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going up or above; ascending, hovering. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and ग what goes; also ऊर्द्ध्वगामिन्, &c.
7907: ऊर्द्ध्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone up, risen, ascended. E. ऊर्द्ध्व, गत gone.
7908: ऊर्द्ध्वगति f. (-तिः) Ascent, elevation. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and गति going.
7909: ऊर्द्ध्वगपुर n. (-रं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA, who with his subjects is supposed to be suspended in the atmosphere. E. ऊर्द्ध्वग going above, and पुर a city: see हरिश्चन्द्रपुर.
7910: ऊर्द्ध्वगम m. (-मः) Upward motion of any kind. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and गम going; also ऊर्द्ध्वगति.
7911: ऊर्द्ध्वचरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Supine, heels upwards. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and चरण the foot; also ऊर्द्ध्वपाद, &c.
7912: ऊर्द्ध्वजानु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) 1 Thick-kneed, long-shanked. 2 Sitting on the hams. E. ऊर्द्ध्व high, large, जानु the knee, and with कन् added ऊर्द्ध्वजानुक.
7913: ऊर्द्ध्वज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Thick-kneed: see the preceding. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and ज्ञ substituted for जानु; also ऊर्द्ध्वज्ञ.
7915: ऊर्द्ध्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Height, elevation. E. त्व added to ऊर्द्ध्व; also with तल्, ऊर्द्ध्वता.
7916: ऊर्द्ध्वदृष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Looking up or upwards. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and दृष्टि sight.
7917: ऊर्द्ध्वदेव m. (-वः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. ऊर्द्ध्व superior, and देव a deity.
7918: ऊर्द्ध्वन्दम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Exalted, elevated. E. ऊर्द्ध्व upper, दम to tame, and अप् aff.
7919: ऊर्द्ध्वपातन n. (-नं) 1 Causing to ascend. 2 Sublimation. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and पातन causing to go.
7920: ऊर्द्ध्वपात्र n. (-त्रं) A sacrificial vessel. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and पात्र a vessel.
7921: ऊर्द्ध्वपाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Heels upwards. m. (-दः) A fabulous animal with eight legs. E. ऊर्द्ध्व superior, exceeding, and पाद a foot.
7922: ऊर्द्ध्वपुण्ड्र m. (-ण्ड्रः) A perpendicular line on the forehead made with Sandal, &c. a Vaiṣṇava mark. E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, पुण्ड्र a similar mark.
7923: ऊर्द्ध्वबाहु n. (-हुः) An ascetic, one who holds his arms above his head constantly till they are fixed in that position. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and वाहु the arm.
7924: ऊर्द्ध्वरेतस् m. (-ताः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Of BHĪṢMA. 3 A description of saint, one who lives in perpetual chastity. E. उर्द्ध्व up, above, and रेतस् semen virile.
7925: ऊर्द्ध्वलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of ŚIVA. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and लिङ्ग the generative organ.
7926: ऊर्द्ध्वलोक m. (-कः) Svarga, the heaven of INDRA or paradise. E. ऊर्द्ध्व, and लोक a world: the world above.
7927: ऊर्द्ध्ववर्त्मन् m. (-त्मा) The atmosphere, heaven. E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, and वर्त्मन् a path.
7928: ऊर्द्ध्ववायु m. (-युः) The wind in the upper part of the body. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and वायु wind.
7929: ऊर्द्ध्ववृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Put on, above or over the head. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and वृत worn.
7930: ऊर्द्ध्वशोधन n. (-नं) Vomiting. E. ऊर्द्ध्व and शोधन purifying.
7931: ऊर्द्ध्वस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Above, superior, placed on high; also.
7932: ऊर्द्ध्वस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं.) E. ऊर्द्ध्व and स्थ what stays or is.
7933: ऊर्द्ध्वस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 A horse's back, the part where the rider sits. 2 Elevation, superiority. E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, and स्थिति being, staying.
7934: ऊर्द्ध्वासित m. (तः) The name of a vegetable, (Momordica charantia.) E. ऊर्द्ध्व above, आसित thrown: raised above other fruits.
7935: ऊर्म्मि mf. (-र्म्मिः) or f. only, (-र्म्मी) 1 A wave. 2 A current, the flowing of water. 3 A fold or plait in a garment. 4 Light, manifestation. 5 Speed, velocity. 6 Mental suffering, distress, uneasiness. 7 Pain. 8 Missing, regretting. 9 Human infirmity, as grief, illusion, hunger, thirst, decay, death. 10 Association. 11 Number, quantity. E. ऋ to go, मि Uṇādi affix, ऊ substituted for the initial letter.
7936: ऊर्म्मिका f. (-का) 1 A finger ring. 2 A plait or fold in a garment. 3 A wave. 4 Regret, sorrowing for any thing lost. 5 The buzzing of a bee. E. as the preceding, कन्, &c. added.
7937: ऊर्म्मिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Crooked. 2 Wavy, billowy. E. ऊर्म्मि a wave, and मतुप् poss. aff.
7938: ऊर्म्मिमता f. (-ता) 1 Undulation. 2 Crookedness. E. ऊर्म्मिमत् and तल् added.
7939: ऊर्म्मिमालिन् m. (-ली) The ocean. E. ऊर्म्मि, माला a necklace, and इनि affix; whose necklace is the surge.
7940: ऊर्व्वरा f. (-रा) Fertile soil, land bearing any and every crop: see उर्व्वरा.
7941: ऊर्व्वष्ठीवत् n. (-वः) The thigh and knee. E. ऊरु and अष्ठीवत् the knee pan.
7942: ऊर्व्वसी f. (-सी) A nymph of Svarga: see उर्व्वशी. Also written ऊर्व्वशी.
7943: ऊर्व्व्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A mushroom. E. ऊर्व्वी for उर्व्वी the earth, and अङ्ग body: earth-born.
7944: ऊर्षा f. (-र्षा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratum:) see देवताडक. E. वृष to rain, अङ् and टाप् affixes, व changed to ऊ.
7945: ऊलूक m. (-कः) An owl. E. वल to be strong, and ऊक affix; व becomes ऊ.
7946: ऊलूपिन् m. (-पी) A porpoise: see उलुपिन्, &c.
7947: ऊष r. 1st cl. (ऊषति) To be diseased or disordered.
7948: ऊष m. (-षः) Salt ground, soil impregnated with saline particles. n. (-षं) Dawn, day-break. f. (-षा) The wife of ANIRUDDHA. E. ऊष to be or make sick, क affix, fem. टाप्: see उषा.
7949: ऊषक n. (-कं) Dawn, day-break. E. as before, कन् added.
7950: ऊषण n. (-णं) Black pepper. f. (-णा) Long pepper: see उषण.
7951: ऊषर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A spot with saline soil. E. ऊस such soil, रच् aff.
7952: ऊषवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Consisting of saline soil, (a place, &c.) E. ऊष and poss. affix मतुप्.
7953: ऊह r. 1st cl. (ऊहते) To reason, to apprehend and infer: with प्र and वि, to intermit; with वि, to array in order of battle; with सम् prefixed, (समूहति or -ते) to assemble or be assembled.
7954: ऊह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Reasoning. 2 Completing a defective sentence or verse, supplying an ellipsis. E. ऊह to deliberate, घञ् affix, or with ल्युट् affix, ऊहन.
7955: ऊहन n. (-नं) Reasoning, inferring, concluding. E. ऊह and ल्युट्.
7956: ऊहनी f. (-नी) A broom. E. वह to carry, ल्युट् and ङीष् affixes; व is changed to ऊ.
7957: ऊहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Who or what reasons. 2 Who or what assembles. f. (-णी) An assemblage, a collection. E. ऊह reasoning, इनि aff.
7958: ऊह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be investigated, to be supplied. E. ऊह to reason, यत् aff. ऋ
7959: ऋ The seventh vowel of the Sanscrit alphabet, and peculiar to it. It corresponds in sound with RI, in merrily.
7960: ऋ f. (आ) A name of ADITI, the mother of the gods. ind. 1 An expression of abuse. 2 An articulate sound. 3 An expression of laughter. 4 A sound inarticulate or reiterated as in stammering.
7961: ऋ r. 1st cl. (ऋच्छति) 1 To go, to approach. 2 To gain, to acquire; (the radical is changed to ऋछ before an initial mute श.) r. 3rd cl. (ईयर्त्ति) To go; (some confine this root to the Vedas.) r. 5th cl. (ऋणोति) To kill, to injure; also रि.
7962: ऋक्थ m. (-क्थं) 1 Wealth, possessions, property. 2 Gold. E. ऋच to praise, थक् Uṇādi aff.
7963: ऋक्थग्रहण n. (-णं) Receiving or inheriting property. E. ऋक्थ and ग्रहण taking.
7964: ऋक्थग्राह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who inherits or takes property. m. (-हः) Inheriting or receiving property. E. ऋक्थ and ग्रह to take, with घञ् affix; also with णिनि, ऋक्थग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि.)
7965: ऋक्थजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Accumulated, added, (as property.) E. ऋक्थ and जात produced.
7966: ऋक्थभाग m. (-गः) 1 Division of property, inheritance, partition. 2 A share. E. ऋक्थ and भाग division.
7967: ऋक्थभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) An heir, a coheir, inheriting or sharing property. E. ऋक्थ and भागिन् who shares.
7968: ऋक्थहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) An heir, a coheir. E. ऋक्थ and हर who takes.
7969: ऋक्थहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) An heir, inheriting or sharing property. E. ऋक्थ and हारिन् who takes.
7970: ऋक्शत n. (-तं) A hundred texts. E. ऋच् a prayer, and शत a century.
7971: ऋक्संहिता f. (-ता) The collection of the prayers and hymns of the Ṛk Veda. E. ऋच् and संहिता compendium.
7972: ऋक्ष r. 5th cl. (ऋक्ष्णोति) To kill, to hurt or seek to hurt.
7973: ऋक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Pierced, cut, divided. mn. (-क्षः-क्षं) A star, a constellation. m. (-क्षः) 1 A mountain in the peninsula, the temporary residence of RĀMA. 2 A bear. 3 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. ऋष to go, Uṇādi affix स, the radical final then becomes क, and स becomes ष; and क and ष form the compound letter क्ष.
7974: ऋक्षगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 1 A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) 2 Another sort, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. ऋक्ष a bear, and गन्ध smell, smelling like a bear.
7975: ऋक्षगन्धिका f. (-का) A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus paniculatus, the pale sort:) see the preceding. E. as before, कन् added.
7976: ऋक्षर n. (-रं) A shower, a stream. m. (-रः) A family priest. E. ऋष to go, and सर Uṇādi affix: see the derivation of ऋक्ष.
7977: ऋक्षविभावन n. (-नं) Observing or seeing the stars. E. ऋक्ष and विभावन noticing.
7978: ऋक्षेश m. (-शः) The moon. E. ऋक्ष a star, ईश lord.
7979: ऋक्षेष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Offering worship to the planets and stars. E. ऋल and इष्टि worship.
7980: ऋग्वेद m. (-दः) The Ṛc or Ṛk Veda, the first of the four Vedas. E. ऋच् and वेद a Veda.
7981: ऋग्वेदविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) A Brahman familiar with the Ṛk Veda. E. ऋग्वेद and विद् who knows.
7982: ऋच r. 6th cl. (ऋचति) 1 To praise. 2 To cover, to screen.
7983: ऋच् f. (ऋक्) 1 Ṛk or Ṛg Veda, one of the four principal religious books of the Hindus. 2 A stanza of a prayer or hymn of the Rig Veda. 3 A mantra, a magical invocation, a mystical prayer. E. ऋच to praise, affix क्विप्, celebrating the praises of the gods.
7984: ऋचीष n. (-षं) A frying pan. m. (-षः) A hell. E. ऋज to fry, ईषन् affix, च substituted for ज; also ऋजीष.
7985: ऋच्छ r. 6th cl. (ऋच्छति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To fail in faculties. 3 To become hard or stiff, to congeal. 4 To incur.
7986: ऋच्छरा f. (-रा) A harlot, a courtezan. E. ऋच्छ to go, अर Uṇādi affix, and टाप् for the fem.
7987: ऋज r. 1st cl. (अर्जते) 1 To go. 2 To stand or be firm. 3 To be strong. 4 To acquire, to gain or earn. 5 To live. With a prefix ending in अ, the radical vowel is changed to आर, as in the pass. voice, (प्रार्ज्यते.) (इ) ऋजि (ऋजते) To fry.
7988: ऋजीक m. (-कः) 1 INDRA. 2 Smoke. E. ऋज and कीकन् Uṇādi aff.
7989: ऋजीष n. (-षं) 1 A frying pan. 2 A hell. E. ऋज to fry, ईषन् Uṇādi affix: see ऋचीष.
7990: ऋजु mfn. (-जुः-जुः-जु) 1 Straight. 2 Straight metaphorically, as in morals, upright, honest. E. ऋज to go, affix कु.
7991: ऋजुकाय m. (-यः) A name of the saint KAŚYAPA. E. ऋजु straight, काय body.
7992: ऋजुता f. (-ता) 1 Uprightness, sincerity. 2 Straightness. E. ऋजु with तल् affix; also with त्व, ऋजुत्वं.
7993: ऋजूकरण n. (-णं) Straightening. E. ऋजु and करण making; the vowel lengthened.
7994: ऋजूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made straight. E. ऋजू and कृत made; the vowel lengthened.
7995: ऋज्र m. (-ज्रः) A leader. E. ऋज to go, रन् Uṇādi aff.
7996: ऋञ्जसान m. (-नः) A cloud. E. ऋजि to go, शानच् Uṇādi aff.
7997: ऋण r. 8th cl. (उ) ऋणु (अर्णोति or अर्णुते, ऋणोति or -णुते) To go; according to some it is ऋन.
7998: ऋण n. (-णं) 1 Debt. 2 A fort, a strong hold. 3 (In algebra,) Negative quantity, minus. E. ऋ to go, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
7999: ऋणकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Getting into debt, indebted. E. ऋण and कर्त्तृ who makes.
8000: ऋणग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Indebted, involved in debt. E. ऋण and ग्रस्त seized.
8001: ऋणग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Borrowing. 2 A borrower. E. ऋण and ग्र taking.
8002: ऋणग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Borrowing, a borrower. E. ऋण and ग्राहिन् who takes.
8003: ऋणदातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) One who pays a debt. E. ऋण and दातृ who gives. Also ऋणद (-दः-दा-दं) and ऋणदायिन् (-यी-यिनी-यि.)
8004: ऋणदान n. (-नं) Payment of debt. E. ऋण and दान giving.
8005: ऋणमत्कुण m. (-णः) A security, a bail. E. ऋण debt, मत्कुण an insect.
8006: ऋणमार्गण m. (-णः) A security. E. ऋण, मृग to cleanse, in the causal, and ल्युट् aff.
8007: ऋणमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Discharge of a debt. E. ऋण and मुक्ति emancipation.
8008: ऋणमोक्ष m. (-क्षः) Paying a debt. E. ऋण and मोक्ष release.
8009: ऋणवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Owing, in debt. E. ऋण and मतुप् aff.
8010: ऋणशोधन n. (-नं) Payment or discharge of a debt. E. ऋण an शोधन purifying.
8011: ऋणादान n. (-नं) Recovery of a debt, receipt of money, &c. lent It is one of the eighteen titles or subjects of judicial procedure. E. ऋण and आदान receiving.
8012: ऋणान्तक m. (-कः) The planet MARS. E. ऋण, अन्त end, and क affix of agency: being the patron of debtors.
8013: ऋणापनयन n. (-नं) Discharge of a debt. E. ऋण and अपनयन removing.
8014: ऋणापनोदन n. (-नं) Payment of a debt. E. ऋण and अपनोदन removing.
8015: ऋणापाकरण n. (-णं) Paying off a debt. E. ऋण and अपाकरण acquittance.
8016: ऋणिक m. (-कः) A debtor. E. ऋण debt, वुन् aff.
8017: ऋणिन् mfn. (-णी-णीनी-णि) 1 Indebted. 2 Of or belonging to debt. m. (-णी) A debtor. E. ऋण and इनि aff.
8018: ऋणोद्ग्रहण n. (-णं) Recovering a debt in any way from the creditor, by friendly or legal proceedings, by stratagem, or by arrest. E. ऋण and उद्ग्रहण taking.
8019: ऋत r. 6th cl. (ऋतति) 1 To go. 2 To have power. 3 To domineer. 4 To hate.
8020: ऋत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Enlightened, luminous. 3 Wonshipped, respected. 4 True. n. (-तं) 1 Gleaning. 2 Wate 3 Truth. E. ऋ to go, affix क्त.
8021: ऋतधामन् m. (-मा) A name of VIṢṆU. E. ऋत luminous, धाम abode; whose residence is brilliant.
8022: ऋतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Seasonable, in season, relating to a season. E. ऋतु and यत् aff.
8023: ऋति f. (-तिः) 1 Prosperity, felicity. 2 A road, a way. 3 Abus censure, reproach. 4 Envy, emulation. 5 Going, motion. 6 I fortune. E. ऋ and क्तिन् aff.
8024: ऋतिङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Propitious, fortunate. E. ऋति and क what makes.
8025: ऋतीया f. (-या) 1 Censure, reproach, (according to some,) 2 Sham E. ऋत sautra root, to abuse, ईयच् affix, fem. ठाप्.
8026: ऋतु m. (-तुः) 1 A season, (the Hindu year is divided into ar seasons, each consisting of two months.) 2 The menstrual evacuation. 3 The time favourable for procreation, or sixteen days in each month. 4 A month. 5 A kind of collyrium 6 Light. E. ऋ to go, तु Uṇādi aff.
8027: ऋतुकाल m. (-लः) 1 The duration of a season. 2 The period menstruation. 3 The period favourable for procreation, sixteen days in each month. E. ऋतु and काल time.
8028: ऋतुगण m. (-णः) The seasons collectively. E. ऋतु and गण class.
8029: ऋतुपर्य्याय m. (-यः) The revolution of the seasons. E. ऋतु an पर्य्याय revolution.
8030: ऋतुप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Fruitful, fertile, &c. productive in due season. E. ऋतु season, and प्राप्त attained.
8031: ऋतुमती f. (-तिः) A woman during menstruation. E. ऋतु, मतुप् a.
8032: ऋतुवृत्ति m. (त्तिः) A year. E. ऋतु a season, वृत्ति being.
8033: ऋतुराज m. (-जः) Spring. E. ऋतु and राज king.
8034: ऋतुलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A sign of the season. 2 A symptom of menstruation. E. ऋतु and लिङ्ग a mark.
8035: ऋतुसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) The interval or junction between two seasons: the last seven days of one season and the first seven of the next. E. ऋतु and सन्धि union.
8036: ऋतुसात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) Diet, &c. suited to the season. E. ऋतु and सात्म्य suitableness.
8037: ऋतुस्नाता f. (-ता) A woman who has bathed after menstruation. E. ऋतु and स्नाता bathed.
8038: ऋतुस्नान n. (-नं) Bathing after menstruation. E. ऋतु and स्नान bathing.
8039: ऋते ind. Besides, except. E. ऋत Sautra root, to except, के aff.
8040: ऋतोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Speaking truth. E. ऋत and उक्ति saying.
8041: ऋत्वन्त m. (-न्तः) The close of a season. 2 The termination of menstruation. E. ऋतु and अन्त term.
8042: ऋत्विज् m. (-त्विक्) 1 A domestic chaplain, a family priest. E. ऋतु a season, यज to worship, affix क्विन् deriv. irr.
8043: ऋद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Prosperous, thriving, rising, &c. n. (-द्धं) 1 Stored grain. 2 A demonstrated conclusion, a distinct result. E. ऋध to grow, &c. affix क्त.
8044: ऋद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 A medicinal plant; also सिद्धि. 2 Increase, growth. 3 Fortune, prosperity. 4 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ. E. ऋध to grow, &c. क्तिन् aff.
8045: ऋद्धिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Rich, prosperous. E. ऋद्भि and मतुप् aff.
8046: ऋध r. 4th cl. (उ) ऋधु (ऋध्यति) To increase, to grow, to flourish, to prosper. r. 5th cl. (ऋध्नीति) 1 To increase, &c. 2 To augment or make increase. 3 To please.
8047: ऋफ r. 6th cl. (ऋफति) To injure, to kill; also रिफ.
8048: ऋभु m. (-भुः) 1 A deity, a divinity. 2 A divinity of a particular order. E. ऋ the mother of the gods, भू to be, डु affix; also रिभु.
8049: ऋभुक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 INDRA'S heaven or paradise. 3 The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. ऋभु a deity, क्षि to waste, to go, ड aff.
8050: ऋभुक्षिन् m. (-क्षाः) INDRA. E. ऋभुक्ष paradise, &c. इनि aff.
8051: ऋम्फ r. 6th cl. (ऋम्फति) To injure, to kill; also रिम्फ.
8052: ऋश्य m. (-श्यः) The painted or white footed antelope. E. ऋष to go, क्यप् affix; also ऋष्य and रिश्य.
8053: ऋष r. 1st cl. (अर्षति) To take, to receive, to choose. (ई) ऋषी r. 6th cl. (ऋषति) To go, to approach.
8054: ऋषभ m. (-भः) 1 (In composition,) best, excellent. 2 A bull. 3 A dried plant, one of the eight principal medicaments. 4 The second of the seven notes of the Hindu gamut; in abbreviation, Ri. 5 The first of the twenty-four principal. Jinas or Jaina saints. 6 The hollow of the ear. 7 The name of a mountain. 8 A crocodile's tail. 9 A boar's tail. f. (-भी) 1 A masculine woman, a woman with a beard, &c. 2 A widow. 3 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. ऋष to go, अभच् Uṇādi aff.
8055: ऋषभध्वज m. (-जः) A name of ŚIVA. 2 A Jaina saint. E. ऋषभ and ध्वज a sign: he whose symbol is a bull.
8056: ऋषि m. (-षिः) A Ṛṣi or sanctified personage so called: there are seven orders of these saints, as the Śrutarṣi, Kāṇḍarṣi, Paramarṣi, Maharṣi, Rājarṣi, Brahmarṣi and Devarṣi: the uncompounded name is especially applied to seven sages, of the Brahmarṣi order, cotemporary with each MANU; those of the present Manvantara, are MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU and VASIṢṬHA: the names of each series differ: those specified also form, in astronomy, the asterism of the greater bear: the Ṛṣi of a Mantra or mystic prayer in the Vedas, is the saint by whom it is supposed to have been remembered or recited. 2 A Veda. 3 A ray of light. 4 A saint or sanctified sage in general. f. (-षी) The wife of A Ṛṣi. E. ऋष to go, इन् Uṇādi affix fem. affix ङीष्; who goes beyond the limits of earthly life and wisdom.
8057: ऋषिकुल्या f. (-ल्या) A river. E. ऋषि a saint, कुल्या an artificial canal; a canal made by the saints.
8058: ऋषिगण m. (-णः) A company or number of sages. E. ऋषि and गण a number.
8060: ऋषिजाङ्गलिकी f. (-की) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus:) see वृद्धताडक. E. ऋषि and जाङ्गलिक a dealer in antidotes, affix ङीप्.
8061: ऋषिप्रोक्ता f. (-क्ताः) A plant: see माषपर्णी. E. ऋषि, प्रोक्त mentioned.
8062: ऋषियज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) The study of Scripture. E. ऋषि a sage, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
8063: ऋषीवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing or conveying a Ṛṣi. E. ऋषि and वह what bears, the final made long.
8064: ऋष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A sword. E. ऋष to go, affix क्तिन्.
8065: ऋष्य m. (-ष्यः) The painted or white footed antelope. n. (-ष्यं) A sort of leprosy. E. ऋष to go, क्यप् affix: also ऋश्य and रिश्य.
8066: ऋष्यकेतु m. (-तुः) A name of ANIRUDDHA the son of KANDARPA. E. ऋष्य and केतु a sign; having a deer for his symbol: some read this दिश्वकेतु, and others ऋश्यकेतु, ऋष्यकेतन, रिष्यकेतु, &c.
8067: ऋष्यगता f. (-ता) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. ऋषि and अ before गत gone.
8068: ऋष्यगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus:) see वृद्धताडक. E. ऋषि, अ priv. and गन्ध smell.
8069: ऋष्यजिह्व n. (-ह्वं) A sort of leprosy. E. ऋष्य the deer and जिह्वा the tongue; to which the blotches are compared.
8070: ऋष्यप्रोक्ता f. (-क्ता) 1 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 2 Asparagus racemosus. 3 Sida, (cordifolia and rhombifolia.) E. see ऋषिप्रोक्ता.
8071: ऋष्यमूक m. (-कः) A mountain in the Dekhin, the temporary abode of RĀMA with the monkey chief SUGRĪVA. E. ऋष्य a deer, मूक dumb.
8072: ऋष्यशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The name of a holy sage celebrated in the first book of the Rāmāyaṇa. ॠ
8073: ॠ The long vowel corresponding to the short one preceding, and having the sound of RI long.
8074: ॠ r. 9th cl. (गि) ॠणोति To go or move.
8075: ॠ f. (री) 1 The mother of the gods. 2 Also of the demons. 3 Recollection. m. (आ) 1 A name of BHAIRAVA. 2 An Asura or demon. 3 The breast. 4 Motion, going. ind. 1 Incipient particle. 2 An interjection of compassion. 3 Of reproach. 4 Of terror. 5 A mystical letter used in the Tantras. ऌ
8076: ऌ The ninth vowel of the Nāgarī Alphabet, having the power of Lri, but more usually considered to be expressed by Li as in Lily.
8077: ऌ aptote. 1 The divine nature. 2 The earth. 3 A mountain. ind. A mystical letter. ल
8078: ॡ The long vowel corresponding to the preceding short one, Ḹ of Ḷ.
8079: ॡ aptote. 1 A divine female. 2 The female nature. 3 A mother. m. (-ॡः) A name of ŚIVA. f. (-ॡः) 1 The mother of the demons. 2 The mother of the all-bestowing cow. ind. A mystical letter used once or repeatedly in many Mantras or mystical formulae. The letter ॠ and ऌ are employed in the same manner: they have apparently no signification, but are personified and invested with marvellous properties in the Tantras. ए
8080: ए The eleventh vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to the letter E as pronounced in most languages except the English, and having the sound of A in amiable.
8081: ए ind. An interjection of, 1 Remembering, (ha.) 2 Censure or contempt. 3 Compassion, (ah!) 4 Addressing, (eh! hey.) 5 Calling, (hey, ho.) (-एः) A name of VIṢṆU.
8082: एक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 One. 2 Alone, solitary. 3 Other, different. 4 Chief, pre-eminent. E. इण to go, Uṇādi affix कन्
8083: एकऋक्थिन् m. (-क्थी) A coheir. E. एक one (father), ऋक्थिन् heir.
