8084: एकक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Alone, solitary. E. एक one, &c. कन् aff.
8085: एककर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Making one. 2 One-handed. 3 Onerayed. E. एक and कर making, &c.
8086: एककार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Performing the same office, answering the same end. E. एक and कार्य्य act.
8087: एककाल m. (-लः) One or the same time. E. एक and काल time.
8088: एककालभोजन n. (-नं) Eating but one meal in any given time. E. एककाल and भोजन food.
8089: एककालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Coeval, cotemporary. E. एक and कालीन relating to time.
8090: एककुण्डल m. (-लः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 An epithet of KUVERA. E. एक and कुण्डल an ear-ring: wearing it in one ear.
8091: एकक्षीर n. (-रं) The milk of one (nurse, &c.) E. एक and क्षीर milk.
8092: एकगुरु m. (-रुः) A spiritual brother, pupil of the same preceptor. E. एक and गुरु a religious preceptor; also with कन् added एकगुरुक.
8093: एकग्रामीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Of the same town or village. E. एक one, ग्रामीण villager.
8094: एकचक्र m. (-क्रः) The name of a city: see हरिगृह. E. एक, चक्र a circle.
8095: एकचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Solitary, alone. 2 Having one follower. m. (-रः) A rhinoceros. E. एक् alone, and चर who goes.
8096: एकचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going alone or with one follower only. m. (-री) A follower of BUDDHA. E. एक one, चर to go, णिनि aff.
8097: एकचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Thinking of one thing only, intent upon, absorbed in. 2 Of one mind, agreeing, concurring. E. एक one, चित्त the mind.
8098: एकजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A Śūdra. E. एक best or one, जन्मन् birth.
8099: एकजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Of one parentage, born of the same parents. E. एक and जात born.
8100: एकजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Of the same caste. 2 Once born. m. (-तिः) A Śūdra. E. एक one, and जाति birth or caste: not being regenerated by investiture, &c.
8101: एकज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 The chord of an arc. 2 Sine of 30° or of the radius. E. एक and ज्या a cord.
8102: एकतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) One of many. E. एक and डतमच् affix of the superlative.
8103: एकतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Either, one of two. 2 Other, different. E. एक and डतरच् affix of the comparative.
8104: एकतस् ind. On one side, on one part. E. एक and तसिल् aff.
8105: एकता f. (-ता) Unity, oneness. E. एक and तल् affix, or with त्व aff. एकत्व n. (-त्वं.)
8106: एकतान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Closely attentive, having the mind fixed on one only object. m. (-नः) Musical unison: see the next. E. एक, तन to stretch or spread, घञ् aff.
8107: एकताल m. (-लः) Harmony, unison, the accurate adjustment of song, dance, and instrumental music. (-ली) An instrument for heating time, any instrument having but one note. E. एक one, uniform, and ताल musical measure or time.
8108: एकतीर्थिन् m. (-र्थी) A spiritual brother, an associate in religious offices or objects. E. एक one, the same, तीर्थ place of pilgrimage, इनि aff.
8109: एकत्र ind. Together, in one, in one place. E. एक and त्रल् aff.
8110: एकदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. एक and दंष्ट्र a tooth, single toothed or tusked; the fellow being broken off in a scuffle by KĀRTTIKEYA, or according to another legend by PARAŚURĀMA; also एकदन्त.
8111: एकदन्त m. (-न्तः) A name of GAṆEŚA: see the preceding. E. एक and दन्त a tooth.
8112: एकदा ind. At the same time, at once. E. एक and दाच् aff.
8113: एकदुःखसुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Sympathizing, having the same joy and sorrows. E. एक, and दुःख pain, सुख pleasure.
8114: एकदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) One-eyed. m. (-दृक्) 1 A name of MAHĀDEVA 2 A crow. E. एक and दृश् an eye: ŚIVA is termed one-eyed from the eye in his forehead.
8115: एकदेश m. (-शः) A part, a portion, a division. E. एक and देश place.
8116: एकदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Elegantly formed. 2 Single bodied m. (-हः) The planet MERCURY. E. एक best or one, and देह body.
8117: एकधा ind. In one way. E. एक and धाच् aff.
8118: एकधुर् f. (-धूः) A particular burthen or conveyance. E. एक an धुर् a load.
8119: एकधुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cattle for special burthen, fit for but or kind of labour. E. see एकधुरीण.
8120: एकधुरावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) See the preceding. E. एक, धुर burthen, and वह who bears.
8121: एकधुरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Cattle of special burthen. E. एक, धुर a burthen, ख affix which leaves ईण, or with अ affix forming एकधुर.
8122: एकनट m. (-टः) The principal actor in a drama, the manager. E. एक chief, and नट an actor.
8123: एकनाथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Having one master. m. (-थः) Sole master or lord. E. एक and नाथ lord.
8124: एकपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) An associate, a firm ally or partisan. E. एक one, पक्ष part; of the same side or party.
8125: एकपत्नी f. (-त्नी) 1 A faithful wife, one devoted to her husband. 2 The wife of a man who has no other wives. E. एक one or excellent, पति a husband, न substituted for the final, and ङीप् aff.
8126: एकपत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, white basil. E. एक and पत्र a leaf.
8127: एकपद adv. n. (-दं) Then, at that time, at once. m. (-दः) A single inflection of a verb or noun. f. (-दी) A road, a path or way. E. एक one, पद a foot, fem. affix ङीप्.
8128: एकपरि ind. One over, a term at dice. E. एक and परि over, against.
8129: एकपात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sudden, rapid, coming suddenly or at once. E. एक and पात falling upon.
8130: एकपाद् m. (-त्) A name of ŚIVA. E. एक best, and पाद् a ray.
8131: एकपिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of KUVERA. E. एक one, and पिङ्ग tawny: having a yellow mark in the place of one of his eyes.
8132: एकपिङ्गल m. (-लः) See the preceding. E. as before.
8133: एकपिण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Related, near of kin, united by the offering of the funeral cake. E. एक and पिण्ड a funeral cake.
8134: एकपिण्डता f. (-ता) Connexion by the funeral cake, consanguinity. E. एकपिण्ड and तल् affix; also with त्व, एकपिण्डत्वं.
8135: एकफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having one or a principal result or object. E. एक and फल fruit.
8136: एकभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Attached to a common master. 2 Worshipping one deity. 3 Eating together. 4 Eating but one meal, (a day.) E. एक and भक्त attached to, or भक्त food.
8137: एकभक्तव्रत n. (-तं) Eating but once a day as a religious obligation. E. एक, भक्त food, व्रत vow.
8138: एकभक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) 1 Of one faith. 2 Believing in one deity. E. एक and भक्ति faith.
8139: एकभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Of a simple or single nature or temperament. E. एक and भाव disposition.
8140: एकभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Eating but one meal, (a day, &c.) 2 Eating together. E. एक and भुक्त eaten.
8141: एकभोजन n. (-नं) 1 Eating in common, feeding together. 2 Eating one meal a day, &c. E. एक and भोजन food.
8142: एकमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) 1 Having one chief or head. 2 One faced. E. एक and मुख the mouth.
8143: एकमूला f. (-ला) 1 A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.) 2 Flax, (Linum.) E. एक and मूल root.
8144: एकयष्टिका f. (-का) A single string of flowers, pearls, &c. E. एक and यष्टिका a necklace, &c.
8145: एकयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Uterine, of the same mother. E. एक and योनि womb.
8146: एकरज m. (-जः) A plant, (Verbesina scandens:) see भृङ्गराज. E. एक excellent, and रजस् farina.
8147: एकरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Of one flavour. E. एक and रस flavour.
8148: एकरात्र n. (-त्रं) One night, a night. E. एक and रात्रि night.
8149: एकरात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) For a night, of a night. E. एक and रात्रि night, with ठक् aff.
8150: एकराशि f. (-शिः) A heap, a crowd. E. एक and राशि a heap.
8151: एकराशिभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped or collected together. E. एकराशि and भूत become.
8152: एकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Alone, solitary; a various reading of एकक.
8153: एकलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 A place or district in which for five Cos there is but one Phallus. E. एक one or best, लिङ्ग a mark, &c.
8154: एकवद्भाव m. (-वः) An aggregate of many, as in grammar, the formation of a compound noun of several nouns. E. एक, वत् like, भाव property.
8155: एकवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Of one caste or tribe. 2 Of one colour. 3 Of one quality. m. (-र्णः) One unknown quantity, (in algebra.) f. (-र्णी) Beating time, marking musical measure by clapping the hands, or the instrument which does so, a castanet: see एकताली. E. एक, वर्ण a quality, a note, and ङीष् aff.
8156: एकवर्णसमीकरण n. (-णं) Uniliteral equation. E. एकवर्णं and समीकरण equation.
8157: एकवर्षिका f. (-का) A heifer one year old. E. एक, वर्ष a year, ठक् aff.
8158: एकवाद m. (-दः) A musical instrument, a kind of drum or tabor. E. एक principal, वाद sound: high-sounding.
8159: एकवीर m. (-रः) A chief warrior. E. एक and वीर a hero.
8160: एकवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A desert place, in which but one tree is seen for four Cos. E. एक and वृक्ष a tree.
8161: एकवेणी f. (-णी) 1 A single braid of hair. 2 A woman whose hair is tied in one braid. E. एक and वेणी a tress.
8162: एकशफ m. (-फः) 1 A horse. 2 Any animal whose hoof is not cloven. E. एक one, uniform, and शफ a hoof.
8163: एकशरण n. (-णं) One only hope or refuge, especially applied to a deity. E. एक and शरण protection.
8164: एकशरीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Consanguineous, of one body or blood. 2 Of one or the same body. E. एक, शरीर body.
8165: एकशरीरान्वय m. (-यः) Consanguineous descent. E. एकशरीर and अन्वय lineage.
8166: एकशरीरारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Commencement of consanguinity by the union of father and mother. E. एकशरीर and आरम्भ beginning.
8167: एकशरीरावयव m. (-वः) A descendant in a right line, a kinsman by blood. E. एकशरीर and अवयव a member.
8168: एकशरीरावयवत्व n. (-त्वं) Consanguineous descent or connexion. E. त्व added to the last.
8169: एकशाख m. (-खः) A Brahman of the same branch or school. E. एक and शाखा a branch, (of the Vedas.)
8170: एकशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A title of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 2 A unicorn, a rhinoceros, &c. E. एक and शृङ्ग a mark or horn.
8171: एकसर्ग mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) Closely attentive, having the mind intent upon one object. E. एक one, and सृज to create, घञ् aff.
8172: एकसूत्र m. (-त्रः) A small double drum, played by a string and ball attached to the body of it: see वृषाङ्कज. E. एक and सूत्र a thread.
8173: एकसूनु m. (-नुः) An only son. E. एक, and सूनु a son.
8174: एकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Collected, assembled, conjoined, in one site or place. E. एक and स्थ what stays.
8175: एकस्थान n. (-नं) One place, the same place. E. एक and स्थान place, aff.
8176: एकहायनी f. (-नी) A heifer one year old. E. एक, हायन a year, affix ङीष्.
8177: एकाकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Alone, solitary. E. एक and आकिनिच् aff.
8178: एकाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) One-eyed. m. (-क्षः) A crow. E. एक and अक्षि an eye.
8179: एकाक्षर n. (-रं) A monosyllable, especially the sacred monosyllable Om. E. एक and अक्षर a letter.
8180: एकाग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 Intent, closely attentive, fixed on one object. 2 Undisturbed, unperplexed. 3 Known, celebrated. 4 Single-pointed. m. (-ग्रः) The whole of a long line which is subdivided. E. एक and ग्र chief, &c.
8181: एकाग्रता f. (-ता) Close and undisturbed attention. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, एकाग्रत्वं.
8182: एकाग्र्य mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं) Closely attentive: see the preceding. E. एक, अग्र्य chief, &c.
8183: एकाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The planet MERCURY. n. (-ङ्गं) Sandal. E. एक best pre-eminent, and अङ्ग body.
8184: एकादश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Eleven, eleventh. f. (-शी) The eleventh day of the half month: it is especially sacred to VIṢṆU, and fasting on it is most efficacious. E. एकादशन् eleven, affix ड.
8185: एकादशन् plur. mfn. (-श) Eleven. E. एक one, दशन् ten, with आङ् inserted.
8186: एकानंशा f. (-शा) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. अंश a part, with the neg. pref. and एक preeminent: chief and undivided.
8187: एकानुदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Left, as a funeral feast, one who has recently partaken of it. E. एक one, (ancestor,) अनु after, दिष्ट shown.
8188: एकान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Excessive. 2 Solitary, lonely, retired. 3 Aside, apart. adv. n. (-न्तं) 1 Much, excessive. 2 Apart. E. एक one, and अन्त end.
8189: एकान्तकरुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Very compassionate, weakly charitable. E. एकान्त and करुण charitable.
8190: एकान्ततस् ind. 1 Alone, apart, privately. 2 Much, exceedingly. E. एकान्त and तसिल् aff.
8191: एकान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Next but one. E. एक and अन्तर between.
8192: एकान्तस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Staying alone or apart. E. एकान्त and स्थित staying.
8193: एकाब्दा f. (-ब्दा) A heifer one year old. E. एक and अब्द a year.
8194: एकायन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Closely attentive, intent. E. एक, अयन going.
8195: एकायनगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) See the preceding. E. एकायन and गत being, having gone.
8196: एकावली f. (-ली) A single string of beads, flowers, &c. E. एक and आवली a row.
8197: एकार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Having one sense or meaning. 2 Having one or the same object. E. एक and अर्थ meaning.
8198: एकाश्रितगुण m. (-णः) A simple attribute or predicate, as form, taste, smell, &c. E. एक one, आश्रित invested, गुण property.
8199: एकाष्टी f. (-ष्टी) A pod or seed of cotton.
8200: एकाष्टील m. (-लः) A plant: see वकपुष्प; the flowers are sacred to ŚIVA. f. (-ली) A medicinal plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. एक best, अष्टि seed, and ल what gives or takes, from ला with क aff.
8201: एकाह n. (-हः) The period of one day. E. एक and अहन् a day.
8202: एकाहगम m. (-मः) A day's journey. E. एकाह and गम going.
8203: एकीभाव m. (-वः) Common nature or property. E. एक with च्चि augment, and भाव nature.
8204: एकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) A companion, a partisan or associate. E. एक one, and छण affix, also एकपक्ष.
8205: एकैक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Singly, one by one. E. एक repeated.
8206: एकैकशस् ind. One by one, severally, seriatim. E. एक repeated, with शसि aff.
8207: एकोद्दिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) The Śrāddha or funeral rite offered to one person only. E. एक and उद्दिष्ट addressed to.
8208: एकोशिका f. (-का) A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra:) see एकाष्टील.
8209: एकौघभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, crowded together. E. एक one, ओघ quantity, भूत become.
8210: एज r. 1st cl. (ऋ) एजृ (एजते) To shine. (एजति) To quake or tremble.
8211: एजन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling. E. एज and ल्युट् aff.
8212: एजयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing to shake or tremble. E. एज to shake, causal form, शतृ aff.
8213: एजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling. E. एज to shake, क्त aff.
8214: एजितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be shaken. E. एज and तव्य aff.
8215: एजितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Shaking, trembling. E. एज and तृच् aff.
8216: एठ r. 1st cl. (एठते) To annoy, to resist or oppose.
8217: एड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Deaf. E. ईड to praise, आङ् prefixed, अच् or घञ् aff.
8218: एडक m. (-कः) 1 A ram. 2 A wild goat. f. (-का) A ewe. E. ईल to go, ण्वुल् affix; and ल changed to ड.
8219: एडगज m. (-जः) A medicinal plant, used for the cure of ringworms, (Cassia tora.) E. एड a sheep, गज to sound, अच् aff.
8220: एडमूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Deaf and dumb. 2 Wicked, perverse. E. एड deaf, and भूक dumb.
8221: एडुक n. (-कं) 1 A building constructed of rubbish, bones, &c. 2 A wall enclosing bones, a tomb, &c. 3 A building of hard substances resembling bones. E. ईड to throw or send, deriv. irr.; also एडूक and ण्डोक.
8222: एण mf. (-णः-णी) A kind of deer or antelope, described as being of a black colour, with beautiful eyes, and short legs. E. इण to go, ण aff.
8223: एणक m. (-कः) A species of deer or antelope: see the preceding. E. कन् added to एण.
8224: एणतिलक m. (-कः) The moon. E. एण an antelope, and तिलक the sectarial mark; a deer being fancifully visible in the moon.
8225: एणभृत् m. (-त्) The moon. E. एण and भृत् who nourishes: see the preceding.
8226: एणाजिन n. (-नं) A deer skin. E. एण and अजिन the same.
8227: एत mfn. (-तः-ता or -ती तं) Of a variegated colour. (-तः-ता-तं) Arrived, come. m. (-तः) 1 A deer or antelope. 2 A variegated colour. E. इण to go, तन् affix; when signifying colour, the fem. affix is either टाप् or ङीप्, and before the latter, त is changed to न.
8228: एतद् pron. mfn. (एषः एषा एतद् or एतत्) This. E. एत derived from इण to go, and तद् Uṇādi aff.
8229: एतन m. (-नः) Expiration, breathing out, discharging air from the lungs. E. इण to go, तनन् aff.
8230: एतर्हि ind. Now, at this time. E. एत substituted for इदम्, and र्हिल aff.
8231: एतश m. (-शः) A Brahman. E. इण to go, and तशः Uṇādi aff.
8232: एतशस् m. (-शाः) A Brahman or man of the first class. E. इण to go, तशस् aff.
8233: एतादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such, such like. E. एतद् this, दृश् to see, क्किप् aff.
8234: एतादृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Such, such like. E. एतद् this, दृश to see, कञ् aff.
8235: एतावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) So many, so much, so far. ind. (-वत) So far, thus far, so much, &c. E. एतद्, and मतुप् or वति aff.
8236: एत्य ind. Having gone to or approached. E. इण to go, ल्यप् aff.
8237: एध r. 1st cl. (एधते) To grow or increase.
8238: एध m. (-धः) Fuel, as wood, grass, &c. E. एध to increase, घञ् aff.
8239: एधतु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Increased, grown. m. (-तुः) 1 Man. 2 Fire. E. एध to increase, तु Uṇādi aff.
8240: एधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be enlarged or increased. E. एध to grow, and अनीयर् affix; also एधितव्य and एध्य.
8241: एधस् n. (-धः) Fuel: see एध. E. एध to grow, Uṇādi affix असुन्.
8242: एधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Increased, grown. E. एध to increase, affix क्त.
8243: एधितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Increasing, growing, enlarging. E. एध to grown, and तृच् aff.
8244: एनस् n. (-एनः) 1 Sin, fault, offence. 2 Censure, blame. E. इण to go, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
8245: एनस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Sinful, a sinner. E. एनस्, and विनि aff.
8246: एरका f. (-का) A sort of grass of emollient and diluent properties.
8247: एरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A kind of fish; also एलङ्ग.
8248: एरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The castor-oil plant, (Palma christi or Ricinus communis). f. (-ण्डी) Long pepper. E. इर to go, &c. आङ् prefixed, अण्डच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added एरण्डक.
8249: एरण्डक m. (-कः) Palma christi: see the preceding.
8250: एरण्डपत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Danti. E. एरण्ड, and पत्र leaf, having similar leaves.
8251: एरण्डफला f. (-ला) A plant: see the preceding. E. एरण्ड, and फल fruit.
8252: एर्वारु m. (-रुः) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) E. see ईर्व्वारु.
8253: एलक m. (-कः) A ram: see एडक. E. ड and ल being interchanged.
8254: एलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of fish, (Cyprinus marginatus, BUC.) also एरङ्ग.
8255: एलवालु n. (-लु) The name of a perfume: see the next word.
8256: एलवालुक n. (-वं) A granular substance apparently vegetable, of a reddish brown colour, and used as a drug and as a perfume. E. एला cardamoms, वल to breathe, उण् affix, and कन् added, or without कन्, एलवालु.
8257: एलविल m. (-लः) A name of KUVERA: see ऐलविल.
8258: एला f. (-ला) Cardamoms, the seed of the Eletteria cardamomum, or Alpinia Cardamomum: it applies to both the large and small cardamom, but most commonly to the former. E. इल to send, &c. अच् aff.
8259: एलापत्र m. (-त्रः) One of the chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent race.
8260: एलापर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) E. एल cardamoms, and पर्ण a leaf, ङीष् fem. aff.
8261: एलीका f. (का) Small cardamoms. E. एला, and ईकन् added.
8262: एव mfn. (-एवः-एवा-एवं) Going, moving. ind. As, like, &c.: see एवम्. E. इण् to go, Uṇādi affix वन्: see the next.
8263: एवम् ind. A particle implying. 1 Likeness, (as, so, like.) 2 Assent, (yes, verily.) 3 Sameness of manner, (thus, in this way.) 4 Certainly, (indeed, assuredly, even so.) 5 Command, (so, thus, &c.) 6 An expletive. E. इण to go, वम् affix; also एव.
8264: एवम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) So, such, in such manner. E. एवम्, and भूत been.
8265: एवम्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Such, in such form or manner, of such a kind. E. एवम्, and विध sort, way.
8266: एष r. 1st cl. (ऋ) एषृ (एषते) To go or approach.
8267: एषण m. (-णः) An iron arrow. f. (-णी) 1 A goldsmith's balance, assay scales. 2 An iron or steel probe. E. एष to go, ल्युट् and ङीष् affs.
8268: एषणिका f. (-का) A goldsmith's balance. E. as before, with कन् and टाप् added.
8269: एषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be desired, desirable. 2 To be aimed at. E. इष to wish, affix अनीयर्.
8270: एषा f. (-षा) Desire. E. इष to wish, अङ् and टाप् affs.
8271: एषितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wishing, desirous. E. ईष to wish, तृच् aff.
8272: एष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्र) 1 Wishing, desirous. E. ईष to wish, तृच् aff. ऐ
8273: ऐ The twelfth vowel of the Nagarī alphabet, or more properly a diphthong; corresponding in sound to Ei in heighth.
8274: ऐ ind. An interjection of, 1 Remembering, (aye, ha.) 2 Calling, summoning, (hola, ho, heigh.)
8275: ऐ m. (-ऐः) A name of ŚIVA.
8276: ऐकध्य n. (-ध्यं) Singleness of time or occurrence. E. एक, and ध्यमुञ् aff.
8277: ऐकमत्य n. (-त्यं) Consent, concurrence, sameness of doctrine or opinion. E. एक one, मत minded, ष्यञ् aff.
8278: ऐकशफ mfn. (-फः-फी-फं) Produced by or belonging to animals with single hoofs. E. एकशफ, and अण aff.
8279: ऐकागारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 A thief, a robber. 2 The possessor of one residence. E. एक one, अगार a house, affix ठक्.
8280: ऐकाग्र्य n. (-ग्र्यं) Intentness. of one object. E. एकाग्र, and ष्यञ् aff.
8281: ऐकान्यिक m. (-कः) One who commits a single error in reading. E. एक, and अन्य other, ठक् aff.
8282: ऐकाहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ephemeral, quotidian, of one day, of the same day. E. एक, and अहन a day, ठञ् aff.
8283: ऐक्य n. (-क्यं) 1 Unity, oneness. 2 A whole of various parts, an aggregate, a total. E. एक, and ष्यञ् aff.
8284: ऐक्षव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Sugar, sugary, produced from or relating to the sugar cane. E. इक्षु sugar cane, अण् aff.
8285: ऐक्षुक m. (-कः) A carrier of sugar canes. E. ईक्ष, and ठञ् aff.
8286: ऐक्षुभारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carrying sugar canes. E. इक्षु, and भार a load, ठञ् aff.
8287: ऐक्ष्वाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of the family of IKṢVĀKU. E. ईक्षाकु, and अञ् affix, the final rejected.
8288: ऐक्ष्वाकव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of the family of IKṢVĀKU. E. ईक्ष्वाकु, and अण् aff.
8289: ऐङ्गुद n. (-दं) The fruit of the plant called Iṅguda. E. इङ्गुद the plant, affix अण्.
8290: ऐच्छिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Optional, voluntary, at will. E. इच्छा wish, ठञ् aff.
8291: ऐडुक n. (-कं) A wall, &c. of bones and rubbish: see एडुक.
8292: ऐण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Belonging to a male antelope. E. एण an antelope, अण aff.
8293: ऐणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a deer, &c. m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-killer. E. एण, and ठञ् aff.
8294: ऐणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Appertaining to a doe or the female antelope. E. एणी a doe, affix ढक्.
8295: ऐतरेयोपनिषद् f. (-षद् or षत्) One of the Upaniṣads of the Vedas.
8296: ऐतिहासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Historical. m. (-कः) A historian. E. इतिहास a story, and ठक् aff.
8297: ऐतिह्य n. (-ह्यं) Traditional instruction. E. इतिहा tradition, ञ्य aff.
8298: ऐन्दव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Lunar. n. (-वं) The asterism Mṛgaśiras. f. (-वी) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. इन्दु the moon, अण् aff.
8299: ऐन्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रं) Sacred, or relating to the god INDRA. m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A name of the monkey king BĀLĪ. 2 A name of ARJUNA. f. (-न्द्री) 1 The wife of INDRA. 2 The goddess DURGĀ. 3 Misfortune, misery, (personified.) The name of a plant, a kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) 5 The constellation Jyeṣṭha. 6 The east quarter, of which INDRA is regent. E. इन्द्र, and अण् aff.
8300: ऐन्द्रजालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Deceptive, illusory. m. (-कः) A juggler. E. इन्द्रजाल deception, and ठक् aff.
8301: ऐन्द्रलुप्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Afflicted with falling of the hair or morbid baldness. E. इन्द्रलुप्त falling of the hair, and ठक् aff.
8302: ऐन्द्राग्न m. (-ग्नः) A ceremony, &c. addressed to INDRA and AGNI. E. इन्द्र, and अग्नि, with अण् aff.
8303: ऐन्द्रायुध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Relating to INDRA'S bow or the rainbow. E. इन्द्रायुध, and अण् aff.
8304: ऐन्द्रावरुण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Sacred to INDRA and VARUṆA. E. इन्द्र, and वरुण with अण् aff.
8305: ऐन्द्रि m. (-न्द्रिः) 1 The patronymick of JAYANTA the son of INDRA. 2 A name of the monkey BĀLĪ. 3 A name of ARJUNA. 4 A crow. E. इन्द्र, इञ् patronymick aff.
8306: ऐन्द्रियक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Perceptible, perceived, present. 2 Of or belonging to the sense. E. इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, and वुञ् aff.
8307: ऐरावण m. (-णः) INDRA'S elephant. E. इरावत् the ocean, अण affix of descent; ocean-born: न is changed irregularly to ण.
8308: ऐरावत m. (-तः) 1 INDRA'S elephant. 2 The same, considered as the elephant of the north quarter. 3 An orange. 4 A fruit, (Artocarpus lacucha.) 5 A serpent, one of the chiefs of the Nāga or serpent race, inhabiting the infernal regions. f. (-ती) 1 Lightning. 2 A particular kind of it. 3 The female of INDRA'S elephant. 4 The Rāvī river in the Pañjāb. n. (-त) INDRA'S bow unbent, the rainbow. E. इरावत् water-having; that is, the ocean, a cloud, &c. अण् affix implying origin or descent; born from the ocean, (the elephant,) proceeding from watery clouds, (lightning, &c.)
8309: ऐरिण n. (-णं) Fossil or rock salt. E. इरिन् earthy, अण् aff.
8310: ऐरेय n. (-यं) A spirituous liquor. E. इरा wine, ढक् affix: see मैरेय.
8311: ऐल m. (-लः) The name of a king, also PURŪRAVAS. E. इला the wife of BUDDHA, अण् patronymick affix; the son of ILĀ.
8312: ऐलवालुक n. (-कं) A perfume: see एलवालुक.
8313: ऐलविल m. (-लः) A title of KUVERA. E. इलविला the wife of PULASTYA, and the paternal grand-mother of the deity, affix अण; also ऐडविल, ऐडविड, एलविल, &c. ल and ड being interchanged.
8314: ऐलेय n. (-यं) A perfume: see एलवालुक. E. एला cardamoms, ढक् aff.
8315: ऐश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 1 Divine. 2 Regal. E. ईश, and अण aff.
8316: ऐशानी f. (-नी) The north-east quarter. E. ईशान ŚIVA, as regent of the north-east, अण् and ङीष् affs.
8317: ऐशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Divine, heavenly. 2 Regal, royal. E. ईश, and ठक् aff.
8318: ऐश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Divine, relating to god, &c. 2 Royal, supreme. E. ईश्वर, and अण् aff.
8319: ऐश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Super-human power, the divine faculties of omnipresence, omnipotence, invisibility, &c. 2 Supremacy, dominion, sway, power, might. E. ईश्वर a master, a deity, and ष्यञ् aff.
8320: ऐषमस् ind. The present year. E. इदम् this, समसण् aff.
8321: ऐषमस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of or belonging to the present year. E. ऐषमस, and त्यय affix; or with द्यु affix, ऐषमस्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
8322: ऐष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacrificial, ceremonial. E. इष्टि a sacrifice, ठञ् aff.
8323: ऐष्टिकपौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ceremonial and meritorious, (any act, &c.) E. इष्टापूर्त्तं any pious act, ठञ् aff.
8324: ऐहलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of this world, terrestrial, sublunary. E. इह here, लोक world, ठञ् aff.
8325: ऐहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worldly, local, of this world, of this place. E. ईह here, and ठञ् aff. ओ
8326: ओ The vowel O, and the thirteenth of the Nāgarī alphabet.
8327: ओ ind. 1 A vocative particle, (oh.) 2 An interjection of calling, (ho, hola.) 3 Of reminiscence, (ho, ah.) 4 Of compassionating, (ah, oh.)
8329: ॐ ind. The mystical monosyllable Om: see ओम्.
8330: ओक m. (-कः) 1 A house. 2 An asylum, a refuge: see ओकम्. 3 A bird. E. उच to assemble, क aff.
8331: ओकण m. (-णः) A bug; also ओकणि.
8332: ओकस् n. (-कः) 1 An asylum, a place of refuge. 2 A house. E. उच to collect, असुन Uṇādi affix, च becomes क.
8333: ओकुल m. (-लः) A cake of flour.
8336: ओख r. 1st. cl (ऋ) ओखृ (ओखति and with a prefix, as प्र, प्रोखति.) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To be able or competent, to suffice. 4 To refuse or prevent.
8337: ओघ m. (-घः) 1 A heap or quantity, flock or multitude. 2 A stream, a torrent, a rapid flow of water, an inundation. 3 Quick time in music. 4 Tradition. 5 Advice, instruction. E. उच to collect, घञ् affix, and च is changed to घ.
8338: ओङ्कार m. (-रः) The mysterious name of the deity: see ओम्. f. (-रा) A Bauddha Śakti, or female personification of divine energy. E. ओम, and कार affix implying a letter, the compound letter ओ; otherwise ओम्, signifying assent, and कार who makes; what complies with our wishes.
8339: ओज (त) r. 1st cl. (ओजति) 1 To live, to have the vital faculties and organs. 2 To be strong or able.
8341: ओजस् n. (-जः) 1 Light, splendor. 2 Manifestation, appearance. 3 Strength. 4 Support, stay. 5 Metallic lustre. 6 Vitality, the principle of vital warmth and action diffused throughout the body. 7 Virility, the generative faculty. 8 A form of style, elaborate style, abounding with compounds. 9 (In astrology,) Each alternate sign of the zodiac, first, third, fifth, &c. E. ओज to live, and असुन् affix; or with अच् affix ओज.
8342: ओजस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Mighty, powerful, strong. 2 Splendid, bright. E. आजस्, and विनि aff.
8343: ओडक m. (-कः) A musical mode, which omits two of the notes of the scale, Ri and Pa.
8346: ओड्र m. (-ड्रः) 1 The China rose, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 2 The name of a country, the northern part of Orissa. E. उड to embrace. रक affix, and उ is changed to ओ.
8347: ओड्रपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The China rose, the plant or its flower. E. ओड्र China rose, and पुष्प a flower.
8348: ओण r. 1st cl. (ऋ) ओणृ (ओणति) To remove, to take away or abstract.
8349: ओतु m. (-तुः) A cat. E. अव to go, &c. and तु Uṇādi affix, the radical is changed to ओ.
8350: ओदन mn. (-नः-नं) Boiled rice. f. (-निका-नी) A plant, (Sida cordifolia, &c.) see वला. E. उन्द to be wet, ल्युट् Uṇādi affix, and न dropped.
8351: ओद्म m. (-द्मः) Wetting, moistening. E. उन्द to be wet, मम् aff.
8352: ओम् ind. 1 The mystic name of the deity, prefacing all the prayers and most of the writings of the Hindus. E. अ a name of VIṢṆU, उ ŚIVA, and म of BRAHMA; it therefore implies the Indian triad, and expresses the three in one. 2 A particle of command or injunction, 3 Of assent, (verily, amen.) 4 Of auspiciousness. 5 Of removal, (away, hence,) and, 6 It is an inceptive particle. E. अव to go, to preserve, &c. मन् Uṇādi affix, the radical being converted into ओ.
8353: ओल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wet, damp; also ओण. m. (-लः) An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum.) E. वल or वल्ल to destroy, (complaints, especially hoemorrhoids.) अच् affix, व changed to ओ.
8354: ओलड r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) ओलडि (ओलण्डति or ओलण्डयति.) To dart or throw up: some consider the initial vowel to be indicatory, and make the root लडि q. v.
8355: ओष m. (-षः) Burning, combustion. E. उष to burn, घञ् aff.
8356: ओषण m. (-णः) Pungency, pungent taste or flavour. f. (-णी) A potherb, commonly Pūrya. E. उष to burn, and ल्यट् aff.
8357: ओषधि f. (-धिः) An annual plant or herb, one that dies after becoming ripe. E. ओष heat, and धा to have, कि affix; or with ङीष्, ओषधी; or with इञ् affix, औषधि.
8358: ओषधी f. (-धी) An annual plant or deciduous herb: see the preceding.
8359: ओषधीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. ओषधी and पति lord: presiding over annual plants.
8360: ओषधीश m. (-शः) The moon. E. see the preceding; ईश meaning lord.
8361: ओष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The lip, especially the upper, &c. du. m. (ओष्ठौ or ओष्ठाधरौ) The lips: see अधर. f. (-ष्ठी) A creeper, bearing a red flower, to which the lip is commonly compared, (Bryonia grandis.) E. उष to burn, थन् Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्: see विम्ब.
8362: ओष्ठपल्लव n. (-वं) A lip or the lips. E. ओष्ठ and पल्लव a new shoot.
8363: ओष्ठरोग m. (-गः) Any morbid affection of the lips. E. ओष्ठ and रोग disease.
8364: ओष्ठोपमफला f. (-ला) The creeper, (Bryonia grandis:) see ओष्ठी. E. ओष्ठ a lip, उपम like, फल a flower, अच् and टाप् affixes; whose flower resembles a lip. औ
8365: औ The diphthong Au or Ou, having the same sound as in Our, and considered as the fourteenth vowel of the Nāgarī alphabet.
8366: औ ind. An interjection of, 1 Calling, (ho! hola.) 2 Of addressing, (the vocative particle oh.) 3 A particle of prohibition, and 4 Of asseveration.
8367: औ m. (-औः) The serpent ANANTA. f. (-औः) The earth.
8368: औ ind. The mystical prefix proper for Śūdras: see ओम्.
8369: औक्थक m. (-कः) A Brahman acquainted with the Uktha portion of the Sāma Veda. E. उक्था, and ठक् aff.
8370: औक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Relating to an ox, derived from one, &c. E. उक्षन्, and अण् aff.
8371: औक्षक m. (-कः) A herd of oxen. E. उक्ष an ox, वुञ् aff.
8372: औख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Boiled or dressed in a pot. E. उखा a cauldron, a saucepan, यञ् aff.
8373: औचित्य nf. (-त्यं-ती) Propriety, aptness, fitness. E. उचित proper, ष्यञ् affix in the abstract sense.
8374: औजसिक m. (-कः) A hero. E. ओजस् strength, ठक् aff.
8375: औडुपिक m. (-कः) A passenger, one going in a raft or boat. E. उडुप, and ठक् aff.
8376: औडुम्बर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Coppery, made of copper, &c. 2 Made of the wood of the Uḍumbara fig tree. m. (-रः) A name of YAMA the regent of death. n. (-रं) 1 A kind of leprosy. 2 Copper. E. उडुम्बर, and अण affix: see उडुम्बर, उदुम्बर, &c.
8377: औड्र m. (-ड्रः) An Uriya, an inhabitant of Urisa. E. ओड्र, and अण् aff.
8378: औत्कर्ष्य n. (-र्ष्यं) Excellence, superiority. E. उत्कर्ष, and ष्यञ् aff.
8379: औत्तमि m. (-मिः) The third MANU. E. उत्तम, and इञ् patron. aff.
8380: औत्तरपथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going or coming in a northerly direction. E. उत्तर, पथ for पथिन् a road, ठक् aff.
8381: औत्तानपादि m. (-दिः) A name of DHRUVA, in mythology the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA, and grandson of the first MANU; in astronomy, the polar star, or the north pole itself. E. उत्तानपाद, and इञ् patronymic aff.
8382: औत्पातिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Portentous, calamitous. E. उत्पात, and ठक् aff.
8383: औत्सङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carried or placed upon the hip or flank. E. उत्सङ्ग, and ठक् aff.
8384: औत्सर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Omitting, leaving. 2 Terminative, completing, relating or belonging to a final ceremony, by which the rite is dismissed. 3 Natural, inherent. 4 Derivative, produced from or of, directly and naturally. E. उत्सर्ग abandoned, and ठञ् aff.
8385: औत्सुक्य n. (-क्यं) Anxiety, perturbation, regret. E. उत्सुक anxious, ष्यञ् aff.
8386: औदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Watery, aquatic, of or belonging to water. E. उदक, and ठञ् aff.
8387: औदनिक m. (-कः) A cook. E. ओदन boiled rice, and ठक् aff.
8388: औदरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Selfishly voracious. E. उदर the belly, and ठक् aff.
8389: औदश्वित mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Made of buttermilk, &c. n. (-तं) Buttermilk with an equal proportion of water. E. उदश्वित the same, and अण् affix; or with कस् added औदश्वित्क.
8390: औदार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Magnanimity, generosity, greatness. E. उदार liberal, and ष्यञ् aff.
8391: औदास्य n. (-ष्यं) Philosophy, stoicism, indifference. E. उदास, and ष्यञ् aff.
8392: औद्दालक n. (-कं) A bitter and acrid substance like honey, said to be found in the nest of the white ant.
8393: औद्धत्य n. (-त्यं) Arrogance, disdain. E. उद्धत haughty, and ष्यञ् aff.
8394: औद्धारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Heritable, portionable, belonging to a share or portion. n. (-कं) A portion or inheritance. E. उद्धार a share, ठञ् aff.
8395: औद्धाहिक n. (-कं) A gift made to a woman at her marriage. E. उद्धाहिक, and अण् added.
8396: औद्भिज्ज n. (-ज्जं) Fossil salt. E. उद्भिज् the same, and अण् aff.
8397: औद्भिद n. (-दं) Rock or Sambher salt. E. उद्भिद्, and अण aff.
8398: औपकार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A booth, a residence.
8399: औपगवक n. (-कं) A multitude of the descendants of Upagu. E. औपगव the patronymic of उपगु, and वुन् aggregate aff.
8400: औपग्रस्तिक m. (-कः) An eclipse, or the sun or moon in eclipse. E. उपग्रस्त an eclipse, ठक् aff.
8401: औपग्रहिक m. (-कः) An eclipse, or the sun or moon in eclipse. E. उपग्रह an eclipse, ठञ् aff.
8402: औपजानुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Upon or near the knees. E. उपजानु, and ठक् aff.
8403: औपधेय n. (-यं) The wheel of a carriage. E. उपधि, and ढञ् pleonasm.
8404: औपनायनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the rite of investiture. E. उपनयन, and ठञ् aff.
8405: औपनिधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a deposit. n. (-कं) A deposit, the thing pledged or deposited. E. उपनिधि, and ठक् aff.
8406: औपनिषद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Scriptural, theological. E. उपनिषद, and अण् aff.
8407: औपम्य n. (-म्यं) Resemblance, similitude. E. उपमा, and ष्यञ् aff.
8408: औपयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Right, fit, proper. n. (-कं) A means, an expedient. E. उपाय an expedient, ठक् aff.
8409: औपरिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टी-ष्टं) Being or produced above. E. उपरिष्ट, and अण् aff.
8410: औपरोधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Proceeding from or relating to kindness or favour. 2 Opposing, impeding, connected with or relating to a check or hindrance. E. उपरोध, and ठक् affix. m. (-कः) A staff of the wood of a particular tree, (the Pīlu.) E. उपरोध willingness to oblige, &c. ठक् aff.
8411: औपल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Stony, of stone. E. उपल, and अण् aff.
8412: औपवस्त n. (-स्तं) Fasting, a fast. E. उपवस्त, and अण् aff.
8413: औपवाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Drawn for pleasure, (a carriage.) E. उपवह a conveyance, यञ् aff.
8414: औपसर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Portentous. 2 Prepositive, connected with a preposition. 3 Relating to change, &c. m. (-कः) Irregular action of the humors of the body, producing cold sweats, &c. E. उपसर्ग a portent, ठक् aff.
8415: औपस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) Cohabitation, sexual enjoyment. E. उपस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.
8416: औपाध्यायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Preceptral, of or relating to a spiritual teacher. E. उपाध्याय, and वुञ् aff.
8417: औपानह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be tied or bound on (grass, leather, &c.) E. उपानह, and ञ्य aff.
8418: औपासन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Devotional, holy, connected with or belonging to worship or service. E. उपासना, and अण् aff.
8419: औम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Flaxen, made of flax, &c. E. उमा, and अञ् aff.
8420: औमक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Flaxen, made of flax, &c. E. उमा, and वुञ् aff.
8421: औमीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flax, (a field of, &c.) E. उमा flax, and ख aff.
8422: औरग mfn. (-गः-गी-गं) Serpent, serpentine, relating or belonging to a snake. n. (-गं) The constellation Aśleṣā. E. उरग a snake, and अण् affix; a serpent is the regent of this constellation.
8423: औरभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्री-भ्रं) Belonging to, &c. a sheep. m. (-भ्रः) A coarse woollen blanket. n. (-भ्र) 1 Mutton, the flesh of sheep. 2 Woollen cloth. E. उरभ्र a sheep, अण् aff.
8424: औरभ्रक n. (-कं) A flock of sheep. E. उरभ्र, and वुञ् affix of multitude.
8425: औरभ्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to, produced by, &c. sheep. m. (-कः) A shepherd. E. उरभ्र a sheep, and ठञ् aff.
8426: औरस mf. (-सः-सी) A legitimate child, i. e. by a wife of the same tribe. E. उरस् the best, and अण् affix; the best of the twelve sons; also उरस्य and औरस्य.
8428: और्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Woollen (cloth, &c.) E. ऊर्णा wool, अण् aff.
8429: और्णक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of wool, woollen, &c. E. ऊर्णा, and वुञ् aff.
8430: और्द्धदेहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Obsequial, funeral. n. (-कं) Obsequies of a deceased person; whatever is given or performed on a person's decease, as burning, offering cakes, giving  alms, &c. E. ऊर्द्ध or ऊर्द्ध्व above, देह the body, and ठक् affix; hence also और्द्ध्वदेहिक.
8431: और्द्धश्रोतसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A Śaiva or adherent of that doctrine, which gives ŚIVA the pre-eminence in the Hindu triad. E. ऊर्द्धश्रोतस् a name of ŚIVA, viz. above whom or in whose head is the river, (-श्रोतस्) (the Ganges,) and ठक् aff.
8432: और्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Submarine fire. E. उर्व्व a saint so named, from whose thighs sprang a being of flame, which was received by the ocean; the affix is अण्.
8433: और्व्वशेय m. (-यः) A name of the saint AGASTYA. E. उर्व्वशी the celestial courtezan, and ठक् affix; his birth being ascribed indirectly to this lady.
8434: और्व्वानल m. (-लः) Submarine fire. E. और्व्व, and अनल fire.
8435: औलूक n. (-कं) A flock of owls. E. उलूक, and अण् aff.
8436: औलूक्य m. (-क्यः) A follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine. E. उलूक an owl, and ष्यञ् affix, like an owl: this etymology, and perhaps the word, owes its origin probably to controversial animosity.
8437: औलूखल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Ground or pounded in a mortar. E. उलूखल, अण् aff.
8438: औशनस n. (-सं) The code, &c. of UŚANAS. E. उशनस्, and अण् aff.
8439: औशीर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The cow's tail used as a fan, the Chowri. 2 A stick, or, according to some, the stick which serves as a handle to the preceding. 3 A bed. 4 A seat, a chair or stool. 5 The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. उशीर the root of the Andropogon muricatum, अण् aff.
8440: औषण n. (-णं) Pungency. E. उषण pepper, &c. अण affix; also उषण.
8441: औषध n. (-धं) A medicament, a drug, any herb, mineral, &c. used in medicine. E. औषधि an annual plant, and अण् aff.
8442: औषधि n. (-धिः) A deciduous plant, an annual as grass, &c. E. see औषधि.
8443: औषधीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Medicinal. E. औषध, and छ aff.
8444: औषर n. (-रं) 1 Fossile salt. 2 Iron stone. E. ऊषरा desert soil, अण् affix; also with कन् added औषरक.
8445: औषस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Early, matutinal. E. उषस् the dawn, अण् aff.
8446: औषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Early, morning, &c. with the dawn. E. उषा, and ठक् aff.
8447: औष्ट्र mfn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रं) Derived from or relating to a camel. n. (-ष्ट्रं) The camel genus or species. E. उष्ट्र, and अञ् aff.
8448: औष्ट्रक n. (-कं) A herd of camels. E. उष्ट्र a camel, and वुञ् aff.
8449: औष्म्य n. (-ष्म्यं) Heat, warmth. E. उष्म, warm, यञ् aff. क
8450: क The first consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, and the first of the guttural letters, corresponding to K or C in can, designated by the latter in Sir WM. JONES'S system, but in this work by the former.
8451: क m. (कः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 Of VIṢṆU. 3 Of KĀMADEVA. 4 Of fire. 5 Air or wind. 6 A title of YAMA. 7 The sun. 8 The soul. 9 A clever or dexterous man. 10 A king, a prince. 11 A knot or joint. 12 A peacock. 13 The mind. 14 The body. 15 Time. 16 Wealth, property. 17 Sound. 18 Light, splendor. n. (-कं) 1 The head. 2 Water. 3 Pleasure, happiness. 4 Hair. 5 A head of hair. pron. mfn. (कः का किम्) Who or what: see किम्. E. कै to sound, or कच to shine, &c. affix ड.
8452: कंय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Happy. E. कं happiness, यस् aff.
8453: कंय्यु mfn. (-य्युः-य्युः-य्यु) Happy, prosperous. E. कं, and युस् aff.
8454: कंश m. (-शः) A goblet: see कंस.
8455: कंस m. (-सः) A proper name; KAṂSA king of Mathura the uncle and enemy of KṚṢṆA, by whom he was slain; as the foe of the deity, he is considered an Asura or demon. mn. (-सः-सं) 1 A goblet, a drinking vessel; also कंश and कांस्य. 2 A metal, tutanag or white copper; also bell metal. 3 A measure. E. कमु to desire, सः Uṇādi aff.
8456: कंसक n. (-कं) A mineral substance, (a salt of iron?) used as an application to the eyes: see पुष्पकासीस. E. कंस, and क affix of similarity; of similar white colour.
8457: कंसकार m. (-रः) A worker in pewter or white brass. E. कंस and कार who makes.
8458: कंसजित् m. (-जित्) A title of KṚṢṆA. E. कंस, and जित् who conquers.
8459: कंसहन् m. (-हा) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. हन् from हन, to kill; the destroyer of KAṂSA.
8460: कंसाराति m. (-तिः) KṚṢṆA, or VIṢṆU in that character. E. कंस, and अराति an enemy, the foe of KAṂSA; hence also कंसारि and other similar epithets: see the preceding.
8462: कंसास्थि n. (-स्थि) Tutanag, white copper, any alloy of tin and copper. E. कंस white metal, and अस्थि bone, fig. substance.
8463: कंसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of bellmetal, &c. E. कंस, and ठन् aff.
8464: कंसीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit for or relating to a cup. E. कंस, and छ aff.
8465: कंसोद्भवा f. (-वा) A fragrant earth: see तुवरी.
8466: कक r. 1st cl. (ककते) 1 To be proud. 3 To be unsteady. 4 To be thirsty. (इ) ककि (कंकते) To go.
8467: कक्ख r. 1st cl. (कक्खति) To laugh. to laugh, at or deride: see कख.
8468: ककन्द m. (-न्दः) Gold. E. कनी to shine, affix द, and the initial repeated.
8469: ककुञ्जल m. (-लः) A bird, the Cātaka.
8470: ककुत्स्थ m. (-त्स्थः) A prince, the grandson of IKṢVĀKU, and ancestor of RĀMA. E. ककुद् an emblem of royalty, and स्थ who resides.
8471: ककुद् f. (-त्) or ककुद mn. (-दः-दं) 1 The hump on the shoulders of the Indian bull. 2 An ensign or symbol of royalty, as the white parasol, &c. 3 Chief, pre-eminent. 4 The peak or summit of a mountain. E. क happiness, कु to sound, affixes क्विप् and तुक्; त becomes द; or with a final vowel, taking an additional affix अच्.
8472: ककुद्मत् m. (-द्मान्) 1 A bull. 2 A mountain. f. (-द्मती) The hip and loins. E. ककुद् a bull's hump, &c. affix मतुप्.
8473: ककुद्मिकन्या f. (-न्या) A river. E. ककुद्मिन् a mountain, कन्या a daughter.
8474: ककुद्मिन् mfn. (-द्मी-द्मिनी-द्मि) 1 Peaked. 2 Humped. m. (-द्मी) 1 A mountain. 2 A bull. E. ककुद, and मिनि aff.
8475: ककुन्दर n. (-रं) The cavities of the loins: see कुकुन्दर.
8476: ककुभ् f. (-प्) 1 Space, region or quarter, as east, west, &c. 2 Beauty, splendor. 3 Unornamented hair, or the hair hanging  down as a tail. 4 A wreath of Champaka flowers. 5 A Rāgiṇī or personified mode of music. 6 A Śāstra or sacred treatise. E. क wind, स्कुभ to spread, क्विप् affix and the स is dropped; or कक to be proud, उभ् aff.
8477: ककुभ m. (-भः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna, Rox.) 2 A part of a lute, the belly, a wooden vessel covered with leather placed under its neck to render the sound deeper, or a crooked piece of wood at the end of the lute. 3 One of the Rāgas or personified musical modes. f. (-भा) 1 Space, region, quarter: see ककुभ्. 2 One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music. E. ककुभ् space, and अच् affix; or क wind, स्कुभ spread, क affix and स rejected, &c.
8478: ककुभादनी f. (-नी) A kind of perfume: see नली.
8479: ककेरुक m. (-कः) A worm in the stomach.
8481: कक्कोल m. (-लः) A perfume, a plant bearing a berry, the inner part of which is a waxy and aromatic substance. n. (-लं) The berry, -possibly the fruit of the Cocculus Indicus. E. कक to be proud, with क्विप् affix, कुल to accumulate, अच् affix; also with कन् added कक्कोलक (-कः-कं.)
8482: कक्ख (ए) r. 1st cl. (कक्खति) To laugh, to laugh at, to deride.
8483: कक्खट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Hard, solid. f. (-टी) Chalk. E. कक्ख to deride, अटन् affix, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्; also खक्खट.
8484: कक्खटपत्रक m. (-कः) A plant of the fibres of which a kind of rope is made, (Corchorus olitorius, Rox.) E. कक्खट hard, पत्र a leaf, and कन् aff.
8486: कक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The armpit. 2 A spreading creeper, a climbing plant. 3 Grass. 4 Dry grass. 5 A wood, a forest. 6 A forest of dead trees, a dry wood. 7 A private or inner chamber or part of a house. 8 Sin. 9 A buffalo. 10 The side or flank. 11 (In astronomy,) The orbit of a planet, or the circle anciently termed a deferent. 12 A gate. 13 The beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) mf. (-क्षः-क्षा) 1 A wall. 2 The end of the lower garment, which after the cloth is carried round the body, is brought up behind, and tucked into the waistband. f. (-क्षा) 1 An elephant's rope, the string round his neck, also his girth. 2 A woman's girdle or zone. 3 An enclosure, a part or division of an edifice. 4 A part of a car. 5 Objection or reply in argument. 6 Similarity, parity. 7 Emulation, rivalship. 8 The jeweller's weight, the Ratti. 9 Painful boils in the armpit, side, shoulder, &c. n. (-क्षं) A constellation, a star: see कक्ष्या, कच्छ, काञ्चि, &c. E. कष to hurt or kill, स Uṇādi affix, fem. टाप्.
8487: कक्षरुहा f. (-हा) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) E. कक्ष an enclosure, and रुह what grows.
8488: कक्षशाय m. (-यः) A dog. E. कक्ष an inner room, शाय who sleeps.
8489: कक्षान्तर n. (-रं) The inner or private apartment. E. कक्ष and अन्तर interior.
8490: कक्षापट m. (-टः) A cloth passed between the legs to cover the privities. E. कक्षा a girdle, and पट a cloth.
8491: कक्षावत् m. (-वान्) The name of a saint. E. कक्षा a reply, and मतुप् aff.
8492: कक्षावेक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A doorkeeper. 2 A guard of the queen's apartments. 3 Keeper of a royal garden. 4 A painter. 5 A poet. 6 A debauchee. 7 Eagerness of feeling, strength of sentiment. E. कक्षा an enclosure, and अबेक्ष to see, वुन् aff.
8494: कक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) The cup or receptacle of a balance. f. (-क्ष्या) 1 The girth of an elephant, of rope or leather. 2 A woman's girdle or zone. 3 The enclosure of an edifice; that is, either the wall, &c. so enclosing, or the court or chamber constituting the enclosure. 4 The inner apartment of a palace. 5 Similarity. 6 Effort, exertion. 7 An upper garment. 8 A shrub, yielding the black and red berry, that serves as a jeweller's weight; the Ratti or Gunja, (Abrus precatorius.) E. कक्ष the flank, &c. यत् affix; see कक्ष.
8495: कख r. 1st cl. (ए) कखे (कखति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride; also कक्ख and खक्ख q. v.
8496: कख्या f. (-ख्या) An enclosure, a division of a large building: see कक्ष्या. E. कख to deride, यत् affix, and टाप्.
8497: कग r. 1st cl. (ए) कगे (कगति) To perform any action: the meaning of this root is not given in many lists, from its application being indefinitely various.
8498: कङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A heron. 2 YAMA or death. 3 A false or pretended Brahman. 4 A title of YUDHIṢṬHIRA, from his assuming the disguise of a Brahman. 5 A man of the second or military tribe. 6 One of the eighteen division of the continent. 7 The brother of KAṂSA. 8 A kind of mango. f. (-ङ्का) 1 A daughter of UGRASENA. 2 A sort of sandal. E. ककि to go, अच् aff.
8499: कङ्कट m. (-टः) Mail, defensive armour. E. ककि to go, Uṇādi affix अटन्, and with कन् added कङ्कटक.
8501: कङ्कण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 A bracelet or ornament of the wrist. 2 A string or ribbon tied round the wrist. 3 An ornament or trinket. 4 A crest. f. (-णी) A small bell or tinkling ornament; also किङ्किणी and कङ्कणीका. E. कं happily, agreeably, कण to sound, or the reiterative form of कण and अच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
8502: कङ्कणीका f. (-का) See कङ्कणी. E. कण to sound in the reiterative form, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
8503: कङ्कत mfn. (-तः-तिका or -ती-तं) A comb, an instrument for cleaning the hair. m. (-तः) A tree. E. ककि to go, अतच् affix, fem. ङीष्, or कन् added in the fem. form.
8504: कङ्कत्रोट m. (-टः) A kind of fish commonly Kankila, (Esox Cancila, HAM.) E. कङ्क a heron, and त्रोटि, the throat; whose long snout resembles the beak of a heron; also कङ्कत्रोटि.
8505: कङ्कत्रोटि m. (-टिः) A kind of fish: see the preceding; also जलसूचि.
8506: कङ्कपत्र m. (-त्रः) An arrow. E. कङ्क, and पत्र leaf, (feather.)
8507: कङ्कमाला f. (-ला) Beating time by clapping the hands: see करताली.
8508: कङ्कमुख m. (-खः) A pair of tongs. n. (-खं) A sort of forceps. E. कङ्क, and मुख the mouth; heron-mouthed.
8509: कङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Vile, bad. n. (-रं) Buttermilk mixed with water. see कञ्जर. E. क implying bad, or कं water, कर what does or makes.
8510: कङ्करोल m. (-लः) A small tree, (Alangium hexapetalum:) see निकोचक; the word in the dialects Kāṅkarol is applied to a species of gourd, (Momordica mixta.)
8511: कङ्कलोद्य n. (-ड्यं) A kind of drug.
8512: कङ्कशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum:) see शालपर्णी. E. कङ्क a heron, and शत्रु an enemy.
8513: कङ्कशाय m. (-यः) A dog. E. कङ्क a heron, and शाय sleeping, sleeping like a heron, from शीङ् and घञ् aff.
8514: कङ्का f. (-ङ्का) Scent of the lotus.
8515: कङ्काल m. (-लः) The skeleton. E. ककि to go, कालच् aff.
8516: कङ्कालमालिन् m. (-ली) A title of ŚIVA. E. कङ्काल, माला, a necklace, and इनि affix; whose necklace is formed of bones.
8517: कङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 The brother of KAṂSA. 2 A sort of Panic: see कङ्गु. E. ककि to go, उ aff.
8518: कङ्कुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A medicinal earth, described as of two colours, one of a silvery and one of a gold colour, or one of a light and one of a dark yellow.
8519: कङ्केरु m. (-रुः) A kind of crow. E. कङ्क an imitative sound, ईर to send, to utter, उ aff.
8520: कङ्केलि m. (-लिः) The Asoka tree, (Jonesia asoca;) also कङ्केल्लि.
8521: कङ्केल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A kind of potherb, (Chenopodium esculentum, Rox.) see वास्तुक.
8522: कङ्केल्लि m. (-ल्लिः) A tree, (Jonesia asoca, Rox.)
8523: कङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) Enjoyment, fruition. E. कखि to deride, अच् aff.
8524: कङ्गु f. (-ङ्गुः) A kind of Panick seed, (Panicum Italicum;) several varieties of it are cultivated, and form articles of food for the poor. E. क water, अगि to go, कु affix; also with ऊङ् affix कङ्गू, and with कन् added कङ्गुका.
8525: कङ्गुनी f. (-नी) A sort of Panick: see the last.
8526: कङ्गुनीपत्रा f. (-त्रा) A kind of grass.
8528: कच r. 1st cl. (कचते) 1 To bind. 2 To shine. 3 To sound. (इ) कचि r. 1st cl. (कञ्चते) 1 To shine. 2 To bind; also काचि.
8529: कच m. (-चः) 1 The hair. 2 A proper name, the son of VṚHASPATI. 3 Binding or a binding. 3 A cicatrix, a dry or healed sore. 5 A cloud. f. (-चा) 1 A female elephant. 2 Beauty, brilliance. E. कच to bind, &c. अच् affix, fem. टाप्.
8530: कचङ्गन n. (-नं) A free market, a place of sale that pays no duty or custom.
8531: कचङ्गल m. (-लः) The ocean. E. कच a cloud, अङ्ग the body, and ल what takes or receives.
8532: कचप m. (-पः) 1 Grass. 2 A leaf. E. कच a cloud, and प what drinks.
8533: कचपक्ष m. (-क्षः) Much or ornamented hair. E. कच hair, and पक्ष, in this combination, abundance; similar compounds are made with पाश and हस्त, कचपाश, कचहस्त; also with केश hair, as केशपक्ष.
8535: कचमाल m. (-लः) Smoke. E. कच a cloud, and माला a necklace, ड affix; also खतमाल.
8538: कचाकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) 1 Ill disposed, wicked. 2 Intolerable, difficult to be borne. m. (-कुः) A snake.
8539: कचाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having long or dishevelled hair. E. कच, and अचित not gathered.
8541: कचु f. (-चुः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia and other kinds, many of which are cultivated for food:) see कच्ची.
8543: कच्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Dirty, foul. 2 Soiled, spoiled by dirt. 3 Vile, wicked, bad. n. (-रं) Buttermilk diluted with water. E. कुत् bad, vile, चर what goes or is, from चर with अच् affix; कत् is substituted for कत्, and the त changed.
8544: कच्चित् ind. 1 A particle implying wish or desire, (may it be so;) also introducing a kind enquiry, (I hope that it is so, &c.) 2 A particle implying an alternative, whether, whether or not. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and चित् aff.
8545: कच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) Contiguous to water, (land, &c.) m. (-च्छः) 1 Marshy ground, a marsh, a morass. 2 Ground bordering water or watery soil, as the bank of a river, the margin of a lake or tank, a mound or causeway, &c. 3 Level land skirting mountains. 4 A tree, the timber of which is used for making furniture, &c. commonly Tūn, (Cedrela Tunna, Rox.) 5 Another tree, (Hibiscus Populneoides.) 6 A part of a boat. mf. (-च्छः-च्छा) The hem of a garment tucked into the waistband: see कक्ष. f. (-च्छा) 1 A plant, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) see वाराही. 2 A cricket. E. क water, छो to cut or break, क affix; or कच to bind, छ aff.
8546: कच्छटिका f. (-का) The end or hem of a lower garment or cloth gathered up behind, and tucked into the waistband; also कक्षा and कच्छाटिका.
8547: कच्छप m. (-पः) 1 A turtle, a tortoise. 2 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures. 3 An attitude in wrestling. 4 A flat kind of still. f. (-पी) 1 A female tortoise, also a small one. 2 A kind of lute, also the lute of SARASVATĪ. 3 A cutaneous disease, wart or blotch. E. कच्छ a morass, and प who cherishes, who inhabits watery places: the lute, &c. are so named from being similar in shape to the tortoise.
8548: कच्छपिका f. (-का) 1 A pimple, a blotch or wart. 2 A wart accompanying gonorrhoea. E. कच्छप a tortoise, कन् added, fem. form.
8549: कच्छभू f. (-भूः) Marshy ground, a swamp, a morass. E. कच्छ, and भू land.
8550: कच्छरुहा f. (-हा) A kind of grass, Dūrvā or Dūb, (Agrostis linearis, Lin. Panicus dactilon, Rox.) E. कच्छ marshy ground, and रुह what grows.
8552: कच्छान्त m. (-न्तः) The border of a lake or stream. E. कच्छ, and अन्त term.
8553: कच्छु f. (-च्छुः) Itch, formation of watery pustules on the hands, &c. E. कष to hurt, उ affix; also कच्छू.
8554: कच्छुघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A vegetable, (Trichosanthes.) E. कच्छु, and ध्नी what removes.
8555: कच्छुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Scabby, itchy. 2 Unchaste, libidinous. f. (-रा) 1 A plant, (a species of Hedysarum?) 2 Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.) 3 Another plant: see शठी. E. कच्छ itch or scab, and र aff.
8556: कच्छू f. (-च्छूः) Scab or itch. E. कष to injure, ऊ Uṇādi affix, and छ substituted for ष.
8557: कच्छूमती f. (-ती) Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.) E. चच्छू itch, and मतुप् affix; producing an itching upon application to the skin.
8558: कच्छोटिका f. (-का) The fastening of the lower garment: see कच्छटिका.
8559: कच्वी f. (-च्ची) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia and other kinds, several of which are cultivated for food;) also written कचु.
8560: कज r. 1st cl. (कजति) To be disturbed or confused with joy, pride, or sorrow.
8561: कज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Watery, aquatic, produced in or by water. n. (-जं) A lotus. E. क water, and ज born.
8562: कज्जल m. (-लः) 1 A cloud. n. (-लं) Lampblack, considered as a collyrium, being applied upon the eyelashes or eyelids, medicinally or ornamentatively; also sulphuret of lead or antimony, when so used. f. (-ली) Sulphuret of mercury, Æthiop's mineral. f. (-ला or -ली) A kind of fish, (Cyprinus atratus,) or any kind peculiar to stagnant waters, whence the name. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and जल water or juice, as the moisture of the collyrium, &c.
8563: कज्ज्वल n. (-लं) Lampblack, especially considered as an application to the eyes: see the preceding. E. कत bad, and ज्वल flame.
8564: कज्ज्वलध्वज m. (-जः) A lamp. E. कज्ज्वल, and ध्वज a sign; also कज्जलध्वज.
8565: कज्ज्वलरोचक mn. (-कः-कं) The wooden stand or tripod on which the lamp is placed, a candlestick. E. कज्ज्वल and रुच to shine; affixes घञ् and कन्.
8566: कञ्चट m. (-टः) A plant: see लाङ्गली, (Commelina salicifolia.) n. (-टं) Another species of the same, (Commelina Bengalensis.) E. कं water, and चट to divide; alluding to the habits of the plant.
8567: कञ्चड m. (-डः) A plant, (Commelina Bengalensis): see the preceding.
8568: कञ्चार m. (-रः) The sun. E. कं heaven, and चर to go, affix अण्.
8569: कञ्चिका f. (-का) 1 The branch of a bamboo. 2 A small boil.
8570: कञ्चुक m. (-कः) 1 The skin of a snake. 2 Armour, mail. 3 A bodice or jacket. 4 Cloth, clothes. 5 A kind of drawers or short breeches. f. (-की) The name of a plant. E. कचि to bind or shine, affix उकन्.
8571: कञ्चुकालु m. (-लुः) A snake. E. कञ्चुक a serpent's skin, and आलुक poss. aff.
8572: कञ्चुकिन् m. (-की) 1 An attendant on the women's apartments. 2 A libidinous man, a debauchee. 3 A serpent. 4 Agallochum. 5 Barley. 6 A sort of pulse, (Chenna.) E. कञ्चुक armour, &c. इनि aff.
8573: कञ्चुलिका f. (-का) A bodice or jacket.
8574: कञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Produced in or from water. m. (-ञ्जः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The hair. n. (-ञ्जं) 1 Nectar, the food of the immortals. 2 A lotus. E. कं happiness, water, &c. and ज what is born or produced.
8575: कञ्जक m. (-कः) A kind of bird, the Mayana: see कञ्जन.
8576: कञ्जज m. (-जः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. कञ्ज a lotus, and ज born.
8577: कञ्जन m. (-नः) 1 The Mayana or Maina, (Gracula religiosa.) 2 A name of KANDARPA, the deity of love. E. कचि to go, युच् aff.
8578: कञ्जर m. (-रः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The sun. 3 The belly. 4 An elephant. E. कञ्ज a lotus, &c. ऋ to hate or injure, अच or घञ् affix कञ्जार, the pen. made short; also derived by some from कजि, a Sautra root, to produce or grow, and अर Uṇādi aff.
8579: कञ्जल m. (-लः) The Maina: see कञ्जन.
8580: कञ्जार m. (-रः) 1 Muni or holy sage. 2 BRAHMĀ, &c. see कञ्जर.
8581: कञ्जिका f. (-का) A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica:) see ब्रह्मयष्टिका.
8582: कट r. 1st cl. (कटति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To live with difficulty. (इ) कटि (कण्टति) To go. (ए) कटे (कटति) 1 To rain. 2 To encompass, to cover or screen. (ई) कटी (कटति) To go or approach: with प्र prefixed, verb 10th cl. (प्रकटयति) To appear, to become apparent or manifest.
8583: कट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) An agent in any action. mf. (-टः-टी) 1 The hip. 2 The hollow above the hip or the loins, also the hip and loins. m. (-टः) 1 The temples of the elephant. 2 A mat. 3 A twist of straw or grass. 4 A screen of the same. 5 A corpse. 6 A time or season. 7 Much, excessive. 8 Grass. 9 A place where dead bodies are burnt or buried, a place of sepulture. 10 A hearse, a bier, a bed, &c. used for conveying a dead body. 11 An annual plant. 12 A thin piece of wood, a plank. f. (-टी) Long pepper. E. कट to rain or encompass, अच् affix, fem. ङीष्; also कटि.
8584: कटक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The side or ridge of a hill or mountain. 2 Table land. 3 Sea salt. 4 A ring placed as an ornament upon an elephant's tusk. 5 A bracelet of gold, shell, &c. 6 A zone. 7 A royal metropolis. 8 A city or town. 9 A village. 10 A house or dwelling. 11 A camp. 12 An army. 13 A circle. 14 A wheel. E. कट to encompass, कन् Uṇādi aff.
8585: कटकिन् m. (-की) A mountain. E. कटक land on a hill, &c. and इनि aff.
8587: कटखादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An eater, one who eats voraciously. m. (-कः) 1 A glass vessel, a tumbler or bowl. 2 A crow. 3 A jackall. E. कट much, or a corpse, खाद to eat, affix वुन्.
8588: कटङ्कट m. (-ठः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. कट a mat, &c. कट who goes, खच् aff.
8590: कटन n. (-नं) Roof or thatch of a house.
8591: कटपूटन m. (-नः) A kind of goblin.
8592: कटप्रू m. (-प्रूः) 1 A name of MAHĀDEVA. 2 A kind of demigod, one of the class of Vidyādharas. 3 A Rākṣasa, an imp or demon. 4 Gambling, playing with dice. 5 A worm. E. कट much, प्र to go, क्विप् affix, and the final is made long.
8593: कटप्रोथ m. (-थः) The buttocks: see कटिप्रोथ.
8594: कटभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Gleaning, plucking or gathering corn by the hand. 2 Royal misfortune, as deposure, defeat, &c. E. कट, &c. भञ्ज to break, अच् aff.
8595: कटभी f. (-भी) 1 A plant, (Heartpea, Cardiaspermum halicacabum.) 2 Another creeper, (Clitoria ternata.) E. कट to encompass, and भज to serve, ड and ङीष् affs.
8596: कटमालिनी f. (-नी) Wine or any vinous liquor.
8597: कटम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A kind of musical instrument. 2 An arrow. E. कट to go, and अम्ब Uṇādi aff.
8598: कटम्बरा f. (-रा) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. कट to surround, अच् affix; what invests the body, as sickness; वृ to screen or defend, मुम् inserted, and अच् and टाप् affixes; also कटम्भरा.
8599: कटम्भरा f. (-रा) 1 A plant, (Poederia fetida.) 2 A medicinal plant, कटुकीः see the preceding. 3 A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.) 4 A female elephant. 5 Red arsenic. 6 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides:) see मुर्व्वा. 7 Hog-weed. E. as before, भृ to nourish, &c.
8600: कटव्रण m. (-णः) A name of BHĪMASENA, one of the five Pāṇḍava brothers. E. कट much, व्रण who wounds.
8601: कटशर्करा f. (-रा) A plant: see गाङ्गेष्टी.
8602: कटस्थल n. (-लं) 1 The hip and loins. 2 An elephant's temples. E. कट, and स्थल place; also कटभू, &c.
8603: कटाकु m. (-कुः) A bird. E. कट to go, काकु Uṇādi aff.
8604: कटाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A leer, a glance or side look. E. कट to go, and अक्षि the eye.
8605: कटाक्षावेक्षण n. (-णं) Casting lewd or amorous glances, ogling. E. कटाक्ष a leer, and अवेक्षण looking.
8606: कटाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 A fire of grass or straw. 2 Straw, &c. investing a criminal who is to be burnt and set on fire. E. कठ, and अग्नि fire.
8607: कटायन n. (-नं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
8608: कटार m. (-रः) A libidinous man, a lecher.
8609: कटाह m. (-हः) 1 A shallow boiler for oil or butter. 2 A frying pan. 3 A winnowing basket. 4 A turtle's shell. 5 A young buffalo whose horns are just appearing. 6 A Dvīpa or division of the known continent, so called. 7 Hell, the infernal regions. 8 A well. E. कट much, &c. हन to destroy, with आङ् prefixed, and ड aff.
8610: कटि mf. (-टिः-टी) 1 The hip. 2 The buttocks. 3 An elephant's cheek. E. कट to go, कि affix, fem. ङीष्; see कट and कटिप्रोथ.
8611: कटितट n. (-टं) The loins, the hip. E. कटि, and तट shore.
8612: कटित्र m. (-त्रः) 1 An ornament of small bells worn round the loins. 2 A cloth so worn. 3 Armour for the hip and loins. E. कटि the hip, and त्र what preserves, from त्रै with ड aff.
8613: कटिदेश m. (-शः) The loins. E. कटि and देश place.
8614: कटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) 1 Matted, screened. 2 Loined, having handsome loins, &c. m. (-टी) An elephant. E. कट an elephant's temples, &c. इनि pos. aff.
8615: कटिप्रोथ m. (-थः) The buttocks. E. कटि the hip or loins, and प्रोथ to be equal to; also written कटप्रोथ, कटीप्रोथ, and severally कटि and प्रोथ.
8616: कटिरोहक m. (-कः) The rider of an elephant, as distinct from the driver, the person that sits upon the loins. E. कटि the loins, रुह to mount, and वुञ् aff.
8617: कटिल्लक m. (-कः) A species of the balsam apple, (Momordica charantia.) E. कट to go, &c. इल्ल affix कन् added; also कठिल्लक.
8618: कटिशीर्षक m. (-कः) The hip and loins, or the hollow above the hip. E. कटि, शीर्ष the head or superior part, कन् aff.
8619: कटिशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A girdle of small bells. E. कटि the loins, and शृङ्खला a chain.
8620: कटिसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A female zone or waist-band. E. कटि the loins, and सूत्र a thread.
8621: कटी f. (-टी) See कटि and कट.
8622: कटीतल m. (-लः) A crooked sword, a sabre or scymitar.
8623: कटीर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The cavity of the loins, or the iliac regions. m. (-रः) 1 Mons veneris. 2 A cave. E. कट to go, and ईरन् Uṇādi aff.
8624: कटीरक m. (-कः) The posteriors. E. कन् added to the preceding.
8625: कटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः or -ट्वी-टु) 1 Pungent. 2 Envious. 3 Fierce, impetuous, hot. 4 Fragrant. 5 Bad scented, ill smelling. 6 Displeasing, disagreeable. m. (-टुः) 1 Pungency or a pungent taste. 2 A flower, (Michelia champaca.) 3 Camphor. 4 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes.) n. (-टु) 1 An improper action, an act which ought not to have been done. 2 Blaming, reviling, scandal. f. (-टुः) 1 The name of a medicinal plant; also कटुका and कटुकी. 2 A plant which bears a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. 3 Mustard. E. कट to go, &c. and उ Uṇādi aff.
8626: कटुक m. (-कः-की) 1 A plant, the bark and seed of which have an acrid and bitter taste, and are used in medicine for worms, dysentery, &c. (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 2 Gigantic swallow wort, (Colotropis gigantea.) 3 A fragrant kind of grass. 4 Mustard. 5 A gourd: see पटोल. f. (-का or -की) A medicinal plant, used as a sedative and laxative; also कटुरोहिणी. n. (-कं) A compound of three pungent substances, as black pepper, long pepper, and dry ginger: see त्रिकटु. E. कटु pungent, and कन् aff.
8627: कटुकन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) 1 A plant, (Morunga guilandina, and Hyperanthera.) 2 Ginger, the fresh root or the plant. 3 Garlic. E. कटु, and कन्द a root; having a pungent root.
8628: कटुकालावु m. (-वुः) A bitter gourd. E. कटुक pungent and acrid, अलावु a gourd.
8629: कटुकीट m. (-टः) A gnat or musquito. E. कटु, and कीट an insect.
8630: कटुकीटक m. (-कः) A gnat or musquito. E. कटु fierce, and कीटक a worm.
8631: कटुक्वाण m. (-णः) A bird, jacana, (Parra goensis.) E. कटु disagreeable, क्वाण sound.
8632: कटुग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) Ginger, the root. E. कटु pungent, and ग्रन्थि joint.
8633: कटुच्छद m. (-दः) The name of a plant; also तगर. E. कटु, and छद a leaf: having a pungent leaf.
8634: कटुता f. (-ता) 1 Pungency, sharpness. 2 Testiness, irritability. E. कटु, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कटुत्वं.
8635: कटुतिक्तिका f. (-का) A bitter gourd. E. कटु, and तिक्त bitter, कन् affix with the fem. form.
8636: कटुतुम्बी f. (-म्बी) See the preceding. E. कटु pungent, here meaning bitterly so, and तुम्बी a gourd.
8637: कटुत्रय n. (-यं) The aggregate of three spices, ginger, and long and black pepper. E. कटु, and त्रय three.
8638: कटुनिष्प्लाव m. (-वः) Grain not inundated. E. कटु, and निष्प्लाव, non-inundation.
8639: कटुपत्र m. (-त्रः) A medicinal plant, (Oldenlandia biflora.) E. कटु pungent, and पत्र leaf.
8640: कटुफल m. (-लः) A sort of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. कटु, and फल fruit.
8642: कटुभद्र n. (-द्रं) Ginger either fresh or dry. E. कटु, and भद्र auspicious.
8643: कटुर n. (-रं) Buttermilk. E. कटु, and रा to give, affix ड.
8644: कटुरव n. (-वः) A frog. E. कटु, and रव sound.
8645: कटुरोहिणी f. (-णी) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. कटु pungent, and रोहिणी that grows.
8646: कटुवार्त्ताकी f. (-की) A variety of solanum. E. कटु, and वार्त्ताकी the egg plant.
8647: कटुवीजा f. (-जा) Long pepper. E. कटु, and वीज seed.
8648: कटुस्नेह m. (-हः) The mustard seed plant, (Sinapis dichotoma.) E. कटु, and स्नेह oily substance: yielding a pungent oil.
8649: कटूत्कट n. (-टं) Ginger. E. कटु, and उत्कट best, and with कन् added कटूत्कटक.
8651: कटोल m. (-लः) A man of an inferior and degraded tribe, a Caṇḍāla, a Pariah, &c. 2 A pungent flavour. E. कट to go, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also कटोलक.
8652: कटोलवीणा f. (-णा) A kind of lute played by the common people. E. कटोल a Caṇḍāla, and वीणा a lute.
8653: कट्टार m. (-रः) A weapon, a dagger.
8654: कट्फल m. (-लः) A small tree found in the north-west of Hindustan, the bark and seeds of which are used in medicine, and as aromatics; the fruit also is eaten; the common name is Kayaphal. f. (-ला) 1 A plant, (Gmelina arborea, Rox.) 2 The egg plant, &c. E. कट् instead of कटु acrid, and फल fruit, fem. affix टाप्.
8655: कट्वङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 A name of DILĪPA a king of Ayodhya. E. कटु pungent, &c. अङ्ग bark, body, &c.
8656: कट्वर n. (-रं) 1 Sauce, condiment. 2 Buttermilk. 3 The skim or whey of curds. E. कट to rain, &c. वरच् aff.
8657: कठ r. 1st cl. (कठति) To live in distress. (इ) कठि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कण्ठति-ते कण्ठयति) 1 To grieve. 2 To recollect. With उद् prefixed, to regret or miss, to lament, to bewail.
8658: कठ m. (-ठः) 1 The name of a Muni or saint. 2 A note or simple sound. 3 A portion of the Yajur Veda. 4 A Mantra or mystical prayer. 5 A Brahman. 6 A Brahman versed in the Vedas, especially in the Rig Veda. 7 A student of the same. 8 Trouble, distress. f. (-ठी) The wife of a Brahman. E. कठ to be confused, and अप् aff.
8659: कठधूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A BRAHMAN skilled in the Kaṭha branch of the Vedas. E. कठ, and धूर्त्त cunning.
8660: कठमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कठ distress, मर्द्द who dissipates.
8661: कठर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard. E. कठ trouble, and र from रा to take or give, affix ड.
8662: कठश्रोत्रिय m. (-यः) A BRAHMAN who has studied the Kaṭha portion of the Vedas. E. कठ, and श्रोत्रिय a BRAHMAN.
8663: कठाध्यापक m. (-कः) A teacher of the Kaṭha portion of the Veda. E. कठ, and अध्यापक a teacher.
8666: कठिञ्जर m. (-रः) A plant worshipped by the Hindus, commonly Tulsi, (Ocymum sanctum, or sacred basil.) E. कठिन hard, and जृ to destroy, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
8667: कठिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Hard, solid. 2 Unkind, severe. 3 Paralysed, rendered stiff or rigid. 4 Difficult, obscure. nf. (-नं-ना) An earthen vessel. f. (-ना) A sweetmeat made with refined sugar. (-नी or निका) Chalk. E. कठ to be confounded, and इनच् Uṇādi affix, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्.
8668: कठिनता f. (-ता) 1 Firmness, hardness. 2 Severity. 3 Difficulty, obscurity. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कठिनत्वं.
8669: कठिनपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A tortoise. E. कठिन, and पृष्ठ back; also कठिनपृष्ठक.
8670: कठिनहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Hardhearted, cruel, unkind. E. कठिन, and हृदय the heart.
8671: कठिनान्तःकरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Harsh, cruel, severe. E. कठिन, and अन्तःकरण disposition.
8672: कठिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A plant, (Momordica charantia:) see कटिल्ल.
8673: कठिल्लक m. (-कः) 1 A plant: see the preceding. 2 A name of Tulasi or holy basil. 3 Hogweed. E. कन् added to the preceding: see कटिल्ल and कटिल्लक.
8674: कठेर m. (-रः) A needy or distressed man, a pauper. E. कठ to be distressed, and एरक् Uṇādi aff.
8676: कठोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hard, solid. 2 Severe, cruel. 3 Full, complete, full-grown. 4 Full, (as the moon.) E. कठ to be distressed, &c. आरन् Uṇādi affix; also कठोल.
8677: कठोरता f. (-ता) 1 Hardness, firmness. 2 Severity, rigor. E. तल्, added to the preceding; also कठोरत्वं with त्व aff.
8679: कड r. 1st and 6th cls. (कडति) To be confused or disturbed by pleasure or pain, to be proud or mad, (the roots differ in some of the inflections.) (इ) कडि r. 1st cl. (कण्डते) The same as the preceding; also r. 1st and 10th cls. (कण्डति, कण्डयति) 1 To break off a part, to tear, to separate or detach. 2 To remove the chaff or husk of grain, &c. 3 To preserve.
8680: कड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Ignorant, stupid. E. कड to be perplexed, अच् aff.
8681: कडक n. (-कं) Sea salt obtained by evaporation. E. कड to separate, वुन् aff.
8682: कडङ्कर m. (-रः) Straw, the stalks of various sorts of pulse, &c. E. कड made, कृ to make, खच् affix; also कडङ्गर.
8683: कडङ्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be fed with straw. E. कडङ्कर, and छ affix; also with यत्, कडङ्कर्प्य; and from कडङ्ग, कडङ्गरीय.
8684: कडङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A spirituous liquor, a kind of rum. E. कड to be intoxicated, अङ्ग aff.
8685: कडङ्गर m. (-रः) Straw, chaff. E. कड, रक affix, अङ्गच् inserted.
8686: कडत्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel. E. गड to distil, अत्रन् Uṇādi affix, and क substituted for ग; also कलत्र.
8687: कडम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 The stalk of a potherb. 2 The end or point. E. कड to separate, &c. अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.
8688: कडम्बी f. (-म्बी) A potherb, (Convolvulus repens:) see कलम्बी.
8689: कडार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Tawny. m. (-रः) 1 Tawny, (the colour.) 2 A servant. E. कड to be confused, आरण् aff.
8690: कडितुल m. (-लः) A sword, a scymitar, a sacrificial knife.
8691: कड्ड r. 1st cl. (कड्डति) To be rough, to be harsh or severe: the pen. is originally द.
8692: कण (म) r. 1st cl. (कणति) 1 To sound. 2 To cry as in distress. (ऋ) कण r. 1st cl. (कणति) To go or approach. r. 10th cl.  (कणयति) To wink, to cover or close the eye with the lids or lashes.
8693: कण mf. (-णः-णी or -णिका) 1 Small, minute. 2 An atom, a minute particle. m. (-णः) 1 An eye of corn. 2 The spark or facet of a gem. 3 A spark of fire. 4 A drop of water, &c. f. (-णा) 1 Cummin seed. 2 Long pepper. 3 A kind of fly, (कुम्भीरमक्षिका) the crocodile fly? E. कण to contract, अच् affix fem. टाप् or ङीष्.
8694: कणजीर n. (-रः) A white kind of cummin seed. E. कण small, and जीर cummin.
8695: कणजीरक n. (-कं) Small cummin seed. E. कण minute, and जीरक cummin.
8696: कणभक्षक m. (-कः) A kind of bird. E. कण pepper, and भक्षक who eats.
8698: कणाटीन m. (-नः) A wagtail. E. कण little, अट to go, and ईनच् aff.
8699: कणाटीर m. (-रः) A wagtail; also कणाटीरक.
8700: कणाद n. (-दः) 1 The name of a Muni, also called Kaśyapa: the author of the Vaiśeṣika philosophy. 2 A goldsmith. E. कण a little, and अद to eat, referring to the abstemiousness of the saint; or आदा to take, alluding to the proverbial dishonesty of the artificer.
8701: कणिक m. (-कः) 1 A small particle, as a crystal, an eye of corn, &c. 2 An enemy. 3 Whirling round a set of lamps at sacrificial ceremonies. 4 The heart of wheat, commonly Suji, sharps or semoule. f. (-का) 1 An atom, a small particle. 2 Small, minute: see कण. 3 A plant, (Premna spinosa:) see गणिकारिका. 4 A kind of rice. E. कण small, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted, fem. affix टाप्.
8702: कणित n. (-तं) A cry or sound uttered through pain. E. कण to sound, affix क्त.
8703: कणिश n. (-शं) An ear or spike of corn. E. कण small, &c. affix श.
8704: कणीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Small, diminutive. E. कण to be small, ईकन् Uṇādi affix; it is also written कनीक, and कणिक.
8705: कणीचि f. (-चिः) 1 A creeper in flower. 2 A cart. 3 The Abrus precatorius. E. कण to wink, ईचि Uṇādi aff.
8706: कणीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very small. 2 Young, younger. E. कण small, and ईयसुन् superlative affix; also कनीयस्.
8707: कणेर m. (-रः) A tree, (Cascaria ovata, &c.) f. (-रा) 1 A courtezan. 2 A she-elephant. E. कण to go, एर affix, or with एरु affix अणेरु.
8708: कण्टक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A thorn. 2 A paltry foe. 3 A fish bone. 4 Horripilation, or the erection of the hair of the body. 5 Any annoyance or source of vexation. 6 A term in the Nyāya philosophy, implying refutation of argument, detection of error, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A workshop, a manufactory. 2 Fault, defect. 3 The point of a pin or needle. 4 A fish or marine monster, the symbol of KĀMADEVA: see मकर. 5 A bamboo. E. कटि to divide, वुन् aff.
8709: कण्टकद्रुम m. (-मः) The Śālmali or silk cotton tree. E. कण्टक, and द्रम a tree.
8710: कण्टकफल m. (-लः) 1 The Jaka or bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) 2 Another plant: see गोक्षुर. 3 The castor oil tree. 4 The Datura. E. कण्टक a spike, and फल fruit; the term is applicable to any plant, the fruit of which is invested with a hairy or thorny coat; also कण्टकिफल.
8711: कण्टकभुज् m. (-भुक्) A camel. E. कण्टक, and भुज who eats.
8712: कण्टकमर्द्दन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 What treads down or extracts thorns. 2 What bridles or suppresses disturbances, annoyances, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Beating down thorns. 2 Suppressing disturbances, &c. E. कण्टक, and मर्द्दन trampling on.
8713: कण्टकश्रेणी f. (-णी) A porcupine. E. कण्टक, and श्रेणी a row.
8714: कण्टकागार m. (-रः) A porcupine. E. कण्टक, and आगार a house.
8715: कण्टकारिका f. (-का) A sort of prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. कण्टक a thorn, ऋ to go, अण् affix, कन् added with the feminine termination; also कण्टकारी.
8716: कण्टकारी f. (-री) 1 A prickly nightshade: see the preceding. 2 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 3 Another plant, commonly Buïñchi, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) E. as before.
8717: कण्टकाल m. (-लः) 1 The bread-fruit tree or Jaka: see कण्टकफल. 2 A species of the coral tree, (Erythrina Indica.) E. कण्टक a thorn, आला to take, affix ड.
8718: कण्टकाशन m. (-नः) A camel. E. कण्टक, and अशन food; whose food is of thorns, thistles, &c.; also कण्टकभुज्, &c.
8719: कण्टकाष्ठील m. (-लः) A kind of fish, one which has many bones. E. कण्टक, अस्थि a bone, and ईलच् aff.
8720: कण्टकिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Produced from a fish. 2 Borne by the mimosa tree. E. कण्टकिन. and ज born.
8721: कण्टकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) 1 Thorny, prickly. 2 Vexatious, annoying. m. (-की) 1 A fish. 2 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.) 3 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4 A bamboo. 5 The jujube. E. कण्टक a thorn or small bone, and इनि poss. aff.
8722: कण्टकिफल m. (-लः) The Indian bread fruit tree or Jaka, (Artocarpus integrifolia:) see कण्टकफल; also कण्टकीफल.
8723: कण्टकिल m. (-लः) A thorny kind of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa, Rox.)
8725: कण्टकोद्धरण n. (-णं) 1 Weeding, extracting thorns, &c. 2 Removing annoyances. 3 Extirpating thieves, rogues, &c. or all national or public nuisances. E. कण्टक, and उद्धरण extracting.
8726: कण्टपत्र m. (-त्रः) A plant, commonly Buïñchi, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) and कण्टपत्रक.
8727: कण्टफल m. (-लः) 1 The jack tree. 2 The Datura plant. 3 The castor oil plant. E. कण्ट for कण्टक a thorn or spike, फल fruit: see कण्टकफल.
8728: कण्टल m. (-लः) The Babul, a tree yielding a species of gum arabic, (Acacia Arabica.) the branches are prickly, whence the name. E. कण्ट for कण्टक a thorn, and ल from ला to take or have.
8730: कण्टाफल m. (-लः) The Jaca or Jack tree: see कण्टकफल.
8731: कण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा) or -ण्ठी-ण्ठं 1 The throat. 2 Sound, especially guttural sound. 3 Near, proximate. m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) 2 The space of an inch from the edge of the hole in which sacrificial fire is deposited. f. (-ण्ठी) 1 A rope or leather round the neck of a horse. 2 A necklace, a collar. E. कण to sound, ठ Uṇādi affix, fem. Affix. टाप् or ङीष्.
8732: कण्ठकूणिका f. (-का) The Vīṇā or Indian lute. E. कण्ठ the throat, कूण to sound, and ठक् affix; sounding like the larynx.
8733: कण्ठग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Extending to the throat or swallow. E. कण्ठ, and ग what goes.
8734: कण्ठतलासिका f. (-का) The leather or rope passing round the neck of a horse.
8736: कण्ठनीलक m. (-कः) A torch, a whisp of lighted straw, &c.
8737: कण्ठपाशक m. (-कः) 1 A halter. 2 A rope passing round an elephant's neck. E. कण्ठ, and पाशक a fetter.
8738: कण्ठभूषा f. (-षा) A collar or short necklace. E. कण्ठ the throat, and भूषा an ornament.
8739: कण्ठमणि m. (-णिः) A jewel worn on the throat. E. कण्ठ, and मणि a gem.
8740: कण्ठलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Fastened or suspended round the throat. 2 Clinging to, embracing. E. कण्ठ, and लग्न attached to.
8741: कण्ठलता f. (-ता) 1 A collar. 2 A horse's halter. E. कण्ठ, and लता a creeper.
8742: कण्ठसज्जन n. (-नं) Hanging on or round the throat. E. कण्ठ, and सज्जन equipping.
8743: कण्ठस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Sticking in the throat. 2 Being in or upon the throat. 3 Guttural. 4 Having by rote, ready to repeat. E. कण्ठ, and स्थ what stays.
8744: कण्ठागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come in to the throat, (breath, &c.) E. कण्ठ, and आगत come.
8745: कण्ठाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A bird. E. कण्ठ, and अग्नि fire, and figuratively digestive faculty; digesting in the throat or gizzard.
8746: कण्ठाल m. (-लः) 1 A boat. 2 A hoe, a spade. 3 War. 4 An esculent root, (Arum.) 5 A camel. f. (-ला) A churning vessel. E. कण्ठ the throat, अल to ornament, &c. अच् aff.
8747: कण्ठावसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Embracing, clinging to the neck. E. कण्ठ, and अवसक्त fastened to.
8748: कण्ठिका f. (-का) A necklace of one string or row. E. कण्ठी and कन् aff.
8749: कण्ठीरव m. (-वः) 1 A lion. 2 An elephant in rut. 3 A pigeon. E. कण्ठ the throat, and रव sound.
8750: कण्ठेकाल m. (-लः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कण्ठे in the throat, काल black, black-necked; see नीलकण्ठ.
8751: कण्ठ्य mfn. (-ण्ठ्यः-ण्ठ्या-ण्ठ्यं) Guttural, belonging to the throat, pronounced from the throat, &c. E. कण्ठ and यत् aff.
8752: कण्डन n. (-नं) Threshing, separating the chaff from grain. f. (-नी) A wooden bowl or mortar, in which the cleaning or threshing of grain is performed. E. कडि to divide, ल्युट् affix, fem. do. ङीष्.
8753: कण्डरा f. (-रा) A principal vessel of the body, a large artery, vein, &c. E. कडि to divide, अरन् aff.
8754: कण्डु f. (-ण्डुः) 1 The itch, itching. 2 Scratching: see कण्डू.
8756: कण्डू n. (ञ्) कण्डूञ् Sautra root, (कण्डूयति-ते) 1 To itch. 2 To scratch.
8757: कण्डू f. (-ण्डूः) 1 The itch, itching. 2 Scratching. E. कण्डूञ् to itch, affix क्विप्; also with the final short, कण्डु.
8758: कण्डूकरी f. (-री) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. कण्डू itching, and कर what makes, ङीप् aff.
8759: कण्डूघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Cassia, (fistula.) E. कण्डू, and घ्न what destroys.
8760: कण्डूति f. (-तिः) 1 Itching, the itch. 2 Scratching. E. कण्डू and क्तिन् affix; also कण्डू, कण्डूयन, &c.
8761: कण्डूयत् mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत्) Scratching, rubbing. E. कण्डू to itch, शतृ aff.
8762: कण्डूयन n. (-नं) 1 Itching. 2 Scratching; also कण्डूया and कण्डू. E. as before, affixes यक् and ल्युट्.
