8763: कण्डूयनक m. (-कः) A tickler, one who tickles or scratches. E. कण्डूयन and क who makes.
8764: कण्डूया f. (-या) 1 Itching. 2 Scratching. E. कण्डू to itch, affixes यक् and टाप्.
8765: कण्डूरा f. (-रा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. कण्डू itching, and रा what makes, from रा to take or give, affixes क and टाप; alluding to the irritating property of the leaves of this plant.
8766: कण्डूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Itchy, having the itch. m. (-लः) A esculent root, (Arum.) E. कण्डू and ला to have, ड aff.
8767: कण्डोल m. (-लः) 1 A basket, a safe, any place in which provisions are kept. 2 A camel. E. कडि to divide, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added कण्डोलक.
8768: कण्डोलक m. (-कः) A safe, a store room: see the preceding.
8769: कण्डोलवीणा f. (-णा) A vulgar lute. E. कण्डोल here implying a Cāṇḍāla, and वीणा the Vīṇā or Indian lute; also कटोलवीणा and कण्डोली.
8771: कण्ड्वोघ m. (-घः) A caterpillar. E. कण्डु itching, and ओघ an abode.
8772: कण्व m. (-ण्वः) The name of a celebrated Muni or saint. n. (-ण्वं) Sin. E. कण to sound, क्वन् Uṇādi aff.
8773: कत m. (-तः) 1 The name of a Muni or saint. 2 The clearing nut plant. E. कै to sound, अत Uṇādi aff.
8774: कतक m. (-कः) The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum:) one of the seeds of this plant being rubbed upon the inside of the water jars used in Bengal, occasions a precipitation of the earthy particles diffused through the water.
8775: कतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Which, (of many.) E. किम् and डतमच् aff.
8776: कतमाल m. (-लः) A name of AGNI or fire; this word is perhaps a corruption: see कचमाल and खतमाल.
8777: कतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Which, (of two,) whether. E. किम् and डतरच् aff.
8778: कति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 How many. 2 How much. E. किम् what, and डति aff.
8779: कतिचित् ind. 1 In any way, in some way. 2 For some time. E. कति how many, and चित् aff.
8780: कतिथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) What, how much. E. थुक् added to कति.
8781: कतिपय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 How many. 2 A certain number, so many.
8782: कतिपयथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) What, how much. E. थक् added to कतिपयथ.
8783: कतिविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Of how many sorts. 2 Of various kinds. E. कति, and विध sort.
8784: कत्तृण n. (-णं) 1 A fragrant grass. 2 A plant, commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) E. कत् for कुत् bad, तृण grass.
8785: कत्तोय n. (-यं) Wine or vinous spirit. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and तोय water.
8786: कत्थ r. 1st cl. (कत्थते) 1 To praise or celebrate. 2 To flatter or coax. 3 To boast.
8787: कत्र r. 10th cl. (कत्रयति) To loosen, to slacken, to remove.
8788: कत्सवर n. (-रं) The shoulder, the shoulder blade.
8789: कथ r. 10th cl. (कथयति) To speak, to tell.
8790: कथक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A narrator, a relator, one who recites a story, or who publicly reads and expounds the Purāṇas, &c. 2 One who speaks or tells. mf. (-कः-का) The speaker of a prologue or a monologue. 2 A professional story teller. E. कथ to speak, to relate, वुन् aff.
8791: कथङ्कथिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An interrogant, one who asks or questions. E. कथम् how, कथ to speak, ठक् aff.
8792: कथङ्कथिकता f. (-ता) A question, asking, enquiring. E. तल् affix of the abstract added to the preceding.
8793: कथङ्कथित m. (-तः) An interrogant, one who questions. E. कथम् how, कथित said.
8794: कथञ्चन ind. In some way, in any way, by any means. E. कथम् and चन aff.
8795: कथञ्चित् ind. In any way, by some means or other. E. कथम् and चित् aff.
8796: कथन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Talkative. n. (-नं) Saying, narrating, relating. E. कथ to say, &c. युच् or ल्युट् aff.
8797: कथनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be said, to be told or declared. E. कथ to tell, अनीयर् affix; also with तव्य, कथितव्य, and with यत्, कथ्य.
8798: कथन्ता f. (-ता) Enquiry, question, demand. E. कथ to speak, भश् aff.
8799: कथम् ind. 1 A particle of interrogation, (how, what.) 2 Also implying mode, (how, in what manner.) 3 A particle of amazement or surprise, 4 Of pleasure, 5 Of abuse, 6 Of interrogation, implying doubt. E. किम् what, and थमु aff.
8800: कथा f. (-था) A feigned story, a tale or fable. E. कथ to tell, &c. अङ् and टाप् affs.
8801: कथानुराग m. (-गः) Attention, taking pleasure in a discourse. E. कथा, and अनुराग inclination.
8802: कथाप्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) A narrative, a tale, a fiction. E. कथा, and प्रबन्ध connexion.
8803: कथाप्रसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Talkative, talking much and foolishly. 2 Half-witted, foolish. 3 A conjuror, a dealer in antidotes, &c. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Talking, conversation, speaking to or with. 2 Rumour, report. E. कथा a fable, and प्रसङ्ग who relates.
8804: कथाप्राण m. (-णः) 1 An actor, the speaker of a prologue or monologue, the introducer or a drama. 2 A professed story teller. E. कथा, and प्राण life, livelihood.
8805: कथायोग m. (-गः) Conversation, talk, discourse. E. कथा, and योग uniting.
8806: कथारम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Narration, narrative, story telling. 2 Beginning of a story. E. कथा, and आरम्भ beginning, &c.
8807: कथाविरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Reserved, taciturn, disliking conversation. E. कथा, and विरक्त disliking.
8808: कथासंग्रह m. (-हः) A collection of tales or fables. E. कथा, and संग्रह collection.
8809: कथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A story teller by profession, a narrator, a relator. E. कथा a tale, and ठक् aff.
8810: कथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, told, related. E. कथ to tell, क्त aff.
8811: कथितपद n. (-दं) Repetition, tautology. E. कथित said, पद a word.
8812: कथोद्घात m. (-तः) The opening of a drama, by the character that first enters overhearing and repeating the last words of the prelude. E. कथा, and उद्घात beginning.
8813: कथोपकथन m. (-नं) 1 Conversation, conference. 2 Narration. E. कथा, and उपकथन speaking.
8814: कथोपाख्यान n. (-नं) Narration, narrative, relation, telling a story. E. कथा, and उपाख्यान telling.
8815: कथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) To be spoken or said. E. कथ and यत् aff.
8816: कद or (-इ.) कदि r. 1st cl. (कदते and कन्दते) 1 To be confused, to suffer mentally, to grieve. 2 To confound. 3 To kill or hurt; also कदि, (कंदति) 1 To call. 2 To cry or shed tears.
8817: कद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. क water, and द what gives.
8818: कदक m. (-कः) An awning. E. कद a cloud, and क what makes; yielding a shade as a cloud; also fem. कदका and कदकी.
8819: कदक्षर n. (-रं) A bad letter. E. कत् for कुत् and अक्षर a letter.
8820: कदध्वन् m. (-ध्वा) A bad road. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and अध्वन a road.
8821: कदन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, destroying. 2 Sin. 3 War. E. कद to kill or injure, affix ल्युट्.
8822: कदन्न n. (-न्नं) Bad food. E. कत् for कुत् bad, अन्न food.
8823: कदम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A plant, commonly Kadamba (Nauclea kadamba.) 2 The mustard seed plant, (Sinapis dichotoma.) 3 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratum:) see देवताडक. 4 Turmeric. n. (-म्बं) A multitude, an assemblage or collection. E. कद to confound, &c. अम्बच् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added कदम्बक.
8825: कदम्बद m. (-दः) Mustard seed plant: it seems to be a variety of reading for कदम्बक, q. v.
8826: कदम्बपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, the flowers, of which resemble those of the Kadamba, commonly called Muṇḍīrī. E. कदम्ब, and पुष्प a flower, fem. affix ङीष्; also with टाप्, कदम्बपुष्पा.
8827: कदम्बवायु m. (-युः) A fragrant breeze. E. कदम्ब the plant, and वायु wind.
8828: कदम्बानिल m. (-लः) 1 A fragrant breeze. 2 Spring. E. कदम्ब, and अनिल wind.
8829: कदर m. (-रः) 1 A white sort of mimosa. 2 A corn, a callosity. 3 A saw. 4 An iron goad for an elephant. n. (-रं) Coagulated milk. E. क water, &c. दृ to tear, अच् aff.
8830: कदर्थ (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Useless. 2 Unmeaning. E. कत् for कुत्, and अर्थ object.
8831: कदर्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Despised, disdained, rejected. 2 Rendered useless. E. कत् for कुत् bad, अर्थित sought.
8832: कदर्थीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Despised, disdained. 2 Rendered useless and unavailing. E. कदर्थ and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
8833: कदर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Avaricious, miserly. 2 Little, insignificant, mean. 3 Bad, disagreeable. m. (-र्य्यः) A miser. E. कत् bad, vile, and अर्य्य possessor.
8834: कदर्य्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Avarice. 2 Insignificance. 3 Badness. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, कदर्य्यता.
8835: कदल mf. (-लः-ली) 1 The plaintain tree, (Musa sapientum.) 2 Another plant, (Pistia stratiotes:) see पृष्णी. f. (-ला) The silk cotton tree; also (-ली-लिका) 1 A kind of deer, the hide of  which is used as a seat, &c. 2 A flag, a banner. 3 A flag carried by an elephant. E. क water, air, &c. दल to pierce, to divide, &c. affix अच्, and टाप् or ङीष् fem. aff.
8836: कदलक m. (-कः) The plaintain or banana tree: see the preceding. E. कन् added to कदल.
8837: कदलीक्षता f. (-ता) 1 A sort of cucumber. 2 A fine woman.
8838: कदश्व m. (-श्वः) A hack, a bad horse. E. कत् for कुत्, and अश्व a horse.
8839: कदा ind. When, at what time. E. किम् what, दा aff.
8840: कदाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Ill formed, ugly. E. कत् for कुत्, and आकार form.
8841: कदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) A plant, commonly Kurh or Kudh, (Costus speciosus.) E. कत् bad, आख्या name, ill named: having a bad name or reputation.
8842: कदाचन ind. Sometime or other, ever; नकदाचन never.
8843: कदाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wicked, abandoned, following evil practices. E. कत् for कुत्, आचार observance.
8844: कदाचित् ind. Sometimes, at sometime or other, ever; नकदाचित् never.
8845: कदापि ind. Sometimes, now and then. E. कदा when, अपि certainly.
8846: कदुष्ण mfn. (ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Tepid, warm. n. (-ष्णं) Warmth, gentle warmth. E. कत् instead of कुत् bad, inferior, उष्ण heat.
8847: कद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) Tawny. f. (-द्रुः) The wife of KAŚYAPA the saint, and mother of the Nāgas or the serpent race, inhabiting the regions below the earth. m. (-द्रुः) Tawny, (the colour.) E. कभ to desire, डु affix, and र inserted; the final of the radical is irregularly changed to द; fem. affix ऊञ्.
8848: कद्रुपुत्र m. (-त्रः) A serpent. E. पुत्र a son, joined to the preceding; also other compounds of similar import, as कद्रुसुत, &c.
8849: कद्रुसुत m. (-तः) A serpent: see the preceding.
8850: कद्वद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Speaking ill, inaccurately, indistinctly, &c. 2 Vile, base, contemptible. E. कत् for कुत् bad, and वद who speaks.
8851: कन (इ ञि) ञिकनी r. 1st cl. (कनति) 1 To shine. 2 To desire or love. 3 To go or approach.
8852: कनक n. (-कं) Gold. m. (-कः) 1 The name of a tree which bears red flowers, (Butea frondosa:) see पलाश. 2 Thorn apple, (Datura metel, &c) 3 Another plant, (Mesua ferrea:) see नागकेशर. 4 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) see काञ्चनाल. 5 A black sort of agallochum. 6 A shrub yielding a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) E. कन to shine, अक Uṇādi aff.
8853: कनकक्षार m. (-रः) Borax. E. कनक, and क्षार flux.
8854: कनकटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A golden hatchet. E. कनक, and टङ्क a hatchet.
8855: कनकदण्डक n. (-कं) The royal parasol. E. कनक gold, दण्ड a staff, and कन् affix; golden-sticked.
8856: कनकपराग m. (-गः) Gold dust. E. कनक, and पराग pollen.
8857: कनकपल m. (-लः) A Pala, a weight of gold and silver equal to sixteen Māṣas, or about 280 grains troy: see पल. E. कनक, and पल a Pala.
8858: कनकभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A piece of gold. E. कनक, भङ्ग what is broken off.
8859: कनकमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden, consisting or made of gold. E. कनक and मयट् aff.
8860: कनकरस m. (-सः) Yellow orpiment. E. कनक, and रस juice.
8862: कनकसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A gold cord. E. कनक, and सूत्र string.
8863: कनकस्थली f. (-ली) A gold mine, golden soil. E. कनक, and स्थल place.
8864: कनकाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Sumeru. E. कनक, and अचल a mountain; the golden mountain.
8865: कनकाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The treasurer or superintendant of the gold. E. कनक, and अध्यक्ष a superintendant.
8866: कनकालुका f. (-का) A golden jar or vase. E. कनक, आलु a water jar, कन् and टाप् added.
8867: कनकाह्व m. (-ह्वः) A tree with golden or yellow blossoms, (Mesua ferrea.) E. कनक, and आह्वा appellation.
8868: कनन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) One-eyed. E. कन to shine, युच् aff.
8869: कनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Small, little. 2 Younger, younger born. 3 Young. f. (-ष्ठा) The little finger. E. कन् to shine, &c. and इष्ठच् affix, or कण small, the ण being changed, or कन substituted for युवन् and अल्प.
8870: कनिष्ठता f. (-ता) The state of being younger or smaller. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कनिष्ठत्वं.
8871: कनी f. (-नी) A girl, a maiden. E. कन to shine, अच् and ङीष् affs.
8872: कनीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Very small: see कणिक.
8873: कनीचि f. (-चिः) 1 A creeping plant which bears flowers. 2 The Gunja, a shrub bearing a red and black berry, (Abrus precatorios.) 3 A cart. E. कनी to shine, ईचि Uṇādi affix; also according to some कणीचि.
8874: कनीनक m. (-कः) The caruncula lacrymalis. f. (-निका) 1 The pupil of the eye. 2 The little finger. E. कन to shine, ईकन् affix, कन added; also with ङीष् only कनीनी.
8875: कनीनी f. (-नी) 1 The little finger. 2 The pupil of the eye.
8876: कनीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very young, youngest. 2 Very small, least. 3 Younger born, a younger brother or sister. E. कण small, ईयसुन् affix, the ण being changed; or कन to shine, &c.: or कन substituted for युवन् and अल्प.
8877: कनीयस n. (-सं) Copper. E. कन to shine, ईयसच् aff.
8878: कनेर f. (-रा) 1 A female elephant. 2 A harlot.
8879: कन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Happy. E. कं and त aff.
8880: कन्ति mfn. (-न्तिः-न्तिः-न्ति) Happy. E. कम् and ति aff.
8881: कन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) Happy. m. (-न्तुः) 1 KĀMADEVA, the deity of love. 2 The heart, as the seat or faculty of perception and feeling. E. कम to desire, तु Uṇādi affix; or कं and तु possessive aff.
8882: कन्था f. (-न्था) 1 A rag, a patched cloth or garment, a quilt of grass. 2 A wall: this word in composition may be used as neuter, if the compound imply a town in the province of Usināra, as सोसिमकन्थं.
8883: कन्थाधारण n. (-णं) Wearing a garment of patch-work, the practice of some Yogis. E. कन्था, and धारण wearing.
8884: कन्थाधारिन् mf. (-री) A Yogi, a religious mendicant. E. कन्था, and धारिन् who wears.
8885: कन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) 1 A bulbous or tuberous root. 2 One of an esculent sort, (Arum campanulatum.) 3 Garlic. m. (-न्दः) 1 A cloud. 2 An affection of the feminine organ, considered as a fleshy excrescence, but apparently prolapsus uteri. E. कदि to wet, &c. अच् affix, or कं water, and दा to give.
8886: कन्दट n. (-टं) The white esculent water lily.
8887: कन्दमूल n. (-लं) A radish. E. कन्द, and मूल root.
8888: कन्दर mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) 1 An artificial or natural cave. 2 A glen, a defile, a valley. m. (-रः) A hook for driving an elephant with. n. (-रं) Dry ginger. E. क water, or the head, and दृ to divide, to pierce, अप् aff.
8889: कन्दराकर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. कन्दर a cave, आकर having, making.
8890: कन्दराल m. (-लः) A plant, (Hibiscus populneoides.) 2 A species of fig tree, (Ficus venosa:) see प्लक्ष. 3 The walnut tree. E. कन्दरा a cave, and लक्ष् affix; growing in desolate places: also with कन् added, कन्दरालक.
8891: कन्दरालक m. (-कः) A species of fig tree: see the preceding.
8892: कन्दर्प m. (-र्पः) A name of the deity KĀMA, the CUPID of the Hindu mythology. E. कं BRAHMĀ, दर्प to inflame, अच् affix; the inflamer even of the first of the gods; corresponding in this respect with his Grecian prototype. f. (-र्पा) One of the presiding female deities of the Jainas.
8894: कन्दर्पज्वर m. (-रः) Passion, desire. E. कन्दर्प, and ज्वर fever.
8896: कन्दल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 The cheek, or the cheek and temple. 2 A portent, a natural phoenomenon supposed to announce evil. 3 A new shoot or spring. 4 A low minute tone. 5 Reproach, censure. m. (-लः) 1 Gold. 2 War, battle. f. (-ली) 1 A species of deer of which the hide is used. 2 A sort of tree, the banana: see कदली. 3 A flag. E. कन्द a root, &c. and ल from ला to take, fem. affix ङीप्.
8897: कन्दलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Budden, blown. 2 Put forth, emitted. E. कन्दल a bud, इतच् aff.
8899: कन्दवर्द्धन m. (-नः) An esculent root. E. कन्द, and वर्द्धन increasing.
8900: कन्दशूरण m. (-णः) A sort of Arum, (A. campanulatum.) E. कन्द, and शूरण the same.
8901: कन्दसंज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Prolapsus uteri, see कन्द. E. कन्द a root, and संज्ञा a name, affix ड; every संज्ञा or name for a bulbous root, being a term for this complaint.
8902: कन्दसार n. (-रं) The garden or grove of INDRA.
8903: कन्दालु m. (-लुः) An esculent root, a sort of Arum.
8904: कन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Having a bulbous root. m. (-न्दी) A sort of Arum, (A. campanulatum, or any similar bulb.) E. कन्द and इनि aff.
8905: कन्दु mfn. (-न्दुः-न्दुः-न्दु) 1 A boiler, a saucepan or other cooking utensil of iron. 2 An oven or vessel serving for one. E. स्कन्द to go, उ Uṇādi affix, and the initial स rejected.
8906: कन्दुक m. (-कः) A ball of wood or pith for playing with. n. (-कं) A germ. E. कदि to cry, to call, &c. उ affix, and कन् added.
8907: कन्दुपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Parched, roasted, (as grain,) fried, &c. dressed without water. E. कन्दु, and पक्व dressed.
8908: कन्दोट m. (-टः) The white esculent water lily. n. (-टं) The blue lotus.
8910: कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A cloud. E. कं water, and ध from धा to have.
8911: कन्धर mf. (-रः-रा) The neck. m. (-रः) A cloud. E. कं water or the head, and धर having, from धृञ्, affix खच्.
8912: कन्धि m. (-न्धिः) The ocean. f. (-न्धिः) The neck. E. क water or the head, धा to have, कि aff.
8913: कन्न n. (-न्नं) Fainting, falling in a fit or state of insensibility: in some copies this word is read कल्ल.
8914: कन्यका f. (-का) 1 A girl, a maiden. 2 A daughter. 3 The Socotrine aloe, (Aloes perfoliata.) E. कन्या A girl, कन् pleonastic affix, fem. affix, टाप्: see कन्या and कन्याका.
8915: कन्यकाछल n. (-लं) Beguiling a maiden, seduction, betrayal. E. कन्यका, and छल deceit.
8916: कन्यकाजात m. (-तः) The son of an unmarried woman. E. कन्यका, and जात born.
8917: कन्यकापति m. (-तिः) A daughter's husband. E. कन्यका, and पति a husband.
8918: कन्यस m. (-सः) 1 A younger brother. f. (-सा) The little finger: see कनिष्ठ.
8919: कन्या f. (-म्पा) 1 A girl nine years old, a virgin. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 The sign of the zodiac, Virgo. 4 The socotrine aloe (Aloe perfoliata.) 6 Large cardamoms. 6 A species of metre of four lines, with four syllables in each. 7 A parasite plant. E. कन to shine, Uṇādi affix यक्, fem. टाप्.
8920: कन्याका f. (-का) A young girl or virgin: see कन्या and कन्यका.
8921: कन्याकुब्ज m. (-ब्जः) Kanyākubja or Kinnoge, an ancient city of great note, in the north of Hindustan, known to classical geography as Canogyza: the name also applies to its dependencies or the surrounding district; also कान्यकुब्ज. E. कन्या a girl, and कुब्ज round-shouldered, crooked; the etymology alludes to a legend relating to the one hundred daughters of KUŚANĀBHA the king of this city, who were all rendered crooked by Vāyu, for non-compliance with his licentious desires.
8922: कन्याग्रहण n. (-णं) Taking a girl in marriage. E. कन्या, and ग्रहण taking.
8923: कन्याट m. (-टः) The middle of a house; the inner or private apartments. E. कन्या a girl, अट to go, and अच् aff.
8924: कन्यादान n. (-नं) 1 Giving a girl in marriage. 2 Receiving the same. E. कन्या, and दान gift, or आदान acceptance.
8925: कन्यादातृ m. (-ता) A father, one who gives a girl in marriage. E. कन्या, and दातृ donor.
8926: कन्यादूषक m. (-कः) 1 A violator or defiler of a virgin. 2 A calumniator of a girl. E. कन्या, and टूषक who defiles; also कन्यादूषिन् (-षी.)
8927: कन्यादूषण n. (-णं) 1 Defiling a virgin. 2 Calumniating a girl. E. कन्या, and दूषण spoiling.
8928: कन्यादोष m. (-षः) A blemish in a virgin, disease, bad repute, &c. E. कन्या, and दोष fault.
8929: कन्यापति m. (-तिः) A daughter's husband: see कन्यकापति.
8930: कन्यापाल m. (-लः) 1 A dealer in slave girls. 2 The father of a daughter. E. कन्या, and पाल who cherishes.
8931: कन्यापुत्र m. (-त्रः) The offspring of an unmarried daughter. E. कन्या, and पुत्र a son.
8932: कन्याप्रदान n. (-नं) Giving a daughter in marriage. E. कन्या, and प्रदान a gift.
8933: कन्याराम m. (-मः) A Bauddha or Jaina saint. E. कन्या a girl, रम to please, affix घञ्.
8934: कन्यावेदिन् m. (-दी) A son-in-law. E. कन्या, and वेदिन् who knows.
8935: कन्याशुल्क n. (-ल्कं) The purchase money of a maiden, money given to the bride's father. E. कन्या, and शुल्क tax.
8936: कन्यासमुद्भव m. (-वः) The son of an unmarried girl. E. कन्या, and समुद्भव born.
8937: कन्याहरण n. (-णं) Carrying off a girl, rape, ravishment. E. कन्या, and हरण taking.
8938: कन्यिका f. (-का) A young girl, a virgin: see कन्यका.
8939: कन्युष n. (-षं) The hand below the wrist.
8940: कप (इ) कपि r. 1st cl. (कंपते) To shake, to tremble: with अनु prefixed, to feel tenderness or compassion, to pity.
8941: कपट mn. (-टः-टं) Fraud, deceit, cheating, circumvention. E. क. BRAHMĀ, पट to go, अच् affix; what extends even to BRAHMĀ; or क the head, and पट a covering, screening the head as it were. f. (-टी) A measure equal to the capacity of the hollows of the two hands joined.
8942: कपटता f. (-ता) Deceitfulness. E. तल् added to कपट्; also with त्व, कपटत्वं.
8943: कपटप्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Fraud, trick, fraudulent plot or contrivance. E. कपट, and प्रबन्ध procedure.
8944: कपटलेख्य n. (-ख्यं) A forged document, a false or fraudulent statement. E. कपट, and लेख्य a writing.
8945: कपटवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Masked, disguised, assuming a false dress or appearance. m. (-शः) Disguise. E. कपट, and वेश costume.
8946: कपटवेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Disguised, in masquerade. E. कपटवेश and इनि aff.
8947: कपटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A rogue, a cheat, fraudulent, dishonest. E. कपट and ठक् aff.
8948: कपटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Fraudulent, dishonest, a cheat, &c. E. कपट and इनि aff.
8949: कपर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 The braided hair of ŚIVA. 2 A small shell used as a coin, a Cowri. 3 A name of ŚIVA. E. क water, (that of the Ganges,) पृ in the deriv. form, nourishing, and द from दा to give; or क happiness, &c. which will apply to both senses; also with कन् added कपर्द्दक.
8951: कपर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A name of ŚIVA. E. कपर्द्द his braided hair, and इनि aff.
8952: कपाट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) A door, the leaf or pannel of a door. E. क the head or wind, पट to go, अण् affix; also कबाट.
8953: कपाटघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A thief, a house-breaker. n. कपाट, and घ्न who breaks.
8954: कपाटसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) 1 The junction of the leaves of a door. 2 A mode of multiplying, (in arithmetic.) E. कपाट, and सन्धि junction.
8955: कपाल m. (-लः-लं) 1 The skull, the cranium. 2 Either half of a water jar. 3 Any flat bone. 4 A beggar's bowl. 5 Multitude, assemblage, collection. 6 A species of leprosy. 7 A treaty of peace on equal terms. E. कपि to tremble, and कालन् Uṇādi affix; or क the head, and पाल what cherishes or protects.
8956: कपालनालिका f. (-का) A sort of pin or spindle for winding cotton, thread, &c.
8957: कपालभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of MAHĀDEVA. E. कपाल a skull, and भृत् who cherishes; being represented with a necklace of skulls.
8958: कपालसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) Treaty of peace on equal terms. E. कपाल, and सन्धि peace.
8959: कपालिका f. (-का) 1 The tartar of the teeth. 2 A potsherd. E. कपाल and कन् aff.
8960: कपालिन् m. (-ली) 1 A title of ŚIVA. 2 A man of low caste, from a Brahman mother and fisherman father. f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ. E. कपाल a skull, इनि affix; and ङीष् fem. do.
8961: कपि m. (-पिः) 1 An ape or monkey. 2 The monkey HANUMĀN. 3 A title of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 4 Incense, storax or impure benzoin. 5 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 6 A kind of Bonduc or Bonducella. E. कपि to tremble, इ Uṇādi affix, the nasal rejected.
8962: कपिकच्छु f. (-च्छुः) Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.) E. कपि a monkey, and कच्छु itching; also with final vowel long कपिकच्छू.
8963: कपिकच्छुरा f. (-रा) Cowach: see the preceding.
8964: कपिकन्दुक n. (-कं) The skull, the cranium. E. कपि, and कन्दुक a ball.
8965: कपिचूत m. (-तः) A tree, (Spondias mangifera:) see आम्रातक. E. कपि, and चूत the mango tree, the monkey's mango.
8966: कपिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born of a monkey, &c. m. (-जः) Incense, benzoin. E. कपि, and ज born.
8967: कपिञ्जल m. (-लः) 1 A bird, the francoline partridge. 2 The Chataka.
8968: कपितैल n. (-लः) Benzoin or storax. E. कपि, and तैल oil.
8969: कपित्थ m. (-त्थः) The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantum.) E. कपि, and त्थ from स्था to stay or abide; the residence of apes.
8970: कपित्थपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, commonly कपित्थानी, the leaves of which are compared to those of the preceding.
8971: कपित्थानी f. (-नी) A plant: see the preceding.
8972: कपित्थास्य m. (-स्यः) A kind of monkey. E. कपित्थ, and आस्य a face; having a roundish face, in shape like the wood apple.
8973: कपिध्वज m. (-जः) A name of ARJUNA. E. कपि a monkey, and ध्वज a sign; having a monkey as his symbol, his ensign or arms.
8976: कपिप्रभु m. (-भुः) A name of the first RĀMA. E. कपि, and प्रभु master; general of the monkey force with which he invaded Laṅkā or Ceylon.
8977: कपिप्रिय m. (-यः) The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. E. कपि and प्रिय beloved.
8978: कपिरथ m. (-थः) A title of RĀMA. E. कपि and रथ a car; having been carried by his monkies.
8979: कपिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tawny. m. (-लः) 1 KAPILA, a celebrated Muni or saint, the founder of the Sāṃkhya system of philosophy: the son of KĀRDDAMA by DEVAHŪTI, and according to some, an avatāra of VIṢṆU. 2 A title of AGNI the deity of fire. 3 A dog. 5 Tawny, (the colour.) f. (-ला) 1 The female elephant of the south-east. 2 A kind of Sisu, or timber tree so  called: see शिंशपा. 3 A sort of perfume: see रेणुका. 4 The aloe plant. 5 A fabulous cow, celebrated in the Purāṇas. 5 The common leech. E. कभ to desire, इलच् Uṇādi affix, and प substituted for म; or कपि a monkey, and ल to take, &c. being of such a colour.
8980: कपिलद्युति m. (-तिः) A name of SŪRYA or the sun. E. कपिल, and द्युति light; being of a dull red or tawny hue.
8981: कपिलद्राक्षा f. (-क्षा) The brown or tawny grape. E. कपिल, and द्राक्षा a grape.
8982: कपिलद्रुम m. (-मः) The name of a perfume or sweet scented wood: see काक्षी.
8983: कपिलधारा f. (-रा) 1 The Ganges. 2 A holy place, a place of pilgrimage.
8984: कपिलाश्व m. (-श्वः) A title of the god INDRA. E. कपिल tawny, and अश्व horse; such being the colour of INDRA'S steed.
8985: कपिलोह n. (-हं) Brass. E. कपि for कपिल brown, and लोह iron.
8986: कपिल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, which bears a seed resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis.)
8987: कपिवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A name of NĀRADA, a saint and philosopher, and friend of KṚṢṆA. E. कपि, and वक्त्र a face; the saint having a face like a monkey.
8988: कपिवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. E. कपि, and वल्ली a pedicle; that being invested with a downy coat, resembling the hair of an ape.
8989: कपिश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Brown, of a brown colour. m. (-शः) 1 Brown, (the colour,) a compound of black and yellow. 2 Incense, styrax or coarse benzoin. f. (-शी) A spirit, a sort of rum. f. (-शा) The mother of the demons called Piśācas. E. कपि an ape, and शः affix; of the colour of an ape.
8990: कपिशाञ्जन m. (-नः) A title of ŚIVA.
8991: कपिशायन m. (-नः) 1 A deity. 2 A sort of spirit or rum. E. कपिशा, affix फक्.
8992: कपिशापुत्र m. (-त्रः) A Piśāca, an imp or goblin. E. कपिशा the mother of these beings, and पुत्र a son.
8993: कपिशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Embrowned, made brown or dusky red. E. कपिश and इतच् aff.
8994: कपिशीका f. (-का) Spirituous liquor. E. कपिश, and ईकन् affix: see कपिश.
8995: कपिशीर्ष n. (-र्षः) The upper part or coping of a wall. E. कपि, and शीर्ष the head; a monkey's head.
8996: कपिशीर्षक n. (-कं) Vermilion, the red sulphuret of mercury.
8997: कपिस्थल n. (-लं) A place frequented by monkies. E. कपि, and स्थल place.
8999: कपीज्य m. (-ज्यः) A plant, (a species of mimusops:) see क्षीरिका. E. कपि, and इज्य respected, liked: a favourite plant with the monkies; also कपीज्यक.
9000: कपीतन m. (-नः) 1 A tree bearing an acid fruit, (Spondias mangifera:) see आम्रातक. 2 Another tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्दभाण्ड. 3 A species of Mimosa, (Mimosa sirisha, Rox.) 4 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 5 The betel nut tree, (Areca faufel or Catechu.) 6 The name of another plant, (Crataeva marmelos.) E. कपि an ape, and तन what spreads; sheltering or feeding monkies; the vowel is made long irregularly.
9001: कपीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A name of the celebrated monkey HANUMĀN. 2 Also of SUGRĪVA, &c. E. कपि, and इन्द्र the chief.
9002: कपुष्टिका f. (-का) A patch of hair on each side of the head. E. क the head, पुष्टि cherishing, कन् aff.
9003: कपुच्छल n. (-लं) Hair hanging down to the ground. E. क the head, पुच्छ a tail, and ल what resembles.
9004: कपोत m. (-तः) 1 A dove or pigeon, especially the spotted necked pigeon. 2 A bird in general. E. कब to tinge, to be of various hues, आतच् Uṇādi affix, ब changed to प.
9005: कपोतक n. (-कं) Antimony. E. कपोत, and कन् affix, implying resemblance, (in colour.)
9006: कपोतचरणा f. (-णा) A perfume: see नली.
9007: कपोतपालिका f. (-का) A dove cot, an aviary or pigeon house. E. कपोत a bird, &c. पाल to nourish, and वुन् affix, fem. termination टाप्; also with the affixes अण and ङीप्, कपोतपाली.
9009: कपोतसार n. (-रं) Antimony. E. कपोत, and सार essence.
9010: कपोताङ्घ्रि f. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A perfume: see नली. E. कपोत, and अङ्घ्रि a foot; of a red colour, like the claw of a pigeon.
9011: कपोताभ m. (-भः) A pale or dirty white colour. E. कपोत, and आङ् before भा to shine, affix ड; of the colour of a pigeon.
9012: कपोतारि m. (-रिः) A hawk, a falcon. E. कपोत, and अरि an enemy.
9013: कपोतिका f. (-का) A done. E. कपोत a pigeon, कन् affix fem. form.
9014: कपोल m. (-लः) A cheek. f. (-ली) The forepart of the knee, the knee-cap or pan. E. कपि to quiver, and ओलच् Uṇādi aff.
9015: कपोलकाष m. (-षः) The elephant's temples and cheeks. E. कपोल, and काष a touchstone; being of the like dark colour.
9016: कपोलभित्ति m. (-त्तिः) The temples and cheek, the upper part of the face. E. कपोल, and भित्ति a wall.
9017: कपोलराग m. (-गः) Colour or flush in the cheek. E. कपोल, and राग colour.
9018: कपोलफलक f. (-कः) The cheek. E. कपोल, and फलक a plank.
9019: कप्याख्य m. (-ख्यः) Incense. E. कपि, and आख्या aff.
9020: कफ m. (-फः) 1 Phlegm, one of the three humours of the body. 2 Watery froth or foam in general. E. क water, and फल to bud or flower, ड aff.
9021: कफकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Producing phlegm. E. कफ, and कर what makes.
9022: कफकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Saliva, spittle. E. कफ, and कूर्च्चिका cream.
9023: कफघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing phlegm, antiphlegmatic, (an epithet of many plants, &c.) E. कफ, and घ्न what destroys.
9024: कफणि mf. (-णिः-णी) The elbow. E. क pleasure, फण to go, इन् and ङीष् affixes; also कफोणि.
9025: कफनाशन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Antiphlegmatic. E. कफ, and नाशन destroying.
9026: कफवर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Exciting phlegm. E. कफ, and वर्द्धक what increases.
9027: कफवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Exciting phlegm. m. (-नः) The name of a plant; also पिण्डीतगर. E. कफ phlegm, वृध to augment, and ल्युट् aff.
9028: कफारि m. (-रिः) Ginger. E. कफ, and अरि foe.
9029: कफिन् mfn. (-फी-फिनी-फी) Phlegmatic. m. (-फी) An elephant. E. कफ and इनि aff.
9030: कफेलू mfn. (-लूः-लूः-लु) Phlegmatic, causing or exciting phlegm. E. कफ, लू from ला to take or give, and कू Uṇādi affix; the deriv. is irr.
9031: कफोणि mf. (-णिः-णी) The elbow. E. क pleasure, स्फुर् to go, &c. इन् and ङीष् affixes; the form is irregular: see कफणि.
9032: कब (ऋ) कबृ r. 1st cl. (कबते) 1 To colour, to tinge with various hues. 2 To praise.
9033: कबन्ध mn. (-न्धः-न्धं) A headless trunk, especially retaining vitality. n. (-न्धं) Water. m. (-न्धः) 1 A name of RĀHU. 2 Also of a demon destroyed by RĀMA. 3 The belly. E. कं the head, and बध to injure, to lop, affix अच्; also कं water, and बन्ध binding, attaching.
9034: कबन्धता f. (-ता) Headlessness, decapitation. E. कबन्ध and तल् affix; also with त्व, कबन्धत्व.
9035: कबित्थ m. (-त्थः) The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ.
9036: कबिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tawny, (of such a hue.) m. (-लः) Tawny, (the colour:) see कपिल.
9037: कम (उ) कमु r. 1st cl. (कामयति) To desire: this root is irregular.
9038: कम् ind. 1 Water. 2 The head. 2 Happiness or happily. 4 An expletive. E. कम to desire, विच् aff.
9039: कमठ mn. (-ठः-ठं) 1 A water jar, especially one made of a hollow gourd or cocoanut, and used by ascetics. m. (-ठः) 1 A turtle, a tortoise. 2 A bamboo. 3 The name of a Daitya or demon. 4 A porcupine. f. (-ठी) A female tortoise, a small one. E. कम to desire, &c. अठः Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
9040: कमण्डलु mn. (-लुः-लु) An earthen or wooden water pot, used by the ascetic and religious student. 2 The waved-leaf fig tree: see प्लक्ष. E. क BRAHMĀ or water, and मण्ड ornament or essence, ल from ला to get or give, and डु aff.
9041: कमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Libidinous, desirous. 2 Beautiful, desirable. m. (-नः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 KĀMA or love. 3 A tree, (Jonesia asoca.) E. कम to desire, affix युच् or ल्युट्.
9042: कमनच्छद m. (-दः) A heron. E. कमन beautiful, and च्छद plumage.
9043: कमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Pleasing, beautiful, desirable. E. कम and अनीयर् affix of the future participle, to be desired.
9044: कमनीयता f. (-ता) 1 Loveliness, beauty. 2 Desirableness. E. तल् added to the last, or with त्व, कमनीयत्वं.
9045: कमन्ध m. (-न्धः) Water. see कबन्ध; also according to some, this is an orthographical compound, of कं and अन्ध, both synonyms of water.
9046: कमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Desirous, lustful. E. कम and अरन् Uṇādi aff.
9047: कमल n. (-लं) 1 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphaea nelumbo.) 2 Water. 3 Copper. 4 A medicament, a drug. 5 The bladder. m. (-लः) A species of deer. f. (-ला) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 An excellent woman. E. कम् water, and अल what adorns, or कम to desire, with कलच् aff.
9048: कमलच्छद m. (-दः) 1 A heron: see कङ्क. 2 Petal of the lotus. E. कमल, and छद a leaf.
9049: कमलाकर m. (-रः) A lake &c. where lotuses abound. E. कमल, and आकर a mine.
9050: कमलासन m. (-नः) An epithet of BRAHMĀ. E. कमल a lotus, and आसन seat or abode.
9051: कमलिनी f. (-नी) A number of lotus flowers, or a place abounding with them. E. कमल, इनि and ङीष् affs.
9052: कमलोत्तर n. (-रं) Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) E. कमल, and उत्तर best, excellent.
9053: कमा f. (-मा) Beauty, radiance. E. कम to desire, अङ् and टाप् affs.
9054: कमितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Lustful, desirous, cupidinous. E. कम to desire, तृच् affix; and इ inserted.
9055: कम्प m. (-म्पः) Tremour, trembling, shaking. E. कपि to shake, and अच् affix; also कम्पन, &c.
9056: कम्पन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Trembling, unsteady, shaken. n. (-नं) Trembling, quivering. m. (-नः) The dewy season. (Nov.-Dec. E. कपि to tremble, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.
9057: कम्पमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Trembling. E. कपि to tremble, शानच् aff.
9058: कम्पलक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Air, wind. E. कम्प trembling, and लक्ष्मन् mark or sign.
9059: कम्पाक m. (-कः) Wind, air. E. काकुन् affixed to कपि.
9060: कम्पान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trembling, agitated. E. कम्प, and अन्वित possessed of.
9061: कम्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaking, shaken, trembling. (-तं) Trembling, a trembling, a tremor. E. कपि and क्त aff.
9062: कम्पिल m. (-लः) A plant: see रोचनी: see काम्पिल्ल; also कम्पिल्ल and कम्पील.
9063: कम्प्र mfn. (-म्प्रः-म्प्रा-म्प्रं) Trembling, shaken. E. कपि, and रः aff.
9064: कम्ब r. 1st cl. (-कम्बति) To go, to move.
9065: कम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Variegated. m. (-रः) Variegated, (the colour.)
9066: कम्बल m. (-लः) 1 A blanket. 2 A chief of the Nāgas or serpents. 3 A small worm. 4 A dewlap. 5 An upper cloth or garment. 6 A sort of deer. n. (-लं) Water. E. कम to desire, कलः Uṇādi affix, and ब inserted; or कम् the head, water, &c. and बल to be strong, affix अच्.
9067: कम्बलकारक m. (-कः) Woollen cloth manufacturer. E. कम्बल, and कारक who makes.
9068: कम्बलवाह्यक n. (-कं) A kind of carriage, covered with a coarse blanket or woollen cloth, and drawn by oxen. E. कम्बल and बह to bear, affixes ण्यत् and कन्.
9069: कम्बालायिन् m. (-यी) A sort of kite.
9070: कम्बि f. (-म्बिः) 1 A ladle or spoon. 2 A shoot, a branch or joint of a bamboo. E. कम to desire, बिन् affix, or with ङीष् added, कम्बी.
9071: कम्बु mfn. (-म्बुः-म्बू-म्बु) Speckled, variegated. mn. (-म्बुः-म्बु) 1 A conch, a shell. m. (-म्बुः) 1 A bracelet, a ring. 2 A bivalve shell. 3 An elephant. 4 The neck. 5 A vein or tubular vessel of the body, &c. E. कम्ब to go, उ affix, or कम to desire; the form is irr.
9072: कम्बुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A mean person. m. (-कः) A conch. f. (-का) A tree, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. कन् added to the last.
9073: कम्बुग्रीवा f. (-वा) A neck marked with three lines like a shell, and considered to be indicative of exalted fortune. E. कम्बु a shell, and ग्रीवा the neck.
9074: कम्बू mfn. (-म्बूः-म्बू-म्बु) A thief, a plunderer. m. (-म्बूः) A bracelet. E. कम to desire, ऊ Uṇādi affix, and बुक् inserted.
9075: कम्बोज m. (-जः) 1 The name of a country in the north of India, Camboja or Camboya. 2 A kind of shell. 3 A description of elephant: see काम्बोज.
9076: कम्भारी f. (-री) A plant, (Gmelina arborea.) E. कम water, भार a burthen, ङीष् affix; also गम्भारी.
9077: कम्भु n. (-म्भु) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. कं water, भू produced.
9078: कम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) 1 Desirous, cupidinous. 2 Beautiful, desirable. E. कम to desire, रन् aff.
9079: कयस्था f. (-स्था) A medicinal plant, commonly Kākoli: also कायस्था, or more accurately, perhaps, वयस्था.
9080: कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what does, makes or causes, as किङ्करः A servant, who does any thing; भयङ्करः frightful, what causes fear; उपकरः who gives aid; अपकरः who does ill, &c. m. (रः) 1 A ray of light, a sun or moonbeam. 2 Royal revenue, toll, tax, impost, &c. 3 The hand. 4 Hail. 5 An elephant's trunk. E. कृञ् to do, &c. ट or अप् aff.
9081: करक mf. (-कः-का) Hail. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The water pot of the student or ascetic. 2 The shell of the cocoanut hollowed to form a vessel. m. (-कः) 1 The pomegranate tree. 2 Toll, tax. 3 A particular sort of bird. 4 A plant, (Galedupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्च. 5 A tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. कन् added to the preceding, or कृ to injure, &c. and वुन् aff.
9082: करकण्ठक m. (-कः) The finger nail. कर the hand, and कण्ठक a thorn.
9083: करकमल n. (-लं) The hand, especially of a lover, a mistress, &c. E. कर, and कमल a lotus; also similar compounds, as करपद्मं, करपङ्कज, करपल्लव, &c.
9084: करकलश m. (-शः) The hand hollowed to receive water. E. कर, and कलश a ewer.
9085: करकाम्भस् m. (-म्भाः) The cocoanut tree, (Cocos nucifera.) E. करक the shell, and अम्भस् the water, the nut containing a serous fluid.
9086: करकुद्मल n. (-लं) A finger. E. कर, and कुद्मल a bud.
9087: करकोष m. (-षः) The hollow of the hand. E. कर, and कोष receptacle.
9088: करग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Marriage. 2 Levying or gathering a tax. 3 A tax gatherer. 4 Taking the hand. E. कर, and ग्रह taking: one part of the ceremony of marriage is the placing of the right hand of the bride with the palm uppermost, in the right hand of the bridegroom; also करग्राह.
9089: करग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Levying or gathering a tax. 2 Taking the hand. 3 Marriage. E. कर, and ग्रहण taking.
9090: करग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 1 Levying a tax. 2 Taking the hand. E. कर, and ग्राहिन् who takes.
9091: करघर्षण m. (-णः) The churning stick. n. (-णं) Rubbing the hands together. E. कर the hand, and घर्षण rubbing.
9092: करघर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) The churning stick. E. कर the hand, घृष to rub, णिनि aff.
9093: करङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 The head. 2 A cocoanut hollowed so as to form a cup or vessel. 3 Any bone of the body. 4 A kind of sugar cane. E. कृ to send or throw, &c. अंक aff.
9094: करङ्कशालि m. (-लिः) A sort of sugar cane.
9095: करङ्गण n. (-णं) A market or fair. E. कर tax, and गण collection, &c.
9096: करच्छद m. (-दः) The teak tree. E. कर, and च्छद a leaf.
9097: करज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in or from a hand, a ray, &c. m. (-जः) 1 A finger nail. 2 The name of a timber tree, commonly Karanja, (Galendupa arborea, Rox.) n. (-जं) A perfume, commonly Nakhi, resembling a nail in appearance. E. कर the hand, and ज produced; or कं pleasure, रञ्ज to colour, &c. अच affix: see the next.
9098: करजाल n. (-लं) A pencil of rays, a stream of light. E. कर, and जाल multitude.
9099: करञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) The name of a plant, commonly Karanja, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.) E. क water, and रञ्ज to colour, अच् affix: see करज.
9100: करञ्जक m. (-कः) 1 Karanja: see the preceding. 2 Another plant, (Verbesina scandens, Rox.) see भृङ्गराज. E. कन् added to the foregoing.
9101: करट m. (-टः) 1 A crow. 2 An elephant's cheek. 3 Safflower or carthamus. 4 A man of a low or degraded profession. 5 The first Śrāddha or ceremony performed in honour of a deceased relation. 6 An atheist, an unbeliever, an oppugner of the doctrines of the Vedas. 7 A musical instrument, (Castanets?) f. (-टा) A cow difficult to be milked. E. क pleasure, &c. रट to sound, and अच् affix; or कृ to do, and अटन् Uṇādi aff.
9102: करटक m. (-कः) A crow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
9103: करटिन् m. (-टी) An elephant. E. करट and इनि aff.
9104: करटु m. (-टुः) The numidian crane. E. कर् for कुत् bad, अट to go, and डु aff.
9105: करण n. (-णं) 1 An instrument or means of action. 2 Making, doing. 3 Action, act. 4 Cause, motive. 5 Business, occupation, as trade, &c. 6 An organ of sense. 7 The body. 8 The mind or heart. 9 A field. 10 Grain. 11 The posture, abstinence, &c. of an ascetic. 12 Copulation, (seu modus coeundi.) 13 The usage or practice of the writer caste. 14 Acting, dramatic action. 15 Song, singing. 16 The particular business of any tribe or cast. 17 Plaistering, spreading any thing with the hand. 18 A Karaṇa, an astrological division of time; the Karaṇas are eleven: 7 moveable and 4 fixed, and two are equal to a lunar day; or the time during which the moon's motion from the sun amounts to 6°. 19 (In grammar) The instrumental case, or noun in that case. m. (-णः) A man of a mixed class, the son of a Śūdra woman by a Vaiśya; or, according to some, of an outcast Kṣetriya, by a Kṣetriya female; the occupation of this class is writing, accounts, &c. a writer, a scribe. f. (-णी) 1 A woman of the same caste. 2 (In arithmetic, &c.) A surd or irrational quantity. E. कृ to do, to act, &c. ल्युट् aff.
9106: करणत्राण n. (-णं) The head. E. करण an organ of sense, and त्राण preserving.
9107: करणत्व n. (-त्वं) Instrumentality, mediate agency. E. त्व added to करण.
9108: करणनियम m. (-मः) Suppression or restraint of the organs of sense. E. करण, and नियम restraint.
9109: करणि f. (-णिः) Doing, making, effecting. E. कृ to do, अनि affix; also with कन added करणिका.
9110: करणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be done or made. E. कृ to do, अनीयर् aff.
9112: करण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A basket or covered box of bamboo wicker work. 2 A bee-hive, a honey-comb. 3 A sword. 4 A sort of duck. 5 An aquatic weed, (Vallisneria.) E. कृ to do, अण्डन् Uṇādi aff.
9113: करण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) A fish in general. E. करण्ड Vallisneria, and इनि aff.
9114: करतल n. (-लं) The palm of the hand. E. कर, and तल lower part.
9115: करतलधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held in the hand. E. करतल, and धृत held.
9116: करतलस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Held in the hand, what is in or under the hand. E. करतल, and स्थ what is.
9117: करताल nf. (-लं-ली) 1 A musical instrument, a cymbal. 2 Beating time by clapping the hands. E. कर the hand, ताल musical time, and ङीष् aff.
9118: करतोया f. (-या) The Karatoyā river, a river in the north-east of Bengal. E. कर the hand, and तोय water: at the wedding of ŚIVA and PĀRVATĪ, the water which had been poured into the hand of the former, constituted, upon its being thrown on the ground, the source of this river.
9119: करद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Subject to tax or duty. 2 Tributary. 3 Who gives his hand, &c. E. कर, and द who gives.
9120: करदक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Handy, dexterous, ready. कर, and दक्ष clever.
9121: करदीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subjugated, made tributary. E. करद, and कृत made with च्चि augment.
9122: करधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held, supported by the hand. E. कर, and धृत held.
9123: करनिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held in the hand. E. कर, and निहित placed.
9124: करपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A saw. 2 Splashing water about while bathing, playing or gamboling in water. E. कर, and पत्र a leaf; being in the hand as a leaf.
9125: करपत्रवत् m. (-वान्) The palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.) E. करपत्र a saw, and मतुप् affix, the spatha being compared to a saw.
9126: करपत्रिका f. (-का) Playing with water, gamboling in it, splashing it about; also करपत्र, करपात्र and करपत्रिक.
9127: करपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A species of castor oil tree. E. कर, and पर्ण a leaf.
9128: करपल्लव m. (-वः) A finger. E. कर, and पल्लव a shoot.
9129: करपात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The hand hollowed so as to hold any thing. 2 The throwing of water in sport. E. कर, and पात्र a cup.
9130: करपाल (-लः) A sword, a scymitar. E. कर the hand, and पल protecting, or with बल to be strong, करबाल.
9131: करपालिका f. (-का) 1 A cudgel, a short club or wooden sword. 2 A sword or one edged knife. E. कर the hand, पाल to nourish, ण्वुल् affix, and the fem. termination.
9132: करपुट m. (-टं) Joining the palms of the hands to shew respect. 2 The hands joined and hollowed to receive anything. E. कर, and पुट् a bag.
9133: करपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Back of the hand. E. कर, and पृष्ठ back.
9134: करप्रचेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be held, to be taken hold of. 2 To be collected by taxes. E. कर, and प्रचेय to be accumulated.
9135: करप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Held in hand, got, secured. E. कर, and प्राप्त obtained.
9136: करबाल n. (-लः) 1 A finger nail. 2 A sword, a scymitar: see करपाल.
9137: करबालिका f. (-का) A small sword, &c. see करपालिका.
9138: करभ m. (-भः) 1 The metacarpus, the hand from the wrist to the root of the fingers. 2 A young camel or any young animal. 3 A young elephant. 4 A perfume, commonly Nakhi. f. (-भी) A she camel. E. कृ to reject, अभच Uṇādi affix: see कलभ.
9139: करभप्रिया f. (-या) A plant, a sort of Hedysarum. E. करभ, and प्रिय fond of; folder for camels.
9140: करभिन् m. (-भी) An elephant. E. करभ and इनि aff.
9141: करभीर m. (-रः) A lion. E. करभ a young animal, and ईर who destroys.
9142: करभूषण n. (-णं) A bracelet, an ornament worn round the wrist. E. कर the hand, and भूषण an ornament.
9143: करमट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The betel nut tree: see गुवका.
9144: करमरिन् m. (-री) A prisoner, a captive.
9145: करमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A small tree bearing an acid fruit, commonly Karonda or Karinda, (Carissa carondas.) E. कर the hand, and मृद to destroy, अण् affix; what is plucked by the hand; also with कन् affix, करमर्द्दक and fem. with ङीष् affix करमर्द्दी.
9147: करमाल m. (-लः) Smoke, probably an error or corruption for खतमाल.
9148: करमाला f. (-ला) The hand used as a rosary, the joints of the fingers corresponding to the beads. E. कर, and माला a rosary.
9149: करमुक्त n. (-क्तं) A missile weapon, but thrown by the hand, a dart, a javelin, &c. E. कर, and मुक्त released.
9150: कराग्रपल्लव m. (-वः) A finger. E. कर and अग्र to the point, पल्लव a shoot.
9151: करम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 1 Mixed, intermingled. 2 Set, inlaid. m. (-म्बः) Flour or meal mixed with curds: see करम्भ. E. कृ to do, अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.
9152: करम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Intermingled, mixed, blended, &c. 2 Pounded, reduced to grains or dust. 2 Set, inlaid. E. करम्ब and इतच् aff.
9153: करम्भ m. (-म्भः) A cake, flour or meal mixed with curds. E. क water, and रभि to send, &c. अच् affix, also with कन् added करम्भक; also with रवि to sound, &c. करम्ब, &c. as above.
9154: कररुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Stopped by the hand, held tight or fast. E. कर, and रुद्व stopped.
9155: कररुह m. (-हः) A finger nail. E. कर the hand, and रुह to grow, to rise, affix क.
9156: करर्द्धि m. (-र्द्धिः) A small musical instrument used for marking time, (a castanet,) or clapping the hands together for that purpose. E. कर the hand, ऋद्धि property.
9157: करवालिका f. (-का) A small club, &c. see करबालिका.
9158: करवी f. (-वी) The leaf of the Asafoetida plant, Hingupatri: see कवरी and कारवी.
9159: करवीर m. (-रः) 1 A fragrant plant, (Oleander or Nerium odorum.) 2 The name of a demon. 3 A sword or scymitar. 4 A  cemetery, a place for burning or interring the dead. f. (-रा) Red arsenic. (-री) 1 A name of ADITI, the mother of the gods. 2 A good cow. 3 A woman who has borne a son, a mother. E. कर here said to mean a root, वीर to become evident, and अच् affix, or कर hand, वि prefixed to ईर to go, &c. affix क.
9160: करवीरक m. (-कः) 1 A sword. 2 A poison, the poisonous root of the Oleander. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
9161: करशाखा f. (-खा) A finger. E. कर the hand, and शाखा a branch.
9162: करशीकर m. (-रः) Water expelled by an elephant's trunk. E. कर his trunk, and शीकर drizzling rain.
9163: करशूक m. (-कः) A finger nail. E. कर the hand, and शूक the beard of corn.
9164: करशोथ m. (-थः) OEdematous swelling of the hands. E. कर, and शोथ swelling.
9165: करहाट m. (-टः) 1 The fibrous root of a lotus. 2 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. क water, and रह to abandon, करह a lotus, अट what goes, or by what it goes; or कर the hand, हट to illuminate or adorn, and अण् aff.
9166: करहाटक m. (-कः) The name of a tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
9167: कराघात m. (-तः) A thump, a blow with the hand. E. कर, and आघात a blow.
9168: करामर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A fruit tree, (Carissa carondas:) see करमर्द्ध.
9169: करामुक m. (-कः) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta, Rox.) see कृष्णपाक.
9170: कराम्लक m. (-कः) A fruit tree, (Carissa carondas.)
9171: करायिका f. (-का) A bird, a small kind of crane.
9172: करारोट m. (-टः) A finger ring. E. कर the hand, रुट to shine, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्.
9173: कराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Great, large. 2 High, lofty. 3 Formidable, terrible. 4 Having projecting teeth. m. (-लः) Rosin, pitch, or a mixture of oil and the resin of the Śāl tree. n. (लं) A dark kind of Tulasī or Basil. f. (-ला) A kind of swallow wort, commonly Ananta-mul, (Hemisdemus Indicus). see शारिवा. f. (-ली) One of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire. E. कर the hand, &c. ला with आङ् prefixed to take, and क affix; or कर, and अल to be able, &c. affix अण्, fem. do टाप् or ङीष्.
9174: करालक m. (-कः) A sort of Basil, the dark kind.
9175: करालकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Having a large trunk, (an elephant.) 2 Having a powerful arm or hand. E. कराल, and कर a hand.
9176: करालम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) One who stretches out his hand to support or pick up another, &c. E. कर, and अलम्ब what supports.
9177: करालम्बन n. (-नं) Extending the hand, taking by the hand, helping, sustaining. E. कर, and आलम्बन supporting.
9178: करालवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of hideous aspect, ugly, frightful. f. (-ना) A form or emanation of DURGA. E. कराल, and वदन countenance; also करालानन, करालमुखः, &c.
9180: करालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Afraid of, alarmed by or at. 2 Rendered formidable. 3 Magnified. E. कराल and इतच्.
9181: करिकणवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A species of pepper, (Piper chavya.) E. करिकण elephant-pepper, वल्ली a vine.
9182: करिकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) The frontal globe of an elephant. E. करि, and कुम्भ the same.
9183: करिकुसुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A fragrant powder prepared from the flowers of the Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea;) also करिकुसुम्भक.
9184: करिगर्ज्जित n. (-तं) The roaring of elephants. E. करिन् an elephant, and गर्ज्जित sounding, thundering.
9185: करिचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) An elephant's hide. E. करिन्, and चर्म्मन् skin.
9186: करिज m. (-जः) A young elephant. E. करि an elephant, and ज born.
9187: करिदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 An elephant's tusk. 2 Ivory. E. करिन् and दन्त a tooth.
9188: करिदारक m. (-कः) A lion. E. करि an elephant, दृ to tear or rend, ण्वुल affix; or with युच् affix करिदारण.
9189: करिन् m. (-री) An elephant. E. कर the proboscis of this animal, and इनि aff.
9191: करिपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant bearing a pungent fruit, (Pothos officinalis, Rox.) E. करि, and पिप्पली long-pepper; Elephantpepper; considered by native writers as a large species of that condiment; also गजपिप्पली, &c.
9192: करिपोत m. (-तः) A young elephant, one under ten years old. E. करि, and पोत a young animal; also करिशावक.
9193: करिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The post to which an elephant is tied. E. करि, and बन्ध a binding.
9194: करिमाचल m. (-लः) A lion. E. करि, मा splendor, and चल to go; the lion being considered as the natural enemy and destroyer of the elephant.
9195: करिमुख m. (-खः) A title of GAṆEŚA. E. करि, and मुख a face: this deity being represented with an elephant's head.
9196: करियादस् n. (-दः) A water elephant, a hippopotamus. E. करि, and यादस् any aquatic animal.
9197: करिर m. (-रः) The shoot of a bamboo: see करीर.
9198: करिशावक m. (-कः) A young elephant under five years old; according to some, also until ten years. E. see करिपोत, शावक meaning a young animal.
9199: करिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Doing much. E. कर who does, इष्ठन् aff.
9200: करिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Doing, (with a future sense,) about to do. E. कृ to do, शतृ affix of the future.
9201: करिष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) About to do, going to do. E. कृ to do, शानच् affix of the future.
9202: करीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A large, or a war or state elephant. 2 INDRA'S elephant. E. करि, and इन्द्र chief.
9203: करीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Who does much. E. कर who does, ईयसुन् aff.
9204: करीर mn. (-रः-रं) The shoot of a bamboo; also करिर. m. (-रः) 1 A thorny plant, described as growing in desarts, and fed upon by camels, commonly Karit, (Capparis aphylla, Rox.) 2 A water jar. f. (-रा or री) 1 The root of an elephant's tusk. 2 A cricket, a small grasshopper, &c. E. कृ to injure, to throw. or send, &c. and ईरण् aff.
9205: करीरिका f. (-का) The root of an elephant's tusk: see करीरी.
9206: करीष mn. (-षः-षं) Dry cowdung. E. कृ to throw, send, &c. and ईषन् Uṇādi aff.
9207: करीषङ्कषा f. (-षा) A strong wind, a gale. E. करीष, कष to disturb, खच् aff.
9208: करीषाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A fire of dry cowdung. E. करीष, and अग्नि fire; this substance is very generally used as fuel in Hindustan.
9209: करुण mf. (-णः-णा) Tenderness, pity, compassion, the feeling or sentiment. adv. (-णं) Pitifully, in distress. m. (-णः) 1 Sorrow, affliction, one of the eight sentiments. 2 The name of a fruit tree, the pamplemousse, (Citrus decumana.) 3 A Jina or Jaina saint. E. कृ to send or cast, उनन् Uṇādi aff.
9210: करुणात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Compassionate, tender-hearted. E. करुणा आत्म self, कन् added.
9211: करुणापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Compassionate, tender. E. करुणा, and पर excellent.
9212: करुणामल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Double jasmin: see नवमल्ली.
9213: करुणामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Gentle, compassionate. E. करुणा and मयट् aff.
9214: करुणार्द्र mfn. (-र्द्रः-र्द्रा-र्द्र) Tender-hearted, soft, sensitive. E. करुणा, and आर्द्र moist.
9215: करुणाविप्रलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Grief of separation with the uncertainty of meeting again, fears occurring in absence. E. करुणा sorrow, and विप्रलम्भ separation.
9216: करुणावेदिता f. (-ता) Charitableness, kindliness. E. करुणा, वेदिन् who knows, तल् aff.
9217: करेट m. (-टः) A finger nail. E. कर, and इट to go, अच् aff.
9219: करेटु mf. (-टुः) The numidian crane. E. क for कुत् bad, or क water, and रेट to sound, उ aff.
9220: करेणु mf. (-णुः) A male or female elephant. m. (-णुः) A plant: see कर्णिकार. E. कृ to do, &c. ण्णु Uṇādi affix; also with a final long vowel, करेणू.
9221: करेणुभू m. (-भूः) The name of a Muni or saint; also पालकाप्य.
9222: करेणुवर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A large or powerful elephant. E. करेणु, and वर्य्य excellent.
9223: करेणुसुत m. (-तः) The name of a Muni.
9224: करेणू mf. (-णूः) A male or female elephant: see करेणु.
9226: करोट mf. (-टः or टी) The bones of the head, the scull. E. क the head, रुट to oppose, to defend, &c. affixes अच् and इन् or ङीष्.
9227: करोत्कर m. (-रः) 1 A bundle of rags. 2 A heavy tax. E. कर, and उत्कर plenty.
9228: करोदक n. (-कं) Water held in, or poured into the hand. E. कर, and उदक water.
9229: कर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं) 1 White. 2 Good, excellent. m. (-र्कः) 1 A white horse. 2 A mirror. 3 A water jar. 4 A crab. 5 A sign of the zodiac, (Cancer.) 6 Fire. 7 A long gourd. 8 Beauty. E. कृ to do, &c. कः Uṇādi aff.
9230: कर्कचिर्भिटी f. (-टी) A small cucumber. E. कर्क, and चिर्भिटी the same.
9231: कर्कट m. (-टः) 1 A crab. 2 The sign of the zodiac, (Cancer.) 3 A kind of bird, the numidian crane. 4 A long gourd: see तुम्बी. 5 The fibrous root of the lotus. 6 The curved end of the beam of a balance, to which the strings supporting the scale are attached. 7 A compass. 8 The radius of a circle. f. (-टा) A plant, commonly Kurkavali, (Momordica mixta.) (-टी) 1 A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus, Rox.) 2 The fruit of the silk cotton tree. 3 A snake. 4 A water jar. E. कर्क a Sautra root, to laugh or smile, and अटन् affix, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
9232: कर्कटक m. (-कः) A crab. E. कन् added to the preceding.
9233: कर्कटशृङ्गिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Kāṅkarasriṅgī: see the next.
9234: कर्कटशृङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, the fruit of which is compared to the claw or feelers or a crab, the horn of a goat, &c. see अजशृङ्गी. E. कर्कट, शृङ्ग a horn, इनि and ङीष् affixes.
9235: कर्कटाख्या f. (-ख्या) See the preceding. E. कर्कट, and आख्या an appellation.
9236: कर्कटि f. (-टिः) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus:) see कर्कट.
9238: कर्कन्धु mf. (-न्धुः-न्धूः) A tree, the jujube: see the next.
9239: कर्कन्धू mf. (-न्धूः) The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. कर्क excellent, धा to have, and कु Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ऊञ्.
9240: कर्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard, firm. n. (-रं) Stone, limestone. especially the nodule found in Bengal under the name of Kankar. m. (-रः) A mirror. f. (-री) A small water jar. E. कर्क beauty, from कर्क to smile, र from रा to give, fem. affix ङीष्.
9241: कर्कराक्ष m. (-क्षः) A wagtail. E. कर्कर a mirror, and अक्ष an eye: bright-eyed.
9242: कर्कराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A gallinule. E. कर्कर firm, and अङ्ग body.
9243: कर्कराटु m. (-टुः) A glance, a side look.
9244: कर्कराटुक m. (-कः) The numidian crane: see कर्करेटु.
9245: कर्करान्धक m. (-कः) A blind well, one of which the mouth is overgrown with grass, &c. so as to be hidden.
9246: कर्कराल mn. (-लः-लं) A curl, a ringlet.
9247: कर्करी f. (-री) A water jar with a spout.
9248: कर्करीका f. (-का) A small water jar. E. कॄ to scatter, in the reiterative form, and ईकः Uṇādi aff.
9249: कर्करेट n. (-टं) The hand curved as a claw or half moon, for the purpose of grasping any thing. E. कर्कर hard, firm, इट to go, to be, affix अप्.
9250: कर्करेटु mf. (-टुः) The numidian crane: see करेटु. E. कर्कश hard, &c. रेट to sound, deriv. irr.
9251: कर्कश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Violent. 2 Hard. 3 Intangible. 4 Cruel. 5 Unfeeling, unmerciful. 6 Harsh, unkind. 7 Miserly. m. (-शः) 1 A plant, commonly Sunda rocani, (Crinum?) 2 A kind of cassia, (Cassia esculenta.) 3 Sugar cane. 4 A sword, a scymitar. f. (-शी) Wild jujube; also कर्क्कशिका. E. कृ to injure, विच् affix, कश with the same meaning, and अच्, highly injurious: or कर्क्क a Sautra root, and शः aff.
9252: कर्कशच्छद m. (-दः) 1 A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 2 A kind of gourd, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. कर्कश hard, and छद a leaf.
9254: कर्कशवाक्य n. (-क्यं) Harsh or contumelious speech. E. कर्श, and वाक्य speech.
9255: कर्कसार n. (-रं) Flour or meal mixed with curds. E. कर्क, and सार essence.
9256: कर्कारु m. (-रुः) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.) E. कव white, ऋ to go, or to be, उण् affix; also कर्कारु.
9257: कर्कारुक m. (-कः) A plant, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
9259: कर्क्केतर m. (-रः) A kind of gem or precious stone.
9260: कर्कोट m. (-टः) One of the principal serpents or Nāgas of Pātāla.
9261: कर्कोटक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Ægle marmelos:) see मालूर. 2 A Nāga or serpent: see the preceding. 3 A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia:) in this sense; also कर्कोटिका. 5 Sugar cane.
9262: कर्कोटकी f. (-की) A plant, a Ghosha with yellow flowers: see घोष.
9263: कर्घ r. 1st cl. (कर्घति) To go, to move.
9264: कर्चूर m. (-रः) A plant, (Curcuma reclinata, Rox.) n. (-रं) Gold: see कर्बूर.
9265: कर्चूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet:) see कर्बूरक.
9266: कर्ज r. 1st cl. (कर्जति) To pain or make uneasy.
9267: कर्ण r. 10th cl. (कर्णयति) To pierce or bore: with the prefix आङ्, समा, (सम् and आङ्) or उप, to hear or listen.
9268: कर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The ear. 2 KARṆA a prince, sovereign of Aṅgadeśa, and elder brother, by the mother's side, to the Pāṇḍu princes, being the son of SŪRYA by KUNTĪ, before her marriage with PĀṆḌU. 3 The helm or rudder of a vessel. 4 (In prosody,) A spondee, a foot of two long syllables. 5 (In geometry,) The hypothenuse of a triangle, or the diagonal of a tetragon. 6 A plant, (Cassia fistula.) 7 A kind of swallow wort, (Colotropis gigantea.) E. कर्ण to hear, घञ् affix; or कृ do, &c. न Uṇādi aff.
9269: कर्णकण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) Itching of the ear. E. कर्ण, and कण्डु itching.
9270: कर्णकीटी f. (-टी) 1 An insect or worm with many feet, and of a reddish colour, (Julus cornifex.) 2 A small centipede. E. कर्ण the ear, and कीट an insect, being supposed to attack the ear especially.
9271: कर्णक्ष्वेड m. (-डः) An affection of the ear, a roaring or constant noise in it. E. कर्ण, and क्ष्वेड a buzzing in the ear.
9272: कर्णग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Hanging on the ear, next to the ear. 2 Extending to the ear. E. कर्ण, and ग what goes.
9273: कर्णगूथ m. (-थः) The wax of the ear. E. कर्ण, and गूथ foeces, excrement.
9274: कर्णगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Capable of being heard, perceptible to the ear. E. कर्ण, and गोचर perceptible.
9275: कर्णग्राह m. (-हः) A helmsman. E. कर्ण, and ग्राह who holds.
9276: कर्णग्राहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a helmsman. E. कर्णग्राह, and मतुप् aff.
9277: कर्णछिद्र n. (-द्रं) The outer auditory passage. E. कर्ण, and छिद्र hole.
9278: कर्णजप m. (-पः) An informer. E. कर्ण, and जप who whispers; also कर्णेजप.
9279: कर्णजलूका f. (-का) 1 An insect, (Julus.) 2 A small centipede: see कर्णकीटी. E. कर्ण; and जलूका a leech.
9280: कर्णजलौकस् f. (-काः) A worm: see the preceding; also कर्णजलौका.
9281: कर्णजलौका f. (-का) A kind of insect, (Julus cornifex, &c.) 2 A small centipede; also कर्णजलौकस् and कर्णजलूका.
9282: कर्णजाह n. (-हं) The root of the ear. E. कर्ण, and जाह affix in this sense.
9283: कर्णजित् m. (-जित्) A title of ARJUNA. E. कर्ण, and जित् conqueror; KARṆA. having taken the part of the Kurus, was killed by ARJUNA in the great battle between them and the Pāṇḍus.
9284: कर्णताल m. (-लः) The flapping of an elephant's ears. E. कण, and ताल tune.
9285: कर्णदर्पण m. (-णः) An ear-ring, an ornament of the ear. E. कर्ण, and दर्पण a mirror.
9286: कर्णदुन्दुभि f. (-भिः) A kind of worm: see कर्णकीटी. E. कर्ण, and दुन्दुभि a sort of drum; making a noise in the ear like a drum.
9287: कर्णधार m. (-रः) A pilot, a helmsman. E. कर्ण the helm, धृञ् to have or hold, and अण् aff.
9288: कर्णनाद m. (-दः) Ringing in the ear. E. कर्ण, and नाद sound.
9289: कर्णन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A woman's ear-ring: see कर्णान्दु and कर्णेन्दु.
9290: कर्णपाक m. (-कः) Inflammation of the outer ear. E. कर्ण, and पाक ripening.
9291: कर्णपाली f. (-ली) An ornament of the ear, a garland or string of jewels pendent from it. E. कर्ण, and पाल to cherish.
9292: कर्णपुर m. (-रः) The capital of KARṆA, the ancient name of Bhāgalpur. E. कर्ण, and पुर city; also कर्णपुर् f. (-पूः)
9293: कर्णपूर m. (-रः) 1 A tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) 2 The blue lotus. 3 An ear-ring. 4 The Asoka tree. E. कर्ण, and पूर to make full, to complete.
9294: कर्णपूरक m. (-कः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.) E. कर्णपूर an ear-ring, and कन् resembling, like the large round drop or pendant of a Hindustani ear-ring.
9295: कर्णप्रतिनाह m. (-हः) A disease of the ear, suppression of the excretion or wax, which is supposed to have dissolved and pass by the nose and mouth. E. कर्ण, and प्रतिनाह suppression.
9296: कर्णफल m. (-लः) A sort of fish, (Ophiocephalus kurrawey.) E. कर्ण, and फल fruit.
9297: कर्णमद्गुर m. (-रः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus unitus.) E. कर्ण, and मद्गुर a sheat fish.
9298: कर्णमल m. (-लः) The excretion or wax of the ear. E. कण, and मल dirt.
9299: कर्णमुकुर m. (-रः) 1 An ornament of the ear. 2 An ear-ring. E. कर्ण, and मुकुर a mirror; reflecting its beauty.
9300: कर्णमोटी f. (-टी) A name of DEVĪ or DURGĀ in one of her forms or incarnations. E. कर्ण the ear, मुठ to rub, घञ् and ङीप् affixes; this is sometimes written कर्णमोटि.
9301: कर्णलतिका f. (-का) The lobe of the ear. E. कर्ण, लता a creeping plant, कन् added.
9302: कर्णवंश m. (-शः) An elevated platform. E. कर्ण, and वंश a bamboo.
9303: कर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having ears. 2 Long eared. 3 Having a helm. E. कर्ण and मतुप् aff.
9304: कर्णवर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Earless. m. (-तः) A snake. E. कर्ण, and वर्जित deprived.
9305: कर्णविद्रधि f. (-धिः) Ulceration of the ear. E. कर्ण, and विद्रधि a sore.
9306: कर्णवेध m. (-धः) 1 Boring the ears: as a religious ceremony it is performed where there are three sons, to prevent one of them from dying. 2 Piercing the ear in general. E. कर्ण, and वेध piercing.
9307: कर्णवेधनिका f. (-का) An instrument for perforating the ear. E. कर्ण, विध to pierce, ल्युट् and ङीष् affixes, with कन् added, and the fem. termination टाप्.
9309: कर्णवेष्टक n. (-कं) An ear-ring: see the next.
9310: कर्णवेष्टन n. (-नं) An ear-ring. E. कर्ण, and वेष्टन surrounding.
9311: कर्णशष्कुली f. (-ली) The outer part of the ear, the cartilage and depressions leading to the auditory passage. E. कर्ण, and शष्कुल the hollows of the ear.
9312: कर्णशूल n. (-लं) Ear-ache. E. कर्ण, and शूल pain.
9313: कर्णश्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Audible, loud. E. कर्ण, and श्रव hearing.
9314: कर्णसंस्राव m. (-वः) Discharge of pus from the ear. E. कर्ण, and संस्राव suppuration.
9315: कर्णस्राव m. (-वः) Discharge of ichorous matter from the ear. E. कर्ण, and स्राव running.
9316: कर्णस्फोटा f. (-टा) A sort of creeper. E. कर्ण, and स्फोट a boil.
9317: कर्णाट m. (-टः) A country, Karṇāṭa, whence the modern Karnatic: the name however was anciently applied to the central districts of the peninsula, including Mysūr. f. (-टी) 1 One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes, the bride of the Rāga MĀLAVA. 2 A plant. E. कर्ण the ear, a prince, &c. and अट to go, affix अच्.
9318: कर्णानुज m. (-जः) A name of Yudhiṣṭhira, the elder brother of the five Pāṇḍu princes. E. कर्ण, and अनुज younger born; the younger brother of KARṆA.
9319: कर्णान्तिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Near or close to the ear. E. कर्ण, and अन्तिक near.
9320: कर्णान्दु f. (-न्दुः) 1 An ornament of the ear. 2 An ear-ring: see the next, and कर्णेन्दु.
9321: कर्णान्दू f. (-न्दूः) An ornament of the ear, an ear-ring, &c. E. कर्ण, and अन्दू a chain.
9322: कर्णारा f. (-रा) An instrument for perforating the ear. E. कर्ण the ear, ऋ to go, अच् and टाप् affs.
9323: कर्णारि m. (-रिः) A name of ARJUNA. E. कर्ण, and अरि an enemy.
9324: कर्णालङ्कार m. (-रः) An ear-ring, an ornament of the ear. E. कर्ण and अलङ्कार ornament; also कर्णालङ्किया, कर्णालङ्कृति, &c.
9325: कर्णास्फाल m. (-लः) The flapping of an elephant's ear. E. कर्ण, and आस्फाल with the same import.
9326: कर्णिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Having large or long ears. 2 Having ears. 3 Having a helm. m. (कः-) A steersman. f. (-का) 1 An ear-ring or ornament of the ear. 2 The pericarp of a lotus. 3 The middle finger. 4 The tip of an elephant's trunk. 5 A fruit stalk. 6 A pen or small brush. 7 A plant, (Premna spinosa, &c.) see अग्निमन्थ. E. कर्णं the ear, &c. इक affix; or कन् and टाप् aff.
9327: कर्णिकाचल m. (-लः) The fabulous mountain Sumeru. E. कर्णिका the seed vessel of a lotus, and अचल a mountain, Meru being in the centre of the world, the divisions of which are delineated as the leaves of a lotus; also other compounds, as कर्णिकाद्रि, &c.
9328: कर्णिकार m. (-रः) 1 The name of a tree, commonly Kaniyar, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) 2 A sort of Cassia, (Cassia fistula.) 3 The pericarp of a lotus. E. कर्णिका an ornament of the ear, ऋ to go, अण् affix; also with कन् added कर्णिकारक.
9329: कर्णिकिन् m. (-की) An elephant. E. कर्णिका the tip of his trunk, and इनि aff.
9330: कर्णिन् mfn. (-र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) 1 Having an ear, relating to the ear, &c. 2 Long eared. 3 Barbed, (as an arrow.) 4 Having a helm. m. (-र्णी) 1 The name of a mountain, one of the seven principal ranges of the mountains, dividing the universe. 2 The side of the neck, the part near the ear. 3 A steersman. f. (-णिनी) A disease of the uterus, prolapsus or polypus uteri. E. कर्ण, and इनि aff.
9331: कर्णिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Long eared. E. कर्ण and इलच् aff.
9332: कर्णीरथ mf. (-थः-था) A covered car, or according to some, a litter for the conveyance of women, &c. borne on men's shoulders. E. कर्णी the part near the ear, and रथ a carriage.
9333: कर्णीसुत m. (-तः) A name of KAṂSA the enemy of KṚṢṆA. E. कर्णी the mother of this prince, and मुत a son.
9334: कर्णेजप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) An informer, a tale bearer. E. कर्णे in the ear, and जप to recite in a low voice, अच् aff.
9335: कर्णेन्दु f. (-न्दुः) 1 A semicircular ornament of the ear. 2 An earring. E. कर्ण, and इन्दु the moon, a crescent, &c. see कर्णान्द.
9336: कर्त्त r. 10th cl. (कर्त्तयति) To slacken or unloose, to remove; also कत्र and कर्त्र.
9337: कर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting, cutting off or in pieces. 2 Spinning cotton or thread. f. (-नी) Scissors. E. कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.
9338: कर्त्तरिका f. (-का) 1 A knife. 2 A small sword or cutlass. 3 A hunter's knife or sword, a couteau de chasse. 4 A scissors. E. कर्त्तरी, and कन् added.
9339: कर्त्तरी f. (-री) 1 A scissors or shears. 2 A knife. 3 A small sword or cutlass. E. कृत to cut, अरन् affix, and ङीप् fem. do.
9340: कर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be done or made. 2 What ought to be done. E. कृ to make, तव्य aff.
9341: कर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Necessity, obligation, propriety, fitness. E. कत्तव्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix कर्त्तव्यत्वं.
9342: कर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, cut off. E. कृत to cut, क्त aff.
9343: कर्त्तिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Intending or wishing to cut. E. कृत to cut, शतृ affix of the future participle; also कर्त्तिष्यमाण (-णः-णा-णं) with शानच् aff.
9344: कर्त्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous or intending to do. E. कत्तुम् to do, काम desire, the final of the first rejected.
9345: कर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) 1 An agent, a doer, a maker, one who makes or does. 2 One who practices what he knows. m. (-र्त्ता) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 (In grammar,) The active noun, the nominative case. E. कृ to do, and तृच् affix: it may also be read कर्त्तृ.
9346: कर्त्तृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) An agent, one who does any thing. E. कन् added to the last.
9347: कर्त्तृकत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, action. E. कर्त्तृक and त्व aff.
9348: कर्त्तृका f. (-का) A small sword. E. कृत to cut, कृन् aff.
9349: कर्त्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Agency, the act or property of an agent. E. कर्त्तृ, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix कर्त्तृता.
9350: कर्त्तृवाच्य m. (-च्यः) (In grammar,) The active voice. E. कर्त्तृ agent, and वाच्य to be said.
9351: कर्त्र r. 10th cl. (कर्त्रयति) To unloose, to remove: see कर्त्त.
9352: कर्त्री f. (-र्त्री) A scissors. E. कृत to cut, तृच् and ङीष् affs.
9353: कर्द r. 1st cl. (कर्दति) To grumble, as the bowels; to caw as a crow; or to make any such noise.
9354: कर्द m. (-र्दः) Mud, clay. E. कर्द to sound ill, अच् aff.
9355: कर्दट m. (-टः) 1 The fibrous root of the lotus. 2 Mud, dirt. 2 Any aquatic weed, as Vallisneria, &c. E. कर्द mud, and अट what goes.
9356: कर्दन n. (-नं) Grumbling of the bowels, borborygmi. E. कर्द to make such a noise, and ल्युट् aff.
9357: कर्दम m. (-मः) 1 Mud, mire, clay. 2 Sin. 3 A Prajāpati, the son of BRAHMĀ by CHĀYĀ, and he father of Kapila: (this personage appears to be an innovation in Hindu mythology.) f. (-मी) A plant. n. (-मं) Flesh. E. कर्द to sound badly, and अम Uṇādi aff.
9358: कर्दमाटक m. (-कः) A receptacle for filth, a sewer, a necessary. E. कर्दम filth, अट to go, and वुन् aff.
9359: कर्पट m. (-टः) Old and patched or ragged garments. E. कृप to be able, and अटन् aff.
9360: कर्पटधारिन् m. (री) A religious mendicant, a Fakir, a beggar in patched or ragged clothes, or sometimes with merely a cloth to cover the privities. E. कर्पट as above, धृ to have, and णिनि affix; also कर्पटिक and कर्पटिन्.
9362: कर्पटिन् m. (-टी) See कर्पटधारिन्. This and the two preceding words may also be used in three genders, meaning, beggar in general, or any one in beggarly raiment.
9363: कर्पर m. (-रः) 1 The skull, the cranium. 2 An iron saucepan or frying pan. 3 A kind of weapon. 4 The Glomerous fig tree: see उडुम्बर. f. (-री) A collyrium extracted from the Amomum authorhiza, Rox. E. कृप to be able, अरन् aff.
9364: कर्पराल m. (-लः) A tree, described as a Pīlu growing in the hills. E. कर्पर the skull, &c. and अल to adorn, अण् aff.
9365: कर्पराश m. (-शः) Sand, gravel, a sandy soil.
9366: कर्परिकातुत्थ n. (-त्थं) A collyrium extracted from the Amomum authorhiza: see कर्परा. E. कर्परिका for कर्परी, and तुत्थ any collyrium.
9367: कर्पास mn. (-सः-सं) Cotton. f. (-सी) The cotton tree; also कार्पासी. E. कृ to do, &c. पास Uṇādi aff.
9368: कर्पूर mn. (-रः-रं) Camphor. E. कृप to be able, ऊरः Uṇādi aff.
9369: कर्पूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet, Rox.) see कर्ब्बूरक and कचूरक.
9370: कर्पूरतिलका f. (-का) One of DURGĀ'S female attendants or confidantes: see जया. E. कर्पूर camphor, and तिलक the sectarial spot on the forehead; having the Tilaka of camphor.
9371: कर्प्पूरतैल n. (-लं) Camphor liniment. E. कर्प्पूर, and तैल oil.
9372: कर्प्पूरनालिका f. (-का) Rice dressed with spices, camphor and ghee.
9373: कर्प्पूरमणि m. (-णिः) A white mineral used medicinally. E. कर्प्पूर, and मणि a gem.
9375: कर्ब r. 1st cl. (कर्बति) To go, to move or approach.
9377: कर्बुदार m. (-रः) 1 Mountain ebony: see कोबिदार. 2 Blue barleria: see नीलझिण्टी.
9378: कर्बुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Variegated, of a spotted or variegated color. f. (-रा) 1 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 A sort of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum:) see वर्वरा. f. (-री) A name of the goddess DURGĀ. n. (-रं) 1 Gold. 2 Water. 3 Datura, (the fruit.) (-रः) 1 A demon, an imp or goblin. 2 A variegated colour. 3 A plant, (Curcuma reclinata, Rox.) see शठी. 4 Sin. 5 Rice growing amidst inundation. E. कब to tinge or dye, उरच् Uṇādi affix and र inserted, or कर्ब to go, &c. and उरन् affix, also long, कर्बुर; it is also often read with the dental ब, but perhaps erroneously.
9379: कर्बूर mn. (-रः-रं) Gold. m. (-रः) 1 A species of curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.) 2 Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) 3 A demon. f. (-रा) A leech. n. (-रं) Yellow orpiment, see कर्बुर and कर्बूरक.
9380: कर्बूरक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet, Rox.) E. कन् added to the preceding: also कचूरक.
9381: कर्ब्बूरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated, many coloured. E. कर्ब्बूर, and इतच् aff.
9382: कर्म्म mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं) Act, action; see कर्म्मन्.
9383: कर्म्मकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 A hired laborer. 2 A servant of any kind, (as a pupil, &c.) not a slave. 3 An agent, any one who does work or business. m. (-रः) A name of YAMA, regent of the dead. f. (-री) 1 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides:) see मूर्व्वा. 2 Bryonia grandis: see निम्बिका. 3 A female servant or slave. E. कर्म्म work, act, and कर who does or performs; also कर्म्मकार.
9384: कर्म्मकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 A worker, one who does any business, an artisan, a mechanic. 2 One who performs any act. m. (-रः) A blacksmith, one of the progeny of the divine artist VIŚVAKARMA. 2 A bull. E. कर्म्म an act, कृञ् to perform, affix अण्.
9385: कर्म्मकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who does any work, one who performs any act. E. कर्म्म, and कारक who does.
9386: कर्म्मकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Working, doing any work, who performs any act. E. कर्म्म, and कारिन् who does.
9387: कर्म्मकार्म्मुक m. (-कः) A strong bow. E. कर्म्म used to action, कार्म्मुक a bow.
9389: कर्म्मकृत् mfn. (-त) 1 Having done work. 2 A workman, an artisan. E. कर्म्म, and कृत् who does.
9390: कर्म्मकृतवत् m. (-वान्) The director of a religious rite, the reciter of the Mantras or formula. E. कर्म्म, and कृतवत् doing.
9391: कर्म्मक्षम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Competent to an act. E. कर्म्म, and क्षम to be patient, अच् aff.
9392: कर्म्मचेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Active exertion, action. E. कर्म्म, and चेष्टा effort.
9393: कर्म्मचोदना f. (-ना) The object of acts, the inducement, to ritual acts, or the combination of knowledge, the thing to be known, and the person who acquires knowledge. E. कर्म्म, and चोदना impelling.
9394: कर्म्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Resulting from or produced by any act, especially religious or moral, or unrighteous or immoral actions. m. (-जः) The Kali-yug or fourth and present age of the world, the age of iniquity. 2 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. कर्म्म, and ज produced.
9395: कर्म्मजगुण m. (-णः) A predicate or property resulting from human acts, as separation, reunion, &c. E. कर्म्मज, and गुण quality.
9396: कर्म्मज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Skilled in any work. 2 Acquainted with religious rites. E. कर्म्म, and ज्ञ who knows.
9397: कर्म्मठ mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं) 1 Finishing carefully. 2 Accomplishing any rite. m. (-ठः) The director and performer of a sacrifice. E. कर्म्म, and ठच् aff.
9398: कर्म्मणिवाच्य m. (-च्यः) The passive voice, (in grammar.) E. कर्म्मणि in the act or object, and वाच्य to be said.
9399: कर्म्मण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Proper to any act, suitable to or fit for it. f. (-ण्या) Wages, hire. n. (-ण्यं) Energy, activity. E. कर्म्मन् and यत् aff.
9400: कर्म्मण्यभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Working for hire. E. कर्म्मण्य wages, and भुज to eat, affix क्विप्: see भरण्यभुज्.
9401: कर्म्मत्याग m. (-गः) Abandonment of worldly duties or ceremonial rites. E. कर्म्म, and त्याग abandonment.
9402: कर्म्मत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Acts, action, the active discharge of the duties and functions of life. 2 Any act. E. कर्म्म, and त्व affix; also with तल्, कर्म्मता.
9403: कर्म्मदुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Following wicked or degrading practices, immoral, disreputable. E. कर्म्म, and दुष्ट defiled.
9404: कर्म्मदोष m. (-षः) 1 Error, blunder. 2 Sin, vice. 3 The evil consequence of human acts. 4 Discreditable conduct or business. E. कर्म्म, and दोष fault.
9405: कर्म्मध्वंस m. (-सः) 1 Loss of benefits arising from religious acts. 2 Destruction of any work. 3 Disappointment. E. कर्म्म, and ध्वंस loss.
9406: कर्म्मन् mn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Action in general. 2 The object of an action. 3 The subject of action in grammar, considered of three kinds, प्राप्य or व्याप्य when it is simple, as ग्रामं गच्छति he goes to the village; सूर्य्यं पश्यति he sees the sun; विकार्य्य when change of form is implied, as सुवर्णं कुण्डलं करोति gold forms the ear-ring; and निर्वर्त्य when some new product is evolved, as कटं करोति he makes a mat; पुत्रं प्रसूते she bears a son. 4 The objective noun. 5 Action specific, moral duty, the obligation imposed by peculiarities of tribe, occupation, &c. 6 Natural, active property, as maturity, of heat; support, of earth; dispersion, of wind, &c. 7 Religious action, as sacrifice, ablution, &c. especially as originating in the hope of future recompense, and as opposed to speculative religion or knowledge of spirit. 8 (In Logic,) Substantial action or motion of five kinds, upwards, downwards, extension, contraction, and going in general. 9 Action or act involving retribution or reward, virtue, vice, &c. 10 Fate, the certain consequence of previous acts. E. कृञ् to do, मनिन् aff.
9407: कर्म्मनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Engaged in active duties. m. (-ष्ठः) A Brahman who performs sacrifices, &c. E. कर्म्म, and निष्ठ who stays in.
9408: कर्म्मन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) The beggar, the religious mendicant, the member of the fourth order; see आश्रम, &c. E. कर्म्म work, अन्द to abandon, or कर्म्मन्द the name of a saint, the founder of the sect, and इनि aff.
9409: कर्म्मफल n. (-लं) 1 Pain, pleasure, &c. considered as the consequence or fruit of human actions. 2 The name of a fruit: see कर्म्मरङ्ग. E. कर्म्म, and फल fruit.
9410: कर्म्मफलोदय m. (-यः) The occurrence of consequences. E. कर्म्मफल, and उदय rising.
9411: कर्म्मबन्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bound by acts. n. (-नं) Confinement to repeated existence, as the consequence of acts. E. कर्म्म, and बन्धन binding.
9412: कर्म्मभू f. (-भूः) Tilled or cultivated ground. E. कर्म्म, and भू earth, ground, &c. it may also mean the same as the next word.
9413: कर्म्मभूमि f. (-मिः) Aryavarta or the central part of India, Bharata Varṣa, the whole of India, or any similar place considered as holy land. E. कर्म्म, and भूमि earth: where men perform the ceremonies of the Hindu faith.
9414: कर्म्ममूल n. (-लं) Kuśa or sacrificial grass; see कुश. E. कर्म्म, and मूल a root: it being used in many religious and essential Karmas or sacred rites.
9415: कर्म्मयुग m. (-गः) The fourth and present age of the world, the iron age, the Kali-yug: see कलि, and above, कर्म्मज. E. कर्म्म, and युग a Yuga or age.
9416: कर्म्मयोग m. (-गः) 1 Performance of worldly functions or duties. 2 The same, considered as equivalent to a religious duty. 3 Active exertion, industry. E. कर्म्म, and योग union or observances.
9417: कर्म्मरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A plant bearing an acid fruit, (Averhoa carambola.)
9418: कर्म्मरी f. (-री) The manna of the bamboo.
9419: कर्म्मवज्र m. (-ज्रः) A Śūdra. E. कर्म्म, and वज्र the thunderbolt.
9420: कर्म्मवश m. (-शः) 1 The necessary influence of acts. 2 Fate, considered as the inevitable consequence of actions done in a former life. E. कर्म्म, and वश subjection.
