9421: कर्म्मवाटी f. (-टी) A lunar day, or the 30th division of a lunar month. E. कर्म्म, and वाटी a road, &c. regulating all ceremonies and observances, &c.
9422: कर्म्मविघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Impediment, obstruction. E. कर्म्म, and विघ्न hindrance.
9423: कर्म्मविधि f. (-धिः) 1 Rule of action, observance, practice. 2 Mode of conducting any ceremony. E. कर्म्म, and विधि precept; also कर्म्मविधान.
9424: कर्म्मविपर्य्यय m. (-यः) Succession of office or employment, revolving or alternating duty. 2 Contrariety or reverse of any act or business. E. कर्म्म, and विपर्य्यय contrariety.
9425: कर्म्मविपाक m. (-कः) 1 Future reward or punishment, the consequence of human acts in a subsequent birth. 2 A work on this subject, explaining expiatory rites to be performed in cases of disease, &c. supposed to be the punishment of offences in a previous existence. E. कर्म्म, and विपाक, maturity.
9426: कर्म्मविशेष m. (-षः) Variety of act or actions. E. कर्म्म, and विशेष difference.
9427: कर्म्मशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Assiduous, laborious. 2 One who perseveres in his duties without looking forward to their reward. E. कर्म्म, and शील attached.
9428: कर्म्मशुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Approved occupation. E. कर्म्म, and शुद्ध pure, correct.
9429: कर्म्मशूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Assiduous, laborious. E. कर्म्म, and शूर dexterous, able.
9430: कर्म्मशौच m. (-चः-चा-चं) Humility. E. कर्म्म and शौच purity.
9431: कर्म्मसंग्रह m. (-हः) Collective acts, comprising the act, its performance, and the performer. E. कर्म्म, and संग्रह assemblage.
9432: कर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A minister, a subordinate one employed upon active duties, as a judge, a deputy, &c. E. कर्म्म, and सचिव an adviser, a friend.
9433: कर्म्मसन्न्यासिक m. (-कः) An ascetic, a religious person who has withdrawn from the world. E. कर्म्म, and सन्न्यासिक a Sannyāsī or religious mendicant.
9434: कर्म्मसमाधि m. (-धिः) Devotion, abstraction. E. कर्म्म, and समाधि abstraction.
9435: कर्म्मसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by, or the consequence of acts. E. कर्म्म, and सम्भव born.
9436: कर्म्मसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) The sun. E. कर्म्म, and साक्षिन् an evidence; who beholds all deeds.
9437: कर्म्मसाधन n. (-नं) 1 Implement, means. 2 Articles essential to the performance of a religious act. E. कर्म्म, and साधन means of effecting.
9438: कर्म्मसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Success, accomplishment. E. कर्म्म, and सिद्धि completion.
9439: कर्म्महेतु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Arising from acts, caused by acts. E. कर्म्म, and हेतु cause; also with कन् added कर्म्महेतुक.
9440: कर्म्माङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Part or progress of any act. 2 Part of a sacrificial rite. E. कर्म्म, and अङ्ग member.
9441: कर्म्मात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Endowed with principles of action, active, acting. E. कर्म्म, and आत्मन् self.
9442: कर्म्मानुबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Connexion with or dependance upon acts. E. कर्म्म, and अनुबन्ध attachment.
9443: कर्म्मानुबन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Connected or confined by works. E. कर्म्म, and अनुबन्धिन् what connects.
9444: कर्म्मानुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 According to action or act. 2 According to function or duty. E. कर्म्म, and अनुरूप according to.
9445: कर्म्मानुरूपतस् ind. Conformably to act, function, &c. E. तसि added to the last.
9446: कर्म्मानुष्ठान n. (-नं) Practising one's duties, discharging peculiar functions. E. कर्म्म, and अनुष्ठान following.
9447: कर्म्मानुसार m. (-रः) Consequence of or conformity to acts. E. कर्म्म, and अनुसार consequence.
9448: कर्म्मानुसारतस् ind. According to one's deeds. E. कर्म्म, and अनुसार conformity, तसि aff.
9449: कर्म्मानुस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Practising duties, performing rites, &c. E. कर्म्म, and अनुस्थायिन् following.
9450: कर्म्मान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Tilled or cultivated land. 2 The end or abandonment of ritual acts. 3 The end of any task or act. E. कर्म्म, and अन्त an end or limit.
9451: कर्म्मान्तर n. (-रं) Difference or contrariety of action, re-action. 2 Penance, expiation. 3 Suspense, interval of action. E. कर्म्म, and अन्तर difference, &c.
9452: कर्म्मान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Final, completing. m. (-कः) A servant, one who finishes work. E. कर्म्मान्त, and ठक् aff.
9453: कर्म्माभिधायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Enjoining, or prescribing duties or acts. E. कर्म्म, and अभिधायक what shows; also कर्म्माभिधायिन्.
9454: कर्म्मार m. (-रः) 1 An artificer, a mechanic, a blacksmith, a brazier, a carpenter, &c. 2 A bamboo. 3 An acid fruit: see कर्म्मरङ्ग. E. कर्म्म, ऋ to go, घञ् aff.
9455: कर्म्मारम्भ m. (-म्मः) Commencement of any act. E. कर्म्म, and आरम्भ beginning.
9456: कर्म्मार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 1 Fit for work, able to do any thing. 2 Suitable to any rite, &c. m. (-र्हः) A man. E. कर्म्म, and अर्ह fit for.
9457: कर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) 1 Busy, active, engaged in any work. 2 Belonging or relating to any act. E. कर्म्म, and इनि aff.
9458: कर्म्मिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Active, assiduous, diligent. E. कर्म्म, and इष्ठन् aff.
9460: कर्म्मीरक m. (-कः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera.)
9461: कर्म्मेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of action; five are reckoned, the hand, the foot, the larynx or organ of the voice, the organ of generation, and that of fœculent excretion. E. कर्म्म, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
9462: कर्म्मोदार n. (-रं) Any honourable or valiant act, magnanimity, prowess. E. कर्म्म, and उदार lofty.
9463: कर्म्मोद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Actively labouring, busily engaged. E. कर्म्म, and उद्युक्त exerting.
9464: कर्म्मोद्योग m. (-गः) Engaging actively in any work. E. कर्म्म, and उद्योग effort.
9465: कर्व r. 1st cl. (कर्वति) To be proud, to boast.
9466: कर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) 1 Love, desire. 2 A rat. E. कृ to injure, and व Uṇādi aff.
9467: कर्व्वट m. (-टः-टं) 1 The capital of a district, (of two or four hundred villages,) in a pleasant site and of handsome construction, a market town, &c. n. (-टं) A city. E. कर्व to be proud, and अटच् aff.
9468: कर्व्वर m. (-रः) 1 A demon or imp. 2 A tiger. f. (-री) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 The leaf of the asafoetida plant: see हिङ्गुपत्री. E. कृ to injure, क्करच् Uṇādi affix; if derived from कर्व्व to go, &c. this word is read कर्व्वर, but such a reading is probably inaccurate: see कर्व्वर, also कर्व्वुर; it is sometimes considered as a various reading of this last, meaning, variegated.
9469: कर्ष mn. (-र्षः-र्षं) A weight of gold or silver, a Karṣa equal to sixteen Māṣas; this, according to the ancient division of five Rattis to the Māṣa, would make the Karṣa equal to about 176 grains troy; in common use, eight Rattis are given to the Māṣa, and the Karṣa is therefore about 280 grains troy: see मास and रक्तिक. m. (-षः) 1 Drawing, dragging, pulling. 2 Ploughing. 3 Attracting. 4 Beleric myrobalan: see विभीतक. E. कृष to plough, अच् aff.
9470: कर्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A cultivator of the soil, one who lives by tillage. 2 What draws or drags. 3 Attractive, what attracts. E. कृष to plough, वुन् aff.
9471: कर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Ploughing, cultivating the ground. 2 Pulling. dragging. 3 Attracting. E. कृष to plough, ल्युट् aff.
9472: कर्षणि f. (-णिः) A dishonest woman. E. कृष and अनि aff.
9473: कर्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be drawn or pulled. 2 To be attracted, to be conciliated or won. E. कृष to plough, with अनीयर् aff.
9474: कर्षफल m. (-लः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. कर्ष the same, and फल fruit.
9475: कर्षयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Dragging, pulling. 2 Attracting. 3 Harassing, annoying. E. कृष to attract, causal form, शतृ aff.
9476: कर्षाह्व n. (-ह्वं) A Tola, a weight of sixteen Māṣas. E. कर्ष, and आह्वा appellation.
9477: कर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drawn. 2 Attracted. 3 Ploughed. E. कृष to draw, क्त aff.
9478: कर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-षि) 1 What pulls or draws. 2 What ploughs or furrows. 3 Attractive, what attracts. f. (-णी) 1 A medicinal sort of moon plant: see क्षीरिणी. 2 The bit of a bridle. E. कृष to plough, &c. णिनि aff.
9479: कर्षू m. (-र्षूः) 1 A fire of dried cowdung. 2 Agriculture, cultivating, cultivation. 3 Livelihood. f. (-र्षूः) 1 A river. 2 A canal. 3 A shallow trench for receiving the sacrificial fire. E. कृष to plough, &c. Uṇādi affix ऊ.
9480: कर्हि ind. When, at what time.
9481: कर्हिचित् ind. Sometimes, occasionally, ever; नकर्हिचित् never.
9482: कल r. 1st cl. (कलति) To sound. 1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कालयति) To throw or cast, to send; also 1st and 10th cls. (कलति, कलयति) 1 To go. 2 To count or reckon: with आङ् prefixed, 1 To take. 2 To bind or tie; with परि, To keep in mind, to think or remember; with वि, To maim, to separate a part, to make defective; with सम, To sum up, to add.
9483: कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Crude, undigested. 2 Weak. m. (-लः) 1 A low or soft tone, as humming, buzzing, &c. 2 The Śāl tree. 3 In poetry, time equal to four mātras or instants. n. (-लं) 1 Semen virile. 2 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba) f. (-ला) 1 A small part of any thing. 2 A digit or one sixteenth of the moon's diameter. 3 A division of time, equal to thirty Kāṣas or about eight seconds. 4 The 60th part of one thirtieth of a zodiacal sign, a minute of a degree. 5 Interest on a capital. 6 Any practical art, mechanical or fine, sixty-four such are enumerated, as carpentering, architecture, jewellery, farriery, acting, dancing, music, medicine, poetry, &c. 7 The menstrual discharge. 8 A boat. 9 Fraud, deceit. E. कल to sound, to count, &c. (-अच्) affix; or क pleasure, and ल what gives, from ला to bring, &c.
9484: कलक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of fish: see शकुल. 2 Name of a species of prose composition. E. कल to count, &c. वुन् aff.
9485: कलकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A low murmuring tone. 2 The Indian cuckoo. 3 A dove, a pigeon. 4 A goose. E. कल a low tone, and कण्ठ the throat; in whose throat it is made.
9486: कलकल m. (-लः) 1 A confused noise, the murmuring or buzz of a crowd. 2 Resin, pitch, the resin of the Śāl tree. E. कल to sound, as above; the root reiterated.
9487: कलकूजिका f. (-का) A wanton, a lascivious woman. E. कल, and कूज to coo, affix क्वुन्.
9488: कलघोष m. (-षः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. कल, घुष to sound, and घञ् aff.
9489: कलङ्क m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A spot or mark. 2 Defamation, abuse. 3 The rust of iron. E. क BRAHMĀ, water, &c. लकि to deface, and घञ् aff.
9490: कलङ्ककर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Censorious, calumniating, defaming. 2 Spotting, staining. E. कलङ्क, and कर what makes.
9491: कलङ्ककला f. (-ला) A digit of the moon in shadow. E. कलङ्क, and कला a digit.
9492: कलङ्कमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Spotted, stained. 2 Calumniated, defamed. E. कलङ्क and मयट् aff.
9493: कलङ्कष m. (-षः) A lion. f. (-षा) A musical instrument: see करताली. E. कल a murmuring sound, and कष to make a sound, affix खच्.
9494: कलङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spotted, soiled, stained. 2 Calumniated, defamed. E. कलङ्क, and इतच् aff.
9495: कलङ्किन् mfn. (-ङ्की-ङ्किनी-ङ्कि) 1 Soiled, stained. 2 Disgraced, reviled. 3 Rusty. E. कलङ्क, and इनि aff.
9496: कलङ्कुर m. (-रः) An eddy, a whirlpool. E. कल a sound, and कुर to emit sound, क affix, and the termination of the 2nd case retained.
9497: कलञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) An animal struck with a poisoned weapon.
9498: कलट n. (-टं) The that of a house; other works read this कुटक q. v.
9499: कलता f. (-ता) Melody, music. E. कल, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कलत्वं.
9500: कलत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The hip and loins. 2 A wife. 3 A royal citadel, a strong hold or fastness. E. गड to distil, &c. अत्रच् affix, क is substituted for ग, and ड and ल are interchangeable: see कडत्र; or कल weak, feeble, and त्र, from त्रै to preserve, affix ड.
9501: कलधूत n. (-तं) 1 Gold. 2 Silver: see the next.
9502: कलधौत n. (-तं) 1 Gold. 2 Silver. 3 A low or pleasing tone; also कलधूत.
9503: कलधौतलिपि f. (-पिः) 1 A streak of gold. 2 Illumination of a manuscript with gold. E. कलधौत, and लिपि writing.
9504: कलध्वनि m. (-निः) 1 The turtle dove. 2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 3 A peacock. 4 A low sweet tone. E. कल, and ध्वनि a sound.
9505: कलन n. (-नं) 1 A spot, a stain. 2 An offence, fault, defect. 3 Murmuring, sounding. 4 An embryo or the first vestige of the foetus. m. (-नः) A sort of cane. f. (-ना) 1 Subjection, submission. 2 Chattering, talking. 3 Shedding, emitting. E. कल to count, ल्युट् aff.
9506: कलन्दर m. (-रः) A man of a mixed caste.
9507: कलन्दिका f. (-का) Knowledge, intelligence, wisdom in general.
9508: कलभ m. (-भः) 1 A young elephant: see कल. 2 The Datura plant. E. कल to cast, अभच् Uṇādi affix; or according to some authorities कृ to cast, अभच् affix, making करभ, and र is then changed to ल.
9509: कलम m. (-मः) 1 Rice which is sown in May and June, and ripens in December or January; a white rice growing in deep water: see शालि. 2 A pen, a reed for writing with. 3 A thief, a rogue. E. कल to count, &c. and अमः Uṇādi aff.
9510: कलम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 An arrow. 2 The stalk of a potherb. 3 The Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba:) see कदम्ब. n. (-म्बं) Calumba root, (Menispermum calumba.) f. (-म्बी) or m. and f. (-म्बः-म्बी) A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus repens, &c.) see कडम्बी. E. कड to delight, अम्बच् affix, ल substituted for ड, fem. affix ङीष्; also कलम्बक.
9511: कलम्बिका f. (-का) 1 A potherb: see the preceding. E. कन् added to कलम्बी. 2 The nape of the neck. E. क the head, and लबि to be, to rest, ण्वुल aff.
9513: कलम्बू f. (-म्बूः) A potherb: see कलम्बी the fem. affix being ऊञ्.
9514: कलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Computing, calculating. E. कल to count, शतृ aff.
9515: कलरव m. (-वः) 1 A dove, a pigeon. 2 The Indian cuckoo. 3 A low or pleasing tone, a humming, buzzing, &c. E. कल a low tone, and रव what utters.
9516: कलल mn. (-लः-लं) The womb, the uterus; according to some, the embryo one month after conception. E. कल to reckon, अलच् aff.
9517: कललज m. (-जः) Resin, the extract of the Śāl tree.
9518: कललजोद्भव m. (-वः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. कललज, and उद्भव birth.
9519: कलविङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A sparrow. 2 A plant, (Echites antidysenterica:) see कलिङ्कक. 3 A spot, a stain. 4 A white Chowri. E. कल a low tone, chirping, &c. वकि to go, &c. अच् affix, the deriv. is irr; also कलविङ्कक.
9520: कलश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) An earthen water pot; also कलस, कलशि, &c. E. क water, लश to labour, क aff.
9521: कलशि f. (-शिः) 1 A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.) 2 A water jar. E. क water, लश to labour, &c. कि affix; also कलशी and कलसि.
9522: कलशी f. (-शी) 1 A plant. 2 A water jar: see the preceding, and कलश.
9523: कलस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) A water jar: see कलश. m. (-सः) 1 A measure, a Droṇa: see द्रोण. 2 A rounded pinnacle or ball on the top of a temple. f. (-सी) A plant: see कलशि, &c.
9525: कलसीसुत m. (-तः) A name of the saint AGASTYA: see घटोद्भव and अगस्त्य.
9526: कलसोदधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. कलस, and उदधि the same.
9527: कलस्वर n. (-रं) A low musical sound. E. कल, and स्वर a note.
9528: कलह mn. (-हः-हं) 1 War, battle. 2 Strife, contention. m. (-हः) 1 The sheath of a sword, a scabbard. 2 A road, a way. 3 Deceit, falsehood. 4 Violence without murderous weapons, abuse, beating, kicking, &c. E. कल a pleasing sound, and ह what destroys, from हन with ड aff.
9529: कलहंस m. (-सः) 1 A drake, or according to some, a teal. 2 A gander. 3 Another bird, (Gallinula porphyria.) 4 BRAHM or the Supreme Being. 5 An emperor. 6 A species of the Atijagatī metre. E. कल pleasing sound, and हंस a goose.
9530: कलहकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Contending with, fighting. 2 Quarrelsome, turbulent. E. कलह, and कार who makes.
9531: कलहकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Assailing, contending or fighting with. 2 Quarrelsome, fractions, turbulent. E. कलह, and कारिन् who makes.
9533: कलहप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Quarrelsome. m. (-यः) NĀRADA. f. (-या) The Maina, a bird. E. कलह, and प्रिय fond of.
9534: कलहान्तरिता f. (-ता) An appeased wife, one who has been angry and is sorry for it. E. कलह strife, अन्तरित covered, &c. fem. affix टाप्.
9535: कलहापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken by force. E. कलह, and अपहृत taken away.
9537: कलाकुशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Skilled in the elegant arts; singing, dancing, &c. E. कला, and कुशल clever.
9538: कलाकेलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Gay, frolicsome, wanton. m. (-लिः) A name of KĀMA or love. E. कला deceit, and केलि who sports.
9539: कलाङ्कुर m. (-रः) 1 A crane. 2 A name of KAṂSA.
9540: कलाचिका f. (-का) The fore arm, the arm below the elbow; also कलाची.
9542: कलाद m. (-दः) A goldsmith: see कणाद. E. कला an art, and दा to give, ड aff.
9543: कलानिधि m. (-धिः) The moon. E. कला a digit, निधि a treasure; containing many digits.
9544: कलानुनादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A bee, but particularly one of a very large kind. 2 A sparrow. 3 The Cātaka, a bird so called. E. कल a buzz, &c. अनुनद to sound, णिनि aff.
9545: कलान्तर n. (-रं) Interest, profit. E. कला a part, अन्तर over.
9546: कलाप m. (-पः) 1 An ornament in general. 2 A zone, a string of bells worn by women round the wrist. 3 A peacock's tail. 4 Assemblage, multitude. 5 A quiver. 6 The moon. 7 A clever and intelligent man. 8 The name of a grammar of the Sanscrit language, ascribed to the god KĀRTTIKEYA. 9 A village where the destroyer KALKI is to be born. 10 A poem written in one metre. E. कला an art, a division of time, &c. आप to obtain, and अण् aff.
9547: कलापक m. (-कः) A rope on an elephant's neck. n. (-कं) 1 A number of verses in one metre. 2 A series of four stanzas on one subject. 3 A loan to be repaid when the peacocks spread their tails. E. कलाप and वुन् aff.
9548: कलापिन् m. (-पी) 1 A peacock. 2 The Indian cuckoo. 3 Waved leaf fig tree. 4 The author of the Kalāpa grammar. f. (-नी) 1 The moon. 2 A species of cyperus. E. कलाप a peacock's tail, &c. इनि aff.
9549: कलापूर्ण m. (-र्णः) The moon. E. कला a digit, and पूर्ण filled, complete.
9550: कलाभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 The moon. 2 An artist, a mechanic, &c. E. कला a digit, &c. and भृत् who cherishes.
9551: कलामक m. (-कः) A kind of rice ripening in the cold season: see कलम.
9552: कलाम्बि f. (-म्बिः) Lending, a loan: see the next.
9553: कलाम्बिका f. (-का) Lending, a loan. E. कल a part, and अम्ब to go, वुन् aff.
9554: कलाय m. (-यः) The name of various leguminous seeds, chiefly of the order Phaseolus, particular kinds of pulse or vetches. E. क wind, ला to bring or give, and युक् aff.
9555: कलायखञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) One who trembles and totters as he walks. E. कलाय, and खञ्ज a wagtail.
9556: कलायन m. (-नः) A tumbler, a dancer, but especially one who dances or walks on a sharp edge, as the edge of a sword, &c. E. कला a part, and अयन going.
9557: कलालाप m. (-पः) A bee, &c. E. कल buzz, and आलाप speech.
9558: कलावत् m. (-वान्) A name of Candra or the moon. f. (-ती) 1 A celestial lute or Vīṇā. 2 The mother of RĀDHĀ. 3 An Apsaras. 4 A mystical ceremony, initiation of the Tāntrika student, in which the goddess DURGĀ is supposed to be transferred from the water jar to the body of the novice. E. कला a digit, or कल a sweet tone, and मतुप् aff.
9560: कलाविकल m. (-लः) A sparrow: see कलविङ्क.
9561: कलाहक m. (-कः) A musical instrument; also काहल.
9562: कलि m. (-लिः) 1 The fourth age of the world, according to the Hindus; the iron age, or that of vice: the commencement of the Kali-yug or age, is placed 3,101 years anterior to the Christian aera, so that in A. D. 1830, the Kali year is 4,931, the number of its years is 432,000, at the expiration of which, the world is to be destroyed. 2 The age personified. 3 War, battle. 4 Strife, dissension. 5 An arrow. 6 Beleric myrobalan. f. (-लिः or ली) An unblown flower: see कलिका. E. कल to count or reckon, इन् Uṇādi aff.
9564: कलिका f. (-का) 1 An unblown flower. 2 The bottom or peg of a lute. E. कल to count, इन् affix कलि, and with ङीष्, कली as above; again, कन् pleonastic affix, and टाप् fem. do.
9565: कलिकापूर्व्व n. (-र्व्वं) Acts leading to future consequences, not connected with those of a previous birth. E. कलिका a bud, अपूर्व्व not preceding.
9566: कलिकार m. (-रः) 1 A plant bearing a nut, which is used as a febrifuge, (Grey bonduc:) see पूर्तिकरञ्ज. 2 The fork-tailed shrike. 3 Another bird, a small one with a yellow head, (Loxia philippensis.) 4 A name of NĀRADA. f. (-री) A poisonous plant: see लाङ्गली. E. कलि strife, &c. कृञ् to make, affix अण्; also with कन् added कलिकारक.
9567: कलिकारक m. (-कः) 1 Grey bonduc; also कलिमारक. 2 The name of NĀRADA a divine sage, and great mischief maker: see कलिकार.
9568: कलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The febrifuge nut plant, (Caesalpinia bonduccella.) 2 The fork-tailed shrike, (Lanius forficatus, Lath.) 2 The name of a country; the name Kaliṅga is applied in the Purāṇas to several places, but it especially signifies a district on the Coromandel coast, extending from below Cuttack to the vicinity of Madras, (in this sense, like some other names of countries, it is usually confined to the plural number, (-ङ्गाः) confounding the place with the people inhabiting it. nf. (-ङ्गं-ङ्गा) A medicinal seed, that of Echites antidysenterica. f. (-ङ्गा) 1 A woman of a good shape. 2 A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum:) see त्रिवृत्. E. कलि strife, &c. ग from गम to go, खच् aff.
9569: कलिङ्गक m. (-कः) The seed of the Coraiya, (Echites antidysenterica): see इन्द्रयव.
9570: कलिञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A mat, a screen of grass, a tāti, &c.
9571: कलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gained, acquired. 2 Known, understood. 3 Numbered, reckoned. 4 Separated, divided. 4 Made, done. 6 Held, laid hold of. 7 Sounded indistinctly, buzzed, murmured, &c. E. कल to count, &c. affix क्त.
9572: कलिद्रुम m. (-मः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica,) also कलि, the tree of strife; being supposed to be the favorite haunt of imps or goblins.
9573: कलिन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 The sun. 2 A mountain. 3 Beleric myrobalan. E. कलि strife, दा to give, खश् aff.
9574: कलिन्दकन्या f. (-न्या) The Yamunā. E. कलिन्द the sun or a mountain, कन्या daughter.
9575: कलिन्दनन्दिनी f. (-नी) The Yamunā or Jumna river. E. कलिन्द the name of a mountain, part of the Himālaya range, and नन्दिनी a daughter; the source of the river being in the mountain Kalinda.
9576: कलिन्दशैलजाता f. (-ता) The Yamunā river: see the preceding. E. कलिन्दशैल the mountain, and जाता born; also कलिन्दसू, कालिन्दी, &c.
9577: कलिप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Quarrelsome, mischievous, mischief making. m. (-यः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 NĀRADA. E. कलि strife, and प्रिय fond of.
9578: कलिमारक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bonduccella:) see पूतिकरञ्ज. E. कलि strife, मृ to destroy or remove, affixes अण् and कन्; some copies read कलिकारक.
9579: कलियुग n. (-गं) The Kali, the present or iron age: see कलि. E. कलि, and युग an age.
9580: कलिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Impervious, impenetrable. 2 Mixed, blended. E. कल to count, &c. इलच् Uṇādi aff.
9582: कलुक्क m. (-क्कः) A musical instrument; a cymbal. f. (-क्का) 1 A tavern. 2 A meteor.
9583: कलुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Turbid, foul, muddy. 2 Wicked, bad. mf. (-षः-षी) A buffalo. n. (-षं) 1 Sin. 2 Wrath. E. कल to go, &c. उषन् Uṇādi aff.
9584: कलुषत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Foulness, turbidness. 2 Opacity. 3 Agitation, trouble, anger. E. कलुष foul, &c. त्व affix; also with तल्, कलुषता.
9585: कलुषयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Of impure origin. E. कलुष, and योनि womb.
9586: कलुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Defiled, contaminated. 2 Foul, impure. 3 Wicked. E. कलुष and इतच् aff.
9587: कलुषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) 1 Foul, impure. 2 Depraved, wicked. 3 Defiled. E. कलुष and इनि aff.
9588: कलेवर n. (-रं) The body. E. कल semen, and वर best; formed from the seminal fluid; the termination of the ablative is retained.
9589: कलोत्ताल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) High, sharp. E. कल, and उत्ताल loud, high sounding.
9590: कल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्का-ल्कं) Sinful, wicked. mn. (-ल्कः-ल्कं) 1 Sediment, the deposit of oil, ghee, &c. 2 Dirt, filth. 3 Ordure, faeces. 4 Sin. 5 Hypocrisy. 6 Pride. 7 The beleric myrobalan. 8 The wax of the ear. 9 Levigated powder. E. कल to count, &c. कः Uṇādi aff.
9592: कल्कि m. (-ल्किः) A name of VIṢṆU, in his future capacity of destroyer of the world, the tenth and last Avatāra or descent of the deity, in the four ages or Kalpa. E. कल to count, कि aff.
9593: कल्किन् mfn. (-ल्की-ल्किनी-ल्कि) 1 Foul, turbid, having sediment, 2 Dirty. 3 Wicked. m. (-ल्की) The last descent of VIṢṆU; see the preceding. E. कल्क and इनि aff.
9594: कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) In composition; Like, but with a degree of inferiority. m. (-ल्पः) 1 A Śāstra or sacred work; one of the six Vedāṅgas, and comprehending the description of religious rites. 2 A day and night of BRAHMĀ, a period of  4,320,000,000 solar-sydereal-years or years of mortals, measuring the duration of the world, and as many, the interval of its annihilation. 3 A destruction of the world. 4 A sacred precept, practice prescribed by the Vedas for effecting certain consequences. 5 Propriety, fitness. 6 Optionality, alternative, doubt. 7 Resolve, purpose, any act of determination. 8 One of the trees of INDRA'S paradise or Svarga. E. कृष to be able, घः affix, ऋ is changed to अल्.
9595: कल्पक m. (-कः) A barber. E. कृप to cut, बुन् aff.
9596: कल्पक्षय m. (-यः) The destruction of all things, the end of the world. E. कल्प, and क्षय destruction.
9597: कल्पद्रुम m. (-मः) A fabulous tree, one granting every thing desired. E. कल्प purpose, and द्रुम a tree; also कल्पद्रु, कल्पवृक्ष, &c.
9598: कल्पन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting. 2 Making, manufacturing. 3 Making as a poem or tale, inventing, composing. nf. (नं-ना) 1 Inference. 2 Invention, fabrication. 3 Caparisoning or decorating an elephant. (-नी) A scissors or shears. E. कृप to be able, &c. ल्यु or ल्युट् affixes, and consequently टाप् or ङीप् fem. do.
9599: कल्पनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be made or contrived. 2 To be substituted or supplied. E. कृप to be able, अनीयर् affix; also कल्प्य and कल्पितव्य.
9600: कल्पवायु m. (-युः) The wind that is to blow at the end of all things. E. कल्प, and वायु wind.
9601: कल्पवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) One of the fabulous trees of INDRA'S heaven; a tree which yields whatever may be desired. E. कल्प purpose, and वृक्ष a tree.
9602: कल्पादि m. (-दिः) The beginning of a Kalpa, the renovation of all things. E. कल्प, and आदि beginning.
9603: कल्पान्त m. (-न्तः) The destruction of the world, the end of the Kalpa, or four ages of its existence. E. कल्प the period, and अन्त the end.
9604: कल्पान्तस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lasting, permanent. E. कल्पान्त, and स्थायिन् what stays.
9605: कल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, fabricated, artificial. 2 Composed, invented. 3 Arranged, put in order. 4 Prepared at once, put together extempore. 5 Brought, conducted. 6 Inferred. m. (-तः) An elephant armed or caparisoned for war. E. कृप to be able, &c. क्त aff.
9606: कल्पितार्धं mfn. (-र्धः-र्धा-र्धं) One for whom or what a respectful offering is prepared. E. कल्पित made, and अर्ध an offering.
9607: कल्प्य mfn. (-ल्प्यः-ल्प्या-ल्प्यं) 1 To be made or contrived. 2 To be substituted. E. कृप to be able, यत् aff.
9608: कल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Dirty, foul. m. (-षं) A kind of hell, a division of the infernal regions. n. (-षं) 1 Sin. 2 The hand below the wrist. E. कर्म्म virtuous or pious action, षो to destroy and क affix; the form is irr.
9609: कल्माष mfn. (-षः-षा or षी-षं) Of a mixed or variegated colour. m. (-षः) 1 A variegated colour. 2 A mixture of black and white. 3 Black. 4 A demon or goblin. f. (-षी) The spotted cow of Jamadagni, the giver of all desires. E. कल to go, &c. क्विप् affix, कल्, मष to injure, अण् affix माष; what injures or triumphs over other colours.
9610: कल्माषकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कल्माष black, and कण्ठ throat; form irr.
9611: कल्माषपाद m. (-दः) The name of a king, also SAUDĀSA, transformed to a Rākṣasa by VASIṢṬHA. E. कल्माष, and पाद a foot.
9612: कल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Ready, prepared, armed. 2 Healthy, free from sickness. 3 Clever, dexterous. 4 Deaf and dumb. 5 Auspicious, (speech or discourse.) 6 Counselling, monitory. 7 Sound, perfect, free from mental or bodily imperfections. n. (-ल्यं) 1 The dawn or break of day. 2 Yesterday. 3 Tomorrow. nf. (-ल्यं-ल्या) 1 Spirituous liquor. 2 Congratulation, good wishes, annunciation of good tidings. f. (-ल्या) Emblic myrobalan: see हरीतकी. E. कल to count, &c. यक् aff.
9613: कल्यजग्धि f. (-ग्धिः) The morning meal, breakfast. E. कल्य dawn, and जग्धि eating.
9614: कल्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Health. 2 Recovery, convalescence. E. कल्य being well, and त्व affix of the abstract; also कल्यता with तल् aff.
9615: कल्यपाल m. (-लः) A distiller. E. कल्य vinous liquor, and पाल who nourishes; also with कन् added, कल्यपालक.
9616: कल्यवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Breakfast. E. कल्य, and वर्त्त, from वृत to be or abide, affix घञ्.
9617: कल्याण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Happy, well, right, prosperous, lucky. f. (-णी) 1 A cow. 2 A leguminous shrub, (Glycine debilis.) n. (-णं) 1 Good fortune, happiness, prosperity. 2 Gold. E. कल्य, healthy, &c. अ to be, to sound, अण् aff.
9618: कल्याणकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Propitious, auspicious, conferring good fortune, &c. E. कल्याण, and कर what makes.
9619: कल्याणकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) 1 Virtuous, good. 2 Propitious, lucky. E. कल्याण, and कृत् who does.
9620: कल्याणचार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Following virtuous courses. 2 Lucky, fortunate. E. कल्याण, चर to go, अण् aff.
9621: कल्याणधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Good, virtuous. E. कल्याण, धर्म्म duty, अनिच्.
9622: कल्याणपञ्चमीक m. (-कः) A fortnight which has the fifth lunation lucky. E. कल्याण, पञ्चमी the fifth, and कन् added.
9623: कल्याणवचन n. (-नं) Friendly speech, good wishes. E. कल्याण, and वचन speech.
9624: कल्याणवीज m. (-जः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum hirsutum.) E. कल्याण, and वीज seed.
9625: कल्याणाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Virtuous, following good practices. E. कल्याण, and आचार rule.
9626: कल्याणिका f. (-का) Red arsenic. E. कल्याणी and कन् aff.
9627: कल्याणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) 1 Happy, lucky, prosperous. 2 Auspicious, propitious. E. कल्याण, and इनि aff.
9628: कल्यापाल m. (-लः) A distiller. E. कल्या spirituous liquor, and पाल who preserves.
9630: कल्ल r. 1st cl. (कल्लते) 1 To sound ill or indistinctly. 2 To sound. 3 To be mute.
9631: कल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Deaf. E. कल्ल to sound indistinctly, affix अच.
9632: कल्लत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Indistinct articulation, hoarseness. 2 Deafness. E. कल्ल to sound indistinctly, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix कल्लता.
9634: कल्लोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) An enemy, hostile, inimical. m. (-लः) 1 A surge, a billow. 2 Joy, happiness, pleasure. E. कल्ल to sound, ओलच् aff.
9635: कव (ऋ) कवृ r. 1st cl. (कवते) 1 To describe, (as a poet.) 2 To paint, to picture; also कब.
9636: कवक m. (-कः) 1 A mouthful. 2 A fungus, a mushroom, &c. E. कु to sound, अक aff.
9637: कवच mn. (-चः-चं) 1 Armour, mail. 2 A drum used in battle, a kettle drum. 3 An amulet, a charm. 4 A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्दभाण्ड. 5 The mystical syllable Hum, forming part of a Mantra, and considered as a preservative like armour; it is also inscribed on a Birch leaf, &c. and worn as an amulet; being carried about the person as a charm: see the next. E. कु to sound, अच् Uṇādi aff.
9638: कवचपत्र n. (-त्रं) The Birch tree, commonly Bhojpatra: see भूर्जपत्र. E. कवच an amulet, and पत्र a leaf: see the last.
9639: कवचहर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Wearing armour or amulets. m. (-रः) A boy, a child. E. कवच, and हृ to take, अच् or ट aff.
9640: कवटी f. (-टी) A door: see कवाट.
9641: कवयी f. (-यी) A kind of flat fish, commonly Kavay or Kay; remarkable for going by land from one spot to another, (Coiuscoboius, HAM.)
9642: कवर sub. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A braid or fillet of hair. adj. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Mixed, intermingled, blended. 2 Set, inlaid. mn. (-रः-रं) 1 Salt. 2 Sourness or acidity. f. (-रा or -री) A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) (-री) The leaf of the asafoetida plant, Hingupatri. E. क the head, &c. वृ to screen, अच् affix, fem. do. टाप् or ङीष्
9643: कवरकी f. (-की) A captive, a prisoner: see वन्दी.
9644: कवरीभार m. (-रः) A fine head of hair. E. कवरी, and भार a load; also कवरीभर.
9645: कवरीभृत् mfn. (भृत्) Wearing a fillet of hair. E. कवरी, and भृत् who has.
9646: कवल m. (-लः) 1 A mouthful. 2 A kind of fish, commonly Baliya. 3 An astringent wash for cleaning the mouth, a gargle. E. क the head, water, &c. and वल to be strong, अच् aff.
9647: कवलिका f. (-का) A piece of cloth over a sore, a bandage.
9648: कवलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. कवल nominal verb, to eat, and क्त aff.
9649: कवस m. (-सः) Armour, mail. E. कु to sound, and अस Uṇādi affix; also कवच.
9650: कवाट sub. mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) A door, the leaf or pannel of the door. E. क wind, air, वट to exclude, and अण् affix; also कपाट.
9651: कवाटवक्र n. (-क्रं) A plant, commonly Kapāta venlu.
9652: कवार m. (-रः) 1 A lotus. 2 A bird, (Tantalus falcinellus, BUC.) E. क water, वर to prefer, अण् aff.
9653: कवि mfn. (-विः-विः or -वी-वि) Learned, wise. m. (-विः) 1 A poet. 2 The sun. 3 ŚUKRA, the regent of the planet Venus, and preceptor of the demons. 4 A name of VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa, the inventor of poesy. 5 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-विः-वी) The bit of a bridle, or the reins altogether; also कविका. E. कु to sound, to celebrate, and इन् Uṇādi aff.
9654: कविक nf. (-कं-का) The bit of a bridle, or the reins altogether, (-का) A sort of fish, the Kay. E. कन् added to the preceding.
9655: कविज्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A name of VĀLMĪKI, author of the Rāmāyaṇa. E. कवि a poet, and ज्येष्ठ elder or superior.
9656: कविता f. (-ता) 1 Poesy, poetical style or composition. 2 A poem. E. कवि, and तल affix; also with त्व affix, कवित्वं.
9657: कवितावेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Wise, learned, a genius, a poet. E. कविता poetry, &c. वेदिन् who understands.
9658: कविय mn. (-यः-यं) The bit of a bridle, or the reins. E. कु to sound, affix यः see कवि and कविक.
9659: कविरामायण m. (-णः) A name of VĀLMĪKI. E. कवि a poet, &c. and रामायण the epic poem so called; the poet of the Rāmāyaṇa.
9660: कविलाशिका f. (-का) A musical instrument, a kind of lute.
9662: कवीय n. (-यं) The bit of a bridle, or the reins. E. कु to sound, छ affix; also कविय.
9663: कवेल n. (-लं) A lotus. E. क water, विल to send, &c. घञ् aff.
9664: कवोष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Slightly warm, tepid. n. (-ष्णं) A slight warmth. E. कु indifferent, and उष्ण warm.
9665: कव्य n. (-व्यं) An oblation or offering of food to deceased ancestors. E. कु to sound or praise, यत् aff.
9666: कव्यवाल m. (-लः) A class of the manes or deified ancestors. E. कव्य an offering to the manes, वा occasionally, and ल who receives.
9667: कव्यवाहन m. (-नः) Fire. E. कव्य, and वाहन vehicle; also कव्यवाह.
9668: कश r. 1st cl. (कशति-ते) To kill, to hurt.
9669: कशा f. (-शा) 1 A whip. 2 Whipping, flogging. E. कश to hurt, अच् and टाप् affixes; also कष.
9670: कशात्रय n. (-यं) Three modes of whipping (a horse), good, bad, and middling. E. कषा, and त्रयम् three-fold.
9671: कशार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Deserving a whipping. E. कशा a whip, and अर्ह to be fit or proper.
9672: कशिपु m. (-पुः) 1 Food. 2 Clothing. du. m. (-पूः) Food and clothing. E. कश to injure, to remove, (pain, hunger, &c.) पु affix, the form is irr.
9673: कशेरु mn. (-रुः-रु) The back bone. f. (-रूः) A kind of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.) m. (-रुः) One of the nine divisions of Jambu Dvīpa. E. क sound, शृ to harm, ऊ or उ Uṇādi affix, and एरङ् substituted for the radical vowel.
9674: कशेरुक f. (-का) The back bone. n. (-कं) A sort of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
9675: कशेरुस् n. (-रुः) A grass, (Scirpus kysoor:) see कशेरु.
9676: कश्चन ind. Some body, a certain person; the first member of the compound is declinable, as कश्चन, कस्यचन, &c.
9677: कश्चित् ind. Some body, some one, a certain one: the first member of the compound is declinable, as कश्चित्, कस्मैचित् &c.
9678: कश्मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Foul, dirty. m. (-लः) 1 Fainting, syncope. 2 Sin. E. कश to go, क्मलच् aff.
9679: कश्मीर m. (-रः) The name of a country, Kāṣmir. E. कश to go, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, and मुद inserted: see काश्मीर.
9681: कश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Deserving a whipping. n. (-श्यं) 1 Spirituous liquor. 2 A horse's flank. E. कश to beat, यत् aff.
9682: कश्यप m. (-पः) 1 The name of a Muni or deified sage, the son of MARĪCI, and father of the gods, demons, animals, fishes, reptiles, &c. by the seventeen daughters of DAKṢA. 2 A kind of deer. 3 A sort of fish.
9683: कश्यपनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of GARUḌA The bird of VIṢṆU. E. कश्यप, and नन्दन a son, the son of KAŚYAPA.
9684: कष r. 1st cl. (कषति) 10th cl. (कषयुति) 1 To injure, to hurt, to destroy, to kill. 2 To try, to test: with नि, to try metals.
9685: कष m. (-षः) The touchstone. f. (-षा) A whip; also कशा. E. कष to hurt, to test or try, अच् and टाप् affs.
9686: कषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Unripe, immature. n. (-णं) 1 Touch or test of gold by the touchstone. 2 Rubbing, marking. E. कष to hurt, affix युच्.
9687: कषपाषाण m. (-णः) A touchstone. E. कष and पाषाण a stone.
9688: कषाकु m. (-कुः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. कष to injure, आकु Uṇādi aff.
9689: कषाघात m. (-तः) A cut, a stroke with a whip. E. कषा and आघात a blow.
9690: कषाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Astringent. 2 Fragrant. 3 Red, dull red. 4 Brown, of a colour composed of red and yellow. mn. (-यः-यं) 1 An astringent flavour or taste. 2 A decoction or infusion. 3 Gum, resin, extract, exudation from a tree, &c. 4 Plastering, anointing. 5 Colouring or perfuming the person. 6 Attachment to worldly objects. m. (-यः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 Passion, emotion. f. (-या) A plant, a small sort of Hedysarum. E. कष to injure, आय aff.
9691: कषायकृत् m. (-कृत्) Red. Lodh, a tree the bark of which is used in dyeing. E. कषाय red, कृत् what makes.
9692: कषायचित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Dyed or stained of a dull red colour. E. कषाय, and चित्र painted.
9693: कषायन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Astringent, harsh. E. कषाय, and अन्वित having.
9694: कषायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Prepared for dyeing or colouring. E. कषाय nominal verb, to astringe, and क्त aff.
9695: कषायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Yielding a resinous exudation. 2 Astringent. 3 Dyed of a red colour. 4 Worldly minded. m. (-यी) The Śāl tree. E. कषाय and इनि aff.
9696: कषि mfn. (-षिः-षिः-षि) Injurious, mischievous. E. कष to hurt, and इन् aff.
9697: कषिका f. (-का) A bird in general. E. कष to hurt, and इकन् Uṇādi aff.
9698: कषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hurt, injured. E. कष to hurt, क्त aff.
9699: कषेरुका f. (-का) The back bone, the spine: see कशेरुका.
9700: कष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pained, suffering pain. 2 Impervious, impenetrable. n. (-ष्टं) Bodily pain or uneasiness. ind. (-ष्टं) An exclamation of regret or sorrow, ah, alas! E. कष to hurt, participial affix क्त.
9701: कष्टकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Giving pain or trouble. E. कष्ट, and कर what makes.
9702: कष्टकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Causing trouble or annoyance. m. (-कः) The world. E. कष्ट pain, and कारक the maker, the cause.
9703: कष्टश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suffering pain or misfortune, undergoing hardships, performing penance. E. कष्ट and श्रित subjected to.
9704: कष्टस्थान n. (-नं) A bad or disagreeable place or site. E. कष्ट, and स्थान place, situation.
9705: कष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Test, trial. 2 Pain, trouble. E. कष to hurt, क्तिन् aff.
9706: कस r. 1st cl. (कसति) To move, to go or approach: with वि prefixed, to open or expand as a flower, to blow. (इ) कसि r. 2nd cl. (कंस्ते) 1 To go. 2 To command. 3 To destroy: this root is also read by some authorities, कस (कस्ते) or कशि (कंष्टे.)
9707: कस m. (-सः) A touchstone: see कष. f. (-सा) A whip: see कशा and कषा.
9708: कसनोत्पाटन m. (-नः) A plant, (Justicia, &c.) see वासक.
9709: कसिपु m. (-पुः) Food, boiled rice: see कशिपु.
9710: कसेरु m. (-रुः) A sort of grass: see कशेरु, &c.
9711: कसेरुका f. (-का) 1 A sort of grass. 2 The back bone: see कशेरुका.
9712: कस्तीर n. (-रं) Tin. E. कस् to go, deriv. irr.
9713: कस्तुरिका f. (-का) Musk; also कस्तूरी and कस्तूरिका.
9717: कस्तूरी f. (-री) 1 Musk, the animal perfume so called, as brought from Kashmir, Napal, and western Asam or Butan, the latter is said to be the best. 2 A plant, (Hibiscus abelmoschus.) 3 Another plant, (Amaryllis zeylanica.) E. कस to go, and तूरच् affix; its scent going or spreading; the deriv. is irr.; also कन् being added, कस्तूरिका and कस्तुरिका as above.
9718: कस्मल n. (-लं) 1 Fainting, syncope. 2 Sin: see कश्मल.
9719: कस्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what goes or moves. E. कस to go, वरच् aff.
9720: कल्हार n. (-रं) The white esculent water lily, (Nymphaea lotus.) E. क water, हार a necklace or ornament, and ल irregularly inserted.
9721: कह्व m. (-ह्वः) A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. क water, ह्वेञ् to call, &c. ड aff.
9722: कांसीय n. (-यं) White copper: see the next.
9723: कांस्य mn. (-स्यः-स्यं) A goblet, a drinking vessel. n. (-स्यं) 1 White copper or brass, queen's-metal, any amalgam of zinc and copper. 2 A musical instrument, a sort of gong or plate of bell-metal struck with a stick or rod. 3 A measure: see कंस, &c. E. कसि to injure, ण्यत् aff.
9725: कांस्यकार m. (-रः) A brazier, a pewterer, a worker in white or bell-metal. E. कांस्य, and कार a workman.
9726: कांस्यनील m. (-लः) Blue vitriol considered as a collyrium. E. कांस्य bell-metal, and नील blue or black; also written occasionally कांश्यनील.
9727: काक m. (-कः) 1 A crow. 2 A plant, (Ardisia solanacea?) 3 A lame man, a cripple, one whose legs are wanting or useless. 4 One of the divisions of the world or Dvīpas. 5 A measure. 6 Washing the head, bathing by dipping the head only into the water. 7 A sectarial mark, the Tilaka? 8 Shameless, arrogant. n. (-कं) 1 Modus coeundi. 2 A multitude or assemblage of crows. f. (-का) An appellation of several plants, as, 1 The common Bakapuṣpa: see वक, 2 Kakjhangi, (Leea hirta;) also in this sense काकी; 3 A medicinal plant, vulg. Kākoli; 4 The Ratti or Gunja, (Abrus precatorius;) 5 Opposite leaved fig tree: see उडुम्बर; 6 A potherb, (Solanum Indicum, &c.) see काकमाची. E. कै to sound, Uṇādi affix कन्; or क for कु bad, ill, and अक to go, &c.
9728: काककङ्गु f. (-ङ्गुः) A kind of panick, (P. miliaceum.) E. काक, and कङ्ग another species of the same grass; the Kaṅgu of the crows.
9729: काककला f. (-ला) A plant, (Leea hirta:) see काकजङ्घा.
9730: काकघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A tree, said to be a large kind of Karanja, (Galedupa arborea.) E. काक, and घ्नी what kills.
9731: काकचिञ्चा f. (-ञ्चा) The shrub which yields the red and black berry, used in India as a jeweller's weight, (Abrus precatorius:) see गुञ्जा. E. काक, and चिञ्चा extremity; the point being as black as a crow; also काकचिञ्चि and काकचिञ्ची.
9734: काकछद m. (-दः) 1 A wagtail. 2 Side locks of the head of hair. E. काक a crow, and छद plumage.
9735: काकछर्द्दि m. (-र्द्दिः) 1 A wagtail. 2 What is ejected by a crow. E. काक and छर्द्दि vomiting.
9736: काकजङ्घा f. (-ङ्घा) A plant, (Leea hirta, Rox. Catalogue; elsewhere described as Leea aequata.) E. काक, and जङ्गा a thigh; compared to a crow's leg.
9737: काकजम्बु f. (-म्बुः) A plant, commonly Bhuinjamb, (Ardisia solanacea:) see भूमिजम्बु; also काकजम्बू.
9738: काकण n. (-णं) A leprosy with black and red spots, considered incurable. E. काक the Gunja berry, deriv. irr. also with कन्, affix काकणक.
9739: काकणन्तिका f. (-का) The Abrus precatorius: see काकचिञ्चा.
9740: काकता f. (-ता) The state or nature of a crow. E. काक, and तल् affix; also काकत्वं.
9741: काकतालीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Accidental, unexpected, opportune. E. काक, and ताली the fruit of the palm: it alludes to a story of the fruit of the palm falling in the way of a crow.
9742: काकतालीयवत् ind. Suddenly, opportunely. E. काकतालीय, and वत् like.
9743: काकतालुकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Contemptible, vile. E. काक, तालु palate, कन् affix of similitude, and इनि aff.
9744: काकतिक्ता f. (-क्ता) The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा.
9745: काकतिन्दुक m. (-कः) A kind of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa. Rox.) E. काक, and तिन्दुक ebony.
9746: काकतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A dark sort of Agallochum: see कालागुरु. f. (-ण्डी) 1 The Gunja plant. 2 A sort of brass. 3 A tree, commonly Kuwa dorī. E. काक, and तुण्ड face; of the colour of a crow.
9747: काकतुण्डिका f. (-का) The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा.
9748: काकध्वज m. (-जः) Submarine fire, a personage in Hindu mythology: see और्व्व. E. काक, and ध्वज a banner, whose symbol is a crow.
9749: काकनाशा f. (-शा) A plant, commonly Vakapushpa: see वकपुष्प.
9750: काकनासा f. (-सा) A plant: see काकजङ्गा; also काकनासिका.
9751: काकनासिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Leea hirta.) 2 Red Tëori. E. काक a crow, and नासिका a nose; the root being fancifully compared to the beak of the bird; also काकनासा and काकनासिकी.
9753: काकपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The side locks of the head of hair; three or five on each side left when the head is first shaved, and which may be allowed to remain, especially in persons of the military cast. E. काक and पक्ष a feather, a wing, a crow's wing; the word is also used as an epithet of a warrior, a name of RĀMA, &c.
9754: काकपीलु m. (-लुः) A kind of ebony: see काकतिन्दुक; also with कन् added काकपीलुकः.
9755: काकपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. काक, and पुच्छ a tail; crow-tailed.
9756: काकपुष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The Koil or Kokil, as before. E. काक, and पुष्ट nourished; this bird, like the English cuckoo, being said to leave its eggs in the nests of other birds, as in that of the crow, &c.
9757: काकफल m. (-लः) The Nimb tree. E. काक, and फल fruit.
9758: काकबन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) A woman that bears only one child.
9759: काकभीरु m. (-रुः) An owl. काक, and भीरु fearful; afraid of the crows.
9760: काकमद्गु m. (-द्गुः) A water hen, a gallinule. E. काक, and मद्गु another kind of bird, a Shag; resembling a crow in colour.
9761: काकमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) The colocynth or bitter apple. E. काक, and मर्द्दक destroying; the fruit of which destroys crows; also काकमर्द्दक.
9762: काकमाचिका f. (-का) A plant: see the next word.
9763: काकमाची f. (-ची) An esculent vegetable, commonly Gūrkamai, (Solanum Indicum.) E. काक, मच to respect, &c. अण् and ङीष् affixes; also with कन् and टाप् added, काकमाचिका.
9764: काकमुद्गा f. (-द्गा) A plant, commonly Mugani, according to some, a wild kind of bean. E. काक and मुद्ग Moong.
9765: काकयव m. (-वः) Barren corn, the ear of which has no grain. E. काक and यव barley.
9766: काकरुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Naked. 2 Timid, fearful. 2 Poor, indigent. m. (-कः) 1 Fraud, deceit. 2 An owl. 3 A henpecked husband.
9767: काकरुहा f. (-हा) A parasite plant, (Epidendrum tesseloides, &c.) see वन्दा. E. काक and रुह what mounts; on which crows rest.
9768: काकल n. (-लं) A jewel worn upon the neck. f. (-लिः or -ली) A low and sweet tone, the song of a bird, &c. E. का instead of कु diminutive, कल to sound, इन् or ङीप् aff.
9769: काकलक m. (-कः) An ornament of the neck. E. कन् added to the preceding.
9770: काकलीद्राक्षा f. (-क्षा) A grape with a very small stone.
9771: काकलीरव m. (-वः) The Kokila. E. काकली a sweet tone, and रव sound.
9772: काकशब्द m. (-ब्दः) The cawing of a crow. E. काक, and शब्द sound.
9773: काकशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) A tree, commonly Vakapushpa: (Æschynomene grandiflora.) E. काक, and शीर्ष a head.
9775: काकाङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A plant, (Leea aequata.) E. काक, and अङ्ग form, body, टाप् affix; or with ङीष् affix, काकाङ्गी.
9777: काकाञ्ची f. (-ञ्ची) 1 A plant, (Leea aequata.) 2 An esculent vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.) E. काक, अञ्च to go, अच् and ङीप् affs.
9778: काकादनी f. (-नी) The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा. E. काक, अदन food, ङीप् fem. aff.
9779: काकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Scattering water. E. क water, क, to scatter; with आङ् prefixed, and अण् aff.
9780: काकारि m. (-रिः) An own. E. काक, and अरि a foe; whose enemy is the crow.
9781: काकाल m. (-लः) A raven. E. काक, and अल to be able, affix अच्.
9782: काकिणी f. (-णी) 1 A cubit, the fourth part of a Daṇḍa or short pole. 2 The quarter of a Paṇa, a weight, or a tale of shells equal to twenty Cowries. 3 A quarter of a Māṣa, a weight of silver or gold. 4 A Ratti or small seed used as a weight. 5 A Cowri or shell used as a coin. E. कक to be unsteady, ल्युट् and ङीप् affixes; deriv. irr; also the dental न being substituted, काकिनी.
9784: काकिल m. (-लः) The central jewel in a necklace, &c. see काकल.
9785: काकु f. (-कुः) 1 Change of voice in fear, grief, &c. 2 Muttering, murmuring. 3 The tongue. E. कक to deride, उण् affix, deriv. irr.
9786: काकुत्स्थ m. (-त्स्थः) A name of RĀMA. 2 The name of a sovereign, also Purañjaya. E. ककुट् preeminent, अण् affix, and स्थ who stays or is.
9787: काकुद m. (-दः) The palate. E. ककुद् the head, and अण् aff.
9788: काकेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. काक, and इक्षु sugar cane.
9789: काकेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A species of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon.)
9790: काकोचिक m. (-कः) A kind of fish, commonly Caouchi; also काकोचि. (Cyprinus cachius, HAM.)
9791: काकोडुम्बर m. (-रः) Opposite leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositifolia.)
9792: काकोडुम्बरिका f. (-का) See the preceding. E. काक, and उडुम्बर glomerous fig, कन् affix, and the feminine termination; also काकोदुम्बरिका.
9793: काकोदर m. (-रः) A snake. E. काक going ill or tortuously, (derived from का for कु, and अक to go,) and उदर the belly.
9794: काकोल mn. (-लः-लं) A poisonous substance of a black colour, or the colour of a raven, whence its name; possibly the berry of the Cocculus Indicus. n. (-लं) A division of the infernal regions or hell. (-लः) 1 A raven. 2 A potter. 3 A snake. 4 A boar. 5 A drug; as follows. f. (-ली) The name of a vegetable substance used in medicine, described as sweet and cooling, allaying fever, removing phlegm, &c.; it is said to be a root brought from Nepal or Morung. E. काक to be unsteady, &c. and ओलच् affix, deriv. irr.
9795: काकोलूकिका f. (-का) The natural enmity of the owl and crow. E. काक a crow, उलूक an owl, वुन् affix, implying enmity in this and similar compounds.
9796: काक्ष r. 1st cl. (इ) काक्षि (कांक्षति) To desire; it is most frequently used with आङ् prefixed, in the same sense.
9797: काक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Frowning, looking scornfully or in displeasure. m. (-क्षः) A glance, a wink or leer. n. (-क्षं) A frown, a look of displeasure. E. का for कु diminutive, or depreciative, and अक्षि the eye. f. (-क्षी) 1 A sort of trefoil, (Cytisus cajan.) 2 A perfume, a fragrant kind of earth. E. कक्ष a creeping plant, अण् and ङीप् affs.
9798: काक्षीव m. (-वः) A plant, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन. E. का for कु diminutive, and क्षीव to be intoxicated: see अक्षीव; also with कन् added काक्षीवक.
9799: काग m. (-गः) A crow: (in the dialects, a raven.) E. का an imitative sound, and ग who sings, from गै with ड or क aff.
9800: काङ्क्षत् mfn. (-ङ्क्षन्-ङ्क्ष-न्ती-ङ्क्षत्) Wishing, desiring, hoping. E. काक्षि to desire, शतृ aff.
9801: काङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) Wish, inclination, desire. E. काक्षि to wish, अच् and टाप् affs.
9802: काङ्क्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. E. काक्षि to wish, क्त aff.
9804: काङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) Orris root. E. का bad, crooked, and अङ्ग body, shape.
9805: काच r. 1st cl. (इ) काचि (काचते) 1 To shine. 2 To bind.
9806: काच m. (-चः) 1 Alkaline ashes, any salt of potash or soda in a glassy or crystalline state. 2 Crystal, quartz or glass, considered as a natural production, and used as a jewel or ornament. 3 A loop, a swinging shelf, a string so contrived as to hold or support burthens, &c. A disease of the eyes, affection of the optic nerve or gutta serena. n. (-चं) 1 Alkaline salt, black salt. 2 Wax. E. कच to shine or bind, घञ् aff.
9807: काचक (-कः) 1 A stone. 2 Alkaline ashes, &c. see the preceding. E. कन added to the last.
9808: काचकूपी f. (-पी) A glass bottle. E. काच, and कूपी bottle.
9809: काचघटी f. (-टी) A glass ewer. E. काच, and घटी a small jar.
9810: काचन n. (-नं) An enclosure, a string or tape which ties a parcel or bundle or papers, &c. E. कच to tie, ल्युट् affix; also with कन् added काचनक m. (-कः.)
9811: काचन ind. Some one, any one, (applied to feminine objects,) the first member is declinable. E. का fem. of किम, चन added.
9812: काचनक n. (-कं) A binding or rope for binding. E. कन् added to काचन.
9813: काचनकिन् m. (-की) A writing, a written paper. E. काचनक a binding, and इनि aff.
9814: काचभाजन n. (-नं) A vessel of glass or crystal, a cup, a goblet, &c. E. काच, and भाजन a vessel.
9815: काचमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal, quartz. E. काच, and मणि a gem.
9816: काचमल n. (-लं) Black salt or soda: see काचलवण. E. काच glass, and मल soil.
9817: काचलवण n. (-णं) Black salt, a medicinal salt, prepared by calcining fossile salt and the fruit of the emblic myrobalan together. It consists chiefly or muriate of soda, with a small quantity of iron, lime and sulphur, and is a tonic aperient. E. काच alkaline ashes, and लवण salt.
9818: काचवकयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A glass retort. E. काच, and वकयन्त्र a retort.
9819: काचसम्भव n. (-वं) Black salt: see the last. E. काच, and सम्भव produced.
9820: काचसौवर्च्चल n. (-लं) Black salt: see काचलवण. E. काच, and सौवर्च्चल salt.
9821: काचस्थाली f. (-ली) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. काच glass, and स्थाली a goblet, &c. to which its colour is compared.
9822: काचिघ m. (-घः) 1 A legume. 2 A rat. 3 Gold.
9823: काचित् ind. Some one, any one, (a female person or object,) the first member is declinable, as काञ्चित्, &c. E. का fem. of किम् and चित् aff.
9824: काचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended by a swing or in a loop. E. काच a nominal root, to hang by a loop or in a swing, and क्त aff.
9825: काचिम m. (-मः) A tree considered as sacred, one growing near a temple, and an object or religious veneration or worship, &c.
9826: काञ्चन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Golden, of gold. n. (-नं) 1 Gold. 2 Wealth. 3 A filament of the lotus. m. (-नः) 1 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) 2 A tree bearing a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) 3 Another plant, (Mesua ferrea:) see नागकेसर. 4 Glomerous fig tree: see उदुम्बर. 5 Common thorn apple, (Datura metel.) f. (-नी) 1 Turmeric. 2 A yellow pigment. E. कचि to shine, &c. ल्युट् affix, the radical vowel lengthened; this etymology gives the meaning gold, the others refer to their colour, &c. in which they resemble the metal.
9827: काञ्चनक m. (-कः) Mountain ebony, &c. n. (-कं) Yellow orpiment. E. काञ्चन gold, &c. and कन् affix, implying resemblance or identity.
9828: काञ्चनकन्दर m. (-रः) A gold mine. E. काञ्चन, and कन्दर a cave.
9829: काञ्चनकारिणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus:) see शतमूली.
9830: काञ्चनगिरि m. (-रिः) Mount Sumeru. E. काच्चन, and गिरि a mountain; the golden mountain.
9831: काञ्चनचय m. (-यः) A heap of gold. E. काञ्चन, and चय assemblage.
9832: काञ्चनभू f. (-भूः) 1 Gold dust. 2 A golden or yellow soil. E. काञ्चन, and भू soil.
9833: काञ्चनमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden. E. काञ्चन, and मयट् aff.
9834: काञ्चनवप्र m. (-प्रः) A hill or mound of gold. E. काञ्चन, and वप्र a mound.
9835: काञ्चनसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) A treaty of friendship between two parties on equal terms. E. काञ्चन, and सन्धि alliance.
9836: काञ्चनाल m. (-लः) Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) E. काञ्चन gold, and अल to be able or like; some copies read काञ्चनार.
9837: काञ्चनीया f. (-या) A yellow pigment, commonly Gorocanā. E. काचि to shine, अनीयर् aff.
9839: काञ्चिक n. (-कं) Sour gruel: see काञ्जिक.
9840: काञ्ची f. (-ञ्ची) 1 A woman's zone or girdle. 2 The name of an ancient city situated in the peninsula, and one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus. 3 A plant, (Abrus precatorious:) see गुञ्चा. E. काचि to bind or shine, इन or ङीष् affixes; whence also काञ्चि.
9841: काञ्चीपद n. (-दं) Mons veneris, the pubic region. E. काञ्ची the zone, and पद place, site.
9842: काञ्जिक nf. (-कः-का) Sour gruel, the water of boiled rice in a state of spontaneous fermentation. E. क water, अञ्ज to go, &c. and affix इक; also the vowel being lengthened काञ्जीक, or without the final, काञ्जी.
9843: काठ m. (-ठः) A stone, a rock. E. कठ to be hard, &c. अण् affix; also with कन् added, काठक.
9844: काठक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) According to the Kaṭha portion of the vedas. E. कठ, and वुञ् aff.
9845: काठिन m. (-नः) The date fruit. n. (-नं) 1 Hardness. 2 Sternness. E. कठिन and अण aff.
9846: काठिन्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Hardness. 2 Difficulty, obscurity. 3 Sternness, severity. E. कठिन hard, and ष्यञ् aff.
9847: काण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) One-eyed, monoculous. m. (-णः) A crow. E. कण to sound, &c. अण् aff.
9848: काणूक m. (-कः) A crow. E. कण to sound, &c. and ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.
9849: काणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) One-eyed. E. काण, and ढक् aff.
9850: काणेर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) One-eyed. E. काण, and द्रक aff.
9851: काण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 A stalk or stem. 2 The part of the trunk of a tree whence the branches proceed. 3 A cluster, a clump. 4 An arrow. 5 Opportunity, season. 6 Water. 7 A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.) 8 A multitude, a heap, a quantity. 9 A horse. 10 A chapter, a section. 11 The part in a sacrifice appropriated to different objects, as the gods or manes. 12 A long bone, a bone of the extremities. 13 Praise, flattery. 14 Private, privacy. 15 Low, vile, bad. 16 Sinful, wicked. E. कन to shine, &c. डः Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel made long.
9852: काण्डकाण्डक m. (-कः) A species of grass. E. काण्ड repeated.
9853: काण्डकार n. (-रं) The betle nut, the fruit of the areca.
9854: काण्डगोचर m. (-रः) An iron arrow. E. काण्ड a stem or stalk, and गोचर an object of sense: it is fired from a stock like the arrow of the cross bow.
9855: काण्डणी f. (-णी) A plant, commonly Rāmadūtī: see सूक्ष्मपर्णी.
9856: काण्डतिक्तक m. (-कः) A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.) E. काण्ड the stem, and तिक्त sharp, bitter, कन् added to this and similar compounds.
9857: काण्डनील m. (-लः) A plant with an astringent bark, commonly Lodh. E. काण्ड, and नील blue.
9858: काण्डपट m. (-टः) An outer tent, a screen surrounding a tent. E. काण्ड a stem, &c. and पट a cloth; also with कन् added काण्डपटकः.
9859: काण्डपुष्प n. (-ष्पः) A small fragrant flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.) E. काण्ड the stem, and पुष्प flower; flowering from the stalk.
9860: काण्डपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Of the military profession, a soldier. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 The husband of a Vaiśya female. 2 An adopted or any other than the natural son. n. (-ष्ठं) The bow of KĀMA. E. काण्ड an arrow, and पृष्ठ the back: see काण्डस्पृष्ठ.
9861: काण्डभग्न n. (-ग्नं) A fracture of either of the extremities. E. काण्ड, and भग्न breaking.
9862: काण्डरुहा f. (-हा) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. काण्ड the stem of a tree, and रुहा what ascends; hence it appears to be a creeper.
9863: काण्डर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi or divine saint of a peculiar class; Jaimini and others who teach a particular Kāṇḍa or section of Vedas. E. काण्ड a section, and ऋषि a saint.
9864: काण्डवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Armed with an arrow, an archer. E. काण्ड an arrow, and मतुप् poss. aff.
9865: काण्डसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) A knot, a joint in the stem of a tree, &c. E. काण्ड a stem, and सन्धि union.
9866: काण्डस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Of the military profession, living by arms, a soldier. E. काण्ड an arrow, &c. स्पृश to touch, and क्त aff.
9867: काण्डहीन n. (-नं) A fragrant grass, a sort of cyperus: see भद्रमुस्तक. E. काण्ड a stem, and हीन deprived.
9868: काण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Armed with an arrow, an archer. m. (-रः) 1 A creeping plant, commonly Kāṇḍa Bel, (Momordica charantia.) 2 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) f. (-रा) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith): see मञ्जिष्ठा. E. काण्ड an arrow, a stem, &c. and ईरच् aff.
9869: काण्डेक्षु n. (-क्षुः) 1 A plant, (Barleria longifolia.) 2 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum:) see काश. E. काण्ड, and ईक्षु sugar cane; having a similar stem.
9870: कातर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Confused, perplexed, disordered. 2 Timid, gentle. m. (-रः) A large kind of fish, commonly Kātala, (Cyprinus catla, HAM.) E. का a little or badly, and तर what crosses.
9871: कातरता f. (-ता) Timidity, agitation. E. तल् added to कातर; also with त्व, कातरत्वं.
9872: कातल m. (-लः) The name of a fish, commonly Kātala, (Cyprinus catla, HAM.) E. see कातर, र changed to ल.
9873: कातीय m. (-यः) 1 A name of KĀTYĀYANA. 2 A pupil of the same. E. कात्यायन with फक् affix and the middle syllable dropped; also कात्यायनीय.
9874: कात्त्रयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced from any bad triad. E. कत्त्रय, and ढकञ् aff.
9875: कात्य m. (-त्यः) The name of a saint; also कात्यायन. E. कत a proper name, and यञ् affix implying descent or lineage.
9876: कात्यायन m. (-नः) 1 The name of a celebrated lawgiver and divine sage. 2 An appellation of VARARUCI a poet. E. कात्य, and फक् pleonastic affix. f. (-नी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A middle- aged widow. E. ङीष् added to कात्यायन; the daughter of the saint KĀTYĀYANA, (DURGĀ,) or resembling the wife of a sage in dress and austerity, (the widow.)
9877: कात्यायनीय m. (-यः) A pupil of KĀTYĀYANA. E. कात्यायन, and फक् aff.
9878: काथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a story, told in it, &c. m. (-कः) A narrator. E. कथा and ठक् aff.
9879: कादम्ब n. (-म्बं) 1 A tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) 2 A drake, or, according to some, a teal. 3 An arrow. f. (-म्बा) A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī: see कदम्बपुष्प. E. अण् added to कदम्ब.
9880: कादम्बक m. (-कः) An arrow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
9881: कादम्बर n. (-रं) The surface or skim of coagulated milk. m. (-रः) A spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the Kadamba. f. (-री) 1 Wine, spirituous liquor in general. 2 A name of SARASVATĪ. 3 The female Koil or Indian cuckoo. 4 The female of another bird, (Turdus salica, BUC.) E. कदम्ब the Kadamba flower, र what gains or gets, from रा, affix ड.
9882: कादम्बरीवीज n. (-जं) Ferment, yeast, whatever occasions fermentation. E. कादम्बरी, and वीज seed.
9883: कादम्बर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The Kādamba tree: see कादम्ब. E. कादम्बरी a spirit, and यत् aff.
9884: कादम्बिनी f. (-नी) A long line of clouds. E. कादम्ब the Kādamba flower, इनि and ङीप् affixes, implying a multitude; the clouds being compared he large white flowers of the Nauclea cadamba.
9885: कादाचित्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्की-त्कं) Produced sometimes, occasional, incidental. E. कदाचित् sometimes, with कन् added, and अण् aff.
9886: काद्रवेय m. (-यः) A Nāga or serpent of the race that is supposed to people the lower regions. E. कद्रु the mother of these beings, and ढक् aff.
9887: कानक n. (-कं) The seed of the croton.
9888: कानन nf. (-नं-नी) 1 A forest, a grove. 2 The face of BRAHMĀ. 3 A house. E. कनि to shine, in the causal form, and ल्युट् affix, or क BRAHMĀ, and आनन a face.
9889: काननारि m. (-रिः) The Śami or Śain tree, (Mimosa albida:) see समी. E. कानन, and अरि enemy; injurious to a wood; being a thorny tree.
9890: कानीन mf. (-नः-नी) The son or daughter of a young and unmarried woman. m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA. 2 Also of KARṆA, (being both born of mothers who were unmarried.) E. कन्या a virgin or young girl, changed to कनीन् and अण् aff.
9891: कान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Pleasing, agreeable. 2 Lovely, beautiful. 3 Dear, beloved. m. (-न्तः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA. 2 The moon. 3 A husband. 4 Spring. 5 A precious stone; in which case it is compounded with सूर्य्य, चन्द्र or अयस्, as सूर्य्यकान्त a crystal lens, &c. f. (-न्ता) 1 A wife, a mistress, any beloved or lovely woman. 2 A plant, commonly Priyangu: see प्रियङ्गु. 3 A grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) n. (-न्तं) 1 Iron. 2 Saffron. E. कम to desire, affix क्त.
9892: कान्तता f. (-ता) Loveliness, beauty, splendor. E. कान्त pleasing, &c. तल् aff.
9893: कान्तपक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A peacock. E. कान्त beautiful, पक्षिन् a bird.
9894: कान्तपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Mountain ebony, &c. (Bauhinia variegata.) E. कान्त, and पुष्प flower.
9895: कान्तलक m. (-कः) A tree, the wood of which something resembles mahogany, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna, Rox.) E. कान्त, beauty, and र what gives, कन् added, and र changed to ल.
9896: कान्ताङ्घ्रिदोहद m. (-दः) A tree, commonly Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.) E. कान्ता a woman, अङ्ग्नि a foot, and दोहद desire; the tree being supposed to blossom upon coming in contact with the foot of a handsome female.
9897: कान्ताचरणदोहद m. (-दः) The tree Aśoka: see the preceding.
9898: कान्तायस n. (-सं) Iron stone: see अयस्कान्त. E. कान्त, and अयस् iron, अण् added.
9899: कान्तार mn. (-रः-रं) 1 A bad or difficult road. 2 A wood, a forest. 3 A hole, a cavity. m. (-रः) 1 A red variety of the sugar cane. 2 A bamboo. 3 Mountain ebony. n. (-रं) 1 A symptom or symptomatic disease. 2 A lotus. f. (-री) A sort of sugar cane. E. कान् for कञ्चित् any one, here meaning no one, तृ to go, in the causal form, अच् affix; allowing none to pass; or क pleasure, &c. अन्त end, and ऋ to go, अण् aff.
9900: कान्तारक m. (-कः) A sort of sugar cane. E. कान्त good, excellent, (juice,) ऋ to go, to gain, अण् and कन् affixes: see the preceding.
9901: कान्तारग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes into or in a wood. E. कान्तार, and ग who goes.
9902: कान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Beauty, splendor, light. 2 Female beauty. 3 Wish, desire. 4 A lovely or desirable woman. 5 Personal decoration or embellishment. E. कम to desire or be desired, क्तिन् aff.
9903: कान्तिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Beautifying, illumining, making handsome or splendid. E. कान्ति, and कर what makes.
9904: कान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Beautifying, illuminating. n. (-दं) Bile, the bilious humour. E. कान्ति light, splendor, &c. and द what gives.
9905: कान्तिदायक mfn. (-यकः-यिका-यकं) Beautifying, adorning. n. (-कं) A kind of Curcuma, from the root of which a yellow die is pared, (C. Zanthorhiza.) E. कान्ति beauty, &c. दायक distributor, giver.
9906: कान्तिभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Handsome, beautiful. 2 Bright, shining. E. कान्ति, and भृत् what has.
9907: कान्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Splendid. 2 Beautiful. E. कान्ति, and मतुप् aff.
9908: कान्तिहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Dimming, dulling, making dull or ugly. E. कान्ति, and हर what removes.
9909: कान्दव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Roasted or baked, (in an iron pan or oven, as bread, cakes, &c.) E. कन्दु and अण् aff.
9910: कान्दविक m. (-कः) A baker. E. कान्दव baked bread, and ठक् aff.
9911: कान्दिशीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Flying, running away, put to flight. E. कदि to fear, घञ् and इन् affixed, कन्दि; शीक to go, to ooze, घञ् affix, कन्दिशीक; and again, अण् affix, कान्दिशीक.
9912: कान्यकुञ्ज m. (-जः) A country, the modern Kanouj; also कन्यकुब्ज
9913: कान्यजा f. (-जा) A kind of perfume, commonly Nali.
9914: कापटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Wicked, bad, perverse. 2 Fraudulent, dishonest. m. (-कः) 1 A student, a scholar. 2 A flatterer, a parasite. E. कपट fraud, &c. ठक् aff.
9915: कापट्य n. (-ट्यं) Wickedness, fraud, dishonesty. E. कपट, and ष्यञ् aff.
9916: कापथ m. (-थः) A bad road. E. का for कु bad, vile, and पथिन् a road.
9917: कापाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Cranial, relating to the skull. m. (-लः) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) n. (-लं) A sort of leprosy. E. कपाल and अण् aff.
9918: कापालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the skull. m. (-कः) A worshipper of ŚIVA of the left-hand order, characterised by carrying a half of the skull as a cup, drinking spirituous liquors, &c. E. कपाल, and ठञ् aff.
9919: कापिल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Of a tawny colour. m. (-लः) 1 A follower of the Sāṃkhya system of philosophy. E. कपिल the founder of the school, and अण् affix. 2 Tawny, (the colour.) E. अण् pleonastic, added to कपिल, q. v.
9920: कापिश n. (-शं) A spirituous liquor, wine. f. (-शी) A country. E. कपिश brown, and अण् aff.
9921: कापिशायन m. (-नः) 1 A deity. 2 A kind of vinous liquor. n. (-नं) Honey. f. (-नी) A grape. E. कपिश brown, or कापिशी a country, and ष्फक् aff.
9922: कापिशेय m. (-यः) A Piśāca, an imp or goblin. E. कपिश, and ढक् aff.
9923: कापुरुष m. (-षः) A mean contemptible man, a coward, a wretch. E. का for कु bad, vile, पुरुष a man.
9924: कापुरुषत्व n. (-त्वं) Meanness, cowardliness. E. त्व added to the preceding: also with तल्, कापुरुषता.
9925: कापेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging to or relating to a monkey. E. कपि a monkey, and ढक् aff.
9926: कापोत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Of a dirty white colour. m. (-तः) 1 Natron, fossile alkali. 2 Antimony, considered as a collyrium or application to the eyes. 3 A pale or dirty white colour. n. (-तं) A flock of pigeons. E. कपोत a pigeon, &c. अण् aff.
9927: कापोताञ्जन n. (-नं) Antimony, especially considered as a collyrium. E. कपोत a pigeon, and अञ्जन a collyrium.
9928: काप्यकर m. (-रः) A penitent, one who acknowledges his faults. E. का for कु bad, आप्य having obtained, and कर who does; from कृ and अच्.
9929: काप्यकार m. (-रः) 1 Avowal or confession of sin. 2 A penitent, one who confesses a crime. E. as before, affix अण्.
9930: काफल m. (-लः) A bitter seed: see कट्फल. E. का bad, and फल fruit.
9931: काम m. (-मः) 1 KĀMA the Hindu Cupid or deity of love. 2 Wish, desire. 3 BALARĀMA the brother of KṚṢṆA. 4 The mango tree. f. (-मा) Love, desire. n. (-मं) 1 Semen virile. 2 An object of desire. 3 Willingly, voluntarily. 4 A particle of assent or agreement: see कामम्, ind. (in composition,) Following one's own desire, as कामवाद speaking what one lists; कामभक्ष eating whatever one likes; कामचार doing whatever one chooses; in law, a child previous to the imposition of the characteristic cord is all these. E. कम to desire, घञ् aff.
9932: कामकला f. (-ला) RATI the wife of KĀMA. E. काम, and कला a part.
9933: कामकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Following the dictates of passion or desire. E. काम, and कामिन् desirous.
9934: कामकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Following one's inclinations. m. (-रः) Desire, the operation or influence of desire. E. काम, and कार act, who acts.
9935: कामकारतस् ind. According to one's desires, following one's inclinations, indulging desire. E. कामकार and तसि aff.
9936: कामकूट m. (-टः) 1 The paramour of a harlot, a cully. 2 Wanton caresses, harlotry. E. काम desire, and कूट a peak or summit.
9937: कामकेलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Libidinous, wanton. m. (-लिः) 1 Copulation. 2 Amorous sport. E. काम love desire, केलि play, sport.
9938: कामग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Acting as one pleases. E. काम, and ग who goes.
9939: कामगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going as one lists. E. काम the wish, and गामिन् who goes.
9940: कामगुण m. (-णः) 1 Passion, affection. 2 An object of sense. 3 Completion, satiety, perfect enjoyment. E. काम desire, and गुण a quality or property.
9941: कामङ्गामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going as one lists. E. कामं at will, and गामिन् who goes.
9942: कामचार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Following one's own pleasure, unchecked, unrestrained. m. (-रः) Following one's own wishes or pleasure, sensuality, selfishness. E. काम, and चार practice.
9943: कामचारतस् ind. According to one's own inclinations. E. तसि added to the last.
9944: कामचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Desirous, libidinous. 2 Self-willed, m. (-री) 1 A sparrow. A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. E. काम desire, and चारिन् who goes, from चर with णिनि affix; also with ण्वुल् affix, कामचारक.
9945: कामज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced or caused by passion or desire. m. (-जः) The son of KĀMA. E. काम, and ज born; also कामजनित, कामोत्पन्न, &c.
9946: कामजान m. (-नः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. काम, and जान what produces, from जन in the causal form, and घञ् affix; also read कामजनि.
9948: कामठ (-ठः) A tortoise. E. कमठ the same, अण् pleonasm.
9949: कामतस् ind. 1 Willingly, consentingly. 2 Passionately. E. काम and तसि aff.
9950: कामताल m. (-लः) The Kokila, or Koïl, the Indian cuckoo. E. काम, and ताल a musical strain; the song of the Koïl being poetically considered as an incentive to love.
9951: कामद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Giving what is wished, granting one's desires. f. (-दा) A fabulous cow, the cow of plenty. E. काम desire, and द what gives.
9952: कामदुघा f. (-घा) The cow of plenty. E. काम, and दुह to yield milk, affix कप्.
9953: कामदुह् f. (-धुक्) 1 The cow of plenty. E. काम, and दुह to give milk, क्विस् aff.
9954: कामदूती f. (-ती) 1 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 The female koïl. E. काम desire, and दूती a messenger; also कामदूति and कामदूतिका.
9955: कामध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A name of ŚIVA. E. काम CUPID, and ध्वंसिन् an enemy.
9956: कामन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lustful, libidinous, desirous. f. (-ना) Wish, desire. E. कम to desire, and युच् aff.
9957: कामन्धमिन् m. (-मी) A brazier. E. काम willingly, ध्मा to blow, णिनि aff.
9958: कामपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A name of RATI. E. काम KANDARPA, and पत्नी a wife.
9959: कामपाल m. (-लः) A name of BALARĀMA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. E. काम KĀMA, and पाल who cherishes; being by one legend the paternal uncle of that deity.
9960: कामप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Granting what is desired. E. काम, and प्रद what yields.
9961: कामबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound by love. n. (-द्धं) A wood. E. काम and बद्ध tied.
9962: कामभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Eating any thing or every thing. E. काम, and भक्ष who eats.
9963: कामभक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Eating any thing. E. काम, and भक्ष्य to be eaten.
9964: कामम् ind. A particle, 1 Of reluctant assent, (well, very well.) 2 Of assent, (willingly, readily.) 3 Of agreement, (very well, so be it.) 4 Of contempt or invidious remark. 5 Agreeably to desire, following the inclination: see काम.
9965: काममह m. (-हः) The day of full moon in the month Chaitra, (March-April.) E. काम the deity, and मह worship; a festival in honour of KĀMA.
9966: काममालिन् m. (-ली) A name of GAṆEŚA.
9967: कामयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Libidinous, lustful, desirous. E. कम to desire, in the causal form, and तृच् aff.
9968: कामरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) 1 Pleasing, beautiful. 2 Taking any or every shape at will. m. (-पः) A district lying east of Bengal, the western portion of Asam. E. काम desire, and रूप form or figure.
9969: कामरूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Pleasing, beautiful. 2 Taking any shape at will. m. (-पी) 1 A Vidyādhara, a kind of subordinate deity. 2 A pole cat. E. काम desire, will, रूप form, and इनि aff.
9970: कामरेखा f. (-खा) A harlot, a courtezan. E. काम desire, and रेखा a line.
9971: कामल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Libidinous, cupidinous. mf. (-लः-ला) A complaint, jaundice, excessive secretion or obstruction of bile. m. (-लः) 1 Spring. 2 A dry and sterile soil. E. काम desire, ला to bring, ड aff.
9972: कामलता f. (-ता) 1 Membrum virile. 2 A plant, (Ipomaea quamoclit.) E. काम, and लता creeper.
9973: कामलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Overcome with desire or passion. E. काम, and लोल agitated.
9974: कामवल्लभ m. (-भः) 1 The mango tree. 2 Spring. f. (-भा) Moonlight. E. काम, and वल्लभ friend.
9975: कामवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Saying any thing at pleasure. E. काम, and वाद speech.
9976: कामविहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Disappointing, preventing. E. काम, and विहन्तृ who destroys.
9977: कामवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Licentious, dissipated, debauched. E. काम, and वृत्त practising.
9978: कामवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 A shrub, commonly Kāmaja, of supposed aphrodisial properties. 2 Increase of passion or desire. E. काम, and वृद्धि increase.
9979: कामवृन्ता f. (-न्ता) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. काम, and वृन्ता a flower stalk.
9980: कामशर m. (-रः) 1 The shaft of KĀMADEVA. 2 The mango. E. काम, and शर an arrow.
9981: कामसंयोग m. (-गः) Attainment of desired objects. E. काम, and संयोग union.
9982: कामसख m. (-खः) 1 Spring. 2 The mango. E. काम and सखि a friend.
9983: कामसुत m. (-तः) A name of ANIRUDDHA. E. काम, and सुत a son; also similar compounds, as कामपुत्र, &c.
9984: कामहैतुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of one's own accord. E. काम, हेतु cause, वुञ् aff.
9985: कामाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Passion, lust, violent desire. E. काम, and अग्नि fire.
9986: कामाङ्कुश m. (-शः) 1 A finger nail. 2 Membrum virile. E. काम, and अङ्कुश shoot.
9987: कामाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) E. काम, and अङ्ग the body or form.
9988: कामातुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) In love, affected by love or desire. E. काम, and आतुर diseased.
9989: कामात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 1 Licentious, libidinous. 2 Desiring, wishing for. E. काम, and आत्मन् self.
9990: कामात्मता f. (-ता) 1 Passion, lust. 2 Wish, desire. E. कामात्म and तल् aff.
9991: कामाधिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Influenced or overcome by love. E. काम, and अधिष्ठित placed over.
9992: कामाधिकार m. (-रः) 1 The influence of passion or desire. 2 The aspiration of the will. 3 The part of the Śāstra which relates to human wishes or desires. E. काम, and अधिकार superintendence.
9993: कामानल m. (-लः) Passion, lust, violent desire. E. काम, and अनल fire.
9994: कामान्ध m. (-न्धः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. काम, and अन्ध blind.
9995: कामायुध n. (-धं) An arrow of KĀMADEVA. m. (-धः) 1 Membrum virile. 2 The mango tree. E. काम, and आयुध a weapon.
9996: कामायुस् m. (-युः) Name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU. E. काम, and आयुस् life; existing at will.
9997: कामारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A handsome grove or wood. E. काम desirable, and अरण्य a forest.
9998: कामारि m. (-रिः) A mineral substance used in medicine, a sort of pyrites: see विटमाक्षिक. E. काम love, and अरि an enemy.
9999: कामार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) In love, afflicted by love or passion. E. काम, and आर्त्त pained.
10000: कामालु m. (-लुः) A red sort of mountain ebony.
10001: कामावसाय m. (-यः) Coldness, stoicism, mortification or suppression of the passions. E. काम, and अवसाय destruction.
10002: कामावसायिता f. (-ता) The power of suppressing desire, self-denial or mortification. E. कामावसायिन् and तल् affix, or with त्व, कामावसायित्व n. (-त्वं).
10003: कामावसायितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what suppresses or destroys passion or desire. E. काम, and अवसायितृ destroying.
10004: कामावसायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Destructive of love or desire, one who suppresses desire, &c. E. कामावसाय and इनि aff.
10005: कामासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Impassioned, in love, overcome with desire or passion. E. काम, and आसक्त attached.
10006: कामासक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Passion, desire. E. काम, and आसक्ति attachment.
10007: कामि m. (-मिः) A libidinous man, a lecher. f. (-मिः) A name of RATI the wife of KĀMA. E. कम to desire, कि affix; the pen. becomes long.
10008: कामिक m. (-कः) A kind of wild duck. E. कन् added to the preceding.
10009: कामिता f. (-ता) Love, desire. E. कामिन् and तल् affix; also with त्व, कामित्व.
10010: कामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Impassioned, fond, loving, wanton. 2 Cupidinous, desirous. m. (-मी) 1 The moon. 2 A lover, an uxorious husband. 3 The ruddy goose. 4 A pigeon. 5 A sparrow. f. (-नी) 1 A loving or affectionate woman. 2 A timid woman. 3 A woman in general. 4 Spirituous liquor. 5 A climbing plant. E. कम to desire, and णिनि aff.
10011: कामिनीश m. (-शः) A plant, (Morunga guilandina, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन.
10012: कामील m. (-लः) A kind of betel, commonly रामगुवाक. E. काम desire, ईलच् aff.
10013: कामुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Cupidinous, desirous, lustful, libidinous. m. (-कः) 1 A plant, Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.) 2 A creeping plant, (Gaertnera racemosa.) 3 A sparrow. 4 A bow. f. (-का) A woman desirous of wealth, food, &c. (-की) A woman libidinous or lustful. E. कम to desire, उकञ् affix, fem. टाप् or ङीष्.
10014: कामोदक n. (-कं) Oblation of water to deceased friends, &c. exclusive of those for whom it is directed by law. E. काम will, and उदक water; being given according to the inclination of the giver.
10015: कामोदा f. (-दा) A Rāgiṇī, one of the female personifications of the musical modes.
10016: कामोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overcome with passion or desire. E. काम, and उपहत struck.
10017: काम्पिल m. (-लः) A country believed to be situated in the north of India: see काम्पिल्ल, &c. f. (-ली) The capital city of that region.
10018: काम्पिल्य m. (-ल्यः) 1 A perfume, commonly Sunda Rocani. 2 A country: see the preceding; also काम्पिल्ल, &c.
10019: काम्पिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 Sunda Rocani, a perfume and drug so called. 2 The name of a country said to be in the north-west of India. E. कपि to tremble or shake, इल्ल affix; also काम्पिल or काम्पील, काम्पिल्य, &c.
10021: काम्पील m. (-लः) See काम्पिल and काम्पिल्ल; also काम्पीलक.
10022: काम्बल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Clothed with a blanket, &c. m. (-लः) A car covered with a woollen cloth or blanket. E. कम्बल a blanket, अण् aff.
10024: काम्बविक m. (-कः) A dealer in shells, a vender of ornaments made of them, &c. E. कम्बु a shell, ठक् aff.
10025: काम्बुका f. (-का) A plant, (Physalis flexuosa:) see अश्वगन्धा.
10026: काम्बोज m. (-जः) 1 A native of Kāmboja, a foreign race going like the Yavanas, with the whole of the head shaved, one of the tribes originally Kṣatriya, but degraded by omission of the essential rites. 2 A horse of the breed of Kamboya or Kamboja. 3 A white mimosa. 4 A tree, commonly Punnag, (Rottleria tinctoria.) f. (-जी) 1 A plant, commonly Maṣāni: see माषपर्णी. 2 A white mimosa, as above. 3 The Gunja plant. E. कम्बोज Kamboja or Kamboya, a country in the north of India, अण and ङीष् affix: the plants, &c. being supposed indigenous to that district.
10027: काम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Agreeable, desirable, amiable. 2 Performed through the desire of some advantage, (a religious ceremony, &c.) 2 Optional, supererogatory, performed for some particular object, and opposed to the नित्यकर्म्म or fixed and indispensable observance. 4 Relating to desire, will, &c. 5 Done through lust or passion. E. काम desire, love, &c. and यत् aff.
10028: काम्यगिर् f. (-गीः) A pleasing sound, an agreeable speech or song. E. काम्य, and गिर् speech.
10029: काम्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Supererogation, will, pleasure. 2 Love, desire. E. काम्य, and त्व affix; also with तल्, काम्यता.
10030: काम्यदान n. (-नं) 1 An acceptable or desirable gift. 2 A voluntary gift. E. काम्य, and दान a gift.
10031: काम्यमरण n. (-णं) Voluntary death, suicide. E. काम्य, and मरण dying.
10032: काम्याभिप्राय m. (-यः) The purpose of deriving benefit from any act. E. काम्य, and अभिप्राय intention.
10033: काम्ल mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं) Slightly acid, acidulous. E. का dimin. अम्ल sour.
10034: काय mn. (-यः-यं) The body. n. (-यं) 1 Part of the hand sacred to the creator; the root of the little finger. 2 Clarified butter or any oblation to BRAHMĀ. m.
