10636: कुटीर m. (-रः) A small house, a hut, a hovel. E. कुटी a house, and र aff.
10637: कुटुङ्कक m. (-कः) 1 An arbour or bower, formed of creeping plants. 2 A thatch, a roof. 3 A hut, a cottage. 4 A creeper winding round a tree. E. कुट to be crooked, क affix, कुट and अङ्ग the body, with कन् added; the form is irr.; also कुटङ्कक.
10638: कुटुम्ब r. 10th cl. (कुटुम्बयते) To support a family.
10639: कुटुम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A name. 2 A kinsman, a relation by descent. 3 A connexion, a relation by the mother's side by marriage, &c. 4 Offspring, progeny. 5 Family, race. E. कुटुम्ब to support a family, and अच् aff.
10640: कुटुम्बक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Being of one family. n. (-कं) A family, a kindred. E. कन् added to the last.
10641: कुटुम्बव्यापृत m. (-तः) A provident and attentive father of a family. E. कुटुम्ब kindred, and व्यापृत one who manages.
10642: कुटुम्बिता f. (-ता) Family connexion or union, living as one family. E. कुटुम्बिन्, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कुटिम्बित्व.
10643: कुटुम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) 1 A peasant, a cultivator of the soil. 2 One who supports or has a family. m. (-म्बी) A householder, a pater-familias. f. (-म्बिनी) 1 The wife of a householder and mother of a family, a matron. 2 A small shrub used in medicine, a kind of moon plant: see क्षीरिणी. E. कुटुम्ब kindred, &c. and इनि poss. aff.
10644: कुटुम्बार्थ n. adj. (-र्थं) For the support or on account of a family. E. कुटुम्ब, and अर्थ object.
10645: कुटुम्बौकस् n. (-कः) Apartments, &c. appropriated to the accommodation of relations, &c. E. कुटुम्ब kindred, and ओकस् a house.
10646: कुटेर m. (-रः) A hut, a cottage. E. कुट to be crooked, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
10647: कुट्ट r. 10th cl. (कुट्टयति) 1 To cut, to divide. 2 To grind or pound. 3 To censure. 1st cl. (कुट्टति) 10th cl. (कुट्टयति) To heat, some make this root कुट.
10648: कुट्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What cuts. 2 What pounds or grinds. m. (-कः) 1 A power in arithmetic or algebra, a quantity such,  that a given number being multiplied by it, and the product added to a given quantity, the sum may be divisible without remainder by a given divisor. 2 A kingfisher. E. कुट्ट to pound, वुन् aff.
10649: कुट्टकव्यवहार m. (-रः) That branch of arithmetic which treats of the Kuṭṭaka: see the last. E. कुट्टक, and व्यवहार practice; also कुट्टकाध्याय or chapter.
10650: कुट्टन n. (-नं) 1 Pounding, grinding, cutting, dividing. 2 Abusing. f. (-नी) A bawd, a procuress, a go-between. E. कुट्ट to cut, ल्युट् and ङीष् affs.
10651: कुट्टमित n. (-तं) One of the ten graces of women, affected repulse of a lover's caresses.
10652: कुट्टाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) What cuts or divides. E. कुट्ट to cut, षाकन aff.
10653: कुट्टार m. (-रः) A mountain. n. (-रं) 1 Pleasure. 2 A blanket. adv. Only, merely. (केवले) This word is also written कुट्टीर and कुठार, but perhaps inaccurately.
10654: कुट्टिन् mfn. (-ट्टी-ट्टिनी-टि) What cuts or pounds. f. (-नी) A bawd, a procures. E. कुट्ट cutting, इनि aff.
10655: कुट्टिम mn. (-मः-मं) 1 A jewel mine. 2 Ground smoothed and plastered. 3 Ground prepared for the site of a mansion. 4 A hut, a cottage. 5 The pomegranate. E. कुट्ट to cut or pierce, and इमच् aff.
10656: कुट्टिहारिका f. (-का) A female servant, a slave: see कुटहारिका.
10657: कुट्टीर m. (-रः) A mountain: see कुट्टार.
10658: कुट्मल mn. (-लः-लं) An opening bud. n. (-लं) One of the hells in which sinners are punished, where they are bound with ropes. E. कुट to be curved, and क्मलच् Uṇādi affix, or कल affix, with मुट् inserted.
10659: कुठ (इ,) कुठि 1st cl. (कुण्ठति) To be idle. r. 10th cl. (कुण्ठयति) To surround; अप् is usually prefixed.
10660: कुठ m. (-ठः) A tree. E. कु the earth, and स्था to abide, ड affix; earth-abiding; the deriv. is irregular, and is sometimes written कुट, derived from कुट to be crooked, to bend or wave, affix क.
10661: कुठर m. (-रः) The post round which the string of the churning stick winds: see कुटर. E. कुट to surround, करन् aff.
10662: कुठाकु m. (-कुः) A bird; the woodpecker. E. कुठ for कुट to cut, and आकुः Uṇādi aff.
10663: कुठाटङ्क m. (-कः) An axe. E. कुठ a tree, आङ् prefixed to टकि to bind, and अच् aff.
10664: कुठार mf. (-रः-री) 1 An axe. 2 A sort of hoe or spade. m. (-रः) A tree. E. कुठ a tree, and ऋ to go, affix अण्.
10665: कुठारिका f. (-का) A small one or adze; also a similarly shaped instrument used in surgery for scarification. E. कन् added to the preceding.
10666: कुठारु m. (-रुः) 1 A tree. 2 A monkey, an ape. 3 An armourer. E. कुठ a tree, ऋ to go, affix ञुण्.
10667: कुठि m. (-ठिः) 1 A mountain. 2 A tree. E. कुठ to surround, and इः Uṇādi aff.
10668: कुठिक m. (-कः) A kind of costus, commonly, Cuṭh, (Costus speciosus.)
10669: कुठेर m. (-रः) 1 A name of fire. 2 Tulasi or basil: see the next. E. कुठ to surround, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
10670: कुठेरक m. (-कः) 1 Holy basil, (Ocimum sanctum:) see पणास. 2 A white sort of the same, (Ocimum gratissimum.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
10671: कुठेरज m. (-जः) A white species of basil; also कुठेरक.
10672: कुठेरु m. (-रुः) The wind of a fan or Chowrie.
10673: कुड (शि) r. 6th cl. (कुडति) 1 To play or act as a child, to trifle. 2 To eat. 3 To heap. (इ,) कुडि r. 1st cl. (कुंडति) 1 To confound or disorder with grief or pain. 2 To form, to make. 3 (कुण्डते) To burn, to heat. r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंडति कुण्डयति) To preserve.
10674: कुडप m. (-पः) A measure: see the next.
10675: कुडव m. (-वः) A measure of grain, wood, iron, &c. the fourth part of a Prastha, described by some as a vessel four fingers wide, and as many deep, and containing twelve Prakṛtis or handfuls: it is also said to contain thirteen and a half cubic Aṅgulas; or to be a finger and a half deep, and three fingers each length and breadth. In medicine it is equal to two Prakṛtis or thirty-two Tolakas. E. कुड to heap, कवन् affix; also कुडप and कुटप.
10676: कुडि m. (-डिः) The body. E. कुड to burn, इ Uṇādi aff.
10677: कुडिका f. (-का) An earthen or wooden water pot used by ascetics.
10678: कुडिश m. (-शः) A fish, commonly Kūrci, (Cyprinus curchius, HAM.)
10679: कुडुप m. (-पः) The clasp or fastening of a necklace or bracelet.
10680: कुड्मल m. (-लः) A new bud: see कुट्मल.
10681: कुड्मलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Budded, blossomed. 2 Cheerful, smiling, (as the countenance.) E. कुद्मल and इतच् aff.
10682: कुड्य n. (-ड्यं) 1 A wall. 2 Anointing, plastering, 3 Eagerness, curiosity. E. कु to sound, and ड्यन् affix, or कुड to heap, &c. and क्यप् affix; also कूड्य.
10683: कुड्यक n. (-कं) A wall: see the preceding, कन् being added.
10684: कुड्यच्छेदिन् m. (-दी) A thief, a housebreaker. E. कुड्य a wall, and छेदिन् who cuts or breaks.
10685: कुड्यच्छेद्य n. (-द्यं) An opening, a hole in a wall, a breach. E. कुड्य a wall, and छेट्ट्य to be broken.
10686: कुड्यमत्स्य mf. (-त्स्यः-त्स्यी) A house lizard. E. कुड्य a wall, and मत्स्य a fish.
10687: कुण r. 6th cl. (कुणति) 1 To sound. 2 To cherish, to support or aid with gifts, &c. 3 To be in pain. r. 10th cl. (कुणयति) 1 To converse with, to speak to or address. 2 To counsel or advise.
10688: कुणप mn. (-पः-पी-पं) Foul smelling, stinking. mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A dead body, a corpse. m. (-पः) 1 A stink, a foul smell. 2 A spear. f. (-पी) A small bird, a kind of Maina or Sārika: see विट्सारिका. E. क्वण to sound, कपन् affix, व is changed to its congener उ; sound proceeding from the corpse, &c. by the escape of the vital air, &c.
10689: कुणाल m. (-लः) The name of a country. E. क्वण to sound, कालन् Uṇādi affix, व becomes उ.
10690: कुणि m. (-णिः) 1 A cripple with a crooked or withered arm, or without a hand or finger; कूणि. 2 The Tūn tree, (Cedrela tunna:) also तुणि. 3 A whitlow. E. कुण to sound, कि aff.
10691: कुणिन्द m. (-न्दः) Sound, sounding. E. क्वण to sound, किन्दच् aff.
10692: कुण्टक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fat, corpulent. E. कुटि to be crooked, क्वन् aff.
10693: कुण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) 1 Indolent, lazy, slow. 2 Stupid, foolish, a fool. E. कुठि to be slothful, &c. affix अच्.
10694: कुण्ठक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A fool, stupid, ignorant. E. कन् added to the former.
10695: कुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grasped, held. 2 Encircled. 3 Stupid. E. कुठि and क्त aff.
10696: कुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A son born in adultery, the son of a woman by another man than her husband, while the husband is alive. n. (-ण्डं) 1 A hole in the ground for receiving and preserving consecrated fire. 2 A pool, a well, a spring or basin of water, especially consecrated to some holy purpose or person. 2 A measure. mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) A pitcher. f. (-ण्डी) A student's water-pot, made of a hollow cocoanut, &c. E. कुडि to preserve, ड aff.
10697: कुण्डकीट m. (-टः) 1 A follower of the Cārvāka doctrine, or the tenets of those sects who deny the authority of the Vedas. 2 The son of a woman of the Brahminical tribe born in adultery, particularly with a man of an inferior caste. 3 A keeper of concubines, a man who has female slaves. E. कुण्ड a pool, &c. and कीट a worm, a reptile.
10698: कुण्डकील m. (-लः) A low, vile man: see नागर.
10700: कुण्डगोलक m. (-कः) Sour rice gruel: see काञ्जिक. E. कुण्ड a pitcher, गुड to preserve, ण्वुल् affix, ड is changed to ल.
10701: कुण्डङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) An arbour, a bower. E. कुडि to preserve, अङ्गच् aff.
10702: कुण्डपाय्य m. (-य्यः) A sacrifice, an oblation. E. कुण्ड, and पाय्य to be imbibed.
10703: कुण्डल n. (-लं) 1 An earring. 2 A bracelet. 3 A fetter, a tie, a collar. f. (-ली) 1 Mountain ebony: see काञ्चन. 2 Gurūci, a plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची. 3 Cowach. E. कुडि to preserve, कलच् aff.
10704: कुण्डलधारण n. (-णं) Wearing earrings. E. कुण्डल, and धारण having.
10705: कुण्डलधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wearing earrings. E. कुण्डल, and धारिन् who has.
10706: कुण्डलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having an earring. m. (-ली) 1 A name of VARUṆA regent of the water. 2 A snake. 3 A peacock. 4 The spotted or painted deer. f. (-नी) 1 A Śakti or form of DURGĀ, worshipped by the Tāntrikas. 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 Curds boiled with Ghee and spices. E. कुण्डल an earring, and इनि affix; the rings on the snake, the eyes in the peacock's tail, &c., being compared to this ornament.
10707: कुण्डाशिन् m. (-शी) 1 A pander, a pimp. 2 One who is supported by a bastard. E. कुण्ड, अश to eat, and इनि aff.
10708: कुण्डिका f. (-का) 1 A student's waterpot, the Kamandalu. 2 A pitcher. E. कुण्ड a pitcher, &c. कन् added with the fem. aff.
10709: कुण्डिन n. (-नं) A city; also Vidarbhā, the capital of Vidarbha the father-in-law of Nala Rājā, apparently the modern Condavir. m. plur. (-नाः) The people of Kundina. m. (-नः) The name of a saint. E. कुडि to preserve, इनच् Uṇādi aff.
10710: कुण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) A bastard: see कुण्ड. E. कुण्ड and इनि aff.
10711: कुण्डीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Able, powerful. m. (-रः) A man.
10712: कुतनु mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु) Deformed. m. (-नुः) A name of KUVERA. E. कु bad, vile, and तनु body, this deity being of a monstrous appearance, having three legs and but eight teeth.
10713: कुतप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Slightly hot, mild, tepid. mn. (-पः-पं) 1 The eighth Muhūrta or portion of the day, from the last Daṇḍa of the second watch to the first of the third or about noon; an eligible time for the performance of sacrifices to the manes. 2 A daughter's son. 3 A musical instrument. 4 A sort of blanket made of the hair of the mountain goat. 5 Sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) m. (-पः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 A twice born man, one of the three first classes. 4 A guest. 5 A sister's son. 6 An ox. E. कु the earth, and तप what warms, or कु diminutive, and तप heat; the sun being on the decline, &c.
10714: कुतपसप्तक n. (-कं) A Śrāddha in which seven constituents occur, noon, a horn platter, a Nepal blanket, silver, sacrificial grass, sesamum and kine. E. कुतप, and सप्तक sevenfold.
10715: कुतश्चन् ind Anywhere, somewhere. E. चन added to कुतस्.
10716: कुतश्चित् ind. Somewhere or other. E. चित् added to कुतस्.
10717: कुतस् ind. Implying interrogation, 2 How, what. 2 How, in what way, how should it be thus, &c. implying denial or concealment of knowledge. 3 Whence, from what place. E. कु for किम् what, and तसिल् aff.
10718: कुतस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Whence come, how happened. E. त्यप् added to the last.
10719: कुतुक n. (-कं) 1 Eagerness, vehemence. 2 Desire, inclination. 3 Curiosity. E. कुत a particular sound, कै to emit sound, ड affix; also कौतुक.
10720: कुतुप m. (-पः) A small leathern oil bottle. mn. (-पः-पं) The eighth hour of the day: see कुतप. E. कुतू as below, and उपच् aff.
10721: कुतू f. (-तूः) A leathern oil bottle. E. कु bad, and तन to spread, डु affix, and the final lengthened.
10722: कुतूणक m. (-कः) Weakness of the eyes in infants; also read कुकूणक.
10723: कुतूहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Excellent, best, praised, celebrated. 3 Surprising, wonderful. n. (-लं) Eagerness, vehemence, impetuosity. 2 Desire, inclination. 3 Curiosity. E. कु bad, तूल to send forth, क affix, and ह inserted; or कुतू an oil bottle, and हल to make lines or furrows; or कु the earth, and तुद to vex or tease; the etymologies however are all fanciful; the word is also written कौतूहल.
10724: कुतूहलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Curious, inquisitive. 2 Eager, impatient. E. कुतूहल, and इनि aff.
10725: कुतृण n. (-णं) An aquatic plant, water house-leek, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. कु bad, तृण grass.
10726: कुत्र ind. Where, wherein, in what place. E. कु substituted for किं what, and त्रल् aff.
10727: कुत्रचित् ind. Somewhere. E. चित् added to कुत्र.
10728: कुत्रापि ind. Wherever, somewhere. E. कुत्र, and अपि certainly.
10729: कुत्स r. 10th cl. (कुत्सयते-ति) To despise, to abuse, to revile.
10730: कुत्सन n. (-नं) Abuse, contempt, reproach, reviling. E. कुत्स to revile, ल्युट् aff.
10731: कुत्सला f. (-ला) The indigo plant: see नीली.
10732: कुत्सा f. (-त्सा) Reproach, contempt, censure. E. कुत्स to despise, अङ् and टाप् affs.
10733: कुत्सावादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Censorious, abusive. E. कुत्स, and वादिन् who speaks.
10734: कुत्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Low, vile, contemptible, contemned, reviled, &c. n. (-तं) A grass, (Cyperus.) E. कुत्स to reproach, &c., and क्त aff.
10735: कुथ r. 4th cl. (-कुथ्यति) To stink. r. 9th cl. (कुथ्नाति) 1 To be distressed: see कुन्थ. (इ) कुथि r. 1st cl. (कुंथति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To afflict, to give pain. 3 To be afflicted, to suffer pain.
10736: कुथ mf. (-थः-था) A painted or variegated cloth or blanket, serving as an elephant's housings. m. (-थः) Sacrificial or Kusa grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) E. कुथ to be connected, &c. अच् aff.
10737: कुद r. 10th cl. (ऋ) कुदृ (कोदयति) To lie, to speak falsely: see कुद्र.
10738: कुदाल m. (-लः) 1 Mountain ebony. 2 A kind of spade: see कुद्दाल.
10739: कुदृष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Having bad eyes. f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Heterodox doctrine, as that of the Sāṃkhyas, &c. 2 Weak sight. 3 Evil eye. E. कु bad, दृष्टि sight.
10741: कुद्दार m. (-रः) See the next; sometimes also written कुदार.
10742: कुद्दाल m. (-लः) 1 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) also काञ्चन. 2 A kind of spade or hoe. E. कु the earth, and दल to divide, with उत् prefixed, and अण् affix, or with दॄ to divide, कुद्दार; also कुदाल, &c.
10743: कुद्मल n. (-लं) An opening bud: see कुड्मल.
10744: कुद्य n. (-द्यं) A wall: see कुद्य.
10745: कुद्र r. 10th cl. (इ) कुद्रि (कुंद्रयति) To speak falsely, to lie: some read this root कुदृ.
10746: कुद्रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A dwelling raised on a platform or scaffold. It is sometimes written कुद्रङ्क. E. कु the earth, and द्रङ्ग what goes.
10747: कुद्रव m. (-वः) A kind of grass, the grain of which is eaten by the poor, (Paspalum scrobiculatum;) also कोद्रव. E. कु the earth, and द्रु to be fixed, अच् aff.
10748: कुध्र m. (-ध्रः) A mountain. E. कु the earth, ध्रु to be fixed, affix ड.
10749: कुनख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Having ugly nails. n. (-खं) A disease of the nails. E. कु bad, and नख a nail; also with इनि added, कुनखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि.)
10750: कुनखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Having bad or diseased nails. E. कुनख, and इनि aff.
10751: कुनट m. (-टः) A sort of trumpet flower. f. (-टी) 1 Red arsenic. 2 Coriander. E. कु the earth, and नट to dance, to be; also कुलटी.
10752: कुनलिन् m. (-ली) A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora:) E. कु bad, नल a stalk, and इनि aff.
10753: कुनाभि m. (-भिः) 1 A whirlwind. 2 KUVERA'S aggregate treasure: see निधि. E. कु the world, and नाभि the navel.
10754: कुनाशक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Javāsa: see यवास. E. कु the earth, and नाशक what injures.
10755: कुनीति f. (-तिः) 1 Impolicy, misgovernment. 2 Ill conduct, misbehaviour. E. कु bad, नीति policy.
10756: कुन्त mf. (-न्तः-न्ती) 1 A bearded dart, a lance. m. (-न्तः) 1 A species of grain, (Coix barbata, Rox.) 2 A small animal, an insect. 3 Passionateness. f. (-न्तिः or -न्ती) 1 The wife of PĀṆḌU, and mother of the three elder PĀṆḌAVA princes by as many gods. 2 The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 3 Bdellium, a fragrant resin. 4 The wife of a Brahman. E. कु bad, and अन्त end, destroying ill, enemies, &c. or क the head, and उन्द to give pain, त substituted for द, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्.
10757: कुन्तल m. (-लः) 1 Hair. 2 A drinking cup. 3 Barley. 4 A plough. 5 The name of a country in the north-west of the peninsula. m. plu. (-लाः) The people of that country, the inhabitants of Kuntala. E. कुन्त a dart, and ला to bring or gain, क aff.
10758: कुन्तलिका f. (-का) A butter-knife or scoop. E. कुन्तल a cup, &c. and इकन् aff.
10759: कुन्थ r. 9th cl. (कुथ्नाति) 1 To cling to, to twine round or be connected with. 2 To be distressed. 3 To suffer pain, want, &c.: see कुथ.
10760: कुन्थु m. (-न्थुः) 1 The seventeenth of the Jinas or deified Jaina saints. 2 One of the Jaina emperors of the world.
10761: कुन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) A kind of jasmin, (J. multiflorum or pubescens.) m. (-न्दः) 1 A turner's lathe. 2 Olibanum, the resin of the Boswellia thurifera: see कुन्दरु. 3 One of KUVERA'S nine treasures. 4 The Nerium plant. E. कु to sound, दन Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted, or कु the earth, उन्द to hurt, and अण् affix; also with कन् added कुन्दक.
10762: कुन्दम m. (-मः) A cat. E. कु vile, (animals, as mice,) and दम who tames.
10763: कुन्दर m. (-रः) A sort of grass.
10764: कुन्दिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. कुन्द the jasmin, and इनि affix, fem. affix ङीप्; an assemblage like that of Kunda flowers, from the similar whiteness of the lotus.
10765: कुन्दु f. (-न्दुः) Frankincense or olibanum: see कुन्दुरु. m. (-न्दुः) A rat, a mouse. E. कु the earth, and दृ to tear or divide, डु aff.
10767: कुन्दुरु mf. (-रुः) The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, gum olibanum or frankincense. E. क BRAHMĀ, उन्द to moisten, (to bedew with incense in sacrifice,) रु affix, उक् inserted. m. (-रुः) A rat: see कुन्दु.
10768: कुन्दुरुक mf. (-कः-की) The olibanum tree, commonly Salaī or Salae, (Boswellia thurifera.) m. (-कः) The gum. E. कन् possessive or pleonastic added to कुन्दुरु, fem. affix ङीष्.
10769: कुप (इर) कुपिर r. 4th cl. (कुप्यति) To be angry, to be flushed with wrath. With प्र, to be very much enraged. r. 10th cl. (कोपयति) 1 To shine: see कूप. 2 To speak. (इ) कुपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंपति कुंपयति) 1 To spread. 2 To remember.
10770: कुपङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A slough, a heap of filth and mud. E. कु vile, पङ्क mud.
10772: कुपथ n. (-थं) 1 A bad road. 2 Immorality, profligacy. 3 Heterodox doctrine. E. कु bad, and पथिन् a road; also कापथ.
10773: कुपथगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Wicked, going in a bad or wrong road. E. कुपथ, and गामिन् who goes; also कुपथग, कुपथचर, &c.
10774: कुपथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) 1 Relating to a bad road, literally or figuratively. 2 Counter-indicated, improper, unwholesome, (as regimen, &c.) E. कु and पथ्य proper, &c.
10775: कुपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Crooked-handed, having a deformed or maimed hand. E. कु bad, and पाणि the hand.
10776: कुपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Incensed, angry, offended. E. कुप to be angry, क्त aff.
10777: कुपितवायु m. (-युः) Flatulence or hypochondria. E. कुपित, and वायु wind.
10778: कुपितान्तक m. (-कः) Imminent or threatening death. E. कुपित, and अन्तक destroyer.
10779: कुपिनिन् m. (-नी) A fisherman. E. कुपिनी a net, and इनि aff.
10780: कुपिनी f. (-नी) A kind of net or snare, for catching small fish, made of bamboos or rushes. E. गुप to cover or conceal, इनि and ङीष् affixes; ग is changed to क.
10781: कुपिन्द m. (-न्दः) A weaver. E. कुप or कुय to spread out, किन्दच् Uṇādi affix; also कुयिन्द.
10782: कुपीलु m. (-लुः) A sort of ebony tree. E. कु bad, पीलु a tree, so called.
10783: कुपुत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A son of an inferior degree, as one adopted, &c. 2 A disobedient or wicked son. E. कु, and पुत्र a son.
10784: कुपुरुष m. (-षः) 1 A low or vile man. 2 A poltroon. E. कु bad, and पुरुष a man.
10785: कुपूय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Inferior, low, vile. E. कु bad, and पूय to divide, अच् aff.
10786: कुप्य n. (-प्यं) Base metal, copper, brass, &c. or any metal except gold and silver. E. गुप to conceal or preserve, क्यप् affix; ग is changed irregularly to क.
10787: कुप्यशाला f. (-ला) A braziery, a foundery, a place where metallic vessels, &c. are made or sold. E. कुप्य base metal, शाला a dwelling, a shop, &c.
10788: कुप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Low, vile, last, worst. E. कु reverse, and प्रिय beloved; disagreeable.
10789: कुप्लव m. (-वः) A weak or frail raft or float. E. कु, and प्लव a raft.
10790: कुब r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) कुबि (कुम्बति-कुम्बयति) To cover, to hide, to clothe, to screen, &c.
10791: कुबेर m. (-रः) The deity KUVERA: see कुवेर.
10792: कुब्ज mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं) Humpbacked, crooked. m. (-ब्जः) 1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्ग. 2 A scymitar. 3 A sort of fish, (Bola cuja, HAM.) E. कु the earth, or कु ill, badly, and उज to be straight, affix अच्.
10793: कुब्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Humpbacked. m. (-कः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa:) see वारिकण्टक. E. क water, and उब्ज to be straight, affix अच्, and कन् added, or कुब्ज and कन् aff.
10794: कुब्जकण्टक m. (कः) A white mimosa. E. कुब्ज, and कण्टक a thorn.
10795: कुब्र n. (-ब्रं) 1 A forest. 2 A hole for sacrificial fire. 3 An earring. 4 A thread. 5 A cart. E. कुबि to hide, रक् Uṇādi aff.
10796: कुब्रह्म m. (-ह्मः) A degraded or contemptible Brahman, one who officiates for Śūdras. E. कु bad, ब्रह्मन् a Brahman, टच् affix; also retaining the final, कुब्रह्मन्.
10797: कुभ r. 10th cl. (इ) कुभि (कुम्भयति) To cover, to clothe, to veil or hide: see कुब.
10798: कुमार r. 10th cl. (कुमारयति) To play, especially as a child; also कुमाल.
10799: कुमार m. (-रः) 1 A boy, one under five years of age. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 3 A prince, the heir apparent, and who is associated to the empire, (in theatrical language.) 4 A horseman, a cavalier. 5 A parrot. 6 One of the attendants on the twenty-four Jinas, and also a sanctified character amongst the Jaina sect. 7 A tree, (Tapia crataeva:) see वरुण. 8 A name of the Sindhu river or Indus. n. (-रं) Pure gold. f. (-री) 1 A young girl, one from ten to twelve years old, a virgin; or in the Tantras any virgin to the age of sixteen, or as long as menstruation has not commenced. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 The central part of the universe according to Hindu geography, Jambu Dvīpa or India. 4 The most southerly of the nine portions of the known continent, or of Jambu Dvīpa, the southern extremity of the peninsula, whence Cape Comorin or Kumāri. 5 The name of a river flowing from the mountain Sactiman. 6 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता. 7 Double jasmin. 8 The aloe tree, (Aloes perfoliata:) see घृतकुमारी. 9 The Śyāmā, a bird so named. E. कुमार to play as a child, affix अच् fem. affix ङीष्.
10800: कुमारक m. (-कः) 1 A boy, a lad. 2 A tree: see वरुण. E. कन् added to the preceding.
10801: कुमारघातिन् m. (-ती) The slayer of a child. E. कुमार, हन to kill, णिनि aff.
10802: कुमारपाल m. (-लः) 1 A name of Rājā SĀLIVĀHANA. 2 Name of a king of Guzerat. E. कुमार a child, and पाल a cherisher.
10803: कुमारभृत्या f. (-त्या) Care of a pregnant or lying-in woman, midwifery. E. कुमार a child, and भृत्या cherishing.
10804: कुमारयु m. (-युः) A prince. E. कुमार a prince, या to go or be, and उ Uṇādi aff.
10805: कुमारवाहिन् m. (-ही) A peacock. E. कुमार KĀRTTIKEYA, and वाहिन् what bears; this god being usually represented riding on a peacock.
10806: कुमारसू f. (-सूः) A name of GAṄGĀ, the river goddess. E. कुमार the god KĀRTTIKEYA, and सू a mother.
10807: कुमारिका f. (-का) 1 A girl from ten to twelve years old, or generally a virgin. 2 Double jasmin. 3 A division of the known continent. 4 Large cardamoms. 5 An insect, (Sphex Asiatica:) see कुमारी, कन् being added.
10808: कुमाल r. 10th cl. (कुमालयति) To play as a child, &c.: see कुमार.
10809: कुमालक m. (-कः) The name of a district, part of Malva: also termed Sauvīra.
10810: कुमुद् mfn. (-त् or द्) 1 Niggardly, avaricious. 2 Unkind, unfriendly. n. (-त् or -द्) 1 The esculent white water lily. 2 The red lotus. E. कु the earth, or bad, vile, मुद to be pleased, and क्विप् affix; also कुमुद.
10811: कुमुद n. (-दं) 1 The white esculent water lily, (Nymphaea esculenta.) 2 The red lotus, (N. rubra.) 3 Silver. m. (-दः) 1 The elephant of the south-west quarter. 2 One of the monkey heroes of the Rāmāyaṇa. 3 One of the Nāga or serpent race. 4 A Dānava or infernal deity. 5 Camphor. f. (-दा) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea:) see गम्भारी. (-दी) A medicinal and aromatic shrub, commonly Kāyaphal. E. कु the earth, &c. मुद to be pleased, and क aff.
10812: कुमुदबान्धव m. (-वः) The moon. E. कुमुद a lotus, and बान्धव the friend; the white esculent lotus expanding its petals during the night, and closing them in the day time; hence other similar appellations of the moon, as कुमुदवन्धु, कुमुदप्रिय, &c.
10813: कुमुदवती f. (-ती) A place abounding in water lilies, &c. see कुमुद्धती.
10814: कुमुदाकर m. (-रः) A number of water lilies or place abounding with them. E. कुमुद, and आकर a mine; also कुमुदवनं, कुमुदिनी, &c.
10815: कुमुदावास m. (-सः) A pool abounding in lotuses. E. कुमुद, and आवास a residence.
10816: कुमुदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Abounding with water lilies. E. कुमुद, and ठच् aff.
10817: कुमुदिका f. (-का) A small tree, the seeds of which are aromatic, commonly Kāyaphal: see कुमुदी, and कट्फल.
10818: कुमुदिनी f. (-नी) A place abounding in lotuses, &c. see कुमुद्धती. E. कुमुद, इनि and ङीष् aff.
10819: कुमुदिनीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. कुमुदिनी, and पति lord: see कुमुदबान्धव.
10820: कुमुदेश m. (-शः) The moon: see कुमुदबान्धव. E. कुमुद, and ईश a master.
10821: कुमुद्वत् mfn. (-द्वान्-द्वती-द्वत्) A place abounding in the flowers of the Nymphaea esculenta. f. (-ती) 1 The same. 2 A multitude of lotus flowers. 3 The flexible stalk of a water lily. 4 A sort of water lily, (Menyanthes Indica or cristata.) E. कुमुद the water lily, and मतुप् poss. affix, or वति affix of comparison, fem. ङीष्.
10822: कुमेरु m. (-रुः) The southern hemisphere or pole, the region of the demons and Titans. E. कु, and मेरु the mountain where the gods reside.
10823: कुमोदक m. (-कः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. कु the earth, मुद to delight, वुन् aff.
10825: कुम्बा f. (-म्बा) An enclosure round a place of sacrifice, to prevent profane intrusion. E. कुवि to cover, to screen or conceal, अङ् and टाप् affs.
10826: कुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A small water jar. 2 The frontal globe on the upper part of the forehead of an elephant; there are two of these projections, which swell in the rutting season. 3 A sign of the zodiac, (Aquarius.) 4 A proper name, the nephew of Rāvaṇa considered as a Rākṣasa or demon. 5 The paramour of a harlot, a bully, a flash or fancy man. 6 A religious exercise, closing the nostrils and mouth, so as to suspend breathing. 7 A measure of grain equal to twenty Droṇas, a little more than three bushels and three gallons, or a Comb: some make it two Droṇas or sixty-four Seers. n. (-भं) 1 A fragrant resin or the plant which bears it, (Bdellium.) 2 A plant commonly Teöri: see त्रिवृत्. f. (-म्भी) 1 A pot, an earthen cooking vessel, a small jar. 2 Kāyaphal, a small tree, the seeds of which are used in medicine: see कट्फल. 3 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 4 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) (-म्भा) A harlot, a whore. E. कु the earth, or base, vile, &c. उम्भ to fill, and अण् or अच् affix, deriv. irr.
10827: कुम्भक m. (-कः) Stopping the breath by shutting the mouth and closing both nostrils with the fingers of the right hand. E. कन् added to the last.
10828: कुम्भकर्ण m. (-णः) The gigantic brother of RĀVAṆA. E. कुम्भ, and कर्ण the ear.
10829: कुम्भकामला f. (-ला) A bilious affection, a sort of jaundice.
10830: कुम्भकार m. (-रः) 1 A potter. 2 A kind of wild fowl. f. (-री) 1 A mineral substance, used as an application to strengthen the eyes and beautify the eye lashes. 2 Red arsenic. 3 The wife of a potter. E. कुम्भ a jar, &c. and कार what makes, from कृ to make, and अण् aff.
10831: कुम्भकारक m. (-कः) A potter. f. (-रिका) 1 Collyrium. 2 A woman of the potter caste. E. कन् added to the last.
10832: कुम्भतुम्बी f. (-म्बी) A large round gourd. E. कुम्भ, and तुम्बी a gourd.
10833: कुम्भदासी f. (-सी) A bawd, a procuress. E. कुम्भ a bully, and दासी a female slave.
10834: कुम्भपदी f. (-दी) A woman with an enlarged leg. E. कुम्भ, and पद् for पाद a foot, fem. affix ङीष्.
10835: कुम्भपाद m. (-दः) A man with an enlarged leg. E. कुम्भ, and पाद a foot.
10836: कुम्भयोनि m. (-निः) 1 A name of AGASTYA, a saint so called. 2 Also of VAŚIṢṬHA; and, 3 Of DROṆA, the military preceptor of the Kurus and Pāṇḍus. E. कुम्भ a jar, and यानि a womb; born in a water jar, &c.
10837: कुम्भला f. (-ला) A plant, the flowers of which are compared to those of the Nauclea cadamba: see मुण्डिरी.
10838: कुम्भशाला f. (-ला) A pottery, a potter's kiln. E. कुम्भ a jar, and शाला a hall, a shop.
10839: कुम्भसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) The hollow on the top of an elephant's head, between the frontal globes. E. कुम्भ the frontal globe, and सन्धि junction.
10840: कुम्भसम्भव m. (-वः) The saint AGASTYA: see अगस्त्य. E. कुम्भ a jar, and सम्भव born.
10841: कुम्भाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A minister of the Asura, BĀṆA. mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) A pumpkin gourd: see कुष्माण्ड.
10842: कुम्भिका f. (-का) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 Trumpet flower. 3 A disease of the eyes, hordeolum or stye. E. कुम्भी as above, and कन् affix, in the fem. form.
10843: कुम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Having a water jar. 2 Shaped like a water jar, &c. E. कुम्भ, and इनि affix. m. (-म्भी) 1 An elephant. 2 A crocodile. 3 A fish. 4 A plant bearing a fragrant resin, Bdellium. E. कुम्भ as above, and इनि aff.
10845: कुम्भिमद m. (-दः) The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples at certain seasons. E. कुम्भि, and मद the exudation.
10846: कुम्भिल m. (-लः) 1 A thief. 2 A plagiarist, a paraphrast. 3 A wife's brother. 4 A fish, the gilt-head. 5 A child begotten at undue seasons, or of an imperfect impregnation. E. कुम्भ as above, and इलच् aff.
10847: कुम्भीक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, the bark of which furnishes a yellow dye, (Rottleria tinctoria:) see पुन्नाग. 2 An aquatic plant. 3 An affection of the eyes, hordeolum or stye: see कुम्भिका.
10848: कुम्भीधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain stored in jars sufficient, according to some, for six days, or to others for one year's consumption. E. कुम्भ, and धान्य grain, च्चि augment.
10849: कुम्भीधान्यक m. (-कः) A householder, preserving grain in store for six days, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
10850: कुम्भीनस m. (-सः) A large, and venomous snake. f. (-सी) The mother of LAVANA, a Rākṣasa or fiend. E. कुम्भी a pitcher, and नस derived from नासा the nose; having wide nostrils.
10851: कुम्भीपाक m. (-कः) A hell. E. कुम्भी a pot, and पाक what cooks: in which the wicked are baked like potterś vessels.
10852: कुम्भीर m. (-रः) The crocodile of the Ganges, the long nosed alligator. E. कुम्भी an elephant, and ईर what resembles; or कुम्भी a fish, and र who seizes, from रा to take or gain: or ल from ला, whence also कुम्भील.
10853: कुम्भीरमक्षिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of fly or aquatic insect. E. कुम्भीर a crocodile, and मक्षिका a fly, the crocodile fly, alluding, perhaps, to its size.
10854: कुम्भील m. (-लः) A crocodile: see कुम्भीर.
10855: कुम्भीवीज n. (-जं) The nut of the croton.
10858: कुरङ्कर m. (-रः) The Indian crane. E. कुर to sound, क aff., a sound, and कर what makes; also कुरङ्कुर.
10859: कुरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A deer, an antelope. E. कुर to sound, अङ्गच् Uṇādi aff.
10860: कुरङ्गक m. (-कः) A deer. E. कन् added to the preceding.
10861: कुरङ्गनयना f. (-ना) A handsome woman. E. कुरङ्ग, and नयना the eye, fawn-eyed.
10862: कुरङ्गम m. (-मः) A deer, an antelope.
10864: कुरट m. (-टः) A currier, a leather-seller, a shoe-maker. E. कु bad, रट to speak, अच् affix; being described as a man of low occupation.
10865: कुरण्टक m. (-कः) 1 Yellow amaranth. 2 Yellow barleria: see कुरुण्टक.
10866: कुरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Enlargement of the testicles or rather of the scrotum, including inguinal hernia, hydrocele, &c. E. कु bad, ill, रम to play, and ड aff.
10867: कुरण्डक m. (-कः) Yellow amaranth: see करुण्टक.
10868: कुरर f. (-रः-रा) An osprey; also another species of eagle. f. (-री) A sheep, an ewe. 2 A female osprey.
10869: कुररीगण m. (-णः) A flight of ospreys. E. कुररी, and गण a troop.
10870: कुरल m. (-लः) A curl, a lock of hair. 2 An osprey, see कुरुल.
10871: कुरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Having a bad voice. m. (-वः) 1 A bad or harsh sound. 2 Red or yellow amaranth: see कुरवक. E. कु bad or ill, and रव what sounds.
10872: कुरवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a bad voice, making a disagreeable sound. m. (-कः) 1 A purple sort of Jhinti or Barleria. 2 A crimson species of amaranth. E. कु bad, रव to sound, क्वुन् aff.
10873: कुरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Bad-juiced, of bad essence. m. (-सः) Spirituous or vinous liquor. f. (-सा) A wild creeping plant, a species of hieracium: see गोजिह्वा. E. कु bad, and रस juice.
10874: कुराल m. (-लः) A light bay horse, with black legs.
10875: कुरी f. (-री) A kind of grass.
10876: कुरीर n. (-रं) Copulation. E. कृ to do, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, उद् inserted.
10877: कुरु m. (-रुः) 1 Kuru or Uttara Kuru, the most northerly of the four Mahā Dvīpas, or principal divisions of the known world; by other systems it is considered as one of nine divisions or Varṣas of the same; in both cases it is the country beyond the northern-most range of mountains, extending to the frozen ocean. 2 A proper name, son of AGNĪDHRA, and grandson of PRIYAVRATA. 3 A proper name, a prince of the lunar race, son of SAṂVARAṆA by TAPATĪ; sovereign of the north-west of India or the country about Dehli, and ancestor of both PĀṆḌU and DHṚTARĀṢṬRA; the patronymic however derived from his name is most usually applied to the sons of the latter. 4 A holy place: see कुरुक्षेत्र. 5 Boiled rice. 6 Pricklynightshade: see कण्टकारिका. E. कृ to make, कु affix, and ऋ becomes उ.
10879: कुरुक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) The country near Dehli, the scene of the great battle between the Kurus and Pāṇḍus. E. कुरु the Kuru race, and क्षेत्र a field.
10880: कुरुक्षेत्रीयोग m. (-गः) A solar day, in the course of which three lunar days, three asterisms and three Yogas occur. E. कुरुक्षेत्र, and योम conjunction.
10881: कुरुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) 1 Yellow amaranth. 2 Yellow Barleria. f. (-ण्टी) 1 A doll, a puppet. 2 The wife of a Brahman or teacher. E. कु bad, रुटि to shine, affix अण्.
10882: कुरुण्टक m. (-कः) 1 Yellow or white amaranth. 2 A yellow species of Barleria, (B. prionitis.) E. कु bad, रुटि to shine, &c. ण्वुल् affix; also कुरण्टक.
10883: कुरुम्ब n. (-म्बं) A large species of orange. f. (-म्बा) Trumpet flower.
10884: कुरुराज् m. (-ट्) A name of DURYODHANA. E. कुरु the Kuru race, राज to shine, and क्विप् affix; the Kuru chief.
10885: कुरुरी f. (-री) A kind of bird with a warbling note.
10886: कुरुल m. (-लः) A curl or lock of hair, especially on the forehead.
10887: कुरुवक m. (-कः) 1 The crimson amaranth. 2 A purple species of Barleria. 3 Also a yellow kind. E. कु a little, रु to sound, क्वुन् affix, and उवङ् substituted for उ.
10888: कुरुविन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 2 A kind of barley: see कल्माष. 3 A ruby: see कुरुविल्ल. 4 Black salt. E. कुरु Kurudeśa, विन्द to gain, and शः affix; found in that country.
10889: कुरुविन्दक m. (-कः) A kind of Dolichos biflorus, a wild variety.
10890: कुरुविल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A ruby; also कुरुविल्व, and कुरुविन्द.
10891: कुरुविल्व m. (-ल्वः) A ruby; also कुरुविन्द.
10892: कुरुविस्त m. (-स्तः) A Pala of gold, a weight of gold equal to about 700 Troy grains. E. कुरु the country, and विस्त, abundant; abounding in Kurudeśa.
10893: कुरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Ugly, ill made, deformed. n. (-षं) Ugliness. E. कु, and रूप form.
10894: कुरूपता f. (-ता) Ugliness. E. तल् added to the last; also कुरूपत्वं.
10895: कुरूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Ugly, ill made, frightful, deformed. E. कुरूप, and इनि aff.
10896: कुरूप्य n. (-प्यं) Tin. E. कु base, रूप्य silver.
10897: कुर्क्कुर mf. (-रः-री) A dog or bitch. E. कुर् instead of कु bad, prefixed to कु to sound, and रक् affix: see कुक्कुर.
10898: कुर्द r. 1st cl. (कूर्दते or कुर्दते) To play; also कूर्द.
10899: कुर्द्दन n. (-नं) Play, playing, sport: see कूर्दन.
10900: कुर्पर m. (-रः) 1 The knee. 2 The elbow; also कूर्पर.
10901: कुर्पास m. (-सः) A sort of bodice or jacket: see कूर्पास; also with कन् added कुर्पासक.
10902: कुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Doing, making. E. कृ to make, शानच् aff.
10903: कुर्व्वत् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वन्ती-र्व्वत) 1 Doing, acting, an agent. 2 A servant. E. कृ to do, शतृ aff.
10904: कुर्व्वत्रूप n. (-पं) Cause according to the Cārvākas. E. कुर्व्वत्, and रुप nature.
10905: कुल r. 1st cl. (कोलति) 1 To accumulate. 2 To be of kin, to act as of kin. 3 To flow homogeneously. 4 To count. With आङ् prefixed, to be attentive; with वि and आङ् to be bewildered, flurried or distressed.
10906: कुल n. (-लं) 1 Family, race, tribe or caste. 2 A herd, a flock, &c. of animals of the same species. 3 An inhabited country. 4 A house, an abode. 5 The body. 6 The front or fore part. 7 A blue stone: see कुलत्थ. m. (-लः) An artist of celebrated descent. f. (-लिः or -ली) A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी, &c. (-ली) A wife's elder sister. E. कुल to accumulate, क affix, or कुङ् to sound, and लक् affix, or कु the earth, and ल who takes or possesses, from ला with ड aff.
10907: कुलक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Of a good family, of eminent birth. m. (-कः) 1 A species of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa, Rox.) see काकेन्दु. 2 An artist of eminent birth. 3 An ant or mole hill. 4 A green snake. n. (-कं) 1 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes diaeca.) 2 The connexion of several stanzas, protraction of the government of the noun or verb through several verses, contrary to the practice of closing the sense with each verse. E. कन् added to the preceding, or कुल race, and क who sounds, declares, &c.
10908: कुलकन्या f. (-न्या) A girl of good family. E. कुल, and कन्या a maiden.
10909: कुलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The proper duty of a race or family, any observance customarily held by one. E. कुल, and कर्म्म act; also कुलक्रिया and कुलकार्य्य.
10910: कुलक्क m. (-क्कः) Beating time in music.
10911: कुलक्षय m. (-यः) Decay or disappearance of a family. f. (-या) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. कुल the body, and क्षय injurious.
10912: कुलगिरि m. (-रिः) A mountain, any one of the seven principal mountains of Bhārata Varṣa. E. कुल, and गिरि mountain: see कुलाचल.
10913: कुलङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A thorny plant: see कर्कटशृङ्गी.
10914: कुलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Well-born, of a good family. 2 Ancestral, hereditary. E. कुल, and ज born; also कुलजात, कुलोत्पन्न, and similar compounds.
10916: कुलञ्जन m. (-नः) An aromatic plant, (Alpinia galanga;) also कुलञ्ज and गन्धमूल.
10917: कुलट m. (-टः) Any son except the one begotten, as one adopted, bought, &c. f. (-टा) An unchaste woman. E. कुल race, and अट who goes, deriv. irr.; by whom the family honour is injured.
10918: कुलटापति m. (-तिः) The husband of an unchaste woman, a cuckold. E. कुलटा, and पति husband.
10920: कुलतिथि mf. (-थिः) The fourth, eighth, twelfth, or fourteenth lunar day. E. कुल, and तिथि a lunation, respectable days.
10921: कुलतिलक m. (-कः) The chief of a family, one who does honour to a family. E. कुल, and तिलक frontal mark.
10922: कुलत्थ m. (-त्थः) A kind of pulse, (Dolichos biflorus.) f. (-त्था) 1 A blue stone used in medicine, and applied as a collyrium to the eyes; also as an astringent to sores, &c. 2 A wild kind of Dolichos. E. कुल a bank, and स्था to stand or stay, affix ड.
10923: कुलत्थिका f. (-का) 1 A blue stone used as a collyrium, &c. 2 A sort of vetch, considered as a wild sort of the Dolichos biflorus. E. see the preceding, कन् added to कुलत्थ in the fem. form.
10924: कुलधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Practice or observance peculiar to a tribe or family, peculiar duty of caste or race. E. कुल family, and धर्म्म virtue.
10925: कुलधारक m. (-कः) A son. E. कुल a race, and धृ to hold, in the causal form, वुन् affix; upholding a family.
10926: कुलनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) Any propitious asterism. E. कुल, and नक्षत्र asterism.
10927: कुलनायिका f. (-का) A girl who is worshipped at the celebration of the orgies of the left hand Śāktas. E. कुल society, and नायिका a female.
10928: कुलनारी f. (-री) A woman of good family. E. कुल, and नारी a woman.
10929: कुलनाश m. (-शः) 1 A camel. 2 A reprobate, an outcaste. E. कुल a family, नाश who hurts or destroys.
10930: कुलनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Family disgrace. E. कुल, and निन्दा reproach.
10931: कुलपति m. (-तिः) Head or chief of a family. E. कुल a family, and पति master.
10932: कुलपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A principal mountain of India, any one of seven so considered: see कुलाचल. E. कुल, and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as कुलगिरि, कुलशैल, &c.
10934: कुलपालक mfn. (-लकः-लिका-लकं) Nourishing or providing for a family. n. (-कं) A kind of orange. E. कुल a race, &c. पाल to nourish, and वुन् aff.
10935: कुलपालि f. (-लिः) A chaste woman. E. कुल race, and पाल who nourishes, इन् fem. affix; also कुलपालिका and कुलपाली.
10937: कुलबधू f. (-धूः) A virtuous or respectable woman. E. कुल, and बधू a wife.
10938: कुलभृत्या f. (-त्या) A midwife, a nurse. E. कुल family, and भृत्या a servant.
10939: कुलभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Expelled from a family. E. कुल, and भ्रष्ट fallen from.
10940: कुलमर्य्यादा f. (-दा) Family honour or respectability. E. कुल, and मर्य्यादा propriety.
10941: कुलमित्र m. (-त्रं) A friend of the family. E. कुल, and मित्र a friend.
10942: कुलम्भर m. (-रः) A thief: see कुजम्भल.
10943: कुलयोषित् f. (-त्) A virtuous woman. E. कुल, and योषित् a woman.
10944: कुलवार m. (-रः) Tuesday or Friday. E. कुल, and वार a day.
10945: कुलविप्र m. (-प्रः) The family priest. E. कुल race, and विप्र a Brahman.
10946: कुलव्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Attaching or applicable to tribe or caste. E. कुल, and व्यापिन् prevailing.
10947: कुलश्रेष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) 1 An artificer or artist of eminent birth. 2 Well-born, of good family. 3 Eminent in a family. E. कुल race, and श्रेष्ठ best, poss. affix इनि.
10948: कुलसङ्ख्या f. (-ङ्ख्या) Ranking or being reckoned as a family, family respectability. E. कुल, and सङ्ख्या enumeration.
10949: कुलसन्तति f. (-तिः) Posterity, descendants. E. कुल, and सन्तति continuance.
10950: कुलसन्निधि f. (-धिः) 1 Kindred, relations. 2 Presence of witnesses. E. कुल, and सन्निधि proximity.
10951: कुलसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Sprung from family. E. कुल race, and सम्भव born, produced.
10952: कुलसौरभ n. (-भं) A plant, commonly Marüa: see मरुवक.
10953: कुलस्थिति f. (-तिः) Antiquity or prosperity of a family. E. कुल, and स्थिति duration.
10954: कुलस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) 1 A chaste woman. 2 A woman of a good family, a respectable woman. E. कुल a family, and स्त्री a woman.
10955: कुलहण्डक m. (-कः) An eddy: see कूलहण्डक.
10956: कुलाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of mixed origin of a mixed character. E. कुल propitious, and आकुल bewildered, or कुल with a neg. prefix.
10957: कुलाकुलतिथि mf. (-थिः) The second, sixth or tenth lunar days. E. कुलाकुल, and तिथि a lunation.
10958: कुलाकुलनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) An asterism of mixed character, as Vāruṇī, Ārdrā, Mūla and Abhijit. E. कुलाकुल, and नक्षत्र asterism.
10959: कुलाकुलवार m. (-रः) Wednesday. E. कुलाकुल, and वार a day.
10961: कुलाचल m. (-लः) A mountain, one of a class of seven principal mountains, which are supposed to exist in each Varṣa or division of a continent: those of Bhārata Varṣa or India are Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimān, Ṛkṣa, Vindhya, and Pāripātra. E. कुल a race, and अचल a mountain; also कुलाद्रि, &c.
10962: कुलाचार m. (-रः) The proper duty or practice of a caste or family. E. कुल, and आचार observance.
10963: कुलाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A family priest. 2 A genealogist. E. कुल, and आचार्य्य teacher.
10964: कुलाट m. (-टः) A small fish. E. कुल for कूल a bank, and अट who goes; burrowing in the sand and mud.
10965: कुलाधारक m. (-कः) A son. E. see कुलधारक, आङ् being here inserted signifying extension.
10967: कुलाभिमान n. (-नं) Pride of birth, family pride. E. कुल, and अभिमान pride.
10968: कुलाभिमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Proud of birth or of family descent. E. कुल, and अमिमानिन् proud.
10969: कुलाय m. (-यः) 1 A nest. 2 A place, a spot in general. n. (-यं) The body. E. कुल family, and अय to go, अच् aff.
10970: कुलायनिलाय m. (-यः) Sitting in a nest, brooding. E. कुलाय, and निलाय abiding.
10971: कुलायनिलायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Brooding, hatching, (as a bird.) E. कुलाय, and निलायिन् who abides in.
10972: कुलायनिलायिता f. (-ता) The act or condition of hatching, &c. E. तल् added to the last.
10973: कुलायस्थ m. (-स्थः) A bird. E. कुलाय a nest, and स्थ who abides.
10974: कुलायिका f. (-का) An aviary. E. कुलाय a nest, and कन् affix in the fem. form.
10975: कुलाल m. (-लः) 1 A potter. 2 A wild cock. f. (-ली) A species of blue stone, applied as a collyrium to the eyes. 2 The wife of a potter. E. कुल to accumulate, and कालन Uṇādi affix, or कुल family, अल to adorn, &c. अण् and ङीप् or ङीष् affs.
10976: कुलालम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) Supporting or maintaining a family. E. कुल, and आलम्बिन् what upholds.
10978: कुलाह m. (-हः) A horse of a light brown colour, with black knees.
10979: कुलाहल m. (-लः) A small tree, (Conyza terebinthina.)
10981: कुलि m. (-लिः) A hand. f. (-लिः) A prickly nightshade: see कुल. E. कुल to accumulate, &c. कि aff.
10982: कुलिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of a good family, well-born. m. (-कः) One of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent race, described as having a half moon on the top of his head, and being of a monkey hue. 2 An artist or artificer of eminent birth. 3 A thorny plant, (Ruellia longifolia.) 4 The chief or headman of a tribe or caste. E. कुल family, &c. कन् affix, and इ substituted for अ.
10983: कुलिकवेला f. (-ला) Certain portions of each day, on which it is improper to begin any business. E. कुलिक, and वेला time.
10984: कुलिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The fork-tailed shrike; also कलिङ्ग.
10986: कुलिर m. (-रः) A crab; also कुलीर.
10987: कुलिश mn. (-शः-शं) 1 The thunderbolt of INDRA. 2 A kind of fish. E. कुलि for कुल a bank, and श what rests, from शीङ् to sleep. &c. and क aff.
10988: कुलिशभृत् m. (-भृत्) INDRA. E. कुलिश, and भृत् who has.
10989: कुलिशाङ्कुशा f. (-शा) A kind of female deity. E. कुलिश the thunderbolt, and अङ्कुश a goad.
10990: कुलिशासन m. (-नः) A name of Śākya, a Buddha or Bauddha saint.
10991: कुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Well-born, of high or eminent descent, of a good family. m. (-नः) 1 A horse of a good breed. 2 A Brahman of one of the twenty-two Rārhiya divisions of the five principal tribes, as established by Balāl Sen king of Beṅgal. 3 A worshipper of ŚAKTI, according to the left hand ritual: see कौलीन. E. कुल a family, and ख aff.
10992: कुलीनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of a good family. m. (-कः) A kind of wild kidney bean. E. कन् added to the preceding.
10993: कुलीनता f. (-ता) Birth, rank, family respectability. E. कुलीन, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कुलीनत्वं.
10995: कुलीर mf. (-रः-रं) A crab. E. कुल to accumulate, and ईरन् affix; also कुलिर.
10996: कुलीरशृङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant: see कर्क्कटशृङ्गी.
10997: कुलीराद् m. (-द् or त्) A young crab. E. कुलीर a crab, and अद to eat, affix क्विप्; destroying its parent; the old crab being supposed to perish on producing young.
10998: कुलीश mn. (-शः-शं) INDRA'S thunderbolt: see कुलिश.
10999: कुलुक n. (-कं) The fur or foulness of the tongue. E. कुल to accumulate, and उक aff.
11001: कुलेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The chief of a family or race. E. कुल a race, ईश्वर lord.
11002: कुलोत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) High-born. m. (-टः) A horse of a good breed. E. कुल race, and उत्कट eminent.
11003: कुलोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Family respectability. E. कुल, and उत्कर्ष excellence.
11004: कुलोद्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Of good family. E. कुल, and उद्गत exalted.
11005: कुलोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Of a good family, well-born. 2 Family, belonging to, inherited by, &c. E. कुल, and उत्पन्न born.
11006: कुलोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Well-born, of good family. 2 Produced in a family. E. कुल, and उद्भव birth.
11007: कुलोद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well-born, of family. E. कुल, and उद्भूत born.
11008: कुलोद्वह m. (-हः) A chief, a leader, the head of a family. E. कुल, and उद्वह who upholds.
11009: कुल्फ mn. (-ल्फः-ल्फं) A disease. m. (-ल्फः) The ancle; also गुल्फ. E. कल to count, फ Uṇādi affix, and उ inserted.
11010: कुल्मल n. (-लं) Sin. E. कुष to extract, क्मलन् Uṇādi affix, and ष changed to ल.
11011: कुल्माष mn. (-षः-षं) Sour gruel prepared by the spontaneous fermentation of the water of boiled rice. n. (-षं) 1 Half ripe barley. 2 Forced rice. 3 A sort of Phaseolus: see राजमाष. 4 A species of Dolichos, (D. biflorus.) see यावक. 5 A disease. m. (-षः) A dish consisting of half boiled rice, with pulse, &c. commonly Khicri. E. कुल a class or race, मष or मस to hurt or kill, अण् affix; hence the word is also written कुल्मास.
11012: कुल्माषाभिसुत n. (-तं) Sour gruel. see कुल्मास.
11014: कुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Of a good family, well-born, well descended. 2 Of or relating to a family or race. m. (-ल्यः) A counsellor. f. (-ल्या) 1 A river in general. 2 A canal, a channel for irrigation. 3 A ditch, a dyke or trench. 4 A drug or medicinal plant, (Celtis orientalis:) see जीवन्ती. 5 A chaste or virtuous woman. n. (-ल्यं) 1 A bone. 2 A measure of eight Droṇas: see द्रोण. 3 A winnowing basket. 4 Flesh. 5 Friendly inquiry after family affairs or domestic accidents, condolence, congratulation, &c. E. कुल to accumulate, and यत् affix, &c.
11015: कुल्वक n. (-कः) Fur upon the tongue.
11016: कुव n. (-वं) A water lily, a lotus.
11017: कुवङ्ग n. (-ङ्गः) Lead. E. कु bad, and वङ्ग tin.
11018: कुवच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Abusive, censorious, detracting. E. कु bad, वच to speak, क aff.
11019: कुवज्रक n. (-कं) Crystal, a stone resembling a diamond. E. कु inferior, वज्र the diamond, कन् aff.
11020: कुवद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Censorious. E. कु bad, वद to speak, क aff.
11021: कुवर m. (-रः) An astringent taste: see तुवर.
11022: कुवल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) 1 The jujube, the tree. 2 The fruit. n. (-लं) 1 A water lily. 2 A pearl. E. कु the earth, and वल to cover, affix अच्; see the next.
11023: कुवलय n. (-यः) 1 Any water lily. 2 The blue lotus. E. कु the earth, वल to cover, and कयन् affix; also कुवल, and कुव.
11024: कुवलयिनी f. (-नी) A place abounding in water lilies. E. कुवलय, and इनि aff.
11025: कुवलाश्व m. (-श्वः) A proper name of a king; also घुन्धुमार.
11026: कुवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Detracting, censorious. E. कु evil, वद to speak, अण् aff.
11028: कुविन्द m. (-न्दः) A weaver. E. कुप to spread, किन्दच् Uṇādi affix, and प changed to व; also कुपिन्द.
11029: कुविवाह m. (-हः) A degrading or improper marriage. E. कु, and विवाह marriage.
11030: कुवृत्तिकृत् m. (-कृत्) A plant, (Caesalpinia bonduccella:) see पूतिक.
11031: कुवेणी f. (-णी) 1 A fish basket. 2 An ill braided tress of hair. 3 A woman with her hair ill braided. E. कु bad, वेण to go, घञ् affix, and ङीष् fem. affix; also with टाप् or इन् affixed, कुवेणा and कुवेणि.
11032: कुवेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Deformed, monstrous. 2 Slow, lazy. m. (-रः) KUVERA the son of VISRAVAS by IḌAVIḌĀ, the chief of the Yakṣas, god of wealth and regent of the north. E. कु vile, and वेर body, alluding to the deformity of the god, who is represented as having three legs and but eight teeth. 2 The Tūn tree: see नन्दिवृक्ष. 3 One of the attendants of a Jaina saint. E. as above, or कुवि to cover, &c. and एरच् Uṇādi affix; in this case the word may be read कुबेर.
11033: कुवेरक m. (-कः) The Tūn tree, (Cedrela tunna.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
11034: कुवेराक्षी f. (-क्षी) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. कुवेर, and अक्षि the eye.
11035: कुवेराचल m. (-लः) Mount Kailāsa. E. कुवेर, and अचल a mountain; the capital of KUVERA, being situated in Kailāsa, which is supposed to be in the Himālaya range.
11036: कुवेराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) See the preceding. E. as above, अद्रि being a mountain.
11037: कुवेल n. (-लं) Any water lily. E. कु the earth, बेल to shake, अच् affix: see कुवलय.
11038: कुव्र n. (-व्रं) A forest or wood.
11039: कुश (इर) कुशिर r. 4th cl. (कुश्यति) 1 To embrace, to enfold. 2 To take out or from. (इः) कुशि r. 1st and 10th cl. (कुंशति कुंशयति) To shine: see कुस.
11040: कुश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Wicked, depraved. 2 Mad, inebriate. mn. (-शः-श) A species of grass used in many solemn and religious observances, hence called sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) m. (-शः) 1 The yoke of a plough. 2 A proper name, one of the sons of RĀMA. 3 One of the great Dvīpas or divisions of the universe, surrounded by the sea of spirituous liquor. f. (-शा) 1 A rope. 2 A plant, commonly Maükāṭha. n. (-शं) Water. (-शी) 1 A ploughshare. 2 Wrought iron. mf. (-शः-शी) A bridle, a horse's head rope. E. कु the earth, शीङ् to sleep or rest, and ड affix, or कु bad, and शो to destroy, again कुश to embrace or to enfold, and क aff.
11042: कुशय m. (-यः) A drinking vessel, a cup, a goblet. E. कुश to extract, and अय Uṇādi aff.
11043: कुशपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla.
11044: कुशल mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं) 1 Happy, well, right. 2 Expert, skilful. 3 Clever. 4 Eloquent. n. (-लं) 1 Adequacy, ability. 2 Virtue, virtuous action. 3 Well-being, happiness. E. कु the earth, and शल to go, affix अच्; also कुषल and कुसल.
11045: कुशलता f. (-ता) 1 Cleverness, ability. 2 Eloquence. 3 Wellbeing. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कुशलत्वं.
11046: कुशलप्रश्न m. (-श्नः) Salutation, greeting, friendly inquiry respecting a person's health or welfare. E. कुशल well-being, and प्रश्न asking.
11047: कुशलव du. m. (-वौ) The two sons of RĀMA, or KUŚA and LAVA.
11048: कुशलबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Wise, able, intelligent. E. कुशल, and बुद्धि understanding.
11049: कुशलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Auspicious, favourable. 2 Virtuous, good. 3 Happy, prosperous. 4 Clever. E. कुशल, and इनि aff.
11050: कुशवारि n. (-रि) Water in which Kusa grass has been boiled. E. कुश, and वारि water.
11051: कुशलव m. (-वः) A bundle of Kuśa grass. E. कुश, and स्तव a cluster.
11052: कुशस्थल nf. (-लं-ली) The country of Kanyakubja or Kanouj. f. (-ली) The residence of KṚṢṆA: see द्वारका. 2 A name of Oujein or Avanti during the Tretā Yuga or second age. E. कुश sacred grass, and स्थल place; abounding in Kuśa grass.
11053: कुशाकर m. (-रः) Fire. E. कुश the grass, &c. आकर a mine; the sacrificial fire being made upon a tuft of this grass.
11054: कुशाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A monkey, an ape.
11055: कुशाग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Sharp, shrewd, intelligent. m. (-ग्रं) The sharp point of the Kusa grass. E. कुश, and अग्र point.
11056: कुशाग्रबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Sharp, shrewd, intelligent. f. (-द्धिः) Shrewdness, subtlety. E. कुशाग्र, and बुद्धि understanding; also similar compounds, कुशाग्रधी, कुशाग्रीयमति, &c.
11057: कुशाग्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Subtile, penetrating: see the next. E. कुश the grass, अग्र point, and छ, affix; implying resemblance.
11058: कुशाग्रीयमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Inspecting minutely, subtile, sharp sighted, intelligent, possessing mental acumen. E. कुश the grass, अग्रीय point, and मति mind; also other similar compounds, as कुशाग्रीयधी, कुशाग्रीयबुद्धि, &c.
11059: कुशाङ्गुरीय n. (-यं) A ring of Kusa grass, worn at religious ceremonies. E. कुश, and अङ्गुरीय a ring; also कुशाङ्गुरीयकं.
11060: कुशाल्मलि m. (-लिः) A tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.) E. कु, and शाल्मलि silk cotton tree.
11061: कुशारणि m. (-णिः) The name of a sage celebrated for his irascibility: see दुर्व्वास. E. कुश the grass, and अरणि wood whose attrition produces fire; using Kusa for this purpose.
11062: कुशासन n. (-नं) A seat of Kuśa grass. E. कुश, and आसन a seat.
11063: कुशिंशपा f. (-पा) A kind of Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) E. कु inferior, and शिंशपा the Sisu tree.
11064: कुशिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Squint-eyed. m. (-कः) 1 A Muni or divine sage so named, the father of JAMADAGNI. 2 A ploughshare. 3 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) 4 Beleric myrobalan: see विभीतक. 5 The sediment of oil. E. कुश the grass, &c. इकन् aff.
11065: कुशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed, combined with water, &c. E. कुश or कुष to embrace, to mix, and इतच् Uṇādi affix; hence also कुषित.
11066: कुशिन् m. (-शी) A name of VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa. E. कुश the son of RĀMA, affix इनि; the poem is supposed to be recited by KUSA and LAVA, the sons of the hero.
11067: कुशीद n. (-दं) 1 The profession of usury. 2 Red saunders: see कुमीद.
11068: कुशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Ill-behaved. rude, wicked. 2 Evil disposed, ill-tempered. E. कु, and शील temper, conduct.
11069: कुशीलता f. (-ता) 1 Misbehaviour, misconduct. 2 Bad disposition, ill-temper. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, कुशीलत्वं.
11070: कुशीलव n. (-वः) 1 An actor, a dancer, a mime. 2 A bard, a herald. 3 A newsmonger. E. कु bad, शील practice, and वः affix, from वा to go, &c. with क affix, du. m. (-वौ) The two sons of RĀMA: see कुशलव.
11071: कुशीवश m. (-शः) A name of VĀLMĪKI: see कुशिन्.
11072: कुशूल m. (-लः) A granary, a cupboard, a place in which rice or other grain is kept. 2 Conflagration of chaff. E. कुश to enfold, कूल affix; also कुसूल.
11073: कुशूलधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain stored for three year's consumption. E. कुशूल, and धान्य grain.
11074: कुशूलधान्यक m. (-कः) A householder, &c. who has three year's grain in store. E. कुशूलधान्य, and कन् aff.
11075: कुशेशय n. (-यं) A lotus in general. m. (-यः) 1 A tree, commonly Kaniyār: see कर्णिकार. 2 The Indian crane. E. कुश water, in the seventh case, शीङ् to sleep or rest, with the affix अच्.
11077: कुशोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having, or being covered with grass. E. कुश and उत्तर beyond.
11078: कुशोदक n. (-कं) Water in which Kusa grass has been infused. E. कुश, and उदक water.
11079: कुष r. 9th cl. (कुष्णाति) 1 To expel, to force or draw out, to extract 2 To test, to assay. 3 To shine. With अव, to prove, to display; with निर्, to extract.
11080: कुषल mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं) Clever, expert, skilful: see कुशल.
11081: कुषाकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) 1 Burning, scorching, inflaming. 2 Wicked, detestable. m. (-कुः) 1 A monkey. 2 The sun. 3 Fire. E. कुष to shine, काकु Uṇādi affix; also कुषाकु.
11083: कुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed with water, &c. see कुशित. n. (-त) Happy, well, right, fortunate, auspicious, &c.
11084: कुषीद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Indifferent, apathetic, inert. n. (-दं) Usury: see कुसीद. E. कु vile, षद to move, &c. अच् aff.
11085: कुष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) 1 Leprosy, of which eighteen varieties are enumerated, seven great or severe, and eleven of minor importance. 2 A plant, a kind of costus, (Costus speciosus:) 3 A sort of poison. E. कुष to extract, and क्थन् Uṇādi affix, or कु bad, ill, and स्थ being, staying.
11086: कुष्ठघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A medicinal plant, commonly Hiyāvali: see हितावली. f. (-घ्नी) 1 An esculent root, (Solanum Indicum.) see काकमाची. 2 Opposite leaved fig tree; also काकोडुम्बरिका. E. कुष्ठ the leprosy, and घ्न what destroys.
11087: कुष्ठनाशन m. (-नः) 1 White mustard. 2 A sort of yam: see वाराही. E. कुष्ठ the leprosy, and नाशन what destroys.
11088: कुष्ठनाशिनी f. (-नी) A plant, commonly Hākuca, (Psoralia corylifolia.) E. as above: see कुष्ठनाशन.
11089: कुष्ठल n. (-लं) 1 A bad place or spot. 2 The surface of the earth. E. कु bad, or the earth, and स्थल place; स becomes ष, and थ is then changed to ठ.
11090: कुष्ठसूदन m. (-नः) The cassia tree, (C. fistula.) E. कुष्ठ, and सूदन destroying.
11091: कुष्ठहृत् m. (-हृत्) Catechu, (Mimosa catechu:) see खदिर. E. कुष्ठ leprosy, and हृत् what takes away, from हृ to convey, affix क्विप्.
11092: कुष्ठहन्तृ m. (-न्ता) A large esculent root, described as possessed of medicinal virtue in leprosy, and other cutaneous affections, (Arum campanulatum:) see हस्तिकन्द. E. कुष्ठ leprosy, and हन्तृ what kills or destroys.
11093: कुष्ठारि m. (-रिः) 1 A fetid mimosa, (M. Farnesiana.) 2 The Khayar or Catechu: (M. catechu.) 3 A kind of Aristolochia: see अर्कपत्र. 4 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) 5 Sulphur. E. कुष्ठ the leprosy, and अरि an enemy.
11094: कुष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Leprous, a leper, &c. E. कुष्ठ, and इनि aff.
11095: कुष्मल n. (-लं) Cutting, dividing. E. कुष to extract, and क्मलन् Uṇādi aff.
11096: कुष्माण्ड mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डा or -ण्डी) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo). m. (-ण्डः) 1 One of a class of demigods attached to ŚIVA. 2 State of the womb in gestation. f. (-ण्डी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A drug. 3 A religious ceremony, a certain rite performed as a penance or expiation; also कुष्माण्डक.
11097: कुष्माण्डक m. (-कः) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.) E. कु the earth, उष्म heat, अन् to exist or be, ड affix, and the vowel irregularly short, कन् added; also कुष्माण्ड.
11098: कुस (इर) कुसिर r. 4th cl. (कुस्यति) To embrace. (इ) कुसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंसति कुंसयति) 1 To shine. 2 To talk.
11099: कुसरित् f. (-रित्) A shallow stream. E. कु bad, सरित् a river.
11100: कुसल adv. n. (-लं) Well, happy, &c. see कुशल.
11101: कुसित m. (-तः) An inhabited country. E. कुस to shine, and इत Uṇādi aff.
11102: कुसीतायी f. (-यी) The wife of a money-lender: see कुसीदायी.
11103: कुसीद n. (-दं) 1 Usury, the profession of usury. 2 Any loan or thing lent to be repaid with interest. mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 A money-lender. 2 Slothful, inert. E. कुस to embrace, ईद Uṇādi affix; or कु bad, and षद to go, affix अच्.
11104: कुसीदपथ m. (-थः) Usury, usurious interest, any exceeding five per cent. E. कुसीद, and पथ for पथिन् road.
11105: कुसीदवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Interest on money. E. कुसीद, and वृद्धि increase.
11106: कुसीदायी f. (-यी) The wife of a usurer. E. कुसीद a usurer, ऐ substituted for its final, and ङीष् affix; also कुसीतायी.
11107: कुसीदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) One who follows the profession of usury. E. कुसीद usury, and ठक् aff.
11108: कुसुम n. (-मं) 1 A flower in general. 2 Fruit. 3 The menstrual discharge. 4 Ophthalmia, disease of the eyes. E. कुस to shine, उम Uṇādi aff.
11109: कुसुमकार्म्मुक m. (-कः) KĀMA. E. कुसुम, and कार्म्मुक a bow.
11110: कुसुमचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped with flowers. E. कुसुम, and चित gathered.
11111: कुसुमपुर n. (-रं) A city, the vicinity of the modern Patna: see पाटलिपुत्र. E. कुसुम a flower, and पुर a city.
11112: कुसुममध्य n. (-ध्यं) The name of a tree, bearing a large acid fruit, (Dilenia Indica.) E. कुसुम a flower, and मध्य the centre; the flower blossoming from the fruit.
11113: कुसुमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Producing flowers, causing to flower. E. कुसुम nom. verb, शतृ aff.
11114: कुसुमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) In flower, flowering. f. (-ती) 1 A female during menstruation. 2 A town: see कुसुमपुर. E. कुसुम and मतुप् aff.
11115: कुसुमस्तवक m. (-कः) A collection of flowers, a garland, a nosegay. E. कुसुम, and लवक a cluster.
11116: कुसुमाकर m. (-रः) 1 Spring, the vernal season. 2 A quantity of flowers or place abounding with them, a parterre, a garden. E. कुसुम, and आकर a mine.
11117: कुसुमाञ्जन n. (-नं) The calx of brass, used as a collyrium. E. कुसुम a flower, and अञ्जन application to the eyes; resembling a flower.
11118: कुसुमात्मक n. (-कं) Saffron. E. कुसुम, and आत्मक self; the essential part of the flower.
11119: कुसुमाधिप m. (-पः) The Campa, a tree which bears a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) E. कुसुम a flower, and अधिप a king; royal amongst flowers.
11121: कुसुमायुध m. (-धः) A name of KĀMADEVA. E. कुसुम a flower, and आयुध a weapon: his shafts being tipped with flowers.
11123: कुसुमावचाय m. (-यः) Gathering flowers. E. कुसुम, and अवचाय, gathering.
11124: कुसुमावतंसक n. (-कं) A chaplet, a crown of flowers. E. कुसुम, and अवतंसक a tiara.
11125: कुसुमासव n. (-वं) Honey. E. कुसुम, and आसव spirit.
11126: कुसुमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowered, budded, in flower. E. कुसुम, and इतच् aff.
11127: कुसुमितलता f. (-ता) A species of the Dhṛti metre.
11128: कुसुमेषु m. (-षुः) A name of the god KĀMA. n. (-षु) The bow of KĀMA. E. कुसुम, and इषु an arrow; whose shafts are flowers.
11129: कुसुम्भ n. (-म्भं) 1 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 2 Gold. m. (-म्भः) The water pot of the student and Sannyāsī. E. कुस to shine, and उम्भः Uṇādi aff.
11130: कुसू m. (-सूः) An earthworm. E. कु the earth, सू produced.
11131: कुसूल m. (-लः) A granary, &c. see कुशूल.
11132: कुसृति f. (-तिः) 1 Wickedness, depravity. 2 Conjuring, slight-ofhand, &c. E. कु vile, सृ to go, क्तिन् aff.
11133: कुस्तुभ m. (-भः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. कु the earth, ष्टुभ to stop, क aff.
11134: कुस्तुम्बरी f. (-री) A pungent seed used in condiments, coriander: see the next.
11135: कुस्तुम्बुरु f. (-रुः) Coriander, a pungent seed. E. कु bad, vile, तुवि to take, उरु affix, deriv. irr.; also कुस्तुम्बरी.
11136: कुस्वप्न m. (-प्नः) A bad dream, nightmare. E. कु, and स्वप्न a vision.
11137: कुस्म r. 10th cl. (कुस्मयति) 1 To smile improperly or blamably. 2 To see mentally, to perceive, to imagine: this is considered by some as a denominative, and to be classed improperly amongst the roots.
11138: कुह r. 10th cl. (कुहयते) 1 To surprise, to astonish, to excite wonder. 2 To cheat, to impose upon.
11139: कुह m. (-हः) A name of KUVERA. f. (-हा) A medicinal drug: see कटुकी. ind. Where, whither, used in the Vedas in place of कुत्र. E. कु vile, and हा to leave, affix ड.
11140: कुहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A cheat, a rogue, a juggler. m. (-कः) Juggling, deception, slight-of-hand, &c. E. कुह to astonish, क्वुन् aff.
11141: कुहककार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Juggling, conjuring, cheating. E. कुहक, and कार who makes; also कुहककारक and कुहककारिन्.
11142: कुहकचकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspicious, cautious, wary. E. कुहक, and चकित fearful.
11143: कुहकजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living by slight-of-hand, a conjuror, a cheat, &c. E. कुहक deception, and जीविन् who lives by.
11144: कुहकवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Juggling, conjuring, slight-of-hand. 2 Hypocrisy. E. कुहक, and वृत्ति practice.
11145: कुहकस्वन m. (-नः) A wild cock. E. कुहक deception, and खन who sounds.
11146: कुहकस्वर m. (-रः) A wild cock: see the preceding.
11147: कुहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Envious. 2 Hypocritical. m. (-नः) 1 A rat. 2 A snake. f. (-ना) Hypocrisy, assumed and sanctity, the interested performance of religious austerities. n. (-नं) 1 A small earthen vessel. 2 A glass vessel. E. कुह to surprise, युच् aff.
11148: कुहनिका f. (-का) Hypocrisy: see the preceding. E. कुहन, and इकन् aff.
11149: कुहर n. (-रं) 1 A cavity, a hollow. 2 A hole, a rent, &c. 3 The ear. 4 A guttural sound. 5 The throat or larynx. m. (-रः) A kind of snake. E. कु the earth, &c. and हर what takes, &c. from हृ with the affix अप्.
11150: कुहरित n. (-तं) 1 The song, or cry of the Kokila, the Indian cuckoo. 2 Vox congressus in coitu. 3 A sound in general. E. कुहर, and इतच् aff.
11151: कुहलि m. (-लिः) A Pān, the leaf of the Piper betel, with small pieces of the Areca nut, and Catechu and a little lime, which are chewed and eaten by the Oriental nations.
11153: कुहू f. (-हूः) 1 New moon; the first day of the first quarter on which the moon rises invisible. 2 The cry of the Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. कुह to astonish, ऊः affix, or with कु affix कुहु.
11154: कुहूक m. (-कः) The Indian cuckoo. E. कन् added to the last.
11155: कुहूकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. कुहू the Kokila's cry, and कण्ठ the throat.
11156: कुहूपाल m. (-लः) The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world.
11157: कुहूमुख m. (-खः) The Kokila: see the preceding.
11158: कुहूरव m. (-वः) The Kokila. E. कुहू, and रव sound.
11159: कुहूल n. (-लं) A pit, filled with stakes.
11160: कुहेडिका f. (-का) A fog, a mist, haze, haziness. E. कु the earth, हेड to surround, वुन् affix; also कुहेलिक and कुहेडी.
11161: कुहेडी f. (-डी) See the preceding: also कुहेली.
11162: कुहेलिका f. (-का) Fog, mist: see कुहेडिका, ल being changed to ड.
11163: कू r. 6th cl. (ङ) कूङ (कुवते) To sound, especially as if in pain, to moan, to groan, &c. (ञ) कूञ् r. 9th cl. (कुनानि-नीते) To sound, &c. as before.
11164: कू f. (-कूः) A female Piśāca or goblin. E. कू to sound, क्विप् aff.
11165: कूकुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) One who gives a girl in marriage with due ceremony, and suitable decorations. E. कुक to take, deriv. irr.
11166: कूच m. (-चः) A breast, a female breast, especially that of a young or unmarried woman: see कुच. f. (-ची) A painting brush or pencil. E. कु to sound, चट Uṇādi affix, and the vowel made long.
11167: कूचिका f. (-का) A small brush or hair pencil. E. कुच to be curved, and क्वुन् affix, with the fem. affix टाप्.
11168: कूज r. 1st cl. (कूजति) To make any inarticulate sound, to utter a cry as a bird, to coo as a pigeon, to caw as a crow, &c. With परि prefixed, to moan.
11169: कूजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Cooing. E. कूज to coo, शतृ aff.
11170: कूजन n. (-नं) Cooing, moaning, uttering an inarticulate sound. E. कूज and ल्युट् aff.
11171: कूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cooed, uttered inarticulately. n. (-तं) The cry of a bird, cooing. E. कूज to sound, क्त aff.
11172: कूट r. 10th cl. (कूटयते) 1 To avoid or decline giving, to not give. 2 To render indistinct or unintelligible, to muddle or render confused or foul. (कूटयति) 1 To give pain. 2 To burn. 3 To call or invite, to counsel or advise.
11173: कूट mf. (-टः-टी) A house, a dwelling: see कुट. mn. (-टः-टं) 1 The peak or summit of a mountain. 2 A water-jar. 3 A heap of grain, &c. 4 Uniform and elementary substance. 5 A hammer, a mallet. 6 A ploughshare. 7 The body of a plough. 8 A trap for catching deer. 9 A concealed weapon, as a dagger in a wooden case, a sword-cane, &c. 10 Illusion. 11 Fraud, trick, deceit. 12 Untruth, falsehood, (or attributively,) false, untrue. 13 Vile, low. 14 An ox whose horns are broken. m. (-टः) The name of a saint, also named AGASTYA. E. कूट to confuse, to withhold, अच् aff.
11174: कूटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfair, fraudulent. n. (-कं) A ploughshare. m. (-कः) 1 A braid or tress of hair. 2 A perfume: see मुरा. E. कूट to cut, and क्वुन् aff.
11175: कूटकार m. (-रः) 1 A rogue. 2 A cheat, a false witness. E. कूट, and कार who makes.
11176: कूटकारक m. (-कः) 1 A false witness. 2 A rogue, a cheat. E. कूट, and कारक who makes.
11177: कूटकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Fraudulent, dishonest. m. (-कृत्) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A Kāyastha or man of the writer cast. E. कूट illusion, &c. and कृत् who makes.
11178: कूटज m. (-जः) A medicinal plant: see कुटज.
11179: कूटता f. (-ता) Falsehood, fraud. E. तल् added to कूट; also with त्व, कूटत्वं.
11180: कूटपर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Fever occurring in an elephant from vitiation of the three humors; also read कूटपूर्व्व.
11181: कूटपाकल m. (-लः) 1 A bilious fever in an elephant. 2 A potter's kiln. E. कूट a heap, and पाक what ripens, लच् aff.
11182: कूटयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A trap or snare for deer, birds, &c. E. कूट a trap, and यन्त्र an implement; also simply कूट.
11183: कूटशाल्मलि m. (-लिः) A species of the Simul silk cotton tree. E. कूट false, and शाल्मलि the Simul.
11184: कूटशासन n. (-नं) A forged or false grant or decree. E. कूट, and शासन a grant, &c.
11185: कूटसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A false witness. E. कूट falsehood, and साक्षिन् a witness.
11186: कूटस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Uniform, perpetually and universally the same, as spirit, elementary matter, aether, &c. n. (-स्थं) 1 The soul. 2 A sort of perfume, a species of dried shell fish, commonly Nakhi. E. कूट fixed, and स्थ what remains.
11187: कूटस्वर्ण n. (-र्णं) Alloyed or counterfeit gold. कूट, and स्वर्ण gold.
11188: कूटाक्ष m. (-क्षः) Loaded or false dice. E. कूट, and अक्ष a die.
11189: कूटागार n. (-रं) An upper room, an apartment on the top of a house. E. कूट a peak, आगार a house.
11190: कूटार्थभाषिता f. (-ता) A tale, a story, a fiction. E. कूट false, अर्थ meaning, and भाषिता spoken.
11191: कूड r. 6th cl. (कूडति) 1 To be or become firm or solid. 2 To eat. 3 To graze.
11192: कूड्य n. (-ड्यं) A wall: see कुड्यं.
11193: कूण r. 10th cl. (कूणयते-ति) To contract or close.
11194: कूणि mfn. (-णिः णिः-णि) Crooked-armed, having a curved or withered arm: see कुणि.
11195: कूणिका f. (-का) 1 The horn of any animal. 2 The peg of a lute. E. कूण to sound or be crooked, वुन् and टाप् affs.
11196: कूणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contracted, shut, closed. E. कूण to contract, affix क्त.
11197: कूदर m. (-रः) The offspring of a Brahman woman by a Ṛṣi, begotten during menstruation. E. कु bad, उदर belly.
11198: कूद्दाल m. (-लः) Mountain ebony: see कुद्दाल.
11199: कून r. 10th cl. (कूनयति) To contract or close.
11200: कूप r. 10th cl. (कूपयति) 1 To be weak. 2 To weaken: see कुप.
11201: कूप m. (-पः) 1 A well. 2 A hole, a hollow. 3 A mast. 4 A tree or rock in the midst of a river. f. (-पी) 1 A small well. 2 The navel. 3 A flask, a bottle. E. कु to sound, (frogs croaking in a well, &c.) and प Uṇādi affix: the vowel is made long; also कूपक.
11202: कूपक m. (-कः) 1 The mast of a vessel. 2 A stake, &c. to which a boat is moored. 3 A leather oil vessel. 4 The hollow below the loins. 5 A funeral pile. 6 A well. 7 A temporary well, a hole dug for water in the dry bed of a rivulet. 8 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream. E. कन् added to the preceding.
11203: कूपमण्डूक m. (-कः) A frog in a well, applied to a person of no enterprise, one who never leaves his home. E. कूप, and मण्डूक a frog.
11204: कूपाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Horripilation, erection of the hairs of the body. E. कूप a well, and अङ्ग the body; some copies read कूपाङ्क, from अङ्क a mark.
11205: कूपार m. (-रः) The ocean; also कूवार, and अकूपार, &c.
11206: कूपिका f. (-का) A stone or rock in the middle of a stream: see कूपक.
11207: कूम n. (-मं) A lake, a pool, a pond.
11209: कूर्च्च mn. (-र्च्चः-र्च्चं) 1 The upper part of the nose, the part between the eye-brows. 2 The beard. 3 Deceit, fraud, circumvention. 4 Hard, solid. 5 The tip of the thumb and middle finger brought in contact, as to pinch, &c. 6 A handful of Kusa grass or peacock's feathers. 7 A bunch, a bundle, as of grass, &c. 8 A brush of the same. 9 The head. 10 False praise, unmerited commendation, either of one's self or another person, boasting, flattery. 11 Hypocrisy. 12 The mystic syllable Hum. E. कूर to sound, चङ् affix, or कृ to do, उर्च्च affix or कूर्च्च Sautra root, to praise, affix घञ्.
11210: कूर्च्चक n. (-कं) A brush for cleaning the teeth, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
11212: कूर्च्चशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) A drug, commonly Jivaka, one of the eight principal medicaments. E. कूर्च्च the beard, &c. and शीर्ष the head; being bearded: or from कूर्च्च praise, and शिर्ष chief; commendable amongst medicines; also with कन् added कूर्च्चशीर्षक.
11213: कूर्च्चशेखर m. (-रः) The cocoa nut tree. E. कूर्च्च a bunch, and शेखर summit.
11214: कूर्च्चिका f. (-का) 1 Inspissated milk. 2 A key. 3 A bud, a blossom. 4 A painting brush or pencil. 5 A needle. E. कूर्च्च to praise, &c. वुन् affix, and the fem. form.
11215: कूर्द r. 1st cl. (कूर्दते) To play: see कुर्द.
11216: कूर्दन n. (-नं) Playing, sport, pastime. f. (-नी) A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held on the day of full moon, in the month Chaitra. E. कूर्द to play, ल्युट् affix, fem. ङीप्.
11217: कूर्प्प n. (-र्प्पं) The space between the eye-brows. E. कॄ to scatter, &c. deriv. irr.: see कूर्च्च.
11218: कूर्प्पर mf. (-रः-रा) 1 The elbow. 2 The knee. E. कुर to sound, with क्विप् affix कुर, पर from पृ to nourish, the first vowel is made long; sometimes also कुर्पर.
11219: कूर्प्पास m. (-सः) A cuirass or quilted jacket worn as armour: see कूर्प्पासक.
11220: कूर्प्पासक mn. (-कः-कं) A bodice, a jacket with short sleeves worn next the body, by women especially. E. कूर्पर the elbow, आस to abide, घञ् affix, and र dropped, कूर्प्पास, see the preceding; again, कन् pleonastic affix added.
11221: कूर्म्म mf. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी) 1 A tortoise, a turtle. 2 The descent of VIṢṆU as a tortoise to support the mountain Mandāra at the churning of the ocean. 3 A peculiar gesticulation with the fingers. E. कु implying reverse, ऊर्म्मी speed, अच् aff.
11222: कूर्म्मचक्र n. (-क्रं) An astrological diagram. E. कूर्म्म, and चक्र circle.
11223: कूर्म्मपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठः) 1 Globe amaranth, (Gomphrena globosa.) 2 The back or shell of a tortoise. E. कूर्म्म a tortoise, and पृष्ठ the back.
11224: कूर्म्मपृष्ठक n. (-कं) The cover of a dish, a lid. E. कन् added to the preceding, implying resemblance.
11225: कूर्म्मराज m. (-जः) The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world. E. कूर्म्म tortoise, and राज a king, from राजन् with टच् aff.
11226: कूल r. 1st cl. (कूलति) To cover, to hide, to screen, to enclose: with अनु prefixed, to protect, to be kind to, as to a follower or dependant.
11227: कूल n. (-लं) 1 A bank, a shore. 2 A heap, a mound. 3 A pond or pool. 4 The rear of an army. E. कूल to cover, अच् aff.
11228: कूलक m. (-कः) An anthill. n. (-कं) 1 A mound of earth, a heap, a pile. 2 A bank, a dyke. E. कन् added to the former.
11229: कूलङ्कष m. (-षः) 1 The ocean, the sea. 2 The stream or current of a river. f. (-षा) A river. E. कूल a bank, कष to injure, affix स्वच्.
11230: कूलचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Frequenting the banks of rivers, grazing there, &c. E. कूल, चर what goes.
11231: कूलभू f. (-भूः) A bank, the land upon the bank or shore. E. कूल, and भू earth.
11232: कूलमुद्रुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Breaking down banks (as a river, &c.) E. कूल, रुज to make sick, with उत् pre. and खश aff.
11233: कूलमुद्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Carrying away the banks, (a river, &c.) E. कूल, वह to bear, उत् pre. खश् aff.
11234: कूलवती f. (-ती) A river. E. कूल a bank, and मतुप् poss. affix, fem. ङीष्.
11235: कूलहण्डक m. (-कः) An eddy. E. कूल a bank, and हुडि to collect, वुन् affix, deriv. irr.
11236: कूलिका f. (-का) Base or bottom part of the Indian lute.
11237: कूवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Beautiful, agreeable, pleasing. mn. (-रः-रं) The pole of a carriage or wood to which the yoke is fixed. m. (-रः) A humpbacked man. f. (-री) A carriage covered with a cloth or blanket. E. कू to sound, and वर from वृ to cherish, with अप् aff.
11238: कूवरिन् m. (-री) A carriage. E. कूवर the pole, इनि
11239: कूष्माण्ड mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita pepo.) m. (-ण्डः) A kind of sprite or imp, of which there exists a Gaṇa or class. f. (-ण्डी) A name of DURGĀ; also कुम्माण्ड and कूष्माण्डक.
11240: कूष्माण्डक m. (-कः) A pumpkin gourd: see कूष्माण्ड. E. कु bad, उष्म warm, and अण्ड an egg, here put for seed, कन् aff.
11241: कूहना f. (-ना) Hypocrisy, affectation of religious zeal or austerity: see कुहना.
11242: कूहा f. (-हा) A fog, a mist. E. कुह to astonish, अङ् and टाप् affs.
11243: कृ r. 5th cl. (ञ्) कृञ् (कृणोति कृणुते) To hurt, to injure, to kill. (डु, ञ,) डुकृञ् r. 8th cl. (करोति कुरुते) To do, to make, to perform any kind of action: this root admits most of the prepositions and a variety of significations; it is also active or deponent, according to its prefix and import; as, 1 With अति, (अतिकुरुते) To exceed, to do more. 2 With अधि, (अधिकुरुते) ^a To surpass or overcome. ^b To superintend, to govern. ^c To hold of right. ^d To bear patiently. ^e To refrain from. 3 With अनु (अनुकरोति) To copy, to imitate, to act like or after. 4 With अप (अपकुरुते) ^a To wrong, to injure. ^b To do evil. 5 With आङ् (आकुरुते) ^a To call. ^b To take shape or form. 6 With उत् (उत्कुरुते) ^a To kill or hurt dangerously. ^b To collect, to assemble. 7 With उद् and आङ् (उदाकुरुते) To reproach. 8 With उप (उपकुरुते) To befriend, to serve or assist. 9 With उप, and स inserted (उपस्कुरुते, or उपस्करोति) To alter. (उपस्करोति) ^a To polish, to adorn. ^b To assemble. ^c To reply. 10 With तिरस् (तिरस्करोति) To abuse, to revile. 11 With दुर् (दुष्करोति) To do evil. 12 With निर् and आङ् (निराकुरुते) ^a To make light of, to contemn. ^b To expel. ^c To annihilate. 13 With परि, and स inserted (परिष्करोति) To polish, to refine, to make elegant or perfect. 14 With पर and आङ् (पराकरोति) To act well. 15 With प्र (प्रकुरुते) ^a To begin. ^b To do any thing quickly. ^c To serve. ^d To allot, to portion. ^e To violate. ^f To chaunt, to recite. 16 With प्रति (प्रतिकुरुते) ^a To counteract. ^b To retaliate. ^c To remedy. 17 With प्रति and उप (प्रत्युपकुरुते) To requite, to return a kindness; with वि (विकुरुते) ^a To utter, to sound. ^b To seek, to strive for. (विकरोति) ^a To alter, to change in form. ^b To disturb or agitate. 18 With वि and आङ् (व्याकुरुते) ^a To explain, to expound. ^b To make manifest or public. 19 With सम (संस्करोति) ^a To polish, to perfect. ^b To assemble, to bring together. 20 With सु (सुकरोति) To do well.
11244: कृक m. (-कः) The throat, the larynx. E. कृ to make, and क्वुन् affix, what makes or produces sound.
