11245: कृकण m. (-णः) 1 A kind of partridge, commonly Kaër, (Perdix sylvatica.) 2 A worm. E. कृक the throat, and अण् to sound, affix अच्, the deriv. irr.
11246: कृकणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a partridge. E. कृकण and छ aff.
11247: कृकर m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 One of the five vital airs, that which assists in digestion. 3 A kind of partridge: see कृकण. 4 A sort of pepper, (P. chavya.) 5 The oleander tree. E. कृक the throat, and र what gets or receives; or कृ imitative sound, and कर what makes, from कृ to make or do, affix अप्.
11249: कृकलास m. (-सः) A lizard, a chameleon. E. कृक the throat, and लस to play, &c. affix अण्; also कृकलाश.
11250: कृकवाकु m. (-कुः) 1 A cock, a gallinaceous fowl. 2 A peacock. 3 A lizard, a chameleon. E. कृक the throat, वच् to speak, Uṇādi affix ञुण्.
11251: कृकवाकुध्वज m. (-जः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. कृकवाकु a peacock, and ध्वज a standard or symbol; the peacock is the vehicle and standard of SKANDA.
11252: कृकाटिका f. (-का) 1 The back of the neck. 2 The raised and straight part of the neck. E. कृक the throat, अट to go, वुन् aff.
11253: कृकुलास m. (-सः) A lizard, a chameleon: see कृकलास.
11254: कृच्छ्र mfn. (-च्छ्रः-च्छ्रा-च्छ्रं) 1 Attended with pain, painful. 2 Wicked, sinful. mn. (-च्छ्रः-च्छ्रं) Bodily pain. 2 Penance, expiation. 3 Sin. 4 Difficulty, labour, trouble. 5 A kind of religious penance, according to some, the same as the Prājāpatya: (see प्राजापत्य;) according to others, as the Sāntapana: (see सान्तपनं) E. कृत to cut, रक् Uṇādi affix, and छ substituted for the final.
11255: कृच्छ्रगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Embarrassed, distressed. 2 Pained, suffering pain. E. कृच्छ्र, and गत gone to or in.
11256: कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्र m. (-च्छ्रः) A kind of penance, taking no sustenance but water for three, nine, twelve, or twenty-one days. E. कृच्छ्र one kind of penance, and अतिकृच्छ्र another; the substance of both.
11257: कृच्छ्रार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) An inferior penance lasting six days. E. कृच्छ्र, and अर्द्ध half.
11258: कृड r. 6th cl. (कृडति) 1 To be thick or coarse, to be gross, to be solid. 2 To eat.
11259: कृणु m. (-णः) A painter. E. कृ to do or make, क्रु aff.
11260: कृत (ई,) कृती r. 6th cl. (कृन्तति) To cut, to divide. r. 7th cl. (कृणति) To surround, to encompass.
11261: कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done, made, performed. 2 Injured, hurt. 3 Fit, proper. n. (-तं) 1 The first of the four ages of the world, the Satya yug. 2 Fruit, consequence. adv. 1 Enough, sufficient. 2 Enough, completely finished. 3 Enough, have done, no more. E. कृ to do, to injure, &c. affix क्त.
11262: कृतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Artificial, factitious, made, not produced spontaneously. 2 Assumed, simulated, not natural. n. (-कं) Factitious salt, produced by boiling and evaporating from saline soils. E. कृत to cut or divide, Uṇādi affix अक.
11263: कृतकपट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Deceiving, beguiling, fraudulent. E. कृत, and कपट deceit.
11264: कृतकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Having done or discharged, or being done, (a duty.) कृत done, कर्त्तव्य what was to be done.
11265: कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Skilful, clever, able. E. कृत made, and कर्म्मन् act.
11267: कृतकाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fixed, settled as to time. 2 Sent or deposited, &c. for a certain time. E. कृत, and काल time.
11268: कृतकूर्च्छक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Tied up as a small bundle or brush. E. कृतकूर्च्छ a bundle, and कन् added.
11269: कृतकृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Having done or discharged any thing to be done. 2 Having accomplished or attained any object. 3 Contented, satisfied. E. कृत done, and कृत्य what was to be done; also कृतकर्त्तव्य, कृतकार्य्य, &c.
11270: कृतकृत्यता f. (-ता) Success, attainment, accomplishment, the full discharge of any duty or realisation of any object. E. कृतकृत्य, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, कृतकृत्यत्वं.
11271: कृतकोटि m. (-टिः) 1 A name of the saint KAŚYAPA. 2 A name of UPAVARṢA, another divine sage. E. कृत made, कोटि excellence.
11272: कृतकोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Angry, indignant. E. कृत, and कोप anger.
11273: कृतक्रय m. (-यः) A purchaser, a buyer. E. कृत, and क्रय purchase.
11274: कृतक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Having finished or completed any thing in which one was engaged. 2 Having attained any end or accomplished any object. 3 Having fulfilled one's duty. E. कृत done, क्रिया work, duty, &c.
11275: कृतक्रुध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Angry, resentful. E. कृत, and क्रुधा wrath.
11276: कृतघातयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Assaulting, attacking, one who tries to kill. E. कृत, घात a blow, यत्न effort.
11277: कृतघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) 1 Ungrateful, not acknowledging former good offices. 2 Defeating or rendering vain all previous measures. E. कृत what has been done, and घ्न killing, destroying.
11278: कृतघ्नता f. (-ता) Ingratitude. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कृतघ्नत्वं.
11279: कृतचूड m. (-डः) A boy on whom the ceremony of tonsure has been performed. E. कृत, and चूडा a crest, a lock of hair being left on the top of the head.
11280: कृतजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) 1 Born, produced. 2 Generated. E. कृत, and जन्मन् birth.
11281: कृतज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Grateful, remembering former aid or favours. 2 Observant of propriety, correct in conduct. m. (-ज्ञः) A dog. E. कृत what is done, and ज्ञ who knows.
11282: कृतज्ञता f. (-ता) Gratitude. E. कृतज्ञ, and तल् affix; also कृतज्ञत्वं.
11283: कृततीर्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 A guide to holy places, &c. one who frequents them. 2 A councillor, one fertile in expedients. E. कृत, तीर्थ pilgrimage, &c.
11284: कृतत्व n. (-त्वं) The being done or effected. E. त्व, added to कृत.
11285: कृतदार m. (-रः) A married man. E. कृत, and दार a wife.
11286: कृतदास mf. (-सः-सी) A self-engaged servant, a hired servant. E. कृत made, (spontaneously,) and दास a slave.
11287: कृतधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) 1 Prudent, considerate. 2 Learned, educated. E. कृत, and धी understanding.
11288: कृतध्वंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Defeated, overpowered. 2 Injured, destroyed. 3 Recollecting past transactions. E. कृत, and ध्वंस loss.
11289: कृतध्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Lost after being once possessed or acquired. E. कृत made, gained, ध्वस्त destroyed.
11290: कृतनाशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ungrateful. E. कृत, and नाशक who destroys.
11291: कृतनिर्णेजन m. (-नः) A penitent, one who has performed penance or made expiation. E. कृत, and निर्णेजन cleansing.
11292: कृतनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Confident, sure, certain. E. कृत, and निश्चय certainly.
11293: कृतपुङ्ख mfn. (ङ्खः-ङ्खा-ङ्खं) Skilled in archery. E. कृत done, made, पुङ्ख the feather of an arrow.
11294: कृतपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Done formerly or precedingly. E. कृत, and पूर्व्व prior.
11295: कृतपूर्व्वनाशन n. (-नं) Ingratitude, forgetting past services. E. कृतपूर्व्व, and नाशन destroying.
11296: कृतपूर्व्विन् mfn. (-र्व्वी-र्व्विणी-र्व्वि) One by whom any thing was done in time past. E. कृत done, पूर्व्व formerly, इनि affix of agency.
11297: कृतपौरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Behaving gallantly. E. कृत, and पौरुष manhood.
11298: कृतप्रणाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Saluting, making or having made obeisance. E. कृत, and प्रणाम salute.
11299: कृतप्रयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Active, industrious, persevering. E. कृत, and प्रयत्न effort.
11300: कृतफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Successful, fruitful. n. (-लं) 1 Result, consequence of an act. 2 A poisonous substance: see कृक्वोल. E. कृत, and फल fruit.
11301: कृतबाहु mfn. (-हुः-हुः-हु) Laying hand upon, touching. E. कृत, and बाहु the arm.
11302: कृतबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Informed of one's duty, having acquired knowledge. E. कृत, and बुद्धि understanding.
11303: कृतभय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Alarmed, apprehensive. E. कृत, and भय fear.
11304: कृतमङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Blessed, consecrated. E. कृत, and मङ्गल auspicious.
11305: कृतमन्यु mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु) Angry, offended, indignant. E. कृत, and मन्यु anger.
11306: कृतमाल m. (-लः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. कृत made, माल a garland, garlands being made of its flowers; also आरग्वध.
11307: कृतमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Skilled, clever, conversant. E. कृत done, and मुख chief, principal.
11308: कृतरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Sounding, singing. E. कृत, and रव a sound.
11309: कृतरुच् mfn. (-रुक्) Splendid, brilliant. E. कृत, and रुच् light; also कृतरुचि.
11310: कृतरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Angry, displeased. E. कृत, and रुषा wrath.
11311: कृतलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Excellent, amiable, &c. noted for good qualities. 2 Defined, discriminated. 3 Marked, stamped. 4 Branded. E. कृत made, लक्षण a mark, a sign.
11312: कृतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Making, was making, made. E. कृत, and क्तवतु aff.
11313: कृतवाप m. (-पः) A penitent who has shaven his head and chin. E. कृत, and वाप tonsure.
11314: कृतविक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Altered, changed. E. कृत, and विक्रिय change; also कृतविकार.
11315: कृतविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Scientific, a philosopher. E. कृत, and विद्या knowledge.
11316: कृतविस्मय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Surpassing, astonishing. E. कृत, and वित्पय wonder.
11317: कृतवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Hired as a servant or labourer. E. कृत made, appointed, and वतन wages.
11318: कृतवेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Grateful. 2 Knowing, observant. E. कृत, and वेदिन् who knows.
11319: कृतवेधन m. (-नः) A plant, a sort of Ghosha with white flowers: see घोष.
11320: कृतवेपथु mfn. (-थुः-थुः-थु) Trembling. E. कृत, and वेपथु trembling.
11321: कृतवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Decorating, adorning. E. कृत, and वेश dress.
11322: कृतव्यलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Annoyed, vexed, irritated. कृत, and व्यलीक pain, &c.
11323: कृतशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Putting forth one's strength or courage. E. कृत, and शक्ति power.
11324: कृतशोभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Splendid, brilliant. 2 Beautiful, beautified. 3 Dexterous, handy. E. कृत, and शोभा splendor.
11325: कृतशौच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Purified, cleansed, freed from the natural dejections, released from conventional defilement, &c. E. कृत, and शाच purification.
11326: कृतश्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Laborious, assiduous, persevering, painstaking, making great or continuous exertions. E. कृत made, श्रम fatigue.
11327: कृतसङ्केत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Making an agreement or appointment, E. कृत, and सङ्केत agreement.
11328: कृतसंसर्ग mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) Approximate, united. E. कृत, and संसर्ग union.
11329: कृतसंस्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Initiated, having undergone all the purificatory ceremonies. E. कृत, and संस्कार rite.
11330: कृतसज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Distinguished by appropriate marks, devices, &c. E. कृत, and सज्ञा a signal.
11331: कृतसन्निधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Contracted, approximated. E. कृत, and सन्निधान proximity.
11332: कृतसम्बन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Connected, allied. E. कृत, and सम्बन्ध alliance.
11333: कृतसापत्निका f. (-का) A woman whose husband has taken another wife. E. कृक made, स with, together with, पत्नी a wife, affix कन्: or derived from सापत्नक, कृतसापत्नका; also कृतसापत्नी, &c.
11334: कृतस्थिति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Abiding, staying, taking up an abode in or with. E. कृत, and स्थिति stay.
11335: कृतस्वस्त्ययन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Recommended to the protection of gods previous to any journey or undertaking. E. कृत, स्वस्त्ययन benediction.
11336: कृतहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Skilled in archery. 2 Clever, skilful, dexterous. E. कृत exercised, हस्त the hand; also कृतहस्तक.
11337: कृताकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done in part, not completed. 2 Committed and omitted. E. कृत, and अकृत undone.
11338: कृतागम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Advanced, proficient. E. कृत, and आगम coming.
11339: कृतागस् mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः) Criminal, offending, in fault. E. कृत done, अगस् crime.
11340: कृताग्निकार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A Brahman who has offered the usual oblations with fire. E. कृत, and अग्निकार्य्य fire-sacrifice.
11341: कृताङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) 1 Marked. 2 Numbered. 3 Branded. E. कृत, and अङ्क a mark.
11342: कृताञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) One who joins the palms of the hands, making such a sign of reverence or solicitation, reverent, respectful. m. (-लिः) A shrub used in medicine, also in magical potions, &c. E. कृत made, अञ्जलि the hand joined, &c.
11343: कृताञ्जलिपुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Joining the palms of the hands for the purpose of doing obeisance, also for holding water, &c. E. कृत, and अञ्जलिपुट the palms joined.
11344: कृतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Subdued, tranquil, of a self-governed spirit. E. कृत, and आत्मन् self.
11345: कृतानति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Bending, bowed, paying homage or respect. E. कृत, and आनति bowing.
11346: कृतानुकूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Kind, favouring, compliant. E. कृत, आनुकूल्य favour.
11347: कृतानुव्याध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Mixed, combined, united. E. कृत, and अनुव्याध mixture.
11348: कृतानुसार m. (-रः) Established practice, usage, custom, rate. E. कृत, and अनुसार custom.
11349: कृतान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A name of YAMA, son of SŪRYA, and regent of the dead, or death personified. 2 Destiny, that is, the inevitable result of actions done in a past existence. 3 A demonstrated conclusion, proved or established doctrine. 4 Sinful or inauspicious action. 5 Saturday, which is considered as an unlucky day. f. (-न्ता) A perfume: see रेणुका. E. कृत act, (actum) done, अन्त end, destruction.
11351: कृतान्तजनक m. (-कः) A name of the sun. E. कृतान्त YAMA, and जनक progenitor; being the father of YAMA.
11352: कृतापकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Injured, wronged. 2 Discomfited, overpowered. 3 Doing wrong, offending. E. कृत, and अपकार offence.
11353: कृतापदान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Completing a task, effecting an object. E. कृत, and अपदान accomplishment.
11354: कृतापराध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Guilty, culpable, an offender. E. कृत, and अपराध offence.
11355: कृताभिषेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Inaugurated. m. (-कः) A prince, &c. who has been inaugurated. E. कृत, and अभिषेक sprinkling.
11356: कृतार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Successful, having attained an end, having accomplished a purpose or desire. E. कृत done, अर्थ object.
11357: कृतार्थता f. (-ता) Success, fruitfulness, accomplishment of an object. E. तल् added to the last; also कृतार्थत्व.
11358: कृतार्थीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rendered successful. E. कृतार्थ, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
11359: कृतार्थीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become successful. E. कृतार्थ, and भूत been, च्चि augment.
11360: कृतालय m. (-यः) A frog. E. कृत made, आलय abode.
11361: कृतावधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Careful, cautious, prudent, attentive. E. कृत, and अवधान care.
11362: कृतावधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) 1 Fixed, appointed, agreed upon. 2 Bounded, limited. E. कृत, and अवधि term, &c.
11363: कृतावमर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) 1 Disregarding, effacing from recollection. 2 Intolerant. E. कृत, and अवमर्ष impatience.
11364: कृतावशक्थिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Seated on the hams with the knees tied together, or the hips and knees surrounded by a cloth. E. कृत, and अवशक्थिका the cloth so used.
11365: कृतावस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Summoned, called. 2 Made present. 3 Fixed, settled. E. कृत, and अवस्था condition.
11366: कृतावास m. (-सः) A lodging, a temporary accommodation, an apartment. E. कृत, and आवास abode.
11367: कृताशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Feeding upon. E. कृत, and अशन eating.
11368: कृतास्कन्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Assailing, attacking. 2 Effacing from recollection. E. कृत, and आस्कन्दन going to.
11369: कृतास्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Armed. E. कृत, and अस्त्र weapon.
11370: कृतास्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Governed, ruled. 2 Supporting, rested upon by any thing. 3 Residing in or on, taking one's abode. E. कृत, and आस्पद place, rule.
11371: कृताहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having performed the daily ceremonies, or devotions. E. कृत, अहन् a day, कन् added.
11372: कृताह्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Summoned, called. 2 Challenged. E. कृत, and आह्वान calling.
11373: कृति f. (-तिः) 1 Act, action, acting, doing, &c. 2 Injuring, hurt, hurting. 3 A sort of metre, a stanza of four lines, with twenty syllables in each. E. कृ to do, to injure, क्तिन् aff.
11374: कृतिकर m. (-रः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. कृति injuring, कृ to do, ट aff.
11375: कृतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Wise, learned. 2 Clever, skilful. 3 Good, virtuous. 4 Pure, pious. 5 Following, obeying, doing what is enjoined. E. कृत done, performed, इनि affix; by whom proper acts are done.
11376: कृते ind. For, on account of.
11377: कृतेर्ष्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं) Envious, jealous. E. कृत, and ईर्ष्या envy.
11378: कृतोच्चैस् ind. Raised on high. E. कृत, and उच्चैस् high.
11379: कृतोदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having performed ablutions. E. कृत, and उदक water.
11380: कृतोद्वाह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Performing penance by standing with uplifted hands. 2 Married. E. कृत, and उद्वाह marriage.
11381: कृतोपकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Assisted, befriended. 2 Friendly, giving aid. E. कृत, and उपकार help.
11382: कृतोपनयन m. (-नः) The student invested with the sacrificial cord. E. कृत, and उपनयन investiture.
11383: कृतोपभोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Used, enjoyed. E. कृत, and उपभोग use.
11384: कृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Cut, divided. 2 Desired, sought, wished for. E. कृत to cut, &c. affix क्त.
11385: कृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 The hide upon which the religious student sits, sleeps, &c. usually the skin of an antelope. 2 The skin. 3 The bark of the Bhojpatra, used for writing upon, for making hooka snakes, &c. 4 One of the lunar mansions: see the next. E. कृत to cut, क्तिन् aff.
11386: कृत्तिका f. (-का) 1 The third of the lunar mansions, or constellations in the moon's path, consisting of six stars, and corresponding to the Pleiades. 2 (In mythology,) a nymph; one of six, the nurses of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. कृत to cut, क्तिन् and कन् affixes; the figure of the asterism is a razor or knife.
11387: कृत्तिकाभव m. (-वः) A name of CANDRA or the moon. E. कृत्तिका the constellation, and मव who is born.
11388: कृत्तिकासुत m. (-तः) A name of SKANDA or KĀRTTIKEYA. E. कृत्तिका, and सुत the son; the nymphs so named being his foster mothers.
11389: कृत्तिवास m. (-सः) ŚIVA: see the next.
11390: कृत्तिवासस् m. (-सः) An appellation of MAHĀDEVA. E. कृत्ति a skin or hide, and वासस् clothes; clothes with a tiger's skin; also कृत्तिवास.
11391: कृत्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) An artist, an artificer or mechanic. E. कृ to make, कत्नु Uṇādi aff.
11392: कृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 To be done or performed. 2 To be rendered murderous or mischievous, hired as an assassin, seduced from allegiance or alliance, hostile through covetousness, &c. f. (-त्या) 1 Action, act. 2 A female deity, to whom sacrifices are offered for destructive and magical purposes. 3 Magic. 4 A pestilence. n. (-त्यं) 1 Motive, cause. 2 The class of affixes in grammar forming nouns corresponding to gerunds and supines, chiefly with a passive signification, but sometimes active, and sometimes abstract nouns. E. कृत to injure, to divide, &c. क्यप् or यत् affixed, or कृत to injure, वुन् affix, and य inserted.
11394: कृत्यज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Learned, wise, who knows what is to be done. E. कृत्य, and ज्ञ who knows.
11395: कृत्यवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The right way, the manner in which any object is to be effected. E. कृत्य, and वर्त्मन् a road.
11396: कृत्यविद् mf. (-विद्) Learned, wise, who knows what is to be done. E. कृत्य, and विद who knows.
11397: कृत्यविधि f. (-धिः) The way to do any thing, a rule or precept. E. कृत्य, and विधि rule.
11398: कृत्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Made, factitious, artificial, the reverse of what is naturally or spontaneously produced. m. (-मः) 1 Incense, olibanum. 2 An adopted son, used for कृत्रिमपुत्र. n. (-मं) A kind of salt, the common Bit Noben or Bit Lavan, E. कृ to make, क्त्रि Uṇādi affix, and मम् added.
11399: कृत्रिमधूप m. (-पः) A compound perfume, containing ten or eighteen ingredients. E. कृत्रिम artificial, and धूप resin; also with कन् added कृत्रिमधूपक.
11400: कृत्रिमपुत्र m. (-त्रः) An adopted son; one of the twelve kinds recognized in law, the son made. E. कृत्रिम, and पुत्र a son.
11401: कृत्रिममित्र m. (-त्रः) An acquired friend; one on whom benefits have been conferred, or from whom they have been received. E. कृत्रिम made, and मित्र a friend; also similar compounds in this or other senses, कृत्रिमशत्रु an acquired enemy, कृत्रिमौदसीन one who is indifferent to benefits or injuries, neither an acquired friend nor foe.
11402: कृत्वा ind. Having done, made, &c. E. कृ to do, क्त्वाच् aff.
11403: कृत्स n. (-त्सं) 1 Water. 2 Entire, whole. E. कृत to surround, and स Uṇādi aff.
11404: कृत्स्न mfn. (-त्स्नः-त्स्ना-त्स्नं) All, whole, entire. n. (-त्स्नं) Water. 2 The flank or hip. E. कृत to encompass, क्स्न Uṇādi aff.
11405: कृत्स्नविद् mfn. (-वित् or -विद्) Omniscient, acquainted with all things. E. कृत्स्न all, and विद् who knows.
11406: कृत्स्नशस् ind. Wholly, entirely, altogether. E. कृत्स्न, and शम् aff.
11407: कृदर m. (-रः) A granary, a cupboard, &c. for holding corn, grain, &c. E. कृत to contain, Uṇādi affix अर.
11408: कृदन्त m. (-न्तः) A noun formed by the application of the affixes termed कृत् to the root. E. कृत, and अन्त a final.
11409: कृन्तत्र n. (-त्रं) A plough. E. कृत to divide or cut, कत्रन् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
11410: कृन्तन m. (-नं) Cutting. E. कृति to cut, ल्युट् aff.
11411: कृन्तनिका f. (-का) 1 A knife. 2 The edge of a knife. E. कन् added to the last.
11412: कृप (ऊ, ऌ) ऊकृपॢ r. 1st cl. (कल्पते) To be able. r. 1st and 10th cls. (कल्पति, कल्पयति) 1 To think or imagine. 2 To mix. 3 To paint or colour. r. 1st cl. (कृपति) To have pity or mercy. r. 10th cl. (कृपयति) To be weak. In the first roots ल ॡ is substituted for ऋ.
11413: कृप m. (-पः) 1 The name of a sage, the brother-in-law of DROṆA. 2 A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas. f. (-पा) Tenderness, compassionateness. f. (-पी) The wife of the sage DROṆA. E. कृप to be able, &c. अङ् aff.
11414: कृपण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Miserly, avaricious. 2 Low, vile. 3 Poor, feeble, miserable, pitiable. m. (-णः) A worm. E. कृप to be able, क्वुन् or ल्युट् aff.
11415: कृपाण m. (-णः) A sword, a scymitar or sacrificial knife. f. (-णी) 1 A knife. 2 A shears or scissors. 4 A dagger. E. कृपा mercy, नुद to destroy, ड aff.
11416: कृपाणक m. (-कः) A sword, a scymitar: see the preceding. E. कन् added to कृपाण.
11417: कृपाणिका f. (-का) A knife. E. कन् added to कृपाण, and the fem. aff.
11418: कृपाद्वैत m. (-तः) One of the Buddhas or deified saints of the Bauddhas. E. कृपा compassion, and अद्वैत not second; unequalled for tenderness.
11419: कृपालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Compassionate, tender. E. कृपा tenderness, आलुक् aff.
11420: कृपामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Compassionate: so कृपावत् (-वान्-वती-वत्) कृपान्वित (-तः-ता-तं) &c.
11421: कृपाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unfeeling, unkind, hardhearted. E. कृपा, हीन devoid of.
11422: कृपीट n. (-टं) 1 The belly. 2 Water. 3 A wood, a forest. 4 Wood, timber. E. कृप to be able, कीटन् Uṇādi aff.
11423: कृपीटपाल m. (-लः) 1 The ocean. 2 A rudder or large oar used as one. 3 Air, wind. E. कृपीट water, पाल what preserves, &c. अच् aff.
11424: कृपीटयोनि m. (-निः) Fire. E. कृपीट water, योनि source, place of origin.
11425: कृपीपति m. (-तिः) A name of DROṆĀCĀRYA. E. कृपी the wife of the sage, and पति master.
11426: कृपीपुत्र m. (-त्रः) AŚVATTHĀMA a sage, the son of KṚPĪ and DROṆA. E. कृपी, and पुत्र a son, or with other synonyms of a son, as कृपीसुत, &c.
11427: कृब r. 1st cl. or 5th cl. (इ,) कृवि (कृणोति) 1 To kill, to hurt or injure in any way. 2 To act, to do. 3 To go, to move. 4 To be in pain.
11428: कृमि m. (-मिः) 1 A worm, an insect in general. 2 Lac, the red dye, which is in fact an insect. 5 An Asura or demon. 4 One subject to worms. E. क्रम to go, इन् Uṇādi affix, and the corresponding vowel substituted for र; also किमि.
11429: कृमिकण्टक n. (-कं) 1 A plant used in medicine: see बिडङ्ग. 2 Opposite leaved fig tree. 3 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata:) see मूषिकपर्णी. E. कृमि a worm, and कण्टक a thorn, a foe; also क्रिमिकण्ठक.
11430: कृमिकर्ण m. (-र्णः) Worms or lice generating in the external ear. E. कृमि, and कर्ण the ear.
11431: कृमिकोशोत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Silken, silk. E. कृमि a worm, कोश a ball, and उत्थ what comes or rises from.
11432: कृमिग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) Insects generated at the roots of the eyelashes. E. कृमि, and ग्रन्थि a joint.
11433: कृमिघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Vermifuge, anthelmintic. m. (-घ्नः) 1 A shrub used in medicine, as an anthelmintic, commonly Bireṅg, (Erycibe paniculata, Rox.) see बिडङ्ग. 2 The onion. 3 The root of the jujube. 4 The marking nut plant. f. (-घ्नी) Turmeric. E. कृमि a worm, हन् to kill, and टक् affix; also क्रिमिघ्न.
11434: कृमिज n. (-जं) Agallochum: see क्रिमिज. f. (-जा) Lac, a red dye so called. E. कृमि an insect, and ज born, produced.
11435: कृमिदन्तक m. (-कः) Toothache with decay of the teeth. E. कृमि, and दन्त a tooth, कन् added.
11436: कृमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Affected with worms. E. कृमि, and इनि aff.
11437: कृमिरिपु n. (-पुः) An anthelmintic plant: see कृमिघ्न. E. कृमि, and रिपु an enemy.
11438: कृमिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having worms, wormy. f. (-ला) A fruitful woman, one bearing many children. E. कृमि a worm, and ला to receive, to get, affix ड.
11439: कृमिशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) The fish of the conch. E. कृमि a worm, and शङ्ख a shell.
11440: कृमिशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) An oyster. E. कृमि an insect, and शुक्ति oyster-shell.
11441: कृमिशैल m. (-लः) An ant or mole hill. E. कृमि a worm, and शैल a hill; also with कन् added, कृमिशैलक.
11442: कृमिहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Anthelmintic, vermifuge. E. कृमि, and हर what removes; so कृमिहन्तृ (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ.)
11443: कृमीलक m. (-कः) A wild sort of kidney bean: see बनमुद्ग.
11444: कृवि r. 5th cl. (कृविणीति) To want to hurt or kill.
11445: कृवि m. (-विः) A loom. E. कृ to make, (cloth,) and क्विन् Uṇādi aff.
11446: कृश r. 4th cl. (इर) कृशिर (कृश्यति) To make thin or small.
11447: कृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Small, thin, little, minute. 2 Thin, spare, emaciated. 3 Weak, feeble. E. कृश to pare or make thin, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
11448: कृशता f. (-ता) Leanness, thinness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कृशत्वं.
11449: कृशर mf. (-रः-रा) 1 A dish composed of milk, sesamum, and rice. 2 Rice and pease boiled together with a few spices, commonly Khichree; also कृसर.
11450: कृशला f. (-ला) The hair of the head. E. कृश minute, ल what receives.
11451: कृशाकु m. (-कुः) 1 Heating. 2 Grieving. E. कृश to make small, and काकु aff.
11452: कृशाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A spider. E. कृश, अक्षि eye, टच् aff.
11453: कृशाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Spare, thin, emaciate. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 A woman with a slender shape. 2 A plant, commonly Priyangu: see प्रियङ्गु. E. कृश thin, अङ्ग the body, अण् and ङीष् affs.
11454: कृशानु m. (-नुः) 1 A name of fire. 2 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.) E. कृश to make thin, आनुक Uṇādi aff.
11455: कृशानुरेतस् m. (-ताः) A name of ŚIVA. E. कृशानु fire, and रेतस् semen virile.
11456: कृशाश्व m. (-श्वः) The name of a sage.
11457: कृशाश्विन् m. (-श्वी) A dancer, an actor, a tumbler. E. कृशाश्व the name of a saint, the author of directions to players, and इनि aff.
11458: कृष r. 1st cl. (आ) औकृश (कर्षति) and 6th cl. (कृषति-ते) 1 To draw or make furrows. 2 To plough. With अप, 1 To draw down. 2 To debase. 3 To disregard. With अव, 1 To draw out or off. 2 To disregard or contemn. With आङ्, To attract, to draw to. With उत्, 1 To raise, to draw up. 2 To raise, to excite, to make high, proud, loud, &c. With सम, To draw together. With सम and नि, To bring near or close to.
11459: कृषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What or who makes furrows or ploughs. 2 Attractive, attrahent. m. (-कः) 1 The ploughshare. 2 A husbandman, a peasant. E. कृष to plough, &c. Uṇādi affix, क्वुन्; also कृषिक.
11461: कृषाणु m. (-णुः) A name of fire: see कृशानु.
11462: कृषि f. (-षिः) 1 Husbandry, agriculture. 2 Ploughing, cultivating the soil, &c. E. कृष to plough, इक् Uṇādi aff.
11463: कृषिक m. (-कः) 1 The ploughshare. 2 A husbandman, a cultivator. E. कृष to plough, Uṇādi affix किकन्; also कृषक.
11464: कृषिजीविन् m. (-वी) A cultivator, a farmer. E. कृषि, and नीविन् who lives by.
11465: कृषिफल n. (-लं) Agricultural produce or profit. E. कृषि, and फल fruit.
11466: कृषीबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who lives by agriculture, &c. m. (-लः) A husbandman. E. कृषि agriculture, वलच् affix, and इ made ई.
11467: कृष्कर m. (-रः) An appellation of ŚIVA.
11468: कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ploughed or tilled, a field, &c. E. कृष to plough, affix क्त.
11469: कृष्टपच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Sown in ripening after ploughing, (rice, &c.) E. कृष्ट ploughed, पच to ripen, and क्यप् affix; in some places the grain is sown without previous ploughing, whence it is called अकृष्टपच्य.
11470: कृष्टपाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Sown or rather ripening after ploughing: see कृष्टपच्य.
11471: कृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A teacher, a learned man or Paṇḍita. f. (-ष्टिः) Ploughing, cultivating the soil. 2 Attracting, drawing. E. कृष to plough, to trace, ति or क्तिन् aff.
11472: कृष्णंश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Devoted to Kṛṣṇa. E. कृष्णं second case, श्रित serving; also कृष्णश्रित.
11473: कृष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Black or dark blue. m. (-ष्णः) 1 Black, the colour, or dark blue, which is often confounded with it by the Hindus. 2 KṚṢṆA, the most celebrated form of VIṢṆU, or rather VIṢṆU himself; he is distinct from the ten Avatāras or incarnations, being identified with the deity. 3 VYĀSA, a sage, the compiler of the Vedas. 4 A name of ARJUNA. 5 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 6 A crow. 7 A fruit, Karonda or Karinda, (Carissa carondas.) 8 The dark half of the lunar month from full to new moon. n. (-ष्णं) 1 Black pepper. 2 Iron. 3 Blue vitriol. 4 Black agallochum. f. (-ष्णा) 1 A name of DRAUPADĪ wife of the PĀṆḌAVAS. 2 The indigo plant. 3 Long pepper. 4 A grape. 5 A drug, commonly Kakoli. 6 Kalonji, (Nigella Indica:) see कृष्णजीरक. 7 Black mustard, (the name is applied to other vegetable substances of a dark colour.) 8 The Kṛṣṇā river in the Dekhin. 9 A black leech, considered poisonous. E. कृष to attract, as the minds of men, &c. नक् Uṇādi affix; (this is applied to KṚṢṆA, &c.) else, कृष to tinge, affix the same; again कृष्ण black, &c. and अच् affix, fem. affix टाप्.
11474: कृष्णकन्द n. (-न्दं) The red lotus, (Nymphaea rubra.) E. कृष्ण black, and कन्द stalk.
11475: कृष्णकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Criminal, guilty. n. (-र्म्म) 1 Making black. 2 Cauterising. E. कृष्ण black, and कर्म्मन् action.
11476: कृष्णकाक m. (-कः) A raven. E. कृष्ण black, and काक a crow.
11477: कृष्णकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A black variety of agallochum. E. कृष्ण, and काष्ठ wood.
11479: कृष्णकोहल m. (-लः) A gamester, a gambler.
11480: कृष्णचतुर्द्दशी f. (-शी) The fourteenth day in the dark half of a month. E. कृष्ण dark, चतुर्द्दशी fourteen; it is the day preceding new moon.
11481: कृष्णचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Formerly or in a former existence, KṚṢṆA. E. कृष्ण, and चरट् affix, implying former state of being; also कृष्णरुप्य.
11483: कृष्णचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Rust of iron, iron filings. E. कृष्ण black, and चूर्णं powder, dust.
11484: कृष्णजटा f. (-टा) Indian spikenard: see जटामांसी. E. कृष्ण black, जटा twisted hair, to which its entangled stalks are compared.
11485: कृष्णजीरक m. (-कः) Kalonji, a plant having a small black seed, which is used for medical and culinary purposes, (Nigella Indica, Rox.) E. कृष्ण black, and जीरक cummin seed.
11486: कृष्णता f. (-ता) Blackness. E. तल् added to कृष्ण; with त्व, कृष्णत्वं.
11487: कृष्णताम्र n. (-म्रं) A kind of Sandal wood. E. कृष्ण, and तास्र copper, of a dusky copper hue.
11488: कृष्णतार m. (-रः) A deer, an antelope. E. कृष्ण black, and तार the pupil of the eye, black-eyed.
11489: कृष्णत्रिवृता f. (-ता) A plant, black Teöri: see चिवृता.
11490: कृष्णदशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having bad or discoloured teeth. E. कृष्ण, and दशन a tooth.
11491: कृष्णदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Black-bodied. m. (-हः) A large black bee. E. कृष्ण black, and देह the body.
11492: कृष्णद्वैपायन m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas, and Purāṇas. E. a compound of two other names of the sage: see कृष्ण, and द्वैपायन.
11493: कृष्णधत्तूर m. (-रः) A dark species of Datura or thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa:) see घत्तूर.
11494: कृष्णपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The dark half of a month, the fifteen days during which the moon is in the wane. E. कृष्ण dark, and पक्ष fortnight or half month.
11495: कृष्णपाक m. (-कः) A tree bearing a small fruit, which, when ripe, is of a black colour, commonly Karinda or Karonda, (Carissa carondas.) E. कृष्ण black, and पाक what is ripe, from पच to ripen, to cook, and घञ् affix; also कृष्णफल, and कृष्णपाकफल.
11496: कृष्णपाकफल m. (-लः) The Karonda: see the preceding. E. फल fruit, added to कृष्णपाक.
11497: कृष्णपिङ्गला f. (-ला) A name of DURGĀ. E. कृष्ण black, and पिङ्गल tawny; being of such of such a colour.
11498: कृष्णपिण्डीतक m. (-कः) A dark kind of Māyana, (Vangueria spinosa). E. कृष्ण black, and पिण्डीतक the Mayan or Mayana tree.
11499: कृष्णपिण्डीर m. (-रः) A dark kind of Mayan: see the preceding.
11500: कृष्णपिपीली f. (-ली) The black ant. E. कृष्ण, and पिपील ant.
11501: कृष्णपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A black kind of Datūra. f. (-ष्पी) Another plant: see प्रियङ्गु. E. कृष्ण black, and पुष्प a flower.
11502: कृष्णफल (-लः) A fruit tree, the Karinda: see कृष्णपाक. f. (-ला) A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica:) see सोमराजी. E. कृष्ण black, and फल fruit.
11503: कृष्णफलपाक m. (-कः) A fruit: see the preceding; also कृष्णपाकफल.
11504: कृष्णभूमि f. (-मिः) A country with a dark soil, one of mould, blue clay, &c. E. कृष्ण black, and भूमि earth; also with a final अ, कृष्णभूमः.
11505: कृष्णभूमिजा f. (-जा) A species of grass, described as a nourishing food for cattle. E. कृष्णभूमि black earth, and ज born, produced.
11506: कृष्णभेदी f. (-दी) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. कृष्ण black, hence, dirt or excrement, and भेदी what breaks, or dissipates.
11507: कृष्णमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus max.) E. कृष्ण black, मुद्ग phaseolus.
11508: कृष्णमृत् f. (-मृत्) A country with a soil of a dark colour. E. कृष्ण black, and मृत् earth: see कृष्णभूमि.
11510: कृष्णरुप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Formerly KṚṢṆA: see कृष्णचर. E. कृष्ण, and रुप्य affix, implying past state of being.
11511: कृष्णलवण n. (-णं) A factitious salt, either that prepared by evaporation from saline soil, or the medicinal kind, called Bit Loben or Bit Noben, a muriate of soda with a proportion of sulphur and iron. E. कृष्ण black, and लवण salt.
11512: कृष्णल m. (-लः) A Ratti, a weight, the berry so used; or an artificial weight derived from it, the berry averaging about 1¼ grain, the weight 2(3/16) grains. f. (-ला) A shrub bearing a small black and red berry, the Ratti or Gunja: see गुञ्जा. E. कृष्ण blackness, and ल what gets, from ला to obtain, affix ड and fem. affix टाप्.
11513: कृष्णलक m. (-कः) A Ratti, the jeweller's weight, the fifth of a Māṣa. E. कन् added to the preceding.
11514: कृष्णलोह n. (-हं) The loadstone. E. कृष्ण what attracts, and लोह iron.
11515: कृष्णलोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Of a purple colour. E. कृष्ण black, and लोहित red; of which two colours purple is supposed to consist.
11516: कृष्णवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) The black faced monkey. E. कृष्ण black, and वक्त्र the face.
11517: कृष्णवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Black or dark blue. n. (-र्णं) The colour black. E. कृष्ण and वर्ण colour.
11518: कृष्णवर्त्मन् m. (-र्त्ना) 1 Fire. 2 RĀHU or the personified ascending node. 3 A low man, an outcaste, a profligate, a blackguard. 4 The marking nut plant. E. कृष्ण black, and वर्त्मन् a path or way; whose way is darkness.
11519: कृष्णवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A plant, a dark kind of Babul, (Ocymum pilosum).
11520: कृष्णवानर m. (-रः) A black monkey. E. कृष्ण black, and वानर an ape.
11521: कृष्णवीज m. (-जः) A red variety of the Morunga: see रक्तशीग्र. E. कृष्ण black, and वीज the seed.
11522: कृष्णवृन्ता f. (-न्ता) 1 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 A leguminous plant, (Glycine debilis.) E. कृष्ण black, and वृन्त foot-stalk.
11523: कृष्णवृन्तिका f. (-का) A tree, (Gmelina arborea:) see गम्भारी.
11524: कृष्णशार m. (-रः) The black antelope: see कृष्णसार.
11525: कृष्णशालि m. (-लिः) A sort of rice of a dark colour. E. कृष्ण, and शालि rice.
11526: कृष्णशिम्बी f. (-म्बी) A sort of bean, (Dolichos virosus.) E. कृष्ण, and शिम्बी a Dolichos.
11527: कृष्णशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A buffalo. E. कृष्ण black, and शृङ्ग a horn, black, horned.
11528: कृष्णश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipping or devoted to KṚṢṆA. E. कृष्ण, and श्रित attached.
11529: कृष्णसख m. (-खः) A friend or follower of KṚṢṆA, especially ARJUNA. E. कृष्ण, and सखि a friend, टच् affix in this class of compounds.
11531: कृष्णसर्प m. (-र्पः) A black snake. E. कृष्ण, and सर्प a snake.
11532: कृष्णसर्षप m. (-पः) Black mustard. E. कृष्ण, and सर्षप mustard.
11533: कृष्णसार mf. (-रः-रा) A timber tree, Sisū, (Dalbergia Sisu, Rox.) m. (-रः) 1 The black antelope. 2 Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 A thorny plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli, &c.) E. कृष्ण black, and सार essence.
11534: कृष्णसारङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The black antelope. E. कृष्ण black, and सारङ्ग a deer.
11535: कृष्णसारथि m. (-थिः) ARJUNA. E. कृष्ण, and सारथि charioteer; driven by KṚṢṆA.
11536: कृष्णस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A tree which bears black blossoms, the Tamāla tree. E. कृष्ण black, and स्कन्ध the shoulder: see कालस्कन्ध.
11537: कृष्णागुरु n. (-रु) Agallochum or aloe wood, the black variety. E. कृष्ण, and अगुरु aloe wood.
11538: कृष्णाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Raivata, part of the western portion of the Vindhya chain; it is also one of the nine principal mountains that separate the same divisions or Varṣas of the known world. E. कृष्ण black, and अचल a mountain.
11539: कृष्णानदी f. (-दी) The name of a river, possibly the Kistṇa in the Dekin. E. कृष्ण, and नदी a river, the river of KṚṢṆA; also other analogous names, as कृष्णसमुद्भवा, कृष्णवेण्या, कृष्णगङ्गा, &c.; also कृष्णा.
11540: कृष्णामिष n. (-षं) Iron. E. कृष्ण black, and आमिप flesh, substance.
11541: कृष्णायस n. (-सं) Iron, crude or black iron. E. कृष्ण black, and अयस iron.
11542: कृष्णार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) A name of fire. E. कृष्ण black, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
11543: कृष्णार्जक m. (-कः) A black species of basil: see कृष्णवल्ली. E. कृष्ण black, and अर्जक basil.
11544: कृष्णावास m. (-सः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. कृष्ण the deity, and आवास abode.
11545: कृष्णाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Devoted to or the votary of KṚṢṆA. E. कृष्ण, and आश्रित attached or devoted to.
11546: कृष्णिका f. (-का) Black mustard. E. कृष्ण black, कन् affix, the fem. form.
11547: कृष्णिमन् m. (-मा) Blackness. E. कृष्ण, and इमनिच् aff.
11548: कृष्णीकरण n. (-णं) Blackening, making black. E. कृष्णं, and करण making, च्चि augment.
11549: कृष्णीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blackened, made black. E. कृष्ण, कृत made, च्चि augment.
11550: कृष्णीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being or become black, &c. E. कृष्ण, भूत become, च्चि augment.
11551: कृष्णेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A sort of sugar cane. E. कृष्ण black, and इक्षु sugar cane.
11552: कृसर m. (-रः) 1 A dish consisting of sesamum and grain. 2 A mixture of rice and peas with a few spices. E. कॄ to scatter, सरः Uṇādi affix; also कृशर.
11553: कॄ r. 6th cl. (किरति) To throw, to scatter. r. 9th cl. (कृणति) or (गि, ञ्) गिकॄञ् (कृणाति-कृणीते) To hurt, to injure. r. 10th cl. (कारयते) To know. 1 With अप prefixed, ^a To draw furrows, to make lines. ^b To disperse. 2 With अव, To throw, to cast. 3 With आङ्, To fill up, to cover over. 4 With प्रति, To hurt, to injure. 5 With वि, To throw, to caste, to send, to scatter widely. 6 With सम, To gather, to collect. 7 With अभि, in the passive voice, to be upset, overcome or overwhelmed.
11554: कॄत r. 10th cl. (कीर्त्तयति) To celebrate, to glorify, to render renowned or notorious.
11555: कॢप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Made, formed. 2 Fixed, appointed. 3 Ascertained, determined. 4 Cut, pared, shorn. E. कृप to be able, &c. affix क्ल, and the augment इट् omitted.
11556: कॢप्तकीला f. (-ला) Title deed, lease of a house, &c. E. कॢप्त fixed, कील a bolt or pin.
11557: कॢप्तधूप m. (-पः) Frankincense, olibanum. E. कॢप्त made, धूप incense.
11559: केकय m. (-यः) A prince of the solar race. f. (-यी) The daughter of the preceding, and one of the wives of DAŚARATHA: the mother of BHARATA: see केकेयी.
11560: केकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Squint-eyed. E. के in the head, कृ to make, टच् affix; also compounded with अक्ष an eye, as केकराक्ष.
11562: केका f. (-का) The cry of a peacock. E. के an imitative sound, and क what sounds, from के to sound, affixes ड and टाप्.
11563: केकाबल m. (-लः) A peacock. E. केका his cry, and बलच् aff.
11564: केकिन् m. (-की) A peacock. E. केका the cry of the bird, and इनि aff.
11565: केकेयी f. (-यी) One of DAŚARATHA'S three wives, the mother of BHARATA.
11566: केचन ind. Some, some or certain persons. E. के plural of किम्, and चन aff.
11567: केचित ind. Some, some persons. E. see the last; चिति aff.
11568: केचुक n. (-कः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia:) see कचु.
11569: केणिका f. (-का) A tent. E. किण to cover (a Sautra root), ण्वुल aff.
11570: केत r. 10th cl. (केतयति) 1 To call or invite. 2 To counsel or advise; some authorities substitute सङ्केत for this root.
11571: केत m. (-तः) A house, an abode. E. कित to abide, affix घञ्.
11572: केतक mf. (-कः-की) A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. किति to abide, ण्वुल् aff.
11573: केतन n. (-नं) 1 A flag, a banner. 2 Business, indispensable act. 3 Invitation. 4 A spot or mark, a sign, a symbol. 5 A house, an abode. 6 Place, site, situation, &c. E. कित to abide, affix ल्युट्.
11574: केतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Called, summoned. 2 Dwelt, inhabited. E. केत to call, or कित to dwell, affix क्त.
11575: केतु m. (-तुः) KETU the dragon's tail or descending node; in astronomy, the ninth of the planets; in mythology, a demon: the body of SAIṂHIKEYA severed from the head (RĀHU), by VIṢṆU, at the churning of the ocean, but immortal, by having tasted the Amṛta. 2 A banner, a flag. 3 A mark, a sign, a symbol, &c. 4 Light. 5 A comet, a falling star, &c. 6 Disease. 7 A pigmy race inhabiting Kusa Dvīpa, the progeny of JAIMINI. E. चाय to worship, तु Uṇādi affix, कि substituted for the root.
11576: केतुतारा f. (-रा) A comet. E. केतु, and तारा a star.
11577: केतुभ m. (-भः) A cloud. E. केतु the plant, and भ what resembles it in darkness.
11578: केतुमाल n. (-लं) One of nine great divisions of the known world, the western portion or Varṣa of Jambu Dvīpa.
11579: केतुयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A flag-staff. E. केतु, and यष्टि a stick.
11580: केतुरत्न n. (-त्नं) Lapis lazuli. E. केतु, and रत्न a gem.
11581: केतुवसन m. (-नः) A flag. E. केतु a standard, and वसन cloth.
11582: केदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Squint-eyed. m. (-रः) The name of a plant. E. क the earth or the head, दृ to divide, affix अच्.
11583: केदार m. (-रः) 1 A field, a meadow, a plain. 2 A mountain. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 A particular place, the modern Kedār, part of the Himālaya mountains. 5 A basin for water round the root of a tree. 6 A bed in a garden or field. E. क water, earth, &c. दृ to tear or rend, घञ् aff.
11584: केदारखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A small dyke or mound, earth raised to keep out water. E. केदार, and खण्ड a portion.
11585: केनार m. (-रः) 1 The head. 2 The temples, the upper part of the cheek. 3 A joint. 4 A division of hell, a hell like a potter's kiln. E. क the head, &c. मृ to guide, घञ् aff.
11586: केनिपात m. (-तः) The helm, a rudder, a large oar used as one. E. क water, निपात who goes or falls; also केनिपातक m. (-कः)
11587: केन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A sort of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa, Rox.) E. क the earth, इन्द to moisten, उ aff.
11588: केन्दुक m. (-कः) A sort of ebony, that yields a species of tar, (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. कन् implying resemblance, affixed to the preceding.
11589: केन्द्र n. (-न्दं) 1 The centre of a circle. 2 The argument of an equation. 3 The distance of a planet from the first point of its orbit in the fourth, seventh, or tenth degree. It is variously applied in combination, as पतनकेन्द्रं argument of the latitude; द्वितीयकेन्द्रं the distance of the higher apsis form a planet in any point of its orbit; शीघ्रकेन्द्रं commutation, the distance of  the sun from a superior planet or of an inferior planet from the sun; मन्दकेन्द्रं argument of anomaly.
11590: केप (ऋ) केपृ r. 1st cl. (केपते) 1 To shake or tremble. 2 To go, to move or approach.
11591: केयूर n. (-रं) A bracelet worn on the upper arm. E. क the head, here implying the head of the arm, यु to join, ऊर aff.
11592: केरल m. (-लः) The appellation of a country, Keraladeś or the modern Malabar. f. (-ली) 1 Astronomical science. 2 An astronomical Śāstra or treatise. 2 A Horā or period of time equal to about one hour.
11593: केल r. 1st cl. (ऊ) केलु (केलति) 1 To shake. 2 To go or move.
11594: केलक m. (-कः) A dancer, a tumbler, one who walks or dances on the edge of a sword. E. किल to sport, ण्वुल् aff.
11595: केलास m. (-सः) Crystal. E. के in water, लस to shine, अंण aff.
11596: केलि mf. (-लिः लिः or -ली) Play, sport, pastime, amusement. f. (-लिः) The earth. E. किल to sport, Uṇādi affix इ.
11597: केलिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sportive, sporting. m. (-कः) The Asoka tree. E. केलि and कन् added.
11598: केलिकला f. (-ला) 1 The Vīṇā or lute of SARASVATĪ. 2 Amorous or sportive accents or address. 3 Sportive skill, wantonness. E. केलि sport, कल to sound, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
11599: केलिकिल m. (-लः) One of ŚIVA'S attendant demigods. 2 The confidential companion of the hero of a drama, in general a sort of buffoon. f. (-ला) A name of RATI, the wife of KĀMADEVA. E. केलि sport, किल who plays, from किल to sport, affix क.
11601: केलिकुञ्चिका f. (-का) A wife's younger sister. E. केलि play, कुचि to be crooked, ण्वुल् aff.
11602: केलिकोष m. (-षः) An actor, a dancer or tumbler: see केलक.
11603: केलिगृह n. (-हं) A pleasure house, a private apartment. E. केलि sport, and गृह a house; also कलिनिकेतन, &c.
11604: केलिनागर m. (-रः) A sensualist, an enjoyer of worldly pleasures. E. केलि sport, and नागर a libertine, &c.
11605: केलिपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wanton, sportive. E. केलि, and पर intent on.
11606: केलिमुख m. (-खः) Pastime, sport. E. केलि play, and मुख chief.
11607: केलिवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A species of the Kadamba, commonly KeliKadamba, (Nauclea cordifolia.) E. केलि sport, and वृक्ष a tree; being abundant in the scene of KṚṢṆA'S sports with the Gopīs.
11608: केलिशयन n. (-नं) A couch, a sofa. E. केलि, and शयन a bed.
11610: केलिसचिव m. (-वः) Minister of the sports, master of the revels. E. केलि play, सचिव a counsellor, a minister.
11611: केव r. 1st cl. (ऋ) केवृ (केवते) To serve.
11612: केवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A fisherman: see कैवर्त्त.
11613: केवल mfn. (-लः-ला or -ली-लं) 1 One, alone, only. 2 All, entire, whole. m. (-लः) An envious or selfish man. n. adv. (-लं) 1 Absolutely, certainly. 2 Only, alone. Subst. 3 A species of knowledge, that of the unity of spirit. E. केव to sprinkle, कल aff.
11614: केवलज्ञानिन् m. (-नी) One of the Jaina saints of the last age. E. केवल unity, and ज्ञानिन् who knows.
11615: केवलद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Black pepper. E. केवल one, only, द्रव्य thing.
11616: केवलवैयाकरण m. (-णः) A grammarian, a mere grammarian, one not versed in any other science. E. केवल only, and वैयाकरण a grammarian; also similar compounds, as केवलनैयायिक a mere logician, &c.
11617: केवलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) One, only, alone. m. (-ली) A Jaina who has acquired holy knowledge. E. केषल one, इनि affix; a unitarian.
11618: केविका f. (-का) The name of a flower, commonly Keber.
11619: केश m. (-शः) 1 Hair. 2 A name of VARUṆA. 3 A kind of perfume: see वाला. 4 The name of a demon. 5 A name of VIṢṆU. f. (-शी) 1 A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 2 The indigo plant. 3 Indian spikenard. E. क्लिश to bind, अण् affix, and ल rejected; or क the head, and ईश to rule, affix अच्; again, क water or happiness, and ईश the lord or master.
11620: केशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Skilful in dressing hair, taking pains with it, &c. E. केश, and कन् aff.
11621: केशकलाप m. (-पः) A quantity of hair. E. केश hair, and कलाप in this compound implying quantity.
11622: केशकार m. (-रः) A sort of sugar cane. E. केश, and कार what makes.
11623: केशकीट m. (-टः) A louse. E. केश, and कीट an insect.
11624: केशगर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) 1 A braid of hair. 2 Varuṇa. E. केश, and गर्भ origin.
11625: केशगर्ब्भक m. (-कः) A braid or tress of hair. E. केश hair, and गर्ब्भक a chaplet.
11626: केशगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pulled or seized by the hair. E. केश, and गृहीत seized.
11627: केशग्रह m. (-हः) Pulling the hair. E. केश, and ग्रह seizing; also केशग्रहणं.
11628: केशघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Morbid baldness, falling of the hair. E. केश the hair, and घ्न what destroys, from हन् to injure, affix टच्.
11629: केशच्छिद् m. (-च्छित् or -च्छिद्) A barber, a hair-dresser. E. केश the hair, छिद् to cut, affix क्विप्.
11630: केशट m. (-टः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A goat. 3 A louse. 5 A brother. 5 One of KĀMA'S arrows. 6 A tree, commonly Sonapat, (शोणक.) E. केश hair, अट to go, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
11631: केशधृत् m. (-धृत्) The root of sweet flag. E. केश hair, धृ to hold, affix, क्विप्; resembling hair.
11632: केशपक्ष m. (-क्षः) Much or ornamented hair. E. केश hair, पक्ष quantity, in this compound.
11633: केशपङ्क्ति f. (-ङ्क्तिः) 1 A row or line of hair. 2 A quantity of hair. E. केश, and पंक्ति a line.
11634: केशपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera;) also अपामार्ग. E. केश hair, पर्ण a leaf.
11635: केशपाश m. (-शः) Much or ornamented hair. f. (-शी) A lock of hair on the top of the head. E. केश hair, पाश quantity, in this compound.
11636: केशभू m. (-भूः) The head. E. केश, and भू place.
11637: केशमार्जक m. (-कः) A comb. E. केश hair, मृज to clean, ण्वुल् affix; also केशमार्जन.
11638: केशमार्जन n. (-नं) 1 A comb. 2 Cleaning the hair. E. see the preceding, ल्युट् aff.
11639: केशमुष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) 1 A large species of Nimb tree. 2 A handful of hair. E. केश, and मुष्टि the fist.
11640: केशर mn. (-रः-रं) The filament of a lotus or of any vegetable. m. (-रः) 1 A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) 2 A tree bearing a white strong smelling flower, (Mimusops elengi:) see वकुल. 3 A shrub used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria;) also पुन्नाग. 4 A lion's mane. n. (-रं) Asafoetida. E. क water, &c. in the seventh case के, शृ to go, अप् affix; also with सृ to go केसर.
11641: केशरञ्जन m. (-नः) A plant: see भृङ्गराज, (Verbesina prostrata). E. केश the hair, and रञ्जन what colours.
11642: केशराज m. (-जः) A species of Bhringariva: see the preceding. E. केश hair, राज to shine, टच् aff.
11644: केशरिन् m. (-री) 1 A lion. 2 A horse. 3 A plant used in dying: see पुन्नाग. 4 Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) 5 The citron tree. E. केशर a mane, a filament, &c. इनि aff.
11645: केशव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Having much or handsome hair. m. (-वः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. 2 A plant, commonly Punnag: see पुन्नाग. E. क BRAHMA, and ईश ŚIVA, व who goes, &c. from वा with ड affix; again केश hair, व who possesses; fine-haired.
11646: केशवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a fine head of hair. E. केश and मतुप् aff.
11647: केशवभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Devotion to KṚṢṆA. E. केशव, and भक्ति faith.
11648: केशवायुध m. (-धः) 1 The mango tree. 2 Any weapon of KṚṢṆA. E. केशव KṚṢṆA, and आयुध a weapon.
11649: केशवालय m. (-यः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. केशव KṚṢṆA, and आलय abode.
11652: केशवेश m. (-शः) A tress or fillet of hair. E. केश hair, and बेश ornament.
11653: केशहल m. (-लः) Much or ornamented hair. E. केश hair, and हल here implying much.
11654: केशाकेशि n. (-शि) Pulling the hair mutually, hair to hair. E. केश hair, repeated, affix इञ्.
11655: केशान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Cutting off the hair finally as a religious ceremony, performed upon Brahmans at sixteen years of age; Kṣatriyas at twenty-two; and Vaiśyas at twenty-four. 2 The tip or end of hair. E. केश, and अन्त end.
11656: केशान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Extending to the hair. 2 Relating to the ceremony of final tonsure. E. केशान्त, and ठक aff.
11658: केशावमर्षण n. (-णं) Pulling the hair, especially amorously, playing with it, rubbing it, &c. E. केश the hair, अव implying improperly, and मर्षण rubbing.
11659: केशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Having fine or luxuriant hair. 2 Relating to the hair. E. केश hair, ठक् aff.
11660: केशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Having fine hair. m. (-शी) 1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 2 The name of a Daitya or demon killed by KṚṢṆA. 3 A lion. f. (-शिनी) 1 A kind of grass, (Andropogon aculeatum.) 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) E. केश hair, इनि aff.
11661: केशिसूदन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. केशि a demon, सूदन destroyer; also similar compounds, as केशिहन्, कशिनिसूदन, &c.
11663: केशोच्चय m. (-यः) Much or handsome hair. E. केश hair, उच्चय heap, abundance.
11664: केसर mn. (-रः-रं) A filament, m. (-रः) 1 A lion. 2 A horse. 3 The mane of a horse or lion, &c., see केशर. 4 A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) 5 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) nf. (-रं-री) Asafoetida. n. (-रं) 1 Gold. 2 Sulphate of iron. 3 The flower of the Nagesar. E. के on the head, सृ to go, ट aff.
11665: केसरवर n. (-रं) Saffron. E. केसर, and वर best.
11666: केसराम्ल m. (-म्लः) A citron. E. केसर, and अम्ल sour.
11667: केसरिन् m. (-री) 1 A lion. 2 A horse. 3 A plant used in dying: see पुन्नाग. 4 Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) 5 A monkey the father of HANUMĀN. E. केसर a filament, a mane, इनि aff.
11668: केसरिसुत m. (-तः) The monkey HANUMAN. E. केसरि, and सुत son.
11670: कैकेयी f. (-यी) One of the wives of DAŚARATHA, and the mother of BHARATA. E. केकय a king, father of this lady, and ढक् aff.
11671: कैङ्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Service, servitude. E. किङ्कर a servant, and ष्यञ् aff.
11672: कैटभ m. (-भः) A demon slain by VIṢṆU. f. (-भा) A name of DURGĀ. E. कैटभ a demon in whose death the goddess was instrumental, by having at the prayers of BRAHMĀ roused VIṢṆU from his slumbers, during which two demons, Kaitabha and Madhu, were about to demolish BRAHMĀ; also कैटभी.
11673: कैटभजित् m. (-जित्) A name of VIṢṆU. E. कैटभ the name of an Asura killed by the deity, and जित् who conquers; also similar compounds, as कैटभहन्, &c.
11674: कैटभारि m. (-रिः) A name of VIṢṆU: see कैटभजित्.
11675: कैटर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A plant used in medicine, commonly Kayaphal. 2 The Nimb tree. 3 Mayana, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. कैटर from किट to fear, and रा to cause, alarming by its pungency; pleonastic affix ष्यञ्; also कैडर्य्य.
11676: कैतव n. (-वं) 1 Deceit, fraud, cheating, roguery. 2 Gambling. 3 The lapis lazuli. E. कितव a cheat, &c. अण् aff.
11677: कैतवप्रयोग m. (-गः) A trick, a device. E. कैतव, and प्रयोग application.
11678: कैतववाद m. (-दः) Evasion, falsehood. E. कैतव, and वाद speech.
11679: कैदार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Belonging to a field, a meadow, &c. m. (-रः) Rice, corn. n. (-रं) A multitude of fields. E. केदार a field, and अण् affix; also केदारक, and कैदारिक.
11680: कैदारक n. (-कं) A multitude of fields. E. केदार, and वुञ् affix; also with ठञ् affix कैदारिक.
11681: कैदार्य्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-री-र्य्यं) Belonging to a field, &c. n. (-र्य्यं) A number of fields. E. केदार, and ष्यञ् aff.
11682: कैरव m. (-बः) 1 A rogue, a cheat. 2 An enemy. f. (-वी) Moonlight. n. (-वं) 1 The white esculent water-lily. 2 Fraud, trick. E. केरव here said to mean, a goose, from के in water, and रु to sound, with अप् affix; again, अण् affix, liked by the geese; or किरव a cheat, &c. or कैरव a lotus, and अण् affix, implying identity or resemblance.
11683: कैरविणी f. (-णी) A place abounding in lotus flowers, or an assemblage of lotuses. E. कैरव a white lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.
11684: कैरविन् m. (-वी) The moon. E. कैरवी moonlight, इनि aff.
11685: कैराटक m. (-कः) A species of poison, one of the fixed kinds.
11686: कैरात n. (-तं) 1 A sort of gentian, commonly Cherayta, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.) 2 A kind of Sandal. m. (-तः) A strong man. E. किरात gentian, &c. अण् aff.
11687: कैल n. (-लं) Sport, pleasure. E. केलि, and अञ् pleonasm.
11688: कैलास m. (-सः) The mountain Kailāsa, the fabulous residence of KUVERA, and favourite haunt of ŚIVA; it is placed by the Hindus amongst the Himālaya mountains, and the name is given to one of the loftiest peaks lying on the north of the Mānasa lake. E. कैलास crystal, and the affix अण् implying nature or consistence; or कैल pleasure, आस to abide, affix घञ्; the place where beings reside in bliss.
11689: कैलासनिकेतन m. (-नः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 KUVERA. E. कैलास, and निकेतन dwelling.
11690: कैलासौकस् m. (-काः) A name of KUVERA. E. कैलास the mountain, औकस् abode; whose abode is mount Kailāsa.
11691: कैवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A fisherman born of a prostitute by a Kṣatriya, or of an Ayogava female by a Niṣāda father. f. (-र्त्ती) The wife of a fisherman. E. क water, in the seventh case, के and वर्त्त who abides, केवर्त्त a fish, अण् affix, implying enmity.
11694: कैवर्त्तमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass: see the next.
11695: कैवर्त्तिमुस्तक n. (-कं) A fragrant kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus). E. कैवर्त्त as above, water-abiding, and मुस्तक cyperus; also कैवर्त्तीमुस्तक, कैवर्त्तंमुस्त, &c.
11696: कैवल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ली-ल्यं) Sole, only. n. (-ल्यं) 1 Eternal emancipation, future happiness. 2 Exclusiveness, individuality. E. केवल alone, free from all fetters, व्यञ् affix of the abstract.
11697: कैशिक m. (-कः) Love, passion, lust. f. (-की) One of the four varieties of dramatic style, the graceful style, suited especially to the passion of love. n. (-कं) A quantity of hair, the head of hair. E. केशिक having much hair, &c. affix अण्, fem. affix ङीष्.
11698: कैशोर n. (-रं) Youth, boyhood, from the age of ten to that of fifteen. E. किशोर a child, and अञ् aff.
11699: कैश्य n. (-श्यं) A head of hair, much or ornamented hair. E. केश hair, यञ् aff.
11700: कोक m. (-कः) 1 A wolf. 2 The ruddy goose. 3 A frog. 4 A lizard, a chameleon. 5 The wild date tree. 6 A name of VIṢṆU. E. कुक to seize or take, or क water, उक to go, affix अच्.
11701: कोकड m. (-डः) An animal said to be a kind of deer, of a brown colour, with a bushy tail, and lurking in holes, perhaps a hare.
11703: कोकनद n. (-दं) 1 The red lotus. 2 The red water lily. E. कोक a goose, and नद to sound, affix क.
11704: कोकनदच्छवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) Red, the colour, or of that colour. E. कोकनद the red lotus, and छवि light, splendor.
11705: कोकबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The sun. E. कोक the ruddy goose, and बन्धु a friend: see चक्रवाक.
11707: कोकिल m. (-लः) 1 The Kokila or Koïl, the black or Indian cuckoo, (Cuculus Indicus.) 2 A firebrand, a lighted coal. E. कुक to seize, (the heart,) and इलच् affix: the Kokila makes a prominent figure in Hindu poetry, and is supposed, by his musical cry, to inspire pleasing and tender emotions.
11708: कोकिलनयन m. (-नः) A plant bearing a dark black flower, (Capparis spinosa); it is also applied to Barleria longifolia. E. कोकिल the Koil, and नयन an eye, to which the flower is compared; also other similar compounds, as कोकिलाक्ष, &c.
11709: कोकिलाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A shrub: see the preceding. E. कोकिल, and अक्ष the eye, or with कन् added, कोकिलाक्षक.
11710: कोकिलावास m. (-सः) The mango tree. E. कोकिल, and आवास abode.
11711: कोकिलेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) The black variety of sugar cane. E. कोकिल, and इक्षु sugar cane.
11712: कोकिलोत्सव m. (-वः) The mango tree. E. कोकिल, and उत्सव festival.
11713: कोच m. (-चः) A man of degraded caste, the offspring of a fisherman by a female of the butcher tribe.
11714: कोङ्कण m. (-णः) The name of a country, Konkan, in the peninsula. n. (-णं) A kind of weapon.
11715: कोङ्कणासुत m. (-तः) A name of PARAŚURĀMA. E. कोङ्कणा the mother of the hero, or the woman of Konkan, and सुत a son.
11716: कोजागर m. (-रः) The day of full-moon in the month Aśvin, (September-October.) E. कः who, जागर wakeful; who is awake, the call of LAKṢMĪ, who, descending on this night, promised wealth to all that were awake: hence the night is spent in festivity, and games of chance in honour of the goddess.
11717: कोट m. (-टः) 1 A fort, a strong hold. 2 A shed, a hut. 3 Crookedness, curvature.
11718: कोटक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Who or what curves or bends. m. (-कः) A thatcher, a builder of huts, &c. E. कुट to be crooked, ण्वुल aff.
11719: कोटर mn. (-रः-रं) The hollow of a tree. f. (-री) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A naked woman: see कोटवी. E. कोट and र, from रा to get, to possess, with the affix ड.
11720: कोटरावण n. (-णं) A wood in which there are hollow trees. E. कोटर the hollow of a tree, and वन a wood; by special rules, the final vowel of the first word is made long, and न in the second is changed to ण.
11721: कोटवी f. (-वी) 1 A naked woman. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. कोट crookedness, and वा to get or receive, क and ङीष् affixes; also कोट्टवी, and कोटरी.
11722: कोटि f. (-टिः) 1 The edge or point of a sword. 2 The end of a bow. 3 A number, a Krore or ten millions. 4 Eminence, excellence. 5 The upright side of a triangle. 6 The complement of an are to 90°. 7 A plant, Piring or Asparac, (Medicago esculenta.) E. कुट to be crooked, and इण् Uṇādi affix; also कोटी.
11723: कोटिक m. (-कः) An insect., coccinella of various kinds; this is most usually read कोटिर.
11724: कोटिजित् m. (-जित्) A name of the poet KĀLIDĀSA. E. केटि a crore, (of competitors,) and जित् conqueror.
11725: कोटिज्या f. (-ज्या) The cosine of an angle, in a right angled triangle. E. कोटि, and ज्या a sine.
11726: कोटिपात्र m. (-त्रः) A rudder or large oar used as one. E. कोटि an edge, and पात्र a plank.
11727: कोटिर m. (-रः) 1 An ichneumon, (Viverra ichneumon.) 2 An insect, coccinella of various kinds: see इन्द्रगोप. 3 A name of INDRA. E. कोटि excellence, and र what possesses.
11728: कोटिवर्ष n. (-र्षं) The name of a city, Vāṇapura or Devikote, on the Koromandel coast. f. (-र्षा) A plant used as a medicinal vegetable, (Medicago esculenta:) see पिडिङ्ग. E. कोटि excellence, वर्ष what diffuses.
11729: कोटिश m. (-शः) A harrow. E. कोटि an edge, शो to cut or pare, क aff.
11730: कोटिशस् ind. In multitudes, by millions. E. कोटि, and शसि aff.
11731: कोटी f. (-टी) 1 The edge or point of a sword. 2 A medicinal plant, (Medicago esculenta.) 3 A Krore, &c.: see कोटि.
11732: कोटीर m. (-रः) 1 Long entangled hair. 2 A crest, a diadem. E. कुट to be crooked, इरन् affix and the radical vowel converted.
11733: कोटीवर्ष n. (-र्षं) A name of Vāṇapura. f. (-र्षा) Piring, a plant: see कोटिवर्ष.
11734: कोटीश m. (-शः) A harrow: see कोटिश.
11735: कोट्ट m. (-ट्टः-ट्टं) A fort, a castle, a strong hold. E. कुट्ट to cut or divide, affix घञ्.
11736: कोट्टवी f. (-वी) 1 A naked woman. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 The mother of Vāṇa, an asura: see कोटवी.
11737: कोट्टवीपुर n. (-रं) Vanapur or Devicotta. E. कोट्टवी the mother of Vāṇa, and पुर a city.
11738: कोट्टार m. (-रः) 1 A well. 2 The stairs of a pond. 3 A fortified town, a strong hold. 4 A libertine. E. कोट्ट a fort, &c. ऋ to go, affix अप्.
11739: कोठ m. (-ठः) 1 A species of leprosy with large round spots. 2 Ringworm, impetigo. E. कुठ to surround, affix घञ्.
11740: कोण m. (-णः) 1 A corner, an angle. 2 The quill or bow of a lute, a fiddle stick, &c. 3 A drum stick. 4 A sort of stringed musical instrument. 5 The sharp edge of a sword. 6 A stick, a staff, a club. 7 A name of Maṅgala, the planet MARS. 8 A name of the planet SATURN. 9 An intermediate point of the compass. E. कुण to sound, &c. घञ् aff.
11741: कोणकुण m. (-णः) A bug. E. कुण to cut, affix क, added to कोण the edge of a sword.
11742: कोणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Having a crooked arm: see कुणि.
11743: कोथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Afflicted with pain. 2 Churned. m. (-थः) 1 Inflammation, and ulceration of the angles of the eyelids. 2 Gangrene. 3 Churning. E. कुथ to afflict or be afflicted, affix घञ्.
11744: कोदण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A bow. m. (-ण्डः) 1 An eyebrow. 2 The name of a country. E. कुण to sound, अण्ड Uṇādi affix, &c. दन् inserted; the final radical consonant is rejected; otherwise, कुद to speak false, अण्डच् aff.
11745: कोद्रव n. (-वं) A species of grain eaten by the poorer people, (Paspalum kora.) E. क wind, उद्रव to go, affix अच्; sown by the wind, or growing wild in many places.
11746: कोप m. (-पः) 1 Wrath, rage. 2 Morbid irritation or disorder of the humours. E. कुप to be angry, affix घञ्.
11747: कोपक्रम m. (-मः) An angry or passionate man. E. कोप rage, and क्रम who goes or has. n. (-मं) The creation by BRAHMĀ. E. क BRAHMĀ, and उपक्रम order, method; also similar compounds, as कोपज्ञ, &c.
11748: कोपज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enraged, inflamed with wrath. E. कोप, and ज्वलित inflamed.
11749: कोपदीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Incensed, inflamed with anger. E. कोप, and दीप्त shining.
11750: कोपन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Passionate, wrathful. f. (-ना) A passionate woman. E. कुप to be angry, युच् affix, fem. affix टाप्.
11751: कोपपद n. (-दं) Appearance of anger, pretended wrath. E. कोप, and पद place.
11752: कोपवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Passionate, angry. E. कोप, and मतुप् aff.
11753: कोपवेग m. (-गः) Violence, impetuosity of passion. E. कोप, and वेग speed.
11754: कोपाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Furious, enraged. E. कोप, and आकुल bewildered.
11755: कोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Angry, enraged. E. कोप, and इतच् aff.
11756: कोपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Angry, passionate, wrathful. m. (-पी) A bird called the water-pigeon. E. कुप to be angry, णिनि aff.
11757: कोमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Soft, bland. 2 Soft, low, sweet. 3 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. f. (-ला) A plant: see क्षीरिका. n. (-लं) Water. E. कुट to be curved, कल Uṇādi affix, and मुट् inserted, formative irregular; or कम to desire, कलच् affix, and उ inserted with conversion.
11758: कोमलक n. (-कं) The fibres of the stalk of a lotus. E. कोमल soft, कन् added.
11759: कोमलगीत n. (-तं) A pleasing song. E. कोमल, and गीत a song; also with कन् added, कोमलगीतकः.
11760: कोमलता f. (-ता) Softness, tenderness, agreeableness; also with त्व, कोमलत्वं.
11762: कोयष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) The lapwing: see the next.
11763: कोयष्टिक m. (-कः) The lapwing. E. क water, यष्टि a line or row, कन् added, deriv, irr.; also कोयष्टि. These birds are found in the vicinity of marshes, &c.
11764: कोर m. (-रः) 1 Union with little or no motion, as that of the fingers with one another, amphiarthrosis. 2 A bud. E. कुर sound, घञ् aff.
11765: कोरक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A bud, an unblown flower. 2 A species of perfume, commonly Chor. 3 Another perfume, a berry containing a resinous and fragrant substance: see कक्कोलक. 4 The fibres of the stalk of the lotus. E. कुर to sound, affix वुन्.
11766: कोरङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) Small cardamoms: see एला. E. कुर to sound, अङ्गच् and ङीष् aff.
11767: कोरदूष m. (-षः) A kind of grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.) E. कोर a bud, दूष to change, अण् affix; also कन् being added, कोरदूषक m. (-कः)
11768: कोरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, ground, comminuted. 2 Budded, sprouted. E. कोर, and इतच् aff.
11769: कोल m. (-लः) 1 A hog. 2 A raft, a float. 3 The haunch, the hip or flank. 4 Embracing, an embrace. 5 The planet Śani or SATURN. 6 Plumbago, (Zeylanica, &c.) 7 A country, Kaliṅga, the modern seacoast from Cuttak to Madras. 8 A kind of weapon. 9 An outcaste, one of a tribe degraded by SAGARA  from the military order. 10 A man of a mixed caste. 11 A barbarian, a Kol, people inhabiting the hills and forests in central India. n. (-लं) 1 The fruit of the jujube. 2 The weight of one Tola. 3 Black pepper. f. (-ला or -ली) 1 The jujube tree. 2 Long pepper. 3 A kind of pepper, (Piper chavya, Rox.) E. कुल to accumulate, affix अच्.
11770: कोलक n. (-कं) 1 A kind of perfume: see कक्कोलक. 2 Long pepper. m. (-कः) A plant, (Cordia myxta.) E. कुल to accumulate, वुन् aff.
11771: कोलदल n. (-लं) A kind of perfume: see नखी. E. कोल the jujube, दल a leaf; having a similar leaf.
11772: कोलनासिका f. (-का) A plant? also वङ्किनी.
11773: कोलपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A heron. E. कोल a hog, पुच्छ a tail; hog-tailed.
11774: कोलमूल n. (-लं) The root of long pepper. E. कोल, and मूल root.
11775: कोलम्बक m. (-कः) The body of a lute, the whole of it except the strings. E. कुल to accumulate, अम्बच् and कन् affs.
11776: कोलवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A plant, with a pungent fruit resembling pepper: see गजपिप्पली (Pothos officinalis.) E. कोल a hog, वल्ली a creeper; resembling a hog's bristle.
11777: कोलाञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A name of Kaliṅga, the Coromandel coast, from Cuttak to Madras; according to some, it is in Gangetic Hindustan, with Kanouj for the capital.
11778: कोलाहल m. (-लः) A loud and confused sound, an uproar, a great and indistinct noise. E. कोल accumulation, from कुल, with घञ्; again, हल to make or plough, आङ् prefixed, and अच् aff.
11779: कोलि f. (-लिः or ली) The jujube tree, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. see कोल.
11780: कोविद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Wise, learned. E. को who sounds or teaches, (the Shasters,) विद divine knowledge, from विद to know, affix क.
11781: कोविदार m. (-रः) A species of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) E. कु the earth, दॄ to tear or divide, with वि prefixed, deriv. irr.
11782: कोश m. (-शः) 1 An egg. 2 Wrought or unwrought gold or silver plate, jewellery. 3 An ordeal, &c. f. (-शी) 1 A shoe, a sandal. 2 The beard of corn. E. कुश or कुष to issue, घञ् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; see कोष.
11783: कोशकार m. (-रः) The sugar cane; also कोषकार.
11784: कोशफल n. (-लं) A berry containing a waxy and fragrant substance: see कक्कोल. E. कोश an egg, फल fruit; the berry being egg-shaped.
11785: कोशल mf. (-लः-ला) 1 A name of the city Ayodhya (Oude), or the neighbouring district. 2 The name of a prince. E. कुश to shine, अल Uṇādi affix; also कोषल.
11786: कोशलात्मजा f. (-जा) The wife of DAŚARATHA the mother of RĀMA. E. कोशल the name of a king, and आत्मजा a daughter.
11787: कोशवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Wrapped up in a sheathe or shell, &c. m. (-सी) 1 A shelled animal. 2 A chrysalis or pupa. E. कोश, and वासिन् what abides.
11788: कोशस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Sheathed, enveloped in a sheathe, a shell, &c. m. (-स्थः) 1 Any shelled insect or animal, as a snail, &c. 2 A pupa or chrysalis. 3 The silk worm in its cocoon. E. कोश, and स्थ what abides.
11789: कोशलिक n. (-कं) A bribe. E. कोश or कोष wealth, and ल what takes, ठक् affix; also कोषलिक.
11790: कोशाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A kind of reed or grass, commonly Ikāda. E. कोश or कोष a sheathe, and अङ्ग body; also कोषाङ्ग.
11791: कोशातक m. (-कः) Hair. f. (-की) Several sorts of cucurbitaceous plants: see कोषातक.
11792: कोशातकिन् f. (-की) 1 Trade, business. 2 A trader, a merchant. 3 Submarine fire.
11793: कोष mn. (-षः-षं) 1 A bud. 2 A sheathe, a scabbard, &c. 3 A coat, a surrounding cover, any investing sheathe. 4 Judicial trial by oath or ordeal, or by fire, water, poison, the balance, heated balls of iron, boiling oil, &c. attesting a deity, and touching or drinking water three times in which some idol has been washed. 5 Gold or silver, wrought or unwrought, as plate, jewellery, &c. 6 Wealth. 7 Accumulated wealth, treasure. 8 A treasury, the apartment where money or plate is kept. 9 A sacrificial vessel or any drinking vessel. 10 The vulva, the womb. 11 The penis. 12 A testicle or the scrotum. 13 An egg. 14 (In composition,) A ball or globe, as सूत्रकीष a ball of thread, नेत्रकोष the eyeball, &c. 15 The inner part of the Jack-fruit or its like. 16 A nutmeg. 17 A dictionary or vocabulary. f. (-षी) 1 A shoe, a sandal. 2 The beard of corn: see कोश. E. कुश or कुष to issue, affix घञ्; hence the word is optionally कोष or कोश; the meanings may be mostly resolved into, that from which something issues or evolves.
11794: कोषक m. (-कः) 1 An egg. 2 A testicle. E. कन् added to the preceding.
11795: कोषकार m. (-रः) 1 Sugar cane, or a variety. 2 The silk worm, or the insect while in its cocoon. 3 A chrysalis, or (pupa.) E. कोश a sheathe, and कार what makes; also कोशकार or with कन् added कोशकारक and कोशकारक.
11796: कोषग्रहण n. (-णं) Undergoing an ordeal. E. कोष, and ग्रहण taking; also कोशग्रहणं.
11797: कोषचञ्चु m. (-ञ्चुः) The Indian crane. E. कोष a sheathe, &c. and चञ्चु a beak.
11798: कोषनायक m. (-कः) 1 The Indian Plutus. 2 A treasurer. E. कोष, and नायक chief.
11799: कोषफल n. (-लं) A berry having a fragrant pulp: see कक्वोल. m. (-लः) A kind of creeping plant: see घोषक. f. (-ला) A sort of Ghoṣa with yellow flowers. E. कोष a sheathe, and फल fruit; also कोशफल.
11800: कोषभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Treasured, stored, accumulated. E. कोष, and भूत been.
11801: कोषला f. (-ला) The country south of Ayodhya (Oude), or Ayodhya itself: see कोशला.
11802: कोषवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Rich, wealthy. E. कोष, and मतुप् aff.
11803: कोषवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Swelled testicle, enlargement of the scrotum, from hernia or hydrocele, &c. E. कोष a testicle, and वृद्धि increase.
11804: कोषशायिका f. (-का) A knife. E. कोष a scabbard, and शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.
11805: कोषशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Purification by ordeal. E. कोष, and शुद्धि purity; also कोशशृद्धि.
11806: कोषहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, without treasure. E. कोष, and हीन deprived of.
11807: कोषांश m. (-शः) Part of a treasure, a portion of a person's wealth. E. कोष, and अंश part.
11808: कोषातक m. (-कः) Hair. f. (-की) 1 A small species of cucumber, (Trichosanthes diaeca:) 2 A cucurbitaceous plant, commonly called Turai, (Luffa acutangula.) 3 Another kind, (L. pentangula.) 4 A kind of creeper: see घोष. 5 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera;) also अपामार्ग. 6 Night. E. कोष a sheathe, &c. अत to go, affixes क्वुन् and ङीष्; also कोशातक and कोषातकी.
11809: कोषाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A treasurer. 2 KUVERA. E. कोष, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
11810: कोषापहरण n. (-णं) Carrying off treasure. E. कोष, and अपहरण taking away.
11811: कोषिन् m. (-षी) The mango tree. E. कोष a sheathe, and इनि aff.
11812: कोष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Own. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 A granary, a place in which grain is kept. 2 A treasury. 3 An apartment. 4 Any viscus, as the heart, lungs, stomach, bowels, &c. E. कुष to issue, थन् Uṇādi aff.
11813: कोष्ठक n. (-कं) 1 A granary. 2 A treasury. 3 A brick trough for watering cattle at. E. कन् added to the last.
11814: कोष्ठपाल m. (-लः) 1 A municipal officer, a constable. 2 A watch, a guard. 3 A storekeeper, a treasurer. E. कोष्ठ the granary, &c. and पाल who protects.
11815: कोष्ठागार m. (-रः) 1 A store. 2 A treasury. E. कोष्ठ, and आगार a house.
11816: कोष्ठाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The digestive faculty, the gastric juice. E. कोष्ठ stomach, and अग्नि fire.
11817: कोष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Warm, moderately warm, tepid. n. (-ष्णं) Warmth. E. का diminutive, and उष्ण warm.
11818: कोहल m. (-लः) 1 The name of a saint or Muni, the inventor or first preceptor of the drama. 2 A kind of musical instrument. 3 A sort of spirituous liquor.
11819: कौकृत्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Evil doing, wickedness. 2 Repentance. E. कु bad, कृत्या action, affix अण्.
11820: कौक्कुटिक m. (-कः) 1 A hypocrite. 2 A kind of mendicant, one who does not look far before him, or who proceeds with his eyes fixed upon the ground, for fear of treading upon insects, &c. E. कुक्कुटी hypocrisy, or a small part, ठक् aff.
11821: कौक्कुटिकन्दल m. (-लः) A species of snake, the Boä or Bor.
11822: कौक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Abdominal, ventral. E. कुक्षि the belly, अण् aff.
11823: कौक्षेयक m. (-कः) A sword, a scymitar. E. कुक्षि the belly, and ढकञ् affix; in any other sense the affix is अण्, making कौक्ष.
11824: कौङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The country, the Konkan.
11825: कौङ्किण m. (-णः) The district of Konkan in the peninsula: see कोङ्कण.
11826: कौञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) The name of a mountain, part of the Himāla range: see क्रौञ्च.
11827: कौञ्जायनी f. (-नी) 1 The wife of a Brahman or any venerable personage. 2 A female descendant of Kuñja. E. कुञ्ज, and फक् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; this word may be masculine, कौञ्जायन. m. (-नः) meaning a male descendant of Kuñja; also कैञ्जायन्य formed from कुञ्ज by च्यञ् affix m. sing. (-न्यः) sense; also plur. (-नाः)
11828: कौट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) 1 Fraudulent, dishonest. 2 Snared, wired. 3 Domestic, homely, home-born, home-bred. 4 Independent. n. (-टं) Fraud, falsehood. m. (-टः) A medicinal shrub, &c. कुटज. E. कूट fraud, or कुटि a house, अण् aff.
11829: कौटकिक m. (-कः) A vender of the flesh of birds or beasts, a poacher, a butcher, &c.; also कौटिक. E. कूट or कूटक a snare, a trap, and ठक् aff.
11830: कौटज m. (-जः) A medicinal shrub, (Echites antidysenterica:) see कुटज. E. अण् pleonastic affix to कुटज the same.
11831: कौटतक्ष m. (-क्षः) An independent carpenter, one who works at home on his own account, and not for the village or the corporation, &c. E. कौट domestic, and तक्ष a carpenter.
11832: कौटल्य m. (-ल्यः) The name of a saint; also called Vātsyāyana.
11833: कौटसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A false witness. E. कौट fraud, साक्षिन् a witness.
11834: कौटसाक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) False evidence. E. कौट, and साक्ष्य testimony.
11835: कौटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Fraudulent, dishonest. 2 Relating to a snare or trap. m. (-कः) One who kills animals, and sells their flesh for his own subsistence, a hunter, a poacher, a mountaineer, &c. E. कूट a trap for catching birds, &c. affix ठक्.
11836: कौटिलिक m. (-कः) 1 A hunter. 2 A blacksmith. E. कुटिलिका derived from कुटिल crooked, said to mean a forge, or the stooping approach of a hunter on his prey, affix अण्.
11837: कौटिल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Crookedness. 2 Dishonesty. E. कुटिल, and ष्यञ् aff.
11838: कौटुम्बिक m. (-कः) The father or master of a family. E. कुटुम्ब, and ठञ् aff.
11839: कौडविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sown with a certain measure, (a Kuḍava) of grain; (a field, &c.) E. कुडव a measure, and ठक् aff.
11840: कौणप m. (-पः) A Rākṣasa or goblin. E. कुणप a corpse, and अण् affix; these beings are supposed to eat human flesh.
11841: कौणपदन्त m. (-न्तः) A name of BHĪṢMA uncle of the Pāṇḍus.
11842: कौण्डिन्य m. (-न्यः) The name of a Muni or divine sage.
11843: कौण्य n. (-ण्यं) Being maimed, being handless. E. कुणि a cripple, यञ् aff.
11844: कौतुक n. (-कं) 1 Eagerness, vehemence, impatience. 2 Joy, pleasure, happiness. 3 Sport, pastime. 4 A festival, festivity. 5 Wish, inclination. 6 Curiosity. 7 Kind or friendly greeting, civility, salutation. 8 The marriage thread or ring. 9 The enjoyment of public diversions. 10 Song, dance, shew or spectacle. 11 Season of enjoyment. E. कुतुक, and अण् aff.
11845: कौतूहल n. (-लं) 1 Eagerness, vehemence. 2 Curiosity. E. कुतूहल and अण् pleonastic affix; also with ष्यञ् affix, कौतूहल्य n. (-ल्यं)
11846: कौतूहलान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eager, vehement. 2 Curious. E. कौतूहल, and अन्वित having.
11847: कौदालिक m. (-कः) A man of a mixed caste, the son of a fisherman by a woman of the washerman caste.
11849: कौद्रवीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A field, &c. of a particular grain, (Paspalum frumentaceum.) E. कोद्रव a species of grain, and खञ् aff.
11850: कौनख्य n. (-ख्यं) Ugliness of the nails. E. कुनख, and ष्यञ् aff.
11851: कौनख्यादिक n. (-कं) Neglect of personal decoration. E. कु bad, नखी a nail, आदि etcetera, कन् added, and अण् affix; allowing the nails to grow, &c.
11852: कौन्तिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a soldier armed with a spear. E. कुन्त a spear, affix ठक्.
11853: कौन्ती f. (-न्ती) A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā. E. कुन्ति here said to mean a country, affixes अण् and ङीष्; produced in that district.
11854: कौन्तेय m. (-यः) Either of the Pāṇḍu princes. E. कुन्ती, and ढक् affix, son of KUNTĪ.
11855: कौन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दी-न्दं) Relating to the jasmine. E. कुन्द, and अण् aff.
11856: कौप n. (-पं) Water of a well. E. कूप, and अण् aff.
11857: कौपीन n. (-नं) A small piece of cloth worn over the privities. 2 A privity, a privy part. 3 A wrong or improper at. 4 Sin. E. कूप a well, &c. खञ् aff.
11858: कौपोदकी f. (-की) The mace of KṚṢṆA: see कौमोदकी.
11859: कौमार mfn. adj. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Maiden, virgin. 2 Juvenile. 3 Soft, tender. f. (-री) One of the seven Mātṛs, the divine mothers or personified energies of the gods; the energy or Śakti of KUMĀRA or KĀRTTIKEYA. n. (-रं) 1 Youth, childhood, from birth to the age of five. 2 Maidenhood to the age of sixteen. E. कुमार a youth, and अञ् aff.; or कुमार the deity KĀRTTIKEYA, अण् and ङीष् affixes.
11860: कौमुद m. (-दः) The month Kartik, (Oct.-Nov.) f. (-दी) 1 Moonlight. 2 A festival. 3 A festival in honour of KĀRTTIKEYA, held on the full moon of the month Kartik. 4 Day of full moon in the month Aśvin. 5 The same in the month Kartik. E. कुमुद a white lotus, अण् and ङीष् affixes, कौमुदी moonlight, equally white or brilliant; the other senses come from this.
11861: कौमुदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a water lily, abounding with them, &c. कुमुद, and ठञ् aff.
11862: कौमुदीका f. (-का) A companion and confidant of DURGĀ.
11863: कौमुदीचार mn. (-रः-रं) Day of full moon in the month of Aśvin. E. कौमुदी a festival, and चार what proceeds.
11864: कौमुदीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. कौमुदी moonlight, and पति lord.
11865: कौमुदीवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) the stick or stand of a lamp. E. कौमुदी here light in general, and वृक्ष a tree.
11866: कौमोदकी f. (-की) The club or mace of KṚṢṆA. E. कुमुदक what gives the earth pleasure, here said to be VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, affixes अण् and ङीष्; also कौमुदी.
11867: कौरव m. (-वः) A Kaurava, a descendant of KURU. E. कुरु, and अण् affix; also with वुञ् affix कौरवक.
11868: कौरव्य m. (-व्यः) An ancestor or descendant of KURU. E. कुरु, and ण्य aff.
11869: कौर्म्म mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी-र्म्मं) 1 Relating to a tortoise. 2 Acting as a tortoise. 3 Belonging or relating to the Avatar of VIṢṆU, as a tortoise, as the Kaurmma or Kūrma Purāṇa. E. कूर्म्म, and अण् aff.
11871: कौल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Of a good family, well-born. m. (-लः) A worshipper of Śakti according to the left hand ritual. n. (-लं) The doctrine and practices of the left hand Śāktas. E. कुल a family, and अञ् aff.
11872: कौलकेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Of a good family, well-born. m. (-यः) The son of an unchaste woman. E. कुलक family, and ढक् aff.
