11873: कौलटिनेय mf. (-यः-यी) 7 The son or daughter of a female beg gar. 2 A bastard. E. कुलटा a female beggar, ढक् affix, and इनञ् inserted; also without the augment कौलटेय.
11874: कौलटेय mf. (-यः-यी) 1 The child of a female beggar. 2 A bastard, the child of an unchaste wife: see the preceding.
11875: कौलटेर mf. (-रः-रा) A bastard son or daughter of a disloyal wife. 2 The child of a beggar. E. कुलटा an unchaste woman, द्रक aff.
11876: कौलत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्थी-त्थं) Made, prepared, consisting of a kind of vetch. E. कुलत्थ Dolichos biflorus, अण् aff.
11877: कौलत्थीन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) A field, &c. of Dolichos biflorus. E. कुलत्थ, and खञ् affix; see the preceding.
11878: कौलव m. (-वः) One of the astrological periods called Karaṇas.
11879: कौलालक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made by a potter. n. (-कं) Earthenware, porcelain. E. कुलाल, and वुज् aff.
11880: कौलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ancestral, heritable in the family, belonging to it, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A heretic, an impostor. 2 A weaver. 3 A follower of the left hand Śākta ritual. E. कुल race, affix ठक्.
11881: कौलीन n. (-नं) 1 High birth, family descent. 2 Rumor, report. 3 Evil report, detraction. 4 Combat of animals, of birds, snakes, &c. 5 Cock-fighting, &c. contention of animals as a species of gambling. 6 A privity, a privy part. 7 An improper act. m. (-नः) The son of a female beggar. 2 A follower of the left hand Śākta ritual. E. कुलीन of a good family, affix श्वण्.
11882: कौलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Of a good family, well-born. 2 Of the left hand Śākta sect. E. कुल family, ढक् aff.
11883: कौलेयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of good parentage. E. कुल family, ढकञ् affix. m. (-कः) A dog. E. कुल a house, affix as before; a domestic animal.
11884: कौल्माषीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A field, &c. fit for or sown with a kind of bean. E. कुल्माष q. v. and खञ् affix; also with अञ् affix, कौल्माष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं).
11885: कौल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Of good family or parentage. 2 Of the left hand Śākta sect. E. कुल family, and यञ् aff.
11886: कौवल n. (-लं) The jujube tree: see कुवल.
11887: कौवेर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Relating or referable to KUVERA. 2 Situated in the north. f. (-री) 1 The Śakti or female energy of KUVERA. 2 The north quarter. n. (-रं) A sort of costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ठ. E. कुवेर the deity, affix अण्.
11888: कौश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Silk, silken. n. (-शं) Kanyakubja or Kanouj. the ancient city so called. E. कोश, and अण् affix.
11889: कौशल mf. (-लं-ली) 1 Greeting, salutation, friendly inquiry. 2 A respectful present, a Nazr. 3 Happiness, welfare, &c. E. कुशल good fortune, well-being, अण् and ङीष् affs.
11890: कौशलिका f. (-का) A present, a respectful gift or offering. E. कन् added to the last.
11891: कौशलेय m. (-यः) A name of RĀMA. E. कौशल्या the wife of DAŚARATHA, ढक् affix of descent.
11892: कौशल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Good fortune, well-being, &c. 2 Cleverness, talent. f. (-ल्या) The mother of RĀMA. E. कुशल and यञ् affix, or कोशल a name of the father of this princess, affix ण्यत्.
11893: कौशल्यानन्दन m. (-नः) A name of RĀMA. E. नन्दन a son, and कौशल्या RĀMA'S mother.
11894: कौशल्यायनि m. (-निः) RĀMA: see the preceding. E. कौशल्या, and फिञ् aff.
11895: कौशाम्बर n. (-रं) Silk cloth. E. कौश, and अम्बर vesture.
11896: कौशाम्बी f. (-म्बी) The name of an ancient city on the Ganges in the lower part of the Doab, in the vicinity of Kurrah; also वत्सपत्तन. E. कुशाम्ब a proper name, (the founder,) अण् and ङीप् affs.
11897: कौशिक (-कः-की-कं) 1 Silk, silken. 2 Of the family of Kuśika, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A fragrant substance, (Bdellium.) 3 An owl. 4 A snake-catcher. 5 An ichneumon, (Viverra ichneumon.) 6 A title of VIŚVAMITRA. 7 One skilled in dictionaries. 8 A dictionary compiler. 9 Love, the passion. 10 The marrow. f. (-की) 1 A river in Behar, the Kosi or Koosa. 2 A name of the goddess DURGA. n. (-कं) Silk. E. कोश a sheathe, &c. ठक् affix, and ङीप् for the feminine; also कौषिक, and कौषिकी.
11898: कौशिकप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of RĀMA. E. कौशिक the sage VIŚVAMITRA, and प्रिय a friend or favourite.
11899: कौशिकफल n. (-लं) A cocoanut. E. कौशिक the saint VIŚVAMITRA, and फल fruit, being said to have been created by the sage in his progress to make a human being in rivalry to BRAHMĀ, the nut being the first rudiment of the head.
11900: कौशिका f. (-का) A drinking vessel, a cup or goblet. E. कुश to surround or contain, affixes ण्वुल् and टाप्.
11901: कौशिकात्मज m. (-जः) A name of ARJUNA. E. कौशिक INDRĀ, and आत्मज a son.
11902: कौशिकायुध n. (-धं) The rainbow. E. कौशिक INDRĀ, and आयुध a weapon.
11903: कौशिकाराति m. (-तिः) A crow. E. कौशिक an owl, and अराति an enemy; also कौशिकारि, &c.
11904: कौशितकी f. (-की) The wife of the saint AGASTYA. E. कुश to retract, (wrath,) इतक and ङीष् affixes; this lady being an anti-xantippe.
11905: कौशीलव्य n. (-व्यं) The profession of an actor, a dancer, &c. E. कुशीलव, and ष्यञ् aff.
11906: कौशेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Silken, of silk. n. (-यं) 1 Silk. 2 A silk petticoat or trowsers, a woman's lower garment of silk. E. कोश or कोष the cocoon, and ढक affix; also कौषेय.
11907: कौषिक m. (-कः) A name of INDRA, &c.: see above, काशिक. f. (-की) DURGĀ, &c.: see कौशिकी.
11909: कौसीद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Usurious. E. कुसीद, and अण् aff.
11910: कौसीद्य n. (-द्यं) 1 Sloth, indolence. 2 The practice of usury. E. कुसीद usury, &c. affix यञ्.
11911: कौसुम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Flowering. E. कुसुम and अण् aff.
11912: कौसुम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भी-म्भं) Dyed with safflower, orange, red. E. कुसुम्भ safflower, and अण् aff.
11913: कौसृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A juggler, a conjuror. E. कुसृति wickedness, affix ठक्.
11914: कौस्तुभ m. (-भः) The jewel of KṚṢṆA suspended on his breast. E. कुस्तुभ a name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, and अण् aff.
11915: कौस्तुभलक्षक m. (-कः) A name of VIṢṆU.
11916: कौस्तुभवक्षस् m. (-क्षाः) A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. कौस्तभ the jewel, and वक्षस् the breast.
11917: क्नथ r. 1st and 10th cls. (क्नथति क्नथयति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
11918: क्नस (उ) क्नसु r. 4th cl. (क्नस्यति) 1 To be crooked, (in mind or body.) 2 To shine, (इ,) क्नसि r. 10th cl. (क्नंसयति) To shine.
11919: क्नु r. 9th cl. (ञ्) क्नुञ् (क्नुनाति-नीते) To sound; also क्नू.
11920: क्नू r. 9th cl. (ञ्) क्नूञ् (क्ननाति-नीते) To sound.
11921: क्नूय r. 1st cl. (ई) क्नूया (क्नूयते) 1 To sound. 2 To be wet. 3 To stink.
11922: क्नूयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) What stinks, &c. E. क्नूय, and तृच् aff.
11923: क्मर r. 1st cl. (क्भरति) To be crooked in person, to be crooked in mind, to be fraudulent or crafty.
11924: क्रकच mn. (-चः-चं) 1 A saw. 2 A thorny plant: see करीर. f. (-चा) The Ketaki: see the next. E. क्र an imitative sound, कच to emit sound, affix अच्.
11925: क्रकचच्छद m. (-दः) A plant with a strong smelling flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. क्रकच a saw, and छद a leaf; having serrated leaves.
11926: क्रकचपाद् m. (-पाद् or -पात्) A chameleon, a lizard. E. क्रकच a saw, पाद् a foot, saw-footed, or with a final vowel, क्रकचपाद m. (-दः)
11927: क्रकचपृष्ठी f. (-ष्ठी) A small fish with numerous small spines in the back, (Coius cobojius, HAM.) E. क्रकच a saw, and पृष्ठ the back, saw-backed.
11928: क्रकण m. (-णः) A kind of partridge, commonly Kayar; also कृकण and क्रकर.
11929: क्रकर m. (-रः) 1 A sort of partridge, called Kaër, (Perdix sylvatica;) also कृकर. 2 A thorny plant, vulgarly Karil: see करीर. 3 A saw. 4 A poor man. E. क्र an imitative sound, कर what makes.
11930: क्रतु m. (-तुः) 1 Sacrifice, offering, worship. 2 An Aśvamedha, the sacrifice. 3 The name of a Muni, one of the seven principal Ṛṣis or saints, the offspring of BRAHMĀ, married to Kriyā, and the father of the 60,000 Bālikhilyas. 4 One of the ten VIŚVADEVAS. E. कृञ् to do, क्तु Uṇādi aff.
11931: क्रतुच्छद m. (-दः) 1 A Jina. 2 One skilled in sacrifice.
11932: क्रतुतुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Equal to an Aśvamedha in merit. E. क्रतु, and तुल्य equal.
11933: क्रतुद्रुह् m. (-द्रुक् or -द्रुग्-द्रुट् or -द्रुड्) An Asura, a demon. E. क्रतु sacrifice, and द्रुह who hates, affix क्विप्.
11934: क्रतुद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A Daitya or demon. E. क्रतु a sacrifice, and द्विष who hates.
11935: क्रतुध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A name of ŚIVA. E. क्रतु a sacrifice, ध्वसि to destroy, affix णिनि, the destroyer of DAKṢA'S sacrifice: see दक्ष.
11936: क्रतुपशु m. (-शुः) A horse, especially such a one as is fit for an Aśvamedha. E. क्रत sacrifice, and पशु animal.
11937: क्रतुपुरुष m. (-षः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. क्रतु, and पुरुष man or male.
11938: क्रतुफल n. (-लं) The reward of a sacrifice, the object for which it is performed. E. क्रतु, and फल fruit.
11939: क्रतुभुज् m. (-भुक्) A god, a deity. E. क्रतु sacrifice, and भुज् who eats.
11940: क्रतुराज m. (-जः) A particular sacrifice, the Rājasūya: one performed by a monarch who has subdued all the princes of the  word. E. क्रतु sacrifice, and राज a king; a royal or preeminent ceremony: see राजसूय.
11941: क्रतुविक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A Brahman who sells to another the possible benefits of a sacrifice which he has performed. E. क्रतु, and विक्रयिन् who sells; also क्रतुविक्रायकः
11942: क्रतुसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Completion of a sacrifice, attainment of the object for which it is performed. E. क्रतु, and सिद्धि completion.
11943: क्रतूत्तम m. (-मः) The Rājasūya sacrifice: see the preceding. E. क्रतु, and उत्तम best: the pre-eminent sacrifice.
11944: क्रथ r. 1st and 10th cls. (क्रथयति-ते and क्राथयति-ते) To kill, to hurt or injure. r. 10th cl. (क्रथयति) To amuse, to delight repeatedly.
11945: क्रथन n. (-नं) 1 Slaughter, killing. 2 Snoring, stertor. E. क्रथ to kill, affix ल्युट्.
11946: क्रथनक n. (-कं) A white sort of Agallochum: see अगुरु.
11947: क्रद r. 1st cl. (क्रदते) or (इ) क्रदि (क्रन्दति) 1 To confound, to confuse. 2 To grieve, to be confused; also (क्रन्दति) 1 To call, to cry out. 2 To weep, to shed tears: see क्रन्द.
11948: क्रन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Going, who or what goes. E. क्रम, and तृच् aff.
11949: क्रन्द r. 1st and 10th cls. generally used with आङ् prefixed, आक्रन्द (आक्रन्दति आक्रन्दयति) 1 To weep, to shed tears. 2 To call continually.
11950: क्रन्दन m. (-नः) A cat. n. (-नं) 1 Weeping, lamenting, sobbing. 2 Crying out, calling. 3 Mutual daring or defiance, challenging, braving. E. क्रदि to cry out, to call, sob, &c. affix ल्युट्; also with क्र affix क्रन्दित.
11951: क्रन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wept. 2 Called or cried out. n. (-तं.) 1 Weeping. 2 Calling. 3 Mutual daring: see the preceding. E. क्रन्द to call, क्त aff.
11952: क्रप r. 1st cl. (क्रपते) 1 To compassionate, to pity. 2 To go or move: see कृप.
11953: क्रम r. 1st cl. (उ) क्रमु (क्रामति क्राम्यति or क्रम्यति) To go, to walk, to step: (in the following senses it is optionally deponent:) (क्रमते क्रम्यते) 1 To proceed uninterruptedly. 2 To grow or increase. 3 To preserve. It is also active or deponent according to various prefixes and in various senses, as, with अति (अतिक्रामति) 1 To go over or beyond, to leap over. 2 To transgress, to pass beyond the bounds of virtue. With अनु (अनुक्रमते) To proceed regularly or in order. With अभि (अभिक्रामति) 1 To overcome, to surpass. 2 To assail. With अप (अपक्रमते) To go away, to depart. With आङ्, (आक्रमते) To rise as the sun, &c. or (आक्रामति) To rise, to mount, to overcome. With उत्, (उत्क्रामति) To transgress. With उप, (उपक्रामति) To depart. (उपक्रमते) To begin. With निर्, (निष्क्रामति) To go forth. With पर and आङ् (पराक्रमति) To display valour, to surpass or overcome. With प्र, (प्रक्रामति) To depart, to go or approach, (प्रक्रमते) To begin. With परि, (परिक्रामति) To wander about, to ramble. With वि, (विक्रामति) 1 To overcome. 2 To mount or ascend. (विक्रमते) To pace, to proceed by steps, to move with the feet. With वि and आङ् (व्याक्रमते) To transgress. With सम्, (संक्रामति) to remove.
11954: क्रम m. (-मः) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 A sacred precept or practice prescribed by the Vedas. 3 Order, method. 4 Power, strength. 5 Overcoming, surpassing, subduing, &c. 6 A foot. 7 Uninterrupted progress. E. क्रम to go, घञ् aff.
11955: क्रमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Orderly, methodical. 2 Proceeding, going. m. (-कः) A student who goes through a regular course of study, one who proceeds methodically. क्रम to go, affix वुन्.
11956: क्रमज्या f. (-ज्या) (In astronomy,) The sine of a planet's declination. E. क्रम going, and ज्या sine.
11957: क्रमण m. (-णः) A foot. n. (-णं) Going, proceeding. E. क्रम to go, affix ल्युट्.
11958: क्रमतस् ind. Gradually, successively, in order. E. क्रम, and तस् aff.
11959: क्रममाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Going, proceeding. E. क्रम to go, शानच् aff.
11960: क्रमयोग m. (-गः) Successive or methodical practice. E. क्रम, and योग union.
11961: क्रमशस् ind. 1 Gradually, by degrees. 2 Regularly, seriatim. E. क्रम, and शसि aff.
11962: क्रमागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Descended to or inherited lineally, what comes from one's ancestors in regular succession. 2 Arrived in due course or succession. E. क्रम, and आगत come.
11963: क्रमागतत्व n. (-त्वं) Hereditary succession or possession. E. त्व added to the preceding.
11964: क्रमायात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proceeding in regular order. 2 Descended lineally, (estate, &c.) E. क्रम order, and आयात come, obtained.
11965: क्रमि m. (-मिः) A worm: see क्रिमि.
11966: क्रमितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Going, who or what goes, &c. E. क्रम to go, तृच् affix, with इट augment.
11967: क्रमु m. (-मुः) The betel nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu;) also क्रमुक्.
11968: क्रमुक m. (-कः) 1 The areca or betel nut, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 2 A kind of tree, a red sort of Lodh: see लाघ्र. 3 A kind of fragrant grass: see भद्रमुस्तक. 4 The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.) 5 The fruit of the cotton tree. f. (-की) The areca tree. E. क्रम to go, उक aff.
11969: क्रमुकफल n. (-लं) The areca nut. E. क्रमुक, and फल fruit.
11970: क्रमेल m. (-लः) A camel: see the next.
11971: क्रमेलक m. (-कः) A camel. E. क्रम to go, एलप Uṇādi affix, and कन् added; or क्रम order, इल to go, क affix, and कन् added.
11972: क्रमोद्वेग m. (-गः) An ox. E. क्रम a foot, उद्वेग who goes.
11973: क्रय m. (यः) Buying, purchase. E. क्री to buy, अच् aff.
11974: क्रयक्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bought, purchased. E. क्रय, and क्रीत bought.
11975: क्रयलेख्य n. (-ख्यं) Deed of sale, conveyance, &c. E. क्रय, and लेख्य writing.
11976: क्रयविक्रय m. (-यः) Trade, traffic, buying and selling. E. क्रय purchase, विक्रय sale.
11977: क्रयविक्रयानुशय m. (-यः) Rescission of sale, a title of civil judicature. E. क्रयविक्रय, and अनुशय doubt.
11978: क्रयविक्रयिक m. (-कः) A trader or merchant, a dealer. E. क्रय buying, विक्रय sale, and ठन् aff.
11979: क्रयशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) The coping of a wall.
11980: क्रयारोह m. (-हः) A market, a fair. E. क्रय purchase, and रुह to rise, आङ् prefix, and घञ् aff.
11981: क्रयिक m. (-कः) 1 A trader, a dealer. 2 A purchaser, a buyer. E. क्री to buy, Uṇādi affix इकन्.
11982: क्रयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) A buyer or purchaser. E. क्री to buy, इनि aff.
11983: क्रय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Purchasable. E. क्री to buy, यत् affix, deriv. irr.
11984: क्रव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Flesh. 2 Raw flesh. E. कृप to be able, यत् affix, and प changed to ब; the latter becomes dental before य.
11985: क्रव्यघातन m. (-नः) A deer. E. क्रव्य flesh, and घातन killing for its flesh.
11986: क्रव्यभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Carnivorous. m. (-भुक्) A Rākṣasa. E. क्रव्य, भुज who eats.
11987: क्रव्याद् m. or mfn. (-व्याद् or -व्यात्) 1 An imp or goblin, a Rākṣasa. 2 A flesh-eater. 3 A beast of prey, a carnivorous animal. E. क्रव्य flesh, अद् to eat, विद् affix, or with अण् affix, क्रव्याद.
11988: क्रव्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) An eater of flesh or meat, carnivorous. m. (-दः) 1 A goblin, a Rākṣasa. 2 A lion. 3 A hawk. 4 Funeral fire. E. see the preceding.
11989: क्रव्याशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Carnivorous. m. (-शी A demon, an anthropophagus. E. क्रव्य, and अशिन्) who eats.
11990: क्राकचिक m. (-कः) A sawyer. E. क्रकच्, and ठञ् aff.
11991: क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Overcome, surpassed. 2 Attacking, invading, gone to or against. 3 Spread, extended. 4 Going, going over or across. m. (-न्तः) 1 A horse. 2 (In astronomy,) Declination. n. (-न्तं) An astrological element, the conjunction of any planet with the moon. E. क्रम to go, affix क्त.
11992: क्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 Overcoming, surpassing. 3 The sun's course on the globe, the ecliptic. 4 Declination of a planet. E. क्रम to go, affix क्तिन्.
11993: क्रान्तिकक्ष m. (-क्षः) The ecliptic. E. क्रान्ति, and कक्ष girdle.
11994: क्रान्तिज्या f. (-ज्या) Sine of the declination. E. क्रान्ति, and ज्या sine.
11995: क्रान्तिपात m. (-तः) The nodes of the ecliptic, or the equinoctial points. E. क्रान्ति, and पात going.
11996: क्रान्तिपातगति f. (-तिः) Motion of the nodes of the ecliptic, precession of the equinox. E. क्रान्तिपात, and गति going.
11997: क्रान्तिभाग m. (-गः) Declination of a point of the ecliptic. E. क्रान्ति, and भाग division.
11998: क्रान्तिमण्डल n. (-लं) The ecliptic. E. क्रान्ति, and मण्डल circle.
11999: क्रान्तिवलय m. (-यः) The space within the tropics. E. क्रान्ति, and वलय bracelet.
12000: क्रान्तु m. (-न्तुः) A bird in general. E. क्रम to go, वुन् Uṇādi affix, and the pen. made long.
12001: क्रामत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 1 Going, proceeding over or through. E. क्रम to go, शतृ aff.
12002: क्रायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A buyer or purchaser. 2 A dealer, a trader. क्री to buy, ण्वुल् aff.
12003: क्रिमि m. (-मिः) 1 A worm, an insect. 2 Lac, which is the accumulation of an insect. 3 A worm in the intestines. E. क्रम to go, इन् Uṇādi affix, and इट् inserted; also कृमि.
12004: क्रिमिकण्टक m. (-कः) A medicinal plant, commonly Bireng: see कृमिकण्टक.
12005: क्रिमिघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Vermifuge, anthelmintic. m. (-घ्नः) An anthelmintic shrub: see कृमिघ्न. f. (-घ्नी) Somraj, (Serratula or Conyza anthelmintica.) E. कृमि or क्रिमि a worm, and घ्न what kills: see कृमिघ्न.
12006: क्रिमिज n. (-जं) Aguru or aloe wood: see अगुरु. f. (-जा) The red dye called Lac. E. (-क्रिमि a worm, and ज born; also कृमिज.
12007: क्रिमिशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.) E. क्रिमि a worm, and शत्रु an enemy; the leaves yield, by expression, an acrid anthelmintic juice.
12008: क्रिमिशात्रव m. (-वः) A fetid mimosa, (M. farnesiana.) E. क्रिमि a worm, and शात्रव inimical: an anthelmintic.
12009: क्रिमिशैल m. (-लः) An ant hill. E. क्रिमि a worm, and शेल a hill.
12010: क्रिय m. (-यः) The sign Aries. E. कृ to do, श aff.
12011: क्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Doing, making, engaged in. E. कृ to do, शानच् aff.
12012: क्रिया f. (-या) 1 An act, action, acting. 2 Means, expedient. 3 Beginning, undertaking. 4 Atonement. 5 Study. 6 Worship. 7 Disquisition. 8 Bodily action. 9 Remedying, physical treatment or practice. 10 Instrument, implement. 11 A religious or initiatory ceremony. 12 Obsequies, rites performed immediately after death. 12 Purificatory rites, as ablution, &c. 14 Judicial investigation, by human means, as witnesses, documents, &c. or by superhuman or ordeals of various kinds. 15 In grammar, a verb of two kinds, सकर्म्मक्रिया active or अकर्म्मक्रिया intransitive. 16 A noun of action. E. कृ to act, to do, श affix, fem. do. टाप्; the above meanings may be all resolved into the first.
12014: क्रियाकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) One who does any act, an agent, a performer. m. (-रः) A student, a novice, a tyro. E. क्रिया study, and कर or कार, who makes.
12015: क्रियाद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Opposed or averse to any act. m. (-षी) One of the five kinds of witnesses, he whose testimony is hurtful to the cause. E. क्रिया a suit, and द्वेषिन् injuring.
12016: क्रियानिर्देश m. (-शः) Evidence. E. क्रिया, and निर्देश proof.
12017: क्रियानुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Conformably to the act, according to the action. E. क्रिया, and अनुरूप like to.
12018: क्रियापटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Clever, dexterous. E. क्रिया, and पटु clever.
12019: क्रियापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Attentive to or diligent in the performance of their duties. E. क्रिया, and पर engaged in.
12020: क्रियापवर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 End of an affair. 2 Liberation from ceremonial acts. E. क्रिया, and अपवर्ग end.
12021: क्रियापाद m. (-दः) The third division of a suit at law, the proof or rejoinder of the plaintiff. E. क्रिवा an affair, and पाद a fourth part.
12022: क्रियाप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Course of proceeding. E. क्रिया, and प्रसङ्ग procedure.
12023: क्रियाफल n. (-लं) Result or consequence of acts. E. क्रिया, and फल fruit.
12024: क्रियाभ्युपगम m. (-मः) Special compact or agreement. E. क्रिया business, अभि and उप prefixed to गम to go, affix अच्; going through with any thing.
12025: क्रियालोप m. (-पः) Discontinuance or loss of any of the essential ceremonies of the Hindu religion. E. क्रिया, and लोप loss.
12026: क्रियावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Engaged in business. 2 Understanding business, fit for it, possessed of worldly knowledge. 2 Celebrating religious rites. E. क्रिया, and मतुप् aff.
12027: क्रियावश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Subject to the influence of acts. m. (-शः) Necessity, necessary influence of acts done or to be done. E. क्रिया, and वश subjection.
12028: क्रियावसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) One who loses his cause in a lawsuit. E. क्रिया affair, अवसन्न ended.
12029: क्रियावादिन् m. (-दी) A plaintiff. E. क्रिया affair, and वादिन् who declares.
12030: क्रियाविधि f. (-धिः) 1 Conduct of affairs. 2 Mode of performing any rite. E. क्रिया, and विधि rule.
12031: क्रियाविधिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Conversant with business. 2 Understanding the ritual, &c. E. क्रियाविधि, and ज्ञ who knows.
12032: क्रियासमभिहार m. (-रः) Repetition of any act, doing any thing repeatedly. E. क्रिया, and समभिहार repetition.
12033: क्रियेन्द्रिय m. (-यः) An organ of action, as the hand, foot, voice, organ of generation and that of excretion. E. क्रिया acting, and इन्द्रिय an organ; also कर्म्मेंन्द्रिय.
12034: क्री (डु, ङ्,) डुक्रीङ् r. 9th cl. (क्रीणाति क्रीणीते) To buy, to barter or exchange; with वि prefixed, to sell.
12035: क्रीड r. 1st cl. (ऋ) क्रीडृ (क्रीडति) To play, to sport; with अनु, अव, आङ्, परि, or सम् prefixed, it is deponent, as अनुक्रीडते, &c. unless अनु requires the accusative case, and the compound with सम् implies inarticulate sound, as तमनुक्रीडति सा she plays with him, संक्रीडति चक्रं the wheel creaks.
12036: क्रीड mfn. (-डः-डा) 1 Sport, play, pastime, pleasure, amusement. f. (-डा) 1 Playing, as a ball, &c. 2 Disrespect. E. क्रीड to play, अ affix, and fem. do. टाप्.
12037: क्रीडन n. (-नं) Play, sport, &c. E. क्रीड to play, affix युच्.
12038: क्रीडत् mfn. (-डन्-डन्ती-डत्) Playing, gamboling, sporting. E. क्रीड, and शतृ aff.
12039: क्रीडमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sporting, playing. E. क्रीड, and शानच् aff.
12040: क्रीडाकूत n. (-तं) Sportive or wanton purpose or desire. E. क्रीडा, and आकूत wish.
12041: क्रीडाकोप m. (-पः) Assumed anger, anger in sport. E. क्रीडा, and कोप anger.
12042: क्रीडारत्न n. (-त्नं) Copulation. E. क्रीडा, and रत्न a gem.
12043: क्रीडारथ m. (-थः) A car, a carriage. E. क्रीडा sport, pleasure, and रथ a car.
12044: क्रीडावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sporting, sportive. E. क्रीडा, and मतुप् aff.
12045: क्रीडासरस् n. (-रः) A reservoir, a basin. E. क्रीडा pleasure, सरस् a lake.
12046: क्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bought, purchased. m. (-तः) A son, one of the twelve kinds acknowledged by the ancient Hindu law; he who is purchased from his natural parents. E. क्री to buy, affix क्त.
12047: क्रीतक m. (-कः) A son bought from his natural parents, and adopted as male issue; also क्रीत and क्रीतपुत्त्रः see the preceding.
12048: क्रीतानुशय m. (-यः) Returning a purchase upon the seller, admissible in some cases by law. E. क्रीत bought, अनुशय repentance.
12049: क्रुञ्च (उ) क्रुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (क्रुञ्चति) 1 To go, to approach to wards or arrive at. 2 To move crookedly. 3 To be crooked. 4 To curve or make crooked. 5 To become small, to shrink. 6 To make small, to lessen; also कुञ्च.
12050: क्रुञ्च् mf. (क्रुङ् क्रुञ्चा) A curlew. E. क्रुञ्च to go crookedly, affix क्विन्, fem. affix टाप्.
12051: क्रुञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A name of the mountain Krouncha. f. (-ञ्चा) A kind of Vīṇā or lute. E. क्रुञ्च to be crooked, affixes क and टाप्.
12052: क्रुड r. 6th cl. (क्रुडति) To sink. 2 To be childish. 3 To eat. 4 To be thick.
12053: क्रुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Angry, wrathful. 2 Fierce, cruel. n. (-द्धं) Anger. E. क्रुध to be angry, क्त aff.
12054: क्रुध (औ, ऌ) औक्रुधॢ r. 4th cl. (क्रुध्यति) To be wrathful, to be flushed with anger.
12055: क्रुध् f. (क्रुत् or (-क्रुद्) Anger, passion. E. क्रुध to be angry, affix क्विप्; also with अङ् and टाप् affixes, क्रुधा.
12056: क्रुधा f. (-धा) Anger: see the preceding.
12057: क्रुध्यत् mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्) Being angry. E. क्रुध, and शतृ aff.
12058: क्रुन्थ r. 9th cl. (क्रुथ्नाति) 1 To be connected with, to cling or adhere to. 2 To be distressed, to suffer pain.
12059: क्रुश r. 1st cl. (-क्रोशति) 1 To call. 2 To cry, to weep. With अनु prefixed, To feel for, to sympathise with. With आङ्, To revile, to abuse or censure. With उप, To reproach. With प्र, To cry aloud, to shout.
12060: क्रुश्वन् m. (-श्वा) A jackall. E. क्रुश to cry or howl, Uṇādi affix क्वनिप्.
12061: क्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Wept, cried. 2 Cried aloud, bawled. n. (-ष्टं) 1 Weeping, sobbing. 2 Noise, sound. E. क्रुश to weep, affix क्त.
12062: क्रूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Cruel, pitiless. 2 Hard, harsh. 3 Hard, solid. 4 Mischievous, destructive. 5 Formidable, terrible. 6 Hot, sharp. 7 Disagreeable. m. (-रः) 1 An odd sign of the zodiac, as the first, third, fifth, &c. which are of malignant influences. 2 A hawk. 3 A heron. 4 Red oleander. E. कृत to cut, रक् Uṇādi affix, and क्रू substituted for कृत.
12063: क्रूरकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Fierce, cruel, unrelenting. E. क्रूर, and कर्म्मन् act.
12064: क्रूरकोष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) Torpid or costive bowels unaffected by strong purgatives. E. क्रूर, and कोष्ठ the alimentary canal.
12065: क्रूरगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Sulphur. E. क्रूर, and गन्ध smell.
12066: क्रूरचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cruel, ferocious, addicted to cruel practices. E. क्रूर, and चरित who practices.
12067: क्रूरता f. (-ता) Cruelty, fierceness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्रूरत्वं.
12068: क्रूरदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Mischievous, villainous. 2 Evil-eyed. m. (-दृक्) A name of the planet Śani or Saturn. E. क्रूर cruel, &c. and दृश who sees, from दृश to see, affix क्विप्.
12069: क्रूरराविन् m. (-वी) A raven. E. क्रूर formidable, राविन् who cries.
12070: क्रूरलोचन m. (-नः) A name of Saturn. E. क्रूर evil, and लाचन an eye; of an evil or inauspicious aspect.
12071: क्रूरव m. (-वः) 1 A jackall. 2 Any thing bad.
12072: क्रूराकृति m. (-तिः) A name of RĀVAṆA the ruler of Laṅkā. E. क्रूर evil, and आकृति figure, form.
12073: क्रूराचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Following barbarous or savage practices. E. क्रूर, and आचार observance.
12074: क्रूर्च्च mn. (-र्चः-र्चं) The beard: see कूर्च्च.
12075: क्रेणि m. (-णिः) Buying, purchase. E. क्री to buy, णि Uṇādi aff.
12076: क्रेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Purchasable. E. future participle of क्री to buy, affix तव्यत्.
12077: क्रेतृ m. (-ता) A purchaser, a buyer. क्री to buy, affix तृच्.
12078: क्रेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Purchasable. E. क्री to buy, affix यत्; to be bought.
12079: क्रोञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A mountain: see क्रौञ्च.
12080: क्रोञ्चपदा f. (-दा) A species of metre of four lines, and twenty-five syllables in each.
12081: क्रोञ्चदारण m. (-णः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. क्रोञ्च or क्रौञ्च a mountain, and दारण the render or tearer; also क्रौञ्चदारण.
12082: क्रोड nf. (-डं-डा) 1 The breast, the chest. 2 The haunch, the flank, the hollow above the hip. m. (-डः) 1 A name of Śani or Saturn. 2 A hog. E. क्रुड to be thick, घञ् aff.
12083: क्रोडपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारिका.
12084: क्रोडपाद m. (-दः) A turtle, a tortoise. E. क्रोड the breast, and पाद a foot.
12086: क्रोडाङ्गि m. (-ङ्गिः) A turtle or tortoise. E. क्रोड and अङ्गि a foot.
12087: क्रोडीकरण n. (-णं) Embracing. E. क्रोड breast or side, करण making, and च्चि augment.
12088: क्रोडीकृति f. (-तिः) Embracing, mutual embrace. E. see the preceding; कृति making.
12089: क्रोथ m. (-थः) Killing, slaying. E. क्रुथ to kill or hurt, affix घञ्.
12090: क्रोध m. (-धः) Anger, wrath. E. क्रुध to be angry, affix घञ्.
12091: क्रोधज mf. (-जः-जा-जं) Proceeding from or engendered by wrath; it especially applies to eight vices, hatred, envy, oppression, violence, &c. E. क्रोध passion, and ज produced.
12092: क्रोधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Passionate, angry, wrathful. f. (-ना) A passionate woman, a vixen. E. क्रुध to be angry, affix युच्.
12093: क्रोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Provocative. n. (-यं) An injury. E. क्नुध to be angry, (on account of,) अनीयर् aff.
12094: क्रोधमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Angry, passionate. E. क्रोध, and मयट् aff.
12095: क्रोधमूर्च्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Passionate, angry, overcome with rage. m. (-तः) A kind of perfume, commonly Cor. E. क्रोध wrath, and मूर्च्छित confused, overcome.
12096: क्रोधवर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from wrath, mild, calm. E. क्रोध, and वर्जित devoid of.
12097: क्रोधवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Passionate, violent. E. क्रोध, and वश subject to.
12098: क्रोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Angry, passionate. E. क्रोध angry, affix इनि.
12099: क्रोधोज्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Calm, composed, free from wrath. E. क्रोध, and उज्झित abandoned.
12100: क्रोश m. (-शः) A measure of distance, a league, a Koś, containing 4000 cubits; some double this, and make the Koś 8000 cubits. E. क्रुश to call, &c. affix घञ्.
12101: क्रोशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Crying, calling out. क्रुश to cry, शत् aff.
12102: क्रोशताल m. (-लः) A large or double drum. E. क्रोश a Koś, and ताल a tune; whose sound may be heard for a league.
12103: क्रोशध्वनि m. (-निः) A large drum. E. क्रोश, and ध्वनि sound: see the preceding.
12104: क्रोशयुग n. (-गं) A measure of two Koś 4000 yards, or about 2½ miles; this seems to correspond to the modern Koś, but the standard varies. E. क्रोश a Koś, and युग a pair; also गव्यूति.
12105: क्रोष्टु mf. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री) A jackall. E. क्रुश to cry or call, and तुन् affix; the noun declined in many cases like nouns in ऋ.
12106: क्रोष्टुकपुच्छिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Chaculiya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) or according to some, Ramvāsac, a different plant: see क्रोष्टुविन्ना. E. क्रोष्टु a jackall, कन् affix, and पुच्छिका tail; the flower being compared to the tail of the animal.
12107: क्रोष्टुकमेखला f. (-ला) The plant Cāculiya; see the preceding.
12108: क्रोष्टुपुच्छिका f. (-का) See क्रोष्टुकपुच्छिका: also क्रोष्टुपुच्छी.
12109: क्रोष्टुविन्ना f. (-न्ना) The name of a plant, either Chaculiya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) or a different plant called Ramvāsac. E. क्रोष्टु a jackall, and विन्न known; known by being compared to the animal.
12110: क्रोष्टेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) The white sugar cane. E. क्रोष्ट, and इक्षु cane.
12111: क्रोष्ट्री f. (-ष्ट्री) 1 The black or white Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus:) see भूमिकुष्माण्डक. 2 Cāculiya: see क्रोष्टुविन्ना. 3 A she jackall: see क्रोष्टु. E. क्रुश to cry, affix ष्ट्रन् and fem. ङीप्.
12112: क्रौञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) 1 A kind of heron, (Ardea jaculator, BUC.) 2 One of the Dvīpas or principal divisions of the world, surrounded by the sea of curds. 3 A mountain, part of the Himāla range, situated in the eastern part of the chain on the north of Asam. 4 A Jaina emblem, the figure of the curlew, used as a symbol. 5 The name of a demon. f. (-ञ्चा) The female of the curlew. E. क्रुञ्च to go crookedly, affix अण्.
12113: क्रौञ्चदारण m. (-णः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. क्रौञ्च the name of a mountain; also of an Asura, and दारण the tearer or destroyer.
12114: क्रौञ्चादन m. (-नः) 1 Long pepper. 2 The fibres of the stalk of the lotus. 3 An esculent root, commonly Ghenchu. 4 An aquatic plant, commonly Ciñcāta. E. क्रौञ्च the heron, and अदन eating.
12115: क्रौञ्चाराति m. (-तिः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. क्रौञ्च the Asura, and अराति an enemy.
12116: क्रौञ्चारि m. (-रिः) 1 The deity KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 The hero and Avatāra PARAŚURĀMA. E. क्रौञ्च the Asura or the mountain, and अरि a foe: RĀMA is said to have made with his arrows a pass or defile through the Krauncha mountain.
12117: क्रौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Cruelty, fierceness, passion. E. क्रूर cruel, &c. य्यञ् aff.
12118: क्रौशशतिक m. (-कः) One who goes a hundred Koś or leagues. E. क्रोश a Koś, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
12119: क्लथ (म) r. 1st cl. (क्लथति) To kill or hurt.
12120: क्लद r. 1st cl. (क्लदते) or (इ) क्लदि (क्लंदते) 1 To be confused, to grieve. 2 To confound; also क्लदि (क्लंदति) 1 To call. 2 To shed tears.
12121: क्लप r. 10th cl. (क्लापयति) To speak, to speak barbarously.
12122: क्लम (उ, भ, ञि, इर) क्लमु r. 4th cl. (क्लाम्यति) To be fatigued, to be weary or exhausted.
12123: क्लम m. (-मः) Fatigue, weariness, exhaustion. E. क्लम to be weary, affix घञ्.
12124: क्लमथ m. (-थः) Fatigue, exhaustion. E. क्लम to be weary, Uṇādi affix अथ.
12125: क्लमित्व n. (-त्वं) Exhaustion, languor, fatigue. E. क्लमिन्, and त्व affix; also with तल्, क्लमिता.
12126: क्लमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Weary, exhausted. E. क्लम, and इनि aff.
12127: क्लव r. 1st cl. (क्लवते) To fear, to be afraid: वि is usually prefixed in this sense.
12128: क्लान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता न्तं) 1 Wearied. 2 Depressed in spirits or exhausted. E. क्लम to be weary, क्त aff.
12129: क्लान्तमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Low spirited, languid, melancholy. E. क्लान्त, and मनस् the mind.
12130: क्लान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Fatigue, weariness. E. क्लम to be weary, क्तिन् aff.
12131: क्लान्तिच्छिद् mfn. (-च्छित् or च्छिद्) Relieving fatigue, refreshing, invigorating. E. क्लान्ति, and च्छिद् what cuts.
12132: क्लान्तिच्छेद m. (-दः) Refreshing, restoring, removing fatigue. E. क्लान्ति, and च्छेद cutting.
12133: क्लिद (इ) क्लिदि r. 1st cl. (क्लिंदते-ति) To bewail, to lament, to weep. (ऊ, इर;) इर क्लिदू r. 4th cl. (क्लिद्युति) To be or become wet, damp, &c.
12134: क्लिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Wet, moistened. E. क्लिद to be or become wet, irr. participle.
12135: क्लिन्नवर्त्मन् m. (-त्मा) Excess of the lachrymal discharge, watering of the eyes. E. क्लिन्न, and वर्त्मन् the eyelid.
12136: क्लिन्नाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Blear-eyed. E. क्लिन्न wet, and अक्ष the eye.
12137: क्लिश (उ) क्लिशु r. 4th cl. (क्लिश्यते) 1 To suffer distress. 2 To inflict or cause distress; (ऊ,) क्लिशू r. 9th cl. (क्लिश्नाति) 1 To oppose. 2 To afflict, to distress.
12138: क्लिशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distrest, afflicted, wearied. E. क्लिश to be distrest, &c. affix क्त with इद inserted; also without इट् क्लिष्ट.
12139: क्लिशितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Suffering pain or distress. E. क्लिश, and क्तवतु aff.
12140: क्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Distrest, afflicted, &c. 2 Inconsistent, contradictory. E. क्लिश to be distrest, &c. affix क्त, deriv. irr.
12141: क्लिष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Calamity, distress. 2 Service. E. क्लिश to afflict, क्तिन् aff.
12142: क्लीतक n. (-कं) Liquorice, (Glycirrhiza glabra?) E. क्लीव to be weak, affix क्त, व being dropped; क्लीत weakness, कल to remove, and ल dropped by affixing ड.
12143: क्लीतकिका f. (-का) The indigo plant, (Indigofera Indica.) E. क्रीतक traffic, कन् pleonastic, the fem. form; र is changed to ल.
12144: क्लीब (ऋ) क्लीबृ r. 1st cl. (क्लीबते) 1 To be impotent. 2 To be timorous, to be modest or unassuming.
12145: क्लीव (ऋ) क्लीबृ r. 1st cl. (क्लीवते) 1 To be impotent. 2 To be timid or modest.
12146: क्लीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Weak, impotent. 2 Idle, slothful. mn. (-वः-वं) 1 The neuter gender. 2 A eunuch. E. क्लीव to be weak or timid, affix क; also read क्लीव.
12147: क्लेद n. (-दं) 1 Wetness, dampness, moisture, &c. 2 Running, discharge from a sore. E. क्लिद to be wet, affix घञ्.
12148: क्लेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Wetting, moistening, making wet or moist. m. (-कः) Phlegm in the stomach, excess of saliva. E. क्लिद to be wet, causal form, वुन् aff.
12149: क्लेदन् m. (-दा) The moon. E. क्लिद to be damp, कनिन् Uṇādi aff.
12150: क्लेदन n. (-नं) 1 Wetting, moistening. 2 Oozing, trickling. m. (-नः) Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor. E. क्लिद to be moist, ल्यट aff.
12151: क्लेदु m. (-दुः) 1 The moon. 2 Complication of disorders. E. क्लिद to be wet or damp, उण् Uṇādi aff.
12152: क्लेश r. 1st cl. (क्लेशते) 1 To speak articulately. 2 To distress. 3 To impede or obstruct. 4 To kill, to strike.
12153: क्लेश m. (-शः) 1 Pain, affliction or distress. 2 Pain from disease, anguish. 3 Worldly occupation, care, trouble. 4 Wrath, anger. E. क्लिश to suffer or inflict pain, affix घञ्.
12154: क्लेशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Giving pain, annoying, afflicting. E. क्लिश, and वुञ् aff.
12155: क्लेशप्रहाण n. (-णं) Termination of distress, especially of worldly cares, passions, &c. E. क्लेश, and प्रहाण destruction.
12156: क्लेशापह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Consolatory, consoling. 2 Palliative, allaying pain. m. (हः) A son. E. क्लेश, and अपह what removes.
12157: क्लेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pained, distressed, afflicted. E. क्लिश to suffer pain, क्त aff.
12158: क्लैतकिक n. (-कं) Wine, spirituous liquor. E. क्लीतक liquorice, ठक् affix; a fermented liquor being prepared from this root.
12159: क्लैव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Absence of virility, impotence. 2 The neuter gender. 2 Unmanliness, cowardice, &c. E. क्लीव, and ष्यञ् aff.
12160: क्लोमन् n. (-म) The bladder. E. क्लु to go, कनिन् affix; also with a final vowel; क्लोम n. (-मं)
12161: क्व ind. Where, in what place or degree.
12162: क्वङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) A sort of Panick: see कङ्गु.
12165: क्वण m. (-णः) 1 The sound or tone of any musical instrument. 2 Sound in general. E. क्वण to sound, अप् affix; also क्वाण.
12166: क्वणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) Sounding. E. क्वण, and शतृ aff.
12167: क्वणन n. (-नं) The sound of any musical instrument. m. (-नः) A small earthen pot or boiler. E. क्वण to sound, affix ल्युट्.
12168: क्वणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, twanged. E. क्वण to sound, क्त aff.
12169: क्वत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Of or belonging to where or what place. E. त्यप् added to क्व.
12170: क्वथ r. 1st cl. (ए,) क्वथे (क्वथति) To decoct, to boil, to prepare by heat, to digest.
12171: क्वथन n. (-नं) Boiling, decocting. E. क्वथ to boil, ल्युट् aff.
12172: क्वथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Boiled, decocted, stewed, digested. E. क्वथ to decoct, &c. affix क्त.
12173: क्वाण m. (-णः) The sound of musical instruments. E. क्वण to sound, affix घञ्: see क्वण.
12174: क्वाथ m. (-थः) 1 A decoction, any solution or infusion prepared with a continued and gentle heat. 2 Pain, sorrow. 3 Calamity, distress. 4 The mixture of the materials for a decoction. E. क्वथ to decoct, घञ् aff.
12175: क्वाथोद्भव n. (-वं) Blue vitriol used as a collyrium. E. क्वाथ, and उद्भव produced.
12176: क्वेल r. 1st cl. (ऊ) क्वेलू (क्वेलति) To shake or move.
12177: क्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A destruction of the world. 2 A demon, a goblin. 3 The third incarnation of VIṢṆU, the Narasiṃha Avatāra. 4 Lightning. 5 A field. 6 A peasant, a husbandman. 7 Loss, disappearance. E. क्षि or क्षै to waste, &c. affix क.
12178: क्षज (म, ष) r. 1st cl. (क्षजते) 1 To go or approach. 2 To give. (इ, ष, म) क्षजि r. 1st cl. (क्षञ्जते) 1 To go. 2 To give. r. 1st and  10th cls. (इ) क्षजि (क्षञ्जति क्षञ्जयति) To live in distress, to live in pain or want.
12179: क्षण (उ) क्षणु r. 8th cl. (क्षणति क्षणुते) To kill, to injure.
12180: क्षण m. (-णः) 1 A measure of time, equal to thirty Kalās or four minutes. 2 A moment. 3 A festival. 4 Vacation from work, state of being unemployed. 5 Leisure, opportunity. 6 A certain day of the fortnight, as the full, change, &c. see पर्वन्. 7 Dependence, servitude. 8 The centre, the middle. n. adv. (-णं) For a moment. E. क्षण to injure, affix अच्.
12181: क्षणक्षेप m. (-पः) A short delay. E. क्षण, and क्षेप throwing (away).
12182: क्षणतु m. (-तुः) A wound or sore. E. क्षण to hurt, अतु aff.
12183: क्षणद m. (-दः) An astrologer. n. (-दं) Water. f. (-दा) 1 Night. 2 Turmeric. E. क्षण leisure, a moment, &c. and द who gives.
12184: क्षणदाचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Nocturnal, nightwalker. mf. (-रः-री) A fiend, a goblin. E. क्षणदा night, and चर who or what goes.
12185: क्षणदान्ध्य n. (-न्ध्यं) Night blindness, nyctalopsis. E. क्षणदा, and आन्ध्य blindness.
12186: क्षणदृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Momentarily visible, seen for an instant. E. क्षण, and दृष्ट seen.
12187: क्षणद्युति f. (-तिः) Lightning. E. क्षंण, and द्युति light.
12188: क्षणन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. क्षण to hurt, to kill, affix ल्युट्.
12189: क्षणनिश्वास m. (-सः) A porpoise, the Gangetic porpoise. E. क्षण a moment, and निश्वास breath, breathing.
12190: क्षणप्रकाश f. (-शः) Lightning. E. क्षण, and प्रकाश manifest.
12191: क्षणप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gleaming, flashing. f. (-भा) Lightning. E. क्षण a moment, and प्रभा light.
12192: क्षणभङ्गुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Transient, frail, perishable. E. क्षण, and भङ्गुर breaking.
12193: क्षणभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Momentary, short-lived. E. क्षण, and भूत been.
12194: क्षणमात्र adv. n. (-त्रं) Momentary, but for a moment. E. क्षण, and मात्र only.
12195: क्षणरामिन् m. (-मी) A pigeon. E. क्षण a moment, and रम to play, affix णिनि.
12196: क्षणविध्वंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Transient, frail. E. क्षण, and विध्वंसिन् what is destroyed.
12197: क्षणान्तर adv. n. (-रं) A minute afterwards, the next moment. E. क्षण, and अन्तर interval.
12198: क्षणिक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Momentary, transient. f. (-का) Lightning. E. क्षण a moment, affix कन् or ठक्.
12199: क्षणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Momentary, transient. f. (-णी) Night. E. क्षण, इनि and ङीप् affs.
12200: क्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hit, hurt, wounded, &c. 2 Broken, torn, rent. 3 Trodden or broken down. 4 Impaired, diminished. 5 Destroyed. n. (-तं) A wound, a sore, a hurt. E. क्षण to hurt, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
12201: क्षतघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The name of a plant, (Conyza lacera.) f. (-घ्नी) Lac, the animal dye. E. क्षत a wound, and घ्न what destroys or removes; from हन to kill, affix टक्, fem. affix ङीप्.
12202: क्षतज n. (-जं) 1 Blood. 2 Pus, matter. E. क्षत a wound, and ज produced.
12203: क्षततेजस् mfn. (-जः-जाः-जं) Dimmed, obscured, (as light or power.) E. क्षत, and तेजस् splendour.
12204: क्षतविक्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mangled, wounded. E. क्षत, and विक्षत wounded.
12205: क्षतविध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A sort of potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus:) see ष्टद्धदार. E. क्षत a wound, &c. ध्वंसि to attack, with वि prefix, and णिनि aff.
12206: क्षतवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Destitution, being without the means of support, living on what one can get. E. क्षत, and वृत्ति maintenance.
12207: क्षतव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) A violator of a vow or religious engagement. E. क्षत broken, and व्रत a religious obligation.
12208: क्षतहर n. (-रं) Agallochum or aloe wood: see अगुरु. E. क्षत a wound, and हर what removes.
12209: क्षतारि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Victorious, triumphant. E. क्षत struck, and अरि a foe.
12210: क्षति f. (-तिः) A wound. E. क्षण to hurt, क्तिन् aff.
12211: क्षतौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Weakened, reduced, impaired. E. क्षत, and ओजस् strength.
12212: क्षत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ) Occupied, engaged in work. m. (-त्ता) 1 A charioteer, a coachman. 2 A doorkeeper, a porter. 3 The son of a Śūdra by a Kṣatriya woman, whose employment is catching animals that live in holes. 4 The son of a female slave. 5 A name of BRAHMĀ. 6 The son of a Śūdra man and Vaiśya woman. E. क्षद a Sautra root, to screen or defend, to join or mix, Uṇādi affix तृच्.
12213: क्षत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A man of the second or military and regal class. n. (-त्त्रं) The body. E. क्षद Sautra root, to divide or eat, Uṇādi affix त्र; this word and its derivatives are commonly, for the sake of convenience, written with one त, क्षत्र.
12214: क्षत्त्रधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duty of a Kṣatriya, bravery, military conduct. E. क्षत्त्र, and धर्म्म duty.
12215: क्षत्त्रधर्म्मानुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Following or observing the duty of a soldier. E. क्षत्त्रधर्म्म, and अनुग who follows.
12216: क्षत्त्रबन्धु mfn. (-न्धुः-न्धू or न्धुः-न्धु) 1 A mere Kṣatriya, a certain Kṣatriya. 2 A Kṣatriya, one of the military tribe: see ब्रह्मबन्धु.
12217: क्षत्त्रिन् m. (-त्त्री) A man of the military class. E. क्षत्र, and इनि aff.
12218: क्षत्त्रिय mf. (-यः-या or -याणी) A man or woman of the second or military tribe. f. (-यी) The wife of a Kṣatriya. E. क्षत्त्र, affix घ, fem. टाप् or ङीष्, in one form, with आनुक inserted.
12219: क्षत्त्रियजाति f. (-तिः) The military tribe or caste. E. क्षत्त्रिय, and जाति caste.
12220: क्षत्त्रियधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duty or occupation of the warrior tribe, war, government, &c. E. क्षत्त्रिय, and धर्म्म duty.
12221: क्षत्त्रियप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Full of or abounding with the military tribe. E. क्षत्रिय, and प्राय most.
12222: क्षद Sautra r. 1st cl. (क्षदति) 1 To eat. 2 To pull to pieces, to divide.
12223: क्षदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Eating. 2 Dividing, tearing. E. क्षद to eat, &c. v. शतृ aff.
12224: क्षदन n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Tearing, dividing. E. क्षद to eat, ल्युट् aff.
12225: क्षन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be endured, to be suffered or submitted to patiently. E. क्षम to bear, and तव्य aff.
12226: क्षन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Patient, resigned. E. क्षम to bear, to be patient, तृच् aff.
12227: क्षप r. 10th cl. (क्षपयति) 1 To send, to throw, to cast, to direct, &c. 2 To bear patiently. (इ) क्षपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (क्षम्पति क्षम्पयति) 1 To bear patiently, to endure. 3 To compassionate. 3 To shine.
12228: क्षपण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Shameless, impudent. n. (-णं) Defilement, impurity. E. क्षप to throw away (shame,) affix ल्युट्.
12229: क्षपणक m. (-कः) 1 A Buddha. 2 A Bauddha mendicant. 3 A Jaina mendicant. E. कन् added to the preceding.
12230: क्षपणी f. (-णी) 1 An oar. 2 A net: see क्षेपणि.
12231: क्षपण्यु m. (-ण्युः) Offence, transgression. E. क्षप to bear, अण्यु aff.
12232: क्षपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Bearing patiently, enduring. 2 Casting, sending. E. क्षप to send, शतृ aff.
12233: क्षपा f. (-पा) Night. E. क्षप to send or reject, अ affix, and टाप् fem. do.
12234: क्षपाकर m. (-रः) The moon. E. क्षपा night, and कर who makes.
12235: क्षपाघन m. (-नः) A dark cloud or clouds of night. E. क्षपा, and घन a cloud.
12236: क्षपाचर m. (-रः) A fiend, a goblin. E. क्षपा, and चर who goes.
12237: क्षपाट m. (-टः) A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin. E. क्षपा night, and अट who goes.
12238: क्षपानाथ m. (-थः) The moon. E. क्षपा, and नाथ lord.
12239: क्षपान्त m. (-न्तः) Dawn, day-break. E. क्षपा, and अन्त end.
12240: क्षपाह n. (-हं) A day and night. E. क्षपा, and अहन् a day.
12241: क्षपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Submitted to, borne, endured. 2 Sent, cast, directed. E. क्षप, and क्त aff.
12242: क्षम (उ, ष, ञि) ञिक्षमुष r. 1st cl. (क्षमते) To bear or endure. (उ, इर, भ) इरक्षमुभ r. 4th cl. (क्षम्यति) To bear or endure.
12243: क्षम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Patient, resigned, enduring. 2 Refraining from, forbearing. 2 Able, adequate. 4 Benevolent, friendly. 5 Fit, appropriate, suitable, proper. f. (-मा) 1 Patience. 2 The earth. 3 Night. 4 A name of DURGĀ. n. (-मं) Propriety, fitness. E. क्षम as above, affix अच्.
12244: क्षमान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Patient, enduring. 2 Forgiving. E. क्षमा, and अन्वित possessed of.
12245: क्षमापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Patient, forbearing. E. क्षमा, पर practising.
12246: क्षमाभुज् mfn. (-क्) Patient. m. (-क) A king, a prince. E. क्षमा, the earth, &c. and भुज् who possesses.
12247: क्षमायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Patient, enduring. E. क्षमा, and युक्त joined with.
12248: क्षमावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Patient, enduring. E. क्षमा, and मतुप् aff.
12249: क्षमितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Patient, enduring. E. क्षम to bear, affix तृच्.
12250: क्षमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Patient. 2 Capable, able. E. क्षम to bear, घिनुण् aff.
12251: क्षय m. (-यः) 1 Loss, waste, destruction, removal, &c. 2 A destruction of the universe. 3 Consumption, Phthisis pulmonalis. 4 A house, an abode. 5 Sickness in general. 6 Decay, wasting away. 7 In algebra, negative quantity, minus. E. क्षि to waste or destroy, affix अच्.
12252: क्षयकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Destroying, terminating. 2 Liberating from existence. E. क्षय, and कर who makes.
12253: क्षयकाल m. (-लः) The end of all things, the period of destruction. E. क्षय, and काल time.
12254: क्षयकास m. (-सः) A consumptive or phthisical cough. E. क्षय, and कास cough.
12255: क्षयथु m. (-थुः) Cough, consumption. E. क्षि to waste, अथुच् affix; some copies read this क्षवथु, q. v.
12256: क्षयनाशिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Celtis Orientalis:) see जीवन्ती. E. क्षय consumption, and नाशिनी what removes.
12257: क्षयपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The dark fortnight, that of the moon's wane. E. क्षय, and पक्ष half month.
12258: क्षयवायु m. (-युः) The wind that is to blow at the end of the world. E. क्षय, and वायु wind.
12259: क्षययुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Necessity or opportunity of destroying. E. क्षय, and युक्ति fitness; also क्षययोग.
12260: क्षयरोग m. (-गः) Consumption. E. क्षय, and रोग disease.
12261: क्षयरोगित्व n. (-त्वं) Consumption. E. क्षयरोगिन्, and त्व affix; also with तल् क्षयरोगिता.
12262: क्षयरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Consumptive, hectic. E. क्षय, and रोगिन् diseased.
12263: क्षयसम्पद् f. (-त् or -द्) Total loss, ruin, destruction. E. क्षय, and सम्पद् increase.
12264: क्षयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Wasting, decaying. 2 Consumptive. E. क्षय, and इनि aff.
12265: क्षयिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Wasting, decaying, perishing. E. क्षि to perish, इष्णुच् aff.
12266: क्षर r. 1st cl. (क्षरति) 1 To drop or let fall. 2 To distil, to ooze, to trickle. With सं, To flow. With आ, r. of the 10th cl. (आक्षारयति) To accuse, to abuse.
12267: क्षर m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 Trickling, oozing. n. (-रं) Water. E. क्षर to drop, and अच् aff.
12268: क्षरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by distillation, &c. E. क्षर, and ज born; also क्षरेज.
12269: क्षरण n. (-णं) 1 Trickling, running. 2 Distilling, dropping. E. क्षर, and ल्युट् aff.
12270: क्षरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Trickling, oozing, running. E. क्षर to trickle, शतृ aff.
12272: क्षरभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Mutable, dissoluble. E. क्षर flowing, भाव property.
12273: क्षरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Oozed, trickling, dropped, flowing, liquefied. E. क्षर, and क्त aff.
12274: क्षरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Dropping, flowing, trickling. m. (-री) The rainy season. E. क्षर water, and इनि aff.
12275: क्षरेज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by distilling, &c. E. क्षर in the seventh case, and ज born.
12276: क्षल r. 1st cl. (क्षलति) 1 To shake. 2 To move, (some consider this as interchangeable with क्षर.) r. 10th cl. (क्षलयति) To purify, to cleanse or make clean.
12277: क्षव m. (-वः) 1 Sneezing. 2 Cough, catarrh. 3 A species of Mustard, (Sinapis dichotoma, Rox.) E. क्षु to sneeze, affix अप्.
12278: क्षवकृत् mfn. (-त्) Sneezing, coughing. E. क्षव, and कृत who makes.
12279: क्षविका f. (-का) 1 A kind of rice. 2 A woman.
12280: क्षवथु m. (-थुः) 1 Cough, catarrh. 2 Sneezing. 3 Irritation of the throat, sore throat. E. क्षु to sneeze, &c. अथुच् aff.
12281: क्षात्त्र mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्री-त्त्रं) Belonging or relating to the military tribe. E. क्षत्र, and अण् aff.
12282: क्षान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Patient, enduring. E. क्षम to bear, affix क्त.
12283: क्षान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Patience, forbearance, endurance. E. क्षम to be patient, affix क्तिन्.
12284: क्षान्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) Patient, enduring. E. क्षम to bear, Uṇādi affix तुन्; the vowel is made long.
12285: क्षाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Slender, slim, emaciated. 2 Weak, infirm. E. क्षै to waste, affix क्त, form irr.
12286: क्षामता f. (-ता) 1 Slenderness. 2 Thinness, emaciation. 3 Debility. E. क्षाम, and तल् affix: also with त्व, क्षामत्व.
12287: क्षामास्य n. (-स्यं) Improper regimen, diet, &c. Contra-indicated in disease. E. क्षाम debilitating, and आस्य to be eaten.
12288: क्षार m. (-रः) 1 Glass. 2 Juice, essence. 3 Molasses, treacle. 4 Salt. 5 Ashes. 6 A rogue, a cheat. 7 Borax, borate of soda. 8 Alkali, either soda or potash. 9 Caustic alkali, one species of cautery. n. (-रं) A factitious or medicinal salt, commonly black salt: see कृष्णलवण. E. क्षर to drop, or distil, affix अण्.
12289: क्षारक m. (-कः) 1 A blossom, a new blown flower. 2 A cage or basket for birds or fish. 3 A washerman. 4 Juice, essence. E. क्षर to fall or drop, affix ण्वुल्.
12290: क्षारकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Applying caustic alkali (lapis infernalis) to proud flesh, &c. E. क्षार, and कर्म्मन् act.
12291: क्षारण nf. (-णं-णः) Accusing, calumniating. n. (-णं) 1 Distilling. 2 Converting to alkali or ashes. E. क्षार to drop, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
12293: क्षारद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, commonly Ghantaparali: see घण्टापाटलि; also क्षारवृक्ष.
12294: क्षारपत्र n. (-त्रं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. क्षार juice, and पत्र a leaf; also क्षारपत्रक.
12295: क्षारमध्य m. (-ध्यः) A shrub, (Achyranthes aspera;) also अपामार्ग. E. क्षार alkali, and मध्य middle; its alkaline ashes make it useful in washing clothes.
12296: क्षारमृत्तिका f. (-का) Saline soil, especially an impure sulphate of soda. E. क्षार, salt, and मृत्तिका earth.
12297: क्षाररस m. (-सः) A salt or alkaline flavour. E. क्षार, and रस flavour.
12298: क्षारवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Any tree yielding abundant potash, as the plantain, &c. E. क्षार, and वृक्ष a tree.
12299: क्षारषट्क n. (-ट्कं) Six kinds of trees distinguished by their juice, as the Butea frondosa, Grislea tomentosa, Achyranthes aspera, Cowach, Ghaṇṭāpārali, Coraya. E. क्षार, and षट्क six.
12300: क्षाराच्छ n. (-च्छं) Sea-salt. E. क्षार salt, and अच्छ clear, pure.
12302: क्षारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Guilty. 2 Calumniated, falsely accused, specially of adultery. 3 Accused of crime. 4 Distilled from saline matter, strained through alkaline ashes, &c. E. क्षर to go or fall, in the causal form, affix क्त.
12303: क्षालन n. (-नं) Washing, sprinkling, cleaning with water. E. क्षाल to wash, affix ल्युट्.
12304: क्षालनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be washed, to be cleaned with water. E. क्षल, and अनीयर् affix; also with तव्य and यत्, क्षालितव्य and क्षाल्य.
12305: क्षालयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Washing, sprinkling. E. क्षल् to wash, शतृ aff.
12306: क्षालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cleared, cleaned, washed. E. क्षाल to cleanse, affix क्त.
12307: क्षि r. 1st cl. (क्षयति-ते) 1 To wane or decrease. 2 To diminish, to disappear, to waste, to perish. 3 To rule or possess with unlimited power. r. 5th cl. (क्षिणोति) To hurt or injure, to wound or kill. r. 6th cl. (क्षियति) 1 To dwell. 2 To go or approach. (ष) क्षिष r. 9th cl. (क्षिणाति) To injure or kill.
12308: क्षि f. (-क्षिः) Residence, abode. 2 Going, moving. 3 Waste, loss, destruction. E. क्षि to decrease, &c. कि aff.
12309: क्षिण (उ) क्षिणु r. 8th cl. (क्षिणोति or क्षिणुते or क्षेणोति-णते) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
12310: क्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wasted, decayed. 2 Poor, miserable. E. क्षि to waste, affix क्त; also क्षिण.
12311: क्षिति f. (-तिः) 1 The earth. 2 An abode, a dwelling, a house. 3 Loss, destruction, wane. 4 The period of the destruction of the universe. 5 A perfume, commonly called Rocana. E. क्षि to waste, to dwell, &c. क्तिन् aff.
12312: क्षितिकण mf. (-णः-णा) Dust. E. क्षिति the earth, and कण a particle.
12313: क्षितिक्षम m. (-मः) A tree, (Mimosa khayar.) E. क्षिति, and क्षम able.
12314: क्षितिक्षित् m. (-त्) A king, a prince. E. क्षिति, and क्षि to dwell, affix क्विप्.
12315: क्षितिखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A clod or lump of earth. E. क्षिति, and खण्ड earth.
12316: क्षितिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Earth-born, produced of or in the earth. m. (-जः) 1 Mars. 2 The demon NARAKA. 3 An earth-worm. f. (-जा) SĪTĀ. E. क्षिति, and ज born.
12317: क्षितिजन्तु m. (-न्तुः) An earth-worm. E. क्षिति, and जन्तु animal.
12318: क्षितितल n. (-लं) 1 The region below the earth. 2 The surface of the earth. E. क्षिति, and तल beneath.
12319: क्षितिधर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. क्षिति the earth, and धर what holds.
12320: क्षितिधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Carrying soil or earth. E. क्षिति, and धारिन् bearing.
12321: क्षितिनाग m. (-गः) An earth-worm. E. क्षिति, and नाग a serpent.
12322: क्षितिप m. (-पः) A king. E. क्षिति, and प who protects; also क्षितिपाल.
12323: क्षितिपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign. E. क्षिति, and पति lord.
12324: क्षितिपाल m. (-लः) A king, a prince. E. क्षिति, and पाल who protects.
12325: क्षितिपीठ n. (-ठं) The surface of the earth. E. क्षिति, and पीठ a stool.
12326: क्षितिप्रतिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Dwelling on the earth. E. क्षिति, and प्रतिष्ठ established.
12327: क्षितिभृत् m. (-भृत्) A prince, a king. E. क्षिति, and भृत् who nourishes.
12328: क्षितिमण्डल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe. E. क्षिति, and मण्डल circle.
12329: क्षितिरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. क्षिति the earth, and रुह what mounts.
12330: क्षितिवर्द्धन m. (-नः) A corpse. E. क्षिति the earth, and वर्द्धन what increases.
12331: क्षितिसुत m. (-तः) 1 A name of the demon NARAKA, also of 2 Mars. E. क्षिति, and सुत a son.
12332: क्षितीश m. (-शः) A king. E. क्षिति, and ईश a prince.
12333: क्षितीश्वर m. (-रः) A king. E. क्षिति, and ईश्वर a king.
12334: क्षित्यदिति f. (-तिः) The mother of KṚṢṆA. E. क्षिति the earth, and अदिति the mother of the gods; the terrestrial parent of divinity.
12335: क्षित्वन् m. (-त्वा) Air, wind. E. क्षि to go, Uṇādi affix, क्वनिप्, त inserted.
12336: क्षिद r. 1st cl. (क्षेदति) To utter an inarticulate sound, to moan as in grief.
12337: क्षिप (औ) औक्षिप r. 4th cl. (क्षिप्यति) (ञ, आ) औक्षिपञ्. r. 6th cl. (क्षिपति-ते) To throw or cast, to direct or send. With अधि prefixed, To abuse, to censure or reproach. With अव, To throw down. With आङ्. 1 To attract. 2 To ridicule. With उत्, To raise up, &c. With नि, To place, to deposit. With प्र, To throw far or violently. With वि, To scatter, to disperse. With वि and नि, To deliver over, to resign, to leave. With सम and आङ्, To remove, to send away. With सम्. 1 To abridge, to compress or contract. 2 To disappear.
12338: क्षिप m. (-पः) 1 Throwing, casting. 2 Reviling. 3 One who throws, &c. f. (-पा) 1 Sending, casting, throwing, &c. 2 Night. see क्षपा. E. क्षिप to throw, affix क.
12339: क्षिपक m. (-कः) A warrior, a fighter. E. क्षिप throwing or directing, (darts, &c.) क Uṇādi aff.
12340: क्षिपण n. (-णं) 1 Sending, dismissing, throwing, casting, &c. 2 Reviling, abusing. E. क्षिप to throw, &c. affix ल्युट्, the radical vowel unchanged.
12341: क्षिपणि m. (-णिः) A missile weapon. f. (-णिः-णी) An oar. E. क्षिप to throw or cast, Uṇādi affix अणि, and the radical vowel unchanged.
12342: क्षिपणु m. (-णुः) Air, wind. E. क्षिप to throw or send, to waft, Uṇādi affix अनु.
12343: क्षिपण्यु mfn. (-ण्युः-ण्युः-ण्यु) 1 Fragrant, sweet-smelling. 2 Diffusive, what may be sent or scattered. m. (-ण्युः) 1 The body. 2 Spring, the season of spring. E. क्षिप to send, &c. कन्युच् Uṇādi affix.
12344: क्षिपत् mfn. (-पत्-पन्ती-पत्) 1 Throwing, casting. 2 A busing, reproaching. E. क्षिप to throw, affix शतृ.
12345: क्षिप्नु mfn. (-प्नुः-प्नुः-प्नु) Obstructive, throwing obstacles in the way; also क्षिप्णु. E. क्षिप to cast, &c. क्नु aff.
12346: क्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Thrown, cast. 2 Sent, despatched. 3 Dismissed. f. (-प्ता) Night; also क्षिपा and क्षपा. E. क्षिप to throw, &c. affix क्त.
12347: क्षिप्तदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Prostrate, lying down. E. क्षिप्त, and देह the body.
12348: क्षिप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Throwing. 2 Sending, ordering. 3 Solving a riddle, explaining or understanding a hidden meaning. E. क्षिप to throw, क्तिन् aff.
12349: क्षिप्यत् mfn. (-प्यन्-पन्ती-प्यत्) 1 Throwing. 2 Sending. E. क्षिप 4th cl. to send, शतृ aff.
12350: क्षिप्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Tossing, throwing. 2 Casting aside, throwing off. 3 Sending, directing. E. क्षिप, and शानच् aff.
12351: क्षिप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) Quickly, speedily, quick, swift. adv. n. (-प्रं) Quickly. E. क्षिप्त to send or despatch, Uṇādi affix रक्.
12352: क्षिप्रपाकिन् m. (-की) A kind of tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्धभाण्ड. E. क्षिप्र quick, and पाकिन् what ripens.
12353: क्षिया f. (-या) Loss, waste, destruction. E. क्षि to waste, अङ्, and टाप् affixes, इ substituted for the penultimate.
12354: क्षिव (उ) क्षिवु r. 4th cl. (क्षीव्यति) To eject from the mouth, to vomit.
12355: क्षी r. 1st cl. (क्षयति-ते) To hurt or injure.
12356: क्षीज r. 1st cl. (क्षीजति) To sound inarticulately, to sigh or groan as in distress.
12357: क्षीजन n. (-नं) The whistling of hollow reeds or bamboos. E. क्षीज to sound inarticulately, affix ल्युट्.
12358: क्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Thin, emaciated, feeble. 2 Thin, slender. 3 Wasted, diminished, worn away, expended. 4 Destroyed. lost. 5 Injured, broken, torn. 6 Subdued, suppressed. 7 Poor, miserable. E. क्षि to waste, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
12359: क्षीणता f. (-ता) 1 Slenderness, delicacy. 2 Thinness, emaciation. 3 Diminution, decay. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीणत्वं.
12360: क्षीणपाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Purified, having suffered the consequences of sin. E. क्षीण, and पाप sin.
12361: क्षीणपुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 1 Abandoned. 2 Having enjoyed the fruits of virtue, and being doomed by another birth to labour for more. E. क्षीण, and पुण्य virtue.
12362: क्षीणमध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Slender-waisted. E. क्षीण, and मध्य middle.
12363: क्षीणवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wasted, decayed. E. क्षि to waste, and क्ततवतु aff.
12364: क्षीणवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Inhabiting a destructible house. m. (-सी) A dove or pigeon. E. क्षीण, and वासिन् abiding.
12365: क्षीणविक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Cowed, deprived of courage or prowess. E. क्षीण, and विक्रान्त valiant.
12366: क्षीणवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Out of employ, out of bread, having no maintenance. E. क्षीण lost, and वृत्तिं practice.
12367: क्षीणशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Weak, feeble, impotent. E. क्षीण, and शक्ति vigour.
12369: क्षीणाष्टकर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A Jina, an inspired teacher according to the Jainas. E. क्षीण, and अष्टकर्म्मन् eight natural acts.
12370: क्षीब (ऋ) क्षीवृ r. 1st cl. (क्षीबते) To be intoxicated, (literally or metaphorically.)
12371: क्षीब mfn. (-बः-बा-बं) Drunk, intoxicated. E. क्षीब to be drunk, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
12372: क्षीबता f. (-ता) Intoxication. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीवत्वं.
12373: क्षीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Perishing, wasting away. E. क्षि to perish, शानच् aff.
12374: क्षीर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Milk. f. (-री) A small shrub (Asclepia rosea;) also दुग्धिका. 2 A tree, a species of Mimosa, (M. kauki, Rox.) also क्षीरिका. 3 Gigantic swallow-wort. 4 Euphorbia; several kinds, particularly, E. hirta. E. thymifolia, and E. chamæsyce. E. घस to eat, ईरन् Uṇādi affix; the fem. nouns are derived from क्षीर milk, the plants yielding a milky juice or sap, upon expression or incision.
12375: क्षीरकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) An infant, a young child. E. क्षीर milk, and कण्ठ throat; also with कन् added क्षीरकण्ठक.
12376: क्षीरकन्दा f. (-न्दा) A kind of potherb, black Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. क्षीर water, and कन्द root: having a watery root.
12377: क्षीरकाकोलिका f. (-का) A drug, and one of the eight principal medicaments of the Hindus; it is a root from the Himālaya. E. क्षीर milk, and काकोली a drug, कन् added; yielding, when fresh, a milky juice; also क्षीरकाकोली.
12379: क्षीरकीट m. (-टः) An insect or animalcule generated by the fermentation of milk. E. क्षीर milk, and कीट a worm.
12380: क्षीरज n. (-जं) Coagulated or curdled milk. E. क्षीर milk, and ज produced.
12381: क्षीरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) What gives or yields milk. E. क्षीर, and द what gives.
12382: क्षीरदल m. (-लः) Gigantic swallow-wort. E. क्षीर milk, and दल leaf; the leaves, &c. yielding, on expression or incision, a milky juice.
12383: क्षीरनीर n. (-रं) Embracing, embrace. E. क्षीर, milk, and नीर water; mixing like milk and water.
12384: क्षीरप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Drinking milk, who or what drinks it. E. क्षीर, and प who drinks.
12386: क्षीरपाण n. (-णं) Drinking milk; also क्षीरपान. m. plu. (-णाः) The name of a people, the milk-drinkers. E. क्षीर, and पान drink; in the second sense, न is changed always to ण.
12387: क्षीरपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Drinking milk, sucking, &c. 2 Drinking or imbibing water repeatedly. E. क्षीर, and पायिन् who drinks.
12388: क्षीरपायिण् m. plu. (-यिणः) The people called Usinaras, the milk-drinkers. E. क्षीर, पा to drink, णिनि affix, य inserted, and न final changed to ण.
12390: क्षीरमोरट m. (-टः) A plant, a kind of Murva: see मूर्व्वा.
12391: क्षीरयष्टिक n. (-कं) A dish of liquorice and milk. E. क्षीर, and यष्टिक made of liquorice.
12392: क्षीरवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The dark Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. क्षीर water, and वल्ली pedicle: see क्षीरकन्दा.
12393: क्षीरविकृति f. (-तिः) Inspissated milk. E. क्षीर milk, and विकृति change of form.
12394: क्षीरविदारिका f. (-का) The dark Bhuincaönra; also क्षीरविदारी.
12395: क्षीरविदारी f. (-री) The white or black Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus): see भूमिकुष्माण्डक. E. क्षीर water, and विदारी the same plant.
12396: क्षीरवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata:) also उडुम्बर. E. क्षीर milk, and वृक्ष a tree, the leaves and bark yielding a white milky juice.
12397: क्षीरशर m. (-रः) Cream, the surface or skim of milk. E. क्षीर milk, and शर what goes over or on.
12398: क्षीरशुक्ल m. (-क्लः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa, Rox.) f. (-क्ला) The pale Bhuincaönra: see भूमिकुष्माण्डक. E. क्षीर milk, and शुक्त white; as milk, the fruit, &c.
12399: क्षीरसार m. (-रः) Butter. E. क्षीर, and सार essence.
12400: क्षीरस्फटिक m. (-कः) A precious stone, described as a milky crystal, (opal or cat's eye?) E. क्षीर milk, and स्फटिक crystal.
12401: क्षीराद m. (-दः) An infant at the breast. E. क्षीर, and अद who feeds.
12402: क्षीराब्धि m. (-ब्धिः) The sea of milk, one of the seven seas surrounding as many worlds. E. क्षीर milk, and अब्धि the ocean.
12403: क्षीराब्धिज m. (-जः) The moon. f. (-जा) A name of the goddess LAKṢMĪ. n. (-जं) 1 Sea salt. 2 A pearl. E. क्षीरब्धि the sea of milk, and ज born.
12404: क्षीराब्धितनया f. (-या) A name of LAKṢMĪ. E. क्षीराब्धि the sea of milk, and तनया daughter.
12405: क्षीरान्नाद m. (-दः) An infant both fed and suckled. E. क्षीर, and अन्न food, अद who eats.
12406: क्षीराविका f. (-का) A sort of Asclepias: see the next.
12407: क्षीरावी f. (-वी) A sort of Asclepias, (A. rosea, Rox;) also दुग्धिका. E. क्षीर milk or milky juice, अव to contain, affixes अण् and ङीप्.
12408: क्षीराह्व m. (-ह्वः) The Saral, a kind of pine. E. क्षीर milk, and आह्व what is named; or it may mean that the tree is also named simply क्षीर, that which yields a milky juice or sap.
12409: क्षीरिका f. (-का) 1 A tree bearing an edible fruit, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.) 2 A potherb, Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. क्षीर milk, affix ठक्.
12410: क्षीरिणी f. (-णी) 1 A milch-cow. 2 A tree bearing an edible fruit, (Mimusops kauki.) 3 A medicinal kind of the moon plant or acid Asclepias. E. क्षीर milk, and इनि affix, alluding to its juice, fem. affix ङीप्.
12411: क्षीरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Milky, yielding milk. 2 Having milk. m. (-री) A sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका. E. क्षीर milk, and इनि aff.
12412: क्षीरेयी f. (-यी) An oblation of milk, rice, and sugar.
12413: क्षीरोद m. (-दः) The sea of milk. E. क्षीर milk, and उद water; it also implies the sea in general.
12414: क्षीरोदतनया f. (-या) A name of LAKṢMĪ. E. क्षीरोद the sea of milk, and तनया daughter.
12415: क्षीरोदनन्दन m. (-नः) The moon. E. क्षीरोद the ocean in general, and नन्दन a son.
12416: क्षीव (उ) क्षीवु r. 1st cl. (क्षीवति) 1 To spit or sputter, to eject from the mouth. 2 To be drunk: see क्षिव, also क्षीब.
12417: क्षीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Drunk, intoxicated. E. क्षीव, and क्त affix; also क्षीब.
12418: क्षीवता f. (-ता) Drunkenness, intoxication. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीवत्वं; also क्षीवता, &c.
12419: क्षु (टु) टुक्षु r. 2d cl. (क्षौति) To sneeze, to make any such sound.
12420: क्षुण m. (-णः) The soap berry plant, (Sapindus saponaria.) E. क्षुद to bruise, डुण aff.
12421: क्षुण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 1 Bruised, pounded. 2 Exercised, practised, skilful. 3 One versed in sacred science, but described as unable to explain or teach it. 4 Defeated, overcome. E. क्षुद to bruise, &c. affix क्त, form irr.
12422: क्षुत् f. (-क्षुत्) 1 Sneezing; also क्षुत. E. क्ष to sneeze, affix क्विप्, तुक् is added.
12423: क्षुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sneezed, sneezing. mf. (-तः-ता) 1 Sneezing. 2 Cough. E. क्षु to sneeze, affix क्त.
12424: क्षुतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sneezing. E. क्षु to sneeze, क्तवतु aff.
12425: क्षुताभिजनन m. (-नः) Black mustard. E. क्षुत sneezing, and अभिजनन what produces; also क्षुधाभिजनन.
12426: क्षुत्करी f. (-री) Black mustard. E. क्षुत् sneezing, करी making.
12427: क्षुत्तृष्णोपपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungry and thirsty. E. क्षुध् with तृष्णा thirst, and उपपीडित distressed.
12428: क्षुत्पिपासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungry and thirsty. E. क्षुध्, and पिपासा thirst, इतच् aff.
12429: क्षुत्प्रतीकार m. (-रः) Allaying hunger, eating. E. क्षुध्, and प्रतीकार counteracting.
12430: क्षुद (ञ, इर, औ) औ क्षुदिर r. 7th cl. (क्षुणत्ति क्षुत्ते) To pound, to bruise, to reduce to powder.
12431: क्षुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Small, little. 2 Mean, low. 3 Mean, niggardly, avaricious. 4 Cruel. 5 Poor, indigent. f. (-द्रा) 1 A woman maimed or crippled, wanting a limb, &c. 2 A dancing girl. 2 A whore, a harlot. 4 A fly. 5 A bee or wasp. 6 A gnat, &c. 7 A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी. 8 The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) 9 Sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.) E. क्षुद to bruise or pound, Uṇādi affix रक्.
12432: क्षुद्रकम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A small shell. E. क्षुद्र small, and कम्बु a shell.
12433: क्षुद्रघण्टिका f. (-का) A tinkling ornament, a girdle of small bells, &c. E. क्षुद्र small, घण्टा a clock or bell, affix कन्, and the fem. form.
12434: क्षुद्रचूड m. (-डः) A kind of small bird. E. क्षुद्र small, and चूडा a crest, small crested.
12435: क्षुद्रजन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 1 Any small animal. 2 A kind of worm, (Julus.) E. क्षुद्र small, and जन्तु animal.
12436: क्षुद्रजीर m. (-रः) Small cummin. E. क्षुद्र small, and जीर cummin seed.
12437: क्षुद्रता f. (-ता) 1 Smallness, minuteness. 2 Inferiority, insignificance, meanness. E. तल् added to क्षुद्र; also with त्व, क्षुद्रत्वं.
12438: क्षुद्रदंशिका f. (-का) A small gadfly. E. क्षुद्र, and दंशिका a gadfly.
12439: क्षुद्रदंशी f. (-शी) A small gadfly. E. क्षुद्र, and दंशी a gadfly.
12440: क्षुद्रनासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having a little nose. E. क्षुद्र, and नासिका the nose.
12441: क्षुद्रपत्रा f. (-त्रा) Wood-sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.) E. क्षुद्र, and पत्र a leaf, small-leaved.
12442: क्षुद्रफलक m. (-कः) A tree, (Celtis orientalis:) see जीवन. E. क्षुद्र, and फल fruit, कन् added, bearing a small fruit.
12443: क्षुद्रफला f. (-ला) A plant, (Ardisia solanacea.) E. क्षुद्र, and फल fruit.
12444: क्षुद्रबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Simple, silly, ignorant, E. क्षुद्र, and वुद्धि understanding.
12445: क्षुद्ररोग m. (-गः) A minor disease, one of little importance. E. क्षुद्र, and रोग disease.
12446: क्षुद्रवंशा f. (-शा) A plant, (Dioscorea:) see वराहक्रात्त्वा.
12447: क्षुद्रशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A small shell. E. क्षुद्र, and शङ्ख a shell.
12448: क्षुद्रशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) A tree, (Celosia cristata.) E. क्षुद्र, and शीर्ष the head, having a small head.
12449: क्षुद्रसहा f. (-हा) A plant, commonly Mugāi: see मुद्गपर्णी.
12450: क्षुद्रहिङ्गुलिका f. (-का) A prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) a small species. E. क्षुद्र small, and हिङ्गुली the plant.
12452: क्षुद्राण्डमत्स्यसङ्घात m. (-तः) Small fry. E. क्षुद्र small, अण्ड an egg, मत्स्य a fish, and सङ्घात a heap.
12453: क्षुद्राम्लपनस m. (-सः) A tree, (Artocarpus lacucha:) see लकुच.
12454: क्षुद्राम्ला f. (-म्ला) Wood-sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.) E. क्षुद्र, and अम्ल sour; a small and acid plant.
12455: क्षुध (ऋ औ) औक्षुधृ r. 4th cl. (क्षुध्यति) To be hungry, to hunger.
12456: क्षुध् f. (-क्षुत् or -क्षुद्) Hunger. E. क्षुध to be hungry, affix क्विप्.
12457: क्षुधा f. (-धा) Hunger. E. क्षुध to be hungry, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
12458: क्षुधाकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Causing hunger, improving the appetite. E. क्षुधा, and कर what makes.
12459: क्षुधाध्वंस m. (-सः) Allaying hunger. E. क्षुधा, and ध्वंस destruction.
12460: क्षुधापीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungry, starving. E. क्षुधा, and पीडित pained.
12461: क्षुधाभिजनन m. (-नः) Black mustard. E. क्षुधा hunger, and अभिजनन causing, promoting.
12462: क्षुधार्त्त m. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Hungry, hungered. E. क्षुधा, and आर्त्त pained.
12463: क्षुधाशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Satisfaction, satiety, allaying hunger. E. क्षुधा, and शान्ति appeasing.
12464: क्षुधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungered, hungry. E. क्षुध to be hungry, affix क्त.
12465: क्षुधुन m. (-नः) A savage, a barbarian. E. क्षुध to be hungry, Uṇādi affix उनन्.
12466: क्षुप m. (-पः) A small tree, one with short branches and roots, a bush, a shrub. E. क्षु to sound, aff. प.
12467: क्षुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्ध) 1 Agitated, tossed, stirred. 2 Agitated mentally, anxious, disturbed. m. (-ब्धः) The churning stick. E. क्षुभ to stir, to agitate, affix क्त, form irr.
12468: क्षुभ r. 1st cl. (क्षोभति) 1 To be confused or agitated. 2 To stir or disturb. r. 4th cl. and 9th cl. (क्षुभ्यति and क्षुभ्नाति) To shake, to tremble, to be unsteady.
12469: क्षुभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Frightened, alarmed, afraid. 2 Agitated, tossed, set in motion. 3 Agitated mentally, disturbed, anxious. 4 Angry, enraged. E. क्षुभ to shake, to be agitated, to stir, &c. affix क्त.
12470: क्षुमा f. (-मा) 1 Linseed, (Linum usitatissimum.) 2 A sort of flax, Bengal San. 3 The indigo plant. 4 A sort of creeper. E. क्षु to sound, affix मक्.
12471: क्षुर r. 6th cl. (क्षुरति) 1 To cut. 2 To scratch, to make lines or furrows.
12472: क्षुर m. (-रः) 1 A razor. 2 A plant, (Barleria longifolia.) 3 Also Tribulus lanuginosus: see गोक्षुर. 4 A horse's hoof; also खुर. 5 The hoof of a cow, &c. 6 The foot of a bedstead. f. (-री) A knife. E. क्षुर to scratch or cut, Uṇādi affix रन्, and the final consonant rejected; also खुर.
12473: क्षुरक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, commonly Tila. 2 Barleria longifolia. 3 Tribulus lanuginosus. E. क्षुर to scratch, &c. क्वुन् aff.
12474: क्षुरप्र m. (-प्रः) 1 A kind of arrow, one with a horse shoe head. 2 A sort of hoe or weeding spade. E. क्षुर a hoof, and प्रथ to go, ड affix; also खुरप्र.
12475: क्षुरभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A razor case. E. क्षुर, and भाण्ड a vessel.
12476: क्षुरमर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A barber. E. क्षुर a razor, and मृद to destroy, affix णिनि.
12477: क्षुरिणी f. (-णी) A kind of yam: see वराहक्रान्ता.
12478: क्षुरिन् mf. (-री-रिणी) A male or female barber. E. क्षुर a razor, and इनि aff.
12479: क्षुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Little, small. E. क्षुद to pound, affix क्विप्, क्षुद powder, dust, ल from ला to get, to be, affix ड; also खुल्ल.
12480: क्षुल्लक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Little, small. 2 Hard. 3 Poor, indigent. 4 Low, vile. 5 Wicked, malicious, abandoned. 6 Young.  youngest. 7 Pained, distressed. m. (-कः) A small shell. E. क्षुल्ल as above, and कन् added; also खुल्लक.
12482: क्षुल्लतातक m. (-कः) A paternal uncle. E. क्षुल्ल youngest, and तात a father, कन् added.
12483: क्षुवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sneezing. E. क्षु, and मतुप् aff.
12485: क्षेड m. (-डः) 1 Disease in the ear. 2 Poison. 3 Sound: see क्ष्वेड.
12486: क्षेडित m. (-तः) Roar of a lion.
12487: क्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A field. 2 The body. 3 A wife. 4 A pure or sacred spot, a place of pilgrimage, as Benares, &c. 5 Plane figure, geometry. 6 A diagram. E. क्षि to dwell, &c. affix ष्ट्रन्.
12488: क्षेत्रकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making a field, cultivating it, &c. E. क्षेत्र, कर who makes.
12489: क्षेत्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Produced in a field, (as corn, &c.) 2 Born of the body, &c. m. (-जः) A son, the offspring of the wife by a kinsman or person duly appointed to procreate issue to the husband. E. क्षेत्र wife, and ज born, born of the wife only; this is one of the twelve kinds of issue acknowledged by the old Hindu law.
12490: क्षेत्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Clever, dexterous, skilful. 2 A husbandman, &c. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 The soul, the emanation of divinity residing in the body. 2 A libertine, a whore-monger. E. क्षेत्र a field, the body, &c. and ज्ञ who knows.
12491: क्षेत्रपति m. (-तिः) A landowner, a farmer, the master of a field. E. क्षेत्र, and पति master.
12492: क्षेत्रभूमि f. (-मिः) Cultivated land. E. क्षेत्र, and भूमि land.
12493: क्षेत्रविद् m. (-विद्) 1 A sage, one who possesses spiritual knowledge. 2 A husbandman. E. क्षेत्र, and विद् who knows.
12494: क्षेत्रराशि f. (-शिः) Figurate quantity. E. क्षेत्र, and राशि number.
12495: क्षेत्रसीमा f. (-मा) The boundaries of a meadow or field, or holy place. E. क्षेत्र, and सीमा limit.
12496: क्षेत्राजीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) A cultivator, a peasant. E. क्षेत्र a field, and जीव who lives, with आङ् prefixed; who gets a livelihood by the labours of the field.
12497: क्षेत्रामलकी f. (-की) A plant, commonly Bhūmyāmalakī, (Flacourtia cataphracta, Rox.)
12498: क्षेत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having a field, relating to a field, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A farmer, a cultivator. 2 A husband. E. क्षेत्र, and ठक् aff.
12499: क्षेत्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Owning or having a field, cultivating it, &c. m. (-त्री) 1 A husband. 2 A cultivator, a husbandman. E. क्षेत्र a field, and इनि aff.
12500: क्षेत्रिय n. (-यं) 1 Meadow grass, herbage, pasturage. 3 Physicking. operating. m. (-यः) 1 An adulterer. 2 A medicament, what is fit to be administered in medicine. 3 An incurable disease, E. क्षेत्र a field, the body, घ aff.
12501: क्षेद m. (-दः) Sorrowing, moaning. E. क्षि to moan, affix घञ्.
12502: क्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Sending, dismissing. 2 Throwing, casting. 3 Pride, haughtiness. 4 Delay, dilatoriness. 5 Disrespect, contempt. 6 Passing away time. 7 Abuse, reviling. 8 A clump of flowers, &c. 9 (In arithmetic, &c.) Additive quantity, addendum. E. क्षिप to throw, affix घञ्.
12503: क्षेपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Who or what throws or sends. 2 Abusing, disrespectful. E. क्षिप to throw, ण्वुल् aff.
12504: क्षेपण n. (-णं) 1 Sending, directing. 2 Throwing, casting. 3 Passing away time. 4 Abusing. E. क्षिप to throw, affix ल्युट्.
12505: क्षेपणि f. (-णिः or -णी) 1 An oar. 2 A net, a fishing net. E. क्षिप to cast or throw, अण and ङीष् affs.
12506: क्षेपिमन् m. (-मा) Great velocity. E. क्षिप्र quick, and इमनिच् affix, deriv. irr.
12507: क्षेपिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very quick, quickest. E. क्षिप्र quick, and इष्ठन् superlative affix, र rejected.
12508: क्षेपीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very quick. E. क्षिप्र, and ईयसुन् aff.
12509: क्षेप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्ती-प्तृ) Who or what throws, sends, orders, &c. E. क्षिप to throw, तृच् aff.
12510: क्षेम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Happy, well, prosperous, right, &c. mn. (-भः-मं) 1 Happiness, well being. 2 Preserving, protecting, keeping what is acquired. 3 Final emancipation or eternal happiness. 4 The proper term of civil address to a Vaiśya, as क्षेममस्ति, क्षेमं भवतु, Is it well, or may it be well, &c. f. (-मा) A name of DURGĀ. E. क्षि to remove, and मन् Uṇādi affix; what removes or destroys sorrow, &c.
12511: क्षेमक m. (-कः) A perfume, commonly Cor. E. कन् added to क्षेम.
12512: क्षेमकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, conferring happiness or good fortune. E. क्षेम, and कृ to make, अच् aff.
12513: क्षेमकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness or good fortune. E. क्षेम happiness, and कृ to make, अण् aff.
12514: क्षेमङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Propitious, &c.: see the preceding. f. (-री) The Brahmani kite or Coromandel eagle, which is considered as a bird of good omen, (Falco ponticerianus.) E. क्षेम, and कृ to make, with खच् aff.
12515: क्षेमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Happy, prosperous. E. क्षेम, and मतुप् aff.
12516: क्षेमाफला f. (-ला) Opposite leaved fig tree. E. क्षेम auspicious, and फल fruit.
12517: क्षेम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Luckly, prosperous, thriving. 2 Healthy, salubrious. E. क्षेम, and यत् added.
12518: क्षेव (उ) क्षेवु r. 1st cl. (क्षेवति) To spit, to eject from the mouth.
12519: क्षै r. 1st cl. (क्षायति) To wane, to waste or decline.
12520: क्षैत्र n. (त्रं) A multitude of fields, &c. E. क्षेत्र a field, &c. and अण् aff.
12521: क्षैत्रज्ञ n. (-ज्ञ्यं) Spirituality, the nature of the soul. E. क्षेत्रज्ञ, and अण् aff.
12522: क्षैत्रज्ञ्य n. (-ज्ञ्यां) Spirituality, the nature of the soul, the knowledge of it, &c. E. क्षेत्रज्ञ, and यञ् aff.
12523: क्षैरेयी f. (-यी) Milk and rice, or any preparation of milk. E. क्षीर milk, affix ढञ्, fem. affix ङीप्; some copies read this word क्षीरेयी.
12524: क्षोड m. (-डः) The post to which an elephant is bound.
12525: क्षोजन n. (-नं) Sound of the flute.
12526: क्षोणि f. (-णिः or -णी) The earth. E. क्ष to sound, अणि affix, fem. affix optionally ङीप्; also क्षौणि.
12527: क्षोद m. (-दः) 1 Powder, pulverized substance. 2 A piece, a small piece or particle. 3 The stone or slab on which any thing is  ground or powdered, a mortar, &c. 3 Dust. E. क्षुद to bruise or pound, affix घञ्.
12528: क्षोदारज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Ground, pulverized. E. क्षोद, and रज for रजस् dust.
12529: क्षोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pounded, ground, comminuted. n. (-तं) Powder, dust, substance pulverized or ground. E. क्षुद to bruise or pound, affix क्त.
12530: क्षोदिमन् m. (-मा) Minuteness, exceeding smallness or inferiority. E. क्षुद्र small, &c. Affix इमनिच्, deriv. irr.
12531: क्षोदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Finely pounded or levigated, very small or minute. E. क्षुद्र small, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, र rejected.
12532: क्षोदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very fine or small. E. क्षुद्र, and इयसुन् affix of the superlative.
