12533: क्षोभ m. (-भः) 1 Agitation, emotion. 2 Shaking, trembling, tossing. E. क्षुभ to be agitated, घञ् aff.
12534: क्षोम mn. (-मः-मं) A room on the top of a house: see क्षौम n. (-मं) Wove silk. E. क्षु to make a sound, Uṇādi affix मन्; also क्षौम.
12535: क्षौणि f. (-णिः or -णी) The earth. E. क्षोणि the earth, and अण् pleonastic, with इन् or ङीप् fem. terminations added.
12536: क्षौणीप्राचीर m. (-रः) The ocean. E. क्षौणी the earth, and प्राचीर an enclosure.
12537: क्षौद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 Honey. 2 Water. m. (-द्रः) A flower, (Michelia champaca.) E. क्षुद्रा a fly, &c. affix अञ्.
12538: क्षौद्रक्य mfn. (-क्यः-की-क्यं) Small, minute. E. क्षुद्र Small, ञ्यट् pleonastic aff.
12539: क्षौम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Linen, made of linen, covered with it, &c. f. (-मी) Linen or flax, (Linum usitatissimum.) mn. (-मः-मं) 1 An airy room on the top of a house. 2 An apartment on the top of a hall. 3 The back of an edifice. 4 A fortified place in front of a building. 5 A building of a particular form. 6 Wove silk: 7 Linen cloth. E. क्षोम q. v. अण् added.
12540: क्षौमक m. (-कः) Cor, a species of perfume.
12541: क्षौर m. (-रः) 1 Shaving the head. 2 Shaving in general. (-री) A razor. E. क्षुर a razor, affix अण्.
12542: क्षौरिक m. (-कः) A barber. E. क्षुर a razor, affix ठक्.
12543: क्ष्णु r. 2nd cl. (क्ष्णोति or with सम्) prefixed संक्ष्णुते) To whet, to sharpen. (क्ष्णोते) To take away, to remove.
12544: क्ष्णुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Whetted, sharpened. E. क्ष्णु to whet, affix क्त.
12545: क्ष्मा f. (-क्ष्मा) The earth. E. क्षम to bear, Uṇādi affix अच्, and the penultimate dropped.
12546: क्ष्मातल n. (-लं) The surface of the earth. E. क्ष्मा, and तल below.
12547: क्ष्माभुज् m. (-क्) A king. E. क्ष्मा, and भुक् who enjoys.
12548: क्ष्माभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A king, a prince. 2 A mountain. E. क्ष्मा the earth, and भृत् who nourishes, from भृ, affix क्विप्, तुक् added.
12549: क्ष्माय (ई) क्ष्मायी r. 1st cl. (क्ष्मायते) To shake, to make tremble.
12550: क्ष्मायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling. E. क्ष्माय, and क्त aff.
12551: क्ष्मायितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Trembling, shaking. E. क्ष्माय, and तृच् aff.
12552: क्ष्मील r. 1st cl. (-क्ष्मीलति) To wink or twinkle, to close as the eye lids.
12553: क्ष्विण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 1 Sounded. 2 Soft, unctuous. E. क्ष्विद to sound, &c. क्त aff.
12554: क्ष्विद (ञि, आ) ञिक्ष्विदा r. 1st cl. (क्ष्वेदति) To sound inarticulately. r. 4th cl. (क्षिद्यति) 1 To be unctuous, to be soft or bland. 2 To liberate, to free: some consider these roots as more properly read क्ष्विड.
12555: क्ष्वेड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) 1 Crooked, bent. 2 Wicked, depraved. m. (-डः) 1 Venom, poison. 2 Sound, noise. 3 Tingling or buzzing in the ear, from hardening of the wax, &c. 4 Ghosha, with yellow flowers; see घोष. n. (-डं) 1 The flower of the Ghosha plant. 2 The fruit of a red kind of swallow wort. f. (-डा) 1 A war whoop, a battle cry. 2 A bamboo rod or stake. E. क्ष्विद to sound inarticulately, to be soft or bland, &c. affix घ, and ड substituted for द, or क्ष्वेल to shake, &c. अच् affix, and स्व changed to ड.
12556: क्ष्वेडित n. (-तं) A battle cry, a war whoop. E. क्ष्विद to sound inarticulately, affix क्त.
12557: क्ष्वेल (ऋ) क्ष्वेऌ r. 1st cl. (क्ष्वेलति) 1 To shake, to tremble. 2 To go, to move. ख
12558: ख The second consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding; it is written in the Roman character Kh.
12559: ख n. (-खं) 1 Heaven. 2 Sky or ether. 3 An organ of sense. 4 Knowledge. 5 Happiness, pleasure. 6 Vacuity. 7 A dot, a cypher. 8 A city, a field. 9 Action. 10 Auspiciousness. 11 Talc. 12 The tenth constellation from any given one, or the sun's entrance into it. 13 Brahma the supreme spirit. m. (-खः) A name of the sun. E. खन to dig, to penetrate, affix ड.
12560: खकुन्तल m. (-लः) A name of ŚIVA. E. ख ether, कुन्तल hair.
12561: खक्ख r. 1st cl. (खक्खति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride; also कख.
12562: खक्खट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Hard, solid: see कक्खट.
12563: खखोल्क m. (-ल्कः) The sun. E. ख the sky, and खोल्क a meteor, &c.
12564: खग m. (-गः) 1 A bird. 2 An arrow. 3 The sun. 4 A planet. 5 A deity. 6 Air, wind. 7 A grasshopper. E. ख the sky, &c. and ग who goes.
12565: खगपति m. (-तिः) A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. खग a bird, and पति lord or chief.
12566: खगम m. (-मः) A bird. E. ख and गम what goes.
12567: खगवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A tree, commonly Lakucha, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. खग a bird, and वक्त्र face, bird-faced.
12568: खगवती f. (-ती) The earth. E. खग a bird, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.
12569: खगशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, commonly Chakuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) E. खग a bird, and शत्रु an enemy.
12570: खगस्थान n. (-नं) 1 The hollow of a tree. 2 A bird's nest. E. खग a bird, स्थान place.
12571: खगान्तक m. (-कः) A hawk, a falcon. E. खग, and अन्तक destroyer.
12572: खगासन m. (-नः) 1 The eastern mountain over which the sun rises. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. E. खग a bird or the sun, and आसन seat or place of abiding.
12573: खगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of GARUḌA. E. खग, and इन्द्र chief.
12574: खगेन्द्रध्वज m. (-जः) VIṢṆU. E. खगेन्द्र, and ध्वज emblem.
12575: खगेश्वर m. (-रः) GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU; also खगेश. E. खग, and ईश्वर king of birds.
12576: खगोड m. (-डः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
12577: खगोल m. (-लः) 1 The vault or circle of the heavens, the planisphere. 2 The same represented artificially, the armillary sphere. E. ख, and गोल sphere.
12578: खगोलविद्या f. (-द्या) Astronomy. E. खगोल, and विद्या knowledge.
12579: खङ्कर m. (-रः) A curl, a lock of hair.
12580: खच r. 1st cl. (खचति) also r. 9th cl. (खन्नाति) 1 To be past birth. 2 To cause prosperity. 3 To purify. r. 10th cl. (खचयति) To fasten, to bind, to set.
12581: खचमस m. (-सः) The moon. E. ख the sky, चम to eat, and अस aff.
12582: खचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Moving in the sky, flying in the air. m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 An aerial spirit. 3 Air, wind. 4 A demon. 5 The sun. 6 A bird. E. ख the sky, and चर who goes, from चर to go, affix ट; see also खेचर.
12583: खचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, blended, inlaid. 2 Joined, combined. E. खच to fasten, &c. affix क्त.
12584: खज r. 1st cl. (खजति) To churn or agitate. (इ,) खजि (खञ्जति) To limp, to halt, to walk lame or ill.
12585: खज m. (-जः) A ladle, a spoon. f. (-जा) 1 Churning, stirring. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 The palm with the fingers extended. E. खज to agitate, &c. affix अच्.
12586: खजक m. (-कः) The churning stick. f. (-जिका) A ladle or spoon. E. खज to churn or agitate, affix ण्वुल्.
12587: खजप m. (-पः) Ghee or clarified butter. E. खज to stir or agitate, Uṇādi affix अप.
12588: खजल n. (-लं) 1 Frost, hoar-frost. 2 Dew, rain. E. ख the sky, and जल water.
12589: खजाक mf. (-कः-का) A spoon, a ladle. m. (-कः) A bird. E. खज to agitate, and आक Uṇādi aff.
12590: खजित् m. (जित्) A Buddha, one of seven teachers or saints of the Buddha sect. E. ख heaven, and जित् who subdues.
12591: खज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A fire-fly. E. ख, and ज्योतिस् light.
12592: खञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Lame, crippled, limping. f. (-ञ्जा) A species of metre, a stanza of two lines, one of thirty-two, the other of thirty feet. E. खजि to limp or go lame, affix अच्.
12593: खञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Lame, limping. E. खजि to limp, affix वुन्.
12594: खञ्जखेट m. (-टः) A wag-tail. E. खञ्ज lame, and खेट who moves.
12595: खञ्जखेल m. (-लः) A wag-tail. E. खञ्ज lame, and खेल who moves, from खेल to move, affix अच्.
12596: खञ्जन m. (-नः) A small bird, the wag-tail, (Motacilla alba.) f. (-ना) 1 A small kind of wag-tail. 2 Mustard. n. (-र्नं) Going, moving. E. खजि to go lamely, affix ल्यु.
12597: खञ्जनरत n. (-तं) The cohabitation of saints. E. खञ्जन a wag-tail, and रत cohabitation.
12598: खञ्जनाकृति f. (-तिः) A sort of wag-tail.
12599: खञ्जनिका f. (-का) A kind of wag-tail.
12600: खञ्जरीट m. (-टः) A wag-tail. E. खञ्ज lame, ऋ to go, कीटन् affix, deriv. irr.
12601: खट r. 1st cl. (खटति) To desire, to wish, to seek or inquire.
12602: खट m. (-टः) 1 Grass. 2 Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor. 3 A blind well. 4 An axe, a hatchet. 5 A closed or doubled fist, as for striking. 6 A plough. 7 A fragrant kind of grass: see कत्तृण. E. खट to seek, to wish, affix अच्.
12603: खटक m. (-कः) 1 A go-between, a man whose business it is to negociate marriages: see घटक. 2 The doubled fist of wrestlers or boxers. E. खट to seek, to wish, affix वुन्.
12604: खटकामुख m. (-खः) A man in the attitude of shooting.
12605: खटखादक m. (-कः) 1 An eater. 2 A glass vessel. 3 A jackal. 4 An animal. 5 A crow.
12606: खटिक m. (-कः) The fist, the hand closed. f. (-का) 1 Chalk. 2 The external opening of the ear. 3 A fragrant grass: (Andropogon muricatus.) E. खट to seek or wish, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted.
12607: खटिनी f. (-नी) Chalk. E. खट to seek, इनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also कठिनी.
12608: खटी f. (-टी) Chalk. E. खट to seek, अच् and ङीष् affs.
12609: खट्ट r. 10th cl. (खट्टयति) To cover, to screen.
12610: खट्टन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dwarfish, short of stature. E. खट्ट to cover or hide, affix ल्यु.
12611: खट्टा f. (-ट्टा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) E. खट्ट to screen, अङ् and टाप् affs.
12612: खट्टाश mf. (-शः-शी) The civet or zebet cat, (Viverra zibetha.) E. खट्टा the grass, and अश who eats; also खट्टास.
12613: खट्टास m. (-सः) The civet: see the preceding.
12614: खट्टि m. (-ट्टिः) A bier, the bed on which the corpse is carried to the pile; also खट्टी. E. खट्ट to screen, affix कि.
12615: खट्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A hunter, a fowler, one who lives by killing and selling game. f. (-का) 1 A small bedstead, a cot. 2 A bier or bed on which the corpse is carried. E. खट्ट to screen, इकन् aff.
12617: खट्वा f. (-ट्वा) 1 A bedstead, a cot, a couch. 2 A hammock, a swing. E. खट्ट to hide, Uṇādi affix कन्.
12618: खट्वाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गं) A king of the solar line. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Part of a bed. 2 A club or staff with a skull at the top of it, considered as a weapon of ŚIVA, and carried by penitents and Yogis. 3 Wood from a funeral pile. E. खट्वा a cot, and अङ्क body or form.
12619: खट्वाङ्गभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of ŚIVA. खट्वाङ्ग one of his weapons, भृत् who maintains.
12620: खट्वाङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A name of ŚIVA. E. खट्वाङ्ग, and इनि aff.
12621: खट्वारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Low, vile, abandoned, iniquitous. 2 Erring, going wrong. 3 Stupid, silly. 4 Laid or lying on a bed. E. खट्वा a bed, and आरूढ mounted.
12622: खट्विका f. (-का) A small bedstead. E. खट्वा a bedstead, and कन् affix, fem. form.
12623: खड r. 10th cl. (खाडयति) also (इ,) खडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (खण्डति खण्डयति) and (इ ङ) खडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खण्डते) To divide, to tear, to break off a part or piece.
12624: खड m. (-डः) 1 Breaking, dividing. 2 Buttermilk boiled with acid vegetables and spices. 3 A small grass. f. (-डी) Chalk. E. खड to break, &c. affix अच्.
12625: खडक्किका f. (-का) A private or back door, a small or venetian door or window.
12626: खडिका f. (-का) Chalk. E. खड to break, affix वुन् fem. form.
12627: खडु m. (-डुः) A bier. E. खड to break, affix उ.
12628: खड्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A rhinoceros. 2 A rhinoceros horn. 3 A sword, a scimitar. 4 A large sacrificial knife. 5 One of the Buddhas or Bauddha saints. n. (-ङ्गं) Iron. E. खड to tear or rend, Uṇādi affix गन.
12629: खड्गकोष m. (-षः) 1 A creeping plant, (Scirpus maximus.) 2 A scabbard, a sheathe. E. खङ्ग a sword, and कोष a sheathe.
12630: खड्गचर्म्मधर m. (-रः) A soldier armed with a sword and shield. E. खड्ग, and चर्म्म a shield, धर who bears.
12631: खड्गट m. (-टः) A large kind of Kās, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. खड्ग the rhinoceros, and अट who goes; these animals being usually found amongst high grass or reeds.
12632: खड्गधर m. (-रः) A swordsman. E. खड्ग, and धर who holds.
12633: खड्गधेनु f. (-नुः) 1 A small knife. 2 A female rhinoceros. E. खड्ग a sword, &c. धेनु a cow, used here as a diminutive.
12634: खड्गपत्र m. (-त्रः) The name of a creeper, (Scirpus maximus.) n. (-त्रं) The blade of a sword. E. खड्ग a sword, and पत्र a leaf.
12635: खड्गपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Holding a sword. E. खड्ग, and पाणि the hand.
12636: खड्गपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel of buffalo's horn. E. खड्ग, and पात्र a vessel.
12637: खड्गपिधान n. (-नं) A scabbard, a sheathe. E. खड्ग a sword, and पिधान a sheathe; also with कन् added, खड्गपिधानक.
12638: खड्गपुत्त्रिका f. (-का) A knife, a small sword. E. खड्ग, and पुत्त्रिका infant.
12639: खड्गप्रहार m. (-रः) A sword cut. E. खड्ग, and प्रहार a stroke.
12640: खड्गमांस m. (-सः) Buffalo-beef. E. खड्ग, and मांस flesh.
12641: खड्गलेखा f. (-खा) A row of sabres. E. खड्ग, and लेखा a line.
12642: खड्गराट m. (-टः) 1 A shield. 2 One who observes a peculiar religious obligation, rubbing the feet backwards and forwards on the edge of a sword made red hot, this is a penance peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. खड्ग a sword, रट to speak, deriv. irr.
12643: खड्गाघात m. (-तः) A sword cut. E. खड्ग, and आघात a blow.
12644: खड्गाधार m. (-रः) A sheathe, a scabbard. E. खड्ग, and आधार what receives.
12645: खड्गाभिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut or struck with a sword. E. खड्ग, and अभिहत struck.
12646: खड्गामिष n. (-षं) Buffalo's flesh. E. खड्ग, and आमिष flesh.
12647: खड्गिक m. (-कः) 1 The cream or froth of buffalo's milk. 2 A vender of flesh meat. E. खड्ग a sword, &c. affix ठक्.
12648: खड्गिन् mfn. (-ड्गी-ड्गिनी-ड्गि) Armed with a sword. m. (-ड्गी) 1 A rhinoceros. 2 A Jina or Jaina saint. E. खड्ग a horn, &c. affix इनि.
12649: खड्गिमार m. (-रः) A kind of creeper: see खड्गकोष. E. खड्गि a rhinoceros, and मार what destroys.
12650: खड्गीक m. (-कः) A sickle, a scythe. E. खड्ग a scymitar, and ईकन् aff.
12651: खण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 A piece, a part, a fragment, a portion. 2 A chapter, a section. 3 A term in an equation. m. (-ण्डः) A flaw in a jewel. 2 Treacle or molasses partially dried or candied. n. (-ण्डं) 1 A sort of sugar cane. 2 Black salt. E. खडि to break, and घञ् affix, or खन to tear, affix ड, and न changed to ण.
12652: खण्डक m. (-कः) 1 Pared or clipped finger nails. 2 A part, a piece. E. खण्ड to tear, वुन् aff.
12654: खण्डकथा f. (-था) A tale or story divided into sections. E. खण्ड a section, and कथा a story.
12655: खण्डकालु n. (-लु) An esculent root, sweet potatoe: also खण्डकालुक. n. (-कं) E. खण्डक a portion, and आलु any esculent root.
12656: खण्डकाव्य n. (-व्यं) A poem interspersed with prose. E. खण्ड, and काव्य a poem.
12657: खण्डज m. (-जः) Treacle, molasses. E. खण्ड, and ज what is produced.
12658: खण्डधारा f. (-रा) Shears, scissors. E. खण्ड a part, and धृ to have or hold, in the causal form.
12659: खण्डन n. (-नं) 1 Breaking, dividing, cutting, reducing to pieces. 2 Destroying, annihilating. 3 Refuting, (in argument.) 4 Rebellion, opposition. E. खण्ड to break, ल्युट् aff.
12660: खण्डनरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destructive, skilful in cutting or destroying. E. खण्डन, and रत engaged in.
12661: खण्डनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Brittle, fragile. 2 Refutable. 4 Destructible, &c. E. खडि, and अनीयर् affix; also खण्ड्य, and खण्डितव्य.
12662: खण्डपत्र m. (-त्रं) A bundle of various leaves. E. खण्ड, and पत्र a leaf.
12663: खण्डपरशु m. (-शुः) A name of ŚIVA. E. खण्ड a part, and परशु a hatchet; cutting his foes to pieces.
12664: खण्डपर्शु m. (-र्शुः) 1 A name of PARAŚURĀMA. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 Rāhu, the personified ascending node. 5 A spreader of unguents, fragrant powders, &c. 5 A drug, commonly Candāmalaki. 6 An elephant with a broken tusk. E. खण्ड a part, and पर्शु an axe; whose axe or arms cut every thing to pieces.
12665: खण्डपाल m. (-लः) A confectioner, a seller of sweetmeats. E. खण्ड molasses, and पाल who cherishes.
12666: खण्डप्रलय m. (-यः) Partial destruction of the universe, the destruction of the division of the terrestrial world. E. खण्ड, and प्रलय destruction.
12667: खण्डमण्डल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Gibbous, not full or round. n. (-लं) A segment of a circle, part of a circle or an incomplete sphere. E. खण्ड, and मण्डल sphere.
12668: खण्डमोदक m. (-कः) Granulated sugar. E. खण्ड, and मोदक a sweetmeat.
12669: खण्डलवण n. (-णं) Black salt. E. खण्ड, and लवण salt.
12670: खण्डशस् ind. Piece-meal, in or by pieces. E. खण्ड, and शसि aff.
12671: खण्डसर m. (-रः) Granulated sugar. E. खण्ड, and सर what goes.
12672: खण्डाभ्र n. (-भ्रं) 1 Scattered clouds. 2 A bite, the impression of the teeth. E. खण्ड a part, and अभ्र a cloud, &c.
12673: खण्डाली f. (-ली) 1 A measure for oil. 2 A pond. 3 A woman whose husband has been guilty of infidelity.
12674: खण्डिक m. (-कः) 1 Pease. 2 The armpit. E. खडि to break, इकन् aff.
12675: खण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut, torn, broken in pieces. 2 Destroyed. 3 Broken as allegiance, disobeyed against, rebelled. 4 Refuted, controverted. 5 Scattered, dispersed. 6 Disappointed. 7 Betrayed, abandoned, (as a lover.) f. (-ता) A woman whose husband or lover has been guilty of infidelity. E. खडि to cut, affix क्त.
12676: खण्डितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be broken, what may or ought to be broken, confuted, destroyed, &c. E. खडि, and तव्य aff.
12677: खण्डितविग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Maimed, mutilated. E. खण्डित, and विग्रह body.
12678: खण्डिताशंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Disappointed, foiled, frustrated. E. खण्डित, and आशंसा expectation.
12679: खण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) 1 In pieces or parts, divided, comminuted, &c. 2 Consisting of pieces or parts. m. (-ण्ड,) A wild  kind of kidney bean: see वनमद्ग. f. (-नी) The earth. E. खण्ड a portion, and इनि aff.
12680: खण्डीर m. (-रः) A kind of kidney bean: see पीतमुद्ग. E. खण्ड a part, ईरन् aff.
12681: खण्ड्य mfn. (ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं) What may or ought to be broken, &c. see खण्डितव्य. E. खडि, and यत् aff.
12682: खतमाल m. (-लः) 1 Smoke. 2 A cloud. E. ख the sky, तमाल a tree with dark blossoms; the etherial Tamāla.
12683: खद r. 1st cl. (खदति) 1 To be steady or firm. 2 To hurt or kill. 3 To eat. r. 10th cl. (खदयति) To cover.
12684: खदिका m. (-का) Fried or parched grain.
12685: खदिर m. (-रः) 1 A tree, the resin of which is used in medicine, Khayar, Terra japonica or catechu, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 A name of INDRA. 3 The moon. f. (-री) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. खद to hurt, Uṇādi affix इरच्.
12686: खदिरपत्री f. (-त्री) The sensitive plant. E. खदिर, and पत्र a leaf, affix ङीप्; also with कन् added खदिरपत्रिका.
12688: खदूरक n. (-कं) A dwarf. E. ख, and दूर afar, कन् aff.
12689: खदूरवासिनी f. (-नी) One of the female deities or Śaktis of the Buddhas. E. ख heaven, दूर ill, and वासिनी who abides.
12690: खद्योत m. (-तः) 1 A fire-fly. 2 The sun. E. ख the sky, and द्योत what is luminous.
12691: खद्योतन m. (-नः) The sun. E. ख heaven, and द्युत to shine, affix ल्युट.
12692: खधूप m. (-पः) A rocket, a fire work. E. ख, and धूप incense.
12693: खन (उ,) खनु r. 1st cl. (खनति-ते) 1 To dig or delve. 2 To hurt.
12694: खनक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Tearing, dividing. 2 Digging, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A rat. 2 A housebreaker. 3 A miner. E. खन to dig, affix ण्वुल्.
12695: खनत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) Digging. E. खन, and शतृ aff.
12696: खनि f. (-निः or -नी) A mine, especially of precious stones; when used in composition with आकर, more commonly a mine of the precious metals. E. खन to dig, इन् affix, and ङीष् optionally added.
12697: खनितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what digs or delves, a digger, a ditcher, &c. E. खन to dig, तृच् aff.
12698: खनित्र n. (-त्रं) A spade or hoe. E. खन to dig, इत्रच् aff.
12699: खपुर m. (-रः) 1 The betel tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 3 Garlic. 4 Flatulence. n. (-रं) 1 A water jar. 2 A city in the sky, the city of HARIŚCANDRA. E. ख the heavens, &c. पृ to nourish, affix क.
12700: खभ्रान्ति m. (न्तिः) A kite. E. ख the sky, भ्रम to roam, affix क्तिन्.
12701: खमणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. ख the sky, and मणि a jewel.
12702: खमीलन n. (-नं) Lassitude, weariness, sleepiness. E. ख the sky, and मीलन twinkling.
12703: खमूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) A celestial appearance or person. E. ख, and मूर्त्ति form.
12704: खमूर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having a divine or celestial person or form. E. खमूर्त्ति, and मतुप् aff.
12705: खमूलि f. (-लिः or -ली or -लिका) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes). E. ख ether, मूल a root, affixes इन् or ङीष्; also खमूलिका.
12706: खम्ब r. 1st cl. (खम्बति) To go or move.
12707: खर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hot. 2 Sharp, pungent. 3 Sharp, sharp-edged, cutting. 4 Cruel, harsh. mn. (-रः-रं) Heat. m. (-रः) 1 An ass. 2 A Rākṣasa, the brother of RĀVAṆA. 3 A Daitya or demon in general. 4 A sort of prickly nightshade. 5 A crow. 6 A heron. 7 An osprey. f. (-रा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) E. ख an organ of sense, and रा to get or give, affix क.
12708: खरकुटि f. (-टिः or टी) A barber's shop. E. खर heat, and कुटि a dwelling; also written खरकुट्टि.
12709: खरकोण m. (-णः) The francoline partridge. E. खर heat, कुण to sound, affix अच्.
12712: खरगृह n. (-हं) An ass's stable. E. खर an ass, and गृह a house.
12713: खरगेह n. (-हं) A stable for asses. E. खर, and गेह a house.
12714: खरग्रह n. (-हं) A stable for asses. E. खर, and ग्रह a house.
12715: खरघातन m. (-नः) A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) E. खर an ass, and घातन mischievous.
12716: खरच्छद m. (-दः) 1 A kind of reed or grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) 2 Also another kind, commonly Okera. E. खर warm, sharp, छद a leaf.
12717: खरणस् mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः) Sharp-nosed. E. खर sharp, नस् from नासिका a nose; also with a final vowel खरणस (-सः-सा-सं.)
12718: खरदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A lotus, (Nymphaea lotus.) E. खर sharp, and दण्ड stick or stem.
12719: खरदला f. (-ला) Opposite leaved fig tree. E. खर hot, दल leaf.
12720: खरदूषण m. (-णः) Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) E. खर an ass, and दूषण hurting; by its narcotic properties.
12721: खरध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A name of RĀMA. E. खर an imp or goblin so called, and ध्वंसिन् the destroyer.
12722: खरनाद m. (-दः) The braying of an ass. E. खर, and नाद noise.
12723: खरनादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Braying as an ass. f. (-नी) A kind of perfume: see रेणुका. E. खरनाद and इनि aff.
12724: खरपत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A red sort of Tulasi or basil. 2 The teak tree, (Tectona grandis.) E. खर hot, and पत्र a leaf.
12725: खरपत्रक m. (-कः) A plant: see तिलक. E. कन् added to खरपत्र hot leaved.
12726: खरपात्र n. (-त्रं) An iron pot or vessel. E. खर an ass, and पात्र a vessel; fit for such an animal.
12727: खरपादाद्य m. (-द्यः) The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantium:) see कपित्थ.
12728: खरपाल m. (-लः) A wooden vessel. E. खर, and पाल what cherishes.
12729: खरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, commonly Marüa: see मरुवक. f. (-ष्पा or ष्पिका) A kind of Tulasi, (Ocymum gratissimum;) also वर्वर. E. खर sharp, hot, पुष्प a flower.
12730: खरप्रिय m. (-यः) A pigeon. E. खर hot, and प्रिय fond, dear.
12731: खरमञ्जरी f. (-री) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera:) see अपामार्ग. E. खर sharp, pungent, and मञ्जरी a pedicle.
12732: खरयान n. (-नं) A vehicle drawn by asses. E. खर, and यान a carriage.
12733: खरलोमन् m. (-मा) One of the chiefs of the Nāga or serpent race inhabiting hell. E. खर an ass, and लोमन् hair of the body; having the skin of an ass.
12734: खरवल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Gorakṣa Cākuliya, (Hedysarum lagopodiodes.) E. खर hot, sharp, वल्लिका a pedicle.
12735: खरशब्द m. (-ब्दः) 1 An osprey. 2 The braying of an ass. E. खर, and शब्द sound.
12736: खरशाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Born or produced in an ass's stall. f. (-ला) An ass's stable or stall. E. खर, and शाला a hall; in the first sense the final is dropped.
12737: खरसोल्ल m. (-ल्लः) An iron vessel; also read खरसोनि.
12738: खरांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. खर hot, and अंशु a ray.
12739: खरागरी f. (-री) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus;) also देवताड. E. खर venom, गृ to take, with आङ् prefixed, अच् and ङीष् affixes; antivenomous, an antidote.
12740: खरालक m. (-कः) An iron arrow; also खरालिक. m. (-कः).
12741: खराश्वा f. (-श्वा) A plant, (Celosia cristata.) E. खर an ass, अश to be eaten, and व and टाप् affs.
12742: खरिका f. (-का) Musk in powder. E. खर, कन् added, fem. form.
12743: खरिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Drinking ass's milk. E. खरी, and धे to drink, खश् aff.
12744: खरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः or -रूः-रु) 1 White. 2 Desirous of improper or prohibited things. 3 A fool, foolish, idiotic. 4 Harsh, cruel. m. (-रुः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A horse. 3 A tooth. 4 Pride. 5 Love or the deity KĀMA. 6 White, the colour. E. खन to dig, &c. Uṇādi affix कु, and र substituted for the final.
12745: खर्ब r. 10th cl. (खर्ब्वति) To go or move.
12746: खर्ज r. 1st cl. (खर्जति) 1 To worship, to treat with respect or courtesy. 2 To pain or make uneasy. 3 To cleanse or make clean.
12747: खर्जिका f. (-का) A relish, a provocative to drinking. E. खर्ज to pain, and वुन् affix, fem. form.
12749: खर्ज्जू f. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 Cutaneous eruption, itch, scab, &c. 2 A worm, an insect. E. खर्जि to give pain, Uṇādi affix ऊ.
12750: खर्ज्जूर n. (-रं) 1 Silver. 2 The fruit of the date. 3 Yellow orpiment. m. (-रः) 1 The date tree, (Phoenix sylvestris.) 2 A scorpion. f. (-री) The wild date tree. E. खर्ज to give pain, &c. Uṇādi affix ऊर.
12751: खर्ज्जूररस m. (-सः) The juice or extract of the wild date, Tāri, used to leaven bread, and as an intoxicating liquor, when in a state of spontaneous fermentation. E. खर्ज्जूर, and रस juice.
12752: खर्द r. 1st cl. (खर्दति) To bite, to sting, to sting venomously.
12753: खर्प्पर mf. (-रः-री) A kind of collyrium or application to the eyes: see कर्पर. m. (-रः) 1 A thief. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 A beggar's bowl or dish. 4 The half of a skull. 5 An umbrella or parasol.
12754: खर्द्ध r. 1st cl. (खर्घति) To go, to move.
12755: खर्पराल m. (-लः) A plant: see कन्दराल.
12756: खर्प्परीतूत्थ n. (-त्थं) A sort of collyrium.
12757: खर्ब r. 1st cl. (खर्बंति) To go, to move to or towards.
12758: खर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्बं) A dwarf, short, low, of little size or stature. m. (-र्ब्बः) One of KUVERA'S nine Nidhis or treasures. n. (-र्ब्बं) A large number, ten million-millions. E. खर्ब्ब or खर्व्व to be small, to go, to move, affix अच्; also खर्व्व.
12759: खर्ब्बशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Small, short, dwarfish. E. खर्ब्ब short, and शाखा a branch.
12761: खर्व्व r. 1st cl. (खर्व्वति) To be proud, or haughty.
12762: खर्व्व mfn. (र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) A dwarf, &c.: see खर्ब्ब.
12763: खर्व्वट mn. (-टः-टं) 1 The capital of a district of four hundred villages, a market or country town. 2 A village at the foot of a mountain. E. खर्व्व being proud, and अट what goes or is.
12764: खल r. 1st cl. (खर्लति) 1 To gather. 2 To move.
12765: खल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Low, vile, base. 2 Low, inferior. 3 Cruel, mischievous, mischief-making. 4 Bad, wicked. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Earth, mould or soil. 2 Place, site. 3 Sediment, deposit of oil, &c. 4 A granary, a threshing floor. 5 A mill. m. (-लः) 1 The sun. 2 A tree with black blossoms: see तमाल. 3 The Datura plant. E. खल to gather, (misfortune, &c.) affix अच्.
12766: खलता f. (-ता) 1 Wickedness, villainy. 2 Filthiness. E. खल, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix खलत्वं.
12767: खलति mfn. (-तिः-तिः or -ती-ति) Bald, baldheaded. E. स्खल to fall, Uṇādi affix अतच, इ inserted, and स rejected.
12768: खलपू mf. (-पूः) A sweeper, a cleaner, Mehter or Ferash. E. खल place, and पू who cleans, from पूञ् to cleanse or purify, affix क्विप्.
12769: खलप्रीति f. (-तिः) The friendship or favour of wicked or low persons. E. खल, and प्रीति affection.
12770: खलमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) Quicksilver. E. खल place, and मूर्त्ति form; taking the form of the place it lies in.
12771: खलसंसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Associating with bad company. E. खल, संसर्ग associating.
12772: खलाधारा f. (-रा) A cockroach. E. खल the sediment of oil, and आधार having.
12773: खलि m. (-लिः) Sediment of oil or oil-cake. E. खल to gather, इन् aff.
12774: खलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having sediment, &c. f. (नी) 1 A multitude of threshing floors. 2 A plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.) E. खल, and इनि aff.
12775: खलिन mn. (-नः-नं) The bit of a bridle: see खलीन.
12776: खलिश mf. (-शः-शा) A kind of fish, (Trichopodus colisa, HAM.) also खलेश.
12777: खलीकार m. (-रः) 1 Mischief, evil. 2 Leaving or reducing to sediment. E. खल mischievous, and कार who makes; च्चि inserted.
12778: खलीन mn. (-नः-नं) The bit of a bridle. E. ख the mouth, and लीन what is fixed; also the vowel being made short खलिन.
12779: खलु ind. 1 A particle of prohibition. 2 An expletive. 3 An expression of endearment or conciliation. 4 An expression indicating inquiry. 5 An expression of asseveration or ascertainment, (certainly, indeed.) 6 Only, merely. E. खल to gather, affix उ.
12780: खलुज् m. (-लुक्) Darkness. E. ख the sky, लुक् dropped, lost, from लुज to efface, affix क्विप्.
12781: खलुरेष m. (-षः) A kind of wild animal; also खलुरेषक.
12782: खलूरिका f. (-का) A parade, a place for military exercise. E. खडि to break, ऊरच् affix, ड changed to ल, and कन् added.
12783: खलेधानी f. (-नी) The post of a threshing floor, round which the oxen pass who tread out the grain; also खलेवाली.
12784: खलेबाली f. (-ली) A post: see the preceding. E. खल a threshing floor in the seventh case, and बाली what is firm, a post, &c. from बल to be strong, अण् and ङीष affs.
12785: खलेश m. (-शः) A kind of fish, (commonly Trichopodus colisa, HAM.) see खलिश. E. खले in dirt, and श from शी to sleep; burrowing in the mud of the banks, &c.
12786: खलेशय m. (-यः) The Khaliśa fish: see the preceding. E. as before, शी, and अच् aff.
12787: खलोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Abuse, low or wicked language. E. खल, and उक्ति speech.
12788: खल्या mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Fit for oil cake, for a threshing floor, &c. f. (-ल्या) A multitude of threshing floors. E. खल a threshing floor, affix क्यप् यत् or य.
12789: खल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 A kind of cloth or clothes, leather garments. 2 A canal, a cut, a creek, a trench, a deep hole. 3 The Cātaka, a kind of cuckoo. 4 Leather. 5 A leather water bag. 6 A mill, a stone or vessel for grinding drugs, &c. f. (-ल्ली) Shooting pain in the extremities. E. खल collecting, &c. and ल what gets; also खल्लक m. (-कः)
12790: खल्लिका f. (-का) A frying pan. E. कन् added to the preceding, fem. form.
12791: खल्लिट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Bald, morbidly troubled with falling of the hair; also खल्लीट.
12792: खल्लीट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Becoming morbidly bald: see the preceding.
12795: खव r. 9th cl. (खौनाति) 1 To be past birth. 2 To cause or procure prosperity. 3 To produce purity, to purify. 4 To produce or manifest wealth.
12796: खवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A parasitic plant. E. ख, and वल्ली a pedicle.
12797: खवारि n. (-रि) Rain water, dew, vapour, &c. E. ख heaven, and वारि water.
12798: खवाष्प m. (-ष्पः) Snow, hoar frost, dew. E. ख sky, and वाष्प vapour or tears.
12799: खश m. (-शः) 1 A mountainous country to the north of India. 2 A native of that country, considered as a degraded Kṣatriya. f. (-शा) A kind of perfume, commonly Mura.
12800: खशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Resting or dwelling in the air. E. ख, and शी to sleep, अच् aff.
12801: खशरीर n. (-रं) A celestial or immortal body. E. ख, and शरीर body.
12802: खशरीरिन् m. (-री-रिणी-रि) Of a heavenly body. E. खशरीर, and इनि aff.
12803: खशेट m. (-टः) The Khaliśa, a kind of fish: see खलेश.
12804: खश्वास m. (-सः) Air or wind. E. ख the atmosphere, and श्वास breath.
12805: खष r. 1st cl. (खषति) To kill, to hurt or injure.
12806: खष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Anger, passion. 2 Violence, oppression. E. खन to hurt, to dig, प Uṇādi affix, न changed to ष.
12807: खस m. (-सः) 1 Itch, scab. 2 A man of a country or tribe considered to be a degraded Kṣatriya: the Khasas inhabit the mountains surrounding Kashmir. f. (-सा) The mother of the imps or goblins.
12808: खसगन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, commonly Kṣīrakañcuki.
12809: खसम m. (-मः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint. E. ख heaven, and सम equal, the same.
12810: खसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in the sky, aerial, ethereal. E. ख. and सम्भव birth.
12811: खसर्पण m. (-णः) One of the Buddhas or Buddha saints. n. (-णं) Gliding through the air. E. ख heaven, and सर्पण who goes to or in.
12812: खसात्मज m. (-जः) An imp or goblin. E. खसा the mother of these beings, आत्मज a son.
12813: खस्तनी f. (-नी) The earth. E. ख ether, स्तन a breast, affix ङीष्.
12815: खस्खसरस m. (-सः) Poppy juice, opium. E. खस्खस, and रस juice.
12816: खस्फटिक m. (-कः) 1 Crystal, the sun gem. 2 The moon gem: see सूर्य्यकान्त, and चन्द्रकान्त. E. ख heaven, and स्फटिक crystal.
12817: खहर m. (-रः) (In arithmetic.) A fraction having a cypher for its denominator. E. ख a cypher, हर divisor.
12818: खाजिक m. (-कः) Fried or parched grain. E. खज to go, &c. affix ण्वुल्.
12819: खाट mf. (-टः-टा) 1 A bier, a cot or bedstead on which dead bodies are conveyed to the pile. E. खट to screen, affix घञ्.
12820: खाटि f. (-टिः) 1 Caprice, whim. 2 A scar. 3 A bier. E. खट to screen, &c. इञ् aff.
12821: खाटिका f. (-का) A bier: see खाट; also खाटी.
12822: खाण्डव n. (-वं) A wood, sacred to INDRA.
12823: खाण्डिक m. (-कः) A confectioner, a seller of sweetmeats. E. खण्ड molasses or coarse sugar, and ठक् aff.
12824: खात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dug, excavated. 2 Torn, rent. n. (-तं) 1 A square or oblong pond. 2 Any excavation. E. खन to dig, affix क्त, and the pen. lengthened.
12825: खातक m. (-कः) 1 A delver, a digger. 2 A debtor; more correctly खादक n. (-कं) A moat, a ditch. E. खात a pond, affix कन्.
12826: खातभू f. (-भूः) A moat, a ditch. E. खात a pond, भू earth.
12827: खात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A square or large pond. 2 A spade, a hoe. 3 A wood. 4 A thread. E. खन to dig, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
12828: खाद (ऋ) खादृ r. 1st cl. (खादति) To eat.
12829: खादक m. (-कः) 1 A borrower, a user, (in law,) literally, an eater. 2 A feeder, one who eats or feeds. E. खाद to eat, affix वुन्.
12830: खादन m. (-नः) A tooth. n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Food, victuals. E. खाद to eat, affix ल्युट्.
12831: खादनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Edible, to be eaten. E. खाद and अनीयर् aff.
12832: खादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. खाद to eat, affix क्त.
12833: खादितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Eating, feeding. E. खाद and क्तवतु aff.
12834: खादितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be eaten, what may be or must be eaten, &c. E. खाद, and तव्य.
12835: खादिर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Derived from the Khayar tree. 2 Made of its wood. E. खदिर, and अण् aff.
12836: खादिरसार m. (-रः) Catechu, the resinous extract of the Mimosa catechu. E. खादिर, and सार essence.
12837: खादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, injurious, malignant. E. खाद to eat, उकन् aff.
12838: खाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Edible, to be eaten, what is to be or may be eaten. n. (-द्यं) Food, victuals. E. खाद to eat, यत् aff.
12839: खानि mf. (-निः-नी) A mine. E. खन to dig, इञ् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
12840: खानिक n. (-कं) An opening or hole in a wall, a breach. E. खन to dig, affix ठञ्.
12841: खानिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A housebreaker. E. खन to dig, इलच् affix, deriv. irr.; this is sometimes read खानिन.
12842: खानोदक m. (-कः) A cocoanut. E. खान rending, and उदक water.
12843: खापगा f. (-गा) A name of GAṄGĀ or the Ganges. E. ख heaven, and अपगा a river.
12844: खार mf. (-रः-रिः or -री) A Khāri, a measure of grain containing sixteen Droṇas, or about three bushels: it is also reckoned at three or four Droṇas; also at five Gonis, which is considered equal to 512 Ser's. f. (-री) A scar. E. खन to dig, deriv. irr.
12845: खारिम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Cooking a Khāri, by measure (a vessel, &c.) E. खारी as above, पच to cook, affix खश्.
12846: खारीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A field, &c. equal to or sown with a Khāri of grain. E. खारी the measure, and इकन् or ठञ् aff.
12847: खारीवाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) A field sown with a Khāri of grain, &c. E. खारी, and वाप sowing.
12848: खालित्य n. (-त्य) Morbid baldness. E. खलति, and यञ् aff.
12849: खाशि m. (-शिः) Name of a country to the east of Bengal: the Cossya hills; also खाशिक m. (-कः).
12850: खाश्मरी f. (-री) A plant: see कश्मरी.
12851: खिखि f. (-खिः) A fox; also in some copies, किखि q. v.
12852: खिङ्खिर mf. (-रः-रा) A fox. m. (-रः) 1 One of ŚIVA'S weapons. 2 A kind of perfume, commonly Hāla.
12853: खिट r. 1st cl. (खेटति) 1 To terrify, to alarm or surprise. 2 To be terrified, to fear or dread.
12854: खिद r. 4th and 7th cls. (खिद्यते and खिंते) To be distrest, to suffer pain or misery. (औ, प) औखिदप् r. 6th cl. (खिन्दति) To afflict or distress.
12855: खिदिर m. (-रः) The moon. 2 An ascetic, a penitent. 3 A pauper. E. खिद to suffer pain, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
12856: खिद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Suffering pain or distress. E. खिद, with शानच् aff.
12857: खिद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 Disease, sickness. 2 A pauper, a poor man. E. खिद, to be in pain, रक् Uṇādi aff.
12858: खिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Distrest, suffering pain or uneasiness. 2 Wearied, exhausted. E. खिद to be in pain, affix क्त.
12859: खिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Waste or unploughed land. 2 Empty. vacant. m. (-लः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 VIṢṆU. mn. (-लः-लं) A compendium, a compilation, especially of hymns and prayers. E. ख vacuity, &c. ल what gets or possesses, affix ड, and इ substituted for the penultimate.
12860: खु (ङ) खुङ् r. 1st cl. (खुवते) To sound.
12862: खुज r. 1st cl. (उ) खुजु (खुजति) To steal or rob.
12863: खुञ्जाक m. (-कः) A kind of grass: see देवताडक.
12864: खुड r. 6th cl. (खुडति) To cover. r. 1st and 10th cl. (खोडति खोडयति) also (इ,) खुडि r. 1st and 10th cl. (खुण्डति, खुण्डयति) To break in pieces, to sunder, to divide, tear, rend, &c. (इङ्) खुडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खुण्डते) To limp, to be lame.
12865: खुर r. 6th cl. (खुरति) To cut, to scratch.
12866: खुर m. (-रः) 1 A hoof, a horse's hoof, &c. 2 A razor. 3 The foot of a bedstead; also क्षुर. 4 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi, apparently a dried shell fish, and of the shape of a hoof. E. खुर to cut, रन् Uṇādi affix, the radical र is dropped.
12867: खुरक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Tilā. E. कन् added to the preceding.
12868: खुरक्षेप m. (-पः) A kick, kicking. E. खुर, and क्षेप throwing.
12869: खुरणस् mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः) Flat-nosed, having a nose like a horse's hoof. E. खुर a hoof, and नस् deriv. of नासिका a nose; also with a final vowel खुरणस. mfn. (-सः-सा-सं.)
12870: खुरपदवी f. (-वी) A horse's foot marks. E. खुर, and पदवी vestige.
12871: खुरप्र m. (-प्रः) An arrow with a semicircular head: see क्षुरप्र.
12872: खुरली f. (-ली) Military exercise, practising archery, &c. E. खुर to cut, अलच् aff.
12873: खुराक m. (-कः) An animal in general. E. खुर to cut, and आक aff.
12874: खुराघात m. (-तः) A kick. E. खुर, and आघात a blow.
12875: खुराभिघात m. (-तः) 1 A kick. 2 Kicking, pawing, (as a horse.) E. खुर, and अभिघात, striking.
12876: खुरालक m. (-कः) An iron arrow. E. खुर a razor, and अल what is able, affix कन्.
12877: खुरालिक m. (-कः) 1 A barber's case. 2 An iron arrow. 3 A pillow. E. खुर a razor, &c. अल to be equal to, affix ठक्; some read this खरालक, but to all appearance erroneously.
12878: खुर्द r. 1st cl. (खुर्दते or खूर्दते) To play, to sport.
12879: खुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Small, little, low, mean, &c. n. (-ल्लं) A kind of perfume: see खुर. E. खुद to divide, &c. and ल from ला to get, the radical द becomes ल.
12880: खुल्लक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Low, vile. 2 Little, small. 2 Poor, indigent. 4 Cruel, harsh. 4 Wicked, mischievous, malignant: see क्षुल्ल.
12881: खुल्लतात m. (-तः) A father's younger brother; also क्षुल्लतात.
12883: खूर्द r. 1st cl. (खूर्दते) To play: see खुर्द.
12884: खेखीरक m. (-कः) A hollow or sounding reed, or cane.
12885: खेगमन m. (-नः) A gallinule. E. खे in the air, and गमन going.
12886: खेचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Aerial, moving in the air. m. (-रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A Vidyādhara or kind of demigod. 3 Quicksilver. E. खे in heaven, and चर who goes.
12887: खेट r. 1st cl. (खेटति) To alarm. r. 10th cl. (खेटयति) To eat.
12888: खेट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Vile, bad, low. 2 Armed, having a weapon or weapons. mn. (-टः-टं) Hunting, the chase; also आखेट. m. (-टः) 1 A shield. 2 A village, the residence of peasants or farmers. 3 A small town, half the Pura or town. 4 The club of BALARĀMA. 5 Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humour. 6 The ascending node or RĀHU. 7 A horse. n. (-टं) Grass. E. खिट to terrify, &c. affix घञ्.
12889: खेटक m. (-कः) 1 A village, the residence of agricultural peasants. 2 A shield. 3 The club of BALARĀMA. E. खिट to terrify, &c. अच् affix, and कन् added.
12890: खेटिताल m. (-लः) A minstrel, a family bard or piper, whose business it is to awaken the Laird, with music and singing. E. खेटि derived from खिट to disturb, and ताल tune.
12891: खेटिन् m. (-टी) A lecher, a libertine. E. खेट sport, affix इनि.
12893: खेडिताल m. (-लः) A minstrel: see खेटिताल.
12894: खेद m. (-दः) 1 Sorrow, affliction, distress. 2 Lassitude, depression. 3 Pain. 4 Poverty. E. खिद to be distrest, affix घञ्.
12896: खेदान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, pained. E. खेद, and अन्वित having.
12897: खेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Annoyed, harassed. 2 Afflicted, distressed, pained. E. खिद to give pain, क्त aff.
12898: खेदिनी f. (-नी) 1 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia:) see असनपर्णी. 2 A creeper, a creeping plant. E. खिद to be distrest, affixes णिनि and ङीष्.
12899: खेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be dug. n. (-यं) A ditch, a moat. E. खत to dig, affix क्यप्.
12900: खेल (ऋ) खेऌ r. 1st cl. (खेलति) To shake, to tremble, to move.
12901: खेलन n. (-नं) Play, sport, pastime. f. (-नी) A piece or man at drafts, chess, &c. E. खेल to shake or move, affix ल्युट्.
12902: खेला f. (-ला) Play, pastime, sport. E. खेल to shake, अङ् and टाप् affs.
12903: खेलि f. (-लिः) 1 A song, a hymn. 2 An arrow. 3 The sun. 4 A bird. 5 Any animal. E. खेल to shake, कि aff.
12904: खेव (ऋ) खेवृ r. 1st cl. (खेवते) To serve.
12905: खेसर m. (-रः) A mule. E. खे in air, सर who goes.
12906: खै r. 1st cl. (स्वायति) 1 To be firm or steady. 2 To kill, to injure or hurt. 3 To dig. 4 To mourn, to sorrow for.
12907: खोङ्काह m. (-हः) A white and brown horse.
12908: खोट r. 1st cl. (ऋ) खोदृ (खोटति) To be lame or lamed. r. 10th cl. (खोटयति) 1 To eat. 2 To throw or cast.
12909: खोटि f. (-टिः) A cunning or scheming woman; also read खोरि.
12910: खोटी f. (-टी) The gum olibanum tree.
12911: खोड (ऋ) खोडृ r. 1st cl. (खोडति) To be or become lame. r. 10th cl. (खोडयति) To throw or cast.
12912: खोड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Lame, limping. E. खोड to be lame, affix अच्.
12913: खोडकशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The arched roof of a house, the coping of a wall, &c. also खोडकशीर्षकः.
12914: खोर (ऋ) खोरृ r. 1st cl. (खोरति) To be lame, to be prevented from moving.
12915: खोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Lame. E. खोर to be lame, affix अच्; also खोड, and खोल.
12916: खोल (ऋ) खोऌ r. 1st cl. (खोलति) To be lame, to limp, to be prevented from moving. खोड, खोर, &c. are conceived by some authorities to be mere variations in the form of this root.
12917: खोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Lame. E. खोल to be lame, affix अच्; also खोर, &c.
12918: खोलक m. (-कः) 1 A helmet, armour for the head. 2 A pot, a saucepan. 3 An ant hill. 4 The shell of the betel nut. E. खुड to cover, affix ण्वुल्, ड changed to ल.
12920: खोल्क m. (-ल्कः) 1 A meteor. 2 A planet. E. ख, and उल्का torch.
12921: खोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet MARS. E. ख heaven, उल्मुक a hot coal.
12922: ख्या r. 2nd cl. (ख्याति) 1 To relate, to recount, to say or tell. 2 To celebrate, to make known. With अभि prefixed, To shine or be glorious. With आ, To be famous. With वि, To celebrate. With सु, To be approved. With कु, To be infamous. With प्रति and आ, To reject, to refuse. With सम्, To count, to reckon. With सं and आ, To denominate.
12923: ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Famous, celebrated, notorious. E. ख्या to relate, affix क्त.
12924: ख्यातगर्हण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Notoriously vile, infamous. E. ख्यात famous, गर्हण abuse; also ख्यातगर्हित.
12925: ख्यातगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Infamous: see the preceding.
12926: ख्याति f. (तिः) Fame, celebrity. E. ख्या to tell, affix क्तिन्.
12927: ख्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Declaring, making known, one who tells or declares. 2 One who confesses. E. ख्या to say, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
12928: ख्यापन n. (-नं) 1 Declaring, divulging, 2 Saying, avowing. 3 Confessing. 4 Explaining. E. ख्या causal form, ल्युट् aff. ग
12929: ग The third consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, the letter. G.
12930: ग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes, used chiefly in composition: as अधगः a traveller, who goes a road; अपगा what goes down, (a river, &c.) m. (-गः) 1 A name of the deity GAṆEŚA. 2 A Gandharba or celestial musician. f. (गा) A song. n. (-गं) Song, singing. E. गम to go or गै to sing, affix ड, fem. affix टाप्.
12931: गगण n. (-णं) Sky, atmosphere, heaven. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix, युच्, and the radical final changed to ग; the word and its derivatives are also sometimes read गगन.
12932: गगणध्वज m. (-जः) 1 A cloud. 2 The sun. E. गगण the sky, and ध्वज a standard or symbol.
12933: गगणाध्वग m. (-गः) 1 The sun. 2 A planet. 3 A heavenly spirit. E. गगण the sky, अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes.
12934: गगणपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A flower in the sky, i. e. an impossibility. E. गगण and पुष्प a flower; also गगणकुसुम, &c.
12935: गगणविहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Sporting in heaven. m. (-री) 1 The sun. 2 A heavenly luminary. 3 A divinity or celestial being. E. गगण, and विहारिन् who sports.
12936: गगणसद् mf. (-सत् or सद्) Going in the air. m. (-सद्) A celestial being. E. गगण, and षद to go, क्विप् aff.
12937: गगणस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Situated in the sky. E. गगण, and स्थ what stays in; also गगणस्थित, &c.
12938: गगणस्पर्शन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. गगण, and स्पर्शन who touches.
12939: गगणाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The highest heavens, the summit or highest part of heaven. E. गगण, and अग्र end.
12940: गगणेचर m. (-रः) 1 A planet. 2 An asterism. 3 A heavenly spirit. E. गगणे in the sky, चर who goes.
12941: गगणोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet Mars. E. गगण the sky, and उल्मका, a torch or coal.
12942: गग्घ r. 1st cl. (गग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride: see घग्घ.
12943: गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The river Ganges, or its personification as a goddess. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix गन्, or गां the accusative of गो the earth, and ग who goes, form irr.
12944: गङ्गाका f. (-का) The river Ganges. E. कन् added to the preceding; also read गङ्गका.
12945: गङ्गाक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) The river Ganges, and two Kos on either of its banks. E. गङ्गा, and क्षेत्र holy place; all dying within such limits going to heaven, whatever their crimes.
12946: गङ्गाचिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The black headed gull, (Larus ridibundus.) E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and चिल्ली a kite, considered by the Hindus as a species of that bird; the Gangetic kite.
12947: गङ्गाज m. (-जः) 1 A name of BHĪṢMA. 2 A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. गङ्गा the river goddess, and ज born; the son of GAṄGĀ.
12948: गङ्गाजल n. (-लं) The water of the Gaṅgā. E. गङ्गा, and जल water.
12949: गङ्गाटेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Going in or to the Ganges. m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn; also गलाविल. E. गङ्गा the river, and अट् to go, अच् affix, गङ्गाट, and ढक् added.
12950: गङ्गाद्वार n. (-रः) The place where the Gaṅgā enters the plains; also Haridvār. E. गङ्गा, and द्वार gate.
12951: गङ्गातीर m. (-रं) The bank of the Gaṅgā. E. गङ्गा, and तीर a bank.
12952: गङ्गाधर m. (-रः) 1 An epithet of ŚIVA. 2 The ocean. E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and धर who possesses or receives; according to the legend, the Ganges in its descent first alighted on the head of ŚIVA, and continued for some period entangled in his hair.
12953: गङ्गापार n. (-रं) The bank of the Ganges. E. गङ्गा and पार the bank.
12954: गङ्गापुत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 BHĪṢMA. 2 A man of a mixed and vile caste, employed to remove dead bodies. 3 A Brahman who conducts the ceremonies of pilgrimage at some places on the Ganges, especially at Benares, E. गङ्गा, and पुत्र a son.
12955: गङ्गामध्य n. (-ध्यं) The bed or stream of the Ganges. E. गङ्गा, and मध्य centre.
12956: गङ्गाम्बु n. (-म्बु) 1 Pure rain water, such as falls in Aśvin. 2 Ganges water. E. गङ्गा, and अम्बु water.
12957: गङ्गायात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Pilgrimage to the Gaṅgā. 2 Carrying a sick person to the river side to die there. E. गङ्गा, and यात्रा going.
12958: गङ्गासुत m. (-तः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A name of the hero BHĪṢMA: see गङ्गाज. E. गङ्गा, and सुत a son; the son of GAṄGĀ.
12959: गङ्गिका f. (-का) The Ganges. E. गङ्गा, and कन् affix fem. form; also गङ्गका, and गङ्गाका.
12960: गङ्गीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become as the Ganges, as sacred, &c. E. मङ्गा, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
12961: गच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree. E. गम to go, and स Uṇādi affix, what goes or grows; also अगच्छ.
12962: गच्छत् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छन्ती-च्छत्) Going. E. गम to go, शतृ aff.
12963: गज r. 1st cl. (गजति) To be drunk, to be confused or inebriated: r. 1st and 10th cls. (गजति गजयति) also (इ) गजि r. 1st cl. (गञ्जति) To sound.
12964: गज m. (-जः) 1 An elephant. 2 A measure of length, the Gaz, a yard, a measure of two cubits. 3 A mound of earth sloping on both sides, on which a house may be erected. 4 A small hole in the ground for a fire, over which to prepare medicines. E. गज to sound, to roar, affix अच्
12965: गजकन्द m. (-न्दः) A large esculent root, a sort of arum. E. गज, and कन्द root.
12966: गजकूर्म्माशिन् m. (-शी) A name of GARUḌA the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. गज an elephant, कूर्म्म a tortoise, and अशिन् who eats; alluding to a legend of his swallowing both animals whilst engaged in a contest with each other.
12967: गजचिर्भट mf. (-टः-टा) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)
12968: गजच्छाया f. (-या) A portion of time proper for a Śrāddha. E. गज, and छाया shadow.
12969: गजढक्का f. (-क्का) A kettle drum carried on an elephant. E. गज an elephant, and ढक्का a large drum.
12970: गजता f. (-ता) A multitude of elephants. E. गज an elephant, तल् aff.
12971: गजदघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) As high or tall as an elephant. E. गज, and दघ्नच् aff.
12972: गजदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 Ivory, the elephant's tooth. 3 A bracket or pin projecting from the wall. E. गज a elephant, and दन्त a tooth; GAṆEŚA is represented with an elephant's head.
12973: गजदान n. (-नं) The liquor exuding from an elephant's temples. E. गज, and दान the same.
12974: गजद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) As high as an elephant. E. गज, and द्वयसच् aff.
12975: गजपति m. (-तिः) 1 A large state elephant. 2 A king. E. गज, and पति a master.
12976: गजपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant bearing a seed which resembles pepper, (Pothos officinalis.) E. गज an elephant, and पिप्पली long pepper; considered to be a large species of pepper: see similar names, as करिपिप्पली, इभकणा, &c.
12977: गजपुङ्गव m. (-वः) A large and excellent elephant. E. गज, and पुङ्गव implying eminence.
12978: गजपुट m. (-टः) A small hollow for a fire, over which to prepare medical decoctions, extracts, &c. E. गज, and पुट a hollow.
12979: गजप्रिया f. (-या) The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia serrata). E. गज an elephant, and प्रिय beloved; also वल्लकी.
12980: गजबन्धनी f. (-नी) A post to which an elephant is bound. E. गज, and बन्धन a binding.
12981: गजभक्षक m. (-कः) The sacred fig tree. E. गज, and भक्षक eater; the young branches of the Pipal being the elephant's favourite food.
12982: गजभक्षा f. (-क्षा) The gum olibanum tree: see गजप्रिय. E. गज an elephant, and भक्षा food; also गजभक्ष्या.
12983: गजमण्डलिका f. (-का) A ring or circle of elephants surrounding a car, &c. E. गज, मण्डल a circle, कन् affix fem. form.
12984: गजमाचल m. (-लः) A lion. E. गज an elephant, मा fortune, and चल what goes; the destroyer of the elephant.
12985: गजमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) As tall as an elephant. E. गज, and मात्रच् aff.
12986: गजमुक्ता f. (-क्ता) A pearl, supposed to be found in the head of an elephant. E. गज, and मुक्ता a pearl.
12987: गजमोटन m. (-नः) A lion. E. गज an elephant, मुट to run away, in the causal form, affix ल्युट्; or with मुच to go, गजमोचन as it is sometimes read.
12988: गजयूथ m. (-थः) A herd of elephants. E. गज, and यूथ a herd.
12989: गजवदन m. (-नः) A name of GAṆEŚA, who is represented always with the head of an elephant. E. गज, and वदन a face.
12990: गजव्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Who walks like an elephant. n. (-जं) 1 A troop of elephants. 2 The pace of an elephant. E. गज, and व्रज a number or going, who goes, &c.
12991: गजसाह्वय n. (-यं) A famous city, Hastinapur the capital of the KURUS. E. गज, स for सम् with, and आह्वय an appellation; named from its elephants; also गजाह्व, &c.
12992: गजाग्रणी m. (-णीः) The elephant of INDRA. E. गज, and अग्रणी preeminent.
12993: गजाजीव m. (-वः) An elephant keeper or driver. E. गज, and आजीव who lives; who gets his livelihood by elephants.
12994: गजानन m. (-नः) The deity GAṆEŚA. E. गज an elephant, and आनन a face; see गजवदन.
12995: गजारि m. (-रिः) 1 A lion. 2 A particular tree. E. गज, and अरि a foe.
12996: गजारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted or riding on an elephant. E. गज, and आरूढ mounted.
12997: गजाशन m. (-नः) The religious fig tree. f. (-ना) 1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 2 The gum olibanum tree. 3 The root of a lotus. E. गज, and अशन food; the food of elephants.
12998: गजास्य m. (-स्यः) GAṆEŚA: see गजानन. E. गज an elephant, and आस्य a face.
12999: गजाह्व n. (-ह्वं) The city Hastinapur. f. (-ह्वा) A plant: see गजपिप्पली. E. गज, and आह्वा a name: see गजसाह्वय.
13000: गजाह्वय n. (-य) Hastinapur, the ancient Dehli: see the preceding.
13001: गजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A large and excellent elephant. 2 INDRA'S elephant. E. गज, and इन्द्र chief.
13002: गजोषणा f. (-णा) A sort of pepper: see गजपिप्पली. E. गज, and उषणा pepper.
13003: गञ्ज mfn. subst. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) A mine, a jewel mine. mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं) 1 A cow-house or station of cowherds. 2 A treasury, a jewel room, the place where plate, &c. is preserved. 3 A mart, a place where grain, &c. is stored for sale. m. (-ञ्जः) Disrespect, contempt. f. (-ञ्जा) 1 A tavern. 2 A drinking vessel. 3 A hut, a hovel, the abode of low people. 4 The Gunja or Ratti, (Abrus precatorius:) see गुञ्जा. E. गजि to sound, अच् affix; fem. affix टाप्.
13004: गञ्जिका f. (-का) A tavern. E. कन् added to the preceding.
13005: गड r. 1st cl. (गडति) To distil or drop, to run as a liquid; also, गल. (इ) गडि r. 1st cl. (गण्डति) To affect the cheek, to be rough as the cheek, (obsolete.)
13006: गड m. (-ड) 1 A kind of fish, the young of the Ophiocephalus lata, HAM. 2 Another species, (Cyprinus garra. HAM.) see गल. 3 An impediment, an obstacle. 4 A screen, a covering, a fence. 5 A moat, a ditch. 6 A country, part of Malva, Gerha or Gera Mendela. E. गड to drop, affix अच्.
13007: गडक m. (-कः) A kind of fish: see the last. E. गड to drop, affix क्वुन्
13008: गडयन्त m. (-न्तः) A cloud. E. गड to drop (water), Uṇādi affix झच् and अय substituted for the penultimate.
13009: गडलवण n. (-णं) Rock or fossile salt, especially that found in the district of Sāmbher in the province of Ajmere. E. गड a country, and लवण salt.
13010: गडि m. (-डिः) 1 A steer. 2 A lazy ox. E. गड to drop, इन् aff.
13011: गडु mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु) Crooked, humpbacked, &c. m. (-डुः) 1 A hump on the back. 2 Goitre or Bronchocele. 3 A humpbacked man. 4 A javelin, a spear. 5 An earth-worm. 6 A water pot. E. गड to drop, Uṇādi affix उ.
13012: गडुक n. (-कं) 1 A water pot. 2 A finger ring. E. कन् added to the last.
13013: गडुकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठी-ण्ठं) Having a goitre. E. गडु, and कण्ठ the throat.
13014: गडुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Crooked, bent, humpbacked. E. गडु a hump, and र substituted for ल: see the next.
13015: गडुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crooked, humpbacked. E. गडु hump, and लच् affix; also गडुर.
13016: गडेर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. गड to drop (water), and एरक् Uṇādi aff.
13017: गडोत्थ n. (-त्थं) Fossile salt. E. गड the country, and उत्थ produced.
13018: गडोल m. (-लः) 1 A mouthful. 2 Raw sugar. E. गड to drop, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also गण्डोल.
13019: गड्डरिका f. (-का) 1 A sudden rush of water of which the source is unknown. 2 A single ewe preceding a flock of sheep.
13020: गड्डुक m. (-कः) A golden vase. E. गड to sprinkle, डुक Uṇādi affix; also गड्डूक and occasionally गडुक.
13021: गड्डूक m. (-कः) A golden water vessel: see the preceding.
13022: गण r. 10th cl. (गणयति) To count, to reckon up by number, to calculate.
13023: गण m. (-णः) 1 A flock, a multitude, a troop, a tribe or class, &c. 2 A body of troops equal to three Gulmas, or twenty-seven chariots and as many elephants, eighty-one horses, and 135 foot. 3 Troops of inferior deities considered as ŚIVA'S attendants, and under the especial superintendence of GAṆEŚA. 4 A name of GAṆEŚA. 5 A number, (in arithmetic.) 6 A kind of perfume, commonly Cor. 7 A sect in philosophy or religion. 8 A conjugation, a class of radicals. 9 Series of asterisms which are classed under three heads, human, infernal, and divine. E. गण to count or reckon, affix अच्.
13024: गणक m. (-कः) 1 An astrologer, a calculator of nativities, &c. 2 An arithmetician. f. (-की) The wife of an astrologer. E. गण to calculate, affix क्वुन्, fem. affix ङीष्.
13025: गणकार m. (-रः) 1 A name of BHĪMASENA. 2 A classifier, one who arranges into classes. E. गण a troop, and कार who forms.
13026: गणचक्रक n. (-कं) A dinner in common by a party of virtuous men. E. गण a number, चक्र a wheel or circle, and कन् aff.
13027: गणता f. (-ता) 1 Classification. 2 Multitude, assemblage. 3 Following a party or faction. 4 Arithmetic. E. गण a class, तल् affix; also with त्व, गणत्वं.
13028: गणदीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Initiation of a particular kind in which GAṆEŚA is especially worshipped. 2 Initiation of a number or class. 3 Performance of religious rites for a number of persons. E. गण, and दीक्षा a religious rite.
13029: गणदीक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) 1 A priest who officiates for various castes and people. 2 One who has been initiated into the worship of GAṆEŚA. E. गण, दीक्षा a rite, and इनि aff.
13030: गणदेवता f. (-ता) A deity of a class, as an Āditya, a Vasu, a Rudra, &c. E. गण, and देवता a divinity.
13031: गणद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Public property, common stock. 2 A variety of articles. E. गण a class, and द्रव्य thing.
13032: गणधर m. (-रः) 1 The head of a class or number, the teacher of a school. 2 A title of the first disciples of the Jina Mahāvīra. E. गण a class, and धर who holds.
13033: गणन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Counting, enumerating. 2 Arithmetic. E. गण to count, युच् aff.
13034: गणनाथ m. (-थः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. गण, and नाथ lord.
13035: गणनायक m. (-कः) A name of GAṆEŚA. f. (-यिका) A name of DURGĀ. E. गण, and नायक a leader: see गणेश.
13036: गणनीय mfn. (-य-यी-यं) 1 Numerable, to be counted or reckoned. 2 To be classed. E. गण to count, and अनीयर् aff.
13037: गणपति m. (-तिः) GAṆEŚA. E. गण, and पति lord: see गणेश.
13038: गणपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The fabulous mountain Kailāsa. E. गण ŚIVA'S attendant demigods, and पर्ब्वत a mountain; this mountain being the residence of the Kinnaras, Yakṣas, and other subordinate deities.
13039: गणपीठक n. (-कं) The breast or bosom. E. गण the aggregate, (of qualities,) and पीठक a seat.
13040: गणरात्र n. (-त्रं) A multitude of nights. E. गण, and रात्र night.
13041: गणरूप m. (-पः) Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea;) also अर्क. E. गण a number, and रूप form, multiform.
13042: गणरूपिन् m. (-पी) Swallow wort, the white sort: see the preceding.
13043: गणवतीसुत m. (-तः) The name of a sage and physician; also called DHANVANTARI or KĀŚIRĀJA. E. गणवती a proper name, and सुत a son, the son of GAṆAVATĪ.
13044: गणहासक m. (-कः) Cor, a species of perfume. E. गण many, and हासक what causes to smile, what delights.
13045: गणाग्रणी m. (-णीः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. गण the troops of deities, and अग्रणी principal.
13046: गणाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Kailāsa. E. गण, and अचल a mountain, the residence of the GAṆAS or troops of demigods.
13047: गणाधिप m. (-पः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 A title of ŚIVA. 3 The chief of a troop of soldiers, of a class of disciples, of a body of men or animals, &c. E. गण, and अधिप master; also गणाधिपति, and other similar epithets: see गणेश.
13048: गणान्न n. (-न्नं) A mess, food prepared for a number of persons in common. E. गण, and अन्न food.
13049: गणाभ्यन्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One of a troop or number. m. (-रः) A member of a religious convent or association. E. गण, and अभ्यन्तर included.
13050: गणि f. (-णिः) Counting, enumerating. E. गण to count, इञ् aff.
13051: गणिका f. (-का) 1 A courtezan, a harlot. 2 A sort of jasmin, (J. auriculatum.) 3 A tree, commonly Ganiyari, (Premna spinosa.) 4 A female elephant. 5 Counting, enumerating. E. गण to reckon, &c. ण्वुल् aff.
13052: गणिकारिका f. (-का) The name of a small tree with a very fetid leaf, commonly called Ganiyāri, the wood of which is used in attrition, for the purpose of producing flame, (Premna spinosa.) E. कन् added to गणिकारी.
13053: गणिकारी f. (-री) The name of a tree: see the preceding.
13054: गणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Numbered, counted, reckoned, calculated. n. (-तं) 1 The science of computation, comprising arithmetic, algebra, and geometry, distinguished as पाटीगणितं, वीजगणितं and रेखागणितं. 2 Calculating, numbering. E. गण to count, affix क्त.
13055: गणितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be counted or numbered. 2 To be calculated. E. गण, and तव्य aff.
13056: गणिपिटका f. (-का) A division of science peculiar to the Jainas.
13057: गणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Included in any class or troop. 2 Calculated. E. गण, and भूत become, with च्चि augment.
13058: गणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Numberable, calculable, what may be reckoned or counted. E. गण to count, and यत् affix, form irr. see गण्य.
13059: गणेरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Pterospermum acerifolium, &c.) see कर्णिकार f. (-रुः) 1 A harlot, a whore. 2 A female elephant. E. गण a number, ईर to go, &c. affix उ.
13060: गणेरुका f. (-का) A bawd, a procuress. E. कन् added to the preceding.
13061: गणेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 GAṆEŚA the son of ŚIVA and PĀRVATĪ; he is the deity of wisdom, and remover of obstacles, whence in the commencement of all undertakings, the opening of all compositions, &c. he receives the reverential homage of the Hindus. He is represented as a short fat man, with the head of an elephant; and the present appellation, with other similar compounds, alludes to his office as chief of the various classes of subordinate gods, who are regarded as ŚIVA'S attendants. E. गण a troop or class (of deities attendant upon ŚIVA), and ईश lord or master.
13062: गणेशकुसुम m. (-मः) A shrub, Oleander with red flowers. E. गणेश, and कुसुम a flower.
13063: गणेशपूजा f. (-जा) Worship of GAṆEŚA. E. गणेश, and पृजा worship.
13064: गणेशभूषण n. (-णं) Red lead. E. गणेश, and भूषण ornament.
13065: गणोत्साह m. (-हः) A rhinoceros. E. गण a herd, and उत्साह toil.
13066: गण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A cheek, the whole side of the face including the temple. 2 An elephant's temple or cheek. 3 A boil, a pimple. 4 A mark, a spot. 5 A bubble. 6 A knot. 7 A rhinoceros: (see गण्डक.) 8 Part of a horse's trappings, a stud or button fixed as an ornament upon the harness. 9 A hero. 10 The abrupt interchange of question and answer, as one of the characteristics of the dramatic composition called Vīthi. 11 The tenth Yoga, or one of the twenty-seven portions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic: see योग. 12 An astronomical period. E. गडि to affect the cheek, अच् affix, or गम to go, ड Uṇādi aff.
13067: गण्डक m. (-कः) 1 A rhinoceros. 2 A mode of reckoning by fours. 3 An obstacle or impediment. 4 Separation, disjunction. 5 Astrological science or a part of it. f. (-की) The name of a river in the north of India, the Gandaki. f. (-का) A lump, a ball. E. गडि to affect the cheek, &c. ण्वुल् affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
13068: गण्डकारी f. (-री) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. गण्ड a boil, and कारी what occasions.
13069: गण्डकाली f. (-ली) See the preceding. E. गण्ड a knot, and काली black; black with many joints and knots.
13070: गण्डकुसुम n. (-मं) The juice that exudes from the elephant's temples in time of rut. E. गण्ड an elephant's temples, and कुसुम a flower, from its supposed fragrance.
13071: गण्डकूप m. (-पः) The peak or summit of a mountain.
13072: गण्डगात्र n. (-त्रं) A fruit, custard apple, (Annona squamosa.) E. गण्ड a boil, and गात्र a body; the inside being compared to purulent pustules.
13073: गण्डफलक n. (-कं) The cheek. E. गण्ड, and फलक a layer.
13074: गण्डमाला f. (-ला) Inflammation of the glands of the neck, &c. E. गण्ड a boil, and माला a necklace.
13075: गण्डमालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having the glands of the neck inflamed. E. इनि added to the last.
13076: गण्डशैल m. (-लः) 1 A rock or rocky fragment fallen from a height, thrown down by an earthquake, a storm, &c. 2 The forehead. E. गण्ड a cheek, and शैल a rock, the cheek of the mountain, or in the second instance, vice-versa, the mountain as it were of the cheek or face.
13077: गण्डस्थल nf. (-लः-ली) The cheek. E. गण्ड, and स्थल place.
13078: गण्डाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A rhinoceros. E. गण्ड a stud, and अङ्ग a body: from the studded appearance of his hide.
13079: गण्डाली f. (-ली) A bent grass with white blossoms, a white sort of Dūrvā, (Agrostis linearis.) E. गण्ड a boil, अल to be adequate to or fit for, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
13080: गण्डि m. (-ण्डिः) 1 Goitre or Bronchocele. 2 The trunk of a tree. E. गडि to affect the cheek, &c. Uṇādi affix इन्.
13081: गण्डीर m. (-रः) 1 A kind of potherb, described as growing in watery ground, and according to some, a species of cucumber. 2 A hero, a champion. f. (-री) A milky plant, (Euphorbia.) E. गडि to affect a part, &c. इरन् aff.
13082: गण्डु mf. (-ण्डुः) A pillow. f. (-ण्डूः) A knot or joint. E. गडि to support the cheek, Uṇādi affix उ.
13083: गण्डूपद m. (-दः) An earth-worm. f. (-दी) A small or female worm. E. गण्डू a knot, and पद a foot.
13084: गण्डूपदभव m. (-वः) Lead. E. गण्डूपद a worm, and भव produced.
13085: गण्डूष mf. (-षः-षा) 1 A mouthful. 2 A handful. 3 A handful of water, water, &c. held in the hollowed palm of the hand for rincing the mouth, &c. 4 Filling the mouth, rincing it, &c. 5 The tip of an elephant's trunk. E. गड to drop, ऊषण् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
13086: गण्डोल m. (-लः) 1 Raw sugar. 2 A mouthful. E. गड to drop, or गडि to affect the cheek, ओलच् affix; also गडोल. E. गल to court, यत् aff.
13087: गण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be counted or calculated. E. गण to count, affix of the future participle यत्; also irregularly गणेय.
13088: गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Known, understood. 3 Obtained, gained. 4 Lost. n. (-तं) Going, motion. 2 Any thing past or done, an event. E. गम to go, in the participle past.
13089: गतकाल n. (-लं) Time past. E. गत, and काल time.
13090: गतक्लम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Rested, refreshed. E. गत, and क्लम fatigue.
13091: गतचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Senseless, swooned. E. गत, and चेतना consciousness.
13092: गतज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Well, recovered, free from fever or sickness. E. गत, and ज्वर fever.
13093: गततोयद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Cloudless, cleared up, fair. E. गत, and तोयद a cloud.
13094: गतप्रत्यागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Returned, come back again after having gone away. E. गत, and प्रत्य, गत come back.
13095: गतदिन n. (-नं) Yesterday. E. गत, and दिन day; also गतदिवसं.
13096: गतधृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Agitated, discomposed, unsteady. E. गत, and धृति firmness.
13097: गतनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Noseless. E. गत gone, lost, and नासिका the nose.
13098: गतमाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Reformed, without deceit. 2 Cruel without compassion. E. गत, and माया deceit.
13099: गतलक्ष्मीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, suffering losses; so गतदीक.
13100: गतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Going, passing. 2 Obtaining. 3 Falling into. 4 Feeling, entertaining. E. गम, and क्तवतु aff.
13101: गतवित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Beggared, impoverished. E. गत, and वित्त wealth.
13102: गतविभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Poor, indigent. E. गत, and विभव wealth.
13103: गतव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Free from pain. 2 Unanxious. E. गत, and व्यथ pain.
13104: गतशैशव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Grown up, above eight years of age. गत, and शैशव infancy.
13105: गतसङ्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Bereft of sense, foolish. E. गत, and सङ्कल्प purpose.
13106: गतसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Detached from, dissevered. 2 Adverse or indifferent to. E. गत, and सङ्ग union.
13107: गतसत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) 1 Base. 2 Lifeless, dead, &c. E. गत, and सत्व being.
13108: गतसन्नक m. (-कः) An elephant out of rut.
13109: गताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Blind, sightless. E. गत gone, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
13110: गतागत n. (-तं) 1 The flight of a bird backward and forward. 2 Going and coming, reiterated motion in general. E. गत going, आगत coming.
13111: गतानुगतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Following, imitating, imitative, doing as others do. E. गत, and अनुगतिक who goes after.
13112: गतायुस् mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) 1 Very old, infirm, decrepid, decayed. 2 Dead. E. गत, and आयुस् life.
13113: गतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) 1 A woman past child bearing. 2 A barren woman. E. गत, and आर्त्तवा a woman menstruating.
13114: गतार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Unmeaning, nonsensical. 2 Poor. 3 Void of an object. E. गत, and अर्थ sense, &c.
13115: गतासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Dead, expired. E. गत, and असु breath.
13116: गति f. (-तिः) 1 Going, moving, motion in general. 2 March, procession. 3 A road, a way, a path. 4 A period of life, as age, youth, &c. 5 An expedient, a means of success. 6 Knowledge, wisdom. 7 A sinus, a fistular sore. 8 Worldly vanity or wickedness. 9 Course of events, fate, fortune. 10 Resource, refuge, asylum. 11 The diurnal motion of a planet in its orbit. 12 State, mode of existence. E. गम to go, affix क्तिन.
13117: गतिक n. (-कं) 1 Going, motion. 2 Refuge, asylum. 3 Course. 4 Condition. E. कन् added to the preceding.
13118: गतिला f. (-ला) 1 The name of a river, the Gatilā. 2 Mutual separation. E. गप्त to go, इल Uṇādi affix, and त substituted for the radical final.
13119: गत्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going, moving, locomotive. E. गम to go, affix क्वरप्.
13120: गत्वा ind. Having gone, gone to or attained, &c. E. गम to go, क्त्वा aff.
13121: गत्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Impassable, difficult of access. 2 Desert. 3 Helpless. E. गति, and ऊन् defective.
13122: गद r. 10 cl. (गदति) 1 To speak articulately. 2 To be sick, r. 10th cl. (गदयति) To thunder.
13123: गद m. (-दः) 1 Disease, sickness. 2 Speech, speaking. 2 GADA the younger brother of KṚṢṆA. f. (-दा) 1 A mace, a club. 2 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. गद to speak, &c. अच् aff.
13124: गदयित्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) 1 Loquacious, talkative, talking much or idly. 2 Libidinous, lustful, desirous. m. (-त्नुः) A name of KANDARPA, the deity of love. E. गद to speak, Uṇādi affix इत्नुच्, and अय inserted.
13125: गदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) A kind of Costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ठ.
13126: गदागद m. (always dual -दौ) The two physicians of Svarga, the sons of AŚVINĪ by SŪRYA. E. गद disease in general, and अगद health.
13127: गदाग्रज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. गद, and अग्रज an elder brother.
13128: गदाधर m. (-रः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. गदा a club, and धर who holds; KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU is represented holding a mace in one of his hands.
13129: गदाभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA. 2 A mace or club bearer. 3 One who fights with a mace. E. गदा a club, and भृत् who nourishes: see the preceding.
13130: गदाम्बर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. गद sound, अम्बर the sky.
13131: गदाराति m. (-तिः) A drug, a medicament. E. गद, and अराति an enemy.
13132: गदाहू n. (-ह्वं) A kind of grass, (Costus speciosus:) see कुष्ठ. E. गद disease, and आह्वा a name; named by many of the same terms as disease: see व्याधि, &c.; also गदाख्य, गदाह्वय, &c.
13133: गदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said. E. गद to speak, क्त aff.
13134: गदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Saying, speaking, having spoken. E. गद, and क्तततु aff.
13135: गदिन् m. (-दी) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A mace bearer. 3 One armed with a club. 4 A sick man. E. गदा a mace, and इनि poss. aff.
13136: गद्गद m. (-दः) Indistinct or convulsive utterance, as sobbing, &c. E. गद to speak, क्विप् affix, root repeated with अच्.
13137: गद्गदध्वनि m. (-निः) Low inarticulate expression of joy or grief. E. गद्गद inarticulate utterance, and ध्वनि sound.
13138: गद्गदपद n. (-दं) Inarticulate speech. गद्गद, and पद a word.
13139: गद्गदवाच् f. (-बाक्) Inarticulate or convulsive speech, interrupted by sobbing, &c. E. गद्गद, and वाच् speech.
13140: गद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be spoken or uttered. n. (-द्यं) Prose. E. गद to speak, affix यत्.
13141: गद्यानक n. (-कं) A weight either of sixty-four or forty-eight Rattis; also read गद्यालक.
13142: गन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be gone, to be gone to or attained. E. गम, and तव्य aff.
13143: गन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A traveller, a way-farer. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix तुन्.
13144: गन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Who or what goes or moves. E. गम to go, तृच् aff.
13145: गन्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A cart or car drawn by oxen. E. गम to go, ष्ट्रन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
13146: गन्त्रीरथ m. (-थः) A cart. E. गन्त्री a carriage drawn by oxen, and रथ a vehicle.
13147: गन्ध r. 10th cl. (गन्धयते) 1 To injure, to hurt or kill. 2 To move, to go. 3 To ask or beg.
13148: गन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Smell, odour. 2 A perfume, a fragrance or fragrant substance. 3 A diffusive fragrance. 4 Sulphur. 5 Connexion, relationship. 6 A neighbour. 7 A plant, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) 8 Pride, arrogance. 9 Small, diminutive, a little, a small quantity, &c. 10 Pounded Sandal. f. (-न्धा) The bud of the Champaca flower, (Michelia Champaca.) n. (-न्धं) Aloe-wood. E. गन्ध to hurt, to move, &c. affix अच्.
13149: गन्धक m. (-कः) 1 Sulphur. 2 The morunga tree, (M. hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन. E. कन् added to the preceding.
13150: गन्धकारिका f. (-का) A female artisan, living in the house of another woman. E. गन्ध perfume, and कारिका who makes.
13151: गन्धकालिका f. (-का) The mother of VYĀSA. E. कन् added to the next.
13152: गन्धकाली f. (-ली) The mother of the poet VYĀSA. E. गन्ध perfume, कल to make, affixes अण् and ङीप् having a strong scent.
13153: गन्धकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A fragrant wood, as Sandal, aloewood, &c. E. गन्ध smell, and काष्ठ timber.
13154: गन्धकुटी f. (-टी) A kind of perfume, commonly Mura. E. गन्ध smell, &c. कुटी abode.
13155: गन्धखेड n. (-डः) A fragrant grass. E. गन्ध, and खेड grass; also with कन् added गन्धखेडकं: see गन्धतृण.
13156: गन्धगज m. (-जः) An elephant of the best kind. E. गन्ध odour, गज an elephant.
13157: गन्धगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having the property of odour. E. गन्ध and गुण quality.
13158: गन्धघ्राण n. (-णं) Smelling any odour. E. गन्ध, and घ्राण smelling.
13159: गन्धचेलिका f. (-का) Musk. E. गन्ध fragrance, चेलि clothes, affix कन्; being used for scenting clothes.
13160: गन्धजात n. (-तं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. गन्ध smell, and जात produced; fragrant.
13161: गन्धज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) The nose. E. गन्ध scent, and ज्ञा who knows.
13162: गन्धतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A musical instrument, one of a loud sound used in battle: (a drum or trumpet.) E. गन्ध pride, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
13163: गन्धतृण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) E. गन्ध, and तृण grass.
13164: गन्धत्वच् f. (-त्वक्) A sort of perfume, commonly Elavāluka. E. गन्ध and त्वच् skin, rind.
13165: गन्धद्विप m. (-पः) An elephant of the best class, supposed to emit a particular smell at all times. E. गन्ध, and द्विप an elephant.
13166: गन्धधूलि f. (-लिः) Musk, the fragrant secretion of the musk-deer. E. गन्ध fragrant, and धूलि dust.
13167: गन्धन n. (-नं) 1 Continued effort, perseverance. 2 Injury, hurting, killing. 3 Intimation, information. 4 Manifestation. E. गन्ध to hurt, to move, &c. affix ल्युट्.
13168: गन्धनकुल m. (-लः) The musk-rat of Bengal, (Sorex moschata.) E. गन्ध scented, and नकुल an ichneumon.
13169: गन्धनाकुली f. (-ली) A plant, possibly the serpent Ophioxylon: see रास्ना. E. गन्ध smelling, and नाकुली the same plant.
13170: गन्धनामन् m. (-मा) A fragrant kind of basil. E. गन्ध fragrance, and नामन् a name.
13171: गन्धनाली f. (-ली) The nose. E. गन्ध scent, and नाली a tubular canal.
13172: गन्धनिलया f. (-या) Double jasmin, (J. Zambac floribus multiplicatis.) E. गन्ध smell, and निलय a house.
13173: गन्धपत्र m. (-त्रः) A white sort of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum:) see श्वेतपर्णास. f. (-त्री) 1 A sort of zedoary, (-त्रा) Ajwaen, (Ligusticam ajwaen.) 2 Another plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. गन्ध, and पत्र a leaf.
13174: गन्धपलाशिका f. (-का) Turmeric. E. गन्ध small, पलाश a leaf.
13175: गन्धपलाशी f. (-शी) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) E. गन्ध, and पलाश a leaf.
13176: गन्धपाषाण m. (-णः) Sulphur. E. गन्ध smelling, and पाषाण a stone.
13177: गन्धपिशात्रिका f. (-का) The smell of incense, diffusive incense. E. गम्म smell, पिशाचिका female demon; imp-like, from its dark colour or cloudy nature; or attracting demons by its fragrance.
13178: गन्धपीता f. (-ता) A species of zedoary. E. गन्ध, and पीत yellow.
13179: गन्धपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A kind of cane, (Calamus roatang.) 2 Another plant, (Alangium hexapetalum:) see अङ्कोट. 3 Sebesten, (Cordia myxa.) f. (-ष्पा) 1 The indigo plant. 2 Ganiyāri, (Premna spinosa, &c.) see गणिकारी. n. (-ष्पं) Flowers and Sandal presented together at seasons of worship. E. गन्ध smell, and पुष्प flower; having odoriferous flowers.
13180: गन्धफल m. (-लः) 1 Elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. 2 The Bel, (Ægle crataeva.) f. (-ला or -ली) 1 A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. 2 The gum olibanum tree. f. (-ली) The blossom of the Champaca: see चम्पक. E. गन्ध smell, and फल a fruit.
13181: गन्धबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The mango tree. E. गन्ध a smell, and बन्धु a friend.
13182: गन्धभद्रा f. (-द्रा) A creeper commonly Gandhabhādali or Ghandali, (Poederia fetida?) E. गन्ध smell, and भद्र auspicious.
13183: गन्धभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्धभाण्ड.
13184: गन्धमांसी f. (-सी) A kind of Indian spikenard: see जटामांसी.
13185: गन्धमातृ f. (-ता) The earth. E. गन्ध scent, and मातृ the mother; the property of fragrance residing in the earth or earthy atoms.
13186: गन्धमादन mn. (-नः-नं) The name of a particular mountain, forming the division between Ilāvṛtta and Bhadrāśva or to the east of Meru. m. (-नः) 1 A large black bee. 2 Sulphur. 3 The name of one of the monkey chiefs. f. (-नी) Spirituous liquor; also in some books read गन्धमादिनी. E. गन्ध smell, मद to inebriate in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
13187: गन्धमादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Strong scented, of intoxicating odour. f. (-नी) 1 Lac. 2 A sort of perfume. 3 Wine or spirituous liquor. E. गन्ध, and मादिन् what intoxicates.
13188: गन्धमार्जार m. (-रः) The civet-cat. E. गन्ध smell, and मार्जार a cat.
13189: गन्धमालिनी f. (-नी) Murā, a perfume so called. E. गन्ध smell, माला a necklace, affixes इनि and ङीप्.
13190: गन्धमुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A creeper, (Hibiscus populneoides;) also गन्थभाण्ड.
13191: गन्धमूल m. (-लः) A plant with a fragrant and tuberous root, one of the Scitaminea, (Alpinia galanga:) see कुलञ्जन. f. (-ला or -ली) 1 A species of Curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.) 2 The olibanum tree. E. गन्ध smell, and मूल a root, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्; also with कन् affix गन्धमूलक.
13192: गन्धमूलक m. (-कः) A sort of Curcuma; also गन्धमूली: see the preceding.
13193: गन्धमूषिक mf. (-कः-का) The musk-rat or shrew, (Sorex moschata;) also in the fem. गन्धमृषी.
13194: गन्धमृग m. (-गः) The civet-cat. E. गन्ध smell, and मृग a deer; the name also may be applied to the musk-deer.
13195: गन्धमोदन n. (-नं) Sulphur. E. गन्ध, and मोदन pleasing.
13196: गन्धमैथुन m. (-नः) A bull. E. गन्ध smell, and मैथुन copulation.
13197: गन्धमोहिनी f. (-नी) The Champaca flower. E. गन्ध smell, and मोहिनी delighting.
13198: गन्धरस m. (-सः) Myrrh. E. गन्ध smell, and रस essence; also रसगन्ध.
13199: गन्धराज n. (-जं) 1 Sandal. 2 Any sweet smelling flower. f. (-जी) 1 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi: see नखी. E. गन्ध smell, and राज what excels, from राज to shine, affix अच्; fem. affix ङीष्.
13200: गन्धर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) 1 A Gandharba or celestial musician; these demigods inhabit INDRA'S heaven, and form the orchestra at all the banquets of the principal deities. 2 A horse. 3 A kind of deer; according to some authorities, the musk-deer. 4 The soul after death, and previous to its being born again, corresponding, in some respects, to the western notion of ghosts. 5 A singer in general. 6 The Koïl or black cuckoo. 7 The sun. 8 A sage, a pious man. E. गन्ध smell, injury, &c. अर्ब्ब to go, affix अच्, the अ final of गन्ध is rejected; the root is also sometimes written with the dental letter अर्व्व, when the compound will be गन्धर्व्व; the best authorities however write it with the final labial letter ब as above.
13201: गन्धर्ब्बविद्या f. (-द्या) Music, dancing, &c. E. गन्धर्ब्ब, and विद्या science.
13202: गन्धर्ब्बविवाह m. (-हः) Marriage by mutual consent, without any ceremonies, allowable between persons of the second class. E. गन्धर्ब्ब, and विवाह marriage.
13203: गन्धर्ब्बवेद m. (-दः) The science of music considered as a branch of the Sāma Veda. E. गन्धर्ब्ब, and वेद a Veda.
13204: गन्धर्ब्बहस्त m. (-स्तः) The castor-oil tree, (Palma christi or Ricinus communis.) E. गन्धर्ब्ब a deer, and हस्त hand or foot; the leaves being compared to the foot of the deer; also with कन् added गन्धर्ब्बहस्तक.
13205: गन्धलोलुपा f. (-पा) A fly or gnat. E. गन्ध smell, &c. लोलुप unsteady.
13206: गन्धवणिज् m. (-णिक्) A perfumer, a dealer in perfumes. E. गन्ध, and वणिज a dealer.
13207: गन्धवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Scented, smelling, odoriferous. f. (-ती) 1 The earth. 2 The name of a city. 3 Wine or vinous liquor. 4 A kind of perfume: see मुरा. 5 The mother of VYĀSA. 6 A wild species of Ajväen: see यमानी. E. गन्ध smell, मतुप् poss. affix fem. ङीप्.
13208: गन्धवल्कल n. (-लं) 1 Cassia bark. 2 Sarsaparilla. E. गन्ध, and वल्कल bark.
13209: गन्धवल्लरी f. (-री) A plant; also सहदेवी. E. गन्ध smell, and वल्लर a pedicle, or with वल्ली the same, गन्धवल्ली.
13210: गन्धवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Smelling, fragrant, &c. m. (-हः) The wind. f. (-हा) The nose. E. गन्ध smell, and वह what conveys, from वह to bear, &c., and अच् aff.
