13211: गन्धवाह m. (-हः) 1 The wind. 2 A deer, the musk-deer. f. (-हा) The nose. E. गन्ध smell, वह to convey, and अण् aff.
13213: गन्धवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. गन्ध perfume, and वृक्ष a tree, yielding a fragrant resin.
13214: गन्धव्याकुल n. (-लं) A perfume, a fragrant berry: see कक्कोल. E. गन्ध smell, and व्याकुल disturbed.
13215: गन्धशटी f. (-टी) A sort of Curcuma: see शटी. E. गन्ध smell, and शटी the same plant.
13216: गन्धशालि m. (-लिः) A sweet smelling kind of rice. E. गन्ध, and शालि rice.
13217: गन्धशुण्डिनी f. (-नी) The musk-rat or shrew. E. गन्ध, and शुण्डिनी a rat; also गन्धाशुण्डिनी.
13218: गन्धशेखर m. (-रः) Musk. E. गन्ध, and शेखर chief, a principal perfume.
13219: गन्धसार m. (-रः) Sandal. E. गन्ध, and सार essence, the essence of perfume.
13220: गन्धसूयी f. (-यी) The musk shrew or small musk-rat. E. गन्ध smell, and सू to produce, affixes युक् and ङीप्; also sometimes read गन्धसुखी, from गन्ध and सुख pleasure.
13221: गन्धसोम n. (-मं) The white esculent water lily. E. गन्ध smell, and सोम the moon; opening its petals at night.
13222: गन्धहारिका f. (-का) A female artisan working in another person's house.
13223: गन्धाखु m. (-खुः) A musk-rat. E. गन्ध smell, and आखु a rat: see गन्धसूयी, &c.
13224: गन्धाजीव m. (-वः) A vender of perfumes. E. गन्ध, and आजीव who gets a livelihood.
13225: गन्धाढ्य m. (-ढ्यः) The orange tree. f. (-ढ्या) A plant: see गन्धाली. E. गन्ध, and आढ्य wealth, rich in odour.
13226: गन्धापकर्षण n. (-णं) Removing any smell. E. गन्ध, and अपकर्षण taking away.
13227: गन्धाला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly Jiyati, (Celtis orientalis.)
13228: गन्धाली f. (-ली) 1 Gandhali or Gandbhadalīya, a plant, (Paederia fetida.) 2 A wasp: see गन्धोली. E. गन्ध smell, and आली a line, a quantity.
13229: गन्धाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) Sulphur. E. गन्ध smell, and अश्मन् a stone.
13230: गन्धाष्टक n. (-कं) A class of eight fragrant articles used in worship, &c. as a Sandal, agallochum, camphor, saffron, valerian, and some fragrant grasses. E. गन्ध, and अष्टक eight collectively.
13231: गन्धिक m. (-कः) Sulphur. E. गन्ध smell, and ठक् affix; also गन्धक.
13232: गन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Smelling, odoriferous. m. (-न्धी) 1 A bug; also the flying bug. 2 A tree, (Xanthophyllum virens.) f. (-नी) A kind of perfume: see Mura. E. गन्ध smelling, इनि poss. aff.
13233: गन्धोतु m. (-तुः) The civet-cat. E. गन्ध smell, and ओतु a cat; also गन्धौतु.
13234: गन्धोत्तमा f. (-मा) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. गन्ध odour, and उत्तम excellent.
13235: गन्धोपजीविन् m. (-वी) A perfumer. E. गन्ध, and उपजीविन् who lives by.
13236: गन्धोलि f. (-लिः or -ली) A kind of cucumber, (C. reclinata, Rox.) (-ली) 1 A wasp. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गन्ध to smell or injure, ओलच affix, इन् or ङीष् fem. aff.
13237: गभलि mf. (-स्तिः) A ray of light, a sun or moon-beam. m. (-स्तिः) The sun. f. (-स्तिः) A name of SVĀHĀ the wife of AGNI. E. ग for गो the heaven, भस to shine, and क्तिच् aff.
13238: गभस्तिमत् m. (-मान्) The sun. n. (-मत्) One of the seven divisions of Pātāla or regions below the earth. E. गभस्ति a ray of light, and मतुप् poss. aff.
13239: गभस्तिहस्त m. (-स्तः) The sun. E. गभस्ति a ray, and हस्त a hand; wielding the sun-beams.
13240: गभीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Deep. 2 Thick, impervious, (as a forest.) 3 Profound, sagacious. 4 Deep in sound, hollow-toned. E. गम to go, भ substituted for the final, ईरन् Uṇādi affix; also with नुम् inserted गम्भीर.
13241: गभीरध्वनि m. (-निः) 1 Deep sound. 2 A low note or tone. E. गभीर, and ध्वनि sound; also गभीरनाद, गभीरशब्द, &c.
13242: गभीरिका f. (-का) 1 A large drum. 2 A gong. E. गभीर deep, (as sound,) कन् affix, and the fem. form.
13243: गभोलिक m. (-कः) A small round pillow.
13244: गम (औ, ऌ) औगसॢ r. 1st cl. (गच्छति) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To arrive at, to accomplish or attain. With अनु prefixed, To follow, to imitate. With आङ् (आगच्छति) 1 To come, to arrive. 2 To go to or unto. 3 (आगमयते) To wait, to delay. With अधि, 1 To obtain, to gain or acquire. 2 To go over, as a book or set of rules, to peruse, to learn. 3 To pass over, to omit. With अप, To go back or away, to separate. With अव, To know, to understand. With उत्, 1 To approach, to go near to. 2 To go up, to rise. With उप, 1 To produce. 2 To go near. 3 To consent to. With उप and आङ्, To approach. With दुर्, To go with difficulty. With नि, To acquire knowledge. With निर्, To go forth or out. With परि and उत्, To rise as from a seat, &c. With परि, 1 To surround. 2 To go away. With प्रति and आङ्, To return or arrive at. With वि, To go against as an enemy. With सम्, (संगच्छते) 1 To go with, to accompany. 2 To meet, to encounter. (संगच्छति) To go to, (in a transitive sense.) With सम and आङ् To meet, to unite. With सम and उप, To submit to, to yield. With सु, 1 To go easily or well. 2 To arrive at.
13245: गम m. (-मः) 1 Going, moving. 2 March, especially the march of an assailant. 3 A road. 4 A game played with dice and men, as backgammon, &c. 5 Acting inconsiderately, looking at any thing hastily and superficially. 6 Reading lightly, hasty or careless perusal, running over a book, &c. E. गम to go, घञ् aff.
13246: गमकारित्व n. (-त्वं) Rashness, inconsiderateness. E. गम as above, कारिन् who does or acts, and त्व abstract aff.
13247: गमथ m. (-थः) 1 A road. 2 A traveller. E. गम to go, अथ Uṇādi aff.
13248: गमन n. (-नं) 1 Going in general. 2 March in general, or the march of an assailant. 3 Cohabitation. 4 Obtaining, attaining. E. गम to go or move, affix ल्युट्.
13249: गमनार्ह m. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) To be sought, fit, suitable, desirable. E. गमत, and अर्ह worthy.
13250: गमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 What may be gone to or reached, attainable, accessible. 2 What ought to be followed, to be practised or observed. E. गम, and अनीयर् aff.
13251: गमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing or making to go. E. गम to go, causal form, शतृ aff.
13252: गमागम m. (-मः) Going and coming. E. गम, and आगम going.
13253: गमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Caused to go, sent, brought, reduced, driven to, &c. E. गम to go, causal form, क्त aff.
13254: गमिन् m. (-भी) A passenger. E. गम to go, इनि Uṇādi affix, otherwise with णिनि affix, गामिन्.
13255: गम्ब r. 1st cl. (गम्बति) To go or move.
13256: गम्भारी f. (-री) The name of a tree, commonly called by the same name Gambhāri, (Gmelina arborea.) E. क water, भृ to nourish, affixes अण् and ङीष्, क is changed to ग and into the second case.
13257: गम्भीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Deep, (as water, but applied metaphorically to sound, intellect, &c. as in English.) 2 Dull, slow. m. (-रः) A Mantra or magical incantation written in prose in the Rig Veda. 2 A lotus. 3 The citron. f. (-रा) Hiccup, violent singultus. E. गम to go, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, म changed to भ, and नुम् inserted: see गभीर.
13258: गम्भीरता f. (-ता) 1 Depth, (of water.) 2 Depth of thought, profoundness. 3 Depth of sound. E. गम्भीर, and तल् affix; also गम्भीरत्वं.
13259: गम्भीरनाद m. (-दः) A deep or hollow sound, thundering, roaring, &c. E. गम्भीर, and नाद sound; also similar compounds, as गम्भीरध्वनि, गम्भीरशव्य; also with गभीर, गभीरनाद, &c.
13260: गम्भीरवेदिन् m. (-दी) A restive elephant. E. गम्भीर dull, and विद to know, affix णिनि.
13261: गम्भीरार्थ n. (-र्थं) Profound sense or meaning. E. गम्भीर, and अर्थ sense.
13262: गम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Attainable, accessible. 2 To be gone, to be gone to. 3 Perceptible. 4 Desirable, suitable, fit. E. गम to go, यत् aff.
13263: गम्यता f. (-ता) 1 Accessibility. 2 Perceptibility. 3 Being capable of attainment. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, गन्यत्वं.
13264: गम्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be gone, to be traversed, to be gone to, &c. E. गम to go, passive v., शानच् aff.
13265: गय m. (-यः) 1 A species of ox, the Gayal or Bos Gavoeus. 2 The name of a royal or military saint. 3 The name of an Asura. 4 One of the monkey chiefs of the Rāmāyaṇa. f. (-या) Gaya, a city in Behār still so called, and a place of pilgrimage; the capital of the saint of the same name; it was made holy by the benediction of VIṢṆU, who granted its sanctity to the piety of Gaya the Rājarṣi; or according to another legend to Gaya the Asura, who was overwhelmed here by the deities with rocks; sacrifices should be offered once at least in the life of every Hindu to his progenitors at Gaya. E. गै to sing, डय aff.
13266: गर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 Poison. 2 An antidote. m. (-रः) Sickness, disease. n. (-रं) 1 Sprinkling, wetting. 2 The fifth of the eleven Karaṇas. f. (-रा) Swallowing. (-री) A species of grass, (Andropogon serratus); also गरागरी. E. गर to hurt, and अच् affix, or गृ to wet or sprinkle, or again गॄ to swallow, affix अप्.
13267: गरघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) 1 Antidote, an antidote. 2 Sanative, healthy. m. (-घ्नः) A species of Basil. f. (-घ्नी) A fish (the young of the Ophiocephalus lata, HAM.) E. गर, and घ्न what destroys.
13268: गरण n. (-णं) 1 Wetting, sprinkling. 2 Swallowing. E. गृ to wet, or गृ to swallow, affix ल्युट्.
13269: गरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 A poisoner, poisoning. 2 Unwholesome, occasioning sickness. n. (-दं) Poison. E. गर poison, and द who gives.
13270: गरब्रत m. (-तः) A peacock. E. गर sprinkling, (of rain,) and ब्रत religious observance.
13271: गरभ m. (-भः) The foetus or embryo: see गर्भ. E. गृ to drop, &c. अभच् aff.
13272: गरल n. (-लं) 1 The venom of a snake or venom in general. 2 A bundle of grass, or hay. 3 Measure in general. E. गर poison, &c. and ल what gets or possesses.
13273: गरलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Venomous, poisonous. E. गरल, and इनि aff.
13274: गरागरी f. (-री) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus:) see खरा and गरी; also अगरी.
13275: गरात्मक n. (-कं) The seed of the Śobhāñjana or Morunga. E. गर poison, and आत्मक nature.
13276: गराधिका f. (-का) Lac, the animal red dye so called.
13277: गरिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Weight, heaviness. 2 Venerableness. E. गुरु and इमनिच् aff.
13278: गरिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Heaviest, excessively heavy. 2 Very venerable. E. गुरु heavy, इष्ठच् superlative affix, deriv. irr.
13279: गरीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Heaviest, very heavy. 2 Highly venerable. 3 Worst. E. see the last, affix ईयसुन्.
13280: गरुड m. (डः) The bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU; he is generally represented as a being something between a man and a bird, and considered as sovereign of the feathered race; he is the son of KAŚYAPA and VINATĀ, and younger brother of ARUṆA. E. गरुत् a wing, डी to fly, affix ड, and the त of the noun dropped, who flies like a bird, or गृ to moisten, and उडच् Uṇādi aff.
13281: गरुडध्वज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. गरुड, and ध्वज a symbol; whose symbol is GARUḌA.
13282: गरुडरुत n. (-तं) A species of metre having four lines to the stanza, and sixteen syllables to each line.
13283: गरुडाग्रज m. (-जः) ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. E. गरुड, and अग्रज elder born; the elder brother of GARUḌA.
13284: गरुडाङ्कित n. (-तं) An emerald. E. गरुड GARUḌA, and अङ्किय marked.
13285: गरुडाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) An emerald. E. गरुड, and अश्मान् a stone: see the preceding.
13286: गरुडोत्तीर्ण n. (-णं) The emerald. E. गरुत, and उत्तीर्ण passed over.
13287: गरुत् m. (-रुत्) A wing. E. गृ to moisten, and उति Uṇādi aff.
13288: गरुत्मत् m. (-त्मान्) 1 The bird of VIṢṆU. 2 A bird in general. E. गरुत् a wing, and मतुप् poss. aff.
13289: गरुद्योधिन् m. (-धी) A quail. E. गरुत् a wing, and योधिन् who fights.
13290: गर्ग m. (-र्ग) One of the ten principal Munis or saints, a son of BRAHMĀ. f. (गर्गी) Wife of GARGA. E. गृ to sprinkle, ग Uṇādi aff.
13291: गर्गर m. (-रः) 1 A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora, HAM) f. (-री) 1 A churn. 2 A water vessel, a guglet. E. गर्ग an imitative sound, a guggling, and र what makes.
13292: गर्गाट m. (-टः) A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora, HAM.)
13293: गर्गीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) A descendant of GARGA. E. गर्ग, and छ aff.
13294: गर्घ r. 1st cl. (गर्घति) To go or move.
13295: गर्ज r. 10th cl. (गर्जयति) To sound. r. 1st cl. (गर्जति) To emit a deep or full sound, to sound as distant thunder, to roar as a lion, &c.
13296: गर्ज n. (-र्जं) 1 The roaring of elephants. 2 The grumbling of clouds, &c. E. गर्ज to roar or growl, affix अच्.
13297: गर्जक m. (-कः) A fish, commonly Gajar. E. गर्ज to grumble, affix वुन्.
13298: गर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Sound, noise. 2 Passion, wrath. 3 Excessive indignation. 4 Reproach, menace. 5 War, battle, conflict. 6 The grumbling of clouds, &c. E. गर्ज to grumble or roar, affix ल्युट्.
13299: गर्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sounded or roared. E. गर्ज to sound, अनीयर् aff.
13301: गर्जि m. (-र्जिः) The muttering of clouds or distant thunder. E. गर्ज to sound as thunder, कि aff.
13302: गर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, roared, bellowed. m. (-तः) An elephant in rut. n. (-तं) The muttering of clouds or rolling of distant thunder. E. गर्ज to roar, &c. affix क्त.
13303: गर्ज्य mfn. (-र्ज्यः-र्ज्या-र्ज्यं) To be roared or sounded. E. गर्ज to sound, ण्यत् aff.
13304: गर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A hole in general. 2 The hollow of the loins. 3 The name of a country; also त्रिगर्त्त, in the north-west of India. 4 A kind of disease. E. गृ to drop, Uṇādi affix तन्.
13305: गर्त्तिका f. (-का) A weaver's workshop. E. गर्त्त a hole, affix ठन्, the weaver sits at his loom with his feet in a hollow or hole below. the level of the floor.
13306: गर्द r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्दति गर्दंयति) To sound, to roar.
13307: गर्द्दभ m. (-भः) 1 Smell, odour. 2 An ass. f. (-भी) 1 A she-ass. 2 An insect, a kind of beetle springing from cow dung. 3 A disease of the skin, eruption of round, red, and painful spots; also गर्दभिका. 4 A creeper, (Clitoria ternata.) n. (-भं) The white lotus. E. गर्द to sound, Uṇādi affix अभच्.
13308: गर्द्दभाजिन n. (-नं) The skin or hide of an ass. E. गर्द्दभ, and अजिन a skin.
13309: गर्द्दभशाक mf. (-कः-का) A plant, (Ovieda verticellata.) E. गर्द्दभ an ass, and शाक a vegetable.
13310: गर्द्दभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of tree, commonly Pārspīpal, (Hibiscus populneoides) E. गर्द्दभ smell, अम to go, and ड aff.
13311: गर्द्दभाह्वय m. (-यः) The white lotus. E. गर्द्दभ smell, and आह्वय an appellation.
13312: गर्द्दभिका f. (-का) A cutaneous disease, a blotch, an eruption. E. कन् fem. form added to गर्द्धभ.
13313: गर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) 1 Eagerness, greediness. 2 The Pārspīpal: see गर्द्धभाण्ड. E. गृध to desire, to be greedy, affix घञ्.
13314: गर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Covetous, greedy. E. गृध to be greedy, affix युच्.
13315: गर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) Greedy, covetous. E. गर्द्ध, and इनि aff.
13316: गर्ध r. 10th cl. (गर्धयति) To desire or covet: see गृध.
13317: गर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (गर्ब्बति) To move, to go or approach.
13318: गर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) Pride, haughtiness. E. गर्ब्ब to be proud, अच् affix; also read गर्व्व.
13319: गर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) A foetus, &c.: see the next. f. (-र्ब्भा) Interval of time, division of time or place.
13320: गर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 A foetus or embryo. 2 A child. 3 The belly. 4 The inside, the middle. 5 Joining, union. 6 The rough coat of the fruit of the Jaka. 7 An inner apartment, a lying-in chamber. 8 Any interior chamber, the adytum of a temple, &c. 9 The bed of the Ganges, when the river is fullest; that is, on the fourteenth day of the dark half of the month Bhādra, or in the height of the rains; as high as the river flows at this period, so far extends the Garbha, after which the Tīra or proper bank begins, and extends for 150 cubits; this space is holy ground. 10 The calyx of the lotus. The interior or inner part of any thing. E. गृ to drop, or गॄ to swallow, Uṇādi affix भन्; also read गर्ब्भ.
13321: गर्भक m. (-कः) A chaplet of flowers, &c. worn in the hair. n. (-कं) A period of a day and two nights. E. कन् added to the preceding.
13322: गर्भकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Impregnating, fecundatory, procreative, producing impregnation. m. (-रः) A plant, (Nagelia putranjiva.) E. गर्भ, and कर what makes.
13323: गर्भकोश m. (-शः) The uterus. E. गर्भ, and कोश sheathe.
13324: गर्भगृह n. (-हं) 1 An inner chamber. 2 A lying-in chamber. 3 The sanctuary or adytum of a temple. E. गर्भ, and गृह a house.
13325: गर्भग्रहण n. (-णं) Conception, impregnation. E. गर्भ, and ग्रहण taking.
13326: गर्भघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Producing abortion. E. गर्भ, and घातिन् what destroys.
13327: गर्भचलन n. (-नं) Quickening, motion of the foetus in utero. E. गर्भ, and चलन moving.
13328: गर्भच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bearing a child. 2 Miscarrying. E. गर्भ and च्युत falling.
13329: गर्भच्युति f. (-तिः) 1 Birth, delivery. 2 Miscarriage. E. गर्म, and च्युति falling.
13330: गर्भण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Enlargement of the navel. E. गर्भ the belly, and अण्ड an egg, the penultimate made short.
13331: गर्भद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Impregnating, procreative. m. (-दः) A tree, (Nagelia putranjiva.) f. (-दा) A shrub so called. E. गर्भ a foetus, and द what gives, with reference to the supposed virtue of the plant; also गर्भदातृ (-ता-त्री-तृ).
13332: गर्भद्रुह् mfn. (-द्रुक् or द्रुट्) Causing abortion. E. गर्भ, and द्रुह what injures.
13333: गर्भधारण n. (-णं) Impregnation, gestation. E. गर्भ, and धारण holding.
13334: गर्भनाडी f. (-डी) The umbilical cord. E. गर्भ, and नाडी a vessel.
13335: गर्भपरिस्रव m. (-वः) Secundines. E. गर्भ, and परिस्रव what exudes.
13336: गर्भपाकिन् m. (-की) Rice ripening after two months.
13337: गर्भपातक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Producing abortion. m. (-कः) A red kind of morunga. E. गर्भ the foetus, पत to fall, in the causal form, and वुञ् aff.
13338: गर्भपातन n. (-नं) Producing abortion. f. (-नी) Any plant or drug supposed to have that effect. E. गर्भ, and पातन causing to fall.
13339: गर्भपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Producing abortion. f. (-नी) A kind of potherb: see विशल्या. E. as in the last, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
13340: गर्भपोषण n. (-णं) Gestation. E. गर्भ, and पोषण nourishing.
13341: गर्भरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) A child, an infant. E. गर्भ an embryo, and रूप form; also गर्भरूपकः.
13342: गर्भवती f. (-ती) A pregnant female. E. गर्भ a foetus, and मतुप् poss. aff.
13343: गर्भशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कः) A kind of vectis or instrument for extracting the dead foetus. E. गर्भ, and शङ्क, a probe.
13344: गर्भशय्या f. (-य्या) The uterus. E. गर्भ, and शय्या a bed.
13345: गर्भस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Situated in the womb. 2 Centrical, internal, within the centre of any thing. E. गर्भ, and स्थ what abides.
13346: गर्भस्राव m. (-वः) Abortion, miscarriage. E. गर्भ the embryo, and स्राव expulsion.
13347: गर्भस्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Producing or occasioning abortion. E. गर्भ, and स्राविन् what causes to issue.
13348: गर्भागार n. (-रं) 1 An inner and private room, the female apartments, the lying-in chamber. 2 The sanctuary of a temple, the chamber where the object of worship is placed. E. गर्भ the foetus, and आगार an abode, hence it is also applied to the womb: see गर्भाशय.
13349: गर्भाधान n. (-नं) A ceremony performed prior to conception. E. गर्भ the embryo, and आधान taking, being supposed conducive to future impregnation.
13350: गर्भाशय m. (-घः) The womb, the uterus. E. गर्भ the embryo, and आशय asylum or abode.
13351: गर्भाष्टम m. (-मः) The eighth month of uterine gestation. 2 The eighth year reckoning from conception. E. गर्भ the foetus, and अष्टम eighth.
13352: गर्भिणी f. (-णी) 1 A pregnant woman. 2 A plant, (Asclepias rosea.) E. गर्भ embryo, and इनि poss. affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
13353: गर्भिण्यवेक्षण n. (-णं) Midwifery, attendance and care of pregnant women and new born infants. E. गर्भिणी, and अवेक्षण care, looking to.
13354: गर्भोपघातिनी f. (-नी) A cow (or female), miscarrying from going unseasonably. E. गर्भ the foetus, उप intensitive prefix, हन to destroy, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
13355: गर्म्मुटिका f. (-का) A species of rice.
13356: गर्म्मुत् f. (-म्मुत्) 1 A kind of grass. 2 Gold. 3 A reed. E. गॄ to swallow, &c. Uṇādi affix उति, and म inserted.
13357: गर्व्व r. 1st cl. (गर्व्वति) To be proud or haughty; also (ङ) गर्व्वङ् r. 10th cl. (गर्व्वयते) To grow proud.
13358: गर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride, arrogance. E. गर्व्व to be proud, affix अच् or गॄ swallow, &c. and व Uṇādi affix; this word is sometimes written गर्ब्ब.
13359: गर्व्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty, arrogant. E. गॄ to reject, &c. Uṇādi affix स्वरच्.
13360: गर्व्वाट m. (-टः) A watchman, a doorkeeper, a sort of village constable, a headborough or beadle. E. गर्व्व pride, अट to go, and अच् aff.
13361: गर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Conceited. E. गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.
13362: गर्ह r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्हति-ते गर्हयति) To blame, to censure, to despise or contemn.
13363: गर्हण n. (-णं) Censuring, censure, blame, reproach. E. गर्ह to reprove, affix ल्युट्.
13364: गर्हणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Censurable, contemptible, vile, bad. E. गह to abuse, अनीयर् aff.
13365: गर्हा f. (-र्हा) Abuse, censure, reproach. E. गर्ह to revile, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
13366: गर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blamed, censured. 2 Contemned, despised. 3 Bad, vile. E. गर्ह to blame, क्त aff.
13367: गर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Low, vile, contemptible. E. गर्ह to abuse, affix यत्.
13368: गर्ह्यवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking ill, speaking vilely or inaccurately. E. गर्ह्य vile, and वादिन् who speaks.
13369: गल r. 1st cl. (गलति) 1 To eat. 2 To ooze; also (ङ्) गलङ् r. 10th cl. (गलयते) To drop, to ooze or distil. With अव prefixed, To fall, to fall down or off; With वि, 1 To go, to approach. 2 To bear or support.
13370: गल m. (-लः) 1 The throat. 2 The resin of the Sal tree. 3 A reed, a large kind of the Saccharum cylindricum. 4 A rope. 5 A musical instrument. 6 A kind of fish, a small kind of cyprinus, a subgenus of that class, (Cyprinus garra, HAM.) E. गल to eat, to drop, &c. affix अच्, or गॄ to swallow, with अच्, गर, and र changed to ल.
13371: गलक m. (-कः) A kind of fish. E. कन् added to the preceding.
13372: गलकम्बल m. (-लः) A bull's dewlap. E. गल the neck, and कम्बल a soft substance as a blanket, &c.
13373: गलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Inflammation, enlargement of the glands of the neck. E. गल the throat, and गण्ड a swelling or boil.
13374: गलग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A sauce of fish ground up with salt, pepper, Ghee, &c. 2 A day on which a course of study is commenced, but immediately preceding a day on which study is prohibited. 3 The fourth lunation of the dark fortnight, the seventh, eighth, and ninth, the thirteenth and three days following. 4 Seizing any one by the throat, throttling, choking. E. गल the throat, and ग्रह what takes, &c.; also गलग्रहण.
13375: गलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Falling, dropping. 2 Oozing, trickling, flowing. 3 Melting. E. गल to flow, शतृ aff.
13376: गलन n. (-नं) Melting, fusing. 2 Trickling, dropping, oozing. 3 Falling down or off. 4 Leaking. E. गल to drop, ल्युट् aff.
13377: गलनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fusible, liquefiable, to be melted, &c. E. गल to melt, अनीयर् affix; also गलितव्य and गल्य.
13378: गलन्तिका f. (-का) 1 A small pitcher. 2 A small water jar with a small hole in the bottom, from which the water drops upon a Liṅga or Tulasi plant, placed beneath. E. गड to drop, affix झच्, गडन्ति; कन् in the fem. form added, and ड changed to ल.
13379: गलमेखला f. (-ला) A thread worn round the neck, a necklace. E. गल the throat, and मेखला a girdle.
13380: गलव्रत m. (-तः) A peacock. E. गल the throat, व्रत holy observance; also the same as गरव्रत q. v. ल being substituted for र.
13381: गलशुण्डिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. E. गल the throat, and शुण्डिका the elephant's trunk, resembling it in being a pendulous, roundish, and fleshy substance.
13382: गलस्तनी f. (-नी) A she goat. E. गल the throat, and लन the breast; some species of the Bengal goat have small fleshy processes, resembling nipples depending from the throat; also गलेस्तनी.
13383: गलहस्त m. (-स्तः) Throttling. E. गल, and हस्त the hand.
13384: गलाङ्कुर m. (-रः) A disease of the throat, inflammation of the fauces, and enlargement of the tonsils. E. गल the throat, and अङ्कुर a new sprout.
13385: गलाविल m. (-लः) A prawn or shrimp: see गङ्गाटेय. Some books read this गलानिल, and others गलानिक.
13386: गलि m. (-लिः) A strong and lazy ox. E. गल to eat, and इन् affix; who is good for nothing but eating.
13387: गलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fallen, dropped. 2 Liquefied, melted. 3 Distilled, oozing, flowing. 4 Decayed, impaired. 5 Lost, deprived. 6 Untied, loosed. E. गल to drop, to ooze, affix क्त.
13388: गलितकुष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Advanced and incurable leprosy, when the fingers and toes fall off. E. गलित, and कुष्ठ leprosy.
13389: गलितदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Toothless. E. गलित, and दन्त tooth.
13390: गलितनख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) Having no nails. E. गलित, and नख the nail.
13391: गलितनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Blind. E. गलित, and नयन the eye.
13392: गलेगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of bird, (the Adjutant or Ardea argala.) E. गल the throat, in the seventh case, and गण्ड a boil; alluding to a pendulous fleshy purse hanging from the throat.
13393: गलेस्तनी f. (-नी) A she goat: see गलस्तनी.
13394: गलू m. (-लूः) A sort of gem.
13395: गल्भ r. 1st cl. (गल्भते) To be bold or confident.
13396: गल्भ mfn. (-ल्भः-ल्भा-ल्भं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Confident, bold, audacious. E. गल्भ to be proud, &c. अच् affix, more commonly प्रगल्भ.
13397: गल्या f. (-ल्या) 1 A multitude of throats. 2 A quantity of a kind of grass, or ropes made of it. E. गल a throat, &c. य aff.
13398: गल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The cheek. E. गल to eat, and ल affix; from ला to get or receive.
13399: गल्लचातुरी f. (-री) A small round pillow to put underneath the cheek. E. गल्ल the cheek, and चातुर a pillow.
13400: गल्वर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 A goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor. 2 Lapis lazuli. E. गल to drop, deriv. irr.
13401: गल्ह r. 1st cl. (गल्हते) To blame, to censure or despise: see गर्ह.
13402: गवय m. (-यः) 1 A species of ox, the Gayal, erroneously classed by Hindu writers amongst the kinds of deer, (Bos gavaeus.) 2 A monkey chief: the son of VAIVASVATA. f. (-यी) The female Gayal. E. गु to sound, and अय affix, form irregular; or गो a cow, and य from या to obtain, affix ड, resembling a cow.
13403: गवराज m. (-जः) A bull. E. गो a cow, affix अण्, गव relating to a cow, and राजन् king, chief; the more direct compound makes गोराज.
13404: गवल m. (-लः) A wild buffalo. n. (-लं) Buffalo's horn. E. गु to sound, अलच् aff.
13405: गवाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 An air hole, a loop hole, a round window, a bull's eye, &c. 2 A monkey chief; one of the sons of VAIVASVATA. E. गो a ray of light, अक्ष to spread, affix घञ्, or गो an ox, and अक्ष an eye; ox-eyed. f. (-क्षी) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) 2 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता. E. गो the earth, अक्ष to spread, affixes अण् and ङीप्.
13406: गवाक्षजाल n. (-लं) A lattice, a jealousie, trellis-work. E. गवाक्ष, and जाल a net.
13408: गवादन n. (-नं) Pasture or meadow grass. f. (-नी) 1 A hay rack, a trough for holding grass out of which cattle feed. 2 A species of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus, or, according to some, C. coloquintida.) 3 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see the preceding. E. गो a cow, अदन food, fem. affix ङीप्.
13409: गवालूक m. (-कः) The Gayal, (Bos gavaeus:) see गवय. E. गो a cow, लोक to see, with आङ् prefixed, deriv. irr; in appearance a cow.
13410: गवाशन m. (-नः) An outcaste. E. गव, and अशन who eats, eating beef.
13412: गवाह्निक n. (-कं) A day's feed for a cow. E. गो, and अह्निक daily.
13413: गवीश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Owner of kine. E. गो a cow, ईश्वर a lord or master.
13414: गवेडु m. (-डुः) A cloud. f. (-डुः) A kind of grain, (Coix barbata.) E. गो a cow or the earth, ण्ड to preserve, उ affix, or with कन् added गवेडुका; also गवेधु, &c.
13415: गवेधु f. (-धुः) Coix barbata: see the preceding; also with कन् added गवेधुका.
13416: गवेरुक n. (-कं) Red chalk. E. गो light or colour, ईर to send, affix वुन्, and the penultimate changed to उ irregularly; also read गवेधुक.
13418: गवेष r. 10th cl. (गवेषयति) 1 To seek, to hunt for, to search or inquire. 2 To make an effort.
13419: गवेषण nf. (-णं-णा) Research, inquiry after any thing, (physical or philosophical, &c.) E. गवेष to inquire, affix युच्.
13420: गवेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired for. E. गवेष to search or hunt, affix क्त.
13421: गवोद्घ m. (-द्घः) An excellent cow. E. गो a cow, and उद्घ implying excellence; the compound remains masculine.
13422: गव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 (Of or belonging to a cow, as milk, curds, &c.) 2 Proper or fit for cattle. nf. (-व्यं-व्या) A bowstring. f. (-व्या) 1 A multitude of cows. 2 A measure of two Kos: see गव्यूति. n. (-व्यं) A colouring substance, a yellow pigment or dye. E. गो a cow, &c. and यत् aff.
13423: गव्यूत nf. (-तं) 1 A Kos, a measure of length equal to 4000 cubits. 2 A measure of two Kos: see the next.
13424: गव्यूति mf. (-तिः) A measure of two Kos, a league measured by 2000 Dands or fathoms. E. गो the earth, यु to join, क्तिन् affix, deriv. irr.
13425: गह r. 10th cl. (गहयति) To be thick or impervious as a forest, &c.
13426: गह m. (-हः) 1 A cave. 2 A forest. E. गह to be impervious, अच् aff.
13427: गहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Impervious, inaccessible. n. (-नं) 1 A wood, a thicket. 2 A cave. 3 Pain, distress. E. गाह to tremble, &c. affix युच्, and the radical vowel made short; or गह to be thick, affix as before.
13428: गहीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to a cave or a thicket, deep, difficult of access, impervious. E. गह a thicket, छ aff.
13429: गह्वर nf. (-रं-री) A cave, a cavern, a grotto, a recess in a rock or mountain, &c. n. (-रं) 1 A thicket, a wood. 2 Hypocrisy. 3 Weeping, crying, but not violently. m. (-रः) An arbour, a bower. E. गाह to be agitated, and ष्वरच् Uṇādi affix, the radical vowel made short.
13430: गा r. 1st cl. (ङ) गाङ् (गाते) To go, to go to or towards. r. 3rd cl. but restricted to the Vedas (जगाति) To praise.
13431: गा f. (-गा) A verse or metrical composition. E. गै to sing, क and टाप् affix: see ग.
13432: गाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Belonging or relating to the river Ganges. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A name of BHĪṢMA. E. गङ्गा the GAṄGĀ, अण् aff.
13433: गाङ्गट m. (-टः) A prawn or shrimp. E. गाङ्ग relating to the Ganges, and अट what goes, form irr.; also गाङ्गाट or with कन् affix गाङ्गटक.
13434: गाङ्गटेय m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn. E. गङ्गा, अट to go, and ढक् affix; also गङ्गाटेय, and गाङ्काट, &c.
13435: गाङ्गायनि f. (-निः) 1 A name of BHĪṢMA. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. गङ्गा the personified river, (as the wife of ŚANTANU, in the first instance, and mother of the hero; and in the second, as the receiver of KĀRTTIKEYA the son of ŚIVA, from AGNI, the god of fire,) and फिञ् patronymic aff.
13436: गाङ्गेय m. (-यः) 1 BHĪṢMA. 2 KĀRTTIKEYA: see the preceding. 3 The Hilsa or Illias fish, (Clupanodon ilisha, HAM.) n. (-यं) 1 Gold. 2 A grass: see कशेरु. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गङ्गा the Ganges, ढक् affix of descent, &c.
13437: गाङ्गेरुकी f. (-की) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides, but it is variously described.) E. गाङ्ग Ganges water, ईर to go or grow, उकन् aff.
13439: गाङ्गौघ n. (-घं) The current of the Ganges. E. गाङ्ग Gangetic, and ओघ heap.
13441: गाढ adv. n. (-ढं) adj. mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Excessive, much, very much, heavy, oppressive, &c. 2 Firm, strong. 3 Hard. 4 Close. E. गाह to agitate, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
13442: गाढता f. (-ता) 1 Firmness, hardness. 2 Excess. E. गाढ, and तल् affix; also with त्व, गाढत्वं.
13443: गाढमुष्ठि mfn. (-ष्ठिः-ष्ठिः-ष्ठि) Miserly, niggard, avaricious, closefisted. m. (-ष्ठिः) A scymitar, a large sacrificial knife. E. गाढ heavy or close, and मुष्ठि gripe.
13444: गाणपत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Relating to GAṆEŚA, or the leader of a troop, &c. E. गणपति, and अण् aff.
13445: गाणपत्य mfn. (-त्यः-ती-त्यं) Relating to GAṆAPATI or GAṆEŚA. m. (-त्यः) A worshipper of him. n. (-त्यं) 1 Worship of him. 2 Chieftainship, presidency. E. गणपति, and ष्यञ् aff.
13446: गाणिक्य n. (-क्यं) An assembly of harlots. E. गणिका a whore, यञ् aff.
13447: गाण्डिव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 The bow of ARJUNA. 2 Any bow; also गाण्डीव.
13448: गाण्डीव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 The bow of ARJUNA. 2 Any bow. E. गाण्डि what affects the cheek, from गण्ड with इञ् affix, then व added, and इ final lengthened; or continuing short, गाण्डिव.
13449: गाण्डीविन् m. (-बी) A name of ARJUNA. E. गाण्डीव ARJUNA'S bow, and इनि aff.
13450: गातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Angry, wrathful. m. (-तुः) 1 A Gandharba or celestial quirister. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 3 A large black bee. 4 A singer. E. गै to sing, Uṇādi affix तु.
13451: गातृ mf. (-ता-त्री) A male or female singer. E. गै to sing, तृच् aff.
13452: गात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The body. 2 The fore quarter of an elephant. 3 A limb, a member. E. गभ to go, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix, the radical final is rejected, and the vowel made long.
13453: गात्रभङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. गात्र the body, and भङ्गा what breaks or hurts.
13454: गात्रमार्जनी f. (-नी) A towel. E. गात्र, and मार्जनी a wiper.
13455: गात्रसङ्कोचिन् m. (-ची) The pole-cat, (Viverra putorius.) E. गात्र the body, and सङ्कोचिन् who draws up or contracts in order to spring upon prey.
13456: गात्रसम्प्लव m. (-वः) A small bird, the diver. E. गात्र the body, and सम्प्लव who plunges, from सम् entirely, प्लुङ् to go, and अच् aff.
13457: गात्रानुलेपनी f. (-नी) Fragrant unguents, &c. smeared upon the body, perfume for the person. E. गात्र the body, अनु upon, लिप to plaster or smear, and ल्युट् aff.
13458: गात्रोत्सादन n. (-नं) Cleaning the person with perfumes, &c. E. गात्र, and उत्सादन cleaning.
13459: गाथक m. (-कः) 1 A musician, a singer. 2 A chaunter of the Purāṇas or sacred poems. E. गै to sing, स्थकन् aff.
13460: गाथा f. (-था) 1 A verse, a stanza. 2 Metre, rhythm. 3 A song, a chaunt or verse to be chaunted or sung. 4 Prākṛta or any language not Sanscrit. 6 The same as the Arya Metre, in which the verse contains sixty syllabic instants, variously arranged. E. गै to sing, थन् Uṇādi aff.
13461: गाथाकार m. (-रः) A singer, a reciter. E. गाथा, कृ to make, अण् aff.
13462: गाथिक m. (-कः) One who recites Gāthas, verses or hymns. E. गाथा, and ठक् aff.
13463: गाध (ऋ) गाधृ r. 1st cl. (गधते) 1 To stand, to stay, to remain. 2 To seek, to search or inquire for. 3 To compile, string or heap together.
13464: गाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Not very deep. m. (-धः) 1 Place, site. 2 Desire of gain, cupidity, covetousness. 3 Bottom, soundings. E. गाध to stand, &c. affix अच्.
13465: गाधि m. (-धिः) The name of a king, sovereign of Kanyakubja, father of VIŚVĀMITRA.
13466: गाधिज m. (-जः) 1 A name of the celebrated saint VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाधि as above, and ज born.
13467: गाधिपुर n. (-रं) Kanyakubja the ancient Kanouj. E. गाधि a proper name, and पुर a city; the capital of GĀDHI.
13468: गाधिभू m. (-भूः) The saint VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाधि, and भू born, the son of GĀDHI.
13469: गाधेय m. (-यः) VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाधि, and ढक् patronymick affix: see the preceding.
13470: गान n. (-नं) 1 Singing, song in general, or a song. 2 Sound. E. गै to sing, affix ल्युट्.
13471: गानिनी f. (-नी) Orris root. E. गान song, इनि and ङीप् affixes; supposed to be of use in clearing the voice.
13472: गानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Musical. E. गान and छ aff.
13473: गान्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) A goer, a traveller, one who goes or moves. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix तु, and the radical vowel made long.
13474: गान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A carriage drawn by oxen. E. गम to go, ष्ट्रन् affix, fem. do. ङीष्, and the pen. made long; also गन्त्रा.
13475: गान्दिनी f. (-नी) 1 The river Ganges, or the goddess GAṄGĀ. 2 The mother of AKRŪRA. E. गो paradise, in the accusative case, द who gives, इनि, and ङीप् affs.
13476: गान्दिनीसुत m. (-तः) 1 A name of BHĪṢMA, &c. 2 AKRŪRA. E. गान्दिनी GAṄGĀ, and सुत a son: see गङ्गासुत.
13477: गान्धर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बी-र्ब्बं-) Relating or belonging to a Gandharba. m. (-र्ब्बः) A heavenly quirister: see गन्धर्ब्ब. n. (-र्ब्बं) 1 Song, singing. 2 A form of marriage, that which requires only mutual and amorous agreement. E. गन्धर्ब्ब a Gandharba, and अण् aff.
13478: गान्धार m. (-रः) 1 One of the seven primary notes of music. 2 Minium or red lead. 3 A country, (Kandahar, between the north of India and Persia.) n. (-रं) Gum myrrh. f. (-री) 1 The wife of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, mother of DURYODHANA. 2 One of the tutelary female deities of the Jainas. 3 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 4 Prickly nightshade. E. गान्ध the aggregate of गन्ध smell, &c. ऋ to go, and अण् affix; the note being said to be produced by pure and fragrant breath, &c.
13479: गान्धारेय m. (-यः) A name of DURYODHANA, the son of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. गान्धारी the name of the mother of this chief, and ढक् aff.
13480: गान्धिक m. (-कः) 1 A scribe, a clerk. 2 A vender of perfumes, a perfumer. 3 A kind of worm, having a strong fetid smell. E. गन्ध smell, and ठञ् aff.
13481: गामुक mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) Going, locomotive. E. गम to go, उकञ् aff.
13482: गाम्भीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Depth, (of water, sound, &c.) 2 The deep sound of the voice of a Jaina saint, like distant thunder or the muttering of clouds. E. गम्भीर deep, affix ष्यञ् or ज्य.
13483: गायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Singing, one who sings. m. (-कः) A singer. E. गै to sing, ण्वुल् aff.
13484: गायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Singing. E. गै to sing, affix शतृ.
13485: गायत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A tree that yields the resin formerly called Terra Japonica, (Mimosa catechu;) also गायत्री fem. noun, as below.
13486: गायत्री f. (-त्री) 1 A measure of verse in the Vedas, a stanza usually of twenty-four syllables, variously arranged, but most commonly in three lines. 2 A sacred verse from the Vedas to be recited only mentally; this is usually personified and considered as a goddess, the wife of BRAHMĀ; the metaphorical mother of the three first classes, in their capacity of twice born, investiture with the sacred and distinguishing string, &c. being regarded as a new birth; there is but one Gāyatrī of the Vedas, but according to the system of the Tāntrikas, a number of mystical verses are called Gāyatrīs; each deity has one in particular. 3 A kind of mimosa, (M. catechu:) see the preceding, &c. E. गायन् who sings, and त्रै to preserve, affixes क and ङीष्; this applies especially to the mystical verse, the repetition of which is necessary for salvation; the word is also written गायत्त्री.
13487: गायन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Singing, a singer. m. (-नः) 1 A singer. 2 A chatterer, a gossip. n. (-नं) 1 Singing. 2 Professing or practising singing as a livelihood. E. गै to sing, aff. ल्युट्.
13488: गारित्र m. (-त्रः) Rice, grain, corn. E. ग to swallow, Uṇādi affix णित्रन.
13489: गारुड m. (-डः) 1 Gold. 2 A Mantra or charm against poison. 3 An emerald. E. गरुड the vehicle of VIṢṆU, and अण् affix; of or relating to GARUḌA.
13490: गारुडिक m. (-कः) A charmer, a dealer in antidotes. E. गारुड the mantra of GARUḌA, or a charm against venom, and ठक् aff.
13492: गारुत्मत् n. (-त्) The emerald. E. गरुत्मत् GARUḌA, and अण् affix; derived from or relating to GARUḌA; the gem is supposed to be generated from his voided phlegm.
13493: गार्ग्ग mfn. (-र्ग्गः-र्ग्गी-र्ग्गं) Descended from the age GARGA. E. गर्ग्ग, and अण् aff.
13494: गार्गक n. (-कं) A multitude of the descendants of the saint GARGA. E. गार्ग a descendant of GARGA, and वुञ् affix of multitude; also with ठञ्, गार्गिक.
13495: गार्गीपुत्रकायनि m. (-निः) A descendant of the son of GĀRGĪ. E. गार्गी the wife of the saint GARGA, पुत्र a son, and फिञ् affix, कुक् augment; also without the augment गार्ग्गीपुत्रायनि, or with इञ् affix, गार्ग्गीपुत्रि.
13496: गार्ग्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्ग्यः-र्ग्ग्यी-र्ग्ग्यं) Descended from GARGA, son, daughter, &c. E. गर्ग्ग, and ष्यञ् aff.
13497: गार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) 1 Derived from a vulture. 2 Greedy. m. (-द्धः) 1 Desire, greediness, cupidity. 2 An arrow. E. गृध greedy, affix अण् or गृध्र with अण् affix, and र rejected optionally.
13498: गार्द्धपक्ष m. (-क्षः) An arrow. E. गार्द्ध, and पक्ष a wing; formed with vulture's feathers.
13499: गार्द्धपत्र m. (-त्रः) An arrow. E. as before, पत्र a leaf, a wing.
13500: गार्द्ध्य n. (-र्द्ध्यं) 1 Greediness. 2 Desire. E. गृध greedy, यञ् aff.
13501: गार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) Derived from a vulture. E. गृध्र, and अण् aff.
13502: गार्द्धपक्ष m. (-क्षः) An arrow. E. गार्द्ध, and पक्ष a wing.
13503: गार्भ mfn. (-र्भः-र्भी-र्भं) 1 Uterine, fœtal. 2 Relating to conception, (any act or ceremony, &c.) E. गर्भ, and अण् aff.
13504: गार्भिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Foetal, uterine. 2 Relating to or connected with gestation or the foetus in utero. E. गभ, and ठञ् aff.
13505: गार्भिण n. (-णं) A number of pregnant women. E. गर्भिणी a pregnant woman, and अण् aff.
13506: गार्भिण्य n. (-ण्यं) An assembly of pregnant women. E. गर्भिणी as above, and यञ् aff.
13507: गार्हपत्य m. (-त्यः) A sacred fire perpetually maintained by a householder, received from his father, and transmitted to his descendants, and from which fires for sacrificial purposes are lighted. E. गृहपति a householder, (from गृह a house, and पति master,) and ज्य referential aff.
13508: गार्हस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) The order or estate of a householder. E. गृहस्थ, and यञ् aff.
13509: गाल m. (-लः) 1 Flowing, liquefying. 2 Flowing, dropping. 3 A flux. E. गल to flow, घञ् aff.
13510: गालन n. (-नं) 1 Straining fluids. 2 Fusing, liquefying, &c. E. गल् to flow, causal form, affix ल्युट्.
13511: गालव m. (-वः) 1 A tree, the bark of which is used in dying, Lodh, (Symplocus racemosa, Rox.) 2 A pale species of the same: see लोध्र. 3 A kind of ebony; also केन्दुक, (Diospyros glutinosa.) 4 A particular Muni or saint, a disciple of VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाल flux, and ब what prevents; referring to the astringent qualities of the Lodh.
13512: गालि m. (-लिः) A curse, execration or imprecation. E. गल in the causal form, to cause to drop, and इन् aff.
13513: गालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Melted, fused. 2 Strained. 3 Distilled, dropped. E. गल to drop, causal form, क्त aff.
13514: गालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Fusing, liquefying. 2 Distilling. 3 Abusive, abusing. f. (-नी) A particular gesticulation or Madrā. E. गल to flow, causal form, णिनि aff.
13515: गालोड्य n. (-ड्यं) The seed of the lotus.
13516: गाह (ऊ) गाहू r. 1st cl. (गाहते) 1 To churn, to stir or agitate. 2 To penetrate. 3 To destroy. With अव or वि prefixed, To bathe, to perform ablutions. With वि, To shake, to agitate.
13517: गाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, trembling. 2 Destroyed. 3 Plunged into, immersed. E. गाह to agitate, क्त aff.
13518: गाहितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Shaking, agitating. 2 Destroying, a destroyer. 3 One who plunges into water, bathes, dives, &c. E. गाह to agitate, तृच् aff.
13519: गिर् f. (-गीः) 1 Speech, speaking. 2 A name of SARASVATĪ the goddess of speech. 3 Fame, celebrity. E. गॄ to sound, affix क्विप्, ॠ is changed to इर्.
13520: गिरण n. (-णं) Swallowing. E. गॄ to swallow, ल्युट् aff.
13521: गिरा f. (-रा) Speech. E. गॄ to sound, क, and टाप् affs.
13522: गिरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Venerable, respectable, worshipful. m. (-रिः) 1 A mountain, a hill. 2 A wooden ball with which children play. 3 A disease of the eyes. f. (-रिः) 1 Swallowing. 2 A small rat, a mouse. 3 A title given to one order of the Dāsnāmī Gosains. E. गॄ to swallow, &c. इ Uṇādi aff.
13523: गिरिकण्टक m. (-कः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. गिरि a mountain, and कण्टक a thorn, tearing or splitting rocks.
13524: गिरिकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) A species of Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba.) E. गिरि, and कदम्ब the same.
13525: गिरिकन्दर m. (-रः) A cave, a cavern. E. गिरि, and कन्दर a cave.
13526: गिरिकदली f. (-ली) A species of plantain growing in hilly countries. E. गिरि, and कदली a plantain.
13527: गिरिकर्णिका f. (-का) The earth. E. गिरि a mountain, and कर्ण an ear, affixes कन् and टाप्; the mountain-eared.
13528: गिरिकर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A plant, commonly Javāsa, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 2 A different plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता. E. गिरि a mouse, and कर्णी an ear, affix ङीष्, the mouse-earleaved.
13529: गिरिका f. (-का) A small rat, a mouse. E. कन् added to गिरि the same.
13530: गिरिकाण m. (-णः) A blind or one-eyed man, one blind from a particular disease. E. गिरि as above, and काण one-eyed.
13531: गिरिगुड m. (-डः) A ball for playing with. E. गिरि, and गुड, each meaning the same thing, a ball.
13532: गिरिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain-born, mountaineer, &c. m. (-जः) The Mahwa tree, (Bassia.) f. (-जा) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ, as the daughter of the personified HIMĀLA mountain. 2 The Shaddock or pamplemouse, (Citrus decumana.) 3 A plant considered as a white species of Rasnā: see रास्ना. 4 The hill plantain. 5 Jasmine. 6 A pebble, a small stone. n. (-जं) 1 Talc. 2 Benzoin or gum benjamin; it is also confounded with styrax, another gum resin. 3 Bitumen. 4 Iron. E. गिरि, and ज born.
13533: गिरिजामल n. (-लं) Talc. E. गिरिज mountain-born, and अमल clear, clean; also गिरिज, and अमल severally.
13534: गिरिज्वर m. (-रः) The thunderbolt. E. गिरि a mountain, and ज्वर what burns.
13535: गिरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eaten. 2 Swallowed. E. गॄ to swallow, affix क्त; also गिलित.
13536: गिरिदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A hill fort or any strong hold amongst mountains. E. गिरि, and दुर्ग a place of difficult access.
13537: गिरिधातु m. (-तुः) Red chalk. E. गिरि, and धातु a mineral.
13538: गिरिध्वज m. (-जः) A thunderbolt. E. गिरि, and ध्वज a banner.
13539: गिरिपुष्पक n. (-कं) Bitumen. E. गिरि, and पुष्प a flower; कन् affix of similitude.
13540: गिरिपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) The top of a hill. E. गिरि, and पृष्ठ back.
13541: गिरिप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fond of or frequenting mountains. f. (-या) The Yak. E. गिरि, and प्रिय fond of.
13542: गिरिमल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, (Echites antidysenterica:) see कुटज. E. गिरि a mountain, and मल्ली a jasmin, कन् affix of similitude.
13543: गिरिमान m. (-नः) A large and powerful elephant. E. गिरि a mountain, and मान measure, like a mountain in bulk.
13544: गिरिभिद् m. (-भित्) A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) E. गिरि, and भिद् what breaks.
13545: गिरिभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountaineer, mountain-born. f. (-भूः) PĀRVATĪ. m. (-भूः) A small stone. E. गिरि, and भू born.
13546: गिरिमृत् f. (-मृत्) 1 Red chalk. 2 Mountain-soil. E. गिरि a mountain, and मृत् clay, earth.
13547: गिरिमृद्भव n. (-वं) Red chalk. E. गिरिमृत्, and भव produced.
13548: गिरिमेद m. (-दः) A foetid mimosa. E. गिरि, and मेद filth.
13549: गिरियक m. (-कः) A ball for playing with. E. गिरि a ball, घ pleonastic affix, and कन् added; also गिरियाक the pen, being lengthened.
13550: गिरियाक m. (-कः) A ball: see the preceding.
13551: गिरिवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living in the mountains, being or produced in them. m. (-सी) A large kind of Arum. E. गिरि, and वासिन् what abides.
13552: गिरिश m. (-शः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गिरि a mountain, and शीङ् to sleep, affix ड; inhabiting mount Kailāsa, or frequenting the Himāla range.
13553: गिरिशालिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Clitoria ternatea.) E. गिरि, and शालिनी what grows in.
13554: गिरिशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 The peak of a mountain. E. गिरि a mount, and शृङ्ग a peak, alluding to his bulk, or गिरि the mountain Kailāsa, and शृङ्ग chief.
13555: गिरिसार m. (-रः) 1 The Malaya mountains, situated in the south of India. 2 Iron. 3 Tin. E. गिरि a mountain, and सार essence.
13556: गिरिसुता f. (-ता) PĀRVATĪ. E. गिरि Himālaya, and सुता daughter.
13557: गिरीश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of Himāla, the snowy mountains on the north of Hindustan, or the range personified. 3 A name of VṚHASPATI. E. गिरि a mountain, (or in the last meaning, गिर् speech,) and ईश lord.
13558: गिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Who or what swallows. m. (-लः) 1 The citron. 2 Swallowing. E. गॄ to swallow, affix क, and र changed to ल.
13559: गिलग्राह m. (-हः) A shark. E. गिल, and ग्राह who seizes, who swallows.
13560: गिलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Swallowing, eating, devouring. E. गै to swallow, शतृ aff.
13561: गिलन n. (-नं) Swallowing; also गिरण. E. as before; र changed to ल.
13562: गिलि f. (-लिः) 1 Swallowing. 2 Eating. E. see गिरि, र being changed to ल.
13563: गिलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eaten. 2 Swallowed. E. गॄ to swallow, affix क्त, गिरित, and र changed to ल.
13564: गिष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 1 A Brahman versed in the Sāma Veda, a chanter of that Veda, which is always to be so recited. 2 An actor, a professional singer. E. गै to sing, डिष्ण Uṇādi aff.
13565: गीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sung, chaunted, sounded, &c. f. (-ता) A name often applied to books, as the Śiva Gītā, Rāma Gītā, Gītā Govinda, Bhagavad Gītā, which last is also often called Gītā only. n. (-तं) Singing, song either general or particular. E. गॄ to sing, affix क्त.
13566: गीतमोदिन् m. (-दी) A Kinnara or celestial chorister. E. गीत song or singing, and मोदिन् who delights.
13567: गीति f. (-तिः) 1 Song, singing. 2 A kind of poetical metre, a form of the Ārya metre, in which the stanza consists of four lines of twelve and eighteen syllabic instants alternately. E. गै to sing, affix क्तिन्.
13568: गीरथ m. (-थः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. गी speech, and रथ a car, the conveyer of words.
13569: गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Praised. 2 Swallowed. E. गॄ to swallow or make known, affix क्त.
13570: गीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 Swallowing. 2 Fame, celebrity. 3 Praise, applause. E. गॄ to swallow, &c. affix क्तिन्.
13571: गीर्देवी f. (-वी) The goddess SARASVATĪ. E. गी speech, and देवी a goddess, the goddess of language.
13572: गीर्व्वाण m. (-णः) A deity, a god. E. गीः speech, and वाण an arrow or weapon in general, whose fiat or word is his weapon; or गी with वन to desire, affix अन्, desiring hymns, prayers, &c. it is also written गीर्ब्बाण.
13573: गीष्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER and preceptor of the gods. 2 A Paṇḍita or learned teacher. E. गिर् speech, in the nominative case, गीः and पति master, Visarga becomes स and स is here changed irregularly to ष; the compound however is sometimes written differently, thus गीःपति, गीर्पति or गीस्पति.
13574: गु (ओ, शि) r. 6th cl. (गुवति) To stool, to void excrement. (ङ) गुङ् r. 1st cl. (गवते) To sound inarticulately.
13575: गुग्गुल m. (-लः) A gum resin: see the next.
13576: गुग्गुलु m. (-लुः) 1 A fragrant gum resin, Bdellium or the exudation of the Amyris agallochum. 2 A species of morunga, (M. hyperanthera.) E. गुज् (here said to mean) disease, and गुड to perfume, affixes क and उ, ड changed to ल; also गुग्गुल.
13577: गुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 A cluster of blossoms. 2 A clump of grass. 3 A necklace of thirty-two strings. 4 A pearl necklace. 5 A peacock's plumage or bundle of peacock's feathers. 6 A bundle. f. (-च्छी) A species of Bonduc: see करञ्ज. E. गु to sound, छ affix, or गुध to play, and च्छक् affix, where bees, &c. sport.
13578: गुच्छक m. (-कः) 1 A cluster of blossoms. 2 A clump of grass. 3 A kind of necklace. 4 A peacock's plumage, a bundle of peacock's feathers. E. कन् added to the preceding; also गुत्सक.
13579: गुच्छपत्र m. (-त्रः) The palm tree. E. गुच्छ a cluster, and पत्र a leaf.
13580: गुच्छफला m. (-ला) 1 The plaintain. 2 The vine. E. गुच्छ a cluster, and फल fruit.
13581: गुच्छार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A necklace of thirty-four strings. E. गुच्छ a large necklace, and अर्द्ध a part; also गुत्सार्द्ध.
13582: गुच्छाल m. (-लः) A species of grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) E. गुच्छ, and अल to be fit for, अच् aff.
13583: गुज r. 1st cl. (गोजति) or (शि) r. 6th cl. गुजति) or (इ) गुजि r. 1st cl. (गुञ्जति) To sound, to sound inarticulately, to buzz, to hum, &c.
13584: गुज्जरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs, perhaps more correctly गुर्ज्जरी.
13585: गुञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. f. (-ञ्जा) 1 A small shrub, (Abrus precatorius,) bearing a red and black berry, which forms the smallest of the jeweller's weights. 2 The berry which averages about 1(5/16) grains troy, or the artificial weight called by this name, weighing about 2(3/16) grains: see रक्तिका, &c. 3 A kettle drum. 4 A low murmuring sound. 5 A tavern. 6 Reflection, meditation. E. गुजि to sound, affix क; where the bees buzz.
13586: गुञ्जकृत् m. (-त्) A large black bee. E. गुञ्ज a low tone, and कृत् who makes.
13587: गुञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) Buzzing, humming, making a low murmuring sound. E. गुजि to sound, शतृ aff.
13588: गुञ्जन n. (-नं) Sounding low and deep, as buzzing, murmuring, &c. E. गुजि to sound, and ल्युट् aff.
13589: गुञ्जिका f. (-का) The Ratti or Gunja seed, considered as equal to three barley corns: see गुञ्जा. E. गुञ्जा, and कन् aff.
13590: गुञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered in a low tone, murmured, &c. n. (-तं) Sounding, murmuring, buzzing. E. गुजि, and क्त aff.
13591: गुटिका f. (-का) 1 A pill, a bolus, any small globe or ball. 2 A small pustule. 3 The cocoon of the silk worm. E. गुड to surround, affix क्वुन्, ड changed to ट.
13592: गुठ (इ) गुठि r. 10th cl. (गुण्ठयति) To surround, to envelope or enclose: with अव, to veil, to screen.
13593: गुड (शि) r. 6th cl. (गुडति) To defend, to guard or preserve. (इ) गुडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (गुण्डति गुण्डयति) 1 To surround, to enclose. 2 To pound, to grind, to reduce to powder. 3 (According to some authorities,) To preserve.
13594: गुड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Round, globular. m. (-डः) 1 A globe or ball. 2 Treacle, molasses, the first thickening of the juice of the cane by boiling. 3 An elephant's trappings or armour. 4 A mouthful. f. (-डा) 1 A plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli:) see स्नुही. 2 Powder, pounded substance. E. गुङ् to sound, affix ड.
13595: गुडक m. (-कः) A conserve, a drug prepared with treacle. n. (-कं) Treacle. E. गुड, and कन् added.
13596: गुडकरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the musical modes.
13597: गुडची f. (-ची) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडुची.
13598: गुडतृण n. (-णं) Sugar cane. E. गुड raw sugar, and तृण grass.
13599: गुडत्वच् n. (-त्वक्) The aromatic bark of the Laurus cassia. E. गुड sugar, and त्वच् skin, bark, sweet-bark; also गुडत्वच.
13600: गुडत्वच n. (-चं) 1 Mace. 2 Cassia bark. E. गुड sugar, sweet as sugar, त्वच् bark, and अच् added in this form of the compound.
13601: गुडदारु m. (-रुः) Sugar cane. E. गुड raw sugar, and दारु wood.
13602: गुडधेनु f. (-नुः) Sugar piled up for distribution at certain religious rites. E. गुड, and धेनु a cow.
13603: गुडपिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A sort of sweetmeat, flour or rice and sugar, ground and boiled together. E. गुड, and पिष्ट ground.
13604: गुडपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A kind of bassia, (B. latifolia.) E. गुड sugar, and पुष्प flower; the flowers being full of saccharine matter.
13605: गुडफल m. (-लः) A tree, commonly Pilu, (Careya arborea, &c.:) see पीलु. E. गुड, and फल fruit, the fruit yielding Gur or saccharine matter.
13606: गुडमिश्र n. (-श्रं) A sort of cake or sweetmeat, flour or rice and coarse sugar ground and boiled together. E. गुड, and मिश्र mixed.
13607: गुडमूल m. (-लः) A kind of amaranth, (A. polygamus;) also अल्पमारिष. E. गुड, and मूल root; having a root as sweet as Gur.
13608: गुडल n. (-लं) A spirituous liquor distilled from molasses, a sort of rum. E. गुड sugar, and ल what requires.
13609: गुडशर्क्करा f. (-रा) Sugar, refined sugar. E. गुड molasses, and शर्क्करा sugar or sand.
13610: गुडशिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) A red sort of morunga: see शोभाञ्जन. E. गुड sugar, शिग्रु morunga.
13612: गुडाकेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A title of ARJUNA. E. गुडा Euphorbia, and केश the hair; the hair forming matted locks, resembling in shape the leaves of the Euphorbia: again, गुडाका sloth, and ईश paramount; subduing indolence.
13613: गुडाशय m. (-यः) A mountain Pilu: see गुडफल.
13614: गुडिका f. (-का) A pill, a bolus. E. गुड to be round, वुन् aff.
13615: गुडुची f. (-ची) A plant: see the next.
13616: गुडूची f. (-ची) A creeper, commonly called Guricha, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. गुड to preserve, (from disease,) ऊचट् affix; also with the pen. vowel short गुडुची.
13617: गुडेर m. (-रः) A mouthful. E. गुड to surround, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
13618: गुडेरक m. (-कः) A mouthful. E. गुड to preserve, एरक् affix, and कन् added; also गुडेर.
13619: गुडोद्भवा f. (-वा) Sugar. E. गुड, and उद्भव produced.
13620: गुडौदन m. (-नं) Boiled rice and coarse sugar. E. गुड, and ओदन rice.
13621: गुण r. 10th cl. (गुणयति) 1 To invite. 2 To advise. 3 To multiply.
13622: गुण m. (-णः) 1 A quality, attribute, or property in general. 2 A property of all created things; three are particularized, the Sattva, Raja, and Tama, or principles of truth or existence, passion or foulness, and darkness or ignorance. 3 A means of defence, one of six expedients in government, as, peace, war, a march, a halt, a stratagem, and recourse to protection: see सन्धि, &c. 4 Form, shape, &c. or property of the body. 5 Knowledge, ignorance, &c. or quality of the mind. 6 Heroism, valor, &c. 7 White, black, &c. or the attributes of color. 8 An organ of sense. 9 A string in general. 10 A bow-string. 11 Abandoning, leaving. 12 A cook. 13 A name of BHĪMA. 14 Secondary, subordinate. 15 Excellence, merit, freedom from fault or blemish. 16 (In arithmetic,) The given coefficient of any number. 17 (In geometry,) The chord of an are. 18 (In grammar,) The substitution of e, o, ar and al for i, u, ṛ, ḷ. 19 (In rhetoric,) Consistency of plan, elegance of expression, &c. as the merits of a composition. 20 In composition with numerals, multiplication, as द्विगुण twice, त्रिगुण thrice. f. (-णा) A plant of the fibres of which bow- strings are made: see मूर्व्वा. E. गुण to address or advise, affix क्त.
13623: गुणक m. (-कः) 1 A numerator, a reckoner. 2 (In arithmetic,) The multiplier. E. गुण to count, क्वुन् aff.
13624: गुणकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who counts, &c. m. (-रः) A name of BHĪMASENA. E. गुण, and कार who makes; BHĪMA performed the duties of a cook at the time all the Pāṇḍava princes became servants to VIRĀṬA.
13625: गुणगान n. (-नं) Panegyric, praise. E. गुण, and गान singing.
13626: गुणग्रहण n. (-णं) Acknowledging or appreciating merit. E. गुण, and ग्रहण taking.
13627: गुणग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Who judges or appreciates good qualities. E. गुण, and ग्राहिन् who seizes.
13628: गुणगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Suited to good qualities. 2 Admiring or attached to merit. E. गुण, and गृह्य to be caught by.
13629: गुणघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) A detractor, a calumniator, envious, censorious. E. गुण, and घातिन् who destroys.
13630: गुणज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who knows how to appreciate men or things, knowing or judging of their merits. E. गुण, and ज्ञ who knows.
13631: गुणतस ind. 1 According to property or quality. 2 According to desert. E. गुण, and तसि aff.
13632: गुणता f. (-ता) 1 Excellence, the possession of good qualities. 2 Substantiality, possession of attributes or qualities in general. 3 Multiplication. E. गुण, and तल् affix; also with त्व, affix गुणत्वं.
13633: गुणत्रय n. (-यं) The three properties of nature; purity, passion, and darkness. E. गुण, and त्रय triple; also गुणत्रितयं.
13634: गुणदोषपरीक्षण n. (-णं) Test or investigation of merits and faults. E. गुण, दोष fault, परीक्षण trying.
13635: गुणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The virtue incident to the possession of certain qualities, as clemency is the virtue of royalty, &c. E. गुण a property, and धर्म्म virtue.
13636: गुणन n. (-नं) 1 Describing, relating qualities. 2 Enumerating. 3 Multiplication. E. गुण to number, ल्युट् aff.
13637: गुणनिका f. (-का) 1 Dance, the science or profession of dancing, acting, &c. 2 Determining the reading of a manuscript, &c. 3 A cypher. 4 The prologue or introduction to a drama. 5 A necklace. E. कन् added to गुणनी.
13638: गुणनी f. (-नी) Examining books, studying, collating, and correcting copies, &c. E. गुण to advise, affix ल्युट्, and ङीप्.
13639: गुणनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be advised. 2 To be multiplied. 3 To be enumerated. m. (-यः) Practice, practising any thing, but especially science or study. m. (-यं) The multiplicand. E. गुण to advise, &c. अनीवर् aff.
13640: गुणपूग n. (-गं) Great merit. E. गुण, and पूग a heap.
13641: गुणप्रकर्ष m. (-र्षः) Great merit, excellence. E. गुण, and प्रकर्ष eminence.
13642: गुणप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Attached to merit, fond of excellence. E. गण, and प्रिय fond of.
13643: गुणभ्रंश mfn. (-शः) The loss of all good qualities. E. गुण good property, and भ्रंश fall, loss.
13644: गुणमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Endowed with or consisting of properties. 2 Possessed of merit. E. गुण, and मयट् aff.
13645: गुणमहत् n. (-हत्) Great merit, superior qualities. E. गुण, and महत् great.
13646: गुणयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Having virtues or properties. E. गुण, and युक्त joined.
13647: गुणलक्षण n. (-णं) Mark or indication of internal property. E. गुण, and लक्षण mark.
13648: गुणलयनिका f. (-का) A tent. E. गुण rope, ली to bind, ल्युट् and ङीप् affix, with कन् added; also गुणलयनी.
13649: गुणलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Desirous of merit, attached to excellence. E. गुण, and लुब्ध covetous.
13650: गुणवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Possessing attributes. 2 Endowed with good qualities. 3 Tied, bound, &c. E. गुण quality, and मतुप् poss. aff.
13651: गुणवत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Excellent. E. गुणवत् and तमप् aff.
13652: गुणवत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent. E. गुणवत् and तरप् aff.
13653: गुणवत्ता f. (-त्ता) Excellence. E. गुणवत् and तल् affix; also with त्व, गुणवत्त्वं.
13654: गुणवाचक n. (-कं) An adjective or attributive noun. E. गुण, and वाचक a word.
13655: गुणवैशेष्य n. (-ष्यं) Preeminence of merit or of any property. E. गुण, and वैशेष्य superiority.
13656: गुणवृक्षक m. (-कः) A mast. E. गुण a rope, and वृक्ष a tree, कन् affix of similitude; also गुणवृक्षः.
13657: गुणश्लाघा f. (-घा) Praise, encomium. E. गुण, and श्लाघा praise.
13658: गुणसम्पद् f. (-पत् or पद्) Great merit. E. गुण, and सम्पद् wealth.
13659: गुणसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Association with properties or qualities. E. गुण, and सङ्ग combination.
13660: गुणसङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) A collection of merits or properties. E. गुण, and सङ्ग्रह collection.
13661: गुणसागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Endowed with all good qualities. m. (-रः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A form of BUDDHA, a Buddha. E. गुण excellence, and सागर the ocean; an ocean of desert.
13662: गुणस्तुति f. (-तिः) Panegyric, encomium. E. गुण, and स्तुति praise.
13663: गुणहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Void of merit. 2 Free from properties. E. गुण, and हीन void of.
13664: गुणाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Possessing all excellences. m. (-रः) A name of BUDDHA the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. गुण attribute, especially good, and आकर a mine; a mine of merit.
13665: गुणातीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Freed from or beyond all properties. E. गुण, and अतीत passed.
13666: गुणानुरोध m. (-धः) Conformity or suitableness to good qualities, &c. E. गुण, and अनुरोध concurrence.
13667: गुणान्तर n. (-रं) 1 Species or sort of merit. 2 Variety of property or quality. E. गुण, and अन्तर difference.
13668: गुणान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having attributes or qualities. 2 Excellent, good, endowed with virtues. E. गुण, and अन्वित possessed of.
13669: गुणापवाद m. (-दः) Detraction. E. गुण, and अपवाद reproach.
13670: गुणाभास m. (-सः) Semblance of qualities. E. गुण, and आभास appearance.
13671: गुणाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Virtuous, excellent, able, endowed with good qualities. E. गुण, and आश्रय asylum.
13672: गुणिगण m. (-णं) A number of virtuous persons. E. गुणिन्, and गण a troop.
13673: गुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Multiplied, (arithmetically.) 2 Collected, heaped together. E. गुण to advise, &c. affix क्त.
13674: गुणिद्वैध n. (-धः) Equality of merit on two sides. E. गुणिन्, and द्वैध duality.
13675: गुणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Endowed with good qualities. m. (-णी) A bow. E. गुण a quality, &c. and इनि aff.
13676: गुणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made secondary or subordinate. 2 Invested with attributes, &c. 3 Varied according to its qualities. 4 Having a certain force or application, (a word, &c.) E. गुण, and भृत become, with च्चि augment.
13677: गुणेश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having good qualities, &c. m. (-रः) The name of a mountain, according to some, Citrakūṭa or Comptah in Bundelcund. E. गुण qualities, and ईश्वर master or possessor.
13678: गुणोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Excellence, endowment with superior qualities. E. गुण, and उत्कर्ष abundance.
13679: गुणोत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Panegyric, eulogium. E. गुण, and उत्कीर्त्तन celebrating.
13680: गुणोत्कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Superior in merit or in good qualities. E. गुण, and उत्कृष्ट best.
13681: गुणोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Endowed with good qualities. E. गुण, and उपेत possessed of.
13682: गुणौघ n. (-घं) Superior or abundant merit. E. गुण, and ओघ heap.
13683: गुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, ground, reduced to dust or powder. 2 Covered with, surrounded. E. गुठि to surround, &c. affix क्त; also गुण्डित.
13684: गुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A fragrant grass, (Scirpus kysoor.)
13685: गुण्डक m. (-कः) 1 Dust, powder. 2 Dirty meal. 3 An oil vessel. 4 A low tone. E. गुडि to surround, &c. affix वुन्.
13686: गुण्डिक mf. (-कः-का) Flour, powder, meal. E. गुडि to pound, वुन् affix, and इ inserted.
13687: गुण्डिचा f. (-चा) The name of the place where the car of JAGANNĀTHA stays for a week at the Ratha Yātrā.
13688: गुण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, ground. 2 Covered with dust. E. गुड to grind or pound, affix क्त.
13689: गुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 1 To be enumerated. 2 To be described as qualities, to be praised. 3 To be multiplied, the multiplicand. E. गुण to count, क्यप् aff.
13690: गुत्स m. (-त्सः) 1 A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. 2 A clump of grass. 3 A necklace of thirty-six strings. 4 A perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. 5 A bundle. E. गुध to enclose or surround, Uṇādi affix स; also गुत्सक, गुच्छ, &c.
13691: गुत्सक m. (-कः) 1 A nosegay, a cluster of blossoms. 2 A chowri, a cow tail. E. कन् added to the preceding; also गुच्छक.
13692: गुत्सपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Echites scholaris:) see सप्तपर्ण. E. गुत्स, and पुष्प a flower; bearing its flowers in clusters.
13693: गुत्सार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A necklace or garland of twenty-four strings. E. गुत्स a large garland, and अर्द्ध a part; also गुच्छार्द्ध.
13695: गुद n. (-दं) The anus. E. गुद to play, affix क.
13696: गुदकील m. (-लः) Piles. E. गुद the anus, कील a pin or bolt; also with कन् added गुदकीलक.
13697: गुदग्रह m. (-हः) Constipation, flatulence, &c. E. गुद the anus, and ग्रह what takes or affects.
13698: गुदभ्रंश m. (-शः) Prolapsus ani. E. गुद, and भ्रंश loss.
13699: गुदाङ्कुर m. (-रः) Piles. E. गुद the anus, and अङ्कुर a sprout.
13700: गुद्र r. 10th cl. (इ) गुद्रि (गुंद्रयति) To lie, to speak falsely.
13701: गुध r. 1st cl. (गोधते) To play. r. 4th cl. (गोध्यति) To surround, to encompass. r. 9th cl. (गोध्नाति) To be angry.
13702: गुधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, inclosed. E. गुध to surround, क्त aff.
13703: गुधेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A protector, a defender. E. गुध to invest, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
13704: गुन्दल m. (-लः) The sound of a small oblong drum. E. गुद to play, अलच् affix, and नुम् inserted.
13705: गुन्दाल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of bird, (a sort of pheasant?) 2 The bartavelle: see चकोर. E. गुन्द्रा a kind of grass, and ल what takes or eats, र rejected; also read गुन्द्राल.
13706: गुन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A kind of grass, (Saccharum sara.) f. (-न्द्रा) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis; also C. rotundus.) 2 A plant bearing a fragrant seed; also प्रियङ्गु. E. गुद to play, affix रक्, and नुम् inserted.
13707: गुन्द्राल m. (-लः) A sort of bird: see गुन्दाल.
13708: गुप r. 1st cl. (जुगुप्सते) 1 To conceal, to hide. 2 To censure, to blame or despise, (this root takes सन् irregularly.) (उ) गुपू r. 1st cl. (गोपयति) To guard or protect. (इर) गुपिर r. 4th cl. (गुप्यति) 1 To be confused or disturbed. 2 To disturb or perplex. गुप r. 10th cl. (गोपयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak.
13709: गुपिल m. (-लः) A king, a prince. E. गुप to protect, Uṇādi affix इलच्.
13710: गुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Preserved, protected. 2 Hidden, concealed, secret. 3 Joined, combined. 4 Invisible, withdrawn from sight. n. adv. (-प्तं) Privately, secretly. m. (-प्तः) An appellation forming especially the second member of the name of a Vaiśya or man of the third class. f. (-प्ता) 1 Cowach. 2 A woman who hides from her lover's endearments. E. गुप to defend, &c. affix ऊ.
13711: गुप्तगति m. (-तिः) A spy or secret emissary. f. (-तिः) Going privately or secretly. E. गुप्त and गति going.
13712: गुप्तचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what goes secretly. m. (-रः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. गुप्त, and चर who goes, or चरट् aff.
13713: गुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Concealing, hiding, concealment. 2 Preserving, protecting. 3 Restraint, check. 4 A hole in the ground, a cavern, a sink, a cellar, &c. (a place of concealment.) 5 A prison. 6 The well or lower deck of a boat. 7 Digging a hole in the ground. 8 Fortification. E. गुप to hide, &c. affix क्तिन.
13714: गुफ r. 6th cl. (गुफति) To string as a garland, &c.
13715: गुफित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, tied on a string. 2 Arranged in order. E. गुफ to string, affix क्त.
13716: गुम्फ r. 6th cl. (गुम्फति) To string together as a garland, &c.
13717: गुम्फ m. (-म्फः) 1 Tying, stringing as a garland, &c. 2 A bracelet. 3 A whisker, a mustachio. E. गुम्फ to tie or string, affix अच्.
13718: गुम्फित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tied, strung. 2 Arranged, placed in order. E. गुम्फ to tie, affix क्त; also गुफित, and ग्रन्थित.
13719: गुर r. 1st cl. (गोरति) r. 6th cl. (ई) गुरी (गुरते) To make an effort or exertion.
13720: गुरण n. (-णं) Effort, perseverance, great or continued exertion. E. गुर to make an effort, affix ल्युट्; also गोरण.
13721: गुरु mfn. (-गुरुः गुर्व्वी गुरु) 1 Heavy, weighty. 2 Great, (large or eminent.) 2 Difficult, arduous. 4 Important. 5 Much, excessive. 6 Best, excellent. 7 Venerable, respectable. 8 Dear, valuable, highly prized. 9 Accented long, (as a foot or vowel.) mn. (-रुः-रु) The long vowel, a sound equal to two Mātras or simple sounds. m. (-रुः) 1 A spiritual parent, from whom the youth receives the initiatory Mantra or prayer, and who conducts the ceremonies necessary at various seasons of infancy and youth, up to the period of investiture with the characteristic thread or string; this person may be the natural parent or the religious preceptor. 2 A religious teacher, one who explains the law and religion to his pupil, instructs him in the Śāstras, &c. 3 A name of VṚHASPATI, who is considered as the Guru or preceptor of the gods. 4 A father or any venerable male relation. E. गॄ to sound or speak, &c. Uṇādi affix कु, and उ substituted for ऋ; declaring the mode of performing the rites, &c.
13722: गुरुकार्य्य (-र्य्यं) n. 1 A serious or momentous affair. 2 The business or office of a spiritual teacher. E. गुरु as above, and कार्य्य business, &c.
13723: गुरुकोप m. (-पः) Violent wrath. E. गुरु much, and कोप anger.
13724: गुरुक्रम m. (-मः) Traditionary instruction. E. गुरु a teacher, and क्रम order.
13725: गुरुगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being with or belonging to a spiritual teacher. E. गुरु, and गत gone to.
13726: गुरुघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Destroying a spiritual parent. m. (-घ्नः) White mustard. E. गुरु, and घ्न who or what destroys.
13727: गुरुजन m. (-नः) 1 An elder, a venerable person. 2 The elders of a family, &c. E. गुरु, and जन people.
13728: गुरुण्टक m. (-कः) A kind of bird, a sort of peacock: see नीलमयूर.
13729: गुरुतल्पग m. (-गः) A violator of his teacher's bed. E. गुरु as above, तल्प a bed, and ग who goes.
13730: गुरुतल्पव्रत n. (-तं) Penance for intercourse with the wife of a Guru. E. गुरु, तल्प a bed, (defiling, &c. understood,) and व्रत penance.
13731: गुरुतल्पिन् m. (-ल्पी) One who has criminal intercourse with his teacher's wife. E. गुरु, तल्प a bed, इनि aff.
13732: गुरुताप m. (-पः) Excessive heat. E. गुरु, and ताप heat.
13733: गुरुत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Sacredness, venerableness, respectability. 2 Greatness, magnitude. 3 Weight, heaviness. 4 Burden, trouble. E. गुरु, and त्व affix; also with तल्, गुरुता.
13734: गुरुप्रमोद m. (-दः) Happiness, delight. E. गुरु, and प्रमोद pleasure.
13735: गुरुरत्न n. (-त्नं) A topaz. E. गुरु valuable, रत्न a gem.
13736: गुरुदैवत m. (-तः) The eighth lunar constellation; also पुष्य. E. गुरु and देवता deity, affix अण्; VṚHASPATI is the ruling deity of the constellation.
13737: गुरुपत्र n. (-त्रं) Tin. f. (-त्रा) The tamarind tree. E. गुरु, and पत्र leaf; heavy or abundant in leaves.
13738: गुरुमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A kind of drum or tabor. E. गुरु heavy or large, and मर्द्दल a small drum.
13739: गुरुवत् ind. Like a Guru, as a Guru. E. गुरु, and बति aff.
13740: गुरुवद्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Behaving to any one with as much respect as to a sacred teacher. E. गुरुवत्, and वृति practice.
13741: गुरुवर्च्चोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The lime or citron. E. गुरु much, वर्च्चम् heat, and घ्न what removes; of cooling properties.
13742: गुरुशिंशपा f. (-पा) A tree, (Dalbergia sisu:) see शिंशपा.
13743: गुरुशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Service of a Guru. E. गुरु, and शुश्रूषा; also गुरुपूजा, गुरुसेवा, &c.
13745: गुरुस्थिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very firm. E. गुरु, and स्थिर steady.
13746: गुरुहन् m. (-हा) The murderer of his Guru or spiritual parent. E. गुरु, and हन् who kills, from हन with क्विप् affix; this is the most heinous of all criminals, according to Hindu notions.
13747: गुर्ज्जर m. (-रः) The name of a district, Gurjara or Guzerat. plu. m. (-राः) The people of Guzerat. f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.
13748: गुर्द r. 1st cl. (गुर्दते or गूर्दते) To play. r. 10th cl. (गूर्दयति) 1 To dwell or inhabit. 2 To invite.
13749: गुर्व r. 1st cl. (ई) गुर्वी (गुर्वति) To endeavor, to aim or strive.
13750: गुर्व्वर्थम् ind. For or on account of a Guru. E. गुरु, and अर्थ object.
13751: गुर्व्वङ्गना f. (-ना) 1 The wife of a Guru. 2 Any woman entitled to great respect. E. गुरु, and अङ्गना a female.
13752: गुर्व्विणी f. (-णी) A pregnant woman. E. गर्व्व to be proud, Uṇādi affix इनच् and ङीष् fem. affix, उ substituted for the radical अ; also गर्भिणी.
13753: गुर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) 1 A pregnant woman. 2 The wife of a Guru or spiritual teacher. E. गुरु heavy, &c. and ङीष् aff.
13754: गुल m. (-लः) Raw or unrefined sugar, molasses. f. (-ला) A plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli:) see स्नुहि. (-ली) 1 A pill, a bolus, any small globular substance. 2 Small pox. E. गुड to surround, &c. affixes क and टाप्, or ङीष्, ड changed to ल.
13755: गुलञ्चकन्द m. (-न्दः) An esculent root, commonly कुली.
13756: गुलिका f. (-का) A small ball. E. कन् added to गुली.
13757: गुलिकाक्रीडा f. (-डा) Playing with a ball, bat and ball, golf, &c. E. गुलिका, and क्रीडा play.
13758: गुलुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A cluster of blossoms; also गुलुञ्छ.
13759: गुलुञ्छ m. (-ञ्छः) A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. E. गुड to preserve, affix क्विप्, and ड changed to ल, and उच्छ or इच्छि to gather or glean, affix क; also with कन् added गुलुञ्छक.
13760: गुल्फ m. (-ल्फः) The ancle. E. गल to go, affix फक्, and उ substituted for the penultimate.
13761: गुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 The division of an army, a body of troops, consisting of nine platoons, or nine elephants, nine chariots, twenty-seven horse, and forty-five foot. 2 The spleen. 3 A shrub, a bush. 4 A clump of grass, &c. 5 A fort, an intrenchment. 6 Disciplining an army, keeping it in a posture of defence. 7 A wharf or stairs, a Ghat. 8 A disease; according to some, a chronic enlargement of the spleen, but as variously situated it is any glandular enlargement in the abdomen, as that of the mesenteric gland, &c. so as to be perceived externally. f. (-ल्मी) 1 A tent. 2 Emblic myrobalan; also आमलकी. 3 Small cardamoms: see एला. 4 A cluster or clump of trees, a multitude of thickets. 5 A kind of plant, commonly Kurkavali. E. गुड to surround, मक् affix, ड changed to ल.
13762: गुल्मकेतु m. (-तुः) A small sort of cane or reed. E. गुल्म, and केतु banner.
13763: गुल्ममूल n. (-लं) Ginger. E. गुल्म, and मूल a root.
13764: गुल्मिन् mfn. (-ल्मी-ल्मिनी-ल्मि) 1 Composed of different divisions, (a force, &c.) 2 Growing, &c. in a clump or cluster. 3 Having the spleen affected by it. f. (-नी) A spreading creeper or any creeping plant. E. गुल्म a clump, इनि and ङीष् affs.
13765: गुल्य m. (-ल्यः) Sweetness, a sweet or saccharine taste. E. गुड molasses, and क्यप् affix; ड changed to ल.
13766: गुवाक m. (-कः) The betelnut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) E. गु to stool, affix आक, and उ converted to अव irregularly.
13767: गुह r. 1st cl. (ऊ) गुहू (गुहति) To cover, to cover as with clothes, to wear.
13768: गुह m. (-हः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 A swift horse. 4 The name of a Niṣāda, ruler of Sringavera, the friend of RĀMA. 5 A name or title proper to persons of the writer caste. f. (-हा) 1 A cave, a cavern. 2 A pit, a hole in the ground. 3 A plant, commonly Cākuliya: see सिंहपुच्छी. E. गुह to conceal, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
13769: गुहागृह n. (-हं) A cavern. E. गुहा, and गृह a house.
13770: गुहामुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Wide mouthed, open mouthed. E. गुहा, and मुख mouth.
13771: गुहाशय m. (-यः) 1 A tiger. 2 Any animal or man living in caverns. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. E. गुहा a cave, and आशय abode.
13772: गुहिन n. (-नं) A wood, a thicket. E. गुह to hide, इनच् aff.
13773: गुहिल n. (-लं) Wealth, property. E. गुह to hide, &c. इलच् aff.
13774: गुहेर m. (-रः) 1 An ironsmith. 2 A guardian, a preserver. E. गुह to cover, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
13775: गुह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Secret, solitary, retired. 2 Private, concealable, to be kept hidden or secret. 3 Mysterious, mystical. m. (-ह्यः) 1 A tortoise. 2 Hypocrisy. 3 VIṢṆU. n. (-ह्यं) 1 A privity, an organ of generation, &c. 2 The anus. E. गुह to cover, क्यप् affix, deriv. irr.
13776: गुह्यक m. (-कः) A kind of demigod attendant upon KUVERA the deity of wealth, and guardian of his treasures. E. गुह to preserve or conceal, affix क्वुन् and य inserted.
13777: गुह्यकेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of KUVERA the Hindu PLUTUS. E. गुह्यक a demigod, (see the preceding,) and ईश्वर lord or master.
13778: गुह्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गुह्य secret, and गुरु a master; ŚIVA being considered as the teacher, especially of the Tantras, or Hindu mystic and magical works.
13779: गुह्यदीपक m. (-कः) The fire fly. E. गुह्य a solitary place, and दीपक the illuminer; from दीप to light or inflame, and क्वुन् aff.
13780: गुह्यनिष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Urine. E. गुह्य, and निष्यन्द what flows.
13781: गुह्यभाषित n. (-तं) 1 A Mantra, a mystical prayer or incantation. 2 A secret. E. गुह्य secret, and भाषित spoken.
13782: गू (ओ) ओगू r. 6th cl. (गुवति) To void by stool; also with a short vowel, गु.
13783: गूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Hidden, concealed. n. (-ढं) 1 A solitary or private place. 2 A private part. 3 A mystery. E. गुह to hide, affix क्त, deriv. irregular.
13784: गूढचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One who goes about privately. m. (-रः) A secret emissary. E. गूढ, and चार practice.
13785: गूढचारिन् m. (-री) A secret emissary, a spy. E. गूढ, and चारिन् who goes.
13786: गूढज m. (-जः) The son of a concealed birth; born privately of a woman whose husband is absent, the real father being unknown; this is one of the twelve forms particularized in Hindu law. E. गूढ hidden, and ज born; also compounded with पुत्त्र a son, गूढजपुत्त्र.
13787: गूढनीड m. (-डः) The wagtail. E. गूड secret, and नीड a nest.
13788: गूढपथ m. (-थः) 1 Mind, intellect. 2 A bye-path, a hidden way. E. गूढ secret, and पथ a road; whose path is unperceived.
13789: गूढपाद् m. (-द् or त्) A snake. E. गूढ hidden, and पाद a foot, the final vowel rejected; also being retained गूढपाद nom. (-दः)
13790: गूढपुरुष m. (-षः) A spy, a secret emissary, a disguised agent, &c. E. गूढ concealed, and पुरुष a man.
13791: गूढभाषित n. (-तं) Secret intelligence, private communication. E. गूढ secure, and भाषित what is said.
13792: गूढमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A subterraneous passage, a defile, a bye-road, or secret way. E. गूढ concealed, and मार्ग a road.
13793: गूढमैथुन m. (-नः) A crow. E. गूढ secret, and मैथुन copulation.
13794: गूढवर्च्चस् m. (-र्च्चाः) A frog. E. गूढ hidden, and वर्च्चस light, warmth; perhaps an idea is implied analogous to that of cold blooded animals: some explain it वर्च्चस् foeces, whose excrement is unknown.
13795: गूढसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A concealed witness, one placed by the plaintiff, so as to overhear what has been said by the defendant. E. गूढ, and साक्षिन् a witness.
13796: गूढाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tortoise. E. गूढ, and अङ्ग body, hidden in his shell.
13797: गूढाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A snake. E. गूढ, and अङ्घ्रि foot.
13798: गूढोत्पन्न m. (-न्नः) The son of concealed birth: see गूढज. E. गूढ privately, and उत्पन्न born.
13799: गूथ m. (-थः) Foeces, ordure. E. गू to void by stool, and थक् Uṇādi aff.
13800: गूथलक्त m. (-क्तः) A small bird, considered to be a species of the Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. गूथ ordure, and लक्त marked.
13801: गून m. (-नः-ना-नं) Voided, (as ordure.) E. गू to stool, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
13802: गूर r. 10th cl. (गूरयते) 1 To strive, to endeavor, to make an effort or exertion. 2 To eat. (ई) गूरी r. 4th cl. (गूर्यते) 1 To hurt, to injure, as to wound, to kill, &c. 2 To be decayed or old.
13803: गूरण n. (-णं) Effort, exertion. E. गूर to strive, affix ल्युट्; also गुरण.
13804: गूर्द r. 1st cl. (गूर्दते) To play. r. 10 cl. (गूर्दयति) 1 To dwell or inhabit. 2 To invite; these roots are both written more usually with the short vowel.
13805: गूवाक m. (-कः) The betelnut tree: see गुवाक.
13806: गूषणा f. (-णा) The eye in a peacock's tail.
13807: गूहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Hiding, concealing. E. गुह to hide, शानच् aff.
13808: गूहयित्वा ind. Having concealed, hidden, disguised. E. गुह to hide, causal form, क्त्वा aff.
13809: गृ r. 1st cl. (गरति) To sprinkle, to moisten or wet.
