13810: गृज r. 1st cl. (गर्जति) also (इ,) गृजि (गृञ्जति) To sound, to roar, to grumble, &c. also गर्ज.
13811: गृञ्जन n. (-नं) Poisoned flesh, the meat of an animal destroyed by poison. m. (-नः) 1 Garlic, or a small variety of it of a red colour. 2 A turnip. 3 The tops of hemp chewed as an inebriating substance, the Gāñja. E. गृजि to sound, and ल्युट् affix; applied to the latter as causing eructation.
13812: गृणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) 1 Speaking. 2 Praising, flattering. E. ग to speak, शतृ aff.
13813: गृण्डीव m. (-वः) An animal of prey, considered as a large kind of jackal. E. गॄ to sound, and डीव affix; deriv. irr.; also sometimes short गृण्डिव.
13814: गृत्स m. (-त्सः) A name of KANDARPA. E. गृध to be desirous, and स Uṇādi aff.
13815: गृध r. 4th cl. (उ,) गृधु (गृध्यति) To covet, to desire greedily, to be greedy.
13816: गृधु m. (-धुः) 1 The deity KĀMA or love. 2 A libidinous man. E. गृध to desire, कु Uṇādi aff.
13817: गृधू m. (-धूः) 1 Understanding. 2 Air voided downwards. 3 Bad, wicked. E. गृध, and कू Uṇādi aff.
13818: गृध्नु mfn. (-ध्नुः-ध्नुः-ध्नु) Covetous, cupidinous, greedy. E. गृध to be greedy, क्नु aff.
13819: गृध्नुता f. (-ता) Covetousness, greediness, extreme and illiberal desire. E. गृध्नु greedy, and तल् abstract aff.
13820: गृध्र mfn. (-ध्रः-ध्रा-ध्रं) Desirous, greedy, covetous. m. (-घ्रः) A vulture. E. गृध to desire, and क्रन् Uṇādi affix; it may also be written गृद्ध.
13821: गृध्रनखी f. (-खी) 1 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) 2 A wild kind of the same, (Zizyphus nepeca.) E. गृध्र a vulture, and नख nail, having thorns like a vulture's claws.
13822: गृध्रराज m. (-जः) A name of JAṬĀYU. E. गृध्र, and राज king.
13823: गृध्रसी f. (-सी) 1 Lumbago. 2 Rheumatism affecting the loins. E. गृध desire, सो to destroy, ड and ङीप् affixes; also sometimes written ग्रध्रसी.
13824: गृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) 1 A cow that has had one calf. 2 A yam. 3 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. घृष to grind, affix क्तिन्, and घ changed to ग.
13825: गृह r. 1st cl. (ऊ,) गृहू (गर्हते) also r. 10th cl. (गृहयते) To take, to seize, to receive or accept; also ग्रह.
13826: गृह n. (-हं) 1 A house, a mansion, a habitation in general. 2 A wife: (in these senses the plural is always masculine, गृहाः). 3 A name, an appellation. E. गृह to receive or take, (grain, goods, &c.) affix क.
13827: गृहकच्छप m. (-पः) A small flat oblong stone, used for grinding condiments, &c. E. गृह a house, and कच्छप a tortoise.
13828: गृहकन्या f. (-न्या) The aloe, (Aloes perfoliata;) also घृतकुमारी, कुमारी, &c. E. गृह a house, and कन्या a virgin.
13829: गृहकपोतक m. (-कः) A pigeon, a tame or domestic pigeon. E. गृह a house, and कपोतक a dove or pigeon.
13830: गृहकरण n. (-णं) 1 Household affairs. 2 House building. E. गृह, and करण making.
13831: गृहकारक m. (-कः) 1 A house builder. 2 A thatcher. E. गृह, and कारक who makes.
13832: गृहकारिन् m. (-री) 1 A kind of wasp. 2 A house builder. E. गृह a house, and कारिन् who makes, building a nest or house of clay, &c.
13833: गृहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Household affairs. E. गृह, and कार्य्य business; also गृहकर्म्म, &c.
13834: गृहगोधा f. (-धा) A small house lizard. E. गृह a house, and गोधा or गोधिका an iguana; hence also गृहगोधिका, or ध being changed to ल, गृहगोलिका.
13835: गृहगोलिका f. (-का) A lizard: see the preceding.
13836: गृहचटक m. (-कः) A house sparrow. E. गृह, and चटक a sparrow.
13837: गृहछिद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 Private or family afflictions or troubles. 2 A breach in a house. E. गृह, and छिद्र a hole; also गृहरग्ध्रं.
13838: गृहज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in the house. m. (-जः) A slave born in the house. E. गृह, and ज born; also गृहजात.
13840: गृहतटी f. (-टी) A terrace in front of a house, a threshold. E. गृह a house, and तट a bank.
13841: गृहदास mf. (-सः-सी) A domestic slave. E. गृह, and दास a slave.
13842: गृहदीप्ति f. (-प्तिः) A virtuous woman. E. गृह, and दीप्ति light.
13843: गृहद्वार m. (-रः) The door of a house. E. गृह, and द्वार a door.
13844: गृहद्रुम m. (-मः) A plant commonly Medhasriṅgi: see मेढशृङ्गी. E. गृह a house, द्रुम a tree, growing near dwellings.
13845: गृहनाशन m. (-नः) A pigeon. E. गृह, and नाशन who injures; defacing the walls of a house by building in and about it.
13846: गृहनीड m. (डः) A sparrow. E. गृह, and नीड a nest, who builds his nest in human dwellings.
13847: गृहपति m. (-तिः) 1 A householder, a man of the second class, or who after having finished his studies is married and settled. 2 A householder of particular merit, giving alms, and performing all the prescribed ceremonies, &c. 3 Maintenance of a sacred and perpetual fire. 4 Virtue, especially of a householder, as hospitality, &c. E. गृह a house, and पति lord or master.
13848: गृहपोतक m. (-कः) The site of a habitation, the ground on which it stands, and which is attached to it. E. गृह, and पोत a young animal, affix कन्, the rudiments of the house.
13849: गृहबलि m. (-लिः) Offering of the reliques of a meal, or sacrifice to the spirits of the air, &c. E. गृह, and वलि offering.
13850: गृहबलिप्रिय m. (-यः) A kind of crane, the Vaca. E. गृह a house, बलि food offered in oblation, and प्रिय fond of: see the next.
13851: गृहबलिभुज् m. (-भुक्) 1 A sparrow. 2 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) 3 A crow. E. गृह a house or a wife, बलि grain, &c. used in oblations, or any edible grain, and भुज् who eats; that is, who eats the food of his female, or the fragments of offerings fallen in or about the house; also गृहवलिप्रिय.
13852: गृहभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 An exile, one who is driven from his house. 2 Family decay. 3 Breaking down or into a house. E. गृह, and भङ्ग breaking.
13853: गृहभञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Breaking down or destroying a house. 2 Causing the ruin or decay of a family. E. गृह, and भञ्जन breaking.
13854: गृहभूमि f. (-मिः) The site of a habitation. E. गृह a house, and भूमि ground.
13855: गृहमणि m. (-णिः) A lamp. E. गृह a house, and मणि a jewel.
13856: गृहमाचिका f. (-का) A bat. E. गृह a house, and माचिका a fly.
13857: गृहमृग m. (-गः) A dog. E. गृह a house, and मृग a deer.
13858: गृहमेधिन् m. (-धी) A householder. f. (-धिनी) 1 A housewife, the wife of a householder. 2 Natural sense or intelligence. E. गृह a house, मेध to understand, and इनि aff.
13859: गृहयाप्य m. (-प्यः) The householder, the master of a house or family. E. गृह to take, आप्य Uṇādi affix, and अय inserted.
13860: गृहयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Disposed to seize or take. E. गृह to take, अय inserted, and आलुच् aff.
13861: गृहरन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 1 Private or family affairs, especially of an unpleasing nature. 2 A breach in the wall of a house. E. गृह, and रन्ध्र a hole; also गृहछिद्रं.
13862: गृहवाटिका f. (-का) A garden or grove near a house. E. गृह a house, वट to surround, affix ण्वुल्, and fem. form.
13863: गृहव्यापार m. (-रः) Household affairs, domestic economy. E. गृह, and व्यापार practice.
13864: गृहस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) The pillar of a house. E. गृह, and स्तम्भ a post.
13865: गृहस्थ m. (-स्थः) A householder, the man of the second class, or he who, after having finished his studies, and been invested with the sacred thread, performs the duties of the master of a house, and father of a family. E. गृह a house, and स्थ who stays or abides.
13866: गृहस्थधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The practice or duty of a householder. E. गृहस्थ, and धर्म्म duty.
13867: गृहस्थाश्रम m. (-मः) The order of householder. E. गृहस्थ, and आश्रम order of life.
13868: गृहस्थूण n. (-णं) The pillar of a house. E. गृह a house, and स्थूण a prop or pillar.
13869: गृहाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A loophole, an eyelet hole, a round or oblong window. E. गृह a house, and अक्ष for अक्षि an eye.
13870: गृहागत m. (-तः) A guest. E. गृह, and आगत come to.
13871: गृहाधिप m. (-पः) The Gṛhastha or householder: see गृहस्थ. E. गृह a house, and अधिप a master.
13872: गृहाभिपालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Watching, taking care of the house. m. (-ली) A watchman. E. गृह and अभि before पाल to protect, णिनि aff.
13873: गृहाम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sour gruel, made from the fermentation of rice water. E. गृह a house, and अम्ल sour, the domestic acid.
13874: गृहायणिक m. (-कः) A householder. E. गृह a house, फिञ् derivative affix, and कन् added.
13875: गृहाराम m. (-मः) A garden, a grove, &c. near a house. E. गृह a house, and आराम a garden.
13876: गृहालिका f. (-का) A small lizard. E. गृह a house, आलि a scorpion, कन् affix of similitude.
13877: गृहावग्रहणी f. (-णी) The threshold, a raised ground or a terrace in front of the door. E. गृह a house, and अव prefixed to ग्रह to take, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.
13878: गृहावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dwelling or living in a house. 2 Lying in any place. E. गृह, and अवस्थित placed or situated in.
13879: गृहाशया f. (-या) The betel tree, (Piper betel.) E. गृह a house, &c. आशय an asylum, growing near dwellings.
13880: गृहाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) A flat oblong stone, upon which condiments are ground together. E. गृह a house, and अश्मन् a stone.
13881: गृहिणी f. (-णी) A wife. E. गृह a house, and इनि and ङीष् affs.
13882: गृहिन् m. (-ही) A householder. E. गृह a house, and इनि aff.
13883: गृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, attached, seized, caught. 2 Obtained. 3 Known, understood. 4 Promised, agreed. 5 Learnt, acquired. E. ग्रह to take, affix क्त, र charged to ऋ.
13884: गृहीतविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Versed in science, learned, studied. E. गृहीत, and विद्या learning.
13885: गृहीतदिश् mfn. (-दिक्) Flown, escaped, retreated. E. गृहीत seized, and दिश place.
13886: गृहीतवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Paid, remunerated. E. गृहीत, and वेतन wages.
13887: गृहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Taking, disposed to seize or take. E. ग्रह to seize, affix तृच्, and ई inserted.
13888: गृहीत्वा ind. Having taken. E. ग्रह to take, क्त्वा aff.
13889: गृहोपकरण n. (-णं) Any domestic utensil. E. गृह, and उपकरण instrument.
13890: गृहोत्पात m. (-तः) 1 A domestic nuisance, as vermin, &c. 2 Family misfortune. E. गृह, and उत्पात calamity.
13891: गृहोलिका f. (-का) A small house lizard. E. गृह to take, and उल and कन् affixes: see गृहगोधिका.
13892: गृह्णत् mfn. (-ह्णन्-ह्णन्ती-ह्णत्) Taking, seizing, accepting, &c. E. ग्रह to take, शतृ aff.
13893: गृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Dependant, subservient. 2 A partisan of or belonging to a side or party. 3 To be taken or seized. 4 To be trusted to, to be relied on. 5 To be acknowledged or admitted, to be adopted as faith or belief. 6 Domestic, of or belonging to a house. m. (-ह्यः) A tame or domesticated animal. n. (-ह्यं) 1 The name of a book, containing directions for religious rites, a section or component treatise of the Sāma Veda, by GOBHILA and others; which contains rules for the performance of domestic and other ceremonies: the ritual of the Vedas. f. (-ह्या) A suburb, a village adjoining to a city, or a small village attached to a larger. E. ग्रह or गृह to take, affix क्यप्; or गृह a house, यत् affix; also with कन् added गृह्यक.
13894: गृह्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dependent, docile, not following one's own inclinations. m. (-कः) A tame or domesticated animal, whether a bird or beast, &c. E. गृह for ग्रह to take, क्यप् affix, and कन् added.
13895: गृह्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गृह्य, and गुरु a teacher.
13896: गृह्यसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A precept of the Gṛhya or ritual of the Vedas. E. गृह्य, and सूत्र a rule.
13897: गॄ r. 6th cl. (गिरति or गिलति) To swallow, to eat. r. 9th cl. (गृणाति) To sound, to sound intelligibly or articulately, to speak. r. 10th cl. (गीरयते) 1 To know. 2 To make known, to teach: With निर् or उत् prefixed, To reject, to vomit. With सम् and उत्, 1 To throw up. 2 To cry aloud.
13898: गेण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A ball for playing with. E. गा to go, affix इण्डु, or with कन् added गेण्डुक.
13899: गेण्डुक m. (-कः) A ball; also गेण्डूक, the penultimate being made long.
13900: गेप r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेपृ (गेपते) 1 To shake or tremble. 2 To move.
13901: गेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 A singer. 2 A song or chaunt, what is to be sung or chaunted. n. (-यं) Song, singing. E. गै to sing, affix यत्.
13902: गेव r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेवृ (गेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
13903: गेष r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेषृ (गेषते) To seek, to search, to investigate.
13904: गेष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 1 A professional singer, an actor, a mime, &c. 2 A chaunter of the Sāma Veda. E. गै to sing, and इष्णच् Uṇādi aff.
13905: गेष्णु m. (-ष्णुः) 1 A singer. 2 An actor. 3 A chaunter of the Sāma Veda: see गेष्ण. E. गै to sing, and इष्णुच् Uṇādi aff.
13906: गेह n. (-हं) A house, a dwelling. E. ग a name of GAṆEŚA, इह to desire, affix घञ्; that deity being usually invoked upon laying the foundations of a house.
13907: गेहनर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A lazy or effeminate man, a cotquean. E. गेह a house, and नर्द्दिन् who makes a noise: see the next.
13908: गेहशूर m. (-रः) A slothful and trifling man, one who is unfit for concerns beyond those of the house, a cotquean, a house-hero. E. गेह a house, and शूर a hero.
13909: गेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Having a house, a householder, &c. E. गेह, and इनि aff.
13910: गै r. 1st cl. (गायति) To sound, to sing. With उद् or प्र prefixed; (उद्गायति प्रगायति) To sing, to chaunt, to sing out or aloud. (उद्गीयते प्रगीयते) To be sung or chaunted. With वि (विगायति) To assert repeatedly.
13911: गैर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Mountain, mountaineer, mountain-born. E. गिरि, and अण् aff.
13912: गैरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mountain, mountain-born or produced. n. (-कं) 1 Red chalk, or as sometimes applied, red orpiment. 2 Gold. E. गिरि a mountain, affix ठक्.
13913: गैरेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain, mountaineer, mountain-born. n. (-यं) 1 Bitumen. 2 Red chalk. E. गिरि a mountain, affix ढक्.
13914: गो m. (-गौः) 1 Heaven, Svarga or paradise. 2 A bull. 3 A ray of light. 4 The thunderbolt. 5 The moon. 6 The sun. 7 A kind of sacrifice, the sacrifice of a cow. 8 The moment of the sun's entering Taurus. mn. (-गौः-गु) 1 The hair of the body. 2 Water: (in the last sense some confine it to the mas. plu. गावः and according to others, it is neuter in several other senses.) f. (-गौः) 1 A cow. 2 The eye. 3 An arrow. 4 A quarter, as the east, west, &c. 5 Speech; also identified with the goddess of speech, SARASVATĪ. 6 The earth. 7 A mother. E. गम to go, and डो Uṇādi aff.
13915: गोकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 The name of a plant: see गोखुर. 2 The print of a cow's hoof or spot so marked. E. गो the earth or a cow, &c. and कण्टक a thorn.
13916: गोकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A span from the tip of the thumb to that of the little finger. 2 A kind of deer, (the Nīlgau?) 3 A mule. 4 A class of demigods. 5 A kind of snake. 6 A snake in general. 7 A place of pilgrimage on the Malabar coast. f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides:) see मूर्व्वा. E. गो a cow, and कर्ण an ear, having ears like a cow, &c.
13917: गोकिराटिका f. (-का) A bird, considered as one kind of the common Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. गो the earth, and किर a hog, अट who goes, with कन् added in the fem. form; resembling a hog, feeding on ordure, &c.
13918: गोकिल m. (-लः) 1 A plough. 2 A pestle. E. गो the earth, and किल to go, affix क; also गोकील.
13919: गोकील m. (-लः) 1 A pestle. 2 A plough. E. गो the earth, and कील a pin or bolt.
13920: गोकुल n. (-लं) 1 A herd of kine, a multitude of cattle. 2 A cowhouse or station. 3 A village or tract on the Jumna, the residence of NANDA and of KṚṢṆA during his youth. E. गो a cow, and कुल an assemblage.
13921: गोकुलिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Squint-eyed. 2 One who gives help to a cow in the mud. E. गो the eye, &c. and कुल to accumulate, affix ठक्.
13922: गोकृत n. (-तं) Cowdung. E. गो a cow, and कृत made.
13923: गोक्षुर m. (-रः) The name of a plant; also Gokhura, (Ruellia longifolia, Rox. it is also applied in Bengal to Tribulus lanuginosus.) n. (-रं) A cow's hoof. E. गो a cow, and क्षुर a hoof, the thorns getting between the hoofs of cattle; also with कन् added गोक्षुरक, and with खुर a hoof, गोखुर.
13925: गोखुर m. (-रः) See गोक्षुर; also गोखुरि.
13926: गोगोयुग n. (-गं) A pair of oxen. E. गो, and गोयुग a pair.
13927: गोगोष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A cattle shed. E. गो, and गोष्ठ a shed.
13928: गोगृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A cow that has had one calf. E. गो a cow, and गृष्टि q. v. the same as the compound.
13929: गोग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 1 Dried cow-dung. 2 A station for cows, a cowyard or house, &c. E. गो a cow, ग्रन्थ to arrange, and इन् aff.
13930: गोग्रह m. (-हः) Spoil, booty, capture of cattle. E. गो, and ग्रह seizing.
13931: गोग्रास m. (-सः) The ceremony of presenting grass to the cow when making atonement. E. गो, and ग्रास a mouthful.
13932: गोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Who or what kills kine. m. (-घ्नः) A guest. E. गो a cow, and घ्न what kills, from हन् with टक् affix; a cow being killed on the arrival of the latter, or being presented to him.
13933: गोघृत n. (-तं) 1 Rain. 2 Ghee made from cow's milk. E. गो the earth, घृत what sprinkles, from घृ to sprinkle or wet, affix क्त.
13934: गोचर m. (-रः) 1 An object of sense, as sound, shape, colour, &c. 2 A country, a district. 3 The house or mansion of a planet, or its presence in any sign which is that of a person's nativity. 4 Pasturage. E. गो an organ of sense, &c. and चर what goes, from चर to go, घ aff.
13935: गोचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A cow's hide. 2 A hide of land, 300 feet long, by 10 broad: it is also defined as that extent of land, the crop of which will support a man for a year. E. गो, and चर्म्मन् skin.
13936: गोचारक m. (-कः) A cowherd. E. गो, चर to go, causal form, वुन् aff.
13937: गोछाल m. (-लः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended, &c. see अलम्बुष.
13938: गोजल n. (-लं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and जल water.
13939: गोजागरिक m. (-कः) A prickly nightshade. n. (-कं) Happy, fortunate, auspicious. E. गो the earth, जागृ to wake or to be awake, affix ठक्.
13940: गोजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A potherb growing wild, (Elephantophus scaber.) E. गो a cow, and जिह्वा a tongue: the leaves being so compared; also with कन् added गोजिह्वका.
13941: गोडु m. (-डुः) A lump of flesh on the navel. E. गुड to be sound, affix घञ्.
13942: गोडुम्ब mf. (-म्बः-म्बा) The water melon. f. (-म्बा) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) E. गो the earth, लुवि to hurt, affix अच्, and ल changed to ड.
13943: गोणी f. (-णी) 1 Torn or ragged clothes. 2 A sack. 3 The measure of a Droṇa. E. गुण to reckon, affixes अच् and ङीष्, the deriv. irr.
13944: गोण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) A person with a prominent navel. m. (-ण्डः) A man of a low tribe, a mountaineer, especially inhabiting the eastern portion of the Vindhya range, between the Nerbudda and Kṛṣṇa, giving name to the province of Gondwana. 2 A prominent navel, or a lump of flesh on the navel, &c. E. गुडि to enclose, &c. अच् aff.
13945: गोतम m. (-मः) The name of a sage; also गौतम.
13946: गोतमान्वय m. (-यः) A name of ŚĀKYA or ŚĀKYA MUNI, a Bauddha sage. E. गोतम a sage, and अन्वय lineage; the descendant of GOTAMA.
13947: गोतल्लज m. (-जः) An excellent cow. E. गो a cow, तल्लज implying excellence.
13948: गोत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Family, race, lineage, kin. 2 A name, an appellation. 3 A forest. 4 A field. 5 A Catta, an umbrella or parasol. 6 A road. 7 Knowledge of futurity, inspiration. 8 A genus, a class or species. 9 A caste, a tribe or subdivision of it into families, as in that of the Brahman; twenty-four Gotras are reckoned, supposed to be sprung from and named after celebrated teachers, as ŚĀṆḌILYA, KAŚYAPA, GAUTAMA, BHĀRADVĀJA, &c. 10 Increase. 11 Wealth. f. (-त्रा) 1 The earth. 2 A herd of kine. m. (-त्रः) 1 A mountain. E. गु to sound, and त्र Uṇādi affix, or गो the earth, &c. and त्र what preserves, from त्रै with क aff.
13949: गोत्रज m. (-जः) A relation: in law, the term is nearly equivalent to the Gentile of Roman law, and is applied to kindred of the same general family, who are connected by offerings of food and water, and stands opposed to the Bandhu or cognate kin, who do not partake in the offerings to the common ancestors: see बन्धु. E. गोत्र as above, ज born.
13950: गोत्रभिद् m. (-भिद् or भित्) A name of INDRA. E. गोत्र a mountain, and भिद् who splits, (with his thunderbolt.)
13951: गोत्ररिक्थ n. (-क्थं) Patrimony, inheritance. E. गोत्र, and रिक्थ wealth.
13952: गोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives a cow. m. (-दः) The brain. E. गो light or a cow, and द what gives.
13953: गोदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Yellow orpiment. 2 A cow's tooth. 3 A fossile substance of a white colour, apparently an earthy salt. E. गो a cow, and दन्त a tooth, a cow's tooth, from its similar hardness, &c.
13954: गोदा f. (-दा) The Godāvarī river. E. गो water, and द who gives: see गोदावरी.
13955: गोदान n. (-नं) Gift of a cow. E. गो, and दान gift; also गोप्रदान.
13956: गोदारण m. (-णः) 1 A plough. 2 A spade or hoe. E. गो the earth, and दारण what cuts or tears.
13957: गोदावरी f. (-री) The name of a river in the peninsula, the Godāvarī. E. गो water, and द what gives, गोद and आवृ to cover or conceal; affixes अप् and ङीष्.
13958: गोदुग्ध n. (-ग्धं) Cow's milk. E. गो, and दुग्ध milk.
13959: गोदुह् m. (-धुक्) A cowherd, a milkman. E. गो a cow, दुह to milk, and क्विप् affix; also with क affix गोदुह, nom. (-हः)
13960: गोदोहनी f. (-नी) A milk pail. E. गो a cow, and दुह to milk, with ल्युट् and ङीष् aff.
13961: गोद्रव n. (-वं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and द्रव what runs from.
13962: गोधन n. (-नं) A herd of cows, a multitude or number of cattle, especially if considered as property. m. (-नः) A large headed arrow. E. गो a cow, and धन wealth.
13963: गोधा f. (-धा) 1 A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm, to prevent its being injured by the bowstring. 2 An iguana, either the Gosamp or the alligator. E. गुध to surround, affixes अङ् and टाप्; see गोधिक.
13964: गोधापदिका f. (-का) Cissus pedata. E. कन् added to the next.
13965: गोधापदी f. (-दी) A plant, (Cissus pedata.) E. गोधा, and पद for पाद a foot, affix ङीष्, the root being compared to an alligator's foot.
13966: गोधि m. (-धिः) 1 The forehead. 2 The Gangetic alligator. 3 An iguana. E. गो the eye or water, and धा to possess, with कि aff.
13967: गोधिका f. (-का) 1 The Gangetic alligator. 2 The iguana. E. कन् with the fem. form added to गोधा.
13968: गोधिकात्मज m. (-जः) The iguana. E. गोधा an alligator, and आत्मज offspring, here used to imply diminution: so गोधिकापुत्र, &c.
13969: गोधुम m. (-मः) Wheat: see the next.
13970: गोधूम m. (-मः) 1 Wheat. 2 The orange. 3 The name of a drug. E. गुध to surround, and ऊम Uṇādi aff.
13971: गोधूमचूर्ण n. (-र्लं) Wheat flour. E. गोधूम, and चूर्ण powder.
13972: गोधूमसम्भव n. (-वं) Sour paste. E. गोधूम, and सम्भव produced.
13973: गोधूलि f. (-लिः) A period of the day, in the hot season when the sun is half risen; in the cold and dewy seasons, when the sun is full but mild; and in the three other seasons, sunset. E. गो, and धूलि dust.
13974: गोधेनु f. (-नुः) A milch cow. E. गो a cow, and धेनु the same.
13975: गोधेर m. (-रः) A guardian, a protector, a preserver.
13976: गोनन्दी f. (-न्दी) The female of the Sāras or Indian crane. E. गो water, नदि to be happy, अच् and ङीष् affs.
13977: गोनर्द m. (-र्दः) The Sāras or Indian crane. n. (-र्दं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गो water, नर्द to sound, affix अच्.
13978: गोनर्द्दीय m. (-यः) A name of the saint PATAÑJALI, the founder of the Yoga philosophy. E. गो heaven, नर्द्दीय to be sounded or celebrated.
13979: गोनस m. (-सः) 1 A large kind of snake, by some considered to be the same with the Boa or Bor. 2 A kind of gem. E. गो a cow, and नस a nose, cow-nosed; also गोनास.
13980: गोनाथ m. (-थः) 1 A bull. 2 A herdsman. E. गो, and नाथ master.
13981: गोनास m. (-सः) A snake: see गोनास.
13982: गोनिष्यन्द n. (-न्दं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and निष्यन्द what oozes.
13983: गोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 A helper, a friend or patron. 2 A preserver, a cherisher. 3 Who or what hides or conceals. m. (-पः) 1 Superintendent of a district. 2 The head of a cowpen. 3 A herdsman, a cowherd, a milkman by caste and occupation. 4 A king. 5 Myrrh: see गोपरस. f. (-पा or -पी) A plant, (Echites frutescens). f. (-पा) A milkwoman, a female cowherd. f. (-पी) 1 A cowherd's wife, but especially applied to those of Vṛndāvana, the companions and objects of KṚṢṆA'S juvenile sports, and who are considered sometimes as holy or celestial personages. 2 A protectress. 3 Nature, elementary nature. E. गो the earth, &c. and प what preserves; also in some senses गुप to hide, to protect, &c. affix घञ्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
13984: गोपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who guards or protects. (-कः) 1 Myrrh. 2 The superintendant of a district. E. कन् added to the preceding.
13985: गोपकन्या f. (-न्या) 1 The daughter of a cowherd. 2 A nymph of Vṛndāvana. 3 A medicinal plant. E. गोप, and कन्या a daughter.
13986: गोपघोण्टा f. (-ण्टा) A wild sort of jujube, (Zizyphus nepeca.) E. गोप a cowherd, and घोण्टा the jujube.
13987: गोपति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Of INDRA. 3 The sun. 4 A king. 5 A bull. E. गो the earth, &c. and पति lord or master.
13988: गोपतिचाप m. (-पः) The rainbow. E. गोपति INDRA, and चाप a bow.
13989: गोपदल m. (लः) The areca tree. E. गोप preserving, and दल a leaf.
13990: गोपन n. (-नं) 1 Protecting, guarding. 2 Concealment, hiding. 3 Reviling, abuse. 4 Flurry, hurry, alarm. 5 Light, lustre. 6 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. गुप to hide, ल्युट् aff.
13991: गोपनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Secret, mysterious, to be concealed or hidden. 2 To be preserved or protected. E. गुप to hide, &c. अनीयर् aff.
13992: गोपबधू f. (-धूः) 1 The wife of a cowherd. 2 A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa.) E. गोप, and वधू a wife.
13993: गोपबधूटी f. (-टी) The youthful wife of a cowherd.
13994: गोपभद्र m. (-द्रः) The fibrous root of a waterlily. E. गोप a cowherd, and भद्र lucky, auspicious.
13995: गोपभद्रिका f. (-का) The name of a tree: see गम्भारी. E. गोप a preserver, and भद्र auspicious, and कन् and टाप् affs.
13996: गोपरस m. (-सः) Gum myrrh. E. गोप secret, and रस juice, exuding in a manner or place unknown.
13997: गोपवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens:) see श्यामलता. 2 Another plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa.) E. गोप a cowherd, and वल्ली a pedicle, being used in medicines for cattle.
13998: गोपाटविक m. (-कः) A cowherd. E. गो, and पाटविक clever.
13999: गोपानसी f. (-सी) 1 The wood of a thatch. 2 A crooked beam which supports it. 3 The bamboo frame work on which it rests. E. गोप preserving, affixes नसट् and ङीष्, आ inserted.
14000: गोपायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A preserver, a cherisher, one who guards or protects. E. गुप to preserve, ण्वुल् aff.
14001: गोपायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preserved, protected, cherished. E. गुप to protect, affix क्त.
14002: गोपाल m. (-लः) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A cowherd. 3 A name of KṚṢṆA. E. गो the earth, &c. and पाल who preserves or protects.
14003: गोपालक m. (-कः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 KṚṢṆA. 3 A cow keeper or protector. E. गो a cow or the earth, पाल् to cherish, and वुन् aff.
14004: गोपालिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of worm. 2 A female cowherd: see गोपालक.
14005: गोपाष्टमी f. (-मी) The eighth lunation of the light half of Kārttika, on which KṚṢṆA became a cowherd; cows are to be worshipped. E. गोप, and अष्टमी the eighth.
14006: गोपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) A protector, one who preserves or protects. f. (-नी) 1 A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.) 2 A cowherd's wife. E. गुप to preserve, णिनि and ङीष् affs.
14007: गोपिका f. (-का) A female cowherd, &c.: see गोपक.
14008: गोपिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who preserves or protects. E. गुप, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
14009: गोपीचन्दन n. (-नं) A species of white clay, said to be brought from Dvārakā, and used by the worshippers of VIṢṆU to smear their faces with. E. गोपी, and चन्दन Sandal.
14010: गोपीथ m. (-थः) Preserving, protecting. n. (-थं) A holy place, a place of pilgrimage. E. गोप preserving, and थक् Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.
14011: गोपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 A cowtail. 2 A sort of necklace, one of four or thirty-four strings. 3 A sort of monkey. E. गो a cow, and पुच्छ a tail, resembling or possessing a cow's tail.
14013: गोपुटिक n. (-कं) A temple or edifice consecrated to ŚIVA'S bull. E. गो a cow, and पट to enclose, affix इकन्.
14014: गोपुर n. (-रं) 1 A town gate. 2 A gate in general. 3 The ornamented gateway of a temple. 4 A kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गुप to preserve, and ऊरच् aff.
14015: गोपुरीष n. (-षं) Cowdung. E. गो, and पुरीष dung.
14016: गोपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. गोप a cowherd, and इन्द्र lord or chief.
14017: गोपेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚĀKYA MUNI, a Buddha. 2 A name of KṚṢṆA. 3 A chief herdsman, the keeper or owner of kine. 4 A name of NANDA. E. गोप a cowherd, and ईश lord.
14018: गोप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ) A preserver, a protector, one who defends or cherishes. E. गुप to preserve, &c. affix तृच्.
14019: गोप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 To be cherished or preserved. 2 To be kept secret or hidden. 3 To be kept, to be taken care of. m. (-प्यः) 1 A slave. 2 The son of a female slave. E. गुप to preserve, &c. ण्य aff.
14020: गोप्यक m. (-कः) A servant or slave. E. कन् added to the preceding.
14021: गोप्याधि f. (-धिः) A pledge, that is not to be used, but to be carefully preserved. E. गोप्य to be preserved, and आधि a pledge.
14022: गोप्रकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An excellent cow. E. गो a cow, and प्रकाण्ड excellent; the compound is always neuter.
14023: गोप्रचार m. (-रः) Pasturage ground. E. गो, and प्रचार going.
14025: गोबध m. (-धः) Killing a cow. E. गो, and बध killing.
14026: गोबाल m. (-लः) The hair of a cow. E. गो, and बाल hair.
14027: गोभण्डीर m. (-रः) A water fowl. E. गो water, भडि to sound, affix ईरच्.
14028: गोम r. 10th cl. (गोमयति) To smear, to anoint.
14029: गोमक्षिका f. (-का) A gadfly. E. गो a cow, and मक्षिका a fly: stinging cattle.
14030: गोमण्डल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe. E. गो, and मण्डल sphere.
14031: गोमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Possessing herds, rich in cattle. f. (-मती) The name of a river, the Goomtī, in the province of Oude. 2 A prayer or formula of the Vedas, to be repeated during expiation for killing a cow. E. गो a cow or water, and मतुप् aff.
14032: गोमतल्लिका f. (-का) A tractable and good cow. E. गो a cow, मतल्लिका excellence.
14033: गोमध्यमध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्वं) Slender in the waist. E. गो a cow, &c. मध्य middle: repeated.
14034: गोमन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The name of a mountain. 2 An owner of cattle. 3 A herd of cattle. E. गो the earth, मन to mind, झच् aff.
14035: गोमय mn. (-यः-यं) 1 Cowdung. 2 The property or nature of a cow. E. गो a cow, and मयट् affix of relation or comprehension.
14036: गोमयछत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom, a fungus. E. गोमय cowdung, and छत्र a Catta or parasol.
14037: गोमयछविका f. (-का) A kind of fungus or mushroom. E. कन् and the fem. form added to the preceding.
14038: गोमयप्रिय n. (-यं) A sort of grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) E. गोमय cowdung, and प्रिय favourable to.
14039: गोमयोत्था f. (-त्था) A kind of beetle found in cowdung. E. गोमय cowdung, and उत्थ what rises or is generated.
14040: गोमयोद्भव m. (-वः) Cassia fistula. E. गोमय, and उद्भव born, produced, requiring manure.
14041: गोमायु m. (-युः) 1 A jackall. 2 A kind of Gandharba or celestial musician. 3 The bile or bilious humor of the cow. E. गो sound, &c. मा to measure, and उण् Uṇādi affix, य inserted, or गो a cow, and मायु bile.
14042: गोमिथुन n. (-नं) A pair of cattle. E. गो, and मिथुन a couple.
14043: गोमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Rich in herds, &c. m. (-मी) 1 The owner of cattle. 2 A jackall. 3 A worshipper. 4 An attendant on a Buddha. E. गो a cow, &c. मिनि aff.
14044: गोमिल m. (-लः) Name of a Muni.
14045: गोमीन m. (-नः) A sort of fish, the bull-fish. E. गो, and मीन a fish.
14046: गोमुख n. (-खं) 1 A house built unevenly or crookedly, viz. with angles, projections, &c. 2 A kind of musical instrument, (a sort of horn or trumpet?) 3 Spreading unguents, plastering, smearing. 4 A hole in a wall made by thieves, &c a breach. m. (-खः) 1 A shark. 2 A kind of Yakṣa; according to the Jainas, a demigod subservient to their deified saints. nf. (-खं-खी) A cloth-bag, containing a rosary into which the hand is thrust to count the beads. f. (-खी) The chasm in the Himālaya mountains through which the Ganges flows, erroneously conceived by the Hindus to be of the shape of a cow's mouth. 2 A river in Bengal. E. गो a cow, and मुख face, having the face of a cow, &c.
14047: गोमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Stupid as an ox. E. गो, and मूढ foolish.
14048: गोमूत्र n. (-त्रं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and मूत्र urine.
14049: गोमूत्रिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of grass, described as growing in corn fields, of a reddish colour, and eaten by cattle, commonly Tāmbāda (तांवड.) 2 A verse the second half of which repeats nearly all the syllables of the first. 3 A form of calculation. E. गो, मूत्र urine, कन् affix; operating on cows as a diuretic.
14050: गोमेद m. (-दः) A yellow gem: see the next.
14051: गोमेदक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A gem or precious stone brought from the Himālaya and Indus, described as of four sorts, white, pale yellow, red, and dark blue, perhaps varieties of agate. 2 A kind of poison: see काकोल. 3 Smearing the body with unguents. E. गो the eye, मिद to anoint, &c. affix घञ् and कन्.
14052: गोमेदसन्निभ m. (-भः) Chalcedony or opal. E. गोमेद, and सन्निभ what resembles.
14053: गोमेध m. (-धः) The offering or sacrifice of a cow. E. गो a cow, and मेध sacrifice.
14054: गोयान n. (-नं) 1 A cart. 2 A carriage drawn by oxen. E. गो, and आत a vehicle.
14055: गोयुग n. (-गं) A yoke of oxen. E. गो, and युग a pair.
14056: गोरक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) A cow-keeper, the cherisher or preserver of kine. m. (-क्षः) 1 The orange. 2 Keeping or tending cattle. 3 A name of ŚIVA. f. (-क्षी) A small shrub. E. गो a cow, and रक्ष who preserves.
14057: गोरक्षक m. (-कः) A cow keeper, one who tends cattle. E. कन् added to the last.
14058: गोरक्षजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 1 Wheat. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides;) also गाङ्गेरुकौ. 3 The fruit of the jujube. E. गोरक्ष, and जम्बू a rose-apple.
14059: गोरक्षण n. (-णं) Tending or taking charge of cattle. E. गो, and रक्षण protecting.
14060: गोरक्षतण्डुला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. गोरक्ष cow-preserving, and तण्डुल grain, used in medicines for cattle.
14061: गोरक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Tending cattle. E. गो, and रक्ष्य to be preserved.
14062: गोरङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 A waterfowl. 2 A prisoner, a person or animal confined. 3 A naked man, a mendicant, &c. wandering about without clothes. E. गो water, sky, &c. रङ्कु a kind of deer: as it were, the water deer, &c.
14063: गोरण n. (-णं) Effort, exertion. E. गुर to make effort, affix ल्युट्; also गुरण.
14064: गोरस mn. (-सः-सं) 1 Milk. 2 Curdled or coagulated milk. 3 Buttermilk. E. गो a cow, and रस juice.
14065: गोरसज n. (-जं) 1 Buttermilk. 2 Curds. E. गोरस, and ज produced.
14066: गोराज m. (-जः) A bull. E. गो a cow, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.
14067: गोराटी f. (-टी) A small bird, (Turdus salica.) E. गो speech, रट to utter, affix घञ्, feminine affix ङीष्.
14068: गोरुत n. (-तं) A measure of distance equal to two Cros or Cos: see गव्यूति.
14069: गोरोच n. (-चं) Yellow orpiment. E. गो, and रोच what shines.
14070: गोरोचना f. (-ना) A bright yellow pigment prepared from the urine of a cow, or vomited in the shape of scibulæ by the animal; or according to some, found in the head of a cow; it is employed in painting and dying, and is of especial virtue in marking the foreheads of the Hindus with the Tilaka or sectarial mark; it is also used in medicine as a sedative, tonic, and anthelmintic remedy, &c. E. गो a cow, रुचि to shine, affix ल्युट्.
14071: गोर्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) The brain. E. गुर to endeavor, and दन affix; also गोद.
14072: गोल mn. (-लः-लं) A circle, a ball, any thing round or globular. m. (-लः) 1 A widow's bastard. 2 Myrrh. 3 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4 A globe, celestial or terrestrial. 5 Conjunction of planets, or the presence of several in one sign. f. (-ला) 1 A globe, a sphere, a Mandala. 2 A wooden ball with which children play. 3 A woman's female friend. 4 The Godāvarī river. 5 A large water jar. 6 Ink. 7 Red arsenic. 8 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. गो heaven, water, &c. and ल what gets or receives; again, गुड to be round, &c. affix घञ् and ड changed to ल.
14073: गोलक m. (-कः) 1 A wooden ball for playing with, or any thing globular, a sphere, a globe, &c. 2 A widow's bastard. 3 A water jar. 4 Gum myrrh. 5 Pease. n. (-कं) The heaven of KṚṢṆA. E. कन् added to the preceding.
14074: गोलाङ्गुल m. (-लः) A kind of monkey, described as of a black colour, and having a tail like a cow. E. गो a cow, and लाङ्गुल a tail.
14075: गोलाध्याय m. (-यः) The division of mathematical science which treats of the spheres, spherics. E. गोल the globe, and अध्याय chapter.
14076: गोलास m. (-सः) A mushroom, a kind of fungus springing from cowdung.
14077: गोलिह m. (-हः) A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. E. गो a cow, and लिह to lick, affix क; upon which kine graze.
14078: गोलीढ m. (-ढः) A plant: see the preceding. E. गो, and लिह as above, affix क्त.
14079: गोलोक n. (-कं) The heaven of KṚṢṆA. E. गो a cow, and लोक world.
14080: गोलोमिका f. (-का) A kind of small shrub. E. गोलोमन् cow's hair, कन् affix, fem. form.
14081: गोलोमी f. (-मी) 1 A kind of bent grass, with white blossoms; also श्वेतदूर्व्वा. 2 Root of sweet flag. 3 Orris root. 4 A whore, a harlot. 5 A small shrub. E. गो the earth, &c. and लोमन् hair, the hair of the earth.
14082: गोवन्दनी f. (-नी) A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. E. गो the earth, and वन्दनी praising.
14083: गोवर्द्धन m. (-नः) A celebrated hill in Vindrāvan or the country about Mathura; it was upheld by KṚṢṆA upon one finger, to shelter the cowherds from a storm excited by INDRA, as a test of the former's divinity. E. गो a cow, and वर्द्धन encreasing; pasturing cattle.
14084: गोवर्द्धनधर m. (-धः) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. गोवर्द्धन Govardhana, and धर who upholds: see the preceding.
14085: गोवशा f. (-शा) A barren cow. E. गो a cow, and वशा barren.
14086: गोविन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 One of the most usual appellations of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU in that form. 2 A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER. 2 A cowkeeper, one who protects, cherishes or owns cattle. E. गो language, here the language of the Vedas especially, and विन्द who knows, from विद to know, with श affix; also गो heaven, a cow, विद to obtain, by whom heaven is obtained, or who obtains felicity by protecting kine.
14087: गोविष् f. (-विद्) Cowdung. E. गो a cow, and विष् ordure; also गोविष्ठा.
14088: गोवृन्द n. (-न्दं) 1 Property in cattle, possession of flocks and herds. 2 A herd, a drove of cattle. E. गो a cow, and वृन्द a heap, a multitude.
14089: गोवृन्दारक m. (-कः) A capital cow. E. गो a cow, and वृन्दारक affix of pre-eminence.
14090: गोवृष m. (-षः) A bull. E. गो a cow, and वृष best, pre-eminent.
14091: गोव्रज m. (-जः) A station for cattle. E. गो and व्रज a pen, a fold.
14092: गोशकृत् n. (-कृत्) Cowdung. E. गो a cow, and शकृत् ordure.
14093: गोशाल mfn. sub. (-लः-ला-लं) A cowhouse. adj. Born in a cowhouse. E. गो a cow, and शाला a hall.
14094: गोशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) 1 A kind of Sandal, described as of the colour of brass, and of great fragrance. 2 The head of a cow. E. गो a cow, and शीर्ष the head.
14095: गोशीर्षक m. (-कः) A plant; also called Droṇapuṣpī. E. कन् added to गोशीर्ष.
14096: गोशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tree; also Berbera. n. (-ङ्गं) The horn of a cow. E. गो, and शृङ्ग a horn.
14097: गोष्ठ r. 1st cl. (गोष्ठते) To assemble, to collect, to heap together.
14098: गोष्ठ mn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठं) 1 A cowpen, a fold for cattle, any place where animals are kept. 2 A station of cowherds. f. (-ष्ठी) 1 An assembly, a meeting. 2 Conversation, discourse, dialogue, dispute. 3 Family connexions, but especially the dependant or junior branches. 4 A dramatic composition in one act. E. गो a cow, and ष्ठ from स्था to stay, with क affix; here meaning the place of abiding, or गोष्ठ to assemble, affix अच्.
14099: गोष्ठवेदिका f. (-का) A mound or altar in a cowpen. E. गोष्ठ, and वेदिका a mound.
14100: गोष्ठश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) Malignant, censorious, envious: especially applied to a person who stays at home, and slanders his neighbours. E. गोष्ठ a cowpen, in the first case used for abode in general, and श्वि to increase, affix ड, who magnifies himself in his own house. m. (-श्वः) A horse in a cowpen. E. गोष्ठ, and अश्व a horse, the form is irregular.
14101: गोष्ठाष्टमी f. (-मी) A particular holiday: see गोपाष्टमी.
14102: गोष्ठीपति m. (-ति) 1 The chief person in assembly, a president. 2 The master of a family. E. गोष्ठी, and पति master.
14103: गोष्पद n. (-दं) 1 A spot frequented by kine. 2 A measure, as much as a cow's footstep will hold. 3 The mark or impression of a cow's foot. 4 A cow's foot or hoof. E. गो a cow, and पद for पाद a foot.
14104: गोस m. (-सः) 1 Gum myrrh. 2 The last watch of the night, early morning or day-break. E. गो water, dew, and षो to destroy, to absorb, affix ड.
14105: गोसंख्य m. (-ख्यः) A herdsman, a cowherd. E. गो a cow, and सम् prefixed to ख्या to count, affix ड.
14106: गोसगृह n. (-हं) The inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping room, a bedchamber.
14107: गोसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Dawn, day-break. E. गो a cow, and सङ्ग meeting, junction; the herd assembling at that time.
14108: गोसदृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Gayal, (Bos gavæus.) E. गो a cow, and सदृक्ष like, from सदृश with स aff.
14109: गोसन्दाय m. (-यः) One who gives a cow. E. गो a cow, दा to give, with सम् prefixed, युक् augment, affix अच्.
14110: गोसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from or by a cow. E. गो and सम्भव born.
14111: गोसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Dawn, day-break. E. गो a cow, and सर्ग going forth, the cattle then going forth to pasture.
14112: गोसव m. (-वः) The sacrifice of a cow, one of the grand sacrifices of the Hindus in former times, and not permitted in the present or Kali age: see गोमेध. E. गो a cow, and सव sacrifice.
14113: गोसशश m. (-शः) Myrrh: see गोस and शश.
14114: गोस्तन m. (-नः) 1 The udder of a cow. 2 A garland consisting of four or of thirty-four strings. 3 A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay, &c. f. (-ना or नी) A grape. E. गो a cow, and लन a breast, full or clustering like the udder of a cow.
14115: गोस्थान n. (-नं) A cowpen, a station for cattle. E. गो a cow, and स्थान a place; also with कन् added गोस्थानक.
14117: गोस्वामिन् m. (-मी) 1 The master or possessor of herds. 2 A holy man, a religious personage and teacher; in common language, a Gosain. E. गो kine, or an organ of sense, and स्वामिन् a lord or master.
14118: गोहत्या f. (-त्या) Killing a cow. E. गो, and हत्या murder.
14119: गोहन्न n. (-न्नं) Cowdung. E. गो and हन्न ordure.
14120: गोहरीतकी f. (-की Vilva) or Bel, (Ægle marmelos.)
14121: गोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proper or fit for cattle. 2 Cherishing or protecting kine. m. (-तः) 1 A creeping plant; also घोषा. 2 The Bel tree. E. गो a cow, and हित suitable, &c.
14122: गोहिर n. (-रं) The heel. E. गूह to cover, इरन् aff.
14123: गोह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be covered or concealed. 2 To be kept secret. E. गूह to cover, ण्यत् aff.
14124: गौञ्जिक m. (-कः) A goldsmith. E. गुञ्जा the small weight especially used by goldsmiths, and ठक् aff.
14125: गौड m. (-डः) The district of Gaur, the central part of Bengal, extending from Bang to Bhuvaneswar in Orissa: the ruins of its capital, called by the same name, are still extensive. m. plu. (-डाः) The inhabitants of Gaur. f. (-डी) 1 Rum or spirit distilled from Gur or molasses. 2 One of the Rāgiṇīs. 3 A style of poetry, the bold and spirited style. E. गुड to surround, or गुड raw sugar, and अण् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
14126: गौडिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to Gur or molasses. n. (-कं) Rum. E. गुड as above, affix of relation ठञ्.
14127: गौण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Having qualities or attributes. 2 Relating to multiplication or enumeration. 3 Secondary, subordinate. 4 Secondary as applied to the month, reckoned from fullmoon to full moon. E. गुण, and अण् aff.
14128: गौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having qualities, relating to or connected with them. E. गुण, and ठञ् aff.
14129: गौतम m. (-मः) 1 The name of a saint or sage and founder of the Nyāya philosophy. 2 A legislator of the same name. 3 A name of ŚĀKYA Muni, the original Buddha or founder of the Bauddha sect. 4 A name of the first pupil of the last Jina. 5 Name of a tribe or family of Brahmans descended from GOTAMA. 6 A poison, one of the fixed kinds, or mineral, vegetable, &c. f. (-मी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A female Rākṣasa or goblin. 3 A yellow dye: see गोरोचना. 4 The Godāvarī river. E. गोतम a sage, and अण् patronymic affix, &c.
14130: गौधार m. (-रः) An iguana. E. गोधा an alligator, and आरक् affix of descent; considered as the offspring of the alligator, on account of its smaller size, and similar shape; also गौधेय and गाधेर.
14131: गौधेय m. (-यः) An iguana. E. गोधा, and ढक् affix: see the last.
14132: गौधेर m. (-रः) An iguana. E. गौधा, and द्रक् affix: see गौधार.
14133: गौपुच्छिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to a cow's tail, bought for a cow's tail, &c. E. गो, and पुच्छ a tail, affix ठञ्.
14134: गौर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 White. 2 Yellow. 3 Pale red: (or it may be used as a noun substantive mas. to imply either of these colours.) 4 Clean, cleansed, pure. m. (-रः) 1 White mustard. 2 The moon. 3 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa:) see धव. 4 A name of CAITANYA. n. (-रं) 1 The filament of a lotus. 2 Gold. 3 Saffron. f. (-रा or री) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ. (-री) 2 A young girl, eight years old. 3 Any young girl prior to menstruation, a maid, a virgin. 4 The name of a river. 5 The wife of the deity VARUṆA. 6 The earth. 7 Turmeric. 8 A yellow die called Gorocanā. 9 A plant: see रोचनी. 10 A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. 11 One of the female energies or Śaktis of the Bauddhas. 12 A white kind of Dūrbbā or bent grass. 13 Arabian jasmin. 14 Sacred basil or Tulasi. 15 One of the Rāgiṇīs. E. गुड to sound, and रन् Uṇādi affix, the deriv. is irregular; also गुरी to endeavour, घञ् affix, and derivative irr.; upon whom or what the mind exerts itself; again, गौर white, pure, &c. affix ङीष्, that which is white or brilliant, &c. which applies to the virgin, &c.
14135: गौरचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of the saint CAITANYA.
14136: गौरव n. (-वं) 1 Reputation, respectability, venerableness or weight. 2 Physical weight, heaviness. E. गुरु heavy, respectable, &c. and अण् affix, implying condition of being.
14137: गौरवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Venerable, respectable. E. गौरव, and इतच् aff.
14138: गौरवेरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, famed, celebrated. E. गौरव fame, and ईरित declared.
14139: गौरशाक m. (-कः) A species of bassia; also धूमल. E. गौर pale white, and शाक a potherb.
14140: गौरसर्षप m. (-पः) 1 White mustard. 2 The white mustard seed considered as a measure of weight. E. गौर white, and सर्षप mustard; also गौर.
14141: गौराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of CAITANYA. E. गौर pale, and अङ्ग body.
14142: गौरार्द्रक m. (-कः) A kind of poison. E. गौर white, and आर्द्रक ginger.
14143: गौरास्य m. (-स्यः) A black monkey with a white face. E. गौर, and आस्थ face.
14144: गौरिका f. (-का) A virgin, a young girl, one eight years old, or in whom menstruation has not commenced. E. गौरी as above, and कन् aff.
14145: गौरिल m. (-लः) 1 White mustard. 2 Iron or steel filings or dust. E. गौर pale white, and इलच् aff.
14146: गौरीज m. (-जः) KĀRTTIKEYA or GAṆEŚA. n. (-जं) Tale. E. गौरी, and ज born.
14147: गौरीपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The horizontal plate of the Liṅga, typical of the female organ. E. गौरी, and पट्ट a layer.
14148: गौरीपति m. (-तिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गौरी, and पति husband.
14149: गौरीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. गौरी the goddess, and पुत्र a son, the son of GAURĪ.
14150: गौरीललित n. (-तं) Yellow orpiment. E. गौरी the goddess, or a young girl, and ललित loved, liked; this being used as a dye to stain the clothes of women, &c.
14151: गौरुतल्पिक m. (-कः) A violator of the bed of a Guru. E. गुरु, तल्प a bed, and ठञ् aff.
14152: गौलक्षणिक m. (-कः) One who distinguishes the good marks of a cow. E. गो, लक्षण a mark, ठक् aff.
14154: गौशतिक m. (-कः) One possessing a hundred cows. E. गौ, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
14155: गौष्ठीन n. (-नं) The site of an old and abandoned cowpen. E. गाष्ठ a cowpen, and खञ् aff.
14156: गौसहस्रिक m. (-कः) One who has a thousand cows. E. गो, सहस्र a thousand, ठञ् aff.
14157: ग्रथ r. 1st cl. (इ) ग्रथि (ग्रन्थते) 1 To be crooked. 2 To be crooked metaphorically, to be wicked. 2 To curve, to bend or make crooked. 3 To string together, to arrange r. 10th cl. (ग्रन्थयति) To bind or tie.
14158: ग्रथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, tied together or in order. 2 Collected. 3 Arranged, classed. 4 Overcome. 5 Hurt, injured. E. ग्रथि to bind, affix क्त.
14159: ग्रन्थ r. 1st, 9th and 10th cls. (ग्रन्थति ग्रथ्नाति ग्रन्थयति) To string, to tie together, to connect or arrange in a regular series. With उद् prefixed, To untie, to loosen.
14160: ग्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 Stringing or tying together, (literally or metaphorically.) 2 Wealth, property. 3 A book or composition in prose or verse. 4 A metre or measure of thirty-two syllables. E. ग्रन्थ to dispose or arrange, affix अच्.
14161: ग्रन्थकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) An author. E. ग्रन्थ, and कर्त्तृ maker.
14162: ग्रन्थकार m. (-रः) An author. E. ग्रन्थ, and कार who makes.
14163: ग्रन्थकुटी f. (-टी) An office, a study, a library. E. ग्रन्थ a book, and कुटी a house or room.
14164: ग्रन्थन nf. (-नं-ना) Arranging, stringing, tying or connecting together either as a chaplet or a book. E. ग्रन्थ to arrange, affix युच्.
14165: ग्रन्थविस्तर m. (-रः) A voluminous work. E. ग्रन्थ, and विस्तर extent.
14166: ग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 1 The joint or knot of a reed or cane, &c. 2 A tie, the knot of a cord, &c. 3 A joint or articulation of the body. 4 A plant, commonly Ganṭhiāla: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. 5 Crookedness, distortion. 6 A complaint, knotting of the vessels as in varicocele, &c. E. ग्रन्थ to connect, &c. Uṇādi affix इन्.
14167: ग्रन्थिक m. (-कः) 1 An astrologer, a fortune teller. 2 The youngest of the Pāṇḍus. 3 A thorny plant: see करीर. n. (-कं) 1 The root of long pepper. 2 A kind of resin, Bdellium. 3 A perfume: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. E. कन् added to the preceding, or ग्रन्थ a book, &c. and ठक् aff.
14168: ग्रन्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Strung, tied. E. ग्रन्थ to tie, affix क्त.
14169: ग्रन्थिदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A species of Dūrvā grass. E. ग्रन्थि, and दूर्व्वा Panicum dactylon.
14170: ग्रन्थिन् mfn. (-न्थी-न्थिनी-न्थि) 1 Bookish, read, learned. 2 Relating or belonging to a book, &c. E. ग्रन्थ, and इनि aff.
14171: ग्रन्थिपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A plant, and according to some authorities a perfume, commonly called Ganṭhiāla. E. ग्रन्थ a knot, and पर्ण a leaf.
14172: ग्रन्थिबन्धन n. (-नं) 1 Tying a knot. 2 A ligament. 3 Tying together the garments of the bride and bridegroom at the marriage ceremony. E. ग्रन्थि, and बन्धन binding.
14173: ग्रन्थिमत् m. (-मान्) A plant, (Heliotropium indicum;) also अस्थिसंहार. E. ग्रन्थि knot, and मतुप् poss. aff.
14174: ग्रन्थिमूल n. (-लं) Garlic. E. ग्रन्थि, a knot, and मूल root.
14175: ग्रन्थिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Knotted, knotty, &c. m. (-लः) 1 A plant, commonly Buïñci (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) 2 Karīr, a thorny plant, (Capparis:) see करीर. n. (-लं) 1 Green or undried ginger. 2 Root of long pepper. E. ग्रन्थि a knot, and लच् aff.
14176: ग्रन्थिवर्हिन् m. (-र्ही) A plant: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. E. ग्रन्थि a knot, वर्ह to cover, and णिनि aff.
14177: ग्रन्थिहर m. (-रः) A counsellor, a minister. E. ग्रन्थि a knot, and हर who removes; who unites the knots of business.
14178: ग्रन्थीक n. (-कं) The root of long pepper: see ग्रन्थिक.
14179: ग्रस r. 1st cl. (उ) ग्रसु (ग्रसते) 1 To eat. 2 To swallow, to devour. r. 1st and 10th cls. (ग्रसति ग्रासयति) To take, to seize.
14180: ग्रसन n. (-नं) 1 Swallowing, eating. 2 Taking, seizing. E. ग्रस to take, ल्युट् aff.
14181: ग्रसमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Swallowing, devouring. 2 Receiving or listening to any thing eagerly. E. ग्रस to eat, शानच् aff.
14182: ग्रसिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Eating, taking food. E. ग्रस to eat, इष्णुच् aff.
14183: ग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Inarticulately pronounced, slurred, uttered with the omission of a letter or syllable. 2 Eaten. 3 Taken, seized. 4 Affected by. 5 Commenced as an eclipse, eclipsed. E. ग्रस to eat, affix क्त.
14184: ग्रस्तास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Commenced and ended as an eclipse. E. ग्रस्त seized, अस्त set.
14185: ग्रह r. 1st, and 10th cls. (ग्रहति ग्रहयति) r. 9th cl. (ऊ) ग्रहू (गृह्णाति गृह्णीते) 1 To take, to seize, to receive or accept. With अनु prefixed, To favour, to shew kindness to. With अव, To oppose. With उत्, To deposit, to trust. With उप, To provide. 2 To favour. With नि, 1 To take, to arrest. 2 To punish. 3 To restrain. With परि, To lay hold of, to seize. With प्रति, 1 To assent to, to receive as a precept or truth. 2 To embrace, to enfold, to comprehend or contain. 3 To subdue. 4 To accept. With वि, To quarrel, to fight. With सम्, To collect, to assemble.
14186: ग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Taking, whether by seizure or acceptance. 2 An eclipse or seizure of the sun or moon, by RĀHU, &c. 3 A planet. 4 The place of a planet in the fixed zodiac. 5 A moveable point in the heavens. 6 A name of RĀHU, or the ascending node. 7 An imp, one of a particular class, beginning with PŪTANĀ, supposed especially to seize upon young children, producing convulsions. 8 Effort in battle. 9 Tenacity, perseverance. 10 Purpose, design. 11 Favor, patronage. E. ग्रह to take, &c. affix अप्.
14187: ग्रहकल्लोल m. (-लः) A name of RĀHU, the personified ascending node. E. ग्रह a planet, and कल्लोल an enemy.
14188: ग्रहगण m. (-णः) The planets taken collectively. E. ग्रह, and गण a number.
14189: ग्रहण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A prisoner, captive, confined. n. (-णं) 1 Taking, seizure. 2 Receiving, acceptance. 3 Assent, agreement. 4 Respect. 5 The hand. 6 An eclipse. 7 Comprehension, the taking or receiving of instruction, or the acquirement of any science. 8 Sound. 9 An organ of sense. 10 In grammar, Exception. E. ग्रह to take, affix ल्युट्.
14190: ग्रहणान्त n. (-न्तं) Close of study, acquirement of science, &c. E. ग्रहण taking, and अन्त end.
14191: ग्रहणान्तिक n. (-कं) Termination of holy study. E. ग्रहण, and अन्तिक final.
14192: ग्रहणि f. (-णिः) 1 Diarrhoea, dysentery. 2 The vessels diffusing vital warmth. 3 The small intestines, that part of the alimentary canal where the bile assists digestion. E. ग्रह to seize, अनि Uṇādi affix; also with ङीष् added ग्रहणी.
14193: ग्रहणीरुज् f. (-रुक्) Diarrhoea, dysentery. E. ग्रहणी the same (as above), and रुज् sickness, disease.
14194: ग्रहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken, to be seized, accepted, &c. E. ग्रह, and अनीयर् aff.
14195: ग्रहणीहर n. (-रं) Cloves. E. ग्रहणी diarrhoea, and हर what removes.
14196: ग्रहनायक m. (-कः) 1 The sun. 2 The planet Saturn. E. ग्रह a planet, and नायक a chief.
14197: ग्रहनाश m. (-शः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) E. ग्रह taking, and नाश injury, producing pain in the bowels, &c. also ग्रहनाशन.
14198: ग्रहनेमि m. (-मिः) The moon. E. ग्रह a planet, and नेमि the circumference of a wheel, from its shape.
14199: ग्रहपति m. (-तिः) The sun. E. ग्रह a planet, and पति chief.
14200: ग्रहपीडा f. (-डा) The influence of an unpropitious planet. E. ग्रह, and पीडा pain.
14201: ग्रहपुष m. (-षः) The sun. E. ग्रह, and पुष to cherish, affix क; cherishing the planets with his light.
14202: ग्रहपूजा f. (-जा) Worship of the sun and the other planets. E. ग्रह, and पूजा worship.
14203: ग्रहयाग m. (-गः) Worship of or offering to the planets. E. ग्रह, and याग sacrifice; also ग्रहयज्ञ.
14204: ग्रहयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Taking, receiving. E. ग्रह to take, आलुच् affix, अय inserted; also गृहयालु.
14205: ग्रहराज m. (-जः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 The planet Jupiter or its regent. E. ग्रह a planet, and राज a king, a chief.
14206: ग्रहविप्र m. (-प्रः) An astrologer. E. ग्रह, and विप्र a Brahman.
14207: ग्रहाधार m. (-रः) The constellation DHRUVA or the polar star. E. ग्रह planet, and आधार asylum; the star remaining fixed amidst the planetary movements.
14208: ग्रहाधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Subject to planetary influence. E. ग्रह, and अधीन dependant.
14209: ग्रहामय m. (-यः) Epilepsy, convulsions, demoniac possession which the complaint is supposed to be. E. ग्रह an imp, and आमय sickness.
14210: ग्रहाशिन् m. (-शी) A plant, (Echites scholaris:) see ग्रहनाश. E. ग्रह taking, and अश here meaning to hurt, affix इनि.
14211: ग्रहीतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be taken or accepted. 2 To be learned or acquired. E. ग्रह to take, तव्य affix, and ई inserted.
14212: ग्रहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Taking, disposed to take. E. ग्रह to take, तृच् affix, and ई inserted.
14213: ग्राम m. (-मः) 1 A village, a hamlet, an inhabited and unfortified place in the midst of fields and meadow land, where men of  the servile class mostly reside, and where agriculture thrives. 2 A scale in music. 3 (In composition.) A multitude. E. गम to go, affix घञ् and deriv. irr. or ग्रस to eat, Uṇādi affix मन् and आच् substituted for the radical final.
14214: ग्रामकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A tame or domestic cock. E. ग्राम, and कुक्कुट a cock.
14215: ग्रामकूट m. (-टः) A man of the fourth tribe, a Śūdra. E. ग्राम a village, and कूट a number, the crowd or population of the village.
14216: ग्रामग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes to a village. E. ग्राम, and गम to go, ड aff.
14217: ग्रामगमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going in or to a village. E. ग्राम, and गमिन् who goes.
14218: ग्रामगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Being or remaining outside the village. E. ग्राम, and गृह्य to be taken out.
14219: ग्रामघात m. (-तः) Plundering a village. E. ग्राम, and धात attacking.
14220: ग्रामङ्गमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what goes to a village. E. ग्राम in the 2d case, गमिन् what goes.
14221: ग्रामज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Village, rustic, village-born or produced. E. ग्राम, and ज born; also ग्रामजात, &c.
14222: ग्रामणी mfn. (-णीः-णीः-णि) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Chief, pre-eminent, superintendent. 3 One who only thinks of enjoyment. m. (-णीः) A barber. f. (-णीः) 1 A whore, a harlot. 2 A female peasant or villager. 3 The indigo plant. E. ग्राम a village, नी to get or obtain, affix क्विप्.
14223: ग्रामणीपुत्र m. (-त्रः) The son of a whore, a bastard. E. ग्रामणी, and पुत्र a son; also read ग्रामणिपुत्र.
14224: ग्रामतक्ष m. (-क्षः) The village carpenter. E. ग्राम a village, and तक्ष carpenter.
14225: ग्रामतस् ind. From the village. E. ग्राम, and तसि aff.
14226: ग्रामता f. (-ता) A multitude of villages. E. ग्राम, and तल् affix of multitude; also ग्रामत्वं with त्व aff.
14227: ग्रामदशेश m. (-शः) The head of ten villages. E. ग्राम, दश ten, and ईश chief; also ग्रामद शाधिपति, &c.
14228: ग्रामभृत m. (-तः) The village messenger or servant. E. ग्राम, and भृत supported.
14229: ग्राममद्गुरिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.) 2 A riot, a fray, a village war, (ग्रामयुद्व.) E. ग्राम, and मद्गुर a fish, &c.
14230: ग्राममुख m. (-खः) A market town, a fair, a market. E. ग्राम a village, and मुख chief.
14231: ग्राममृग m. (-गः) A dog. E. ग्राम, and मृग a deer, the village deer.
14232: ग्रामयाजक m. (-कः) The village priest, one who conducts the ceremonies for any or all classes, and is consequently considered as a degraded Brahman; it also applies to the attendant of an idol. E. ग्राम a village, यज to sacrifice, in the causal form, affix वुन्; also with णिनि affix ग्रामयाजिन्.
14233: ग्रामलुण्टन n. (-नं) Plundering or pillaging a village. E. ग्राम, and लुण्टन robbing.
14234: ग्रामवास m. (-सः) 1 A villager. 2 Living in a village. E. ग्राम, and वास abode; also ग्रामेवास.
14235: ग्रामवासिन् m. (-सी) A villager. E. ग्राम, and वासिन् who inhabits; also ग्रामेवासिन्.
14236: ग्रामविशेष m. (-षः) Variety of the scales in music. E. ग्राम, and विशेष difference.
14237: ग्रामशत n. (-तं) A hundred villages, a province. E. ग्राम, and शत a hundred.
14238: ग्रामशतेश m. (-शः) The governor of a province. E. ग्राम, शत and ईश chief; also ग्रामशताधिपति, ग्रामशताध्यक्ष, &c.
14239: ग्रामसङ्कर m. (-रः) The common sewer or drain of a village. E. ग्राम, and सङ्कर a narrow place.
14240: ग्रामसङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A village corporation, a municipality. E. ग्राम, and सङ्घ an assembly.
14241: ग्रामस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Being or residing in a village, belonging to it, &c. m. (-स्थः) A village. E. ग्राम, and स्थ what stays.
14242: ग्रामहासक m. (-कः) A sister's husband. E. ग्राम a village, and हास who delights, from हस to laugh, &c. and ण्वुल् aff.
14243: ग्रामाधान n. (-नं) Hunting. E. ग्राम a village, and आधान what supports.
14244: ग्रामाधिकृत m. (-तः) The head man or chief of a village. E. ग्राम, and अधिकृत set over.
14245: ग्रामाधिपति m. (-तिः) Chief or head of a village. E. ग्राम, and अधिपति chief.
14246: ग्रामाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) Superintendent or chief of a village. E. ग्राम, and अध्यक्ष superior.
14247: ग्रामान्त n. (-न्तं) Space near a village. E. ग्राम, and अन्त a boundary.
14248: ग्रामान्तीय m. (-यं) Space near a village. E. ग्राम, and अन्त end, छ aff.
14249: ग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Village, rude, rustic. 2 Chromatic. m. (कः) 1 The headman of a village. 2 A village. E. ग्राम, and ठक् aff.
14250: ग्रामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Village, villager. m. (-मी) The headman of a village. f. (-मिनी) The indigo plant. E. ग्राम a village, इनि and ङीष् affixes; also ग्रामीणा.
14251: ग्रामीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 A villager, a rustic. 2 Produced in or peculiar to a village. 3 Vulgar, rude. 4 Chromatic. m. (-णः) 1 A dog. 2 A crow. f. (-णा) The indigo plant. E. ग्राम, and खञ् aff.
14252: ग्रामीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to a village, produced in or derived from it. m. (-यः) A villager. E. ग्राम, and छ affix; also with कन् added ग्रामीयक.
14253: ग्रामेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) A villager, rustic, village-born, &c. E. ग्राम, and ढक् affix; also with कन् added ग्रामेयक.
14254: ग्रामेवास m. (-सः) 1 A villager. 2 A village abode. E. ग्रामे seventh case, and वास abode.
14255: ग्रामेवासिन् m. (-सी) A village. E. ग्रामे seventh case, वासिन् who dwells.
14256: ग्रामेश m. (-शः) The headman of a village. E. ग्राम, and ईश a master.
14257: ग्रामेश्वर m. (-रः) The headman or ruler over a village. E. ग्राम, and ईश्वर a master.
14258: ग्राम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Village-born, produced in or relating to a village. 2 Vulgar, rude, rustic. 3 Relating to a musical scale. m. (-म्यः) A hog, a tame or a village hog. n. (-म्यं) 1 Rustic or homely speech. 2 The Prākṛta and the other dialects of India, except the Sanscrit. E. ग्राम, and यत् aff.
14259: ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी f. (-टी) A pumpkin gourd. E. ग्राम्य village, and कक्कट gourd.
14260: ग्राम्यकन्द m. (-न्दः) A common species of Arum. E. ग्राम्य, and कन्द root.
14261: ग्राम्यकुङ्कुम n. (-मं) A yellow dye, safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) E. ग्राम्य, and कुङ्कुम saffron, village saffron.
14262: ग्राम्यधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Copulation. E. ग्राम्य, and धर्म्म virtue, village virtue.
14263: ग्राम्यमद्गुरिका f. (-का) A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.) ग्राममद्गुरिका.
14264: ग्राम्यमांस n. (-सं) Meat of tame animals. E. ग्राम्य rural, and मांस fresh.
14265: ग्राम्यमृग m. (-गः) A dog. E. ग्राम्य, and मृग a deer, the village deer; also ग्राममृग.
14266: ग्राम्यराशि f. (-शिः) A name of several of the signs of the zodiac. E. ग्राम्य, and राशि a sign.
14267: ग्राम्यशूकर m. (-रः) A village hog, a tame hog, a pig. E. ग्राम्य, and शूकर a hog.
14268: ग्राम्याश्व m. (-श्वः) An ass. E. ग्राम्य, and अश्व a horse, the village horse.
14269: ग्रावन् mfn. (-वा-वा-व) Hard, solid. m. (-वा) 1 A stone or rock. 2 A mountain. 3 A cloud. E. ग्रह to seize, वनिप् aff.
14270: ग्रास m. (-सः) A mouthful or a quantity equivalent to a mouthful, a lump of rice, &c. of the size of a peacock's egg. E. ग्रस to eat, affix घञ्.
14271: ग्रासाच्छादन n. (-नं) Bare subsistence, food and clothing. E. ग्रास, and आच्छादन covering.
14272: ग्राह m. (-हः) 1 Taking, either by seizure or acceptance. 2 A shark; according to some, the Gangetic alligator, (Lacerta Gangetica;) according to others, the water elephant, (the hippopotamus?) 3 Any large fish or marine animal. E. ग्रह to take, affix घञ् or ण.
14273: ग्राहक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) One who takes or seizes, one who accepts or receives. m. (-कः) 1 A hawk, a falcon. 2 A police officer, a constable, a bailiff. E. ग्रह to take, ण्वुल् aff.
14274: ग्राहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Containing or abounding with alligators. E. ग्राह, and मतुप् aff.
14275: ग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 1 Taking, seizing, accepting, who or what takes. 2 Astringent, binding, constipating. m. (-ही) 1 A sedative, a narcotic. 2 The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. f. (-णी) A small kind of Javāsa, perhaps a species of Hedysarum. E. ग्रह to take, णिनि aff.
14276: ग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be seized, to be taken, to be accepted. 2 To be accepted as a rule or law, to be acknowledged or assented to. 3 To be attached to or obeyed. 4 To be admitted in evidence, &c. 5 To be apprehended or arrested. E. ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
14277: ग्रीवा f. (-वा) 1 The neck. 2 The back part of the neck, the nape, the tendon of the Trapezium muscle. E. गॄ to swallow, वन् Uṇādi affix, ईट् inserted.
14278: ग्रीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Long-necked, handsome-necked. m. (-वी) A camel. E. ग्रीवा a neck, and इनि poss. aff.
14279: ग्रीष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मा-ष्मं) Hot, warm. m. (-ष्मः) 1 The hot season, comprehending two months, about June-July. 2 Heat, warmth. f. (-ष्मी) Jasmin. E. ग्रस to take, &c. मक् Uṇādi affix, and the deriv. irr.
14280: ग्रीष्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Produced by heat. 2 Produced in the hot season. f. (-जा) A kind of fruit, (Annona reticulata.) E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and ज produced.
14281: ग्रीष्मभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by heat or in the hot season. f. (-वा) Double jasmin: see नवमल्ली. E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and भव being, flourishing.
14282: ग्रीष्मसुन्दरक m. (-कः) A kind of potherb, (Chironia centauroides; it is also applied to Pharnaceum mollugo.) E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and सुन्दर handsome, affix कन्.
14283: ग्रीष्महास n. (-सं) The flocculent seeds, down, &c. blown about in the air. E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and हास a smile, considered, from their white colour, as the smiles of the season.
14284: ग्रीष्मोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by heat or in the hot season. f. (-वा) Double jasmin. E. ग्रीष्म, and उद्भब produced.
14285: ग्रुच (इर उ) इर ग्रुचु r. 1st cl. (ग्रोचति) To steal or rob.
14286: ग्रैव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Belonging to the neck, &c. n. (-वं) 1 A necklace, a close necklace or collar. 2 A chain worn round the neck of an elephant, &c. E. ग्रीवा the necklace, and अण् aff.
14287: ग्रैवेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging to the neck. n. (-यं) 1 A collar, a necklace. 2 A chain on the neck of an elephant or horse. E. ग्रीवा, and ढक् affix; also ग्रैवेयक.
14288: ग्रैवेयक n. (-कं) A collar, an ornament for the neck. E. ग्रीवा, and ढकञ् affix: see ग्रै and ग्रैवेय.
14289: ग्रैष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मी-ष्मं) Belonging or relating to, or produced by heat or the hot season. f. (-ष्मी) Double jasmin. E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, &c. affix अण्.
14290: ग्लपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Distressed, pained. 2 Exhausted, overpowered. E. ग्लै to be weary, causal form, क्त aff.
14291: ग्लस (उ) ग्लसु r. 1st cl. (ग्लसते) To eat: see ग्रस.
14292: ग्लस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Eaten. E. ग्लस to eat, affix क्त.
14293: ग्लह (उ) ग्लहु r. 1st and 10th cl. (ग्लहति-यति) To take, to receive or accept: see ग्रह.
14294: ग्लह m. (-हः) Gaming, playing with dice. E. ग्लह to take, &c. affix अच्, or it is derived irregularly from ग्रह, with अप् aff.
14295: ग्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearied, languid, feeble, exhausted by fatigue, disease, &c. E. ग्लै to be feeble, and क्त aff.
14296: ग्लानि f. (-निः) Langour, lassitude, fatigue of body or depression of mind. E. ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, Uṇādi affix नि.
14297: ग्लायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Being exhausted, languid, faint, &c. E. ग्लै to be weary, शतृ aff.
14298: ग्लास्नु mfn. (-स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु) Exhausted by disease or fatigue, wearied, languid. E. ग्लै to be weak, affix स्नु.
14299: ग्लुच (इर उ) इर ग्लुचु r. 1st cl. (ग्लोचति) 1 To steal, to rob. 2 To go: see ग्रुच.
14300: ग्लुञ्च (इर उ) इर ग्लुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (ग्लुञ्चति) To go, to move.
14301: ग्लेप (ऋ) ग्लेपृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेपते) 1 To be poor or dependant. 2 To shake, to tremble. 3 To move.
14302: ग्लेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be made weary or exhausted, exhaustible, fatigable. E. ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, affix यत्.
14303: ग्लेव (ऋ) ग्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेवते) To serve, to worship, to gratify by service or devotedness.
14304: ग्लेष (ऋ) ग्लेषृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेषते) To inquire, to search, to investigate.
14305: ग्लै r. 1st cl. (ग्लायति) 1 To be languid or weary, to be exhausted, faded, &c. 2 To yawn: this root is sometimes considered  to be ग्ला, making ग्लायति as above, and in the causal form ग्लपयति or ग्लापयति.
14306: ग्लौतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wearied, exhausted. E. ग्लै to be weary, तृच् aff.
14307: ग्लौ m. (-ग्लौः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. ग्ला to be weary, Uṇādi affix डा. घ
14308: घ The fourth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding to Gh.
14309: घ m. (-घः) 1 A bell. 2 A rattling or gurgling sound. f. (घा) 1 A tinkling ornament worn by women round the waist. 2 Striking, killing. 3 Wetting, sprinkling. E. हन to kill, affix ड, and घ substituted for the radical letter, or the same affix, with घृ to sprinkle, &c.
14310: घग्घ r. 1st cl. (घग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride; also घघ and गग्घ.
14311: घघ r. 1st cl. (घघति) To laugh or to laugh at: see the preceding.
14312: घट r. 1st cl. (घटते) To act, to strive or endeavour. r. 10th cl. (घाटयति) 1 To unite or to put together. 2 To injure or kill. 3 To shine. (इ) घटि, r. 10th cl. (घण्टयति) To shine.
14313: घट m. (-टः) 1 A large earthen water jar. 2 The sign Aquarius. 3 A measure: see कुम्भ. 4 An elephant's frontal sinus. 5 Suspending the breath as a religious exercise. 6 A man who makes effort or exertion. f. (-टा) 1 A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes. 2 Effort, endeavour. 3 An assembly. 4 A number, a collection, an assemblage. f. (-टी) 1 The Gharī or Indian clock, a plate of iron or mixed metal on which the hours are struck. 2 A small water jar, a ewer. E. घट to endeavour, &c. affixes अच् or अङ्, and fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.
14314: घटक m. (-कः) 1 A tree that produces fruit without apparent flowers. 2 A match-maker, an agent who ascertains or invents genealogies, and negociates matrimonial alliances. 3 A genealogist. E. घट to endeavour, and वुन् aff.
14315: घटग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who or what takes a water pot. E. घट, and ग्रह to take, अच् aff.
14316: घटदासी f. (-सी) A bawd or procuress. E. घट effort, and दासी a slave or servant.
14317: घटन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Effort, exertion. 2 Assembling, bringing together. 3 Joining, mixing. 4 Occurring. E. घट to strive, &c. affix युच्.
14318: घटयोनि m. (-निः) The saint AGASTYA. घट a water jar, and योनि place of birth; the saint being born from a water jar: see कुम्भसम्भव.
14319: घटराज m. (-जः) A large water jar of baked clay. E. घट a jar, and राज king, chief.
14320: घटस्थापन n. (-नं) Placing a water pot as a type of DURGĀ, an essential part of various Tāntrika ceremonies. E. घट, and स्थापन placing.
14321: घटाटोप m. (-पः) A covering for a carriage or any article of furniture. E. घट, and आटोप pride.
14322: घटिक n. (-कं) The posteriors. f. (-का) 1 The ancle; also घुटिका. 2 A Muhūrta or thirtieth part of a day and night. 3 A Daṇḍa or period of twenty-four minutes. m. (-कः) A waterman. E. घटी a clock, &c. affixes कन् and टाप् for the feminine; otherwise घट a jar, and ठन् aff.
14323: घटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Devised, attempted. 2 Made of. 3 In contact with, contiguous, joined. E. घट to make effort, क्त aff.
14324: घटिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Who blows or sounds in a jar. m. (-मः) A potter. E. घटी, and ध्मा to blow, खश् aff.
14325: घटिन्धय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who drinks a Ghaṭī, (in measure.) E. घटी, and धे to drink, खश् aff.
14326: घटीकार m. (-रः) A potter. E. घट, कार who makes, with च्चि aff.
14327: घटीग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who or what takes a small jar, &c. E. घटी, and ग्रह who takes.
14328: घटीयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) The rope and bucket of a well, or any machine for raising water. E. घट effort, and यन्त्र machine.
14329: घटोत्कच m. (-चः) The son of BHĪMA by the Rākṣasī, named HIḌIMBĀ.
14330: घटोत्कचान्तक m. (-कः) A name of KARṆA, natural brother to the Pāṇḍus. E. घटोत्कच a proper name, and अन्तक destroyer.
14331: घटोद्भव m. (-वः) The sage AGASTYA. E. घट a jar, and उद्भव born, produced.
14332: घट्ट r. 1st and 10th cls. (घट्टते घट्टयति) To move. With परि prefixed, To spread or diffuse. With वि, To rub gently, to scratch.
14333: घट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A Ghat, a quay or landing place, steps on the side of a river, &c. leading to the water's edge. f. (-ट्टी) A small or inferior landing place, private stairs, &c. E. घट्ट to go, affix अच्, and with ङीष् affix, implying diminution.
14334: घट्टना f. (-ना) 1 Going, moving. 2 Practice, business, means of living. 3 Rubbing or striking together. E. घट्ट to go, affix युच्, fem. टाप्.
14335: घट्टजीविन् m. (-वी) An attendant at a landing place, who takes care of the clothes of the bathers, &c. E. घट्ट, and जीविन् who subsists.
14336: घण (उ,) घणु r. 8th cl. (घणुति or घणुते) To shine.
14337: घण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A sort of sauce, vegetables made into a pulp with water, turmeric, mustard seeds and capsicums. f. (-ण्टा) 1 A bell; also a plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a bell. 2 A plant: see घण्टापाटली. E. हन to strike, ट affix, fem. टाप्, and deriv. irr.
14338: घण्टाक m. (-कः) A plant: see घण्टापाटली. E. कन् added to the preceding; some copies read घण्टीक and घाण्टीक.
14339: घण्टाकर्ण m. (-र्णः) One of ŚIVA'S attendants, who is supposed to preside over cutaneous complaints, and is worshipped for exemption from them in the month Chaitra. E. घण्टा, and कर्ण an ear; having ears as broad as a bell.
14340: घण्टाताड m. (-डः) A bellman, one who strikes a bell or Gharī. E. घण्टा, and ताड who beats.
14341: घण्टाताडन n. (-नं) Striking a bell. E. घण्टा, and ताडन beating.
14342: घण्टानाद m. (-दः) The sound of a bell, &c. E. घण्टा, and माद sound.
14343: घण्टापथ m. (-थः) The chief road through a village, a highway. E. घण्टा a bell, and पथि a road, affix अ; the bell-road, or that by which elephants, &c. decorated with tinkling ornaments, proceed.
14344: घण्टापाटली f. (-ली) A plant commonly called by the similar name Ghaṇṭāpārali, a species of the trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. घण्टा a bell, &c. and पाटली the trumpet flower.
14345: घण्टावाद्य n. (-द्यं) The sound of a clock. E. घण्ठा, and वाद्य playing.
14346: घण्टावीज n. (-जं) The croton nut. E. घण्टा, and वीज seed.
14347: घण्टारवा f. (-वा) Crotolaria of various species. E. घण्टा, and रव sound; the seed rattling within the husk.
14348: घण्टाशब्द m. (-ब्दं) 1 Bellmetal. 2 The sound of a bell. E. घण्टा, and शब्द sound.
14349: घण्टास्वन m. (-नः) The sound of a bell or clock. E. घण्टा, and स्वन sound.
14350: घण्टिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. E. घण्ठा a bell, and कन् affix of similitude.
14351: घण्टु m. (-ण्टुः) 1 A string of bells tied on an elephant's chest, &c. by way of ornament. 2 Heat, light, &c. घण to shine, Uṇādi affix टु.
14352: घण्टेश्वर m. (-रः) A minor deity, the son of MARS. E. घण्टा, and ईश्रर lord.
14354: घन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Material, solid. 2 Coarse, gross. 3 Compact. 4 Hard, firm. 5 Full, plump. 6 Impenetrable. 7 Viscid, thick, inspissated. 8 Deep, (as sound.) 9 Very, much. 10 Auspicious, fortunate. 11 A Permanent, eternal. m. (-नः) 1 A cloud. 2 An iron club. 3 The body. 4 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 5 A number, an assemblage or quantity. 6 Extension, diffusion. 7 Hardness. 8 Solidity, substance, matter. 9 The cube of a number, (in arithmetic.) 10 A solid, (in geometry.) 11 Phlegm. 12 Talc. n. (-नं) 1 A cymbal, a bell, a Gong, &c. any brazen or composite metallic instrument, which is struck as a clock, &c. 2 A mode of dancing, neither quick nor slow. 3 Iron. 4 Skin, rind, bark, &c. E. हन to strike or be struck, affix अप्, and ह changed to घ.
14355: घनकफ m. (-फः) Hail. E. घन a cloud, and कफ phlegm.
14356: घनकाल m. (-लः) The rainy season. E. घन a cloud, and काल time.
14357: घनगोलक m. (-कः) An alloy of gold and silver.
14358: घनघनौघ m. (-घः) A gathering of dark clouds. E. घन thick, close, घनौघ cumulus.
14359: घनचय m. (-यः) A collection of clouds, cumulus. E. घन, and चय a heap.
14360: घनजम्बाल m. (-लः) A quantity of mire, a slough. E. घन much, a heap, and जम्बाल mud.
14361: घनजाल n. (-लं) A gathering of clouds. E. घन, and जाल multitude.
14362: घनज्वाला f. (-ला) Lightning, a flash of lightning. E. घन a cloud, and ज्वाला flame.
14363: घनताल m. (-लः) A bird: see घनतोल.
14364: घनतिमिर n. (-रं) 1 The darkness of clouds. 2 Great darkness. E. घन, and तिमिर dark.
14365: घनत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Firmness, compactness. 2 Thickness, coarseness, solidity. E. त्व added to घन; also with तल्, घनता.
14366: घनतोल m. (-लः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. घन a cloud, and तुल to be equal, affix घञ्; who soars to the clouds in the rainy season, which, according to the fable, is the only time when he gets water to drink; some books have घनताल from ताल tune, or sound; whose music is (from) the clouds.
14367: घनध्वनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Roaring, who or what makes such a sound. m. (-निः) 1 A deep and loud tone, a roar. 2 The muttering of thunder clouds. E. घन, and ध्वनि sound.
14368: घननाभि m. (-भिः) Smoke. E. घन a cloud, and नाभि the navel or centre; smoke being supposed to be a principal ingredient in clouds.
14369: घननीहार m. (-रः) Thick falling frost or snow. E. घन, and नीहार hoar frost.
14370: घनपदवी f. (-वी) The sky. E. घन a cloud, and पदवी station.
14371: घनपयोधर m. (-रः) A firm breast. E. घन, and पयोधर the female breast.
14372: घनपल्लव m. (-बः) A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga:) see शोमाञ्जन. E. घन abundance, and पल्लव a shoot or sprout.
14373: घनपाषण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A peacock. E. घन a cloud, and पाषण्ड a sectary; this bird is supposed to delight in cloudy and rainy weather.
14374: घनफल n. (-लं) The contents of a solid, (in Geometry.) E. घन, and फल fruit.
14375: घनमूल n. (-लं) Cube root, (in Arithmetic.) E. घन, and मूल root.
14376: घनरव m. (-वः) The roaring of clouds, thunder. E. घन, and रव sound.
14377: घनरस mn. (-सः-सं) Water. m. (-स) 1 Camphor. 2 Extract, decoction, &c. 3 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) 4 Thick or inspissated juice. E. घन a cloud or a heap, and रस juice, essence.
14378: घनवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The sky. E. घन, and वर्त्मन् path.
14379: घनवल्लिका f. (-का) Lightning. E. घन a cloud, and वल्लिका a creeper.
14380: घनवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Lightning. E. चन, and वल्ली a creeper.
14381: घनवात m. (-तः) One of the regions of hell. E. घन much, and वात wind; the region of storm.
14382: घनवास m. (-सः) A pumpkin gourd. E. घन a long time, and वास abiding.
14383: घनवाहन m. (-नः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of INDRA. E. घन a cloud, and वाहन a vehicle; who rides in the clouds.
14384: घनवीथि f. (-थिः) A line of clouds. E. घन, and वीथि a row.
14385: घनशब्द m. (ब्दः) The noise of clouds, thunder. E. घन, and शब्द sound.
14386: घनश्याम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Black, deep black, as that of heavy clouds. m. (-मः) 1 RĀMA. 2 KṚṢṆA. E. घन, and श्याम black.
14387: घनसंवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Profound secrecy. E. घन impenetrable, संवृत्ति secret purpose.
14388: घनस्वन m. (-नः) Low thunder, the muttering of clouds. E. घन, and स्वन sound.
14389: घनसमय m. (-यः) The rainy season. E. घन a cloud, समय time.
14390: घनसार m. (-रः) 1 Camphor. 2 Mercury, or some peculiar form of it. 3 Water. 4 A kind of tree. E. घन firm, &c. and सार essence.
14391: घनाकर m. (-रः) The rainy season. E. घन a cloud, and आकर a mine or place of producing.
14392: घनाघन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Mischievous, cruel. 2 Even, uniform, without spaces or interstices. m. (-नः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A vicious elephant, or one in rut. 3 A rainy cloud. 4 Mutual collision. f. (-ना) A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum;) also काकमाची. E. घन as above, reiterated and the final of the first made long.
14393: घनात्यय m. (-यः) The season succeeding the rains, autumn. E. घन a cloud, and अत्यय disappearance, departure.
14394: घनान्त n. (-न्तं) Autumn, the end of the rains. E. घन a cloud, and अन्त end.
14395: घनामय m. (-यः) The date tree, (Elate sylvestris.) E. घन a cloud, and आमय sickness, pining in the rains.
14396: घनामल m. (-लः) A kind of potherb, (Chenopodium album:) see वास्तूक. E. घन much, and अमल clear, clean.
14397: घनाम्बु n. (-म्बु) Rain. E. घन, and अम्बु water.
14398: घनारुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Deep red. E. घन, and अरुण red.
14399: घनारुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Overcast, overspread with clouds. E. घन, and आरुद्ध obstructed.
14400: घनावरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Overcast, overspread with clouds. E. घन, and अवरुद्ध impeded.
14401: घनाश्रय m. (-यः) Æther, the atmosphere or heaven. E. घन a cloud, and आश्रय asylum.
14402: घनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hardened, compacted, made solid or firm. 2 Congealed, thickened. E. घन, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
14403: घनोदधि m. (-धिः) A division of hell. E. घन viscid, and उदधि an ocean.
14404: घनोपल m. (-लः) Hail. E. घन a cloud, and उपल a stone.
14405: घनोपरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Clouded, overcast. E. घन, and उपरुद्ध obstructed.
14406: घनौघ m. (-घः) A gathering of clouds. E. घन, and ओघ a heap.
