15021: चामर nf. (-रं-रा or री-रं) A Chowri, the tail of the Bos grunniens,  used to whisk off flies, also as an emblem or insignia of princely rank. E. चमर the Yak or Bos grunniens, and अण् aff.
15022: चामरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 2 A kind of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) 3 The mango tree. 4 A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. चामर a Chowri, and पुष्प a flower; whose flowers grow in clusters like the Indian Chowri.
15023: चामरपुष्पक m. (-कः) A kind of grass: see काश. E. कन् added to the preceding.
15024: चामरिन् m. (-री) A horse. E. चामर a Chowri, and इनि affix, either alluding to his bushy tail, or the custom of whisking off flies, &c. from the animal.
15025: चामीकर n. (-रं) Gold. E. चमीकर, said to mean a kind of mine, and अण् affix implying production.
15026: चामुण्डा f. (-ण्डा) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 One of the Mātṛkās. E. च the moon, and मुण्ड the head; having a head like the moon; or चा for चण्ड the name of a demon, and मुण्ड the skull; having seized the decapitated head of the demon: in either case the deriv. is irregular: see चर्म्ममुण्डा, &c.
15028: चाम्पेय m. (-यः) 1 The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.) 2 A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.) E. चम्पा the district, and ढक् aff.
15029: चाम्य n. (-म्यं) Food, &c. E. चम to eat, ण्यत् aff.
15030: चाय (ऋ) चायृ r. 1st cl. (चायति-ते) 1 To worship, to revere. 2 To discern, to perceive.
15031: चार m. (-रः) 1 Going, motion. 2 A spy, a secret agent or emissary. 3 Binding, a binding, a fetter, &c. 4 A prison, a house of confinement. 5 A kind of tree, the Piyal, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) see प्रियाल. 6 Wandering about, travelling. n. (-रं) A factitious poison. E. चर going, &c. affix अण्.
15032: चारक m. (-कः) 1 A groom, a horseman, a cavalier. 2 A binding, a fetter. 3 An associate, a companion. E. चर to go, in the causal form, and वुन् aff.
15033: चारकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Ascenscional difference, (in Astronomy.) E. चार, and काण्ड part.
15034: चारचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) Espionage. m. (-क्षुः) One (a king, &c.) who employs spies. E. चार, and चक्षुस् eye.
15035: चारचण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Graceful in gait or motion. E. चार and चणप् aff.
15036: चारचुञ्चु mfn. (-ञ्चुः-ञ्चुः-ञ्च) Remarkable in walking, of graceful carriage. E. चार, and चुञ्चुप् aff.
15037: चारज्या f. (-ज्या) The sine of the ascensional difference. E. चार and ज्या a sine.
15038: चारटी f. (-टी) A plant: see पद्मचारिणी. E. चर in the causal, what makes go or disperses, (disease,) अटन् aff.
15039: चारण m. (-णः) 1 A dancer, a mime. 2 An actor of note. 3 A reader of scripture. 4 A panegyrist of the gods. 5 A bard, a herald. E. चर in the causal, to cause to go, to diffuse, (fame, &c.) and ल्युट् aff.
15040: चारणदारा f. plur. (-राः) Female dancers, actresses, &c. E. चारण and दारा wives.
15041: चारपथ m. (-थः) A meeting of two roads. E. चार a passenger, and पथिन् a road, ष affix, which leaves अ final.
15042: चारभट m. (-टः) A hero, a chief or warrior. E. चार diffusion, (of praise, &c.) and भट who desires.
15043: चारयित्वा ind. 1 Having enjoined or prescribed, having caused to observe. 2 Having made to go. E. चर to go, causal form, क्त्वा aff.
15044: चारवायु m. (-युः) Summer-air, zephyr. E. चार causing to go, and वायु air or wind.
15045: चारान्तरित m. (-तः) A secret emissary or spy. E. चार, and अन्तरित concealed.
15047: चारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Caused to go. 2 Distilled. E. चर to go, causal form, क्त aff.
15048: चारिवाच् f. (-क्) A plant: see कर्क्कटशृङ्गी.
15049: चारित्र n. (-त्रं) Peculiar observance or practice, peculiarity of customs or condition: see चरण. f. (-त्रा) The tamarind tree. E. चर to go, नित्रन् Uṇādi affix; also चरित्र, &c.
15050: चारित्र्य n. (-त्र्यं) Becoming practices, moral conduct or instituted observance. E. चरित्र, and ष्यञ् aff.
15051: चारु mfn. (-रुः-र्व्वी-रु) Beautiful, elegant. m. (-रुः) A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods. E. चर to go, Uṇādi affix ञुण्.
15052: चारुक m. (-कः) The seed of the Sara cane. E. कन् added to the last.
15053: चारुगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A son of KṚṢṆA. E. चारु, and गर्भ asylum.
15054: चारुगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A son of KṚṢṆA. E. चारु, and गुप्त preserved.
15055: चारुता f. (-ता) Loveliness, beauty. E. तल् added to चारु; also with त्व added चारुत्वं.
15056: चारुदेष्ण m. (-ष्णः) The son of KṚṢṆA by RUKMIṆĪ.
15057: चारुधामन् m. (-मा) A plant: see शठी.
15058: चारुधारा f. (-रा) A name of SACI the wife of INDRA. E. चारु beautiful, and धारा fame, splendor, &c. some authorities read चारुधामा, from चारु, and धामन् abode.
15059: चारुफला f. (-ला) A grape. E. चारु beautiful, and फल fruit.
15060: चारुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Lovely, beautiful. f. (-ती) The daughter of KṚṢṆA by RUKMIṆĪ. E. चारु, and मतुप् aff.
15061: चारुलोचन m. (-नः) A deer. f. (-ना) A woman with fine eyes. E. चारु beautiful, and लोचन an eye.
15062: चारुवर्द्धना f. (-ना) A woman. E. चारु, and वर्द्धन increasing.
15063: चारुवाहु m. (-हुः) One of KṚṢṆA'S sons. E. चारु, and वाहु an arm.
15064: चारुव्रता f. (-ता) A female who observes a month of fasting. E. चारु elegant, and व्रत religious observance.
15065: चारुशिला f. (-ला) A jewel, a gem. E. चारु, and शिला a stone.
15066: चारुशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Lovely, beautiful. E. चारु, and शील having.
15067: चारुहासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Smiling sweetly. E. चारु, and हासिन् laughing.
15068: चारेक्षण m. (-णः) A statesman, a minister or king. E. चार a spy, and ईक्षण seeing.
15069: चार्च्चिक्य n. (-क्यं) Perfuming the person, smearing it with Sandal, &c. E. चर्च to beautify, ण्वुल् affix, and ष्यञ् added: see चर्चिका, &c.
15070: चार्म्म mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी-र्म्मं) 1 Covered with leather, (a car, &c.) 2 Defended by a hide or skin. 3 Shielded, having a shield. E. चर्म्म leather, and अण् aff.
15071: चार्म्मण n. (-णं) A multitude of hides, of shields, &c. E. चर्म्मन् a hide, &c. and अण् affix of aggregation.
15072: चार्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Leather, made of leather. 2 Belonging to the skin, &c. E. चर्म्म, and ठञ् aff.
15073: चार्म्मिण n. (-णं) A number of men armed with shields. E. चर्म्मिन् a shield bearer, and अण् aff.
15074: चार्व्वङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A beauty. E. चारु, and अङ्ग the body.
15075: चार्व्वाक m. (-कः) A sophist, a philosopher; one acquainted with the doctrines of the schools, a sceptic in many matters of Hindu faith, and considered by the orthodox as an atheist or materialist. E. चारु good, beautiful, and वाक discourse.
15076: चार्व्वाघाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Destructive of beauty. E. चारु, and हन to destroy, affix घञ् and घट substituted for the radicals; also with घत, चार्व्वाघात.
15077: चार्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) 1 A beautiful woman, a beauty. 2 The wife of KUVERA. 3 Understanding, intellect. 4 Moonlight. 5 Light, splendor. E. चारु beautiful, fem. affix ङीप्.
15078: चाल m. (-लः) 1 The thatch or roof of a house. 2 The blue jay. E. चल to go, affix अण्.
15079: चालक m. (-कः) A restive elephant. E. चल to go, ण्वुल् aff.
15080: चालन nf. (-नं-नी) A sieve, a strainer. n. (-नं) 1 Causing to move or go. 2 Muscular action. E. चल in the causal, to make go, (grain, &c. through its pores,) ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.
15081: चाष m. (-षः) 1 The blue jay, (Coracias Indica.) 2 A kingfisher, (according to some.) E. चष to injure, (fish, &c.) affix घञ्; also चास.
15082: चास m. (-सः) 1 The blue jay. 2 Sugar cane: see the preceding.
15083: चि (ञ) चिञ् r. 1st, 5th and 10th cls. (चयति-ते चिनोति चययति or चपयति) To collect, to gather together, to heap, to assemble, to accumulate, &c. With अप, To lose, to squander. With उप or सम्, To collect or acquire. With निर्, To determine. With वि and निर, To determine exactly. (ईर ण) ईरचिण् r. 1st cl. (चयति) To injure, (peculiar to the Vedas.)
15084: चिकरिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to cast or throw. E. कृ to throw, desiderative form उ aff.
15085: चिकर्त्तिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desiring or intending to cut or cut off. E. वृत to cut, desiderative form, उ aff.
15086: चिकित्सक m. (-कः) A physician, a practiser in medicine. E. कित, to cure, affix ण्वुल्, and the root reiterated.
15087: चिकित्सन n. (-नं) Healing, practising medicine. E. कित to relieve, reiterative form, ल्युट् aff.
15088: चिकित्सा f. (-त्सा) The practice of medicine, healing, curing, administering or applying remedies. E. कित to relieve, (disease,) in the reduplicate form, affixes अ and टाप्.
15089: चिकित्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Remedied, healed, physicked, cured. n. (-तं) Healing, remedying. E. कित, &c.: see the preceding, affix क्त.
15090: चिकिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flat-nosed. E. नि preposition, इनच् affix in this sense, and नि changed to चिक्.
15091: चिकिल m. (-लः) Mud, mire. E. चिक to obstruct, इलच् affix deriv. irr.
15092: चिकीर्षत् mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षती-र्षत्) Wishing, purposing, meaning to do. E. कृ to do, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
15093: चिकीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Desire to do any thing. E. कृ to do, in the desiderative form, अ aff.
15094: चिकीर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, designed, purposed. n. (-तं) Purpose, intention. E. कृ to do, desiderative form, क्त aff.
15095: चिकीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Desirous to do any thing. E. कृ to do, reiterated, and उ aff.
15096: चिकुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Rashly criminal, inconsiderately guilty, punishing or injuring others without consideration. m. (-रः) 1 Hair. 2 A mountain. 2 A snake. 4 A musk rat. 5 A kind of bird. 6 A kind of tree. E. चि imitative sound, and कुर to utter, affix क.
15097: चिकुरपाश m. (-शः) Abundance of hair. E. पाश affix in this sense: see कचपाश; also with other affixes चिकुरपक्ष, and चिकुरहस्त.
15098: चिकूर m. (-रः) Hair. E. see चिकुर; the vowel made long.
15099: चिक्क r. 10th cl. (चिक्कयति) To give pain.
15100: चिक्क mfn. (-क्कः-क्की-क्कं) Flat-nosed. m. (-क्कः) A musk rat. f. (-क्का) A mouse. E. चिक् imitative sound, and क who utters, from कै with ड affix; or चिक्क to give pain, and क affix; or in the last sense, नि preposition changed to चिक्, and कच् added.
15101: चिक्कण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Unctuous, greasy. 2 Bland, emollient. 3 Smooth, glossy. 4 Slippery. m. (-णः) The betel-nut tree. nf. (-णं-णा or णी) 1 The betel-nut. 2 A good cow. E. चित to think of, Uṇādi affix कन्, the final of the radical changed to क.
15102: चिक्कणता f. (-ता) Smoothness, greasiness, oiliness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, चिक्कणत्वं.
15103: चिक्कस m. (-सः) Barley meal. E. चिक्क to give pain, असच् aff.
15104: चिक्किण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Unctuous, greasy. 2 Bland, emollient. 3 Glossy, shining, smooth. 4 Slippery. f. (-णा) An excellent cow: see चिक्कण.
15105: चिक्रंसा f. (-सा) Wish to go or to approach. E. क्रम to go, desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
15106: चिक्लिद n. (-दं) Moisture, freshness. E. क्लिद to be wet, क affix, root redup.
15107: चिङ्गेट mf. (-टः-टी) A shrimp or prawn. E. चिङ्ग, handsome, and अट what goes, the radical vowel changed; also चिङ्गडः
15108: चिचिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A sort of gourd, commonly Chichinda, (Trichosanthes anguinæ.)
15109: चिचीषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing to gather or collect. E. चि to collect, desiderative form, शतृ aff.
15110: चिञ्चा f. (-ञ्चा) The tamarind tree. E. चम to eat, affix क्विप्, and the radical vowel changed, चिम् then, चर to go, with ड affix, and the fem. form; what becomes edible.
15111: चिञ्चाटक mfn. (-कः) A sort of grass, commonly Ceñcrā.
15112: चिञ्चाम्ल m. (-म्लः) An acid potherb, (Rumex vesicatorius.) E. चिञ्चा, and अम्ल sour.
15113: चिञ्चासार m. (-रः) A sort of potherb, (Rumex vesicatorius.) E. चिञ्चा, and सार essence.
15114: चिट r. 1st and 10th cls. (चेटति चेटयति) 1 To be another's messenger or servant. 2 To order as a servant.
15115: चित (ई) चिती r. 1st cl. (चेतति) चित r. 10th cl. (चेतयति-ते) also (इ) चिति r. 10th cl. (चिन्तयनि) To think or reflect on, to be sensible or rational, to weigh, to remember, to consider, &c.
15116: चित् f. (चित्) Intellect, understanding. ind. A particle and affix to words giving them an indefinite signification, as कश्चित् some one, कस्यचित् of some one, &c. see चन. E. चित् to remember, affix क्विप्.
15117: चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered, veiled, concealed. 2 Collected, accumulated. 3 Piled, heaped. f. (-ता) 1 A funeral pile. 2 A heap, an assemblage. E. चि to collect, &c. affix क्त; also चिति and चिती.
15118: चिताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The funeral fire. E. चिता the pile, and अग्नि fire.
15119: चिताचूडक n. (-कं) A mark where a funeral pile has been, a mausoleum, a monument, &c. E. चिता a pile, and चूडक a crest.
15120: चिति f. (तिः) Collecting, gathering. (-तिः-ती) 1 A funeral pile. 2 A heap, a quantity. 3 A pile, a stack. 4 An oblong with quadrangular sides. E. चि to collect, affix क्तिन्, and optionally ङीष् is added.
15121: चितिका f. (-का) A small chain worn as an ornament round the loins. E. चित to think of, इकन् affix, and fem. form.
15122: चित्कार m. (-रः) A cry, a scream. E. चित् imitative sound, and कार making.
15123: चित्कारशब्द m. (-ब्दः) A cry, a scream. E. चित्कार the same, and शब्द sound.
15124: चित्त n. (-त्तं) The mind or faculty of reasoning, the heart considered as the seat of intellect. E. चित to consider, and क्त aff.
15125: चित्तकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Anticipated, expected, calculated. 2 Known. E. चित्त, and कलित computed.
15126: चित्तजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) Love. E. चित्त, and जन्मन् birth.
15127: चित्तनिर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Contentment, happiness. E. चित्त, and निर्वृत्ति repose.
15128: चित्तप्रशम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Tranquil, content. E. चित्त, and प्रशम calmness.
15129: चित्तप्रसन्नता f. (-ता) Happiness, gaiety, joy. E. चित्त the heart, प्रसन्नता happiness.
15130: चित्तराग mn. (-गः-गं) Passion, desire. E. चित्त, and राग passion.
15131: चित्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Kind-hearted, amiable. E. चित्त, and मतुप् aff.
15132: चित्तविकार m. (-रः) Change of thoughts or feelings. E. चित्त, and विकार alteration.
15133: चित्तविकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Changing a person's character or feeling. E. चित्त, and विकारिन् causing change.
15134: चित्तविप्लव m. (-वः) Madness, insanity. E. चित्त the mind, and विप्लव affliction.
15135: चित्तविभ्रम m. (-मः) Madness, derangement. E. चित्त as above, and विभ्रम wandering.
15136: चित्तवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Inward purpose, feeling, emotion. E. चित्त, and वृत्ति being.
15137: चित्तवेदना f. (-ना) Anxiety, affliction. E. चित्त, and वेदना pain.
15138: चित्तभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Felt, perceived, being in the thoughts. E. चित्त, and भव being.
15139: चित्तभू m. (-भूः) Love. E. चित्त, and भू born.
15140: चित्तभेद m. (-दः) Inconsistency, contrariety of purpose or will. E. चित्त, and भेद difference.
15141: चित्तसङ्ख्य mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्यं) Pervading the heart, penetrating, knowing the thoughts. E. चित्त, and सङ्ख्य what enumerates.
15142: चित्तसमुन्नति f. (-तिः) Pride, arrogance, hauteur, haughtiness. E. चित्त the mind, समुन्नति elevation.
15143: चित्तसंहति f. (-तिः) A multitude of thoughts, minds or emotions. E. चित्त, and संहति assemblage.
15144: चित्तहृत् mfn. (-हृत्) Winning, fascinating. E. चित्त, and हृत् who takes.
15145: चित्तहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Beautiful, agreeable, fascinating. E. चित्त, and हारिन् what seizes.
15146: चित्तापहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Captivating, attractive. E. चित्त, and अपहारिन् what takes away.
15147: चित्ताभोग m. (-गः) Consciousness of pleasure or pain, the attention of the mind to its own sensations. E. चित्त the mind, and आभोग enjoyment.
15148: चित्तासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Love, attachment, affection. E. चित्त, and आसङ्ग devotion.
15149: चित्तैक्य n. (-क्यं) Harmony, agreement, unanimity. E. चित्त, and ऐक्य identity.
15150: चित्तोन्नति f. (-तिः) Pride, &c. see चित्तसमुन्नति. E. चित्त, and उन्नति elevation.
15151: चित्य n. (-त्यं) A monument, or any mark of the site of a funeral pile. E. चिता a pile, and क्यप् affix. f. (-त्या) A funeral pile. m. (-त्यः) Fire. E. चि to collect, ण्यत् affix, and deriv. irr.
15152: चित्याधिरोहण n. (-णं) Burning with a husband's corpse. E. चित्या and अधिरोहण ascending.
15153: चित्यारोहण n. (-णं) Ascending the funeral pile. E. चिति, and आरोहण mounting; also चितारोहण.
15154: चित्र r. 10th cl. चित्रयति) 1 To paint, to delineate, to colour with various colours, &c. 2 To wonder. 3 To cause wonder or be wonderful. 4 To see a rare or wonderful sight.
15155: चित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) 1 Variegated, spotted, speckled. 2 Wonderful, surprising. m. (-त्रः) A name of YAMA. f. (-त्रा) 1 A plant: see मूषिकपर्णी. 2 A kind of cucumber: see गोडुम्वा. 3 A plant, commonly Danti: see दन्तिका. 4 A name of SUBHADRĀ, the sister of JAGANNĀTHA. 5 A star in the virgin's spike. 6 A kind of snake. 7 The name of a river. 8 Illusion, worldly unreality. 9 The name of a nymph of Svarga. 10 A form of metre. n. (-त्रं) 1 Wonder, surprise. 2 Painting, delineation, writing, &c. 3 Sky, heaven. 4 A circular ornament, a sectarial mark on the forehead. 5 White or spotted leprosy. 6 Facetious conversation, conundrums, riddles, &c. 7 Writing or arrangement of verses in mathematical or other fanciful figures. mn. (-त्रः-त्रं) Variegated colour. E. चि to accumulate, Uṇādi affix क्ति, or चित् the mind, and त्र what preserves, from त्रै with क affix, and the duplicate त rejected.
15156: चित्रक m. (-कः) 1 The Cīta or small hunting leopard. 2 A painter. 3 The castor oil plant. 4 A medicinal plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.) n. (-कं) 1 A mark made with Sandal, &c. on the forehead. E. कन् added to the preceding.
15157: चित्रकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon. E. चित्र variegated, speckled, and कण्ठ throat.
15158: चित्रकर m. (-रः) A painter. E. चित्र colouring, and कर who makes.
15159: चित्रकम्बल m. (-लः) A painted cloth used as an elephant's housings, &c. E. चित्र, and कम्बल a blanket.
15160: चित्रकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) 1 Astonishing, surprising, working  wonders. 2 Painting, variegating. m. (-र्म्मा) 1 A magician. 2 A painter. 3 A tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.) n. (-र्म्म) Painting, or a painting. 2 Magic. E. चित्र surprising, and कर्म्मन् function.
15161: चित्रकर्म्मविद् m. (-विद्) 1 A painter. 2 A magician. E. चित्रकर्म्म, and विद् who knows.
15162: चित्रकाय m. (-यः) 1 A tiger. 2 A Chita. E. चित्र speckled, and काय body.
15163: चित्रकार m. (-रः) A painter. E. चित्र, and कार who makes.
15164: चित्रकूट m. (-टः) The name of a mountain in Bundelkhand, the modern Compteh, and first habitation of RĀMA in his exile. E. चित्र wonderful, and कूट peak; it is an epithet of many hills.
15165: चित्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) 1 A painter. 2 A tree, (Dalbergia ougieniensis.) E. चित्र, and कृत् what makes.
15166: चित्रकोल m. (-लः) A kind of lizard. E. चित्र speckled, and क्रोड haunch, deriv. irr.
15167: चित्रगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Painted, delineated, represented in a picture. 2 Coloured, variegated. E. चित्र, and गत gone.
15168: चित्रगन्ध n. (-न्धं) Yellow orpiment. E. चित्र, and गन्ध smell.
15169: चित्रगुप्त m. (-प्तः) 1 A name of YAMA, or rather one of the fourteen YAMAS. 2 YAMA'S registrar, who records the vices and virtues of mankind. E. चित्र wonderful, and गुप्त preserving; or चित्र writing, and गुप्त as before.
15170: चित्रगो mfn. (-गौः-गौः-गु) Having a brindled cow. E. चित्र, and गो a cow.
15171: चित्रजल्प m. (-ल्पः) Talking incoherently. E. चित्र, and जल्प prattle.
15172: चित्रतण्डुल mfn. subst. (-लः-ला-लं) A medicinal plant, said to possess anthelmintic virtues: see विडङ्ग. E. चित्र wonderful, and तण्डुल grain.
15173: चित्रतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Painted or variegated on the surface, (as a floor, &c.) E. चित्र, and तल below.
15174: चित्रत्वच् m. (-त्वक्) The birch or Bhurja tree. E. चित्र, and त्वच् bark.
15175: चित्रदण्डक m. (-कः) The cotton plant. E. चित्र, and दण्डक stem.
15176: चित्रनेत्रा f. (-त्रा) A small bird, the Maina of the dialects. E. चित्र variegated, and नेत्र an eye.
15177: चित्रपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The francoline partridge. E. चित्र surprising, and पक्ष a wing.
15178: चित्रपत्रिका f. (-का) The name of a plant, commonly कपित्थानी. E. चित्र wonderful, and पत्र a leaf.
15179: चित्रपदक्रम adv. ind. or n. (-मं) At a good pace. E. चित्र, पद a step, and क्रम going.
15180: चित्रपदा f. (-दा) 1 A creeper, (Cissus pedata.) 2 A kind of metre. E. चित्र surprising, and पद foot.
15181: चित्रपर्णिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, commonly Cākuliya, (Hemionites cordifolia.) 2 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. कन् added to चित्रपर्णी.
15182: चित्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 Cākuliya. 2 Madder; also चित्रपर्णिका. E. चित्र writing or painting, and पर्ण leaf; the leaves being as it were painted: see the preceding.
15183: चित्रपादा f. (-दा) The Maina, a small bird so called. E. चित्र speckled, and पाद foot.
15184: चित्रपिच्छक m. (-कः) A peacock. E. चित्र, and पिच्छ the tail.
15185: चित्रपुङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) An arrow. E. चित्र wonderful, and पुङ्ख shaft.
15186: चित्रपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A sparrow. E. चित्र speckled, and पृष्ठ the back.
15187: चित्रफल mf. (-लः-ला) A kind of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus.) m. (-लः) A kind of fish, (Mystus chitala, HAM.) f. (-ला-ली) 1 Egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) 2 Prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) 3 Gourds of various sorts. 4 A fish, (Mystus karpirat, HAM.) E. चित्र surprising, and फल fruit.
15188: चित्रफलक m. (-कः) A sort of fish: see the last. E. चित्र variegated, and फलक a scale.
15189: चित्रभानु m. (-नुः) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. 3 A name of BHAIRAVA, a form of ŚIVA. 4 The marking-nut plant. 5 Gigantic swallow wort. E. चित्र surprising, and भानु light.
15190: चित्रमृग m. (-गः) The spotted antelope. E. चित्र, and मृग a deer.
15191: चित्रमेखल m. (-लः) A peacock. E. चित्र spotted, and मेखला a girdle.
15192: चित्रयोधिन् m. (-धी) 1 A name of ARJUNA. 2 A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) 4 Any hero. E. चित्र, and योधिन् a warrior.
15193: चित्ररथ m. (-थः) 1 The sun. 2 The chief of the Gandharbas or choristers of INDRA'S heaven. E. चित्र painted, and रथ a car; lord of the painted car.
15194: चित्रल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Variegated or spotted. m. (-लः) A variegated colour. E. चित्र painting, and ल what produces.
15195: चित्रलेखा f. (-खा) 1 A portrait, a picture. 2 An Apsaras and friend of UṢĀ. 3 A form of metre.
15196: चित्रलिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Represented, delineated, (as in a picture.) E. चित्र, and लिखित drawn.
15197: चित्रलोचना f. (-ना) The Maina, a small bird so called. E. चित्र variegated, and लोचन an eye.
15198: चित्रवदाल m. (-लः) A sheat fish, (Silurus pelorius.) E. वित्र variegated, and वदाल a sheat fish, the epithet being a pleonasm.
15200: चित्रवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Astonishing act or effort. E. चित्र, and वृत्ति practice.
15201: चित्रशिखण्डिज m. (-जः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. चित्रशिखण्डी one of the seven Ṛṣis, and ज born; being the son of AṄGIRAS; also similar compounds, as चित्रशिखण्डिप्रसुत, &c.
15202: चित्रशिखण्डिन m. plu. (-ण्डिनः) The seven sages or Ṛṣis, but especially as represented in the seven principal stars of the great bear; these sages are MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULAHA, PULASTYA, KRATU, and VASIṢṬHA. E. चित्र surprising, शिखण्ड a crest, and इनि affix; sing. nom. case, शिखण्डिन् (-ण्डी).
15203: चित्रशिखण्डिप्रसुत m. (-तः) VṚHASPATI. E. चित्रशिखण्डि, and प्रसुत born: see चित्रशिखण्डिज; there are other similar compounds.
15204: चित्रश्री f. (-श्रीः) Great beauty, or the loveliness of variegated colours. E. चित्र, and श्री beauty.
15205: चित्रसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Pictured, painted. E. चित्र, and संस्थ fixed.
15206: चित्रसर्प m. (-र्पः) A large speckled snake. E. चित्र, and सर्प a snake.
15207: चित्रसेन m. (-नः) One of the judges or recorders of hell. E. चित्र, and सेना an army.
15208: चित्राक्षी f. (-क्षी) The Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. चित्र variegated, अक्ष an eye, fem. affix ङीष्, implying diminution.
15209: चित्राङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Painted, spotted, striped, (the body.) m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A kind of snake. 2 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.) n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Yellow orpiment. 2 Vermilion. f. (-ङ्गी) Madder. 2 A  worm, (Julus cornifex.) E. चित्र spotted or painted, &c. अङ्ग the body.
15210: चित्राङ्गद m. (-दः) 1 A king, the predecessor of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA and PĀṆḌU, and son of ŚANTANU. 2 A judge and recorder in hell. E. चित्र, अङ्ग body, and द who gives.
15211: चित्राङ्गदसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VYĀSA. E. चित्राङ्गद the name of a king, uterine brother of VYĀSA, and सू mother.
15212: चित्राटीर m. (-रः) 1 The moon. 2 The forehead spotted with the blood of a goat, slain in the worship of the demon GHAṆṬĀKARṆA. E. चित्र spotted, &c. and अट to go or be, and ईरन् aff.
15213: चित्रान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice dressed with coloured condiments. E. चित्र, and अन्न food.
15214: चित्रापूप m. (-पः) A cake. E. चित्र speckled, and आपूप a cake, a plum-cake.
15215: चित्रायस n. (-मं) Steel. E. चित्र, and अयस् iron.
15216: चित्रिक m. (-कः) The month Chaitra or Cheyt, (March-April.) E. चित्र the star, and ठन् affix; also ऐत्रिक.
15217: चित्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Painted. 2 Spotted, striped. 3 Variegated. E. चित्र to paint, क्त aff.
15218: चित्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) 1 Variegated. 2 Wonderful. f. (-णी) One of the four kinds in which women are classed. E. वित्र, and इनि aff.
15219: चित्रीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Astonishing, surprising, causing wonder or astonishment. E. चित्र with क्यच्, or used as a verb, शानच् aff.
15220: चित्रेश m. (-शः) The moon. E. चित्र the star, and ईंश lord.
15221: चित्रोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 A voice from heaven, that of an invisible speaker. 2 A marvellous tale. 3 Agreeable or eloquent discourse. E. चि miraculous, and उक्ति saying.
15222: चित्रौदन n. (-नं) Boiled rice coloured with turmeric, &c. E. चित्र variegated, and ओदन boiled rice.
15223: चिदात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The intellectual soul, spirit. E. चित, and आत्मन् soul.
15224: चिद्रूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Amiable, good-hearted. 2 Wise, intelligent, of liberal or expansive mind. n. (-पं) The Supreme Being, as identifiable with intellect or understanding. E. चित् mind, and रूप form.
15225: चिन्तयत् mfn. (-यत्-यती-यत्) Reflecting, considering. E. चिति to think, and शतृ aff.
15226: चिन्तनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be considered or thought. 2 To be comprehended. 3 To be meditated on. E. चिति to reflect, अनीयर् aff.
15227: चिन्तयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be considered, to be reflected on. E. चिति to think, (10th cl.) तव्य aff.
15228: चिन्तयित्वा ind. Having thought or considered. चिति to think, (10th cl.) क्त्वा aff.
15229: चिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Reflexion, consideration, recollection. E. चिति to reflect, affixes अङ् and ठाप्.
15230: चिन्ताकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Disturbed in thought or distracted by any idea. E. चिन्ता, and आकुल agitated.
15231: चिन्तापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Thoughtful, anxious. E. चिन्ता, and पर engaged in.
15232: चिन्तामणि m. (-णिः) 1 A fabulous gem, supposed to yield its possessor whatever may be required. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 A Jina or Jaina saint. E. त्रिन्ता reflexion, and मणि a jewel.
15233: चिन्तायान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Reflecting, considering, meditating. E. चिति to think, शानच aff.
15234: चिन्तावत् mfn. (-बान्-वती-वत्) Thinking, thoughtful. E. चिन्ता, and मतुप् aff.
15235: चिन्तावेश्मन् n. (-श्म) Council house or room. E. चिन्ता reflexion, and वेश्मन् a house.
15236: चिन्तिडी f. (-डी) The tamarind tree. E. irregularly changed from तिन्तिडी, q. v. also चिन्तिडीका, कन् being added.
15237: चिन्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thought, considered. 2 Reflecting, considering. n. (-तं) Reflexion: see चिन्ता. E. चिति to think, affix क्त.
15238: चिन्तिति f. (-तिः) Consideration, reflexion. E. चिति to think, क्तिन् aff.
15239: चिन्तिया f. (-या) Reflexion, consideration, thinking. E. चिति, and इय aff.
15240: चिन्तोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Midnight cry or alarm.
15241: चिन्त्य mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं) 1 To be considered. 2 To be appreciated or conceived. 3 To be thought of or meditated upon. E. चित् to think, यत् aff.
15242: चिन्न m. (-न्नः) A kind of grain, (Panicum miliaceum,) a various reading of चीन, q. v.
15243: चिन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्) Gathering, collecting. E. चि to gather, (5th cl.) शतृ aff.
15244: चिपिट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Flat-nosed. E. नि preposition, पिटञ् affix in this sense, and नि changed to चि. m. (-टः) Rice or grain flattened. E. पिट to flatten, क affix, the derivative reduplicated, and च substituted for the radical; also with कन् added चिपिटक; also the pen. becoming उ, चिपुट.
15248: चिमि m. (-मिः) 1 A parrot. 2 A plant, from the fibres of which coarse cloth and rope are made: see पट्ट. E. चि imitative sound, and मि to utter, affix क्विप्, with कन् added, चिमिक.
15249: चिमिक m. (-कः) A parrot: see the preceding.
15250: चिरकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Dilatory, tedious, slow. E. चिर, and कारिन् who acts.
15251: चिरकाल n. (-लं) A long period. E. चिर long, and काल time.
15252: चिरकालपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected for a long time. E. चिरकास्त, and पालित nourished.
15253: चिरकालोपार्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Accumulated slowly or after a long time. E. चिरकाल, and उपार्ज्जित gained.
15254: चिरक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dilatory, tedious, slow. E. चिर long, and क्रिया business.
15255: चिरगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Long absent, a long time gone. E. चिर, and गत gone.
15256: चिरचेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Long sought for, of rare occurrence. E. चिर, and चेष्टित sought.
15257: चिरजीवक m. (-कः) A tree: see जीवक. E. चिर long, and जीवक lived.
15258: चिरजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Long-lived. m. (-वी) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A crow. 3 The Jivaka: see the preceding. 4 An  epithet applied especially to eight chiefs or saints, viz. MĀRKAṆḌEYA, AŚVATTHĀMA, BĀLĪ, VYĀSA, HANUMĀN, VIBHĪṢAṆA, KṚPA, and PARAŚURĀMA. E. चिर for चिरम् long, and जीविन् living or lived; also चिरञ्जीविन्.
15259: चिरञ्जीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Long-lived. m. (-वी) 1 A crow. 2 VIṢṆU. E. see the preceding.
15260: चिरण्टी f. (-ण्डी) 1 A woman married or single, who continues to reside after maturity in her father's house. 2 A young woman. E. चिरम् long or late, and अट to go, (from home,) affix अच्, and deriv. irr.; also चिरिण्टी.
15261: चिरतिक्त m. (-क्तः) A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta.) E. चिर long, and तिक्त bitter.
15262: चिरत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्नी-त्नं) Old, ancient, what has been or lasted long. E. चिर long, and त्न aff.
15263: चिरदिवसं ind. For a long time. E. चिर, and दिवस a day.
15264: चिरनिविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Long rested, long abided. E. चिर, and निविष्ट rested.
15265: चिरन्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Old, ancient, antiquated, long lasting. E. चिरम् long, and द्यु affix, with तुद augment.
15266: चिरम् ind. A long time. E. चिर to injure, and क affix: this word, and others evidently derived from it, are now considered as particles, and have accordingly appropriate, though strained, etymologies; the derivatives however corresponding with the inflections of the singular number of nouns masculine or neuter, it may have been originally an imperfect noun of the 1st declension, thus; nom. चिरः or चिरं, acc. चिरं, 1st abl. चिरेण, dat. चिराय, 2nd abl. चिरात्, gen. चिरस्य, 3rd abl. चिरे; see these words severally.
15267: चिरप्रवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Dwelling a long time abroad. E. चिर, and प्रवासिन् who is away from home.
15268: चिरमित्र n. (-त्रं) An old friend. E. चिर, and मित्र a friend.
15269: चिरमेहिन् m. (-ही) An ass. E. चिर a long time, and मिह to sprinkle or urine, affix णिनि.
15270: चिरम्भण m. (-णः) A kite. E. चि imitative cry, and रभि to commence, affix ल्युट्.
15271: चिररात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of very many nights, a long time. E. चिर long, and रात्र a night.
15272: चिररात्राय ind. A long time. E. चिररात्र as above, and अय to go, affix अण्.
15273: चिरलब्ध (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Obtained after a long time, (as a son in old age.) E. चिर, and लब्ध gained.
15274: चिरविल्व m. (-ल्वः) The name of a plant: see करज. E. चिर a long time, विल to divide, and व affix; also चिरिविल्व.
15275: चिरसूता f. (-ता) A cow that has borne many calves. E. चिर for a long time, and सूता prolific; also चिरसूतिका.
15276: चिरसेवक m. (-कः) An old servant. E. चिर, and सेवक who serves.
15277: चिरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Long continuing, enduring, lasting. E. चिर, and स्थ what is; also चिरस्थायिन्.
15278: चिरस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Of long continuance. E. चिर for चिर्, and स्थायिन् what stays.
15279: चिरस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Long enduring, lasting or remaining for a long time. 2 Left behind for a long time. E. चिर, and स्थित stayed.
15280: चिरस्य ind. A long time. E. चिर a long time, अस to be, affix ण्यत्: see चिरम.
15281: चिराटिका f. (-का) Hogweed, the white sort.
15282: चिरातिक्त m. (-क्तः) A sort of gentian: see चिरतिक्त.
15283: चिराद् m. (-रात्) A name of GARUḌA. ind. A long time. E. चिर for a long time, and अद् who eats, from अद with क्विप् affix: or चिर and आजि aff.
15284: चिराय ind. A long time. E. चिर a long time, and अय to go, affix अण्.
15285: चिरायुस् mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Long-lived. m. (-युः) A deity, a divinity. E. चिर long, and आयुस् life.
15286: चिरारोध m. (-धः) Blockade. E. चिर, and आरोध obstruction.
15287: चिराश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Long maintained or protected. E. चिर, and आश्रित supported.
15288: चिरि r. 5th cl. (चिरिणोति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
15289: चिरि m. (-रिः) A parrot. E. चि imitative cry, and रा to utter, affix कि.
15290: चिरिण्ठी f. (-ण्ठी) 1 A woman staying in her father's house. 2 A young woman. E. irregularly derived from चिरि to hurt: see चिरण्टी.
15291: चिरिविल्व m. (-ल्वः) A tree: see चिरविल्व. E. चिरि a parrot, and विख to break, affix व.
15292: चिरु n. (-रु) The shoulder joint. E. चिर to hurt, affix उ.
15293: चिरे ind. A long time: see चिरम्.
15294: चिरेण ind. A long time: see चिरम्.
15295: चिरोज्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Long since abandoned or left. E. चिर, and उञ्झित abandoned.
15296: चिर्भिटी f. (-टी) A kind of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus.)
15297: चिल r. 6th cl. (चिलति) To put on clothes.
15298: चिलमीलिका f. (-का) 1 A necklace. 2 A firefly. 3 Lightning. E. चिर a long time, and र changed to ल, मील to twinkle or glister, with क्वुन् affix; and the fem. form.
15299: चिलिचिम m. (-मः) 1 A kind of sprat, (Clupea cultrata, B. MSS?) 2 A kind of prawn, (according to some.) E. चिल to sport or play, affix कि, चिलि and reiterated, चिलिचि sport, pastime, मा to mete, to find, क affix, finding sport in marshy places amongst reeds, &c.; this word has various forms, being read as above, and चिलिचीम, चिलिमीनक, चिलीचिम, चिलिचिमि, चिलीम, &c.
15300: चिल्ल r. 1st cl. (-चिल्लति) 1 To be loose, to be slack or flaccid. 2 To indicate one's meaning. 3 To act wantonly.
15301: चिल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ली-ल्लं) Blear-eyed. m. (-ल्लः) 1 The Bengal kite, (Falco cheela, Lath.) 2 A bleared or sore eye. f. (-ल्ली) 1 A potherb, said to be a small kind of Chenopodium: see वास्तूक. 2 A cricket. E. चिल्ल to be flaccid or loose, affix अच्: see चुल्ल, or नि preposition, लच् in the second sense, and चिल् substituted for नि.
15302: चिल्लका f. (-का) A cricket: see चीलिका.
15303: चिल्लभक्ष्या f. (क्ष्या) A vegetable perfume: see हट्टविलाशिनी. E. चिल्ल a kite, and भक्ष्य eatable.
15304: चिल्लाभ m. (-भः) A petty thief, a shoplifter, a pick-pocket, &c. E. चिल्ल a kite, and आभ resembling, from भा to shine, with आङ् prefix and ड affix, pouncing on his prize like a kite on its prey.
15305: चिवि m. (-विः) The chin. E. चीव to take, कि affix, and the radical vowel shortened: see चिवु.
15306: चिविट m. (-टः) Flattened grain. A various reading of चिपिट, q. v.
15307: चिवु m. (-वुः) The chin: see the next.
15308: चिवुक n. (-कं) The chin. E. चीव to take or cover, कु affix, and कन् added; also चिवु.
15309: चिह्न Sautra root. 10th cl. (चिह्नयति) To mark, to spot, to stamp.
15310: चिह्न n. (-ह्नं) 1 A mark of any kind, a spot, stain, sign, symbol, &c. 2 A banner, a standard. 3 A symptom. E. चह to pound, affix नक्, and the radical vowel changed to इ, or चिह्न to mark, क aff.
15311: चिह्नकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Spotting, marking. 2 Hideous, frightful. 3 Striking, killing. E. चिह्न, and कारिन् who or what makes.
15312: चिह्नधारिणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. चिह्न a mark, and धारिणी possessing.
15313: चिह्नित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Marked, spotted, stained, stamped. 2 Designated. 3 Known. E. चिह्न to mark, and क्त aff.
15314: चीक r. 1st and 10th cls. (चीकति चीकयति) 1 To be patient, to suffer or endure. 2 To be impatient. 3 To touch.
15315: चीन m. (-नः) 1 A kind of deer. 2 A sort of panic, (Panicum miliaceum.) 3 A country, China. 4 A sort of cloth. 5 A thread. n. (-नं) 1 A banner, (perhaps made of deer skin.) 2 Lead. E. चि to collect, नक् affix, and the deriv. irr.
15316: चीनक m. (-कः) A sort of panic, (P. miliaceum.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
15317: चीनकर्प्पूर m. (-रः) Camphor. E. चीन, and कर्पूर the same; the best is from China.
15318: चीनज n. (-जं) Steel. E. चीन, and ज produced.
15319: चीनपिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) 1 Minium or red-lead. 2 Lead. E. चीन China, and पिष्ठ cake; brought in lumps from the hills on the northwest of Bengal, and between it and China.
15320: चीनवङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Lead, or more probably tutenague. E. चीन, and वङ्ग zinc.
15321: चीनांशुक n. (-कं) China cloth, silk. E. चीन, and अंशुक cloth.
15322: चीब् (ऋ) चीवृ r. 1st cl. (चीबति) To take: see चीव.
15323: चीभ (ऋ) चीभृ r. 1st cl. (चीभते) To coax, to commend, to flatter. 2 To appropriate praise, to boast, &c.: some authorities substitute वीभृ for this root.
15324: चीय (ऋ) चीयृ r. 1st cl. (चीयति-ते) 1 To take, to receive. 2 To wear.
15325: चीर n. (-रं) 1 Cloth, clothes. 2 A rag, old and torn cloth. 3 Bark, rind. 4 A crest. 5 A kind of garland. 6 Lead. 7 A line, a stroke. 8 Writing. 9 The dress of a Bauddha priest. f. (-री) 1 A cricket. 2 The ends or hem of a garment. E. चि to collect, Uṇādi affix रक्, deriv. irr.
15326: चीरवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Clothed in tatters. E. चीर, and वासस् vesture.
15327: चीरि f. (-रिः) An eye cloth, a veil covering the eyes. E. चिर to hurt, and कि affix; the radical vowel lengthened.
15328: चीरिका f. (-का) A cricket. E. कन् added to चीरी.
15329: चीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Conversant, learned. 2 Split, divided.
15330: चीर्णपर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The Nimb: see निम्ब. 2 The date tree, (Elate sylvestris.) E. चीर्ण divided, and पर्ण a leaf.
15331: चीलिका f. (-का) A cricket. E. चीरी imitative cry, and क who utters; also चिल्लका and झिल्लका.
15332: चीव r. 10th cl. (चीवयति) To shine. 2 To speak. (-ऋ,) चीवृ r. 1st cl. (चीवति-ते) 1 To take. 2 To wear.
15333: चीवर n. (-रं) The tattered dress of a Bauddha mendicant, or of any mendicant. E. चि to collect, &c. and स्वरच् Uṇādi aff.
15334: चीवरिन् m. (-री) A Bauddha or Jaina mendicant. E. चीवर a beggar's dress, and इनि aff.
15335: चुक्क r. 10th cl. (चुक्कयति) To inflict or suffer pain.
15336: चुक्कार m. (-रः) The roaring of a lion. E. चुक्क pain, derived from चुक्क, with अच् affix, ऋ in the causal, to occasion, affix अप्.
15337: चुक्र m. (-क्रः) 1 Sorrel. 2 Sourness. n. (-क्रं) 1 Acid seasoning. 2 Vinegar made by the acetous fermentation of grain. f. (-क्रा or क्री) 1 Indian sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.) 2 Hogplum. 3 The tamarind. E. चक to satisfy, Uṇādi affix रक्, and the radical vowel changed to उ; also with कन्, चुक्रक.
15338: चुक्रिका f. (-का) Indian sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
15339: चुचि m. (-चिः) The female breast or bosom.
15340: चुचुक mn. (-कः-कं) A nipple. E. चुष to such, and क affix, deriv. irr. or चुचु imitative sound, (such as a child makes in sucking,) and क what sounds; also चुचूक and चूचुक.
15341: चुचू m. (-चूः) A potherb, (Marsilea dentata, Rox.)
15342: चुच्य (ई) चुच्यी r. 1st cl. (चोच्यति) 1 To distil, to drop. 2 To bathe.
15343: चुञ्चु m. (-ञ्चुः) 1 The musk rat or shrew. 2 A mixed caste, born of a Brahman father by a Vaideha female.
15344: चुञ्चुरी f. (-री) A game, a kind of hazard played with tamarind seeds in place of dice. E. चुञ्च substituted for चिञ्चा the tamarind, and र from रा to get or give, affixes ड and ङीष्, or with ल affix चुञ्चुली.
15345: चुट r. 1st cl. (चोटति) and 10th cl. (चोटयति) To wane, to become small, low or shallow. r. 6th and 10th cls. (चुटति चोटति) To cut, to pierce or divide; (इ,) चुटि r. 1st cl. (चुंटति) To become low or shallow. r. 1st and 10th cls. (चुण्टति चुण्टयति) To cut, &c.; also चुट्ट and चुड.
15346: चुट्ट r. 10th cl. (चुट्टयति) 1 To become small, low or shallow, as a river, &c. 2 To collect.
15347: चुड (इ) चुडि r. 1st cl. (चुण्डति) To become small, low or shallow. r. 10th cl. (चुण्डयति) To cut, to pierce or divide.
15348: चुड्ड r. 1st cl. (चुड्डति) 1 To hint one's meaning. 2 To dally, to wanton, to coquet, &c. 3 To act.
15349: चुण r. 6th cl. (चुणति) To cut, to pierce or divide.
15350: चुण्टा f. (-ण्टा) A small well or reservoir near a well. E. चुडि to be low or shallow, affixes अङ् and टाप्; also चुड्डी, the fem. affix being ङीष्.
15351: चुण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A small well: see the preceding.
15352: चुत (इर) चुतिर r. 1st cl. (चोतति) To wet, to be wet or moist.
15353: चुत m. (-तः) The anus. E. चुत to be moist, affix क; also च्युत and चुति.
15354: चुति f. (-तिः) The anus. E. चुत to be wet, क्तिन् affix; also च्यति.
15355: चुद r. 10th cl. (चोदयति) 1 To send, to direct, to throw or cast. 2 To ask or interrogate. (इर, इ) इर चुदि r. 1st cl. (चुन्दति-ते) To sharpen.
15356: चुन्दी f. (-न्दी) A procuress, a bawd. E. चुद to inquire, affixes क and ङीष्, and नुम् inserted.
15357: चुप r. 1st cl. (चोपति) To move slowly, to creep or steal along.
15358: चुब (इ,) चुबि r. 1st cl. (चुम्बति) or implying reciprocity, (चुम्बते) To kiss. r. 10th cl. (चुम्बयति) To kill or hurt.
15359: चुब्र n. (-ब्रं) The face. E. चुव to kiss, रन् Uṇādi aff.
15360: चुम्बक m. (-कः) 1 A kisser, a lecher. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 The loadstone. 4 A general scholar, one who knows parts in a variety of books. 5 The upper part or middle of a balance. E. चुबि to kiss, affix क्वुन्.
15361: चुम्बत् mfn. (म्बन्-म्बन्ती-म्बत्) Kissing. E. चुवि to kiss, शतृ aff.
15362: चुम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Kissing. 2 A kiss. E. चुबि to kiss, affix ल्युट्.
15363: चुम्बनदान n. (-नं) Kissing. E. चुम्बन, and दान giving.
15364: चुम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kissed. E. चुवि to kiss, क्त aff.
15365: चुम्बितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Kissing. E. चुवि, and क्तवतु aff.
15366: चुर r. 10th cl. (चोरयति) To steal, to rob: according to some it is also r. 1st cl. (चोरति.) This root gives its name to the 10th class, which is thence called चुरादि; (ई) चुरी r. 4th cl. (चूर्य्यते) To burn.
15367: चुरा f. (-रा) Theft, stealing. E. चुर to steal, affix क, fem. affix टाप्.
15368: चुरी f. (-री) A small well. E. चु, ट to be shallow, affixes क and ङीष्; ट changed to र.
15369: चुल r. 10th cl. (चोलयति) 1 To rise, to increase. 2 To raise, to elevate. 2 To dip or dive into.
15370: चुलुक m. (-कः) 1 Mud, mire. 2 A small vessel or pot, a gallipot, &c. 3 The hand hollowed to hold water. n. (-कं) Water in which pulse has been steeped. E. चुल to dip into, affix क्वुन्: see चलुक.
15371: चुलुकिन् m. (-की) A porpoise. E. चुलुक mud, इनि aff.
15372: चुलुम्प r. 1st cl. (चुलम्पति) 1 To cut. 2 To disappear, to be lost.
15373: चुलुम्प m. (-म्पः) Fondling or nursing children, &c. f. (-म्पा) A she goat. E. चुलुम्प to cut, अच् and टाप् affs.
15374: चुलुम्पिन् m. (-म्पी) The gangetic porpoise. E. चुलुम्प to cut, इनि aff.
15375: चुल्ल r. 1st cl. (चुल्लति) 1 To manifest one's meaning. 2 To dally, to wanton or coquet.
15376: चुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Blear-eyed. m. (-ल्लः) A blear eye. f. (-ल्ली) 1 A chimney, a fire place. 2 A funeral pile. E. चुल्ल to indicate meaning, affix अच्; or नि preposition, लच् affix implying moisture of the eyes, and चुल् substituted for नि.
15377: चुल्लक m. (-कः) The palm of the hand hollowed as if to hold water.
15378: चुल्लकी f. (-की) 1 A porpoise. 2 A water pot. 3 The opposite bank of a river. E. चुल्ल to dally, (in the water,) क्वुन् affix, and fem. affix ङीष्.
15379: चुल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) A fire place, a chimney. E. चुल्ल to manifest meaning, and इ aff.
15380: चुस्त n. (-स्तं) 1 Fried meat. 2 Chaff, rind. E. चूष to suck, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
15381: चूचुक mn. (-कः-कं) A nipple. E. चूष to suck, and deriv. irr.; or चूचु imitative sound, (in sucking,) and क what makes; also चुचुक, &c.
15382: चूडक m. (-कः) A well. E. चुड to become shallow, affix क्वुन् and the vowel lengthened.
15383: चूडा f. (-डा) 1 A single lock of hair left on the crown of the head at the ceremony of tonsure. 2 A peacock's crest. 3 Any crest, plume, diadem, &c. 4 The head. 5 Top, summit. 6 An upper house, a room on the top of a house, &c. 7 A kind of bracelet. 8 A small well. 9 Tonsure; more commonly चूडाकरणं. E. चूल to elevate, अङ् and टाप् affixes, ल changed to ड, and the vowel lengthened.
15384: चूडाकरण n. (-णं) Shaving the head all but one lock, considered as a religious, and purificatory rite; it should be performed in the first or third year. E. चूडा, and करण making.
15385: चूडाकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The rite of tonsure: see the last. E. चूडा, and कर्म्म act.
15386: चूडामणि m. (-णिः) 1 A jewel worn in a crest or a diadem. 2 The Gunja, (Abrus precatorius.) E. चूडा a crest, and मणि a jewel.
15387: चूडाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crested, having a lock of hair on the crown of the head, &c. f. (-ला) A kind of grass, (Kyllinga monocephala.) n. (-लं) The head. E. चूडा a crest, and ल what has, from ला with ड affix, or लच् poss. aff.
15388: चूडालक्षण n. (-णं) Tonsure. E. चूडा, and लक्षण mark.
15389: चूडावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत) Crested, having a lock of hair, &c. on the top of the head. E. चूडा a crest, and मतुप् aff.
15390: चूण r. 10th cl. (चूणयति) To contract, to close or shrink.
15391: चूत m. (-तः) 1 The mango, (Manjifera Indica.) 2 The anus. E. चूष to drink, affix क्त, deriv. irr., or चुत to be moist, affix घञ्.
15392: चूतक m. (-कः) 1 The mango. 2 A small or shallow well. E. कन् added to the preceding.
15393: चूति f. (-तिः) The anus: see चुति.
15394: चूर (इ,) चूरी r. 1st cl. (चूर्य्यते) To burn.
15395: चूर्ण r. 1st cl. (चूर्णयति) 1 To contract, to shrink, to close as an eye, to wink. 2 To throw, to send or direct. 3 To grind or pound.
15396: चूर्ण mn. (-र्णः-र्णं) 1 Powder, any pulverulent or minute division of substance. 2 Chalk, lime. 3 Aromatic powder, pounded Sandal, &c. 4 Pounded camphor. f. (-र्णी) 1 A Cowri, the shell used as a coin. 2 Selection of an unanswerable argument. 3 A river in Bengal. 4 The red powder scattered at the Holi festival. 5 Dust: see चूर्णि. E. चूर्ण to pound, &c. affix घञ्.
15397: चूर्णक m. (-कः) Grain fried and pounded. n. (-कं) Expounding in prose the purport of a foregoing verse, an order or interpretation or prose not abounding in compound words. E. कन् added to the preceding.
15398: चूर्णकार m. (-रः) A lime-burner, a maker of lime. E. चूर्ण, and कार who makes.
15399: चूर्णकुन्तल m. (-लः) A lock of hair, a curl or curling hair. E. चूर्ण what contracts, and कुन्तल hair.
15400: चूर्णखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Pebble, gravel, hardened fragments of earth or brick; limestone nodule, commonly known in India by the name of Concar. E. चूर्ण dust, and खण्ड fragment.
15401: चूर्णता f. (-ता) Pulverulence, comminution, the state of dust or powder. E. चूर्ण with तल् affix; also त्व, चूर्णत्वं.
15402: चूर्णपारद m. (-दः) Vermilion. E. चूर्णं, and पारद quicksilver.
15403: चूर्णमुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A handful of perfume or powder. E. चर्ण, and मुष्टि handful.
15404: चूर्णि m. (-र्णिः) A sum of 100 Cowries, the small shells used as coin. 2 A selection or picking out of an unanswerable argument. 2 The grammar of PATAÑJALA, a comment on PĀṆINI'S grammar. E. चर to go, to pass, (current,) नि Uṇādi affix, and ऊ substituted for the radical vowel, or चूर्ण to direct, &c. affix कि.
15405: चूर्णिका f. (-का) Fried and ground rice. E. चूर्ण to pound, वुन् affix, and the feminine form.
15406: चूर्णिकृत् m. (-कृत्) An annotator, commentator, &c. E. चूर्णि selecting, picking out, (meanings or corroborative passages,) and कृत who makes.
15407: चूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ground, pounded, reduced to dust or powder. 3 Squeezed, smashed. E. चूर्ण to pound, क्त aff.
15408: चूर्णिन् mfn. (-णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) Made or mixed up with any thing powdered or pounded. E. चूर्ण powder, and इनि aff.
15409: चूर्णीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reduced to dust or powder, pounded, beaten to pieces. E. चूर्ण, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
15410: चूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Going. E. चर to go, क्तिन् affix, deriv. irr.
15411: चूला f. (-ला) 1 An upper room, a room on the top of a house. 2 A crest. E. चुल to rise, affixes अङ् and टाप्: see चूडा.
15412: चूलिका f. (-का) 1 The root of an elephant's ear. 2 The body of a drama, the inferior personages of the drama collectively. n. (-कं) Flour cakes fried with ghee. E. चूल to be or make high, affix ण्वुल्.
15413: चूष r. 1st cl. (चूषति) To drink or suck.
15414: चूषा f. (-षा) 1 Sucking. 2 A leathern girth. E. चूष to drink, affix घञ्.
15415: चूष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) To be drunk or sucked. n. (-ष्यं) Any thing that can be eaten by sucking. E. चूष to suck, यत् aff.
15416: चृत r. 1st and 10th cls. (चर्त्तति-चर्त्तयति) To light, to kindle. (ई) चृती r. 6th cl. (-चृतति) 1 To hurt, to wound or kill. 2 To tie or connect together.
15417: चृप r. 1st and 10th cls. (चर्पति, चर्पयति) To light or kindle.
15418: चेक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who does much or often, active, industrious. E. कृ to do, intens. form, अच् aff.
15419: चेट m. (-टः) A servant, a slave. f. (-टी) A female servant. E. चिट to serve, affix अण्, also with कन् added चेटक. f. चेटिका; also चेड, &c.
15420: चेटक m. (-कः) 1 A slave. 2 A gallant: see the last. 3 A servant, a minister, one who fulfils an appointed duty. E. चिट to serve, ण्वुल affix, or चेट with कन् added.
15421: चेड m. (-डः) A servant. f. (-डी) A female servant or slave. E. चिट to serve, अण् affix, and ट changed to ड; also चेट, &c. as above, and चेडक, चेडिका, &c.
15422: चेत् ind. If. E. चित to think, to consider, affix विच्.
15423: चेतक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Suggesting, causing to think. 2 What thinks or feels, sentient. f. (-की) The yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) E. चित to consider, affix वुन्.
15424: चेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Alive, living, feeling. m. (-नः) 1 Soul, self. 2 A man. 3 A living and sentient being. f. (-ना) Understanding, intelligence, wisdom, reflection. E. चित to reflect, affix युच्.
15425: चेतनावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Living, sentient. E. चेतना, and मतुप् aff.
15426: चेतय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) A living and sentient being. E. चित to think, श aff.
15427: चेतयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sentient, reflecting, conscious. E. चित to think, शानच् aff.
15428: चेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be collected, to be gathered. E. चि to collect, तव्य aff.
15429: चेतस् n. (-तः) Mind, intellect, the faculty of reasoning or understanding. E. चित to consider, Uṇādi affix असुन्.
15430: चेतोभू m. (-भूः) Love. E. चेतस्, and भू born.
15431: चेदार m. (-रः) A lizard, a chamelion.
15432: चेदि m. (-दिः) The name of a country, perhaps the modern Chandail. m. plu. (-दयः) The inhabitants of Cedi.
15433: चेदिपति m. (-तिः) 1 A VASU named UPACARA. 2 A name of ŚIŚUPĀLA. E. चेदि, and पति master.
15434: चेदिराज m. (-जः) A name of ŚIŚUPĀLA a king killed by KṚṢṆA. E. चेदि the country, and राज a king; also चेदिपति, चेदिराज्, &c.
15435: चेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be gathered or collected. E. चि to collect, यत् aff.
15436: चेल (ऋ) चेलृ r. 1st cl. (चेलति) 1 To shake or tremble. 2 To go or move.
15437: चेल mfn. sub. (-लः-ली-लं) Cloth, clothes, raiment. adj. Vile, wicked, bad. E. चिल to wear, affix अग्; also चेलक and चैल.
15438: चेलप्रक्षालक m. (-कः) A washerman. E. चेल, and प्रक्षालक who washes.
15440: चेलिका f. (-का) A corset, a boddice. E. चेल clothes, कन् aff.
15441: चेलीम m. (-मः) A small kind of fish.
15442: चेल्ल r. 1st cl. (चेल्लति) 1 To think. 2 To go: this root is not usually admitted: see चेल.
15443: चेवी f. (-वी) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.
15444: चेष्ट r. 1st cl. (चेष्टते) To act or perform functions, duties, &c. to strive, to endeavour, to be busy or follow any particular avocation.
15445: चेष्टन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Making effort, who or what acts or attempts any act. n. (-नं) Effort, exertion. E. चेष्ट, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.
15446: चेष्टमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Active, moving. E. चेष्ट to exert, शानच् aff.
15447: चेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Effort, exertion, bodily effort. E. चेष्ट to act, अङ् and टाप् affs.
15448: चेष्टानिरूपण n. (-णं) Observing a person's actions. E. चेष्टा, and निरूपण investigating.
15449: चेष्टानाश m. (-शः) The end of the world. E. चेष्टा, and नाश destruction.
15450: चेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Exerted, done with effort. 2 Done. n. (-तं) 1 Going, motion. 2 Bodily act or function. 3 Action, behaviour. E. चेष्ट to act, affix क्त.
15451: चैतन्य n. (-न्यं) Soul, spirit, the deity considered as the essence of all being. 2 Sense, consciousness. m. (-न्यः) A modern reformer of the Vaiṣṇava faith, considered in Bengal as an Avatāra of KṚṢṆA. E. चेतन intellect, and ण्यत् aff.
15452: चैत्य m. (-त्यः) A sacred tree, a religious fig tree, &c. growing in a village or near it, and held in veneration by the villagers. n. (-त्यं) 1 A place of sacrifice or religious worship, an altar, a  shed kept for sacrifices, &c. 2 A religious building peculiar to the Jainas, a Jaina temple. 3 A Jaina or Bauddha image, &c. 4 A monument, a tombstone, a column, &c. erected in memory of some deceased person, or on the site of a funeral pile. 5 A pile of stones forming a landmark or boundary. E. चि to collect, deriv. irr.; or चित to consider, affix क्यप्, चित्य, and अण् aff.
15453: चैत्यद्रु m. (-द्रुः) 1 The religious fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 2 A large tree in a village. E. चैत्य as above, and द्रु a tree.
15454: चैत्यद्रुम m. (-मः) A large tree in a village. E. चैत्य as above, and द्रुम a tree.
15455: चैत्यमुख m. (-खः) A student's water pot. E. चैत्य place of sacrifice, and मुख principal.
15456: चैत्यवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The religious fig tree. 2 A large tree in a village. E. चैत्य, and वृक्ष a tree: see चैत्य.
15457: चैत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 The month Chaitra or Cheyt, (March-April.) 2 One of the ranges of mountains dividing the continent into portions or Varṣas: see वर्ष. 3 A Bauddha or Jaina religious mendicant. 4 The son of BUDHA by CITRĀ. n. (-त्रः) 1 A monument erected to the dead, a column or block of wood, a tree, &c. so considered. 2 A small temple. E. चित्रा the star, or चित्र wonderful, &c. affix अण्.
15458: चैत्रक m. (-कः) The month Chaitra. E. कन् added to the preceding; also चैत्रिक.
15459: चैत्ररथ n. (-थं) The garden of the deity KUVERA. E. चित्ररथ a Gandharba in charge of the garden, affix अण्.
15460: चैत्रावली f. (-ली) The day of full moon in Chaitra. E. चैत्र the month, and आवली a line, a series.
15461: चैत्रि m. (-त्रिः) The month Chaitra. E. चित्रा, and इञ् aff.
15462: चैत्रिक m. (-कः) The month Chaitra. E. चित्रा the asterism, or lunar mansion for this month, and ठक aff.
15463: चैत्रिन् m. (-त्री) The month Chaitra. E. चित्रा, and णिनि aff.
15464: चैद्य m. (-द्यः) A name of ŚIŚUPĀLA an adversary of KṚṢṆA, the son of DAMAGHOṢA, and sovereign of Cedi or Chandail. m. plu. (-द्याः) The inhabitants of Cedi. E. चेदि the country so called, and ज्य aff.
15465: चैल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) 1 Cloth, of cloth. 2 Bred in clothes, (insects or lice, &c.) E. चेल cloth, अण् aff.
15466: चैलाशक m. (-कः) An eater of lice, (a goblin so designated.) E. चैल an insect found in clothes, and अशक who eats.
15467: चोक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Sung. 2 Pure, clean. 3 Clever, dexterous. 4 Pleasing, delightful, beautiful. 5 Sharp, pungent, keen, &c. E. चूष to suck, affix ष.
15468: चोच n. (-चं) 1 Bark, rind. 2 Skin. 3 Cassia bark. 4 Half eaten fruit of the palm. 5 A banana or plaintain: see मोचा. 6 A cocoanut.
15469: चोचक n. (-कं) Bark, rind. E. कन् added to the preceding.
15470: चोटी f. (-टी) A petticoat. E. चुट to be small, affixes अच् and ङीष्.
15471: चोड m. (-डः) 1 A bodice or jacket. 2 A country: see चोल.
15472: चोदना f. (-ना) 1 A precept, a sacred ordinance or commandment. 2 Sending, commanding, directing, &c. 3 Enjoining, ordaining. 4 Casting, throwing. E. चुद to command, &c. affixes ल्यु and टाप्.
15473: चोदनागुड m. (-डः) A ball for playing with. E. चेदना directing or throwing, and गुड a ball.
15474: चोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Informed, apprised. 2 Ordered, directed. 3 Appointed. 4 Urged, impelled. 5 Thrown, cast. E. चुद to direct, क्त aff.
15475: चोद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be sent, thrown, or directed. n. (-द्यं) 1 Surprise, astonishment, wonderful or astonishing. 2 Asking, an asking, a question, &c. E. चुद to send, to command, &c. affix ण्यत्.
15476: चोपन m. (-नः) Moving, moving slowly. E. चुप to move, affix युच.
15477: चोर m. (-रः) 1 A thief, a robber. 2 A perfume called commonly by the same name. f. (-रा) A plant: see चोरपुष्पी. E. चुर to steal, affix अच; also with कन added चोरक.
15478: चोरकण्टक m. (-कः) A kind of grass, commonly Corkānta, (Andropogon aciculatum.) E. चोर, and कण्टक a thorn: the seeds clinging to the feet and clothes of those who walk amongst it.
15479: चोरपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A kind of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) E. चोर a thief, and पुष्प a flower, fem. affix ङीष्: see the last; also with कन् added चोरपुष्पिका.
15480: चोरिका f. (-का) Theft, robbery: see चौरिका.
15481: चोल mf. (-लः-ली) A short jacket, a bodice. m. (-लः) or m. plu. (-लाः) A country, the modern Tanjore, the name is also supposed to apply to a part of Birbhum, in Bengal. E. चुल to be high or to elevate, affix अच, and ल being changed to ड, चोड ut sup. or चोल a proper name, that of the king of the country applied to the country.
15482: चोलक m. (-कः) A breastplate, a cuirass. n. (-कं) Bark, rind. E. चुल to elevate, affix वुन्.
15483: चोलकिन् m. (-की) 1 The shoot of the bambu. 2 The wrist. 3 The orange. 4 A cuirassier, a soldier armed with a breastplate. E. चोलक armour, rind, &c. and इनि aff.
15484: चोलोण्डुक m. (-कः) A diadem, a fillet for the head, a turban or tiara.
15485: चोष m. (-षः) 1 Suction, sucking. 2 Burning, (of the skin,) inflammation. 3 Drying up. E. चूष to suck, घञ् aff.
15486: चोषण n. (-णं) Sucking, suction. E. चूष to suck, ल्युट् aff.
15487: चोस्क m. (-स्कः) A horse of a particular and good breed.
15488: चौक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Agreeable, pleasant. E. चोक्ष the same, अण् aff.
15489: चौड mfn. (-डः-डी-डं) 1 Crested, relating to a crest. 2 Relating to tonsure. n. (-डं) Tonsure. E. चूडा a crest, &c. and अण aff.
15490: चौडकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The rite of tonsure. E. चौड, and कर्म्मन् act.
15491: चौर mf. (-रः-री) 1 A thief, a robber, a pilferer. 2 A plant: see चोरपुष्पी. 3 A perfume. f. (-री) Stealing, theft. E. चोर a thief, affix अण्.
15492: चौरतस् ind. From theft. E. चौर, and तसि for the sign of the fifth case.
15493: चौरहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stolen, robbed. E. चौर, and हृत taken.
15494: चौरापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Carried off, stolen, E. चौर, and अपहृत taken away.
15495: चौरिका f. (-का) Theft, robbing. E. चोर a thief, वुञ् affix, optionally चोरिका; or चौरी theft, कन् added.
15496: चौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Theft, robbing. E. चोर a thief, ष्यञ् aff.
15497: चौर्य्यार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by plunder or robbery. E. चौर्य्य, and अर्ज्जित gained.
15498: चौल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating to a crest or top-knot, &c. E. चूला for चूडा, and अण् aff.
15499: चौलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The ceremony of tonsure, cutting off all the hair from the head of a child three years old, except one lock on the crown. E. चौल or चौड relating to the चूडा or crest, and कर्म्मन् work, act.
15500: चौलुक्य m. (-क्यः) One of the Rājarṣis or royal saints.
15501: च्यवन n. (-नं) 1 Oozing, trickling, flowing. 2 Going, moving. m. (-नः) The name of a ṚṢI. E. च्यु to go, ल्युट् aff.
15502: च्यु (ङ) च्युङ् r. 1st cl. (च्यवते) 1 To go or move. 2 To flow, to drop. r. 10th cl. (च्यावयति) 1 To laugh. 2 To bear or suffer.
15503: च्युत (इर) च्युतिर r. 1st cl. (च्योतति) To wet thoroughly, to moisten a little, to sprinkle, to drop, to exude.
15504: च्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fallen, dropped, oozed out, &c. 2 Fallen, from or off. 3 Deviated from, erred, strayed. 4 Broken, disordered. 5 Lost. E. च्यु to go, affix क्त.
15505: च्युताचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Deviating from duty. E. च्युत, and आचार rite, usage.
15506: च्युताधिकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dismissed, (from an office, &c.) deprived of, (as a right.) E. च्युत lost, and अधिकार function.
15507: च्युतोत्साह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Spent, exhausted, incapable of effort. E. च्युत, and उत्साह exertion.
15508: च्युति f. (-तिः) 1 Dropping, dripping, oozing. 2 Falling, falling from. 3 Deviating from. 4 The vulva. 5 The anus. E. च्यु to fall, &c. affix क्तिन्; also with ङीष्, च्युती; again with the radical vowel protracted च्यूति &c.; and without the semivowel च्युति, &c.
15509: च्युप m. (-पः) The face. E. च्यु to laugh, प Uṇādi aff.
15510: च्युस r. 10th cl. (च्चोसयति) 1 To laugh. 2 To bear. 3 To loose. 4 To hurt or kill.
15511: च्योत n. (-तं) Sprinkling, pouring or dropping forth, falling as an unctuous substance, oozing, trickling, &c. E. च्युत to wet or moisten, affix घञ्.
15512: च्योत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्नी-त्नं) 1 A mover, a goer, one who moves or goes. 2 Oviparous. 3 Abandoned, wicked, void of virtue or purity. E. च्यु to go, Uṇādi affix त्नण्. छ
15513: छ The aspirated letter corresponding to the preceding, and expressed by Ch.
15514: छ mfn. (छः-छा-छं) 1 Pure, clean. 2 Trembling, tremulous, unsteady. m. (छः) 1 Cutting, dividing. 2 A part, a fragment. f. (-छा) 1 Covering, concealing. 2 An infant, a child, any young animal. E. छो to cut, or छद to cover, &c. affix ड.
15515: छग mf. (-गः-गा) A goat. E. छो to cut, गक् aff.
15516: छगण mn. (-णः-णं) Dried cowdung. E. छ a fragment, and गण assemblage.
15517: छगल m. (-लः) A goat. f. (-ला-ली) A she goat. 2 A kind of convolvulus (C. argenteus), or more probably (C. pes-capræ:) see ऋक्षगन्धा. n. (-लं) Blue cloth or raiment. E. छो to cut or tear, Uṇādi affixes कल and गुट्, or ग substituted for क.
15518: छगलक m. (-कः) A goat. E. कन् added to the preceding.
15519: छगलाङ्घ्री f. (-ङ्घ्री) A kind of convolvulus, (C. pes-caprae:) see छगला. E. छगल a goat, and अङ्घ्रि a foot; also छगलान्त्री, &c.
15520: छगलाण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A plant: see the preceding.
15521: छगलान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A kind of convolvulus: see छगलाङ्घ्री. E. छगल a goat, and अन्त्र a gut, an entrail; with कन् added, छगलान्त्रिका; also छगलाङ्घी.
15522: छटा f. (-टा) 1 Light, lustre, splendor. 2 Assemblage, quantity, number. 3 A straight or continuous mark or line.
15523: छटाफल m. (-लः) A palmyra tree. E. छटा a line, and फल fruit.
15524: छटाभा f. (-भा) Lightning. E. छटा a streak, and भा light.
15525: छत्र n. (-त्रं) A parasol, an umbrella, the Indian catta. f. (-त्रा) 1 A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 2 A pungent seed, coriander. 3 A mushroom. 4 Anise. E. छद to cover, and ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix; hence the word and its derivatives are also written with a double त, छत्त्र, &c.
15526: छत्रक m. (-कः) A king-fisher. 2 A mushroom. 3 A shrub, commonly Kuliyā-khāra. 4 A small vaulted temple, in honour of a deity. 5 A beehive of a conical or umbrella form. E. कन् added to the preceding.
15527: छत्रचक्र n. (-क्रं) An astrological diagram. E. छत्र, and चक्र a circle.
15528: छत्रधार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Bearing a parasol, having or possessing one. E. छत्र, and धर who has or holds, affix अण्; also छत्रधर, छत्रधारक, and छत्रधारिन्.
15529: छत्रधारण n. (-णं) 1 Carrying a catta. 2 The carrying of one as a type of authority. E. छत्र, and धारण having.
15530: छत्रपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. छत्र, and पत्र a leaf, umbrella-leaved; also छत्रपत्रक.
15531: छत्रभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Widowhood. 2 Wilfulness, independence. 3 Subversion of dominion, loss of empire, deposition, &c. E. छत a parasol, and भङ्ग a breaking; in the first two senses छत्र is used metaphorically, for any cover or defence, as a husband, &c.; in the last it is used by synecdoche, a parasol being one of the ensigns of royalty.
15532: छत्राक n. (-कं) A mushroom. f. (-की) A plant, commonly Rāsnā: see रास्ना. E. छत्र a parasol, and अक to go, to resemble; affixes अण् and ङीष्.
15533: छत्रातिछत्र m. (-त्रः) A fragrant grass, described as growing in marshy ground. E. छत्र a mushroom, and अतिछत्र surpassing an umbrella, i. e. more like a catta, than even a mushroom.
15534: छत्रिका f. (-का) A mushroom. E. छत्र, कन् affix of resemblance, fem. form.
15535: छत्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Bearing a parasol or umbrella. m. (-त्री) A barber. E. छत्र, and इनि aff.
15536: छत्वर m. (-रः) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 A bower, an arbour. E. छद to cover, स्वरच् Uṇādi affix, and त substituted for द.
15537: छद r. 1st and 10th cls. (छदति-ते and छदयति, or more commonly छादयति.) 1 To cover, to clothe, to veil, to hide, or remove from view: (आङ् is usually prefixed to the root in these senses.) 2 To march. (इ) छदि r. 1st cl. (छंदति) To live or breathe, to be or make strong; also r. 1st and 10th cls. (छन्दति छंदयति) To cover, &c. as above.
15538: छद m. (-दः) 1 A leaf. 2 A wing. 3 A plant: see ग्रन्थिपर्णी. 4 A tree bearing dark blossoms: see तमाल. E. छद to cover, &c. aff. घ.
15539: छदन n. (-नं) 1 A leaf. 2 A wing. 3 A covering, a sheathe, a scabbard. 4 Cassia. E. छद to cover or hide, affix युच्.
15540: छदपत्र m. (-त्रः) A tree, (Symplocos racemosa, Rox.) see भूर्य्य E. छद a cover or skin, and पत्र a leaf.
15541: छदिस् m. (-दिः) The thatch or roof of a house. E. छद to cover, इसि Uṇādi aff.
15542: छद्मतापस m. (-सः) A religious hypocrite, a false brother. E. छद्म disguise, and तापस an ascetic.
15543: छद्मन् n. (-द्मं) 1 Trick, deceit. 2 Fraud, dishonesty. 3 Plea, pretext. 4 Masquerade, disguise of person, &c. E. छद a cloak, a covering, and मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
15544: छद्मवेशिन् m. (-शी) Being in disguise, a player. E. छद्म and वेशिन् who wears a dress, &c.
15545: छद्वर m. (-रः) 1 A tooth. 2 An arbour or bower.
15546: छन्च्छन् ind. An imitative sound, expressive of sobbing, &c.
15547: छन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Solitary, secret, private. m. (-न्दः) 1 Meaning, intention, purport, opinion. 2 Subjection. 3 Poison. n. (-न्दं) Wish, desire. E. छद to cover, affix घञ्: see छन्दस्.
15548: छन्दपातन m. (-नः) A hypocrite, a pretended and false ascetic. E. छन्द subjection, (of all human beings,) and पातन obtaining, from पत to go, affix ल्युट्; also छन्दकपातन.
15549: छन्दस् n. (-न्दः) 1 Poetical metre of every kind, but it is also applicable particularly to the metre of the Vedas. 2 Meaning, purport, object, intention. 3 Wish, desire. 4 The Vedas or scripture. 5 Wilfulness, independence, uncontrolled or unrestrained conduct. E. चदि to gladden, &c. and असुन् Uṇādi affix, च is changed to छ; also in some senses with a final vowel छन्द, q. v.
15550: छन्दस्कृत n. (-तं) A holy verse. E. छन्दस्, and कृत made.
15551: छन्दस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Made or done at will or according to one's wish. E. छन्दस् inclination, and यत् aff.
15552: छन्दोग m. (-गः) A reciter, or chanter of the Sāma Veda. E. छन्दस् the metre of the Vedas, and ग who sings.
15553: छन्दोनुवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Humouring, indulgence. E. छन्दस् will, and अनुवृत्त conforming to.
15554: छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Private, secret. 2 Solitary. 3 Covered. E. छद to cover, affix क्त.
15555: छप (इ) छपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (छम्पति छम्पयति) To go or move.
15556: छम (उ) छमु r. 1st cl. (छमति) To eat: see चमु.
15557: छमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 An orphan, a fatherless son. 2 A lad who has no kinsmen. E. छम to eat, अण्डच् Uṇādi affix; also छेमण्ड.
15558: छर्द r. 10th cl. (छर्दयति) To vomit, to be sick.
15559: छर्द nf. (-र्दं-र्दी) Vomiting, sickness, reaching. E. छर्द to vomit, affix अच्; also with the affixes ल्युट् and इन्, छर्दन्, छर्दि, &c. ut infra.
15560: छर्दन n. (-नं) Vomiting, reaching, sickness. m. (-नः) 1 The Nimb tree: see निम्ब. 2 The Rākṣasa, ALAMBUṢA. E. कृद to be or make sick, affix ल्युट्.
15561: छर्दि f. (-र्दिः) Vomiting: see छर्द. E. छृद to be sick, इन् Uṇādi affix; also with ङीष् added छर्दी, and with a further addition of कन्, छर्दिका.
15562: छर्द्दिघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The Nimb tree. E. छर्द्दि, and घ्न what removes.
15563: छर्दिकारिपु m. (-पुः) Small cardamoms. E. छर्दिका vomiting, and रिपु enemy, anti-emetic.
15564: छर्दिस् f. (-र्दिः) Vomiting. E. छृद to be sick, Uṇādi affix इसि; also छर्दि and छर्द.
15565: छर्ष r. 1st cl. (छर्षति-ते) To kill, to wound, to hurt.
15566: छल n. (-लं) 1 Wickedness. 2 Fraud, circumvention, trick, stratagem. 3 Design, device. E. छो to cut, कलच् affix, and the radical final rejected.
15567: छलन nf. (-नं-ना) Tricking, deceiving. E. छल nominal verb, युच् aff.
15568: छलनापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cunning, crafty, deceitful. E. छलना, and पर addicted to.
15569: छलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Deceiving, cheating. E. छल nom. verb to cheat, शतृ aff.
15570: छलिन् m. (-ली) A cheat. E. छल, and इनि aff.
15571: छल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) Skin, bark, rind, &c. E. छद a cover, ला to give or get; with affix कि, द becomes ल; also with ङीप् added छल्ली.
15572: छल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 Skin, bark, rind, &c. 2 Offspring, posterity. 3 A spreading creeper. 4 A kind of flower. E. see the preceding.
15573: छवि f. (-विः) 1 Beauty, splendor, brilliance. 2 Light, lustre. E. छो to divide, (darkness, &c.) इन् affix, and the deriv. irr. or क्विन् Uṇādi affix; also with ङीष् added छवी.
15574: छा f. (छा) A young animal. E. छो to cut, डा aff.
15575: छाग f. (-गः) A goat. f. (-गी) A she goat. E. छो to cut, Uṇādi affix गण्.
15576: छागण m. (-णः) A fire of dried cowdung. E. अण् affix of relation, added to छगण्.
15577: छागभोजिन् m. (-जी) A wolf. E. छाग, and भोजिन् who eats.
15578: छागरथ m. (-थः) AGNI or the deity of fire. E. छाग a goat, and रथ a car or any vehicle.
15579: छागल m. (-लः) 1 A goat: see छगल; also with कन् added छागलक. 2 A proper name, the son of CHAGALA or ATRI. E. छगल and अण affix; also with इञ् aff. छागलि or कन् added छागलक.
15580: छागलान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A plant, (Convolvulus pes-capræ:) see छगलान्त्री.
15581: छागवाहन m. (-नः) A name of AGNI or the deity of fire. E. छाग a goat, and वाहन a vehicle, the goat-borne.
15582: छागिका f. (-का) A she goat. E. कन् added to छागी.
15583: छात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut, divided. 2 Thin, feeble, emaciated. E. छो to cut, affix क्त; also छित.
15584: छात्र m. (-त्रः) A scholar, a pupil, a disciple, a tyro or novice. n. (-त्रं) Honey. E. छत्र an umbrella, a screen or cover, affix अण्.
15585: छात्रक n. (-कं) Honey in the comb or hive. E. छत्रक a hive, and अण् aff.
15586: छात्रगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) An indifferent scholar in poetical composition; one citing imperfect portions only of a verse.
15587: छात्रदर्शन n. (-नं) Oiled butter prepared from milk one day old.
15588: छाद n. (-दं) A thatch, a roof. E. छद to cover, affix घञ्.
15589: छादन n. (-नं) 1 Covering. 2 A covering, a screen, &c. 3 Hiding, concealing. 4 A leaf. E. छद to cover, affix ल्यु, and the vowel lengthened.
15590: छादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut, divided. 2 Covered. 3 Hidden, concealed. E. छो to cut, or छद to cover, affix क्त.
15591: छाद्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fraudulent, dishonest. m. (-कः) A rogue, a cheat. E. छद्मन् knavery, ठञ् aff.
15592: छान्दस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to poetical metre, to the Vedas, &c. m. (-सः) A priest conversant with scripture. E. छन्दस्, and अण् aff.
15593: छान्दोग्य n. (-ग्यं) 1 The doctrine of the Vedas. 2 A celebrated Upaniṣad of the Sāma Veda. E. छान्दस् belonging to the Vedas, ग who goes, and क्य affix of habitude or practice.
15594: छाया f. (-या) 1 Shade. 2 Shadow, reflected image. 3 The wife of the sun. 4 Beauty, splendor, lustre. 5 Light. 6 Nourishing, cherishing. 7 A bribe. 8 A straight or continuous line. 9 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. 10 Darkness, obscurity. 11 The shadow of a Gnomon, especially as indicative of the position of the sun. E. छो to cut, (to cut off the light, &c.) and य Uṇādi aff.
15595: छायाकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Shading, shadowing. m. (-रः) 1 A catta or umbrella bearer. 2 A species of metre. E. छाया shade, and कर who makes.
15596: छायातनय m. (-यः) A name of SATURN. E. छाया the wife of SŪRYA, and तनय a son; also similar compounds, as छायात्मज, छायासुत, &c.
15597: छायातरु m. (-रुः) A large tree, one that gives shade or shelter. E. छाया, and तरु a tree.
15599: छायापथ m. (-थः) Æther, the Ākāśa or firmament. E. छाया light, and पथ a road.
15600: छायाभृत् m. (-भृत्) CANDRA or the moon. E. छाया light, and भृत् who possesses.
15601: छायामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Reflected. 2 Casting a shadow. E. छाया, and मयट् aff.
15602: छायामित्र n. (-त्रं) A catta or parasol. E. छाया shade, and मित्र friendly.
15603: छायामृगधर m. (-रः) The moon. E. छाया an image, मृग a deer, and धर who possesses; also छायाधर, and मृगधर severally.
15605: छि m. (-छिः) Abuse, reproach. E. छो to cut, कि aff.
15606: छिक्कण n. (-णं) Sneezing. f. (-णी) A small plant, (Artemisia sternutatoria). E. छिक्क nominal verb, to sneeze, ल्युट् aff.
15607: छिक्का f. (-क्का) Sneezing. E. छिक् imitative sound, and क what utters, from कै with ड and टाप् affs.
15608: छिक्कक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sternutatory. 2 Sneezing. f. (-का) A plant, (Artemisia sternutatoria.) E. छिक्क nominal verb, to sneeze, वुन् aff.
15609: छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, divided. E. छो to cut, affix क्त, deriv irr.
15610: छित्ति m. (-त्तिः) 1 Cutting, division. 2 A plant, (Galedupa arborea:) see करज. E. छिद to cut, affix क्तिन्.
15611: छित्त्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Roguish, fraudulent, knavish, a knave. 2 Hostile, inimical, a foe. 3 Cutting or fit for cutting, (a weapon, &c.) E. छिद to cut, स्वरच् Uṇādi affix, and त optionally substituted for the radical final, otherwise छिद्वर.
15612: छित्त्वा ind. Having cut or divided. E. छिद to cut, क्त्वा aff.
15613: छिद (औ, इर) औछिदिर r. 7th cl. (छिनत्ति छिंत्ते) To divided, to split, to cut, &c. With the prefix आङ्, To seize, to lay hold of. With the prefix उत, To slay or kill.
15614: छिद् mfn. (-द् or त्) Cutting, destroying, who or what cuts. E. छिद to cut, affix क्विप्.
15615: छिदक n. (-कं) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. छिद to cut or split, affix क्वन्; also छिदिक.
15616: छिदा f. (-दा) Cutting, dividing. E. छिद, as above, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
15617: छिदि f. (-दिः) An axe. E. छिद to cut, इ Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel unchanged.
15618: छिदिर m. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 A rope, a cord. 3 A sword. 4 An axe, a hatchet. E. छिद to cut, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
15619: छिदुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Cutting, dividing, what cuts or divides. 2 A knave. 3 Hostile, a foe. E. छिद to cut, and कुरच् aff.
15620: छिद्र r. 10th cl. (छिद्रयति) 1 To pierce, to bore, to perforate, to make openings or holes. 2 To perforate the ear for rings, &c.
15621: छिद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 A hole, a vacuity, a perforation, &c. 2 Fault, defect, flaw, (moral or physical.) 3 A weak side. 4 Infirmity. E. छिद to pierce, Uṇādi affix रक्.
15622: छिद्रकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears pierced. E. छिद्र, and कर्ण the ear.
15623: छिद्रानुसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Looking out for faults or flaws. E. छिद्र, and अनुसारिन् who pursues.
15624: छिद्रान्तर् m. (-न्तः) A reed. E. छिद्र, and अन्तर् within.
15625: छिद्रान्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking for faults, malicious. E. छिद्र, and अन्वेषिन् searching.
15626: छिद्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perforated, pierced, having holes or openings. E. छिद्र to pierce, affix क्त.
15628: छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Cut, divided. f. (-न्ना) 1 A whore, a harlot. 2 A tree: see गुडूची. E. छिद to cut, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
15629: छिन्नक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Cut a little, incised, not cut off. E. कन् added to छिन्न.
15630: छिन्नकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears cut off. E. छिन्न, and कर्ण the ear.
15631: छिन्नकेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Shorn, shaven. E. छिन्न, and केश the hair.
15632: छिन्नधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A warrior whose bow has been cut or broken by his enemy's arrow. E. छिन्न, and धन्वन् a bow.
15633: छिन्ननासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Noseless, having had the nose cut off. E. छिन्न, and नासिका the nose.
15634: छिन्ननास्य mfn. (स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Having the rope that passes through the nose of a draft ox broken. E. छिन्न, and नास्य the nose-rein.
15635: छिन्नबन्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Loosed, liberated. E. छिन्न, and बन्धन binding.
15636: छिन्नभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Cut up, destroyed, scattered. E. छिन्न, and भिन्न broken.
15637: छिन्नमस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Decapitated. f. (-स्ता) A form of DURGĀ without her head. E. छिन्न, and मस्त the head; also with कन् added छिन्नभस्तक, छिन्नमस्तका.
15638: छिन्नरुहा f. (-हा) A tree, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची. E. छिन्न cut, and रुहा what grows; growing again after being cut.
15639: छिन्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having cut or cut off. E. छिन्न, and मतुप् aff.
15640: छिन्नवेशिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Akaindhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. छिन्न what is cut, (a wound,) and विश to enter, वुन् affix, and the fem. form.
15641: छिन्नसंशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Confirmed, confident, free from doubt. E. छिन्न, and संशय doubt.
15642: छुछुन्दरी f. (-री) The musk rat or shrew.
15643: छुट r. 6th and 10th cls. (छोटति छोटयति) To cut; also चुट्.
15645: छुद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 Retaliating, returning, remedying. 2 A ray.
15646: छुप (औ) ओछुप r. 6th cl. (छुपति) To touch.
15647: छुप m. (-पः) 1 A small tree, a shrub, a bush. 2 Touch, touching. 3 Air, wind. 4 War, combat. E. छुप to touch, affix क.
15649: छुरा f. (-रा) Lime. E. छुर to cut, अङ् and टाप् affs.
15650: छुरिका f. (-का) A knife. E. छुर to cut, क्वुन् affix, and the fem. form; also with क, and ङीष् affixes, छुरी.
15651: छुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut. 2 Inlaid, set, coated, spread. 3 Blended, intermingled. E. छुर to cut, affix क्त.
15652: छुरितोदर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Pierced, transpierced. 2 Run through the belly. E. छुरित, and उदर the belly.
15653: छुरी f. (-री) A knife: see छुरिका.
15654: छृद (उ and इर) उछृदिर r. 7th cl. (छृणत्ति छृंत्ते) 1 To shine. 2 To vomit. 3 To play. (ई) छृदी r. 1st and 10th cls. (छर्दति छर्दयति) To light, to kindle.
15655: छृप (ई) छृपी r. 1st and 10th cls. (छर्पति छर्पयति) To light, to inflame or kindle.
15656: छेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Tame, domesticated, as a bird or beast. 2 Citizen, town-bred, rakish, buckish, smart, trained in the acuteness and vice of towns. E. छो to cut, affix ईकन, deriv. irr.
15657: छेकोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Indirect speech, insinuation, double entendre, hint, &c. E. छेक city-bred, and उक्ति saying.
15658: छेत्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut, to be cut off, &c. E. छिद to cut, तव्य aff.
15659: छेत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ) 1 Who or what cuts. 2 Solving, resolving, (doubts, &c.) E. छिद to cut, तृच् aff.
15660: छेद r. 10th cl. (छेदयति) To cut, to cover, to divide, but especially into two parts.
15661: छेद m. (-दः) 1 Cutting, dividing. 2 A part, a portion. 3 Solving, dissipating, (as doubt.) 4 The denominator of a fraction. 5 The divisor. E. छिद to cut, affix घञ्.
15662: छेदकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Cutting. m. (-रः) A wood-cutter. E. छेद, and कर who makes.
15663: छेदन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting, dividing. 2 A part, a portion. E. छिद to cut, affix ल्युट्.
15664: छेदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cut or divided. E. छिद to cut, अनीयर् aff.
15665: छेदि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Cutting, dividing, a cutter, &c. E. छिद to cut, Uṇādi affix इन्.
15666: छेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, divided. E. छिद to cut, affix क्त.
15667: छेदितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut or divided. E. छिद to cut, तव्य aff.
15668: छेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be cut or divided. n. (-द्यं) Amputation, excision. E. छिद to cut, यत् aff.
15669: छेमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A fatherless son: see छमण्ड.
15670: छेलु m. (-लुः) A medicinal plant, (Conyza anthelmintica.)
15671: छैदिक m. (-कः) A ratan, a cane. E. छेद cutting, ठञ् aff.
15672: छो r. 4th cl. (छ्यति) To cut, to mow, to reap, &c.
15673: छोटिका f. (-का) Snapping the thumb and fore finger together. E. छुट to touch, वुद aff.
15674: छोटिन् m. (-टी) A fisherman. E. छो to cut, उटिन् affix, deriv. irr.
15675: छोरण n. (-णं) Abandoning, leaving. E. छुर to cut, affix ल्युट.
15676: छोलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A citron, a lime.
15677: छ्यु r. 1th cl. (छ्यवते) To go, to move or approach: see च्यु. ज
15678: ज The third letter of the second class of consonants, corresponding to the letter J in jet.
15679: ज mfn. (जः जा जं) 1 Speedy, swift. 2 Eaten. 3 Victorious, triumphant, conquering or a conqueror. m. (-जः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 Birth, production. 4 A parent, a progenitor. 5 Poison. 6 Enjoyment. 7 Light, lustre. 8 Speed. 9 An imp, a goblin. E. जन to bear or be born, जि to conquer, or other roots, and ड aff.
15680: जकुट m. (-टः) 1 The Malaya mountain. 2 A dog. n. (-टं) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
15681: जक्ष r. 1st cl. (जक्षति 3rd plu. जक्षति) 1 To eat. 2 To laugh. (इ) जक्षि (जंक्षते) 1 To give. 2 To go.
15682: जक्षण n. (-णं) Eating. E. जक्ष to eat, affix ल्युट्.
15683: जक्षि f. (-क्षिः) Eating. E. जक्ष to eat, कि aff.
15684: जक्षिवस् mfn. (-वान्-क्षुषी-वत्) Eating, who eats. E. जक्ष to eat, वसु aff.
15685: जक्ष्म m. (-क्ष्मः) Consumption, decline: see the next.
15686: जक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Consumption, phthisis. E. यक्ष to worship, and मनिन् affix; ज is substituted for the semivowel; also यक्ष्मन्, and with a final vowel जक्ष्म.
15687: जगच्चक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) The sun. E. जगत् the universe, and चक्षुस् the eye.
15688: जगत् mfn. (-गन्-गती-गत्) Moveable, loco-motive, transitory. nf, (-त्-ती) The world, the universe. m. (-त्) Air, wind. f. (-ती) 1 The earth. 2 People, mankind. 3 A sort of metre, a stanza of forty-eight syllables variously disposed so as to form thirty varieties. 4 A field of Jambu flowers.
