16358: जिह्वामूलीय m. (-यः) A character substituted for the Visarga, as हरिन्काम्य, and with a like sound. E. जिह्वामूल, and छ aff.
16359: जिह्वारद m. (-दः) A bird. E. जिह्वा, and रद a tooth; whose tooth, (i. e. beak,) is like a tongue.
16360: जिह्वालिह् m. (-लिट्) A dog. E. जिह्वा, and लिह् who licks or laps, from लिह with क्विप् aff.
16361: जिह्वास्वाद m. (-दः) Licking, lapping. E. जिह्वा the tongue, and आस्वाद eating.
16362: जिह्वाशत n. (-तं) A hundred tongues. E. जिह्वा, and शत a century.
16363: जिह्वोल्लेखन n. (-नं) Scraping the tongue. f. (-नी) A tongue-scraper, made of a thin piece of wood of the Mimusops Kauki or other trees. E. जिह्वा, and उल्लेखन scraping; also in the second sense, with कन् added, जिह्वोल्लेखनिका.
16364: जीन mf. (-नः-ना-नं) Old, aged. E. ज्या to become old, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
16365: जीमूत m. (-तः) 1 A cloud. 2 A mountain. 3 A grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 4 A name of INDRA. 5 A nourisher, a sustainer. 6 A plant: see घोषक. 7 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. जि to excel or surpass, Uṇādi affix तन्, and मूट् augment, or जी for जीव life, and मूत who urines.
16366: जीमूतकुट m. (-टः) A small hill near a mountain. E. जीमूत a mountain, and कुट a house.
16367: जीमूतवाहन m. (-नः) 1 INDRA. 2 The author of a celebrated work on inheritance. E. जीमूत a cloud, and वाहन vehicle.
16368: जीमूतवाहिन् m. (-ही) Smoke. E. जीमूत a cloud, and वह to bear, affix णिनि.
16369: जीर m. (-रः) 1 Cumin seed. 2 A sacrificial knife or sword, a scymitar. 3 A sort of panic seed: see अणु. E. जु to go, or grow quickly, रक् Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel changed.
16370: जीरक m. (-कः) Cumin seed. E. कन् added to the preceding.
16371: जीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Old, ancient. 2 Withered, decayed. 3 Digested. m. (-र्णः) 1 An old man. 2 Cumin seed. n. (-र्णं) Benjamin. E. जॄ to become old or decayed, affix क्त.
16372: जीर्णज्वर m. (-रः) Fever of some continuance and diminished intensity. E. जीर्ण, and ज्वर fever.
16373: जीर्णता f. (-ता) 1 Old age. 2 Infirmity, decay. E. जीर्ण, and तल् affix; also with त्व, जीर्णत्वं.
16374: जीर्णदारु m. (-रुः) A potherb, (Convolvulus argentaceus.) E. जीर्ण, and दारु wood.
16375: जीर्णपर्ण्ण m. (-र्णः) The Kadamba: see कदम्बक. n. (-र्णं) A withered leaf. E. जीर्ण old, withered, and पर्ण a leaf.
16376: जीर्णवज्र n. (-ज्रं) A gem, said to be a sort of diamond. E. जीर्ण decayed, वज्र diamond.
16377: जीर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Old, decayed. E. जॄ to grow old, क्तवतु aff.
16378: जीर्णवस्त्र n. (-स्रं) Old, worn or tattered raiment. E. जीर्ण old, and वस्त्र cloth or clothes.
16379: जीर्णवाटिका f. (-का) A ruined mansion. E. जीर्ण, and वाटिका a house.
16380: जीर्णव्रध्नक m. (-कः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. जीर्ण old, and व्रध्न a root, affix कन्.
16381: जीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 Old age, infirmity, decay. 2 Digestion. E. जॄ to become old, क्तिन् aff.
16382: जीर्णोद्यान n. (-नं) A neglected garden. E. जीर्ण, and उद्यान a garden.
16383: जीर्णोद्धार m. (-रः) Repairing, renewal, repairs. E. जीर्ण, and उद्धार lifting up.
16384: जीर्णोद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Repaired, renewed. E. जीर्ण, and उद्धृत lifted up.
16385: जीर्वि m. (-र्विः) 1 An axe. 2 A cart. 3 The body. E. जॄ to decay, Uṇādi affix क्विन्.
16386: जीव (ऋ) जीवृ r. 1st cl. (जीवति) To live. With आङ्, To use or enjoy, to get a living. With उप, To be dependant on for a living. With सं or प्र, To live agreeably.
16387: जीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Life, existence. mf. (-वः-वा) 1 Livelihood, profession, specific occupation. 2 A tree: see जीवन्ती. m. (-वः) 1 The sentient soul, the emanation of the deity, which is incorporated with the animal body, and gives it life, motion, and sensation; hence also called जीवात्मन्; it is opposed to that abstract state of the soul परमात्मन् in which by meditating upon its own divine nature and origin, the spirit is set at liberty from human feelings and passions. 2 A name of VṚHASPATI. 3 A name of the prince KARṆA. f. (-वा) 1 A bow string. 2 The earth. 3 The tinkling of metallic ornaments. 4 Orris root. 5 (In Geometry,) The chord of an arc. E. जीव to live, affix घञ् or क, and fem. affix टाप्.
16388: जीवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A servant, a slave, one who gets a livelihood by service. 2 A snake-catcher, one whose business is catching snakes, curing their bites, &c. 3 An usurer, or one who lives by lending money at high interest. 4 A mendicant or one who lives by begging. 5 One whose life is prolonged by blessings. m. (-कः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa:) see असन. 2 A medicinal plant, commonly called by the same name Jīvaka, and considered as one of the eight principal drugs, classed together under the name अष्टवर्ग. 3 An animal, any being endowed with life. E. जीव to live, affix ण्वुल् or वुन्.
16389: जीवग्राह m. (-हः) A prisoner, one taken alive. E. जीव, and ग्राह capture.
16390: जीवजीव m. (-वः) A kind of bird, supposed to be a sort of pheasant: see जीवञ्जीव.
16391: जीवञ्जीव m. (-बः) 1 A kind of bird, supposed to be a pheasant. 5 The Cakora or Greek partridge. 3 A kind of tree. E. जीव life, and जीव who lives, from जीव with खच् affix, long-lived.
16392: जीवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Living, alive. E. जीव to live, शतृ aff.
16393: जीवत्तोका f. (-का) A woman whose children are living. E. जीवत् living, and तोक offspring.
16394: जीवत्पति f. (-तिः) A wife whose husband is alive. E. जीवत् living, and पति a husband.
16395: जीवत्पितृक m. (-कः) A son whose father is alive. E. जीवत्, and पितृ a father, कन् added.
16396: जीवथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Virtuous, pious. 2 Long-lived. m. (-थः) Virtue, piety. 2 Life, existence. 3 A cloud. 4 A peacock. 5 A tortoise. E. जीव to live, अथ Uṇādi aff.
16397: जीवद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Life-giving, who or what gives life. m. (-दः) 1 A physician, a practitioner of medicine. 2 An enemy. E. जीव life, and द in the first sense, from दा to give, in the second, from दो to destroy, affix ड.
16398: जीवधन n. (-नं) Living property, live-stock, wealth in flocks and herds. E. जीव alive, and धन wealth.
16399: जीवन m. (-नः) 1 A plant, commonly Jiuti, (Odina wodier.) 2 A son. 3 A living being, an animal. f. (-ना or गी) A plant, commonly Jiyati: see जीवन्ती. f. (-नी) Jasmin. n. (-नं) 1 Life, existence. 2 Livelihood, profession. 3 Water. 4 Butter of new or one day-old milk. 5 Marrow. E. जीव to live, affix ल्यु or ल्युट्.
16400: जीवनक m. (-कः) Food, especially boiled rice. E. कन् added to the preceding.
16401: जीवनविडम्बन n. (-नं) Disappointment of all hopes, living in vain. E. जीवन, and विडम्वन frustrating.
16402: जीवनयोनि m. (-निः) Communication of vitality with body. E. जीवम, and योनि origin.
16403: जीवनहेतु m. (-तुः) End or object of life, the cause of living. E. जीवन, and हेतु cause.
16404: जीवनाघात n. (-तं) Poison. E. जीवन life, and आघात destroying.
16405: जीवनान्त m. (-न्तः) Death. E. जीवन, and अन्त end.
16406: जीवनावास m. (-सः) VARUṆA, regent of water. E. जीवन water, and आवास abode.
16407: जीवनीय n. (-यं) Water. f. (-या) Jiyati: see जीवन्ती. E. जीवन life, छ affix; being friendly or necessary to existence.
16408: जीवनोपाय m. (-यः) Livelihood, means of subsistence. E. जीवन and उपाय means.
16409: जीवनौषध n. (-धं) A drug to revive the dead. E. जीवन living, and औषध a medicament.
16410: जीवन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Living, existent. m. (-न्तः) 1 Life, existence. 2 A medicament, a drug. f. (-न्ती) 1 The name of a tree, commonly Jiyati, (Celtis orientalis.) 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची. 3 The Śami or Sāen tree, (Mimosa albida.) 4 A parasite plant. 5 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula, Rox.) E. जीव to live, affix झच्; fem. affix ङीप्; also with कन् added जीवन्तिका, &c.
16411: जीवन्तिक m. (-कः) A fowler, a bird-catcher: see जीवान्तक. f. (-का) 1 A parasite plant, (Epidendron tesseloides,) and other species. 3 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 A kind of potherb. E. कन् added to the preceding.
16412: जीवन्मुक्त m. (-क्तः) A man purified by knowledge of BRAHMA, and exonerated whilst living from future birth, and all ritual ceremonies. E. जीवत्, and मुक्त freed.
16413: जीवन्मुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Acquirement of spiritual knowledge, and consequent liberation from future birth, and ritual acts. E. जीवत्, and मुक्ति liberation.
16414: जीवपुत्रक m. (-कः) 1 A tree, commonly Ingua. 2 A different plant bearing seeds which are used in rosaries, commonly Jiyaputa, (Nageia putranjiva.)
16415: जीवबध m. (-धः) Destruction of living beings. E. जीव, and बध killing.
16416: जीवमन्दिर m. (-रः) The body. E. जीव life, and मन्दिर mansion.
16417: जीवभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Alive, endowed with life. E. जीव, and भूत become.
16418: जीवलोक n. (-कं) 1 The world, the habitation of living beings. 2 Mankind. E. जीव, and लोक world.
16419: जीवसाधन n. (-नं) Rice, grain. E. जीव, and साधन means.
16420: जीवसाफल्य n. (-ल्यं) Realisation of all one's wishes. E. जीव, and साफल्य fruitfulness.
16421: जीवसू f. (-सूः) The mother of living offspring. E. जीव living, and सू bringing forth.
16422: जीवस्थान n. (-नं) A joint, an articulation. E. जीव life, and स्थान place.
16423: जीवाजीवाधार m. (-रः) The material and visible world. E. जीव animate, and अजीव inanimate, आधार a support.
16424: जीवातु mn. (-तुः-तु) 1 A drug for reanimating the dead. 2 Boiled rice, food. 3 Life, existence. E. जीव life, आतु Uṇādi aff.
16425: जीवात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The vital principle or spirit; that spiritual essence which renders bodies susceptible of motion or sensation. E. जीव life, and आत्मन् soul or spirit.
16426: जीवाधार m. (-रः) The world. E. जीव an animal, and आधार support.
16427: जीवान्तक m. (-कः) 1 A fowler, a bird-catcher. 2 A destroyer of life, a slayer, a murderer. E. जीव a living being, and अन्तक a destroyer; also sometimes written जीवन्तक.
16428: जीवाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Hoping for life. f. (-शा) Hope of living. E. जीव, and आशा hope.
16429: जीविका f. (-का) 1 Livelihood, profession or occupation by which a subsistence is obtained. 2 A tree: see जीवन्ती. E. जीव to live, ण्वुल् and टाप् affixes: see जीवक.
16430: जीविकापन्न mf. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Having obtained subsistence. E. जीविका, and आपन्न obtained.
16431: जीविकाप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Having obtained as a livelihood. E. जीविका, and प्राप्त obtained.
16432: जीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Living, alive, existent. n. (-तं) Living, life, existence. E. जीव, and क्त aff.
16433: जीवितकाल n. (-लं) Period or duration of life, a life. E. जीवित existence, and काल time.
16434: जीवितज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) An artery, a vessel of the body. E. जीवित, and ज्ञा what knows.
16435: जीवितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be lived, to be kept alive. E. जीव, and तव्य aff.
16436: जीवितव्य m. (-यः) Casting away life. E. जीवित, and व्यय expense.
16437: जीवितसंशय m. (-यः) Fear of death. E. जीवित, and संशय doubt.
16438: जीवितहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Destroying life. E. जीवित, and हारिन् what takes away.
16439: जीविताशा f. (-शा) Love of life. E. जीवित, and आशा hope.
16440: जीवितेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Ruling life, master of being, (applicable to objects either of reverence or affection.) m. (-शः) 1 A name of YAMA, regent of death. 2 The sun. 3 The moon. 4 A lover, a husband. 5 Lord or master of existence. 6 A drug to revive the dead. E. जीवित life, and ईश lord, ruler.
16441: जीवोत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) Abandonment of life, voluntary death. E. जीव, and उत्सर्ग leaving.
16442: जीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Alive, living, animate, a living being. E. जीव, and इनि aff.
16443: जु r. 1st cl. (जवति) 1 To go or move. 2 To move quickly, to go rapidly. (ङ) जुङ् r. 1st cl. (जवते) To go or move.
16444: जुकुट m. (-टः) 1 The Malaya range of mountains. 2 A dog. n. (-टं) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
16445: जुग (इ) जिगि r. 1st cl. (जुंगति) 1 To except, to exclude. 2 To quit or abandon.
16446: जुगुप्सन n. (-नं) Censure, abuse, reproach, reviling. E. गुप to censure, affix ल्युट्, or with अङ् and टाप् affixes जुगुप्सा; the root is always inflected in this sense, in the desiderative form.
16447: जुगुप्सा f. (-प्सा) Censure, &c. see the preceding.
16448: जुगुप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reviled, blamed, censured, abused. E. गुप to censure, affix क्त.
16449: जुङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) E. जुगि to quit, affix घञ्, removing all blemishes; also with कन् added जुङ्गक m. (-कः).
16450: जुङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Outcaste, deserted, injured, abandoned. m. (-तः) A man of a degraded caste, a Caṇḍāla, &c. E. जुगि to abandon, affix क्त.
16451: जुटक nf. (-टकं-टिका) 1 The matted hair of ŚIVA or of ascetics. 2 Any knot or fillet of hair. E. जट to collect, affix वुन्, and उ or ऊ inserted: see जटा; also जूट, जूटक, &c.
16452: जुड r. 6th cl. (जुडति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To bind. 3 To join, as in making or mending. r. 10th cl. (जोडयति) 1 To send, to cast or throw, to direct. 2 To grind or pound.
16453: जुत (ऋ) जुतृ r. 1st cl. (जोतते) To shine, &c.
16454: जुन r. 6th cl. (जुनति) To go or move.
16455: जुर् f. (-जूः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Motion in general. E. ज्वर to make haste, affix क्विप्, and उठ् substituted for ब.
16456: जुल r. 10th cl. (जोलयति) To reduce to powder.
16457: जुर्व (इ) जुर्वी r. 1st cl. (जूर्वति) To hurt or kill.
16458: जुष r. 1st and 10th cls. (जुषति जोषयति) 1 To reason, to think, to conceive or imagine, to investigate or examine. 2 To injure, to hurt or kill. 3 To like. (ञि ई) ञि जुषी r. 6th cl. (जुषते) To please, to gratify, to give satisfaction or delight, to serve.
16459: जुष्कक m. (-कः) The water of boiled pulse, pease soup, porridge, &c. E. जुष to please or satisfy, क affix, and deriv. irr. see जूष.
16460: जुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Served, obliged, worshipped, gratified by service. n. (-ष्टं) The crumbs or remnants of a meal or its leavings. E. जुष to please, &c. affix क्त.
16461: जुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) To be served or worshipped. E. जुष to please, यत् aff.
16462: जुहुवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sacrificing, offering oblations. m. (-वान्) Fire. E. हु to sacrifice, क्तवतु aff.
16463: जुहुवान m. (-नः) 1 Fire. 2 A tree. 3 A hard hearted man.
16464: जुहू f. (-हूः) A wooden vessel, of the shape of a semicircle or crescent, used at sacrifices. E. हु to sacrifice, Uṇādi affix क्विप्, the root reiterated, and the final made long; also remaining short जुहु. f. (-हुः.)
16465: जुहूवत् m. (-वान्) Fire, or the deity AGNI. E. जुह्व a sacrificial vessel, and मतुप् possessing; being the medium of (burnt) offerings; also जुहुवत्.
16466: जुहूराण m. (-णः) 1 The moon. 2 Fire or its deity. 3 An officiating priest. E. हूर्च्छ to be crooked, to abandon, &c. Uṇādi affix आनच्; the root is reiterated, and the final छ rejected.
16467: जुह्वत् mfn. (-ह्वन्-ह्वती-ह्वत्) Sacrifice, offering oblations. E. हु to sacrifice, शतृ aff.
16468: जू f. (-जूः) 1 Æther, heaven. 2 A name of the goddess SARASVATĪ. 3 A female demon or goblin. 4 Speed, expedition, velocity. 5 Going, motion. E. जु to go swiftly, affix क्विप्, and the final lengthened.
16469: जूट m. (-टः) 1 The matted hair of ŚIVA. 2 The clotted hair of an ascetic. E. जट to collect, affix अच्, ऊ inserted: see जटा; also with कन् added जूटक. n. (-कं) And with a short vowel जुटक q. v; it is also used compounded with जटा in the same sense, as जटाजूट.
16470: जूति f. (-तिः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Going, proceeding, moving. E. जु to go swiftly, affix क्तिन्, deriv. irr.
16471: जूर (ई) जूरी r. 4th cl. (जूर्य्यते) 1 To hurt, to injure, to world or kill. 2 To be decayed, to decay or grow old.
16472: जूर्णाह्वय m. (-यः) A kind of grain, (Andropogon sorghum:) see देवधान्य.
16473: जूर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 Speed. 2 The body. 3 The sun. 4 BRAHMĀ. 5 Fever. E. ज्वर to be feverish, Uṇādi affix नि.
16474: जूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Fever, feverish or morbid heat. E. ज्वर to be feverish, क्तिन् aff.
16475: जूर्व्व (-ई) जूर्व्वी (जूर्व्वति) To hurt or kill.
16476: जूष r. 1st cl. (जूषति-ते) To kill or hurt.
16477: जूष n. (-षं) The water of boiled pulse, pease soup, porridge, &c. E. जुष to satisfy, affix क, and the radical vowel made long.
16478: जूषण n. (-णं) A plant, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. जष to hurt, affix ल्युट्.
16479: जृ r. 1st cl. (जरति) To make short or low.
16480: जृभ (ई) जृभी r. 1st cl. (जर्भते) or more commonly r. 1st cl. (इ) जृभि (जृम्भते) To gape, to yawn. r. 10th cl. (जृम्भयति) To fear, to dread.
16481: जृम्भ mfn. sub. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Gaping, yawning. 2 Expansion, stretching, expanding. 3 Swelling, a puffing or blowing up. 4 Blowing blossoming. E. जृभि to gape, affix घञ्.
16482: जृम्भक m. (-कः) A subordinate deity. 2 A yawner. E. जृभि, and वुन् aff.
16483: जृम्भण n. (-णं) 1 Gaping, yawning. 2 Blowing. E. जृभि to yawn, affix ल्युट्.
16484: जृम्भमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Yawning, gaping. 2 Opening, blowing. E. जृभि to open, शानच् aff.
16485: जृम्भावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Yawning, gaping. E. जृम्भा, and मतुप् aff.
16486: जृम्भिका f. (-का) Gaping, yawning. E. जृम्भि, and क्वुन् affix, fem. form.
16487: जृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opened, expanded. 2 Enlarged. 3 Done, exerted. 4 Opened, (as a flower,) blown. n. (-तं) 1 Gaping, yawning. 2 Swelling, expansion. 3 Bursting, opening. 4 Wish, active wish or search for. E. जृभि to gape, affix क्त.
16488: जृम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Who or what yawns or gapes. 2 Expanding, blossoming. f. (-नी) A kind of Mimosa, (M. octandra.) E. जृम्भ bursting, budding, and इनि aff.
16489: जॄ r. 1st cl. (जरति) 4th cl. (जोर्य्यते) 9th cl. (जृणाति) and 10th cl. (जारयति) To grow old, to be or become old or decayed.
16490: जेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be conquered or overcome, to be surpassed or excelled. E. जि to conquer, तव्य aff.
16491: जेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Victorious, triumphant. 2 Surpassing, excelling. m. (-ता) A victor, a conqueror. E. जि to conquer, तृच् aff.
16492: जेन्ताक m. (-कः) A dry hot bath, or heated chamber for inducing perspiration in rheumatism, &c.
16493: जेमन n. (-नं) 1 Food, victuals. 2 Eating. E. जमु to eat, affix ल्युट्.
16494: जेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Conquerable, fit or subject to be conquered. E. जि to conquer, affix यत्.
16495: जेष (ऋ) जेषृ r. 1st cl. (जेषते) To go or move.
16496: जेह (ऋ) जेहृ r. 1st cl. (जेहते) To resolve, to attempt resolutely, to endeavour diligently or perseveringly. 2 To go, to move.
16497: जै r. 1st cl. (जायति) To wane or decline.
16498: जैत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Victorious, triumphant. m. (-त्रः) A conqueror, a victor. f. (-त्री) A tree, (Aeschynomene sesban.) E. जि to conquer or excel, ष्ट्रन् aff.
16499: जैत्ररथ m. (-थः) A hero, a victor, a conqueror. E. जैत्र victorious, and रथ a car; whose chariot is triumphant.
16500: जैन m. (-नः) A Jaina, a follower of the principles of a Jina or teacher of heterodox notions, the chief of which are, the supremacy of certain religious pontiffs over the gods of the Hindus, a denial of the divine authority of the Vedas, and a disregard of the distinction of castes. E. जिन a Jina, and अण् aff.
16501: जैपाल m. (-लः) A plant, (Croton tiglium:) see जयपाल, the diphthong being considered as a substitute for the semivowel and vowels of the first members of the compound; it is most probably a corruption borrowed from the dialects in which such a substitution is common.
16502: जैमिनि m. (-निः) The name of a celebrated saint and philosopher, the pupil of VYĀSA, and founder of the Uttara Mīmāṃsā school.
16503: जैवातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Long-lived. 2 Thin, spare. m. (-कः) 1 The moon. 2 A drug, a medicament. 3 Camphor. 4 A son. E. जीव life, आतृकन् Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel changed.
16504: जैष्णव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to a conqueror, to ARJUNA, &c. E. जिष्णु as above, and अण् aff.
16505: जैह्म्य n. (-ह्म्यं) Crookedness, moral or physical. E. जिह्म crooked, ष्यञ् aff.
16506: जोङ्गक n. (-कं) Aloe wood or Agallochum. E. जुगि to remove, ण्वुल् affix; dissipating bad smells.
16507: जोङ्गट m. (-टः) Longing for, wishing earnestly or eagerly. E. जुगि to abandon, (all objects save that desired,) and अटन् aff.
16508: जोटिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A devotee, an ascetic, who subjects himself to the severest penances. E. जूट the braided hair of ŚIVA, ग who goes, from गम to go, the form is irregular.
16509: जोन्ताला f. (-ला) A kind of grain: see देवधान्य.
16510: जोष n. (-षं) Happiness, felicity, pleasure, enjoyment, satisfaction. f. (-षा) A woman: see योषा; also जोषित्, जोषिता, &c. E. जुष to delight, affix घञ्, fem. affix टाप्.
16511: जोषम् ind. 1 Silently. 2 In happiness, delightedly at ease, &c. 3 Well, excellently. 4 Excessively, beyond bounds. E. जुष to please or be pleased, affix अम्.
16512: जोषिका f. (-का) A bud, a germ. E. जुष to please, affix वुन्, and fem. form; some copies have more accurately perhaps कोषिका.
16513: जोषित् f. (-षित्) A woman. E. जुष to delight, affix इति; also योषित्, जोषिता, &c.
16514: जोषिता f. (-ता) A woman. E. जुष to please, affix क्त; also योषित, योषिता, &c.
16515: ज्ञ A compound letter, considered to be composed of ज and ज्ञ; it is usually expressed by jn or gn, but its peculiar nasal sound is not well conveyed by any combination of the Roman alphabet.
16516: ज्ञ mfn. (ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Who or what knows. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A wise and learned man; it especially applies to one possessed of sacred learning, and religious knowledge. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 The moon. 4 Buddha, first of the line of the moon, and regent of the planet MERCURY. 5 The planet MARS or its regent. E. ज्ञा to know, to possess knowledge, affix क.
16517: ज्ञप r. 10th cl. (ज्ञापयति) 1 To know. 2 To cause to be known: see ज्ञा. 3 To whet or sharpen. 4 To beat. 5 To please.
16518: ज्ञपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught, expounded, made known. E. ज्ञप to make known, affix क्त, इट् optionally inserted, otherwise ज्ञप्त.
16519: ज्ञप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Made known: see the preceding.
16520: ज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Understanding, comprehension, the exercise of the intellectual faculty. E. ज्ञप to make known, affix क्तिन्, deriv. irr.
16521: ज्ञा r. 9th cl. (जानाति जानीते) To know, to understand. With अनु prefixed, 1 To assent or conform to. 2 To acknowledge. With अप, To conceal. With अव, To disrespect, to despise. With उप, To deny knowledge of any thing. With परि, To ascertain. With प्र, To know well. With प्रति or सम्, To assent, to admit, to agree, to promise. With प्रति and अभि, To recognise. With वि, To discriminate, to know. With सम्, To recollect or possess the power of knowing. (In combination, it usually takes the deponent form, as अनुजानीते, अपजानीते, &c.) r. 10th cl. (ज्ञापयति) To command, to direct; आङ् is usually prefixed in this sense. r. 1st cl. but occurring in the form of the causal, (ज्ञपयति) 1 To slay. 2 To gratify or please. 3 To exhibit. 4 To sharpen. 5 To praise. In these senses the root is, in general, combined with a prefix.
16522: ज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, comprehended, understood fully. E. ज्ञा to know, affix क्त.
16523: ज्ञातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be known or understood. E. ज्ञा, and तव्य aff.
16524: ज्ञातसिद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) A man completely versed in any science or Śāstra. E. ज्ञात what is known, and सिद्धान्त completion.
16525: ज्ञातान्वय m. (-यः) A name of Varddhamāna, the last Jina or Jaina pontiff. E. ज्ञात known, and अन्वय lineage.
16526: ज्ञाति m. (-तिः) 1 A father. 2 A kinsman in general. 3 A distant kinsman, one who does not participate in the oblations of food or water offered to deceased ancestors. E. ज्ञा to know, affix क्तिन्; who is known, an acquaintance.
16527: ज्ञातिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Duty of kindred. E. ज्ञाति, and कम्म act; also ज्ञातिकार्य्य.
16528: ज्ञातित्व n. (-त्वं) Relationship, kin. E. त्व added to ज्ञाति.
16529: ज्ञातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Knowing, wise, intelligent, who or what knows. E. ज्ञा to know, तृच् active aff.
16530: ज्ञातेय n. (-यं) Relationship, affinity. E. ज्ञाति a kinsman, and ढक् aff.
16531: ज्ञात्वा ind. Having known. E. ज्ञा to know, क्त्वाच् aff.
16532: ज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 Knowledge in general. 2 Knowledge of a specific and religious kind, that which is derived from meditation, and the study of philosophy, which teaches man the divine nature and origin of his immaterial part, with the unreality of corporal enjoyments or worldly forms, and which, separating him during life from terrestrial objects, secures him, after death, a final emancipation from existence, and reunion with the universal spirit. E. ज्ञा to know, aff. ल्युट्.
16533: ज्ञानगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Attainable by knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and गम्य attainable.
16534: ज्ञानचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) Intellect, intellectual vision. E. ज्ञान, and चक्षुस् the eye.
16535: ज्ञानतपस् n. (-पः) Cultivation of sacred knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and तपस् religious austerity.
16536: ज्ञानतस् ind. By or through knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and तसिल् aff.
16537: ज्ञानदर्पण m. (-णः) One of the Jaina saints. E. ज्ञान true knowledge, and दर्पण a mirror.
16538: ज्ञानदीप m. (-पः) Knowledge, the lamp of knowledge. E. ज्ञान, दीप a lamp.
16539: ज्ञाननिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Cultivating spiritual knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and निष्ठ engaged in.
16540: ज्ञानपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Versed in spiritual wisdom. E. ज्ञान, and पर attentive to.
16541: ज्ञानपूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Preceded by the acquirement of divine wisdom. E. ज्ञान, and पूर्व्व prior.
16542: ज्ञानमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Consisting of knowledge, made up of it. E. ज्ञान, and मयट् aff.
16543: ज्ञानमुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Having the impress of wisdom, wise, making wise. E. ज्ञान, and मुद्रा a seal.
16544: ज्ञानमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Founded on spiritual knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and मूल root.
16545: ज्ञानलक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) Indication, sign, means of knowing or inferring. 2 (In Logic,) Sign or proof of knowledge, or subsequent derived from antecedent knowledge. E. ज्ञान, and लक्षण indication.
16546: ज्ञानवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wise, especially in spiritual things. E. ज्ञान, and मतुप् aff.
16547: ज्ञानविज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 Sacred and profane knowledge. 2 The Vedas and their subordinate parts, as medicine, war, &c. E. ज्ञान, and विज्ञान miscellaneous knowledge.
16548: ज्ञानानुत्पाद m. (-दः) Folly, ignorance. E. ज्ञान, and अनुत्पाद nonproduction.
16549: ज्ञानावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Occupied by wisdom. E. ज्ञान, and अवस्थित placed.
16550: ज्ञानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) 1 Wise, intelligent. 2 Knowing, who or what knows. m. (-नी) 1 An astrologer, a fortuneteller, a man prescient of future events. 2 A sage, one possessing religious wisdom or Jñāna (ज्ञान) as above. E. ज्ञान knowledge, affix इनि.
16551: ज्ञानेन्द्रिय m. (-यं) An organ of perception or consciousness, the skin, tongue, eye, ear and intellect. E. ज्ञान, and इन्द्रिय an organ.
16552: ज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Making or causing to know. m. (-कः) An instructor. 2 A commander, a master. E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, वुन् aff.
16553: ज्ञापन n. (-नं) Making known, apprising, informing. E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
16554: ज्ञाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Making known, informing. E. ज्ञा to know, causal form, क्तिन् aff.
16555: ज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be known, what may be or ought to be known. E. ज्ञा, and यत् aff.
16556: ज्यका f. (-का) The chord of an arc. E. ज्या the same, कन् added.
16557: ज्या r. 9th cl. (जिनाति) To decay, to be or become old.
16558: ज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 A mother. 2 The earth. 3 A bowstring. 4 The chord of an arc. E. ज्या to become old, to decay, affixes अङ्, and टाप्.
16559: ज्याघोष m. (-षः) Twang of a bow. E. ज्या, and घोष sound.
16560: ज्यानि f. (-निः) 1 Old age, decay, infirmity. 2 Abandoning, quitting, leaving. 3 A river, a stream. E. ज्या to decay, &c. Uṇādi aff. नि.
16561: ज्यायस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very old. 2 Very excellent, best. 3 Elder, elder born. 4 In law, one independent and answerable for his own conduct. E. ज्या to be old, इयसुन् affix.
16562: ज्यु r. 1st cl. (ज्यवते) To go or approach.
16563: ज्युत r. 1st cl. (ऋ) ज्युतृ (ज्योतते;) also (इर) ज्युतिर r. 1st cl. (ज्योतति) To shine. see द्युत.
16564: ज्येष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Best, most excellent, pre-eminent. 2 Very old, oldest. 3 Elder, elder born. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 One of the asterisms considered as lunar mansions; the eighteenth, comprising three stars, of which one is a Scorpionis, figured by a ring or earring. 2 The middle finger. 3 Misfortune, personified as a goddess. 4 The Ganges, (-ष्ठा or ष्ठी) A small house lizard. m. (-ष्ठः) The month Jyaiṣṭha or Jeyte, (May-June.) n. (-ष्ठं) Age, oldness. E. ज्या to decay, to grow infirm or old, affix इष्ठन्, fem. affixes. टाप् and ङीष्.
16565: ज्येष्ठता f. (-ता) 1 Seniority. 2 Superiority. E. ज्येष्ठ, and तल् affix; also ज्येष्ठत्वं.
16566: ज्येष्ठतात m. (-तः) A father's elder brother. E. ज्येष्ठ elder born, and तात a father; the usual order of composition is here irregularly inverted.
16567: ज्येष्ठभार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) 1 An elder brother's wife. 2 The elder or chief wife. E. ज्येष्ठ, and भार्य्या a wife.
16568: ज्येष्ठवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A Brahman. E. ज्येष्ठ elder born or best, and वर्ण tribe.
16569: ज्येष्ठवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The duties of age or seniority. E. ज्येष्ठ, and वृत्ति practice.
16570: ज्येष्ठावाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be obtained by virtue or seniority, &c. E. ज्येष्ठ, and आवाप्य obtainable.
16571: ज्येष्ठश्वश्रू f. (-श्रूः) A wife's elder sister. E. ज्येष्ठ elder, श्वश्रू motherin-law.
16572: ज्येष्ठसामन् n. (-म) 1 A portion of the Sāma Veda. 2 A religious rite of which its perusal is a part.
16573: ज्येष्ठांश m. (-शः) 1 The elder brother's share. 2 The best share. E. ज्येष्ठ, and अंश a share.
16574: ज्येष्ठामूलीय m. (-यः) The month Jyeṣṭha. E. ज्येष्ठा the constellation, (as above,) मूल root, origin, and छ aff.
16575: ज्येष्ठाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) The scum of boiled rice, or water in which grain has been washed. E. ज्येष्ठ, and अम्बु water.
16576: ज्येष्ठाश्रम m. (-मः) 1 The order of the householder. 2 A householder. E. ज्येष्ठ, and आश्रम order.
16577: ज्येष्ठाश्रमिन् m. (-मी) A householder, a man of the second order. E. ज्येष्ठ best, आश्रम order, इनि aff.
16578: ज्यैष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The month Jyaiṣṭha or Jyeṣṭha or Jeyte, (MayJune.) f. (-ष्ठी) 1 The day of full moon in Jyeṣṭha. 2 A house lizard. E. ज्यैष्ठा the mansion or asterism which the moon is in this month, and अण् aff.
16579: ज्यैष्ठसामन् m. (-मा) A Brahman versed in that portion of the Sāma Veda called Jyeṣṭha Sāma. E. ज्येष्ठसामन् as above, aff. अण्.
16580: ज्यैष्ठिनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Born of the elder or principal wife. E. ज्यैष्ठा, and ढक् affix, इनङ् inserted.
16581: ज्यैष्ठ्य n. (-ष्ठ्यं) Seniority, age. E. ज्यैष्ट, and यञ् aff.
16582: ज्यो r. 1st cl. (ज्यवते) 1 To advise or instruct. 2 To order. 3 To observe a vow or any religious obligation.
16583: ज्योतिःशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The science of Astronomy. E. ज्योतिस्, and शास्त्र a scripture.
16584: ज्योतिरिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A fire fly. E. ज्योतिस् light, इगि to go, affix क; also with युच् affix, ज्योतिरिङ्गण n. (-णं).
16585: ज्योतिर्गण m. (-णः) The heavenly bodies collectively. E. ज्योतिम् a planet, and गण a class.
16586: ज्योतिर्विद् m. (-त्) An astrologer, an arithmetician. E. ज्योतिस्, and विद् who knows.
16587: ज्योतिर्विद्या f. (-द्या) The science of computation, from arithmetic to astronomy and astrology. E. ज्योतिस्, and विद्या science.
16588: ज्योतिर्वीज n. (-जं) A fire fly. E. ज्योतिस् light, and वीज seed.
16589: ज्योतिश्चक्र n. (-क्रं) 1 The zodiac. 2 The lunar mansion. E. ज्योतिस् planet, and चक्र a sphere.
16590: ज्योतिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Astrological, astronomical, relating to the heavenly bodies. mf. (-षः-षी) An astrologer. n. (-षं) Mathematical, astronomical, and astrological science, astronomy, astrology. f. (-षी) A star, a planet, an asterism. E. ज्योतिस् light, especially of the heavenly bodies, affix अण्, fem. ङीष्
16591: ज्योतिषिक m. (-कः) An astrologer: see ज्यौतिषिक.
16592: ज्योतिष्क m. (-ष्कः) 1 A planetary or heavenly body; the generic term for the sun, the moon, a planet, an asterism, a star: the word in the m. plu. (-ष्काः) implies all these five. 2 A tree, the wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition: see गणिकारिका. f. (-का) Heart-pea: see ज्योतिष्मती. E. ज्योतिस् light, and क what makes, from कृ, with ड aff.
16593: ज्योतिष्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Blazing, radiant, like flame or fire. E. ज्योतिस्, and कल्प affix, implying resemblance.
16594: ज्योतिष्टोम n. (-मं) A particular sacrifice at which sixteen officiating priests are required. E. ज्योतिस् light, and स्तोम a sacrifice.
16595: ज्योतिष्मत् m. (-मान्) The sun. f. (-मती) Heart-pea, (Halicacabum cardiospermum.) E. ज्योतिस् light or splendor, and मतुप् poss. aff.
16596: ज्योतिस् n. (-तिः) 1 Light. 2 A star. 3 The pupil of the eye. m. (-तिः) 1 The sun. 2 AGNI or fire. E. द्युत् to shine, to be or give light, इसिन् Uṇādi affix, and ज substituted for the radical initial.
16597: ज्योतिस्सात् ind. In flame or fire. E. ज्योतिस्, and साति aff.
16598: ज्योतीरथ m. (-थः) The pole star, or in mythology DHRUVA, the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA. E. ज्योतिस् a star, and रथ a vehicle.
16599: ज्योत्स्ना f. (-त्स्ना) 1 Moonlight. 2 A moonlight night. 3 A small cucumber: see ज्योत्स्नी. E. ज्योतिस् light, त affix, and the penultimate rejected deriv. irr. fem. affix टाप्; also with ङिप्, ज्योत्स्नी q. v.
16600: ज्योत्स्नाप्रिय m. (-यः) The Cakora or Greek partridge. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, and प्रिय fond of; this bird is said to feed upon the moonbeams.
16601: ज्योत्स्नावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The tripod or tree of a lampstand, a candlestick. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, (put for lamp-light,) and वृक्ष a tree.
16602: ज्योत्स्नी f. (-त्स्नी) 1 A moonlight night. 2 A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes diæca;) it is also applied to Luffa acutangula, &c. 3 A kind of perfume: see रेणुका. E. see ज्योत्स्ना.
16603: ज्यौतिषिक m. (-कः) An astrologer. E. ज्योतिस् a star, affix टक्; also the vowel being unchanged optionally, ज्योतिषिक.
16604: ज्यौत्स्न mfn. (-त्स्नः -त्स्नी -त्स्नं) Light, especially with moonlight, &c. E. ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, अण् affix: see ज्यौत्स्नी and ज्यौत्स्निका.
16605: ज्यौत्स्निका f. (-का) A moonlight. E. ज्योत्स्नी and कन्.
16606: ज्यौत्स्नी f. (-त्स्नी) A moonlight night, or a night on which the moon is full. 2 A kind of cucumber: see ज्यौत्स्ना. E. ज्योत्ली as above, and अण् pleonastic aff.
16607: ज्रि r. 1st cl. (ज्रियति) 1 To conquer, to reduce. 2 To be conquered or reduced.
16608: ज्री r. 1st cl. (ज्रिणाति) r. 1st and 10th cls. (ज्रयति-ज्राययति) To grow old, to be or become old or decayed.
16609: ज्वर r. 1st cl. (ज्वरति) To be diseased, to be feverish, &c.
16610: ज्वर m. (-रः) Fever, intermitting or continued. E. ज्वर to be feverish, affix अच्.
16611: ज्वरघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Anti-febrile, febrifuge. f. (-घ्नी) 1 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 2 A potherb, (Chenopocium album.) E. ज्वर, and घ्न what destroys.
16612: ज्वरनाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Febrifuge. E. ज्वर, and नाशक what destroys.
16613: ज्वरहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Febrifuge. E. ज्वर, and हन्तृ what destroys; ज्वरहन् (-च्चा).
16614: ज्वराग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Feverish heat, or the hot paroxysm of fever. E. ज्वर fever, and अग्नि fire.
16615: ज्वरान्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Febrifuge. m. (-कः) 1 A kind of Nimb from Nepal. 2 Cassia fistula. E. ज्वर, and अन्तक what removes.
16616: ज्वरापहा f. (-हा) A plant, (Medicago esculenta.) E. ज्वर fever, अपहा removing.
16617: ज्वरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Febrile, feverish, affected with fever. E. ज्वर to be feverish, क्त aff.
16618: ज्वरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Febrile, feverish, fevered. E. ज्वर, and इनि.
16619: ज्वल r. 1st cl. (ज्वलति,) or with a prefix, r. 10th cl. (प्रज्वलयति) To shine, to blaze, to flame.
16620: ज्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Blazing, shining. m. (-लः) Flame, blaze, light. E. ज्वल, to blaze, affix अच्; also ज्वाल.
16621: ज्वलका f. (-का) Flame. E. ज्वल to blaze, affix वुन्.
16622: ज्वलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Burning, blazing. 2 Shining, radiant, brilliant. E. ज्वल to burn, शतृ aff.
16623: ज्वलन n. (-नं) 1 Burning, blazing. 2 The fire. m. (-नः) AGNI, or fire. E. ज्वल to blaze, affix ल्युट्.
16624: ज्वलनाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) The sun-stone. E. ज्वलन, and अश्मन् a stone.
16625: ज्वलन्मणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Blazing with jewels. m. (-णिः) A brilliant gem. E. ज्वलत्, and मणि a jewel.
16626: ज्वलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Burning, blazing. 2 Radiant. E. ज्वल to burn, r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.
16627: ज्वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Burnt. 2 Blazing, flaming. E. ज्वल to flame, affix क्त.
16628: ज्वलितनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fiery-eyed, looking angrily or fiercely. E. ज्वलित, and नयन the eye; also ज्वलितचक्षुस्, ज्वलितनेत्र, &c.
16629: ज्वलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Burning, flaming. 2 Shining. E. ज्वल, and इनि aff.
16630: ज्वाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Burning, blazing. mf. (-लः-ला) Flame, blaze. f. (-ला) Burnt rice. E. ज्वल to blaze, affix अण्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.
16631: ज्वालाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Flame. E. ज्वाल, and अग्नि fire.
16632: ज्वालाजिहू m. (-ह्वः) AGNI, or fire. E. जाला, and जिह्वा a tongue; whose tongue is flame.
16633: ज्वालामुखी f. (-खी) A place where subterraneous fires break forth; an object of veneration to the Hindus: a celebrated Jvālāmukhī exists in Lahore, to which pilgrimages are made; the soil abounding with carburetted hydrogen, which takes fire upon coming in contact with the external air; otherwise vents being made, a light is applied to the orifice, and flame being kindled, is fed by the stream of gas that escapes. The tongue of PĀRVATĪ is said to have fallen at this place. E. ज्वाला flame, and मुख chief, principal, fem. affix ङीष्.
16634: ज्वालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Flaming, blazing. E. ज्वाला, and इनि aff. झ
16635: झ The ninth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet; the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding in power to Jh.
16636: झ mfn. (झः झा झं) 1 Asleep, sleeping. 2 Lost, destroyed. m. (झः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI, preceptor of the gods. 2 A name of the chief of the Daityas or demons. 3 Sound, or a sort of sound like the splashing of water, or the clashing of cymbals, jangling, clanging, &c. 4 High wind. 5 A stray, a thing lost or mislaid. 6 Playing a tune, beating time. f. (झा) The descent of a cascade, a water fall. E. झट to collect, affix ड.
16637: झङ्कार m. (-रः) A low inarticulate sound, as the buzzing of bees, &c. E. झं, and कार a making.
16638: झञ्झन n. (-नं) An indistinct noise, like the jangling of metal ornaments, a ringing, a rattling, &c.
16639: झञ्झा f. (-ञ्झा) 1 Wind, wind and rain, a hurricane, a gale. 2 A sharp clanging sound, jangling. 3 Raining in large drops. 4 A stray, any thing lost.
16640: झञ्झानिल m. (-लः) Wind with rain, a high wind in the rainy season, a typhoon or the sort of tempest frequent during the south-west monsoon. E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and अनिल wind; also झञ्झामरुत्, &c.
16641: झञ्भ्कावात m. (-तः) Wind with rain, a storm, a squall. E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and वात wind.
16642: झट r. 1st cl. (झटति) To clot, to be entangled, (as hair:) see जट.
16643: झटा f. (-टा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. झट to be entangled, affix अच्.
16644: झटि m. (-टिः) A small tree, a shrub, a bush. E. झट to be entangled, इ Uṇādi aff.
16645: झटिति ind. Quickly, speedily, instantly. E. झटि entangling, confusing, affix क्तिच्; also जटिति.
16646: झनत्कार m. (-रः) The clanging of metallic ornaments, &c. E. झनत् imitative sound, &c. कार making.
16647: झम (उ) झमु r. 1st cl. (झमति) To eat: see जमु, &c.
16648: झम्प mf. (-म्पः-म्पा) Jumping, springing, plunging. E. झं imitative sound, and पत to fall, affix ड.
16649: झम्पाक m. (-कः) A monkey or ape. E. झम्प, and अक to go.
16650: झम्पारु m. (-रुः) A monkey, an ape. E. झम्प plunging, and ऋ to go, उण् aff.
16651: झम्पाशिन् m. (-शी) A kingfisher. E. झम्प plunging, and अश to eat, affix णिनि.
16652: झम्पिन् m. (-म्पी) A monkey, an ape. E. झम्प springing, इनि aff.
16653: झर m. (-रः) f. (-रा or -रिः-री) A cascade, a water-fall. f. (-री) A river. E. झॄ to waste or decay, affix अप्, fem. affix टाप्, इन् or ङीष्; also निर्झर.
16654: झर्च r. 6th cl. (झर्चति) 1 To say. 2 To blame; to abuse or menace; also झर्छ, झर्ज, &c.
16655: झर्छ r. 6th cl. (झर्छति) 1 To say. 2 To blame, to abuse or menace; also झर्च.
16656: झर्ज r. 6th cl. (झर्जति) 1 To say, to speak. 2 To censure, to blame.
16657: झर्झ r. 1st and 10th cls. (झर्झति झर्झयति) 1 To speak or say. 2 To censure or reprove. r. 1st cl. (झर्झति) To kill or hurt.
16658: झर्झर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of drum. m. (-रः) 1 The Kali yug, the present Yug or age of the world. 2 The name of a river. f. (-रा) A whore. n. (-रं) A sound as of splashing or dropping. E. झर्झ an imitative sound like that of water splashing, &c. and र what makes, from रा with ड affix, or झर्झ to censure, and अरन् Uṇādi aff.
16659: झर्झरक m. (-कः) The Kali yug. E. कन् added to the preceding.
16660: झर्झरीक m. (-कः) 1 The body. 2 A country. 3 A picture. E. झर्झ to injure or destroy, ईकन् affix, and र inserted.
16661: झलञ्झला f. (-ला) The flapping of an elephant's ears, of loose breasts, &c. the word is considered as merely imitative of the noise made.
16662: झलरी f. (-री) 1 A sort of drum. 2 A curl. E. झल imitative sound, र from रा to get or make, affix ड and ङीप्; also झल्लरी and झल्ली.
16663: झला f. (-ला) 1 A daughter. 2 Sunshine, splendour, brilliant or glistering light. 3 A cricket; also झाला.
16665: झल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A prize fighter, a cudgel player, a man of a tribe following such a profession; one of the degraded classes, being sprung from the outcaste Kṣatriya. E. जल to surround or embrace, ल added, and ज changed to झ.
16666: झल्लक n. (-कं) Cymbals. E. झल्ल imitative sound, a clash, and क what emits, from कै to sound, affix ड.
16667: झल्लकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon. E. झल्ल imitative sound, and कण्ठ a throat.
16668: झल्लरी f. (-री) 1 A sort of drum. 2 A curl, a lock of hair: see झलरी. 3 A ball, &c. of perfumed substances used for cleaning the hair. 4 Moisture. 5 Purity.
16669: झल्लिका f. (-का) 1 Light, splendour, lustre. 2 A rag or cloth used for applying colour or perfumes. 3 Dirt brought off the body by rubbing it with perfumes.
16670: झल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A kind of drum: see झलरी.
16671: झल्लोल m. (-लः) A ball or protuberance at the lower end of a spindle.
16672: झष r. 1st cl. (-झषति) To kill or hurt. 2 To take. 3 To put on, to wear.
16673: झष m. (-षः) 1 A fish. 2 The sign Pisces. 3 Heat, warmth. 4 A forest, a thicket. f. (-षा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) n. (-षं) Waste land. E. झष to injure, affix अच्.
16674: झषकेतन m. (-नः) A name of KANDARPA. E. झष a fish, and केतन a banner, who bears a fish on his banner.
16675: झषाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A name of ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMA. E. झष a fish, and अङ्क a mark or symbol.
16676: झषाशन m. (-नः) The gangetic porpoise. E. झष fish, and अशन food.
16677: झषोदरी f. (-री) A proper name, the mother of the poet VYĀSA. E. झष a fish, and उदर the belly: born from the belly of a fish.
16678: झांकृत n. (-तं) A tinkling ornament worn on the toes or the feet. E. झां a jangling or jingling, and कृत made (by which.)
16679: झाट m. (-टः) 1 An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creepers. 2 A wood, a thicket. 3 Cleaning sores or wounds. f. (-टा-टी) 1 Jasmine. 3 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झाट n. (-टं) A wood, a thicket. E. झट to be entangled, affix घञ्.
16680: झाटल m. (-लः) A kind of flower: see घण्टापाटलि. E. झाट a thicket. or bower, ला to make, affix ड.
16683: झामक n. (-कं) A burnt or vitrified brick. E. झम to eat, affix ण्वुल, being fed upon by fire.
16684: झामर m. (-रः) A small whetstone, used chiefly by housewives for sharpening their spindles, needles, &c. E. झाम eating, wearing away, from झम to eat, affix घञ्, and र what gets, from रा with ड aff.
16685: झार्झर mf. (-रः-री) A tabor player, a drummer. E. झर्झर a cymbal, affix अण्; also with ठक् affix झार्झरिक.
16686: झालरी f. (-री) A kind of drum or tabor. E. झलरी the same, अण् pleonastic, aff.
16688: झालि f. (-लिः) A sort of sour or unripe mangoes, fried with salt, mustard and asafœtida.
16689: झावु m. (-वुः) A tree, (Tamarix Indica;) also with कन् added झावुक m. (-कः) and with a long final vowel झावू. m. (-वूः) the words are considered as irregular or foreign.
16690: झिङ्गाक m. (-कः) A sort of cucumber, (Luffa acutangula.)
16691: झिङ्गिनी f. (-नी) 1 A torch, a firebrand. 2 A sort of cucumber, (Luffa acutangula.)
16692: झिज्जी f. (-ज्जी) A cricket: see झिल्ली.
16693: झिञ्जिम m. (-मः) A forest on fire.
16694: झिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A shrub, (Barleria cristata.) E. झि imitative sound, रट to utter, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
16695: झिरी f. (-री) A cricket. E. झि imitative of the cricket's chirp, रा to make, affixes ड and ङीष्; also झिल्ली; also झिरिका, कन् being added; also इ pen. being made long झिरीका, or changed to उ, झिरुका; the first vowel also being lengthened झीरिका, and झीरुका, &c.
16696: झिरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see the last.
16697: झिल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) 1 Cymbals. 2 A cricket. 3 Membrane: see झिल्ली.
16698: झिल्लिका f. (-का) 1 A cricket. 2 The light of sunshine, strong light, splendour. 3 Dirt taken off the body in rubbing it with perfumes. 4 A cloth or rag used for applying colour, unguents, &c. 5 A cricket's cry. 6 Membrane, thin skin, parchment. E. झिल्ल for चिल्ल imitative sound, expressing the cricket's chirp, and ङीष् being added झिल्ली, and कन् again added झिल्लिका; also with the penultimate long झिल्लीका.
16699: झिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 A cricket. 2 Sunshine, light, lustre. 3 The wick of a lamp. 4 A cloth or rag for applying unguents, colour, &c. 5 A musical instrument, cymbals. 6 Membrane. E. see the preceding.
16700: झिल्लीकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon. E. झिल्ली a cricket, and कण्ठ the throat; chirping as it were in the throat.
16701: झीरिका f. (-का) A cricket: see झिरी.
16702: झीरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see झिरी.
16703: झु r. 1st cl. (झवते) To go or move.
16704: झुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A shrub, a bush. E. झट to be entangled, affix अच्, नुम् augment, and the vowel changed to उ.
16705: झूणि f. (-णिः) 1 A kind of betel nut. 2 Heavenly annunciation of misfortunes.
16706: झूमेरि f. (-रिः) One of the Rāgiṇīs, or modes of music personified.
16707: झूष r. 1st cl. (झूषति) To hurt or kill.
16708: झॄ r. 9th cl. (भृणाति) (ष) झॄष् r. 1st cl. (झीर्य्यति) To grow old, to become infirm with age, &c. to decay.
16709: झोड m. (-डः) The betel nut tree.
16710: झ्यु r. 1st cl. (झ्यवते) To go or move. ञ
16711: ञ The nasal attached to the class of palatal letters, having something like the sound of N in the French word Singe, and expressed by that letter accented N.
16712: ञ m. (ञः) 1 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of Venus. 2 An ox. 3 A heretic, an apostate. 4 Singing. 5 Jingling or inarticulate sound. ट
16713: ट The 11th consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and first of the 3rd class or cerebrals. It corresponds in sound to the letter T pronounced far back in the mouth, or as in true, and is expressed in the roman character by the accented letter T.
16714: ट m. (-टः) 1 Sound, or a particular sound, like the twang of a bow strong. 2 A dwarf. 3 A quarter, a fourth. n. (-टं) A hollowed cocoanut. f. (टा) 1 The earth. 2 An oath, confirming an assertion by ordeal, &c. E. टक to bind, &c. affix ड.
16715: टक (इ) टकि r. 1st and 10th cls. (टङ्कति टङ्कयति) To bind, to tie.
16717: टगर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Squint-eyed. m. (-रः) 1 Borax. 2 Wanton play or sport. 3 Wandering of the mind, confusion, perplexity. 4 An object of sense.
16718: टङ्क mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं) 1 A kind of elephant or wood apple. नीलकपित्थ. 2 Borax. 3 A spade or hoe. m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A hatchet or stone cutter's chisel. 2 A sword, a scimitar, a sacrificial hatchet or knife. 3 A scabbard, a sword-sheath. 4 Anger, wrath. 5 A weight (of silver) equal to four māṣas. 6 A coin. 7 Pride, arrogance. 8 A cleft, a chasm. 9 A peak. f. (-ङ्गा) 1 The leg. 2 The edge or side of a mountain. E. टकि to bind, affix अच्; or ट imitative, कै to emit sound, affix ड, and नुम् augment.
16719: टङ्कक m. (-कः) A stamped coin, especially of silver. E. कन् added to टङ्क a weight of silver.
16720: टङ्ककपति m. (-तिः) The master of a mint or superintendent of the silver coin. E. टङ्कक, and पति master.
16721: टङ्ककशाला f. (-ला) A mint. E. टङ्कक, and शाला a hall.
16722: टङ्कटीक m. (-कः) A name of ŚIVA. E. टङ्क an axe, and टीक who has, from टीक to go or get, affix अच्.
16723: टङ्कण n. (-णं) 1 Borax. 2 Binding, tying. E. टङ्क to bind, affix ल्युट्.
16724: टङ्कपति m. (-तिः) The master of the mint. E. टङ्क a weight of silver put for a coin, and पति master.
16725: टङ्कशाला f. (-ला) A mint. E. टङ्क see the last, and शाला a house or hall.
16727: टङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Surprise, wonder. 2 Fame, notoriety. 3 The twang of a bow string. E. टकि to bind, &c. affix आरक्; or ट twang, in the second case, कृ to make, affix अण्.
16728: टङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A spade or hoe. 2 An axe. 3 The leg. 4 Borax. 5 A weight of four māṣas. E. टकि to bind, affix अच्, क changed to गः otherwise टङ्क as above; also with ल्युट् affix, टङ्गन n. (-नं)
16730: टट्टनी f. (-नी) A house lizard. E. टट्ट imitative sound, and न what makes, from नी, affixes ड and ङीष्.
16731: टट्टरी f. (-री) 1 A joke, a jest. 2 A kettle drum. 3 Any musical instrument. E. टट्ट imitative sound, and र what makes, from रा, with ड and ङीष् affs.
16732: टट्टुर m. (-रः) The sound of a drum. E. टट्टु imitative sound, tattoo, and र what gets or has.
16733: टल r. 1st cl. (टलति) To be confused, to be disturbed by fear, anxiety, &c.
16734: टलन n. (-नं) Anxiety, perturbation. E. टल to be disturbed, ल्युट् aff.
16735: टाङ्कर m. (-रः) A blackguard, a lecher, a libertine. E. टां an oath, and कर who takes.
16736: टार m. (-रः) 1 A horse. 2 A catamite.
16737: टिक (ऋ) टिकृ r. 1st cl. (टेकते) To go or move.
16738: टिटिभक m. (-कः) A bird: see the next.
16739: टिट्टिभ m. (-भः) A bird, (Parra jacana or goensis.) E. टिट्टि imitative sound, भास to utter, affix ड; also with कन् added, टिट्टिभक; also टिटिभक, टिठिभक, &c.
16740: टिण्डिश m. (-शः) A kind of tree.
16741: टिप r. 10th cl. (टेपयति) To direct, to send, to throw or cast: the act of throwing being considered analogous to that of sending or ordering.
16742: टिप्पनी f. (-नी) A gloss, a comment.
16743: टीक (ऋ) टीकृ r. 1st cl. (टीकते) To go or move.
16744: टीका f. (-का) A commentary. E. टीक to go, affix अङ् and टाप्; by which the sense of the text proceeds.
16745: टु m. (-टुः) 1 Gold. 2 A Proteus, a changer of shapes at will. 3 KAMA or love.
16746: टुण्ठुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Low, little, vile. 2 Cruel, harsh. m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 A black species of catechu. 3 A small bird, (Silvia sutoria.) f. (-का) A plant, commonly Aknidhi: see टङ्गिनी. E. टुण्ठु imitative sound, and क what utters.
16747: टेपन n. (-नं) 1 Sending. 2 Throwing. E. टिप to throw, ल्युट् aff.
16750: टौक m. (ऋ) टौकृ r. 1st cl. (टौकते) To go, to move.
16751: ट्वल r. 1st cl. (ट्वलति) To be disturbed or confused: see टल. ठ
16752: ठ The aspirate of the preceding letter, corresponding to Ṭh.
16753: ठ m. (-ठः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The disk of the sun or moon. 3 A circle, a globe. 4 A cypher. 5 An object of sense. 6 A loud noise. 7 An idol, a deity.
16754: ठक्कुर m. (-रः) An idol, a deity, an object of reverence or worship.
16755: ठठम् ind. An imitative sound. ड
16756: ड The third letter of the cerebral class of consonants, having the sound of D, pronounced far back in the head: it is often confounded in pronounciation with a hard R, or L, sounded as in the Northumbrian bur; it is written in the Roman character D.
16757: ड m. (डः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Fear. 3 Sound. 4 Submarine fire. 5 A kind of drum or tabor. f. (डा) 1 A kind of female imp or goblin. 2 A basket, &c. carried by a sling: see डलक. E. डप to collect, affix ड.
16758: डङ्गरी f. (-री) A kind of gourd; also read डङ्गारी.
16759: डप r. 10th cl. (डापयति) (इ) डपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डम्पति डम्पयति) To collect, to accumulate, to heap together.
16760: डब r. 10th cl. (इ) डबि (डम्बयति) To throw, to send, to order. With वि prefixed, to deceive, to disgrace.
16761: डभ (इ) डभि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डम्भति डम्भयति-ते) To collect, to heap together.
16762: डम m. (-मः) A man of a low caste, employed to clear away filth, &c.
16763: डमर mf. (-रः-रा) 1 An affray, a conflict without weapons. 2 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. 3 Petty or predatory warfare, war carried on by detachments or by villages, one in which kings are not engaged. 4 Rout, riot. n. (-रं) Flight, running away through fear. E. डम् imitative sound, and अर what occasions, from ऋ to go, affix अप्.
16764: डमरु m. (-रुः) 1 A musical instrument, a sort of small drum, shaped like an hour glass, and held in one hand. 2 Any thing surprising, any strange occurrence, &c. E. डम् imitative sound, ऋ to go or get, कु affix, and the vowel changed.
16765: डयन n. (-नं) 1 A car or litter carried upon menś shoulders, a Palanquin, a Dūli. 2 Flying in the air, the flight of a bird. E. डी to fly, aff. ल्युट्.
16766: डलक m. (-कं) A sling, a basket, a dūlī carried on menś shoulders by means of a stick and ropes like the beam and strings of a balance; presents of fruit, sweetmeats, &c. are usually sent in this manner; also read डल्लक.
16767: डहु m. (-हुः) A tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. दह to burn, affix कु, and the deriv. irr.; also with कू affix डहू, m. (-हूः)
16768: डाकिनी f. (-नी) A kind of female imp or evil being.
16769: डामर m. (-रः) 1 Affray, conflict without weapons, &c. see डमर. 2 Rout, uproar, the bustle and the confusion of festivity or strife. 3 Any surprising thing, sight or occurrence. 4 A name common to six Tantras, as the Śivaḍāmara, Yogaḍāmara, Durgāḍāmara, &c. E. डमर q. v. and अण् aff.
16770: डालिम m. (-मः) A pomegranate: see दाडिम.
16771: डाहल m. (-लः) The name of a country; also Tripura: see त्रिपुर.
16772: डाहुक m. (-कः) A gallinule. E. दह to consume, (disease,) उकञ् affix, the flesh being considered medicinal: the radical initial is changed.
16774: डिङ्गर m. (-रः) 1 Throwing, sending. 2 A fat man. 3 A servent, a slave. 4 A rogue, a cheat. 5 A low or depraved man.
16775: डिण्डिम m. (-मः) 1 A musical instrument, a kind of small drum or tabor. 2 A plant, bearing a small fruit, (Carissa carandas:) see कृष्णपाक. E. डिण्डि imitative sound, a din, and म what emits, from मि, with ड aff.
16776: डिण्डिर m. (-रः) Cuttle fish bone, considered to be the foam of the sea.
16778: डिप r. 4th cl. (इर) डिपिर (डिप्यति) r. 6th cl. (डिपति) and r. 10th cl. (डेपयति) To throw, to cast, to send or order, to direct: see टिप. r. 10th cl. (डेपयति-ते) also (इ) डिपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डिम्पति) and (डिम्पयति-ते) To collect, to heap together.
16779: डिब r. 10th cl. (इ) डिबि (डिम्बयति) To cast, to throw.
16780: डिभ (इ) डिभि r. 1st and 10th cls. (डिम्भति and डिम्भयति-ते) To collect, to heap together.
16781: डिम m. (-मः) A dramatic entertainment, dramatic exhibition of battle or siege, such as the Tripuradāha, in which the destruction of the three cities of TRIPURA by ŚIVA is dramatised. E. डिम्ब affray, &c. deriv. irr.
16782: डिम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 Affray, assault, conflict without weapons, mutual defiance, petty and predatory war, &c. see डमर. 2 Sound or noise occasioned by terror. 3 An egg. 4 A chrysalis. 5 The bladder. 6 The spleen. 7 The uterus. 8 Fear, terror. 9 Any young animal. 10 A globe or ball. E. डी to fly, derive irr.
16783: डिम्बाहव m. (-वः) Petty warfare, affray, skirmish, riot, &c. E. डिम्ब as above, and आहव war, battle; also डिम्बयुद्ध, and other similar compounds.
16784: डिम्बिका f. (-का) 1 A bubble. 2 A kind of waterfly. 3 A libidinous woman. E. डिम्ब the bladder, &c. कन् aff.
16785: डिम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Any young animal. 2 A fool, an idiot, a blockhead. f. (-म्भा) An infant. E. डिभि to collect, affix अच्; कन् being added; also डिम्भक.
16786: डिम्भचक्र n. (-क्रं) A diagram for telling fortunes.
16787: डी (ङ) डीङ् r. 1st and 4th cls. (डयते डीयते) 1 To fly, to pass through the air. 2 To go, to move. With अव prefixed, To fly down, to alight. With उत्, To fly up, to soar. With परि, To fly round. With प्र, To fly well or swiftly. With सम्, To fly well or in flocks. With सम् and उत्, To fly up by degrees.
16788: डीन n. (-नं) Flying, the flight of a bird. E. डी to fly, affix ल्युट्.
16789: डीनडीनक m. (-कः) Flying reiteratedly. E. डीन flying, reduplicated, कन् added.
16790: डीनावडीन n. (-नं) 1 Flying up and down. 2 Flying ill. E. डीन, and अवडीन alighting.
16791: डुण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A kind of snake, (Amphisbæna.)
16792: डुण्डुभ m. (-भः) A kind of snake, (Amphisbæna.) E. डुण्डु, and भ from भा to shine or resemble.
16794: डुन्दुक m. (-कः) A gallinule: see डाहुक.
16795: डुलि f. (-लिः) 1 A small turtle. 2 A female turtle: see दुलि.
16796: डुलिका f. (-का) A bird resembling a wagtail.
16797: डोर n. (-रं) A fillet of thread or cord tied round the arm or wrist; it is also applied to the string tying a packet or parcel; also with कन added डोरक. ढ
16798: ढ The aspirate of the preceding letter corresponding to Ḍh: the use of this as an initial letter is very limited, and several of the words in which it occurs can scarely be regarded as pure Sanscrit.
16799: ढ m. (ढः) 1 A large drum. 2 A dog. 3 A dog's tail. 4 Sound. 5 A serpent.
16800: ढक्क m. (-क्कः) 1 A city or district, Dhacca or Dacca. 2 Coveting, disappearance. f. (-क्का) A large or double drum, a Ḍhāk. E. ढक् imitative sound, and क what utters.
16801: ढक्कारी f. (-री) The goddess TĀRIṆĪ, a Tāntrika form of DURGĀ.
16804: ढालिन् m. (-ली) A warrior armed with a shield, a shield-bearer.
16805: ढुढ (इ) ढढि Sautra root, (ढुण्ढति) To search, to seek.
16806: ढुण्ढन n. (-नं) Seeking, investigating. E. ढुढि to search, ल्युट् aff.
16807: ढुण्ढि m. (-ण्ढिः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. ढुढि to seek, कि aff.
16808: ढुण्ढित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired. E. ढुढि to seek, क्त aff.
16809: ढोल m. (-लः) A Dhol or large drum.
16810: ढौक (ऋ) ढौकृ r. 1st cl. (ढौकते) To go or move.
16811: ढौकन m. (-नः) A bribe. E. ढौक to go, ल्यु aff. ण
16812: ण The nasal Ṇ belonging to the third or cerebral class of consonants; in derivation and inflection this is usually changed to न or the dental N, and hence the derivatives from the following radicals occur under that letter.
16813: ण m. (णः) 1 Knowledge. 2 Certainty, ascertainment. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 Vindudeva, said to be a Jaina deity. 5 An ornament. 6 A water or summer house. 7 One without good qualities. 8 A kind of sound, the sound of negation. 9 Gift, giving. E. णी to guide, &c. affix ड.
16814: णक्ष r. 1st cl. (नक्षति, or with प्र prefixed प्रणक्षति) To go, to move, to approach.
16815: णख r. 1st cl. (नखति) also (इ) णखि r. 1st cl. (नंखति) To go, to move; also नख.
16816: णट r. 1st cl. (नटति प्रणटति) 1 To dance. 2 To dance as an actor, to gesticulate, to act; also नट. 3 To hurt.
16817: णद r. 1st cl. (नदति प्रणदति) To sound inarticulately, to roar as a river or a wild beast, to ring as a bell, &c. r. 10th cl. (नादयति) 1 To speak or tell, to shine.
16818: णभ r. 1st cl. (नभते प्रणभते) 4th cl. (नभ्यति) and 9th cl. (नभ्नाति) 1 To kill, to injure. 2 To be annihilated, to cease to be.
16819: णम r. 1st cl. (नमति) 1 To salute with reverence or respect. 2 To bow or bend, to bow down in homage or worship. 3 To sound. With अव or आङ् or सम् prefixed, To bend down, to decline. With प्र, To bow, to salute. With उत्, To lift up, to raise, to make straight or erect.
16820: णय r. 1st cl. (नयते प्रणयते) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To preserve, to protect, to defend.
16821: णर्द r. 1st cl. (नर्दति प्रणर्दति) To sound; also नर्द.
16822: णल r. 1st cl. (नलति प्रणलति) 1 To smell. 2 To bind.
16823: णश r. 4th cl. (ऊ) णशू (नश्यति) To disappear, to cease to be, to perish, to be annihilated.
16824: णस r. 1st cl. (नसते प्रणसते) 1 To be crooked, (literally or metaphorically.) 2 To bend, to make curved or crooked.
16825: णह r. 4th cl. (औ) औनह (नह्यति नह्यते) To bind, to tie. With सभ prefixed, (सन्नाहति) To arm, to put on mail or military accoutrements.
16826: णास (ऋ) णासृ r. 1st cl. (नासते प्रणासते) To sound in a particular manner, to snore.
16827: णिक्ष r. 1st cl. (निक्षति प्रणिक्षति) To kill: the change of the ण after a preposition is optional in the derivatives of this root.
16828: णिज (इ) णिजि r. 2nd cl. (निंक्ते प्रणिंक्ते) To cleanse, (औ, इर) औणिजिर r. 3rd cl. (नेनेक्ति नेनिक्ते) 1 To nurture, to cherish or maintain. 2 To purify, to cleanse.
16829: णिद (इ) णिदि r. 1st cl. (निन्दति-ते प्रणिन्दति) also (ऋ) णिदृ r. 1st cl. (नेदति-ते प्रणेदति) 1 To abuse, to censure, to reproach, to reprove or revile, to despise or condemn, &c. (The second root means also) 2 To approach, to come near. The change of ण after a preposition is optional in the derivatives of the first of these roots.
16830: णिल r. 6th cl. (निलति) 1 To misunderstand, to comprehend ill or imperfectly. 2 To be thick or impenetrable.
16831: णिव (इ) णिवि r. 1st cl. (निन्वति प्रणिन्वति) To wet, to moisten, to sprinkle.
16832: णिश r. 1st cl. (नेशति प्रणेशति) To meditate profoundly.
16833: णिष r. 1st cl. (उ) णिषु (नेषति) To sprinkle, to shed as water.
16834: णिस (इ) णिसि r. 2nd cl. (निंस्ते प्रणिंस्ते) To kiss: the change of ण after a preposition is optional in the derivatives.
16835: णी (ञ) णीञ् r. 1st cl. (नयति-ते) 1 To conduct, to drive or guide, to cause progressive conveyance. 2 To obtain, to get. The root is inflected as the deponent verb, implying. 1 Instruction, as नयते शास्त्रे he instructs in the Śāstra; 2 Worshipping, विष्णुंनयते he worships VIṢṆU; also with prepositions in the sense of; 1 Paying, भृत्यमुपनयते he pays the hire; 2 Paying as a debt, ऋणम्विनयते he discharges the debt; 3 Casting or lifting up, दण्डमुन्नयते he lifts up the stick; 4 Giving, द्रव्यम्बिनयते he gives the things; and 5 Brahmanical Investiture, पुत्त्रमुपनयते he invests his son with the thread: it is also deponent, governing an incorporeal object existing in the agent, as क्रोधम्विनयते he suppresses wrath; if the object is not in the agent the verb is active, as गुरोःक्रोधम्विनयति he appeases his teacher's anger; as also if the object is corporal, as गण्डं विनयति he turns away the cheek. The root occurs with many prefixes, and in a great variety of meanings; 1 With अनु, ^a To ask, to entreat. ^b To make like or resembling. ^c To favour. 2 With अप, ^a To take away, to remove. ^b To attract. 3 With अभि, 3 To indicate by signs. ^b To be kind or civil to. 4 With आङ्, To bring. 5 With उत्, To raise up. 6 With उप, To approach, to go near to, (see also above.) 7 With दुर्, To act or behave wickedly. 8 With निर्, ^a To get or obtain. ^b To ascertain, to determine. 9 With परि, ^a To marry. ^b To take cognizance of. 10 With प्र, ^a To punish. ^b To love. 11 With वि, ^a To take away, to make remote or distant. ^b To be humble or modest. 12 With वि and अप, To remove, to dispel, to disperse. 13 With वि and निर्, To decide by law. 14 With सम्, ^a To collect. ^b To discharge. 15 With सम् and अनु, To intreat. 16 With सम and आङ्, To assemble, to collect, &c.
16836: णील r. 1st cl. (नीलति प्रणीलति) 1 To be blue. 2 To make or dye blue.
16837: णीव r. 1st cl. (नीवति प्रणीबति) To be large or corpulent.
16838: णु r. 3rd cl. (नौति प्रणौति) To praise. With आङ् prefixed (आनुते) To utter a cry of regret. r. 6th cl. (नवति) To praise.
16839: णुद r. 6th cl. (औ) औणुद (नुदति नुदते) 1 To cast, to command, to direct, to throw or send; the act of ordering being considered analogous to that of throwing. 2 To go or proceed. With अप, To remove. With निर्, 1 To throw out. 2 To confess, to acknowledge. With वि, To be happy. With सं in the causal To drive, (as horses.)
16840: णू r. 6th cl. (नुवति) To praise; also ण.
16841: णेद (ऋ) णेदृ r. 1st cl. (नेदति-ते) 1 To censure, to despise. 2 To approach or come near: see णिद.
16842: णेष (ऋ) णेषृ r. 1st cl. (नेषते) To go, to move or approach. त
16843: त The first consonant of the fourth or dental class, corresponding to the letter T, in tongue.
16844: त m. (तः) 1 A thief. 2 Nectar, the food of the immortals. 3 An outcaste, a barbarian or Mleccha. 4 The flank, the hip or haunch. 5 A tail. 6 The womb. 7 A wicked man. 8 A tree. 9 A jewel. 10 A Buddha. n. (तं) 1 Passing, crossing. 2 Virtue, sanctity. E. तृ to cross, &c. affix ड.
16845: तक r. 1st cl. (तकति) 1 To laugh at or deride. 2 To bear. With वि and अति prefixed, and implying reciprocity (ष्यतितकते) To retort a laugh. (इ) तकि r. 1st cl. (तङ्कति) To live in distress, to be in poverty or pain. (तंकते) To go, to move.
16846: तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) That. E. तत् that, कन् pleonasm added.
16847: तकिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. f. (-ला) A medicament, a drug. E. तक to deride, affix इलच्
16848: तक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 1 Laughable, ridiculous. 2 To be borne or endured. E. तक to laugh, यत् participial aff.
16849: तक्र n. (-क्रं) Buttermilk with a fourth part water. E. तक to bear (sickness), Uṇādi affix रक्.
16850: तक्रकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) Inspissated buttermilk. E. तक्र, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk.
16851: तक्रमांस n. (-सं) Meat fried with ghee, turmeric and asafœtida, &c. eaten with buttermilk. E. तक्र, and मांस flesh.
16852: तक्राट m. (-टः) A churning-stick. E. तक्र buttermilk, and अट what goes or is, (from it.)
16853: तक्ष r. 1st cl. (तक्षति) 1 To cover. 2 To skin or peel. (ऊ) तक्षू r. 1st cl. (तक्ष्णोति) To pare, to plane, to make thin, to cut off, to chip or slice; used in any other sense, this root takes the regular form only, whether simple or compound, as with सम् prefixed, To censure, (सन्तक्षति,) &c.
16854: तक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A carpenter. 2 The Sūtradhāra, the manager and chief actor in the prelude of a drama. 3 One of the principal Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla. 4 The divine artist, VIŚVAKARMA. 5 The name of a tree. E. तक्ष to chip, to peel or plane, &c. affix वुन्.
16855: तक्षण n. (-णं) Paring, peeling, planing, &c. f. (-णी) A carpenter's adze. E. तक्ष to plane or pare, affix ल्युट् and ङीष्.
16856: तक्षन् m. (-क्षा) A carpenter. E. तक्ष to pare, Uṇādi affix कनिन्.
16857: तक्षशिला f. (-ला) The name of a city, the Taxila of Ptolemy, in the Punjab. E. तक्ष paring, शिला stone, built of hewn stones.
16858: तग (इ) तगि r. 1st cl. (तंगति) 1 To go or move. 2 To quake, to shake or tremble. 3 To trip, to stumble.
16859: तगर m. (-रः) 1 A shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) 2 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 3 Another plant, commonly Tagaramūla.
16860: तगरपादिका f. (-का) A plant; also Tagaramūla.
16861: तङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 An axe, a crow, a stonecutter's chisel: see तङ्क. 2 Grief upon separation from a beloved object. 3 Fear, terror. E. तकि to be in distress, &c. affix अच्.
16862: तज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Immediate, instantaneous. E. तत् that, (that moment,) and ज born.
16863: तञ्च उ) तञ्चु r. 1st cl. (तञ्चति) To go. (ऊ) तञ्चू r. 7th cl. (तनक्ति) To shrink or contract; also तञ्ज.
16864: तञ्ज उ) तञ्जू r. 7th cl. (तनक्ति) To shrink or contract.
16865: तट r. 1st cl. (तटति) To be elevated or high, to rise. r. 10th cl. (ताटयति) To beat.
16866: तट mfn. sub. (-टः-टा-टी-टं) A shore or bank. n. (-टं) A field. E. तट to rise or be high, affix अच्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
16867: तटस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Indifferent, alien, neuter. 2 Situated on the bank or shore. m. (-स्थः) An indifferent person, one neither a friend nor a foe. n. (-स्थं) That property which is distinct from the nature of any thing, yet is the faculty by which it is known: in other words, spiritual essence unconnected with bodily wants or passions. E. तट a bank, a height, and स्थ who stands.
16868: तटाक m. (-कः) A pond deep enough for the lotus and other aquatic flowers. E. तट a bank, and अक to go, affix अच्; also तडाक; also ताटाक and तटीक.
16869: तटिनी f. (-नी) A river. E. तट a bank, and इनि poss. aff.
16870: तड r. 10th cl. (ताडयति) 1 To beat, to strike. 2 To shine: (इ) तडि r. 1st cl. (तण्डते) To strike or beat.
16871: तडग m. (-गः) A pond, a tank: see तडाग.
16872: तडाक m. (-कः) A pond or pool, one deep enough for the lotus, &c. f. (-का) 1 A bank, a shore. 2 A blow. E. तड to beat, Uṇādi affix आक; also तटाक and तडाग.
16873: तडाग m. (-गः) 1 A pond, a pool, deep enough for the growth of the lotus, &c. see the preceding. 2 A trap for catching deer, &c. E. तड to beat, affix आग, deriv. irr.
16874: तडाघात m. (-तः) A blow from an elephant's uplifted trunk. E. तडा a beating, and आघात a blow.
16875: तडित् f. (-डित्) Lightning. E. तड to strike or beat, Uṇādi affix इति; striking the earth, &c.
16876: तडित्वत् mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्) Lightening, emitting lightning, flashing. m. (-त्वान्) A cloud. E. तडित्, lightning, and मतुप् aff.
16877: तडिल्लता f. (-ता) Forked lightning. E. तडित्, and लता a creeper.
16878: तण्डक mn. (-कः-कं) Complete performance or preparation. m. (-कः) 1 A wag-tail. 2 Froth, foam. 3 The trunk of a tree. 4 The upright post of a house. 5 A compound word. 6 A juggler, a cheat. E. तडि to beat or kill, affix वुन्.
16879: तण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) One of ŚIVA'S doorkeepers, and one of the original teachers of the arts of dancing and mimicry.
16880: तण्डुरीण m. (-णः) 1 A worm, an insect. 2 A fool, a blockhead. 3 The water in which rice has been soaked or steeped. E. तण्डुल rice, &c. ख affix, and ल changed to र.
16881: तण्डुल m. (-लः) 1 Grain after threshing and winnowing, especially rice. 2 A vermifuge plant: see विडङ्ग. 3 A potherb, a sort of Amaranth, (A. polygonoides.) E. तड to beat, Uṇādi affix उल, and नुम् inserted.
16882: तण्डुलाम्बु f. (-म्बुः) Rice water or gruel. E. तण्डुल, and अम्बु water.
16883: तण्डुलीक m. (-कः) A sort of Amaranth. E. ईकन् added to the preceding; also तण्डुलीय.
16884: तण्डुलीय m. (-यः) 1 A kind of Amaranth, (A. polygonoides.) 2 Viraṅga, a vermifuge. 3 A mineral, iron pyrites. E. तण्डुल grain, (to which the seeds, &c. are compared,) and छ affix; also तण्डुलीयक.
16885: तण्डुलु f. (-लुः) A plant of which the seeds are used as a vermifuge: see विडङ्ग. E. तडि to beat, affix उलु.
16886: तण्डुलेर m. (-रः) A sort of Amaranth: see तण्डुलीय, &c. E. तण्डुल, and एरक् aff.
16887: तण्डुलोदक n. (-कं) Water in which rice has been boiled, rice gruel. E. तण्डुल, and उदक water.
16888: तण्डुलौघ m. (-घः) A prickly sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.) 2 A heap of grain. E. तण्डुल grain, &c. or (as derived from तडि to beat, to tear,) a thorn, ओघ a heap or quantity.
16889: तत् ind. Therefore, thence, the consequent or correlative to यत्. E. तन to spread or extend, affix क्विप्.
16890: ततःप्रभृति ind. Thenceforth. E. ततस्, and प्रभृति the rest.
16891: तत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread, diffused, expanded. 2 Stretched, extended. m. (-तः) Air, wind. n. (-तं) Any stringed musical instrument. E. तन to spread, &c. क्त affix, or Uṇādi affix तन्.
16892: ततचिह्न mfn. (-ह्नः-ह्ना-ह्नं) Distinctly marked. E. तत, and चिह्न a mark.
16893: ततपत्री f. (-त्री) The plantain tree. E. तत spread, and पत्री a leaf, broad-leaved.
16894: ततम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) That one, (of many.) E. तद् that, डतमच् affix of the superlative degree.
16895: ततर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) That one, (of two.) E. तद् that, and डतरच् affix of the comparative degree.
16896: ततस् ind. 1 Therefore, thence, consequently. 2 From that or then. 3 Then, how, (asking.) 4 Then, further, after that, (in continuation.) 5 Afterwards, subsequently. 6 Thither, there. E. तद् that, affix तसि.
16897: ततस्ततस् ind. 1 Hither and thither. 2 Then, after that, what next; (asking impatiently.) E. ततस् reiterated.
16898: ततस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of or relating to that, &c. E. ततस् as above, त्यप् aff.
16899: तति mfn. plu. (ततयः ततयः ततीनि) So many.
16900: तति f. (-तिः) 1 A line, a row or range. 2 A number, a crowd, E. तन to spread, affix क्तिन्.
16901: तत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Obeying, serving, a servant. E. तद्, and कर who does.
16902: तत्काल m. (-लः) Present time, time being, or the time when an, act occurs. E. तत् that, काल time.
16903: तत्कालधी m. (-धीः) A man wise or intelligent for the time being, one having presence of mind, &c. E. तत्काल time being, and धी understanding.
16904: तत्क्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Working without hire or wages. E. तत् thence, क्रिया business.
16905: तत्क्षण n. (-णं) Time present, time being. E. तद् that, and क्षण moment.
16906: तत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) 1 Essential nature, the real nature of the human soul, considered as one and the same with the divine spirit animating the universe: the philosophical etymology of this word best explains its meaning, तद् that, that divine being, and त्व thou, that very God art thou. 2 The Supreme Being, or BRAHMA. 3 Truth, reality, substance, opposed to what is illusory or fallacious. 4 An element or elementary property, differently enumerated in different systems, from the three which are the same with the three Guṇas, to twenty-seven, which include the elements, organs, faculties, matter, spirit, life, and God. 5 A first principle, an axiom. 6 Mind, intellect. 7 Slow time in music. 8 A musical instrument. E. as above, or तद that, thence, &c. affix त्व; the word is properly, therefore, written तत्त्व, but in books one त is commonly rejected.
16907: तत्त्वज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge of divine truth. E. तत्त्व as above, and ज्ञान knowledge.
16908: तत्त्वतस् ind. Truly, accurately, fully. E. तत्त्व, and तसिल् aff.
16909: तत्त्वन्यास m. (-सः) Touching different parts of the body in the worship of VIṢṆU. E. तत्त्व, and न्यास gesticulation.
16910: तत्त्वविद् mfn. (-वित्) Knowing the truth, knowing things as they are. E. तत्त्व, and विद् who knows.
16911: तत्त्वावबोध m. (-धः) Knowledge of spirit. E. तत्त्व, and अवबोध ascertainment.
16912: तत्त्वाभियोग m. (-गः) A positive charge or declaration. E. तत्त्व, and अभियोग accusation.
16913: तत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Diligent, attending to any thing closely and anxiously. 2 Belonging to a principal object or intent of. m. (-रः) The thirtieth part of the time of the twinkling of the eye. E. तत् that, पर addicted to.
16914: तत्परायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Attached or addicted to some particular thing or person. E. तद् that, परायण attached to.
16915: तत्पूर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) Prior, former. E. तत्, and पूर्व्व before.
16916: तत्पुरुष m. (-षः) 1 That or a certain person. 2 A form of composition, (in Grammar,) usually consisting of two nouns, the first of which was in any case except the nominative or vocative; sometimes the inflection of the case is retained. E. तत् that, and पुरुष man or person.
16917: तत्फल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Resulting from any particular act, &c. m. (-लः) 1 The white-water lily. 3 A fragrant grass. E. तद्, and फल fruit.
16918: तत्र (इ) तत्रि r. 10th cl. (तन्त्रयति) 1 To spread, to extend or expand. 2 To nourish or support a family, &c.
16919: तत्र ind. There, therein, the relative to अत्र. E. तद् that, त्रल् affix, in lieu of the proper seventh case.
16920: तत्रत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Produced there or in a certain place. E. तत्र, and त्यप् aff.
16921: तत्रभवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Venerable, respectable, reverend. E. तत्र therein, (in all things,) भवत् preeminent: see अत्रभवत्.
16923: तथा ind. 1 So, like, correlative to यथा as, &c. 2 Thus, (implying certainty.) 3 So, so be it, (implying assent or promise.) 4 Thus, then, therefore, (or reply.) 5 And, so, in (conjunction.) E. तद् that, थाल affix, implying manner.
16924: तथागत m. (-तः) A Jina or Buddha. E. तथा thus, (what really is,) and गत known, obtained.
16925: तथाच ind. And so, thus, even so. E. तथा, with च and.
16926: तथात्व n. (-त्वं) Being so; the case or circumstances being admitted to be as stated. E. तथा, and त्व aff.
16927: तथापि ind. Nevertheless, yet, even. E. तथा, and अपि even.
16928: तथाविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of such a sort or kind. E. तथा, and विध sort.
16929: तथाराज m. (-जः) A Jina or Buddha.
16930: तथैव ind. So, even so, in the same manner. E. तथा, and एव thus.
16931: तथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) True. n. (-थ्यं) Truth. E. तथा thus, (what, is really so,) and यत् aff.
16932: तद् Relative or third personal pronoun, (सः सा तद्) He, she, it, that man, that woman, that thing. E. तन to extend or spread, Uṇādi affix अदि.
16933: तद (इ) तदि r. 1st cl. (तन्दते) To be content or happy.
16934: तदतिपात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Transgressing, going beyond the bounds.
16935: तदनन्तर n. adv. (-रं) Next, afterwards. E. तत् that, अनन्तर after.
16936: तदन्त n. adv. (-न्तं) To that end, just so far. E. तद, and अन्त end.
16937: तदर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 On that account, with that object. 2 Having such a meaning. E. तद्, and अर्थ sense.
16938: तदर्पण n. (-णं) 1 A thing returned. 2 Delivering any article. E. तद, and अर्पण delivery.
16939: तदा ind. Then, at that time. E. तद् that, दाच affix, implying time.
16940: तदात्व n. (-त्वं) Time being, time present. E. तदा then, त्व affix of the abstract.
16941: तदानीम् ind. Then, at that time. E. तद that, दानीम् aff.
16942: तदाप्रभृति ind. Thenceforward. E. तदा, and प्रभृति the rest.
16943: तदामुख n. (-खं) Commencement, beginning. E. तदा, and मुख beginning.
16944: तदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) That, that person, that thing. E. तद्, and छ aff.
16945: तद्दिनम् ind. 1 In the course of the day. 2 Day by day. n. (-नं) On a certain day. E. तद् that, and दिन a day.
16946: तद्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Miserly, niggardly. E. तत् thence, धन wealth.
16947: तद्वत् ind. So, in like manner, the correlative to यद्वत् as. E. तद् that, वति aff.
16948: तद्वला f. (-ला) A sort of arrow. E. तत् thence, वल strong.
16949: तद्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) In that manner, in such a manner, of such a kind or sort. E. तद्, and विध way.
16950: तद्धित m. (-तः) A derivative noun, as a patronymic or attributive of various kinds, &c. n. (-तं) The formation of such nouns. E. तत् that, (original noun,) हित what relates to or suits.
16951: तन (उ) तनु r. 8th cl. (तनोति-तनुते) To expand, to spread, to extend, to diffuse, to dilate, &c. physically or morally. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तनति तानयति) 1 To confide, to believe or have faith in. 2 To aid, to assist. 3 To be harmless. 4 To sound. 5 To pain or afflict with disease. 6 (With a preposition,) To lengthen, to stretch, to expand, &c. as in the 8th cl.
16952: तनय m. (-यः) 1 A son. 2 A male descendant. f. (-या) 1 A daughter. 2 A plant: see चक्रकुल्या. E. तन to spread, (to extend the family or name,) कयन् Uṇādi aff.
16953: तनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Smaller, less. 2 Minute, delicate, small. E. तनु, and इष्ठन् aff.
16954: तनीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Smallest, least. 2 Very small or delicate, &c. E. तुनु, and ईयसुन् aff.
16955: तनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः or न्वी or नूः-नु) 1 Small, minute. 2 Delicate, fine, but with interstices. 3 Thin, slender, emaciated. 4 Little. f. (-नुः-नूः) 1 The body. 2 The skin. f. (नुः) 1 A woman. 2 Point of conjunction, or sun's entrance into a new sign. f. (-न्वी) 1 A delicate or slender woman. 2 A stanza of four lines, and twenty-four syllables in each: a variety of the Saṃkṛti metre. E. तन to stretch or spread, Uṇādi affix उ; also तनू and तनुस्.
16956: तनुकूप m. (-पः) A pore of the skin. E. तनु, and कूप a well.
16957: तनुच्छद् mfn. (-छत्) Covering (the body,) clothing, protecting. f. (-छत्) 1 Armour. 2 Attire. E. तनु, and छद to cover, affix क्विप्.
16958: तनुज m. (-जः) A son. f. (-जा) A daughter. E. तनु body, and ज born.
16959: तनुत्र n. (-त्रं) Armour, mail. E. तनु the body, and त्र what preserves; also तनुत्राण (-णं.)
16960: तनुत्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Armed, defended. E. तनुत्र, and मतुप् aff.
16961: तनुत्याग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Niggardly, sparing, letting little go or be spent. m. (-गः) Quitting the body, death. E. तवु little or the body, त्याग parting with.
16962: तनुभस्त्रा f. (-स्त्रा) The nose. E. तनु the body, and भस्वा a bellows.
16963: तनुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Embodied, corporeal. E. तनु, and मतुप् aff.
16964: तनुमध्या f. (-ध्या) 1 A woman with a slender or elegant waist. 2 A species of the Gāyatrī metre. E. तनु, and मध्य middle.
16965: तनुरस m. (-सः) Perspiration, sweat. E. तनु the body, and रस juice.
16966: तनुरुह n. (-हं) The hair or down of the body. E. तनु, and रुह what grows: also with the final consonant. तनुरुह् n. (-रुट्)
16967: तनुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Spread, expanded. E. तनु to spread, उलच् Uṇādi aff.
16968: तनुवात m. (-तः) A division of hell. E. तनु thin, small, and वात wind.
16969: तनुवार n. (-रं) Armour. E. तनु, वृ to defend, अण् aff.
16970: तनुवारभस m. (-सः) A warrior, a man in armour. E. तनुवार, and भस who shines.
16971: तनुव्रण m. (-णः) A pimple, a pustule, a boil. E. तनु slight, and व्रण a sore.
16972: तनुस् n. (-नुः) The body. E. तन to stretch, Uṇādi affix उसि.
16973: तनुसञ्चारिणी f. (-णी) A young woman, a girl, one of ten years old. E. तनु the body, सञ्चारिणी who makes perfect.
16974: तनू f. (-नूः) The body. E. तन to stretch, affix ऊः see तनु.
16975: तनूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pared, made delicate or thin. E. तनु thin, कृत made, and उ rendered long.
16976: तनूज m. (-जः) A son. f. (-जा) A daughter. E. तनू, and ज born.
16977: तनूजनि m. (-निः) A son. E. तनू, and जनि birth.
16978: तनून m. (-नः) the wind. E. तनु body, ऊन defective.
16979: तनूनप n. (-पं) Clarified butter or ghee. E. तनु the body, and ऊन deficiency, thinness, spareness of body, and प what cherishes; what fattens.
16980: तनूनपाद् m. (-पाद् or पात्) Fire or its deity. E. तनूनप ghee, and अद् who eats, from अद with विच् affix, or तनू the body, न negative, and पा to preserve, deriv. irr. destroying other bodies, or consuming its own support or fuel, and ceasing to be.
