16981: तनूरुह mn. (-हः-हं) 1 The hair of the body. 2 The wing of a bird. m. (-हः) A son. E. तनु or तनू the body, and रुह what grows or rises, from रुह with क affix; also तनुरुह.
16982: तनूह्रद m. (-दः) The anus, the rectum. E. तनू the body, and ह्रद a deep place.
16983: तन्ति m. (-न्तिः) A weaver. f. (-न्तिः) Expansion, extension. E. तन to stretch, affix क्तिच्.
16984: तन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 1 A thread. 2 A shark. 3 Offspring, race, descendants. E. तन to spread or stretch, Uṇādi affix तुन्.
16985: तन्तुक m. (-कः) Mustard seed. f. (-की) A vein or any tubular vessel: see तन्तुभ.
16986: तन्तुकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A piece of fibrous wood, or a brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof. E. तन्तु a weaver's thread, and काष्ठ a woof.
16987: तन्तुकीट m. (-टः) A silk worm. E. तन्तु a thread, and कीट a worm.
16988: तन्तुण m. (-णः) A shark. E. तन to spread, तुण aff.
16989: तन्तुनाग m. (-गः) A shark. E. तन्तु, and नाग a snake.
16990: तन्तुनिर्यास m. (-सः) A palmyra tree. E. तन्तु thread, and निर्यास exudation, alluding to its stringy or adhesive nature.
16991: तन्तुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) The full moon of Śrāvaṇa, when KṚṢṆA is invested with the Brahmanical cord. E. तन्तु, and पर्व्वन् a festival.
16992: तन्तुभ m. (-भः) 1 Mustard seed, (Sinapis dichotoma;) also sometimes तन्तुका. 2 A calf. E. तन्तु a thread, and भा to shine, affix क.
16994: तन्तुल n. (-लं) The filaments or fibrous root of the lotus. E. तन्तु a thread, and ल what has; also with र, तन्तुर.
16995: तन्तुवाप m. (-पः) 1 A weaver. 2 A loom. E. तन्तु a thread, वप to weave, affix घञ्.
16996: तन्तुवाय m. (-यः) 1 A weaver. 2 A spider. E. तन्तु a thread, वे to weave, अण् affix; also तन्त्रवाय.
16997: तन्तुविग्रहा f. (-हा) The banana or plantain. E. तन्तु a thread, and विग्रह a part.
16998: तन्तुशाला f. (-ला) A weaver's shop. E. तन्तु weaving, and शाला a house or hall.
16999: तन्तुसन्तत n. (-तं) Wove cloth. E. तन्तु a thread, and सन्तत collected.
17000: तन्तुसार m. (-रः) The betel-nut tree; also तन्तुसारक. E. तन्तु a thread, and सार pith; having a stringy pith.
17001: तन्त्र mfn. (न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं) Dependant, subservient. m. (-न्त्रः) A weaver. f. (-न्त्री) 1 Any string or rope. 2 The wire or string of a lute. 3 Any tubular vessel of the body. 4 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गूडुची. 5 The name of a river. 6 A young woman. n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A Tantra, a religious treatise teaching peculiar and mystical formulæ and rites for the worship of the deities, or the attainment of superhuman power: it is mostly in the form of a dialogue between ŚIVA and DURGĀ, who are the peculiar gods of the Tāntrikas: there is a great number of these works, and their authority, in many parts of India, seems to have, in a great measure, superseded that of the Vedas: according to one account, a Tantra comprises five subjects, the creation and destruction of the world, the worship of the gods, the attainment of all objects, magical rites for the acquirement of six (superhuman) faculties, and four modes of union with spirit by meditation; a variety of subjects are, however, introduced into many of them, whilst some are limited to a single topic, as the mode of breathing in certain rites, the language of birds, beasts, &c. 2 A branch of the Vedas, that which teaches Mantras or mystical and magical formula. 3 Demonstration, clear and right conclusion. 4 Raiment, vesture. 5 A medicament, a drug. 6 A principal medicament, or perhaps a charm, considered as producing medicinal effects. 7 Providing for a family. 8 A cause, a motive. 9 Cause common to two or more results; the instruments or means of more than one effect. 10 Necessary or indispensable act or provision; the right way of doing any thing. 11 Chief, principal. 12 A royal retinue, a court, a train. 13 An army. 14 A royal property; that of providing for the security and prosperity of the kingdom. 15 A realm, a country. 16 A thread. 17 Subservience, service, dependance. 18 Oath or ordeal. 19 Decorations, hanging with trophies, garlands, &c. 20 Heap, multitude. 21 Wealth. 22 A house. 23 An implement of weaving, a loom. 24 Happiness, felicity. E. तन to spread or extend, affix ष्ट्रन्; or तत्रि to spread, to support a family, &c. affix क, fem. affix ङीप्; or तत्त्र with ई Uṇādi aff.
17002: तन्त्रक n. (-कं) New and unbleached cloth. E. तन्त्र the loom, and कन् affix, recently from the loom.
17003: तन्त्रकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A fibrous stick for cleaning the woof, &c. E. तन्त्र weaving, and काष्ठ wood.
17004: तन्त्रता f. (-ता) 1 Dependance, subservience. 2 The quality or character of a Tantra. 3 Comprehending several rites in one, performance of one ceremony or penance in lieu of a number. E. तत्त्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, तन्त्रत्व.
17005: तन्त्रवाप m. (-पः) A weaver. mn. (-पः-पं) A loom. E. तन्त्र a thread, and वप to weave, affix घञ्.
17006: तन्त्रवाय m. (-यः) 1 A weaver. 2 A spider. E. तन्त्र a thread, a web, and वे to spin or weave, affix घञ्; also तन्त्रवाप, and sometimes तन्द्रवाय.
17007: तन्त्रिका f. (-का) A plant, Guricha. E. कन् added to तन्त्री.
17008: तन्त्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) 1 Spun, wove, made of threads. 2 Chorded, having chords or wires, (as an instrument.) 3 A musician. 4 Having a Tantra, following one, &c. E. तन्त्र, and इनि aff.
17009: तन्त्रिपालक m. (-कः) A name of JAYADRATHA. E. तन्त्रि (derived from तन्त्र any army, with इनि affix,) a general, and पालक who cherishes or aids.
17010: तन्द्रवाय m. (-यः) A weaver: see तन्त्रवाय.
17011: तन्द्रा f. (-न्द्रा) 1 Lassitude, exhaustion, weariness, syncope. 2 Sleepiness, sluggishness. E. तन्द्रि a Sautra root, to be weary, affixes क and टाप्; also with क्तिन् affix तन्द्रि. f. (-न्द्रिः) and with ङीष् added तन्द्री.
17012: तन्द्रालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Slothful, sluggish, overcome with sleep or fatigue. E. तन्द्र sloth, and आलुच् aff.
17013: तन्द्रि f. (-न्द्रिः) 1 Sleepiness. 2 Lassitude. 3 Fainting, exhaustion: see तन्द्रा. E. as above, or तदि Sautra root, to be weary, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
17014: तन्द्रिका f. (-का) Sloth, sleepiness. E. कन् added to तन्द्री.
17015: तन्द्री f. (-न्द्री) 1 Drowsiness. 2 Lassitude: see तन्द्रा.
17016: तन्नि f. (-न्निः) A plant: see चक्रकुल्या.
17017: तन्मात्र n. sub. (-त्रं) The archetype or subtile rudiment of elementary matter. adv. Merely that. E. तद्, and मात्र only, or element.
17018: तन्यतु m. (-तुः) 1 Night. 2 A musical instrument. E. तन to spread, यतुच् Uṇādi aff.
17019: तन्वत् mfn. (-न्वत्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्) Spreading, extending. E. तन to spread, शतृ aff.
17020: तप (औ) तपौ r. 1st cl. (तपति-ते) r. 4th cl. (तप्यति-ते) and r. 10th cl.  (तापयति-ते) 1 To heat or be hot, to burn; (hence figuratively,) to suffer mental or bodily pain. 2 To have pre-eminent or superhuman power: the deponent form only is used when the root with the prefix उत् or वि occurs intransitively, or governs as its object part of the body of the agent, as पाणिं वितपते warms the hand, (उत्तपते वितपते) shines, burns, &c. The root takes the passive form also, when implying religious meditation, as तप्यते तपस्तापसः the devotee revolves religious thoughts. With अनु prefixed, (अनुतपते) To repent, to regret. With परि or सम् (परितपति सन्तपति,) 1 To bear or inflict pain, anguish, heat, distress, &c. 2 To be sorrowful, to repent.
17021: तपःकर m. (-रः) The mango fish: see तपस्विन्.
17022: तपःकृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Emaciated by austerities. E. तपस्, and कृश lean.
17023: तपःक्लेशसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Patient of austerities. E. तपस् austere devotion, क्लश fatigue, and सह bearing.
17024: तपःस्थली f. (-ली) A name of Benāres. E. तपस् religious austerities, and स्थल soil, place, fem. affix ङीष्.
17025: तप m. (-पः) 1 The hot season, summer. 2 Heat, warmth. 3 The sun. E. तप to heat, affix अच्.
17026: तपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) 1 Heating or warming. 2 Performing penance. E. तप to heat, शतृ aff.
17027: तपती f. (-ती) 1 A name of CHĀYĀ, wife of the sun. 2 Also of the daughter of the sun, or the personified Taptī river, married to SAṂVARAṆA of the Kuru family. E. तप heat or the sun, and अत who accompanies, fem. affix ङीष्.
17028: तपन m. (-तः) 1 The sun. 2 A division of hell. 3 Heat, burning. 4 Mental distress, pining, grieving. 5 The hot season. 6 The marking nut plant. f. (-नी) The Godāvarī river. E. तप to inflame, affixes ल्युट् and ङीष्.
17029: तपनकर m. (-रः) A ray, a sun-beam. E. तपन, and कर a ray.
17030: तपनतनय m. (-यः) KARṆA, &c. f. (-या) 1 The Yamunā river. 2 The Tapti. E. तपन, the sun, and तनय child.
17031: तपनमणि m. (-णिः) The sun-stone. E. तपन, and मणि a gem.
17032: तपनांशु m. (-शुः) A ray of the sun, a sun-beam. E. तपन, and अंशु ray.
17033: तपनात्मजा f. (-जा) 1 The Godāvarī river. 2 The Yamunā or Jumna river. E. तपन the sun, and आत्मजा a daughter.
17034: तपनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be heated. 2 To be suffered or practised as penance. n. (-यं) Gold. E. तप to heat, &c. अनीयर् aff.
17035: तपनीयक n. (-कं) Gold. E. तपनीय, and कन् added.
17036: तपनेष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Copper. E. तपन, and इष्ट liked.
17037: तपस् m. (-पाः) 1 The name of a month, Māgha, (January-February.) 2 The cold or dewy season. 3 The hot season. n. (-पः) 1 Religious austerity, penance, mortification, the practice of mental or personal self-denial, or the infliction of bodily tortures. 2 A world, the region above the Janaloka, inhabited by saints or devotees after death. 3 Virtue, moral merit. 4 Duty, the special observance of certain things: thus the Tapas of a Brahman is sacred learning; of a Kṣatriya, the protection of subjects; of a Vaiśya, almsgiving to Brahmans; of a Śūdra, the service of the same tribe; and of a Ṛṣi or saint, feeding upon herbs and roots. E. तप to heat or inflame, affix असुन.
17038: तपस m. (-सः) 1 The moon. 2 A bird. E. तप to heat, असच् Uṇādi aff.
17039: तपस्तक्ष m. (-क्षः) A name of INDRA. E. तपम् austerity, and तक्ष who pares or makes thin; emaciating himself by his devotions.
17040: तपस्य m. (-स्यः) 1 The month Phālguna, (February-March.) A name of ARJUNA. f. (-स्या) 1 Devout austerity, religious penance. n. (-स्यं) The flower of the Kunda, (Jasminum pubescens.) E. तपस् the cold season, यत् aff.
17041: तपस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Devout, practising austerities. 2 Poor, wretched, pitiable. m. (-स्वी) 1 An ascetic, a religious man engaged in the practice of rigorous and devout penance. 2 A name of NĀRADA. 3 A mendicant, a pauper. 4 The mango fish (Polynemus risua.) f. (-स्विनी) 1 A female devotee, a woman leading a religious life. 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 3 Another plant: see कटुरोहिणी. E. तपस् religious austerity, the hot season, &c. विनि aff.
17042: तपस्समाधि m. (-धिः) The practice of penance. E. तपस्, and समाधि obligation.
17043: तपात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Practising austerities. E. तप, and आत्मक self.
17044: तपात्यय m. (-यः) The rainy season. E. तप the warm season, and अत्यय destroying; following the hot weather.
17045: तपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heated, burnt. E. तप to heat, affix क्त, with इट् inserted.
17046: तपुस् m. (-पुः) 1 Fire. 1 The sun. E. तप to heat, Uṇādi affix उसि,
17047: तपोधन m. (-नः) A devotee, an ascetic, one who performs religious penance. f. (-ना) A plant: see मुण्डीरी. E. तपस् religious austerity, and धन wealth.
17048: तपोनुभाव m. (-वः) The influence of religious penance. E. तपस, and अनुभाव authority.
17049: तपोनिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Performing penance, practising austerities. E. तपस्, and निष्ठ engaged in.
17050: तपोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Devout, practising austerities. E. तपस्, and मयट् aff.
17051: तपोमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः) An ascetic. E. तपस्, and मूर्त्ति form.
17052: तपोराशि m. (-शिः) An ascetic. E. तपस्, and राशि a heap.
17053: तपोवट m. (-टः) A country, part of central India or holy land, E. तपस् religious austerity, and वट what surrounds.
17054: तपोवन n. (-नं) A sacred grove, a place frequented by ascetics. E. तपस्, and वन a wood.
17055: तप्त mfn. (-प्रः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Heated, inflamed, burnt. 2 Scorched by pain or sorrow, distressed, afflicted. 3 Inflamed with anger, incensed. 4 Undergone or performed as penance. 5 Fused, melted. 6 Burnished. E. तप to heat, क्त aff.
17056: तप्तकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A hell. E. तप्त, and कुम्भ a jar.
17057: तप्तकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, drinking hot water, milk, and ghee for three days each, and inhaling hot air for three days. E. तप्त heated, कृच्छ्र penance.
17058: तप्ततपस् m. (-पाः) An ascetic. E. तप्त, and तपस् penance.
17059: तप्तपाषाणकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A hell. E. तप्त, पाषाण a stone, and कुण्ड a well.
17060: तप्तबालुक m. (-कः) A hell. E. तप्त, and वालुका sand.
17061: तप्तरूपक n. (-कं) Silver. E. तप्त, and रूपक silver.
17062: तप्त्वा ind. 1 Having heated. 2 Having performed penance. E. तप, and क्त्वा aff.
17063: तप्स्यत् mfn. (-प्स्यन्-प्स्यन्ती-प्स्यत्) Practising or intending to practise austerities. E. तप to perform penance, शतृ affix, future part.
17064: तमःप्रवेश m. (-शः) 1 Groping in the dark. 2 Mental indistinctness or aberration. E. तमस्, and प्रवेश entrance.
17065: तमःस्थित n. (-तं) A hell, one of the lowest divisions of hell. E. तमस्, and स्थित placed.
17066: तम (इर उ) इर्तमु r. 4th cl. (ताम्यति) 1 To desire. 2 To be distressed in body or mind.
17067: तम m. (-मः) The quality of darkness incident to humanity: see तमस्. mf. (-मः-मा) A tree bearing black blossoms. n. (-मं) 1 Darkness, gloom. 2 The point of the foot. f. (-मा-मी) Night. E. तम to be disturbed, to be fatigued, &c. affixes अच्, and टाप् or ङीष्.
17068: तमङ्गक m. (-कः) The flat and projecting roof of a house, a sort of balcony or terrace. E. तम to desire, अङ्गक affix; pleasant, desirable.
17069: तमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Desirous, cupidinous, longing or hankering after. 2 Wished, desired. E. तम to desire, affix अतच्.
17070: तमप्रभ mf. (-भः-भा) A hell, one of the lowermost divisions of the infernal regions. E. तम darkness, and प्रभ what is manifest.
17071: तमर n. (-रं) Lead. E. तम to be disturbed, affix अरन्.
17072: तमराज m. (-जः) A kind of sugar.
17073: तमस् n. (-मः) 1 The third of the qualities incident to the state of humanity, the Tama guṇa, or property of darkness, whence proceed folly, ignorance, mental blindness, worldly delusion, &c. 2 Darkness, gloom. 3 Sin. 4 Sorrow, grief. mn. (-माः-मः) Rāhu or the personified ascending node: see राहु. E. तम to be disturbed, and असच् Uṇādi affix; that property by which the mind is troubled, the world perplexed, &c.; also तमम् and तम.
17074: तमस n. (-सं) 1 Darkness. 2 A city. f. (-सा) a river, the Tamasā or Tonse. E. तम to be disturbed, (daylight, &c.) and असच् aff.
17075: तमस्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Like darkness, black, gloomy. E. तमस्, and कल्प aff.
17076: तमस्तति f. (-तिः) Great or diffusive darkness. E. तमस् darkness, and तति a spreading.
17077: तमस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Dark, gloomy. f. (-नी) 1 Night. 2 Turmeric. E. तमस् darkness, and विनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
17078: तमाल m. (-लः) 1 The sectarial mark made with Sandal, &c. upon the forehead. 2 The name of a tree bearing black blossoms, (Xanthocymus pictorius, Rox.) 3 A sword, a scymitar or large sacrificial knife. 4 A plant: see वरुण. 5 A black kind of Mimosa. 6 The bark of the bambu. n. (-लं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तम to be dark or troubled, Uṇādi affix कालन्.
17079: तमालक n. (-कं) 1 A sort of potherb, (Marsilea dentata, Rox.) 2 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The bark of a bambu. 2 The Tamāla tree: see the preceding. E. कन् pleonasm, or implying some resemblance, added to तमाल.
17080: तमालपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The Tamāla tree: see तमाल. 2 The Tilaka or sectarial mark on the forehead. 3 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तमाल, and पत्र a leaf: the leaf of the Tamāla, either in fact or resemblance.
17081: तमालिका f. (-का) A district in Bengal, the modern Tumlook. E. तमाल a Tamāla tree, ठन् affix, implying possession; also with an analogous affix इनि, तमालिनी abounding in Tamāla trees.
17082: तमाली f. (-ली) A medicinal plant: see ताम्रवल्ली.
17083: तमि f. (-मिः) Night. E. तम to be weary, इन् affix: see तम and तमी.
17084: तमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Desiring, desirous, wishing. E. तम to desire, घिणुन् aff.
17085: तमिस्र m. (-स्रः) The dark half of the month, from the full to the change. f. (-स्रा) 1 A dark night, or one during the wane of the moon. 2 Great or extensive darkness. 3 The night of new moon. 4 Any night. n. (-स्रं) 1 Darkness. 2 Anger, wrath. E. तमस darkness, र added, and इ substituted for the penultimate.
17086: तमिस्रपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The fortnight of the moon's wane. E. तमिस्र, and पक्ष a fortnight.
17087: तमोगुण m. (-णः) The quality of darkness or ignorance. E. तमस्, and गुण property.
17088: तमोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. 3 The moon. 4 The legislator BUDDHA. 5 VIṢṆU. 6 ŚIVA. E. तमस् darkness, (physical or moral,) and घ्न destroyer.
17089: तमोज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A fire fly. E. तमस् darkness, and ज्योतिस् light.
17090: तमोनुद् mfn. (-नुद्) Dispersing darkness. m. (-नुद् or नुत्) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. 3 The moon. 4 A lamp. E. तमस् darkness, नुद to send away or disperse, affix क्विप्; also with क affix तमोनुद.
17092: तमोपह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Lightening, enlightening, removing darkness physical or moral. m. (-हः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. 4 A name of Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. तमम् darkness, अपह removing, from अप prefixed to हन to kill or destroy, affix ड; also तमोहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
17093: तमोभिद् m. (-भिट् or भित्) A fire-fly. E. तमस् darkness, and भिद what penetrates.
17094: तमोभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dark. 2 Ignorant. E. तमस्, and भूत become.
17095: तमोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Consisting or composed of darkness, derived from it. E. तमस्, and मयट् aff.
17096: तमोमणि m. (-णिः) A fire-fly. E. तमस् darkness, मणि a gem.
17097: तमोलिप्ती f. (-प्ती) The district of Tumlook in Bengal. E. तमस् darkness or sin, and लिप्त soiled, affix ङीष्; a country of which the inhabitants are notoriously depraved.
17098: तमोविकार m. (-रः) Disease, sickness. E. तमस्, and विकार changed, proceeding from the Tama guṇa.
17099: तमोवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overcome with or influenced by rage, fear, &c. or any of the effects of the property of darkness. 2 Obscured, clouded. E. तमस् as above, and आवृत surrounded.
17100: तमोहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Removing darkness, lightening. m. (-रः) The moon. E. तमस् darkness, and हर who removes.
17101: तम्पा f. (-म्पा) A cow. E. तम to desire, अप affix; also प being changed to ब, तम्बा.
17102: तम्ब r. 1st cl. (तम्बति) To go or move.
17103: तम्बा f. (-म्बा) A cow: see तम्पा.
17104: तय r. 1st cl. (तयते) 1 To go or move. 2 To guard or preserve.
17105: तय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what protects. m. (-यः) Protection. E. तय, and अच् aff.
17106: तर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what passes over or beyond. m. (-रः) 1 Passing over, crossing. 2 A float, a raft. 3 A road. 4 A tree. f. (री) 1 A boat. 2 A club. 3 A clothes basket, a Pitāra. 4 Smoke. 5 A small wooden baling vessel. 6 The end of a garment. E. तॄ to cross, affix अप्, fem. affix ङीष्; also with इन् affix तरि, q. v.
17107: तरक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A hyena. E. तर a road, and क्षि to annoy, affix डु infesting the road; also with कन् added तरक्षुक. m. (-कः) or with ड affix तरक्ष. m. (-क्षः) but not common.
17108: तरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A wave. 2 Cloth or clothes. 3 The gallop of a horse. E. तॄ to pass over or cross, Uṇādi affix अङ्गच्.
17109: तरङ्गिणी f. (-णी) A river. E. तरङ्ग a wave, इनि and ङीष् affs.
17110: तरङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wavy, billowy, tossing with waves. E. तरङ्ग, and इतच् aff.
17111: तरण m. (-णः) 1 A raft, a float. 2 Svarga or paradise. n. (-णं) 1 Crossing over, passing, going across. 2 Removing from an inundation. E. तॄ to cross, affix ल्युट्.
17112: तरणि m. (-णिः) 1 The sun. 2 A ray of light. 3 A float or raft. f. (-णिः or णी) 1 A boat. The Socotrine aloe, (A. perfoliata.) 3 A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. तॄ to cross, Uṇādi affix अनि.
17113: तरणिपेटक m. (-कः) An oval bowl or bason of wood, for baling a boat. E. तरणि, and पेटक a basket, the boat's basket.
17115: तरण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा or ण्डी-ण्डं) A boat, a vessel. mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 A raft or float, made of bambus, &c. tied together, and sometimes floated upon jars or hollow gourds inverted. 2 The float of a fishing line. 3 An oar. m. (-ण्डः) A country. E. तॄ to cross, अण्डन् aff.
17116: तरण्डपादा f. (-दा) A boat. E. तरण्ड an oar, and पाद a foot, having oars for feet.
17117: तरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Crossing, passing over. n. (-रत् or रद्) 1 A float or raft. 2 A kind of duck. E. तॄ to cross, शतृ affix of the active participle.
17118: तरत्सल m. (-लः) Conflagration of chaff: see तृणाग्नि.
17119: तरन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A fog. 2 A hard shower, a torrent of rain. 3 The ocean. f. (-न्ती) A boat. E. तॄ to cross, झच् aff.
17120: तरम्बुज n. (-जं) A watermelon, (most probably borrowed from the Persian, تربز)
17121: तरपण्य n. (-ण्यं) Fare, freight. E. तर passing (a river), and पण्य price.
17122: तरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Trembling, tremulous. 2 Libidinous, lecherous, wanton. 3 Luminous, splendid. 4 Hollow. 5 Liquid, liquefied. m. (-लः) 1 The central gem of a necklace. 2 A necklace. 3 Bottom, depth, lower or under part. f. (-ला) 1 Rice gruel. 2 Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor. 3 A bee. E. तॄ to pass, to go or move, affix कल.
17123: तरलता f. (-ता) Tremulousness, unsteadiness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तललत्वं.
17124: तरललोचना f. (-ना) A woman with rolling or tremulous eyes. E. तरल trembling, and लोचना an eye.
17125: तरलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Caused to tremble, agitated, undulating. m. (-तः) 1 A large wave or surf. 2 Fickleness. E. तरल used as a verb, क्त aff.
17126: तरलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, trembling, tremulous. E. तरल trembling, and इतच् aff.
17127: तरवारि m. (-रिः) A sword, a scymitar. E. तर passing, वॄ to effect, इञ् affix; making its pass through the enemy, &c. also तरवारिक m. (-कः.)
17128: तरस् n. (-रः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Strength. 3 A bank. 4 A float, a raft. E. तॄ to go, to go quick, &c. असुन् aff.
17129: तरस n. (-सं) Flesh. E. तरस् strength, affix अच्; in which there is strength.
17130: तरस्थान n. (-नं) A landing place, a wharf or stairs. E. तर passing, ferrying, and स्थान place.
17131: तरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) 1 Quick, swift. 2 Valiant. E. तरस्, and वतुप् aff.
17132: तरस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Quick, swift. 2 Strong, valiant. m. (-स्वी) 1 A courier, an express, a runner. 2 A hero. 3 The bird of VIṢṆU. 4 Air, wind. E. तरस् speed, &c. विनि aff.
17133: तरान्धु m. (-न्धुः) A large flat bottomed boat. E. तर crossing, अन्धु water; perhaps a various reading of the next.
17134: तरालु m. (-लुः) A flat bottomed boat. E. तर passing over, आलुच् affix: see the preceding.
17135: तरि f. (-रिः) 1 A boat. 2 A clothes basket. 3 The end of a cloth. E. तॄ to pass, Uṇādi affix इन्; also with ङीष् affix तरी see तर, &c.
17136: तरिक n. (-कं) A raft, a float. m. (-कः) A ferry-man. f. (-का) A boat. E. तरि a boat, कन् aff.
17137: तरिकिन् m. (-की) A ferry-man. E. तरिक a raft, इनि aff.
17138: तरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Carried over or across. f. (-ता) 1 The fore finger. 2 Garlic, or perhaps hemp: see गृञ्जन. E. त to cross, इनि aff.
17139: तरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-णि) Who or what crosses. f. (-णी) A boat. E. तृ to go, in the causal, affix क्त.
17140: तरितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) What crosses, passes or carries over. f. (-त्री) A boat, a raft. E. तृ to cross, तृच् aff.
17141: तरिरथ m. (-थः) An oar, a paddle. E. तरि a boat, and रथ a car.
17142: तरीष m. (-षः) 1 The ocean. 2 Heaven or paradise. 3 Decorating, ornamenting. 4 A raft, a float. 5 Practice, business, profession. f. (-षी) 1 The daughter of INDRA. E. तॄ to cross or cause to cross, Uṇādi affix ईषन्; in some of its senses this word and तबिष seem to be confounded: see तबिष and ताविष.
17143: तरु m. (-रुः) A tree. E. तॄ to proceed, Uṇādi affix उ; what goes or grows; or from what flowers and fruits arise, &c.
17144: तरुकूणि m. (-णिः) A sort of bird. E. तरु a tree, and कूण to contract, affix कि; nestling in the tree.
17145: तरुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Borne, produced by a tree, (as a flower, fruit, &c.) E. तरु, and ज born.
17146: तरुजीवन n. (-नं) The root of a tree. E. तरु a tree, and जीवन living.
17147: तरुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Young, juvenile. 2 New, fresh, novel. m. (-णः) 3 A young man, one of the virile age. 4 The castor oil plant. 5 Large cumin seed. f. (-णी) 1 A young woman from 16 to 30 years of age; generally however one about the first age. 2 The aloe tree, (A. perfoliata.) 3 A perfume, commonly Chira. 4 A flower, the Indian white rose, (Rosa standulifera.) n. (-णं) A kind of flower, that of the Achyranthes aspera? (कुजपुष्प.) E. तॄ to pass away, उनन् Uṇādi aff.
17148: तरुणज्वर m. (-रः) A fever that lasts a week. E. तरुण, and ज्वर fever.
17149: तरुणदधि n. (-धि) Curds five days old. E. तरुण, and दधि curds.
17150: तरुणास्थि n. (-स्थि) Cartilage, gristle. E. तरुण, and अस्थि bone.
17151: तरुणीगण m. (-णः) A number of young women. E. तरुणी, and गण a troop.
17152: तरुणीजन m. (-नः) A young woman. E. तरुणी, and जन person.
17153: तरुतल m. (-लः) The part under the branches of a tree, the ground about its root. E. तरु, and तल below.
17154: तरुतूलिका f. (-का) The flying fox. E. तरु a tree, and तूलिका scales, suspended like a balance from the branches of a tree; also read तरुदूलिका.
17155: तरुनख m. (-खः) A thorn. E. तरु a tree, and नख a nail.
17156: तरुपङ्क्ति f. (-क्तिः) A row of trees, an avenue. E. तरु, and पंक्ति a line.
17157: तरुभुज् m. (-क्) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and भुज what enjoys.
17158: तरुमृग m. (-गः) A monkey, an ape. E. तरु a tree, and मृग a deer.
17159: तरुराग m. (-गः) 1 A bud, a blossom. 2 A new sprout. E. तरु a tree, राग delight.
17160: तरुविटप m. (-पः) A branch or sprout. E. तरु, and विटप a shoot.
17161: तरुराज m. (-जः) The palmyra tree. E. तरु, and राज king, chief.
17162: तरुरुहा f. (-हा) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and रुह what mounts.
17163: तरुरोहिणी f. (-णी) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and रोहिणी what ascends.
17164: तरुशायिन् m. (-यी) A bird. E. तरु a tree, and शीङ् to sleep, with णिनि aff.
17165: तरुसार m. (-रः) Camphor. E. तरु a tree, and सार essence.
17166: तरुस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Staying or being in a tree. f. (-स्था) A parasite plant. E. तरु, and स्थ what stays.
17167: तरूट m. (-टः) The root of the lotus.
17168: तर्क r. 10th cl. (तर्कयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak. 3 To reason, to discuss. 4 To doubt or apprehend.
17169: तर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 Doubt or disputation, discussion, reasoning. 2 Wish, desire. 3 Supplying an ellipsis. 4 Cause, motive. 5 The science of reasoning, logic. 6 (In Logic,) Reduction to absurdity, a conclusion opposed to or disproving the premises. E. तर्क to infer, to reason, &c. affix घञ्.
17170: तर्कक m. (-कः) 1 A supplicant, a petitioner, an asker. 2 A logician. E. तर्क to reason, and affix वुन्.
17171: तर्कयत् mfn. (-यत्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Expecting, anticipating. 2 Doubting. E. तर्क to doubt, शतृ aff.
17172: तर्कविद्या f. (-द्या) The science of reasoning or logic. E. तर्क as above, and विद्या knowledge.
17173: तर्काभास m. (-सः) Apparent reduction to absurdity, or seeming not real, incompatibility of the conclusion with the premises. E. तर्क, and आभास fallacy.
17174: तर्कारी f. (-री) A tree, (Aeschynomene sesban.) E. तर्क reasoning, ऋ to go or affect, affixes अण and ङीप्.
17175: तर्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Doubted, apprehended. 2 Discussed. E. तर्क to doubt, क्त aff.
17176: तर्किन् m. (-की) A logician, a disputant, a follower of the Tarka Śāstra. E. तर्क as above, इनि aff.
17178: तर्कु f. (-र्कुः) A spindle, an iron pin upon which the cotton is first drawn out; it also serves as the distaff, the cotton being next transferred from it to the wheel. E. कृत to cut, Uṇādi affix उ, and the radical letters transposed.
17179: तर्कुट n. (-टं) Drawing out the cotton upon the distaff or upon the wheel. f. (-टी) A spindle or a distaff: see तर्कु. E. कृत to cut, &c. उटच् affix, and the radical letters transposed.
17180: तर्कुपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A ball of clay, &c. upon the lower end of the spindle to assist in giving it a rotatory motion. E. तर्कु as above, पिण्ड a lump.
17181: तर्कुपीठी f. (-ठी) A ball at the lower end of a spindle: see the preceding. E. तर्कु a spindle, and पीठ a stool.
17182: तर्कुलासक m. (-कः) A concave shell or saucer in which the lower end of the spindle is placed, and whirled round. E. तर्कु a spindle, लस to go, ण्वुल् aff.
17183: तर्कुशाण m. (-णः) A small whetstone, for sharpening spindles, &c. E. तर्कु a spindle, and शाण a whetstone.
17184: तर्क्षु m. (-र्क्षुः) A hyena. E. तर्ज to give pain, affix कु; also तरक्षु.
17186: तर्ज r. 1st and 10th cls. (तर्जति-ते तर्जयति) To blame, to censure, to reprove.
17187: तर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Blaming, censuring. 2 Pointing at, in ridicule, or contempt. 3 Putting to shame, surpassing. 4 Wrath, anger. f. (-नी) The forefinger. E. तर्ज to abuse, to injure, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.
17188: तर्ज्जिक m. (-कः) The name of a country, perhaps to the north-west of India or Bokhara, &c. the country of the Tājiks: also तायिक.
17189: तर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blamed, reviled. 2 Shamed, disgraced. E. तर्ज to blame, affix क्त.
17190: तर्ण m. (-र्णः) A calf. E. तॄ to go, ण affix; also with कन् added, तर्णक.
17191: तर्णक m. (-कः) A calf: see the preceding.
17192: तर्णि m. (-र्णिः) 1 A raft, a float. 2 The sun. E. तॄ to cross, affix णि.
17193: तर्त्तरीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A passenger, one who passes or crosses. n. (-कं) A boat, a raft, a vessel. E. तॄ to cross over, ईकन् aff. and deriv. irr.
17194: तर्द r. 1st cl. (तर्दति) To kill or hurt.
17195: तर्दू m. (-र्दूः) A wooden ladle. E. तॄ to go, Uṇādi affix उ, and दूट् augment.
17196: तर्पण n. (-णं) 1 Satisfaction given or received; either the act of pleasing, or the state of being pleased. 2 Satiety, fulness. 3 A religious rite, presenting water to the manes of the deceased or to the Pitṛs collectively; also to the gods either generally or individually. 4 Fuel used on sacrificial occasions. f. (-णी) A plant; also गुरुस्कन्ध. E. तृप to satisfy or be satisfied, affix ल्युट्.
17197: तर्पणेच्छु mfn. (-च्छुः-च्छुः-च्छु) Desirous of satisfaction, or of receiving after death the presentation of water called Tarpaṇa. m. (-च्छुः) A name of BHĪṢMA. E. तर्पण as above, इच्छु to wish, and उ aff.
17198: तर्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, satisfied. E. तृप to be pleased, क्त affix, with इट्.
17199: तर्पिन् mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि) 1 Giving pleasure or satisfaction. 2 Offering oblations to the manes, (who does so.) f. (-णी) A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. तृप to give pleasure, इनि and ङीप् affs.
17200: तर्ब r. 1st cl. (तर्बति) To go or move.
17201: तर्ब्बट m. (-टः) A year. E. तर्ब्ब to go, अटन् aff.
17202: तर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The top or term of the sacrificial post. E. तॄ to pass up, and मनिन् aff.
17203: तर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Thirst. 2 Wish, desire. 3 The ocean. 4 A raft or float. 5 The sun. E. तृष to thirst, affix अच्, or तॄ to pass over, and ष Uṇādi aff.
17204: तर्षण n. (-णं) Thirst, thirsting: it is also used metaphorically. E. तृष to thirst, affix ल्युट्.
17205: तर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thirsting, athirst, thirsty. 2 Desiring, wishing for. E. तृष to thirst, affix क्त.
17206: तर्हि ind. Therefore. E. तद that, and र्हिल् aff.
17207: तल r. 1st and 10th cls. (तलति तालयति) 1 To be full or complete. 2 To fix, to found. 3 To establish.
17208: तल n. (-लं) 1 Essential nature, (in composition especially, as महीतलं the earth itself, the very earth.) 2 Depth, bottom, lowness, inferiority of position, the place under or underneath. 3 A wood, a forest. 4 A hole, a pit, a chasm. 5 Cause, origin, motive, the root or seed of events. 6 Sole of the foot. 7 A slap with the hand. nf. (-लं-ला) A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm. m. (-लः) 1 The palmyra tree. 2 The palm with extended fingers. 3 The hilt or handle of a sword, &c. 4 Pressing the strings of a lute with the left hand. 3 The stand or support of any thing, that which is under or below it. 6 The fore arm. 7 A span. E. तल to fix, affix अच्.
17209: तलक n. (-कं) A large pond. E. तल a hole, a hollow, and कन् aff.
17210: तलप्रहार m. (-रः) A slap or blow with the palm of the hand. E. तल the open palm, प्रहार striking.
17211: तलवारण n. (-णं) A sword. E. तल, and वारण opposing.
17212: तलसारक n. (-कं) 1 A martingale. 2 A vessel from which horses are fed. E. तल below, सृ to go, in the causal form, वुन् aff.
17213: तलहृदय n. (-यं) The centre of the sole of the foot. E. तल below, and हृदय heart.
17214: तलाची f. (-ची) A mat, one made of reeds or bamboos. E. तल below, अञ्च to go, क्विप् affix, fem. form.
17215: तलातल n. (-लं) One of the seven divisions of the infernal regions. E. तल below, reiterated, as downadown.
17216: तलिका f. (-का) A martingale. E. तल to fix, and वुन् aff.
17217: तलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fixed, placed, having a bottom. n. (-तं) Fried meat. E. तल to be fixed or to satisfy, क्त aff.
17218: तलिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Separate, having spaces or interstices. 2 Clear, clean. 3 Small, little. 4 Delicate, thin, spare. 5 Below, situated under or underneath. n. (-नं) A bed, a couch or cot. E. तल to fix or be fixed, Uṇādi affix इनन्.
17219: तलिम n. (-मं) 1 Ground prepared for the site of a dwelling, &c. see कुट्टिम. 2 A bed, a couch or cot. 3 An awning. 4 A scymitar, a large sacrificial sword or knife. E. तल to fix, इमन् aff.
17220: तलुन m. (-नः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A youth. f. (-नी) A young woman. E. तॄ to pass, उनन् affix, and र changed to लः see तरुण.
17221: तलेक्षण m. (-णः) A hog. E. तल down, and ईक्षण looking.
17222: तलोदरी f. (-री) A mistress or wife.
17223: तलोदा f. (-दा) A river. E. तल steep, down, उद water.
17224: तल्क n. (-ल्कं) A wood, a forest. E. तल to fix, क Uṇādi aff.
17225: तल्प mn. (-ल्पः-ल्पं) 1 A bed. 2 An upper story, a room on the top of a house, a turret, a tower or keep. 3 A wife. E. तल to fix, Uṇādi affix प.
17226: तल्पकीट m. (-टः) A bug. E. तल्प a bed, and कीट an insect.
17227: तल्पज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Born of a wife, (as a son by an appointed substitute.) 2 Produced in or from a bed, &c. E. तल्प, and ज born.
17228: तल्पन n. (-नं) An elephant's back. 2 The exterior muscles of the back. E. तल्प a nominal verb, to be as a bed, to be broad, &c. and ल्युट् aff.
17229: तल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A reservoir, a large pond, a tank or Talao. f. (-ल्ला) 1 A young woman. 2 A boat. 3 The wife of VARUṆA. n. (-ल्लं) A pit, a hole. E. तल deep, depth, and ल to be or have, from ला with ड aff.
17230: तल्लज m. (-जः) Excellence, happiness; also attributively, Excellent, happy: used in apposition as an epithet, the gender is not changed, as कुमारीतल्लजः an excellent maiden. E. तत् that, (that which is every thing,) and लज to attain, affix अच्.
17232: तल्व n. (-ल्वं) Scent arising from the rubbing of fragrant substances.
17233: तवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Thine. E. कन् added to तव the poss. case of त्वं.
17235: तवराज m. (-जः) A sort of sugar prepared from a species of Hedysarum.
17236: तविष m. (-षः) 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 The ocean. f. (-षी) 1 A river. 2 The daughter of INDRA. 3 Strength, (in the dialect of the Vedas.) E. तव a Sautra root, टिषच् Uṇādi affix; also ताविष and तवीष.
17237: तवीष m. (-षः) 1 Heaven. 2 The ocean. 3 Gold. E. see the last.
17238: तष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pared, made thin. E. तक्ष to pare, affix क्त.
17239: तष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) 1 A carpenter. 2 A name of VIŚVAKARMA. 3 One of the twelve Ādityas or suns; also त्वष्टृ. E. तक्ष to pare, तृच् aff.
17240: तस (इर उ) इरतसु r. 4th cl. (तस्यति) To throw, to toss, to direct, to send. (इ) तसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तंसति तंसयति or with अव prefixed अवतंसति अवतंसयति) To adorn, to dress or decorate.
17241: तसर m. (-रः) A shuttle. E. तन to stretch, क्मरन् Uṇādi aff.
17242: तस्कर m. (-रः) 1 A thief, a robber. 2 The ear. 3 A kind of potherb, (Medicago esculenta.) 3 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa:) see मदन. f. (-री) A passionate woman. E. तत् that, used depreciatingly, and कर who does, सुट् substituted for the final of तत्.
17243: तस्करता f. (-ता) 1 Thievishness, thieving. 2 Hearing, catching by the ear. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तस्करत्वं.
17244: ताटङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) An ornament of the ear, a large sort of ear-ring: see ताडङ्क and तालपत्र.
17245: ताटस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) 1 Indifference, disregard, exemption from attachment or aversion. 2 Proximity. E. तटस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.
17246: ताड m. (-डः) 1 Beating, whipping, inflicting bodily chastisement. 2 Sound, noise. 3 A handful of grass, corn, &c. a sheaf. 4 A mountain. 5 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) f. (-डि or डी) A kind of palm, (Corypha talliera, Rox.) see ताली. E. तड to give pain, to beat, &c. affix घञ्.
17247: ताडका f. (-का) A female demon, killed by RĀMA.
17249: ताडङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A kind of ear-ring: see तालपत्र. E. तड to shine, अङ्कन् affix; also ड being changed to ट, ताटङ्क.
17250: ताडघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Beating with a whip or with strokes of any kind. E. ताड, and घ who strikes.
17251: ताडघात m. (-तः) An artificer who beats or hammers any thing. E. ताड, and घात a blow.
17252: ताडन n. (-नं) Beating, whipping, &c. f. (-नी) A whip. E. तड to beat, अनीयुट् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
17253: ताडनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be beaten, punishable. E. तड to beat, अनीयर् affix; also ताड्य and ताडयितव्य.
17254: ताडपत्र n. (-त्रं) An ornament of the ear. E. ताड the Tāla tree, and पत्र a leaf, an earring resembling this: see तालपत्र.
17255: ताडयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what beats or strikes. E. तड to beat, तृच् aff.
17256: ताडयित्वा ind. Having beaten. E. तड to beat, क्त्वा aff.
17257: ताडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, beaten. E. तड to beat, क्त aff.
17258: ताडुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Beating, who or what beats or strikes. E. तड to give pain, उलच् Uṇādi aff.
17259: ताड्य mfn. (-ड्यः-ड्या-ड्यं) To be beaten or chastised, what may or ought to be punished, punishable. E. तड to beat, ण्यत् aff.
17260: ताड्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being beaten or struck. m. (-नः) A musical instrument, which is struck, as a drum, &c. E. तड to beat or strike, शाणच् affix, यक् inserted.
17261: ताण्डव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 Dancing, especially with violent gesticulation, and particularly applied to the frantic dance of the god ŚIVA, and his votaries. 2 A sort of grass, (Saccharum procerum.) m. (-बः) In prosody, a tribrach or foot of three short syllables. E. तण्डु the name of the Muni, by whom the style of dancing was first taught, affix अण्; or तडि to beat, and अव aff.
17262: ताण्डवतालिक m. (-कः) A name of NANDI, one of ŚIVA'S principal attendants. E. ताण्डव ŚIVA'S dancing, and तालिक accompanier with music, from ताल tune or time, and ठक् aff.
17263: ताण्डवप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of ŚIVA. E. ताण्डव dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
17264: ताण्डि f. (-ण्डिः) The science of dancing. E. तण्डु the teacher of this art, and इञ् aff.
17265: तात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Venerable, reverend, respectable. m. (-तः) 1 A father. 2 A term of affection addressed to any person, but especially to a junior or inferior, as हे तात oh! child, &c. E. तन to extend, (his race or fame,) क्त affix, and the vowel made long.
17266: तातगु mfn. (-गुः-गूः-गु) Paternal, relating or belonging to the father. m. (-गुः) A paternal uncle. E. तात a father, गु who goes or is, from गम to go, with डु aff.
17267: तातजनयित्री f. du. always (-त्र्यौ) Father and mother, parents. E. तात father, and जनयित्री mother.
17268: ताततुल्य m. (-ल्यः) A paternal uncle, or the most respectable of the male relations. E. तात a father, and तुल्य like, equal to.
17270: तातल m. (-लः) 1 A fatherly relative, one who may be considered as a father. 2 Sickness, disease. 3 An iron club or spike. 4 Cooking or maturing. 5 Heat, physical or morbid.
17271: ताति m. (-तिः) A son. E. तन to spread, (the race,) ञि aff.
17272: तात्कालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to any particular moment of time. E. तत्काल, and ठक् aff.
17273: तात्पर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Object, purpose, intent, design. 2 Meaning, purport. 2 Explanation. E. तत्पर intent, यञ् aff.
17274: तात्पर्य्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) The meaning or purpose of a sentence. E. तात्पर्य्य purpose, and अर्थ meaning.
17275: तादर्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) 1 Sameness or precision of meaning. 2 Identity of object. E. तदर्थ, यञ् aff.
17276: तादात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) Identity, unity, sameness. E. तदात्म same, and यञ् aff.
17277: तादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such like, like him or it, &c. E. तद् that, दृश to see, affix क्विन्; also with कञ् affix तादृश. mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) or with क्म affix, तादृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं.)
17278: तान m. (-नः) A tune. n. (-नं) 1 Expanse, extension. 2 An object of sense. E. तन to extend, affix घञ्.
17279: तानव n. (-वं) Thinness, spareness. E. तनु, and अण् aff.
17280: तानूर m. (-रः) A whirlpool. E. तन to spread, ऊरच् aff.
17281: तान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Wearied, fatigued, distressed. 2 Languid, languishing. 3 Faded, withered, blighted. E. तम to be distressed, affix क्त.
17282: तान्तव m. (-वं) Spinning, weaving. E. तन्तु a thread, अण aff.
17283: तान्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्री-न्त्रं) 1 Stringed, having wires or strings, (as a musical instrument.) 2 Relating to the Tantras, &c. E. तन्त्र, and अण् aff.
17284: तान्त्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to the Tāntras, taught by them, following them, &c. 2 Relating to a thread, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A scholar, a man completely versed in any science. 2 A follower of the doctrine taught by the Tantras. E. तन्त्र truth, &c. and ठक् aff.
17286: ताप m. (-पः) 1 Heat, burning, (moral or physical.) 2 Pain, sorrow, distress. E. तप to burn or inflame, affix घञ् f. (-पी) A name of the Tapti or Surat river. 2 A name of the Yamunā or Jumna river. E. तप the sun, affix of descent इण्.
17287: तापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Burning, inflaming, heating. m. (-कः) Fever, morbid heat. E. तप to burn, ण्वुल् aff.
17288: तापत्य m. (-त्यः) ARJUNA. E. तपती, and यञ् affix of descent.
17289: तापन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) What heats or inflames. m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 One of KĀMA'S arrows, the inflamer. 3 Sun-shine. 4 Heating, inflaming. E. तप to heat, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
17290: तापनीय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Golden, made of gold. E. तपनीय, and अण् aff.
17291: तापस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Performing penance, a practiser of devout austerities, a devotee, an ascetic. m. (-सः) A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea). n. (-सं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तपस penance, affix अण्.
17292: तापसक m. (-कः) A contemptible devotee, one not long engaged in austerities. E. तापस, and कन् depreciative aff.
17293: तापसतरु m. (-रुः) A tree, commonly Ingua or Jiyaputa, (Nagelia putranjiva.) E. तापस an ascetic, and तरु a tree; also similar compounds, as तापसद्रुम, तापसवृक्ष, &c.
17294: तापसप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, (Chironjia sapida:) see पियाल. f. (-या) A grape. E. तापस an ascetic, प्रिय beloved by.
17295: तापहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Cooling, removing heat. 2 Consoling, alleviating distress. f. (-री) A dish, a sort of soup, of pulse and grain, first fried with ghee and turmeric, and afterwards boiled with salt and sugar. E. ताप, and हर what removes.
17296: तापिच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree bearing dark blossoms, the Tamāla: see the next.
17297: तापिञ्छ m. (-ञ्छः) The Tamāla tree, (Xanthocymus pictorius.) E. तापिन् a person heated, and छद what covers or shelters, ड affix, deriv. irr.; also the final being dropped तापिच्छ, and with जि to conquer or remove तातिञ्ज.
17298: तापिञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) The Tamāla tree. n. (-ञ्जं) Sulphuret of iron: see the preceding.
17299: तापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Inflamed. 2 Distressed, pained. E. तप to inflame, affix क्त.
17300: तापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Oppressed by heat, morbid, moral or physical; any thing heated or glowing. m. (-पी) One of the deified saints of the Bauddhas. E. तप to heat, affix णिनि.
17301: ताप्य mn. (-प्यः-प्यं) A mineral substance, sulphuret of iron. E. तापी the river, and यत् affix; said to be procured from the Tāpi river; also with कन् added ताप्यकं.
17302: ताम m. (-मः) 1 An object of terror. 2 Fault, defect, vice. 3 Anxiety, distress. 4 Desire. E. तम to be distressed, affix घञ्.
17303: तामर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Ghee or oiled butter. E. ताम desire, and र from रा to get or have; desirable for drinking, &c.
17304: तामरस n. (-सं) 1 A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.) 2 Copper. 3 Gold. 4 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. तामर water, सम to abide, and ड affix; or ताम desire, and रस here implying object.
17305: तामलकी f. (-की) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see भूम्यामलकी. E. तम to desire, to be as it were, or resemble, आमलकी the Āmalaki.
17306: तामलिप्त nf. (-प्तं-प्ती) A district in the south of Bengal, commonly Tumlook. E. ताम distress, trouble, and लिप्त smeared, affected.
17307: तामस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) 1 Affected by or appertaining to the third quality, that of darkness or vice: belonging to it, as a Purāṇa, a system of philosophy, a ceremonial rite, &c. 2 Dark, of or belonging to darkness. m. (-सः) 1 A snake. 2 An incendiary, a malignant and mischievous man, a villain. 3 An owl. 4 The fourth Menu. f. (-सी) 1 A dark night. 2 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. n. (-सं) The quality of darkness. E. तमस् the quality of darkness, &c. affix अण्.
17308: तामसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Of or belonging to the quality of darkness, derived from it, teaching lessons so characterised, &c. 2 Of or belonging to physical darkness. E. तसस्, and ठञ् aff.
17309: तामिस्र n. (-स्रं) 1 Great darkness. 2 A hell, that of deep gloom. m. (-स्रः) Indignation at being disappointed or slighted. E. तमिस्र, and अण् added.
17310: ताम्बूल nf. (-लं-ली) 1 Areca, (Areca faufel or catechu.) 2 Betel, (Piper betel,) or its pungent leaf, which together with the areca nut and catechu, and sometimes caustic lime and spices, is eaten very generally by the natives of the east. n. (-लं) The areca nut. m. (-लः) Śaṇa, a plant, (Crotolaria juncea.) E. तम to desire, affix उलच्, and वुक्र् augment, the radical vowel made long.
17311: ताम्बूलकरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The Pān-dān or betel-box. E. ताम्बूल as above, and करङ्क a hollowed cocoanut, &c. which the Panbox usually resembles.
17312: ताम्बूलद m. (-दः) The betel bearer; kings and great men being attended by an officer of this description. E. ताम्बूल betel, and द who gives.
17313: ताम्बूलपेटिका f. (-का) A betel box. E. ताम्बूल, and पेटिका a casket.
17314: ताम्बूलराग m. (-गः) A kind of pulse, (Ervum lens.) E. ताम्बूल betel, and राग colour.
17315: ताम्बूलवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A small plant bearing a pungent leaf, which with the areca nut, a small quantity of caustic lime (or Chunam) and catechu, and occasionally cloves, cardamoms, &c. form the Pan or betel of the Asiatic, (Piper betel.) E. ताम्बूल the same, and वल्ली foot-stalk; also with कन् added ताम्बूलवल्लिका.
17316: ताम्बूलवाहक m. (-कः) A betel bearer, a servant attached to men of rank to prepare the pān, and carry the betel box. E. ताम्बूल, and वाहक who carries; also ताम्बूलवाहिन् m. (-ही).
17317: ताम्बूलिक mf. (-कः-की) A seller of betel. E. ताम्बूल, and ठक् aff.
17318: ताम्बूलिन् mf. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Relating or belonging to a Pān, having one, giving one, &c. m. (-ली) The Pān bearer, a servant who prepares and furnishes the Pān. E. ताम्बूल as above, इनि aff.
17319: ताम्यत् mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-भ्यत्) Distressing, afflicting, annoying. E. तम to distress, शतृ aff.
17320: ताम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्री-म्रं) Of a coppery red colour. n. (-म्रं) 1 Copper. 2 A kind of sandal, represented as of a dark red colour, and smelling like a lotus. 3 A dark or coppery red. m. (-म्रः) A leprosy with large red spots. f. (-म्री) A copper or metallic cup of prescribed capacity, and perforated by a small hole at the bottom, answering the purpose of an hour glass: it is put into a vessel of water, the water gradually filling it, and the cup sinking, marks the time that has elapsed. E. तम to desire, Uṇādi affix रक, and the vowel made long; or ताम्र copper, अण् and ङीष् affixes, implying analogy or derivation.
17321: ताम्रक n. (-कं) Copper. E. ताम्र as above, and कन् pleonastic aff.
17322: ताम्रकर्णी f. (-र्णी) A name of the female elephant of the west. E. ताम्र coppery, and कर्ण ear.
17323: ताम्रकार m. (-रः) A brazier, a copper-smith. E. ताम्र copper, and कार worker.
17324: ताम्रकिलि m. (-लिः) A small worm of a red colour. E. ताम्र red, and किलि a worm.
17325: ताम्रकुट m. (कः) A brazier or copper smith. E. ताम्र copper, कुट to cut, क्वुन् aff.
17326: ताम्रकुट्टक m. (-कः) Tobacco. E. ताम्र, and कुट्ट a point: the word is imitative of the foreign original.
17327: ताम्रकृमि m. (-मिः) The lady-bird, (Coccinella.) E. ताम्र red, and कृमि a worm.
17328: ताम्रगर्भ n. (-र्भं) Blue vitriol or sulphate of copper. E. ताम्र copper, and गर्भ womb or source.
17329: ताम्रचूड m. (-डः) A cock. E. ताम्र, and चूडा a crest.
17330: ताम्रतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Having a ruddy or fair complexion, copper-coloured. E. ताम्र, and तनु body.
17331: ताम्रपट्ट n. (-ट्टं) A copper plate, such as Hindu grants of land, &c. are frequently inscribed on. E. ताम्र copper, and पट्ट a cloth.
17332: ताम्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A large pond or lake. 2 The name of a river in the peninsula, and of the district in its vicinity.
17333: ताम्रपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plate of copper. m. (-त्रः) A potherb: see जीव. E. ताम्र, and पत्र a leaf.
17334: ताम्रपाकिन् m. (-की) A tree: see गर्द्दभाण्ड. E. ताम्र red, and पाकिन् ripening, the fruit being of this colour.
17335: ताम्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A kind of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) 2 A plant, (Kæmpferia rotunda.) f. (-ष्पा) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens). f. (-ष्पी) 1 Lythrum fruticosum: see धातृपुष्पिका. 2 Trumpet flower. 3 Red Tëori: see त्रिकृत्. E. ताम्र coppery red, and पुष्प a flower, bearing red blossoms.
17336: ताम्रफल m. (-लः) A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) E. ताम्र copper, and फल fruit.
17337: ताम्रफलक n. (-कं) A copper plate. E. ताम्र, and फलक a plank or board.
17338: ताम्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Copper-coloured, fair-complexioned. m. (-खः) A European. E. ताम्र, and मुख face.
17339: ताम्रमूला f. (-ला) A plant: see ग्राहिणी. E. ताम्र copper, and मूल root.
17340: ताम्रमृग m. (-गः) The red deer. E. ताम्र, and मृग a deer.
17341: ताम्रवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Red, copper-coloured. f. (-र्णी) The blossom of sesamum. E. ताम्र, and वर्ण colour.
17342: ताम्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) 2 A medicinal plant used as an emollient in affections of the mouth and fauces; also called तमाली, ताली, सूक्ष्मवल्ली, &c. E. ताम्र copper, and वल्ली pedicle.
17343: ताम्रवीज m. (-जः) A kind of vetch: see कुलत्य. E. ताम्र copper, and वीज the seed.
17344: ताम्रवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of Sandal wood. E. ताम्र copper, and ष्टक्ष a tree.
17345: ताम्रवृन्त mf. (-न्तः-न्ता) A kind of vetch: see कुलत्य. E. ताम्र copper, or coppery, वृत्त foot-stalk.
17346: ताम्रशिखिन् m. (-खी) A cock. E. ताम्र copper, शिखा a crest, and इनि affix: see ताम्रचूड.
17347: ताम्रसार m. (-रः) A red kind of Sandal, (Pterospermum santolinum). E. ताम्र copper, and सार pith.
17348: ताम्राकु m. (-कुः) One of the eighteen minor divisions of the known continent.
17349: ताम्राक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. m. (-क्षः) The Koil or Kokila, the Indian cuckoo. E. ताम्र, and अक्षि an eye.
17350: ताम्राभ n. (-भं) Red saunders. E. ताम्र copper, and आभ resembling.
17351: ताम्रार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) Mixed or bell metal. E. ताम्र copper, and अर्द्ध part or half.
17352: ताम्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of copper, made of copper, &c. m. (-कः) A brazier, a copper smith. E. ताम्र copper, and ठक् affix. f. (-का) A copper vessel for marking time. E. कन् added to ताम्री, q. v.
17353: ताय (ऋ) तायृ r. 1st cl. (तायते) 1 To spread, to extend, to proceed in a continuous stream or line. 2 To cherish or protect.
17354: तायिक m. (-कः) A country; or plu. m. (-काः) Its inhabitants. E. ताय to cherish, इकन् aff.
17355: तार mfn. adj. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 High, as a note in music. 2 Radiant, shining, radiating. 3 Clean, clear. 4 Good, excellent, well flavoured, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A high note or tone in music. 2 Elegance of a pearl. 3 A clear or beautiful pearl. 4 Crossing, passing over, &c. 5 A wire, a chord. 6 The mystic monosyllable. Om. 7 A mystical monosyllable in the Tantras. 8 The name of a monkey chief, the son of BĀLĪ. n. (-रं) 1 Silver. 2 A pearl. mfn. subst. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 The pupil of the eye. 2 A star in general, a planet, an asterism, &c. f. (-रा) A female deity peculiar to the Bauddha sect. 2 The wife of VṚHASPATI. 3 The wife of the monkey king SUGRĪVA. 4 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. तॄ to pass or proceed; also in the causal, to cause to pass, and अच् or घञ् aff.
17356: तारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 A protector, a preserver. 2 One who causes or enables to pass or go over. n. (-कं) 1 The eye. 2 A Mantra, a formula addressed to Rāma, as Rāmāya namaḥ, nf. (-कं-का) 1 The pupil of the eye. 2 A star. mn. (-कः-कं) A float or raft. m. (-कः) A pilot, a helmsman or steersman. 2 The name of a demon or evil spirit destroyed by KĀRTTIKEYA. E. तॄ to pass or cause to pass, and ण्वुल् affix; or कन added to the preceding.
17357: तारकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. तारक a demon, and जित् conqueror: also similar names, as तारकारि, तारकहन्, तारकरिपु, &c.
17358: तारकारि m. (-रिः) The deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. तारक, and अरि a foe: see the preceding.
17359: तारकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Starry. E. तारक a star, इतच् aff.
17360: तारकिन् mfn. (-की-किणी-कि) Starry. f. (-णी) Night. E. तारक, and इनि aff.
17361: तारण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Who or what causes or enables to cross. m. (-णः) A raft, a float. n. (-णं) Carrying or conveying across. E. तॄ to cross, affix ल्युट्.
17362: तारणि f. (-णिः) A boat. E. तॄ to pass over, अनि aff.
17363: तारतम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 More or less, the state or condition. 2 Dependance of larger numbers on smaller in a progressive series. E. तर, and तम affixes of the comparative and superlative degrees, and ष्यञ् aff.
17364: तारनाद m. (-दः) A loud sound or noise. E. तार, and नाद sound.
17365: तारल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Libidinous, dissipated, a lecher. E. तरल unsteady, affix अण्.
17366: तारविमला f. (-ला) A sort of mineral said to be of the colour of silver. E. तार a star, and विमल pure, clean.
17367: तारशुद्धिकर n. (-रं) Lead. E. तार silver, शुद्धिकर what refines.
17368: ताराधिपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. तारा a star, and अधिपति a ruler.
17369: तारापथ m. (-थः) The atmosphere, the firmament, heaven or sky. E. तारा a star, and पथ for पथिन् a path.
17370: तारापीड m. (-डः) The moon. E. तार a star, and आपीड a chaplet.
17371: ताराभूषा f. (-षा) Night. E. तारा, and भूषा ornament.
17372: ताराभ्र m. (-भ्रः) Camphor. E. तारा, and अभ्र talc.
17373: तारामण्डल m. (-लः) 1 A large splendid temple. 2 The region of the stars. E. तारा a star, and मण्डल a region; shining with gold and jewels as with stars.
17374: तारारि m. (-रिः) A pyritic ore of iron: see विट्माक्षिक. E. तारा the pupil of the eye, and अरि hostile.
17375: तारिक n. (-कं) Fare, freight, toll. f. (-का) 1 A star; also तारका. 2 The juice of the palmyra tree, especially when become a spirit by spontaneous fermentation. E. तर fare, ठक् affix, or तारक fem. form, or ताल and कन् added, ल changed to र.
17376: तारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Enabling or causing to cross or get over. f. (-णी) 1 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas or Bauddhas. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. तॄ to cause to proceed, (life, fortune, &c.) and ङीष् aff.
17377: तारीष m. (-षः) 1 Svarga or paradise. 2 The ocean. 3 Gold. f. (-षी) The daughter of INDRA. E. तृ to cross, ईषन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्: see तरीष and तविष.
17378: तारुण्य n. (-ण्यं) Youth. E. तरुण young, ष्यञ् aff.
17379: तारेय m. (-यः) The son of BĀLĪ, the monkey. E. तारा the wife of BALI, and ढक् aff.
17380: तार्क्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Spun, made with or belonging to a spindle. E. तर्कु, and अण् aff.
17381: तार्क्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or attached to the science of reasoning or logic. m. (-कः) A philosopher, a sophist, a follower of either of the six schools of Hindu philosophy. E. तर्क doubt, disputation, affix ठक्.
17382: तार्क्ष m. (-र्क्षः) A name of KAŚYAPA.
17383: तार्क्ष्य m. (-र्क्ष्यः) 1 A horse. 2 A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 3 A name of ARUṆA, or the dawn personified, considered as the elder brother of GARUḌA. 4 A car, a chariot. 5 A snake. 6 Gold. 7 A tree, the Sal, (Shorea robusta.) n. (-र्क्ष्यं) A sort of collyrium. f. (-र्क्ष्यी) A wild creeper. E. तृक्ष to go, घञ् affix तार्क्ष and यत् added; again, तृक्ष or तार्क्षं considered as a name of KAŚYAPA the father of ARUṆA, &c. ष्यञ् or अण् aff.
17384: तार्क्ष्यध्वज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. तार्क्ष्य GARUḌA, and ध्वज emblem or symbol.
17385: तार्क्ष्यनायक m. (-कः) GARUḌA. E. तार्क्ष्य, and नायक leader.
17386: तार्क्ष्यशैल n. (-लं) A substance prepared from the calx of brass, or from the Amomum anthorrhiza, and used as a medical application to the eyes; see रसाञ्जन. E. तार्क्ष्य a collyrium, and शैल derived from शिला a rock or stone.
17387: तार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be crossed or carried across, to be ferried over. n. (-र्य्यं) Toll, fare, freight. E. तृ to cross, ण्यत् aff.
17388: ताल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Made of the palm wood. m. (-लः) 1 Beating time in music, musical time or measure. 2 A short span, one measured by the thumb and middle finger. 3 Slapping or clapping the hands together, or against the arms, &c. 4 The open hand with the fingers extended, the palm. 5 A musical instrument of bell metal or brass, (a sort of cymbal,) played with a stick. 6 The hilt of a sword or sacrificial knife, &c. 7 The palmyra tree or fan palm, (Borassus flabelliformis.) 8 A lock, a bolt. 9 In prosody, a trochee. n. (-लं) 1 The throne of DURGĀ. 2 Yellow orpiment: see हरिताल. 3 The fruit of the palm tree. f. (-ली) 1 A sort of key or pin. 2 A species of the mountain palm, (Corypha taliera, Rox.) 3 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झटा and अमला. 4 A fragrant earth: see तुवरिका. 5 A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.) 6 The spirituous juice of the palm, the common Toddy. E. तल to fix or तन to spread, affix घञ्; or in the causal form, with अच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्, न changed to ल; otherwise, तड to beat, to overcome, (disease, &c.) अच् and ङीष् affixes, and ड changed to ल; the adjective is derived from the substantive by adding अण्.
17389: तालक n. (-कं) 1 A bolt, a latch, a kind of lock for fastening a door with. 2 Yellow orpiment. 3 A fragrant earth. E. कन् added to the preceding.
17390: तालकाभ adj. mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Green. m. (-भः) Green, the colour. E. तालक yellow orpiment, and आभ what resembles.
17391: तालकी f. (-की) Toddy, or the fermented exudation of the palm trees. E. ताल the palmyra, कन् aff.
17392: तालजटा f. (-टा) The fibres of the palm tree under the outer bark. E. ताल, and जटा matted hair.
17393: तालध्वज m. (-जः) A name of BALARĀMA. f. (-जा) The name of a city. E. ताल the palm, and ध्वज a banner.
17394: तालपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A hollow cylinder of gold with or without a ring attached to it, thrust through the lobe of the ear, and worn as an ornament. 2 The palm leaf. E. ताल the palmyra, and पत्र a leaf, pieces of the leaf of this tree being rolled up and used occasionally for the purpose or as a substitute. f. (-त्री) A plant: see मूषिकपर्णी. E. as above; the leaves resembling those of the palm tree, or the palm of the hand.
17395: तालपर्ण nf. (-र्णं-र्णी) 1 A kind of vegetable perfume: see मुरा. f. (-र्णी) A sort of anise, (Anethum pammorium, Rox.) E. ताल the palm, and पर्ण a leaf, palm-leaved.
17396: तालपुष्पक n. (-कं) A medicinal application to the eyes. E. ताल the palmyra, पुष्प a flower, and कन् affix; perhaps prepared from the blossoms of the palmyra.
17397: तालप्रलम्व n. (-म्वं) The fibres that grow on the cocoanut and other palms, under the outer rind, and from which Coir, a sort of cordage, is prepared. E. ताल, and प्रलम्व what depends.
17398: तालभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of BALARĀMA. E. तास्व the palm, and भृत् who retains, (as his banner or symbol:) see तालध्वज, &c.
17399: तालमय mn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of the palm, &c. E. ताल, and मयट् aff.
17400: तालमूली f. (-ली) A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.) E. ताल the palm, and मूल a root, having a similar root; also with कन् added तालमूलिका f. (-का).
17401: तालयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A lock, a lock and key. 2 A small pair of pincers. E. ताल, and यन्त्र instrument.
17402: ताललक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) A name of BALARĀMA. E. ताल, and लक्ष्मन् a mark or sign: see तालध्वज.
17403: तालवृन्त m. (-न्तः) A fan. E. ताल the palm of the hand, and वृन्त a root-stalk; expanding from the hand like a leaf from its stem; also with कन् added तालवृन्तक.
17404: तालवृन्तक n. (-कं) A fan, a Pankha: see the preceding.
17405: तालवेचनक m. (-कः) A dancer, an actor. E. ताल musical tone, विच to observe, ल्यु affix, तालवेचन and कन् pleonasm added; also read तालरेचनक.
17406: तालाख्या f. (-ख्या) A perfume: see मुरा. E. ताल, the palmyra, and आख्या a name.
17407: तालाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 A saw. 3 A book. 4 A name of ŚIVA. 5 A man marked with every fortunate spot or sign, &c. 6 A sort of vegetable. E. ताल the tree, and अङ्क mark or emblem.
17408: तालावचर m. (-रः) A dancer, an actor. E. ताल musical time, अवचर to follow or perform, to affix अच्.
17409: तालि f. (-लिः) A kind of palm, (Corypha taliera:) see ताली.
17410: तालिक mf. (-कः-का) The open palm of the hand. m. (-कः) A tie, a seal, a string, &c. binding a letter or parcel of papers. f. (-का) A plant: see तालमूली. E. ताल as above, and कन् affix.
17411: तालित n. (-तं) 1 Any musical instrument. 2 Dyed or coloured cloth. 3 A string, a tie. E. ताल musical time, &c. इतच् aff.
17412: तालिश m. (-शः) A mountain. E. ताल to be fixed, इश Uṇādi affix, the radical vowel made long.
17413: तालीश n. (शं) A tree, commonly Tālīśa or its leaf. E. ताल the corypha, ईश what resembles.
17414: तालीशपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 2 A tree, Tāliśa or its leaf, which is used in medicine. E. तालीश as above, and पत्र a leaf.
17415: तालु n. (-लु) The palate. E. तॄ to pass, to go, Uṇādi affix, ञुण्; by which words, &c. proceed.
17416: तालुका f. (-का) The palate. E. तालु, and कन् added.
17417: तालुजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) 1 The uvula. 2 A crocodile. E. तालु the palate, and जिह्वा the tongue.
17418: तालुपुप्पुट m. (-टः) An indolent swelling of the palate.
17419: तालूर m. (-रः) A whirlpool, an eddy. E. तल to be deep, उरन् affix; also read तालुर.
17420: तावक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Thine. E. तवक, and अण् added.
17421: तावकीन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Thine. E. तवक for तव thine, and खञ् aff.
17422: तावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 So many, as many, as much. 2 All. ind. So much, so far, so many, unto, until, the correlative to यावत्. E. तत् that, then, and डावत् affix: see यावत्.
17423: तावतिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Of so much, worth so much, &c. see the next.
17424: तावत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Of so much, bought for so much, &c. E. कन् added to तावत्; also with इट् inserted तावतिक.
17425: तावत्काल adv. n. (-लं) For so long a period, for such a time. E. तावत्, and काल time.
17426: तावद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Measuring so much. E. तावत्, and द्धयसच् aff.
17427: तावन्मात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) So much. E. तावत्, and मात्रच् aff.
17429: ताविष m. (-षः) 1 Svarga or paradise. 2 The ocean. f. (-षी) The daughter of INDRA. 2 A river. 3 The earth. E. तव a Sautra root, Uṇādi affix टिषच्; also read तविष, तवीष, &c.
17431: तास्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Theft, robbery. E. तस्कर, and यञ् aff.
17432: तिक r. 1st cl. (ऋ) तिकृ (तेकते) To go or move. r. 5th cl. (तिक्नोति) 1 To go. 2 To assail, to assault. 3 To seek to injure or kill: see तिग.
17433: तिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Bitter. 2 Fragrant. m. (-क्तः) 1 A bitter taste, bitterness. 2 Fragrance, perfume. 3 A medicinal plant, (Echites antidysenterica.) 4 A tree, (Capparis trifoliata:) see वरुण. f. (-क्ता) Katuki, a medicinal plant. n. (-क्तं) A medicinal plant, (Mollugo pentaphylla.) E. तिज to sharpen, (the appetite,) affix क्त.
17434: तिक्तक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of gourd, (Trichosanthes diœca, Rox.) 2 A sort of gentian, (G. cherayta.) 3 A dark sort of the Khayar or Mimosa catechu. E. कन् added to तिक्त a bitter; alluding to the taste of these substances.
17435: तिक्तगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) E. तिक्त fragrant, and गन्ध smell, fem. affix टाप्; also with कन् added, and the fem. form, तिक्तगन्धिका.
17436: तिक्ततुम्बी f. (-म्बी) A bitter gourd. E. तिक्त, and तुम्बी a gourd.
17437: तिक्तदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) A medicinal kind of moon plant: see स्वर्णक्षीरी. E. तिक्त bitter, and दुग्ध milk.
17438: तिक्तपत्र m. (-त्रः) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica mixta.) E. तिक्त bitter, and पत्र a leaf.
17439: तिक्तपर्व्वन् f. (-र्व्वां) 1 A potherb, (Hilancha repens.) 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 Liquorice. E. तिक्त bitter, and पर्व्वन् a joint.
17440: तिक्तभद्रक m. (-कः) A kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. तिक्त bitter, and भद्रक auspicious, useful in medicine.
17441: तिक्तरोहिणिका f. (-का) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. तिक्त bitter, and रोहिणी the same plant, कन् added.
17442: तिक्तवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) E. तिक्त bitter, and वल्ली a stalk.
17443: तिक्तशाक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Capparis trifoliata:) see वरुण. 2 A kind of mimosa: see खदिर. E. तिक्त bitter, and शाक an esculent vegetable; also तिक्तशाकक.
17444: तिक्तसार m. (-रः) A sort of mimosa, (M. catechu:) see खदिर E. तिक्त bitter, and सार pith.
17445: तिक्तिका f. (-का) A bitter gourd. E. तिक्त, and कन् aff.
17446: तिग r. 5th cl. (तिग्नोति) 1 To go or move. 2 To assail. 3 To seek to injure, to attempt to kill, &c. also तिक.
17447: तिग्म mfn. (-ग्मः-ग्मा-ग्मं) 1 Hot. 2 Pungent, acrid. 3 Sharp, (as a weapon.) 4 Passionate, hasty. n. (-ग्मं) Heat; also the heat of spices, or pungency. E. तिज to sharpen, Uṇādi affix मक्.
17448: तिग्मता f. (-ता) 1 Sharpness. 2 Pungency. 3 Heat. 4 Passion, petulance. E. तल added to तिग्म; also with त्व, तिग्मत्वं.
17449: तिग्मरुच् mfn. (-रुक्) 1 Bright, shining. 2 Hot. m. (रुक्) The sun. E. तिग्म, and रुच् light.
17450: तिग्मांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. तिग्म hot, and अंश्रु a ray; also similar compounds, as तिग्मकर, तिग्मरश्मि.
17451: तिघ r. 5th cl. (तिघ्नोति) To strike, to hurt or kill.
17452: तिङ्गुद m. (-दः) The name of a plant: see इङ्गुद.
17453: तिज r. 1st cl. (तितिक्षते) To bear, to endure, to suffer with patience. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तेजते तेजयति) 1 To whet, to sharpen. 2 To shine: see तेज.
17454: तिजिल m. (लः) 1 The moon. 2 A Rākṣasa. E. तिज to shine, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
17455: तिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A plant, commonly Teori, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
17456: तितउ mn. (-उः-उ) A sieve, a cribble. E. तन to spread or scatter, (grain, &c.) डौ Uṇādi affix, and the radical reiterated.
17457: तितिक्षा f. (-क्षा) Patience, resignation, sufferance, endurance. E. तिज to bear, अङ् and टाप् affix, and the root repeated.
17458: तितिक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Patient, resigned. E. तिज to bear, affix इतच्, and the root reduplicate.
17459: तितिक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Patient, resigned. E. तिज to bear, reduplicated, and उ aff.
17461: तितिल n. (-लं) 1 One of the seven Karaṇas, or astronomical periods so called. 2 A bowl or bucket. 3 A sort of sweetmeat made of sesamum, ground, and baked with sugar. E. तिल to go, affix क, and the radical reiterated: see तैतिल.
17462: तितीर्षा f. (-र्षा) 1 Wish to cross. 2 Wish to be freed from life. E. तॄ to cross, desid, form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
17463: तितीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) 1 Desirous of crossing. 2 Desirous of emancipation from existence. E. तॄ to cross, desid. form, affix उ.
17464: तित्तिर m. (रः) The francoline partridge: see the next.
17465: तित्तिरि m. (-रिः) 1 The francoline partridge. 2 The name of a Muni, and one of the early teachers of the Taittiri or Black Yajur Veda. 3 The Yajur Veda, named after its teacher. E. तित्ति an imitative sound, रा to make, affix कि; also with क affix तित्तिर.
17466: तिथ m. (-थः) 1 Fire. 2 KĀMA or love. 3 Time. E. तिथ to inflame, Uṇādi affix थक्, and the radical final rejected.
17467: तिथि mf. (-थिः-थिः or -थी) A lunar day, (1/30)th of a whole lunation. E. अत to go, to proceed, affix इथिन् and the radical initial rejected; also ङीष् being added तिथी.
17468: तिथिक्षय m. (-यः) Day of new moon. E. तिथि, and क्षय destruction.
17469: तिथिप्रणी m. (-णीः) The moon. E. तिथि a lunar day, प्र before णी to get or obtain, affix क्विप्.
17470: तिनाशक m. (-कः) A tree: see the next.
17471: तिनिश m. (-शः) A tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.) E. अति exceeding, निश to meditate, affix क and the initial of the prefix rejected, deriv. irr.
17472: तिन्तिड mf. (-डः-डी) The tamarind tree, (Tamarindus Indica.) m. (-डः) 1 The name of a demon. 2 Acid seasoning, sour sauce. 3 An inauspicious period, the evil aspect of planets, &c. f. (-डी) Emblic myrobalan. E. तिम to be damp or moist, अच् affix, the root reduplicated, and ड substituted for the final म.
17473: तिन्तिडिका f. (-का) The tamarind tree. E. कन् added to तिन्तिडी.
17474: तिन्तिडीक subst. mfn. (-कः-का-कं) The tamarind tree. n. (-कं) 1 Acid seasoning. 2 The fruit of the tamarind. E. तिन्तिड as above, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
17475: तिन्तिडीद्यूत n. (-तं) A kind of game, a sort of odd or even played with tamarind seeds. E. तिन्तिडी the tamarind, and द्यूत playing.
17476: तिन्तिली f. (-ली) The tamarind tree. E. see तिन्तिड, ल being substituted for ड; also कन् being added in the usual form, तिन्तिलिका, or retaining the final तिन्तिलीका.
17477: तिन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A species of ebony, from the fruit of which a kind of resin is obtained, that is used in India as pitch for caulking vessels, &c. (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. तिम to be wet or moist, affix कु; also with कन् added, तिन्दुक.
17478: तिन्दुक mf. (-कः-की) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) f. (-की) The resinous fruit of this tree: see the preceding. Also with इ substituted for the final तिन्दुकि. n. (-कं) A Karṣa, the measure. E. तिन्दु, and कन् added.
17479: तिन्दुल m. (-लः) A sort of ebony: see the preceding. E. लच् added to तिन्दु.
17480: तिप (उ ऋ) उ तिपृ r. 1st cl. (तेपते) To sprinkle, to distil or drop, to ooze or leak.
17481: तिम r. 4th cl. (तिम्यति) To be or become wet, damp, &c.
17482: तिम m. (-मः) A fish: see the next.
17483: तिमि m. (-मिः) 1 A whale, or a fabulous fish of an enormous size, said to be one hundred Yojanas long. 2 The ocean. E. तम to distress, इन् affix, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; otherwise तिम to be wet or watery, affix कि, or with क affix तिम.
17484: तिमिकोष m. (-षः) The ocean. E. तिमि a fish, as above, and कोष receptacle: also तिमिकोषक.
17485: तिमिङ्गिल m. (-लः) A large fabulous fish: see तिमि. E. तिमि the fish so called, and गिल who swallows, (from गॄ with क affix, र changed to ल) and मुम् augment.
17486: तिमिङ्गिलगिल m. (-लः) A fabulous fish larger than either of the preceding: see तिमि and तिमिंगिल. E. तिमिङ्गिल the fish so called, and गिल who devours.
17487: तिमित mn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wet, moist, moistened, damp. 2 Steady, fixed, unmoved, unshaken. E. तिम to be wet or damp, affix क्त.
17488: तिमिर n. (-रं) 1 Darkness. 2 Gutta serena, total blindness from affection of the optic nerve. E. तिम to be damp, or तम to give pain, किरच् Uṇādi affix, in the latter case इत् is inserted.
17489: तिमिररिपु m. (-पुः) The sun. E. तिमिर darkness, and रिपु an enemy.
17490: तिमिष n. (-षः) 1 A kind of pumpkin gourd: see ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी. 2 A watermelon. E. तम to desire or be desired, इषच् affix, इत् inserted.
17491: तिरश्चीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sideways, awry, irregular. E. तिय्यच् and ख aff.
17492: तिरस् ind. 1 Indirectly, underhandedly, secretly, covertly. 5 Crookedly, awry. 6 A particle of abuse or depreciation. E. तॄ to go, असच् aff.
17493: तिरस्करिणी f. (-णी) 1 An outer tent, a Kenāt, a wall or screen of cloth surrounding the principal tent. 2 A veil. 3 A curtain. E. तिरस् secret, and करिणी making; also with the antepen. vowel long, तिरस्कारिणी.
17494: तिरस्कार m. (-रः) 1 Disrespect, abuse, reproach. 2 Disappearance, concealment. E. तिरस् disrespect, and कार making.
17495: तिरस्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reviled, abused, reproached, censured. 2 Veiled, hidden. 3 Vanished, disappeared. E. तिरस्, and कृत made.
17496: तिरस्क्रिया f. (-या) 1 Disrespect, contempt, reproach. 2 Disappearance, concealment. E. तिरस् disrespect, and क्रिया action.
17497: तिरिट m. (-टः) The joint of the sugar cane.
17498: तिरिम m. (-मः) A kind of rice.
17499: तिरिय m. (-यः) A sort of rice.
17500: तिरीट m. (-टः) Pale Lodh, a kind of tree: see लोध्र. n. (-टं) A diadem, a tiara. E. तॄ to pass, कीटन् Uṇādi aff.
17501: तिरोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disappeared, vanished, out of sight. E. तिरस्, and गत gone.
17502: तिरोधान n. (-नं) 1 A cover or concealment, a sheath, a veil, a cloth or cloak, any thing which withholds another from sight. 2 Disappearance, the being hidden or the act of hiding or vanishing. E. तिरस् concealing, and धान having or holding.
17503: तिरोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered, concealed, hidden, removed or withdrawn from sight. E. तिरम् covering, धा to have, affix क्त.
17504: तिर्य्यक् ind. Crookedly, awry: see तिर्य्यच्.
17505: तिर्य्यक्स्रोतस् m. (-ताः) An animal, a beast or bird. E. तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and स्रोतस् motion.
17506: तिर्य्यग्ज mfn. (-ग्जः-ग्जा-ग्जं) Born of an animal or insect. E. तिर्य्यच्, and ज born.
17507: तिर्य्यग्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of the brute species, born as an animal. f. (-तिः) The brute kind. E. तिर्य्यच्, and जाति species.
17508: तिर्य्यग्यवोदर n. (-रं) A barley corn. E. तिर्य्यच् curved, यव barley, उदर the interior.
17509: तिर्य्यग्यान m. (-नः) A crab. E. तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and यान motion, going.
17510: तिर्य्यग्योनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Born of or as an animal. E. तिर्य्यच्, and योनि place of birth.
17511: तिर्य्यग्योन्यन्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the brute kind. m. (-यः) The race or kind of animals, birds, &c. E. तिर्य्यग्योनि, and अन्वय race.
17512: तिर्य्यच् or तिर्य्यञ्च् mfn. (तिर्य्यङ् तिरञ्ची तिर्य्यक्) Moving tortuously, going crookedly or awry, (the neuter is also used adverbially: see तिर्य्यक्.) m. (-र्य्यङ्) 1 An animal, a quadruped. 2 A bird, or any animal moving tortuously. f. (-र्य्यञ्ची) The female of an animal, a beast or bird. E. तिरस् crookedly, अञ्च to go, affix क्विप्.
17513: तिल r. 1st cl. (तेलति) To go. r. 6th cl. (तिलति) and 10th cl. (तेलयति) 1 To be unctuous or greasy. 2 To oil or anoint.
17514: तिल m. (-लः) 1 A plant bearing an oily seed; the oil and seed being both much used in Oriental cooking, (Sesamum orientale.) 2 A mole or spot, compared to a seed of sesamum. 3 A small particle or portion. E. तिल to be unctuous, affix क.
17515: तिलक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Spotted, freckled, a person having moles or spots. 2 Chief, principal. mn. (-कः-कं) A mark or marks made with coloured earths or unguents upon the forehead, and between the eye-brows, either as an ornament or a sectarial distinction. m. (-कः) 1 A freckle, a natural mark on the person. 2 A kind of tree, commonly Tila. 3 A sort of horse. 4 A title, especially in composition, implying pre-eminence, as रघुवंशतिलकः the Tilaka of the race of RAGHU, a name of RĀMA. n. (-कं) 1 The bladder. 2 Black Sochal salt, a factitious salt, containing sulphur and iron, &c. 3 A disease, the appearance of dark spots on the skin, unattended with inflammation. f. (-का) A kind of necklace. E. तिल sesamum, &c. कन् added, or तिल to go or be unctuous, and क्वुन् aff.
17516: तिलकट m. (-टः) The farina of sesamum. E. तिल, and कटच् aff.
17517: तिलकल्क n. (-ल्कं) Sesamum ground or bruised. E. तिल, and कल्क sediment.
17518: तिलकालक m. (-कः) 1 A mole, a spot on the body. 2 A man so marked. E. तिल sesamum seed, and काल black, कन् aff.
17519: तिलकाश्रय m. (-यः) The forehead. E. तिलक, and आश्रय asylum.
17520: तिलकिट्ट n. (-ट्टं) The sediment or cake of sesamum after the oil is expressed. E. तिल, and किट्ट sediment.
17521: तिलकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) 1 Marked with the Tilaka. 2 Freckled, spotted. E. तिलक, and इनि aff.
17522: तिलचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Sesamum ground or pounded. E. तिल, and चूर्ण powder.
17523: तिलतण्डुलक n. (-कं) An embrace, embracing. E. तिल sesamum, and तण्डुल grain, कन् affix, as agreeable as rice mixed with sesamum.
17524: तिलतैल n. (-लं) Sesamum oil. E. तिल, and तैलच् aff.
17525: तिलधेनु f. (-नुः) Sesamum made up in the shape of a cow, for the purpose of being presented to Brahmans, &c. E. तिल sesamum, and धेनु a cow.
17526: तिलपर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 Sandal. 2 The leaf of the Tila tree. m. (-र्णः) Turpentine. E. तिल, and पर्ण a leaf.
17527: तिलपर्णिका mfn. (-का) Red sanders: see the next. E. कन् added to तिलपर्णी.
17528: तिलपर्णी f. (-र्णी) Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santolinus.) E. तिल the sesamum plant, and पर्ण a leaf: see तैलपर्णी.
17529: तिलपिच्चट n. (-टं) A sort of sweetmeat, made chiefly of ground sesamum.
17530: तिलपिञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) Barren sesamum, bearing no blossom, or its seed yielding no oil. E. तिल sesamum, and पिञ्ज affix, in this sense.
17531: तिलपेज m. (-जः) Barren sesamum: see the preceding. E. तिल sesamum, and पेज affix, with this sense.
17532: तिलमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or composed of sesamum. E. तिल, and मयट् aff.
17533: तिलमयूर m. (-रः) A kind of peafowl. E. तिल, and मयूर a peacock: marked with spots resembling the seed of the sesamum.
17534: तिलरस m. (-सः) Sesamum oil. E. तिल, and रस extract.
17535: तिलस्नेह n. (-हं) Oil, especially from sesamum. E. तिल, and स्नेह grease.
17536: तिलहोम n. (-मं) Burnt offering of sesamum. E. तिल, and होम burnt offering.
17537: तिलापत्या f. (-त्या) A plant, bearing a small pungent seed, (Nigella Indica). E. तिल sesamum, and अपत्य offspring as it were, from the resemblance of the seeds.
17538: तिलित्स m. (-त्सः) A large snake, according to some, the same as the Gokhura, to others the Böa, (Böa constrictor.) E. तिलत् here said to imply motion, षो to destroy, and क affix, destroying life or loco-motion.
17539: तिलोत्तमा f. (-मा) One of the courtezans of Svarga. E. तिल a mole, and उत्तम excellent, beautiful.
17540: तिलोदक n. (-कं) Sesamum seeds and water, as an oblation. E. तिल, and उदक water.
17541: तिलौदन n. (-नं) A dish of milk, rice, and sesamum. E. तिल sesamum, and ओदन boiled rice.
17542: तिल्य n. (-ल्यं) A field of sesamum. E. तिल, with क्यप् aff.
17543: तिल्ल r. 1st cl. (तिल्लति) To go or move.
17544: तिल्व m. (-ल्वः) A pale sort of Lodh: see लोध्र. E. तिल to anoint, and व affix; also with कन् added तिल्वक.
17545: तिष्ठत् mfn. (-ष्ठन्-ष्ठन्ती-ष्ठत्) Staying, abiding, standing, being. E. स्था to stay, &c. शतृ aff.
17546: तिष्ठद्गु n. (-द्गु) Evening, sun-set, the time which a cow stands to be milked, &c. E. स्था to stand, गौ a cow.
17547: तिष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Auspicious, fortunate, lucky. m. (-ष्यः) 1 The eighth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion, an asterism figured by an arrow, and containing three stars, of which one is δ Cancri. 2 The month Pauṣa, (December-January.) 3 The Kali Yug. the fourth and present age. f. (-ष्या) Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) E. तुष to please or delight, affix क्यप्, and इत् substituted for the penultimate.
17548: तिष्यक m. (-कः) The month Pauṣa: see the preceding. E. कन् added to तिष्य, the moon being then in that asterism.
17549: तिष्यपुष्प f. (-ष्पा) Emblic myrobalan. E. तिष्य auspicious, and पुष्प a flower.
17550: तिष्यफला f. (-ला) Emblic myrobalan: see तिष्य. E. तिष्य auspicious, and फल fruit.
17551: तिहन् m. (-हा) 1 Sickness. 2 Rice. 3 A bow. 4 A good disposition.
17552: तीक (ऋ) तीकृ r. 1st cl. (तिकते) To go or move.
17553: तीक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) 1 Hot, warm. 2 Hot, pungent. 3 Selfdevoted, self-abandoning, committing suicide, &c. 4 Zealous, active, warm. 5 Keen, intelligent. 6 Devout, ascetic, a devotee, a zealot. 7 Sharp, (as a sword.) n. (-क्ष्णं) 1 Heat, warmth. 2 Poison. 3 Iron. 4 War, battle. 5 Plague, pestilence, epidemic destruction. 6 Death, dying. 7 Any weapon. 8 Haste, hurry. 9 Sea salt. 10 The scrotum or testicles. 11 Any metal. 12 Pungency, the heat of pepper, &c. m. (-क्ष्णः) Nitre. f. (-क्ष्णा) 1 Orris root. 2 The cast skin of a snake. E. तिज to sharpen or be sharp, Uṇādi affix क्स्न.
17554: तीक्ष्णक m. (-कः) 1 The scrotum or the testicles. 2 White mustard. E. कन् added to the preceding.
17555: तीक्ष्णकण्टक m. (-कः) Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and कण्टक a thorn.
17556: तीक्ष्णकन्द m. (-न्दः) The onion. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and कन्द root.
17557: तीक्ष्णकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Active, zealous. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, keen, and कर्म्मन् conduct.
17558: तीक्ष्णगन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Morunga hyperanthera. 2 The gum olibanum tree. 3 Small cardamoms. 4 A tree: see जियती. f. (-न्धा) Mustard seed. 2 Orris root. 3 Pandanus odoratissimus. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and गन्ध smell; also with कन् added तीक्ष्णगन्धक.
17559: तीक्ष्णतण्डुला f. (-ला) Long-pepper. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and तण्डल grain.
17560: तीक्ष्णतैल n. (-लं) 1 Resin. 2 The milky juice of the Euphorbia. 3 Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. तीक्ष्ण hot, pungent, and तैल oil, unguent.
17561: तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A tiger. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and दंष्ट्र a tooth.
17562: तीक्ष्णधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sharp-edged, sharp. E. तीक्ष्ण, and धारा edge.
17563: तीक्ष्णपत्र m. (-त्रः) Coriander. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and पत्र a leaf.
17564: तीक्ष्णपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Cloves. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and पुष्प flower.
