17565: तीक्ष्णफल m. (-लः) Coriander. E. तीक्ष्ण pungent, and फल fruit, bearing pungent seeds.
17566: तीक्ष्णरस m. (-सः) Saltpetre. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and रस juice.
17567: तीक्ष्णशूक m. (-कः) Barley. E. तीक्ष्ण sharp, and शूक awn.
17568: तीक्ष्णाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Heartburn, dyspepsia. E. तीक्ष्ण, and अग्नि digestion.
17569: तीक्ष्णायस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Made of steel, sharp. n. (-सं) Steel. E. तीक्ष्ण, and अयस् iron, टच् added.
17570: तीम r. 4th cl. (तीम्यति) To be wet or moist: see तिम.
17571: तीर r. 10th cl. (तीरयति) To finish or complete, to get through or over.
17572: तीर n. (-रं) 1 A shore, a bank. 2 An arrow. m. (-रः) Tin. f. (-री) A kind of arrow. E. तीर to get through or over, अच् aff.
17573: तीरभुक्ति m. (-क्तिः) Tirhut, a province in the east of central Hindustan, lying on the north of Behar. E. तीर a bank, and भुक्ति here signifying a limit: being bounded on the west and east by the Gandaki and Kauśikī rivers, on the south by the Ganges, and on the north, by the skirts of the Himāla mountains.
17575: तीरान्तर n. (-रं) The opposite bank or shore. E. तीर, and अन्तर beyond.
17576: तीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adjudged, settled, finished. n. (-तं) 1 Completion of any act or affair. 2 Corrupt or improper non-infliction of a sentence. E. तीर to get through, affix क्त.
17577: तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Crossed, passed over. 2 Spread, expanded. 3 Surpassed, excelled. E. तॄ to pass, affix क्त.
17578: तीर्णपदी f. (-दी) A plant: see तालमूली. E. तीर्ण spreading, and पाद foot or root.
17579: तीर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Crossed, having crossed. E. त to cross, affix क्तवतु.
17580: तीर्थ mn. (-र्थः-र्थं) 1 Sacred science, or any of the branches of knowledge esteemed holy. 2 A holy place, any place of pilgrimage, as Benares, &c. but especially particular spots along the course of sacred streams, as the Ganges, &c. and in the vicinity of some piece of water or sacred springs. 3 Any piece of water. 4 A Ghāt or stairs of a landing place. 5 A sacred preceptor, a Guru. 6 Sacrifice. 7 An Avatāra or descent of a deity. 8 A school of philosophy, a Darśana, a sect. 9 A counsellor, an adviser. 10 An expedient, a means of success. 11 The menses. 12 Pudendum muliebre. 13 A vessel. 14 A royal vessel. 15 A Brahman. 16 Ascertainment of disease. 17 Fire. 18 A part of the hand sacred to any  deity, as between the thumb and finger to the manes, the root of the thumb to BRAHMA, &c. E. तॄ to pass over, थक् Uṇādi affix; by which persons are extricated from sin, difficulty, &c.
17581: तीर्थकर m. (-रः) One of the synonyms of a Jina or sanctified teacher of the Jaina sect. E. तीर्थ pure, purity, and कर who does or acts; also retaining the nasal तीर्थङ्कर.
17582: तीर्थकृत् m. (-कृत्) A Jina: see the preceding.
17583: तीर्थध्वाङ्क्ष m. (-ङ्क्षः) An epithet of contempt, a crow, as it were, at a pilgrimage. E. तीर्थ, and ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow.
17584: तीर्थराजी f. (-जी) A name of Benāres. E. तीर्थ a holy place, and राजी the queen: the most eminent of the Tīrthas or places of pilgrimage.
17585: तीर्थवाक m. (-कः) A curl of hair. E. तीर्थ, and वच to speak, affix घञ्.
17586: तीर्थसेविन् mf. (-वी-विनी) 1 A pilgrim. 2 A sort of crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. तीर्थ, and सेविन् who frequents.
17587: तीव r. 1st cl. (-तीवति) To be large, to be fat or corpulent.
17588: तीवर m. (-रः) 1 The ocean. 2 A hunter, one who lives by killing and selling game. 3 A fisherman, one who lives by fishing. f. (-री) The wife of a hunter. E. तॄ to go, to pass or cross, ष्वरच् aff.
17589: तीव्र mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं) 1 Much, excessive, endless, unbounded, unlimited. 2 Pungent. 3 Hot, warm. m. (-व्रः) A name of ŚIVA. f. (-व्रा) 1 A medicinal plant, Katuki. 2 Black mustard. 3 A sort of Dūrvā or bent grass, (गण्डदूर्व्वा) 4 The name of a river in the east of Bengal; also the Caṇḍī or Padmāvatī. adv. n. (-व्रं) 1 Much, excessively, endless. 2 Violently, fiercely. subst. 1 A shore, a bank. 2 Tin. 3 Heat. 4 Pungency. E. तीव to be large, &c. रक् aff.
17590: तीव्रवेदना f. (-ना) Agony, excessive pain, the pain of damnation. E. तीव्र exceeding, and वेदना pain.
17591: तु r. 2nd cl. (तौति or तवति) 1 To go or move. 2 To thrive or increase. 3 To injure, to hurt or kill. 4 To become full. According to some authorities this is merely a Sautra root.
17592: तु ind. A particle, implying. 1 Difference, (but, or.) 2 Disjunction, (but, again, further, other.) 3 Connexion, (and, moreover.) 4 Asseveration, (indeed.) 5 An expletive.
17593: तुकाक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of bambus; also तुगा and सुगाक्षीरी.
17594: तुगा f. (-गा) The manna of bambus.
17596: तुङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 High, elevated, lofty. 2 Chief, principal. 3 Passionate, hot. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 2 A mountain. 3 The planet Mercury. 4 The superior apsis or aphelion of a planet. 5 Top, vertex, altitude. 6 The cocoanut tree. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 A kind of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum.) 2 Turmerick. 3 Night. f. (-ङ्गा) Bambu manna. E. तुजि to guard, to dwell, to hurt, &c. affix घञ्.
17597: तुङ्गक m. (-कः) A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
17598: तुङ्गता f. (-ता) 1 Loftiness. 2 Passionateness. E. तल् added to तुङ्ग; also with त्व, तुङ्गत्व.
17599: तुङ्गभद्र m. (-द्रः) A restive elephant or one in rut. f. (-द्रा) A river in the Mysur country, the Toombhadra. E. तुङ्ग lofty, tall, &c. and भद्र auspicious.
17600: तुङ्गशेखर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. तुङ्ग lofty, and शेखर crest or summit.
17601: तुङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) High, lofty. m. (-ङ्गी) A planet at the apex of its orbit, or of its position, with regard to others considered astrologically. E. तुङ्ग, and इनि aff.
17602: तुङ्गीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. तुङ्गी night, and पति master.
17603: तुङ्गीश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The moon. 3 The sun. 4 A name of KṚṢṆA. E. तुङ्गी night, or तुङ्ग a mountain, &c. and ईश lord.
17604: तुच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) 1 Void, empty. 2 Small, little. 3 Abandoned, deserted. 4 Low, contemptible. n. (-च्छं) Chaff. E. तुल to weigh, Uṇādi affix छ.
17605: तुच्छधान्यक n. (-कं) Straw. E. तुच्छ, and धान्यक grain.
17606: तुच्छद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The castor oil tree. E. तुच्छ empty, pithless, द्रु a tree; having no sap.
17607: तुज् m. (तुक्) Offspring, children. E. तुज to guard, affix क्विप्.
17608: तुज r. 1st cl. (तोजति) To kill or hurt. (इ) तुजि r. 1st cl. (तुञ्जति) To guard or protect. r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुञ्जति तुञ्जयति) 1 To dwell, to abide. 2 To be strong or vigorous. 3 To give. 4 To hurt, to injure or kill. 5 To shine.
17609: तुञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Noxious, mischievous. m. (-ञ्जः) A Daitya, a demon. E. तुजि to hurt, affix अच्.
17610: तुट r. 6th cl. (तुटति) 1 To dispute, to quarrel, to wrangle. 2 To hurt or injure.
17611: तुटुम m. (-मः) A rat. E. तुट to injure, affix उम.
17612: तुड (ऋ) तुडृ (तोडति) also (इ) तुडि r. 1st cl. (तुण्डते) also तुड r. 6th cl. (तुडति) 1 To tear, to break or cut, to pull to pieces, to hurt or kill.
17614: तुण r. 6th cl. (तुणति) 1 To curve, to bend or make crooked. 2 To act fraudulently.
17615: तुणि m. (-णिः) A timber tree: see तुन्न. E. तूण to shrink or warp, affix कि, and the radical vowel made short.
17616: तुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The mouth, the face. E. तुडि to tear, (food, &c.) affix अण्, and कन् being added तुण्डक.
17617: तुण्डकेरी f. (-री) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica monadelpha.) E. तुण्डक the mouth, ऋ to go, अण् and ङीष् affs.
17618: तुण्डि mf. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी) 1 The mouth, the face. 2 A beak. 3 The navel; (also तुन्दि.) E. तुडि to break or destroy, Uṇādi affix इन्.
17619: तुण्डिका f. (-का) 1 The navel. 2 A plant, commonly Telakuca. E. कन् added to तुण्डी.
17620: तुण्डिकेरी f. (-री) 1 The cotton plant. 2 A sort of gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.) 2 A large boil or swelling on the palate. E. तुण्डिका the mouth or beak, ऋ to go, affixes अण् and ङीष्; also with कन् added तुण्डिकेरिका. f. (-का) and with इन् fem. affix तुण्ठिकेरि. f. (-रिः) also तुण्डकेरी and तुण्डिकेशी.
17621: तुण्डिकेशी f. (-शी) A sort of gourd, commonly Telakuca: see the preceding.
17622: तुण्डिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Having a prominent or elevated navel. E. तुण्डि the navel, भ affix; also तुन्दिभ, &c.
17623: तुण्डिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Having a prominent or elevated navel. 2 Speaking harshly or severely. E. तुण्डि the navel, and ल affix; also तुन्दिल, &c.
17624: तुत्थ r. 10th cl. (तुत्थयति) 1 To screen, to veil, to cover. 2 To spread.
17625: तुत्थ m. (-त्थः) Fire. f. (-त्था) 1 Indigo. 2 Small cardamoms. n. (-त्थं) 1 A collyrium extracted from the Amomum zanthorrhiza. 2 Blue vitriol, sulphate of copper, especially medicinally considered as an Añjana, or application to the eyes. E. तुद to pain, थक् Uṇādi aff.
17626: तुत्थक n. (-कं) Blue vitriol. E. कन् added to तुत्थ.
17627: तुत्थाञ्जन n. (-नं) Blue vitriol, considered as a medicinal application to the eyes. E. तुत्थ the same, and अञ्जन a collyrium.
17628: तुद (औ) r. 6th cl. (तुदति-ते) To pain, to wound, to vex or harass, to tease, to torture or torment, (इ) तुदि r. 1st cl. (तुन्दति) To search, to seek.
17629: तुन्द n. (-न्दं) The belly. f, (-न्दी) The navel: see तुण्डि. E. तुद to torment, क affix, and नुम् augment.
17630: तुन्दकूपी f. (-पी) The navel. E. तुन्द the belly, and कूप a pit, a well, dim. affix ङीष्; also with कन् added तुन्दकूर्पिका, f. (-का.)
17631: तुन्दपरिमार्ज m. (-र्जः) A lazy man, a sloth, a sluggard: see the next.
17632: तुन्दपरिमृज m. (-जः) A lazy man, a sluggard. E. तुन्द the belly, मृज to rub, with परि prefixed, and क affix; also with the affix घञ्, तुन्दपरिमार्ज as above; passing his whole time in stroking his sides.
17633: तुन्दवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Corpulent, fat. E. तुन्द, and मतुप् aff. also from तुन्दि, तुन्दिवत्.
17634: तुन्दि n. (-न्दि) The belly. f. (-न्दिः) The navel. m. (-न्दिः) One of the Gandharbas or quiristers of Svarga. E. तुद to vex or harass, affix इन्, and नुम् inserted.
17635: तुन्दिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having a large or prominent navel, fat, corpulent. f. (-का) The navel. E. तुन्दी the navel, कन् affix, or तुन्द with ठन् aff.
17637: तुन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having a large or prominent navel. E. तुन्द with इतच् affix; also तुन्दिक, तुन्दिल, &c.
17638: तुन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Having a large or prominent navel. E. तुन्द with इनि affix; also तुन्दिक, &c.
17641: तुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Tormented, vexed, injured. 2 Cut, broken, cut down, &c. m. (-न्नः) Toon or Tuna, a tree of which the wood bears some resemblance to mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.) E. तुद to vex, affix क्त.
17642: तुन्नवाय m. (-यः) A tailor. E. तुन्न cut, (cloth, &c.) and वे to sew, affix अण्.
17643: तुन्नसेवनी f. (-नी) A suture of the skull. E. तुन्न cut, and सेवनी a suture.
17644: तुप r. 1st 6th and 10 cls. (तोपति, तुपति, तोपयति) also (इ) तुपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्पति तुम्पयति) To injure, to hurt or kill; also तुफ, तुम्ब, तुम्प, &c.
17645: तुफ r. 1st, 6th and 10th cls. (तोफति तुफति तोफयति) To hurt or kill.
17646: तुब (इ) तुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुम्बति तुम्बयति) To kill or hurt. r. 10th cl. (तुम्बयति) To disappear.
17647: तुभ r. 1st cl. (तोभते) 4th cl. (तुभ्यति) 9th cl. (तुभ्नाति) To kill, to hurt, to injure in any manner.
17648: तुमुर mn. (-रः-रं) Mingled combat: see तुमुल.
17649: तुमुल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Mingled or tumultuous combat. 2 Uproar, clangour, tumult, tumultuous sound or noise. m. (-लः) Beleric myrobalan. E. तु a Sautra root, to kill, to injure, &c. मुलक affix; or with the vowel long तुमूल. mn. (-लः-लं) and ल being changed to र, तुमुर as above.
17650: तुम्प r. 1st and 6th cls. (तुम्पति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To be distressed.
17651: तुम्फ r. 1st cl. (तुम्फति) To hurt or kill.
17652: तुम्ब mf. (-म्बः-म्बा or म्बी) A long gourd, &c. see तुम्बि f. (-म्बा) A cow disposed to be milked. E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, &c.) affix अच्.
17653: तुम्बक m. (-कः) A long gourd. n. (-कं) The gourd. E. कन् added to the preceding: see तुम्बि.
17654: तुम्बि f. (-म्बिः or तुम्बी) A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaris.) E. तुबि to destroy, (bile, sickness, &c.) अच् affix; fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; also with कन् added तुम्बिका.
17655: तुम्बीपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The flower of the Cucurbita lagenaris. E. तुम्बी, and पुष्प a flower.
17656: तुम्बुरी f. (-री) 1 Coriander. 2 A bitch: see तुम्बुरु.
17657: तुम्बुरु m. (-रुः) 1 One of the Gandharbas or singers of heaven. 2 A celestial inhabitant and attendant upon the sanctified Jaina teachers. n. (-रुः) Coriander. E. तुबि to hurt, &c. उरन् affix; also with the pen. long तुम्बूरु.
17658: तुर r. 3rd cl. (तुतोर्त्ति) To go quick, to hurry, to make haste; this root is restricted to the Vedas: see त्वर.
17659: तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Quick, swift. E. तुर to make haste, क aff.
17660: तुरग m. (-गः) 1 A horse. 2 The mind. E. त्वर speed, velocity, and ग what goes, व changed to उ. f. (-गी) 1 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa:) see अश्वगन्ध. 2 A mare. E. ङीष् added to तुरग.
17661: तुरगगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant: see the preceding. E. तुरग a horse, and गन्ध small, smelling like a horse; also अश्वगन्ध, &c.
17662: तुरगब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं) Necessary celibacy, leading a life of continence, in consequence merely of being without female society. E. तुरग a horse, and ब्रह्मचर्य्यक the practice of a religious student, one of whose duties is continence.
17663: तुरगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Equestrian, riding, mounted or carried on a horse. m. (-गी) A horseman, cavalier, &c. E. तुरग a horse, and इनि aff.
17664: तुरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A horse. 2 The mind, considered as the seat of feeling as well as intellect, the heart. E. त्वर speedily, and ग what goes. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 A plant: see तुरगी and तुरगगन्धा. 2 A mare. E. ङीष् added to the preceding.
17665: तुरङ्गक m. (-कः) A plant, a kind of Ghosha, commonly हस्तिघोष. E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and कन् affix of analogy; coursing through the body.
17666: तुरङ्गद्विषणी f. (-णी) A she buffalo. E. तुरङ्ग, and द्विषणी disliking.
17667: तुरङ्गप्रिय m. (-यः) Barley. E. तुरङ्ग, and प्रिय fond of.
17668: तुरङ्गम m. (-मः) A horse. E. त्वर speed, and गम to go, with खच् aff.
17669: तुरङ्गयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going on horseback. E. तुरङ्ग, and यायिन् who goes.
17670: तुरङ्गवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A Kinnara or quirister of INDRA'S heaven. E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वक्त्र a face.
17671: तुरङ्गवदन m. (-नः) A celestial quirister. E. तुरङ्ग a horse, and वदन a face; these beings are described as having the bodies of men, and the heads of horses; also similar compounds, as तुरङ्गानन, तुरङ्गवक्त्र, तुगङ्गास्य, अश्ववक्त्र, &c.
17672: तुरङ्गारि m. (-रिः) 1 A buffalo. 2 Oleander. E. तुरङ्ग, and अरि foe.
17673: तुरङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 1 A horseman, a rider. 2 A groom. E. तुरङ्ग, and इनि aff.
17674: तुरायण subst. mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Attachment to any object or pursuit. adj. Attached to any object or pursuit. m. (-णः) A particular sacrifice. E. त्वर speed, haste, अय to go, affix ल्यु; speeding towards a given end or in a certain cause: see परायण.
17675: तुरासाह् m. (-षाट् or षाड्) A name of INDRA. E. तुर for त्वर haste, सह to bear, in the causal form, and क्विप् affix, स being changed to ष in inflexion.
17676: तुरि f. (-रिः) See the next; also तुलि.
17677: तुरी f. (-री) 1 A brush or a fibrous stick used by weavers to clean and separate the threads of the woof. 2 A painter's brush, &c.: see तुली.
17678: तुरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fourth, a fourth. m. (-यः) A fourth part, a quarter. n. (-यं) The divine being, or universal spirit. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with छ affix; also तूर्य्य and तुर्य्य.
17679: तुरीयभाग m. (-गः) A fourth part or share. E. तुरीय, and भाग share.
17680: तुरीयभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) A sharer of a fourth. E. तुरीय, and भाज who divides.
17681: तुरीयवर्ण m. (-र्णः) The Śūdra or fourth tribe of the Hindus. E. तुरीय fourth, and वर्ण tribe.
17682: तुरीयांश m. (-शः) A fourth part, a quarter share. E. तुरीय, and अंश a share.
17683: तुरुष्क m. (-ष्कः) 1 Incense. 2 A country, or m. plu. (-ष्काः) Its inhabitants; Turan or Turkestan, the original country of the Turks. E. तुर to haste, (into smoke, &c.) affix उस्, and कन् added.
17684: तुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth. E. irr. derived from चतुर् four, with यत् aff.
17685: तुर्व (इ) तुर्वी r. 1st cl. (तुर्वति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
17686: तुर्व्वसु m. (-सुः) One of the sons of YAYĀTI, king of the south and eastern portion of India, reigning over the Mleccha tribes
17687: तुल r. 1st and 10th cls. (तोलति तुलति तोलयति-ते or irr. तुलयति) To weigh or measure.
17688: तुलयित्वा ind. Having weighed, having counterpoised, made equal or like, &c. E. तुल to weigh, क्त्वा aff.
17690: तुलसी f. (-सी) A small shrub held in veneration by the Hindus, Tulasi or holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) E. तुला resemblance, and षो to destroy, affixes ङ and ङीप्; being unparalleled: this plant is said to be a female metamorphosed.
17691: तुला f. (-ला) 1 Measure by weight. 2 A measure or weight of gold and silver, 100 Palas, or about 145 ounces troy. 3 A balance, especially a fine balance, goldsmith's or assay scales. 4 The sign of the zodiac, Libra. 5 Resemblance, likeness, equality, similarity. 6 A vessel. 7 Sloping beams or timbers in the roof of a house. E. तुल to weigh or to resemble, affixes क and टाप्.
17692: तुलाकोटि f. (-टिः-टी) 1 An ornament of the feet or toes. 2 A certain weight. 3 A hundred millions. E. तुला a balance, कुट to measure, affix अच् and इ or ङीष्; what is valued by weight, &c. or तुला a measure, &c. and कोटि Crore, or million.
17693: तुलाकोश m. (-शः) A sort of ordeal, in which the accused is tried by being weighed repeatedly in a scale: if he is lighter the second time he is pronounced innocent; if equipoised still, or heavier, he is guilty. E. तुला a scale, and कोश ordeal.
17694: तुलाधट m. (-टः) 1 An oar, a paddle. 2 The scale or cup of a balance. E. तुला, and धट a scale.
17695: तुलाधर m. (-रः) The sun. E. तुला the sign, and धर who has or possesses.
17696: तुलाधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A trader, a dealer, trafficking, trading. m. (-रः) 1 The sign Libra. 2 The string of a balance. 3 The beam. E. तुला the scales, &c. आधार what or who supports.
17697: तुलापरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Ordeal by the balance, the weight of the accused being first taken, certain prayers and ceremonies are performed, after which he is weighed again: if lighter, he is innocent; if heavy, or as at first, guilty. E. तुला, and परीक्षा test.
17698: तुलापुरुष m. (-षः) A person weighed in a balance, or an effigy of him used as a weight. E. तुला, and पुरुष a man.
17699: तुलापुरुषदान n. (-नं) Gift of gold or valuables of the weight of the donor. E. तुलापुरुष, and दान gift.
17700: तुलाप्रग्रह m. (-हः) The string of a balance. E. तुला, and प्रग्रह holding; also तुलाप्रग्राह.
17701: तुलामान n. (-नं) Measure by weight. E. तुला, and मान measure.
17702: तुलावीज n. (-जं) The Gunjā or berry of the Abrus precatorius, from which the goldsmith's or jeweller's weight in India is taken; the berry weighs about 1(5/16) grain troy, the factitious weight about 2(3/16). E. तुला weight, and वीज seed.
17703: तुलासूत्र n. (-त्रं) The string of a balance. E. तुला, and सूत्र thread.
17704: तुलि f. (-लिः or -ली) 1 A fibrous stick or brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof. 2 A painter's brush, or fibrous stick used for that purpose: see तूलिका. E. तुल to resemble, &c. affix क, fem. affix इन् or ङीष्; also with ल changed to र, तुरि, तुरी.
17705: तुलिका f. (-का) A small bird said to resemble the wagtail.
17706: तुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made equal or like, equalled, compared. 2 Weighed, counterpoised. E. तुल to weigh, क्त aff.
17707: तुलिफला f. (-ला) The Simul or silk cotton tree. E. तुलि for तूलि cotton, and फल fruit.
17708: तुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Like, resembling, equal or analogous to. E. तुला resemblance, and यत् aff.
17709: तुल्यता f. (-ता) Likeness, sameness, equality. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तुल्यत्वं.
17710: तुल्यपान n. (-नं) Drinking together. E. तुल्य alike, and पान drinking.
17711: तुल्यबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of equal strength. E. तुल्य, and बल strength.
17712: तुल्यभावन n. (-नं) Combination of like series, (in calculation.) E. तुल्य, and भावनं computing.
17713: तुल्यरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 1 Like, similar, analogous. 2 Of like or equal form. E. तुल्य, and रूप nature, &c.
17714: तुल्यवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Following the same or similar occupation. E. तुल्य, and वृत्ति business.
17715: तुल्यशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Equal subtraction, transposition, (in Arithmetic.) E. तुल्य, and शुद्धि subtraction.
17716: तुल्याकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Alike, of the same form. E. तुल्य, and आकृति form.
17717: तुवर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Astringent. 2 Beardless. mn. (-रः-रं) An astringent taste. f. (-री) 1 A fragrant earth. 2 A kind of lentil, (Cytisus cajan:) see आढकी. E. तु a Sautra root, to remove, (disease, &c.) थ्वरच् and affix ङीष्; also कन् being added, in the fem. form तुवरिका, f. (-का.)
17718: तुवरोशिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A kind of cassia. E. तुवरी the pulse so called, and शिम्ब Cassia tora.
17719: तुवि f. (-विः) A long gourd: see तुम्बी.
17720: तुष r. 4th cl. (ञि, औ) ञिऔतुष (तुष्यति) To be satisfied or content, to be pleased or delighted.
17721: तुष mf. (-षः-षा) 1 The husk or chaff of rice, &c. 2 Beleric myrobalan. E. तुष to please or be pleased, affix क.
17722: तुषग्रह m. (-हः) Agni or fire. E. तुष chaff, and ग्रह who seizes.
17723: तुषसार m. (-रः) Agni or fire. E. तुष chaff, and सार who embraces, from सृ to go, with अण् aff.
17724: तुषानल m. (-लः) 1 A conflagration of chaff, or of the husk of corn. 2 A capital punishment, burning; twisting dry straw, &c. round the limbs of a criminal, and setting it on fire. E. तुष, and अनल fire.
17725: तुषार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cold, frigid, frosty. m. (-रः) 1 Frost. 2 Cold. 3 Thin rain, mist. 4 Ice or snow. 5 The name of a country. E. तुष to please, Uṇādi affix आरन्.
17726: तुषारकण m. (-णः) 1 A dew drop. 2 An icicle. 3 Hoar frost. E. तुषार, and कण a particle.
17727: तुषारकाल m. (-लः) Winter, the cold season. E. तुषार, and काल time.
17728: तुषारपात m. (-तः) 1 Thin rain, a sprinkling, a shower. 2 A fall of snow. E. तुषार, and पात falling.
17729: तुषाराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himālaya mountain. E. तुषार, and अद्रि a mountain; also similar compounds, as तुषारपर्व्वत, तुषारशैल, &c.
17730: तुषित m. (-तः) A Tuṣita, a kind of subordinate deity, one of a class of thirty-six. E. तुष to please, इतच् aff.
17731: तुषोदक n. (-कं) Rice gruel. E. तुष to satisfy, and उदक water.
17732: तुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pleased, satisfied. E. तुष to be pleased, affix क्त.
17733: तुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Pleasure, satisfaction, gratification, content. 2 Indifference to every thing but that possessed or obtained. 3 One of the Mātṛs. E. तुष to please, &c. affix क्तिन्.
17734: तुष्टिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pleasing, satisfying. E. तुष्टि, and कर what makes.
17735: तुष्टिजनन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Gratifying, giving or producing satisfaction. E. तुष्टि, and जनन birth.
17736: तुष्टिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Pleasing, satisfying. E. तुष्टि, and द what gives.
17737: तुष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A jewel worn in the ears. E. तुष to please, क्तु aff.
17738: तुष्ट्वा ind. Having pleased or gratified. E. तुष, and क्त्वा aff.
17740: तुस m. (-सः) The husk of corn or rice: see तुष.
17741: तुस्त n. (-स्तं) Dust. E. तुस to sound, affix क्त: see तूस्त.
17742: तुह (इर) तुहिर r. 1st cl. (तोहति) To hurt or give pain, to kill.
17743: तुहिन n. (-नं) 1 Frost. 2 Moon-light, moonshine. E. तुह to give pain, इनन् Uṇādi aff.
17744: तुहिनशैल m. (-लः) The Himālaya mountains. E. तुहिन, and शैल a mountain; also similar compounds, as तुहिनपर्व्वत, &c.
17745: तुहिनांशु m. (-शुः) The moon. E. तुहिन cold, अंशु a ray.
17746: तुहिनांशुतैल n. (-लं) Camphor. E. तुहिनांशु, and तैल oil.
17747: तुहिनाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The Himālaya mountains. E. तुहिन, and अद्रि a mountain; also तुहिनशैल, &c.
17748: तूण r. 1st cl. (तूणयते) To fill, to fill up. (तूणयति) To shrink, to contract, to close as the eye-lids or wink.
17749: तूण mfn. (-णः-णा or -णी) A quiver, &c. f. (-णी) Indigo. E. तूण to be filled (with arrows, &c.) अच् and टाप् affixes, or घञ् and ङीष्.
17750: तूणक n. (-कं) A measure of verse, species of the अतिशर्करी metre.
17751: तूणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Having a quiver, quivered. m. (-णी) The Tūn tree. E. तूण, and इनि aff.
17752: तूणीर m. (-रः) A quiver. E. तूण to be filled (with arrows), ईरण् aff.
17754: तूनी f. (-नी) Sharp pain in the perinœum and lower part of the abdomen.
17755: तूर् f. (-तूः) Speed. m. (-तूः) A courier. E. त्वर to make haste, क्विप् affix, and the semivowel changed to ऊ.
17756: तूर (ई) तूरी r. 4th cl. (तूर्य्यते) To go quick, to make haste. 2 To kill, to hurt or injure.
17757: तूर n. (-रं) Any musical instrument. f. (-री) A trumpet. E. त्वर to speed, affix अच्.
17758: तूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Quick, expeditious. n. adv. (-र्णं) Quick, swift, quickly. E. त्वर to go swiftly, affix क्त.
17759: तूर्णि m. (-र्णिः) 1 Speed, velocity, expedition. 2 Dirt, excrement. 3 A stanza. 4 The mind. E. त्वर to make haste, Uṇādi affix नि.
17760: तूर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fourth: see तुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Any musical instrument, the genus of which four species are reckoned, as wind instruments, stringed instruments, &c. E. चतुर four, यत् deriv. irr.
17761: तूर्य्यखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A musical instrument, a sort of tabor.
17762: तूल r. 1st cl. (तूलति) 1 To dismiss, to send forth or turn out. 2 To ascertain quantity or weight; some make this a root of the tenth class (तूलयति-ते.)
17763: तूल n. (-लं) 1 The mulberry, (Morus Indica.) 2 Æther, the heaven or atmosphere. mn. (-लः-लं) Cotton. f. (-ला-ली) The wick of a lamp, or cotton twisted into a similar form for applying unguents, &c. (-ली) 1 Indigo. 2 A weaver's fibrous stick or brush. 3 A painter's brush, &c. see तुली and तुरी; also तूलि. E. तूल to dismiss, to send forth, affix घञ्, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्.
17764: तूलक n. (-कं) Cotton. E. कन् added to the preceding.
17765: तूलकार्म्मुक n. (-कं) A bow which is used for cleaning cotton. E. तूल cotton, and कार्म्मुक a bow; also similar compounds, as तूलचाप, तूलधनुः, &c.
17766: तूलनाली f. (-ली) A thick roll of cotton, from which it is drawn out in spinning. E. तूल cotton, नाल a tube, affixes अण् and ङीप्; also with कन् added तूलनालिका, f. (-का.)
17767: तूलपिचु m. (-चुः) Cotton. E. तूल cotton, and पिचु the same.
17768: तूलशर्करा f. (-रा) A pod or seed of the plant, any seed yielding a similar substance. E. तूल cotton, and शर्करा sand or gravel.
17769: तूलसेचन n. (-नं) Spinning. E. तूल cotton, सिच to sprinkle, and ल्युट् aff.
17770: तूलि f. (-लिः) A painter's brush, or a fibrous stick used as one, and for other purposes. E. तूल to send forth or cut, affix इन्: see तूल and तूली.
17771: तूलिका f. (-का) 1 A pencil, a painter's brush, or a stick with a fibrous extremity used as one. 2 A mattress or quilt, a bed, a down or cotton bed. 3 An ingot mould. 4 A rod, &c. dipped into crucibles to try if their contents are in fusion. 5 A wick or twist of cotton either for a lamp or for applying unguents, &c. E. तूली as above, and कन् added.
17772: तूलिनी f. (-नी) The silk cotton tree. E. तूल cotton, इनि and ङीष् aff.
17773: तूवर m. (-रः) 1 A bull without horns, though of an age to have them. 2 A beardless man. 3 A eunuch. 4 An astringent taste. f. (-री) A fragrant earth. E. तु to injure, ष्वरच् affix, and the vowel optionally long, hence also तुवर and तुवरी; with कन् added तूवरिका and तूवरीका.
17774: तूष r. 1st cl. (तूषति) 1 To satisfy. 2 To be satisfied or happy.
17775: तूष्णींशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Silent, taciturn. E. तूष्णीम् silent, and शील practising.
17776: तूष्णीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Silent, taciturn. E. तूष्णीम् silent, अकच् affix, and म dropped.
17777: तूष्णीकाम् ind. Silent, silently. E. तूष्णीम् silent, and काम् aff.
17778: तूष्णीम् ind. Silent, silently. E. तुष to please or be pleased, affix नीम्, and उ made long.
17779: तूष्णीम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Silent. E. तूष्णीम्, and भूत become.
17780: तूस्त n. (-स्तं) 1 Dust. 2 Clotted hair. 3 Sin. 4 An atom, a very thin or delicate substance. E. तूस to sound, Uṇādi affix तन्, and the radical vowel made long.
17781: तृक्ष r. 1st cl. (तृक्षति) To go, to move or approach.
17783: तृढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Hurt, injured, wounded. E. तृह to hurt, क्त aff.
17784: तृण (उ) तृणु r. 8th cl. (तर्णोति तर्णुते or तृणोति तृणुते) To eat, especially grass, to graze.
17785: तृण n. (-णं) Grass, any gramineous plant. E. तृह to hurt, Uṇādi affix क्न, and ह rejected; what is consumed by cattle, &c.
17786: तृणकुङ्कुम n. (-मं) A sort of perfume. E. तृण grass, कुङ्कुम saffron.
17787: तृणकुटी f. (-टी) A hovel, a hut of grass or straw. E. तृण grass, and कुटी a small house.
17788: तृणकूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) A long gourd, (Cueurbita lagenaria.) E. तृण grass, and कूर्म्म a tortoise.
17789: तृणकेतु m. (-तुः) A bambu. E. तृण grass, and केतु a banner.
17790: तृणगोधा f. (-धा) 1 A kind of newt. 2 A chameleon. 3 A worm. E. तृण grass, and गोधा a lizard.
17791: तृणग्राहिन् m. (-ही) 1 Amber, &c. or any gem which being rubbed becomes electrically attractive. 2 Sapphire. E. तृण grass, and ग्राहिन् what seizes.
17792: तृणजम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) 1 Graminivorous, one whose food is grass. 2 Grass-toothed, having teeth of the colour of grass, &c. E. तृण grass, and जम्भ food, or a tooth.
17793: तृणजाति m. (-तिः) The vegetable kingdom. E. तृण, and जाति genus.
17794: तृणता f. (-ता) 1 A bow. 2 The aggregate properties of grass or herbage, gramineousness. E. तल् affix of the abstract, added to तृण; also तृणत्व, n. (-त्वं.)
17795: तृणद्रुम m. (-मः) A palm tree, any of the various species, as the palmyra, cocoanut, date, &c. E. तृण grass, and द्रुम a tree; pre-eminent amongst gramineous plants.
17796: तृणधान्य m. (-न्यः) Grain growing wild or without cultivation. E. तृण grass, and धान्य grain, corn.
17797: तृणध्वज m. (-जः) A bambu. E. तृण grass, and ध्वज a flag or banner.
17798: तृणपूली f. (-ली) A mat, a seat made of reeds or basket-work. E. तृण grass, पूल to gather together, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
17799: तृणमणि m. (-णिः) A sort of gem, apparently amber. E. तृण grass, and मणि a gem; attracting straws, &c.
17800: तृणमत्कुण m. (-णः) A bail or surety.
17801: तृणराज m. (-जः) A palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.) E. तृण grass, and राजन् a sovereign, टच् affix, leaving a final vowel.
17802: तृणविस्तर m. (-रः) A heap of grass. E. तृण, and विस्तर expanse.
17803: तृणशीत n. (-तं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon serratus.) E. तृण grass, and शीत here said to imply abundance.
17804: तृणशून्य mfn. subst. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Arabian jasmine. adj. Free from or devoid of grass. n. (-न्यं) The flower of the Ketaki. E. तृण grass, शून्य void of.
17805: तृणषट्पद m. (-दः) A wasp. E. तृण grass, and षट्पद् six-foot; an insect haunting meadows, &c. having six feet.
17806: तृणस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Grassy, made, &c. with grass. E. तृण grass, and स aff.
17807: तृणसारा f. (-रा) The plantain or banana. E. तृण grass, and सार essence, pith.
17808: तृणसिंह m. (-हः) An axe. E. तृण grass, and सिंह a lion.
17809: तृणहर्म्म्य m. (-र्म्म्र्यः) A hovel, a house or upper-room of grass or straw. E. तृण grass, and हर्म्म्र्य a mansion.
17810: तृणाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 Conflagration of chaff. 2 Burning a criminal wrapped up in straw. E. तृण grass, and अग्नि fire: see तुषानल.
17811: तृणाञ्जन m. (-नः) A chameleon, a lizard. E. तृण grass, and अञ्जन a lizard.
17812: तृणेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A kind of long grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. तृण, and इक्षु sugar cane.
17813: तृणोद्भव m. (-वः) Rice, &c. growing wild or without cultivation. E. तृण grass, and उद्भव produced.
17814: तृणोल्का f. (-ल्का) A firebrand made of a wisp of straw. E. तृण grass, and उल्का a firebrand.
17815: तृणौकस् n. (-कः) A hovel, a hut, a house of straw or mats. E. तृण grass, and ओकस् abode.
17816: तृणौषध n. (-धं) A perfume, commonly Elavāluka. E. तृण, and औषध a drug; resembling grass in its appearance.
17817: तृण्या f. (-ण्या) A heap or quantity of grass. E. तृण grass, यत् and टाप् affs.
17818: तृतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Third. f. (-या) The third lunation, the third day of the fortnight. E. त्रि three, तीय affix, and रि changed to the analogous vowel ऋ.
17819: तृतीयक m. (-कः) A tertian ague. E. कन् added to the last.
17820: तृतीयकज्वर m. (-रः) Tertian ague. E. तृतीय, and ज्वर fever.
17821: तृतीयप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 A eunuch. 2 The neuter gender: see तृतीयाप्रकृति.
17822: तृतीयाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.) E. तृतीय third, आकृत made, wrought.
17823: तृतीयाप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 A eunuch. 2 The neuter gender. E. तृतीया the third, and प्रकृति nature; neither male nor female, (whose or which;) the compound is more regularly तृतीयप्रकृति.
17824: तृतीयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Having a third. E. तृतीय, and इनि aff.
17825: तृद (औ इर) औतृदिर् r. 7th cl. (तृणत्ति तृन्ते) 1 To kill, to injure. 2 To disregard. 3 To give. 4 To eat.
17826: तृप r. 1st cl. (तर्पति) 4th cl. (ञि, उ) ञितृपु (तृप्यति) 5th cl. (तृप्नोति) 6th cl. (तृपति) and 10th cl. (तर्पयति) 1 To please, to satisfy, to content. 2 To be pleased or satisfied, to be content or satiate. 3 (In the 1st and 10th cls.) To light or kindle.
17827: तृपत् m. (-पत्) 1 The moon. 2 A parasol. E. तृप to please, अति Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.
17828: तृपला f. (-ला) A creeper or creeping plant. E. तृप to please, कल Uṇādi aff.
17829: तृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Contented, satisfied. E. तृप to be pleased, affix क्त.
17830: तृप्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म्) Contented, satisfied, tranquil. E. तृप्त, and आत्मन् self.
17831: तृप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Satisfaction, content. E. तृप to please, or be pleased, affix क्तिन्.
17832: तृप्र m. (-प्रः) Ghee or oiled butter. E. तृप to satisfy, Uṇādi affix रक्.
17833: तृप्रालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Having ghree, but not liking it or not blending with it. E. तृप, and आलुच् possessive affix; but in this compound implying also aversion.
17834: तृफ r. 6th cl. (तृफति) 1 To content, to please. 2 To be pleased or content. 3 To hurt.
17835: तृफला f. (-ला) The three myrobalans. E. तृ for त्रि three, फल a fruit, fem. affix टाप्; also त्रिफला.
17836: तृफू m. (-फूः) A serpent in general, the serpent genus. E. तृफ to hurt or kill, ऊ Uṇādi aff.
17837: तृम्प r. 6th cl. (तृम्पति) 1 To content, to please. 2 To be pleased or content.
17838: तृम्फ r. 6th cl. (तृम्फति) 1 To content, to please. 2 To be pleased or content.
17839: तृष (ञि आ) ञितृषा r. 4th cl. (तृष्यति) 1 To thirst. 2 To thirst metaphorically, to desire, to long for.
17840: तृष् f. (तृट्) 1 Thirst. 2 Thirst, (metaphorical,) wish, desire, lust. 3 The daughter of KĀMA, the deity of love. E. तृष to thirst, affix क्विप्; also तृषा, &c.
17841: तृषा f. (-षा) 1 Thirst. 2 Wish, desire. 3 The daughter of KĀMA: see the preceding. 4 A plant, (Commelina salicifolia:) see लाङ्गलिकी. E. तृष to thirst, affix क and टाप्; also तृष्णा, तर्षा, &c.
17842: तृषाभू f. (-भूः) The bladder. E. तृषा thirst, and भू being: whence thirst arises.
17843: तृषार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-त्ती-र्त्तं) 1 Affected by desire. 2 Thirsty, athirst. E. तृषा, and आर्त्त pained.
17844: तृषाह n. (-हं) Water. f. (-हा) A kind of anise: see मधुरिका. E. तृष thirst, आङ् before हन् to destroy or remove, affix ड.
17845: तृषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thirsty, thirsting, (physically or metaphorically.) n. (-तं) Thirst, desire. E. तृष to thirst, affix क्त.
17846: तृषितोत्तरा f. (-रा) A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia:) see असनपर्णी. E. तृषित thirst, and उत्तर answering.
17847: तृष्णज् mfn. (-ष्णक्) Thirsty, (physically or metaphorically,) desiring, longing for, cupidinous. E. तृष to thirst, न added, तृष्ण and जिङ् aff.
17848: तृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) 1 Thirst. 2 Desire, wish. E. तृषं to thirst, न Uṇādi aff.
17849: तृष्णाक्षय m. (-यः) Content, resignation, patience. E. तृष्णा greediness, thirst, and क्षय destruction.
17850: तृष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यती-ष्यत्) 1 Thirsting, athirst. 2 Desiring. E. तृष to thirst, and शतृ aff.
17851: तृह (ऊ) तृहु r. 6th cl. (तृहति) also तृह r. 7th cl. (तृणड्डि) To kill, to hurt, to injure in any manner. (इ) तृहि r. 1st cl. (तृंहति) To grow or increase.
17852: तॄ r. 1st cl. (तरति) 1 To pass over or across. 2 To pass or float over, to navigate. 3 To float or swim. 4 To overcome, to surpass. With अव prefixed, To descend, as from heaven. With आङ्, To cross by a boat, &c. With उत्, ^a To pass over or above; ^b To answer. ^c To land, to arrive at the opposite shore. With दुर्, To cross with difficulty. With निर्, To cross safely, to obtain salvation. With प्र, To excel or surpass. With वि, ^a To pass from; ^b To relinquish, to give, to give away, to give alms. With सम्, To swim over.
17853: ते ind. With or by thee. E. ते substituted for त्वया, but not to be confounded with the optional inflection of the 4th and 6th cases of युष्मद् thou.
17854: तेज r. 1st cl. (तेजति) To guard, to cherish, to defend or protect.
17855: तेज m. (-जः) 1 Sharpness, pungency. 2 Sharpness of a weapon. 3 Brilliancy. 4 Spirit. E. तिज to sharpen, affix घञ्: see तेजस्.
17856: तेजन n. (-नं) 1 A bambu. 2 Enlightening, making splendid or polished. 3 Sharpening. f. (-नी) 1 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) 2 Heartpea. E. तिज to sharpen, &c. affix ल्युट्.
17857: तेजनक m. (-कः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
17858: तेजपत्र n. (-त्रं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. तेज sharp, pungent, and पत्र a leaf.
17859: तेजल m. (-लः) The francoline partridge. E. तेज sharpness, ल what gets.
17860: तेजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Sharp, pungent. 2 Sharp as a weapon. 3 Bright. 4 Spirited, energetic. f. (-ती) An aromatic plant, (Pothos officinalis:) see गजपिप्पली. E. तेज sharpness, and मतुप् aff.
17861: तेजस् m. (-जाः) A name of Agni or fire. n. (-जः) 1 Splendour, light, lustre. 2 Dignity, consequence. 3 Strength, power. 4 Ardour, spirit, energy. 5 Semen virile. 6 Fresh butter. 7 Impatience, inability to bear or put up with. 8 Gold. 9 Bile,  the bilious humour. 10 Marrow, the brain, &c. 11 Fame, glory. 12 Sharpness, (metallic.) 13 Pungency. 14 Heat. 15 Bodily vigour. 16 Vivacity. E. तिज to sharpen or polish, affix असुन्.
17862: तेजस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Illuminating, making bright. 2 Sharpening, whetting. 3 Invigorating, tonic. E. तेजस् light, &c. and कर what makes.
17863: तेजस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Famous, celebrated. 2 Splendid, &c. see the preceding. f. (-स्विनी) Heartpea: see ज्योतिष्मती. E. तेजस् splendour, &c. विनि aff.
17864: तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sharpened, whetted, polished, burnished. 2 Excited, invigorated, stimulated. E. तिज to sharpen, and क्त aff.
17865: तेजिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Very bright or splendid. 2 Vigorous, powerful. E. तेजस्, and इष्ठन् aff.
17866: तेजीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very bright, radiant, splendid. 2 Very powerful or vigorous. E. तेजस्, and ईयसुन् aff.
17867: तेजोमन्थ m. (-न्थः) A tree, (Premna spinosa:) see गणिकारी. E. तेजस् fire, light, and मन्थ friction; the friction of the wood engendering flame.
17868: तेजोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Luminous, brilliant, consisting or made of light. E. तेजस्, मयट् made of.
17869: तेजोरूप n. (-पं) 1 The supreme spirit. 2 The nature of light, &c. E. तेजस् light (divine), रूप form.
17870: तेजोवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Pungent. 2 Sharp. 3 Bright. 4 Energetic. f. (-ती) 1 A plant bearing a fruit resembling pepper: see गजपिप्पली. 2 A kind of pepper, (Piper chavya, Rox.) E. तेजस् pungency, मतुप् aff.
17871: तेजोवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Superior brilliancy or power. E. तेजस्, and वृत्त being.
17872: तेन ind. Therefore, thence, for that reason, on that account, the correlative to येन. E. the third case of तद् that, used as a particle.
17873: तेन m. (-नः) A note or cadence introductory to a song, &c. E. त said to mean GAURI and न ŚIVA; whose favour is secured by this word.
17874: तेप (ऋ) तेपृ r. 1st cl. (तेपते) 1 To sprinkle, to distil, to ooze or drop. 2 To shake or tremble. 3 To shine.
17875: तेम m. (-मः) Wet, damp, moisture. E. तिम to be wet, affix घञ्.
17876: तेमन n. (-नं) 1 Wetting, moistening, moisture. 2 A sauce or condiment. f. (-नी) A chimney, a fireplace. E. तिम to be or become wet, affix ल्युट्.
17877: तेव (ऋ) तेवृ r. 1st cl. (तेवते) 1 To play, to sport. 2 To weep or lament.
17878: तेवन n. (-नं) 1 A garden, a pleasure garden or play-ground. 2 Play, sport, pastime. E. तेव to play, affix ल्युट्.
17879: तैक्ष्ण्य n. (-क्ष्ण्यं) 1 Sharpness. 2 Heat. 3 Pungency. 4 Fierceness, cruelty. E. तीक्ष्ण, and ष्यञ् aff.
17880: तैजस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) 1 Of or relating to fire, fiery, splendid. 2 Powerful, vigorous, intense. n. (-सं) 1 Ghee or oiled butter. 2 Any metal. 3 Intensity. 4 Vigour, energy. E. तेजस् brilliance, affix अण्.
17881: तैजसावर्त्तिनी f. (-नी) A crucible. E. तैजस metal, and आवर्त्तिनी stirring.
17882: तैतिल m. (-लः) A rhinoceros. n. (-लं) One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas. E. अण् added to तितिल.
17883: तैत्तिर m. (-रः) A francoline partridge. n. (-रं) A flock of partridges. E. तित्तिर, and अण् affix of aggregation or pleonastic.
17884: तैत्तिरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to the Tittiri portion of the Vedas, as a student, a text, teacher, section of, &c. E. तित्तिरि the Yajur Veda so called, and छ affix; or तित्तिरि a partridge, affix as before; the texts of this Veda being disgorged by YĀJÑAVALKYA in a tangible form, and picked up by the rest of VAIŚAMPĀYANA'S disciples, who, for the purpose, assumed the shape of partridges.
17885: तैत्तिरीयक m. (-कः) A follower of the Tittiri branch of the Vedas. E. कन् added to the preceding; also इन् being added तैत्तिरीयिन्, &c.
17886: तैग्म्य n. (-ग्म्यं) 1 Heat. 2 Sharpness. 3 Pungency. E. तिग्म, and ष्यञ् aff.
17887: तैल n. (-लं) 1 Oil, expressed oil, prepared from sesamum, mustard, &c. 3 Storax, gum benzoin, incense. E. तिल sesamum, and अण् aff.
17888: तैलक n. (-कं) A small quantity of oil. E. तैल, and कन् diminutive affix.
17889: तैलकार m. (-रः) An oil manufacturer. E. तैल, and कार who makes.
17890: तैलकिट्ट m. (-ट्टं) The oil cake, a cake made of the oily seed, after expression. E. तैल, and किट्ट sediment.
17891: तैलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The part of the peninsula south of Orissa to Madras, the modern Carnatic.
17892: तैलचौरिका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, चुर to steal, ण्वुल् affix; it is also sometimes read तैलाचारिका from चर to go, with आङ् prefixed, and ण्वुल् aff.
17893: तैलद्रोणी f. (-णी) A bathing tub for an oil bath. E. तैल, and द्रोणी a bucket.
17894: तैलपक m. (-कः) A cockroach. E. तैल, and पच to digest, अच् aff.
17895: तैलपर्णिक n. (-कं) White Sandal wood. E. तिलपर्णी Sandal wood, affix कन्.
17896: तैलपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 Sandal. 2 Incense. 3 Turpentine. E. तिल sesamum, and पर्ण a leaf, affix अण् and ङीप्.
17897: तैलपा f. (-पा) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, and पा who drinks.
17898: तैलपायिका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, पा to drink, ण्वुल् affix, and यक् inserted.
17899: तैलपिपीलिका f. (-का) The small red ant. E. तैल, and पिपीलिका an ant.
17900: तैलमाली f. (-ली) A wick, the cotton of a lamp. E. तैल oil, माला a necklace, ङीप् aff.
17901: तैलम्पात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blending with oil, &c. f. (-ता) Oblation to fire. E. तिल sesamum, पत to go or alight, घञ् affix, and नुम् augment.
17902: तैलसाधन n. (-नं) A fragrant substance, (Civet.) E. तैल oil, and साधन menstruum.
17903: तैलस्फटिक m. (-कः) A sort of gem, (Amber.) E. तैल oil, and स्फटिक crystal.
17904: तैलाटी f. (-टी) A wasp. E. तैल oil, and अट to go, affixes अण् and ङीप्.
17905: तैलाम्बुका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. तैल oil, अम्बु water or drink, कन् aff.
17906: तैलिक m. (-कः) An oilman. E. तैल, and ठक् aff.
17907: तैलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Relating or belonging to oil, oily, &c. m. (-ली) An oilman, an oil grinder or preparer. f. (-लिनी) 1 The wick or cotton of a lamp. 2 A kind of insect found in oil. E. तैल oil, affix इनि.
17908: तैलिशाला f. (-ला) An oil mill. E. तैलिन् an oilman, and शाला a house or hall.
17909: तैलीन n. (-नं) A field of sesamum. E. तिल sesamum, and खञ् aff.
17910: तैष m. (-षः) The month Pauṣa, (December-January.) f. (-त्री) Day of full moon in Pauṣa. E. तिष्य the constellation, (in which the moon is full in this month,) and अण् affix; य is dropped.
17911: तोक n. (-कं) A child, a son or a daughter, male or female offspring. E. तु a Sautra root, to increase, affix क, deriv. irr. also तोककं.
17912: तोक्म m. (-क्मः) 1 Green or unripe barley. 2 Green, (the colour.) n. (-क्मं) 1 The wax of the ear. 2 A cloud. E. तक to deride, म affix, and ओ substituted for the radical vowel; it is also written तोक्य.
17913: तोटक n. (-कं) A measure of verse, a stanza, each line containing twelve syllables.
17914: तोड r. 1st cl. (ऋ) तोडृ (तोडति) To treat with disrespect.
17915: तोत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A stick or bambu, with a sharp iron head, used for guiding an elephant. 2 A goad or pike for driving cattle. E. तुद to vex, to goad, affix ष्ट्रन्; also तोदन.
17916: तोत्रवेत्र n. (-त्रं) A rod or wand carried by VIṢṆU. E. तोत्र a goad, and वेत्र a stick.
17917: तोद m. (-दः) 1 Pain, anguish, vexation, torture, uneasiness, (either of body or mind.) 2 Sharp, shooting or pricking pain. E. तुद to tease or torment, affix घञ्.
17918: तोदन n. (-नं) 1 A goad: see तोत्र. 2 Pain, affliction from disease, &c. E. तुद to give pain, affix ल्युट्.
17919: तोमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 An iron club or crow. 2 A lance. E. तु Sautra root, to hurt, affix विच्, तु that which injures, मृ to die, affix अच्, and the vowel of तु changed.
17920: तोमरग्रह m. (-हः) A warrior armed with a club. E. तोमर, and ग्रह who takes.
17921: तोमरधर m. (-रः) 1 A name of Agni. 2 A warrior armed with a club. E. तोमर an iron club, and धर having.
17922: तोमरिका f. (-का) A fragrant earth: see तुवरिका.
17923: तोय n. (-यं) Water. E. तु to surround, Uṇādi affix कोय or ताय to nourish, अच् affix, and आ changed irregularly to ओ.
17924: तोयकाम m. (-मः) A sort of cane growing in or near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.) E. तोय water, and काम desiring, affecting.
17925: तोयकृच्छ्र m. (-च्छ्रः) A sort of penance, drinking nothing but water for a fixed period. E. तोय water, and कच्छ्र penance.
17926: तोयडिम्भ m. (-म्भः) Hail. E. तोय water, and डिम्भ young; also तायडिम्भक.
17927: तोयद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives water. m. (-दः) 1 A cloud. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) n. (-दं) Ghee or oiled butter. E. तोय water, and द yielding.
17928: तोयधर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Having or containing water. m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 A fragrant grass: see मुस्तक. 3 A potherb, (Marsilia dentata.) E. तोय water, and धर possessing.
17929: तोयधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. तोय water, and धि having.
17930: तोयधिप्रिय m. (-यः) Cloves. E. तोयधि the sea, and प्रिय fond of; produced in maritime countries.
17931: तोयनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. तोय water, and निधि nest or receptacle.
17932: तोयपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant, (Jussieua repens.) E. तोय water, and पिप्पली long pepper.
17933: तोयपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) Trumpet flower. E. तोय water, and पुष्प a flower; flowering near water.
17934: तोयप्रसादन n. (-नं) The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum.) E. तोय water, and प्रसादन clearing, cleansing; the nut being rubbed upon the inside of a water jar, occasions the precipitation of the impurities of the water poured into it.
17935: तोयप्रसादनफल n. (-लं) The clearing nut: see the preceding. E. तोयप्रसादन as above, and फल fruit.
17937: तोयवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) E. तोय water, and वल्ली a creeper.
17938: तोयशुक्तिका f. (-का) An oyster. E. तोय, and शुक्तिका an oyster.
17939: तोयसूचक m. (-कः) A frog. E. तोय water, and सूचक a spy.
17940: तोयाधिवासिनी f. (-नी) Trumpet flower. E. तोय water, अधि upon or near, वस to abide, णिनि and ङीप् affs.
17941: तोरण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 The ornamented arch of a door or gateway. 2 An outer door. 3 Decoration of the gate post. 4 A temporary and ornamental arch. 5 A mound or raised mark near a bathing place. 6 A triangle supporting a large balance. n. (-णं) The neck, the throat. E. तुर to hasten, affix ल्युट्; by which people pass or go.
17942: तोल mn. (-लः-लं) A Tola, a weight of gold or silver: it is stated in books at 16 Māṣas of 5 Rattis or 6½ grains each, and weighs therefore 105 grains troy: in practice it is calculated at 12 Māṣas jeweller's weight, and weighs nearly double, or 210 grains; but actually it is of the same weight as the Sicca or grs. 179(2/3). E. तुल to weigh, affix घञ्; also with ण्वुल् affix तोलक, mn. (-कः-कं.)
17943: तोलन n. (-नं) Weighing. E. तुल to weigh, ल्युट् aff.
17944: तोलयित्वा ind. Having weighed. E. तुल to weigh, causal form, त्त्वा aff.
17945: तोष n. (-षं) Pleasure, joy, happiness. E. तुष to be pleased, affix घञ्.
17946: तोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, appeased. E. तुष to be pleased, affix क्त.
17947: तौक (ऋ) तौकृ r. 1st cl. (तौकते) To go or move.
17949: तौतिक n. (-कं) A pearl. m. (-कः) The pearl oyster.
17950: तौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) The sound of musical instruments, harmony, &c. E. तूर्य्य an instrument, and अण् aff.
17951: तौर्य्यत्रिक n. (-कं) Symphony, union of song, dance, and instrumental music. E. तौर्य्य as above, त्रि three, कन् affix; triple or threefold melody.
17952: तौल n. (-लं) A balance. E. तुला, अण् pleonasm.
17953: तौलिक m. (-कः) A painter. E. तुलिका a brush, and अण् aff.
17954: तौलिकिक m. (-कः) A painter. E. तुलिका a brush or pencil, and ठक् aff.
17955: तौषार n. (-रं) 1 Snow. 2 Cold. E. तुषार frost, and अण् aff.
17956: त्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Left, resigned, abandoned, deserted, &c. E. त्यज to quit, affix क्त.
17957: त्यक्तजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ready to die; willing to run all hazards, having relinquished the expectation of life as men on the forlorn hope. E. त्यक्त left, and जीवित life.
17958: त्यक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Leaving, abandoning. E. त्यज to quit, क्तवतु aff.
17959: त्यक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be left, abandoned, excepted, &c. E. त्यज, and तव्य aff.
17960: त्यक्ताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman who has lost his household fire, one who neglects essential ceremonies. E. त्यक्त, and अग्नि fire.
17961: त्यक्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Wishing to leave. E. त्यक्तु for the infin. त्यक्तुं, and काम desiring.
17962: त्यक्त्वा ind. Having left or abandoned. E. त्यज, and क्त्वा aff.
17963: त्यज r. 1st cl. (औ) त्यजौ (त्यजति) To quit, to abandon, to leave or resign, to part from, to give away.
17964: त्यजन n. (-नं) 1 Leaving, quitting, abandoning. 2 Excepting, exclusion. 3 Giving. E. त्यज, and ल्युट् aff.
17965: त्यजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be left or abandoned. 2 To be avoided. 3 To be excepted. E. त्यज, and अनीयर् aff.
17966: त्यद् pron. for तद् mfn. (स्यः-स्या-तद्) That. E. त्यज to quit, Uṇādi affix अदि, and the final of the radical rejected.
17967: त्याग m. (-गः) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Abandoning, leaving, parting from, separation, deserting, &c. 3 A sage, one who separates himself from worldly thoughts. E. त्यज to abandon, घञ् aff.
17968: त्यागशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Generous, liberal. E. त्याग, and शील addicted to.
17969: त्यागशीलता f. (-ता) Generosity. E. त्यागशील, and तल् affix; also with त्व, त्यागशीलत्वं.
17970: त्यागिता f. (-ता) Liberality, generosity. E. त्यागिन्, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, त्यागित्वं.
17971: त्यागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Who or what leaves, gives, excepts, &c. m. (-गी) A giver, a donor. 2 A hero. 3 An abandoner, a deserter, but chiefly applied to the religious ascetic, or him who abandons terrestrial objects, thoughts, passions, &c. E. त्याग as above, इनि aff.
17972: त्यागिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Left, abandoned. E. त्याग leaving, इमच् aff.
17973: त्याज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 1 To be left or avoided. 2 To be abstained from. 3 To be given. 4 To be excepted. n. (-ज्यं) Part of an asterism, or its duration considered as unlucky. E. त्यज to leave, affix ण्यत्.
17974: त्रक (इ) त्रकि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्कते) To go or move.
17975: त्रख (इ) त्रखि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्खति) To go or move.
17976: त्रग (इ) त्रगि r. 1st cl. (त्रङ्गति) To go or move.
17977: त्रङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा) The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended, it is supposed, in the air. E. त्रै to fear, affix क्विप्, and ग what goes; what imparts terror.
17978: त्रद (इ) त्रदि r. 1st cl. (त्रन्दति) 1 To act, to perform functions. 2 To endeavour, to strive. 3 To be busy.
17979: त्रप (ऊ, ष) त्रपूष् r. 1st cl. (त्रपति) To be modest, to be ashamed.
17980: त्रप mf. (-पः-पा) Shame, modesty, bashfulness. f. (-पा) 1 An unchaste woman, (a shame to her family.) 2 Family, race. 3 Fame, celebrity. E. त्रप to be modest, affix अङ्, fem. affix टाप्.
17981: त्रपमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being ashamed. E. त्रप्र to be ashamed, शानच् aff.
17982: त्रपाक m. (-कः) A barbarian of a certain description. E. त्रप to be modest, आकन् Uṇādi aff.
17983: त्रपानिरस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Shameless, impudent. E. त्रपा, and निरस्त expelled.
17984: त्रपान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, bashful, ashamed. E. त्रपा, and अन्वित possessed of.
17985: त्रपाभर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Overcome with shame. E. त्रपा, and भर having.
17986: त्रपायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Bashful, modest. E. त्रपा, and युक्त attached.
17987: त्रपारण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A whore, a harlot. E. त्रपा shame, लडि to reject, affix अच् and टाप्, and ल changed to र.
17988: त्रपावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Modest, ashamed. E. त्रपा, and मतुप् aff.
17989: त्रपाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Immodest, impudent. E. त्रपा, and हीन void of.
17990: त्रपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, bashful, ashamed. E. त्रप to be modest, क्त aff.
17991: त्रपिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Highly satisfied. 2 Very much ashamed. E. तृप to please, or त्रपा shame, and इष्ठन् affix, deriv. irr.
17992: त्रपीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Highly or excessively pleased or content. 2 Very much ashamed. E. तृप to be pleased, or तृपा and इयसुन् affix of the irr. superlative.
17993: त्रपु n. (-पुः) 1 Tin. 2 Lead. E. त्रप to be modest, Uṇādi affix उ.
17994: त्रपुल n. (-लं) Tin. E. लच् added to the preceding.
17995: त्रपुष mf. (-षं-षी) A cucumber. n. (-षं) Tin. E. त्रप to be ashamed, &c. उसस् affix, fem. ङीष्.
17996: त्रपुस् n. (-पुः) Tin, or according to some, lead: see त्रपु. E. त्रप to be ashamed, Uṇādi affix उस्.
17997: त्रप्सा n. (-प्स्यं) Thin or diluted curds. E. तृप to be satisfied, deriv. irr.; also without the final य, त्रप्स, n. (-प्सं) also द्रप्स्य and द्रप्सा.
17998: त्रय nf. (-यं-यी) 1 The third. 2 (In composition) Three, as गुणत्रयं the three properties. E. त्रि, टयप् aff.
17999: त्रयी f. (-यी) 1 The three Vedas collectively, that is, omitting the Atharvan, which not being a text book for the customary religious rites of the Hindus, is considered very commonly rather as an appendix to the other three, than a fourth work of equal authority. A matron, a married woman who has children living. 3 Intellect, understanding. 4 A plant, (Conyza serratula.) E. त्रि three, अयप् or टयप् substituted for the final, fem. affix ङीप्.
18000: त्रयीतनु m. (-नुः) The sun. E. त्रयी the three Vedas, and तनु diffusion; celebrated through these sacred books, or because the Sāma Veda, and portions of the other Vedas, are said to have proceeded from the sun.
18001: त्रयीधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Duty enjoined by the Vedas, modes of sacrifice, &c. prescribed by them. E. त्रयी the three Vedas, and धर्म्म virtue.
18002: त्रयीमुख m. (-खः) A Brahman. E. त्रयी the Vedas, and मुख the mouth.
18003: त्रयोदश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Thirteenth. f. (-शी) The thirteenth day of the lunar fortnight: see the next.
18004: त्रयोदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Thirteen. E. त्रयस् for त्रि three, and दशन् ten.
18005: त्रस (ई) त्रसी r. 1st and 4th cl. (त्रसति त्रस्यति) 1 To fear, to be afraid. 2 To run, to go quickly. (इ) त्रसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (त्रंसति त्रंसयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. Also त्रस r. 10th cl. (त्रासयति) 1 To hold. 2 To seize or take. 3 To oppose, to prevent or forbid. 4 To frighten.
18006: त्रस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Moveable, loco-motive. n. (-सं) A wood, a forest. E. त्रस to go, affix अच्.
18007: त्रसर m. (-रः) 1 A shuttle. 2 Weaving. E. त्रस to go, affix अरच्.
18008: त्रसरेणु mf. (-णुः) An atom or mote visible in a sunbeam, especially considered as an ideal weight, either of the lowest denomination, or equal to three, or according to some, thirty invisible atoms. f. (-णुः) A wife of the sun. E. त्रस moveable, and रेणु dust; also read त्र्यमरेणु.
18009: त्रसुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Timid, fearful. E. त्रस to fear, उरच् aff.
18010: त्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Timid, fearful. 2 Frighted, alarmed. 3 Quick. E. त्रस to fear, affix क्त; also त्रस्नु.
18011: त्रस्तरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Fearful, terrified. E. त्रस्त, and रूप form.
18012: त्रस्नु mfn. (-स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु) Timid, fearful. E. त्रस to fear, क्नु aff.
18013: त्रस्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Fearing, apprehending. E. त्रस to fear, शतृ aff.
18014: त्रा r. 2nd cl. (त्राति) To preserve, &c.: see त्रै.
18015: त्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Preserved, saved, guarded, protected. n. (-णं) Preserving, protection. 2 A plant: see त्रायमाण. E. त्रै to preserve, affix क्त and ण optionally substituted for त; also त्रात; again, त्रै to preserve, affix ल्यु.
18016: त्रात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preserved, guarded, protected. n. (-तं) Preserving, protection: see the preceding.
18017: त्रापुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Made of tin. E. त्रपुस् tin, affix अण, and षुक् augment.
18018: त्रायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Preserving, protecting. f. (-न्ती) 1 A plant: see the next. 2 A protectress, &c. E. त्रै to preserve, affix शतृ.
18019: त्रायमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A preserver, preserving. f. (-णा) A medicinal plant. E. त्रै to preserve, affix शानच्.
18020: त्रास m. (-सः) 1 Fear, terror. 2 A flaw or defect in a jewel. E. त्रस to fear, affix घञ्.
18021: त्रासकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Fearful, alarming. E. त्रास, and कर what makes.
18022: त्रासदायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Terrifying, fear-exciting. E. त्रास fear, and दायिन् what gives.
18023: त्रासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Frightened, alarmed. E. त्रास to fear, causal form, affix क्त.
18024: त्रि plu. only, m. (त्रयः) f. (तिस्रः) n. (त्रीणि) Three. subst. m. sing. (त्रिः) plu. (त्रयः) Three times, a thrice. E. तॄ to pass, Uṇādi affix क, and त्रि substituted.
18025: त्रिंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Thirtieth. E. त्रिंशत, and ड aff.
18026: त्रिंशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Thirty collectively, a multitude of thirty. E. त्रिंशत thirty, affix क्वुन्.
18027: त्रिंशत् f. sing. (-त्) Thirty, &c. (-तौ) Two thirties. plu. (-तः) Many thirties. E. त्रिं for त्रि three, and शत् aff.
18028: त्रिंशत्पत्र n. (-त्रं) The white esculent water lily. E. त्रिशत thirty, and पत्र a leaf.
18029: त्रिक n. (-कं) 1 The lower part of the spine. 2 The aggregate of three, a trine, a triad. 3 The three mystical words to be pronounced in daily prayer. 4 A place where three roads meet. 5 Three spices, three myrobalans, &c. collectively: see त्रिकटु, त्रिफल and the like. m. (-कः) A plant: see गोक्षुरक. f. (-का) 1 A triangular frame or bar across the mouth of a well over which passes the rope of the bucket, or to which one end of it is tied to guard against, its slipping. 2 A wooden frame at the mouth of a well, or the upper part of the well. 3 A frame at the bottom of a well, on which the masonry rests. 4 The cover or lid of a well. E. त्रि three, and कन् aff.
18030: त्रिककुद् m. (-द् or -त्) A mountain with three peaks. E. त्रि, three, and ककुद a peak.
18031: त्रिककुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Having three humps or peaks. E. त्रि, and ककुद् a hump, and अच् aff.
18032: त्रिकट m. (-टः) A plant, (Ruellia longifolia,) &c. see गोक्षुरक.
18033: त्रिकटु m. (-टुः) The aggregate of three spices, viz. black and long pepper, and dry ginger. E. त्रि three, or three-fold, and कटु pungent, (as a spice.)
18034: त्रिकण्ट m. (-ण्टः) 1 A plant, (Ruellia longifolia,) &c. त्रिकट. 2 A sort of Euphorbia. E. त्रि three, and कण्ट a thorn.
18035: त्रिकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 A sort of fish, (Silurus.) 2 A plant: see the preceding. E. कन् added to त्रिकण्ट.
18036: त्रिकाय m. (-यः) A name of Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. त्रि three, and काय a body, the three-bodied.
18037: त्रिकालज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Omniscient. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A divine sage. 2 A deity. 3 A name of Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. त्रि three, काल time, and ज्ञ who knows, acquainted with the past, present, and future; also similar compounds as the next, &c.
18038: त्रिकालदर्शिन् mfn. (-शी-शिणी-शि) Omniscient. m. (-शी) 1 A Ṛṣi or divine sage. 2 A name of Buddha. E. त्रि three, काल time, and दर्शिन् who views: see the preceding.
18039: त्रिकालविद् mfn. (-विद्-वित्) Omniscient. m. (-विद् or -वित्) A name of Buddha: see the preceding. E. as before, विद् who knows.
18040: त्रिकुद m. (-दः) The name of a mountain in the peninsula; it is also applicable to any mountain with three peaks. n. (-टं) Sea salt prepared by evaporation. E. त्रि three, कूट a peak, &c.
18041: त्रिकूर्च्चक n. (-कं) A sort of knife with three edges. E. त्रि, and कूर्च्चक a bunch.
18042: त्रिकोण n. (-णं) 1 The vulva. 2 A triangle. 3 Any triangular object. E. त्रि three, and कोण a corner.
18043: त्रिख (इ) त्रिखि r. 1st cl. (त्रिङ्खति) To go, to move or approach.
18044: त्रिख n. (-खं) A cucumber. E. त्रि three, and ख a cavity or space; also read sometimes तृख.
18045: त्रिखद्व nf. (-द्वं-द्वी) The aggregate of three beds. E. त्रि three, खद्वा a bed, अच् aff.
18046: त्रिगण m. (-णः) The aggregate of three human objects, or virtue, wealth, and desire. E. त्रि three, and गण a class: see त्रिवर्ग.
18047: त्रिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tripled. 2 Gone or done in three ways. n. (-तं) The expression of different senses by the same word. E. त्रि, and गत gone.
18048: त्रिगर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A country in the north-west division of India, or m. plu. (-र्त्तः) Its inhabitants: apparently part of Lahore, said, by Mr. WILFORD, to be the modern Tahora, but differently described in the Koṣas: see जालन्धर and वाह्लीक. 2 A form of calculation, (गणितान्तरे.) f. (-र्त्ता) 1 A small worm. 2 A lascivious woman, a wanton. 3 A woman in general. 4 A pearl. E. त्रि three, and गर्त्त a hole, &c.
18049: त्रिगर्त्तक m. (-कः) A country, the same as Vāhlika: see वाह्लीक. E. कन् added to the preceding.
18050: त्रिगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णी-णं) 1 Thrice, three times, triple. 2 Possessing the three Guṇas or properties. n. (-णं) The aggregate of the three qualities incident to human nature. E. त्रि three, गुण a time or property.
18051: त्रिगुणाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.) E. त्रिगुण three times, and आकृत made, wrought.
18052: त्रिगूढ n. (-ढं) The dancing or acting of a man in female attire. E. त्रि, and गूढ concealed.
18053: त्रिचतुर mfn. plur. (-राः-राः-राणि) Three or four. E. त्रि, and चतुर four, अच् added.
18054: त्रिजातक n. (-कं) Three spices collectively, mace, cardamoms, and cassia leaf. E. त्रि, and जातक species.
18055: त्रिज्या f. (-ज्या) A radius, a sine of three signs or ninety degrees. E. त्रि, and ज्या a sine.
18056: त्रिण n. (-णं) Grass, meadow grass. E. see तृण, ऋ being changed to रि.
18057: त्रिणता f. (-ता) 1 A bow. 2 The state or abstract property of grass. E. त्रिण for तृण grass, and तल् aff.
18058: त्रिणाचिकेत n. (-तं) A portion of the Yajur Veda. m. (-तः) A follower of that branch of the Vedas. It is also sometimes read तृणाचिकेत.
18059: त्रितक्ष nf. (-क्षः-क्षी) An assemblage of three carpenters. E. त्रि three, तक्ष a carpenter, affix अण्.
18060: त्रितय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Third. E. त्रि three, तयप् aff.
18061: त्रिदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 1 Three staves collectively. 2 Triple subjection of words, thoughts, and acts; the state of a religious ascetic. E. त्रि three, दण्ड a staff, &c.
18062: त्रिदण्डधारण n. (-णं) Carrying three staves tied together, (as done by some mendicants.) E. त्रिदण्ड, and धारण holding.
18063: त्रिदण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 1 A wandering devotee, one who carries three long bambu staves in his right hand. 2 The religious man who has obtained a command over his words, thoughts, and actions, or mind, body, and speech. E. त्रि three, and दण्ड a punishment, a staff, &c. इनि aff.
18064: त्रिदला f. (-ला) A creeping plant, (Cissus pedata.) E. त्रि three, and दल a leaf.
18065: त्रिदश m. (-शः) A god, a deity, an immortal. E. त्रि the third, and दशा state, being, (youth;) enjoying perpetual youth; or त्रि three, and दश state, subject as well as mortals to the three conditions, of birth, being, and destruction.
18066: त्रिदश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Thirteenth. f. (-शी) The thirteenth day of the fortnight; also त्रयोदश.
18067: त्रिदशदीर्धिका f. (-का) The heavenly Ganges. E. त्रिदश a deity, and दीर्धिका a long pool.
18068: त्रिदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Thirteen. E. त्रि three, and दशन् ten.
18069: त्रिदशनदी f. (-दी) The heavenly Ganges. E. त्रिदश, and नदी a river.
18070: त्रिदशपति m. (-तिः) INDRA. E. त्रिदश, and पति chief.
18071: त्रिदशबधू f. (-धूः) A nymph of INDRA'S heaven. E. त्रिदश, and बधू wife.
18072: त्रिदशवनिता f. (-ता) A nymph of INDRA'S heaven. E. त्रिदश, and वनिता a wife.
18073: त्रिदशाङ्कुश n. (-शं) The thunderbolt. E. त्रिदश a deity, and अङ्कुश a goad.
18074: त्रिदशाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The preceptor of the gods, VṚHASPATI. E. त्रिदश a deity, and आचार्य्य a teacher.
18075: त्रिदशायुध n. (-धं) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. त्रिदश a deity, and आयुध a weapon.
18076: त्रिदशारि m. (-रिः) An Asura or infernal being hostile to the gods, a Titan, a Giant. E. त्रिदश a deity, and अरि a foe.
18077: त्रिदशालय m. (-यः) 1 Svarga, INDRA'S heaven or paradise. 2 The mountain Sumeru. E. त्रिदश a deity, and आलय an abode.
18078: त्रिदशावास m. (-सः) Svarga, the heaven of INDRA. E. त्रिदश a god, and आवास abode.
18079: त्रिदशाहार m. (-रः) Amṛta or ambrosia. E. त्रिदश a deity, and आहार food.
18080: त्रिदालिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Carmaghās.
18081: त्रिदिन n. (-नं) Three days collectively. E. त्रि, and दिन a day.
18082: त्रिदिनस्पृश् m. (-स्पृक्) Conjunction or concurrence of three lunations with one solar day. E. त्रिदिन, and स्पृश् contact.
18083: त्रिदिव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 Svarga or paradise. 2 Sky, atmosphere, heaven. f. (-वा) The name of a river. E. त्रि the three, BRAHMA, VIṢṆU, and ŚIVA, दिव to sport, affix क; the place where these three gods take divine pleasure.
18084: त्रिदिवेश m. (-शः) A god, a deity. E. त्रिदिव heaven, and ईश master or lord.
18085: त्रिदिवौकस् m. (-काः) A god, a celestial. E. त्रिदिव heaven, and ओकस् asylum.
18086: त्रिदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Tri-ocular, three-eyed. m. (-दृक्) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रि three, and दृश् an eye.
18087: त्रिदोष n. (-षं) Disorder of the three humours of the body, vitiation of the bile, blood, and phlegm. E. त्रि three, and दोष a fault.
18088: त्रिदोषघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Correcting the vitiated state of the three humours. E. त्रिदोष, and घ्न what destroys.
18089: त्रिदोषज m. (-जः) Disease, &c. proceeding from disorder of the three humours of the body E. त्रिदोष, and ज produced.
18090: त्रिधा ind. In three ways. E. त्रि, and धाच् aff.
18091: त्रिधातु m. (-तुः) A name of GAṆEŚA. n. (-तु) Three minerals, &c. E. त्रि three, and धातु mineral, &c.
18092: त्रिधामन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Having three residences, &c. m. (-मा) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 An appellation of ŚIVA. 3 Agni or fire. 4 Death. E. त्रि three (worlds), and धामन् abode.
18093: त्रिनयन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Three-eyed, tri-ocular. m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रि three, and नयन an eye; this deity is represented with a third eye in his forehead; also similar compounds, as त्रिहृश्, त्रिनेत्र, त्र्यक्ष, &c.
18094: त्रिनेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Tri-ocular. m. (-त्रः) ŚIVA. E. त्रि, and नेत्र eye.
18095: त्रिनेत्रचूडामणि m. (-णिः) The moon. E. त्रिनेत्र ŚIVA, त्रूडा a crest and मणि a gem; being worn by that deity as his crest.
18096: त्रिपक्ष n. (-क्षं) A period of six weeks. E. त्रि, and पक्ष a fortnight.
18097: त्रिपताक m. (-कः) 1 The forehead marked naturally with three horizontal lines. 2 The hand with three fingers erect. E. त्रि three or three-fold, and पताका a banner, a symbol.
18098: त्रिपत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Three-leaved trefoil. m. (-त्रः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. त्रि, and पत्र leaf.
18099: त्रिपत्रक m. (-कः) The Kiṃśuka tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. त्रि three, and पत्र a leaf; having three leaves on each stalk.
18100: त्रिपथ n. (-थं) 1 A place where three roads meet. 2 Three ways or paths. E. त्रि, and पथ a road.
18101: त्रिपथगा f. (-गा) The Ganges. E. त्रिपथ three roads, and गा who goes, flowing through earth, heaven, and hell.
18102: त्रिपद mfn. (-दः-दा-दी-दं) 1 Three-footed. 2 Having three lines or divisions, (a stanza.) 3 (In Arithmetic,) Trinomial. n. (-दं) 1 A tripod. f. (-दा) A verse of three lines, as the Gāyatrī. f. (-दी) 1 A creeper, (Cissus pedata.) 2 The girth of an elephant. E. त्रि three, and पद a foot.
18103: त्रिपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Three-leaved trefoil. f. (-र्णी) Wild cotton. E. त्रि three, and पर्ण a leaf.
18104: त्रिपाद् m. (-पाद्) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 Fever, (personified.) E. त्रि three, and पाद foot or part; three-footed, alluding to VIṢṆU'S three steps which paced the universe; and the demon of fever is described in the Purāṇas, with three feet, and three heads, alluding probably to its three stages of cold, hot, and sweating.
18105: त्रिपिव m. (-वः) A long-eared goat. E. त्रि, and पिव who drinks, touching water with both ears as he laps.
18106: त्रिपिष्टप n. (-पं) 1 Heaven, Svarga or paradise. 2 Sky, æther. E. पिष्टप a world. and त्रि three, or the third; also त्रिविष्टप.
18107: त्रिपिष्टपसद् m. (-सद्) A deity. E. त्रिपिष्टप heaven, and सद् who goes, from सद् with क्विप् affix; also त्रिविष्टपसद्.
18108: त्रिपुट m. (-टः) 1 Pulse, pease of three kinds. 2 A bank or shore. 3 A kind of vetch, (Cicer arietinum.) 4 A cubit. 5 A plant, (Ruellia longifolia.) f. (-टा-टी) A plant, (Convolvulus turpethum.) f. (-टा) Small cardamoms. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 A goddess. E. त्रि three, and पुट skin or coat of a seed, &c.
18109: त्रिपुटक m. (-कः) A triangle. E. कन् added to the last.
18110: त्रिपुटिन् m. (-टी) The castor oil plant. E. त्रि three, पुट the seed vessel, and इनि aff.
18111: त्रिपुटीफल m. (-लः) The castor oil plant. E. त्रिपुटी as above, and फल fruit.
18112: त्रिपुण्ड्र n. (-ण्ड्रं) Three curved horizontal marks, made across the forehead with cowdung, ashes, &c.; they are worn especially by the followers of ŚIVA, or ŚAKTI, and are indispensable in proceeding to worship the former. E. त्रि three, triple, and पुण्ड्र a line; also with उन् added त्रिपुण्ड्रक.
18114: त्रिपुर nf. (-रं-री) A district, the modern Tipparah, &c. m. (-रः) The name of an Asura, and king of Tripura. E. त्रि three, and पुर a city, the district and dominion of that Asura, consisting of three strong and famous cities.
18115: त्रिपुरदहन m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रिपुर the country of Tripura, and दहन burning, consuming; the Asura and his three cities being destroyed by MAHĀDEVA; also similar names, as त्रिपुरजित्, त्रिपुरसूदन, &c.
18116: त्रिपुरमल्लिका f. (-का) A medicinal plant, apparently a kind of jasmine. E. त्रिपुर Tipperah, and मल्लिका jasmine.
18117: त्रिपुरान्तक m. (-कः) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रिपुर, and अन्तक ender, destroyer: see त्रिपुरदहन.
18118: त्रिपुरुष n. (-षं) Three generations collectively. E. त्रि three, पुरुष a man.
18119: त्रिपुरुषागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enjoyed or inherited through three generations. E. त्रिपुरुष, and आगत come.
18120: त्रिपौरुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Relating or belonging to three persons or generations, offered to three, (the funeral cake, &c.) inherited from three, (an estate, &c.) E. त्रिपुरुष, and अण् aff.
18122: त्रिपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A king, and one of the Vāsudevas, or descendants of VASUDEVA, according to the Jains.
18123: त्रिफला f. (-ला) The three myrobalans. E. त्रि three, फल fruit, fem. affix टाप्; also with ङीष् affix त्रिफली.
18124: त्रिबुलीक n. (-कं) The anus. E. त्रि three, (the three humors,) बुल to sink, affix कीकन्.
18125: त्रिभण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A plant, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. त्रि three, (ailments, or bile, phlegm, and fever,) भडि to oppose, affix अण् and ङीष्.
18126: त्रिभद्र n. (-द्रं) Copulation, cohabitation. E. त्रि three, and भद्र pleasurable.
18127: त्रिभुज m. (-जः) A triangle. E. त्रि, and भुज an arm.
18128: त्रिभुवन n. (-नं) Three worlds, or heaven, earth, and hell. E. त्रि three, and भुवन a world.
18129: त्रिमधु m. (-धुः) 1 A portion of the Rig Veda. 2 A follower or student of the Tri-madhu section of the Rig Veda. n. (-धुः) Ghee, honey, and sugar. E. त्रि, and मधु honey.
18130: त्रिमार्ग्गी f. (-र्ग्गी) The meeting of three roads. E. त्रि three, and मार्ग्ग a road.
18131: त्रिमुकुट m. (-टः) A mountain with three peaks. E. त्रि three, and मुकुट a crest.
18132: त्रिमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Having three faces. m. (-खः) A divine attendant upon a Jaina saint. f. (-खा) A female deity of the Jaina sect. E. त्रि three, and मुख a face, three-faced, or त्रि three (worlds), and मुख principal.
18133: त्रिमूर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A Jina or Jaina saint. 2 The united form of BRAHMĀ, VIṢṆU, and ŚIVA, or the Hindu trial. 3 One possessing three forms or modes of being. E. त्रि three, and मूर्त्ति form, matter.
18134: त्रिमूर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) Three-headed. E. त्रि, and मूर्द्धन् the forehead, ष aff.
18135: त्रियव n. (-बः) A Ratti or weight of three barley-corns. E. त्रि, and यव barley.
18136: त्रियष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A medicinal plant, (Mollugo pentaphylla.) E. त्रि three, and यष्टि a line; having three stalks.
18137: त्रियामक n. (-कं) Sin. E. स्त्रि the three objects of life, and यामक impeder, from यम, with ण्वुल् aff.
18138: त्रियामा f. (-मा) 1 Night. 2 The YAMUNĀ or Jumna river. 3 Indigo. 4 Black Tëori, a plant so called. E. त्रि three (times, or past, present, and future,) या to go, affix मन्.
18139: त्रियूह m. (-हः) A brown or chesnut horse.
18140: त्रिरात्र n. (-त्रं) Three nights collectively, or the duration of three nights. E. त्रि three, and रात्रि a night; compounded with a numeral रात्रि substitutes अ for its final, and becomes neuter.
18141: त्रिरेख m. (-खः) A conch. E. त्रि, and रेखा a line; this shell being marked with three lines.
18142: त्रिलोकी f. (-की) The aggregate of the three worlds, or heaven, earth, and hell, collectively. E. त्रि three, and लोक a world, and ङीप् affix, with the sense of aggregation.
18143: त्रिलोकेश m. (-शः) The sun. E. त्रिलोक the three worlds or the universe, and ईश lord.
18144: त्रिलोचन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Tri-ocular, three-eyed. m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA. f. (-ना) A female deity of the Jainas. f. (-नी) A name of DURGĀ. E. त्रि three, and लोचन an eye: see त्रिदृश् &c.
18145: त्रिलोहक n. (-कं) Gold, silver, and copper. E. त्रि, and लोहक metal.
18146: त्रिवर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Three human objects or pursuits, as love, duty, and wealth. 2 Three conditions of a king or state; prosperity, evenness, and decay; or loss, gain, equality, &c. 3 The three qualities of nature, purity, blindness, and depravity. 4 The three myrobalans. 5 The three spices: see त्रिकटु. 6 Propriety, good behaviour. E. त्रि three, and वर्ग a class; a class or aggregate of three.
18147: त्रिवर्गपारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having passed through the three conditions, or attained the three objects of life. E. त्रिवर्ग, and पारीण gone to the opposite shore.
18148: त्रिवर्णक n. (-कं) 1 The three myrobalans. 2 The three spices. 3 A plant, (Ruellia longifolia:) see गोक्षुरक. E. त्रि three, वर्ण a class, and कन् added.
18149: त्रिवर्षिका f. (-का) A three years old heifer. E. त्रि, and वर्ष a year, affix ठन्.
18150: त्रिवली f. (-ली) Three folds of skin on the abdomen, from obesity. E. त्रि, and वली a wrinkle.
18151: त्रिविक्रम m. (-मः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. त्रि, and विक्रम going; crossing over the three worlds in three steps, to the discomfiture of BĀLĪ.
18152: त्रिविद्या f. (-द्या) Three branches of knowledge, especially that of the three Vedas. E. त्रि, and विद्या knowledge.
18153: त्रिविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) In three ways, of three kinds. E. त्रि, and विध sort.
18154: त्रिविष्टप n. (-पं) 1 Heaven or paradise. 2 The three worlds, or heaven, earth, and hell: see त्रिपिष्टप.
18155: त्रिविष्टपसद् m. (-सद) A deity; also त्रिपिष्टपसद्.
18156: त्रिवृत् mfn. (-वृत्) Triple, tri-form, three-fold. m. (-वृत्) 1 A plant of valuable purgative properties, commonly called Tëori, and distinguished into two species, white and black, (Convolvulus turpethum.) 2 Combining any thing by three. 2 A triple cord, a girdle, &c. of three strings. 3 A kind of sacrifice. E. त्रि three, (three seed vessels,) वृ to cherish, affix क्विप्, and तुक् added; also with टाप् added त्रिवृता (-ता.)
18157: त्रिवृत्करण n. (-णं) Combining earth, water, and fire, in the proportion of half of one with a quarter of each of the others. E. त्रिवृत्, and करण making.
18158: त्रिवृत्पर्णी f. (-र्णी) A potherb, (Hilancha repens.) E. त्रिवृत् Tëori, and पर्ण a leaf; having similar leaves.
18159: त्रिवेणी f. (-णी) A name of the Ganges. E. त्रि three, वेणी a braid of hair: the name is especially applied to the river at Allahabad, where it receives the Jumna, and is supposed to receive under ground the Sarasvatī; it is also that of a village in Bengal, above Hugli.
18160: त्रिवेद n. (-दं) The three Vedas collectively. E. त्रि, and वेद a Veda.
18161: त्रिवेदिन् m. (-दी) A Brahman acquainted with three Vedas. E. त्रिवेद्, and इनि aff.
18162: त्रिशङ्कु m. (ङ्कुः) 1 The name of a king of the solar race, famous for attempting to go to heaven in his mortal frame, by the aid of VIŚVĀMITRA. 2 A cat. 3 A grasshopper. 4 A bird, the Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 5 A fire-fly. E. त्रि three, शङ्कु a dart, ट aff.
18163: त्रिशङ्कुज m. (-जः) A name of HARIŚCANDRA, a prince. E. त्रिशङ्कु, and ज born, descended from TRIŚAṄKU.
18164: त्रिशङ्कुयाजिन् m. (-जी) VIŚVĀMITRA, a celebrated sage and saint. E. त्रिशङ्कु the king so named, and याजिन् causing to worship; being the family priest of the monarch.
18165: त्रिशरण m. (-णः) A Jina, a sanctified teacher of the Jaina sect. E. त्रि three, (the three worlds,) and शरण protection.
18166: त्रिशला f. (-ला) The mother of VARDDHAMĀNA, the last of the Jaina pontiffs.
18167: त्रिशिख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Three-crested, three-headed. n. (-खं) 1 A crest, a tiara with three points. 2 A trident, a three-pronged spear. m. (-खः) The son of RĀVAṆA, a demon with three heads. E. त्रि three, and शिखा a crest.
18168: त्रिशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Three-headed. m. (-राः) A name of KUVERA. 2 Fever personified as a demon with three heads: see त्रिपाद. 3 A son of RĀVAṆA. E. त्रि three, and शिरस् a head.
18169: त्रिशीर्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Three-headed. m. (-कः) A trident, a tri-pointed spear. E. त्रि three, and शीर्ष a head, affix कन्.
18170: त्रिशूल n. (-लं) A trident, a three-pointed pike or spear, especially the weapon of ŚIVA. E. त्रि three or Tri, and शूल a dart.
18171: त्रिशूलिन् m. (-ली) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रिशूल, and इनि affix, armed with a trident.
18172: त्रिशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः). 1 A hill with three peaks. 2 A triangle. E. त्रि three, and शृङ्ग a horn.
18173: त्रिशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A sort of fish, commonly Rohi, (Cyprinus rohita, HAM.)
18174: त्रिषवण n. (-णं) The three ablutions to be performed in the day, or at dawn, noon, and sun-set. E. त्रि three, सवन bathing; also read त्रिसवन.
18175: त्रिषवणस्नायिन् m. (-यी) A man performing regularly the prescribed ablutions, morning, noon, and night. E. त्रि three, सवन time or period of ablution, and स्नायिन् who bathes.
18176: त्रिष्टुभ् f. (-ष्टुप्) A form of metre, the stanza consisting of four lines of eleven syllables each, or of five lines, one of eleven  and four of eight each, forming altogether forty-four syllables; there are other varieties.
18177: त्रिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Situated in three places. E. त्रि, and स्था to be, क aff.
18178: त्रिसन्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या or -न्ध्यी-न्ध्यं) The three periods of the day, or dawn, noon, and eve. E. त्रि three, and सन्ध्य either of the periods.
18179: त्रिसम n. (-मं) An aggregate of three like or equal things. E. त्रि, and सम same.
18180: त्रिसर subst. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A dish of sesamum, rice, &c. E. त्रि three, three-fold, and सर what is, from सृ to go or get, affix अप्.
18181: त्रिसवन n. (-नं) Bathing thrice: see त्रिषवण.
18182: त्रिसीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.) E. त्रि thrice, and सीत्य ploughed.
18183: त्रिसुपर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A portion of the Rig and Yajur Vedas. 2 An observance enjoined by it. 2 A Brahman following it.
18184: त्रिसुपर्णिक m. (-कः) A Tri Suparṇa Brahman: see the last.
18185: त्रिस्रोतस् f. (-ताः) 1 The Ganges. 2 Another river. E. त्रि three, and स्रोतस् a river, the river of the three worlds, or one with three channels.
18186: त्रिहल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.) E. त्रि thrice, हल्य ploughed.
18187: त्रिहायण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Three years, (old, &c.) f. (-णी) A threeyears-old heifer. E. त्रि, and हायन a year; also read त्रिहायन.
18188: त्रुट r. 4th cl. (त्रुल्यति) r. 6th cl. (त्रुटति) and 10th cl. (त्रोटयति) To cut, literally or metaphorically; to cut, (wood, &c.) to cut or solve, (difficulties, doubts, &c.)
18189: त्रुटि f.
