(-टिः-टी) 1 Cutting, breaking. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 Breaking a promise, &c. 4 Small cardamoms, (Alpinia cardamomum.) 5 A short time, a moment. 6 Doubt, uncertainty. 7 (Always feminine, though used attributively,) Little, small. 8 An atom, or a visible atom composed of three subtler elementary particles. E. त्रुट to cut or divide, affix कि and ङीप् optionally added.
18190: त्रुटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut, broken, divided. 2 Hurt, wounded. E. त्रुट, and क्त aff.
18191: त्रुटितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Chapped, chafed, cut. E. त्रुट, and क्तवतु aff.
18192: त्रुटिवीज m. (-जः) An esculent root: see कचु. E. त्रुटि small, and वीज a seed.
18193: त्रुप r. 1st cl. (त्रोपति) To hurt, to injure or kill.
18194: त्रुफ r. 1st cl. (त्रोफति) To hurt, to kill or injure; also तुफ, तुम्फ, &c.
18195: त्रुम्प r. 1st cl. (त्रुम्पति) To hurt or injure: see तुप, तुम्प, &c.
18196: त्रुम्फ r. 1st cl. (त्रुम्फति) To kill or injure; also त्रुफ, &c.
18197: त्रेता f. (-ता) 1 The second Yug or age of the Hindus, consisting of 1,296,000 years. 2 The three sacred fires collectively, or the southern, household, and sacrificial fires. E. त्र preservation, &c. derived from त्रै to preserve, इत obtained, got.
18198: त्रेताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A man who has preserved the three sacred fires. E. त्रेता as above, and अग्नि fire.
18199: त्रेतायुग n. (-गं) The second or Tretā age. E. त्रेता, and युग age.
18200: त्रेधा ind. Triple, three-fold, in three ways. E. त्रि three, धा affix, and ए substituted for the vowel.
18201: त्रै (ङ) त्रैङ 1st cl. (त्रायते) To preserve, to protect, to cherish, to defend, &c.
18202: त्रैगुणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Giving three times, relating to thrice, three qualities, &c. E. त्रिगुण, and ठक् aff.
18203: त्रैगुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 The quality of three Guṇas or properties collectively. 2 A trine, a multiplication by three. E. त्रिगुण, and यञ् aff.
18204: त्रैदशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacred to the gods, belonging or relating to them. E. त्रिदश, and ठञ् aff.
18205: त्रैधम् ind. In three ways, three-fold. E. त्रि three, धमञ् affix; also ड being added, the word becomes an attributive, and may be inflected in the three genders, त्रैध, mfn. (-धः-धी-धं.)
18206: त्रैपुर m. (-रः) Tripura or Tipperah: see त्रिपुर. E. अण् added to त्रिपुर.
18207: त्रैराशिक mf. (-कः-का) (In Arithmetic,) The rule of three: it is of two kinds क्रमत्रैराशिकः Rule of three direct, व्यस्त or विलोमत्रैराशिक Rule of three inverse. E. त्रि three, राशि quantity, ठञ् aff.
18208: त्रैरूप्य n. (-प्यं) Three ways or forms. E. त्रि, रूप form, ष्यञ् aff.
18209: त्रैलोक्य n. (-क्यं) The three worlds, or heaven, hell, and earth. E. वि लोक, and ष्यञ् aff.
18210: त्रैलोक्यविजया f. (-या) A sort of hemp from which an intoxicating infusion, &c. is prepared. E. त्रैलोक्य, and विजाय subduing; alluding to its inebriating properties.
18211: त्रैवर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the three objects of life. E. त्रिवर्ग, and ठक् aff.
18212: त्रैवर्णिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to three castes, the first three. E. त्रि, वर्ण cast, ठक् aff.
18213: त्रैवार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Triennial, three years old, &c. E. त्रिवष three years, ठञ् aff.
18214: त्रैविद्य m. (-ट्यः) A scholar in the three Vedas, or one who possesses three sciences. n. (-द्यं) A collection or assembly of learned Brahmans. E. त्रि three, विद्या knowledge, and अण् aff.
18215: त्रैविध्य n. (-ध्यं) Three ways or kinds. E. त्रिविध, and यञ् aff.
18216: त्रैवेदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Scriptural, enjoined by the Vedas. E. त्रिवेद, and यक् aff.
18217: त्रैष्टुभ mfn. (-भः-भी-भं) Relating to or written in the Triṣṭubh metre. E. त्रिष्टुभ्, and अण् aff.
18218: त्रैस्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) The three accents collectively. E. त्रि, and स्वर vowel sound, ष्यञ् aff.
18219: त्रैहायण n. (-णं) A period or age of three years. E. त्रिहायण, and उ, अण् affix; also read त्रैहायन.
18220: त्रोटक n. (-कं) 1 Angry speech. 2 A minor drama, such as the Vikramorvaśī. E. त्रुट to cut, ण्वुल् aff.
18221: त्रोटकी f. (-की) A Rāgiṇī or one of the female personifications of music.
18222: त्रोटि f. (-टिः or टी) 1 The beak or bill of a bird. 2 A bird in general. 3 A kind of pike, (Esox kankila.) 4 A medicinal plant: see कट्फल. E. त्रुट to cut, affix अच्, and fem. affix इन् or ङीप्.
18223: त्रोटिहस्त m. (-स्तः) A bird in general. E. त्रोठि a beak, and हस्त a hand.
18224: त्रोत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A goad. 2 A weapon. E. त्रै to preserve, उत्र Uṇādi aff.
18225: त्रौक (ऋ) त्रौकृ r. 1st cl. (त्रौकते) To go, to move.
18226: त्र्यंश m. (-शः) Three-fourths, three shares. E. त्रि, and अंश part.
18227: त्र्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Tri-ocular. m. (-क्षः) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रि three, अक्षि an eye, अच् substituted for the final: see त्रिदृश्.
18228: त्र्यक्षर m. (-रः) 1 A genealogist, the Ghaṭaka or person whose business it is to form alliances. 2 A word, &c. of three letters. E. त्रि three, and अक्षर a letter.
18229: त्र्यङ्गट mn. (-टः-टं) 1 A sling or three strings like those of a balance, suspended to either end of a pole for the purpose of carrying burthens. 2 A sort of collyrium. m. (-टः) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रि three, अङ्ग body, and अट what goes, deriv. irr.
18230: त्र्यञ्जन n. (-नं) Combination of three, or Kālāñjana, Puṣpāñjana, and Karāñjana collyria. E. त्रि, and अञ्जन a collyrium.
18231: त्र्यधिष्ठान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Situate in or affected by three places, (as body, mind, speech.) E. त्रि, and अधिष्ठान site.
18232: त्र्यध्वगा f. (-गा) A name of the Ganges. E. त्रि three, अध्व a road, and ग what goes; going through the three worlds.
18233: त्र्यब्द n. (-ब्दं) A period of three years. E. त्रि, and अब्द a year.
18234: त्र्यम्बक m. (-कः) A name of ŚIVA. E. त्रि three, (the three Vedas,) अबि to speak or sound, and कन् added; or त्रि may mean the three letters, अ, उ, म, combined in the mystical word ओम्.
18235: त्र्यम्बकसस्व m. (-स्वः) KUVERA the god of wealth. E. त्र्यम्बक ŚIVA, and सखि a friend.
18236: त्र्यवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having three inferiors or followers. E. त्रि, and अवर inferior.
18237: त्र्यसरेणु m. (-णुः) A gross atom, one composed of three subtle atoms: see त्रसरेणु.
18238: त्र्यस्र n. (-स्रं) A triangle. E. त्रि, and अस्र an angle.
18239: त्र्यह n. (-हं) Three days collectively. E. त्रि, and अहन् a day.
18240: त्र्यहस्पर्श n. (-र्शं) Meeting of three lunations in one solar day. E. त्र्यह, and स्पर्श contact; also त्र्यहस्पृश, m. (-स्पृक्) and त्र्यहस्पृशं.
18241: त्र्यहैहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Providing for three days. E. त्र्यह, and ऐहिक who makes an effort for.
18242: त्र्याहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Produced or performed, &c. in three days. 2 Quartan (fever.) E. त्रि, and आहिक diurnal.
18243: त्र्युषण n. (-णं) The three spices collectively, or black pepper, long pepper, and dry ginger. E. त्रि three, and उषण a spice or pungent substance; also with ऊषण the same, त्र्यूषण, n. (-णं.)
18244: त्व mfn. (त्वः त्वा त्वं) Other, different. E. तन to divide or spread, and व substituted for the final letter of the radical.
18245: त्वक्कण्डुर m. (-रः) A sore or wound. E. त्वक् the skin, कण्डु itching or irritation, and र what excites.
18246: त्वक्क्षीरा f. (-रा) The manna of the bambu. E. त्वच् the bark of the bambu, and क्षीर milk; also with ङीप् affix, त्वक्क्षीरी.
18247: त्वक्छद m. (-दः) A plant, commonly Kshirakanchuki. E. त्वक् bark, and छद a leaf.
18248: त्वक्छेद m. (-दः) A cut, a scratch. E. त्वक्, and छेद a cut.
18249: त्वक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) Armour. E. त्वक्, and त्र what preserves.
18250: त्वक्पत्र n. (-त्रं) Woody cassia. f. (-त्री) A medicinal and vegetable substance: see हिङ्गुपत्री. E. त्वक् bark, and पत्र a leaf.
18251: त्वक्परिपुटन n. (-नं) Desquamation, pealing of the skin. E. त्वक्, and परिपुटन pealing.
18252: त्वक्पुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Erection of the hairs of the body, horripilation. nf. (-ष्पं-ष्पी) Blotch, scab, cutaneous eruption, &c. E. म्बक् the skin, and पुष्प a flower.
18253: त्वक्पुष्पिका f. (-का) Scab, blotch: see the preceding. E. कन् added to त्वकपुष्पी.
18254: त्वक्सार m. (-रः) 1 A bambu. 2 Woody cassia. f. (रा) Bambu manna. E. त्वक् bark, and सार essence.
18255: त्वक्सुगन्ध m. (-न्धः) An orange. f. (-न्धा) A perfume, commonly Elavāluka. E. त्वक् skin or rind, and सुगन्ध fragrant.
18256: त्वग्भेद m. (-दः) A flesh wound, a scratch. E. त्वच्, and भेद breaking.
18257: त्वग्भेदक m. (-कः) A stabber, a scratcher, one who draws blood from the skin. E. त्वच्, and भेदक who cuts.
18258: त्वक्ष (ऊ) त्वक्षू r. 1st cl. (त्वक्षति) 1 To pare, to make thin. 2 To be thin. 3 To peel, to skin.
18259: त्वग (इ) त्वगि r. 1st cl. (त्वंगति) To go, to move.
18260: त्वगङ्कुर m. (-रः) Erection of the hairs of the body. E. त्वच् or त्वक् skin, and अङ्कुर a sprout.
18261: त्वगस्थिमात्रशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Reduced to a skeleton, to mere skin and bone. E. त्वच् skin, अस्थि bone, मात्र mere, and शेष end.
18262: त्वगाक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of the bambu. E. त्वक् bark, आङ् limitative, and क्षीरी milk, being of a milky colour.
18263: त्वग्गन्ध m. (-न्धः) An orange. E. त्वच् rind, गन्ध smell.
18264: त्वग्दोष m. (-षः) Leprosy. E. त्वक्, and दोष fault.
18265: त्वग्रोग m. (-गः) 1 Leprosy. 2 Any cutaneous disease. E. त्वच्, and रोग disease.
18266: त्वङ्कार n. (-रं) The expression, ‘thou.’ E. त्व, and कार making.
18267: त्वङ्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of bark or skin. E. त्वक् skin, and मयट् aff.
18268: त्वच r. 6th cl. (त्वचति) To cover, to clothe, to invest.
18269: त्वच् f. (त्वक्) 1 Skin. 2 Bark, rind, peel, &c. 3 Woody cassia. E. तन to spread, to encircle or cover, Uṇādi affix चिक्, and व substituted for the final letters of the radical; also अच being added त्वच and त्वचा.
18270: त्वच nf. (-चं-चा) 1 Skin. 2 Bark, rind. 3 Woody cassia: see the preceding.
18271: त्वचापत्र n. (-त्रं) Woody cassia. E. त्वचा bark, and पत्र a leaf; also त्वक्पत्र.
18272: त्वचिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Having abundant skin or bark. E. त्वच skin, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative; also with ईयसुन् affix त्वचीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः.)
18273: त्वचिसार m. (-रः) A bambu. E. त्वचि seventh case of त्वच्, in the bark, and सार strength, pith; also त्वक्सार.
18274: त्वचिसुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) Small cardamoms. E. त्वचि in the bark, सुगन्ध fragrance.
18275: त्वञ्च (उ) तञ्जु r. 1st cl. (त्वञ्चति) To go, or move.
18276: त्वत् mfn. (-त्वत्) Other, different: see त्व.
18277: त्वत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Thine, your. E. त्वत् thine, and कन् added.
18278: त्वदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Thine. E. त्वत्, from त्वं thou, and छ added.
18279: त्वर (ञि आ) ञित्वरा r. 1st cl. (त्वरते) To hurry, to make haste, to go or move with speed, to do any thing readily or precipitately.
18280: त्वरण n. (-णं) Making haste, speed, velocity. E. त्वर to haste, and ल्युट् aff.
18281: त्वरमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Hastening, making haste, going speedily. E. त्वर to be quick, शानच् aff.
18282: त्वरा f. (-रा) Haste, speed. E. त्वर to make haste, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
18283: त्वरान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Swift, quick. E. त्वरा haste, and अन्वित possessed of.
18284: त्वरायण mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं) Adherence, attachment. E. त्वर to go, with speed, and युच् affix: see तुरायण.
18285: त्वरायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Quick, expeditious. E. त्वरा, and युक्त having.
18286: त्वरि f. (-रिः) Haste, speed. E. त्वर to make haste, affix इन्.
18287: त्वरित mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं) Quick, swift, expeditious. n. (-तं) Dispatch, haste. adv. Quickly, swiftly. E. त्वर to make haste, affix क्त, and इट् inserted.
18288: त्वरितगति f. (-तिः) 1 Swift motion. 2 A species of the Paṅkti metre. E. त्वरित, गति going.
18289: त्वरितोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken fast, hurried. E. त्वरित quickly, उदित said.
18290: त्वष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pared, made thin. E. त्वक्ष to make thin, affix क्त.
18291: त्वष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Carpentry. E. त्वक्ष to plane, क्तिन् aff.
18292: त्वष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) 1 A carpenter. 2 A name of VIŚVAKARMĀ, the artist of the gods. E. त्वक्ष to pare, affix तृच्. 3 The sun. E. तिष to shine, Uṇādi affix तृच्, and अ substituted for the radical इ.
18293: त्वाच mfn. (-चः-ची-चं) 1 Cuticular, relating to the skin. 2 Contagious, derived from touch. E. त्वच्, and अण् aff.
18294: त्वाचप्रत्यक्ष n. (-क्षं) Ascertainment of objects by contact. E. त्वाच, and प्रत्यक्ष perception.
18295: त्वाष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) The name of a demon, also called VṚTRĀSURA. nf. (-ष्ट्रं-ष्ट्री) One of the lunar mansions, the fourteenth or Citra. f. (-ष्ट्री) 1 A wife of SŪRYA, or the sun; also called SAṂJÑĀ, the daughter of VIŚVAKARMA. 2 A small car. E. त्वष्टृ the sun, or a carpenter, अण् affix of relation or descent, and ङीप् fem. aff.
18296: त्विष r. 1st cl. (औ) औत्विष (त्वेषति) To shine. With अव prefixed, 1 To give. 2 To dwell.
18297: त्विष् f. (-त्विट्) 1 Light. 2 Splendour, beauty. 3 Speech. 4 Wish, desire. 5 Custom, practice, usage. E. त्विष to shine, affix क्विप्; also with टाप् added त्विषा.
18298: त्विषा f. (-षा) Light: see the preceding.
18299: त्विषाम्पति m. (-तिः) The sun. E. त्विषां gen. plu. of तिष् light, and पति master.
18300: त्विषि m. (-षिः) A ray of light. E. त्विष to shine, कि aff.
18301: त्सर r. 1st cl. (त्सरति) To proceed fraudulently or crookedly.
18302: त्सरु m. (-रुः) The hilt or handle of a sword, &c. E. त्सर to go, Uṇādi affix उ. थ
18303: थ The seventeenth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and second of the dental class; the aspirate of the preceding letter, and expressed by Ṭh.
18304: थ n. (थं) 1 Auspiciousness. 2 Fear, terror. 3 Preserving, preservation. m. (-थः) 1 A mountain. 2 Eating. 3 A disease. E. स्था to stand, affix ड.
18305: थुड r. 6th cl. (थुडति) To cover, to skreen, to clothe or hide.
18306: थुत्कार m. (-रः) The sound made in spitting.
18307: थुथु ind. Imitative sound of spitting.
18308: थुध r. 4th cl. (थुध्यति-ते) To become pure.
18309: थुर्व (ई) थुर्वी r. 1st cl. (थुर्वति) To kill, to injure or hurt.
18310: थोडन n. (-नं) Covering, clothing, wrapping up. E. थुड and ल्युट् aff. द
18311: द The third letter of the dental class, and eighteenth consonant in the Nāgarī alphabet, corresponding to the letter D.
18312: द n. (दं) A wife. nf. (दं दा) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Dividing, cutting, breaking, &c. f. (दा) 1 Purifying, cleansing. 2 Preserving, cherishing. 3 Repentance. m. (दः) 1 A donor, a giver. 2 A mountain. 3 A gift, a thing given. E. दा to give, or दो to cut, &c. affix ड.
18313: दंश r. 1st cl. (दंशति) To bite, to sting.
18314: दंश m. (-शः) 1 A gadfly. 2 A tooth. 3 Biting, stinging. 4 Armour, mail. 5 Cutting, dividing, tearing. 6 Fault, defect. 7 A joint, a limb. 8 The sting of a snake. 9 Pungency. f. (-शी) A small gadfly. E. दंश to bite or sting, affix अच्, diminutive affix ङीष्.
18315: दंशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What bites or stings. m. (-कः) A gadfly. E. कन् added to the preceding.
18316: दंशन n. (-नं) 1 Biting, stinging. 2 Armour, mail. E. दंश to bite, &c. ल्युट् aff.
18317: दंशभीरु m. (-रुः) A buffalo. E. दंश a gadfly, and भीरु afraid of; also with कन् added, दंशभीरुक m. (-कः.)
18318: दंशमूल m. (-लः) A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. दंश biting, and मूल a root; the root of this plant is substituted in Bengal for horseradish.
18319: दंशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Armed, mailed. 2 Bitten, stung. E. दंश armour, and इतच् affix, or दंश to bite, affix क्त.
18320: दंशेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mischievous, noxious. E. दंश to bite or sting, Uṇādi affix एरक्.
18321: दंष्ट्रा f. (-ष्ट्रा) A large tooth, a tusk. E. दंश to bite, affix ष्ट्रन्, and टाप् fem. aff.
18322: दंष्ट्रिका f. (-का) The beard. E. दंष्ट्रा a tooth, इकन् aff.
18323: दंष्ट्रिन् mfn. (-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रिणी-ष्ट्रि) 1 Biting or wounding with the teeth, (any animal, &c.) 2 Tusked, having tusks or sharp teeth. 3 Carnivorous. m. (-ष्ट्री) 1 A hog. 2 A snake. E. दंष्ट्रा a tooth, and इनि aff.
18324: दंसन n. (-नं) Armour, mail: see दंशन.
18325: दक n. (-कं) Water. E. see उदक, the initial vowel being dropped.
18326: दक्ष r. 1st cl. (दक्षते) 1 To grow or increase. 2 To dispatch, to expedite, to do quickly. 3 To go, to move. 4 To hurt or kill.
18327: दक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Clever, able, dexterous. m. (-क्षः) 1 A Brahmādika; according to one legend, son of BRAHMĀ, born from the thumb of his right hand, for the purpose of peopling the world: according to another, he is the son of the Munis, called Prācetasas. DAKṢA had sixty daughters, of whom twenty-seven are the nymphs who form the lunar asterisms, and wives of the moon; one of his daughters also was SATI or DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA; and seventeen were married to KAŚYAPA, and were the mothers of all created beings. DAKṢA was on one occasion decapitated by ŚIVA: see दक्षाध्वरध्वंसकृत्; he is sometimes regarded as an Avatāra of BRAHMĀ himself. 2 A Muni and legislator, who flourished in the beginning of the Tretā Yuga. 3 A kind of tree. 4 The bull of ŚIVA. 5 A cock. 6 A scholar, a Paṇḍita. 7 A dexterous or clever man. 8 ŚIVA. 9 A name of Agni of fire. 10 A general lover, one attached to many mistresses. f. (-क्षा) The earth. E. दक्ष to grow or increase, affix अच्.
18328: दक्षकन्या f. (-न्या) A name of DURGĀ. E. दक्ष, and कन्या the maiden, the daughter of DAKṢA, who in this case seems to be identified with Himāla, the snowy mountain.
18329: दक्षजा f. (-जा) 1 The goddess DURGĀ. 9 A lunar asterism. E. दक्ष, and जा born: see the preceding.
18330: दक्षजापति m. (-तिः) 1 The moon. 2 The deity ŚIVA. E. दक्षजा a lunar asterism or DURGĀ, and पति husband.
18331: दक्षता f. (-ता) Dexterity, cleverness. E. तल् added to दक्ष; also with त्व, दक्षत्वं.
18332: दक्षयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The sacrifice made by DAKṢA. E. दक्ष, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
18333: दक्षयज्ञविनाशिनी f. (-नी) DURGA. E. दक्षयज्ञ, and विनाशिनी destructress.
18335: दक्षाध्वरध्वंसकृत् m. (-कृत्) A name of ŚIVA. E. दक्ष the Brahmādika, as DAKṢA, अध्वर a sacrifice, ध्वंसकृत् subduer or disturber: DAKṢA having on one occasion made a sacrifice, to which he invited all the gods, except his son-in law ŚIVA, and his wife SATI, the latter went unbid, and being received coolly, threw herself into the fire; an emanation of ŚIVA, proceeded against DAKṢA, and an affray ensued, in which the gods and Ṛṣis were maltreated and dispersed, and DAKṢA decapitated; he was restored to life, and the head of a ram substituted for the one he had lost.
18336: दक्षाय्य m. (-य्यः) 1 The bird of VIṢṆU, Garuḍa. 2 A vulture. E. दक्ष to hurt, आय्य Uṇādi aff.
18337: दक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Candid, sincere, honest, upright. 2 Right, (not left.) 3 South, southern. 4 Dependent, subject. 5 Clever, able, dexterous. f. (-णा) 1 A present to Brahmans, upon solemn or sacrificial occasions. 2 The south. 3 Completion of any rite, fixing or establishing any act or place. 4 A form or figure of DURGĀ, in which the right side is said to be advanced. 5 Donation to Brahmans, personified as a goddess, said to be born from KṚṢṆA'S right side. E. दक्ष to prosper, &c. Uṇādi affix इनन्.
18338: दक्षिणकालिका f. (-का) A form of DURGĀ worshipped by the Tāntrikas. E. दक्षिण, and कालिका a form of the same.
18339: दक्षिणतस् ind. Southward, southerly. E. तसि added to दक्षिण.
18340: दक्षिणपथ n. (-थं) 1 The south. 2 Southern road or course. E. दक्षिण, and पथ for पथिन् path.
18341: दक्षिणपूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) The south-east quarter. E. दक्षिण south, and पूर्व्व east.
18342: दक्षिणस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Upon the right side, to the south, &c. m. (-स्थः) A charioteer. E. दक्षिण as above, and स्थ who stays or abides.
18343: दक्षिणाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) One kind of sacred fire, that which is taken from the domestic or consecrated fire, and is placed to the south. E. दक्षिण south, and अग्नि fire.
18344: दक्षिणाग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Pointing to the south, having the head or top to the south. E. दक्षिण, and अग्र end.
18345: दक्षिणाचल m. (-लः) The Malaya mountain. E. दक्षिण south, and अचल mountain.
18346: दक्षिणाचार m. (-रः) A worshipper of Śakti according to the purer or right-hand ritual. E. दक्षिण, and आचार observance.
18347: दक्षिणात् ind. Southward. E. the fifth case of दक्षिण, used as a particle.
18348: दक्षिणात्यय m. (-यः) A southern, or an inhabitant of the south. E. दक्षिण, अत्यय who goes to or beyond.
18349: दक्षिणापथ m. (-थः) The south, the southern direction or quarter. E. दक्षिणा, and पथ for पथिन् path.
18350: दक्षिणापथजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A southern, or the Andhakas, Guhas, Pulindas, Savaras, Cucukas, and Madrapas, all outcaste or barbarous tribes. E. दक्षिणापथ, and जन्मन् birth.
18351: दक्षिणाप्रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Declining, shelving or inclining to the south. E. दक्षिणा, and प्रवण declivity.
18352: दक्षिणामुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Turning the face south wards. E. दक्षिण south, and मुख the face, with आङ् prefixed.
18353: दक्षिणायन n. (-नं) The sun's progress south of the equator, the winter solstice. E. दक्षिण, and अयन going.
18354: दक्षिणारण्य n. (-ण्यं) The peninsula, the great southern forest. E. दक्षिण, and अरण्य a wood.
18355: दक्षिणार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Meriting a reward. E. दक्षिण a present, and अर्ह fit for.
18356: दक्षिणावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch shell with the valve opening to the right. E. दक्षिण, and आवर्त्त a turn.
18357: दक्षिणावर्त्तकी f. (-की) A line of bees. E. दक्षिण, and आवर्त्तक turning.
18358: दक्षिणाशा f. (-शा) The south. E. दक्षिण, and आशा quarter.
18359: दक्षिणाशापति m. (-तिः) A name of YAMA. E. दक्षिण south, आशा quarter, and पति master or regent.
18360: दक्षिणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Meriting a reward. E. दक्षिण a present or reward, affix च्छ.
18361: दक्षिणेन ind. Southward, southerly. E. the third case of दक्षिण, used as a particle.
18362: दक्षिणेर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A deer struck by a hunter. E. दक्षिण the right side, and इर्म्म wound, comp. irr.
18363: दक्षिण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Meriting a reward. E. दक्षिण a present, and यत् aff.
18364: दग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Burnt, scorched, consumed by fire. f. (-ग्धा) 1 The quarter where the sun is observable. 2 An epithet of certain lunations, on which it is unlucky to do any thing, and religious rites are prohibited. n. (-ग्धं) A fragrant grass. E. दह to burn, affix क्त.
18365: दग्धकाक m. (-कः) A raven, or perhaps the carrion crow. E. दग्ध burnt, (black,) and काक crow.
18366: दग्धव्य mfn. (व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be burnt. E. दह to burn, तव्य aff.
18367: दग्धिका f. (-का) Scorched rice. E. दग्ध burnt, कन् depreciative affix, and the fem. form.
18368: दग्धेष्टका f. (-का) A burnt or vitrified brick. E. दग्ध burnt, and इष्टक a brick.
18369: दग्धोदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hungry, starving. n. (-रं) The appetite, an empty or craving stomach. E. दग्ध, and उदर the belly.
18370: दग्ध्वा ind. Having burnt. E. दह to burn, क्त्वा aff.
18371: दघ r. 1st cl. (ई) दधि (दंघति) 1 To quit or abandon. 2 To cherish or protect. r. 5th cl. (दध्नीति) 1 To hurt or kill. 3 To protect: some consider this root peculiar to the Vedas.
18372: दण्ड r. 10th cl. (दण्डयति) 1 To punish, especially by fine. 2 To fine, to amerce.
18373: दण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A stick, a staff. m. (-ण्डः) 1 Punishment, castigation, amercement, imprisonment or putting to death. 2 A name of YAMA, regent of the dead. 3 An army. 4 A form of array, a line or column of troops. 5 A long measure, a pole of four cubits. 6 A churning stick. 7 A corner, an angle. 8 A horse. 2 A companion or attendant of the sun. 10 A stem or stick of a tree. 11 Subduing, subjecting. 12 Pride, arrogance. 13 A measure of time, a Daṇḍa, (1/60)th part of the day and night, or twenty-four minutes. 14 Standing upright or erect, being like a staff. 15 A son of IKṢVĀKU. E. दम to tame, and ड Uṇādi aff. or दण्ड to punish, affix अच्.
18374: दण्डक mn. (-कः-कं) A sort of metre, the stanza of which exceeds twenty-seven syllables, and may extend to 200. f. (-का) The peninsula of India, from between the Narmadā and Godāvarī rivers to the south, the whole of which, in the days of RĀMA, was a large forest. E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and कन् aff.
18375: दण्डकारण्य n. (-ण्यं) The peninsula, the peninsular forest: see the last. E. दण्डक, and अरण्य a wood.
18376: दण्डग्रहण n. (-णं) Becoming a mendicant or ascetic. E. दण्ड the staff carried by the mendicant, and ग्रहण taking.
18377: दण्डघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A fighter, one who commits personal violence. E. दण्ड a stick, and घ्न who strikes.
18378: दण्डजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suppressed by punishment. E. दण्ड, and जित conquered.
18379: दण्डढक्का f. (-क्का) A kettle drum. E. दण्ड a stick, and ढक्का a drum.
18380: दण्डताम्री f. (-स्री) A perforated copper vessel, of given capacity, placed in a vessel of water; when filled with water, it sinks, marking a certain portion of time. E. दण्ड twenty-four minutes, and ताम्री (q. v.) a copper vessel, &c.
18381: दण्डदास m. (-सः) A slave, a bondsman, one who has become so as a punishment or for debt. E. दण्ड, and दास a slave.
18382: दण्डधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Having a stick or staff. 2 Having authority to punish. m. (-रः) 1 A name of YAMA. 2 A king. 3 A potter. 4 A mendicant carrying a staff. E. दण्ड punishment, a stick, &c. and धर who holds or possesses; also दण्डधार m. (-रः) दण्डधारिन्, &c.
18383: दण्डधारण n. (-णं) 1 Punishment. 2 Carrying a staff. 3 Following the order of a mendicant. E. दण्ड, and धारण having.
18384: दण्डन n. (-नं) Punishing, inflicting punishment. E. दण्ड to tame, ल्युट् aff.
18385: दण्डनायक m. (-कः) 1 A general, a commander-in-chief. 2 A magistrate, a head police officer. E. दण्ड a column of troops, and नायक a leader.
18386: दण्डनीति f. (-तिः) Policy, the system of civil and military administration taught by CĀṆAKYA and others. E. दण्ड (by) punishment or subjection, नी to get or obtain, and क्तिच् aff.
18387: दण्डनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Punishable, deserving punishment. E. दण्ड to punish, अनीयर् aff.
18388: दण्डनीयत्व n. (-त्वं) Demerit, desert of punishment. E. त्व added to to the last; also with तल्, दण्डनीयता.
18389: दण्डपांशुल m. (-लः) A porter, a warder or doorkeeper. E. दण्ड a staff, पा to cherish or bear, affix ड, दण्डपः again, अंशुल for अंशल strong, sturdy.
18390: दण्डपाणि m. (णिः) 1 YAMA. 2 A staffbearer. 3 One of ŚIVA'S attendants worshipped at Benares. E. दण्ड, and पाणि a hand.
18391: दण्डपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Awarding, fining. E. दण्ड, and पातिन् causing to alight.
18392: दण्डपारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) 1 Assault and battery, a title of jurisprudence. 2 Infliction of cruel punishment, one of the seven vices of kings and rulers. E. दण्ड punishment, पारुष्य severity.
18393: दण्डपाल m. (-लः) 1 A doorkeeper, a porter. 2 A small kind of fish, (Cyprinus danrica, HAM.) see अर्द्धसफर. E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and पाल who cherishes.
18394: दण्डपालक m. (-कः) 1 A sort of fish: see the preceding, which it is supposed to resemble. 2 A doorkeeper. E. कन् implying likeness, or pleonastic added.
18395: दण्डपाशिक m. (-कः) A hangman, an executioner. E. दण्ड, and पाश a noose, ठक् aff.
18396: दण्डप्रणयन n. (-नं) Inflicting punishment. E. दण्ड, and प्रणयन leading.
18397: दण्डभीति f. (-तिः) Fear of punishment. E. दण्ड, and भीति fear.
18398: दण्डभृत् mfn. (भृत्) 1 Having a staff or stick. 2 Inflicting punishment. m. (-भृत्) A potter. E. दण्ड the stick or handle of his wheel, and भृत् who possesses or works with.
18399: दण्डमानव m. (-वः) 1 An ascetic, one who uses a staff. 2 A leader. E. दण्ड, and मानव a man.
18400: दण्डयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Punishing, amercing, chastising. E. दण्ड to punish, शतृ aff.
18401: दण्डयात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Subjection or conquest of a region or quarter. 2 A bridal procession. 3 Procession, moving in state or with attendants. E. दण्ड punishment, &c. and यात्रा going.
18402: दण्डयाम m. (-मः) 1 A name of YAMA. 2 The saint AGASTYA. 3 A day. E. दण्ड punishment, &c. यम to refrain, in the causal form, and अच् aff.
18403: दण्डयोग n. (-गं) Infliction of punishment. E. दण्ड, and योग application.
18404: दण्डलेश n. (-शं) A small fine. E. दण्ड, and लेश a little.
18405: दण्डवत् ind. Prostrate, falling or lying prostrate. E. दण्ड a strick, and वति aff.
18406: दण्डवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a stick, carrying a staff. E. दण्ड, and मतुप् aff.
18407: दण्डवादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A doorkeeper or a warder. 2 One who threatens another with punishment or castigation. E. दण्ड castigation, and वद to speak, to threaten, affix णिनि.
18408: दण्डवालधि m. (-धिः) An elephant. E. दण्ड a stick, and वालधि a tail.
18409: दण्डवासिन् m. (-सी) 1 A doorkeeper, a warder, a chamberlain. 2 The magistrate or the head of a village. E. दण्ड a staff or mace, or punishment, &c. वस to abide, affix णिनि.
18410: दण्डविकल्प m. (-ल्पः) Appropriate punishment or sentence. E. दण्ड, and विकल्प alternative.
18411: दण्डविधि f. (-धिः) Criminal law, mode of punishment. E. दण्ड, and विधि rule.
18412: दण्डविशेष m. (-षः) Kind or degree of punishment. E. दण्ड, and विशेष sort.
18413: दण्डविष्कम्भ m. (-म्भः) A post or a stake, round which plays the string that works the churning stick. E. दण्ड a stick, स्कम्भ to stop, with वि prefixed, and अण् aff.
18414: दण्डहस्त m. (-स्तः) 1 A staff-bearer. 2 A doorkeeper. n. (-स्तं) A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.) E. दण्ड, and हस्त the hand.
18415: दण्डाजिन n. (-नं) Deceit, fraud, cheating, roguery.
18416: दण्डादण्डि ind. Single stick, cudgelling, fighting with sticks or staves. E. दण्ड a stick, repeated, with आ inserted, and इच् added.
18417: दण्डार m. (-रः) 1 A carriage, a vehicle. 2 A potter's wheel. 3 A bow or any instrument for casting arrows or darts. 4 An elephant in rut, a furious or intoxicated elephant. E. दण्ड a stick, ऋ to go, and अण् aff.
18418: दण्डाहत m. (-तः) Buttermilk. E. दण्ड a churning stick, and आहत struck, churned.
18419: दण्डिक m. (-कः) 1 A mace-bearer, &c. one carrying a stick or staff. A fish, (Cyprinus dankena, HAM.) E. दण्ड a staff, and ठन् aff.
18420: दण्डिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of necklace. 2 A string. E. दण्ड a measure, and इकन् aff.
18421: दण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Punished, chastised, sentenced, fined. E. दण्ड to punish, affix क्त.
18422: दण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) Having a staff or stick. m. (-ण्डी) 2 A doorkeeper, a warder, a porter, a staff or mace-bearer. 2 A name of YAMA. 3 A man of the fourth order or beggar. 4 A mendicant carrying a staff. 5 A mendicant of a particular order, derived from ŚAṂKARĀCĀRYA. 6 A Jina or Jaina saint. E. दण्ड a staff, &c. and इनि aff.
18423: दण्डोत्पला f. (-ला) A small shrub; also सहदेवा.
18424: दण्ड्य mfn. (-ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं) Punishable, deserving punishment. E. दण्ड punishment, and यत् affix implying fitness.
18425: दत् m. (दन्तः दन्तौ दन्तः) 2nd case plu. (दतः) A tooth: see दन्त; the nasal is dropped after the 2nd case. E. दम to subdue, affix डत्.
18426: दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Given, presented, made over, assigned. 2 Preserved, guarded, protected. m. (-त्तः) 1 The name of a king. 2 A saint; also दत्तात्रेय. 3 A common surname or title of a man of the Vaiśya or third tribe, at present common to the Kayeth class. n. (-त्तं) A gift, a donation. E. दा to give, affix क्त.
18427: दत्तक m. (-कः) A son given: see the next. E. कन् added to the last.
18428: दत्तकपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A son given away by his natural parents, to persons engaging to adopt him; one of the twelve heirs acknowledged by the old Hindu law. E. दत्तक, and पुत्त्र a son; also simply दत्तक, and sometimes दत्त्रिम.
18429: दत्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Gave, was giving. E. दा to give, क्तवतु aff.
18430: दत्तशुल्का f. (-ल्का) A bride for whom a sum of money has been paid to her father. E. दत्त, and शुल्क dower.
18431: दत्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-given. m. (-त्मा) A youth or orphan, who gives himself to persons disposed to take the place of parents. E. दत्त given, and आत्मन् self.
18432: दत्तात्रेय m. (-यः) A sage, the son of ATRI given to him by three deities, BRAHMA, VIṢṆU, and ŚIVA. E. दत्त, and अत्रेय son of ATRI; also दत्त.
18433: दत्तादत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given and received. E. दत्त, and आदत्त taken.
18434: दत्तादर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Treated with respect. E. दत्त, and आदर respect.
18435: दत्तानपकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Nonresumption of gifts. E. दत्त a gift, अन for अ, neg. before अपकर्म्मन् resuming.
18436: दत्तापहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Given and taken again. E. दत्त, and अपहृत taken back.
18437: दत्ताप्रदानिक n. (-कं) Resumption of gifts; one of the eighteen titles of law. E. दत्त, and अप्रदानिक not giving.
18438: दत्तावधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Attentive. E. दत्त, and अवधान attention.
18439: दत्तासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a seat given, requested to sit. E. दत्त, and आसन a seat.
18440: दत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Gift, donation. E. दा to give, क्तिन् aff.
18441: दत्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Given. 2 Produced or effected by gifts. m. (-मः) 1 A slave who is given by another. 2 A son given by his parents. E. दा to give, क्त्रिम aff.
18443: दत्त्वा ind. Having given. E. दा to give, क्त्वाच् aff.
18444: दद r. 1st cl. (ददते) 1 To give. 2 To relinquish.
18445: ददत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Giving. E. दा to give, शतृ aff.
18446: दद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who gives or bestows. E. दद to give, and श aff.
18447: ददन n. (-नं) Gift, giving, donation. E. दद to give, affix ल्युट्.
18448: ददि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Who or what gives or bestows. E. दा to give, कि aff.
18449: ददिवस् mfn. (-वान्-दुषी-वः) Giving, who or what gives. E. दा to give, वसु aff.
18450: ददृत् mfn. (-दृत्) Fearful, alarmed. E. दॄ to fear, क्विप् affix, and the radical vowel made short.
18451: ददृशिवस् mfn. (-वान्-शुषी-वः) Seeing, looking. E. दृश to see, वसु affix, इट् inserted.
18452: ददृश्वस् mfn. (-श्रान्-शुषी-श्वः) Seeing, looking. E. दृश to see वसु aff.
18453: दद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Cutaneous and herpetick eruptions; also दद्रूः or with कन् added दद्रुक, m. (-कः)
18454: दद्रुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A kind of cassia, (C. tora.) E. दद्रु herpes, and घ्न, destroying, remedying; also दद्रूघ्न.
18455: दद्रुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Herpetick, afflicted with herpes. E. दद्रु, and न affix; also दद्रूण.
18456: दद्रुरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Herpetick, diseased by herpes. E. दद्रु herpes, रोग a disease, and इनि aff.
18457: दद्रू m. (-द्रूः) Herpetick eruptions: see दद्रु.
18460: दध r. 1st cl. (दधते) 1 To hold, to possess or retain. 2 To give, to present, to assign or make over. (इ) दधि (दन्धति) To nourish.
18461: दध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Who has or possesses. E. धा to have, श aff.
18462: दधत् mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्) Having, holding, possessing. E. धा to have, शतृ aff.
18463: दधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having, holding, possessing. E. धा to have, शानच् aff.
18464: दधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) Holding, having, who or what has or possesses. n. (-धि) 1 Milk curdled or coagulated spontaneously by heat, or by the addition of buttermilk; it is an article of food of general use, and in high estimation amongst the Hindus, and is considered, medicinally, as the remedy or preventative of most disorders. 2 Resin, turpentine; (all the synonyms are common to these two senses.) 3 A house, an abode. E. धा to have, किन् affix, and the root reiterated.
18465: दधिकूर्च्चिका f. (-का) A mixture of boiled and coagulated milk, or of water and sour curds. E. दधि as above, and कूर्च्चिका inspissated milk.
18466: दधिचार m. (-रः) The churning stick. E. दधि curdled milk, and चर to move, in the causal form, affix अच्.
18467: दधिज n. (-जं) Fresh butter. E. दधि curdled milk, and ज born.
18468: दधित्थ m. (-त्थः) The wood-apple: see कपित्थ. E. दधि, स्था to stand or be, affix ड; the root yielding a juice compared to curdled milk.
18469: दधिधेनु f. (-नुः) A quantity of curds given away at any sacrifice. E. दधि, and धेनु a cow.
18470: दधिपुष्पिका f. (-का) A flower, (Clitorea ternata.) E. दधि curdled milk, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added in the fem. form.
18471: दधिफल m. (-लः) The elephant or wood-apple; also दधित्थ. E. दधि curdled milk, and फल fruit, the fruit having the acid taste of Dahī or Dadhi.
18472: दधिभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A vessel for holding curds, a pail. E. दधि, and भाण्ड a vessel.
18473: दधिमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Whey. E. दधि, and मण्ड scum.
18474: दधिमण्डोद m. (-दः) The sea of curds, or rather of whey. E. दधिमण्ड, and उद water.
18475: दधिशोण m. (-णः) A monkey. E. दधि, and शोण crimson; of a colour composed of that of curdled milk and crimson.
18476: दधिसक्तु m. plu. always (-क्तवः) Barley meal mixed with curds. E. दधि, and सक्तु the meal of barley, after frying and grinding.
18477: दधिसर m. (-रः) The skim of coagulated milk; also सर only. E. दधि Dahī, and सर which goes on or upon.
18478: दधिसार m. (-रः) Fresh butter. E. दधि curdled milk, and सर essence.
18479: दधिस्नेह m. (-हः) Skim of Dahī, or curdled milk whey. E. दधि curdled milk, and स्नेह oily substance.
18480: दधिस्वेद m. (-दः) Buttermilk. E. दधि as above, and स्वेद exudation.
18481: दधीच m. (-चः) The name of a Muni or saint, famous for having devoted himself to death, that the gods might be armed with his bones in lieu of thunderbolts; they being the only effective weapons against the demon VṚTRA; also दधीचि.
18482: दधीचि m. (-चिः) A Muni or saint: see the last.
18483: दधीच्यस्थि n. (-स्थि) 1 The diamond. 2 The thunderbolt. E. दधीचि a saint, and अस्थि a bone; the bones of the saint were converted into thunderbolts, which are of the same substance with the diamond, according to the Hindus.
18484: दधृच् mfn. (-धृक्) Shameless, impudent. E. धृष to be vain, affix क्विन्, deriv. irr.
18485: दध्न m. (-ध्नः) A name of YAMA. E. धा to have, reiterated, and न aff.
18486: दध्याकर m. (-रः) The sea of curds. E. दधि, and आकर a mine.
18487: दध्यानी f. (-नी) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. दधि curdled milk, नी with आङ् prefixed, affix क्विप्.
18488: दध्याह्व m. (-ह्वः) The wood-apple. E. दधि, and आह्वा name.
18489: दध्युत्तर n. (-रं) The skim of curdled milk, whey. E. दधि, and उत्तर upper part; also with कन् added, दध्युत्तरक, n. (-कं.)
18490: दध्युद m. (-दः) The sea of curds. E. दधि, and उद water; that which has curds for water.
18491: दनु f. (-नुः) A daughter of DAKṢA, wife of KAŚYAPA, and mother of the demons of Daityas, the Titans of Hindu mythology.
18492: दनुज m. (-जः) An Asura. E. दनु the mother of the giant race, and ज born.
18493: दनुजद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A god, a deity. E. दनुज a demon, and द्धिष् the hater.
18494: दनुजारि m. (-रिः) A god, a deity. E. दनुज, and अरि enemy.
18495: दनुसूनु m. (-नुः) An Asura or infernal deity. E. दनु as above, and सूनु offspring; also similar compounds, as दनुज, &c.
18496: दन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A tooth. 2 The peak of a mountain. 3 The side or ridge of a mountain. 4 An arbour. 5 Ivory, elephant's tooth. f. (-न्ती) A medicinal plant, commonly known by the same name, Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) E. दम to subdue, तन् Uṇādi aff.
18497: दन्तक m. (-कः) 1 A crooked peak or projection in a rock or mountain. 2 A bracket, a pin or shelf projecting from a wall. 3 A tooth. E. कन् implying resemblance, added to दन्त.
18498: दन्तकर्षण m. (-णः) The common lime, (Citrus acida.) E. दन्त a tooth, and कर्षण attracting, drawing.
18499: दन्तकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A piece of stick, or of the small branch of a tree used as a tooth brush. E. दन्त, and काष्ठ wood.
18500: दन्तच्छद m. (-दः) A lip. E. दन्त a tooth, and च्छद a cover.
18501: दन्तजात mfn (-तः-ता-तं) Toothed, having teeth. E. दन्त, and जात produced.
18502: दन्तधावन n. (-नं) 1 A tooth brush, or a fibrous stick used for cleaning the teeth. 2 Cleaning the teeth. m. (-नः) 1 A tree yielding an astringent resin, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 A plant, (Mimusops elengi:) see वकुल. E. दन्त a tooth, and धाव to clean, affix ल्युट्.
18503: दन्तपत्र n. (-त्रं) An earring. E. दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf or plate set with studs, resembling teeth.
18504: दन्तपत्रक n. (-कं) A kind of jasmine, (J. pubescens.) E. दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf: the petals or leaves of the flower resembling teeth in colour and shape; this comparison is frequent among the poets.
18505: दन्तपवन n. (-नं) A dentifrice, or any thing taken to clean the teeth. E. दन्त, and पवन purifying.
18507: दन्तपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, the flower of which is compared to a tooth, (Strychnos potatorum.) E. दन्त a tooth, and पुष्प a flower.
18508: दन्तफल m. (-लः) A plant: see the preceding. E. दन्त, and फल a fruit.
18509: दन्तभाग m. (-गः) An elephant's front or forehead. 2 Part of a tooth. E. दन्त the tusk, and भाग a part.
18510: दन्तमल mn. (-लः-लं) The tartar of the teeth. E. दन्त a tooth, and मल dirt.
18511: दन्तमांस n. (-सं) The gums. E. दन्त, and सांभ flesh.
18512: दन्तमूलिका f. (-का) A plant: see दन्ती. E. दन्त, and मूल a root, कन् fem. form.
18513: दन्तवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A lip. E. दन्त a tooth, and वस्त्र a garment.
18514: दन्तवासस् m. (-साः) A lip. E. दन्त a tooth, and वासस् vesture.
18515: दन्तव्यसन n. (-नं) Fracture or decay of a tusk or tooth. E. दन्त, and व्यसन misfortune.
18516: दन्तवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The gums. E. दन्त, and वेष्ट what incloses.
18517: दन्तशट m. (-टः) A lime: see the next.
18518: दन्तशठ m. (-ठः) 1 Elephant or wood-apple: see कपित्थ. 2 Common lime, (Citrus acida.) 2 A plant bearing an acid fruit, (Averhoa carambola.) 4 An orange. 5 Sourness, acidity. f. (-ठा) Woodsorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.) E. दन्त a tooth, and शठ noxious, bad.
18519: दन्तशर्करा f. (-रा) Tartar of the teeth. E. दन्त tooth, and शर्करा sand.
18520: दन्तशाण n. (-णं) A dentifrice, composed chiefly of the powdered fruit of the chebulic myrobalan, and green sulphate of iron. E. दन्त a tooth, and शाण a whetstone; sharpening or polishing the teeth.
18521: दन्तशिरा f. (-रा) The gum. E. दन्ता, and शिरा a long vein or tubular vessel.
18522: दन्तशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Cleaning the teeth. E. द्रन्त, and शुद्धि cleaning.
18523: दन्तश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Entangled in or between the teeth. E. दन्त, and श्लिष्ट united.
18524: दन्तसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Touched by the teeth; entangled in or between the teeth. E. दन्त, and सक्त in contact.
18525: दन्तहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Tenderness of the teeth; intolerance of any rough, austere, or acid substances. E. दन्त, and हर्ष delight.
18526: दन्तहर्षक m. (-कः) The lime, (Citrus acida.) E. दन्त a tooth, and हर्षक delighting, from हृष to please, with वुन् affix; also with युच् affix दन्तहर्षण, m. (-णः)
18527: दन्ताघात m. (-तः) A bite. E. दन्त, and आघात a wound.
18528: दन्तावल m. (-लः) An elephant. E. दन्त a tooth, वलच् affix, and the final of दन्त made long.
18529: दन्तायुध m. (-धः) A hog. E. दन्त a tooth or tusk, and आयुध a weapon.
18530: दन्तार्व्वुद m. (-दः) A disease of the teeth or gums; gum boil, ulceration of the gums. E. दन्त a tooth, and अर्व्वुद a swelling.
18531: दन्तालिका f. (-का) A horse's bridle. E. दन्त a tooth, अलि a line, affix कन्, and fem. form.
18532: दन्तिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) E. कन् added to दन्ती; also read दन्तिजा, f. (-जा.)
18533: दन्तिन् mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिनी-न्ति) Toothed, tusked. m. (-न्ती) 1 An elephant. 2 A mountain. E. दन्त a tooth, and इनि possessive aff.
18534: दन्तिमद m. (-दः) The temporal juice of the elephant. E. दन्ति and मद the effusion.
18535: दन्तीवीज n. (-जं) A strongly purgative nut, the fruit of the croton. E. दन्ती, and वीज seed.
18536: दन्तुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Having a large or projecting tooth. 2 Waving, undulatory. 3 Rising (a hair), bristling. E. दन्त a tooth, &c. affix उरच्.
18537: दन्तोद्भेद m. (-दः) Dentition. E. दन्त, and उद्भेद out-break.
18538: दन्तोलूखलिक m. (-कः) One who eats grain without its having been threshed, an anchorite. E. दन्त a tooth, उलखल a mortar, and ठक् affix; who winnows with his teeth.
18539: दन्त्य mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं) Dental, of or belonging to the teeth. E. दन्त, and यत् aff.
18540: दन्दश m. (-शः) A tooth. E. frequentative form of दश to bite.
18541: दन्दशूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mischievous, malignant, venomous. m. (-कः) 1 A snake or serpent. 2 A Rākṣasa, a demon or goblin. E. दश to bite, affix ऊक, the radical reiterated, and नुक् inserted.
18542: दन्द्रम n. (-मं) Going slowly or tortuously. E. द्रम to go, root redup. घञ् aff.
18543: दन्द्रमण n. (-णं) Going slowly or tortuously. mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Who or what goes so. E. द्रम to go, root redup. युच् aff.
18544: दभ r. 10th cl. (दभयति) also दभि (दम्भयति) To order, to command.
18545: दभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं) Little, small. m. (-भ्रः) The ocean.
18546: दम r. 4th cl. (इर, उ) इरदमु (दम्यति) 1 To tame or subject as an enemy, to quiet or pacify, to tranquillize. 2 To be tamed or tranquillized.
18547: दम् ind. A wife. E. दम to subject, affix क्विप्.
18548: दम m. (-मः) 1 Punishing, chastisement, punishment. 2 Taming, subduing. 3 Self-command, endurance of the most painful austerities. 4 Self-restraint, subduing the senses, suppressing the appetites, passions, &c. 5 Mud, mire. 6 (In the Vedas,) The hall of sacrifice. E. दम to tame or subdue, affix अक्ष्.
18549: दमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A tamer, a subduer. E. दम to tame, affix ण्वुल्.
18550: दमघोष m. (-षः) A prince of the lunar race, king of Cedi, father of ŚIŚUPĀLA.
18551: दमघोषसुत m. (-तः) A name of ŚIŚUPĀLA, a king and enemy of KṚṢṆA. E. दमघोष a proper name, the father of ŚIŚUPĀLA, and सुत a son.
18552: दमथ mn. (-थः-थं) 1 Punishment, punishing, chastising. 2 Selfcontrol, endurance of rigorous austerities. n. (-थं) Taming, subduing. E. दम to tame or subdue, Uṇādi affix अथ.
18553: दमथु mn. (-थुः) 1 Punishment, restraint or subjection of others. 2 Self-denial, subjection of oneself. E. दम to tame, अथुच् aff.
18554: दमन m. (-नः) 1 A hero. 2 A philosopher. 3 A kind of flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.) n. (-नं) Taming, subduing. E. दम to tame, ल्युट् aff.
18555: दमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be tamed, subjected, or subdued. E. दम to tame, अनीयर् aff.
18556: दमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Taming, restraining, chastising. f. (-न्ती) 1 The wife of NALA. 2 A kind of cucumber. E. दम to subdue, participial affix शतृ.
18557: दमस्वसृ f. (-सा) DAMAYANTĪ. E. द्रम, खसृ sister of.
18558: दमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tamed, subdued, patient of every suffering, exaction or privation. E. दम to tame, affix क्त, with इट् inserted.
18559: दमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) A tamer, a dominator. E. दम with धिनुण् aff.
18560: दमुनस् m. (-नाः) 1 A name of Agni or fire. 2 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of Venus. E. दम to tame (all things), Uṇādi affix उनसि; also ऊनसि, whence दमुनस्, m. (-नाः.)
18561: दम्पति m. du. (-ती) Husband and wife. E. दम् a wife, and पति a husband.
18562: दम्भ r. 5th cl. (उ) दम्भु (दभ्नोति) 1 To act deceitfully, to cheat, to impose upon, to trick or deceive. 2 To split or divide. r. 10th cl. (दम्भयति) To collect, to gather, to arrange or string.
18563: दम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Deceit, fraud, cheating. 2 Hypocrisy. 3 Sin, wickedness. 4 Arrogance, pride. E. दम्भ to deceive, &c. affix घञ्.
18564: दम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Hypocritical. 2 Proud. 3 Wicked. m. (-म्भी) A hypocrite, an impostor. E. दम्भ, and इनि aff.
18565: दम्भोलि m. (-लिः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. दम्भ to divide or split, affix उलि.
18566: दम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) To be subjected or tamed. 2 To be punished. m. (-भ्यः) A steer, a young bullock. E. दम to tame, यत् affix.
18567: दय (ञि) त्रिदय r. 1st cl. (दयते) 1 To give. 2 To move. 3 To take. 4 To protect. 5 To hurt or kill.
18568: दय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Compassionate, tender-hearted. mf. (-यः-या) Tenderness, compassion, clemency. E. दय to preserve, affix अङ्, fem. affix टाप्.
18569: दयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Preserving, protecting. E. दय, and शानच् aff.
18570: दयाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Kind, showing compassion. E. दया, and कर who makes.
18571: दयाकूर्च्च m. (-र्च्चः) A Buddha, a Bauddha saint, or a form of BUDDHA, the founder of the sect. E. दया compassion, and कूर्च्च boasting.
18572: दयाकृत् mfn. (-त्) Compassionate. E. दया, and कृत् doing.
18573: दयान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compassionate, charitable, kind. E. दया, and अन्वित possessed of.
18574: दयायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Compassionate, benevolent. E. दया, and युक्त joined.
18575: दयाल m. (-लः) The breaking of a bank.
18576: दयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Tender, compassionate. E. दया compassion, आलुच् affix; also दयालुक.
18577: दयालुत्व n. (-त्वं) Tenderness, compassionateness. E. त्व added to the last; with तल् दलालुता.
18578: दयावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Merciful, tender. E. दया, and मतुप् aff.
18579: दयाशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Kind, compassionate. E. दया, and शील possessed of.
18580: दयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beloved, dear, desired. m. (-तः) 1 A husband. 2 A lover. f. (-ता) 1 A woman. 2 A wife or mistress. E. दय to regard tenderly, affix क्त.
18581: दयिताधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Hen-pecked, subject to a wife. E. दयिता a wife, and अधीन subject.
18582: दर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 Fear, terror. 2 A hole in the ground. n. (-रं) A conch shell. ind. A little. f. (-रा-री) 1 A natural or artificial excavation in a mountain, a cave, a cavern, a grotto, &c. 2 A valley. E. दॄ to divide, to dread, &c. affix अप्.
18583: दरणि m. (-णिः) An eddy, a current. E. दॄ to tear (down the banks), affix अणि; some bocks read दारणि, and others आरणि.
18584: दरद् f. (-त्) 1 Terror. 2 A mountain. 3 A precipice. 4 The heart. 5 A bank or mound. 6 A tribe of barbarians. E. दॄ to divide or tear, अदि Uṇādi aff.
18585: दरद mf. (-दः-दा) A country bordering on Kashmir, the mountains about Kashmir and above Peshawer. m. (-दः) 1 Fear, terror. 2 A tribe of barbarians. E. अच् added to the former.
18586: दरविदलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Slightly or a little burst or opened. E. दर, and विदलित divided.
18587: दरि f. (-रिः) A cave: see दर. E. दृ to divide, इन् aff.
18588: दरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Frightened, terrified. 2 Torn, rent, divided. E. दर fear, इतच् affix; or दॄ to divide, affix क्त.
18589: दरिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Poor, needy, indigent, distressed. E. दरिद्रा to be poor, affix अच्.
18590: दरिद्रता f. (-ता) Poverty, indigence. E. दरिद्र, and तल् affix; also with त्व, दरिद्रत्वं.
18591: दरिद्रा r. 2nd cl. (दरिद्राति) 3rd plu. (दरिद्रति) To be poor or needy.
18592: दरिद्रायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Poor, distressed. E. दरिद्रा, and ण्वुल् aff.
18593: दरिद्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Poor, impoverished. E. दरिद्रा to be poor, affix क्त.
18594: दरिद्रितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Poor, needy. E. दरिद्रा, and तृच् affix; otherwise with ण्वुल् affix दरिद्रायंक.
18595: दरीभू f. (-भूः) A cavern, a hollow. E. दरी, and भू a place.
18596: दरीभृत् m. (-भृत्) A mountain. E. दरी a cave, and भृत् what has.
18597: दरोदर m. (-रः) 1 A gamester. 2 A stake. n. (-रं) Gambling: see टुरोदर.
18598: दर्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cracked, flawed, slightly broken, (a vessel, &c.) m. (-रः) A mountain. E. दॄ to tear or break, affix अच्, and the root repeated.
18599: दर्दराम्र m. (-म्रः) A sort of sauce or condiment; also मीनाम्रीण.
18600: दर्दरीक mn. (-कः-कं) A musical instrument. m. (-कः) 1 A cloud. 2 A frog. E. दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix रीकन्, and the radical reduplicate; what is struck, &c.
18601: दर्दुर m. (-रः) 1 A frog. 2 A cloud. 3 A mountain. 4 A sort of musical instrument, a pipe or flute. n. (-रं) A number of villages. f. (-रा) A name of DURGĀ. E. दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix उरच्, and the radical repeated.
18602: दर्दुरपुट m. (-टः) The mouth or extremity of a pipe. E. दर्दुर, and पुट a cup.
18603: दर्द्रु m. (-र्द्रुः) Herpetick eruption: see दर्द्रू.
18604: दर्दू m. (-र्दूः) A cutaneous disease, herpes; also दर्द्रू.
18605: दर्द्रू m. (-र्द्रूः) Cutaneous eruption, herpes. E. दरिद्रा to be poor, ऊ Uṇādi affix, the form is irregular: by substituting the short vowel, and omitting the first र, this word and its compounds appear in a variety of forms, as दर्द्रु, दद्रु, दद्रू; also omitting the second र, दर्द, &c. &c. q. v.
18606: दर्द्रूघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Cassia, (tora:) also दद्रघ्न, and दर्द्रूघ्न.
18607: दर्द्रूण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Diseased with herpes, herpetick; also दर्द्रूण, दर्द्रूण, &c.
18608: दर्द्रुरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Herpetick, afflicted with herpes; also दर्द्रूरोगिन्, दद्रुरोगिन्, &c.
18609: दर्प m. (-र्पः) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Musk. 3 Heat. E. दृप to be proud, to inflame, affix घञ्.
18610: दर्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What kindles, inflames, or excites. m. (-कः) A name of KĀMADEVA. E. दृप to inflame, affix ण्वुल्.
18611: दर्पण m. (-णः) A mirror. n. (-णं) 1 The eye. 2 Kindling, inflaming. E. दृप to excite, to shine, affix ल्यु.
18612: दर्पध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Puffed up or swelling with pride. E. दर्प, and ध्मात inflated.
18613: दर्पह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Humbling, humiliating, pride-destroying. E. दपौ, and ह what removes.
18614: दर्पारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Incipient pride, conceit. E. दर्प pride, आरम्भ commencement.
18615: दर्पोपशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Conciliating or subduing arrogance. E. दर्प, and उपशान्ति allaying.
18616: दर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) 1 A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin. 2 A mischievous man or animal, &c. E. दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix व.
18617: दर्ब्बट m. (-टः) A constable, a police officer set over a village, &c. 2 A warder, a doorkeeper.
18618: दर्ब्बरीक m. (-कः) 1 INDRA. 2 Air, wind. 3 A musical instrument.
18619: दर्ब्बि f. (-र्ब्बिः-र्ब्बी) 1 A ladle or spoon. 2 The expanded hood of a snake. E. दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix बि; also with ङीप् added दर्ब्बी; some authorities make the final consonant the labial letter व, as दर्ब्बि, दर्ब्बी; also दार्ब्बी.
18620: दर्ब्बिक m. (-कः) A ladle, a spoon. f. (-का) A potherb: see दार्ब्बिका. E. कन् added to the preceding.
18621: दर्ब्बीकर m. (-रः) A snake. E. दर्ब्बी the hood expanded, and कर who makes.
18622: दर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 Kuśa or sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) 2 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.) 3 Another species, (S. cylindricum.) E. दृभि to collect, to arrange, affix घञ्; or दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix भ.
18623: दर्भट m. (-टः) A private apartment or house, a retirement.
18624: दर्भपत्र m. (-त्रः) A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. दर्भ, and पत्र a leaf.
18625: दर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 Day of new moon when it rises invisible. 3 Half monthly sacrifice, performed at the change of the moon, by persons maintaining a perpetual fire. E. दृश to see, affix घ.
18626: दर्शक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what shows, displays, explains, makes clear, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A doorkeeper, a warder. 2 An exhibiter, one who points out or shows any thing. 3 A skilful man, one conversant with any science or art, &c. E. दृश to see, वुन् aff.
18627: दर्शत m. (-तः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. E. दृश to see, अतच् aff.
18628: दर्शन m. (-नं) 1 Sight, seeing, looking. 2 The eye. 3 A mirror. 4 Showing. 5 Aspect, appearance. 6 Directing, instructing. 7 A dream, a vision. 8 Virtue, moral merit. 9 Knowledge, especially religious. 10 Understanding, intellect. 11 A Śāstra, one of six religious or philosophical systems, the Pātañjala, Sāṃkhya, Vaiśeṣika, Nyāya, Mīmāṃsā, and Vedānta. 12 Sacrifice. 13 Colour. 14 Visiting any sacred shrine, worshipping in the presence of any image. E. दृश to see, affix ल्युट्.
18629: दर्शनप्रतिभू m. (-भूः) A surety for appearance. E. दर्शन, and प्रतिभू a surety.
18630: दर्शनप्रातिभाव्य n. (-व्यं) Surety for appearance, bail. E. दर्शन, and प्रातिभाव्य surety.
18631: दर्शनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Beautiful, handsome, agreeable. 2 Visible, to be seen. E. दर्श looking, and छ affix; or दृश to see, and अनीयर् aff.
18632: दर्शनीयमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Vain, conceited, thinking oneself handsome. E. दर्शनीय, मन to mind, णिनि aff.
18633: दर्शयामिनी f. (-नी) The night of new moon, on which it rises invisible. E. दर्श new moon, and यामिनी night.
18634: दर्शयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Showing, displaying, who or what shows. m. (-ता) 1 A warder, an usher, a doorkeeper. 2 A show man, a guide, an exhibiter. E. दृश to see, in the causal form, and तृच् aff.
18635: दर्शयित्वा ind. Having shown, having made manifest. E. दृश to see, causal form, क्त्वाच् aff.
18636: दर्शयिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Showing, explaining or proposing to shew or explain. E. दृश to see, causal form, शतृ affix, with a future sense.
18637: दर्शविपद् m. (-द्) The moon. E. दर्श day of new moon, and विपद् trouble.
18638: दर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Visible, apparent. 2 Shown, displayed. 3 Explained. 4 Seen. 5 Understood. E. दृश to see, in the causal form, affix क्त.
18639: दर्शितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having shown, showing, displaying. 2 Explaining, teaching. E. दृश causal form, क्तवतु aff.
18640: दल r. 1st cl. (दलति) r. 10th cl. (दालयति) 1 To cut, to divide, to split or pierce. 2 To be cut, &c. 3 To display. 4 To wither.
18641: दल mn. (-लः-लं) A leaf. n. (-लं) 1 A part, a portion, a fragment. 2 Dividing, tearing, cutting, splitting, &c. 3 A sheath, a scabbard. 4 An adulteration or alloy. 5 A heap or quantity. 6 The leaf of the Tamāla. 7 A half. E. दल to divide, to cut, &c. affix अच्.
18642: दलकपाट m. (-टः) A folded petal or leaf. E. दल, and कपाट a door.
18643: दलकोष m. (-षः) A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.) E. दल, a leaf, and कोष a sheath.
18644: दलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Splitting, rending. 2 Being torn or cut. E. दल to cut or be pierced, affix शतृ.
18645: दलद्धृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Broken-hearted, cut to the heart, &c. E. दलत्, and हृदय the heart.
18646: दलन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Breaking to pieces, cutting, dividing, (who or what does so.) n. (-नं) Tearing, rending, breaking, pulling to pieces. f. (-नी) A clod or clump of earth or mould. E. दल to divide, affix ल्युट्.
18647: दलनिर्म्मोक m. (-कः) The Bhojpatra, a tree of which the bark is used for hookah snakes, &c. E. दल a leaf, and निर्म्भोक shedding, casting off.
18648: दलप m. (-पः) 1 Gold. 2 A sacred or religious institute. E. दल to be divided, Uṇādi affix अप.
18649: दलपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. दल a leaf, and पुष्प a flower; the leaves surrounding the flower.
18650: दलसूचि m. (-चिः) A thorn. E. दल a leaf, and सूचि a needle.
18651: दलस्नसा f. (-सा) The fibre or vein of a leaf. E. दल a leaf, and स्नसा a fibre.
18652: दलाढक m. (-कः) 1 Sesamum growing wild or spontaneously. 2 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 3 A plant commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.) 4 A tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) 5 Red chalk. 6 Cuttle fish bone. 7 A moat, a ditch. 8 A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.) 9 An elephant's ear. 10 The driver of an elephant. 11 A hurricane, a high wind. E. दल as above, ढौकृ to go, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
18653: दलाद्य m. (-ढ्यः) Mud, but mud especially on the banks of a river.
18654: दलामल n. (-लं) 1 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa:) see मरुवक. 2 A plant, (Artemisia.) E. दल a leaf, and अमल clear, clean.
18655: दलाम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sorrel. E. दल the leaf, and अम्ल sour.
18656: दलि mf. (-लिः-ली) A clod of clay or mould. E. दल to be divided, (by the harrow or plough,) Uṇādi affix इ.
18657: दलिक m. (-कः) Timber, wood. E. दल to split, affix इकच्.
18658: दलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown, full blown, expanded. 2 Broken, split. 3 Cut to pieces. 4 Torn, rent. 5 Scattered, driven apart, divided. 6 Opened, unfolded. E. दल to split, affix क्त.
18659: दलेगन्धि m. (-न्धिः) A plant, (Echites scholaris:) see सप्तपर्ण. E. दल in the seventh case दले, in the leaf, and गन्धि fragrance.
18660: दल्भ m. (-ल्भः) 1 Fraud, dishonesty. 2 Sin. 3 The name of a Muni or saint. 4 A wheel. E. दल to divide, भ Uṇādi aff.
18661: दल्भि m. (-ल्भिः) A name of INDRA. 2 INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. दल to break or split, Uṇādi affix भि.
18662: दव (इ) दवि r. 1st cl. (दन्वति) To go, to move.
18663: दव m. (-वः) 1 A wood on fire, a forest conflagration. 2 A wood, a forest. 3 Fire in general. 4 Heat, (moral or physical.) E. दु to agitate, affix अच्; also दाव.
18664: दवथु m. (-थुः) 1 Anxiety, vexation, distress. 2 Inflammation of the eye, &c. E. दु to be agitated, अथुच् aff.
18665: दवयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत) Removing, making remote, placing at a distance. E. दव for दूर used as a verb, शतृ aff.
18666: दवाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A wood on fire, or the conflagration of a forest. E. दव a wood, and अग्नि a fire; also दव and दाव.
18667: दविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very remote, very distant. E. दूर् far, affix इष्ठन्, and दव substituted for दूर्; also दवीयस्.
18668: दवीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very remote or distant: see the preceding, the affix being the superlative affix ईयसुन्.
18669: दश (इ) दशि r. 1st and 10th cls. (दशति दंशयति) 1 To bite or sting. 2 To arm, to put on armour. 3 To see. r. 10th cl. (दंशयते) To shine. With उप, to be in trouble, to be reduced in circumstances, With सम्, to pinch, to nip, to bite.
18670: दशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Ten. E. कन् added to दश.
18671: दशकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. दश ten, and कण्ठ a neck; the ten-necked; also similar names, as दशग्रीव, &c.
18672: दशकण्ठजित् m. (-जित्) A name of RĀMA. E. दशकण्ठ RĀVAṆA, and जित् the conqueror.
18674: दशकामजव्यसन n. (-नं) The aggregate of ten vices, proceeding from the quality of desire, viz. hunting, gambling, sleeping during the day, abusiveness, lechery, drunkenness, dancing, singing, playing, and hypocrisy. E. दश ten, काम desire, ज born, व्यसन calamity.
18675: दशगुण adv. n. (-णं) Ten times, ten-fold. E. दश, and गुण a time.
18676: दशग्राम n. (-मं) A district or collection of ten villages. E. दश, and ग्राम a village.
18677: दशग्रामपति m. (-तिः) A magistrate or chief of ten villages. E. दश, and ग्राम a village, पति master.
18678: दशग्रामिन् m. (-मी) 1 The head man of ten villages. 2 The municipality or corporation of the same. E. दशग्राम, and इनि aff.
18681: दशधा ind. In ten ways. E. दश, and धाच् aff.
18682: दशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Ten. E. दश to bite, Uṇādi affix अन्, the nasal rejected.
18683: दशन mn. (-नः-नं) A tooth. m. (-नः) The peak of a mountain. n. (-नं) Armour, mail. E. दंश to bite, affix ल्युट्.
18684: दशनवासस् n. (-मः) A lip. E. दशन a tooth, and वामस् vesture.
18685: दशनांशु m. (-शुः) The whiteness or brightness of the teeth. E. दशन, and अंशु a ray.
18686: दशनाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A bite, the mark of the teeth. E. दशन, and अङ्क a mark.
18687: दशनाद्या f. (-ढ्या) A kind of sorrel.
18688: दशनोच्छिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Toothless. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 Breathing, breathing out, expiration. 2 A lip. 3 Kissing, a kiss. E. दशन a tooth, and उच्छिष्ठ expelled, ejected.
18689: दशपारमिताधर m. (-रः) A Buddha or Bauddha saint. E. दश, पारमिता a particular work or scripture of this sect, धर who has.
18690: दशपुर n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus;) see दाशपुर. 2 A district, part of Malva or Bundelkhand. 3 A town or city. E. दश for दाश a fisherman, and पुर or पूर to nourish, affix दश; also दश ten, and पुर a city: a district of ten cities.
18691: दशपूर n. (-रं) A fragrant grass: see the preceding; also दाशपूर.
18692: दशबल m. (-लः) A Buddha or Bauddha teacher. E. दश ten, (the ten worlds,) बल powerful.
18693: दशभूमिग m. (-गः) BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect, or a Buddha, the generic name of the sanctified teachers of that sect. E. दश ten, भूमि earth, and ग who goes; traversing the ten worlds; also दशभूमीश, m. (-शः) Lord of the same.
18694: दशम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Tenth. f. (-मी) 1 The tenth day of the half month. 2 The tenth or last stage of human life, the last ten years of a century. E. दशन् ten, and मट् aff.
18695: दशमहाविद्या f. (-द्या) DURGĀ. E. दश ten, (forms, or names,) महा great, and विद्या a name of DURGA.
18696: दशमाल nf. (-लं-ली) A collection of ten garlands. E. दश ten, माला a garland, टच् aff.
18697: दशमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Very old or aged. E. दशमी the tenth, (stage of life,) and इनि aff.
18698: दशमीङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very old, above ninety. E. दशमी, and गत arrived at.
18699: दशमीस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Impotent. 2 Very old, turned of ninety. 3 Dying, on the point of death. E. दशमी the last stage of life, and स्थ who is.
18700: दशमुख m. (खः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. दश ten, and मुख a face.
18701: दशमुखान्तक m. (-कः) A name of RĀMA. E. दशमुख RĀVAṆA, and अन्तक destroyer.
18702: दशमूल n. (-लं) A tonic medicament prepared from the roots of ten plants. E. दश ten, and मूल a root.
18703: दशरथ m. (-थः) A proper name, sovereign of Ayodhya or Oude, and father of RĀMA. E. दश ten, and रथ a car; whose car bore him to the ten quarters of the universe.
18704: दशरात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of ten days and nights. E. दश, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
18705: दशरूपभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) A name of VIṢṆU. E. दश ten, रूप forms, (Avatars,) and भृत् who assumes.
18706: दशलक्षण n. (-णं) Ten marks or attributes. E. दश, and लक्षण a mark.
18707: दशवाजिन् m. (-जी) The moon. E. दश ten, and वाजिन् a horse, whose car is drawn by ten horses.
18708: दशशत n. (-तं) A thousand. E. दश, and शत a hundred.
18709: दशसहस्र n. (-स्रं) A myriad. E. दश, and सहस्र a thousand.
18710: दशा f. (-शा) or m. plu. (-शाः) 1 The ends of a piece of cloth, the end of a garment. 2 A state, a condition, a period or time of life, as youth, age, manhood, &c. 3 The wick of a lamp. 4 The mind or faculty, of understanding. 5 Aspect or position of the planets at birth. E. दश to bite, to cut or divide, or be cut or divided, अङ् aff.
18711: दशाकर्ष m. (-र्षः) A lamp. E. दशा a wick, आकर्ष what possesses.
18712: दशाकर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) A lamp. E. दशा a wick, आङ् before, कृष to make lines, affix इनि.
18713: दशानन m. (-नः) The giant RĀVAṆA. E. दश ten, and आनन a face.
18714: दशानिक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)
18715: दशाफल n. (-लं) Result of circumstance or of condition of life. E. दशा, and फल fruit.
18716: दशार्ण m. (-र्णः) A country, part of central Hindustan, lying on the south-east of the Vindhya mountains. f. (-र्णा) A river rising in the Vindhya hills, the Dosarene of the ancients. E. दश ten, ऋण a fort.
18717: दशास्थिति f. (-तिः) Condition. E. दशा, and स्थिति stay.
18718: दशार्ह m. (-र्हः) 1 A Buddha or Jina. 2 A country in the south of India, the kingdom of YADU. m. plu. (-र्हाः) The Yādavas or people of Daśārha. E. दश ten, and अर्ह proper, worthy.
18719: दशावतार m. (-रः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. दश ten, and अवतार descent; the deity of whom there are ten descents from heaven, for the purpose of protecting or punishing mankind: see अवतार.
18720: दशाविशेष m. (-षः) Existing circumstances, peculiar condition. E. दशा, and विशेष sort.
18721: दशाश्व m. (-श्वः) A name of CANDRA or the moon. E. दश ten, and अश्व a horse; driving ten horses in his carriage.
18722: दशास्य m. (-स्यः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. दश ten, and आस्य face, the ten-headed.
18723: दशास्यजित् m. (-जित्) RĀMA. E. दशास्य as above, and जित् the conqueror.
18724: दशाह n. (-हं) A period of ten days. E. दश, and अहन् a day.
18725: दशेन्द्रिय m. plu. (-याः) The ten organs of sense and action, viz. the skin, eye, tongue, nose, ear, organ of speech, hand, foot, anus, and pudendum. E. दश ten, and इन्द्रिय an organ.
18726: दशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Having ten of any thing. m. (-शी) The superintendent of ten villages. E. दश, and इनि aff.
18727: दशेन्धन m. (-नः) A lamp. E. दशा a wick, and इन्धन fuel.
18728: दशेर m. (-रः) A mischievous or venomous animal, a beast of prey, &c. E. दश to bite, Uṇādi affix एरक्.
18729: दशेरक m. (-कः) A country destitute of water. E. कन् added to the preceding; also दशेरुक.
18730: दष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Bitten. 2 Joining to, in contact with. E. दश to bite, क्त aff.
18731: दस (इर्, उ) इरदसु r. 1st cl. (दस्यति) 1 To lose. 2 To throw or direct, to throw up or toss. r. 10th cl. (दसयते) To see. (इ) दसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (दंसति दंसयति) 1 To bite or sing. 2 To see. 3 To shine.
18732: दसन n. (-नं) 1 Throwing, tossing. 2 Dismissing. 3 Perishing. E. दस to lose, affix ल्युट्.
18733: दस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Lost, destroyed. 2 Thrown, tossed. 3 Sent away, dismissed. E. दस to lose, &c. क्त aff.
18734: दस्म m. (-स्मः) 1 A name of fire. 2 A sacrificer, one who employs Brahmans in instituting a religious ceremony. 3 A thief. 4 A rogue, a knave. E. दस to throw or send, मक् Uṇādi aff.
18735: दस्यु m. (-स्युः) An enemy. 2 A thief. 3 An oppressor, a violator, a committer of injustice, &c. 4 A barbarian, an outcaste, or a Hindu who has become so by neglect of the essential rites. E. दस to lose or be lost, Uṇādi affix युच्.
18736: दस्युह m. (-हः) A name of BĀLĪ.
18737: दस्र m. (-स्रः) 1 Either of the twin sons of AŚVINI, and physicians of Svarga; also collectively m. du. (दस्रौ) 2 An ass. n. (-स्रं) Thin rain, dew, frost. E. दस to destroy, (disease, &c.) रक Uṇādi aff.
18738: दस्रदेवता f. (-ता) The lunar constellation AŚVINI. E. दस्र a divine physician, and देवता a deity: he being the ruling genius of the asterism.
18739: दस्रसू f. (-सूः) A name of SAṂJÑĀ, a wife of the sun, and mother, according to one legend, of the twin physicians of INDRA'S heaven. E. दस्र as above, and सू mother.
18740: दह (औ) दहौ r. 1st cl. (दहति) To burn or reduce to ashes. (इ) दहि r. 10th cl. (दंहयति) 1 To shine. 2 To burn.
18741: दहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Scorching, burning. E. दह to burn, शतृ aff.
18742: दहन n. (-नं) Burning, combustion. m. (-नः) 1 Fire, or the deity AGNI. 2 A bad man, one of evil dispositions. 3 The marking nut plant. 4 Lead wort, (Plumbago zeylanica, &c.) E. दह to burn, affix ल्युट्.
18743: दहनकेतन n. (-नं) Smoke. E. दहन fire, and केतन a banner or sign.
18744: दहनप्रिया f. (-या) A name of SVĀHĀ, the wife of AGNI. E. दहन fire, and प्रिया the beloved.
18745: दहनबहुल m. (-लः) Fire. E. दहन, and बहुल much.
18746: दहनाराति m. (-तिः) Water. E. दहन, and अराति foe.
18747: दहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be or what may be burnt, combustible. E. दह to burn, अनीयर् aff.
18748: दहनोपल m. (-लः) The Sun-gem, a crystal lens. E. दहन fire, and उपल a stone; fire-stone.
18749: दहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Thin, small, fine. m. (-रः) 1 A rat, a mouse. 2 A young animal. 3 A younger brother. 4 A child, an infant. E. दह to burn, affix अर.
18750: दह्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Burnt, being burnt. E. दह to burn, pass. v. शानच् aff.
18751: दह्र m. (ह्रः) 1 A name of AGNI or fire. 2 The conflagration of a forest. E. दह to burn, रक् aff.
18752: दा (ण) दाण r. 1st cl. (यच्छति, or with सम् prefixed संयच्छते;) also (डु ञ्) डुदाञ् r. 3rd cl. (ददाति) To give, to present. With आङ् prefixed (आदत्ते), To take, to accept or receive. With प्र, To give, to give to. With वि and आङ्, To open. With सम and आङ्, To select. (प) दाप् r. 2nd cl. (दाति) To cut.
18753: दाक m. (-कः) 1 A donor, one who makes presents, especially to Brahmans. 2 A sacrificer, one who pays all the expenses of the ceremony, and employs the officiating priests. E. दा to give, क Uṇādi aff.
18754: दाक्षक n. (-कं) A multitude of the descendants of DAKṢA. E. दक्ष, and वुञ् aff.
18755: दाक्षायण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Of or relating to DAKṢA, a descendant, &c. n. (-णं) Gold, or a gold ornament, as an earring, &c. E. दक्ष, and फञ् aff.
18756: दाक्षायणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Having gold. m. (-णी) A Brahman student, wearing gold earrings. E. दाक्षायण, and इनि aff.
18757: दाक्षायिणी f. plu. (-यिण्यः) The twenty-seven lunar mansions, considered mythologically as the daughters of DAKṢA, and wives of the moon. f. sing. (-णी) A name of DURGĀ. 2 The nymph and asterism ROHIṆĪ. 3 A plant, commonly Dantī, (Croton polyandrum.) 4 A lunar asterism in general. E. दक्ष the son of BRAHMA, so called, फिञ् affix of descent, and ङीप् fem. aff.
18758: दाक्षायिणीप m. (-पः) 1 CANDRA. 2 ŚIVA. E. दाक्षायिणी, and प who protects.
18759: दाक्षायिणीपति m. (-तिः) CANDRA or the moon. E. दाक्षायिणी an asterism, and पति husband: see the preceding; also similar compounds.
18760: दाक्षायिणीरमण m. (-णः) The moon: see the last. E. दाक्षायिणी, and रमण lover.
18761: दाक्षाय्य m. (-य्यः) A vulture. E. दक्षा to be quick, आय्य affix, and again, अण् affix of descent.
18762: दाक्षिकन्था f. (-न्था) A place in the north of India, in the country of Vāhlika or Balkh: see कन्थ.
18763: दाक्षिकन्थीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Produced or born, &c. in Dākṣikantha; see the last. E. दाक्षिकन्थ, and छ affix; also similar compounds, as दाक्षिनगरीय, दाक्षिग्रामीय.
18764: दाक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Relating or belonging to the south, to a gift to Brahmans, &c. E. दक्षिण, and अण् aff.
18765: दाक्षिणात्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Southerly, southern, belonging to or produced in the south. m. (-त्यः) The cocoanut. E. दाक्षिण southern, and त्यक् aff.
18766: दाक्षिण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Meriting a reward. n. (-ण्यं) 1 Concord, harmony, agreement. 2 Cleverness. talent. 3 Appeasing or restoring any one offended to good humour. E. दक्षिणा a gift, &c. affix ण्यत्.
18767: दाक्षीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The inspired grammarian PĀṆINI. E. दाक्षी a proper name, the mother of the saint, and पुत्त्र a son.
18768: दाक्षेय m. (-यः) A name of PĀṆINI. E. दाक्षी the mother of the Muni, and ढक् affix of descent.
18769: दाक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Cleverness, dexterity, ability. E. दक्ष, and यञ् aff.
18770: दाडक m. (-कः) A tooth, a tusk.
18771: दाडिम subst. mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) 1 The pomegranate tree, (of mf. the tree, n. the fruit). 2 Small cardamoms. E. दल to divide, इमच् affix, the radical vowel made long, and ल changed to ड.
18772: दाडिमपुष्पक m. (-कः) A medicinal plant, (Andersonia rohitaka.) E. दाडिम as above, पुष्य a flower, and कन् affix of resemblance; bearing flowers like those of the pomegranate.
18773: दाडिमप्रिय m. (-यः) A parrot. E. दाडिम the pomegranate, and प्रिय fond of.
18774: दाडिमभक्षण m. (-णः) A parrot. E. दाडिम a pomegranate, and भक्षण eating.
18775: दाडिम्ब m. (-म्बः) The pomegranate: see दाडिम.
18776: दाढा f. (-ढा) 1 A large tooth, a tusk. 2 Wish, desire. 3 A number, a multitude. E. दा to cut, ढ affix, fem. affix टाप्.
18777: दाढिका f. (-का) The beard. E. दाढा a tooth, and कन् affix, implying propinquity, fem. form.
18778: दाण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) 1 Relating to a stick or staff. 2 Relating to punishment, &c. E. दण्ड a stick, अण् aff.
18779: दाण्डमाथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Churning with a straight stick or staff. E. दण्डमाथ a churning stick, ठक् aff.
18780: दाण्डाजिनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fraudulent, dishonest. E. दण्डाजिन fraud, affix ठक्.
18781: दात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, divided. E. दा to cut, affix क्त.
18782: दातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be given, what may or ought to be given. E. दा to give, तव्य aff.
18783: दाति f. (-तिः) Cutting, destroying. E. दा to cut, क्तिन् aff.
18784: दातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A donor, a giver, giving, bestowing. E. दा to give, तृच् aff.
18785: दात्यूह m. (-हः) 1 A gallinule. 2 The Cātaka, a sort of cuckoo. 3 A cloud. E. दाति destroying, ऊह to plan or arrange, affix अण्; also दात्यौह.
18786: दात्यौह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Of, relating to, or produced in the vehicle of a demon. (E. दैत्य a demon. बह to bear, affix घञ्, अण् added, and the first vowel changed to आ by especial rule.) m. (-हः) A gallinule. E. see दात्यूह (the radical vowel being optionally changed,) with अण् affix.
18787: दात्र n. (-त्रं) A sort of sickle, a large knife or a Dā. E. दो to cut, त्रन् Uṇādi aff.
18788: दात्व m. (-त्वः) A giver, a donor. E. दा to give, त्वन् Uṇādi aff.
18789: दाद m. (-दः) 1 A gift, a donation. 2 Giving. E. दद to give, घञ् aff.
18790: दादद m. (-दः) A donor, one who gives. E. दाद, and द who gives.
18791: दादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Giving. E. दद to give, णिनि aff.
18792: दाधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made of or from Dadhi, or coagulated milk, mixed with it, sprinkled with it, &c. E. दधि, and ठक् aff.
18793: दान (उ) दान r. 1st cl. irr. (दीदांसति-ते) 1 To cut. 2 To straighten or make straight. 3 To be straight.
18794: दान n. (-नं) 1 Gift, giving, donation. 2 The fluid that flows from the temples of an elephant in rut. 3 Nourishing, cherishing. 4 Purification. 5 Cutting, dividing. 6 A present, a special gift. 7 Beating, striking. 8 Wild honey. E. दा to give, or दो to cut, affix ल्युट्.
18795: दानकुल्या f. (-ल्या) The flow of an elephant's temporal ichor. E. दान, and कुल्या a river.
18796: दानधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Almsgiving, charity. 2 The rules for making donations. E. दान, and धर्म्म virtue.
18797: दानपति m. (-तिः) 1 A liberal or munificent man. 2 A name of AKRŪRA, the kinsman of KṚṢṆA. E. दान giving, and पति eminent.
18798: दानप्रतिभाव्य n. (-व्यं) Security for payment of a debt, &c. E. दान, and प्रतिभाव्य surety.
18799: दानभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Divided or made hostile by bribes. E. दान, and भिन्न broken.
18800: दानयोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Fit for or meriting a donation. E. दान, and योग्य fit for.
18801: दानव m. (-वः) A demon, a Titan or giant. E. दनु the mother of these beings, and अण् affix of descent.
18802: दानवज्र m. (-ज्रः) A Vaiśya or man of the third tribe. E. दान, and वज्र diamond.
18803: दानवर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) 1 An elephant in rut. 2 A liberal man. E. दान, and वर्षिन् showering.
18804: दानवारि m. (-रिः) A deity. E. दानव a Titan, and अरि a foe.
18805: दानवीर m. (-रः) A liberal man. E. दान, and वीर a hero.
18806: दानव्यत्यास m. (-सः) Gift under error, as giving to the wrong person, &c. E. दान, and व्यत्यास perversion.
18807: दानशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Liberal, munificent. E. दान giving, शील addicted to.
18808: दानशौण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Liberal, bountiful, munificent. E. दान a gift, and शौण्ड intoxicated, attached to violently.
18809: दानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Giving. E. दान, and इनि aff.
18810: दानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Worthy of having any thing given, or worthy or fit to be given. n. (-नं) Gift, donation. E. दा to give, अनीयर् affix of the future participle.
18811: दानु m. (-नुः) 1 A donor, a giver. 2 A victor, a conqueror. 3 Prosperity. 4 Air, wind. E. दा to give, Uṇādi affix नु.
18812: दान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Tamed, subdued, daunted. 2 Bearing patiently privation, austerity, &c. 3 Dental. m. (-न्तः) 1 A donor, a giver. 2 A well situated about the peak of a mountain. E. दम to tame, to pacify, affix क्त, or दन्त a peak, &c. affix अण्.
18813: दान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 The patient endurance of religious austerities or privations. 2 Subjection, humiliation. E. दम to tame, &c. affix क्तिन्.
18814: दापयित्वा ind. Having fined. E. दा to give, causal form, क्त्वा aff.
18815: दापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Condemned, adjudged, (the person.) 2 Assigned, awarded, (the thing.) 3 The person to whom a fine, &c. is awarded or paid. 4 Given, caused to be given. 5 Purified. E. दा to give, in the causal form, and क्त affix; also दायित.
18816: दाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be fined, to be made to give or pay. E. दा to give, causal form, यत् aff.
18817: दाभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) To be ordered, to be governed or ruled. E. दभ to order, ण्यत् aff.
18818: दामन् nf. (-म-मा) A string, a cord, a thread or rope. E. दो to cut or divide, &c. affix मनिन्.
18819: दामन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to the Dona or Artemisia flower. E. दामन, and अण् aff.
18820: दामनपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) The fourteenth of the light half of Chaitra, when the Dona flower is worshipped. E. दामन, and पर्व्व a holiday.
18821: दामनी f. (-नी) A string, a rope, especially for typing cattle. E. दामन् as above, अण् and ङीष् affs.
18822: दामलिप्त n. (-प्तं) A country, the modern district of Tumlook. E. see तामलिप्त, त being changed to द.
18823: दामा f. (-मा) A rope, a string, a cord. E. see दामन्.
18824: दामाञ्जन n. (-नं) A foot-rope for horses, &c. E. दामा, and अञ्ज to go, affix ल्युट्; also दामा, and अञ्चल end, दामाञ्चल, n. (-लं.)
18825: दामोदर m. (-रः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA. 2 A Jina of the past age. E. दाम a rope, and उदर a belly; YAŚODHĀ his foster mother having in vain passed the folds of a rope round his body, whilst a child, to keep him in confinement.
18826: दाम्भिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Hypocritical. m. (-कः) A hypocrite. 2 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. दम्भ, and टक् aff.
18827: दाय (ऋ) दायृ r. 1st cl. (दायते) To give.
18828: दाय m. (-यः) 1 Gift, donation. 2 A special gift, as a nuptial present, alms to a student at his initiation, &c. 3 Portion, inheritance. 4 Loss, destruction. 5 Breaking, dividing. 6 A place, a site. 7 Irony. E. दा to give, in the passive form, affix ण; that which is given; or दो to cut, &c. that which is divided; or दाय to give, affix अच्.
18829: दायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Liberal, giving, a donor. E. दा to give, ण्वुल् aff.
18830: दायबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A brother. E. दाय portion, बन्धु a friend.
18831: दायभाग m. (-गः) Partition of heritage, apportioning inheritance, &c. E. दाय heritage, and भाग a part or portion.
18832: दायविभाग m. (-गः) Portioning or portion of inheritance, division of property amongst different heirs. E. दाय heritage, and धिभाग a part or portion.
18833: दायाद m. (-दः) 1 A son. 2 A kinsman, near or remote. 3 An heir. f. (-दा-दी) A daughter, an heiress. E. दाय a portion, आङ् prefixed to दा to take, affix क.
18834: दायादव m. (-वः) An heir, a kinsman.
18835: दायापवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Privation, a forfeiture of property. E. दाय, and अपवर्त्तन taking away.
18836: दायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Condemned, sentenced. 2 Awarded, adjudged. 3 The person to whom any thing is awarded, &c. see दापित.
18837: दार m. plu. (-राः) A wife. E. दॄ to take, to tear, (a husband,) affix घञ्; also दारा.
18838: दारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A breaker, a tearer. m. (-कः) 1 A son. 2 A child, an infant or young animal. 3 The charioteer of VIṢṆU. 4 A village hog. f. (-रिका) 1 A daughter. 2 A whore. E. दॄ to tear, affix ण्वुल्.
18839: दारकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Marriage. E. दार a wife, and कर्म्मन् a business; also कारकिया.
18840: दारण n. (-णं) 1 The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum.) 2 Tearing, rending, dividing. E. दॄ to tear, affix ल्युट्.
18841: दारद m. (-दः) 1 A sort of poison, one brought from the country named Darad. 2 Quicksilver. 3 Vermilion. 4 The ocean. E. दारदृ a country, &c. affix अण्.
18842: दारपरिग्रह m. (-हः) Marriage. E. दार, and परिग्रह taking.
18843: दारव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Wooden, made of wood. E. दारु, and अण् aff.
18844: दारवलिभुज् m. (भुक्) 1 The Vaka, a sort of crane. 2 A crow. 2 A sparrow. E. दार a wife or female, वलि food, and भुज् who eats.
