19498: दृङ्मण्डल n. (-लं) A small circle within the great circles of the armillary sphere, accompanying each planetary circle or orbit. E. दृश, and मण्डल sphere.
19499: दृडक m. (-कः) A fire-place, or hole made in the ground for cooking.
19500: दृढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Much, exceeding; (in this sense it is also an adverb declinable in the neuter gender.) 2 Hard, firm. 3 Able, powerful. 4 Bulky, massive, solid. 5 Strong. 6 Confirmed. n. (-ढं) Iron. E. दृह to increase, affix क्त.
19501: दृढकण्टक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Dhaliākāra. E. दृढ much or many, and कण्टक a thorn.
19502: दृढकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A bambu. E. दृढ, and काण्ड a stem.
19503: दृढकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Persevering, determined. E. दृढ, and कारिन् who does, (any act.)
19504: दृढगात्रिका f. (-का) Granulated sugar. E. दृढ firm. गात्र substance, affix कन्.
19505: दृढग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A bambu. E. दृढ, and ग्रन्थि a knot.
19506: दृढता f. (-ता) 1 Firmness, hardness. 2 Steadiness. 3 Solidity. 4 Strength. E. तल् added to दृढ; also with त्व, दृढत्वं.
19507: दृढदंशक m. (-कः) A shark. E. दृड hard, दंशक a biter.
19508: दृढधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A good archer. E. दृढ, and धन्वन् a bow.
19509: दृढधुर् mfn. (-धूः-धूः-धु) Strong, able to bear a weight or load. E. दृढ, and धुर् a burthen.
19510: दृढनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Certain, confirmed, corroborated, undoubted. E. दृढ, and निश्चय certainty.
19511: दृढफल m. (-लः) The cocoanut. E. दृढ hard, and फल fruit.
19512: दृढबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound or tied tightly. E. दृढ, and वद्ध bound.
19513: दृढबन्धिनी f. (-नी) A creeper, (Echites frutescens.) E. दृढ firmly, वन्ध to bind, affixes णिनि, and ङीप्; winding closely round a tree or stem.
19514: दृढभक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Faithful, devoted. E. दृढ, and भक्ति faith.
19515: दृढमुष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Miserly, niggardly, close-fisted, m. (-ष्टिः) A sword, any weapon with a hilt or handle. E. दृढ firm, and मुष्टि a handle, a fist.
19516: दृढमूल m. (-लः) The cocoanut. E. दृढ hard, and मूल root.
19517: दृढलोमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-मं) Having coarse hair on the skin. m. (-मा) 1 A wild hog. 2 Coarse hair, bristles. E. दृढ firm, stiff, and लोमन् the hair of the body.
19518: दृढव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Observing steadily a religious vow or obligation. E. दृढ, and व्रत a vow.
19519: दृढसन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) 1 Strong knit, well fixed or compact, (the person, &c.) 2 Close, compact, free from interstices. 3 Closely connected or allied. E. दृढ firm, and सन्धि union, a joint, &c.
19520: दृढसूत्रिका f. (-का) A plant from the fibres of which bow strings are made: see मूर्व्वा. E. दृढ firm, and सूत्र a thread, a fibre, affix क.
19521: दृढसौहृद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Firm in friendship, constant. E. दृढ, and सौहृद friendship.
19522: दृढस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, a sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका. E. दृढ firm, and स्कन्ध stem.
19523: दृढाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Firm-bodied, hard, strong. n. (-ङ्गं) A diamond. E. दृढ, and अङ्ग body.
19524: दृढार्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 The end of a bow. 2 Great pain. E. दृढ, and अर्त्ति end of a bow, &c.
19525: दृढाभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A faithful mistress or wife. E. दृढ fem. form, and भक्ति attachment.
19526: दृढायुध m. (-धः) A hero, one firm in battle. E. दृढ, and आयुध war.
19527: दृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Respected, honoured. f. (-ता) Cumin. E. दृ to respect, affix क्त.
19528: दृति m. (-तिः) 1 A bellows. 2 A fish. 3 A skin of leather, or a leather bag for holding water. 4 Skin, hide. E. दॄ to divide, क्तिन् aff.
19529: दृतिधारक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Acanpāta. E. दृति a bellows, and धारक having; having leaves compared to a leather bellows.
19530: दृतिहरि m. (-रिः) A dog. E. दृति here said to mean skin in general, and हरि who steals, from हृ with इन् aff.
19531: दृतिहार m. (-रः) A carrier of skins or bags, a water carrier, &c. E. दृति, and हृ to take, अण् aff.
19532: दृन्भू m. (-न्भूः) 1 The thunderbolt. 2 The sun. f. (-न्भूः) 1 A snake in general. 2 A wheel. E. दृभ to fear, Uṇādi affix कू, and नुम् inserted; न being optionally changed to म before भ, the word is also read दृम्भू.
19533: दृप r. 4th cl. (ञि ईर ऊ) ञि ईरदृपु (दृप्यति) 1 To be glad, to rejoice. 2 To be arrogant, to be vain or proud. r. 6th cl. (दृपति) To pain, to inflict pain, to torture. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्पति दर्पयति) To light, to kindle or inflame.
19534: दृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Proud, arrogant. E. दृप to be proud, affix क्त.
19535: दृप्यत् mfn. (-प्यन्-प्यती-प्यत्) Being proud or arrogant. E. दृप to be proud, शतृ aff.
19536: दृप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) 1 Strong, powerful. 2 Proud, arrogant. E. दृप to be proud, Uṇādi affix रक्.
19537: दृफ r. 6th cl. (दृफति) To pain, to hurt.
19538: दृब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Strung, tied. 2 Afraid, frightened. 3 Pained, tortured. E. दृभ to pain, to string, affix क्त.
19539: दृभ (ई) दृभी r. 6th cl. (दृभति) 1 To string, to arrange. 2 To give pain. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्भति दर्भयति) To fear, to be afraid.
19540: दृम्प r. 6th cl. (दृम्पति) To inflict pain, to torture.
19541: दृम्फ r. 6th cl. (दृम्फति) To pain, to torture.
19542: दृम्फू f. (-म्फूः) A snake in general. E. दृम्फ to give pain, affix कूः see दृम्भू.
19543: दृम्भू f. (-म्भूः) A snake, &c.: see दृम्भ.
19544: दृश (औ ईर) औदृशिर r. 1st cl. (पश्यति) To see. With उत् prefixed, 1 To see, to observe. 2 To anticipate, to foresee. 3 To doubt, to think doubtingly.
19545: दृश् mfn. (-दृक्) 1 A seer, a looker. 2 Wise, possessed of knowledge. f. (-दृक्) 1 The eye. 2 Sight, seeing. E. दृश to see, affix क्विप्; also दृशा and दृशि, &c.
19546: दृशद् f. (-शद् or शत्) 1 A stone, a rock. 2 A flat stone for grinding condiments upon. E. दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix अदि, augment षुक्, and ष changed to श; the crude form may also be दृषत् or दृषट्, &c.
19547: दृशद्वती f. (-ती) 1 The name of a river which forms the eastern boundary of the Āryavarta or holy land of the Hindus, running on the north-east of Delhi. 2 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. दृशद् a stone or rock, and मतुप् poss. aff.
19548: दृशा f. (-शा) The eye. E. see दृश, टाप् being here added.
19549: दृशाकाङ्क्ष्य n. (-ङ्क्ष्य) A lotus, or rather a kind of nelumbium. E. दृश the eye, काङ्क्ष्य to desire, with आङ् prefix, and यत् affix; desirable as an object of comparison to the eye.
19550: दृशान n. (-नं) Light. m. (-नः) 1 The name of an Asura; also VIROCANA. 2 A holy or spiritual teacher. 3 A king, a ruler, a protector or cherisher of the world. 4 A Brahman. E. दृश to see, आनच् Uṇādi affix; by whom or which sight, &c. is enjoyed.
19551: दृशि f. (-शिः or शी) The eye. 2 A Śāstra. E. दृश to see, affix कि, ङीष् is optionally added.
19552: दृशोपम n. (-मं) The white lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.) E. दृशा the eye, उपमा resemblance; what resembles the eye.
19553: दृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 Visible, to be seen. 2 Beautiful, pleasing. m. (-श्यः) (In Arithmetic,) A given quantity or number. E. दृश to see, यत् aff.
19554: दृश्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Vision, sight. E. त्व added to the last.
19555: दृषद् f. (-षद् or षत्) 1 A stone or rock. 2 A flat stone or plate on which spices, &c. are ground. E. दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix अदि, and षुक् augment; also दृशद्.
19556: दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seen, visible, apparent. n. (-ष्टं) Obvious danger or calamity. E. दृश to see, affix क्त.
19557: दृष्टकूट n. (-टं) A riddle, an enigma. E. दृष्ट seen, कूट trick.
19558: दृष्टदोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Found out, exposed, detected. E. दृष्ट, and दोष fault.
19559: दृष्टरजस् f. (-जाः) A girl arrived at puberty. E. दृष्ट seen, (by whom,) and रजस् the menstrual discharge.
19560: दृष्टवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Seeing, beholding, having seen. E. दृश to see, क्तवतु aff.
19561: दृष्टान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A science, a Śāstra. 2 An example, an illustration. 3 Death, dying. E. दृष्ट obvious or seen, and अन्त end.
19562: दृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 The eye. 2 Sight, seeing. 3 Knowledge, wisdom. 4 The sight of the eye, the pupil. 5 Aspect, (of the stars.) E. दृश to see, affix क्तिन्.
19563: दृष्टिकृत् n. (-कृत्) A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. दृष्टि the eye, कृ to make, here meaning resemble; affix क्विप् and तुक् added; also with क्त affix दृष्टिकृत n. (-तं.)
19564: दृष्टिगुण m. (-णः) A butt, a mark for archers, &c. E. दृष्टि the eye, and गुण object.
19565: दृष्टिनिपात m. (-तः) A look, a look at or on. E. दृष्टि, and निपात alighting.
19566: दृष्टिपात m. (-तः) A look, a glance. E. दृष्टि, and पात falling.
19567: दृष्टिपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kept pure by the sight, i. E. watched, that no impropriety is committed, or impurity contracted. E. दृष्टि, and पूत purified.
19568: दृष्टिबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fire-fly. E. दृष्टि sight, and बन्धु a friend.
19569: दृष्टिविक्षेप m. (-पः) A leer, a side glance. E. दृष्टि the eye, विक्षेप casting.
19570: दृष्टिविष m. (-षः) A snake. E. दृष्टि, and विष poison, venomous in his look.
19571: दृष्ट्वा ind. Having seen. E. दृश to see, क्त्वा aff.
19572: दृह r. 1st cl. (दर्हति) also (इ) दृहि r. 1st cl. (दृंहति) To grow, to increase, to prosper.
19573: दृहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased, thriven. E. दृह to grow, affix क्त with इट् inserted; also from दृहि, दृहित.
19574: दॄ r. 9th cl. (दृणाति) To tear, to rend, to divide or pull to pieces. r. 1st cl. (दरति) To fear, to dread.
19575: दे (ङ) देङ् r. 1st cl. (दयते) To preserve, to cherish or protect.
19576: देदीप्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining repeatedly or intensely, glowing, blazing. E. दीप to kindle, intens. form, शानच् aff.
19577: देय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be given, fit or proper for a gift. E. दा to give, यत् affix, and the vowel changed.
19578: देव (ऋ) देष्ट r. 1st cl. (देवते) To sport or play.
19579: देव m. (-वः) 1 A deity, a god. 2 A king, in poetical language. 3 A husband's brother: see देवृ. 4 A cloud. 5 A fool, a dolt. 6 A child. 7 A man following any particular line or business. 8 A spear-man, a lancer. 9 Emulation, wish to excel or overcome. 10 Sport, play. 11 A term or surname applicable to a Brahman; also to a man of the Kayeth class. n. (-वं) An organ of sense. f. (-वा) 1 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis). 2 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) f. (-वी) 1 A goddess, the wife of any deity or divine being. 2 A name very commonly applied to the goddess DURGĀ. 3 A queen, one who has been consecrated as well as the king, (in theatrical language chiefly.) 4 A respectful epithet or title applied to a woman of the first class. 5 Worship, reverence. 6 A plant, (Trigonella corniculata:) 7 Another plant: see मूर्व्वा. E. दिव to play, (in heaven, &c.) affix अच्, fem. affix टाप् and ङीष्.
19580: देवक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Who or what sports or plays. 2 Divine, celestial, like a deity. m. (-कः) A proper name, the maternal grandfather of KṚṢṆA. E. दिव to play, ण्वुल् affix; or देव, and कन् aff.
19581: देवकर्द्दम m. (-मः) A fragrant paste of sandal, agallochum, camphor, and safflower. E. देव, and कर्द्दम mud.
19582: देवकात्मजा f. (-जा) The mother of KṚṢṆA. E. देवक as above, and आत्मजा daughter.
19583: देवकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Worship of, or oblations to the gods. E. देव, and कार्य्य business.
19584: देवकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A kind of pine: (Pinus devadaru.) E. देव divine, and काष्ठ wood.
19585: देवकिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.
19586: देवकी f. (-की) DEVAKĪ, the daughter of DEVAKA, wife of VASUDEVA, and mother of KṚṢṆA. E. देवक, अञ् patronymick affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with the vowel changed by the affix, दैवकी.
19587: देवकीनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. देवकी as above, and नन्दन a son.
19588: देवकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divine, belonging or relating to a divinity. E. देव, and छ aff.
19589: देवकीसूनु m. (-नुः) The deity KṚṢṆA. E. देवकी as above, and सूनु a son; also similar compounds, as देवकीनन्दन, and देवकीपुत्र.
19590: देवकुण्ड n. (ण्डं) A natural spring. E. देव, and कुण्ड a well.
19591: देवकुल n. (-लं) A temple. E. देव a god, and कुल a house.
19592: देवकुसुम n. (-मं) Cloves. E. देव a deity, and कुसुम a flower; fit for a deity.
19593: देवखात mfn. (-तं) 1 A cave or hollow among mountains. 2 A natural pond or reservoir. E. देव a deity, and खात dug; not the work of men.
19594: देवखातक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A natural pond or one in front of a temple. 2 A natural cavern, a grotto. E. देव a deity, खात dug, and कन् affix; dug by divine hands, or in honour of a god.
19595: देवखातविल n. (-लं) A cavern, a chasm. E. देवखात, and विल a hole.
19596: देवगान्धारी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the modes of music.
19597: देवगायन m. (-नः) A Gandharba, a celestial quirister. E. देव a god, and गायन a singer.
19598: देवगिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of music.
19599: देवगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. देव, and गुरु teacher; the preceptor of the gods.
19600: देवगृह n. (-हं) 1 A celestial or planetary sphere, the dwelling of the gods. 2 A temple. E. देब, and गृह house.
19601: देवचिकित्सक m. du. (-कौ) The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of heaven. E. देव a god, and चिकित्सक a physician.
19602: देवच्छन्द m. (-न्दः) A garland or necklace of pearls, &c. composed of 100 or 103 strings. E. देव a deity, and छदि to cover, affix घञ्.
19603: देवजग्ध n. (-ग्धं) A fragrant grass. E. देव a deity, and जग्ध eaten.
19604: देवजग्धक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass. E. कन् pleonastic, added to the preceding.
19605: देवट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) An artist, an artisan. E. दिव to sport, अटन् Uṇādi aff.
19606: देवट्टी f. (-ट्टी) A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.)
19607: देवतरु m. (-रुः) The holy fig tree. 2 A tree of Svarga or paradise, the Mandāra tree. 3 The tree of plenty. 4 Any venerable and ancient tree; usually the place of assembling in a village. E. देव a deity, and तरु a tree.
19608: देवता f. (-ता) 1 A god, a deity or divine being. 2 Divinity: see देवत्व. E. देव divine, तल् affix of the abstract: in the first case, अन् added; of whom the attribute is divinity.
19609: देवतागार m. (-रः) A temple. E. देवता, and आगार a house.
19610: देवताड m. (-डः) 1 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 2 A name of Rāhu, the personified ascending node. 3 A name of fire. 4 A sort of creeper: see घोषक. E. देव a deity, &c. तड to torment, affix अण्.
19611: देवताडक m. (-कः) A grass: see the preceding. E. कन् added to देवताड.
19612: देवताधिप m. (-पः) A name of INDRA. E. देवता a deity, अधिप ruler or chief.
19613: देवताभ्यर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping an idol. E. देवता, and अभ्यर्च्चन worshipping.
19614: देवतायतन n. (-नं) A temple. E. देवता, and आयतन dwelling.
19615: देवतीर्थ n. (-र्थं) The part of the hand sacred to the gods, the tips of the fingers. E. देव, and तीर्थ a shrine.
19616: देवत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Divinity, the abstract attribute of divine being. 2 Identification with a deity, deification. E. देव a deity, and त्व abstract affix; also with तल्, देवता.
19617: देवदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given by the gods, god-given. m. (-त्तः) 1 The younger brother of the legislator Buddha. 2 The conch of ARJUNA. 3 One of the vital airs, that which is exhaled in yawning. E. देव a deity, and दत्त given; the name is often used in grammatical and other examples, in the place of some one, a certain person, &c.
19618: देवदत्ताग्रज m. (-जः) A name of Buddha. E. देवदत्त as above, and अग्रज elder born.
19619: देवदानी f. (-नी) A sort of creeper, commonly Hātīghoṣa. E. देव a deity, and दान a gift, fem. affix ङीप्.
19620: देवदारु mn. (-रुः-रु) A species of pine, (Pinus devadaru;) in Bengal it is usually applied to the Uvaria longifolia, and in the Peninsula to another tree, (Erythroxylon sideroxylloides.) E. देव a deity, and दारु timber.
19621: देवदासी f. (-सी) A courtezan, especially one employed as a dancer, &c. in a temple. E. देव a deity, and दासी a female slave.
19622: देवदीप m. (-पः) An eye. E. देव an organ of sense, and दीप a lamp.
19623: देवदूती f. (-ती) 1 A female messenger of the gods. 2 A sort of plant; also मधुकुक्कुटी. E. देव, and दूती a messenger.
19624: देवदेव m. (-वः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A name of ŚIVA. E. देव god, repeated; god of gods.
19625: देवद्रोणी f. (-णी) The procession of a deity or idol. E. देव a deity, द्रुण to go, affixes घञ् and ङीप्.
19626: देवद्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Approaching or adoring a deity. E. देव an idol, अञ्च to go to or to worship, affix क्विप्, and द्रि inserted.
19627: देवधान्य n. (-न्यं) A sort of grain cultivated in many parts of Hindūstan, (Andropogon saccharatus.) E. देव a deity, and धान्य corn.
19628: देवधूप m. (-पः) A fragrant resin, (Bdellium,) used in the incense. E. देव a deity, and धूप incense.
19629: देवन् m. (-वा) A husband's brother. E. दिव to play, अन् Uṇādi aff.
19630: देवन n. (-नं) 1 Sport, play, pastime, &c. 2 Emulation, desire to excel or overcome. 3 Affair, business, profession. 4 Gaming. 5 Splendour, lustre, beauty. 6 Light. 7 Praise. 8 Motion. 9 Grief, sorrow. 10 A garden, a play or pleasure ground. 11 A  lotus. m. (-नः) A die or dice. f. (-ना) 1 Service. 2 Sport, wanton sport or pastime. E. दिव to play, &c. affix ल्युट्, or युच्, fem. टाप्.
19631: देवनन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) One of INDRA'S doorkeepers. E. देव a deity, and नन्दिन् who pleases.
19632: देवनल m. (-लः) A kind of reed, (Arundo bengalensis.) E. देव, and नल a reed; also read देवानल.
19634: देवनिकाय m. (-यः) A heaven, a paradise, the residence of a divinity. E. देव, and निकाय abode.
19635: देवनिन्दक m. (-कः) A heretic, an unbeliever, a reviler of the gods. E. देव, and निन्दक a calumniator.
19636: देवनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Heresy, atheism. E. देव, and निन्दा abuse.
19637: देवनिर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Natural, created. E. देव, and निर्म्मित made by.
19638: देवपति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA. E. देव a deity, and पति master.
19639: देवपत्नी f. (-त्नी) 1 The wife of a deity. 2 Sweet potatoe. E. देव a deity, &c. and पत्नी wife.
19640: देवपथ m. (-थः) Heaven, the firmament, the celestial path or way. E. देव a deity, and पथिन् a road, final affix अ.
19641: देवपद n. (-दं) The royal presence. E. देव, and पद for पाद a foot; also देवपाद.
19642: देवपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Addicted to play. 2 Future, what will be, (predestined, &c.) see दैवपर.
19643: देवपशु m. (-शुः) An animal consecrated to a deity. E. देव, and पशु an animal.
19644: देवपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) A medicinal plant: see पृक्का. E. देव a deity, and पुत्त्री a daughter.
19645: देवपुर् f. (-पुः) The capital of INDRA. E. देव a god, and पुर् a city.
19646: देवप्रतिमा f. (-मा) An idol. E. देव, and प्रतिमा image.
19647: देवप्रश्न n. (-श्नं) Astrology, consulting the stars or gods. E. देव a deity, and प्रश्न asking.
19648: देवबल्लभ m. (-भः) A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria, Rox.) see युन्नाग. E. देव a deity, and बल्लभ a friend.
19649: देवब्रह्मन् m. (-ह्मा) A name of the Muni NĀRADA. E. देव a deity, ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ; BRAHMĀ amongst the saints and demigods.
19650: देवब्राह्मण m. (-णः) A venerable Brahman, one esteemed by the deities. E. देव, and ब्राह्मण a Brahman.
19651: देवभवन n. (-नं) 1 The holy fig tree. 2 Paradise. 3 A temple. E. देव a deity, and भवन a dwelling.
19652: देवभाज् mfn. (-क् or ग्) Belonging to a god. E. देव, and भाज् what has.
19653: देवभू m. (-भूः) 1 A deity. 2 Svarga or paradise. E. देव divine, and भू being.
19654: देवभूति f. (-तिः) The Ganges of heaven. E. देव a deity, and भूति being, abiding.
19655: देवभूय n. (-यं) 1 Divinity, godhead. 2 Inferior deification or identification with a deity. E. देव a deity, and भूय being, becoming.
19656: देवमञ्जर n. (-रं) The jewel of KṚṢṆA suspended on his breast.
19657: देवमणि m. (-णिः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The jewel of KṚṢṆA. 3 A twist of hair on a horse's neck. E. देव a deity, मणि a jewel.
19658: देवमातृ f. (-ता) A name of ADITI. E. दव, and मातृ a mother; the mother of gods.
19659: देवमातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Watered by rain, (corn, land, &c.) E. देव a cloud, मातृ a mother, and कप् affix; cherished by the clouds as by a parent.
19660: देवमानक m. (-कः) The jewel worn by KṚṢṆA: see कौस्तुभ. E. देव a deity, मान respect, affix कन्.
19661: देवमास m. (-सः) The eighth month of pregnancy; also देवमासक. E. देव divine, and मास a month.
19662: देवयज् m. (-यक्) A worshipper of the gods. E. देव, and यज् to worship, क्विप् aff.
19663: देवयजि m. (-जिः) 1 A worshipper of the gods. 2 A Muni. E. देव, and यजि who worships.
19664: देवयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The Homa or burnt sacrifice. E. देव, and यज्ञ sacrifice; the sacrifice appropriated to the gods.
19665: देवयात्रा f. (-त्रा) The procession of a deity or idol, or sacred festival when the images are carried in procession. E. देव a god, and यात्रा going.
19666: देवयान n. (-नं) The car or vehicle of a god. f. (-नी) The daughter of ŚUKRA. E. देव a deity, and यान going.
19667: देवयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Sporting, playing. E. देव to play, शतृ aff.
19668: देवयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) 1 Pious, righteous, virtuous. 2 Frequenting holy festivals. m. (-युः) A deity. E. देव a deity, या to go, Uṇādi affix कु.
19669: देवयोनि m. (-निः) A superhuman being, a demon or demigod. E. देव a deity, and योनि place of production.
19670: देवर m. (-रः) A husband's brother, especially his younger brother. E. दिव to play, &c. affix अर.
19671: देवरथ m. (-थः) The car or vehicle of a deity. E. देव a deity, and रथ a carriage.
19672: देवराज m. (-जः) INDRA. E. देव a deity, राजन् a king, and टच् aff.
19673: देवरात m. (-तः) 1 A sort of crane. 2 The name of a king; also Parikṣit.
19674: देवरूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Godlike, of divine form. E. देव, and रूप form, इनि aff.
19675: देवर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi, a saint of the celestial class, as NĀRADA, ATRI, MARĪCĪ, BHARADVĀJA, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, BHṚGU, VASIṢṬHA, PRACETAS; also BHĀRATA, TUMBURU, KAṆĀDA, and others. E. देव divine, and ऋषि a saint: see ऋषि, and राजर्षि.
19676: देवल m. (-लः) 1 An attendant upon an idol; a Brahman of an inferior order, who subsists upon the offerings made to the images which he attends, and who conducts the ceremonies of all sorts of people for hire. 2 A Muni; according to some authorities, a name of NĀRADA; to others, of a different saint, who is also a legislator, the son of ASITA and also named AṢṬAVAKRA. 3 A husband's brother: see देवर. 4 A holy or virtuous man. E. देव a deity, ला to bring, and क aff.
19677: देवलक m. (-कः) The attendant on an idol: see the preceding. E. कन् added to देवल.
19678: देवलता f. (-ता) Double jasmine. E. देव divine, and लता a creeper.
19679: देवलोक m. (-कः) 1 Heaven or paradise. 2 Any one of the seven superior worlds, from earth to the highest or Satya loka, in  opposition to those below the earth. 8 The particular sphere or heaven of any divinity. E. देव, and लोक a world.
19680: देववक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) Fire or its deity AGNI. E. देव a deity, and वक्त्र a face, here implying, mouth; the mouth of the gods, eating or consuming the oblations made to them.
19681: देववल्लभ m. (-भः) A tree: see पुन्नाग.
19682: देववर m. (-रः) A superior or supreme deity. n. (-रं) A divine boon or blessing. E. देव, and वर best.
19683: देववर्द्धकि m. (-किः) A name of VIŚVAKARMĀ, the divine architect. E. देव a deity, वर्द्धकि a carpenter.
19684: देववृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 2 A tree of heaven or paradise. 3 A plant yielding a fragrant resin, (Bdellium.) E. देव a god, वृक्ष a tree.
19685: देवव्रत m. (-तः) 1 A worshipper of the gods. 2 A name of BHĪṢMA. n. (-तं) Any obligation or vow of a deity. E. देव a deity, and व्रत religious obligation.
19686: देवश्रुत m. (-तः) 1 A god. 2 A sacred treatise or branch of scripture. 3 A name of NĀRADA. E. देव divine, and श्रुत heard.
19687: देवसभा f. (-भा) An assembly of the gods. E. देव a deity, and सभा assembly.
19688: देवसभ्य m. (-भ्यः) 1 A player, a gambler, a frequenter of clubs or assemblies. 2 An attendant on a deity. E. देव sport in general, or gambling, सभा an assembly, and यत् aff.
19689: देवसन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Divine, relating to a deity. E. देव, and सन्ध connected.
19690: देवसहा f. (-हा) A small shrub: see सहदेवा. E. देव a deity, सह to bear, affix टाप् and अञ्.
19691: देवसात् ind. In or on a deity, becoming as a deity, appropriate or offered to one. E. देव, and साति aff.
19692: देवसायुजय n. (-ज्यं) 1 Inferior deification, the state or being of the inferior gods. 2 Absorption into or identification with a deity. E. देव a god, स with युज to join or be joined, affix क्विप्, देवसयुज् junction with a deity, ष्यञ् added, implying the state or condition.
19693: देवसृष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Spirituous liquor. E. देव, and सृष्ट created, made by the gods.
19694: देवसेना f. (-ना) 1 The daughter of INDRA. 2 An army or host of celestials. E. देव INDRA or any deity, and सेना an army.
19695: देवसेनापति m. (-तिः) A name of SKANDA. E. देवसेना as above, and पति ruler; commander of the hosts of heaven.
19696: देवस्व n. (-स्वं) The property applicable to religious purposes, endowments, &c. E. देव divine, and स्व wealth.
19697: देवाजीव m. (-वः) An attendant upon an idol, a low Brahman, subsisting by attendance upon an image, and upon the offerings made to it. E. देव a deity, and आजीव who gets a livelihood; also with इनि added देवजीविन् m. (-वी.)
19698: देवात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 1 One with or identified with a deity. 2 Belonging to a deity, consecrated, sacred. m. (-त्मा) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. देव, and आत्मन् the self or soul.
19699: देवानाम्प्रिय m. (-यः) 1 A goat. 2 An ascetic, one who relinquishes or abandons the world. 3 A fool, an ideot. E. देव in the second case plural, and प्रिय beloved; the beloved of the gods.
19700: देवान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice or food that has been first presented to an idol. E. देव, and अन्न food.
19701: देवापि m. (-पिः) The son of PRATĪPA, supposed to be still alive, near the Sumeru mountain.
19702: देवाभीष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sacred, dedicated to a deity. f. (-ष्टा) Betel, (Piper betel.) E. देव, and अभीष्ट wished.
19703: देवायतन n. (-नं) A temple. E. देव, and आयतन abode.
19704: देवायुध n. (-धं) The rainbow. E. देव, and आयुध a weapon.
19705: देवालय n. (-यं) 1 A division of heaven, the residence of the gods. 2 A temple. E. देव and आलय an asylum.
19706: देवाला f. (-ला) One of the female personifications of music. E. देव a deity, and अल adapted to, fem. affix टाप्.
19707: देवार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-हं) Divine, worthy of the gods. E. देव, and अर्ह fit for.
19708: देवावास m. (-सः) 1 A temple. 2 The holy fig tree. E. देव a deity, and आवास abode.
19709: देवाश्व m. (-श्वः) The horse of INDRA. E. देव a deity, and अश्व a horse.
19710: देविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Appertaining to or derived from a deity. E. देव, and ठच् affix; also देविय, and देविल.
19711: देविका f. (-का) The name of a river, the Sarju or Deva. E. देवी, and कन् affix, fem. form.
19712: देविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Virtuous, pious, just. 2 Appertaining to a deity: see देविक. E. देव, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
19714: देवीकोट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A town, the city of VĀṆA, probably DEVICOTTA, on the Coromandel coast. E. देवी a name of DURGĀ, and कोट्ट a house or abode.
19715: देवृ m. (-वा) 1 A husband's brother, but especially his younger brother. 2 The husband of a woman previously married. E. दिव to play, Uṇādi affix ऋण्.
19716: देवेज्य m. (-ज्यः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. देव a deity, and इज्य a teacher, the Guru or spiritual preceptor of the gods.
19717: देवेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Acceptable to the gods, wished for by them. E. देव, and इष्ट wished.
19718: देवोद्यान n. (-नं) A sacred grove, one near a temple or consecrated to a deity. E. देव a deity, and उद्यान a garden.
19719: देश m. (-शः) 1 A country, a region, whether inhabited or uninhabited. 2 A part, a portion. 3 Institute, ordinance. E. दिश to point, to show, affix घञ्.
19720: देशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what shows, points out, describes, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A ruler, a governor. 2 A guide. 3 An instructor. E. दिश to command, affix ण्वुल्.
19721: देशकारी f. (-री) A mode of music, a Rāgiṇī.
19722: देशकालविद् mfn. (-विद्) Knowing what is suited to time and place. E. देश, काल time, and विद् who knows.
19723: देशकालव्यवस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Regulated by time and place. E. देश, काल time, व्यवस्थित determined.
19724: देशदृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Considered locally, judged as to place. E. देश, and दृष्ट seen.
19725: देशधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Local law, the law or usage of the country. E. देश, and धर्म्म moral merit.
19726: देशरूप n. (-पं) Propriety, fitness. R. देश ordinance, रूप form, essence.
19727: देशव्यवहार m. (-रः) Local usage, custom of the country. E. देश, and व्यवहार practice.
19728: देशान्तर n. (-रः) 1 A foreign country. 2 Longitude or difference of longitude. E. देश, and अन्तर different.
19729: देशापेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Spying, searching out a land. E. देश, and अपेक्ष who inspects.
19730: देशिक m. (-कः) 1 A traveller, a stranger, a sojourner. 2 A Guru or spiritual teacher. E. देश a country, &c. ठक् aff.
19731: देशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Directed, commanded. 2 Shown. 3 Advised, instructed. E. दिश to show, and क्त affix, with इट् inserted.
19732: देशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 Of or belonging to a country. 2 Showing, instructing, guiding. f. (-नी) The index or forefinger. E. दिश to show, affix णिनि or देश, and इनि aff.
19733: देश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 What is proper to be proved or ordered. 2 Local. 3 Present at any transaction, on the spot. n. (-श्यं) 1 The postulate, the statement or exhibition of a question or argument. 2 The fact or charge to be proved or substantiated. m. (-श्यः) An eyewitness of any thing, one who was on the spot. E. दिश to show or command, affix ण्यत्; or देश, and यत् aff.
19734: देष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Difficult of subjection, untameable, intractable, ungovernable. 2 Liberal in giving, a donor. m. (-ष्णुः) A washerman. E. दा to give, &c. इष्णुच् Uṇādi aff.
19735: देह mn. (-हः-हं) The body. E. दिह to collect together, affix घञ्.
19736: देहकोष m. (-षः) 1 The skin. 2 A feather, a wing. E. देह body, and कोष a sheath or covering.
19737: देहक्षय m. (-यः) Disease, sickness. E. देह the body, and क्षय a wasting.
19738: देहच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Separated or detached from the body, (as excrement or the spirit, &c.) E. देह, and च्युत fallen.
19739: देहत्याग m. (-गः) 1 Voluntary death. 2 Death in general. E. देह, and त्याग leaving.
19740: देहद m. (-दः) Quicksilver. E. देह, and द what gives.
19741: देहधारक n. (-कं) A bone. E. देह the body, and धारक sustainer.
19742: देहधि m. (-धिः) A wing. E. देह the body, धा to have, and कि aff.
19743: देहधृज् m. (-धृक्) Air, wind. E. देह the body, धृज् to pervade, क्विप् aff.
19744: देहभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Living, being. 2 Embodied, corporeal. m. (-त्) Life, vitality. E. देह the body, भृत् what has or supports.
19745: देहयात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Death, dying. 2 Food. E. देह the body, यात्रा proceeding, (to or by which.)
19746: देहला f. (-ला) Spirituous liquor. E. देह the body, ला to seize, affix उ, and टाप्.
19747: देहलि f. (-लिः or ली) 1 The threshold of a door, the lower part of the wooden frame of a door, or a raised terrace in front of it. E. देह here said to imply plastering of cow-dung, &c. ला to have or get, affix कि or क, and ङीष्.
19748: देहसार m. (-रः) Marrow. E. देह, and सार essence.
19749: देहवत् mfn. (वान्-वती-वत्) Corporeal, inhabiting a body. E. देह, and मतुप् aff.
19750: देहात्मवादिन् m. (-दी) A Cārvāka, a materialist. E. देह, and आत्मन् the soul, and वादिन् who maintains; asserting that the body and soul are one.
19751: देहावरण n. (-णं) 1 Armour. 2 Dress. E. देह, and आवरण screening.
19752: देहिका f. (-ला) A sort of insect, (a flea.) E. देह the body, affix ठन्, and टाप्.
19753: देहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Corporeal, embodied, having body. 2 Living, a living being. m. (-ही) The spirit. E. देह, and हनि aff.
19754: दै (प) दैप् r. 1st cl. (दायति) To purify or cleanse.
19755: दैतेय m. (-यः) A demon, an Asura, the Titan or giant of Hindu mythology. E. दिति the mother of the giants, and ढक् affix of descent.
19756: दैत्य m. (-त्यः) A Daitya or demon: see the preceding. f. (-त्या) 1 A perfume, commonly Mura. 2 A drug: see चण्डा. 3 Spirituous liquor. 4 The wife of a demon. E. दिति, and ण्य aff.
19757: दैत्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of ŚUKRA, regent of Venus. E. दैत्य and गुरु a teacher; the spiritual preceptor of the Daityas, or Titans.
19758: दैत्यदेव m. (-वः) 1 A name of VARUṆA, deity of the waters. 2 Air or wind personified. E. दैत्य a demon, and देव a god.
19759: दैत्यपुरोधस् m. (-धाः) A name of ŚUKRA. E. दैत्य, and पुरोधस् a family priest: see दैत्यगुरु.
19760: दैत्यपुरोहित m. (-तः) A name of ŚUKRA, regent of Venus. E. दैत्य, and पुरोहित a family priest.
19761: दैत्यमातृ f. (-ता) A name of DITI, the mother of the Titanic race of Daityas. E. दैत्य, and मातृ a mother.
19762: दैत्यमेदजा f. (-जा) The earth. E. दैत्य, मेद marrow, ज born.
19763: दैत्ययुग m. (-गः) An age of the demons, consisting of 12,000 divine years, or the sum of the four Yugas or ages of men. E. दैत्य a demon, and युग an age.
19764: दैत्यारि m. (-रिः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A deity in general. E. दैत्य, and अरि a foe; the enemy of the Daityas.
19765: दैत्याहोरात्र m. (-त्रः) A day and night or the demons, being a year of mortals. E. दैत्य a demon, अहन् a day, and रात्रि a night.
19766: दैन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Diurnal, daily, relating to a day. n. (-नं) Poverty, wretchedness. E. दीन or दिन, and अण् aff.
19767: दैनन्दिन mfn. (-तः-नी-नं) Diurnal, quotidian. E. दिनदिन day by day, अण् aff.
19768: दैनन्दिनप्रलय m. (-यः) Destruction of the world after fifteen years of BRAHMĀ'S age. E. दैनन्दिन, and प्रलय destruction.
19769: दैनार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Bought with a Dinar, of the value of one, &c. E. दीनार, and अण् aff.
19770: दैनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Dirunal, of or relating to a day. f. (-की) A day's hire or wages. E. दिन a day, affix ठक्.
19771: दैन्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Meanness, covetousness. 2 Poverty, humbleness. E. दीन a pauper, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
19772: दैप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Relating or belonging to a lamp. E. दीप, and अण् aff.
19773: दैर्घ्य n. (-र्ध्यं) Length. E. दीर्घ long, ष्यञ् aff.
19774: दैव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of or relating to divinity or a deity, divine, celestial, &c. mn. (-वः-वं) Destiny, fate, fortune. n. (-वं) 1 The part of the hand sacred to the gods; the tips of the fingers, (some exclude the thumbs.) 2 One of the forms of marriage; the gift of a daughter at a sacrifice to the officiating priest. f. (-वी) A division of medicine, the medical use of charms, prayers, &c. E. देव a deity, and अञ् affix of reference or relation.
19775: दैवकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Burnt-offering, oblations to the gods. E. दैव, and कर्म्म rite.
19776: दैवकी f. (-की) The mother of KṚṢṆA. E. देवक father of the lady, affix of descent अण्, fem. affix ङीष्: see देवकी.
19777: दैवकीनन्दन m. (-नः) KṚṢṆA. E. दैवकी as above, नन्दन a son; also देवकीनन्दन.
19778: दैवकोविद mf. (-दः-दा) A conjuror or fortune-teller. E. दैव fortune, and कोविद skilful.
19779: दैवचिन्तक m. (-कः) A fatalist. E. दैव, and चिन्तक who thinks of.
19780: दैवचिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Fatalism, reliance on fate. E. दैव, and चिन्ता thinking; also दैवचिन्तनं.
19781: दैवज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Prophetic, foretelling, acquainted with fate. m. (-ज्ञः) An astrologer. f. (-ज्ञा) A female fortune-teller. E. दैव, and ज्ञ who knows.
19782: दैवत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) 1 Of or relating to a god. mn. (-तः-तं) 1 A god, a deity. 2 An idol. n. (-तं) A number of gods. E. देवता a deity, अण् pleonastick or referential affix.
19783: दैवदीप m. (-पः) 1 The eye. 2 A heavenly lamp. E. दैव, and दीप a lamp.
19784: दैवदुर्विपाक m. (-कः) Hardness of fortune, unpropitiousness of fate. E. दैव, and दुर्विपाक unfavourableness.
19785: दैवपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Fated, willed, predestined. 2 Trusting to fate, a fatalist. E. दैव fate, &c. पर after, according to.
19786: दैवप्रश्न m. (-श्नः) Astrology, fortune-telling. E. दैव fate, &c. प्रश्न asking.
19787: दैवयुग m. (-गः) An age of the gods or immortals: see दैत्ययुग.
19788: दैवयोग m. (-गः) The occurrence of any unforeseen event, the intervention of destiny. E. दैव, and योग juncture.
19789: दैवलक m. (-कः) The servant or worshipper of an evil spirit.
19790: दैवलेखक m. (-कः) An astrologer, a fortune-teller. E. दैव fate, लिख to write, ण्वुल् aff.
19791: दैववाणी f. (-णी) A voice from heaven. E. दैव, and वाणी speech.
19792: दैवाकरि m. (-रिः) 1 YAMA. 2 SATURN. f. (-री) YAMUNĀ. E. दिवाकर the sun, and इञ patron. aff.
19793: दैवात् ind. By chance, by accident, unavoidably, fatally. E. the 5th case of दैव used as a particle.
19794: दैवानुरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Subject or obedient to the gods. E. दैव divine (will), अनुरोधिन् assenting to.
19795: दैवायत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Dependant upon destiny. E. दैव, and आयत्त subject to.
19796: दैवासुर n. (-रं) The natural enmity between the gods and Asuras. E. देव, and असुर, with अण् added in this sense.
19797: दैवाहोरात्र m. (-त्रः) A day of the gods, the human year: see दैत्याहोरात्र.
19798: दैविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to the gods, divine, deific, &c. E. देव a deity, and ठञ् aff.
19799: दैवोढा f. (-ढा) A woman married according to the Daiva ritual, E. दैव, and ऊढा married.
19800: दैवोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill-fated, unfortunate, unlucky. E. दैव, and उपहत struck by; also with कन्, दैवोपहतकः.
19801: दैव्य n. (-व्यं) Fate, fortune. E. देव a deity, and यञ् affix: see दैव.
19802: दैशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Provincial, national, belonging to a country, produced in it, &c. E. देश, and ठञ् aff.
19803: दैष्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fated, predestined. m. (-कः) A predestinarian, a fatalist. E. दिष्ट fate, affix ठञ्.
19804: दैष्टिकता f. (-ता) Fatalism, predestinarianism. E. तल् added to दैष्टिक; also with त्व, दैष्टिकत्वं.
19805: दैहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Corporeal, bodily. E. देहिक, and अण् added.
19806: दो r. 4th cl. (द्यति) To cut, to divide: अव is usually prefixed.
19808: दोःशिखर n. (-रं) The shoulder. E. दोस्, and शिखर crest.
19809: दोःसहस्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) The name of a king, also called KĀRTAVĪRYA. E. दोस् an arm, महस्र a thousand, and भृत् possessing; having a thousand arms.
19810: दोग्धृ mfn. (-ग्धा-ग्ध्री-ग्धृ) 1 A milker, who or what milks. 2 What yields milk. m. (-ग्धा) 1 A poet, a panegyrist, one who writes verses for hire or reward. 2 A calf. 3 A cowherd. f. (-ग्ध्री) A cow. E. दुह to milk, तृच् aff.
19811: दोदुल्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Swinging or being swung repeatedly or violently. E. दुल to swing, intens. form, शानच् aff.
19812: दोध m. (-धः) A calf. E. दुह to milk, घञ् affix, deriv. irr.
19813: दोधक n. (-कं) A form of metre.
19814: दोधूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shaking or trembling violently. E. धू to shake, intens. form, शानच् aff.
19815: दोरक mf. (-रकः-रिका) A string for fastening the wires of a lute.
19816: दोर्गडु mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु) Crooked-armed, having a crippled or crooked arm. E. दोस् an arm, and गडु a cripple.
19817: दोर्ग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Strong, powerful. m. (-हः) Pain in the arm. E. दोस् an arm, and ग्रह who takes or uses.
19818: दोर्दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The arm. E. दोस्, and दण्ड a stick.
19819: दोर्मध्य n. (-ध्यं) The middle of the arm. E. दोस् the arm, and मध्य the centre.
19820: दोर्मूल n. (-लं) The armpit. E. दोस् the arm, and मूल the root.
19821: दोल m. (-लः) 1 Swinging. 2 A festival on the 14th of Phalguna, the swinging of the juvenile KṚṢṆA. mf. (-लः-ला or ली) 1 A litter, a swinging cot, a dooly. 2 A swing. f. (-ला) The indigo plant. E. दुल to throw up or toss, to swing, affix अच्; fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
19822: दोलायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Swinging, being swung. 2 Doubting, perplexed, vacillating. E. दुल to swing, causal form, शानच् aff.
19823: दोलिका f. (-का) A swing. E. कन् added to दोली.
19824: दोष m. (-षः) 1 Fault, defect, blemish. 2 Sin, offence, transgression. 3 Disorder of the humours of the body, or defect in the functions of bile, circulation, or wind. 4 A calf. E. दुष to be defective, affix घञ्.
19825: दोषक m. (-कः) A calf. E. कन् added to दोष.
19826: दोषकल्पन n. (-नं) Reprehending, condemning. E. दोष, and कल्पन attributing.
19827: दोषग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Malicious, malignant, censorious. E. दोष a fault, ग्रह to take, affix णिनि.
19828: दोषज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing faults, &c. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A Paṇḍita, a teacher, a sage. 2 A physician. E. दोष fault, defect, and ज्ञ who knows.
19829: दोषत्रय n. (-यं) 1 Vitiation of the three humours, bile, wind, and phlegm. 2 Any combination of three defects. E. दोष, and त्रय triad.
19830: दोषप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Censure, condemnation. E. दोष, and प्रसङ्ग attribution.
19831: दोषभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Wrong, faulty, doing wrong, being defective or to blame. E. दोष, and भाज् who or what shares.
19832: दोषवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Faulty, defective. 2 Wicked. E. दोष, and मतुप् aff.
19833: दोषा f. (-षा) 1 Night. 2 The arm. ind. (-षा) 1 By night, at night. 2 At the beginning of the night. E. दम to tame, डोस् affix, and टाप् added.
19834: दोषाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Defective, faulty. m. (-रः) The moon. E. दोषा night, and कर a ray; or दोष, and आकर a mine.
19835: दोषातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Nocturnal, by night. E. दोषा by night, द्यु aff.
19836: दोषातिलक m. (-कः) A lamp. E. दोषा night, and तिलक excellence.
19837: दोषास्य m. (-स्यः) A lamp. E. दोषा night, and आस्य a face.
19838: दोषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Faulty, defective, bad. m. (कः) Sickness, disease. E. दोष defect, ठक् aff.
19839: दोषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) 1 Faulty, defective. 2 Wicked, bad. E. टुष to be defective, affix घिनुण्.
19840: दोषैकदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Malevolent, censorious, discovering defects only. E. दोष a fault, एक one, alone, and दृश् seeing.
19841: दोस् m. (-दोः) 1 The arm. 2 The side of a triangle, or square, &c. E. दम to subdue, affix डोम्.
19842: दोस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Worn, &c. on the arms. E. दोस् the arm, क aff.
19843: दोस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Placed on the arm. m. (-स्थः) 1 Play, sport. 2 A player, one who sports or plays. 3 Service. 4 A servant. E. दु bad, स्था to stay, ड affix दुस्थ, अण् added.
19844: दोह m. (-हः) 1 A milk-pail. 2 Milk. 3 Milking. 4 Satisfaction, success. E. दुह to milk, &c. affix घञ्.
19845: दोहज n. (-जं) Milk. E. दोह milking, and ज produced.
19846: दोहडिका f. (-का) The Prākṛta metre, commonly Doha; a stanza of four lines, containing thirteen and eleven syllabic instants alternately.
19847: दोहद n. (-दं) 1 Wish, desire. 2 The longing of a pregnant woman, especially as a sign of impregnation. E. दोह here said to mean satisfaction, and द what gives.
19848: दोहदलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 The fœtus, the embryo, sometimes confounded with the womb. 2 The period of passing from one season of life to another, as from childhood to youth, from youth to manhood. E. दोहद longing, and लक्षण a sign.
19849: दोहदवती f. (-ती) A pregnant woman longing for any thing. E. दोहद as above, मतुप् aff.
19850: दोहदान्विता f. (-ता) A pregnant woman longing for any thing. E. दोहद as above, and अन्वित attached or become inherent.
19851: दोहन nf. (-नं-नी) A milk vessel, a milk pail. n. (-नं) Milking. E. दुह to milk, affix ल्युट्.
19852: दोहल m. (-लः) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Longing. f. (-ली) The Asoka tree. E. दोह satisfaction, and ल what gets: see दोहद.
19853: दोहलवती f. (-ती) A pregnant woman longing for any thing: see दोहदवती.
19854: दोहापनय m. (-यः) Milk. E. दोह milking, अप below, णी to bring, affix अप्.
19855: दोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Milking, a milker. E. दुह to milk, घिनुण् aff.
19856: दोहीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Yielding a great abundance of milk. E. दोह milk, ईयसुन् aff.
19857: दोह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be milked, milkable. E. दुह to milk, ण्यत् affix; also दुह्य.
19858: दौःसाधिक m. (-कः) 1 A sort of head borough or beadle, the superintendent of a village. 2 A doorkeeper, a warder, a porter. E. दुर् bad, difficult, साध to accomplish, affix ठञ्.
19859: दौकूल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Covered with silk, (a car, &c.) E. दुकूल wove silk, affix अण्.
19860: दौत्य n. (-त्यं) An embassy or message. E. टूत a messenger, affix ष्यञ्: see दूत्य.
19861: दौरात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) Wickedness, depravity. E. दुरात्मन् wicked, ष्यञ् aff.
19862: दौर्गन्धि n. (-न्धिः) Fœtor, bad smell. E. दुर्गन्ध ill smelling, and इञ् aff.
19863: दौर्ग्य n. (-ग्यं) Difficulty, inaccessibility. E. दुर्ग, and ष्यञ् aff.
19864: दौर्जन्य n. (-न्यं) Wickedness, depravity, vileness. E. दुर्ज्जन, and ष्यञ् aff.
19865: दौर्ब्बल्य n. (-ल्यं) Weakness, debility. E. दुर्ब्वल, and ष्यञ् aff.
19866: दौर्भागिणेय m. (-यः) The son of a woman disliked by her husband. f. (-यी) The daughter of such a woman. E. दर्मगा such a woman, ढक् affix and इनङ् augment.
19867: दौर्भाग्य n. (-ग्यं) Ill luck, misfortune. E. दुर bad, भाग portion, यञ् aff.
19868: दौर्मनस्य n. (-स्यं) 1 Evil disposition or thought. 2 Despair. 3 Affliction, distress. E. दुर्मनस्, and ष्यञ् aff.
19869: दौर्वीण n. (-णं) 1 The sap or juice of bent grass. 2 A clean leaf. E. दूर्ब्बा bent grass, and खञ् aff.
19870: दौर्हृद n. (-दं) Wish, desire, but especially the longing of pregnant women. E. दुर् pained, हृद the heart, affix अञ्.
19871: दौलेय m. (-यः) A turtle or tortoise. E. दूली a female tortoise, affix ढक्.
19872: दौल्मि m. (-ल्मिः) A name of INDRA.
19873: दौवारिक m. (-कः) A warder, a porter. E. दु bad, वार impediment, and ठक् aff.
19874: दौश्चर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) Paraphymosis, circumcision. E. दुश्चर्म्म, and ष्यञ् aff.
19875: दौष्कुलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sprung of a bad or low family or race. E. दुष्कुल of a bad race, affix ढक्; also दुष्कुलीन.
19876: दौष्ठव n. (-वं) Badness, wickedness. E. दुष्ठ, and अण् aff.
19877: दौष्मन्ति m. (-न्तिः) A name of BHARAT, the first sole monarch of India. E. दुष्मन्त DUṢMANTA, husband of ŚAKUNTALĀ, and father to BHARATA, इञ् affix of descent; it is perhaps preferably read दौष्यन्ति from दुष्यन्त.
19878: दौहित्र m. (-त्रः) A daughter's son. f. (-त्री) A daughter's daughter. E. दुहितृ a daughter, affix अण्.
19879: द्यावाक्षमा f. always dual, (-मे) Heaven and earth. E. द्यौ heaven, क्षमा the earth, form irr.; also similar compounds, as द्यावापृथिवी, द्यावाभूमी, &c.
19880: द्यावापृथिवी f. always dual, (-व्यौ) Heaven and earth. E. द्यौ heaven, and पृथिवी the earth: see the preceding.
19881: द्यावाभूमी f. always dual. (-म्यौ) Heaven and earth. E. द्यौ, and भूमी the earth: see the two words preceding.
19882: द्यु r. 2nd cl. (द्योति) 1 To advance towards or against, to assail. 2 To advance before or in front of, to approach.
19883: द्यु m. (द्युः) A name of AGNI or fire. n. (द्यु) 1 A day. 2 Heaven, sky, æther. 2 Heaven, paradise. E. द्यु to go to or towards, affix क्विप्.
19886: द्युग m. (-गः) A bird. E. द्यु, and ग who goes.
19887: द्युगण m. (-णः) A given term of days, as a month, &c. E. द्यु, and गण a number.
19889: द्युत् m. (द्युत्) A ray of light. E. द्युत to shine, affix क्विप्.
19890: द्युति f. (-तिः) 1 Light. 2 Beauty or splendour. 3 A ray of light. 4 Stimulating, exciting. E. द्युत to shine, affix कि.
19891: द्युतिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Shining, bright. 2 Handsome. m. (-रः) The polar star, or in mythology, the divine sage DHRUVA. E. द्युति light, and कर who makes.
19892: द्युतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enlightened, illuminated, &c. E. द्युत to shine, affix क्त; also with the vowel changed द्योतित.
19893: द्युतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Resplendent, bright. E. द्युति, and मतुप् aff.
19894: द्युतिला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.) E. द्युति beauty, and ला to possess, affix ड and टाप्.
19895: द्युनिवास m. (-सः) 1 Heavenly abode, heaven. 2 A deity. E. द्यु, and निवास abiding.
19896: द्युनिवासिन् m. (-सी) 1 A deity. 2 A pious person. E. द्यु, and निवासिन् who abides.
19897: द्युनिश n. (-शं) Day and night. E. द्यु a day, निशा night.
19898: द्युपति m. (-तिः) 1 The sun. 2 A name of INDRA. E. द्यु a day or paradise, and पति ruler.
19899: द्युमणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. द्यु a day, and मणि a gem.
19900: द्युमयी f. (-यी) The daughter of VIŚVAKARMA, and wife of the sun. E. द्यु a day, and मयट् affix of identity.
19901: द्युम्न n. (-म्नं) 1 Wealth, property, substance. 2 Strength, power. E. द्यु day, म्ना to remember or regard, affix क.
19902: द्युवन् m. (-वा) 1 The sun. 2 Heaven. E. द्यु to go, (through the heavens,) Uṇādi affix कनिन्.
19903: द्युषद् m. (-षद् or षत्) 1 A god, a deity. 2 A planet. E. द्यु heaven, षद to go, affix क्विप्; it is also written द्युषद्.
19904: द्यूत mn. (-तः-तं) Gaming, playing with dice, or any thing not possessing life. E. दिव to play, क्त aff.
19905: द्यूतकर m. (-रः) A gambler. E. द्यूत, and कर who practices.
19906: द्यूतकार m. (-रः) 1 The keeper of a gaming house. 2 A gambler. E. द्यूत gaming, and कार who practices; also with कन् added, द्यूतकारक.
19907: द्यूतकृत् m. (-कृत्) A gambler. E. द्यूत, and कृत् who practices: see the last.
19908: द्यूतपूर्णिमा f. (-मा) The day of full moon in the month Kārttika, (October-November,) the night of which is spent in games of chance, in honour of the goddess of fortune, LAKṢMĪ. E. द्यूत gaming, and पूर्णिमा day of full moon; also with अण् pleonastic affix added, and ङीष् fem. affix द्यूतपौर्णिमी, f. (-मी)
19909: द्यूतप्रतिपत् f. (-पत्) The first day of the moon's increase in Kartik, when BĀLĪ is to be venerated. E. द्यूत, and प्रतिपद् the first lunation.
19910: द्यूतवीज n. (-जं) A Cowri, a small shell used as a coin in most parts of India. E. द्यत gaming, and वीज seed.
19911: द्यूतवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A gambler. E. द्यूत, and वृत्ति subsistence.
19912: द्यूतसभा f. (-भा) A gaming house or assembly. E. द्यूत, and सभा an assembly.
19913: द्यूताधिकारिन् m. (-री) The keeper of a gaming house. E. द्यूत, and अधिकारिन् who superintends.
19914: द्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Playing, sportive. n. (-नं) The seventh sign of the zodiac, reckoning from that which the sun enters. E. दिव to play, &c. affix क्त.
19915: द्यै r. 1st cl. (द्यायति) To despise, to reprove, to treat or name with contempt.
19916: द्यै ind. Fie, for shame. E. द्यै, and क्विप् aff.
19917: द्यो f. (द्यौ) 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 Heaven, sky. E. दिव to sport, Uṇādi affix डो; where the gods, &c. sport.
19918: द्योत m. (-तः) Sunshine, light, lustre, heat. E. द्युत to shine, घञ् aff.
19919: द्योतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) Bright, shining. n. (-नं) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 Making manifest. 3 Illumination. 4 An illumination. m. (-नः) A lamp. E. द्यूत to shine, affix ल्युट् or युच्.
19920: द्योतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining, bright, radiant. E. द्युत to shine, शानच् aff.
19921: द्योतयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Enlightening, irradiating. E. द्युत to shine, causal v. शानच् aff.
19922: द्योतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Enlightened, &c. 2 Shining. E. द्युत to light, affix क्त.
19923: द्योतितप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Resplendent. E. द्योतित, and प्रभा splendor.
19924: द्योभूमि m. (-मिः) A bird. f. du. (-मी) Heaven and earth. E. द्यो heaven, and भूमि the earth.
19925: द्योषद् m. (-षद्-षत्) A deity, a celestial. E. द्यो heaven, षद् to go, affix क्विप्.
19926: द्यौत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Light, splendor. 2 Much or forked lightning. E. द्यु for दिव to shine, Uṇādi affix ष्ट्रन्.
19928: द्रङ्खण n. (-णं) A measure or weight, a Tola.
19929: द्रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A city, a town. E. द्रम to go, affix गन्.
19930: द्रढिमन् m. (-मा) Firmness, hardness, heaviness. E. दृढ hard, firm, इमनिच् aff.
19931: द्रढिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Hardest, very hard or firm, &c. E. दृढ with the superlative affix, इष्ठन् and the liquid substituted for the vowel; also with ईयसुन् affix द्रढीयस् (-यान्-यसी-यः.)
19932: द्रप्स mn. (-प्सः-प्सं) Thin or diluted curds. E. दृप to please, affix स; also त्रप्स and द्रप्सा.
19933: द्रप्स्य n. (-प्सां) Thin or diluted curds. E. दृप to please, affix स्यः or it is derived from तृप to be satisfied, त being changed to द.
19934: द्रम r. 1st cl. (द्रमति) To go, to move.
19935: द्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Dropping, oozing. 2 Flowing. 3 Fluid, liquid. 4 Fused, liquefied, melted. m. (-वः) 1 Going, motion. 2 Flight, retreat. 3 Sport, amusement. 4 Juice, essence, exudation. 5 Fusion, liquefaction. 6 Decoction. 7 Dropping, distilling, trickling. E. द्रु to go, to go out of, to drop, affix अप्.
19936: द्रवज m. (-जः) Treacle. E. द्रव, and ज born.
19937: द्रवण n. (-णं) 1 Going. 2 Dropping, exuding. 3 Heat. E. द्रु to go, affix ल्युट्.
19938: द्रवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) 1 Trickling, oozing. 2 Running, flowing. 3 Going. f. (-न्ती) 1 A river in general. 2 A medicinal plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.) E. द्रु to go, affix शतृ.
19939: द्रवत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Fluidity, natural or artificial. 2 Distillation. 3 Fusion. E. द्रव, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्रवता.
19940: द्रवरसा f. (-सा) Lac. E. द्रव, and रस juice.
19941: द्रवाधार m. (-रः) A small vessel, a receiver. E. द्रव juice, distillation, &c. and आधार what receives.
19942: द्रविड m. (-डः) A man of an outcaste tribe, descended from a degraded Kṣatriya. f. (-डी) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.
19943: द्रविण n. (-णं) 1 Wealth, property, thing, substance. 2 Gold. 3 Strength, power. E. द्रु to go, इनन् Uṇādi aff.
19944: द्रविणनाशन m. (-नः) A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. द्रविण strength, and नाशन destroying.
19945: द्रविणोदास् m. (-दाः) AGNI. E. द्रविण, and दास् who gives.
19946: द्रवीकरण n. (-णं) Liquefying, melting. E. द्रव fluid, करण making, च्चि augment.
19947: द्रवीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Melted, liquefied. E. द्रव, कृत made, च्चि augment.
19948: द्रवीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fluid, liquefied, fused. E. द्रव, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
19949: द्रवेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard, solid, congealed. E. द्रव, and इतर reverse.
19950: द्रव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Fit, proper, right, what is or ought to be. 2 Derived from or relating to a tree. n. (-व्यं) 1 Wealth, property. 2 Substance, thing, the receptacle or substratum of properties, &c. 3 Elementary substance, nine kinds of which are reckoned: viz. earth, water, fire, air, æther, time, space, soul, and intellect. 4 Brass. 5 A stake, a wager. 6 A drug, a medicament, any thing used in medicine. 7 Anointing, plastering. 8 Lac, the animal dye. 9 Extract, gum, resin, &c. derived from vegetables. 10 Modesty, propriety. 11 Spirituous liquor. E. द्रु a tree, affix यत्.
19951: द्रव्यक m. (-कः) A carrier or taker of any thing. E. कन् added to the last.
19952: द्रव्यप्रयोजन n. (-नं) Use or employment of any article. E. द्रव्य, and प्रयोजन purpose.
19953: द्रव्यमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Material. 2 Having or holding any thing. E. द्रव्य, मयट् aff.
19954: द्रव्ययज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Offering oblations, sacrifice, &c. E. द्रव्य, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
19955: द्रव्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-ववी-वत्) Rich, wealthy. E. द्रव्य, and मतुप् aff.
19956: द्रव्यशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Cleansing or purification of any soiled or defiled article. E. द्रव्य, and शुद्धि purity.
19957: द्रव्यसंस्कार m. (-रः) 1 Consecration of articles for sacrifice. 2 Purification or cleansing of any articles soiled or defiled. E. द्रव्य, and संस्कार perfectioning.
19958: द्रव्यसञ्चय m. (-यः) Accumulation of property. E. द्रव्य, and सञ्चय collection.
19959: द्रव्यसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Acquirement of wealth. 2 Effecting any thing by wealth. E. द्रव्य, and सिद्धि completion.
19960: द्रव्यहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Holding any thing in the hand. E. द्रव्य, and हस्त hand.
19961: द्रव्यार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Gain, acquisition, acquiring property. E. द्रव्य, and अर्ज्जन acquiring.
19962: द्रष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be seen, visible, apparent. E. दृश to see, तव्य affix, and ऋ changed to र.
19963: द्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what sees, a spectator. E. दृश to see, तृच् aff.
19964: द्रा r. 2nd cl. (द्राति) 1 To fly, to run away. 2 To be ashamed or spoiled.
19965: द्राक् ind. Instantly, immediately, soon, shortly. E. द्रा to fly, कक् aff.
19966: द्राक्ष (इ) द्राक्षि r. 1st cl. (द्राङ्क्षति) 1 To croke, to caw, &c. as a bird. 2 To desire, to wish or long for.
19967: द्राक्षा f. (-क्षा) A grape. E. द्राक्ष to desire, affix घञ्.
19968: द्राख (ऋ,) द्राखृ r. 1st cl. (द्राखति) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn, 2 To be able or competent. 4 To prohibit, to prevent.
19969: द्राघ (ऋ) दाधृ r. 1st cl. (द्राघते) 1 To be able or competent. 2 To stretch, to lengthen. 3 To tire, to be tired or fatigued.
19970: द्राघिमन् m. (-मा) Length. E. दीर्घ, and इमनिच् affix, the first syllable changed.
19971: द्राघिमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Long, lengthy. E. द्राघिमन्, and मतुप् aff.
19972: द्राघिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Longest, very long. E. दीर्घ long, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, and द्राध substituted for दीर्घ.
19973: द्राघीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very or exceeding long. E. दीर्घ, and ईयसुन् affix, deriv. irr.
19974: द्राड (ऋ) दाघृ r. 1st cl. (द्राडते) To divide, to split, to pierce, to pull to pieces, &c.
19975: द्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Flown, run away, &c. E. द्रु to fly, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
19976: द्राप m. (-पः) 1 Mud, mire. 2 Heaven, sky. 3 A fool, an idiot. 4 A cowri.
19977: द्रामिल m. (-लः) The Muni CĀṆAKYA. E. द्रमिल a proper name, and अण् patronymick aff.
19978: द्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flight, retreat. 2 Speed, going quickly. 3 Flowing, running. 4 Fusion, liquefaction. 5 Heat. E. द्रु to go, affix घञ्.
19979: द्रावक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of stone, (a loadstone.) 2 A wit, a wag, a sharp or clever man. 3 A thief. 4 A libertine, a lecher. 5 A pursuer, a chaser, one who causes to fly. 6 A sort of Rasa or quality, n. (-कं) Bee's wax. E. द्रु to fly, affix ण्वुल्.
19980: द्रावकर n. (-रं) 1 A kind of borax. 2 A flux. E. द्राव fusion, and कर what makes.
19981: द्रावन n. (-नं) 1 The clearing nut. 2 Causing to fly or retreat. 3 Fusing. 4 Distilling. E. द्रु to go or retreat, in the causal form, अच् aff.
19982: द्राविका f. (-का) Saliva. E. द्रु to ooze out, ण्वुल् affix, and the fem. form.
19983: द्राविड m. (-डः) 1 A country, properly the coast of Coromandel from Madras to Cape Comorin, or the country in which Tamul is spoken. 2 A native of Drāvira or Drāviḍa. 3 A Brahman of Dravira, or rather of the south, five Drāviras being specified, or Drāvira, Karṇāṭa, Gujjerāta, Mahārāṣṭra, and  Telanga. 4 A particular number. 5 Zedoary. E. द्रविड, and अण् aff.
19984: द्राविडक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) n. (-कं) Black salt. E. कन् added to the preceding, growing in the country of Drāvira.
19985: द्राविडभूतिक m. (-कः) Zedoary. E. द्राविड the country, भूत being, affix ठक्: see the preceding.
19986: द्रावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Melted, liquefied. 2 Softened, mollified. 3 Driven, chased. E. द्रु to go, causal form, क्त aff.
19987: द्राव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be set in motion, to be put to flight, &c. 2 Fusible, liquefiable, to be made fluid. E. द्रु to go, ण्यत् aff.
19988: द्राह (ऋ) द्राह r. 1st cl. (द्राहते) 1 To wake. 2 To deposit, to pledge.
19989: द्रु r. 1st cl. (द्रबति) 1 To go, to move, to run. 2 To drop. 3 To distil or ooze. r. 5th cl. (द्रुनुते द्रुनोति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. With अनु prefixed, To pursue, to follow. With अभि, To swim, to float, to descend. With आङ्, To flee. With उप, To oppress, to destroy. With प्र, To fly, to retreat, to run away. With वि, 1 To smite, to kill. 2 To flee, to run away. With सम् and आङ्, To run together. With सम् and उप, To flee. 2 To meet.
19990: द्रु m. (द्रुः) A tree. f. (द्रुः) Going, motion. E. द्रु to go (up), to grow, affix डु.
19991: द्रुकिलिम n. (-मं) A tree, a sort of pine: (Pinus devadaru.) E. द्रु a tree, किलिम the fir or pine, derived from किल to send or cast, to give out (resin), and किमच् aff.
19992: द्रुघण m. (-णः) 1 A mace, a millet, an iron weapon made like a carpenter's hammer. 2 An axe, a hatchet. 3 A name of BRAHMĀ. 4 A plant: see भूमिचम्पक. E. द्रु a tree, हन to injure or demolish, affix अप्, and घन substituted for the radical; न is usually changed to ण, but the word is also written द्रुघन.
19994: द्रुण r. 6th cl. (द्रुणति) 1 To hurt, to injure. 2 To go, to move, to approach. 3 To bind, to make crooked or curved.
19995: द्रुण m. (-णः) 1 A scorpion. 2 A bee. 3 A rogue, a cheat. f. (-णा) A bow string. n. (-णं) A bow. 2 A sword, a scimitar. E. द्रुण to injure, affix क.
19996: द्रुणस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Large-nosed. E. द्रु a tree, and नस for नास a nose.
19997: द्रुणह m. (-हः) A scabbard, a sword sheath. E. द्रुण a sword, हन to kill or remove, affix ड; the word is also द्रुनह.
19998: द्रुणि f. (-णिः-णी) 1 An oval water bason of wood or stone, &c. shaped like a boat, and used for pouring water. 2 A bucket, a basket. f. (-णी) 1 A centipede. 2 A small or female tortoise. E. द्रुण to go, to hurt, affixes कि and ङीष्.
19999: द्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Quick or swift. 2 Melted, fused. 3 Liquid, fluid. 4 Flown, escaped, run away. 5 Scattered, diffused. m. (-तः) A tree. n. (-तं) Quick time, (in music,) adv. n. (-तं) Quickly, swiftly. E. द्र to go, affix क्त.
20000: द्रुतपद n. subs. (-दं) A quick pace or step. adv. Quickly. E. द्रुत, and पद a step.
20001: द्रुनख m. (-खः) A thorn. E. द्रु a tree, and नख nail.
20002: द्रुनह m. (-हः) A scabbard: see द्रुणह.
20003: द्रुम m. (-मः) 1 A tree in general, 2 A tree of Svarga or paradise. 3 A name of KUVERA. E. द्रु to go, म aff.
20004: द्रुमनख m. (-खः) A thorn. E. द्रुम a tree, and नस्व a finger nail: see द्रुनख.
20005: द्रुमर m. (-रः) A thorn. E. द्रुम a tree, रम to sport, affix ड.
20006: द्रुमव्याधि m. (-धिः) Lac. E. द्रुम, and व्याधि disease.
20007: द्रुमशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The upper part of a building or wall. E. द्रुम a tree, and शीर्ष a head, resembling the top of a tree.
20008: द्रुमश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The palm tree: see ताल. E. द्रुम a tree, and श्रेष्ठ best.
20009: द्रुमामय m. (-यः) Lac, the animal dye. E. द्रुम a tree, and आमत्र sickness.
20010: द्रुमारि m. (-रिः) An elephant. E. द्रुम, and अरि a foe.
20011: द्रुमाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sheltering or dwelling in trees. E. द्रुन, and आश्रय abode.
20012: द्रुमेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 The palm tree: see ताल. 2 The moon. E. द्रुम a tree, and ईश्वर sovereign.
20013: द्रुमोत्पल m. (-लः) A plant: see कर्णिकार. E. द्रुम a tree, and उत्पल a lotus, to which the flowers are compared.
20014: द्रुवय n. (-यं) Measure in general. E. द्रु a tree, and वय affix, implying measure.
20015: द्रुसल्लक n. (-कः) A tree, (Chironjia sapida.) E. द्रु a thing or substance, सल्लका the olibanum plant; a resinous plant.
20016: द्रुह् m. (ध्रुक्) An injurer. E. द्रुह to hate, affix क्विप्.
20017: द्रुह r. 4th cl. (द्रुह्यति) To bear hatred, to seek to hurt or injure.
20018: द्रह m. (-हः) A son. f. (-ही) A daughter. E. द्रुह to hurt, affix क.
20019: द्रुहण m. (-णः) A name of BRAHMĀ: see the next.
20020: द्रुहिण m. (-णः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. द्रुह to injure or hurt, (the wicked,) and इनन् affix, or द्रु a tree, (figuratively the universe,) हन to destroy, इनि affix, destroyer of the world; न changed to ण; also द्रुहण.
20021: द्रुह्यत् mfn. (-ह्यन्-ह्यन्ती-ह्यत्) 1 Attacking, assailing, defying. 2 Tyrannising over, oppressing. E. द्रुह to hate, शतृ aff.
20022: द्रू r. 9th cl. (ञ्,) द्रूञ् (द्रूणाति द्रूणीते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
20023: द्रू m. (-द्रूः) Gold. E. द्रु to go, क्विप् affix, and the vowel made long.
20024: द्रूघण m. (-णः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 An iron club. 3 A sort of hatchet. E. द्रु a tree, हन to strike, affix अप्, घ and ण substituted for ह and न, and the vowel of द्रु made long; also optionally द्रुघण, द्रुघन, and द्रूघन.
20025: द्रूण m. (-णः) A scorpion; also द्रुण and द्रोण.
20026: द्रेक r. 1st cl. (ऋ) देकृ (द्रेकते) 1 To sound. 2 To grow or increase. 3 To manifest joy or elevation by noise.
20027: द्रेक्क m. (-क्कः) The regent of one-third of a planetary sign.
20028: द्रेक्काण m. (-णः) The regent of one-third of a planetary sign, the Decanus of European astrology, whence the word is probably derived.
20029: द्रै r. 1st cl. (द्रायति) To sleep; नि is usually prefixed.
20030: द्रोण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 A measure of capacity, the same as an ĀḌhaka: see आढक. 2 A measure of four ĀḌhakas. 3 In common use, a measure of thirty-two Seras, or rather more than sixty-four lbs. avoirdupois. 4 The sixteenth part of a Khāri, or forty-eight gallons. m. (-णः) 1 A proper name, the military  preceptor of the Pāṇḍus. 2 A raven, or perhaps the carrion crow. 3 A scorpion: see द्रुण. 4 A large piece of water, one four hundred poles long. 5 One of the principal clouds. 6 A small tree bearing white flowers. f. (-णिः-णी) 1 Any oval vessel made of wood, stone, &c. in the shape of a boat, and used for holding or pouring out water, as a bathing tub, a baling vessel, a bucket, a watering pot, &c. 2 A trough or rack for feeding cattle. 3 The name of a country. 4 The name of a mountain. m. (-णिः) The name of a river. f. (-णी) 1 The indigo plant. 2 The union of two mountains, the valley or chasm between them. 3 A sort of boat, implying the sort of water vessel, probably, described above. 4 A measure of capacity equal to 128 Seras. E. द्र to go, न or नि Uṇādi affix, and ङीष् added to either form.
20031: द्रोणकाक m. (-कः) A raven. E. द्रोण the same, and काक a crow.
20032: द्रोणकाकल m. (-लः) A raven. E. द्रोण as above, काकल here said to mean a crow, from का imitative sound, caw, and कल who utters.
20033: द्रोणक्षीरा f. (-रा) A cow that yields a Droṇa of milk. E. द्रोण the measure so called, and क्षीरा milk; also other analogous compounds, ut infra.
20034: द्रोणगन्धिका f. (-का) A plant: see रास्ना.
20035: द्रोणघा f. (-घा) A cow that yields a Droṇa of milk. E. द्रोण the measure, दुह to milk, deriv. irr.
20036: द्रोणदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) A cow that yields a Droṇa of milk. E. द्रोण, and दुग्ध milk.
20037: द्रोणदुघा f. (-घा) See the last. E. द्रोण, and दुह to milk, affix कप्, and ह changed to घ.
20038: द्रोणपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, known commonly by the same name; also गोशीर्षक. E. द्रोण the measure, and पुष्प a flower.
20039: द्रोणमाना f. (-ना) A cow yielding a Droṇa of milk. E. द्रोण, and मान a measure: see द्रोणक्षीरा.
20040: द्रोणमुख m. (-खः) The capital of a district, the chief of four hundred villages.
20041: द्रोणम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Liberal in entertaining, one who cooks a Droṇa. E. द्रोण, and पच to cook, खच् aff.
20042: द्रोणाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A proper name; Droṇa, the son of BHĀRADVĀJA, and the Ācārya or teacher of the Pāṇḍava princes. E. द्रोण as above, and आचार्य्य a preceptor; also with कन् added द्रोणाचार्य्यक.
20043: द्रोणिका f. (-का) The indigo plant. E. द्रोणि the same, and कन् added.
20044: द्रोणीदल m. (-लः) A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) E. द्रोणी a water vessel, and दल a leaf, the leaves being boat-shaped.
20045: द्रोणीमुख m. (-खः) The principal of four hundred villages: see द्रोणमुख.
20046: द्रोह m. (-हः) 1 Mischief, malice, trespass, injury. 2 Offence, wrong. 3 Rebellion. E. द्रुह to hurt or injure, affix घञ्.
20047: द्रोहचिन्तन n. (-नं) Injurious design, malice prepense; the wish, thought, or attempt to injure. E. द्रोह as above, and चिन्तन thinking, meditating.
20048: द्रोहाट m. (-टः) 1 A hunter, a deer killer. 2 A sort of metre, the Doha or stanza of Hindi poetry. 3 A religious impostor, a tartuffe, a hypocrite. E. द्रोह injury, mischief, and अट who goes or is.
20049: द्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 1 Hurting, harming, endeavouring to hurt, malignant, malicious. 2 Rebellious. E. द्रुह to seek to hurt, घिनुण् aff.
20050: द्रौणायण m. (-णः) A name of AŚVATTHĀMA, son of Droṇa. E. द्रोण as above, and फक affix; also with फिञ affix द्रौणायणि, or with इञ् affix द्रौणि.
20051: द्रौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sown with a Droṇa of grain, (fields, &c.) f. (-की) A vessel holding a Droṇa by measure. E. द्रोण the measure, ठञ् or ठन् affix; also with अण् and ङीष् affix in the last sense द्रौणी.
20052: द्रौपदी f. (-दी) A proper name; DRAUPADĪ, the daughter of DRUPADA, king of Pañcāla, and the common wife of the five Pāṇḍava princes. E. द्रुपद the father of this lady, and अण and ङीप् affixes.
20053: द्वन्द m. (-न्दः) A clock or plate on which hours are struck. n. (-न्दं) A pair, a couple, (male and female especially:) see the next.
20054: द्वन्द्व n. (-न्द्वं) 1 A pair, a brace. 2 A couple of animals, or male and female. 3 Union of the sexes or coupling. 4 Strife, dispute. 5 A secret. m. (-न्द्वः) 1 A form of grammatical combination uniting two or more words in the same case, properly separated by a conjunction, as रामलक्ष्मणौ RĀMA and LAKṢMAṆA; पाणिपादं hand and foot. 2 A sign of the zodiac, (Gemini.) 3 A species of disease, a complication of two disorders, or compound affection of two humours. E. द्वि two, reduplicate, deriv. irr.
20055: द्वन्द्वचर m. (-रः) The ruddy goose. E. द्वग्द्व a couple, and चर who goes; flying in couples.
20056: द्वन्द्वचारिन् m. (-री) The ruddy goose. E. द्वन्द्व, and चर to go, affix णिनिः see the last.
20057: द्वन्द्वज mfn. (-जः-जा-लं) 1 Produced or proceeding from morbid affection of two humours. 2 Proceeding from a pair, &c. E. द्वन्द्व, and ज born.
20058: द्वन्द्वदुःख n. (-खं) Pain arising from alternation, as of heat or cold, pleasure or pain, &c. E. द्वन्द्व, and दुःख pain.
20059: द्वन्द्वभिन्न n. (-न्नं) Separation of the sexes. E. द्वन्द्व, and भिन्न broken.
20060: द्वन्द्वयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Single combat. E. द्वन्द्व, and युद्ध war.
20061: द्वन्द्वातीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from worldly affections. E. द्वन्द्व alternation. (of pain and pleasure, &c.) and अतीत passed.
20062: द्वय n. (-यः-यं) A pair, a couple, two, chiefly used in composition, as पुरुषद्वयं two men. E. द्वि two, टयप् aff.
20064: द्वयातिग m. (-गः) A saint, a holy or virtuous man. E. द्वय a pair, the two bad qualities, passion and ignorance, अति beyond, and ग who goes.
20065: द्वाःस्थ m. (-स्थः) 1 A warder, a porter. 2 NANDĪ, one of ŚIVA'S doorkeepers. E. द्वार् a door, and स्थ who stays; also द्वास्थ.
20066: द्वाःस्थित m. (-तः) A doorkeeper, a warder. E. द्वार् a door, and स्थित staying; also द्वास्थित.
20067: द्वाःस्थितदर्शक m. (-कः) A warder, a porter, a chamberlain. E. द्वार् a door, स्थित staying, and दर्शक who shows, who introduces to the prince or great man to whom the mansion belongs; also द्वाःस्थित and दर्शक severally; also द्वाःस्थितदर्शिन्, m. (-र्शी)
20068: द्वात्रिंशदक्षरिन् m. (-री) A book or composition. E. द्वात्रिंशत thirty-two, अक्षर a letter, a consonant, इनि affix; formed of thirty-two letters.
20069: द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having thirty-two auspicious marks, illustrious, great. E. द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, लक्षण a mark, उपेत possessing, endowed with.
20070: द्वादश mfn. (-शः-शी) Twelfth. f. (-शी) The twelfth day of the half month. E. द्वादशन्, and टच् aff.
20071: द्वादशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Consisting of twelve, amounting to twelve, &c. E. कन् added to the last.
20072: द्वादशकर m. (-रः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. द्वादश twelve, and कर a hand or ray.
20073: द्वादशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Twelve. E. द्वा for द्वि two, and दशन् ten.
20074: द्वादशपत्रक n. (-कं) A particular religious observance. E. द्वादश, and पत्र leaf or part, कन् added.
20075: द्वादशलोचन m. (-नः) The god KĀRTTIKEYA. E. द्वादश twelve, and लोचन an eye; the twelve-eyed, or six-headed deity.
20076: द्वादशांशु m. (-शुः) The deity VṚHASPATI, or planet Jupiter, over which he presides. E. द्वादश twelve, and अंशु a ray.
20077: द्वादशाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The god KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 The deity or sage Buddha. E. द्वादश twelve, and अक्ष an eye: the word is sometimes read in the second sense, द्वादशाख्य m. (-ख्यः) the twelve-named.
20078: द्वादशाक्षरमन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A prayer of twelve syllables, especially as addressed to VIṢṆU, or Om, BHAGAVATE, VĀSUDEVĀYA, RĀMĀYA. E. द्वादश, अक्षर a letter, and मन्त्र formula.
20079: द्वादशाङ्गुल m. (-लः) A measure of twelve fingers. E. द्वादश, and अङ्गुल a finger.
20080: द्वादशात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The sun. E. द्वादश twelve, and आत्मन्, identity; being represented in and identified with the twelve Ādityas, or the sun in each month of the year; also द्वादशात्मक.
20081: द्वादशायुस् m. (-युः) A dog. E. द्वादश twelve, (years,) and आयुस् life.
20082: द्वादशार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) VṚHASPATI, regent of Jupiter, and preceptor of the gods. E. द्वादश twelve, and अर्च्चिस् a ray of light.
20083: द्वादशास्र nf. (-स्रं-स्री) A parallelopipedon, a dodecagonal figure. E. द्वादश, and अस्र an angle.
20084: द्वापर m. (-रः) 1 The third of the four Yugas or great periods, comprising 864,000 years. 2 The age personified as a god. 3 Doubt, uncertainty. E. द्वा for द्वि two, पर after.
20085: द्वार् f. (-द्वाः) 1 A door, a gate. 2 A means, an expedient, a medium or way by which any thing takes place or is effected. E. द्वृ to cover or hold, in the causal form, affix विच.
20086: द्वार n. (-रं) 1 A door, a gate, or rather the door or gateway, a passage, an entrance. 2 A way, a means, a medium or vehicle. E. द्वृ to cover, affix अच्.
20087: द्वारक mf. (-कः-का) Dvāraka the capital of KṚṢṆA, supposed to have been submerged by the sea, but represented by a small island off the north part of the Malabar coast. E. द्वार a way, (to salvation,) affix कन्; also द्वारिका, द्वारवती, &c.
20088: द्वारकण्टक m. (-कः) A door, a gate, the door itself. E. द्वार a doorway, and कण्टक a thorn.
20089: द्वारकेश m. (-शः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. द्वारका as above, and ईश master.
20090: द्वारपाल m. (-लः) A warder, a doorkeeper. E. द्वार a door, and पाल who protects; also with कन् added द्वारपालक, or with the radical finals dropped द्वारप.
20091: द्वारपिण्डी f. (-ण्डी) The threshold of a door. E. द्वार a door, and पिण्ड a ball.
20092: द्वारयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A lock, a bolt. E. द्वार a door, and यन्त्र an instrument.
20093: द्वारवती f. (-ती) The city Dvārakā. E. द्वार a door, and मतुप् poss. affix; also द्वारावती.
20094: द्वारवलिभुज् m. (-भुक) The Vaka, a sort of crane, (Ardea nivea). E. द्वार a door, वलि offal or fragments, and भुज् who eats.
20095: द्वारशाखा f. (-खा) The leaf of a door. E. द्वार a door, and शास्वा a branch.
20096: द्वारस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) A door-post. E. द्वार, and स्तम्भ a post.
20097: द्वारस्थ m. (-स्थः) A doorkeeper. E. द्वार a gate, and स्थ who stays.
20099: द्वारिक m. (-कः) A doorkeeper, a warder. E. द्वार a door, and ठक् affix. f. (-का) Dvāraka, KṚṢṆA'S capital: see द्वारक. E. द्वार, and ठन् aff.
20100: द्वारिन् m. (-री) A porter, a warder, a doorkeeper. E. द्वार, and इनि aff.
20101: द्वास्थ m. (-स्थः) A doorkeeper, a warder. E. द्वार a door, स्थ who stays, and र rejected; also र being changed to Visarga, द्वाःस्थ.
20102: द्वास्थित m. (-तः) A doorkeeper. E. द्वार, and स्थित who stays; also द्वाःस्थितः see the last.
20103: द्वास्थितदर्शक m. (-कः) A doorkeeper: see द्वाःस्थितदर्शक, &c.
20104: द्वि dual only. mf. (-द्वौ) n. (-द्वे) Two. m. (-द्विः) Two, (of times, &c.) it is only used in composition, as अतिद्वि a thing more than two, and inflected like other nouns in इः in composition with other numerals, it is changed to द्वा, as द्वादश twelve, द्वाविंशति twenty-two, द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, &c.
20105: द्विक m. (-कः) 1 A crow. 2 The ruddy goose. E. द्वि two, and क the letter क, as in काक. mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Two. 2 Twice. 3 Two-fold. E. द्वि two, कन् pleonastick aff.
20106: द्विककार m. (-रः) A crow. E. द्वि two or twice, and ककार the letter क, as in काक.
20107: द्विककुद् m. (-दः) A camel. E. द्वि two, and ककुद् a hump.
20108: द्विकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what makes two of any thing. E. द्वि and कृ to make, ञच् aff.
20109: द्विगु m. (-गुः) A form of grammatical combination, that in which the first member of the compound is a numeral.
20110: द्विगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Twice, two times. 2 Multiplied by two, doubled. E. द्वि two, and गुण number.
20111: द्विगुणाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed. E. द्विगुणा twice, and कृत ploughed.
20112: द्विगुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Doubled, multiplied by two. 2 Folded, double. 3 Invested, enveloped. E. द्वि, and गुण a time, इतच् aff.
20113: द्विगुणीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Doubled. 2 Increased. E. द्विगुण twice, कृत made, च्चि augment.
20114: द्विगुणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Doubled. 2 Augmented. E. द्विगुण twice, भूत become, च्चि augment.
20115: द्विज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Twice born. 2 Oviparous. m. (-जः) 1 A man of either of the three first classes, a Brahman, a Kṣatriya or a Vaiśya whose investiture with the characteristick string, at years of puberty, constitutes, religiously and metaphorically, their second birth. 2 Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, a fish, &c. first born in the shell, and in the second instance produced from it. 3 A tooth. 4 Coriander seed. f. (-जा) 1 A sort of perfume; also called Reṇukā. 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indicus.) 3 Kundur or gum olibanum. E. द्वि two, and ज born.
20116: द्विजकुत्सित m. (-तः) A tree, (Cordia myxa.) E. द्विज a bird, कुत्सित reviled, disregarded.
20117: द्विजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) 1 Twice born, regenerate. 2 Oviparous. m. (-न्मा) 1 A tooth. 2 A Brahman. 3 A bird. 4 A man of the three first classes. 5 Any oviparous animal: see द्विज. E. द्वि twice, जन्मन् birth.
20118: द्विजदास m. (-सः) A Śūdra or man of the fourth and servile tribe. E. द्विज a man of either of the three first castes, and दास a slave.
20119: द्विजपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. द्विज a Brahman, and पति master.
20120: द्विजप्रपा f. (-पा) A trough near a well for watering birds, cattle, &c. E. द्विज a bird, &c. and प्र prefixed to पा to drink, affix अङ् and टाप्.
20121: द्विजप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Acceptable or friendly to a man of the three first classes, or a Brahman especially. f. (-या) The moonplant, (Asclepias acida.) E. द्विज a Brahman, and प्रिय beloved, the acid juice being drank at certain sacrifices.
20122: द्विजराज m. (-जः) 1 The moon. 2 The great serpent ANANTA. 3 The bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 4 Camphor. E. द्विज a snake or bird, and राज king.
20123: द्विजलिङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) 1 A Kṣatriya or man of the military tribe. 2 An impostor, a pretended Brahman, wearing the distinguishing mark of that tribe without belonging to it. E. द्विज twice born, and लिङ्ग a mark, इनि aff.
20124: द्विजवर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An excellent or superior Brahman. E. द्विज, and वर्य्य excellent.
20125: द्विजव्रण m. (-णः) Gumboil, toothache. E. द्विज a tooth, व्रण a sore.
20126: द्विजब्रुव m. (-वः) A Brahman by birth only, one not studied or not practising the duties of his caste. E. द्विज a Brahman, and व्रुव who speaks.
20127: द्विजशप्त m. (-प्तः) A sort of pulse; also called Raja-māṣ-kalai and Berbetti, (Dolichos catjang.) E. द्विज a Brahman, and शप्त cursed; it is prohibited food on some occasions.
20128: द्विजशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahmans, by the fourth. E. द्विज, and शुश्रूषा service.
20129: द्विजसत्तम m. (-मः) A respectable Brahman. E. द्विज, and सत्तम best; also द्विजवर, द्विजप्रवर, &c.
20130: द्विजसेवक m. (-कः) A Śūdra or man of the fourth and servile class. E. द्विज a man of the three first classes, and सेवक a servant.
20131: द्विजसेवा f. (-वा) Service of the three first classes, especially of the Brahman by the fourth. E. द्विज, and सेवा service.
20132: द्विजाग्र्य m. (-ज्यः) A chief or respectable Brahman. E. द्विज, and अग्र्य first.
20133: द्विजाङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A medicinal plant; also कटुरोहिणी.
20134: द्विजाति (-तिः) 1 A Brahman. 2 A man of either of the three first classes. 3 Any oviparous animal, as a bird, a snake, &c. E. द्वि two, जाति birth.
20135: द्विजानुलोम n. (-मं) The regular order or series of the three first classes. E. द्विज, and अनुलोम with the hair.
20136: द्विजायनी f. (-नी) The characteristick thread or cord which designates the three first classes of the HindŪs. E. द्विज twiceborn, फक् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
20137: द्विजालय m. (-यः) 1 The hollow of a tree. 2 The residence of Brahmans. E. द्विज a bird, a Brahman, and आलय an asylum.
20138: द्विजिह्व mfn. (ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Double-tongued, (literally or figuratively.) m. (-ह्वः) 1 A snake. 2 An informer. 3 A rogue, a scoundrel, a bad man. 4 A thief. E. द्वि two, जिह्वा the tongue.
20139: द्विजिह्वता f. (-ता) Insincerity, dishonesty. E. तल् added to the last.
20140: द्विजोत्तम m. (-मः) 1 A Brahman. 2 A superior or excellent Brahman. E. द्विज the twice-born, (three first classes,) and उत्तम best.
20141: द्विज्या f. (-ज्या) The sine or chord of an arc. E. द्वि, and ज्या sine.
20142: द्विज्यामार्ग n. (-र्गं) A horizontal line. E. द्विज्य, and मार्ग road.
20143: द्विट्सेवा f. (-वा) Treachery. E. द्विष् a foe, सेवा service.
20144: द्विट्सेविन् n. (वी) A traitor. E. द्विट् an enemy, and सेविन् who serves.
20145: द्विठ m. (-ठः) Svāhā, the expression used with an oblation to fire.
20146: द्वितय n. (-यं) A couple, a pair, two. E. द्वि two, तयप् aff.
20147: द्वितीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Second. 2 Two. m. (-यः) A son, a second or successor. f. (-या) 1 A wife, according to the ritual, a woman wedded after the ceremony prescribed by the Vedas, a second self as it were. 2 The second day of the fortnight. E. द्वि two, and तीय affix, fem. affix टाप्; also with कन् added, द्वितीयक.
20148: द्वितीयत्व n. (-त्वं) The circumstance or state of second. E. द्वितीय, and त्व affix: also with तल्, द्वितीयता.
20149: द्वितीयत्रिफला f. (-ला) A set of three fruits, the grape, the date, and the Gambhāri. E. द्वितीय second, त्रिफल three fruits.
20150: द्वितीयाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed, &c. (a field.) E. द्वितीय a second time, and आकृत made.
20151: द्वितीयाभा f. (-भा) A scitamineous plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhiza.) E. द्वितीय second, आभा lustre.
20152: द्वितीयीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Second. E. द्वितीय, and ईकक pleonasm added.
20153: द्वित्र mfn. plu. always (-त्रः-त्राः-त्रणि) Two or three. E. द्वि two, and त्र for त्रि three.
