20154: द्विदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Two-toothed. E. द्वि two, दत् for दन्त a tooth; if marking age or period the compound is द्विदन्त.
20155: द्विदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Old enough to have two teeth, &c. E. द्वि and दन्त a tooth, see the last.
20156: द्विदण्डि ind. Single stick, quarter staff, as द्विदण्डि प्रहरणं fighting with two sticks. E. द्वि, दण्ड a staff, इच् affix; also similar compounds, as द्विमुषलि, &c.
20157: द्विदश m. plu. (-शाः) Twenty, two tens. E. द्वि, and दश ten.
20158: द्विदाम्नी f. (-म्नी) A cow tied with two ropes. E. द्वि, and दामन् a rope.
20159: द्विदेह m. (-हः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. द्वि two, and देह a body; having the head of an elephant, with the figure of a man.
20160: द्विदैवत्या f. (-त्या) The constellation Viśākha. E. द्वि two, दैवत a deity, and क्यप् affix; INDRA and AGNI jointly presiding over the asterism.
20161: द्विधा ind. Of two kinds, in two ways. E. द्वि two, धा aff.
20162: द्विधाकरण n. (-णं) Dividing into two parts, arranging in two ways, &c. E. द्विधा, and करण making.
20163: द्विधागति m. (-तिः) A crocodile. E. द्विधा of two sorts, गति going; amphibious.
20164: द्विधातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Having two natures, two roots, &c. m. (-तुः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. द्वि two or double, धातु nature: see द्विदेह.
20165: द्विधात्मक n. (-कं) A nutmeg. E. द्विधा two sorts, and आत्मक being.
20166: द्विधालेख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) To be written in two ways. m. (-ख्यः) The marshy date tree. E. द्विधा, and लेख्य to be written or described.
20167: द्विनग्नक m. (-कः) A circumcised man, one having no prepuce. E. द्वि two, नग्न naked, कन् added; exposed either by want of clothes or skin.
20168: द्विनिष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Bought, &c. with two Niṣkas. E. द्वि, and निष्क a measure of value; also द्विनैष्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं.)
20169: द्विप m. (-पः) 1 An elephant. 2 A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. द्वि two, and प who drinks, the elephant imbibing fluids by his trunk, and thence conveying them into his mouth.
20170: द्विपथ n. (-थं) A place where two roads meet. E. द्वि two, प्रथिन् a road.
20171: द्विपद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Two-footed. 2 Having two parts. 3 Binomial. m. (-दः) A biped, including four genera, gods, demons, men, and birds. E. द्वि, and पद for पाद a foot.
20172: द्विपदराशि f. (-शिः) Either of the signs, Gemini, Libra, Aquarius, Virgo, and half of Sagittarius. E. द्विपद, and राशि a sign.
20173: द्विपमद m. (-दः) The elephant's temporal juice. E. द्विप, and मद the exudation.
20174: द्विपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Two-leaved, opposite-leaved. E. द्वि, and पर्ण a leaf.
20175: द्विपात्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The having of two feet, two parts, &c. E. द्विपाद्, and त्व affix; also with तल्, द्विपात्ता.
20176: द्विपाद् mfn. (-पाद् पती पत्) Biped, two-footed. E. द्वि two, and पाद् for पाद a foot.
20177: द्विपाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Bought, &c. with two quarters. n. (-द्यं) A double penalty, an amercement of twice the common amount. E. द्वि two, पाद a division, and यत् aff.
20178: द्विपायिन् m. (-यी) An elephant. E. द्वि two, and पायिन् who drinks: see द्विप.
20179: द्विपृष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A proper name; also VASUDEVA.
20180: द्विप्रतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought, &c. with two Karṣas. E. द्वि, प्रति for कार्षापण, and ठन् added.
20181: द्विबाहु mfn. (-हुः-ह्वी-हु) Two-armed. E. द्वि, and बाहु an arm.
20182: द्विभुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Two-armed. 2 An angle or the lines which form it. E. द्वि two, and भुज an arm.
20183: द्विमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of two, (parts of any thing.) E. द्वि, and मयट् aff.
20184: द्विमातृज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having two mothers, born in two ways; it may be said of some of the deities, thus GAṆEŚA was the son of PĀRVATĪ, but not born in the usual way, being made of the scurf of her body: see द्वैमातुर. E. द्वि two, मातृ a mother, and ज born.
20185: द्विमुख m. (-खः) A serpent. f. (-खः) 1 A small water jar. 2 A leech. E. द्वि, and मुख mouth; double-headed.
20186: द्विमुखाहि m. (-हिः) A sort of serpent, (Amphisbœna.) E. द्वि two, मुख face, अहि a snake; the double-headed snake.
20187: द्विमुखोरग m. (-गः) A sort of snake: see the last. E. द्विमुख as above, and उरग a snake.
20188: द्विमूर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Two-headed. E. द्वि two, मूर्द्धन् the forehead, and यच् aff.
20189: द्विर m. (-रः) A bee: see द्विरेफ.
20190: द्विरद m. (-दः) An elephant. E. द्वि two, and रद a tooth, having tusks and teeth.
20191: द्विरदान्तक m. (-कः) A lion. E. द्विरद, and अन्तक destroyer.
20192: द्विरशन n. (-नं) Eating twice a day. E. द्वि, and अशन eating.
20193: द्विरसन m. (-नः) A snake in general. E. द्वि two, रसना the tongue; double or forky-tongued.
20194: द्विरात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of two nights. E. द्वि, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
20195: द्विराप m. (-पः) An elephant. E. द्विर् for द्वि two, आङ् prefixed to पा to drink, affix ड; drinking with the trunk and mouth: see द्विप.
20196: द्विरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Repeated, said twice. 2 Said or told in two ways. E. द्वि, and उक्त said.
20197: द्विरुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Tautology, repetition. 2 Variety of narration, telling any thing in two ways. 3 (In Grammar,) Repetition of a syllable. E. द्वि, and उक्ति saying.
20198: द्विरुढा f. (-ढा) A woman who has been twice married. E. द्वि two, उढ a married woman.
20199: द्विरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पी-पं) 1 Of two forms, having a different shape. 2 Spelled or written in two ways. m. (-पः) A word that may be correctly spelled in two ways. 2 Variety of interpretation or reading. E. द्वि, and रूप form.
20200: द्विरेफ m. (-फः) A large black bee. E. द्वि two, रेफ the letter र; having two rs, in the most common name, भ्रमर, Bhramara.
20201: द्विरेफवृन्द n. (-न्दं) A flight or swarm of bees. E. द्विरेफ, and वृन्द a number.
20202: द्विवर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-र्षं) Two years old, &c. (-र्षा) A cow two years old. E. द्वि two, वर्ष a year.
20203: द्विवर्षिका f. (-का) A cow two years old. E. द्विवर्षा, and कन् added.
20204: द्विवर्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Two years old, two years standing, &c. E. द्वि two, वर्ष a year, ख affix; also with ठञ् affix द्विवार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) when futurity is implied, the first vowel is usually changed, as द्वैवार्षिक.
20205: द्विवाहिका f. (-का) A swing, a swinging cot, a litter. E. द्वि two, वह to bear, affix ठक्; born usually by two men.
20206: द्विविद m. (-दः) The name of a monkey, slain by RĀMA or VIṢṆU in that incarnation.
20207: द्विविदारि m. (-रिः) VIṢṆU. E. द्विविद as above, अरि the foe.
20208: द्विविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of two kinds, in two ways. E. द्वि, and विध sort.
20209: द्विवेशरा f. (-रा) A kind of carriage.
20210: द्विशफ m. (-फः) Any cloven-footed animal. E. द्वि, and शफ a hoof.
20211: द्विशस् ind. Two by two, respectively. E. द्वि two, and शस् aff.
20212: द्विशीर्षक m. (-कः) A name of AGNI. E. द्वि two, शीर्ष a head, and कन् added.
20213: द्विशूर्प्प mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Bought with two winnowing baskets of anything. E. द्वि, and शूर्प्पं a basket; also with ठञ् द्विशौर्प्पिक, mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
20214: द्विशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A sort of fish, commonly called Marmaka. E. द्वि two, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि aff.
20215: द्विष r. 1st cl. (द्विषति) also (औ) औद्विष r. 2nd cl. (द्वेष्टि) plu. (द्विषन्ति) To hate, to dislike, to be hostile or unfriendly.
20216: द्विष् mfn. (द्विट्) Inimical, hostile. m. (द्विट्) An enemy. E. द्विष to hate, affix क्विप्; also with क affix द्विष. m. (-षः) or mfn. (-षः-षा-षं.)
20217: द्विषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) 1 Hating or detesting, hostile. 2 Inimical, unfriendly. m. (-न्) An enemy. E. द्विष to hate, participal aff. शतृ.
20218: द्विषतीताप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Vexing or harassing an enemy. E. द्विषत्, and ताप who afflicts, with च्चि augment.
20219: द्विषन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Punishing or annoying an enemy, revenging, retaliating. E. द्विष an enemy, तप to burn, affix खच्.
20220: द्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Hated, disliked. n. (-ष्टं) Copper: see द्व्यष्ट. E. द्विष to hate, affix क्त.
20221: द्विष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Staying in two shapes or places, &c. E. द्वि two, and स्थ what is or abides.
20222: द्विसप्ताह m. (-हः) A fortnight. E. द्वि twice, सप्त seven, and अह a day, twice seven days.
20223: द्विसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Consisting of two equal portions, &c. E. द्वि two, सम equal.
20224: द्विसमत्रिभुजा f. (-जा) An isosceles triangle. E. द्वि, सम equal, त्रिभुजा triangle.
20225: द्विसहस्राक्ष m. (-क्षः) The great serpent, sovereign of the snake race, and the couch of VIṢṆU. E. द्विसहस्र two thousand, and अक्षि an eye; the two thousand-eyed.
20226: द्विसीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Twice ploughed. E. द्वि twice, सीता a plough, and यत् aff.
20227: द्विस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Two-breasted, two-uddered. E. द्धि, and स्तन breast.
20228: द्विहन् m. (-हा) An elephant. E. द्वि two, in two ways, with tusks and teeth, and हन् who kills.
20229: द्विहल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Twice ploughed. E. द्वि two, हल a plough, affix यत्.
20230: द्विहायन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Two years old. f. (-नी) A cow two years old. E. द्वि two, हायन a year, affix अण् and ङीष्.
20231: द्विहृदया f. (-या) A pregnant woman. E. द्वि two, हृदय a heart; having one of her own and one in the foetus.
20232: द्वीन्द्रियग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Perceptible by two senses or forms, by sight and touch, &c. E. द्वि, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, ग्राह्य to be seized.
20233: द्वीप mf. (-पः-पं) 1 An island, any land surrounded by water; the word is hence applied to the seven grand divisions of the terrestrial world, each of these being separated from the next, by a peculiar and circumambient ocean: the seven Dvīpas, reckoning from the central one are, Jambu, Kuśa, Plakṣa, Śālmali, Krauncha, Śāka, and Puṣkara: the central Dvīpa, or the known continent, is again portioned into ten divisions, likewise termed Dvīpas: viz. Kuru, Candra, Varuṇa, Saumya, Nāga, Kumārikā, Gabhastimān, Tāmrāpūrna, Kaseru and Indra. 2 A tiger's skin. E. द्वि two, (on both sides,) and आप water, आ dropped, and इ made long.
20234: द्वीपकर्पूरक m. (-कः) China camphor. E. द्वीप, and कर्पूर camphor.
20235: द्वीपवत् m. (-वान्) The ocean. mf. (-वान्-वती) A river. f. (-वती) The earth. E. द्वीप an island, मतुप् possessive aff.
20236: द्वीपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Island, islander. m. (-पी) 2 A tiger. 2 An ounce or panther. E. द्वीप an island, इनि affix; haunting the small woody islands that abound in the rivers in India, or द्वीप a tiger's spotted skin, derived from द्वि two, इ to go or be, प affix: and इनि as before.
20237: द्वीपिशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. द्वीपिन् a tiger, and शत्रु obnoxious.
20238: द्वीप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Island, an islander, &c. m. (-प्यः) 1 A sort of crow. 2 A name of VYĀSA. E. द्वीप, and क्यप् aff.
20239: द्वृ r. 1st cl. (द्वरति) 1 To accept, to appoint. 2 To cover.
20240: द्वेधा ind. In two ways: see द्विघा.
20241: द्वेष m. (-षः) Hate, enmity. E. द्विष to hate, affix घञ्.
20242: द्वेषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Inimical, hostile. m. (-णा) An enemy. n. (-णं) Hate, enmity. E. द्विष to hate, and ल्यु or युच् aff.
20243: द्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Hostile, inimical, adverse, obnoxious. m. (-षी) An enemy. E. द्विष to hate, घिणुन् aff.
20244: द्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Hating, inimical, an enemy. E. द्विष to hate, तृच् aff.
20245: द्वेष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Hateful, detestable. E. द्विष to hate, affix ण्यत्.
20246: द्वेष्यता f. (-ता) Aversion, dislike, detestableness. E. द्वेष्य, and तल् aff.
20247: द्वैगुणिक m. (-कः) A usurer, a money lender. E. द्वि two, गुण number, affix ठक्; who requires cent. per cent.
20248: द्वैगुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Duality. 2 The possession of two out of the three qualities. 3 Doubling. E. द्विगुण, and अण् aff.
20249: द्वैजात mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Twice born. E. द्विजात, and अण् aff.
20250: द्वैत n. (-तं) 1 Duplication, doubling or being doubled. 2 Duality, in philosophy, the assertion of two principles, as the distinctness of life and soul, spirit and matter, god and the universe. E. द्वि two, तल् affix, द्वित double, two-fold, abstract affix अण्.
20251: द्वैतवादिन् m. (-दी) A philosopher who asserts two principles. E. द्वैत, and वादिन् who asserts.
20252: द्वैतीयीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Second. E. द्वितीय second, pleonastick affix अण्, and ईकक् added.
20253: द्वैध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Two-fold, of two sorts. n. (-धं) 1 A double resource, a stratagem, a secondary arrangement or array, a reserve. 2 Contest, dispute, difference. 3 A two-fold form or state. E. द्वैधम्, and ड added.
20254: द्वैधम् ind. In two ways. E. द्वि, and धमुञ् aff.
20255: द्वैधीकरण n. (-णं) Making two, separating, disuniting. E. द्वैध, and करण making, च्चि augment.
20256: द्वैधीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Separated. 2 Made into two, sundered. E. द्वैध, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
20257: द्वैधीभाव m. (-वः) 1 Sowing dissension, causing the separation of allies. 2 Dividing into two. 3 The nature or property of being two or distinct. E. द्वैध, and भाव property, च्चि aff.
20258: द्वैधीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being two, being separated or disunited. E. द्वैध, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
20259: द्वैप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) 1 Made of a tiger's skin. 2 Island, islander. m. (-पः) A car covered or hung with a tiger's skin. E. द्वीप a tiger's skin, and अञ् aff.
20260: द्वैपायन m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA, the author or compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas. E. द्वीप an island, फक् affix; the island-born, the place of his nativity being a small island in the Ganges.
20261: द्वैप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Of or belonging to an island. E. द्वीप an island, यञ् aff.
20262: द्वैमातुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having two mothers, or the natural mother and a step-mother. m. (-रः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 An epithet of JARĀSANDHA: see जरासन्ध. E. द्वि two, मातृ a mother, अण् affix, उ substituted for the penultimate: see द्विमातृज.
20263: द्वैमित्रि mfn. (-त्रिः-त्री-त्ति) Born of two friends, the children, &c. E. द्वि, and मित्र a friend, इञ् aff.
20264: द्वैयह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to two days. E. द्व्यहन्, and ठञ् aff.
20265: द्वैरथ m. (-थः) Single combat in chariots. E. द्विरथ two cars, अण् aff.
20266: द्वैरात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to a period of two nights. E. द्विरात्र, and ठञ् aff.
20267: द्वैवर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) After two years, of or belonging to two years to come. E. द्वि, वर्ष a year, ठञ् aff.
20268: द्वैविध्य n. (-ध्यः) The state of being two-fold. E. द्विविध, and ष्यञ् aff.
20269: द्वैहायन n. (-नं) The age of two years. E. द्विहायन, and अण् aff.
20270: द्व्यंश m. (-शः) Two shares. E. द्वि, and अंश part.
20271: द्व्यक्षर n. (-रं) A word of two syllables. E. द्वि, and अक्षर a syllable.
20272: द्व्यङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Measuring two fingers. n. (-लं) Two fingers. E. द्वि two, अङ्गुलि a finger; if wood is implied, the fem. form is द्व्यङ्गुली.
20273: द्व्यञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Measuring, &c. two Añjalis. n. (-लिः) Two Añjalis collectively. E. द्वि, and अञ्जलि a certain measure, टच् affix; also with the final retained द्व्यञ्जलि.
20274: द्व्यणुक n. (-कं) The aggregation of two atoms, the first step in the formation of substances, and when they become perceptible. E. द्वि, and अणु an atom, कन् added.
20275: द्व्यन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Accompanied, &c. by two others. n. (-न्यं) Two others collectively. E. द्धि, and अन्य another.
20276: द्व्यर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Having two senses, meaning two things. 2 Having two objects. m. (-र्थः) Two-fold meaning, double-entendre. E. द्वि, and अर्थ sense.
20277: द्व्यष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Copper. E. द्वि two, (metals; gold and silver,) अश to pervade, affix क्त; mixed as alloy with the fine metals; also the य being interchanged with its congener इ, द्विष्ट.
20278: द्व्यह m. (-हः) Two days. E. द्वि two, and अह a day.
20279: द्व्यहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of or belonging to two days. E. द्व्यह, and ख aff.
20280: द्व्यात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Comprising two, being two. m. (-कः) A sign of the zodiac, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces. E. द्वि, and आत्मन् self, कन् aff.
20281: द्व्यामुषायण m. (-णः) A boy who remains heir to his father though adopted by another. E. द्वि, and आमुष्यायण a certain person.
20282: द्व्यायुष n. (-षं) Two lives. E. द्वि, and आयुस life.
20283: द्व्याहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced, &c. in two days. E. द्व्याह, and ठञ् aff.
20284: द्व्येकान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having two between, two off. E. द्वि, and एकान्तर an interval, च a line. ध
20285: ध The aspirated letter corresponding to the preceding, and expressed by Dh.
20286: ध m. (धः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A name of KUVERA. 3 Virtue, moral merit. n. (धं) Wealth, property. E. धा to have or possess, affix क.
20287: धक्क r. 10th cl. (धक्कयति) To destroy or annihilate.
20288: धट m. (-टः) 1 A balance, a pair of scales. 2 The sign Libra. 3 Ordeal by the balance. f. (-टी) 1 Old cloth or raiment. 2 A piece of cloth worn over the privities. E. धण to sound, and ट substituted for ण, affix अच्.
20289: धटक m. (-कः) A weight of forty-two Rattis.
20290: धटिनी f. (-नी) A cotton tie or string, fastened round the loins. E. धट a cloth, and इनि aff.
20291: धटीदान n. (-नं) Giving old cloth to a woman after impregnation. E. धदी, and दान giving.
20293: धत्तूर m. (-रः) The thorn apple: see धुस्तर. E. धेट् to drink, उरच् affix, deriv. irr.
20294: धन r. 1st. cl. (धनति) To sound. r. 3rd cl. (दधन्ति) To bear or produce, (grain, &c.): restricted to the Vedas.
20295: धन n. (-नं) 1 Property of any description, thing, substance, wealth. 2 Wealth in cattle, property in herds. 3 A term of endearment. 4 (In Algebra,) The affirmative quantity or plus. E. धन to produce, (a crop,) affix अच्.
20296: धनकेलि m. (-लिः) KUVERA, the Hindū Plutus; also धनकेलिक. E. धन wealth, and केलि who sports.
20297: धनगर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purseproud. E. धन, and गर्व्वित arrogant.
20298: धनच्छू f. (-च्छूः) The Numidian crane. E. धन the wealth, (of fields,) and च्छो to destroy, affix डू. Note; as a synonym of करेटव्या this word would seem to mean the bird stated: the name itself is more analogous to the Dhanesa of the dialects or the Indian Buceros.
20299: धनजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Springing from wealth. E. धन, and जात born.
20300: धनञ्जय m. (-यः) 1 The deity of fire. 2 A name of ARJUNA. 3 One of the Nāgas or infernal serpents. 4 One of the five vital airs, that which is supposed to fatten. 5 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. धन wealth, जि to conquer or possess, affix खञ्.
20301: धनतृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) Covetousness. E. धन, and तृष्णा thirst.
20302: धनद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Beneficent, liberal, who gives away property, &c. m. (-दः) A name of KUVERA. E. धन wealth, देङ् to drink, or दा to give, affix क.
20303: धनदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Fine, amercement. E. धन, and दण्ड punishment.
20304: धनदर्प m. (-र्पः) Pride of wealth. E. धन, and दर्प pride.
20305: धनदानुज m. (-जः) RĀVAṆA. E. धनद KUVERA, and अनुज younger brother.
20306: धनदायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Liberal, munificent. m. (-यी) 1 The deity of fire. 2 A benefactor, a donor. E. धन wealth, दा to give, णिनि aff.
20307: धनन्ददा f. (-दा) One of the Śaktis, or female personifications of divine power peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. धन wealth, दद to give, affix खश्.
20308: धनपति m. (-तिः) The god of riches, KUVERA. E. धन wealth, and पति master or lord.
20309: धनपिशाचिका f. (-का) Avarice, thirst of wealth. E. धन wealth, पिशाचा a she-demon, affix कन्.
20310: धनपिशाची f. (-ची) Extreme desire of riches, avarice. E. see the preceding.
20311: धनप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fond of wealth. f. (-या) A vegetable, (Ardisia solanacea.) E. धन, and प्रिय dear to.
20312: धनमद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Proud, inflated with the pride of wealth. E. धन wealth, मद to be intoxicated, affix अप्.
20313: धनमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Proceeding from wealth. n. (-लं) Principal, capital. E. धन, and मूल root.
20314: धनलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Miserly, avaricious, greedy of wealth, mercenary. E. धन, and लुब्ध desirous.
20315: धनलोभ m. (-भः) Desire of wealth, greediness, avarice. E. धन, and लोभ desire.
20316: धनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wealthy, opulent. f. (-वती) The constellation Dhaniṣṭha. E. धन wealth, and मतुप् possessive aff.
20317: धनव्यय m. (-यः) Expenditure, extravagance. E. धन, and व्यय expense.
20318: धनसम्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Accumulation of wealth. E. धन, and सम्पत्ति acquirement.
20320: धनस्यक m. (-कः) A plant: see गोक्षुर.
20321: धनहर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Inheriting, an heir. 2 Stealing, a thief. 3 Taking wealth, &c. f. (-री) A sort of perfume, commonly called Cor. E. धन wealth, हृ to steal, affix अप्, or टच्.
20322: धनहरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) A thief, a pilferer. E. see the last.
20323: धनहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Inheriting, an heir. 2 A thief. E. धन, and हारिन् who takes.
20324: धनहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, reduced to poverty. E. धन, and हीन deprived of.
20325: धनागम m. (-मः) Accession of wealth. E. धन, and आगम coming.
20326: धनादान n. (-नं) Acceptance of money. E. धन, and आदान taking.
20327: धनाधिकारिन् mf. (-री-रिणी) An heir, an heiress. m. (-रिः) A treasurer, a collector. E. धन, and अधिकारिन् having a right to.
20328: धनाधिकृत m. (-तः) A treasurer. E. धन, and अधिकृत placed over.
20329: धनाधिप m. (-पः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 A treasurer. E. धन riches, and अधिप lord; also similar compounds, धनाधिपति, &c.
20330: धनाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 A treasurer. E. धन wealth, अध्यक्ष superintendent.
20331: धनापहार m. (-रः) 1 Fine, amercement. 2 Plunder. E. धन, and अपहार taking away.
20332: धनार्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wealthy, opulent. E. धन, and अर्च्चित respected by.
20333: धनार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of property. E. धन, and अर्ज्जन acquiring.
20334: धनार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for wealth, covetous, miserly. E. धन, and अर्थिन् who wants.
20335: धनाशा f. (-शा) Thirst of wealth, longing after riches. E. धन wealth, आशा hope, wish.
20336: धनाश्री f. (-श्रीः) One of the Rāgiṇīs.
20337: धनिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Pious, virtuous, excellent. 2 Rich, opulent. m. (-कः) 1 A wealthy man. 2 A creditor. 3 A husband. 4 Coriander. f. (-का) 1 A virtuous or excellent woman. 2 A wife. 3 A young woman. 4 A tree: see प्रियङ्गु. E. धन wealth, affix ठक्.
20338: धनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Wealthy, opulent. m. (-नी) 1 A rich man. 2 A creditor. E. धन wealth, इनि aff.
20339: धनिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) The twenty-fourth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion; it comprises four stars, apparently α β γ and δ Delphini, and is figured by a drum or tabor. E. धन to produce, (as corn,) affix अच् and मतुप् added, धनवत् again, इष्ठन् added, and मतुप् rejected, fem. affix टाप्.
20340: धनीका f. (-का) A young woman. E. धन wealth, ठक् affix, and the vowel made long.
20341: धनीयक n. (-कं) Coriander seed. E. धन to be produced, (as corn,) affix छ, and कन् added: see धन्याक.
20342: धनु m. (-नुः) 1 A bow. 2 The sign Sagittarius. 3 A tree: see प्रियाल. 4 A measure of four cubits. E. धन here meaning to cast as an arrow, Uṇādi affix उ; also धनुस्.
20343: धनुःकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A bow and arrow. E. धनुस्, and काण्ड an arrow.
20344: धनुःखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A bow, the stick or horns of the bow. E. धनुस्, and खण्ड a part.
20345: धनुःपट m. (-टः) The Piyal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) E. धनुस् a bow, and पट width; bending like a bow.
20346: धनुःशाखा f. (-खा) A plant, from the leaves of which a tough thread is extracted, of which bow strings were formerly made: see मूर्व्वा, (Sanseviera zeylanica, Rox. but called by Sir WM. JONES, Aletris hyacinthoides.) E. धनुस् a bow, शाखा a branch.
20347: धनुःश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant: see the last. E. धनुस् a bow, and श्रेणी a line.
20348: धनुर्गुण mf. (-णः-णा) A bow string. f. (-णा) A plant, from which bow strings are made: see the two last. E. धनुस् a bow, and गुण a string.
20349: धनुर्द्रुम m. (-मः) A bambu. E. धनुस्, and द्रुम a tree.
20350: धनुर्धर m. (-रः) An archer, a bowyer, one armed with a bow. E. धनुस् a bow, and धर who possesses.
20351: धनुर्धारिन् m. (-री) An archer, a bowyer. E. धनुस्, and धारिन् who has.
20352: धनुर्भृत् m. (-त्) An archer. E. धनुस् a bow, and भृत् who possesses: see the last.
20353: धनुर्म्मध्य n. (-ध्यं) The middle part of a bow. E. धनुस् a bow, मध्य the centre.
20354: धनुर्म्मार्ग n. (-र्गं) A curve line. E. धनुस् an are, and मार्ग a road.
20355: धनुर्म्माला f. (-ला) A plant, from the leaves of which bow strings were made: see मूर्व्वा. E. धनुस् a bow, and माला a garland.
20356: धनुर्य्यास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. धनुस् for धन्वन् a dry soil, and यास here said to mean effort; also धन्वयास.
20358: धनुर्वृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A plant; also called Dhāminiya. 2 A bambu. 3 A measure of four cubits. 4 An are, a portion of the circumference of a circle. E. धनुस् a bow, and वृक्ष a tree.
20359: धनुष्कर m. (-रः) A bowyer, an archer. E. धनुस् a bow, and कर who makes or practices.
20360: धनुष्पट m. (-टः) A tree: see धनुःपट. E. धनुस् a bow, पट breadth.
20361: धनुष्पाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Armed with a bow. m. (-णिः) An archer. E. धमुस्, and पाणि hand.
20362: धनुष्मत् m. (-ष्मान्) An archer, a bowyer. E. धनुस् a bow, मतुप् aff.
20363: धनुस् mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Armed with a bow. mn. (-नुः-नु) 1 A bow. 2 Sagittarius, the sign. m. (-नुः) The Piyal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) E. धन to produce, (as grain,) to throw forth, (darts, &c.) Uṇādi affix उसि; also with उ affix धनु, and with ऊ affix, धनू.
20364: धनू m. (-नूः) A bow: see the last.
20365: धनेयक n. (-कं) Coriander: see धन्याक. E. धन grain, ढक् affix, and कन् added.
20366: धनेश m. (-शः) KUVERA. E. धन, and ईश lord.
20367: धनेश्वर m. (-रः) KUVERA, the Hindū PLUTUS. E. धन wealth, ईश्वर lord.
20368: धनैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing or claiming property. m. (-षी) A creditor. E. धन, and ऐषिन् who wishes.
20369: धनोपचय m. (-यः) Accumulation of wealth. E. धन, and उपचय assembling.
20370: धन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 Fortunate, well fated, lucky. 2 Good, virtuous. m. (-न्यः) 1 An infidel, an atheist. 2 A virtuous or fortunate man. f. (-न्या) 1 Emblic myrobalan. 2 A nurse. 3 Coriander. n. (-न्यं) Wealth. E. धन to produce, (grain, &c.) or धन wealth, and यत् affix of fitness.
20371: धन्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Luck, good fortune. E. धन्य, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix धन्यता.
20372: धन्याक n. (-कं) A plant, bearing a small pungent seed used by the Hindus as a condiment, (Coriandrum sativum.) E. धन to produce, (as grain,) deriv. irr.
20373: धन्व n. (-न्वं) A bow: see धन्वन्.
20374: धन्वदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A desart. E. धन्व the same, and दुर्ग strong, hold.
20375: धन्वन् mn. (-न्वा-न्व) A bow. m. (-न्वा) A country scantily supplied with water, a desart, a waste. n. (-न्व) A firm spot, land, ground. E. धन्वि Sautra root, to go or move, (by or on which,) and कनिन् Uṇādi affix; also with अच् affix धन्व.
20376: धन्वन m. (-नः) A medicinal plant, commonly called Dhāminiya or Dhamin.
20377: धन्वन्तरि m. (-रिः) 1 The physician of the gods, who was produced at the churning of the ocean. 2 A celebrated physician; also काशिराज being the same as the preceding in another existence: he appears to have been the founder of the Hindu medical school. 3 The sun. 4 A name of ŚIVA. 5 One of the nine gems of the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA.
20378: धन्वन्तरिग्रस्ता f. (-स्ता) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. धन्वन्तारि, and ग्रस्त eaten.
20379: धन्वयवास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.) E. धन्व dry soil, यु to unite, आसच् affix; also with कन् added धन्वयवासक.
20380: धन्वयास m. (-सः) A plant: see the last; also simply यास, &c.
20381: धन्विन् m. (-न्वी) 1 An archer, a bow-man. 2 A name of ARJUNA. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 4 A wag, a wit, a sharp or shrewd man. E. धन्व a bow, इनि aff.
20382: धम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) One who blows a fire or a trumpet. m. (-मः) 1 A name of the moon. 2 KṚṢṆA. 3 A name of Yama. 4 BRAHMA, or the Supreme Spirit. E. ध्मा to blow, affix श.
20383: धमक m. (-कः) A blacksmith. E. ध्मा to blow, (the forge,) कुन् Uṇādi aff.
20384: धमधमा ind. Blowing reiteratedly, or the sort of sound made by blowing with a bellows or a trumpet.
20385: धमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 One who blows a bellows, a trumpet, &c. 2 Cruel. m. (-नः) 1 A reed, (Arundo tibialis or karka.) 2 Blowing, (a wind instrument.) f. (-निः or -नी) 1 Any tubular vessel of the body, as a vein, a nerve, &c. 2 The neck. 3 Turmerick. 4 A sort of perfume; also हट्टविलासिनी. E. धम from ध्मा, to blow, &c. affix युच्, fem. affix इन् or ङीष् or ध्मा as before, Uṇādi affix अनि, and ङीप् optionally added.
20386: धम्मल m. (-लः) The breast ornamented with gold or jewels: see धम्मिल्ल.
20387: धम्मिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) Braided and ornamented hair, tied round the head, and intermixed with flowers, pearls, &c. E. धम a Sautra root, to breathe, affix विच्, धम्; मिल to meet, लच् affix, and the two conjoined.
20388: धय mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं) Who or what drinks. f. (-या) A little girl, female infant. E. घे to drink, affix श.
20389: धर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what has or holds. m. (-रः) 1 A mountain. 2 A flock of cotton. 3 The tortoise Avatāra. 4 One of the demigods called VASUS. f. (-रा) 1 The earth. 2 The uterus or womb. 3 Marrow. 4 A vessel of the body. 5 A golden globe or heap of valuables, representing the earth, and given to Brahmans. E. धृञ् to have or hold, to contain or support, &c. affix अच्, or ट fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
20390: धरण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 Holding, possessing, having. 2 A sort of measure, a weight of ten Palas. 3 A weight of silver, sixteen Māṣas. m. (-णः) 1 The Himāla mountain considered as king of mountains. 2 The sun. 3 A world. 4 A breast, a female breast. 5 Rice. 6 A ridge of land answering the purpose of a bridge, the edge of a river, the skirt of a mountain, a bridge. f. (-णी) 1 The earth. 2 The silk cotton tree. 3 A vessel of the body. 4 An esculent root. E. धृ to hold, to uphold or support, affix ल्युट्, fem. affix ङीप्.
20391: धरणि f. (-णिः) The earth. E. धृ to be contained, (animals, &c.) Uṇādi affix अणि; also धरणी as above.
20392: धरणिधर m. (-रः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. धरणि the earth, and धर who sustains; also धरणिधर.
20393: धरणिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Being or staying on earth. E. धरणि, and स्थ what stays or is.
20394: धरणीकन्द m. (-न्दः) An esculent root or bulb. E. धरणी the earth, कन्द a root.
20395: धरणीकीलक m. (-कः) A mountain. E. धरणी the earth, कीलक a pin or bolt.
20396: धरणीधर m. (-रः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A mountain. 3 A tortoise: see धरणिधर.
20397: धरणीपूर m. (-रः) The ocean. E. धरणी the earth, पूर to surround completely, affix अच्.
20398: धरणीप्लव m. (-वः) The ocean. E. धरणी the earth, and प्लव what swims; in which the earth floats.
20399: धरणीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of ŚIVA. E. धरणी, and ईश्वर lord; lord of the world.
20400: धरणीसुता f. (-ता) A name of SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA. E. धरणी the earth, and सुता daughter; the earth-born; being turned up from the soil by a plough, as JANAKA was ploughing a spot to prepare it for a sacrifice.
20401: धरसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Like a mountain, as huge as, &c. E. धर, and संस्थ what is, or is like.
20402: धराकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba;) also धराकदम्बक.
20403: धरात्मज m. (-जः) The planet Mars or its regent. E. धरा the earth, and आत्मज son, terræ-filius; also similar compounds, as धरासुत, धरापुत्र, &c.
20404: धराधर m. (-रः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A mountain. E. धरा the earth, and धर who or what sustains.
20405: धराशय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sleeping on the ground. E. धरा, and शय who sleeps.
20406: धरामर m. (-रः) A Brahman. E. धरा, and अमर a deity.
20407: धरित्री f. (-त्री) The earth. E. धृ to contain, (beings,) इत्र Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
20408: धरिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Form, figure, semblance. 2 A balance, a pair of scales. E. धृ to have or hold, Uṇādi affix इमनिच्.
20409: धरिममेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measurable by weight. E. धरिम, and मेय to be measured.
20410: धरुण m. (-णः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 Heaven, paradise. 3 Water. 4 Opinion, conception. E. धृ to hold or uphold, affix उनन्.
20411: धर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be upheld or supported. 2 To be had or possessed. 3 To be placed or fixed. 4 To be fallen or alighted by. E. धृ to hold, तव्य aff.
20412: धर्त्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Who or what has or holds. E. धृ to have, तृन् aff.
20413: धर्त्त्र n. (-र्त्त्रं) 1 A house. 2 Sacrifice. 3 Virtue, moral merit. E. धृ to contain, Uṇādi affix त्र.
20414: धर्म्म mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं) 1 Virtue, moral and religious merit, according to the law and the Vedas. 2 Usage, practice, the customary observances of caste, sect, &c. 3 Duty, especially that enjoined by the Vedas. 4 Fitness, propriety. 5 Nature, character, proper or natural state or disposition. 6 Innocence, innoxiousness. 7 Resemblance. 8 Any sacrifice. 9 An Upaniṣad or theological portion of a Veda. 10 Any peculiar or prescribed practice or duty; thus, giving, alms, &c. is the dharma of a householder; administering justice, the dharma of a king; piety, that of a Brahman; courage, that of a Kṣatriya, &c. 11 Kind and virtuous speech or discourse. 12 Law. m. (-र्म्मः) 1 A name of YAMA, ruler of the lower regions, and judge of the dead. 2 A drinker of the juice of the acid asclepias, at certain sacrifices. 3 Virtue personified, born from the right breast of BRAHMĀ. 4 A bow. 5 Associating with the virtuous. 6 The fifteenth of the twenty-four Jaina pontiffs of the present age. 7 A pious or virtuous man. 8 The bull of ŚIVA, a personification or type of virtue. E. धृ to maintain or support, &c. Uṇādi affix मन्, what supports all men.
20415: धर्म्मकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Acting according to some or any indispensable act of piety or duty. E. धर्म्म, and कर्म्मन् act.
20416: धर्म्मकाय m. (-यः) A Jina or Jaina deified saint. E. धर्म्म virtue, and काय body; virtue personified.
20417: धर्म्मकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Any indispensable act of religion, &c. 2 Religious or virtuous conduct. E. धर्म्म piety, and कार्य्य act.
20418: धर्म्मकील m. (-लः) An edict, a royal order, decree, or grant. E. धर्म्म virtue, कील proper stay; also with कन् added, धर्म्मकीलक m. (-कः)
20419: धर्म्मकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Any moral or religious observance. E. धर्म्म, and कृत्य to be done.
20420: धर्म्मकेतु m. (-तुः) A Jaina deified saint. E. धर्म्म virtue, केत् an emblem or banner.
20421: धर्म्मकोष m. (-षः) Store or treasure of virtue. E. धर्म्म, and कोष treasury.
20422: धर्म्मक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Righteous conduct, acting according to law. 2 Any religious act. E. धर्म्म, and क्रिया act.
20423: धर्म्मक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) A plain in the north-west of India near Delhi, the scene of the great battle between the Kurus and Pāṇḍus. m. (-त्रः) A man of piety and virtue. E. धर्म्म virtue, holiness, and क्षेत्र a field, literally or figuratively.
20424: धर्म्मग्रहण n. (-णं) Observance of moral or religious institutes, accepting or following the law. E. धर्म्म, and ग्रहण taking.
20425: धर्म्मघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Immoral, unlawful, contrary to law or duty. E. धर्म्म, and घ्न what destroys.
20426: धर्म्मचक्र m. (-क्रः) A Jaina deified saint. E. धर्म्म, and चक्र a wheel, &c.
20427: धर्म्मचक्रभृत् m. (-त्) A Jaina deified saint. E. धर्म्म virtue, चक्र a circle, and भृत् possessing.
20428: धर्म्मचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Virtuous, moral, dutiful. f. (-रिणी) A virtuous woman, an honest wife. E. धर्म्म duty, चर to follow, affix णिनि and ङीष्.
20429: धर्म्मचिन्तन n. (-नं) Virtuous reflection. E. धर्म्म, and चिन्तन reflecting.
20430: धर्म्मचिन्ता f. (-न्ता) Virtuous reflection. E. धर्म्म, and चिन्ता reflection: see the last.
20431: धर्म्मजीवन m. (-नः) A Brahman who lives according to rule, one who practices the outward acts of the law. E. धर्म्म, and जीवन living.
20432: धर्म्मज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing one's duty, conversant with virtue. E. धर्म्म, and ज्ञ who knows.
20433: धर्म्मज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge of moral, legal, and religious duty. E. धर्म्म, and ज्ञान knowledge.
20434: धर्म्मण m. (-णः) 1 A sort of tree, commonly Dhāminiya. 2 A kind of large snake, not poisonous, commonly Dhemana.
20435: धर्म्मतस् ind. Rightly, justly, righteously. E. धर्म्म, and तसि aff.
20436: धर्म्मत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Morality, piety. 2 Inherent nature, peculiar property, &c. E. धर्म्म, and त्व aff.
20437: धर्म्मद्रवी f. (-वी) The Ganges. E. धर्म्म virtue, द्रु to shed, affix अच्,
20438: धर्म्मद्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Wicked. (-ही) A Rākṣasa. E. धर्म्म, and द्रोहिन् rebellious.
20439: धर्म्मधातु m. (-तुः) A Jaina saint. E. धर्म्म virtue, धातु essence, root.
20440: धर्म्मध्वजिन् m. (-जी) A religious hypocrite or impostor, one who makes a livelihood by assumed devotion. E. धर्म्म piety, ध्वज an emblem, इनि affix; having every outward mark of piety, matted hair, ragged garments, &c.
20441: धर्म्मनिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Piety, virtue. E. धर्म्म, and निबन्ध attachment.
20442: धर्म्मनिबन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Pious, holy, engaged in or conducive to virtue. E. धर्म्म, निबन्ध connexion, and इनि aff.
20443: धर्म्मनिष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Duty, moral or religious observance, discharge or fulfilment of duty. E. धर्म्म, and निष्पत्ति completion.
20444: धर्म्मपत्तन n. (-नं) 1 Pepper. 2 The name of a district or city. E. धर्म्म virtue, पत्तन a city; pepper grows there, whence is said to be its name.
20445: धर्म्मपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A man's first wife and of the same class. E. धर्म्म, and पत्नी a wife.
20446: धर्म्मपत्र n. (-त्रं) Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.) E. धर्म्म sacrifice, and पत्र leaf.
20447: धर्म्मपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Righteous, pious. E. धर्म्म, and पर addicted to.
20448: धर्म्मपाठक m. (-कः) A teacher of law. E. धर्म्म, and पाठक who teaches.
20449: धर्म्मपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A name of the Pāṇḍu prince, YUDHIṢṬHIRA. 2 One so considered, as a son for piety or duty; also धर्म्मपुत्त्रक. E. धर्म्म a proper name, and पुत्त्र a son, the son of DHARMA or YAMA.
20450: धर्म्मप्रधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Eminent in piety. E. धर्म्म, and प्रधान chief.
20451: धर्म्मप्रवक्तृ m. (-क्ता) A teacher or expounder of the law. E. धर्म्म, and प्रवक्तृ who explains.
20452: धर्म्मभागिनी f. (-नी) A virtuous and amiable wife. E. धर्म्म, and भागिनी who shares.
20453: धर्म्मभाणक m. (-कः) A lecturer, a public reader of the Mahābhārata and other sacred works which are read aloud, and explained to large assemblies of Hindūs at particular seasons. E. धर्म्म virtue, and भण to utter, to speak, affix ण्वुल्.
20454: धर्म्मभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A fellow religious student. E. धर्म्म, and भ्रातृ a brother.
20455: धर्म्मभिक्षुक m. (-कः) A mendicant Brahman, one who is so, or has become so from meritorious motives. E. धर्म्म, and भिक्षुक a beggar.
20456: धर्म्ममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Moral, righteous, made up or replete with virtue, &c. E. धर्म्म, and मयट् aff.
20457: धर्म्ममूल n. (-लं) The foundation of Hindū law and religion (the Vedas.) E. धर्म्म, and मूल root.
20458: धर्म्मयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Virtuous, righteous. E. धर्म्म virtue, यु to go, affix क्विप्.
20459: धर्म्मयुज् mfn. (-युक्) Righteous, pious, just. E. धर्म्म virtue, युज to join, affix क्विप्.
20460: धर्म्मराज m. (-जः) 1 A Jina or deified saint, according to the Jaina sect. 2 A name of YAMA, regent of the dead. 3 A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. 4 Also of ARJUNA. 5 A king in general. E. धर्म्म virtue, justice, and राज who shines, affix अच्; or राज from राजन a king; lord of justice.
20461: धर्म्मरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Illegal, immoral. E. धर्म्म, and रोधिन् opposed to.
20462: धर्म्मलक्षण n. (-णं) An essential ingredient in ethics or law, (as place, time, &c.) E. धर्म्म, and लक्षण mark.
20463: धर्म्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-बत्) Virtuous, pious, upright, just. E. धर्म्मं as above, मतुप् poss. aff.
20464: धर्म्मवासर m. (-रः) The day of full moon. E. धर्म्म virtue, and वासर a day; peculiar sacrifices being performed on this day.
20465: धर्म्मवाहन m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA. E. धर्म्म the bull of this god, virtue typified, and वाहन a vehicle.
20466: धर्म्मविद् mfn. (-द् or -त्) 1 Virtuous, pious, moral. 2 Acquainted with the law. E. धर्म्म, and विद् who knows.
20467: धर्म्मविधि f. (-धिः) Course of law, legal precepts or injunctions. E. धर्म्म, and विधि manner.
20468: धर्म्मविप्लव m. (-वः) Immorality, wickedness. E. धर्म्म, and विप्लव submersion.
20469: धर्म्मविवेचन n. (-नं) Judicial investigation. E. धर्म्म, and विवेचन deliberation.
20470: धर्म्मशाला f. (-ला) A court of justice, a tribunal. E. धर्म्म justice, and शाला a hall.
20471: धर्म्मशास्त्र n. (-स्त्वं) 1 The body or code of Hindu law. 2 Any work on the subject. E. धर्म्म virtue, and शास्र a treatise.
20472: धर्म्मशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Virtuous, just, pious. E. धर्म्म virtue, शील attached to.
20473: धर्म्मसंहिता f. (-ता) A code of laws, especially the work of some saint or divine person, as MANU, YĀJÑAVALKYA, &c. E. धर्म्म virtue, and सम् prefixed to धा, to have or possess, affix क्त, fem. affix टाप्; a compilation made for the purpose of teaching and maintaining virtue.
20474: धर्म्मसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Virtue. 2 Hypocrisy. E. धर्म्म, and सङ्ग addiction to, real or seeming.
20475: धर्म्मसन्तानसू mfn. (-सूः-सूः-सू) Virtuous, producing virtuous offspring or actions. E. धर्म्म, सन्तान progeny, सू who bears.
20476: धर्म्मसभा f. (-भा) A tribunal, a court of justice. E. धर्म्म justice, and सभा assembly.
20477: धर्म्मसाधन n. (-नं) Any act or virtue essential to a system of duties. E. धर्म्म, and साधन instrument.
20479: धर्म्मसुत m. (-तः) A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. धर्म्म YAMA, and सुत a son; also धर्म्मसूनु, धर्म्मात्मज, &c.
20480: धर्म्मात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A saint, a pious or virtuous person. E. घर्म्म virtue, आत्मन् self.
20481: धर्म्माधर्म्मपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Ordeal by drawing lots or slips of black and white paper. E. धर्म्म, अधर्म्म iniquity, परीक्षा trial.
20482: धर्म्माधिकरण n. (-णं) A court of justice. m. (-णः) A judge. E. धर्म्म, and अधिकरण supervision.
20483: धर्म्माधिकरणिन् m. (-णी) A judge, a sovereign, an administrator of the law. E. धर्म्माधिकरण, and affix इनि.
20484: धर्म्माधिकार m. (-रः) The office of a judge. E. धर्म्म, and अधिकार office.
20485: धर्म्माधिकारिन् m. (-री) A judge. E. धर्म्माधिकार, and इनि aff.
20486: धर्म्माध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) A magistrate, a judge, &c. E. धर्म्म justice, and अध्यक्ष superintendent.
20487: धर्म्मानुष्ठान n. (-नं) Virtuous or moral conduct, behaviour according to law. E. धर्म्म, and अनुष्ठान act or condition.
20488: धर्म्मानुसार m. (-रः) Conformity to law or virtue, course or practice of duty. E. धर्म्म, and अनुसार following.
20489: धर्म्मापेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wicked, immoral, unrighteous. n. (-तं) Immorality, vice. E. धर्म्म, and अपेत deviated.
20490: धर्म्माभिमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Virtuous. E. धर्म्म, अभि to or inclined to, मनस् the mind.
20491: धर्म्मारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A forest into which DHARMA once retired. E. धर्म्म, and अरण्य a wood.
20492: धर्म्मासन n. (-नं) The seat of the judge, the bench. E. धर्म्मं, and आसन a seat.
20493: धर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) 1 Virtuous, pious, just. 2 Endowed with a peculiar property or faculty. E. धर्म्म, and इनि poss. aff.
20494: धर्म्मिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very pious or virtuous. E. धर्म्म, and इष्ठन् aff.
20495: धर्म्मीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very pious, moral, &c. E. धर्म्म, and ईयसुन् aff.
20496: धर्म्मोपदेश m. (-शः) Moral or religious instruction. E. धर्म्म, and उपदेश advice.
20497: धर्म्मोपदेशक m. (-कः) A Guru or spiritual preceptor. E. धर्म्म virtue, उप before दिश to show, affix वुन्; pointing out good and evil to his scholars.
20498: धर्म्मोपध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Hypocritical. E. धर्म्म, and उपधि fraud, अच aff.
20499: धर्म्मोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Virtuous, moral. E. धर्म्म, and उपेत possessed of.
20500: धर्म्म्य mfn. (-र्म्म्यः-र्म्म्या-र्म्मां) 1 Conformable or according to justice or morality. 2 Obtainable by virtue or justice. E. धर्म्म as above, यत् aff.
20501: धर्म्म्यविवाह m. (-हः) Legal marriage of five sorts, as the Brāhma, Daiva, Ārṣa, Gandharba, and Prājāpatya. E. धर्म्मा, and विवाह marriage.
20502: धर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Contumely, overbearing. 3 Impatience. 4 Paralysing, rendering weak or impotent. 5 Injury, wrong. 6 Restraint. 7 Copulation. 8 A eunuch. E. धृष to be vain, affix अच्.
20503: धर्षक m. (-कः) A dancer, an actor, a mime. E. धृष to be vain or presumptuous, affix वुन्.
20504: धर्षकारिणी f. (-णी) A violated virgin. E. धर्ष, कृ to act, affix णिनि.
20505: धर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Disrespect, contumely, overbearingness or contempt. 2 Copulation. 3 Arrogance, vanity. f. (-णिः-णी) An unchaste woman. E. धृष to be arrogant, &c. affix ल्युट्.
20506: धर्षवर m. (-रः) A eunuch superintending the women's apartments. E. धर्ष copulation, वृ to cherish, affix अप्.
20507: धर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proud, insolent. 2 Unbearing, impatient. 3 Overpowered, smitten. n. (-तं) Copulation, cohabitation. 2 Contumely. 3 Pride. f. (-ता) An unchaste woman. E. धृष to be vain or impatient, affix क्त.
20508: धर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 1 Proud, arrogant. 2 Cohabiting. f. (-णी) A dishonest or unchaste woman. E. धर्ष cohabitation, इनि and ङीष् affs.
20509: धलण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A small tree, commonly called Dhalākara; also धलण्डक.
20510: धव (इ,) धवि r. 1st cl. (धन्वति) To go or move: this is considered sometimes as a Sautra root.
20511: धव m. (-वः) 1 A husband. 2 A man. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. धू to make tremble, (children, &c.) affix अप्.
20512: धवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 White. 2 Handsome, beautiful. m. (-लः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 A capital ox. 3 The Grislea tomentosa. 4 Camphor. 5 An inferior Rāga or mode of music. n. (-लं) White pepper. f. (-ला or -ली) A white cow, &c. E. धाव to be clean or pure, कलच् affix, and the radical vowel made short.
20513: धवलपक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A goose. 2 The fortnight of the moon's increase. E. धवल, and पक्ष a wing or fortnight.
20514: धवलमृत्तिका f. (-का) Chalk. E. धवल white, मृत्तिका earth.
20515: धवलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White, whitened. E. धवल, and इतच्.
20516: धवलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White, made white. E. धवल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
20517: धवलीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become white. E. धवल, and भूत become, च्चि aff.
20518: धवलोत्पल n. (-लं) The white esculent water lily. E. धवल white, and उत्पल a lotus.
20519: धवाणक m. (-कः) Air, wind. E. धू to agitate, (the leaves of trees, &c.) and आणक Uṇādi aff.
20520: धवित्र n. (-त्रं) A Pankhā or fan, made of antelope's skin, and used especially for blowing a sacrificial fire. E. धू to agitate, इच aff.
20521: धा (डु, ञ,) डुधाञ् r. 3rd cl. (दधाति धत्ते) 1 To hold or support. 2 To nurture, to maintain. 3 To give. 4 To have, to possess. With अनु and सम् prefixed, To search after. With अपि, To cover. With अभि, 1 To speak, to speak to or address. 2 To promulgate. 3 To show. With अभि and सम, To overcome. With अव, 1 To be careful. 2 To attend to. With आङ्, To take, to receive. With उप and आङ्, To support. With उप, 1 To uphold. 2 To do, to perform. With नि, 1 To take up or hold up. 2 To place in or upon. 3 To be born or produced. 4 To hold. With परि, To assume, to put on, as clothes, &c. With प्र and नि, 1 To hold or support. 2 To elevate or exalt, to dignify. 3 To admit. With प्र. 1 To be chief or first. 2 To send. With प्रति and वि, To do, to perform. With वि, 1 To do, to execute, to act. 3 To act conformably to religious ordinances, to execute the precepts of the Vedas. 3 To choose, to select. 4 To provide. 5 To order or direct. 6 To promise. 7 To give. With वि and अव, To hide, to veil, to conceal. With सम, 1 To place, to place firmly, to fix. 2 To unite, to combine, to hold together. 3 To shoot at a mark. With सम and प्र, To doubt, to discuss; (also with प्रति and सम्.) With सम and आङ्, To instruct, to teach. With सम and नि, To place or have near at hand. In the causal with उप, To understand.
20522: धा m. (-धाः) 1 A possessor, a holder, a container, &c. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 VṚHASPATI. E. धा to have, affix विच्.
20523: धाक m. (-कः) 1 An ox. 2 Food. 3 Boiled rice. 4 A post. E. धा to have or hold, Uṇādi affix क.
20524: धाटी f. (-टी) Advancing towards or confronting an enemy.
20525: धाणक m. (-कः) A weight of gold, a coin of that metal, the division of a Dīnāra. E. धा to contain, Uṇādi affix आणक.
20526: धातकी f. (-की) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. धा to have, affix ण्वुल्, तन् inserted.
20527: धातु m. (-तुः) 1 A principle or humour of the body, as phlegm, wind, and bile. 2 Any constituent part of the body, as blood, flesh, &c. 3 A primary or elementary substance, viz. earth, water, fire, air, and Ākāśa or atmosphere. 4 The property of a primary element, odour, flavour, colour, touch, and sound. 5 An organ of sense. 6 A mineral, a fossil. 7 A metal. 8 A grammatical root; in Sanskrit this radical performs no other office, and cannot be used as a word without undergoing some change. E. धा to possess, to contain, (life, substance, &c.) तुन् aff.
20528: धातुकाशीश n. (-शं) Red sulphate of iron. E. धातु mineral, and काशीश the green sulphate.
20529: धातुघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Sour gruel, prepared from the fermentation of rice water. E. धातु chyle, and घ्न destroying; also similar compounds.
20530: धातुनाशन n. (-नं) Sour gruel: see the last. E. धातु, and नाशन injuring.
20531: धातुप m. (-पः) The alimentary juice or chyle. E. धातु an essential constituent of the body, and प what cherishes.
20532: धातुपुष्पिका f. (-का) A plant: see धातृपुष्पिका; also धातुपुष्पी.
20533: धातुभृत् m. (-त्) 1 A mountain. 2 A robust man. mfn. (-भृत्) Promoting the animal secretions. E. धातु a mineral, and भृत् what contains.
20534: धातुमाक्षिक n. (-कं) A mineral substance, a sulphuret of iron. E. धातु mineral, and माक्षिक the same substance.
20535: धातुमारिणी f. (-णी) Borax. E. धातु a metal, मृ to perish, in the causal form, णिनि and ङीप् affixes; the borate of soda is generally used in India as a flux.
20536: धातुराजक m. (-कः) Semen, the seminal fluid. E. धातु animal fluid, &c. राज chief, कन् added.
20537: धातुवल्लभ n. (-भं) Borax. E. धातु, and वल्लभ friend, a flux.
20538: धातुवादिन् m. (-दी) An assayer, a miner, a mineralogist. E. धातु a mineral, वद to speak or describe, affix णिनि.
20539: धातुवैरिन् m. (-री) Sulphur. E. धातु a metal, and वैरिन् an enemy; tarnishing metallic lustre, &c.
20540: धातुशेखर m. (-रः) Green sulphate of iron, or green vitriol. E. धातु a mineral, and शेखर crest or chief.
20541: धातूपल m. (-लः) Chalk. E. धातु a mineral, and उपला stone.
20542: धातृ m. (-ता) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A title of VIṢṆU. 3 A father, a parent. f. (-त्री) 1 A mother. 2 A foster-mother, a nurse. 3 The earth. 4 Emblick myrobalan. mfn. (-ता-ती-तृ) 1 A cherisher, a protector, fostering, nourishing. 2 Having, containing, possessing, a possessor, &c. E. धा to have, to nourish, &c. affix तृच्.
20543: धातृपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A saint, also called SANATKUMĀRA. E. धातृ BRAHMĀ, and पुत्त्र the son.
20544: धातृपुष्पिका f. (-का) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa, Rox.) E. धातृ cherishing, पुष्प a flower, ङीष् added, धातृपुष्पी and कन् added; also without the pleonasm, धातृपुष्पी, f. (-ष्पी).
20545: धात्रिका f. (-का) Emblick myrobalan. E. कन् added to धात्री.
20546: धात्रीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 An actor. 2 A foster-brother. E. धात्री a nurse, and पुत्त्र a son.
20547: धात्रीफल n. (-लं) The fruit of the emblic myrobalan. E. धात्री Phyllanthus emblica, and फल fruit.
20548: धात्रेयी f. (-यी) 1 A sort of confidante, a foster-sister so employed. 2 A wet-nurse. E. धातृ a nurse, ढक् affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
20549: धाना f. plu. (-नाः) 1 Fried barley or rice. sin. (-नः) 1 Coriander, (Coriandrum sativum.) 2 Grain fried, and reduced to powder. 3 A bud, a shoot. E. धा to nourish, न Uṇādi aff.
20550: धानाका f. plu. (-काः) Fried barley or rice. E. धाना as above, कन् added.
20551: धानाचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) The meal or flour of fried barley, rice, &c. E. धाना fried grain, चूर्ण powder, dust.
20552: धानी f. (-नी) 1 Coriander. 2 A granary, a receptacle. 3 The site of a habitation. 4 The name of a river. 5 What has or contains, used in composition, as राजधानी a royal capital, having the king's presence; मत्स्यधानी a net, &c. E. धा to have, affix युच्, fem. affix ङीप्.
20553: धानुष्क m. (-ष्कः) A bowyer, an archer. E. धनुस् a bow, ठञ् affix. f. (-ष्का) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera). E. धनुष्क an archer, अण् affix, and fem. affix टाप्, or धनुस् a bow, ठन् aff.
20554: धानुष्य m. (-ष्यः) A bambu. E. धनुस् as above, यञ् aff.
20555: धानेय n. (-यः) Coriander, (Coriandrum sativum.) E. धन grain, &c. aff. ढक्; also with कन् added, धानेयक.
20557: धान्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Corn in general, but especially rice, (Oriza sativa.) 2 Coriander. 3 A measure equal to four Sesamum seeds. E. धा to nourish (mankind), Uṇādi affix यत्, and नुट् augment.
20558: धान्यक n. (-कं) Coriander, (C. sativum.) E. कन् added to धान्य; also धन्याक and धान्याक.
20559: धान्यकल्क n. (-ल्कं) Bran, chaff, straw. E. धान्य, and कल्क dirt or sediment.
20560: धान्यकोष्ठक n. (-कं) A granary, a basket, a cupboard or small shed of matting, &c. for keeping rice. E. धान्य rice, कोष्ठ a granary, and कन् added.
20561: धान्यचमस m. (-सः) Rice flattened by threshing after it has been steeped, and fried in the husk. E. धान्य grain, and चमस a sort of cake.
20562: धान्यधेनु f. (-नुः) A heap of rice to be presented to Brahmans. E. धान्य, and धेनु a cow.
20563: धान्यमाय m. (-यः) A corn-seller, &c. E. धान्य grain, मा to measure, अण् aff.
20564: धान्यराज m. (-जः) Barley. E. धान्य, and राजा king.
20565: धान्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Abounding in corn, having abundance of it. E. धान्य, and मतुप् poss. aff.
20566: धान्यवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Lending grain at interest; receiving a usurious return for a loan of seed corn supplied to the peasants. E. धान्य corn, वर्द्धन increasing.
20567: धान्यवीज n. (-जं) Coriander. E. धान्य, and वीज seed.
20568: धान्यवीर m. (-रः) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus max.) E. धान्य, and वीर best.
20569: धान्यशीर्षक n. (-कं) The ear or spike of corn. E. धान्य, with शीर्षक the top or head.
20570: धान्यसङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) A store or magazine of grain. E. धान्य, and सङ्ग्रह collection.
20571: धान्यसार m. (-रः) Grain after threshing. E. धान्य corn, and सार essence.
20572: धान्याक n. (-कं) Coriander. E. अण् added to धन्याक.
20573: धान्याचल m. (-लः) A pile of grain for presentation to Brahmans. E. धान्य, and अचल a mountain.
20574: धान्याम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sour gruel made of the fermentation of rice water. E. धान्य rice, and अम्ल sour.
20575: धान्यारि m. (-रिः) A rat. E. धान्य, and अरि a foe.
20576: धान्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) Wealth in rice or grain. E. धान्य, and अर्थ wealth.
20577: धान्यास्थि n. (-स्थि) Grain after threshing. E. धान्य, and अस्थि a bone.
20578: धान्योत्तम n. (-मं) Rice. E. धान्य, and उत्तम best.
20579: धामन् n. (-म) 1 The body. 2 A house, a dwelling. 3 Dignity, consequence, eminence. 4 Spirit, pride, especially martial pride, heroism. 5 Light, splendour, radiance. 6 A ray of light. 7 A place, a spot, a country. 8 Birth. E. धा to contain, (life, a tenant, &c.) and मनिन् aff.
20580: धामनिधि m. (-धिः) The sun. E. धाम light, निधि a nest or receptacle.
20581: धामनी f. (-नी) Any tubular vessel of the body: see धमनी.
20582: धामवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Splendid, luminous. 2 Eminent, exalted, illustrious. 3 Heroic. E. धामन्, and मतुप् aff.
20583: धामार्ग्गव n. (-वः) 1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 A plant, a sort of Ghosha, with white flowers. E. धामन् a dwelling, मार्ग a road, ब to go or approach, affix क, deriv. irr.
20584: धाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having, possessing, or who has or possesses. E. धा to have, ण aff.
20585: धायस् mfn. (-याः-याः-यः) An upholder. E. धा to have, &c. असुन् Uṇādi affix; also with a final vowel added, धायस.
20586: धाय्य m. (-य्यः) A Purohita or family priest. f. (-य्या) A prayer for exciting fire, upon the addition of fuel. E. irregularly derived from धी to contain, with ण्यत् aff.
20587: धार n. (-रं) Water derived from rain. m. (-रः) 1 A sort of stone. 2 Debt. 3 Slight sprinkling rain. 4 Frost. 5 End, bound, a line or limit. 6 A deep place, a depth. f. (-रा) 1 A horse's pace, as the trot, canter, &c. 2 The van of an army. 3 The sharp edge of a sword or any cutting instrument. 4 The flowing, running, oozing, or distilling, &c. of any liquid, the motion of a fluid, stream, current, &c. 5 Offspring. 6 A leak, a flaw, a hole in a pitcher, &c. 7 Excellence. 8 The wheel of a carriage. 9 A garden wall or fence, a hedge, &c. 10 The edge of a mountain. 11 Quantity, multitude. 12 A heavy shower falling in large drops, or hail. 13 Fame. 14 Likeness. 15 Custom, usage. 16 The capital of BHOJA. 17 Pouring a stream of water upon an image to get rid of a fever. E. धृ to fall, to uphold, &c. in the causal form, and अङ् and टाप् affs.
20588: धारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what holds or contains, a vessel or receptacle of any kind. m. (-कः) A water pot. E. धृ to have, ण्वुल् aff.
20589: धारण n. (-णं) Holding, having, keeping, maintaining. f. (-णा) 1 Continuance in rectitude, keeping in the right way. 2 Fortitude, firmness, steadiness, resolution. 3 A particular religious exercise; keeping the mind collected, the breath suspended, and all natural wants restrained; steady, immoveable abstraction. 4 Mental retention, memory. 5 Understanding, intellect. 6 Believing, conviction. 7 Certainty, conclusion. 8 Positive precept or injunction. 9 Debt. f. (-णी) 1 Any tubular vessel of the body. 2 A mystical verse or charm, or collection of such verses, among the Bauddhas. 3 A row or line. E. धृ to hold, (purpose, intent, virtue, &c.) affix ल्युट् or युच्.
20590: धारणक m. (-कः) A debtor. E. धारण a debt, कन् aff.
20591: धारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be held or retained, to be adhered to. E. धृ to hold, अनीयर् aff.
20592: धारय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who or what has or possesses. E. धृ to have, causal form, श aff.
20593: धारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Having, possessing. 2 Acquainted with, versed in. 3 Holding as doctrine, believing, maintaining. E. धृ to have, शतृ aff.
20594: धारयित्री f. (-त्री) The earth. E. धृ to contain, in the causal form, तृच् aff.
20595: धाराकदम्बक m. (-कः) A sort of Kadamba tree.
20596: धाराङ्कुर m. (-रः) 1 Thin rain. 2 Hail. 3 Advancing before an army by way of defiance to an enemy. E. धारा rain, and अङ्कुर shoot or sprout.
20597: धाराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A sword, a scimitar. 2 A place of pilgrimage. E. धारा the edge of a sword, &c. and अङ्ग body.
20598: धाराट m. (-टः) 1 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 2 A horse. 3 A cloud. 4 A furious elephant. E. धारा rain, &c. अट who goes.
20599: धाराध्वनि f. (-निः) The sound of falling rain or of the flowing of any fluid. E. धारा, and ध्वनि sound.
20600: धाराधर m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 A sword. E. धारा rain or an edge, and धर what has.
20601: धारायन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A scent bottle, a sprinkling vase or ewer, a sort of censer. E. धारा, and यन्त्र an instrument.
20602: धारावनि m. (-निः) Air, wind. E. धारा thin rain, वन to sound, affix इ.
20603: धाराविष m. (-षः) A crooked sword, a scimitar, a sabre. E. धारा, and विष poison; whose edge is as fatal as venom.
20604: धाराश्रु n. (-श्रु) A flood of tears. E. धारा, and अश्रु a tear.
20605: धारासम्पात m. (-तः) A hard shower, a heavy fall of rain. E. धारा rain, सम् implying quantity or accumulation, and पात falling.
20606: धारासार m. (-रः) A heavy fall of rain, a large drop or shower. E. धारा, and आसार sprinkling.
20607: धारिणी f. (-णी) 1 The earth. 2 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) E. धृ, and घिणुन् aff.
20608: धारित n. (-तं) A horse's trot; also धारितकंः see धौरितकं.
20609: धारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि 1 Having, holding, keeping, possessing. 2 Edged. m. (-री) A sort of tree: see पीलु. E. धारा an edge, &c. इनि aff.
20610: धारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Who drinks or sucks, a drinker, a sucker. E. धे to drink, रु affix, form special.
20611: धार्त्तराष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A sort of goose, with black legs and bill. 2 A kind of snake. 3 DURYODHANA or any other descendant of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. धृतराष्ट्र the name of a king or a bird, &c. and अण् affix of descent.
20612: धार्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Virtuous, pious, just. E. धर्म्म virtue, affix ठञ्.
20613: धार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be born or upheld, to be contained, &c. 2 To be kept or detained. 3 To be determined. E. धृ to hold, ण्यत् aff.
20614: धार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being held, maintained, &c. E. धृ to uphold, pass. v. शानच् aff.
20615: धार्य्यमाणत्व n. (-त्वं) Property. E. त्व added to the last.
20616: धार्ष्ट्य n. (-र्ष्ट्यं) Boldness, confidence, arrogance. E. धृष्टि bold, and ष्यञ् aff.
20617: धाव (उ) धावु r. 1st cl. (धावति-ते) 1 To go or move. 2 To run. 3 To cleanse. 4 To be clean or pure. With अनु, 1 To know. 2 To run after. With अभि prefixed, To approach, to come before. With आङ्, To alight. With परि, To run fast. With वि, To shed or sprinkle. With सम् and उग्र, To run to meet.
20618: धावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Running, going, swift, expeditious. 2 Cleaning, what cleans or cleanses. E. धाव to go, वुन् aff.
20619: धावत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Running, going quickly. E. धाव to go, शतृ aff.
20620: धावन n. (-नं) 1 Going, motion. 2 Cleansing, purifying. f. (-निः) or (-नी) A sort of creeping plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. धाव to go, to cleanse, affix ल्युट् or अनि fem. affix ङीप्.
20621: धावनिका f. (-का) A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी. E. कन् added to धावनी, implying similitude.
20622: धावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Purified, clean, cleansed. 2 Gone, gone or run away. 3 Run to, advanced to or against. E. धाव to clean, affix क्त, with इट् augment, or without the augment धौत.
20623: धासस् m. (-साः) A mountain. E. धा to uphold, Uṇādi affix असुन् and षुट् augment; the word is considered as peculiar to the Vedas.
20624: धि r. 6th cl. (धियति) To have or hold, to keep, to possess. 5th cl. (धिनोति) 1 To satisfy. 2 To go, to move.
20625: धिक् ind. An interjection of reproach or menace, (fie, shame, &c.) E. धक्क to annihilate, डिक् aff.
20626: धिक्कार m. (-रः) Disrespect, reproach, censure, contempt. E. धिक् fie, and कार making.
20627: धिक्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cursed. 2 Reproached, reviled, censured, condemned. E. धिक् fie, and कृत made.
20628: धिक्क्रिया f. (-या) Reproach. E. धिक् fie, and क्रिया making.
20629: धिक्पारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Excessive abuse. E. धिक्, and पारुष्य violence.
20630: धिक्ष r. 1st cl. (धिक्षते) 1 To kindle. 2 To be weary. 3 To live.
20631: धिग्वण m. (-णः) A man of a low caste sprung from a Brahman, and a female of the tribe called Ayogava.
20632: धिग्दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Reprimand, censure. E. धिक्, and दण्ड punishment.
20633: धिप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Deceptive, wishing to trick or deceive. E. दम्भ to cheat, desid. v. उ aff.
20634: धियाम्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A Jina or Jaina deified saint. 2 The soul. E. धी the understanding, in the seventh case, and पति master.
20635: धिव (इ,) धिवि r. 1st and 5th cl. (धिनोति) 1 To please, to satisfy. 2 To be pleased or satisfied. 3 To go or approach: this verb takes उ, and substitutes अ for the final, whence its unusual form for the first class, in the instance given.
20636: धिष r. 3rd cl. (दिधष्टि) To emit sound.
20637: धिषण m. (-णः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI. 2 Any Guru or spiritual preceptor. f. (-णा) The understanding, the intellect. E. धृष to be presumptuous, Uṇādi affix क्यु, and धिष substituted for the root.
20640: धिष्ण्य n. (-ष्ण्यं) 1 A place, a spot, a country. 2 A house. 3 A star, an asterism. 4 Fire. 5 Power, strength. m. (-ष्ण्यः) A name of AGNI, the deity of fire. 2 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of VENUS. E. धृष to be proud or overbearing, deriv. irr.; the word is also written धिष्ट्य or धिष्ठ्य.
20641: धी (ओ ङ) ओ धीङ् r. 4th cl. (धीयते) 1 To contain, to hold. 2 To slight, to disregard or despise. 3 To accomplish. With अन्तर्, To disappear, to become invisible.
20642: धी f. (-धीः) Understanding, intellect. E. ध्यै to meditate, affix क्विप्, the final diphthong rejected, and the semi-vowel changed to its congener इ, which becomes long.
20643: धीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drank, sucked. E. धे to drink, participial affix क्त, and form irr.
20644: धीति f. (-तिः) Thirst. E. धे to drink, affix क्तिन्, and the radical vowel changed to ई.
20645: धीदा f. (-दा) 1 A virgin, a maiden. 2 Understanding, intellect.
20646: धीन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An intellectual organ, as the mind, the eye, the ear, the nose, the tongue, and skin. E. धी the intellect, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense in general.
20647: धीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Sensible, wise, learned. m. (-मान्) A name of VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods. E. धी wisdom, understanding, मतुप् possess. aff.
20648: धीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Wise, sensible, learned. 2 Firm, steady, consistent, determined. 3 Cool, collected. 4 Head-strong, selfwilled, uncontrollable. 5 Lazy, dull, slow. 6 Strong, powerful. 7 Well behaved, decorous, decent. 8 Gentle, steady, (as a breeze.) 9 Deep, (as a sound.) m. (-रः) 1 A name of BALI, a celebrated prince. 2 The ocean. mn. (-रः-रं) Saffron. f. (-रा) 1 A drug; also काकोली. 2 A woman who, although jealous of a husband or lover, suppresses all expression of resentment in his presence. E. धी understanding, रा to possess, क affix; or धी with ईर to go to, affix अण्; or धी to possess, क्तन् Uṇādi aff.
20649: धीरत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Firmness, fortitude. 2 The feminine property of suppressing violent expression of jealousy. E. धीर firm, steady, affix त्व; also with तल् affix धीरता.
20650: धीरप्रशान्त n. (-न्तं) The hero of a poem or play who unites all good qualities. E. धीर, and प्रशान्त calm.
20651: धीरललित m. (-तः) The hero of a poem or play, who is firm and brave, but reckless and inconsiderate. E. धीर, and ललित sportive.
20652: धीरस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) A buffalo. E. धीर strong, स्कन्द a shoulder.
20653: धीराधीरा f. (-रा) A mistress or wife, who having cause for jealousy, pursues a middle conduct between the suppression and expression of resentment. E. धीरा, and अधीरा joined.
20654: धीरोदात्त m. (-त्तः) The hero of a poem or play whose characteristics are benevolence and fortitude. E. धीर, and उदात्त liberal.
20655: धीरोद्धत m. (-तः) The hero of a poem or play who is deficient in magnanimity. E. धीर, and उद्धत haughty.
20657: धीवन् m. (-वा) 1 A brazier. 2 A fisherman. E. धृ to hold, Uṇādi affix कनिन्, and ऋ changed to ई.
20658: धीवर m. (-रः) A fisherman. f. (-री) 1 A fisherman's wife. 2 A sort of harpoon for catching fish with. E. धी to hold or gain, (fish,) Uṇādi affix ष्वरच्.
20659: धीशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) An intellectual faculty or power of the understanding, as attention, comprehension, &c. E. धी the intellect, and शक्ति power.
20660: धीसख m. (-खः) 1 A counsellor, an adviser, a minister. 2 A tutor or friend. E. धी the understanding, and सखि a friend.
20661: धीसचिव m. (-वः) 1 A counsellor, a minister. 2 A friendly or prudent adviser. E. धी the intellect, and सचिव a friend.
20662: धु (ञ) धुञ् r. 7th cl. (धुनोति धुनुते) To shake, to agitate: see धू.
20663: धु f. (धुः) Shaking, trembling. E. धु to shake, क्विप् aff.
20664: धुक्ष r. 1st cl. (धुक्षते) 1 To kindle. 2 To be weary. 3 To live.
20665: धुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, deserted, left. 2 Shaken, agitated, (as leaves by wind, &c.) E. धु to shake, affix क्त.
20666: धुतपाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Purified from sin. E. धुत shaken, पाप sin.
20667: धुनन n. (-नं) Shaking, agitation. E. धु to shake, affix ल्यु; also धूनन, &c.
20668: धुनान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shaking, agitating. E. धु to shake, शानच् aff.
20669: धुनि f. (-निः) A river; see the next.
20670: धुनी f. (-नी) A river. E. धु to go, affix नुक्, fem. affix ङीप्; the affix is sometimes considered as निक्, leaving नि, which makes धुनि ut sup.
20671: धुनीनाथ m. (-थः) The ocean. E. धुनी, and नाथ lord.
20672: धुन्धुमार m. (-रः) 1 The name of a sovereign; also named Kuvalayāśva. 2 An insect, (Coccinella.) 3 The smoke of a house. 4 A house lizard (?) E. धूम smoke reiterated, ऋ to go, affix अण्, deriv. irr.
20673: धुन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्) Shaking, agitating. E. धु to shake, शतृ aff.
20674: धुन्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shaking, agitating. E. धु to shake, शानच् aff.
20675: धुर् f. (-धूः) 1 The fore part of a carriage, the pole or the part where the yoke is fixed. 2 Agitation, trembling. 3 Reflection, recollection. 4 A spark of fire. 5 A burthen, a load. 6 A part, a portion. 7 Wealth. 8 A name of the Ganges. E. धुर्ब्ब to hurt, affix क्विप्, and व rejected; also with टाप् added, धुरा.
20676: धुरन्धर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Bearing a burthen. 2 Bearing, (figuratively,) laden with good qualities, heavy duties, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A man of business. 3 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. धुर् a burthen, and धृ to have, affix खञ्.
20677: धुरा f. (-रा) A burthen, a load. E. धुर्व्व to hurt, affixes क and टाप्.
20678: धुरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Bearing, (as a burthen.) 2 Charged with, abounding with, (qualities, duties, &c.) m. (-णः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A man of business. E. धुर् a burthen, ख aff.
20679: धुरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Fit for a load, suited to a burthen. 2 Charged with important duties. m. (-यः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A man of business. E. धुर्, and छ aff.
20680: धुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fit for a burthen, adapted to it, &c. m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A minister, a charge d'affaires. 3 A horse. E. धुर् a burthen, यत् aff.
20681: धुर्व्व (इ) धुर्व्वी r. 1st cl. (धुर्व्वति) To kill or hurt.
20682: धुर्व्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing a load, a burthen. m. (-हः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A minister, a charge d'affaires. E. धुर्, and वह who bears; also धुरावह.
20683: धुवका f. (-का) The introductory stanza to a song, forming afterwards the burthen of each verse. E. धू to agitate, अक Uṇādi aff.
20684: धुवन m. (-नः) A title of AGNI. E. धू to agitate, affix युच्.
20685: धुवित्र n. (-त्रं) A sort of fan made of deer skin, and used especially to excite a sacrificial fire. E. धू to agitate, इत्र affix; also धवित्र.
20686: धुस्तुर m. (-रः) Thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa:) see the next.
20687: धुस्तूर m. (-रः) Thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa.) E. धूष to make handsome, affix क्विप्, तूर् to be mischievous, affix क्; elegant but deleterious: the vowels are also both made short, as धुस्तुर, or both remain long, as in धूस्तूर; also written धुत्तूर.
20688: धू (ञ) धूञ् r. 5th cl. (धूनोति धूनुते) r. 6th cl. (धूवति) r. 9th cl. (धुनाति धुनीते) r. 1st and 10th cls. (धवति-ते धावयति-ते or धूनयति) To shake or agitate, to make tremble. With अव prefixed, 1 To abandon, to quit. 2 To perceive. With निर्, 1 To destroy. 2 To go or move. With वि, To make tremble or agitate.
20689: धूक m. (-कः) 1 The air or wind. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 Time. E. धु to agitate, कन् Uṇādi affix, and the vowel made long.
20690: धूक्ष r. 1st cl. (धूक्षते) 1 To live. 2 To kindle. 3 To be distrest.
20691: धूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, agitated. 2 Reproached, reviled. 3 Abandoned, deserted. 4 Judged, discriminated. f. (-ता) A wife. E. धू to shake, &c. affix क्त; this root also forms धून with the same aff.
20692: धूतकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Pure, free from sin. E. धूत shaken, पाप sin.
20693: धून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Distressed by heat or thirst. 2 Shaken, agitated. E. धू to shake, affix क्त, form irr.
20694: धूनक m. (-कः) Resin; it is sometimes read धूणक.
20695: धूनन n. (-नं) Shaking, agitating. E. धू to shake, affix ल्युट्.
20696: धूनि f. (-निः) Shaking, agitating. E. धू to agitate, affix क्तिन्, and त changed to न.
20697: धूप r. 1st cl. (धूपायति) To heat. r. 10th cl. (धूपयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine.
20698: धूप m. (-पः) Incense, the aromatic vapour that proceeds from the combustion of any fragrant gum or resin, the use of which is authorized by scripture. E. धूप to heat, affix अच्.
20699: धूपन m. (-नः) 1 Resin. 2 Incense. E. धूप to heat, affix ल्यु.
20700: धूपवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A species of pine, (Pinus longifolia.) E. धूप incense or resin so used, and वृक्ष a tree; also with कन् added, धूपवृक्षक.
20701: धूपाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Turpentine. E. धूप, and अङ्ग part.
20702: धूपायित mn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Suffering pain or fatigue. 2 Incensed, perfumed with incense. E. धूप (to heat, &c.) affix क्त, आय inserted, or the passive form with the same aff.
20703: धूपिका f. (-का) Mist, fog. E. धूप incense, कन् affix of resemblance, fem. form.
20704: धूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Suffering pain or fatigue. 2 Scented, perfumed, incensed. E. धूप to heat, affix क्त.
20705: धूम m. (-मः) 1 Smoke. 2 A saint. E. धूम to agitate, Uṇādi affix क्.
20706: धूमकेतन m. (-नः) 1 KETU, the personified descending node. 2 Fire or its deity. E. धूम smoke, and केतन a symbol.
20707: धूमकेतु m. (-तुः) 1 A comet or falling-star. 2 Fire. 3 The personified descending node. E. धूम smoke, and केतु a mark or symbol.
20708: धूमध्वज m. (-जः) Fire. E. धूम smoke, and ध्वज a sign or symbol.
20709: धूमप्रभा f. (-भा) A division of hell, the hell of smoke. E. धूम, and प्रभा what shines.
20710: धूममहिषी f. (-षी) Fog, mist. E. धूम smoke, महिषी a buffalo.
20711: धूमयोनि m. (-निः) A cloud. E. धूम smoke, and योनि womb; what is engendered from smoke or vapour.
20712: धूमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a purple colour. m. (-लः) Purple, a colour compounded of black and red. E. धूम smoke, and ल what is, being of the hue of smoke.
20713: धूमसंहति f. (-तिः) A cloud or quantity of smoke. E. धूम, and संहति collection.
20714: धूमसी f. (-सी) A cake of pulse steeped in water, and dried in the sun.
20715: धूमाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Of the form or appearance of smoke. E. धूम, and आकार form.
20716: धूमाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Of a purple colour. m. (-भः) Purple. E. धूम smoke, and आभ resembling; of a smoky hue.
20717: धूमावलि f. (-लिः) A wreath or cloud of smoke. E. धूम, and आवलि a line.
20718: धूमिका f. (-का) Fog, vapour. E. धूम smoke, and कन् affix of resemblance.
20719: धूमोर्णा f. (-र्णा) The wife of YAMA. E. धूम smoke, and ऊर्ण wool; of a smoky hue, and woolly-headed, a Caffree Proserpine.
20720: धूमोर्णापति m. (-तिः) YAMA, the ruler of the dead. E. धूमोर्णा as above, and पति husband.
20721: धूम्या f. (-म्या) A quantity of smoke. E. धूम with य affix, implying aggregation.
20722: धूम्याट m. (-टः) The fork-tailed shrike. धूम्या much smoke, and अट who goes.
20723: धूम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Of a purple or smoky colour. m. (-म्रः) Purple; the colour; a compound of red and black. n. (-म्रं) Sin, vice, wickedness. E. धूम smoke, रा to get, affix क, deriv. irr.
20724: धूम्रक m. (-कः) A camel. E. धूम्र smoky, कन् affix; of a smoky or tawny hue.
20725: धूम्रलोचन m. (-नः) A pigeon. E. धूम्र dark, लोचन the eye.
20726: धूम्ररुच् mfn. (-रुक्) Of a purple colour. E. धूम्र, and रुच् to shine, affix क्विप्.
20727: धूम्रवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Of a smoky hue. m. (-र्णः) Incense. f. (-र्णा) Flame, or one of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire. E. धूम्र smoky or purplish, and वर्णं colour.
20728: धूम्राक्षि m. (-क्षिः) A pearl of a bad colour. E. धूम्र smoky, अक्षि an eye.
20729: धूम्राट m. (-टः) The fork-tailed shrike. E. धूम्र smoky, and अट who goes.
20730: धूम्राभ m. (-भः) Air, wind. E. धूम्र smoky, आभ who shines.
20731: धूम्रिका f. (-का) The Sisu tree. E. कन् added to धूम्र, fem. form.
20732: धूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Agitated, shaken. E. धू to shake, pass. v. शानच् aff.
20733: धूर (ई,) धूरी r. 4th cl. (धूर्य्यते) 1 To kill or hurt. 2 To move or approach.
20734: धूर्ज्जटि m. (-टिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. धुर् a burthen, and जटि a collection, from जट to collect, and इन् affix; who collects or bears the burthen of the three worlds.
20735: धूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Fraudulent, crafty, dishonest, knavish, &c. 2 Mischievous, injurious. m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A gamester. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 Thorn apple, (Datura.) n. (-र्त्तं) 1 Rust or iron filings. 2 Black salt. E. धुर्व्व to injure, Uṇādi affix तन्, deriv. irr.
20736: धूर्त्तक m. (-कः) 1 A jackal. 2 A cheat, a rogue, &c. E. धूर्त्त crafty, कन् added.
20737: धूर्त्तकितव m. (-वः) A gamester. E. धूर्त्त, and कितव a knave.
20738: धूर्त्तकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Dishonest, a knave, a rogue, a cheat. m. (-त्) Thorn apple: see धुस्तूर. E. धूर्त्तं mischievous, and कृत् who acts.
20739: धूर्त्तजन्तु m. (-न्तुः) Man. E. धूर्त्त crafty, and जन्तु an animal; the subtlest of all animals.
20740: धूर्त्तता f. (-ता) Knavery, roguery, knavishness. E. धूर्त्त, and तल् affix; also with त्व, धूर्त्तत्वं.
20741: धूर्त्तमण्डल m. (-लः) A party of rogues or gamblers. E. धूर्त्त a cheat, and मण्डल a circle.
20742: धूर्त्तमानुषा f. (-षा) A plant: see रास्ना.
20743: धूर्धर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Bearing a load or burthen. 2 Managing affairs. m. (-रः) A beast of burthen. E. धूर् a burthen, and धर bearing.
20744: धूर्व्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Bearing a load, who or what does so. 2 Managing affairs. E. धूर्, and वह what bears.
20745: धूर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) The fore part or pole of a carriage. E. धुर्व्व to injure, affix अच् and ङीष्.
20747: धूलि mf. (-लिः-लिः or -ली) 1 Dust. 2 A number. E. धू to agitate, affix लि.
20748: धूलिका f. (-का) Fog or mist. E. धलि dust, कन् affix of resemblance; the dust of the atmosphere.
20749: धूलिकुट्टिम n. (-मं) A mound, a rampart. E. धूलि dust or earth, and कुट्टिम prepared ground.
20750: धूलिकेदार m. (-रः) A mound, a rampart of earth. E. धूलि dust, and केदार a field.
20751: धूलिगुच्छक m. (-कः) The red vegetable powder thrown about at the spring festival called the Holī. E. धूलि dust, and गुच्छक a nosegay; also धूलिगुच्छ m. (-च्छः.)
20752: धूलिध्वज m. (-जः) Air or wind. E. धूलि dust, and ध्वज sign or symbol.
20753: धूलीकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A species of the Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.) 2 Tila, a plant. 3 A tree: see वरुण (Tapia cratæva.) E. धली dust, and वदम्ब Kadamba, whose pollen perhaps resembles that of the Kadamba, or having a similar  quantity of blossoms; also with कन् added धूलीकदम्बक; these words are also written with a short इ, as धूलिकदम्बक.
20754: धूलीपटल m. (-लः) A cloud of dust. E. धूली, and पटल a heap.
20755: धूश r. 10th cl. (धूशयति) To make splendid or elegant; also धूष, and धूस.
20756: धूष r. 10th cl. (धूषयति) To make splendid or elegant; also धूश and धूस.
20757: धूस r. 10th cl. (धूसयति) To embellish, to make splendid or elegant.
20758: धूसर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Grey, of that colour. m. (-रः) 1 Grey, (the colour.) 2 A jackass. 3 An oilman. 4 A camel. 5 A pigeon. 6 Any thing of a grey tint. f. (-री) A female Kinnara or chorister of heaven. E. धू to agitate, (the mind,) सर Uṇādi aff.
20759: धूसरछदा f. (-दा) A plant commonly Śvetarāsnā. E. धूसर grey, and छद a leaf, grey-leaved.
20760: धूस्तूर m. (-रः) The thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.) E. धूस् elegant, and तूर injurious: see धुस्तुर.
20761: धृ (ङ) धृङ् r. 1st cl. (धरते) To fall. r. 6th cl. (ध्रियते) 1 To continue, to remain. 2 To have or hold. (ञ) धृञ् r. 1st cl. (धरति-ते) To have or hold, to keep, to maintain. r. 1st cl. (धरति) To sprinkle. r. 10th cl. (धारयति) To hold. With अप or निर् prefixed, To verify, to make sure or certain.
20762: धृज r. 1st cl. (धर्जति) also (ई) धृजि r. 1st cl. (धृंजति) To go or move.
20763: धृत् mfn. (-धृत्) Who has, holds, possesses, &c. E. धृ to have, क्विप् aff.
20764: धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Possessed, held, contained. 2 Cherished, supported. 3 Stood, stayed, standing. 4 Alighted, gone down. 5 Placed. 6 Considered, weighed. E. धृ to hold, and क्त aff.
20765: धृतकार्मुकेषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Armed with bow and arrow. E. धृत, कार्म्मुक a bow, and इषु an arrow.
20766: धृतपट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Covered or overspread with a cloth, &c. E. धृत, and पट a cloth.
20767: धृतराष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A proper name; DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, the father of DURYODHANA, and uncle of the Pāṇḍu princes. 2 A good king. 3 A Nāga or serpent of the lower regions. 4 A kind of bird, perhaps a sort of goose: see धार्त्तराष्ट्र. f. (-री) A goose, the female bird only. E. धृत possessed, cherished, (by whom,) राष्ट्र a region.
20768: धृतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Held, was holding. 2 Having taken or conveyed. E. धृ to hold, क्तवतु aff.
20769: धृतहेति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Armed. E. धृत, and हेति a weapon.
20770: धृतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Firm, steady, calm, collected. E. धृत, and आत्मन् self.
20771: धृताम्भस् mfn. (-म्भाः-म्भाः-म्भः) Full of water. E. धृत, and अम्भस् water.
20772: धृति m. (-तिः) Sacrifice, offering, religious rite or ceremony. f. (-तिः) 1 Holding, having. 2 Steadiness, firmness. 3 One of the astrological Yogas: see योग. 4 Pleasure. 5 Satisfaction, content. 6 Happiness. 7 A metre; a stanza of four lines of eighteen syllables each. 8 The thirteenth Mātṛkā. E. धृ to have, &c. affix क्तिन्.
20773: धृतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Firm, steady, calm. 2 Content. E. धृति, and मतुप् aff.
20774: धृतिमुष् mfn. (मुट्) Discomposing, agitating. E. धृति firmness, and मुष् what steals.
20775: धृत्वन् m. (-त्वा) 1 Virtue, morality. 2 A Brahman. 3 The sea. 4 The sky. 5 A clever man. 6 A name of VIṢṆU. E. धृ to hold, क्वनिप् affix, तुक् augment.
20776: धृत्वरी f. (-री) The earth. E. धृ to hold, क्वरप् affix, and तुक augment.
20777: धृत्वा ind. Having taken or held. E. धृ, and क्त्वा aff.
20778: धृष r. 5th cl. (ञि-आ) ञिधृषा (धृष्णाति) To be proud, to be confident or presumptuous. r. 1st and 10th cls. (धर्षति धर्षयति) To overcome, to overbear, to resist impatiently, to be impatient. (उ) धृषु r. 1st cl. (धर्षति) 1 To collect. 2 To hurt or kill. (ङ) धृषङ् r. 10th cl. (धर्षयते) To neutralise, paralyse or make powerless.
20779: धृषु m. (-षुः) 1 A clever man. 2 A proud one. 3 A heap. E. धृष to be confident, Uṇādi affix कु.
