20780: धृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Impudent, confident, bold, shameless. 2 Forward, intrusive, presumptuous. 3 Secured, obtained. 4 Profligate, abandoned. m. (-ष्टः) A faithless husband. f. (-ष्टा) A disloyal or unchaste woman. E. धृष to be confident, affix क्त.
20781: धृष्णज् mfn. (-ष्णक्) Confident, impudent, shameless. E. धृष to be confident, नजिङ् aff.
20782: धृष्णि m. (-ष्णिः) A ray of light. E. धृष to be arrogant, नि aff.
20783: धृष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Confident, bold. 2 Impudent, shameless. f. (-ष्णुः) The branch of a bambu. E. धृष to be arrogant, affix क्नु.
20784: धॄ r. 9th cl. (धृणाति) To be or grow old.
20785: धे r. 1st cl. (ट्) धेट् (धयति) also (ङ्) धेङ् (धयते) To drink.
20786: धेन m. (-नः) 1 The ocean. 2 A male river. f. (-ना) A river. E. धे to drink, Uṇādi affix न; what is drunk.
20787: धेनु f. (-नुः) A milch cow, one that has lately calved. E. धे to drink, Uṇādi affix नु.
20788: धेनुक m. (-कः) The name of an Asura or demon, killed by KṚṢṆA. f. (-का) 1 A she-elephant. 2 A milch cow. E. धेनु a cow, and कन् aff.
20789: धेनुकसूदन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. धेनुक a demon, so called, and सूदन the destroyer; also similar compounds, as धेनुकहन्, धेनुकारि, &c.
20790: धेनुकादुग्ध n. (-ग्धं) 1 Cow's milk. 2 A plant: see चिर्भिट. E. धेनुका, and दुग्ध milk.
20791: धेनुकारि m. (-रिः) 1 KṚṢṆA. 2 A small tree, Nagesara. E. धेनुक, and अरि a foe.
20792: धेनुष्या f. (-ष्या) A cow at the dairy or tied up to be milked. E. धेनु a milch cow, यत् affix, and षुक् augment.
20793: धेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be held. 2 Denominated, called. E. धा to have, यत् aff.
20794: धैनुक n. (-कं) A herd of milch cows. E. धेनुका a milch cow, and अण् aff.
20795: धैर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Steadiness, firmness. E. धीर firm, ष्यञ् aff.
20796: धैर्य्यकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Steady, calm, assuming firmness or composure. E. धैर्य्य, and कलित made.
20797: धैवत m. (-तः) The sixth note of the gamut. E. धी intellect, deriv. irr.
20798: धोड m. (-डः) A sort of snake, commonly Dhora, a kind of watersnake. E. धू to make tremble, ड aff.
20799: धोर (ऋ) धोरृ r. 1st cl. (धोरति) To move well, to be quick or alert, or to have good paces.
20800: धोरण n. (-णं) 1 A vehicle in general, any means of conveyance, as a horse, an elephant, a car, &c. 2 A horse's trot. 3 Going well or quickly. E. धोर to move well or quickly, affix ल्युट्.
20801: धोरणि f. (-णिः) Tradition. E. धोर to proceed, affix अनि.
20802: धोरित n. (-तं) A horse's trot. E. धोर to go well, affix क्त; also with कन् added, धोरितक n. (-कं) and with अण् again added, धौरितक.
20803: धौत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Washed, cleaned, purified. 2 Bright and shining. 3 White. n. (-तं) Silver. E. धाव to make clean, affix क्त.
20804: धौतकट m. (-टः) A bag of coarse cloth, a sack. E. धौत washed, and कट a mat.
20805: धौतकोषज n. (-जं) Bleached or wild silk. E. धौत pure or washed, कोष the cocoon, and ज born.
20806: धौतकौशेय n. (-यं) Bleached or wild silk. E. धौत pure or washed, कोश a cocoon, and ढक् aff.
20807: धौतशिल n. (-लं) Crystal. E. धौत pure, शिला a stone.
20808: धौमक m. (-कः) The name of a district. E. धूम smoke, वुञ् aff.
20809: धौरितक n. (-कं) A horse's trot: see धोरितक.
20810: धौरेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for burthen, capable of taking or bearing it, (either a vehicle or a beast, &c.) m. (-यः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A horse. E. धूर् a burthen, ढक् aff.
20811: धौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a cheat, knavish, fraudulent, &c. n. (-कं) Fraud, dishonesty. E. धूर्त्त a cheat, ठन् aff.
20812: धौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A horse's trot. E. धोर to go well, affix यञ्.
20813: ध्मा r. 1st cl. (धमति) 1 To blow, as a wind instrument, to produce sound by blowing. 2 To blow a fire, to excite fire by blowing. 3 To apply fire. 4 To excite sparks.
20814: ध्माकार m. (-रः) A blacksmith. E. ध्मा blowing, from ध्मा to blow, affix क्विप्, and कार who makes.
20815: ध्माक्ष (इ) ध्माक्षि r. 1st cl. (ध्मांक्षति) 1 To desire. 2 To crow or caw: see ध्राक्ष and ध्वाक्ष.
20816: ध्माक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 Any aquatic bird. 2 A crow, &c. E. ध्माक्ष to crow or caw, अच् affix; more usually read ध्वाङ्क्ष, q. v.
20817: ध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तुं) 1 Inflamed, excited. 2 Blown into or up, inflated. 3 Blown by a bellows, (a fire, &c.) E. ध्मा to blow, &c. affix क्त.
20818: ध्मामन् m. (-मा) 1 Measure. 2 Light. 3 Meditation. E. ध्मा to blow or breathe, Uṇādi affix मन्.
20819: ध्मायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being melted or refined. 2 Being inflated. E. ध्मा to blow, शानच् aff.
20820: ध्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thought, meditated. E. ध्यै to meditate, affix क्त.
20821: ध्यातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be thought or reflected upon. E. ध्यै to think, तव्य aff.
20822: ध्यान n. (-नं) 1 Meditation, reflection, but especially that profound and abstract consideration which brings its object fully and undisturbedly before the mind. 2 Mental representation of the personal attributes of the divinity to whom worship is addressed. E. ध्यै to meditate, affix ल्युट्.
20823: ध्यानयोग n. (-गं) The performance of religious abstraction. E. ध्यान meditation, &c. योग a religious observance.
20824: ध्यानपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Meditating, reflecting. E. धान, and पर engaged in.
20825: ध्यानतत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Reflecting. E. धान, and तत्पर absorbed in.
20826: ध्यानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be meditated upon. E. ध्यै to think, and अनीथर् aff.
20827: ध्याम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Black. n. (-मं) 1 A fragrant grass. 2 A plant, (Artemisia.) E. ध्यै to think, मक् aff.
20828: ध्यामन् n. (-म) Meditation. m. (-मा) Measure. E. ध्यै to meditate, and मनिन् aff.
20830: ध्यायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Thinking of, meditating upon. E. ध्य to think, शतृ aff.
20831: ध्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be meditated or pondered. E. ध्यै to meditate, यत् aff.
20832: ध्यै r. 1st cl. (ध्यायति) To recollect, to call to mind, to meditate, to think; with the preposition नि, to see, to look, to look out for.
20833: ध्रज r. 1st cl. (ध्रजति) To go; also (इ) ध्रञ्जि r. 1st cl. (ध्रंजति) To go or move.
20834: ध्रण r. 1st cl. (ध्रणति) To sound, as a drum or other instrument.
20835: ध्रस r. 10th cl. (ध्रसयति) To throw or toss up. (उ) उध्रस r. 9th cl. (ध्रस्नाति) To glean: the root is by some authorities read उध्रस.
20836: ध्राक्ष (इ) ध्राक्षि r. 1st cl. (ध्रांक्षति) 1 To utter the sound of birds, or to crow, caw, &c. 2 To desire: see ध्वाक्ष.
20837: ध्राख (ऋ) ध्राखृ r. 1st cl. (ध्राखति) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To suffice, to be able or competent. 4 To refuse, to prevent.
20838: ध्राघ (ऋ) ध्राघृ r. 1st cl. (ध्राघते) To be able on competent.
20839: ध्राजि f. (-जिः) A whirlwind, a gale. E. ध्रज to go, इ Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel made long.
20840: ध्राड (ऋ) ध्राडृ r. 1st cl. (ध्राडति) To divide, to split, to cut or pierce.
20841: ध्राडि m. (-डिः) Gathering flowers. E. ध्राड to divide, affix इ.
20842: ध्रिज r. 1st cl. (ध्रेजति) To go or move.
20843: ध्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Being held or sustained. 2 Being withheld, checked, suppressed, &c. E. धृ to hold, passive v. शानच् aff.
20844: ध्रु r. 1st cl. (ध्रवति) r. 6th cl. (ध्रुवति) 1 To be firm or fixed. 2 To go or move.
20845: ध्रुव r. 6th cl. (ध्रुवति) 1 To stand firm. 2 To go or move.
20846: ध्रुव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Eternal. 2 Fixed, stable, firm. 3 Continual, permanent. 4 Certain, ascertained. 5 Spread, extended. m. (-वः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 The polar star or north pole itself; in mythology, personified by DHRUVA, the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA, and grandson of the first MANU. 5 The pole of any great circle, particularly either of the celestial poles. 6 (In Astronomy,) The distance of a planet from the beginning of the sydereal zodiac. 7 Any epoch to which a computation of dates is referred. 8 One of the demigods called VASUS. 9 The trunk of a lopped tree. 10 The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 11 One of the twenty-seven astronomical Yogas, or the Yoga star of the twelfth lunar asterism, supposed to be β Leonis. 12 A sort of bird: see शराटि. n. (-वं) 1 Ascertainment, certainty. 2 Logie, reasoning, discussion. 3 Heaven. f. (-वा) 1 A sacrificial vase made in the shape of the Indian fig leaf, and of the wood of the Flacourtia sapida. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 3 A small tree from the fibres of which bow strings are made: see मूर्व्वा. 4 The introductory stanza of a song: it is distinct from the verses of the song, after each of which it is again repeated as a burden or chorus. 5 A virtuous woman. E. ध्रु to be fixed, affix अच्.
20847: ध्रुवक m. (-कः) 1 The trunk of a lopped tree. 2 Longitude. f. (-का) The introductory stanza and burden of a song: see ध्रुवा. E. कन् added to the preceding.
20848: ध्रू r. 6th cl. (ध्रुवति) 1 To be firm, to stand fast. 2 To go or move.
20849: ध्रेक (ऋ) ध्रेकृ r. 1st cl. (ध्रेकते) 1 To sound. 2 To grow or increase. 3 To be exhilarated or elevated with joy. 4 To manifest elevation or hilarity by noise.
20850: ध्रै r. 1st cl. (ध्रायति) To be satisfied or pleased.
20851: ध्रौव्य n. (-व्यं) Firmness, fixedness. 2 Duration. E. ध्रुव, and ष्यञ् aff.
20852: ध्वंस (उ) ध्वंसु r. 1st cl. (ध्वंसते) 1 To fall down. 2 To reduce to powder. 3 To go.
20853: ध्वंस m. (-सः) Loss, destruction. f. (-सी) A mote in a sun-beam. E. ध्वंस to fall, affix अच्.
20854: ध्वंसन n. (-नं) 1 Perishing, dying. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 Going. 4 Falling. E. ध्वंस to fall down, affix ल्युट्.
20855: ध्वंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Lost, destroyed. 2 Vexed, incensed. E. ध्वंस to fall down, क्त aff.
20856: ध्वंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Destructive, destroying. 2 Suffering loss, perishing. m. (-सी) A Pilu tree, said to grow in mountainous districts. E. ध्वंस to fall, and इनि aff.
20857: ध्वज r. 1st cl. (ध्वजति) also (इ) ध्वजि r. 1st cl. (ध्वंजति) To go, to move.
20858: ध्वज mn. (-जः-जं) 1 A flag or banner. 2 A mark, a sign or symbol. 3 The penis. 4 The upper part of a skull carried on a stick, as a penance for the murder of a Brahman. 5 A house situated to the east of any object. 6 A flag-staff. 7 (In Prosody,) An Iambic. m. (-जः) 1 A distiller. 2 Pride. 3 Hypocrisy, fraud. E. ध्वज to go, affix अच्.
20859: ध्वजद्रुम m. (-मः) The palm tree. E. ध्वज a banner, द्रुम a tree.
20860: ध्वजप्रहरण m. (-णः) Air or wind. E. ध्वज a flag, and प्रहरण who seizes.
20861: ध्वजभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Impotence. 2 Fracture or fall of a banner. E. ध्वज, and भङ्ग breaking.
20862: ध्वजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a mark or sign. m. (-वान्) 1 An ensign, a standard-bearer. 2 A distiller, a vender of spirituous liquors. 3 A Brahman who having slain another, carries the skull of the murdered man with him to places of pilgrimage by way of penance. E. ध्वज as above, मतुप् aff.
20863: ध्वजराजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Bearing or displaying ensigns. E. ध्वज, and राज to shine, णिनि aff.
20864: ध्वजांशुक m. (-कः) A flag. E. ध्वज, and अंशुक a cloth.
20865: ध्वजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Having a flag or sign, &c. m. (-जी) 1 A Brahman. 2 A mountain. 3 A car or carriage. 4 A snake. 5 A horse. 6 A peacock. 7 A distiller or vender of spirituous liquors. 8 A standard-bearer. 9 An armiger, one having an emblem or sign. f. (-नी) An army. E. ध्वज symbol, इनि aff.
20866: ध्वजीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Raising a standard. 2 Taking an emblem, &c. 3 Making any thing a plea, or setting up as a claim or right. E. ध्वज, and करण making, च्चि augment.
20867: ध्वजोत्थान n. (-नं) The twelfth day of the light half of Bhādra, a festival in honour of INDRA. E. ध्वज a flag, and उत्थान elevating.
20869: ध्वन r. 1st cl. (ध्वनति) r. 10th cl. (ध्वनयति ध्वानयति) To sound.
20870: ध्वन m. (-नः) Sound. E. ध्वन to sound, अच् affix: see ध्वान.
20871: ध्वनत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) Sounding, making a noise. E. ध्वन to sound, शतृ aff.
20872: ध्वनमोदिन् m. (-दी) The humble bee. E. ध्वन sound, and मोदिन् who delights.
20873: ध्वनयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Sounding, resounding, echoing with. E. ध्वन to sound, शतृ aff.
20874: ध्वनि m. (-निः) 1 Sound. 2 Figurative or poetical style. 3 The sound of a drum. E. ध्वन to sound, इ aff.
20875: ध्वनिग्रह m. (-हः) 1 The ear. 2 Hearing. E. ध्वनि sound, ग्रह the recipient.
20876: ध्वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, making a noise, as a drum, &c. 2 Poetical, figurative, rhetorically expressed. E. ध्वन to sound, affix क्त.
20877: ध्वनिनाला f. (-ला) 1 The Vīṇā or lute. 2 A pipe, a fife. 3 A sort of trumpet. E. ध्वनि sound, and नाला a hollow tube.
20878: ध्वनिविकार m. (-रः) Change of voice, through fear, grief, &c. E. ध्वनि sound, विकार change.
20879: ध्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Fallen. 2 Destroyed, perished, lost. E. ध्वंस to fall, affix क्त.
20880: ध्वाक्ष (इ) ध्वाक्षि r. 1st cl. (ध्वांक्षति) 1 To utter a cry peculiar to birds, as to croke, caw, &c. 2 To desire.
20881: ध्वाङ्क्ष m. (-ङ्क्षः) 1 Any aquatick bird, as a crane, a gull, &c. feeding upon fish. 2 A crow. 3 One of the Nāgas. 4 A beggar. f. (-ङ्क्षी) 1 A drug: see काकोली. 2 A female imp or fiend. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष to cry, affix अच्; it and its derivatives may also be read ध्माक्ष, &c.
20882: ध्वाङ्क्षपुष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and पुष्ट fostered.
20883: ध्वाङ्क्षराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Having a voice like a crow. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and रव sound, affix णिनि.
20884: ध्वाङ्क्षाराति m. (-तिः) An owl. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and अराति an enemy.
20885: ध्वाङ्क्षाली f. (-ली) A medicinal plant: see काकोली.
20886: ध्वान n. (-नं) Sound in general. E. ध्वन to sound, घञ् aff.
20887: ध्वान्त n. (-न्तं) Darkness. E. ध्वन to sound, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
20888: ध्वान्तवित्त m. (-त्तः) The firefly. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and वित्त wealth.
20889: ध्वान्तशात्रव m. (-बः) 1 A sort of Cassia, (C. fistula.) 2 The sun or any luminous body. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and शात्रव averse to.
20890: ध्वान्ताराति m. (-तिः) The sun or any luminous body. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and अरानि an enemy.
20891: ध्वान्तोन्मेष m. (-षः) The firefly. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and उन्मेष twinkling.
20892: ध्वृ r. 1st cl. (ध्वरति) 1 To bend, to make crooked. 2 To kill. 3 To describe. न
20893: न The twentieth consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding with the letter N.
20894: न mfn. (नः-ना-नं) 1 Thin, spare. 2 Vacant, empty. 3 Identical, same, like. 4 Unvexed, unwearied. 5 Undivided, unbroken. m. (नः) 1 A Bauddha, a follower of Buddha. 2 Binding, tying. 3 One who is praised. 4 A name of GAṆEŚA. 5 War. 6 Giving, a gift. 7 Good, welfare, prosperity. 8 A jewel. f. (ना) 1 The navel. 2 A musical instrument. 3 Knowledge. ind. 1 No, not, a particle of prohibition. 2 A particle of comparison. 3 A particle of negation, annihilation, &c. E. नी to obtain, or नह to bind, &c., ड aff.
20895: नःक्षुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Small-nosed. E. नस् the nose, क्षुद्र small.
20896: नंशुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Injurious, destructive. E. नश to destroy, णुकन् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
20897: नंष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) An injurer, injurious, destructive. E. नश to destroy, affix तृच्, and नुम् inserted.
20899: नकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Disgraced, rejected from a family or race. m. (-लः) 1 The Bengal mungoose, (Viverra ichneumon.) 2 A proper name, NAKULA, the fourth of the five Pāṇḍu princes. 3 A son. 4 A name of ŚIVA. f. (-ली) 1 Silk cotton tree. 2 Indian spikenard. 3 A sort of perfume: see शङ्खिनी. 4 Saffron. 5 The letter ह as used in the Tantras. E. न not, कुल race or heap, fem. affix ङीष्.
20900: नकुलेश m. (-शः) 1 A Bhairava, an attendant on or emanation from ŚIVA. 2 The letter ह as used mystically in Tantras. E. नकुल, and ईश master.
20901: नकुलेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) A plant: see रास्ना. E. नकुल an ichneumon, and इष्ट wished; the mungoose, if wounded in a conflict with a poisonous snake, is supposed to prevent the effects of the venom by the use of this plant; also नकुलेष्टका.
20902: नक्क r. 10th cl. (नक्कयति) To destroy or annihilate.
20903: नक्त n. (-क्तं) Night. E. नज to be ashamed, तन् aff.
20904: नक्तक m. (-कः) 1 Dirty or ragged cloth. 2 A rag, a wiper, a handkerchief, &c. E. नज to be ashamed or modest, affix तन्, and कन् added; also लक्तक.
20905: नक्तचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going or moving about at night. m. (-री) 1 A cat. 2 An owl. 3 A goblin. 4 A thief. E. नक्त by night, चर to go, णिनि aff.
20906: नक्तञ्चर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going at night. m. (-रः) 1 A goblin, a demon. 2 A tree, the Bdellium tree: see गुग्गुल. 3 An owl, 4 A thief. E. नक्तं by night, and चर who goes.
20907: नक्तभोजन n. (-नं) Supper. E. नक्त night, भोजन food.
20908: नक्तम् ind. By night, at night. E. नज to be ashamed, तन् aff.
20909: नक्तमाल m. (-लः) A tree, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.) E. नक्तम् by night, अल to ornament, आङ् prefix, and अच् affix; blossoming at night.
20910: नक्तमुखा f. (-खा) Night. E. नक्तम् by night, उख to produce, affix क.
20911: नक्तव्रत n. (-तं) 1 Fasting by day and eating at night. 2 Any religious rite or obligation observed at night. E. नक्त, and व्रत vow.
20912: नक्र n. (-क्रं) The upper timber of a door-frame. nf. (-क्रं-क्रा) The nose. f. (-क्रा) A string of bees or wasps. m. (-क्रः) A crocodile. E. न not, क्रम to go, affix ड.
20913: नक्रराज् m. (-राट्) or नक्रराज (-जः) A shark, but applied also differently: see ग्राह. E. नक्र a crocodile, and राज् or राज king.
20914: नक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A star in general. 2 An asterism in the moon's path or lunar mansion, of which twenty-eight, distinct in name, figure, and number of stars, are enumerated; the Paurānic and popular enumeration of those constellations is twenty-seven; Abhijit, the twenty-seventh, being considered as formed of portions of the two contiguous asterisms, and not distinct from them. 2 A pearl. E. णक्ष to go, Uṇādi affix अत्रन् or क्षद Sautra root, to injure, or क्षर to drop, or क्षी to waste or decay, with the negative prefix, and ष्ट्रन् affix; deriv. irr.
20915: नक्षत्रचक्र n. (-क्रं) 1 A particular diagram for astrological calculations. 2 The lunar asterisms collectively. E. नक्षत्र, and चक्र a circle.
20916: नक्षत्रनेमि m. (-मिः) 1 The moon. 2 The pole-star. 3 VIṢṆU. f. (-मिः) The last of the asterisms, Revatī, containing thirtytwo stars. E. नक्षत्र a star, and नेमि circumference.
20917: नक्षत्रप m. (-पः) The moon. E. नक्षत्र, and प who cherishes.
20918: नक्षत्रमाला f. (-ला) 1 A necklace containing twenty-seven pearls. 2 The table of the asterisms in the moon's path. 3 A kind of dance. E. नक्षत्र a constellation, and माला a garland.
20919: नक्षत्रेश m. (-शः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. नक्षत्र an asterism, and ईश lord.
20921: नख mn. (-खः-खी) A finger nail. m. (-खः) A part, a portion. nf. (-खं-खी) A perfume, a dried substance, of a brown colour, and of the shape of a nail; apparently, a dried shell fish, used as a perfume. f. (-खी) A vegetable perfume, different from the one above, though known by the same name, NAKHI. E. न privative, ख sense; or नह to bind, ख Uṇādi affix, the radical ह rejected.
20922: नखकुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A barber. E. नख a nail, and कुट्ट who cuts; barbers in India trim the nails, &c.
20923: नखखादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what eats with nails or talons. E. नस्व, and खादिन् eating.
20924: नखदारण m. (-णः) A falcon. E. नख a nail, and दारण tearing,
20925: नखपद n. (-दं) A scratch, the mark of a finger nail. E. नख, and पद a mark.
20926: नखभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Torn, or torn off with a nail. E. नख, and भिन्न divided.
20927: नखमुच m. (-चः) A bow. E. नख a nail, मुच to let loose, क aff.
20928: नखम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) What scalds the nail. E. नख, and पच to cook, खश aff.
20929: नखर m. (-रः) A finger nail. f. (-री) A perfume: see नस्वी. E. न not, खन to go, and डर affix; or नख a nail, रा to go or be, affix ड.
20930: नखरञ्जनी f. (-नी) A nail-parer. E. नख, and रञ्जनी beautifying.
20931: नखरायुध m. (-धः) 1 A lion. 2 Any beast of prey. 3 A cock. E. नखर a nail, आयुध a weapon.
20932: नखलेखा f. (-खा) A scratch. E. नख, and लेखा a line.
20933: नखविलेख m. (-खः) A scratch. E. नख, and विलेखा a mark.
20934: नखविष्किर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) What tears or rends, (as a bird of prey, &c.) E. नख, and विष्किर what scatters.
20935: नखव्रण n. (-णं) A scratch. E. नख, and व्रण a wound.
20936: नखशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A small shell. E. नख a nail, शङ्ख a shell, one as small as a nail.
20937: नखांशु m. (-शुः) Elegance of the finger nails. E. नख, and अंशु a ray.
20938: नखाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A scratch, a mark of the nail. 2 A sort of perfume. E. नख a nail, and अङ्क a mark.
20939: नखायुध m. (-धः) 1 A tiger. 2 A lion. 3 A cock. 4 Any beast or bird having talons. E. नख, and आयुध a weapon.
20940: नखालि m. (-लिः) A small shell. E. नख a nail, and आलि a line; also नखालिका.
20941: नखाशिन् m. (-शी) An owl. E. नख a nail, and अशिन् who eats, using its claws in feeding.
20942: नखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Nailed, clawed, having nails or talons. E. नख, and इनि aff.
20943: नग m. (-गः) 1 A mountain. 2 A tree. E. न not, गम to go, affix ड, immoveable; or दह to burn, Uṇādi affix ग, ह rejected, and द changed to न.
20944: नगज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain, mountaineer. m. (-जः) An elephant. E. नग a mountain, and ज born.
20946: नगनन्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ. E. नग a mountain, and नन्दिनी a daughter, being in one of her characters the daughter of Himāla, the snowy Imaus personified.
20947: नगपति m. (-तिः) Himāla, the personified range of snowy mountains dividing India from Tartary, &c. E. नग mountain, and पति lord.
20948: नगभिद् m. (-द् or त्) 1 A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) 2 An axe, a crow. 2 INDRA. E. नग, and भिद् what breaks.
20949: नगभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountain, mountaineer. E. नग, and भू born.
20950: नगमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The crest or brow of a mountain. E. नग, and मूर्द्धन् forehead.
20951: नगर mf. (-रं-री) A town, a city. E. नग a tree, or according to some, a mountain, रल् affix; having trees or houses like mountains.
20952: नगरघात m. (-तः) An elephant. E. नगर a city, and घात who destroys or subverts.
20953: नगरजन m. (-नः) Towns-folk, citizens. E. नगर, and जन people.
20954: नगरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) City, citizens. E. नगर, and स्थ who or what stays.
20955: नगरस्वरूपिणी f. (-णी) A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
20956: नगरीवक m. (-कः) A crow. E. नगरी, and वक a crane, the town-crane.
20957: नगरोपान्त m. (-न्तं) Suburb, skirts of the town. E. नग, and उपान्त vicinity.
20958: नगरौषधि f. (-धिः) The plantain. E. नगर a city, and औषधि a medicament.
20959: नगाटन m. (-नः) A monkey. E. नग a mountain, अट to go, affix ल्युट्.
20960: नगाधिप m. (-पः) Himāla: see नगपति. E. नग a mountain, and अधिप a lord; also नगाधिराज, &c.
20961: नगाश्रथ mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Living in or frequenting mountains. E. नग, and आश्रय abode.
20962: नगोच्छ्राय n. (-यं) The elevation of a mountain. E. नग, and उच्छ्राय heighth.
20963: नगौकस् m. (-काः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A lion. 3 A fabulous animal: see शरभ. 4 A crow. E. नग a tree, a mountain, and ओकस् a house or dwelling.
20964: नग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Naked. m. (-ग्नः) 1 A naked mendicant. 2 A Bauddha. 3 A bard. f. (-ग्ना) A naked woman. E. नज to be ashamed, affix क्त.
20965: नग्नक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Naked. E. कन् added to the last.
20966: नग्नजित् m. (-जित्) The name of a king, father of one of KṚṢṆA'S wives. E. नग्न Bauddha, and जित् who conquers.
20967: नग्नत्व n. (-त्वं) Nudity, nakedness. E. त्व added to नग्न; also with तल्, नग्नता.
20968: नग्नहू mn. (-हूः-हु) Ferment, a drug used to throw the mixture for spirituous liquor into fermentation. E. नग्न naked, and ह्वे to call, affix. क्विप्, what is called for by the barefaced, shameless, &c.
20969: नग्नाट m. (-टः) A naked man, but especially a kind of religious mendicant, who wanders about without clothes. 2 A Bauddha. 3 A Jain. E. नग्न naked, and अट who goes; also with कन् added नग्राटक.
20970: नग्निका f. (-का) 1 A girl before menstruation or about ten years old. 2 A naked woman. E. नग्न naked, कन् added, and the fem. form: see नग्नक.
20971: नग्नीकरण n. (-णं) Stripping, undressing. E. नग्न, and करण making, च्चि augment.
20972: नग्नीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undressed, stripped, naked. E. नग्न, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
20973: नज (ओ ई) ओनजी r. 6th cl. (नजते) also (इ, ओ) ओनजि r. 1st cl. (नञ्जते) To be ashamed, to be modest or bashful.
20974: नञ् ind. A particle of negation, prohibition, &c. (no, not:) see अ and न.
20975: नट r. 1st and 10th cls. (नटति नाटयति) 1 To dance, to dance as an actor, to act. 2 To drop or fall. 3 To shake, to move slightly. 4 To injure. 5 To shine.
20976: नट m. (-टः) 1 A dancer, a mime, an actor, a Nut, &c. in modern times: in caste, the son of a degraded Kṣatriya by a woman of the second caste. 4 A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or latterly called A. karka, Roxburgh's Catalogue;) also नड and नल. 5 A subordinate mode of music. f. (-टा) A sort of shrub, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.) (-टी) 1 A medicinal plant: see नली. 2 A whore. 3 A Nach girl, a dancer, an actress. 4 Red arsenick: see नली. 5 A Rāgiṇī. E. नट to dance, affix अच्, and टाप् or ङीष्; otherwise, नश to destroy, Uṇādi affix डट, &c.
20977: नटन n. (-नः) The art or act of dancing, pantomime, &c. E. नट to dance, affix ल्युट्.
20978: नटनारायण m. (-णः) A Rāga or mode of music, according to some, the sixth, or to others, a subdivision of Dīpaka or of Megha. E. नट, and नारायण VIṢṆU: the supreme with dancers, &c.
20981: नटमण्डन n. (-नं) Yellow orpiment. E. नट an actor, and मण्डन adorning; dying theatrical raiment.
20982: नटवर m. (-रः) A chief dancer or actor. E. नट, and वर best.
20983: नटसज्ञक m. (-कः) 1 Yellow orpiment. 2 An actor, a dancer, &c. E. नट an actor, सज्ञा a name, affix कन्.
20984: नटश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A chief or excellent dancer or actor. E. नट, and श्रेष्ठ best.
20985: नटान्तिका f. (-का) Shame, modesty. E. नट dancing, and अन्त destroying, affix कन् and टाप्; it is also read नटान्धिका.
20986: नटेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of ŚIVA. E. नट a dancer, and ईश्वर a deity, the god of the dancers.
20987: नड r. 1st cl. (नडति) To be thick or impervious. r. 10th cl. (नडयति) To fall off or from.
20988: नड m. (-डः) 1 A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or karka;) also नल. 2 A particular tribe whose employment is making a sort of glass bracelets. E. नड to be thick, affix अच्.
20989: नडकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds, (a field, &c.) E. नड a reed, छ affix, and कुक् augment.
20990: नडप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds. E. नड, and प्राय abundance.
20991: नडमीन m. (-नः) A small fish, a kind of sprat haunting reedy places. E. नड a reed, and मीन a fish.
20992: नडसंहति f. (-तिः) A quantity of reeds. E. नड, and संहति assemblage; also any analogous compound.
20993: नडह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Lovely, beautiful, desirable. E. नड here said to be mental anxiety, derived from नड to fall off or from, हन to destroy, affix ड.
20994: नड्या f. (-ड्या) A quantity of reeds. E. नड a reed, affix यत्.
20995: नड्वत् mfn. (-ड्वान्-ड्वती-ड्वत्) Reedy, abounding in reeds. E. नड, and मतुप् aff.
20996: नड्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Reedy, abounding in reeds. E. नड, and ड्वलच् aff.
20997: नड्वाभू f. (-भूः) A house or hut of reeds. E. नड्व, and भू being, with आङ् prefixed.
20998: नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, bowed, reclining. 2 Crooked, curved. n. (-तं) 1 The are or distance of any planet from the zenith. 3 A plant or its root: see तगर and तगरमूल. E. नम to bow or bend, affix क्त.
20999: नतनाडिका f. (-का) Any hour of birth, after noon or before midnight. E. नत, and नाडिका a period of twenty-four minutes.
21000: नतनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Flat-nosed. E. नत bowed, and नासिक the nose.
21001: नतभाग m. (-गः) (In Astronomy,) Zenith distance. E. नत, and भाग a part.
21002: नतभ्रू mfn. (-भ्रूः-भ्रूः-भ्रू) Frowning. E. नत, and भ्रू the brow.
21003: नतमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Down-faced, looking down. E. नत, and मुख the face.
21004: नतमूर्द्धन् mfn. (-र्द्धा-र्द्धा-र्द्ध) Looking down, hanging down the head. E. नत, मूर्द्धन् the forehead.
21005: नतांश m. (-शं) Zenith distance, (in Astronomy.) E. नत, and अंश a degree.
21006: नताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bent, curved, bowed, stooping. f. (-ङ्गी) A woman. E. नत, and अङ्ग the body.
21007: नति f. (-तिः) 1 Bending, bowing, stooping. 2 Curvature, crookedness. E. नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.
21009: नद r. 1st and 10th cls. (नदति नादयति) 1 To speak or emit sound. 2 To shine: see खद. With वि and अनु, To fill with noise or sound; (दु इ,) दुनदि r. 1st cl. (नन्दति) 1 To thrive, to be prosperous. 2 (Usually with आङ् prefixed,) To be happy, to be pleased or delighted. With अभि prefixed, 1 To wish for. 2 To acknowledge or confess. With प्रति, To be thankful.
21010: नद m. (-दः) A river, applied only to one of which the personification is male, as the Brahmaputra, Śoṇa, Indus, &c. f. (-दी) A river in general; the common personification of rivers being female. E. नद to sound, affix अट्, fem. affix ङीप्.
21011: नदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Sounding, making a sound. E. नद to sound, शतृ aff.
21012: नदनदीपति m. (-तिः) The sea. E. नद, and नदी, and पति lord.
21013: नदनु m. (-नुः) 1 A cloud. 2 A lion. E. नद to sound, अनुङ् Uṇādi aff.
21014: नदीकान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The ocean. 2 A sort of tree, (Barringtonia acutangula:) see इज्जल. 3 A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) f. (-न्ता) 1 A creeper. 2 The rose apple, (Eugenia jambu.) 3 A shrub, (Leea hirta.) E. नदी a river, कान्त loved.
21015: नदीकूल n. (-लः) The bank or shore of a river. E. नदी a river, कूल a bank.
21016: नदीकूलप्रिय m. (-यः) A sort of reed, (Calamus rotang.) E. नदीकूल a river bank, and प्रिय fond of; growing on the banks of rivers.
21017: नदीज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, water-born. n. (-जं) 1 Antimony. 2 A lotus. m. (-जः) 1 A sort of tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 2 The marshy date tree. 3 A name of BHĪṢMA. E. नदी a river, and ज born.
21018: नदीज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who knows the course of rivers, &c. E. नदी, and ज्ञ who knows.
21019: नदीतरस्थान n. (-नं) A Ghāt, a landing place, a ferry. E. नदी a river, तर crossing, and स्थान place; also नदीतरस्थल.
21020: नदीतीर n. (-रं) The bank of a river. E. नदी, and तीर a bank.
21021: नदीन m. (-नः) 1 The ocean. 2 The god of water, VARUṆA. E. नदी a river, and इन lord.
21022: नदीमातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Watered by rivers, (land, rice, &c.) E. नदी a river, मातृ a mother, कन् aff.
21023: नदीरय m. (-यः) The stream or current of a river. E. नदी, and रय going.
21024: नदीवङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The bend or arm of a river. E. नदी a river, and वङ्क a bend.
21025: नदीवेग m. (-गः) The stream or current of a river. E. नदी, and वेग speed.
21026: नदीवेला f. (-ला) The current or stream of a river. E. नदी, and वेला flow.
21027: नदीष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) 1 Bathing, &c. in a river. 2 One who knows rivers, their depth, course, &c. E. नदी river, स्ना to bathe, ड affix; and स्न changed to ष्ण.
21028: नदीसर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. नदी a river, and सर्ज्ज the Śāl tree.
21029: नदेयी f. (-यी) A plant, (Premna herbacea, Rox.) E. नदी a river, ढक्, affix; also नादेयी.
21030: नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Bound, tied. 2 Drawn up, raised. E. नह to tye, affix क्त.
21031: नद्धी f. (-द्धी) A leather cord, a thong. E. नह to bind, ष्ट्रन् aff.
21032: ननान्दृ f. (-न्दा) A husband's sister. E. न negative, नन्द to please, ऋत् Uṇādi affix; also the penultimate being made long, ननान्दृ.
21033: ननु ind. 1 A particle of interrogation, (how, what.) 2 Of affirmation, (certainly.) 3 Of assent. 4 A consolatory and kind expression. 5 A vocative particle, (ho, hola,) or one implying kindness, conciliation, (pray, good friend, &c.) 6 An inceptive particle, implying doubt or dissent, (may be, but, on the other hand.) 7 A responsive particle. 8 A particle of reproach. E. न negative, नुद to send or command, affix डु.
21034: ननुच ind. An inceptive particle, implying doubt, dissent, or contradiction. E. ननु as above, and च particle.
21035: नन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be saluted, to be revered or honoured. E. नम to salute, तव्य aff.
21036: नन्द mf. (-न्दः-न्दी) Happiness, pleasure, felicity. m. (-न्दः) 1 One of KUVERA'S nine inestimable gems or treasure. 2 The cowherd NANDA, the foster father of KṚṢṆA. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. 4 A prince, the son of MAHĀNANDI. 5 A flute, one eleven inches long. f. (-न्दा) 1 An earthen water jar. 2 The first, sixth, or eleventh day of the fortnight. 3 Prosperity, increase. 4 A husband's sister. f. (-न्दी) INDRA'S garden. f. (-न्दा or -न्दी) A name of DURGĀ. E. नदि to be prosperous or happy, affix अच् and टाप्.
21037: नन्दक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Rejoicing, making happy or delighted. 2 Cherishing or rearing a family. m. (-कः) 1 Happiness, pleasure. 2 The sword of KṚṢṆA. 3 The foster father of KṚṢṆA. 4 A frog. E. नदि to make happy, affix वुन्.
21038: नन्दकि f. (-किः) Long pepper. E. नदि to delight, affix कि.
21039: नन्दकिन् m. (-की) KṚṢṆA. E. नन्दक, and इनि aff.
21040: नन्दगोपिता f. (-ता) A plant: see रास्ना.
21041: नन्दथु m. (-थुः) Happiness, felicity. E. नदि to be happy, affix अथुच्.
21042: नन्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Delighting, rejoicing, making pleased or happy. m. (-नः) 1 A son. 2 A frog. 3 VIṢṆU. n. (-नं) INDRA'S pleasure ground, elysium. 2 A species of the Dhṛti metre. f. (-ना) A daughter, E. नदि to be or make happy, affix ल्यु.
21043: नन्दनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. नन्द, and नन्दन a son; the son of NANDA.
21044: नन्दनन्दिनी f. (-नी) A name of DURGĀ. E. नन्द the cowherd NANDA, and नन्दिनी a daughter.
21045: नन्दन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A son. 2 A friend. 3 A prince. E. नदि to make happy, झच् Uṇādi aff.
21046: नन्दनमाला f. (-ला) A chaplet or garland made by KṚṢṆA. E. नन्दन delighting, माला a garland.
21047: नन्दयत् mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत) Making happy, delighting. E. नदि to be happy, causal v. शतृ aff.
21048: नन्दयन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Making happy, rejoicing, delighting. E. नदि in the causal form, with झच् aff.
21049: नन्दपाल m. (-लः) A name of VARUṆA. E. नन्द KUVERA'S treasure, and पाल who guards.
21050: नन्दपुत्री f. (-त्री) DURGĀ. E. नन्द the cowherd NANDA, and पुत्री a daughter; the goddess becoming incarnate, as the infant daughter of NANDA.
21051: नन्दात्मज m. (-जः) KṚṢṆA. f. (-जा) DURGĀ. E. नन्द as above, and आत्मज offspring: see नन्दनन्दन; also नन्दपुत्र, नन्दसुत, &c.
21052: नन्दि mn. (-न्दिः-न्दि) 1 Gambling, gaming. 2 Happiness. m. (-न्दिः) 1 One of ŚIVA'S principal attendants. 2 The speaker of the prologue or prelude to a drama. 3 One who pronounces a benediction. E. नदि to make happy, and इन् Uṇādi aff.
21053: नन्दिक m. (-कः) Tūn, a tree, the wood of which resembles mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.) f. (-का) 1 INDRA'S garden or pleasure ground. 2 An earthen water pot. 3 The first, sixth, or eleventh day of a fortnight. E. नन्द, with कन् or ठक् aff.
21054: नन्दिकेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 One of ŚIVA'S chief attendants. 2 An inferior Purāṇa. E. नन्दिक INDRA'S garden, and ईश्वर master.
21055: नन्दिघोष m. (-षः) 1 The car of ARJUNA. 2 The acclaim or proclamation of a panegyrist or herald. E. नन्दि happy, and घोष sound.
21056: नन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Happy, rejoiced, delighted. m. (-न्दी) 1 The name of one of ŚIVA'S chamberlains, and chief attendants. 2 The Indian fig tree. 3 Pārspīpal, (Hibiscus populneoides.) 4 The speaker of the prelude or prologue to a drama. f. (-न्दिनी) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ. 2 GAṄGĀ, the river goddess. 3 A husband's sister. 4 A fabulous cow, related to the cow of plenty, and the property of the sage VAŚIṢṬHA. 5 The Alakanandā river. 6 The mother of the writer VYĀḌI. E. नन्द happiness, इनि aff.
21057: नन्दिनीतनय m. (-यः) A name of VYĀḌI, author of a vocabulary. E. नन्दिनी as above, and तनय a son; also similar compounds, as नन्दिनीसुत, नन्दिनीपुत्त्र, &c.
21058: नन्दिवर्द्धन m. (-नः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 The last day of either half of the month, the full or new moon. 3 A son. 4 A friend. E. नन्दि happiness, &c. and वर्द्धन increasing.
21059: नन्दिवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Tūn tree. E. नन्दि pleasure, and वृक्ष a tree: also ङीष् being added to नन्दि, नन्दीवृक्ष; or with कन् added, नन्दिवृक्षक.
21060: नन्दीट m. (-टः) A bald-headed man. E. नन्दि ŚIVA'S bald-headed attendant, and अट who resembles, deriv. irr.
21062: नन्दीश m. (-शः) 1 A name of NANDĪ, ŚIVA'S attendant. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 A species of musical rhythm. E. नन्दी INDRA'S garden, or नन्दि a proper name, ईश master.
21063: नन्दीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of ŚIVA, &c.: see the last. E. नन्दि ŚIVA'S chamberlain, and ईश्वर master.
21064: नन्दीसरस् n. (-रः) A lake or pond in INDRA'S garden. E. नन्दी the garden, सरस् a piece of water.
21065: नन्द्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A sort of temple. 2 A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria:) see तगर. 3 A peculiar diagram. E. नन्दी happiness, आवर्त्त abode.
21066: नन्नम्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bending or bowing very low. E. नम to bow, intens. form, शानच् aff.
21067: नपुंसक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A eunuch. 2 An impotent or imbecile man. 3 The neuter gender. E. न not, पुंसक a male.
21068: नप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A grandson. f. (-प्त्री) A granddaughter. E. न not, पत to fall, तृच् Uṇādi affix; propping or sustaining the family.
21069: नभ m. (-भः) 1 The month Śrāvaṇa. 2 Æther, atmosphere. f. (-भा) 1 A spitting pot. 2 The city of the sun. E. नह to bind, affix भ; see नभस्.
21070: नभःक्रान्तिन् m. (-न्ति) A lion. E. नभस् a cloud, and क्रान्तिन् who goes; whose shape is seen in the clouds.
21071: नभःप्राण m. (-णः) Air, wind. E. नभस् atmosphere, and प्राण life or breath.
21072: नभःसद् m. (-सद्) A deity. E. नभस् heaven, and सद् who travels, from सद to go, with क्विप् aff.
21073: नभःसरित् f. (-रित्) The celestial Ganges. E. नभस् heaven, and सरित् a river.
21074: नभःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Celestial, aerial, heavenly, etherial. E. नभस्, and स्थ what stays; also नभस्स्थ.
21075: नभःस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) A biding in heaven or in the sky. m. (-तः) A division of the infernal regions, a hell. E. नभस् atmosphere, and स्थित a staying; also नभस्स्थित.
21076: नभश्चक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) The sun. E. नभस् heaven, and चक्षुस् the eye.
21077: नभश्चमस m. (-सः) 1 The moon. 2 A variegated cake. 3 Conjuring. E. नभस् heaven, and चमस a sort of ladle, &c.
21078: नभश्चर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going in the air or heaven. m. (-रः) 1 A bird. 2 A Vidyādhara or demigod so called. 3 A cloud. 4 Air, wind. E. नभस् heaven, and चर who goes.
21079: नभस् m. (-भाः) 1 The month Śrāvaṇa, (July-August.) 2 A cloud. 3 The rains, or rainy season. 4 Smell. 5 The fibres in the root of the lotus. 6 A bird. 7 A grey-headed man. n. (-भः) Sky, atmosphere, æther or heaven. E. नभ to injure, to be annihilated, (at the end of the world,) Uṇādi affix असुन्, or नह to bind, and भ substituted for ह.
21080: नभस n. (-सं) Heaven, sky, &c. see the last. E. नभ as above, Uṇādi affix असच्.
21081: नभसङ्गम m. (-मः) A bird. E. नभस heaven, गम to go, affix खच.
21082: नभस्तल m. (-लः) The atmosphere. E. नभस् sky, and तल below.
21083: नभस्य m. (-स्यः) The month Bhādra, (August-September.) E. नभस् a cloud or rain, and यत् aff.
21084: नभस्वत् m. (-स्वान्) Air, wind. E. नभस्, and मतुप् aff.
21085: नभाक n. (-कं) Darkness. E. नभ to injure, आक Uṇādi aff.
21087: नभोगज m. (-जः) A cloud. E. नभस् sky, and गज an elephant.
21088: नभोगति f. (-तिः) Flying, soaring, going in the air. E. नभस् sky and गति going.
21089: नभोदुह m. (-हः) A cloud. E. नभस् rain, (-दुह) to milk, affix क.
21090: नभोद्वीप m. (-पः) A cloud. E. नभस् rain, द्वीप an island.
21091: नभोधूम m. (-मः) A cloud. E. नभस् sky, and भूम smoke.
21092: नभोनदी f. (-दी) The celestial Ganges. E. नभस् heaven, and नदी a river.
21093: नभोमणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. नभस् sky, मणि a gem.
21094: नभोऽम्बुप m. (-पः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. नभस् sky, अम्बु water, and प who drinks.
21095: नभोरजस् n. (-जः) Darkness. E. नभस् sky, and रजस् dust.
21096: नभोरेणु f. (-णुः) Fog, mist, vapour. E. नभस् sky, and रेणु thin dust.
21097: नभोलय m. (-यः) Smoke. E. नभस् sky, and लय abode.
21098: नभोलिह् mfn. (-लिट्) Lofty, towering, rising to the clouds. E. नभस्, and लिह् what touches.
21099: नभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Relating to the nave of a wheel, resembling it, &c. E. नभ for नाभि, and यत् aff.
21100: नभ्राज् m. (-भ्राट्) A cloud. E. न negative, भ्राज to shine, affix क्विप्.
21101: नम r. 1st cl. (नमति) To bow, to pay obeisance. r. 10th cl. (नमयति-नामयति) To bend, to bow: see णम.
21102: नमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Bending, stooping, bowed. E. नम to bow, शतृ aff.
21103: नमत m. (-तः) 1 A master, a lord. 2 An actor, a mime. 3 A cloud. E. नम to bow or bend, Uṇādi affix अतच्.
21104: नमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Bending, directing downward, declining. E. नम to bow. r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.
21105: नमस् ind. 1 Gift, present. 2 Bowing, bending, salutation, obeisance. 3 An inarticulate cry. 4 The term used in connexion with the name of a deity in the fifth case to signify veneration, as रामाय नमः salutation, glory or reverence to RĀMA. E. नम to bend, and affix असुन्.
21106: नमस m. (-सः) Agreement, concord. E. नम to bow, affix कसच्.
21107: नमसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverenced, respected, worshipped. E. नमस् bowing, क्यप् affix, and क्त added, य rejected: see नमस्यित.
21108: नमस्कार m. (-रः) 1 Respectful or reverential address or salutation. 2 A sort of poison. f. (-री) A sensitive plant. E. नमस् bowing, and कार making, fem. affix ङीप्.
21109: नमस्कृत्वा ind. Having saluted reverentially. E. नमस्, and कृत्वा having made.
21110: नमस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Venerable, respectable, entitled to salutation or civility. f. (-स्या) Reverence, respect, worship, adoration. E. नमस् respect, क्यप् aff.
21111: नमस्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Saluting reverentially, bowing to, paying adoration. E. नमस् nominal verb, to bow, शतृ aff.
21112: नमस्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverenced, respected, worshipped. E. नमस् respect, affix क्यप्, and the participial affix क्त; also नमसित.
21113: नमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bowed, making salutation or obeisance. 2 Bowed, bent down. E. नम to bend, causal form, affix क्त.
21114: नमुचि m. (-चिः) 1 The deity of love. 2 A demon so named. E. न negative, मुच to loose, and कि aff.
21115: नमुचिसूदन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA. E. नमुचि the demon, and सूदन destroyer; also similar names, as नमुचिद्विष्, &c.
21116: नमेरु m. (-रुः) The seed of the Elæocarpus. E. न not, मेरु the mountain Meru.
21117: नमोगुरु m. (-रुः) A spiritual teacher. E. नमस् reverence, and गुरु a teacher.
21118: नम्ब r. 1st cl. (नम्बति) To go, to move.
21119: नम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Crooked, curved, bent, bowed. E. नम to bow, affix र.
21120: नम्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bent or bowed, stooping. E. कन् added to the last.
21121: नम्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking down, having the head bent. E. नम्र, and मुख the face.
21122: नम्रमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Bending down, stooping, bowed. E. नम्र, and मूर्त्ति form.
21123: नम्राङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bent, bowed, stooping. E. नम्र, and अङ्ग the body.
21124: नय r. 1st cl. (-नयते) To go, to move: see णय and णी.
21125: नय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Fit, right, proper. 2 Leading, conducting, (who or what does so.) m. (-यः) 1 Guiding, directing, (literally or figuratively, as in morals, &c.) 2 Polity, civil and military government. 3 The theological part of the Vedas. 4 A sort of dice or men for playing with. 5 A guide, a conductor. E. नय to go, affix घञ्, or णी to guide, &c. affix अच्.
21126: नयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Leading, guiding. 2 Tending or conducing to. 3 Informing, certifying, giving in evidence. 4 Obtaining. E. णी to obtain, शतृ aff.
21127: नयन n. (-नं) 1 The eye. 2 Leading, guiding, (literally or figuratively.) 3 Attaining, obtaining. 4 Bringing. f. (-ना) The pupil of the eye. E. णी to guide, affix ल्युट्.
21128: नयनवारि n. (-रि) Tears. E. नयन, and वारि water.
21129: नयनामोषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Sight-stealing, blinding. E. नयन, and आमोषिन् what steals.
21130: नयनोत्सव m. (-वः) 1 A lamp. 2 Any lovely or desired object. E. नयन the eye, and उत्सव a festival.
21131: नयनोपान्त m. (-न्तः) The outer angle or canthus of the eye. E. नयन, and उपान्त extremity.
21132: नयनौषध m. (-धः) Green sulphate of iron, or the salt in a state of partial decomposition by exposure to the atmosphere. E. नयन the eye, and औषध a medicament, being used as a collyrium.
21133: नयपीठी f. (-ठी) The board or cloth on which dice or men are played. E. नय dice, पीठी a stool.
21134: नयप्रयोग m. (-गः) Policy, political address. E. नय, and प्रयोग application.
21135: नयविशारद m. (-दः) A politician, a statesman. E. नय, and विशारद skilled in.
21136: नयसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Political success, accomplishing any thing by good management. E. नय, and सिद्धि success.
21137: नर m. (-रः) 1 Man, individually or generally. 2 The Eternal, the divine imperishable spirit pervading the universe. 3 A name of ARJUNA. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 A gnomon. 6 A man or piece at chess, draughts, &c. 7 A Muni, an incarnation of VIṢṆU. n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, commonly Rāmkapūr. f. (-री) Woman in general: see नारी. E. नृ to lead or guide, affix अच्.
21138: नरक mn. (-कः-कं) Hell, the infernal regions, including a number of places of torture of various descriptions. m. (-कः) The name of a Daitya or demon. E. नृ to guide or lead, affix वुन्, whither the wicked are conducted: sometimes read नारक.
21139: नरककुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A well or pit in Tartarus, eighty-six such are enumerated. E. नरक, and कुण्ड a pit.
21140: नरकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of VIṢṆU. E. नरक the demon, and जित् subduing.
21141: नरकदेवता f. (-ता) Misfortune, personified as a goddess. E. नरक, and देवता divinity.
21142: नरकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Living or being in Tartarus, who or what is there. f. (-स्था) The river of hell. E. नरक hell, स्थ who stays or abides, fem. affix टाप्.
21143: नरकान्तक m. (-कः) VIṢṆU. E. नरक hell, and अन्तक destroyer.
21144: नरकामय m. (-यः) The soul after death. E. नरक hell, and आमव sickness.
21145: नरकीलक m. (-कः) The murderer of his spiritual preceptor. E. नर mankind, and कील a stake, affix कन्.
21146: नरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Pimples on the face. n. (-ङ्गं) The penis. E. नृ to guide or lead, Uṇādi affix अङ्ग.
21147: नरदेव m. (-वः) A sovereign, a king. E. नर a man, and देव a deity.
21148: नरनारायण m. dual. (-णौ) Two sages, incarnations of VIṢṆU, and born again, as KṚṢṆA and ARJUNA. E. नर, and नारायण, each severally the name of a sage.
21149: नरपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign prince. E. नर man, पति lord.
21150: नरप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Favourable or friendly to mankind. E. नर, and प्रिय fond of.
21151: नरभू f. (-भूः) Bharata Varṣa, India, or the central part of the known continent. 2 The birth or birthplace of men. E. नर man, and भू land; also नरभूमि f. (-मिः)
21152: नरमानिनी f. (-नी) A woman who has a beard. E. नर a man, मन to regard or think, and णिनि affix; also with कन् affix in the feminine form, नरमानिका; these words are also written नरमालिनी, &c.
21153: नरमाला f. (-ला) A string or girdle of skulls. E. नर, and माला a garland.
21154: नरमालिनी f. (-नी) A woman with a beard. E. नर a man, माला a necklace, इनि aff.
21155: नरमेध m. (-धः) A human sacrifice. E. नर, and मेध a sacrifice.
21156: नरवाहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Borne or carried by men. m. (-नः) A name of KUVERA. E. नर a man, and वाहन a vehicle.
21157: नरवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Carried by men, (a vehicle.) E. नर, and वाहिन् what bears.
21158: नरविष्वण m. (-णः) An imp or goblin. E. नर man, and विष्वण who devours.
21159: नररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Having the form of man. n. (-पं) The human form. E. नर, and रूप form.
21160: नररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Having the human form. E. नररूप, and इनि aff.
21161: नरसिंह m. (-हः) 1 VIṢṆU in his fourth Avatāra or descent, the lion-headed man. 2 A chief, a man of eminence or power. E. नर a man, and सिंह a lion.
21162: नरहरि m. (-रिः) VIṢṆU in his fourth Avatar: see the last. E. नर, and हरि a lion.
21163: नराधम m. (-मः) A low or vile man, a wretch. E. नर, and अधम low.
21164: नराधारा f. (-रा) The earth. E. नर man, आधार receptacle.
21165: नराधिप m. (-पः) A king. E. नर, and अधिप ruler.
21166: नरान्तक m. (-कः) 1 Death. 2 A Rākṣasa, a son of RĀVAṆA. E. नर, and अन्तक destroyer.
21167: नरायण m. (-णः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. नर man, and अयण going: see नारायण.
21168: नरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A king, an anointed sovereign. 2 A dealer in antidotes, a juggler. E. नर a man, इन्द्र chief.
21169: नरेश m. (-शः) A king. E. नर, and ईश master.
21170: नरेश्वर m. (-रः) A king. E. नर, and ईश्वर a sovereign.
21172: नर्त्तक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, a mime. 2 A juggler, a dancer, a player of any description. 3 A bard, a herald. 4 An elephant. 5 A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 5 A peacock. f. (-की) 1 An actress, female dancer or singing girl. 2 A female elephant. 3 A peahen. E. नृत to dance or act, ष्वुन् aff.
21173: नर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing, gesticulating, acting. E. नृत to dance, &c. affix ल्युट्.
21174: नर्त्तनप्रिय m. (-यः) A peacock. E. नर्त्तन dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
21175: नर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Danced, dancing. E. नृत to dance, क्त aff.
21176: नर्द्द r. 1st cl. (नर्द्दति प्रनर्द्दति) To sound: the radical न is not convertible to ण after a preposition, &c. see णर्द्द.
21177: नर्द्दटक n. (-कं) A kind of metre, containing eight feet of various syllabic quantities.
21178: नर्द्दत् mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्) 1 Sounding. 2 Praising aloud, proclaiming. E. नर्द्द, and शतृ aff.
21179: नर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Sounding, roaring, making a noise. 2 Celebrating, praising aloud. E. नर्द्द to sound, affix ल्युट.
21180: नर्द्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be sounded. 2 To be celebrated or praised aloud. E. नर्द्द sound, and अनीयर् aff.
21181: नर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, made as a noise. 2 Celebrated, praised aloud. n. (-तं) Sound, roar, bellowing. E. नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.
21182: नर्द्धटक m. (-कं) A stanza of four parts, having seventeen syllables in each.
21183: नर्ब्ब r. 1st. cl. (नर्ब्बति) To go, to move.
21184: नर्म्मकील m. (-लः) A husband. E. नर्म्म amusement, कील a prop or stay.
21185: नर्म्मगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A secret lover. E. नर्म्म, and गर्भ source.
21186: नर्म्मट m. (-टः) 1 The sun. 2 A potsherd. E. नर्म्म, and अट what goes, deriv. irr.
21187: नर्म्मठ m. (-ठः) 1 The nipple. 2 A rake, a lecher, a libertine. 3 Sport, amusement. 4 Coition. E. नर्म्म pleasure, स्था to abide, ड affix, deriv. irr.
21188: नर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Delighting, making happy, giving pleasure. m. (-दः) The associate or companion of a person's sports or amusements. f. (-दा) 1 The Narmadā river, which rising in the Vindhyā mountains, runs westward to the gulf of Cambay. 2 A plant: see पृक्का. E. नर्म्म pleasure, and द what gives.
21189: नर्म्मद्युति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Happy, merry. f. (-तिः) Enjoyment of a joke or any amusement. E. नर्म्म, and द्युति lustre.
21190: नर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Sport, amusement, pastime, diversion. 2 Jest, joke. 3 Wit, humour. E. नृ to guide, affix मनिन्.
21191: नर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A companion, an associate, the promoter and partaker of a person's amusements, especially of a prince or man of rank. E. नर्म्मन्, and सचिव a minister.
21192: नर्म्मसाचिव्य n. (-व्यं) Superintendence or provision of a prince's amusements, partaking a person's amusements. E. नर्म्मसाचिव, and ष्यञ् aff.
21193: नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) Happiness or amusement ending in alarm. E. नर्म्म, and स्फूर्ज्ज thundering.
21194: नर्म्मस्फोट m. (-टः) Slight or inferior amusement. E. नर्म्म, and स्फोट opening.
21195: नल r. 10th cl. (नालयति) 1 To shine. 2 To bind or confine.
21196: नल m. (-लः) 1 A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 2 The name of a king, son of NIṢADHA, and hero of several poetical works famous amongst the Hindus, especially the poem called Naiṣadha. 3 Another prince, the son of VĪRASENA. 4 A deified progenitor or Pitṛdeva. 5 The name of a monkey chief. 6 A demon. f. (-ली) Red arsenick. 2 A perfume, commonly called by the same name of Nali. n. (-लं) 1 The water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum.) 2 Smell, odour. E. नल to shine, affix अच्.
21197: नलक n. (-कं) A bone of either of the extremities, any long bone. E. नल a reed, and कन् affix of resemblance.
21198: नलकिनी f. (-नी) The knee cap or pan. E. नलक as above, and इनि affix; connecting the bones of the lower extremity.
21199: नलकील m. (-लः) The knee. E. नल a reed, or reed-like bone, and कील a pin or bolt.
21200: नलकूवेर m. (-रः) The son of KUVERA. E. नल a reed, कूवेर a carriage yoke.
21201: नलद n. (-दं) Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) f. (-दा) 1 The honey or nectar of a flower. 2 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. नल here said to mean, fragrance, and द what gives.
21202: नलपट्टिका f. (-का) A sort of mat made with reeds, a coarse mat. E. नल a reed, and पट्ट a cloth, कन् affix of similitude.
21203: नलमीन m. (-नः) A kind of sprat, or according to some, a shrimp or prawn. E. नल a reed, and मीन a fish; frequenting reedy spots.
21204: नलिका f. (-का) A perfume: see नली. E. नली, and कन् added.
21205: नलिन n. (-नं) 1 A lotus or water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum, or Nymphaea nelumbo.) 2 Water. 3 Indigo. m. (-नः) 1 The Indian crane. 2 A small fruit, Karonda. f. (-नी) 1 An assemblage of lotus flowers. 2 A place abounding in lotuses. 3 The flexible stalk of a water lily. 4 A pond in which the lotus grows or may grow. 5 The Ganges of heaven. 6 The fermented and intoxicating juice of the cocoanut. E. नल to be bright, Uṇādi affix इनच्.
21206: नलिनीरुह m. (-हः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 The fibres of the lotus stalk. E. नलिनी, and रुह what grows.
21207: नलिनेशय m. (-यः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. नलिने in a lotus, and शय who sleeps.
21208: नल्व m. (-ल्वः) A furlong, a distance measured by four hundred cubits. E. नल to be as a reed in length, and व aff.
21209: नल्ववर्त्मगा f. (-गा) The orange tree. E. नल्व as above, वर्त्म a road, and ग what goes.
21210: नव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) New. m. (-बः) Praise, panegyrick, celebration. E. नु to praise, &c. affix अच्.
21211: नवकारिका f. (-का) 1 A bride, a woman newly married. 2 A new comment. E. नव new, and कारिका agent.
21212: नवकास्तिका f. (-का) A young woman, either one recently married or one in whom menstruation has lately commenced. E. नव new, काल time, कन् added with the fem. form.
21213: नवग्रह m. plu. (-हाः) The nine planets, or sun, moon, five planets, and the ascending and descending nodes. E. नव for नवन्, and ग्रह a planet.
21214: नवछात्र m. (-त्रः) A student, a novice. E. नव new, and छात्र a disciple.
21215: नवत m. (-तः) An elephant's painted or variegated housings. E. नव new, तन् to spread, affix ड.
21216: नवता f. (-ता) Novelty. E. तल् added to नव; also with त्व, नवत्वं.
21217: नवति f. (-तिः or -ती) Ninety. E. नव nine, and क्तिन् aff.
21218: नवतिका f. (-का) A painting brush. E. नवति ninety, (hairs,) कन् aff.
21219: नवतिधा ind. Ninety-fold. E. नवति, and घा aff.
21220: नवतिशस् ind. Ninety by ninety. E. नवति, and शस् aff.
21221: नवदल n. (-लं) 1 The new leaf of a lotus. 2 Any young leaf. E. नव new, and दल a leaf.
21222: नवदीधिति m. (-तिः) Mars, the planet or its deified regent. E. नव nine, दीधिति a ray.
21223: नवदुर्गा f. (-र्गा) The nine forms of DURGĀ. E. नव, and दुर्गा the goddess.
21224: नवदोला f. (-ला) A litter borne by nine men. E. नव, and दोल a litter.
21225: नवद्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having nine doors; an epithet applied to the body, which has nine inlets or outlets, as the nostrils, ears, mouth, &c. E. नव, and द्वार a door.
21226: नवधा ind. Nine-fold, in nine ways. E. नव nine, and धा aff.
21229: नवनीत n. (-तं) Fresh butter. E. नव new, and नीत procured (from milk, &c.)
21230: नवनीतक n. (-कं) Clarified butter. E. कन् added to the last.
21231: नवनीतधेनु f. (-नुः) A quantity of butter as a present to Brahmans. E. नवनीत, and धेनु a milch cow.
21232: नवपल्लव n. (-वं) A new shoot or sprout. E. नव, and पल्लव a shoot.
21233: नवफलिका f. (-का) 1 A bride, a newly married woman. 2 A girl in whom menstruation has recently begun. E. नव new, फल fruit, and ठक् aff.
21234: नवबधू n. (-धूः) A bride, a newly married woman. E. नव, and बधु a wife.
21235: नवम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Ninth. f. (-मी) The ninth day of a lunar half month. E. नव nine, and मट् aff.
21236: नवमल्लिका f. (-का) Double jasmine: see the next.
21237: नवमालिका f. (-का) Double jasmine, (J. Zambac.) E. नव excellent, praised, and मालिका or मलिका jasmine: see the last.
21238: नवयौवना f. (-ना) A young woman. E. नव new, and यौवन young.
21239: नवरक्तक f. (-कं) A newly dyed garment. E. नव, रक्त red, and कन् aff.
21240: नवरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Gift to five and acceptance by four persons of the best Kāyastha families. E. नव, and रङ्ग colour.
21241: नवरत्न n. (त्नं) 1 Nine precious gems, or a pearl, ruby, topaz, diamond, emerald, lapis lazuli, coral, sapphire, and one called Gomeda. 2 The nine men of letters at the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA, or DHANVANTARI, KṢAPAṆAKA, AMARASIṂHA, SAṄKU, VETĀLABHAṬṬA, GHAṬAKARPARA, KĀLIDĀSA, VARĀHAMIHIRA, and VARARUCI. E. नव, and रत्न a jewel.
21242: नवरात्र n. (-त्रं) The period of nine days, from the first of the light half of Aśvin to the ninth; part of the time devoted to the worship of DURGĀ. E. नव, and रात्र for रात्रि a night.
21243: नववरिका f. (-का) A newly married woman. E. नव new, वर a blessing, affix कन् added, fem. affix टाप्.
21244: नववस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) New cloth. E. नव new, and वस्त्र cloth.
21245: नवशस् ind. Nine by nine. E. नव, and शस् aff.
21246: नवशस्य n. (-स्यं) Grain of the year's harvest. E. नव, and शस्य grain.
21247: नवशस्येष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A sacrifice performed on eating the new rice or grain of the year. E. नवशस्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.
21248: नवशायक m. (-कः) A name given to any of nine inferior classes, the cowherd, gardener, oilman, weaver, confectioner, water-carrier, potter, blacksmith, and barber.
21249: नवश्राद्ध n. (-द्धं) The first series of Śrāddhas collectively, or funeral offerings on the first, third, fifth, seventh, ninth, and eleventh days after a person's demise. E. नव, and श्राद्ध obsequial rite.
21250: नवसूतिका f. (-का) 1 A milch cow. 2 A woman recently delivered. E. नक new, and सूत offspring, and कन् affix, fem. form.
21251: नवांश m. (-शः) A ninth, a ninth part. E. नव, and अंश share.
21252: नवान्न n. (-न्नं) 1 New rice or grain. 2 A ceremony observed on first eating the rice, &c. of the last harvest. E. नव, and अन्न food.
21253: नवाम्बर n. (-रं) New and unbleached cloth. E. नव new, and अम्बर cloth.
21254: नवार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mars or its deified personification. E. नव nine, and अर्च्चिस् light.
21255: नवाह m. (-हः) 1 A new day. 2 The first day of the fortnight. E. नव new, and अह a day.
21256: नवीकरण n. (-णं) Renewing, doing or making anew. E. नव, करण making, च्चि augment.
21257: नवीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived, done or made anew. E. नव, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
21258: नवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) New. E. नव new, ख pleonasm, and the semivowel changed.
21259: नवीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived. E. नव, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
21260: नवै ind. Not so perhaps, a particle implying doubt. E. न not, वै expletive.
21261: नवोढा f. (-ढा) A newly married woman, a bride. E. नव new, and ऊढा a wife.
21262: नवोद्धृत n. (-तं) Fresh butter. E. नव new, उद्धृत made.
21263: नव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) New, recent, young, &c. m. (-व्यः) Praise, panegyrick. E. नव new, and यत् aff.
21264: नशाक m. (-कः) A bird, said to be a sort of crow. E. णश to destroy, affix आक.
21265: नशितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Destroying. E. णश to destroy, affix तृच् with इट् augment, else with a nasal augment नष्टृ.
21266: नश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Perishing, decaying, wasting, being destroyed. E. नश to perish, and शतृ aff.
21267: नश्यत्प्रसूतिका f. (-का) A female bearing a dead child. E. नश्यत्, प्रसूतिका a mother.
21268: नश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mischievous, destructive. E. णशि to destroy, affix क्वरप्.
21269: नष्ट mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Lost, destroyed, removed, annihilated. E. णश to perish, affix क्त.
21270: नष्टचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The moon on the fourth lunation of either half of Bhādra. E. नष्ट, and चन्द्र the moon: it is very unlucky to see the moon on these days.
21271: नष्टचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fainted, insensible. E. नष्ट, and चेतन conscious.
21272: नष्टचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Insensible, inert. E. नष्ट, and चेष्टा effort.
21273: नष्टचेष्टता f. (-ता) Fainting, swooning, insensibility, proceeding either from joy or sorrow, &c. E. नष्ट lost, चेष्टता effort.
21274: नष्टसंस्मृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Unmindful, forgetful. E. नष्ट, and संस्मृति recollection.
21275: नष्टाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman or householder who has lost his consecrated fire. E. नष्ट lost, and अग्नि fire.
21276: नष्टाप्तिसूत्र n. (-त्रं) Booty, plunder. E. नष्ट lost, आप्ति gain, and सूत्र thread or chain.
21277: नष्टार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Reduced, become poor. E. नष्ट, and अर्थ wealth.
21278: नष्टेन्दुकला f. (-ला) The day of new moon when it rises invisible. E. नष्ट, and इन्दुकला a digit.
21279: नस् f. (-नाः) The nose. E. नस to sound, affix क्विप्.
21280: नसा f. (-सा) The nose: see नासा and नासिका.
21281: नस्त m. (-स्तः) The nose. n. (-स्तं) A sternutatory, snuff, &c. f. (-स्ता) A hole bored in the septum of the nose. E. णस to make crooked, affix क्त.
21282: नस्तित m. (-तः) An ox or any other draft animal, with a string through his nose, the sort of rein usually employed in India. E. नस्त as above, the nose, formed into a nominal verb, and क्त added, nozzled or nose-led.
21283: नस्तोत m. (-तः) An ox led by a string through his nose: see the last; also नस्योत.
21284: नस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Nasal, relating or belonging to the nose. n. (-स्यं) A sternutatory, snuff. f. (-स्या) The nose. E. नसा the nose, यत् aff.
21285: नस्योत m. (-तः) An ox or other animal led by a string through the septum of the nose. E. नसा the nose, यत् affix of relation or fitness, and ऊत woven: see नस्तित.
21286: नह (औ) औनह r. 4th cl. (नह्यति-ते) To bind: see णह.
21287: नहि ind. No, not. E. णह to bind or tie, affix इन्.
21288: नहुष m. (-षः) 1 The name of a Nāga or serpent. 2 The name of a king, one of the lunar race, son of ĀYUS and grandson of PURŪRAVAS. E. णह to bind, Uṇādi affix उषन.
21289: नहुषात्मज m. (-जः) A king, also YAYĀTI. E. नहुष as above, आत्मज son.
21291: नाक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise, æther, sky, atmosphere. E. न not, with अक derived from क happiness, and the privative अ prefixed, misery; in which there is no unhappiness.
21292: नाकनाथ m. (-थः) A name of INDRA. E. नाक paradise, and नाथ lord; also with कन् added नाकनाथक.
21293: नाकनायक m. (-कः) INDRA. E. नाक, and नायक a chief.
21294: नाकवनिता f. (-ता) A nymph of heaven. E. नाक, and वनिता a wife.
21296: नाकसद् m. (-सत्) A deity. E. नाक, and सद् who dwells in.
21297: नाकिन् m. (-की) A deity, a god. E. नाक heaven, and इनि aff.
21298: नाकु m. (-कुः) 1 An ant or mole hill, a burrow. 2 A mountain. 3 A name of a Muni or saint. E. न privative, अक to go, affix उ, or नम to be crooked or bowed, Uṇādi affix उ, and नाक substituted for the radical letters.
21299: नाकुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating or belonging to an ichneumon. f. (-ली) 1 A plant: the ichneumon plant, a vegetable supposed to furnish the mungoose with an antidote, when bitten in a conflict with a snake, (Serpent ophioxylon?) 2 The root of the Simul tree, (कुक्कुटीकन्द.) A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya.) E. नकुल the ichneumon, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
21300: नाकुलान्ध्य n. (-न्ध्यं) Weakness of sight. E. नाकुल, and अन्ध्य blindness.
21301: नाकुसद्मन् m. (-द्मा) A snake. E. नाकु a mound of earth, सद्मन् a dwelling.
21302: नाक्षत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms. n. (-त्रं) A month, one computed by the moon's passage through the twenty-seven mansions, or of thirty days of sixty Gharis each. E. नक्षत्र, and अण् aff.
21303: नाक्षत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms. m. (-कः) A month of twenty-seven days, each day being the period of the moon's passage through a lunar asterism. f. (-की) The state or condition to which a person is subjected agreeably to the asterism presiding over his nativity. E. नक्षत्र as above, and ठक् aff.
21304: नाग m. (-गः) 1 A Nāga or demigod so called, having a human face, with the tail of a serpent, and the expanded neck of the Koluber Nāga; the race of these beings is said to have sprung from KADRU, the wife of KAŚYAPA, in order to people Pātāla or the regions below the earth. 2 A serpent in general, or especially the spectacle snake, or cobra capella, (Coluber Naga.) 3 An elephant. 4 A cruel or tyrannical person. 5 A cloud. 6 (In composition,) Pre-eminent. 7 A pin or nail projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon. 8 A small tree, (Mesua ferrea.) 9 A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 10 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 11 One of the airs of the body, that which is expelled by belching. 12 Betle or Pān. 13 The name of a country. n. (-गं) 1 Tin. 2 Lead. 3 One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas; it is one of those termed invariable, and always corresponds to the last half of Amāvāsyā or new moon. 4 The effects of that period on any thing done or happening during it. E. नग a mountain, and अण् affix; living or produced in mountainous regions, &c.
21305: नागकेशर m. (-रः) A small tree, commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea). E. नाग, and केशर synonyms of the same plant compounded; the word is also written नागकेसर.
21306: नागगर्भ n. (-र्भं) Red lead. E. नाग lead, and गर्भ origin.
21307: नागज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or of a Nāga, &c. n. (-जं) 1 Red lead. 2 Tin. E. नाग lead, &c. and ज produced.
21308: नागजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa:) see शारिवा. E. नाग a snake, and जिह्वा a tongue.
21309: नागजिह्विका f. (-का) Red arsenick. E. नाग a snake, जिह्वा a tongue, कन् affix of comparison.
21310: नागजीवन m. (-नः) Tin. E. नाग lead, जीवन proceeding.
21311: नागदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Elephant's tooth or ivory; also the tooth of the elephant. 2 A shelf, a pin or bracket projecting from a wall, and used to hang things upon. f. (-न्ती) 1 A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) 2 A whore. E. नाग an elephant, and दन्त a tooth.
21312: नागदन्तक m. (-कः) A wooden pin or bracket, projecting from a wall, a shelf. E. नागदन्त an elephant's tooth, and कन् affix of resemblance.
21313: नागदन्तिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly called Rāmadūtī: see विशल्या. E. नागदन्ती a plant, and कन् affix of resemblance.
21314: नागदलोपम m. (-मः) A sort of tree, commonly Parusha. E. नाग one of the plants so called, दल a leaf, and उपमा resemblance.
21315: नागद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Euphorbia. E. नाग a snake, and द्रु a tree; being used in offerings to the snake goddess MANASĀ.
21316: नागनिर्य्यूह m. (-हः) A large pin or bracket, projecting from a wall like a shelf. E. नाग an elephant, and निर्य्यूह projection.
21317: नागपाश m. (-शः) 1 A weapon of VARUṆA, the regent of water. 2 A sort of noose or knot, used in battle to entangle an enemy. E. नाग an elephant, and पाश a binding.
21318: नागपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A tree used in dyeing, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 2 Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.) 3 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.) E. नाग an elephant, and पुष्प flower.
21319: नागबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. नाग an elephant, and बन्धु friendly, liked.
21320: नागबल m. (-लः) A name of BHĪMA. f. (-ला) A creeping plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. नाग an elephant, and बल strong.
21321: नागभिद् m. (-भिद्) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.) E. नाग an elephant, and भिद् destroying; the word is sometimes written नागभृत्, from भृत् cherishing.
21322: नागमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The elephant of INDRA. E. नाग elephant, and मल्ल a boxer.
21323: नागमातृ f. (-ता) 1 A name of MANASĀ, a goddess supposed to preside over snakes. 2 Red arsenick. E. नाग a snake, and मातृ a mother.
21324: नागमार m. (-रः) A sort of potherb; also केशराज. E. नाग a snake, and मार destroying; considered as an antidote.
21325: नागयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A piece of wood erected in a place dug for water. E. नाग a snake, and यष्टि a staff; looking like a snake; also नागयष्टिका.
21326: नागर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Clever, sharp, knowing, (as a buck, a blood, a wag, &c.) 2 Town-born or bred, city, citizen. 3 Nameless. 4 Bad, vile. n. (-रं) 1 Dry ginger. 2 A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 3 A form of writing, the Devanāgarī alphabet. m. (-रः) 1 A husband's brother. 9 An orange. 2 A lecturer. 4 Denial of knowledge. 5 Fatigue. 6 Desire of final beatitude. f. (-री) 1 A sort of Euphorbin. 2 A clever or intriguing woman. E. नगर a city, अण् aff.
21327: नागरक m. (-कः) 1 The orange: see नागरङ्ग. 2 A thief. 3 An artist. E. नगर, and वुञ् aff.
21328: नागरक्त m. (-क्तः) Red lead. E. नाग mountain, and रक्त red.
21329: नागरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange; in India usually applied to the Silhet orange, (Citrus aurantium). E. नाग an elephant, रञ्ज to be sick, affix घञ्; on which elephants feed till they become ill; or नाग red lead, and रङ्ग colour, of the colour of red lead.
21331: नागराज m. (-जः) ANANTA, the chief of the Nāgas. E. नाग, and राज king.
21332: नागरीट m. (-टः) A libertine, a debauchee, a rake, a blackguard. E. नागरी an intriguing woman, अट to accompany, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
21333: नागरुक m. (-कः) The orange: see नागरङ्ग.
21334: नागरेणु m. (-णुः) Red lead. E. नाग, and रेणु oxid.
21335: नागरेयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) City, citizen. E. नगर a town, and ढकञ् aff.
21336: नागलता f. (-ता) The penis. E. नाग a snake, and लता a creeper.
21337: नागलोक m. (-कः) The Nāga regions below the earth. E. नाग a Nāga, and लोक world.
21338: नागवल्लिका f. (-का) The betel plant: see the next.
21339: नागवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The betel plant, (Piper betel.) E. नाग the infernal Nāga, and वल्ली a creeper; the creeper of the lower regions; also with कन् added नागवल्लिका.
21340: नागवारिक m. (-कः) Garuḍa, the bird of VIṢṆU. 2 A peacock. 3 A royal elephant. 4 An elephant driver or keeper. 5 The chief person in a court or assembly. E. नाग an elephant, वृ to cherish, &c. affix ठक्.
21341: नागवीट m. (-टः) A rake: see नागरीट.
21342: नागवीथी f. (-थी) The path of Airāvata, the milky way. E. नाग the elephant, वीथी a road or path.
21343: नागसम्भव n. (-वं) Minium or red lead. E. नाग lead, and सम्भव production.
21344: नागसुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) The ichneumon plant: see नाकुली. E. नाग a snake, and सुगन्ध perfume.
21345: नागाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant: see नागकेसर. E. नाग an elephant, and आख्या a name.
21347: नागाञ्चला f. (-ला) A stick or pole driven into a square piece of earth in the centre of a newly dug pond, a boring rod. E. नाग a snake, and अञ्चला end of a garment; it is also written नागाञ्जना f. (-ना) see नागयष्टि.
21348: नागाधिप m. (-पः) The great serpent ANANTA. E. नाग a serpent, and अधिप a king.
21349: नागान्तक m. (-कः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. नाग a snake, and अन्तक a destroyer; this and similar compounds are also applied to the Ardea Argala, the peacock, and other birds who are natural enemies of the serpent genus.
21350: नागारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted or riding upon an elephant. E. नाग, and आरूढ mounted.
21351: नागाशन m. (-नः) Garuḍa: see नागान्तक. E. नाग a snake, and अशन food.
21352: नागाह्व n. (-ह्वं) Hastināpura or ancient Delhi. E. नाग an elephant, and आह्वा a name.
21353: नागोद n. (-दं) Armour for the front or the belly.
21354: नागोदर n. (-रं) A breast-plate, a cuirass.
21355: नाचिकेतु m. (-तुः) A name of fire.
21356: नाट n. (-टं) 1 Dancing, acting. 2 The Carnatic. E. नट to dance, affix घञ्.
21357: नाटक m. (-कः-की-कं) An actor, acting, dancing, &c. m. (-कः) A play, a drama: the first of the ten species of dramatic compositions of the first order. f. (-की) The court of INDRA. E. नट to act or perform, ण्वुल् aff.
21358: नाटकप्रपञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) Course or arrangement of a drama. E. नाटक and प्रपञ्च extent.
21359: नाटकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dramatic. E. नाटक, and छ aff.
21360: नाटाम्र m. (-म्रः) The water melon, (Cucurbita citrullus.)
21361: नाटार m. (-रः) The son of an actress.
21362: नाटिका f. (-का) A short or light comedy, the first of the Uparūpakas or dramas of the second order. E. नट to dance, ण्वुल् aff.
21363: नाटेय m. (-यः) The son of an actress. E. नटी, and ढक् aff.
21364: नाटेर m. (-रः) The son of an actress or dancing girl. E. नटी, an actress, द्रक् aff.
21365: नाट्य n. (-ट्यं) The science or art of dancing or acting, or the union of song, dance, and instrumental musick. E. नट to dance, affix ण्यत् or ज्य.
21366: नाट्यधर्म्मिक m. (-कः) Rules of dramatic representation. E. नाट्य acting, धर्म्म rule, and ठक् aff.
21367: नाट्यप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of ŚIVA. E. नाट्य dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
21368: नाट्यशाला f. (-ला) A theatre, a building for dramatic exhibitions; according to some it should be built near the gate of a palace. E. नाट्य, and शाला a hall.
21369: नाट्योक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Dramatic phraseology. E. नाट्य, and उक्ति expression.
21370: नाडि f. (-डिः-डी) 1 The stalk or culm of any plant. 2 Any tubular organ of the body, as an artery, a vein, an intestine, &c. 3 The hollow stalk of a lotus, &c. 4 A fistulous sore, a fistula, a sinus. 5 A sort of bent grass. 6 A juggling trick. 7 Deception. 8 An hour of twenty-four minutes. 9 Any pipe or tube. 10 The pulse, either at the hand or feet, &c. E. नड to fall off or from, affix अच्, and इ or ङीष्, optionally added.
21371: नाडिका f. (-का) An Indian hour, or twenty-four minutes. E. नाडि the same, कन् pleonasm.
21372: नाडिकेल m. (-लः) The cocoanut: see नारिकेल.
21373: नाडिचीर n. (-रं) A small reed or tube round which the woof is wound; it is then used as a shuttle. E. नाडि a tube, and चीर old cloth.
21374: नाडिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Terrifying. 2 Moving the intestines. m. (-मः) A goldsmith. E. नाडि a tube, a hollow bambu, &c. and धम who blows, from ध्मा, with खश् aff.
21375: नाडिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what drinks or sucks through a tube. E. नाडि a pipe, धे to drink, affix खश्.
21376: नाडिपत्र m. (-त्रं) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) E. नाडि a tube, पत्र a leaf.
21377: नाडिमण्डल n. (-लं) The celestial equator. E. नाडि, and मण्डल a sphere.
21378: नाडीकेल m. (-लः) The cocoanut: see नाडिकेल.
21379: नाडीच n. (-त्रं) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) E. नाडी a tube, चर to go or grow, affix ड.
21380: नाडीचरण m. (-णः) A bird in general. E. नाडी a tube, चरण a foot.
21381: नाडीजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) 1 A crow. 2 The name of a holy teacher or saint. 3 The name of a fabulous crane. E. नाडी a stalk, and जङ्घा a leg or thigh.
21382: नाडीतरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A sort of poison: see काकोल. 2 An astrologer. 3 A ravisher, a debaucher. E. नाडी an Indian hour, and तरङ्ग a wave; also नाडीतरङ्गक.
21383: नाडीदेह m. (-हः) BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S followers. E. नाडी a tube, and देह the body; as thin.
21384: नाडीनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) The planet of a person's nativity. E. नाडी, and नक्षत्र an asterism.
21385: नाडीविग्रह m. (-हः) A name of BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S chief attendants. E. नाडी a pipe, and विग्रह the body; also नाडीदेह, &c.
21386: नाडीव्रण m. (-णः) An ulcer. E. नाडी a sinus, and व्रण a sore.
21387: नाडीस्नेह m. (-हः) A name of BHṚṄGI: see नाडीदेह.
21388: नाणक n. (-कं) A coin, or any thing struck or stamped with an impression.
21389: नाणकपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Assaying. E. नाणक, and परीक्षा trial.
21390: नाणकपरीक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) An assayer. E. नाणक, and परीक्षिन् who tries.
21391: नात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Praise, eulogium. 2 Surprise, wonder. m. (-त्रः) ŚIVA. 2 A sage. E. नम to bow, ष्ट्रण् affix, म is dropped, and the short radical vowel made long.
21392: नाथ (ऋ) नाथृ r. 1st cl. (नाथति-ते) 1 To ask or beg. 2 To bless. 3 To destroy. 4 To have wealth or power. 5 To be deceased.
21393: नाथ m. (-थः) 1 A master, a lord. 2 A name of ŚIVA, especially in the form of a Liṅga; it is usually compounded with some word relating to the legendary history of the Liṅga, as Somanātha, the Liṅga a set up by SOMA, &c. 3 A name adopted by a class of Yogis, as GORAKHNĀTH, &c. 4 A rope passed through the nose of a draft ox. E. नाथ to ask, (from whom,) and अच् aff.
21394: नाथवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Dependant, subservient, subject. E. नाथ master, and मतुप् poss. aff.
21395: नाथहरि m. (-रिः) An animal bridled by the nose. E. नाथ the string, हृ to take, इन् aff.
21396: नाथहार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Taking or carrying a master, &c. E. नाथ, हृ to take, अण् aff.
21397: नाद m. (-दः) 1 Sound in general. 2 A semicircle, used especially as an abbreviation or hieroglyphic in mystical works. E. नद to sound, affix घञ्.
21398: नादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what sounds. E. नद to sound, घिणुन् aff.
21399: नादेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Ocean or river-born, marine, aquatick. n. (-यं) 1 Sea salt. 2 Antimony. f. (-यी) 1 A sort of reed growing usually near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.) 2 A plant, (Premna herbacea, Rox.) 3 The orange. 4 A tree: see जयन्ती. 5 The China rose. E. नद a river or the sea, and ढक् affix, fem. affix ङीप्; also with कन् added, in the fem. form नादेयिका f. (-का)
21400: नाध (ऋ) नाधृ r. 1st cl. (नाधते) 1 To ask or beg. 2 To bless. 3 To destroy. 4 To have wealth or power. 5 To be deceased.
21401: नाना ind. 1 Without, except. 2 Many, various. 3 Double or twofold. E. नञ् negative, and नाञ् aff.
21402: नानाध्वनि m. (-निः) A musical instrument of more than one tone. E. नाना various, and ध्वनि sound.
21403: नानारस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Of different flavours. E. नाना, and रस flavour.
21404: नानाराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Variegated, of many colours. E. नाना, and राग colour.
21405: नानारूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Multiform, various. E. नाना various, and रूप form.
21406: नानावर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Variegated, many-coloured. E. नाना, and वर्ण colour.
21407: नानाविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 In various ways. 2 Of various sorts or kinds. E. नाना, and विध kind.
21408: नानुष्ठेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Improper, unusual, not right or customary. E. न not, अनु according to, ष्ठेय from स्था to be, to be fixed or determined.
21409: नान्दिकर m. (-रः) The speaker of the prologue to a drama: see नान्दीकर.
21410: नान्दी f. (-न्दी) 1 Eulogium of a king, or praise of a deity, recited in benedictory verses at the commencement of a religious ceremony, or the opening of a drama; it most usually signifies the kind of blessing pronounced as a prologue to a Nāṭaka or play. 2 Prosperity, thriving, increase. E. नदि to be happy, in the causal form, affix इन्, and ङीष्; delighting the gods, &c. or procuring happiness for mankind.
21411: नान्दीक m. (-कः) A post in a door-way, set up for good luck. E. नान्दी prosperity, कृ to make, affix ड.
21412: नान्दीकर m. (-रः) The speaker of the prologue or prelude of a drama. E. नान्दी as above, कर who makes; also with the vowel made short, नान्दिकर.
21413: नान्दीपट m. (-टः) The lid or cover of a well.
21414: नान्दीमुख m. (-खः) 1 The lid or cover of a well. 2 The class of male progenitors to whom the Nāndī-mukha Śrāddha is addressed. f. (-खी) A female ancestor sharing in the same. n. (-खं) 1 A species of the Śarkarī metre. 2 A Śrāddha or funeral obsequies performed on joyous occasions, as initiation, marriage, &c. in which nine balls of meat are offered to the deceased father, paternal grandfather, and great grandfather; to the maternal grandfather, great grandfather, and great great grandfather; and to the mother, paternal grandmother, and paternal great grandmother. E. नान्दी good fortune, मुख principal.
21415: नान्दीवादिन् m. (-दी) 1 The speaker of the prologue or introduction to a drama. 2 A drummer, one who beats a drum at festivals, &c. E. नान्दी as above, and वादिन् who speaks.
21416: नापि ind. Not even. E. न not, and अपि even.
21417: नापित m. (-तः) A barber. E. न negative, आप to obtain, (respect,) तन् Uṇādi affix, and इट् augment.
21418: नापितशाला f. (-ला) A barber's shop. E. नापित, and शाला house; also with कन added in the fem. form, नापितशालिका f. (-का).
21419: नापित्य m. (-त्यः) The business of a barber. E. नापित, and यत् aff.
21421: नाभि f. (-भिः-भी) 1 The nave of a wheel. 2 Musk. mf. (-भिः and भिः or भी) The navel. m. (-भिः) 1 An emperor, a sovereign, a lord paramount. 2 A king, a chief. 3 A Kṣatriya or Hindū of the regal and military tribe. 4 The son of PRIYAVRATA. 5 A race, a family. E. नह to bind, Uṇādi affix इञि, and भ substituted for ह.
21422: नाभिकण्टक m. (-कः) Ruptured or protruded navel. E. नाभि a navel, and कण्टक a thorn.
21423: नाभिगुडक m. (-कः) A prominent or ruptured navel. E. नाभि, and गुडक a ball or lump.
21424: नाभिगोलक m. (-कः) A prominent or ruptured navel. E. नाभि, and गोलक a lump or ball.
21425: नाभिछेदन n. (-नं) Division of the umbilical cord. E. नाभि, and छेदन cutting.
21426: नाभिज m. (-जः) BRAHMĀ. E. नाभि navel, and ज born; BRAHMĀ appearing from the lotus which sprung from the navel of VIṢṆU.
21427: नाभिजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) BRAHMĀ. E. नाभि the navel, and जन्मन birth: see the last.
21428: नाभिनाडी f. (-डी) The umbilical cord. E. नाभि, and नाडी a vessel.
21429: नाभिनाला f. (-ला) The umbilical cord. E. नाभि the navel, and नाला a string, a vessel.
21430: नाभिभू m. (-भूः) BRAHMĀ. E. नाभि, and भू born: see नाभिज.
21431: नाभिवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Division of the umbilical cord. 2 Umbilical hernia. 3 Corpulency. E. नाभि, and वर्द्धन increasing.
21432: नाभील n. (-लं) 1 The groin of a woman. 2 A prominent or ruptured navel. 3 Pain. 4 The hollow of the navel. E. नाभि the navel, लच् aff.
21433: नाभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Umbilical, of or relating to the navel. E. नाभि the navel, and यत aff.
21434: नाभ्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The hollow or pit of the navel. E. नाभि a navel, आवर्त्त a round.
21435: नाम ind.
