A particle implying. 1 Certainty. 2 Possibility. 3 Anger. 4 Reproach. 5 Consent, promise. 6 Recollection. 7 Surprise. 8 Pretence, &c. as हिमालयो नाम नगाधिपः Himālaya, evidently the king of mountains, इह नाम सीता भविष्यति SĪTĀ will perhaps be here, &c. E. णम to call or address, affix ड, deriv. irr.
21436: नामकरण n. (-णं) Naming a child first after birth. E. नाम, and करण making.
21437: नामग्रह n. (-हं) Addressing by name. E. नाम, and ग्रह taking; also नामग्रहण.
21438: नामद्वादशी f. (-शी) A religious ceremony, worshipping DURGĀ daily under one of twelve appellations. E. नाम, and द्वादशी twelfth.
21439: नामधेय n. (-यं) A name or appellation. E. नाम a name, and धेय aff.
21440: नामन् n. (-म) A name, an appellation. E. म्ना to be minded or remembered, मनिन् Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.
21441: नामशेष m. (-षः-षा-षं) Dead, deceased. m. (-षः) Dying, death. E. नाम a name, and शेष end.
21442: नामापराध m. (-धः) Abusing a respectable object, as a pious man, a deity by name. E. नाम, and अपराध offence.
21443: नामित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bent down, bowed. E. णम to bow, causal form, क्त aff.
21444: नाय m. (-यः) 1 Guiding, directing, (morally or physically.) 2 Policy. 3 Obtaining. 4 Means, expedient. E. णी to guide, &c. affix ण or घञ्; also with अच् affix नय.
21445: नायक m. (-कः) 1 A guide, a leader, a conductor. 2 A chief, a head, pre-eminent, principal. 3 A general, a commander. 4 The central gem of a necklace. 5 (In Erotick poetry,) The man, the husband or lover. f. (-यिका) 1 A mistress, a wife, the female in the amatory poetry of the Hindūs. 2 A sort of goddess, an inferior form of DURGĀ, and attendant upon her: there are eight Nāyikās. E. णी to guide, ण्वुल् aff.
21446: नायकाधिप m. (-पः) A king, a sovereign prince. E. नायक a chief, and अधिप lord.
21447: नार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Relating to men, human, mortal, &c. 2 Spiritual. nf. (-रं-रा) Water. m. (-रः) A calf. n. (-रं) A multitude of men. E. नर, and अण् affix or न negative, ऋ to go, अप् aff.
21448: नारक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Infernal, hellish. m. (-कः) Hell or the infernal regions. E. नरक hell, अण् aff.
21449: नारकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Infernal, being in hell, condemned to or deserving it. E. नारक, and इनि aff.
21450: नारकीट m. (-टः) 1 A sort of worm. 2 A deceiver, one who disappoints expectations excited by himself.
21451: नारङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The juice of the pepper plant. 2 An animal, one of twins. 3 A catamite. 4 The orange tree. E. नार many men, and ग who goes.
21452: नारद m. (-दः) A name of NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and one of the ten divine Munis or Ṛṣis; he is a friend of KṚṢṆA, a celebrated legislator, and inventor of the Vīṇā or lute. E. नार men, and दा to give, (instruction,) ड affix; or नार water, and द who gives; offering sacrifices to the manes.
21453: नाराच m. (-त्रः) 1 An iron arrow. (E. नार men, आङ् before चम to eat or consume, affix ड; destroying hosts of men.) 2 A bad or cloudy day. 3 A species of the Dhṛti metre. (E. नार water, आचम to spit, affix ड.) f. (-त्री) A goldsmith's scales, a fine or assay balance. E. नाराच an iron arrow, and ङीष् diminutive affix; also with कन् added in the fem. form, नाराचिका f. (-का)
21454: नारायण m. (-णः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU, but especially considered as the deity who was before all worlds. 2 A sage, the son of DHARMA, a manifestation of VIṢṆU. 3 A valiant combatant. f. (-णी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A name of LAKṢMĪ, the goddess of prosperity, and wife of VIṢṆU. 3 GAṄGĀ. 4 A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.) E. नारा the primeval waters, derived from नर the spirit of God, whence they originated, and अयन place of coming or moving; he who moved over the waters before creation: the word has several etymologies, as नर the spirit or soul of the universe, अण् affix, नार appertaining to it, the actions or emotions of the soul, and अयन pervading, influencing; again नार multitudes, mankind, and अयन place: present amongst all men, &c.
21455: नारायणक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) Four cubits on either side of the stream of the Ganges. E. नारायण, and क्षेत्र shrine.
21456: नारायणतैल n. (-लं) An oil of great reputed efficacy in many complaints, expressed from a variety of plants. E. नारायण, and तैल oil.
21457: नारायणप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Attached to KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. m. (-यः) ŚIVA. E. नारायण, and प्रिय fond of.
21458: नारायणास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A weapon of undefined form and mystical nature. E. नारायण, and अस्त्र weapon.
21459: नारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Watery, aqueous. 2 Spiritual. E. नर or नार, and ठक् aff.
21460: नारिकेर m. (-रः) The cocoanut: see the next.
21461: नारिकेल mf. (-लः-ली) The cocoanut. E. नारिक watery (place), ईर to go or grow, affix क, and र optionally changed to ल; also with इन, नारिकेलि, and ड being substituted for र, नाडिकेर, &c.
21462: नारी f. (-री) 1 A woman in general, a female. 2 A species of the Madhya metre. E. नर a man, अञ् and ङीप् aff.
21463: नारीकवच m. (-चः) A king of the solar line, the son of AŚMAKA.
21464: नारीकेल mf. (-लः-ली) The cocoanut. f. (-ली) Fermented liquor made from the water of the cocoanut: see नारिकेल, &c.
21465: नारीच n. (-चं) An esculent root, Arum colocasia: see नाडीच.
21466: नारीतरङ्गक m. (-कः) A catamite. E. नारी a woman, तरङ्ग capricious, and कन् affix of comparison.
21467: नारीदूषण n. (-णं) A vice or breach of duty in a woman, of which six cases are reckoned, drinking spirits, keeping bad company, quitting a husband, rambling abroad, and sleeping or dwelling in a strange house. E. नारी a woman, दूषण defect.
21468: नारीप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Libertinism, lechery. E. नारी, and प्रसङ्ग addiction.
21469: नारीयान n. (-नं) A litter or other conveyance for women. E. नारी, and यान a carriage.
21470: नार्य्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange tree; also नागरङ्ग.
21471: नाल mfn. (-लः-ला or ली-लं) 1 A hollow or tubular stalk, the stalk of the water lily, &c. 2 Any pipe or tube. n. (-लं) Yellow orpiment. f. (-ली) 1 A stalk or culm. 2 An instrument for perforating an elephant's ear. 3 A period of time, a Ghari, twentyfour minutes. 4 Any tubular vessel of the body. 5 The pulse. E. णल to bind, affix ण, fem. affix टाप्, and ङीष्, &c.
21472: नालि f. (-लिः) Any tubular vessel of the body. E. ल interchanged with डः see नाडि.
21473: नालिक m. (-कः) A buffalo. n. (-कं) A lotus. f. (-का) 1 A tubular stalk. 2 An instrument for piercing an elephant's ear. 3 A plant, commonly Carmaghās. 4 A sort of potherb, (Hibiscus cannabinus.) 5 Any plant growing on a hollow stem, as Śaṇa, safflower, a mushroom, &c. E. नाली as above, and कन् aff.
21474: नालिकेर m. (-रः) The cocoanut. E. नल to bind, affix इन, नालि a leaf, &c. क air, wind, and इर what goes; fluttering in the wind.
21475: नालिजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A raven or the carrion crow. E. नालि a tube, and जङ्घा the leg.
21476: नालिता f. (-ता) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
21477: नालीक m. (-कः) 1 An arrow. 2 A dart, a javelin, a pike. 3 A lotus. 4 The fibrous stalk of the lotus. n. (-कं) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. नाली a fibrous stalk, affix ठन्.
21478: नालीकिनी f. (-नी) A multitude of lotus flowers. E. नालीक, and इनि aff.
21479: नालीव्रण m. (-णः) A fistulous or sinous sore: see नाडीव्रण, ल and ड being interchanged.
21480: नावमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ninth. E. नवम and ठञ्.
21481: नाविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a vessel, a boat, &c. m. (-कः) 1 The helmsman of a vessel, the steersman, the pilot. 2 A sailor. E. नौ a boat, affix ठन्.
21482: नाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Navigable. 2 Belonging to a boat. n. (-व्यं) Newness, novelty. E. नौ a boat or vessel, and यक् affix; or नव new, ष्यञ् aff.
21483: नाश m. (-शः) 1 Annihilation, loss, destruction, disappearance. 2 Death. 3 Flight, retreat. 4 Abandonment, desertion. (In Arithmetic,) 5 Elimination. E. णश to cease to be, affix धञ्.
21484: नाशन n. (-नं) Destruction, perishing. E. णश to perish, affix ल्युट्.
21485: नाशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Destroying, annihilating. E. णश to perish, causal form, शतृ aff.
21486: नाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed. E. नश to perish, causal form, क्त aff.
21487: नाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 Destructive, destroying, a destroyer. 2 Perishing, being lost or destroyed. E. नश to cease to be, in the causal form, affix इनि; or नाश, and इनि aff.
21488: नाष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to any thing lost. m. (-कः) The owner of any thing lost. E. नष्ट, and ठक् aff.
21489: नासत्य m. du. (-त्यौ) The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga. f. (-त्या) The constellation AŚVINĪ. E. न not, असत्य impure.
21490: नासा f. (-सा) 1 The nose. 2 The upper timber of a door. E. णस to sound, to stand, अच् aff.
21491: नासाछिन्नी f. (-न्नी) A sort of bird; also पूर्णिका. E. नासा the nose, छिन्न cut, fem. affix ङीप्.
21492: नासादक्षिणावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the right nostril by women who have money and children. E. नासा the nose, दक्षिण the right, and आवर्त्त a turning.
21493: नासादारु m. (-रुः) The upper timber of a door: see नासा.
21494: नासानाह m. (-हः) Thickening of the membrane of the nose, stoppage of the nostrils. E. नासा, and नाह binding.
21495: नासापरिस्राव n. (-वः) Running at the nose. E. नासा, and परिस्राव flow.
21496: नासारन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) The nostril. E. नासा, and रन्ध्र a hole.
21497: नासालु m. (-लुः) A plant, commonly Kāyaphal: see कट्फल. E. नासा the nose, and लु to cut, affix डु.
21498: नासावंश m. (-शः) The bridge of the nose. E. नासा, and वंश bambu.
21499: नासावामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the left nostril, a mark of sorrow or distress. E. नासा the nose, वाम the left side, आवर्त्त a turning.
21500: नासाशोष m. (-षः) Dryness of the nostrils. E. नासा, and शोष drying.
21501: नासिकन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Blowing or breathing through the nose, snoring, &c. E. नासिका the nose, ध्मा to blow, &c. affix खश्.
21502: नासिकन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Drinking through the nose. E. नासिका, and धेट् to drink, affix खञ्.
21503: नासिका f. (-का) 1 The nose. 2 The upper timber, or nose as it were, of a door. 3 A name of the nymph Aśvinī. E. नासा as above, affix कन्, fem. form.
21504: नासिकाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The tip of the nose. E. नासिका, and अग्र end.
21505: नासिकामल n. (-लं) The mucus of the nose, snot. E. नासिका, and मल excrement; it may also be नासमल.
21506: नासिक्य m. du. (-क्यौ) The two sons of Aśvinī. n. (-क्यं) The nose. E. नासिका, and यत् affix of identity or descent.
21507: नासिक्यक n. (-कं) The nose. E. कन् added to the preceding.
21508: नासीर n. (-रं) Advancing or skirmishing in front of an army, leaving the line, and defying the enemy by shouts and gestures. m. (-रः) The van, or a champion who advances before the line. E. णास to sound, affix ईरन्.
21509: नास्ति ind. Nonexistence, not so, it is not. E. न negative, and अस्ति is, third person singular present tense of अस to be.
21510: नास्तिक m. (-कः) An atheist, but applied by the orthodox Hindūs, to any one who denies the divine authority of the Vedas, or doubts the legends of the Purāṇas. E. नास्ति there is not (a god, &c.) and ठक् aff.
21511: नास्तिकता f. (-ता) Atheism, denial of the deity, of a future state, of the divinity of the Vedas; Bauddhism, heresy, &c. E. तल् abstract affix added to the preceding; also with त्व, नास्तिकत्व, or with यत् affix नास्तिक्य.
21512: नास्तिक्य n. (-क्यं) Infidelity, atheism. E. नास्तिक, and यत् aff.
21514: नास्तित्व n. (-त्वं) Nonexistence. E. त्व added to नास्ति; also with तल् affix नास्तिता.
21515: नास्य n. (-स्यं) The rein of an ox passed through the septum of the nostrils. E. नासा the nose, यञ् aff.
21516: नाह m. (-हः) 1 Binding, confinement. 2 A trap, a snare for catching deer, &c. 3 Obstruction in any organ or secretion of the body, as costiveness, &c. E. णह to bind, affix घञ्.
21517: नाहल m. (-लः) A man of a barbarous or outcast tribe.
21518: नाहुषि m. (-षिः) The name of a king; also YAYĀTI. E. नहुष, and इञ् affix of descent.
21519: निःकारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causeless, unfounded. E. निर् neg. कारण cause.
21520: निःकासन n. (-नं) Expulsion, exile, turning out. E. निर्, and कस to go, causal form, ल्युट् affix; also निःकाशन.
21521: निःकासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned out or forth, expelled, removed. E. निर् out, कस to go, in the causal form, affix क्त; also निष्कासित and निःकाशित and निष्काशित.
21522: निःक्रामित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, turned out. E. निः for निर् out, क्रामित caused to go, also निष्क्रामित.
21523: निःक्षत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Having none of the military tribe, (a city &c.) E. निर् not, क्षत्र a Kṣatriya.
21524: निःक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Thrown or sent away. 2 Spent. 3 Passed. E. निर् before क्षिप्त to throw, &c. affix क्त.
21525: निःक्षिप्य ind. 1 Having thrown or sent away. 2 Having spent, (as time.) 3 Having wiped away, (as tears,) &c. E. निर् before क्षिप to throw, and ल्यप् aff.
21526: निःक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Throwing, sending, putting away. 2 Spending. 3 Passing, (as time.) 4 Wiping away, (as tears.) E. निर्, and क्षिप to throw, घञ् aff.
21527: निःप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gloomy, dark, obscured. E. निः for निर् privative, and प्रभा light; also निष्प्रभ.
21528: निःफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fruitless, barren. E. निर् neg. फल fruit, more commonly निष्फल.
21529: निःशंसय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undoubted. E. नि for निर, शंसय doubt.
21530: निःशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless. E. निर्, and शङ्का apprehension.
21531: निःशलाक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Solitary, private. E. निः for निर् privative, and शलाका the maina; not even frequented by birds; also निश्शलाक.
21532: निःशब्द mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दा-ब्दं) Silent, voiceless. E. निः for निर्, and शब्द sound.
21533: निःशूक m. (-कः) Rice without any awn or beard. E. नि for निर्, and शूक beard of corn.
21534: निःशेष mfn. (षः-षा-षं) Complete, entire. E. निः for निर् negative, and शेष remainder; also निश्शेष.
21535: निःशोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) Cleansed, cleared, purified. E. निः for निर् implying completion, and शोध्य pure; also निश्शोध्य.
21536: निःश्रयणी f. (-णी) Wooden steps, a ladder, a staircase. E. निः for निर् out, forth, श्रि to go, affix ल्युट्; also with अच् affix, and इनि added, निःश्रयिणी.
21537: निःश्रेणि f. (-णिः-णी) 1 A ladder or staircase, a flight of steps. 2 The wild date tree. E. निः for निर् implying certainty, and श्रणी a line; also निश्श्रेणी.
21538: निःश्रेयस् n. (-यः) 1 Final beatitude, the release of the soul from the body, and its reunion with the primary and universal spirit. 2 Happiness, welfare. 3 Knowledge, learning. 4 Belief, faith, devotedness. 5 Apprehension, conception. m. (-याः) A name of ŚIVA. E. निः for निर् implying eternity or certainty, श्रेयस् best, अच् added; also निश्श्रेयस्.
21539: निःश्वसन n. (-नं) 1 Sighing, &c. 2 Breathing out. E. निर्, and श्वसन breathing.
21540: निःश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sighed, sighing. 2 Breathing out. n. (-तं) 1 Expiration. 2 Sighing. E. निर्, and श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.
21541: निःश्वस्य ind. Having sighed. E. निर्, and श्वस to breathe, affix ल्यप्.
21542: निःश्वास m. (-सः) 1 Breathing out, expiration. 2 Sighing. E. निर्, and श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
21543: निःश्वासपरम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Sorrowful, sighing. E. निःश्वास, and परम best.
21544: निःषमम् ind. 1 A particle of reproof, (improperly, unseasonably.) 2 A term of regret, (alas!) E. निर् not, सम equal to, र is changed to Visarga, and स becomes ष.
21545: निःसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Separated, unconnected. 2 Regardless, indifferent, free from attachment or desire. E. निर् not, सङ्ग association.
21546: निःसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Senseless, insensible. E. निर not, संज्ञा sign of life.
21547: निःसत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) False, untrue. E. निर् not, सत्य true.
21548: निःसत्यता f. (-ता) Insincerity, falsehood. E. निर् neg. सत्यता truth.
21549: निःसत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) 1 Weak, impotent. 2 Insignificant, mean, low. 3 Nonexistent. 4 Insubstantial. n. (-त्वं) 1 Insignificance, absence of power or consideration. 2 Nonexistence. E. निर् neg. सत्व substance, &c.
21550: निःसन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Firm, well-knit, compact. E. निर् not, सन्धि junction; the joints of which are not perceivable.
21551: निःसम्पात m. (-तः) Midnight. E. निर् neg. सम्पात going, from पत to go, with सम् prefix, and घञ् aff.
21552: निःसरण n. (-णं) 1 Death, dying. 2 A means or expedient. 3 Exit, a going forth or out. 4 Final beatitude. 5 The entrance into a house or town, &c. the gate, the gate-way. E. निर् forth or out, सरण place, means or act of going.
21553: निःसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Intolerable, unbearable. 2 Irresistible. 3 Unable to support or bear. E. निर् neg. सह bearing.
21554: निःसहत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Inability to bear or support. 2 Impatience, unendurance. E. निःसह, and त्व affix; also with तल्, निःसहता.
21555: निःसाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Bold, fearless. E. निर्, and साध्वस fear.
21556: निःसार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Sapless, pithless. 2 Worthless, vain, insubstantial. m. (-रः) 1 A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 2 Going forth. f. (-रा) The plantain. E. निर् privative, सार essence, pith; or निर out, सृ to go, घञ् aff.
21557: निःसारण n. (-णं) 1 Going forth or out. 2 The entrance of a house or town, &c. the passage, the road of ingress and egress. E. निर् forth or out, and सारण place of going: see निःसरण.
21558: निःसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-त्तं) Turned forth or out, expelled, dismissed. E. निर् out, and सारित caused to go.
21559: निःसुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Disagreeable, distressing. 2 Unhappy. E. निर् neg. सुख pleasure.
21560: निःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone forth or out. E. निर्, and सृ to go, affix क्त.
21561: निःस्नेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Dry, not greasy or unctuous. 2 Cold, insensible, unfeeling. f. (-हा) Linseed, (Linum utilitissimum.) E. निर् forth, out, and स्नेह oil; whence oil is extracted or expressed, &c. or निर privative, स्नेह oil or affection.
21562: निःस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Free from desire. 2 Disregarding, indifferent to. E. निर् neg. स्पृहा wish.
21563: निःस्राव m. (-वः) The moisture or water of boiled rice. E. निर् forth, and स्राव what is oozing.
21564: निःस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Poor, indigent. E. निर् not, nothing, स्व own property.
21565: निःस्वादु mfn. (-दुः-दुः-दु) Insipid, tasteless. E. निर् neg. स्वादु sweet.
21566: नि ind. 1 In, within; on, upon: a particle and prefix. 2 A negative or prohibitive particle. 3 A particle implying certainty, affirmation, proximity, continuance, doubt, intensity, fulness, &c. see the following compounds.
21567: निकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Kinless, solitary. E. नि, and कटच् affix; or नि prefixed to कट to go to or towards, affix अच्.
21568: निकर m. (-रः) 1 A flock or multitude. 2 A heap, a bundle. 3 Pith, sap, essence. 4 Suitable or proper gift. 5 A treasure, especially belonging to KUVERA: see निधि. E. नि in or upon, कृ to throw, affix अप्.
21569: निकर्षण m. (-णः) 1 An open space or sort of play-ground in or near a town. 2 A court at the entrance to a house. 3 A neighbourhood. E. नि, with कर्षण ploughing; so prepared.
21570: निकष m. (-षः) The touch-stone. f. (-षा) The mother of the imps or goblins. E. नि prefixed to कष to injure, affix घ.
21571: निकषा ind. 1 Near, proximate. 2 In the middle, betwixt, between. E. नि prefixed to कष to hurt, Uṇādi affix आ.
21572: निकषात्मज m. (-जः) A Rākṣasa, a sort of goblin. E. निकषा the mother of the race, and आत्मज a son.
21573: निकस m. (-सः) A touch-stone: see निकष.
21574: निकाम n. adv. (-मं) Voluntarily, willingly, implying certainty. E. नि, काम will.
21575: निकाय m. (-यः) 1 An assemblage of persons performing like duties, a congregation, an audience. 2 A flock, a multitude. 3 A butt, a mark. 4 A house, a habitation. 5 The Supreme Being. E. नि in or within, चि to collect, affix घञ्, and क substituted for the radical initial.
21576: निकाय्य m. (-य्यः) A house. E. as above: see निकाय, deriv. irr.
21577: निकार m. (-रः) 1 Opposition, contradiction. 2 Injury, wrong, offence. 3 Wickedness; malice. 4 Abuse, reproach, disrespect. 5 Raising, tossing or lifting up. 6 Piling or winnowing corn. E. नि depreciative prefix, कृ to make, or कॄ to throw, affix घञ् or अप्.
21578: निकारण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि prefixed to कॄ to injure, affix ल्युट्.
21579: निकाष m. (-षः) Rubbing. E. नि before कष to hurt, घञ् aff.
21580: निकास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Like, (in composition:) see नीकास.
21581: निकुञ्चक m. (-कः) A measure of capacity equal to (1/4th) of a Kuḍava. E. नि before कुचि to be small, affix क्वुन्.
21582: निकुञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contracted. E. नि in, and कुञ्चित curved.
21583: निकुञ्ज mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं) An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creepers. E. नि expletive, and कुञ्ज an arbour.
21584: निकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 The son of KUMBHAKARṆA, the brother of RĀVAṆA. 2 A plant, (Croton polyandrum.) E. कु the earth भू to be, affix खच्, and नि prefixed.
21585: निकुम्भिला f. (-ला) A place where offerings with fire are made. E. नि before कुम्भ a jar, इलच् aff.
21586: निकुरुम्ब n. (-म्बं) A flock or multitude; also निकुरुम्बक. E. नि before कुर to divide or cut, affix अम्बच्, and उ substituted for the penultimate; also read निकुरुम्भ.
21587: निकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dishonest, wicked, perverse. 2 Removed, set aside, dismissed. 3 Tricked, cheated, deceived. 4 Injured, afflicted. 5 Low, base, vile. E. नि prefixed to कृत to cut, affix क.
21588: निकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Wickedness, dishonesty. 2 Abuse, reproach. 3 Rejection, removal. 4 Poverty, indigence. E. नि prefixed to कृत to cut, affix कि.
21589: निकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Outcast, despised, low, vile. E. नि prefixed to कृष to make furrows, to revile or despise, affix क्त.
21590: निकेचाय m. (-यः) Piling or collecting repeatedly. E. नि before चि to gather, reit. v., घञ् aff.
21591: निकेत m. (-तः) A house, a habitation. E. नि in, कित to dwell, affix घञ्; also with युच् affix निकेतन.
21592: निकेतक n. (-कं) A house, a dwelling. E. कन् added to निकेत.
21593: निकेतन n. (-नं) A house, a habitation. m. (-नः) An onion. E. see निकेत.
21594: निकोचक m. (-कः) A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) E. नि prefixed to कुच to be crooked, affix वुन्; also derived from कुठ to surround, निकोठक; also with अण् pleonasm added, निकौचक.
21595: निक्वण m. (-णः) 1 A musical tone or sound. 2 Any sound. E. नि prefixed to क्वण to sound, अप् affix; also with घञ् affix निक्वाण m. (-णः.)
21596: निक्ष r. 1st cl. (निक्षति) To kiss: see णिक्ष.
21597: निक्षण n. (-णं) Kissing. E. निक्ष to kiss, ल्युट् aff.
21598: निक्षा f. (-क्षा) A nit. E. णिश to meditate, Uṇādi affix स.
21599: निक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Rejected, abandoned, foregone, given or thrown away. 2 Deposited, pawned, pledged. 3 Thrust into, placed in. 4 Sent, sent off or away. E. नि implying absolutely or internally, and क्षिप्त thrown away, &c.
21600: निक्षिपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) Throwing or placing in or upon. E. नि before क्षिप to throw, affix शतृ.
21601: निक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 A pledge, a deposit in general, or one which is counted or particularised in presence of the receiver, and left without cover or seal. 2 Abandoning, parting with, throwing away. 3 Sending or putting away. 4 Wiping, drying. E. नि prefixed to क्षिप to throw or reject, affix घञ्.
21602: निक्षेप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ) Who or what places or deposites. m. (-प्ता) A depositor, a pawner or pledger. E. नि before क्षिष to throw, तृच् aff.
21603: निखर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्बं) Dwarfish, a dwarf. n. (-र्ब्बं) A billion. E. नि certainly, verily, खर्ब्ब short, &c.
21604: निखात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dug, dug up, excavated. 2 Fixed in the ground as a stake. E. नि before खन to dig, क्त aff.
21605: निखिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) All, entire, complete. E. नि negative, खिल defective.
21606: निगड mn. (-डः-डं) An iron chain for the feet, a fetter, but especially the heel chains of an elephant. E. नि not, गड to drop, (to drop off,) affix अच्.
21607: निगडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied, chained, &c. E. निगड a chain, इतच् aff.
21608: निगण m. (-णः) The smoke of a burnt offering or sacrificial fire. E. नि implying certainty, prefixed to गण to estimate, affix क; by which the presence of fire is indicated.
21609: निगद m. (-दः) 1 Speech, speaking, discourse. 2 Audible recitation of prayers or charms. E. नि affirmative prefix, गद speech.
21610: निगदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Speaking, saying, speaking to, addressing. E. निगद to speak, शतृ aff.
21611: निगदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, spoken. E. नि before गद to speak, क्त aff.
21612: निगदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-नती-वत्) Speaking, having spoken. E. नि before गद to speak, क्तवतु aff.
21613: निगम m. (-मः) 1 A town, a city. 2 A market, a fair. 3 Holy-writ, the Vedas collectively. 4 A road, a market road. 5 Trade, traffick. 6 A camp or caravan of itinerant dealers, as Banjaras, &c. 7 Certainty, assurance. E. नि affirmative prefix, गम to go, affix घ; by which people go, &c.
21614: निगमन n. (-नं) 1 Certain or logical conclusion, the winding up of a syllogism. 2 Going. E. नि, and गमन going.
21615: निगर m. (-रः) Eating, swallowing. E. नि in, गॄ to swallow, affix अप्.
21616: निगरण n. (-णं) Eating, swallowing. m. (-णः) 1 The throat, the gullet. 2 Smoke of a burnt offering. E. नि prefixed to गॄ to swallow, affix ल्युट्.
21617: निगाद m. (-दः) Speech, discourse. E. नि before गद to speak, affix घञ्; also निगद.
21618: निगार m. (-रः) Swallowing. E. नि prefixed to गॄ to swallow, affix घञ्; also निगर.
21619: निगाल m. (-लः) The throat or neck of a horse. E. नि before गल to eat, affix घञ्.
21620: निगालवत् m. (-वान्) A horse. E. निगाल as above, and मतुप् aff.
21621: निगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sung, said. E. नि, and गीत sung.
21622: निगु m. (-गुः) The mind, the faculty of feeling and reasoning. E. नि affirmation, गम to go, affix डु.
21623: निगूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Profound, obscure. 2 Hidden, concealed. m. (-ढः) A sort of wild bean: see मुद्ग. E. नि before गुह to hide or conceal, affix क्त.
21624: निगूढार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Having a hidden sense or purpose. E. निगूढ, and अर्थ meaning.
21625: निगूहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be hid or concealed. 2 To be protected or defended. E. नि before गुह to conceal, अनीयर् aff.
21626: निगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Assailed, attacked. 2 Harassed, spoiled. 3 Seized, arrested. 4 Restrained, subdued, checked. E. नि before ग्रह to take, क्त aff.
21627: निगृहीति f. (-तिः) Restraint, check, &c.: see निग्रह. E. नि before ग्रह to take, क्तिन् aff.
21628: निगृह्णत् mfn. (-ह्णन्-ह्णन्ती-ह्णत्) 1 Seizing, taking. 2 Suppressing, restraining. E. नि before ग्रह to take, शतृ aff.
21629: निगृह्य ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Having restrained or suppressed. 3 Having arrested or confined. E. नि before ग्रह to take, ल्यप् aff.
21630: निग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Aversion, disfavour, discouragement, dislike. 2 Abusing, blaming. 3 Binding, confinement, capture, arrest. 4 A binding, a tie. 5 Restraint, subjugation. 6 Suppression, putting down. 7 A boundary, a limit. 8 Administering medicine. 9 Killing. 10 A name of KṚṢṆA. E. नि before ग्रह to take or seize, affix अप्.
21631: निग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Subduing, suppression. 2 Defeat. 3 Capture. E. नि before ग्रह to take, ल्युट् aff.
21632: निग्रहस्थान n. (-नं) Failure in logical argument. E. निग्रह, and स्थान place.
21633: निग्राह m. (-हः) Aversion, &c. used as an imprecation, as निग्राहस्ते भूयात् confusion seize you, &c. E. नि before ग्रह to seize, affix घञ्.
21634: निघ m. (-घः) 1 A round or circle, a ball, any thing whose height and circumference are equal. 2 A tree. E. नि before हन to kill, affix क, deriv. irr.
21635: निघण्टु m. (-ण्ठुः) A vocabulary, a collection of words or names.
21636: निघस m. (-सः) Food, victuals. E. नि before अद to eat, अप् affix, and घस substituted for the root.
21637: निघाति f. (-तिः) An iron club or mace. E. नि before हन to kill, इञ् Uṇādi affix, घात substituted for the root.
21638: निघानिघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Of different forms or sizes.
21639: निघुष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Sound, noise. E. नि before घुष to sound, affix क्त.
21640: निघृष्व m. (-ष्वः) 1 A hoof. 2 A mule. 3 A boar. 4 A road. E. नि before घृष to pound, Uṇādi affix वन्.
21641: निघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) 1 Docile, subservient, domestic, dependant. 2 Completing a quotient, (in Arithmetic.) E. नि before हन to injure or do mischief, क aff.
21642: निघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नन्ती-घ्नत्) 1 Slaying. 2 Destroying, overcoming. E. नि before हन to kill, शतृ aff.
21643: निघ्नान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Slaying, killing. E. नि before हन to kill, शानच् aff.
21644: निचय m. (-यः) 1 Heap, assemblage, collection. 2 Certainty. E. नि before चिञ् to collect, affix अच्.
21645: निचयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Having or containing a quantity. full of, redolent with, abounding. E. निचय, and इनि aff.
21646: निचिकी f. (-की) A capital cow: see नैचिकी.
21647: निचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Full, filled. 2 Covered, overspread. E. नि before चि to collect, affix क्त.
21648: निचुल m. (-लः) 1 A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.) 2 An upper and outer garment. E. नि before चुल to lift up, affix क.
21649: निचुलक n. (-कं) A breast-plate, a cuirass. E. कन् added to the preceding; also निचोलक.
21650: निचोल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) A cover, a wrapper, a veil, a surtout. E. नि before चुल to lift up, affix घञ्.
21651: निचोलक m. (-कः) A sort of jacket, but especially a soldier's jacket or a body dress, serving as a cuirass or breast-plate. E. कन added to निचोल.
21652: निच्छवि f. (-विः) A district, the modern Tirhut. E. नि constantly, छवि light.
21653: निच्छिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Unimpeached. E. नि neg. च्छिद्र flaw.
21654: निच्छिवि m. (-विः) A man of one of the degraded classes, born from the outcast Kṣatriya; the occupation of this caste is apparently public exhibition of tricks, prize-fighting, &c. being classed with the Jhallas, Mallas, and others. E. नि privative, छवि light or credit, इ substituted for the penultimate.
21655: निच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 Cutting off. 2 (In Arithmetic,) Leaving no common measure. E. नि, and छेद cutting.
21656: निज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Own. 2 Perpetual, eternal. E. नि implying continuance, and ज what is produced.
21657: निजिघृक्षयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Desirous of making to excel. E. नि before ग्रह to take, desid. v., शतृ aff.
21658: निजुह्नूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to conceal. E. नि before ह्नु to hide, desid. v., उ aff.
21659: निटल n. (-लं) The forehead. E. नि before टल to be marked, (with frowns, &c.) affix अप् or घञ्, whence it is also निटाल.
21660: निटलाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A name of ŚIVA. E. निटल the forehead, and अक्ष an eye.
21661: निडीन n. (-नं) The flight of a bird, or a peculiar mode of flying. E. नि affirmative prefix, and डीन flight, flying.
21662: निण्डिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Teöri.
21663: नितम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A woman's buttocks. 2 The buttocks or posteriors in general, or as it is sometimes applied, the circumference of the hip and loins. 3 The shoulder. 4 The side of a mountain. 5 A bank or shore. E. नि prefixed to तम्ब to go, affix अच् or तम to go, with ब aff.
21664: नितम्बिनी f. (-नी) A woman with large and handsome posteriors. E. नितम्ब as above, इनि and ङीप् aff.
21665: नितराम् ind. 1 Always, continually, eternally. 2 Especially, particularly. E. नि always, डतरच् comparative affix, and आम् added.
21666: नितल m. (-लः) One of the seven divisions of Pātāla or hell. E. नि not, (known,) तल depth.
21667: नितान्त adj. mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Much, excessive. adv. n. (-न्तं) Much, excessively. E. नि prefixed to तम to desire, affix क्त, and the vowel made long.
21668: नित्य mfn. adj. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Eternal, everlasting, continual, perpetual; past, present, and future. 2 Regular, fixed, invariable. n. adv. (-त्यं) Always, eternally, continually. sub. Indispensable rite or act. m. (-त्यः) The ocean. f. (-त्या) 1 A name of PĀRVATĪ. 2 The goddess MANASĀ. 3 A Śakti, a form of DURGĀ, or personified energy of ŚIVA. E. नि particle implying perpetually, and त्यप् aff.
21669: नित्यकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Indispensable act or ceremony, as observance of the five great sacrifices, or any daily and necessary rite. E. नित्य, and कर्म्म act; also नित्यक्रिया, &c.
21670: नित्यकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Regular and necessary act or ceremony. E. नित्य, and कृत्य to be done.
21671: नित्यगति m. (-तिः) Air or wind. E. नित्य eternal, गति motion.
21672: नित्यता f. (-ता) Perpetuity, eternity. E. तल् added to नित्य; also with त्व, नित्यत्वं.
21673: नित्यदा ind. Always, constantly, and eternally. E. नित्य, and दाच् aff.
21674: नित्यदान n. (-नं) Daily alms. E. नित्य, and दान gift.
21675: नित्यनैमित्तिक n. (-कं) Any act or ceremony which though occasional is of regular recurrence, as Śrāddhas at fixed lunar periods. E. नित्य, and नैमित्तिक occasional; also नित्यनैमित्तिक कर्म्मन्.
21676: नित्यप्रलय m. (-यः) The constant loss of living beings. E. नित्य, and प्रलय destruction.
21677: नित्ययुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Always busy or engaged in. E. नित्य, and युक्त attached to.
21678: नित्ययौवन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ever or always young. m. (-ना) A name of DRAUPADĪ. E. नित्य always, and यौवन youth.
21679: नित्यशस् ind. Always, constantly, eternally. E. नित्य, and शसि aff.
21680: नित्यसम m. (-मः) An erroneous answer, one asserting perpetuity for perishable things. E. नित्य, and सम same.
21681: नित्यानध्याय m. (-यः) A period when the perusal of the Vedas is invariably prohibited, as the day of full moon, new moon, the eighth and fourteenth days of the half month. E. नित्य always, अन् negative prefix, अध्याय to be read.
21682: नित्यानित्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Eternal and perishable, permanent and temporary, &c. E. नित्य, and अनित्य transient.
21683: निद (इ) निदि r. 1st cl. (निन्दति) To reproach, to blame.
21684: निद m. (-दः) Poison, venom. E. नि affirmative prefix, दो to destroy, affix ड.
21685: निदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given, given absolutely. E. नि, and दत्त given.
21686: निदद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A man. E. निद poison, and द्रु tree, a living Upas.
21687: निदर्शन n. (-नं) 1 An example or illustration. 2 Injunction, precept. 3 Tenour, purport. 4 Authority, text. E. नि fully or certainly, दर्शन showing.
21688: निदाघ m. (-घः) 1 The hot season, (May and June.) 2 Heat, warmth. 3 Sweat, perspiration. E. नि always, दह to burn, घञ् affix, and घ substituted for ह.
21689: निदाघकर m. (-रः) The sun. E. निदाघ the hot season, and कर who makes.
21690: निदाघकाल m. (-लः) The hot season, two months previous to the rains, about May and June. E. निदाघ, and काल time or season.
21691: निदाघसिन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A river in the hot weather, one nearly dry. E. निदाघ, and सिन्धु a river.
21692: निदान n. (-नं) 1 A first cause, a primary or remote cause. 2 Disappearance, cessation or removal of a first cause. 3 Purification, purity, correctness. 4 Asking for the recompense or objects of austere devotion. 5 End, cessation. 6 A rope for tying a calf. 7 Ascertaining the causes of disease, study of symptoms with a view to trace the remote or proximate causes; hence this word is the name of a division of all works on medicine. E. नि always or certainly, दा to give, affix ल्युट्; by which all effects are produced.
21693: निदिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Smeared, anointed, plastered. f. (-ग्धा) Small cardamoms. E. नि prefixed to दिह to smear, affix क्त.
21694: निदिग्धिका f. (-का) A sort of prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
21695: निदिध्यासन n. (-नं) Deep and repeated consideration, thinking of or recalling repeatedly. E. नि before ध्यै in the reiterative form, affix ल्यु.
21696: निदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Ordered, directed. 2 Advised, enjoined. 3 Explained, pointed out. E. नि implying certainty, दिश to show, affix क्त.
21698: निदेश m. (-शः) 1 Order, command, direction, instruction. 2 Speech, speaking, saying, relating. 3 Vicinity, proximity. 4 The word of command. E. नि verily, दिश to show, affix घञ्.
21699: निदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Showing, directing, pointing out. f. (-नी) A quarter of space. E. नि before दिश to show, णिनि aff.
21700: निदेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what shows or points out, explaining, advising, commanding, &c. E. नि before दिश to show, तृच् aff.
21701: निद्रा f. (-द्रा) Sleep, sleepiness, sloth. E. णिद to condemn or censure, Uṇādi affix रक्; or द्रै to sleep, affix क्विप्, and नि prefixed.
21702: निद्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Asleep, sleepy, drowsy. 2 Shut up, closed. E. निद्रा as above, affix क्त.
21703: निद्रात् mfn. (-द्रान्-द्रान्ती-द्रात्) Sleeping. E. नि before द्रा to go, affix शतृ.
21704: निद्राभङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Awaked, aroused from sleep. E. निद्रा, भङ्ग breaking.
21705: निद्रायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sleeping, asleep. E. नि before द्रै to sleep, शानच् aff.
21706: निद्रालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Sleeping, sleepy, drowsy, slothful. f. (-लुः) A sort of perfume, commonly नीली. E. निद्रा, and आलुच् aff.
21707: निद्रावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Darkness. E. निद्रा sleep, and वृक्ष a tree, (whose fruit is sleep.)
21708: निद्रासंजनन n. (-नं) Phlegm, phlegmatic humour. E. निद्रा sleep, and संजनन producing, occasioning.
21709: निधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor. mn. (-नः-नं) 1 Race, family. 2 Loss, disappearance, annihilation. 3 Death, dying. 4 The seventh asterism of the lunar mansions, reckoning from that under  which a person is born. m. (-नः) The head of a family. E. नि before धन to perish, affix अच्, or नि neg. धन wealth.
21710: निधनकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Destroying, destructive. E. निधन, and कारिन् making.
21711: निधनता f. (-ता) Poverty. E. निधन, and तल् added; also with त्व, निधनत्वं.
21712: निधान n. (-नं) 1 A Nidhi or divine treasure, belonging especially to KUVERA, the god of wealth. 2 A receptacle, a place or vessel in or on which any thing is collected or deposited. 3 Place of cessation or rest. 4 Property, possessions, wealth. E. नि in or on, धा to possess, Uṇādi affix क्युप्: see निधि.
21713: निधापक m. (-कः) 1 A weapon. 2 Burnt timber, charcoal. 3 The castor oil plant.
21714: निधाय ind. Having fixed or placed in or on. E. नि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
21715: निधि m. (-धिः) 1 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or divine treasures, nine of which are enumerated: viz. The Padma, Mahāpadma, Śaṅkha, Makara, Kacchapa, Mukunda, Nanda, Nīla, and Kharba: their nature is not exactly defined, though some of them appear to be precious gems; according to the Tāntrika system, they are personified and worshipped as demigods, attendant either upon KUVERA or upon LAKṢMĪ, the goddess of prosperity. 2 A receptacle, a place of asylum or accumulation, as a treasury, a granary, a nest, &c.; also figuratively, as गुणनिधिः a man who contains or is endowed with all good qualities. 2 A treasure, any sum or quantity of wealth or valuables. 4 A medicinal plant and perfume, commonly Jivaka. 5 The ocean. E. नि in, धा to have, affix कि.
21716: निधिनाथ m. (-थः) A name of KUVERA. E. निधि a divine treasure, and नाथ lord; also similar compounds, as निधिप्रभु, निधीश्वर, &c.
21717: निधीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being in the course of placing, depositing, &c. E. नि before धा to have, causal form, शानच् aff.
21718: निधीश m. (-शः) KUVERA. E. निधि as above, and ईश lord.
21719: निधुवन n. (-नं) 1 Coition, copulation. 2 Trembling, agitation. 3 Pleasure, enjoyment. 4 Sport, play, pastime. E. नि before धू to shake or agitate, युच् aff.
21720: निधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be placed in or on, to be deposited, &c. E. नि before धा to have, ण्यत् aff.
21721: निध्यान n. (-नं) Sight, seeing. E. नि before ध्यै to think, affix ल्युट्.
21722: निध्वान m. (-नः) Sound. E. नि before ध्वन to sound, affix घञ्.
21723: निनीषा f. (-षा) Desire to take or lead. E. णी to lead, desid. form, affix अङ् and टाप्.
21724: निनीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to take or lead. E. णी to lead, desid. form, उ aff.
21725: निन्दक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Reproachful, abusive, scurrilous, censorious. E. निदि to abuse, ण्वुल् aff.
21726: निन्दत् mfn. (-न्दन्-न्दन्ती-न्दत्) Abusing, blaming. E. निन्द to blame, शतृ aff.
21727: निन्दतल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Having a maimed or defective hand: it is also sometimes read निम्नतल.
21728: निन्दन n. (-नं) Reproach, censure, blame. E. णिद to reprove, affix ल्यट्.
21729: निन्दा f. (-न्दा) 1 Censure, reproach, reproof, blame, abuse, reviling. 2 Injury, injuring. 3 Wickedness. E. णिद to abuse, &c. affixes अङ् and टाप्.
21730: निन्दास्तुति f. (-तिः) Irony, ironical praise. E. निन्दा censure, and स्तुति praise.
21731: निनङ्क्षु mfn. (-ङ्क्षुः-ङ्क्षुः-ङ्क्षु) Wishing to kill. E. नि before णश to destroy, desid. v., उ affix, form irr.
21732: निनद m. (-दः) Sound in general. E. नि before नद to sound, affix अप्; also निनाद.
21733: निनयन n. (-नं) Engaging in performance. नि before णी to lead, ल्युट् aff.
21734: निनाद m. (-दः) Sound in general. E. नि before नद to sound, affix घञ्; also निनद.
21735: निनादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded. E. नि before नद to sound, causal v., क्त aff.
21736: निन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abused, reviled, reproved. 2 Low, despicable, worthy of being reviled. 3 Prohibited, forbidden. E. णिद to abuse, affix क्त.
21737: निन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A woman bearing a dead child. E. णिदि to abuse, affix डु.
21738: निन्द्य mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्यं) Bad, vile, despicable, reprehensible. E. निन्दा, and यत् aff.
21739: निप mn. (-पः-पं) A water jar. m. (-पः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) E. नि continuative particle, पा to drink, affix क.
21740: निपठ m. (-ठः) Reading, studying or lecturing. E. नि before पठ to read, affix अप्; also with ल्युट्, निपठनं.
21741: निपठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Read, studied. E. नि, पठ to read, क्त aff.
21742: निपठिति f. (-तिः) Reading, study. E. नि, पठ to read, क्तिन् aff.
21743: निपतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) 1 Falling, falling down, prostrating, 2 Alighting. E. नि before पत to fall, affix शतृ.
21744: निपतन n. (-नं) 1 Falling. 2 Alighting, descending. E. नि in or on, पत to go, ल्युट् aff.
21745: निपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fallen, fallen down. 2 Alighted, descended. E. नि in or on, पत to go, क्त aff.
21746: निपत्य ind. 1 Having fallen down, prostrate. 2 Having alighted. E. नि before पत to fall, ल्यप् aff.
21747: निपत्या f. (-त्या) 1 A field of battle. 2 Any plashy or slippery ground. E. नि in, पत to fall, affix क्यप्.
21748: निपाक m. (-कः) Cooking, maturing, ripening. E. नि before पच to cook, affix घञ्.
21749: निपाठ m. (-ठः) Reading, study of the sacred books, or public perusal of popular poems. E. नि before पठ to read, affix घञ्.
21750: निपात m. (-तः) 1 Death, dying. 2 Falling, coming down, alighting. 3 Irregularity, (in Grammar,) 4 A particle, (in ditto.) E. नि before पत to go, affix घञ्.
21751: निपातन n. (-नं) 1 Causing to descend or fall, throwing down. 2 Beating, knocking down. 3 Killing. 4 (In Grammar,) Irregularity, exception. E. नि before पत to fall, in the causal form, ल्युट् aff.
21752: निपातित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Beaten down, made to fall or descend. 2 Killed. 3 Irregular, excepted. E. नि before पत to fall, causal form, affix क्त.
21753: निपान n. (-नं) 1 A through or ditch near a well for watering cattle. 2 A well. 3 Any reservoir of water. 4 A milk pail. 5 Drinking, imbibing. E. नि before पा to drink, ल्युट् affix; also with कन् added, निपानक n. (-कं)
21754: निपीडन n. (-नं) 1 Squeezing, pressing. 2 Embracing. 3 Hurting, giving pain. E. नि before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.
21755: निपीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Squeezed, pressed. 2 Embraced. 3 Pained, hurt. E. नि before पीड to give pain, affix क्त.
21756: निपीड्य ind. 1 Having pressed or squeezed, having pressed against or upon. 2 Having embraced. 3 Having hurt. E. नि before पीड to pain, and ल्यप् aff.
21757: निपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drank, drank up. 2 Absorbed, imbibed, dried up. E. नि before पा to drink, क्त aff.
21758: निपीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being drank. E. नि before पा to drink, pass. form, शानच् aff.
21759: निपुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Clever, skilful, conversant. E. नि before पुण to be pure, affix क.
21761: निबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Bound, confined. 2 Bound, costive. 3 Fixed upon, fastened to. 4 Checked, restrained. 5 Restricted to. E. नि before बध to bind, affix क्त.
21762: निबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Epistasis, suppression of urine or constipation. 2 Commentary, explanation of technical rules. 3 The Nimb tree: see निम्ब. 4 Binding, confinement. 5 Intentness on or attachment to. 6 A grant of property, an assignment of cattle or money for support, a corrody. 7 Fixed property, not moveable or fluctuating. n. (-न्धं) Song, singing. E. नि before बधि to bind, affix धञ्.
21763: निबन्धदान n. (-नं) Grant of an assignment, gift of a corrody. E. निबन्ध, and दान gift.
21764: निबन्धन n. (-नं) 1 Cause, motive, origin. 2 Binding, confining, 3 Checking, restraining. 4 Fastening. 5 A grant, an assignment. 6 A commentary. 7 The tie or peg of a lute. E. नि before बधि to bind, affix ल्युट्.
21765: निबन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, confined, tied. E. नि before बन्ध to bind, affix क्त.
21766: निबन्धृ mfn. (-न्धा-न्ध्री-न्धृ) Who or what ties or binds. m. (-न्धा) An author, a commentator. E. नि affirmative, बन्ध to bind, तृच् aff.
21767: निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like, resembling, similar. m. (-भः) 1 Fraud, trick, disguise. 2 Light, manifestation. E. नि before भा to shine, affix ड.
21768: निभालन n. (-नं) Sight, seeing. E. नि before भाल to see, affix ल्युट्.
21769: निभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Past, gone. E. नि affirmative, भूत been.
21770: निभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Modest, humble, unassuming. 2 Lonely, solitary. E. नि before भृ to cherish, affix क्त.
21771: निभृतम् ind. 1 Privately, apart. 2 Unobservedly in a corner. 3 Covertly, in disguise or out of sight. E. नि before भृ to cherish, affix क्त, and मुट् added.
21772: निम m. (-मः) A pin, a stake. E. नि in, माञ् to plunge or stick, affix ड; stuck in the ground.
21773: निमग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Plunged in, immersed. E. नि in, मस्ज to bathe, affix क्त.
21774: निमज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्) Bathing, plunging in. E. नि before मस्ज to bathe, शतृ aff.
21775: निमज्जथु m. (-थुः) Sleep, sleeping. E. नि in, मस्ज to bathe, अथु aff.
21776: निमज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Bathing. 2 Immersion. E. नि before मस्ज to bathe, ल्युट् aff.
21777: निमन्त्रण n. (-णं) 1 Summoning, calling. 2 Inviting, invitation. E. नि affirmative, मन्त्रण advising.
21778: निमन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Summoned, convoked. 2 Invited. E. नि before मन्त्र to advise, affix क्त.
21779: निमय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange. E. नि before मि to measure, to mete, affix अच्.
21780: निमातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be exchanged or bartered. E. नि before मा to measure, तव्य aff.
21781: निमि m. (-मिः) A son of IKṢVĀKU, condemned to reside in the twinkle of the eye.
21782: निमित्त n. (-त्तं) 1 Cause, motive, instrumental cause. 2 Mark, sign, spot, trace, token. 3 Omen. E. नि before मि to measure, क्त affix; also with कन् added निमित्तक.
21783: निमित्तक n. (-कं) 1 Kissing, a kiss. 2 Cause, &c. E. see the last.
21784: निमित्तकारण n. (-णं) The instrumental cause, the material or the agent, especially the deity considered as the agent in creation. E. निमित्त the instrumental cause, कारण cause.
21785: निमित्तकाल m. (-लः) Any given or specific time. E. निमित्त, and काल time.
21786: निमित्तत्व n. (-त्वं) Causality, instrumentality. E. निमित्त, and त्व affix; also with तल्, निमित्तता.
21787: निमित्तधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Expiation. 2 Any occasional or special penance, rite, or obligation. E. निमित्त, and धर्म्म piety.
21788: निमित्तमात्र n. (-त्रं) The mere agent or instrument. E. निमित्त, and मात्र alone.
21789: निमित्तविद् m. (-विद्) An astrologer. E. निमित्त a mark, (lucky or unlucky,) and विद् who knows.
21790: निमित्तावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Dependance upon a special cause or occasion. E. निमित्त, and आवृत्ति revolving.
21791: निमिष m. (-षः) 1 Twinkling of the eye. 2 The twinkling of an eye, considered as a measure of time. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. E. नि before मिष to twinkle, affix क; also with घञ् affix निमेष, or निमि a proper name, षद to go, ड aff.
21792: निमिषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Blinking, closing the eyelids. E. निमिष to twinkle, शतृ aff.
21793: निमीलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Twinkling, closing, (as the eye.) E. नि before मील to disappear, शतृ aff.
21794: निमीलन n. (-नं) Death, dying. 2 Twinkling of the eye, shutting of the eyelids, winking. E. नि before मील to disappear, &c. affix ल्युट्.
21795: निमीलिका f. (-का) 1 Fraud, trick, disguise. 2 Twinkling of the eye, winking, blinking. E. नि before मील to twinkle, affix वुन् and टाप्.
21796: निमीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Closed, (as the eyelid,) twinkled, blinked. E. नि before मील to disappear, क्त aff.
21797: निमेय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange. E. नि before मि to measure affix यत्.
21798: निमेष m. (-षः) 1 Twinkling of the eye. 2 A momentary space of time, a twinkling of the eye considered as a measure of time: see निमिष.
21799: निमेषक m. (-कः) 1 Twinkling of the eye. 2 A firefly. E. कन् added to the last.
21800: निमेषकृत् f. (कृत्) Lightning. E. निमेष twinkling, and कृत् what makes.
21801: निमेषरुच् m. (-रुक्) A firefly. E. निमेष a twinkling, रुच् who shines.
21802: निम्न mfn. (-म्नः-म्ना-म्नं) Deep, profound, (literally or figuratively.) E. नि before म्ना to mind, affix क.
21803: निम्नग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Deep, going deep. f. (-गा) A river. E. निम्न deep, and ग what goes.
21804: निम्नता f. (-ता) Depth, profundity. E. निम्न with तल् affix; also with त्व, निम्नत्वं.
21805: निम्नोन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) High and low, up and down. E. निम्न, and उन्नत high.
21806: निम्ब m. (-म्बः) The Nimb or Neemb tree, (Melia azadiracta.) E. निबि to sprinkle, affix अच्; also with कन् added, निम्बकः these words are written with either ब or व, as निम्ब or निम्व.
21807: निम्बतरु m. (-रुः) The Coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens;) it is considered as one of the trees of paradise. E. निम्ब as above, and तरु a tree.
21808: निम्बूक m. (-कः) The common lime, (Citrus acida.)
21809: नियत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Self-governed, subdued, restrained. 2 Attentive, fixed or intent upon. 3 Constant, permanent. 4 Ascertained, certain, fixed. 5 Inevitable. 6 Positive, definite. 7 Permeable, what may be spread through or over. n. adv. (-तं) Always, constantly. subst. Elementary or crude matter, the recipient of attributes or properties. E. नि before यम to restrain, affix क्त.
21810: नियतमानस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Of subdued mind or spirit. E. नियत, and मानस the mind.
21811: नियतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-regulated, self-controlled or restrained. E. नियत, and आत्मन् self.
21812: नियताहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Abstemious, moderate. E. नियत, and आहार food.
21813: नियति f. (-तिः) 1 Destiny, luck, good or bad fortune. 2 A religious duty or obligation. 3 Self-command, self-restraint. (-ती) A name of DURGĀ. E. नि before यम to refrain, affix क्तिन् or क्तिच्.
21814: नियतेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of restrained or subdued passions. E. नियत controlled, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
21815: नियन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be restrained, checked, controlled, &c. E. नि before यम to restrain, तव्य aff.
21816: नियन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Who or what restrains, governs, or guides. m. (-न्ता) 1 A charioteer, a coachman. 2 A ruler, a governor, a master. 3 A punisher. E. नि before यम to restrain, affix तृच्.
21817: नियन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Checked, restrained, governed, guided. E. नि affirmative particle, यम to restrain or check, affix क्त.
21818: नियम m. (-मः) 1 Agreement, contract, engagement, assent, promise. 2 Any religious observance voluntarily practised, as fasting, watching, pilgrimage, praying, &c.; voluntary penance, meritorious or supererogatory piety. 3 A religious observance or obligation in general. 4 Certainty, ascertainment. 5 Rule, precept. 6 Usage, practice. 7 Common places in poetry, conventional expression, as notice of the Birch in describing the Himālaya, of the Sandal tree in describing the Malaya mountain, the whiteness of vesture, blackness of hair, the cry of the peacock in the rains, of the Koïl in spring, &c. E. नि before यम to refrain, affix अच्.
21819: नियमन n. (-नं) 1 Precept, fixed practice or rule. 2 Binding. 3 Restraining, checking. E. नि before यम to restrain, affix ल्युट्.
21820: नियमपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Observing fixed rules. 2 Relating to or corroborative of a rule. E. नियम, and पर attached to.
21821: नियमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Regulated, prescribed. 2 Governed, guided. 3 Checked, restrained. 4 Bound, confined. E. नि before यम to check, affix क्त.
21822: नियम्य ind. Having restrained. mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) To be checked or restrained. E. नि before यम to govern, ल्यप् or यत् aff.
21823: नियातन n. (-नं) Causing to fall or descend: see निपातन.
21824: नियाम m. (-मः) 1 Religious act, penance, fasting, &c. especially if an act of supererogation. 2 Restraint. E. नि before यम to restrain, affix घञ्: see नियम.
21825: नियामक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Guiding, governing, what regulates or restrains. m. (-कः) 1 A boatman, a sailor; but variously applied to one who rows, who steers, or who keeps a look-out from the mast head. 2 A pilot, a helmsman. 3 A charioteer. E. नि before यम to go or stop, affix ण्वुल्.
21826: नियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Engaged in, applying or attached to. 2 Authorized, called, appointed. 3 Directed, enjoined, commanded. 4 Ascertained. 5 Fastened or attached to. E. नि before युज to join, affix क्त.
21827: नियुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Authorizing, appointing. E. नि before युज to join, शानच् aff.
21828: नियुज्य ind. 1 Having joined or attached to. 2 Having put to or harnessed. E. नि, युज to join, ल्यप् aff.
21829: नियुत mn. (-तः-तं) 1 A million. 2 A hundred thousand. E. नि before यु to join, affix क्त.
21830: नियुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Close fight, personal struggle. E. नि before युद्ध fight, contest.
21831: नियोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be appointed or authorized. E. नि, युज to join, affix तव्य.
21832: नियोग m. (-गः) 1 An order or command. 2 Authority, appointment. 3 Occupation, appointed duty. 4 Effort, exertion. 5 Ascertainment, certainty. 6 Incidence, occurrence. E. नि before युज to join, affix घञ्.
21833: नियोगप्रयोजन n. (-नं) The object of any appointment, authorized act or duty. E. नियोग, and प्रयोजन cause.
21834: नियोगविधि m. (-धिः) The form of appointing to any act or duty. E. नियोग, and विधि rule.
21835: नियोगार्थ m. (-र्थः) The object of an authorized act or appointment. E. नियोग, and अर्थ object.
21836: नियोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Engaged in any pursuit, closely attached to it or engrossed by it. 2 Appointed, authorized, entrusted with authority, &c. m. (गी) A minister, a deputy, an agent, &c. E. नियोग, and इनि aff.
21837: नियोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Fit to be appointed or authorized, able or fit for a duty. m. (-ग्यः) A master. E. नि before युज to join, यत् aff.
21838: नियोजन n. (-नं) 1 Ordering, commanding, directing. 2 Uniting, attaching to. 3 Urging, impelling. E. नि before युज to join, affix ल्युट्.
21839: नियोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Entrusted with, appointed to. 2 Directed, ordered. 3 Impelled, urged to, instigated. 4 Joined or attached to. 5 Suited or adapted to, connected with, &c. E. नि before युज to join, क्त affix, with इट् augment.
21840: नियोजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be attached or joined to. E. नि, युज to join, अनीयर् aff.
21841: नियोज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 1 To be attached to. 2 To be appointed to or employed in. 3 To be commanded, instigated, &c. m. (-ज्यः) A servant. E. नि before युज to join, ण्यत् aff.
21842: नियोद्धृ m. (-द्धा) 1 A cock. 2 A combatant, a wrestler, a boxer. E. नि near, युद्ध to fight, तृन् aff.
21843: निर् ind. 1 A particle and prefix implying certainty, assurance. 2 Negation, privation. 3 Outside, out, without, forth. E. नृ to guide, affix क्विप्.
21844: निरक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Having no dice, &c. 2 Having no latitude. m. (-क्षः) (In Astronomy,) The terrestrial equator. E. निर्, and अक्ष a die, &c.
21845: निरक्षदेश m. (-शः) 1 A first meridian, as Laṅkā, a place where the sun is always vertical, and the days and nights are equal. 2 The equatorial region. E. निर्, अक्ष latitude, देश a country.
21846: निरङ्कुश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Unchecked, uncontrolled, self-willed. E. निर् privative, अङ्कुश a hook for guiding an elephant.
21847: निरङ्कुशत्व n. (-त्वं) Self-will, wilfulness. E. त्व added to the foregoing; also with तल्, निरङ्कशता.
21848: निरग्नि mfn. (-ग्निः-ग्निः-ग्नि) Having lost or neglected the consecrated fire. E. निर्, अग्नि fire.
21849: निरञ्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Void of passion or emotion. 2 Unstained, unblackened. n. (-नं) The Supreme Being. f. (-ना) The day of fullmoon. E. नि neg. रञ्जन affection; or निर् not, अञ्जन collyrium; figuratively, darkness.
21850: निरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Engaged or interested in. 2 Attached or devoted to. E. नि, and रत occupied.
21851: निरत्यय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Faultless, unblamable. E. निर् neg. अत्यय fault.
21852: निरनुक्रोश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Hard-hearted, destitute of compassion. E. निर्, and अनुक्रोश pity.
21853: निरनुक्रोशता f. (-ता) Cruelty, hard-heartedness. E. तल् added to the last.
21854: निरनुरोध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Unkind, unfavourable. E. निर् neg. अनुरोध favour.
21855: निरन्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Coarse, gross, without interstices. 2 Continuous. 3 Uninterrupted, continual. 4 Unbounded. 5 Identical, not different. 6 Unconcealed, not hidden or vanished. 9 Not external, &c. E. निर् not, अन्तर interval, difference, &c.
21856: निरन्तराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Narrow, contracted. E. निर् neg. अन्तराल intermediate space.
21857: निरन्तराभ्यास m. (-सः) 1 Private study, reading to one's self the sacred works. 2 Diligent and uninterrupted pursuit, exercise, practice. E. निर् not, अन्तर between, अभ्यास practice.
21858: निरन्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Childless, having no family. 2 Unconnected with, not belonging or related to. 3 Done in one's absence, not done openly or visibly. 4 Unmethodical, ill arranged. E. निर् neg. अन्वय descent, connexion.
21859: निरप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Destitute of water. E. निर्, and अप water.
21860: निरपत्रप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Shameless, impudent. 2 Bold, confident. E. निर् not, अपत्रप shame.
21861: निरपराध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Faultless, blameless. E. निर् neg. अपराध fault.
21862: निरपवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Non-returning or turning back. 2 (In Arithmetic,) Leaving no common measure. E. निर्, and अपवर्त्त returning.
21863: निरपाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Free from destruction or decay, eternal. E. निर् neg. अपाय loss.
21864: निरपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Independant of, unconnected or unconcerned with. 2 Careless, indifferent, negligent. 3 Without purpose or hope. E. निर्, and अपेक्षा regard to.
21865: निरब्भ्र mfn. (-ब्भ्रः-ब्भ्रा-ब्भ्रं) Cloudless. E. निर्, and अब्भ्र a cloud.
21866: निरय m. (-यः) Hell. E. निर् out, beyond, अय good fortune.
21867: निरर्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unobstructed, unrestrained, unimpeded. E. निर् not, अर्गल a bolt or bar.
21868: निरर्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Vain, fruitless, unprofitable. 2 Unmeaning. E. निर् not, अर्थं object, end, कन् added.
21869: निरव m. (-वः) Loss of voice. E. नि neg. and रव sound.
21870: निरवग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Self-willed, headstrong, independant, uncontrolled. E. निर् neg. अवग्रह control.
21871: निरवद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Unobjectionable, unexceptionable. E. निर् neg. अवद्य not to be said.
21872: निरवशेषतस् ind. Fully, particularly, circumstantially. E. निर् neg. अवशेषतस् a remainder.
21873: निरवसाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Animated, anxious, eager. E. निर् neg. अवसाद languor.
21874: निरवहालिका f. (-का) A fence, a hedge, an outer wall. E. निर् out, without, and अवहालिका a fence.
21875: निरव्यय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Undecaying, eternal. E. निर् neg. अव्यय.
21876: निरशन n. (-नं) Fasting, going without food. E. निर्, and अशन eating.
21877: निरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Dry. 2 Insipid, tasteless. m. (-सः) 1 Insipidity, want of flavour or passion. 2 Dryness, want of juice. E. नि neg. रस juice, &c. also निरस.
21878: निरसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) What removes, expels, subdues, checks, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Rejection, denial, contradiction, disallowance. 2 Suppressing, checking. 3 Appeasing. 4 Expelling, ejecting. 5 Spitting, spitting out any thing with sickness or disgust. 6 Killing, destroying. E. निर् out or forth, अस to throw, affix ल्युट् or युच्.
21879: निरस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Expelled, sent forth or out. 2 Sent, thrown, cast, directed. 3 Thrown off, (as from a horse.) 4 Abandoned, deserted, left. 5 Rejected, disallowed. 6 Shot, (as an arrow.) 7 Uttered rapidly, hurried. 8 Destroyed. 9 Gone, absent, what is not. 10 Suppressed, checked. 11 Torn or taken. 12 Broken, (as an agreement.) E. निर् out or forth, अस to throw or send, affix क्त.
21880: निरस्य ind. 1 Having ejected or thrown out. 2 Having expelled, &c. E. निर्, and अस to throw, ल्यप् aff.
21881: निरस्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) 1 Ejecting, thrown out. 2 Abandoning, neglecting. 3 Expelling. 4 Scattering. 5 Destroying, &c. E. निर् out, अस to throw, शतृ aff.
21882: निरस्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being suppressed or checked. 2 Being abandoned. 3 Suppressing. 4 Expelling. 5 Scattering, &c. E. निर् before अस to throw, either a. or p. voice, शानच् aff.
21883: निरहङ्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Humble, free from pride. E. निर् neg. अहङ्कार pride.
21884: निराकरण m. (-णं) 1 Obstruction, opposition, contradiction, rejection. 2 Refutation, reply. 3 Holding in no consideration, making light of, contempt, disesteem. 4 Expelling, turning out or away. 5 Throwing out or off. 6 Neglecting the chief sacrificial or religious duties. E. निर् privative particle, and आङ् before कृ to do or make, affix ल्युट्.
21885: निराकरिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Obstructive, obstructing. 2 Disdaining, despising. E. निर्, and आङ् before कृ, affix इष्णुच्.
21886: निराकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Devoid of form or figure. m. (-रः) 1 Heaven. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 ŚIVA. 4 The divine spirit, God. 5 Reproach, censure. E. निर् implying negative or depreciation, and आकार shape, &c.
21887: निराकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Calm, steady, unperplexed, unconfused. E. निर् neg. आकुल agitated.
21888: निराकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Removed, rejected, set aside. 2 Refuted, replied to. 3 Made light of, contemned, despised. 4 Expelled, turned out. 5 Thrown from or off. 2 Divorced. E. निरा, and कृत done, with आङ् prefixed.
21889: निराकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 A person who has not duly gone through a course of study, especially applied however to the religious student, who has not duly read the Vedas. 2 One who neglects the five great religious obligations. 3 Shapeless, formless, viewless. m. (-तिः) 1 Rejection, contradiction, opposition, disallowance. 2 Obstacle, impediment. E. निरा implying privation or obstruction, कृति making, causing; or निर् privative, and आकृति form.
21890: निराक्रोश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Unaccused, unreviled. E. निर्, and आक्रोश exclaiming.
21891: निरागस् mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः) Sinless, faultless. E. निर् neg. आगस् sin.
21892: निराचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Lawless, corrupt, barbarian, depraved. E. निर् not, आचार moral ordinance: it is especially applied to those people who have not the ordinances of the Vedas or distinction of Castes, &c. and comprises all, therefore, except Hindūs.
21893: निरातपा f. (-पा) Night. E. निर् not, none, and आतप sunshine.
21894: निरादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Given, paid, delivered. E. निर्, and अदिष्ट shown.
21895: निरादेश m. (-शः) Payment, discharge, delivery. E. निर्, and आङ्दिश to show, affix घञ्.
21896: निरानन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Causing no pleasure, undelighting. E. निर् neg. आनन्द happiness.
21897: निरापद् mfn. (-द् or -त्) Prosperous, fortunate. E. निर् neg. आपद misfortune.
21898: निराबाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Frivolously or unreally vexatious, (as a cause of complaint.) E. निर् privative, आङ् before बाधा pain, annoyance.
21899: निरामय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Well, hale, recovered from sickness. m. (-यः) 1 A wild goat. 2 A hog, a boar. E. निर् not, आमय sickness.
21900: निरामालु m. (-लुः) The wood apple: see कपित्थ.
21901: निरामिषाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 Living without meat. 2 Free from sensual desires. E. निर्, आमिष flesh, अशिन् who eats.
21902: निराय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having no income or profit, yielding none, &c. E. निर् neg. आय receipt.
21903: निरायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contracted, compact. E. निर् neg. आयत spread.
21904: निरायव्ययवत् m. (-वान्) An idler who lives by clandestine means, has neither income nor expenditure. E. निर्, आय income, व्यय expense, मतुप् aff.
21905: निरायास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Not giving trouble, ready, easily attainable. E. निर् neg. आयास exertion.
21906: निरायुध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Unarmed, defenceless. E. निर् neg. आयुध a weapon.
21907: निरालम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Self-supported, not relying on another. E. निर्, आलम्ब stay.
21908: निराश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Hopeless, despairing. 2 Disappointed. E. निर्, and आश hope.
21909: निराशिस् mfn. (-शिः-शिः-शिः) Without a blessing. E. निर्, and आशिम् blessing.
21910: निराश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Without refuge, destitude. E. निर्, and आश्रय asylum.
21911: निरास m. (-सः) 1 Opposing, rejecting. 2 Dispension. 3 Ejecting, expelling. 4 Removal. 5 Abandonment. E. निर् out, and आस throwing.
21912: निरासन n. (-नं) 1 Rejection, contradiction. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 Spitting out. E. निर् before अस् to be, &c. with आङ् prefixed, and ल्युट् affix; also निरासन.
21913: निराहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Fasting through necessity or choice. E. निर् privative, आहार food.
21914: निरास्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Restless, anxious, unappeasable. 2 Homeless, portionless. E. निर् neg. आस्पद station.
21915: निरिङ्गिनी f. (-नी) A veil. E. निर् negative, अङ्ग a hint, इनि and ङीप् affs.
21916: निरिन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Imperfect, mutilated, maimed. E. निर् privative, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
21917: निरीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Looking at, regarding, seeing. 2 Expecting, E. निर्, and ईक्षण seeing.
21918: निरीक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्) 1 Looking at, regarding. 2 Expecting, hoping. E. निर्, and ईक्षत् seeing.
21919: निरीक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Looking at, regarding. 2 Hoping, expecting. E. निर् before ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.
21920: निरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Looking at, regarding. 2 Hope, expectation. E. निर् before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.
21921: निरीक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being regarded or looked at. E. निर्, and ईक्ष to see, pass, शानच् aff.
21922: निरीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, beheld, looked at. 2 Hoped, expected. E. निर्, and ईक्षित seen.
21923: निरीश n. (-शं) The body of a plough. E. ईश or ईष the shaft of the plough, and निर् forth or from, prefixed; hence also निरीष n. (-षं)
21924: निरीह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Indifferent, unanxious. E. निर् neg. ईह who seeks.
21925: निरीहता f. (-ता) Indifference, absence of effort or wish to get any thing. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, निरीहत्वं.
21926: निरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Said, described. 2 Obscure, obsolete. n. (-क्तं) 1 One of the Vedāṅgas or works considered as supplementary to and connected with the Vedas, forming part of scriptural or sacred science: glossarial explanation of obscure terms, especially those occurring in the Vedas. 2 Explanation of the concord or disagreement of letters, &c. 3 Separation or analysis of a derivative or compound word. E. निर् negative or affirmative prefix, उक्त spoken, said.
21927: निरुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 The Vedāṅga or portion of scriptural science, which explains obscure and obsolete terms. 2 Explanation of words: see the last. E. निर्, and उक्ति saying.
21928: निरुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being uttered or said. E. निर्, and उच्यमान being spoken.
21929: निरुच्छास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Breathless. 2 Narrow, contracted, crowded. E. निर्, and उच्छास breathing.
21930: निरुत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Non-plussed, without an answer. E. निर्, and उत्तर an answer.
21931: निरुत्साह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Indolent, indifferent. E. निर् neg. उत्साह effort.
21932: निरुत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unanxious, unregretting. E. निर् neg. उत्सुक sorrowing for.
21933: निरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Stopped, checked, restrained, hindered. 2 Confined, imprisoned. E. नि, and रुद्ध hindered.
21934: निरुद्धप्रकश m. (-शः) Stricture of the urethra. E. निरुद्ध, and प्रकश what pains.
21935: निरुद्धशमवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Wearied, tired. E. निरुद्ध, and शमवृत्ति repose.
21936: निरुद्द्राव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Immoveable, undecaying. E. निर्, and उद्द्राव going away.
21937: निरुद्विग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Sedate, free from perturbation. E. निर्, and उद्विग्न perturbed.
21938: निरुद्योग mfn. (-गः-गी-गं) Causeless, groundless. E. निर् negative, उद्योग cause.
21939: निरुन्धत् mfn. (-न्धन्-न्धती-न्धत्) Hindering, checking, suppressing. E. नि before रुध to hinder, शतृ aff.
21940: निरुन्धान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Hindering, opposing. 2 Preventing, depriving of. E. नि before रुध to hinder, शानच् aff.
21941: निरुपद्रव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Free from any national distress or affliction, free from tyranny. E. निर्, and उपद्रव violence.
21942: निरुपप्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Free from trouble or alarm. E. निर्, and उपप्लव calamity.
21943: निरुपम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Unequalled, having no resemblance or likeness. E. निर्, and उपमा similitude.
21944: निरुपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Honest, free from trick or fraud. E. निर्, and उपेक्षा trick.
21945: निरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Conventional, accepted, (as the meaning of technical words or names in opposition to their etymological sense alone.) 2 Unmarried. 3 Inherent. m. (-ढः) 1 The force or application of words, according to their natural or received meanings, (in Rhetoric.) 2 (In Logic,) The implied description of any property in the term designing it, (as of redness in the word red, &c.) E. नि affix, and रूढ ascended; or निर् neg. ऊढ married.
21946: निरूपण n. (-णं) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 Doubt, discussion, investigation. 3 Ascertaining, determining. 4 Searching, looking for. E. नि implying certainty, रूप to have form, affix ल्युट्.
21947: निरूपणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be discussed, to be investigated. 2 To be sought or looked for. E. नि before रूप to have form, अनीयर् aff.
21948: निरूपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यन्) 1 Searching, looking for. 2 Investigating, considering. E. नि, रूप to have form, शतृ aff.
21949: निरूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, beheld. 2 Ascertained. 3 Discovered, found. 4 Appointed, deputed, directed to do any thing. 5 Considered, weighed. E. नि before रूप to have form, affix क्त.
21950: निरूप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be seen or ascertained. ind. Having seen or considered. E. नि before रूप to have form, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
21951: निरूप्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Ascertaining, determining. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, निरूप्यता.
21952: निरूह m. (-हः) 1 A complete sentence, one having no ellipsis. 2 Certainty, ascertainment. 3 Logick, disputation. 4 An enema, one not of an oily kind. E. निर् privative, and ऊह reasoning, &c.
21953: निरूहण n. (-णं) 1 Ascertaining. 2 Administering enemata not of an oily kind. E. निर् before ऊह to reason, affix ल्युट्.
21954: निरेभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Silent, noiseless. E. नि neg. रेभ sounding.
21955: निरोध m. (-धः) 1 Loss, destruction. 2 Opposition, hindrance, check, restraint, prevention. 3 Aversion, disfavour, dislike. 4 Preserving. 5 Confinement. E. नि before रुध to oppose, affix घञ्.
21956: निरृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Free from violence, tyranny, &c. m. (-तिः) A demigod and ruler of the south-west quarter: see नैरृति. f. (-तिः) 1 Misfortune, calamity. 2 Security, prosperity, immunity from tyranny or violence. E. निर् implying reverse, ऋति good fortune, &c.
21957: निरृथ m. (-थः) The Sāma Veda. E. निर्, ऋ to go, Uṇādi affix थक्.
21958: निर्ग m. (-र्गः) Country, region, place or province. E. निर् forth, गम to go, affix ड.
21959: निर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone out or forth. 2 Expended, extinct, departed. E. निर् out, गत gone.
21960: निर्गन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Inodorous, void of fragrance or smell. E. निर् neg. गन्ध smell.
21961: निर्गन्धन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. निर् affirmative particle, गन्ध to hurt, affix ल्युट्.
21962: निर्गन्धपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) The Simel or silk cotton tree. E. निर्गन्ध, पुष्प a flower, ङीष् aff.
21963: निर्गम m. (-मः) 1 Going forth or out, exit. 2 Total loss or departure. E. निर् out, and गम going; also निर्गमन and निर्गति.
21964: निर्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Void of all properties. 2 Bad, worthless, having no good qualities. m. (-णः) The Supreme Being, or any deity so considered. E. निर् privative, and गुण a property, an excellence.
21965: निर्गुणत्व n. (-त्वं) The state of being free from all qualities, an attribute especially of the Supreme Being. E. निर्गुण, and त्व affix; also with तल्, निर्गुणता.
21966: निर्गुण्ठी f. (-ण्ठी) 1 A shrub, (Vitex negundo.) 2 Another plant, (नीलशेफालिका.) 3 The root of the lotus. E. निर् forth or out, गुठि or गुडि to surround, क affix fem. affix ङीष्; hence also निर्गुण्डी f. (-ण्डा.)
21967: निर्गूढ m. (-ढः) The hollow of a tree. E. निर् in, गुह to hide, aff. क्त.
21968: निर्ग्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 A saint, a devotee, one who has withdrawn from the world, and lives either as a beggar or a hermit. 2 A religious character wandering about naked. 3 A pauper, a beggar. 4 An ideot, a fool. 5 A gambler. E. निर् not, ग्रन्थ a knot or tie, or figuratively, attachment.
21969: निर्ग्रन्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Unattended, unaccompanied. 2 Abandoned, deserted. 3 Clever, expert, conversant. m. (-कः) 1 A religious mendicant. 2 A naked devotee. 3 A gambler. E. निर् not, ग्रन्थ tie or connexion, affix कन्; also read निर्ग्रन्थिक.
21970: निर्ग्रन्थन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. निर् privative, before ग्रन्थ to hurt or kill, affix ल्युट्.
21971: निर्घट n. (-टं) 1 A great collection of people, a fair, a market, &c. 2 A free market or wharf, one where no toll is levied. 3 A place where is no quay or stairs. E. निर् prefixed to घट to endeavour, affix अच्.
21972: निर्घण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A vocabulary, an index. E. निर् before घटि to endeavour, aff. अच्
21973: निर्घर्षण n. (-णं) Rubbing, friction. E. निर् before घृष to rub, ल्युट् aff.
21974: निर्घर्षणक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Rubbing, a rubber. E. कन् added to the last.
21975: निर्घात m. (-तः) 1 A gust of wind, a hurricane, a whirlwind. 2 The noise of contending vapours in the heavens. E. निर् forth, हन to drive, affix घञ्, घात substituted for the radical.
21977: निर्घृण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Cruel, unmerciful. 2 Shameless, immodest. E. निर् neg. घृणा mercy, &c.
21978: निर्घोष m. (-षः) Sound in general. E. निर् before घुष to sound, affix घञ्.
21979: निर्ज्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lonely, unpeopled, unfrequented. E. निर् neg. जन a person.
21980: निर्ज्जर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Immortal, imperishable, undecaying. m. (-रः) A deity, an immortal. n. (-रं) Ambrosia, the food of the gods. f. (-रा) 1 A plant: see गुडुची. 2 A sort of perfume, commonly Mura. E. निर् not, जरा decrepitude or decay.
21981: निर्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Dry, desart, void of water. m. (-लः) A desart, a waste. E. निर् neg. and जल water.
21982: निर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Conquered, subdued, overcome. 2 Won, gained. 3 Unconquered. E. निर् affirmative or neg. prefix जित conquered.
21983: निर्जितेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of subdued passions or feelings. E. निर्जित, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
21984: निर्जितेन्द्रियग्राम m. (-मः) A Muni, a saint. E. निर्जितेन्द्रिय, and ग्राम accumulation.
21985: निर्जीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Lifeless. E. निर्, and जीव alive.
21986: निर्झर mf. (-रः-री) A cascade or torrent, the precipitous descent of water from mountains, &c. f. (-री) A river. m. (-रः) 1 A horse of the sun. 2 A fire of chaff. E. निर् before झॄ to waste, and अप् aff.
21987: निर्झरिन् m. (-री) A mountain. f. (-रिणी) A river. E. निर्झर a waterfall, इनि aff.
21988: निर्णय m. (-यः) 1 Certainty, positive conclusion. 2 Doubt, discussion, investigation. 3 (In Law,) Sentence, decision. 4 (In the Mīmāṃsā,) The application of a conclusive argument. 5 (In Logic,) Complete ascertainment. E. निर् affirmative prefix, णी to guide, affix अच्.
21989: निर्णयन n. (-नं) Certainty, ascertainment, positive conclusion. E. see निर्णय, with ल्युट् aff.
21990: निर्णयपाद m. (-दः) A sentence, a verdict, (in Law.) E. निर्णय, and पाद process.
21991: निर्णर m. (-रः) One of the horses of the sun.
21992: निर्णायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Causing or leading to certainty. E. निर् before णी to guide, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
21993: निर्णायन n. (-नं) 1 Causing certainty. 2 The outer angle of the elephant's eye. E. विर्णय certainty, फक् aff.
21994: निर्णिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Cleaned, cleansed. E. निर् before निज to clean, affix क्त.
21995: निर्णीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ascertained, determined. 2 Sentenced, decreed. E. निर् before णी to get, affix क्त.
21996: निर्णेक m. (-कः) Cleansing, washing, cleaning. E. निर् before निज to wash, घञ् aff.
21997: निर्णेजक m. (-कः) A washerman. E. निर् before निज to clean, affix ण्वुल्.
21998: निर्णेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Certifying, verifying, leading to certainty, decisive. m. (-ता) 1 A judge. 2 A document, a voucher. 3 A guide. E. निर् before णी to lead, तृच् aff.
21999: निर्णेतृत्व n. (-त्वं) Proof, verification. E. त्व added to the preceding.
22000: निर्णेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be ascertained, what is or ought to be determined. E. निर् before णी to lead, यत् aff.
22001: निर्द्दग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Burnt, burnt up. 2 Unburnt. E. निर्, and दग्ध burnt.
22002: निर्दट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Unkind, unfeeling, unmerciful, devoid of pity or charity. 2 Unnecessary. 3 Envious, slanderous, abusive. 4 Mad, intoxicated. E. निर् before दो to cut, to hurt, affix अटच्, deriv. irr.
22003: निर्दय mfn. (-पः-या-यं) Unkind, unmerciful, cruel, hard-hearted. E. निर् before दया compassion, charity.
22004: निर्द्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Harsh spoken. 2 Shameless. n. (-रं) Much, excessively. subst. n. (-रं) Pith, essence. E. निर् not, दृ to respect, अच् aff.
22005: निर्द्दरि m. (-रिः) A cave. E. निर् before दॄ to rend, इन् aff.
22006: निर्द्दरिवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Inhabiting a cave. E. निर्द्दरिन्, and वासिन् who abides in.
22007: निर्द्दशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Biting, consuming. E. निर्, and दशत् biting.
22008: निर्दशन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Toothless. E. निर् neg. दशन a tooth.
22009: निर्दहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Not burning, not caustic. n. (-नं) Marking nut. E. निर् affir. or neg. and दहन burning.
22010: निर्दहनी f. (-नी) A sort of creeper, from the fibres of which bowstrings are made, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)
22011: निर्द्दातृ m. (-ता) A reaper, a husbandman. E. निर् before दो to cut, तृच् aff.
22012: निर्द्दारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Torn, rent. 2 Open, unclosed. 3 Starting, starting, (the eyes.) E. निर्, and दारित torn.
22013: निर्दिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Stout, lusty. 2 Anointed, smeared. E. निर् before दिह to heap, affix क्त.
22014: निर्दिश्य ind. Having shown, explained, enjoined, &c. E. निर् before दिश to show, ल्यप् aff.
22015: निर्दिष्ट mfn. (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Described, depicted, pointed out, shown. 2 Ascertained, determined. 3 Ordered, directed. 4 Assigned. 5 Asserted, declared. E. निर् before दिश to show, affix क्त.
22016: निर्देश m. (-शः) 1 Order, command, authoritative instruction or direction. 2 Description, designation. 3 Depicting, pointing out or exhibiting. 4 Certainty, ascertainment. 5 Saying, telling. 6 Vicinity, proximity. E. निर् before दिश to show, affix घञ्.
22017: निर्देष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what shows or explains. m. (-ष्टा) An authority, a guide. E. निर् before दिश to show, तृच् aff.
22018: निर्दोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Faultless, without defect or blemish. E. निर् negative, and दोष defect.
22019: निर्द्वन्द्व mfn. (-न्द्वः-न्द्वा-न्द्वं) 1 Not double. 2 Free from either of two alternatives, neither glad nor sorry, &c. 3 Not acknowledging two principles. E. निर् neg. द्वन्द्व a pair.
22020: निर्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, indigent. m. (-नः) An old ox. E. निर् priv. and धन wealth.
22021: निर्धर्म्म mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मा-र्म्मं) 1 Impious, unrighteous, immoral, void of law or religion. 2 Not acknowledging moral or religious institutions, but especially those of the Hindūs. E. निर् not, धर्म्म virtue, &c.
22022: निर्धार m. (-रः) 1 Certainty, ascertainment. 2 Particularising individuals according to their degree of merit. E. निर् before धृ to hold or have, affix घञ्.
22023: निर्धारण n. (-णं) Certainty, ascertainment. E. निर् before धृ to have, affix ल्युट्.
22024: निर्धारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be ascertained. 2 Acting resolutely, irresistible. E. निर् affir. or neg. धृ to hold, अनीयर् affix; also निर्धारितव्य, and निर्धार्य्य.
22025: निर्धारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ascertained, determined. E. निर् affirmative, धृ to have, causal form, क्त aff.
22026: निर्धार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Acting fearlessly. 2 Active, energetic. 3 Ascertainable, to be ascertained or determined. E. निर् neg. or affir. घृ to restrain, affix ण्यत्; it may also be written निर्द्धार्य्य.
22027: निर्धूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deserted, rejected. 2 Removed, departed. 3 Broken, divided. 4 Refuted. 5 Thrown out. 6 Suffered, undergone. 7 Destroyed. m. (-तः) A man abandoned by his relatives or friends. E. निर् before धु to shake, affix क्त.
22028: निर्धौत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Washed. 2 Bright, polished. E. निर्, and धौत cleansed.
22029: निर्नमस्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Uncourteous. E. निर् neg. नकस्कार salutation.
22030: निर्नाथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Having no superior, master, protector, &c. E. निर् neg. नाथ a lord.
22031: निर्नाथता f. (-ता) 1 Being without a master. 2 Widowhood. E. निर् neg. नाथता masterhood.
