22032: निर्निमित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Causeless, groundless. E. निर् neg. निमित्त cause.
22033: निर्ब्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Intent, and pertinacious pursuit of any thing, urgency, importunity. 2 Seizure, laying hold of any thing, literally or figuratively. 3 Caprice, fancy, whim. E. रिर् before बन्ध to bind or tie, affix अच्.
22034: निर्ब्बर्हण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter. E. निर् before वर्ह to slay, affix ल्युट्.
22035: निर्ब्बल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Weak, feeble, powerless. E. निर् neg. बल strength.
22036: निर्बुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Ignorant, unwise. E. निर् neg. and बुद्धि understanding; also निर्बोध.
22037: निर्ब्बैर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Free from hatred or enmity. E. निर् neg. वैर hostility.
22038: निर्भग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Broken down. E. निर्, and भग्न broken.
22039: निर्भट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Hard, firm, compact. E. निर् before भट to maintain, affix अच्.
22040: निर्भय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearless, undaunted. E. निर् not, भय fear.
22041: निर्भर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Much, excessive. 2 Fearless. n. adv. (-रं) Much, excessively. subst. Pith, essence. E. निर् before भृ to fill, affix अप्.
22042: निर्भर्त्सन n. (-नं) 1 Wickedness, malignity. 2 Abuse, blame. 3 Lac. E. निर् before भर्त्स to abuse, affix ल्युट्.
22043: निर्भर्त्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abused, reviled, despised. E. निर् before भर्त्स to abuse, affix क्त.
22044: निर्भाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Unlucky. E. निर् neg. भाग्य luck.
22045: निर्भिद्य ind. Having pierced or penetrated. E. निर् before भिद to break, ल्यप् aff.
22046: निर्भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Undistinguished, equal, like. 2 Pierced, divided. E. निर्, भिन्न separated or pierced.
22047: निर्भुन्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Straight, flat, not bent. E. निर्, and भुग्न curved.
22048: निर्म्मथ्य ind. 1 Having discriminated or particularised. 2 Having ground or churned. E. निर् before मथि to churn, ल्यप् aff.
22049: निर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Sober, quiet, unintoxicated. m. (-दः) An elephant after the frontal juice has ceased to exude, one out of rut. E. निर् priv. and मद madness.
22050: निर्म्मनुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Uninhabited, desolate. E. निर्, मनुष्य a man.
22051: निर्म्मन्थन n. (-नं) 1 Separating, distinguishing, discriminating. 2 Churning. E. निर् before मन्थ to churn, ल्युट् aff.
22052: निर्म्मन्थ्य mfn. (-न्थ्यः-न्थ्या-न्थ्यं) 1 To be rubbed, to be churned, &c. 2 To be distinguished or discriminated. E. निर् affir. मन्थ्य to be rubbed.
22053: निर्म्मम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Disinterested, claiming or wishing for nothing. E. निर्, and मम mine.
22054: निर्म्ममत्व n. (-त्वं) Disregard of worldly interests or possessions. E. निर्म्मम, and त्व affix; also निर्म्ममता, with तल् aff.
22055: निर्म्मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Clear, clean, free from dirt or impurities, (literally or figuratively.) n. (-लं) 1 The remains of an offering made to a deity. 2 Talc. E. निर् priv. and मल dirt.
22056: निर्म्मलत्व n. (-त्वं) Purity, cleanness, (physical or moral.) E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, निर्म्मलता.
22057: निर्म्माण n. (-णं) 1 Manufacture, production, making. 2 Pith, marrow, essence. 3 Propriety, fitness. E. निर् before मा to measure, affix ल्युट्.
22058: निर्म्माल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Clear, clean. n. (-ल्यं) 1 The remains of an offering presented to a deity. 2 Purity, cleanness, clearness. f. (-ल्या) A medicinal plant: see पृक्का. E. निर् not, मल dirt, impurity, affix यञ्.
22059: निर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made. 2 Fabricated, artificial. E. निर् before मा to mete, affix क्त.
22060: निर्म्मिति f. (-तिः) Making, manufacturing, artificial production. E. as above: see निर्म्मित, affix क्तिन्.
22061: निर्म्मुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Loosed, set free, liberated, disjoined, sundered, separated, &c. m. (-क्तः) A snake who has lately cast his skin. E. निर् before मुक्त loosed.
22062: निर्म्मुट m. (-टः) 1 A tree bearing apparent blossoms. 2 The sun. 3 A rogue. n. (-टं) A large, and free market or fair. E. निर् before मुट to press, &c. affix क.
22063: निर्म्मूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Baseless, unfounded. 2 Eradicated. E. निर्, and मूल a root.
22064: निर्मृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Rubbed out. E. निर्, and मृष्ट rubbed.
22065: निर्म्मोक m. (-कः) 1 The slough of a snake. 2 Liberating, setting loose or free. 3 Armour, mail. 4 Sky, heaven, atmosphere. E. निर् forth, मुच to let loose, affix घञ्.
22066: निर्यत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Going forth or out, issuing. E. निर्, and यत् going.
22067: निर्य्यन्त्रण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Self-willed, unrestrained, uncontrolled, independant. n. (-णं) Independence, absence of restraint. E. निर् not, यन्त्रण restraining.
22068: निर्य्यन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Self-willed, uncontrolled, unrestrained. E. निर् neg. यन्त्रित restrained.
22069: निर्याण n. (-णं) 1 Going forth or out, exit, issue. 2 Eternal emancipation, final beatitude. 3 A rope for tying cattle, a foot-rope. 4 The outer corner of an elephant's eye. E. निर् before यम to go, affix ल्युट्.
22070: निर्य्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone out or forth, departed. E. निर्, and यात gone.
22071: निर्यातन m. (-नं) 1 Revenge. 2 Gift, donation. 3 Delivery of a deposit. 4 Replacing any thing lost. 5 Payment of a debt. 6 Killing, slaughter. E. निर् before यत to endeavour, in the causal form, affix ल्युट्.
22072: निर्य्यातित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken away. 2 Retaliated, requited. E. निर्, यत to endeavour, causal v. क्त aff.
22073: निर्याम m. (-मः) A sailor, a boatman. E. निर् before यम to refrain, affix घञ्
22074: निर्य्याय ind. Having gone out or departed. E. निर् out, याय having gone.
22075: निर्यास m. (-सः) 1 Extract, decoction, infusion. 2 Any natural exudation of a plant, as gum, milk, extract, &c. E. निर् forth or out, यस to endeavour, affix घञ्; it is also read निर्य्यास.
22076: निर्य्युक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Disunion. 2 Unfitness, inappropriateness, impropriety. 3 Want of connexion or government, (in Grammar.) E. निर् neg. युक्ति union, &c.
22077: निर्य्युक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Detached, disunited. 2 Unconnected, unmeaning. 3 Inappropriate, improper. E. ठक् added to the preceding.
22078: निर्य्यूह m. (-हः) 1 A chaplet, a crest, an ornament for the head. 2 Extracted juice, or a decoction, &c. 3 A door, a gate. 4 A pin or bracket projecting from a wall to hang or place any thing upon. 5 Wood placed in a wall for doves to build upon. E. निर् out, out from, युह to go, affix क.
22079: निर्य्योगक्षेम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Free from care or anxiety about property. E. निर् neg. योगक्षेम property.
22080: निर्लक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Unmarked, unnoted, unspotted, &c. 2 Undefined. E. निर् priv. and लक्षण a mark.
22081: निर्लज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Impudent, shameless. E. निर् neg. लज्जा shame.
22082: निर्लिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Unsmeared, unanointed. 2 Undefiled, uncontaminated, (by passion, &c.) m. (-प्तः) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA. 2 A sage. E. निर् neg. लिप्त anointed.
22083: निर्लेप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Anointed or smeared. 2 Undefiled, (by passion.) m. (-पः) A sage. E. निर् on, लेष plastering.
22084: निर्व्वचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Silent. n. (-नं) 1 Explanation, declaration. 2 Vocabulary, index. E. निर् affir. or neg. वचन speaking.
22085: निर्व्वन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bare, open, (a country.) E. निर् neg. वन a wood.
22086: निर्व्वपण n. (-णं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Presentation of funeral offerings. 3 Extinguishing, pulling out. E. निर् before वप to go, affix ल्युट्.
22087: निर्व्वयनी f. (-नी) The cast slough of a snake.
22088: निर्व्वर्णण n. (-णं) Sight, seeing, looking at, regarding. E. निर् before वर्ण to class or colour, affix ल्युट्.
22089: निर्वर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Leaving off, desisting from. 2 Completing, ending. 3 Limiting to, measuring by. E. निर् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
22090: निर्व्वर्त्य ind. 1 Having finished, having done. 2 Having ceased. E. निर् before वृत to be, ल्यप् aff.
22091: निर्व्वहण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 End, completion. 2 Supporting, carrying on, maintaining. 3 The catastrophe of a drama, the conclusion of the fable. E. निर् out, वह to bear, affix युच्.
22092: निर्व्वाच्य m. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 Unobjectionable, blameless, not to be found fault with or censured. 2 Improper to be said. E. निर् neg. वाच्य to be spoken.
22093: निर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Liberated from existence. 2 Dead, deceased. 3 Gone out, extinguished, (as a fire.) 4 Set, as a planet. 5 Immersed, plunged. 6 Having no arrows. n. (-णं) 1 Eternal happiness, emancipation from matter, and re-union with the deity: it is especially employed in this sense by the Bauddhas and Jains, understanding by it perfect and perpetual calm. 2 Setting, disappearing, departure. 3 Refraining, desisting, leaving off, cessation. 4 Union, association,  blending, confluence. 5 Bathing or plunging of an elephant. 6 Repose. 7 Vacuity, vacuum or space. 8 Instructing in science. E. निर् before वाण to blow, &c. affix क्त, deriv. irr. or निर् neg. वाण an arrow.
22094: निर्व्वाणमस्तक m. (-कः) Liberation. E. निर्व्वाण, and मस्तक head, chief.
22095: निर्व्वात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Calm, still, not windy, having ceased to blow. 2 Sheltered from the wind. m. (-तः) A calm. E. निर् before वात wind, air.
22096: निर्व्वाद m. (-दः) 1 Censure, blame, reproach. 2 Rumour, report. 3 Asseveration, affirmation, decision of a controversy. 4 Absence of dispute or railing. 5 Disrespect. E. निर् privat, prefix, and वाद speech.
22097: निर्व्वाप m. (-पः) 1 Putting out, as a fire or light. 2 Gifts in honour of a deceased ancestor: see निवाय.
22098: निर्व्वापन n. (-नं) 1 Putting out, as a fire or light, extinguishing, quenching. 2 (In medicine,) Refrigerant. 3 Killing, slaughter. 4 Gift, giving. 5 Presenting funeral oblations. E. निर् before बप to go, &c. in the causal form, affix ल्युट्.
22099: निर्व्वापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Put out, quenched, extinguished. 2 Allayed, cooled. 3 Killed. 4 Offered in oblation. E. निर्, वप to go, causal v., क्त aff.
22100: निर्व्वाप्य ind. 1 Having offered funeral cakes. 2 Having delighted. 3 Having quenched. E. निर् before वप to sow, affix ल्यप्.
22101: निर्व्वार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-य्यं) 1 Acting fearlessly or determinately. 2 Irresistible, not to be opposed or resisted. E. निर्, वृ to hinder, affix ण्यत्.
22102: निर्व्वासन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Hurting, injuring. 3 Banishment, expulsion. E. निर् out, forth, वस to abide, causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
22103: निर्व्वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, banished. E. निर् out, वस to abide, causal v., क्त aff.
22104: निर्व्वास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be banished. E. निर् out, वस to abide, causal form, यत् aff.; also निर्व्वासनीय, निर्व्वासितव्य.
22105: निर्व्वाह m. (-हः) 1 Accomplishment, completion, end. 2 Carrying on, supporting, maintaining. 3 Providing means. 4 Sufficiency, adequacy. E. निर् before वह to bear, affix घञ्.
22106: निर्व्वाहक n. (-कं) Application or connexion of cause and effect. E. निर् before वह to convey, ण्वुल् aff.
22107: निर्व्वाहण nf. (-णं-णा) Catastrophe of a drama: see निर्व्वहण.
22108: निर्व्विकल्पक n. (-कं) Knowledge, not depending upon or derived from the senses. E. निर् neg. विकल्प alternative, कन् added.
22109: निर्विकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unchanged, unaltered, uniform. E. निर् neg. विकार change of form or state.
22110: निर्विघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) Unobstructed. n. subst. (-घ्नं) Absence of obstruction or impediment. adv. Freely, unobstructedly. E. निर् neg. निघ्न obstruction.
22111: निर्विण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 1 Desponding, overcome with fear or sorrow. 2 Humble. 3 Abused, degraded. 4 Fallen away, emaciate with grief. 5 Decayed, impaired. 6 Certain. E. निर् privative, विद to know, affix क्त.
22112: निर्विण्णचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Humble, resigned, meek. E. निर्व्विण्ण, and चेतस mind.
22113: निर्विन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) The name of a river that rises in the Vindhya mountains. E. निर् out of, विन्ध्या the Vindh hills, fem. aff. टाप्.
22114: निर्विवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Close, contiguous, without interval or interstice. E. निर् neg. विवर a space.
22115: निर्विवेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Foolish, undiscriminating. E. निर् neg. विवेक judgment.
22116: निर्विशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless, undaunted, confident. E. निर् neg. विशङ्क fearful.
22117: निर्व्विशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) 1 Entering in or into. 2 Engaged in. 3 Attaining, obtaining. 4 Marrying. E. निर् before विश to enter, शतृ aff.
22118: निर्विशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Undiscriminating, making no difference. 2 Same, like, indiscriminate. E. निर् neg. विशेष difference.
22119: निर्विषा f. (-षा or षी) A plant, (Curcuma zedoaria.) E. निर् opposite, (anti,) विष poison, antidote.
22120: निर्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Attained, arrived at. 2 Obtained, got. 3 Engaged in, occupied by. 4 Staying, being. 5 Married. 6 Earned, gained. 7 Taken, received. E. निर् before विश to enter, affix क्त.
22121: निर्व्वीज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Seedless. 2 Impotent. E. निर् neg. वीज seed.
22122: निर्वीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unheroick, cowardly. (-रा) A woman whose husband and children are dead, a childless widow. E. निर् privative, and वीर a hero, a champion.
22123: निर्वीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Tame, feeble, spiritless. 2 Impotent. E. निर् not, वीर्य्य power.
22124: निर्वृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ended, terminated. 2 Happy, content. 3 Emancipated. 4 Free from occupation or interest. n. (-तं) A house. E. निर्, and वृ to choose, क्त affix: see निवृत्त.
22125: निर्वृति f. (-तिः) 1 Final emancipation from existence. 2 Death. 3 Happiness. 4 Rest, repose, tranquillity, ceasing or abstaining from. 5 Setting, departure, disappearance. 6 Completion, accomplishment, conclusion. E. निर् affirmative particle, वृ to choose, affix क्तिन्.
22126: निर्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Finished, completely done, accomplished. E. निर् before वृत to be, affix क्त.
22127: निर्वृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Destitute, having no occupation. f. (-त्तिः) 1 Completion, termination, conclusion. 2 Satisfaction. 3 Final beatitude. 4 Approach, advance. E. निर् neg. वृत to be, affix क्तिन्, or निर् and वृत्ति business.
22128: निर्वेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Calm, (as the ocean.) E. निर्, and वेग agitation.
22129: निर्वेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Not having the Vedas, infidel, unscriptural. m. (-दः) 1 Humility, self-disparagement. 2 Being neglected or disregarded by others. 3 Indifference, disregard of worldly objects. E. निर् depreciative particle, विद to know, affix घञ्, or निर् neg. वेद the Vedas.
22130: निर्वेश m. (-शः) 1 Wages, hire. 2 Enjoyment. 3 Eating. 4 Fainting, swooning, syncope. 5 Attaining, obtaining. 6 Engaged or entering in. E. निर् before विश to enter, affix घञ्.
22131: निर्वेष्टन n. (-नं) A small reed used as a shuttle. E. निर् without, वेष्टन surrounding.
22132: निर्वैर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Friendly, without enmity. E. निर् neg. वैर hostility.
22133: निर्व्यथन n. (-नं) 1 A hole, a chasm. 2 Exemption from pain. 3 Paining, afflicting. E. निर् affix or neg, prefix, and न्यथन fear, dread.
22134: निर्व्यपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Indifferent to, disregarding. E. निर् neg. व्यपेक्षा expectation.
22135: निर्व्यलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Undissembling, true. E. निर् neg. व्यलीक false.
22136: निर्व्याज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Without deceit. 2 Without obstruction. E. निर् neg. व्याज deceit.
22137: निर्व्यूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Abandoned, left, deserted. 2 Finished, completed. E. निर् before व्यूढ arranged.
22138: निर्हरण m. (-णं) 1 Taking forth or out. 2 Removing entirely. 2 Setting apart. 4 Burning dead bodies, or carrying them out to be burnt. E. निर् away, हरण taking.
22139: निर्हार m. (-रः) 1 Extracting, drawing out, rooting up, &c. 2 Putting forth or out. 3 Evacuation of any of the natural excrements of the fæces, urine, sweat, &c. 4 Burning, combustion. 5 Giving away, selling, exchanging, &c. 6 Diffusive fragrance. 7 Accumulation of wealth, a hoard, a private purse or hoard. E. निर् out, हृ to take, affix घञ्.
22140: निर्हारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Taking forth or out. 2 Diffusively fragrant, having a wide spreading odour. 3 Having wealth. E. निर्, हृ to take, घिणुन् aff. or निर्हार, affix इनि.
22141: निर्हृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken or carried forth or out. 2 Extracted. E. निर् out, हृत taken.
22142: निर्हृत्य ind. 1 Having taken forth or out. 2 Having extracted. E. निर् before हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
22143: निर्हेति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Unarmed. E. निर्, and हेति a weapon.
22144: निर्ह्राद m. (-दः) Sound in general. E. निर् before ह्रद to sound, affix घञ्.
22145: निलय m. (-यः) A house, a habitation. E. नि in, ली to embrace, affix घ.
22146: निलयन n. (-नं) Place, dwelling. E. नि before ली to endeavour, ल्युट् aff.
22147: निलायिता f. (-ता) Dwelling, domesticality. E. निलायिन्, and तल् aff.
22148: निलायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Dwelling in, inhabiting. E. नि before ली to embrace, णिनि aff.
22149: निलिम्प m. (-म्पः) A deity. f. (-म्पा) A cow. E. नि in or on, लिम्प to smear, affix खञ्.
22150: निलिम्पिका f. (-का) A cow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
22151: निलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Encompassed, surrounded, shut or wrapt up, embraced. 2 Destroyed, perished entirely. 3 Transformed, changed. 4 Fused in or into. 5 Full. E. नि in or on, ली to embrace, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
22152: निवपन n. (-नं) Gifts in honour of deceased ancestors; also निवाप.
22153: निवरा f. (-रा) A virgin, a girl unmarried. E. नि priv. and वर a husband.
22154: निवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Returning, turning or coming back. 2 Bringing back. 3 Reforming, repenting. 4 Desisting from. 5 Giving back, returning. 6 Stopping, ceasing. 7 A measure of land 20 rods, or 200 cubits square. E. नि before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
22155: निवर्त्तयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be restrained, to be hindered or diverted. E. नि before वृत to be, causal v. तव्य aff.
22156: निवर्त्त्य ind. 1 Having desisted or refrained from. 2 Having turned back. 3 Having repented. 4 Having repaid. E. नि before ष्टत to be, aff. ल्यप्.
22157: निवर्हण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Killing, destroying. 2 Removing. E. नि before वर्ह to cover, ल्युट् aff.
22158: निवर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, destroyed. 2 Removed, taken away. E. नि before वर्ह to cover, क्त aff.
22159: निवसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Dwelling in, inhabiting. E. नि before वस to dwell, शतृ aff.
22160: निवसति f. (-तिः) A house, a habitation. E. नि in, वस to dwell, aff. क्तिन्.
22161: निवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. नि in, वस to dwell, aff. अथ.
22162: निवसन n. (-नं) 1 A house, a habitation. 2 Cloth, clothes, raiment. E. नि in, वस to dwell or wear, aff. ल्युट्.
22163: निवह m. (-हः) 1 A multitude, a quantity. 2 One of the seven winds. E. नि always, वह to gain, घ or अच् aff.
22164: निवात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well armed, accoutred in strong mail. 2 Secure, safe, as in an asylum. 3 Calm, not windy. m. (-तः) An asylum, a dwelling, &c. 2 A calm. 3 Strong armour. E. नि neg. वात wind, &c.
22165: निवातकवच m. (-चः) A demon, the grandson of HIRAṆYAKAŚIPU. E. निवात, and कवच a cuirass.
22166: निवाप m. (-पः) 1 Gifts in honour of a deceased parent or relative. 2 Offering of water at Śrāddhas, or daily ablution to the manes. 3 Gift, giving in general. E. नि before वप to go, to give, &c. aff. घञ्.
22167: निवार m. (-रः) Hindering, opposition, impediment. E. नि prefix, वॄ to screen, घञ् aff.
22168: निवारण n. (-णं) 1 Hindering, opposing. 2 An impediment. 3 Contemning, holding light or worthless. E. नि prefix, वॄ to screen, ल्युट् aff.
22169: निवारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be checked, hindered, &c. E. नि before वॄ to screen, aff. अनीयर्; also निवारितव्य and निवार्य्य.
22170: निवारयत् mfn. (-यत्-यन्ती-यत्) Opposing, hindering. E. नि before वॄ to screen, शतृ aff.
22171: निवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hindered, checked, opposed. E. नि prefix, वॄ to screen, क्त aff.
22172: निवार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) To be opposed or hindered. E. नि before वॄ to screen, pass. v. शानच् aff.
22173: निवास m. (-सः) A house, a dwelling. E. नि in, वस to abide, aff. घञ्.
22174: निवासभूय n. (-यं) Habitation or inhabiting. E. निवास, and भूय being.
22175: निवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Dwelling, abiding in, inhabiting. E. निवास, and इनि aff.
22176: निविड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) 1 Coarse, large, gross, bulky, without spaces or interstices. 2 Thick, impervious, impenetrable. 3 Crooked-nosed. E. नि not, विल an interstice, ल changed to ड; or नि particle, with विलच् aff.
22177: निविडीष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Coarse, gross. 2 Crooked-nosed. E. see the last; also मि particle, विडीसच् aff.
22178: निविवृत्सत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Wishing to stop or return. E. नि before वृत to abide, desid. form, शतृ aff.
22179: निविशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Alike, not different. E. नि neg. विशेष difference.
22180: निविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered, gone in or into. 2 Seated, sitting upon. 3 Situated or placed in or on. E. नि before विश to enter, aff. क्त.
22181: निवीत mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं) A veil, a mantle, a wrapper. n. (-तं) The Brahminical thread suspended round the neck, in which manner it is worn on some occasions. E. नि before व्ये to cover, aff. क्त.
22182: निवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman with the cord suspended round his neck. E. निवीत, and इनि aff.
22183: निवृत mfn. adj. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, enclosed, encompassed. subst. A veil, a mantle, a wrapper. E. नि before वृ to surround, aff. क्त.
22184: निवृति f. (-तिः) Covering, enclosing. E. नि, वृ to be, क्तिन् aff.
22185: निवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Ceased, stopped. 2 Abstaining from worldly acts, &c. 3 Abstracted from or independant of worldly motives. 3 Desisting from or repenting of any improper conduct. 4 Returned, turned back. 5 Gone, departed. 6 Finished, completed. E. नि prohibitory prefix, वृत to be, aff. क्त; see निर्वृत्त.
22186: निवृत्तकारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Without further cause or motive. m. (-णः) A virtuous man, one uninfluenced by worldly desires. E. निवृत्त ceased, कारण cause.
22187: निवृत्तराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Of subdued appetites or passions. E. निवृत्त stopped, राग passion.
22188: निवृत्तवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Quitting any practice or occupation. E. निवृत्त, and वृत्ति maintenance.
22189: निवृत्तात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 A sage. 2 VIṢṆU. E. निवृत्त stopped, (from worldly acts, &c.) आत्मन् spirit.
22190: निवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Cessation, completion, leaving off, rest, repose. 2 Discontinuance of worldly acts, cessation of emotions, separation from the world. 3 Denial, refusal. 4 Abolition, prevention. 5 Returning. E. नि negative prefix, वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्: see निर्वृत्ति.
22191: निवेदन n. (-नं) 1 Delivering, giving, entrusting, addressing, (either an article, a message, or a speech.) E. नि before विद to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
22192: निवेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Given, entrusted, addressed, delivered. 2 Represented, stated, told. E. नि before विद to know, aff. क्तः see निवेदन.
22193: निवेश m. (-शः) 1 Entrance, entering. 2 Delivering, entrusting, depositing. 3 A camp, a palace, the residence of a king or general. 4 Any dwelling. 5 Military array. 6 Ornament, dress, decoration. 7 Marriage. E. नि before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
22194: निवेशन n. (-नं) 1 Entering, entrance. 2 A house, a habitation. 3 A town or city. E. नि before विश to enter, aff. ल्युट्.
22195: निवेशनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be entered. 2 To be engaged in. E. नि before विश to enter, अनीयर् aff; also निवेशितव्य and निवेश्य.
22196: निवेशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Sending in or into, causing to enter. E. नि before विश to enter, causal form, शतृ aff.
22197: निवेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Entered into. 2 Engaged in. 3 Sent, directed. 4 Placed in or upon. 5 Turned to or towards, fixed upon. E. नि before विश to enter, क्त aff.
22198: निव्यूढ n. (-ढं) Perseverance, resolution. E. नि, and व्यूढ arranged.
22200: निशठ m. (-ठः) The son of BALARĀMA.
22201: निशमन n. (-नं) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 Hearing. E. नि before शम to be quiet, aff. ल्युट्.
22202: निशम्य ind. Hearing, having heard. E. नि, शम to repose, ल्यप् aff.
22203: निशमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Hearing. E. नि before शम to rest, शतृ aff.
22204: निशमय्य ind. (-य्यः) Having heard. E. नि before शमु to repose, ल्यप् aff., and अय inserted.
22205: निशा f. (-शा) 1 Night. 2 Turmerick, (Curcuma longa.) 3 Another sort, (C. zanthorrhiza) E. नि always, शो to waste or reduce, (mortals,) aff. क; or निश to meditate, aff. क्विप् and टाप् added.
22206: निशाकर m. (-रः) 1 The moon. 2 A cock. E. निशा night, and कर who makes or marks.
22207: निशाकेतु m. (-तुः) The moon. E. निशा night, and केतु symbol.
22208: निशागण m. (-णः) A number of nights. E. निशा A night, and गण a class, a troop.
22209: निशाचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Nocturnal, night-walking, what goes or moves about by night. m. (-रः) 1 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, an imp or goblin. 2 A Shakāl. 3 An owl. 4 A snake. 5 The ruddy goose. 6 A ghost, an evil spirit. 7 A thief. f. (-री) 1 A woman who goes to an assignation, a harlot, a whore. 2 A she devil, a female fiend. 3 A sort of perfume: see केशिनी. E. निशा night, and चर् who goes.
22210: निशाचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Darkness. E. निशा night, and चर्म्मन् skin or hide.
22211: निशाजल n. (-लं) 1 Frost, hoar frost. 2 Dew. E. निशा night, and जल water.
22212: निशाट m. (-टः) 1 An owl. 2 A demon, a ghost. E. निशा night, and अट who goes; also with ल्यु aff. निशाटन m. (-नः.)
22213: निशात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sharpened, polished, whetted, burnished. E. नि before शो to cut or pare, aff. क्त.
22214: निशाद m. (-दः) A man of a low caste: see निषाद.
22215: निशादत्व n. (-त्वं) The state or condition of a man of low caste.
22216: निशादर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) An owl. E. निशा night, and दर्शिन् who sees.
22217: निशादि f. (-दिः) Evening, twilight. E. निशा, and आदि beginning.
22218: निशान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Quiet, tranquil, patient. n. (-न्तं) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 The end of the night, or break of day. E. नि before शम to be quiet, aff. क्त; or निशा night, अम to go, aff. क्त; or निशा as before, night, and अन्त end or term.
22219: निशान्तनारी f. (-री) A female, a housewife. E. निशान्त a house, नारी a woman.
22220: निशान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Blind at night. E. निशा, and अन्ध blind.
22221: निशापति m. (-तिः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. निशा night, and पति master.
22222: निशापुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Hoar frost. 2 Dew. 3 The white water lily. E. निशा, and पुष्प a flower.
22223: निशाभङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A plant commonly Dugdhapeya. E. निशा night, भङ्ग breaking.
22224: निशामणि m. (-णिः) The moon. E. निशा night, and मणि a gem.
22225: निशामन n. (-नं) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 Looking at, beholding. 3 Looking at repeatedly. 4 Hearing. 5 A shadow, a reflexion. E. नि before शम to quiet, aff. ल्युट्.
22226: निशामृग m. (-गः) A Shakāl. E. निशा night, and मृग a deer.
22227: निशाम्य ind. Having put out, (as a light.) 2 Having tranquillized. E. नि before शम to be quiet, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
22228: निशारण n. (-णं) 1 Killing, slaying, slaughter. 2 Night combat. E. नि before शृ to injure or kill, aff. ल्युट्; or निशा night, and रण war.
22229: निशारत्न m. (-त्नः) The moon. E. निशा night, and रत्न jewel.
22230: निशारुक n. (-कं) An air, a sort of musical composition, played as an accompaniment to dancing.
22231: निशावृन्द n. (-न्दं) A number of nights. E. निशा, and वृन्द a many.
22232: निशावेदिन् m. (-दी) A cock. E. निशा night, and वेदिन् who knows.
22233: निशाहस m. (-सः) The white water lily. E. निशा, and हस what smiles; opening its petals at night.
22234: निशाह्वा f. (-ह्वा) Turmerick. E. निशा, and आह्वा appellation.
22235: निशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sharpened, whetted. n. (-तं) Iron. E. नि before शो to pare, affix क्त.
22236: निशिपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. निशि by night, seventh case of निश्, and पुष्प flower, fem. affix टाप्; also with ङीप् affix निशिपुष्पी, and with कन् added निशिपुष्पिका the night-flower.
22237: निशीथ n. (-थः) 1 Midnight. 2 Night. E. नि always, शी to sleep, Uṇādi affix थक्.
22238: निशीथिनी f. (-नी) Night. E. निशीथ as above, इनि aff.
22239: निशीथिनीनाथ m. (-थः) The moon. E. निशीथिनी night, and नाथ lord.
22240: निशीथ्या f. (-थ्या) Night. E. निशीथ midnight, and यत् aff.
22241: निशुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 The name of a giant slain by DURGĀ. E. नि before शुम्भ to hurt or kill, aff. घञ्.
22242: निशुम्भन n. (-नं) Killing, slaying, slaughter. E. see the last, aff. ल्युट्.
22243: निशुम्भमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) A name of DURGĀ. E. निशुम्भ an Asura or demon so named, and मर्द्दिनी the female destroyer.
22244: निशुम्भिन् m. (-म्भी) An inferior deity of the Bauddhas; also Heramba and Vajraṭīka. E. नि not, शुम्भ injuring, aff. इनि.
22245: निशोपशाय m. (-यः) Resting at night. E. निशा, and उपशाय rest.
22246: निशैत m. (-तः) The Vaka, a crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. निशा by night, इत gone, to his roost.
22247: निश्चय m. (-यः) Certainty, ascertainment, positive conclusion. E. निर् affirmative particle, चि to collect, aff. अप्.
22248: निश्चल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Immoveable, still, fixed. f. (-ला) The earth. E. निर् privat. चल what goes or moves.
22249: निश्चलाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Firm, immoveable. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) 2 A mountain, a rock. E. निश्चल, and अङ्ग body.
22250: निश्चायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what ascertains or determines. E. निर् before चि to collect, ण्वुल् aff.
22251: निश्चारक m. (-कः) 1 Evacuation by stool. 2 Air, wind. 3 Obstinacy, wilfulness. E. निर् not, चर to go, aff. ण्वुल्.
22252: निश्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Certain, ascertained, determined, concluded. 2 Sentenced, pronounced. n. (-तं) Certainty, conclusion. E. निर् before चि to collect, क्त aff.
22253: निश्चित्य ind. Having ascertained. E. निर aff. चि to collect, ल्यप् aff.
22254: निश्चिन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Thoughtless, inconsiderate, void of reflexion. E. निर् neg. चिन्ता reflexion.
22255: निश्चीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being in the course of ascertainment or conclusion, being under investigation. E. निर before चि to collect, शानच् aff., यक् inserted.
22256: निश्चुक्कण n. (-णं) A sort of tooth-powder prepared of sulphate of iron, &c. it destroys the tartar, but blackens the teeth. E. निर् before चुक्क to give pain, aff. ल्युट्.
22257: निश्चेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Powerless, helpless. 2 Incapable of effort. E. निर् neg. चेष्टा effort.
22258: निश्श्रेयस n. (-सं) Final emancipation: see निःश्रेयस.
22259: निश्श्रेयसकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Conferring final happiness or emancipation. E. निश्श्रेयस, and कर what makes.
22260: निश्श्वसन n. (-नं) 1 Breathing out, expiration. 2 Sighing. E. निर् forth, and श्वसन breathing.
22261: निश्श्वास m. (-सः) 1 Breath expired, breathing out, expiration. E. निर् out, and श्वास breath.
22262: निष (उ) निषु r. 1st cl. (नेषति) To sprinkle.
22263: निषङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A quiver. 2 Union, meeting, association. E. नि before सञ्ज to embrace, aff. घञ् a collection of arrows, &c.
22264: निषङ्गथि m. (-थिः) 1 Embracing, an embrace. 2 A bowman. 3 A charioteer. 4 A car. 5 Grass. 6 The shoulder. E. नि before सञ्ज to embrace, aff. घ and थिन् Uṇādi aff. added.
22265: निषङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) An archer, a bowman. E. निषङ्ग a quiver, and इनि aff.
22266: निषद m. (-दः) A musical note: see निषाद.
22267: निषद्या f. (-द्या) 1 A market. 2 A small bed. E. नि before षद to go, क्यप् aff.
22268: निषद्वर m. (-रः) Mud, mire. f. (-री) Night. E. नि before षद to go, Uṇādi aff. ष्वरच्.
22269: निषध m. (-धः) 1 The name of a mountain or mountainous range, forming one of the principal ranges of the universe, and described as lying immediately south of Hāvrata, and north of the Himāla range. 2 A country in the south-east division of India. 3 The sovereign of Niṣadha. 4 A musical note; also निषाद्र. 5 Hard, solid. E. नि before षद to go, aff. अच् and द irregularly changed to ध.
22270: निषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 1 Placed in or on. 2 Gone to. 3 Rested, reclined. E. नि before षद to go, क्त aff.
22271: निषण्णक mfn. (-कः-का-खं) Seating, seated. m. (-कं) A seat. E. कन् added to the last.
22272: निषन्नक m. (-कः) A sort of potherb, (Marsilea dentata.)
22273: निषाद m. (-दः) 1 The first of the seven musical notes, or more properly the last or highest of the scale. 2 A man of a degraded tribe, or an outcaste, especially the son of a Brahman by a Śūdra woman. 3 A fisherman. E. नि before षद to go, aff, घञ्; pervading the mind, &c.
22274: निषादिन् m. (-दी) An elephant keeper or driver. E. नि before षद to go, aff. णिनि.
22275: निषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Prohibited, forbidden. E. नि priv. सिध to complete, aff. क.
22276: निषीदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Sitting, sitting upon. 2 Standing or resting in or on. E. नि before षद to go, शतृ aff.
22277: निषूदन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before षद to kill, aff. ल्युट्.
22278: निषेक m. (-कः) 1 The ceremony performed upon impregnation taking place. 2 Sprinkling, aspersion. 3 Effusion. 4 Seminal effusion. E. नि, and षिच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
22279: निषेदिवस् mfn. (-वान्-दुषी-वस्) Sitting, seated on or upon. E. नि before सद to go, क्वसु aff.
22280: निषेध n. (-धः) 1 Prohibition, negation. 2 Stop, discontinuance. 3 Contrariety to or deviation from rule, irregularity, exception. E. नि before सिध to complete, aff. घञ्.
22281: निषेवन n. (-नं) 1 Service. 2 Observance, practice, adherence to. E. नि before सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.
22282: निषेवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be served, to be obeyed. 2 To be observed or followed. E. नि before सेव to serve, अनीयर् aff.; also निषेवितव्य, and निषेव्य.
22283: निषेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Observed, practised. 2 Served, obeyed. 3 Frequented through respect. E. नि before सेव to serve, क्त aff.
22284: निष्क r. 10th cl. (निष्कयते) To measure or weigh.
22285: निष्क mn. (-ष्कः-ष्कं) 1 A weight of gold, applied however to different quantities: it is considered as synonymous with the Dīnāra of thirty-two small, or sixteen large Rettīs; with the Karṣa or Suvarṇa of sixteen Māṣas; with the Pala of four or five Suvarṇas; and with the larger Pala or Dināra, which is sometimes reckoned at 108, and other times at 150 Suvarṇas. 2 Gold in general. 3 Any ornament of the breast. 4 An ornament of the neck. 5 A weight of four Māṣas. 6 A weight of silver of four Suvarṇas. 7 A value of sixteen Kahans or Dramyas. E. नि before षद to go, Uṇādi aff. कन्, and the radical final rejected.
22286: निष्कण्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Without thorns. 2 Free from trouble. E. निर् neg. कण्टक a thorn.
22287: निष्कण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A plant, (Capparis trifoliata,) &c.: see वरुणा.
22288: निष्कर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Exempt from or neglecting religious rites, worldly acts, &c. E. निर् neg. कर्म्मन् act.
22289: निष्करुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Cruel, unpitying, unmerciful. E. निर् neg. करुण compassionate.
22290: निष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Waned, diminished. 2 Impotent, seedless, barren. m. (-लः) 1 Pudendum muliebre. 2 A name of BRAHMA. 3 A fancied personification of BRAHMA, for religious ceremonies. f. (-ला or -ली) A woman past child bearing, in whom menstruation has ceased. E. निर् gone, lost, कल a part, &c.
22291: निष्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. निर् before कृष to plough, घञ् aff.
22292: निष्काम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Free from wish or desire. n. adv. (-मं) Unwillingly. E. निर् neg. काम desire.
22293: निष्कारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causeless, groundless. E. निर् neg. कारण cause.
22294: निष्कारुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Of a noble race, not degraded.
22295: निष्कालक m. (-कः) A penitent, shaved and smeared with Ghee.
22296: निष्काश m. (-शः) A portico, a veranda. E. निर्, and कश to go, घञ् aff.
22297: निष्काशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expelled: see the next.
22298: निष्कासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expelled, dismissed, turned out. 2 Gone forth or out, issued. 3 Placed, deposited. 4 Placed over, appointed, stationed. 5 Reviled, reproached. 6 Opened out, blown, expanded. E. निर् out, कस to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त, र becomes ष or Visarga: see निःकासित; also निष्काशित.
22299: निष्कासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Who or what expels. (-नी) A female slave not restrained by her master. E. निर् forth, कस to go, causal form, णिनि aff.
22300: निष्कुट m. (-टः) 1 A grove near a house. 2 A field. 3 A door. 4 The private apartments, the Zenana. (E. निर् without, कुट the house.) f. (-टा, also टिः or टी) Large cardamoms. E. निर out, कुट the shell or husk, aff. क, with टाप् fem. aff. or कि with ङीष् optionally added.
22301: निष्कुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A plant, commonly Danti. E. निर् forth, स्कुम्भ a Sautra root, to spread, aff. अच्; also निःकुम्भ.
22302: निष्कुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, extracted, forced or drawn out. E. निर् neg. कुष to extract, aff. क्त.
22303: निष्कुह m. (-हः) The hollow of a tree. E. निर् affirmative prefix, कुह to astonish, aff. अच्.
22304: निष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Regardless, negligent. 2 Disregarded, thought nothing of. 3 Pardoned. 4 Undone. E. निर् neg. कृत made.
22305: निष्कृति f. (-तिः) 1 Pardon, absolution. 2 Expiration. 3 Escaping from, avoiding the consequence of any thing. 4 Undoing, doing away. 5 Disregarding, neglecting. 6 Acquittance, compensation, discharge of a debt or obligation. E. निर् neg. कृति doing.
22306: निष्कोषण n. (-नं) 1 Taking away. 2 Extracting, extirpating. E. निर् before कुष to expel, aff. ल्युट्.
22307: निष्कोषितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taken away. E. निर् out, कुष to expel, तव्य aff.; also निष्कोषणीय.
22308: निष्क्रम m. (-मः) 1 Any intellectual faculty, as attention, comprehension, &c. 2 Degradation, baseness, inferiority of tribe, family, &c. 3 Going out, exit. E. निर् assuredly or forth, and क्रम going.
22309: निष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Going forth or out. 2 Taking a child for the first time out of the house, in the fourth month, considered as an essential ceremony, and accompanied by sacrifice, &c. E. निर् forth, क्रमण going.
22310: निष्क्रम्य ind. Going forth. E. निर्, क्रम to go, ल्यप् aff.
22311: निष्क्रय m. (-यः) Hire, wages. E. निर् before क्री to buy, aff. अच्.
22312: निष्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Gone out, gone, departed. E. निर् out, क्रम to go, aff. क्त.
22313: निष्क्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Abstaining from ceremonial rites. 2 Idle, unoccupied. n. (-यं) BRAHMA or the Supreme Spirit. E. निर् neg. क्रिया act.
22314: निष्क्वाथ m. (-थः) Broth, soup. E. निर् before क्वथ to decoct, aff. घञ्.
22315: निष्ट्य m. (-ष्ट्यः) A man of one of the outcast or barbarous tribes.
22316: निष्टप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Well done, dressed or cooked. 2 Burnished, made bright. E. निर्, and तप्त heated.
22317: निष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Staying, being in, who or what stays or is in or on any thing. 2 Believing, faithful. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 The catastrophe of a drama, the conclusion of a fable. 2 Conclusion in general, end, termination. 3 Disappearance, loss,  destruction. 4 Confirmation, completion. 5 Asking, begging. 6 Ordinary and uniform practice or profession. 7 Good conduct, excellence. 8 Religious practice, devout and austere exercise. 9 Faith, belief. 10 Condition, state. 11 Fixed time of life, &c. 12 Trouble, distress, anxiety. 13 The technical term for the past participial affixes क्त and क्तवतु. E. नि completely, assuredly, स्था to stay or stop, अङ् and टाप affs.
22318: निष्ठान n. (-नं) Sauce, condiment. E. नि before स्था to stay, aff. ल्युट्.
22319: निष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Firm, fixed. 2 Certain, ascertained. 3 Engaged in, attached to, devoted to. 4 Staying, being in or on. E. नि before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
22321: निष्ठीवन m. (-नं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. ल्युट्; also निष्ठेवन and निष्ठीव.
22322: निष्ठुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Harsh, contumelious, (as speech.) 2 Hard, solid. E. नि before स्था to be, to be firm, aff. कुरच्.
22323: निष्ठुरता f. (-ता) Harshness of speech, reviling, abuse. E. निष्ठुर, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, निष्ठुरत्व.
22324: निष्ठ्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cast, thrown, sent, directed, dispatched. 2 Ejected from the mouth, spit. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
22325: निष्ठ्यूति f. (-तिः) Spitting, spitting out. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject from the mouth, aff. क्त.
22326: निष्ठेव subst. mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. घञ्; also निष्ठीव.
22327: निष्ठेवन n. (-नं) Spitting. E. see the last; also निष्ठीव.
22328: निष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Skilful, &c. see the next.
22329: निष्णात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Skilful, clever, conversant, learned. 2 Perfect, superior, supreme. 3 (In law,) Agreed upon. E. नि before स्ना to bathe, aff. क्त; also with ड, निष्ण.
22330: निष्पक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Decocted, infused, boiled. E. निर् before पक्व ripe or cooked.
22331: निष्पङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Pure, free from mud or filth. E. निर् neg. पङ्क mud.
22332: निष्पतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Issuing, going forth or out. E. निर् before पत to go, शतृ aff.
22333: निष्पतन n. (-नं) Going forth or out, issuing. E. निर्, and पतन going.
22334: निष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Completion, conclusion, termination, consummation. 2 Birth, production. 3 Going forth or out. E. निर् negative, पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.
22336: निष्पन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Motionless. E. निर् not, स्पदि to shake or move, aff. अच्; also निष्पन्न.
22337: निष्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Done, finished, concluded, completed. 2 Born, produced. 3 Motionless. 4 Gone forth or out of. E. निर् affirmation or negation, and पन्न gone, from पद to go, aff. क्त.
22338: निष्पराक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Weak, destitute of power. E. निर् neg. पराक्रम valour.
22339: निष्परिग्रह m. (-हः) An ascetic, one who has no family nor dependants. E. निर् neg. परिग्रह dependants.
22340: निष्पादन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Doing, effecting, accomplishing. 2 Concluding. 3 Producing, causing, engendering. E. निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, aff. युच्.
22341: निष्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, effected, made, produced. E. निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, क्त aff.
22342: निष्पाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be done, to be effected or accomplished. E. निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, यत् aff.; also निष्पादनीय and निष्पादयितव्य.
22343: निष्पाद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being done or made, in the course of completion. E. निर् before पद to go, causal form, शानच् aff.
22344: निष्पान n. (-नं) Drinking. E. निर् before पान drinking.
22345: निष्पाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Certain, indubitable. m. (-वः) 1 Winnowing, cleaning corn, &c. 2 Wind, air. 3 The wind of the winnowing sieve or basket. 4 Straw, chaff. 5 A legume, a pod. 6 A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus radiatus.) E. निर् before पू to purify, aff. घञ्.
22346: निष्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ground, reduced to dust or powder. 2 Beaten, oppressed. E. निर्, and पिष्ट ground.
22347: निष्पुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः-त्त्रा-त्त्रं) Sonless. E. निर्, and पुन्त्र a son.
22348: निष्पुरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Feminine, neuter, not male. m. (-षः) 1 A eunuch or impotent man. 2 A coward. E. निर् neg. पुरुष a man.
22349: निष्प्रतिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Stupid, frigid, dull, apathetic, ignorant. E. निर् privative, प्रतिभ brilliance.
22350: निष्प्रत्यूह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Unobstructed, unimpeded. n. adv. (-हं) Freely, without hindrance. E. निर् neg. प्रत्यूह obstacle.
22351: निष्प्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gloomy, dark, obscure. E. निर् privative, and प्रभा light.
22352: निष्प्रयोजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Causeless, groundless. E. निर् negative, प्रयोजन motive, cause.
22353: निष्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Content, not envying any person, nor coveting any thing. f. (-हा) A plant; also अमूला and विष्णुघल्लभा. E. निर् not, स्पृहा envy, &c.
22354: निष्प्रवाण mfn. subst. (-णः-णी-णं) New and unbleached cloth. E. निर् gone, प्रकाणी here said to mean the weaver's brush; also निष्प्रवाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) the forms are irregular.
22355: निष्फल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Barren, unfruitful. 2 Seedless, impotent. f. (-ला or -ली) A woman past child bearing, one in whom menstruation has ceased: see निष्कल. E. निर् priv. and फल fruit.
22357: निसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 The natural state, nature, peculiar character or condition. 2 Form. 3 Creation. 4 Relinquishment, abandoning. 5 Transfer, barter. E. नि before सृज to create, or to abandon, aff. घञ्.
22358: निसर्गज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Cognate, innate. 2 Produced at creation. E. निसर्ग, and ज produced.
22359: निसिन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A shrub, (Vitex negundo;) it is also read निसिन्ध, and with कन् added निसुन्धक; the words are considered as barbarous: see सिन्धुवार.
22360: निसूदन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before षद to kill, aff, ल्युट्; also निषूदन.
22361: निसृता f. (-ता) A plant, commonly Teöri.
22362: निसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Delivered, deposited. 2 Centrical, middle. E. नि before सृज to go, aff. क्त.
22363: निसृष्टार्थ m. (-र्थः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador: one who decides upon his own discretion, knowing the intentions of both parties. E. निसृष्ट deposited, अर्थ meaning.
22364: निस्तनी f. (-नी) A pill, a bolus, a sort of force-meat ball. E. नि before स्तन a breast, ङीप् diminutive aff.
22365: निस्तरण n. (-णं) 1 Going out or forth. 2 Crossing over or passing. 3 Extraction, getting rid of or free from. 4 Means of success, an expedient, a plan. E. निर् before तॄ to cross or pass over, aff. ल्युट्.
22366: निस्तब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Paralysed, numbed. 2 Stopped, fixed. E. नि before स्तम्भ to stop, aff. क्त.
22367: निस्तर्हण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter. E. निर् before तृह to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
22368: निस्तल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Round, globular. 2 Trembling, shaking, moving. 3 Down, below. E. निर् negative or affirmative, and तल a support or stay; or depth, bottom.
22369: निस्तार m. (-रः) 1 Getting over or across. 2 Getting rid of, or away from, extraction, escape. 3 Acquittance, requital. 4 Means, expedient. 5 Final liberation. E. निर्, and तॄ to cross, घञ् aff.
22370: निस्तारवीज n. (-जं) The cause of final liberation, faith in any deity, &c. E. निस्तार, and वीज seed.
22371: निस्तितीर्षत् mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्) 1 Desirous or anxious to cross. 2 Wishing for salvation, or to traverse the world. E. निर् before तॄ to cross, desid. form, शतृ aff.
22372: निस्तुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Freed from the chaff, (corn, &c.) E. निर् neg. तुष chaff.
22373: निस्तुषक्षीर m. (-रः) Wheat. E. निस्तुष, and क्षीर milk.
22374: निस्तुषरत्न n. (-त्नं) Crystal. E. निस्तुष, and रत्न a gem.
22375: निस्तुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned, deserted. 2 Skinned, peeled. 3 Pared, made thin. E. निर् before तुष husk or skin, converted into a nominal verb, and क्त participial aff.
22376: निस्तेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Dull, obscure. 2 Dull, spiritless. 3 Powerless, impotent. E. निर् neg. तेजस् light, &c.
22377: निस्त्रंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Fearless, unapprehensive. E. निर् neg. त्रशि to fear, aff. अच्.
22378: निस्त्रिंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Merciless, unfeeling, unpitying. m. (-शः) A scimitar, a sacrificial knife. E. निर् forth, त्रिंशत् thirty, ड aff.; being of thirty finger's length, &c.
22379: निस्त्रिंशधारिन् m. (-री) A soldier armed with a sword. E. निस्त्रिंश, and धारिन् who bears.
22380: निस्त्रैगुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Destitute of the qualities, truth, passion, and darkness. E. निर् neg. त्रैगुण्य three qualities.
22381: निस्नाव m. (-वः) The remainder of articles, &c. after a sale or market.
22382: निस्पन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Still, steady, immoveable. m. (-न्दः) Throbbing, trembling. E. नि before स्पद to go, aff. अच्.
22383: निस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Content, unenvious. f. (-हा) 1 A plant, (Gloriosa superba.) 2 Contentment. E. नि neg. स्पृहा desire.
22384: निस्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Trickling, oozing, issuing. E. नि before स्यन्द to ooze, aff. अच्.
22385: निस्राव m. (-वः) The scum of boiled rice. E. नि before स्रु to ooze or drop, aff. घञ्.
22386: निस्वन m. (-नः) 1 Sound. 2 Silence. E. नि before स्वन to sound, aff. अप्.
22387: निस्वान m. (-नः) Sound. E. नि before स्वन with घञ् aff.: see the last.
22388: निहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, slain. E. नि affir. हत killing.
22389: निहनन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before हनन killed.
22390: निहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Murderous, who or what kills. E. नि before हन to kill, तृच् aff.
22391: निहन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Killed. E. नि, हन to kill, pass. v. शानच् aff.
22392: निहव m. (-वः) Calling, calling to. E. नि before ह्वे to call, अप् aff.
22393: निहाका f. (-का) An iguana or the Gangetic alligator. E. नि before हा to quit, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
22394: निहार m. (-रः) Frost, dew: see नीहार.
22395: निहिंसन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before हिंस to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
22396: निहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deposited, delivered, given, entrusted. 2 Applied to, bestowed upon. 3 Laid, (as dust by rain.) E. नि before घा to have, aff. क्त.
22397: निहीन m. (-नः) A low man, an outcast. E. नि before हीन abandoned.
22398: निह्नव m. (-वः) 1 Denial or concealment of knowledge, dissimulation, secrecy. 2 Concealment in general. 3 Mistrust, doubt, suspicion. 4 Wickedness. 5 A secret. E. नि before ह्नु to hide or secrete, aff. अच्.
22399: निह्नववादिन् m. (-दी) A defendant or witness who prevaricates or tries to hide the truth. E. निह्नव, and वादिन who speaks.
22400: निह्नवोत्तर n. (-रं) An evasive reply or defence. E. निह्नव, and उत्तर answer.
22401: निह्नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Concealed, secreted. 2 Denied, evaded. E. नि before ह्नु to secrete, aff. क्त.
22402: निह्नुति f. (-तिः) 1 Denial or concealment of knowledge, dissimulation, reserve, secrecy. 2 Hiding, concealment. E. नि before ह्नु to secrete, aff. क्तिन्.
22403: निह्नुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Insinuating, using double entendre. E. नि, ह्नु to secrete, शानच् aff.
22404: निह्राद m. (-दः) Sound. E. नि before ह्रद to sound, aff. घञ्.
22405: निह्रादवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sounding, making a noise. E. निह्राद, and मतुप् aff.
22406: नीक m. (-कः) The name of a tree. E. णी to gain, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
22407: नीकार m. (-रः) Disrespect, contempt, vilifying, degrading. E. नि before कृ to make, aff. अण्.
22408: नीकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) (In composition,) Like, resembling. m. (-शः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. नि before काश to shine, aff. घञ्, and the vowel made long.
22409: नीच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 1 Low, (in stature,) short, dwarfish. 2 Low, (in condition,) vile, base, mean. 3 Deep. E. न privative, ई good fortune, चि to obtain, aff. ड.
22410: नीचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Low, dwarfish, a dwarf. 2 Vile, low. f. (-का) An excellent cow. E. कन added to the preceding.
22411: नीचकिन् m. (-की) 1 The head or top of any thing. 2 The owner of a good cow.
22412: नीचकैस् ind. Low, below, little, vile, &c. E. नीचैस् low, अकच् inserted.
22413: नीचग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Low, vile, base. n. (-गं) Water. f. (-गा) A river. E. नीच low or deep, and ग who is going.
22414: नीचभोज्य m. (-ज्यः) An onion. E. नीच a low man, and भोज्य food.
22415: नीचिका f. (-का) A good cow; also नीचिकी and नैचिकी.
22416: नीचैस् ind. Little, small, low. E. नि before चि to collect, डैसि aff. and the vowel of नि made long.
22417: नीड mn. (-डः-डं) 1 A nest. 2 A place, a spot. E. नि before इङ् to go, aff. घञ्.
22418: नीडज m. (-जः) A bird in general. E. नीड a nest, and ज born.
22419: नीडोद्भव m. (-वः) A bird. E. नीड a nest, and उद्भव born.
22420: नीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well behaved, correct, modest. 2 Gained, obtained. 3 Led, conducted. n. (-तं) 1 Wealth. 2 Corn, grain. E. णी to get, &c. aff. क्त.
22421: नीति f. (-ती) 1 Guiding, directing. 2 Obtaining, acquirement, acquisition. 3 Polity, political science, treating especially of the administration of government, including the practice of morality in private life, both by the sovereign and his subjects. E. णी to guide or gain, aff. क्तिन्.
22422: नीतिकथा f. (-था) Any work on polity, or good government. E. नीति, and कथा a tale.
22423: नीतिकुशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Politic, conversant with government and human affairs. E. नीति, and कुशल able.
22424: नीतिघोष m. (-षः) The car of VṚHASPATI. E. नीनि guiding, and घोष sound.
22425: नीतिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing what is right, especially in government, sagacious, politic. (-ज्ञः) A statesman, a politician. E. नीति, and ज्ञ who knows.
22426: नीतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Moral, eminent for royal duties. E. नीति, and मतुप् aff.
22427: नीतिविद्या f. (-द्या) Political science. E. नीति, and विद्या knowledge.
22428: नीतिशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The science of political ethics, or any work treating of it. E. नीति, and शास्त्र a scripture.
22429: नीत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given, given away. E. नि before, दत्त given, form irr.
22430: नीत्वा ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Having passed or spent. E. णी to take, क्त्वा aff.
22431: नीथ m. (-थः) A guider, a leader. n. (-थं) Water. E. णी to guide, कथन् Uṇādi aff.
22432: नीध्र n. (-ध्रं) 1 The edge of a thatch. 2 A wood. 3 The circumference of a wheel. 4 The moon. 5 The constellation Revatī. E. नि before धृ to fall, &c. aff. क, and the vowel of the prefix made long: this is considered as a various reading also of नीब्र, q. v.
22433: नीप m. (-पः) 1 The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.) 2 A species of Ixora, (I. bandhuca, Rox.) 3 A sort of Aśoca or Nil Asoka. E. णी to obtain, (pleasure,) and प Uṇādi aff.
22434: नीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being sought or obtained. 2 Being led or conducted. 3 Being taken or taken away. E. नी to obtain, शानच् aff. यक् inserted.
22435: नीर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Juice, liquor. E. नी to obtain, aff. रक्.
22436: नीरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्त) Colourless, faded, having the colour taken out. E. निर् neg. रक्त red or dyed.
22437: नीरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatick. n. (-जः) 1 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) 2 A lotus in general. m. (-जः) An otter. E. नीर water, and ज born, or produced.
22438: नीरजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Free from dust. 2 Having no pollen, (as a flower.) f. (-जाः) A woman not menstruating. E. निर् neg. रजस् dust, &c. and इ made long before र.
22439: नीरजस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Free from dust. E. निर्, and रजस् dust, the इ made long by the dropping of the र.
22440: नीरजीकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cleansed, made free from dust. E. नीरजस्, and कारित caused, च्चि augment.
22441: नीरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Indifferent, not taking pleasure in. 2 Stopped, staying. E. नि neg. रत engaged in, इ made long.
22442: नीरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Toothless. m. (-दः) A cloud. E. नीर water, द what gives, or नि neg. रद a tooth.
22443: नीरदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Cloudy. E. नीरद, and इनि aff.
22444: नीरधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. नीर water, and धि having.
22445: नीरनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. नीर water, and निधि receptacle.
22446: नीरन्ध्र mfn. (-न्ध्रः-न्ध्रा-न्ध्रं) 1 Coarse, thick, gross, without interstices. 2 Entire, having no holes. 3 Imperforate. E. नी for निर् negative prefix, रन्ध्र a hole.
22447: नीरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Dry, withered, insipid, devoid of taste, &c. morally or physically. m. (-सः) The pomegranate. E. नी for निर् negative or affirmative prefix, and रस juice, flavour.
22448: नीराखु m. (-खुः) An otter. E. नीर water, and आखु a cat; the water-cat.
22449: नीराजन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Lustration of arms; a military and religious ceremony held on the 19th of Aśvin, and by kings or generals before taking the field; it is still observed by some Hindū states, under the name of Desahara. 2 Waving lights before an idol; but it may also be performed with a lotus, clean cloth, or the leaves of various sacred plants; prostration is also considered as the fifth kind of this sort of adoration. E. निर् completely, राज to shine, aff. युच्; or नीर water, and अजन going, sprinkling the arms, horses, &c. with water.
22450: नीरिन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A plant, (Trophis aspera.) E. नीर water, इन्दु the moon.
22451: नीरुच् mfn. (-रुक्) Dull, dim, faded. E. निर् neg. रुच् light, and इ made long.
22452: नीरुज् mfn. (-रुक्) Convalescent, well in health. E. नि privative, रुज disease.
22453: नीरुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Convalescent, well. n. (-जं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. नि implying opposition, (anti,) and रुज् disease.
22454: नीरुप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Formless, shapeless. n. (-पं) Heaven, æther. m. (-पः) 1 Air, wind. 2 GOD. E. निर् neg. रुप form.
22455: नील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Blue, dark blue or black. m. (-लः) 1 Black or dark blue, (the colour.) 2 The blue mountain, one of the principal ranges of mountains, dividing the world into nine portions, and lying immediately north of Hāvrata or the central division. 3 One of the monkey chiefs. 4 One of the Nidhis or divine treasures of KUVERA. 5 A gem, (the sapphire.) 6 A  name of the Buddha MAÑJUGHOṢA. 7 The blue or hill Maina, a bird so called. n. (-लं) 1 Indigo, the dye. 2 A mark, a characteristick mark. 3 A medical plant, apparently distinct form the Indigofera. 4 Blue vitriol. 5 Black salt. 6 Poison. 7 Antimony. f. (-ला) 1 A blue fly. 2 A Rāgiṇī or mode of music, personified as the wife of the Rāga Mallāra. f. (ली) 1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 A complaint of the eyes, a darkening of the pupil. 3 A bruise, a black and blue mark on the skin. E. नील to dye or tinge, क aff. or नीली indigo, अन् aff., implying being coloured or stained by it.
22456: नीलक m. (-कः) 1 The Nil Gao or slate coloured antilope, (A. picta.) 2 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) n. (-कं) 1 Blue steel. 2 Blue vitriol. 3 Black salt. E. कन् added to the preceding.
22457: नीलकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A gallinule. 3 A sparrow. 4 A wagtail. 5 A peacock. 6 Morunga, (Hyperanthera morunga.) 7 A blue jay. E. नील blue or black, and कण्ठ the throat; also कालकण्ठ.
22458: नीलकण्ठाक्ष n. (-क्षं) The Eloeocarpus seed. E. नीलकण्ठ ŚIVA, and अक्ष seed.
22459: नीलकमल n. (-लं) The blue lotus. E. नील, and कमल a lotus.
22460: नीलकुरुण्टक m. (-कः) Blue Barleria, (B. cærulea.) E. नील, and कुरुण्टक Barleria.
22461: नीलक्रौञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A sort of curlew or heron. E. नील blue, and क्रौञ्च a heron, &c.
22462: नीलग्रीव m. (-वः) A name of MAHĀDEVA. E. नील blue, and ग्रीवा neck; the neck of ŚIVA was stained blue by the acrimony of the poison, which, upon its production at the churning of the ocean, he swallowed.
22463: नीलङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) 1 An insect in general. 2 A sort of worm. 3 A Shakal. E. नि before लगि to go, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the इ of नि made long.
22464: नीलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the blue mountain, &c. n. (-जं) Blue steel. E. नील, and ज produced.
22465: नीलझिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) Blue Barleria. E. नील blue, and भिण्टी Barleria.
22466: नीलपङ्क n. (-ङ्कं) 1 Darkness. 2 Black mud. E. नील black, and पङ्क clay or mire.
22467: नीलपटल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very dark or black. E. नील, and पटल abundance.
22468: नीलपत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Having black or dark blue leaves. n. (-त्रं) The blue lotus. E. नील blue, and पत्र leaf.
22469: नीलपाचन n. (-नं) Steeping or maceration of indigo. E. नील, and पाचन cooking.
22470: नीलपाचनभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An indigo vat. E. नीलपाचन, and भाण्ड vessel.
22471: नीलपद्म n. (-द्मं) The blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea.) E. नील, and पद्म a lotus.
22472: नीलपिच्छ m. (-च्छः) A falcon. E. नील blue, and पिच्छ a tail.
22473: नीलपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A sort of Verbesina with blue flowers. f. (-ष्पी) A blue species of Rasan. E. नील blue, and पुष्प flower.
22474: नीलपुष्पिका f. (-का) The indigo plant. E. कन् added to नीलपुष्पी.
22475: नीलपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A sort of fish, commonly called Rohi, (Cyprinus denticulatus.) E. नील blue, पृष्ठ the back.
22476: नीलभ m. (-भः) 1 The moon. 2 A cloud. 3 A bee. E. नील blue or black, भा to shine, to show, aff. क.
22477: नीलमणि m. (-णिः) A gem of a blue colour, the sapphire. E. नील blue, and मणि a jewel.
22478: नीलमाधव m. (-वः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. नील, and माधव VIṢṆU, being of a dark colour.
22479: नीलमीलिक m. (-कः) A firefly. E. नील black or dark blue, मील to twinkle, aff. टक्.
22480: नीलमृत्तिका f. (-का) 1 Iron pyrites. 2 Black mould. E. नील, and मृत्तिका earth.
22481: नीललोह n. (-हं) Blue steel. E. नील blue, and लोह iron.
22482: नीललोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purple, of a purple colour. m. (-तः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A mixture of red and blue, purple. f. (-त्ता) A vegetable: see भूमिजम्बु. E. नील blue or black, and लोहित red.
22483: नीलवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Blue, of a blue colour. E. नील, and वर्ण colour.
22484: नीलवसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearing dark blue or black garments. m. (-नः) The planet Saturn. E. नील dark blue, and वसन vesture.
22485: नीलवस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Dressed in dark blue or black vesture. n. (-स्त्रं) Dark coloured cloth. m. (-स्त्रः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. नील, and वस्त्र clothes.
22486: नीलवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Dressed in dark blue clothes. m. (-साः) A name of Saturn. E. नील dark blue, वासस् raiment.
22487: नीलवृष m. (-षः) A dark coloured bull. E. नील, and वृष a bull.
22488: नीलाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A goose. E. नील, and अक्ष an eye, having dark blue eyes.
22489: नीलाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The Indian crane. 2 The blue jay. E. नील blue, and अङ्ग body.
22490: नीलाङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) 1 An insect in general. 2 A sort of insect. 3 A Shakāl. f. (-ङ्गुः) A gad-fly. E. see नीलङ्गु the penultimate being irregularly made long.
22491: नीलाञ्जन n. (-नं) Blue vitriol. f. (-ना) Lightning. E. नील blue, अञ्जन collyrium, &c.
22492: नीलाञ्जसा f. (-सा) 1 One of the Apsarasas or courtezans of Svarga. 2 The name of a river. 3 Lightning. E. नील dark, अञ्जस quickly, affs. अच् and टाप्.
22493: नीलाम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dressed in dark blue cloth. m. (-रः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 A demon, a goblin. 3 A name of ŚANI or Saturn. n. (-रं) Black or dark blue rainment. E. नील, and अम्बर clothing, &c.
22494: नीलाम्बुजन्मन् n. (-न्म) The blue lotus. E. नील, and अम्बुजन्मन् a lotus.
22495: नीलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Blue. m. (-भः) A cloud. E. नील, and आभ what shines.
22496: नीलाभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A dark cloud. E. नील, and अभ्र cloud.
22497: नीलाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) A blue stone, a sapphire. E. नील, and अश्मन् a stone.
22498: नीलिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Nyctanthes tristis;) a species with blue flowers. 2 The indigo plant. 3 A slight malady; black and blue marks on the body from bruises, &c. E. कन् added to नीली.
22499: नीलिनी f. (-नी) 1 Indigo, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 A black species of Tëori. E. नील black or dark blue, poss. aff. इनि fem. aff. ङीप्.
22500: नीलीराग m. (-गः) 1 A firm and constant friend. 2 Firm, unalterable attachment, (as that of RĀMA and SĪTĀ.) 3 Dark blue. E. नीली indigo, and राग colour; as permanent as the dye of indigo.
22501: नीलीसन्धान n. (-नं) Fermentation or maceration of indigo. E. नीली, and सन्धान fermentation.
22502: नीलीसन्धानभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An indigo vat. E. नीलीसन्धान, and भाण्ड vessel.
22503: नीलोत्पल n. (-लं) A blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea.) E. नील blue, and उत्पल a lotus.
22504: नीलोत्पलिन् m. (-ली) One of the Jaina saints or teachers.
22505: नीलोपल n. (-लं) A blue stone, lapis lazuli. E. नील, and उपल a stone.
22506: नीवर m. (-रः) 1 Trade, traffick. 2 A place, &c. proper for the site of a habitation. 3 A religious mendicant. n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Mud. E. णी to obtain, &c. ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.
22507: नीवाक m. (-कः) Dearth, scarcity. E. नि before वच to speak, aff. घञ्; creating alarm and causing conversation.
22508: नीवार m. (-रः) Rice growing wild or without cultivation. E. नि before वृ to be, aff. घञ्.
22509: नीवि f. (-विः-वी) 1 Capital, principal, stock. 2 Stake, wager. 3 A cloth round a woman's waist, or the ends of the cloth passed round the loins so as to hold the whole together; on being loosed the lower members are exposed: the tie of drawers worn by women, &c. 4 The outer tie of a packet, in which the offerings of a Śūdra at funeral obsequies are presented. E. नि before व्येञ् to cover, Uṇādi aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; the इ of नि is made long, and the radical finals rejected.
22510: नीवृत् mfn. (-वृत्) Any inhabited country. E. नि always, वृत to be, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel of the prefix made long.
22511: नीव्र n. (-व्रं) 1 The edge of a thatch. 2 The circumference of a wheel. 3 A wood. 4 The moon. 5 The constellation Revatī. E. नि certainly, वृ to be, aff. क, deriv. irr.; also नीध्र.
22512: नीशार m. (-रः) 1 A warm cloth, a blanket. 2 Curtains, musquito curtains. 3 An outer tent or screen. नि before शृ to hurt, &c. aff. घञ्, deriv. irr.
22513: नीहार m. (-रः) 1 Frost, hoar frost. 2 Heavy dew. E. नि before हृ to steal or take, aff. घञ्.
22514: नु ind. 1 A particle, of interrogation; 2 Of discrimination; 3 of reflexion. 4 Of doubt; 5 Of contempt; 6 Of pretence; 7 Of respect. 8 A particle implying cause or motive: (what, but, how, hum, or, either, &c. will in general express it.) E. नुद to go, or नु praise, &c. aff. डु.
22515: नु m. (-नुः) 1 A weapon. 2 Time. 3 A boat. 4 The nasal mark above the line in neuter nouns, &c. f. (नुः) Praise, eulogium, panegyrick. E. ण्णु to praise, &c. aff. क्विप्.
22516: नुड r. 6th cl. (नुडति) To hurt or kill.
22517: नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended. E. णु to praise, aff. क्त.
22518: नुति f. (-तिः) 1 Praise, eulogium, panegyrick. 2 Worship, reverence. E. णु to praise, क्तिन् aff.
22519: नुत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Sent, ordered, despatched. m. (-त्तः) A plant: see लकुच. E. णुद to send, aff. क्त; also नुन्न.
22520: नुनुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Desirous of removing. E. णुद to send, desid. v. उ aff.
22521: नुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Sent, thrown, despatched, cast, dismissed. E. णुद to send, aff. क्त, form irr.; also नुत्त.
22522: नूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 New. 2 Praised, eulogized, hymned. E. णु to praise, aff. क्त.
22523: नूतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) New, recent, fresh, young, &c. E. नव new, नू substituted for it, and तनप् aff.
22524: नूतनत्व n. (-त्वं) Newness, novelty. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, नूतनता.
22525: नूत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) New. E. नू substituted for नव new, त्नप् aff.
22526: नूद m. (-दः) The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.) E. णुद to send, क aff. and the deriv. irr.
22527: नूनम् ind. 1 Certainly, assuredly. 2 A particle of doubt or deliberation. 3 A reminiscent particle. 4 An expletive. E. नू a particle, नम to bow or bend, aff. विच्, deriv. irr.
22528: नूपुर mn. (-रः-रं) An ornament for the toes and feet. E. णु to praise or be praised. aff. क्विप्, नू an ornament, पुर to precede, aff. क.
22529: नृ r. 1st cl. (नरति) 5th cl. (नृणाति) To lead, to conduct, to guide, physically or morally.
22530: नृ m. (ना) 1 Man, individually or collectively, a man, mankind. 2 A piece at chess, &c. 3 A gnomon. E. णी to guide or gain, aff. डृन्.
22531: नृकेशरिन् m. (-री) The Nṛsiṃha or man-lion Avatar. E. नृ, and केशरिन् a lion.
22532: नृग m. (-गः) The name of a king, the son of IKṢVĀKU.
22533: नृचक्षस् m. (-क्षाः) A demon, a Rākṣasa, a goblin. E. नृ a man, and चक्षस् an eater; from चक्ष to eat, असुन् aff.
22534: नृजग्ध m. (-ग्धः) A man eater, a cannibal, a Rākṣasa. E. (by whom,) नृ man, जग्ध is eaten.
22535: नृत (ई) नृती r. 4th cl. (नृत्यति) To dance, to dance as an actor, to gesticulate, to act.
22536: नृति f. (-तिः) Dancing, the science or practice. E. नृत to dance, aff. कि.
22537: नृतू m. (-तूः) 1 A dancer, a mime, an actor. 2 Earth. 3 A worm. 4 Length. E. नृत to dance, and कू aff.
22538: नृत्त n. (-त्तं) Dancing. E. नृत to dance, aff. क्त.
22539: नृत्य n. (-त्यं) Dancing, acting, the actor's practice in general. E. नृत to dance, aff. क्यप्.
22540: नृत्यत् mfn. (-त्यन्-त्यन्ती-त्यत्) Dancing. E. नृत to dance, शतृ aff.
22541: नृदेव m. (-बः) A king. E. नृ, and देव a divinity.
22542: नृधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Acting as a man, doing a man's duty, &c. m. (-र्म्मा) A name of KUVERA. n. (-र्म्म) Manly property or duty. E. नृ man, धर्म्म virtue, अनिच aff.
22543: नृप m. (-पः) A king, a sovereign. E. नृ man, पा to protect, aff. ड.
22544: नृपनीति f. (-तिः) Royal policy. E. नृप, नीति policy.
22545: नृपति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 A king, a sovereign. E. नृ man, and पति a master.
22546: नृपद्रुम m. (-मः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. नृप, and द्रम a tree.
22547: नृपप्रिय m. (-यः) A thorny species of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.) E. नृप a king, and प्रिय fond of.
22548: नृपमन्दिर n. (-रं) A royal palace. E. नृप a king, and मन्दिर a residence.
22549: नृपमान m. (-नः) Sound of musick, made to give warning to kings when eating or feasting. E. नृप, and मान measure.
22550: नृपलक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) 1 The royal umbrella. 2 Any of the royal insignia. E. नृप a king, and लक्ष्मन् a mark or sign.
22551: नृपलिङ्ग n. (ङ्गं) Any emblem or mark of royalty. E. नृप, and लिङ्ग mark.
22552: नृपलिङ्गधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Assuming the insignia of sovereignty. 2 Taking, (fraudulently,) the emblem or marks of the royal or military caste. E. नृपलिङ्ग, and धर who has.
22553: नृपवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) A king's friend. f. (-भा) A queen. E. नृप, and वल्लभ beloved.
22554: नृपसंश्रय m. (-यः) Service of princes. E. नृप, and संश्रय dependance.
22555: नृपसभ n. (-भं) 1 An assembly of princes. 2 A palace. E. नृप a king, and सभा an assembly.
22556: नृपांश m. (-शः) Revenue, the royal portion; of grain, a sixth, eight, or twelfth; of fruits, &c. a sixth; and of merchandise a fiftieth. E. नृप, and अंश a part.
22557: नृपात्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Of royal birth. m. (-जः) A prince. f. (-जा) 1 A bitter gourd. 2 A princess. E. नृप a king, and आत्मज offspring.
22558: नृपाध्वर m. (-रः) A sort of sacrifice; the Rājasūya, held by a lord paramount, in which all the offices are performed by tributary princes. E. नृप a king, अध्वर a sacrifice.
22559: नृपाभीर n. (-रं) Music played at the royal meals.
22560: नृपामय m. (-यः) Consumption. E. नृप, and आमय disease.
22561: नृपावर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) A kind of gem. E. नृप, and आवर्त्त what revolves.
22562: नृपासन n. (-नं) A throne. E. नृप a king, and आसन a seat.
22563: नृपोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kingly, princely, suited to a king. E. नृप, and उचित proper.
22564: नृयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Hospitality. E. नृ a man, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
22565: नृवराह m. (-हः) The boar incarnation of VIṢṆU. E. नृ a man, वराह a boar; being delineated with the figure of a man, and the head of the wild boar.
22566: नृशंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Malicious, wicked, hurtful, injurious, mischievous, destructive. E. नृ man, शसि to hurt, aff. अण्.
22567: नृशंसवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Practising mischief. E. नृशंश, add वृत्त engaged in.
22568: नृसिंह m. (-हः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The fourth Avatāra or descent of that deity, in the shape of a man, with the head and claws of a lion. 3 A chief, a noble, a great or illustrious man. E. नृ a man, and सिंह a lion; applied in composition, also to signify pre-eminence.
22569: नृसेन nf. (-नं-ना) An army of men. E. नृ a man, and सेना an army.
22570: नृसोम m. (-मः) An illustrious or great man, a prince or chief. E. नृ mankind, and सोम the moon, here implying superiority or excellence.
22571: नृहरि m. (-रिः) VIṢṆU as the man-lion. E. नृ, and हरि a lion.
22572: नेजक m. (-कः) A washerman. E. णिज to cleanse, aff. वुन्.
22573: नेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taken, to be carried or conducted. E. णी to take, तव्य aff.
22574: नेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Leading, conducting, one who guides or leads, &c. m. (-ता) 1 A master, an owner. 2 A guide. E. णी to lead, aff. तृच्.
22575: नेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) A leader, a guide, one who guides or leads. n. (-त्रं) 1 The eye. 2 The root of a tree. 3 Bleached or wove silk. 4 A car, a carriage. 5 The string of a churning rope. 6 An enema pipe. mn. (-त्रः-त्रं) Any tubular vessel. f. (-त्री) 1 A river. 2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. E. णी to guide or gain, Uṇādi aff. ष्ट्रन्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
22576: नेत्रज n. (-जं) A tear. E. नेत्र, and ज born.
22577: नेत्रच्छद m. (-दः) An eyelid. E. नेत्र the eye, छद to cover, aff. अच्.
22578: नेत्रपर्य्यन्त mfn. (न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) As far as to the eye, up to the eye. m. (-न्तः) The outer angle of the eye. E. नेत्र, and पर्य्यन्त limitative.
22579: नेत्रपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A cat. 2 The ball of the eye. E. नेत्र the eye, and पिण्ड a ball of flesh, &c.
22580: नेत्रयोनि m. (-निः) 1 INDRA. 2 The moon. E. नेत्र an eye, and योनि the vulva; being covered with marks resembling that organ, through the curse of GAUTAMA, whose wife he had attempted to debauch; the sage afterwards relenting, changed these disgraceful marks on the body of the deity to as many eyes.
22581: नेत्ररञ्जन n. (-नं) Collyrium. E. नेत्र, and रञ्जन delighting.
22582: नेत्ररोग m. (-गः) Any disease of the eye. E. नेच, and रोग disease.
22583: नेत्रवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A veil over the eye. E. नेत्र, and वस्त्र clothes.
22584: नेत्रामय m. (-यः) Ophthalmia, &c. E. नेत्र, and आमय sickness.
22585: नेत्राम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A tear. E. नेत्र an eye, and अम्बु water.
22586: नेत्रोत्सव n. (-वं) Any pleasing or beautiful object. E. नेत्र, and उत्सव festival.
22587: नेत्रौषध n. (-धं) 1 Green sulphate of iron considered as a collyrium. 2 Collyrium in general. f. (-धी) A drug, commonly क्ॐगा. E. नेत्र the eye, and औषध a medicament.
22588: नेदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Approximating, bringing near. E. नेद for अन्तिक nom. verb, शतृ aff.
22589: नेदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Very near. 2 Clever. m. (-ष्ठः) A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) E. अन्तिक near, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, and the form irr.; also नेदीयस् with ईयसुन् aff.
22590: नेदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very near, nearest: see the last.
22591: नेन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Taking or obtaining frequently. E. णी to obtain, frequent. v., अच् aff.
22592: नेप m. (-पः) 1 The family priest. 2 Water. E. णी to guide, Uṇādi aff. प.
22593: नेपथ्य n. (-थ्यं) 1 A stage, or the part behind the scenes, the tiring room, &c. 2 Ornament, embellishment. E. णी to guide, विच् aff. and the vowel changed; ने the eye, or a chief, पथ्य proper, agreeable, grateful.
22594: नेपाल n. (-लः) The country of Nepal. E. ने a chief: see the last, and पाल cherishing.
22595: नेपालिका f. (-का) Arsenic. E. नेपाल, and कन् aff.
22596: नेम m. (-मः) 1 Time, period, season. 2 Term, boundary, limit. 3 Part, portion. 4 A fence, a boundary wall or hedge. 5 A  hole, a chasm. 6 Fraud, deceit. 7 Acting, dancing. 8 Other, different. 9 Evening. 10 Up, above. 11 A root. E. णी to gain, Uṇādi aff. मन्.
22597: नेमि f. (-मिः-मी) 1 The circumference of a wheel. 2 The framework for the rope of a well. m. (-मिः) 1 The twenty-second Jina or Jaina pontiff. 2 A sacred place, as Mathura. mf. (-मिः-मी) A tree, (Dalbergia Oujeiniensis). E. णी to gain or go, Uṇādi aff. मि.
22598: नेमिचक्र m. (-क्रः) A prince descended from PARĪKṢIT, who is said to have removed the capital of India to Kauśāmbī, after the inundation of Hastinapur.
22599: नेमिन् m. (-मी) A tree. E. नेमि the circumference of a wheel, इनि aff.; the wood being used for its manufacture.
22600: नेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) One of the officiating priests at a sacrifice. E. णी to lead or conduct the ceremonies, Uṇādi aff. तृच् and षुक augment.
22601: नैःश्रेयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to final emancipation, leading to it, effecting it, &c. E. निःश्रेयस, and अण् aff.
22602: नैःश्रेयसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to final emancipation, &c. E. निःश्रेयस, and ठक् aff.
22603: नैःस्नेह्य n. (-ह्यं) 1 Dryness, austerity. 2 Coldness, want of feeling or affection. E. निःस्नेह, and ष्यञ् aff.
22604: नैक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Many, various. E. न neg. एक one.
22605: नैकटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Near, being near. E. निकट, and ठञ् aff.
22606: नैकट्य n. (-ट्यं) Proximity, vicinage. E. निकट, and ष्यञ् aff.
22607: नैकभेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Various, multiform, manifold. E. नैक, and भेद kind.
22608: नैकरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Multiform. E. नैक, and रूप form.
22609: नैकषेय m. (-यः) A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin. E. निकषा the mother of the race, and ढक् aff.
22610: नैकृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Morose, harsh spoken. 2 Wicked, bad. E. निकृति, and ठक् aff.
22611: नैगम m. (-मः) 1 An Upaniṣad or portion of the Vedas. 2 A sectarian, not a heretic. 2 A trader, a merchant. 4 A citizen, a townsman. 5 Guiding, leading, directing. 6 A road, a way. E. निगम a religious obligation, aff. अण्.
22612: नैचिक n. (-कं) The head of an ox. f. (-की) A capital cow. E. नीचैस् low, down, चर to go, ठक् aff. and the radical finals rejected; also नीचिकी, &c.
22613: नैज mfn. (-जः-जी-जं) Own. E. निज, and अण् aff.
22614: नैत्य n. (-त्यं) Eternity, perpetuity. E. नित्य, and अण् aff.
22615: नैत्यक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Always, constant, indispensable. E. नित्य, and वुञ् aff.
22616: नैत्यिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Invariable, constant, perpetual, indispensable. E. नित्य, and ठक् aff.
22617: नैद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Sleepy, somniferous, relating or occurring in sleep. E. निद्रा, and अण् aff.
22618: नैधान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to a treasure, a nest, &c. f. (-नी) A boundary where some articles are buried and dug up. E. निधान a treasure, अण् aff.
22619: नैपाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Produced in Nepal. f. (-ली) 1 Double jasmine. 2 Red arsenick. 3 Śephālikā, (Nyctanthes tristis.) 4 Indigo. E. नेपाल Nepal, अण् and ङीप् affs.; brought from thence.
22620: नैपालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced in or brought from Nepal, &c. n. (-कं) Copper. E. नेपाल, and ठक् aff.
22621: नैपुण n. (-णं) Dexterity, cleverness, skill. E. निपुण skilful, aff. अण्; also with ष्यञ् aff., नैपुण्य n. (-ण्यं.)
22623: नैमित्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Occasional. n. (-कं) Occasional, periodical act or rite. E. निमित्त cause, ठक् aff.
22624: नैमित्तिककर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) An occasional ceremony, such as should be observed on the birth of a child, &c. E. नैमित्तिक, and कर्म्भ act; also नैमित्तिकक्रिया, &c.
22625: नैमिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Momentary, transient, in a twinkling. n. (-षं) The name of a forest. see नैमिषारण्य. E. निमिष, and अण् aff.
22626: नैमिषारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A wood celebrated as the residence of the Ṛṣis, to whom Sauti related the Mahābhārata. E. निमिष a twinkling of an eye, in which the sage GAURAMUKHA destroyed a sort of Asuras, and अण् aff. and अरण्य forest.
22627: नैमेय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange. E. नि before मि to measure, अच् aff. and अण् added.
22628: नैयग्रोध n. (-धं) The fruit of the Indian fig, &c. E. न्यग्रोध the fig tree, &c. and अण् aff.
22629: नैयङ्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made of the skin, &c. of the deer, called न्यङ्क. E. न्यङ्कु, and अण् aff.
22630: नैयत्य n. (-त्यं) Self-government or subjugation. E. नियत, and ष्पञ् aff.
22631: नैयमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) According to rule, regular, enjoined. E. नियम, and ठञ् aff.
22632: नैयायिक m. (-कः) A logician, a follower of the Nyāya or logical philosophy. E. न्याय the Nyāya system, and ठक् aff.
22633: नैरन्तर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Compactness, closeness, contiguity. E. निरन्तर, and ष्यञ् aff.
22634: नैराश्य n. (-श्यं) Despair. E. निराश, and ष्यञ् aff.
22635: नैरृत m. (-तः) 1 A demon, a fiend. 2 The ruler of the south-west quarter. f. (-ती) The south-west quarter. E. निरृति said to be a proper name, and अञ् aff.
22636: नैरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं) 1 Obsolete, uncommon, belonging to the glossary of the Vedas. 2 Acquainted with the terms of the Vedas. E. निरुक्ति, and अण् aff.
22637: नैर्गुण्य n. (-ण्यं) Absence of qualities or properties. E. निर्गुण, and ष्यञ् aff.
22638: नैर्मल्य n. (-ल्यं) Cleanness, purity. E. निर्मल, and ष्यञ् aff.
22639: नैल्य n. (-ल्यं) Blueness, darkness of colour. E. नील, and ष्यञ् aff.
22640: नैविड्य n. (-ड्यं) 1 Thickness, substance. 2 Closeness, compactness. 3 Continued sound. E. निविड thick, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
22641: नैवेद्य n. (-द्यं) An offering of eatable articles presented to a deity, which may afterwards be distributed to his ministers or worshippers, especially when it has been presented to any form of VIṢṆU. E. निवेद presenting, offering, ष्यञ् aff.
22642: नैवेशिक n. (-कं) A present to a Brahman who is a householder, a girl so given, or ornaments with her, &c. E. निवेश a house, aff. ठञ्.
22643: नैश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Nocturnal, relating to the night; or a person, &c. doing any thing by night. E. निशा night, and अण् aff.; also with ठञ् aff. नैशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं.)
22644: नैश्चित्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Certainty. 2 A fixed festival; as at birth, investiture, marriage, &c. E. निश्चित, certain, ष्यञ् aff.
22645: नैषध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Relating to NIṢADHA. m. (-धः) A name of NALA. E. निषध the country so called, aff. अण्,
22646: नैष्कर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्मां) 1 Abstinence or exemption from acts or their consequences. 2 The salvation obtained by abstraction in opposition to that obtained by works. E. निष्कर्म्मन्, and ष्यञ् aff.
22647: नैष्कशतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worth a hundred Niṣkas, bought with them, &c. E. निष्क, and शत a hundred, ठञ् aff.; also with सहस्र a thousand नैष्कसहस्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
22648: नैष्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought with, made of, &c. a Niṣka. m. (-कः) The mint-master. E. निष्क a weight of gold, and ठक् aff.
22649: नैष्कृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Wicked, evil doing, malignant. E. निष्कृति, and ठक् aff.
22650: नैष्ठिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to state or condition. 2 Belonging to the character or office of a perpetual student. 3 Firm, fixed. m. (-कः) The Brahman who continues with his spiritual preceptor, and always remains in the condition of the religious student. E. निष्ठा certainty, ठक् aff.
22651: नैष्ठुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Severity, cruelty. E. निष्ठुर, and ष्यञ् aff.
22652: नैसर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Natural, innate. E. निसर्ग nature, ठक् aff.
22653: नैस्त्रिंशिक m. (-कः) A swordsman, a soldier armed with a sword. E. निस्त्रिंश a sword, aff. ठक्.
22654: नो ind. No, not. E. णुद to command, aff. डो.
22655: नोधास् m. (-धाः) The name of a saint. E. नु to praise, असि Uṇādi aff. and धुट augment.
22656: नोपस्थातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Remote, far off. E. न negative, उप near, स्था to be, aff. तृच्.
22657: नौ f. (नौः) A boat, a vessel in general. E. नुद to send, Uṇādi aff. डौ.
22658: नौका f. (-का) A boat. E. कन् added to the preceding.
