22659: नौकादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) An oar, a paddle. E. नौका a boat, and दण्ड a stick.
22660: नौतार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Navigable, to be gone to or traversed in a vessel. E. नौ, and तार्य्य to be crossed.
22661: नौयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) A passenger, a freight, who or what goes in a boat or vessel. E. नौ, and यायिन् who goes.
22662: न्यक् ind. A particle of abuse or contempt. E. the neuter of न्यञ्च् used as a particle.
22663: न्यक्करण n. (-णं) Treating with disrespect or contempt. E. न्यक्, and करण making.
22664: न्यक्कार m. (-रः) Contempt, disrespect. E. न्यङ् little, low, कृ to make, aff. घञ्.
22665: न्यक्कारुका f. (-का) An insect found in ordure.
22666: न्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Whole, entire. 2 Low, inferior. m. (-क्षः) 1 A name of PARAŚURĀMA. 2 A buffalo. n. (-क्षं) 1 A hole. 2 Grass. E. नि before अक्ष a die, &c.
22667: न्यग्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of mean or inferior race. E. न्यक्, and जाति cast.
22668: न्यग्भावन m. (-नः) 1 Contempt. 2 Defiling. E. न्धक्, and भावन conceiving.
22669: न्यग्रोध m. (-धः) 1 The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 2 A fathom measured by the arms extended. 3 The Śami, (Mimosa albida.) f. (-धी) 1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.) 2 A medical plant, commonly Mohānā. E. न्यक् short, रुध to impede, aff. अण्.
22671: न्यङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 A deer. 2 The name of a saint or Muni. E. नि always, अञ्च to go, aff. कु.
22672: न्यङ्कुभूरुह m. (-हः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. न्यङ्कु a deer, and भूरुह a tree.
22673: न्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Low abuse. E. न्यङ्, and ग what goes or is.
22674: न्यञ्च् mfn. (न्यङ् नीची न्यक्) 1 Short, dwarfish. 2 Low, vile, contemptible, base. 3 Slow, lazy. 4 Whole, entire. E. नि prefixed to अञ्च to go, aff. क्विप्.
22675: न्यञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrown or cast down. E. नि before, अञ्चित gone.
22676: न्यय m. (-यः) Loss, expense, waste, destruction. E. नि before इ to go, aff. अच्.
22677: न्यर्ण्ण mfn. (-र्ण्णः-र्ण्णा-र्ण्णं) 1 Asked, solicited. 2 Gone. 3 Injured. E. नि, अर्द्द to ask, क्त aff.
22678: न्यसन n. (-नं) 1 Delivering, giving up. 2 Depositing. E. नि before अस to throw, ल्युट् aff.
22679: न्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Deposited, consigned, delivered. 2 Placed in or upon. 3 Applied to. E. नि before अस to throw or send, aff. क्त.
22680: न्यस्तशस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Unarmed, defenceless, having laid down or resigned weapons. m. (-स्त्रः) A deified progenitor. E. न्यस्त delivered, and शस्त्र a weapon.
22682: न्याद m. (-दः) Eating, feeding. E. नि before अद to eat, अण aff.
22683: न्याय m. (-यः) 1 Propriety, fitness. 2 The Nyāya doctrine, logic, logical philosophy. 3 Apposite illustration. 4 A complete argument or syllogism. 5 Policy, good government. E. नि certainly, इन् to go, aff घञ्.
22684: न्यायता f. (-ता) Fitness, propriety. E. तल् added to न्याय; also with त्व न्यायत्वं.
22685: न्यायसारिणी f. (-णी) A woman acting or judging rightly. E. न्याय propriety, सारिणी proceeding.
22686: न्यायाचार m. (-रः) A virtuous man. E. न्याय, and आचार observance.
22687: न्यायाधार m. (-रः) An example of virtue or propriety. E. न्याय, and आधार what upholds.
22688: न्यायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Right, fit. 2 Logical. E. न्याय, and इनि aff.
22689: न्याय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Right, proper, fit. E. न्याय, and यत् aff.
22690: न्यास m. (-सः) 1 A deposit, a pledge. 2 Deserting, abandoning. 3 Delivering, presenting. 4 Mental delivering, consigning or entrusting any thing to the mind. 5 Mental appropriation or assignment of various parts of the body to tutelary divinities, accompanied with certain prayers and gesticulations. E. नि before अस to throw or cast away, aff. घञ्.
22691: न्यासधारिन् m. (-री) The holder of a deposit, a mortgagee. E. न्यास, and धारिन् who has.
22692: न्युङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 1 Six-fold repetition of the triliteral name of God. 2 The Sāma Veda. 3 Pleasing, agreeable E. नि before उखि to go, aff. घ; it is also read न्युङ्ख.
22693: न्युब्ज mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं) 1 Crooked-backed, hump-backed. 2 Looking downwards. 3 Bent, crooked. 4 Convex. m. (-ब्जः) 1 Disease, sickness, pain. 2 A sort of ladle made of Kusa grass. n. (-ब्जं) 1 The fruit of the Kāmaraṅga, (Carambola averrhoa.) 2 A vessel used at Śrāddhas. E. न्युब्ज to be crooked, aff. घञ्.
22694: न्युब्जखड्ग m. (-ड्गः) A sabre, a crooked sword. E. न्युब्ज crooked, and खड्ग a sword.
22695: न्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Blameable, vile, wicked, despicable. 2 Less, deficient, defective. E. नि before ऊन less.
22696: न्यूनता f. (-ता) 1 Deficiency. 2 Inferiority. E. तल् added to न्यून also न्यूनत्व.
22697: न्यूनधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Ignorant, foolish. E. न्यून and धी intellect.
22698: न्यूनपञ्चाशद्भाव m. (-वः) An ideot. E. न्यून, and पञ्चाशत् fifty, भाव property, having but forty-nine properties of human nature.
22699: न्यूनाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Maimed, mutilated, imperfect. E. न्यून, and अङ्ग body.
22700: न्यूनाधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unequal, more or less. E. न्यून, and अधिक more.
22701: न्यूनाधिकविभाग m. (-गः) Unequal partition. E. न्यूनाधिक, and विभाग division.
22702: न्यूनेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Imperfect, wanting some organ; as blind, deaf, &c. E. न्यून, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
22703: न्रस्थिमालिन् m. (-ली) A name of ŚIVA. E. नृ man, अस्थि a bone, माला a necklace, and इनि poss. aff.; ornamented with a garland of human skulls. प
22704: प The twenty-first consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, corresponding to the letter P.
22705: प m. (पः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A prince, a ruler. 3 A leaf. 4 Drinking. E. पा to nourish, &c. aff. ड.
22706: पक्कण mn. (-णः-णं) The residence of low or outcast tribes. E. पच to cook, कण aff. and क substituted for च.
22707: पक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be cooked or dressed. 2 To be matured. 3 To be digested. E. पच to cook, &c. तव्य aff.
22708: पक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Cooking, ripening. 2 Fame, respectability. E. पच to cook, aff. क्तिन्.
22709: पक्तिशूल n. (-लं) Inflammation of the bowels, cholic. E. पक्ति, and शूल cholic.
22710: पक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Who or what ripens or cooks. m. (-क्ता) 2 The digestive faculty. E. पच to cook, &c. तृच् aff.
22711: पक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) The sacred fire to be maintained perpetually by the householder. E. पच to mature, Uṇādi aff. त्र.
22712: पक्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Ripe, ripened, matured, cooked. E. पच to cook, &c. aff. क्त्रि and मप् added.
22713: पक्त्वा ind. Having cooked, dressed, matured, &c. E. पच to cook, क्त्वा aff.
22714: पक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) 1 Mature, dressed, cooked, matured by nature or by art. 2 Fully matured, on the eve of rottenness or decay. 3 Perfect, come to perfection. 4 Able, shrewd, experienced, mature, as the understanding. 5 Grey, (the hair.) 6 Digested. E. पच to cook or ripen, व substituted for क्त aff.
22715: पक्वकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Cooking, maturing, who or what does so m. (-त्) The Nimb tree. E. पक्व ripe, and कृत् what makes; the leaves of the plant are applied to phlegmonoid swellings, to induce suppuration.
22716: पक्वकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Grey-haired. E. पक्व, and केश the hair.
22717: पक्वरस m. (-सः) Wine or vinous liquor. E. पक्व matured, रस juice.
22718: पक्ववारि n. (-रि) 1 Rice gruel. 2 Boiling water. 3 Distilled water. E. पक्व boiled, वारि water; also read पङ्कवारि.
22719: पक्वान्न n. (-न्नं) Dressed food. E. पक्व, and अन्न food.
22720: पक्वाशय m. (-यः) The abdomen, the stomach. E. पक्व, and आशय receptacle.
22721: पक्वेष्टका f. (-का) A burnt or baked brick. E. पक्व, and इष्टका a brick.
22722: पक्ष r. 1st and 10th cls. (पक्षति पक्षयति) 1 To take or accept. 2 To take a part or side.
22723: पक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The half of a lunar month or fortnight, comprising fifteen days. 2 A wing; (it is also neuter in this sense.) 3 The feather of an arrow. 4 A partisan. 5 A friend. 6 A side, a flank. 7 An army, forces. 8 A house. 9 An argument, a thesis, a position advanced, doctrine to be maintained. 10 Contradiction, opposition, rejoinder, reply. 11 The subject of an inference. 12 Alternative. 13 A tribe, a class. 14 The ash pit of a fire place. 15 A royal elephant. 16 (In composition with words signifying hair,) Quantity, as केशपक्ष much or abundant hair. 17 A bird. 18 A bracelet. 19 Purity, perfection. 20 A limb, a member. 21 A tail. 22 (In Arithmetic,) Side of an equation in a primary division. E. पक्ष to take, aff. अच् or पण to transact business, Uṇādi aff. स, and क substituted for the radical final.
22724: पक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A private or back door. 2 A side. 3 A sidesman, an associate, a confederate or partisan. E. कन् added to the preceding.
22725: पक्षचर m. (-रः) 1 The moon. 2 An elephant. 3 An attendant, a constant companion. E. पक्ष a fortnight, &c. चर who goes.
22726: पक्षज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in a fortnight, &c. m. (-जः) The moon. E. पक्ष a fortnight, and ज born.
22727: पक्षजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) The moon. E. पक्ष, and जन्मन् birth: see the last.
22728: पक्षता f. (-ता) 1 The nature or essential character of a proposition. 2 The taking up a side or argument. 3 Maintaining or defending a thesis. E. तल् added to पक्ष; also with त्व, पक्षत्वं.
22729: पक्षति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 The first day of the half month. 2 The root or insertion of a wing. E. पक्ष a fortnight, &c. तिन् aff. and ङीष् optionally added.
22730: पक्षद्वय n. (-यं) 1 A month. 2 Both sides of an argument, &c. E. पक्ष, and द्वय two.
22731: पक्षद्वार n. (-रं) A private entrance, an inner or back door. E. पक्ष a side, and द्वार a door.
22732: पक्षधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what has a part or side, a wing, &c. m. (-रः) 1 The moon. 2 A bird. 3 A partisan. E. पक्ष a half month, धर who has.
22733: पक्षपात m. (-तः) 1 Adopting a side or an argument whether right or wrong, partisanship. 2 A partisan, an adherent, who or  what sides with. 3 The moulting of birds considered to proceed from fever. E. पक्ष, and पात who causes to go, or पक्ष a wing, and पात falling.
22734: पक्षपातिता f. (-ता) Adherence, friendship, fellowship. E. पक्षपातिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पक्षपातित्वं.
22735: पक्षपातिन् m. (-ती) A partisan, a friend, an adherent. E. पक्षपात, and इनि aff.
22736: पक्षपालि m. (-लिः) A private or back door. E. पक्ष a side, and पालि a point, &c.
22737: पक्षभाग m. (-गः) 1 The side or flank of an elephant. 2 The side in general. E. पक्ष the side, and भाग a part.
22738: पक्षमूल n. (-लं) The root or articulation of a wing. E. पक्ष a wing, and मूल a root.
22739: पक्षवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Winged. 2 Having a side or party. E. पक्ष, and मतुप् aff.
22740: पक्षवाहन m. (-नः) A bird. E. पक्ष a wing, and वाहन vehicle.
22741: पक्षविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A heron. E. पक्ष a feather, and विन्दु a spot.
22742: पक्षस m. (-सः) A wing. E. पक्ष as above, असि aff.
22743: पक्षसुन्दर m. (-रः) A sort of tree, commonly Lodh. E. पक्ष a part, सुन्दर handsome.
22744: पक्षाघात m. (-तः) 1 Refutation, confuting. 2 Palsy, hemiplegia. E. पक्ष, and आघात a blow.
22745: पक्षान्त m. (-न्तः) The fifteenth and last day of either half month, new or full moon. E. पक्ष a fortnight, and अन्त end.
22746: पक्षान्तर n. (-रं) Another side or part, another view of the argument. E. पक्ष, and अन्तर difference.
22747: पक्षाभास m. (-सः) 1 A seeming or fallacious argument. 2 A false plaint. E. पक्ष, and आभास semblance.
22748: पक्षालु m. (-लुः) A bird. E. पक्ष a wing, आलुच् poss. aff.
22749: पक्षावसर m. (-रः) The last day of either half month, new or full moon. E. पक्ष a fortnight, and अवसर conclusion.
22750: पक्षिन् mf. (-क्षी-क्षिणी) A bird. m. (-क्षी) An arrow. f. (-णी) 1 A night and two days. 2 Day of full moon. 3 A female fiend, also called Pūtanā. E. पक्ष a wing, and इनि poss. aff.
22751: पक्षिपाणीयशालिका f. (-का) A trough for watering birds, cattle, &c. E. पक्षिन् a bird, पाणीय water, शाला a hall, and कन् diminutive aff.
22752: पक्षिराज m. (-जः) King of the birds, usually applied to Garuḍa. E. पक्षिन्, and राज for राजा king.
22753: पक्षिल m. (-लः) A name of the saint VĀTSYĀYANA. E. पक्ष to take, इलच् aff.
22754: पक्षिशावक m. (-कः) A young bird. E. पक्षिन्, and शावक a young animal.
22755: पक्षिशाला f. (-ला) A nest, an aviary. E. पक्षिन् a bird, शाला a hall or house.
22756: पक्षिसिंह m. (-हः) A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. पक्षि for पक्षिन् a bird, सिंह pre-eminent.
22757: पक्षिस्वामिन् m. (-मी) GARUḌA. E. पक्षि, and स्वामिन् lord: see the last.
22758: पक्षोद्ग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Showing partiality, taking a side. E. पक्ष, and उद्ग्राहिन् taking.
22759: पक्ष्णु mfn. (-क्ष्णुः-क्ष्णुः-क्ष्णु) Who or what cooks or matures. E. पच to ripen, स्नु aff.
22760: पक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) 1 An eye-lash. 2 The filament of a flower. 3 The point of a thread. 4 A wing. E. पक्ष to take, मनिन् aff.
22761: पक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 Produced or occurring in a fortnight. 2 Belonging to a side, &c. E. पक्ष, and यत् aff.
22762: पङ्क mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्कं) 1 Mud, mire, clay. 2 Sin. E. पचि to spread, aff. घञ् and च changed to क.
22763: पङ्ककर्व्वट m. (-टः) Soft mud, especially such as is left by the retiring of floods, or on the banks of a river, a marsh, a quagmire. E. पङ्क mud, कर्व्वट the capital of a district.
22764: पङ्ककीर m. (-रः) A lap-wing. E. पङ्क mud, and कीर a parrot.
22765: पङ्कक्रीड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Wallowing, sporting in mud. m. (-डः) A pig. E. पङ्क mud, and क्रीड who sports.
22766: पङ्कगडक m. (-कः) A small fish, (Macrognathus Pancalus, HAM.) E. पङ्क mud, and गडक another fish.
22767: पङ्कगति f. (-तिः) The Pancāl fish: see the last. E. पङ्क mud, and गति going.
22768: पङ्कग्राह m. (-हः) The Makara, a marine monster. E. पङ्क mud, and ग्राह a shark.
22769: पङ्कज n. (जं) A lotus. E. पङ्क mud, ज born.
22770: पङ्कजन्मन् n. (-न्म) A lotus. E. पङ्क mud, and जन्मन् birth; also पङ्केज, &c.
22771: पङ्कजिनी f. (-नी) A pool or pond where the lotus grows, or a place abounding with that flower. 2 The flexible stalk of a water-lily. E. पङ्गज a lotus, इनि and ङीष् affs.
22772: पङ्कण m. (-णः) The residence of the lowest and most impure tribes. E. पचि to spread, युच् aff.
22773: पङ्कता f. (-ता) Muddiness, the nature or property of mud. E. तल् added to पङ्क; also with त्व, पङ्कत्व.
22774: पङ्कधूम m. (-मः) One of the divisions of hell. E. पङ्क, and धूम smoke.
22775: पङ्कप्रभा f. (-भा) A hell, the hell of mud or mire. E. पङ्क, and प्रभा light.
22776: पङ्कभाज् mfn. (-क् or -ग्) Sunk in the mire. E. पङ्क, and भाज् what shares.
22777: पङ्कभारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Muddy, laden with mud. E. पङ्क, and भारक burthened.
22778: पङ्कमण्डुक m. (-कः) A bivalve shell. E. पङ्क mire, मडि to ornament, aff. उक.
22779: पङ्करुह् n. (-रुट्) A lotus. E. पङ्क mud, रुह to grow, aff. क्विप्; also with क aff. पङ्करुह n. (-हं.)
22780: पङ्कवास m. (-सः) A crab. E. पङ्क, and वास abode.
22781: पङ्कशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A cockle. E. पङ्क mud, शुक्ति an oyster.
22782: पङ्कसूरण m. (-णः) The fibrous root of a lotus. E. पङ्क mud, and सूरण a sort of root; also written पङ्कशूरण, and पङ्कसूरण.
22783: पङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 An aquatick plant, (Vallisneria.) 2 A bridge or raised bank, forming a path amidst inundated fields. 3 Stairs, steps. 4 An aquatick plant, (Trapa bispinosa, Rox.) E. पङ्क mud, ऋ to go, घञ् aff.
22784: पङ्किल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Muddy, clayey. m. (-लः) A boat, a canoe. E. पङ्क mud, इलच् aff.
22785: पङ्केज n. (-जं) A lotus. E. पङ्के in mud, and ज born; also पङ्कज.
22786: पङ्केरुह n. (-हं) A lotus. m. (-हः) The Indian crane. E. पङ्के in mud, and रुह what grows; also पङ्करुह.
22787: पङ्क्ति f. (-ङ्क्तिः-ङ्क्ती) 1 A line, a row or range. 2 A sort of metre, a stanza of four lines, each line consisting of ten syllables. 3 The number ten, (in composition, ut infra.) 4 The earth, 5 Fame, celebrity. 6 Cooking, maturing. 7 Associating with,  eating or sitting with, especially with persons of the same caste. 8 A company, a society, an assembly. E. पचि to spread, to extend, to make evident, and क्तिन् aff. or पच to cook, deriv. irr.
22788: पङ्क्तिग्रीव m. (-वः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. पङ्क्ति ten, ग्रीवा a neck; the ten-necked.
22789: पङ्क्तिचर m. (-रः) An ospray. E. पङ्कृ, and चर who goes.
22790: पङ्क्तिदूषक m. (-कः) An improper person to associate with, an outcast. E. पङ्कृ, and दूषक who spoils.
22791: पङ्क्तिपावन m. (-नः) A respectable or eminent person. E. पङ्कृ, and पावन who purifies.
22792: पङ्क्तिरथ m. (-थः) DAŚARATHA, the father of RĀMA. E. पङ्क्ति ten, and रथ a car.
22793: पङ्गु mfn. (-ङ्गुः-ङ्गुः-ङ्गु) Lame, crippled, halt, one who has lost his legs, &c. m. (-ङ्गुः) The planet Saturn. E. पण to engage in business, उ aff., and अङ्गु substituted for the radical final.
22794: पङ्गुल m. (-लः) A horse of a glassy or silvery white colour.
22795: पङ्गुग्राह m. (-हः) One of the signs of the zodiac: see मकर.
22796: पङ्गुता f. (-ता) Deformity, mutilation. E. तल् added to पङ्गु.
22797: पच (डु, ष्) डुपचष् r. 1st cl. (पचति) To mature by cooking or ripening, to boil, to dress, to ripen; (इ) पचि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पंचति-ते पंचयति) 1 To make evident or apparent. 2 To represent, to state fully. 3 To spread.
22798: पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) Who or what cooks, matures, &c. m. (-चः) Cooking, maturing, &c. E. पच to cook, aff. अच्.
22799: पचक m. (-कः) A cook. E. पच to cook, वुन् aff.
22800: पचत् mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्) Cooking, ripening. E. पच to cook, participial aff. शतृ.
22801: पचत m. (-तः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 A name of INDRA. E. पच to cook or ripen, Uṇādi aff. अतच्.
22802: पचतिकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) or adv. n. (-ल्पं) Almost cooked or ripened. E. पचति what cooks, and कल्प aff.; implying incompleteness; also in a similar sense पचतिदेश्य and पचतिदेशीय.
22803: पचत्पुट m. (-टः) A tree, (Hibiscus phæniceus.) E. पचत् here said to mean the sun, and पुट to shine, aff. क.
22804: पचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं) What books or matures, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Cooking, dressing, boiling. 2 Maturing. m. (-नः) Fire. E. पच to cook, aff. युच् or ल्युट्.
22805: पचमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cooking, in the act of cooking or ripening. E. पच to cook, &c. and शानच् aff., मुक् augment.
22806: पचम्पचा f. (-चा) A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.) E. पच to cook, reiterated, अच् aff. and मुम् inserted; it is also read पचम्बचा.
22807: पचा f. (-चा) Cooking, dressing, maturing, ripening. E. पच to dress, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
22808: पचि m. (-चिः) 1 Fire. 2 Cooking, maturing. E. पच to be cooked, (by it,) इन् Uṇādi aff.
22809: पचेलिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Fit to cook or ripen of itself. m. (-मः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. पच to dress or ripen, केलिमन् aff. of the reflective form, or Uṇādi aff. एलिमन्.
22810: पचेलुक m. (कः) A cook. E. पच, and एलुक aff.
22811: पच्छस् ind. Foot by foot, or stanza by stanza. E. पत् for पाद, and शश् aff. of several orders.
22812: पच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being in the act of ripening. cooking &c. E. पच to cook, pass. v., शानच् aff.
22813: पज्ज m. (-ज्जः) A Śūdra. E. पत् for पाद a foot, and ज born, from the feet of BRAHMĀ.
22814: पञ्चक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Five or relating to five, made of five, bought with five, &c. m. (-कः) Any collection or aggregate of five, a five. n. (-कं) A field of battle. E. पञ्च five, and कन् aff.
22815: पञ्चकपाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A particular ceremony in which ghee is offered in five cups. E. पञ्च five, कपाल a concave piece of pottery skull-shaped.
22816: पञ्चकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Five actions of the body, vomiting, evacuation by bleeding or by stool, diseased excretion of fæces or purging, and blowing the nose. E. पञ्च five, कर्म्मन् an act.
22817: पञ्चकृत्वस् ind. Five times. E. पञ्च, and कृत्वसुच् aff.
22818: पञ्चकोण m. (-णः) A pentagon. E. पञ्च, and कोण an angle.
22819: पञ्चकोल n. (-लः) The aggregate of five spices, viz. Long pepper, its root, Chai or Piper Cavya, Plumbago, and dry ginger. E. पञ्च five, and कोल pepper.
22820: पञ्चकोषा m. plu. (-षाः) The five sheathes supposed to invest the soul, or the Annamaya koṣa that supported by food the gross form; the Prāṇamaya koṣa, the organs of action; the Manomaya koṣa, the organs of perception, with the manas or mind; the Vijñānamaya, the same with the Buddhi or intellect; and the Ānandamaya, consisting of the elements of identity and divine wisdom. E. पञ्च, and कोष a sheath.
22821: पञ्चखद्व nf. (-द्वं-द्वी) A collection of five beds. E. पञ्च five, and खद्वा bed.
22822: पञ्चगव n. (-वं) A collection of five cows. E. पञ्च, and गौ a cow.
22823: पञ्चगवधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having five cows. E. पञ्चगव, and धन wealth.
22824: पञ्चगव्य n. (-व्यं) Five articles derived from the cow; milk, curds, clarified butter, cow's urine, and cow-dung. E. पञ्च five, and गव्य, from गौ a cow.
22825: पञ्चगुण mf. (-णः-णा-णं) Five times, five-fold. E. पञ्च, and गुण multiplying.
22826: पञ्चगुप्त m. (-प्तः) 1 A tortoise, a turtle. 2 The atheistical system of the Bauddhas. E. पञ्च five, (members, &c.) गुप्त concealed.
22827: पञ्चगो mfn. (-गौः-गौः-गु) Bought with five cows. E. पञ्च, and गो a cow.
22828: पञ्चचामर n. (-रं) A form of metre, in which the line contains sixteen syllables.
22829: पञ्चचीर m. (-रः) A Bauddha saint and legislator; also named MAÑJUGHOṢA, apparently the teacher of this doctrine in Nepal. E. पञ्च spreading, चीर rags.
22830: पञ्चचूडा f. (-डा) One of the nymphs of heaven. E. पञ्च, and चूडा a top knot.
22831: पञ्चजन m. (-नः) 1 Man in general, a man. 2 The name of a demon, whose bones became the Conch, Pāñcajanya, the shell of KṚṢṆA. f. (-नी) An assemblage of five persons. E. पञ्च five, (elements,) and जन who is born.
22832: पञ्चजनीन m. (-नः) 1 An actor, a mimic, a buffoon. 2 The chief of five men. E. पञ्च five, and जन a man, or पञ्चजन man, and ख aff.
22833: पञ्चज्ञान m. (-नः) A Buddha or Bauddha sanctified teacher. E. पञ्च five, (organs,) and ज्ञान knowledge.
22834: पञ्चत् mfn. (-ञ्चत्) Five. E. पचि to spread, अति aff.
22835: पञ्चतक्ष nf. (-क्षं-क्षी) An assemblage of five carpenters. E. पञ्च, and तक्ष a carpenter.
22836: पञ्चतत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 The five elements collectively. 2 (In the Tantras,) The five essentials of certain rites; or wine, meat, fish, sexual intercourse, and mystic gesticulations. E. पञ्च, and तत्व an element.
22837: पञ्चतन्मात्र n. (-चं) The five subtile rudiments of the five elements. E. पञ्च, and तन्मात्र element.
22838: पञ्चतपस् m. (-पाः) An ascetic, who, in the hot weather, sits amongst four fires, and has the sun for the fifth. E. पञ्च, and तपस् penance.
22839: पञ्चतय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Having five parts or limbs. 2 Five. E. पञ्च five, and तयप् aff.
22840: पञ्चता f. (-ता) 1 Death, dying, i. e. the separation of the five elements of whose aggregate the body consists. 2 The nature or condition of five, the aggregate of five or five times. 3 The five elements collectively, earth, air, fire, water, and Ākāśa. E. पञ्च five, and तल् abstract aff.
22841: पञ्चतीर्थी f. (-र्थी) 1 Any five principal places of pilgrimage, especially Viśrānti, Saukara, Naimiṣa, Prayāga, and Puṣkara. 2 Bathing on the day of the equinox. E. पञ्च, and तीर्थ a shrine.
22842: पञ्चत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Death. 2 The state or being of five. 3 The coexistence of the five elements. 3 An aggregate, &c. of five. E. पञ्च five, and त्व aff.: see पञ्चता.
22843: पञ्चथु m. (-थुः) 1 Time. 2 The Koil or Indian cuckoo.
22844: पञ्चदश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Fifteen or fifteenth. f. (-शी) The fifteenth day of a half month, full or new moon. E. पञ्च five, दशन् ten, aff. डत्.
22845: पञ्चदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Fifteen. E. पञ्च five, and दशन् ten.
22846: पञ्चदीर्घ m. (-र्घः) Marks on five parts of the body, the arms, eyes, belly, nose, and breast.
22847: पञ्चधा ind. In five ways, five-fold. E. पञ्चन् five, and धा aff.
22848: पञ्चन् mfn. plu. (-ञ्च) Five. E. पचि to spread, Uṇādi aff. अन्.
22849: पञ्चनख m. (-खः) 1 An elephant. 2 A tortoise. 3 A tiger. 4 Any animal having five toes or claws. f. (-खी) A lizard. E. पञ्च five, नख nail.
22850: पञ्चनद m. (-दः) The Panjab, or country of five rivers, viz. the Śatadru, Vipāśā, Irāvatī, Candrabhāgā and Vitastā. E. पञ्च, नदी a river, ट aff.
22851: पञ्चनिम्ब n. (-म्बं) Five parts of the Nimb tree; the flowers, fruit, leaves, bark, and root. E. पञ्च five, and निम्ब the Nimb, (Melia azadiracta.)
22852: पञ्चनी f. (-नी) A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, chess, &c. E. पञ्च five, नी to get, aff. क्विप्.
22853: पञ्चनीराजन n. (-नं) Waving four things before an idol; a lamp, a lotus, cloth, a mango or betel leaf, and then falling prostrate. E. पञ्च, and नीराजन presentation.
22854: पञ्चपञ्चनख m. (-खः) Five kinds of animals allowed to be killed and eaten, the hare, porcupine, alligator, rhinoceros, and tortoise. E. पञ्च, and पञ्चनख a five-toed animal.
22855: पञ्चपल्लव n. (-वं) The aggregate of five sprouts; viz. of the spondias, rose-apple, Bel or marmelos, citron, and wood-apple. E. पञ्च five, and पल्लव a new shoot.
22857: पञ्चपाच n. (-त्रं) 1 Five plates collectively. 2 A Śrāddha in which offerings are made in five vessels. E. पञ्च five, and पात्र a vessel.
22858: पञ्चप्रसाद m. (-दः) A temple with four pinnacles and a steeple. E. पञ्च, and प्रसाद a palace.
22859: पञ्चप्राण m. plu. (-णाः) The five airs supposed to be in the body, and necessary to life. E. पञ्च, and प्राण vital air.
22860: पञ्चबन्ध m. (-न्धः) A fine equal to the fifth part of any thing lost or stolen. E. पञ्च five, and बन्ध binding.
22861: पञ्चभद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 A horse with five auspicious marks; or spotted on the chest, back, face, and flanks. 2 A sauce or condiment of five vegetables. E. पञ्च five, and मद्र fortunate.
22862: पञ्चभूत n. (-तं) The five elements; earth, air, fire, water, Ākāśa. E. पञ्च, and भूत an element.
22863: पञ्चभूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) Man as formed of the five elements. E. पञ्चभूत, and आत्मन् one with.
22864: पञ्चम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) 1 Fifth. 2 Beautiful, pleasing. 3 Dexterous, clever. m. (-मः) 1 One of the seven musical notes; the seventh, called Pañcama, from being said to be formed by air drawn from five places; the navel, the breast, the heart, throat, and forehead. 2 One of the Rāgas or modes of music. f. (-मी) 1 A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the five Pāṇḍus. 2 A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, &c. a chess board. 3 The fifth day of a half month. E. पञ्चन् five, and डट् aff. with मट् augment.
22865: पञ्चमकार n. (-रं) The five essentials of the left hand Tantra ritual; Madya wine, Māṃsa flesh, Matsya fish, Maithuna copulation, Mudrā gesticulation. E. पञ्च, and मकार the letter M,; all beginning with that letter.
22866: पञ्चमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having the fifth of any thing. E. पञ्चम, and मतुप् aff.
22867: पञ्चमहायज्ञ m. plu. (-ज्ञाः) The five great sacraments of the Hindus, or the worship of spirits, progenitors, gods, Vedas, and mankind, by offerings of perfumes and flowers, obsequial rites, oblations with fire, the study of the Vedas, and hospitality. E. पञ्च five, महा great, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
22868: पञ्चमार m. (-रः) The son of BALADEVA.
22869: पञ्चमाषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of five Māṣas, relating to, worth, amounting to five Māṣas. E. पञ्च, माष a measure of silver, ठक् aff.
22870: पञ्चमास्य m. (-स्यः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. पञ्चम the musical note, and आस्य mouth.
22871: पञ्चमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Being in the fifth year of one's age. E. पञ्चम, and इनि aff.
22872: पञ्चमुख m. (-खः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A lion. E. पञ्च five, and मुख face.
22873: पञ्चमुद्रा f. (-द्रा) Five gestures to be made in the usual presentation of offerings to an idol. E. पञ्च, and मुद्रा gesture.
22874: पञ्चमूत्र n. (-त्रं) The urine of the cow, goat, sheep, buffalo, and ass. E. पञ्च, and मूत्र urine.
22875: पञ्चमूल n. (-लं) The assemblage of five roots, the Bel, Premna longifolia, Cassia, Gmelina arborea, and the Trumpet flower. f. (-ली) A similar aggregate of five roots, considered as the smaller one, viz. Hedysarum gangeticum, H. lagopodioides, Solanum melongena, S. jacquini, and Tribulus lanuginosus. E. पञ्च five, मूल a root; the fem. aff. has a diminutive import.
22876: पञ्चयज्ञ m. plu. (-ज्ञाः) The five rites of a house-keeper: see पञ्चमहायज्ञ. E. पञ्च, and यज्ञ a sacrifice.
22877: पञ्चरत्न n. (-त्नं) A collection of five precious objects; or gold, a diamond, a pearl, a ruby, an amethyst. E. पञ्च, and रत्न a gem.
22878: पञ्चरसा f. (-सा) Emblic myrobalan. E. पञ्च five, रस flavour, taste.
22879: पञ्चलक्षण n. (-णं) A Purāṇa or mythological poem. E. पञ्च five, and लक्षण a mark; a Purāṇa should comprehend five topics; the creation of worlds, their destruction and renovation, the genealogy of gods and heroes, the reigns of the MANUS, and the actions of their descendants.
22880: पञ्चलवण n. (-णं) Five kinds of salt. E. पञ्च, and लवण salt.
22881: पञ्चलाङ्गलक n. (-कं) Gift of land to the extent requiring five ploughs. E. पञ्च, लाङ्गल a plough, कन् aff.
22882: पञ्चलोह n. (-हं) A metallic alloy containing five metals; copper, brass, tin, lead, and iron. E. पञ्च five, and लोह iron.
22883: पञ्चवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A lion. E. पञ्च five, and वक्त्र a face.
22884: पञ्चवट m. (-टः) The Brahminical thread as worn across the breast; also पञ्चावट. f. (-टी) 1 Five trees, the Indian and holy fig, the Bel, Grislea tomentosa, and Asoka, placed or planted in several quarters; or east, west, north, south and south-east. 2 Part of the great southern forest where the Godāvarī rises. E. पञ्च, and वट the Indian fig.
22885: पञ्चवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class of five persons or things. E. पञ्च, and वर्ग a class.
22886: पञ्चवल्कल n. (-लं) A collection of the bark of five trees, the Indian and the holy fig, the opposite-leaved fig, the wavy-leaved fig, and a sort of reed; other trees are sometimes taken. E. पञ्च five, and वल्कल a bark.
22887: पञ्चवाण m. (-णः) KĀMADEVA, the Indian Cupid. E. पञ्च five, and वाण an arrow; being armed with five arrows.
22888: पञ्चशर m. (-रः) KĀMADEVA. E. पञ्च five, and शर an arrow: see the last.
22889: पञ्चशाख m. (-खः) The hand. E. पञ्च five, शाखा a branch, the five-fingered.
22890: पञ्चशिख m. (-खः) 1 A lion. 2 The name of a Muni, the son of DHARMA by HIṂSĀ. E. पञ्च spreading, शिखा a crest or mane.
22891: पञ्चशैरिषक n. (-कं) The bark of five trees. E. पञ्च, and शिरीष Mimosa sirisha, ठञ् aff.
22892: पञ्चष mfn. plu. (-षाः-षाः-षाणि) Five or six. E. पञ्च, and षष् six, with डच्. aff.
22893: पञ्चसुगन्धक n. (-कं) The aggregate of five aromatic vegetable substances; cloves, nutmeg, camphor, aloe wood, and Kakkola. E. पञ्च five, सुगन्ध fragrance, कन् added.
22894: पञ्चसूना m. plu. (-नाः) The five things in a house by which animal life may be accidentally destroyed; the fire place, the slab on which condiments are ground, the broom, the pestle and mortar, and the waterpot. E. पञ्च five, and सूना place of slaughter.
22895: पञ्चाग्नि n. (-ग्नि) 1 A collection of five fires, amidst which a devotee performs penance during the summer season; or four fires lighted severally to the north, south, east and west, and the sun over head. 2 Five mystic fires, supposed to be present in the body. m. (-ग्निः) 1 A householder who maintains five fires, or the domestic one, and one for warming visitors in addition to the other three. 2 One who is acquainted with the doctrine of the five mystic fires. E. पञ्च five, and अग्नि fire.
22896: पञ्चाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having five limbs or members, five parts or subdivisions, consisting of five things, &c. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Any aggregate of five parts or five things. 3 Five modes of devotion or silent prayer, burnt offering, libations, bathing idols, and feeding Brahmans. 3 An almanac describing solar days, lunar days, and the periods of asterisms, Yogas and Karaṇas. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A tortoise. 2 A horse: see पञ्चभद्र. 3 Reverence by extending the hands, bending the knees and head, and in speech and look. E. पञ्च five, अङ्ग body.
22897: पञ्चाङ्गगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A tortoise. E. पञ्च five, अङ्ग limb, and गुप्त hidden; covering his head and legs beneath his shell.
22898: पञ्चाङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Measuring five fingers. m. (-लः) The castor-oil plant. E. पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger, aff. अच्: the leaves having five lobes compared to fingers.
22899: पञ्चाङ्गुलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Having five fingers, or finger-like divisions. E. पञ्च five, अङ्गुलि a finger.
22900: पञ्चातपा f. (-पा) Doing penance with five fires, or four fires and the sun. E. पञ्च, and आतप heat.
22901: पञ्चानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Very passionate. m. (-नः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A lion. E. पञ्च five or spreading, आनन a face.
22902: पञ्चामृत n. (-तं) 1 A mixture of milk, curds, sugar, ghee, and honey. 2 The aggregate of any five drugs of supposed efficacy. E. पञ्च, and अमृत ambrosia.
22903: पञ्चाम्नाय m. plu. (-याः) Five Śāstras supposed to have proceeded from the five mouths of ŚIVA, constituting the basis of the Tantra ritual. E. पञ्च, and आम्नाय a scripture.
22904: पञ्चाम्ल n. (-म्लं) The aggregate of five acid plants; the jujube, pomegranate, sorrel, spondias, and citron. E. पञ्च five, and अम्ल sour.
22905: पञ्चारी f. (-री) A chequered cloth for playing draughts upon: see पञ्चाली.
22906: पञ्चार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mercury. E. पञ्च five, अर्च्चिस् a ray.
22907: पञ्चाल m. (-लः) A country in the north of India. f. (-ली) 1 A chequered cloth for playing at draughts, &c. 2 A doll, a puppet. 3 A style of singing. E. पचि to spread, Uṇādi aff. कालच्; also with कन् added पञ्चालिका.
22908: पञ्चावट m. (-टः) The sacrificial cord, as worn crossed upon the breast, the ends hanging over the shoulders. E. पञ्च spreading, वट to surround, aff. अच्, आङ् prefixed to the root; also पञ्चवट.
22909: पञ्चावस्थ m. (-स्थः) A corpse. E. पञ्च five, (elements,) अवस्था state or condition.
22910: पञ्चाशत् f. (-शत्) Fifty. E. पञ्च, with शत् aff. and आ augment.
22911: पञ्चास्य m. (-स्यः) A lion. E. पञ्च spreading, and आस्य a face.
22912: पञ्चेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) 1 The five organs of sense; the eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin; or those of action, as hands, feet, windpipe,  anus, and parts of generation. E. पञ्च five, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
22913: पञ्चेषु m. (-षुः) A name of KĀMADEVA, the Hindū Cupid. E. पञ्च five, इषु an arrow.
22914: पञ्चोष्मन् m. plu. (-ष्माणः) The five digestive fires supposed to be in the body. E. पञ्च, and उष्मन् heat.
22915: पञ्जर mn. (-रः-रं) A skeleton. n. (-रं) 1 A cage, an aviary, a dovecot. 2 The ribs. m. (-रः) 1 The body. 2 The Kali age. E. पजि for पिजि to dwell, &c. Uṇādi aff., अरच्; also पिञ्जर.
22916: पञ्जराखेट m. (-टः) A sort of basket or wicker trap in which fish are caught. E. पञ्जर a cage, आखेट hunting.
22917: पञ्जि f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी) 1 The ball or whisp of cotton from which thread is spun. 2 A journal, a register. 3 An almanack. E. पजि for पिजि to touch, &c. aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; also पिञ्जि.
22918: पञ्जिका f. (-का) 1 The ball or skein of cotton, from which the thread is spun: see the last. 2 A perpetual commentary. 3 A calendar, an almanack. 4 A journal, a register. 5 The register or journal of YAMA, the record of human actions. E. कन् added to पञ्जि; also पिञ्जिका.
22919: पञ्जिकाकारक m. (-कः) 1 A writer, a man of the Kāyastha tribe. 2 An almanack-maker. E. पञ्जिका a journal, &c. and कारक. who makes.
22920: पञ्जीकर m. (-रः) 1 The Kāyastha or scribe. 2 An almanack-maker. E. पञ्जी a journal, &c. कर who makes.
22921: पट r. 1st cl. (पटति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (पटयति) 1 To string. 2 To surround or encompass. 3 To share, to portion, to distribute. (पाटयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. With उत् prefixed, To pluck up, to eradicate, to destroy utterly. With वि, To fly, to run away.
22922: पट mn. (-टः-टं) 1 Fine cloth. 2 Coloured cloth. 3 A leaf or sheet of cloth, &c. on which any figures may be painted. m. (-टः) 1 A kind of tree: see पियाल. 2 Any thing well made or polished. f. (-टी) 1 A particular sort of cloth, coarse thick cloth, canvas. 2 A screen of cloth surrounding a tent, an outer tent. 3 A coloured or chintz garment. n. (-टं) A thatch, a roof. E. पट to surround, aff. अच् fem. aff. ङीप्: see पटि.
22923: पटक m. (-कः) A camp, an encampment. E. पट to surround, वुन् aff.
22924: पटकार m. (-रः) 1 A weaver. 2 A painter. E. पट cloth, and कार maker.
22925: पटकुटि f. (-टिः) A tent. E. पट cloth, कुटि a house.
22926: पटच्चर n. (-रं) Old cloth. m. (-रः) A thief. E. पटत् imitative sound, and चर going.
22927: पटमण्डप m. (-पः) A tent. E. पट cloth, and मण्डप a house.
22928: पटमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of cloth. n. (-यं) 1 A tent, a canvas house. 2 A petticoat. E. पट cloth, मयट् aff.
22929: पटल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A heap, a number, a quantity or multitude. mf. (-लं-ली) 1 A book. 2 A tree. 3 A stalk. nf. (-लः-ला) A roof, a thatch. n. (-लं) 1 A cover, a coat, an enclosing or surrounding skin or membrane. 2 A place, a spot, a circle or district. 3 A mark on the forehead with Sandal wood 4 A basket. 5 Train, retinue. 6 A coat of the eye. E. पट to go, कलच् aff.
22930: पटलप्रान्त m. (-न्तः) The edge of a thatch. E. पटल a thatch, and प्रान्त end.
22931: पटवाप m. (-पः) A tent. E. पट cloth, and वाप what is woven.
22932: पटवास m. (-सः) 1 A tent. 2 A petticoat. 3 Perfumed powder. E. पट cloth, वास abode, or वास to perfume, aff. अच्.
22933: पटवासक m. (-कः) Perfumed powder. E. कन् added to the last.
22934: पटवेश्मन् n. (-श्म) A tent. E. पट, and वेश्मन् a house.
22935: पटह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) A kettle-drum. m. (-हः) 1 A war-drum, or one used in battle. 2 Injury, killing, slaughter. 3 Tumult E. पट imitative sound, हा to quit or make, aff. ड.
22936: पटाक m. (-कः) A kind of bird. f. (-का) A flag, a banner. E. पट to go, आक Uṇādi aff.
22937: पटालुका f. (-का) A leech. E. पट to go, आलुच् aff., कन् added.
22938: पटि f. (-टिः) 1 A kind of cloth. 2 An aquatick plant: see कुम्भिका. E. पट to surround, &c. aff. इन्: see पट and पटी.
22939: पटिका f. (-का) Cloth. E. वुन् added to पटी.
22940: पटिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very clever. E. पटु and irr. superlative.
22941: पटीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very clever or able. E. पटु clever, ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative.
22942: पटीर n. (-रं) 1 Sandal- wood. 2 A field. 3 Bambu manna. 4 A radish. 5 The belly. 6 A sieve. 7 Height. 8 Khayar. 9 Rheumatism. m. (-रः) 1 KANDARPA. 2 A cloud. E. पट to go, Uṇādi aff. ईरन्.
22943: पटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-ट्वी-टु) 1 Clever, dexterous, skilful. 2 Diligent. 3 Smart, sharp. 4 Hale, healthy. 5 Warm, hot. 6 Blown, expanded. 7 Cruel, ferocious, unmerciful, unfeeling. 8 Harsh, contumelious, (speech, &c.) 9 Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. 10 Loquacious, talkative. m. (-टुः) 1 A small kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) 2 The leaf of the Trichosanthes. n. (-टु) 1 Salt. 2 A mushroom. E. पाट r. 10th cl. to speak, &c. Uṇādi aff. डु, and the radical vowel short.
22944: पटुक m. (-कः) A sort of gourd. E. कन् added to the preceding.
22945: पटुकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Not so clever, a little less able, &c. E. पटु clever, and कल्प aff. of incompleteness; also in a similar sense पटुदेश्य, and पटुदेशीय.
22946: पटुजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of a clever sort, &c. E. पटु as above, and जातीय aff. of kind.
22947: पटुत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Cleverness. 2 Eloquence. E. त्व, added to पटु; also with तल्, पटुता.
22948: पटुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A medicinal sort of moon plant. E. पटु a sort of gourd, and पर्ण a leaf, fem. aff. ङीष्; also पटुपचक (-कं) and पटुपचिका f. (-का)
22949: पटुरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Very clever. E. पटु, and रूप here implying much.
22950: पटोटज n. (-जं) A tent. E. पट, and उटज a house.
22951: पटोल m. (-लः) A kind of cucumber, commonly Palwal, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) n. (-लं) A sort of cloth, a kind of chintz. f. (-ली) A small cucumber, either the same as above, (Trichosanthes dioeca,) or another kind, (Luffa acutangula.) E. पट to go, in the causal form, aff. ओलच्; removing malady.
22952: पटोलक m. (-कः) An oyster. E. पटोल as above, and कन् aff. of resemblance, compared to the shape of the Trichosanthes.
22953: पटोलिका f. (-का) A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca:) it is also applied to Luffa acutangula. E. कन् with the fem. form added to पटोली.
22954: पट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 1 Cloth. 2 Coloured cloth. 3 Wove silk. 4 A turban, &c. or cloth for that purpose. 5 A coloured silk turban. 6 A fillet bound round the head. 7 A bandage, a ligature, a cloth bound round a sore, &c. 8 An upper or outer garment. 9 A plant, commonly called Pāt, (Corchorus olitorius,) from the fibres of the bark of which, called Jute, a coarse sack-cloth and cordage are prepared. 10 A stone for grinding with a mullar. 11 A plate of metal for inscription or engraving. 12 A royal grant or order written on copper, stone, &c. 13 A shield. 14 A place where four roads meet. 15 A chair, a stool. n. (-ट्टं) A city, a town, a village, the Pettah probably of the south. f. (-ट्टा) 1 An ornament of the forehead. 2 Red Lodh. 3 A horse's girth. E. पट to surround, क्त aff. and त changed to ट.
22955: पट्टक m. (-कः) Cloth, a bandage, &c. E. कन् added to the preceding.
22956: पट्टज n. (-जं) A sort of cloth, probably a kind of canvas or sackcloth. E. पट्ठ as above, and ज produced; made from Jute.
22957: पट्टन nf. (-नं-नी) A city: see पत्तन.
22958: पट्टदेवी f. (-वी) A principal queen. E. पट्ट a fillet or tiara, देवी a queen.
22959: पट्टबन्धन n. (-नं) Crowning, binding the head with a fillet or tiara. E. पट्ट, and बन्धन binding.
22960: पट्टमहिषी f. (-षी) A principal queen. E. पट्ट a fillet or tiara, and महिषी a queen.
22961: पट्टरङ्ग n. (ङ्गं) A plant used in dying, (Coesalpinia sappan.) E. पटृ cloth, and रङ्ग what colours.
22962: पट्टरञ्जन n. (-नं) Sappan wood. E. पट्ट cloth, and रञ्जन colouring; also with कन् added पट्टरञ्जनक.
22963: पट्टशाक n. (-कः) A sort of potherb, commonly also Nālita or Lalita, (Corchorus capsularis.) E. पटृ Corchorus, and शाक potherb; the leaves resembling those of the Pāt.
22964: पट्टारोहा f. (-हा) A principal queen. E. पट्ट, and आरोह what mounts.
22965: पट्टिका f. (-का) Red Lodh. E. पट्टी the same, कन् added: again with आख्या a name; it is read also पट्टिकाख्य, mf. (-ख्यः-ख्या)
22966: पट्टिन् m. (-ट्टी) Red Lodh; also पट्टी.
22968: पट्टिलोध्र m. (-ध्रः) A sort of tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent; the red species of the Lodh, (Symplocos racemosa, Rox.) E. पट्टी the same plant, लोध्र the Lodh; also with कन् added पट्टिलोध्रक.
22969: पट्टिश m. (-शः) A sort of weapon, a kind of axe. E. पट to go, aff. टिश or टिस; whence it is also read पट्टिस.
22970: पट्टोलिका f. (-का) 1 A title deed, a Paṭṭa, a lease, &c. 2 A written legal opinion. E. पट्ट a royal mandate, &c. ओलच् aff., कन् in the fem. form added.
22971: पठ r. 1st cl. (पठति) To speak articulately, to declaim, to recite or read.
22972: पठत् mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्) Reading, reciting. E. पठ to read, शतृ part. aff.
22973: पठन n. (-नं) Reading, reciting. E. पठ to read, ल्युट् aff.
22974: पठनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Readable, to be read. E. पठ to read, अनीयर aff.
22975: पठमञ्जरी f. (-री) A Rāgiṇī, one of the wives of ŚRĪRĀGA.
22976: पठि f. (-ठिः-ठी) Reading, perusal. E. पठ to read, aff. इन्, ङीष् optionally added.
22977: पठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Read, studied. 2 Recited, repeated. E. पठ to read, क्त aff.
22978: पठितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be read, what may or ought to be read. E. पठ to read, तव्य aff.
22979: पठितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Reading, reciting, a reader. E. पठ to read, तृच् aff.
22980: पठ्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being read or recited. E. पठ to read, poss. v. शानच् aff.
22981: पड (इ,) पडि r. 1st cl. (पण्डते) To go, to move. r. 1st and 10th cl. (पण्डति पण्डयति) 1 To destroy, to annihilate. 2 To heap together, to accumulate.
22982: पण r. 1st cl. (पणते) also 10th cl. (पणयति) To negociate, to treat or transact business. (पणयति) To praise.
22983: पण m. (-णः) 1 Measure of account, in cowries or shells, twenty gandas or eighty cowries; also a weight of copper of similar value. 2 Wages or hire. 2 A stake at play, a bet, a wager. 4 Gaming, playing. 5 Playing with dice. 6 Price. 7 Wealth, property. 8 A commodity for sale. 9 Business. 10 A distiller. 11 A house, a dwelling. E. पण to do business, aff. अच्.
22984: पणग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A fair, a market. E. पण a commodity, ग्रन्थि a knot.
22985: पणता f. (-ता) 1 The state or condition of a pledge or stake. 2 Price, value. E. तल् added to पण; also with त्व, पणत्वं.
22986: पणन n. (-नं) 1 Sale, selling. 2 Betting. E. पण to do business, aff. ल्युट्.
22987: पणव mf. (-वः-वा) A sort of musical instrument; a small drum or tabor. E. पण business or price, वा to sound, aff. क, it is also प्रणव.
22988: पणस m. (-सः) A commodity, an article of sale or traffick. E. पण to do business, Uṇādi aff. असच्.
22989: पणाङ्गना f. (-ना) A prostitute, a whore. E. पण price, अङ्गना a woman.
22990: पणाया f. (-या) 1 Business, affair, transaction, buying and selling, &c. 2 Profits or receipts of trade. 3 A market place. E. पण to negociate, in the causal form, अच् and टाप् affs. or पण and अय income, it also occurs mas. (-यः)
22991: पणायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Praised. 2 Transacted. E. पण to praise, aff. क्त.
22992: पणार्पण n. (-णं) Agreement, engagement, contract. E. पण price, अर्पण delivering.
22993: पणास्थि n. (-स्थि) The small shell used as coin, a Cowri. E. पण business, and अस्थि a bone; also with कन् added पणास्थि.
22994: पणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Praised. 2 Transacted as business. E. पण to praise, aff. क्त; also पणायित.
22995: पणितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Vendible, fit or intended for sale. 2 To be transacted, negotiable. 3 To be praised. E. पण to deal, aff. तव्य.
22996: पण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 A catamite. 2 A eunuch. f. (-ण्डा) 1 Wisdom, understanding. 2 Science, learning. E. पडि to go, aff. अच्, or पण to deal, Uṇādi aff. ड; also with कन added पण्डक.
22997: पण्डापूर्व्व n. (-र्व्वं) Non-occurrence of the results of fate or destiny, E. पण्ड, and अपूर्व्व unprecedented.
22998: पण्डित m. (-तः) 1 A scholar, a teacher, a Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, or one read in sacred science, and teaching it to his disciples. 2 Incense. E. पण्डा learning, इतच् aff.
22999: पण्डितम्मन्य m. (-न्यः) An ignorant and vain person, a pedant, one who thinks himself a Paṇḍita or scholar. E. पण्डित learned, मन to think, खश aff.; also with णिनि aff. पण्डितमानिन्.
23000: पण्डितमानिन् m. (-नी) An arrogant and ignorant man: see the last.
23001: पण्डितायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Become wise from a state of ignorance. E. पण्डित used as a verb, शानच् aff.
23002: पण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 1 To be sold, saleable, vendible. 2 To be praised. 3 To be transacted as business. f. (-ण्या) Heart pea: see पिण्या. E. पण to deal, यत् aff.
23003: पण्यफलत्व n. (-त्वं) Prosperity in trade, profit. E. पण्य, and फलत्व fruitfulness.
23004: पण्यमूल्य n. (-ल्यं) The price of a commodity. E. पण्य, and मूल्य price.
23005: पण्यवीथिका f. (-का) 1 A stall, a shop, a place of sale. 2 A market. E. पण्य vendible, and वीथी a shop, &c. कन् added.
23006: पण्यवीथी f. (-थी) 1 A stall, &c. 2 A market: see the last.
23007: पण्यशाला f. (-ला) 1 A market. 2 A shop, a ware-room. E. पण्य vendible, and शाला a hall.
23008: पण्यस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A whore. E. पण्य vendible, and स्त्री a woman.
23009: पण्याङ्गना f. (-ना) A prostitute, a whore. E. पण्य to be sold, अङ्गना a woman; also पणाङ्गना.
23010: पण्याजीव m. (-वः) A trader. n. (-वं) A market, a fair. E. पण्य a vendible, and आजीव a livelihood.
23011: पण्याजीवक n. (-कं) A market. E. कन् added to the last; also पण्यजीवकं.
23012: पण्यार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Saleable, vendible. E. पण्य, and अर्ह fit for.
23013: पत (ऌ) पतॢ r. 1st cl. (पतति) r. 10th cl. (पतयति or पातयति) 1 To go, to move, but especially downwards; as, to fall, to descend, to alight. 2 To possess supreme or superhuman power. r. 4th cl. (पत्यते) To be rich or powerful. With अति prefixed, To excel or surpass. With अभि or अव, To descend. With आङ्, To arrive, to come. With उत्, To ascend. With नि, To gain or get. 2 To happen. With निर्, To abscond. With परि, 1 To go fast. 3 To be valuable. With प्र and नि, To fall prostrate, to salute, to worship. With वि and निर्, To turn, to turn back. With सम्, 1 To go with. 2 To gain. With सम् and आङ्, To purify or cleanse. With सम् and उत्, To fly. With सम् and नि, To go forth or out.
23014: पत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished, protected. m. (-तः) 1 Going. 2 Falling, alighting. E. पत to go, अच् aff. or a various reading of पात.
23015: पतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Who or what falls, descends, &c. m. (-कः) An astronomical table. E. पत to fall, to go, वुन aff.
23016: पतग m. (-गः) A bird. E. पत to go, Uṇādi aff. अगच्.
23017: पतङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A grasshopper. 2 A bird. 3 A sort of rice. 4 The sun. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Quicksilver. 2 A kind of Sandal. E. पत falling, गम to proceed, aff. खच्; or पत to fall, अङ्गच् Uṇādi aff.; also पतङ्गम.
23018: पतङ्गम m. (-मः) 1 A bird. 2 A grasshopper. E. पत, and गम what goes: see the last.
23019: पतङ्गिका f. (-का) A sort of bee. E. कन् implying resemblance, with the fem. form added to पतङ्ग.
23021: पतञ्जलि m. (-लिः) 1 The name of a saint or Muni and teacher of the Yoga philosophy, thence called after him PĀTAÑJALA; also the author of the Mahābhāṣya or commentary on PĀṆINI. 2 A name of the poet VARARUCI. E. पत falling, अञ्जलि the hands joined as a mark of respect; having fallen from heaven, it is said, in the shape of a small snake, into the hands of the saint PĀṆINI as he was performing this act of reverence.
23022: पतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Falling, coming down, alighting, &c. m. (-तन्) A bird. E. पत to go, to alight, participial aff. शतृ.
23023: पतत्र n. (-त्रं) A wing. E. पत to go, अचन् Uṇādi aff.
23024: पतत्रि m. (-त्रिः) A bird. E. पत to go, अत्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
23025: पतत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A bird. E. पतत्र a wing, इनि poss. aff.
23026: पतत्रिराज m. (-जः) VIṢṆU'S bird, Garuḍa. E. पतत्रिन्, and राज king.
23027: पतद्ग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A spitting pot. 2 The reserve of an army. E. पतत् what falls, and ग्रह what takes.
23028: पतद्भीरु m. (-रुः) A hawk, a falcon. E. पतत् a bird, and भीरु fearful.
23029: पतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what goes, falls, descends, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Falling. 2 Alighting, descending. 3 Falling from dignity, virtue, &c. 4 Sin. 5 Going. 6 Substraction. 7 The latitude of a planet. E. पत to fall, युच् or ल्यट् aff.
23030: पतम m. (-मः) 1 The moon. 2 A bird. 3 A grasshopper. E. पत to go, अमच् Uṇādi aff.
23031: पतयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Falling, liable or accustomed to fall. E. पत to go, &c. in the causal form, आलुच aff.
23032: पतस m. (-सः) 1 A bird. 2 The moon. 3 A caterpillar. E. पत to go, Uṇādi aff. असच्.
23033: पताका f. (-का) 1 A flag or banner. 2 A flagstaff. 3 An emblem carried as an ensign or banner, a symbol, a sign. 4 A mark. 5 An episode, or episodical incident in a drama. 6 Good fortune, auspiciousness. E. पत to go, आकन् Uṇādi aff.
23034: पताकिन् m. (-की) 1 An ensign, a standard bearer. 2 A scheme for casting a nativity. f. (-नी) An army. E. पताका a flag, and इनि aff.
23035: पतापत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Who or what goes, &c. much or frequently. पत to go, अच् aff. repeated, and आच् augment.
23036: पति m. (-तिः) 1 A master, an owner. 2 A husband. 3 A root. 4 Going, motion. E. पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. डति, or पत to go, with the same aff.
23037: पतिघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) 1 The murderess of her husband. 2 A line on the hand, indicating that a woman will be faithless or treacherous to her husband. E. पति a husband, and घ्न who kills, fem. aff. ङीप्.
23038: पतिघ्नीलक्षण n. (-णं) Sign of a murderess of a husband. E. पतिघ्नी, and अक्षण a mark.
23039: पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fallen, alighted. 2 Fallen from virtue, wicked, abandoned. 3 Fallen in war, defeated, overthrown. 4 Degraded, outcaste. 5 Gone. E. पत to go, aff. क्त.
23040: पतितसावित्रीक m. (-कः) A man of the first three classes, whose investiture has not been duly performed. E. पतित, and सावित्री the mystical verse, कन् added.
23041: पतितेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Looked at by an outcaste. E. पतित, and ईक्षित seen.
23042: पतितोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born of an outcaste. E. पतित, and उत्पन्न born.
23043: पतित्व n. (-त्वं) The conjugal state. E. पति, and त्व aff.
23044: पतित्वा ind. Having fallen or fallen down, having alighted, &c. E. पत to fall, क्त्वा aff.
23045: पतिप्राणा f. (-णा) A faithful wife. E. पति, and प्राण life.
23046: पतिम्वरा f. (-रा) 1 A bride choosing her husband. 2 A pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) E. पति a husband, वृ to choose, खच् aff.
23047: पतिवत्नी f. (-त्नी) A married woman, a wife whose husband is living. E. पति a husband, मतुप् aff., fem. form irr., नुक् being inserted.
23048: पतिव्रता f. (-ता) A good and virtuous wife. E. पति a husband, व्रत a religious obligation; who never violates her marriage vow.
23049: पतिसेवा f. (-वा) Devotion to a husband. E. पति, and सेवा service.
23050: पतीयन्ती f. (-न्ती) A woman wishing or fit for a husband. E. पति, and क्यच् added, aff. शतृ.
23051: पतेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going, moving, one who goes or moves. m. (-रः) 1 A bird. 2 An Arhaka, a measure so called. 3 A hole. E. पत to go, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
23052: पत्काषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Pedestrian, going on foot. m. (-षी) A footman, a foot soldier, &c. E. पत् for पाद foot, कष to injure, णिनि aff.
23053: पत्तङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Red sanders: see पचङ्ग, of which it appears to be a local corruption.
23054: पत्तन n. (-नं) 1 A town, a city. 2 A sort of drum. E. पत to go, तनन् aff.
23055: पत्तनवणिज् m. (-णिक्) A tradesman. E. पत्तन a city, वणिज् a trader.
23056: पत्ति m. (-त्तिः) 1 A foot soldier. 2 A hero. f. (-त्तिः) 1 Going, moving, walking. 2 A company, a platoon, consisting of one chariot, one elephant, three horse, and five foot. E. पद to go, ति Uṇādi aff. or क्तिन् aff. for the feminine.
23057: पत्तिपङ्क्ति f. (-ङ्क्तिः) A line of infantry. E. पत्ति, and पङ्क्ति a line.
23058: पत्तिसंहति f. (-तिः) A body of troops. E. पत्ति, and संहति assemblage.
23059: पत्तूर m. (-रः) A plant, commonly Śaliñca. n. (-रं) Red sanders.
23060: पत्त्र n. (-त्त्रं) Any vehicle or means of conveyance. E. पत to go, ष्ट्रन् aff.; also पत्र.
23061: पत्नी f. (-त्नी) A wife. E. पति a husband, ङीप् aff., and नुक् augment.
23062: पत्न्याट m. (-टः) The Haram, the private or women's apartments. E. पत्नी a wife, आट who goes, from अट, with घञ् affix, and आङ् prefix.
23063: पत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A leaf. 2 A vehicle in general; as a car, a horse, a camel, &c. 3 The wing of a bird. 4 The feather of an arrow. 5 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. 6 The leaf of a book. 7 Goldleaf, &c. any thin sheet or plate of metal. nf. (-त्रं-त्री) A letter, any written document or address. E. पत to go, ष्ट्रन् aff. and one त rejected; also sometimes पत्त्र.
23064: पत्रक n. (-क) 1 A leaf. 2 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. 3 Staining the person with Sandal, &c. by way of decoration. E. पत्र with कन् added.
23065: पत्रकाहला f. (-ला) The noise made by the flapping of wings, or rustling of leaves. E. पत्र a leaf, a wing, &c. and काहल noise.
23066: पत्रकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, drinking infusion of any leaves for a given time. E. पत्र a leaf, and कृच्छ्र a penance.
23067: पत्रगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A species of Euphorbia, commonly Teṅkānta Śij. E. पत्र a leaf, and गुप्त hidden.
23068: पत्रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santalinus;) also पत्राङ्ग.
23069: पत्रझङ्कार m. (-रः) The current of a river: other authorities have in place of this word, पुरसंस्कार, and पत्रसंस्कार, which last appears to be most accurate.
23070: पत्रणा f. (-णा) Trimming the feathered butt of an arrow. E. पत the feather of an arrow, णी to get, aff. ड.
23071: पत्रतण्डुला f. (-ला) 1 A woman. 2 A kind of barley.
23073: पत्रदारक m. (-कः) A saw. E. पत्र a leaf, &c. and दॄ to tear, ण्वुल् aff.
23074: पत्रनाडिका f. (-का) The fibre or vein of a leaf. E. पत्र a leaf, नाडी a vessel, aff. कन्.
23075: पत्रपरशु m. (-शुः) A small file used by silversmiths, &c. E. पत्र a sheet of metal, परशु an axe; also with पर्शु the same, पत्रपर्शु (-र्शुः.)
23076: पत्रपाल m. (-लः) A large knife. f. (-ली) A pair of shears or scissors. E. पत्र a leaf, पाल to nourish, aff. अच्.
23077: पत्रपाश्या f. (-श्या) An ornament of the forehead, a piece of gold-leaf situate on the forehead, or a painted mark upon it. E. पत्र a leaf, पश to bind, aff. ण्यत्.
23078: पत्रपिशाचिका f. (-का) A sort of cap or cover for the head, made of leaves. E. पत्र a leaf, पिशाचिका an imp.
23079: पत्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, a red sort of Tulasī or Basil, (Ocymum pilosum.) f. (-ष्पा) Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) E. पत्र a leaf, and पुष्प a flower.
23080: पत्रपुष्पक m. (-कः) A kind of birch, from the bark of which Hukka snakes, &c. are made: see भूर्ज्जपत्र. E. पत्र a leaf, and पुष्प a flower, कन् added.
23081: पत्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Adorning with leaves, flowers, &c. decorating with nosegays or garlands. E. पत्र a leaf, and बन्ध a binding.
23082: पत्रबाल m. (-लः) An oar, especially a large one used as a rudder. E. पत्र a leaf, बल to be strong, aff. घञ्.
23083: पत्रभङ्ग mf. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी) Decorating the person by staining it with fragrant pigments of sandal, musk, &c. E. पत्र a leaf, भञ्च to break, aff. अच्.
23084: पत्रयौवन n. (-नं) A new leaf, a sprout. E. पत्र a leaf, यौवन youth.
23085: पत्ररथ m. (-थः) A bird. E. पच a wing, and रथ a vehicle.
23086: पत्ररञ्जन n. (-नं) Embellishing a page, illuminating, gilding, &c. E. पत्र, and रञ्जन colouring.
23087: पत्रल n. (-लं) Thin or skim milk. E. पत to go, रल aff.
23088: पत्रलेखा f. (-खा) Decoration of the face or person, by means of fragrant pigments, consisting of Sandal, saffron, musk, &c. E. पत्र a leaf, and लेखा a line.
23089: पत्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Staining the person with Sandal, &c. by way of ornament. E. पत्र a leaf, and वल्ली a creeper; also पत्रावली, पचलेखा, &c.
23090: पत्रवाह m. (-हः) 1 An arrow. 2 A bird. 3 A postman, a letter carrier. E. पत्र a feather, and बाह bearing.
23091: पत्रशिरा f. (-रा) The vein or fibre of a leaf. E. पत्र a leaf, and शिरा a tubular vessel.
23093: पत्रसंस्कार m. (-रः) The current of a river. E. पत्र a leaf, संस्कार making perfect: see पत्रझङ्कार.
23094: पत्रसूचि m. (-चिः) A thorn. E. पत्र a leaf, and सूचि a needle.
23095: पत्रहिम n. (-मं) Cold, wintry weather. E. पत्र here said to mean falling, हिम frost or snow.
23096: पत्राख्य m. (-स्यः) The pungent leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. पत्र a leaf, and आख्या a name; the leaf, by way of distinction.
23097: पत्राङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santolinus.) 2 Red or sappan wood, (Cæsalpinia sappan.) 3 Bhojpatra, a tree so called, a kind of Birch. 4 Another plant: see पद्मक. E. पत्र a leaf, अङ्ग body or substance.
23098: पत्राङ्गुलि f. (-लिः) Painting the forehead, throat, neck, &c. with coloured Sandal, saffron, or any other fragrant substance. E. पत्र a leaf, and अङ्गुलि a finger, being applied with the finger.
23099: पत्राञ्जन n. (-नं) Ink or blacking. E. पत्र a leaf, (of a book,) and अञ्चन unction.
23100: पत्राढ्य n. (-ढ्यं) 1 The root of long pepper. 2 A kind of grass.
23101: पत्राली f. (-ली) Coloured ornamental marks on the face or person. E. पत्र, and आली a row.
23102: पत्रावलि f. (-लिः) 1 Red chalk. 2 A row of leaves. 3 Decorating the person. E. पत्र, and आवलि a line: see the next.
23103: पत्रावली f. (-ली) 1 Drawing lines along the form; staining some parts of the body with coloured and fragrant pigments, as with saffron, Sandal, &c. 2 A mixture of young Aśvattha leaves with barley and honey. E. पत्र a leaf, and आवली a line: see पत्रलेखा, पत्रक, &c.
23104: पत्रिका f. (-का) A leaf, a written leaf or page, a writing, a letter, &c. E. पत्र, and कन् added, fem. form.
23105: पत्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) 1 Winged. 2 Feathered. 3 Having a page or leaf. m. (-त्री) 1 An arrow. 2 A bird. 3 A falcon. 4 A tree. 5 A mountain. 6 A chariot. 7 A rider in a car or carriage. f. (-णी) A sprout, a shoot. E. पत्र a leaf, &c. इनि aff.
23106: पत्रपूग m. (-गः) A shower of arrows. E. पत्र, and पूग a heap.
23107: पत्रोपस्कर m. (-रः) A tree, (Cassia esculenta.) E. पत्र a leaf, उपस्कर a condiment.
23108: पत्रोर्ण n. (-र्णं) Wove silk. m. (-र्णः) A plant, (Bignonia indica). E. पत्र a leaf, ऊर्णा wool.
23109: पत्रोल्लास m. (-सः) A bud. E. पत्र, and उल्लास what delights.
23110: पत्सल m. (-लः) A road. E. पत to go, सर Uṇādi aff., र changed to ल.
23111: पथ r. 1st cl. (पथति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (पथयति) To throw, to cast, to despatch or send; (इ,) पथि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पन्थति पन्थयति) To go, to proceed, to travel.
23112: पथ m. (-थः) A road. E. पथ to go, aff. अच्.
23113: पथत् mfn. (-थन्-थन्ती-थत्) Going, travelling. m. (-थन्) A road. E. पथ to go, शतृ aff.
23114: पथिक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Knowing or going on a road. m. (-कः) 1 A traveller, a way-farer. 2 A guide, one who knows the way. E. पथिन् a road, वुन् or ष्कन् aff.
23115: पथिकसन्तति f. (-तिः) A line or range of travellers, a cafileh, a caravan. E. पथिक a traveller, सन्तति a range; also with संहति assemblage, पथिकसंहति.
23116: पथिद्रुम m. (-मः) A sort of Khayar, (Mimosa alba.) E. पथिन् a road, and द्रुम a tree.
23117: पथिन् m. (-पन्था) 1 A road, a way. 2 Sect, doctrine, path in morals or religion. 3 A division of hell. E. पथ to go, इन् Uṇādi aff.; the noun is irregularly inflected.
23118: पथिप्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Acquainted with roads. E. पथिन्, and प्रज्ञ who knows.
23119: पथिल m. (-लः) A traveller, a way-farer. पथिन् a road, इलच् Uṇādi aff.
23120: पथिवाहक m. (-कः) 1 A fowler, a bird-catcher. 2 A porter, a burthen-carrier. E. पथिन् a road, and वाहक who bears.
23121: पथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) Proper, fit, suitable, agreeing with, but applied chiefly medically, with respect to diet, regimen, &c. mf. (-थ्यः-थ्या) Yellow Myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) n. (-थ्यं) Sea salt. E. पथ to go, यत् aff.
23122: पथ्यापथ्य n. (-थ्यं) The class of things that are considered beneficial or hurtful in disease. E. पथ्य, and अपथ्य improper.
23123: पथ्याशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Eating wholesome things. E. पथ्य, and आशिन् who eats.
23124: पद r. 4th cl. (औ) पदौ (पद्व्यते) r. 10th cl. (पदयते) To go, to move. (ए) पदे r. 1st cl. (पदति) To stand fast. With अभि prefixed, 1 To know, to understand. 2 To see, to look. With अनु, To follow. With आङ्, 1 To happen, to befall. 2 To gain. 3 To suffer misfortune. 4 To multiply. 5 To produce. 6 To come. With उत्, To be born or produced. With उप, 1 To gain. 2 To be born. 3 To be near or connected with. With उप and सम्, To offer oblations. With प्र, 1 To gain, to acquire. 2 To commence. With प्र and वि, To establish, to enact. With प्रति, 1 To gain. 2 To assent, to agree or promise. 3 To restore. With वि, To suffer misfortune or pain. With वि and आङ्, To injure or kill. With वि and उत्, To discriminate, to analyze. With सम्, 1 To thrive, to grow or increase. 2 To do, to execute, to perform. 3 To select. With सम् and आङ्, 1 To arrive. 2 To finish.
23125: पद् m. (-द् or त्) A foot. E. पद to go, aff. क्विप्; also पद; or it is considered an irregular substitute for पाद.
23126: पद n. (-दं) 1 A foot. 2 A footstep, the mark of a foot. 3 A word. 4 An inflected word. 5 A crude word. 6 A connected sentence. 7 Thing. 8 Preservation, defence. 9 Industry, application. 10 Disguise. 11 Place, site. 12 Rank, station, degree. 13 A mark, a spot. 14 A foot or rather line of a stanza. 15 A mode of writing the Vedas, in which the several words are detached from one another. 16 (In Arithmetic,) Any one of a set of numbers the sum of which is required, or the last of the series. m. (-दः) A ray of light. E. पद to go, aff. अच् or घञ्.
23127: पदक m. (-कः) 1 A Brahman knowing the verses of the Vedas. 2 A Niṣka, a weight of gold. 3 An ornament of the neck. E. पद a verse, &c. and कन् aff.
23128: पदकार m. (-रः) One who divides or separates compound terms. E. पद, and कार who makes.
23129: पदक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Step, pace. 2 Walking. E. पद, and क्रम going.
23130: पदग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going with the feet. m. (-गः) A footman, a foot soldier, &c. E. पद् or पद a foot, and ग who goes; hence also पद्ग.
23131: पदगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone on foot. 2 Described or recorded in a line or stanza. E. पद, and गत gone.
23132: पदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what goes or moves. E. पद to go, युच् aff.
23133: पदन्यास m. (-सः) 1 Step, pace. 2 Conduct, procedure. 3 Position of the feet in a particular attitude. 4 A plant; also गोक्षुर. E. पद, and न्यास gesticulation.
23134: पदपात m. (-तः) Step, pace, foot-fall, tread. E. पद, and पात fall.
23135: पदभञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Explanation of obscure or obsolete words. 2 Etymology. 3 Separating the words of a line or sentence. E. पद a word, भञ्जन a breaking.
23136: पदभञ्जिका f. (-का) A register, a journal, a calendar or almanack. E. पद a mark, &c. भञ्ज to divide, aff. वुन्.
23137: पदवि f. (-विः-वी) 1 A road, a path, a way. 2 Station, situation, degree, rank. 3 Place, site. E. पद to go, अवि aff.; fem. aff. optionally ङीप्.
23138: पदविक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Step, pace, walking. 2 A horse's paces. E. पद, and विक्षेप throwing.
23139: पदविष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) Tread, step, stamp with the foot. E. पद, and विष्टम्भ fixing.
23140: पदष्ठीव n. (-वं) The feet and knees. E. पद् a foot, and अष्ठीवत् the knee, deriv. irr.
23141: पदसङ्घात m. (-तः) A writer, an annotator, one who collects or classes words. E. पद, and सम् before हन to hurt, अण् aff. also पदसङ्घाट.
23142: पदाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) Foot-mark, vestige. E. पद, and अङ्क a mark.
23143: पदाजि m. (-जिः) A foot soldier. E. पद a foot, अज to go, इन् Uṇādi aff.
23144: पदात m. (-तः) A footman, a pedestrian. E. पद foot, अत to go, aff. क्विप्.
23145: पदाति m. (-तिः) A footman or foot soldier. E. पद foot, अत to go, इन् Uṇādi aff.
23146: पदातिक m. (-कः) A peon, a footman or foot soldier. E. कन् added to the preceding.
23147: पदानुराग m. (-गः) 1 A servant. 2 An army. E. पद, and अनुराग attachment.
23148: पदाम्भोज n. (-जं) The foot of a mistress, or a divinity, &c. E. पद, and अम्भोज lotus; also similar compounds, पदारविन्द, &c.
23149: पदार m. (-रः) 1 The dust of the feet. 2 A boat. E. पद a foot, ऋ to go, घञ् aff.
23150: पदारविन्द n. (-न्दं) The foot of a mistress, of a divinity, &c. E. पद, and अरविन्द a lotus.
23151: पदार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 Thing, substantial or material form of being. 2 A category or predicament in Logic, of which seven are enumerated, viz. substance, quality, action, identity, variety, relation, and annihilation; another enumeration gives sixteen. 3 The meaning of a word or sentence. E. पद word, thing, and अथ meaning.
23152: पदासन n. (-नं) A footstool. E. पद a foot, आसन a place of sitting.
23153: पदिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going on foot. m. (-कः) A foot soldier. n. (-कं) The point of the foot. E. पद a foot, aff. ष्ठन्.
23154: पदेपदे ind. Continually. E. पद a foot-step, seventh case, repeated.
23155: पद्ग m. (-द्गः) A foot soldier. E. पद a foot, and ग who goes.
23156: पद्धति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 A road. 2 A line, a row or range. 3 A ritual, a manual, a work upon any act or ceremony, detailing the mode of its performance, and collecting the texts connected with it. 4 A family name, a surname or title. E. पद a foot, हन to strike, aff. क्तिन्.
23157: पद्धिम n. (-मं) Coldness of the feet. E. पद् for पाद, and हिम frost or cold.
23158: पद्म mn. (-द्मः-द्मं) 1 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum;) it is often confounded with the water lily, (Nymphæa.) 2 A form of array. 3 One of KUVERA'S treasures or gems. 4 A large number, ten billions. 5 Coloured marks on the face and trunk of an elephant. 6 A drug, also termed Padmakāṣṭha. 7 Lead. 8 A name given to the six Cakras of the body, or to the mystical faculties present in them. m. (-द्मः) 1 A Nāga or serpent of the lower regions. 2 One of the twelve Cakravartīs or paramount princes of the Jainas. 3 One of the nine persons termed Śukla Balas by the Jainas. 4 A name of RĀMA. 5 The personified treasure of KUVERA, as worshipped by the Tāntrikas. f. (-द्मा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 3 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 4 A female serpent or Nāga, the goddess MANASĀ, and wife to the sage JARATKĀRU. 5 The mother of the twentieth Jina or Jaina saint. 6 The flower of the Carthamus or safflower. E. पद to go, (on the water, &c.) Uṇādi aff. मम्.
23159: पद्मक n. (-कं) 1 Coloured marks or spots on the face and trunk of an elephant. 2 A sort of drug, commonly called पद्मकाष्ठ. 3 A kind of leprosy. E. कन् added to the preceding.
23160: पद्मकर m. (-रः) The sun. E. पद्म, and कर hand, his image always holding a lotus in one hand.
23161: पद्मकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A fragrant wood used in medicine, and described as cooling and tonic. E. पद्म a lotus, and काष्ठ wood.
23162: पद्मकिन् m. (-की) The Bhojpatra or birch tree, the bark is used for writing upon, &c. E. पद्मक, and इनि aff.
23163: पद्मकेशर mn. (-रः-रं) The filaments of a lotus. E. पद्म, and केशर the same.
23164: पद्मखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A quantity of lotuses, or spot abounding with them. E. पद्म a lotus, and खण्ड a portion or district.
23165: पद्मगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Lotus-smelling; smelling like a lotus. E. पद्म, and गन्ध smell; also with इ substituted for the final. पद्मगन्धि.
23166: पद्मगर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The sun. E. पद्म a lotus, and गर्ब्भ womb, born from the lotus.
23167: पद्मचारिणी f. (-णी) A small tree, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. पद्म a lotus, चर to resemble, aff. णिनि, fem. aff. ङीष्.
23168: पद्मतन्तु m. (-न्तुः) The fibrous stalk of the lotus. E. पद्म, and तन्तु thread.
23169: पद्मदर्शन m. (-नः) The resin of the Pinus longifolia.
23170: पद्मनाभ m. (-भः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 One of the Jinas of a future age. E. पद्म a lotus, and नाभि a navel, षच् aff.; also
23171: पद्मनाभि m. (-भिः) VIṢṆU is thus termed, because the lotus, containing BRAHMĀ, sent to create the world, sprang from his navel.
23172: पद्मनाल n. (-लं) The stalk of a lotus. E. पद्म a lotus, and नाल a hollow stalk.
23173: पद्मपब n. (-बं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. पद्म a lotus, and पत्र a leaf; also पद्मपर्ण n. (-र्णं) from पर्ण a leaf.
23174: पद्मपाणि m. (-णिः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The sun. 3 A Buddha, a Bauddha sanctified teacher. E. पद्म a lotus, and पाणि the hand, holding a lotus in one hand.
23175: पद्मपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A shrub, (Webera corymbosa:) see कर्णिकार. 2 A sort of bird. E. पद्म a lotus, and पुष्प a flower.
23176: पद्मप्रभ m. (-भः) The sixth Jina or Jaina pontiff. E. पद्म a lotus, and प्रभ who shines.
23177: पद्मप्रिया f. (-या) The wife of the Muni JARATKĀRU. E. पद्म a lotus, and प्रिया fond of.
23178: पद्मबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The arrangement of the words of a verse in a figure representing the leaves of a lotus. E. पद्म, and बन्ध binding.
23179: पद्मबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 1 A bee. 2 The sun. E. पद्म a lotus, and बन्धु the friend.
23180: पद्मभू m. (-भूः) BRAHMĀ. E. पद्म a lotus, and भू born.
23181: पद्ममुखी f. (-खी) A sort of prickly nightshade.
23182: पद्मयोनि m. (-निः) BRAHMĀ. E. पद्म, and योनि place of production.
23183: पद्मराग m. (-गः) A ruby. E. पद्म a lotus, and राग colour.
23184: पद्मरेखा f. (-खा) A line of the palm, indicating the possession of great wealth. E. पद्म a large number, and रेखा a line.
23185: पद्मलाञ्छन m. (-नः) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 The sun. 4 KUVERA, the god of wealth. f. (-ना) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A name of SARASVATĪ. 3 A title of TĀRĀ, one of the forms of DURGĀ. E. पद्म a lotus, a Catta or parasol shaped like one, a fabulous gem, &c. and लाञ्छन a mark or designation.
23186: पद्मवर्णक n. (-कं) A species of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. पद्म a lotus, वर्ण a colour, कन् aff.
23187: पद्मवासा f. (-सा) A name of LAKṢMĪ. E. पद्म a lotus, and वास abode; abiding at the creation within the petals of the lotus.
23188: पद्मवीज n. (-जं) The seed of the lotus. E. पद्म a lotus, and वीज seed.
23189: पद्मस्नुषा f. (-षा) 1 GAṄGĀ. 2 LAKṢMĪ. 3 GAURĪ or DURGĀ. E. पद्म a lotus, and स्नुषा a daughter-in-law.
23190: पद्माकर m. (-रः) A large deep tank or pond; one in which the lotus does or may grow. E. पद्म, and आकर a mine.
23191: पद्माक्ष m. (-क्षः) The seed of the lotus. E. पद्म a lotus, and अक्ष an eye.
23192: पद्माट m. (-टः) A sort of Cassia, (C. tora.) E. पद्म a lotus, and अट to resemble, aff. अच्.
23193: पद्मान्तर m. (-रः) Petal of the lotus. E. पद्म, and अन्तर inside.
23194: पद्मालया f. (-या) A name of the goddess LAKṢMĪ. E. पद्म a lotus, and आलय an asylum.
23195: पद्मावती f. (-ती) 1 The wife of the sage JARATKĀRU. 2 The name of a river, the main stream of the Ganges, between the Kasimbazar river and the sea. E. पद्म a lotus, मतुप् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्, and the antepen. made long.
23196: पद्मावतीप्रिय m. (-यः) The Muni JARATKĀRU. E. पद्मावती as above, and प्रिय beloved.
23197: पद्मासन n. (-नं) A posture in religious meditation, sitting with the thighs crossed, one hand resting on the left thigh, the other held up with the thumb upon the heart; the eyes directed to the tip of the nose. 2 A seat or throne made in the shape of a lotus, one especially on which idols are placed. m. (-नः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 The sun. E. पद्म a lotus, and आसन sitting.
23198: पद्मिन् m. (-द्मी) An elephant. f. (-नी) 1 A multitude of lotuses, or place abounding in them. 2 A woman of one of the four classes into which the sex is distinguished; the first and most excellent. 3 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.) 4 A pool or pond, especially one deep enough for the growth of the lotus. 5 The fibrous stalk of a lotus. 6 A female elephant. E. पद्म coloured marks, &c. or a lotus, इनि aff.
23199: पद्मिनीकान्त m. (-न्तः) The sun. E. पद्मिनी a lotus, and कान्त beloved.
23200: पद्मिनीखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A place abounding with lotuses, or a district in which they grow. E. पद्मिनी, and खण्ड division.
23201: पद्मिनीवल्लभ m. (-भः) The sun. E. पद्मिनी a lotus, and बल्लभ a friend.
23202: पद्मेशय m. (-यः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. पद्मे in or on a lotus, and शय who sleeps.
23203: पद्मोत्तर m. (-रः) 1 Safflower. 2 A proper name: see the next. E. पद्म, and उत्तर better.
23204: पद्मोत्तरात्मज m. (-जः) One of the Jaina Cakravartīs or emperors. E. पद्मोत्तर, and आत्मज son.
23205: पद्मोद्भव m. (-वः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-वा) The snake goddess MANASĀ. E. पद्म a lotus, and उद्भव born.
23206: पद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्याद्यं) Hurting or coming in contact with the feet. n. (-द्यं) 1 Metre, verse. 2 Wickedness, infamy. m. (-द्यः) A Śūdra. f. (-द्या) 1 A road. 2 Praise, eulogium. E. पद to go, यत् aff.
23207: पद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 A village. 2 The entrance into a village. E. पद to go, रक् Uṇādi aff.
23208: पद्व m. (-द्वः) 1 The abode or world of human beings. 2 A car. 3 A road. E. पद to go, क्वन् Uṇādi aff.
23209: पद्वन् m. (-द्वा) A road. E. पद to go, वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
23210: पन r. 1st cl. (पनायति) To praise: this root and पण in the same sense, take आय before the Sārvadhātuka, and some of the Ārddhadhātuka, affixes. (पनते) To traffic, to buy and sell: see पण.
23211: पनस m. (-सः) 1 The bread fruit or Jaka tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) 2 A thorn. 3 The name of a monkey. f. (-सा) A malady, pustular and phlegmonoid inflammation of the skin or external organs. 2 A she monkey. 3 A female demon. E. पन to praise or be praised, Uṇādi aff. असच्.
23212: पनसनालिका f. (-का) The bread-fruit or Jack.
23213: पन्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced in or on the road. E. पथिन्, and वुन् aff.
23214: पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Fallen, gone down or downwards. 2 Gone. m. (-न्नः) Downward motion, falling, descending. E. पद to go, aff. क्त, deriv. irr., otherwise पद to go, Uṇādi aff. नन्.
23215: पन्नग m. (-गः) 1 A snake. 2 A drug: see पद्मकाष्ठ. f. (-गी) The snake goddess MANASĀ. E. पन्न fallen, ग who goes, or पद् a foot, न not, ग who goes; moving without feet.
23216: पन्नगाशन m. (-नः) A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. पन्नग a snake, and अशन food; the snake-eater.
23217: पन्नद्धा f. (-द्धा) A leather shoe or boot. E. पद् a foot, नह to bind, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
23218: पन्नद्धी f. (-द्धी) A shoe, a boot. E. पद् a foot, नह to bind, aff. ष्ट्रन्, deriv. irr.
23219: पपि mfn. (-पिः-पिः-पि) Who or what drinks. m. (-पिः) The moon. E. पा to drink, कि aff. and the root repeated.
23220: पपिस् m. (-पिः) 1 The moon. 2 The sun. E. पा to drink, reiterated by special rule, Uṇādi aff. इस्.
23221: पपीति f. (-तिः) Mutual or reciprocal drinking, drinking alike or together. E. पा to drink, in the reiterative form, aff. क्तिन्.
23222: पपु m. (-पुः) A fosterer, a protector. f. (-पुः) A nurse, a fostermother. E. पा to cherish, कु aff. and the radical consonant repeated.
23223: पम्पा f. (-म्पा) The name of a river, in the south of India. E. पा to drink, प Uṇādi aff., मन् inserted, and the radical vowel made short.
23224: पय r. 1st cl. (पयते) To go, to move.
23225: पयश्चय m. (-यः) A piece of water. E. पयस् water, चय collection.
23226: पयस् n. (-यः) 1 Water. 2 Milk. E. पय to go, असुन् Uṇādi aff.
23227: पयस n. (-सं) 1 Water. 2 Milk. E. पयस् the same, अच् added.
23228: पयस्प m. (-स्पः) A cat. E. पयस् milk, and प who drinks.
23229: पयस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 Made from milk, (curds, butter, cheese, &c.) 2 Relating to or connected with milk or water. f. (-स्या) 1 A shrub, (Asclepias rosea.) 2 A medicinal kind of moon plant. 3 A drug: see क्षीरकाकोली. 4 Curds of two milk whey. 5 Any plant yielding a milky sap, as the Euphorbia, the Asclepias, &c. E. पयस् milk, यत् aff.
23230: पयस्वल m. (-लः) A goat. E. पयस्, वलच् aff.
23231: पयस्विनी f. (-नी) 1 A river. 2 A milch cow. 3 Night. 4 A she goat. E. पयस् water or milk, विनि aff.
23232: पयोगड m. (-डः) Hail. n. (-डं) An island. E. पयस् water, गड a drop.
23233: पयोघन m. (-नः) Hail. E. पयस् water, चन a lump.
23234: पयोजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A cloud. E. पयस् water, जन्मन् origin.
23235: पयोद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. पयस्, and द what gives.
23236: पयोधर m. (-रः) 1 A woman's breast. 2 A cloud. 3 The sugarcane. 4 The cocoanut. 5 A sort of rush, (Scirpus kysoor.) 6 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus, &c.) (In Prosody) A scolius. E. पयस् milk or water, and धर containing.
23237: पयोधस् m. (-धाः) 1 The ocean. 2 A piece of water. 3 A cloud. E. पयस् water, धा to contain, Uṇādi aff. असि.
23238: पयोधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. पयस्, and धा to have, कि aff.
23239: पयोधिक n. (-कं) Cuttle fish bone. E. पयोधि, and कन् aff.
23240: पयोनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. पयस्, and निधि a treasure.
23241: पयोमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud. E. पयस्, and मुच् what lets go.
23242: पयोर m. (-रः) The Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) E. पयस् water, रा to get, aff. क.
23243: पयोराशि f. (-शिः) A piece of water. E. पयस्, and राशि a quantity.
23244: पयोव्रत n. (-तं) Living upon milk for a month, which with prayer and residence in a cow house, is an expiation for receiving an unsuitable present; offering of milk to VIṢṆU, and subsisting upon it for twelve days; also for one or for three days as a religious act. E. पयस् milk, and व्रत religious observance.
23245: पयोष्णी f. (-ष्णी) A river that rises in the Vindhya mountain.
23246: पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Distant, removed, remote. 2 Best, preeminent. 3 Subsequent, after, following. 4 Other, different. 5 Inimical, hostile, estranged, adverse. 6 Addicted to, attached to, engaged in. 7 More, exceeding, as परंशतं more than a hundred, परो लक्षः more than a Lac: these are also considered as distinct compounds, see the next. m. (-रः) 1 An enemy. 2 The life of BRAHMĀ. n. ind. (-रं) 1 Only, alone. 2 After, afterwards. subst. 1 Final beatitude. 2 (In Logic,) One species of common property, that which comprehends many objects, genus; or it is the same with existence, as the common property of all things. E. पॄ to fill, &c. aff. अप्.
23247: परःशत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) More than a hundred, many. E. पर more, and शत a hundred: see the last.
23248: परःसहस्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) More than a thousand. E. पर more, and सहस्र a thousand: see पर.
23249: परःस्वस् ind. (-स्वः) The day after to-morrow. E. पर after, स्वस् tomorrow.
23250: परकलत्र n. (-त्रं) Another's wife. E. पर, and कलत्र a wife.
23251: परकलत्राभिगमन n. (-नं) Intriguing with another man's wife. adultery. E. परकलत्र another's wife, अभिगमन approaching.
23252: परकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Another, belonging to another. f. (-या) The mistress or wife of another, one of the three objects of love, according to the Śṛṅgāra or amatory doctrine. E. पर another, छ aff., कुक् augment.
23253: परक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Another man's wife. 2 Another's body. 3 Another's field. E. पर another, क्षेच a field.
23254: परग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) An articulation, a joint. E. पर after, ग्रन्थि a joining.
23255: परग्लानि f. (-निः) Reduction or subjugation of an enemy. E. पर, and ग्लानि vexing.
23256: परछन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Dependant, subservient, subjected. E. पर another, छन्द inclination.
23257: परछिद्र n. (-द्रं) A fault or defect in another. E. पर, and छिद्र flaw.
23258: परजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Adopted, fostered, nourished by a stranger. 2 Dependant, servile, subjected. E. पर another, and जात born.
23259: परजित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) 1 Nourished by a stranger. 2 Conquered, subdued. E. पर another, and जित conquered, &c.
23260: परञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) 1 An oil press. 2 Froth, foam. 3 The blade of a sword or a knife. 4 A sword or scymitar. f. (-ञ्जा) The sound of instruments at a festival. n. (-ञ्जं) The sword of INDRA. E. पर in the second case, another, and जि to conquer, aff. ड; some works have परज, and others पराञ्ज in place of this word.
23261: परञ्जन m. (-नः) A name of VARUṆA, the regent of water. E. पर another, जि to conquer, deriv. irr.; also परञ्जय.
23262: परञ्जय m. (-यः) VARUṆA: see the last.
23263: परतन्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं) Subservient, obedient, dependant. E. पर another, तन्त्र will.
