23264: परतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Greatest. E. पर, and तमप् aff. of the superlative.
23265: परतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, more. E. पर more, and तरप् aff.
23266: परतस् ind. 1 Afterwards. 2 Behind. 3 Otherwise, differently. E. पर or परा, and अतसुच् aff.
23267: परत्र ind. The next world, futurity. E. पर another, त्रल् aff.
23268: परत्रभीरु m. (-रुः) A pious man, one standing in awe of futurity. E. परच the next world, and भीरु timid.
23269: परत्व m. (-त्वं) 1 Difference, distinction, separateness. 2 Hostility. 3 (In Logic,) Priority of place or time, proximity, juvenility. 4 The nature of common or generic property. E. त्व added to पर; also with तल, परता.
23270: परदार m. (-रः) Another's wife. E. पर, and दार a wife.
23271: परदारगमन n. (-नं) Adultery, adulterous intercourse or intrigue. E. परदार, and गमन frequenting.
23272: परदाराभिमर्ष m. (-र्षः) Intriguing with another man's wife. E. परदार, and अभिमर्ष contact.
23273: परदारोपसेवन n. (-नं) Intriguing with another's wife. E. परदार, and उपसेवन frequenting; also परदारोपसेवा.
23274: परदुःख n. (-खं) The pain or sorrow of another. E. पर, and दुःख pain.
23275: परदेश m. (-शः) A foreign country. E. पर, and देश place.
23276: परदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Foreign, exotic. m. (-शी) 1 A foreigner. 2 One residing abroad. E. परदेश, and इनि aff.
23277: परदेशसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living abroad, travelling, a traveller. E. परदेश, and सेविन् who frequents.
23278: परदोषकीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Scandal, calumny, censoriousness. E. पर, दोष fault, कीर्त्तन proclaiming.
23279: परद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Hostile, inimical, adverse. E. पर another, द्विष to hate, घिणुन् aff.
23280: परद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Another's property. E. पर, and द्रव्य thing.
23281: परद्रोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Tyrannising over another. E. पर, and द्रोहिन् injurious.
23282: परधन n. (-नं) Another's wealth. E. पर, and धन wealth.
23283: परधनास्वादनसुख n. (-खं) Feeding luxuriously at another's expense. E. परधन, आस्वादन eating, सुख pleasure.
23284: परधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Another's duty or business, the occupation of another caste. E. पर, and धर्म्म duty.
23285: परध्यान n. (-नं) Intent absorption or abstraction in the subject of meditation. E. पर, and ध्यान meditating.
23286: परन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Vexing or annoying another, subduing a foe. m. (-पः) A conqueror. E. पर another, तप to heat or inflame, aff. खच्.
23287: परपद n. (-दं) 1 Eminence, high station. 2 Final felicity. E. पर supreme, पद place.
23288: परपरिग्रह m. (-हः) The family or dependants of another. E. पर, and परिग्रह dependants.
23289: परपाक m. (-कः) What is dressed or cooked by another, another's food. E. पर, and पाक cooking.
23290: परपाकनिवृत्त m. (-त्तः) One who dresses his own food without observing, the expiatory sacrifice for the five Sūnas, or places of destruction to animal life: see पञ्चसूना. E. पर another, पाक cooking, and निवृत्त ceased.
23291: परपाकरत m. (-तः) One who observes all the due ceremonies preparatory to cooking, but lives upon others. E. पर another, पाक cooking, रत constant.
23292: परपाकरुचि m. (-चिः) A constant guest at otherś tables. E. पर anothers, पाक cooking, and रुचि shining.
23293: परपिण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Food given by another. E. पर, and पिण्ड ball of rice or meat.
23294: परपिण्डाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Feeding at another's cost. E. पर पिण्ड, and आद who takes.
23295: परपुरुष m. (-षः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 Another man. E. पर supreme, and पुरुष man.
23296: परपुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Fostered, nourished, &c. by a stranger. m. (-ष्टः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. f. (-ष्टा) A harlot, a whore. 2 A parasite plant. E. पर another, पुष्ट cherished.
23297: परपुष्टमहोत्सव m. (-वः) The mango. E. परपुष्ट the cuckoo, महा great, and उत्सव festival.
23298: परपूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A woman, formerly married. E. पर another, (husband,) पूर्व्व prior, fem. aff. टाप्.
23299: परपूर्व्वापति m. (-तिः) The husband of a woman remarried. E. परपूर्व्वा, and पति a husband.
23300: परप्रतिनप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A great-great-grandson. E. पर subsequent, प्रति after, नप्तृ a grandson.
23301: परप्रपौच m. (-चः) A great-great-grandson. E. पर subsequent, प्रपौत्र great-grandson.
23302: परप्रेष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Servitude, slavery. E. पर, and प्रेष्यत्व service.
23303: परब्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) The Supreme Being. E. पर, and ब्रह्म the same.
23304: परभाग m. (-गः) 1 Excellence, superior merit, supremacy. 2 Good fortune, prosperity. 3 The last part, residue, remainder. E. पर best, भाग portion.
23305: परभाग्य n. (-ग्यं) Another's wealth or prosperity. E. पर, and भाग्य good fortune.
23306: परभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Possessed or enjoyed by another. E. पर, and भुक्त enjoyed.
23307: परभूमि f. (-मिः) A foreign or an enemy's country. E. पर, and भूमि land.
23308: परभूमिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Living or being in a foreign or an enemy's country. E. परभूमि, and स्थ who stays.
23309: परभूषण n. (-णं) Another's ornament. m. (-णः) Peace purchased by ceding the produce of lands. E. पर, and भूषण ornament.
23310: परभृत् m. (-भृत्) A crow. E. पर another, (the cuckoo,) and भृत् who nourishes.
23311: परभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished or nourished by a stranger, fostered, adopted. m. (-तः) The Indian cuckoo, which is supposed to leave its eggs in the nest of the crow to be hatched. E. पर another, and भृत nourished.
23312: परभेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Destroying or subduing a foe. E. पर, and भेदक who breaks.
23313: परम् ind. 1 A particle of command. 2 Of dismissal or refusal. 3 Hereafter, afterwards.
23314: परम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Best, most excellent. 2 Chief, principal, preceding. 3 First. ind. (-मं) 1 A term of assent, yes. 2 A term of command. E. पर best, मा to mete, aff. ड or डम्.
23315: परमगति f. (-तिः) 1 Chief object or refuge, as a god, a protector. 2 Final felicity. E. परम, and गति going.
23316: परमगव mf. (-वः-वी) An excellent bull or cow. E. परम, and गो a cow.
23317: परमगहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Very mysterious or profound. E. परम, and गहन thick.
23318: परमत n. (-तं) A different opinion or doctrine. E. पर, and मत thought.
23319: परमपद n. (-दं) 1 Eminence, high station. 2 Final felicity. E. परम, and पद station.
23320: परमब्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) The Supreme Spirit. E. परम, and ब्रह्मन् the same.
23321: परमराज m. (-जः) A supreme monarch. E. परम, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.
23322: परमर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi or divine sage, of a peculiar order or division, comprising the Muni BHELA and others. E. परम excellent, and ऋषि a divine sage.
23323: परमर्म्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) One who knows another's character or disposition. E. पर, and मर्म्म a vital point, and ज्ञ who knows.
23324: परमस्वधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A virtuous or pious man, one who attends scrupulously to the proper duties of his tribe or station. E. परम best, स्व own, धर्म्म virtue or duty, and अनिच् added.
23325: परमहंस m. (-सः) An ascetic, a religious man who has subdued all his senses by abstract meditation. E. परम best or first, हंस devotee.
23326: परमागति f. (-तिः) Translation to heaven, final beatitude. E. परमा best, गति going.
23327: परमाङ्गना f. (-ना) A beautiful woman. E. परम, and अङ्गना a woman.
23328: परमाणु m. (-णुः) 1 An atom, the invisible base of all aggregate bodies; thirty of them are supposed to form a note in a sunbeam; the lowest measure of weight; in Logic, six of them form the first perceptible object. 2 A measure of time, the sun's passage past an atom of matter. E. परम first, and अणु an atom.
23329: परमाणुङ्गक m. (-कः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. परमाणु an atom, अङ्ग the body, कप् aff., deriv. irr.; smaller than the smallest; as he is larger than the largest, &c.
23330: परमात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The Supreme Being, considered as the soul of the universe. E. परम first, आत्मन् spirit or soul.
23331: परमाद्वैत n. (-तं) Pure unitarianism. m. (-तः) VIṢṆU, the only supreme. E. परम, and अद्वैत without duality.
23332: परमान्न n. (-न्न) An oblation of rice to progenitors or gods, boiled with milk and sugar. E. परम best, and अन्न boiled rice; or परम the best, the supreme, (deities, &c.) and अन्न food.
23333: परमापम m. (-मः) 1 The inclination of a planet's orbit to the ecliptic. 2 The sine of the sun's greatest declination. E. परम, and अपम declination.
23334: परमायुष m. (-षः) A particular tree: see असन.
23335: परमायुस् m. (-युः) The longest period of life, either in men or animals. E. परम, and आयुस् life.
23336: परमार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 Truth, fitness. 2 Spiritual knowledge. 3 Any excellent or important aim or object. 4 The best sense. 5 The best kind of wealth. E. परम, and अर्थ object.
23337: परमार्थविद् m. (-वित्) A sage, a philosopher, one who knows the truth. E. परमार्थ, and विद who knows.
23338: परमार्थविन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Who or what acquires knowledge of truth, the best kind of wealth, &c. E. परमार्थ, and विद् to acquire, श aff. and नुम् augment.
23339: परमावधि f. (-धिः) Utmost term or limit. E. परम, and अवधि limit.
23340: परमार्हत m. (-तः) A king and holy saint, apparently the same as ŚĀLIVĀHANA. E. परम excellent, अर्हत a Jina.
23341: परमृत्यु m. (-त्युः) A crow. E. पर another, and मृत्यु death; having many enemies.
23342: परमेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 The Supreme Being. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. f. (-री) DURGĀ. E. परम best, ईश्वर lord.
23343: परमेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Supreme, superior. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A deity. E. परमे, and स्थ who stays or is.
23344: परमेष्ठिन् m. (-ष्ठी) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A Jina or deified teacher of the Jaina sect. 3 A kind of Śālagrāma stone. 4 A Guru or spiritual guide. E. परमे in the most exalted place, in heaven, स्था to be, Uṇādi aff. निन्.
23345: परम्पद n. (-दं) 1 Eternal felicity. 2 The abode of VIṢṆU. E. पर् another, पद degree.
23346: परम्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Successive, proceeding from one to another, from father to son, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 A great-great-grandson. f. (-रा) 1 Race, progeny, lineage. 2 Order, method, continuous arrangement, regular series or succession. E. पर subsequent, repeated, and the nasal augment.
23347: परम्परतस् ind. Mutually. E. परम्पर and तसि aff.
23348: परम्पराक n. (-कं) Immolating animals in sacrifice. E. परम्पर traditionary or successive, and अक going or worshipping; or पर much, पर the best, and अक going, custom.
23349: परम्परीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Hereditary, what has come by inheritance or descent. 2 Traditional. E. परं another, and पर again, another, ख aff.
23350: पररु m. (-रुः) A potherb, (Eclipta prostrata;) also केशराज. E. पर much, रुह to grow, डु aff.
23351: परलोक n. (-कं) Heaven, paradise. E. पर another, and लोक world.
23352: परलोकगम m. (-मः) Death, dying. E. पर another, लोक world, and गम going.
23353: परवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Dependant, subject. E. पर another, मतुप् aff.
23354: परवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Subservient, dependant, subject. 3 Deceived. E. पर another, and वश subjection.
23355: परवाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Reprehensible, blamable. n. (-च्यं) Fault, defect. E. पर, and वाच्य to be named, not to be spoken of.
23356: परवाणि m. (-णिः) 1 A judge, a ruler. 2 A year. 3 The peacock on which the god KĀRTTIKEYA rides. E. पर best, वा to go, णि aff.
23357: परव्रत m. (-तः) A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. पर best, व्रत religious observance.
23358: परश n. (-शं) A kind of gem.
23359: परशव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit or proper for a hatchet. E. परश an axe, यञ् aff.
23360: परशु m. (-शुः) An axe, a hatchet. E. पर another, शु to injure, Uṇādi aff. कु.
23361: परशुधर m. (-रः) 1 A soldier armed with an axe. 2 A name of GAṆEŚA. 3 PARAŚURĀMA: see the next. E. परशु an axe, धर who holds.
23362: परशुराम m. (-मः) A hero and demigod; the first of the three RĀMAS, and the sixth Avatāra or descent of the deity VIṢṆU; who appeared in the world as the son of the saint JAMADAGNI, for the purpose of repressing the tyranny and punishing the violence of the Kṣatriya, or military tribe; PARAŚURĀMA appears to typify the tribe of Brahmans and their contests with the Kṣetriyas. E. परशु an axe, and राम who delights in; also with कन् added, परशुरामक; and with the first member, पर्शु, पर्शुराम, q. v.
23363: परश्वध m. (-धः) An axe, a hatchet. E. पर another, an enemy, श्व derived from श्वि to grow or thrive, परश्व the prosperity of a foe, घे to drink, क aff.; what drinks the blood or destroys the life of an enemy; also पारश्वध and परस्वध.
23364: परश्वस् ind. The day after to-morrow. E. पर after, श्वस् to-morrow; also परःश्वम्.
23365: परसङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Associated with another. 2 Fighting or engaged with another. E. पर, and सङ्गत gone with.
23366: परसंज्ञक m. (-कः) The soul. E. पर best, संज्ञा name or title, aff. कन्.
23367: परसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Relation or connexion with another. E. पर, and सम्वन्ध connexion.
23368: परसम्बन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) 1 Related to another. 2 Belonging to another. E. परसम्वन्ध, and इनि aff.
23369: परस्तात् ind. 1 Subsequently, afterwards. 2 Behind. E. पर, and अस्तातिल् aff.
23370: परस्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mutual, interchanging. E. पर another, repeated; from one to another.
23371: परस्परज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A friend, an intimate. E. परस्पर, and ज्ञ who knows.
23372: परस्परानुमति f. (-तिः) Mutual concurrence or assent. E. परस्पर, and अनुमति agreement.
23373: परस्पराम् ind. Mutually. E. परस्पर, and आम् aff.
23374: परस्परोपकार m. (-रः) 1 Mutual assistance. 2 Offensive and defensive alliance. E. परस्पर, and उपकार aid.
23375: परस्परोपकारिन् m. (-री) 1 An ally. 2 An associate, a helper. E. इनि added to the last.
23376: परस्मैपद n. (-दं) The transitive or active verb. E. परस्मै to another, पद an inflected word.
23377: परस्व n. (-स्वं) Another person's property. E. पर, and स्व own.
23378: परस्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Another's right. E. पर, and स्वत्व own right.
23379: परस्वत्वापादन n. (-नं) Conferring a right upon another as by gift, &c. E. परस्वत्व, and आपादन producing.
23380: परस्वध m. (-धः) An axe: see परश्वध.
23381: परस्वादायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Extortionary, extortioner. E. परस्व, and आदायिन् taking.
23382: परस्वोपजीविक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dependant, living on the property of others. E. परस्व, and उपजीविक subsisting.
23383: परहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Friendly, benevolent. 2 Good or profitable for another. E. पर, and हित favourable.
23384: परा ind. A participle and prefix implying, 1 Supremacy. 2 Liberation. 3 Inverted order. 4 Pride, contumely. 5 Encounter, mutual presence. 6 Excess, exceeding. 7 Overcoming, surpassing. 8 Going. 9 Killing, destroying, injuring. As पराक्रम superior power or valour; पराजय defeat; पराभव disgrace; परावर्त turning back, &c. see the following. E. पॄ to fill, aff. अप् and आ added.
23385: पराक् ind. Crooked, crookedly. E. परा away, अच् to go, aff. क्विप्.
23386: पराक m. (-कः) 1 A religious obligation of an expiatory kind, fasting for twelve days and nights, and keeping the mind attentive, and organs subdued. 2 A sacrificial sword or scimitar. E. पर best, अक what goes.
23387: पराकरण n. (-णं) Disdaining, disregarding, rejecting. E. परा before कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.
23388: पराकुर्व्वन् mfn. (-र्व्वन्-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्) Throwing off or aside, rejecting, disdaining. E. परा, and कुर्व्वन् making.
23389: पराकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rejected, set aside, thrown off, disdained. E. पर, and कृत made.
23390: पराक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Power, strength. 2 Exertion. 3 Valour, prowess. 4 Going out or forth, exit or issue. 5 Attacking an enemy. E. परा supremacy, opposition, &c. and क्रम going.
23391: पराक्रमज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing the power, (of the enemy.) E. पराक्रम, and ज्ञ who knows.
23392: पराग m. (-गः) 1 The pollen or farina of a flower. 2 Dust. 3 Fragrant powder used after bathing. 4 Sandal. 5 The name of a mountain. 6 Fame, celebrity. 7 An eclipse. 8 Following one's own inclinations. E. परा implying supremacy, &c. and ग who goes.
23393: परागवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Laden with pollen. E. पराग, and मतुप् aff.
23394: परागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread, expanded. 2 Budded, blown. E. पर, and आङ् before गम to go, aff. क्त.
23395: परागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Laden with pollen. E. पराग, and इनि aff.
23396: पराङ्गद m. (-दः) A name of ŚIVA. E. पर another, (DURGĀ,) अङ्ग form, and द who gives; forming with the goddess a deity, half male and half female; or better, पर an enemy, KĀMADEVA, अङ्ग body, and द who gives; restoring the body of that deity to shape, after having reduced it to ashes in a rage.
23397: पराङ्गव m. (-वः) Ocean. E. पर another, (river,) अङ्ग substance, water, and व who receives.
23398: पराङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Turning away, having the face averted. E. पराञ्च, and मुख the face.
23399: पराङ्मुखता f. (-ता) Turning away. E. पराङ्मुख, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पराङ्मुखत्वं.
23400: पराचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished or fostered by a stranger. E. पर another, आचित nourished.
23401: पराचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Turned away, having the face averted. E. पराञ्च् or पराच् turned away, ख aff.
23402: पराजय m. (-यः) Defeat. E. परा implying encounter, contest, and जय victory.
23403: पराजयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Overcoming, surpassing, defeating. E. पर before जि to conquer, शानच् aff.
23404: पराजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Conquered, defeated, overcome. 2 Won at dice, &c. E. परा encounter, and जित conquered.
23405: पराञ्च or पराच् mfn. (पराङ् पराची पराक्) Turned away, inverted, reversed. E. परा away, अञ्च to go, aff. क्विन्.
23406: पराञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) 1 An oil mill. 2 Froth or foam. 3 The blade of a sword or knife: see परञ्ज.
23407: परात्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Superior to the best. E. पर in the fifth case, and repeated in the first.
23408: परात्प्रिय m. (-यः) A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
23409: परादन m. (-नः) A horse of the Persian breed. E. परा exceeding, अदन food.
23411: पराधिकार m. (-रः) Another person's office or post. E. पर, and अधिकार superintendence.
23412: पराधिकारचर्च्चा f. (-र्च्चा) Officiousness, interference with another's concerns. E. पराधिकार, and चर्च्चा searching.
23413: पराधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dependant, subject, subservient. E. पर another, and अधीन humble, docile.
23414: पराधीनता f. (-ता) Subjection, dependance. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, पराधीनत्व n. (-त्वं.)
23415: परानसा f. (-सा) The practice of medicine, administering remedies. E. परान enemies, (disease,) षो to destroy, aff. ड; form irr.
23416: परान्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Living at another's expense. n. (-न्नं) Food supplied by another. 2 Food dressed or touched by or belonging to another. E. पर another, अन्न food.
23417: परान्नभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जी) Living at another's cost. E. परान्न, and भोजिन् who eats.
23418: पराप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) A place, &c. whence water has retired. E. पर away, अप water; also परेप.
23419: परापतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Coming back quickly, returning hastily. E. पर, and आङ before पत to go, शतृ aff.
23420: परापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best and worst, prior and posterior, in front and behind, &c. n. (-रं) (In Logic,) Community of property intermediate between the greatest and smallest numbers: species, as being between genus and individual. m. (-रः) A Guru of an intermediate class, a term applied in the Tantras to the goddess DURGĀ. E. पर, and अपर another.
23421: पराभव m. (-वः) 1 Discomfiting, overcoming. 2 Contempt, disrespect, disgrace. 3 Destruction. E. परा disgrace, भू to be, अच् aff.
23422: पराभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Defeated, discomfited, overcome. 2 Degraded, humbled, treated with contempt. E. परा disgrace, and भू been, become, from भू with क्त aff.
23423: परामर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 Discrimination, discriminating, distinguishing, judgment. 2 (In Logic,) Drawing conclusions from analogy or experience. E. परा implying supremacy, &c. मृश to deliberate, घञ् aff.
23424: परामर्ष m. (-र्षः) Forbearance. E. परा, and मृष to bear, aff. घञ्.
23425: परामृत n. (-तं) Raining. E. पर best, अमृत water.
23426: परामृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Weighed, considered, judged. 2 Connected with. 3 Touched or affected by. 4 Borne, endured. E. पर and आङ् before मृश to deliberate, or मृष to bear, क्त aff.
23427: परायण mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Adherence to any pursuit, attachment to any object. 2 Dependance upon. adj. 1 Adhering or attached to. 2 Connected with, depending upon. 3 Wished, desired. n. (-णं) A religious order or division. E. पर only, (one object,) अयन going.
23428: परायत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Dependant, subject. E. पर another, आयत्त tame, humble.
23429: परारि ind. The year before last. E. पर another, (last,) अरि aff. in this sense.
23430: परारित्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Belonging to the year before last. E. परारि as above, and त्न aff.
23431: परारु m. (-रुः) A kind of gourd, (Momordica charantia.) E. वृ to fill or satisfy, आरु aff.
23432: परारुक m. (-कः) A stone or rock. E. परारु a gourd, कन् aff. of comparison.
23433: परार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Having another object or sense, &c. 2 Designed or purposed by another. n. (-र्थं) For the sake or good of another. E. पर, and अर्थ object.
23434: परार्थवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Officious, intermeddling. E. परार्थ, and वादिन् who speaks.
23435: परार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) 1 A great number, a lack of lacks of crores, or a number equal to half the term of BRAHMA'S life, or as many mortal days as are equal to fifty of his years. E. पर, and अर्द्ध half.
23436: परार्द्ध्य mfn. (-र्द्ध्यः-र्द्ध्या-र्द्ध्यं) Excellent, chief, principal, best. n. (-र्द्ध्यं) An immense or infinite number: see the last. E. परा best, अर्द्ध part, यत् aff.
23437: परावज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Indignity, insult, (received.) E. पर, and अवज्ञा disrespect.
23438: परावर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Before and after, prior and subsequent. E. पर, and अवर after.
23439: परावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Retreat, turning back. 2 Exchange, barter. 3 Reversal of a sentence. 4 Restoration. E. परा, वृत to be, aff. अप्.
23440: परावर्त्त्य mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं) 1 To be turned back. 2 To be exchanged. 3 To be reversed, (as a sentence.) 4 To be given back or restored. E. परा, वृत to be, यत् aff.
23441: परावर्त्त्यव्यवहार m. (-रः) Appeal, (in law.) E. परावर्त्त्य to be reversed, व्यवहार judicial procedure.
23442: पराविद्ध m. (-द्धः) A name of KUVERA. E. पर an enemy, आविद्ध frightened; being a very cowardly deity.
23443: परावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Fled, retreated, turned back. 2 Turned round, revolved. 3 Exchanged. 4 Reversed, (as a judgment.) 5 Given back, restored. E. परा before वृत to be, क्त aff.
23444: परावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Returning, retreating, turning back. 2 Revolving. 3 Exchange, barter. 4 Reversion of a judgment. 5 Restoration of property. E. परा before वृत to be, क्तिन् aff.
23445: पराशर m. (-रः) The father of the poet. VYĀSA. E. पर best, शु to complete, with आङ् prefixed, and अप् aff.
23446: पराशरिन् m. (-री) A beggar, a wandering mendicant. E. पराशर the rules of PĀRĀŚARA or VYĀSA, the founder of the tribe, and इनि aff.; also पाराशरिन्.
23447: पराश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dependant or relying upon another. m. (-यः) Dependance. f. (-या) A parasite plant. E. पर another, आश्रय asylum.
23448: पराश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subject, dependant. E. पर, and आश्रित having refuge.
23449: परासन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. पर an enemy, अस to throw or cast, aff. ल्युट्.
23450: परासिसिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) 1 Desirous to throw or send. 2 Wishing to overcome. E. पर before अस to throw, desid. v., उ aff.
23451: परासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Dead, expired. E. पर away, remote, असु vital breath.
23452: परासुता f. (-ता) 1 Death, extinction. 2 Drowsiness, sleepiness. E. परासु, and तल् aff. or with त्व, परासुत्वं.
23453: परास्कन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) A thief, a robber. E. पर another's property. स्कन्द to steal, with आङ् prefix, णिनि aff.
23454: परास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Thrown, tossed. 2 Expelled, turned out. 3 Defeated. E. पर, and अम to throw, क्त aff.
23455: पराह m. (-हः) The next day. E. पर, and अह, for अहन् a day.
23456: पराहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Assailed, attacked. 2 Struck. E. पर, आहत struck.
23457: पराह्न n. (-ह्नं) The afternoon, the latter part of the day. E. पर after, (past,) अह a day.
23458: परि A particle and prefix to words implying. 1 Ubiquity, (all round, on every side.) 2 Part, portion. 3 Abandonment, (away.) 4 End, term. 5 Sickness, infirmity. 6 Enforcement, stress, (even, very, great.) 7 Separateness, several distributions, (each by each, &c.) 8 Embracing, encircling, (round, roundabout.) 9 Depreciation, exposure of faults. 10 Homage, respect. 11 Rejection, turning off or away. 12 Ornament. 13 Diffusion, extension. 14 Mark or sign. 15 Sorrow. 16 Cessation, stop, impediment. 17 Truth. 18 An exclamation of pleasure or satisfaction. As परिकर्त्तुं, to adorn: परिक्षिप्लुं, to abandon; परिछेत्तुं, to divide; परिदेधितुं, to lament; परिक्षिप्लुं, to embrace; परिव्रजितुं, to go about, to wander, &c.: see the following compound nouns. E. पृ to complete, to satisfy, aff. इन; in combination with roots forming nouns by घञ्, the इ of परि is sometimes optionally lengthened, as परी.
23459: परिकथा f. (-था) A work of fiction, a tale, a story, the history or adventures of any fabulous person. E. परि implying ornament, and कथा a tale.
23460: परिकम्प m. (-म्पः) 1 Fear, terror. 2 Trembling. E. परि very great, कम्प a trembling.
23461: परिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what helps or assists. m. (-रः) 1 A bed. 2 Dependants, retinue, train. 3 Multitude, numbers. 4 A firm girth, a waist, a zone or sash. 5 Commencement. 6 Discrimination, judgment. 7 Covert or indirect intimation of wish or purpose. 8 Unusual meaning or expression. E. परि round about, कर making.
23462: परिकर्त्तन n. (-नं) Cutting, cutting off or round, a circular incision. E. परि, and कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.
23463: परिकर्त्तिका f. (-का) Sharp shooting pain, especially in the rectum. E. परि, and कृत to cut, वुन् aff.
23464: परिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Personal decoration, dressing, painting or perfuming the body. 2 Perfuming the person after bathing. 3 Cleansing, purifying. 4 Arithmetical computation. m. (-र्म्मा) A servant, a slave. E. परि implying ornament, and कर्म्मन् business.
23465: परिकर्म्माष्टक n. (-कं) The eight rules of arithmetic. E. परिकर्म्म, and अष्टक eight.
23466: परिकर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) Adorning, decorating. mf. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी) A slave, a servant. E. परिकर्म्म decoration, इनि aff.
23467: परिकल्पन n. (-नं) 1 Contriving, making, inventing. 2 Doing what is necessary, tending, providing food, rest, &c. 3 Dividing. 4 Settling, agreeing upon. E. परि, कृप to be able, ल्युट् aff.
23468: परिकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, invented. 2 Divided. 3 Tended, waited upon, provided with all necessaries. 4 Settled, agreed. E. परि before कृप to be able, क्त aff.
23469: परिकाङ्क्षित m. (-तः) A devotee, a religious ascetic. E. परि gone, काङ्क्षा wish, and इतच् aff.; having no earthly desires.
23470: परिकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Spread, diffused, scattered around or about. E. परि about, कीर्ण scattered.
23471: परिकीर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Saying, telling. 2 Talking of, boasting. E. परि before कीर्त्तन celebrating.
23472: परिकीर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, declared, promulgated. 2 Vaunted or boasted of. E. परि, and कीर्त्तत famed.
23473: परिकूट n. (-टं) A barrier, a trench before the gate of a town, forming a sort of covered way. E. परि round, कूट a fort or house.
23474: परिकृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Emaciate, thin, wasted. E. परि, and कृश thin.
23475: परिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Walking, going. 2 Walking round or about, circumambulating, going about. 3 Roaming, going about. E. परि about, around, क्रम going.
23476: परिक्रमसह m. (-हः) A goat. E. परिक्रम going about, and सह who bears.
23477: परिक्रय m. (-यः) 1 Redemption, purchasing or purchasing back. 2 Giving up part of a treasure to preserve the rest. E. परि, क्री to buy, अच् aff.
23478: परिक्रामत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Going, going round or about. E. परिक्रम to go, round, &c. शतृ aff.
23479: परिक्रिया f. (-या) Enclosing, surrounding with a fence or ditch, &c. intrenching. E. परि round about, क्रिया making.
23480: परिक्लिश m. (-शः) Vexation, trouble. E. परि much, क्लिश to be vexed, क aff.
23481: परिक्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Vexed, annoyed. E. परि before क्लिश to be wearied, क्त aff.
23482: परिक्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wounded, abraded, cut, scratched, &c. E. परि before क्षत broken.
23483: परिक्षति f. (-तिः) Wounding, lesion. E. परि before क्षति rupture.
23484: परिक्षय m. (-यः) Waste, decay, dissolution, destruction. E. परि before क्षि to waste, अच् aff.
23486: परिक्षित् m. (-क्षित्) The name of a king, the son of ABHIMANYU, and grand-son of ARJUNA; see परीक्षित.
23487: परिक्षिपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what scatters, disperses, &c. E. परि before क्षिप to throw, वुञ् aff.
23488: परिक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Surrounded, encircled, intrenched. 2 Scattered, thrown about, diffused. 3 Left, abandoned. E. परि round about, क्षिप to throw, क्त aff.
23489: परिक्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Wasted, worn away, decayed. 2 Diminished, decreased. 3 Lost, destroyed. 4 (In Law,) Insolvent. E. परि, and क्षीण emaciate.
23490: परिक्षीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Drunk. E. परि, and क्षीव drunk.
23491: परिक्षेप m. (-पः) Scattering, spreading, diffusion. 2 Surrounding. 3 Abandoning, leaving. E. परि about, क्षेप throwing.
23492: परिक्षेपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Who or what scatters or distributes, &c. E. परि about, क्षिप to throw, घिनुण् aff.
23493: परिखा f. (-खा) A moat, a ditch surrounding a fort, &c. E. परि round, खन to dig, aff. ड.
23494: परिख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Famous, celebrated. E. परि before ख्यात said.
23495: परिख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, reputation. E. परि on every side, ख्याति notoriety.
23496: परिगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reckoned, calculated. E. परि, and गणित counted.
23497: परिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Sought, inquired after. 3 Obtained, gained. 4 Forgotten. 5 Diffused, spread. 6 Obstructed, detained. 7 Encircled, encompassed. E. परि about, &c. and गत gone, become.
23498: परिगम m. (-मः) 1 Surrounding. 2 Seeking for. 3 Knowing, ascertaining. 4 Obtaining. 5 Spreading, extending. E. परि before गम to go, अच् aff.; also with ल्युट्, परिगमनं.
23499: परिगमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought, conducted, driven. E. परि, and गम to go, causal v., क्त aff.
23500: परिगलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Flowing, fluid. 2 Melted. E. परि before गल to ooze, aff. क्त.
23501: परिगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, accepted. 2 Assented, consented to. 3 Obeyed. 4 Opposed, checked. E. परि before ग्रह to take, क्त aff.
23502: परिगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be taken or accepted. 2 To be regarded. f. (-ह्या) A woman. ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Considering, looking upon. E. परि encircling, ग्रह to take, aff. यत् or ल्यप्.
23503: परिग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Acceptance, taking. 2 Assent, consent. 3 Dependants, a family, a train or retinue. 4 A wife. 5 Root, origin. 6 An oath. 7 The reserve of an army, a corps posted with the general, four hundred yards in the rear of the line: see प्रतिग्रह. 8 Maintaining, observing. 9 Continued possession, continuance. 10 Subjugation, making subservient or subject. 11 Connexion, concern, business or interference with. 12 Comprehension. 13 The sun near the moon's node. E. परि intensitive prefix, or round about, &c. and ग्रह taking.
23504: परिग्राह m. (-हः) A mound or place prepared for a burnt offering at a ceremony which requires three or four such places, placed to the north or east, &c. as उत्तरपरिग्राह, पूर्व्वपरिग्राह. E. परि about, ग्रह to take, aff. घञ्.
23505: परिग्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearied out, exhausted. E. परि intensitive, ग्लान wearied.
23506: परिघ m. (-घः) 1 A bludgeon, a stick mounted with iron, or an iron club. 2 Killing, striking, destroying. 3 The nineteenth of the astronomical Yogas. 4 The pin or bolt of a door. 5 A glass vessel. 6 A pike, a spear. 7 A water jar. 8 The outer door or gate of a palace: see पलिघ. E. परि round about, हन to kill, अप् aff., घ substituted for the root.
23507: परिघट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed repeatedly. 2 Much handled or touched. E. परि, and घट्टित rubbed.
23508: परिघात m. (-तः) 1 Killing, striking. 2 A weapon. E. परि completely, हन to kill, aff. घञ्, and the root changed.
23509: परिघातन n. (-नं) 1 Striking, hurting, killing. 2 A staff or bludgeon armed with iron. E. परि before हन to kill, aff. ल्युट्.
23510: परिघोष m. (-षः) 1 Sound. 2 Improper or blameable discourse. 3 The muttering or grumbling of clouds. E. परि intensitive or depreciative prefix, and घोष sound.
23511: परिचय m. (-यः) 1 Acquaintance, intimacy. 2 Accumulation. 3 Meeting with a friend. E. परि about, चि to gather, aff. अच्.
23512: परिचयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be known. 2 To be collected. E. परि before चि to heap, aff. अनीयर्.
23513: परिचर m. (-रः) 1 A guard, a body-guard. 2 An attendant, a companion, a servant. 3 A commander-in-chief. E. परि about, and चर who goes.
23514: परिचर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) 1 Service, dependance. 2 Veneration, worship. E. परि about, चर to go, aff. क्यप्.
23515: परिचाय्य m. (-य्यः) 1 A place for preparing or holding a sacrificial fire. 2 Sacrificial fire in general. 3 Raising the rent or revenue of land. E. परि worship, &c. चि to collect, aff. ण्यत, form specifick.
23516: परिचारक m. (-ऊः) A servant, an attendant. E. परि before, चर to go, ण्वुल् aff.
23517: परिचार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-य्य) To be served or obeyed, to be worshipped. E. परि before चर to go, ण्यत aff.
23518: परिचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, acquainted with. 2 Heaped, accumulated. E. परि before चि to collect, क्त aff.
23519: परिचेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्य) 1 To be known, fit or proper to be known as an acquaintance. 2 To be collected together. E. परि, and चेतव्य to be gathered.
23520: परिचेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be collected all round, or from every side. 2 To be known as an acquaintance. E. परि before चि to collect, aff. ण्यत्.
23521: परिच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lost, gone, deprived or devoid of. E. परि, and च्युत fallen.
23522: परिच्छद m. (-दः) 1 Court, train, attendants, retinue. 2 Family, dependants. 3 Goods and chattels, personal property. 4 Dress, paraphernalia. 5 Covering. 6 Clothes. E. परि round, छद to cover, aff. (-घ.)
23523: परिच्छन्द m. (-न्दः) Retinue, train. E. परि around, छद to cover, aff. अच्.
23524: परिछन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Covered, clothed. 2 Invested, enclosed. 3 Having a retinue or paraphernalia. E. परि before छद to cover, क्त aff.
23525: परिछित्ति f. (-त्तिः) Partition, separation, &c.: see परिछेद.
23526: परिछिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Detached, divided, cut off. 2 Resisted, remedied. E. परि before छिद to cut, क्त aff.
23527: परिछेद m. (-दः) 1 Segment, division, cutting or severing. 2 Discrimination. 3 Limit, boundary. 4 Obviating, remedying. 5 The division of a book, a section or chapter. 6 Moderation. E. परि successively, severally, छेद cutting.
23528: परिछेदन n. (-नं) 1 Dividing, division. 2 Discriminating. 3 The division of a book. 4 Laughter, expressive of joy. E. परि before छिद to divide, aff. ल्युट्.
23529: परिजन m. (-नः) 1 Dependants, servants, family, followers. 3 Train, retinue. E. परि about, and जन a person.
23530: परिजल्पित n. (-तं) The covert reproaches of a mistress neglected or ill used by her lover. E. परि, and जल्पित prattling.
23531: परिज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, ascertained. E. परि, and ज्ञात known.
23532: परिज्ञातृ mfn. (-ता-ची-तृ) Wise, intelligent, one who has knowledge. E. परि before ज्ञा to know, तृच् aff.
23533: परिज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge, ascertainment, discrimination. E. परि, and ज्ञान knowledge.
23534: परिज्ञाय ind. Having known or ascertained. E. परि, and ज्ञाय having known.
23535: परिज्मन् m. (-ज्मा) 1 The moon. 2 Fire. E. परि about, जन to be born, Uṇādi aff. मन्, form irr.
23536: परिज्वन् m. (-ज्वा) 1 INDRA. 2 Fire. E. परि before, जु to be quick, Uṇādi aff. वन्.
23537: परिडीनक n. (-कं) The flight of a bird in circles. E. परि round, डीन or डीनक flying.
23538: परिणत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ripe, mature. 2 Bowed, bent. 3 Aimed at, directed to, inclined to. m. (-तः) An elephant stooping to strike with his tusks. n. (-तं) Capital, stock, wealth accumulated for the sake of profit. E. परि before नम to bend or bow, aff. क्त.
23539: परिणति f. (-तिः) Bending, bowing. E. परि before, नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.
23540: परिणय m. (-यः) Marriage. E. परि successively or individually, णी to take, अच् aff.; also with ल्युट् aff. परिणयन.
23541: परिणाम m. (-मः) 1 Change of form or state. 2 Maturity, fulness, ripeness. 3 End, last stage or state. E. परि before नम to bend, aff. घञ्.
23542: परिणामदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Who looks forward or to the end. E. परिणाम, and दर्शिन् who sees.
23543: परिणामनिरोध m. (-धः) Human vicissitude; as birth, growth, death, &c. E. परिणाम, and निरोध obstruction, (of final felicity.)
23544: परिणामपथ्य mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं) Suited to a future stage or condition. E. परिणाम, and पथ्य good for.
23545: परिणामशूल m. (-लः) Flatulence with pain or vomiting after eating, dyspepsia. E. परिणाम, and शूल colic.
23546: परिणाय m. (-यः) 1 Leading or taking round. 2 Moving a piece at chess, draughts, &c. E. परि about, णी to take, aff. घञ्.
23547: परिणायक m. (-कः) A husband. E. परि before, णी to take, ण्वुल् aff.
23548: परिणाह m. (-हः) Width, breadth. 2 Circumference of a circle. E. परि extension, नह to bind, aff. घञ्.
23549: परिणिंसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what eats of feeds upon. 2 Who or what kisses. E. परि before, निसि to kiss, वुन् aff.
23550: परिणिंसा f. (-सा) 1 Eating. 2 Kissing. E. परि before निसि to kiss, अङ् and टाप् affixes.
23551: परिणिनंसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Seeking to take or lay hold of. E. परि, नश to lose, उ aff. desid. v.
23552: परिणीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Married. E. परि before णी to take, क्त aff.
23553: परिणेतृ m. (-ता) A husband. E. परि before णी to take, तृच् aff.
23554: परितस् ind. Around, every way, all round. E. परि round, and तसि aff.
23555: परिताप m. (-पः) 1 Pain, anguish. 2 Sorrow. 3 A division of hell. 4 Heat, warmth. 5 Fear. 6 Trembling. E. परि exceeding, ताप burning.
23556: परितुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pleased, delighted. E. परि much, तुष्ट pleased.
23557: परितोष m. (-षः) Pleasure, satisfaction, delight. E. परि entirely, तोष pleasure.
23558: परित्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Void or deprived of, left, quitted, abandoned. 2 Let go, let fly as an arrow. E. परि, and त्यक्त left.
23559: परित्यजन n. (-नं) 1 Distributing, dispersing. 2 Abandoning. E. परि about, त्यज to abandon, ल्युट् aff.
23560: परित्यज्य ind. Having abandoned. E. परि before त्यज to leave, ल्यप् aff.
23561: परित्याग m. (-गः) 1 Abandonment, quitting, desertion. 2 Loss, privation. E. परि away, त्याग quitting.
23562: परित्यागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Abandoning, quitting. E. परि before त्यज to quit, णिनि aff.
23563: परित्याज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be left or abandoned. E. परि before त्यज to leave, ण्यत् aff.
23564: परित्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Afraid. E. परि much, चल alarmed.
23565: परित्राण n. (-णं) 1 Warding a blow, self-defence. 2 Preserving, protecting. E. परि about, त्राण preserving.
23566: परिदर m. (-रः) Sponginess of the gums. E. परि, and दर rending.
23567: परिदहन n. (-नं) Scorching, burning. E. परि, and दह to burn, aff. ल्युट्.
23568: परिदान n. (-नं) Barter, exchange, returning any thing or its equivalent. E. परि reciprocally, दान giving.
23569: परिदाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Hot, scorching. E. परि before दह to burn, घिणुन् aff.
23570: परिदेवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what laments or complains. E. परि before दिव to play, ण्वुल् aff.
23571: परिदेवन nf. (-नं-ना) Lamentation, complaint, bewailing. 2 Fearing. E. परि implying grief, देवन showing, playing.
23572: परिदेवित n. (-तं) Lamentation. E. परि before देव to play, क्त aff.
23573: परिदेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Lamenting. 2 Fearing, apprehensive. E. परि before दिव to play, घिणुन् aff.
23574: परिधान n. (-नं) 1 A lower garment. 2 Vesture, clothes. E. परि about, round, धान having.
23575: परिधाय m. (-यः) 1 Retinue, attendants. 2 The posteriors. 3 A piece of water. E. परि circling, surrounding, धा to have, घञ् aff., and युक् augment.
23576: परिधि m. (-धिः) 1 The circumference of a circle. 2 The disk of the sun or moon. 3 The periphery of a wheel. 4 A circle surrounding the globe, a great circle. 5 An epicycle. 6 The branch of the tree to which the victim at a sacrifice is tied. 7 A wooden frame round the hole in which a sacrificial fire is lighted. E. परि around, धा to have, कि aff.
23577: परिधिस्थ m. (-स्थः) 1 A guard, a body-guard. 2 An aide-de-camp, an officer attendant on the king or general. E. परिधि around, (the king,) स्थ who stands.
23578: परिधूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perfumed. E. परि, and धूपित perfumed.
23579: परिध्वंस m. (-सः) 1 Injury, destruction. 2 A man of a mixed caste, E. परि before ध्वंस to lose, अच् aff.
23580: परिनिर्व्वपन n. (-नं) Distributing, dispensing, giving. E. परि and निर् before वप to give, ल्युट् aff.
23581: परिनिर्विवप्सा f. (-प्सा) Liberality, wish to give. E. परि and निर् before वप to give, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् aff.
23582: परिनिर्विवप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous of giving. E. परि and निर् before वप give, उ aff. desid. v.
23583: परिनिष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Skilled in, acquainted with. E. परि and नि before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
23584: परिन्यास m. (-सः) Completing the sense of a passage. E. परि, and न्यास position.
23585: परिपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) 1 Cooked, dressed. 2 Mature. 3 Shrewd, knowing. 4 Digested. E. परि before पक्व ripe.
23586: परिपक्वता f. (-ता) 1 Being dressed or cooked. 2 Maturity, perfection. 3 Shrewdness. 4 Digestion. E. तल् added to the last.
23587: परिपण n. (-णं) Capital, principal, stock. E. परि severally, पण price.
23588: परिपणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pledged, plighted, agreed, promised. E. परि, and पण to pledge, क्त aff.
23589: परिपदिन् n. (-दी) An enemy. E. परि against, पद to go, इनि aff.
23590: परिपन्थक m. (-कः) An enemy, an antagonist. E. परि opposition, पन्थक who goes.
23591: परिपन्थिन् m. (-न्थी) 1 An enemy, an antagonist. 2 A robber, a highwayman, a bandit. E. परि obstacle or opposition, पन्थिन् who goes the road.
23592: परिपाक m. (-कः) 1 Being cooked or dressed. 2 Maturity, perfection. 3 Cleverness, shrewdness. 4 Digestion. 5 The fruit or consequence of actions. E. परि before पच to cook or ripen, घञ् aff.
23593: परिपाकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Who or what cooks, ripens, digests, &c. f. (-नी) A drug, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. परि completely, पच to ripen, aff. णिनि, fem. aff. ङीप्.
23594: परिपाटि f. (-टिः-टी) 1 Order, method, arrangement. 2 Arithmetic. E. परि several distribution, पाटि proceeding, from पठ to go, in the causal form, aff. इन्.
23595: परिपालन n. (-नं) Protecting, cherishing. E. परि, and पालन the same.
23596: परिपालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, cherished. E. परि, and पालित protected.
23598: परिपुटन n. (-नं) Peeling, desquamation. E. परि before पुट to reduce, and ल्युट् aff.
23599: परिपुष्करा f. (-रा) A sort of cucumber, (C. madraspatanus.)
23600: परिपूजन n. (-नं) Worshipping, adoring. E. परि before पूज to worship, ल्युट् aff.; also परिपूजा.
23601: परिपूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Served, worshipped, adored. E. परि, पूज to worship, क्त aff.
23602: परिपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pure, purified. 2 Winnowed, threshed, freed from the chaff. E. परि, and पूत pure.
23603: परिपूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Full, entire, complete. 2 Satisfied, content. E. परि quite, पूर्ण full.
23604: परिपूर्णता f. (-ता) 1 Completion, entireness, fulness. 2 Satiety or satisfaction. E. परि completely. पूर्णता fulness.
23605: परिपूर्णत्व n. (-त्वं) Completion, &c.: see the last. E. परि, and पूर्णत्व fulness.
23606: परिपेल n. (-लं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. परि extension, पेल to go, aff. अच्.
23607: परिपेलव n. (-वं) A grass: see the last. E. as above, वन् added.
23608: परिप्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desiring, seeking. E. परि, and प्र before आप to obtain, उ aff. desid. v.
23609: परिप्रेषण n. (-णं) Abandoning, leaving, sending or putting away. E. परि before प्रेष to send, aff. ल्युट्.
23610: परिप्रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left, put or sent away. E. परि before प्रेष to send, क्त aff.
23611: परिप्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Shaking, trembling. 2 Unsteady, restless, moveable. m. (-वः) 1 Bathing, wetting with water, immersing, inundation. 2 Oppression, tyranny. E. परि about, प्लव what goes, from प्लु to go, aff. अप्.
23612: परिप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Immersed, inundated. 2 Wetted, bathed. f. (-ता) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. परि every where, प्लु to go, aff. क्त.
23613: परिबर्ह m. (-र्हः) 1 Retinue, train. 2 Insignia of royalty. 3 Wealth. 4 Thing, substance. E. परि about, or a mark, a sign, बर्ह to cover, घञ् aff.
23614: परिभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Breaking to pieces, shattering. E. परि, and भङ्ग a breaking.
23615: परिभव m. (-वः) 1 Disrespect, contempt, disgrace. 2 Defeat, discomfiture. E. परि implying depreciation, and भव being; also परिभाव.
23616: परिभवपद n. (-दं) Disgrace, a disgraceful situation. E. परिभव, and पद degree.
23617: परिभवास्पद n. (-दं) A situation of disgrace or defeat. E. परिभव, and आस्पद situation.
23618: परिभविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Treating with contumely or disrespect. 2 Suffering disrespect. E. परि before भू to be, णिनि aff. der. irr. or परिभव, and इनि aff.
23620: परिभाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Irreverent, disrespectful. 2 Putting to shame, surpassing. E. परि before भू to be, घिणुन् aff.
23621: परिभावुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Who or what shames or humbles another. E. परि before भू to be, उकञ् aff.
23622: परिभाषण n. (-णं) 1 Reproof, abuse, ridicule, expression of censure or contempt. 2 Addressing, discourse, conversing. 3 Agreement, engagement. 4 Rule, precept. E. परि exposure of faults, or mutually, &c., भाषण speaking.
23623: परिभाषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Reprehensible, liable to or deserving reproof. 2 To be addressed or spoken to. E. परि before भाष to speak, अनीयर् aff.
23624: परिभाषा f. (-षा) 1 A technicality, a conventional term in any science. 2 (In Grammar,) A maxim given by the ancient grammarians as a summary interpretation of the rules of PĀṆINI. 3 (In Medicine,) Prognosis. 4 Abuse, ridicule. E. परि severally, and भाषा speech.
23625: परिभाषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said. 2 Formed or used technically. E. परि, भाष to speak, क्त aff.
23626: परिभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Enjoyed, possessed. E. परि, and भुज to enjoy, क्त aff.
23627: परिभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Treated with contempt or disrespect, disregarded, despised. E. परि exposure of fault, and भूत become.
23628: परिभूय ind. Disgracing, shaming, outvieing, having disgraced, &c. E. परि before भू to be, ल्यप् aff.
23629: परिभोक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्ती-क्तृ) 1 One who uses another's property without leave. 2 Possessing, one who possesses or enjoys. E. परि, and भुज to enjoy, तृच् aff.
23630: परिभोग m. (-गः) 1 Using or living upon another person's property without leave or improperly. 2 Possession, enjoyment. E. परि, भुज to enjoy, aff. घञ्.
23631: परिभ्रम m. (-मः) 1 Wandering, going about. 2 Error. E. परि before भ्रम to roam, घञ् aff.; also with ल्युट्, परिभ्रमणं.
23632: परिभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Fallen, degraded, deprived of. E. परि, and भ्रष्ट fallen.
23633: परिमण्डल n. (-लं) A ball, a globe, a circle. E. परि round, and मण्डल a sphere or circumference.
23634: परिमण्डलता f. (-ता) Rotundity, circularity. E. परिमण्डल, and तल् aff.; also परिमण्डलत्वं, with त्व aff.
23635: परिमण्डलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rounded, made round or circular. E. परिमण्डल, and इतच् aff.
23636: परिमन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) 1 Little, a little, not much. 2 Slow. 3 Dull. E. परि, and मन्द slow.
23637: परिमर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, grinding. 2 Embracing, pressing. 3 Trampling or destroying. E. परि, and मर्द्दन rubbing.
23638: परिमल m. (-लः) 1 An exquisite scent, especially arising from the trituration of fragrant substances. 2 The trituration of perfumes. 3 Copulation. 4 A meeting of learned men. 5 Soil, stain, dirt. E. परि extension, मल to increase, aff. अच्.
23639: परिमलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Soiled, despoiled of freshness or beauty. 2 Perfumed. E. परिमल, and इतच् aff.
23640: परिमर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 Contact, propinquity. 2 Friction. E. परि, and मृश to touch, घञ् aff.
23641: परिमर्ष m. (-र्षः) Envy, dislike. E. परि before मृष to bear, aff. घञ्.
23642: परिमार्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Friction. 2 Touch. 3 Cleaning, wiping. E. परि before मृज to clean, घञ् aff.
23643: परिमार्गितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be sought after. E. परि before मार्ग to search, तव्य aff.
23644: परिमार्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) 1 To be cleaned or cleansed. 2 To be rubbed. E. परि completely, मृज to clean, ण्यत् aff.; also परिमृज्य.
23645: परिमाण m. (-णं) 1 Measure. 2 Measuring. E. परि completely, and माण measuring.
23646: परिमाणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be measured. E. परि, before, मा to measure, अनीयर् aff.; also परिमातव्य and परिमेय.
23647: परिमार्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Cleaning, cleansing. 2 A dish of honey and oil. E. परि completely, मृज to cleanse, aff. ल्युट्.
23648: परिमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined. 2 Meted, measured. 3 Regulated. E. परि, मा to measure, क्त aff.
23649: परिमितभुज् mfn. (-क्) Temperate, abstemious. E. परिमित, and भुज् who eats or enjoys.
23650: परिमिताहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Eating moderately. E. परिमित, and आहार food.
23651: परिमृज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 1 To be cleaned. 2 To be touched. E. परि before मृज to clean, aff. क्यप्; also परिमार्ग्यं.
23652: परिमृदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed, ground. 2 Embraced, clasped. E. परि before मृद to rub, क्त aff.
23653: परिमृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Rubbed, touched. 2 Embraced, clasped. 3 Invested. 4 Spread, pervaded. E. परि before मृष to rub, क्त aff.
23654: परिमृष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) 1 Envying. 2 Rubbing. E. परि before मृष to bear, शतृ aff.
23655: परिमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measurable, to be measured. E. परि before मा to measure, यत् aff.
23656: परिमोषिन् m. (-षी) A thief, a robber. E. परि every where, मुष to steal, aff. घिणुन्.
23657: परिमोहन n. (-नं) Fascinating, beguiling. E. परि, and भोहन fascinating.
23658: परिमोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) What is bewitching, fascinating, &c. E. परि before मुह to be foolish, घिणुन् aff.
23659: परिम्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Soiled, stained. 2 Waned, withered. 3 Diminished, impaired. n. (-नं) 1 Soil. 2 Change of countenance by fear or grief. E. परि, and म्लान dirty.
23660: परिरक्षण n. (-णं) Guarding, defending, preserving. E. परि around, and रक्षण preserving.
23661: परिरटन n. (-नं) Crying, crying aloud. E. परि before रट to cry, and ल्युट् aff.
23662: परिरब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Embraced. 2 Encircled. E. परि before रभ to begin, क्त aff.
23663: परिरभमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Embracing. E. परि, and रभ to begin, शानच् aff.
23664: परिरभ्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being embraced. E. परि every where, रभ to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.
23665: परिरम्भ m. (-म्भः) Embrace, embracing. E. परि about, रभ to begin, aff. घञ्, and नुम् augment.
23666: परिरम्भन n. (-नं) Embracing. E. परि before रभ to begin, ल्युट् aff.
23667: परिराटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) Crying, crying aloud, screaming, &c. E. परि before रट to cry, घिणुन् aff.
23668: परिरिप्समान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wishing or trying to embrace. E. परिरभि to embrace, desid. v. शानच् aff.
23669: परिलुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Gone, lost. E. परि completely, लुप्त lost.
23670: परिलुप्तसञ्ज्ञ mfn. (-ञ्ज्ञः-ञ्ज्ञा-ञ्ज्ञं) Senseless. E. परिलुप्त, and सञ्ज्ञा sign of life.
23671: परिवत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. परि end, वत्सर a year.
23672: परिवदन n. (-नं) 1 Reviling, accusing. 2 Crying out, clamouring, screaming. E. परि, and वद to speak, aff. ल्युट्.
23673: परिवर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Quitting, abandonment. E. परि finally, वृज to shun, aff. ल्युट्.
23674: परिवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abandoned. 2 Devoid of. E. परि before वृज to shun, क्त aff.
23675: परिवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Going or turning back. 2 Turning round, revolving. 3 Flight, retreat, desertion. 4 Exchange, barter. 5 Requital, return. 6 The end of a period of four ages, or destruction of the world. 7 A chapter, a book, a canto, &c. 8 The king of the tortoises, or the tortoise incarnation. E. परि severally, &c. वृत to be, aff. अप्.
23676: परिवर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Who or what turns back or round. 2 Who or what requites, exchanges, &c. 3 Leaving off a thing begun for some other object. E. परि, and वृत to be, ण्वुल् aff.
23677: परिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Turning back or round, returning. 2 Turning round, revolving. 3 Barter, exchange. 4 Requital, return. 5 Inverting, taking or putting any thing in a wrong direction. E. परि around, &c. वर्त्तन being.
23678: परिवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Turned round, revolved. 2 Returned, retreated. 3 Taken or put on in a wrong direction. 4 Exchanged. E. परि before वृत to be, क्त aff.
23679: परिवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ति-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 1 Revolving, going round. 2 Returning. 3 Flying, retreating. 4 Exchanging. 5 Requiting, recompensing. E. परि, and वृत to be, णिनि aff.
23680: परिवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Growing, increasing. 2 Rearing, breeding, (as of cattle.) E. परि, and वर्द्धन increasing.
23681: परिवर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Increased, augmented. E. परि before वृद्ध to increase, क्त aff.
23682: परिवर्ह m. (-र्हः) 1 Train, retinue, dependants. 2 Royal insignia. E. परि around, वर्ह to cover, घञ् aff.; also परिबर्ह.
23683: परिवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. परि about, वसथ a village.
23684: परिवाद m. (-दः) 1 Abuse, reproach, reproof. 2 Charge, accusation. 3 The bow or quill of the lute or fiddle. E. परि censure, &c. and वाद speech.
23685: परिवादक m. (-कः) An accuser, a plaintiff, a complainant or calumniator. E. परि implying censure, वद to speak, वुञ् aff.
23686: परिवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Who or what reproaches, accuses, &c. 2 Censured, abused. 3 Calling out, crying, screaming. m. (-दी) An accuser, a reprover; (in Law,) a plaintiff. f. (-नी) A lute or a Vīṇā, with seven strings. E. परिवाद as above, इनि aff. or परि before वद to speak, धिणुन् aff.
23687: परिवाप m. (-पः) 1 Shaving, shearing. 2 A pool, a pond, a piece of water. 3 Train, retinue. E. परि before, वप to shave, aff. घञ्.
23688: परिवापन n. (-नं) Shaving, shearing. E. परि before, वप to cut or shave, causal v. aff. ल्युट्.
23689: परिवापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaven, shorn. E. परिवाप shaving, aff. इतच्.
23690: परिवार m. (-रः) 1 Dependant. 2 Train or retinue. 3 A scabbard, a sheath. E. परि round, वृ to be, aff. घञ्.
23691: परिवारता f. (-ता) Subjection, dependance. E. तल् added to परिवार.
23692: परिवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, enclosed or begirt by. E. परि, and वारित impeded.
23693: परिवास m. (-सः) Abiding, abode. E. परि, and वस to dwell, घञ् aff.
23694: परिवासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Respectfully attentive to superiors. E. परि respect, वस to abide, aff. क्त, and इट inserted.
23695: परिवाह m. (-हः) 1 An inundation, an overflowing, natural or artificial. 2 A water course or a drain to carry off excess of water. E. परि about, वह to bear, aff. घञ्; also परीवाह.
23696: परिवाहवत् m. (-वान्) A pond or pool. E. परिवाह a drain, and मतुप् poss. aff.
23697: परिवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drained. E. परिवाह, and इतच् aff.
23698: परिविण्ण m. (-ण्णः) An unmarried elder brother whose junior is married. E. परि before विद to know, क्त aff.
23699: परिवित्ति m. (-त्तिः) An unmarried elder brother, the younger being married and a householder. E. परि abandoning, and विद to cover, aff. क्तिच्.
23700: परिविन्दक m. (-कः) A younger brother married or become a householder before the elder. E. परि, विद to possess, क्वुन् aff.
23701: परिविन्दत् m. (-न्दन्) An unmarried elder brother. E. परि before विद to know, शतृ aff.
23702: परिविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Surrounded, enclosed. 2 Offered, presented. E. परि, and विष to enter, क्त aff.
23703: परिविष्णु ind. Entirely or every where VIṢṆU. E. परि round, विष्णु VIṢṆU.
23704: परिविह्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Agitated, bewildered. E. परि, and विह्वल agitated.
23705: परिविह्वलता f. (-ता) Bewilderment. E. परिविह्वल, and तल् aff.
23706: परिवीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Surrounded, encompassed, invested. 2 Overspread, pervaded. n. (-तं) The bow of BRAHMĀ. E. परि, and वी to go, क्त aff.
23707: परिवृंहण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Augmenting, enlarging, what enlarges or adds to. m. (-णः) An appendix, an additional work or section. E. वृहि to increase, with परि prefixed, and ल्युट् aff.
23708: परिवृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Increased, augmented. 2 Improved, thriven. 3 Sounded. 4 Lightened, illuminated. 5 Excited, stimulated. E. परि before वृहि to augment, aff. क्त.
23709: परिवृढ m. (-ढः) A master, an owner, a superior. E. परि exceeding, वृह to thrive, aff. क्त.
23710: परिवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Encompassed, surrounded. 2 Gained or received entirely. 3 Known. E. परि before वृ to be, aff. क्त.
23711: परिवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Gone round, revolved. 2 Turned back, retreated, retired. 3 Exchanged. 4 Finished, ended. E. परि before वृत to be, aff. क्त.
23712: परिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Exchange, barter. 2 Revolution, return. 3 End, termination. 5 An unmarried elder brother: see परिवित्ति. 4 Surrounding, encompassing. E. परि mutually, वृत to be, क्तिच् aff.
23713: परिवृत्य ind. 1 Having retreated or retired. 2 Having turned round or revolved. E. परि before वृत to be, ल्यप् aff.
23714: परिवृस्ति m. (-स्तिः) An elder brother unmarried: see परिवित्ति.
23715: परिवृहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Increased, literally or figuratively, grown, thriven. 2 Making effort, exerted. E. परि much, वृह to grow, aff. क्त.
23716: परिवेत्तृ m. (-त्ता) A younger brother married or become a householder before his elder. E. परि abandoning, (the usual practice,) विद to know or possess, (a wife,) तृच् aff.
23717: परिवेदन n. (-नं) 1 Anguish, pain, misery. 2 Marriage, marrying. 3 Discussion. 4 Gain, acquisition. f. (-ना) 1 Shrewdness, wit. 2 Foresight, prudence. E. परि before, विद to know, &c. aff. ल्युट्, or युच्.
23718: परिवेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Shrewd, knowing. 2 Suffering pain. f. (-नी) The wife of a younger brother, the elder brother being unmarried. E. परि, and विद to know, aff. घिणुन्.
23719: परिवेश m. (-शः) 1 Surrounding, encompassing. 2 The circumference of a circle. 2 The disk of the sun or moon. E. परि round, विश or विष to encompass, aff. अच्; hence also परिवेष.
23720: परिवेष m. (-षः) 1 Surrounding, encircling. 2 The circumference of a circle. 3 The disk of the sun or moon. 4 Distributing rice, &c. to a party, serving up a meal: see the last.
23721: परिवेषण n. (-णं) 1 Surrounding, enclosing. 2 Serving up dinner, distributing food to guests, &c. E. परि round, वेषण encompassing.
23722: परिवेष्टन n. (-नं) 1 Surrounding, encompassing. 2 Circumference. E. परि before वेष्ट to surround, ल्युट् aff.
23723: परिवेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Enclosed, surrounded, encompassed. 2 Covered, veiled. E. परि around, and वेष्टित surrounded.
23724: परिव्याध m. (-धः) 1 A tree, (Pterospermum acerifolia.) 2 A sort of reed growing in water, (Calamus fasciculatus.) E. परि much, व्याध pain.
23725: परिव्रज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 Ascetic devotion, religious austerity, abandonment of the world. 2 Leading the life of a mendicant. E. परि about, व्रज्या religious wandering.
23726: परिव्रढिमन् m. (-मा) Masterhood, superiority. E. परिवृढ, and इमनिच् aff., ऋ changed to र.
23727: परिव्राज् m. (-ड् or ट्) The man of the last religious order, the mendicant devotee. E. परि about, व्रज to go, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel made long; also with घञ् aff. परिव्राज.
23728: परिव्राज m. (-जः) An ascetic: see the last.
23729: परिव्राजक m. (-कः) A religious mendicant. E. परि about, व्रज to wander, ण्वुल् aff.
23730: परिव्राज्य n. (-ज्यं) The state or condition of an ascetic. E. परिव्राज् as above, and यत् aff.
23731: परिशङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be doubted, to be feared or apprehended. E. परि completely, शकि to doubt, अनीयर् aff.
23732: परिशाप m. (-पः) Cursing, reviling. E. परि before शप to curse, घञ् aff.
23733: परिशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Left, remaining. 2 Finished. n. (-ष्टं) A supplement, an appendix. E. परि, and शिष्ट left.
23734: परिशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Cleaned. 2 Purified. 3 Discharged, paid. E. परि before शुध to be pure, क्त aff.
23735: परिशुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) Dry, dried. n. (-ष्कं) Meat fried, first with ghee, washed well with warm water, and dressed with spice, &c. E. परि much, शुष्क dried.
23736: परिशेष m. (-षः) 1 Remainder. 2 Completion. E. परि, and शेष end.
23737: परिशोध m. (-धः) 1 Cleansing, purifying, correcting. 2 Discharging a debt or obligation. E. परि, and शोध purifying; also परिशोधनं.
23738: परिशोष m. (-षः) Drying, evaporation. E. परि before शुष to be dry, घञ् aff.
23739: परिश्रम m. (-मः) 1 Labour, trouble, pain. 2 Distress, fatigue. E. परि exceeding, श्रम weariness.
23740: परिश्रय m. (-यः) 1 An assembly, a meeting. 2 An asylum. E. परि, before श्री to serve, &c. aff. अच्.
23741: परिश्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Overcome with distress or fatigue, exhausted, wearied. E. परि before श्रम to be weary, aff. क्त.
23742: परिश्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Labour, trouble. 2 Fatigue, exhaustion. E. परि before श्रम to be weary, क्तिन् aff.
23743: परिश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heard. E. परि, and श्रुत heard.
23744: परिश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Embraced, clasped. E. परि before श्लिष to embrace, क्त aff.
23745: परिश्लेष m. (-षः) Embracing, an embrace. E. परि, and श्लेष embracing.
23746: परिषत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The formation or collection or functions of an assembly. E. त्व added to the next.
23747: परिषद् f. (-षद् or -षत्) An assembly, a meeting, an audience or congregation. E. परि around, षद to go, aff. क्विप्.
23748: परिषद m. (-दः) A spectator at a play, one of an assembly or congregation. E. परिषद् as above, and अण् aff., whence it is more usually पारिषद.
23749: परिषद्य m. (-द्यः) One of a party or assembly, a spectator, a guest. E. see परिषद, यत् being added.
23750: परिषद्वल m. (-लः) 1 An assistant in an assembly, an associate. 2 A spectator, &c. E. परिषद as above, वलच् aff.
23751: परिष्कन्द m. (-न्दः) A foster child, one nourished by a stranger: see परिस्कन्द.
23752: परिष्कन्न m. (-न्नः) A foster child, or one nourished by a stranger: see परिस्कन्न.
23753: परिष्कार m. (-रः) 1 Decoration, embellishment. 2 Cooking, dressing. 3 Finishing, polishing. 4 Initiation, purification by essential rites. 5 Surrounding. E. परि implying ornament, and कार making, स inserted, and changed to ष; also in the same sense परिस्कार.
23754: परिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Adorned, decorated, embellished. 2 Highly finished or polished. 3 Cooked, dressed. 4 Purified by initiatory rites. 5 Surrounded, encompassed. E. परि before कृ to make, aff. क्तः see the last.
23755: परिष्कृतभूमि f. (-मिः) An altar, or ground prepared for a sacrifice, or for the victim and the utensils employed. E. परिष्कृत, and भूमि ground.
23756: परिष्कृति f. (-तिः) Finishing, polishing, &c.: see परिष्कार.
23757: परिष्टोम m. (-मः) An elephant's coloured housings: see परिस्तोम.
23758: परिष्ठल n. (-लं) Surrounding place or site. E. परि, and स्थल place.
23759: परिष्वङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Embracing, an embrace. E. परि before ष्वजि to embrace, aff. घञ्.
23760: परिष्वज्य ind. Having embraced. E. परि, ष्वजि to embrace, ल्यप् aff.
23761: परिसङ्ख्या f. (-ङ्ख्या) 1 Total or complete enumeration or specification, implying exclusion of any other. 2 Reckoning, enumerating. E. परि, and सङ्ख्य a number.
23762: परिसङ्ख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Counted, enumerated. 2 Reckoned up or specified exclusively of any more. E. परि, and सङ्ख्यात counted.
23763: परिसङ्ख्यान n. (-नं) Exclusive enumeration or specification. E. परि, and सङ्ख्यान reckoning.
23764: परिसभ्य m. (-भ्यः) An assistant at an assembly. E. परि about, सभ्य a fellow guest.
23765: परिसमापन n. (-नं) Finishing entirely. E. परि, and सम, before आप to get, ल्युट् aff.
23766: परिसमाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Finished, done entirely. E. परि, and समाप्त finished.
23767: परिसमाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Entire completion. E. परि, and सम before आप to obtain, क्तिन् aff.
23768: परिसर m. (-रः) 1 Ground on the skirts of a river or mountain, or contiguous to a town, &c. 2 Death, dying. 3 Rule, precept, prescribed mode. 4 Part, place, site. 5 Width, breadth. E. परि about, or end, term, &c. सर going, from सृ to go, aff. अप्.
23769: परिसर्प m. (-र्पः) 1 Encompassing, surrounding. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 Following, pursuing. E. परि around, and सर्प going.
23770: परिसर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) 1 Perambulation, wandering round or about. 2 Near approach. 2 Service. E. परि about, सृ to go, यत् aff.
23771: परिसाधन n. (-नं) 1 Accomplishing, effecting. 2 Determining, ascertaining. E. परि before साध to accomplish, aff. ल्युट्.
23772: परिसार m. (-रः) Wandering about. E. परि before सृ to go, aff. अण्.
23773: परिसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wandering. E. परि before सृ to go, घिणुन् aff.
23774: परिसीमन् m. (-मा) Boundary, extreme term or limit. E. परि, and सीमन् a limit.
23775: परिसेधन् mfn. (-धन्-धन्ती-धत्) Opposing. E. परि against, षिघ to effect, शतृ aff.
23776: परिसेसिचा f. (-चा) Frequent bathing or sprinkling. E. परि before पिच to sprinkle, frequent. v. (अङ्,) and टाप् affs.
23777: परिस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) A foster child, one nourished by a stranger. n. (-न्दं) Going round or about. E. परि about, स्कदि to go, aff. अच्; also स being optionally changed, परिष्कन्द.
23778: परिस्कन्दत् mfn. (-न्दन्-न्दन्ती-न्दत्) 1 Going round or about. 2 Surrounding, circumambulating. 3 Wandering. E. परि, स्कदि to go, aff. शतृ.
23779: परिस्कन्न m. (-न्नः) A foster or an adopted child. 2 The Koil or Indian cuckoo. E. परि before स्कन्द to go, aff. क्त; also परिष्कन्न.
23780: परिस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered, spread over. E. परि, and स्तृत strewed.
23781: परिस्तोम m. (-मः) An elephant's painted or coloured cloth or housings. E. परि around, स्तु to applaud, aff. क्त, irregular form, मन् being substituted for the proper termination; also परिष्टोम when considered as a compound of परि and स्तोम.
23782: परिस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Fixedness, solidity. 2 Fortitude, firmness. E. परि, and स्थान place; also परिस्थिति.
23783: परिस्पन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Beating, throbbing. 2 Decoration of the hair, with flowers, &c. 3 Train, retinue. E. परि around, स्पन्द to go, aff. घञ्.
23784: परिस्पन्दन n. (-नं) Beating, throbbing. E. परि before स्पदि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
23785: परिस्पन्दमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Moving tremulously, being gently agitated, shaking, trembling. 2 Throbbing, beating. E. परि before स्पदि to go, शानच् aff.
23786: परिस्फुरण n. (-णं) 1 Glancing, shooting. 2 Budding. E. परि, and स्फुर to expand, ल्युट् aff.
23787: परिस्फुरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Budding, expanding. 2 Bursting forth. 3 Darting, glancing, moving quickly or suddenly. 4 Gleaming. E. परि, and स्फुर to expand, शतृ aff.
23788: परिस्फुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Glancing, gleaming. 2 Opened, expanded. 3 Shot, glanced. E. परि, and स्फुर to expand, क्त aff.
23789: परिस्यन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Oozing, dropping. 2 Decoration of the hair: see परिस्यन्द. E. परि around, स्यन्द to drop, aff. घञ्.
23790: परिस्यन्दन n. (-नं) Dropping, flowing, oozing. E. परि, and स्यदि to drop, ल्युट् aff.
23791: परिस्रुत् f. (-स्रुत्) 1 Vinous liquor. 2 Dropping, flowing. E. परि before स्रु to distil, aff. क्विप् and तल् added.
23792: परिस्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Oozed, trickled, dropped, distilled. f. (-ता) Vinous or distilled liquor. E. परि before स्रु to drop or ooze, aff. क्त.
23793: परिहरण n. (-णं) 1 Seizing, taking. 2 Leaving, abandoning. 3 Avoiding. 4 Disappearing. 5 Refuting, repelling. E. परि before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
23794: परिहरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be shunned or avoided. 2 To be taken away. 3 To be confuted. E. परि, हृ to take, अनीयर् aff.
23795: परिहरणीयता f. (-ता) 1 Disappearance, unattainableness. 2 Refutation. E. परिहरणीय to be taken away, तल् abst. aff.
23796: परिहरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Illuding. 2 Shunning, avoiding. E. परि, हृ to take, शतृ aff.
23797: परिहरमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Leaving, quitting. 2 Taking, seizing. 3 Confuting. E. परि before हृ to take, शानच् aff.
23798: परिहर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be shunned or avoided. 2 To be taken away. 3 To be confuted. E. परि before हृ to take, तव्य aff.
23799: परिहार m. (-रः) 1 Disrespect. 2 Seizing, surrounding. 3 Bounty, largess. 4 Any thing or person objectionable. E. परि, हृ to take away, aff. घञ्.
23800: परिहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be shunned or avoided. 2 To be taken off or away. m. (-र्य्यः) A bracelet: see परिहार्य्य. E. परि, हृ to take, ण्यत् aff.
23801: परिहास m. (-सः) Mirth, sport, pastime. E. परि much, हस to laugh, aff. घञ्; also परीहास.
23802: परिहासवेदिन् m. (-दी) A jester, a wag, a wit. E. परिहास, and वेदिन् who knows.
23803: परिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered, invested, put on. E. परि, and हित placed.
23804: परिहीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Waned, faded, wasted. 2 Deserted by, deprived of. E. परि, and हीण quitted.
23805: परिहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Avoided, quitted. 2 Taken. E. परि before हृ to take, क्त aff.
23806: परीक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Investigating acutely, trying, examining. (-कः) 1 An experimenter, an assayer, a prover. 2 An investigator, a judge. E. परि well, closely, ईक्ष to look or see, aff. क्वुन्.
23807: परीक्षण n. (-णं) Trial, experiment, examination. E. परि about, ईक्ष to see, aff. ल्युट्.
23808: परीक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be tried or investigated, to be submitted to ordeal, &c. E. परि before, ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff; also परीक्षितव्य and परीक्ष्य.
23809: परीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Discrimination, investigation, examination, test, trial, experiment. 2 Trial by ordeal of various kinds: see दिव्य. E. परि intensitive prefix, before ईक्ष to see, aff. अङ् and टाप्; looking into any thing or person closely and minutely.
23810: परीक्षित् m. (-क्षित्) The grandson of ARJUNA, to whom the Bhāgavata was related. E. परि before, क्षि to destroy, क्विप् aff. also with a final vowel परीक्षितः he was destroyed in his mother's womb, but reanimated by KṚṢṆA.
23811: परीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tried, examined, tested, proved. m. (-तः) A prince: see the last. E. परि before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
23812: परीणाय m. (-यः) Moving a piece at chess, draughts, &c. E. परि before णी to take, aff. घञ्, the vowel of the prefix is optionally made long; also परिणाय.
23813: परीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Surrounded, encompassed. 2 Circumambulated. 3 Addicted, affected by. E. परि round, and इत gone.
23814: परीतत् mfn. (-तत्) Every way spread or extended. E. परि around, तन to spread, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel of the prefix augmented.
23815: परीत्य ind. 1 Having passed round or circumambulated. 2 Having encompassed. E. परि before इण् to go, ल्यप् aff.
23816: परीधाविन् m. (-वी) The forty-first year of the Indian cycle.
23817: परीभाव m. (-वः) Disrespect. E. see परिभाव, the vowel of the prefix being here made long.
23818: परीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being penetrated or pervaded by. E. परि before इङ् to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.
23819: परीर n. (-रं) Fruit. E. पॄ to satisfy, Uṇādi aff. ईरन्.
23820: परीरम्भ m. (-म्भः) An embrace: see परिरम्भ.
23821: परीवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Exchange, barter. 2 The royal tortoise: see परिवर्त्त.
23822: परीवाद m. (-दः) 1 Reproof, censure, abuse. 2 The bow or quill of a lute: see परिवाद.
23823: परीवार m. (-रः) The sheath of a sword. 2 Dependants, family, retinue. E. परि around, वृ to cover, aff. घञ्, and the final of परि made long; also परिवार.
23824: परीवाह m. (-हः) 1 A drain or channel made to carry off water from a pond that overflows. 2 A natural inundation or overflow. 3 Royal insignia. 4 A sword sheath, a scabbard. E. परि before वह to bear, aff. घञ्, and the इ of परि is in consequence optionally long; also परिवाह.
23825: परीष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Inquiry, research, especially philosophical. 2 Service. 3 Willingness, readiness. E. परि much, इष्टि wish.
23826: परीसार m. (-रः) 1 Going round or about, wandering, perambulation. 2 Near approach. E. परि about, सृ to go, aff. घञ्.
23827: परीहार m. (-रः) 1 Disrespect. 2 An open space for the pasturage of cattle near a village or town. 3 Remedying or atoning for any improper action. E. परि disrespect, हृ to convey, aff. घञ्.
23828: परीहास m. (-सः) Mirth, sport, amusement. E. परि pleasure, हस to laugh, aff. घञ्.
23829: परु m. (-रुः) 1 A knot or joint in a read. 2 Paradise. 3 The ocean. 4 A mountain. E. पॄ to fill, aff. उ, also परुस्.
23830: परुत् ind. Last year. E. पर prior, उत् aff.
23831: परुत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Of or belonging to last year. E. परुत last year, त्न aff.
23833: परुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Harsh, abusive, (speech.) 2 Rough, rugged. 3 Severe, cruel, unkind. 4 Variegated in colour. n. (-षं) 1 Harsh, and contumelious speech, abuse. 2 Yellow Barleria. m. (-षः) A sort of tree, (Xylocarpus granatum.) E. पॄ to fill or satisfy, उषन् Uṇādi aff.
23834: परुषवचन n. (-नं) Harsh language, reproach, abuse. E. परुष, and वचन speech.
23835: परुषवाच् mfn. (-क्) Harsh spoken. f. (-क्) Harsh or contumelious speech. E. परुष, and वाच् speech.
23836: परुषोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Abusive or harsh language. E. परुष, and उक्ति speech.
23837: परुषोक्तिक m. (-कः) An abuser, one uttering harsh and scurrilous language. E. परुष abuse, and उक्ति speech, aff. कप्.
23838: परुस् n. (-रुः) The knot or joint of a cane or reed. E. पॄ to complete, Uṇādi aff. उसि.
23839: परूष m. (-षः) The Parush tree: see परुष; also with कन् added परूषक.
23840: परेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, defunct. m. (-तः) A kind of goblin, a ghost, a spirit. E. पर another, (world,) इत gone.
23841: परेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Faithful, friendly. E. पर an enemy, इतर other, opposed to.
23842: परेतराज् m. (-राट्) A name of YAMA. E. परेत a ghost, and राज who rules.
23843: परेद्यवि ind. Next day, to-morrow. E. पर another, एद्यवि aff.
23844: परेद्युस् ind. (-द्युः) Next day. E. परे after, द्युस् for दिवस a day.
23845: परेप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Where water is lodged or retired, whence it has, (a place, &c.) E. पर, and अप water.
23846: परेष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) BRAHMĀ. E. पर best, इष्टि worship.
23847: परेष्टुका f. (-का) A cow bearing many calves. E. पर best, इप to go, तु aff., and कन् added.
23848: परैधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Nourished by a stranger. m. (-तः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. पर a stranger, एधित nourished.
23849: परोक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Invisible, imperceptible. 2 Absent. 3 Past. m. (-क्षः) An ascetic, a religious hermit. n. (-षं) 1 Invisibility, absence, secrecy. 2 (In Grammar,) Past time or tense. E. पर before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. क; or पर away, अक्षि the eye, form irr.
23850: परोक्षभोग m. (-गः) Enjoyment or possession of any thing in the absence of the proprietor. E. परोक्ष, and भोग enjoyment.
23851: परोक्षवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) One who does any thing whilst absent. E. परोक्ष, and वृत्ति practice.
23852: परोक्षार्थ n. (-र्थं) An absent or invisible object. E. परोक्ष, and अर्थ object.
23853: परोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Another's superiority. E. पर, and उत्कर्ष eminence.
23854: परोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said by an enemy, &c. n. (-तं) Clamour, menace. E. पर, and उदित said.
23855: परोपकार m. (-रः) Charity, benevolence, doing good to others. E. पर another, उपकार assistance.
23856: परोपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Benevolent, charitable, good to others. E. परोपकार, and इनि aff.
23857: परोपकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Helped or befriended by another. 2 Brought by another. E. पर, and उपकृत assisted.
23858: परोपजाप n. (-पं) The dissension of enemies. E. पर, and उपजाप dissension.
23859: परोपदेश m. (-शः) Giving advice, counselling, admonishing. E. पर, and उपदेश instruction.
23860: परोपरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Invested, besieged, blockaded. E. पर, and उपरुद्ध surrounded.
23861: परोवरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having both superior and inferior, prior and subsequent, &c. E. पर best, अवर lowest, खश् aff.
23862: परोष्णी f. (-ष्णी) A cockroach. E. पर best, उष्णा warmth; it is also written परोष्टी.
23863: पर्कट n. (-टं) Regret, anxiety. m. (-टः) A heron.
23864: पर्क्कटि f. (-टिः-टी) The waved-leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectiosa.) E. पृच to touch, अटि aff., ङीष् optionally added; also with इन् added पर्क्कटिन्.
23865: पर्क्कटिन् m. (-टी) The waved-leaf fig tree: see the last.
23866: पर्जनी f. (-नी) A sort of Curcuma, (C. zanthorrhizon.) E. पृ to satisfy, aff. क्विप्, जन to produce, aff. अच् and ङीष्.
23867: पर्ज्जन्य m. (-न्यः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A thunder cloud. 3 The muttering of clouds or distant thunder. 4 Any cloud. E. पृष to sprinkle, (rain,) Uṇādi aff. अन्य, and ज or य substituted for ष; also पर्य्यन्य.
23868: पर्ण r. 10th cl. (पर्णयति) To make or be green.
23869: पर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 A leaf. 2 The Pān or betel leaf. m. (-णः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa). f. (-र्णी) 1 An aquatick plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 The leaf of the asafœtida (?) E. पॄ to please, and Uṇādi aff. न, fem. ff. ङीष्, or पर्ण to be or make green, aff. अच्.
23870: पर्णकार m. (-रः) A vender of Pān leaves. E. पर्ण, and कार who makes.
23871: पर्णकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) Living upon leaves and water for a limited term, as a religious obligation. E. पर्ण, and कृच्छ्र penance.
23872: पर्णखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A tree without apparent blossoms. 2 A tree in general. E. पर्ण a leaf, खण्ड a part.
23873: पर्णध्वत् mfn. (-ध्वत्) Causing the falling of leaves. E. पर्ण leaf, ध्वंस to fall, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् substituted for the final.
23874: पर्णनर m. (-रः) A man of leaves, an effigy stuffed with leaves, made to represent a person deceased, whose body cannot be found, and for whom obsequial rites are performed with this representative. E. पर्ण, and नर a man.
23876: पर्णभोजन m. (-नः) 1 A goat. 2 Any animal eating leaves. E. पर्ण a leaf, and भोजन food.
23877: पर्णमाचाल m. (-लः) The Kāmaraṅga, an acid fruit; (Averhoa carambola.) E. पर्ण a leaf, मच to be tall, aff. आलच्.
23878: पर्णमृग m. (-गः) Any wild animal lodging in the boughs of trees, as a monkey, a sloth, a squirrel. E. पर्ण, and मृग deer.
23879: पर्णलता f. (-ता) The betle plant. E. पर्ण, and लता a creeper.
23880: पर्णवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. पर्ण, and वल्ली a pedicle.
23881: पर्णशाला f. (-ला) A hut of leaves and grass, a hermitage. E. पर्ण a leaf, and शाला a hall.
23882: पर्णसन्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sleeping on leaves. E. पर्ण, and सन्तर a bed.
23883: पर्णसि m. (-सिः) 1 A lotus. 2 A summer or water house. E. पॄ to delight, Uṇādi aff. असि, and नुङ् inserted.
23884: पर्णाल m. (-लः) 1 A boat. 2 A spade or hoe. 3 Single combat.
23885: पर्णाशन m. (-नः) A cloud. n. (-नं) Feeding on leaves. E. पर्ण, a leaf, and अशन food.
23886: पर्णास m. (-सः) A Tulasi tree with few leaves.
23887: पर्णासि m. (-सिः) A sort of Basil, (Ocymum sanctum), with small leaves. E. पर्ण a leaf, असि to go, (beautiful,) aff. अच्.
23888: पर्णिन् m. (-र्णी) 1 A tree. 2 The Butea frondosa. E. पर्ण a leaf, aff. इनि.
23889: पर्णोटज n. (-जं) A hut of leaves, the residence of holy anchorets, a hermitage. E. पर्ण a leaf, and उटज a hut.
23891: पर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 A quantity of hair. 2 A fart. E. पॄ to nourish, द Uṇādi aff., or पर्द to fart, aff. अच्.
23892: पर्द्दन n. (-नं) A fart, farting. E. पर्दृ to fart, aff. ल्युट्.
23893: पर्प r. 1st cl. (पर्पति) To go, to move.
23894: पर्प n. (-र्पं) 1 A house. 2 Young grass. 3 A wheel chair, or one on which a cripple can move about. E. पॄ to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. प, or पर्प to go, aff. अच्.
23895: पर्पट m. (-टः) A medicinal plant with bitter leaves, (apparently the Oldenlandia biflora, though the Hindi name Pāpar is also applied to the Gardenia latifolia, Rox.) f. (-टी) A thin crisp cake made of any pulse. 2 A red aluminous earth, apparently a sort of Bol, brought from Surāt or Surāṣṭra. E. पर्प to go, and अट Uṇādi aff.
23897: पर्परीक m. (-कः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 A piece of water. E. पॄ to nourish, ईकन् Uṇādi aff., the root repeated.
23898: पर्प्पिक mf. (-कः-की) A cripple that moves about by the aid of a chair or cradle. E. पर्प्प a chair, &c. aff. ष्ठन्.
23899: पर्ब r. 1st cl. (पर्बति) To go, to move.
23900: पर्य्यङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A bed. E. परि about, अकि to go, aff. अच्; also र being optionally changed to ल, पल्यङ्क.
23901: पर्य्यङ्कबन्धन n. (-नं) Binding a cloth round the knees, thighs, and back, as seated on the hams. E. पर्य्यङ्क, and बन्धन binding.
23902: पर्य्यटन n. (-नं) Wandering about, roaming. E. परि about, अटन going.
23903: पर्य्यनुयोग m. (-गः) Asking, inquiring. E. परि severally, अनु according to, योग fitness.
23904: पर्य्यन्त m. (-न्तं) 1 Limit, term, boundary, extent. 2 End, termination, close. n. (-न्तं) Far, (limitative,) as किंपर्य्यन्तं or कियत्पर्य्यन्तं how much, how far. E. परि, and अन्त end.
23905: पर्य्यन्तभू f. (-भूः) Ground contiguous to the skirts of a river or mountain, &c. E. परि about, अन्त term, भू earth.
23906: पर्य्यन्तस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Limitative, boundary, confining. E. पर्य्यन्त, and स्थ what stays.
23907: पर्य्यन्तस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bounding, confining. E. पर्य्यन्त, and स्थित placed.
23908: पर्य्यन्तिका f. (-का) Loss of all good qualities, depravity. E. परि completely, अन्त end, ठन् aff.
23909: पर्य्यन्य m. (-न्यः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A thunder cloud. 3 The muttering of clouds. E. पृष to sprinkle, अन्य Uṇādi aff., य substituted for ष; it is also read पर्जन्य.
23910: पर्य्यय m. (-यः) 1 Contrariety, opposition. 2 Irregular or inverted order. 3 Neglect of enjoined or customary observances. E. परि improperly, अय to go or be, aff. अच्.
23911: पर्य्ययण n. (-णं) A horse's saddle or housings. E. परि about, अयण going.
23912: पर्य्यवसान n. (-नं) End, conclusion. E. परि, and अवसान end.
23913: पर्य्यवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Finished, completed, concluded. E. परि, and अवसित ended.
