23914: पर्य्यवस्था f. (-स्था) Opposition, contradiction. E. परि opposition, अवस्था staying, station.
23915: पर्य्यवस्थातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Opposing, obstructing, opposed to or against. m. (-ता) An antagonist, an opponent, an enemy. E. परि against, अव before स्था to stand or be, aff. तृच्.
23916: पर्य्यवस्थान n. (-नं) Opposition, resistance, contradiction. E. परि against, अवस्थान being, standing.
23917: पर्य्यवस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Opposed to, siding with an enemy. E. परि adverse, अवस्थित staying.
23918: पर्य्यश्रु mfn. (-श्रुः-श्रुः-श्रु) Filled or suffused with tears. E. परि, and अश्रु a tear.
23919: पर्य्यवष्टब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Surrounded, invested. E. परि, and अवष्टब्ध stopped.
23920: पर्य्यवष्टम्भन n. (-नं) Surrounding, investing. E. परि, and अवष्टम्भन obstructing.
23921: पर्य्यसन n. (-नं) 1 Casting, sending. 2 Putting off or away. E. परि, and अस to throw, ल्युट् aff.
23922: पर्य्यस्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) 1 Going forth, issuing. 2 Investing, oversetting. 3 Scattering. E. परि before अस to throw, शतृ aff.
23923: पर्य्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Fallen, descended, alighted. 2 Thrown down or off. 3 Overturned, upset. 4 Struck, killed. 5 Dismissed, laid aside. 6 Bound. E. परि round, &c. अस्त thrown.
23924: पर्य्यस्तिका f. (-का) A bed. E. परि about, अस to be, aff. क्तिन्, and कन् added.
23925: पर्य्याकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Agitated, anxious. E. परि, and आकुल agitated.
23926: पर्य्यागलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Dropping, falling. E. परि, and आङ् before गल to fall, शतृ aff.
23927: पर्य्याचान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Sipped, (as water, to rinse the mouth whilst eating.) E. परि, and आचान्त sipped.
23928: पर्य्याण n. (-णं) A saddle, a pack-saddle or cloth serving for one. E. परि about, इण् to go, form irr.
23929: पर्य्याप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Obtained, gained. 2 Able, adequate. 3 All, complete, entire, enough, sufficient. n. adv. (-प्तं) 1 Willing, readily. 2 Ably, powerfully. 3 Satisfactorily. 4 Unwillingly. E. परि before आप to acquire, aff. क्त.
23930: पर्य्याप्तभोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Possessing or enjoying a sufficiency. E. पर्य्याप्त, and भोग enjoyment.
23931: पर्य्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Willingness, readiness. 2 Obtaining, acquiring. 3 Satisfaction, repletion, satiety. 4 Entireness, fulness, sufficiency. 5 Adequacy, competency, fitness. 6 Discrimination or distinction of objects according to their natural properties. 7 Preserving, guarding. 8 Warding off a blow. E. परि exceeding, आप्ति obtaining.
23932: पर्य्याय m. (-यः) 1 Order, arrangement, regular and methodical disposal or succession. 2 Manner, kind. 3 Opportunity, occasion. 4 Manufacture, preparation, artificial production. 5 Property of substances, as bitter, cooling, &c. 6 Generic or specific character. 7 Comprehensiveness, aggregation. 8 The text of a vocabulary, or the order of the synonyms for any term. E. परि successively, अय to go or proceed, aff. घञ्.
23933: पर्य्यायशयन n. (-नं) Alternate sleeping and watching. E. पर्य्याय order, शयन sleeping.
23934: पर्य्यायान्न n. (-न्नं) Food that should have been given to some one else, as that of a Śūdra to a Brahman, &c. E. पर्य्याय, and अन्न food.
23935: पर्य्यालोचन n. (-नं) Looking round or about. 2 Considering, deliberating. 3 Knowing, recognising. E. परि, and आङ् before लोच to see, aff. ल्युट्.
23936: पर्य्यास m. (-सः) Inverted order or position. E. परि before अस to be, aff. घञ्.
23937: पर्य्याहार m. (-रः) 1 Conveying, taking. 2 A load. 3 A yoke. 4 Storing hay or grain. 5 An ewer, a pitcher. E. परि, and आङ् before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
23938: पर्य्युत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Afflicted, sorrowful, regretting. E. परि, and उत्सुक unhappy.
23939: पर्य्युदञ्चन n. (-नं) Debt. E. परि severally, उत् over, अञ्च to go, aff. ल्युट्.
23940: पर्य्युदस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Prohibited, objected to, (as a ceremony.) 2 Excepted, excluded. E. परि, and उद before अस to be, क्त aff.
23941: पर्य्युदास m. (-सः) A prohibitive rule or precept. E. परि and उद before अस to throw or be, aff. घञ्; also पर्य्युदासन.
23942: पर्य्युपासन n. (-नं) 1 Joining in or concurrence with any act of reverence. 2 Service, worship. E. परि, and उपासना worship.
23943: पर्य्युपासीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Seated or sitting upon. E. परि and उप before आसीन seated.
23944: पर्य्युप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sown. 2 Set as a gem in a ring. E. परि before वप to sow, aff. क्त.
23945: पर्य्युषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stale, not fresh. E. परि about, वस to abide, aff. क्त.
23946: पर्य्युषितभोजिन् m. (-जी) The eater of stale viands, who will be regenerated as a maggot or worm. E. पर्य्युषित stale, भोजिन् who eats.
23947: पर्य्येषणा f. (-णा) 1 Research, investigation of duty by reasoning. 2 Search, inquiry in general. E. परि severally, इष to go, with युच्, and टाप् affs.
23949: पर्व्वक n. (-कं) The knee. E. पर्व्व for पर्व्वन् a joint, aff. कन्.
23950: पर्व्वकारिन् m. (-री) A Brahman who performs ceremonies for hire out of season. E. पर्व्व, and कारिन् who makes.
23951: पर्व्वगामिन् m. (-मी) A man who associates with his wife on festival or holy days. E. पर्व्व, and गामिन् who goes.
23952: पर्व्वणिका f. (-का) Specks with pain on the edge of the cornea of the eye. E. पर्व्वन्, and कन् added; also पर्व्वणीका.
23953: पर्व्वत m. (-तः) 1 A mountain, a hill. 2 A tree. 3 A sort of potherb. 4 A kind of fish, (Silurus pabda, HAM.) 5 One of the divine Ṛṣis, a friend and rival of NARADA, and mentioned in the Mahābhārata. E. पर्व्व to fill, Uṇādi aff. अतच्.
23954: पर्व्वतकाक m. (-कः) A raven. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and काक a crow.
23955: पर्व्वतज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain, mountain-born. f. (-जा) A river. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and ज born.
23956: पर्व्वतवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living, &c. in the mountains. f. (-नी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 The Gāyatrī. E. पर्व्वत, and वासिन् who dwells.
23957: पर्व्वताधारा f. (-रा) The earth. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and आधार a receptacle or stay.
23958: पर्व्वतारि m. (-रिः) The name of INDRA. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and अरि an enemy.
23959: पर्व्वताशय m. (-यः) A cloud. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and आशय asylum.
23960: पर्व्वताश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mountaineer, living, &c. in mountains. m. (-यः) A fabulous animal, the Śarabha. E. पर्व्वत, and आश्रय abode.
23961: पर्व्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mountainous, mountaineer, &c. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, छ aff.
23962: पर्व्वधि m. (-धिः) The moon. E. पर्व्व a day of the month, and धि who has.
23963: पर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) 1 A knot, a joint in a cane or body, &c. 2 A name given to certain days in the lunar month, as the full and change of the moon, and the 8th and 14th of each half month. 3 Particular periods of the year, as the equinox, solstice, &c. 4 The moment of the sun's entering a new sign. 5 A festival, a holy day. 6 Opportunity, occasion. 7 A chapter, a book, the division of a work. 8 A moment, an instant. E. पॄ to fill or please, Uṇādi aff. वनिन्.
23964: पर्व्वपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, also called Rāmadūtī. E. पर्व्व a joint, and पुष्प a flower.
23965: पर्व्वपूर्णता f. (-ता) 1 Preparations for an assembly or festival. 2 Joining, uniting. 3 Completion of a festival. E. पर्व्व a festival, and पूर्णता completion.
23966: पर्व्वयोनि m. (-निः) A cane or reed, the sugarcane, &c. E. पर्व्व a joint, and योनि place of production.
23967: पर्व्वरीण n. (-णं) A festival, &c.: see पर्व्वन्.
23968: पर्व्वरुह् m. (-रुट्) The pomegranate. E. पर्व्व a joint, and रुह् what grows.
23969: पर्व्वसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) The full and change of the moon, the junction of the 15th and 1st of a lunar fortnight, or the precise moment of the full and change of the moon. E. पर्व्व a joining of the month, and सन्धि union.
23970: पर्व्वावधि m. (-धिः) A peculiar period, the end of a Parva, &c. E. पर्व्व as above, and अवधि limit.
23971: पर्व्वित m. (-तः) A sort of fish, (Silurus pabda, HAM.)
23972: पर्शु m. (-र्शुः) An axe, a hatchet. E. पर an enemy, शु to destroy, Uṇādi aff. कु, deriv. irr.; or स्पृश to touch, changed to पृ, and शुन् Uṇādi aff.; also परशु.
23973: पर्शुका f. (-का) A rib. E. पृ to fill, to complete, शुन् aff. and कन् added.
23974: पर्शुपाणि m. (-णिः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. पर्शु an axe, and पाणि the hand, holding an axe in one hand.
23975: पर्शुराम m. (-मः) The first of three RAMAS, being the sixth Avatāra of VIṢṆU, as the son of the Muni JAMADAGNI. E. पर्शु an axe, and राम RĀMA; also परशुराम.
23976: पर्श्वध m. (-धः) An axe, a hatchet.
23977: पर्ष r. 1st cl. (पर्षति) 1 To be kind or affectionate to. 2 To be moist.
23978: पर्षद् f. (-षद् or -षत्) An assembly, an audience. E. पृष to please, Uṇādi aff. अदि; also परिषद्.
23979: पर्षद्वल m. (-लः) An assistant at an assembly, a spectator, &c. E. पर्षद् as above, वलच् aff.
23980: पल r. 1st cl. (पलति) To go, to move.
23981: पल n. (-लं) 1 A weight of gold or silver equal to four Karṣas or Suvarṇas; also of four or of eight Tolas, or in common use, of three Tolas, two Māṣas, and eight Rattis. 2 A moment, the sixtieth part of an Indian hour. 3 Flesh. m. (-लः) Straw after threshing, &c. E. पल to go, to move, aff. अप्.
23982: पलक्षार m. (-रः) Blood. E. पल flesh, and क्षार what oozes.
23983: पलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. पल flesh or mortar, compared to it, and गण्ड a mark or spot.
23984: पलङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Timid, fearful, frightened. E. पल flesh, कट to go, aff. खच्; whose flesh shrinks with fear.
23985: पलङ्कर m. (-रः) Bile. E. पल flesh, कर what makes.
23986: पलङ्कष m. (-षः) 1 A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin. mf. (-षः-षा) The Bdellium tree. f. (-षा) 1 A plant, (Ruellia longifolia.) 2 The ichneumon plant: see रास्ना. 3 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) 4 Lac, the animal dye. 5 A creeper: see मुण्डीरी. E. पल flesh, and कष what injures, aff. खच्.
23987: पलभा f. (-भा) The mid-day shadow of a gnomon, when the sun is in the equinoctial points.
23988: पलव m. (-वः) A snare or basket of wicker work for catching fish. E, पल flesh, and वा to get, aff. क.
23989: पलल n. (-लं) 1 Flesh. 2 Mud, mire, clay. 3 Oil-cake or sesamum seed. m. (-लः) A Rākṣasa, a goblin or imp. E. पल to go, Uṇādi aff. कलच्; or पल flesh, and ला to get, aff. क.
23990: पललज्वर m. (-रः) Bile. E. पलल flesh, ज्वर heat.
23991: पललप्रिय m. (-यः) A raven. E. पलल, and प्रिय fond of.
23992: पललाशय m. (-यः) Swelled neck, bronchocele. E. पलल flesh, आशय asylum.
23993: पलाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Bile, the bilious humour. E. पल flesh, अग्नि fire.
23994: पलाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The Gangetic porpoise. E. पल flesh, गम to go or get, aff. ड.
23995: पलाण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) An onion. E. पल to preserve, (from disease,) अण्डु aff.
23996: पलाद mf. (-दः-दा) A Rākṣasa, male or female. E. पल flesh, अद who eats; also पलादन mf. (-नः-नी.)
23997: पलाप m. (-पः) 1 A halter. 2 An elephant's temples.
23998: पलापहा f. (-हा) A collyrium: see कुलत्था.
23999: पलायन n. (-नं) Flight, retreat. E. परा from, अयन going, र changed to ल.
24000: पलायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Running away. E. परा before अच् to go, शानच् aff.
24001: पलायनपरायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fugitive. E. पलायन, and परायण addicted to.
24002: पलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Defeated, flown, run away, retreated. E. पलायन flying, इतच् aff., or पल to go, aff. क्त, in the causal form.
24003: पलाल mn. (-लः-लं) Straw. E. पल to go, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.
24004: पलालदोहद m. (-दः) The mango tree. E. पलाल straw, दोहद wishing, requiring straw for manure, or from the fruit being sometimes ripened in straw.
24005: पलाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 1 Green. 2 Unfeeling, unmerciful, cruel. n. (-शं) A leaf. m. (-शः) 1 A tree bearing red blossoms, (Butea frondosa.) 2 A demon, a goblin. 3 A sort of Curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.) 4 Ancient Behār or Magadhā. f. (शी) 1 Lac. 2 A kind of creeper. E. पल going, or flesh, अश to spread, to eat, &c. aff. अण् or अच्.
24006: पलाशक m. (-कः) 1 Curcuma reclinata. 2 The Pala's tree. E. कन् added to the preceding.
24009: पलाशिन् m. (-शी) 1 A tree in general. 2 A goblin. 3 A sort of Mimusops, (M. kauki, Rox.) E. पलाश a leaf, इनि aff.
24010: पलिक्नी f. (-क्नी) 1 An old or greyheaded woman. 2 A cow with calf. E. पलित grey hair, aff. ङीप्, and क्न substituted for तः see पलित.
24011: पलिघ m. (-घः) 1 A glass vessel. 2 A water pot. 3 The gate way of a building. 4 A wall. E. परि completely, हन to injure, घ substituted for the radical, and र changed to लः see परिघ.
24012: पलित mfn. (-तः-ता-क्नी-तं) Greyhaired, old. m. (-तः) An old man. f. (-ता) An old woman. n. (-तं) 1 Greyness of the hair. 2 Much or ornamented hair. 3 Heat, burning. 4 Mud, mire. 5 Benzoin. E. पल to go, (towards death,) Uṇādi aff. क्त, or पल flesh, &c. and इतच् aff.
24013: पल्यङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A bedstead. E. see पर्य्यङ्क, र being changed to ल.
24014: पल्ययन n. (-नः) A saddle, a pack-saddle. E. परि before अयन going, र changed to ल.
24015: पल्युल r. 10th cl. (पल्युलयति) 1 To cut. 2 To purify; also written पल्युल्ल and पल्यूल, &c.
24016: पल्यूल r. 10th cl. (पल्यूलयति) 1 To cut. 2 To purify; also पल्युल and पल्युल्ल.
24018: पल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A large basket, or matted shed used for keeping corn, &c. f. (-ल्ली) 1 A small village. 2 A city, or rather an affix to words forming the name of a town; it is especially used in the Dekhin, as in Trichinopoly or Trisira-pallī, &c. 3 A small house lizard. 4 A creeping plant. E. पल्ल to go, aff. अच्; also with इन् aff. पल्लि.
24019: पल्लव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 A sprout, a shoot, the extremity of a branch bearing new leaves. 2 A branch. 3 Spreading, expansion. 4 A wood. 5 The red dye of lac. 6 Love, the sentiment or passion. 7 A catamite. 8 A bracelet. 9 Unsteadiness, moral or physical. E. पद् the foot, लू to cut or break, अप् aff.
24020: पल्लवक m. (-कः) 1 The paramour of a harlot. 2 A kind of fish, (Cyprinus denticulatus.) 3 A catamite. E. पल्लव love, and कन् aff.
24021: पल्लवद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The Asoka tree. E. पल्लव, and द्रु a tree.
24022: पल्लवाद m. (-दः) A deer. E. पल्लव a shoot, अद to eat, aff. अच्.
24023: पल्लवाधार m. (-रः) A branch. E. पल्लव a sprout, and आधार receptacle.
24024: पल्लवास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) KĀMADEVA. E. पल्लव a sprout or blossom, and अस्र a weapon.
24025: पल्लविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Amorous, desirous. E. पल्लव passion, ठक् aff.
24026: पल्लवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Having new sprouts. 2 Spread, extended. m. (-तः) The red dye of the lac insect. E. पल्लव a sprout, &c. इतच् aff.
24027: पल्लविन् m. (-वी) A tree. E. पल्लव a sprout, aff. इनि.
24028: पल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) 1 A small village. 2 Any village. 3 A house. 4 A number of houses. 5 Any place or station. 6 A house lizard: see पल्ल and पल्ली.
24029: पल्लिका f. (-का) A lizard. E. पल्ली, and कन् added.
24030: पल्वल mn. (-लः-लं) A small pond. E. पल to go, Uṇādi aff. वल.
24031: पल्वलावास m. (-सः) A tortoise. E. पल्वल a pond, and आवास abode.
24032: पव m. (-वः) 1 Winnowing corn. 2 A marsh. 3 Air, wind. 4 Purification, purity. n. (-वं) Cow-dung. E. पू to purify, aff. अप्.
24033: पवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Pure, purifying. E. पू to be pure, शतृ aff.
24034: पवन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Pure, clean. m. (-नः) 1 Air, wind, physical or personified, as a deity. 2 Winnowing grain. 3 The domestic fire. n. (-नं) 1 A potter's kiln. 2 Water. 3 Purifying, purification. E. पू to be or make pure, aff. ल्यु or युच्.
24035: पवनव्याधि m. (-धिः) 1 One of KṚṢṆA'S friends and advisers. 2 Wind, as affected morbidly, or rheumatism, &c. E. पवन, and व्याधि sickness.
24036: पवनात्मज m. (-जः) 1 Hanumān, the monkey hero. 2 Fire. E. पवन wind, (the deity,) and आत्मज son.
24037: पवनाल m. (-लः) A kind of grain, (Andropogon saccharatus.)
24038: पवनाश m. (-शः) A snake. E. पवन wind, and अश who eats.
24039: पवनाशन m. (-नः) A snake. E. पवन wind, and अशन food.
24040: पवनाशनाश m. (-शः) 1 Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 2 A peacock. E. पवनाशन a snake, and अश who eats; feeding on the serpent race.
24041: पवनाहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken by the wind. 2 Rheumatic. E. पवन, and आहत struck.
24042: पवनेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A large kind of Nimb tree.
24043: पवनोम्बुज m. (-जः) The Parush tree: see परुष. E. पवन air, अम्बु water, and ज born.
24044: पवमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Purifying. m. (-नः) 1 Air, wind. 2 Household fire. E. पूञ् to purify, शानच् aff.
24045: पवमानात्मज m. (-जः) The householder's perpetual fire. E. पवमान, and आत्मज son
24046: पवाका f. (-का) A whirlwind. E. पू to purify, आक Uṇādi aff.
24047: पवि m. (-विः) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. पू to purify, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
24048: पवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified, cleansed. n. (-तं) Black pepper. E. पू to purify, क्त aff.
24049: पवितृ mfn. (-ता-ची-तृ) Purifying, cleansing. E. पू to purify, तृन् aff.
24050: पवित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) 1 Pure, clean, purified physically or morally. 2 Who or what cleans or purifies, &c. n. (-त्रं) 1 Sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) 2 Copper. 3 Water. 4 Rain. 5 Rubbing, cleansing. 6 The vessel in which an Argha or libation or oblation is presented. 7 The Brahminical cord. 8 Ghee. 9 Honey. 10 A couple of Kusa leaves a span long, used at sacrifices to present offerings upon, or to sprinkle Ghee, &c. 11 Kusa grass used to clean or purify Ghee used in a sacrifice. 12 A ring of Kusa grass worn on the fourth finger on some occasions. 13 A text or Mantra of the Vedas. 14 Any divinity, as Agni, &c. f. (-त्रा) 1 Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) 2 The name of a river, a little to the north-west of Haridvār; the Pabar. 3 The twelfth of the light fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, a festival in honour of VIṢṆU. E. पू to purify, aff. इत्र.
24051: पवित्रक n. (-कं) Packthread, or a rope or net made of it. E. पवित्र pure, कन् aff.
24052: पवित्रारोपण n. (-णं) 1 Investiture with the Brahminical cord. 2 Investing the image of KṚṢṆA with it, on the twelfth of the light fortnight of Śrāvaṇa. E. पवित्र, and आरोपण placing.
24053: पवित्रारोहण n. (-णं) The putting of the Brahminical cord on images of DURGĀ on the eighth of the light half of Srāvaṇa or Āṣārha. E. पवित्र, and आरोहण mounting.
24054: पवित्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Clean, pure, (literally or metaphorically.) E. पवित्र purifying, इतच् aff.
24055: पवित्रीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Purification, cleansing. 2 The instrument or means of purifying. E. पवित्र, and करण making, त्रि augment.
24056: पवित्रीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified, cleansed. E. पवित्र, and कृत made, त्रि augment.
24057: पश r. 1st cl. (पशति-ते) r. 10th cl. (पाशयति पशयति) 1 To bind, to fetter. 2 To knot or tie. 3 To go, to move. 4 To hinder or obstruct. 5 To touch.
24058: पशव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Fit or advantageous for cattle, (meadow, pasturage, &c.) 2 Possessed of cattle. E. पशु, and यत् aff.
24059: पशु m. (-शुः) 1 An animal in general, a beast. 2 A goat. 3 A subordinate deity, and one of ŚIVA'S followers. 4 Any living being. 5 A sacrifice, an oblation. 6 The divine soul of the universe. 7 The glomerous fig tree. ind. See, behold. E. दृश to see, पश substituted, and कु Uṇādi aff.
24060: पशुका f. (-का) Any small animal. E. पशु, and कन् dimin. aff.
24061: पशुक्रिया f. (-या) Copulation, coition. E. पशु an animal, and क्रिया action.
24062: पशुगायत्री f. (-त्री) A parody of the holy verse of the Vedas, whispered into the ear of an animal about to be sacrificed. E. पशु, and गायत्री the Gāyatrī.
24063: पशुघात n. (-तं) Slaughter of animals for sacrifice, &c. E. पशु, and घात killing.
24064: पशुता f. (-ता) The condition or nature of an animal, bestiality, brutality. E. तल् added to पशु.
24065: पशुत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Sacrifice of an animal. 2 Nature of an animal. E. पशु, and त्व aff.
24066: पशुधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Action or property of animals. 2 Promiscuous cohabitation. 3 The marrying of widows. E. पशु, and धर्म्म office.
24067: पशुपति m. (-तिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. पशु living creature, and पति the master, the creator, or preserver; or पशु ŚIVA'S attendant, and पति master; or according to one legend, पशु an animal, which every deity acknowledged himself to be before his lord and master ŚIVA, when they solicited him to destroy the Asura TRIPURA.
24068: पशुपल्वल n. (-लं) A fragrant, grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
24069: पशुपाल m. (-लः) A herdsman. E. पशु, and पाल who cherishes.
24070: पशुपालन n. (-नं) Tending or rearing cattle. E. पशु, and पालन protecting.
24071: पशुप्रेरण n. (-णं) Driving cattle. E. पशु a beast, प्रेरण sending.
24072: पशुयाग m. (-गः) Sacrifice of animals. E. पशु, and याग sacrifice.
24073: पशुरक्षण n. (-णं) Tending cattle. E. पशु, and रक्षण preserving.
24074: पशुरक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A herdsman, a shepherd. E. पशु, and रक्षिन् who guards.
24075: पशुरज्जु m. (-ज्जुः) A string or tie for fastening cattle. E. पशु an animal, and ज्जु a rope.
24076: पशुराज m. (-जः) A lion. E. पशु a beast, and राज sovereign.
24077: पशुरोमन् n. (-म) The hair of an animal. E. पशु, and रोमन् hair of the body.
24078: पशुसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by an animal, (flesh, honey, butter, &c.) E. पशु, and सम्भव product.
24079: पशुहरीतकी f. (-की) The hog plum. E. पशु an animal, हरीतकी myrobalan.
24080: पशुहव्य n. (-व्यं) Sacrifice of animals. E. पशु, and हव्य oblation.
24081: पश्चात् ind. After, afterwards, behind, westward. E. पश्च considered as a substitute for अपर, and आति aff.
24082: पश्चात्ताप m. (-पः) Repentance. E. पश्चात् afterwards, ताप sorrow.
24083: पश्चार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) The remaining half or part of any thing. E. पश्व for अपर, and अर्द्ध a part.
24084: पश्चिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 West, western. 2 Behind, after. mf. (-मः-मा) The region of VARUṆA, the west. E. पश्चात् behind, and डिमच् aff.; Hindus in their prayers, usually facing the east, and consequently having the west behind them.
24085: पश्य ind. An exclamation of wonder or admiration, (lo, behold, see.) E. दृश to see, deriv. irr.; also पश्यतु and पशु.
24086: पश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Who or what sees. E. पश्य for दृश to see, श aff.
24087: पश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) 1 Looking, seeing. 2 Remarking, considering. f. (-न्ती) A harlot, a courtezan. E. दृश to see, शतृ aff. of the present participle, and root irr.
24088: पश्यतस् ind. Visibly, in sight. E. पश्य, and तसि aff.
24089: पश्यतोहर m. (-रः) A thief, a pilferer, but one who steals in presence of the parties, and proverbially applied to the goldsmith, &c. E. पश्यतस् in presence of, and हर who takes.
24090: पश्ववदान n. (-नं) Sacrifice or offering of animals. E. पशु, and अवदान oblation.
24091: पश्वाचार m. (-रः) Worship of DEVI. E. पशु, and आचार instituted observance.
24092: पष r. 10th cl. (पाषयति पषयति) 1 To bind, to tie. 2 To move. 3 To oppose, to hinder. 4 To touch.
24093: पस r. 1st and 10th cls. (पसति-ते पासयति पसयति) 1 To bind, to fetter, to tie, to string. 2 To touch. 3 To oppose, to obstruct, to hinder. 4 To go, to move. 5 To injure or kill. (इ) पसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पंसति पंसयति) To annual, to annihilate or destroy.
24094: पस्त्य n. (-स्त्यं) A house. E. स्त्यै to collect, अप् prefixed, deriv. irr.
24095: पह्नव m. (-वः) The name of one of the degraded Kṣetrīya races sentenced by SAGARA to wear beards, perhaps a Parthian.
24097: पांक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Linear, in or by line, or row. E. पंक्ति a line, aff. अण्.
24098: पांशव m. (-वः) Rock or fossile salt. E. पांशु dust, and अण् aff.
24099: पांशु m. (-शुः) 1 Dust. 2 Manure. 3 Landed property. E. पशि to bind, Uṇādi aff. कु; also पांसु.
24100: पांशुका f. (-का) 1 A menstruous woman. 2 A fragrant plant, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
24101: पांशुकासीस n. (-सं) Sulphuret of iron. E. पांशु dust, and कासीस the same.
24102: पांशुकुली f. (-ली) A principal road. E. पांशु dust, कुल a heap.
24103: पांशुकूल n. (-लं) A blank lease, a title deed, one not made out in any person's name. E. पांशु landed property, कूल a mound, (as it were.)
24104: पांशुचत्वर m. (-रः) Hail. E. पांशु dust, चत्वर a level space.
24105: पांशुचन्दन m. (-नः) A name of ŚIVA. E. पांशु dust, चन्दन Sandal.
24106: पांशुचामर m. (-रः) 1 A tent. 2 A bank overgrown with Dūrbbā grass. 3 Praise. 4 A heap of dust. 5 A small cucumber. E. पांशु dust, चामर a chowri.
24107: पांशुज n. (-जं) Salt extracted from soil, rock or fossile salt. E. पांशु dust, ज born.
24108: पांशुपत्र n. (-त्रं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. पांशु dust, and पत्र leaf.
24109: पांशुमर्द्दन m. (-नः) A channel or basin for water, near or about the root of a tree. E. पांशु dust, and मर्द्दन destroying.
24110: पांशुव m. (-वः) A cripple: see पीठसर्पिन्.
24111: पांशुर m. (-रः) 1 A gadfly. 2 A cripple carried or moving about in a chair. E. पांशु dust, and रा to get, क or ड aff.
24112: पांशुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Dusty, covered or spotted with dust. m. (-लः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 One of ŚIVA'S weapons; a sort of pole armed at the upper end with transverse pieces, representing the breastbone and ribs adjoining, and surmounted by a skull; also खद्वाङ्ग. 3 A paramour, a gallant. 4 A kind of tree, (Cæsalpinia bonducella.) f. (-ला) 1 An unchaste woman. 2 A woman during menstruation. 3 The earth. E. पांशु dust, लच् aff.
24113: पांशुवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A shower or fall of dust. E. पांशु, and वर्ष rain.
24114: पांसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Contemptible, vile. 2 Vitiating, spoiling. E. पसि to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.
24115: पांसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Contemptible, wicked, bad, infamous. 2 Vitiating, spoiling, destructive. E. पसि to destroy, aff. ल्युट्
24116: पांसु m. (-सुः) 1 Dust. 2 Manure. E. पसि to bind, &c., aff. कु, also पांशु.
24117: पा r. 1st cl. (पिवति) To drink. r. 2nd cl. (पाति) To cherish, to nourish, to protect or preserve.
24118: पा mfn. (-पाः-पाः-पं) 1 Who drinks. 2 Who protects or cherishes. E. पा to drink, &c. क्विप् aff.
24119: पाक m. (-कः) 1 Maturity, natural or artificial, as the state of being cooked or ripened. 2 Cooking, dressing food. 3 A vessel in which any thing is dressed, a saucepan, a boiler, &c. 4 Digestion, assimilation of food. 5 Suppuration, ripeness of a boil. 6 Greyness of the hair. 7 General panick, or the subversion of a country. 8 Fear. 9 An owl. 10 The name of a demon. mf. (-कः-का) The young of animals. E. पच to be or become ripe, aff. घञ्, or पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
24120: पाककृष्ण m. (-ष्णः) The Caronda tree, (Carissa carondas.) E. पाक ripening, कृष्ण black; bearing a black fruit when ripe; also other similar compounds, as पाककृष्णफल, कृष्णपाक, &c.
24121: पाकज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by cooking, maturing, &c. n. (-जं) 1 Black salt. 2 Flatulence. E. पाक, and ज born.
24122: पाकपात्र n. (-चं) A cooking utensil, a boiler, &c. E. पाक, and पात्र a vessel.
24123: पाकपुटी f. (-टी) A potter's kiln. E. पाक backing, पुट to heap, aff. क and ङीप्.
24124: पाकफल m. (-लः) The Caronda. E. पाक ripe, फल fruit, (black, understood:) see पाककृष्णफल; also पाकफलकृष्ण, फलपाक, &c.
24125: पाकभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A culinary utensil. E. पाक, and भाण्ड a vessel.
24126: पाकमत्स्य m. (-त्स्यः) Fish sauce. E. पाक cooking, मत्स्या fish.
24127: पाकयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) An oblation offered on building a house, liberating a bull, &c. or a religious rite of four kinds, oblation to the VIŚVADEVAS, offerings to the spirits, the permanent obsequial rites, and hospitality. E. पाक, and यज्ञ sacrifice; the distribution of food being part of each of these ceremonies.
24128: पाकयज्ञिक m. (-कः) The performer of the ceremony called Pākayajña. E. पाकयज्ञ, aff. ठञ्.
24129: पाकरञ्जन n. (-नं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. पाक cooking, रञ्ज to colour, aff. ल्युट्.
24130: पाकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Producing maturity. 2 Suppurative, producing suppuration in a boil. n. (-लं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) m. (-लः) Fever in an elephant. f. (-ली) A sort of cucumber, (C. utilatissimus.) E. पाक ripeness, ला to get, aff. ड.
24131: पाकलि m. (-लिः) A sort of plant, (Bauhinia candida.)
24132: पाकशाला f. (-ला) A kitchen. E. पाक cooking, शाला a hall.
24133: पाकशासन m. (-नः) INDRA. E. पाक a demon, शासन ruling, overcoming.
24134: पाकशासनि m. (-निः) The son of INDRA. E. पाकशासन INDRA, इञ् aff. of descent.
24135: पाकशुक्ला f. (-क्ला) Chalk. E. पाक cooking, burning, शुक्ल white.
24136: पाकस्थान n. (-नं) A kitchen. E. पाक cooking, स्थान a place.
24137: पाकिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Cooked, dressed, ripened, naturally or artificially. E. पाक cooking, इमनिच् aff.
24138: पाकुक m. (-कः) A cook. E. पच to cook, Uṇādi aff. णुकन्.
24139: पाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) What may or is to be cooked, matured, &c. n. (-क्यं) Bitloben, a medicinal salt, impregnated with iron. m. (-क्यः) Nitre, saltpetre. E. पच to cook, aff. ण्यट्.
24140: पाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) 1 Belonging to a half month. 2 Relating to a side or party, &c. E. पक्ष, and अण् aff.
24141: पाक्षायण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Belonging to or occurring in a Pakṣa or fortnight, &c. E. पक्ष half month, &c. and फक् aff.
24142: पाक्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a bird, to a fortnight, to an argument, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A fowler, a bird catcher. 2 An alternative. E. पक्ष a fortnight, or पक्षिन् a bird, aff. ठञ्.
24143: पाखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A heretick, a heterodox Hindu, adopting the exterior marks of the classes, but not respecting the ordinances of the Vedas. E. पा for पाल what nourishes, (mankind, as virtue may be said to do,) and खडि to subvert or destroy, aff. अण्; also पाषण्ड.
24144: पाङ्क्त्य m. (-ङ्क्त्यः) A Brahman who is or may be worthy to eat in a respectable society at sacrifices, &c. E. पंक्ति an assembly, and यञ् aff.
24145: पाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What produces maturity. 2 What cooks or dresses. 3 Digestive, tonic, what effects digestion. n. (-कं) The bile which assists in digestion. m. (-कः) 1 Fire. 2 A cook. E. पच to ripen or concoct, ण्वुल् aff.
24146: पाचकस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A she cook. E. पाचक cooking, स्त्री a woman.
24147: पाचन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 What cooks or ripens, &c. 2 Digestive. 3 Suppurative. n. (-नं) 1 A medicinal preparation, an infusion, a decoction, &c. of various drugs, chiefly carminatives or gentle stimuli given to bring the vitiated humours in fever, &c. to maturity, a sort of diet drink. 2 Penance, expiation. m. (-नः) 1 Fire. 2 Acidity, sourness. f. (-नी) A sort of myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) E. पच to dress, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
24148: पाचनक m. (-कः) 1 Borax. n. (-कं) A sort of diet drink: see the last. E. पच to mature, (metals,) in the causal form, ल्युट् aff., and कन् added.
24149: पाचल n. (-लं) Cooking, maturing. m. (-लः) 1 Fire. 2 Wind. 3 A thing dressed or matured without the aid of fire. 4 Whatever ripens, cooks, causes digestion, &c. E. पच in the causal form, अलच् aff.
24150: पाचा f. (-चा) Cooking, maturing. E. पच to cook, causal v. अङ् and टाप् affs.
24151: पाचि f. (-चिः) Cooking, maturing. E. पच to cook, इञ् aff.
24152: पाचिका f. (-का) Cooking, maturing. E. पच to cook, ण्वुल् aff.
24153: पाजस् n. (-जः) Strength, power. E. पा to nourish. असुन् Uṇādi aff., and जुट् augment.
24154: पाञ्चकपाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating to or part of that oblation which is offered in five cups. E. पञ्चकपाल, q. v. अण् aff.
24155: पाञ्चजन्य m. (-न्यः) 1 KṚṢṆA'S conch. 2 A name of fire. 3 Any shell. 4 A sort of fish, commonly Garae. E. पञ्चजन a demon, from whose bones the shell was made, यत् aff.
24156: पाञ्चजन्यधर m. (-रः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. पञ्चजन्य the conch, and धर who has.
24157: पाञ्चयाज्ञिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to or included in the five great ceremonies. n. (-कं) Either of the five great sacraments. E. पञ्चयज्ञ, and ठञ् aff.
24158: पाञ्चभौतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Consisting or made of the five elements. E. पञ्चभूत, and ठञ् aff.
24159: पाञ्चलिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet: see पाञ्चालिका.
24160: पाञ्चशब्दिक n. (-कं) Musical instruments in general, or of five sorts. E. पञ्च, शब्द sound, and ठञ् aff.
24161: पाञ्चार्थिक m. (-कः) A follower or votary of ŚIVA.
24162: पाञ्चाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Belonging to, dwelling in, ruling over &c. the country of Pañcāla. m. (-लः) 1 The sovereign of Pañcāla. 2 The company or association of five trades, the carpenter, weaver, barber, washerman, and shoemaker. E. पञ्चाल the country so called, and अण् aff. &c.
24163: पाञ्चालिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet: see पाञ्चाली.
24164: पाञ्चाली f. (-ली) 1 A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the five Pāṇḍu princes. 2 A puppet, a doll. 3 Melodious combination of five or six words. E. पञ्चाल the country so called, aff. of descent or reference अण्, and fem. aff. ङीप्; coming from that region; also with कन् added, पाञ्चालिका, and by making the second vowel short पाञ्चलिका.
24165: पाट् ind. A vocative particle. E. पट to go, in the causal form, aff. क्विप्.
24166: पाट m. (-टः) Breadth, expanse, extension. f. (-टा) Regular or successive order, series, succession. E. पट to spread, aff. घञ्.
24167: पाटक m. (-कः) 1 The half of a village. 2 A shore, a bank. 3 Casting dice. 4 A musical instrument. 5 A large span. 5 Expense or loss of capital or stock. E. पट to go, ण्वुल् aff.
24168: पाटञ्चर m. (-रः) A thief. E. पटच्चर the same, and अण् pleonastick aff.
24169: पाटन n. (-नं) Cutting. E. पट to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
24170: पाटल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a pink or pale red colour. m. (-लः) 1 Pale red, rose colour. 2 Rice ripening in the rains. f. (-ला) 1 The Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 Red Lodh. 3 A name of DURGĀ. nf. (-लं-ला) The flower of the Bignonia suave-olens. E. पाट extension, and ला to get, aff. ड; also पाटलि.
24171: पाटलि mf. (-लिः) Trumpet flower. m. (-लिः) Rice ripening in the rains. E. पाटल pale red, aff. इन्.
24172: पाटलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made red, tinted red, reddened. E. पाटल, and इतच् aff.
24173: पाटलिपुत्र n. (-त्रं) The name of a city, supposed to be the ancient Palibothra, and the modern Patna. E. पाटलि the trumpet flower, पू to be pure, त्रन् aff.; also with कन् added, पाटलिपुत्रक; it is also said to be named after its founder and sovereign, पाटलिपुत्र being a proper name.
24174: पाटलोपल n. (-लं) A ruby. E. पाटल, and उपल a stone.
24175: पाटव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Clever, sharp, dexterous. n. (-वं) 1 Cleverness, talent. 2 Health. 3 Eloquence. E. पटु clever, &c. aff. अण्.
24176: पाटविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Cunning, crafty, fraudulent. 2 Clever, dexterous. E. पटु clever, ठक् aff.
24177: पाटहिका f. (-का) A small shrub, (Abrus precatorius:) see गुञ्जा.
24178: पाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Torn, broken, divided. E. पट to divide, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
24179: पाटिन् m. (-टी) A sort of fish described as having many teeth.
24180: पाटीर m. (-रः) 1 A field. 2 A pungent root, a sort of radish. 3 The pith or manna of the bambu. 4 A cloud. 5 A sieve, a cribble. 6 Tin. 7 Disease arising from wind. 8 Sandal. E. पट to go, &c. in the causal form, ईरन् aff.
24181: पाटूपट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Going, who or what goes. E. पठ to go, अच् aff. and the root repeated, form irr.
24182: पाठ m. (-ठः) 1 Studying the Vedas or scriptures, considered as one of the five great sacraments of the Hindus. 2 Reading, perusal or study in general. (-ठा) A plant, commonly Aknidhi. E. पठ to read, aff. घञ्.
24183: पाठक m. (-कः) 1 A lecturer, a public reader of the Purāṇas or other sacred works, or a Paṇḍita who declares what is the law or custom according to the scriptures. 2 A spiritual preceptor. 3 A reader, a student. E. पठ to read, ण्वुल् aff., or पठ, causal v. वुन् aff.
24184: पाठन n. (-नं) Lecturing, teaching. E. पठ to read, causal v. ल्युट् aff.
24185: पाठभू f. (-भूः) A place where the Vedas are read or studied. E. पाठ reading, (the Vedas,) and भू place.
24186: पाठमञ्जरी f. (-री) A small bird, commonly Sāri, (Gracula religiosa).
24187: पाठशाला f. (-री) A college, a school. E. पाठ study, शाला a hall.
24188: पाठशालिनी f. (-णी) A small bird: see पाठमञ्जरी.
24189: पाठान m. (-नः) 1 Bdellium. 2 A kind of fish.
24190: पाठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Instructed, taught, lectured. E. पठ to read, causal v. क्त aff.
24191: पाठिन् m. (-ठी) 1 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.) 2 A Brahman, especially one who has finished his sacred studies. E. पाठ perusal, and इनि aff; the virtues of the plant are to be read of in medical works.
24192: पाठीन m. (-नः) A sort of fish, (Silurus boalis. HAM.) 2 A public reader or lecturer on the Purāṇas, &c. 3 A tree: see गुग्गुल. E. पाठी a Brahman, and ईन् added
24193: पाठ्य mfn. (-ट्यः-ट्या-ट्यं) To be read or studied. E. पठ to read, ण्यत् aff.; also पठणीय, &c.
24194: पाडिनी f. (-नी) An earthen pot or boiler.
24195: पाण m. (-णः) 1 Trade, traffic. 2 Praise. 3 The hand. E. पण to be of price, &c. घञ् aff.
24196: पाणि m. (-णिः) The hand. f. (-णिः) A place of sale, a shop, a market. E. पण to be of price, &c. Uṇādi aff. इन्.
24197: पाणिका f. (-का) A sort of spoon or ladle. E. पाणि the hand, कन् aff.
24198: पाणिगृहीती f. (-ती) A bride, one wedded according to the ritual. E. पाणि the hand, and ग्टहीत taken: see the next: when the compound means merely taken by the hand, the form is पाणिग्टहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं.)
24199: पाणिग्रहण n. (-णं) 1 Marriage. 2 Laying hold of the hand. E. पाणि the hand, and ग्रहण taking, the junction of the hands of the bride and bridegroom, forming part of this ceremony.
24200: पाणिग्रहणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Matrimonial. E. पाणिग्रहण, and ठक् aff.
24201: पाणिग्राह m. (-हः) 1 Laying hold of the hand. 2 Marriage. E. पाणि, and ग्राह taking.
24202: पाणिघ m. (-घः) 1 A drummer, one who plays on a tabor, &c. with his hands. 2 Playing upon a hand instrument. 3 A workman, a handicraftsman. E. पाणि the hand, हन to strike, ठक् aff. and घ substituted for the root.
24203: पाणिघात m. (-तः) 1 Striking with the hands, boxing. 2 A boxer, or one who strikes with his hand. E. पाणि the hand, and घात blow.
24204: पाणिचापल्य n. (-ल्यं) Fidgeting with the hands, snapping the fingers, &c. E. पाणि the hand, चापल्य unsteadiness.
24205: पाणिज m. (-जः) A finger nail. E. पाणि the hand, जन to be born, aff. ड.
24206: पाणितल n. (-लं) 1 The palm of the hand. 2 A measure of two Tolas. E. पाणि, and तल below.
24207: पाणिन m. (-नः) A name of PĀṆINI: see the next.
24208: पाणिनि m. (-निः) PĀṆINI, a Muni and inspired grammarian. E. पणिन् a proper name, and इञ् aff. of descent.
24209: पाणिनीय m. (-यः-या-यं) Connected with or derived from PĀṆINI, the grammarian, (as a scholar, a rule, &c.) E. पाणिनि the saint, and छ aff.
24210: पाणिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Who blows through the hands. 2 Obscure, dark, (as a path, where a noise is made with the hands, to frighten away snakes, &c.) E. पाणि the hand, ध्मा to blow or breathe, aff. खञ्.
24211: पाणिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what drinks from the hand. E. पाणि, and धे to drink, स्वश् aff.
24212: पाणिपाद n. (-दं) The hands and feet. E. पाणि the hand, and पाद the foot.
24213: पाणिपीडन n. (-नं) Marriage. E. पाणि the hand, पीडन paining, taking: see पाणिग्रहण.
24214: पाणिभुज् m. (-भुक्) The glomerous fig tree, (F. glomerata.) E. पाणि the hand, and भुज् what eats.
24215: पाणिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Possessed of hands. E. पाणि and मतुप् aff.
24216: पाणिमुक्त n. (-क्तं) A missile weapon, one thrown with the hand, as a dart, a spear. E. पाणि the hand, and मुक्त loosed.
24217: पाणिरुह् m. (-ट्) A nail. E. पाणि, and रुह to grow, क्विप् aff.
24218: पाणिवाद m. (-दः) A drummer, playing on a drum or tabor with the hand. E. पाणि the hand, and वाद who sounds; also with कन् added पाणिवादक.
24219: पाणिसर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A rope, a cord. E. पाणि the hand, सृज to go, aff. ण्यत्.
24220: पाणिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Held in the hand. E. पाणि, and स्थ what stays.
24221: पाणिहोम m. (-मः) Offerings made to Brahmans where consecrated fire is not used. E. पाणि, and होम burnt offering.
24222: पाणीतल n. (-लं) A measure of two Tolas.
24223: पाणौकरण n. (-णं) Marriage. E. पाणौ with the hand, and करण making.
24224: पाण्डर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pale or yellowish white. m. (-रः) 1 Pale or yellowish white, (the colour.) 2 A plant, commonly Marüa or Marūvaka. n. (-रं) 1 Many-flowered jasmine. 2 Red chalk. E. पडि to go, अर Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel made long; also पाण्डुर.
24225: पाण्डरपुष्पिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Śitala, (perhaps Phrynium dichotomum:) see शीतला. E. पाण्डर pale white, पुष्पी flower, aff. कन्.
24226: पाण्डव m. (-वः) A Pāṇḍava or descendant of PĀṆḌU; especially applied to YUDHIṢṬHIRA and his four brothers. E. पाण्डु a proper name, and अण् patronymick aff.
24227: पाण्डवाभील m. (-लः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. पाण्डव a Pāṇḍava, and अभी courage, (not fear,) ल who gives.
24228: पाण्डवायन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. पाडव a Pāṇḍava, and अयन going, accompanying; being the friend and ally of the Pāṇḍu princes.
24229: पाण्डवेय m. (-यः) A descendant of Pāṇḍu. E. पाण्डु, and ढक् aff.
24230: पाण्डित्य nf. (-त्यं-ती) Scholarship, learning. E. पण्डित a teacher, aff. ष्यञ्, the semivowel rejected before the feminine aff.
24231: पाण्डु mfn. (-ण्डुः-ण्डुः-ण्डु) Pale or yellowish white. m. (-ण्डुः) 1 Pale or yellowish white, (the colour.) 2 The name of a sovereign of ancient Delhi, and nominal father of YUDHIṢṬHIRA and the other four Pāṇḍava princes. 3 The jaundice. 4 A white elephant (?). f. (-ण्डुः) A plant, commonly Maṣāni, (Glycine debilis.) E. पडि to go, aff. कु, and the penultimate vowel made long.
24232: पाण्डुक m. (-कः) 1 The jaundice. 2 A name of Pāṇḍu. 3 A pale or yellowish white, (the colour.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
24233: पाण्डुकम्बल m. (-लः) 1 A sort of blanket or warm upper garment. 2 A kind of stone, (Limestone or marble?) 3 The housings of a royal elephant. E. पाण्डु pale, and कम्बल blanket.
24234: पाण्डुकम्बलिन् m. (-ली) 1 A carriage covered with a sort of blanket. 2 The housings of a royal elephant. E. पाण्डुकम्बल a blanket, and इनि aff.
24235: पाण्डुनाग m. (-गः) A plant, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 2 A white elephant. E. पाण्डु pale, नाग a plant or elephant.
24236: पाण्डुपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) Either of the Pāṇḍava princes. E. पाण्डु and पुत्त्र son; also similar compounds, as पाण्डुनन्दन, &c.
24237: पाण्डुपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Having no distinguishing or auspicious mark on the body, &c. E. पाण्डु pale, &c., and पृष्ठ back.
24238: पाण्डुभूम m. (-मः) A country with a light-coloured soil. E. पाण्डु, pale, and भूमि earth, aff. अच्.
24239: पाण्डुमृत् f. (-मृत्) 1 A country in which the soil is of a whitish colour. 2 Chalk. E. पाण्डु pale, and मृत् earth.
24240: पाण्डुमृत्तिका f. (-का) 1 The opal. 2 A pale soil. E. पाण्डु pale, and मृत्तिका earth.
24241: पाण्डुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Of a yellowish white colour. m. (-रः) 1 A pale or yellowish white. 2 The jaundice. 3 A tree: see मरुवक. n. (-रं) The white leprosy, vitiligo. E. पाण्डु pale, and र added.
24242: पाण्डुरपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Having no distinguishing or auspicious marks on the body, &c. E. पाण्डुर pale, and पृष्ठ the back.
24244: पाण्डुराग m. (-गः) Whiteness, pallor. E. पाण्डु, and राग colour.
24245: पाण्डुलोमा f. (-मा) A plant, (Glycine debilis) E. पाण्डु pale, लोमन् hair or fibres.
24246: पाण्डुवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) White. m. (-र्णः) Whiteness. E. पाण्डु, and वर्ण colour.
24247: पाण्डुशर्क्करा f. (-रा) Light-coloured gravel, (disease.) E. पाण्डु, and शर्क्करा sugar.
24248: पाण्डुशर्म्मिला f. (-ला) A name of DRAUPADĪ. E. पाण्डु a Pāṇḍu prince, शर्म्म fortune, aff. इलच्.
24249: पाण्डुसोपाक m. (-कः) The offspring of a Caṇḍāla by a Vaidehī woman, a maker of mats, baskets, &c. a worker with bambus, and reeds.
24250: पाण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Excellent, praise-worthy. E. पण to praise, aff. ण्यत्.
24251: पाण्यास्य m. (-स्यः) A Brahman who reads the Vedas upon receiving a gift at a Śrāddha. E. पाणि, and आस्य face or mouth, having his mouth in his hand.
24252: पात् m. (-पात्) 1 Falling. 2 Sin, wickedness. E. पत to fall, aff. क्विप्, and the radical vowel made long.
24253: पात् mfn. (पान् पान्ती पात्) Who or what defends or preserves, a guardian, a protector, &c. E. पा to preserve, aff. शतृ.
24254: पात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preserved, protected. E. पा to preserve, aff. क्त. m. (-तः) 1 Falling, alighting, descending. 2 A name of Rāhu. 3 The node of a planet's orbit. E. पत to fall, aff. घञ्.
24255: पातक n. (-कं) 1 Sin, crime. 2 The cause of falling, literally or figuratively. E. पत to fall or descend, causal form, (from virtue,) aff. ण्वुल्.
24256: पातकयोग m. (-गः) Incurring guilt, acting sinfully. E. पातक, and योग accession.
24257: पातकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Wicked, sinful, a sinner. E. पातक, and इनि aff.
24258: पातङ्गि m. (-ङ्गिः) Saturn. E. पतङ्ग the sun, इञ् aff. of descent.
24259: पातञ्जल n. (-लं) The Yoga system of philosophy. E. पतञ्जलि the sage by whom it was first taught, अण् aff.
24260: पातन n. (-नं) Bringing down, causing to fall. 2 Lowering, humbling. 3 Felling, knocking down. 4 Nodding, as in sleep. E. पत to fall in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
24261: पातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be drunk. 2 To be preserved or protected. E. पा to drink, to preserve, तव्य aff.
24262: पाताल n. (-लं) The regions under the earth, and the abode of the Nāgas or serpents. 2 A hole, a chasm. 3 Submarine fire. 4 The fourth sign from that in which the sun is present. m. (-लः) A sort of apparatus for calcining and subliming metals, formed of two earthen pots, the upper one inverted over the lower, and the two joined together by their necks with cement, and placed in a hole containing fire. E. पत to alight, Uṇādi aff. आलञ्.
24263: पातालनिलय m. (-यः) 1 A demon, a Daitya. 2 A Naga or infernal serpent. E. पाताल hell, and निलय abode.
24264: पातालौकस् m. (-काः) An Asura, a demon. E. पाताल hell, ओकस a house.
24265: पाति m. (-तिः) A master, a lord, a husband. E. पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. अति.
24266: पातिक m. (-कः) The Gangetick porpoise. E. पात trembling, falling, ठक् aff.
24267: पातित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Felled, struck down. 2 Lowered, depressed, humbled. E. पत to fall, causal v. क्त aff.
24268: पातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Going, going to, alighting, falling. E. पत to go, घिणुन् aff.
24269: पातिली f. (-ली) 1 A trap or snare for catching deer. 2 A small earthen vessel or pot, especially used by religious mendicants. 3 A woman of a particular class. E. पात falling, इलच् aff, fem. aff. ङीप्.
24270: पातुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Falling frequently or habitually, disposed to fall. m. (-कः) 1 The declivity of a mountain, a precipice. 2 An aquatick animal of a large size; figuratively, the water elephant. E. पत to fall, aff. उकञ्.
24271: पातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what protects or nourishes. m. (-ता) A plant, (Ocymum pilosum.) E. पा to nourish, तृच् aff.
24272: पात्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be fallen, to be alighted. E. पत to fall, ण्यत् aff.
24273: पात्त्र n. (-त्त्रं) A preservative from sin, a preserver, a saviour. E. पात् and त्र who or what saves.
24274: पात्त्रता f. (-ता) The quality or property of a preservative from sin. E. पात्त्र and तल् aff.; also with त्व, पात्त्रत्वं.
24275: पात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) A vessel in general, a plate, a cup, a jar, &c. n. (-चं) 1 A sacrificial vase or vessel, comprising various forms of cups, plates, spoons, ladles, &c. so used. 2 The channel of a river, or its course between the near and opposite bank. 3 A king's counsellor or minister. 4 Propriety, fitness. 5 A leaf. 6 The persons of a drama. 7 An order, a command. 8 The body. 9 A fit or competent person. 10 A measure of one Āḍhaka or of eight Sers. 11 A receptacle of any kind, what holds or supports. f. (-त्री) A small or portable furnace. E. पा to preserve or retain, aff. त्रन्.
24276: पात्रट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Spare, emaciate, thin. m. (-टः) Ragged garments.
24277: पात्रटीर m. (-रः) 1 An able or competent minister. 2 A vessel of metal, as silver, brass, &c. 3 Rust of iron. 4 Fire. 5 A heron. 6 A crow. E. पात्र a vessel, &c., and टीर aff.
24278: पात्रता f. (-ता) Capacity, fitness. 2 Appropriate state or circumstance. 3 The property or capacity of a cup or vessel. 4 Dignity, honor. E. पात्र capable, and तल् aff. of the abstract, quality; also with त्व aff., पात्रत्व.
24279: पात्रपाल m. (-लः) A large oar used as a rudder. E. पात्र a vessel, (a boat,) and पाल what cherishes.
24280: पात्रभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) The object of a present or of respectful treatment. E. पात्र fit, and भूत become.
24281: पात्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A servant. E. पात्र, and भृत् who takes care of.
24282: पात्रसंस्कार m. (-रः) 1 The current of a river. 2 Cleaning a vessel that has been used. E. पात्र the channel, and संस्कार completion.
24283: पात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Measured by a vessel, or the measure Pātra, sown with it, preparing it, &c. 2 Fit, adequate, appropriate. E. पात्र, and ष्ठन् aff.; also with घ aff. पात्रिय, and with यत्, पात्र्या, &c.
24284: पात्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) 1 Having a vessel. 2 Having fit or worthy persons. E. पात्र, and इनि aff.
24285: पात्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Measured, sown, cooked, &c. by a Pātra. E. पात्र, and ख aff.
24286: पात्रीय n. (-यः) A sacrificial vessel. E. पाच the same, and छ aff.
24287: पात्रीर m. (-रः) An oblation. E. पात्र a sacrificial vessel, ईर to go, क aff.
24288: पात्रेसमित m. (-तः) 1 A parasite, a person constant at dinners, or feasts, but good for nothing else. 2 A connoisseur in eating. 3 A hypocrite. E. पात्रे in a vessel, a plate, &c. and समित collected.
24289: पात्रोपकरण n. (-णं) Decorations of an inferior class, as bells, chowris, &c. E. पात्र, and उपकार instrument.
24290: पाथ m. (-थः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. n. (-थं) Water. E. पा to drink, and थक् aff.; the more usual form however is पीथ.
24291: पाथस् n. (-थः) Water. E. पा to drink, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and थुक् augment.
24292: पाथिस् m. (-थिः) 1 The sea. 2 The eye. n. (-थि) A blotch, a scab. E. पा to drink, Uṇādi aff. इसि, and थुक augment.
24293: पाथेय n. (-यं) 1 Provender, or provisions, &c. for a journey. 2 The sign Virgo. E. पथिन् road, aff. ढञ्.
24294: पाथोज n. (-जं) A lotus. E. पाथस्, and ज produced.
24295: पाथोद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. पाथस् water, दा to give, aff. क.
24296: पाथोधर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. पाथस् water, धर having.
24297: पाथोधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. पाथस् water, and धा to have, aff. कि.
24298: पाथोनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. पाथस् water, and निधि receptacle.
24299: पाद् m. (-पाद् or पात्) The foot. E. पद to go, aff. क्विप्, and the radical vowel made long.
24300: पाद m. (-दः) 1 A foot. 2 A quarter. 3 A hill at the foot of a mountain. 4 A ray of light. 5 The root of a tree. 6 The foot or line of a stanza. 7 The line of a hymn or stanza of the Ṛg Veda. 8 The quadrant of a circle. E. पद to go, aff. घञ्.
24301: पादकटक m. (-कः) An ornament for the feet or toes. E. पाद a foot, and कटक a bracelet.
24302: पादकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, eating once and fasting on alternate nights. E. पाद a quarter, and कृच्छ्र penance.
24303: पादगण्डिर m. (-रः) Morbid enlargement of the legs and feet. E. पाद the foot, गण्ड a swelling, इरन् aff.
24304: पादग्रहण n. (-णं) Respectful obeisance, touching the feet of a Brahman or superior. E. पाद, and ग्रहण taking.
24305: पादचत्वर m. (-रः) 1 A goat. 2 A sand bank. 3 The religious fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 4 Hail. 5 A slanderer, a calumniator. E. पाद the foot, and चत्वर levelled ground.
24306: पादचापल्य n. (-ल्यं) Beating or shuffling with the feet. E. पाद a foot, &c. चापल्य unsteadiness.
24307: पादचार n. (-रं) 1 The daily position of the planets. 2 Going on foot. E. पाद, and चार going.
24308: पादचारिन् m. (-री) A footman, a foot-soldier. E. पाद, and चर to go, aff. णिनि.
24309: पादज m. (-जः) A Śūdra, or man of the fourth and servile tribe. E. पाद the foot, (of BRAHMĀ,) and ज born.
24310: पादतल n. (-लं) 1 The sole or the lower part of the foot. adv. As low as or under the feet. E. पाद, and तल below.
24311: पादतस् ind. 1 At the foot. 2 By or with a quarter. E. पाद, and तसि aff.
24312: पादत्राण n. (-णं) A boot, a shoe. E. पाद the foot, and त्राण preserving.
24313: पाददारी f. (-री) A chap in the feet, a chilblain. E. पाद, दृ to rend, अण् aff.
24314: पादप m. (-पः) 1 A tree. 2 A foot-stool, a cushion, &c. for the feet. f. (-पा) A shoe, a slipper. E. पाद a foot, or root, and पा to drink or preserve, aff. क.
24315: पादपरिघदृन n. (-नं) Trampling, treading upon. E. पाद, and परिघट्टन friction.
24316: पादपरुहा f. (-हा) A creeping or a parasite plant. E. पादप a tree, and रुह what mounts.
24317: पादपाश m. (-शः) 1 A foot-rope for cattle or horses. 2 An anklet of small bells, &c. f. (-शी) 1 A chain for the feet, a fetter. 2 A foot-carpet or mat. E. पाद the foot, and पाश a fetter.
24318: पादपीठ m. (-ठः) A foot-stool. E. पाद, and पीठ a stool.
24319: पादपीठिका f. (-का) 1 Any common or vulgar trade, as that of a barber, &c. 2 A white-stone. E. पादपीठ a foot-stool, a work bench, ङीप् depreciative aff., and कन् added.
24320: पादप्रक्षालन n. (-नं) Washing the feet. E. पाद, and प्रक्षालन washing.
24321: पादप्रणाम m. (-मः) Bowing to the feet, prostration. E. पाद, and प्रणाम bowing.
24322: पादप्रधारण n. (-णं) A shoe. E. पाद, and प्रधारण defending.
24323: पादप्रहार m. (-रः) A kick. E. पाद the foot, and प्रहार striking.
24324: पादबन्धन n. (-नं) Stock of cattle. E. पाद a foot, and बन्धन binding, alluding to the foot-ropes with which cattle are tied.
24325: पादमूल n. (-लं) The heel. E. पाद the foot, and मूल the root.
24326: पादरक्षण n. (-णं) A leather boot or shoe. E. पाद the foot, and रक्षण protecting.
24327: पादरज्जु f. (-ज्जुः) An elephant's heel-ropes. E. पाद, and रज्जु a rope.
24328: पादरथ mf. (-थः-थी) A shoe, a slipper. E. पाद the foot, and रथ, a vehicle.
24329: पादरोहण m. (-णः) The Indian fig tree. E. पाद, and रोहण what rises.
24330: पादवन्दन n. (-नं) Respect, respectful behaviour. E. पाद, and वन्दन saluting.
24331: पादवल्मीक n. (-कं) Morbid enlargement of the legs and feet. E. पाद the foot, वल्मीक a hillock.
24332: पादविक m. (-कः) A traveller, a way-farer. E. पदवी a road, aff. ठक्.
24333: पादविरजस् f. (-जाः) A shoe, a slipper. E. पाद the foot, वि privative, रजस् dust.
24334: पादशब्द m. (-ब्दः) The sound or noise of feet. E. पाद a foot, and शब्द sound.
24335: पादशश् ind. 1 Verse by verse, stanza by stanza. 2 Foot by foot. 3 By a fourth. E. पाद a verse, शशि aff.
24336: पादशाखा f. (-खा) A toe. E. पाद a foot, शाखा a branch.
24337: पादशैल m. (-लः) A hill near a mountain. E. पाद the foot, and शैल a hill.
24338: पादशोथ m. (-थः) Swelling of the feet, gout. E. पाद, and शोथ a swelling.
24339: पादसेवन n. (-नं) Service, duty. E. पाद, and सेवन waiting upon.
24340: पादस्फोट m. (-टः) Kibe, chilblain, a sore or ulcer on the foot. E. पाद the foot, and स्फोट a boil.
24341: पादहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trodden on, kicked, touched with the feet. E. पाद, and हत struck.
24342: पादहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Tingling of the feet after pressure upon the crural nerves. E. पाद, and हर्ष pleasure.
24343: पादहारक m. (-कः) One who takes or steals any thing with his feet. E. पाद a foot, हृ to take, aff. ण्वुल्.
24344: पादाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The point of the foot. E. पाद, and अग्र point or tip.
24345: पादाङ्गद n. (-दं) An ornament for the feet or toes. E. पाद the foot, अङ्ग shape, beauty, and द what gives.
24346: पादाङ्गुली f. (-ली) A toe. E. पाद a foot, अङ्गुली a finger.
24347: पादाङ्गुष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The great toe. E. पाद a foot, अङ्गुष्ठ the thumb.
24348: पादाङ्गुष्ठिका f. (-का) An ornament or ring worn on the great toe. E. पादाङ्गुष्ठ the great toe, aff. कन्, fem. form.
24349: पादात् m. (-दात्) A foot-soldier, a footman. E. पाद foot, अत to go, aff. क्विप्.
24350: पादात m. (-तः) A foot-soldier, a footman. n. (-तं) Infantry. E. पाद, and अत to go, aff. अच्, or पदाति a foot-soldier, अण् collective aff.
24351: पादाति m. (-तिः) A foot-soldier, a man on foot, or footman. E. पाद with अत to go, aff. इन्; also पदाति; also with कन् added, पादातिक m. (-कः)
24352: पादाध्यास m. (-सः) Treading upon, kicking, spurning. E. पाद, and अध्यास placing upon.
24353: पादानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bowed down to the feet, prostrate. E. पाद, and आनत bowed.
24354: पादारक m. (-कः) The knees or ribs of a boat, supporting the deck on each side, (?). E. पाद a foot, ऋ to go, aff. ण्वुल्.
24355: पादार्घ्य n. (-र्ध्यं) A donation to Brahmans, or venerable persons. E. पाद foot, अर्ध्य a respectful offering.
24356: पादार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) 1 An eighth. 2 Half a line of a stanza. E. पाद, and, अर्द्ध a half.
24357: पादालिन्द mf. (-न्दः-न्दा or न्दी) A boat.
24358: पादावनेजन n. (-नं) Washing the feet. E. पाद, and अवनेजन washing.
24359: पादावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A machine for raising water from a well. E. पाद foot, and आवर्त्त revolving, worked by the feet.
24360: पादावसेचन n. (-नं) Washing the feet. E. पाद, and अवसेचन sprinkling.
24361: पादाविक m. (-कः) A foot-soldier. E. पाद a foot, अब to go, &c. aff. इक or ठक्.
24362: पादासन n. (-नं) A foot-stool. E. पाद, and आसन a seat.
24363: पादास्फालन n. (-नं) Trampling, shuffling, or motion of the feet. E. पाद, and आस्फालन waving.
24364: पादाहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kicked, trodden, touched by the foot. E. पाद, and आहत struck.
24365: पादिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fourth, a fourth. E. पाद a quarter, and ठक् aff.
24366: पादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Footed, having feet. 2 Having a fourth part or share. 3 Having four parts, as a stanza, &c. m. (-दी) 1 A footed aquatic animal, an amphibious animal. 2 The heir of a fourth part of the estate. E. पाद, and इनि aff.
24367: पादिन m. (-नः) A fourth part. E. पाद a quarter, घ aff.
24368: पादुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) Who or what goes on foot or with feet. f. (-का) A shoe, a slipper. E. पाद, and उकन् aff.
24369: पादुकाकार m. (-रः) A shoemaker. E. पादुका a shoe, and कार who makes.
24370: पादुकाकृत् m. (-कृत्) A shoemaker. E. पादुका a shoe, and कृत्, who makes.
24371: पादू f. (-दूः) A shoe. E. पद to go, Uṇādi aff. ऊ.
24372: पादूकृत् m. (-कृत्) A shoemaker. E. पादू a shoe, and कृत् who makes.
24373: पादोदक n. (-कं) Water for the feet, especially that in which the feet of a Brahman have been washed. E. पाद, and उदक water.
24374: पाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Water, &c. for cleaning the feet. E. पाद the foot, यत् aff.
24375: पाद्यपात्र n. (-त्रं) A metal vessel for washing the feet. E. पाद्य, and पात्र a vessel.
24376: पान n. (-नं) 1 Drinking. 2 A drinking cup or vessel. 3 Preserving, protecting. m. (-नः) 1 Breath, breathing out, expiration. 2 A distiller. E. पा to drink, &c. aff. ल्युट्.
24377: पानगोष्ठिका f. (-का) A dram shop, a place where people drink together. E. पान drinking, गोष्ठी a station, aff. कन्.
24378: पानपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Drinking, quaffing, who or what drinks assiduously. 2 Looking at amorously. E. पान, and पर intent.
24379: पानपात्र n. (-त्रं) A glass, a drinking vessel. E. पान drinking, पात्र a vessel.
24380: पानबणिज् m. (-णिक्) A distiller, a vender of spirits. E. पान drinking, बणिज् a dealer.
24381: पानभाजन n. (-नं) A drinking vessel, a glass, a goblet. E. पान, and भाजन a vessel.
24382: पानरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drinking, drunken. E. पान, and रत engaged in.
24383: पानशौण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A hard drinker. E. पान, and शौण्ड intoxicated.
24384: पानस n. (-सं) A spirituous liquor prepared from the fruit of the Jack tree. E. पनस the Jack, and अण् aff.
24385: पानात्यय m. (-यः) Morbid state after intoxication. E. पान, and अत्यय end.
24386: पानिल n. (-लं) A drinking vessel. E. पान drinking, and इलच् aff.
24387: पानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Drinkable, to be drunk. 2 To be cherished, protected or preserved. n. (-यं) Water. E. पा to drink, अनीयर participial aff.
24388: पानीयनकुल m. (-लः) An otter. E. पानीय water, नकुल an ichneumon.
24389: पानीयपृष्ठज m. (-जः) An aquatick plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. पानीय water, पृष्ठ surface, ज born.
24390: पानीयमूलक m. (-कः) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica:) see सोमराजी. E. पानीय water, मूल root, कन् aff.
24391: पानीयशालिका f. (-का) A place where water, &c. is distributed. E. पानीय water, शाला a place, aff. कन्.
24392: पानीयामलक n. (-कं) A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. पानीय water, and आमलक myrobalan.
24393: पान्थ mf. (-न्यः-न्या) A traveller. E. पथिन् a road, and अण् aff.
24394: पाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Mischievous, destructive, malignant. 2 Vile, low, abandoned, vicious. m. (-पः) A wicked man, a wretch, a profligate. n. (-पं) Sin, crime, wickedness, vice. E. पा to preserve (from it), and प Uṇādi aff.
24395: पापक n. (-कं) Sin. E. कन् added to the last.
24396: पापकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wicked, abandoned. E. पाप, and कर who does.
24397: पापकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) Sinful, wicked, a sinner. E. पाप, and कर्त्तृ who does.
24398: पापकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, sinful. E. पाप, and कर्म्मन् act.
24399: पापकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Sinful, wicked, a sinner. E. पाप sin, कृ to commit, aff. क्विप्.
24400: पापगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Evidently involved in the consequences of sin. E. पाप, and गोचर visible object.
24401: पापग्रह m. (-हः) Any ill omened aspect of the stars, as the conjunction of the sun or Budha with the moon in its last quarter. 2 Rāhu. 3 Saturn. 4 Mars. E. पाप, and ग्रह asterism.
24402: पापघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing sin. E. पाप, and घ्न destructive.
24403: पापचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what matures or cooks often or much. E. पच to cook, &c. frequent. v. ण्वुल् aff.; also पापाचक.
24404: पापचर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A sinner. 2 A fiend, a Rākṣasa. E. पाप, and चर्य्या practice, or चर्य्य to be gone (in or by.)
24405: पापचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Wicked, vile. E. पाप, and चेतस् understanding.
24406: पापचेली f. (-ली) A plant, commonly Aknidhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. पच to ripen, reiterated पापच, (rheumatism,) ईर to dissipate, affs. अच् and ङीप्, and र changed to ल; also with कन् added in the fem. form पापचेलिका.
24407: पापति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Who or what alights, goes or falls much or frequently. E. पत to alight, &c. frequent. v, किन् aff.
24408: पापदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Malevolent, looking at faults. E. पाप, and दर्शिन् who sees.
24409: पापदृश्वन् mfn. (-श्वा-श्वा-श्व) Conscious of guilt, knowing an act to be wicked. E. पाप, and दृश to see, क्वनिप् aff.
24410: पापनापित m. (-तः) A vile or bad barber. E. पाप sinful, नापित a barber.
24411: पापनाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Purifying, sin-destroying. E. पाप, and नाशिन् destroying.
24412: पापनिरति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Wicked, villainous, a wretch. f. (-तिः) Wickedness. E. पाप, and निरति attachment.
24413: पापपति m. (-तिः) A paramour, a gallant. E. पाप wicked, and पति husband.
24414: पापपुरुष m. (-षः) A personification of all sin, or a male, whose head is Brahmanicide, whose arms are theft, whose heart is wine drinking, &c. E. पाप, and पुरुष a man.
24415: पापबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Evil-minded, wicked. E. पाप, and बुद्धि intellect.
24416: पापमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a corrupt mind, depraved. E. पाप, and मति mind.
24417: पापमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Freed from sin, liberated from all crime. E. पाप, and मुक्त set free.
24418: पापयोनि f. (-निः) Birth in some inferior state, as an animal, &c. as the punishment of sin. E. पाप, and योनि womb.
24419: पापरोग m. (-गः) A disease, considered as the punishment of sin in a former life. 2 Small pox. E. पाप sin, and रोग disease.
24420: पापर्द्धि f. (-र्द्धिः) Hunting, chase. E. पाप sin, and ऋद्वि thriving.
24421: पापल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Giving or taking sin. n. (-लं) A measure. E. पाप, and लच् aff.
24422: पापविनिग्रह m. (-हः) Restraining or punishing wickedness. E. पाप, and विनिग्रह restraint.
24423: पापशमन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Palliating or removing crime. n. (-नं) A sin-offering. E. पाप, and शमन appeasing.
24424: पापसम्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Equal in sin, of like guilt. E. पाप, and सम्मित measured.
24425: पापात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A sinner, a reprobate, a wretch. E. पाप, and आत्मन् soul.
24426: पापानुवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Addicted to sin. E. पाप, and अनुवसित dwelling with.
24427: पापापनुत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Expiation. E. पाप, and अपनुत्ति removing.
24428: पापाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Wicked, sinful. E. पाप, and आशय abode.
24429: पापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Wicked, sinful, bad, a sinner. E. पाप, and इनि aff.
24430: पापिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very wicked. E. पाप, and इष्ठन् aff.
24431: पापीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very wicked. E. पाप, and ईयसुन् aff.
24432: पाप्मन् m. (-प्मा) Sin, wickedness. E. पा to preserve (from it), मनिन् Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.
24433: पामघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Sulphur. E. पामन् scab, and अघ्न destroying.
24434: पामन् nf. (-म-मा) Cutaneous eruption, herpes, scab. E. पै to dry, aff. मनिन्.
24435: पामन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Diseased with herpes. E. पामन् herpes, and न aff.
24436: पामर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Wicked, vile, low, base. 2 Stupid, an idiot, a fool. E. पाम scab, and रा to get, क aff.
24437: पामरोद्धारा f. (-रा) A plant: see गुडुची. E. पामर here said to mean bile, उद् before हृ to take away, aff. घञ् and टाप्.
24438: पामारि m. (-रिः) Sulphur. E. पामा scab, and अरि an enemy.
24439: पाम्प mfn. (-म्पः-म्पी-म्पं) Belonging to the river, (Pampā.) E. पम्पा, and अण् aff.
24440: पाय n. (-यं) Water. E. पा to drink, अच् aff. and युक् augment.
24441: पायस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Made of or from milk or water. mn. (-सः-सं) 1 An oblation of milk, rice, and sugar. 2 Turpentine. n. (-सं) Milk. E. पयस् milk, aff. अण्.
24442: पायसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fond of or relating to a mixture of milk, &c. E. पायस, and ठक् aff.
24443: पायिक m. (-कः) A foot-soldier, a footman. E. पा to cherish, ण्वुल् aff., and युक् and इट् augments.
24444: पायु m. (-युः) The anus. E. पा to preserve, Uṇādi aff. उण् and युक् inserted.
24445: पाय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Low, vile, reprehensible, contemptible. n. (-य्यं) 1 Measure. 2 Water. 3 Drinking. 4 Practice, profession. E. पा to drink, ण्यत् aff.
24446: पार r. 10th cl. (पारयति) To accomplish, to finish, to get through or over.
24447: पार n. (-रं) The further or opposite bank of a river. mn. (-रः-रं) The end, the extremity, the last. m. (-रः) Quicksilver. f. (-रा) The name of a river, said to flow from the Pāriyātra mountains, or the centrical and western portion of the Vindhya chain. f. (-री) 1 A quantity of water. 2 A rope for tying an elephant's feet. 3 A small water jar. 4 The pollen of a flower. 5 A drinking vessel, a glass, a cup. 6 A milk pail. E. पर another, ईर to go to or towards; or पार to cross over; or पॄ to fill, aff. अच्.
24448: पारक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 What purifies, protects, cherishes, pleases, &c. 2 What enables any one to cross, (a river or the world.) E. पॄ to please, ण्वुल् aff.
24449: पारक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 1 An enemy, hostile, inimical. 2 Alien, belonging to another. n. (-क्यं) Pious conduct, doing any thing for the sake of future happiness. E. परक or पारक, and यञ् aff.
24450: पारग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Crossing, crossing over. 2 Going over or beyond the world. E. पार the opposite bank, and ग who goes.
24451: पारगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Crossed. 2 Gone over the world, pure, holy. m. (-तः) A Jina or Jaina deified teacher. E. पार the further bank, (of the world,) and गत attained, gone to.
24452: पारग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Hostile, inimical. E. पर an enemy, ग्राम a number, ठक् aff.
24453: पारज् m. (-रक्) Gold. E. पॄ to satisfy, Uṇādi aff. अजि.
24454: पारजायिक m. (-कः) An adulterer. E. पर another, जाया wife, ठक् aff.
24455: पारटीट m. (-टः) A stone, a rock. E. पार across, and टीट aff.
24456: पारण m. (-णः) A cloud. nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Eating or drinking after a fast, breaking a fast. 2 Satisfying, satisfaction. E. पॄ to satisfy, aff. ल्यु.
24457: पारत m. (-तः) Quicksilver. E. पार fulness, (from पॄ to please,) and तन to spread or diffuse, aff. ड, also पारद.
24458: पारतन्त्र्य n. (-न्त्र्यं) Subservience, slavery, dependence. E. परतन्त्र dependant, aff. ष्यञ्.
24459: पारत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the next world. E. परत्र, and ठक् aff.
24460: पारद m. (-दः) Quicksilver. E. पार as in पारत, and द what gives, from दा with क aff.
24461: पारदण्डक m. (-कः) The name of a country, part of Orissa. E. पार beyond, दण्डक the Daṇḍaka forest.
24462: पारदारिक m. (-कः) An adulterer. E. पर another, दार wife, aff. ठक्.
24463: पारदार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Adultery. E. पर another, दार a wife, ष्यञ् aff.
24464: पारदेशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Foreign, abroad. m. (-कः) 1 A traveller. 2 A foreigner. E. परदेश, and ठक् aff.
24465: पारदेश्य mfn. (-श्यः-शी-श्यं) Belonging to another country. m. (-श्यः) 1 A traveller, one gone to a foreign country. 2 A foreigner. E. पर another, देश country, ष्यञ् aff.
24466: पारदृश्वन् mfn. (-श्वा-श्वा-श्व) Long-sighted, far-seeing, wise. E. पार, and दृश to see, क्वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
24467: पारधेनु m. (-नुः) A particular and low cast, the Ayogava. Also, पारधेनुक.
24468: पारभृत n. (-तं) A present, an offering. E. पर, भृत prepared, अण् aff.
24469: पारभृतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a present. E. पारभृत, and छ aff.
24470: पारमार्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Preferable, best, most desirable. E. परमार्थ chief object, and ठक् aff.
24471: पारमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Supreme, chief, best. E. परम best, ठञ् aff.
24472: पारमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Crossed, traversed. 2 Transcendant, (as spiritual knowledge.) E. पारस् across, and इत gone.
24473: पारम्पर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Traditional instruction, tradition. 2 Continuous order or succession. E. परम्पर from one to another, aff. ष्यञ्.
24474: पारम्पर्य्योपदेश m. (-शः) Traditional instruction. E. पारम्पर्य्य, and उपदेश instruction.
24475: पारय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Able, adequate, fit for. 2 Satisfying. E. पॄ to satisfy, श aff.
24476: पारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Satisfying, filling. 2 Being able or competent to. 3 Being alive, living. E. पॄ to satisfy, शतृ aff.
24477: पारयिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Gratifying, pleasing, satisfying. E. पॄ to please, causal v. इष्णु aff.
24478: पारलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to the next world. E. परलोक another world, aff. ठक्, and both vowels changed by special rule.
24479: पारवत m. (-तः) A pigeon. See पारावत.
24480: पारशव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made or derived from an axe. m. (-वः) 1 The son of a Śūdra woman by a Brahman. 2 A son by another's wife, an adulterine. 3 An iron weapon. E. पर another, शत्र to go, अच् aff. and अण् implying descent, added; or पार crossing, शव a corpse, a living corpse; or परशु an axe, aff. अञ्.
24481: पारशीक m. (-कः) 1 Persia. 2 A native of Persia. 3 A Persian horse; also पारसीक.
24482: पारश्वध m. (-घः) One armed with an axe, a hatchet-man, a pioneer, &c. E. परश्वध an axe, aff. अण्.
24483: पारश्वधिक m. (-कः) A soldier, or any other man armed with an axe. E. पारश्वध an axe, ठञ् aff.
24486: पारसिक m. (-कः) 1 The kingdom of Persia. 2 A Persian, an inhabitant of Persia. 3 A Persian horse.
24487: पारस्त्रैणेय m. (-यः) An adulterine, the son of another's wife. E. पर another, स्त्री woman, ठक् aff. of descent, and इणञ augment.
24488: पारापत m. (-तः) A pigeon; also पारावत.
24489: पारापार m. (-रः) The ocean. n. (-रं) The two banks of a river. E. पार the further bank, and अपार the near bank.
24490: पारायण n. (-णं) 1 Totality, entireness, completeness. 2 Going over, reading or doing any thing completely. 3 Going across. 4 Reading a Purāṇa, or causing it to be read. f. (-णी) 1 The goddess SARASVATĪ. 2 Action, act. 3 Considering, meditating. 4 Light. E. पार the boundary or limit, and अयन going to, extending: when used attributively it remains always neuter.
24491: पारायणिक m. (-कः) 1 A pupil, a scholar. 2 A lecturer, a reader of the Purāṇas. E. पारायण reading through, ठञ् aff.
24492: पारारुक m. (-कः) A rock. E. पार the further bank, ऋ to go to, aff. उकन्.
24493: पारावत m. (-तः) 1 A dove, a pigeon. 2 A monkey. 3 A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) 4 A mountain. f. (-ती) 1 The name of a river in the peninsula. 2 The fruit of the Annona reticulata. 3 A form of song, peculiar to the cowherds. E. पर another, (life, &c.) अव to go, to preserve, शतृ participial aff., and अण् added.
24494: पारावतपदी f. (-दी) Heart pea: see पारावताङ्घी.
24496: पारावताङ्घ्री f. (-ङ्घ्री) Heart pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.) E. पारावत a pigeon, अङ्घ्रि a foot, the root being compared to a pigeon's foot; also similar compounds, as पारावतपदी.
24497: पारावार m. (-रः) The ocean. n. (-रं) The near and opposite banks of a stream. E. पार the further bank, वृ to surround, with आङ् prefix, अण् aff.
24498: पारावारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 On both sides of a river, &c. 2 One who goes to both sides. E. पार the opposite side, अवार this side, aff. ख.
24499: पाराशर m. (-रः) A name of the poet VYĀSA. n. (-रं) The rules of PARĀŚARA or VYĀSA, for the conduct of the mendicant orders. E. पराशर, and अण् added.
24500: पाराशरकल्पिक m. (-कः) A follower of PARĀŚARA, the institutor of rules for the mendicant order. E. पराशर the sage, कल्प aff., and ठक् added.
24501: पाराशरि m. (-रिः) VYĀSA. E. पराशर, and इञ् patronymick aff.
24502: पाराशरिन् m. (-री) The religious mendicant or Brahman, who having passed through the three stages of student, householder, and ascetick, leads a vagrant life, and subsists upon alms. E. पाराशर्य्य VYĀSA, the author of the rules of this order, and इनि aff.
24503: पाराशर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The poet VYĀSA. E. पराशर the father of the poet, and यञ् aff.
24504: पारिकाङ्क्षिन् m. (-ङ्क्षी) 1 An ascetick, one who devotes his days to devout contemplation. 2 The religious mendicant. E. परि implying secession, (abandoning worldly wishes,) काङ्क्षि to desire, and णिनि aff.; or पारि derived from पर, supreme felicity, and कांक्षिन् who desires.
24505: पारिजात m. (-तः) 1 A tree of paradise. 2 The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgenis.) E. पारि said to mean, above, and जात produced.
24506: पारिजातक m. (-कः) 1 A tree of paradise. 2 The coral tree. E. कन् added to the last.
24507: पारिणाय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Belonging to specifically or peculiarly. n. (-य्यं) Property received at the time of marriage by a woman. E. परि about, around, णी to get, aff. ण्यत्.
24508: पारिणाह्य n. (-ह्यं) Household furniture and utensils. E. परिणाह and ष्यञ् aff.
24509: पारितथ्या f. (-थ्या) A trinket worn on the forehead, where the hair is parted. E. परि every way (splendid), तथा there, यञ् added.
24510: पारितोषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Delighting, making happy. n. (-कं) A reward, a gratuity. E. परितोष satisfaction, ठञ् aff.
24511: पारिन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A lion: see परिन्द्र.
24512: पारिपन्थिक m. (-कः) A robber, a thief, a highwayman. E. परि around, पथिन the road, aff. ठक्.
24513: पारिपाट्य n. (-ट्यं) Regularity, methodicalness, successiveness. E. परिपाटी orderly course, ष्यञ् aff.
24514: पारिपात्र m. (-त्रः) The name of a mountain, apparently the centrical or western portion of the Vindhya chain, which skirts the province of Malva. E. परि every way, पा to cherish, ष्ट्रन् aff.; or with कन् added, पारिपात्रक; also read पारियात्र.
24515: पारिपात्रक m. (-कः) A mountain so called: see the last.
24516: पारिपार्श्विक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, who serves as a sort of chorus to the drama, and is one of the interlocutors in the prologue. 2 An attendant. E. परि about, पार्श्व the side, (of the manager, &c.) aff. ठक्.
24517: पारिप्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Perturbed, troubled in mind. 2 Trembling, tremulous, unsteady. E. परिप्लव, and अण् added.
24518: पारिप्लाव्य m. (-व्यः) A goose. n. (-व्यं) 1 Perplexity, agitation. 2 Tremulousness. E. परिप्लव, and ष्यञ् aff.
24519: पारिभद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.) 2 The Nimb tree. 3 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadāru.) 4 The Saral, also a sort of pine, (P. longifolia.) E. परि completely, भद्र auspicious, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, पारिभद्रक.
24520: पारिभाव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Surety, security, bail. 2 A drug, a sort of costus, (C. speciosus.) E. परिभू a surety, or परिभव overcoming (disease), aff. यञ्.
24521: पारिमाण्डल्य n. (-ल्यं) An atom, as a measure of space, a mote in a sun beam. E. परिमण्डल a ball, and ष्यञ् aff.
24522: पारिमुखिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Present, before or about the face. E. परि about, मुख the face, ठक् aff.
24523: पारिमुख्य n. (-ख्यं) Presence, being before the face. E. परिमुख, and ष्यञ् aff.
24524: पारियात्र m. (-त्रः) The name of a mountain: see पारिपात्र, also with कन् added, पारियात्रक, or with ठक aff. पारियात्रिक.
24525: पारियानिक m. (-कः) A travelling cart or carriage. E. परि every way, यान going, aff. ठक्.
24526: पारिरक्षक m. (-कः) An ascetick or religious mendicant. E. पारि said to mean, future happiness, from परि, and रक्षक who preserves.
24527: पारिश m. (-शः) A tree: see गर्द्धभाण्ठ.
24528: पारिषद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Belonging or relating to an assembly. m. (-दः) A spectator, a person present at an assembly or congregation. E. परिषद् an assembly, aff. अञ्; or with ण्य aff. पारिषद्य.
24529: पारिषद्य m. (-द्यः) A spectator: see the last.
24530: पारिहारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Taking away, seizing. 2 Surrounding. m. (-कः) A maker of garlands. E. परिहार seizure, ठक् aff.
24531: पारिहार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A bracelet. n. (-र्य्यं) Taking, seizure. E. परिहार, and ष्पञ् aff.; also परिहार्य्य.
24532: पारीक्षित m. (-तः) 1 The name of a sovereign, to whom the ŚrīBhāgavata, or life of KṚṢṆA, is supposed to have been addressed. 2 The successor of the preceding; also JANAMEJAYA. E. परीक्षित्. the king so called, and अण् pleonasm or patronymic.
24533: पारीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 On the other or opposite side. 2 Who goes or crosses to the other side. E. पार the other side, aff. ख.
24534: पारीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A lion. 2 A large snake, (Böa.) E. पर another, (animal,) and इन्द्र lord, form irr.
24535: पारु m. (-रुः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. पा to nourish, Uṇādi aff. रु.
24536: पारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) 1 Abuse, reproach, scurrilous, opprobrious or unfriendly speech. 2 The property of harshness, &c. in speaking. 3 The forest or grove of INDRA. 4 Aloe wood or Agallochum. 5 Severity, violence, either in word or deed, as वाक्पारुष्यं defamation, abuse, or violence of words, and दण्डपारुष्यं personal injury, assault or violence of blows. m. (-ष्यः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. परुष harsh, contumelious, &c. aff. ष्यञ्.
24537: पारेरक m. (-कः) A sword, a scimitar. E. पार collectively, foes, from पर an enemy, ईर to penetrate, aff. वुन्.
24538: पार्घट n. (-टं) Ashes. E. पार from पर another, घट to endeavour, aff. अच्, and the final vowel of पार rejected.
24539: पार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 A king, a prince. 2 A name of the Pāṇḍu prince ARJUNA. 3 A name of KĀRTAVĪRYA. 4 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. पृथा a proper name, अण् aff. of descent.
24540: पार्थक्य n. (-क्यं) Severalty, individuality, difference. E. पृथक् separate, ष्यञ् aff.
24541: पार्थव n. (-वं) Greatness, immensity. E. पृथु great, अण् aff.; also पृथुता, पृथुत्व, &c.
24542: पार्थिव mfn. (-वः-वा or वी-वं) 1 Earthen, made or derived from earth. 2 Ruling or possessing the earth. m. (-वः) 1 A king, a prince. 2 An earthen vessel. f. (-वी) A name of SĪTĀ. E. पृथिवी the earth, अञ् aff.
24543: पार्पर m. (-रः) A name of YAMA.
24544: पार्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं) Relating to a Parva, a particular day of the month, &c. E. पर्व्वन् and अण् aff.
24545: पार्व्वण m. (-णः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 The general funeral ceremony to be offered to all the manes at the Parva, or conjunction of the sun and moon, at which double oblations are offered; three cakes to the father, paternal grandfather, and great grandfather; and three to the maternal grandfather, his father, and grandfather; and the crumbs of each set to the remoter ancestors in each line. E. पर्व्व a knot, &c. aff. अण्.
24546: पार्व्वत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Mountain, produced in the mountains. m. (-तः) A tree called the large Nimb, (Melia sempervirens.) f. (-ती) 1 A name of DURGĀ, in her capacity of daughter of HIMĀLA, the sovereign of the snowy mountains. 2 DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the Pāṇḍu princes. 3 A female cowherd or Gopī. 4 The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 5 Another tree, (Celtis orientalis.) 6 A red clay, commonly called Saurāṣṭrī, or Surat earth. 7 A name applied to several rivers. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, अण् aff. of descent or relation.
24547: पार्व्वतीनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. पार्व्वती the goddess, and नन्दन a son.
24548: पार्व्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mountain, mountaineer. E. पर्व्वतीय, and अण् added.
24549: पार्व्वतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain or mountain-born, &c. n. (-यं) 1 Antimony. 2 A plant bearing a pungent fruit. E. पर्व्वत a mountain, and ढक् aff.
24550: पार्व्वायनान्तीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Occurring at the end of a Parva or a solstice, (a sacrifice, &c.) E. पर्व्व, and अयन solstice, अन्त end, छ aff.
24551: पार्शव m. (-वः) A warrior armed with an axe. E. पर्शु an axe, and अण् aff.
24552: पार्श्व mfn. (-र्श्वः-र्श्वा-र्श्वं) Near, proximate, by the side of. mn. (-र्श्वः-र्श्वं) 1 A side, the part of the body below the armpit. 2 The curve or circumference of a wheel. 3 Side of any square figure. n. (-र्श्वं) 1 A multitude of ribs, the thorax. 2 A fraudulent or crooked expedient. m. (-र्श्वः) The twenty-third Jina or Jaina pontiff. E. स्पृश to touch, श्वण Uṇādi aff., and पृ substituted for the root, or पर्शु a rib, aff. अण्.
24553: पार्श्वक m. (-कः) 1 A pilferer, a swindler, any one who seeks wealth or other objects, by dishonest or indirect means. 2 A rib. E. पार्श्व a dishonest means, a side, and कन् aff.
24554: पार्श्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Close to, beside. E. पार्श्व, and गत gone to.
24555: पार्श्वतस् ind. By or from the side of, &c. E. पार्श्व the side, and तसि aff.
24556: पार्श्वतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to the side of. E. पार्श्वतस्, and छ aff.; the final अस् rejected.
24557: पार्श्वपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Turning upon the side. E. पार्श्व, and परिवर्त्तन turning.
24558: पार्श्वभाग m. (-गः) The side, the flank. E. पाश्व the side, and भाग part.
24559: पार्श्वशय mfn. (-यः-या-र्य) 1 Sleeping on. 2 Sleeping beside the side. E. पार्श्व, and शी to sleep, aff. अच्.
24560: पार्श्वशूल n. (-लं) Spasm of the chest, stitch. E. पार्श्व, and शूल sharp pain.
