26351: प्रत्युपकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Requiting a favour or kindness. E. प्रत्युपकार, and इनि aff.
26352: प्रत्युप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Set, inlaid, studded. 2 Sown. E. प्रति before वप to sow, क्त aff.
26353: प्रत्युष m. (-षः) The morning, dawn, daybreak. E. see प्रत्यूष.
26354: प्रत्युषस् n. (-षः) Morning. E. see प्रत्यूषस्.
26355: प्रत्यूष m. (-षः) 1 Morning. 2 One of the demigods called VASUS. 3 The sun. E. प्रति before ऊष to be sick, aff. क; also with उष to burn, प्रत्युष; and with असि aff. प्रत्यूषस्.
26356: प्रत्यूषस् n. (-षः) Morning, dawn. E. प्रति before ऊष to be sick, and अमि aff.; also प्रत्यूष and प्रत्यूषस्.
26357: प्रत्यूह m. (-हः) Obstacle, impediment. E. प्रति before ऊह to infer, aff. क.
26358: प्रत्येक n. adv. (-कं) Singly, one by one, one at a time. E. प्रति, and एक one.
26359: प्रत्येतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Believing, trusting, having confidence. E. प्रति before इ to go, तृच् aff.
26360: प्रथ r. 1st cl. (प्रथते) To be famous or renowned. r. 10th cl. (प्राथयति) 1 To throw or cast. 2 To scatter, to spread. 3 To celebrate.
26361: प्रथन n. (-नं) 1 Spreading, extension, scattering. 2 Throwing, projecting. 3 Celebrating. E. प्रथ to cast, ल्युट् aff.
26362: प्रथम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 First, prior, initial. 2 Chief, principal. E. प्रथ to be famous, अमच् Uṇādi aff.
26363: प्रथमसाहस m. (-सः) The first or lowest degree of fine or punishment. E. प्रथम, and साहस infliction.
26364: प्रथयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Displaying, making manifest, famous, &c. 2 Seeing, beholding. 3 Casting, throwing. E. प्रथ to be famous, शतृ aff.
26365: प्रथा f. (-था) Fame, celebrity. E. प्रथ to be famous, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
26366: प्रथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, celebrated. 2 Made known, declared. 3 Spread, scattered. 4 Stretched. 5 Cast, thrown. 6 Intent upon, engaged in, occupied by, devoted to. E. प्रथा fame, aff. इतच्.
26367: प्रथिति f. (-तिः) Celebrity, notoriety. E. प्रथ to be famous, ति Uṇādi aff., and इट् aug.
26368: प्रथिमन् m. (-मा) Greatness, magnitude. E. पृथु large, इमनिच् aff. form irr.
26369: प्रथिमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Large, great, having size or magnitude. E. प्रथिमा magnitude, and इनि aff.
26370: प्रथिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very large. E. पृथु large, इष्ठन् superl. aff.
26371: प्रथीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very large. E. पृथु large, and ईयसुन् aff.
26372: प्रथुक m. (-कः) The young of any animal. E. प्रथ to be famous, कुकन् aff.: see पृथुक.
26373: प्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) A giver, giving, bountiful. f. (-दा) A gift, a donation. E. प्र before दा to give, and श aff. or अङ् and टाप्.
26374: प्रदक्षिण mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं) Reverential salutation, by circumambulating a person or object, keeping the right side towards them. E. प्र before दक्षिण the right.
26375: प्रदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given, bestowed, conferred. E. प्र before दत्त given.
26376: प्रदर m. (-रः) 1 Splitting, rending, tearing. 2 Fracture, a breaking. 3 A disease of women, (Mænorrhagia.) 4 An arrow. E. प्र intensitive, दृ to tear, aff. अप्.
26377: प्रदर्शक m. (-कः) 1 A teacher, an expounder. 2 A prophet. E. प्र before दर्शक who shews.
26378: प्रदर्शन n. (-नं) 1 Shewing. 2 Explaining generally, not exclusively. 3 Explaining or specifying. 4 Prophesying. E. प्र before दृश to see, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
26379: प्रदर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mentioned, specified. 2 Shewn. 3 Prophesied. E. प्र before दृश to see, and क्त aff.
26380: प्रदल m. (-लः) An arrow. E. प्र before दल to tear, or the र of प्रदर changed to ल.
26381: प्रदव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Who or what annoys, distresses, &c. E. दु to annoy, with प्र prefix, and अच् aff.
26382: प्रदातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) A donor, who or what gives. E. प्र before दा to give, तृच् aff.
26383: प्रदान n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 A goad. E. प्र before दा to give, or दो to cut, aff. ल्युट्.
26384: प्रदिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Smeared, anointed. m. (-ग्धः) A kind of sauce or gravy. E. प्र before दिग्ध smeared.
26385: प्रदिश् f. (-दिक्) Intermediate point of the compass, or half quarter, as north-east, south-west, &c. E. प्र implying division, and दिश् a point or quarter.
26386: प्रदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Appointed, directed. E. प्र before दिश to shew, क्त aff.
26387: प्रदीप m. (-पः) A lamp. E. प्र before दीप to shine, aff. घञ्.
26388: प्रदीपन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Inflaming, illuminating. 2 Stimulating, exciting, who or what does so. n. (-नं) The act of inflaming, exciting, &c. m. (-नः) A sort of mineral poison, of a red colour, and caustic operation. E. प्र before दीप to inflame, aff. ल्युट्.
26389: प्रदीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Kindled, burning. 2 Excited, stimulated. E. प्र before दीप to inflame, क्त aff.
26390: प्रदुह् mfn. (-घुक्) Who or what milks much or well. E. प्र before दुह to milk, क्विप् aff.
26391: प्रदेय n. (-यं) A gift. E. प्र before देय to be given.
26392: प्रदेश m. (-शः) 1 A place in general, a country, a district, &c. 2 A foreign country, abroad. 3 A short span, measured from the tip of the thumb to that of the forefinger. 4 A wall. E. प्र before देश place.
26393: प्रदेशन n. (-नं) A gift, a present, a bribe or offering, any thing given to the gods, to superiors, or friends, &c. f. (-नी) The forefinger. E. प्र before दिश to show, aff ल्युट्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
26394: प्रदेशिनी f. (-नी) The forefinger. E. प्र before दिश to shew, aff. णिनि, fem. aff. ङीप्.
26395: प्रदेह m. (-हः) Unguent, unction. E. प्र before दिह to plaster, aff. घज्.
26396: प्रदोष m. (-षः) 1 Evening, the first part of the night. 2 Fault, offence, defect, transgression. E. प्र implying commencement, &c. and दोष fault.
26397: प्रद्यु n. adv. (-द्यु) Heavenly, holy, securing heaven. E. प्र before द्यु for द्युस् heaven.
26398: प्रद्युम्न m. (-म्नः) KĀMA, the Hindū CUPID, reborn as the son of KṚṢṆA. E. प्र pre-eminent, द्यम्न power.
26399: प्रद्युतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Illuminated, irradiated. E. प्र before द्यु to shine, क्त aff. and the vowel unchanged; also प्रद्योतित.
26400: प्रद्योत m. (-तः) 1 A ray of light. 2 Light, lustre. E. प्र excess, and द्योत shining.
26401: प्रद्योतन m. (-नः) The sun. n. (-नं) Blazing, shining, light. E. प्र excess, द्युत to shine, aff. ल्युट्.
26402: प्रद्योतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Illuminated, lighted. E. प्र before द्यु to shine, क्त aff.; also प्रद्युदित.
26403: प्रद्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flight, retreat, running away. 2 Going, going quick or well. E. प्र before द्रु to go, aff. घञ्.
26404: प्रद्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Who retreats, flies, goes, &c. E. प्र before द्रु to go, घिनुण् aff.
26405: प्रद्विष् mfn. (-द्विट्) Who hates or dislikes, hostile, inimical. E. प्र before द्विष to hate, क्विप् aff.
26406: प्रद्विषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षती-षत्) Hating, hostile, an enemy. E. प्र, and द्विषत् a foe.
26407: प्रद्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who hates or dislikes. E. प्र before द्विव to hate, तृच् aff.
26408: प्रध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Who or what has or holds. E. प्र before षा to have, श aff.
26409: प्रधन n. (-नं) 1 War, battle. 2 Tearing, rending, destroying. E. प्र before घा to have, aff. क्यु.
26410: प्रधर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Haughty, arrogant. E. प्र before धृष to be proud, क्त aff.
26411: प्रधर्षितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Proud, arrogant. E. प्र before धृष to be proud, क्तवतु aff.
26412: प्रधान n. (-नं) 1 Nature, the natural state of any thing, or the cause of the material world. 2 The SUPREME GOD. 3 Intellect, understanding. 4 Chief, principal, (in this sense, it is always neuter and confined to the singular number.) mn. (-नः-नं) 1 The first companion of a king, his minister, his eunuch or confident, &c. a courtier, a noble. 2 An elephant-driver. E. प्र before धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
26413: प्रधानतस् ind. According to eminence or superiority. E. प्रधान, and तसि aff.
26414: प्रधानता f. (-ता) Excellence, superiority, supremacy. E. तल् added to प्रधान; also with त्व, प्रधानत्वं.
26415: प्रधानधातु m. (-तुः) Semen virile. E. प्रधान principal, and धातु radical part.
26416: प्रधानमन्त्रिन् m. (-न्त्री) Prime minister. E. प्रधान, and मन्त्रिन् counsellor.
26417: प्रधानाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The chief member of the body, the chief person of a state, branch of a science, &c. E. प्रधान, and अङ्ग limb.
26418: प्रधानामात्य m. (-त्यः) Prime minister. E. प्रधान, and अमात्य minister.
26419: प्रधानोत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Warlike, braver. 2 Eminent, illustrious. E. प्रधान, and उत्तम best.
26420: प्रधावन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. प्र violently, घ to shake, aff. ल्युट.
26421: प्रधि m. (-धिः) The periphery of a wheel. E. प्र principal, धा to have, कि aff.
26422: प्रधिमण्डल n. (-लं) The circumference of a wheel. E. प्रधि, and मण्डल a circle.
26423: प्रधूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heated, burnt. 2 Lighted, inflamed. 3 Afflicted. 4 Excited. f. (-ता) 1 A woman in trouble or affliction. 2 The quarter to which the sun is proceeding. E. प्र before धूप to heat, aff. क्त.
26424: प्रधृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Proud, arrogant. 2 Treated with contumely. E. प्र before धृष to be proud, क्त aff.
26425: प्रध्वंस m. (-सः) Destruction, loss. E. प्र entirely, ध्वंस loss.
26426: प्रध्वंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Destroying, annihilating. E. प्र before ध्वंस to destroy, घिनुण् aff.
26427: प्रध्वनयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing to sound. E. प्र before ध्वन to sound, causal v., शतृ aff.
26428: प्रध्मा mfn. (-ध्माः-ध्माः-ध्म) Blowing violently. E. प्र before ध्मा to blow, aff. विच्.
26429: प्रध्रुह् mfn. (-क्) 1 Injurious, doing wrong or violence to. 2 Rebellious, refractory. E. प्र before द्रुह to seek to hurt, क्विप् aff.
26430: प्रनर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated, set in motion. E. प्र before नृत to dance, causal v., क्त aff.
26431: प्रनाल mf. (-लः-ली) A water-course, a canal. E. प्र before नल to go, aff. घञ्.
26432: प्रनिघातन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र and नि before हन to kill or hurt, ल्युट् aff., and the radical letters changed.
26433: प्रपञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) 1 Reverse, opposition, reversion or inversion. 2 Extent, expanse. 3 Heap, abundance, quantity. 4 Delusion, deceit, trick or fraud. 5 Joke, jest. 6 Prolixity, copiousness, in style or composition. 7 Error, illusion. 8 The world. E. प्र before पचि to spread, aff. अच्.
26434: प्रपञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expanded, diffused. 2 Erring, mistaken. 3 Tricked, deceived, beguiled. 4 Declared fully, explained, treated at length. E. प्रपञ्च prolixity, इतच् aff.
26435: प्रपतन n. (-नं) 1 Death, dying. 2 Destruction. 3 Falling. 4 Alighting. E. प्र before पत to fall, क्त aff.
26436: प्रपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead. 2 Decayed. 3 Fallen. 4 Come down. E. प्र before पत to fall, क्त aff.
26437: प्रपथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, enervated, relaxed. E. प्र before पथ to go, aff. अच्.
26438: प्रपद n. (-दं) The point of the foot, the tip of the toes. E. प्र projecting, and पद the foot.
26439: प्रपदीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Relating to the top of the foot, extending to it, fitting it, &c. E. प्रपद, and ख aff.
26440: प्रपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Taking refuge with. 2 Reaching, arriving at. 3 Seeking, adhering to. 4 Effecting, producing. 5 Promised, assented to. 6 Attained, obtained, possessed of. 7 Poor. 8 Distressed. E. प्र before पद to go, क्त aff.
26441: प्रपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A fallen leaf. E. प्र before पर्ण leaf.
26442: प्रपलायन n. (-नं) Flight, running away. E. प्र before पलायन flying.
26443: प्रपलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Routed, defeated. E. प्र before पलायित the same.
26444: प्रपलायिन् m. (-यी) A fugitive, one who deserts his cause. E. प्र before पलायिन् who flies.
26445: प्रपवण n. (-णं) Purifying. E. प्र before पू to purify, ल्युट् aff. न optionally changed, whence also प्रपवन.
26446: प्रपवणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be purified or cleansed. E. प्र before पू to purify, अनीयर् aff.; also प्रपवनीय.
26447: प्रपश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Foreseeing. E. प्र, and पश्यत् seeing.
26448: प्रपा f. (-पा) A place where water is distributed. E. प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
26449: प्रपाणि m. (-णिः) The palm of the hand. E. प्र prostrate, and पाणि the hand.
26450: प्रपाणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Drinkable. E. प्र before पा to drink, अनीयर् aff.
26451: प्रपात m. (-तः) 1 A cliff, a precipice. 2 A cascade, or water-fall. 3 A bank, a shore. 4 Facing an enemy. E. प्र before पत to descend, aff. घञ्.
26452: प्रपाथ m. (-थः) A road. E. प्र before पथ to go, aff. घञ्.
26454: प्रपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Who or what drinks. 2 Who or what protects. E. प्र before पा to drink, &c. घिनुण् aff. and आय inserted.
26455: प्रपावन n. (-नं) A grove, a pleasure garden. E. प्रपा a place of refreshment, and वन a wood.
26456: प्रपितामह m. (-हः) 1 A paternal great grandfather. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-ही) A paternal great grandmother. E. प्र preceding, पितामह a grandfather.
26457: प्रपित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing or intending to descend, alight, fall, &c. E. प्र before पत to go, desid. v., उ aff.
26458: प्रपुनाड m. (-डः) A sort of Cassia, (C. tora:) see प्रपुन्नाड.
26459: प्रपुन्नड m. (-डः) Cassia tora: see प्रपुन्नाड.
26460: प्रपुन्ना f. (-न्ना) A sort of grass, (Hedysarum alhaji.)
26461: प्रपुन्नाड m. (-डः) A tree, (Cassia tora.) E. प्र excellently, पुपस् manking, and णल to smell, aff. अण्, the स of पुमस् is rejected, and the ल of the radical changed optionally to ड; the antepenultimate is occasionally short, and one of the conjunct न is sometimes rejected; whence the word is variously written, प्रपुन्नाल, or प्रपुन्नड, or प्रपुनाड, &c.
26462: प्रपुन्नाल m. (-लः) Cassia tora: see the last.
26463: प्रपूरण n. (-णं) The drawing out of a bow string for the purpose of shooting.
26464: प्रपूरिका f. (-का) A prickly nightshade, (Solanum Jacquini.)
26465: प्रपौण्डरीक m. (-कः) A small herbaceous plant, used in medicine, and as a perfume, commonly Punderya; in medicine it forms the basis of applications to ulcers, and bad eyes. E. प्र excellent, पुण्डरीक the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.
26466: प्रपौत्र m. (-त्रः) A great grandson. f. (-त्री) A great granddaughter. E. प्र preceding, पौच a son's son.
26467: प्रप्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fat, bulky. E. प्र before प्याय to be fat, क्त aff.
26468: प्रफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Blown, as a flower. 2 Smilling. 3 Shining. 4 Glad, pleased. E. प्र before फुल्ल flowered.
26469: प्रफुल्लनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having full or sparkling eyes. E. प्रफुल्ल, and नयन the eye.
26470: प्रफुल्लवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a cheerful or smiling countenance, looking gay or happy. E. प्रफुल्ल, and वदन face.
26471: प्रबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Continuous application or action, continuance, uninterruptedness. 2 A connected discussion, or narrative. E. प्र before बधि to bind, aff. अच्.
26472: प्रबन्धकल्पना f. (-ना) A feigned story, a work of imagination, whether founded on fact or not. E. प्रबन्ध a connected narrative, and कल्पना a making.
26473: प्रबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, powerful. m. (-लः) A sprout, a shoot. E. प्र before बल to be strong, aff. अच्.
26474: प्रबाधमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Paining, afflicting, tormenting. E. प्र before बाध to pain, शानच् aff.
26475: प्रबाल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Coral. 2 A shoot, a sprout, a new leaf. 3 The neck of a lute. m. (-लः) 1 An animal. 2 A pupil. E. प्र before बल to be strong, and aff. घञ्; also प्रबालक.
26476: प्रबालवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having new leaves or shoots. E. प्रबाल, and मतुप् aff.
26477: प्रबुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Wise, learned. 2 Blown, expanded. 3 Wakened, awake, roused. E. प्र before बुद्ध to be wise, aff. क्त, form irr.
26478: प्रबोध m. (-धः) 1 Vigilance, wakefulness, active or vigilant state of being. 2 Intellect, understanding. 3 Knowledge, wisdom. 4 Sense, consciousness. 5 Awaking either from ignorance or sleep. E. प्र before बुध to understand, aff. घञ्.
26479: प्रबोधन n. (-नं) 1 Awakening, arousing, exciting, reviving. 2 Instructing. 3 Reviving the fragrance of a perfume, which had lost its scent. f. (-नी) The lunation on which VIṢṆU is supposed to wake from his sleep, the eleventh of the light half of Kartik; also प्रबोधिनी. E. प्र before बुध to know or understand, aff. ल्युट्.
26480: प्रबोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Aroused, awakened. 2 Instructed. E. प्र before बुध to know, causal v., क्त aff.
26481: प्रबोधिता f. (-ता) A species of the Atijagatī metre.
26482: प्रभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Breaking down, destroying. E. प्र before भञ्ज to break, aff. घञ्.
26483: प्रभञ्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Breaking, destroying. m. (-नः) Air or wind. E. प्र before भञ्ज to break, aff. युच्.
26484: प्रभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Superior, powerful. m. (-वः) 1 Generative cause, the basis or root of being or existence. 2 The operative cause, or immediate origin of being, as the father or mother, &c. 3 The place of receiving existence, or where an object is first perceived, as हिमवान् गङ्गा प्रभवः the Himavān mountain, (is) the place where Gaṅgā is first seen. 4 Birth, production. 5 The basis or origin of water, i. e. light. 6 The name of a Muni. 7 Strength, superiority, power. E. प्र superiority or manifestation, and भव being.
26485: प्रभवन n. (-नं) 1 Being born or produced. 2 Ruling, presiding. E. प्र before भू to be, aff. ल्युट्.
26486: प्रभविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Mighty, potent. 2 Born completely or well. E. प्र before भू to be, इष्णुच् aff.
26487: प्रभविष्णुता f. (-ता) Consequence, importance, power, authority, supremacy. E. प्र before भू to be, इष्णुच् aff., and तल् aug.
26488: प्रभव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be born or produced. 2 Fit for rule. E. प्र before भू to be, aff. क्यप्; also प्रभवनीय and प्रभवितव्य.
26489: प्रभा f. (-भा) 1 Light, radiance. 2 The city of KUVERA. 3 One of the wives of the sun. 4 A name of DURGĀ. E. प्र exceeding, भा to shine, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
26490: प्रभाकर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 The moon. 4 The ocean. E. प्रभा light, and कर what makes.
26491: प्रभाकीट m. (-टः) The firefly. E. प्रभा light, कीट insect.
26492: प्रभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Who or what shares or divides. E. प्र before भज to divide, and खि aff.
26493: प्रभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. प्रभा light, beauty, अञ्ज to go, aff. ल्युट्.
26494: प्रभात n. (-तं) Morning, dawn, daybreak. E. प्र before भा to shine, aff. क्त.
26495: प्रभान n. (-नं) Light, radiance, shining. E. प्र before भा to shine, ल्युट् aff.
26496: प्रभानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be irradiated or lighted. E. प्र before भा to shine, अनीयर् aff.
26497: प्रभाव m. (-वः) 1 Majesty, dignity, magnanimity, high spirit. 2 Power, strength. 3 Spirit. 4 Tranquillizing, conciliation. E. प्र pre-eminence, भाव quality.
26498: प्रभावज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Proceeding from conscious majesty or power. E. प्रभाव, and ज born.
26499: प्रभावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Luminous, radiant, splendid. f. (-ती) 1 The mother of MALLI the 19th of the Jinas or Jaina saints. 2 The lute of one of the demigods attendant on ŚIVA, or other principal deities. 3 A form of poetical metre. E. प्रभा light or splendour, and मतुप् poss. aff.
26500: प्रभास m. (-सः) 1 A place of pilgrimage, in the west of India, 2 One of the eight VASUS. 3 One of the Gaṇādhipas of the Jainas. E. प्र before भास to shine, aff. अच्.
26501: प्रभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Well cut or detached. 2 Severed, separated. m. (-न्नः) A furious elephant, one in rut or from whose temples the juice is exuding. E. प्र much, भिन्न broken, or seized with fury.
26502: प्रभु mfn. (-भु-भ्वी-भु) 1 Strong, able. 2 Always, eternal. 3 A superior, an owner, a proprietor, a master or mistress, &c. m. (-भुः) 1 A master, a lord. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 Quicksilver. 4 Sound. E. प्र pre-eminent, भू to be, aff. क्विप्, and the final vowel made short.
26503: प्रभुता f. (-ता) Greatness, power, supremacy, lordship or sovereignty. E. प्रभु master, aff. तल्; also with त्व aff. प्रमुत्व n. (-त्वं.)
26504: प्रभुभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Faithful, devoted. m. (-क्तः) A good horse. E. प्रभु a master, and भक्त worshipped.
26505: प्रभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Much, abundant. 2 Gone up or upwards. 3 Been, become, produced. 4 High, lofty. 5 Governed, presided over. 6 Mature, perfect. E. प्र principal, &c. भूत been.
26506: प्रभूतता f. (-ता) Abundance, plenty. E. तल् added to the last; also प्रभूतत्वं.
26507: प्रभूष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Strong, able. E. प्र before भू to be, aff. ष्णुच्.
26508: प्रभृति f. (-तिः) 1 Manner, kind. 2 Etcetera, others, rest, remainder, (in composition;) as गर्म्मुत्प्रभृतयःतृणं the grass called Garmut and other sorts; मुनयः सोमश्रवः प्रभृतयः the Munis, Somaśravas, and the rest; ततः प्रभृति thence, after that. E. प्र before भृ to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.
26509: प्रभेद m. (-दः) Kind, sort, difference. E. प्र before भेद kind.
26510: प्रभ्रश्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Falling down, being broken off or down. E. प्र before भ्रंश to break, pass. v., शानच् aff.
26511: प्रभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Fallen, dropping, fallen off. 2 Broken. E. प्र before भ्रंश to fall, क्त aff.
26512: प्रभ्रष्टक n. (-कं) A chaplet of flowers suspended from the middle lock of hair. E. प्र before म्रंश to fall or depend, aff. क्त and कन added.
26513: प्रमग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Immersed, drowned. E. प्र and मग्न plunged in.
26514: प्रमङ्गन mfn. (-नं) Going, proceeding. E. प्र before मगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
26515: प्रमङ्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, proceeded. E. प्र before मगि to go, क्त aff.
26516: प्रमणस् mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Joyful, cheerful. E. प्र implying pleasure, and मनस् the mind; also प्रमनस्, न being optionally changed to ण.
26517: प्रमत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Careless, negligent. 2 Blundering, a blunderer. 3 Intoxicated. 4 Insane. E. प्र before मत्त mad.
26518: प्रमथ m. (-थः) 1 An attendant on ŚIVA. 2 A horse. f. (-था) 1 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 2 Pain, affliction. E. प्र excess, मथ to churn, (the enemies of ŚIVA,) aff. अच्.
26519: प्रमथन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Paining, distressing. 3 Agitating, churning. E. प्र before मथ to churn, aff. ल्युट्.
26520: प्रमथालय n. (-यं) Hell. E. प्रमथ pain, and आलय an abode.
26521: प्रमथाधिप m. (-पः) ŚIVA. E. प्रमथ a follower of ŚIVA, and अधिप master.
26522: प्रमथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well-churned. 2 Pained, distressed. 3 Trampled down. n. (-तं) Butter-milk without water. E. प्र before मथि to churn, क्त aff.
26523: प्रमद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Mad, intoxicated, figuratively with passion or literally with liquor. 2 Violent. 3 Careless. 4 Impassioned. m. (-दः) 1 Joy, pleasure, delight, rapture. 2 Datura, (D. metel.) f. (-दा) A woman, a handsome woman. E. प्र before मद mad, drunk.
26524: प्रमदकानन n. (-नं) A royal garden or pleasure ground. E. प्रमद pleasure, and कानन a wood.
26525: प्रमदवन n. (-नं) A royal garden or pleasure ground attached to the Haram. E. प्रमद pleasure, and वन a wood.
26526: प्रमदाकानन n. (-नं) A royal garden. E. प्रमदा a woman, and कानन a wood: see the next.
26527: प्रमदावन n. (-नं) A royal garden or pleasure ground attached especially to the private apartments of the palace. E. प्रमदा a woman, and वन a grove.
26528: प्रमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Happy, delighted. E. प्र implying pleasure, and मनस् the mind.
26529: प्रमन्यु mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु) Distressed, sorrowful. E. प्र, and मन्यु grief.
26530: प्रमय m. (-यः) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र before मी to injure, aff. अच्.
26531: प्रमा f. (-मा) 1 True knowledge, or knowledge exempt from all error. 2 Consciousness, perception. E. प्र before मा to mete or measure, aff. अङ् and टाप्; that by which every object is measured or estimated.
26532: प्रमाण n. (-णं) 1 Cause, motive. 2 Limit. 3 Proof, testimony, authority. 4 A scripture, a work of sacred authority. 5 Measure, quantity. 6 A speaker of the truth. 7 Always, eternal. 8 A title of VIṢṆU. 9 Principal, capital. E. प्र before मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्; that by which all is measured; this word is generally restricted to the singular number, as वेदाः-प्रमाणं the Vedas are the authority; it is also confined to the neuter gender, as पुत्त्रः प्रमाणं the boy is a witness; some exceptions occur however, as प्रमाणः पुरुषः, प्रमाणा स्त्री the man witness, the woman witness; and in the following rule, प्रत्यक्षानुभानोपमानशब्दाः-प्रमाणानि perception, inference, comparison, and sound, are proofs.
26533: प्रमाणतस् ind. 1 According to proof or authority. 2 Agreeably to measure, to weight, &c. E. प्रमाण, and तसि aff.
26534: प्रमाणपुरुष m. (-षः) An umpire, an arbitrator, a judge. E. प्रमाण, and पुरुष a man.
26535: प्रमाणयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Receiving, admitting, or obeying, &c. as authority. E. प्रमाण, nominal v., शतृ aff.
26536: प्रमाणाभाव m. (-वः) Want or absence of proof or authority. E. प्रमाण, and अभाव non-existence.
26537: प्रमाणिका f. (-का) A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
26538: प्रमाणीकरण n. (-णं) Establishing or admitting as authority or proof. E. प्रमाण, and करण making, च्चि aug.
26539: प्रमाणीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Admitted or established as proof or authority. E. प्रमाण, and कृत made, च्वि aug.
26540: प्रमाणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Proving, establishing. E. प्रमाण, and भूत become, च्वि aug.
26541: प्रमातामह m. (-हः) A maternal great grandfather. f. (-ही) A maternal great grandmother. E. प्र before मातामह a grandfather.
26542: प्रमातृ mfn. (-ता-बी-तृ) Proving, evidence, who or what is proof or authority. E. प्र before मा to measure, तृच् aff.
26543: प्रमाथ m. (-थः) 1 Killing. 2 Paining, afflicting, torturing. 3 Violence. E. प्र before मथि to churn, घञ् aff.
26544: प्रमाथिन् mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि) 1 Afflicting, inflicting pain or sorrow. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 Breaking, cutting. E. प्र before मथ to churn, to grind, to pain, and घिनुण् aff.
26545: प्रमाद m. (-दः) 1 Inadvertence, carelessness, error, inaccuracy. 3 Intoxication. 4 Insanity. E. प्र before मद to be mad, aff. घञ्.
26546: प्रमादवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Heedless, careless, incautious, inconsiderate, unreflecting. 2 Insane. 3 Intoxicated. E. प्रमाद carelessness, and मतुप् aff.
26547: प्रमादिका f. (-का) 1 An imprudent or careless woman. 2 A deflowered girl. E. प्र before मद to be careless, ण्वुल् aff., fem. form.
26548: प्रमादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Careless, indifferent. 2 Insane. 3 Intoxicated. E. प्र before मद to be inebriate, and घिनुण् aff.
26549: प्रमाद्य n. (-द्यं) 1 Carelessness. 2 Insanity. E. प्र before मद to be mad, ण्यत् aff.
26550: प्रमाद्यतस् ind. From carelessness. E. प्रमाद्य, and तसि aff.
26551: प्रमापण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र before मीञ् to hurt or kill, पुक augment, from its taking the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.; the न of the affix also being unchanged, the word is written प्रमापन n. (-नं.)
26552: प्रमापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Killing, destroying. E. प्र before मी to kill, causal v., णिनि aff.
26553: प्रमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood, established, proved. 2 Measured. E. प्र before मा to measure, aff. क्त.
26554: प्रमिताक्षरा f. (-रा) A species of the Jagatī metre.
26555: प्रमिति f. (-तिः) 1 True knowledge, or knowledge derived from the senses, inference, analogy or information. 2 Measuring. E. प्र before मा to measure, (by which,) क्तिन् aff., and radical vowel changed.
26556: प्रमीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Thick. 2 Passed, passed as urine. E. प्र before मिह to sprinkle, aff. क्त.
26557: प्रमीणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) 1 Overcoming, subduing. 2 Injuring, killing. E. प्र before मी to hurt or kill, शतृ aff.
26558: प्रमीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead, deceased. 2 Immolated, sacrificed. E. प्र before मी to hurt or kill, aff. क्त.
26559: प्रमीला f. (-ला) Lassitude, enervation, exhaustion from indolence or fatigue. E. प्र before मील to twinkle, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
26560: प्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Chief, principal. 2 Best, most excellent. 3 First. m. (-खः) 1 A chief, a sage, any respectable man. 2 A heap, a multitude. 3 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) n. (-खं) Time being, the present. E. प्र before मुख the face, &c.
26561: प्रमुखत्व n. (-त्वं) Superiority, predominance. E. प्रमुख, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, प्रमुखता.
26562: प्रमुद् mfn. (-मुत्) Pleased, happy. E. प्र before मुद to be pleased, क्विन् aff.
26563: प्रमुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, glad, content, happy. E. प्र excess, मुद to be pleased, aff. क्त.
26564: प्रमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 A fool, foolish, stupid. 2 Bewildered, deceived. E. प्र, and मूढ a fool.
26565: प्रमूढसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Bewildered, infatuated. E. प्रमूढ, and सज्ञा sign of sense.
26566: प्रमृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered, concealed, withdrawn or gone out of sight. 2 Dead. n. (-तं) Tillage, cultivation. E. प्र before मृ to die, क्त aff.
26567: प्रमृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Polished, bright, clear. 2 Rubbed. E. प्र before मृज to clean, or मृष to rub, aff. क्त.
26568: प्रमेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Greasy, unctuous. 2 Becoming or made unctuous. E. प्र before मिद to be unctuous, aff. क्त.
26569: प्रमेदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Being or made unctuous. E. प्र before मिद to be unctuous, क्तवतु aff.
26570: प्रमेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Proveable, what may or ought to be proved. 2 Measurable, finite. n. (-यं) The thing to be proved. In logic, the second head, or topic, including twelve objects, as the soul, body, &c. or the form and end of existence. E. प्र before मा to measure, य aff.
26571: प्रमेह m. (-हः) Urinary affection, as change in the colour, quantity, or consistence of the urine; twenty-one varieties are enumerated, including diabetes, gonorrhœa, &c. E. प्र implying change, मिह to pass urine, with घञ् aff.
26572: प्रमोचन n. (-नं) Liberating, setting free. E. प्र before मुच to liberate, ल्युट् aff. f. (-नी) A sort of cucumber: see गवाक्षी. E. प्र before मुच to loose, aff. ल्युट्.
26573: प्रमोद m. (-दः) Pleasure, happiness, delight. E. प्र before मुद to be pleased, aff. घञ्.
26574: प्रमोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Happy, delighted. m. (-तः) A name of KUVERA. E. प्रमोद happiness, इतच् aff.; or प्र before मुद to be happy, क्त aff., and the radical vowel changed.
26575: प्रमोदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Happy, delighted. 2 Delighting, making happy. E. प्रमोद, and इनि aff.
26576: प्रमोह m. (-हः) 1 Fascination. 2 Fainting, insensibility. E. प्र before मुह to be bewildered, घञ् aff.
26577: प्रम्लोचा f. (-चा) One of the Apsaras, or nymphs of heaven.
26578: प्रयच्छन् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छती-च्छत्) Giving, presenting, bestowing. E. प्र before दा to give, शतृ aff.
26579: प्रयत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well-governed, restrained, self-subdued. 2 Careful, prudent. m. (-तः) A holy or pious person, one purified by austerity and mortification. E. प्र intensely, यत to endeavour, aff. अच्.
26580: प्रयतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Devout, pious, of a holy spirit. E. प्रयत, and आत्मन् soul.
26581: प्रयत्न n. (-त्नं) 1 Continued or persevering effort, exertion. 2 Act, action. 2 (In logic,) Active effort of three kinds, engaging in any act, prosecuting it, and completing it. 4 Caution, care. 5 Articulation of sounds. E. प्र intensitive, यत्न effort.
26582: प्रयत्नतस् ind. Particularly, especially, with especial effort, care or pains. E. प्रयत्न, and तसि aff.
26583: प्रयत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Active, zealous, enterprising, assiduous, persevering. E. प्रयत्न effort, and मतुप् aff.
26585: प्रयस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Seasoned, dressed with sauces and condiments. E. प्र before यस to take pains, and क्त aff.
26586: प्रयाग m. (-गः) 1 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 A celebrated place of pilgrimage, the confluence of the Ganges and Jumna, with the supposed subterraneous addition of the Sarasvatī; the modern Allahabad. The term in composition is applied to many places of reputed sanctity, situated at the confluence of two rivers, as Deva-Prayāga, Rudra-Prayāga, Karṇa-Prayāga, and Nanda-Prayāga, in the Himāla mountains, which with Prayoga or Allahabad, constitute the five principal places so termed. 3 A name of INDRA. 4 A horse. E. प्र principal, यज to worship, and घञ् aff.; actual worship, or the place where worship is peculiarly efficacious; Allahabad is one of the places where BRAHMĀ is supposed to have consummated ten Aśvamedhas or sacrifices of the horse, in commemoration of his recovery of the four Vedas from ŚAṄKHĀSURA.
26587: प्रयागभय m. (-यः) A name of INDRA. E. प्रयाग sacrifice, especially of the horse or Aśvamedha, and भय fear; INDRA being dethroned by the performance of a hundred such sacrifices.
26588: प्रयाज m. (-जः) 1 A principal ceremony or sacrifice. 2 A part of a sacrifice. E. प्र before यज to sacrifice, aff. घञ्, form irr.
26589: प्रयाण n. (-णं) 1 Going, motion. 2 Going forth or to a distance. 3 Departure. 4 Death. 5 March of an assailing force, attack, invasion. E. प्र before या to go, aff. ल्युट्; also with कन् added, प्रयाणक n. (-कं)
26590: प्रयाणकाल m. (-लः) 1 Time of departure. 2 Death. E. प्रयाण, and काल time.
26591: प्रयाणार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Worthy of death. E. प्रयाण, and अर्ह fit for.
26592: प्रयात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Removed, gone away or to a distance. 3 Deceased. m. (-तः) 1 A name of BHṚGU. 2 A sleepy or lazy fellow. E. प्र before यत to endeavour, aff. घञ्.
26593: प्रयापण n. (-णं) 1 Sending, dispatching. 2 Expelling, driving away. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.; also न being unchanged, यापन.
26594: प्रयापणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sent or sent away. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also प्रयापनीय.
26595: प्रयापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Driven or sent away, made to go or pass away. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., क्त aff.
26596: प्रयापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Causing to go, who or what sends, or sends away, &c. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., णिनि aff.
26597: प्रयाप्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being sent or made to go, pass away, &c. E. प्र before या to go, causal v., pass v., शानच् aff.; also प्रयाप्यमान.
26598: प्रयाम m. (-मः) 1 Checking, restraining. 2 Scarcity, dearth. 3 Competition of buyers in consequence of scarcity. 4 Length, either of space or time. E. प्र before यम to refrain, aff. घञ्.
26599: प्रयाम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-य्यं) To be checked, controlled, &c. E. प्र before यम to check, ण्यत् aff.
26600: प्रयास m. (-सः) 1 Trouble, labour, fatigue. 2 Desire for or pursuit of any object. E. प्र before यस to make exertion, aff. घञ्.
26601: प्रयासभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Capable of exertion or fatigue, active, energetic. E. प्रयास, and भाज् sharing.
26602: प्रयास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Going, about to go or depart. E. प्र before या to go, शतृ aff. to the fut. tense.
26603: प्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Endowed with, possessing as an attribute, &c. 2 Resulting from, consequential. 3 Appointed, nominated. 4 Associated or connected with. 5 Applied, employed. 6 Compact, closely united. 7 Done, to or for. 8 Abstracted, lost in meditation. 9 Lent, (as money.) 10 Asleep. n. (-क्तं) Cause. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. क्त.
26604: प्रयुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Occasion, cause, main object or end. E. प्र before युज to join, and क्तिन् aff.
26605: प्रयुज् mfn. (-युक्) Who or what joins or is connected with, literally or figuratively, as a cause, motive, &c. E. प्र before युज to join, क्विप् aff.
26606: प्रयुज्य ind. 1 Having acted or behaved to or towards. 2 Having connected. E. प्र before युज to join, ल्यप् aff.
26607: प्रयुज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being united or connected with. 2 Being used, employed, applied, &c. E. प्र before युज to join, pass. v., शानच् aff.
26608: प्रयुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Adding, joining. 2 Using, employing. 3 Appointing, deputing. 4 Performing, doing. E. प्र before युज to join, शानच् aff.
26609: प्रयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joined, combined, united. n. (-तं) Ten hundred thousand, a million. E. प्र before यु to join, aff. क्त.
26610: प्रयुत्सु m. (-त्सुः) 1 A warrior. 2 A name of INDRA. 3 A name of the wind. 4 A ram. 5 An ascetic. E. प्र before युद्ध to contend, in the desiderative form, with उ aff.
26611: प्रयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) War, battle. E. प्र before युद्ध the same.
26612: प्रयुद्धार्थ m. (-र्थः) War, battle, going to war or battle. E. प्र initiatory, युद्ध war, and अर्थ object.
26613: प्रयोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Applicable, suitable, to be applied or employed. E. प्र before युज to unite, aff. तव्य.
26614: प्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Occasion, cause, motive, object. 2 Consequence, result. 3 Affair, matter. 4 Appointing, appointment. 5 Application, use, employment. 6 Ceremonial form, course of proceeding. 7 Magic, magical rites. 8 Subduing, fascinating. 9 Device, contrivance. 10 Example, comparison. 11 Act, action. 12 Dramatic action or performance. 13 Principal, loan bearing interest. 14 Lending money at interest. 15 Profits of usury or trade. 16 A horse. 17 Text, authority. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
26615: प्रयोगतस् ind. 1 According to or in consequence of. 2 Actually, in action. E. तसि added to प्रयोग.
26616: प्रयोगार्थ m. (-र्थः) Act, tending to a main object. E. प्रयोग aim or end, and अर्थ purpose.
26617: प्रयोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Having some object in view, calculated for some particular purpose. E. प्रयोग object, and इनि aff.
26618: प्रयोजक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Who or what causes or induces any act. 2 Who or what deputes or appoints. m. (-कः) 1 A founder or institutor of any ceremony. 2 A law-giver, a legislator. E. प्र before युज to join, ण्वुल् aff.
26619: प्रयोजककर्त्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Acting as an instigator or promoter. E. प्रयोजक, and कर्त्तृत्व agency.
26620: प्रयोजन n. (-नं) 1 Cause, occasion. 2 Motive, origin. 3 Purpose, object, intention, design. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.
26621: प्रयोजनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Designing, purposing. 2 Having a cause, caused, produced. E. प्रयोजन, and मतुप् aff.
26622: प्रयोजयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Behaving to or towards, shewing, displaying. 2 Combining, &c. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. शतृ.
26623: प्रयोज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 1 To be set to work, to be appointed or directed. 2 To be used, practised, employed, &c. n. (-ज्यं) Capital, principal. m. (-ज्यः) A servant, a slave. E. प्र before युज to join, aff. ण्यत्.
26624: प्ररुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wept, weeping. E. प्र before रुद to weep, क्त aff.
26625: प्ररूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Rooted, fastened, growing or proceeding from a root. 2 Grown, increased. 3 Born, produced. m. (-ढः) The belly. E. प्र before रुह to grow, क्त aff.
26626: प्ररोचन n. (-नं) 1 Stimulating, exciting. 2 Propitiating. f. (-ना) Praise of the author of a drama, &c. in the prelude, to secure the favour of the spectators. E. प्र before रुच to, be light, causal v., युच् aff.
26627: प्ररोह m. (-हः) A bud, a shoot. E. प्र before रुह to grow, aff. घञ्.
26628: प्ररोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Budding, sprouting. E. प्ररोह, and इनि aff.
26629: प्रलपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) Speaking, talking. E. प्र before लप to speak, शतृ aff.
26630: प्रलपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, spoken, declared. E. प्र before लप to speak, aff. क्त.
26631: प्रलम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 1 Hanging down, depending from, pendulous. 2 Slow, dilatory. m. (-म्बः) 1 Depending, hanging on or from. 2 The new shoot or bud of a creeping plant. 3 A garland of flowers worn round the neck. 4 A branch. 5 The female breast. 6 Tin. 7 The name of a Daitya, killed by BALARĀMA. E. प्र before लवि to oppose, aff. घञ्.
26632: प्रलम्बघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. प्रलम्ब a demon, killed by BALADEVA, and घ्न who kills; also similar compounds, as प्रलम्बभित्, &c.
26633: प्रलम्बभिद् m. (-भित्) BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. E. प्रलम्ब, and भित् who destroys: see the last.
26634: प्रलम्बाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A man having large testicles. E. प्रलम्ब pendulous, and अण्ड testicle.
26635: प्रलम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended, pendulous, hanging. E. प्रलम्ब hanging, इतच् aff.
26636: प्रलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Over-reached, cheated, deceived. E. प्र before लभ to gain, क्त aff.
26637: प्रलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Fraud, cheating. E. प्र before लभि to get, घञ् aff.
26638: प्रलय m. (-यः) 1 The end of a Kalpa, or destruction of the world. 2 Death, dying, loss, destruction, dissolution, annihilation. 3 Fainting, syncope, loss of sense or consciousness. E. प्र before ली to destroy, aff. अच्.
26639: प्रलाप m. (-पः) 1 Unmeaning or incoherent speech. 2 Speaking. 3 Discourse, conversation. E. प्र before लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
26640: प्रलापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) 1 Talking much, or unmeaningly, chattering. 2 Speaking to, conversing with. E. प्र before लप to speak, घिनुण् aff.
26641: प्रलिप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what smears, plasters, &c. E. प्र before लिप to anoint, क aff.
26642: प्रलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Destroyed, annihilated. 2 Unconscious, insensible. E. प्र before ली to destroy, क्त aff.
26643: प्रलीनता f. (-ता) 1 Destruction, annihilation. 2 The end of the universe. 3 Unconsciousness, loss of sense. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, प्रलीनत्वं.
26644: प्रलेपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what anoints, smears, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A plasterer. 2 A slow fever. E. प्र before लिप to smear, aff. ण्वुल्.
26645: प्रलोठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolling, heaving, tossing. E. प्र before लुठ to roll, क्त aff.
26646: प्रलोठन n. (-नं) Rolling on the ground, heaving, tossing, (as of the ocean.) E. प्र before लुठ to roll, ल्युट् aff.
26647: प्रलोभ m. (-भः) Desire, cupidity. E. प्र before लुभ to covet, घञ् aff.
26648: प्रलोभन n. (-नं) 1 Allurement, inducement. 2 Attraction, attracting, seducing. E. प्र before लुभ to desire, ल्युट् aff.
26649: प्रवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what goes. E. प्रु to go, वुन् aff.
26650: प्रवक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be expounded or explained. E. प्र before वच to speak, तव्य aff.
26651: प्रवक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Who speaks or declares. m. (-क्ता) A teacher, an expounder. E. प्र before वच to speak, तृच् aff.
26652: प्रवचन n. (-नं) 1 A Veda, scripture. 2 Excellent speech or language, eloquence. 3 Teachinge, expounding. E. प्र principal, वचन speech.
26653: प्रवचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 A good speaker. 2 To be well or elegantly spoken. E. प्र before वच to speak, aff. अनीयर्.
26654: प्रवचनपटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Eloquent. E. प्रवचन, and पटु skilful.
26655: प्रवट m. (-टः) Wheat. E. प्र before वट to divide, aff. अच्.
26656: प्रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Declivity, declining, steep. 2 Bent, bowed. 3 Attached or adhering to, filled with, possessed of, endowed with. 4 Curved, crooked. 5 Swift. 6 Generous. 7 Humble, modest. 8 Wasted, decayed. m. (-णः) A place where four roads meet. E. प्र before वन to sound, &c. aff. अच्.
26657: प्रवदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Speaking to or with, conversing, addressing. 2 Speaking much or well. 3 Arguing, a disputant. E. प्र before वद to speak, शतृ aff.
26658: प्रवपण n. (-णं) Sowing. E. प्र before वप to sow, aff. ल्युट्.
26659: प्रवयण n. (-णं) A goad. E. प्र before अज to go, वी substituted for the root, and aff. ल्युट्.
26660: प्रवयस् m. (-याः) An old man. E. प्र past, and वयस् life or age.
26661: प्रवर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best, most excellent. n. (-रं) 1 Offspring, descendants. 2 Family, race, kindred. 3 A black sort of kidney bean. 4 Covering, screening. 5 A Muni, who contributes to the continuation of, and credit of a particular caste or tribe of Brahmans. E. प्र before वृ to chuse, aff. अप्.
26662: प्रवरललित n. (-तं) A species of the Aṣṭī metre.
26663: प्रवर्ग m. (-र्गः) Sacrificial fire. E. प्र before वृज to abandon, aff. घञ्.
26664: प्रवर्ग्य m. (-र्ग्यः) An officiating priest. n. (-र्ग्यं) A particular ceremony or sacrifice. E. प्रवर्ग, and यत् aff.
26665: प्रवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Engaging in, undertaking. 2 Excitement, stimulus. E. प्र before वृत to be, घञ् aff.: see प्रवर्त्तन and प्रवृत्ति.
26666: प्रवर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Inciting, stimulating, inducing, who or what sets in action. m. (-कः) 1 The original instigator of any act, the author, the principal. 2 An arbiter, a judge. n. (-कं) The entrance of the first person of the drama on the close of the introduction. E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. ण्वुल्.
26667: प्रवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Action, business, worldly interest or activity as opposed to abstract contemplation. 2 Fixing, establishing. 3 Engaging in, (any work.) 4 Beginning. 5 Inciting, stimulating. 6 Directing, superintending. 7 Informing. 8 Revolving. f. (-ना) Order, permission, the sense of the precative, or qualified imperative tense. E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. (-युच्,) fem. aff. टाप्.
26668: प्रवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Engaging in, practising, doing. 2 Being used or employed. E. प्र before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
26669: प्रवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Informed, apprized. 2 Stimulated, excited, instigated. 3 Revolving, going round. 4 Made, rendered. E. प्र before वृत to be, क्त aff.
26670: प्रवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) What causes to grow or increase. n. (-नं) Increase, augmenting. E. प्र before वृध to increase, aff. ल्युट्.
26671: प्रवर्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Chief, principal, first. E. प्र before वृह to increase, aff. अच्.
26672: प्रवलाकिन् m. (-की) 1 A snake. 2 One with a variegated girdle.
26673: प्रवसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-मत्) Residing abroad. E. प्र before वस to dwell, शतृ aff.
26674: प्रवसन n. (-नं) Going abroad, sojourning in a foreign country. E. प्र before वस to dwell, घञ् aff.
26675: प्रवह m. (-हः) 1 Going forth, or from a town. 2 One of the seven Vāyus, or winds. 3 Wind, air. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. अच्.
26676: प्रवहण n. (-णं) A covered car, a litter or carriage for women. E. प्र forth, वह to bear, ल्युट् aff.
26677: प्रवहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Bearing. 2 Receiving, enjoying. E. प्र before वह to bear, शतृ aff.
26678: प्रवह्लि f. (-ह्णिः-ह्णी) A riddle. E. प्र before वल्ह to speak, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added: see the next.
26679: प्रवह्लिका f. (-का) A riddle, an enigma, a conundrum or charade, &c. E. प्र before वल्ह to speak or tell, aff. क्वुन्; the conjunct consonants of the root are transposed; also प्रवह्लि and प्रवह्ली, and with कन् added to the latter प्रवह्लीका.
26680: प्रवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Eloquent, oratorical, speaking, a speaker. E. प्र before वच to speak, aff. क्विप्.
26681: प्रवाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Speaking well, eloquent. E. प्र before वच to speak, ण्वुल् aff.
26682: प्रवाणी f. (-णी) A weaver's shuttle. E. प्र before वी to go, aff. ल्युट, fem. aff. ङीप्; also प्रवाणि.
26683: प्रवाद m. (-दः) 1 Rumour, report. 2 Discourse, conversation. 3 Mutual defiance, the conversation of antagonists prior to combat. E. प्र spreading, and वाद speech.
26684: प्रवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what speaks, reports, &c. E. प्र before वद to speak, घिनुण् aff.
26685: प्रवापिन् m. (-पी) A sower, one who sows seed. E. प्र before वप to sow, घिनुण् aff.
26686: प्रवार m. (-रः) Covering, clothing. E. प्र before वृ to cover, aff. घञ्; also with अप् aff., and in other senses, प्रवर्.
26687: प्रवारण n. (-णं) 1 A desirable gift. 2 Prohibition, objection, opposition. E. प्र before वृ to chuse, aff. ल्युट्.
26688: प्रवास m. (-सः) A temporary or foreign residence, a habitation away from home. E. प्र far or removed, and वास abode.
26689: प्रवासत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Dwelling or being abroad or absent. E. प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., शतृ aff.
26690: प्रवासन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Dwelling abroad, sojourning, lodging. 3 Exile. E. प्र away, वस to dwell, or divide, causal v., aff. ल्युट्.
26691: प्रवासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, expatriated. E. प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., क्त aff.
26692: प्रवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) A traveller, a sojourner, one living away from home. E. प्रवास a foreign or strange habitation, and इनि aff.; or प्र before वस to dwell, and घिनुण् aff.
26693: प्रवाह m. (-हः) 1 Stream, flow, continuous passage. 2 Action, occupation, active life. 3 A pond. 4 A swift horse. f. (-ही) Sand. E. प्र continually, वह to bear, aff. घञ्.
26694: प्रवाहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what bears or carries well. m. (-कः) An imp, a goblin. f. (-हिका) Diarrhoea. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्
26695: प्रवाहकम् ind. 1 At the same time. 2 Above, over; also in this sense, प्रवाहिका ind.
26696: प्रविकशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Expanding, opening, blossoming. E. प्र and वि before कश to go, शतृ aff.
26697: प्रविख्याति f. (-तिः) Celebrity, reputation. E. प्र and वि prefixed to ख्या to say, aff. क्तिन्.
26698: प्रवितत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread out, expanded. 2 Dishevelled. E. प्र and वि before तन to spread, क्त aff.
26699: प्रविदारण n. (-णं) 1 War, battle, combat. 2 Tearing, rending, breaking. 3 Tumult, crowd, confusion. 4 Bursting, budding. E. प्र and वि prefixed to दॄ to tear to pieces, aff. ल्युट्.
26700: प्रविदारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Torn, rent, severed. 2 Opened, expanded. E. प्र and वि before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.
26701: प्रविभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Partitioned, divided, separated, shared. E. प्र, and विभक्त divided.
26702: प्रविभाग m. (-गः) Division, a part. E. प्र, and विभाग division.
26703: प्रविर m. (-रः) A yellow fragrant wood. E. प्र and वि before रा to get or be, aff. ड.
26704: प्रविरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Apart, separate. E. प्र, and विरल distinct.
26705: प्रविलुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Lost, removed, fallen or rubbed off. E. प्र and वि before लुप to cut, क्त aff.
26706: प्रविविक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Separated, detached. 2 Solitary. E. प्र, and विविक्त detached.
26707: प्रविव्राजयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or intending to banish. E. प्र before व्रज to go, causal desid. v., उ aff.
26708: प्रविश्लेष m. (-षः) Separation, parting. E. प्र and वि negative prefix before श्लिष to unite, aff. घञ्.
26709: प्रविषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) Sad, dejected, spiritless. E. प्र much, घिषण्ण dejected.
26710: प्रविषा f. (-षा) A plant, commonly Atis or Ataich. E. प्र against (anti), and विष poison.
26711: प्रविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered, gone in or into. 2 Entered upon, (as an affair,) engaged in. E. प्र before विश to enter, aff. क्त.
26712: प्रवीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Skilful, clever, conversant. E. प्र implying excellence, and वीणा a lute, or वीण a nominal verb, to play on a lute, aff. अच् or घञ्.
26713: प्रवीणता f. (-ता) Proficiency, skill. E. प्रवीण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, प्रवीणत्वं.
26714: प्रवीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best, most excellent. m. (-रः) 1 A hero, a warrior. 2 A chief, a person of rank or distinction. E. प्र preeminent, and वीर a hero.
26715: प्रवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Fixed, settled, determined, done. 2 Engaged in, undertaking, occupied by. 3 Begun, beginning. 4 Doing, acting. 5 Undisputed, (as dominion.) E. प्र before वृत to be, aff. क्त, form irr.
26716: प्रवृत्तकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any act the cause of being born again. E. प्रवृत्त, and कर्म्मन् act.
26717: प्रवृत्तचक्रता f. (-ता) Absolute dominion. E. प्रवृत्त fixed, चक्र rule, and तल् abstract aff.
26718: प्रवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Activity, occupation, active life, as opposed to contemplative devotion; or it is defined to consist of the wish to do, knowledge of the means of success, and accomplishing the desired object. 2 Prosecution, perseverance. 3 Addiction to, predilection for. 4 Practice, conduct. 5 Tidings, intelligence. 6 Continuous flow, stream, current. 7 The juice that exudes from the elephant's temples, when in rut. 8 Oujein, or any holy place. 9 (In arithmetic,) The multiplier. E. प्र before वृत to be or abide, aff. क्तिन्.
26719: प्रवृत्तिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) An emissary, an agent, a spy. E. प्रवृत्ति news, and ज्ञ who knows.
26720: प्रवृद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Full grown. 2 Expanded, diffused, spread abroad or dispersed. 3 Swoln, (as a river.) 4 Full, deep, (as a sigh.) E. प्र before वृद्ध to increase or grow, aff. क्त.
26721: प्रवेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Chief, head, principal. E. प्र before विच to distinguish, aff. अच्.
26722: प्रवेक्षण n. (-णं) Foressing. E. प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
26723: प्रवेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Foreseen, anticipated. E. प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
26724: प्रवेक्ष्यत् mfn. (-क्ष्यन्-क्ष्यन्ती-क्ष्यत्) Foreseeing, anticipating. E. प्र and अव before ईक्ष to see, शतृ aff. the first syllable made short.
26725: प्रवेट m. (-टः) Barley. E. प्र before विट to sound, aff. घञ्.
26726: प्रवेणि f. (-णिः) 1 The hair twisted, and undecorated, as worn by women in the absence of their husbands. 2 An elephant's  housings. E. प्र before वेणृ to go, aff. इण्; also with डीप् added, प्रवेणी.
26727: प्रवेणी f. (-णी) 1 Unornamented hair. 2 An elephant's housings. E. see the last.
26728: प्रवेपण n. (-णं) Shaking, agitation, tremulous motion. E. प्र before वेपृ to tremble, ल्युट् aff.
26729: प्रवेल m. (-लः) The yellow variety of kidney bean. E. प्र before वेल to go, aff. अच्.
26730: प्रवेश m. (-शः) 1 Intentness on an object, engaging closely in a pursuit or purpose. 2 Entrance. E. प्र before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
26731: प्रवेशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what enters. m. (-कः) 1 An inferior actor who announces the entrance of the principal characters. 3 An entry. E. प्र before विश to enter, ण्वुल् aff.
26732: प्रवेशन n. (-नं) 1 The entrance to a house, the principal door or gate. 2 Entering, entrance. E. प्र before विश to enter, aff. ल्युट्.
26733: प्रवेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Called or sent in. E. प्र before विश to enter, causal v., क्त aff.
26734: प्रवेश्य ind. Having sent in, thrown in, or into, &c. E. प्र before विश to enter, causal v., ल्युप् aff.
26735: प्रवेश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be entered, to be pervaded. E. प्र before विश to enter, यत् aff.; also प्रवेशनीय.
26736: प्रवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 An arm. 2 The forearm, or wrist. 3 An elephant's gums. 4 An elephant's housings. E. प्र before वेष्ट to encompass, aff. अच्.
26737: प्रवेष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be entered, to be penetrated or pervaded. E. प्र before विश to enter, तव्य aff.
26738: प्रव्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Evident, apparent, manifest. E. प्र and वि before अञ्ज to spread, aff. क्त.
26739: प्रव्यथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, pained. E. प्र before व्यथ to pain, aff. क्त.
26740: प्रव्रजित m. (-तः) 1 An ascetic or mendicant. 2 The pupil, or attendant of a Jaina or Bauddha mendicant. f. (-ता) 1 A female devotee or ascetic. 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana Jatamansi). 3 A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī, (Sphoeranthus molis ?) E. प्र before व्रज to go, aff. क्त.
26741: प्रव्रज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 Roaming, travelling, wandering about, as a religious mendicant especially. 2 Abandonment of the world. E. प्र before व्रज to go, aff. यम.
26742: प्रव्रज्यावसित m. (-तः) An ascetic, who has broken his observance. E. प्रव्रज्या, and अवसित finished.
26743: प्रव्राजन n. (-नं) Banishment. E. प्र before व्रज to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
26744: प्रशंशन n. (-नं) Praising, eulogising: see प्रशंसन. E. प्र before शंश to praise, ल्युट् aff.
26745: प्रशंशा f. (-शा) Praise, eulogium. E. प्र before शंश to praise, अङ् and टाप् affs.: see प्रशंसा.
26746: प्रशंसन n. (-नं) Praising, eulogising. E. प्र before शंस to praise, ल्युट् aff.; also प्रशंशन.
26747: प्रशंसनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be praised, praise-worthy. E. प्र before शंस to praise, अनीयर् aff.
26748: प्रशंसा f. (-सा) Praise, applause, flattery, commendation. E. प्र especially, शंस to praise, affs. अङ् and टाप्; the root is also read शंश, when this word and the analogous derivatives are read प्रशंशा, &c.
26749: प्रशंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, eulogised. E. प्रशंसा, and इतच् aff.
26750: प्रशंसितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be praised, praise-worthy. E. प्र before शंस to praise, तव्य aff.
26751: प्रशत्वन् m. (-त्वा) The ocean. f. (-री) A river. E. प्र before शद् to go, and क्वनिप् Uṇādi aff., र inserted before ङीप्.
26752: प्रशमन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Pacifying, tranquillising. 3 Quiescence, reposing. E. प्र before शम to pacify, aff. ल्युट्.
26753: प्रशमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Allayed, appeased, relieved, tranquillised, &c. E. प्र before शम to be calm, causal v., aff. क्त.
26754: प्रशमय्य ind. Having appeased. E. प्र before शम to be calm, causal v., ल्युप् aff.
26755: प्रशम्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Pacified, quieted, appeased, flattered. E. प्र before शम to be at rest, pass. v., शानच् aff.
26756: प्रशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Happy, well, right. 2 Good, excellent, best. E. प्र before शंस to praise or commend, aff. क्त.
26757: प्रशस्ति f. (-स्तिः) 1 Excellence, eminence. 2 Eulogy. E. प्र before शंस to praise, क्तिन् aff.
26758: प्रशाखिक m. (-कः) A small branch or twig. E. प्र before शाखा a branch, ठक् aff.
26759: प्रशान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Calmed, calm, tranquillised. 2 Ceased, discontinued, (as active effort.) 3 Ended. 4 Relieved. E. प्र before शम to be calm, क्त aff.
26760: प्रशान्तचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Resting. E. प्रशान्त, and चेष्टा effort.
26761: प्रशान्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Peaceful, calm, composed. E. प्रशान्त, and आत्मन् self.
26762: प्रशान्तोज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Weakened, prostrate in strength. E. प्रशान्त, and ओजस् strength.
26763: प्रशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Calm, quiet, tranquillity, moral or physical. E. प्र before शम to be calm, क्तिन् aff.
26764: प्रशाम् mfn. (प्रशान्) Quiet, tranquil. E. प्र before शम to be tranquil, क्विप् aff., and the penultimate long.
26765: प्रशाम m. (-मः) 1 Tranquility, quiescence. 2 Allaying, pacifying. 3 Laying, suppressing. E. प्र before शम to be at rest, अच् aff.
26766: प्रशासन n. (-नं) 1 Governing, ruling. 2 Enacting. E. प्र before शास to rule, aff. ल्युट्.
26767: प्रशासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Governed, ruled. 2 Promulgated, enacted. E. प्र before शास to rule, क्त aff.
26768: प्रशासितृ m. (-ता) A ruler or governor. E. प्र before शास to govern, तृच् aff.
26769: प्रश्च्योतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Sprinkling, scattering. E. प्र before श्च्युत to sprinkle, शतृ aff.
26770: प्रश्न m. (-श्नः) A question, a demand, an inquiry. f. (-श्नी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. प्रच्छ to ask, aff. नङ्.
26771: प्रश्नदूती f. (-ती) A riddle, an enigma, an intricate or enigmatical question. E. प्रश्न a question, and टूती playing.
26772: प्रश्रथ m. (-थः) Laxity, relaxation, flaccidity. E. प्र before श्रथ to be loose, aff. घञ्.
26773: प्रश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Affection, affectionate regard or solicitation. 2 Respect. 3 Courtesy, civility. E. प्र before श्री to serve, aff. अच्.
26774: प्रश्रवण n. (-णं) 1 A fountain, a cascade, a water-fall. 2 Oozing, flowing. 3 A range of mountains in the south, part of the western Ghats. E. प्र before श्रु to ooze or drop, aff. ल्युट्.
26775: प्रश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, humble, well-behaved. E. प्र before श्रि to serve, aff. क्त.
26776: प्रश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowing, oozing, issuing. E. प्र before श्रि to drop, aff. क्त.
26777: प्रश्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, flaccid, loose, relaxed, unnerved. E. प्र before श्लथ to be loose, aff. अच्.
26778: प्रष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be asked. E. प्रच्छ to ask, तव्य aff.
26779: प्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Asking, demanding, an asker or questioner. E. प्रच्छ to ask, तृच् aff.
26780: प्रष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 A leader, a conductor, one who goes first or before. 2 Prior, preceding. 3 Chief, principal, best. f. (-ष्ठी) The wife of a leader or chief. E. प्र pre-eminent, स्था to stay or be, aff. क.
26781: प्रष्ठवाह् m. (-वाट्-वाड्) A young bull or steer, training for the plough, &c. E. प्रष्ठ a leader, and वह to bear, aff. ण्डि or विच.
26782: प्रष्ठौही f. (-ही) A cow pregnant with her first calf. E. प्रष्ठ here said to be the first birth, and वह to bear, aff. ण्वि or विच, fem. aff. ङीप्, and व is changed to ऊ, which with the preceding vowel becomes औ by special rule.
26783: प्रस r. 1st cl. (प्रसते) 1 To spread or diffuse. 2 To bring forth young.
26784: प्रसक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Eternal, constant, continual. 2 Opened, expanded. 3 Obtained, gained, attained. 4 Attached to, devoted to, (person or thing,) engaged in. 5 United to, connected with, accompanying. 6 Applied to, used, employed. n. adv. (-क्तं) Continually, incessantly, eternally. E. प्र before षञ्ज to unite or embrace, aff. क्त.
26785: प्रसक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Union, connexion. 2 Adherence or attachment to. 3 Energy, perseverance. 4 Acquiring. 5 Inference, conclusion, deduction. 6 A topic, or subject of conversation. E. प्र before षञ्ज to unite, क्तिन् aff.
26786: प्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Introduction, insertion. 2 Association, connexion. 3 Addiction or attachment to. 4 Connected language or style. 5 Connected reasoning or argument. 6 Double or conjoint result, producing two effects, attaining two objects by one act. 7 Revealing a secret. 8 (In dramatic language,) A second or subsidiary incident or plot. E. प्र preceding, षञ्ज to join, aff. अच्.
26787: प्रसञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Bringing into use, employing, applying, bringing to bear. 2 Combining, connecting. E. प्र before षञ्ज to unite, ल्युट् aff.
26788: प्रसत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Purity, cleanness, brightness, transparency. 2 Favour, graciousness, complacency. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. क्तिन्.
26789: प्रसत्वन् m. (-त्वा) 1 Virtue, piety. 2 BRAHMĀ. f. (-री) Acquisition, accomplishment. E. प्र before षद to go, क्वरप् Uṇādi aff.
26790: प्रसन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Clear, clean, bright, pellucid. 2 Pleased, delighted. 3 Complacent, gracious, favourable. f. (-न्ना) 1 Propitiating, pleasing. 2 Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. प्र principally, &c. सद to go, aff. क्त.
26791: प्रसन्नता f. (-ता) 1 Brightness, pellucidness, clearness, purity. 2 Favour, kindness, being pleased with. E. प्रसन्न clear, and तल aff.; also with त्व, प्रसन्नत्व.
26792: प्रसन्नमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Agreeable looking, smiling, looking pleased. E. प्रसन्न, and मुख face.
26793: प्रसन्नेरा f. (-रा) Spirituous liquor. E. प्रसन्न clear, and ईरा wine.
26794: प्रसभ n. (-भं) Violence. adv. 1 Violently, forcibly. 2 Much, exceedingly. E. प्र gone, passed, सभा an assembly.
26795: प्रसमीक्षण n. (-णं) Considering, deliberating, discussing. E. प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
26796: प्रसमीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Deliberation, judgment. E. प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.
26797: प्रसमीक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be weighed, considered, discussed, &c. ind. Having considered. E. प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
26798: प्रसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what proceeds, projects, &c. m. (-रः) 1 Spreading, extending. 2 Space, room. 3 Occasion, opportunity. 4 Affectionate solicitation. 5 Speed, velocity. 6 Battle, war. 7 Multitude, assemblage. 8 An iron arrow. 9 A projection, a process. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. अप् or घ.
26799: प्रसरण n. (-णं) 1 Going forth or round. 2 Surrounding an enemy. 3 Spreading over the country to forage. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रसरणी and प्रसरणि.
26800: प्रसरणि f. (-णिः or णी) Surrounding an enemy. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. अनि, and ङीप् optionally added.
26801: प्रसरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Expanding, spreading, bursting. 2 Proceeding, projecting. E. प्र before सृ to go, शतृ aff.
26802: प्रसर्पक m. (-कः) An uninvited guest, an intruder. E. प्र before सृप to go, ण्वुल् aff.
26803: प्रसर्पण n. (-णं) 1 Spreading, stretching, expanding. 2 Going, proceeding. E. प्र before सृप to go, aff. ल्युट्.
26804: प्रसर्पत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) Advancing, proceeding. E. प्र before सृप to go, शतृ aff.
26805: प्रसव m. (-वः) 1 Bringing forth, bearing, (as young.) 2 Birth, production. 3 Offspring, posterity. 4 Fruit. 5 A blossom, a flower. E. प्र before सू to bear, aff. अप्.
26806: प्रसवक m. (-कः) A tree, commonly Piyāl, (Buchanania latifolia). E. प्रसव a flower, aff. कन्.
26807: प्रसवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Bearing. f. (-न्ती) A woman in labour. E. प्र before सू to bear, शतृ aff.
26808: प्रसवबन्धन n. (-नं) The footstalk of a leaf or flower, the petiole or peduncle. E. प्रसव a flower, and बन्धन a binding.
26809: प्रसवस्थली f. (-ली) A mother. E. प्रसव, and श्यल place, ङीप् aff.
26810: प्रसवितृ m. (-ता) A father. f. (-त्री) A mother. E. प्र before सू to bear or have offspring, aff. तृच्.
26811: प्रसविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Having or bearing young. E. प्रसव, and इनि aff.
26812: प्रसव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Contrary, reverse, inverted, reverted. E. प्र inclined towards, सव्य the left or wrong side.
26813: प्रसह m. (-हः) A beast or bird of prey. E. प्र before सह to be able, aff. अच्.
26814: प्रसहन m. (-नः) A beast or bird of prey. n. (-नं) 1 Embracing, an embrace. 2 Defeat. 3 Bearing, enduring. E. प्र before सह to bear, aff. ल्युट्.
26815: प्रसह्य ind. 1 Forcibly, violently. 2 Exceedingly. E. प्र excessively, सह to be able, यप् aff.
26816: प्रसह्यचौर m. (-रः) A robber, a plunderer. E. प्रसह्य violently, and चौर a thief.
26817: प्रसाद m. (-दः) 1 Clearness, cleanness, brightness. 2 Favour, kindness, propitiousness, approbation. 3 Well being, welfare. 4 Composure, calmness of mind. 5 Poetry written in an elegant but an easy style. 6 Perspicuity. 7 Connexion, association. 8 Food that has been offered to an idol, or of which a spiritual teacher has partaken. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. घञ्.
26818: प्रसादन n. (-नं) 1 Boiled rice. 2 Cleaning, freeing from soil or impurities. 3 Pleasing, gratifying. f. (-ना) 1 Service. 2 Worship. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. ल्युट्, fem. aff. टाप्.
26819: प्रसादयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Pleasing, propitiating. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. शतृ.
26820: प्रसादस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Kind, propitious. 2 Happy. E. प्रसाद, and स्थ who or what is.
26821: प्रसादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased, propitiated. 2 Worshipped. 3 Purified, cleansed. E. प्र before षद to go, क्त aff.
26822: प्रसाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Who or what accomplishes or perfects. 2 Who or what cleanses or purifies. f. (-का) 1 Wild rice. 2 A dresser, a female attendant, one who decorates or adorns. E. प्र before साध to accomplish, ण्वुल् aff.
26823: प्रसाधन n. (-नं) 1 Dress, decoration, embellishment. 2 Accomplishing, effecting. nf. (-नं-नी) A comb. f. (-नी) A drug, commonly Siddhi. E. प्र before साध to accomplish, aff. ल्युट्.
26824: प्रसाधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ornamented, decorated. 2 Accomplished, completed, done. E. प्र before साध to finish, aff. क्त.
26825: प्रसाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Accomplishable, what may be done. 2 To be done for, destroyed, defeated. E. प्र, and साध to accomplish, यत् aff.
26826: प्रसार m. (-रः) 1 Going about, spreading, extending. 2 Going to forage, spreading over the country for grass and fuel. E. प्र afar, सृ to go, aff. घञ्.
26827: प्रसारण n. (-णं) 1 Going about, spreading. 2 Expanding, extending. 3 Unfolding. 4 Surrounding an enemy. 5 The dispersion of an army by detachments for that purpose, or for collecting forage. f. (-णी) A plant, (Pœderia foetida.) E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रसरण.
26828: प्रसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stretched, expanded, extended. 2 Laid out. E. प्र before सृ to go, causal v., क्त aff.
26829: प्रसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Going along gently, gliding, flowing, creeping. 2 Spreading, expanding. 3 Spreading around, or about. 4 Expanded, unfolded. E. प्र before सृ to go, घिनुण् aff.
26830: प्रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Diligent, attentive, adhering to, or engaged in. 2 Ingrossed by, devoted or attached to. 3 Bound, fastened. n. (-तं) Pus, matter. E. प्र before षिञ् to bind, aff. क्त.
26831: प्रसिति f. (-तिः) 1 Ligament, fetters, binding, tye. E. प्र before षिञ् to bind, aff. क्तिन्.
26832: प्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Famous, celebrated. 2 Adorned, ornamented. E. प्र before सिद्ध accomplished.
26833: प्रसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Fame, celebrity, notoriety. 2 Ornament, decoration. 3 That which is notorious or known. E. प्र before षिध to go, aff. क्तिन्.
26834: प्रसुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Sleeping, asleep, fast asleep. E. प्र, and सुप्त slept.
26835: प्रसू f. (-सूः) 1 A mother. 2 A mare. 3 A spreading creeper. 4 The plantain. E. प्र before सू to bear, aff. क्विप्.
26836: प्रसूका f. (-का) A mare. E. कन् added to the last.
26837: प्रसूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, engendered. 2 Bearing, bringing forth, delivered. n. (-तं) A flower. f. (-ता) A woman who has borne a child, or one who is recently delivered. E. प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्त, fem. aff. टाप्; also प्रसूतिका.
26838: प्रसूति f. (-तिः) 1 Bringing forth, (as young.) 2 Birth, production. 3 Offspring, children, a son or daughter. E. प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्तिन्.
26839: प्रसूतिका f. (-का) A woman who has had a child, or one who has been recently delivered. E. प्रसूता the same, pleonastic aff. कन्, fem. form.
26840: प्रसूतिज n. (-जं) Pain, affliction, mental or corporeal. E. प्रसूति birth, and ज produced; attending man from birth.
26841: प्रसून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Born, produced. n. (-नं) 1 A flower, a bud, a blossom. 2 Fruit. E. प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्त, form irr.
26842: प्रसूनेषु m. (-षुः) KĀMADEVA. E. प्रसून a flower, and इषु an arrow.
26843: प्रसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dispersed, extended, spread abroad. 2 Stretched. 3 Long, lengthened. 4 Modest, humble. 5 Swift, quick. 6 Gone. 7 Attached to, engaged in, occupied. 8 Appointed. m. (-तः) The palm of the hand, hollowed as if to hold liquids. f. (-ता) The leg. n. (-तं) A measure of two Palas. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. क्त.
26844: प्रसृति f. (-तिः) The palm of the hand hollowed. E. प्र before सृ to go, aff. क्तिन्.
26845: प्रसेक m. (-कः) 1 Sprinkling, wetting. 2 Dropping, oozing. 3 Running or watering of the mouth and nose. E. प्र before सिच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
26846: प्रसेदिका f. (-का) A small garden. E. प्र excellence, सद to go, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. aff. टाप्.
26847: प्रसेदिवस् mfn. (-वान्-टुषी-वस्) Pleased, propitiated, favourable. E. प्र before षद to go, क्वसु aff.
26848: प्रसेव m. (-वः) 1 Part of a lute: see the next. 2 A sack. E. प्र before षिव to tie or sew, aff. घञ्.
26849: प्रसेवक m. (-कः) 1 A part of a lute, a wooden vessel covered with leather, placed under the neck to render the sound deeper. 2 A crooked piece of wood at the end of a lute. E. प्र before षेव to serve, aff. क्वुन्.
26850: प्रस्कन्दन n. (-नं) Purging, diarrhœa. E. प्र before स्कन्द to go, aff. ल्युट्.
26851: प्रस्कन्दिका f. (-का) Diarrhœa. E. प्र before खन्द to go, वुन् aff.
26852: प्रस्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Fallen, dropped. m. (-न्नः) A sinner, an outcast, one who has violated the usages of his caste or order. E. प्र before स्कन्द to go, to drop, aff. क्त, form irr.
26853: प्रस्तर m. (-रः) 1 A stone or rock. 2 A jewel, a precious stone. 3 A couch, made of flowers or grass. 4 Any bed or couch. 5 A tabular form of representing the long and short vowels of poetical metre. 6 Notation of music. 7 A handful or bundle of Kuśa grass used at sacrifices. E. प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप्.
26854: प्रस्तार m. (-रः) 1 A jungle, a thicket or wood, overgrown with grass. 2 A bed made with blossoms, leaves, &c. 3 Any bed or couch. E. प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. घञ्.
26855: प्रस्ताव m. (-वः) 1 Opportunity, occasion, season. 2 Occasional or introductory eulogium. 3 Subject matter of a composition. 4 A chapter, a section. E. प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. घञ्.
26856: प्रस्तावना f. (-ना) 1 Commencement, introduction. 2 A dramatic prelude, an introductory dialogue, usually spoken by the manager and one of the actors. E. प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. ल्युट्; the commencement of books, &c. being usually the praise of gods or princes.
26857: प्रस्तावसदृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Suited to the occasion, appropriate, seasonable. E. प्रस्ताव, and सदृश like.
26858: प्रस्तिर m. (-रः) A bed or couch made of blossoms, flowers, leaves, &c. E. प्र before स्तॄ to spread, aff. अच्, and इर substituted for अर.
26859: प्रस्तीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Crowded, clustering. 2 Sounded, making a noise. E. प्र before स्त्यै to crowd, aff. क्त, form irr.
26860: प्रस्तीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Crowded together, swarming, clustering. 2 Sounded. E. प्र before स्त्यै to crowd, aff. क्त, form irr.
26861: प्रस्तुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, revealed, propounded, declared. 2 Ready, prepared. 3 Praised, panegyrised. 4 Accomplished, done. 5 Happened, come to pass. 6 Made or consisting of. 7 Approached, proximate. 8 Done with effort or energy. 9 Expected, desired. E. प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. क्त.
26862: प्रस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread. 2 Disappeared. E. प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. क्त.
26863: प्रस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Expanding, spread. 2 What stays well, firm, solid. 3 Who goes on a journey or march, &c. m. (-स्थः) 1 A measure of quantity, four Kuḍavas, or forty-eight double handfuls. 2 Table land on the top of a mountain. 3 A level expanse. 4 A Prastha of any thing, or any thing measuring a Prastha. E. प्र before स्था to stand, aff. क.
26864: प्रस्थपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A sort of Tulasi, or basil with small leaves. E. प्रस्थ the top of a mountain, and पुष्प flower.
26865: प्रस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Going forth, proceeding, departing. 2 March of an assailant. 3 March. 4 An inferior kind of drama, the personages of which are slaves and outcastes. E. प्र away, away from, स्था to stay, aff. ल्युट्.
26866: प्रस्थानविघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Non-attendance at a festival, impeding its taking place, &c. E. प्रस्थान proceeding, and विघ्न obstacle.
26867: प्रस्थानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a departure. E. प्रस्थान, and ठक् aff.
26868: प्रस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Sending away. 2 Appointment on an embassy. 3 Harrying, carrying off cattle, &c. E. प्र before स्था to stay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
26869: प्रस्थापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be sent away. 2 To be carried or driven off. E. प्र before स्था to stay, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
26870: प्रस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Sent away, dismissed. E. प्र reverse, स्था to stay, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
26871: प्रस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Who or what goes, travels, marches, &c. E. प्र before स्था to stay, इनि Uṇādi aff.
26872: प्रस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, departed, set forth, (on a journey, a march, &c.) E. प्र before स्था to stay, aff. क्त.
26873: प्रस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Going forth or away. 2 Journey. 3 March. E. प्र before स्था to stay, क्तिन् aff.
26874: प्रस्फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Blown, expanded. E. प्र before स्फुट to blossom, क aff.
26875: प्रस्फुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Swollen. 2 Budded. E. प्र before स्फुर to expand, क्त aff.
26876: प्रस्फोटन n. (-नं) 1 A winnowing basket. 2 Striking, beating. 3 Expanding, budding, opening, blowing. 4 Winnowing corn. 5 Ripening. E. प्र before स्फट to blossom, aff. ल्युट्.
26877: प्रस्मृति f. (-तिः) Forgetfulness, forgetting. E. प्र privative, स्मृति recollection.
26878: प्रस्रवण n. (-णं) 1 A pool of water formed by dripping of springs in the mountains. 2 Dripping or fall of water, cascade, cataract. 3 Washing away of rocks, &c. by the dripping of water. 4 Oozing, leaking, dripping. m. (-णः) 1 Sweat, perspiration. 2 Pissing, urining. 3 A range of mountains in the peninsula; also Malayavān. E. प्र before स्रु to drop, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रश्रबण.
26879: प्रस्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flowing, dropping. 2 Urine. E. प्र forth, स्रु to ooze, aff. घञ्.
26880: प्रस्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Oozed, issued, dropped. E. प्र before स्रु to drop, क्त aff.
26881: प्रस्वान m. (-नः) A loud noise. E. प्र before स्वन to sound, aff. घञ्.
26882: प्रस्विन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Perspiring, covered with perspiration. 2 Heated, sweated. E. प्र before स्विद to sweat, क्त aff.
26883: प्रस्वेद m. (-दः) Great or excessive perspiration. E. प्र intensitive, स्वेद sweat.
26884: प्रस्वेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perspiring, sweating. 2 Heated, sweated. 3 Hot, causing perspiration. E. प्र before स्विद to sweat, क्त aff.
26885: प्रस्वेदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Suffering or producing perspiration. E. प्र before ष्विद to sweat, क्तवतु aff.
26887: प्रहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, wounded, killed. 2 Repelled, repulsed, overcome, defeated. 3 Spread, expanded. 4 Contiguous, bounding, limitative. 5 Learned, accomplished. E. प्र again, and हत struck, injured.
26888: प्रहर m. (-रः) A watch, an 8th part of the day, or a division comprising about three hours. E. प्र before हृ to take, घञ् aff.
26889: प्रहरण n. (-णं) 1 A weapon. 2 A covered car, a litter for women, or any litter, or small covered car for diversion. 3 War, battle. 4 Striking, killing. E. प्र before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
26890: प्रहरणकलिका f. (-का) A species of the Śarkarī metre.
26891: प्रहरिन् m. (-री) A watchman, a bellman. E. प्रहर a watch, and इनि aff.
26892: प्रहरिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Taking, intending or wishing to take. E. प्र, हृ to take, with a future sense, शतृ aff.
26893: प्रहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Striking, a striker, a combatant. E. प्र before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
26894: प्रहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Delight, joy, rapture. E. प्र before हृष to rejoice, घञ् aff.
26895: प्रहर्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Happy, delighted. 2 Delighting. m. (-णः) The planet Mercury, or its ruler. f. (-णी) 1 Turmerick. 2 A form of metre. E. प्र before हृष to rejoice, aff. ल्युट्.
26896: प्रहर्षिणी f. (-णी) A species of the Atijagatī metre.
26897: प्रहर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, very happy. E. प्र before हृष to rejoice, क्त aff.
26898: प्रहसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Laughing, laughing heartily. f. (-न्ती) Arabian jasmine. E. प्र before हस to smile, aff. शतृ; fem. aff. ङीप्.
26899: प्रहसन n. (-नं) 1 Loud, violent or hearty laughter. 2 Mirth, merriment. 3 Sarcasm, satire, as a branch of rhetorical composition. 4 Reproof, ridicule, irony. 5 A farce, a comedy. E. प्र before हस to laugh, aff. ल्युट्.
26900: प्रहसित n. (-तं) Laughter, mirth. E. प्र and हस to laugh, क्त aff.
26901: प्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) The open hand with the fingers extended. E. प्र exchanging, हस्त the hand.
26902: प्रहापण n. (-णं) Driving away, forced abandonment or departure. E. प्र before हा to quit, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
26903: प्रहार m. (-रः) 1 Striking, wounding, killing. 2 A blow. E. प्र before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
26904: प्रहारण n. (-णं) A desirable gift. E. प्र before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रवारण.
26905: प्रहारार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Bruised, wounded, hurt by a blow. n. (-र्त्तं) Lasting and acute pain from a wound or maim. E. प्रहार striking, and आर्त्त pained.
26906: प्रहास m. (-सः) 1 Loud laughter. 2 Blowing, (as a flower.) 3 ŚIVA. 4 An actor, a dancer. 5 A place of pilgrimage; also सोमतीर्थ. E. प्र before हस to laugh, aff. घञ्.
26907: प्रहासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Laughing aloud. 2 Diverting, causing laughter. m. (-सी) A jester, a buffoon, a clown. E. प्र before हस to laugh, aff. णिनि.
26908: प्रहि m. (-हिः) A well. E. प्र before हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and the final of the radical rejected.
26909: प्रहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, dispatched. 2 Appointed, commissioned. 3 Stretched out, extended. 4 Placed. 5 Discharged, as an arrow from a bow. 6 Learned. 7 Suitable, appropriate. n. (-तं) Sauce, gravy, condiment. E. प्र before हित proper.
26910: प्रहीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Left, abandoned. m. (-णः) Removal, loss, waste, destruction. E. प्र before हा to quit, ल्युट् aff.
26911: प्रहीणजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, slain. E. प्रहीण, and जीवित life.
26912: प्रहुत n. (-तं) Offering articles of food to spirits or goblins. E. प्र before हुत the same.
26913: प्रहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seized. n. (-तं) Striking, killing. E. प्र, and हृत taken.
26914: प्रहृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pleased, delighted. E. प्र before हृष to be pleased, aff. क्त.
26915: प्रहृष्टक m. (-कः) A crow. E. प्र before हृष्ट pleased, aff. कन्.
26916: प्रहेणक n. (-कं) Victuals or sweetmeats, &c. distributed at festivals.
26917: प्रहेलक n. (-कं) Sweetmeats, &c. distributed at festivals.
26918: प्रहेलिका f. (-का) An enigma, a riddle, a puzzling or enigmatical question. E. प्र before हिल to play, and ण्वुल् aff.
26919: प्रह्राद m. (-दः) A prince: see प्रह्लाद. E. ल changed to र.
26920: प्रह्लत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Pleasure, happiness. E. प्र before ह्लद to be glad, क्तिन् aff.
26921: प्रह्लन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Pleased, happy, glad. E. प्र before ह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.
26922: प्रह्लन्नि f. (-न्निः) Pleasure, delight. E. प्र before ह्लद to be happy, क्तिन् aff.
26923: प्रह्लाद m. (-दः) 1 Pleasure, joy, happiness. 2 Sound, noise. 3 The name of HIRAṆYĀKṢA'S pious son and regent of one division of Pātāla. E. प्र before ह्लाद gladness or sound.
26924: प्रह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rejoiced, delighted. E. प्रह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.
26925: प्रह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) 1 Bowed, bent, stooping. 2 Intent upon, engaged in, engrossed by. E. प्र before ह्वेञ् to call, Uṇādi aff. वन्, form irr.
26926: प्रह्वाञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Stooping or bowing with the palm of the hands joined, and put to the forehead in token of respect. E. प्रह्व, and अञ्जलि salute.
26927: प्रह्वाय m. (-यः) Calling, summoning, invocation. E. प्र before ह्वे to call, घञ् aff.
26928: प्रह्वीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Conquered, won, subjected. 2 Bent, bowed. E. प्रह्व, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
26930: प्रांशु mfn. (-शुः-शुः-शु) High, tall, lofty. E. प्र before अंशु a ray of light.
26931: प्राक् ind. 1 Before, prior, preceding, in place or time. 2 East, eastern. 3 Past, gone. 4 First. 5 Between, amongst, amidst. 6 At dawn, early in the morning. E. see प्राच्.
26932: प्राकषिक m. (-कः) 1 A catamite. 2 A dancer, but especially one who employs or hires the wives of others, one who gets his livelihood by another man's wife. E. प्र and आङ् prefixed to कष to go, Uṇādi aff. किकन्.
26933: प्राकाम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 Irresistible will or fiat, one of ŚIVA'S eight attributes. 2 Wilfulness, following or obeying one's own will or inclination. E. प्र and आङ् before कम to desire, aff. ण्यत्.
