26934: प्राकार m. (-रः) An inclosure, a fence, a rampart, particularly a surrounding wall, &c. elevated on a mound of earth. E. प्र and आङ् implying initial, first, कृ to make, aff. घञ्; otherwise the prefix is considered as प्र only, the vowel being made long by the affix being घञ्.
26935: प्राकारीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Walled, enclosed by a wall. 2 Of, belonging to, or fit for a wall. E. प्राकार, and छ aff.
26936: प्राकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Low, common, vulgar, thence especially applicable to a provincial and peculiar dialect of the Sanskrit language. 2 Natural. 3 Belonging to or derived from the philosophical Prakṛti, illusory, material, &c. m. (-तः) A low man or one following a degraded profession. n. (-तं) Any dialect not Sanskrit, it is especially spoken by the female characters and the inferior personages of plays. E. प्रकति nature, and अण् aff., or प्र pre-eminently, and अकृत not made.
26937: प्राकृतज्वर m. (-रः) Common or usual fever, occurring from affections of the wind, bile, and phlegm, severally, in as many seasons, or the rains, autumn, and spring. E. प्राकृत, and ज्वर fever.
26938: प्राकृतप्रलय m. (-यः) The total dissolution of the world. E. प्राकृत material, and प्रलय destruction.
26939: प्राकृतमानुष m. (-षः) A man in general. E. प्राकृत, and मानुष man.
26940: प्राकृतमिच m. (-त्रः) A natural friend or ally; as applied to a sovereign, it means one whose states are removed by an intervening kingdom from those to which it should be friendly, the प्राकृतारि or natural enemy is the chief of the intervening state, and the प्राकृतोदासीनः or natural neutral is the outer one of the four. E. प्राकृत natural, and मिच a friend.
26941: प्राकृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to Prakṛti, nature or matter, material, natural, illusory, &c. E. प्रकृति, and ठक् aff.
26942: प्राक्कूल m. (-लः) The tip of Kusa grass placed to the east. E. प्राक्, and कूल point of grass.
26943: प्राक्काल n. (-लं) Former age or time. E. प्राच्, and काल time.
26944: प्राक्कालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Anterior, ancient, of a former time. E. प्राक्काल, and ख aff.
26945: प्राक्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Old, ancient. 2 Prior, anterior, preceding, former. E. प्राक् formerly, द्युल् aff., and तन् aug.
26946: प्राक्तनकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Fate, destiny. 2 Any act formerly done. E. प्राक्तन prior, and कर्म्मन् act.
26947: प्राक्फल्गुणी f. (-णी) The eleventh of the lunar asterisms: see पूर्व्वफल्गुण. E. प्राक् preceding, and फल्गुणी the asterism.
26948: प्राक्फल्गुणीभव m. (-वः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. प्राक्फल्गुणी, and भय born, born when the moon was in that mansion; also similar compounds, as प्राक्फल्गुणीय.
26949: प्राक्फाल्गुण m. (-नः) VṚHASPATI. E. प्राक्फल्गुणी, and अण् aff.
26950: प्राक्सन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) Dawn. E. प्राक् the first, सन्ध्य junction of the day.
26951: प्राक्शिरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Facing the east. 2 Having the head to the east in burial. E. प्राच्, and शिरम the head, मच added.
26952: प्राखर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Sharpness. 2 Pungency. 3 Wickedness. E. प्रखर, and ष्यञ् aff.
26953: प्रागभाव m. (-वः) Antecedent privation, the non-existence of any thing which may yet be. In law, the non-possession of property that may be possessed. E. प्राक् prior, अ negative, and भाव being.
26954: प्रागल्भ्य n. (-ल्भ्यं) 1 Confidence, boldness, determination. 2 Arrogance, effrontery. 3 Importance, rank. E. प्रगल्भ confident, यञ् aff.
26955: प्रागुदीची f. (-ची) The north-east. E. प्राक् the east, and उदीची the north.
26956: प्रागुदीची mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going before, a precursor. E. प्राच, and गामिन् who goes.
26957: प्राग्ज्योतिष m. (-षः) A country, Kāmarūpa, part of Asam. E. प्राक् formerly, ज्योतिष light; being the scene of BRAHMĀ'S penance.
26958: प्राग्भार m. (-रः) The top or peak of a mountain. E. प्राक् first, भार burthen; also read प्राग्भाव.
26959: प्राग्भाव m. (-वः) 1 Prior existence. 2 Superiority, excellence. 3 The top of a mountain. E. प्राक्, and भाव being or nature.
26960: प्राग्भावतस् ind. From a prior state of being. E. प्राग्भाव, and तसि aff.
26961: प्राग्रहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Chief, principal. E. प्र and अग्र first, हर who surpasses.
26962: प्राग्राट n. (-टं) Thin curds. E. प्र before अग्र the top, and अट what goes.
26963: प्राग्र्य mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं) Chief, principal. E. प्र prefixed to अग्र्य chief.
26964: प्राग्वंश m. (-शः) 1 The room opposite to that which contains the materials for an oblation, and in which the family and friends of the sacrificer assemble. 2 A former dynasty or race. E. प्राक् before, and वंश a race, &c.
26965: प्राघात m. (-तः) War, battle. E. प्र before हन to kill, aff. घञ्, and the vowel of the prefix optionally made long.
26966: प्राघार m. (-रः) Dropping, oozing, trickling, aspersion, or pouring out of any oily substance. E. प्र before घृ to sprinkle or drop, aff. घञ्.
26967: प्राघुण m. (-णः) A guest, a visitor, one demanding hospitality. E. प्र and आङ् before घुण to turn round, aff. क.
26968: प्राघूर्णिक m. (-कः) A guest. E. प्र before घूर्ण going about, aff. ठक्.
26969: प्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of small tabor or drum. E. प्र before अञ्ज to go or be, aff. ग.
26970: प्राङ्गण n. (-णं) 1 A sort of drum. 2 A court, a yard. E. प्र before अगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
26971: प्राङ्न्याय m. (-यः) Plea of a former trial, special plea. E. प्राक् former, न्याय proper.
26972: प्राङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) Facing the east. E. प्राञ्च्, and मुख the face.
26973: प्राच् or प्राञ्च mfn. (प्राङ् प्राची प्राक्) 1 East, eastern. 2 Before, in front. 3 Former, prior, first. 4 At top, above. f. (-ची) The east. E. प्र before अञ्ज to go, aff. क्विन्.
26974: प्राचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Contrary to rectitude, deviating from the ordinary institutions and observances. E. प्र reverse, and आचार ordinance.
26975: प्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A scholar, a pupil. E. प्र meaning प्राप्त obtained, and आचार्य्य a preceptor.
26976: प्राचिका f. (-का) 1 A musquito. 2 The female falcon.
26977: प्राचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 East, eastern. 2 Former, prior, ancient, old. 3 Placed towards the east. fn. (-ना-नं) A bound hedge, a fence, a wall. f. (-ना) 1 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 2 The ichneumon plant: see रास्ना. E. प्राच् the east, aff. ख.
26978: प्राचीनतिलक m. (-कः) The moon. E. प्राचीन eastern, and तिलक mark.
26979: प्राचीनपनस m. (-सः) A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. प्राचीन् eastern, and पनस the jack.
26980: प्राचीनवर्हिस् m. (-र्हिः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A king. E. प्राचीन eastern, and वर्हिस् light; presiding over the eastern quarter.
26981: प्राचीनामलक m. (-कः) A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. प्राचीन eastern, आमलक myrobalan.
26982: प्राचीनावीत n. (-तं) The sacrificial thread, worn over the right arm, and passing under the left, as at Śrāddhas. E. प्राचीन east, and आवीत hung.
26983: प्राचीनावीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman wearing his cord over his right shoulder, as at Śrāddhas. E. प्राचीतावीत, and इनि aff.
26984: प्राचीपति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA. E. प्राची the east, and पति master, regent.
26985: प्राचीर n. (-रं) A bound hedge, a fence, a wall, an inclosure, a rampart. E. प्र and आङ prefixed to चि to collect, aff. क्रन्, and the radical vowel made long.
26986: प्राचेतस m. (-सः) VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa. m. plu. (-साः) The ten sons of Prācīnavarhis. E. प्रचेतस, the father of the poet, and अण् aff.; it also occurs प्राचेतस् (-ताः.)
26987: प्राच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Eastern, easterly. m. (-च्यः) The eastern country, the country south or east of the SARASVATĪ, which flows from the north-east to the south-west. E. प्राच् the east, aff. यत्.
26988: प्राच्छ् m. (-प्राट) An inquirer, a questioner. E. प्रच्छ to ask, aff. क्विप्.
26989: प्राजक m. (-कः) A coachman, a driver. E. प्र before अज to go, causal form, aff. वुन्.
26990: प्राजन n. (-नं) A goad. E. प्र before अज to go, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
26991: प्राजापत्य m. (-त्यः) 1 A form of marriage, the gift of a girl, respectfully by her father to her lover. 2 A name of Allahabad or Prayāga. 3 The first of the persons, called Vāsudevas, by the Jainas. n. (-त्यं) 1 A sort of penance, eating once a day for three days in the morning, once in the night for three days, subsisting three days on food given as alms, and fasting three days more. 2 A particular sacrifice performed before appointing a daughter to raise issue in default of male heirs. 3 The asterism Rohiṇī. f. (-त्या) Giving away the whole of one's property before entering upon the life of an ascetic or mendicant. E. प्रजापति BRAHMĀ, and ण्यत् aff.
26992: प्राजितृ m. (-ता) A coachman, a charioteer. E. प्र before अज to go, causal v., तृच् aff.
26993: प्राज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Patient in investigation. 2 Wise, clever, sensible. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A Paṇḍita, a learned or wise man. 2 A skilful or clever man. f. (-ज्ञा) Knowledge, understanding. f. (-ज्ञा-ज्ञी) A clever or intelligent woman. f. (-ज्ञी) The wife of a Paṇḍita. E. प्र and आङ before ज्ञा to know, क aff.
26994: प्राज्ञत्व n. (-त्वं) Learning, wisdom. E. प्राज्ञ, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, प्राज्ञता.
26995: प्राज्ञमान n. (-नं) Respect for learned men. E. प्राज्ञ, and मान respect.
26996: प्राज्ञमानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Respecting men of learning. E. प्राज्ञमान, and इनि aff.
26997: प्राज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Much, many. E. प्र before अञ्ज to pervade, aff. क्यप्.
26998: प्राञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Honest, upright, sincere. E. प्र before अञ्ज to go, aff. अलच्.
26999: प्राञ्जलि f. (-लिः) Putting the hands together to the forehead, a mark of respect. E. प्र, and अञ्जलि the same.
27000: प्राड्विवाक m. (-कः) A judge, a magistrate. E. प्राट् who asks, and विवाक् who decides or discriminates.
27001: प्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Full, replete, filled. m. (-णः) 1 Air inhaled, inspiration, breath. 2 Air, wind. 3 Life, vitality. 4 A vital organ or part. 5 Strength, power. 6 Myrrh. 7 Poetical talent or inspiration. 8 A name of BRAHMĀ. 9 A title of BRAHMĀ, the supreme spirit. 10 An aspiration in the articulation of letters. m. plu. (-णाः) The five vital airs or modes of inspiration and expiration collectively. E. प्र before अन to breathe, aff. अच्.
27002: प्राणक m. (-कः) 1 An animal or sentient being. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. प्राण life, कन् aff.
27003: प्राणकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Vital action. E. प्राण, and कर्म्मन् act.
27004: प्राणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) Living, breathing. E. प्राण nominal v. to live, शतृ aff.
27005: प्राणत्याग m. (-गः) Abandoning life, dying, suicide. E. प्राण, and त्याग relinquishment.
27006: प्राणथ m. (-थः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A strong or powerful man. 3 A progenitor of mankind. 4 A place of pilgrimage. E. प्र before अन to breathe or be strong, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
27007: प्राणद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives life. n. (-दं) 1 Water. 2 Blood. E. प्राण life, and द who gives.
27008: प्राणधारण n. (-णं) Sustenance, supporting life. E. प्राण, and धारण upholding.
27009: प्राणन n. (-नं) 1 Life, living. 2 The throat. E. प्र before अन to live or breathe, aff. ल्युट्.
27010: प्राणनाथ m. (-थः) A husband. E. प्राण life, and नाथ lord.
27011: प्राणन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A sort of collyrium: see रसाञ्जन. f. (-न्ती) 1 Sneezing. 2 Hickup. E. प्र before अन to breathe, Uṇādi aff. भच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
27012: प्राणपरिग्रह m. (-हः) Life, existence. E. प्राण, and परिग्रह possession.
27013: प्राणप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Saving life, when in imminent danger. E. प्राण, and प्रद who or what gives.
27014: प्राणप्रदा f. (-दा) A medicinal plant, commonly Ṛddhi. E. प्राण life, प्रद what gives.
27015: प्राणबाध m. (-धः) Extreme peril or distress, fear for life. E. प्राण, and बाध obstruction.
27016: प्राणभास्वत् m. (-स्वान्) The ocean. E. प्राण life, भास्वत् the sun, the sun being produced or rising from the sea.
27017: प्राणभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Living, sentient. E. प्राण, and भृत् who has.
27018: प्राणमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Living, breathing, endowed with breath or life. E. प्राण, and मयट् aff.
27019: प्राणमयकोष m. (-षः) One of the cases or investitures of the soul, the vital or organic case. E. प्राणमय, and कोष a sheath.
27020: प्राणयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Rescuing, restoring to life. E. प्राण nom. v. caus. form, शतृ aff.
27021: प्राणयात्रा f. (-त्रा) Support of life, subsistence. E. प्राण, and यात्रा proceeding.
27022: प्राणव्यय m. (-यः) Death, expenditure of life. E. प्राण, and व्यय expence.
27023: प्राणसंयम m. (-मः) 1 A peculiar religious exercise: see पाणायाम. 2 Suspending the breath. E. प्राण breath, सम् before यम to restrain, aff. अञ्.
27024: प्राणसद्मन् n. (-द्म) The body. E. प्राण vital air, and सद्मन् abode.
27025: प्राणसमा f. (-मा) A wife. E. प्राण life, समा equal to, same.
27026: प्राणहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Destructive, taking away life. E. प्राण, and हर who or what takes.
27027: प्राणहारक n. (-कं) Aconite. E. प्राण, and हारक what takes away.
27028: प्राणहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Mortal, deadly. E. प्राण, and हारिन् what takes.
27029: प्राणाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Fatal, deadly. E. प्राश, and अद what eats.
27030: प्राणाधिनाथ m. (-थः) A husband. E. प्राण life, अधि over, नाथ lord.
27031: प्राणान्त n. (-न्तं) Death. E. प्राण, and अन्त end.
27032: प्राणान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Fatal, destructive of life. 2 Capital, (as punishment.) n. (-कं) Murder, assassination. E. प्राण, and अन्तिक final.
27033: प्राणापहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Deadly, fatal. E. प्राण, and अपहारिन् what takes away.
27034: प्राणापान m. du. (-नौ) 1 The Aśvinī kumāras. 2 Two of the vital airs. E. प्राण, and अपान the air expelled by the anus.
27035: प्राणाबाध n. (-धं) Any act injurious to life. E. प्राण, and आङ् before वाध to pain, अच aff.
27036: प्राणायाम m. (-मः) Breathing in a peculiar way through the nostrils, during the mental recitation of the names or attributes of some deity; it is differently performed: the Vaidyas or followers of the Veda close the right nostril first with the thumb, and inhale breath through the left, then they close both nostrils, and finally open the right for exhalation: the followers of the Tantras close the left nostril first, and exhale also through it; these operations are severally called पुरक, कुम्भक, and रेचक. E. प्राण breath, आ before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
27037: प्राणिणिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing for life. E. प्राण nom. v., desid. form, उ aff.
27038: प्राणिद्यूत n. (-तं) Cock fighting, ram fighting, setting animals to fight for wagers. E. प्राणि a living being, and द्यूत gaming.
27039: प्राणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Living, breathing. m. (-णी) An animal, a sentient or living being. E. प्राण vital air, and इनि aff.
27040: प्राणिपीडा f. (-डा) Cruelty to animals. E. प्राणिन्, and पीडा pain.
27041: प्राणिमाता f. (-ता) A mother. E. प्राणिन्, and मातृ mother.
27042: प्राणिहिंसा f. (-सा) Doing harm to any living creature. E. प्राणि, and हिंसा injury.
27043: प्राणिहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Favourable or good for living beings. f. (-ता) A shoe, a boot. E. प्राणि an animal, (man,) and हित suitable.
27044: प्राणीत्य n. (-त्यं) Debt. E. प्रणीत taken, यञ् aff.
27045: प्राणेश m. (-शः) A husband. f. (-शा) A wife. E. प्राण life, and ईश sovereign.
27046: प्राण्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Any animal part or product, (as flesh, bone, milk, Ghee, &c.) E. प्राणिन, and अङ्ग a part.
27047: प्रातःकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Morning duty or ceremonies, worship, ablution, purification, &c. E. प्रातर, and कृत्य to be done.
27048: प्रातःसन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) 1 Dawn. 2 The morning sacrifice. E. प्रातर, and सन्ध्या part of the day.
27049: प्रातःसमय m. (-यः) Early morning, day break. E. प्रातर्, and समय season.
27050: प्रातःस्नान n. (-नं) Morning ablution, bathing at sun-rise. E. प्रातर्, and स्नान bathing.
27051: प्रातर् ind. Morning, dawn. E. प्र initial, अत to go, अर् aff.
27052: प्रातराश m. (-शः) The morning meal, breakfast. E. प्रातर् morning, अश to eat, aff. घञ्.
27053: प्रातराशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Breakfasted, having had the morning meal. E. प्रातर, and आशित eaten.
27054: प्रातर्गेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sung or chanted in the morning. m. (-यः) A minstrel, a bard, but one who especially wakes the sovereign or prince by his morning chant. E. प्रातर् in the morning, गेय to be sung.
27055: प्रातर्भोक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) Who or what eats early. m. (-क्ता) A crow. E. प्रातर् morning, and भोक्तृ who eats.
27056: प्रातर्भोजन n. (-नं) Breakfast, the morning meal. E. प्रातर् morning, and भाजन food.
27058: प्रातिकूलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Opposed to, opposing. E. प्रतिकूल, and ठक् aff.
27059: प्रातिकूल्य n. (-ल्यं) Contrariety, contradiction, opposition. E. प्रतिकूल, and ष्यञ् aff.
27060: प्रातिजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for or suitable to dependants, family, &c. E. प्रतिजन, and खञ् aff.
27061: प्रातिपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) 1 Hostile, belonging to an enemy. 2 Adverse, contrary. E. प्रतिपक्ष, and अण् aff.
27062: प्रातिपदिक n. (-कं) A crude noun, a noun before any of its inflections are formed with appropriate affixes. m. (-कः) Fire. E. प्र and अति before पद an inflected word, ठक् aff.
27063: प्रातिपथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Hostile, opposing. E. प्रतिपथ, and ठक् aff.
27064: प्रातिभाव्य n. (-व्यं) Security, the act of becoming bail or surety, or being answerable for the appearance of the debtor, for his being trust-worthy, or for the payment of his debt in case of his failing to do it. E. प्रतिभू, a security, and ष्यञ् aff.
27065: प्रातिलोम्य n. (-म्यं) Inverted order. E. प्रतिलोम, and ष्यञ् aff.
27066: प्रातिवेश्य m. (-श्यः) A next-door neighbour. E. प्रतिवेश, and ष्यञ् aff.
27067: प्रातिस्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Own, peculiar, proper. E. प्रति to or towards, स्व own, and ठक् aff.
27068: प्रातिहर m. (-रः) A juggler. E. प्रतिहार the same, and अण् pleonastic: see the next.
27069: प्रातिहारक m. (-कः) A juggler. E. कन् added to प्रातिहार.
27070: प्रातिहारिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a conjuror. E. प्रतिहार disguise, trick, aff. ठञ्.
27071: प्रातीप m. (-पः) A name of ŚĀNTANU. E. प्रतीप the father of this prince, and अण् aff. of descent.
27072: प्रातीपिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Reverse, contrary, retrograde. E. प्रतीप, and ठक् aff.
27073: प्रात्ययिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Trusty, confidential, having faith in. m. (-कः) A surety. E. प्रत्यय, and ठक् aff.
27074: प्राथमकल्पिक m. (-कः) A student, one who has just commenced the perusal of the Vedas. E. प्रथम first, कल्प beginning, and ठक् aff.
27075: प्राथमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) First, of the first, initial, initiative. E. प्रथम, and ठञ् aff.
27076: प्राथम्य n. (-म्यं) Firstness, priority. E. प्रथम, and ष्यञ् aff.
27077: प्रादक्षिण्य n. (-ण्यं) Circumambulation. E. प्रदक्षिण, and ष्यञ् aff.
27078: प्रादुर्भाव m. (-वः) Appearance, manifestation. E. प्राटुम्, and भाव quality.
27079: प्रादुष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested, made apparent. E. प्राटुस, and कृत made.
27080: प्रादुस् ind. 1 Evidently, apparently, manifestly. 2 Visible, apparent. 3 Name, appellation. 4 Existence. 5 Co-existence. E. प्र before अद to go, or eat, Uṇādi aff. उस्.
27081: प्रादेश m. (-शः) 1 The span of the thumb and forefinger. 2 Place, country. E. प्र before दिश to shew, aff. घञ्; whence the vowel of the prefix is optionally long: see प्रदेश.
27082: प्रादेशन n. (-नं) Gift, donation. E. प्र and आङ् before दिश to give, aff. ल्युट्.
27083: प्रादोष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Belonging, or relating to the evening. E. प्रदोष evening, aff. अण्; also with ठञ् aff. प्रादोषिक.
27084: प्राधान्य n. (-न्यं) Supremacy, superiority. E. प्रधान chief, ष्यञ् aff.
27085: प्राधान्यतस् ind. Chiefly. E. प्रधान्य, and तसि aff.
27086: प्राधीत m. (-तः) A Brahman who has finished his studies. E. प्र, and अधीत read over.
27087: प्राध्ययन n. (-नं) Reading, study. E. प्र before अधि to read through, ल्युट् aff.
27088: प्राध्व mfn. (-ध्वः-ध्वा-ध्वं) 1 Distant, remote, long, as a road or journey. 2 Bowed, bent. 3 Binding, confining. m. (-ध्वः) A car, a carriage. E. प्र before अध्वन् a road, aff. अच्.
27089: प्राध्वम् ind. 1 In conformity, conformably. 2 Crooked, crookedly, stooping. E. प्र and आङ् before ध्वन to sound, aff. डम्.
27090: प्रान्त m. (-न्तः) Edge, margin, border, end. E. प्र before अन्त end.
27091: प्रान्ततस् ind. Bordering, marginally, along or upon the extremity. E. प्रान्त the edge, and तसि aff.
27092: प्रान्तदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A suburb or collection of houses out of the walls of the town, a Petta, &c. E. प्रान्त skirting, टुर्ग the fort.
27093: प्रान्तर n. (-रं) 1 A long and unshaded road, a lonesome or tiresome path. 2 A forest. 3 The hollow of a tree. E. प्र considerable, अन्तर space.
27094: प्रान्तरशून्य n. (-न्यं) A long and tiresome road. E. प्रान्तर spacious, and शून्य empty, void.
27095: प्राप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Watery, abounding with water. E. प्र, and अप water.
27096: प्रापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Procuring, causing to obtain. 2 Obtaining, who or what obtains. E. प्राप to obtain, ण्वुल् aff.
27097: प्रापण n. (-णं) Obtaining. E. प्र before आप to gain, ल्युट् aff.
27098: प्रापणिक m. (-कः) 1 A trader, a dealer. 2 A retail dealer. E. प्र and आङ् before पण to deal, to transact business, किकन Uṇādi aff.
27099: प्रापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Brought, placed. 2 Procured. E. प्र before आप to gain, causal v., क्त aff.
27100: प्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Obtained, gained, received, procured. 2 Fixed, placed. 3 Proper, right. E. प्र before आप to gain, aff. क्त.
27101: प्राप्तकाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Fated, destined, one whose fated time has come. 2 Opportune, in season. E. प्राप्त, and काल time.
27102: प्राप्तपञ्चत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) Dead, deceased. E. प्राप्त obtained, पञ्चत्व death.
27103: प्राप्तबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) 1 Enlightened, instructed, intelligent. 2 Recovering, becoming conscious, (after fainting.) E. प्राप्त, and बुद्धि understanding.
27104: प्राप्तभार m. (-रः) A draft ox or beast of burthen. E. प्राप्त, and भार load.
27105: प्राप्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Wise. 2 Handsome. 3 Of a good disposition. m. (-वः) A bullock. E. प्राप्त gained, भाव disposition.
27106: प्राप्तरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Learned, wise. 2 Handsome, pleasing. E. प्राप्त gained or proper, रूप form.
27107: प्राप्तार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-थं) Successful, having gained an object. E. प्राप्त, and अर्थ object.
27108: प्राप्तापराध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Offending, being in fault. E. प्राप्त, and अपराध offence.
27109: प्राप्तावसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opportune, seasonable, taking or finding occasion. E. प्राप्त, and अवसर opportunity.
27110: प्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Gain, profit. 2 Acquiring, getting, obtaining. 3 Improvement, success. 4 Rise, ascent. 5 Collection, assemblage, quantity. 6 Happy denouement, successful termination of a plot. 7 Guessing, discovering from a hint. 8 One of the eight superhuman faculties, the power of obtaining every thing. E. प्र before आप to get or obtain, aff. क्तिन्.
27111: प्राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Attainable, obtainable. E. प्र before आप to attain, aff. ण्यत्.
27112: प्राबल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Power, vigour. 2 Predominance. E. प्रबल strong, ष्यञ् aff.
27113: प्राबोधिक m. (-कः) Dawn, daybreak. E. प्रबोध waking, and ठक् aff.
27114: प्राभव n. (-वं) Superiority, pre-eminence. E. प्रभु a master, aff. अण्.
27115: प्राभवत्य n. (-न्यं) Power, authority. E. प्रभवन् being superior, ष्यञ् aff.
27116: प्राभृत n. (-तं) A present, an offering to a deity or sovereign, or a gift to a friend, a bribe, the Nezer of Hindustan. E. प्र and आङ् before भृ to nourish, aff. क्त।; also with कन् aff. प्राभृतक, n. (-कं)
27117: प्रामाणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Exercising or proceeding from some evidence or authority, &c. 2 Being of authority. m. (-कः) 1 A president, the chief or head of a trade, &c. 2 A learned man, one who supports his arguments by reference to books, &c. E. प्रमाण testimony, authority, aff. ठञ्.
27118: प्रामाण्य n. (-ण्यं) Authority, proof. E. प्रमाण, and ष्यञ् aff.
27119: प्रामाद्य m. (-द्यः) A tree, (Justicia adhenatoda.) n. (-द्यं) Madness, frenzy, fury, intoxication. E. प्र before मद to delight, aff. अच् and ण्यत् added.
27120: प्रामीत्य n. (-त्यं) Debt. E. प्र and आङ् before मा to measure, क्यप् aff., and तुक aug.; also read प्राणीत्य.
27121: प्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Like, resembling, (used in composition.) 2 Exceeding, much. m. (-यः) 1 Fasting to death, as a religious or penitentiary act, and especially after abandoning all worldly goods, and desires. 2 Quantity, abundance. 3 Death, dying. 4 A state or condition of life, age, youth, &c. n. (-यं) Sin. E. प्र before इन् to go, अच् aff.
27122: प्रायण n. (-णं) Death, voluntary death. E. प्र, and अयन going.
27123: प्रायशस् ind. Usually, commonly, for the most part. E. प्राय, and शसि aff.
27124: प्रायिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Common, usual. E. प्राय, and ठक् aff.
27125: प्रायश्चित्त m. (-त्तः) Expiation, penance. E. प्राय sin, चित्त or चित्ति reflection, and सुट् aug. hence also प्रायश्चित्ति, f. (-त्तिः.)
27126: प्रायश्चित्तविधि f. (-धिः) Rules for penance or expiation. E. प्रायश्चित्त, and विधि rite.
27127: प्रायस् ind. 1 Frequently, generally, for the most part. 2 Abundantly, largely. E. प्र before इण् or अय to go, aff. असुच्.
27128: प्रायुधेषिन् m. (-षी) A horse. E. प्र mostly, आयुध a weapon, इप् to wish, aff. णिनि.
27129: प्रायोपवेशन n. (-नं) Fasting to death. E. प्राय, and उपवेशन sitting down.
27130: प्रायोपवेशनिका f. (-का) Sitting down to die by fasting. E. प्राय, उपवेश sitting down, कन् added, fem. form.
27131: प्रारब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Begun, beginning. E. प्र and आङ् before रभ to begin, क्त aff.
27132: प्रारब्धि f. (-ब्धिः) 1 Beginning, commencement. 2 A rope or fastening for an elephant. E. प्र and आङ् before रभ to commence, aff. क्तिन्.
27133: प्रारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Beginning. E. प्र and आङ् before रभि to begin, घञ् aff.
27134: प्रार्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Asking, an asker, a solicitor. E. प्र before अर्थ to seek, वुन् aff.
27135: प्रार्थन nf. (-नं-ना) Asking, begging. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, aff. युच्.
27136: प्रार्थनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be asked or begged. n. (-यं) The third or Dvāpara age of the world. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, अनीयर् aff.
27137: प्रार्थयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) One who asks or solicits, a beggar, an inquirer, a solicitor. E. प्र before अर्थ to seek, तृच् aff.
27138: प्रार्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Asked, begged, solicited. 2 Said, spoken. 3 Obstructed or opposed by an enemy. 4 Killed, hurt. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, aff. क्त.
27139: प्रार्थितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Asking, begging. E. प्र before अर्थ to ask, क्तवतु aff.
27140: प्रालम्ब n. (-म्बं) A garland hanging round the neck, and reaching to the breast. E. प्र and आङ् before लवि to hang or fall, aff. अच्; also with कन् added प्रालम्बक.
27141: प्रालम्बिका f. (-का) A garland, a necklace. E. प्रालम्ब a garland, &c. कन् aff., fem. form.
27142: प्रालेय n. (-यं) Frost. E. प्र before लीच् to unite with, aff. अच्; प्रलय here said to mean a mountain, अण् aff. of derivation, and the penultimate vowel changed to ए.
27143: प्रालेयांशु m. (-शुः) The moon. E. प्रालेय frost or cold, and अंशु a ray.
27144: प्रावट m. (-टः) Barley. E. प्र and आङ् before वट to encompass. aff. अच्.
27145: प्रावर m. (-रः) An inclosure, a fence, a hedge. E. प्र and आङ् before वृ to surround, aff. अप्.
27146: प्रावरण n. (-णं) 1 An upper or outer garment. 2 Any covering. E. प्र and आङ् before वृ to cover, aff. ल्युट्.
27147: प्रावार m. (-रः) An upper or outer garment, a cloak, a mantle. E. प्र before वृ with आङ् prefix, aff. घञ्.
27148: प्रावारकीट m. (-टः) A body louse. E. प्रावार the outward garment, and कीट an insect.
27149: प्रावीण्य n. (-ण्यं) Cleverness, skilfulness. E. प्रवीण, and ष्यञ् aff.
27150: प्रावुर्वृषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to wear. E. प्र and आङ् before वृ to wear, desid. v., उ aff.
27151: प्रावृत mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं) A veil, a wrapper, a cloak or mantle. adj. Covered, inclosed, encompassed. E. प्र before वृ with आङ् prefix, to cover, aff. क्त.
27152: प्रावृति f. (-तिः) An inclosure, a fence, a bound hedge. E. प्र before वृ with आङ prefix, to inclose, aff. क्तिन्.
27153: प्रावृष् f. (-वृट्) The rainy season, two months, about July and August. E. प्र before वृष to sprinkle, aff. क्विप् and the vowel of the prefix made long.
27154: प्रावृषा f. (-षा) The season of the rains. E. प्रावृष् as above, and टाप् added.
27155: प्रावृषायणी f. (-णी) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. प्रावृष् the rains, फक aff.; growing in the rains.
27156: प्रावृषिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced, &c. in the rainy season. m. (-कृः) A peacock. E. प्रावृष the rains, aff. ठक्.
27157: प्रावृषिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the rains. E. प्रावृष् in the 7th case, ज born.
27158: प्रावृषेण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्य) 1 Produced in the rains. 2 Much, abundant. m. (-ण्यः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) E. प्रावृष the rains, and एण्य aff.
27159: प्रावेशन n. (-नं) A manufactory, a workshop. E. प्र before आवेशन entering.
27160: प्राशन n. (-नं) 1 Feeding, causing to taste or eat. 2 Tasting. E. प्र before अश to eat, intransitive or causal v., ल्युट् aff.
27161: प्राशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eaten, devoured. 2 Tasted, taken into the mouth without reaching to the throat. n. (-तं) Oblation to deified progenitors. E. प्र before अशित eaten.
27162: प्राशित्र n. (-त्रं) Any edible article. E. प्र before अश to eat, इत्रन् aff.
27163: प्राश्निक m. (-कः) 1 An assistant at a spectacle or assembly. 2 An inquirer, an asker. E. प्रश्न a question, aff. ठक्.
27164: प्राश्य ind. Having tasted or sipped. E. प्र before अश to eat, ल्यप् aff.
27165: प्रास m. (-सः) A bearded dart. E. प्र before अस to throw, aff. अच्.
27166: प्रासक m. (-कः) A die, dice. E. प्र before अस to throw, aff. ण्वुल्.
27167: प्रासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A yoke for cattle. E. प्र and आङ before सञ्ज to join, aff. घञ्.
27168: प्रासङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Proceeding from or belonging to any connexion or relation. 2 Relevant, belonging to any topic. 3 Inherent, innate. 4 Inseparably connected with. 5 Incidental, episodical. E. प्रसङ्ग, and ठञ् aff.
27169: प्रासङ्ग्य m. (-ड्ग्यः) A beast of draught, an ox, yoked or in training. E. प्रासङ्ग a yoke, and यत् aff.
27170: प्रासाद m. (-दः) A temple, a palace, a building consecrated to a deity, or inhabited by a prince. E. प्र before सद to go, aff. घञ, and the vowel of the prefix lengthened, or आङ् prefixed to the verb.
27171: प्रासादकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A pigeon. E. प्रासाद a palace, and कुक्कुट a cock.
27172: प्रासादपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A terrace or balcony on the top of a large house. E. प्रासाद, and पृष्ठ back.
27173: प्रासादशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A turret, a spire on a palace or temple. E. प्रासाद, and शृङ्ग a horn.
27174: प्रासादीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of or belonging to a palace. E. प्रासाद्, and छ aff.
27175: प्रासिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer, a soldier armed with a dart or spear. E. प्रास a dart, and ठक् aff.
27176: प्रास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Thrown, thrown off or away. 2 Thrown into. 3 Expelled, turned out, banished. E. प्र before अस to throw, क्त aff.
27177: प्रास्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought for a Prastha, containing a Prastha, &c. E. प्रस्थ a certain measure, and ठञ् aff.
27178: प्राह m. (-हः) Instruction in the art of acting or dancing.
27179: प्राह्ण m. (-ह्णः) The forenoon. E. प्र prior, अह्न the day.
27180: प्राह्णे ind. In the morning, in the forenoon. E. the seventh case of the last word, used as a particle.
27181: प्राह्णेतन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging to the forenoon. E. प्राह्णे in the morning, aff. द्यु, and तुक aug.
27182: प्राह्णेतमाम् ind. Early in the day, in the forenoon. E. प्राह्णे with तमप् aff. and आमु added.
27183: प्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Beloved, dear, desired. m. (-यः) 1 A husband, a lover. 2 A sort of drug, commonly Ṛddhi. 3 A sort of  deer. f. (-या) 1 A woman. 2 A wife or mistress. 3 Small cardamoms. 4 News, information. 5 Arabian jasmine. 6 Spirituous or vinous liquor. 7 A species of the Supratiṣṭhā metre. E. प्री to please, aff. क, and the vowel made short.
27184: प्रियक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) 2 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) 4 A variegated or spotted deer. 5 A bee. 6 Saffron. E. कन् added to the preceding.
27185: प्रियकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Kind, favourable, affectionate, doing good to, or treating kindly. 2 Suiting, congenial. E. प्रिय, and कृ to do, अण् aff.
27186: प्रियकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Kind, friendly, a friend, a benefactor. E. प्रिय, and कृत् who does.
27187: प्रियङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Amiable, exciting or attracting regard. 2 Acting kindly or affectionately to. E. प्रिय beloved, कृ to make, aff. खच्; also with अण् aff. प्रियकार.
27188: प्रियङ्करण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Acceptable, grateful to. 2 Acting kindly to, who or what does so. n. (-णं) Gratifying, treating kindly, (the act.) E. प्रिय, कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.
27189: प्रियङ्गु (-ङ्गुः) 1 A medicinal plant, and perfume, commonly known by the name Priyangu, and described in some places as a fragrant seed. 2 Panick seed, (Panicum italicum.) 3 Black mustard seed. 4 Long pepper. 5 A peculiar tree: see कटुकी. E. प्रिय desired, गम to go, aff. डुन् and मुम् aug.
27190: प्रियतम mfn. (-मः-मा-भं) Dearest, most beloved. m. (-मः) A tree, (Celosia cristata) E. प्रिय desirable, तमप् aff.
27191: प्रियतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dearer, more dear. E. प्रिय, and तरप् comparative aff.
27192: प्रियता f. (-ता) Love, affection. E. प्रिय beloved, तस्न् aff.; also with त्व, aff. प्रियत्व n. (-त्वं.)
27193: प्रियदर्शन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Handsome, lovely, good looking. m. (-नः) 1 A parrot. 2 A tree, (Mimusops kauki.) E. प्रिय beloved, and दर्शन appearance.
27194: प्रियप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Eloquent, well spoken, of pleasing speech. n. (-यः) Eloquence in language. E. प्रिय desired, प्राय abundance.
27195: प्रियप्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सः-प्सुः-प्सु) Lamenting the loss or absence of any beloved object, wishing or grieving for it. E. प्रिय beloved, and प्रेप्सु desirous.
27196: प्रियभाषण n. (-णं) Speaking kindly. E. प्रिय, and भाष्ण speaking.
27197: प्रियमधु m. (-धुः) BALARĀMA, the half brother of KṚṢṆA. E. प्रिय fond, मधु wine.
27198: प्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Beloved, affectionate. E. प्री to please, शानच् aff.
27199: प्रियम्बद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Sweet or pleasant speaking. m. (-दः) A sort of demigod or Vidyādhara. E. प्रिय kind, desired, वद to speak, aff. खश्.
27200: प्रियम्भविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Become dear to, or beloved by. E. प्रिय, भू to be, खिष्णुच् aff.
27201: प्रियम्भविष्णुता n. (-ता) Amiability, becoming beloved by. E. तल् added to the last.
27202: प्रियम्भावुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Become dear to, or beloved by. E. प्रिय, and भू to be, खुकञ् aff.
27203: प्रियम्भावुकता f. (-ता) Amiability, becoming beloved, the state or condition. E. तल् added to the last.
27204: प्रियवर्णी f. (-र्णी) A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. प्रिय desired, वर्ण class.
27205: प्रियवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Sweet or pleasant spoken, flattering, a flatterer. E. प्रिय kind, and वादिन् who speaks.
27206: प्रियसख m. (-खः) A tree, (Khayar, or Mimosa catechu) f. (-खी) A female friend or companion, a confidante. E. प्रिय desired, सखि a friend, टच् aff.
27207: प्रियसत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Pleasant, and true. n. (-त्यं) Eloquent, or pleasing, as well as true, (discourse.) E. प्रिय loved, and सत्य true.
27208: प्रियसन्देश m. (-शः) A tree bearing a fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.) E. प्रिय a friend, and सन्देश intelligence.
27209: प्रियाख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Announcing good tidings. E. प्रिय, and आख्य who says.
27210: प्रियाल m. (-लः) A tree, commonly Piyal, (Buchanania latifolia, ROXBURGH'S catalogue, but the name is applied to different trees.) E. पृ to satisfy, aff. कालन् and the radical vowel changed to रि; also with कन् added प्रियालक m. (-कः) and with the vowel protracted, प्रियाल. m. (-लः) also as derived from पीय a Sautra root, पीयाल or पियाल, &c.
27211: प्रियासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Fond of life. E. प्रिय, and असु breath.
27212: प्रियैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Friendly, affectionate, wishing to please. E. प्रिय, and एषिन् seeking.
27213: प्रियोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well or kindly spoken, pleasingly uttered. n. (-तं) Kindly or gentle speech. E. प्रिय kind, &c. and उदित said.
27214: प्री(ङ्)प्रीङ् r. 4th cl. (प्रीयते) (ञ्) प्रीञ् r. 9th cl. (प्रीणाति प्रीणीते) and 1st and 10th cls. (प्रियति-ते प्राययति-ते or प्रीणयति) 1 To please, to delight, to satisfy. 2 To be pleased or satisfied. 3 To desire or love.
27215: प्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Old, ancient. 2 Pleased, satisfied. E. प्री to please, aff. क्त, form irr.
27216: प्रीणन n. (-नं) Satisfaction, satisfying, satiety. E. प्री to please, aff. ल्युट्.
27217: प्रीणयित्वा ind. Having pleased or propitiated. E. प्री to please, क्त्वा aff.
27218: प्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pleased, happy, glad. 2 Pleased or satisfied with. 3 Gracious, kind, affectionate. 4 Beloved, dear to. n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight. E. प्री to please, aff. क्त.
27219: प्रीतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्मः) Pleased, satisfied, content. E. प्रीत, and आत्मन् self.
27220: प्रीति f. (-तिः) 1 Joy, pleasure, happiness. 2 Love, affection, regard. 3 The wife of KĀMA, or Cupid. 4 The second of the twenty-seven astronomical Yogas. E. प्री to please, aff. क्तिन्.
27221: प्रीतिकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Pleasing, agreeable to. E. प्रीति, and कर making.
27222: प्रीतिजुषा f. (-षाः) The wife of ANIRUDDHA. E. प्रीति the wife of KĀMA, जुष to serve, affs. क and टाप्.
27223: प्रीतिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Affectionate, inspiring love or regard. m. (-दः) A jester, a buffoon. E. प्रीति affection, pleasure, and द who gives.
27224: प्रीतिदान n. (-नं) A kind or friendly present. E. प्रीति affection, and दान giving.
27225: प्रीतिदाय n. (-यं) A gift or token of affection. E. प्रीति, and दाय a gift.
27226: प्रीतिपूर्व्वक n. adv. (-कं) Through favour or kindness. E. प्रीति, and पूर्व्वक an antecedent.
27227: प्रीतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Kind, affectionate. E. प्रीति, and मतुप् aff.
27228: प्रीतिमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) 1 Content, happy. 2 Kind. E. प्रीति, and मनस् the mind.
27229: प्रीतिवचस् n. (-चः) Gracious or kindly speech. E. प्रीति, and वचस् speech.
27231: प्रीयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being pleased or propitiated. E. प्री to please, pass. v., शानच् aff.
27232: प्रु(ङ्)प्रुङ् r. 1st cl. (प्रवते) To go, to move.
27233: प्रुष r. 1st cl. (उ) प्रुषु (प्रोषति) To burn, to consume with fire. r. 9th cl. (प्रुष्णाति) To be unctuous or bland. 2 To sprinkle. 3 To fill. 4 To set free. 5 To be fond of or kind to.
27234: प्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Burnt. E. प्रुष to burn, aff. क्त.
27235: प्रुष्व m. (-ष्वः) 1 A season of the year, a period of two months. 2 The sun. f. (-ष्वा) A drop of water. E. प्रुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. क्वन्.
27236: प्रेक्षक m. (-कः) A spectator, a beholder, one of an audience. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, वुन् aff.
27237: प्रेक्षण n. (-णं) 1 The eye. 2 Any public show or spectacle, a sight. 3 A place where public exhibitions are held. nf. (-णं-णा) Seeing, viewing, looking at, regarding. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
27238: प्रेक्षणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Looking, who looks at. f. (-का) A woman fond of seeing shows. E. प्रेक्षण seeing, ठक् aff.
27239: प्रेक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Visible, apparent. 2 Looking or appearing like. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.; also with कन् added, प्रेक्षणीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं.)
27240: प्रेक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Looking at or on, beholding, regarding. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.
27241: प्रेक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being seen or looked at. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, pass. v., शानच् aff.
27242: प्रेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Intellect, understanding. 2 Dancing. 3 Seeing, viewing, observing. 4 Seeing a play or entertainment of dancing, &c. 5 The branch of a tree. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
27243: प्रेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld, looked at. E. प्र before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
27244: प्रेङ्खण n. (-णं) 1 Going, wandering. 2 Entering. 3 Twinging. 4 A minor drama in one act. E. प्र before इखि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
27245: प्रेङ्खत् mfn. (-ङ्खन्-ङ्खन्ती-ङ्खत्) 1 Touching, being in contact with. 2 Scattering, diffusing. 3 Shaking, moving. 4 Wandering, roving. E. प्र before इखि to go, शतृ aff.
27246: प्रेङ्खा f. (-ङ्खा) 1 A swing, a sort of hammock or swinging cot, either for travelling or diversion. 2 Wandering, roaming, travelling about 3 A horse's going or motion. 4 Dancing. E. प्र before इखि to go, aff. घञ्.
27247: प्रेङ्खित mfn. (-तः-ता-नं) 1 Shaken, moving, set in motion, swung, &c. Joined to, being in contact with. E. प्र before इखि to go, aff. क्त or प्रेङ्खा a swing, इतच् aff.
27248: प्रेङ्खोलन n. (-नं) A swing, a swing cot or hammock. E. प्रङ्खोल to swing or shake, nominal verb, and ल्युट् aff.
27249: प्रेङ्खोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agitated, shaken, swung, set in motion. E. प्रेङ्खोल nominal verb, to swing, aff. क्त.
27250: प्रेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, deceased. m. (-तः) 1 A ghost, a goblin a sprite, an evil being, especially animating the carcases of the dead. 2 The spirit before obsequial rites are performed. E. प्र before इत gone.
27251: प्रेतकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Funeral or obsequial rites. E. प्रेत, and कम्मन् act; also प्रेतकार्य्य, प्रेतक्रिया, &c.
27252: प्रेतकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Obsequial ceremonies, any usages observed in honour of the dead. E. प्रेत dead, कार्य्य practice.
27253: प्रेतकृत्य nf. (-त्यं-त्या) Obsequial rites. E. प्रेत, and कृत्य a ceremony; also प्रेतकर्म्म, &c.
27254: प्रेतगृह n. (-हं) A cemetery, a burying ground. E. प्रेत a sprite, and गृह abode.
27255: प्रेतत्व n. (-त्वं) The character or state of a departed spirit. E. प्रेत, and त्व aff.
27256: प्रेतधूम n. (-मं) The smoke of a funeral pile. E. प्रेत, and धूम smoke.
27257: प्रेतनदी f. (-दी) The river of hell. E. प्रेत a goblin, and नदी a river.
27258: प्रेतनर m. (-रः) A ghost, a corpse. E. प्रेत, and नर a man.
27259: प्रेतनिर्हारक m. (-कः) 1 A man employed to carry forth dead bodies. 2 A kinsman who does so. E. प्रेत, निर् out, हृ to take, ण्वुल् aff.
27260: प्रेतपक्ष n. (-क्षं) The dark half of the month. E. प्रेत, and पक्ष a fortnight.
27261: प्रेतपटह m. (-हः) A drum played at the death of a person. E. प्रेत dead, and पटह a drum.
27262: प्रेतपति m. (-तिः) YAMA, ruler of the dead. E. प्रेत dead, and पति master.
27263: प्रेतपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel used in obsequial presentations. E. प्रेत, and पात्र a vessel.
27264: प्रेतराज m. (-जः) YAMA. E. प्रेत, and राज king.
27265: प्रेतलोक m. (-कः) The region of disembodied spirits, in which they remain for one year, or until the obsequial rites are completed. E. प्रेत, and लोक region.
27266: प्रेतवन n. (-नं) A burying ground, a cemetery, a place where bodies are burnt or buried. E. प्रेत a sprite, and वन a wood.
27267: प्रेतवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed by a devil or fiend. E. प्रेत a sprite, and वाहित borne, actuated.
27268: प्रेतशुद्धि m. (-द्धिः) Purification after the death of a kinsman. E. प्रेत, and शुद्धि purifying.
27269: प्रेतहार m. (-रः) One who carries a corpse, a near kinsman. E. प्रेत, and हार who takes.
27270: प्रेतान्न n. (-न्नं) Food offered to the manes, or distributed on a person's death. E. प्रेत, and अन्न food.
27271: प्रेतोद्देश m. (-शः) An offering to the manes. E. प्रेत, and उद्देश object.
27272: प्रेत्य ind. 1 In the next world. 2 Having died. E. प्रेत dead, and यत् aff,; or प्र before इ to go, ल्यप् aff.
27273: प्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous of obtaining. E. प्र before अप to obtain, desid. v., उ aff.
27274: प्रेमन् mn. (-मा-म) 1 Affection, kindness, tender regard. 2 Pleasure, sport, pastime, joy. m. (-मा) 1 INDRA. 2 Air. E. प्र for प्रिय loved, इमनिच् aff.
27275: प्रेमपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Affectionate, loving, constant. E. प्रेम, and पर attached to.
27276: प्रेमपातन n. (-नं) Rheum, tears. E. प्रेम tenderness, पातन falling.
27277: प्रेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Dearest, most beloved, very dear. f. (-सी) A wife, a mistress. E. प्रिय dear, and ईयसुम् aff.
27278: प्रेयोपत्य m. (-त्यः) A heron. E. प्रेयस् dear, and अपत्य offspring.
27279: प्रेरण n. (-णं) 1 Sending, directing. 2 Ordering, commanding. 3 Passion, operation of the organs of sense. 4 The sense of the causal verb. E. प्र before ईर to go, aff. ल्युट्.
27280: प्रेरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, directed, dispatched. 2 Ordered. E. प्र before ईर to go, aff. क्त.
27281: प्रेत्यभाव m. (-वः) Being born again after dying. E. प्रेत्य, भाव nature.
27282: प्रेन्वन n. (-नं) 1 Pervading, spreading. 2 Satisfying. E. प्र before ईर to go, इवि to pervade, &c. ल्युट् aff.
27283: प्रेर्त्वन् m. (-र्त्वा) The ocean. f. (-री) A river. E. प्र before ईर to go, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिप्, and तुट् aug.
27284: प्रेष (ऋ) प्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (प्रेषते) To go, to move or approach.
27285: प्रेष m. (-षः) 1 Sending, directing, dispatching. 2 Pain, affliction. E. प्र before इष to go or send, aff. अच्.
27286: प्रेषण n. (-णं) Sending, dispatching. E. प्र before इष to go, aff. ल्युट्.
27287: प्रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sent, directed. E. प्र before इष to go, aff. क्त.
27288: प्रेषितवत् mfn. (-वान-वती-वत्) Sent, having sent. E. प्र before इष to go, क्तवतु aff.
27289: प्रेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Most or very dear. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 A wife. 2 The leg. E. प्रिय dear, aff. इष्ठन्, form irr.
27290: प्रेष्य m. (-ष्यः) A servant. E. प्र before इष to go, or प्रेष to send, aff. ण्यत्; also प्रैष्य.
27291: प्रैष m. (-षः) 1 Sorrow, distress, affliction. 2 Pain, suffering. 3 Sending, directing. 4 Phrenzy, intoxication, insanity. E. प्र before इष to go, aff. घञ्; also प्रेष.
27292: प्रैष्य m. (-ष्यः) A servant, a slave. n. (-ष्यं) Service, servitude. E. प्र before इष to go, and ण्यत् aff.
27293: प्रोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said, declared. E. प्र before वच to speak, aff. क्त.
27294: प्रोक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having or had said, was saying. E. प्र before वच to speak, क्तवतु aff.
27295: प्रोक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Killing animals in sacrifice, immolation of victims. 2 Killing, slaughter. 3 Sprinkling with water, &c. 4 A text to be repeated when animals are offered. E. प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. ल्युट्.
27296: प्रोक्षणीपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel for sprinkling water, &c. E. प्रोक्षण, and पात्र a vessel, च्चि aff.
27297: प्रोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Killed, slaughtered. 3 Offered in sacrifice. E. प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. क्त.
27298: प्रोच्छलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्तो-लत्) Flowing, issuing, coming out or up. E. प्र and उत् before शल to go, aff. क्त.
27299: प्रोच्छून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Swelled, swoln. E. प्र, and उच्छून swelled.
27300: प्रोज्जासन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. प्र and उत् before जस to hurt or kill, aff. ल्युट्.
27301: प्रोज्झन n. (-नं) Leaving, quitting, letting go. E. प्र before उञ्झ to leave, aff. ल्युट्.
27302: प्रोज्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, shunned, avoided. E. प्र before उज्झित left.
27304: प्रोत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sewn or stitched. 2 Tied, strung. 3 Set, inlaid. 4 Impaled. 5 Joined, connected. n. (-तं) Cloth, clothes. E. प्र before वे to weave or sew, aff. क्त.
27305: प्रोतोत्सादन n. (-नं) A parasol, a Catta, an umbrella. E. प्रोत cloth, उत् over, सादन a house.
27306: प्रोत्फल m. (-लः) A sort of palm tree. E. प्र and उत् above, फल fruit.
27307: प्रोत्सादन n. (-नं) Contriving, device. E. प्र and उत् before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
27308: प्रोत्सारण n. (-णं) Clearing away, getting rid of, expelling. E. प्र and उत् before सृ to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
27309: प्रोत्सारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Relinquished, left, given up. 2 Got rid of, ejected, expelled. E. प्र and उत् before सृ to go, causal v., क्त aff.
27310: प्रोत्साह m. (-हः) 1 Effort, exertion. 2 Stimulus, incitement. E. प्र before उत्साह effort.
27311: प्रोत्साहक m. (-कः) The instigator or adviser of any act, or, in law, of any crime. E. प्रोत्साह with कन् added.
27312: प्रोत्साहन n. (-नं) Instigating, exciting, stimulating. E. प्र and उत् before सह to bear, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
27313: प्रोत्साहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Incited, instigated, stimulated, encouraged. E. प्र and उत् before सह to bear, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
27314: प्रोथ (ऋ) प्रोथृ r. 1st cl. (प्रोथति-ते) 1 To be able, adequate or competent. 2 To be complete or ample. 3 To destroy, to subdue or overpower.
27315: प्रोथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Travelling, wayfaring, a traveller. 2 Notorious, famous. 3 Placed, fixed. mn. (-थः-थं) The nose of a horse or the tip of it. m. (-थः) 1 The loins or hip. 2 Old clothes. 3 The embryo or fœtus. E. प्रु to go, Uṇādi aff. थक्.
27316: प्रोद्घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Resonant, sounding well. 2 Making a loud noise. E. प्र, and उद्वुष्ट sounded.
27317: प्रोद्घोषण n. (णं) Sounding or crying aloud. E. प्र and उत् before घुष to cry, ल्युट् aff.
27318: प्रोद्भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Breaking forth, (as seeds, &c.) E. प्र, and उद्भिन्न put forth.
27319: प्रोन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Towering, very lofty. E. प्र, and उन्नत high.
27320: प्रोम्भन n. (-नं) Filling. E. प्र before उम्भ to fill, ल्युट् aff.
27321: प्रोम्भित mfn. (-त-ता-तं) Filled. E. प्र before उम्भ to fill, क्त aff.
27322: प्रोर्णुनविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to cover. E. प्र before ऊर्णु to cover, desid. v., उ aff. and the vowel changed.
27323: प्रोर्णुनूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to cover. E. प्र before ऊर्णु to cover, desid. v., उ aff. the augment इ omitted.
27324: प्रोल्लाघित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Recovered from sickness, convalescent. 2 Strong, robust. E. प्र and उत् before लाघ to be able, क्त aff.
27325: प्रोल्लिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्) Marking, making lines, scratches, &c. E. प्र and उल्लिख to mark, शतृ aff.
27326: प्रोल्लेखन n. (-नं) Scratching, marking, drawing lines or marks. E. प्र and उत् before लिख to write, ल्युट् aff.
27327: प्रोष m. (-षः) Burning. E. प्रुष to burn, aff. घञ्.
27328: प्रोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abroad, absent, away from home, sojourning in another country. E. प्र before वस to dwell, aff. क्त.
27329: प्रोषितभर्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband is absent. E. प्रोषित abroad, भर्तृ a husband, aff. कन् and टाप्.
27330: प्रोषितमरण n. (-णं) Dying in a foreign country. E. प्रोषित absent, and मरण dying.
27331: प्रोषितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Strange, a stranger, a sojourner. E. प्र before वस to dwell, क्तवतु aff.
27332: प्रोष्ठ mf. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी) A sort of carp, (Cyprinus Pausius, HAM.) m. (ष्ठः) An ox. E. प्र before उष to burn, aff. थन्.
27333: प्रोष्ठपदा f. (-दा) One of the constellations, the twenty-sixth or twenty-seventh, containing stars in the wing of Pegasus: see माद्रपदा. E. प्रोष्ठ here said to mean an ox, and पद a foot.
27334: प्रोष्ठपाद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Born under the sign Proṣṭha padā. E. प्रोष्ठपद, and अण् aff. in this sense; in any other, the form is प्रोष्ठपद.
27335: प्रोह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Skilful, clever. 2 Logical, reasoning, a reasoner, a disputant. m. (-हः) 1 An elephant's foot. 2 A joint, a knot. 3 The ancle of an elephant. E. प्र before वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क.
27336: प्रोहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be reasoned or argued. E. प्र before ऊह to reason, अनीयर् aff.
27337: प्रौढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Full-grown. 2 Confident, bold, arrogant. 3 Impudent. 4 Full, (as the moon.) 5 Thick, heavy, (darkness, &c.). 5 Forward, (as the hand to seize any thing.) 7 Raised, lifted up. 8 Controverted. 9 Old. 10 Married. f. (-ढा) 1 A woman from thirty years of age to fifty-five. 2 A description of the Nāyikā or mistress, a woman whose feelings are violent or impetuous, or one who is not in any awe of her lover or husband. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. क्त.
27338: प्रौढि f. (ढिः) 1 Enterprise, zeal, confident or audacious exertion. 2 Investigation, controversy, discussion. E. प्र before वह to bear, aff. क्तिन्.
27339: प्रौढपाद m. (-दः) One who sits with his feet upon a seat. E. प्रौढ raised, and पाद the foot.
27341: प्रौर्णुवितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Extending over, covering. E. प्र and ऊर्णु to cover, तृच् aff.
27342: प्रौष्ठपद m. (-दः) The month Bhādra, (August-September.) f. (-दी) Full moon in Bhādra. E. प्रोष्ठपदा the sign, and अण् aff.; when the moon is near the wing of Pegasus.
27344: प्लक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 Waved leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectoria.) 2 Another tree, (Hibiscus populneoides.) 3 The holy fig, (Ficus religiosa.) 4 One of the seven Dvīpas or continents, into which the world is divided. 5 A private or back door. E. प्लुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. स, and अ substituted for the penultimate vowel.
27345: प्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Who or what goes by leaps or jumps, leaping, jumping, a tumbler. m. (-वः) 1 Jumping, leaping, plunging, going by leaps or plunges. 2 Swimming, floating, diving. 3 A raft, a float. 4 A frog. 5 A monkey. 6 A sheep. 7 A diver, or bird so called, (Pelicanus fusicollis.) 8 A sort of duck. 9 A man of a low or degraded tribe. 10 Waved-leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectoria.) 11 The continuous protracted accent, the lengthened sound of vowels in poetry or the Vedas. 12 Protracting a sentence through several stanzas. 13 A declivity or shelving ground. 14 A piece of water. 15 A sort of basket or snare of basket work for catching fish. 16 An enemy. 17 Sending, directing. n. (-वं) 1 A sort of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 2 Fragrant grass in general, or another sort. E. प्लु to go, aff. अप्.
27346: प्लवक m. (-कः) 1 A tumbler, a dancer, a man who walks on the edge of a sword, a rope-dancer, &c. 2 An outcast. E. प्लव a tumbler, &c. and कन् aff.
27347: प्लवग m. (-गः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 A frog. 3 The charioteer of the sun. 4 A sort of bird, the diver. E. प्लव leaping, and ग who goes, from गम with ड aff.
27348: प्लवगति m. (-तिः) 1 A frog. 2 Going by leaps and jumps. E. प्लव leaping, and गति going.
27349: प्लवङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A monkey. 2 A deer. E. प्लव leaping, गम to go, aff. खच् with the power of ड, whence the nasal is inserted, and final syllable rejected; also प्लव, प्लवग, and प्लवङ्गम.
27350: प्लवङ्गम m. (-मः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 A frog. E. प्लव leaping, गम to go, aff. खच्.
27351: प्लवन n. (-नं) 1 Jumping, leaping. 2 A deluge, an inundation. 3 Swimming, plunging into. E. प्लु to go, ल्युट् aff.
27352: प्लवमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Bounding, springing, leaping. 2 Swimming. E. प्लु to go, शानच् aff.
27353: प्लवाका f. (-का) A boat, a raft. E. प्लव tossing, अक what goes, टाप् fem. aff.; also प्लविका, from प्लु with वुन् aff. and fem. form.
27354: प्लाक्ष m. (क्षं) The fruit of the Hibiscus populneoides. E. प्लक्ष, and अण् added.
27355: प्लाव m. (-वः) 1 Submersion. 2 Filling a vessel till it runs over. E. प्लु to go, causal v., घञ् aff.; also with ल्युट, प्लावनं.
27356: प्लाव्य mfn. (व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be jumped, leaped, &c. 2 To be submerged or inundated. E. प्लु to go, ण्यत् aff.
27357: प्लाविन् m. (-वी) A bird. E. प्लु to go, aff. घिनुण्.
27358: प्लिह r. 1st cl. (प्लेहते) To go, to move or approach.
27359: प्लिहन् m. (-हा) The spleen: see प्लीहन्.
27360: प्लिहा f. (-हा) The spleen: see प्लीहन्.
27362: प्लीहघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A medicinal plant, (Andersonia rohitaka, Rox.) E. प्लीह the spleen, (the disease, &c.) घ्न what removes.
27363: प्लीहन् m. (-हा) The spleen; the organ or the disease of it, as in English; in the latter sense, however, it is equally applied to the enlargement of the mesenteric glands, &c. E. प्लिह to increase, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, and the vowel made long; otherwise being प्लिहन्; and with क and टाप् affs., and the vowel long or short प्लिहा or प्लीहा.
27364: प्लीहशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A medical plant, commonly Rohera or Rohiṇī, (Andersonia rohitaka, Rox.) E. प्लीह for प्लीहन् the spleen, (the disease,) and शत्रु enemy; also प्लीहाशत्रु.
27365: प्लीहारि m. (-रिः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. प्लीहा the spleen, and अरि enemy.
27366: प्लु(ङ)प्लुङ् r. 1st cl. (प्लवते) 1 To go, to approach. 2 To go by leaps, to jump, &c. With उत् prefixed, To leap up. With वि, To plunge in, to be submerged or inundated.
27367: प्लुक्षि m. (-क्षिः) Fire or its deity. E. प्लुष to burn, Uṇādi aff. सि
27368: प्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Jumped, leaped, gone by leap or jump, &c. 2 Thrown or tossed up. m. (-तः) 1 Bounding, capering, one of a horse's paces. 3 Leaping, jumping, tumbling. mn. (-तः-तं) The third sound given to vowels; the protracted or continuous sound, being three times the length of the short vowel, and occupying three moments in its utterance. E. प्लु to go by leaps, aff. क्त.
27369: प्लुष r. 1st cl. (उ) प्लुषु (प्लोषति) r. 4th cl. (ऌ) प्लुषॢ (प्लुष्यति) To burn r. 9th cl. (प्लुष्णाति) 1 To be unctuous. 2 To sprinkle. 3 To fill. 4 To set free. 5 To be fond of or kind to.
27370: प्लुष m. (-षः) Burning, combustion. E. प्लुष to burn, aff. क.
27371: प्लुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Burnt. E. प्लुष to burn, aff. क्त.
27372: प्लुस(इर)प्लुसिर r. 4th cl. (प्लुस्यति) 1 To burn. 2 To share.
27373: प्लेव(ऋ)प्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (प्लेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
27374: प्लोष m. (-षः) Burning, combustion. E. प्लुष to burn, aff. घञ्.
27376: प्सा f. (प्सा) Eating. E. प्सा to eat, aff. क्विप्.
27377: प्सात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. प्सा to eat, aff. क्त.
27378: प्सान n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Food. E. प्सा to eat, aff. ल्युट्. फ
27379: फ The twenty-second consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, the aspirate of the preceding letter, and expressed by Ph.
27380: फ m. (फः) 1 Increasing, swelling, enlarging, expanding. 2 Performance of a mystical rite, by which KUVERA'S attendants are propitiated. 3 A high wind, a gale. 4 Wind expelled in yawning. 5 Fruitfulness, fertility. 6 An augmentor or increaser. nf. (फं फा) Unprofitable or idle speech. n. (फं) 1 Angry speech. 2 Bursting with some little noise, as air bubbles, boiling water, &c.; bubbling, boiling. f. (फा) Distress, anxiety. E. फल to bear fruit, or स्फाय to swell, aff. ड; in the latter case, the initial is rejected.
27381: फक्क r. 1st cl. (फक्कति) 1 To creep, to move slowly or sluggishly. 2 To behave ill, to practise ill or improper conduct.
27382: फक्किका f. (-का) 1 A position, an assertion or argument, to be proved or maintained. 2 Logical exposition or elucidation. 3 A sophism. 4 A trick. 5 Illusion. 6 Fraud. E. फक्क to move slowly, aff. किकन्.
27383: फञ्जिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 2 A species of Hedysarum, (H. alhagi.) E. भञ्ज to break, (disease,) aff. ण्वुल्, and the radical initial changed to फ.
27384: फञ्जिपुत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. फञ्जि as above, and पुत्रिका infant.
27385: फट mfn. subst. (-टः-टा-टं) The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra de capello. mf. (-टः-टा) 1 A tooth. 2 A cheat. E. स्फुट to burst or expand, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्, deriv. irr.
27386: फट् ind. Exclamation of no meaning, forming part of a Mantra or incantation. E. स्फुट to burst, aff. क्विप् and the deriv. irr.
27388: फण r. 1st cl. (फणति) 1 To go. 2 To produce easily or readily 3 To be unoily. Causal form, (फाणयति) 1 To dilute. 2 To shine. (फणयति) To cause to go.
27389: फण mfn. subst. (-णः-णा-णं) The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra de capello, &c. E. फण to go, aff. अच्.
27390: फणकर m. (-रः) A snake, especially the Cobra de capello, or COLUBER naja. E. फण the hood, and कर who makes; also फणाकर.
27391: फणधर m. (-रः) A snake. E. फण the hood, and धर who has; also फणाधर.
27392: फणभृत् m. (-भृत्) A snake. E. फण a hood, and भृत् who possesses.
27393: फणमणि m. (-णिः) A jewel supposed to be in the head of a snake. E. फण, and मणि a gem.
27394: फणवत् m. (-वान्) A snake. E. फणा a hood, and मतुप् possessive aff.
27395: फणाकर m. (-रः) A snake: see फणकर.
27396: फणाधर m. (-रः) A snake: see फणधर.
27397: फणाभर m. (-रः) A snake. E. फण the hood expanded, भृ to possess, aff. अप्.
27398: फणावत् m. (-वान्) A snake: see फणवत्.
27399: फणिकेशर m. (-रः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. फणिन् a snake, and केशर filaments.
27400: फणिखेल m. (-लः) A quail. E. फणि a snake, and खेल who plays.
27401: फणिज्झक m. (-कः) A plant, also Marüa. f. (-का) A plant, commonly Rāmadūtī, apparently a sort of basil with small leaves. E. फणि for फणी a snake, and उज्झ to abandon, aff. वुन्, deriv. irr.
27402: फणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Diluted. E. फण to go, क्त aff.
27403: फणितल्पग m. (-गः) VIṢṆU. E. फणि a snake, तल्प a bed, and ग who goes.
27404: फणिन् m. (-णी) A snake. E. फण a hood, and इनि aff.
27405: फणिप्रिय m. (-यः) Air, wind. E. फणि for फणी a snake, and प्रिय fond of.
27406: फणीश्वर m. (-रः) The great serpent ANANTA. E. फणि a snake, and ईश्वर sovereign; also फणीन्द्र, &c.
27407: फण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The belly. E. फण to go, Uṇādi aff. ड.
27408: फत्कारिन् m. (-री) A bird. E. फत् imitative sound, and कारिन who makes.
27409: फर n. (-रं) A shield. E. र substituted for ल; see फल.
27411: फर्फरीक m. (-कं) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. n. (-कं) Sweetness. E. स्फुर to expand, Uṇādi aff. ईकन्, and the form irr.
27412: फल r. 1st cl. (फलति) 1 To produce or bear fruit. 2 To make fruitful, to fructify. 3 To go. (ञि, आ;) ञिफला r. 1st cl. (फलति) To divide, to cleave or split.
27413: फल n. (-लं) 1 The fruit of any plant, fruit in general. 2 Fruit (metaphorically), result, produce, consequence. 3 Prosperity, flourishing, thriving. 4 Gain, profit, acquisition. 5 Recompense, reward. 6 A shield. 7 The blade of a sword or knife, the head of an arrow, &c. 8 A sort of fragrant berry and drug, commonly Kakoli. 9 A nutmeg. 10 The three myrobalans collectively. 11 The menstrual discharge. 12 Gift, giving. 13 A ploughshare. 14 The quotient of a sum, (in arithmetic.) 15 The area of a circle, &c. 16 An equation. 17 (In astronomy,)  The anomalistic equation of a planet. f. (-ली) A medicinal plant, commonly Priyangu. m. (-लः) A plant, (Echites antidysenterica, Rox.:) see कुटज. E. फल to bear or produce fruit, aff. अच्.
27414: फलक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A shield. 2 A bench. 3 A plank. 4 A layer. m. (-कः) 1 A bone, the os frontis, or bone of the forehead. 2 A leaf or page for writing on. 3 A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) n. (-कं) The buttocks. E. कन् added to the preceding, or फल to split or divide, aff. वुन्.
27415: फलकपाणि m. (-णिः) A soldier armed with a shield. E. फलक, and पाणि the hand.
27416: फलकामना f. (-ना) Desire of any consequence. E. फल, and कामना desiring.
27417: फलकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Having, or being armed with a shield, &c. m. (-की) A sort of fish, commonly Phalāi. E. फलक as above, and इनि aff.
27418: फलकेशर m. (-रः) The cocoanut tree. E. फल the fruit, and केशर hair, covered with a fibrous coat like hair.
27419: फलकोषक m. (-कः) The scrotum or testicles. E. फल fruit, कोष sheath, and कन् aff. of comparison.
27420: फलकृष्ण m. (-ष्णः) A small fruit, (Carissa carandas.) E. फल fruit, and कृष्ण black.
27421: फलग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Fruitful, bearing fruit in due season. E. फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. इन्, also फलेग्रहि.
27422: फलग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A tree. E. फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. णिनि.
27423: फलखण्डन n. (-नं) Disappointing. E. फल, and खण्डन destroying.
27424: फलचमस n. (-सं) The bark of the Indian fig, ground and eaten with curds, by way of penance.
27425: फलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Yielding fruit, profit, &c. E. फल to bear fruit, शतृ aff.
27426: फलत्रय n. (-यं) 1 Three sorts of fruit collectively, as the fruit of the vine, the Parush, and the Gmelina arborea. 2 The three myrobalans. E. फल fruit, and त्रय three.
27427: फलत्रिक n. (-कं) The three myrobalans collectively. E. फल fruit, and त्रिक three-fold.
27428: फलद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Yielding or bearing fruit, results, &c. m. (-दः) A tree. E. फल fruit, and द what gives; also फलदातृ, फलदायिन्, &c.
27429: फलन n. (-नं) Fructifying, bearing fruit, producing consequences. E. फल, and ल्युट् aff.
27430: फलनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Cessation of consequences. E. फल, and निवृत्ति stop.
27431: फलनिर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Final consequence or result. E. फल, and निर्वृत्ति completion.
27432: फलनिष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Bearing fruit. 2 Yielding profit or desired results. E. फल, and निष्पत्ति putting forth.
27433: फलपाक m. (-कः) 1 The ripening of fruit. 2 The fulness of consequences. 3 The Caronda. E. फल fruit, and पाक ripening.
27434: फलपाकान्ता f. (-न्ता) An annual plant. E. फल fruit, पाक ripening or ripeness, and अन्त end; dying after bearing fruit.
27435: फलपातन n. (-नं) Knocking down or gathering fruit. E. फल, and पातन felling.
27436: फलपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A sort of esculent root or bulb. E. फल fruit, and पुच्छ a tail.
27437: फलपूर m. (-रः) Common citron, (Citrus medica.) E. फल fruit, and पूर to fill, aff. क.
27438: फलपूरक m. (-कः) Common citron. E. कन् added to the last.
27439: फलप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Yielding fruit, productive, yielding a reward, &c. E. फल, and प्रद what gives.
27440: फलप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Connected with or producing consequences, yielding fruit, &c. E. फल, and प्रयुक्त applied.
27441: फलप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining the desired result or fruit. E. फल, and प्राप्ति acquiring.
27442: फलभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Having or receiving fruit, consequence, &c. E. फल, and भाज् who shares.
27443: फलभूमि f. (-मिः) Any region not included in the known continent, as heaven, hell, &c. E. फल fruit, (of actions,) and भूमि earth.
27444: फलभोग m. (गः) 1 Receipt or enjoyment of consequences. 2 Possession of rent or profit, usufruct. E. फल, and भोग enjoyment.
27445: फलभोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Who receives the profits, consequences, &c. E. फल, and भोगिन् who enjoys.
27446: फलमुद्गरिका f. (-का) A sort of date. E. फल fruit, and मुद्गर a mal- let, aff. कन् in the fem. form.
27447: फलवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Bearing fruit. 2 Yielding results, or consequences. E. फल fruit, and मतुप् poss. aff.
27448: फलशाडव m. (-वः) The pomegranate. E. फल fruit, शाड to extol, aff. अव.
27449: फलशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Bearing or yielding fruit. E. फल, and शालिन् having.
27450: फलश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The mango. E. फल fruit, and श्रेष्ठ best.
27451: फलस m. (-सः) The jack or bread fruit. E. फल fruit, सह to be able, aff. डः see पनस.
27452: फलसम्पद् f. (-पद् or पत्) Prosperity, success. E. फल, and सम्पत् abundance.
27453: फलसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in or by fruit. E. फल, and सम्भव born; also फलसम्भू.
27454: फलसाधन n. (-नं) Means or instrument of success. E. फल, and साघन means.
27455: फलसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Realising an object, reaping the fruit of any act. E. फल, and सिद्धि perfection.
27456: फलहानि f. (-निः) Loss of fruit or profit. E. फल, and हानि abandonment.
27457: फलानुसरण n. (-णं) Rate or aggregate of profits. E. फल, and अनुसरण conformity.
27458: फलाकाङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) Hope or expectation of favourable consequences. E. फल, and आकाङ्क्षा desire.
27459: फलादन m. (-नः) A parrot. E. फल fruit, अदन eating.
27460: फलाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree, commonly Khirani, (Mimusops Kauki.) E. फल fruit, अध्यक्ष superintendant.
27461: फलान्त m. (-न्तः) A bambu. E. फल fruit or blossom, अन्त end.
27462: फलापेक्षा f. (-क्षा) Regard to or expectation of consequences. E. फल, and अपेक्षा expectation.
27463: फलापेत mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Unproductive, unfertile. E. फल, and अपेत deprived.
27465: फलाशन m. (-नः) A parrot. E. फल fruit, and अशन food.
27466: फलाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Living on fruits. E. फल, and अशिन् who eats.
27467: फलासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Doing any thing for the sake of reward. 2 Fond of or seeking to pluck fruit. E. फल, and आसक्त attached to.
27468: फलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fruitful, bearing fruit. 2 Successful, yielding a result. m. (-तः) A tree. E. फल fruit, and इतच् aff.
27469: फलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Bearing fruit, fruitful. 2 Productive of consequences. m. (-ली) 1 A sort of fish, commonly Phalāi (Mystus kapirat.) 2 A tree, especially in fruit. f. (-नी) 1 A medicinal plant, commonly Priyangu. 2 A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.) 3 A flower, (Celosia cristata.) E. फल fruit, and इनि aff.
27470: फलाभोग m. (गः) Non-enjoyment of profits, &c. E. फल, and अभोग non-use.
27471: फलूष m. (-षः) A sort of creeper. E. फल fruit, and ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.
27472: फलेग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Bearing fruit in season, fruitful. E. फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. इन्; ए substituted irregularly for the final of फल; also फलग्रहि and फलेग्राहिन्.
27473: फलेग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Bearing fruit in due season. E. as above, णिनि aff.
27474: फलेरुहा f. (-हा) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. फल fruit, in the seventh case, रुह to grow, aff. क.
27475: फलोच्चय m. (-यः) 1 Collecting of fruits. 2 A collection of fruits. E. फल, and उच्चय abundance.
27476: फलोत्तमा f. (-मा) 1 A small sort of rope. 2 The benefit arising from sacred study. E. फल fruit, उत्तभ best.
27477: फलोपेत mfn. (त-ता-तं) Having or yielding fruit, &c. E. फल, and उपेत possessing.
27478: फलोत्पति m. (-तिः) The mango. E. फल fruit, उत् over, पति ruler.
27479: फलोदय m. (-यः) 1 Gain, profit. 2 Heaven, paradise. 3 Joy, happiness. 4 Consequence, result. E. फल fruit, gain, &c. उदय rising.
27480: फलोद्देश m. (-शः) Regard to results. E. फल, and उद्देश pointing out.
27482: फल्क m. (-ल्कः) An expanded or extended body. E. फल to separate, Uṇādi aff. क.
27483: फल्गु mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) 1 Pithless, sapless. 2 Vain, unprofitable, unmeaning, useless. 3 Weak, feeble. f. (-ल्गुः) 1 The oppositeleaved fig tree, (F. oppositi-folia, Rox.) 2 The name of a river which is said to run underneath Gaya. 3 Falsehood, false or lying speech. 4 A red powder, usually of the root of wild ginger, coloured with sappan wood, and thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the Holi festival. 5 The spring season. E. फल to bear fruit, Uṇādi aff. गुक्
27484: फल्गुन m. (-नः) 1 A name of ARJUNA. 2 The month Phālguna. f. (-नी) The constellation Phalgunī. E. फल to bear fruit, Uṇādi aff. उनन् and गुक् aug.: see फाल्गुन.
27485: फल्गुनाल m. (-लः) The month Phālguna. E. फल्गु, and अल equal to, the same.
27486: फल्य n. (-ल्यं) A bud, a flower. E. फल fruit, यत् aff.
27487: फल्लकिन् m. (-की) A fish, caught in ponds, commonly Phalāi, (Mystus kapirat.)
27488: फाट् ind. An interjection of calling.
27489: फाणि f. (-णिः) 1 Unrefined sugar, molasses. 2 Flour or meal mixed with curds. E. स्फायी to swell, Uṇādi aff. नि, deriv. irr.
27490: फाणित n. (-तं) Raw sugar, the inspissated juice of the sugar cane. E. फण to go, causal form, aff. क्त.
27491: फाण्ट mfn. (-ण्टः-ण्टा-ण्टं) Readily prepared, made by an extemporaneous easy process, (decoction, &c.). n. (-ण्टं) 1 Diluted decoction, decoction easily prepared. 2 The first particles of butter that are produced by churning. E. फण to prepare easily, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
27492: फाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Made of cotton, (vesture.) m. (-लः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of BALARĀMA. n. (-लं) The share of a plough. E. फल to divide, in the causal form, aff. अच्; or फल fruit, and अण् aff.
27493: फालकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Furrowed, ploughed. n. (-ष्टं) A ploughed field. E. फाल, and कृष्ट furrowed.
27494: फाल्गुन m. (-नः) 1 A name of ARJUNA. 2 A sort of tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) 3 A month, commonly called by the name Phālguna, (February-March.) f. (-नी) 1 Day of full moon on the month Phālguna, on which the Holī or great vernal festival of the Hindus is celebrated. 2 A name common to the eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithets first and last, or पूर्व्व and उन्तरः see पूर्व्वफाल्गुनी, &c.
27495: फाल्गुनानुज m. (-जः) Spring. E. फाल्गुन the month, अनु according, and ज born.
27496: फाल्गुनिक m. (-कः) The month Phālguna. E. फाल्गुनी day of full moon in this month, and ठक् aff.
27497: फि m. (फिः) Anger, passion. E. फल to separate, aff. डि.
27498: फिङ्गक m. (-कः) The fork-tailed shrike. E. फिङ्ग imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड.
27500: फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) The hood or expanded neck of a snake. E. स्फुट to swell, aff. क, deriv. irr.
27501: फुत् ind. 1 Expression of disregard or contempt, (Phoo, hoot.) 2 Imitative sound, implying the bubbling or boiling of water &c. or of blowing into any liquid. E. स्फुर to swell, aff. क्विप्, स rejected, and तुक् added, form irr.
27502: फुत्कर m. (-रः) Fire. E. फुत् boiling, and कर who makes.
27503: फुत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Arrogant, contemptuous, disdainful. m. (-रः) 1 The sound of bubbling, &c. 2 Blowing or breathing into, (as to cool it.) E. फुत् expression of contempt, and कार who makes.
27504: फुत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown up, (as a bubble.) 2 Blown into, cooled by blowing into it. E. फुत्, and कृत made.
27505: फुप्फुस m. (-सः) The lungs: see पुप्फुस.
27506: फुल्ल r. 1st. cl. (फुल्लति) To blow or blossom, to bud or flower.
27507: फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Blown, opened, expanded as a flower. 2 Opened (as the eyes with pleasure, &c.), smiling, gay. E. फुल्ल to blow, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
27508: फुल्लदामन् n. (-म) A species of the Atidhṛti metre.
27509: फुल्लनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Full or large-eyed. 2 Smiling, looking happy. E. फुल्ल, and नयन the eye; also similar compounds, as फुल्लनेत्र, फुल्लदृष्टि, &c.
27510: फुल्लफाल m. (-लः) Winnowing corn. E. फुल्ल blown, and फाल for स्फाल् spreading.
27512: फुल्ललोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Full-eyed. 2 Looking pleased or happy. n. (-नं) A large full eye. m. (-नः) A species of the antelope. E. फुल्ल full, expanded, and लोचन the eye.
27513: फुल्लवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Blossoming, blowing. E. फुल्ल to blow, क्तवतु aff.
27514: फुल्लवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking pleased or happy. E. फुल्ल, and वदन the face.
27515: फुल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) Blowing, blossoming. E. फुल्ल to blow, aff. इन्.
27516: फुल्लिति f. (तिः) Flowering, blossoming. E. फुल्ल to blow, क्तिन् aff.
27517: फूत् ind. Imitative sound of bubbling, sobbing, &c.: see फुत्.
27518: फूत्कार m. (-रः) 1 Bubbling. 2 Sobbing. 3 Blowing or breathing into any liquid. E. फूत्, and कार making.
27519: फूत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bubbled, bubbling, made to sound so. 2 Blown or breathed into, (a liquid.) 3 Sounded as in sobbing. E. फूत्, and कृत made.
27520: फेन m. (-नः) 1 Froth, foam. 2 Cuttle fish bone, supposed to be the indurated foam of the sea. 3 Vapour. E. स्फायी to swell, नक् Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.
27521: फेनक m. (-कः) Cuttle fish bone. f. (-का) 1 Rice, ground and boiled with water. 2 The soap berry. E. फेन froth, and कन् aff.
27522: फेनता f. (-ता) Frothiness, vapour. E. तल् added to फेन; also with त्व, फेनत्वं.
27523: फेनल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy. E. फेन froth, अलच् poss. aff.; also with इलच् similar aff. फेनिल, and with the usual possessive मतुप्, फेनवत्.
27524: फेनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Frothy, foaming, bubbling. E. फेन froth, and मतुप् aff.
27525: फेनवाहिन् m. (-ही) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. फेन foam, वह to bear, aff. णिनि; INDRA having used the foam of the sea for his thunderbolt, to kill the demon VṚTRĀSURA.
27526: फेनाग्र n. (-ग्रं) A bubble. E. फेन foam, and अग्र top.
27527: फेनायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Foaming, frothing. E. फेन nom. verb to foam, शानच् aff.
27528: फेनाशनि m. (-निः) A name of INDRA. E. फेन foam, and अशनि the thunderbolt: see फेनवाहिन्.
27529: फेनिका f. (-का) Froth arising from treacle. E. फेन foam, कन् added, fem. form.
27530: फेनिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy. m. (-लः) The soap plant, (Sapindus detergens, Rox.) n. (-लं) 1 The fruit of the jujube. 2 The fruit of the Vangueria spinosa. E. फेन froth or foam, इलच् aff.
27532: फेरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A jackal. E. फे imitative sound, रम to sport, aff. ड.
27533: फेरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. 2 Malicious, noxious, injurious. m. (-वः) 1 A jackal or shacal. 2 A demon, a goblin. E. फे imitative sound, रु to utter, aff. अप्.
27534: फेरु m. (-रुः) A jackal. E. फे imitative sound, रु to cry, aff. डु.
27535: फेल (ऋ) फेलृ r. 10th cl. (फेलति) To go or move.
27536: फेलक m. (-कः) Orts, leavings of a meal, or droppings from the mouth. E. फेल to go, वुन् aff.
27537: फेला f. (-ला) Orts, leavings. E. फेल to go, अच् aff., fem. aff. टाप्; also फेलक and फेलि.
27538: फेलि f. (-लिः or ली) Orts, leavings. E. फेल to go, इन् aff., ङीप् optionally added; also with टाप् and कन् added, फेलिका f. (-का)
27539: फ्वल r. 1st cl. (फ्वलति) To live. ब
27540: ब The twenty-third consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding to the letter B, and often confounded with the analogous semivowel ब or V, with which some grammarians consider it to be at all times optionally interchangeable.
27541: ब m. (-बः) 1 A name of VARUṆA. 2 A water jar. E. बण to sound, &c. aff. ड.
27542: बंहिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very much, excessively many. E. बहु much, इष्ठन् superlative aff., form irr.
27543: बंहीयस् mfn. (यान्-यसी-यः) Very many. E. बहु much, ईयसुन् superlative aff.
27544: बठ r. 1st cl. (बठति) To be large, powerful, or able: better also वठ.
27545: बडवा f. (-वा) 1 A mare. 2 A female slave. 3 The nymph AŚVINĪ, or the personified asterism which is designated by a horse's head. E. बल strength or force, and वा to go to, affs. क and टाप्, and ल changed to ड.
27546: बडवाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Submarine fire: see the next. E. बडवा a mare, and अग्नि.
27547: बडवानल m. (-लः) Submarine fire; in mythology, a being consisting of flame, but with the head of a mare, who sprang from the thighs of ŪRVA, and was received by the ocean. E. बडवा a mare, and अनल fire.
27548: बडवाहृत m. (-तः) The gallant of a female slave, and thence also a slave. E. वडवा, and हृत taken.
27549: बडवामुख m. (-खः) Submarine fire: see बडवानल. n. (-लं) The infernal regions. E. बडवा a mare, and मुख head, principal.
27550: बडवासुत m. dual. (-तौ) The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and the physicians of heaven. E. बडवा the nymph AŚVINĪ, and सुत a son.
27551: बण r. 1st cl. (बणति) To sound; better also वण.
27552: बण m. (-णः) Sound, noise. E. बण to sound, aff. अच्.
27553: बणिक्पथ n. (थं) Traffick, commerce. E. बणिज्, and पथ् for पथिन् a path.
27554: बणिक्पुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The son of a merchant, or a young merchant or trader. f. (-त्त्री) A young woman of the same tribe. E. बणिज्, and पुत्त्र a son.
27555: बणिग्बन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) E. बणिज् a trader, and बन्धु the friend.
27556: बणिग्भाव n. (-वं) Traffick, trade, commerce. E. बणिज् a trader, and भाव property.
27557: बणिग्वह m. (-हः) A camel. E. बणिज् a trader, बह who bears.
27558: बणिज् m. (-णिक) 1 A merchant, a trader. 2 The sixth of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas, corresponding to the half of a lunar day. f. (-णिक्) Trade, traffick. E. पण to transact business, इजि Uṇādi aff., and ब substituted for प.
27559: बणिज्य nf. (-ज्यं-ज्या) Trade, traffick. E. बणिज् a trader, य aff.
27560: बद r. 1st cl. (बदति) To be steady or firm. r. 1st and 10th cls. (बदति-ते बादयति-ते) 1 To speak. 2 To declare or communicate  information: in these two senses, the root is more commonly and correctly written वद.
27561: बदर mf. (-रः-री) 1 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba or scandens.) m. (-रः) The seed of the cotton pod. f. (-रा-री) Cotton. f. (-रा) 1 A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) 2 A medicinal drug, commonly Varāhakrāntī. n. (-रं) 1 The fruit of the jujube. 2 The berry or pod of the cotton. E. बद to be firm, Uṇādi aff. अर; or if derived from वद to give information, it is read by some authorities बदर.
27562: बदरामलक m. (-कः) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. वदर the jujube, and आमलक myrobalan.
27563: बदरि m. (-रिः) The jujube: see बदर. E. बद to be firm, aff. अरि.
27564: बदरीछदा f. (-दा) 1 A kind of perfume, apparently a dried shell fish. 2 A tree, apparently a species of the zizyphus. E. बदर, the jujube, छद a leaf.
27565: बदरीपत्रक n. (-कं) A sort of perfume, a leaf. E. बदरी the jujube, पत्र a leaf, and कन् aff. of comparison added.
27566: बदरीफला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly blue Śephālikā or nyctanthes. E. बदरी the jujube, फल fruit.
27567: बदरीशैल n. (-लं) A part of the Himālaya range, and a celebrated place of pilgrimage; the Bhadrināṭh of modern travellers, or a town and temple on the west bank of the Alakanandā river, in the province of Srinagar. E. बदरी the jujube, and शैल mountain; also बदरीवन n. (-नं) The wood of jujubes, &c.
27568: बद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound, tied. 2 Checked, suppressed. 3 Fixed, firm. 4 Withheld. E. बन्ध to bind, aff. क्त, form irr.
27569: बद्धकोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) One who governs or suppresses wrath. E. वद्ध, and कोप passion.
27570: बद्धमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fast or firmly rooted. E. बद्ध, and मूल the root.
27571: बद्धशिख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Young, a pupil, a child, one whose hair has not been shaven. f. (-खा) A sort of pungent root, called by some a kind of garlic. E. बद्ध tied, and शिखा a crest or lock of hair, &c.
27572: बद्धाञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Saluting respectfully, putting the hands joined to the forehead. E. बद्ध attached, अञ्जलि the palms joined and hand touching the forehead.
27573: बद्धानुशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Of fixed intent. 2 Taking aim. E. वद्ध, and अनुशय purpose.
27574: बध r. 1st cl. (बीभत्सते) 1 To bind or tie. 2 To hate, to despise, to loath. 3 To suffer change or affection of the mind. r. 1st and 10th cls. (बधति बाधयति) 1 To tie, to bind. 2 To kill.
27575: बध m. (-धः) 1 Killing, slaughter, slaying, murder. 2 A killer, a slaughter. E. बध substituted for हन to kill, aff. घञ्.
27576: बधक m. (-कः) A slaughterer, a killer. E. हन changed to बध, and कुन् aff.
27577: बधकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्क्षि) Wishing death. E. बध, and काङ्क्षिन् who wishes.
27578: बधकाम्या f. (-म्या) Intent or desire to kill. E. बध, and काम्या desire.
27579: बधजीविन् m. (-वी) A hunter, a fowler, a butcher, &c. E. बध killing, and जीविन् who lives by.
27580: बधत्र n. (-त्रं) A weapon. E. बध to kill, Uṇādi aff. त्रच्.
27581: बधदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Capital punishment. E. बध, and दण्ड punishment.
27582: बधस्थली f. (-ली) A place of slaughter or execution. E. बध killing, स्थल ground.
