27583: बधस्थान n. (-नं) Place of slaughter or execution. E. बध killing, स्थान place.
27584: बधाङ्गक n. (-कं) Poison. E. बध killing, अङ्ग the body, aff. कन्.
27585: बधार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Deserving death. E. बध, and अर्ह fit for.
27586: बधिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Deaf. E. बन्ध to bind, (the hearing,) aff. किरन्, deriv. irr.
27587: बधू f. (-धूः) 1 A woman. 2 A wife. E. बन्ध to bind, aff. ऊ; it is more usually derived from वह to bear, and is consequently written with the semivowel: see वधू, &c.
27588: बधोदर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं) Effecting or causing death. E. बध, and उदर्क future result.
27589: बधोद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Murderous, felonious, an assassin, a murderer. E. बध killing, and उद्यत endeavouring.
27590: बधोपाय m. (-यः) Instrument or means of putting to death. E. बध, and उपाय means.
27591: बध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Deserving death. 2 Condemned to death. E. बध for हन to kill, aff. यत्.
27592: बध्यता f. (-ता) 1 Destruction. 2 Fitness to be killed. E. बध्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, बध्यत्व.
27593: बध्यभूमि f. (-मिः) Place of public execution. E. बध्य, and भूमि site.
27594: बध्यस्थान n. (-नं) Place of execution. E. बध्य, and स्थान place.
27595: बध्वा ind. 1 Having tied or bound. 2 Having killed. E. बन्ध to tie, or बध to kill, and क्त्वाच् aff.
27596: बध्रं n. (-ध्रं) Lead. f. (-ध्री) A thong. E. बन्ध to bind, aff. ष्ट्रन्; see वर्द्ध and वर्द्धी.
27597: बध्र्य n. (-ध्र्यं) A shoe, a slipper. E. बन्ध to bind or tie, ष्ट्रान् aff.
27598: बन(बनु) r. 8th cl. (बनुते) To ask or beg, preferably written वन.
27599: बन्ध r. 9th cl. (बध्नाति) r. 10th cl. (बन्धयति) To bind or tie; with आङ् prefixed, To loosen, to let loose. With अनु, 1 To follow. 2 To be affixed or attached to. With नि, to disunite. With सम, to connect.
27600: बन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 A pledge, a deposit. 2 A binding, a tie or fetter, &c. 3 Binding, tying. 4 The body. E. बन्ध to tie, aff. अच्.
27601: बन्धक n. (-कं) 1 Exchanging, barter. 2 A city. 3 A binding. 4 Binding, confinement. m. (-कः) A pledge. f. (-की) 1 An unchaste woman, a harlot, a wanton. 2 A barren woman. 3 A she elephant. E. बन्ध to bind, ण्वुल् aff. fem. aff. ङीप्.
27602: बन्धतन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A complete army, or one with its four divisions, of chariots, elephants, horse, and foot. E. बन्ध binding, तन्त्र an army.
27603: बन्धन n. (-नं) 1 Binding, tying, confining. 2 A rope for tying cattle. 3 Killing. 4 Hurting, injuring. mfn. subst. (नः-ना or नी-नं) The implement of binding or tying, a rope, a chain, a bandage, a ligature, &c. E. बन्ध to tie, aff. ल्युट् or बुच्.
27604: बन्धनग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 1 A rope for tying cattle. 2 The knot of a ligature. E. बन्धन tying, and ग्रन्थि a knot.
27605: बन्धनरज्जु f. (-ज्जुः) 1 A rope for tying cattle, &c. 2 Any rope or string used for tying. E. बन्धन tying, रज्जु a rope.
27606: बन्धनवेश्मन् n. (-श्म) A prison. E. बन्धन confinement, and वेश्मन् a house.
27607: बन्धनालय m. (-यः) A prison. E. बन्धन confinement, and आलय abode.
27608: बन्धस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) The post to which an elephant is tied. E. बन्ध a binding, and लम्भ a post.
27609: बन्धित्र n. (-त्रं) Love, desire. E. बन्ध to bind, इत्र Uṇādi aff.
27610: बन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 1 A kinsman, a relation, but especially a distant or cognate kinsman, and subsequent in right of inheritance to the gentile or Sagotra; the Bandhu, is of three kinds; the kinsman of the person himself, of his father, or his mother, as his father's brother's son, and his mother's sister's or brother's son; and the same reckoning upwards, as his father's father's sister's son, &c. 2 A friend. 3 A brother. 4 A flower, (Pentapetes phænicea.) E. बन्ध to bind or connect, उ aff.
27611: बन्धुक m. (-कः) A flower: see बन्धूक.
27612: बन्धुजन m. (-नः) A relation, a friend. E. बन्धु, and जन a person.
27613: बन्धुजीव m. (-वः) A flower, (Pentapetes Phoenicea.) E. बन्धु a friend, जीव to live, aff. अच्; also कन् being added, बन्धुजीबक (-कः)
27614: बन्धुता f. (-ता) 1 A multitude of relations. 2 Relationship. E. बन्धु a kinsman, and तल् aff.
27615: बन्धुत्व n. (-त्वं) Relationship. E. बन्धु, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, बन्धुता.
27616: बन्धुदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given by a kinsman. n. (-त्तं) One kind of female property, that given to a girl at her marriage by her own relations. E. बन्धु, and दत्त given.
27617: बन्धुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Uneven, undulating, wavy, partially even, and depressed. 2 Bowed, bent. 3 Pleasing, delightful, handsome, beautiful. 4 Deaf. 5 Injurious, mischievous. m. (-रः) 1 A goose. 2 A flower, (Pentapetes Phœnicea.) 3 A drug, commonly Bireng. 4 A bird. 5 A crane. 6 A drug, commonly Ṛṣabha. n. (-रं) 1 A diadem, a crest. 2 The dregs of oil, or oil cake. f. (-रा) A whore, a prostitute. f. plu. (-राः) The meal of parched corn. E. बन्ध to bind, उरच् Uṇādi aff.; also with ऊरच्, aff. बन्धूर.
27618: बन्धुहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Friendless, relationless. E. बन्धु, and हीन devoid of.
27619: बन्धूक m. (-कः) 1 A shrub bearing a red flower, (Pentapetes Phœnicea, but also applied to the Ixora Bandhuca.). 2 A tree, (Pentaptera.) E. बन्ध to bind, ऊक aff.
27620: बन्धूकपुष्प m. (-ष्पं) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) E. बन्धूक the Pentapetes or Ixora, and पुष्प flower; having a similar flower.
27621: बन्धूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Wavy, undulating, uneven. 2 Bowing, bent. 3 Beautiful, handsome. m. (-रः) A hole, a chasm. E. बन्ध to bind, Uṇādi aff. ऊरच्; also वन्धुर.
27622: बन्धूलि m. (-लिः) A flower, (Pentapetes, &c.:) see बन्धूक. E. वन्ध, and ऊलिच् aff.
27623: बन्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या-न्ध्यं) 1 Barren, unfruitful, not bearing fruit in due season. 2 Detained, confined, under arrest. f. (-न्ध्या) 1 A childless woman. 2 A barren cow. 3 A perfume, commonly Bālā. E. बन्ध to bind, aff. यत्.
27624: बभूवस् mfn. (-वान्-भूषी-वः) Been, become. E. भू to be, वसु aff.
27625: बभ्र r. 1st cl. (बभ्रति) To go; also वभ्र.
27626: बभ्रवी f. (-वी) A name of DURGĀ. E. बभ्रु ŚIVA, and ङीप् aff.
27627: बभ्रि mfn. (-भ्रिः-भ्रिः-भ्रि) Who or what has, holds, possesses, &c. E. भृ to cherish, किन् aff.
27628: बभ्रु mfn. (-भ्रुः-भ्रुः or भ्रूः-भ्रु) 1 Large, great. 2 Tawny, &c. 3 Baldheaded through disease. m. (-भ्रुः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 ŚIVA. 3 AGNI or fire. 4 A large ichneumon. 5 The name of a Muni or holy sage. 6 A rat. n. (-भ्रु) 1 A tawny or brown colour. 2 Any object of that colour. E. भृ to fill, aff. कु, and the initial repeated.
27629: बम्भर m. (-रः) A bee. E. बम्भ imitative sound, रा to make, क aff.
27630: बम्भराली f. (-ली) A fly. E. बम्भ imitative sound, रा to make, लच् aff.; also भम्भराली.
27631: बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best, excellent. m. (-रः) 1 A boon, a blessing, &c. 2 A son-in-law. 3 Surrounding, encompassing. 4 A catamite. n. (-रं) Saffron. f. (-र,) Asparagus racemosus. f. (-रा) The three myrobalans. n. or ind. (-रं) Slightly desired, preferable. E. बॄ to select, &c. अप् aff; the root is more usually written वॄ, and the derivative वर, q. v.
27633: बर्ब्बट mf. (-टः-टी) A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) f. (-टी) A whore. E. बर्ब्ब to go, अट aff.
27634: बर्ब्बणा f. (-णा) A blue fly. E. बर्ब्ब to go, aff. युच् or derived from वर् imitative sound, and बण or वण् to sound, aff. अच्, बर्ब्बण or वर्ब्बण.
27635: बर्ब्बर m. (-रः) A blockhead, a fool. E. वर्ब्ब to go, अरच् aff.
27636: बर्ह r. 1st cl. (बर्हते) 1 To be pre-eminent or excellent; (also वर्ह, but less usually.) 2 To speak or tell. 3 To kill or hurt. 4 To cover. 5 To remember. 6 To spread. 7 To give. (In these senses it is more usually वर्ह.) r. 10th cl. (बर्हयति) To hurt or kill; also वर्ह.
27637: बर्ह mn. (-र्हः-र्हं) 1 A peacock's tail. 2 A leaf. 3 Dependants, retinue. E. बर्ह to spread, &c. aff. अच्; this word and the corresponding forms are more usually derived from वृह to increase, &c. and are written with the semivowel: see वर्ह, वर्हिस्, &c.
27638: बल r. 1st and 10th cls. (बलति बलयति) 1 To live. 2 To hoard grain. 3 To prevent or obstruct wealth. r. 1st cl. (बलते) 1 To kill. 2 To go. r. 10th cl. (बालयते) To explain. (बालयति) To support, nourish, rear, as a child.
27639: बल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, stout, robust, powerful. m. (-लः) 1 BALADEVA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA, and the third of the three incarnations termed RĀMAS. 2 A crow. 3 A demon, slain by INDRA. 4 The Varuṇa tree. n. (-लं) 1 Strength, power. 2 Bulkiness. 3 Form, figure. 4 An army, forces. 5 Gum myrrh. 6 Semen virile. 7 The body. 8 The leaf of a tree. 9 Blood. 10 Rigour, severity. f. (-ला) An aquatic plant, (Sida cordifolia.) E. बल to live, aff. अच्; in some of the senses it may be derived from वल to go or surround, and may then be written with the semivowel: see वल.
27640: बलक्ष m. (-क्षः) White, (the colour, &c.) E. बल strength, and क्षै to waste, aff. क; this word is more properly written वलक्ष, q. v.
27641: बलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or from strength or power. n. (-जं) 1 A field. 2 A city gate. 3 Fruit. 4 War. 5 Pith, marrow. f. (-जा) 1 A pretty or handsome woman. 2 The earth. 3 Arabian jasmine. E. बल strength, and ज born.
27642: बलद्विष् m. (-ट्) A name of INDRA. E. बल, and द्विष् a foe.
27643: बलदेव m. (-वः) 1 BALADEVA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA. 2 Air, wind. f. (-वा) A medicinal plant, commonly Trāyamāṇa. E. बल the same, and देव divine, or बल strength, and देव who sports.
27644: बलनिग्रह m. (-हः) Weakening, reducing strength or power. E. बल, and निग्रह restraint.
27645: बलप्रसू f. (-सूः) ROHIṆĪ, the mother of BALARĀMA. E. बल, and प्रसू the mother.
27646: बलभद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 BALADEVA, as above. 2 ANANTA, the great serpent, considered as identified with the preceding, BALADEVA being regarded by some authorities as an incarnation of ANANTA. 3 A strong or robust man. 4 A tree, commonly Lodh. f. (-द्रा) 1 A young girl, a maiden. 2 A drug, commonly Trāyamāṇa. E. बल strength, and भद्र auspicious, excellent.
27647: बलभद्रिका f. (-का) A medicinal plant, Trāyamāṇa. E. बलभद्रा the same, and कन् aff.
27648: बलभिद् mfn. (-भिद्) Breaking or routing an army. m. (-भिद्) INDRA. E. बल, and भिद् who or what destroys.
27649: बलराम m. (-मः) The demigod named BALARĀMA, half brother to KṚṢṆA, and the third of the RĀMAS; according to some, the eighth Avatāra of VIṢṆU. E. बल strength, रम to sport, aff. घञ्.
27650: बलल m. (-लः) BALARĀMA: see the last. E. बल strength, aff. लच्.
27651: बलवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Strong, stout, lusty, powerful. E. बल strength, and मतुप् poss. aff.
27652: बलवत्ता f. (-ता) Strength, power. E. बलवत्, and तल् aff.
27653: बलवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Strengthening. 2 Ennobling. E. बल, and वर्द्धन augmenting.
27654: बलवर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) Strengthening. f. (-र्द्धिनी) A plant: see जीबक. E. बल, and वर्द्धिन् what augments.
27655: बलविन्यास m. (-सः) Array of troops. E. बल forces, and विन्यास disposition.
27656: बलवृत्रनिसूदन m. (नः) INDRA. E. बल, वृत्र two demons, and निसूदन destroyer.
27657: बलवृत्रहन् m. (-हा) A name of INDRA. E. बलवृत्र as before, हन् who kills.
27658: बलव्यसन n. (-नं) Defeat or rout of an army. E. बल, and व्यसन calamity.
27659: बलशालिता f. (-ता) Pride of, or confidence in strength or prowess. E. बलशालि, and तल् added.
27660: बलशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having strength, confident of strength, &c. E. बल, and शालिन् having.
27661: बलसूदन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA. E. बल the demons, and सूदन destroyer.
27662: बलस्थिति f. (-तिः) A royal residence, a royal camp or quarters. E. बल forces, स्थिति station.
27663: बलहन् m. (-हा) Phlegm, the phlegmatic humour. E. बल strength, and हन् destroying.
27664: बलहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Weak, infirm. E. बल, and हीन void of.
27665: बलहीनता f. (-ता) Exhaustion, weakness, prostration of strength, infirmity from fatigue or age, &c. E. बलहीन, and तल् added.
27666: बलाका f. (-का) A sort of crane. E. बल strength, अक् to go, aff. अच्; it is preferably written वलाका.
27667: बलाञ्चिता f. (-ता) A sort of Vīṇā or lute, called also RĀMA'S lute.
27668: बलाट m. (-टः) A sort of beam, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. बल strength, and अट what goes or grows.
27669: बलात्कार m. (-रः) 1 Violence, oppression, exaction. 2 (In law) The detention of the person of a debtor by his creditor, and the violent measures taken by the latter, (flogging, &c.) to recover his debt. E. बल strength, अत to go, aff. क्विप्, बलात्, and कार making, doing.
27670: बलात्मिका f. (-का) A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. बल strength, आत्मन् self, aff. कन्, fem. form.
27671: बलाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) Commander of an army, a general. E. वल, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
27672: बलान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strong, powerful. 2 Leading an army. E. बल, and अन्वित possessed of.
27673: बलानुज m. (-जः) KṚṢṆA. E. बल BALARĀMA, and अनुज younger born.
27674: बलापकर्षम् ind. By force. E. बल, and अपकर्ष removal.
27675: बलाबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong and weak. E. बल, and अबल feeble.
27676: बलावलेप m. (-पः) Pride of strength or prowess. E. बल, and अबलेप pride.
27677: बलाय m. (-यः) A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.) E. बल strength, अय to go, aff. अच्.
27678: बलाराति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA. E. बल a demon, and अराति an enemy.
27679: बलालक m. (-कः) The Caronda, (Carissa carandas.) E. बल strength, आङ् before ला to get, aff. बुन्.
27680: बलाश m. (-शः) The phlegmatic humour. E. बल strength, अश to eat or destroy, aff. अच्; also with कन् added बलाशक.
27681: बलास m. (-सः) The phlegmatic humour. E. बल life or strength, अस to pervade, aff. अच्.
27682: बलासम m. (-मः) One of the Jaina saints. E. बल strength, असम unequalled.
27683: बलाह n. (-हं) Water. E. बल strength, आहा to quit, aff. क.
27684: बलाहक m. (-कः) 1 A mountain. 2 A cloud. 3 One of the Nāgas or infernal serpents. 4 The name of a demon. E. बल strength, अ the negative prefix to हा to abandon, aff. E. क्वुन् strength, this word is differently derived also, and preferably written वलाहक, q. v.
27685: बलि m. (-लिः) 1 Tax, royal revenue. 2 An oblation, a religious offering in general. 3 The handle of a Chowrie or fly-flapper. 4 Presentation of food to all created beings, one of the five great sacraments of the Hindu religion: it consists in throwing a small parcel of the offering, Ghee or rice, or the like, into the open air at the back of the house. 5 The sacrifice of an animal, or raw flesh offered to the goddess DURGĀ. 6 Fragments of food left at an oblation or a meal. 7 An animal, or one which is fit for an oblation. 8 Three folds of skin at the end of the rectum. 9 A king, and Daitya, also MAHĀBALI, the virtuous sovereign of Mahābali-pura, tricked out of the dominion he had obtained over earth and heaven, by VIṢṆU, in the Vāmana or dwarf Avatāra, and left, in consideration of his merits, the sovereignty of Pātāla, or the infernal regions. f. (-लिः-ली) 1 A wrinkle, skin shrivelled by old age. 2 The fold of skin in stout persons, especially females, upon the upper part of the belly, or between the ensiform cartilage and the navel. 3 The ridge of a thatch. E. बल to live, or बध to hurt or kill, ध changed to ल, aff. इन् or इ.
27686: बलिक m. (-कः) The edge of a thatch. E. बलि the ridge, and कन् aff.
27687: बलिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Offering sacrifices. 2 Producing wrinkles. E. बलि before कृ to make, टच् aff.
27688: बलिकरम्भ m. (-म्भः) Sacrificial cake. E. बलि, and करम्भ a sort of cake.
27689: बलिकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Offering of oblations to all creatures. E. बलि, and कर्म्भन् act.
27690: बलिदान n. (-नं) 1 Offering victims in sacrifice. 2 Giving food to all beings. E. बलि, and दान giving.
27691: बलिध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A name of VIṢṆU. E. बलि the king so named, and ध्वंसिन् injuring.
27692: बलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Strong, stout, robust. m. (-ली) 1 A camel. 2 A buffalo. 3 A bull. 4 A hog. 5 Phlegm. 6 A name of BALARĀMA. 7 A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus radiatus.) 8 A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.) f. (-नी) Sida cordifolia. E. बल strength, इनि aff.
27693: बलिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shrivelled, wrinkled, flabby, flaccid. E. बलि wrinkled skin, aff. न.
27694: बलिनन्दन n. (-नः) VĀṆĀSURA, the son of BALI. E. बलि, and नन्दन the son; BALI had however four sons, to either of whom the epithet is applicable.
27695: बलिन्दम m. (-मः) VIṢṆU. E. बलि, and दम to humble, खच् aff.
27696: बलिपुष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A crow. E. बलि fragments of food, and पुष्ट nourished.
27697: बलिप्रिय m. (-यः) The Lodh tree. E. बलि sacrifice, and प्रिय fond of; said to grow the quicker for being perfumed and illuminated.
27698: बलिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Shrivelled, withered, flaccid, wrinkled. E. बलि a wrinkle, भ aff.
27699: बलिभुज् m. (-भुक्) 1 A crow. 2 A sparrow. 3 A crane. E. बलि the orts of a meal or sacrifice, and भुज् who eats.
27700: बलिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Wrinkled, shrivelled, flaccid. E. बलि a wrinkle, and मतुप् poss. aff.
27701: बलिमन्दिर n. (-रं) The infernal regions. E. बलि the Daitya, and मन्दिर abode.
27702: बलिमुख m. (-खः) A monkey. E. बलि a wrinkle, and मुख a face: also बलीमुख.
27703: बलिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very strong, more or most powerful. E. बल, and इष्ठन् super. aff.
27704: बलिष्णु mfn. (ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Arrogant, disrespectful. E. बल to be powerful, इष्णु Uṇādi aff.
27705: बलिसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The lash of a whip. 2 A number of monkeys. 3 The base of an ant hill.
27706: बलिसद्मन् n. (-द्म) The infernal regions. E. बलि the Daitya, sovereign of Pātāla, and मद्मन् abode.
27707: बलिहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. बलि BALI, and हन् to injure, aff. क्विप्.
27709: बलीमुख m. (-खः) A monkey. E. बली a wrinkle, and मुख face.
27710: बलीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very strong, exceedingly powerful. E. बल strong, ईयसुन् superlative aff.
27711: बलीयस्त्व n. (-स्त्वं) Superiority in strength. E. बलीयस्, and त्व added.
27712: बलीवर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) A bull or ox. E. बल strength, and वर्द्ध increasing, ली substituted for ल, and द final for ध; also वरीबर्द्द and वलीवर्द्द.
27713: बलोपविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Endowed with or possessed of strength. E. बल, and उपविष्ट entered.
27714: बलोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed of strength. E. बल, and उपेत possessed of.
27715: बल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Strong, vigorous. n. (-ल्यं) Semen virile. m. (-ल्यः) A Bauddha mendicant. E. बल strength, यत् aff.
27716: बष्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow bearing many calves: see बष्कयणी.
27717: बहि(इ)बहि r. 1st cl. (वंहते) To grow or increase; also वहि, but upon inferior authority.
27718: बहु mfn. (-हुः-हुः-ह्वी-हु) 1 Much, many. 2 Large, great. E. बहि to increase, Uṇādi aff. कु; it is less correctly derived from वह to obtain, and written वहु.
27719: बहुक m. (-कः) 1 A crab. 2 A gallinule. 3 A plant, (Asclepias gigantea.) 4 The digger of a tank, (जलखातके.) E. बहु much, कन् aff.
27720: बहुकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 A prickly plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 2 The marshy date tree. E. बहु many, कण्ट a thorn, कन् aff.
27721: बहुकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 A sweeper. 2 Industrious, labouring. m. (-रः) A camel. f. (-री) A broom. E. बहु much, कृ to do, अप् or टच् aff.
27722: बहुक्षम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Patient, enduring. m. (-मः) A Jaina deified saint. E. बहु much, and क्षम to bear, aff. ण.
27723: बहुगन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Smelling, strong-scented. m. (-न्धः) Olibanum. f. (-न्धा) 1 Arabian jasmine. 2 The bud of the Champac. E. बहु much, गन्ध odour.
27724: बहुगर्ह्यवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Talking much, and blameably. E. बहु much, गर्ह्य reproachable, and वाच् speech.
27725: बहुगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Many times. 2 Having many good qualities. E. बहु, and गुण quality, &c.
27726: बहुग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) Tamarisk, (Tamarix diœca.) E. बहु many, and ग्रन्थि a knot or joint.
27727: बहुग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) What takes or holds much. E. बहु, and ग्रह what takes.
27728: बहुतन्त्रि mfn. (-न्त्रिः-न्त्री-न्त्रि) Many-fibred, (applicable only to the body.) E. वहु many, and तन्त्री a string.
27729: बहुतन्त्रीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Many-stringed, (a musical instrument, &c.) E. बहु many, तन्त्री a wire, and कप् added.
27730: बहुतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Much, many, most. E. तरप् aff. added to बहु.
27731: बहुतस् ind. From or by much, or many. E. बहु much, तसि aff.
27732: बहुतिथ mfn. (-थः-थी-थं) Manieth, (the ordinary of many.) E. बहु many, much, डट् aff. and तिथुक् augment.
27733: बहुत्र ind. In many ways, or places, &c. E. बहु much, many, त्रल् aff.
27734: बहुत्व n. (त्वं) Plurality, multitude, muchness, abundance. E. बहु much, त्व aff. of the abstract.
27735: बहुत्वक्क m. (-क्कः) The Bhoj, or Birch tree. E. बहु much, त्वच् skin or bark, कन् aff. having several layers of bark.
27736: बहुत्वच् m. (-त्वक्) The Bhojpatra, or Birch tree. E. बहु much, and त्वच् bark: see the last.
27737: बहुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Liberal, munificent. E. बहु, and द who gives.
27738: बहुदक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Accompanied with many presents, (a ceremony.) 2 Liberal, bountiful. E. बहु, and दक्षिणा a gift.
27739: बहुदण्डिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having many staff-bearers, &c. E. बहु many, दण्डिन् having a staff, कन् aff.; also in the masculine form बहुदण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी)
27740: बहुदुग्ध m. (-ग्धः) Wheat. f. (-ग्धा) A cow giving much milk. E. बहु much, and टुग्ध milk.
27741: बहुदुग्धिका f. (-काः) A plant, yielding a caustic milky juice, (Euphorbia, of various sorts.) E. बहु much, टुग्ध milk, कन् aff., fem. form.
27742: बहुदोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Full of faults or defects, very wicked, very bad. E. बहु, and दोष fault.
27743: बहुदृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Experienced. E. बहु, and दृष्ट seen.
27744: बहुधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wealthy, rich. E. बहु, and धन wealth.
27745: बहुधा ind. In many ways, sorts, &c. E. बहु much, धाच् aff.
27746: बहुधागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dispersed, scattered. E. बहुधा, and गत gone.
27747: बहुधार m. (-रः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. बहु many, धारा edge.
27748: बहुनाद m. (-दः) The conch shell. E. बहु much, नाद sound.
27749: बहुपटु mfn. (-टुः-ट्वी-टु) Very clever. E. बहु much, and पटु clever.
27750: बहुपत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Many-leaved. m. (-त्रः) An onion. n. (-त्रं) Talc. f. (-त्री) A drug, (Trigonella foenugræcum.) E. बहु many, पत्र a leaf, &c.
27751: बहुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A medicinal plant, (Trigonella fœnugræcum.) E. बहु many, पर्ण a leaf.
27752: बहुपाद् m. (-पाद्) The Indian fig tree. E. बहु many, पाद foot; also बहुपाद. m. (-दः) alluding to the branches, which grow downwards and take root again.
27753: बहुपुत्त्र mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्री-त्त्रं) Having many children. m. (-त्त्रः) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) f. (-त्त्री) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus). E. बहु many, पुत्त्र a child or produce.
27754: बहुप्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having a numerous progeny. m. (-जः) 1 A hog. 2 A sort of grass: see मुञ्ज. E. बहु many, प्रजा offspring.
27755: बहुप्रतिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Complicated, containing more than one circumstance. 2 (In law) Comprising many counts, (a plaint, &c.) E. बहु many, प्रतिज्ञा assent.
27756: बहुप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Munificent, bountiful. E. बहु much, and प्रद who gives.
27757: बहुप्रवाह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Flowing in many streams. E. बहु, and प्रवाह course.
27758: बहुप्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of many children. E. बहु much, and प्रसू who bears offspring.
27759: बहुफल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Fertile, fruitful. m. (-लः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.) f. (-ली) The opposite leaved fig tree. E. बहु much, फल fruit.
27760: बहुभाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Fortunate. E. बहु, and भाग्य fortune.
27761: बहुभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Voracious. E. बहु, and भुज् who eats.
27762: बहुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thought much of, respected, considered. 2 Having many different opinions. E. बहु, and मत minded.
27763: बहुमति f. (-तिः) Value, estimation, prizing or preferring. E. बहु, and मति mind.
27764: बहुमल m. (-लं) Lead. E. बहु much, मल dirt.
27765: बहुमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A place where four roads meet. E. बहु many, मार्ग a road.
27766: बहुमान n. (-नं) Respect, reverence. E. बहु, and मान respect.
27767: बहुमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Multiform. f. (-र्त्तिः) Wild cotton. E. बहु many, भूर्त्ति form.
27768: बहुमूर्द्धन् mfn. (-र्द्धा-र्द्धा-र्द्ध) Many-headed. m. (-र्द्धः) VIṢṆU. E. बहु many, मूर्द्धन् a forehead.
27769: बहुमूल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Many-rooted, having many roots. m. (-लः) A sort of reed or grass: see इक्कट and इत्कट. E. बहु many, and मूल a root; also with कन् added, बहुमूलक m. (-कः)
27770: बहुमूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Costly, precious. E. बहु much, and मूल price, aff. यत्.
27771: बहुरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Multiform. m. (-पः) 1 Resin. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 Love, CUPID. 5 A chameleon. 6 BRAHMĀ. 7 Hair. 8 One of the Jinas or Jaina saints. E. बहु many, रूप shape.
27772: बहुरेख m. plu. (-खाः) Wrinkles, furrows, marks of care or pain. E. बहु many, रेखा a line.
27773: बहुरेतस् m. (-ताः) BRAHMĀ. E. बहु much, and रेतम् seed.
27774: बहुरोमन् m. (-मा) A sheep. E. बहु much, and रोमन् hair.
27775: बहुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Much, many. 2 Black. 3 Variously applicable, comprehensive, (a rule, &c.) m. (-लः) 1 AGNI or fire. 2 The dark half of a month. n. (-लं) The sky. f. plu. (-लाः) The Pleiades. f. (-ला) 1 Indigo. 2 Cardamoms. 3 A cow. E. बहु many, ला to get, aff. क.
27776: बहुलत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Abundance, muchness. 2 Comprehensiveness, (of a rule.) E. त्व added to the last; also with तल् बहुलता.
27777: बहुलीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Multiplying, magnifying, making much. 2 Winnowing. E. बहुल, and करण making, with च्चि aug.
27778: बहुलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Threshed and winnowed. 2 Made manifold or much. E. बहुल much, कृत made, and च्चि substituted for the final of the former, by which the ई is inserted.
27779: बहुवचन n. (-नः) The plural number, (in grammar.) E. बहु, and वचन saying.
27780: बहुवार m. (-रः) A fruit, (Cordia myxa.) E. बहु much, वॄ to nourish, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, बहुवारक m. (-कः)
27781: बहुविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Various, multiform, of many sorts or kinds. E. बहु many, and विध sort.
27782: बहुविलीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Widely spread or diffused. f. (-र्णा) A shrub bearing a small red and black berry, (Abrus precatorius.) E. बहु much, विलीर्ण spreading.
27783: बहुवीज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having many or much seed. n. (-जं) The custard apple, (Annona squamosa.) E. बहु many, and वीज a seed.
27784: बहुवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. वहु much, and वीर्य्य seed.
27785: बहुव्रीहि m. (-हिः) One of the forms of grammatical composition, the compounding two or more words to furnish an epithet or attributive, as बहुमाल or बहुमालक having many necklaces, from वहु, and माला A necklace. E. बहु many, and व्रीहि grain.
27786: बहुशत्रु mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु) Having many enemies. m. (-त्रुः) A sparrow. E. बहु many, and शत्रु an enemy.
27787: बहुशस् ind. Abundantly, plentifully, E. बहु much, many, शस् aff.
27788: बहुशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Having many branches or ramifications. E. बहु, and शाखा a branch.
27789: बहुश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well taught, learned. 2 Acquainted with the Vedas. E. बहु, and श्रुत heard, or श्रुति Vedas.
27790: बहुश्रेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Having many excellencies. 2 Very excellent. E. बहु, and श्रेयस् best.
27791: बहुस्पृश् mfn. (स्पृक्) Expanded, spread, diffused. E. बहु, and स्पृश् what touches.
27792: बहुसन्तति m. (-तिः) A species of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa) E. बहु much, सन्तति spreading.
27793: बहुसुता f. (-ता) A plant, (Asparagus.) E. बहु many, सुत a birth or shoot.
27794: बहुसू f. (-सूः) 1 A sow. 2 The mother of many children. E. बहु many, and सू bearing.
27795: बहुसूति f. (-तिः) A cow bearing many calves. E. बहु many, सू to bear, aff. क्तिन्.
27796: बहुस्वन m. (-नः) An owl. E. बहु much, स्वन noise or sound.
27797: बहूदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having much water. E. बहु, and उदक water.
27798: बह्ल r. 1st cl. (बह्लते) 1 To be pre-eminent or excellent, (also वह्ल, but less usually.) 2 To speak or tell. 3 To kill or hurt. 4 To cover, to spread. 5 To give, (also बह्ल in these five senses, and more accurately.) 6 To remember. r. 10th cl. (बह्लयति) To shine.
27799: बह्वर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Important, having much meaning. 2 Having many objects. E. बहु, and अर्थ meaning.
27800: बह्वपत्य m. (-त्यः) 1 A hog. 2 A rat. f. (-त्या) A cow that has borne many calves. E. बहु many, अपत्य offspring.
27801: बह्वाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Voracious, gluttonous. E. बहु much, आशिन् who eats.
27802: बह्वृच् f. (-ह्वृक्) The Ṛg Veda. E. बहु many, ऋच् a hymn or prayer.
27803: बह्वृची f. (-ची) The wife of a Brahman conversant with the Ṛg Veda. E. बहु many, ऋच् a prayer or incantation, aff. ङीप्.
27804: बा ind. 1 As, like. 2 Or, either: see वा.
27805: बाड(ऋ)बाडृ r. 1st cl. (-बाडते) To bathe, to dive and emerge. Vopadeva differs from other authorities in writing this with an initial व.
27806: बाडव m. (-वः) 1 Submarine fine. 2 A Brahman. n. (-वं) A stud, a collection of mares. E. बाडव a mare, and अण् aff. of derivation: see बडवानल.
27807: बाडवाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Hell. E. बडवाग्नि submarine fire, and अण् aff. of place.
27808: बाडवेय m. du. (-यौ) The two sons of AŚVINĪ and physicians of Svarga. E. बडवा a mare, Saṃjñā changed into a mare, and ढक् aff. of descent.
27809: बाडव्य n. (-व्यं) A number of Brahmans. E. बाडव a Brahman, यत् aff.
27810: बाडीर m. (-रः) A servant, a hired labourer.
27811: बाण m. (-णः) An arrow, &c.: see वाण. E. बण or वण to sound, aff. घञ्.
27812: बाणगोचर m. (-रं) The course of an arrow. E. बाण, and गोचर object.
27813: बाणि f. (-णिः) 1 Speech. 2 The goddess of speech, &c.: see वाणि. E. बण or वण to speak, in the causal form, aff. इ.
27814: बाणिज m. (-जः) 1 A merchant, a trader. 2 Submarine fire. E. बणिज्, &c. aff. अण्.
27815: बाणिजिक m. (-कः) 1 Submarine fire. 2 A trader, a merchant. 3 A rogue, a cheat. E. बणिज trade, aff. ठञ्.
27816: बाणिज्य mf. (-ज्यं-ज्या) Trade, traffic, commerce. E. बणिज् a trader, with ष्यञ् aff. or बाणिज् the same, aff. यत्.
27817: बादर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Made of cotton. mf. (-रः-रा) The cotton plant. E. बदर cotton, aff. अण्.
27818: बाध(ऋ)बाधृ r. 1st cl. (बाधते) 1 To resist, to oppose. 2 To annoy or afflict.
27819: बाध m. (-धः) 1 Opposing, hindering. 2 Annoyance. 3 Refutation arising from incompatibility or contradiction of assigned cause and effect (in logic). E. बाध to oppose, घञ् aff.
27820: बाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What hinders, opposes, pains, &c. E. बाध, and वुन् aff.
27821: बाधन n. (-नं) 1 Pain. 2 Impeding, opposing. E. बाध to oppose, aff. ल्युट्.
27822: बाधमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Paining, annoying. E. बाध to annoy, and शानच् aff.
27823: बाध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being harassed or tormented. E. बाध to annoy, pass. v. शानच् aff.
27824: बाधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Obstructed, impeded. 2 Pained, tormented. 3 Self-refuted (in logic), contradictory, incompatible. E. बाध to oppose, क्त aff.
27825: बान्धकिनेय m. (-यः) A bastard, the son of a disloyal wife. E. बन्धकी a wanton, aff. ढक्, and इनङ् augment.
27826: बान्धव m. (-वः) 1 A relation, a kinsman: see बन्धु. 2 A friend. E. बन्धु a kinsman, अण् pleonastic aff.
27827: बान्धवाक्रोशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Calling upon or bewailing a kinsman. E. बान्धव, and आक्रोशिन् who calls aloud.
27828: बाभ्रवी f. (-वी) A name of DURGĀ. E. बभ्रु ŚIVA, with अण् and ङीप् added.
27829: बार्ब्बटीर m. (-रः) 1 Tin. 2 A shoot of the mango. 3 The son of an unchaste woman, a bastard. E. बर्ब्बटी a whore, and र aff.
27830: बाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Ignorant, unwise, uninstructed. 2 Young, infantine, a child. mf. (-लः-ला) 1 An infant, a child; it usually means the young child, under five years old, but is equally applicable till sixteen years of age. 2 A colt. 3 A five year old elephant. 4 An elephant's tail. 5 A horse's tail. 6 Any tail. 7 Hair. 8 A sort of fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) mn. (-लः-लं) A perfume, perhaps a sort of fragrant grass, (Andropogon schænanthus.) f. (-ला) 1 Small cardamoms. 2 A woman, a female. 3 Aloes. 4 Another plant, commonly Acnadhi. 5 The cocoa-nut. 6 Turmeric. 7 A sort of jasmine. 8 A flower, (Hibiscus tortuosus, Rox.) 9 Pure, (applied specially to a female animal, as a heifer, &c. fit for an oblation.) f. (-ली) A sort of ear-ring. E. बल to live, aff. घञ्, it sometimes occurs, but less accurately perhaps, with a palatial initial.
27831: बालक m. (-कः) 1 A boy, an infant: see the last. 2 A fool, a blockhead. 3 The tail of a horse or elephant. 4 A finger ring. 5 A bracelet. 6 A perfume; also द्रीवेर. f. (-लिका) 1 A female infant. 2 Sand. 3 The knot or flower of an ear-ring. 4 The rustling of leaves. 5 Small cardamoms. n. (-कं) A sort of Hibiscus, (H. mutabilis.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
27832: बालकत्व n. (-त्वं) Childhood, childishness. E. बालक, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, बालकता.
27833: बालकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Childish, infantine. E. बालक, and छ aff.
27834: बालकृमि m. (-मिः) A louse. E. बाल hair, and कृमि a worm.
27835: बालखिल्य m. (-ल्यः) A divine personage, of the size of the thumb, sixty thousand of whom were produced from the hair of BRAHMA'S body.
27836: बालगर्ब्भिणी f. (-णी) A cow with calf for the first time. E. बाल young, गर्ब्भिणी pregnant.
27837: बालचर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. बाल a child, and चर्य्य usage.
27838: बालतनय m. (-यः) 1 A young son. 2 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.) E. बाल young or small, and तनय offspring, leaves.
27839: बालतन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Midwifery, care of a lying-in woman, and her child. E. बाल an infant, and तन्त्र rule, management.
27840: बालतृण n. (-णं) Young grass. E. बाल young, and तृण grass.
27841: बालदलक m. (-कः) A tree, (Mimosa catechu.) E. बाल small, दल a leaf, aff. कन्.
27842: बालधन n. (-नं) The property of a minor or infant. E. बाल, and धन wealth.
27843: बालधि m. (-धिः) A hairy tail, as a horse's, &c. E. बाल hair, धा to have, कि.
27844: बालपत्र m. (-त्रः) Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) E. बाल young or small, and पत्र a leaf; also with कन् added, बालपत्रक.
27845: बालपाश्या f. (-श्या) 1 An ornament of gold or silver, &c. worn between the hair divided on the forehead. 2 A string of pearls binding the hair. E. बाल hair, पाश a tie or quantity, and यत् aff.
27846: बालपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A sort of jasmine, (J. auriculatum.) E. बाल the hair, and पुष्प flower; worn in the hair.
27847: बालभद्रक m. (-कः) A sort of mineral poison.
27848: बालभाव m. (-वः) Childhood. E. बाल, and भाव nature.
27849: बालमूषिका f. (-का) A small rat or mouse. E. बाल small, भूषिका a rat.
27850: बालयज्ञोपवीतक n. (-कं) A sort of substitute for the sacrificial thread, a string or scarf as worn by children, (?) E. बाल a child, and यज्ञोपवीत the Brahminical cord.
27851: बालराज m. (-जः) Lapis lazuli. E. बाल young, and राज what shines.
27852: बालवत्स m. (-त्सः) A pigeon, a dove. E. बाल a child, and वत्स dear.
27853: बालवासस् m. (-साः) Woollen garments. E. बाल hair, (of cows, goats, &c.) and वासस् vesture.
27855: बालवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) A wild goat. E. बाल hair, वह to endeavour, aff. ण्यत्.
27856: बालव्यजन n. (-नं) A Chowrie, a whisk, a fly-flapper. E. बाल hair, and व्यजन a fan; it being made usually of the tail of the Yak.
27857: बालव्रत m. (-तः) A Bauddha saint; also named MAÑJUGHOṢA.
27858: बालसन्ध्याभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Of a purple colour. m. (-भः) Purple, the colour. E. बाल young, and सन्ध्या twilight, आङ् before भा to shine, aff. क.
27859: बालसूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Lapis lazuli. E. बाल young, सूर्य्य the sun; also with कन् added, बालसूर्य्यक n. (-कं)
27860: बालहस्त m. (-स्तः) The tail of a horse, or any hairy animal. E. बाल hair, and हस्त the hand, to which organ it is compared.
27861: बालाक्षी f. (-क्षी) A plant, commonly Keśapuṣṭa.
27862: बालातप m. (-पः) The rays of the rising sun. E. बाल, and आतप light.
27863: बालापत्य n. (-त्यं) Young offspring or progeny. E. बाल, and अपत्य offspring.
27864: बालि m. (-लिः) A monkey, the son of INDRA, killed by RĀMA. E. बाल hair, and इन् aff.; being born from the hair of his mother.
27865: बालिन् m. (-ली) The monkey son of INDRA. f. (-नी) The constellation Aśvinī. E. see the last, aff. इनि.
27866: बालिश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Young. 2 Ignorant. 3 Careless, heedless. n. (-शं) A pillow. E. बाड to emerge, इन् aff., बाडि or बालि, and शो to destroy, aff. ड.
27867: बालिश्य n. (-श्यं) 1 Thoughtlessness, heedlessness. 2 Youth. 3 Folly. E. बालिश, and यञ् aff.
27868: बालिसम्भव m. (-वः) Name of a celebrated monkey, the son of BALI.
27869: बालिहन्तृ m. (-न्ता) RĀMA. E. बालि the monkey, and हन्तृ killer.
27870: बालीश m. (-शः) Pain in making water from gravel, &c.
27871: बालु m. (-लुः) A drug, commonly Elavāluka. E. बल to live, aff. उण्.
27872: बालुक m. (-कः) A drug and perfume; also Elavāluka. f. (-का) 1 Sand, gravel. 2 (Also बालुकी) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) 3 Camphor. 4 A sand bath. E. बल to live, (by its means,) उकञ् aff. or बालु as above, and कन् added.
27873: बालुकागड m. (-डः) A sort of fish, (Cheilodipterus culius and butis, HAM.) E. बालुका sand, and गड to scatter, aff. अच्.
27874: बालुकात्मिका f. (-का) Sugar. E. बालुका sand, आत्मन् identity, कन् aff. in the fem. form.
27875: बालुकाप्रभा f. (-भा) One of the seven hells of the Jainas, the hell of sand. E. बालुका sand, and प्रभा splendour.
27876: बालुङ्की f. (-ङ्की) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) also बालुकी, बालुङ्गी.
27877: बालुङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A sort of cucumber: see the last; also with कन् added बालुङ्गिका.
27878: बालूक m. (-कः) A sort of poison.
27879: बालेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Soft. 2 Fit or proper for a child. 3 Fit or proper for a tax, a sacrifice, &c. m. (-यः) 1 An ass. 2 A demon, a Daitya. 3 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. बलि a tax, a sacrifice, or बाल a child, and ढक् aff.
27880: बालेयशाक m. (-कः) A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. बालेय an ass, and शाक a potherb; also बालेय.
27881: बालोपवीत n. (-तं) 1 The sacrificial thread, or a substitute for it as worn by children. 2 A cloth covering the privities. E. बाल a child, उपवीत the thread.
27882: बाल्य n. (-ल्यं) Childhood. E. बाल a child, ष्यञ् aff.
27883: बाष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 Vapour, steam. 2 A tear, tears, rheum. 3 Iron. E. बाध to oppose, Uṇādi aff. प, and ध changed to ष; according to other etymologies, this word is वाष्प, or बास्प, and वास्प
27884: बाह(ऋ)बाहृ r. 1st cl. (बाहते) 1 To resolve, to attempt perseveringly or resolutely, to endeavour diligently; also वाहृ.
27885: बाह mf. (-हः-हा) The arm. E. बाह to endeavour, aff. अच्; it is sometimes read वाह.
27886: बाहु m. (-हुः) 1 The arm. 2 The side of any angular geometrical figure, the leg of a triangle, &c. E. बाध to oppose, उ Uṇādi aff. and ध changed to ह.
27887: बाहुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A servant, servile, dependant. m. (-कः) 1 The name of NALA, after his change of form, by the bite of KARKOṬAKA Nāga. 2 A monkey. f. (-का) The name of a river. E. बाहु an arm, कन् aff. or कृ to do, with ड aff.
27888: बाहुकुन्थ m. (-न्थः) A wing. E. बाहु the arm, कुन्थ what adheres to, aff. अच्.
27889: बाहुकुब्ज mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं) Crooked armed. E. बाहु an arm, and कुब्ज bent.
27890: बाहुज m. (-जः) 1 The Kṣatriya or warrior, born from the arms of BRAHMĀ. 2 A parrot. 3 Sesamum growing wild, or spontaneously. E. बाहु the arm, and ज born.
27891: बाहुत्राण n. (-णं) Armour for the arms. E. बाहु the arm, and त्राण preserving.
27892: बाहुदन्तिन् m. (-न्ती) INDRA. E. बाहु an arm, दन्त a tooth, aff. इनि.
27893: बाहुदा f. (-दा) The name of a river, said to rise in the snowy chain of the Himālaya, and probably the modern Behut, the classical Hydaspes. E. बाहु an arm, and दा bestower; alluding to a legend of a saint's recovering his lost arms, by bathing in this stream.
27894: बाहुप्रहरण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) A striker, a boxer. n. (-णं) Boxing, wrestling. E. बाहु, and प्रहरण striking.
27895: बाहुभूषा f. (-षा) An armlet, an ornament worn round the upper arm. E. बाहु the arm, and भूषा an ornament.
27896: बाहुमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or done with the arms. E. बाहु, and मयट् aff.
27897: बाहुमूल n. (-लं) The arm-pit. E. बाहु the arm, मूल the root.
27898: बाहुयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Close fight, personal struggle, boxing, wrestling. E. बाहु the arm, and युद्ध fight.
27899: बाहुल m. (-लः) 1 Fire or its deity. 2 The month Kārttika. n. (-लं) 1 Mail worn on the arm. 2 A term in grammar, implying various or irregular formation, or construction, or such as is analogous to this word. E. बहुल fire, and अण् aff.; also with कन् added, बाहुलक.
27900: बाहुलेय m. (-यः) The deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. बाहुला the Pleiades, considered as nymphs, and nurses of this god; aff. of relation ढक्.
27901: बाहुल्य n. (-ल्यं) Plenty, abundance, quantity. E. बहुल, and ष्यञ् aff.
27902: बाहुवीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Personal prowess. E. बाहु, and वीर्य्य heroism.
27903: बाहुसहस्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A king killed by PARAŚURĀMA, also named KĀRTAVĪRYA. E. बाहु an arm, सहस्र a thousand, and भृत् having.
27904: बाहूबाहवि ind. Arm to arm, hand to hand, (fighting, &c.) E. बाहु the arm, repeated, इच् aff.
27906: बिद(इ)बिदि r. 1st cl. (बिन्दति) To make or constitute a part; the root is obsolete.
27907: बिभ्रक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) 1 Desirous to destroy or lose. 2 Wishing to scorch, fry, parch. m. (-क्षुः) Fire. E. भ्रस्ज to break, to fry, desid. v. उ aff.
27908: बिभ्रज्जिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to fry or scorch. m. (-षुः) Fire. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, desid. v., उ aff.
27909: बिल r. 6th cl. (बिलति) r. 10th cl. (बेलयति) To break, to tear or rend, to divide or detach.
27910: बिस्(इर)बिसिर् r. 4th cl. (बिस्यति) To throw or cast, to send or direct.
27911: बीभत्स mfn. subst. (-त्सः-त्सा-त्सं) 1 Disgust, abhorrence. adj. Detesting, loathing, changed or averted in mind. 2 Cruel, mischievous. 3 Compassionate. 4 Wicked. 5 Envious. E. बध to bind, to hate, &c. aff. घञ्.
27912: बुक्क r. 1st and 10th cls. (बुक्कति बुक्कयति-ते) 1 To bark. 2 To speak. r. 10th cl. To give pain.
27913: बुक्क subst. mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्की-क्कं) The heart. m. (-क्कः) A goat. E. बुक्क to bark, &c., aff. अच्; also बुक्कन् mn. (-क्का-क्क) also बुक्क.
27914: बुक्कन n. (-नं) Barking, (as of a dog.) E. बुक्क to bark, aff. ल्युट्.
27915: बुक्काग्रमांस n. (-सं) The heart. E. बुक्क the heart, अग्र principal, मांस flesh.
27916: बुक्कार m. (-रः) The roar or barking of a lion. E. बुक्क to bark, आर aff.; the lion of Hindustan barks much like a dog.
27917: बुड r. 6th cl. (बुडति) 1 To leave, to abandon. 2 To cover, to clothe.
27918: बुद(उ, इर)उबुदिर् r. 1st cl. (बुदति-ते) To discern, to apprehend, to perceive.
27919: बुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Known, understood. m. (-द्धः) 1 A generic name for a deified teacher of the Bauddha sect, amongst whom numerous Buddhas are reckoned; the name is especially applied to the ninth incarnation of VIṢṆU and the apparent founder of the religion of the Buddhas; the term is often confounded, but improperly, with a Jina: see जिन. 2 A sage, a wise or learned man. E. बुध to know, aff. क्तः see बुध.
27920: बुद्धद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Avarice, covetous accumulation. E. बुद्ध known, द्रव्य thing.
27921: बुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Understanding, intellect. E. बुध to know, aff. क्तिन्.
27922: बुद्धिजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Rational, an intellectual being. E. बुद्धि, and जीविन् alive.
27923: बुद्धिविनाश m. (-शः) Loss or deficiency of understanding. E. बुद्धि, and विनाश destruction.
27924: बुद्धिभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Wise, intelligent. E. बुद्धि, and भृत् having.
27925: बुद्धिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Wise, learned. 2 Famed, known. 3 Humble, docile. m. (-मान्) A man. E. बुद्धि wisdom, मतुप् aff.
27926: बुद्धिसहाय m. (-यः) A counsellor, a minister. E. बुद्धि understanding, and सहाय companion.
27927: बुद्धिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, silly, a fool. E. बुद्धि, And हीन void of.
27928: बुद्धिहीनत्व n. (-त्वं) Folly, ignorance. E. बुद्धिहीन, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, बुद्धिहीनता.
27929: बुद्धीन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of intellect, as the mind, eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin. E. बुद्धि understanding, and इन्द्रिय an organ.
27930: बुद्ध्यवज्ञान n. (-नं) Disregard of or contempt for one's understanding. E. बुद्धि, and अवज्ञान disrespect.
27931: बुद्बुद m. (-दः) A bubble. E. बुद imitative sound, बुद to perceive, aff. क.
27932: बुध(औ)औबुध r. 1st cl. (बोधति) r. 4th cl. (बुध्यते-ति) also (उ, इर) उबुधिर् r. 1st cl. (बोधति-ते) To know, to understand. With प्रति, to look for, expect. With प्रति and वि, to wake.
27933: बुध m. (-धः) 1 BUDHA, the son of the moon, and regent of the planet MERCURY, with whom he is identified. 2 A wise or learned man, a sage. f. (-धा) Indian spikenard. E. बुध to know or understand, aff. क.
27934: बुधजन m. (-नः) A wise man. E. बुध, and जन a person.
27935: बुधतात m. (-तः) The moon, the father of BUDHA.
27936: बुधवार m. (-रः) Wednesday. E. बुध MERCURY, and वार a day.
27937: बुधसुत m. (-तः) PURŪRAVAS, the first king of the lunar dynasty. E. बुध BUDHA or MERCURY, and the son of SOMA, and सुत son.
27938: बुधान m. (-नः) 1 A wise man, a sage. 2 A holy teacher. 3 One who speaks kindly. 4 A worshipper or adorer of BRAHMĀ. E. बुध to know, आनच् Uṇādi aff.
27939: बुधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, understood. E. बुध to know, aff. क्त.
27940: बुधिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wise, learned. E. बुध to know, Uṇādi aff. इलच्.
27941: बुध्न m. (-ध्नः) 1 The root of a tree. 2 ŚIVA. E. बुध to know, Uṇādi aff. नक्; also व्रध्न.
27942: बुन्द(उ, इर)उबुन्दिर् r. 1st. cl. (बुन्दति-ते) To discern, to perceive, literally or figuratively.
27943: बुन्ध(उ, इर्)उ बुन्धिर् r. 1st. cl. (बुन्धति-ते) To discern, to perceive: see बुन्द.
27944: बुभुक्षा f. (-क्षा) Hunger. E. भुज to eat, in the desid. form, aff. अड् and टाप्.
27945: बुभुक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hungry. E. बुभुक्षा hunger, इतच् aff.
27946: बुभुक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to eat. E. भुज to eat, desid, v., उ aff.
27947: बुभुत्सा f. (-त्सा) The wishing to know. E. बुध to know, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.
27948: बुभुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to know. E. बुध to know, desid. v., उ aff.
27949: बुभूषा f. (-षा) Desire to be or become. E. भू to be, desid. v. affs. अङ् and टाप्.
27950: बुभूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to be or become. E. भू to be, desid. v., उ aff.
27951: बुभूर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) 1 Wishing to fill. 2 Desirous to nourish, &c. E. भृ to nourish, desid. v. उ aff.
27952: बुल r. 10th cl. (बोलयति) To sink, to dive, to plunge and again emerge.
27953: बुलि f. (-लिः) The vulva. E. बुल to emerge, aff. इन्.
27954: बुष n. (-षं) 1 Chaff; also बुस. 2 Water.
27955: बुस r. 4th cl.) (बुस्यति) To dismiss, to loose, to quit or leave.
27956: बुस n. (-सं) 1 Chaff. 2 Wealth. 3 Dry cow-dung. 4 The thick part of sour curds. f. (-सा) A younger sister, (in theatrical language.) E. बुस to abandon, aff. क; also बुष, स being changed to ष.
27957: बुस्त r. 10th cl. (बुस्तयति) 1 To regard, to respect. 2 To disregard, to treat with disrespect.
27958: बुस्त n. (-स्तं) 1 Force-meat ball. 2 Fried meat. 3 The inner part of the jack fruit. E. बुस्त to disrespect, aff. अच्.
27959: बूक्क mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्कं) The heart: also बुक्क; also with a final न्, बूक्कन् mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्क) also बृक्क.
27960: बृक्क mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्कं) 1 The heart. 2 The kidney. E. see the last, ऋ substituted for ऊ.
27961: बॄ r. 9th cl. (बृणाति) 1 To choose or select. 2 To support or nourish; also in the first sense, वॄ more usually.
27962: बोध m. (-धः) 1 Wisdom, intellect. 2 Awakening, arousing. E. बुध to understand, aff. घञ्.
27963: बोधक m. (-कः) 1 A spy, an informer. 2 A teacher. E. बुध to understand, causal form, aff. वुन्.
27964: बोधकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who teaches, informs, awakes, &c. m. (-रः) An awakener, a sort of minstrel who awakens the prince or chief in the morning, by music. E. वोध awakening, कर who makes.
27965: बोधन nf. (-नं-नी) 1 Knowledge. 2 Teaching, informing. 3 Awaking, arousing. n. (-नं) Burning incense. m. (-नः) The planet MERCURY. f. (-नी) Long pepper. E. बुध to know, aff. ल्युट्.
27966: बोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be explained or expounded, to be rendered intelligible. E. बुध to know, in the causal form, aff. अनीयर्.
27967: बोधयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Informing, apprising. 2 Teaching. 3 Arousing, waking. E. बुध to know, causal v., शतृ aff.
27968: बोद्धव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be informed, taught, waked, &c. 2 Requiring to be taught or explained. 3 Necessary to be understood. E. बुध to know, causal v., तव्य aff.
27969: बोधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) Wise, learned. m. (-धिः) 1 A branch of holy study; keeping the mind awake to the knowledge of the true GOD. 2 Intellect, understanding. 3 The holy fig tree. E. बुध to know, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
27970: बोधितरु m. (-रुः) The holy fig tree. E. बोधि wisdom, and तरु the tree.
27971: बोधिद्रुन m. (-मः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. बोधि knowledge, द्रुम a tree.
27972: बोधिसत्त्व m. (-त्त्वः) A Buddha, or Bauddha saint. E. बोधि intellect, सत्त्व truth.
27973: बोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be informed, taught, waked, &c. E. बुध to know, causal v., यत् aff.
27974: बौद्ध m. (-द्धः) A Bauddha, or follower of the religion of the Buddhas. E. बुद्ध a Buddha, अण् aff.
27975: बौध m. (-धः) A name of PURŪRAVAS, the son of BUDHA, and grandson of SOMA or the moon. E. बुध MERCURY, and अण् aff. of descent.
27977: ब्रण r. 1st cl. (ब्रणति) To sound; व्रण more properly.
27978: ब्रतति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 A creeper. 2 Expansion. E. प्र before तन् to spread, aff. क्तिच्, and प changed to ब; also ब्रतति.
27979: ब्रध्न m. (-ध्नः) 1 The root of a tree. 2 The sun. 3 ŚIVA. 4 BRAHMĀ. 5 A son. 6 The body. E. बन्ध to bind, aff. नक्, and ब्रध substituted for the root.
27980: ब्रह्मकन्यका f. (-का) The goddess SARASVATI. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and कन्या the daughter; being born from the head of that deity.
27981: ब्रह्मगिरि m. (-रिः) A mountain. E. ब्रह्म, and गिरि a hill; the hill of BRAHMĀ.
27982: ब्रह्मघातक m. (-कः) The slayer of a Brahman. E. ब्रह्म, and घातक who kills; also ब्रह्मघातिन् m. (-ती)
27983: ब्रह्मघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The slayer of a Brahman. E. ब्रह्म, and घ्न who kills.
27984: ब्रह्मचर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The Brahmacarya or Brahmacārī, the religious student: see ब्रह्मचारिन्. n. (-र्य्यं) The order or condition of the religious student. E. ब्रह्म the Veda, and चर्य्य observance.
27985: ब्रह्मचर्य्यस्खलन n. (-नं) Incontinence. E. ब्रह्मचर्य्य, and स्खलन deviating from.
27986: ब्रह्मचारिन् m. (-री) The Brahmacārī or religious student; the young Brahman, from the time of his investiture with the cord, to the period of his becoming a householder: it is also applied to a person, who continues with his spiritual teacher, through life, studying the Vedas, and observing the duties of the student; it is also given as a title to Paṇḍitas learned in the Vedas; to a class of ascetics; by the Tantras, it is assigned to persons whose chief virtue is the observance of continence; and it is assumed by many religious vagabonds. f. (-रिणी) A woman leading a life of continence. E. ब्रह्म the Veda, and चर to go or follow, aff. णिनि.
27987: ब्रह्मजन्मन् n. (-न्म) Second or spiritual birth, investiture. E. ब्रह्म the Vedas, and जन्मन् birth.
27988: ब्रह्मजीविन् m. (-वी) An impure Brahman, one who converts his religious duties into a trade, and performs sacrifice, teaches the Veda, &c. for hire. E. ब्रह्मन् an officiating priest, and जीविन् who gets a living.
27989: ब्रह्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sage, one who has spiritual wisdom. E. ब्रह्म, and ज्ञ who knows.
27990: ब्रह्मज्ञान n. (-नं) Spiritual wisdom. E. ब्रह्म, and ज्ञान knowledge.
27991: ब्रह्मण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Relating to or connected with BRAHMĀ, or a Brahman. m. (-ण्यः) 1 The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.) 2 The planet SATURN. E. ब्रह्मन्, and यत् aff.
27992: ब्रह्मतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The true knowledge of Supreme Spirit. E. ब्रह्म, and तत्त्व truth.
27993: ब्रह्मत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Identification with BRAHMĀ or GOD. 2 Godhead. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMA, त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल् aff. ब्रह्मता, or with भूय added ब्रह्मभूय n. (-यं.)
27994: ब्रह्मद m. (-दः) A spiritual teacher. E. ब्रह्म the Veda or holy knowledge, and द who gives; also ब्रह्मदातृ ब्रह्मदायिन्, &c.
27995: ब्रह्मदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A plant: see ब्रह्मयष्टि. 2 A curse, an anathema. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and दण्ड a stick.
27996: ब्रह्मदत्त m. (-त्तः) One of the sovereigns of the race of Ikṣvāku, enumerated by the Jains. E. ब्रह्म by or to BRAHMĀ, दत्त given.
27997: ब्रह्मदर्भा f. (-र्भा) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.) E. ब्रह्म, and दर्भा sacrificial grass.
27998: ब्रह्मदान n. (-नं) Instruction in the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म, and दान gift; also ब्रह्मदायः.
27999: ब्रह्मदारु m. (-रुः) The mulberry, (Morus Indica.) E. ब्रह्म, and दारु wood.
28000: ब्रह्मद्विष् mfn. (-द्विट्) Hostile to Brahmans, &c. E. ब्रह्म, and द्विष् a foe.
28001: ब्रह्मन् m. (-ह्या) 1 BRAHMĀ, the first deity of the Hindu triad, and the operative creator of the world. 2 A Brahman. 3 The superintending or presiding priest at a sacrifice. 4 One of the astronomical Yogas. 5 One of the principal servants of the Jinas. n. (-ह्म) 1 The divine cause, and essence of the world, from which all created things are supposed to emanate, and to which they return; the unknown God. 2 The practice of austere devotion. 3 The Vedas or scripture. 4 Holy knowledge. E. वृह to increase, (mankind,) aff. मनिन् and the initial letter changed to ब.
28002: ब्रह्मनाभ m. (-भः) VIṢṆU. E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ, and नाभि the navel; BRAHMĀ having arisen to create the world, in a lotus, which sprang from the navel of VIṢṆU.
28003: ब्रह्मनिर्व्वाण n. (-णं) Absorption into or identification with the Supreme. E. ब्रह्म, and निर्व्वाण final absorption.
28004: ब्रह्मपद n. (-दं) The place or nature of spiritual being. 2 The station or rank of a Brahman or of BRAHMĀ. E. ब्रह्म, and पद place.
28005: ब्रह्मपादप m. (-पः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and पादप a tree.
28006: ब्रह्मपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A sort of poison. 2 The Brahmaputra or Burampooter river. 3 A place of pilgrimage, probably the source of the stream. f. (-त्त्री) 1 The Sarasvatī river. 2 The goddess SARASVATĪ. E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ, and पुत्त्र offspring.
28007: ब्रह्मपुरी f. (-री) The capital of BRAHMĀ on the mountain Kailāsa. E. ब्रह्मन्, and पुरी the city.
28008: ब्रह्मबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 1 The epithet or appellative of a Brahman. 2 A term of abuse. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and बन्धु a friend.
28009: ब्रह्मभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become as or one with the Supreme or with spirit. E. ब्रह्म, and भूत become.
28010: ब्रह्मभूति f. (-तिः) Twilight. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and भूति being.
28011: ब्रह्मभूय n. (-यं) Identification with BRAHMĀ. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and भूय being.
28012: ब्रह्ममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Consisting of or identified with spirit. 2 Belonging to or fit for a Brahman, &c. E. ब्रह्म, and मयट् aff.
28013: ब्रह्ममूर्द्धभृत् m. (-भृत्) ŚIVA. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, मूर्द्धन् the forehead, and भृत् who has: having in a dispute cut off one of BRAHMĀ'S heads.
28014: ब्रह्मयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The study of the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म a Veda or the Supreme Being, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
28015: ब्रह्मयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.) E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and यष्टि a stick; also with कन् added in the fem. form, ब्रह्मंयष्टिका, or with ङीप् added ब्रह्मयष्टी.
28016: ब्रह्मयोग m. (-गः) Cultivation of spiritual knowledge. E. ब्रह्म, and योग addition to.
28017: ब्रह्मयोनि m. (-निः) A particular mountain. E. ब्रह्म, and योनि place of production.
28018: ब्रह्मराक्षस m. (-सः) A demon or fiend of the Brahminical class. E. ब्रह्म, and राक्षस a goblin.
28019: ब्रह्मरात्रि m. (-त्रिः) 1 A name of YĀJÑAVALKYA, a saint and legislator. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, रा to give, ष्ट्रिन् aff.; conferring the knowledge of BRAHMĀ upon JANAKA in return for his bounty. 2 A night of BRAHMĀ, equal to a thousand divine ages. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and रात्रि night.
28020: ब्रह्मरीति f. (-तिः) Brass. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and रीति calx.
28021: ब्रह्मर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A divine saint, a Ṛṣi of a particular class, including VAŚIṢṬHA, &c. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and ऋषि a saint; the saints of this class are supposed to be of the Brahminical order.
28022: ब्रह्मर्षिदेश m. (-शः) A part of India, including the four countries of Kuru-kṣetra, Matsya, Pañcāla, and Śūrasena or Mathurā. E. ब्रह्मर्षि a Ṛṣi, देश country.
28023: ब्रह्मलोक m. (-कः) A division of the universe, the supposed eternal residence of the spirits of the pious. E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ, and लोक a world.
28024: ब्रह्मवद्य n. (-द्यं) Knowledge or declaration of BRAHMĀ, the knowledge of the universal permeation of one spirit, as taught by the Vedānta system of philosophy. E. BRAHMĀ or the spiritual deity, वद to speak or declare, aff. क्यप्; also with the aff. यत्, and the semivowel changed, ब्रह्मोद्य n. (-द्यं.)
28025: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस् n. (-र्च्चः) The power or sanctity of a Brahman. E. ब्रह्म, and वर्च्चस् splendour.
28026: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस n. (-सं) 1 Holiness, resulting from the study and observance of the Vedas. 2 The sanctity or superhuman power of a Brahman. E. ब्रह्म the Vedas, and वर्च्चस् splendour, aff. अच्.
28027: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Endowed with sanctity, pure, pious. 2 Having Brahmanical power or virtue. E. ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्, and विनि aff.
28028: ब्रह्मवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A district of western India; also ब्रह्मावर्त्त. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and वृत to abide, aff. अच्.
28029: ब्रह्मवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Copper. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and वर्द्धन increasing, favouring; being highly proper for utensils of worship, &c.
28030: ब्रह्मवाद m. (-दः) 1 Citing the Vedas. 2 Declaring or teaching spiritual knowledge. E. ब्रह्म scripture. and वाद speaking.
28031: ब्रह्मवादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A follower of the Vedānta system of philosophy, one who maintains all things are spirit. 2 A defender or expounder of the Veda. E. ब्रह्म the Veda or BRAHMĀ, GOD, and वादिन् who recites.
28032: ब्रह्मविद् m. (-वित् or विद्) A sage, one who knows the nature of the Supreme Spirit. E. ब्रह्म, and विद् who knows.
28033: ब्रह्मविद्या f. (-द्या) Knowledge of spirit. E. ब्रह्म, and विद्या science.
28034: ब्रह्मविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) Saliva sputtered out in reading the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म scripture, and विन्दु a drop.
28035: ब्रह्मवृन्दा f. (-न्दा) The capital of BRAHMĀ. E. ब्रह्मन्, and वृन्द heap, assemblage.
28036: ब्रह्मवेद m. (-दः) 1 Knowledge of BRAHMĀ, monotheism. 2 Knowledge of the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and वेद knowing.
28037: ब्रह्मवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) 2 The glomerous fig tree. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and वृक्ष a tree.
28038: ब्रह्मवेदि f. (-दिः) A country: see ब्रह्मावर्त्त. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and वेदि a country.
28039: ब्रह्मवेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Knowing or acquainted with the Vedas, with spiritual knowledge, &c. E. ब्रह्म, and वेदिन् who knows.
28040: ब्रह्मशल्य m. (-ल्यः) A tree, (Mimosa Arabica.) E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and शल्य a stake.
28041: ब्रह्मशासन n. (-नं) An edict or grant, &c. addressed to Brahmans. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and शासन governing or an edict, &c.
28042: ब्रह्मसत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Study and teaching of the Vedas. 2 The constant study of them. E. ब्रह्म, and सत्र sacrifice.
28043: ब्रह्मसर्प m. (-र्पः) A sort of snake. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and सर्प a snake.
28044: ब्रह्मसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from BRAHMĀ. m. (-वः) The second of the persons called Vāsudevas or Kṛṣṇas by the Jains. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and सम्भव offspring.
28045: ब्रह्मसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) Identification with BRAHMĀ. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and सायुज्य intimate union.
28046: ब्रह्मसार्ष्टिता f. (-ता) Equality with BRAHMĀ. E. ब्रह्म, and सार्ष्टिता sameness.
28047: ब्रह्मसुवर्च्चला f. (-ला) A plant, an infusion of which is to be drank in expiation of having any thing touched by a dog, cat, &c. E. ब्रह्म, and सुवर्च्चला linseed.
28048: ब्रह्मसू m. (-सूः) 1 ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMA. 2 KĀMADEVA. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and सू the son.
28049: ब्रह्मसूत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The sacrificial or Brahmanical thread. 2 An aphorism of the Vedānta philosophy. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and सूत्र thread.
28050: ब्रह्मसूनु m. (नुः) A sovereign, according to the Jains, of the race of Ikṣvāku. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and सूनु son.
28051: ब्रह्मस्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Of the nature of spirit, of the same essence as the Godhead. E. ब्रह्म, and स्वरूप nature.
28052: ब्रह्महत्या f. (-त्या) 1 Brahmanicide, killing a Brahman. 2 Any crime equally heinous. E. ब्रह्म, and हत्या killing.
28053: ब्रह्महन् m. (-हा) The murderer or slayer of a Brahman. E. ब्रह्मन्, and हन who kills.
28054: ब्रह्महुत n. (-तं) The performance of hospitality, &c., that one of the great sacraments which consists in the veneration of mankind. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, हुत worshipped; being the most worthy of respect, &c.
28055: ब्रह्माक्षर m. (-रः) The sacred and mysterious name of the deity. E. ब्रह्म GOD, अक्षर a letter, the Oṃkāra.
28057: ब्रह्माञ्जलि m. (-लिः) 1 Joining both hands together, whilst reading the Vedas, either as an act of humility or to mark the accentuation of the Sāma Veda. 2 Paying obeisance to the spiritual preceptor at the beginning or end of a lecture. E. ब्रह्म the Vedas, and अञ्जलि the hands joined.
28058: ब्रह्माणी f. (-णी) 1 The female energy of BRAHMĀ. 2 A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā. E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ, fem. aff. ङीप्.
28059: ब्रह्माण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The globe, the world. 2 One of the Purāṇas. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and अण्ड an egg, to which it is compared; in creation there are said to have been innumerable Brahmāṇḍas.
28060: ब्रह्माधिगमन n. (-नं) Perusal of the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म, and अधिगमन going through; also ब्रह्मधिगम.
28061: ब्रह्माधिगामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or contributing to a course of sacred study. E. ब्रह्माधिगम, and ठञ् aff.
28062: ब्रह्माभ्यास m. (-सः) Study or repetition of scripture. E. ब्रह्न, and अभ्यास exercise.
28063: ब्रह्माम्भस् n. (-म्भः) Cow's urine. E. ब्रह्मन् a Brahman, and अम्भस् water.
28064: ब्रह्मारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A place where the Vedas are read and explained. E. ब्रह्म the Veda, and अरण्य a wood.
28065: ब्रह्मावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तं) The country to the north-west of Dehli, lying between the rivers Sarasvatī, and Dṛṣadvatī. E. ब्रह्म a Brahman, and आवर्त्त abode.
28066: ब्रह्मासन n. (-नं) A posture suited to devout and religious meditation. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and आसन sitting.
28067: ब्रह्मास्व n. (-स्वं) 1 The BRAHMĀ weapon, a fabulous weapon originally from BRAHMĀ. 2 The imprecation of a Brahman. E. ब्रह्म, and अस्व a weapon.
28068: ब्रह्माहुति f. (-तिः) An oblation of ghee. E. ब्रह्म the Veda, and आहुति an offering.
28069: ब्रह्मी f. (-ह्मी) 1 A sort of fish, commonly Pancal, (Macrognathus Pancalus, HAM.) 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. वृह to grow or increase, affs. मनिन and ङीप्; also ब्रह्मी.
28070: ब्रह्मोज्झता f. (-ता) Neglecting or forgetting the Veda. E. ब्रह्म, and उज्झता abandonment.
28071: ब्रह्मोद्य n. (-द्यं) Reciting or explaining the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म, and वद to speak, aff. क्यप्.
28072: ब्रह्मौदन n. (-नं) Boiled rice distributed to priests at a sacrifice. E. ब्रह्मन् a Brahman, and ओदन boiled rice.
28073: ब्राह्म mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मी-ह्मं) Relating or belonging to BRAHMĀ, the Vedas, &c. n. (-ह्मं) 1 The part of the hand under the root of the thumb. 2 A mode of marriage, the presentation of the bride elegantly adorned, by the father, to the bridegroom whom he has invited. m. (-ह्मः) NĀRADA the sage, and son of BRAHMĀ. f. (-ह्मी) 1 One of the eight divine mothers of created beings, or the personified energies of the gods; the Śakti or energy of BRAHMĀ. 2 The goddess of speech SARASVATĪ. 3 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 4 A sort of potherb, (Ruta graveolens.) 5 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 6 A sort of fish. 7 The asterism Rohiṇī. 8 A she frog. 9 A yellow coloured ant. 10 The wife of a Brahman. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, &c. अण् aff.
28074: ब्राह्मण m. (-णः) A man of the first Hindu tribe, a Brahman. n. (-णं) 1 An assemblage of Brahmans, a council, a conclave. 2 A portion of the Vedas, that which comprises the precepts that inculcate religious duties, the maxims which explain those precepts, and the arguments which relate to theology; it is, however, now often blended with other portions. f. (-णी) 1 The wife of a Brahman, or a woman of the Brahmanical tribe. 2 A wasp. 3 A small ant. 4 A potherb, (Ruta graveolens.) 5 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 6 A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. ब्रह्मन् the Veda, &c. अण् aff., and the final syllable of the original word retained.
28075: ब्राह्मणचाण्डाल m. (-लः) An outcaste Brahman, one who is attended by a wife of another caste, or the son of a Śūdra by a Brahman female. E. ब्राह्मण, and चाण्डाल an outcaste.
28076: ब्राह्मणजाति f. (-तिः) The Brahmanical tribe or caste. E. ब्राह्मण, and जाति tribe.
28077: ब्राह्मणजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to the Brahmanical race. E. ब्राह्मण, and जातीय generic.
28078: ब्राह्मणजीविका f. (-का) The occupation or subsistence of a Brahman. E. ब्राह्मण, and जीविका livelihood.
28079: ब्राह्मणता f. (-ता) Brahmanhood. E. ब्राह्मण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, ब्राह्मणत्वं.
28080: ब्राह्मणबध m. (-धः) Brahmanicide. E. ब्राह्मण, and बध killing.
28081: ब्राह्मणब्रुव m. (-वः) A Brahman by birth but not by attention to his duties; one who subsists by avocations properly limited to the other tribes. E. ब्राह्मण a Brahman, and ब्रुव who speaks, who calls himself (improperly) a Brahman.
28082: ब्राह्मणयष्टिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. ब्राह्मण a Brahman, and यष्टि a staff, aff. कन्.
28083: ब्राह्मणसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Belonging to or abiding with a Brahman. E. ब्राह्मण, and संस्थ what stays with.
28084: ब्राह्मणहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suitable to or fit for a Brahman. E. ब्राह्मण, and हित proper.
28085: ब्राह्मणातिक्रम m. (-मः) Disregarding or disrespecting Brahmans. E. ब्राह्मण, and अतिक्रम going over or beyond.
28086: ब्राह्मणात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Belonging to, one or with or containing Brahmans, the Brāhmaṇa section of the Vedas, &c. E. ब्राह्मण, and आत्मक own.
28087: ब्राह्मणादर्शन n. (-नं) Absence of Brahmanical instruction or guidance. E. ब्राह्मण, and अदर्शन not showing or teaching.
28088: ब्राह्मणाभ्युपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The protection or preservation of a Brahman. E. ब्राह्मण, and अभ्युपपत्ति defence.
28089: ब्राह्मणायन m. (-नः) A Brahman, sprung from learned and holy progenitors. E. ब्राह्मण, and फञ् aff.
28090: ब्राह्मणीगामिन् m. (-मी) The gallant of a woman of the Brahmanical tribe, or the wife of a Brahman. E. ब्राह्मणी a female Brahman, and गामिन् who goes to or with.
28091: ब्राह्मण्य m. (-ण्यः) The planet SATURN. n. (-ण्यं) 1 An assembly of Brahmans. 2 The state, quality, or business of a Brahman, Brahmanhood. E. ब्रह्मन्, and यञ् aff., or बाह्मण, and यत् aff.
28092: ब्राह्मदेया f. (-या) A girl to be wedded by the Brāhma form. E. ब्राह्म, and देय to be given.
28094: ब्राह्माहोरात्र m. (-त्रः) A day and night of BRAHMĀ, a period of two thousand ages of the gods or two Kalpas of mortals. E. ब्राह्मण relating to BRAHMĀ, अहन् a day, and रात्रि a night.
28095: ब्राह्मिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. ब्राह्मी, and कन् aff.
28096: ब्राह्मीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The son of a woman married according to the Brāhma form. E. ब्राह्मी, and पुत्त्र a son.
28097: ब्राह्म्य n. (-ह्म्यं) 1 The worship or veneration of Brahmans, considered as one of the great sacraments. 2 Astonishment. E. ब्रह्म, and ष्यञ् aff.
28098: ब्राह्म्यहुत n. (-तं) Respect shown to guests, especially to Brahmans, hospitality. E. ब्राह्म्य, and हुत sacrifice.
28099: ब्रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वती-वत्) Speaking, saying. E. ब्रू to speak, शतृ aff.
28100: ब्रुवाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Speaking, telling, saying. E. ब्रू to speak, शानच् aff.
28101: ब्रू(ञ)ब्रूञ् r. 2nd cl. (ब्रवीति or आह) To speak or tell: आह is optionally substituted for this root before the first five inflections of the present tense, and वच in several other tenses भ
28102: भ The twenty-fourth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and aspirate of the last letter, or Bh.
28103: भ n. (भं) 1 A star. 2 An asterism. 3 A planet. m. (भः) 1 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet VENUS. 2 A bee. 3 Error, delusion. f. (भा) 1 Light, lustre, splendor. 2 A ray of light. f. (भी) Fear. E. भा to shine, or भी to fear, aff. ड.
28105: भक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Attached or attentive to, devoted to, engrossed by. 2 Served, worshipped. 3 Dressed, cooked. n. (-क्तं) 1 Boiled rice. 2 Food. 3 Any edible grain boiled with water. m. (-क्तः) A follower, a votary. E. भज to serve, &c. aff. क्त.
28106: भक्तकर m. (-रः) Factitious incense, incense prepared from various fragrant resins and perfumes. E. भक्त dressed, and कर making.
28107: भक्तकार m. (-रः) A cook. E. भक्त boiled rice, and कार who makes.
28108: भक्तछन्द n. (-न्दं) Appetite, wish for food. E. भक्त, and छन्द will.
28110: भक्तता f. (-ता) Devotedness, implied faith in and attachment to. E. भक्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, भक्तत्वं.
28111: भक्ततूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Music played at the hour of eating, amongst princes and great men. E. भक्त rice or food, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
28112: भक्तद m. (-दः) A supporter, a maintainer. E. भक्त, and द who gives; also भक्तदायक, भक्तदायिन्, &c.
28113: भक्तदातृ m. (-ता) A maintainer, a feeder. E. भक्त food, and दातृ donor.
28114: भक्तदास m. (-सः) A slave, one maintained in consideration of service. E. भक्त food, दास a slave.
28115: भक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Service, worship. 2 Faith, belief. 3 Devotion or attachment to. 4 Part, portion. 5 Fracture, division. 6 Metonymy. E. भज to serve, or भञ्ज to break, aff. क्तिन्.
28116: भक्तिमत् mfn. (-भान्-मती-मत्) Faithful, devoted to. E. भक्ति, and मतुप् aff.
28117: भक्तियोग m. (-गः) Devotion or worship, as shewn by implicit faith in any divinity. E. भक्ति, and योग devotion.
28118: भक्तिल m. (-लः) 1 A good horse. 2 A follower, a votary. E. भक्ति service, &c. ला to afford, aff. ड.
28119: भक्ष r. 1st and 10th cls. (भक्षति भक्षयति) To eat.
28120: भक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Gluttonous, voracious, gourmand. 2 A feeder, an eater, who or what eats. f. (-क्षिका) A meal, a feed. E. भक्ष to eat, aff. ण्वुल्.
28121: भक्षकार m. (-रः) A confectioner, a pastry cook. E. भक्ष food, and कार who prepares; also भक्षङ्कार.
28122: भक्षण n. (-णं) Eating. E. भक्ष to eat, aff. ल्युट्.
28123: भक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Eatable, to be eaten. E. भक्ष, and अनीयर् aff.
28124: भक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Eating. E. भक्ष to eat, शानच् aff.
28125: भक्षयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Eating. E. भक्ष to eat, शतृ aff.
28126: भक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. भक्ष to eat, aff. क्त.
28127: भक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be eaten, what may be eaten E. भक्ष to eat, तव्य aff.; also भक्षयितव्य.
28128: भक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Eatable. n (-क्ष्यं) Food. E. भक्ष to eat, aff. यत्.
28129: भक्ष्यकार m. (-रः) A baker. E. भक्ष्य eatable, and कार who makes or prepares; also भक्ष्यंकार.
28130: भक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) To be eaten. E. भक्ष to eat, pass. v., शानच् aff.
28131: भग n. (-गं) 1 Pudendum muliebre. 2 Fortune, prosperity. 3 Beauty, splendor. 4 Excellence, greatness. 5 Desire, wish, love. 6 Strength, vigour. 7 Effort, exertion. 8 Fame, glory. 9 Knowledge.. 10 Absence of passion, the tranquillity of the religious man, who has divested himself of worldly excitability. 11 Omnipotence, supreme or divine power. 12 Virtue, moral merit. 13 Final emancipation. m. (-गः) 1 The sun. 2 One of the twelve suns or Ādityas. 3 The moon. 4 A form of ŚIVA. E. भज to serve, &c. ग aff.
28132: भगदेवता f. (-ता) Hymeneal divinity. E. भग, and देवता divinity.
28133: भगन्दर m. (-रः) Fistula in ano. E. भग the vulva, दृ to divide, aff. खश्.
28134: भगवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Respectable, worshipful, adorable, and hence the common appellative of a prince or deity. m. (-वान्) One of the generic titles of a Jina or Jaina deified sage. f. (-ती) 1 A name of GAURĪ. 2 Any goddess. E. भग fortune, supremacy, &c. and मतुप् poss. aff.
28135: भगाङ्कुर m. (-रः) The clitoris. E. भग, and अङ्कुर a shoot.
28136: भगाल m. (-लः) The human skull. E. भग ŚIVA, अल to adorn, aff. अच्.
28137: भगालिन् m. (-ली) A name of ŚIVA. E. भगाल a skull, and इनि aff.
28138: भगिनी f. (-नी) 1 A sister. 2 A woman in general. E. भग prosperity, desire, इनि and ङीप् affs.
28139: भगीरथ m. (-थः) A king whose austerities brought GAṄGĀ, the river, from heaven.
28140: भगोस् ind. A particle used as a respectful term of address. E. भगवत् reverend, and ओस् irregularly substituted for the three final letters.
28141: भग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Torn, broken. 2 Overcome, defeated. 3 Disregarded, despised. 4 Disappointed. E. भञ्ज to break, aff. क्त.
28142: भग्नजानु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Having a broken leg. E. भग्न, and जानु the knee.
28143: भग्नपृष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Confronting, encountering, coming before or in front of. E. भग्न disregarded, and पृष्ठ the back; heedless of what is behind.
28144: भग्नप्रक्रम m. (-सः) 1 Disorder, confusion 2 Want of method or arrangement in composition. E. भग्न, and प्रक्रम proceeding.
28145: भग्नसन्धिक n. (-कं) Butter-milk. E. भग्न broken, सन्धि union, and कप् aff., divided by churning.
28146: भग्नात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The moon. E. भग्न broken, and आत्मन् the body; having been cut in two by the trident of ŚIVA, as a punishment for having violated the wife of VṚHASPATI.
28147: भग्नाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Disappointed. E. भग्न, and आशा expectation.
28148: भग्नी f. (-ग्नी) A sister. E. भञ्ज to share, aff. क्त, fem. aff. ङीप्.
28149: भग्नोद्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Labouring in vain. E. भग्न, and उद्यम effort.
28151: भङ्क्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्त) Breaking, a breaker, who or what breaks. E. भञ्ज to break, तृप् aff.
28152: भङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Breaking, splitting. 2 A chasm, a fissure, a division. 3 Defeat, discomfiture. 4 Disappointment. 5 Fear. 6 Dishonesty, fraud, circumvention, cheating. 7 Going, motion. 8 A wave. 9 A water-course, a canal. 10 Disease in general. 11 A disease, (hemiplegia, palsy.) 12 Interruption of the voice. f. (-ङ्गा) 1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 2 A plant, commonly Teori. 3 A fibrous plant from which a sort of flax is obtained, (Crotolaria juncea.) E. भञ्ज to break, aff. अच्.
28153: भङ्गभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Breaking, being broken. E. भङ्ग, and भाज् partaking.
28155: भङ्गसार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Crafty, fraudulent, dishonest. E. भङ्ग breaking, fraud, &c. स for सम् with, and अर्थ object.
28156: भङ्गान m. (-नः) A sort of fish, (Cyprinus Banggana, HAM.) E. भङ्ग a wave, अन to live, aff. अच्.
28158: भङ्गि f. (-ङ्गिः-ङ्गी) 1 Fracture, division, separation. 2 Fraud, deception, trick, disguise. 3 Irony. 4 Wit, repartee. 5 A wave. E. भञ्ज to break, aff. इन् and ङीप् optionally added.
28159: भङ्गील n. (-लं) Defect in the organs of sense.
28160: भङ्गुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Crooked, bent. 2 Fraudulent, crafty, dishonest. m. (-रः) The bend or elbow of a river. E. भञ्ज to break, aff. घुरच्.
28161: भङ्ग्य n. (-ङ्ग्यं) A field of hemp. E. भङ्गा hemp, यत् aff.
28162: भज r. 1st cl. (औ) भजौ (भजति) 1 To serve, to worship. 2 To possess, to enjoy, (carnally.) r. 10th cl. (भजयति) 1 To give. 2 To dress or cook. 3 To separate or divide: see भाज. (इ) भजि r. 10th. cl. (भंजयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak: with वि prefixed, to measure; with प्र and वि, to discriminate, to discuss.
28163: भजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) 1 Serving, waiting upon. 2 Enjoying carnally. 3 Dividing, sharing. E. भज to serve, &c. शतृ aff.
28164: भजन n. (-नं) 1 Service, adoration. 2 Possessing or enjoying carnally. 3 Sharing. m. (-नः) The sound of the conch. E. भज to serve, aff. ल्युट्.
28165: भजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Serving, waiting. 2 Enjoying, possessing, (carnally.) 3 Dividing, sharing. 4 Right, fit, proper. E. भज to serve, &c., शानच् aff.
28166: भञ्ज(ओ, औ) ओभञ्जौ r. 7th cl. (भनक्ति) To break, to destroy.
28167: भञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what breaks, severs, divides, destroys, &c. E. भञ्ज to break, ण्वुल् aff.
28168: भञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) Breaking, destroying. E. भञ्ज, and शतृ aff.
28169: भञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Breaking, destroying. 2 Afflicting. E. भञ्ज to break, ल्युट् aff.
28170: भञ्जनक m. (-कः) A disease of the mouth, contortion of the lips, and decay of the teeth. E. भञ्जन, and कन् added.
28171: भञ्जरु m. (-रुः) A tree growing near a temple. E. भञ्ज to break, अरुन् aff.
28172: भट r. 1st cl. (भटति) 1 To hold or cherish. 2 To hire or maintain. 3 To speak. (इ) भटि r. 10th cl. (भंटयति) To deceive.
28173: भट m. (-टः) 1 A warrior, a soldier, a combatant. 2 A barbarian, or outcast of a particular tribe. 3 A goblin. E. भट to maintain, aff. अच्.
28174: भटित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Roasted on a spit, (meat, &c.) E. भट to nourish, इत्र aff.
28175: भट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 1 A philosopher, a learned man, especially one conversant with the philosophical systems. 2 An enemy. 3 Best, excellent. 4 Authority.
28176: भट्टार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Worshipful, reverend, entitled to homage or respect: see the next.
28177: भट्टारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Venerable, respectable, entitled to reverence or to homage. m. (-कः) 1 A sage, a Muni or saint. 2 A deity. 3 (In theatrical language) A king. 4 The sun. 5 A term especially applied to a Bauddha teacher. E. भट to nourish, aff. क्विप्, तृ to pass, aff. ण्वुल्, त changed to ट; otherwise with टल to be confused, the same aff., and ल changed to ष; a cherisher and punisher, a distributor of rewards and punishments; again, भट्ट said here to mean, authority, ऋ to go to or obtain, अण् aff., कन् added.
28178: भट्टारकवार n. (-रं) Sunday. E. भट्टारक, and वार a day.
28179: भट्टिनी f. (-नी) 1 A queen, who has been consecrated as well as her husband; (a theatrical term.) 2 The wife of a Brahman. E. भट्ट authority: see etymology of the last word, इनि and ङीप् affs.
28180: भड(इ)भडि r. 1st cl. (भण्डते) 1 To rally, to deride or treat with merriment. 2 To jest, to joke. 3 To speak. 4 To upbraid, to reprove. r. 1st and 10th cls. (भण्डति भण्डयति) To do an auspicious act.
28181: भडिल m. (-लः) A servant. 2 A hero. E. भड a Sautra root, to be happy, Uṇādi aff. इलच्.
28182: भण r. 1st cl. (भणति) To sound, to utter articulate sound, to speak or say. With प्रति, to reply.
28183: भणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, spoken, uttered. E. भण to speak, aff. क्त.
28184: भणिति f. (-तिः) Speech, speaking. E. भण to speak, aff. क्तिन्, with the augment इट्.
28185: भण्टाकी f. (-की) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. भट to nourish, aff. आक, and नुम् augment.
28186: भण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A mime, a jester, a buffoon, an actor. E. भडि to deride, &c. aff. अच्.
28187: भण्डक m. (-कः) A wagtail. E. कन् added to the preceding.
28188: भण्डन n. (-नं) 1 Armour, mail. 2 War, battle. 3 Evil, wickedness, mischief. E. भडि to blame, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
28189: भण्डहासिनी f. (-नी) A whore, a harlot. E. भण्ड a jester, and हासिनी who delights.
28190: भण्डि f. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी) 1 A plant, from the wood of which a red dye is prepared; Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith, Rox.) 2 A wave. E. भडि to be auspicious, &c. aff. इन्; also with कन् added भण्डिका, also भण्डिरी and भण्डीरी.
28191: भण्डिर m. (-रः) A tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) f. (-री) Madder. E. see भण्डिल, भण्डीरी, &c.
28192: भण्डिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 A messenger, one sent or dispatched. 2 Fortunate, happy, prosperous, auspicious. m. (-लः) A tree, (Mimosa sirisha). E. भडि to be happy, &c. Uṇādi aff. इलच्; also र being substituted for ल, भण्डिर, or the short vowel being lengthened, भण्डील.
28193: भण्डीरी f. (-री) The Bengal madder tree: see भण्डि. E. भडि to be auspicious, ईरन् aff.
28194: भण्डील m. (-लः) The Sirisha tree: see भण्डिल.
28195: भण्डूक m. (-कः) A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) E. भडि to be auspicious, ऊकन् aff.
28196: भद(इ)भदि r. 1st and 10th cls. (भन्दति-ते भन्दयति) 1 To do an auspicious act. 2 To be happy, well, prosperous, &c. 3 To shine.
28197: भदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 1 Reverend, venerable, worshipped or adored. 2 Brilliant, splendid. m. (-न्तः) 1 A Saugata, a Bauddha, a heterodox or sceptical philosopher. 2 A devotee, an ascetic. E. भदि to be happy or pleased, to shine, Uṇādi aff. झच्, and the nasal rejected.
28198: भदाक mn. (-कः-कं) Prosperous, fortunate, auspicious. E. भदि to be happy, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.
28199: भद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Happy, prosperous, lucky, propitious. 2 Best, excellent. 3 Pure, pious, virtuous. n. subst. (-द्रं) Prosperity, fortune, happiness. (adv.) Happy, well, right. n. (-द्रं) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 2 Gold. 3 Iron or steel. nf. (-द्रं-द्री) One of the astrological periods called Karaṇas, the seventh; also called Viṣṭī, regarded as an unlucky period. m. (-द्रः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A wagtail. 3 A bull. 4 A heap, a multitude. 5 A description of elephant, one of four classes into which they are divided. 6 Mount Meru. 7 One of the nine persons termed Śuklabalas by the Jainas. f. (-द्रा) 1 The Ganges of heaven. 2 The ichneumon plant: see रास्ना. 3 Indigo. 4 Asclepias pseudosarsa. 5 A shrub, (Pœderia foetida.) 6 A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal. 7 A name of the second, seventh, and twelfth days of the lunar fortnight. 8 A female Śakti or deity of the Jainas. 9 One of the four divisions of the Ganges, according to the Purāṇas, that which flows to the northern Kuru. 10 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 11 A cow. 12 Turmerick. E. भदि to be happy, Uṇādi aff. रन् and the nasal rejected.
28200: भद्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. 2 Respectable, worthy, estimable. 3 Lucky, fortunate. n. (-कं) A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) m. (-कः) A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. कन् added to the last.
28201: भद्रकाली f. (-ली) 1 One of the forms of the goddess DURGĀ. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis or rotundus.) E. भद्र ŚIVA, क्ल to approximate, aff. घञ and ङीप्.
