28202: भद्रकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A golden jar filled with water from a holy place, or with the water of the Ganges, and used especially at the consecration of a king. E. भद्र auspicious, and कुम्भ a water jar.
28203: भद्रगन्धिका f. (-का) A creeping plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa, the narrow-leaved variety.) E. भद्र auspicious, and गन्ध smell, aff. कन् and टाप्; some copies read भद्रवल्लिका in place of this word.
28204: भद्रङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness or prosperity. E. भद्र happy, and कृ to make, aff. खश्.
28205: भद्रचूड m. (-डः) A sort of Euphorbia, (E. tirucalli.) E. भद्र propitious, and चूडा a crest.
28206: भद्रदारु m. (-रुः) A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. भद्र auspicious, and दारु wood.
28207: भद्रदार्व्वादिक m. (-कः) A class of thirty-nine medicinal plants, and substances. E. भद्रदारु the pine, आदि etcetera, कन् added.
28208: भद्रनामन् m. (-मा) The woodpecker. E. भद्र auspicious, and नामन a name.
28209: भद्रपदा f. (-दा) A name given to the 26th and 27th lunar asterisms: see भाद्रपदा.
28210: भद्रपर्णा f. (-र्णा) A shrub, (Pœderia foetida.) E. भद्र auspicious, पर्ण a leaf, and टाप् fem. aff.
28211: भद्रपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 2 A shrub, (Pœderia fœtida.) E. भद्र lucky, पर्ण a leaf, and ङीष् fem. aff.
28212: भद्रबलन m. (-नः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. भद्र conferring happiness, and बल to be strong, aff. युच्.
28214: भद्रमल्लिका f. (-का) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)
28215: भद्रमुस्तक m. (-कः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) E. भद्र lucky, and मुस्तक Cyperus.
28216: भद्रयव n. (-वं) The seed of the Echites or Wrightea antidysenterica. E. भद्र lucky, and यव seed.
28217: भद्ररेणु m. (-णुः) The elephant of INDRA. E. भद्र auspicious, and रेणु dust.
28220: भद्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) 2 The large Bengal creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. भद्र lucky, and वल्ली a creeper.
28221: भद्रश्रय n. (-यं) Sandal. E. भद्र auspicious, श्रय for आश्रय asylum, place of growing.
28222: भद्रश्री f. (-श्रीः) Sandal wood. E. भद्र best, श्री excellence or beauty.
28223: भद्रसोमा f. (-मा) A name of GAṄGĀ. E. भद्र ŚIVA, स with or equal to, उमा the wife of ŚIVA; equally dear with UMĀ to that deity.
28224: भद्राकरण n. (-णं) Shaving. E. भद्र auspicious, with डाच् aff., and कृ to do, aff. ल्युट्.
28225: भद्रात्मज m. (-जः) A sword, a scimitar. E. भद्र iron, and आत्मज born.
28226: भद्रारक m. (-कः) One of the eighteen minor Dvīpas, or divisions of the world. E. भद्र prosperity, ऋ to go to, or attain, aff. ण्वुल्.
28227: भद्रालपत्रिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Poederia foetida.) E. भद्र auspicious, अल what is equal to, and पत्र a leaf, aff. कन्.
28228: भद्राली f. (-ली) A shrub, (Poederia foetida.) E. भद्रा the same plant, ला to go or be, aff. ड and ङीष्.
28229: भद्राश्व n. (-श्वं) One of the four Mahā Dvīpas, into which the known world is divided, according to some systems; or according to another system, one of the nine Khāṇḍas, or smaller divisions of the continent; in either case it is the east division. m. (-श्वः) One of the nine sons of AGNĪDHRA, to whom the division of the earth called Bhadrāśva was assigned, and from whom it was so named. E. भद्र auspicious, अश्व a horse.
28230: भद्राश्रय m. (-यः) Sandal wood. E. भद्र auspicious, and आश्रय abode, habitat.
28231: भद्रासन n. (-नं) 1 A throne. 2 A peculiar posture, in which abstract meditation is performed by the devotee; the legs bent, and crossed underneath, and turned so as to bring the ancles in contact with the perineum, whilst the soles of the feet are held close to the sides. E. भद्र auspicious or beautiful, and आसन a seat or sitting.
28233: भन्दिल n. (-लं) Good, happiness, welfare, prosperity. E. भदि to be auspicious, Uṇādi aff. इलच्.
28234: भपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. भ a star, and पति chief.
28235: भम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Smoke. 2 A fly. E. भम् imitative sound, भा to emit sound, to shine, &c., and ड aff.
28236: भम्भरालिका f. (-का) A gnat, a musquito. E. भम्भराली a fly, and कन् aff.
28237: भम्भराली f. (-ली) A fly, especially of a large sort. E. भम् imitative sound, repeated, रा to make, and लच् aff.; making a buzzing noise.
28238: भम्भासार m. (-रः) A sovereign of Magadha; also ŚREṆIKA.
28239: भय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Frightful, fearful, horrible, dreadful. n. (-यं) 1 Fear, alarm, fright, dread. 2 The flower of the Trapa bispinosa. E. भी to be afraid, अच् aff.
28240: भयकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Terrifying, frightening. E. भय, and कारक what causes.
28241: भयङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Fearful, formidable, frightful. E. भय fear, कृ to make, खच् aff.
28242: भयद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Fearful, terrifying. E. भय, and द who or what gives.
28243: भयदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Fearful, frightful. E. भय, and दर्शिन् appearing.
28244: भयदाय m. (-यः-या-यं) Terrific. E. भय, and दाय what gives.
28245: भयद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Routed, put to flight. E. भय fear, द्रुत flown, fled.
28246: भयप्रतीकार m. (-रः) Removal of fear. E. भय, and प्रतीकार counteraction.
28247: भयप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Causing or inspiring fear. E. भय, and प्रद who or what gives.
28248: भयप्रस्ताव m. (-वः) Season or occasion of alarm. E. भय, and प्रस्ताव occasion.
28249: भयभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Put to flight. E. भय fear, भ्रष्ट fallen, gone.
28250: भयविधायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Alarming, fearful. E. भय, and विधायिन् causing.
28251: भयविप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Panick-struck. E. भय, and विप्लुत immersed in.
28252: भयसंहृष्टरोमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Horrified. E. भय, संहृष्टरोमन् having the hair erect.
28253: भयस्थान n. (-नं) Seat or part exposed to peril or hurt. E. भय, and स्थान place.
28254: भयहेतु n. (-तु) Cause of alarm. E. भय, and हेतु cause.
28255: भयातुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Afraid. E. भय, and आतुर affected.
28256: भयार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Frightened, afraid. E. भय, and आर्त्त afflicted.
28257: भयानक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Frightful, formidable, terrific. n. (-कं) Terror. m. (-कः) 1 RĀHU the personified ascending node. 2 A tiger. 3 The Rasa or sentiment of terror, as excited by poetical or dramatic composition. E. भी to fear, आनक Uṇādi aff.
28258: भयापह m. (-हः) A king, a sovereign. E. भय fear, अप before हा to quit, to oppose or remove from, aff. क.
28259: भयावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Formidable, fearful. E. भय fear, वह to bear, aff. अच्, and आङ् prefixed.
28260: भयैकप्रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Engrossed by fear. E. भय, एक alone, प्रवण bent.
28261: भयोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Attended with or succeeded by fear. E. भय, and उत्तर subsequent.
28262: भयोपशम m. (-मः) Encouraging, allaying fear. E. भय, and उपशम tranquillising.
28263: भर adv. m. (-रः) 1 Much, excessive. noun. 2 A measure of value, two thousand Palas. mfn. (-रः-रा or री-रं) Who or what cherishes, upholds, supports, &c. E. भृ to cherish, अप् aff., or with घञ् aff. भार, q. v.
28264: भरट m. (-टः) 1 A potter. 2 A servant. E. भृ to cherish, Uṇādi aff. अटन्.
28265: भरण n. (-णं) 1 Cherishing, maintaining, nourishing, supporting. 2 Wages, hire. 3 The constellation Bharaṇī. f. (-णी) 1 The name of the second lunar asterism, containing three stars, (Musca,) and figured by the pudendum muliebre. 2 A creeper, commonly Ghosha. E. भृ to nourish, ल्युट् aff.
28266: भरणीभू m. (-भूः) The personified ascending node or Rāhu. E. भरणी the asterism personified as a nymph, and भू born.
28267: भरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit or proper to be cherished or maintained, a dependant. E. भृ to nourish, अनीयर् aff.
28268: भरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A master, an owner, a lord, a husband. 2 A sovereign, a king. 3 A king. 2 A bull. E. भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्.
28269: भरण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be cherished or protected. n. (-ण्यं) 1 Wages, hire. 2 Cherishing, maintaining. 3 The asterism Bharaṇī. f. (-ण्या) A woman. E. भरण maintaining, and यत् aff.
28270: भरण्यभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) A labourer, a hireling, one who works for hire. E. भरण्य wages or hire, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.
28271: भरण्याह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, commonly Rāmadūtī.
28272: भरण्यु m. (-ण्युः) 1 A master, a protector. 2 The sun. E. भृ to nourish, अन्यु aff.
28273: भरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Upholding, supporting, having, cherishing. E. भृ to cherish, शतृ aff.
28274: भरत m. (-तः) 1 The younger brother of RĀMA. 2 The son of DUṢYANTA by ŚAKUNTALĀ. 3 The name of a sage or Muni, 4 The name of a celebrated writer on dramatic composition, of which he is also sometimes considered as the inventor; the term is also applied to his work, which appears to have been a body of Sūtras, or rules, relating to every branch of theatrical writing and exhibition; it is said to be lost, but is constantly quoted by the commentators on the Nāṭakas, or Indian dramas. 5 An actor, a dancer, a mime, 6 A barbarian, a mountaineer, a savage. 7 A weaver. 8 A descendant of BHARATA. E. भृ to nourish, अतच् Uṇādi aff.
28275: भरतपुत्त्रक m. (-कः) An actor, a mime. E. भरत the dramatic author, पुत्त्र a son, and कन् aff. of comparison.
28276: भरतप्रसू f. (-सूः) A name of KAIKEYĪ, wife of DAŚARATHA, and mother of BHARATA. E. भरत as above, and प्रसू parent; hence equally applicable to ŚAKUNTALĀ, &c.
28277: भरतवर्ष n. (-र्षं) India. E. भरत the son of DUṢYANTA, and वर्ष region; he is supposed to have been the first emperor or monarch of all India.
28278: भरताग्रज m. (-जः) A name of RĀMA. E. भरत, and अग्रज elder.
28279: भरथ m. (-थः) A sovereign, a king. E. भृ to nourish, aff. अथ्.
28280: भरद्वाज m. (-जः) 1 A skylark. 2 The name of a Muni. 3 The son of VṚHASPATI. E. भरत् upholding, and वाज a wing; also भारद्वाज.
28281: भरद्वाजक n. (-कः) A lark. E. कन् added to the preceding.
28282: भरित mfn. (-तः-ता or ती-तं) 1 Green, of a green colour. 2 Nourished. 3 Filled. E. भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. उ.
28283: भरिमन् m. (-मा) Nourishing, cherishing. E. भृ to nourish, aff. इमनिच्.
28284: भरु m. (-रुः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 Gold. 4 A husband, a lord. E. भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. उ.
28285: भरुज m. (-जः) A small sort of Shakal.
28287: भर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Light, lustre. 3 A name of BRAHMĀ. 4 Cooking, frying. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. घञ्; having scorched KĀMADEVA to ashes, with a look.
28288: भर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Frying. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. ल्युट्.
28289: भर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cherished or maintained. E. भृ to nourish, aff. तव्य.
28290: भर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्त्री-र्त्तृ) 1 A cherisher, a nourisher, a protector. 2 A holder, a supporter. m. (-र्त्ता) 1 A husband. 2 A lord, a master. E. भृ to nourish, &c. aff. तृच्.
28291: भर्त्तृघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) The murderess of her husband. E. भर्त्तृ a husband, हन to kill, aff. ङीष्, and घ्न substituted for the radical.
28292: भर्त्तृता f. (-ता) 1 Masterhood. 2 Husbandship. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, भर्त्तृत्वं.
28293: भर्त्तृताङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subject, married. E. भर्त्तृता 2nd case, and गत gone.
28294: भर्त्तृदारक m. (-कः) A young prince, designated as successor, and associated to the empire, (in theatrical language.) f. (-का) (In theatrical language,) A princess. E. भर्त्तृ the master or monarch, and दारक the son.
28295: भर्त्तृहरि m. (-रिः) The brother of VIKRAMĀDITYA, A prince and poet. E. भर्त्तृ a prince, and हरि VIṢṆU, a deity amongst kings.
28296: भर्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Maintained, nourished, supported. E. भृ to nourish, क्ति aff. and मप् added.
28297: भर्त्स r. 10th cl. (भर्त्सयति-ते) To reprove, to reproach, to abuse or menace.
28298: भर्त्सन n. (-नं) 1 Threat, menace. 2 Reproach, abuse, cursing, reviling. E. भर्त्स to abuse, aff. ल्युट्.
28300: भर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) 1 Gold. 2 Hire, wages. 3 The navel. 4 A particular coin. E. भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. मन्, whence it is properly भर्म्भन्, q. v.
28301: भर्म्मण्या f. (-ण्या) Wages, hire. E. भर्म्भन् hire, यत् aff.
28302: भर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मं) 1 Wages, hire. 2 Gold. 3 The navel. 4 A coin, a piece of money. E. भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. मन्.
28303: भर्व r. 1st cl. (भर्वति) To hurt, to injure.
28304: भल r. 1st and 10th cls. (भलते भलयते) To describe, to expound, to explain. r. 1st cl. 1 To hurt, to injure. 2 To give. r. 10th cl. To throw up.
28306: भल्ल r. 1st cl. (भल्लते) 1 To tell, to describe. 2 To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. 3 To give.
28307: भल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A bear. mn. (-ल्लः-ल्लं) A kind of arrow. f. (-ल्ली) 1 An arrow, with a crescent-shaped head. 2 The marking nut plant; also भल्लातकी. E. भल्ल to hurt or kill, aff. अच्.
28308: भल्लक m. (-कः) A bear. E. कन् added to the preceding.
28309: भल्लपुच्छी f. (-च्छी) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. भल्ल a bear, पुच्छ a tail; to which the flower is compared.
28310: भल्लात m. (-तः) Marking nut plant. E. see the next.
28311: भल्लातक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) The marking nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) E. भल्ल an arrow, अत to resemble, aff. घञ् with कन् added; wounding like a weapon; also भल्लात, भल्ली, &c.
28312: भल्लिका f. (-का) Marking nut. E. कन् added to भल्ली.
28313: भल्लूक m. (-कः) A bear. E. भल्ल to hurt, aff. उक; also भल्लूक.
28314: भल्लूक m. (-कः) A bear. E. भल्ल to injure, Uṇādi aff. ऊक; also भाल्लुक and भल्लुक.
28315: भव m. (-वः) 1 Being, existing, the self-support of something already produced. 2 Birth. 3 Origin, production. 4 The place or means of being. 5 The state of being. 6 The being or becoming possessed of any thing, as family, cattle, &c. 7 Welfare, prosperity. 8 Obtaining, acquisition. 9 Excellence, superiority. 10 The world. 11 A deity, a god. 12 A name of ŚIVA. n. (-वं) A fruit, the fruit of the Dillenia speciosa. E. भू to be, aff. अच्.
28316: भवघस्मर m. (-रः) Fire in a forest. E. भव being, घस्मर voracious.
28317: भवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Thou; but used as a respectful term of address, as Sir or Lord, and governing the verb in the third person. E. भा to shine, डवतुप Uṇādi aff. mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Being, existing. f. (-न्ती) A poisoned arrow. E. भृ to be, participial aff. शतृ.
28318: भवदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Yours, your honour's. E. भवत् as above, and छ aff.
28319: भवद्भी mfn. (-द्भीः-द्भिः-द्भि) Afraid. E. भवत् being, and भी fear.
28320: भवन n. (-नं) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 A nature, a quality. 3 The place of abiding or being, site, field, spot, &c. E. भू to be, aff. ल्युट्.
28321: भवनाशिनी f. (-नी) The Seryu or Serju river, which runs from the Himāla chain and falls into the Goggrah, with which it is then confounded. E. भव being, and नाशिनी destructress; giving eternal happiness, being a sacred stream.
28322: भवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be or become, what is or ought to be. E. भू to be, अनीयर् aff. of the gerund.
28323: भवनोदर n. (-रं) The interior apartments. E. भवन, and उदर belly.
28324: भवन्त m. (-न्तः) Time in general, or time present. f. (-न्ती) A virtuous wife. E. भू to be, Uṇādi aff. झच्.
28325: भवन्ति m. (-न्तिः) Time being, the present. E. भू to be, Uṇādi aff. झिच्.
28326: भवभाज् mfn. (-क्) Living, sharing the world. E. भव, and भाज् who possesses.
28327: भवभूति m. (-तिः) The author of MĀLATĪMĀDHAVA, and other dramas. E. भव the world, भूति increase, in wisdom, &c.
28328: भवरुद् f. (-रुद् or -रुत्) A drum played at funerals. E. भव being, रुद् to weep or wail, aff. क्विप्.
28329: भववीति f. (-तिः) 1 Liberation from the world, cessation from worldly acts. 2 End of the world. E. भव, and वीति passing away.
28331: भवादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Like you, your like. E. भवत् you, दृश् to shew, aff. क्विप्; also भवादृश, and भवादृक्ष.
28332: भवानी f. (-नी) The goddess PĀRVATĪ or DURGĀ, in her pacific and amiable form. E. भव ŚIVA, fem. aff. ङीप्, and आनुक् augment.
28333: भवानीगुरु m. (-रुः) The personified Himālaya mountain. E. भवानी the goddess, and गुरु here put for father: DURGĀ in this form being the daughter of the mountain.
28334: भवाभाव m. (-वः) 1 Non-existence of the world. 2 A sage, one unaffected by worldly infirmities. E. भव, and अभाव nonexistence.
28335: भवाभिभाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Superior to or overcoming the world. E. भव, and अभिभाविन् disgracing.
28336: भवायना f. (-ना) The Ganges. E. भव the world, and अयन going.
28337: भविक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Prosperous, happy, welfaring. n. (-कं) Prosperity, welfare. E. भव being, (for well being,) and ठन् aff.
28338: भवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Been, become. E. भव being, इतच् aff.
28339: भवितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be or become, what is to be. E. भू to be, तव्य aff. of the gerund.
28340: भवितव्यता f. (-ता) Fate, destiny. E. भवितव्य what is to be, तल् abstract aff.
28341: भवितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Actually being, or disposed to be. 2 Wellbeing, faring well. E. भू to be, तृच् aff.
28342: भविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living, being, having life and sensation. E. भव being, इनि aff.
28343: भविन m. (-नः) A poet, a versifier. E. भव the world, इनन् aff.
28344: भविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Being, existing, what is or exists. m. (-लः) A catamite. E. भू to be, इलच् Uṇādi aff.
28345: भविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Actually being or disposed to be. 2 Being well, existing happily, virtuously, &c. E. भू to be, इष्णुच् participial aff.
28346: भविष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Future, what will be. E. see भविष्यत्, the final rejected.
28347: भविष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) What is to be, what will be, future. n. (-ष्यत्) The future. E. भू to be, शतृ participial aff., स्य augment, and इट् inserted.
28348: भव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Happy, auspicious, prosperous. 2 Well, proper, fit, right. 3 True. 4 To be or become, what is to be. 5 A being, what is or exists. m. (-व्यः) The Kāmaraṅga, a small fruit tree, (Averhoa carambola.) f. (-व्या) 1 A name of UMĀ. 2 A large sort of pepper. n. (-व्यं) 1 A bone. 2 Fruit, result. 3 Being, existence. mn. (-व्यः-व्यं) One division of the poetical Rasas or sentiments. E. भू to be, aff. यत्.
28349: भशिरा f. (-रा) A sort of beet, (Beta Bengalensis.)
28350: भष r. 1st cl. (-भषति) 1 To bark or growl. 2 To reproach, to speak malevolently, to rail.
28351: भष m. (-षः) A dog. f. (-षी) A bitch. E. भष to bark. aff. अच्.
28352: भषक m. (-कः) A dog. E. भष to bark, वुन् aff.; it is sometimes written भसक.
28353: भषण n. (-णं) Barking. E. भष to bark, aff. ल्युट्.
28354: भषत् m. (-त्) 1 The heart. 2 Wood. 3 The thigh.
28355: भस r. 3d cl. (वभस्ति) 1 To shine. 2 To blame or abuse; this root is usually restricted to the Vedas.
28356: भसद् f. (-सद्) 1 The sun. 2 Pudendum muliebre. 3 The mons veneris. 4 Time. 5 A sort of duck. 6 A float, a raft. E. भस to shine, अदि Uṇādi aff.
28357: भसन m. (-नः) A large bee. E. भस to sound, युच् aff.
28358: भसन्त m. (-न्तः) Time. E. भस to shine, aff. झच्.
28359: भसित n. (-तं) Ashes. E. भस to shine, aff. क्त.
28360: भसूचक m. (-कः) An astronomer or astrologer. E. भ a star, सूचक an intelligencer.
28361: भस्त्रका f. (-का) A bellows. E. कन् added to भस्त्रा; also भस्त्रिका, and भस्त्राका.
28362: भस्त्रा f. (-स्त्रा) A bellows, a large hide with valves, and a clay nozzle, which is used for this purpose. E. भस to shine, त्रन Uṇādi aff., fem. aff. टाप्; also with ङीष् aff. भस्त्री, and with कन् in the fem. form added भस्त्रका or भस्त्रिका optionally; and with the feminine termination retained also, भस्त्राका.
28363: भस्त्राका f. (-का) A bellows: see the last.
28364: भस्त्रिक mf. (-कः-की) A bellows-blower, &c. m. (-कः) An inflated skin on which rafts, &c. are floated. f. (-का) A bellows: see भस्त्र. E. भस्त्र a bellows, and ठन् aff.
28365: भस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A bellows: see भस्त्रा, &c.
28366: भस्मक n. (-कं) 1 A disease of the eyes, thickening of the membranes, and indistinctness of vision. 2 Morbid appetite, constant craving for food, with general decay. 3 An anthelmintic plant, commonly Bireng. 4 Gold. E. भस्मन् ashes, कन् aff.
28367: भस्मकार m. (-रः) A washerman. E. भह्मन् ashes, and कार agent; using the ashes of wood in place of soap or ley.
28368: भस्मगन्धिका f. (-का) A perfume, commonly Reṇukā. E. भस्मन् ashes, and गन्ध smell, aff. कन्, and टाप्; also भस्मगन्धिनी.
28369: भस्मगर्भा f. (-र्भ) 1 The Sisu tree, or a variety of it, (Dalbergia Sisu.) 2 A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā. E. भस्म ashes, and गर्भ place of production.
28370: भस्मतूल n. (-लं) 1 A number of villages. 2 A shower of dust. 3 Frost or snow. E. भस्म ashes, तूल to weigh, and aff. क.
28371: भस्मन् n. (-स्म) Ashes. E. भस to shine, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्.
28372: भस्मवेधक m. (-कः) Camphor. E. भस्म ashes, and वेधक distresser; whiter than ashes.
28373: भस्मसात् ind. Ashes, to ashes, as स भस्मसाच्चकारारीन् He reduced the enemies to ashes. E. भस्मन्, and साति aff.
28374: भस्माह्वय m. (-यः) Camphor. E. भस्मन् ashes, आह्वय a name.
28375: भस्मीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Reducing to ashes. 2 Calcining. E. भह्म, and करण doing, च्चि aug.
28376: भस्मीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reduced to ashes. 2 Calcined, (as a metal.) E. भस्म, and कृत made, with च्चि aug.; also भस्मकृत and भस्मसात्कृत.
28377: भस्मीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reduced to ashes. 2 Being mere ashes, i. e. being wholly worthless. E. भस्मन्, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
28378: भा r. 2nd cl. (-भाति) 1 To shine, to be luminous, splendid or beautiful. 2 To be pleased. 3 To be angry. 4 To blow. 5 To be, to exist. With आङ्, to flash. With प्र or वि, to shine brightly.
28379: भा f. (-भा) 1 Light. 2 Beauty. 3 The shadow of a gnomon. m. (भाः) The sun. E. भा to shine, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
28380: भाकूट m. (-टः) 1 A mountain, apparently the part of the Himālaya, called Bhākūr. 2 A sort of fish. E. भा light, कूट peak or quantity.
28381: भाकोष m. (-षः) The sun. E. भा light, कोष receptacle.
28382: भाक्त m. (-क्तः) 1 A follower, a dependant, one to whom food is regularly given. 2 Grain, edible grain, as rice, &c. E. भक्त food, aff. अण्.
28383: भाक्तिक m. (-कः) One who is fed by another, a dependant, a retainer. E. भक्त food, aff. ठक्.
28384: भाग m. (-गः) 1 A portion, a share, a part. 2 Fate, fortune, luck. 3 A half rupee. 4 Part of any thing given as interest. 5 A division of time, the thirtieth part of a Rāśi or zodiacal sign. 6 A degree, the 360th part of the circumference of a great circle. 7 A fraction. E. भज to share, aff. घञ्.
28385: भागक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what divides. m. (-कः) (In arithmetic), A divisor. E. भज, and ण्वुल् aff.
28386: भागजाति f. (-तिः) Assimilation of fractions. E. भाग, and जाति species.
28387: भागधेय m. (-यः) 1 An heir, a co-heir. 2 Royal revenue. n. (-यं) Fate, destiny, luck. E. भाग a part, and घेय to be taken, or घेय aff.
28388: भागन n. (-नं) 1 The period, during which the sun passes through the twelve signs of the zodiac, thence by ellipsis, the zodiac. 2 The circumference of a great circle. E. भाग to divide, aff. ल्युट्.
28389: भागशस् ind. According to a share or portion, in parts or portions. E. भाग, and शसि aff.
28390: भागहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Taking a part, sharing. m. (-रः) 1 A coheir. 2 (In arithmetic,) Division. E. भाग, and हर who or what takes.
28391: भागार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिणी-र्थि) Desirous of a share. E. भाग, and अर्थिन् who seeks.
28392: भागानुबन्धजाति f. (-तिः) Assimilation of fractional increase. E. भाग, अनुवन्ध accession, जाति kind.
28393: भागापवाहजाति f. (-तिः) Assimilation of fractional decrease. E. भाग, अपवाह taking away, जाति kind.
28394: भागिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Bearing interest, subject to a deduction for interest. 2 Having a part. 3 Relating to a part. 4 Fractional. E. भाग a part, and ठन् aff.
28395: भागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Who or what shares. 2 Having parts, consisting of parts or shares. mf. (-गी-गिनी) A co-heir or co-heiress. E. भाग, and इनि aff.
28396: भागिनेय m. (-यः) A sister's son. E. भगिनी a sister, ढक् aff.
28397: भागीरथी f. (-थी) The Ganges. E. भगीरथ a pious monarch, at whose intercession the Ganges first descended from heaven, affs. अण् and ङीप्.
28399: भाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 To be portioned or divided. 2 Bearing interest, subject to a deduction of some part on that account. n. (-ग्यं) Destiny, fortune, good or ill luck. E. भज to divide, ण्यत् aff.; or भाग a part, and यत् added.
28400: भाङ्गीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bearing hemp, (a field, &c.) E. भङ्ग hemp, and खञ् aff.
28401: भाज् mfn. (भाक्) Who or what participates or possesses, used chiefly in composition, as धनभाज् rich, &c. E. भाज् to divide, and क्विप् aff.
28402: भाज r. 10th cl. (भाजयति) To divide, to separate; it is usually employed with वि prefixed, especially in a legal sense, as to divide or portion an inheritance.
28404: भाजन n. (-नं) 1 Any vessel, as a pot or cup, a plate, &c. 2 A clever, capable, or fit person. 3 Sharing, dividing. 4 (In arithmetic,) Division. E. भज to serve or share, aff. ल्युट्.
28405: भाजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Divided, portioned. n. (-तं) A portion, a share. E. भाज to divide, aff. क्त.
28406: भाज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Divisible, to be portioned or divided. n. (-ज्यं) 1 A portion, a share, an inheritance. 2 (In arithmetic,) The dividend. E. भाज to divide, aff. यत्.
28407: भाटक m. (-कः) Price, especially paid for the use of any thing or person; wages, hire. E. भट to hire or maintain, aff. ण्वुल्.
28408: भाटि f. (-ठिः) Wages, hire, fee. E. भट to hire, इञ् aff.
28409: भाण m. (-णः) A sort of dramatic entertainment, described as one, in which one only of the interlocutors appears on the scene; or as the narrative of some intrigue, told either by the hero or a third person. E. भण to speak, aff. घञ्.
28410: भाणिका f. (-का) A comic drama in one act. E. भाण, and कन् dimin. aff.
28411: भाण्ड m. (-ण्डं) 1 Any vessel, a pot, a cup, a plate, &c. 2 Any musical instrument. 3 Any implement or utensil. 4 Capital, principal. 5 An ornament in general. 6 An ornament round a horse's neck and breast. 7 The bed of a river, the space between its banks. 8 Mimickry, buffoonery, the practice of the Bhaṇḍa or professional jester. m. (-ण्डः) A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides.) E. भदि to be auspicious, aff. अच्, or भण to sound, aff. ड, deriv. irr., or भण्ड a jester, and अण् aff.
28412: भाण्डक m. (-कः) A cup, a plate, a vessel, or utensil. n. (-कं) Goods, merchandise. E. भाण्ड, and कन् added.
28413: भाण्डपुट m. (-टः) A barber. E. भाण्ड a vessel, पुट to rub, aff. क.
28414: भाण्डपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A sort of snake.
28415: भाण्डप्रतिभाण्डक m. (-कः) Rule of barter, (in arithmetic.) E. भाण्ड, and प्रति for, again, भाण्डक goods.
28416: भाण्डप्रतिभाण्डक m. (-कः) The contents of any vessel. E. भाण्ड, and भरक what fills.
28417: भाण्डवादन n. (-नं) Playing on musical instruments. E. भाण्ड, and वादन sounding.
28418: भाण्डागार m. (-रः) A store-room, a place where household goods and utensils are kept. n. (-रं) A treasury. E. भाण्ड a vessel, and आगार a house.
28419: भाण्डिक m. (-कः) A musician, one especially who is to waken the prince or chief in the morning, by vocal, or instrumental music. E. भाण्ड a vessel, (an instrument,) and ठक् aff.
28420: भाण्डिन् mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि) Having a vessel, utensil, &c. E. भाण्ड, and इनि aff.
28421: भाण्डिवाह m. (-हः) A barber. E. भाण्डि for भाण्डी having a bason, and वाह who works or labours.
28422: भाण्डिल m. (-लः) A barber. E. भाण्ड a vessel, and इलच् aff.
28423: भाण्डीर m. (-रः) The Indian fig tree. E. भाण्ड a vessel, ईर to bring, aff. क; referable perhaps to the legend that describes the infant KṚṢṆA, taking his meals under a tree of this kind in the woods of Vṛndāvana.
28424: भात् mfn. (-भान्-भान्ती-भाती-भात्) Shining, splendid. E. भा to shine, शतृ aff.
28425: भात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shone, bright, resplendent. m. (-तः) Morning, dawn. E. भा to shine, aff. क्त.
28426: भातु m. (-तुः) The sun. E. भा to shine, तु Uṇādi aff.
28427: भाद्र m. (-द्रः) The name of a month, (August-September,) when the moon is full near the wing of Pegasus. E. भद्र for भद्रपदा, and अण् aff.: see the next.
28428: भाद्रपद m. (-दः) The month Bhādra. E. भद्रपदा the asterism, and अण् aff. f. (-दा) A name common to the twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithets prior, and subsequent, or पूर्व्व and उत्तरः see पूर्व्वभाद्रपदा, &c. E. भद्रा said to mean a cow, and पद foot, अण् added optionally, whence it is often read भद्रपदा.
28429: भाद्रमातुर m. (-रः) The son of a virtuous and loyal wife. E. भद्र auspicious, मातृ a mother, aff. अण्.
28430: भानु m. (-नुः) 1 The sun. 2 Light. 3 A ray of light. 4 A master. 5 A sovereign, a prince. 6 The father of the fifteenth Jaina pontiff. 7 Beauty. f. (-नुः) A handsome woman. E. भा to shine, Uṇādi aff. नु.
28431: भानुफला f. (-ला) The plantain, (Musa sapientum.) E. भानु the sun, फल the fruit; being offered in the worship of the sun.
28432: भानुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Luminous, splendid, resplendent. 2 Beautiful, handsome. m. (-मान्) The sun. E. भानु light, मतुप् poss. aff.
28433: भानुवार m. (-रः) Sunday. E. भानु the sun, and वार a day.
28434: भानेमि m. (-मिः) The sun. E. भा light, नेमि circumference.
28435: भाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Bright, (as a planet.) E. भ, and आभा light.
28436: भाम r. 1st cl. (भामते) r. 10th cl. (भामयति) To be angry or wrathful, to be impatient.
28437: भाम m. (-मः) 1 Passion, wrath. 2 Light, lustre. 3 The sun. 4 A sister's husband. f. (-मा) A passionate woman. E. भा to shine, and मन् Uṇādi aff.; or भाम to be angry, aff. अच्.
28438: भामक m. (-कः) A sister's husband. E. कन् added to the preceding.
28439: भामिन् mfn. (-मी-भिनी-मि) Angry, passionate. f. (-नी) A passionate woman. E. भाम passion, इनि aff.
28440: भार m. (-रः) 1 A weight of gold, equal to two thousand Palas. 2 A yoke for carrying burthens. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. 4 A weight, a burthen. E. भृ to nourish, aff. घञ्.
28441: भारत n. (-तं) 1 Bhāratavarṣa or India proper, so called from BHARATA, the son of DUṢYANTA, whose patrimony it was. (E. भरत the prince, and अण् aff.) 2 The great sacred epic poem of the Hindus. (E. भार weight, त aff., भारत; having been put by the Ṛṣis in a scale, and weighed against the four Vedas which it was found to outweigh; thence its usual prefix of Mahā or great: a special grammatical rule, however, derives it from भरत the prince so named, because the war narrated in it occurred amongst his descendants.) m. (-तः) 1 An actor, a mime. 2 A name of fire. 3 A descendant of BHARATA. f. (-ती) 1 The goddess of speech. 2 Speech. 3 A quail. 4 A branch of the dramatic art, dramatic recitation or declamation, the delivery of the dialogue that is composed in elaborate Sanscrit stanzas. E. भरत the inventor of the Indian drama, aff. अण्; or the name of a sage, whose devotions brought the goddess SARASVATĪ from heaven; or again, भॄ to nourish, aff. अतच्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
28442: भारद्वाज m. (-जः) 1 A name of DROṆA, the military preceptor of the Kurus, and Pāṇḍus. 2 One of the seven Ṛṣis. 3 A name of the Muni AGASTYA. 4 The son of VṚHASPATI. 5 A skylark. n. (-जं) A bone. f. (-जी) Wild cotton. E. भरद्वाज a lark, and अण् pleonastick or derivative aff.; in the latter case it refers to a legend of the Ṛṣi BHARADVĀJA having been nursed by a lark, in consequence of being abandoned at his birth by his natural parents.
28444: भारयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A pole or yoke for carrying burthens; a stick carried over the shoulder, with strings attached to either end of it, forming at their lower extremity a noose, in which the articles to be conveyed are suspended. E. भार a burthen, and यष्टि a stick.
28445: भारव n. (-वं) A bow-string. f. (-वी) Holy basil. E. भार a weight, वा to take, aff. क.
28446: भारवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Loaded, burthened, bearing a burthen. E. भार, and मतुप् aff.
28447: भारवाह m. (-हः) A porter, a bearer of burthens. E. भार a burthen, वह to bear, aff. अण्.
28448: भारवाहन m. (-नः) A beast of burthen, (as a camel, &c.) n. (-नं) A vehicle for burthens, a waggon. E. भार, and वाहन vehicle.
28449: भारवाहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carrying burthens. m. (-कः) A porter. E. भारवाह, and ठक् aff.
28450: भारवाहिन् m. (-ही) A porter. E. भार, and वाहिन् who bears.
28451: भारवि m. (-विः) The name of a poet, the author of the Kirātārjunīya.
28452: भारवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A fragrant substance, commonly Kākṣi, considered variously as a vegetable or mineral product.
28453: भारसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Able to carry loads. 2 Fit for the yoke. E. भार, and सह what bears.
28454: भारहर m. (-रः) A porter. E. भार a burthen, and हर who takes, from हृ with ट aff.; also with अण् aff. भारहार, and कन् added, भारहारक; or with घिनुण, भारहारिन्.
28455: भारहार m. (-रः) 1 A porter. 2 Carrying a load. E. see the last.
28456: भारहारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bearing a load, relating or referring to it, &c. E. भारहार, and ठक् aff.
28457: भाराक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Loaded, laden, bearing a burthen. f. (-न्ता) A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre. E. भार, and आक्रान्त overcome.
28458: भारि m. (-रिः) A lion. E. भॄ to threaten, aff. इन्.
28459: भारिक m. (-कः) A porter. E. भार a burthen, ठक् aff.
28460: भारिन् m. (-री) A porter. E. भार a burthen, and इनि aff.
28461: भारोद्धरण n. (-णं) Taking up or bearing a burthen. E. भार, and उद्धरण taking up.
28462: भारोद्वहन n. (-नं) Bearing a load. E. भार, and उद्वहन up lifting.
28463: भार्गव m. (-वः) 1 A name of PARAŚURĀMA. 2 A name of ŚUKRA regent of VENUS, and preceptor of the Titans or demons. 3 An archer. 4 An elephant. f. (-वी) 1 The goddess PĀRVATĪ. 2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 3 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon, the Agrostis linearis of LINNÆUS; according to the Hindus, a black variety.) E. भृगु a Muni, the ancestor of PARAŚURĀMA, &c., and अण् aff. of descent.
28464: भार्गवप्रिय m. (-यः) The diamond. E. भार्गव ŚUKRA, and प्रिय fond of.
28465: भार्गी f. (-र्गी) A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. भर्ग BRAHMĀ, and अण् aff., sacred to that deity.
28466: भार्द्वाजी f. (-जी) Wild cotton. E. a various reading of भारद्वाजी as above.
28467: भार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A wife, espoused according to the ritual of the Vedas. E. भॄ to nourish, ण्यत् aff.
28468: भार्य्याट m. (-टः) A man who lets out his wife for prostitution. E. भार्य्या wife, अट to go, aff. अच्; who lives by his wife.
28469: भार्य्याटिक m. (-कः) 1 A henpecked husband, one overruled by his wife. 2 A kind of deer. E. भार्य्या a wife, अट to go or be with, aff. अच्, भार्य्याट, and ठक् added.
28470: भार्य्यातिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Adultery. 2 Connubial intercourse. E. भार्य्या, and अतिक्रम approaching.
28471: भार्य्यात्व n. (-त्वं) The condition or state of a wife. E. भार्य्या, and त्व aff.
28472: भार्य्यापति m. dual only. (-ती) Husband and wife. E. भार्य्या wife, and पति a husband.
28473: भार्य्यारु m. (-रुः) 1 The name of a mountain. 2 A sort of deer. 3 The father of a child by another man's wife. E. भार्य्या a wife, ऋ to go to or with, उ aff.
28474: भार्य्योढ m. (-ढः) Married. E. भार्य्या, and ऊढ married.
28475: भाल m. (-लः) 1 The forehead. 2 Light, lustre. E. भल to explain, and अञ् aff., a man's fortunes being supposed to be legible on his forehead; or भा to shine, aff. लच्.
28476: भालदर्शन n. (-नं) Red lead. E. भाल, and दर्शन appearing; being used to stain the forehead with particular lines, and marks.
28477: भालदृश् m. (-दृक्) A name of ŚIVA. E. भाल, and दृश् the eye, having the third eye in his forehead; also similar compounds, as भाललोचन, &c.
28478: भालाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A sort of fish, commonly the Rohi, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 2 A saw. 3 A sort of potherb. 4 A man born with lucky lines on his forehead. 5 A tortoise. 6 A name of ŚIVA. E. भाल the forehead, and अङ्क a spot or mark.
28479: भाल्लुक m. (-कः) A bear. E. भल्ल to injure, aff. उकञ् or ऊकञ्, whence also भाल्लूक; and with उक aff. भल्लुक, भल्लूक, &c., q. v.
28480: भाव m. (-वः) 1 State or condition of being. 2 Natural state of being, innate property, disposition, nature. 3 Meaning, purpose, intention. 4 Mind, soul. 5 State or affection of mind, emotion, passion, sentiment, especially as an object of amatory and dramatic poetry; two kinds of Bhāvas are usually enumerated, the Sthāyi, and Vyabhicārī; the first of which comprehends eight varieties, and the second thirty-three; the list blends both feelings and effects, and sorrow, and sleep, and passion, and death, &c. are equally classed amongst the Bhāvas; dramatic writers add two other classes, the Vi- bhāvas or preceding states of mind, leading to a particular condition of mind or body, and Anubhāvas the external signs of any state of mind. 6 Birth. 7 Act, action. 8 Movement, gesture. 9 Wanton sport or pastime. 10 Corporeal expression of amorous sentiments; or love, of which the origin and effects are ascribed to the organs of the body. 11 Thing, substance. 12 A being, a living thing. 13 The place of birth, or pudendum muliebre. 14 Superhuman power. 15 The abstract idea conveyed by any word. 16 The simple idea derived from the root, as expressed in one class of derivatives, as a going, a doing, &c. 17 Advice, instruction. 18 A learned man, a Paṇḍita, (in theatrical language; but especially applied to the manager, or principal performer.) 19 Venerable, respectable. 20 The world, the universe. 21 An organ of sense or passion. E. भू to be, aff. घञ्.
28481: भावक m. (-कः) The external expression of amatory sentiments. E. कन् added to the last.
28482: भावज m. (-जः) Love, KĀMA. E. भाव sentiment, and ज produced.
28483: भावत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Yours, your honour's. E. भवत् you, and अण् aff.
28484: भावत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Yours, (but used respectfully,) your honour's. E. भवत् you, and ठक् aff.
28485: भावन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Mental perception, recollection, the present consciousness of past ideas or perceptions. 2 Imagination. 3 Religious and abstract meditation. 4 Looking about, (literally or figuratively,) observing, investigating. 5 Causing to be. 6 Decorating any person or object with flowers, perfume, &c., scenting, anointing. 7 Steeping, infusion, especially repeatedly drying the article by day and keeping it moist at night. 8 (In arithmetic,) Composition. 9 (In law,) Ascertainment, proof. E. भू to be, in the causal form, to bring present or into being, aff. युच्.
28486: भावबोधक m. (-कः) The sign or indication of any sentiment or passion. E. भाव sentiment, and बोधक what indicates.
28487: भावयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Fancying, imagining, calling to mind. E. भू to be, causal v., शतृ aff.
28488: भावशवलता f. (-ता) Co-existence of various emotions. E. भाव, and शवलता variety of colour.
28489: भावशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Allaying, any transitory or incidental emotion. E. भाव, and शान्ति quieting.
28490: भावसंशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Purification of the natural condition or quality. E. भाव, and संशुद्धि purification.
28491: भावसन्धि m. (-न्धिः) Co-existence of two emotions. E. भाव, and सन्धि union.
28492: भावसमाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Of restrained purpose or thought, abstracted, devout. E. भाव, and समाहित collected.
28493: भावाट m. (-टः) 1 The external expression or indication of amatory feeling. 2 A pious or holy man. 3 An actor. 4 A libidinous man. 5 Dress, decoration. E. भाव the sentiment or disposition, अट to go with, aff. अच्.
28494: भावानुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Natural, simple, not forced or assumed. E. भाव, and अनुग according to.
28495: भावाभास m. (-सः) Simulation of feeling or emotion. E. भाव, and आभास appearance.
28496: भावार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 The simple inherent or abstract meaning of words. 2 The obvious purport of a phrase or sentence. E. भाव, and अर्थ sense.
28497: भावाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Tender, compassionate. E. भाव, and अव what preserves.
28498: भाविक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Natural, innate. 2 Sentimental, relating to feeling, &c. 3 Future. n. (-कं) A figure of rhetoric, describing the past or future as present. E. भाव, and ठक् aff., or भू to be, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
28499: भावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Occupied with, pervaded by, having as an inherent or pervading property. 2 Animated, inspired. 3 Imagined, conceived. 4 Perfumed, scented. 5 Mixed, (with any thing as an ingredient, as asafoetida or other fragrant substances in curry, &c.) 6 Obtained, got. 7 Promised, agreed, acknowledged. 8 Steeped, infused, digested, &c. 9 (In arithmetic,) Supposed, as the product of unknown quantities. E. भू to be, passive or causal v., aff. क्त.
28500: भावितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Imagining, conceiving. 2 Infusing, &c. E. भू to be, causal v., क्तवतु aff.
28501: भावितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Intent upon, engaged in. E. भावित pervaded, आत्मन् spirit.
28502: भावित्र n. (-त्रं) The three worlds: earth, heaven, and hell, collectively. E. भू to exist, णित्रन् Uṇādi aff.
28503: भाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Future, what will be or what is about to be, proximately future. f. (-नी) A wanton woman. E. भू to be, Uṇādi aff. णिनि.
28504: भावोदय m. (-यः) Accession or occurrence of emotions. E. भवा, उदय rising.
28505: भावुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Happy, well, right. 2 Actually being or disposed to be. 3 (In composition with other nouns,) Becoming what it was not before, as आढ्यंभावुक one who becomes rich. n. (-कं) Happiness, auspiciousness. m. (-कः) A sister's husband, (in theatrical language.) E. भू to be, aff. उकञ्; used in composition, the aff. is खुकञ्.
28506: भाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 What must, will, or ought to be. 2 To be investigated or determined. E. भू to be, aff. ण्यत्.
28507: भाष(ऋ)भाषृ r. 1st cl. (भाषते) To speak: with परि prefixed, to explain, to expound; with सम्, to discourse, to converse.
28508: भाषण n. (-णं) 1 Speaking, speech. 2 Declaration of satisfaction at the end of a drama. E. भाष to speak, ल्युट् aff.
28509: भाषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Speaking, saying. E. भाष, and शतृ aff.
28510: भाषमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Speaking, saying. E. भाष to speak, शानच् aff.
28511: भाषा f. (-षा) 1 Speech. 2 Common or vernacular speech. 3 SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech. 4 One of the Rāgiṇīs. E. भाष to speak, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
28512: भाषापाद n. (-दं) The plaint, the charge, the first of the four divisions of a law suit. E. भाषा speech, averment, and पाद quarter, division.
28513: भाषासम m. (-मः) A figure of rhetoric, arrangement of a sentence so that it is both Sanscrit and Prākṛta. E. भाषा, and सम same.
28514: भाषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, uttered, said. n. (-तं) Speech. E. भाष to speak, aff. क्त.
28515: भाष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) To be said or spoken. n. (-ष्यं) 1 A commentary, but particularly the explanation and application of a technical Sūtra or aphorism; hence applied to many of the annotations on the grammatical aphorisms of PĀṆINI, to comments on the Vedas, &c. 2 A sort of building. E. भाष to speak, यत् aff.
28516: भाष्यकर m. (-रः) A commentator or expounder of technical texts or aphorisms; commonly applied as an epithet of PĀTAÑJALI, the author of the Mahābhāṣya or commentary on the annotations of KĀTYĀYANA, on PĀṆINI'S grammatical aphorisms. E. भाष्य as above, and कार who makes; also with कृत्, भाष्यकृत्, the same.
28517: भाष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being spoken to or addressed. E. भाष to speak, pass. v., शानच् aff.
28518: भास(ऋ)भासृ r. 1st cl. (भासते) To shine. With प्र and नि prefixed, To appear to, to seem likely or probable to.
28519: भास् f. (-भाः) 1 Light. 2 A ray of light. 3 Wish, desire. E. भास to shine, aff. क्विप्.
28520: भास mf. (-सः-सा) Light, lustre, shining. m. (-सः) 1 A vulture. 2 A sort of bird, described as a water-fowl. 3 A cock. 4 A station of cowherds. E. भास to shine, अप् aff.
28521: भासन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 1 Beautiful, handsome. 2 Shining, splendid. m. (-न्तः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 A kind of waterfowl. mf. (-न्तः-न्ती) A star. E. भास to shine, झच् Uṇādi aff.
28522: भासयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Shining, radiant. E. भास to shine, शतृ aff.
28523: भासस् n. (-सः) Light, lustre. E. भास to shine, असुन् aff.
28524: भासु m. (-सुः) The sun. E. भास to shine, Uṇādi aff. उ.
28525: भासुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Shining, splendid. n. (-रं) A species of Costus, (C. speciosus.) m. (-रः) 1 Crystal. 2 A hero. E. भास to shine, घुरच् aff.
28526: भास्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Resplendent, shining. m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 A hero. 4 The name of a celebrated astronomer. n. (-रं) Gold. E. भा light, and कृ to make, अच् aff., and स inserted.
28527: भास्करप्रिय n. (-यं) The ruby. E. भास्कर the sun, and प्रिय fond of.
28528: भास्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Luminous, splendid, shining. m. (-स्वान्) 1 The sun. 2 Light. 3 A hero. f. (-स्वता) The city of the sun. E. भास् light, मतुप् aff.
28529: भास्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Shining, radiant. m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 A day. n. (-रं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. भास् to shine, वरच् aff.
28530: भास्मन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Ashy, ashen, made or consisting of ashes. E. भस्मन्, and अण् aff.
28531: भिक्ष r. 1st cl. (भिक्षते) 1 To beg. 2 To obtain. 3 To fail of obtaining. 4 To solicit any thing through cupidity or covetousness. 5 To be weary or distressed.
28532: भिक्षण n. (-णं) Begging, asking alms. E. भिक्ष to beg, ल्युट् aff.
28533: भिक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Asking, begging. E. भिक्ष to beg, शानच् aff.
28534: भिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Service. 2 Hire, wages. 3 Begging, asking. 4 The thing obtained by begging, alms. 5 A mouthful or handful of food, given as alms. E. भिक्ष to beg or obtain by begging, अङ् and टाप् aff.
28535: भिक्षाक mf. (-कः-की) A mendicant, a beggar. E. भिक्षा alms, and काकन् aff.
28536: भिक्षाचर mf. (-रः-री) A mendicant, a beggar. E. भिक्षा alms, चर to go, aff. ट.
28537: भिक्षाटन n. (-नं) Begging, mendicancy. E. भिक्षा alms, and अटन going about for.
28538: भिक्षान्न n. (-न्नं) Food obtained as alms. E. भिक्षा, and अन्न food.
28539: भिक्षापात्र n. (-त्रं) A beggar's bowl, a vessel for collecting alms. E. भिक्षा, and पात्र a vessel.
28540: भिक्षाशित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Profligacy, roguery. 2 Mendicancy, subsisting on alms. E. भिक्षाशिन् a beggar, त्व abstract aff.
28541: भिक्षाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 A beggar, a mendicant, subsisting on alms. 2 Dishonest. E. भिक्षा alms, अश to eat, aff. णिनि.
28542: भिक्षार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Fit for a beggar. E. भिक्षा, and अर्ह fit for.
28543: भिक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Begged, sought as alms. E. भिक्ष to beg, क्त aff.
28544: भिक्षु m. (-क्षुः) 1 The mendicant; the Hindu who has entered the fourth order, and subsists wholly upon alms. 2 The fourth order of the Hindus. 3 A Bauddha mendicant. E. भिक्ष to beg, aff. उ.
28545: भिक्षुक mf. (-कः-की) A beggar. E. भिक्षु a beggar, कन् added.
28546: भिक्षुसंघाटी f. (-टी) Old or ragged raiment, the garb of a beggar. E. भिक्षु a beggar, सम् with, घट to endeavour, aff. अण् and ङीप्.
28547: भिक्षोत्कर m. (-रः) Scattering alms. E. भिक्षा alms, उत् before कॄ to scatter, aff. अप्.
28548: भित्त n. (-त्तं) A part, a portion, a fragment, a bit. E. भिट् to divide, aff. क्त, form irr.
28549: भित्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 A wall of earth or masonry. 2 A thing broken or divided. 3 A place, a part. 4 Opportunity, occasion. 5 An asylum. 6 Breaking, tearing, dividing. 7 A flaw, a defect. 8 A rent, a fissure. 9 A fragment, a bit, a broken piece or part. E. भिद to divide, to break, to tear, &c. aff. क्तिन्.
28550: भित्तिका f. (-का) 1 A wall. 2 A small house lizard. E. कन् added to the preceding.
28551: भित्तिचौर m. (-रः) A house-breaker. E. भित्ति a wall, and चौर a thief; the mud wall of the Hindu cottages being easily and commonly cut through, for burglarious purposes.
28552: भिद्(इर)भिदिर् r. 7th cl. (भिनत्ति-भिंत्ते) To break, to break or tear to pieces.
28553: भिद् mfn. (-भिद् or भित्) Who or what breaks, divides, severs, destroys, &c. f. (-भिट् or भित्) 1 Kind, sort, difference. 2 Breaking, dividing. E. भिद to break, and aff. क्विप्.
28554: भिदक m. (-कः) A sword. n. (-कं) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. भिद to break, aff. क्वुन्.
28555: भिदा f. (-दा) 1 Tearing, rending. 2 Coriander. E. भिद to divide, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
28556: भिदि m. (-दिः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. भिद to break, Uṇādi aff इ, and the vowel unchanged; also भिट्.
28557: भिदिर n. (-रं) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. भिद to break or split, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
28558: भिदु m. (-दुः) The thunderbolt. of INDRA. E. भिद to split, Uṇādi aff. कु.
28559: भिदुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Brittle. n. (-रं) The thunderbolt. E. भिद to break, (the earth, the mountains, &c.) कुरच् aff.
28560: भिदेलिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) To be, or what may be broken. E. भिद to break, केलिमर् aff.
28561: भिद्य m. (-द्यः) A river, a male river. E. भिद to break, (its banks,) क्यप् aff.
28562: भिद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being divided, pierced, broken, &c. 2 Being separated or distinguished. E. भिद to break, pass. v. शानच् aff.
28563: भिद्र mn. (-द्रः-द्रं) The thunderbolt. E. भिद to break, Uṇādi aff. रक्; also भिदु, भिदुर, &c.
28564: भिन्दत् mfn. (-न्दन्-न्दती-न्दत्) Breaking, destroying. E. भिद to break, शतृ aff.
28565: भिन्दपाल m. (-लः) A short arrow thrown from the hand, or shot through a tube.
28566: भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Split, broken, torn, rent. 2 Divided, distinguished, other, different. 3 Separated, detached. 4 Blown, budded, opened. 5 Neglected, deviated from. 6 Connected, joined. m. (-न्नः) A flaw in a jewel. n. (-न्नं) 1 A bit, a portion. 2 (In arithmetic,) A fraction. E. भिद to break, to divide, aff. क्त.
28567: भिन्नक m. (-कः) A heterodox sectary, a Bauddha, a seceder. E. भिन्न broken, separated, and कन् aff.
28568: भिन्नगात्रिका f. (-का) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) E. भिन्न divided, गात्र the body, aff. of comparison कन्.
28569: भिन्नगुणन n. (-नं) Multiplication of fractions. E. भिन्न, and गुणन multiplying.
28570: भिन्नघन n. (-नं) Cube of a fraction. E. भिन्न, and घन a cube.
28571: भिन्नदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Wounded. E. भिन्न, and देह body.
28572: भिन्ननौक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Wrecked. E. भिन्न, and नौका a ship.
28573: भिन्नभागहर m. (-रः) Division of fractions. E. भिन्न, and भागहर division.
28574: भिन्नभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A potsherd, a broken plate or vessel. E. भिन्न, and भाण्ड a vessel.
28576: भिन्नमर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Pierced in the joints, mortally wounded. E. भिन्न, and मर्म्मन् a joint.
28577: भिन्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Divided, scattered. E. भिद to break, क्तवतु aff.
28578: भिन्नवर्ग m. (-र्गः) Square of a fraction. E. भिन्न, and बर्ग a square.
28579: भिन्नवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) 1 Neglecting the prescribed observances. 2 Following an occupation not suited to birth or caste. E. भिन्न, and वृत्ति practice.
28580: भिन्नव्यवकलित n. (-तं) Subtraction of fractions. E. भिन्न, and व्यवकलित subtraction; also भिन्नव्यवकलनं, &c.
28581: भिन्नसङ्कलित n. (-तं) Addition of fractions. E. भिन्न, and सङ्कलित addition; also भिन्नसङ्कलनं, &c.
28582: भिन्नस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hesitating (in speech.) 2 Hoarse, discordant. E. भिन्न, and स्वर a note.
28583: भिया f. (-या) Fear. E. भी to fear, टाप् aff., and इयङ् augment.
28584: भिल r. 10th cl. (भिलयति) To divide or separate.
28585: भिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A barbarian of a particular tribe, perhaps the modern Bheel, a savage race dwelling especially along the course of the Narmadā, and subsisting chiefly by plunder.
28586: भिषग्जित n. (-तं) A drug, a medicament. E. भिषज् a physician, and जित subdued, (by whom.)
28587: भिषज् m. (-षक्) A Vaidya or physician. E. भी to fear, अजि Uṇādi aff., and षुक् augment; or भिषज् a Kaṇḍvādi root, to overcome, (disease,) aff. क्विप्.
28588: भिस्सटा f. (-टा) Scorched rice. E. भिस्सा boiled rice, टीक to go or resemble, ड aff.; this word is variously read भिस्सिटा, भिष्मिटा, भिष्मिष्टा, भिष्मिका.
28589: भिस्सा f. (-स्सा) Boiled rice. E. भिट् to break, aff. क्विप्, षो to destroy, aff. क, and the द of भिट् changed irr. to स; also read भिष्माः see the last.
28590: भी(ञि)ञिभी r. 3rd cl. (बिभेति) To dread, to fear, to be afraid of: also, r. 1st and 10th cls. (भयति भाययति) but not always admitted.
28591: भी f. (भीः) Fear, dread. E. भी to fear, aff. क्विप्.
28592: भीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Afraid, frightened, fearful, timid. n. (-तं) Fear, alarm, apprehension. E. भी to fear, aff. क्त.
28593: भीतङ्कार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Fear-inspiring. E. भीत, and कार making.
28594: भीतभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Much frightened. E. भीत afraid, repeated.
28595: भीतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Afraid. E. भी to fear, क्तवतु aff.
28596: भीति f. (-तिः) 1 Fear, apprehension. 2 Trembling, shaking. E. भी to fear, aff. क्तिन्.
28597: भीम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Horrible, fearful, terrific. n. (-मं) Horror, terror. m. (-मः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 One of the five Pāṇḍu princes. 3 A kind of sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.) f. (-मा) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A whip. 3 A sort of perfume: see रोचना. E. भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. मक्.
28598: भीमकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Dreadful, destructive. E. भीम, and कर्म्मन् act.
28599: भीमदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Frightful, hideous. E. भीम, and दर्शन appearance.
28600: भीमनाद m. (-दः) 1 A lion. 2 A loud or fearful sound. E. भीम formidable, नाद voice.
28601: भीमर m. (-रः) War, battle. E. भीम fear, रा to give or get, aff. क.
28602: भीमरथी f. (-थी) 1 A particular night, supposed to be the ordinary period of human life; the seventh night, in the seventh month, of the seventy-seventh year; a person after this period is exempt from all religious or specific observances. 2 The name of a river in the Himālaya mountains. E. भीम formidable, रथ a car.
28603: भीमविक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Tremendous in power or strength. E. भीम, and विक्रम prowess.
28604: भीमविक्रान्त m. (-न्तः) A lion. E. भीम formidable, विक्रान्त power, valour.
28605: भीमविग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Gigantic, terrific in appearance. E. भीम, and विग्रह body.
28606: भीमवेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Terribly swift or rapid. E. भीम, and वेग speed.
28607: भीमशासन m. (-नः) A name of YAMA. E. भीम formidable, शासन edict.
28608: भीमसेन m. (-नः) The third of the five Pāṇḍu princes. E. भीम formidable, and सेना an army.
28609: भीरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः or -रूः-रु) Timid, fearful. f. (-रुः-रूः) 1 A timid woman. 2 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) 3 A sort of prickly night-shade. 4 A shakal. 5 A centipede. 6 A tiger. 7 A goat. E. भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. क्रु; also र being changed to उ, भीलु.
28610: भीरुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Timid, fearful. 2 Formidable. n. (-कं) A wood, a forest. m. (-कः) 1 An owl. 2 A bear. E. भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. क्रुकन्; also ल being substituted for र, भीलुक.
28611: भीरुचेतस् m. (-ताः) A deer. E. भीरु timid, and चेतस् disposition.
28612: भीरुता f. (-ता) Fear, timidity, fearfulness. E. तल् added to भीरु; also with त्व, भीरुत्वं.
28613: भीरुमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Terrific, frightful. E. भीरु, and मयट् aff.
28614: भीरुरन्ध्र m. (-न्ध्रः) An oven, a furnace. E. भीरु fearful, and रन्ध्र a chasm.
28615: भीरुहृदय m. (-यः) A deer. E. भीरु timid, हृदय the heart.
28616: भीलु mfn. (-लुः-लुः or लूः-लु) Timid, fearful: see भीरु.
28617: भीलुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Timid, fearful. m. (-कः) A bear: see भीरुक.
28618: भीषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Horrible, terrific, formidable. 2 Hard, harsh. 3 Exciting the sentiment of horror, applied to poetical compositions. m. (-णः) The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 2 A name of ŚIVA. n. (-णं) 1 Horror, terror, the property that excites fear. 2 The sentiment of horror as the object of poetical composition. E. भी to fear, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
28619: भीषयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Terrifying, frightening. E. भी to fear, causal v., शानच् aff.
28620: भीषा f. (-षा) Terrifying, frightening, intimidation. E. भी to fear, causal v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
28621: भीष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मा-ष्मं) Horrible, terrific, fearful. n. (-ष्मं) Horror, horribleness, the property of exciting fear or terror. m. (-ष्मः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The grand-uncle of the Pāṇḍus. 3 An imp, a goblin. E. भी to fear, मक् Uṇādi aff. and षुक् augment.
28622: भीष्मसू f. (-सूः) The Ganges. E. भीष्म the prince so named, and सू mother, being the mother of BHĪṢMA by ŚĀNTANU.
28623: भुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Eaten, eating, (either that which is eaten, or the person who has eaten.) 2 Possessed, enjoyed. n. (-क्तं) Food. E. भुज to eat, aff. क्त.
28624: भुक्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having eaten. 2 Having possessed. E. भुज to eat, क्तवतु aff.
28625: भुक्तशेष n. (-षं) Orts, leavings. E. भुक्त, and शेष remainder.
28626: भुक्तसमुज्झित n. (-तं) Orts, leavings, either after a meal or what has dropped from the mouth. E. भुक्त eaten, समुज्झित abandoned.
28627: भुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Eating. 2 Possession, fruition, usufruct. E. भुज to eat, aff. क्तिन्.
28628: भुक्त्वा ind. Having possessed, eaten, enjoyed, &c. E. भुज to eat, क्त्वा aff.
28629: भुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Crooked, curved. 2 Bent, bowed, bending, stooping. E. भुज to curve, aff. क्त.
28630: भुज r. 7th cl. (भुनक्ति भुंक्ते) 1 To save, to cherish or protect. 2 To eat. 3 To enjoy. 4 To suffer or endure. (ओ, ञौ) ओभुजौ r. 6th cl. (भुजति) To bend, to make crooked.
28631: भुज mf. (-जः-जा) 1 The arm. 2 The hand. 3 The arm or leg of a geometrical figure, as a square or triangle. 4 A bending, a curve. E. भुज to bend, aff. क.
28632: भुजकोटर m. (-रः) The armpit. E. भुज the arm, and कोटर a hollow.
28633: भुजग m. (-गः) A snake. E. भुज a curve, and ग who goes.
28634: भुजगदारण m. (-णः) The bird of VIṢṆU. E. भुजग a snake, and दारण destroyer; this word, and similar compounds, may be applied equally to any of the natural enemies of the serpent race, as the ardea, the peacock, the ichneumon, &c. ut infra.
28635: भुजगान्तक m. (-कः) GARUḌA, the bird of VIṢṆU. E. भुजग a snake, and अन्तक destroyer: see the last.
28636: भुजगाभोजिन् m. (-जी) A peacock. E. भुजग a snake, and आभोजिन् who eats: see भुजगदारण.
28637: भुजगाशन m. (-नः) GARUḌA. E. भुजग a snake, and अशन food.
28638: भुजङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A snake. 2 A catamite, a lecher. f. (-ङ्गी) A female snake. E. भुज a curve, गम to go, खच् aff.; also भुजङ्गम.
28639: भुजङ्गघातिनी f. (-नी) A plant considered as an antidote, commonly Kaṅkālika, and said to be a sort of mustard (?). E. भुजङ्ग a snake, घातिनी destructive.
28640: भुजङ्गप्रयात n. (-तं) A species of the Jagatī metre.
28641: भुजङ्गभुज् m. (-क्) 1 The bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 2 A peacock. E. भुजङ्ग a snake, and भुज् who eats.
28642: भुजङ्गभोजिन् m. (-जी) The large Indian serpent, (Böa constrictor.) E. भुजङ्ग a snake, and भोजिन् who eats; devouring the smaller races.
28643: भुजङ्गम m. (-मः) A snake. E. भुज bending, गम to go, and खच् aff.; also भुजग, and भुजङ्ग.
28644: भुजङ्गविजृम्बित n. (-तं) A species of the Utkṛti metre.
28645: भुजङ्गशिशु m. (-शुः) A species of the Vṛhatī metre.
28646: भुजङ्गसंगता f. (-ता) Another species of the Vṛhatī metre.
28647: भुजङ्गहन् m. (-हा) GARUḌA. E. भुजङ्ग a snake, and हन् who kills: see भुजङ्गदारण.
28648: भुजङ्गाक्षी f. (-क्षी) A plant, (the ichneumon plant:) see रास्ना. E. भुजङ्ग a snake, अक्ष to pervade, affs. अण् and ङीप्; otherwise भुजङ्ग and अक्ष an eye; the flowers being compared to the eye of the snake.
28649: भुजङ्गाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. भुजङ्ग a snake, and आख्या a name.
28650: भुजशिरस् n. (-रः) The shoulder, the shoulder blade. E. भुज the arm, शिरस् the head.
28651: भुजाकण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A finger nail. E. भुजा the hand, and कण्ट a thorn.
28652: भुजादल m. (-लः) A hand. E. भुजा the arm, and दल a leaf.
28653: भुजान्तर n. (-रं) The breast, the chest. E. भुज the arm, and अन्तर intervening.
28654: भुजापीड m. (-डः) Clasping or enfolding in the arms. E. भुज, and आपीड pressing.
28655: भुजि m. (-जिः) Fire. E. भुज to eat, इ Uṇādi aff.
28656: भुजिष्य mf. (-ष्यः-ष्या) A servant, a slave. m. (-ष्यः) 1 An independant man. 2 A string worn round the wrist. (-ष्या) A harlot, a whore. E. भुज to be crooked, Uṇādi aff. किष्यन्.
28657: भुज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being enjoyed or possessed. 2 Being eaten. E. भुज to enjoy, pass. v., शानच् aff.
28658: भुज्यु m. (-ज्युः) Eating. E. भुज to eat, युक् Uṇādi aff.
28659: भुञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 An enjoyer, a possessor. 2 Eating, feeding. E. भुज to enjoy, aff. शानच्.
28660: भुड(इ)भुडि r. 1st cl. (भुण्डते) To support, to maintain.
28661: भुरिज् f. (-रिक्) The earth. E. भृ to nourish, इजि Uṇādi aff., and उर substituted for the radical vowel; also भूरिज्.
28662: भुवन n. (-नं) 1 A world. 2 Water. 3 Heaven. 4 Man, mankind. E. भू to be, क्यु Uṇādi aff.
28663: भुवन्यु m. (-न्युः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. 4 A master or lord. E. भू to be, Uṇādi aff. कन्युच्.
28664: भुवनत्रय n. (-यं) The three worlds: heaven, earth, and hell. E. भुवन, and त्रय triad.
28665: भुवर्लोक m. (-कः) One of the divisions of the universe, the space between the earth and the sun, and the haunt of the Siddhas, Munis, and other saintly beings. E. भुवस् heaven, and लोक world.
28666: भुवस् ind. Heaven, æther, sky, or atmosphere. E. भू to be, Uṇādi aff. असुन्.
28667: भुविस् n. (-विः) The ocean. E. भू to be, Uṇādi aff. इसि, and the radical vowel changed.
28668: भुशुण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A weapon, apparently a kind of fire arms or rocket.
28669: भू r. 1st cl. (भवति) 1 To be, to become, to exist. 2 To be born or produced. r. 10th cl. (भावयति) 1 To mix. 2 To think. 3 To be clear or pure. r. 1st and 10th cls. (भवति-त भावयति-ते) To obtain. The first form of this root takes most of the prefixes, and then possesses a great variety of applications. With अधि, To rule or preside over. With अनु, 1 To feel, to apprehend or perceive. 2 To do, to make. 3 To enjoy. 4 To investigate. With अभि, 1 To overcome. 2 To pain or afflict. With उत्, To be born or produced. With परा, To be vanquished. With प्र, 1 To become manifest, to appear, to come into sight or existence. 2 To be equal to in personal conflict, to be a match for. 3 To rule, to be supreme, to preside over. 4 To be beyond or over. 5 To proceed. With प्रति, To be substituted for. With परि, 1 To disrespect. 2 To surround. With वि, 1 To see. 2 To uphold. 3 To prove. 4 To have majesty, or power. With वि and अति, व्यतिभवते, To be mutually or reciprocally. With सं, 1 To be possible. 2 To exist, to be born or produced. 3 To contain. 4 To overcome. 5 To be able or adequate. 6 To associate, to collect, to mix or assemble. 7 To nourish.
28670: भू f. (भूः) 1 The earth. 2 Place, site, the place of being or abiding. 3 Sacrificial fire. ind. (भू) The lowest of the seven hells. E. भू to be, aff. क्विप्.
28671: भूक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A hole, a chasm. 2 Time. 3 Darkness. E. भू to be, Uṇādi aff. कक्.
28672: भूकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) E. भू the earth, and कदम्ब nauclea.
28673: भूकम्प m. (-म्पः) An earth-quake. E. भू the earth, and कम्प a trembling.
28674: भूकर्ण m. (-र्णः) (In astronomy), The radius of the equator. E. भू, and कर्ण a sine.
28675: भूकल m. (-लः) A restiff unmanageable horse.
28676: भूकश्यप m. (-पः) A name of VASUDEVA, the father of KṚṢṆA. E. भू the earth, and कश्यप KAŚYAPA; being an incarnation of that personage.
28677: भूकाक m. (-कः) A small kind of heron. E. भू earth, and काक a crow.
28678: भूकेश m. (-शः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) 2 The Indian fig. f. (-शी) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) (-शा) A Rākṣasī or female goblin. E. भू earth, and केश hair.
28679: भूक्षित् m. (-क्षित्-क्षिट्) A hog. E. भू the earth, क्षि to destroy, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.
28680: भूगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A name of BHAVABHŪTI, the author of the Mālatī Mādhava, and other dramas. E. भू the earth, गर्भ fœtus.
28681: भूगर n. (-रं) Poison. E. भू, and गर poison.
28682: भूगोल m. (-लः) The terrestrial globe, the earth. E. भू the earth, and गोल a ball or globe.
28683: भूचक्र n. (-क्रं) (In astronomy,) The equinoctial line. E. भू, and चक्र a circle.
28684: भूच्छाया f. (-या) Darkness. E. भू the earth, and छाया shade.
28685: भूजन्तु m. (-न्तुः) An earth-worm. E. भू, and जन्तु a being.
28686: भूजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 1 Wheat. 2 The fruit of the Vikaṅkaṭa, (Flacourtia sapida.) E. भू the earth, and जम्बू rose apple.
28687: भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Been, become. 2 Being, existing. 3 Gone, past. 4 (In composition,) Like, resembling. 5 Obtained, got. 6 Proper, right. 7 True. 8 Known. mn. (-तः-तं) 1 A goblin, a ghost, a malignant spirit, haunting cemeteries, lurking in trees, animating carcases, and deluding or devouring human beings. 2 A living being. m. (-तः) 1 A son, a child. 2 A demigod of a particular class. 3 The fourteenth day of the dark half of the lunar month. 4 A name of ŚIVA. n. (-तं) 1 An element; five Bhūtas are enumerated: earth, fire, water, air, and Ākāśa or æther. 2 (In law,) Fact, matter of fact, the real state of the case, or what has actually been. E. भू to be, aff. क्त of the participle past.
28688: भूतकेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Root of sweet flag. E. भूत a spirit, and केश hair.
28689: भूतक्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Possession by evil spirits. E. भूत a goblin, क्रान्ति going.
28690: भूतगण m. (-णः) A class of sprites or goblins. E. भूत, and गण a troop.
28691: भूतगन्धा f. (-न्धा) Murā, a sort of perfume. E. भूत a goblin, and गन्ध a perfume; used perhaps in the ceremonies with which those beings are worshipped.
28692: भूतग्राम m. (-मः) Any aggregate of elementary matter, the body, the world. E. भूत, and ग्राम a heap.
28693: भूतघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 A camel. 2 Garlic. f. (-घ्नी) 1 A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī 2 Holy basil. E. भूत a sprite, and घ्न what destroys or removes.
28694: भूतजटा f. (-टा) Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) E. भूत a goblin, and जटा clustered locks.
28695: भूतदया f. (-या) Compassion or tenderness to all creatures. E. भूत, and दया clemency.
28696: भूतधात्री f. (-त्री) The earth. E. भूत a living being, and धात्री a nurse.
28697: भूतनाथ m. (-थः) ŚIVA. E. भूत a spirit or element, and नाथ lord.
28698: भूतनायिका f. (-का) DURGĀ. E. भूत a spirit, and नायिका leader.
28699: भूतनाशन m. (-नः) 1 Marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) 2 Mustard. n. (-नं) The Eleocarpus seed. E. भूत a goblin, and नाशन dispelling.
28700: भूतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. भूत a sprite, पुष्प a flower.
28701: भूतपूर्णिमा f. (-मा) Day of full moon in Aśvin. E. भूत a sprite, and पूर्णिमा full moon: the Bhūtas being worshipped.
28703: भूतबलि f. (-लिः) Throwing the remnants of an offering on the ground for animals or outcastes, &c. E. भूत, and बलि an offering.
28704: भूतभर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Supporting the elements, living beings, &c. E. भूत, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
28705: भूतभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Elementary. E. भूत, and भाव nature.
28706: भूतभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Supporting the elements, living beings, &c. E. भूत, and भृत् sustaining.
28707: भूतमात्र nf. (-त्रं-त्रा) The rudiment of an element. E. भूत, and मात्र element.
28708: भूतयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 1 Offering viands, &c. to all created beings. 2 Worshipping evil spirits. E. भूत, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
28709: भूतल n. (-लं) The earth, the face of the earth. E. भू, and तल below.
28710: भूतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Being, been. E. भू to be, क्तवतु aff.
28711: भूतवास m. (-सः) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. भूत a goblin, and वास abode.
28712: भूतविक्रिया f. (-या) Epilepsy, possession by evil spirits. E. भूत, and विक्रिया change.
28713: भूतवेशी f. (-शी) A species of the Nebāri, (Nyctanthes tristis,) with white flowers. E. भूत a goblin, विश to pervade, अण् and ङीप् aff.
28714: भूतवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A tree, (Trophis aspera.) 2 A species of Bignonia, (B. Indica.) E. भूत a goblin, and वृक्ष a tree.
28715: भूतसंसार m. (-रः) The world of mortals. E. भूत a sentient being, and संसार world.
28716: भूतसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Elementary nature. E. भूत, and सर्ग nature.
28717: भूतसञ्चार m. (-रः) Possession by evil spirits. f. (-री) Fire in a forest. E. भूत a goblin, सम् with चर to go, aff. घञ्; also f. (-रिणी.)
28718: भूतसम्पृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्त) Combined with elementary matter. E. भूत, and सम्पृक्त united.
28719: भूतसम्प्लव m. (-वः) A deluge, a drowning of the world. E. भूत all beings, and सम्प्लव swimming, floating.
28720: भूतस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Residing or existing in the elements. E. भूत, and स्थ what stays.
28721: भूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 The body. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 War, conflict. 5 The elementary or vital principle, or the proximate cause of life and action. E. भूत an element, आत्मन् self or soul.
28722: भूतादि m. (-दिः) God, the originator of beings. E. भूत, and आदि first.
28723: भूतारि m. (-रिः) Asafœtida. E. भूत, and अरि a foe.
28724: भूतार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Possessed by an evil spirit. E. भूत a spirit, आर्त्त pained.
28725: भूतावास m. (-सः) The body. E. भत, and आवास abode.
28726: भूताविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Occupied or possessed by a devil. E. भूत a spirit, आविष्ट entered.
28727: भूतावेश m. (-शः) Possession by a devil or evil spirit. E. भूत a goblin, and आवेश entrance.
28728: भूति f. (-तिः) 1 Power, dignity. 2 Superhuman power, as attributable to ŚIVA especially, and attainable by the practice of austere and magical rites. 3 Prosperity, success. 4 Production, birth. 5 Ashes. 6 Fried meat. 7 The rut of elephants. 8 State of being, &c. E. भू to be, aff. क्तिच्.
28729: भूतिक m. (-कं) 1 A sort of gentian, (G. cherayta.) 2 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthus.) 3 Another kind of grass. 4 A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal. 5 Ligusticum ajwaen. E. भूत being or spirit, &c. aff. ठक्; also भूतीक.
28730: भूतिकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous of wealth, aggrandisement, &c. m. (-मः) 1 A king's counsellor, a minister of state. 2 VṚHASPATI. E. भूति, and काम who desires.
28731: भूतिकील m. (-लः) 1 A moat, a ditch. 2 A celler, a place under ground for concealing wealth, &c.
28732: भूतिकृत्य n. (-त्यं) Any ceremony of a festive character, as a marriage, &c. E. भूति, and कृत्य rite; also भूतिकर्म्म, &c.
28733: भूतिगर्भ m. (-र्भः) BHAVABHŪTI, the dramatic poet. E. भूति superhuman power, and गर्भ embryo, being resuscitated by his contemporary, and rival KĀLIDĀSA, after having lost his life in an intrigue.
28734: भूतिनिधान n. (-नं) The twenty-fourth lunar mansion, Dhaniṣṭhā. E. भूति prosperity, and निधान receptacle.
28735: भूतीक m. (-कं) 1 A sort of gentian. 2 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) 2 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) 4 Another sort of grass. E. भूत being, aff. ईकक्, otherwise भूतिक.
28736: भूतेज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) A worshipper of spirits. E. भूत, and इज्या worship.
28737: भूतेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. भूत an imp, ईश lord.
28738: भूतोपहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed by an evil spirit. E. भूत, and उपहत affected.
28739: भूत्तम n. (-मं) Gold. E. भू earth, उत्तभ best.
28740: भूत्वा ind. Having been or become. E. भू to be, क्त्वा aff.
28741: भूदार m. (-रः) A hog. E. भू earth, दृ to tear, aff. अण्.
28742: भूदेव m. (-वः) A Brahman. E. भू the earth, and देव a divinity.
28743: भूधन m. (-नः) A king. E. भू the earth, and धन wealth.
28744: भूधर m. (-रः) 1 A mountain. 2 A kind of chemical or medicinal apparatus; a sand bath in which a covered crucible is placed, and the fire is lighted above as well as below it. E. भू earth, धृ to support, aff. अप्.
28745: भूध्र m. (-ध्रः) A mountain. E. भू the earth, धृ to hold, aff. अप्, and the vowel changed to its analogous semivowel.
28746: भूनाग m. (-गः) An earth-worm. E. भू the earth, and नाग a snake.
28747: भूनिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A species of gentian, commonly Cherayta, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.) E. भू the earth, and निम्ब the Nimb tree.
28748: भूनेतृ m. (-ता) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, and नेतृ a leader.
28749: भूप m. (-पः) A sovereign, a prince, a king. E. भू the earth, पा to cherish, aff. क.
28750: भूपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, and पति master.
28751: भूपद m. (-दः) A tree. f. (-दी) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac). E. भू the earth, and पद foot, root.
28752: भूपरिधि m. (-धिः) 1 The equinoctial line. 2 The circumference of the earth. E. भू, and परिधि a circle.
28753: भूपाल m. (-लः) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, and पाल who cherishes.
28754: भूपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA. E. भू the earth, and पुत्त्री a daughter; being turned up out of the soil by a plough.
28755: भूभुज् m. (-भुक्) A king, a sovereign. E. भू the earth, भुज् to enjoy, aff. क्विप्.
28756: भूभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A mountain. E. भू the earth, भृत् sustaining.
28757: भूमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Much, many. E. भू for बहु many, इमनिच् aff.
28758: भूमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of earth. f. (-यी) A name of Chāyā or shadow personified, the wife of the sun. E. भू earth, and मयट् aff.
28759: भूमि f. (-मिः-मी) 1 The earth. 2 Place, site in general. 3 The base of any figure in geometry. E. भू to be, and मि Uṇādi aff.
28760: भूमिका f. (-का) 1 Theatrical dress, the costume of any character, represented on the stage. 2 Decorating images, temples, gateways, &c. E. भूमि place of being, and कन् aff.
28761: भूमिचम्पक m. (-कः) A plant, (Kæmpferia rotunda.) E. भूमि earth, and चम्पक Michelia.
28762: भूमिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced of or on the earth. m. (-जः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 Hell. f. (-जा) SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA. E. भूमि earth, and ज born.
28763: भूमिजम्बु f. (-म्बुः-म्बू) A tree, (Premna herbacea.) E. भूमि earth, and जम्बु Eugenia; also with कन् added to either form, भूमिजम्बुका, and भूमिजम्बूका.
28764: भूमिजीविन् m. (-वी) The Vaiśya or Hindu of the third, or agricultural and mercantile tribe. E. भूमि the earth, and जीविन् who gets a livelihood.
28765: भूमिदान n. (-नं) Donation of landed property. E. भूमि, and दान gift.
28766: भूमिदेव m. (-वः) A Brahman. E. भूमि the earth, and देव a divinity.
28767: भूमिप m. (-पः) A prince, a sovereign. E. भमि the earth, and प who protects.
28768: भूमिपक्ष m. (-क्षः) A horse of a good breed. E. भूमि the earth, and पक्ष part or side.
28769: भूमिपति m. (-तिः) A king. E. भूमि, and पति master.
28770: भूमिपतित्व n. (-त्वं) Princedom, sovereignty. E. त्व added to the last.
28771: भूमिभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A king. 2 A mountain. E. भूमि, and भृत् who nourishes.
28772: भूमिपिशाच m. (-चः) The palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.) E. भूमि earth, पिशाच goblin.
28773: भूमिमण्डा f. (-ण्डा) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) E. भूमि the earth, मडि to ornament, aff. अच्.
28774: भूमिरक्षक m. (-कः) A horse of a good breed. E. भूमि the earth, रक्ष to preserve, aff. वुन्; it is also written भूमिरक्ष, and भूमिपक्ष.
28775: भूमिलाभ m. (-भः) Death, dying. E. भूमि earth, लाभ acquisition.
28776: भूमिलेपन n. (-नं) Cow-dung. E. भूमि earth, and लेपन plastering; the clay floors of houses, temples, &c. being usually kneaded up with this article.
28777: भूमिवर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Increasing or adding to the earth. mn. (-नः-नं) A corpse. E. भूमि the earth, and वर्द्धन increasing.
28778: भूमिशय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sleeping on the ground. E. भूमि, and शी to sleep, श aff.
28779: भूमिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Standing or staying on the earth. E. भूमि, and स्थ who or what stays.
28780: भूमिसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in or of the earth. f. (-वा) SĪTĀ. E. भूमि the earth, and सम्भव born: see भूपुत्त्री.
28782: भूमिस्पृश् m. (-स्पृक्) 1 A man, man, mankind. 2 The Vaiśya or Hindu of the third tribe, the cultivator or trader. 3 A thief, one who creeps along the ground to carry off his plunder. 4 A blind man. 5 A cripple, a lame man. E. भूमि the earth, the ground, and स्पृश who touches, from स्पृश, with क्विप् aff.
28783: भूमीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A king, a sovereign. E. भूमि earth, and इन्द्र chief.
28784: भूम्यामलकी f. (-की) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. भूमि the earth, आमलकी a myrobalan; also भूम्यासनी f. (-नी)
28785: भूय n. (-यं) Abstract state, but used in composition, as ब्रह्मभूय the state of BRAHMA, or identification with BRAHMA, becoming of the same nature, &c. E. भू to be, aff. क्यप्.
28786: भूयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Much, many. ind. Frequently, repeatedly, again. 2 Exceeding, over, above. E. बहु much, इयसुन् affix of the superlative, भू substituted for बहु, and the ई of the aff. rejected; also with इष्ठन् aff. भूयिष्ठ.
28787: भूयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Many, very many, much, most: see the last.
28788: भूरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Much, many. ind. Much, exceeding. m. (-रिः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 ŚIVA. 4 A day. n. (-रि) Gold. E. भू to be, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
28789: भूरिज् f. (-रिक्) The earth. E. भृ to support, इजि Uṇādi aff., and ऋ changed to ऊर.
28790: भूरिधामन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) 1 Splendid, bright. 2 Illustrious. E. भूरि, and धामन् splendor.
28793: भूरिफेना f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Carmaghās. E. भूरि much, and फेन cuttle-fish bone.
28794: भूरिमाय m. (-यः) A shakal. E. भूरि much, माय deceit.
28795: भूरिलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very profitable or beneficial. n. (-भं) Great gain. E. भूरि, and लाभ gain.
28796: भूरिशस् ind. Manifold, many by many. E. भूरि many, शस् aff.
28797: भूरुण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. भू the earth, रुह to grow; or रुद्ध to oppose, क aff., deriv. irr.
28798: भूरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. भू the earth, and रुह what grows.
28799: भूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) The Bhoj or Bhojpatra, a tree growing in the snowy mountains, a kind of birch; the bark is used for writing on, and very generally for Hooka snakes. E. भू the earth, and ऊर्ज्ज to be strong or hardy, aff. अच्.
28800: भूर्ज्जकण्डक m. (-कः) A man of one of the inferior or mixed classes, sprung from an outcast Brahman by a woman of the same tribe. E. भूर्ज्ज the Bhoj, and कण्ठ the throat, कन् added.
28801: भूर्ज्जपत्र m. (-त्रः) The Bhojpatra : see भूर्ज्ज. E. भूर्ज्ज as above, पत्र a leaf.
28802: भूर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 The earth. 2 A desart, a country ill supplied with water. E. भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. नि, deriv. irr.
28803: भूर्लोक m. (-कः) The earth, the habitation of mortals. E. भूः the earth, and लोक the world.
28804: भूलता f. (-ता) A worm, an earthworm. E. भू the earth, लता a creeping plant.
28805: भूशक्र m. (-क्रः) A king. E. भू the earth, and शक्र INDRA.
28806: भूशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Purifying the ground by sweeping, burning, &c. E. भू, and शुद्धि purification.
28807: भूश्रवस् m. (-वाः) An ant or mole hill. E. भू the earth, and श्रु to exude, असुन् aff.
28808: भूष r. 1st and 10th cls. (भूषति भूषयति) To decorate, to adorn.
28809: भूषण n. (-णं) Ornament, embellishment. E. भूष to adorn, aff. युच्.
28810: भूषयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be decorated or ornamented. E. भष, and तव्य aff.; also भूषणीय, &c.
28811: भूषा f. (-षा) Adorning, decorating with trinkets, jewels, &c. E. भूष to adorn, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
28812: भूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adorned, decorated, dressed. E. भूष to adorn, aff. क्त.
28813: भूष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Being, existing. 2 Being well, faring well. E. भू to be, स्नु aff.
28814: भूसुत m. (-तः) The planet MARS. f. (-ता) SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA. E. भू the earth, and सुत the offspring.
28815: भूस्तृण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schænanthus.) E. भू the earth, तृण grass, and सुट् augment.
28816: भूस्पृश् m. (-स्पृक) Man, a man, mankind. E. भू the earth, and स्पृश् who touches: see भूमिस्पृश्.
28817: भूस्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) The mountain Sumeru. E. भू, and स्वर्ग paradise; a heaven on earth.
28818: भूस्वामिन् m. (-मी) A landlord, a landholder.
28819: भृ(ञ्) भृञ् r. 1st cl. (भरति-ते) (डु ञ्) डुभृञ् r. 3rd cl. (विभर्त्ति विभृते) 1 To nourish, to cherish, to foster, to maintain. 2 To fill. 3 To hold or support.
28820: भृकुंस m. (-सः) A male actor or dancer in female apparel. E. भ्रु an eye-brow, कुसि to speak, aff. अच्, रु changed to ऋ; also with कन् added भृकुंसक, and रु unchanged भ्रकुंस; also from कुशि, भृकुंश, &c.
28821: भृकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown, a contraction of the brows. E. भ्रु the eye-brow, कुट to be or make crooked, aff. कि, and ङीप् optionally added, भृ substituted for भ्रु; otherwise भ्रुकुटि, भ्रुकुटी, &c.
28822: भृगु m. (-गुः) 1 The name of a celebrated Muni, and one of the ten Brahmādikas or Prajāpatis, the sons of BRAHMĀ, and first created of beings. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 ŚUKRA, the regent of VENUS. 4 A precipice. 5 Table land, the level summit of a mountain. 6 The Ṛṣi JAMADAGNI, the father of PARAŚURĀMA and grandson of the Muni BHṚGU. E. भ्रस्ज to fry (in religious fervour), Uṇādi aff. कु; र is changed to ऋ, the स rejected, and the final ज becomes ग.
28823: भृगुपति m. (-तिः) The hero, and Avatar PARAŚURĀMA. E. भृगु implying the race of BHṚGU or JAMADAGNI, and पति master, chief.
28824: भृगुसुत m. (-तः) 1 ŚUKRA or VENUS, the son of the Muni BHṚGU, and the preceptor of the DAITYAS. 2 The hero PARAŚURĀMA. E. भृगु the saint BHṚGU, or his descendant JAMADAGNI, and सुत the son.
28825: भृगूणाम्पति m. (-तिः) The first of the three incarnations of VIṢṆU called RĀMAS; PARAŚURĀMA the son of JAMADAGNI. E. भृगु in the sixth case plural, and पति master, chief of the BHṚGUS or race of BHṚGU.
28826: भृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A large black bee, the humble bee. 2 A catamite, a libertine, a lecher. 3 A plant, (Eclipta or Verbesina prostrata.) 4 A wasp, either the common kind, or the Vespa solitaria. 5 A golden vase. 6 The fork-tailed shrike, (Lanius cærulescens.) 7 A bird, apparently a sort of shrike different from the preceding. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Woody cassia. 2 Talc. E. भृ to nourish, गन् Uṇādi aff., and नुट् augment.
28827: भृङ्गक m. (-कः) A bird, a sort of shrike, (Lanius malabaricus.) E. कन्, added to the last.
28828: भृङ्गज n. (-जं) Aloe wood or Agallochum.
28829: भृङ्गपर्णिका f. (-का) Small or Guzerati cardamoms.
28830: भृङ्गरजस् m. (-जाः) Eclipta prostrata: see the next.
28831: भृङ्गराज m. (-जः) 1 A spreading shrub, (Eclipta or Verbesina prostrata, or perhaps more properly, Verbesina scandens.) 2 A sort of bird, apparently the variety of shrike termed Malabar, (Lanius malabaricus). 3 The humble bee. 4 A particular sacrifice. E. भृङ्ग a bee, and राज to shine, aff. अच्; or with रजस dust, भृङ्गरजस्; and with राजन् shining, ruling, भृङ्गराजन् m. (-जा)
