28832: भृङ्गरिट m. (-टः) One of ŚIVA'S door-keepers. E. भृङ्ग a bee, रट to speak or make a noise, to buzz, aff. अच्, and the penultimate changed to इ; also with इन् aff., and the penultimate long or short, the word is read भृङ्गरिटि, भृङ्गरीट, and भृङ्गरीटि.
28833: भृङ्गरोल m. (-लः) A wasp. E. भृङ्ग a bee, रु to cry, लच् aff.
28835: भृङ्गसोदर m. (-रः) A plant, apparently a variety of Eclipta or Verbesina.
28836: भृङ्गार m. (-रः) 1 A golden vase, especially used at royal ceremonials. 2 A shrub, (Eclipta prostrata, &c. see भृङ्गराज.) n. (-रं) 1 Cloves. 2 Gold. f. (-री) A cricket. E. भृ to contain, (water, &c.) आरन् Uṇādi aff., and गुक् augment; or भृङ्ग a bee, and अरि an enemy; fem. form.
28837: भृङ्गारिका f. (-का) A cricket. E. भृङ्ग a bee, अरि an enemy, and कन् aff.
28838: भृङ्गावली f. (-ली) A line or flight of bees. E. भृङ्ग, and आवली a row.
28839: भृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) One of ŚIVA'S chamberlains. E. भृङ्ग a bee, इनि aff.
28840: भृङ्गीफल m. (-लः) The hog-plum: see आम्रातक.
28841: भृङ्गीश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. भृङ्गी the attendant of the deity, and ईश master.
28842: भृज(ई)भृजी r. 1st cl. (भर्जते) To parch, to fry.
28843: भृज्जन n. (-नं) A frying pan. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, Uṇādi aff. क्युन्, and the root changed.
28844: भृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hired, paid, maintained. 2 Cherished, supported. 3 Filled. 4 Having, being possessed of, or endowed with. m. (-तः) 1 A servant. 2 A hired labourer. E. भृ to nourish, aff. क्त.
28845: भृतक m. (-कः) 1 A hired labourer. 2 A servant. E. भृत hired, कन् added.
28846: भृतकाध्यापक m. (-कः) A hired teacher, one who gives instructions for pay. E. भृतक, and अध्यापक a teacher.
28847: भृतकाध्यापित m. (-तः) A student who pays his teacher. E. भृतक, and अध्यापित instructed.
28848: भृतभूति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Prosperous, powerful, exalted. 2 Smeared with ashes. E. भृत possessed, and भूति power, &c.
28849: भृतरन्ध्र mfn. (-न्ध्रः-न्ध्रा-न्ध्रं) Filled up, (as a hole or depression.) E. भृत, and रन्ध्र a hole.
28850: भृति f. (-तिः) 1 Wages, hire. 2 Capital, principal. 3 Nourishment, maintenance. E. भृ to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.
28851: भृतिभुज् m. (-भुक्) A hired labourer or servant. E. भृति hire, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.
28852: भृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be nourished or maintained. m. (-त्यः) 1 A dependant. 2 A servant, a slave. f. (-त्या) Hire, wages. E. भृ to nourish, aff. क्यप्, with तुक् augment.
28853: भृत्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Servitude, service, dependance. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, भृत्यता.
28854: भृत्यध्यापन n. (-नं) Teaching, (especially the Vedas,) for hire. E. भृति, and अध्यापन instructing.
28855: भृत्यभरण n. (-णं) Maintaining or cherishing dependants, servants, &c. E. भृत्य, and भरण nourishing.
28856: भृत्यभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A master of a family taking good care of his dependants. E. भृत्य, and भर्त्तृ who nourishes.
28857: भृत्यवात्सल्य n. (-ल्यं) Kindness to dependants or servants. E. भृत्य, and वात्सल्य tenderness.
28858: भृत्यविनिवेश m. (-शः) Fixing or planting firmly. E. भृत्य, and विनिवेश placing.
28859: भृत्यवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Maintenance of servants or dependants. E. भृत्य, and वृत्ति practice.
28860: भृत्यशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having many servants. E. भृत्य, and शालिन् possessing.
28861: भृमि m. (-मिः) 1 A whirlwind, a hurricane, a high wind. 2 An eddy, a whirlpool. E. भ्रम to turn round, इन् Uṇādi aff., and the semivowel changed to its congener.
28862: भृश(इर्, उ,) इर् भृशु r. 4th cl. (भृश्यति) To fall, to fall down, literally or figuratively, as from a height, from dignity or virtue, &c.
28863: भृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Much, exceeding. n. ad. (-शं) Much, exceedingly. ind. (भृशम्) 1 Much. 2 Eminently, superiorly, better. 3 Repeatedly. 4 Beautifully. E. भृश to fall, aff. क.
28864: भृशस्विद् mfn. (-स्विद्) Perspiring violently. E. भृश, and स्विद् to sweat, क्विन् aff.
28865: भृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Fried. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. क्त, the vowel substituted for the semivowel.
28866: भृष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice boiled, and then fried. E. भृष्ट fried, अन्न boiled rice.
28867: भृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Frying. 2 An uninhabited or lonely garden, &c. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. क्तिन्, the semivowel changed to ऋ.
28868: भॄ r. 9th cl. (भृणाति) 1 To blame or censure. 2 To nourish, to maintain, to support. 3 To hold. 4 To fry.
28869: भेक m. (-कः) 1 A frog. 2 A cloud. f. (-की) 1 The female of the frog, or a small frog. 2 A kind of creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) E. भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
28870: भेकपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) E. भेक a frog, and पर्ण a leaf; resembling the animal.
28871: भेकभुज् m. (-क्) A serpent, a snake. E. भेक, and भुज who eats.
28872: भेड m. (-डः) 1 A ram, a sheep. 2 A raft, a float. 3 The name of a saint. f. (-डी) A ewe. E. भिल a Sautra root, to separate, aff. अच्, and ल changed to ड; also with कन् added, भेडक.
28873: भेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be feared or apprehended. E. भी to fear, तव्य aff.
28874: भेत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ) Who or what divides, disunites, &c. m. (-त्ता) 1 A divider or separator. 2 A factious or seditious man, a traitor, or one who secretly corresponds with an enemy, &c. E. भिद to divide, to sow dissension, aff. तृच्.
28875: भेद m. (-दः) 1 Dividing, separating. 2 Tearing, rending, breaking, &c. 3 Distinction, kind, sort, species, difference. 4 Disunion, disagreement. 5 Sowing dissension, breaking the unanimity of confederates, one of the means of success against an opponent. E. भिद to divide, aff. घञ्.
28876: भेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A breaker, who or what breaks or divides. m. (-कः) A mischief-maker. E. भिद to break, ण्वुल् aff.
28877: भेदकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Separating, disuniting. 2 Causing dissension. E. भेद, and कर who or what makes.
28878: भेदन n. (-नं) Dividing, separating, literally or figuratively, as tearing, breaking, specifying, discriminating, causing separation or dissension, &c. E. भिद to break, aff. ल्युट्.
28879: भेदप्रत्यय m. (-यः) Belief in the reality of the multiform appearances of the world, in opposition to the doctrine that every thing is GOD. E. भेद difference, प्रत्यय faith.
28880: भेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Divided, separated, literally or figuratively. E. भिद to break, aff. क्त; also भिन्न.
28881: भेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Who or what divides, &c. 2 Having a distinction or division. m. (-दी) The ratan. E. भिद to divide, धिनुण् aff. or भेद sort, &c. and इनि aff.
28883: भेदुर n. (-रं) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. भिद to split, (rocks, &c.) उरच् aff.; also भिदुर, and भेदिर.
28884: भेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 To be broken. 2 To be divided, pierced, cut, &c. 3 To be disconcerted or deterred. 4 To be set at variance or disunited. E. भिद to break, यत् aff.
28885: भेन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. E. भ a star, a planet, and इन a master.
28886: भेरि mf. (-रिः-री) A kettle drum. E. भी to fear, to cause fear, Uṇādi aff. कीन्; otherwise, रन् aff., and ङीप् added.
28887: भेरुण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Formidable, fearful. f. (-ण्डा) One of the Yakṣiṇīs, or female attendants on DURGĀ. m. (-ण्डः) A particular deity; a form of ŚIVA, according to the Tantras. n. (-ण्डं) Conception, impregnation. E. भी to fear, deriv. irr.; it is sometimes read भेरण्ड.
28888: भेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Ignorant, unwise, foolish. 2 Fearful, timid. 3 Unsteady, figuratively or literally. m. (-लः) 1 A raft, a float. 2 The name of a Muni, the supposed author of some medical works. E. भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and the final changed to ल.
28889: भेलक mn. (-कः-कं) A raft, a float. E. कन् added to the preceding.
28890: भेष(ऋ)भेषृ r. 1st cl. (भेषति-ते) 1 To fear or dread. 2 To go.
28891: भेषज n. (-जं) 1 A remedy, a drug, a medicament. 2 A kind of fennel, (Nigella Indica.) E. भेष here interpreted disease, जि to conquer, aff. ड; or भिषज् a root of a particular class, and अच् aff.
28892: भेषजाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The vehicle or medium in which medicine is administered, as water gruel, &c. E. भेषज a drug, and अङ्ग a limb or part.
28893: भैक्ष n. (-क्षं) 1 Alms, what is collected by begging. 2 Begging, mendicancy. E. भिक्षा alms, given and received, aff. अण्; also भैक्ष्य.
28894: भैक्षचरण n. (-णं) Plying for alms, begging. E. भैक्ष, and चरण going.
28895: भैक्षचर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Begging, collecting alms. E. भैक्ष, and चर्य्या practice.
28896: भैक्षजीविका f. (-का) Living upon alms, begging, mendicancy. E. भैक्ष aggregate alms, जीविका livelihood.
28897: भैक्षभुज् m. (-भुक्) A mendicant. E. भैक्ष alms, and भुज् who subsists; also भैक्षाशिन्, भिक्षाशिन्, &c.
28898: भैक्षाशिन् m. (-शी) A mendicant. E. भैक्ष, and आशिन् who eats.
28899: भैक्षाहार m. (-रः) A mendicant, one living on charity. E. भैक्ष, and आहार food.
28900: भैक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Mendicity, begging. E. भिक्षा, and यञ् aff.
28901: भैरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Formidable, horrible, terrific. n. (-वं) Horror, the property of exciting terror. m. (-वः) 1 A name of ŚIVA, but more especially an inferior manifestation or form of the deity, eight of which are called by the common name Bhairava, and are severally termed ASITĀṄGA, RURU, CAṆḌA, KRODHA, UNMATTA, KUPATI, BHĪṢAṆA, and SAṂHĀRA, all alluding to terrific properties of mind or body. 2 The name of a river. 3 A musical mode; that which is calculated to excite emotions of terror. f. (-वी) A name or form of DURGĀ. E. भीरु fearful, aff. अण्.
28902: भैरवकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Formidable. E. भैरव, and कारक what causes.
28903: भैषज m. (-जः) A sort of quail. n. (-जं) A medicament. E. भिषज a medicament, and अण् referential or pleonastic aff.
28904: भैषज्य n. (-ज्यं) A drug, a medicament. E. भैषज the same, ञय pleonastic aff.
28905: भो ind. A vocative particle. E. भा to shine, डो aff., more commonly भोम्.
28906: भोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be used or enjoyed. 2 To be eaten. E. भुज to eat, &c., तव्य aff.
28907: भोक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 1 Enjoying, an enjoyer. 2 An eater. m. (-क्ता) A husband. E. भुज to enjoy, &c., aff. तृच्.
28908: भोक्तृत्व n. (-त्वं) Possession, enjoyment. E. त्व added to the last.
28909: भोक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being about to eat. E. भुज to eat, and शानच् aff., here of the future tense.
28910: भोग m. (-गः) 1 Pleasure, enjoyment. 2 Wealth. 3 Nourishing, cherishing. 4 Eating. 5 A snake's body. 6 A snake's expanded hood. 7 Hire. 8 The hire of dancing girls or courtezans. 9 A snake. 10 An army in column. 11 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction. E. भुज to eat, &c., aff. घञ्.
28911: भोगगुच्छ n. (-च्छं) Price paid to harlots.
28912: भोगगृह m. (-हः) The inner or private apartment, the haram. E. भोग enjoyment, and गृह a house.
28913: भोगपति m. (-तिः) 1 A viceroy, a governor. 2 A person having possession or usufruct. E. भोग enjoyment, and पति master.
28914: भोगपाल m. (-लः) A groom. E. भोग pleasure, and पाल who nourishes.
28915: भोगपिशाचिका f. (-का) Hunger. E. भोग eating, पिशाचिका an imp.
28916: भोगभूमि f. (-मिः) Svarga or paradise. E. भोग enjoyment, and भूमि soil.
28917: भोगभृतक m. (-कः) A servant or slave, who works for maintenance only. E. भोग enjoyment, and भृत्तक a hireling.
28918: भोगलाभ m. (-भः) Interest or profit made by the use of any thing pledged. E. भोग enjoyment, and लाभ gain.
28919: भोगवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Enjoying, having enjoyment. 2 Delightful, pleasurable, yielding enjoyment. m. (-वान्) 1 A snake. 2 Dancing, acting. 3 Singing. f. (-ती) 1 The capital of the Nāgas, or serpents. 2 The Ganges of the lower regions. E. भोग enjoyment, aff. मतुप्.
28920: भोगसद्मन् n. (-द्म) The inner apartment, the haram. E. भोग pleasure, and सद्मन् a dwelling.
28921: भोगस्थान n. (-नं) 1 The body as the seat, of sensual enjoyment. 2 A haram, &c. E. भोग enjoyment, and स्थान place.
28922: भोगार्ह n. (-र्हं) Wealth, property. E. भोग, and अर्ह fit for.
28923: भोगावली f. (-ली) Praise, eulogium, the panegyric of professional encomiasts or bards. E. भोग enjoyment, आवली a row or range.
28924: भोगावास m. (-सः) The haram, the inner or women's apartment. E. भोग enjoyment, आवास abode.
28925: भोगिक m. (-कः) A horse-keeper, a groom. E. भोग pleasure, ठक् aff.
28926: भोगिकान्त m. (-न्तः) Air, wind. E. भोगि a snake, and कान्त friend.
28927: भोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Enjoying, possessing, an enjoyer, &c. m. (-गी) 1 A snake. 2 A king, a prince. 3 A barber. 4 The head man of a village. 5 A person who accumulates money for a particular expenditure. f. (-नी) 1 The capital of the Nāgas. 2 A royal concubine. E. भोग enjoyment, aff. इनि.
28928: भोगिवल्लभ n. (-भं) Sandal. E. भोगिन् a snake, वल्लभ beloved.
28929: भोगीन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The serpent ANANTA. E. भोगि a snake, इन्द्र a sovereign; also भोगीश.
28930: भोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) To be enjoyed. n. (-ग्यं) 1 Wealth. 2 Grain. f. (-ग्या) A whore. E. भुज to enjoy, aff. ण्यत्.
28931: भोज m. (-जः) 1 A country, Patna and Bhāgalpur. 2 The name of a sovereign of Oujein, who is supposed to have flourished about the end of the tenth century; he was a celebrated patron of learned men, and the nine gems, or poets, and philosophers, are often ascribed to his æra. 3 A cowherd. E. भुज to enjoy, aff. अच्, and the final consonant unchanged.
28932: भोजकट m. (-टः) The country of Bhoja, the present Bhojpur, or the vicinity of Patna and Bhāgalpur. E. भोज the same, and कट to go, aff. अच्.
28933: भोजन n. (-नं) 1 Food. 2 Eating. E. भुज to eat, aff. ल्युट्.
28934: भोजनविशेष m. (-षः) Choice food, a delicacy. E. भोजन, and विशेष superior sort.
28935: भोजनव्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Straitened for food. E. भोजन, and व्यग्र anxious.
28936: भोजनाधिकार m. (-रः) Commissariat, stewardship, charge of provender. E. भोजन, and अधिकार superintendence.
28937: भोजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be enjoyed. 2 To be eaten. n. (-यं) Food. E. भुज to enjoy, aff. अनीयर्.
28938: भोजयित्वा ind. Having fed. E. भुज to eat, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
28939: भोजाधिप m. (-पः) A name of KARṆA, the half brother of the Pāṇḍus. E. भोज Bhāgalpur, and अधिप sovereign.
28940: भोज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be eaten, edible. n. (-ज्यं) Food. E. भुज to eat, ण्यत् aff., and the final unchanged.
28941: भोज्यसम्भव m. (-वः) Chyle, the primary juice of the body. E. भोज्य food, and सम्भव production.
28942: भोटाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A country, probably Butan.
28943: भोभो ind. A particle of calling or addressing. E. भो as above, repeated.
28945: भोलि m. (-लिः) A camel. E. भा to shine, उलिच् aff.
28946: भोस् ind. 1 A particle of calling or addressing. 2 An interrogative particle. E. भा to shine, aff. डोस्.
28947: भौत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) 1 Demoniac, relating to sprites or goblins. 2 Elemental. 3 Relating to existing beings. m. (-तः) 1 An attendant upon idols. 2 A worshipper of sprites and goblins. f. (-ती) Night. E. भूत a goblin, &c., aff. अण्.
28948: भौतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating or appertaining to evil spirits. 2 Elemental. 3 Existent. m. (-कः) ŚIVA. E. भूत a sprite, &c., and टक् aff.
28949: भौम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Earthly, terrestrial, produced in or relating to the earth. m. (-मः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 Hell. 3 Ambergris. f. (-मी) A name of SĪTĀ. E. भूमि the earth, and अण् aff.
28950: भौमरत्न n. (-त्नं) Coral. E. भौम, and रत्न a gem.
28951: भौमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Earthly, terrestrial. E. भूमि, and ठञ् aff.
28952: भौरिक m. (-कः) The superintendant of gold, the treasurer. E. भूरि gold, aff. ठञ्.
28954: भ्रंश(उ,)भ्रंशु r. 4th cl. (भ्रंश्यति) To fall down; also भ्रंस.
28955: भ्रंश m. (-शः) 1 Falling, declining from a height, or from propriety. 2 Falling from or off. E. भ्रंश to fall, aff. अच्.
28956: भ्रंस(उ,)भ्रंसु r. 1st cl. (भ्रंसते) To fall down.
28957: भ्रकुंस m. (-सः) An actor wearing female apparel. E. भ्र for भ्रू the eye-brow, and कुशि or कुसि to speak, aff. अच्; hence also भ्रकुंश, भ्रूकुंस, &c.
28958: भ्रकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown. E. भ्र for भ्रू the eye-brow, कुट to curve, aff. इन्; also भ्रुकुटि, &c.
28960: भ्रम(उ,)भ्रमु r. 1st cl. (भ्रमति भ्रम्यति) 1 To turn round, to move circularly. 2 To be unsteady or unfixed. 3 To roam, to wander; it is also figuratively applicable to mental unsteadiness, as to err, to wander, to be ignorant or mistaken, &c. With परि, To wander about. With वि, To play, to wanton. With सम्, 1 To hurry. 2 To honour.
28961: भ्रम m. (-मः) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 Straying, roaming. 3 Error, ignorance, mistake, misapprehension. 4 A whirlpool, an eddy. 5 A drain, a water-course. 6 A lathe, a potter's wheel, &c. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. अप्.
28962: भ्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 Wandering, literally or figuratively. f. (-णी) 1 A leech. 2 A sort of game, performed by women for the amusement of a lover or husband. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. ल्युट्.
28963: भ्रमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 1 Going round, whirling, revolving. 2 Roving. 3 Erring. E. भ्रम to turn round, शतृ aff.
28964: भ्रमत्कुटी f. (-टी) An umbrella, a concave mat carried on the head for that purpose, &c. E. भ्रमत्, and कुटी a house.
28965: भ्रमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) What whirls or goes round. m. (-रः) 1 A large black bee. 2 A lecher, a lover. n. (-रं) Vertigo, epilepsy. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. करन्.
28966: भ्रमरक m. (-कः) 1 Hair curled upon the forehead. 2 A bee. 3 A ball for playing with. 4 A whirlpool. E. भ्रमर a bee, &c., कन् aff.
28967: भ्रमरकीट m. (-टः) A sort of wasp, that builds a solitary nest in the angles of walls, doors, &c., (Vespa solitaria.) E. भ्रमर a bee, and कीट an insect.
28968: भ्रमरप्रिय m. (-यः) A sort of Kadamba tree. E. भ्रमर a bee, and प्रिय beloved.
28969: भ्रमरविलसिता f. (-ता) A species of the Triṣṭubh metre.
28970: भ्रमरालक m. (-कः) Hair curled upon the forehead. E. भ्रमर a bee, and अलक a curl.
28971: भ्रमासक्त m. (-क्तः) An armourer, a sword-cleaner, a knifegrinder. E. भ्रस a turning instrument, a grindstone, and आसक्त diligent.
28972: भ्रमि f. (-मिः) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 Error, blunder, mistake. 3 A lathe, a potter's wheel. 4 A whirlpool. E. भ्रम to turn round, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
28973: भ्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) Whirling, going round or about. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. घिनुण्.
28974: भ्रश(उ,)भ्रशु r. 4th cl. (भ्रश्यति) To fall down; also भृश and भ्रंश.
28975: भ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Fallen, lost. 2 Vicious, depraved, fallen from virtue. 3 Fried, parched. E. भ्रंश to fall, or भ्रस्ज to fry, क्त aff.
28976: भ्रष्टराज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Deposed, deprived of a kingdom. E. भ्रष्ट, and राज्य principality.
28977: भ्रस्ज(औ)औभ्रस्ज r. 6th cl. (भ्रज्जति-ते) To broil or fry.
28978: भ्राज(टु, ऋ,) टुभ्राजृ r. 1st cl. (भ्राजते) To shine.
28979: भ्राजक n. (-कं) Bile, the bilious humour. E. भ्राज to shine, aff. ण्वुन्.
28980: भ्राजथु f. (-थुः) Brilliance, splendour, beauty. E. भ्राज to shine, अथुच् aff.
28981: भ्राजथुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Splendid. 2 Beautiful. E. भ्राजथु, and मतुप् aff.
28982: भ्राजिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Elegant, splendid, radiant in ornament and vesture. E. भ्राज to shine, aff. इष्णुच्.
28983: भ्रातृ m. (-ता) A brother, a uterine brother. Dual only, (-रौ) Brother and sister. E. भ्राज to shine, Uṇādi aff. तृच्, and the radical final rejected.
28984: भ्रातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fraternal, brotherly, of or belonging to a brother. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and ठञ् aff.
28985: भ्रातृज m. (-जः) A brother's son. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and ज born.
28986: भ्रातृजाया f. (-या) A sister-in-law, a brother's wife. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and जाया a wife.
28987: भ्रातृपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A brother's wife. E. भ्रातृ, and पत्नी a wife.
28988: भ्रातृभगिन्यौ dual only, (-न्यौ) A brother and sister. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and भगिनी a sister.
28989: भ्रातृवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having a brother. E. भ्रतृ, and वलच् aff.
28990: भ्रातृव्य m. (-व्यः) 1 A brother's son. 2 An enemy. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and तव्य aff.
28991: भ्रातृश्वशुर m. (-रः) A husband's elder brother. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and श्वशुर a father-in-law, (as it were.)
28992: भ्रात्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fraternal, belonging or relating to a brother. m. (-यः) A brother's son. E. भ्रातृ a brother, and छ aff.
28993: भ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Whirled, revolved. 2 Blundering, mistaken. E. भ्रम to revolve, aff. क्त.
28994: भ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Error, mistake, ignorance. 2 Going round, whirling, revolving. 3 Unsteadiness, locomotion. 4 Going about, wandering. E. भ्रम to go round, aff. क्तिन्, and the vowel made long.
28995: भ्रान्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Erring, mistaking. 2 Wandering. E. भ्रान्ति, and मतुप् aff.
28996: भ्रान्तिहर m. (-रः) A counsellor, a minister. E. भ्रान्ति error, and हर who repels or removes.
28997: भ्राम m. (-मः) 1 Wandering, roving. 2 Error. E. भ्रम to turn round, घञ् aff.
28998: भ्रामक m. (-कः) 1 A jackal. 2 A cheat, a rogue. 3 A sort of loadstone. 4 The sun-flower. E. भ्रम to turn round, ण्वुल् aff.
28999: भ्रामयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Whirling round. 2 Bewildering. E. भ्रम to wander or whirl, causal v., शतृ aff.
29000: भ्रामर n. (-रं) 1 Whirling, going round. 2 A dance performed in a ring, dancing round-about. 3 A village. 4 Epilepsy. 5 Honey. m. (-रः) A sort of loadstone. f. (-री) 1 A name of PĀRVATĪ, from her having assumed the form of a bee, in order to contend with MAHĀSURA. 2 A Yoginī, or female attendant on DURGĀ. E. भ्रमर a bee, &c. aff., अण् or अञ्.
29001: भ्रामरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Whirling, revolving. 2 Epileptic, giddy. 3 Made of honey or from a bee, &c. E. भ्रामर, and इनि aff.
29002: भ्राम्यत् mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-भ्यत्) 1 Wandering about. roving, roaming. 2 Erring, deviating. E. भ्रम to wander, शतृ aff.
29003: भ्राश(टु, ऋ,)टुभ्राशृ r. 1st cl. (भ्राशते भ्राश्यते) To shine.
29004: भ्राष्ट्र mfn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रं) Fried in a pan. mn. (ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्रं) A frying pan. E. भ्रस्ज to fry, Uṇādi aff. ष्ट्रन्; and in the attributive, अण् added.
29005: भ्री r. 9th cl. (भ्रीणाति भ्रिणीते) 1 To fear. 2 To hold. 3 To cherish, to maintain or support.
29006: भ्रुकुंस m. (-सः) An actor in female apparel. E. भ्रु for भ्रू an eyebrow, कुसि or कुशि to shine or speak, aff. अच्; hence also भ्रुकुंश, भ्रूकुंस, &c.
29007: भ्रुकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown. E. भ्रु for भ्र an eye-brow, कुट to make crooked, इन् aff.: see भ्रूकुटि.
29008: भ्रुड r. 1st cl. (भ्रुडति) 1 To cover. 2 To collect.
29009: भ्रू f. (भ्रूः) An eye-brow. E. भ्रम to turn round, Uṇādi aff. डू.
29010: भ्रूकुंस m. (-सः) A male actor in female apparel. E. भ्रू the eyebrow, कुसि to speak or shine, aff. अच्; also from कुशि, भ्रूकुंश; this word is variously written भ्रुकुंश or भ्रुकुंस, भृकुंश or भृकुंस, and भ्रकुंश or भ्रकुंस.
29011: भ्रूकुटि f. (-टिः-टी) A frown, a look of displeasure. E. भ्रू the brow, कुट to be curved, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added; it is also written variously, like the last, and occurs भ्रुकुटि, भृकुटि, or भ्रकुटि.
29012: भ्रूक्षेप m. (-पः) A frown. E. भ्रू, and क्षेप throwing.
29013: भ्रूण r. 10th cl. (भ्रूणयते) 1 To hope, to trust. 2 To confide, to be without doubt. 3 To wish for, to desire.
29014: भ्रूण m. (-णः) The embryo or fœtus, a child. E. भ्रूण to hope, to fear, aff. घञ्.
29015: भ्रूणघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Producing or causing abortion, who or what does so. E. भ्रूण, and घ्न what destroys.
29016: भ्रूणहत्या f. (-त्या) 1 Murder of the fœtus, procuring or causing abortion. 2 Any sin equally heinous. E. भ्रूण, and हत्या killing.
29017: भ्रूणहन् mf. (-हा-घ्नी) 1 One who occasions or procures abortion. 2 The murderer of a Brahman. E. भ्रूण the embryo, (or any thing of which the death is equally heinous,) and हन् who kills.
29018: भ्रूभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A frown. E. भ्रू the brow, भङ्ग a breaking, a bending.
29020: भ्रेष(ऋ)भ्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (भ्रेषते) To go, to move, to fear.
29021: भ्रेष m. (-षः) 1 Deviation from rectitude, declining or falling from virtue, &c. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 Loss. E. भ्रेष to go, aff. घञ्.
29022: भ्रेषण n. (-णं) Going, moving. E. भ्रेष to go, aff. ल्युट्.
29024: भ्लाश(टु ऋ)टु भ्लाशृ r. 1st cl. (भ्लाश्यते भ्लाशते) To shine; sometimes भ्लास.
29025: भ्लेष(ऋ)भ्लेषृ r. 1st cl. (भ्लेषति-ते) 1 To go. 2 To fear. म
29026: म The twenty-fifth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, corresponding to the letter M.
29027: म m. (-मः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 YAMA. 5 Time, season. 6 Poison, venom. 7 A magical or mystical verse or formula. 8 The moon. 9 The abbreviated name of the fourth note of the gamut. f. (मा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A mother. 3 Measure. 4 Light, lustre. 5 Knowledge. 6 Binding, tying. 7 Death. 8 A woman's waist. n. (मं) 1 Good fortune, auspiciousness. 2 Water. E. मा to measure, or मन to worship, &c., aff. ड.
29028: मक (इ) मकि r. 1st cl. (मङ्कते) 1 To decorate, to grace or adorn. 2 To go, to move.
29029: मकर m. (-रः) 1 A marine monster, confounded usually with the crocodile and shark, but properly a fabulous animal: as a fish; it might be conjectured to be the horned shark, or the unicorn fish; but it is often drawn, as in the pictured signs of the zodiac, with the head and forelegs of an antelope, and the body and tail of a fish: it is the emblem of the god of love. 2 One of the signs of zodiac, corresponding with CAPRICORN, and like the Greek representation of that sign, being an animal in the foreparts, and ending in the tail of a fish. 3 One of KUVERA'S treasures. E. म for मुख the mouth, कृ to scatter, aff. अच्; or माङ् prohibitive aff., कृ to do, अच् aff., form irr.; grammarians however, sometimes consider this word as a primitive.
29030: मकरकेतन m. (-नः) KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID. E. मकर a marine monster, and केतन emblem; being painted on KĀMA'S banner.
29031: मकरकेतु m. (-तुः) KĀMA: see the preceding. E. मकर, and केतु an emblem.
29032: मकरध्वज m. (-जः) KĀMA: see the two last. E. मकर the Makara, and ध्वज emblem.
29033: मकरन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 The nectar or honey of a flower. 2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 3 A bee. 4 A fragrant kind of mango. 5 A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.) 6 The filament of a lotus. E. मकर the emblem of KĀMA, and दो to destroy, i. e. to surpass, as an incentive to love, aff. क, form irr.
29034: मकरन्दवती f. (-ती) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. मकरन्द honey, and मतुप् aff., fem. form.
29035: मकराकर m. (-रः) The ocean. E. मकर a marine monster, and आकर receptacle.
29036: मकराकार m. (-रः) A plant, said to be a species of Karanja or Cæsalpinia. E. मकर a fish, आकार form.
29037: मकराङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 KĀMADEVA. 2 The ocean. E. मकर a marine monster, and अङ्क mark, emblem.
29038: मकरालय m. (-यः) The ocean. E. मकर a sort of fish, and आलय abode.
29039: मकराश्व m. (-श्वः) VARUṆA. E. मकर a marine monster, and अश्व a horse; riding on the Makara.
29040: मकरिन् m. (-री) The ocean. E. मकर a marine monster, and इनि aff.
29041: मकुट n. (-टं) A crest, a head-dress, a crown, a tiara. E. मकि to adorn, aff. उट, form irr.
29042: मकुति f. (-तिः) An edict or order of the government, addressed to the Śūdra tribe, or to a Śūdra.
29043: मकुर m. (-रः) 1 A mirror. 2 The stick of a potter's wheel. 3 An unblown flower. 4 A tree with light yellow, and fragrant flowers, (Mimusops elengi.) E. मकि to adorn, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and deriv. irr.; also मुकुर.
29044: मकुल m. (-लः) 1 An opening bud. 2 A kind of tree, (Mimusops elengi.) E. मकि to adorn, उलच् aff., deriv. irr.
29045: मकुष्टक m. (-कः) A kind of kidney-bean, a wild variety perhaps of the Phaseolus mungo. E. मकु irr. deriv., from मक to adorn, ष्टक to impede, aff. अच्; also मकुष्ठक.
29046: मकुष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Going lazily, slowly, &c. m. (-ष्ठः) A sort of rice. E. मकि to adorn, aff. उ, deriv. irr. मकु, and स्था to stand, aff. क; also मुकुष्ठ.
29047: मकुष्ठक m. (-कः) A sort of kidney-bean. E. मकु ornament: (see the two last;) स्था to stay or be, aff. क्वुन्.
29048: मकूलक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Danti. E. मक to adorn, ऊलच् aff., and कन् added.
29049: मक्क r. 1st cl. (-मक्कते) To go, to move.
29050: मक्कल n. (-लं) A mineral substance, considered variously to be chalk or benzoin. E. मक्क to go, to be, aff. ऊलच.
29051: मक्कोल m. (-लः) Chalk: see the last. E. मल्ल to go, ओलच् aff.
29052: मक्ष r. 1st cl. (मक्षति) 1 To fill. 2 To be angry. 3 To mix, to combine.
29053: मक्ष m. (-क्षः) Hypocrisy, slyness, concealment of one's own defects. E. मक्ष to fill, aff. अच्.
29054: मक्षिका f. (-का) A fly. E. मक्ष to be angry, Uṇādi aff. सिकन्, or मक्ष the same, क्वुन् aff.
29055: मक्षीका f. (-का) A fly. E. see the last, the pen. vowel made long.
29056: मख r. 1st cl. (मखति) also (इ) मखि (मङ्खति) To go, to move.
29057: मख m. (-खः) Sacrifice, oblation. E. मख to go, aff. घञ् or घ.
29058: मखत्रातृ m. (-ता) RĀMA, the son of DAŚARATHA, and second incarnation of VIṢṆU so named. E. मख sacrifice, and त्रातृ who preserves; his first exploit being the discomfiture of the Rākṣasas, who disturbed the sacrifices of VIŚVAMITRA.
29059: मखवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) Sacrificial fire. E. मख sacrifice, and वह्नि fire; also similar compounds, as मखाग्नि, &c.
29060: मखानल m. (-लः) Sacrificial fire. E. मख, and अनल fire.
29061: मखासुहृद् m. (-ट्) ŚIVA. E. मख sacrifice, here meaning the sacrifice offered by DAKṢA, and असुहृद् unfriendly; having disturbed the ceremony, and slain the sacrificer.
29062: मग(इ) r. 1st cl. (मंगति) To go, to move.
29063: मगध m. (-धः) 1 A country, South Behār. 2 An inhabitant of that country. 3 A bard, whose peculiar province is to sing the praises of a chief's ancestry in his presence, a family bard or minstrel. f. (-धा) Long pepper. E. मगध a Kaṇḍvādi verb, to ask, aff. अच् or मगध the country, अण् aff., with alteration of the vowel optional; hence also मागध.
29064: मगधेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of JARĀSANDHA. E. मगध South Behar, and ईश्वर king.
29065: मग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Plunged, dived, immersed. 2 Sunk, drowned. E. मस्ज to plunge into water, aff. क, form irr.
29066: मघ(इ)मघि r. 1st cl. (मंघते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To begin moving. 3 To begin. 4 To move swiftly. 5 To blame. 6 To game. 7 To cheat, to be addicted to dishonest practices. (मंघति) To decorate, to adorn.
29067: मघ m. (-घः) 1 One of the Dvīpas or divisions of the universe. 2 A country, that of the modern Mugs, or Arrakan. 3 A drug. 4 Pleasure, happiness. n. (-घं) A kind of flower. f. (-घा) The tenth lunar asterism, containing five stars figured by a house, apparently α. γ. ζ. η. and ν. Leonis: it is sometimes considered to be confined to the plural number (मघाः). f. (-घा-घी) A sort of grain. E. मह to worship, aff. कन्, and ह changed to घ.
29068: मघवत् m. (-वान्) A name of INDRA. E. मघ happiness, (of paradise or Svarga,) मतुप् aff.
29069: मघवन् m. (-बा) 1 INDRA. 2 One of the twelve Cakravartīs, or universal monarchs of the Jainas. E. मह to sacrifice, कनिन् Uṇādi aff., and वुक् augment, form irr.; before the vowel affs. of the second case plural, and the last five cases, the व of this word is changed to उ, and thence becomes ओ as usual, as मघोनः, मघोना, मघोने, &c.; also with ङीष् aff. the fem. form is मघोनी f. (-नी) The wife of INDRA.
29070: मघाभव m. (-वः) The planet VENUS or ŚUKRA. E. मघा the asterism, and भव born.
29071: मघाभू m. (-भू) ŚUKRA. E. मघा, and भु born: see the last.
29072: मङ्किल m. (-ल) A fire in a forest. E. मकि to adorn, aff. इलच्.
29073: मङ्कुर m. (-रः) A mirror. E. मकि to adorn, उरच् aff., and the nasal retained; also मकुर and मुकुर.
29074: मङ्क्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 1 Bathing or drowning; any thing, or person. 2 Cleaning any thing by immersion. E. मस्ज to bathe, aff. तृच्, and नुम् augment.
29075: मङ्क्षण n. (-णं) Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs; it is sometimes read मङ्क्षण.
29076: मङ्क्षु ind. 1 Quickly, swiftly, instantly. 2 Much, exceedingly. E. मस्ज to purify, सु aff., and नुम् augment.
29077: मङ्क्षुण n. (-णं) Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs; in some parts of India a sort of iron chain-work petticoat, coming down to the knees, is still worn.
29078: मङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A mendicant of a particular order. E. मखि to go, अच् aff.
29079: मङ्ग m. (-ङ्कः) The head of a boat. E. मगि to go, aff. अच्.
29080: मङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Lucky, fortunate, prosperous, faring well or happily. n. (-लं) 1 Happiness, good fortune. 2 Preserving property, taking care of what has been gained, prudence, carefulness. m. (-लः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 Burnt offering on various occasions of rejoicing. f. (-ला) 1 A name of UMĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. 2 A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon,) with white blossoms. 3 A virtuous and obedient wife. 4 The mother of the fifth Jina or Jaina teacher SUMATI. 5 A species of Cæsalpinia. E. मगि to go, अलच् Uṇādi aff.
29081: मङ्गलच्छाय m. (-यः) Waved leaf fig tree, (Ficus infectoria.) E. मङ्गल prosperous, lucky, and च्छाया shade.
29082: मङ्गलपाठक m. (-कः) A bard, an encomiast. E. मङ्गल good fortune, and पाठक who reads or recites.
29083: मङ्गलप्रदा f. (-दा) Turmeric. E. मङ्गल auspiciousness, and प्रदा bestowing.
29084: मङ्गल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness, prosperity, &c. 2 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. 3 Pure, pious. m. (-ल्यः) 1 A plant, commonly Trāyamāṇa. 2 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 3 The Vilva, (Ægle marmelos.) 4 A sort of pulse, (Cicer lens.) f. (-ल्या) 1 A fragrant sort of Agallochum or aloe wood. 2 A kind of Mimosa, (M. Suma, Rox.) 3 A herb, commonly Gojihva, (Hieracium, or according to Rox.'s Catalogue, a herb of the same class, Elephantopus scaber.) 4 A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 5 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 6 A sort of perfume, commonly Rochana. 7 A kind of Orris root, (Acorus calamus.) n. (-ल्यं) 1 Sour curds. 2 Sandal. 3 Red lead. 4 Gold. E. मङ्गल prosperous, and यत् aff.
29085: मङ्गल्यक m. (-कः) Lentils, (Cicer lens.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
29086: मङ्गल्यनामधेया f. (-या) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. मङ्गल्य auspicious, नामधेया appellation.
29087: मङ्गिनी f. (-नी) A boat. E. मङ्ग the head of a boat, aff. इनि.
29088: मच also (इ) मचि r. 1st cl. (मचते मञ्चते) 1 To be vain or proud. 2 To be wicked. 3 To speak. 4 To pound or grind. मचि r. 1st cl. (मञ्चते) 1 To hold or have. 2 To be high or tall. 3 To revere, to adore, to worship. 4 To shine.
29089: मचर्च्चिका f. (-का) 1 Excellence, happiness. 2 (In apposition,) Best, excellent, (the gender is unchanged.) E. म ŚIVA, चर्च्च to worship, aff. ण्वुल् and टाप्.
29090: मच्चित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Who or what has the mind fixed on me, (God.) E. मत् me, चित्त mind.
29091: मच्छ m. (-च्छः) A fish in general. E. मद to delight, and श aff., form irr.: see मत्स्या.
29092: मज्जकृत् n. (-कृत्) A bone. E. मज्ज marrow, and कृत् what makes.
29093: मज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जती-ज्जत्) Plunging in or into, being immersed, dipping, drowning. E. मस्ज to be immersed, शतृ aff.
29094: मज्जन् m. (-ज्जा) 1 The marrow of the bones and flesh. 2 The pith or sap of trees, &c. E. मस्ज to be immersed, (in the centre of the bones, &c.) and कनिन् Uṇādi aff.
29095: मज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Bathing, ablution. 2 Immersion. 3 Drowning. 4 Marrow. E. मस्ज to bathe, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
29096: मज्जसमुद्भव n. (-वं) Semen genitale. E. मज्ज marrow, समुद्भव production.
29097: मज्जा f. (-ज्जा) Marrow, pith, sap. E. मज्जन् marrow, and टाप् aff.: see मज्जन्.
29099: मज्जिका f. (-का) The female of the Indian crane.
29100: मज्जूषा f. (-षा) A basket. E. see मञ्जूषा.
29102: मञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) 1 A bed, a bedstead. 2 A platform, a scaffold. 3 An elevated shed raised on bambus in a cornfield, &c., where a watchman is stationed to protect the corn from cattle, birds, wild beasts, &c. 4 A sort of throne or chair of state, or the platform on which it is raised, the dais. E. मचि to be high or tall, aff. अच्.
29103: मञ्चक m. (-कः) 1 A bed, a bedstead. 2 A platform, a scaffold. E. कन् added to the preceding.
29104: मञ्चकाश्रय m. (-यः) A bug. E. मञ्चक a bed, and आश्रय abode.
29105: मञ्चमण्डप m. (-पः) A sort of temporary open shed, a platform erected for particular ceremonies, as marriages, &c. E. मञ्च a scaffold, and मण्डप a temporary hall.
29106: मञ्ज r. 10th cl. (मञ्जयति) 1 To sound. 2 To clean, to purify.
29107: मञ्जर nf. (-रं-री) 1 A pearl. 2 A compound pedicle. 3 A sort of plant, commonly Tilaka. E. मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go or be, aff. अप्, deriv. irr: see the next.
29108: मञ्जरि f. (-रिः-री) 1 A compound pedicle, a fruit or flower stalk. 2 A large pearl. 3 A plant, commonly Tilaka. mf. (-रिः-री) A shoot, a sprout. E. मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go or be, aff. इ, deriv. irr., ङीप् optionally added.
29109: मञ्जरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mounted on a stalk, (a bud, &c.) E. मञ्जर, and इतच् aff.
29110: मञ्जा f. (-ञ्जा) 1 A compound pedicle: see the last. 2 A she-goat. E. मजि to sound, aff. अच्.
29111: मञ्जि f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी) A compound pedicle; also मञ्जरी.
29112: मञ्जिका f. (-का) A harlot, a whore.
29113: मञ्जिफला f. (-ला) The plantain, (Musa sapientum.) E. मञ्जि a foot-stalk, and फल fruit.
29114: मञ्जिमन् n. (-म) Beauty, elegance. E. मञ्जु handsome, इमनिच् aff.
29115: मञ्जिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Bengal madder, a plant used in medicine, and in dying, (Rubia manjith, Rox.) E. मञ्जु beautiful, स्था to stay or be, क aff., deriv. irr.; or मञ्जि a compound pedicle, and स्थ aff.
29116: मञ्जिष्ठाराग m. (-गः) 1 The dye of madder. 2 Permanent attachment. E. मञ्जिष्ठा, and राग colour.
29117: मञ्जीर n. (-रं) An ornament for the feet or toes. m. (-रः) A post, round which passes the string that works the stick of a churn. E. मञ्ज to sound, aff. ईरन्; also with कन् added, मञ्जीरक.
29118: मञ्जील m. (-लः) A village, inhabited chiefly by washermen. E. मञ्ज to sound, ईरन् aff., and र changed to ल.
29119: मञ्जु mfn. (-ञ्जुः-ञ्जुः-ञ्जु) Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. E. मजि to sound, aff. उ.
29120: मञ्जुकेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Beautiful-haired. m. (-शी) A name of KṚṢṆA, or VIṢṆU in that form. E. मञ्जु beautiful, केश hair, इनि aff.
29121: मञ्जुगमना f. (-ना) A goose. E. मञ्जु beautiful, elegant, and गमन gait.
29122: मञ्जुघोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Having a sweet voice or cry. m. (-षः) One of the Bauddha teachers. f. (-षा) One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga. E. मञ्जु agreeable, and घोष sound, voice.
29123: मञ्जुनाशी f. (-शी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 The wife of INDRA. 3 A handsome woman. E. मञ्जु beautiful, and नाश destruction; putting every other beauty to shame by their superiority.
29124: मञ्जुप्राण m. (-णः) A name of BRAHMĀ. E. मञ्जु pleasing, and प्राण life.
29125: मञ्जुभद्र m. (-द्रः) A Bauddha; also called Mañjughoṣa.
29126: मञ्जुभाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Speaking sweetly or pleasantly. f. (-णी) 1 A woman speaking kindly. 2 A species of Atijagatī metre. E. मञ्जु, and भाषिन् who speaks.
29127: मञ्जुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Beautiful, agreeable, pleasing. m. (-लः) A gallinule n. (-लं) 1 A natural water-course or channel. 2 An arbor, a bower. 3 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. मञ्जु handsome, ला to be, aff. क.
29128: मञ्जुवक्त्र mfn. (-क्त्रः-क्त्रा-क्त्रं) Lovely, handsome. E. मञ्जु beautiful, वक्त्र the face.
29129: मञ्जुश्री m. (-श्रीः) A Bauddha saint: see मञ्जुघोष.
29130: मञ्जूषा f. (-षा) 1 A basket, a large basket. 2 A stone. 3 Bengal madder. 4 The case in which the great bow that RĀMA broke, was kept. E. मस्ज to make pure or clean by ablution, Uṇādi aff. ऊषन्, and the nasal augment; also with a short vowel मञ्जुषा.
29133: मट्टक m. (-कः) 1 The ridge of a thatch. 2 A sort of grain, (Eleusine corocana.)
29134: मठ r. 1st cl. (मठति) 1 To be confused or disturbed in mind. 2 To dwell, to inhabit. (इ) मठि r. 1st cl. (मंठते) To bewail, to regret, to remember with sorrow or regret.
29135: मठ m. (-ठः) 1 A school, a college, the residence of young Brahmans, prosecuting sacred studies. 2 A building inhabited by ascetics of the same order. 3 A temple. 4 A cart, a carriage. E. मठ to dwell, aff. अच्.
29136: मठर m. (-रः) The name of a Muni or saint. E. मत to respect, Uṇādi aff. अरच्, and ठ substituted for the radical final.
29137: मड(इ)मडि r. 1st cl. (मण्डते) 1 To divide, to separate. 2 To surround, to encompass. r. 1st and 10th cls. (मण्डति मण्डयति) To adorn, to grace, to decorate. r. 10th cl. (मण्डयति) To gladden, to rejoice, to make happy.
29138: मडक m. (-कः) A kind of grain, (Eleusine corocana.)
29139: मड्डु m. (-ड्डुः) A sort of drum. E. मस्ज to purify, aff. उ, deriv. irr.; also with कन् added, मड्डुक.
29140: मण r. 1st cl. (मणति) To sound, to sound inarticulately.
29141: मणि mf. (-णिः-णिः or -णी) 1 A gem, a jewel, a precious stone. 2 A pearl. 3 Fleshy processes pending from the neck of a goat. 4 A small water pot. 5 The glans penis. 6 The clitoris. 7 The wrist. 8 One of the Nāgas or serpent chiefs of Pātāla. E. मण to sound, aff. इन्.
29142: मणिक n. (-कं) A small water jar, a pitcher. E. मणि the same, aff. कन्.
29143: मणिकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) The blue jay. E. मणि a jewel, and कण्ठ the throat.
29144: मणिकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णी-र्णं) Jewel-eared. E. मणि, and कर्ण the ear.
29145: मणिकर्णिका f. (-का) A holy pool at Benares, in which pilgrims are directed to bathe, and adjacent ghāt. E. मणि, and कर्ण the ear, aff. कन्, fem. form. Devi having dropped one of her earrings at this place.
29146: मणिकाच m. (-चः) The feathered part of an arrow.
29147: मणिकानन n. (-नं) The neck or throat. E. मणि a jewel, and कानन a wood; abounding with such ornaments.
29148: मणिकार m. (-रः) A jeweller, a lapidary or worker in precious stones. E. मणि a gem, and कार who makes.
29149: मणिग्रीव m. (-वः) One of KUVERA'S sons. E. मणि a gem, and ग्रीवा the neck.
29150: मणिछिद्रा f. (-द्रा) 1 Marrow. 2 A sort of drug.
29151: मणित n. (-तं) Low murmuring sound. E. मण to sound, aff. क्त.
29152: मणितारक m. (-कः) The Indian crane. E. मणि a jewel, तॄ to pass over, aff. ण्वुल्.
29153: मणिद्वीप m. (-पः) The crest or hood of the great serpent ANANTA. E. मणि a jewel, and द्वीप a continent.
29154: मणिधनुष् m. (-नुः) The rainbow. E. मणि a jewel, and धनुष् a bow.
29155: मणिपूर m. (-रः) 1 The navel. 2 A sort of bodice worn by women, and often richly ornamented with jewels. n. (-रं) The pit of the stomach, as one of the mystical cakras of the body: see चक्र. E. मणि a jewel, and पूर filling, full.
29156: मणिबन्ध m. (-न्धः) The wrist. E. मणि a jewel, and बन्ध binding; where bracelets of precious stones are bound.
29157: मणिभद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 One of the Jinas, or Jaina deified teachers. 2 A name of the king of the Yakṣas.
29158: मणिभित्ति f. (-त्तिः) The palace of the great serpent, ŚEṢA Nāga. E. मणि a jewel, and भित्ति a wall.
29159: मणिभूमि f. (-मिः) A jewel mine, or a place where gems or precious stones are found. E. मणि a gem, and भूमि ground; also मणिभू f. (-भूः).
29160: मणिमण्डप m. (-पः) 1 The capital of Śeṣa. 2 The palace of NAIRṚTA, regent of the S. W. quarter. E. मणि a jewel, and मण्डप a building.
29161: मणिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having jewels, possessed of or adorned with them. m. (-मान्) The sun. E. मणि, and मतुप् poss. aff.
29162: मणिमध्य n. (-ध्यं) A species of the Vṛhatī metre.
29163: मणिमन्थ n. (-न्थं) 1 A mountain or range where salt is found 2 Rock salt. E. मणि a gem, and मन्थ what churns; also माणिमन्थ.
29164: मणिमाला f. (-ला) 1 A necklace, a zone, a fillet, &c. of precious stones. 2 An impression left by a bite. 3 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 4 Light, lustre. 5 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. मणि a gem, and माला a necklace, &c.
29165: मणिरत्न n. (-त्नं) A precious gem. E. मणि, and रत्न a jewel, or the best of any thing.
29166: मणिव m. (-वः) One of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla. E. मणि a gem, and व poss. aff.
29167: मणिवीज m. (-जः) The pomegranate. E. मणि a gem, and वीज seed.
29168: मणिसर n. (-रं) A string of gems, a necklace, &c. E. मणि, and सर what goes.
29169: मणिसौपान m. (-नः) A staff or stick set with jewels. E. मणि a jewel, सौपान a ladder.
29170: मणीचक n. (-कं) The moon gem, probably a sort of crystal. m. (-कः) A kingfisher.
29171: मणीवक n. (-कं) A flower. E. मण to sound, deriv. irr.
29172: मण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) 1 Scum, skimmings, froth, foam, barm, &c., the upper part of any infusion in a state of boiling or ferment. 2 Pith, essence. 3 The head. m. (-ण्डः) 1 Ornament, decoration, 2 The castor oil tree, (Palma christi.) 3 A sort of potherb. f. (-ण्डा) 1 Spirituous or vinous liquor. 2 Emblic myrobalan. E. मडि to adorn, Uṇādi aff. ड.
29173: मण्डन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Adorning, dressing, decorating, fond of or putting on ornaments. n. (-नं) Ornament, decoration, jewels, trinkets, &c. E. मडि to adorn, aff. युच्.
29174: मण्डप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A temporary building, an open shed or hall, adorned with flowers and erected on festival occasions, as at marriages, &c. 2 An open temple or building consecrated to a deity. E. मण्ड ornament, and पा to preserve, aff. क.
29175: मण्डयन्त m. (-न्तः) An ornament, a decoration of trinkets, jewels, &c. f. (-न्ती) A woman, a wife. E. मडि to adorn, Uṇādi aff. झच्. fem. aff. ङीप्.
29177: मण्डल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) The disk of the sun or moon. n. (-लं) 1 The sun's disk. 2 An orb, a circumference in general or the circle bounding the view, the sensible horizon. 3 (In astronomy,) A great circle, as नाडीमण्डलं the equator, क्रान्तिमण्डलं the ecliptic. 4 A ball, a globe. 5 A wheel. 6 A province, a region, a district, extending twenty, or according to some authorities, forty Yojanas every way. 7 The country or empire, over which the twelve princes termed Cakravartīs are supposed to have ruled; perhaps the peninsula of India, where the term Maṇḍala or Mandel is of constant occurrence, to signify a province or district, as in Coromandet, &c. 8 Surrounding or contiguous countries. 9 A sort of leprosy with circular spots. 10 A heap, a quantity, a multitude or  assemblage. 11 An attitude in shooting, the fifth position, in which both knees are bent. 12 The impression or scratch of a finger nail. 13 A sort of perfume, resembling in appearance a dried shell fish. 14 A sort of mystical diagram. 15 A sweetmeat, a sugar-ball. 16 A form of array, an army drawn up in a circle. m. (-लः) 1 A kind of snake. 2 A dog. f. (-ली) Bent grass. E. मडि to adorn, aff. कलच्.
29178: मण्डलक n. (-कं) 1 An orb or disk. 2 A sort of leprosy, with large round spots. 3 A mirror. 4 A form of array, an army drawn up in a circle. 5 A circular figure or diagram. m. (-कः) A dog. E. कन् added to the preceding.
29179: मण्डलनृत्य n. (-त्यं) Dancing in a ring, especially a dance imitative of one, said to have been danced by the Gopīs round KṚṢṆA and his mistress RĀDHĀ. E. मण्डल a circle, and नृत्य dancing.
29180: मण्डलाग्र m. (-ग्रः) A sword, a scimitar. E. मण्डल a circle, and अग्र top or point.
29181: मण्डलायित n. (-तं) A ball, a globe. E. मण्डल a circle, क्यप् aff., and क्त added.
29182: मण्डलाधीश m. (-शः) An emperor, a king of kings. E. मण्डल an extensive district or empire, and अधीश sovereign.
29183: मण्डलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Being in a circle, made up into a coil or ball. 2 Surrounded by. m. (-ली) 1 A large species of snake. 2 A cat. 3 A polecat. 4 A dog. 5 The sun. 6 The ruler or governor of a Maṇḍala or district. E. मण्डल a circle, and इनि aff.
29184: मण्डलीकरण n. (-णं) Rounding, gathering in a ball or a circle, coiling, &c. E. मण्डल, and करण making, च्चि augment.
29185: मण्डलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rounded, made round or globular, gathered in a ball or circle. E. मण्डल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
29186: मण्डलेश m. (-शः) An emperor, a supreme monarch. E. मण्डल an empire, and ईश sovereign.
29187: मण्डलेश्वर m. (-रः) A sovereign, a monarch. E. मण्डल a district, and ईश्वर a sovereign; the power of this prince is limited by AMARA, and the Maṇḍaleśvara is considered as an emperor or supreme prince, only when in addition to his territorial sway, he has performed the Rājasūya sacrifice, or sacrifice in which he has been attended by all his tributary or subject princes: other authorities confound the sovereign of a Maṇḍala, with the Cakravartī or emperor, and with the Samrāj or lord paramount, and others confine him to the government of a district of twenty or forty Yojanas in each direction.
29188: मण्डहारक m. (-कः) A distiller. E. मण्ड froth, ferment, and हृ to take, aff. अण्, and कन् added.
29189: मण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ornamented, adorned. m. (-तः) One of the eleven persons called Gaṇādhipas by the Jainas. E. मडि to adorn, aff. क्त.
29190: मण्डूक m. (-कः) 1 A frog. 2 The name of a Muni. 3 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) f. (-का-की) Madder, (Rubia Manjith.) f. (-की) 1 A female or small frog. 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica, or Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) 3 An unchaste or abandoned woman. E. मडि to ornament, Uṇādi aff. ऊकन्.
29191: मण्डूकपर्ण mf. (-र्णः-र्णी) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) f. (-र्णी) 1 Bengal madder, (Rubia Manjith.) 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 3 A sort of creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.) E. मण्डूक a frog, and पर्ण a leaf, compared to the animal in shape or colour.
29192: मण्डूर mn. (-रः-रं) Rust of iron. E. मडि to adorn, ऊरच् aff.
29193: मण्डोदक n. (-कं) 1 Painting figures or flowers, on the walls or floors of an apartment, &c. on festival occasions, with a white pigment made from ground rice. 2 Variegated colour. E. मण्ड scum, and उदक water.
29194: मत् ind. Mine. E. irregular substitute for मम possessive case of अत्मट् I, and used in composition, as मत्पुत्त्र my son, मन्नाथ my lord.
29195: मत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Admitted, believed, held or entertained, (as opinion, &c.) 3 Respected, reverenced, minded, regarded. n. (-तं) 1 Purpose, intention, wish, mind, (as to have a mind to any thing.) 2 Knowledge. 3 Doctrine, tenet, belief, opinion. E. मन to mind, aff. क्त.
29196: मतङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The name of a Muni. 2 A cloud. 3 An elephant. E. मदि to please, to be pleased, अङ्गच् Uṇādi. aff., deriv. irr.
29197: मतङ्गज m. (-जः) An elephant. E. मतङ्ग the saint MATAṄGA, and ज born.
29198: मतल्लिका f. (-का) Excellence, happiness: (also attributively, but unvarying in gender,) excellent, best, happiest; there is no etymon of this word, according to the best authorities.
29199: मति f. (-तिः) 1 Understanding, intellect. 2 Wish, desire, inclination. 3 Memory, recollection. 4 Respect, reverence. 5 A potherb. E. मन to respect, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
29200: मतिप्रकर्ष m. (-र्षः) Cleverness, talent. E. मति, and प्रकर्ष superiority.
29201: मतिभ्रम m. (-मः) Error, mistake. E. मति understanding, and भ्रम error.
29202: मतिभ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Error, mistake, misapprehension. E. मति mind, understanding, and भ्रान्ति error.
29203: मतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Sensible, clever, intelligent. E. मति, and मतुप् aff.
29204: मतिविभ्रम m. (-मः) Error. E. मति, and विभ्रम error.
29205: मतिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Stupid, ignorant. E. मति, and हीन devoid of.
29206: मत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Mine, belonging to me, &c. m. (-त्कः) A bug: (see the next.) E. मत् for मम mine, and कन् poss. aff.
29207: मत्कुण m. (-णः) 1 A bug. 2 A flea. 3 An elephant without tusks. 4 A beardless man. 5 The cocoanut. 6 Armour for the thighs or legs. 7 A buffalo. f. (-णा) The pudendum muliebre, without hair on the pubis. E. मट् or मत् pleasure, क्वन to sound, aff. अच्, the deriv. irr.
29208: मत्कुणारि m. (-रिः) Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) E. मत्कुण a bug, and अरि an enemy.
29209: मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Pleased, glad, delighted. 2 Intoxicated, (drunk with liquor.) 3 Intoxicated, (with pride, passion, &c.) 4 Furious, mad, insane. m. (-त्तः) 1 A furious elephant, or one in rut. 2 A buffalo. 3 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 4 The thorn apple, (Datura.) f. (-त्ता) 1 Vinous liquor. 2 A species of the Paṅkti metre. E. मद to rejoice, &c. aff. क्त.
29210: मत्तकाशिनी f. (-नी) An excellent woman. E. मत्त intoxicated, and काश to shine, aff. इनि; also from काष or कास, मत्तकाषिणी, and मत्तकासिनी.
29211: मत्तकीश m. (-शः) An elephant. E. मत्तक for मत्त furious, and ईश lord, the vowel unchanged.
29212: मत्तदन्तिन् m. (-न्ती) A furious elephant. E. मत्त, and दन्तिन् an elephant.
29213: मत्तमयूर m. (-रः) 1 A wild peacock. 2 A species of the Atijagatī metre. E. मत्त, and मयूर a peacock.
29214: मत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Better or more than mine. E. मत् for मम mine, and डतरच् aff. of comparison.
29215: मत्तवारण m. (-णः) A furious elephant, or one in rut. n. (-णं) 1 A painted wooden turret or veranda, on the top of a large building or palace. 2 An enclosure of trees, &c. round the walls of a princely residence. 3 Pounded betle nut. E. मत्त wild, and वारण्ण an elephant, or fence.
29216: मत्ताक्रीड n. (-डं) A species of the Vikṛti metre. E. मत्त, and आक्रीड playing.
29217: मत्तालम्ब m. (-म्बः) A fence or enclosure round the walls of a palace, either artificial as palisades, or natural as a grove of trees, &c. E. मत्त mad, wild, (enemies, &c.) आलम्ब delaying.
29218: मत्तेभगमना f. (-ना) A woman with a lounging or rolling walk. E. मत्त intoxicated, इभ an elephant, गमना who goes.
29219: मत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Devoted to me, (GOD.) E. मत्, and पर attentive.
29220: मत्य n. (-त्यं) 1 The iron-bound handle of a sickle. 2 The exercise or application of knowledge. 3 The means of acquiring knowledge. E. मति knowledge, &c., aff. यत्.
29221: मत्र(इ,)मत्रि r. 1st and 10th cls. (मन्त्रति मन्त्रयति) To speak privately, to counsel or advise. With आङ्, To address or salute. With नि, To invite.
29222: मत्स m. (-त्सः) A fish. E. मदि to be pleased, स aff.
29224: मत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Envious. 2 Niggardly, covetous. mf. (-रः-रा) 1 Envy, impatience of another's success or prosperity. 2 Passion, anger. f. (-रा) A gnat, a musquito. E. मदि to rejoice, Uṇādi aff. सर.
29225: मत्सरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Wicked, depraved, bad. 2 Envious. E. मत्सर envy, इनि aff.
29226: मत्स्य mf. (-त्स्यः-त्स्यी) A fish in general. m. (-त्स्यः) 1 A particular fish, probably the Śapharī, or the fish in which VIṢṆU was incarnate in his fish Avatāra. 2 A name of VIṢṆU, from his incarnation as a fish. 3 A country, enumerated amongst the midland divisions of India, (Dinajpur and Rangpur.) 4 One of the Purāṇas. E. मदि to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. स्यत्.
29227: मत्स्यकरण्डिका f. (-का) A fish basket. E. मत्स्य a fish, and करण्ड a basket, कन् added in the fem. form.
29228: मत्स्यगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 1 A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya; (the common name is applied to the Nama zeylanica, and the Commelina salicifolia.) 2 The mother of the sacred poet VYĀSA: see मत्स्योदरी. E. मत्स्य a fish, and गन्ध smell.
29229: मत्स्यघात m. (-तः) Catching fish. E. मत्स्य, and घात killing.
29230: मत्स्यजाल n. (-लं) A fishing net. E. मत्स्य fish, and जाल net.
29231: मत्स्यण्डी f. (-ण्डी) Coarse or unrefined sugar, the juice of the sugar-cane, either after its first boiling, or after it is partially freed from impurities by straining. E. मन्द slowly, स्यन्द to trickle or ooze, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्, deriv. irr.; also with कन् added, मत्स्यण्डीका.
29232: मत्स्यधानी f. (-नी) A fish basket, a small basket used by fishermen, to put the fish into when caught; it is also sometimes, but less accurately, applied to a kind of snare of reeds or grass, which is left in the water, and entangles the fish that swim with the current. E. मत्स्य a fish, धा to have or hold, aff. ल्युट्; also with आङ् prefixed, मत्स्याधानी.
29233: मत्स्यनाशक m. (-कः) An osprey. E. मत्स्य a fish, and नाशक destroyer.
29234: मत्स्यनाशन m. (-नः) An osprey. E. मत्स्य a fish, and नाशन destroyer.
29235: मत्स्यपित्ता f. (-त्ता) A medicinal plant, commonly Katuki. E. मत्स्य a fish, and पित्त bile; being as bitter.
29236: मत्स्यबन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) A fisherman. f. (-नी) A fish basket. E. मत्स्य a fish, and बन्ध confining, aff. इनि.
29237: मत्स्यरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A king-fisher. E. मत्स्य a fish, and रङ्ग inclination; also with कन् added, मत्स्यरङ्गक; it is also read मत्स्यरङ्क.
29238: मत्स्यराज m. (-जः) 1 The Rohi, a sort of fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 2 The country called Matsya. E. मत्स्य a fish, and राज supreme.
29239: मत्स्यवेधन nf. (-नं-नी) A fish-hook. f. (-नी) A bird, the shag, E. मत्स्य a fish, विध to pierce, aff. ल्युट्.
29240: मत्स्यसंघात m. (-तः) A shoal of young or small fish. E. मत्स्य a fish, and संघात heap, quantity.
29241: मत्स्यसन्तानिक m. (-कः) Fish baked in a crust of clay and straw, and eaten with condiments and oil. E. मत्स्य fish, सन्तान product, aff. ठक्.
29242: मत्स्याक्षी f. (-क्षी) The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. मत्स्य a fish, and अक्ष an eye, aff. ङीष्; to which the flowers are compared.
29243: मत्स्याङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, (Hingtsha repens, Rox.) E. मत्स्य a fish, अङ्ग the body or form, aff. ङीष्.
29244: मत्स्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what feeds upon fish. E. मत्स्य, and अद who eats.
29245: मत्स्यादनी f. (-नी) A name applied to several plants, as to Jussieua repens, Hingtsha repens, Nama zeylanica, &c. E. मत्स्य a fish, अदन eating, food, aff. ङीष्.
29246: मत्स्याशन m. (-नः) The king-fisher. E. मत्स्य a fish, and अशन eating.
29247: मत्स्योदरी f. (-री) 1 A name of SATYAVATĪ, the mother of VYĀSA. 2 A place of pilgrimage, a particular pool at Benares held in reverence by pilgrims to that sacred city. E. मत्स्य a fish, and उदर the belly; the mother of VYĀSA was found in the belly of a fish, and retaining a fishy odour, was thence also called MATSYAGANDHA, till the scent was changed to that of a lotus by her paramour the Muni PARĀŚARA, the father of VYĀSA.
29248: मथ(ए,)मथे r. 1st cl. (मथति) 1 To churn. 2 To stir or agitate. (इ,) मथि (मन्थति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To afflict. 3 To suffer pain.
29249: मथन n. (-नं) Churning. m. (-नः) A tree, the wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition, (Premna longifolia.) E. मथ to churn, to stir or rub, aff. ल्युट्.
29250: मथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stirred, churned. 2 Agitated, mentally, distressed, anxious. n. (-तं) Butter-milk, without any watery admixture. E. मथ to churn, aff. क्त.
29251: मथिन् m. (-न्था) A churning stick. E. मथि to stir or agitate, aff. इन्, and the nasal rejected.
29252: मथुरा f. (-रा) A town in the province of Agra, celebrated as the birth place, and early residence of KṚṢṆA, and still an object of pilgrimage amongst the Hindus. E. मथि to stir, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
29253: मथुरेश m. (-शः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. मथुरा a town, and ईश ruler.
29254: मथूरा f. (-रा) Mathurā as above. E. ऊरच् affixed to मथि, instead of उरच्.
29255: मद r. 1st cl. (मादयते) (इ, इर्) मदि r. 1st cl. (मन्दति), and (ई, इर्) मदी r. 4th cl. (माद्यति) 1 To be glad, to be satisfied or content, to rejoice. 2 To be proud. (इ) मदि r. 1st cl. (मन्दति) 1 To praise. 2 To sleep, to doze, to be lazy or sluggish. 3 To be stupid, to be an idiot or fool. 4 To be elegant. 5 To go or approach. मद r. 10th cl. (मादयते) To cause or justify satisfaction or contentment. मदी r. 1st cl. causal form (मादयति) 1 To delight, to make glad, to exhilarate. 2 To madden or intoxicate, literally or figuratively. 2 To be poor or distressed. 4 To be proud. With नि prefixed, (निमादयति) To articulate.
29256: मद m. (-दः) 1 Joy, pleasure, delight. 2 The juice that flows from an elephant's temples when in rut. 3 Spirituous or vinous liquor. 4 Inebriety, intoxication. 5 Pride, arrogance. 6 Insanity, madness. 7 Semen virile. 8 Musk. 9 A male river. 10 Passion, desire. f. (-दी) 1 A drinking vessel. 2 An instrument for making furrows. E. मद to be pleased, &c., aff. अप् or अच्.
29257: मदकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Speaking inarticulately or like a drunken person. m. (-लः) An elephant in rut. E. मद inebriety, &c., कल to sound, aff. अच्.
29258: मदकोहल m. (-लः) A bull that has been liberated at some festival, and is allowed to wander about at will. E. मद pleasure, कुह to sound, aff. अलच्.
29259: मदगन्धा f. (-न्धा) Spirituous liquor. E. मद intoxication, and गन्ध smell.
29260: मदगमन m. (-नः) A buffalo. E. मद pleasure, and गमन going.
29261: मदघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A potherb, (Basella lucida, &c.) E. मद inebriety, घ्नी what destroys.
29262: मदन m. (-नः) 1 KĀMADEVA, the Hindu CUPID. 2 The season of spring. 3 A plant commonly Mayana, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) 5 A bee. 6 A sort of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.) 7 Bee's wax. 8 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.) f. (-ना-नी) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. मद to exhilarate or rejoice, aff. ल्युट्, fem. aff. टाप्, or ङीष्.
29263: मदनकाकुरव m. (-वः) A pigeon, a dove. E. मदन love, काकु change of voice, and रव who utters.
29264: मदनपाठक m. (-कः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मदन spring, and पाठक reader; announcing the season.
29265: मदनवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Subdued by love, in love. E. मदन, and वश subdued.
29266: मदनललित n. (-तं) 1 Sign or effect of love. 2 A species of the Aṣṭī metre.
29267: मदनशलाका f. (-का) 1 A provocative medicine. 2 The Mayana, or more properly the Śārikā, a small bird. 3 The female of the Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मदन love, &c., and शलाका the bird, or a dart, &c.
29268: मदनसारिका f. (-का) The Śārikā or Śārika, a small bird, (Turdus salica.) E. मदब love, and सारिका the Śālikā.
29269: मदनाङ्कुश m. (-शः) 1 Membrum virile. 2 A finger nail. E. मदन KĀMADEVA, and अङ्कुश a goad.
29270: मदनायुध m. (-धः) Pudendum muliebre. E. मदन, and आयुध a weapon.
29271: मदनालय m. (-यः) 1 A sovereign, a prince. 2 A lotus. 3 Pudendum muliebre. E. मदन pleasure, आलय receptacle, abode.
29272: मदनावस्था f. (-स्था) Separation of lovers. E. मदन love, अव depreciative prefix, स्था to stay, aff. क, and टाप्.
29273: मदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be enamoured. 2 Causing or exciting passion. E. मद to delight, अनीयर् aff.
29274: मदनोत्सव m. (-वः) The vernal festival of the Hindus, the Holī. f. (-वा) A courtezan of heaven. E. मदन spring or love, and उत्सव festival.
29275: मदप्रयोग m. (-गः) The issue of the fluid from the forehead of an elephant in rut. E. मद the fluid, and प्रयोग junction.
29276: मदभञ्जिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. मद inebriety, भञ्ज breaking, इनि aff.
29277: मदयन्तिका f. (-का) Arabian jasmine. E. कन् added to the next.
29278: मदयन्ती f. (-न्ती) Arabian jasmine. E. मद to delight, झच् Uṇādi aff., and ङीप् fem. aff.
29279: मदयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 1 Love or CUPID. 2 A distiller. 3 A drunken man, a mad man. 4 A cloud. n. (-त्नु) Vinous or spirituous liquor. E. मद in the causal form, to intoxicate, &c., Uṇādi aff. इत्नुच्.
29280: मदराग m. (-गः) 1 Love or KĀMA. 2 A cock. E. मद passion or desire, and राग propensity, inclination.
29281: मदविक्षिप्त m. (-प्तः) A furious elephant, or one in rut. E. मद the juice, and विक्षिप्त tossed, agitated.
29282: मदवृन्द m. (-न्दः) An elephant. E. मद the juice, and वृन्द a quantity.
29283: मदस्थल n. (-लं) A tavern, a dram shop. E. मद intoxication, and स्थल place.
29284: मदस्थान n. (-नं) A place where liquor is sold, a tavern, a dram shop. E. मद drunkenness, and स्थान place.
29285: मदाढ्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Intoxicated, drunk. m. (-द्यः) The palm tree. f. (-द्या) A sort of Barleria, with red flowers. E. मद intoxication, आद्य fit or proper for.
29286: मदातङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) Pain and sickness, consequent upon ebriety. E. मद, and आतङ्क fear.
29287: मदात्यय m. (-यः) Disorder induced by drunkenness; head-ache, sickness, loss of appetite, &c. E. मद drunkenness, and अत्यय consequence.
29288: मदान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Blind with pride or passion, arrogant, dissolute, &c. E. मद, and अन्ध blind.
29289: मदाम्नात m. (-तः) A drum carried on an elephant. E. मद pride, आम्नात minded, respected, from मना with आङ् prefix, and क्त aff.
29290: मदाम्बर m. (-रः) INDRA'S elephant. E. मद the frontal fluid, and अम्बर garment, housing.
29291: मदार m. (-रः) 1 An elephant. 2 A rogue. 3 A libertine, a lecher. 4 An elephant in rut. 5 A hog. 6 The name of a king. 7 A sort of perfume, probably musk. E. मद to be intoxicated, &c., Uṇādi aff. आरन्.
29292: मदार्म्मद m. (-दः) A sort of fish: see फलक.
29293: मदालस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Indolent, slothful, overcome with passion or pride. E. मद, and अलस idle.
29294: मदालापिन् m. (-पी) The Koïl; or Indian cuckoo. E. मद delight, आङ् before लप to speak, aff. णिनि; the song of this bird is constantly heard in the spring in most parts of Hindustan.
29295: मदाह्व m. (-ह्वः) Musk. E. मद musk, and आह्व name.
29296: मदिर m. (-रः) A red species of Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) f. (-रा) 1 Wine, spirits, spirituous or vinous liquor. 2 A wagtail. 3 A species of the Ākṛti metre. E. मद to be delighted, &c., Uṇādi aff. किरन्, fem. aff. टाप्.
29297: मदिराक्षी f. (-क्षी) A woman, a mistress, a wife. E. मदिरा wine, अक्षि the eye, षच् and ङीष् affs., whose eyes inebriate like wine.
29298: मदिरागृह n. (-हं) A tavern, a dram shop. E. मदिरा wine, and गृह a house.
29299: मदिरासख m. (-खः) The mango, (Mangifera Indica.) E. मदिरा wine or spirits, and सखि the friend.
29300: मदिरेक्षणा f. (-णा) A fascinating woman. E. मदिरा, and ईक्षण the eye.
29301: मदिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Vinous liquor. E. मद what delights or intoxicates, इष्ठन् superlative aff.
29302: मदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Mine, my own. E. मत् for मम mine, and छ aff.
29303: मदोत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Arrogant, haughty. 2 Furious, mad. m. (-टः) 1 An elephant in rut. 2 A pigeon. E. मद, and उत्कट who is furious.
29304: मदोदग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Haughty, arrogant. f. (-ग्रा) A woman in general. E. मद, and उदग्र elevated.
29305: मदोद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Drunk, intoxicated. 2 Arrogant, drunk with pride. E. मद drunkenness, उद्धत struck, overcome.
29306: मदोन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Drunk or mad with pride, passion, &c. E. मद, and उन्मत्त mad.
29307: मद्गु m. (-द्गुः) 1 An aquatic bird, the shag. 2 An outcaste, the son of a Brahman by a woman of the bard, or panegyrist class, whose employment is hunting wild beasts. 3 A ship, a galley. E. मस्ज to emerge, to dive, उ aff., deriv. irr., or मद to be delighted, (in the water,) and गुक् Uṇādi aff.
29308: मद्गुर m. (-रः) A fish, (Macropteronatus Magur, HAM.) E. मद to intoxicate, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and गुक् augment, form irr.; also with कन् added, मद्गुरक्.
29309: मद्गुरसी f. (-सी) A sort of fish: see मद्गुर.
29310: मद्य n. (-द्यं) Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor. E. मद to be intoxicated (by it), aff. यत्.
29311: मद्यपङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) Vinous liquor for distilling. E. मद्य wine, पङ्क mud.
29312: मद्यपासन n. (-नं) Eating a relish, or what excites thirst. E. मद्य wine, पस to go, aff. ल्युट्.
29313: मद्यपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drunk, a drunkard. E. मद्य, and पीत drunk.
29314: मद्यपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, the blossoms of which are used in distilling: see मद्यवासिनी, &c. E. मद्य wine, पुष्प the flower.
29315: मद्यमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Yeast, barm, froth. E. मद्य wine, मण्ड froth, scum.
29316: मद्यवासिनी f. (-नी) A shrub, the blossoms of which are used in distilling, (Grislea tomentosa, or Lythrum fruticosum.) E. मद्य wine, वस to dwell, aff. णिनि and ङीष्.
29317: मद्यवीज n. (-जं) A drug used to produce fermentation. E. मद्य wine, and वीज seed.
29318: मद्यसन्धान n. (-नं) Distillation. E. मद्य vinous liquor, and सन्धान distilling.
29319: मद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 Joy, delight. 2 A country enumerated amongst those to the N. W. of Hindustan proper. 3 A sovereign of that country. f. (-द्रा) The name of a river. E. मदि to be delighted, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
29320: मद्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced, &c. in the country of Madra. E. मद्र a country so named, and कन् aff.
29321: मद्रकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Delighting, giving delight. E. मद्र delight, कृ to make, aff. अण्; also with खच् aff., मद्रङ्कर.
29322: मद्रसुता f. (-ता) The wife of Pāṇḍu, mother of the two youngest Paṇḍu princes. E. मद्र a proper name, and सुता the daughter.
29323: मद्वन् m. (-द्वा) A name of ŚIVA. E. मद to be intoxicated, वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
29324: मद्वर्गीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Connected with or related to me. E. मत् mine, वर्ग a class or number, ख aff.; also with छ aff., मद्वर्ग्गीय; and with यत्, मद्वर्ग्य.
29325: मधु mfn. (-धुः-ध्वी-धु) Sweet, literally or figuratively. n. (-धु) 1 Spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia, or according to some explanations wine, or spirit distilled from grapes. 2 Honey. 3 The nectar, or honey of flowers. 4 Water. 5 Milk. 6 Sugar. 7 Sweetness, in flavour, sound, or disposition. m. (-धुः) 1 The month Chaitra, (March-April.) 2 The season of spring. 3 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 4 The name of a Daitya or demon, slain by VIṢṆU. 5 The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia asoca.) 6 Liquorice. 7 The name of a RĀKṢASA killed by ŚATRUGHNA. f. (-धुः) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. मन to mind or respect, Uṇādi aff. उ, and ध substituted for the final.
29326: मधुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sweet, (in taste.) 2 Sweet speaking, or sounding, mellifluous, melodious. m. (-कः) 1 A bard, a panegyrist, one who recites the lineage and praises of sovereigns in their presence. 2 A bird. 2 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) mn. (-कः-कं) Liquorice, &c. n. (-कं) Tin. f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Menispermum. glabrum.) 2 The sweet lime. 3 A kind of panic seed. E. मधु sweet, कै to sound, aff. ड; or मधु honey, कन् aff. of comparison, &c.
29327: मधुकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु honey, (as sweet,) कण्ठ the throat.
29328: मधुकर m. (-रः) 1 A bee. 2 A lover. 3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 4 A fruit, the round sweet lime. E. मधु honey, and कर what makes.
29329: मधुकर्क्कटिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of citron, the round sweet lime. 2 A kind of date. E. मधु honey, and कर्क्कटी or कर्क्कटिका a cucumber; some authorities have मधुकुक्कुटिका in place of this word.
29330: मधुकारिन् m. (-री) A bee. E. मधु, and कारिन् who makes.
29331: मधुकेशट m. (-टः) A bee. E. मधुके in honey, and शट to go, aff. अच्.
29332: मधुकृत् m. (-कृत्) A bee. E. मधु honey, and कृत् what makes.
29333: मधुकोष m. (-षः) The honeycomb or hive. E. मधु honey, कोष receptacle.
29334: मधुक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Tippling. 2 The honeycomb. E. मधु wine or honey, and क्रम order, arrangement.
29335: मधुक्षीर m. (-रः) The date tree. E. मधु honey, and क्षीर milk.
29337: मधुघोष m. (-षः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु sweet, and घोष voice.
29338: मधुज n. (-जं) Bee's wax. f. (-जा) 1 The earth. 2 Clayed or candied sugar. E. मधु honey, and ज produced.
29339: मधुजित् m. (-जित्) VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. मधु the demon so named, and जित् conqueror.
29340: मधुतृण n. (-णं) Sugar-cane. E. मधु sweet, and तृण grass.
29341: मधुदीप m. (-पः) KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID. E. मधु spring, and दीप inflaming.
29342: मधुदूत m. (-तः) The mango tree. E. मधु spring, and दूत messenger; blossoming in spring.
29343: मधुद्र m. (-द्रः) A bee. E. मधु honey, द्रु to take, क aff., and the vowel changed.
29344: मधुद्रव m. (-वः) A red variety of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. मधु honey, and द्रव dropping.
29345: मधुद्रुम m. (-मः) A tree, from the blossoms of which a spirit is distilled, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मधु wine, and द्रुम a tree.
29346: मधुधातु m. (-तुः) A sort of pyrites. E. मधु honey, (as yellow,) and धातु mineral, honey-stone.
29347: मधुधूलि f. (-लिः) Molasses, sugar before it is quite purified. E. मधु honey, and धूलि dust.
29348: मधुनालिकेरक m. (-कः) A sweet kind of cocoanut. E. मधु sweet, नालिकेरक cocoanut.
29349: मधुनेतृ m. (-ता) A bee. E. मधु honey, नी to get, तृच् aff.
29350: मधुनोलेह m. (-हः) A bee. E. मधुनः of honey, लेह who licks.
29351: मधुप m. (-पः) A bee. E. मधु honey, and प who drinks.
29352: मधुपर्क n. (-र्कं) A dish of curds, ghee, and honey, to be offered to a respectable guest on his arrival. E. मधु honey, पृच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
29353: मधुपर्णिका f. (-का) 1 The indigo plant. 2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 3 Moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 4 A creeper of the cryptogamia class, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) 5 A shrub, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. मधु honey, पर्ण a leaf, aff. कन्, fem. form; also मधुपर्णी.
29354: मधुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A sort of creeper, (Menispermum glabrum.) 2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 3 The indigo plant. 4 The sweet lime. E. मधु honey, पर्ण the leaf, aff. ङीष्.
29355: मधुपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Living on honey. m. (-यी) A bee. E. मधु honey, पा to drink, णिनि aff., and युक् augment.
29356: मधुपालिका f. (-का) A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) E. मधु honey, पाल to nourish, वुन् aff., fem. form.
29357: मधुपुरी f. (-री) Mathurā, a city so called. E. मधु the Rākṣasa killed by ŚATRUGHNA, and पुरी city or capital.
29358: मधुपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 2 The Mimosa Śirīṣa. 3 The Bakul, (Mimusops elengi.) E. मधु wine or honey, and पुष्प flower.
29359: मधुप्रिय m. (-यः) 1 A shrub, (Ardisia solanacea.) 2 A name of BALARĀMA. E. मधु wine, &c., and प्रिय fond of.
29360: मधुफल m. (-लः) 1 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 2 A sweet kind of cocoanut. E. मधु honey, and फल fruit.
29361: मधुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Sweet, honied. f. (-ती) A species of the Uṣṇih metre. E. मधु, and मतुप् aff.
29362: मधुभिद् m. (-भिट् or -भित्) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. मधु the Daitya, and भिट् destroyer.
29363: मधुमक्षिका f. (-का) A bee. E. मधु honey, and मक्षिका a fly.
29364: मधुमथन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. मधु the Daitya, and मथन destroyer.
29365: मधुमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sweet, luscious. E. मधु, and मयट् aff.
29366: मधुमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Double jasmine. E. मधु honey, and मल्ली jasmine.
29367: मधुमस्तक n. (-कं) A sweetmeat made of flour, honey, oil, and ghee. E. मधु honey, and मस्तक a head.
29368: मधुमाध्वीक m. (-कं) A spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia latifolia. E. मधु spirit, and माध्वीक the same.
29369: मधुमूल n. (-लं) An esculent root, a sort of yam. E. मधु spirit, and मूल root.
29370: मधुयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Sugar-cane. E. मधु honey, and यष्टि a cane or stick.
29371: मधुयष्टिका f. (-का) Liquorice, (Glycirrhiza glabra, or rather the Abrus precatorius, of which the root is similarly used.) E. मधु honey, यष्टि a stick, and कन् added; or without the aff. मधुयष्टी f. (-ष्टी)
29372: मधुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Sweet. 2 Pleasing, agreeable, liked. m. (-रः) 3 The sweet taste, sweetness. 4 A drug, commonly Jīvaka. n. (-रं) 1 Poison. 2 Tin. 3 Treacle, syrup. f. (-रा) 1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa or panmorium, Rox.) 2 Anise, (Pimpinella anisum.) 3 A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) 4 Liquorice. 5 The sweet lime. 6 Marrow. 7 The city Mathurā. 8 A medicinal plant, commonly Kakkoli. 9 Asparagus racemosus. 10 Bengal beet. E. मधु honey, and रा to get or be, aff. क; to have the flavour of honey, to be as sweet.
29373: मधुरक m. (-कः) A medicinal plant, commonly Jīvaka. E. मधुर the same, and कन् added.
29374: मधुरकण्टक m. (-कः) A sort of fish. E. मधुर sweet, and कण्टक bone.
29375: मधुरजम्बीर m. (-रः) The sweet lime. E. मधुर sweet, जम्बीर lime.
29376: मधुरत्वच m. (-चः) A shrub, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. मधुर sweet, त्वच् bark, अच् added.
29377: मधुरनिस्वना f. (-ना) A woman with a sweet voice. E. मधुर sweet, निस्वन who sounds.
29378: मधुरवीजपूर m. (-रः) The sweet lime. E. मधुर sweet, वीजपूर a citron.
29379: मधुरस m. (-सः) 1 Sweetness, (in flavour.) 2 Sweetness, (in speech.) 3 The sugar-cane. 4 The palm tree. f. (-सा) 1 A shrub, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) 2 A plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. मधु wine or honey, and रस juice, flavour.
29380: मधुराक्षर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sweet, mellifluous, mellow, melodious. E. मधुर, and अक्षर a letter.
29381: मधुराम्लक m. (-कः) The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.) E. मधुर sweet, अम्ल sour, कन् aff.
29382: मधुरालापा f. (-पा) The talking Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. मधुर sweet, आलाप talking, fem. form.
29383: मधुरिका f. (-का) A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa, Rox.) E. मधुरा the same, कन् aff.; this name is applied also to the Anethum panmorium, Rox. and the Bengali derivative Mahuri is applied to common anise.
29384: मधुरिपु m. (-पुः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. मधु the demon, and रिपु foe.
29385: मधुरोदक m. (-कः) The sea of fresh or sweet water, surrounding Puṣkara dvīpa, and being the outermost of the seven seas. E. मधुर sweet, and उदक water.
29386: मधुल n. (-लं) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. मधु wine, ला to be or get, aff. क.
29387: मधुलिह् m. (-लिड्-लिट्) A bee. E. मधु honey, लिह् to lick, aff. क्विष्.
29388: मधुलेह m. (-हः) A bee. E. मधु, and लेह what licks.
29389: मधुलेहिन् m. (-ही) A bee. E. मधु honey, लिह to lick, aff. णिनि
29390: मधुवन m. (-नः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु sweet, and वन who speaks or cries.
29391: मधुवार m. (-रः) Tippling, drinking frequently and repeatedly. E. मधु wine, वार quantity.
29392: मधुवीज m. (-जः) The pomegranate. E. मधु sweet, वीज seed.
29393: मधुव्रत m. (-तः) A bee. E. मधु honey, व्रत observance.
29394: मधुशाख m. (-खः) Bassia latifolia. E. मधु spirituous liquor, शाखा a branch.
29395: मधुशिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) A red variety of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. मधु sweet, and शिग्रु the same tree.
29396: मधुश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. मधु honey, श्रेणी a line or row.
29397: मधुष्ठील m. (-लः) A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मधु spirit, ष्ठीव to eject, aff. क, and ल substituted for the final.
29398: मधुसख m. (-खः) KĀMADEVA. E. मधु spring, and सख for सखि friend.
29399: मधुसहाय m. (-यः) KĀMADEVA. E. मधु, and सहाय friend.
29400: मधुसात् ind. As honey, sweet. E. मधु, and साति aff.
29401: मधुसाद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become sweet. E. मधुसात्, and भूत become.
29402: मधुसारथि m. (-थिः) KĀMA the Hindu CUPID. E. मधु the spring personified, and सारथि a charioteer, having Vasanta or spring for his coachman.
29403: मधुसिक्थक m. (-क) A sort of poison. E. मधु honey, and सिक्थक wax.
29404: मधुसुहृद् m. (-हृद् or -हृत्) KĀMADEVA. E. मधु spring, सुहृत् the friend.
29405: मधुसूदन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU. f. (-नी) Bengal beet. E. मधु the Daitya or honey, and सूदन destroyer.
29406: मधुस्रवस् m. (-वाः) A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मधु spirituous liquor, स्रु to drop or distil, aff. असुन्.
29407: मधुस्रवा f. (-वा) 1 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) 2 Liquorice. E. मधु honey, स्रु to drop, aff. अप् and टाप्.
29408: मधुस्वर m. (-रः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. मधु sweet or spring, and स्वर note, song.
29409: मधुहन् m. (-हा) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. मधु the Daitya, and हन् destroyer.
29410: मधूक m. (-कः) A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) E. मन to respect, ऊक aff., and ध substituted for the final.
29411: मधूच्छिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Bee's wax. E. मधु honey, and उच्छिष्ट left, rejected.
29412: मधूपघ्न n. (-घ्नं) The city Mathurā. E. मधु the demon, उपघ्न destruction.
29413: मधूल m. (-लः) A sort of Bassia described as growing in watery or mountainous situations. f. (-ली) 1 Liquorice. 2 The sweet lime. 3 The mango tree. 4 A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. मधु honey or spirit, ला to be or get, aff. ड, and the उ of मधु irregularly long.
29414: मधूलक mfn. (-लकः लिका-लकं) Sweet. m. (-कः) 1 A sort of Bassia, growing in watery or mountainous sites. 2 Sweetness. f. (-लिका) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
29415: मध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Middle, intermediate. 2 Right, proper, reasonable. 3 Low, vile. 4 Amongst, amidst. 5 Mean, (in astronomy,) as मध्यछाया middle or mean shadow. mn. (-ध्यः-ध्यं) 1 The west. 2 Mean or common time in music. 3 The middle, the centre. 4 The waist. f. (-ध्या) 1 A young woman, a girl arrived at puberty. 2 The middle finger. 3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines containing three syllables in each. m. (-ध्यः) Cessation, rest, interval. n. (-ध्यं) 1 A very large number, ten Āntyas. 2 A horse's flank. E. मां beauty, धा to have, अण् aff., deriv. irr.
29416: मध्यग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes in the centre or betwixt, amongst, &c. E. मध्य, and ग what goes.
29417: मध्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The mango tree. E. मध्य middle, and गन्ध smell.
29418: मध्यचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going amongst or amidst. E. मध्य, and चारिन् who goes.
29419: मध्यतस् ind. From or in the middle, centrical, centrically. E. मध्य the middle, and तसि aff.
29420: मध्यदेश m. (-शः) The middle region; part of India, bounded by Kurukṣetra on the north, Allahabad on the south, the Himālaya mountains on the east, and the Vindhya mountains on the west; comprising therefore the modern provinces of Allahabad, Agra, Delhi, Oude, &c.; the northern limit is elsewhere defined to be the disappearance of the Sarasvatī. E. भध्य middle, and देश country.
29421: मध्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Middle, centrical, intervening, intermediate. 2 Middle born, neither the oldest nor youngest. 3 Mean, (in astronomy,) as मध्यमगति mean motion (of a planet.) mn. (-मः-मं) The waist, the middle of the body. m. (-मः) 1 One of the seven musical notes, the fifth note of the Hindu gamut. 2 The middle country: see मध्यदेश. 3 A sort of deer. 4 One of the Grāmas or musical scales of the Hindus, corresponding apparently with the major mode of European music. f. (-मा) 1 A girl arrived at puberty, or in whom menstruation has commenced. 2 The middle finger. 3 A central blossom. 4 A form of metre, a verse of four lines of three syllables each. E. मध्य middle, and म aff.
29422: मध्यमपाण्डव m. (-वः) ARJUNA, the third or middle of the PĀṆḌU princes. E. मध्यम middle, and पाण्डव Pāṇḍava or descendant of PĀṆḌU.
29423: मध्यमलोक m. (-कः) The earth, the world of mortals. E. मध्यम middle, and लोक world; between heaven and hell.
29424: मध्यमभृतक m. (-कः) A husbandman. E. मध्यम middle, and भृतक a labourer; working partly for his own advantage, and partly for that of the landlord.
29425: मध्यमवयस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Middle, aged. E. मध्यम, and वयस्क aged.
29426: मध्यमसंग्रह m. (-हः) Intriguing with another man's wife, the act of presenting flowers, perfumes, &c. to her, and conversing with her privately. E. मध्यम middle, संग्रह connexion.
29427: मध्यमसाहस n. (-सः) 1 Punishment due to crimes of a middling degree. 2 Injuring buildings, throwing down walls, &c. E. मध्यम middle, साहस violence.
29428: मध्यमिका f. (-का) A girl arrived at puberty, one in whom menstruation has commenced. E. मध्यमा the same, कन् added, in the fem. form.
