29429: मध्यमीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Central, middle. E. मध्यम middle, and छ aff.
29430: मध्ययव m. (-वः) A weight of six white mustard seeds. E. मध्य middle, and यव barley-corn, the Yava being sometimes considered equal to eight seeds.
29431: मध्यरात्र m. (-त्रः) Midnight. E. मध्य middle, रात्र night, and the masculine form in the compound.
29432: मध्यलोक m. (-कः) The earth, the dwelling of mortals. E. मध्य middle, and लोक world; placed in the middle between heaven and hell; also with कन् added मध्यलोकक.
29433: मध्यलोकेश m. (-शः) A king, a sovereign. E. मध्यलोक the earth, and ईश sovereign.
29434: मध्यवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 1 Central, middle. 2 Being amongst or amidst. m. (-र्त्ती) A mediator. E. मध्य, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
29435: मध्यवृत्त n. (-त्तं) The navel. E. मध्य the middle, and वृत्त abiding.
29436: मध्यस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Centrical, middle. m. (-स्थः) A middle man, an umpire, an arbitrator, a mediator. E. मध्य middle, and स्थ what or who stays.
29437: मध्यस्थता f. (-ता) 1 Middle state or character. 2 Indifference. E. मध्यस्थ middle, and तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व, मध्यस्थत्व n. (-त्वं)
29438: मध्यस्थल n. (-लं) The waist. E. मध्य middle, स्थल place or part.
29439: मध्याह्न m. (-ह्नः) Midday, noon. E. मध्य middle, अहन् a day.
29440: मध्वल m. (-लः) Tippling, drinking repeatedly. E. मधु wine, अल to be equal to, aff. अच्.
29441: मध्वापात m. (-तः) Taste or touch of honey. E. मधु, and आपात alighting.
29442: मध्वालुक n. (-कं) Sweet potatoe. E. मधु sweet, आलु an esculent root, कन् added.
29443: मध्वासव m. (-वः) A spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia. E. मधु the Bassia, and आसव spirit.
29444: मध्वासवनिक m. (-कः) A distiller. E. मध्वासव spirit, नी to go, aff. क, form irr.
29446: मन r. 4th cl. (मन्यते) (उ,) मनु r. 8th cl. (मनुते) 1 To know, to understand. 2 To regard, to mind. 3 To think, to conceive. r. 10th cl. (मानयते) 1 To be dull or insensible. 2 To be proud. 3 To oppose, to stop. r. 1st and 10th cls. (मनति मानयति) To honour, to respect, to worship. With अनु prefixed, To assent to, to agree. With अभि, To desire. With अव, To disrespect. With सम, To concur, to agree.
29447: मन n. (-नं) Indian spikenard. E. मन to respect, aff. अच्.
29448: मनआप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Pleasing, agreeable, beautiful. E. मनस् the mind, आप to go or attract, aff. अच्; the final consonant of the first word is rejected, and the vowels do not coalesce.
29449: मनःकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attended to, applying the mind. E. मनस्, and कृत made.
29450: मनःशिल mf. (-लः-ला) Red arsenic. E. मनस् the mind, शिला a stone; a mineral delightful to the mind or heart; also with the dental स, मनःसिल.
29451: मनःसिल mf. (-लः-ला) Red arsenic: see the last.
29452: मनन n. (-नं) Minding, understanding. E. मन to know, aff, ल्युट्.
29453: मनस् n. (-नः) 1 The mind, or considered as the seat of perception and passion, the heart. 2 The intellect, the understanding. E. मन to know, to understand, aff. असुन्.
29454: मनसा f. (-सा) The goddess of the serpent race, and the particular protectress against their venom. E. मनस् the mind, aff. ठाप्; the object of love and devotion.
29455: मनसाज्ञायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Knowing by the mind, perceiving intellectually. E. मनसा third case of मबस्, and ज्ञायिन् who knows.
29456: मनसादेवी f. (-वी) The goddess presiding over snakes: see the last. E. मनसा the same, and देवी goddess.
29457: मनसिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mental, intellectual. m. (-जः) A name of KĀMA or love. E. मनसि in the heart or mind, and ज born.
29458: मनसिशय m. (-यः) KĀMA or love. E. मनसि in the heart or mind, and शय who reposes.
29459: मनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Mental. E. मनस्, and कन् aff.
29460: मनस्कार m. (-रः) The attention of the mind to its own sensations, consciousness of pleasure or pain. E. मनस् of the mind, and कार operation; the compound also occurs with the seventh case सनसिकार.
29461: मनस्ताप m. (-पः) Mental distress. E. मनस्, and ताप sorrow.
29462: मनस्ताल m. (-लः) The lion of DURGĀ. E. मनस् the mind, तल to depress, aff. घञ्.
29463: मनस्विता f. (-ता) 1 Hope, expectation, dependance. 2 Intelligence. E. मनस्विन्, and तल् aff.
29464: मनस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Attentive, fixing the mind upon any thing. 2 Intelligent, intellectual. f. (-स्विनी) A virtuous wife. E. मनस् the mind or heart, aff. विन्.
29465: मनाक् ind. 1 A little. 2 Tardily, slowly. E. मन to know, आक् aff.
29466: मनाका f. (-का) A female elephant. E. मन to mind or know, Uṇādi aff. आक.
29467: मनाक्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Doing little, lazy, sluggish. f. (-रा) A sort of Agallochum. E. मनाक् a little, and कर who does.
29468: मनायी f. (-यी) The wife of MANU. E. मनु the saint, ङीष् aff., and उ changed to ऐ; otherwise मनवी the same.
29469: मनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, understood. E. मन to know, aff. क्त.
29470: मनीक n. (-कं) Collyrium, powdered antimony or other substances, used as an application and ornament to the eye. E. मन to know, to be agreeable, ईकन् Uṇādi aff.
29471: मनीषा f. (-षा) Intellect, understanding. E. मनस् mind, ईष to go, aff. क, or ईष aff., form irr.
29472: मनीषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Intellectual, intelligent. m. (-षी) A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher. E. मनीषा understanding, इनि possessive aff.
29473: मनु m. (-नुः) 1 MANU, the legislator and saint, the son of BRAHMĀ, or a personification of BRAHMĀ himself, the creator of the world, and progenitor of mankind; the name is however a generic term, and in every Kalpa or interval from creation to creation, there are fourteen successive MANUS presiding over the universe for the period of a Manvantara, respectively: in the present creation there have been the six following MANUS: MANU called also SVAYAMBHUVA, the supposed revealer of the code of law possessed by the Hindus, SVAROCIṢA, UTTAMA, TĀMASA, RAIVATA, and CĀKṢUṢA; the seventh or the present MANU is VAIVASVATA, or RAIVATA the second. 2 A man in general. 3 One of the Jaina saints. 4 A Mantra, a mystical verse or formula. f. (-नुः-नायी-नावी) The wife of the legislator MANU. E. मन to know or understand, (the Vedas or scripture especially,) and उ Uṇādi aff.
29474: मनुज m. (-जः) A man in general. f. (-जा) A woman. E. मनु the legislator and progenitor of mankind, and ज born, descended.
29475: मनुजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A king. E. मनुज, and इन्द्र chief.
29476: मनुभू m. (-भूः) Man, a man, mankind. E. मनु the saint, and भू born: see the last.
29477: मनुराज् m. (-राट्) KUVERA, the god of wealth. E. मनु man, and राज् to shine, aff. क्विप्.
29478: मनुषी f. (-षी) A woman, the wife or female of the man. E. मनुष्य a man, and ङीष् aff.
29479: मनुष्य m. (-ष्यः) Man, a man, mankind. E. मनु the progenitor of mankind, यत् aff. of descent, and युक् augment.
29480: मनुष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) The state or condition of man, manhood, humanity. E. त्व added to मनुष्य; also with तल्, मनुष्यता.
29481: मनुष्यधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) KUVERA, the god of wealth. n. (-र्म्म) The duty of man. E. मनुष्य man, and धर्म्मन् piety.
29482: मनुष्ययज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Hospitality. E. मनुष्य a man, and यज्ञ sacrifice, sacrament.
29483: मनुष्यसभा f. (-भा) 1 A multitude, a crowd, a meeting. 2 A place of meeting or assembly. E. मनुष्य a man, mankind, and सभा assembly.
29484: मनोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seated in the mind. n. (-तं) Thoughts, ideas, notions, feelings. E. मनस्, and गत gone to or in.
29485: मनोगवी f. (-वी) Wish, desire. E. मनस् the mind, and गो a cow, &c., fem. form.
29486: मनोगुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Thought or meditated on secretly. f. (-प्ता) Red arsenic. E. मनस् the mind, and गुप्त cherished.
29487: मनोज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or seated in the mind. m. (-जः) KĀMA. E. मनस्, and ज born.
29488: मनोजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born or seated in the mind. m. (-न्मा) KĀMA or CUPID. E. मनस् the heart or mind, and जन्मन् birth; also मनोज.
29489: मनोजव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Fatherly, parental. 2 Quick in thought or apprehension. 3 Swift, as thought. f. (-वा) A plant: see अग्निजिह्वा. n. (-वं) Quickness of thought or apprehension. E. मनस् the mind, जु to move, to pervade, aff. अच्, or मनस् compounded with जव speed.
29490: मनोजवस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Fatherly. E. मनोज desire, love, वस to abide, aff. अच्.
29491: मनोज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Beautiful, handsome, lovely, pleasing, agreeable. f. (-ज्ञा) 1 Red arsenic. 2 The daughter of a sovereign, a princess. E. मनस् the mind or heart, ज्ञा to know, to get, aff. क.
29492: मनोदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Restraint or controul over the mind. E. मनस्, and दण्ड castigation.
29493: मनोनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Chosen, preferred. E. मनस्, and नीत taken.
29494: मनोभव m. (-वः) KĀMA or CUPID. E. मनस् the mind or heart, and भव born.
29495: मनोभू m. (-भूः) KĀMADEVA. E. मनस् the heart, भू born.
29496: मनोयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Swift, quick, as thought. E. मनस्, and यायिन् what goes.
29497: मनोयोनि m. (-निः) The deity KĀMA. E. मनस् the heart, and योनि place of production.
29498: मनोरथ m. (-थः) Wish, desire. E. मनस् the heart, and रथ vehicle.
29499: मनोरम mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Beautiful, lovely, pleasing. f. (-मा) 1 A goddess, peculiar to the Bauddhas. 2 A species of the Paṅkti metre. E. मनस् the mind, रम to delight, aff. अच्.
29500: मनोलौल्य n. (-ल्यं) Fancy, caprice, whim. E. मनस्, and लौल्य unsteadiness.
29501: मनोहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disappointed. E. मनस् the mind, हत struck.
29502: मनोहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Beautiful, lovely, pleasing. E. मनस् the mind, हृ to take or steal, aff. अप्.
29503: मनोहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable, lovely. E. मनस् the mind, हृ to steal, aff. णिनि.
29504: मनोह्वा f. (-ह्वा) Red arsenic. E. मनस् the mind, and ह्वेञ् to call, to arrest, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
29505: मन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be reflected on, to be ascertained or fixed in the mind, to be discussed either mentally or with proper persons. 2 To be thought, believed, conceived, &c. E. मन to know, aff. तव्य.
29506: मन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 1 Fault, offence, transgression. 2 A man, mankind. 3 A king. f. (-न्तुः) Understanding, intellect. E. मन to know, Uṇādi aff. तु.
29507: मन्तृ m. (-न्ता) 1 A sage, one who is possessed of holy knowledge. 2 An adviser, a counsellor. E. मन to know, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.
29508: मन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) 1 A division of the Vedas; in the first or practical part or Kāṇḍam, it includes prayers and hymns, addressed to particular deities, and used at peculiar sacrifices, &c.; in the Uttara Kāṇḍam, it is applied to addresses to BRAHMĀ or God, and to didactic explanations of his nature and attributes,  &c. 2 A mystical verse or incantation, (in the Tantras.) 3 A formula sacred to any individual deity, as, Om Viṣṇave nama, Om Śivāya nama, &c. 4 Secret consultation, private advice. E. मत्रि to advise or consult privately, aff. अच्.
29509: मन्त्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) A counsellor, a minister. E. मन्त्र advice, and कृत् who gives or makes.
29510: मन्त्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Consecrated by the Mantra. E. मन्त्र, and कृत made.
29511: मन्त्रगण्डक m. (-कः) Knowledge, science. E. मन्त्र advice, गडि to be a part of, aff. वुन्.
29512: मन्त्रगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Secret counsel. E. मन्त्र, and गुप्ति concealing.
29513: मन्त्रगूढ m. (-ढः) A spy, a secret emissary or agent. E. मन्त्र advice, information, गूढ secret.
29514: मन्त्रजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A name of fire. E. मन्त्र prayer, and जिह्वा the tongue.
29515: मन्त्रज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent. 2 A counsellor, an adviser. 3 A priest, a sacred teacher. E. मन्त्र advice, &c. and ज्ञ who knows.
29516: मन्त्रण nf. (-णं-णा) Advising, counselling in private. E. मत्रि to counsel, युच् aff.
29517: मन्त्रतस् ind. 1 From, with, or by, a Mantra or mystical prayer. 2 Advisedly, deliberately. E. मन्त्र, and तसि substituted for the termination of the fourth or fifth cases.
29518: मन्त्रद m. (-दः) A spiritual guide or teacher. E. मन्त्र initiatory text, and द who gives.
29519: मन्त्रदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) A Brahman learned in the Vedas. E. मन्त्र, and दर्शिन् who sees.
29520: मन्त्रदीधिति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire. E. मन्त्र holy prayer, and दीधिति lustre.
29521: मन्त्रपूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A name of GARUḌA. E. मन्त्र, and पूतात्मन् pure.
29522: मन्त्रफल n. (-लं) The object or effect of counsel. E. मन्त्र, and फल fruit.
29523: मन्त्रभेद m. (-दः) Divulging or betraying counsel. E. मन्त्र, and भेद breaking.
29524: मन्त्रयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Counselling, consulting. E. मत्रि to advise, शतृ aff.
29525: मन्त्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Accompanied with holy texts, (a ceremony.) 2 Entitled to use the Vedas. 3 Initiated. 4 Having or hearing counsel. E. मन्त्र, and मतुप् aff.
29526: मन्त्रवित् m. (-विट्-वित्) 1 A spy, a secret emissary or agent. 2 A counsellor. 3 A priest. 4 A Brahman learned in the Vedas. E. मन्त्र secret council, &c. and विट् who knows.
29527: मन्त्रस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Obtaining or effecting any thing by means of mystic formulæ or prayers. E. मन्त्र a prayer of the Vedas, &c., and स्पृश् to touch, aff. क्विन्.
29528: मन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Advised, counselled, planned. E. मत्रि to consult, aff. क्त.
29529: मन्त्रित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Property or condition of a counsellor, counsellorship. E. मन्त्रिन्, and त्व added.
29530: मन्त्रिन् m. (-न्त्री) A counsellor or adviser, a king's counsellor or minister. E. मचि to advise, इनि aff.
29531: मन्त्रोपष्टम्भ m. (-म्मः) Advice, direction. E. मन्त्र, and उपष्टम्भ stopping.
29532: मन्थ r. 1st cl. (मन्थति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To afflict. 3 To suffer pain. 1st and 9th cls. (मन्थति मथ्नाति) To agitate, to stir, to churn.
29533: मन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 A churning. stick. 2 The sun. 3 A dish made of barley meal with ghee and water, a sort of gruel or porridge. 4 A disease of the eyes, cataract or opacity. 5 Rheum, excretion of the eyes. 6 Killing, destroying. 7 Agitating, stirring, churning. E. मन्थ to churn, &c., aff. अच्.
29534: मन्थज n. (-जं) Butter. E. मन्थ churning, and ज produced.
29535: मन्थदण्डक m. (-कः) A churning-stick. E. मन्थ churning, and दण्डक a stick.
29536: मन्थन n. (-नं) 1 Agitating, stirring, churning. 2 Killing, injuring. f. (-नी) A churn. E. मन्थ to agitate, &c. aff. ल्युट्.
29537: मन्थनघटी f. (-टी) A churn, a common earthen pot used for the purpose. E. मन्थन churning, and घटी a small jar or pitcher.
29538: मन्थर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Slow, lazy, tardy. 2 Large, bulky. 3 Curved, bowed, crooked. 4 Stupid, dull, a fool. 5 Low, vile, little. 6 Low, hollow, (as sound.) m. (-रः) 1 A soldier marching slowly. 2 A spy, an informer. 3 A treasury, a store, a repertory. 4 Fruit. 5 An obstacle, a hindrance. 6 A churning-stick. 7 Fresh butter. 8 The month Vaiśākha. 9 Passion, wrath. 10 A deer. 11 A fort, a strong-hold. 12 The mountain Mandara. n. (-रं) Safflower. E. मन्थ to agitate, &c. aff. अरण्.
29539: मन्थरु m. (-रुः) The wind from a Chowrie or whisk. E. मन्थ to agitate, अरुन् aff.
29540: मन्थशैल m. (-लः) The mountain Mandara. E. मन्थ a churningstick, and शैल a mountain, being so employed in churning the ocean.
29541: मन्थान m. (-नः) A churning-stick. E. मन्थ to agitate, आनच् aff.
29542: मन्थिन् mfn. (-न्थी-न्थिनी-न्थि) 1 Agitating, churning. 2 Paining, afflicting. f. (-नी) A churn. E. मन्थ to churn, णीनि aff.
29543: मन्थोदधि m. (-धिः) Sea of milk. E. मन्थ churning, and उदघि a sea.
29544: मन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) 1 Slow, tardy. 2 Dull, stupid, heavy. 3 Foolish, a fool. 4 Unlucky. 5 Sick, diseased. 6 Little. 7 Idle, lazy. 8 Drunken, addicted to drunkenness. 9 Vile, wicked. 10 Self-willed. 11 Cold, phlegmatic, apathetic. 12 Low, (as a tone.) m. (-न्दः) 1 A name of SATURN. 2 A sort of elephant. 3 A name of YAMA. 4 (In astronomy,) Anomaly. 5 A destruction of the universe. E. मदि to be lazy, &c. aff. घञ्.
29545: मन्दकान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Dull, not bright. E. मन्द, and कान्त shining.
29546: मन्दगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Going slowly. E. मन्द, and गत gone.
29547: मन्दगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Slow moving. f. (-तिः) Going slowly. E. मन्द, and गति going.
29548: मन्दगमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what moves slowly. n. (-नं) Moving or going slowly. E. मन्द, and गमन going.
29549: मन्दगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going slowly or gently. m. (-मी) A soldier marching slowly. E. मन्द slow, गम to go, aff. घिनुण्.
29550: मन्दजननी f. (-नी) The wife of SŪRYA. E. मन्द SATURN, and जननी mother.
29551: मन्दट m. (-टः) The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.) E. मदि to please, aff. अटच्.
29552: मन्दन n. (-नं) Praise, eulogium. E. मदि to be pleased, (by) Uṇādi aff. क्यु.
29553: मन्दफल n. (-लं) (In astronomy), The anomalistic equation of a planet. E. मन्द, and फल product.
29554: मन्दबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Stupid, foolish. E. मन्द, and बुद्धि understanding.
29555: मन्दभाग्य. mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Wretched, unhappy, unfortunate. E. मन्द, and भाग्य fate.
29556: मन्दमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Dull, stupid, slow of apprehension. E. मन्द, and मति intellect.
29557: मन्दयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Slow, tardy. E. मदि to be slow, शानच् aff.
29558: मन्दर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Large, bulky. 2 Slow, sluggish, dull, lazy, &c. m. (-रः) 1 The mountain Mandara, with which the ocean was churned by the Suras and Asuras, after the deluge, for the purpose of recovering the sacred things lost in it during that period. 2 The Mandara tree, one of the trees of paradise. 3 Svarga or the paradise of the Hindus. 4 A string of pearls, &c. 5 A mirror. E. मदि to please, to be lazy, &c. अरन् aff.
29559: मन्दसान m. (-नः) 1 A name of AGNI or fire. 2 Life, living. 3 Sleep, sleeping. E. मदि to be slow or sleepy, Uṇādi aff. असानच्.
29560: मन्दस्मित n. (-तं) A smile, a gentle laugh. E. मन्द slowly, gently, स्मित smiling.
29561: मन्दहास्य n. (-स्यं) A smile, a gentle laugh. E. मन्द slowly, gently, and हास्य laughter.
29562: मन्दाक n. (-कः) Praising, praise. E. मन्द to praise, आकन् Uṇādi aff.
29563: मन्दाकिनी f. (-नी) 1 The Ganges of heaven. 2 A species of the Jagatī metre. E. मन्द slowly, अक to go, aff. णिनि, fem. form.
29564: मन्दाक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre.
29565: मन्दाक्ष n. (-क्षं) Modesty, shame, bashfulness. E. मन्द slow, retiring, and अक्ष organ of sense.
29566: मन्दात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Slow of apprehension, dull. E. मन्द, and आत्मन् self.
29567: मन्दादर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Disregarding, neglecting, disrespecting. E. मन्द, and आदर respect.
29568: मन्दानिल m. (-लः) A gentle breeze, zephyr. E. मन्द, and अनिल wind.
29569: मन्दायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Delaying, going tardily. E. मदि to be lazy, causal v., शानच् aff.
29570: मन्दार m. (-रः) 1 One of the five trees of Svarga. 2 The coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens.) 3 Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) E. मदि to delight, &c. aff. आरक्.
29571: मन्दास्य n. (-स्यं) Shame, modesty. E. मन्द retiring, and आस्य face.
29572: मन्दिकुकुर m. (-रः) A sort of fish.
29573: मन्दिर nf. (-रं-रा) A house. n. (-रं) 1 A town. 2 A temple. m. (-रः) 1 The sea. 2 The back of the knee, the ham. 3 One of the Gandharbas. f. (-रा) A stable. E. मदि to sleep, &c. Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
29574: मन्दिरपशु m. (-शुः) A cat. E. मन्दिर a house, and पशु an animal.
29575: मन्दीभव m. (-वः) 1 Tardiness. 2 Stupidity. E. मन्द्, and भू to be, अप् aff., च्चि augment.
29576: मन्दीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being slow, dull, stupid, &c. E. मन्द, and भू to be, aff. क्त, च्चि augment.
29577: मन्दुरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in a stable. E. मन्दुरा, and ज born, the final of the first rejected.
29578: मन्दुरा f. (-रा) 1 A stable. 2 A bed, a mat used as one. E. मदि to please, &c. Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
29579: मन्दोच्छ m. (-च्छः) The apsis of a planet's orbit. E. मन्द, and उच्छ high.
29580: मन्दोदरी f. (-री) A proper name, the wife of RĀVAṆA. E. मन्द slow, heavy, उदर the belly, aff. ङीष्.
29581: मन्दोदरीश m. (-शः) A name of RĀVAṆA. E. मन्दोदरी as above, and ईश lord or husband.
29582: मन्दोदरीसुत m. (-तः) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. मन्दोदरी the wife of the demon, and सुत son.
29583: मन्दोष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Temperate, tepid, moderately warm. n. (-ष्णं) Warmth, gentle heat. E. मन्द slack, and उष्ण hot.
29584: मन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A base or low tone, such as the grumbling of clouds, &c. 2 A sort of drum. E. मदि to please, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
29585: मन्मथ m. (-थः) 1 A name of KĀMA, the god of love. 2 Love, amorous passion or desire. 3 The elephant or wood-apple. E. मत् the heart, मथ to agitate, aff. अच्.
29586: मन्मन m. (-नः) Whispering, murmuring, low reiterated sound, especially murmur libidinosum. E. मत् the heart or mind, मन to express, aff. अच्.
29587: मन्मथिन् mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि) Amorous, impassioned, in love. E. मन्मथ, and इनि aff.
29588: मन्मय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Full of me, like me, (God.) E. मत्, and मयट् aff.
29589: मन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Thinking, considering. 2 Respecting, attending to. 3 Praising. E. मन to mind, शानच् aff.
29590: मन्या f. (-न्या) The tendon forming the nape of the neck. E. मन to mind, to admire, aff. क्यप्.
29591: मन्याका f. (-का) The tendon of the trapezium muscle forming the nape of the neck. E. मन्या the same, and कन् added.
29592: मन्यु m. (-न्युः) 1 Sorrow, grief. 2 Distress, indigence. 3 Anger, wrath. 4 A sacrifice. 5 Pride. E. मन to know, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
29593: मन्युमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Sorrowful, distressed. 2 Angry, wrathful. E. मन्यु, and मतुप् aff.
29594: मन्वन्तर n. (-रं) The reign of a MANU, a period equal to seventy-one ages of the gods, or 306,720,000 years of mortals, or with its Sandhi or interval of universal deluge, 308,448,000 years; fourteen Manvantaras constitute a Kalpa; the grand period of creation and destruction, or 4,320,000,000 years; each Manvantara is governed by its distinct MANU, and is provided with its own INDRA, and minor deities; according to Hindu cosmogony, there have been innumerable Manvantaras since the first creation of the world. E. मनु MANU, and अन्तर period or interval.
29595: मन्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Thinking, conceiving. 2 Minding, regarding. E. म्ना to mind, शानच् aff.
29596: मपष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo;) also मपष्टक, and मपुष्टक.
29597: मपुष्टक m. (-कं) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo;) also मपष्टक.
29598: मभ्र r. 1st cl. (मभ्रति) To go, to move.
29599: ममता f. (-ता) 1 Pride, arrogance, self-sufficiency. 2 The interest or affection entertained for other objects from considering  them as belonging to or connected with one's self. 3 Individuality. E. मम mine, the possessive case of अस्मट् I, and तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व aff. ममत्व.
29600: ममतायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Selfish. m. (-क्तः) A miser, a niggard. E. ममता selfishness, and युक्त affected.
29601: ममापताल m. (-लः) An object of sense. E. मव्य to bind, आल Uṇādi aff., य rejected, and म substituted for ब, and आपतुट् augment.
29602: मय r. 1st cl. (मयते) To go, to move.
29603: मय m. (-यः) 1 A camel. 2 A mule. 3 A demon, and the carpenter or architect of the DAITYAS. 4 Hurting, injuring. f. (-या) Administering remedies, the practice of physic. E. मय to go, or मि to scatter, or मी to hurt, aff. अच् or खल् and टाप्.
29604: मयट m. (-टः) A hut of grass or leaves. E. मय to go, अटच् aff.
29605: मयु m. (-युः) 1 A Kinnara or chorister of Svarga. 2 A deer. E. मि to scatter, (sweet sounds, &c.,) Uṇādi aff. उ.
29606: मयुराज m. (-जः) A name of KUVERA. E. मयु a Kinnara, and राज chief; having these beings attached especially to his court and capital.
29607: मयुष्टक m. (-कः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. मय to go, aff. उ, मयु one who goes, ष्टक to impede, aff. ड, मयुष्ट, and with the pleonastic addition, कुन् मयुष्टक; also with अच् aff. after मय to go, मयष्ट, and मयष्टक; and again with प substituted for म, मपष्ट, मपष्टक, मपुष्ट or मपुष्टक.
29608: मयूख m. (-खः) 1 Light, lustre, brightness. 2 A ray of light. 3 Flame. 4 Beauty. 5 The pin or gnomon of a sun-dial. E. मा to measure, (time, &c.,) ऊख Uṇādi aff., and मय substituted for the root.
29609: मयूर m. (-रः) 1 A peacock. 2 A flower, the coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.) 3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) f. (-री) 1 A peahen. 2 A potherb, (Basella rubra, &c.) E. मि to scatter, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन् or मही the earth in the seventh case, मह्यां, रु to cry, ड aff., and the formation irr.
29610: मयूरक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 A flower, (Celosia cristata.) 3 A peacock. n. (-कं) Blue vitriol. E. कन् added to the preceding.
29611: मयूरचटक m. (-कः) A house or dunghill cock.
29612: मयूरचूडा f. (-डा) Coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.) E. मयूर a peacock, and चूडा the comb or crest.
29613: मयूरपदक n. (-कं) A sort of scratch with a finger nail. E. मयूर a peacock, पद a foot, and कन् aff. implying resemblance.
29614: मयूरारि m. (-रिः) A chameleon, a lizard. E. मयूर a peacock, and अरि the enemy.
29615: मरक m. (-कः) Epidemic or pestilential disease. E. मृ to die, वुन् aff.
29616: मरकत m. (-तः) An emerald. E. मरक epidemic disease, तॄ to cross or escape, aff. ड; it is also read मरकतक n. (-कं).
29618: मरण n. (-णं) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, aff. ल्युट्.
29619: मरत m. (-तः) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, अतच् Uṇādi aff.
29620: मरन्द m. (-न्दः) The nectar or honey of a flower. E. मकरन्द, q. v. the second syllable being rejected; also with कन् added मरन्दक.
29621: मरन्दौकस् n. (-कः) A flower. E. मरन्द nectar or honey, ओकस् abode.
29622: मराकाली f. (-ली) A plant, commonly Bichhati.
29623: मरार m. (-रः) A granary, a place where grain, &c. is kept.
29624: मराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Soft, mild, bland. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of goose with red legs and bill, or perhaps the Flamingo. 2 Lampblack, used as a collyrium. 3 A duck. 4 A horse. 5 A cloud. 6 A grove or garden of pomegranate trees. 7 A rogue, a scoundrel. E. मृ to die, aff. आलच्.
29625: मरिच n. (-चं) Pepper. E. मृ to die, (venom,) and इच aff.; considered as an antidote; also मरीच.
29626: मरिमन् m. (-मा) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
29627: मरीच n. (-चं) Pepper, (Piper nigrum.) E. मृ to die, ईच aff.
29628: मरीचि m. (-चिः) 1 A saint, the son of BRAHMĀ, and one of the Prajāpatis, and Brahmādikas, or first created beings, and sovereigns of the world. 2 A niggard, a miser. mf. (-चिः) A ray of light. E. मृ to perish, (darkness,) Uṇādi aff. ईचि.
29629: मरीचिका f. (-का) The Mirage; vapor which in hot, and sandy countries especially appears at a distance like a sheet of water. E. मरीचि a ray of light, कन् aff., implying resemblance.
29630: मरीचिमालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Splendid, radiant. m. (-ली) The sun. E. मरीचि, and मालिन् having a chaplet.
29631: मरीमृज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Who or what cleans or rubs repeatedly. E. मृज to rub, reiter. v., अच् aff.
29632: मरु m. (-रुः) 1 A region or soil destitute of water, sands, a desert. 2 A mountain. 3 The province Marwar, or, in the plu. (-रुवः) The inhabitants. E. मृ to die, (where,) and Uṇādi aff. उ.
29633: मरुज m. (-जः) A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi. E. मरु a desert, and ज produced.
29634: मरुटा f. (-टा) A woman with a high forehead. E. मृ to perish, (of love for such a woman,) उटच् aff.
29635: मरुण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A woman with a high forehead. E. मृ to die, उण्डच् aff.: see the last.
29636: मरुत् m. (-रुत्) 1 Wind, air, or its deified personification. 2 A deity, an immortal. n. (-रुत्) A sort of perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. f. (-रुत्) A kind of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. मृ to die, Uṇādi aff. उति.
29637: मरुत m. (-तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A deity. 3 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpātali. E. अच् added to the preceding.
29638: मरुत्कर m. (-रः) A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) E. मरुत् wind, (eructation,) and कर making.
29639: मरुत्त m. (-त्तः) 1 Wind, a gale. 2 The name of a king. E. मरुत्, and तप् added.
29640: मरुत्पथ m. (-थः) The atmosphere, sky, heaven. E. मरुत् the wind, and पथ road.
29641: मरुत्पाल m. (-लः) A name of INDRA. E. मरुत् the wind, and पाल who nourishes.
29642: मरुत्पुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) BHĪMASENA, the second of the PĀṆḌU princes. E. मरुत् the deity of the wind, and पुत्त्र son.
29643: मरुत्प्लव m. (-वः) A lion. E. मरुत् wind, and प्लव who leaps.
29644: मरुत्फल n. (-लं) Hail. E. मरुत् wind, and फल fruit.
29645: मरुत्वत् m. (-त्वान्) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 The monkey Hanumān. 3 A cloud. E. मरुत् wind, मतुप् aff.
29646: मरुत्सख m. (-खः) INDRA. E. मरुत् the wind, (the deity,) and सखि friend, aff. टच्.
29647: मरुदान्दोल m. (-लः) A sort of fan made of deer's or buffalo's skin. E. मरुत् wind, आन्दोल agitating.
29648: मरुद्ध्वज n. (-जं) Flocculent seeds wafted by the wind. E. मरुत् wind, ध्वज standard.
29649: मरुद्बद्ध m. (-द्धः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A sort of vessel used in sacrifices. 3 A portion of the Sāma Veda. E. मरुत् the wind, बद्ध bound.
29650: मरुद्रथ m. (-थः) 1 A horse. 2 A car in which idols are carried. E. मरुत् the wind, and रथ a vehicle.
29651: मरुद्रुम m. (-मः) A fœtid mimosa. E. मरु dry, and द्रुम a tree.
29652: मरुद्वर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The atmosphere, heaven, sky. E. मरुत् the wind, and वर्त्मन् road or path.
29653: मरुद्वाह m. (-हः) 1 Smoke. 2 Fire. E. मरुत् wind, and वाह vehicle.
29654: मरुद्विप m. (-पः) A camel. E. मरु the desert, and द्विप the elephant.
29655: मरुद्वृता f. (-ता) The Kāverī river in the peninsula. E. मरुत् the wind, and वृत covered, screened.
29656: मरुन्माला f. (-ला) 1 A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) 2 Another plant, commonly Belśunṭh. E. मरुत् a deity, and माला a garland.
29657: मरुप्रिय m. (-यः) A camel. E. मरु a sandy soil, and प्रिय fond of; it also occurs मरुत्प्रिय m. (-यः) from मरुत् wind.
29658: मरुभू m. (-भूः) The province of Marwar, or plu. (-भुवः) The inhabitants of Marwar. E. मरु sandy, and भू country.
29659: मरुल m. (-लः) A sort of duck. E. मॄ to die, उलच् aff.
29660: मरुवक m. (-कः) 1 A large thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 2 A species of basil (Ocymum), described as having small leaves and red flowers. 3 A variety of the citron or lime, said to be a thorny plant, and to bear a small fruit. 4 A flower, (Artemisia vulgaris.) 5 A tiger. 6 The ascending node. 7 A crane. E. मरु a sandy or dry soil, वा to grow or go, aff. क, and कन् added; it sometimes occurs, मरूवक.
29661: मरुस्थल nf. (-लं-ली) A desart, a dry and desart tract. E. मरु, and स्थल place.
29662: मरूक m. (-कः) A sort of deer. E. मृ to die, ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.
29663: मरूद्भवा f. (-वा) 1 A cucumber. 2 Wild cotton. 3 A small species of the fœtid mimosa. 4 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. मरु dry soil, and उद्भव produced.
29664: मरोलि m. (-लिः) The Makara, a marine monster, apparently the Monodon or unicorn, and usually confounded with the crocodile or shark. E. मृ to die, (by it,) ओलिच् aff.; also with कन् added मरोलिक m. (-कः)
29665: मर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 The air, the wind. 2 The body. 3 A monkey. E. मर्च to sound, or a Sautra root, to move, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
29666: मर्कक m. (-कः) A spider. E. मर्क going, aff. कन्.
29667: मर्कट m. (-टः) 1 A monkey or ape. 2 A spider. 3 The large crane, called in India the adjutant, (Ardea argala.) 4 A kind of venom. f. (-टी) 1 A variety of grey Bonduc, (Guilandina bonduccella.) 2 Cowatch, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 3 A small or female monkey. E. मर्क a Sautra root, to go, Uṇādi aff. अटन्.
29668: मर्कटक m. (-कः) 1 A spider. 2 An ape. 3 A fruit. 4 A demon. 5 A fish. E. कन् added to the last.
29669: मर्कटपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. मर्कट an ape, and पिप्पली long pepper.
29670: मर्कटप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, a kind of Mimosa, (M. kauki.) E. मर्कट a monkey, and प्रिय beloved.
29671: मर्कटवास m. (-सः) A spider's web, a cobweb. E. मर्कट a spider, and वास abode; also with कन् added मर्कटवासक.
29672: मर्कटास्य n. (-स्यं) Copper. E. मर्कट a monkey, and आस्य face.
29673: मर्कटेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon.)
29674: मर्करा f. (-रा) 1 A cave, a hole, a chasm. 2 A vessel. 3 A barren or childless woman.
29675: मर्च r. 4th and 10th cls. (मर्चति मर्चयति) 1 To sound. 2 To go.
29676: मर्ज्जू f. (-र्ज्जूः) Cleaning, cleansing, purification. m. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 A washerman. 2 A catamite. E. मृज to cleanse, aff. ऊ.
29677: मर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A man, a mortal. E. मृ to die, तन् Uṇādi aff.
29678: मर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Mortal, what must or should die. E. मृ to die, तव्य aff.
29679: मर्त्त्य m. (-र्त्त्यः) 1 A man, a mortal. 2 The earth, the world, the habitation of mortals. f. (-र्त्त्या) A woman, a female. E. मर्त्त as above, यत् pleonasm.
29680: मर्त्त्यमुख m. (-खः) A demigod, attendant on KUVERA, a Kinnara, a Yakṣa. E. मर्त्त्य a mortal, and मुख chief, principal.
29681: मर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, touching. 2 Rubbing, grinding, pounding, &c. E. मृद to rub or grind, aff. ल्युट्.
29682: मर्द्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be rubbed or touched. E. मृद to rub, अनीयर aff.
29683: मर्द्दयित्वा ind. Having rubbed or touched. E. मृद to rub, क्त्वा aff.
29684: मर्द्दल m. (-लः) A sort of drum. E. मृद to rub or strike, aff. अच्; मर्द्द striking, and ला to get, aff. क.
29685: मर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, tied. 2 Rubbed, ground, pounded. 3 Obtained, got. E. मृद to rub, aff. क्त.
29686: मर्ब r. 1st cl. (मर्बति) To go, to move.
29687: मर्म्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A learned and intelligent man or Brahman. E. मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and ज्ञ who knows.
29688: मर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A joint, an articulation of the body. 2 A vital member or organ. 3 Secret meaning or purpose, a secret, any thing hidden or recondite. E. मृ to die, aff. मनिन्.
29689: मर्म्मभेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Fatal. 2 Penetrating, piercing. 3 Painful. E. मर्म्म, and भेदिन् what cuts or breaks.
29690: मर्म्मर m. (-रः) The rustling sound of cloth or dry leaves. f. (-री) A sort of pine, (P. Devadaru.) E. मृ to die, अरन् aff., and मुक् augment.
29691: मर्म्मरीक m. (-कः) A pauper, a low or humble man. E. मृ to die, (with distress,) Uṇādi aff. ईकन्, and the root reduplicate.
29692: मर्म्मविद् m. (-विट् or -वित्) A learned and intelligent man or Brahman. E. मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and विट् who knows.
29693: मर्म्मवेदिन् m. (-दी) An acute and intelligent man. E. मर्म्म secret, and वेदिन् who knows: see the last.
29694: मर्म्मस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Sharp, corrosive, giving pain. E. मर्म्म a joint, and स्पृश् what touches.
29695: मर्म्माविध् mfn. (-विद् or -वित्) Piercing or affecting the joints, (pain, &c.) E. मर्म्म a joint, व्यध to pierce or pain, aff. क्विप्; the semivowel and following vowel of the radical changed to इ, and the final vowel of the noun made long.
29696: मर्म्मिक m. (-कः) An intelligent and penetrating man. E. मर्म्म a joint, and ठक् aff.: see मर्म्मविट्.
29697: मर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A boundary, a limit. ind. Bounding, limitative.
29698: मर्य्यादा f. (-दा) 1 Continuance in the right way, propriety of conduct, steadiness, rectitude. 2 A boundary, a limit. 3 A bank, a shore. E. मर्य्या limitative, आदा to have or take, aff. अङ् and टाप्; or परि about, round, prefixed to आदा, and म substituted for प.
29699: मर्व r. 1st cl. (मर्वति) 1 To fill. 2 To go.
29700: मर्श m. (-र्शः) Counsel, advice. E. मृश to counsel, aff. घञ्.
29701: मर्शण n. (-णं) Advising, counselling, deliberating. E. मृश to counsel, ल्युट् aff.
29702: मर्ष m. (-र्षः) Patience, endurance. E. मृष to bear with, aff. घञ्.
29703: मर्षण n. (-णं) Enduring, bearing, patience, resignation. E. मृष to bear with, aff. ल्युट्.
29704: मर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Borne, endured. 2 Patient, content. n. (-तं) Patience. E. मृष to bear with, aff. क्त.
29705: मर्षितवत् mfn. (-वान-वती-वत्) Patient, enduring. E. मृष to bear, क्तवतु aff.
29706: मल r. 1st cl. (मलते) 10th cl. (मलयति) 1 To hold. 2 To wear. 3 To stick.
29707: मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Dirty. 2 Miserly, niggardly. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Excretion of the body, as serum, semen, blood, marrow, urine, fæces, earwax, nails, phlegm, tears, rheum, and sweat. 2 Sin. 3 Dirt, filth. 4 Dreg, sediment. 5 Rust. 6 Camphor. 7 Cuttle-fish bone. f. (-ला) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झटामला. E. मल to hold or contain, (in the body,) अच् aff., or मृज to cleanse, Uṇādi aff. कल, and the penultimate and final radical rejected.
29708: मलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced from dregs or dirt, &c. n. (-जं) Pus, matter. E. मल as above, and ज born.
29709: मलदूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Foul, dirty, filthy. E. मल dirt, दूषित faulty.
29710: मलन m. (-नः) A tent. n. (-नं) Rubbing, grinding, &c. E. मल to hold, aff. ल्युट्.
29711: मलपङ्किन् mfn. (-ङ्की-ङ्किनी-ङ्कि) Filthy, covered with mud and dirt. E. मल, and पङ्क mud, इनि aff.
29712: मलपू f. (-पूः) The opposite-leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositifolia, Rox.) E. मल sin, पू to purify, aff. क्विप्; it is also read with a final consonant, derived from पूर to complete or fill, मलपूर् f. (-पूः) Also मलयू.
29713: मलभुज् m. (-भुक्) A crow. E. मल dirt, and भुज् who eats.
29714: मलय m. (-यः) 1 A mountain or mountainous range, from which the best Sandal wood is brought, answering to the western Ghāts in the peninsula of India. 2 The country that lies along the Malaya range, or the west coast of the peninsula, Malayālam or Malabar. 3 A garden. 4 The garden of INDRA. 5 One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world. f. (-या) A plant, commonly Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. मल to hold or contain (Sandal wood), Uṇādi aff. कयन्.
29715: मलयगन्धिनी f. (-नी) One of DURGĀ'S female attendants. E. मलय the mountain, and गन्धिन् fragrant; also मलयवासिनी.
29716: मलयज mn. (-जः-जं) Sandal wood. E. मलय the mountain Malaya, and ज produced.
29717: मलयाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Malaya. E. मलय Malaya, and अचल a mountain; also similar compounds, as मलयाद्रि, &c.
29718: मलयानिल m. (-लः) The southerly wind that prevails in central India during the hot weather. E. मलय the Malaya mountain, over which the air is supposed to have blown, and अनिल wind.
29719: मलयू f. (-यूः) The opposite-leaved fig tree. E. मल sin, यु to join, aff. क्विप्, and the final made long; also with the final short मलयु, or derived from पूञ्, मलपू.
29720: मलवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) What conveys or contains soil or filth. E. मल, and वाहिन् bearing.
29721: मलाकर्षिन् m. (-र्षी) A sweeper, a cleaner. E. मल dirt, fæces, and कृष to draw, with आङ् prefix, and णिनि aff.
29722: मलाका f. (-का) 1 A female messenger. 2 A lewd woman. 3 A female elephant.
29723: मलापकर्षण n. (-णं) Purification, cleaning, cleansing. E. मल dirt, excrescence, अपकर्षण removing.
29724: मलावह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Soiling, dirtying. 2 Defiling, disgracing. m. (-हः) Acceptance of forbidden gifts. E. मल, and आवह what brings.
29725: मलि f. (-लिः) Having, possession. E. मल to hold, इन् aff.
29726: मलिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Dirty, filthy, foul. 2 Black. 3 Vile, bad. 4 Foul, (figuratively,) soiled with crime or vice, sinful, depraved. n. (-नं) 1 Buttermilk. 2 Fault, defect. 3 Borax. f. (-नी) A woman during menstruation. E. मल dirt, इनच् Uṇādi aff.
29727: मलिनप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Obscured, beclouded. E. मलिन, and प्रभा light.
29728: मलिनमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 1 Cruel, fierce, savage. 2 Vile, wicked. m. (-खः) 1 AGNI or fire. 2 A ghost, a goblin. 3 The black-faced monkey. E. मलिन black, and मुख the face.
29729: मलिनाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) Ink. E. मलिन dirty, and अम्बु water.
29730: मलिनास्य m. (-स्यः) A savage, a cruel or ferocious man. E. मलिन black, foul, (with fury,) and आस्य the face.
29731: मलिनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Soiled, defiled. 2 Corrupted, wicked. E. मलिन, and इतच् aff.
29732: मलिम्लुच m. (-चः) 1 A thief. 2 Burning, blazing. 3 Fire, air, wind, 4 The intercalary lunar month, introduced every third year, in order to approximate the lunar, and solar modes of computation. 5 A gnat, a musquito. 6 Frost. E. मलि possession, and म्लुच to steal, aff. क.
29733: मलिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Very foul or unclean. 2 Very wicked. f. (-ष्ठा) A woman during menstruation. E. मल unclean, इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative.
29734: मलीमस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Dirty, foul, unclean. 2 Wicked. m. (-सः) 1 Iron. 2 Green vitriol. E. मल dirt, ईमसच् aff.
29735: मलीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very dirty or impure. 2 Very wicked. E. मल, and ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative.
29736: मलूक m. (-कः) A kind of worm. E. मल dirt, ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.
29737: मल्ल r. 1st cl. (मल्लते) To hold, to have.
29738: मल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 1 Strong, stout, athletic, robust. 2 Best, excellent. m. (-ल्लः) 1 A wrestler, a boxer, by birth; the offspring of an outcaste Kṣatriya by a Kṣatriya female. 2 A cup or vessel. 3 The cheek and temples, the hemicranium, 4 A kind of fish. 5 The residue of an oblation. f. (-ल्ला) 1 A woman. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 Ornamenting the person with coloured unguents. E. मल्ल to hold, and aff. अच्.
29739: मल्लक mf. (-ल्लकः-ल्लिका) An oil vessel, a vessel made of the shell of a cocoanut for holding oil, whether for culinary purposes or for burning as a lamp. m. (-कः) A tooth. E. मल्ल to hold, aff. वुन्.
29741: मल्लतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A musical instrument, a drum or trumpet used at athletic contests. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and तूर्य्य an instrument of music; it also occurs गन्धतूर्य्यं.
29742: मल्लनाग m. (-गः) 1 The elephant of INDRA. 2 A name of the saint VĀTSYĀYANA. 2 A letter-carrier. 4 A work on amorous topics by VĀTSYĀYANA Muni. E. मल्ल strong, and नाग an elephant.
29743: मल्लभू f. (-भूः) A palæstrum or arena, a place for athletic contests; it is also applied to the site of any conflict, as a field of battle, &c. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and भू earth, place; also मल्लभूमि f. (-मिः).
29744: मल्लयाचा f. (-चा) A match of wrestling or boxing. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and याचा a festival.
29745: मल्लयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Wrestling, boxing. E. मल्ल a wrestler, and युद्ध contest.
29746: मल्लारी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs or divisions of the musical mode Megha.
29747: मल्लि m. (-ल्लिः) 1 Having, holding. 2 One of the Jinas or Jaina saints, the 19th of the present era. f. (-ल्लिः-ल्लि) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) E. मल्ल to hold, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added for the fem.
29748: मल्लिक m. (-कः) 1 A bird, said to be a sort of goose with brown legs and bill. 2 A shuttle. 3 The month Māgha. f. (-का) 1 Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) 2 A kind of fish. 3 An earthen vessel for holding oil, &c. 4 A goblet, a cup, a drinking vessel. 6 A river. E. कन् added to मल्लि.
29749: मल्लिकाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A horse marked with white about the eyes. 2 A sort of goose with brown legs and bill. E. मल्लिका the jasmine, and अक्ष the eye, being of like whiteness.
29750: मल्लिकापुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Arabian jasmine. E. मल्लिका the same, पुष्प a flower.
29751: मल्लिगन्धि n. (-न्धिः) Aloe wood. E. मल्लि jasmine, and गन्धि smelling.
29753: मल्लु m. (-ल्लुः) A bear. E. मल्ल to hold, aff. उ.
29754: मव r. 1st cl. (-मवति) To bind, to tie.
29755: मवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Strung, tied. E. मू to bind, aff. क्त.
29756: मव्य r. 1st cl. (मव्यति) To bind, to tie.
29757: मश r. 1st cl. (मशति) 1 To sound. 2 To be angry or irascible.
29758: मश m. (-शः) 1 Anger. 2 Sounding. 3 A musquito. E. मश to sound, &c., अच् aff.
29759: मशक m. (-कः) 1 A gnat, a musquito. 2 A kind of cutaneous eruption, the formation of small pustules or warts. 3 A leather water bag. E. मश to be angry, and वुन् aff.
29760: मशकिन् m. (-की) The glomerous fig tree. E. मशक a gnat, and इनि aff.
29761: मशछद m. (-दः) A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
29762: मशहरी f. (-री) Musquito curtains, bed curtains of gauze, or of any thin substance, used to keep off musquitoes. E. मश a musquito, हृ to take off, ट and ङीप् affs.
29764: मष r. 1st cl. (मषति) To injure, to hurt or kill.
29765: मषि f. (-षिः-षी) 1 Ink. 2 The stalk of the Nyctanthes tristis. E. मष to hurt, इन् aff.; also मशि or मसि.
29766: मस(इर, ई) इर् मसी r. 4th cl. (मस्यति) 1 To mete or measure by weight, bulk, length, &c. 2 To change form.
29767: मस m. (-सः) 1 Measure. 2 Weight. E. मस to measure, aff. अच्.
29768: मसक m. (-कः) A gnat. E. मष to hurt, वुन् aff.
29769: मसन n. (-नं) 1 Hurting. 2 Measuring. 3 A medicinal fruit, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. मष to hurt, ल्युट् aff.
29770: मसार m. (-रः) An emerald. E. मस weight, ऋ to go or get, aff. अण्; also with कन् added मसारक; in some places it seems to be confounded with another gem of a blue colour, perhaps the sapphire.
29771: मसि mf. (-सिः-सी) 1 Ink. 2 The stalk of the Nyctanthes tristis. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. इन्; it also occurs, मशि, मशी, मषि, and मषी.
29772: मसिक m. (-कः) A snake's hole. f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Nyctanthes tristis.) 2 Ink. E. मसि the stalk of the plant, &c., कन् added.
29773: मसिकूपी f. (-पी) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, कूपी a little well; also with कन् added मसिकूपिका.
29774: मसिधान nf. (-नं-नी) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, and घान what holds or contains; also मशिधान, मषिधान, &c.
29775: मसिन n. (-नं) Alliance by the right of presenting the funeral meat balls to a deceased common progenitor (?) E. मस to measure, (affinity,) Uṇādi aff. इनन्.
29776: मसिपण्य m. (-ण्यः) A scribe, a clerk, an accountant. E. मसि ink, पण्य hireable.
29777: मसिपथ m. (-थः) A pen. E. मसि, and पथ path.
29778: मसिप्रसू f. (-सूः) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, प्रसू parent.
29779: मसिमणि f. (-णिः) An inkstand. E. मसि ink, and मणि a jewel.
29780: मसिवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Gum myrrh. E. मसि ink, वृद्ध to increase, aff. ल्युट्.
29781: मसीजल n. (-लं) Writing ink. E. मसी ink, and जल water.
29782: मसीधानी f. (-नी) An inkstand. E. मसी ink, धानी what holds.
29784: मसुर mf. (-रः-रा) A sort of lentil or pulse, (Ervum hirsutum, or Cicer lens) f. (-रा) A whore. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. उरच्; more usually मसूर.
29785: मसूर mf. (-रः-रा) A sort of pulse or lentil, (Ervum hirsutum, and Cicer lens) f. (-रा) A whore. f. (-री) 1 Small-pox. 2 A small round pillow. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन्, मसूर, the pulse; the other meanings refer to this, implying resemblance to the pea in figure, &c.
29786: मसूरक m. (-कः) A small round pillow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
29787: मसूरविदला f. (-ला) 1 A black variety of the plant, commonly called Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) 2 A twining shrub, (Echites frutescens.) E. मसूर pulse, विदल division; having a leaf like a split pea.
29788: मसूरिका f. (-का) 1 A bawd, a procuress. 2 Small-pox. E. मसूरा a whore, aff. कन्, fem. form.
29789: मसृण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Smooth, soft, not hard, not rough. 2 Bland, mild, unctuous. f. (-णा) Linseed. E. मस to measure  or weigh, aff. ऋण, form irr.; or सम equally, smoothly, ऋण to go or be, aff. क, and the initiatory letters irregularly transposed.
29790: मस्क r. 1st cl. (मस्कते) To go, to move: sometimes read मस्क.
29791: मस्कर m. (-रः) A bambu. E. मस्क to go, aff. अर, or मकि to adorn, aff. अर, and the nasal rejected, with सुट् augment.
29792: मस्करिन् m. (-री) 1 The Brahman of the fourth and mendicant order. 2 The moon. E. मस्कर a bambu, (staff,) and इनि possess. aff.
29793: मस्ज(टु ओ)टुमस्जो r. 6th cl. (मज्जति) 1 To immerse, to sink or plunge in water. 2 To purify by washing or bathing.
29794: मस्त n. (-स्तं) The head: see the next.
29795: मस्तक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The head, the skull. 2 The head or top of any thing. E. मस to weigh, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
29796: मस्तकस्नेह m. (-हः) The brain. E. मस्तक the head, and स्नेह marrow.
29797: मस्तकाख्य m. (-ख्यः) The top of a tree. E. मस्तक the head, and आख्या appellation.
29798: मस्तकमूलक n. (-कं) The neck, the upper part of it supporting the head. E. मस्तक the head, मूल the root, कन् added.
29799: मस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Weighing, measuring. E. मस to weigh, क्तिन् aff.
29800: मस्तिस्क m. (-स्कः) The brain. E. मस्ति, मस्क to go or get, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
29801: मस्तु n. (-स्तुः) The watery part of curds, the whey. E. मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.
29802: मस्तुलुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The brain; it also occurs मस्तुलुङ्गक.
29803: मह r. 1st and 10th cls. (महति महयति) To revere, to worship, to adore. (इ,) महि r. 1st cl. (मंहते) To grow or increase. r. 10th cl. (मंहयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine.
29804: मह m. (-हः) 1 A festival. 2 Light, lustre. 3 A buffalo. 4 Sacrifice, oblation. f. (-हा) 1 A cow. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. मह to worship, aff. घञ् : see महस and महि.
29805: महक m. (-कः) 1 An excellent man. 2 A tortoise. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. E. मह to worship, वुन् aff.
29807: महत् mfn. (-हान्-हती-हत्) 1 Great, large, bulky. 2 Much, many. 3 Best, excellent, illustrious. n. (-त्) 1 Kingdom, dominion. 2 The intellectual principle, the second principle in creation. adv. Much, very, exceeding. f. (-ती) 1 The Vīṇā or lute of NĀRADA, containing seven or one hundred strings. 2 The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. मह to worship, अति Uṇādi aff. In composition, महा is generally substituted, आ being inserted in place of the final.
29808: महत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, more. m. (-रः) A man of the fourth or servile tribe, a Śūdra. E. महत् great, and तरप् aff. of comparison, perhaps in derision, or in comparison with the mixed tribes.
29809: महत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Greatness, either in bulk or rank. E. महत् great, त्व aff. of the abstract.
29810: महदाश्वर्य्य n. adv. (-र्य्यं) Very surprising. E. महत्, and आश्चर्य्य surprising.
29811: महद्विल n. (-लं) Æther, heaven, Ākāśa. E. महत् great, and विल a variety.
29812: महदाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dependant upon or attached to the great. E. महत्, and आश्रय asylum.
29813: महर्लोक m. (-कः) A division of the universe; a region said to be one Crore of Yojanas above the polar star, and to be the abode of those saints who survive a destruction of the world. E. महस् sacrifice, लोक world.
29814: महर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi or saint of a particular order, including VYĀSA, and others. E. मह for महत् great, and ऋषि a saint: see राजर्षि.
29815: महल्लक m. (-कः) An eunuch employed in a Hāram. E. महल्ल said to mean the inner apartments, probably the Arabic word محل and कन् added; otherwise with ठक् added महल्लिक m. (-कः.)
29816: महस् n. (-हः) 1 A festival, a sacred festival. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Greatness, vigour. 4 Sacrifice, oblation. E. मह to worship, aff. असुन्.
29817: महस n. (-सं) 1 Knowledge. 2 Kind, sort, difference. E. मह to worship, Uṇādi aff. असच्.
29818: महाकच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 The ocean. 2 The deity of the ocean VARUṆA. 3 A mountain. E. महा great, and कच्छ a shore or bank.
29819: महाकण्टकिनी f. (-नी) The Indian prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus.) E. महा great, कण्टक a thorn, इनि and ङीष् affs.
29820: महाकन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Garlic. 2 A very large esculent root, a sort of yam. 3 A plant, (Hingtsha repens.) E. महा great, and कन्द root.
29821: महाकपित्थ m. (-त्थः) A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. महा great, and कपित्थ wood apple.
29822: महाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Large-handed, &c. 2 Having a large revenue. m. (-रः) A large hand, rent, &c. E. महा, and कर a hand.
29823: महाकाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Large, bulky, stout. m. (-यः) 1 A name of NANDI, the door-keeper and attendant of ŚIVA. 2 An elephant. E. महा large, and काय body.
29824: महाकाल m. (-लः) 1 A name or rather a form of ŚIVA, in his character of the destroying deity, being then represented of a black colour, and of aspect more or less terrific. 2 A name of NANDI, ŚIVA'S porter and attendant. 3 The mango tree. f. (-ली) 1 The wife of the preceding deity, and a terrific form of DURGĀ. 2 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas. 3 One of the Vidyādevīs of the same sect. E. महा great, excessively, काल black, or time; in one capacity that of जगद्भक्षकः the world-eater, ŚIVA or MAHĀKĀLA may be considered as a personification of time that destroys all things.
29825: महाकाव्य n. (-व्यं) A regular and classical poem. E. महा great, and काव्य a poem: the title is applied especially to six works; the Kumāra Sambhava, Raghu Vaṃśa, and Megha Dūta of KĀLIDĀSA; the Kirātārjunīya of BHĀRAVĪ; the Naiṣadhīya of ŚRĪHARṢA, and the Śiśupāla Badha of MĀGHA.
29826: महाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Eminent by birth, of good family or extraction. E. महा great, and कुल lineage.
29827: महाकुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of good family. E. महा great, and कुलीन of family.
29828: महाकूप m. (-पः) A large or deep well. E. महा great, and कूप a well.
29829: महाकूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a good family. E. see महाकुल.
29830: महाक्षीर m. (-रः) Sugar-cane. E. महा great, and क्षीर milk.
29831: महाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Great, prosperous. E. महा, and ग who goes.
29832: महागद m. (-दः) Fever. E. महा, and गद sickness.
29833: महागन्ध m. (-न्धः) A sort of cane growing near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.) f. (-न्धा) A name or form of DURGĀ. n. (-न्धं) Gum myrrh. E. महा great, and गन्ध smell.
29834: महागिरि m. (-रिः) 1 Any large mountain. 2 A sacred personage peculiar to the Jainas. E. महा great, and गिरि a mountain.
29835: महाग्रीव m. (-वः) A camel. E. महा great, and ग्रीवा a neck.
29836: महाग्रीविन् m. (-वी) A camel. E. महा large, ग्रीवा neck, इनि aff.
29837: महाघास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Abounding with grass or fodder. E. महा, and घास grass.
29838: महाघूर्णा f. (-र्णा) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. महा great, much, घूर्ण to roll, aff. अच्, and टाप्.
29839: महाघोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very formidable, terrific, horrible. m. (-रः) A division of Tartarus or hell. E. महा great, much, and घोर terrific.
29840: महाघोष m. (-षः) A great noise, a loud sound. n. (-षं) A market, a fair. f. (-षा) 1 A plant, commonly called Karkaṭaśṛṅgī or Crab's horn, described as a climbing and milky plant, and supposed to be the Asclepias geminata. 2 Gum olibanum tree. E. महा great, घोष sound, &c.
29841: महाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bulky, big, large-bodied. m. (-ङ्गः) A camel. E. महा great, and अङ्ग body.
29842: महाचण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 One of YAMA'S attendants. 2 A very violent or passionate man. E. महा great, much, चण्ड hot, passionate.
29843: महाज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Illustrious, high-born. m. (-जः) A large goat. E. महा great, and अज a goat, or ज born.
29844: महाजन m. (-नः) 1 A virtuous or illustrious man, a great man. 2 A merchant, a trader. E. महा great, जन a man.
29845: महाजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) A plant, perhaps a kind of Eugenia. E. महा great, and जम्बू the rose apple.
29846: महाजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of an excellent sort or species. E. महा great, जातीय of a species.
29847: महाजाली f. (-ली) A plant, a sort of Ghoṣa, with yellow flowers. E. महा great, जाल a net.
29848: महाज्वाल m. (-लः) Sacrificial fire. f. (-ला) One of the Vidyādevīs or goddesses peculiar to the Jainas. E. महा great, ज्वाल flame, lustre.
29849: महातमप्रभा f. (-भा) The lowermost division of Naraka or hell. E. महा great, तम darkness, and प्रभा flame.
29850: महातरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Euphorbia of various kinds.) E. महा large, and तरु a tree.
29851: महातल n. (-लं) The fifth in descent of the seven Pātālas or regions under the earth, inhabited by various races of evil beings, as the Nāgas, Asuras, Daityas, &c. E. महा great, and तल depth.
29852: महातारा f. (-रा) A goddess of the Bauddhas.
29853: महातिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Very bitter. m. (-क्तः) The large Nimb tree, (Melia sempervirens.) f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Aknadhi. E. महा much, and तिक्त bitter.
29854: महातीक्ष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Very sharp (as flavour), or literally (as a weapon), or figuratively, (as perception, &c.) f. (-ष्णा) The marking-nut plant. E. महा great or much, तीक्ष्ण sharp, acrid, acute.
29855: महातेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Very bright. 2 Very energetic or vigorous. m. (-जाः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 AGNI, the deity of fire. 3 A hero, a demigod. E. महा great, and तेजस् light or glory, &c.
29856: महात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Liberal, lofty-minded, magnanimous. E. महा great, आत्मन् self, soul.
29857: महादन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 An elephant with large tusks. 2 An elephant's tusk. E. महा great, and दन्त tooth.
29858: महादारु m. (-रुः) A sort of pine, (P. Devadaru.) E. महा large, and दारु wood.
29859: महादेव m. (-वः) ŚIVA. f. (-वी) DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. E. महा great, and देव god; the epithet Mahā compounded with a substantive forms many appellatives of these deities especially; thus, ŚIVA is Mahākāla, Mahārudra, Maheśvara, &c. and DURGĀ is named Mahākāyā, Mahāsmṛti, Mahāmedhā, Mahāmohā, &c. &c.
29860: महादुन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A large military drum. E. महा great, दुन्दु a drum.
29861: महाद्रुम m. (-मः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. महा great, and द्रुम a tree.
29862: महाधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Rich, opulent. 2 Costly, precious, valuable. n. (-नं) Any thing costly or precious. 2 Gold. 3 Incense. 4 Costly raiment. 5 Agriculture. E. महा great, घन wealth or price.
29863: महाधातु m. (-तुः) Gold. E. महा great, chief, and धातु mineral.
29864: महानट m. (-टः) ŚIVA. E. महा great, and नट a dancer.
29865: महानन्द m. (-न्दः) Eternal emancipation or beatitude. f. (-न्दा) Wine. E. महा great, आनन्द happiness.
29866: महानरक n. (-कं) One of the hells or divisions of Tartarus. E. महा, and नरक hell.
29867: महानस mn. (-सः-सं) A kitchen. E. महा great, chief, अनस rice or food, टच् added; to which the food is conveyed to be dressed, &c.
29868: महानाद m. (-दः) 1 A large black rainy cloud. 2 A loud sound. 3 An elephant. 4 A lion. 5 The ear. 6 A camel. 7 A conch shell. n. (-दं) A musical instrument. E. महा great, and नाद noise or sound.
29869: महानिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Death, dying. E. महा great, निद्रा sleep.
29870: महानिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A large kind of Nimb tree, (Melia sempervirens). E. महा great, and निम्ब the Nimb.
29871: महानिशा f. (-शा) Midnight. E. महा great, and निशा night.
29872: महानीच m. (-चः) A washerman. E. महा great, much, and नीच vile.
29873: महानील m. (-लः) 1 The emerald. 2 One of the Nāgas. 3 A plant, (Verbesina scandens, Rox.) E. महा great, and नील blue.
29874: महानुभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Magnanimous, liberal. m. (-वः) A gentleman. E. महा great, अनुभाव disposition.
29876: महापक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of duck. f. (-क्षी) An owl. E. महा large, and पक्ष a side, a wing.
29877: महापच m. (-चः) A potherb. f. (-चा) A kind of Eugenia. E. महा large, and पच a leaf.
29878: महापथ m. (-थः) 1 The principal path or entrance to a town or house, &c., a main road, a highway. 2 The end of life, the way of all flesh. E. महा chief, and पथ road.
29879: महापथगम m. (-मः) Dying. E. महापथ the great way, (by which all mortals travel,) and गम going.
29880: महापद्म m. (-द्मः) 1 One of the principal Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla. 2 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures. 3 A large number, one hundred thousand millions. 4 A Kinnara or attendant on KUVERA. n. (-द्मं) The large white lotus. E. महा great, and पद्म a lotus.
29881: महापातक n. (-कं) 1 A crime of the highest degree, as, killing a Brahman, stealing gold from a priest, drinking spirits, adultery with the wife of a spiritual teacher, and associating with persons who have committed these offences. 2 Great crime in general. E. महा great, पातक offence.
29882: महापातकिन् m. (-की) An offender in the highest degree: see the last. E. महापातक great sin, and इनि aff.
29883: महापाप n. (-पं) 1 A sin of the highest kind: see महापातक. 2 Heinous crime, or sin in general. E. महा excessive, and पाप sin.
29885: महापुरुष m. (-षः) A great man. E. महा, and पुरुष a man.
29887: महापुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.) E. महा great, and पुष्प flower.
29888: महाप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very bright, splendid. m. (-भः) Lamp light, the light of a lamp. E. महा much, प्रभा shining.
29889: महाप्रभु m. (-भुः) 1 A holy man, a saint. 2 A king. 3 INDRA. 4 ŚIVA. E. महा chief, and प्रभु master.
29890: महाप्रलय m. (-यः) 1 A destruction of the world, occurring after every period of 4,320,000,000 years. 2 A total destruction of the universe, happening after a period commensurate with the life of BRAHMĀ, or 100 years, each day of which is equal to the period first stated, and each night of which is of similar duration; at the expiration of this term, the seven Lokas, with the saints, gods, and BRAHMĀ himself, are annihilated. E. महा great, and प्रलय destruction.
29892: महाफल m. (-लः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) f. (-ला) A bitter gourd: see इन्द्रवारुणी. E. महा great, and फल fruit.
29893: महाफेणा f. (-णा) Cuttle-fish bone. E. महा great, and फेण froth, foam.
29894: महाबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Strong, robust, powerful. m. (-लः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint. n. (-लं) Lead. f. (-ला) A sort of Sida with yellow flowers, (S. rhombifolia.) E. महा great or much, and बल strong, &c.
29895: महाबाहु mfn. (-हुः-हुः-हु) Having long arms. E. महा great, बाहु an arm.
29896: महाबोधि m. (-धिः) A Buddha, a deified teacher of the Bauddhas. E. महा great, and बोधि a teacher.
29897: महाब्राह्मण m. (-णः) 1 A priest who officiates at funeral ceremonies. 2 An eminent Brahman. E. महा great, and ब्राह्मण a Brahman.
29898: महाभद्रा f. (-द्रा) The Ganges. E. महा much, and भद्रा propitious.
29899: महाभाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Virtuous in a high degree, pure, holy. 2 Eminent, exalted. E. महा, and भाग portion.
29900: महाभागता f. (-ता) 1 Possession of the eight cardinal virtues, clemency, &c. 2 Exalted station or merit. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, महाभागत्वं.
29901: महाभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very timid, pusillanimous, cowardly f. (-ता) A sort of sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. महा much, भीत frightened.
29902: महाभीम m. (-मः) 1 A name of ŚĀNTANU. 2 One of ŚIVA'S chamberlains. E. महा great or much, and भीम formidable.
29903: महाभीरु m. (-रुः) A sort of beetle, found in cow-dung. E. महा, much, भीरु fearful.
29904: महाभीष्म m. (-ष्मः) A name of ŚĀNTANU, a sovereign, and the father of BHĪṢMA. E. महा much, and भीष्म formidable.
29905: महाभूत n. (-तं) A primary element: as air, fire, water, earth, and Ākāśa or ether. E. महा principal, and भूत element.
29906: महामति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Magnanimous, high-minded. E. महा, and मति mind.
29907: महामद m. (-दः) 1 An elephant in rut. 2 Great pride or intoxication. E. महा great, and मद fury, or the fluid that issues from the animal's temples.
29908: महामनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) Magnanimous, high-minded, liberal, munificent. E. महा great, मनस् mind.
29909: महामन्त्रिन् m. (-न्त्री) The prime minister. E. महा, and मन्त्रिन् a counsellor.
29910: महामहिमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Very great, high and mighty. E. महा, and महिमन् greatness.
29911: महामात्र m. (-त्रः) 1 A king's minister or associate, any high officer in a kingdom: as a counsellor, a general, &c. 2 An elephant driver, a Mahout. 3 Superintendant of the elephants. 4 A man of wealth and consequence. f. (-त्री) 1 The wife of a spiritual preceptor. 2 The wife of an officer of state, &c. E. महा great, and मात्र wealth or retinue, &c.
29912: महामानसी f. (-सी) A goddess peculiar to the Jainas.
29913: महामाया f. (-या) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 Worldly illusion or unreality. E. महा great, and माया illusion.
29914: महामारी f. (-री) A name of DURGĀ. E. महा great, and मारी destroyer.
29915: महामाष m. (-षः) A kind of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) E. महा large, and माष the Phaseolus radiatus.
29916: महामुख m. (-खः) A crocodile, an alligator. E. महा large, and मुख the mouth.
29917: महामुनि m. (-निः) 1 A name of AGASTYA. 2 A name of Buddha, or more properly, of any one of the sacred persons called by that name. 3 The epithet of a warlike saint, celebrated in the Mahābhārata. 4 Time. 5 A name of VYĀSA. n. (-नि) Coriander. E. महा great, and मुनि saint.
29918: महामूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Costly, precious. m. (-ल्यः) A ruby. E. महा great, मूल्य price.
29919: महामृग m. (-गः) An elephant. E. महा great, मृग an animal.
29920: महामृत्यु m. (-त्युः) ŚIVA. E. महा great, मृत्यु death.
29921: महामेद m. (-दः) 1 The coral tree, (Erythrina Indica.) 2 A drug, classed amongst the principal drugs, and described as a tonic, and stimulant. E. महा much, and मेद marrow.
29922: महामैत्र m. (-चः) Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha sect, or a Buddha or form of him. E. महा great, मैच friendliness.
29923: महाम्ल mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं) Very acid. n. (-म्लं) Acid seasoning. E. महा much, very, and अम्ल sour.
29924: महायक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of demigod, supposed to attend the Jinas or Jaina saints. E. महा great, and यक्ष a divine being, attending usually on KUVERA.
29925: महायज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) An essential sacrifice, a sacrament of the Hindu religion; five acts are enumerated of this description, severally considered as due to the Vedas, to the gods, to man, to the manes, and to all created beings; they are respectively, study of scripture, offering of sacrifice to the gods, hospitable treatment of guests, libation of water, &c. to deceased progenitors, and the casting of food on the ground or in water as an offering to the gods, to spirits, &c. E. महा great, and यज्ञ sacrifice or act of worship.
29926: महायन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Any great mechanical work, as a lock, or dyke, &c. E. महा, and यन्त्र mechanical contrivance.
29927: महायशस् mfn. (-शाः-शाः-शः) Illustrious, celebrated. m. (-शाः) The fifth Jaina of the past era. E. महा great, यशस् fame.
29928: महायशस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Illustrious, celebrated. E. महा great, यशस् celebrity, and कप् added.
29929: महायुग m. (-गः) A great Yuga; the aggregate of the four ages, or a period of four million, three hundred and twenty thousand years. E. महा great, and युग age.
29930: महारजत n. (-तं) Gold. E. महा great, and रजत silver.
29931: महारजन n. (-नं) 1 Safflower. 2 Gold. E. महा great, रञ्ज to color, aff. क्युच्.
29932: महारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A large forest. E. महा great, अरण्य a wood.
29933: महारथ m. (-थः) 1 Wish, desire. 2 A large car. 3 A warrior fighting in a car, or any leader or warrior of note. E. महा great, and रथ a car.
29934: महारस m. (-सः) 1 The date tree, (Phoenix sylvestris.) 2 A species of club rush, (Scirpus kysoor.) 2 Gruel made from the fermentation of rice water. E. महा great, रस juice.
29935: महाराज m. (-जः) 1 A sovereign, an emperor. 2 A finger nail. 3 A Jaina deified teacher. E. महा great, राजन् a king, aff. टच्.
29936: महाराजक m. (-कः) A sort of demigod: see महाराजिक.
29937: महाराजचूत m. (-तः) A kind of mango. E. महाराज sovereign, chief, and चूत the mango; bearing a superior sort of fruit; also similar compounds, as महाराजाम्र, महाराजफल, &c.
29938: महाराजाधिराज m. (-जः) A paramount sovereign, an emperor. E. महाराज, and अधिराज chief sovereign.
29939: महाराजिक m. (-कः) A kind of demigod, of which there is a class of 226. E. महा great, राजि splendour, aff. कन्; or महाराज the epithet of their chief, and कन् added.
29940: महारात्र m. (-त्रः) Midnight. E. भहा great, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
29941: महारूप m. (-पः) Resin. E. महा chief, and रूप form.
29942: महारूपक m. (-कः) A drama, a play or dramatic poem. E. महा chief, रूपक rhetorical composition.
29943: महारौरव m. (-वः) One of the divisions of Tartarus, a hell. E. महा great, रुरु a demon, aff. अण्.
29944: महार्घ mfn. (-र्घः-र्घा-र्घं) Costly, precious, of great price or value. m. (-र्घः) A sort of quail. E. महा great, अर्घ cost.
29945: महार्णव m. (-वः) The ocean. E. महा great, अर्णव the sea.
29946: महार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Significant, meaning. 2 Great, dignified. m. (-र्थः) A principal object. E. महा, and अर्थ sense or object.
29947: महार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A plant, commonly Mahāda.
29948: महार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 1 Costly, valuable. 2 Very worthy. E. महा, and अर्ह worthy.
29949: महाराष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) A country in the west of India, that of the original Mahrattas. f. (-ष्ट्री) A dialect, Mahratta. E. महा, and राष्ट्र kingdom.
29950: महालक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मीः) SARASVATĪ the wife of BRAHMĀ. E. महा great, and लक्ष्मी the goddess LAKṢMĪ.
29951: महालय m. (-यः) 1 GOD, the Supreme being. 2 A place of pilgrimage. 3 A tree, &c. sacred to a deity. 4 The Loka or world of BRAHMĀ. 5 A place of refuge, a sanctuary, an asylum. 6 A temple. E. महा great, आलय asylum.
29952: महालोध m. (-धः) A tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent, (Symplocos racemosa.) E. महा great, लोध the Lodh tree.
29953: महालोल m. (-लः) A crow. E. महा great, and लोल moving.
29954: महालोह n. (-हं) The loadstone. E. महा great, chief, and लोह iron.
29955: महावन n. (-नं) A large forest. E. महा large, वन a wood.
29956: महावप m. (-पः) A plant and drug, commonly Mahāmeda.
29957: महावरा f. (-रा) Bent grass: see दूर्ब्बा. E. महा great, वर best.
29958: महावराह m. (-हः) VIṢṆU in the boar incarnation. E. महा, and वराह a boar.
29959: महावर्त्तन n. (-नं) Large pay or allowance. E. महा, and वर्त्तन maintaining.
29960: महावल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A large and handsome creeping plant, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. महा great, and वल्ली pedicle.
29961: महावस m. (-सः) The Gangetic porpoise. E. महा large, and वस who abides.
29962: महाविल n. (-लं) 1 Sky, heaven, atmosphere. 2 A water jar. 3 The heart, the mind. 4 A cave, a hole. E. महा great, and विल a chasm.
29963: महाविशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Endowed with great, or excellent qualities. E. महा great, विशिष्ट endowed with.
29964: महाविष m. (-षः) A small venomous snake, supposed to be twoheaded. E. महा great, and विष venom.
29965: महाविषुव n. (-वं) The Saṅkrānti or moment of the sun's entering ARIES; the vernal equinox, but varying several days from the European computation. E. महा great, and विषुव equinox.
29966: महावीचि f. (-चिः) One of the divisions of Tartarus. E. महा, and वीचि a wave.
29967: महावीज्य n. (-ज्यं) The septum of the scrotum, and part of the perinœum. E. महा chief, वीज seed, यत् added.
29968: महावीर m. (-रः) 1 GARUḌA the bird, and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 2 A hero. 3 A lion. 4 A white horse. 5 Sacrificial fire. 6 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 7 A bird, a sort of hawk. 8 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 9 The last and most celebrated Jina or Jaina teacher of the present age; supposed to have flourished in the province of Behar, in the sixth century before the Christian era. 10 A sacrificial vessel. 11 VIṢṆU. 12 AGNI or fire. f. (-रा) A sort of drug, commonly Kṣīrakākolī, and conceived to be the dried root of a species of lily. E. महा great, and वीर hero.
29969: महावीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A Jina or Jaina saint. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. f. (-र्य्या) 1 A name of SAṂJÑĀ the wife of the sun. 2 Wild cotton. E. महा great, and वीर्य्य essence.
29970: महावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Euphorbia, of several species: see स्नुही. E. महा great, and वृक्ष a tree.
29971: महावृहती f. (-ती) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. महा great, and वृहती the egg-plant.
29972: महावेग m. (-गः) A monkey. E. महा great, and वेग speed.
29973: महाव्याहृति f. (-तिः) The three mystical words, Bhūr, BhuvaH, and Svar, the essential part, with Om and Gāyatrī, of the daily Brahminical prayer. E. महा great, and व्याहृति a word.
29974: महाव्रतिन् m. (-ती) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A devotee, an ascetic. E. महा great, and व्रत religious penance or observance, and इनि aff.
29975: महाव्रीहि m. (-हिः) A large kind of rice. E. महा large, and व्रीहि rice.
29976: महाशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 1 A human bone. 2 The forehead. 3 A thousand millions. 4 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures. E. महा great, शङ्ख a shell, a number, &c.
29977: महाशक्ति m. (-क्तिः) KĀRTTIKEYA the martial deity of the Hindus. E. महा great, शक्ति power.
29978: महाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Magnanimous, liberal, munificent. m. (-यः) 1 The ocean. 2 A gentleman, sir. E. महा great, आशय purpose or an abode.
29979: महाशय्या f. (-य्या) A throne, a regal seat. E. महा great, and शय्या bed or couch.
29980: महाशल्क m. (-ल्कः) A prawn or shrimp. E. महा large, and शल्क a scale.
29981: महाशाक n. (-कः) A kind of potherb. E. महा large, and शाक a potherb.
29982: महाशालि m. (-लिः) A fragrant sort of rice. E. महा large, chief, and शालि rice.
29983: महाशीता f. (-ता) A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.) E. महा great, much, शीता cooling.
29984: महाशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The pearl oyster. E. महा great, chief, and शुक्ति oyster.
29985: महाशुक्ला f. (-क्ला) The goddess SARASVATĪ. E. महा much, very, and शुक्ल white.
29986: महाशुभ्र n. (-भ्रं) Silver. E. महा much, and शुभ्र white.
29987: महाशूद्र m. (-द्रः) The cowherd. f. (-द्री) The milk-woman, either wife of a cowherd or a woman of that caste. E. महा great, शूद्र Śūdra.
29988: महाश्मशान n. (-नं) The holy city Benares. E. महा great, and श्मशान cemetery; people going thither to die.
29989: महाश्यामा f. (-मा) A creeper, (Echites frutescens.) E. महा large, and श्याम black.
29990: महाश्रमण m. (-णः) A Jaina or Bauddha saint. E. महा much, and श्रमण labouring, (in devotion.)
29991: महाश्री f. (-श्रीः) 1 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas. 2 An epithet of LAKṢMĪ. E. महा great, and श्री prosperity or the goddess.
29992: महाश्वेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very white. f. (-ता) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ. 2 A white variety of the Convolvulus paniculatus. 3 Clayed or candied sugar. 4 A sort of Clitoria, (C. ternata, with white flowers.) E. महा much, and श्वेत white.
29993: महासत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) Good, virtuous, just. E. महा, and सत्व purity.
29994: महासन्न m. (-न्नः) A name of KUVERA.
29995: महासर्ज m. (-र्जः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) 2 The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) E. महा large, and सर्ज the Śāl tree.
29996: महासह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Much-enduring. f. (-हा) 1 A plant, (Glycine debilis.) 2 A flower, (Gomphræna globosa.) 3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) E. महा great, सह to bear, aff. अच् or अङ् and टाप्.
29997: महासान्तपन n. (-नं) A sort of penance; subsisting for six successive days, respectively, on cow's urine, cowdung, milk, curds, Ghee, and water in which Kusa grass has been boiled, and fasting on the seventh day: instead of one day some authorities assign a period of three days to each, considering the first as the common Sāntapana penance; others omit the two last periods, making it last fifteen days. E. महा great, and सान्तपन a penance.
29998: महासाहस n. (-सं) Excessive violence, brutal assault. E. महा great, साहस violence.
29999: महासाहसिक m. (-कः) 1 A robber, a plunderer, one who carries off property openly, and by force. 2 An assaulter, a violator. E. महासाहस violence, and ठक् aff.
30000: महासि m. (-सिः) A large scymitar or sword. E. महा, and असि a sword.
30001: महासुख m. (-खः) A Bauddha or Jaina saint. n. (-खं) Copulation. E. महा great, and सुख happiness, pleasure.
30002: महासूक्ष्म mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं) Subtile, fine, minute. f. (-क्ष्मा) Sand, E. महा very, सूक्ष्म thin.
30004: महासेन m. (-नः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A general, the commander of a large force. 3 The father of the eighth Jina or Jaina saint of the present era. E. महा great, सेना an army.
30005: महास्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A camel. E. महा, and स्कन्ध shoulder.
30006: महास्थली f. (-ली) The earth. E. महा great, and स्थली heap.
30007: महास्नायु m. (-युः) Any principal vessel of the body. E. महा large, and स्नायु a tubular vessel.
30008: महास्वन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Loud sounding. m. (-नः) 1 An instrument of martial music, a kind of drum or trumpet. 2 A loud sound. E. महा great, and स्वन sound or noise.
30009: महाहव m. (-वः) A great battle or war. E. महा, and आहव war.
30010: महाहास m. (-सः) A horse laugh. E. महा great, and हाद्य laughter.
30012: महि f. (-हिः) The earth. E. मह to worship, aff. इ, more commonly मही, q. v.
30013: महिका f. (-का) Frost. E. नह to worship, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form; more commonly मिहिका.
30014: महित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proper, right. 2 Worshipped, reverenced, &c. n. (-तं) The trident of ŚIVA. E. मह to worship, aff. क्त.
30015: महिन n. (-नं) Kingdom, sovereignty. E. मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. इनन्.
30016: महिन्धक m. (-कः) 1 A rat. 2 An ichneumon. 3 The string of a pole for carrying loads.
30017: महिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Greatness in general, literal or figurative. 2 Magnitude as one of ŚIVA'S attributes, illimitability. E. महत् reat, इमनिच् aff. of the abstract property.
30018: महिर m. (-रः) The sun. E. मह to be worshipped, aff. इरच्.
30019: महिला f. (-ला) 1 A woman, a female. 2 A woman, literally or figuratively intoxicated. 3 A plant bearing a fragrant seed, commonly Priyangu. E. मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. इलच्; also महला and महेला.
30020: महिलाह्वया f. (-या) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. महिला a woman, and आह्वय appellation.
30021: महिष m. (-षः) 1 A buffalo. 2 The emblem of one of the Jaina saints. 3 The emblem and vehicle of YAMA. 4 The name of an Asura or demon slain by DURGĀ. f. (-षी) 1 A female buffalo. 2 The wife of a king, but especially the one who has been consecrated or crowned, a queen. 3 A drug. E. मह to worship or be worshipped, Uṇādi aff. टिषच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
30022: महिषध्वज m. (-जः) YAMA the sovereign of hell, and judge of the dead. E. महिष a buffalo, and ध्वज emblem.
30023: महिषमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ. E. महिष the Asura so named, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
30024: महिषवाहन m. (-नः) YAMA, the PLUTO of the Hindus. E. महिष a buffalo, and वाहन vehicle.
30025: महिषाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A plant, supposed to be the Bdellium tree. E. महिष a buffalo, and अक्ष eye.
30026: मही f. (-ही) 1 The earth. 2 A river, the Mahī which rises in the province of Malva, and after pursuing a westerly course of about 280 miles, falls into the upper part of the gulf of Cambay. 3 A cow. 4 A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) E. मह to worship or be worshipped, aff. इ, and ङीष् added; also without the addition, महि.
30027: महीक्षित् m. (-क्षित्) A king, a sovereign. E. मही the earth, and क्षि to rule, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् final augment.
30028: महीतल n. (-लं) The surface of the earth. E. मही, and तल below.
30029: महीधर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. मही, and घर what holds.
30030: महीध्र m. (-ध्रः) A mountain. E. मही the earth, and धृ to uphold, aff. क, and the vowel changed to र.
30031: महीप m. (-पः) A king. E. मही, and प who protects.
30032: महीपति m. (-तिः) A sovereign, a king. E. मही, and पति master.
30033: महीपाल m. (-लः) A king. E. मही, and पाल who protects.
30034: महीप्राचीर n. (-रं) The ocean. E. मही the earth, and प्राचीर a boundary; being supposed to surround the earth completely.
30035: महीभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A king. E. मही, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
30036: महीभुज् m. (-भुक्) A king. E. मही, and भुज् who possesses.
30037: महीमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Earthen, made of earth or clay. E. मही earth, and मयट् aff.
30038: महीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Greatest, very great. E. महत् great, ईयसुन् aff.
30039: महीय्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be worshipped, to be reverenced, to be treated with respect. E. मह to worship, शानच् aff., and यङ् inserted.
30040: महीरुह m. (-हः) A tree. E. मही the earth, and रुह to grow, aff. क; also with क्विप् aff. महीरुह् m. (-रुट्.)
30041: महीलता f. (-ता) An earthworm. E. मही the earth, and लता a creeper.
30042: महीसुत m. (-तः) The regent of the planet MARS. E. मही the earth, and सुत son; said to have sprung from the soil, near Oujein, which was sprinkled with the perspiration from ŚIVA'S body.
30043: महेछ mfn. (-छः-छा-छं) Liberal, magnanimous, high-minded. E. महा great, and इच्छा wish or design.
30044: महेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 INDRA, the ruler of Svarga. 2 A range of mountains, one of the seven principal chains in Bhārata Varṣa or India, and apparently the northern part of the Ghāts of the peninsula. E. महा chief, great, इन्द्र the deity.
30045: महेन्द्रनगरी f. (-री) Amaravatī the city of the immortals, and capital of INDRA. E. महेन्द्र INDRA, and नगरी capital.
30046: महेन्द्राणी f. (-णी) The wife of INDRA. E. महा great, and इन्द्राणी the same.
30047: महेरणा f. (-णा) The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. महा great, ईरन diffusion; or मह sacrifice, ईर to go to, to be used in, aff. ल्यु; also महेरुणा.
30048: महेला f. (-ला) A woman. E. मह a festival, इला the earth or site, or मह to worship, इलच् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel irregularly changed.
30049: महेलिका f. (-का) A woman. E. कन् added to the last.
30050: महेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. मह great, ईश lord or God.
30051: महेशबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. महेश ŚIVA, and बन्धु friend.
30052: महेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. f. (-री) 1 DURGĀ the wife of ŚIVA. 2 Mixed or bell-metal. 3 A flower, (Clitoria ternata.) E. महा great, ईश्वर God, fem. aff. ङीष्.
30053: महेश्वरकरच्युता f. (-ता) The Karatoya river in the north of Bengal. E. महेश्वर ŚIVA, कर the hand, and च्युत fallen.
30054: महेषु f. (-षुः) A large arrow. E. महा, And इषु an arrow.
30055: महेष्वास m. (-सः) A warrior, a champion, an archer. E. सहेषु, and आस who shoots.
30056: महोक्ष m. (-क्षः) A large bull or ox. E. महा large, उक्षम an ox, टच् aff.
30057: महोत्का f. (-त्का) Lightning. E. महा great, (frequent,) उत्क opportunity, interval.
30058: महोत्पल n. (-लं) A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.) E. महा large, chief, and उत्पल a water-lily.
30059: महोत्सव m. (-वः) A great festival. E. महा, and उत्सव a festival.
30060: महोत्साह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Persevering, diligent, making strenuous and unremitting exertion. m. (-हः) 1 A king, possessing all the appendages and powers of monarchy. 2 Diligence, effort, exertion. E. महा great, and उत्साह effort.
30061: महोदधि m. (-धिः) 1 The ocean. 2 INDRA. E. महा great, and उदधि the sea.
30062: महोदय n. (-यं) Kanoj, the ancient city and district. m. (-यः) 1 Final beatitude, emancipation from vitality and absorption into the divine essence. 2 Prosperity, elevation, eminence. 3 Pride. 4 Abandoning, relinquishment. 5 A master, a lord. E. महा great, and उदय rising, splendor, &c.
30063: महोदार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mighty, powerful. E. महा, and उदार great.
30064: महोद्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Diligent, persevering, making strenuous and unremitting effort. m. (-मः) Great effort, energy exertion. E. महा great, उद्यम effort.
30065: महोन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Very high. m. (-तः) The palmyra tree. E. महा, and उन्नत high.
30066: महोन्मद m. (-दः) 1 Intoxication, either literal or figurative, as with pride, passion, &c. 2 A sort of fish, commonly Phalai. E. महा much, उन्मद intoxication.
