30677: मूर्ख mfn. (-र्खः-र्खा-र्खं) Foolish, ignorant, stupid, idiotic. m. (-र्खः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.) E. मूर्ख substituted for मुह to be foolish, aff. अच्, or मुर substituted for the root, with ख Uṇādi aff.
30678: मूर्खभ्रातृक m. (-कः) The brother of a fool. E. मूर्ख a fool, भ्रातृ a brother, and कप् aff.
30679: मूर्च्छत् mfn. (-र्च्छन्-र्च्छन्ती-र्च्छत्) Fainting, swooning. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, शतृ aff.
30680: मूर्च्छन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Fainting, syncope, swooning. 2 Mixing, meeting. 3 A tone or semitone as placed in its scale, the seventh part of a Grāma or scale. 4 Calcining quicksilver with sulphur, &c. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, to become insensible, aff. ल्युट्.
30681: मूर्च्छा f. (-र्च्छा) Fainting, loss of consciousness or sense. E. मुर्च्छा to be faint, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
30682: मूर्च्छाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fainted, fainting, insensible. E. मूर्च्छा fainting, (the act,) and लच् aff.
30683: मूर्च्छावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Faint. E. मूर्च्छा, and मतुप् aff.
30684: मूर्च्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fainting, fainted, insensible. 2 Stupid, ignorant. 3 Tall, lofty. 4 Grown, increased, augmented. E. मुर्च्छ to be faint, to grow or increase, &c., aff. क्त, or मूर्च्छा as above, इतच् aff.
30685: मूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Bound, tied. E. मुर्व्व to bind, aff. क्त; form irr.
30686: मूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Fainting, fainted, losing sense or consciousness. 2 Solid, material, endowed with form or shape. E. मुर्च्छ to lose consciousness, aff. क्त, form irr.
30687: मूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 Matter, substance, solidity. 2 The body. 3 Figure, form, body in general, or any definite shape or image. E. मुर्च्छ to faint, to become insensible, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.
30688: मूर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Material, substantial, having shape or substance. 2 Incarnate. n. (-मत्) The body. E. मूर्त्ति shape, &c., मतुप् poss. aff.
30689: मूर्द्धक m. (-कः) The man of the second or military class. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and कन् aff.
30690: मूर्द्धकर्प्परी f. (-री) An umbrella, or inverted basket carried on the head for the same purpose. E. मूर्द्धं the head, कर्प्पर a sort of pan, and ङीष् aff.
30691: मूर्द्धखोल n. (-लं) A sort of umbrella: see the last. E. मूर्द्ध the head, खोल or खोलक a helmet.
30692: मूर्द्धज m. (-जः) Hair, the hair of the head. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and ज born.
30693: मूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The head. E. मुह to be foolish, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, form irr., or मुर्व्व to bind, the same aff., धङ् augment.
30694: मूर्द्धपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A tree, commonly Siris, (Mimosa sirisha.) E. मूर्द्धं the head, and पुष्प flower.
30695: मूर्द्धरस m. (-सः) The scum of boiled rice, &c. E. मूर्द्ध head, top, and रस juice.
30696: मूर्द्धवेष्टन n. (-नं) A turban, a fillet, a diadem, &c. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and वेष्टन surrounding.
30697: मूर्द्धाभिषिक्त m. (-क्तः) 1 A man of the second or military class, the Kṣatriya or soldier. 2 A king, a prince. 3 A chief minister, a counsellor of state. 4 The name of a mixed class, sprung from a Brahman, and female of the second or Kṣatriya tribe; the principal of the mixed races, and soldier by profession. E. मूर्द्ध the head, and अभिषिक्त sprinkled, anointed; kings being consecrated by having poured on their heads, while seated on a throne prepared for the purpose, water from some sacred stream, mixed with honey, clarified butter, and spirituous liquor, as well as two sorts of grass and the sprouts of corn: the term applies to the Kṣatriya as identified with the king, the duties of royalty, belonging especially, to the military caste.
30698: मूर्द्ध्वन् m. (-र्द्ध्वा) 1 The head. 2 The base, (in geometry.) E. मुर्व्व to bind, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, and ध्वङ् substituted for the radical final.
30699: मूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वी) A sort of creeper, from the fibres of which bowstrings are made, (Sanseviera zeylanica;) they should also form the girdle worn by the Kṣatriya class. E. मुर्व्व to bind, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
30700: मूल r. 1st cl. (मूलति-ते) To stand, to be rooted or firm. r. 10th cl. (मूलयति) 1 To plant or transplant. 2 To grow as a plant, to sprout, to shoot or germinate. With उद् prefixed, to root up or out, to eradicate, to exterminate.
30701: मूल n. (-लं) 1 A root, the root of a tree, &c. 2 Origin, commencement. 3 Capital, principal. 4 Near, proximate. 5 Own, peculiar, proper. 6 The root of the Arum campanulatum. 7 The original text of any work, as opposed to the Ṭīkā or comment. mn. (-लः-लं) The nineteenth lunar asterism, containing eleven stars, which appear to be the same as those in the SCORPION'S tail. f. (-ली) A small house lizard. E. मूल to stand, to be rooted or firm, aff. क, or मू to bind, Uṇādi aff. क्ल.
30702: मूलक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The radish, (Raphanus sativus.) 2 A large, sort of yam. m. (-कः) A sort of poison. E. मूल a root, कन् added.
30703: मूलकपण m. (-णः) A handful of radishes, &c. for sale. E. मूलक, and पण measure.
30704: मूलकमूला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly Kṣīrakākolī.
30705: मूलकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Magic. E. मूल original or essential, and कर्म्मन् act.
30706: मूलकारिका f. (-का) A fire place. E. मूल primary, (work,) and कारिका an agent.
30707: मूलकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A sort of penance, subsisting for a given time on the roots of plants only. E. मूल a root, and कृच्छ्र penance.
30708: मूलखानक m. (-कः) A digger for roots. E. मूल, and खानक a digger.
30709: मूलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born from a root, &c. m. (-जः) A plant growing from a root, as a lotus, &c. E. मूल a root, and ज born.
30710: मूलदेव m. (-वः) A name of KAṂSA, the uncle of KṚṢṆA. E. मूल original, and देव a deity; the incarnation of a demi-god.
30711: मूलद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) Capital, principal, stock. E. मूल capital, and द्रव्य substance.
30712: मूलधन n. (-नं) Capital, principal, stock. E. मूल capital, and धन wealth.
30714: मूलभद्र m. (-द्रः) A name of KAṂSA, the uncle of KṚṢṆA. E. मूल origin, and भद्र auspicious.
30715: मूलभृत्य m. (-त्यः) An old or hereditary servant. E. मूल, and भृत्य dependant.
30716: मूलविभुज m. (-जः) A car, a carriage. E. मूल the root, (the axle,) and विभुज what bends.
30717: मूलशाकट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) Fit or cultivated for esculent roots, (as the arum, the radish, and others, a field, &c.) E. मूल a root, and शाकट aff.; also with शाकिन aff. मूलशाकिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
30718: मूलस्थान n. (-नं) 1 Ether, heaven, space or atmosphere. 2 GOD. f. (-नी) GAURĪ. E. मूल primary origin, &c., and स्थान place, abode.
30719: मूलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Radical, (literal or figurative,) primary, principal. m. (-कः) A devotee, living on roots. E. मूल a root, ठक् aff.
30720: मूलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having a root, stock, origin, &c. m. (-ली) A tree. E. मूल a root, aff. इनि.
30721: मूलेर m. (-रः) Indian spikenard. E. मूल to be rooted, Uṇādi aff. एरक्.
30722: मूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 To be eradicated, to be pulled or plucked up by the root. 2 To be bent from the root, &c. 3 To be bought, purchasable. 4 To be bought for a fair or just price. n. (-ल्यं) 1 Price. 2 Wages, hire. 3 An article purchased. E. मूल principal, and यत् aff.
30723: मूष r. 1st cl. (मूषति) To steal, to rob or plunder.
30724: मूष mf. (-षः-षी-षं) 1 A rat, a mouse. 2 A crucible. f. (-षा) A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratum.) E. मूष to steal, aff. क.
30725: मूषक mf. (-कः-का-षिका) 1 A mouse, a rat. 2 A thief. E. कन् added to the last.
30726: मूषकाराति m. (-तिः) A cat. E. मूषक a rat, and अराति enemy.
30727: मूषण n. (-णं) Stealing, pilfering. E. मूष to steal, ल्युट् aff.
30728: मूषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Stealing, plundering. E. मूष, and शतृ aff.
30729: मूषाकर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. मूषा a rat, कर्ण the ear; to which the leaf of the plant is compared, fem. aff. ङीष्; also मूषिकपर्णी.
30730: मूषातुत्थ n. (-त्थं) Blue vitriol. E. मूषा a crucible, and तुत्थ sulphate of copper.
30731: मूषिक mf. (-कः-का) A rat, a mouse. m. (-कः) 1 A tree, commonly Siris, (Mimosa sirisha.) 2 A thief, a plunderer. 3 A country, the part of the Malabar coast between Quilon and Cape Comorin. f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) 2 A crucible. E. मूष to steal, Uṇādi aff. किनन्, and the vowel made long; also मूषिका, and मूषा, मूषी.
30732: मूषिकपर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant of the cryptogamia class (Salvinia cucullata.) E. मूषिक a rat, (ears, understood,) and पर्णी a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having a leaf compared to a mouse's ear.
30733: मूषिकाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. मूषिक a rat, and अङ्क a mark or emblem; being usually painted riding on a rat or attended by one.
30734: मूषिकाञ्चन m. (-नः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. मूषिक a rat, and अञ्चन going.
30735: मूषिकाराति m. (-तिः) A cat. E. मूषिक, and अराति an enemy.
30736: मूषिकाह्वय m. (-यः) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. मूषिक a rat, and आह्वय appellation; also मूषिकाह्व.
30737: मूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stolen. E. मूष, and क्त, aff.
30738: मूषिपर्णिका f. (-का) A plant: see the last. E. मूषि for मूषी, and कन् added to पर्णी.
30739: मूषीक mf. (-कः-का) A rat, a mouse. E. मूष to steal, कीकन् aff.
30740: मूष्यायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Born of unknown parents, of concealed birth or origin. E. अमूष्यायण the son of somebody, and the initiatory vowel rejected.
30742: मृकण्डक m. (-कः) The name of a saint; also called MĀRKAṆḌEYA. E. मृकण्ड the name of his father, and वुन् aff.
30743: मृकण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) The saint MĀRKAṆḌEYA. E. मृकण्डु his father, अण् aff., but the word unchanged.
30744: मृक्ष r. 1st cl. (मृक्षति) To accumulate, to collect, to fill. r. 10th cl. (मृक्षयति) 1 To mix, to mingle, to blend or combine. 2 To speak incorrectly.
30745: मृग r. 4th cl. (मृग्यति) r. 10th cl. (मृगयते) To seek, to pursue, to hunt, to chase.
30746: मृग m. (-गः) 1 A deer, an antelope. 2 An animal in general. 3 Research, inquiry, investigation. 4 Asking, soliciting, begging. 5 A kind of elephant, one with white marks on his forehead. 6 The fifth lunar constellation, more usually Mṛgaśiras: see मृगशिरस्. 7 The month in which the moon is full in the constellation Mṛgaśiras. 8 A particular sacrifice. 9 Musk. 10 Hunting, chase. 11 One of the four classes into which men are divided, in erotic works. f. (-गी) 1 A description of woman, perhaps the same as the one termed त्रित्रिणी, the corresponding female to the male called मृग. 2 A female deer, a doe. 3 A species of the Madhya metre. E. मृग to search, to chase, aff. घञ्.
30747: मृगक्षीर n. (-रं) Doe's milk. E. मृग for मृगी a female deer, and क्षीर milk.
30748: मृगचैटक m. (-कः) A wild or pole cat.
30749: मृगजालिका f. (-का) A net for confining deer. E. मृग a deer, and जालिका a net.
30750: मृगजीवन m. (-नः) A hunter. E. मृग a deer, and जीवन living, subsistence.
30751: मृगण nf. (-णं-णा) Search, inquiry, research. E. मृग to search for or after, aff. युच् and टाप्.
30752: मृगतृष् f. (-तृट्) Vapour floating over sands or desarts, and appearing at a distance like water. E. मृग a deer, तृष् to thirst, aff. क्विप्; deer being deceived by it; also with अङ्, and टाप् aff. मृगतृषा, and with तृष्णा thirst, मृगतृष्णा.
30753: मृगतृषा f. (-षा) Mirage: see the last.
30754: मृगतृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) Sultry vapour, mirage: see the last.
30755: मृगतृष्णिका f. (-का) Sultry vapour. E. कन् added to the last.
30756: मृगदशक् m. (-कः) A dog. E. मृग deer, and दंशक who bites.
30757: मृगद्युत् m. (-द्युत्) A hunter. E. मृग and द्यु to go, क्विप् aff. and तुक् added.
30758: मृगद्यू m. (-द्यूः) A hunter. E. मृग, and दिब to play, क्विप् aff., and the semivowel changed.
30759: मृगधूर्त्तक m. (-कः) A jackal. E. मृग a deer, and धूर्त्तक a cheat; preying upon them only in consequence of his luring them into his reach.
30760: मृगनाभि m. (-भिः) Musk. E. मृग a deer, (the musk deer,) and नाभि the navel; the musk being formed in a bag attached to the belly of the animal about the navel.
30761: मृगनाभिज nf. (-जं-जा) Musk. E. मृग a deer, नाभि the navel, and ज produced.
30762: मृगनेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Possessing or relating to the constellation Mṛgaśīrṣa. f. (-त्री) A woman with beautiful eyes, or eyes like a deer. E. मृग the asterism, णा to get, तृच् aff., and अप् added, or मृग a deer, and नेत्र the eye.
30763: मृगपति m. (-तिः) A lion. E. मृग an animal or a deer, and पति lord.
30764: मृगपद n. (-दं) A deer's foot. E. मृग, and पद for पाद foot.
30765: मृगपालिका f. (-का) The musk deer. E. मृग a deer, पाल to nourish, वुन् aff., fem. form.
30766: मृगपिप्लु m. (-प्लुः) The moon. E. मृग a deer, and पिप्ल a mark or spot.
30767: मृगबधाजीव m. (-वः) A hunter, a deer-killer. E. मृग a deer, बध killing, and आजीव who lives by.
30768: मृगबन्धिनी f. (-नी) A net for confining deer. E. मृग a deer, and बन्धिनी confinement.
30769: मृगभोजनी f. (-नी) Bitter apple or Colocynth. E. मृग, and भोजन eating.
30770: मृगमद m. (-दः) Musk. E. मृग a deer, and मद passion, or fluid that distils from the elephant's temples when in rut, and to which this secretion is considered analogous.
30771: मृगमातृका f. (-का) A female antelope. E. मृग, and मातृ mother कन् added.
30772: मृगमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Seeking, pursuing, hunting. E. मृग to seek, शानच् aff.
30773: मृगया f. (-या) Chase, hunting. E. मृग to search or seek, यत् aff., deriv. irr.
30774: मृगयु m. (-युः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A jackal. 3 A hunter. E. मृग a deer, या to go, कु Uṇādi aff., form irr.
30775: मृगराज् m. (-राट्) A lion. E. मृग an animal, and राज् who rules over; also with a final vowel, मृगराज m. (-जः.)
30776: मृगरिपु m. (-पुः) A lion. E. मृग an animal, and रिपु the enemy.
30777: मृगरोमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Woollen, (cloth, &c.) E. मृग an animal, रोम hair, and ज produced, made.
30778: मृगलाञ्छन m. (-नः) The moon. E. मृग a deer, लाच्छन symbol, sign.
30779: मृगवाहन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. मृग a deer, and वाहन vehicle.
30780: मृगव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Chase, hunting. 2 The butt or mark in archery. E. मृग a deer, व्यथ to destroy, aff. ड.
30781: मृगशिरस् n. (-रः) The fifth lunar mansion, containing three stars, one of which is λ ORIONIS, and figured by an antelope's head, whence its name. E. मृग a deer, and शिरस् the head; also मृगशिरा f. (-रा) or मृगशिरस् m. (-राः.)
30782: मृगशीर्ष m. (-र्षः) The constellation Mṛgaśiras: see the last. E. मृग a deer, and शीर्ष the head; also f. (-र्षा.)
30783: मृगाक्षी f. (-क्षी) 1 Bitter apple, (Cucumis coloquintida.) 2 A woman with eyes like a deer's. E. मृग a deer, अक्षि the eye.
30784: मृगाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 The moon. 2 Air, wind. E. मृग a deer, and अङ्क a mark, a symbol, or अकि to go, aff. अच्.
30785: मृगाजिन n. (-नं) A deer skin. E. मृग, and अजिन a skin.
30786: मृगाजीव m. (-वः) 1 A hyena. 2 A hunter. E. मृग a deer, and आजीव who lives by or preys upon.
30787: मृगाण्डजा f. (-जा) Musk. E. मृग a deer, अण्ड testicle, and ज produced.
30788: मृगाद् m. (-ट् or -त्) A tiger. E. मृग a deer, अद to eat, aff. क्विन्.
30789: मृगादन m. (-नः) 1 A hyena. 2 A leopard. f. (-नी) Colocynth, (Cucumis coloquintida.) E. मृग a deer, and अदन eating.
30790: मृगान्तक m. (-कः) The Cīta or hunting leopard. E. मृग a deer, and अन्तक destroyer.
30791: मृगाराति m. (-तिः) A dog. E. मृग a deer, and अराति an enemy.
30792: मृगारि m. (-रिः) 1 A lion. 2 A tiger. 3 A dog, a hound. E. मृग a deer, and अरि an enemy.
30793: मृगाविध् m. (-विट्) A hunter, a deer-killer. E. मृग a deer, व्यध to destroy, with आङ् prefix, and क्विप् aff., and the semivowel changed.
30794: मृगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, pursued. E. मृग to chase, aff. क्त.
30795: मृगेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A lion. E. मृग an animal, and इन्द्र lord, master
30796: मृगेन्द्रचटक m. (-कः) A hawk, a falcon. E. मृगेन्द्र a lion, and चटक a sparrow.
30797: मृगेन्द्रमुख n. (-खं) 1 The lion's mouth. 2 A species of the Atijagatī metre. E. मृगेन्द्र, and मुख mouth.
30799: मृग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) To be sought or inquired for. E. मृग to search, क्यप् aff.
30800: मृग्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being sought or inquired after. E. मृग to search, pass. v., शानच् aff.
30801: मृज(ऊ)मृजू r. 2nd cl. (मार्ष्टि) 1st and 10th cls. (मार्जति मार्जयति) 1 To clean, to cleanse. 2 To be clean or pure. 3 To ornament. 4 To sound. With अप or प्र prefixed, 1 To sweep, to sweep away. 2 To clean.
30802: मृज m. (-जः) A musical instrument, probably a sort of tabor or drum. f. (-जा) 1 Cleaning the body, by washing, anointing, &c. 2 Purification, ablution. E. मृज to cleanse, to sound, aff. क or अङ्, and टाप् aff.
30803: मृजान्वय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Clean, cleansed. E. मृजा, and अन्वय order.
30804: मृज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be cleaned or purified. E. मृज to cleanse, क्यप् aff.; also मार्ग्य.
30805: मृड r. 6th cl. (मृडति) r. 9th cl. (-मृड्णाति) 1 To delight, to make happy. 2 To rejoice, to be happy or delighted. r. 9th cl. (according to some authorities,) To grind or pound.
30806: मृड m. (-डः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 The fire that completes an oblation. f. (-डानी) DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. E. मृड to be pleased or delighted, aff. क, fem. aff. ङीष्, with आनुक् augment.
30807: मृडङ्कण m. (-णः) A child, a pupil. E. मृड to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. कङ्कण.
30808: मृडीक m. (-कः) A deer. E. मृड to delight, Uṇādi aff. कीकन्.
30809: मृण r. 6th cl. (मृणाति) To hurt, to injure.
30810: मृणाल mn. (-लः-लं) The film or fibres attached to the stalk of a lotus. n. (-लं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) f. (-ली) A small fibre in the stalk of the waterlily. E. मृण to hurt, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.
30811: मृणालिन् m. (-ली) A lotus. f. (-लिनी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. मृणाल a fibre, and इनि aff.
30812: मृण्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of earth or clay, (as porcelain, &c.) E. मृत्, and मयट् aff.
30813: मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dead, expired, extinct, defunct. 2 Calcined, reduced, (metals.) n. (-तं) 1 Solicited alms. 2 Death. E. मृ to die, aff. क्त.
30814: मृतक n. (-कं) A dead body, a corpse. E. मृत dead, कन् added.
30815: मृतकल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Insensible, fainted. E. मृत dead, and कल्प aff. of comparison.
30816: मृतकान्तक m. (-कः) A jackal. E. मृत dead, and कान्तक fond of.
30818: मृतपा m. (-पाः) A man of the lowest caste, who for a subsistence collects dead men's clothes; conveys dead bodies to the river side to be burnt; executes criminals, &c. E. मृत, and पा who cherishes.
30819: मृतमत्त m. (-त्तः) A jackal. E. मृत a corpse, and मत्त fond of, mad for; also with कन् added मृतमत्तक.
30820: मृतवत्सा f. (-त्सा) A woman or female animal, whose offspring never live long. E. मृत, and वत्स young.
30821: मृतशङ्का f. (-ङ्का) The fear entertained of a person's being dead. E. मृत, and शङ्का fear.
30822: मृतसञ्जीवनी f. (-नी) A Mantra for reviving the dead. E. मृत, सञ्जीवनी reviving.
30823: मृतस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bathed after mourning. 2 Dying immediately after ablution. E. मृत dead, and स्नात bathed.
30824: मृतस्नान n. (-नं) Funeral ablution, bathing after mourning. E. मृत dead, and स्नान bathing.
30825: मृतस्वमोक्तृ m. (-क्ता) The name of a royal saint. E. मृत death, स्व his own, and मोक्तृ liberator.
30826: मृताण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The sun. E. मृत dead, and अण्ड egg.
30827: मृतामद n. (-दं) Blue vitriol. E. मृत् earth, मद to please, आङ् prefix, and अच् aff.
30828: मृतालक n. (-कं) A fragrant sort of earth. E. मृत earth, अल to adorn, causal form, aff. अण्, and कन् added; also मृत्तालक.
30829: मृति f. (-तिः) Death, dying. E. मृ to die, aff. क्तिन्.
30830: मृतोद्भव m. (-वः) The ocean. E. मृत dead, destroyed, and उद्भव produced.
30831: मृत्कर m. (-रः) A potter. E. मृत् earth, and कर who works.
30832: मृत्कांश्य n. (-श्यं) An earthen vessel, a mug, a pitcher. E. मृत् earth, and कांश्य a goblet.
30833: मृत्किरा f. (-रा) An earth worm. E. मृत् earth, and किर a hog, fem form.
30834: मृत्खलिनी f. (-नी) A plant, commonly Carmaghās.
30835: मृत्ताल n. (-लं) A sort of fragrant earth; also called Surat earth. E. मृत् earth, ताल site, place of abiding; also with कन् added,
30836: मृत्तालक n. (-कं) and with a single consonant, मृतालक.
30837: मृत्तिका f. (-का) 1 Earth, clay, soil. 2 A fragrant earth. E. मृत् earth, and तिकन् pleonastic addition, fem. aff. टाप्.
30838: मृत्फली f. (-ली) A sort of Costus. E. मृत् earth, and फल a fruit, fem. aff. ङीष्.
30839: मृत्यु mfn. subst. (-त्युः-त्युः-त्यु) Death, dying. m. (-त्युः) YAMA the judge of the dead. E. मृ to die, Uṇādi aff. त्युक्.
30840: मृत्युञ्जय m. (-यः) A name of ŚIVA. E. मृत्यु death, and जय conqueror.
30841: मृत्युनाशक m. (-कः) Quicksilver. E. मृत्यु death, and नाशक destroyer, remover.
30842: मृत्युपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) Sugar cane. E. मृत्यु death, and पुष्प flower; dying after flowering.
30843: मृत्युफल n. (-लं) A sort of fruit considered as poisonous. f. (-ला or -ली) The plantain. E. मृत्यु death, and फल fruit.
30844: मृत्युभङ्गुरक m. (-कः) A drum beat on funeral occasions. E. मृत्यु death, भङ्गुर crooked, aff. कन्.
30845: मृत्युभृत्य m. (-त्यः) Sickness, malady, disease. E. मृत्यु death, भृत्य servant.
30846: मृत्युवञ्चन m. (-नः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A raven or a kind of crow, the carrion crow. 3 A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. मृत्यु death or decay, and वञ्चन deceiving.
30847: मृत्युवीज m. (-जः) The bambu. E. मृत्यु death, and वीज seed.
30848: मृत्युसूति f. (-तिः) A crab. E. मृत्यु death, and सूति bearing.
30849: मृत्सा f. (-त्सा) 1 Good or rich soil. 2 A fragrant earth. E. मृत् earth, स aff. of superior quality.
30850: मृत्स्ना f. (-त्स्ना) 1 Good soil. 2 A fragrant sort of earth. E. मृत् earth, स्न aff. of excellence.
30851: मृत्स्नाभाण्डक n. (-कं) A pitcher, an earthen vessel for carrying water. E. मृत्स्ना earth, and भाण्डक vessel.
30852: मृद r. 9th cl. (मृद्नाति) 1 To grind, to powder, to reduce to dust or powder. 2 To trample on, to tread under foot.
30853: मृद् f. (मृद् मृत्) 1 Earth, soil, clay. 2 A fragrant earth. E. मृद to trample on, aff. क्विप्.
30854: मृदङ्कुर m. (-रः) The green pigeon, (Columba hariala, BUC.)
30855: मृदङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A tabour, a small drum. 2 A double drum. 3 A sound, a noise. 4 A bambu. E. मृद to be trampled on, to be beat, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्; also with कन् added मृदङ्गक.
30856: मृदङ्गफल m. (-लः) The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) E. मृदङ्ग a drum, and फल a fruit; perhaps alluding to its size and shape.
30857: मृदर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Sportive, sporting. 2 Passing quickly away, transient. E. मृ to die, दर Uṇādi aff.
30858: मृदा f. (-दा) Earth, clay, soil. E. मृद to trample on, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
30859: मृदाकर m. (-रः) The thunderbolt. E. मृदा earth, and कर what makes.
30860: मृदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed, ground. 2 Trodden or trampled on. E. मृद to reduce to powder, aff. क्त.
30861: मृदिनी f. (-नी) Good soil or earth. E. मृद् earth, इनि aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
30862: मृदु mfn. (-दुः-द्वी-दु) 1 Soft. 2 Blunt, not sharp. 3 Gentle, mild. f. (-द्वी) The brown grape. E. म्रद to rub, aff. कु, and the semivowel changed to its congener.
30863: मृदुकोष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A man of lax bowels, one easily affected by medicine. E. मृदु, and कोष्ठ intestinal canal.
30864: मृदुगमना f. (-ना) A goose, a swan. E. मृदु soft, and गमन going.
30865: मृदुचर्म्मिन् m. (-र्म्मी) The Bhojpatra tree. E. मृदु soft, चर्म्म skin or bark, इनि aff.
30866: मृदुच्छद m. (-दः) 1 The Bhojpatra or birch tree. 2 A kind of Pīlu, or tree growing in the hills. E. मृदु soft, and च्छद covering or bark.
30867: मृदुता f. (-ता) Softness. E. तल् added to मृदु; also with त्व, मृदुत्वं.
30868: मृदुत्वच m. (-चः) The Bhojpatra or birch tree, the bark of which peels off, and is used in making Hooka- snakes, &c. E. मृदु soft, and त्वच skin; also with a final consonant मृदुत्वच्, (-त्वक्.)
30870: मृदुपर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A cane or ratan.
30871: मृदुपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Having a soft and delicate hand. E. मृदु, and पाणि hand.
30872: मृदुपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Sirisha tree, (Mimosa sirisha.) E. मृदु soft, and पुष्प flower.
30873: मृदुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Soft. n. (-लं) Water. E. मृदु soft, and लच् aff.
30874: मृदुरोमवत् m. (-वान्) A hare. E. मृदु soft, रोमन् hair, and मतुप् aff.
30875: मृदुलोमक m. (-कः) A hare. E. मृदु soft, लोभ hair, and कन् added.
30876: मृदुवात m. (-तः) A gentle breeze, zephyr. E. मृदु soft, and वात wind.
30877: मृदूत्पल n. (-लं) The blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea) E. मृदु soft, and उत्पल a lotus.
30878: मृद्भाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An earthen vessel. E. मृत्, and भाण्ड vessel.
30879: मृद्वङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of soft or tender frame or body. f. (-ङ्गी) A delicate woman. n. (-ङ्गं) Tin. E. मृदु soft, and अङ्ग body, substance.
30880: मृद्वीका f. (-का) A grape. E. मृद to hurt, कीकन् aff., and उक् augment.
30881: मृध(उ)मृधु r. 1st cl. (मर्द्धति-ते) 1 To be moist or wet. 2 To hurt or kill.
30882: मृध n. (-धं) War, battle. E. मृध to hurt or kill, aff. घ.
30883: मृन्मरु m. (-रुः) A stone, a rock. E. मृद् earth, and मरु dry as a desart.
30884: मृल्लोष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A clod of earth or clay. E. मृत्, and लोष्ट a lump.
30885: मृश(औ)मृशौ r. 6th cl. (मृशति) 1 To touch. 2 To see, to perceive. 3 To consult, to consider, to deliberate. With परा, To counsel, to advise. With वि, To consider, to discuss.
30886: मृष r. 1st and 10th cls. (मर्षति-ते मर्षयति-ते) and 4th cl. (मृष्यति-ते) To bear, to suffer, to endure patiently. (उ) मृषु r. 1st cl. (मर्षति) To sprinkle. With आङ्, To be angry. With वि, To be distressed, to bear hardly.
30887: मृषा ind. 1 Falsely. 2 Uselessly, in vain. E. मृष to bear, with का aff.
30888: मृषार्थक n. (-कं) An impossibility, an absurdity, (in speech or composition;) the sense of which is evidently false, as कूर्म्मलोमतनुत्राणः, शशशृङ्गधनुर्धरः, his armour is of tortoise wool, and his bow the horn of a hare. E. मृषा falsely, अर्थ meaning, कन् added.
30890: मृषावाद m. (-दः) 1 Irony, ironical praise. 2 Falsehood. E. मृषा falsely, and वाद speech, praise.
30891: मृषावादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking falsely, lying, a liar. m. (-दी) A false accuser, one who brings forward an unjust or unfounded accusation. E. मृषा falsely, and वादिन् who speaks.
30892: मृषोद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Speaking falsely, lying, a liar. n. (-द्यं) Falsehood. E. मृषा falsely, वद to speak, aff. क्यप्.
30893: मृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Cleaned, cleansed. 2 Touched, rubbed. 3 Sprinkled. E. मृज to clean, or मृष to rub, &c., aff. क्त.
30894: मृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Touching, contact. 2 Cleaning. 3 Sprinkling. 4 Preparing the food for a meal. E. मृज to clean, or मृष to sprinkle, &c., क्तिन् aff.
30895: मृष्टेरुक m. (-कः) 1 A liberal man, a donor, a benefactor. 2 A churlish or inhospitable man. 3 An eater of sweetmeats.
30896: मॄ r. 9th cl. (मृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
30897: मे r. 1st cl. (मयते) 1 To barter or exchange. 2 To return, to restore.
30898: मेकलकन्यका f. (-का) The Narmadā river. E. मेकल or मेखल the name of a Ṛṣi the supposed father, or of a mountain, the source of the stream, and कन्यका daughter; hence also मेखलकन्यका.
30899: मेकलाद्रिजा f. (-जा) The Narmadā or Nerbadda river. E. मेकलाद्रि the Mekala mountain, part of the Vindhya range, and ज born.
30900: मेखला f. (-ला) 1 A woman's girdle or zone. 2 A sword knot, a string or chain fastened to the hilt, and in fighting bound round the wrist to secure the weapon. 3 A sword-belt. 4 The edge or swell of a mountain. 5 The Narmadā river. 6 The sacrificial string of a Brahman when made of deer skin. 7 A sort of figure, made on the four sides of the hole in which sacrificial fire is offered. 8 A triple zone or string worn round the loins by the three first classes; the girdle of the Brahman should be of the fibres of the Munja or of Kuśa grass, that of the Kṣatriya of a Mūrvā or bowstring, and that of the Vaiśya of a thread of the Śaṇa, &c. E. मि to scatter, खलच् aff., deriv. irr.
30901: मेखलापद n. (-दं) The hip and loins. E. मेखला a zone, and पद place.
30902: मेखलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Wearing a girdle. m. (-ली) A youth of the Brahman tribe, who previous to his marriage wears a girdle suited to his caste. E. मेखला, and इनि aff.
30903: मेघ m. (-घः) 1 A cloud. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 3 A demon, a goblin. E. मिह to sprinkle, aff. अच्, and the final changed.
30904: मेघकफ m. (-फः) Hail. E. मेघ a cloud, and कफ phlegm.
30905: मेघकाल m. (-लः) The rains, the rainy season. E. मेघ a cloud, and काल time.
30906: मेघगर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Thunder. E. मेघ, and गर्ज्जन noise.
30907: मेघङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cloud-producing, (rainy season.) E. मेघ, कृ to make, खच् aff.
30908: मेघचिन्तक m. (-कः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucus.) E. मेघ a cloud, चिन्तक who thinks of; being supposed to drink no water but rain, and therefore naturally anxious for cloudy and rainy weather.
30909: मेघज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Cloud-born, produced in or from the clouds. m. (-जः) A large pearl. E. मेघ, and ज born.
30910: मेघजाल n. (-लं) Talc. E. मेघ a cloud, and जाल a net; some copies read मेघनाल.
30911: मेघजीवक m. (-कः) The Cātaka. E. मेघ a cloud, and जीवक living: see मेघचिन्तक.
30912: मेघज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A flash of lightning or the fire of it. E. मेघ a cloud, and ज्योतिस् light.
30913: मेघतिमिर n. (-रं) Cloudiness, cloudy or rainy weather. E. मेघ a cloud, and तिमिर darkness.
30914: मेघदीप m. (-पः) Lightning. E. मेव a cloud, and दीप inflamer.
30915: मेघद्वार n. (-रं) Sky, heaven, ether. E. मेघ a cloud, and द्वार the gate.
30916: मेघनाद m. (-दः) 1 The son of RĀVAṆA. 2 A name of VARUṆA, deity of water. 3 The noise or grumbling of clouds. 4 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) 5 A sort of amaranth, (Amaranthus polygamus.) E. मेघ a cloud, and नाद sound or noise.
30917: मेघनादजित् m. (-जित्) LAKṢMAṆA, the favourite brother and companion of RĀMA. E. मघनाद the son of RĀVAṆA, and जित् conqueror.
30918: मेघनादानुलासिन् m. (-सी) A peacock. E. मेघनाद the muttering of clouds, अनुलस to be delighted by, and णिनि aff.; pairing in the rainy season.
30919: मेघनामन् m. (-मा) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. मेघ a cloud; and नामन् appellation, or it may apply to every term for a cloud, being a synonym of the grass.
30920: मेघनिर्घोष m. (-षः) The muttering or grumbling of clouds, low or distant thunder. E. मेघ a cloud, and निर्घोष sound, noise.
30921: मेघपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Water. 2 River water. 3 Hail. m. (-ष्पः) One of VIṢṆU'S horses. E. मेघ a cloud, and पुष्प a flower.
30922: मेघप्रसव m. (-वः) Water. E. मेघ a cloud, and प्रसव a parent.
30923: मेघभूति m. (-तिः) The thunderbolt. E. मेघ a cloud, and भूति being.
30924: मेघमाला f. (-ला) A gathering or succession of clouds. E. मेघ a cloud, and माला a necklace or garland.
30925: मेघयोनि m. (-निः) Smoke. E. मेघ a cloud, and योनि place of birth or production.
30926: मेघराग m. (-गः) One of the six modes of music. E. मेघ a cloud, and राग mode; being supposed capable of bringing down rain from heaven.
30927: मेघवर्णा f. (-र्णा) The indigo plant. E. मेघ a cloud, and वर्ण colour.
30928: मेघवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) Sky, atmosphere. E. मेघ a cloud, and वर्त्मन् road.
30929: मेघवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) The fire of lightning, or electrical coruscations in the clouds. E. मेघ a cloud, and वह्नि fire.
30930: मेघवाहन m. (-नः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 ŚIVA. E. मेघ a cloud, and वाहन vehicle.
30931: मेघविस्फुर्ज्जित n. (-तं) 1 Thunder. 2 A species of the Atidhṛti metre. E. मेघ, and विस्फुर्ज्जित bursting.
30932: मेघवेश्मन् n. (-श्म) Sky, atmosphere. E. मेघ a cloud, and वेश्मन् abode.
30933: मेघसुहृद् m. (-हृद्) A peacock. E. मेघ a cloud, and सुहृद् a friend.
30934: मेघागम m. (-मः) The rains, the rainy season. E. मेघ a cloud, and आगम arrival.
30935: मेघानन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) A peacock. E. मेघ a cloud, and आनन्दिन् delighting.
30936: मेघास्थि n. (-स्थि) Hail. E. मेघ a cloud, and अस्थि a bone.
30937: मेघास्पद n. (-दं) Heaven, ether, sky, atmosphere. E. मेघ a cloud, and आस्पद place.
30938: मेघोदर m. (-रः) The father of the fifth Jina or Jaina saint.
30939: मेचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Black, dark, of a dark or black colour. m. (-कः) 1 Black or dark-blue, (the colour.) 2 The eye of a peacock's tail. 3 A cloud. 4 Smoke. 5 A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.) mn. (-कः-कं) Darkness. n. (-कं) Sulphuret of antimony. E. मच to mix, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, and the vowel changed to ए.
30940: मेचकापगा f. (-गा) The Yamunā river. E. मेचक dark, and अपगा the river.
30941: मेट(ऋ)मेदृ r. 1st cl. (मेटति) To be mad.
30942: मेटुला f. (-ला) A tree, (Spondias mangifera.) E. मेट to be mad, उलच् aff.
30943: मेठ m. (-ठः) 1 An elephant-keeper or feeder. 2 A ram; also read मेण्ठ and मेण्ठ.
30944: मेडृ(ऋ)मेडृ r. 1st. cl. (मेडति) To be mad.
30945: मेढ्र m. (-ढ्रः) 1 The penis. 2 A ram. E. मिह to urine, ष्ट्रन aff.
30946: मेढ्रशृङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A milky plant, the fruit of which is crooked, and therefore compared to a ram's horn, (Asclepias geminata?) E. मेढ्र a ram, शृङ्ग a horn, ङीष् aff.
30947: मेण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) An elephant-keeper; also read मेठ as above.
30948: मेण्ड m. (-ण्डः) An elephant-keeper or feeder.
30949: मेण्ढ m. (-ण्ढः) A ram. E. मिह to urine, घञ् aff., नुम् inserted and the final changed; also with कन् added मेण्ढक.
30950: मेथ(ऋ)मेथृ r. 1st cl. (मेथति-ते) 1 To understand, to comprehend. 2 To hurt, to injure. 3 To associate.
30951: मेथि m. (-थिः) The part of a threshing floor, round which the cattle turn to tread out the corn. f. (-थी) A sort of grass, (Trigonella foenugræcum.) E. मथ to understand, &c. इन् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added in the fem. form मेथिका.
30952: मेद(ऋ)मेदृ r. 1st cl. (मेदति-ते) To understand, to kill or injure.
30953: मेद m. (-दः) 1 Adeps, fat, the supposed proper seat of which is the abdomen. 2 One of the outcast tribes. f. (-दा) A drug, described as a sort of root resembling ginger, brought from the Morung district; it is one of the eight principal medicaments, and is said to be of cooling and emollient properties, and of particular use in fever and consumption. E. मिद to be greasy or unctuous, aff. घञ्; also मेदस्.
30954: मेदक m. (-कः) Vinous liquor for distilling. E. मिद to be unctuous, aff. वुन्.
30955: मेदस् n. (-दः) 1 Marrow; applicable not merely to the marrow of the bones, but more properly, to the serous or adipose secretion that spreads amongst the muscular fibres, and which is considered as performing the same functions to the flesh that the marrow of the bones performs to them: in Hindu physiology its proper seat is said to be the abdomen. 2 Morbid or unnatural corpulency. E. मिद to be unctuous, असुन् aff.
30956: मेदस्कृत् n. (-स्कृत्) Flesh. E. मेदस् adeps, and कृत् made.
30957: मेदस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 1 Robust, stout, strong. 2 Fat, corpulent. E. मेदस्, and विनि aff.
30958: मेदिनी f. (-नी) The earth. E. मेदस् adeps, इनि and ङीप् affs.; being made, according to the legend, of the adeps of two demons slain by BRAHMĀ.
30959: मेदिनीद्रव m. (-वः) Dust. E. मेदिनी the earth, and द्रु to get, aff. अच्.
30960: मेदुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Smooth, soft, bland, unctuous, saponaceous, &c. E. मिद to be unctuous, घुरच् aff.
30961: मेदोग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A fatty tumor. E. मेदस्, and ग्रन्थि knot.
30962: मेदोज n. (-जं) A bone. E. मेदस् marrow, and ज born.
30963: मेदोधरा f. (-रा) A membrane in the abdomen, containing the fat, the omentum. E. मेदस्, and धरा what has.
30964: मेदोऽर्व्वुद n. (-दं) Fatty tumors unattended with pain. E. मेदस्, and अर्व्वुद a tumor.
30965: मेदोवह n. (-हं) A vessel carrying fat, a lymphatic. E. मेदस्, and वह what bears.
30966: मेदोवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Corpulence. 2 Enlargement of the scrotum. E. मेदस्, and वृद्धि increase.
30967: मेध(ऋ,)मेधृ r. 1st cl. (मेधति-ते) 1 To understand, to comprehend. 2 To associate. 3 To hurt, to injure, to kill.
30968: मेध m. (-धः) Sacrifice, offering, oblation. f. (-धा) Apprehension, conception, understanding. E. मेध to associate, aff. अप्.
30969: मेधाजित् m. (-जित्) The name of a saint and grammarian; also KĀTYĀYANA. E. मेधा apprehension, and जित् victor.
30971: मेधाविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Intelligent, comprehending, of ready comprehension or conception. m. (-वी) 1 A parrot. 2 A Paṇḍita, a learned man, a sage, a teacher. 3 The inspired writer Vyāḍi. f. (-नी) The wife of BRAHMĀ. E. मेधा apprehension, विनि aff.
30972: मेधि m. (-धिः) A post fixed in the centre of a threshing-floor or barn, to which the cattle are attached, as they turn round it to tread out the corn. E. मेध to associate or connect, (the oxen, &c.) and इन् aff.
30973: मेधिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Intelligent, possessing a ready and just apprehension. E. मेधा apprehension, किरच् aff.
30974: मेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Pure, purified. 2 Fit for a sacrifice or oblation. f. (-ध्या) A kind of orris root, described as the red sort. 3 A sort of pigment; see रोचना. m. (-ध्यः) 1 Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 Barley. 3 A goat. E. मेध to associate, aff. ण्यत्, or मेध a sacrifice, and यत् aff.
30975: मेनका f. (-का) One of the courtezans of Svarga, and wife to Himālaya. E. मे to me, का any one, न not, (equal or comparable.)
30976: मेनकात्मजा f. (-जा) DURGĀ or PĀRVATĪ. E. मेनका the wife of the personified Himālaya mountain, and आत्मजा daughter.
30977: मेनकाप्राणेश m. (-शः) The personified Himālaya mountain. E. मेनका the Apsaras so named, and प्राणेश husband.
30978: मेना f. (-ना) The wife of Himālaya; see मेनका.
30979: मेनाजा f. (-जा) PĀRVATĪ. E. मेना for मेनका the mother of the goddess, and जा born.
30980: मेनाद m. (-दः) 1 A cat. 2 A goat. 3 A peacock. E. मे imitative cry, mew, and नाद sound.
30981: मेनाधव m. (-वः) Himālaya, the personified mountain, and father of DURGĀ, as PĀRVATĪ. E. मेना the wife of the mountain, and धव husband.
30982: मेन्धी f. (-न्धी) A plant, from the leaves of which a reddish dye is prepared, with which the palms of the hands, tips of the fingers, soles of the feet, and finger nails are stained, (Lawsonia inermis;) also मेन्धिका.
30983: मेप(ऋ)मेपृ r. 1st cl. (मेपते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To serve.
30985: मेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measurable, what is to be measured. E. मा to measure, क्यप् aff.
30986: मेरक m. (-कः) An Asura, and foe to VIṢṆU.
30987: मेरु m. (-रुः) The sacred mountain Meru, in the centre of the seven continents, compared to the cup or seed-vessel of the lotus, the leaves of which are formed by the different Dvīpas: its height is said by the Hindus to be 84,000 Yojanas, sixteen thousand of which are below the surface of the earth: the shape is variously described, as square, conical, columnar, spherical, or spiral; and the four faces of it are of various colours, or white towards the east, yellow to the south, back to the west, and red towards the north: the river Ganges falls from heaven on its summit, and flows thence to the surrounding worlds in four streams; the southern branch is the Ganges of India, the northern running into Tartary is the Bhadrasomā, the eastern is the Sītā, and the western the Cakṣu or Oxus: on the summit of Meru BRAHMĀ resides, attended and worshipped by the Ṛṣis, Gandharbas, &c.; the regents of the points of the compass occupy the corresponding faces of the mountain, the whole of which consists of gold and gems: considered in any but a fabulous light, mount Meru appears to mean the high land of Tārtary, immediately to the north of the Himālaya mountains. E. मि to scatter, (radiance,) Uṇādi aff. रु.
30988: मेरुक m. (-कः) Fragrant resin, incense. E. मेरु mount Meru, and कन् aff.
30989: मेरुयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A spindle. E. मेरु, and यन्त्र implement.
30990: मेल mf. (-लः-ला) Meeting, union, assemblage; in the modern dialects, applied to a large concourse of people collected at stated periods for religious or commercial purposes, as at Haridvār, &c. f. (-ला) 1 Ink. 2 Antimony or any collyrium. E. मिल to mix, to meet, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट्, aff. मेलन.
30991: मेलक m. (-कः) Meeting, union, assemblage. E. मेल the same, कन् added.
30992: मेलन n. (-नं) 1 Meeting, assembling. 2 Encounter. 3 Associating with. 4 Mixing with. 5 Adding to. E. मिल to mix, ल्युट् aff.
30993: मेलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Mixing, adding, or causing to be mixed with, or added to. E. मिल to mix, causal v., शतृ aff.
30994: मेलानन्द mf. (-न्दः-न्दा) An inkstand. E. मेला ink, आनन्द delighting.
30995: मेलान्धु f. (-न्धुः) An inkstand. E. मेला ink, अन्धु a well.
30996: मेलाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) An inkstand. E. मेला ink, अम्बु water.
30997: मेव(ऋ)मेवृ r. 1st cl. (मेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
30998: मेष m. (-षः) 1 A ram. 2 The sign Aries. 3 A kind of drug. f. (-षा) A sort of small cardamom, brought from Guzerat. (-षी) An ewe. E. मिष to contend with, aff. अच्.
30999: मेषविषाणिका f. (-का) A plant: see मेढ्रशुङ्गी. E. मेष a ram, विषाण a horn, कन् aff., fem. form.
31000: मेषशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of poison. f. (-ङ्गी) A kind of creeping plant, (Asclepias geminata, &c.;) see मेढ्रशृङ्गी. E. मेष a ram, and शृङ्ग horn.
31001: मेषाक्षिकुसुम m. (-मः) A sort of Cassia, (C. tora.) E. मेष a ram, अक्षि the eye, and कुसुम a flower; which is compared to a sheep's eye; also analogous terms, as मेषलोचन, &c.; it is also read मेषाख्य and मेषाह्व, &c. as being named from the Meṣa or ram.
31002: मेषाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) INDRA. E. मेष a ram, and अण्ड the testicle.
31003: मेषालु m. (-लुः) A sort of shrub, commonly Ververa or Berbera, (Ocimum pilosum.) E. मेष a ram, and आलु esculent root.
31004: मेषिका f. (-का) An ewe. E. मेषी an ewe, कन् aff.
31005: मेह m. (-हः) 1 Urinary disease, especially inflammatory affection of the urethra, including gonorrhoea, &c. 3 A ram. 4 Urine, piss. E. मिह to pass as urine, aff. घञ्.
31006: मेहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Urining, passing urine. E. मिह to urine, शतृ aff.
31007: मेहन n. (-नं) 1 Membrum virile. 2 Urine, piss. 3 Passing urine, pissing. E. मिह to urine, aff. ल्यट्.
31008: मेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Urining. 2 Suffering from urinary affections. E. मेह, and इनि aff.
31009: मैत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Of or belonging to a friend, friendly, amicable. m. (-त्रः) 1 A Brahman. 2 The anus. nf. (-त्रं-त्री) 1 Friendship. 2 A name of the seventeenth lunar asterism, (see the next.) E. मित्र a friend, or the sun, and अण् aff.
31010: मैत्रभ n. (-भं) The seventeenth lunar asterism; also ANURĀDHA. E. मित्र the deity, presiding over the asterism, अण् aff. of relation, मैत्र belonging to Mitra, and भ an asterism.
31011: मैत्रावरुण m. (-णः) A name of the saint AGASTYA. E. मित्र the sun, and वरुण the deity of water, अण् aff.
31012: मैत्रावरुणि m. (-णिः) A name of AGASTYA. E. मित्रवरुण a sage, the father of this saint, and इञ् aff.; or मित्र the sun, and वरुण VARUṆA, alluding to a legend of the birth of the saint from a contest between these deities, for the possession of URVAŚĪ one of the courtezans of INDRA'S heaven.
31013: मैत्रीवल m. (-लः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.
31014: मैत्रेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Of or relating to a friend. m. (-यः) 1 A man of a mixed caste, the son of a Vaideha by an Ayogava mother: his business is to announce the hours in verse. 2 The seventh Buddha, or one still to come. 3 The name of a saint or Muni, the disciple of PARĀŚARA, to whom the Viṣṇu Purāṇa is narrated. E. मित्र a proper name, or मित्र a friend, and ढक् aff. of descent or relation.
31015: मैत्रेयक m. (-कः) A crier or chaunter of the hours: see the last. E. मैत्रेय, and कन् added.
31016: मैत्रेयिका f. (-कां) The contest of friends or allies. E. मैत्रेय relating to friends, वुञ् aff. of animosity.
31017: मैत्र्य nf. (-त्र्यं-त्री) Friendship. E. मित्र friend, ष्यञ् aff. of property, fem. aff. ङीष्, and the semivowel of the aff. rejected.
31018: मैथिल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Belonging to, born in, &c. Mithila. f. (-ली) A name of SĪTĀ. E. मिथिला, and अण् aff.
31019: मैथुन n. (-नं) 1 Copulation. 2 Union, association. 3 Marriage. E. मिथुन a couple, and अण् aff.
31020: मैनाक m. (-कः) A mountain, or rock in the sea between the southern end of the Peninsula and Laṅkā. E. मेनका the wife of Himāla, and अण् aff. of descent, being in mythology her son.
31021: मैनाकस्वसृ f. (-सा) The goddess DURGĀ as PĀRVATĪ. E. मैनाक as above, and स्वसृ sister.
31022: मैनिक m. (-कः) A fisherman. E. मीन a fish, and ठन् aff.
31023: मैन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a demon killed by VIṢṆU.
31024: मैन्दहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. मैन्द as above, and हन् destroyer.
31025: मैरेय n. (-यं) A sort of spirituous liquor, from the blossoms of the Lythrum fruticosum, with sugar, &c. E. मिरा said to be the name of a country or drug, and ढक् aff.
31026: मोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be loosed or let go, to be liberated. E. मुच to let go, तव्य aff.
31027: मोक्ष r. 1st and 10th cls. (मोक्षति मोक्षयति) To let go, to release, to discharge, to send, to cast or throw.
31028: मोक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 Final and eternal happiness, the liberation of the soul from the body, and its exemption from further transmigration. 2 Death. 3 Liberation, freedom. 4 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. 5 Acquittance of an obligation, as by a son to his father. E. मोक्ष to let loose or free, aff. अच्.
31029: मोक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what sets at liberty. m. (-कः) A deliverer, a liberator. E. मोक्ष, and ण्वुल् aff.
31030: मोक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Letting go or free, liberating. 2 Squandering. E. मोक्ष to let go, ल्युट् aff.
31031: मोक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be, or what may be liberated. E. मोक्ष, and अनीयर् aff.; also मोक्ष्य and मोक्षितव्य.
31032: मोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Let go, liberated, at large. E. मोक्ष, and क्त aff.
31033: मोक्षोपाय mfn. (-यः) A sage, a saint, a devotee. E. मोक्ष emancipation, उपाय means.
31034: मोघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) 1 Vain, useless, fruitless. 2 Left, abandoned. f. (-घः) Trumpet-flower, (Bignonia suave olens.) m. (-घः) A fence, a hedge. E. मुह to be foolish, aff. अच्, and the final changed.
31035: मोघकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Following vain practices, observing useless-ceremonies. E. मोघ, and कर्म्मन् act.
31036: मोघज्ञान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cultivating vain knowledge or any but religious wisdom. E. मोघ, and ज्ञान knowledge.
31037: मोघाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Indulging vain hopes. E. मोघ, and आशा hope.
31038: मोघोली m. (-ली) A fence, a hedge.
31039: मोच m. (-चः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) f. (-चा) 1 The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 2 The plantain, (Musa sapientum.) n. (-चं) A plantain, (the fruit.) E. मुच to let loose, aff. घञ्.
31040: मोचक m. (-कः) 1 A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) 2 The silk cotton tree. 3 The plantain tree. 4 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. 5 A devotee, one who has divested himself of worldly passion and desire. 6 A liberator. E. मुच to be let loose, aff. वुन्, or causal form, aff. अच्, and कन् added.
31041: मोचन n. (-नं) Liberating, setting free. E. मुच to be free, ल्युट् aff.
31042: मोचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be liberated or let loose. 2 To be resigned or given up. E. मुच to be loose, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
31043: मोचरस m. (-सः) The gum of the silk-cotton tree. E. मोच the Bombax, and रस juice; also similar compounds, as माचनिर्य्यास, मोचसार, मोचस्राव, मोचस्रुत्.
31044: मोचाट m. (-टः) 1 A kind of pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) 2 Sandal. 3 The heart of the plantain tree. 4 A plantain, (the fruit.) E. मोच a plantain, &c., अट to go, (to be used with, to resemble, &c.) aff. अच्.
31046: मोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 To be let loose. 2 To be given up. E. मुच to be free, यत् aff.
31047: मोटकी f. (-की) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes.
31048: मोटन m. (-नः) Air, wind. n. (-नं) Rubbing, grinding, pressing. E. मुट to rub, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
31049: मोटनक n. (-कं) 1 Destruction. 2 A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
31050: मोट्टायित n. (-तं) One of the ten Bhāvas, or properties of women, the silent expression of returned affection.
31051: मोण m. (-णः) 1 Dried fruit. 2 A sort of water-fly, (the crocodile fly?) 3 A basket for carrying snakes in. E. मुण to vow, aff. घञ्.
31052: मोद m. (-दः) 1 Joy, delight, happiness. 2 Fragrance E. मुद to rejoice, aff. घञ्.
31053: मोदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Delighting, rejoicing, causing happiness or delight. mn. (-कः-कं) A sort of sweetmeat. E. मुद to be glad, in the causal form, to make glad, and ण्वुल् aff.
31054: मोदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Delighting, pleasing. f. (-न्ती) 1 Arabian jasmine. 2 A wild sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) E. मुद to be pleased, causal form, aff. शतृ.
31055: मोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, delighted. n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight. E. मुद to rejoice, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
31056: मोरट m. (-टः) 1 Root of sugar cane. 2 The blossom of the Alangium hexapetalum. 3 Milk of seven days standing, or when it has lost its milky nature. f. (-टा) A sort of creeper, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. मुर to surround, aff. अटन्.
31057: मोषक m. (-कः) A thief. E. मुष to steal, ण्वुल् aff.
31058: मोषण n. (-णं) Stealing. E. मुष, and ल्युट् aff.
31059: मोषयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 1 A Brahman. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
31060: मोषा f. (-षा) Stealing, theft. E. मुष to steal, अङ् and टाप् affs.
31061: मोष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) A thief. E. मुष to rob, aff. तृच्.
31062: मोह m. (-हः) 1 Fainting, loss of consciousness or sense. 2 Ignorance, folly, foolishness; it is applied especially to that spiritual ignorance which leads men to believe in the reality of worldly objects, and to addict themselves to mundane or sensual enjoyment. 3 Pain, affliction. 4 Error, mistake. 5 Bewilderment, distraction. E. मुह to be ignorant or foolish, aff. घञ्.
31063: मोहन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) Fascinating, stupefying, depriving of sense or understanding. n. (-नं) 1 Copulation. 2 One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA. 3 Temptation, seduction, the overpowering of reason and reflection by worldly or sensual allurements. m. (-नः) The thorn-apple, (Datura.) f. (-ना) 1 A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.) 2 A kind of jasmine, commonly the Tripura or Tipperah jasmine. E. मुह to be foolish, (causal form,) aff. युच् or ल्युट्.
31064: मोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Puzzled, perplexed. 2 Beguiled, deceived. E. मुह to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
31065: मोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Illusive, fallacious, beguiling. E. मोह, and इनि aff.; or मुह to be foolish, causal v., घिनुण् aff.
31066: मोहिनी f. (-नी) A kind of jasmine, commonly Tripuramāli. E. मोह folly, इनि aff., and ङीष् fem.
31067: मौकुलि m. (-लिः) A crow; some books have मौकलि.
31068: मौक्तिक n. (-कं) A pearl. E. मुक्ता a pearl, ठक् pleonastic aff.
31069: मौक्तिकप्रसवा f. (-वा) The pearl oyster. E. मौक्तिक, and प्रसवा a mother; mother of pearl.
31070: मौक्तिकशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A pearl oyster. E. मौक्तिक a pearl, and शुक्ति an oyster.
31071: मौक्य n. (-क्यं) Dumbness. E. सूक, and ष्यञ् aff.
31072: मौखर्य्य nf. (-र्य्यं-री) Scurrility, defamation. E. मुखर foul-mouthed, ष्यञ् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
31073: मौख्य n. (-ख्यं) Pre-eminence. E. मुख chief, ष्यञ् aff.
31074: मौग्ध n. (-ग्धं) 1 Simplicity, silliness. 2 Ignorance. 3 A feminine property: asking a lover to tell what is already known. E. मुग्ध, and ष्यञ् aff.
31075: मौञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) The girdle of a Brahman made of three strings of Munja grass. E. मुञ्जा, and अण् aff.
31076: मौञ्जीबन्धन n. (-नं) Investiture with the distinguishing cord. E. मौञ्जी the girdle, and बन्धन binding; both being assumed at the same time.
31077: मौढ्य n. (-ढ्यं) Ignorance, folly, especially spiritual folly: see मोह. E. मूढ a fool, ष्यञ् aff. of property.
31078: मौण्ड्य n. (-ण्ड्यं) Baldness, natural or artificial. E. मुण्ड, and ष्यञ् aff.
31080: मौद्गीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for, or bearing, &c. (kidney-beans.) E. मुद्ग kidney-bean, and खञ् aff.; also with अण्, aff. मौद्ग.
31081: मौन n. (-नं) Silence, taciturnity. E. मुनि a sage, (who practices it,) and अण् aff.
31082: मौनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Silent, taciturn. m. (-नी) An ascetic, a hermit, a religious sage, one who has overcome his passions and retired from the world E. मीन silence, and इनि aff.
31083: मौरजिक m. (-कः) A player on a drum. E. मुरज a drum, and ठक् aff.
31084: मौर्ख्य n. (-र्ख्यं) Stupidity, folly, fatuity. E. सूर्ख a fool, ष्यञ् aff.
31085: मौर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) A bow-string. E. सूर्व्वा the plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings were made, अण् and ङीष् aff.
31086: मौल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Radical, proceeding from a root or origin. 2 Of pure blood, descended from a respectable and primitive family without any improper intermixture. E. मूल a root, and अण् aff.
31087: मौलि mf. (-लिः-ली or -ली) 1 A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 2 Hair ornamented and braided round the head. 3 A diadem, a Tiara. 4 The head. f. (-ली) The earth. E. मूल the root or base, aff. इञ् or मूल a name, and इञ् aff. of descent, or मू to bind, लि aff., and the radical vowel changed.
31088: मौष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Boxing, sparring, playing at fistycuffs. E. मुष्टि the fist, ण aff.
31089: मौहूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) An astrologer. E. मुहूर्त्त an hour, and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. मौहूर्त्तिक.
31090: म्ना r. 1st cl. (मनति) To fix in the memory by frequent practice or repetition, to study, to acquire by study, &c.
31091: म्रक्ष r. 1st cl. (म्रक्षति) 1 To accumulate. 2 To smear, to anoint. 10th cl. (म्रक्षयति) 1 To mix. 2 To speak incorrectly.
31092: म्रक्ष m. (-क्षः) Slyness, hypocrisy, concealment of one's vices or defects. E. म्रक्ष to anoint, aff. अच्.
31093: म्रक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Oil. 2 Smearing the body with fragrant oils or unguents. E. म्रक्ष to smear or anoint, ल्युट् aff.
31094: म्रच r. 1st cl. (म्रचति) To go, to move.
31095: म्रद r. 1st cl. (म्रदते) 1 To grind, to pound, to reduce to powder or dust. 2 To tread or trample on.
31096: म्रदिमन् m. (-मा) Softness. E. मृद् soft, and इमनिच् aff.
31097: म्रदिमान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Soft. 2 Kind. E. म्रदिमन्, and अन्वित endowed with.
31098: म्रदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very soft, exceedingly soft, softest. E. मृदु soft, and इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, ऋ changed to र.
31099: म्रदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Softer, milder. E. मृदु soft, and इयसुन् aff. of the comparative, and the vowel changed to the semivowel.
31100: म्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Dying. E. मृ to die, शानच् aff.
31101: म्रुच(उ,)म्रुचु r. 1st cl. (म्रोचति) To go, to move.
31102: म्रुंच(उ,)म्रुञ्च r. 1st cl. (म्रुञ्चति) To go, to move.
31103: म्रेट(ऋ,)म्रेदृ r. 1st cl. (म्रेटति) To be mad.
31104: म्रेड(ऋ,)मेडृ r. 1st cl. (म्रेडति) To be mad.
31105: म्लक्ष r. 10th cl. (म्लक्षयति) 1 To mix, to unite. 2 To speak incorrectly.
31106: म्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Foul, dirty. 2 Languid, weary. 3 Faded, withered. E. म्लै to be languid, aff. क्त.
31107: म्लानि f. (-निः) 1 Weariness, languor. 2 Foulness, filth. 3 Fading, decay. E. म्लै to be languid, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
31108: म्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Indistinct, (as speech.) 2 Languid. n. (-ष्टं) Indistinct speech. E. म्लेच्छ to speak indistinctly, aff. क्त.
31109: म्लुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Mixed, intermixed, inlaid, set. E. म्लुच to go, aff. क्त.
31110: म्लुच(उ,)म्लुचु r. 1st cl. (म्लोचति) To go, to move. With अभि and नि prefixed, To go down, to set as the sun.
31111: म्लुञ्च(उ,)म्लुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (म्लुञ्चति) To go, to move.
31112: म्लेछ r. 1st and 10th cls. (म्लेछति म्लेछयति) 1 To speak inarticulately or incorrectly, to use a provincial or barbarous dialect. 2 To speak.
31113: म्लेच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 The generic term for a barbarian or foreigner; that is, for one speaking any language but Sanskrit, and not subject to the usual Hindu institutions. 2 A sinner, a criminal. 3 Indistinct or barbarous speech. E. म्लेच्छ to speak inarticulately, aff. घञ्.
31114: म्लेच्छकन्द m. (-न्दः) Garlic. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and कन्द root.
31115: म्लेच्छजाति m. (-तिः) A Mleccha or barbarian, or a man of an outcast race. The tribes enumerated under this head by MANU, but who are by him said to be properly, degraded Kṣatriyas, appear to be chiefly the inhabitants of the countries bordering immediately upon India, both to the north and south: as far as modern research and similarity of appellation may be trusted, the tribes of Mlecchas are as follows: the Pauṇḍrakas, (the people of provinces bordering on Bengal and Behar, and to the south of the Ganges,) Oḍras, (Urīyas,) Drāviras, (people of the southern part of the Coromandel coast,) Cāmbojas, (Arachosians,) Yavanas, (Greeks or Bactrians,) Śakas, (the people of the Sacha region or Sakai,) Pāravas, (Paropamisans,) Pahlavas, (the ancient Persians,) Cīnas, (Chinese,) Kirātas, (generally mountaineers, here perhaps especially the inhabitants of the Himāla or Imaus,) Daradas, (Daradoe,) and Khasas, (Scūthi or Chasas.) E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and जाति tribe, class.
31116: म्लेच्छदेश m. (-शः) The countries bordering on India, or those inhabited by people of a different faith and language; defined to be any, where the black antelope is not found. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, an outcast, and देश country.
31117: म्लेच्छभोजन m. (-नः) Wheat. n. (-नं) Half ripe barley. E. म्लेच्छ an outcaste, and भोजन food.
31118: म्लेच्छमण्डल n. (-लं) The country of the Mlecchas or barbarians. E. म्लेच्छ, and मण्डल region.
31119: म्लेच्छमुख n. (-खं) Copper. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and मुख countenance.
31120: म्लेच्छवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Speaking a barbarous dialect. E. म्लेच्छ, and वाच् speech.
31121: म्लेच्छाश m. (-शः) Wheat. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, अश to eat, aff. अच.
31122: म्लेच्छास्य n. (-स्यं) Copper. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and आस्य face, which would seem to allude to the fair complexion of the Greek or Mohammedan invaders of Hindustan.
31123: म्लेच्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken incorrectly or barbarously. m. (-तं) 1 Foreign or barbarous language. 2 Ungrammatical speech. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, इतच् aff., or म्लेच्छ to speak inaccurately, aff. क्त.
31124: म्लेट(ऋ,)म्लेदृ r. 1st cl. (म्लेटति) To be mad.
31125: म्लेड(ऋ,)म्लेडृ r. 1st cl. (म्लेडति) To be mad.
31126: म्लेव(ऋ,)म्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (म्लेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
31127: म्लै r. 1st cl. (म्लायति म्लपयति) 1 To be faint or languid, to yawn with languor or fatigue. 2 To fade, to decay. य
31128: य The twenty-sixth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, or semivowel Y; in Bengal, it is usually pronounced J.
31129: य mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who goes, a goer, a mover. m. (यः) 1 Air, wind. 2 Union, joining. 3 Fame, celebrity. 4 Barley. 5 Light, lustre. 6 Abandoning. 7 YAMA. f. (या) 1 Pudendum muliebre. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 A car, a carriage. 4 Prohibiting, restraining, checking. 5 Religious meditation. 6 Getting, obtaining. E. यज to worship, यम to check, &c., aff. ड.
31130: यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Which, (of many.) E. यट् which, and अकच् aff.
31131: यकृत् m. (-कृत्) The liver. E. य union, (of the parts of the body,) कृ to make, aff. क्विप् and तुक्.
31132: यकृदात्मिका f. (-का) A cockroach. E. यकृत् the liver, and आत्मन self, कन् aff., fem. form; like it in colour.
31133: यकृद्वैरी f. (-री) A plant, a sort of tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.) E. यकृत् liver, and वैर inimical to.
31134: यक्ष r. 10th cl. (यक्षयते) To worship, to honour or adore.
31135: यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A demigod, attendant especially on KUVERA, and employed in the care of his gardens and treasures. 2 A name of KUVERA. 3 The residence of INDRA. f. (-क्षी) The wife of KUVERA. E. यक्ष to worship, aff. घञ्.
31136: यक्षकर्द्दम m. (-मः) Perfumed paste, used especially for anointing the body, and consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk and Kakkola; or the three first, with saffron and Sandal in equal proportions. E. यक्ष the demigod, and कर्द्दम clay; a perfume of which these beings are supposed to be fond.
31137: यक्षधूप m. (-पः) 1 Resin in general. 2 Turpentine, the resinous exudation of the pine. E. यक्ष the demigod, and धूप perfume or incense, अण् aff.
31138: यक्षरस m. (-सः) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. यक्ष the demigod, and रस taste, fondness.
31139: यक्षराज् m. (-राट्) KUVERA, the deity of wealth, and lord of the demigods called Yakṣas. 2 A palæstrum, a place prepared for wrestling or boxing. E. यक्ष a Yakṣa, and राज् who rules or shines.
31140: यक्षराज m. (-जः) KUVERA: see the last. E. यक्ष the demigod, so called, and राज sovereign.
31141: यक्षराट्पुरी f. (-री) Alakā the capital of KUVERA, supposed to be seated on mount Kailāsa. E. यक्ष्राज KUVERA, and पुरी city.
31142: यक्षरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) The night of the day of full moon in the month Kārttika: see दीपाली. E. यक्ष the demigod, and रात्रि night; these spirits being supposed to be then abroad.
31143: यक्षामलक m. (-कः) A tree, described as a sort of date. E. यक्ष a Yakṣa, and आमलक myrobalan.
31144: यक्षावास m. (-सः) The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) E. यक्ष demigod, and आवास abode.
31145: यक्षिणी f. (-णी) 1 The wife of KUVERA. 2 The wife of a Yakṣa. 3 A sort of female fiend, attached to the service of DURGĀ, and frequently maintaining, like a sylph or fairy, an intercourse with mortals. E. यक्षिन् a name of KUVERA, and ङीष् aff.
31146: यक्षेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KUVERA. E. यक्ष, and इन्द्र lord.
31147: यक्षेश m. (-शः) KUVERA. E. यक्ष, and ईश lord; also यक्षेश्वर and the like.
31148: यक्षोडुम्बरक n. (-कं) The fruit of the Ficus religiosa.
31149: यक्ष्मघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) The raisin, or dried grape. E. यक्ष्म consumption, and घ्न destroyer.
31150: यक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption. E. यक्ष to worship, and मनिन् Uṇādi aff.; also with मन् aff. यक्ष्म m. (-क्ष्मः)
31151: यक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Proposing or wishing to worship. E. यक्ष to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
31152: यङ्न्त m. (-न्तः) (In grammar,) The frequentative deponent verb. E. यङ्, and अन्त termination.
31153: यङ्लुगन्त m. (-न्तः) The frequentative active verb. E. यङ्, लुक् dropped, and अन्त termination.
31154: यज r. 1st cl. (यजति) 1 To worship a deity. 2 To associate with. 3 To present or endow.
31155: यजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Sacrificing, worshipping. E. यज to worship, शतृ aff.
31156: यजत m. (-तः) The officiating priest at a sacrifice. E. यज to worship, अतच् aff.
31157: यजत्र m. (-त्रः) A Brahman who has maintained his consecrated fire. E. यज to sacrifice, अत्रन् Uṇādi aff.
31158: यजन n. (-नं) Offering sacrifices, performing worship. E. यज to worship, ल्युट् aff.
31159: यजन्त m. (-न्तः) A sacrificer, a worshipper. E. यज to sacrifice, aff. झच्.
31160: यजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Worshipping. m. (-नः) An employer of priests at a sacrifice, the person who institutes its performance, and pays the expence of it. E. यज to worship, शानच् aff. of the present participle, with मक् augment.
31161: यजाक m. (-कः) A donor, a benefactor, a liberal giver of presents, &c. E. यज to present, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.
31162: यजि m. (-जिः) A sacrificer, one who institutes or performs a sacrifice. E. यज to sacrifice, aff. इन्.
31163: यजुर्वेद n. (-दं) The Yajur Veda: see the next. E. ययुस्, and वेद a Veda.
31164: यजुस् n. (-जुः) The Yajur or Yajuṣ, one of the four Vedas; it is divided into two principal portions, the white and black, or Vājasaneyi and Taittirīya, the former of which is attributed to the saint YĀJÑAVALKYA, to whom it was revealed by the sun, in the form of a horse; and the latter to TITTIRI, to whom it was communicated by YĀSKA, the first pupil of its original author, the sage VAIŚAMPĀYANA: according to the Purāṇas, the Taittirīya portion was named from Tittiri a partridge; the disciples of VAIŚAMPĀYANA being changed into those birds, to pick up the texts of the Veda, as they were disgorged in a tangible shape by YĀJÑAVALKYA, at the command of VAIŚAMPĀYANA: both portions of this Veda are very full on the subject of religious rites, and the prayers peculiar to it, are chiefly in measured and poetical prose. E. यज to worship, Uṇādi aff. उसि.
31165: यज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sacrifice, a ceremony in which oblations are presented. E. यज to worship, aff. नङ्.
31166: यज्ञकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Any sacrificial act or ceremony. E. यज्ञ, and कर्म्मन् act.
31167: यज्ञकृत् m. (-कृत्) A sacrificer, a worshipper, or priest conducting a sacrifice. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and कृत् who makes.
31168: यज्ञद्रुह् m. (-ध्रुक्) A Rākṣasa, an imp. E. यज्ञ, and द्रुह् to wrong, क्विप् aff.
31169: यज्ञपशु m. (-शुः) 1 A horse. 2 Any animal offered in sacrifice. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and पशु an animal.
31170: यज्ञपात्र n. (-त्रं) A sacrificial vessel. E. यज्ञ, and पात्र a vessel.
31171: यज्ञपुरुष m. (-षः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and पुरुष man or male.
31172: यज्ञभाजन n. (-नं) A sacrificial vessel. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and भाजन vessel.
31173: यज्ञभूमि f. (-मिः) Place prepared for a sacrifice, or where it is offered. E. यज्ञ, and भूमि land.
31174: यज्ञवराह m. (-हः) VIṢṆU in the boar incarnation. E. यज्ञ, and वराह the boar.
31175: यज्ञवाट m. (-टः) A place prepared and enclosed for a sacrifice. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and वाट inclosure.
31176: यज्ञशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) What is left from a sacrifice or oblation. E. यज्ञ, and शिष्ट remainder.
31177: यज्ञशेष n. (-षः) The reliques of a sacrifice or oblation. E. यज्ञ, and शेष remainder.
31178: यज्ञसार m. (-रः) The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and सार essence.
31179: यज्ञसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Performance of sacrifice. 2 Obtaining the objects of a sacrifice. E. यज्ञ, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
31180: यज्ञसूत्र n. (-त्रं) The characteristic thread, worn by the three principal classes of Hindus. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and सूत्र thread.
31181: यज्ञस्थान n. (-नं) A place of sacrifice. E. यज्ञ, and स्थान place.
31182: यज्ञाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The glomerous fig, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) 2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 3 A part of any sacrificial ceremony. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and अङ्ग a member.
31183: यज्ञान्त m. (-न्तः) A supplementary sacrifice. E. यज्ञ the principal, and अन्त end, finish.
31184: यज्ञारि m. (-रिः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A demon, a goblin. E. यज्ञ a sacrifice, and अरि enemy.
31185: यज्ञिक m. (-कः) The Pālaś tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, ठक् aff.
31186: यज्ञिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Proper for or suitable to a sacrifice. m. (-यः) The third Yug or age. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and घ aff.
31187: यज्ञियदेश f. (-शः) The country of the Hindus; those districts in which the ritual and institutes of the Hindu system are enforced; properly the country in which the black deer or antelope is native. E. यज्ञिय sacrificial, and देश a country.
31188: यज्ञियशाला f. (-ला) A temple, a shrine, a place of sacrifice. E. यज्ञिय to be sacrificed, (where,) and शाला hall.
31189: यज्ञोडुम्बर m. (-रः) The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.) E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and उडुम्बर the same.
31190: यज्ञोपवीत n. (-तं) The sacrificial cord, originally worn by the three principal casts of Hindus: at present from the loss of the pure Kṣatriya and Vaiśya casts in Bengal, confined to the Brahmanical order. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and उपवीत thread.
31191: यज्ञोपवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman, &c. invested with the sacred thread. E. यज्ञोपवीत, and इनि aff.
31192: यज्यु m. (-ज्युः) A Brahman, Conversant with the Yajur Veda. E. यज to worship, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
31193: यज्वन् m. (-ज्वा) A sacrificer in due form, or agreeably to the ritual of the Vedas. E. यज to worship, वनिप् aff.
31194: यज्वनांपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. यज्वन् a sacrificer in the sixth case plural, and पति master.
31195: यत(ई)यती r. 1st cl. (यतते) To resolve or determine in consequence of a wish or desire, to apply or endeavour 1 strenuously, to energize, to persevere. r. 10th cl. (यातयति) 1 To distress or afflict. 2 To beat. 3 To order. 4 To collect, to assemble. 5 To work, to make or manufacture. 6 To prevent, to remove. 7 To return, to give back, to requite. 8 To barter or exchange. 9 To purify. With निर् or नि prefixed, To chastise, to punish, to inflict pain.
31196: यत् ind. Because, as, since, wherefore, correlative of तत् thence, therefore, &c. E. यम to check, to restrain, क्विप् and तुक् aff.
31197: यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Governed, controlled. 2 Limited, restrained. E. यम to check, क्त aff.
31198: यतचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Resigned, subdued, one of well-governed thoughts or feelings. E. यत, and चित्त the mind.
31199: यतचित्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Having power over the soul and spirit, of subdued mind. E. यतचित्त, and आत्मन् self.
31200: यतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Striving, making effort, E. यत to make effort, शतृ aff.
31201: यतन n. (-नं) Making effort or exertion. E. यत to make effort, ल्युट् aff.
31202: यतनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be exerted or persevered, to be made as an effort. E. यत to make effort अनीयर्, aff.
31203: यतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Which, (of many.) E. यद् which, डतमच् aff.
31204: यतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Making effort, striving, struggling, persevering. E. यत to strive, शानच् aff.
31205: यतमैथुन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Disinclined to sexual intercourse, abstaining from it. E. यत, and मैथुन coition.
31206: यतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Which, (of two,) whether. E. यट् which, डतरच् aff.
31207: यतव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Firm to an engagement or vow. E. यत, and व्रत a vow.
31208: यतस् ind. Because, as since, whence: see यत्. E. यद् which, what, and तसि substituted for the termination of the 5th case.
31209: यतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Of subdued or well-governed spirit. E. यत, and आत्मन् self.
31210: यतात्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Self-subdued, having the mind and all its powers in subjection. E. यतात्म, and मतुप् aff.
31211: यताहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Temperate, abstemious. E. यत, and आहार food.
31212: यति m. (-तिः) 1 A sage, whose passions are completely under subjection. 2 A religious mendicant, especially one of the Jaina sect. 3 Stopping, ceasing, rest, term. 4 Restraining, controlling, checking. f. (-तीः) 1 A pause in poetry or metre, a stop, a rest. 2 Union, joining. 3 Passion, sentiment. 4 A widow. E. यत to endeavour, &c., aff. इन्, or यम् to restrain, aff. क्तिन्.
31213: यतिन् m. (-ती) A sage with subdued passions. f. (-नी) A widow. E. यत restraining, from यम with क्त aff., and इनि added.
31214: यतिपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel for collecting alms, made of wood, or a hollow bambu, an earthen bowl, or a gourd. E. यति, and पात्र a vessel.
31215: यतिमैथुन n. (-नं) The copulation or cohabitation of holy personages. E. यति as above, and मैथुन coition.
31216: यतुका f. (-का) A plant, Cakāvat commonly.
31217: यतेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Chaste, pure, of subdued passions. E. यत, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
31218: यत्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Doing what. E. यत्, and कृ to do, अच् aff.
31219: यत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Striven, resolved, exerted. E. यत to resolve, क्त aff.
31220: यत्न m. (-त्नः) Effort, exertion, perseverance, energy. E. यत to endeavour strenuously or continuously, aff. नङ्.
31221: यत्नतस् ind. Vigorously, strenuously. E. यत्न, and तसि aff.
31222: यत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Persevering, diligent, making effort or exertion. E. यत्न effort, मतुप् aff.
31223: यत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be exerted or made as an effort. E. यत to exert, यत् aff.
31224: यत्र ind. Where, in what place. E. यद what, and त्रल् aff.
31225: यत्र(इ,)यत्रि r. 1st and 10th cls. (यन्त्रति यन्त्रयति) To confine, to restrain, to subdue or regulate: the root may also be written यन्त्र.
31226: यथा ind. As, according to; correlative to तथा so: it is also commonly used in composition to form adverbs: यथाकालं seasonably, यथाक्रमं regularly, यथान्यायं fitly, suitably, यथाशास्त्रं according to scripture, &c. E. यद् what, थाल् aff.
31227: यथांशतस् ind. Proportionably, in due proportion. E. यथा as, according to, अंश part, तसि aff.
31228: यथाकथा ind. As much as, tantum quantum: it is especially used as a term of disrespect. E. यथा as, and कथा how.
31229: यथाकथाच ind. Rarely, unfrequently, seldomer than proper. E. यथा as much, and कथा how much, with च the particle, and.
31230: यथाकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is right or proper to be done. E. यथा, कर्त्तव्य to be done.
31231: यथाकल्प adv. (-ल्पं) As designed. E. यथा, and कल्प making.
31232: यथाकाम adv. (-मं) At pleasure, as you please. E. यथा, and काम desire.
31233: यथाकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Wilful, independant, uncontrolled, following one's own inclinations. E. यथा as, according to, काम desire, इनि aff.
31234: यथाक्रम adv. n. (-मं) In order, orderly, successively, methodically. E. यथा agreeably to, क्रम order.
31235: यथागत adv. n. (-तं) Applied to a person's being sent away or returning as he came. E. यथा, and गत gone.
31236: यथाजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Foolish, stupid, a fool, a natural. 2 Barbarous, outcast. E. यथा as, and जात born, as simple as at birth.
31237: यथातथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Right, true. ind. or adv. n. (-थं) Properly, suitably. noun. (-थं) Narrative of events, history. E. यथा as, and तथा so, with the termination of the neuter gender.
31238: यथातथा adv. In any way, any how. E. यथा and तथा, &c.
31239: यथापूर्व्व n. adv. (-र्व्वं) 1 In order or succession. 2 Formerly, precedingly, in prior time or place. E. यथा as, and पूर्व्व formerly, before.
31240: यथाभिमतम् ind. According to one's wish or purpose. E. यथा, and अभिमत purposed.
31241: यथामुखीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Like, resembling, shewing similarly or reflecting. E. यथा as, मुख the countenance, and ख aff.
31242: यथायथम् ind. As, thereto appertaining. E. यथा repeated, with the termination of the neuter gender.
31243: यथार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Right, proper. 2 According to the sense. adv. or ind. n. (-र्थं) Properly, suitably. E. यथा as, अर्थ property.
31244: यथार्थता f. (-ता) Rectitude, propriety, fitness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, यथार्थत्वं.
31245: यथार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Proper, suitable, appropriate. n. adv. or ind. (-र्हं) Properly, suitably. E. यथा as, अर्हम् properly.
31246: यथार्हतस् adv. Properly, fitly. E. यथार्ह, and तसि aff.
31247: यथार्हवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A spy, a secret emissary. E. यथार्ह properly, suitably, वर्ण form, colour.
31248: यथावकाश adv. n. or ind. (-शं) According to opportunity. E. यथा, and अवकाश season.
31249: यथावत् ind. 1 Truly, exactly, as it was, according to law or usage. 2 Accordingly, conformably. E. यथा, and वति aff.
31250: यथावसर adv. n. or ind. (-रं) According to opportunity. E. यथा, and अवसर opportunity.
31251: यथाविधि ind. or n. adv. According to rule. E. यथा, and विधि precept.
31252: यथावृत्त adv. (-त्तं) Circumstantially, relating a thing as it happened. E. यथा, and वृत्त being.
31253: यथाशक्ति adv. n. (-क्ति) Extent of capability, as much as possible. E. यथा as much as, and शक्ति power.
31254: यथाशास्त्र adv. n. (-स्त्रं) According to the Śāstras, agreeably to scripture. E. यथा agreeably to, शास्त्र the Śāstras.
31255: यथासुख adv. (-खं) Happily. E. यथा, and सुख pleasure.
31256: यथास्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Right, proper, fit, true. n. (-तं) Circumstantially, or all that happened or existed. E. यथा as, and स्थित fixed, established.
31257: यथास्वम् ind. As, according, or appertaining to, properly, peculiarly. E. यथा as, and स्व own, peculiar.
31258: यथेप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. adv. n. or ind. (-तं) 1 Willingly, voluntarily. 2 Wilfully, independantly. E. यथा as, इप्सित (participle past, desiderative form of आप to obtain), desired, wished.
31259: यथेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Wished, desired. adv. n. or ind. (-ष्टं) According to will or inclination.
31260: यथेष्टचारिन् m. (-री) A bird. E. यथा as, इष्ट wished, and चारिन् who goes.
31261: यथोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Right, proper. adv. n. or ind. (-तं) Properly, suitably. E. यथा, and उचित proper.
31262: यथोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) As said or explained. E. यथा as, उदित said.
31263: यद् mfn. relative pronoun (-यः-या-यत्) Who, which, what. E. यज to worship, Uṇādi aff. अदि, with the power of डित्.
31264: यदा ind. When, at what time. E. यट् what, दाच् aff., and the final rejected.
31265: यदि ind. If; particle of suspicion or doubt. E. यत to make effort, इञ् aff., and the radical final changed to द.
31266: यदु m. (-टुः) 1 The name of a king, the ancestor of KṚṢṆA, and the eldest son of YAYĀTI, the fifth monarch of the lunar dynasty. 2 A country on the west of the Jumna river about Mathurā and Vṛndāvana, over which YADU ruled, and named after him: according to some authorities, however, the kingdom of YADU, is the Dekshin or Peninsula of India. m. plu. (-वाः) 1 The Yādavas, the people of YADU. 2 Descendants of king YADU: more usually however यादवा.
31267: यदुनाथ m. (-थः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. यटु the son of YAYĀTI, but here put for his race, and नाथ lord, chief.
31268: यदृच्छा f. (-च्छा) 1 Wilfulness, independence, following one's own fancies. 2 (In grammar,) A noun which is neither a generic nor specific term, nor noun of agency; one either not derived from authority, or not possessing meaning. E. यत् what, which, ऋच्छ to go, aff. अ and टाप्.
31269: यदृच्छाभिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A voluntary or self-offered witness. E. यदृच्छा, and अभिज्ञ who knows.
31270: यद्यपि adv. Although. E. यदि, and अपि certainly.
31271: यद्वत् ind. As, in what manner, correlative to तद्वत्. E. यट्, and वति aff.
31272: यन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) A check, a restraint, any person or thing that restrains, &c. m. (-न्ता) 1 A charioteer. 2 An elephantdriver. E. यम to restrain, aff. तृच्.
31273: यन्त्र r. 1st and 10th cls. (यन्त्रति यन्त्रयति) To restrain: see यत्रि.
31274: यन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) 1 A machine in general, any implement or apparatus. 2 A diagram of a mystical nature, or astrological character. 3 A sort of vessel. 4 Restraining, checking, controlling. E. यम to check, Uṇādi aff. त्र.
31275: यन्त्रक m. (-कः) A lathe. f. (-का) A wife's younger sister. E. यन्त्र a machine or restraining, &c., and कन् added.
31276: यन्त्रगृह n. (-हः) 1 An oil mill. 2 A manufactory. E. यन्त्र any machine, the apparatus used for grinding substances yielding oil, and गृह a house.
31277: यन्त्रगोल m. (-लः) Common pea. E. यन्त्र a machine, and गोल. round.
31278: यन्त्रण n. (-णं) 1 Pain, anguish, affliction. 2 Binding, confining. 3 Checking, controlling, especially the passions. E. यत्रि to restrain, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
31279: यन्त्रपेषणी f. (-णी) A handmill. E. यन्त्र a machine, and पेषणी a stone for grinding on.
31280: यन्त्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bound, tied, chained, fettered. 2 Checked, restrained. E. यन्त्र restraining, and इतच् aff.
31281: यन्त्रितकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Restrained in speech, constrained to be silent. E. यन्त्रित, and कथा speech.
31283: यम r. 1st cl. (औ उ) औयमु (यच्छति) To stop, to cease, to refrain. With नि prefixed, 1 To remove, to dispel. 2 To observe as a vow or religious rite. 3 To regulate, to restrain. With उत्, 1 To rise, to mount on. 2 To make effort or exertion. 3 To lift up, to raise. With वि and आङ्, To exercise. With सम् and नि, To restrain. In some senses it takes the deponent form, as with आङ्, prefix, (आयच्छते) To put forth, to use or employ any part of one's own body, as the hand, &c. (आयच्छति) 1 To seize. 2 To go to, to proceed to. With सम्, (संयच्छते) To heap together any thing that is one's own. (संयच्छति) To associate with. With उप, (उपयच्छते) 1 To marry. 2 To agree or accede to. 3 To master by learning. r. 10th cl. (यमयति यामयति) 1 To feed, to give food to. 2 To restrain.
31284: यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Twin, fellow, one of a pair or brace. m. (-मः) 1 Restraining, controlling. 2 Forbearance, refraining. 3 Cessation, stop, conclusion, finish. 4 Religious restraint or obligation. 5 Penance, purification, the performance of those acts which remove impurity of any kind. 6 Any of the five acts or virtues, which constitute pure characters, as refraining from violence or injury, patience, sincerity, obedience to a spiritual teacher, and the observance of all purificatory ceremonies. 7 A festival. 8 A crow. 9 A name of the planet SATURN. 10 YAMA, the deity of Naraka or hell, where his capital is placed, in which he sits in judgment on the dead, and distributes rewards and punishments, sending the good to Svarga, and the wicked to the division of Naraka or Tartarus appropriated to their crimes: he corresponds with the Grecian god PLUTO, and the judge of hell MINOS, and in Hindu mythology is often identified with Death and Time: he is the son of SŪRYA or the sun, and brother of the personified YAMUNĀ or Jumna river. n. (-मं) A brace, a couple, a pair. f. (-मी) The Yamunā river. E. यम to restrain, &c., aff. अच् or अप्.
31285: यमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Twin, fellow, one of a pair or twins. m. (-कः) A religious obligation or observance. n. (-कं) 1 A species of alliteration, the repetition of similar words or syllables either in a similar or a dissimilar sense in various parts of a stanza, beginning, middle, or end of each hemistich, or pervading the whole verse: ten varieties are enumerated. 2 A couple of like articles; (in medicine,) serum and marrow: (in diet,) oil and ghee, &c. E. कन् added to the preceding.
31286: यमकालिन्दी f. (-न्दी) SAṂJÑĀ, the wife of the sun. E. यम YAMA, and कालिन्दी the Yamunā river; their mother.
31287: यमकीट m. (-टः) An earthworm. E. यम YAMA, and कीट a worm.
31288: यमदग्नि m. (-ग्निः) 1 The saint JAMADAGNI, the father of the first RĀMA. 2 PARAŚURĀMA, son of the preceding. E. see जमदाग्नि, य being substituted for ज.
31289: यमदूत m. (-तः) An infernal spirit, the messenger or minister of YAMA, employed to bring the souls of the dead to YAMA'S judgment seat, and thence conduct them to their final destination. E. यम YAMA, and टूत a messenger.
31290: यमदूतक m. (-कः) 1 A crow. 2 A messenger or minister of YAMA. f. (-का) The tamarisk tree. E. कन् pleonasm or aff. of comparison, added to the last.
31291: यमदेवता nf. (-तं-ता) The lunar asterism Bharaṇī. E. यम YAMA, देवता deity, the deity or regent of this constellation.
31292: यमन n. (-नं) 1 Binding, confining. 2 Term, cessation, rest. 3 Controlling, restraining. m. (-नः) A name of YAMA. E. यम to restrain, aff. ल्युट्.
