31293: यमनिका f. (-का) A wall or screen of cloth surrounding a tent. E. यम stop or check, aff. ल्युट्, कन् added, fem. form.
31294: यमप्रिय m. (-यः) Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) E. यम YAMA, and प्रिय beloved.
31295: यमभगिनी f. (-नी) The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river. E. यम YAMA, and भगिनी sister.
31296: यमरथ m. (-थः) A buffalo. E. यम YAMA, and रथ a car.
31297: यमराज् m. (-राट्) YAMA, the Indian PLUTO. E. यम YAMA, and राज् ruler; also with a final vowel यमराज m. (-जः.)
31298: यमल n. (-लं) A pair, a brace, a couple. f. (-ली) A sort of dress, a body and petticoat. (-ला) Violent hiccough. E. यम to refrain, to cease, aff. कलच्.
31299: यमलार्जुनहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA. E. यमलार्जुन a tree so named in the forest of Vṛndāvana, and हन् destroyer.
31300: यमवाहन m. (-नः) A buffalo. E. यम YAMA, and वाहन vehicle.
31301: यमव्रत n. (-तं) One of the duties of royalty, punishing offences without regard to persons, or without partiality or prejudice. E. यम the judge of Tartarus, and व्रत observance.
31302: यमसभ n. (-भं) The court or tribunal of Yama. E. यम, and सभा assembly.
31303: यमसभनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to the court of Yama. E. यमसभ, and छ aff.
31304: यमसात्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made over to, devoted to, or sent to YAMA. E. यम with साति aff., and कृत made.
31305: यमस्वसृ f. (-सा) 1 The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river. 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. यम YAMA, and स्वसृ the sister.
31306: यमानी f. (-नी) A sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.) E. यम YAMA, आङ् before नी to obtain, aff. अण् and ङीष्; with ण्वुल् aff. यमानिका; it is more usually read यवानी, and यवानिका.
31307: यमान्तक m. (-कः) A name of ŚIVA. E. यम YAMA, and अन्तक destroyer.
31308: यमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what restrains, checks, &c. m. (-मी) A sage, who has subdued his senses. E. यम restraint, and इनि aff.
31309: यमुना f. (-ना) The YAMUNĀ or Jumnā river, which rises on the south side of the Himāla range, at a short distance to the north-west of the source of the Ganges, and which after a course of about 378 miles falls into that river immediately below Allahabad; in mythology, the personified river is considered as the daughter of SŪRYA, and sister of YAMA. E. यम to stop, (at the Ganges,) and उनन् Uṇādi aff.
31310: यमुनाजनक m. (-कः) SŪRYA, or the sun. E. यमुना the river, and जनक parent.
31311: यमुनाभिद् m. (-भिद् or भित्) BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. E. यमुना the Yamunā, and भिद् divider; having divided the river into two parts with his ploughshare.
31312: यमुनाभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A name of YAMA. E. यमुना the Yamunā, and भ्रातृ brother.
31313: यमेरुका f. (-का) A Gong, a metal plate, or a large drum used to strike the hours or watches.
31314: ययाति m. (-तिः) A monarch of India, the fifth of the lunar race.
31315: ययी m. (-यी) 1 A road. 2 A name of ŚIVA. E. या to go, Uṇādi aff. ई, and the root repeated, form irr.
31316: ययु m. (-युः) 1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice. 2 Any horse. E. या to go, Uṇādi aff. उ, the root reiterated, and form irr.
31317: यर्हि adv. Wherefore, when. E. यट्, and र्हिल् aff.
31318: यव m. (-वः) 1 Barley, (Hordeum hexastichon.) 2 The measure of a barley corn, considered as equal to six mustard seeds. 3 A natural line across the thumb at the second joint, when it may be compared to a grain of barley, and supposed to indicate good fortune. 4 Speed, velocity. 5 A double convex lens. E. यु to join or mix, aff. अप्.
31319: यवक m. (-कः) Barley. E. यव barley, and कन् pleonasm.
31320: यवक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Fit for or producing barley, a field, &c. E. यवक barley, यत् aff.
31321: यवक्षार m. (-रः) Saltpetre, nitre, nitrate of potash. E. यव barley, and क्षार ashes or salt; being prepared, according to some of the commentators, accurately enough, from burnt barley, the potash being thus procured; according to others however it is so termed, from the crystals being supposed to resemble the spike of the plant.
31322: यवक्षोद m. (-दः) Barley meal. E. यव barley, and क्षोद meal or powder.
31323: यवगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of eruption on the face. E. यव for युव youth, and गण्ड affecting the cheek.
31324: यवज m. (-जः) Nitre. E. यव barley, and ज born: see यवक्षार.
31325: यवन m. (-नः) 1 A country; probably Bactria, or it may be extended from that colony to Ionia, (to which word it bears some resemblance,) or still further to Greece: by late Hindu writers, it is most commonly applied to Arabia. 2 A Yavana, apparently originally a Greek, but since applied to both the Mohammedan and European invaders of India, and often used as a general term for any foreign or barbarous race. 3 Speed, velocity. 4 A swift horse. f. (-नी) The wife of a Yavana. E. यु to mix, aff. युच्, or जु to be swift, and the consonant changed to its analogous semivowel: or योनि the womb, (of the cow of VASIṢṬHA,) and अण् aff.; being born for the purpose of opposing the armies of VIŚVĀMITRA.
31326: यवनप्रिय n. (-यं) Black pepper. E. यवन a Yavana, and प्रिय fond of.
31327: यवनाचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An astronomical writer, frequently quoted by Varāhamihira, and other ancient Hindu astronomers: perhaps PTOLEMY, or the Greek astronomers collectively. E. यवन a Yāvana, and आचार्य्य a holy teacher.
31328: यवनारि m. (-रिः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. यवन a Yavana, and अरि enemy.
31329: यवनाल m. (-लः) 1 A sort of grass, very generally cultivated, and the grain extensively eaten, (Andropogon or Holcus bicolor.) 2 Barley straw. E. यत्र barley, and नाल culm or stalk; also यावनाल.
31330: यवनालज m. (-जः) Nitre. E. यवनाल barley straw, and ज produced: see यवक्षार.
31331: यवनिका f. (-का) An outer tent, a screen of cloth surrounding a tent or tents. E. see जवनिका, ज being changed to य.
31332: यवनेष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Lead. m. (-ष्टः) 1 Garlick. 2 A sort of onion. 2 The Nimb tree. E. यवन a Yavana, a barbarian, and इष्ट wished, desired.
31333: यवप्रख्या f. (-ख्या) A small hard indolent tumor like a barley corn. E. यव, and प्रख्या appellation.
31334: यवफल m. (-लः) 1 A bambu. 2 Indian spikenard. 3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica) 4 An onion. E. यव barley, &c., and फल fruit.
31335: यवमध्य n. (-ध्यं) A form of penance, diminishing the food daily during the dark fortnight, fasting on the new moon, and gradually augmenting the food till the full moon. f. (-ध्या) A form of metre, a triplet, the divisions of which are of unequal length, the middle line having one syllable more than the first or last. E. यव barley, मध्य centrical.
31336: यवमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or from barley. E. यव barley, and मयट् aff.
31337: यवलास m. (-सः) Nitre, saltpetre. E. यव barley, and लस to like, aff. घञ्.
31338: यवशूक m. (-कः) Nitre, saltpetre. E. यव barley, and शूक the beard of corn.
31339: यवस m. (-सः) Meadow or pasture grass. E. यु to mix, असच् aff.
31340: यवसुर n. (-रं) Spirituous or fermented liquor distilled from barley, beer. E. यव barley, सुरा wine, ष aff., in the neuter gender; also यवसुरा the second member being unchanged.
31341: यवागू f. (-गूः) Sour gruel, prepared by the spontaneous fermentation of water in which rice has been boiled. E. यु to mix, आगूच् Uṇādi aff.
31342: यवाग्रज m. (-जः) Saltpetre. E. यत्र barley, अग्र the top or ear, and ज born.
31343: यवान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Swift, fleet. f. (-नी) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) E. यव speed, नी to possess, prefix आङ्, and aff. ड; also with कन् added, fem. form यवानिका.
31344: यवास m. (-सः) A flower, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. यु to mix, Uṇādi aff. आस; also with कन् added, यवासक.
31345: यविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Youngest, very young. m. (-ष्ठ) A younger brother. E. युवन् young, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative; also with कन् added, यविष्ठक.
31346: यविष्ठवत् adv. Like a youth. E. यविष्ठ, and वति aff.
31347: यवीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Youngest, very young. m. (-यः) A younger brother. E. युवन् young, इयसुन् aff.
31348: यव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit for barley, sown with barley, &c. m. (-व्यः) A month. E. यव barley, and यत् aff.
31349: यशःपटह m. (-हः) A drum, a double drum. E. यशस् fame, and पटह a drum.
31350: यशःशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Dead, deceased. m. (-षः) Death, dying. E. यशस् fame, and शेष end.
31351: यशस् n. (-शः) 1 Glory, fame, celebrity, reputation. 2 Splendour, lustre. 3 Praise, eulogium. E. अश to pervade, to spread abroad, aff. असुन, and युट् augment, substituted for the initial.
31352: यशस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Rendering famous, conferring celebrity. E. यशस् fame, कृ to make, aff. टच्.
31353: यशस्काम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Ambitious, desirous of fame or glory. E. यशस्, and काम desire.
31354: यशस्काम्यत् mfn. (-म्यन्-म्यती-म्यत) Desiring fame or glory. E. यशस्, and काम्यत् desiring.
31355: यशस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Famous, celebrated. E. यशस् fame, मतुप् poss. aff.
31356: यशस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Famed, renowned, celebrated. f. (-स्विनी) Wild cotton. E. यशस् fame, and विनि aff.
31357: यशस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Conferring fame. E. यशस्, and यत् aff.
31358: यशोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Destroying fame, rendering infamous. E. यशस्, and घ्न what destroys.
31359: यष्टि mf. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टी) 1 A staff, a stick. 2 A staff armed with iron, &c. used as a weapon, a club, a mace. 3 A necklace. 4 Any creeping plant. 5 Liquorice. 6 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 7 A string, a thread, especially as strung with pearls, &c. 8 A thread in general. m. (-ष्टिः) 1 A flag-staff. 2 The arm and forearm. E. यक्ष to worship, aff. क्तिन्, and the क of the compound final rejected.
31360: यष्टिक m. (-कः) A bird, the lapwing. f. (-का) 1 A necklace, especially of but one string. 2 A pond, a pool. 3 Liquorice. 4 A club, a staff, a bludgeon. E. कन् added to the preceding.
31361: यष्टिग्रह m. (-हः) A club-bearer, one carrying a staff or stick. E. यष्टि a stick, and ग्रह to take, aff. अच्.
31362: यष्टिमधु n. (-धु) Liquorice, or the root of the Abrus precatorius, which is used for it. E. यष्टि a stick, and मधु honey; also with कन् added, fem. form यष्टिमधुका, and with the final of the first word long. यष्टीमधु.
31363: यष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) A sacrificer, one who employs priests for a sacrifice. E. यज to worship, aff. तृच्, and ज changed to ष.
31364: यस(इर उ) इर् यसु r. 1st and 4th cls. (यसति यस्यति) To endeavour, to persevere, to make strenuous and persevering exertion. With आङ् prefixed, To labour. With निर्, To exude.
31365: यस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be done with energy or perseverance. 2 To be killed or put to death. E. यस to strive यत् aff.
31366: यस्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Death, being killed. 2 Effort, energy. E. त्व added to the last.
31367: यह्व m. (-ह्वः) A sacrificer, an institutor of sacrifices. E. या to go, वन् Uṇādi aff., and हुक् augment, form irr.
31368: या r. 2nd cl. (याति) 1 To go, to go to. 2 To obtain, to get. With अनु prefixed, To follow. With अभि, To approach, to reach. With आङ्, To come, to arrive. With उप, To give way, to yield. With निर्, 1 To go out or forth. 2 To go readily or quickly. With प्र, To go to. With प्रति, To go to or towards. With प्रति and उत्, To meet, to advance to. With सम and अभि, To approach. With सम and आङ्, To arrive.
31369: याग m. (-गः) A sacrifice, any ceremony in which offerings and oblations are presented. E. यज to worship, aff. घञ्.
31370: याच (दु, ऋ) दुयाहृ r. 1st cl. (याचति-ते) 1 To ask or beg, to solicit, to request. 2 To offer, to tender.
31371: याचक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Beggar, mendicant, asking, one who asks or solicits. E. याच to ask, aff. ण्वुल्.
31372: याचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Beggar, mendicant. E. याचन an asker, and कन् added.
31373: याचना f. (-ना) Asking, begging. E. याच to ask, aff. युच्.
31374: याचमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Asking, soliciting. E. याच to ask, शानच् aff.
31375: याचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be asked, begged, &c. E. याच to ask, अनीयर् aff.
31376: याचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asked, begged, solicited. E. याच to ask, aff. क्त.
31377: याचितक n. (-कं) A thing borrowed for use. E. याचित asked, and कन् added; what is got by solicitation.
31378: याच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be asked, begged, &c. E. याच to ask, ण्य aff.
31379: याच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being asked or solicited. E. याच to ask, pass. v., शानच् aff.
31380: याच्ञा f. (-च्ञा) Asking, begging. E. याच to ask, नङ् aff.
31381: याज m. (-जः) Boiled rice, or generally, food. E. यज to present, aff. घञ्
31382: याजक m. (-कः) 1 An officiating priest, a Brahman who conducts any part of a sacrifice. 2 A royal elephant. 3 A furious elephant. E. यज to worship, ण्वुल् aff.
31383: याजन n. (-नं) Conducting a sacrifice or causing its performance. E. यज to worship, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
31384: याजि m. (-जिः) A sacrificer, an institutor of sacrificial ceremonies. E. यज to sacrifice, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
31385: याजिन् m. (-जी) Sacrificing, one who officiates at a sacrifice. E. यज to sacrifice, घिनुण् aff.
31386: याज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be offered or sacrificed. m. (-ज्यः) A sacrificer, the person for whom it is performed. n. (-ज्यं) Property or presents derived from officiating at sacrifices. E. यज to worship, ण्य aff.
31387: याजुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Belonging to or relating to the Yajur Veda. E. यजुर or यजुस् the Veda, and अण् aff.
31388: याज्ञदत्ति m. (-त्तिः) KUVERA. E. यज्ञदत्त a proper name, and इञ् aff. of descent.
31389: याज्ञवल्क्य m. (-ल्क्यः) A celebrated saint and legislator; the supposed author of a celebrated code of laws, and the first reputed teacher of the white portion of the Yajur Veda revealed to him by the sun. E. यज्ञवल्क the father of the saint, and ष्यञ् aff.
31390: याज्ञसेनी f. (-नी) A name of DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the Pāṇḍus. E. यज्ञसेन the father of the princess, and अण् patronymic aff., ङीष् fem. aff.
31391: याज्ञिक m. (-कः) 1 A sacrificer, an institutor of a sacrifice. 2 An officiating priest at a sacrificial ceremony. 3 Kuśa or sacrificial grass. E. यज्ञ sacrifice, and ठक् aff.
31392: याज्ञिक्य n. (-क्यं) Sacrifice, sacrificial ceremonies. E. याज्ञिक a sacrificer, and यञ् aff.
31393: याज्ञिय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for sacrifice. E. यज्ञिय, and अण added.
31394: यात् ind. An interjection. 1 of pleasure; 2 alarm; 3 restlessness.
31395: यात् m. (-यान्-यान्ती-यात्) Going. E. या to go, शतृ aff.
31396: यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, went. 2 Obtained, got. n. (-तं) Driving or guiding an elephant with a goad. E. यत to endeavour, or या to go, aff. क्त.
31397: यातना f. (-ना) 1 Pain, agony, sharp or acute pain. 2 Pain or punishment inflicted by YAMA or his ministers, the pains of hell. E. यत to inflict pain, aff. युच्.
31398: यातयाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Old. 2 Used, impaired. 3 Rejected, abandoned. 4 Raw, half ripe or dressed. E. यात gone or got, याम forbearance, relinquishment.
31399: यातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be gone. 2 To be gone against, to be attacked or invaded. E. या to go, तव्य aff.
31400: यातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) A goer, one who goes or moves. m. (-तुः) A demon, a goblin, an imp or evil spirit. m. (-तुः) 1 Time. 2 A traveller, a wayfarer. E. या to go, तु Uṇādi aff.
31401: यातुधान m. (-नः) A goblin, an evil spirit. E. यातु the same, घा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
31402: यातृ m. (-ता) 1 A charioteer, a driver. 2 A husband's brother's wife. E. यत to endeavour assiduously, Uṇādi aff. ऋत्, and the radical vowel made long.
31403: यात्य m. (-त्यः) An infernal or condemned spirit. E. यत to endeavour, causal form, aff. यत्, to be made to toil.
31404: यात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Going, moving, proceeding, marching, travelling. 2 Passing away time. 3 Practice, usage, custom. 4 A holy festival, but especially the procession of idols, &c. which usually forms part of the ceremonies on such an occasion. 5 An expedient, a means. 6 The march of an assailing force. 7 Going to pilgrimage. 8 A sort of dramatic entertainment. E. या to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.
31405: यात्राकरण n. (-णं) Setting forth on a journey, a march, &c. E. यात्रा, and करण making.
31406: यात्राप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Performing a pilgrimage. E. यात्रा, and प्रसङ्ग engaging in.
31407: यात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to a march, &c. 2 Customary, usual. m. (-कः) 1 A pilgrim. 2 A traveller. n. (-कं) Provision, supplies, conveyance, &c. for a march. E. यात्रा, and ठक् aff.
31408: यात्रोत्सव m. (-वः) A public festival. E. यात्रा procession, and उत्सव festival.
31409: याथातथ्य n. (-थ्यं) Rectitude, truth, propriety. E. यथातथा, and ष्यञ् aff.
31410: याथार्थिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Just, true, right. E. यथार्थ, and ठञ् aff.
31411: याथार्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) Application, use, accomplishment, attainment of an object. E. यथाथ, and ष्यञ् aff.
31412: यादईश m. (-शः) The ocean. E. यादस् an aquatic animal, and ईश lord.
31413: यादःपति m. (-तिः) 1 The ocean. 2 VARUṆA, regent of water. E. यादस् a fish, &c., and पति lord.
31414: यादव m. (-वः) 1 KṚṢṆA, as descended from the family of Yadu. 2 A Yādava, or descendant of Yadu. f. (-वी) A name of DURGĀ. n. (-वं) Stock of cattle. E. यदु a proper name, and अण् aff. of descent, &c.
31415: यादस् n. (-दः) Any aquatic or amphibious animal. E. या to go, (with speed,) असुन् aff., and दुक् augment.
31416: यादसांनाथ m. (-थः) VARUṆA, the deity of water. E. यादस् an aquatic animal, in the sixth case plural, and नाथ lord.
31417: यादसाम्पति m. (-तिः) VARUṆA, the ocean. E. यादसाम्, and पति lord: see the last.
31418: यादृच्छिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Independant, following one's own will. m. (-कः) A ministering priest who does as he pleases. E. यदृच्छा, and ठञ् aff.
31419: यादृश् mfn. (-दृक) As like, how like, which like. E. यट् what, दृश to see, क्विन् aff., form irr.; also with खञ् aff. यादृश; mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) and with क्स added यादृक्ष (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं).
31420: यादोनिवासस् n. (-सः) Water. E. यादम् an aquatic animal, and निवासस् abode.
31421: यान n. (-नं) 1 Any vehicle or form of conveyance, as a carriage, a litter, a horse, an elephant, &c. 2 Going, marching, proceeding. 3 Invading, marching against an enemy. E. या to go, aff. ल्युट्.
31422: यानपात्र n. (-त्रं) A vessel, a ship, a boat. E. यान going, (by water,) and पात्र a cup or vessel; also with कन् added यानपात्रक; n. (-कं.)
31423: यानमुख n. (-खं) The forepart of a carriage, the pole or part where the yoke is fixed. E. यान a vehicle, and मुख face or front.
31424: यानस्वामिन् m. (-मी) The owner of a vehicle. E. यान, and स्वामिन master.
31425: यापन n. (-नं) 1 Spending or passing away time. 2 Abiding staying, being. 3 Rejection, ejection, expelling, expulsion. 4 Allaying, alleviating, (as pain or sickness.) E. या to go, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
31426: यापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be passed or spent as time. 2 To be allayed or relieved though not cured, (disease or a sick person.) E. या to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
31427: याप्ता f. (-प्ता) Twisted or matted hair. E. या to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त.
31428: याप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 Low, vile, contemptible. 2 To be passed or spent, (as time, &c.) 3 (In medicine,) To be alleviated or relieved though not cured, (disease.) E. या to go, causal form, aff. यत्.
31429: याप्ययान n. (-नं) A litter, a palanquin. E. याप्य vile, and यान carriage.
31430: याम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Relating to YAMA, done by him, ordered by him, &c. (-मः) 1 The eighth part of a day, a watch of three hours. 2 Forbearance. 3 Cessation, term. E. या to go, (through the day,) मन् Uṇādi aff., or यम to restrain, aff. घञ् or यम, and अण् aff.
31431: यामघोष m. (-षः) A cock. f. (-षा) A clock, a metal plate on which the hours are struck, or a drum used for a similar purpose. E. याम a watch, and घोष sound.
31432: यामनाली f. (-ली) A metal plate on which the hours are struck, or a drum used for that purpose. E. याम a watch, and नाली the same instrument.
31433: यामनेमि m. (-मिः) A name of INDRA.
31434: यामल n. (-लं) A pair, a couple, a brace. E. यमल the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.
31435: यामवती f. (-ती) Night. E. याम a watch, and मतुप् aff.
31436: यामातृ m. (-ता) A daughter's husband. E. य substituted for ज; see जामातृ.
31437: यामि f. (-मिः-मी) 1 A sister. 2 A virtuous woman. 3 Night. 4 The south. 5 A daughter, or daughter-in-law, newly married. E. या to go, मि aff., or य substituted for ज, see जामि, or यम YAMA, and अण् aff. of reference.
31438: यामिका f. (-का) Night. E. याम a watch, कन् aff., fem. form.
31439: यामिनी f. (-नी) Night. E. याम a watch, इनि aff.
31440: यामिनीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. यामिनी night, and पति master.
31441: यामीर m. (-रः) The moon. f. (-रा) Night. E. यामी night, रा to have or be, aff. क.
31442: यामुन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to the Yamunā river. n. (-नं) Antimony, or rather the sulphuret of antimony, generally used as an application to darken the eyelashes, and strengthen the eyes. E. यमुना the Jumna river, and अण् aff.
31444: यामेय m. (-यः) A sister's son. E. यामि a sister, and ढक् aff.
31445: याम्य m. (-म्यः) 1 Sandal. 2 The saint AGASTYA. f. (-म्या) 1 The south. 2 The lunar asterism, Bharaṇī. 3 Night. E. यम YAMA, ण्यत् aff.; being sacred to or governed by that deity, &c.
31446: याम्यायन n. (-नं) The sun's course, south of the line. E. याम्य the south, अयन going.
31447: यायजूक m. (-कः) The performer of frequent sacrifices. E. यज to sacrifice, aff. ऊक, the root repeated, and the first vowel made long.
31448: यायावर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Going repeatedly. 2 Wandering, vagrant. m. (-रः) 1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice. 2 The saint JARATKĀRU. 3 A Brahman who has preserved his household fire. 4 A vagrant mendicant. E. या to go, in the reiterative form, and वरच् aff.
31449: यायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going, who or what goes. E. या to go, णिनि aff., युक् inserted.
31450: याव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to barley. m. (-वः) Lac, the red animal dye. E. यु to join, aff. अण्; the nest yielding a sort of resinous substance used as sealing-wax: or यव barley, to which the grains of the dye are compared, and अण् aff.
31451: यावक m. (-कः) 1 Half-ripe barley. 2 Awnless barley. 3 Forced rice. 4 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus.) 5 A kind of pulse, (Dolichos biflorus.) 6 A kind of pulse said to be peculiar to Kashmir. 7 Lac. E. यु to mix, aff. वुन्, and अण् added, or याव as above, pleonastic aff. कन्.
31452: यावच्छक्य adv. (-क्यं) To the utmost of one's power. E. यावत्, and शक्य able.
31453: यावज्जीव n. adv. (-वं) For life, as long as life. E. यावत् until, जीव life.
31454: यावत् mfn. (-यावान्, यावती यावत्) As much, how much, such. ind. 1 As much as. 2 As many as. 3 As long as. 4 As far as, unto, until; the correlative of तावत्. 5 When, (i. e. as much, applied to time.) E. यत् what or which, डवतुप् aff., and आ substituted for the pronominal final.
31455: यावतिथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) That which is as far as, or as much as, &c. the ordinal of the particle यावत्. E. यावत् as much as, &c., and तिथक aff.
31456: यावत्तावत् ind. 1 As much as, quantum-tantum. 2 (In algebra,) The relation of the unknown number and its co-efficient. E. यावत्, and तावत् so much.
31457: यावन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating to a Yavana, Ionian, Mohammedan, &c. m. (-नः) Incense. E. यवन the country of the Yavanas, and अण् aff.
31458: यावनाल m. (-लः) A kind of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus bicolor.) E. यवनाल, and अण् pleonasm.
31459: यावशूक m. (-कः) Nitre, saltpetre. E. यव barley, शूक the spike, and अण् aff.
31460: यावस m. (-सः) A quantity or heap of grass. E. यु to mix, Uṇādi aff. असच् with the effect of णित्, which makes the vowel long.
31461: याव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be mixed or joined, miscible. E. यु to join or mix, aff. ण्यत्.
31462: याशोधरेय m. (-यः) The son of ŚĀKYAMUNI, the probable founder of the Bauddha sect.
31463: याष्टीक m. (-कः) A warrior armed with a club. E. यष्टि a stick, a club, ठक् aff., and both vowels made long.
31464: यास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) f. (-सा) A sort of bird, the Sārikā. E. यस to endeavour, aff. घञ्.
31465: यास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Going, who or what will be going. E. या to go, शतृ aff., with the future tense.
31466: यियक्षमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Purposing or wishing to worship. E. यज to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
31467: यियक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous of sacrificing. E. यज to worship, desid. v., उ aff.
31468: यियविषा f. (-षा) Wish to mix, blend, &c. E. यु to mix, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.
31469: यियविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to mix or blend. E. यु to mix, desid. v., उ aff.
31470: यु r. 2nd cl. (यौति) 1 To mix, to join, to blend. 2 To separate or not mix. r. 10th cl. (यावयति) To censure, to blame, to disrespect, to despise. (ञ) युञ् r. 9th cl. (युनाति युनीते) To bind, to tie.
31472: युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Joined, combined, united, identified. 2 Right, fit, proper. 3 Proved, concluded by inference or argument. 4 Moderate, limited. 5 Possessing, endowed with, as virtues, qualities, &c. 6 Intent on, attached to, as a study or pursuit. 7 Employed or engaged in business, &c. 8 Occupied in performance of the religious exercise called Yoga. m. (-क्तः) The sage who has acquired the command of his feelings and passions, and who performs the customary devotional offices without any regard to their result. n. (-क्तं) A measure of four cubits. f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Elāni. E. युज to join or mix, aff. क्त.
31473: युक्तरसा f. (-सा) A plant, commonly Elāni, (Mimosa octandra.) E. युक्त mixed, joined, रस juice.
31474: युक्तायस् n. (-यः) A sort of wooden spade or shovel. E. युक्त bound, joined, and अयस् iron.
31475: युक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Union, connection, joining. 2 Propriety, fitness. 3 Usage, custom, traditionary and unwritten law. 4 Inference, deduction from circumstance or argument, the reason of a thing or argument. 5 Insertion of circumstanced in written  evidence, specification in writing of place, time, &c. considered as one of the means of verifying such evidence. 6 A figure of rhetoric, emblematic or mystical expression of purpose, so as to conceal it from all but its immediate object. 7 Supplying an ellipsis. 8 Connection of dramatic events, the production of one incident by another. E. युज to join, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
31476: युग(इ)युगि r. 1st cl (युंगति) To except, to abandon.
31477: युग n. (-गं) 1 A pair, a couple, a brace. 2 An age, as the Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali. 3 A lustre, or period of five years. m. (-गः) 1 A yoke. 2 A measure of four cubits. 3 A drug, commonly Ṛddhi. E. युज to join, aff. अच्, and the final changed.
31478: युगकीलक m. (-कः) The pin of a yoke. E. युग a yoke, and कील a pin or bolt, कन् added.
31479: युगक्षय m. (-यः) Destruction of the world. E. युग, and क्षय destruction.
31480: युगन्धर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The pole of a carriage, or wood to which the yoke is fixed. 2 The name of a mountain. E. युग a yoke, धृ to hold or support, खच् aff.
31481: युगपत् ind. 1 At one time, at once. 2 Together, conjointly. E. यु to join, गपतक् aff.
31482: युगपत्र m. (-त्रः) Mountain ebony: see the next.
31483: युगपत्रक m. (-कः) Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) f. (-त्रिका) The Sisu tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) E. युग a pair, and पत्र a leaf, aff. कन्, double-leaved.
31484: युगपार्श्वग m. (-गः) A young ox in training. E. युग a yoke, पार्श्व a side, and ग who goes, or with कन् aff. युगपार्श्वंक m. (-कः.)
31485: युगल n. (-लं) A pair, a brace, a couple. E. युग a pair, लच् aff.
31486: युगांशक m. (-कः) A year. E. युग an age, and अंशक a part.
31487: युगान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A destruction of the universe. 2 The end of an age. E. युग an age, either generally or individually, and अन्त end.
31488: युगान्तबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A real friend, a friend in need. E. युगान्त, and बन्धु a friend.
31489: युग्म n. (-ग्मं) 1 A pair, a couple, a brace. 2 Mixing, uniting. 3 A couple of verses. E. युज to join, Uṇādi aff. मक्, and the final changed.
31490: युग्मक n. (-कं) 1 A couple. 2 A couple of verses connected by the construction of the sentence, the sense being completed only by the two together. E. कन् added to the last.
31491: युग्मपत्र m. (-त्रः) Mountain ebony. E. युग्म a couple, and पत्र a leaf, double-leaved.
31492: युग्मपत्रिका f. (-का) A timber tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) E. युग्म a pair, and पत्र a leaf, कन् added, fem. form.
31493: युग्मफलोत्तम m. (-मः) A plant, (Asclepias rosea.) E. युग्म double, फल fruit, and उत्तम best.
31494: युग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Fit or proper to be yoked or harnessed. n. (-ग्यं) Any vehicle or conveyance. m. (-ग्यः) An animal yoked. E. युज to join, aff. यत् or क्यप्.
31495: युच्छ r. 1st cl. (युच्छति) To be inattentive or negligent, to err or mistake.
31496: युज(औ)युजौ r. 4th cl. (युज्यते) To confine the thoughts, to keep the mind fixed in abstract meditation. r. 1st and 10th cls. (योजति योजयति) To bind, to tie, to connect. (योजयत) To blame. (औ, इर,) औ युजिर r. 7th cl. (युनक्ति युंक्ते) To join, to mix, to unite, &c. With अनु prefixed, 1 To ask, to inquire. 2 To reprove. With अभि, 1 To utter, to speak. 2 To accuse. With उत्, To make effort. With उप, 1 To seize, to take, to lay hold of. 2 To eat. With नि, 1 To order, to appoint. 2 To join. With प्र, 1 To be fit or due. 2 To attach or apply to. 3 To lend money. 4 To make effort. 5 To combine or connect. With वि, 1 To separate, to sunder. 2 To send. With वि and नि, 1 To appoint or employ. 2 To expend. 3 To send. 4 To involve in or force upon. With वि and प्र, to separate, to part, to divide. With सम्, To unite, to combine. With सम् and आङ्, To think profoundly.
31497: युज् n. (-युक्) A pair, a couple. m. (-युक् युग्) A sage, one who devotes his time to abstract contemplation. ind. (-जौ) The twin sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga. m. (-युङ्) A joiner, one who joins or unites. f. (-युक्) A measure of three hundred poles. E. युज to join, to meditate, &c., aff. क्विन्; also युजिर् the same, with the same aff., when न is inserted after the vowel, before the first five affixes in the masc. and fem. genders.
31498: युञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) 1 Uniting, joining. 2 Uniting spiritually, practising devotion. E. युज to join, &c., शतृ aff.
31499: युञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Uniting, combining, joining with. m. (-नः) 1 A charioteer. 2 A Brahman engaged in the religious exercise called Yoga. E. युज to join, &c., aff. शानच्, and नुम् inserted.
31500: युत r. 1st cl. (ऋ) युतृ (योतते) To shine.
31502: युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined, combined, connected, identified. 2 Attached to, engaged in or by. 3 Endowed with, possessed of. n. (-तं) A measure of four cubits. E. यु to join, &c., aff. क्त.
31503: युतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Joined, combined. n. (-कं) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 A pair, a brace. 3 Nuptial presents. 4 The end of a cloth worn by women. 5 A garment worn by women; it is applied, it is said, both to the petticoat, and the upper wrapper or cloth. 6 The ends of a cloth. 7 The edge of a winnowing basket. 8 Asylum. 9 Forbearance, cessation. 10 Alliance, acquaintance, forming an alliance or friendship. E. युत joined, &c., कन् added.
31504: युति f. (-तिः) 1 Joining, uniting. 2 (In arithmetic,) Addition. E. यु to join, क्तिन् aff.
31505: युद्ध n. (-द्धं) War, battle, contest, conflict. E. युध to fight, aff. क्त.
31506: युद्घरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. युद्ध war, and रङ्ग delight.
31507: युद्घसार m. (-रः) A horse. E. युद्ध war, सृ to go, aff. घञ्.
31508: युद्घोन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Fierce or frantic in battle. E. युद्ध, and उन्मत्त frantic.
31509: युध(औ) r. 4th cl. औयुध (युध्यते) To fight, to contend in battle, to slay.
31510: युध् f. (-युत् or -युट्) War, battle. E. युध to fight, aff. क्विप्.
31511: युधान m. (-नः) A man of the second or military order, a soldier, a warrior. E. युध to fight, Uṇādi aff. आनच्, and the radical vowel unchanged.
31512: युधिष्ठिर m. (-रः) The elder of the five Pāṇḍava princes, and leader in the great war, between them and the Kurus, in the beginning of the fourth age; the nominal son of PĀṆḌU, whom he succeeded in the sovereignty of India, but according to the legend, begotten on Kunti by the deity YAMA. E. युधि in war or battle, and ष्ठिर for स्थिर firm; it is also sometimes read युद्घस्थिर.
31513: युध्म m. (-ध्मः) 1 War, battle. 2 A bow. 3 An arrow. 4 A warrior, a combatant. E. युध to fight, मक् Uṇādi aff.
31514: युध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fighting, warring. E. युध to fight, शानच् aff.
31515: युप r. 4th cl. (ईर्) युपीर (युप्यति) To confuse, to perplex.
31517: युयुक्खुर m. (-रः) A hyena. E. युयुक् joined, खुर a hoof.
31518: युयुक्षमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Wishing to join or unite. 2 Devout, wishing to effect spiritual union with the divine essence. E. युज to be devout or to join, desid. v., शानच् aff.
31519: युयुत्सा f. (-त्सा) Wish or purpose to fight, enmity, pugnacity. E. युध to fight, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
31520: युयुत्सारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cowardly, having no intention to fight. E. युयुत्सा, and रहित void of.
31521: युयुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing or ready to make war or fight, pugnacious, hostile, ambitious. m. (-त्सुः) A combatant. E. युध to make war, desid. v., उ aff.
31522: युयुधान m. (-नः) 1 A proper name, one of the chiefs of the Pāṇḍus. 2 A warrior. E. युध to fight, in the reduplicate form, शानच् aff.
31523: युवखलति mfn. (-तिः-तिः or -ती-ति) Bald in youth. E. युवन्, and खलति bald; also युवाखलति, and fem. युवतिःखलति.
31524: युवगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Eruptions on the face peculiar to youth. E. युव a young person, from युवन्, and गण्ड what affects the cheek.
31525: युवजरत् mfn. (-रन्-रती-रत्) Being old as it were in youth, oldfashioned, or prematurely infirm. E. युवन्, and जरत् old; also युवाजरत्, and in the fem. युवतिःजरती.
31526: युवजानि m. (-निः) Having a young wife. E. युव, and जानि wife.
31527: युवन् mfn. (-युवा-युवति or -ती or यूनी-युव) 1 Young. 2 Best, excellent. 3 Endowed with native or natural strength. m. (-वा) A young man or one of the virile age, or from sixteen to seventy. f. (-तिः-ती or यूनी) A young woman, one from sixteen to thirty. (-तिः) Turmeric. E. यु to mix or associate, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, the fem. form takes ति, and optionally adds ङीष् in one form, with which affix the semivowel व is changed to its congener उ, and the two short vowels coalesce into one long one, making यूनी.
31528: युवनाश्वज m. (-जः) A name of MĀNDHĀTĀ, an early sovereign of the Solar dynasty. E. युवनाश्व his father, who appears as the eighth monarch of the Solar line, and ज born.
31529: युवपलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grey-haired in youth. E. युवन्, and पलित gray-haired; also युवापलित, and fem. युवतिःपलिता.
31530: युवराज m. (-जः) 1 A young prince, especially the heir apparent, associated to the throne. 2 One of the Jaina pontiffs. E. युव young, and राजन् a prince, टच् aff.
31531: युवराज्य n. (-ज्यं) The dignity of heir apparent and associate in the throne. E. युवराज, and यत् aff.
31532: युष्मद् 2nd personal pronoun. mf. (-त्वं) Thou. E. युष Sautra root, to serve, to worship, Uṇādi aff. मदिक्.
31533: युष्मद्वाच्य n. (-च्यं) (In grammar,) The second person. E. युष्मट्, and वाच्य to be said.
31534: यू f. (-यूः) The water in which pulse, &c. has been boiled, pease-soup, &c. E. यु to mix, aff. क्विप्, and vowel made long.
31535: यूक mf. (-कः-का) A louse. E. यु to mix, (with the hair,) Uṇādi aff. कन्, and the vowel made long.
31536: यूति f. (-तिः) Joining, mixing. E. यु to join, aff. क्तिच्, and the vowel made long.
31537: यूथ m. (-थं) A multitude of birds or beasts, a herd, a flock. f. (-थी) A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) E. यु to mix, थक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
31538: यूथनाथ m. (-थः) A large elephant, the leader of a wild herd. E. यूथ a multitude, (of elephants,) and नाथ lord.
31539: यूथप m. (-पः) The leader of a wild herd of elephants. E. यूथ a herd, and प who protects: see the last.
31540: यूथभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) An elephant turned out or driven from a herd. E. यूथ the herd, and भ्रष्ट expelled.
31541: यूथशस् adv. Gregariously, in flocks. E. यूथ, and शसि aff.
31542: यूथिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 2 Globe amaranth. E. यूथी the jasmine, कन् aff., fem. form.
31543: यूनि f. (-निः) Joining, union, junction. E. यु to join or mix, aff. क्तिन्, न substituted for the final, and the vowel made long.
31544: यूप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 A sacrificial post, a pillar usually made of bambus, or the wood of the Khadira, to which the victim at a sacrifice is bound. 2 A trophy, a column erected in honour of a victory. E. यु to bind (the victim), प Uṇādi aff.
31545: यूपकटक m. (-कः) A wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post, or according to some authorities, an iron ring at its base. E. यूप the post, and कटक् a ring, &c.
31546: यूपकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A part of a sacrificial post sprinkled with ghee. E. यूप the post, and कर्ण the ear.
31547: यूपद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) E. यूप a sacrificial post, and द्रु a tree; the wood of this tree being especially fit for the sacrificial post; also यूपद्रुम m. (-मः.)
31548: यूपलक्ष्य m. (-क्ष्यः) A bird. E. यूप a sacrificial post, put for any post, and लक्ष्य an aim; a sort of net being made about a post, on which birds may alight.
31549: यूपाग्र m. (-ग्रः) The top of the sacrificial post. E. यूप as above, and अग्र top.
31550: यूपोच्छ्रय m. (-यः) The ceremony of erecting the sacrificial post. E. यूप a sacrificial post, and उच्छ्रय elevation.
31551: यूष r. 1st cl. (यूषति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
31552: यूष mn. (-षः-षं) Pease soup, pease porridge, the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled. m. (-षः) The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica); also पूष. E. यूष to hurt, क aff.
31553: येष(ऋ)येषृ r. 1st cl. (येषते) To resolve, to endeavour diligently, to persevere.
31554: योक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be joined or united. 2 To be performed, (as devotion.) 3 To be united spiritually. E. युज to join, तव्य aff.
31555: योक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) The tie of the yoke of a plough. E. युज to join, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.
31556: योग m. (-गः) 1 Junction, joining, union. 2 Combination, association, meeting, conflux. 3 Religious and abstract meditation. 4 Keeping the body in a fixed posture. 5 Devotion, spiritual worship of GOD, or union with the Supreme Being by means of abstract contemplation; this does not necessarily imply an abandonment of the world or relinquishment of the usual observances of religion, but it involves internal indifference to objects of pleasure and pain, and utter disregard of the consequences or fruit of ceremonial rites. 6 The particular practice of the preceding sort of devotion, or the exercise of that abstraction by which union with GOD is supposed to be obtained; in the Gītā it is described as sitting on Kuśa grass, with the body firm, the eyes fixed on the tip of the nose, and the mind intent on the Deity; in the Tantras a fanciful operation is prescribed, by which the vital spirit seated in the lower part of the body, and the etherial spirit placed in the head, are supposed to be brought into combination in the brain, when the devotee becomes united with BRAHMA. 7 The system of philosophy which treats of the union of the soul with BRAHMA or GOD; it is the same as the Pātañjali doctrine, and constitutes one of the six Darśanas or philosophical schools of the Hindus. 8 Magic, or the acquisition of supernatural powers by the mystical and magical worship of ŚIVA and DURGĀ especially. 9 Consequence, result, the main end or object of any thing or act. 10 Connexion of one thing with another, as of cause with effect, predicate with subject, quality with substance, &c. 11 Acquisition of something not possessed before, accession of property or wealth; in grammar this application is assigned to any unusual construction of words or compounds, unauthorised by rule, but sanctioned by the authority that employs them. 12 A rule, an aphorism. 13 Propriety, fitness. 14 Side, part, cause or argument to be maintained or defended. 15 Thing, substance. 16 Wealth. 17 A drug, a medicament, especially a compound of various ingredients. 18 Fraud, trick. 19 A logician. 20 A spy, an informer. 21 A violator of truth or confidence. 22 A conveyance, a carriage, a boat, &c. 23 A means, an expedient. 24 Armour. 25 Putting on armour. 26 Lucky conjuncture. 27 (In arithmetic,) Addition. 28 (In astronomy,) The leading or principal star of a lunar mansion. 29 The twenty-seventh part of 360° of a great circle measured on the plane of the ecliptic, and used in calculating the longitudes of the sun and moon; each Yogas has a distinct name; astrologers also enumerate twenty-eight Yogas differently named from the foregoing, and corresponding with the twenty-eight Nakṣatras, or the divisions of the moon's path, but varying according to the day of the week. 30 A period, or the time during which the sum of the motions of the sun and moon amount to one Nakṣatra, the mean duration of which is 23hs. 47' 44". E. युज to join literally or figuratively, as with GOD, aff. घञ्.
31557: योगक्षेम n. (-मः) 1 Charge of property, keeping of cattle, &c. for another. 2 Insurance or charge for secure conveyance of goods, and the profit on their sale. 3 Profit, gain, keeping the old and making fresh gains. 4 Such articles as are not divisible amongst coheirs. 5 Welfare, well-being. 6 National prosperity the good government of a state, or the means of maintaining it; as the Raja, minister, priest, &c. forming the administration. E. योग profit, and क्षेम safety or preservation; or योग association, and क्षेम patience.
31558: योगक्षेमकर m. (-रः) A keeper, one who takes charge of property, &c. E. योग, and कर who makes.
31559: योगचर m. (-रः) A name of HANUMĀN. E. योग possession of superhuman powers, and चर going, possessing.
31560: योगतस् ind. 1 Suitably, properly. 2 Seasonably, in due season. 3 Through devotion, magic, &c. 4 Conjointly. E. योग, and तसि aff.
31561: योगदान n. (-नं) 1 A fraudulent gift. 2 Communicating the Yoga doctrine. E. योग, and दान gift.
31562: योगनाविक m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Silurus ascita.)
31563: योगनिद्रा f. (-द्रा) 1 The sleep of VIṢṆU during the deluge. 2 A goddess, a form of DURGĀ or VIṢṆU'S sleep personified. E. योग mystery, and निद्रा sleep.
31564: योगपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A cloth drawn round the lower extremities of the ascetic as he squats to perform religious abstraction. E. योग a religious exercise, and पट्ट cloth.
31565: योगवाहिन् m. (-ही) A menstruum or medium for mixing medicines. E. योग, and वाहिन् conveyer.
31566: योगवाही f. (-ही) 1 Alkali. 2 Quicksilver. E. योग joining of metals, वाह effecting.
31567: योगविक्रय m. (-यः) Fraudulent sale. E. योग, and विक्रय sale.
31568: योगविद् m. (-वित्) 1 A follower of the Yoga doctrines. 2 A practiser of devotional exercises. 3 A magician. 4 A compounder of medicines. E. योग, and विद् who knows.
31569: योगसेवा f. (-वा) Practising religious abstraction. E. योग, and सेवा observance.
31570: योगाधमन n. (-नं) A fraudulent pledge. E. योग fraud, and आधमन a pledge.
31571: योगारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Engaged in devotional exercises. E. योग, and आरूढ mounted on.
31572: योगासन n. (-नं) A religious posture, the position in which the devotee sits to perform the religious exercise called Yoga. E. योग as above, and आसन seat or sitting.
31573: योगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Who or what joins, or effects junction or connection, &c. 2 Possessed of superhuman powers. m. (-गी) 1 A devotee, an ascetic in general. 2 The religious or devout man, who performs worldly actions and ceremonies without regard to their results, and keeps his mind fixed upon BRAHMA or GOD alone. 3 The performer of the particular act of meditation called Yoga. 4 A magician, a conjuror, one supposed to have obtained supernatural powers. f. (-नी) A female fiend or sprite attendant on, and created by DURGA; in some places eight Yoginīs are enumerated by name. E. योग as above, इनि aff., or युज to join, aff. घिणुन्.
31574: योगिनिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Light sleep, wakefulness. E. योगिन् a saint, and निद्रा sleep.
31575: योगेश m. (-शः) 1 The city of BRAHMĀ. 2 The saint and legislator YĀJÑAVALKYA. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 Any principal Muni or  Yogi. E. यीग a Yogi or religious personage, &c., and ईश lord or chief.
31576: योगेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 A principal sage or ascetic. 2 A magician, one who has superhuman faculties. 3 A deity, the object of devout contemplation. E. योग, and ईश्वर lord.
31577: योगेष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Lead. E. योग affinity, (of metals or amalgamation,) इष्ट desired.
31578: योग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 Clever, skilful. 2 Fit or proper for a Yoga, or for religious meditation. 3 Powerful, able. 4 Fit, proper, suitable. n. (-ग्यं) 1 A drug, commonly Ṛddhi. 2 A cake. 3 A vehicle or conveyance. 4 Sandal. m. (-ग्यः) A calculator of expedients. f. (-ग्या) 1 Military exercise. 2 Medical practice. E. युज to join or mix, aff. ण्यत्, or योग union, and यत् aff.
31579: योग्यता f. (-ता) Fitness, suitableness, propriety. E. योग्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, योग्यत्वं.
31580: योजन n. (-नं) 1 GOD, the SUPREME BEIṄG, the soul of the world. 2 A measure of distance equal to four Krośas, which at 8000 cubits or 4000 yards to the Krośa or Kos, will be exactly nine miles; other computations make the Yojana but about five miles, or even no more than four miles and a half. 2 Joining, union, junction. E. युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.
31581: योजनगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 1 Musk. 2 A name of SĪTĀ. 3 A name of SATYAVATĪ, the mother of the sage and poet VYĀSA. E. योजन a Yojana, and गन्ध smell; whose odour is perceptible miles off; also with कन् added, fem. form, योजनगन्धिका.
31582: योजनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) Bengal madder. E. योजन joining, and पर्ण leaf.
31583: योजनवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. योजन joining, and वल्ली pedicle.
31584: योजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be joined. 2 To be added. E. युज to join, अनीयर् aff.
31585: योजयितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Joining, combining, who or what unites. E. युज to join, causal v., शतृ aff.
31586: योजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed, joined. E. युज to join, aff. क्त, more usually युक्त.
31587: योतु m. (-तुः) 1 Measure in general. 2 Cleaning, purifying. 3 A cleanser, a purifier. E. यु to mix, or not to mix, and तुन् Uṇādi aff.
31588: योत्र n. (-त्रं) The tie that fastens the yoke of a plough to the neck of the ox. E. यु to join, ष्ट्रन् aff.
31589: योत्स्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) About to fight, ready to fight. E. युध to fight, desid. v., future tense, शतृ aff.
31590: योद्धव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be fought, what must or ought to be fought. E. युध to fight, ण्यत् aff.
31591: योद्धृ m. (-द्धा) A warrior, a combatant. E. युध to fight, aff. तृच्.
31592: योध m. (-धः) A warrior, a soldier, a combatant. E. युध to fight, aff. अच्.
31593: योधमुख्य m. (-ख्यः) A leader, a chief warrior. E. योध, and मुख्य chief.
31594: योधयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Fighting, warring. E. युध to fight, शतृ aff.
31595: योधवीर m. (-रः) A hero, a warrior. E. योध, and वीर a hero.
31596: योधसंराव m. (-वः) Mutual defiance, challenging or braving each other. E. योध a warrior, संराव cry or shout.
31597: योधहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Carrying soldiers fit for war, (horses.) E. योध, and हर what takes.
31598: योधिन् m. (-धी) A warrior. E. युध to fight, घिनुण् aff.
31599: योधेय m. (-यः) A warrior. E. युद्घ war, and ढक् aff.
31600: योनल m. (-लः) A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.) E. यव barley, and नल culm or stalk, the व of the first word changed to उ, and उ with the inherent vowel of य changed to ओ.
31601: योनि mf. (-निः-निः or नी) 1 The vulva. 2 A mine. 3 Cause, origin. 4 Water. 5 Place or site of birth or production in general. E. यु to join or mix, Uṇādi aff. नि.
31602: योनिदेवता f. (-ता) The 11th Nakṣatra or lunar asterism; also Pūrvaphalgunī. E. योनि the vulva, and दवता presiding deity.
31603: योनिनासा f. (-सा) The upper part of the vulva, or the union of the labiæ. E. योनि the womb, and नासा the nose.
31604: योनिरञ्जन n. (-नं) The menstrual excretion. E. योनि pudendum, and रञ्जन colouring.
31605: योनिलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The clitoris. E. योनि the pudendum, and लिङ्ग the penis.
31606: योनिसंवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Contraction or closure of the vagina. E. योनि, and संवृत्ति contraction.
31607: योनिसङ्कर m. (-रः) Fault or blemish of birth on the mother's side, as from inferiority of caste, &c. E. योनि, and सङ्कर mixture.
31608: योन्यर्शस् n. (-र्शः) An affection of the vulva, Menorrhagia, or prolapsus uteri. E. योनि the vulva, and अर्शस् piles.
31609: योषा f. (-षा) A woman. E. युष to serve, Sautra root, causal form, aff. अच् and टाप्.
31610: योषित् f. (-षित्) A woman in general. E. युष Sautra root, to serve, to worship, to hurt, इति Uṇādi aff.; also with टाप् added योषिता f. (-ता.)
31611: योषित्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done by a woman, contracted by her, &c. E. योषित्, and कृत done.
31612: यौक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Connective, binding. 2 Inferrible, deducible. 3 Customary, usual. 4 Right, proper. m. (-कः) A minister or associate to one's pleasure or amusements. E. युक्ति union, association, aff. ठक्.
31613: यौगक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the religious practice, &c. called Yoga. E. योग as above, and ठञ् aff.
31614: यौगिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Customary, usual, common. 2 Relating to the Yoga, &c. 3 Proper, regular, (as the sense of words, depending upon their derivation or construction.) E. योग, and ठञ् aff.
31615: यौजनशतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Proceeding or extending a hundred Yojanas. E. योजन a measure so named, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
31616: यौजनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Extending or proceeding a Yojana. E. योजन a Yojana, and ठक् aff.
31617: यौट(ऋ,)यौटृ r. 1st cl. (यौटति) To bind, to tie, to join or fasten; also read यौडृ.
31618: यौतक n. (-कं) A nuptial gift, presents made to a bride, at her marriage, by her father or friends; some consider it also implying a gift to the bridegroom. E. युतक the same, pleonastic aff. अण.
31619: यौतव n. (-व) Measure in general. E. योतु the same, अण् aff.; some authorities read यौवत.
31620: यौधेय m. (-यः) A warrior. E. योधेय the same, and अण् pleonasm.
31621: यौन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Relating to the womb or place of origin, uterine. 2 Connected by female alliance, marriage, &c. E. योनि, and अण् aff.
31622: यौवत n. (-तं) 1 Measure in general. 2 An assemblage of young women. E. यु to mix, deriv. irr., or युवती a young woman, aff. अण्.
31623: यौवन n. (-नं) 1 Youth manhood. 2 An assemblage of young women. E. युवन young, अण् aff.
31624: यौवनकण्टक m. (-कः) Pimples on the face, especially in young persons. E. यौवन youth, and कण्टक a thorn.
31625: यौवनदर्प m. (-र्पः) Pride of youth, rashness, conceit. E. यौवन, and दर्प pride.
31626: यौवनदशा f. (-शा) The period of youth. E. यौवन, and दशा state.
31627: यौवनपिडका f. (-का) Blotches or pimples on the face in youth. E. यौवन, and पिडका a pimple.
31628: यौवनलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 The breast, the bosom. 2 Beauty, handsomeness. E. यौवन youth, लक्षण mark or sign.
31629: यौवनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Youthful. E. यौवन, and मतुप् aff.
31630: यौवनाश्व m. (-श्वः) A name of MĀNDHĀTĀ, one of the kings of the solar dynasty. E. युवनाश्च a proper name, and अण् patronymic aff.
31631: यौष्माक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Yours, belonging to you. E. युष्माक for युष्मट् you, and aff. अण्.
31632: यौष्माकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Yours, thine. E. युष्माक for युष्मट् thou, and खञ् aff. र
31633: र The twenty-seventh consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding to the letter R.
31634: र m. (रः) 1 Fire or Agni. 2 Heat, warmth. 3 Burning, scorching. 4 Love, desire. 5 Speed. f. (-रा) 1 Giving. 2 Gold. f. (री) Going, moving. E. रा to give, रम to play, &c., aff. ड.
31635: रंहति f. (-तिः) Speed, velocity, in general, or the speed of a chariot. E. रम to sport, क्तिन् aff., हुक् augment.
31636: रंहस् n. (-हः) Speed, velocity. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, हुक् augment.
31637: रक r. 10th cl. (राकयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain.
31638: रक m. (-कः) 1 The sun gem. 2 Crystal. 3 A hard shower. E. रक to obtain, अच् aff.
31639: रक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Dyed, tinged, coloured, stained. 2 Red, of a red colour. 3 Fond of, attached to, affected with love or interest towards any object. 4 Pure, purified. 5 Sporting, engaging in play or pastime. m. (-क्तः) Red, the colour. n. (-क्तं) 1 Blood. 2 Saffron. 3 Copper. 4 Minium. 5 Vermilion. 6 The fruit of the Flacourtia cataphracta. f. (-क्ता) 1 The Gunja plant, (Abrus precatorius.) 2 Lac. 3 Bengal madder. E. रञ्ज to colour or dye, &c., aff. क्त.
31640: रक्तक m. (-कः) 1 A plant bearing a red blossom, (Pentapetes phoenicea; it is also applied to the Ixora bandhuca.) 2 Globe amaranth, (Gomphræna globosa, the red variety.) 3 Red garments or cloth. 4 A man affected with passion or fondness. 5 A gamboller, a player, one who plays or sports. 6 Safflower. E. कन् added to the preceding.
31641: रक्तकन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Coral. 2 A sort of onion. 3 A kind of yam (Dioscorea purpurea?) E. रक्त red, and कन्द a root.
31642: रक्तकन्दल m. (-लः) Coral. E. रक्त red, कन्द, and लच् aff.
31643: रक्तकमल n. (-लं) The red lotus. E. रक्त red, and कमल the lotus.
31644: रक्तकाञ्चन m. (-नः) Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.) E. रक्त red, and काञ्चन the same.
31645: रक्तकुमुद n. (-दं) The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra, Rox.) E. रक्त red, and कुमुद the lotus.
31646: रक्तकैरव n. (-वं) The red lotus. E. रक्त, and कैरव a lotus.
31647: रक्तकोकनद n. (-दं) The red lotus. E. रक्त, and कोकनद a lotus.
31648: रक्तगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 A disease, a hard lump in the abdomen of the female after conception, perhaps scirrhus of the ovarium. 2 A clot of blood. E. रक्त, and गुल्म cluster.
31649: रक्तघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.) f. (-घ्नी) A kind of grass, a variety of the Dūb grass. E. रक्त blood, and घ्न removing; anti-plethoric.
31650: रक्तचन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Red wood, either red Sandal or sappan wood. 2 Saffron. E. रक्त red, and चन्दन Sandal.
31651: रक्तचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 Red lead. 2 Any red powder. E. रक्त red, चूर्ण powder, dust.
31652: रक्तजन्तुक m. (-कः) An earthworm. E. रक्त red, and जन्तु an insect, aff. कन्.
31653: रक्तजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A lion. E. रक्त red, and जिह्वा the tongue.
31654: रक्ततुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A parrot. E. रक्त red, and तुण्ड a beak.
31655: रक्तत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Redness. 2 Passion, affection. E. त्व added to रक्त; also with तल्, रक्तता.
31656: रक्तदन्ती f. (-न्ती) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. रक्त red, दन्त a tooth, aff. ङीष्.
31657: रक्तदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Red-eyed. m. (-दृक्) A pigeon. E. रक्त red, and दृश् the eye.
31658: रक्तधातु m. (-तुः) 1 Red chalk or red orpiment. 2 Copper. E. रक्त red, and धातु a mineral.
31659: रक्तनयन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Red-eyed. m. (-नः) The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.) E. रक्त red, and नयन the eye, red-eyed.
31660: रक्तनासिक m. (-कः) An owl. E. रक्त red, नासिका the nose.
31661: रक्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what drinks blood. m. (-पः) An imp, a goblin. f. (-पा) 1 A leech. 2 A female goblin. E. रक्त blood, and प what drinks, from पा with क aff. and टाप् for the feminine.
31662: रक्तपक्ष m. (-क्षः) GARUḌA. E. रक्त red, and पक्ष wing.
31663: रक्तपदी f. (-दी) A plant, variously considered as a sort of sensitive plant or a species of Lycopodium. E. रक्त red, पद foot or root, aff. ङीष्.
31664: रक्तपात m. (-तः) Spilling of blood. E. रक्त and पात causing to fall.
31665: रक्तपाता f. (-ता) A leech. E. रक्त blood, and पात nourished.
31666: रक्तपाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Red-footed. m. (-दः) A parrot. E. रक्त red, and पाद foot.
31667: रक्तपायिन् m. (-यी) A bug. f. (-नी) A leech. E. रक्त blood, and पायिन् what drinks.
31668: रक्तपारद n. (-दं) Native vermilion, cinnabar. E. रक्त red, and पारद quicksilver.
31669: रक्तपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The China rose, (Hibiscus rosa sinensis.) 2 A climbing plant, (Ventilago madraspatana.) 3 A spontaneous discharge of blood from the nose and mouth. 4 A red pimple or boil. E. रक्त red, and पिण्ड lump.
31670: रक्तपित्त m. (-त्तः) Plethora, spontaneous hæmorrhages from the mouth, nose, rectum and cuticle, accompanied with fever and headache, vomiting, purging, &c. E. रक्त red, and पित्त bile, the bile being of that colour; or रक्त blood, and पित्त bile, it being supposed to be an affection of both fluids or humors.
31671: रक्तपित्तहा f. (-हा) Variety of bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) E. रक्तपित्त the disease, and हा what removes.
31672: रक्तपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 Nerium odorum, the red variety. 2 A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaca, Rox.) mf. (-ष्पः-ष्पा) The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) f. (-ष्पी) 1 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 2 Bryony, (Bryonia grandis.) E. रक्त red, and पुष्प flower, whence it may be applied to any plant bearing red blossoms.
31673: रक्तपुष्पक m. (-कः) 1 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) 2 A small tree, (Andersonia rohitaca, Rox.) 3 A red flower, (Ixora bandhuca, or Pentapetes phoenicea.) 4 The silk-cotton tree. 5 The coral tree. 6 A tree from which a red dye is prepared, (Rottleria tinctorea.) f. (-ष्पिका) A sort of sensitive plant or species of Lycopodium. E. कन् added to the preceding.
31674: रक्तफल m. (-लः) The Indian fig tree. f. (-ला) A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica monadelpha.) E. रक्त red, and फल fruit.
31675: रक्तफेनज m. (-जः) A part of the body, apparently intending the lungs. E. रक्त blood, फेन froth or phlegm, and ज born.
31676: रक्तबालुक n. (-कं) Red lead. E. रक्त red, and बालुका sand.
31677: रक्तमञ्जर m. (-रः) A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.) E. रक्त red, मञ्जरी a pedicle, aff. टच्.
31678: रक्तमण्डल n. (-लं) The red lotus. E. रक्त red, and मण्डल a circle.
31679: रक्तमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Bloody, full or consisting of blood. E. रक्त, and मयट् aff.
31680: रक्तमोक्षण n. (-णं) Bleeding, letting blood. E. रक्त, and मोक्षण loosing.
31681: रक्तयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. रक्त red, यष्टि a stick.
31682: रक्तरेणु m. (-णुः) 1 Red lead. 2 The blossom of the Palāśa, (Butea frondosa.) 3 A sort of cloth. 4 An angry man. E. रक्त red, and रेणु dust; also with कन् added in the second meaning रक्तरेणुका.
31683: रक्तलोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Red-eyed. m. (-नः) A pigeon. E. रक्त, and लोचन an eye.
31684: रक्तवटी f. (-टी) Small pox. E. रक्त red, and वटी a pustule.
31685: रक्तवरटी f. (-टी) Small pox. E. रक्त red, वरटी a pustule.
31686: रक्तवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Red, of a red colour. m. (-र्णः) 1 An earthworm. 2 Red, (the colour.) E. रक्त red, and वर्ण colour.
31687: रक्तवर्द्धन m. (-नः) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. रक्त blood, and वर्द्धन increasing.
31688: रक्तवसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dressed in red. m. (-नः) The mendicant, or Brahman of the fourth order, especially as occasionally clad in red garments. E. रक्त red, and वसन vesture.
31689: रक्तवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Conveying blood, (as an artery.) E. रक्त, and वाहिन् what bears.
31690: रक्तविद्रधि m. (-धिः) A sore or ulcer from a vitiated state of blood. E. रक्त, and विद्रधि a sore.
31691: रक्तविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A red spot forming a flaw in a gem. 2 A drop of blood. E. रक्त fed, and विन्दु a drop.
31692: रक्तवीज m. (-जः) 1 The pomegranate. 2 The name of a demon killed by DURGĀ. E. रक्त red, and वीज the seed.
31693: रक्तवृन्ता f. (-न्ता) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. रक्त red, and वृन्त a stalk.
31694: रक्तशालि m. (-लिः) A red variety of rice, (Oriza sativa.) E. रक्त red, शालि rice.
31695: रक्तशासन n. (-नं) Red lead. E. रक्त red, and साशन an edict; from the document perhaps being sealed or signed with a preparation of this substance.
31696: रक्तश्राव m. (-वः) 1 Venesection, bleeding. 2 A kind of dock or sorrel. E. रक्त, and श्राव causing to flow; also रक्तश्रावणं.
31697: रक्तसंकोच n. (-चं) Safflower. E. रक्त red, (a dye,) सङ्कोच a contracting.
31698: रक्तसङ्कोचक n. (-कं) The blue lotus. E. कन् added to the last.
31699: रक्तसंज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Saffron. E. रक्त red or blood, and संज्ञा appellation; also similar compounds, as रक्तनामन्, रक्तनामक, &c.
31700: रक्तसन्ध्याक n. (-कं) The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra.). E. रक्त red, सन्ध्या twilight, कन् aff. of comparison.
31701: रक्तसरोरुह n. (-हं) The red lotus. E. रक्त, and सरोरुह a lotus.
31702: रक्तसौगन्धिक m. (-कं) A kind of dock or sorrel. E. रक्त blood, &c., and सौगन्धिक a lotus.
31703: रक्तहंसा f. (-सा) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of the musical modes.
31704: रक्तहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bloodless, cold-blooded. E. रक्त, and हीन devoid of.
31705: रक्ताक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Sprinkled with blood. 2 Dyed red. n. (-क्तं) Red wood, (Pterocarpus santolinus; applied also to the Cæsalpinia sappan.) E. रक्त, and आक्त sprinkled, spread
31706: रक्ताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. m. (-क्षः) 1 A buffalo. 2 A pigeon. 3 The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.) 4 A tyrant, a savage, a barbarous or cruel man. 5 The Indian crane. E. रक्त red, and अक्षि the eye, aff. ष.
31707: रक्ताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The planet MARS. 2 A plant, (a species of Crinum.) 3 A bug. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Coral. 2 Saffron. f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. रक्त red, and अङ्ग body.
31708: रक्तातीसार m. (-रः) Dysentery. E. रक्त, and अतीसार diarrhoea.
31709: रक्ताधार m. (-रः) The skin. E. रक्त blood, आघार receptacle.
31710: रक्ताधिमन्थ m. (-न्थः) Inflammation of the eyes, ophthalmia with sponginess of the vessels so as to discharge blood on being touched. E. रक्त, and अधिमन्थ ophthalmia.
31711: रक्ताभिष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Redness of the vessels of the eye with flow of tears. E. रक्त, and अभिष्यन्द flow.
31712: रक्ताम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dressed in red. m. (-रः) Any vagrant devotee, wearing red garments. E. रक्त red, and अम्बर vesture.
31713: रक्ताम्लान m. (-नः) Globe amaranth, the red variety. E. रक्त red, and अम्लान amaranth.
31714: रक्तालु m. (-लुः) A sort of yam, (Dioscorea purpurea.) E. रक्त red, and आलु yam.
31715: रक्तावसेचन n. (-नं) Letting blood, bleeding. E. रक्त, and अवसेचन sprinkling.
31716: रक्ताशय m. (-यः) Viscus in which the blood is contained or secreted, viz. the heart, the liver, and the spleen. E. रक्त, and आशय receptacle.
31717: रक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Affection, attachment. 2 Addiction to. E. रञ्ज to be affected, aff. क्तिन्.
31718: रक्तिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Abrus precatorius). 2 The seed of the Abrus precatorius used as a weight, or a fictitious weight, denominated from the seeds originally so used; the seed weighs about 1 and (5/16) troy grain, the artificial ratti or Raktikā should be double that weight, but in common use it averages nearly 2 grains and a quarter. E. रक्त red, कन् aff., fem. form.
31719: रक्तेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Red-eyed, having the eyes inflamed or blood-shot. E. रक्त, and ईक्षण the eye.
31720: रक्तोत्पल n. (-लं) The red lotus, (Nymphæa rubra.) E. रक्त red, उत्पल lotus.
31721: रक्तोत्पलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Red. m. (-भः) Redness, red, the colour. E. रक्तोत्पल the red lotus, आभ resembling.
31722: रक्तोपल n. (-लं) Indurated ochre, or clay iron stone. E. रक्त red, उपला a stone, hence applied also to red ochre, red orpiment, red chalk, &c.
31723: रक्ष r. 1st cl. (रक्षति) To guard, to protect, to cherish, to preserve. With परि, To save from ruin.
31724: रक्ष mf. (-क्षः-क्षा) 1 Preserving, protecting. 2 Lac. f. (-क्षा) 1 Ashes. 2 A sort of bracelet, a twist of thread or tinsel, with a small packet containing a few carminative seeds, bound round the wrist at particular periods, especially the day of full moon in Śrāvaṇa. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. अच्.
31725: रक्षःसभ n. (-भं) A multitude or assemblage of goblins. E. रक्षस् a demon, and सभा assemblage.
31726: रक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what protects, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A guardian, a protector. 2 A watch, a guard. E. रक्ष to preserve, वुन् aff.
31727: रक्षण n. (-णं) Preserving, protecting, defending. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. ल्युट्.
31728: रक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be guarded, preserved, protected, &c. E. रक्ष to preserve, अनीयर् aff.
31729: रक्षणीरक m. (-कः) Urinary affection, as gonorrhoea, &c. elsewhere read रक्षणारक.
31730: रक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्) Preserving, guarding, protecting. E. रक्ष to preserve, शतृ aff.
31731: रक्षस् n. (-क्षः) A Rakṣas, an evil spirit, apparently distinguishable into three classes: one sort of Rakṣas is of a demi-celestial nature, and is ranked with the attendants on KUVERA; another corresponds to a goblin, an imp, or ogre, haunting cemeteries, animating dead bodies, disturbing sacrifices, and ensnaring and devouring human beings; the third kind approaches more to the nature of the Titan, or relentless and powerful enemy of the gods. E. रक्ष to preserve, (KUVERA'S treasures, &c.) असुन् aff.; also राक्षम.
31732: रक्षस्पाश m. (-शः) A contemptible Rakṣas E. रक्षस्, and पाश aff.
31733: रक्षाधिकृत m. (-तः) A governor, a magistrate. E. रक्षा, and अधिकृत set over.
31734: रक्षापेक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A door-keeper or porter. 2 A guard of the women's apartments. 3 A catamite. 4 An actor, a mime. E. रक्ष preserving, अप before ईक्ष to see, aff. वुन्.
31735: रक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Preserved, protected, defended. 2 Kept, detained. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. क्त.
31736: रक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be guarded, protected, &c. E. रक्ष to preserve, तव्य aff.
31737: रक्षितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what protects, defends, &c., a protector, a guard. E. रक्ष to preserve, तृच् aff.
31738: रक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) Who or what preserves or protects. E. रक्ष to preserve, घिनुण् aff.
31739: रक्षिवर्ग m. (-र्गः) A guard, a sentinel. E. रक्षि from रक्षिन् a preserver, and वर्ग class.
31740: रक्षोगण m. (-णः) A class or troop of evil spirits. E. रक्षस्, and गण a troop.
31741: रक्षोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) Marking-nut plant. n. (-घ्नं) 1 Sour gruel made from the fermentation of rice water. 2 Asafoetida. E. रक्षम् a goblin, and घ्न destroying, repelling.
31742: रक्षोजननी f. (-नी) Night. E. रक्षम् a sprite, and जननी mother.
31743: रक्ष्ण m. (-क्ष्णः) Preserving, guarding, defence, protection. E. रक्ष to preserve, aff. नङ्.
31744: रक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be guarded, protected, preserved, &c. E. रक्ष to preserve, यत् aff.
31745: रक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Preserved. E. रक्ष to preserve, pass. v., शानच् aff.
31746: रख r. 1st cl. (रखति) also (इ) रखि r. 1st cl. (रंखति) To go, to move.
31747: रग r. 1st cl. (ए) रगे) (रगति) To suspect, to doubt, to fear. r. 10th cl. (रागयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain. (इ) रगि r. 1st cl. (रंगति) To go, to move.
31748: रघ(इ)रघि r. 1st cl. (रंघते) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (रंघयति) To shine; also without the indicatory letter, r. 10th cl. (राघयति) To taste.
31749: रघु m. (-घुः) 1 The name of a sovereign of Oude, the great grandfather of RĀMACANDRA. 2 The family or descendants of RAGHU. E. लघि to shine, कु Uṇādi aff., ल changed to र, and the nasal augment rejected.
31750: रघुकार m. (-रः) The poet KĀLIDĀSA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, which forms the subject of a poem by this writer, and कार author.
31751: रघुनन्दन m. (-नः) RĀMA, the second incarnation of VIṢṆU, under that appellation. E. रघु the king RAGHU, and नन्दन a son or descendant.
31752: रघुनाथ m. (-थः) A name of RĀMA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and नाथ lord, chief.
31753: रघुवंश m. (-शः) The race or family of RAGHU; hence also the name of a poem by KĀLIDĀSA, which treats of the ancestors of RĀMA, from DILĪPA to that prince, and his descendants to AGNIVARṆA; nearly one half relates to the history of RAGHU and as much to that of RĀMA, the remainder is occupied with the remaining princes. E. रघु as above, and वंश race.
31754: रघुवर m. (-रः) RĀMA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and वर eminent.
31755: रघूद्वह m. (-हः) RĀMA. E. रघु the race of RAGHU, and उद्वह pre-eminent.
31756: रङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) 1 Niggardly, avaricious, a miser. 2 Slow, dull. E. रकि to go, aff. अच्.
31757: रङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) A sort of deer, (the spotted axis.) E. रम to sport, aff. कु, form irr.
31758: रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Paint, colour, tint, dye. 2 Dancing, acting, singing, &c. 3 A field of battle. 4 The place where acting, &c. is exhibited, a stage. 5 A place answering to an amphitheatre. n. (-ङ्गं) Tin. E. रगि to go, aff. अच्, or रञ्ज to colour, aff. घञ्, the final changed and the nasal rejected.
31759: रङ्गज n. (-जं) Red lead. E. रङ्ग colour, ज produced.
31760: रङ्गजीवक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, a dancer, a mime. 2 A painter. E. रङ्ग a stage or colour, &c., and जीवक who lives by.
31761: रङ्गभूति m. (-तिः) The day of full moon in the month Aśvin, (September-October,) on the night of which LAKṢMĪ descended, promising wealth to all who were awake. E. रङ्ग dancing and singing, and भूति being, the night being spent in playing ancient chess, in Nāces, &c.
31762: रङ्गभूमि f. (-मिः) 1 A field of battle. 2 A stage, a theatre, a place where dancing is exhibited, or the Indian dramas were represented. E. रङ्ग dancing, &c., and भूमि ground, spot.
31763: रङ्गमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A lute. E. रङ्ग singing, &c., मल्ल to hold, affs. अच् and ङीष्.
31764: रङ्गमातृ f. (-ता) 1 A bawd. 2 Lac, the animal dye. E. रङ्ग passion or colour, &c., and मातृ parent.
31765: रङ्गमातृका f. (-का) Lac, or the insect which forms the red dye so called. E. रङ्ग colour, and मातृ parent, कन् added.
31766: रङ्गलासिनी f. (-नी) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. रङ्ग colour, (of the stalk,) लस to shine, aff. णिनि.
31767: रङ्गवीज n. (-जः) Silver. E. रङ्ग tin, वीज seed or essence.
31768: रङ्गशाला f. (-ला) A hall for public exhibitions, as Nāces, plays, &c., a ball-room, a theatre. E. रङ्ग acting, &c., and शाला a hall.
31769: रङ्गाजीव m. (-वः) 1 A painter. 2 An actor, a dancer. E. रङ्ग colour, &c., and जाजीव who lives by.
31770: रङ्गावतरण n. (-णं) Acting, playing, exhibiting in public. E. रङ्ग, and अवतरण alighting.
31771: रङ्गावतारक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, a buffoon. 2 A boxer. 3 A bard or panegyrist. E. रङ्ग acting, dancing, अव depreciative prefix, तॄ to pass, वुन् aff.; also with णिनि aff., रङ्गावतारिन्.
31772: रङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 1 Colouring, dying. 2 Impassioned, having propensity or passion. f. (-णी) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus). E. रङ्ग colour, &c., इनि aff.
31773: रङ्घस् n. (-ङ्घः) Speed, velocity: see रंहस; ह being changed to घ.
31774: रच r. 10th cl. (रचयति) 1 To make mechanically, to work, to manufacture. 2 To write, to compose, to make as a book.
31775: रचक n. (-कः) A maker, a composer. E. रच to make, वुन् aff.
31776: रचना f. (-ना) 1 Orderly and becoming arrangement or disposition in general. 2 Decoration or dressing of the hair. 3 Stringing flowers, &c., weaving wreaths, chaplets, or similar decorations. 4 Military array, the arrangement of troops. 5 Literary composition, whether in verse or prose. 6 Suspending garlands, &c. at the doors of a house or building on festival occasions. 7 Making or preparing any thing. E. रच to make, to manufacture, aff. युच्.
31777: रचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, manufactured. 2 Written, composed. 3 Strung. E. रच to make, aff. क्त.
31778: रज mn. (-जः-जं) 1 Dust. 2 The pollen of flowers. 3 The menstrual excretion. 4 The second property of humanity, the quality of passion. E. रञ्ज to colour, &c., aff. अच्, and the nasal rejected; this word more commonly occurs रजस्, q. v.
31779: रजःशय m. (-यः) A dog. E. रजम् dust, and शय who sleeps.
31780: रजःसारथि m. (-थिः) Air, wind. E. रजस् dust, and सारथि charioteer.
31781: रजक m. (-कः) 1 A washerman. 2 Cloth, clothes. f. (-की) A washerman's wife or a washerwoman. E. रञ्ज to colour, (clothes,) ष्वुन् or क्वुन् aff.; in the latter case the fem. is रजिका a washerwoman, and रजकी a washerman's wife.
31782: रजत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White. n. (-तं) 1 A necklace. 2 Silver. 3 Gold. 4 Elephant's teeth, ivory. 5 The name of a lake. 6 The name of a mountain, perhaps Kailāsa: see रजताद्रि. 7 White, (the colour.) 8 Blood. 9 An asterism, a constellation. E. रञ्ज to colour, &c., अतच् Uṇādi aff.
31783: रजतद्युति m. (-तिः) The monkey HANUMĀN. E. रजत silver, and द्युति lustre.
31784: रजतप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Mount Kailāsa, the residence of KUVERA and his attendant demigods. E. रजत white, (or silver,) and प्रस्थ table land.
31785: रजताद्रि m. (-द्रिः) Mount Kailāsa: see the last. E. रजत silver, and अद्रि mountain.
31786: रजन n. (-नं) Colouring, dyeing, painting. E. रञ्ज to colour, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
31787: रजनि f. (-निः-नी) 1 Night. 2 The indigo plant. 3 Turmerick. 4 Lac. E. रञ्ज to colour, अनि Uṇādi aff., and ङीष् optionally added.
31788: रजनिकर m. (-रः) The moon. E. रजनि, and कर who makes; also रजनीकर.
31789: रजनिचर m. (-रः) 1 A goblin. 2 A thief. E. रजनि, and चर who goes; also रजनीचर.
31790: रजनीकर m. (-रः) The moon. E. रजनी night, and कर who makes.
31791: रजनीगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The tuberose, (Polianthes tuberosa.) E. रजनी night, and गन्ध smell, emitting a powerful smell after sun-set.
31792: रजनीचर m. (-रः) 1 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin, a ghost. 2 A watchman. 3 A thief. E. रजनी night, and चर who goes.
31793: रजनीजल n. (-लं) Frost, hoar frost, dew. E. रजनी night, and जल water, falling at night.
31794: रजनीमुख n. (-खं) Evening, beginning of the night. E. रजनी night, and मुख commencement.
31795: रजनीहासा f. (-सा) A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor tristis.) E. रजनी night, and हास a smile; the flowers blossoming at night, and diffusing a powerful scent after sun-set.
31796: रजस् n. (-जः) 1 The second condition of humanity, the quality or property of passion; that which produces sensual desire, worldly coveting, pride, and falsehood, and is the cause of pain. 2 Dust. 3 The dust or pollen of a flower. 4 The menstrual evacuation. E. रञ्ज to colour, to be attached to, Uṇādi aff. असुन्.
31797: रजसानु m. (-नुः) 1 A cloud. 2 The heart or mind. E. रञ्ज to colour, to feel affection for, and सानु Uṇādi aff.
31798: रजस्वल m. (-लः) A buffalo. f. (-ला) A woman during menstruation. E. रजस् dust, &c., and वलच् aff.
31799: रजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Affected, moved, attracted, or excited by. E. रञ्ज to affect, causal v., and क्त aff.
31800: रजोबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Suppression of menstruation. E. रजस्, and बन्ध binding.
31801: रजोबल n. (-लं) Darkness. E. रजस् dust, बल heap.
31802: रजोरस m. (-सं) Darkness. E. रजस् dust, and रस essence, or perhaps this and the preceding should be the same.
31803: रजोहर m. (-रः) A washerman. E. रजस् dust, dirt, and हर who removes.
31804: रज्जु m. (-ज्जुः) 1 A rope, a cord, a tie, a string. 2 A lock of braided hair. E. सृज to create, &c. Uṇādi aff. उ, and the radical स rejected, and the vowel changed to its semivowel.
31806: रञ्ज (औ) r. 1st cl. औरञ्ज (रजति-ते) 4th cl. (रज्यति-ते) To dye, to tinge, to give tint or colour to any thing. r. 1st cl. (रजति) To be attached to or intent on, to have one's affections or passions engaged by any object. With अनु prefixed, To be fond of or attached to. With अप and वि, To be averse, to dislike.
31807: रञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 What incites or affects. 2 What colours, &c. m. (-कः) 1 Colouring, dyeing. 2 A colorist, a painter. 3 A dyer. 4 A stimulus, an inciter of affection, &c. 5 Biliary humour on which vision depends. E. रञ्ज to colour, वुन aff.
31808: रञ्जन mn. (-नः-नं) 1 Colouring, dyeing, painting, &c. 2 Affecting the heart, exciting passion, &c. n. (-नं) Red Sandal or Sappan wood. f. (-नी) 1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 Bengal madder. 3 Another plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, (a species of Crinum?) 4 A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. रञ्ज to colour, aff. युच्.
31809: रञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Moved or affected. 2 Coloured, dyed, tinted. E. रञ्ज to colour, क्त aff.
31810: रट r. 1st and 10th cls. (रटति रटयति) To speak.
31811: रटत् mfn. (-टन्-टन्ती-टत्) Speaking. E. रट to speak, शतृ aff.
31812: रटन n. (-नं) Speaking. E. रट, and ल्युट् aff.
31813: रटन्ती f. (-न्ती) The fourteenth of the dark half of Māgha, when bathing is enjoined. E. रट to speak, झच्. aff., the waters speak.
31814: रटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said. n. (-तं) The roaring of flame. E. रट to speak, aff. क्त.
31816: रण r. 1st cl. (रणति) 1 To sound. 2 To go, to move.
31817: रण mn. (-णः-णं) War, battle. m. (-णः) 1 Sound, noise. 2 The quill or bow of a lute, &c. 3 Going, moving. E. रण to sound, aff. अप्.
31818: रणकामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Desirous of war, wishing to fight E. रण, and कामिन् who wishes.
31819: रणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) 1 Warring, fighting. 2 Going. 3 Sounding. E. रण to go, शतृ aff.
31820: रणतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A military drum. E. रण war, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
31821: रणपण्डित m. (-तः) A warrior. E. रण, and पण्डित learned.
31822: रणप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Warlike. n. (-यं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. रण, and प्रिय fond of.
31823: रणमत्त m. (-त्तः) An elephant. E. रण war, and मत्त mad, wild.
31824: रणरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The part of an elephant's face between his tusks. E. रण war, and रङ्क slow.
31825: रणरण n. (-णं) Regret, anxiety, anxious regret, sorrow, of which the object is lost or absent. m. (-णः) A musquito, a gnat. E. रण war, and noise, repeated.
31826: रणरणक m. (-कः) 1 Anxiety, regret: see the last. 2 Love, desire. E. रण to sound, repeated, aff. कन्.
31827: रणसङ्कुल n. (-लं) Mixed or tumultuary combat. E. रण war, संकुल a mingling.
31828: रणस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A trophy, a pillar. 2 A country, Chitore. E. रण, and स्तम्भ a pillar.
31829: रणाङ्गण n. (-णं) A field of battle. E. रण, and अङ्गण a court-yard.
31830: रणाजिर n. (-रं) A field of battle. E. रण, and अजिर a court.
31831: रणाभियोग m. (-गः) Engaging in battle. E. रण, and अभियोग encounter.
31832: रणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, made as a noise. 2 Warred. E. रण to sound, क्त aff.
31833: रणोत्साह m. (-हः) Prowess. E. रण, and उत्साह effort.
31834: रण्डक m. (-कः) A barren tree. E. रण्डा a widow, aff. कन्.
31835: रण्डा f. (-ण्डा) 1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) 2 A widow. E. रम to sport, ड Uṇādi aff.
31836: रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Occupied or engaged by, actively intent on. n. (-तं) 1 Coition, copulation. 2 A privity, a private part. E. रम to sport, क्त aff.
31837: रतकील m. (-लः) A dog. E. रत copulation, and कील a pin, a fastening.
31838: रतकूजित n. (-तं) Lascivious murmur. E. रत copulation, and कूजित murmur.
31839: रतगुरु m. (-रुः) A husband. E. रत copulation, and गुरु teacher.
31840: रतज्वर m. (-रः) A crow. E. रत coition, ज्वर fever.
31841: रततालिन् m. (-ली) A libertine, a lecher, a whoremonger. E. रत copulation, तल to complete, aff. णिनि.
31842: रतताली f. (-ली) A bawd, a procuress. E. रत copulation, तल to complete or effect, and अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
31843: रतनारीच m. (-चः) 1 A dog. 2 KĀMA or love. 3 Sonitus in coitu. 4 A libertine, a lecher. E. रत coition, नारी a female, चि to collect, or चर to go, aff. क or ड.
31844: रतनिधि m. (-धिः) A wagtail. E. रत copulation, निधि a treasure.
31845: रतर्द्धिक n. (-कं) 1 A day. 2 Bathing for pleasure. 3 The aggregate of four auspicious objects, &c. E. रत copulation, ऋधि increase, aff. कन्.
31846: रतव्रण m. (-णः) A dog. E. रत copulation, and व्रण a sore.
31847: रतशायिन् m. (-यी) A dog. E. रत copulation, and शायिन् who sleeps.
31848: रतहिण्डक m. (-कः) 1 A libertine, a lecher. 2 A ravisher, one who carries off and violates a woman. E. रत coition, हिडि to go, aff. वुन्.
31849: रतान्दुक m. (-कः) A dog. E. रत copulation, and अन्दुक a chain.
31851: रतामर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A dog. E. रत coition, आङ् before मृध to rub, aff. अच्.
31852: रतायनी f. (-नी) A whore, a harlot. E. रत copulation, अयन a going.
31853: रतार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Libidinous, lascivious. f. (-नी) A libidinous woman, a wanton harlot. E. रत copulation, अथ seeking, soliciting, इनि and ङीष् affs.
31854: रति f. (-तिः) 1 Passion, desire. 2 Coition, copulation. 3 A privity, a private part. 4 The wife of KĀMADEVA. E. रम to sport, aff. क्तिन्.
31855: रतिकुहर n. (-रः) Pudendum muliebre. E. रति copulation, and कुहर a cavity.
31856: रतिक्रिया f. (-या) Copulation. E. रति the same, and क्रिया act.
31857: रतिगृह n. (-हं) The vagina. E. रति, and गृह abode, place.
31858: रतिपति m. (-तिः) The deity of love, KĀMADEVA. E. रति the wife of the god, and पति husband.
31859: रतिप्रिय m. (-यः) KĀMADEVA. E. रति the wife of the deity, and प्रिय beloved.
31860: रतिमदा f. (-दा) A courtezan of INDRA'S heaven. E. रति copulation, मद to delight, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
31861: रतिमन्दिर n. (-रं) Pudendum muliebre. E. रति copulation, and मन्दिर abode.
31862: रतिरमण m. (-णः) KĀMADEVA, the god of love. E. रति the goddess so named, and रसण husband.
31864: रतिसत्वरा f. (-रा) A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. रति copulation, सत्वर quick; perhaps considered as an aphrodisiac.
31865: रतू f. (-तूः) 1 The Ganges of heaven. 2 An honest woman, one who speaks the truth. E. ऋत a Sautra root, कू Uṇādi aff., and अम् augment.
31866: रतोद्वह m. (-हः) The Koil or Indian cuckoo. E. रत copulation, उद्वह exciting.
31867: रत्न n. (-त्नं) 1 A jewel, a gem. 2 Any thing the best of its kind, or figuratively, the jewel of the species. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. न, and त substituted for the radical final.
31868: रत्नकन्दल m. (-लः) Coral. E. रत्न a jewel, and कन्दल a shoot.
31869: रत्नकूट m. (-टः) A mountain in the Dekshin. E. रत्न a jewel, and कूट a peak.
31870: रत्नगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 The god of wealth, KUVERA. 2 The ocean. f. (-र्भा) The earth. E. रत्न a jewel, and गर्भ embryo.
31871: रत्नप्रभा f. (-भा) The first of the seven hells or purgatories, according to the Jainas. E. रत्न a jewel, and प्रभा splendour.
31872: रत्नमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Gemmed, full or made of gems. E. रत्न, and मयट् aff.
31873: रत्नमुख्य n. (-ख्यं) The diamond. E. रत्न a jewel, and मुख्य chief.
31874: रत्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having gems. f. (-ती) The earth. E. रत्न a jewel, and मतुप् poss. aff.
