31875: रत्नवर्षुक n. (-कं) The carriage of KUVERA. E. रत्न a jewel, and वर्षुक showering.
31876: रत्नवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) Coral. E. रत्न a jewel, and वृक्ष a tree.
31877: रत्नसानु m. (-नुः) The mountain Meru. E. रत्न a jewel, and सानु ridge of a mountain.
31878: रत्नसू f. (-सूः) The earth. E. रत्न a jewel, and सू a mother.
31879: रत्नाकर m. (-रः) 1 The ocean. 2 A jewel mine. E. रत्न a jewel, and आकर a mine.
31880: रत्नाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The car of VIṢṆU. E. रत्न a jewel, and अङ्क mark.
31881: रत्नावलि f. (-लिः) A necklace of gems. E. रत्न, and आवलि a row; also रत्नावली.
31882: रत्नि mf. (-त्निः-त्नी) 1 A sort of cubit, measured from the elbow to the end of the closed fist; it is also computed at twenty-one breadths of the middle of the thumb. 2 The closed hand, the fist. E. ऋ to go, कत्निच् aff., the vowel changed to the semivowel, otherwise अरत्नि, and as derived from सृ to go, सरत्नि.
31883: रत्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The male or female organ. E. रति copulation, अङ्ग member.
31884: रथ m. (-थः) 1 A car, a war-chariot. 2 A car, a carriage in general, any vehicle or mode of conveyance. 3 A limb, a member. 4 The body. 5 A foot. 6. A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.) E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. क्थन्.
31885: रथकट्या f. (-ट्या) A multitude of cars. E. रथ a car, and कट्यच् aff. of multitude.
31886: रथकर m. (-रः) A carpenter. E. रथ a car, and कर who makes; also रथकार and रथकृत्.
31887: रथकार m. (-रः) 1 A carpenter. 2 A man sprung from the male of the Māhiṣya, and woman of the Keren or writer caste; by profession, a maker of cars, a coach-maker. E. रथ a car, and कार who makes.
31888: रथकुटुम्बिन् m. (-म्बी) A charioteer. E. रथ a car, and कुटुम्बिन who takes care of as a part of his family.
31889: रथगर्भक m. (-कः) A car or litter borne on men's shoulders. E. रथ a car, गर्भ an embryo, and कन् aff.
31890: रथगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) A piece of wood, or an iron net-work, encompassing a war-chariot, to secure it from being injured by weapons or collision. E. रथ car, and गुप्ति screening, preserving; also रथगोपन n. (-नं).
31891: रथचरण m. (-णः) The ruddy goose. E. रथ a car, and चरण the foot.
31892: रथद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A timber tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.) E. रथ a car, and द्रु the tree, the wood being used for wheels, &c.; also रथद्रुम m. (-मः).
31893: रथन्तर n. (-रं) The Sāma Veda. E. रथ (as by) a car, तॄ to pass (the world), खच् aff.
31894: रथपर्य्याय m. (-यः) A sort of cane, the ratan. E. रथ a car, and पर्य्याय order.
31895: रथपाद m. (-दः) 1 A wheel. 2 The ruddy goose. E. रथ a car, and पाद the foot.
31896: रथप्सा f. (-प्सा) The name of a river.
31897: रथयात्रा f. (-त्रा) A festival at which the chariots of the gods go in procession: in Bengal and Orissa it is applied to the procession of the car of KṚṢṆA, as JAGANNĀTHA, on the second of the light fortnight of Āṣārha. E. रथ, and यात्रा going.
31898: रथवाहक m. (-कः) A charioteer. E. रथ, and वाहक what conveys.
31899: रथाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A wheel. 2 Any part of a carriage. m. (-ङ्गः) The ruddy goose, (Anas casarca.) E. रथ a car, अङ्ग a member.
31900: रथाङ्गपाणि m. (-णिः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. रथाङ्ग a wheel, (the discus with which one of his, hands is armed,) and पाणि the hand; also रथाङ्गिन् and the like.
31901: रथाभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.) E. रथ the same, and अभ्र a cloud or water.
31902: रथाभ्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A sort of reed: see the last. E. रथाभ्र the same, and पुष्प a flower; also रथ, रथाभ्र, and अभ्रपुष्प.
31903: रथारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted on or riding in a car. E. रथ, and आरूढ mounted.
31904: रथारोहण n. (-णं) 1 Riding in a car. 2 Fighting in a warchariot. E. रथ, and आरोहण mounting.
31905: रथारोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Riding in a car. m. (-ही) A warrior who fights in a car. E. रथ a car, and आरोहिन् who mounts.
31906: रथार्भक m. (-कः) A small car. E. रथ, and अर्भक small.
31907: रथावरोहण n. (-णं) Alighting from a car. E. रथ, and अवरोहण descending.
31908: रथावरोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Descending from a car. E. रथ, and अवरोहिन् who descends.
31909: रथिक m. (-कः) The owner of a car, or one who rides in it. E. रथ, and ष्ठन् aff.
31910: रथिन् m. (-थी) 1 A warrior who fights in a car. 2 The owner of or rider in a car. E. रथ, and इनि aff.
31911: रथिन m. (-नः) The master of a car. E. रथ, and इन a master.
31912: रथिर m. (-रः) The owner of or rider in a car. E. रथ, and इरच् aff.
31913: रथोपस्थ m. (-स्थः) The charioteer's seat for driving. E. रथ, उप near, and स्थ what stays.
31914: रथ्य m. (-थ्यः) A car or carriage horse. f. (-थ्यं) 1 A multitude of cars. 2 A high street. 3 A main or carriage road. 4 A place where several roads meet. n. (-थ्यं) A wheel. E. रथ a car, and य or यत् affixes of multitude or fitness.
31915: रद r. 1st cl. (रदति) 1 To divide, to split, to tear or break. 2 To dig, to delve, to root.
31916: रद m. (-दः) 1 A tooth. 2 Splitting, tearing, dividing. E. रद to divide, &c., aff. अच्.
31917: रदछद m. (-दः) A lip. E. रद a tooth, and छद covering.
31918: रदन m. (-नः) A tooth. n. (-नं) Tearing, rending. E. रद to divide, aff. ल्युट्.
31919: रदनछद m. (-दः) A lip. E. रदन a tooth, and छद covering.
31920: रदिन् m. (-दी) An elephant. E. रद a tooth, a tusk, and इनि aff.
31921: रद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Hurt, injured. E. रध to hurt, क्त aff.
31922: रद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ) Injurious, hurtful, who or what hurts. E. रध to hurt, तृच् aff.
31923: रध(ऌ उ) ऌरधु r. 1st cl. (राध्यति) 1 To finish, to complete, to accomplish. 2 To hurt, to injure or kill. 3 To be right or correct. 4 To cook or mature.
31924: रधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hurt, injured. E. रध to hurt, क्त aff.
31925: रधितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Injurious, hurtful. E. रध to hurt, तृच् aff.
31926: रन्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Pleasure, sport. 2 Cessation, stop. E. रम to sport, क्तिच् aff.
31927: रन्तिदेव m. (-वः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A king of the lunar dynasty; also called ŚAŚIDEVA. 3 A dog. E. रम, and देव a deity, or who sports or plays.
31928: रन्तु f. (-न्तुः) 1 A road. 2 A river. E. रम to sport, &c., aff. तु.
31929: रन्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Injurious, hurtful. E. रध to hurt, ण्वुल् aff.
31930: रन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 1 A hole, a fissure, a cavity, a chasm. 2 A fault, a defect. E. रम to sport, aff. क्विप्, धृ to have or hold, aff. क.
31931: रन्ध्रबभ्रु m. (-भ्रुः) A rat. E. रन्ध्र a hole, and बभ्रु an ichneumon.
31932: रप r. 1st cl. (रपयति) To speak, to say or tell.
31933: रफ(इ)रफि r. 1st. cl. (रफति रंफति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To hurt, to injure or kill.
31934: रब(इ)रबि r. 1st cl. (रंबते) 1 To sound. 2 To go.
31935: रब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Begun. E. रभ to begin, क्त aff.
31936: रब्धृ mfn. (-ब्धा-ब्ध्री-ब्धृ) Beginning, who or what begins. E. रभ to begin, तृच् aff.
31937: रभ(औ)औ रभ r. 1st cl. (रभते) or more usually (आरभते) To begin, to make a beginning, to begin willingly, &c. 2 To be pleased with. (इ) रभि r. 1st cl. (रंभते) To sound. With परि prefixed, To embrace.
31938: रभस m. (-सः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 Joy, delight. 3 Consideration of causes and events, or the past and future. 4 Regret, sorrow for something lost or absent. E. रभ to begin, असच् Uṇādi aff.
31939: रम(औ, उ) औरमु r. 1st cl. (रमते) To sport or play; with some prefixes this root forms an active verb, as with आङ्, उप, and वि; आरमति to rest, to repose, &c.; with उप the form is optional, if the sense is intransitive, as (उपरमति or -ते) To stop or cease.
31940: रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Dear, beloved. 2 Pleasing, delighting, charming. m. (-मः) 1 A husband, a lover. 2 The deity of love, KĀMA. 3 A sort of tree called a red variety of the Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.) f. (-मा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A wife, a mistress. E. रम to sport, aff. अच्.
31941: रमक m. (-कः) A lover, a gallant. E. रम to sport, क्वुन् aff.
31942: रमठ n. (-ठं) Asafoetida. E. रम to sport, अठन् aff.
31944: रमण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causing pleasure, pleasing, charming, delightful. n. (-णं) 1 Sporting, playing. 2 Dalliance, amorous sport. 3 Coition, copulation. 4 The mons veneris. 5 A sort of cucumber. m. (-णः) 1 A name of KĀMA or love. 2 A husband. 3 A lover, a gallant. 4 An ass. f. (-णा or -णी) 1 A woman, or an agreeable woman, a wife, a mistress, &c. 2 A kind of metre, having eleven syllables in the first and third, and twelve in the second and fourth Pādas of every stanza. E. रम to sport, युच् or ल्युट् aff., fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.
31945: रमणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Beautiful, pleasing. E. रम to please, अनीयर् aff.
31946: रमणीयता f. (-ता) Agreeableness, pleasantness. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, रमणीयत्वं.
31947: रमण्य n. (-ण्यं) Sport, pleasure, wanton sport or dalliance. E. रम to sport, अन्य Uṇādi aff.
31948: रमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Playing, sporting. E. रम to play, शतृ aff.
31949: रमति m. (-तिः) 1 A lover, a gallant. 2 Paradise, heaven. 3 A crow. 4 Time. 5 Love or the deity KĀMA. E. रम to sport or stop, &c. Uṇādi aff. उति, but the final of the radical retained.
31950: रममान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Sporting, playing. E. रम to please, शानच् aff.
31951: रमापति m. (-तिः) VIṢṆU. E. रमा LAKṢMĪ, and पति husband.
31952: रमाप्रिय n. (-यं) The lotus. E. रमा LAKṢMĪ, and प्रिय beloved.
31953: रम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A bambu. 2 The name of a monkey. f. (-म्भा) 1 A plantain. 2 One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga. 3 A harlot, a whore. 4 A name of GAURĪ. 5 Lowing, as of a cow. E. रभि to sound, to begin, &c., aff. अच्.
31954: रम्भक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Begining, who or what begins. 2 Sounding. E. रभि to sound, ण्वुल् aff.
31955: रम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded. n. (-तं) Lowing, (of kine.) E. रभि to sound, &c., क्त aff.
31956: रम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Pleasing, delightful, agreeable, charming. 2 Handsome. m. (-म्यः) The champaca, (Michelia champaca.) f. (-म्या) 1 Night. 2 The name of a river. n. (-म्यं) 1 The root of a species of cucumber. 2 Semen virile. E. रम to sport, aff. यत्.
31957: रम्यक n. (-कं) 1 One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world, lying to the north of Ilāvṛta; also called रमणक, and रमण्यक. 2 The root of the Paṭola, a sort of cucumber. E. रम्य agreeable, and कन् added.
31958: रम्यता f. (-ता) 1 Agreeableness, pleasantness. 2 Gracefulness, beauty. E. रम्य with तल् aff.; also with त्व, रम्यत्वं.
31959: रम्र m. (-म्रः) 1 Purple, or the colour of the dawn. 2 Beauty, splendor. E. रम to please, aff. रन्.
31960: रय r. 1st cl. (रयते) To go, to move.
31961: रय m. (-यः) 1 Speed, velocity. 2 The stream or current of a river. E. रय to go, घ aff.
31962: रयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Fleetest, very fleet. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 KUVERA. 2 Fire or AGNI. 3 BRAHMĀ. E. रय speed used attributively, quick, and इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative.
31963: रल्लक m. (-कः) 1 A blanket. 2 An eye-lash. 3 A sort of deer. E. रम to please, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् with the final dropped रत् comfort, pleasure, ला to give, aff. क्विप्-रल्ल, and कन् added.
31964: रव(इ)रवि r. 1st cl. (रम्बति) To go, to move.
31965: रव m. (-वः) Sound in general, cry, noise, &c. E. रु to cry out, to sound, aff. अप्.
31966: रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Sounding, sonorous. 2 Hot, warm. 3 Unsteady, fickle or shaking. 4 Jesting, a jester. m. (-णः) A camel. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. n. (-णं) 1 Bell-metal. 2 Sounding. E. रु to sound, Uṇādi aff. युच्.
31967: रवथ m. (-थः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. रु to cry or sound, Uṇādi aff. अथन्.
31968: रवि m. (-विः) 1 The sun. 2 The right canal for the passage of the vital air. E. रु to sound, passive form, to be praised or glorified, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
31969: रविकान्त m. (-न्तः) The sun-stone, a sort of crystal. E. रवि the sun, and कान्त in this compound, a mineral.
31970: रविनन्दन m. (-नः) The monkey chief SUGRĪVA. E. रवि the sun, and नन्दन a son.
31971: रविनाथ n. (-थः) A lotus. m. (-थः) A flower, (Pentapetes phoenicea.) E. रवि the sun, and नाथ lord.
31972: रविन्द n. (-न्दं) Lotus. E. रवि the sun, and दा to give, aff. खच्.
31973: रविप्रिय n. (-यं) 1 Copper. 2 The red lotus. m. (-यः) A plant, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. रवि the sun, and प्रिय beloved.
31974: रविमण्डल n. (-लं) The disk of the sun. E. रवि, and मण्डल circle.
31975: रविमार्ग m. (-र्गः) The sun's path. E. रवि, and मार्ग road.
31976: रविमार्गभङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Very high, stopping the course of the sun. E. रविमार्ग, and भङ्ग what breaks.
31977: रविलोह n. (-हं) Copper. E. रवि the sun, and लोह iron.
31978: रविवार m. (-रः) Sunday. E. रवि, and वार a time.
31979: रविसंज्ञक n. (-कं) Copper. E. रवि the sun, and संज्ञक appellation.
31980: रशना f. (-ना) 1 The tongue. 2 A woman's girdle or zone. E. see रसन.
31981: रश्मि m. (-श्मिः) 1 A ray of light. 2 A rein. 3 An eye-lash. E. अश to pervade, Uṇādi aff. मि, and रश substituted for the radical.
31982: रश्मिजाल n. (-लं) A blaze or stream of light. E. रश्मि, and जाल heap.
31983: रस r. 1st cl. (रसति) To sound. r. 10th cl. (रसयति) 1 To taste, to relish. 2 To love, to regard.
31984: रस m. (-सः) 1 Flavour, taste, as sweet, salt, pungent, bitter, sour, and astringent. 2 Taste, sentiment, emotion, as an object of poetry or composition; eight sentiments are usually enumerated, Śṛṅgāra or love, Hāsya or mirth, Karuṇā or tenderness, Raudra or anger, Vīra or heroism, Bhayānaka or terror, BIbhatsA or disgust, and Adbhuta or surprise: Śānta, tranquillity or content, or Vātsalya, paternal tenderness, is sometimes considered as the ninth. 3 Affection of the mind, passion. 4 Juice, exudation, a fluid, a liquid, or liquified substance. 5 Poison. 6 Semen virile. 7 Water. 8 The primary or essential juice or fluid of the body, whence blood, serum, sweat, &c. are supposed to be engendered; it corresponds best with chyle, but is probably of a fanciful nature. 9 Gum myrrh. 10 Quicksilver, from its being a semi-fluid metal, and according to certain alchymical notions possessed of supernatural power over the juices of the body, &c. 11 A mineral or a metallic salt, as sulphur, borax, talc, blue or green vitriol, &c.; they are however usually called Upa or inferior Rasas. f. (-सा) 1 The earth. 2 The tongue. 3 A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 4 A sort of grain, (Panicum italicum.) 5 The frankincense tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 6 The grape. 7 A medical drug, commonly Kākoli. E. रस to taste, to love, &c., aff. अच्.
31985: रसक m. (-कः) Stewed or boiled meat. E. रस juice, aff. कन्.
31986: रसकर्प्पूर n. (-रः) A white sublimate or a muriate of mercury, made in close vessels with sulphur, mercury, and common salt; the crystals formed in the first operation are sublimed a second time, which seems to be the only essential difference between this and the preparations called Rasapuṣpa; ut infra. E. रस mercury, and कर्प्पूर camphor; from its white colour.
31987: रसकला f. (-ला) 1 A low sweet sound. 2 Singing upon intoxication. E. रस taste or vinous juice, and कला a note.
31988: रसकेसर n. (-रं) Camphor. E. रस juice, and केसर a filament.
31989: रसगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Gum myrrh. E. रस exudation, गन्ध fragrance; also with कन् added, रसगन्धक.
31990: रसगर्भ n. (-र्भं) 1 A mineral preparation used as a stibium. 2 Vermilion. E. रस quicksilver, and गर्भ embryo.
31991: रसज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced by or in passion, flavour, fluids, &c. n. (-जं) Blood. m. (-जः) 1 Any insect engendered by  the acetous fermentation of liquids. 2 Molasses, treacle. E. रस juice, the primary juice or chyle, &c., and ज born.
31992: रसज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Discriminating or acquainted with tastes, sentiments, &c. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A poet, a writer who understands the different Rasas or sentiments to be described. 2 An alchymist, one who has obtained a command over the magical properties of mercury. 3 A physician, a medical preparer and administerer of mercurial and chemical compounds. f. (-ज्ञा) The tongue. E. रस as above, and ज्ञ who or what knows.
31993: रसज्ञता f. (-ता) 1 Poetical skill or taste. 2 Knowledge of flavours. 3 Alchymy. E. रसज्ञ, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रसज्ञत्वं.
31994: रसज्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) 1 The sweet flavour or taste, sweetness. 2 The sentiment of love. E. रस taste or sentiment, and ज्येष्ठ eldest, best.
31995: रसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Speaking, sounding. 2 Tasting, having flavour. E. रस to sound, शतृ aff.
31996: रसतेजस् n. (-जः) The blood. E. रस chyle, and तेजस् light, strength.
31997: रसधातु n. (-तु) Quicksilver. E. रस fluid, and धातु metal.
31998: रसन n. (-नं) 1 Tasting, taste. 2 Sound, noise. f. (-ना) 1 The tongue. 2 A plant, commonly Rasan. 3 A woman's girdle, a sort of chain worn round the loins. 4 A plant, (Pæderia foetida.) E. रस to sound or taste, aff. युच्; or अश to eat, युच् Uṇādi aff., and रश substituted; also रशना.
31999: रसनाथ m. (-थः) Quicksilver. E. रस juice, fluid, and नाथ chief.
32000: रसनायक m. (-कः) ŚIVA. E. रस mercury, नायक leader.
32001: रसनालिह् m. (-लिट्) A dog. E. रसना the tongue, and लिह to lick, aff. क्विप्.
32002: रसनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Loss of taste, flavour, &c. E. रस, and निवृत्ति cessation.
32003: रसनेत्रिका f. (-का) Red arsenic. E. रस mercury, नेत्र the eye, कन् added, fem. form.
32004: रसपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A preparation of mercury, a kind of muriate formed by subliming in close vessels, a mixture of sulphur, mercury, and common salt. E. रस mercury, and पुष्प flower.
32005: रसफल m. (-लः) The cocoanut tree. E. रस water or juice, and फल the fruit, the nut containing a saccharine fluid.
32006: रसभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Interruption or destruction of passion or sentiment, &c. E. रस, and भङ्ग a breaking.
32007: रसभव n. (-वं) The blood. E. रस chyle, and भव produced.
32008: रसभस्मन् n. (-स्म) Calx or oxid of mercury. E. रस, and भस्मन ashes.
32009: रसयित्वा ind. Having tasted. E. रस to taste, क्त्वाच् aff.
32010: रसराज m. (-जः) Quicksilver. E. रस a mineral, and राज sovereign.
32011: रसवत् ind. Including a secondary or subsidiary feeling or passion. E. रस, and वति aff.
32012: रसवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Juicy. 2 Well-flavoured. 3 Tasteful, applied to a composition, &c. f. (-ती) A kitchen. E. रस juice, flavour, &c., मतुप् aff.
32013: रसविक्रय m. (-यः) Selling juices or liquors, as the juice of the sugar cane, or wine, &c. E. रस juice, and विक्रय sale.
32014: रसशोधन m. (-नः) Borax. E. रस a metal, &c., and शोधन purifying; being used as a flux in refining and melting metals.
32015: रससिद्ध m. (-द्धः) An alchymist, an adept: see the next. E. रस mercury, and सिद्ध accomplished.
32016: रससिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) The knowledge of alchymy, the possession of peculiar familiarity with mercury, obtained by the performance of chemical operations conjoined with certain mystical and magical rites, and the securing thence to the adept, of happiness, health, and wealth, the power of transmuting metals, and the art of prolonging life. E. रस mercury, and सिद्धि accomplishment, especially of some supernatural object.
32017: रसान्तर n. (-रं) Change or diversion of passion or sentiment. E. रस, and अन्तर different.
32018: रससिन्दूर n. (-रं) A sort of factitious cinnabar, made with zinc, mercury, blue vitriol, and nitre, fused together; the compound is used as an escharotic. E. रस mercury, and सिन्दूर minium.
32019: रसस्थान n. (-नं) Cinnabar or vermilion. E. रस mercury, and स्थान abode.
32020: रसाखन m. (-नः) A cock. E. रसा the earth, and खन who digs or picks.
32021: रसाञ्जन n. (-नं) A sort of collyrium, prepared either with the calx of brass, or with the Amomum anthorrhiza. E. रस juice, &c., अञ्जन collyrium.
32022: रसातल n. (-लं) 1 Pātāla; the seven infernal regions under the earth, and the residence of the Nāgas, Asuras, Daityas, and other races of monstrous and demoniacal beings, under the various governments of Śeṣa, Bali, and other chiefs: this is not to be confounded with Naraka or Tartarus, the proper hell or abode of guilty mortals after death. 2 The lowest of the seven divisions of Pātāla. E. रसा the earth, and तल below, underneath.
32023: रसादान n. (-नं) 1 Sucking, suction. 2 Drying, drying up, absorbing. E. रसा water or juice, &c., आदान taking.
32024: रसाधार m. (-रः) The sun. E. रस water, आधार receptacle.
32025: रसाभास m. (-सः) Concealment of sentiment, attributing evident emotions to some cause different from the real one. E. रस sentiment, and आभास unreal exposition or display.
32026: रसाभिनिवेश m. (-शः) Accession of sentiment or passion. E. रस, and अभिनिवेश intentness.
32027: रसायक m. (-कः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum munja.)
32028: रसायन n. (-नं) 1 Alchymy, chemistry. 2 The employment of mercury in medicine. 3 A medicine preventing old age, and prolonging life, the Elixir Vitœ of the alchymists. 4 Poison. 5 Butter-milk. m. (-नः) 1 GARUḌA. 2 An anthelmintic drug commonly Vireng, (Embelia ribes?) 3 An alchymist. f. (-नी) A vessel conveying nutrition, a lacteal, an absorbent. E. रस juice, quicksilver, &c., and अयन a road, a going, &c.
32029: रसायनफला f. (-ला) Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) E. रसायन juice, abiding, and फला fruit.
32030: रसाल m. (-लः) 1 The sugar-cane. 2 The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) 3 The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) 4 The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) 5 Wheat. n. (-लं) 1 Frankincense. 2 Gum myrrh. f. (-ला) 1 The tongue. 2 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 3 A flower, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 4 A grape. 5 Curds mixed up with sugar and spices. E. रस juice, आङ् before ला to yield, aff. क.
32031: रसालसा f. (-सा) A tubular vessel of the body, a nerve, a tendon, &c.
32033: रसास्वादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Tasting, relishing. 2 Sensitive, having taste. m. (-दी) A bee. E. रस flavour, and आस्वादिन् who tastes.
32034: रसाह्व n. (-ह्वः) Turpentine, resin. E. रस juice, and आह्व appellation.
32035: रसिक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Flavoured, having taste or flavour. 2 Tasteful, as a composition, &c. 3 Having a taste for poetry, &c. 4 Sentimental. 5 Impassioned. m. (-कः) 1 A horse. 2 An elephant. 3 A libertine. f. (-का) 1 Curds with sugar and spice. 2 Molasses, the juice of the sugar-cane. 3 The tongue. 4 A woman's zone or girdle. E. रस flavour, sentiment, and ठन् aff.
32036: रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gilded, plated, washed or spread with gold, &c. 2 Sounded. 3 Having taste, or flavour, or sentiment. m. (-तः) 1 The rattling of thunder. 2 Voice, sound in general. 3 Wine, vinous liquor. E. रस to sound, aff. क्त, or रस fluid, (metal, &c,) and इतच् aff.
32037: रसितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Tasting, having tasted, or having a taste for. 2 Sounding. E. रस to have flavour, क्तवतु aff.
32038: रसिताशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 Eating or seizing with a noise or roar. 2 Drinking wine. E. रसित, and आशिन् who eats.
32039: रसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Sounding, making a noise. 2 Tasting, relishing. E. रस to sound, तृच् aff.
32040: रसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Tasting. 2 Impassioned. 3 Humorous. E. रस, and इनि aff.
32041: रसुन m. (-नः) Garlick. E. see लसुन, र being changed to ल.
32042: रसेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 Quicksilver. 2 The philosopher's stone, the touch of which turns iron to gold. E. रस a mineral, and इन्द्र best.
32043: रसोत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Production of taste or flavour. 2 Development of passion or sentiment. 3 Generation of the vital fluids. E. रस, and उत्पत्ति production.
32044: रसोन m. (-नः) A kind of garlick, (Allium ascalonicum.) E. रस flavour, taste, ऊन to be less or deficient, aff. अच्, being supposed to contain in the leaves, stalk, root, &c., every flavour except sourness; also with कन् added, रसोनक.
32045: रसोपल n. (-लं) A pearl. E. रस water, and उपला a stone.
32046: रस्न n. (-लं) Thing, substance. E. रस juice, &c., and नक् Uṇādi aff.
32047: रस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Juicy. n. (-स्यं) Blood. E. रस chyle, यत् aff.
32048: रह r. 1st cl. (रहति) r. 10th. cl. (रहयति) To quit, to leave, to forego, to lose or abandon. With वि, To be separate or away from. (इ) रहि r. 1st cl. (रंहति) To go, to move with speed.
32049: रह m. (-हः) Solitariness, privacy. E. रह to be private, अच् aff.
32050: रहण n. (-णं) Quitting, leaving. E. रह to leave, ल्युट् aff.
32051: रहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Leaving, abandoning. E. रह to leave, शतृ aff.
32052: रहस् n. subst. (-हः) 1 Solitariness, privacy. 2 Copulation. 3 A privity. 4 A religious or mystic truth. ind. or n. adv. (-हः) Solitary, private, in private, secretly, privily. E. रह to abandon, (society, &c.,) and असुन् aff., or रम to sport or play, with the same aff., and अह substituted for the radical finals.
32053: रहस m. (-सः) 1 The ocean. 2 Heaven. E. रह to leave, असच् aff.
32054: रहस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Private, secret, either fit to be concealed or occurring in secret. n. (-स्यं) A secret, a mystery, any thing hidden, recondite or mysterious. f. (-स्या) The name of a river, perhaps the Sarasvatī, from its being supposed to flow in an unknown channel. E. रहस् secret, and यत् aff.
32055: रहाट m. (-टः) 1 A counsellor, a minister. 2 A ghost, a spirit. 3 Spring. E. रह privately, अट to go, aff. अच्.
32056: रहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, quitted, abandoned. 2 Free from, devoid of. E. रह to leave, aff. क्त.
32057: रहीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Alone, solitary, in private. E. रह, and भूत been, with च्चि aug.
32058: रा r. 2nd cl. (राति) 1 To get, to gain, to receive. 2 To give.
32059: राका f. (-का) 1 Full moon, or the day of full moon. 2 A girl in whom menstruation has commenced. 3 Scab, itch. 4 The name of a river. E. रा to give, (good fortune,) क Uṇādi aff.
32060: राक्षस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Infernal, demoniacal. m. (-सः) An evil spirit, a demon, a vampire, a fiend, but who appears to be of various descriptions, and is either a powerful Titan or enemy of the gods in a superhuman or incarnate form, as RĀVAṆA and others; an attendant on KUVERA, and guardian of his treasures; or a mischievous and cruel goblin or ogre, haunting cemeteries, animating dead bodies, and devouring human beings. f. (-सी) 1 A female fiend; the female of the preceding. 2 A large tooth, a tusk. 3 A sort of perfume, commonly Cor. n. (-सं) 1 A form of marriage, the violent seizure and rape of a girl after the repulse or destruction of her relatives. 2 Surgery, cure by the knife or cautery. E. रक्ष to preserve, to be preserved, (from whom,) aff. असुन्, and अण् pleonasm added; or रक्षस् a demon, and अण् aff. of reference.
32061: राक्षसेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 The demon RĀVAṆA. 2 KUVERA. E. राक्षस a demon, and इन्द्र lord.
32062: राक्षा f. (-क्षा) Lac, the red animal dye. E. रक्ष to preserve, (colour,) अ aff., and the vowel made long.
32063: राख(ऋ)राखृ r. 1st cl. (रालति) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To suffice, to be able or competent. 4 To impede or prevent.
32064: राग m. (-गः) 1 Colour, hue, tint, dye. 2 Affection, prepossession, love, desire. 3 Mental affection in general, as sorrow, joy, &c. 4 Envy, impatience of another's success. 5 A mode of music; of which six are enumerated, viz. Bhairava, Mālava, Sāraṅga, Hindola, Vasanta, Dīpaka, and Megha; they are personified in poetry and mythology. 6 A king, a sovereign. 7 The Raja Guṇa, the property or quality of passion. 8 Greediness, cupidity. 9 Colouring, painting, dying. f. (-गा) A sort of grain, commonly Raggy, much cultivated in the south of India, (Eleusine corocana, or Cynosurus corocanus.) E. रञ्ज to colour, &c., aff. घञ्.
32065: रागचूर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A name of KĀMA. 2 A tree yielding an astringent resin or extract, the wood of which is used in dying, (Mimosa catechu.) 3 Red lead. 4 The red powder thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the vernal festival named Holī. E. राग passion or colour, and चर्ण powder.
32066: रागछन्न m. (-न्नः) RĀMA. E. राग, and छन्न covered.
32067: रागद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Colouring. 2 Inspiring passion. f. (-दा) Crystal. E. राग colour, दा to give, अङ् and टाप् affs.
32068: रागरज्जु m. (-ज्जुः) The deity of love, KĀMA. E. राग passion, desire, and रज्जु a rope.
32069: रागलता f. (-ता) The wife of KĀMADEVA. E. राग passion, desire, and लता a creeping plant.
32070: रागवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Coloured. 2 Impassioned. E. राग, and मतुप् aff.
32071: रागवृन्त mfn. (-न्तः) KĀMADEVA. E. राग passion, and वृन्त the stalk of a flower, the support.
32072: रागषाढव m. (-वः) A sweetmeat of unripe mangoes dressed with treacle and oil.
32073: रागसूत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The thread or string of a balance. 2 A string or thread of silk. 3 Any coloured thread or string. E. राग colour, and सूत्र a thread.
32074: रागान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Affected by passion. 2 Coloured. E. राग, and अन्वित possessed of.
32075: रागार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) 1 One who excites hopes and disappoints them. 2 Who or what is an object of affection. E. राग, and अर्ह fit.
32076: रागाशनि m. (-निः) A Jina or Jaina saint. E. राग passion, अश to throw (away), अनि aff.
32077: रागिन् m. (-गी-गिणी-गि) 1 Passionate, impassioned. 2 Colouring, painting. 3 Coloured, dyed. m. (-गी) 1 A dyer, a painter. 2 A libertine, a lover. f. (-णी) 1 A shrewd and intriguing woman. 2 A modification of a musical mode, of which five are assigned to each mode; in mythology, personified as a female, and the wife of the Rāga. E. राग passion, and इनि aff., or रञ्ज to colour, &c., and धिनुण् aff.
32078: राघ (ऋ,) राघृ r. 1st cl. (राघते) To be able or equal to.
32079: राघव m. (-वः) 1 A name of RĀMACANDRA. 2 A sort of fish. E. रघु the ancestor of the demigod, and अण् aff. of descent.
32081: राङ्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Woollen, made of the hair of a sort of deer or any other animal. n. (-वं) A woollen garment. E. रङ्कु a kind of deer, and अण् aff.
32082: राज (ऋ,) राजृ r. 1st cl. (राजते or irregularly रेजते) To shine: With निर् prefixed, To overcome, to subdue.
32083: राज् m. (राट्) A king, a monarch or prince. E. राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.
32084: राजक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Ruling, a ruler. 2 Splendid, irradiating, bright in itself, and the cause of brilliancy in others. n. (-कं) An assemblage of princes. E. राजन् a prince, and वुञ् aff. of multitude; or राज to shine, aff. वुन्.
32085: राजकर n. (-रं) Tax or toll imposed by the king. E. राज, and कर tribute.
32086: राजकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) A sort of Kadamba. E. राज royal, कदम्ब Nauclea.
32087: राजकशेरु m. (-रुः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) E. राज royal, कशेरु scirpus.
32088: राजकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Royal duties, state affairs. E. राज, and कार्य्यं act.
32089: राजकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Royal, kingly. E. राजन a king, क substituted for the final, and छ aff.
32090: राजकुल n. (-लं) A royal race. m. (-लः) A prince, a king. E. राज, and कुल family.
32091: राजकुष्माण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. राज royal, and कुष्माण्ड a gourd.
32092: राजकृत्वन् m. (-त्वा) A king-maker, one who raises him to the throne, &c. E. राजन्, and कृ to make, क्वनिप् aff.
32093: राजगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going to the prince or ruler, devolving or falling to the king, (as property, &c. to which there are no heirs.) E. राज the king, and गामिन् what goes.
32094: राजगुरु m. (-रुः) The king's spiritual preceptor. E. राज a king, and गुरु preceptor.
32095: राजग्रीव m. (-वः) A sort of flat fresh water fish, commonly Phalai. E. राज shining, ग्रीव the neck.
32096: राजघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Sharp, hot. m. (-घः) A king-killer, a slayer of sovereigns, a regicide. E. राज a king, and घ for घ्न, who kills.
32097: राजचिह्नक n. (-कं) The male or female organs of generation. E. राज chief, चिह्न mark, and कन् aff.
32098: राजजक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption. E. राज royal, principal, and जक्ष्मन् for यक्ष्मन् consumption; also राजयक्ष्मन्.
32099: राजजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 1 A large kind of eugenia or rose apple. 2 A sort of date tree. E. राज royal, and जम्बू Eugenia.
32100: राजत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Silver, made of silver, &c. E. रजत silver, and अञ् aff.
32101: राजतान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Plated, inlaid. E. राजत, and अन्वित having.
32102: राजताल m. (-लः) The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.) E. राज royal, and ताल palm.
32103: राजतिमिष m. (-षः) A cucumber. E. राज royal, and तिमिष a kind of gourd; it is also read राजतेमिष.
32104: राजतेजस् n. (-जः) Majesty, kingly dignity. E. राज, and तेजस् splendor.
32105: राजत्व n. (-त्वं) Sovereignty, royalty. E. राज a king, त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल्, राजता.
32106: राजदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 1 Punishment ordered by the king. 2 A baton, a sceptre. E. राज, and दण्ड a staff, &c.
32107: राजदन्त m. (-न्तः) An upper and foretooth, applied to the two middle ones. E. राज royal, and दन्त tooth.
32108: राजदर्शन n. (-नं) A levee, an audience. E. राज, and दर्शन seeing.
32109: राजदेशीय m. (-यः) A petty prince or chief, one something less than a king. E. राज a king, and देशीयर् aff. implying something less or defective, or with देश्य aff. of the same power, राजदेश्य m. (-श्यः).
32110: राजद्वार n. (-रं) The gate of the palace. E. राज for राजा king, द्वार gate.
32111: राजद्रोह m. (-हः) 1 Oppression, tyranny. 2 Rebellion. E. राज, द्रोह violence.
32112: राजद्रोहिन् m. (-ही) A rebel, a traitor. E. राजद्रोह, and इनि aff.
32113: राजधन n. (-नं) Royal revenue or right to property. E. राज, and धन wealth.
32114: राजधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Royal duty. 2 The duty of the military tribe. E. राज, and धर्म्म duty.
32115: राजधर्म्मविटु m. (-वित्) A statesman, one who knows the duties of royalty. E. राजधर्म्म, and विटु who knows.
32116: राजधान mf. (-नं-नी) A royal city, a capital, a metropolis. E. राज a king, धान holding, containing; also with कन् added in the n. or f. (राजधानकं-राजधानिका.)
32117: राजधान्य n. (-न्यं) A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum, Rox.) E. राज royal, धान्य grain.
32118: राजधुरा f. (-रा) Royal state or function, government. E. राज, and धुरा a load.
32119: राजन् m. (-जा) 1 A king, a prince, a sovereign. 2 A soldier by birth, a man of the regal and military tribe. 3 A master. 4 The moon. 5 A Yakṣa. 6 INDRA. 7 (In composition,) Royal, denoting eminence or excellence. f. (-ज्ञी) 1 A queen, a princess, the wife of a king. 2 The wife of the sun. 3 Deepcoloured brass, consisting of three parts of copper to one of zinc or tin. E. राज to shine, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्.
32120: राजनय m. (-यः) Polity. E. राज, and नय conduct: see the next.
32121: राजनीति f. (-तिः) Regal polity, civil and military government. E. राज, and नीति polity.
32122: राजनील n. (-लं) The emerald. E. राज royal, and नील blue.
32123: राजन्य m. (-न्यः) 1 A Kṣatriya, a man of the military or regal tribe. 2 A name of AGNI or fire. 3 A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.) E. राज to shine, अन्य Uṇādi aff., or राजन् a king, and यत् aff.
32124: राजन्यक n. (-कं) A number of Kṣatriyas or men of the military tribe. E. राजन्य a soldier, वुञ् aff.
32125: राजन्वत् mfn. (-न्वान्-न्वती-न्वत्) Possessing or governed by a just and active monarch, (a country, &c.) E. राजन् a king, (or by distinction a good king,) and मतुप् poss. aff., form irr.
32126: राजपटोल m. (-लः) A kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. राज royal, and पटोल the same; also with कन् added, राजपटोलक.
32127: राजपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) 1 A gem, said to be an inferior kind of diamond brought from Viraśa Deśa, a country in the north-west of India. 2 A tiara or royal fillet. E. र ज a king, and पट्ट a bandage, worn in the tiara or diadem of a prince.
32128: राजपत्नी f. (-त्नी) A queen. E. राज, and पत्नी wife.
32129: राजपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 The planet MERCURY. 2 A Kṣatriya or man of the military tribe. 3 A soldier by profession, but one of a mixed birth or fabulous origin. 4 The son of a king, a prince. f. (-त्त्री) 1 Arabian jasmine. 2 A bitter gourd. 3 The musk shrew. 4 A kind of brass or bell-metal. 5 A princess. 6 A woman of the Rajput tribe. E. राज a king or the moon, and पुत्त्र a son, a child.
32130: राजपुत्त्रिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of bird. 2 A king's daughter. E. राज a king, and पुत्त्र a child, कन् aff., fem. form.
32131: राजपुरुष m. (-षः) A guard, a watchman, a constable, &c. E. राज, and पुरुष a man.
32132: राजपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. राज a king, and पुष्प a flower.
32133: राजफणिञ्झक m. (-कः) The orange tree. E. राज royal, and फणिञ्झक a sort of lime.
32134: राजफल n. (-लं) A cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.) E. राज royal, and फल fruit.
32135: राजबदर n. (-रं) 1 A plant, (a sort of Justicia.) 2 Salt. m. (-रः) The jujube. E. राज royal, and बदर the jujube.
32137: राजभद्रक n. (-कं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus) E. राज royal, and भद्रक auspicious.
32138: राजभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Belonging to or claimed by the king. E. राज, and भाज् who shares.
32139: राजभूय n. (-यं) Royalty, sovereignty. E. राज a king, and भूष condition of being.
32140: राजभृत्य m. (-त्यः) A courtier, a servant of the king, any public officer. E. राज, and भृत्य a servant.
32141: राजभोग्य m. (-ग्यः) A tree, (Chironjia sapida, or Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) n. (-ग्यं) Mace. E. राज royal, and भोग्य enjoyment.
32142: राजमण्डूक m. (-कः) A large kind of frog. E. राज a king, and मण्डूक a frog.
32143: राजमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A king's wrestler. E. राज a king, and मल्ल a wrestler.
32144: राजमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A royal road, one passable for horses and elephants, and forty cubits broad. E. राज a king, and मार्ग a road.
32145: राजमाष m. (-षः) A kind of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) E. राज royal, and माष a sort of kidney-bean.
32146: राजमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus.) E. राज royal, and मुद्ग P. mungo.
32147: राजयक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) Pulmonary consumption. E. राज chief, and यक्ष्मन् phthisis.
32148: राजयुध्वन् m. (-ध्वा) An enemy, a rebel, one making war against a prince. E. राज, युध to make war, क्वनिप् aff.
32149: राजयोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Proper or suitable for a sovereign, princely, royal. E. राज a king, and योग्य what is fit for.
32150: राजरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Silver. E. राज royal, and रङ्ग tin.
32151: राजराज m. (-जः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 An emperor, a universal monarch, or king of kings. 3 The moon. E. राज a king, (of a king or kings,) or a Yakṣa, and राज sovereign.
32152: राजर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A kind of saint; that holy and superhuman personage which a king or man of the military class may become by the practice of religious austerities; seven classes of Ṛṣis are enumerated, the Devarṣi, Brahmarṣi, Maharṣi, Paramarṣi, Rājarṣi, Kāṇḍarṣi, and Śrutarṣi: the order is variously given, but the Rājarṣi is inferior to the four preceding ones, and the two last mean the inspired saints and supposed authors of the Hindu scriptures. E. राज king, and ऋषि a saint.
32153: राजलक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Royal insignia. 2 Any natural mark indicating royalty. E. राज, and लक्षण mark.
32154: राजलक्ष्मन् m. (-क्ष्मा) A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. राज royal, लक्ष्मन् a mark or symbol.
32155: राजलेख m. (-खः) A royal letter or order. E. राज, and लेख a writing; also राजलेख्यं, &c.
32156: राजवंश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Of royal parentage or descent. E. राज royal, and वंश family, यत् aff.
32157: राजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Governed by a just and able monarch, (a country, &c.) 2 Royal, kingly. E. राज a king, and मतुप् aff.
32158: राजवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) A royal or main road. E. राज a king, and वर्त्मन् a road.
32159: राजवला f. (-ला) A plant, (Pæderia foetida.) E. राज a king, and वल surrounding.
32160: राजवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A small gourd, (Momordica charantia.) राज royal, and वल्ली a creeper.
32161: राजवसति f. (-तिः) 1 A throne. 2 A palace. E. राज, and वसति abode.
32162: राजवाह m. (-हः) A horse. E. राज a king, and वाह a vehicle.
32163: राजवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) A royal elephant. E. राज a king, and वाह्य a vehicle.
32164: राजवि m. (-विः) The blue jay. E. राज, and वि a bird.
32165: राजवीजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Springing from a royal race. E. राज a king, वीज seed, and इनि aff.
32166: राजवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The Piyāl tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) 2 A sort of tree, (Cassia fistula.) 3 Euphorbia of various kinds. E. राज royal, and वृक्ष a tree.
32167: राजशन m. (-नः) A plant, from the fibres of which a coarse cordage and canvas are prepared, (Corchorus capsularis or olitorius.) E. राज royal, and शन Crotolaria.
32168: राजशफर m. (-रः) The Iliśa or Hilsa fish, (Clupanodon Ilisha, HAM.) E. राज king, and शफर another sort of fish.
32169: राजशय्या f. (-य्या) A royal seat or throne. E. राज a king, and शय्या a bed or couch.
32170: राजशासन n. (-नं) 1 A royal edict. 2 A royal badge. E. राज, and शासन an edict.
32171: राजशुक m. (-कः) A sort of parrot, (Psittacus Lori.) E. राज royal, and शुक a parrot.
32172: राजशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The royal Catta or umbrella. m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus batachus.) E. राज royal, and शृङ्ग a horn.
32173: राजस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to, or derived, &c. from the quality of passion. f. (-सी) 1 The goddess DURGĀ. 2 The state of being in this world or the next, in which the Raja Guṇa or quality of passion predominates: it is divided into three classes; the first class comprises the Gandharbas, Yakṣas, Guhyakas, &c.; the second, kings and heroes; and the third, boxers, wrestlers, gamblers, tipplers, actors, &c. E. रजस् the quality of passion, अण् and ङीप् affs.
32174: राजसत्ता f. (-त्ता) Majesty, royal dignity. E. राज, and सत्ता existence.
32175: राजसदन n. (-नं) A palace. E. राज a king, and सदन a dwelling.
32176: राजसर्प m. (-र्पः) A large kind of snake, (Boa.) E. राज, and सर्प a snake; the king of snakes.
32177: राजसभा f. (-भा) A royal assembly or court. E. राज a king, and सभा assembly.
32178: राजसर्षप m. (-पः) 1 Mustard, (Sinapis dichotoma, or S. ramosa, Rox.) 2 A mustard seed, as a measure of weight. E. राज royal, and सर्षप mustard.
32179: राजसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) Royalty, sovereignty. E. राज a king, सायुज्य state.
32180: राजसारस m. (-सः) A peacock. E. राज royal, and सारम the Indian crane.
32181: राजसिंह m. (-हः) A great king. E. राज, and सिंह a lion.
32182: राजसूय n. (-यं) 1 A sacrifice performed only by a universal monarch, attended by his tributary princes; as in the case of YUDHIṢṬHIRA, and others. 2 A lotus. 3 A mountain. 4 A sort of rice. E. राज a king, (by him,) and षू to be produced, to be effected, aff. क्यप्; or राज the moon, for the moon plant, of which the acid juice is drank at the ceremony, and सु to bring forth, the same aff., deriv. irr.
32183: राजसूयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a royal sacrifice. E. कन added to the last.
32184: राजसूययाजिन् m. (-जी) A priest officiating at the royal sacrifice. E. राजसूय, and याजिन् who sacrifices.
32185: राजसेवक m. (-कः) A courtier, a royal attendant. E. राज, and सेवक a servant.
32186: राजस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A horse. E. राज a king, and स्कन्ध the shoulder.
32187: राजस्व n. (-स्वं) Royal revenue, impost, duty, tax. E. राज, and स्व own.
32188: राजहंस m. (-सः) 1 A white goose with red legs and bill, or more properly perhaps the flamingo. 2 A drake. 3 An excellent king. E. राज, and हंस a goose, the king goose.
32189: राजहर्षण n. (-णं) A city, a town. E. राज a king, and हर्षण delighting.
32190: राजहस्तिन् m. (-ली) A royal elephant. E. राज a king, and हस्तिन् an elephant.
32191: राजहासक m. (-कः) A sort of large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus.) E. राज a king, हासक diverting, pleasing.
32192: राजाज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) A royal edict or command. E. राज, and आज्ञा order.
32193: राजातन m. (-नः) A tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) E. राज a king, and आङ् before तन to stretch, aff. अच्.
32194: राजादन m. (-नः) 1 A tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) 2 Another tree, (Mimusops kauki.) 3 The Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.) E. राज a king, and अदन eating; also राजातन, and राजादनफल.
32195: राजाधिराज m. (-जः) A paramount sovereign. E. राजा, and अधिराज superior prince.
32196: राजान्न m. (-न्नः) A sort of rice, of a superior quality, said to grow in the Āndhra country. E. राज, and अन्न food.
32197: राजाम्र m. (-म्रः) A superior sort of mango. E. राज royal, अम्र mango.
32198: राजार्क m. (-र्कः) Gigantic swallow wort. (Asclepias gigantea, with white flowers.) E. राज royal, and अर्क swallow wort.
32199: राजार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Royal, noble, fit or proper for a king. n. (-र्हं) Aloe wood, (Amyris agallocha, Rox.) E. राज a sovereign, and अर्ह proper.
32200: राजालुक m. (-कः) An esculent root, a sort of yam. E. राज royal, आलु a yam, कन् added.
32201: राजावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A gem, described as an inferior kind of diamond, brought from the country Virāṭa. E. राज a king, आवर्त्तं a turning; it is considered as a lucky possession for princes, though not esteemed as an ornament.
32202: राजावलि f. (-लिः-ली) A line of kings, a royal dynasty or genealogy. E. राज, and आवली a line.
32203: राजाहि m. (-हिः) A sort of snake said to be two-headed. E. राज royal, and अहि a snake.
32204: राजि f. (-जिः-जी) 1 A row, a line. 2 An unbroken row, a continuous line. 3 A small vessel of the body. E. राज to shine, इज् Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
32205: राजिका f. (-का) 1 Black mustard, (Sinapis racemosa, Rox.) 2 A field. 3 A line, a row, a range. 4 A continuous or unbroken line. E. राज to shine, क्वुन् aff., fem. form, or राजि as above, and कन् added.
32206: राजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Adorned, embellished. 2 Illuminated, irradiated. E. राज to shine, क्त aff.
32207: राजिल m. (-लः) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.) E. राजि a line, and लच् aff.
32208: राजीव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Attending on or living about a prince. m. (-वः) 1 A large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus, BUC.) 2 A kind of deer. 3 An elephant. n. (-वं) A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.) E. राजी a line, a row, व aff.
32209: राजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) An emperor. E. राज, and इन्द्र chief.
32210: राजेभ m. (-भः) A state elephant. E. राज, and इभ an elephant.
32211: राज्य n. (-ज्यं) 1 A government, a country, a principality, a kingdom. 2 Administration or exercise of sovereignty or government. E. राज for राजन् a prince, and यत् or यक् aff.
32212: राज्यच्युत m. (-तः) A prince who has lost his kingdom. E. राज्य, and च्युत fallen from.
32213: राज्यच्युति f. (-तिः) Deposal, loss of sovereignty. E. राज्य, and च्युति falling.
32214: राज्यधुरा f. (-रा) Administration, government. E. राज्य, and धुरा burthen.
32215: राज्यभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Subversion of a sovereignty. E. राज्य, and भङ्ग a breaking.
32216: राज्यभाज् m. (-भाक्) A king. E. राज्य, and भाज् who has.
32217: राज्यभ्रंश m. (-शः) Deposal or loss of a kingdom. E. राज्य, and भ्रंश falling.
32218: राज्यभ्रष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A deposed sovereign. E. राज्य, and म्रष्ट fallen.
32219: राज्यरक्षा f. (-क्षा) Protection or defence of a kingdom. E. राज्य, and रक्षा preservation.
32220: राज्यलोभ m. (-भः) Ambition. E. राज्य, and लोभ desire.
32221: राज्याङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A requisite of regal administration; variously enumerated, as seven, eight, or nine, viz. first, the monarch; second, the prime minister; third, a friend or ally; fourth, treasure; fifth, territory; sixth, a strong hold; and seventh, an army; the eighth is the population or companies of citizens, and the ninth the Purohita or spiritual adviser. E. राज्य royalty, and अङ्ग limb or part.
32222: राज्याधिकार m. (-रः) 1 Government of a kingdom. 2 Right or title to a sovereignty. E. राज्य, and अधिकार superintendence, &c.
32223: राटि f. (-टिः) War, battle. E. रट to speak, to sound, aff. इञ्.
32224: राढा f. (-ढा) 1 Beauty, splendour, light, lustre. 2 A country or district, part of Bengal west of the Hugli river. E. रह to quit, aff. घञ्, and ह changed to ढ.
32225: राण n. (-णं) 1 A leaf. 2 A peacock's tail. E. रण to sound, aff. घञ्.
32226: रात्रक n. (-कं) A period of five nights collectively. m. (-कः) A man who takes up his abode in a harlot's house for one year. E. रात्रि night, and कन् aff.
32227: रात्रि f. (-त्रिः-त्री) Night. E. रा to give, (pleasure or rest,) त्रिप् Uṇādi aff., ङीप् optionally added.
32228: रात्रिचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going or moving at night. m. (-रः) 1 A goblin, a fiend, a ghost or evil spirit. 2 A thief, a robber. 3 A guard, a patrole. E. रात्रि night, (by night,) and चर who goes.
32229: रात्रिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Nocturnal, born or produced at night. n. (-जं) A star, a constellation. E. रात्रि night, and ज born.
32230: रात्रिजल n. (-लं) Dew, mist, fog. E. रात्रि night, and जल water.
32231: रात्रिजागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Keeping watch at night, sitting up at night. m. (-रः) A dog. E. रात्रि night, and जागर who wakes.
32232: रात्रिजागरण n. (-णं) Sitting up all night. E. रात्रि, and जागरण waking.
32233: रात्रिजागरद m. (-दः) A musquito, a gnat. E. रात्रिजागर waking by night, and द who gives or makes, from दा to give, or from दो to cut, who stings.
32234: रात्रिञ्चर m. (-रः) A ghost, a goblin. E. रात्रि night, चर to go, ट aff., and मुम् augment; also रात्रिचर.
32235: रात्रिमट m. (-टः) 1 A ghost, a goblin. 2 A theif. 3 A guard. 4 A night-walker. E. रात्रि night, अट to go, aff. अच्, and मुम् augment.
32236: रात्रिमणि m. (-णिः) The moon. E. रात्रि night, and मणि a jewel.
32237: रात्रिम्मन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Thinking it night. E. रात्रि, and मन्य who believes, खच् aff.
32238: रात्रियोग m. (-गः) Coming on of night. E. रात्रि, and योग joining.
32239: रात्रिवासस् n. (-सः) Darkness. E. रात्रि night, and वासस् vesture.
32240: रात्रिविगम m. (-मः) Dawn, day-light. E. रात्रि night, विगम stop, cessation.
32241: रात्रिविश्लेषगामिन् m. (-मी) The ruddy goose. E. रात्रि night, विश्लेष separation, and गामिन् who goes, these birds being supposed to pass the night apart.
32242: रात्रिवेद m. (-दः) A cock. E. रात्रि the night, and वेद who knows, who knows its measure or duration.
32243: रात्रिवेदिन् m. (-दी) A cock. E. रात्रि night, and वेदिन् who knows: see the last.
32244: रात्रिहास m. (-सः) The white lotus. E. रात्रि night, and हास what smiles, blossoming at night.
32245: रात्रिहिण्डक m. (-कः) A guard of the interior or women's apartments. E. रात्रि night, हिडि to go, क्वुन् aff.
32246: रात्र्यट m. (-टः) 1 An imp, a goblin. 2 A ghost. 3 A thief. 4 A night-walker. E. रात्रि night, अट to go, aff. अच्; also with a nasal inserted, रात्रिमट.
32247: राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Cooked, dressed. 2 Perfected, as a religious vow; observed, as a fast, &c. 3 Perfect, in mysterious or magical power, adept, initiated. 4 Perfect in general, accomplished; finished, complete, mature, &c. E. राध to accomplish or be accomplished, aff. क्त.
32248: राद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) Demonstrated truth, proved and established fact or conclusion. E. राद्ध established, अन्त end, result.
32249: राध (औ) औराध r. 4th cl. (राध्यति) 5th cl. (राध्नोति) 1 To bring any thing to fulness or completion, to finish, to effect, to accomplish, to complete. 2 To attain completion, to succeed, to be finished or accomplished. With अप prefixed, To offend, to be in fault. With आङ्, To worship, to propitiate by worship.
32250: राध m. (-धः) The month Vaiśākha, (April-May.) f. (-धा) 1 The asterism, in which the moon is full in the month Vaiśākha; the sixteenth of the Nakṣatras, containing four stars in the shape of a festoon; the stars are supposed to be a v i Libra,  and Scorpionis. 2 A celebrated Gopī, the favourite mistress of KṚṢṆA, during his residence in Vṛndāvana amongst the cow-herds. 3 Lightning. 4 An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. 5 Emblic myrobalan. 6 A flower, (Clitoria ternata.) E. राध to accomplish, aff. अ, टाप् fem. aff., or राधा the asterism, अण् aff. of reference.
32251: राधन n. (-नं) 1 Completing, accomplishing, succeeding, effecting. 2 Obtaining, acquisition. 3 Pleasure, satisfaction. 4 The means or instrument of accomplishing any thing. f. (-ना) Speech, speaking. E. राध to accomplish, aff. युच्.
32252: राधरङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A plough. 2 Thin rain. 3 Hail.
32253: राधाकान्त m. (-न्तः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. राधा, and कान्त beloved.
32254: राधातनय m. (-यः) KARṆA. E. राधा, and तनय son; see राधासुत.
32255: राधानाथ m. (-थः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. राधा, and नाथ lord.
32256: राधापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) KARṆA E. राधा, and पुत्त्र son: see राधासुत.
32257: राधाभेदिन् m. (-दी) A name of ARJUNA. E. राधा the mistress of KṚṢṆA, and भेदिन् dividing; having prevailed on KṚṢṆA to abandon her.
32258: राधावल्लभ m. (-भः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. राधा, and वल्लभ beloved.
32259: राधावेधिन् m. (-धी) ARJUNA. E. राधा the mistress of KṚṢṆA, and वेधिन् who hurts or wounds: see राधाभेदिन्.
32260: राधासुत m. (-तः) KARṆA. E. राधा the name of the wife of the charioteer of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, by whom the prince, after exposure by his own mother KUNTĪ, was found and fostered, and सुत a son.
32261: राधेय m. (-यः) A name of KARṆA. E. राधा a proper name, and ढक् aff.: see राधासुत.
32262: राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be said or spoken. E. रप to speak, aff. ण्यत्.
32263: राम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Black. 2 White. 3 Beautiful, pleasing. m. (-मः) 1 A name common to three incarnations of VIṢṆU, or PARAŚURĀMA, the son of the Muni JAMADAGNI, born at the commencement of the second or Tretā Yug, for the purpose of punishing the tyrannical kings of the Kṣatriya race; RĀMACANDRA, the son of DAŚARATHA, king of Oude, born at the close of the second age, to destroy the demons who infested the earth, and especially RĀVAṆA the Daitya sovereign of Ceylon; and BALARĀMA, the elder and half-brother of KṚṢṆA, the son of ROHIṆĪ, born at the end of the Dvāpara or third age. 2 A name of VARUṆA, regent of the waters. 3 A horse. 4 A sort of deer. f. (-मा) 1 A woman, a female, a pleasing or beautiful female. 2 Asafoetida. 3 A river. n. (-मं) 1 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) 2 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. रम to sport, aff. घञ्.
32264: रामकरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the musical modes. E. राम delighting, and करी who makes; also रामकली.
32265: रामकर्पूर m. (-रः) A fragrant sort of grass. E. राम pleasant, and कर्पूर (smelling like) camphor.
32266: रामकली f. (-ली) A Rāgiṇī. E. राम pleasant, कला sound or note, ङीप् aff.
32267: रामगिरि m. (-रिः) The name of a mountain, variously applied, but especially assigned to a mountain called Compteh or Citrakūṭa in Bundelkund, and to another near Nagpore, called now Rāmtek. E. राम the hero, and गिरि a mountain, the mountain of RĀMA; being one of his halting places in his progress from Oude to the Peninsula.
32268: रामचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The hero RĀMACANDRA, the second incarnation of VIṢṆU under the name of RĀMA. E. राम, and चन्द्र the moon, the moon-like RĀMA.
32269: रामजननी f. (-नी) The mother of BALARĀMA. E. राम, and जननी mother; hence it is equally applicable to REṆUKĀ, the mother of PARAŚURĀMA, and to KAUŚALYĀ, the mother of RĀMACANDRA.
32270: रामठ n. (-ठं) Asafoetida. E. रम to please, अठ Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel lengthened.
32271: रामणीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Beautiful, pleasing. E. रमणीय the same, and वुञ् aff.
32272: रामदूत m. (-तः) The monkey HANUMĀN, the friend and messenger of RĀMA. f. (-तिः-ती) A shrub, apparently a variety of basil with small leaves. E. राम RĀMA, and दूत a messenger.
32273: रामपूग m. (-गः) A small species of the areca or betel-nut tree, (Areca triandra, Rox.) E. राम RAMA, and पूग areca.
32274: रामभद्र m. (-द्रः) The hero RĀMACANDRA. E. राम the same, and भद्र auspicious.
32275: रामवीणा f. (-णा) A sort of Vīṇā or lute. E. राम RAMA, and वीणा a lute; it may be also ironically applicable to the horn blown by BALARĀMA, and called still the Rāmsinh.
32276: रामशर m. (-रः) A variety of the Saccharum Sara, a sort of grass. E. राम RĀMA, and शर the Sara.
32277: रामसख m. (-खः) The monkey king SUGRĪVA. E. राम RĀMA, and सख friend; RĀMA having restored him to his throne, whence he had been driven by another monkey chief BALI.
32278: रामायण n. (-णं) 1 The first epic poem of the Hindus, recording the adventures of RĀMA the son of DAŚARATHA, sovereign of Oude; written by the poet VĀLMIKI. 2 A name of several poems on the life and adventures of RĀMA. E. राम the prince so named, and अयन abode.
32279: रामिल m. (-लः) 1 KĀMA or CUPID. 2 A lover, a husband. E. राम pleasing, agreeable, इलच् aff.
32280: राम्भ m. (-म्भः) The bambu, staff of a religious student. E. रम्भा a bambu, aff. अञ्.
32281: रायण n. (-णं) 1 Pain. 2 Sounding, crying, making a noise. E. रै to sound, aff. ल्युट्.
32282: रायभाटी f. (-टी) The current or flow of a river.
32283: रारस्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Crying aloud and repeatedly. E. रस to cry, reit. v., शानच् aff.
32284: राल m. (-लः) Resin, the resinous and fragrant exudation of the Shorea robusta. E. रा to give or get, aff. अलच्; also अराल.
32285: राव n. (-वः) Sound, noise. E. रु to cry or sound, aff. घञ्.
32286: रावण m. (-णः) The sovereign of Laṅkā or Ceylon, killed by RĀMACANDRA. n. (-णं) Noise, tumult. E. रु to cry (in the causal form), aff. ल्युट्, afflicting mankind.
32287: रावणारि m. (-रिः) The hero RĀMA. E. रावण RĀVAṆA, and अरि the foe.
32288: रावणि m. (-णिः) The eldest son of RĀVAṆA. E. रावण, and इञ् patronymic aff.
32289: राश (ऋ,) राशृ r. 1st and 4th cls. (राशते राश्यते) To sound.
32290: राशि m. (-शिः) 1 A heap, a quantity. 2 A sign of the zodiac. 3 Arithmetical or algebraic quantity. 4 A part and its divisor, or numerator and denominator. 5 A congeries of number or quantity. E. अश to pervade, इण् Uṇādi aff. and रुट् initial augment; or रश to sound, with the same aff.
32291: राशिगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heaped, accumulated. 2 Computed, summed either by arithmetic or algebra. E. राशि, and गत gone to.
32292: राशिचक्र n. (-क्रं) The zodiac. E. राशि a sign, and चक्र a wheel or circle.
32293: राशिभाग m. (-गः) A fraction. E. राशि, and भाग a part.
32294: राशिभोग m. (-गः) Passage of a planet through a sign of the zodiac. E. राशि, भोग enjoyment.
32295: राशीकरण n. (-णं) Heaping, piling, gathering. E. राशि, and करण making, च्चि augment.
32296: राशीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, piled, gathered. E. राशि, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
32297: राशीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Heaped, piled. E. राशि, and भूत become, च्चि aug.
32298: राष्ट्र mn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्रं) 1 An inhabited country or realm, a region. 2 Any public calamity, as plague, famine, &c. E. राज to shine or govern, aff. ष्ट्रन्.
32299: राष्ट्रनिवासिन् m. (-सी) An inhabitant of any civilized country. E. राष्ट्र a district, and निवासिन a dweller.
32300: राष्ट्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to or inhabiting a country. f. (-का) A prickly sort of night-shade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. राष्ट्र a country, and ठन् aff.
32301: राष्ट्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of or belonging to a kingdom, produced or born in it, &c. E. राष्ट्र a region, and घ aff.
32302: राष्ट्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to a region or realm. m. (-यः) A king's brother-in-law, (in theatrical language.) E. राष्ट्र a region, छ aff.
32303: रास (ऋ) रासृ r. 1st cl. (रासते) To sound.
32304: रास m. (-सः) 1 Confused noise, uproar, hubbub. 2 Sound in general. 3 Speech, discourse. 4 A chain. 5 A festival amongst the cowherds, including songs and dances, especially the circular dance as performed by KṚṢṆA and the Gopīs or cowherdesses. 6 A game played by children. E. रस to sound, घञ् aff.
32305: रासभ m. (-भः) An ass. f. (-भी) The she ass. E. रास to sound, अभच् Uṇādi aff.
32306: रासभधूसर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Grey or light-brown, ass-grey. E. रासभ and धूसर grey.
32307: रासभवन्दिनी f. (-नी) Arabian jasmine. E. रासभ an ass, वदि to praise, aff. णिनि.
32308: रासयात्रा f. (-त्रा) A festival in honour of KṚṢṆA on the full moon of Kārttika. E. रास, and यात्रा festival.
32309: रासेरस m. (-सः) 1 An assembly, a company, a party. 2 A game or festival peculiar to the cowherds: see रास. 3 Love, desire, the passion or sentiment. 4 Alchymy: see रससिद्धि. 5 The sixth night after delivery, on which the family and friends sit up all night. 6 Sport, mirth, pastime. 7 Any festival or holiday. E. रास noise, &c., and रस flavour, taste.
32310: रास्ना f. (-स्ना) 1 A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) 2 Another plant, (the serpent ophioxylon ?) 3 A sort of perfume. E. स्स to sound, नक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
32311: राहु m. (-हुः) The ascending node; in mythology, the son of SIṂHIKĀ, a Daitya, with the tail of a dragon, whose head was severed from his body by VIṢṆU, but being immortal, the head and tail retained their separate existence, and being transferred to the stellar sphere, became the authors of eclipses; the first especially, by endeavouring at various times to swallow the sun and moon. E. रह to abandon, (the planets which it has vainly attempted to devour,) aff. उ, and the vowel made long.
32312: राहुग्रस्त m. (-स्तः) Eclipsed, (as the sun or moon.) E. राहु, and ग्रस्त seized.
32313: राहुग्रास m. (-सः) Immersion of a planet in an eclipse. E. राहु, and ग्रास mouthful.
32314: राहुग्राह m. (-हः) An eclipse of the sun or moon. E. राहु the dragon's head, and ग्राह seizure.
32315: राहुभेदिन् m. (-दी) VIṢṆU. E. राहु the Daitya, भेदिन् the divider.
32316: राहुमूर्द्धभिद् m. (-भिद्) VIṢṆU. E. राहु the Daitya, मूर्द्ध the head, and भिट् who divides, who decapitates.
32317: राहुलसू m. (-सूः) A name of the legislator Buddha or Śākyasiṃha.
32318: राहुसंस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) An eclipse. E. राहु the dragon's head, and संस्पर्श seizure, contact.
32319: राहुहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. राहु the Daitya, and हन् destroyer.
32320: राहूच्छिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Garlick. E. राहु the demon, उच्छिष्ट vomited.
32321: राहूत्सृष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Garlick. E. राहू the Daitya, and उत्सृष्ट created.
32322: रि r. 5th cl. (रिणोति) To hurt or injure. r. 6th cl. (रियति) To go, to move.
32323: रि m. (रिः) 1 The tone of voice by which the note Ṛṣabha is uttered. 2 Dancing, tumbling. 3 Waste, loss. f. (रिः) Wish, desire. 4 Light, lustre. E. रा to give, &c. aff. कि.
32324: रिक n. (-कं) 1 The heart, the mind. 2 Law, litigation. E. रिच to divide, &c., aff. क.
32325: रिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Empty, void. 2 Poor, indigent. 3 Unloaded, unburthened. 4 Purged. n. (-क्तं) 1 A wood, a forest. 2 A vacuity, a vacuum. f. (-क्ता) The fourth, ninth, or fourteenth days of the lunar fortnight. E. रिच to void by stool, aff. क्त.
32326: रिक्तक m. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Void, empty. 2 Unladen, unburthened. E. कन् added to the preceding.
32327: रिक्तता f. (-ता) Vacuity, void, space. E. रिक्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रिक्तत्वं.
32328: रिक्तभाण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Having no vessels or effects. n. (-ण्डं) An empty vessel. E. रिक्त, and भाण्ड vessel.
32329: रिक्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Empty-handed. E. रिक्त, and हस्त hand.
32330: रिक्थ n. (-क्यं) Substance, property, wealth. E. रिच् to separate, Uṇādi aff. थक्.
32331: रिक्थहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिनी-रि) Taking or inheriting property. m. (-री) 1 An heir, one who succeeds to the property of the deceased, and gives the funeral cake. 2 A maternal uncle. 3 The seed of the Indian fig. E. रिक्थ wealth, and हारिन् who takes.
32332: रिक्थिन् mfn. (-क्थी-क्थिनी-क्थि) Wealthy, possessing property. m. (-क्थी) A successor or an heir. E. रिक्थ wealth, and इनि aff.
32333: रिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 A nit. 2 A mote in a sun-beam. E. see लिक्षा, ल being changed to र.
32334: रिख r. 1st cl. (रिखति) To go, to move.
32335: रिख (इ) रिखि r. 1st cl. (रिंखति) To go, to move.
32336: रिग (इ) रिगि r. 1st cl. (रिंगति) To go, to move.
32337: रिङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 1 Disappointing, deceiving. 2 A horse's hoof. 3 One of a horse's paces. 4 Dancing. 5 Sliding, slipping. E. रिखि to go, aff. अच्.
32338: रिङ्खण n. (-णं) Slipping, sliding, stumbling, tumbling; or figuratively, deviating from rectitude or virtue. E. रिखि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
32339: रिङ्गण n. (-णं) 1 Creeping, (as a child on all fours.) 2 Tumbling, slipping, sliding. 3 Deviating from rectitude, sliding from virtue. E. रिगि to go, aff. ल्युट्.
32340: रिच r. 1st and 10 cls. (रेचति-रेचयति) To join, to unite. 2 To divide, to scatter or separate. 3 To purge. (औइर्) औ रिचिर r. 7th cl. (रिणक्ति-रिंक्ते) To purge, to evacuate fæces frequently. With अति prefixed, To exceed, to be more than enough. With वि, To purge.
32342: रिटि f. (-टिः) 1 The crackling or roaring of flame. 2 A musical instrument. 3 Black salt.
32343: रिपु m. (-पुः) An enemy. E. रप to speak, to abuse, aff. उ, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
32344: रिपुघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Killing a foe. f. (-नी) A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) E. रिपु an enemy, and घातिन् destructive.
32345: रिपुञ्जय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Victorious. m. (-यः) Name of a king. E. रिपु, जि to conquer, खच् aff.
32346: रिपुता f. (-ता) Hostility, enmity. E. रिपु, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रिपुत्वं.
32347: रिप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) Vile, bad, wicked. E. री to hurt, Uṇādi aff. र, the vowel made short, and पुट् augment.
32348: रिफ r. 6th cl. (रिफति) 1 To speak, to say or tell. 2 To fight. 3 To blame, to censure. 4 To hurt or injure. 5 To give. 6 To praise, to flatter.
32349: रिम्फ r. 6th cl. (रिम्फति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
32350: रिम्फ n. (-म्फं) The zodiac. E. रिम्फ to hurt, अच् aff.
32351: रिरंसा f. (-सा) Wish to sport. E. रम to play, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
32352: रिरंसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Desirous to sport. E. रम to sport, उ aff. desid. v.
32353: रिरी f. (-री) Pale brass, prince's metal, &c. E. री to go, क्रिन् aff., ङीप् added.
32354: रिव (इ) रिवि r. 1st cl. (रिण्वति) To go, to move.
32355: रिश r. 6th cl. (रिशति) To hurt, to injure, to kill or attempt to kill.
32356: रिश्य m. (-श्यः) A deer. E. रिश to hurt, aff. क्यप्.
32357: रिष r. 1st cl. (रेषति) r. 4th cl. (रिष्यति) To hurt, to kill, or attempt to kill. r. 9th cl. (रिष्णाति) To separate, to depart.
32358: रिषि n. (-षिः) A saint. E. रि substituted for ऋ; see ऋषि.
32359: रिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Hurt, injured. 2 Unlucky. 3 Lucky. n. (-ष्टं) 1 Happiness, prosperity. 2 Good luck, fortune. 3 Bad luck, ill fortune. 4 Destruction, loss, privation. 5 Sin. m. (-ष्टः) 1 A sword. 2 The soap plant. 3 A demon, destroyed by VIṢṆU. E. रिष to hurt or injure, aff. क्त.
32360: रिष्टक m. (-कः) The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus of several species.) E. रिष्ट the same, कन् added.
32361: रिष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A sword. f. (-ष्टिः) Prosperity, good fortune. E. रिष to hurt, aff. क्तिन्.
32362: रिष्य m. (-ष्यः) A deer. E. रिष to hurt, to be hurt, aff. क्यप्.
32363: रिष्व mfn. (-ष्वः-ष्वा-ष्वं) Mischievous, injurious. E. रिष to hurt, Uṇādi aff. वन्, form irr.
32364: रिह r. 1st cl. (रेहति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
32365: री r. 9th cl. (रीणाति) 1 To hurt, to injure. 2 To go, to move. 3 To howl, as a wild beast. (ङ) रीङ् r. 4th cl. (रीयते) 1 To distil, to ooze, to drop. 2 To fall, to alight. r. 2nd cl. (रेति) To bear or conceive, (as a child.)
32366: रीज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 Reproach, censure. 2 Shame, modesty. E. ह्री to be ashamed, deriv. irr.
32367: रीढक m. (-कः) The backbone. E. रिह to hurt, aff. क्त, and the vowel made long, रीढ, कन् added.
32368: रीढा f. (-ढा) Disrespect, irreverence, disregard. E. रिह to kill, &c., aff. क्त, and the vowel made long.
32369: रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Oozing, dripping, leaking, distilling. E. री to leak, to run out, aff. क्त.
32370: रीति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 Usage, custom, practice, local or traditionary observance. 2 Oozing, leaking, distilling. 3 Brass, pale brass, or prince's metal. 4 Rust of iron. 5 Calx of brass. 6 Scoria of any metal, or the oxide formed on the surface of metals by their exposure to heat and air. 7 Boundary, limit. 8 Going, motion. 9 Natural property or disposition. E. री to go, to run out, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
32371: रीतिका f. (-का) Calx of brass. E. रीति brass, and कन् aff.
32372: रीतिपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Calx of brass. E. रीति brass, and पुष्प a flower.
32373: रीव r. 1st cl. (रीवते) 1 To take. 2 To screen.
32374: रु (टु) टुरु r. 2nd cl. (रौति) To sound, to make a particular sort of sound. (ड,) रुङ् r. 1st cl. (रवते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To hurt, to injure or kill. 3 To speak. 4 To be angry.
32375: रु m. (रुः) 1 War, battle. 2 Noise, sound. f. (रुः) 1 Fear, alarm. 2 Cutting, dividing. E. रु to sound, aff. क्विप्.
32377: रुक्प्रतिक्रिया f. (-या) The practice of physic, curing, remedying. E. रुक् from रुच् disease, प्रतिक्रिया resisting.
32378: रुक्म n. (-क्मं) 1 Gold. 2 Iron. E. रुच to shine, Uṇādi aff. मक्.
32379: रुक्मकारक m. (-कः) A gold-smith. E. रुक्म gold, and कारक a worker.
32380: रुक्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Golden. f. (-वती) A species of the Paṅkti metre. E. रुक्म, and मतुप् aff.
32381: रुक्मिदर्प m. (-र्पः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. रुक्मिन् a king, and दर्प pride; proud of overcoming him.
32382: रुक्मिदारिन् m. (-री) BALARĀMA. E. रुक्मिन् a prince, and दारिन् destroyer.
32383: रुक्मिन् m. (-क्मी) The name of a prince slain by BALARĀMA. f. (-क्मिणी) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. E. 2 A princess carried off. and married by KṚṢṆA. E. रुक्म gold, and इनि poss. aff.
32384: रुक्मिभिद् m. (-भिद्) BALARĀMA. E. रुक्मि a prince, the elder brother of RUKMIṆĪ, and भिद् breaker, conqueror.
32385: रुक्सद्मन् n. (-द्म) Excrement, fæces. E. रुज् disease, सद्मन् abode.
32386: रुक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Harsh, unkind. 2 Rough, hard. 3 Rugged, uneven. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. स्; it is more properly written रूक्ष, as derived from रूक्ष to be rough.
32387: रुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Bent, crooked, curbed. 2 Broken. 3 Impaired, injured. 4 Diseased, sick, infirm. E. रुज to be disordered, aff. क्त.
32388: रुग्नता f. (-ता) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Crookedness. E. रुग्न, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रुग्नत्वं.
32389: रुच r. 1st cl. (रोचति) 1 To shine. 2 To please, to be pleased.
32390: रुच् f. (रुक्) 1 Light, lustre, splendour. 2 Beauty, loveliness. 3 Lightning. 4 Wish, desire. 5 The chattering of the parrot or Maina. 6 The Ṛg Veda. E. रुच् to shine, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुचा.
32391: रुचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Agreeable, pleasing. 2 Sharp, acrid. 3 Tonic, stomachic. m. (-कः) 1 The citron, (Citrus medica.) 2 An ornament of the neck or breast. 3 A tooth. 4 A pigeon. n. (-कं) 1 Salt. 2 Natron, alkali. 3 Borax. 4 A garland, a chaplet. 5 A curl on a horse's neck. 6 The woody Cassia. 7 Any auspicious or fortunate object. 8 A perfume, commonly Rocanā. 9 An anthelmintic medicine, commonly Virenga, (Embelia ribes?) 10 A sort of temple. 11 A stomachic. E. रुच to shine, &c. in the causal form, क्वुन् aff.; the embellisher, the polisher, &c.
32392: रुचि f. (-चिः-ची) 1 Light, lustre. 2 Beauty. 3 Passion. 4 Wish, desire. 5 A ray of light. 6 Intent application to any object or undertaking. 7 Hunger, appetite. 8 Taste, sentiment. E. रुच् to shine, कि aff.
32393: रुचिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Beautifying. 2 Sharpening, as the appetite, &c. E. रुचि, and कर what makes.
32394: रुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sweet. 2 Sharpened, (as the appetite.) 3 Digested. 4 Bright, brightened. f. (-ता) Species of the Atijagatī metre. E. रुच to please, Uṇādi aff. कितच्.
32395: रुचिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Beautiful, charming, pleasing. 2 Sweet. 3 Stomachic, restorative. E. रुच to please, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
32396: रुचिरमुद् mfn. (-द्) Exquisite, affording great pleasure. E. रुचिर, and मुद what delights.
32397: रुचिरानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Handsome, beautiful. E. रुचिर, and आनन face.
32398: रुचिरापाङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A beautiful charming woman. E. रुचिर, and अपाङ्ग corner of the eye.
32399: रुचिष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) 1 Sweet. 2 Stomachic. E. रुच to be agreeable, Uṇādi aff. किष्यन्.
32400: रुच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 Beautiful, pleasing. 2 Stomachic, tonic. m. (-च्यः) A husband, a lover. n. (-च्यं) A digestive, a tonic. E. रुच to please, aff. क्यप्.
32401: रुज (औ ओ) औरुजो r. 6th cl. (रुजति) 1 To afflict, to disorder, to afflict with pain or disease. 2 To bend or break. r. 10th cl. (रोजयति) To hurt, to injure.
32402: रुज् f. (रुक्) Sickness, disease. E. रुज् to be or make sick, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुजा.
32403: रुजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) 1 Breaking. 2 Giving pain, making ill or sick. 2 Being sick. E. रुज to afflict. शतृ aff.
32404: रुजा f. (-जा) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 Overthrow, destruction. 3 An ewe. E. रुज to be or make sick, aff. क and टाप्.
32405: रुजाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Sickening, making sick or ill. m. (-रः) One of the Bhāvas or sentiments, the sickness induced by passion or love. n. (-रं) An acid fruit, (the fruit of the Averrhoa carambola.) E. रुजा sickness, कर what makes.
32406: रुट r. 1st cl. (रोटते) 1 To resist or oppose. 2 To strive again. 3 To tumble or roll for passion. r. 10th cl. (रोटयति) 1 To be angry. 2 To shine. (इ) रुटि r. 1st cl. (रुण्ठति) To steal, to rob.
32407: रुठ r. 1st cl. (रोठति) To strike, to fell, to knock down, to overturn. (रोठते) To resist, to oppose. (इ) रुठि r. 1st cl. (रुण्ठति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To steal. 3 To be idle. 4 To be lame.
32408: रुणस्करा f. (-रा) A cow easily milked.
32409: रुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A headless body, retaining life and mixing in combat. E. रुडि for रुटि or रुठि to take or steal, aff. अच्.
32410: रुण्डिका f. (-का) 1 The threshold of a door. 2 A field of battle. 3 A female messenger or go-between. 4 Superhuman power. E. रुण्ड as above, कन् aff., fem. form.
32411: रुत n. (-तं) 1 The cry of birds, &c. 2 Any cry or noise. E. रु to sound, to make a particular sound, aff. क्त.
32412: रुतव्याज m. (-जः) 1 Mimicry. 2 Simulated cry or sound. E. रुत, and व्याज disguise.
32413: रुतायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rendered vocal by the cry of birds, &c. E. रुत cry, used as a verb, क्त aff.
32414: रुद(इर)रुदिर r. 2nd cl. (रोदिति) 1 To weep. 2 To call or address weeping. With उप and आङ्, To weep for another, to sympathize.
32415: रुद् f. (रुत्) 1 Grief. 2 Pain, affliction. 3 Disease. 4 Sound, noise. 5 Cry, wail, lamentation. E. रुद to weep, aff. क्विप्.
32416: रुदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दती-दत्) Weeping, wailing. E. रुद to weep, शतृ aff.
32417: रुदथ m. (-थः) 1 A dog. 2 A pupil, a scholar. E. रुद to weep, अथन् Uṇādi aff.
32418: रुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crying, weeping, wept, (by whom.) n. (-तं) Weeping. E. रुद to weep, aff. क्त.
32419: रुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Surrounded, begirt, as with a fence or river, &c. 2 Secured, protected from access. 3 Obstructed, stopped, shut up. 4 Opposed, stopped, impeded. 5 Besieged, invested, blockaded. f. (-द्धा) A siege. E. रुध to close, &c., aff. क्त.
32420: रुद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being weeping or wailing. E. रुद to weep, pass. v., शानच् aff.
32421: रुद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 A name or form of ŚIVA. 2 A demi-god, an inferior manifestation of ŚIVA, or according to one legend, a being born from the forehead of BRAHMĀ: the RUDRAS are eleven in number, and are severally named, AJAIKAPĀDA, AHIVRADHNA, VIRŪPĀKṢA, SUREŚVARA, JAYANTA, BAHURŪPA, TRYAMBAKA, APARĀJITA, SAVITRA, and HARA. f. (-द्री) A sort of lute or guitar. E. रुद to weep, रक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel unchanged; the name is given to ŚIVA, because according to his own declaration, he disperses the tears of  mortals: to the demi-gods, because they wept at their birth, or because they made the enemies of the gods weep.
32422: रुद्रज n. (-जं) Quicksilver. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and ज born, being supposed to be the semen of the deity.
32423: रुद्रपत्नी f. (-त्नी) 1 Linseed, (Linum.) 2 The goddess DURGĀ. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and पत्नी wife.
32424: रुद्रप्रिया f. (-या) 1 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica) 2 The goddess PĀRVATĪ. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, &c., and प्रिया the beloved.
32425: रुद्रभू f. (-भूः) A cemetery. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and भू site or haunt.
32426: रुद्रबलि m. (-लिः) Oblations of meat, &c. presented to the RUDRAS. E. रुद्र a RUDRA, and बलि sacrifice.
32427: रुद्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of eleven children. E. रुद्र a RUDRA, of whom there are eleven, and सू mother.
32428: रुद्राक्रीड m. (-डः) A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and आक्रीड place of sport; being supposed to dance and sport in such places at evening twilight.
32429: रुद्राक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree, (Eleocarpus ganitrus, Rox.) n. (-क्षं) The berry of the Eleocarpus, of which rosaries are usually made. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and अक्ष from अक्षि the eye.
32430: रुद्राणी f. (-णी) The goddess DURGĀ, as the wife of RUDRA or ŚIVA. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.
32431: रुद्रावास n. (-सः) Benares. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and आवास abode.
32432: रुद्रारि m. (-रिः) KĀMA, the deity of love. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, and अरि enemy.
32433: रुध r. 4th cl. (with अनु prefixed) (अनुरुध्यते) 1 To desire, to wish for, to love. 2 To be kind to. 3 To consent, to concur. 4 To lament or be sorry for. (ञि औ इर) ञि औरुधिर् r. 7th cl. (रुणद्धि रुंद्धे) 1 To impede, to oppose, to obstruct, to block or confine. 2 To invest, to blockade, to besiege. With अभि and सम् prefixed, To prevent. With अव, To guard. With उप, To blockade. With प्रति or वि, To oppose, to resist. With सम् and नि, To shut up, to surround or blockade.
32434: रुधिर n. (-रं) 1 Blood. 2 Saffron. m. (-रः) The planet MARS. E. रुध to obstruct, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
32435: रुधिरपायिन् m. (-यी) A Rākṣasa, a demon. E. रुधिर, and पायिन् who drinks.
32436: रुध्वा ind. Having stopped, checked, impeded, &c. E. रुध to hinder. क्त्वाच् aff.
32437: रुन्धत् mfn. (-न्धन्-न्धती-न्धत्) 1 Hindering, opposing, stopping. 2 Resisting, refusing. E. रुध to hinder, शतृ aff.
32438: रुप r. 4th cl. (रुप्यति) To confound, to perplex, to confuse.
32440: रुमा f. (-मा) 1 The wife of the monkey SUGRĪVA. 2 The district, or more properly the salt mines of Sambhar, a town in Ajmer, twenty miles west of Jayanagar. E. रु to weep, मन् aff., with टाप् fem. aff., deriv. irr.
32441: रुम्र m. (-म्रः) ARUṆA, or the dawn. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. रव्, and रु substituted for the initial.
32442: रुरु m. (-रुः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 A Daitya flayed by ŚIVA. E. रु to weep, कु aff.
32443: रुरुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु). 1 Wishing to oppose or obstruct. 2 Wishing to bind or tie up, (as the hair.) E. रुध to oppose, desid. v., उ aff.
32444: रुरुदिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or purposing to wail or weep, ready to cry. E. रुद to weep, desid. v., उ aff.
32445: रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Crying, calling, howling. E. रु to cry, शतृ aff.
32446: रुवथु m. (-थुः) 1 Sound, noise. 2 A cock.
32447: रुवु m. (-वुः) The castor-oil tree, (Ricinus communis.) E. रु to weep, कु aff., and the final vowel changed to उव; also with कन् added रुवुक, and with the first or second vowel made long, रुवुक and रुवूक; also, as differently derived, उरुवूक.
32448: रुश r. 6th cl. (रुशति) To hurt or kill. (इ) रुशि r. 10th cl. (रुंशयति) To shine.
32449: रुशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) 1 Maledictory, imprecative. 2 Cursing, imprecating. E. रुश to seek to injure, aff. शतृ.
32450: रुष r. 1st cl. (रोषति) 4th cl. (रुष्यति) To hurt, to injure, to kill or attempt to kill. (इर्) रुषिर r. 4th and 10th cls. (रुष्यति रोषयति) To be angry, to be passionate or wrathful.
32451: रुष् f. (रुट्) Anger, wrath, passion. E. रुष to be angry, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुषा f. (-षा)
32452: रुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Enraged, angry. E. रुष to be angry, aff. क्त with इट् augment.
32453: रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Angry, enraged. E. रुष to be angry, aff. क्त.
32454: रुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Wrath, rage, anger. E. रुष to be angry, क्तिन् aff.
32455: रुह(ञि औ) ञिऔरुह r. 1st cl. (रोहति) 1 To grow from seed, to grow as a tree, &c. 2 To be produced or become manifest. 3 To be born. With अधि prefixed, To go up or over, to ascend. With अधि and आङ्, To ascend. With अव, To descend. With आङ्. 1 To mount, to ride on. 2 To rise, to ascend. With प्र, To grow, to shoot forth as a branch or shoot taking fresh root.
32456: रुह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Growing, springing up. 2 Mounted, ascended. E. रुह to grow, aff. क.
32457: रुहक n. (-कं) A hole, a vacuity, a cave, a chasm. E. रुह to go or mount, (insects, &c.,) and क्वुन् aff.
32458: रुहा f. (-हा) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) E. रुह to grow, affs. क and टाप्.
32459: रुह्वन् m. (-ह्वा) A tree. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिप्.
32460: रूक्ष r. 10th cl. (रूक्षयति) To be harsh.
32461: रूक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Harsh, rough, not smooth or soft. 2 Rough to the taste, astringent, austere, not bland or sapid. 3 Rugged, uneven. 4 Harsh, unkind, unfriendly. m. (-क्षः) A tree in general. E. रूक्ष to be harsh or rough, aff. क.
32462: रूक्षता f. (-ता) 1 Roughness. 2 Harshness. E. रुक्ष, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रूक्षत्वं.
32463: रूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Famous, notorious. 3 Certain, ascertained. 4 Budded, blown. 5 Much, exceeding. 6 Increased, grown. 7 Traditional, conventional, or known, applied especially to words of foreign or unknown origin, but of which the employment and application are familiar. E. रुह to be born, &c., and क्त aff.
32464: रूढि f. (-ढिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Growing, growth. 3 Fame, notoriety. 4 Traditional or customary meaning of words, as opposed to their etymological signification; it is especially applied to words of foreign or uncertain origin, and incapable of etymological analysis. E. रुह to grow, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
32465: रूढिशब्द m. (-ब्दः) A word used in a peculiar but familiar sense. E. रूढि, and शब्द noun.
32466: रूप r. 10th cl. (रूपयति) To form, to express form, to represent shape either to the eye or the understanding. With नि prefixed, 1 To discuss, to investigate. 2 To explain, to describe, to declare, to expound.
32467: रूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Like, resembling, (in composition, as पितृरूपः पुत्त्रः a son like his father.) n. (-पं) 1 Natural property or disposition nature. 2 Beauty. 3 Form, figure. 4 Appearance, semblance. 5 Cattle generally, flocks and herds, &c. 6 A verse. 7 Declension, conjugation, the inflection of nouns or verbs. 8 A play, a dramatic poem. 9 Acquiring familiarity with any book or authority by frequent perusal, learning by heart or rote. 10 An image, a figure, a reflection or resemblance of any real object. 11 Colour, form, any object of vision. 12 (In arithmetic,) Discrete or distinct quantity, an entire number. 13 Known quantity, whence the first syllable Rū is used in algebra to express the same. E. रूप to express form, aff. क, or रु to sound, Uṇādi aff. प, and the radical vowel made long.
