32468: रूपक n. (-कं) 1 A drama, a dramatic poem. 2 Shape, form, figure. 3 A figure of rhetoric in general. 4 A particular class of rhetorical or poetical figures, including various modes of poetical description, or the illustration and exhibition of visible things and persons. 5 Identification of the objects of a comparison; their being not only like, but the very same. 6 Symptom of disease. f. (-पिका) Swallow wort. E. रूप form, figure, aff. कन्.
32469: रूपतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Natural or inherent disposition or property, nature. E. रूप form, and तत्त्व truth, essence.
32470: रूपधृत् mfn. (-धृत्) Having the form, resembling, like. E. रूप, and धृ to have, क्विप् aff., and तुक् added.
32471: रूपनाशन m. (-नः) An owl. E. रूप form, and नाशन destroying.
32472: रूपभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Having form or beauty. E. रूप, and भृ to possess, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.
32473: रूपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Describing, representing. E. रूप to form, शतृ aff.
32474: रूपलावण्य n. (-ण्यं) Elegance, loveliness. E. रूप, and लावण्य beauty.
32475: रूपवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Having shape or colour, &c. 2 Well-shaped, beautiful, handsome. E. रूप form, &c., and मतुप् poss. aff.
32476: रूपसम्पट् f. (-त् or -ट्) Beauty. E. रूप, and सम्पट् fortune.
32477: रूपाजीवा f. (-वा) A whore, a harlot. E. रूप beauty, and आजीव who lives by.
32478: रूपाधिबोध m. (-धः) The perception, evidence, or influence of the senses, i. e. of colour, sound, odour, flavour, and contact. E. रूप, and अधिबोध perception.
32479: रूपास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) KĀMADEVA. E. रूप beauty, and अस्त्र a weapon.
32480: रूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) 1 Beautiful, having a handsome form or shape. 2 Having form or shape. E. रूप, and इनि aff.
32481: रूप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Handsome, beautiful. n. (-प्यं) 1 Silver. 2 Wrought silver. 3 Wrought gold. E. रूप form, colour, &c., and यत् aff.
32482: रूप्याध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The master of the mint, the superintendant of the silver, or silver coinage. E. रूप्य silver, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
32483: रूवुक m. (-कः) The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis:) see रूवु; also रूवूक, and रुवुक, &c.
32484: रूष r. 1st cl. (रूषति) To decorate, to adorn.
32485: रूषक m. (-कः) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. रूष to adorn, aff. क्वुन्.
32486: रूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, reduced to dust or powder. 2 Covered, spread over, coated, inlaid. 3 Adorned, decorated. 4 Made rough or rugged. E. रूष to adorn, aff. क्त.
32487: रे A vocative particle, but expressive of contempt or disrespect.
32488: रेक(ऋ,)रेकृ r. 1st cl. (रेकते) 1 To suspect or think probable. 2 To excite or entertain doubt: in the last case with आङ् usually prefixed.
32489: रेक mf. (-कः-का) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 Fear, apprehension. m. (-कः) 1 Looseness, purging. 2 An outcaste, a low man. 3 A frog. E. रेक to suspect, to fear, aff. अच्, or रिच to purge, aff. घञ्.
32490: रेकणस् n. (-णः) Gold. E. रिच to divide, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, नुट् augment, and च changed to क.
32491: रेखा f. (-खा) 1 A line, a continuous line. 2 Deceit, fraud. 3 A little. 4 Fulness, satisfaction. E. see लेखा, the initial being changed to र.
32492: रेचक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Purgative, aperient. m. (-कः) 1 A cathartic, a purgative. 2 Nitre, saltpetre. 3 The purging-nut plant, (Croton tiglium.) n. (-कं) A purge. E. रिच् to evacuate by stool, causal form, वुन् aff.
32493: रेचन nf. (-नं-ना) Purging, looseness. f. (-ना-नी) A drug, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī. f. (-नी) 1 A plant, Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum,) the white sort. 2 Another plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) E. रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
32494: रेचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left void or empty, freed from, cleared. 2 Purged. E. रिच to purge, क्त aff.
32495: रेज(ऋ,)रेजृ r. 1st cl. (रेजते) To shine: this root is not universally admitted.
32496: रेज् m. (रेट्) AGNI or fire. E. रेज् to shine, aff. क्विप्.
32497: रेट(ऋ)रेदृ r. 1st cl. (रेटति-ते) 1 To speak. 2 To ask or beg.
32498: रेणु mf. (-णुः-णु) Dust. m. (-णुः) A medicinal plant, commonly Pāpar. E. रि to hurt, Uṇādi aff. नु.
32499: रेणुका f. (-का) A sort of perfume and medicine, of a bitter and slightly pungent taste, and greyish colour; it is procured in grains about the size of those of pepper. 2 The wife of the saint JAMADAGNI and mother of PARAŚURĀMA. 3 A sort of pulse, (Ervum or Cicer lens.) E. रेणु sand, dust, and कन् added.
32500: रेणुकासुत m. (-तः) PARAŚURĀMA. E. रेणुका the mother of the hero, and सुत son.
32501: रेणुरूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dusty, covered over with dust. m. (-तः) An ass. E. रेणु dust, and रूषित made rough.
32502: रेणुवास m. (-सः) A bee. E. रेणु dust (the pollen of flower), and वास abode.
32503: रेणुसार m. (-रः) Camphor. E. रेण dust, and सार essence; also with कन् added रेणुसारक.
32506: रेतस् n. (-तः) 1 The seminal fluid. 2 Quicksilver. E. री to ooze, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and तुट् augment.
32507: रेत्य n. (-त्यं) Calx of brass. E. री to go, यत् aff., and तुट् augment.
32508: रेत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Semen virile. 2 Quicksilver. 3 Nectar or ambrosia. 4 Perfumed or aromatic powder, pulvilio. E. री to flow, ष्ट्रन् aff., and तुट् augment.
32509: रेप(ऋ)रेपृ r. 1st cl. (रेपति-ते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To sound.
32510: रेप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 Low, vile, inferior, contemptible. 2 Cruel, savage. E. रि to injure, प aff.
32511: रेपस् mfn. (-पाः-पाः-पः) 1 Low, vile, contemptible. 2 Cruel, savage. 3 Miserly, niggardly, a miser. 4 Wicked, abandoned. E. रप to speak, to revile, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and ए substituted for the radical vowel.
32512: रेफ mfn. (-फः-फा-फं) 1 Low, vile, contemptible, wicked. 2 Defamed, reviled. m. (-फः) 1 The letter R. 2 Passion, affection of the mind. E. र the letter R. with the inherent short vowel, and इफ aff.; or रिफ् to defame, to reproach, aff. घञ्.
32513: रेफस् mfn. (-फाः-फाः-फः) 1 Low, vile, contemptible. 2 Wicked, abandoned. 3 Miserly, a niggard. 4 Cruel, savage. E. रिफ् to reproach, aff. असुन्; also रेफ, रेपस्, and रेप.
32514: रेब(ऋ)रेबृ r. 1st cl. (रेबते) To go, to move.
32516: रेभण n. (-णं) The lowing of kine. E. रेभ to sound, aff. ल्युट्.
32517: रेरिहाण m. (-णः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 An Asura; an evil spirit. 3 A thief.
32518: रेव(ऋ)रेवृ (रेवते) 1 To go by leaps or jumps, to leap, to jump. 2 To go, to move. 3 To flow as a river.
32519: रेवट n. (-टं) A conch shell with sinistral convolutions, or the spiral lines turning from the right to the left. m. (-टः) 1 Oil of the Morunga tree. 2 A plantain, the fruit. 3 A hog. 4 Dust. 5 A whirlwind. 6 A conjuror, a juggler, a snake dancer. E. रेव to go, अटन् aff.
32520: रेवत m. (-तः) A prince, the father of the wife of BALARĀMA.
32521: रेवति f. (-तिः) The wife of KĀMA.
32522: रेवती f. (-ती) 1 The wife of BALARĀMA, the brother of KṚṢṆA. 2 The last of the Nakṣatras or lunar asterisms, containing thirty two stars, figured by a tabor; one of the stars is ζ piscium. 3 One of the Mātṛs or energies of the gods. 4 A cow. E. रेवत the name of a king, the father of BALARĀMA'S wife, and ङीष् aff.
32523: रेवतीभव m. (-वः) The planet SATURN. E. रेवती the nymph or asterism personified, and भव born.
32524: रेवतीरमण m. (-णः) BALARĀMA. E. रेवती the wife of BALARĀMA, and रमण husband.
32525: रेवतीश m. (-शः) BALARĀMA. E. रेवत the wife of this demigod, and ईश lord or husband.
32526: रेवन्त m. (-न्तः) The fifth MANU of the present Kalpa; also called RAIVATA.
32527: रेवन्तमनुसू f. (-सूः) SAṂJÑĀ, wife of the sun. E. रेवन्त Revanta, मनु the MANU, and सू the mother.
32528: रेवा f. (-वा) 1 The Nerbadda, or Narmadā river, which rises in the mountain Āmrakūṭa, or Amerkantak, in the province of Gondvāna, and runs nearly due west about 750 miles, when it falls into the sea below Baroach. 2 RATI, the wife of KĀMA. 3 The indigo plant. E. रेव to flow, aff. अच्.
32529: रेष(ऋ)रेषृ r. 1st cl. (रेषते) 1 To utter an inarticulate sound. 2 To neigh. 3 To howl.
32530: रेष् mfn. (रेट्) Who or what neighs, howls, &c. E. रेष to neigh, विच् aff.
32531: रेषण n. (-णं) Howling, roaring. E. रेष to sound inarticulately, aff. ल्युट्; also with अङ् and टाप्, aff. रेषा.
32532: रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, made as a noise. n. (-तं) Neighing, roaring. E. रेष to sound, aff. क्त.
32533: रेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) An injurer. E. रिष to hurt, तृच् aff.
32535: रै m. (-राः) 1 Wealth, property, substance. 2 Gold. 3 Sound, noise. E. रा to give, Uṇādi aff. डै.
32536: रैत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्यी-त्यं) Brazen, made of brass. E. रीति, and यञ् aff.
32537: रैवत m. (-तः) 1 A mountain, the eastern part of the Vindhya range, or that part in which the Revā rises. 2 A tree, (Cassia fistula.) 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 A Daitya or demon. 5 The fifth MANU of the present Kalpa. E. रेवा the Revā river, aff. अञ्, and त added.
32538: रैवतक m. (-कः) The mountain Raivata. E. कन् added to the preceding; also with ठक् added to रेवत, रैवतिक.
32539: रोक n. (-कं) 1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity. 2 A boat. 3 Moving, shaking. m. (-कः) 1 Buying with ready money. 2 Light. E. रुच to shine, aff. घञ्.
32540: रोग m. (-गः) 1 Sickness, disease in general, or a disease. 2 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. रुज to be or make sick, aff. घञ्.
32541: रोगग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Sick, diseased. E. रोग, and ग्रस्त seized.
32542: रोगघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Curative, medical. E. रोग, and घ्न what destroys.
32543: रोगभू f. (-भूः) The body. E. रोग disease, and भू the soil.
32544: रोगराज m. (-जः) Consumption. E. रोग disease, and राज principal.
32545: रोगलक्षण n. (-णं) The symptoms or sign of a disease, or of its progress. E. रोग a disease, and लक्षण mark.
32546: रोगशान्तक m. (-कः) A physician. E. रोग disease, and शान्तक alleviator.
32547: रोगशान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Cure or alleviation of disease. E. रोग, and शान्ति appeasing; also रोगशमः and the like.
32548: रोगशिल्पिन् m. (-ल्पी) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. रोग disease, and शिल्पिन् an artisan.
32549: रोगह n. (-हं) A drug, a medicament. E. रोग disease, हा to abandon, aff. क.
32550: रोगहन् m. (-हा) A physician. E. रोग, and हन to destroy, क्विप् aff.
32551: रोगहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Curative, medicinal. E. रोग, and हर what takes.
32552: रोगहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Curative, medicinal. m. (-री) A physician. E. रोग disease, हृ to remove, to take away, णिनि aff.
32553: रोगान्तक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Curative, medicinal. m. (-कः) A physician. E. रोग, and अन्तक destroyer.
32554: रोगान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sick, diseased. E. रोग, and अन्वित having.
32555: रोगार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Suffering pain or sickness. E. रोग, and आर्त्त pained.
32556: रोगिता f. (-ता) Sickness, disease. E. रोगिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रोगित्वं.
32557: रोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Diseased, ill, sick, affected with sickness or disease. E. रोग disease, and इनि aff.
32558: रोगिवल्लभ n. (-भं) A drug, a medicament. E. रोगि a sick man, and वल्लभ the friend.
32559: रोगोपशम m. (-मः) Cure or alleviation of disease. E. रोग, and उपशम allaying.
32560: रोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 Counter-indicated, as menstrua or regimen, &c., what is improper to be taken in any disease or with the medicines administered. 2 Related to or connected with disease. E. रोग sickness, and यत् aff.
32561: रोचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What pleases, brightens, strengthens, &c. m. (-कः) 1 Hunger, appetite. 2 The plantain. 3 A sort of onion. 4 A stomachic, a carminative, any medicine, fruit or fossil, supposed to strengthen the tone of the stomach and restore lost appetite. E. रुच to shine, &c., and ण्वुल् aff.
32562: रोचन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) 1 Splendid, beautiful. 2 Irradiating, illumining, beautifying. 3 Gratifying, pleasing. 4 Whetting, sharpening, (the appetite.) m. (-नः) 1 A species of the silk-cotton tree. 2 The onion. 3 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaca.) 4 The Cassia fistula. 5 The pomegranate. 6 The citron. 7 A stomachic, a carminative. f. (-नी) 1 A yellow pigment, commonly Gorocanā, and supposed to be the concrete bile of the cow, or according to some authorities, to be found in the head of the animal, used as a medicine, a dye, and perfume. 2 The manna of bambus. 3 A excellent woman. 4 A red lotus. f. (-ना-नी) 1 A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, a sort of Crinum? f. (-नी) 1 A variety of Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) 2 Red arsenic. E. रुच to shine, ल्युट् or युच् aff.
32563: रोचनिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī. E. कन् added to रोचनी the same.
32564: रोचमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Splendid, shining. 2 Pleasing, gratifying. m. (-नः) A tuft or curl of hair round the neck of a horse or on the lower part of it. E. रुच to shine, aff. शानच्.
32565: रोचिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Elegantly dressed or ornamented. 2 Splendid, brilliant. E. रुच to shine, इष्णुच् aff.
32566: रोचिस् n. (-चिः) Light. E. रुच to shine, इसुन् aff.
32568: रोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be illuminated or enlightened. E. रुच to shine, aff. ण्य.
32569: रोड(ऋ)रोडृ r. 1st cl. (रोडति) 1 To be mad. 2 To disrespect.
32570: रोदन n. (-नं) 1 Weeping, crying. 2 A tear, tears. f. (-नी) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. रुद to weep, aff. ल्युट्.
32571: रोदस् n. (-दः) 1 Heaven. 2 Earth. dual. (-सी) Heaven and earth. E. रुद to weep, aff. असुन्.
32572: रोदसी f. (-सी). 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 Earth. f. dual. (-स्यौ) Heaven and earth. E. ङीप् added to the preceding.
32573: रोध m. (-धः) A bank, a shore. E. रुध to obstruct, aff. घञ्.
32574: रोधन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Impeding, that which impedes or obstructs, an obstacle, a hinderer or hindrance. m. (-नः) The planet MERCURY. n. (-नं) 1 Impeding, obstructing. 2 Besieging, blockading. E. रुध to obstruct, aff. ल्युट्.
32575: रोधवक्रा f. (-क्रा) A river. E. रोध a bank, and वक्र the course of a stream, fem. form.
32576: रोधस् n. (-धः) A bank, a shore. E. रुध to obstruct, and असुन् aff.
32577: रोधोवक्रा f. (-क्रा) A river. E. रोधस् a bank, and वक्र winding course.
32578: रोध्र m. (-ध्रः) A tree, commonly Lodh. n. (-घ्रं) 1 Offence, transgression. 2 Sin. E. रुध to obstruct, and रन् aff.
32579: रोप m. (-पः) 1 An arrow. 2 Confusing, disturbing, (the ideas.) n. (-पं) A hole, a vacuity, a chasm. E. रुप to disturb, aff. घञ्.
32580: रोपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what plants, raises, &c. m. (-कः) A weight of metal or a coin, the seventieth part of a Suvarṇa. E. रुह to rise, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
32581: रोपण n. (-णं) 1 Placing in or upon. 2 Planting. 3 Raising. 4 A disturbing or bewildering of the mind, a confusing, or confusion of ideas. 4 Cicatrizing, healing. 5 A healing application to sores or wounds. E. रुह to ascend, causal v., or रुप to bewilder, aff. ल्युट्.
32582: रोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed in or upon. 2 Planted. 3 Raised, elevated. Bewildered, perplexed. E. रुह to rise, causal v., or रुप to bewilder, क्त aff.
32583: रोम n. (-मं) Water. m. (-मः) A hole.
32584: रोमकर्णक m. (-कः) A hare. E. रोम hair, and कर्ण the ear, कन् added.
32585: रोमकूप m. (-पः) A pore of the skin. E. रोम hair, and कूप a well, a pit.
32586: रोमकेशर n. (-रं) A Chowri. E. रोम hair of an animal, (especially of the Yac,) and केशर a filament.
32587: रोमगुच्छ n. (-च्छं) A Chowri, a sort of whisk. E. रोम hair, (see the last word,) and गुच्छ a cluster; also with कन् added, रोमगुच्छक.
32588: रोमन् n. (-म) The hair of the body. E. रु to make, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्, form irr.
32589: रोमन्थ n. (-न्थं) Ruminating, chewing the cud, or also eating, without chewing what has been once swallowed and again brought into the mouth. E. रोग disease, and मन्थ to destroy or remove, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.; this habit in animals being indispensable to digestion and health.
32590: रोमबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Made of or fastened with the hair of animals, (as horse hair, &c.) E. रोम, and बद्ध bound.
32591: रोमभूमि f. (-मिः) The skin. E. रोम the hair, and भूमि soil, site.
32592: रोमलता f. (-ता) A line of hair extending to the navel. E. रोम hair, and लता a creeper.
32593: रोमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hairy, woolly. E. रोम hair of the body, and मतुप् aff.
32594: रोमविकार m. (-रः) Horripilation. E. रोम the hair of the body, and विकार change of state.
32595: रोमविक्रिया f. (-या) Horripilation. E. रोम the hair, and विक्रिया change.
32596: रोमविध्वंश m. (-शः) A body louse. E. रोम, and विध्वंश loss.
32597: रोमश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Hairy, woolly. m. (-शः) 1 A ram, a sheep. 2 A hog. E. रोमन् hair, and श aff.
32598: रोमहर्ष m. (-र्षः) Horripilation. E. रोम the hair of the body, and हर्ष pleasure.
32599: रोमहर्षण n. (-णं) Horripilation, erection or rigidity of the hair of the body, conceived to be occasioned by and to express exquisite delight. m. (-णः) 1 SŪTA, the pupil of VYĀSA, and supposed narrator of the events recorded in the Purāṇas. 2 Beleric myrobalan. E. रोम the hair, and हर्ष्ण delighting.
32600: रोमाञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) Horripilation, rigidity and erection of the hair of the body. E. रोम the hair, अञ्च to worship, aff. घञ्.
32601: रोमाञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having the hair of the body erect, considered as a proof of exquisite pleasure; enraptured, delighted. E. रोमाञ्च horripilation, इतच् aff.
32602: रोमाली f. (-ली) A line of hair, extending across the navel. E. रोमन् hair, and आली a line.
32603: रोमावली f. (-ली) A line of hair across the middle of the belly or navel. E. रोम, and आवली a line.
32604: रोमोद्गम m. (मः) Horripilation. E. रोम hair, उद्गम rising; also रोमोद्ग m. (-द्गः).
32605: रोमोद्भेद m. (-दः) Horripilation. E. रोम hair of the body, and उद्भेद breaking forth, protrusion.
32606: रोरुदा f. (-दा) Violent weeping. E. रुद to weep, frequent. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
32607: रोरुदावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Weeping or wailing violently. E. रोरुदा, and मतुप् aff.
32608: रोरुद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Crying bitterly. E. रुद to weep, frequent. v., शानच् aff.
32609: रोल m. (-लः) 1 A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 2 Moist ginger.
32610: रोलम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Distrustful, unbelieving. m. (-म्बः) 1 A bee. 2 Dry or arid soil. E. रोड to be mad, अम्बच् aff., and ड changed to ल.
32612: रोष m. (-पः) Anger, wrath. E. रुष to be angry, aff. घञ्.
32613: रोषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Angry, passionate. m. (-णं) 1 Quicksilver. 2 A touchstone. 3 Arid or desart soil. E. रुष to be angry, aff. युच्.
32614: रोषवाहण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Angry, feeling and displaying wrath. E. रोष, and वह to bear, causal v., युच् aff.
32615: रोष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Violent, wrathful, angry. E. रुष to be angry, तृच् aff.
32616: रोह m. (-हः) 1 A bud, a blossom. 2 Mounting, ascending. E. रुह to grow, aff. घञ्.
32617: रोहक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A rider, riding, mounted, one who rides on any animal or is carried in any vehicle. m. (-कः) 1 A sort of goblin. 2 Rising, growing, mounting. E. रुह to rise, aff. वुन्.
32618: रोहग m. (-गः) The name of a mountain, Adam's peak in Ceylon. E. रोह rising, and ग what goes.
32619: रोहण n. (-णं) 1 Semen virile. 2 Rising in or on, mounting, ascending. 3 Growing as a plant. 4 A mountain; see the last. E. रुह to grow, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
32620: रोहन्त m. (-न्तः) A kind of tree. f. (-न्ती) A sort of creeper. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. झच्, fem, aff. ङीष्.
32621: रोहि m. (-हिः) 1 A tree. 2 A seed. 3 A pious or religious man, one observing a vow, &c. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
32622: रोहिण m. (-णः) 1 The Indian fig tree. 2 A fragrant grass. n. (-णं) A part of the fore-noon, extending to mid-day, in which Śrāddhas are especially to be observed. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. इनच्.
32623: रोहिणिका f. (-का) A woman red with anger, &c. or with red pigments. E. रोहिणी fem. form, of रोहित red, and कन् added.
32624: रोहिणीपति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. रोहिणी the nymph, (see रोहिन्,) and पति husband.
32625: रोहिणीवल्लभ m. (-भः) The moon. E. रोहिणी the nymph, and वल्लभ the lover.
32626: रोहिणीश m. (-शः) The moon. E. रोहिणी the nymph, and ईश lord or husband.
32627: रोहित् m. (-हित्) The sun. f. (-हित्) 1 A deer, a doe. 2 A sort of creeper. E. रुह to go or grow, Uṇādi aff. इति.
32628: रोहित mfn. (रोहितः रोहिता or रोहिणी रोहितं) Red, of a red colour. m. (-तः) 1 Red, (the colour.) 2 The Rohi fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 3 A kind of deer. 4 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.) n. (-तं) 1 INDRA'S bow unbent and invisible to mortals. 2 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 3 Blood. E. रुह to grow or go, Uṇādi aff. इतन्.
32629: रोहितक m. (-कः) A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka, Rox.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
32630: रोहितश्व m. (-श्वः) 1 A name of AGNI. 2 The son of HARIŚCANDRA. E. रेहित् a deer, or red, and अश्व a horse; also from रोहित sometimes read रोहिताश्व.
32631: रोहितिका f. (-का) A woman whose face is stained with red pigments, or who is red with rage, &c. E. रोहित red, fem. form, कन् added.
32632: रोहितेय m. (-यः) A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.) E. रोहित the same, ढक् pleonastic aff.
32633: रोहिन् m. (-ही) 1 The Indian fig tree. 2 The holy fig tree. 3 The Andersonia Rohitaka. f. (-हिणिः-हिणी) 1 The fourth lunar asterism, figured by a wheeled carriage, and containing five stars, probably, α β γ δ ε Tauri; in mythology, the asterism is personified as one of the daughters of Dakṣa, and wives of the moon. 2 The mother of BALARĀMA. f. (-णी) 1 One of the Vidyādevīs of the Jainas. 2 A cow. 3 Inflammatory affection of the throat. 4 Lightning. 5 The name of a medicinal plant. 6 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 7 A woman stained with red pigments, or red with passion, &c. 8 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 9 Bengal madder. 10 A girl nine years old. E. रुह to grow, aff. णिनि.
32634: रोहिष n. (-षं) A sort of grass. m. (-षः) 1 The Rohi, a kind of fish. 2 A deer said to resemble an ass.
32635: रौक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) 1 Roughness, ruggedness. 2 Harshness, unkindness. E. रुक्ष hard, व्यञ् aff.
32636: रौचनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Died or coloured with Rocana, of a yellowish or orange tint. n. (-कं) The tartar of the teeth. E. रोचना a pigment, and ठ् aff.
32637: रौच्य m. (-च्यः) An ascetic with a staff of Bilva wood.
32638: रौट(ऋ)रौटृ r. 1st cl. (रौटति) To treat with disrespect.
32639: रौड(ऋ)रौडृ r. 1st cl. (रौडति) To treat with disrespect.
32640: रौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) 1 Formidable, fearful, terrific. 2 Sharp, acute. 3 Relating or belonging to RUDRA or ŚIVA. 4 Violent, wrathful, irascible. mn. (-द्रः-द्रं) Wrath, rage, (the sentiment as an object of poetical description) m. (-द्रः) 1 Heat, warmth. 2 The cold season. 3 YAMA. f. (-द्री) GAURI, the wife of ŚIVA. E. रुद्र ŚIVA, &c., and अण् aff.
32641: रौद्रता f. (-ता) Fierceness, formidableness. E. रौद्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रौद्रत्वं.
32642: रौद्रदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Formidable, terrific. E. रौद्र, and दर्शन appearance.
32643: रौप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्यी-प्यं) Silver, of silver. n. (-प्यं) Silver. E. रूप्य the same, अण् pleonasm or aff. of relation.
32644: रौम n. (-मं) A sort of salt; see the next. E. रुम the place where it is found, अण् aff.
32645: रौमक n. (-कं) A kind of salt, according to some authorities, brought from a mountain in Ajmere, but in fact procured from a salt lake near the town of Sāmbher, about twenty miles west of Jayanagar. E. रुम the district of Ruma or Sāmbher, aff. अण्, and कन् added; also रौम, and रौमलवण.
32646: रौमलवण n. (-णं) Sāmbher salt; see the last. E. रौम as above, and लवण salt.
32647: रौरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Formidable, horrible, terrific. 2 Dishonest, fraudulent. 3 Unsteady, slipping. m. (-वः) 1 One of the divisions of Naraka or Tartarus. 2 A savage, a monster. E. रुद to weep, deriv. irr., or रुरु said to mean a living being, अण् aff.
32649: रौहिणेय m. (-यः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 The planet MERCURY. n. (-यं) An emerald. mf. (-यः-यी) A calf. E. रोहिणी the nymph, &c., and ढक् aff.
32650: रौहिष m. (-षः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 The Rohi fish. n. (-षं) A kind of grass. E. रुह to grow, Uṇādi aff. ठिषच्, and the vowel changed to औ. ल
32651: ल The twenty-eighth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, the letter L.
32652: ल m. (लः) 1 INDRA. 2 Cutting. f. (ला) 1 Giving. 2 Receiving, taking. f. (ली) 1 Embracing, adhering or clinging to. 2 Liquifying, melting. E. ला to give or take, &c., aff. क or ड, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.
32653: लक r. 10th cl. (लाकयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain.
32654: लक n. (-कं) 1 The forehead. 2 The ear or spike of wild rice. E. लक to taste, &c., aff. अच्.
32655: लकच m. (-चः) A tree: see the next.
32656: लकुच m. (-चः) A species of the bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus Lacucha, Rox.) E. लक to taste, उच aff.; also अ substituted for उ, लकच.
32657: लक्तक m. (-कः) 1 Old and tattered cloth, a rag or rags. 2 Lac, the dye. E. लक to obtain, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
32658: लक्तकर्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A tree used in dyeing, a red variety of the Lodh tree. E. लक्त for रक्त coloured, and कर्म्मन् office, act.
32659: लक्ष r. 10th cl. (लक्षयति-ते) 1 To see, to look at, to notice or inspect. 2 To mark, to make any mark on. 3 To define, to discriminate. With उप prefixed, To remark. With सम्, To know, to understand.
32660: लक्ष nf. (-क्षं-क्षा) A Lac, one hundred thousand. n. (-क्षं) 1 Fraud, disguise. 2 A mark or butt. E. लक्ष to mark, or see, aff. घञ्.
32661: लक्षण n. (-णं) 1 A mark, a spot. 2 A name, an appellation. 3 Sight, seeing. 4 An indication, a predicate, any thing by which an object is designated or distinguished. 5 A symptom or any indication of actual disease. m. (-णः) 1 The younger brother of RĀMA. 2 The Indian crane. f. (-णा) 1 The female of the Indian crane. 2 A goose. 3 An ellipsis, a word, &c. understood, though not inserted. 4 The force or application of a word or phrase. E. लक्ष to see, to mark, aff. ल्युट्, or लक्ष as before, Uṇādi aff. न, and अट् augment; also with मुट् augment, लक्ष्मण, which in the masc. and fem. forms is the more usual reading.
32662: लक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen. 2 Marked. E. लक्ष to mark, aff. क्त.
32663: लक्ष्मण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Prosperous, fortunate. m. (-णः) 1 The son of DAŚARATHA by SUMITRĀ, the half-brother and faithful companion of RĀMACANDRA. 2 The Sāras or Indian crane. n. (-णं) 1 A mark, a spot or sign. 2 A name, an appellation. f. (-णा) 1 The female of the Sāras. 2 A kind of drug. E. लक्ष to mark or see, Uṇādi aff. न, and मुट् augment; also with अट् augment, लक्षण as above.
32664: लक्ष्मणप्रसू f. (-सूः) SUMITRĀ, one of DAŚARATHA'S four wives, the mother of LAKṢMAṆA. E. लक्ष्मण, प्रसू the mother.
32665: लक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) 1 A mark, a spot, a sign. 2 Chief, principal. E. लक्ष to mark, &c., मनिन् aff.
32666: लक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मीः) 1 LAKṢMĪ, one of the three principal female deities of the Hindus, the wife of VIṢṆU, and goddess of wealth and prosperity. 2 Fortune, success, prosperity. 3 SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA. 4 Beauty, splendour. 5 The name of a medicinal root, commonly Vṛddhi. 6 Another root, termed Ṛddhi. 7 A plant: see प्रियङ्गु. 8 The wife of a hero. 9 Turmeric. 10 A pearl. E. लक्ष to see, &c., Uṇādi aff. ई, and मुट् augment.
32667: लक्ष्मीगृह n. (-हं) The red lotus. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess, and गृह abode, appearing at the creation, floating over the water on the expanded petals of the lotus.
32668: लक्ष्मीपति m. (-तिः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A king, a sovereign prince. 3 The clove tree. 4 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel) E. लक्ष्मी the goddess of prosperity, and पति master, husband.
32669: लक्ष्मीपल m. (-लः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
32670: लक्ष्मीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 KĀMADEVA, the god of love. 2 A horse. 3 Either of the sons of RĀMA and SĪTĀ. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess, or SĪTĀ, (she being LAKṢMĪ. incarnate,) and पुत्त्र a son.
32671: लक्ष्मीपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A ruby. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess of fortune, and पुष्प a flower.
32672: लक्ष्मीमत् m. (-मान्) The bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) E. लक्ष्मी prosperity, मतुप् aff., and the म unchanged.
32673: लक्ष्मीवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Prosperous, fortunate, wealthy, thriving. 2 Beautiful. E. लक्ष्मी prosperity, and मतुप् poss. aff.
32674: लक्ष्मीश m. (-शः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The mango tree. 3 A prosperous man. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess of fortune, and ईश lord.
32675: लक्ष्मीसहज m. (-जः) The moon. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess, सह with, ज born; rising as well as LAKṢMĪ from the ocean, at the time it was churned by the gods and Asuras.
32676: लक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 To be seen or noted. 2 To be defined or described. 3 To have attributes or predicates attached. n. (-क्ष्यं) 1 A mark, a butt. 2 A mark, a sign. 3 Fraud, disguise. 4 A Lac, a hundred thousand. E. लक्ष to see, यत् aff.
32677: लख r. 1st cl. (लखति) (इ) लखि (लंखति) To go, to move, to approach.
32678: लग(ए,)लगे r. 1st cl. (लगति) To be with or near, to touch, to be in contact or union with. (इ) लगि r. 1st cl. (लंगनि) 1 To go or move. 2 To go limpingly, to be lame. r. 10th cl. (लागयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain.
32680: लगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Obtained, gained. 2 Connected with, attached to. E. लग to be in contact with, aff. क्त, and इट् augment.
32681: लगुड m. (-डः) 1 A staff, a stick. 2 An iron club, or one bound with iron. E. लग to go, aff. डुलच्, and ल changed to ड; also लगुर.
32682: लगुर m. (-रः) A club, a stick. E. see the last; ड changed to ल.
32683: लगुरहस्त m. (-स्तः) A man armed with a stick, a mace or staffbearer. E. लगुर, and हस्त the hand.
32684: लग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Attached to, intent on. 2 Ashamed. 3 Joined to, connected with. n. (-ग्नं) The rising of a sign, its appearance above the horizon; the oblique ascension, or the divisions of the equator, which rise in succession with each sign in an oblique sphere; also defined as the arc of the equator, which passes the meridian in the same time with each sign of the ecliptic; in popular acceptation it is the moment of the sun's entrance into a zodiacal sign. m. (-ग्नः) A bard, a panegyrist. E. लग to be with or near, or लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
32685: लग्नक m. (-कः) A security, a surety. E. लग्न engaged or associated, (in the business,) aff. कन्.
32686: लग्नभुज m. (-जः) Ascensional difference. E. लग्न, and भुज arm.
32687: लग्निका f. (-का) A girl ten years old, one before menstruation. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. कन्, fem. form; also नग्निका.
32688: लघ r. 10th cl. (-लाघयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain. (इ) लघि r. 1st cl. (लंघते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To fast, to abstain from food. (लङ्घति) 1 To dry, to dry up. 2 To diminish, to lessen. r. 10th cl. (लङ्घयति) To speak. With उत् or वि prefixed, To go beyond or over, to cross, to pass, to leap or spring over; also morally, to exceed, to transgress.
32689: लघट् m. (-ट्) Air, wind. E. लघि to go, अटि Uṇādi aff., and the nasal rejected.
32690: लघटि m. (-टिः) Air, wind. E. लघि to go, Uṇādi aff. अटिच्.
32691: लघिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Lightness, absence of weight. 2 Diminutiveness. 3 Insignificance. E. लघु light, aff. इमनिच्.
32692: लघिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Lightest, very light. 2 Very small, least. E. लघु light, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
32693: लघीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Lightest, most or very light. E. लघु light, and ईयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
32694: लघु mfn. (-घुः-घुः-घ्वी-घु) 1 Light, not heavy. 2 Swift, quick. 3 Sapless, pithless. 4 Beautiful, pleasing. 5 Small, little. 6 Light, vain, frivolous. 7 Insignificant, mean, low. 8 Weak, feeble. 9 Clean, pure. 10 Short, (as a vowel.) n. adv. (-घु) Quickly, swiftly. subst. (-घु) 1 A black kind of Aloe wood or Agallochum. 2 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. f. (-घुः) A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) f. (-घ्वी) 1 A slight or delicate woman. 2 A small light carriage. E. लघि to go, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the nasal not inserted.
32695: लघुकाय m. (-यः) A goat. E. लघु small, and काय a body.
32696: लघुखद्विका f. (-का) A small bedstead. E. लघु small, खद्विका a bedstead.
32697: लघुगर्ग m. (-र्गः) A kind of fish, probably a variety of the Pimelodus. E. लघु small, and गर्ग for गर्गर a fish.
32698: लघुचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Low-minded, frivolous. E. लघु, and चेतस् mind.
32699: लघुजङ्गल m. (-लः) A sort of quail. E. लघु light, जङ्गल flesh.
32700: लघुता f. (-ता) 1 Lightness. 2 Meanness, insignificance. E. तल added to लघु; also with त्व, लघुत्वं.
32701: लघुदुन्दुभि m. (-भिः) A small kettle-drum. E. लघु light, small, and दुन्दुभि a drum.
32702: लघुपत्रक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, (Crinum?) E. लघु light, small, and पत्रक a leaf.
32703: लघुप्रयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Indolent, impotent. E. लघु, and प्रयत्न effort.
32704: लघुमांस m. (-सः) The francoline partridge. E. लघु light, (of digestion,) and मांस flesh.
32705: लघुमित्र n. (-त्रं) A friend or ally of little power or value. E. लघु, and मित्र a friend.
32706: लघुलय n. (-यं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). E. लघु light, लय contexture (in Tatties, &c.) or लघु and लय, both meaning the same root.
32707: लघुवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) 1 Thinly or lightly dressed. 2 Wearing clean or pure clothing. E. लघु, and वासस् vesture.
32708: लघुवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) 1 Low, vile. 2 Ill done, mismanaged. E. लघु, and वृत्ति practice.
32709: लघुवृत्तिता f. (-ता) 1 Insignificance, meanness. 2 Mismanagement, bad conduct. E. तल् added to the last.
32710: लघुमूल n. (-लं) In algebra, the least root with reference to the additive quantities. E. लघु, and मूल root.
32711: लघुहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Ready or light-handed. m. (-स्तः) A good archer. E. लघु quick, and हस्त hand.
32712: लघूकरण n. (-णं) 1 Reducing in weight or consequence. 2 Thinking little of, contemning. E. लघु, and करण making, च्चि augment.
32713: लघूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made light, reduced in weight. 2 Reduced in consequence, made insignificant. 3 Thought lightly of. E. लघु, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
32714: लघ्वाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Eating little, moderate. E. लघु, and अशिन् who eats.
32715: लघ्वाहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Temperate, abstemious. E. लघु, and आहार food.
32716: लङ्का f. (-ङ्का) 1 The capital of RĀVAṆA in Ceylon; the name is extended also to the island, which according to the notions of the Hindus, is much more considerable in size, and lies further from the continent than in reality; it is described as being equal to 1/12th of the equatorial circumference of the earth, and is one of the places lying under the first meridian,  whence the longitude is computed; it is thus placed in the Eastern ocean, South of Ceylon, and according to WILFORD is the peninsula of Malacca: according to some Hindu accounts also, it is distinct from Ceylon, from which island Laṅkā is said to be just visible. 2 A goddess or evil spirit, one of the Śākinīs, perhaps the same as the tutelar deity of the city of Laṅkā. 3 An unchaste woman. 4 A branch. E. लक to obtain (happiness, in which), aff. अच्, and नुग irr. augment.
32717: लङ्कादाहिन् m. (-ही) The monkey HANUMĀN. E. लङ्का the city, and दाहिन् burner; having set fire to the city with his burning tail.
32718: लङ्कापति m. (-तिः) RĀVAṆA the Daitya. E. लङ्का the city, and पति master, ruler; also लङ्काधिपति, &c.
32719: लङ्कायिका f. (-का) A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. लक to taste, root of the 10th cl. aff. ण्वुल् fem. form, and नुम् augment; also य being changed to प, लङ्कापिका, and by a different derivation लङ्कोपिका.
32720: लङ्कास्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Residing or being in Laṅkā. m. A plant, (-नी) (Euphorbia Tirucalli.) E. लङ्का Laṅkā or Ceylon, and स्थायिन् what abides or grows.
32721: लङ्केश m. (-शः) The Daitya RĀVAṆA. E. लङ्का the city Laṅkā, and ईश sovereign.
32722: लङ्कोपिका f. (-का) A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. लङ्का Laṅkā or Ceylon, वप to sow or be sown, aff. क्वुन् fem. form, and the semivowel changed to its congener.
32723: लङ्खनी f. (-नी) The bit of a bridle.
32724: लङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः.) 1 Union, association, proximate connection. 2 A lecher, a catamite. 3 Limping, lameness. E. लगि to be near or with, &c., aff. अच्.
32725: लङ्गूल n. (-लं) The tail of an animal. E. लगि to go, ऊलच् aff., more commonly लाङ्गूल.
32726: लङ्घन n. (-नं) 1 Fasting, abstinence. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 Leaping, springing, going by leaps or jumps. 4 Jumping over or beyond. 5 Exceeding, transgressing, disregarding propriety, going beyond proper bounds. 6 Storming a fort, entering by escalade, &c. 7 Capturing a fort in any way. 8 One of a horse's paces, curvetting, bounding. E. लघि to go, to fast, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
32727: लङ्घनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be passed. 2 Transgressible. 3 To be fasted. E. लघि to go, अनीयर् aff.; also लङ्घ्य and लङ्घितव्य.
32729: लज r. 1st cl. (लजति) also (इ) लजि (लञ्जति) 1 To fry. 2 To affront, to insult. (ओ ई) ओलजी r. 6th cl. (लजति-ते) To be ashamed, to be modest or bashful. r. 10th cl. (लाजयति) To hide, to cover, to screen or clothe: also (लजति) or (इ) लजि (लञ्जयति) 1 To be manifest or apparent. 2 To shine. (इ) लजि (लञ्जयति) 1 To give. 2 To dwell. 3 To injure. 4 To be strong. 5 To censure.
32730: लजकारिका f. (-का) The sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. लज for लज्जा shame, कारिका making, shewing.
32731: लज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्) Being ashamed, blushing, shrinking. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, and शतृ aff.
32732: लज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being ashamed. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. शानच्.
32733: लज्जा f. (-ज्जा) Shame, modesty, bashfulness. E. लस्ज to be modest, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
32734: लज्जाकर mfn. (-रः-री-रा-रं) Shameful, causing shame. E. लज्जा, and कर what makes.
32735: लज्जाकारिन् mfn. (-रि-रिणी-रि) Causing or occasioning shame. E. लज्जा, and कारिन् what makes.
32736: लज्जान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, bashful. E. लज्जा, and अन्वित possessed of.
32737: लज्जारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shameless, immodest. E. लज्जा, and रहित void of.
32738: लज्जालु m. (-लुः) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. लज्जा shame, हालुक् aff.
32739: लज्जावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Modest, bashful. E. लज्जा, and मतुप् aff.
32740: लज्जाशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bashful, modest. E. लज्जा modest, शील possessing.
32741: लज्जाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shameless, impudent. E. लज्जा, and हीन void of.
32742: लज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, modest. E. लज्जा Modesty, इतच् aff.
32743: लज्ज्या f. (-ज्ज्या) Modesty, bashfulness. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, य aff.
32744: लञ्ज r. 10th cl. (लञ्जयति) 1 To be manifest. 2 To shine.
32745: लञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) 1 A foot. 2 The end of the lower garment tucked into the waist band. 3 A tail. f. (-ञ्जा) 1 An adulteress. 2 Sleep. 3 LAKṢMĪ. 4 A current. E. लजि to be strong, &c., aff. अच्.
32746: लञ्जिका f. (-का) A harlot, a whore. E. लजि to censure, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form.
32747: लट r. 1st cl. (लटति) 1 To be a child, to talk or be like one. 2 To speak a little.
32748: लट m. (-टः) 1 A block head, a fool, one speaking ignorantly or foolishly. 2 Fault, defect. 3 A thief. E. लट to be or talk as a child, &c., aff. अच्.
32749: लटक m. (-कः) A vile or contemptible man. E. लट to talk as a child, and वुन् Uṇādi aff.
32750: लट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A vile or bad man, a wretch.
32751: लट्व m. (-ट्वः) 1 A horse. 2 A division of music. 3 A low and wild tribe, a tribe of mountaineers. f. (-ट्वा) 1 A bird said, to be a kind of sparrow. 2 A fruit, a variety of the Karanja. 3 A bad or unchaste woman. 4 Curls on the forehead or hanging down on the face. 5 Safflower. 6 A Sweetmeat. E. लट to be like a child, Uṇādi aff. क्वन्.
32752: लड r. 1st and 10th cls. (लडति लडयति) 1 To frolic, to sport or dally. 2 To loll (the tongue.) 3 To use the tongue. 4 To stir with the tongue. 5 To stir, to agitate. 6 To pain. r. 10th cl. (-लाडयति) 1 To nurse, to foster, to attend closely. 2 To shake. 3 To feel desire. (औ इ) औलडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लंडति लंडयति) 1 To shine. 2 To toss or throw up. 3 To speak.
32754: लड्ड m. (-ड्डः) A wretch, a villain, a low or bad man.
32755: लड्डुक n. (-कं) A class of sweetmeats, or a sweetmeat; a sort of ball made with flour fried with oil or Ghee, and mixed with sugar and spices, and distinguished into different kinds,  according to some slight varieties in its less essential ingredients; also read लड्डक.
32756: लता f. (-ता) 1 A creeper, a creeping or winding plant in general. 2 A branch. 3 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 4 A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) 5 Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.) 6 The large Bengal creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 7 A sort of grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 8 A vegetable and medicinal substance, commonly Latākastūrī or the musk-creeper, said to grow in the Dekshin. 9 Thread. E. लत a Sautra root, to hurt, to enfold, &c., aff. अच् and टाप्.
32757: लताकस्तूरिका f. (-का) A medicinal plant, commonly Latākastūrī. E. लता a creeper, and कस्तूरिका musk.
32758: लताजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A snake. E. लता a creeper, and जिह्वा the tongue, which becomes masc. in the compound.
32759: लतातरु m. (-रुः) 1 The orange tree. 2 The palm tree. 3 The Śāl tree. E. लता a creeper, and तरु a tree: fit for creepers to cling to.
32760: लताद्रुम m. (-मः) A timber tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. लता a creeper, and द्रुम a tree.
32761: लतान्त n. (-न्तं) A flower. E. लता a creeper, and अन्त end.
32762: लतापनस m. (-सः) The water-melon. E. लता a creeper, and पनस the jack, to the fruit of which the melon may be compared in size.
32763: लताप्रतानिनी f. (-नी) A spreading creeper. E. लता a creeper, and प्रतानिनी spreading.
32764: लतामणि m. (-णिः) Coral. E. लता a creeper, and मणि a jewel.
32766: लतामाधवी f. (-बी) The Mādhavī. creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. लता a creeper in general, माधबी the particular one.
32767: लतामृग m. (-गः) An ape or monkey. E. लता, and मृग a deer.
32768: लतायष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. लता a creeper, and यष्टि stick or stem.
32769: लतायावक n. (-कं) Coral. E. लता a creeper, यावक barley, or similar grain; of similar shape.
32770: लतारसन m. (-नः) A snake. E. लता a creeper, and रसना the tongue, but made masc. in the compound.
32771: लतार्क m. (-र्कः) A green onion. E. लता a creeper, and अर्क to heat, aff. घञ्.
32772: लतालक m. (-कः) An elephant. E. लता a creeper, and अलक a curl.
32773: लतावेष्टन n. (-नं) Embracing, an embrace. E. लता a creeper, and वेष्टन surrounding.
32774: लतावेष्टितक n. (-कं) An embrace, embracing. E. लता a creeper, (like it,) वेष्टित a surrounding or enfolding, aff. कन्.
32775: लताशङ्ख m. (-ङ्घः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) This word is elsewhere read लताशङ्कु or लतातरु and शङ्कुतरु.
32776: लतिका f. (-का) A twining plant. E. लता the same, कन् aff. fem. form.
32777: लत्तिका f. (-का) A lizard. E. लत a Sautra root, to hurt, तिकन् Uṇādi aff.
32778: लप(ऋ)लपृ r. 1st cl. (लपति) To speak, to utter. With अनु prefixed, 1 To talk like, to mimic. 2 To repeat. With अप, To deny. With आङ्, To address, to speak to, With प्र, To talk incoherently. With प्रति, To gain, to get. With वि, To lament, to bewail. With वि and प्र, To contradict, to dispute. With सम, 1 To converse, to discourse. 2 To be cunning or crafty.
32779: लपन n. (-नं) 1 The mouth. 2 Talking. E. लप to speak, ल्युट् aff. of the instrument or act.
32780: लपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said. n. (-तं) Voice or speech. E. लप to speak, aff. क्त.
32781: लब(इ)लबि r. 1st cl. (लंबते) 1 To sound. 2 To fall or tumble, to be prostrate. With अव prefixed, 1 To hold, to support. 2 To hang from or on, to depend from. 3 To rest upon. 4 To hang with the head downwards. With आङ्, To trust in, to depend on. With वि, To delay, to detain.
32782: लब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Gained, acquired, obtained, received, got. f. (-ब्धा) A woman whose husband or lover is faithless. E. लभ to get, aff. क्त.
32783: लब्धचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Recovered, restored to one's senses, come to a right mind. E. लब्ध, and चेतस् intellect.
32784: लब्धजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born. E. लब्ध, and जन्मन् birth.
32785: लब्धधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wealthy. E. लब्ध, and धन wealth.
32786: लब्धवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Sage, learned, a sage, a Paṇḍita. E. लब्ध got, and वर्ण praise, celebrity.
32787: लब्धविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Learned. E. लब्ध, and विद्या knowledge.
32788: लब्धसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Revived, recovered from fainting. E. लब्ध, and संज्ञा consciousness.
32789: लब्धावकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Having found an opportunity or interval. E. लब्ध, and अवकाश opportunity.
32790: लब्ध्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Obtained. E. लभ to gain, क्त्रिमच् aff.
32791: लब्ध्वा ind. Having gained or got. E. लभ to get, क्त्राच् aff.
32792: लभ(डु अष)डुलभष् r. 1st cl. (लभते) To obtain, to get or gain. (इ) लभि r. 1st cl. (लम्भते) 1 To sound. 2 To injure. 3 To revile. 4 To gain. With उप prefixed. 1 To apprehend, to understand. 2 To delay. With उप and आङ्, To revile, to abuse.
32793: लभस m. (-सः) 1 Wealth. 2 A solicitor, one who asks or solicits. 3 A horse's foot rope. E. लभ to get, Uṇādi aff. असच्.
32794: लभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) 1 Attainable, procurable. 2 Fit, right, proper. E. लभ to get, aff. यत्.
32795: लमक m. (-कः) A lover, a gallant. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, and र changed to ल.
32796: लम्पट m. (-टः) 1 A lecher, a libertine, a whore-monger, a gallant. 2 The Bakula tree.
32797: लम्पटता f. (-ता) Libertinism, dissoluteness. E. लम्पट, and तल् aff.; also लम्पटत्वं.
32798: लम्पाक m. (-कः) 1 A country, the district of Lamghan in Cabul. 2 A libertine, a lecher.
32799: लम्पापटह m. (-हः) A kettle drum, a state drum, the Nakāra of the Muselmans.
32800: लम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 1 Spacious, capacious. 2 Great, large, broad, long, expanded either in breadth or length, or both. 3 Pendulous, depending. m. (-म्बं) 1 A bribe, a present. 2 Moving a man at a sort of backgammon or draughts. 3 A perpendicular, (in geometry.) 4 (In astronomy,) The arc between the pole and zenith of any place. f. (-म्बा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A name of GAURĪ or DURGĀ. 3 A bitter gourd. E. लबि to fall, to sound, aff. अच्.
32801: लम्बक m. (-कः) 1 A section, a chapter. 2 A perpendicular, &c. E. लवि to fall, वुन् aff.
32802: लम्बकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A goat. 2 An elephant. 3 A goblin or Rākṣasa. 4 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) 5 A hare. 6 A name of GAṆEŚA. E. लम्ब large or pendulous, and कर्ण the ear.
32803: लम्बज्या f. (-ज्या) Sine or cosine of the latitude. E. लम्ब, and ज्या sine.
32804: लम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Depending, descending, falling. 2 A long necklace, one which depends from the neck to the navel. m. (-नः) Phlegm, the phlegmatic humour. E. लबि to fall, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
32805: लम्बमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Depending, descending, hanging or falling, going down. 2 Being large or bulky. E. लबि to fall, &c., and शानच् aff., मुक् augment.
32806: लम्बिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. E. लबि to hang down, aff. क्वुन् fem. form.
32807: लम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended, depending, falling or hanging down. E. लबि to fall down, aff. क्त.
32808: लम्बुषा f. (-षा) A necklace of seven strings. E. लबि to depend, उषच् aff.
32809: लम्बोदर m. (-रः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 A glutton. E. लम्ब large, and उदर the belly.
32810: लम्बौष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A camel. E. लम्ब large, and ओष्ठ a lip.
32811: लम्भन n. (-नं) 1 Abuse, reviling. 2 Gaining, getting. E. लभि to sound, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
32812: लम्भयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing to get, procuring, producing. E. लभ to get, causal v., शतृ aff.
32813: लम्भा f. (-म्भा) A sort of chain enclosure or fence.
32814: लम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Caused to get, given to, procured for. 2 Applied to, employed, adapted. 3 Spoken to, addressed. 4 Heightened, improved, rendered more perfect or intense. 5 Cherished. 6 Gained. 7 Abused. E. लभ to gain, causal form, or लभि to revile, क्त aff.
32815: लय r. 1st cl. (लयते) To go, to move.
32816: लय m. (-यः) 1 Equal time in music and dancing. 2 Adhering or clinging to, embracing, uniting. 3 A house, a dwelling. 4 Sport, pastime. n. (-यं) 1 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 Fusion, melting. E. ली to adhere to, &c., aff. अच्.
32817: लयपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) An actress, a dancer. E. लय equal time in music, &c., and पुत्त्री the daughter.
32818: लयालम्ब m. (-म्बः) An actor, a dancer, a mime. E. लय equal time, &c., and आलम्ब who moves to; it also occurs लयारम्भ.
32819: लर्व्व r. 1st cl. (लर्वति) To go, to move.
32820: लल r. 1st cl. (ललति) 1 To sport, to dally. 2 To loll, as the tongue, &c.: see लड, of which it is considered as a various reading only. r. 10th cl. (लालयते) 1 To desire, to wish for, to seek to obtain. 2 To sport, to wanton. 3 To lay.
32821: लल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Sporting, frolicking. 2 Lolling, wagging. 3 Wishing, desirous. E. लड or लल to sport, अच् aff.
32822: ललजिह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Fierce, savage, (as a beast of prey, &c.) m. (-ह्वः) 1 A camel. 2 A dog. E. लल lapping, licking, and जिह्व the tongue.
32823: ललत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Shaking, tremulous. 2 Licking, lapping, stirring or touching with the tongue, lolling the tongue, &c. 3 Wantoning, dallying. E. लड to loll, to frolick, &c. participial aff. शतृ, and ड changed to ल.
32824: ललदम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A flower, (Nerium odorum.) E. लल trembling, अम्बु water.
32825: ललन n. (-नं) 1 Pleasure, sport, pastime. 2 Lolling the tongue. m. (-नः) The Śāl tree. f. (-ना) 1 A woman in general. 2 A wanton woman. 3 The tongue. E. लड to frolic, &c., aff. ल्युट्, and ड changed to ल.
32826: ललन्तिका f. (-का) 1 A necklace hanging as low as the navel. 2 A lizard, a chamæleon. E. ललत् sporting, lolling, &c. fem. form, and कन् added.
32827: ललाक m. (-कः) The penis. E. लड to frolick, aff. आकन्, and ड changed to ल.
32828: ललाट n. (-टं) The forehead. E. लल wish or dalliance, from लड with अच् aff., and अट् to go or be, aff. अण्; also with कन् added ललाटक n. (-कं)
32829: ललाटतट n. (-टं) The forehead. E. ललाट, and तट a bank.
32830: ललाटन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Burning, scorching, (as the sun.) m. (-पः) The sun. E. ललाट the forehead, तप to scorch or inflame, aff. खश्.
32831: ललाटपट्ट n. (-ट्टं) 1 A tiara, a fillet. 2 The forehead. E. ललाट, and पट्ट a cloth or any flat surface.
32832: ललाटफलक n. (-कं) The open forehead. E. ललाट, and फलक a plank.
32833: ललाटरेखा f. (-खा) 1 A line on the forehead, supposed to indicate long life. 2 A wrinkled or corrugated brow. 3 A coloured sectarial mark on the forehead. E. ललाट the forehead, and रेखा a line; also ललाटलेखा.
32834: ललाटिका f. (-का) 1 An ornament worn on the forehead, a jewel or star suspended there, or a kind of tiara bound over it. 2 A mark made with Sandal on the forehead. E. ललाट the forehead, कन् aff. fem. form.
32835: ललाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Beautiful, agreeable, charming, (in this sense some authorities confine it to the neuter gender, and to its use compounded with another word.) n. (-मं) 1 A mark or sign. 2 A banner, a flag, a symbol or ensign. 3 A mark on the forehead. 4 A horn. 5 A tail. 6 Majesty, dignity. 7 Chief, principal. 8 A horse. 9 An ornament. 10 A horse's ornament. 11 A coloured mark on the forehead of a horse or bull, &c. 12 A mane. 13 A line, a row. f. (-नी) An ornament worn in the ear. E. लल to play, &c., aff. क्विप्, अम to go, to contribute to or occasion, aff. अण्; also with कनिन्, aff. ललामन्.
32836: ललामक n. (-कं) A chaplet of flowers falling over the forehead. E. ललाम a mark on the forehead, कन् aff. of comparison.
32837: ललामन् n. (-म) 1 A mark or sign, &c.: see ललाम. 2 A species of stanza having ten syllables in the first two Pādas, eleven in the third, and thirteen in the fourth.
32838: ललित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Beautiful, lovely. 3 Wanton, dallying. 4 Shaken, trembling, tremulous. 5 Graceful. 6 Gay, cheerful, careless. 7 Slow, gentle. 8 Destroyed. n. (-तं) 1 A branch of feminine action, arising from the passion or sentiment of love, and expressive of satisfaction and triumph; softness and delicacy of gesture or motion, putting on appropriate ornaments, &c. 2 Love of pleasure and gaiety. f. (-ता) 1 Musk. 2 A woman in general. 3 A wanton. E. लड to frolick, &c. or लल to desire, aff. क्त; in the first case, ड changed to ख.
32839: लव m. (-वः) 1 Cutting. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 Reaping. 4 Small, little; (according to some authorities, this when used attributively changes its gender, making लवः लवा लवं; according to others it is invariably masc.) 5 Smallness, littleness. 6 A minute division of time, the sixtieth part of the twinkling of an eye. 7 A larger division of time, two Kāṣṭhas or 36 twinklings of the eye, or about 1/2 a second. 8 One of the sons of RĀMACANDRA. 9 A kind of quail. 10 Hair, wool, &c.; that which is cut or shorn from domestic animals. 11 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction. n. (-वं) 1 The nutmeg. 2 Cloves. E. लु to cut, aff. अप्.
32840: लवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what cuts, reaps, cuts off, &c. E. लू to cut, ण्वुल् aff.
32841: लवङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The clove tree, (Myristica caryophyllata.) n. (-ङ्गं) Cloves, the fruit. E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्; also with कन् added, लवङ्गक.
32842: लवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Salt, saline. 2 Handsome, beautiful. n. (-णं) 1 Sea salt. 2 Rock or fossile salt. 3 Factitious salt, or salt obtained by boiling clay found near the sea-shore, or any earth impregnated with saline particles. m. (-णः) 1 The saline or salt taste, saltness. 2 The sea of salt water. 3 The name of a Rākṣasa mentioned in the Rāmāyaṇa. f. (-णा) 1 Light, lustre, beauty. 2 A small river in Tirhut. E. लू to cut, (rawness, or to assist digestion,) aff. ल्यु, and the final letter made nasal by special rule.
32843: लवणखानि m. (-निः) A salt mine in general, or the district of Sāmbher in Ajmere, celebrated for its fossile salt. E. लवण salt, and खानि a mine.
32844: लवणसमुद्र m. (-द्रः) The sea of salt water. E. लवण, and समुद्र ocean.
32845: लवणाकर m. (-रः) A salt mine. E. लवण salt, and आकर a mine.
32846: लवणोत्तम n. (-मं) 1 Nitre. 2 Rock or river salt. E. लवण salt, and उत्तम best.
32847: लवणोद m. (-दः) The sea of salt water. n. (-दं) Brine. E. लवण salt, and उद water.
32848: लवन n. (-नं) 1 Reaping. 2 Cutting. f. (-नी) A coarse kind of custard apple, (Annona reticulata.) E. लू to cut, aff. ल्युट्.
32849: लवली f. (-ली) A kind of creeper.
32850: लवशस् ind. Piece meal, in pieces. E. लव a bit, and शसि aff.
32851: लवाक m. (-कः) A sickle or reaping-hook. E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.
32852: लवाणक n. (-कं) A sickle, a reaping-hook. E. लू to cut, आणक Uṇādi aff.
32853: लवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) Cutting, edged, sharp, (as an instrument, &c.) E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
32854: लवित्र n. (-त्रं) A sickle, a small reaping-hook. E. लू to cut, aff. इत्रन्.
32855: लवेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing to cut or reap. E. लव, and ईप्सु desirous.
32856: लव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut. E. लू to cut, यत् aff.
32857: लश r. 10th cl. (लाशयति) To be skilful or clever, to do any thing skilfully and scientifically.
32858: लशुन n. (-नं) Garlick. E. अश to eat, Uṇādi aff. उनन्, and लश substituted for the root; also with the vowel of the aff. long लशून n. (-नं)
32859: लशुनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Garlicky. n. (-यं) Cat's eye. E. लशुन, and छ aff.
32860: लष r. 1st and 4th cls. (लषति-त or -लष्यति-ते) To desire, to like, to love. (अभि is usually prefixed.) r. 10th cl. (लाषयति) To be skilful.
32861: लष्व m. (-ष्वः) A dancer, an actor. E. लष to be skilled in any art, (as dancing, &c.) and वन् Uṇādi aff.
32862: लस r. 1st cl. (लसति) 1 To embrace. 2 To sport or play. r. 10th cl. (लासयति) 1 To be skilful, to do any thing skilfully or scientifically. 2 To work. With उत् prefixed, 1 To shine, to be brilliant or splendid. 2 To be happy or delighted. With वि, To gambol, to sport, especially amorously.
32863: लसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Sporting, playing. 2 Shining. 3 Glancing, (as rays of light.) E. लस to sport, शतृ aff.
32864: लसा f. (-सा) Turmeric. E. लस to sport, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
32865: लसिका f. (-का) Saliva, spittle. E. रस to taste, &c., aff. वुन्, and र changed to ल.
32866: लस्ज(ओ ई)ओलस्जी r. 6th cl. (लज्जते) To be modest or ashamed.
32867: लस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Grasped, embraced. 2 Skilled, skilful. E. लस to embrace, aff. क्त.
32868: लस्तक m. (-कः) The middle of a bow. E. लस्त grasped, aff. कन्.
32869: लस्तकिन् m. (-की) A bow. E. लस्तक the middle of a bow, and इनि aff.
32870: लहरि f. (-रिः-री) A large wave or surf.
32871: ला r. 2nd cl. (लाति) 1 To give. 2 To get, to receive.
32872: लाक्षणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Secondary, inferior, subordinate. 2 Indicatory, characteristic. 3 Technical. m. (-कः) A technical term, a word implying a definition. E. लक्षण, and ठक् aff.
32873: लाक्षण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Indicative, symptomatic, relating to a mark or sign, &c. E. लक्षण, and यञ् aff.
32874: लाक्षा f. (-क्षा) Lac, a red dye, or an insect which is analogous to the cochineal insect, and like it forms when dried and prepared, a dye of a red colour; the nest is formed of a resinous substance which is used as sealing wax, and is usually termed Shel lac. E. लक्ष to mark or stain, aff. अ, and अण् added, the vowel made long: or लक्ष a hundred thousand, and अण् aff.; made by a multitude of the insects.
32875: लाक्षातरु m. (-रुः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. लाक्षा lac, and तरु a tree; the insect being especially found in this tree.
32876: लाक्षाप्रसादन m. (-नः) The red Lodh, a tree from the bark of which an astringent infusion is prepared, which is used to fix colour in dyeing. E. लाक्षा lac, and प्रसादन cleansing.
32877: लाक्षावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Butea frondosa. E. लाक्षा the lac, and वृक्ष a tree: see लाक्षातरु.
32878: लाक्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Made of lac, &c. 2 Relating to a large number or a lakh. E. लाक्षा, and ठक् aff.
32879: लाख(ऋ)लाखृ r. 1st cl. (लाखति) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To suffice, to be able or competent to. 4 To refuse or prevent.
32880: लाघ(ऋ)लाघृ r. 1st cl. (लाघते) To be able or competent.
32881: लाघव n. (-वं) 1 Health. 2 Lightness, delicacy, minuteness. 3 Meanness, insignificance. 4 Frivolity. E. लघु light, &c., and अण् aff.
32882: लाङ्गल n. (-लं) 1 A plough. 2 The penis. 3 The palm tree. 4 A sort of flower. 5 The main beam of a house. f. (-ली) 1 An aquatic shrub, (Jussieua repens.) 2 A creeping shrub, (Commelina salicifolia.) 3 Another creeper, (Nama repens.) 4 A plant, (Gloriosa superba.) E. लगि to go, to limp, &c., Uṇādi aff. कल, and the vowel made long.
32883: लाङ्गलग्रह m. (-हः) A ploughman. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and ग्रह who takes.
32884: लाङ्गलग्रहण n. (-णं) Guiding the plough, ploughing. E. लाङ्गल, and ग्रहण taking.
32885: लाङ्गलदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The pole or shaft of a plough. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and दण्ड a stick.
32886: लाङ्गलपद्धति f. (-तिः) A furrow. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and पद्धति a line.
32887: लाङ्गलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to a plough. m. (-कः) One of thirty-four species of the fixed, or mineral and vegetable poisons. f. (-का-की) A small creeper, commonly Lāṅgalī, (Gloriosa superba); or, (Commelina salicifolia.) E. लाङ्गली a name of several plants, aff. कन्, fem. form, or लाङ्गल, and ठक् aff.
32888: लाङ्गलिन् m. (-ली) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 The cocoanut tree. 3 A snake. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and इनि aff.
32889: लाङ्गुल n. (-लं) A horse's tail. E. लगि to go, aff. उलच् see the next.
32890: लाङ्गूल n. (-लं) 1 A hairy tail, (as a horse's, &c.) 2 The penis. 3 A granary, a basket or shed for holding corn or grain. E. लगि to go, Uṇādi aff. ऊलच्, and the radical vowel made long.
32891: लाङ्गूलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Tailed. m. (-ली) A monkey. E. लाङ्गूल a tail, aff. इनि.
32893: लाज r. 1st cl. (लाजति) (इ) लाजि (लांजति) 1 To blame or censure. 2 To fry.
32894: लाज m. (-जः) Grain, wetted or sprinkled. n. (-जं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. f. (-जा) or masc. plu. (-जाः) Fried grain. E. लाज to fry, aff. घञ्.
32895: लाञ्छन n. (-नं) 1 A name, an appellation. 2 A mark or sign. E. लाच्छि to mark, aff. ल्युट्.
32896: लाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Old or worn, spoiled, shabby, (as clothes, ornaments, &c.) 2 Childish. m. (-टः) 1 Cloth, clothes. 2 Fault, defect. 3 Idle or inebriate language. 4 Repetition of words in the same sense, but a different application. 5 The name of a country, the upper part of the Dekhin, Lār or Larice. E. लट to be childish, aff. घञ्, or लाट Kaṇḍvādi root, to live, aff. अच्, or लट childish, अण् aff.
32897: लाटानुप्रास m. (-सः) A figure of rhetoric; repetition of a word in the same sense, but with a different application. E. लाट, and अनुप्रास alliteration.
32898: लाप m. (-पः) Speaking, talking. E. लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
32899: लाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be said or spoken. E. लप to speak, aff. ण्यत्.
32900: लाभ r. 10th cl. (लाभयति) To throw, to send or direct.
32901: लाभ m. (-भः) 1 Gain, profit. 2 Gain in general, acquirement, acquisition. E. लभ to get or gain, aff. घञ्.
32902: लाभकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Gaining, making profit. E. लाभ, and कृत् who makes.
32903: लाभलिप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Covetous, grasping, desirous of gain or profit. E. लाभ, and लिप्सु desirous.
32904: लाभालाभ m. (-भः) Profit and loss. E. लाभ, and अलाभ not gain.
32905: लामज्जक n. (-कं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum, a fragrant grass. E. ला what takes or removes (heat, &c.), मज्जा the pith, and कप् added.
32906: लालन n. (-नं) Wheedling, coaxing. E. लल to sport, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
32907: लालप्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bewailing or supplicating much. E. लप to speak, freq. v., शानच् aff.
32908: लालष्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wishing to enjoy. E. लष to desire, freq. v., शानच् aff.
32909: लालसा mf. (-सः-सा) 1 Ardent desire. 2 Regret, sorrow, missing, wishing for any person or object absent. 3 Soliciting, asking. 4 The longing of pregnant women. 5 Wanton sport, dalliance. E. लल to desire, to wish for, असण् Uṇādi aff. or लष to wish, or लस् to sport, aff. घञ् and टाप्, and the root reiterated, deriv. irr.
32910: लालसीक n. (-कं) Sauce, gravy. E. लालसा desire, ईकन् aff.
32911: लाला f. (-ला) Saliva, spittle. E. लल to wish, अच् and टाप् aff.
32912: लालाटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to the forehead, worn on it, belonging to it, &c. 2 Contemplating the forehead, looking at it, &c. 3 Low, vile. 4 Relating to fate or destiny. mf. (-कः-की) 1 An attentive servant, one who watches a master's countenance, and learns by it what is necessary to be done. 2 An idler, one who is unable to work. m. (-कः) A mode of embracing. E. ललाट the forehead, aff. ठक्.
32913: लालामेह m. हः Passing mucous urine. E. लाला, and मेह urine.
32914: लालाविष m. (-षः) An insect, whose spittle is venomous or acrid, as a spider, &c. E. लाला saliva, and विष venom.
32915: लालास्राव m. (-वः) A spider. E. लाला saliva, स्रु to distil, aff. अण्.
32916: लालिक m. (-कः) A buffalo. f. (-का) A jesting or evasive reply, equivoque. E. लाला saliva, ठक् aff.
32917: लालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Loved, desired. 2 Cherished, treated tenderly. 3 Coaxed, wheedled, seduced. E. लल to desire, causal v., क्त aff.
32918: लालित्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Beauty, loveliness. 2 Gaiety. 3 Gracefulness, &c. E. ललित, and ष्यञ् aff.
32919: लालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Wheedling, coaxing, fondling. m. (-ली) A seducer. f. (-लिनी) A wanton. E. लल to sport, causal v., घिनुण् aff.
32920: लालुका f. (-का) A sort of necklace.
32921: लाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Cutting down. mf. (-वः-वा) A sort of quail, (Perdix chinensis.) E. लू to cut, to eat (corn,) causal form, aff. अच्; also with कन् added, लावक m. (-कः)
32922: लावण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Salted, dressed or cooked with salt. 2 Salt, belonging or relating to it, &c. E. लवण salt, aff. अण्.
32923: लावणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Salted, cooked or dressed with salt. 2 Relating to salt, &c. 3 Lovely, beautiful. m. (-कः) A vender of salt, a salt merchant. n. (-कं) A vessel holding salt, a saltcellar. E. लवण salt, aff. ठक्.
32924: लावण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Saltness, the taste or property of salt. 2 Beauty, loveliness. E. लवण salt, and यञ् aff.
32925: लावण्यश्री f. (-श्रीः) Great beauty. E. लावण्य, and श्री wealth.
32926: लावण्यार्जित n. (-तं) Property belonging to a woman, consisting of that which has been presented to her at her marriage as a token of respect, as a mark of kindness, or by her father or mother-in-law. E. लावण्य loveliness, and अर्जित acquired.
32927: लाविक m. (-कः) A buffalo. E. लव cutting, ठक् aff.
32928: लावु f. (-वुः-वूः) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.) E. लू to cut, to destroy, (disease,) aff. उण्; also with कन् added लावुका, and with अ or आङ् prefixed, अलावु, आलावु.
32929: लाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut, to be cut off or drown. E. लू to cut, ण्यत् aff.
32930: लास m. (-सः) 1 Dancing in general. 2 Dancing, as practised by women: see लास्य. 3 Pulse that has been steeped or slightly boiled, pea-water, &c. not thickened to the consistency of Yūṣa or pease soup. 4 Dalliance, wanton sport, &c. E. लस to sport, aff. घञ्.
32931: लासक m. (-कः) 1 A dancer, an actor, a mime. 2 A peacock. 3 Embracing, enfolding, surrounding. 4 One who sports or gambols. n. (-कं) A turret, a room on the top of a building. f. (-लासिका or लासकी) 1 A female dancer, a Nāc girl. 2 A wanton, a harlot. E. लस to embrace, to be skilful, (in the art of dancing,) and aff. ण्वुल्.
32932: लास्फोटनी f. (-नी) A gimlet, an auger. E. ललन going, आस्फोटन piercing, deriv. irr.
32933: लास्य n. (-स्यं) Dancing in general. 2 Symphony, or union of song, dance, and instrumental music. 3 A mode of dancing; the Nāc of India, or dance practised by women chiefly, and confined to attitude and gesticulation, with a shuffling motion of the feet seldom lifted from the ground; this style is said to have been invented by PĀRVATĪ, and communicated by her to the daughter of Vāṇāsura, by whom her female friends and companions were instructed in it; as a species, it is opposed to the Tāṇḍava, the more boisterous dance of ŚIVA, and his followers or men. 4 A part or embellishment of dramatic composition, the occasional introduction of music and singing; also abrupt transition from Prākṛta to Sanscrit and Sanscrit to Prākṛta, &c. m. (-स्यः) A dancer. f. (-स्या) A female dancer. E. लम to be skilled in the art of dancing, ण्यत् aff.
32934: लास्यक n. (-कं) Dancing in general, or a particular style of dancing. E. लास्य as above, कन् pleonasm.
32935: लास्याङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A part of a drama, of the Lāsya order: see लास्य. E. लास्य, and अङ्ग a part.
32936: लि m. (-लिः) 1 Weariness, fatigue. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 End, term. 4 Equality, sameness. 5 A bracelet. E. ला to take, or ली to melt, &c., aff. कि.
32937: लिकुच m. (-चः) A sort of bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. लकुच q. v. and इ substituted for the first vowel.
32938: लिक्षा m. (-क्षा) A nit, a young louse. E. a various reading of लिक्षा.
32939: लिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 A nit, a young louse, or the egg of a louse. 2 A poppy seed, considered as a measure of weight, or 1/6th of a mustard seed. E. लक्ष to mark, aff. घञ्, इ substituted for the radical vowel and the deriv. irr.; also क्क being substituted for the final लिक्का, and with कन् added, fem. form, लिक्षिका again with ई substituted for the radical vowel लीक्षा, &c.
32940: लिख r. 6th cl. (लिखति) To write. r. 1st cl. (लेखति) To go.
32941: लिख m. (-खः) 1 Writing. 2 A writer. E. लिख to write, क aff.
32942: लिखखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खती-खत्) 1 Writing. 2 Painting, delineating. 3 Scratching, making streaks or lines. E. लिख to write, शतृ aff.
32943: लिखन n. (-नं) 1 Scripture, writing. 2 A writing, a written document. 3 Scratching. 4 Scarifying. E. लिख to write, aff. क्युच्, and the vowel unchanged.
32944: लिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Written. 2 Drawn, delineated, painted: (painting being considered a sort of writing) 3 Drawn as lines, scratched. 4 Scarified. n. (-तं) 1 Scripture, writing. 2 A writing, a manuscript, a written book or paper. E. लिख to write, aff. क्त.
32945: लिखित्वा ind. Having written, delineated, &c. E. लिख to write, क्त्वाच् aff.
32946: लिख्या f. (-ख्या) A poppy seed, considered as a minute measure of weight, variously estimated at four or eight Trasareṇus or motes, or the sixth part of a mustard seed, &c. E. लिख to write, क्यप् aff.
32947: लिग(इ)लिगि r. 1st cl. (लिङ्गति) To go, to move. r. 1st and 10th cls. (लिङ्गति लिङ्गयति) To paint, to variegate. With आङ् prefixed, To embrace.
32948: लिगु n. (-गु) 1 The heart, the mind. m. (-गुः) 1 A fool, a blockhead. 2 A deer. 3 Part of the earth. E. लग to be near or with, Uṇādi aff. कु, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
32949: लिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A mark, a spot, a stain, a sign, a token, &c. 2 The penis. 3 The phallus, or ŚIVA under that emblem. 4 Inference, probable conclusion. 5 The premises leading to a conclusion. 6 Nature or Prakṛti, according to the Sāṃkhya philosophy, which considers this as the active power in creation. 7 Gender, (as पुंलिङ्गः the masculine gender, &c.) 8 The order of the religious student. 9 Symptom or mark of disease. E. लिगि to go, &c., aff. अच्.
32950: लिङ्गक m. (-कः) The elephant or wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium, &c.) E. लिङ्ग the penis, and कन् aff.
32952: लिङ्गनाश m. (-शः) 1 Loss of any characteristic mark, &c. 2 Loss of vision from cataract, &c. considered to be discoloration of the pupil, either red, white, or yellow. 3 Loss of the penis. E. लिङ्ग mark (of the eye), नाश destruction.
32953: लिङ्गवर्द्धन m. (-नः) The elephant or wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium.) E. लिङ्ग the penis, and वर्द्धन increasing.
32955: लिङ्गवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A religious hypocrite, one who assumes the dress, &c. of an ascetic in order to get a livelihood. E. लिङ्ग a mark, external shew or sign, (as the clotted hair, &c.) and वृत्ति practice.
32956: लिङ्गस्थ m. (-स्थः) A religious student. E. लिङ्ग, and स्थ who stays.
32957: लिङ्गालिका f. (-का) A small mouse or shrew.
32958: लिङ्गार्च्चन n. (-नं) Worship of the Liṅga or phallus. E. लिङ्ग, and अर्च्चण worshipping.
32959: लिङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) 1 Having marks, &c. 2 Indicated, characterized. m. (-ङ्गी) 1 An elephant. 2 A hypocrite, a pretended devotee. 3 An ascetic. 4 A religious student. 5 A worshipper of ŚIVA in the phallic type. E. लिङ्ग a mark, and इनि aff.
32960: लिङ्गिवेष m. (-षः) 1 The dress or the insignia of a religious student, the skin, staff, bowl, &c. 2 The dress or appearance of a follower of ŚIVA. E. लिङ्ग, and वेष attire.
32961: लिप(ञि औ)ञि औलिप r. 6th cl. (-लिम्पति-ते) 1 To increase or add to. 2 To anoint, to smear, to plaster.
32962: लिप m. (-पः) Smearing, plastering. E. लिप to smear, aff. क.
32963: लिपि f. (-पिः-पी) 1 Writing in general, handwriting. 2 A writing, a written paper or book, &c. 3 Painting, drawing, 4 Smearing, anointing, plastering. E. लिप to spread (ink) Uṇādi aff. इन् with ङीप् optionally added, the radical vowel unchanged.
32964: लिपिकर m. (-रः) A scribe, a writer. E. लिपि writing, and कर who executes.
32965: लिपिका f. (-का) Writing or a writing. E. लिपि writing, कन् added, fem. form.
32966: लिपिकार m. (-रः) A scribe, a writer. E. लिपि writing, and कार who makes, from कृ to make, and अण् aff.; also with ट aff. लिपिकर.
32967: लिपिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who can write. E. लिपि, and ज्ञ who knows.
32968: लिपिसज्जा f. (-ज्जा) Implements or materials for writing. E. लिपि, सज्जा preparation.
32969: लिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Smeared, anointed, plastered, spread. 2 Eaten. 3 Envenomed, spread or touched with any poisonous substance. 4 Embraced, united, connected with, &c. 5 Defiled or contaminated by. 6 Stained, soiled. E. लिप to smear, aff. क्त, or in the last sense ली to cling to, Uṇādi aff. त, with पुट् augment, and the radical vowel made short.
32970: लिप्तक m. (-कः) A poisoned arrow. E. लिप्त poisoned, कन् aff.
32971: लिप्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Anointed, plastered. 2 Touched. 3 Vitiated, defiled. E. लिप to smear, क्तवतु aff.
32972: लिप्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Having the hands stained or smeared. E. लिप्त, and हस्त the hand.
32973: लिप्सा f. (-प्सा) Wish, desire. E. लिप्स the desiderative form of लभ to get, (to wish to get,) aff. अङ् and टाप्.
32974: लिप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Coveted, desired. E. लिप्स to wish to obtain, क्त aff.
32975: लिप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous, desiring, wishing, cupidinous. E. लिप्स desiderative of लभ, (see the last,) and उ aff.
32976: लिम्प m. (-म्पः) Smearing, anointing, plastering. E. लिप to smear, (taking in its derivative forms the nasal augment,) and श aff.
32977: लिम्पट m. (-टः) A lecher, a whore-monger. E. लिपि to smear with unguents, अटच् aff.; also लम्पट.
32978: लिम्पाक m. (-कः) 1 The lime tree, (Citrus acida.) 2 An ass. E. लिपि to smear, aff. काकन्.
32979: लिवि f. (-विः-वी) Writing, hand-writing, or a writing, a manuscript. E. लिप to smear (with ink), Uṇādi aff. इन्, with the vowel unchanged, and व substituted for प.
32980: लिविकर m. (-रः) A scribe, a writer. E. लिवि writing, and कर who executes.
32981: लिविङ्कर m. (-रः) A writer, a scribe. E. लिवि writing, कृ to practise, खच् aff.
32982: लिश(औ)लिशौ r. 4th cl. (लिश्यते) To lessen or become less. r. 6th cl. (लिशति) To go, to move, to approach.
32983: लिष्व m. (-ष्वः) A dancer, an actor. E. लष to be skilled (in dancing), Uṇādi aff. क्वन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
32984: लिह r. 2nd cl. (लेढि लीढे) To taste, to taste with the tongue, to lick.
32985: ली r. 4th cl. (लीयते) r. 9th cl. (लिनाति) 1 To join, to adhere or cling to, to be in union or connexion with. 2 To obtain. r. 10th cl. (लयति लाययति लापयति लालयति or लीनयति) To melt, to liquefy, to fuse or dissolve. With आङ्, To waste away. With प्र and वि, To acquire or gain.
32986: ली f. (-लीः) Embracing. E. ली to embrace, क्विप् aff.
32987: लीक्का f. (-क्का) A nit: see लिक्का.
32988: लीक्षा f. (-क्षा) A nit: see लिक्षा.
32989: लीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Eaten. 2 Licked. E. लिह to lick or taste, aff. क्त, form irr.
32990: लीढमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Rejected after being tasted. E. लीढ, and मुक्त let go.
32991: लीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Embraced, clung or adhered to. 2 Melted, dissolved. 3 Dissolved with softness, overcome with passion. 4 Diffused. 5 Effaced, wiped away. 6 Staying, being situated. 7 Left, departed. E. ली to be in contact, &c., क्त aff.
32992: लीला f. (-ला) 1 A branch of feminine action, proceeding from love; or the imitation of a lover's manner, speech, gait, &c. by his mistress, to pass the time in his absence. 2 Play, sport, pastime in general. 3 Amorous or wanton sport. 4 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. ली embrace, ला to get or give, aff. क and टाप्.
32993: लीलाखेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Playful. m. (-लः) A species of the Atiśarkarī metre.
32994: लीलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done or written sportively, or in the way of sport or pleasure. E. लीला used as a verb, aff. क्त.
32995: लीलावती f. (-ती) A wanton or sportful woman. E. लीला, and मतुप् aff.
32996: लीलोद्यान n. (-नं) A pleasure ground, a garden. E. लीला sport, and उद्यान a garden.
32997: लु m. (-लुः) Cutting, lopping, shearing, reaping, &c. E. लू to cut, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel made short.
32998: लुच(इ)लुचि r. 1st cl. (लुञ्चति) 1 To cut. 2 To pare or peel.
32999: लुच् f. (-लुक्) Cutting off, dropping, rejecting. E. लुच to cut, क्विप् aff.
33000: लुञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut. 2 Peeled. E. लुच to cut, क्त aff.
33001: लुज(इ)लुजि r. 10th cl. (लुञ्जयति) 1 To give. 2 To injure. 3 To be strong. 4 To dwell. 5 To shine.
33002: लुट(ऌ)लुटॢ r. 1st cl. (लोटति-ते) r. 4th cl. (लुट्यति) 1 To stir, to agitate. 2 To be joined or connected with. 3 To roll upon the ground. r. 1st cl. (लोटति) 1 To resist or oppose. 2 To strike again. 3 To shine. r. 6th cl. (लुटति) To embrace. r. 10th cl. (लोटयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. (इ) लुटि r. 1st and 10th  cls. (लुण्टति लुण्टयति) 1 To steal, to rob or plunder. 2 To disregard, to disobey or disrespect.
33003: लुट्यत् mfn. (-ट्यन्-ट्यन्ती-ट्यत्) Rolling about, (in pain or grief.) E. लुट to roll about, शतृ aff.
33004: लुठ r. 1st cl. (लोठति) To knock down. (लोठते) To resist or oppose. r. 6th cl. (लुठति) To be connected or in contact with, to rest in or on. r. 1st and 6th cls. (लोठते लुठति) 1 To roll on the ground. 2 To flow, to trickle. r. 10th cl. (लोठयति) To rob. (इ) लुठि r. 1st cl. (लुण्ठति) 1 To be lazy. 2 To repel, to resist or oppose. 3 To go, to move. 4 To steal. 5 To be lame.
33005: लुठत् mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्) 1 Rolling on the ground, falling down. 2 Flowing, trickling. E. लुठ to roll, शतृ aff.
33006: लुठन n. (-नं) 1 A horse's rolling himself on the ground. 2 Rolling on the ground with sorrow or vexation, &c. E. लुट or लुठ to cast one's self on the ground, aff. क्युच्.
33007: लुठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolling on the ground, (as a horse, &c.) m. (-तः) A horse rolling himself on the ground, &c. E. लुठ to roll on the ground, aff. क्त.
33008: लुड r. 1st cl. (लोडति) To agitate, to stir, to churn. r. 1st and 6th cls. (लोडति लुडति) 1 To be in connexion or contact with any thing, to join, to adhere to, to rest in or on, &c. 2 To embrace. r. 6th cl. (-लुडति) To cover, to conceal. (इ) लुडि r. 10th cl. (लुण्ठयति) 1 To be agitated. 2 To plunder.
33009: लुण्टक m. (-कः) A sort of potherb, (Chironia centauroides, &c.) E. लुटि to be prostrate, &c., aff. क्वुन्.
33010: लुण्टा f. (-ण्टा) A horse's rolling himself on the ground. E. लुटि or लुठि to roll on the ground, aff. अङ् and टाप्; also लुण्ठा and लुण्ठि.
33011: लुण्टाक m. (-कः) A robber, a thief. E. लुटि to rob, काकन् aff.
33012: लुण्ठत् mfn. (-ण्ठन्-ण्ठन्ती-ण्ठत्) Rolling on the ground. E. लुठि to roll, &c. शतृ aff.
33013: लुण्ठन n. (-नं) Rolling on the ground. E. लुठि To roll on the ground, aff. ल्युट्.
33014: लुण्ठा f. (-ण्ठा) A horse's rolling on the ground: see the last, and लुण्टा.
33015: लुण्ठाक m. (-कः) A crow. E. लुठि to roll on the ground, काकन् aff.
33016: लुण्ठी f. (-ण्ठी) A horse's rolling himself on the ground. E. लुठि to roll on the ground, aff. अच् and ङीप्.
33017: लुण्डी f. (-ण्डी) Observing the rules of princely conduct, acting and judging rightly. E. लुडि to be agitated, &c., aff. अच् and ङीप्; also with कन् added, fem. form लुण्डिका.
33018: लुथ(इ)लुथि r. 1st cl. (लुन्थति) 1 To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. 2 To afflict. 3 To suffer pain or affliction.
33019: लुप r. 4th cl. (लुप्यति) To disturb, to bewilder, to perplex and confound the understanding. (ऌ औ ऋ) औलुपॢ r. 6th cl. (लुम्पति-ते) 1 To cut, to divide, to cut off or down. 2 To rob.
33020: लुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Gone, lost, disappeared. 2 (In grammar,) Cut, off, rejected. n. (-प्तं) Booty, plunder. E. लुप to rob, aff. क्त.
33021: लुप्तता f. (-ता) Disappearance, non-existence. E. लुप्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, लुप्तत्वं.
33022: लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Deprived of funeral rites. E. लुप्त, पिण्डोदक cake and water, क्रिया rite.
33023: लुप्तोपमा f. (-मा) An imperfect comparison. E. लुप्त, and उपमा simile.
33024: लुब(इ)लुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लुम्बति लुम्बयति) To hurt, to pain, to afflict or torment. r. 10th cl. (लुम्बयति) To disappear.
33025: लुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Covetous, greedy, desirous, cupidinous. m. (-ब्धः) 1 A hunter. 2 A lecher, a libertine. E. लुभ to desire, to wish for vehemently, to covet, aff. क्त.
33026: लुब्धक m. (-कः) 1 A hunter. 2 A libertine, a rake, a whoremonger. 3 A covetous or greedy man. E. लुब्ध desirous, aff. कन्.
33027: लुभ r. 4th cl. (लुभ्यति) To desire, to covet. r. 6th cl. (लुभति) To bewilder, to perplex or delude. With प्र or सं, To attract or allure.
33028: लुभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perplexed, deluded, fascinated. E. लुभ to fascinate, aff. क्त.
33029: लुल r. 1st cl. (लोलति) 1 To stir or agitate, to make tremulous. 2 To be attached to or connected with, to join.
33030: लुलाप m. (-पः) A buffalo. E. लुल to agitate, aff. क, stirring, shaking, (in the mud,) आप् to get or obtain, aff. अच्; it is also read लुलाय.
33031: लुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, trembling, tremulous, agitated, stirred. 2 Heaving, panting. 3 Agreeable, pleasing, beautiful, elegant. 4 Injured, destroyed. E. लुल to agitate, aff. क्त.
33032: लुष r. 1st and 10th cls. (लोषति लोषयति) 1 To rob, to steal. 2 To hurt, to kill.
33033: लुषभ m. (-भः) An elephant in rut. E. रुष to be enraged, Uṇādi aff. अभच्, with लुष substituted for the root, and the vowel unchanged.
33034: लू(लू) r. 9th cl. (लुनाति लुनीते) To cut.
33035: लूता f. (-ता) 1 A spider. 2 An ant. 3 Local inflammation produced by the urine of a spider. E. लू to cut, क्तन् aff.
33036: लूतिका f. (-का) A spider. E. लूता a spider, कन् aff., fem. form.
33037: लून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Cut. 2 Wounded. 3 Cut off. E. लू to cut, aff. क्त.
33038: लूनक m. (-कः) 1 An animal. 2 Sort, species, difference. 3 A wound, a division, what is cut or broken. E. लून cut, and कन् added.
33039: लूनि f. (-निः) Cutting, reaping. E. लू To cut, aff. क्तिन्, and न substituted for the final.
33040: लूम n. (-मं) 1 A tail. 2 A hairy tail, as a horse's, a monkey's, &c. E. लू to cut, aff. मन्.
33041: लूमविष m. (-षः) Any animal that stings with its tail, as a scorpion, &c. E. लूम a tail, and विष venom.
33042: लूष r. 1st cl. (लूषति) To adorn, to decorate. r. 10th cl. (लोषयति) 1 To hurt, to injure. 2 To steal, to rob.
33043: लृञ्च r. 1st cl. (लृञ्चति) To put away.
33044: लेख m. (-खः) 1 A letter, an epistle. 2 A god, a deity. f. (-खा) 1 A line, a mark or row, &c. 2 Writing, hand-writing. 3 Delineation, painting. E. लिख to write, aff. घञ्; it is applied to the second sense, because the figures of the gods are written or delineated.
33045: लेखक m. (-कः) A writer, a scribe, a clerk, a copyist, &c. E. लिस्व to write, aff. ण्वुल्.
33046: लेखन n. (-नं) 1 Writing, scripture. 2 The bark of the Bhoj tree, which is used for writing on in Nepal and Upper Hindustan. 3 Vomiting. 4 The leaf of the palm tree. 5 Scraping or  cleaning the tongue. 6 Scarifying, scratching. 7 Reducing corpulency, thinning. m.
