(-नः) A sort of grass or reed, of which pens are made, (Saccharum spontaneum.) f. (-नी) A pen, a style. E. लिख to write, aff. of the act or instrument ल्युट्.
33047: लेखनवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Use of enemas to reduce corpulency. E. लेखन, and वस्ति a glyster.
33048: लेखनिक m. (-कः) 1 A letter-carrier, an express, a postman. 2 One who signs a paper by proxy, who makes his mark, from inability to write, &c. E. लेखन writing, and ठक् aff.
33049: लेखनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be written. n. (-यं) An accusation or defence in law, which are required to be given in writing. E. लिख to write, अनीयर् aff.
33050: लेखर्षभ m. (-भः) INDRA. E. लेख a deity, and ऋषभ best.
33051: लेखहार m. (-रः) A letter-carrier. E. लेख a letter, हृ to convey, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, लेखहारक, or with णिनि, लेखहारिन्.
33052: लेखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Written. E. लिख to write, क्त aff., and the vowel changed.
33053: लेख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) 1 To be written. 2 To be scarified. n. (-ख्यं) 1 A letter, an epistle. 2 A manuscript. 3 A drawing, a delineation. 4 A written accusation or defence. E. लिख to write, ख्यत् aff.
33054: लेख्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Written, in writing, epistolary. E. कन् added to the last.
33055: लेख्यकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done in writing, contracted, executed. E. लेख्य, and कृत done.
33056: लेख्यचूर्णिका f. (-का) A brush, a pencil. E. लख्य a delineation, चूर्ण to pound or grind, aff. वुन् and टाप्.
33057: लेख्यपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A leaf or sheet of any thing for writing. 2 A written paper, a writing, a letter. E. लेख्य, and पत्र a leaf.
33058: लेख्यपत्रक m. (-कः) The palm tree. n. (-कं) A leaf of the palm or any other substance used for writing on. E. लेख्य writing, पत्र a leaf, कन् aff.; books in the south of India, &c. being made of the leaves of the palmyra.
33059: लेख्यप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Written contract, record, or document. E. लेख्य, and प्रसङ्ग application.
33060: लेख्यस्थान n. (-नं) An office, a counting house, &c. E. लेख्य writing or what is to be written, and स्थान place.
33061: लेख्यारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Recorded, committed to writing. E. लेख्य, and आरूढ mounted.
33062: लेप(ऋ)लेपृ r. 1st cl. (लेपते) To go, to approach.
33063: लेप m. (-पः) 1 Plastering, smearing. 2 Food. 3 Mortar, plaster, Chunam. 4 Stain, spot, smearing. 5 The wipings of the hand which has offered funeral oblations to three ancestors, and which are considered as an oblation to ancestors in the 4th, 5th, and 6th degrees. E. लिप to smear, &c., aff. घञ्.
33064: लेपक m. (-कः) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. लिप to smear, (Chunam.) ण्वुल् aff.
33065: लेपन n. (-नं) Smearing, plastering, anointing. E. लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.
33066: लेपभागिन् m. (-गी) An ancestor in the 4th, 5th, and 6th degrees. E. लेप, and भागिन् who shares.
33067: लेपभुज् m. (-भुक्) A paternal ancestor of the 4th, 5th, or 6th degree. E. लेप, and भुज् who eats.
33068: लेपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Who or what smears, plasters, anoints, &c. m. (-पी) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. लेप to plaster, and इनि aff.
33069: लेप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be spread, as unguent or plaster, to be anointed or plastered. n. (-प्यं) Plastering, spreading or smearing ointment, mortar, &c. E. लिप to plaster, ण्यत् aff.
33070: लेप्यकृत् m. (-कृत्) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. लेप्य plastering, and कृत् who makes.
33071: लेप्यमयी f. (-यी) A doll, a puppet. E. लेप्य plastering, मयट् aff., made of wood with a coat of plaster.
33072: लेप्यस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A woman, perfumed with fragrant unguents. E. लेप्य plastering, and स्त्री a woman.
33073: लेलिह m. (-हः) A worm breeding in the stomach. E. लिह to lick, root red., क aff.
33074: लेलिहान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what licks. m. (-नः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A snake. E. लिह to lick, aff. शानच्, root reduplicate, form irr.
33075: लेश adj. masc. only. (-शः) Small, little. subst. 1 Smallness, littleness. 2 A little. E. लिश to be small, aff. घञ्, some authorities vary the gender of the attribute.
33076: लेष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A clod of earth. E. लिश to become less or small, तुन् Uṇādi aff.
33077: लेष्टुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A harrow. E. लेष्टु a clod of earth, and घ्न destroying.
33078: लेष्टुभेदन m. (-नः) A harrow. E. लेष्टु a clod of earth, and भेदन breaking; also लेष्टुभेदिन् and लोष्टभेदन, &c.
33079: लेसिक m. (-कः) The rider on an elephant, who sits on the animal's loins.
33080: लेह m. (-हः) 1 Food. 2 Licking, tasting. E. लिह to taste, aff. ण.
33081: लेहन n. (-नं) Licking, tasting with the tongue. E. लिह to taste, to lick, aff. ल्युट्.
33082: लेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Who or what licks, laps, tastes, &c. E. लिह to lick, घिनुण् aff.
33083: लेहिन m. (-नः) Borax. E. लिह to lick, aff. इन.
33084: लेह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be licked. n. (-ह्यं) 1 The food or beverage of the gods, nectar, ambrosia. 2 Syrup, electuary. E. लिह to taste, क्यप् aff.
33085: लैण(ऋ)लैणृ r. 1st cl. (लैनति) 1 To go or move. 2 To command or direct an act. 3 To touch or embrace. 4 To pound or grind.
33086: लोक(ऋ)लोकृ r. 1st cl. (लोकति) To see. r. 10th cl. (लोकयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine.
33087: लोक m. (-कः) 1 Man, mankind. 2 A world, a division of the universe; in general three Lokas are enumerated, or heaven, hell, and earth: another classification enumerates seven, exclusive of the infernal regions; or Bhūr-loka the earth, Bhuvar-loka the space between the earth and the sun, the region of the Munis, Siddhis, &c.; Svarloka the heaven of INDRA, between the sun and the polar star; Maharloka the usual abode of BHṚGU, and other saints, who are supposed to be co-existent with BRAHMĀ: during the conflagration of these lower worlds, the saints ascend to the next, or Janaloka, which is described as the abode of BRAHMĀ'S sons, SANAKA, SĀNANDA, SANĀTANA, and SANATKUMĀRA; above this, is the fifth world  or the Tapoloka, where the deities called Vairāgis reside; the seventh world, Satyaloka or Brahmaloka, is the abode of BRAHMĀ, and translation to this world exempts beings from further birth; the three first worlds are destroyed at the end of each Kalpa or day of BRAHMĀ; the three last at the end of his life, or of 100 of his years; the fourth Loka is equally permanent, but is uninhabitable from heat, at the time the three first are burning: another enumeration calls these seven worlds, earth, sky, heaven, middle region, place of births, mansion of the blest, and abode of truth, placing the sons of BRAHMĀ in the sixth division, and stating the fifth or Janaloka to be that, where animals destroyed in the general conflagration are born again. 3 Sight, seeing. 4 An element, a primary or radical part of being. E. लोक to see, aff. घ.
33088: लोककृत् m. (-कृत्) The Creator, BRAHMĀ. E. लोक, and कृत् who makes.
33089: लोकचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) The sun. E. लोक the world, चक्षुच् the eye.
33090: लोकजित् m. (-जित्) 1 A conqueror of the world. 2 A sage. 3 A Buddha or Bauddha deified teacher. E. लोक the world, and जित् who conquers.
33091: लोकत्रय n. (-यं-यी) The three worlds, heaven, earth, and hell. E. लोक, and त्रय triad.
33092: लोकनाथ m. (-थः) 1 A sovereign of the universe. 2 One of the Jaina or Bauddha saints. E. लोक the world, नाथ lord.
33093: लोकनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Visible, to be seen. E. लोक to see, अनीयर् aff.
33094: लोकपाल m. (-लः) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A divinity who protects the regions, or the sun, moon, fire, wind, INDRA, YAMA, VARUṆA, and KUVERA. E. लोक the world, and पाल a cherisher; also लोकपालक.
33095: लोकप्रवाद m. (-दः) Common or current report or saying. E. लोक, and प्रवाद report.
33096: लोकप्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Notorious, well known. E. लोक, and प्रसिद्ध celebrated.
33097: लोकबान्धव m. (-वः) The sun. E. लोक the world, and बान्धव the friend.
33098: लोकमातृ f. (-ता) LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU, and goddess of wealth and fortune. E. लोक the world, and मातृ the mother.
33099: लोकयात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Worldly affairs, civil conduct, usage, practice. 2 Resort of men, traffic, intercourse. E. लोक, and यात्रा going.
33100: लोकरञ्जन n. (-नं) Popularity, gaining public confidence. E. लोक, and रञ्जन pleasing.
33101: लोकलोचन m. (-नः) The sun. E. लोक the world, and लोचन the eye.
33102: लोकवाद m. (-दः) Rumour, report. E. लोक, and वाद speech.
33103: लोकवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) An outcaste, one who observes no sort of institutes, and feeds on the flesh of horses and kine. E. लोक mankind, and वाह्य for वहिर् without, excluded.
33104: लोकविक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Censured or condemned by the world. E. लोक, and विक्रुष्ट censured.
33105: लोकविश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, famous. 2 Current. E. लोक, and विश्रुत heard.
33106: लोकविश्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 Unfounded rumour or report. 2 Fame, notoriety. E. लोक the world, and विश्रुति rumour.
33107: लोकवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Worldly or idle conversation and intercourse, E. लोक, and वृत्त practice.
33108: लोकात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The universal spirit. E. लोक, and आत्मन् soul.
33109: लोकान्तर n. (-रं) Another world. E. लोक, and अन्तर other.
33110: लोकान्तरगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead. E. लोकान्तर, and गत gone.
33111: लोकान्तरप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Dead. E. लोकान्तर, and प्राप्त obtained.
33112: लोकायत n. (-तं) The system of atheistical philosophy taught by Cārvāka. E. लोक the world, आङ् before यति to strive, aff. अच्.
33113: लोकायतिक m. (-कः) A follower of the Cārvāka doctrine, an atheist, an unbeliever. E. लोकायत as above, and ठक् aff. with the vowel unchanged.
33114: लोकालोक m. (-कः) A mountainous belt, surrounding the outermost of the seven seas and bounding the world. E. लोक seeing, and अलोक not seeing; causing light and darkness, as interposed between the Dvīpas and the sun.
33115: लोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. लोक to see, क्त aff.
33116: लोकेश m. (-शः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A king, an emperor. 3 A Jaina deified sage. E. लोक the world, and ईश sovereign.
33117: लोकेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A king. 3 A Jaina deified sage. E. लोक the world, and ईश्वर sovereign.
33118: लोकेश्वरात्मजा f. (-जा) A female deity peculiar to the Jainas. E. लोकेश्वर a Jaina sage, and आत्मजा a daughter.
33119: लोच(ऋ)लोचृ r. 1st cl. (लोचते) To see, to perceive, to view or inspect. r. 10th cl. (लोचयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. With आङ्, To consider.
33120: लोचक m. (-कः) 1 A ball or lump of flesh or meat. 2 The pupil of the eye. 3 Stibium or lamp-black, &c. so used. 4 An ornament, worn by women on the forehead. 5 Blue or black vesture. 6 An ear-ring. 7 The plantain tree. 8 A bow-string. 9 A wrinkled or contracted eye-brow. 10 Folly, stupidity. 11 The rejected slough of the snake. E. लोच to see, ण्वुल् aff.
33121: लोचन n. (-नं) The eye. f. (-ना) A goddess of the Jainas. E. लोच to see, ल्यु or युच् aff.
33122: लोचनामय m. (-यः) Diseased affection of the eye, Ophthalmia, &c. E. लोचन the eye, आमय sickness.
33124: लोचमस्तक m. (-कः) A flower, (Celosia cristata.) E. लोच sight, seeing, and मस्तक head.
33125: लोट(ऋ)लोदृ r. 1st cl. (लोटति) To be mad or foolish.
33126: लोटन n. (नं) Tumbling, rolling. E. लुट to roll, ल्युट् aff.
33127: लोड(ऋ)लोडृ r. 1st cl. (लोडति) To be mad, to be frantic or foolish.
33128: लोत mn. (-तः-तं) 1 Plunder, booty, stolen goods. 2 A tear, tears 3 A mark, a spot, a sign. E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. तन्.
33129: लोत्र n. (-त्रं) Plunder, booty, stolen goods. E. लू to cut, ष्ट्रन् aff.
33130: लोध m. (-धः) A sort of tree: see the next.
33131: लोध्र m. (-ध्रः) A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing, (Symplocos racemosa.) E. रुध to hinder, aff. रन्, and ल substituted for र.
33132: लोप m. (-पः) 1 Rejection, cutting off in general, especially used as a grammatical term for dropping letters, syllables, &c. 2 Disappearance, destruction. 3 Erasure. 4 Annulling, cancelling. E. लुप to cut, aff. घञ्.
33133: लोपा f. (-पा) The wife of the Muni AGASTYA. E. लुप to disturb, aff. अच् and टाष्.
33134: लोपाक m. (-कः) A Shakāl. E. लुप to cut, आकन् aff.
33135: लोपापक m. (-कः) A Shakāl. f. (-पिका) A fox. E. लोप rejection (offal), आप to take, aff. वुन्.
33136: लोपामुद्रा f. (-द्रा) The wife of the saint AGASTYA. E. लोप losing (reputation), अमुद्रा sad, not happy.
33137: लोपामुद्रापति m. (-तिः) The Muni AGASTYA. E. लोपामुद्रा as above, and पति husband.
33138: लोपाशक m. (-कः) A Shakāl. f. (-शिका) 1 A female Shakāl. 2 A fox. E. लोप rejection, अश to eat, aff. ण्वुल्.
33139: लोप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be rejected, erased, lost, &c. E. लुप to cut off, ण्यत् aff.
33140: लोप्त्र nf. (-प्त्रं-प्त्री) Plunder, booty. E. लुप to cut off, ष्ट्रन् aff.
33141: लोभ m. (-भः) Covetousness, cupidity, intense or greedy desire. E. लुभ to desire or covet, aff. घञ्.
33142: लोभमोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beguiled or overcome by cupidity. E. लोभ, and मोहित beguiled.
33143: लोभविरह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Free from cupidity. E. लोभ, and हिरह separate.
33144: लोभाकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Tempted or attracted by greediness or desire. E. लोभ, and आकृष्ट drawn.
33145: लोभिन् mfn. (-भी-भिनी-भि) Desirous, cupidinous, covetous, greedy. E. लोभ desire, aff. इनि.
33146: लोभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Desirable. m. (-म्यः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. लुभ to covet or desire, aff. ण्यत्.
33147: लोम m. (-मः) A tail, a hairy tail. E. लू to cut, aff. मन्.
33148: लोमकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A hare. E. लोम hair, कर्ण an ear.
33149: लोमकूप m. (-पः) A pore of the skin. E. लोम, and कूप a well.
33150: लोमघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Falling of the hair, morbid baldness. E. लोम hair of the body, applied here to the hair of the head, and घ्न destroying.
33151: लोमन् n. (-म) The hair of the body. E. रू to sound, मनिन् Uṇādi aff., and र changed, or लू to cut, मनिच् aff.
33152: लोमपाद m. (-दः) The name of a king of Aṅga, the eastern division of Bengal, &c.
33153: लोमपादपुरी f. (-री) Campā, the capital of Lomapāda, the modern Bhāgalpur, and its vicinity. E. लोमपाद a king, and पुरी the city.
33154: लोमविष m. (-षः) An animal, whose hair is supposed to be poisonous, as a tiger, &c. E. लोम hair, and विष poison.
33155: लोमश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Hairy, covered with or made of hair. 2 Woollen. m. (-शः) 1 A ram. 2 The name of a Ṛṣi celebrated in the Mahābhārata. f. (-शा) 1 A fox. 2 A sort of Bonduc. 3 A plant, (Leea hirta.) 4 Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 5 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens) 6 A medicinal plant, commonly Mahāmeda. 7 Sida cordifolia. 8 A female demi-divine being, an attendant on DURGĀ, one of the Śākinīs. 9 Green vitriol. 10 Orris root. E. लोम hair or down, श aff.
33156: लोमशपर्णिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Glycine debilis.) E. लोमश hairy, पर्ण a leaf, and इनि aff.
33157: लोमशमार्जार m. (-रः) The pole-cat. E. लोमश hairy, and मार्जार a cat.
33158: लोमसार m. (-रः) The emerald. E. लोम hair, and सार strength, essence.
33159: लोमहर्षण n. (-णं) Horripilation, erection of the hair of the body. E. लोम hair, and हर्षण rejoicing, supposed to be an indication of great pleasure.
33160: लोमहृत् mfn. (-हृत्) Depilatory. m. (-हृत्) Yellow orpiment. E. लोम hair, and हृत् removing.
33162: लोमालिका f. (-का) A fox. E. लोम hair, आली a line, कन् added.
33163: लोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Shaking, tremulous. 2 Rolling, tossing. 3 Agitated, alarmed. 4 Fickle, unsteady. 5 Desiring, wishing, cupidinous. 6 Greedy. f. (-ला) 1 The tongue. 2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ, or the goddess of wealth and fortune. 3 A species of the Śarkarī metre. E. लोड to be frantic, अच् aff.
33164: लोलजिह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Greedy, insatiable. E. लोल, and जिह्वा the tongue.
33165: लोलमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Rolling, tossing, rolling on the ground. E. लोड to be frantic, शानच् aff.
33166: लोलाक्षि mfn. (-क्षिः-क्षिः-क्षी-क्षि) Having a rolling eye. E. लोल, and अक्षि the eye; also लोलचक्षुस्, लोलनयन, लोललोचन, लोलनेत्र, and the like.
33167: लोलिका f. (-का) A sort of dock or sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)
33168: लोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, tremulous, trembling. E. लुल to agitate, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
33169: लोलुप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Very desirous or covetous, wishing, longing for, greedy, insatiable. E. लुप to desire, aff. अच्, and the intensitive form.
33170: लोलुभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very cupidinous, excessively desirous, very covetous or greedy. E. लुभ to desire or covet, aff. अच्, and the intensitive form.
33171: लोलुव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Cutting much or often. E. लू to cut, freq. v., aff. अच्.
33172: लोलूया f. (-या) Determination to cut. E. लू to cut, intensitive v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
33173: लोलूयावत् mfn. (वान्-वती-वत्) Resolved to cut or cut off. E. लोलूया, and मतुप् aff.
33174: लोष्ट r. 1st cl. (लोष्टते) To heap, to assemble, to collect or gather into a heap.
33175: लोष्ट mn. (-ष्टः-ष्टं) A clod, a lump of earth. n. (-ष्टं) Rust of iron or iron filings. E. लोष्ट to heap, aff. अच्; or लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. क्त, with change of the radical vowel, and सुट् augment; also with कन् added लोष्टक.
33176: लोष्टघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A harrow. E. लोष्ट a clod, and घ्न destroying.
33177: लोष्टभेदन m. (-नः) A harrow. E. लोष्ट a clod, and भेदन what breaks.
33178: लोष्टमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of a clod or of earth. E. लोष्ट, and मयट् aff.
33179: लोष्टमर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिणी-र्द्दि) Who or what breaks clods of earth. E. लोष्ट, and मर्द्दिन् who destroys.
33180: लोष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A lump of earth. E. लोष्ट to heap, उ aff.
33181: लोह mn. (-हः-हं) 1 Iron, either crude or wrought. 2 Steel. 3 Any metal. 4 A weapon. 5 Aloe wood or Agallochum. 6 Blood. m. (-हः) A red-coloured goat. E. ल to cut, aff. ह.
33182: लोहकण्टक m. (-कः) A thorny shrub. E. लोह iron, and कण्टक a thorn.
33183: लोहकान्त n. (-न्तं) The loadstone. E. लोह iron, and कान्त in this compound a gem.
33184: लोहकार m. (-रः) A blacksmith, an ironsmith. E. लोह iron, and कार who works in; also with कन् added लोहकारक m. (-कः)
33185: लोहकिट्ट n. (-ट्टं) Rust of iron, or iron filings. E. लोह, and किट्ट soil or sediment.
33186: लोहचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Iron filings. E. लोह, and चूर्ण powder.
33187: लोहज n. (-जं) 1 Bell-metal. 2 Rust of iron, or iron filings. E. लोह iron, and ज produced.
33188: लोहजित् m. (-जित्) The diamond. E. लोह iron, and जित् conquering, (in hardness.)
33189: लोहदारक n. (-कं) A hell. E. लोह, and दारक what tears.
33190: लोहद्राविन् m. (-वी) Borax. E. लोह metal, and द्राविन् what fuses.
33191: लोहनाल m. (-लः) An iron arrow. E. लोह iron, and नाल a stalk.
33192: लोहपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A heron. E. लोह iron, and पृष्ठ the back.
33193: लोहप्रतिमा f. (-मा) 1 An image of iron. 2 An anvil. E. लोह iron, and प्रतिमा an image.
33194: लोहमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of iron. E. लोह iron, aff. मयट्.
33195: लोहमारक m. (-कः) A plant, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.) E. लोह iron, and मारक destroying.
33196: लोहराजक n. (-कं) Silver. E. लोह metal, राज shining, कन् added.
33197: लोहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Lisping, speaking inarticulately. 2 Iron, irony. m. (-लः) The principal ring of a chain. E. लोह iron, ला to get or be, aff. क.
33198: लोहवर n. (-रं) Gold. E. लोह a metal, and वर best.
33199: लोहवर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Mail, iron armour. E. लोह, and वर्म्मन् armour.
33200: लोहशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 A hell. 2 An iron pike. E. लोह, and शङ्कु a pike.
33201: लोहश्लेषण m. (-णः) Borax. E. लोह metal, श्चिष to embrace, to lay hold of, and ल्युट् aff.
33202: लोहाभिसार m. (-रः) Lustration of arms, ceremonies performed on the ninth of the light half of the month Aśvin; formerly a celebration observed by princes before opening a campaign, but now usually confined to the domestic decoration and worship of the soldier's weapons. E. लोह a weapon, अभि about, सृ to go, aff. घञ्; also लोहाभिहार.
33203: लोहाभिहार m. (-रः) Lustration of arms. E. लोह a weapon, अभि about, हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also लोहाभिसार.
33204: लोहामिष n. (-षं) The flesh of a goat with red hair. E. लोह, and आमिष flesh.
33205: लोहिका f. (-का) A sort of large shallow bowl, sometimes of iron, but usually of wood and bound with iron, for the purpose of washing rice, &c. E. लोह iron, कन् aff. fem. form.
33206: लोहित mfn. (-तः-ता or ती-तं) Red, of a red colour. m. (-तः) 1 Red, the colour. 2 The planet MARS. 3 One of the male rivers. 4 The Rohi, a kind of fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 5 A sort of deer. 6 A snake. 7 A deity, a demi-god. 8 A sort of bean, (Ervum hirsutum.) 9 A form of array. 10 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.) n. (-तं) 1 Blood. 2 A red kind of Agallochum. 3 Saffron. 4 Red sanders. 5 War, battle. f. (-ता) 1 A woman red with anger or with colour, &c. 2 A sort of creeper, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) E. रुह to grow, इतन् Uṇādi aff., and र changed to ल.
33207: लोहितक mfn. (-कः-तिका or -णिका-कं) Red. m. (-कः) 1 A ruby. 2 The planet MARS. n. (-कं) Calx of brass. E. कन् added to the preceding.
33208: लोहितचन्दन n. (-नं) Saffron. E. लोहित red, and चन्दन Sandal.
33209: लोहितमृत्तिका f. (-का) Red chalk. E. लोहित red, and मृत्तिका soil, earth.
33210: लोहिताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. m. (-क्षः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. लोहित red, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
33211: लोहिताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The planet MARS. E. लोहित red, and अङ्ग body.
33212: लोहितानन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Red-faced. m. (-नः) An ichneumon. E. लोहित red, and आनन the face.
33213: लोहितायस् n. (-यः) Copper. E. लोहित red, and अयस् iron.
33214: लोहिनी f. (-णी) A woman red with anger, or painted red. E. see रोहित, the fem. aff. being ङीप्, and the penultimate consonant changed to न.
33215: लोहोत्तम n. (-मं) Gold. E. लोह a metal, and उत्तस best.
33216: लौकायतिक m. (-कः) An atheist, a materialist, a Bauddha. E. लोकायत a particular heterodox doctrine, and ठक् aff.; also लोकायतिक.
33217: लौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mundane, worldly, human, what prevails amongst or is familiar to mankind. E. लोक mankind, the world, and ठञ् aff.
33218: लौकिकता f. (-ता) 1 Worldliness. 2 Worldly currency, or custom. E. तल् added to the last; also लौकिकत्वं.
33219: लौक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Mundane, human. E. लोक, and यञ् aff.
33220: लौह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Iron, made of iron, &c. m. (-हः) Iron, f. (-हा) An iron vessel, a pot. E. लोह iron, and अण् deriv. aff.
33221: लौहबन्ध n. (-न्धं) An iron chain or fetters. E. लौह, and बन्ध binding.
33222: लौहभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A pestle and mortar, usually of metal. E. लौह, and भाण्ड vessel.
33223: लौहभू f. (-भूः) A sort of iron vessel, a boiler, a caldron. E. लौह iron, and भू being.
33224: लौहात्मन् f. (-त्मा) A sort of iron boiler, &c. E. लौह made of iron, and आत्मन् substance.
33225: लौहित m. (-तः) The trident of ŚIVA. E. लोहित, and अण् aff.
33226: लौहितीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Reddish, like or resembling red, &c. E. लोहित red, and ईकक aff. implying similarity in this compound.
33227: लौहित्य nf. (-त्यं-ती) Redness. m. (-त्यः) 1 A male river. 2 The ocean. E. लोहित as above, ष्यञ् pleonasm.
33228: ल्पी r. 9th cl. (ल्पिनाति) To unite, to join, to be connected or attached to: it is also read ल्यी-ह्णी-ल्वी, &c.
33229: ल्वी r. 9th cl. (ल्विनाति) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To join or be connected with, to mix with, to unite. 3 To obtain: see the last. व
33230: व The twenty-ninth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, or more properly the semivowel V; it is often confounded.  with the labial consonant or ब, with which it is also optionally interchangeable.
33231: व m. (-वः) 1 Air, wind. 2 The arm. 3 A name of VARUṆA. 4 Addressing. 5 Auspiciousness. 6 Strong, powerful. 7 A dwelling. 8 The residence of VARUṆA. 9 The ocean. 10 Water. 11 Shaving. 12 Like, as. f. (वा) 1 Going. 2 Hurting, injury. 3 An arrow. 4 Weaving. 5 A weaver. n. (वं) A sort of incantation or Mantra, of which the object is the deity VARUṆA. E. वा to go, to injure, &c., aff. ड.
33232: वंश m. (-शः) 1 Race, lineage, family. 2 Assemblage, multitude. 3 A bambu. 4 The back-bone, the spine. mf. (-शः-शी) 1 A pipe, a fife, a flute. 2 Bambu manna. E. वंश to shine, घ aff., and नुम् augment; or वन् to sound, to serve, aff. श.
33233: वंशक m. (-कः) 1 A small fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.) 2 A large kind of sugar-cane. nf. (-शकं-शिका) Aloe wood. f. (-का) A kind of pipe or flute. E. कन् added to the preceding.
33234: वंशकफ n. (-फं) Flocks of cotton or cottony pods floating in the air. E. वंश a bambu, and कफ phlegm.
33235: वंशकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Making or perpetuating a family. E. वंश, and कर what makes.
33236: वंशकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated. E. वंश, and कीर्त्ति fame.
33237: वंशक्षय m. (-यः) Decay of a family. E. वंश, and क्षय decline.
33238: वंशक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of the bambu. E. वंश the bambu, and क्षीर milk; being of a milky colour.
33239: वंशचरित्र n. (-त्रं) A genealogical table or list, the history of a race or dynasty, &c. E. वंश, and चरित्र an account.
33240: वंशज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Sprung from a good family. 2 Produced by the bambu. nf. (-जं-जा) Bambu manna. E. वंश a bambu, lineage, &c., and ज born, produced.
33241: वंशधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Who or what supports a family. 2 Carrying or holding a bambu, &c. E. वंश, and धर what holds.
33242: वंशनालिका f. (-का) A pipe, a reed or flute. E. वंश a bambu, नाल a tube, कन् aff. fem. form.
33243: वंशपत्रक n. (-कं) Yellow orpiment. m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.) E. वंश a bambu, and पत्र a leaf, the shape of the fish resembling that of the leaf.
33244: वंशपत्रपतित n. (-तं) A species of the Atyaṣṭī metre.
33245: वंशपरम्परा f. (-रा) Family, lineage, descent. E. वंश, and परम्पर successive.
33246: वंशभोज्य n. (-ज्यं) Hereditary estate. E. वंश, and भोज्य to be possessed.
33247: वंशरोचना f. (-ना) An earthy concretion of a milk-white colour, formed in the hollow of the bambu, and known by the name of bambu manna. E. वंश the bambu, रुच to shine, aff. युच्; also र being changed to ल, वंशलोचना.
33248: वंशलोचना f. (-ना) The manna of the bambu: see the last.
33249: वंशवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Increasing or exalting a family. E. वंश, and वर्द्धन augmenting.
33250: वंशवितति f. (-तिः) 1 A clump of bambus. 2 Family, descent. E. वंश, and वितति extent.
33251: वंशविशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Of a good family. 2 Of a good bambu, (made, constructed.) E. वंश, and विशुद्ध pure.
33252: वंशवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Prosperity of a family. E. वंश, and वृद्धि increase.
33253: वंशशलाका f. (-का) 1 The bambu pipe that forms the body of the Vīṇā or lute. 2 Any small bambu pin or stake, as the bar of a cage, &c. E. वंश a bambu, and शलाका a pin or bolt.
33254: वंशसमाचार m. (-रः) Family usage. E. वंश, and समाचार practice.
33255: वंशस्थविल n. (-लं) A species of the Jagatī metre.
33256: वंशहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having no kindred or family. E. वंश, and हीन deprived of.
33257: वंशाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The shoot of a bambu. E. वंश, and अग्र point.
33258: वंशाङ्कुर m. (-रः) The shoot of a bambu. E. वंश, and अङ्कुर a shoot.
33259: वंशावली f. (-ली) A pedigree, a genealogy. E. वंश, and आवली a line.
33260: वंशानुचरित n. (-तं) A pedigree, a genealogical list, or history. E. वंश a family, अनु implying succession, and चरित proceeded.
33261: वंशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a family, a bambu, &c. nf. (-कं-का) Aloe wood. E. वंश a bambu, and ठक् aff.
33262: वंशीधर m. (-रः) 1 A piper. 2 A name of KṚṢṆA. E. वंशी, and धर who holds.
33263: वंश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 Of a good family. 2 Of the same family. m. (-श्यः) 1 A son. 2 A pupil, a scholar. 3 A kinsman, from seven generations above and seven below. E. वंश a family, and यत् aff.
33264: वंहिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Most, very much or great. E. वंह substituted for वृन्दारक great, and इष्ठन् aff.
33265: वंहीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very much or very large. E. वंह for वृन्दारक, and ईयसुन् aff.
33266: वक(इ)वकि r. 1st cl. (वंकते) 1 To be crooked, (literally or figuratively;) to be curved or bent, to be depraved or wicked. 2 To bend, to make crooked. 3 To go.
33267: वक m. (-कः) 1 A crane, (Ardea nivea.) 2 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) 3 KUVERA. 4 The name of a demon. 5 A small apparatus for calcining or subliming metals or minerals, consisting of two crucibles, one inverted over the other, luted together and placed over a fire. E. वच to speak, or वकि to be crooked, aff. घञ् or अच्; in the latter case the nasal augment is not inserted.
33268: वकचिञ्चिका f. (-का) A sort of fish.
33269: वकजित् n. (-जित्) A name of BHĪMA. E. वक a demon, and जित् the conqueror.
33270: वकधूप m. (-पः) Compound perfume: see वृकधूप.
33271: वकनिसूदन m. (-नः) BHĪMA. E. वक the demon, and निसूदन destroyer.
33272: वकपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.) E. वक curving, from वकि to be crooked, and पुष्प a flower.
33273: वकवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A false or hypocritical devotee: see वकव्रतिन्. E. वक, and वृत्ति livelihood.
33274: वकवैरिन् m. (-री) BHĪMA. E. वक the demon, and वैरिन् a foe.
33275: वकव्रतिन् m. (-ती) A false devotee, a religious hypocrite, or one who assumes the appearance of devotion or meditation, for interested purposes. E. वक a crane, व्रत observance, and इनि aff.; compared to the crane, who stands by a pool demure and sly, and apparently absorbed in contemplation, till he sees a fish on which to dart; also with ठक्, aff. वकव्रतिक, and derived from वक, and चर who goes, वकचर or वकव्रतचर m. (-रः) &c.; see वैडालव्रतिक.
33276: वकाची f. (-ची) A sort of fish.
33277: वकुल m. (-लः) A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) f. (-ली) A sort of drug, commonly Kākolī. E. वक to be crooked, aff. उलच्.
33278: वकेरुका f. (-का) 1 A small crane. 2 The branch of a tree bent by the wind. E. वक a crane, or crooked, ईर to go or be, aff. उकन्.
33279: वकोट m. (-टः) A crane. E. वक to be crooked. ओटच् aff.
33281: वक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Fit or proper to be said or spoken, to be spoken or uttered. 2 Vile, bad, reprehensible. 3 Subject, dependant. 4 Low, base. n. (-व्यं) 1 A rule, a dictum, a sentence. 2 Speech. E. वच to speak, and तव्य aff., of the future participle.
33282: वक्तव्यता f. (-ता) 1 Blame, reprehension. 2 The nature or property of what is to be said, or the occasion for it. E. तल् added to the last.
33283: वक्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous of speaking. E. वक्तु for वक्तुम् to speak, काम desire.
33284: वक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 1 Speaking, a speaker. 2 Loquacious, talkative. 3 Speaking well or sensibly, eloquent. 4 Wise, learned. 5 Speaking truly or truth, honest, sincere. m. (-क्ता) 1 An expounder, a teacher. 2 An orator, a speaker. E. वच् to speak, तृच् participial aff.
33285: वक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) 1 The mouth or face. 2 A sort of garment. 3 Metre, verse, especially of the Vedas., 4 A plant: see तगरसूल. E. वच to speak, Uṇādi aff. त्र.
33286: वक्त्रखुर m. (-रः) A tooth. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and खुर a hoof.
33287: वक्त्रज m. (-जः) A Brahman. E. वक्त्र the mouth, (of BRAHMĀ,) ज born.
33288: वक्त्रताल mn. (-लः-लं) A musical instrument, played on with the mouth. E. वक्त्र the mouth, ताल tune; it may also signify, making a noise with the mouth, by striking it with the hand at the moment of uttering sound.
33289: वक्त्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. वक्त्र, and तुण्ड beak or nose, having the proboscis of an elephant.
33290: वक्त्रपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A bag containing corn tied round a horse's head. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and पट्ट a cloth.
33291: वक्त्रभेदिन् m. (-दी) Pungency, pungent or acrid flavour. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and भेदिन् what cuts.
33292: वक्त्रशोधिन् m. (-धी) A lime. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and शोधिन् what cleanses; also वक्त्रशोधन m. (-नः.)
33293: वक्त्रासव m. (-वः) Saliva. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and आसव wine.
33294: वक्र mfn. (-क्रः-क्रा-क्रं) 1 Crooked, curved, bowed or bent. 2 Cruel, malignant. 3 Dishonest, fraudulent. 4 Indirect, evasive. n. (-क्रं) The winding course of a river or water-fall, the arm or bend of a stream. 2 A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre. m. (-क्रः) 1 A name of SATURN. 2 The planet MARS. 3 RUDRA or ŚIVA. 4 The demon TRIPURA. E. वकि to go crookedly, रक् Uṇādi aff.
33295: वक्रखड्ग m. (-ड्गः) A sabre or scimitar. E. वक्र crooked, and खड्ग a sword; also वक्रखड्गकः.
33296: वक्रगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) 1 Who or what goes tortuously. 2 Fraudulent, dishonest. E. वक्र, and गामिन् who goes.
33297: वक्रग्रीव m. (-वः) A camel. E. वक्र crooked, ग्रीवा the neck.
33298: वक्रचञ्चु m. (-ञ्चुः) A parrot. E. वक्र crooked, and चञ्चु the beak.
33299: वक्रता f. (-ता) 1 Crookedness. 2 Wickedness. 3 Craft, cunning. 4 Evasive or indirect speech. E. वक्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, वक्रत्वं.
33300: वक्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A parrot. E. वक्र crooked, तुण्ड a face.
33301: वक्रदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A hog. E. वक्र crooked, and दंष्ट्र a tusk.
33302: वक्रनक्र m. (-क्रः) A low or depraved man. 2 A parrot. E. वक्र crooked, and नक्र the nose, &c.
33303: वक्रनासिक m. (-कः) An owl. E. वक्र crooked, and नासिका the nose.
33304: वक्रपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A dog. E. वक्र crooked, and पुच्छ a tail; also वक्रपुच्छिक.
33305: वक्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Sesbana grandiflora. E. वक्र crooked, and पुष्प the flower.
33306: वक्रबालधि m. (-धिः) A dog. E. वक्र crooked, बालधि a tail.
33307: वक्रभणित n. (-तं) Indirect speech, equivoque, evasion. E. वक्र crooked, and भणित spoken.
33308: वक्रम m. (-मः) Flight, retreat. E. अव reverse, क्रम to go, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected.
33309: वक्रवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A hog. E. वक्र crooked, and वक्त्र a face.
33310: वक्राग्र n. (-ग्रं) A plant, commonly Betu.
33311: वक्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A goose. 2 The ruddy goose. E. वक्र bending, अङ्ग body.
33312: वक्रि mfn. (-क्रिः-क्रिः-क्रि) Speaking falsely, uttering untruths, prevaricating, lying. E. वक्र to be crooked, (metaph.) क्रिन् aff.
33313: वक्रिन् mfn. (-क्री-क्रिणी-क्रि) 1 Crooked. 2 Dishonest, fraudulent. m. (-क्री) A Jaina or Bauddha. E. वक्र crooked, fraudulent, इनि aff.
33314: वक्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Bent, curved. E. वकि to go crookedly, क्रिमच् aff.
33315: वक्रिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Crookedness, curvature. 2 Craftiness, cunning. E. बक्र, and इमनिच् aff.
33316: वक्रीकरण n. (-णं) Curving, bending, distorting. E. वक्र, and करण making, च्चि augment.
33317: वक्रीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, made crooked. E. वक्र, and कृत made, च्चि aug.
33318: वक्रीभाव m. (-वः) 1 Curvature, curve. 2 Fraudulent or dishonest disposition. E. वक्री, and भाव property, च्चि aug.
33319: वक्रीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, crooked. 2 Dishonest. E. वक्र, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
33320: वक्रोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Equivoque, evasion, pun, the covert expression of something else than the words used naturally imply, either from the manner in which they are uttered, or some other sense of which they are susceptible. 2 Hint, insinuation. 3 Sarcasm. E. वक्र crooked, dishonest, and उक्ति speech.
33321: वक्रोष्ठिका f. (-का) A gentle smile, one in which the teeth are not shewn. E. वक्र crooked, ओष्ठ the lip, and कन् aff., fem. form; also वक्रोष्टिः.
33322: वक्ष r. 1st cl. (वक्षति) 1 To be angry. 2 To accumulate.
33323: वक्षःसम्मर्द्धिनी f. (-नी) Wife of the bosom. E. वक्षस्, and सम्मर्द्दिनी who rubs.
33324: वक्षण n. (-णं) The breast: see वक्षस्.
33325: वक्षस् n. (-क्षः) The breast, the bosom, the chest. m. (-क्षाः) An ox, (confined to the Vedas.) E. वच to speak, or वक्ष to accumulate, aff. असुन्, in the first case सुट् is inserted; again वह to bear, असुन् aff., सुट् augment, and the deriv. irr.
33326: वक्षस्स्थल n. (-लं) The breast, the heart. E. वक्षस्, and स्थल place.
33327: वक्षोज n. (-जं) The female breast. E. वक्षस् the breast or chest, and ज born.
33328: वक्षोरुह m. (-हः) The female breast. E. वक्षस् the chest, and रुह what rises.
33329: वक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being to be said or described. E. वच् to say, desid. pass. v., शानच् aff.
33330: वख r. 1st cl. (वखति) (इ) वखि (वंखति) To go or move.
33331: वग(इ)वगि r. 1st cl. (वंगति) 1 To go. 2 To go lamely, to limp.
33332: वगाह m. (-हः) Bathing, ablution. E. अव before गाह to agitate, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected; also अवगाह.
33333: वग्नु m. (-ग्नुः) A speaker. E. वच to speak, नु Uṇādi aff., and च changed to ग.
33334: वघ(इ)वघि r. 1st cl. (वंघते) 1 To go. 2 To blame or censure. 3 To begin. 4 To begin moving. 5 To move swiftly.
33335: वङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 The bend or elbow of a river, the winding course of a stream. 2 Crookedness. f. (-ङ्का) The pummel of a saddle. E. वकि to curve or bend, aff. अच्.
33336: वङ्किल m. (-लः) A thorn. E. वङ्क crookedness, and इलच् aff.
33337: वङ्क्य mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं) Crooked, curved. E. वञ्च to go, ण्यत् aff., and च changed to क.
33338: वङ्क्रि m. (-ङ्क्रिः) 1 A rib. 2 The wood of a thatch. 3 A particular musical instrument. E. वकि to be crooked, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
33339: वङ्क्षण n. (-णं) The groin, the public and iliac regions. E. वाञ्छि to desire, ल्युट् aff., and the form irr., or वक्ष to accumulate, ल्युट् aff., and नुम् augment.
33340: वङ्क्षु f. (-ङ्क्षुः) A small arm or branch of the Ganges. E. वङ्क्ष to accumulate, aff. उ.
33341: वङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Lead. 2 Tin. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Bengal, or the eastern parts of the modern province. 2 Cotton. 3 The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वगि to go, युच् aff.
33342: वङ्गन m. (-नः) The egg-plant. E. वगि to go, युच् aff.
33343: वङ्गशुल्वज n. (-जं) Brass. E. वङ्ग tin, शुल्व copper, and ज produced; an alloy of tin and copper.
33344: वङ्गसेन m. (-नः) The Sesbana grandiflora. E. वङ्ग Bengal, सि to sew, aff. ल्युट्; also with कन् added, वङ्गसेनक.
33345: वङ्गारि m. (-रिः) Yellow orpiment. E. वङ्ग lead, and अरि a foe.
33346: वङ्गुला f. (-ला) A mode of music.
33347: वच(औ)औवच r. 1st cl. (वचति) 2nd cl. (वक्ति) and 10th cl. (वाचयति) 1 To speak, to tell. 2 To inform. 3 To read, to expound: (the second cl. is the most usual form of the root, in which its inflections however are very irregular.) With प्र, To begin to speak.
33348: वच m. (-चः) A parrot. f. (-चा) 1 Orris root, (Acorus calamus; also Zinziber Zedoaria.) 2 The Sārikā, (Turdus Salica.) E. वच to speak, अच् aff.
33349: वचक्नु mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु) Talkative, loquacious, eloquent. m. (-क्नुः) A Brahman. E. वच to speak, Uṇādi aff. अक्नुच्.
33350: वचन n. (-नं) 1 Speech, speaking. 2 A sentence, a text, a dictum, an aphorism, a rule. E. वच to speak, aff. ल्युट्.
33351: वचनकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Obedient. 2 Speaking. m. (-रः) The author or enunciator of a precept. E. वचन्, and कर who makes.
33352: वचनक्रम m. (-मः) Discourse, order of words. E. वचन, and क्रम order.
33353: वचनग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Compliant, conformable, submissive, humble. E. वचन speech, ग्राहिन् taking, obeying.
33354: वचनविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to a text or precept. E. वचन, and विरुद्ध opposed.
33355: वचनविरोध m. (-धः) Incongruity, contradiction, inconsistency of texts. E. वचन, and विरोध opposition.
33356: वचनव्यक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Distinctness or perspicuity of a text. E. वचन, and व्यक्ति plainness.
33357: वचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be spoken or said. 2 Censurable, to be noticed or reproved. E. वच to speak, अनीयर् aff.
33358: वचनीयता f. (-ता) 1 Rumour, report, especially ill report, detraction, scandal. 2 Blame, reprehension. E. वचनीव to be censured, तल् aff.; also with त्व aff., वचनीयत्वं.
33359: वचनमात्र n. (-त्रं) Mere words, assertion unsupported by facts. E. वचन, and मात्र only.
33360: वचनशत n. (-तं) Repeated speech or declaration. E. वचन, and शत a hundred.
33361: वचनेस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compliant, conformable, obedient. E. वचने in the word, and स्थित who stays.
33362: वचलु m. (-लुः) Offence, fault. E. वच to speak, अलुच् aff.
33363: वचस् n. (-चः) 1 Speech, voice. 2 Words, a speech. E. वच to speak, असुन् aff.
33364: वचस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Obedient, compliant. E. वचस्, and कर who does.
33365: वज r. 1st cl. (बजति) To go. r. 10th cl. (वाजयति) 1 To go. 2 To prepare, to make. 3 To prepare the way. 4 To trim or feather an arrow.
33366: वज्र mfn. (-ज्रः-ज्रा-ज्रं) 1 Hard, impenetrable, adamantine. 2 Cross, forked. mn. (-ज्रः-ज्रं) 1 A thunder-bolt in general, or the thunder-bolt of INDRA. 2 The diamond, (the gem being considered analogous in hardness to the thunder-bolt, or in fact to be the same substance.) 3 A diagram, the figure of which is supposed to be that of the thunder-bolt. 4 A child or pupil. 5 Emblic myrobalan. 6 Sour gruel. 7 The blossom of the sesamum. 8 Harsh language. m. (-ज्रः) 1 One of the astronomical Yogas. 2 Kuśa grass. f. (-ज्रा-ज्री) A species of Euphorbia. f. (-ज्रा) 1 A plant: see गुडुची. 2 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. वज to go, रक् aff.
33367: वज्रक n. (-कं) A sort of salt, an impure carbonate of soda. E. कन् added to the last.
33368: वज्रकङ्कट m. (-टः) Hanumān, the monkey demigod. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and कङ्कट armour.
33369: वज्रकण्टक m. (-कः) Euphorbia. E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, and कण्टक a thorn.
33370: वज्रकपालिन् m. (-ली) One of the Bauddha saints.
33371: वज्रक्षार n. (-रं) An alkaline earth, an impure carbonate of soda. E. वज्र diamond, and क्षार alkali.
33372: वज्रजित् m. (जित्) A name of GARUḌA. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and जित् who conquers; being invulnerable to repeated shocks of INDRA'S bolt.
33373: वज्रज्वाला f. (-ला) A clap of thunder. E. वज्र the bolt, and ज्वाला flame.
33374: वज्रटीक m. (-कः) A Jaina deified saint.
33375: वज्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The deity GAṆEŚA. 2 GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 3 A vulture. 4 A gnat, a musquito. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and तुण्ड face or beak, as hard.
33376: वज्रदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A hog. 2 A rat. E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and दन्त a tooth.
33377: वज्रदशन m. (-नः) A rat. E. वज्र, and दशन a tooth: see the last.
33378: वज्रद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Euphorbia of various species. E. वज्र thunderbolt, (as hard,) and द्रु a tree; also वज्रद्रुम.
33379: वज्रद्रुम m. (-मः) Euphorbia: see the last.
33380: वज्रधर m. (-रः) 1 INDRA, as the JUPITER Tonans of the Hindus. 2 A Bauddha saint. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and धर who has or holds.
33381: वज्रनिर्घोष m. (-षः) A clap of thunder. E. वज्र the bolt, and निर्घोष sound.
33382: वज्रनिष्पेष m. (-षः) A clap of thunder. E. वज्र the bolt, and निष्पेष here meaning the sound produced by friction or concussion, from निर् forth, पिष to grind, aff. घञ्.
33383: वज्रपाणि m. (-णिः) INDRA. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and पाणि the hand: see वज्रधर.
33384: वज्रपात m. (-तः) A thunder-bolt, a stroke of lightning. E. वज्र, and पात fall.
33385: वज्रपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The blossom of the sesamum. E. वज्र a diamond, and पुष्प flower.
33386: वज्रबध m. (-धः) 1 Death by lightning. 2 Cross multiplication. E. वज्र, and बय killing, or multiplying.
33387: वज्रमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Hard, adamantine. 2 Hard-hearted. E. वज्र, and मयट् aff.
33388: वज्ररद m. (-दः) A hog. E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and रद a tooth.
33389: वज्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A species of sun-flower, (Heliotropium.) E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and वल्ली a creeper.
33390: वज्रवाराही f. (-ही) A female personification of Māyā or unreality, amongst the Bauddhas.
33391: वज्रशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A female deification peculiar to the Jainas, and one of their sixteen Vidyā-Devīs. E. वज्र a diamond, and शृङ्खला a chain.
33393: वज्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A snake. f. (-ङ्गी) A sort of grain, (Coix barbata.) E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and अङ्ग body or substance.
33394: वज्राघात m. (-तः) 1 A thunder-bolt or stroke. 2 A sudden calamity. E. वज्र, and आघात blow.
33395: वज्राभ m. (-भः) Precious Opal. E. वज्र the diamond, (in hardness perhaps,) आभ resembling.
33396: वज्राभ्यास m. (-सः) Cross multiplication. E. वज्र, and अभ्यास practising.
33398: वज्रिन् m. (-ज्री) 1 INDRA. 2 A Jaina deified saint. 3 A buffalo. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and इनि aff.
33399: वञ्च(उ)वञ्च r. 1st cl. (वञ्चति) To go. r. 1st and 10th cls. (वञ्चते वञ्चयते) To delude, to cheat, to trick or deceive.
33400: वञ्चक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fraudulent, crafty. m. (-कः) 1 A jackal or Shakal. 2 A tame or house ichneumon. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 A low or vile man. E. वञ्च to cheat, ण्वुल् aff.
33401: वञ्चथ m. (-थः) A rogue, a knave, a cheat. E. वञ्च to cheat, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
33402: वञ्चन n. (-नं) Cheating, fraud. E. वञ्च to cheat, ल्युट् aff.
33403: वञ्चनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be tricked or cheated. E. वञ्च to cheat, अनीयर् aff.
33404: वञ्चयित्वा ind. Having cheated. E. वञ्च to cheat, क्त्वाच् aff.
33405: वञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tricked, deceived, cheated. E. वञ्च to cheat, aff. क्त्र.
33406: वञ्चुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Crafty, fraudulent, dishonest. E. वञ्च to cheat, aff. उकन्.
33407: वञ्च्य mfn. (-ञ्च्या-ञ्च्या-ञ्च्यं) 1 To be gone. 2 To be cheated. E. वञ्च to go, यत् aff.
33408: वञ्जुल m. (-लः) 1 A tree, (Dalbergia Ougeinensis.) 2 Another tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) 3 Common cane, (Calamus rotang.) 4 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 5 A sort of bird. f. (-ला) A cow that yields abundance of milk. E. वञ्च to go, aff. उलच्, and च changed to ज.
33410: वट r. 1st and 10th cls. (वटति वटयति) 1 To surround or encompass. 2 To tie or string, to connect. 3 To partition, to divide. r. 1st cl. causal form (वटयति) To speak. (इ) वटि r. 4th and 10th cls. (वण्ट्यति वण्टयति) To partition, to separate or divide.
33411: वट subst. mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) A string, a rope, a tie. m. (-टः) 1 The large Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 2 A round figure, a circle, a cypher, a ball or globe. 3 Pulse ground and fried with oil or butter. 4 A small shell, a cowrie. 5 Equality in shape or dimension. E. वट to surround, to tie, aff. अच्.
33412: वटक m. (-कः) 1 Pulse ground and fried in oil or butter. 2 A weight of eight Māṣas. f. (-टिका) A pill, a bolus. E. वट to surround, aff. वुन्.
33413: वटपत्रा f. (-त्रा) A plant, from the fibrous leaves of which bowstrings, &c. are made, (Aletris hyacinthoides: Sanseviera zeylanica, Rox.'s Cata.) E. वट a string, पत्र a leaf.
33414: वटर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Wicked, villainous. 2 Slippery, unsteady. m. (-रः) 1 A cock. 2 A thief. 3 A cloth worn round the head, a turban. 4 A mat. 5 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 6 A churning stick. E. वट to surround, अरच् aff.
33415: वटवासिन् mf. (-सी-सिनी) A sort of demigod, male and female; a YAKṢA or YAKṢIṆĪ, KUVERA'S special attendants. E. वट the Indian fig in which these spirits are supposed to be fond of abiding, वास abode, and इनि aff.
33416: वटाकर m. (-रः) A cord, a rope, a string. E. वट surrounding, आकर what makes, from कृ to make, with आङ् prefix, टच् aff.
33417: वटावीक m. (-कः) A notorious thief, a dakoit, a robber.
33418: वटि m. (-टिः) A sort of tick or body louse. E. वट to surround, aff. इन्.
33419: वटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) 1 Stringed, having a string. 2 Circular, globular. E. वट, and इनि aff.
33420: वटु m. (-टुः) 1 The Brahmacārī or religious student, after his investiture with the sacred thread. 2 A lad, a youth in general. 3 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) E. वट to surround, (with the string, &c.) or to speak, उ Uṇādi aff.
33421: वटुक m. (-कः) 1 A lad, a young man in general, or one fit to receive the sacrificial thread. 2 A religious student. 3 A stupid fellow, a blockhead. E. कन् added to the preceding.
33422: वटूकरण n. (-णं) Investiture with the sacred and characteristic thread. E. वटु a lad after investiture, कृ to make, aff. ल्युट्. and the vowel of वटु made long or technically, च्चि augment.
33423: वठ r. 1st cl. (वठति) To be large, powerful or able; also वट (इ) वठि (वंठते) To move alone or unaccompanied.
33424: वठर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Vile, wicked, abandoned. 2 Stupid, slow, dull. m. (-रः) 1 A blockhead, a fool. 2 A physician. 3 A waterpot. E. वच to speak, अरच् aff., and च changed to ठ.
33425: वड(इ)वडि r. 1st cl. (वण्डते) 1 To partition, to share or divide. 2 To surround or encompass. 3 To cover: in the first sense it is sometimes read as a root of the 10th cl. (वंडयति.)
33426: वडभि f. (-भिः or भी) 1 The wooden frame of a thatch. 2 A temporary building or awning on the top of a palace, or a room or turret so situated. E. वल to cover, अभच् aff., इन् added, and again optionally ङीष्, ल changed to ड; otherwise वलभि and वलभी.
33427: वडा f. (-डा) Pulse ground and fried with oil or butter. E. वल to cover, अच् and टाप् aff., and ल changed to its congener ड.
33428: वडिश nf. (-शं-शा or -शी) A fish-hook. E. वटिन् having a string, a bait, शो to destroy, and ड aff.; the radical ट changed to ड.
33429: वड्र mfn. (-ड्रः-ड्रा-ड्रं) Large, great. E. वल to cover, रक् aff., ल changed to ड.
33430: वण(ऋ)वणृ r. 1st cl. (वणति) To sound; also वन.
33431: वण्ट r. 10th cl. (वण्टयति) To partition, to separate or divide; also वटि.
33432: वण्ट m. (-ण्टः) 1 A part, a portion. 2 A man unmarried. 3 The handle of a sickle. E. वटि to divide, aff. घञ्.
33433: वण्टक m. (-कः) A part, a portion, a share. E. वटि to divide, घञ् and कन् aff.
33434: वण्टन n. (-नं) Portioning, partitioning, dividing. E. वटि to divide, ल्युट् aff.
33435: वण्टनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divisible, to be divided. E. वटि to divide, अनीयर् aff.
33436: वण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 An unmarried man. 2 A dwarf. 3 A javelin. E. वठि to go alone, aff. घञ्.
33437: वण्ठर m. (-रः) 1 The new shoot of the Tāla or palm tree. 2 The sheath that envelopes the young bambu. 3 A rope for tying a goat, &c. 4 A breast. 5 A dog's tail 6 A dog. 7 A cloud. E. वठि to go alone, aff. अरच्.
33438: वण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Maimed, defective, crippled, but especially in the hands. 2 Impotent, emasculated. m. (-ण्डः) 1 A man who is circumcised or has no prepuce. 2 An ox without his tail. f. (-ण्डः) An unchaste woman. E. वण to sound, &c., aff. ड.
33439: वण्डर m. (-रः) 1 A niggard, a miser. 2 A eunuch or attendant on the woman's apartments.
33440: वण्डाल m. (-लः) 1 A description of conflict, the contest of heroes. 2 A boat. 3 A spade, a hoe. E. वडि to divide, आलच् aff.
33441: वत् ind. As, like, similar: this is more generally considered as an affix to words, termed technically वति, as ब्राह्मणवत् like a Brahman, &c.
33442: वत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uttered, sounded, spoken. 2 Asked, begged ind. 1 A particle analogous to ah, oh, &c. expressing sorrow. 2 Compassion. 3 Pleasure. 4 Oh, ho, a vocative particle. E. वन to ask or beg, &c., aff. क्त.
33443: वतंस m. (-सः) 1 An ear-ring. 2 A crest. E. अव before तसि to adorn, and अच् aff., the initial rejected; also अवतंस.
33444: वतण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The name of a Muni. E. अव before वडि to beat, aff. अच्, and अ rejected.
33445: वतोका f. (-का) A cow miscarrying from accident. E. अव before तोक offspring, and अ rejected; also अवतोका.
33446: वत्स n. (-त्सं) The breast, the chest. m. (-त्सः) 1 A calf. 2 A year. mf. (-त्सः-त्सा) A term of endearment, used to children, scholars, &c. E. वद to speak, kindly to, Uṇādi aff. स.
33447: वत्सक m. (-कः) 1 A calf. 2 A child. 3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) E. वत्स, and कन् added.
33448: वत्सकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Fond of or anxious about a child. f. (-मा) A cow anxious after her calf, a mother anxious after her child, &c. E. वत्स a calf, and काम to desire, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
33449: वत्सगुरु m. (-रुः) A master. E. वत्स, and गुरु teacher.
33450: वत्सतर m. (-रः) A steer. E. वत्स a calf, and तरप् aff. of excess; more than a calf.
33451: वत्सतन्त्री f. (-न्त्री) The rope that ties a calf. E. वत्स, and तन्त्री a string.
33452: वत्सनाभ m. (-भः) An active poison; also called Mīthā Zeher, the root of the Aconite ferox brought from Nepal. E. वत्स a calf, and नभ to injure, अण् aff.; the root is sometimes compared to the nipple of a cow, whence perhaps this etymology.
33453: वत्सपत्तन n. (-नं) The name of a city in the north of India; one place to which it is applied is now a village in the district of Gorakhpur. E. वत्स a calf, and पत्तन a city.
33454: वत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. वद to abide, and सरन् Uṇādi aff.
33455: वत्सरान्तक m. (-कः) Name of a month, Phalguna. E. वत्सर, and अन्तक destroyer.
33456: वत्सल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Affectionate, kind. n. (-लं) Affection, fondness. f. (-ला) A cow anxious for her calf. E. वत्स a child, and लच् aff.
33457: वत्सलता f. (-ता) Tenderness, affection. E. वत्सल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वत्सलत्वं.
33458: वत्साक्षी f. (-क्षी) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.)
33459: वत्सादनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. वत्स a calf, &c., अदन food.
33460: वत्सीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Proper or fit for a calf. m. (-यः) A cowherd. E. वत्स a calf, &c., and छ aff.
33461: वद r. 1st and 10th cls. (वदति-ते वदयति-ते) 1 To inform, to speak to or tell, to declare. 2 To speak articulately. 3 To abide. With अनु, (अनुवदते) To speak similarly or subsequent. With अप prefixed, (अपवदति-ते) To reprove, to censure. With अभि, To salute respectfully or by name. With उप, (उपवदते) To explain. With निर्, To speak out or With परि, (परिवदति) To speak against. With प्र, To rumour, to slander. With प्रति, (प्रतिवदति) To reply to or answer. With वि, (विवदते) To dispute. With वि and प्र, (विप्रवदति or -ते) To wrangle or dispute together. With वि and सं, To break a promise. With सम and प्र, (सष्प्रवदते) To speak articulately in concert; (सष्प्रवदति) To utter or articulate sounds together. (इ,) वदि (वंदते) 1 To salute with reverence or respect. 2 To praise, to eulogize.
33462: वद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Speaking, able to speak, speaking well or sensibly. E. वद to speak, अच् aff.
33463: वदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Speaking, saying. E. वद to speak, शतृ aff.
33464: वदन n. (-नं) 1 The mouth, the face. 2 The summit or apex of a triangle. E. वद to speak, aff. ल्युट्.
33465: वदनसरोज n. (-जं) The face of a mistress. E. वदन, and सरोज a lotus; also similar compounds, as वदनाम्बुरुह, वदनारविन्द, &c.
33466: वदनासव m. (-वः) Saliva, the moisture of the lips. E. वदन the mouth, and आसव spirituous liquor.
33467: वदनेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) The face. E. वदन, and इन्दु the moon; also similar compounds, as वदनत्रन्द्र, &c.
33468: वदन्ति f. (-न्तिः-न्ती) Speech, discourse, talk. E. वद to say or speak, झिच् Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
33469: वदन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Munificent, bountiful. E. वद to speak, aff. अन्य; also वदान्य.
33470: वदमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Saying, calling. 2 Glorifying, boasting. E. वद to speak, शानच् aff.
33471: वदरिक m. (-कः) The jujube: see वदरि.
33472: वदान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 Liberal, munificent. 2 Speaking kindly or agreeably. 3 Eloquent. E. वद to speak, आन्य Uṇādi aff.
33473: वदाल m. (-लः) A sheat-fish, (Silurus Boalis, HAM.) E. वद to speak, aff. आलच्; also with कन् added, वदालक. m. (-कः.)
33474: वदावद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Speaking, a speaker, able to speak, able to speak well, eloquent. E. वद to speak, aff. अच्, the root repeated, and आ inserted.
33475: वधु f. (-धुः) 1 A son's wife. 2 A wife in general. E. वह to bear, उ aff., more commonly वधू.
33476: वधुका f. (-का) A wife. E. वधु for वधू, and कन् added.
33477: वधुटी f. (-टी) A daughter-in-law: see वधूटी.
33478: वधू f. (-धूः) 1 Woman in general, a female. 2 A wife. 3 A young wife, one recently married, a bride. 4 A son's wife. 5 A sort of bulbous root, (Curcuma reclinata.) 6 A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata:) see पृक्का. 7 A plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. वह to bear, उ aff., and ह changed to ध; also derived from षध to bind, in which case it is written वधू.
33479: वधूजन m. (-नः) A woman. E. वधू a female, and जन person.
33480: वधूटी f. (-टी) 1 A son's wife. 2 A young woman living in her father's house, whether married or unmarried. E. वह to bear, कूटट् aff., and ह changed to घ.
33481: वधूशयन n. (-नं) A lattice, a loop-hole.
33482: वन r. 1st and 10th cls. (वनति वनयति) 1 To sound. 2 To serve, to honour. 3 To help. 4 To be distressed. (उ) वनु r. 1st and 10th cls. (वनति वनयति) 1 To act, to transact business. 2 To injure; also r. 8th cl. (वनुते) To ask or beg.
33483: वन nf. (-नं-नी) A forest, a wood, a grove. n. (-नं) 1 Water. 2 A residence, a dwelling or abode. 3 A house. 4 A cascade or fountain. E. वन to sound, to serve, to seek, &c., aff. घञ्.
33484: वनकचु m. (-चुः) A species of Arum, (A. colocasia.) E. वन, and कचु the same.
33485: वनकरिन् m. (-री) A wild elephant. E. वन, and करिन् an elephant.
33486: वनकार्प्पासी f. (-सी) Wild cotton, or a plant resembling it, (Hibiscus vitifolius.) E. वन a wood, and कार्प्पासी cotton.
33487: वनकुक्कुट m. (-टः) Wild fowl. E. वन, and कुक्कुट a cock.
33488: वनगज m. (-जः) A wild elephant. E. वन, and गज an elephant.
33489: वनगहन n. (-नं) A thicket. E. वन, and गहन the same.
33490: वनगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A spy, an emissary. E. वन a wood, and गुप्त concealed.
33491: वनगो f. (-गौः) The Gāyal, (Bos gavæus.) E. वन wood, and गो a cow; also वनगव m. (-वः)
33492: वनगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Frequenting forests. m. (-रः) A hunter, a forester. n. (-रं) A forest. E. वन, and गोचर an object, &c.
33493: वनचन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Aloe wood or Agallochum. 2 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. वन a wood, and चन्दन Sandal.
33494: वनचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Forest, forester, savage. E. वन, and चारिन् who goes.
33495: वनछाग m. (-गः) 1 A wild goat. 2 A hog. E. वन a wood, and छाग a goat.
33496: वनछिद् m. (-ट्) A wood-cutter. E. वन, and छिट् who cuts.
33497: वनच्छेद m. (-दः) Cutting timber. E. वन, and छेद who cuts.
33498: वनज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Wild, forest, born or produced in a wood. n. (-जं) A lotus. m. (-जः) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 2 An elephant. f. (-जा) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. वन wood, and ज born.
33499: वनजीविन् m. (-वी) A wood-man, a forester. E. वन, and जीविन who lives.
33500: वनतिक्त m. (-क्तः) A sort of myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. वन wood, तिक्त bitter.
33501: वनतिक्तिका f. (-का) A climbing plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. कन् in the fem. form added to the preceding.
33502: वनद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. वन water, and द what yields.
33503: वनदीप m. (-पः) The Champak, (Michelia Champaca.) E. वन a wood, and दीप a lamp or illuminator.
33504: वनपल्लव n. (-वः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga, &c.) E. वन a wood, and पल्लव a shoot.
33505: वनपांशुल m. (-लः) A hunter, a deer-killer. E. वन a wood, and पांशुल a low man.
33506: वनपादप m. (-पः) A forest tree. E. वन, and पादप a tree.
33507: वनप्रवेश m. (-शः) Entering a forest, commencing to live as a hermit. E. वन, and प्रवेश entry.
33508: वनप्रिय m. (-यः) The Kökila or Indian cuckoo. E. वन a wood, and प्रिय fond of.
33509: वनभुज् m. (-भुक्) A medicinal root, commonly Ṛṣabha. E. वन a wood, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.
33510: वनमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Wild jasmine. E. वन a wood, मल्ली Jasmine.
33511: वनमाक्षिका f. (-का) A gad fly. E. वन a wood, and माक्षिका fly.
33512: वनमाला f. (-ला) The chaplet or garland worn by KṚṢṆA. E. वन a wood, and माला necklace.
33513: वनमालिन् m. (-ली) KṚṢṆA. f. (-नी) 1 Dvāraka the capital of KṚṢṆA. 2 A female energy of KṚṢṆA. E. वनमाला as above, इनि and ङीष् aff.
33514: वनमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud. E. वन water, and मुच् to let loose, क्विप् aff.
33515: वनमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. वन a wood, and मुद्ग kidney-bean.
33516: वनमूत m. (-तः) A cloud. E. वन water, and मूत sprinkled.
33517: वनर m. (-रः) A monkey. E. वन a wood, रम to play, aff. ड; also वानर.
33518: वनराज m. (-जः) A lion. E. वन a wood, and राजन् a sovereign.
33519: वनराजि mfn. (-जिः-जिः-जी-जि) Embellishing or beautifying a forest. E. वन, राजृ to shine, इन् aff.
33520: वनवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति) Residing in the woods. E. वन, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
33521: वनवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) A wood on fire. E. वन a forest, and वह्नि fire.
33522: वनवास m. (-सः) Living in the woods, as a hermit, &c. E. वन, and वास abode.
33523: वनवासन m. (-नः) A civet or pole cat. E. वन a wood, वस to dwell, aff. युच्.
33524: वनवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Wild, forest, who or what dwells in woods. m. (-सी) 1 An anchoret, a hermit. 2 A forester. E. वन forest, वास abode, aff. इनि.
33525: वनविडाल m. (-लः) A sort of wild cat, (Felis caracal.) E. वन, and विडाल a cat.
33526: वनव्रीहि m. (-हिः) Rice growing wild in pools or swamps, and considered by botanists, as the parent stock of all the varieties cultivated in India. E. वन wood or water, and व्रीहि rice.
33527: वनशृङ्गाट m. (-टः) A plant, (Ruellia longifolia:) see गोक्षुर. E. वन a wood, and शृङ्गाट the same plant.
33528: वनशोभन n. (-नं) A lotus. E. वन water, and शोभन adorning.
33529: वनश्वन् m. (-श्वा) 1 A jackal. 2 A tiger. 3 A civet or pole cat. E. वन a wood, and श्वन् a dog.
33530: वनसङ्कट m. (-टः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum hirsutum.) E. वन a wood, and सङ्कट what contracts.
33531: वनसमूह m. (-हः) A multitude of groves or forests. E. वन, and समूह a collection.
33532: वनसरोजिनी f. (-नी) Wild cotton. E. वन wild, and सरोजिनी Hibiscus.
33533: वनस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Wild, savage, forest or grove-abiding, &c. m. (-स्थः) 1 A deer. 2 A hermit, an ascetic. E. वन (in) a wood, and स्थ what stays.
33534: वनस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Being or abiding in a wood. m. (-यी) A hermit, an anchoret. E. वन, and स्थायिन् who stays.
33535: वनस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Situate or being in a forest. E. वन, and स्थित् what stays.
33536: वनस्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A tree that bears fruit but no apparent blossoms, as several species of the fig, the jack, &c. 2 A tree in general. 3 An ascetic. E. वन forest, and पति lord, सुट् augment.
33537: वनहास m. (-सः) A sort of tall grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. वन wood, and हास a smile, from हस to laugh, with घञ् aff.; also with कन् added, वनहासक.
33538: वनाकम्प m. (-म्पः) Shaking of the trees of a wood by the wind. E. वन, and आकम्प trembling.
33539: वनाखु m. (-खुः) A hare. E. वन a wood, and आखु a rat.
33540: वनाखुक m. (-कः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus Moong.)
33541: वनाज m. (-जः) A wild goat. E. वन a wood, and अज a goat.
33542: वनाटु m. (-टुः) A blue fly. E. वन a thicket, अट to go, कु aff.
33543: वनान्त n. (-न्तं) The skirts of a wood. E. वन, and अन्त end.
33544: वनाभिलाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Wood-destroying. E. वन, and अभिलाव destruction.
33545: वनामल m. (-लः) A fruit, (Carissa carondas.) E. वन wood, and आमल for आमलक myrobalan.
33546: वनायु m. (-युः) A country distinguished for its breed of horses; also वानायु.
33547: वनायुज m. (-जः) A horse of the Vanāyu breed. E. वनायु a country, and ज born.
33548: वनार्च्चक m. (-कः) A flower-gatherer. E. वन a wood, अर्च्च to go, वुन् aff.
33549: वनालिका f. (-का) A sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. वन a wood, अल to adorn, aff. वुन्, and fem. form.
33550: वनाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Forest, forester, who or what is in a forest. m. (-यः) 1 A raven, or perhaps more properly a sort of crow. 2 Dwelling in a forest. E. वन a wood, and आश्रय abode.
33551: वनाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Leading the life of a hermit, &c. E. वन, and आश्रित repaired to.
33553: वनि m. (-निः) Fire or its deity. E. वन to worship, Uṇādi aff. इ.
33554: वनिका f. (-का) A woody place, a grove. E. वनी, and कन् added.
33555: वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Solicited, begged. 2 Served. f. (-ता) 1 A woman in general. 2 A beloved woman, a wife, a mistress. E. वन to ask, aff. क्त.
33556: वनिष्ठु m. (-ष्ठुः) The entrails of an animal offered in sacrifice. E. वन to worship, इष्ठुच् Uṇādi aff.
33557: वनीक m. (-कः) A beggar; also वनीयक.
33558: वनीयक n. (-कः) A beggar, a mendicant. E. वन to ask, इन् aff.; क्यच् and वुन् added; also य being changed to प, वनीपक.
33559: वनेक्षुद्रा f. (-द्रा) A tree, commonly Karanja. E. वने in a wood, क्षुद्रा small.
33560: वनेचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what inhabits a wood, forest, forester. m. (-रः) 1 A forester, one of a savage tribe inhabiting woods, a sylvan, a satyr. 2 An imp, a demon. E. वने in a forest, and चर who goes.
33561: वनेचराग्र्य m. (-ग्र्यः) An ascetic, an anchorite, a sage. E. वनेचर, and अग्र्य chief.
33562: वनेशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Living in the woods. E. वने, शी to sleep, श aff.
33563: वनैकदेश m. (-शः) A part of a thicket. E. वन, and एकदेश a part.
33564: वनोत्साह m. (-हः) A rhinoceros. E. वन a wood, and उत्साह effort.
33565: वनोद्देश m. (-शः) A part of a thicket. E. वन, and उद्देश direction.
33566: वनोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in a forest. f. (-वा) Wild cotton. E. वन a wood, and उद्भव produced.
33567: वनौकस् m. (-काः) 1 A forester. 2 A monkey, an ape. E. वन wood, and ओकस् dwelling.
33568: वन्दका f. (-का) A parasite plant. E. वन्दा the same, कन् aff.
33569: वन्दथ m. (-थः) 1 A panegyrist, a eulogist, a bard. 2 One deserving praise or eulogium. E. वन्द to praise, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
33570: वन्दन n. (-नं) 1 The face or mouth. 2 Obeisance to a Brahman or superior by touching the feet, &c. f. (-नी) 1 Reverence, worship, adoring. 2 Begging, soliciting, asking. 3 The hip (?) 4 A drug for reviving the dead. f. (-ना) Praise, praising, especially the gods or great men. E. वदि to praise, aff. ल्युट् or युच्, fem. aff. ङीष् or टाप्.
33571: वन्दनमाला f. (-ला) The ornamented arch of a gate-way. E. वन्दन praising, and माला a garland; being hung with flowers on marriages and festival occasions.
33572: वन्दनमालिका f. (-का) The ornamented arch of a gate-way. E. वन्दन praising, माला a garland, कन् aff. in the fem. form.
33573: वन्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Praise-worthy, to be eulogised or praised. f. (-या) A yellow substance used as a pigment, said in the Tantras to be procured from the head of a cow: see रोचना. E. वदि to praise, अनीयर् aff.
33574: वन्दा f. (-न्दा) 1 A parasite plant, (Epidendrum tessellatum, &c.) 2 Any parasite plant. 3 A female beggar. E. वदि to praise, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
33575: वन्दाका f. (-का) A parasite plant. E. वन्दा, and कन् added.
33576: वन्दार m. (-रः) A parasite plant. E. वन्दा the same, ऋ to go or be, aff. अच्.
33577: वन्दारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) 1 Civil, complimentary, polite. 2 Praising, celebrating. m. (-रुः) A panegyrist, a bard. E. वदि to praise, आरु aff.
33578: वन्दि f. (-न्दिः-न्दी) 1 A captive, a prisoner, a man or beast confined. 2 A ladder or stairs. E. वदि to praise, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added.
33579: वन्दिग्राह m. (-हः) A house-breaker, especially one who breaks into the place in which the sacred fire is preserved, into an armoury, or a temple. E. वन्दि captive, (what is confined or shut up,) and ग्राह who seizes; also वन्दिचौर, &c.
33580: वन्दिचौर m. (-रः) A thief, a house-breaker. E. वन्दि, and चौर thief; see the last.
33581: वन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) 1 A panegyrist, a bard, a herald, a servant whose duty it is to proclaim the titles of a great man as he passes along, or a poet, who sings the praises of a prince in his presence, or accompanies an army, to chaunt martial songs: considered as one of a distinct tribe, he is the son of a Kṣatriya by a Śūdra female. 2 A praiser, a flatterer. E. वदि to praise, aff. इन्.
33582: वन्दिपाठ m. (-ठः) A complimentary stanza, a panegyric, a eulogium, often improvisatore, recited by a bard, &c. E. वन्दि a bard, and पाठ reading.
33583: वन्दीकार m. (-रः) A thief, a house-breaker.
33584: वन्द्य mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्यं) To be praised, commendable, laudable. f. (-न्द्या) A parasite plant. E. वदि to praise, यत् aff., or यक् Uṇādi aff.
33585: वन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A worshipper, a votary, a follower. E. वदि to praise, aff. रक.
33586: वन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Forest, savage, wild, produced in a wood, &c. f. (-न्या) 1 A multitude of groves. 2 A quantity of water, a flood, a deluge. 3 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. वन a wood, &c., यत् aff.
33587: वन्र m. (-त्रः) A copartner, a coheir, &c. E. वत to ask, and रन Uṇādi aff.
33588: वप(डु)डुवप r. 1st cl. (वपति) 1 To sow seed. 2 To procreate. 3 To shave. 4 To weave.
33589: वप m. (-पः) 1 Shaving. 2 Sowing seed. 3 Weaving. f. (-पा) 1 The mucous or glutinous secretion of the flesh or bones; according to some, also the marrow of the bones. 2 Any hole or cavity. E. वप to sow seed, &c., aff. अच्.
33590: वपन n. (-नं) 1 Sowing seed. 2 Shaving. 3 Semen virile. f. (-नी) A barber's shop. E. वप to shave, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
33591: वपाकृत् m. (-कृत्) Marrow. E. वपा, and कृत what makes.
33592: वपिल m. (-लः) A father. E. वप to sow seed, (figuratively,) and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
33593: वपुन m. (-नः) A deity. n. (-नं) Knowledge. E. वप to sow, उवन् aff.
33595: वपुष्मात् mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्) Having a body, corporeal, incarnate. E. वपुस्, and मतुप् aff.
33596: वपुस् n. (-पुः) 1 The body. 2 A handsome form or figure. E. वप to sow, Uṇādi aff. उसि.
33597: वप्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be sown. 2 To be given, conferred, implanted, &c. 3 To be immitted seminally, to be impregnated or begotten. E. वप to sow, तव्य aff.; also वपनीय, &c.
33598: वप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्ती-प्तृ) A sower, a planter, &c. m. (-प्ता) 1 A father, a progenitor. 2 A poet, a sage. E. वप to sow, aff. तृच्.
33599: वप्र mn. (-प्रः-प्रं) 1 A field. 2 A rampart, a mud wall, earth taken from the ditch of a town and raised as a wall or buttress, or as the foundation of a wall of masonry, &c. 3 The foundation of any building. 4 The gate of a fortified city. 5 A shore or bank. 6 Dust, earth. 7 A mound, a hillock. m. (-प्रः) A father. n. (-प्रं) Lead. f. (-प्री) A hillock, an ant-hill. E. वरु to sow, रन् Uṇādi aff.
33600: वप्रक्रीडा f. (-डा) Butting, as of an elephant or bull, &c. E. वप्र a mound, and कीडा sport.
33601: वप्रानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bowed or stooping to butt at a wall or bank. E. वप्र, and आनत bent.
33602: वप्रान्तर ind. In or between banks, mounds, &c. E. वप्र, and आन्तर् within.
33603: वप्राभिघात m. (-तः) Butting at a bank or mound. E. वप्र, and अभिघात striking.
33604: वप्राम्भस् n. (-म्भः) The water near or along the bank. E. वप्र, and अम्भस water.
33605: वप्रि m. (-प्रिः) A field. E. वप to sow, Uṇādi aff. क्रिन्.
33606: वभ्र r. 1st cl. (-वभ्रति) To go; also वभ्र.
33607: वम(टु उ)टुवमु r. 1st cl. (वमति) To vomit, to eject from the mouth.
33608: वम mf. (-मः-मी) Vomiting. E. वम to vomit, aff. अच्; also वमन and वमि.
33609: वमथु m. (-थुः) 1 Vomiting, ejecting any thing from the mouth. 2 Water ejected from an elephant's trunk. E. वम to vomit, aff. अथुच्.
33610: वमन n. (-नं) 1 Vomiting, ejecting any thing from the mouth. 2 Causing vomiting, an emetic. 3 Pain. 4 Offering oblations to fire. E. वम to vomit, aff. ल्युट्.
33611: वमि f. (-मिः) 1 Vomiting, sickness. 2 An emetic. m. (-मिः) 1 A name of fire. 2 A rogue, a cheat. E. वम to vomit, aff. इन्.
33612: वमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sickened, made to vomit. E. वम to be sick, causal v., क्त aff.
33613: वमित्वा ind. Having vomited or been sick. E. वम to be sick, क्त्वा aff.
33614: वमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Vomiting, sick. E. वम to vomit, इनि aff.
33615: वम्री f. (-म्री) A small ant burrowing in trees; also वम्रा.
33616: वम्रीकूट n. (-टं) An ant-hill, a hillock. E. वम्री a sort of ant, कूट a heap.
33617: वय r. 1st cl. (वयते) To go or move.
33618: वयःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Middle-aged, young, &c.: see वयस्थ.
33619: वयस् n. (-यः) 1 A bird. 2 Age, time of life. 3 Youth. E. वय to go, असुन् aff., or वी as substituted for अज to go, with the same aff.
33620: वयस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Relating to age, aged. E. वयस्, and कन् aff.
33621: वयस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Young, in the prime of life. 2 Mature, middle-aged, past childhood, or from sixteen to seventy. m. (-स्थः) A friend, an associate, a cotemporary. f. (-स्था) 1 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida) 2 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 3 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 4 Small cardamoms. 5 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 6 A medicinal root, commonly Kākolī. 7 A woman's female friend or companion, a confidante. 8 The silk-cotton tree. E. वयस् life, स्था to be or stay, aff. क, fem. aff. टाप्, the final of the former changed to Visarga, and that optionally rejected; hence, also वयःस्थ.
33622: वयस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Aged, relating to age. m. (-स्यः) A friend, a cotemporary, an associate or companion. f. (-स्या) A woman's female friend or confidante. E. वयस् life, यत् aff.
33623: वयुन n. (-नं) A temple. E. वी substituted for अज to go, and उनन् Uṇādi aff.
33624: वयोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Aged, very old. E. वयस्, and गत gone.
33625: वयोधस् m. (-धाः) A young or middle-aged man. E. वयस् youth or manhood, धा to have, Uṇādi aff. असि.
33626: वयोधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Very old. E. वयस्, and अधिक exceeding.
33627: वर r. 10th cl. (वरयति) To desire, to obtain, to covet or ask.
33628: वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Eldest. m. (-रः) 1 A boon, a blessing, especially in the gift of a Brahman or deity. 2 Engaging, selecting, appointing. 3 Requesting, soliciting, especially prevailing on a person by intreaty to undertake any business. 4 Surrounding, encompassing. 5 A husband, a bridegroom. 6 A son-in-law. 7 A catamite. 8 A drug: see गुग्गुल. 9 Wish, desire. 10 A sparrow. n. adv. (वरं) or ind. (वरम) Better, preferable. n. (-रं) Saffron. f. (-रा) 1 The three myrobalans. 2 A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇuka. 3 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) f. (-री) 1 Asparagus racemosus. 2 A name of CHĀYĀ, wife of the sun. E. वृ to select, to cover, &c., aff. अप् or अच्; it is also derived from वृ, and is then written with an initial consonant: see वर; also वर to desire, aff. अच्.
33629: वरक n. (-कं) 1 The cover or awning of a boat. 2 A wild kidneybean. 3 A towel, a wiper. E. वृ to cover, aff. वुन्.
33630: वरक्रतु m. (-तुः) INDRA. E. वर best, क्रतु sacrifice.
33631: वरचन्दन n. (-नं) 1 A dark sort of Sandal or Agallochum. 2 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. वर best, चन्दन Sandal.
33632: वरट m. (-टः) 1 A gander. 2 A man of a barbarous or foreign race. n. (-टं) Many-flowered jasmine. f. (-टः-टी) 1 A goose. 2 A wasp, &c. E. वृ to choose, aff. अटन्; fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.
33633: वरण n. (-णं) 1 Appointing, selecting, choosing. 2 Surrounding, inclosing. 3 Screening, covering. 4 Nourishing, supporting. m. (-णः) 1 An outer building, an enclosure, a wall of masonry, &c. raised on a mound of earth. 2 A causeway, a bridge. 3 A camel. 4 A tree, (Capparis trifoliata.) 5 Any tree. f. (-णा) A rivulet, running past the north of Benares, into the Ganges, now called the Berṇā. E. वृ to choose or appoint, aff. चयु.
33634: वरणसी f. (-सी) The city Benares, more usually वाराणसी. E. वरणा a rivulet as above, and असि another running on the south of the city, deriv. irr.
33635: वरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be applied to or solicited for a boon, &c. 2 To be selected. E. वर to ask as a boon, or वृ to choose, अनीयर् aff.
33636: वरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A portico. 2 Pimples on the face. 3 A multitude. 4 A heap of grass. 5 The string of a fish-hook. 6 A packet, a package. n. (-ण्डा) A small bird, (Turdus.) E. वृञ् to cover, &c., Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्.
33637: वरण्डक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Fearful, terrified. 2 Large, great. 3 Miserly, a miser. m. (-कः) 1 A howdah, a chair or canopy on the back of an elephant. 2 A wall. 3 Eruption or pimples on the face. 4 A ball, a globe. E. वरण्ड as above, and कन् added.
33638: वरण्डालु m. (-लुः) The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis.)
33639: वरतनु f. (-नुः) An elegant woman. E. वर, and तनु body.
33640: वरत्करी f. (-री) A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.
33641: वरत्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 An elephant's or horse's leather girth. 2 A thong, a strip of leather. E. वृञ् to cover or surround, Uṇādi aff. अत्रन.
33642: वरत्वच m. (-चः) The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.) E. वर best, and त्वच् skin, the final vowel added.
33643: वरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Granting a prayer, conferring a boon. 2 Propitious, favourable. m. (-दः) 1 A benefactor. 2 Fire for burnt-offerings of a propitiatory character. f. (-दा) A girl, a virgin. E. वर a blessing, &c., and द who gives.
33644: वरदान n. (-नं) 1 Granting a boon. 2 A place of pilgrimage. E. वर a blessing, and दान giving.
33645: वरपर्णाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.
33646: वरप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring a boon. f. (-दा) The wife of the saint AGASTYA. E. वर a boon, and प्रद who gives.
33647: वरप्रदान n. (-नं) Conferring a boon. E. वर, and प्रदान giving.
33648: वरफल m. (-लः) The cocoa-nut tree. E. वर best, and फल fruit.
33649: वरमुखी f. (-खी) Reṇukā, a sort of perfume.
33650: वरम् ind. Better, sooner, rather, preferable: see वर.
33651: वरम्बरा f. (-रा) The nux vomica plant.
33652: वरयितृ m. (-ता) A husband. E. वर to choose, in the causal form, aff. तृच्.
33653: वररुचि m. (-चिः) A poet and philosopher, one of the ornaments of the court of Bhoja, or one of the nine gems usually ascribed to VIKRAMĀDITYA'S court. E. वर pre-eminent, better, रुचि light or renown.
33654: वरल mf. (-लः-ला or -ली) A wasp. f. (-ला) A goose. E. वर, and ला to take, aff. क.
33656: वरवत्सला f. (-ला) The wife of a father-in-law. E. वर a bridegroom, and वत्सल affectionate.
33657: वरवर्णिनी f. (-नी) 1 An excellent woman. 2 A virtuous woman. 3 A woman in general. 4 Turmeric. 5 Lāc. 6 A brownish yellow pigment; also रोचना and गोरोहना. 7 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 8 A name of GAURĪ. 9 SARASVATĪ. 10 LAKṢMĪ. E. वर best, बर्ण class or colour, aff. इनि and ङीष्.
33658: वरवारण m. (-णः) A fine elephant. E. वर, and वारण an elephant.
33659: वरवाह्लीक n. (-कं) Saffron. E. वर, and वाह्लीक the same.
33660: वरवृद्ध m. (-द्धः) ŚIVA. E. वर better, and वृद्ध old.
33661: वराक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Low, vile, impure. 2 Poor, pitiable. m. (-कः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 War. E. वृ to cover, &c., षाकन् aff.
33662: वराङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 The head. 2 A privity, a private part, male or female. 3 Cassia bark. 4 An elegant form or body. m. (-ङ्गः) An elephant. E. वर best, excellent, अङ्ग body or member.
33663: वराङ्गक m. (-कः) Woody Cassia. E. कन् added to the preceding.
33664: वराङ्गना f. (-ना) A lovely woman. E. वर best, अङ्गना a woman.
33665: वराङ्गरूपोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Handsome and well-shaped. E. वराङ्ग excellent body, रूप form, and उपेत invested, possessing.
33666: वराट n. (-टः) 1 A cord, a rope. 2 A Cowri: see the next.
33667: वराटक mfn. subst. (-टकः-टिका-टकं) 1 A rope, a cord, a string. 2 The small shell, called a Cowri, and used as a coin. 3 The seed-vessel of the lotus. m. (-टिका) The Nagesara plant. E. वृञ् to surround, aff. अटच्, and कन् added.
33668: वराटकरजस् m. (-जाः) A plant, commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea).
33669: वराण m. (-णः) 1 INDRA. 2 A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.) E. वर best, and णी to obtain, with आङ् prefix, and ड aff.
33670: वराणसी f. (-सी) Benares. E. वर best, अनस् water, ङीप् aff., i. e. the Ganges, on whose bank the city is situated; also वाराणसी and वरणसी.
33671: वरादन n. (-नं) A sort of Mimusops, (M. Kauki, Rox.) E. वर best, अदन eating.
33672: वराम्र m. (-म्रः) An acid fruit, (Carissa Carondas.) E. वर best, अम्र acid.
33673: वरारक n. (-कं) The diamond. E. वर best, ऋ to go or be, ण्वुल् aff.
33674: वरारोह m. (-हः) 1 An elephant-driver. 2 Mounting, riding. 3 A rider on an elephant or horse. f. (-हा) 1 A handsome or elegant woman. 2 The hip or flank. E. वर excellent, आरोह mounting, &c.
33675: वरालक m. (-कः) The Caronda fruit, (Carissa Carondas.) E. वर best, अल to be equal to, वुन् aff.
33676: वरालि m. (-लिः) 1 The moon. 2 A division of music.
33677: वरालिका f. (-का) A name of DURGĀ. E. वर best, supreme, आलि a female friend, कन् added.
33678: वराशि m. (-शिः) Coarse cloth. E. वर covering, अश to pervade, aff. इन्; also वरासि.
33679: वरासन n. (-नं) 1 A cistern, a reservoir. 2 The China rose. m. (-नः) 1 A whoremonger. 2 A door-keeper. E. वर best, &c., आसन seat.
33680: वरासि m. (-सिः) 1 Coarse cloth. 2 A swordsman. f. (-सी) Dirty clothes. E. वर covering, अस to be, aff. इन् and ङीप्.
33681: वराह m. (-हः) 1 A hog. 2 A name of VIṢṆU in the third Avatāra or descent, in which he assumed the shape of a boar. 3 A mountain. 4 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 5 A sort of measure. 6 One of the eighteen smaller Dvīpas or divisions of the universe. E. वर best, हन to injure, with आङ् prefix, and ड aff.
33682: वराहकान्ता f. (-न्ता) A sort of yam. E. वराह a hog, and कान्ता beloved; also वराही.
33684: वराहक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A plant, a sort of sensitive plant according to some authorities, but to others, a kind of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.:) it is also considered sometimes, but erroneously, as synonymous with वराही Dioscorea. E. वराह a hog, and क्रान्त passing.
33685: वराहनामन् m. (-मा) An esculent root: see वाराही. E. वराह a hog, and नामन् a name.
33686: वरिवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Served, honoured, adored, as a deity or spiritual teacher. E. वरिवस्या service, इतच् aff., and य optionally rejected.
33687: वरिवस्या f. (-स्या) Service, honour, especially such devoted obedience as a pupil pays his spiritual preceptor. E. वरिवस indeclinable, here said to imply veneration, and क्याच् aff.
33688: वरिवस्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Served, adored. E. वरिवस्या as above, and इतच् aff.
33689: वरिशी f. (-शी) A fish-hook. E. see वडिशी, ड, and र being interchanged.
33690: वरिष n. (-षं) A year. m. plu. (-षाः) The rains or rainy season. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. इषन्.
33691: वरिषाप्रिय m. (-यः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. वरिषा the rainy season, and प्रिय fond of; being supposed to drink rain water only.
33692: वरिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Largest, greatest, most large. 2 Heaviest, mightiest. 3 Best, dearest, most preferable or beloved. n. (-ष्ठं) 1 Copper. 2 Pepper. m. (-ष्ठः) The Francoline partridge. E. वर् substituted for उरु large, or वरु best, and इष्ठन्. affix of the irr. superlative.
33693: वरीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very large, largest, most large. 2 Best, most preferable or excellent. 3 Extremely young, tender, infantine. m. (-यान्) The eighteenth of the astronomical periods called Yogas. E. वर best, or substituted for उरु, and इयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
33694: वरीवर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) An ox or bull. E. see वलीवर्द्द, ब and ल being changed to व and र; also वलीवर्द्द.
33695: वरीषु m. (-षुः) KĀMA or CUPID. E. वृ to choose, ईषुन् aff.
33696: वरुण m. (-णः) 1 VARUṆA, the deity of the waters and regent of the west. 2 Water or the ocean. 3 A tree, (Tapia cratoeva, or Capparis trifoliata.) 4 A name of the sun, or rather of one of the twelve forms of that luminary, or Ādityas.
