E. वृ to enclose (the earth), or वृ to select or prefer, being chosen by the gods for his office, and उनन् Uṇādi aff.
33697: वरुणात्मजा f. (-जा) Spirituous liquor. E. वरुण VARUṆA or the ocean personified, and आत्मजा daughter; being amongst the precious things produced at the churning of the ocean.
33698: वरुणानी f. (-नी) The wife of VARUṆA. E. वरुण, with ङीप् aff. and आनुक् augment.
33699: वरुत्र n. (-त्रं) An upper and outer garment. E. वृ to cover, उत्र Uṇādi aff.
33700: वरूथ m. (-थः) A sort of wooden fender or ledge round a carriage, as a defence from the effects of collision. n. (-थं) 1 Armour, mail. 2 Leather, skin. 3 A house or dwelling. E. वृ to surround, Uṇādi aff. ऊथन्.
33701: वरूथिन् m. (-थी) 1 A guard, a defender. 2 A car. f. (-नी) An army. E. वरूथ part of a car, इनि and ङीप् affs.
33703: वरेण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Chief, principal, pre-eminent. E. वृ to select, Uṇādi aff. एण्य.
33704: वरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A chief, a sovereign. 2 INDRA. f. (-न्द्री) Ancient Gaur, the capital and district so named. E. वर best, इन्द्र chief, and with ङीप् aff.; the favorite country of the deity, &c.
33705: वरेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. E. वर best, principal, ईश्वर lord.
33706: वरोट m. (-टः) A plant, commonly Marüa.
33707: वरोल mf. (-लः-ली) A wasp. E. वृ to cover, ओलच् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्; the fem. form may also mean, a smaller kind of wasp.
33708: वर्कर mf. (-रः-री) Any young animal. m. (-रः) 1 A lamb. 2 A goat. 3 Pleasure, pastime, sport, mirth, festivity. E. वृक to take, aff. अरन्.
33709: वर्कराट m. (-टः) 1 A side glance, a wink, a leer. 2 The rays of the meridian sun. mn. (-टः-टं) The marks of a lover's finger nails on the bosom of a woman. E. वर्कर a young animal, अट to be or resemble, aff. अच्.
33710: वर्कुट m. (-टः) A pin, a bolt.
33711: वर्ग n. (-र्गः) A class, a tribe, a multitude of similar things, whether animate or inanimate; as Ka-verga, the class of guttural letters; Tri-verga, a class of three (objects, as love, duty, and wealth); the Śūdra-varga, the Śūdra tribe. 2 A chapter, a book, a section. 3 A square number, (in arithmetic.) E. वृज to quit, to except (any thing else), aff. घञ्.
33712: वर्गघन n. (-नं) The square of a cube. E. वर्ग, and घन a cube.
33713: वर्गमूल n. (-लं) A square root. E. वर्ग, and मूल a root.
33714: वर्गीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to a class, a tribe, &c. E. वर्ग, and छ aff.
33716: वर्च्च r. 1st cl. (वर्च्चते) To shine. r. 10th cl. (वर्च्चयति) 1 To cut. 2 To fill.
33717: वर्च्चटी f. (-टी) 1 A kind of rice. 2 A harlot.
33718: वर्च्चस् n. (-र्च्चः) 1 Form, figure, shape. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Ordure, fæces. m. (-र्च्चाः) The son of CANDRA. E. वर्च्च to shine, असुन् aff.
33719: वर्च्चस्क mn. (-स्कः-स्कं) Fæces, excrement. E. वर्च to shine, असुन् aff., and कन् depreciative aff. added.
33720: वर्च्चस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Bright, glorious. E. वर्च्चस, and विन् aff.
33721: वर्ज्ज mfn. (-र्ज्जः-र्ज्जा-र्ज्जं) 1 Free from, devoid of. 2 Excepted. m. (-र्ज्जः) 1 Leaving, abandoning. 2 Excepting. E. वृज to abandon, aff. अच्.
33722: वर्ज्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what leaves, shuns, excepts, &c. E. वृज to quit, ण्वुल् aff.
33723: वर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Quitting, abandonment, shunning, avoiding. 2 Injury, hurting. 3 Killing. E. वृज to abandon, aff. ल्युट्.
33724: वर्ज्जयित्वा ind. 1 Having shunned or avoided. 2 Having omitted, excepting, leaving out. E. वृज to quit, aff. क्त्वा.
33725: वर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abandoned, avoided. 2 Given. 3 Excluded, excepted. E. वृज to quit, aff. क्त.
33726: वर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Improper, censurable, wicked, proper to be avoided. 2 Irregular, to be excepted. E. वृज to quit, and अनीयर् aff. of the future participle.
33727: वर्ज्ज्य mfn. (-र्ज्ज्यः-र्ज्ज्या-र्ज्ज्यं) 1 To be shunned. 2 To be excepted, excluded, left out. n. (-र्ज्ज्यं) A point in each lunar mansion during the passage of the moon, in which no business should be begun. E. वृज to quit, यत् aff.
33728: वर्ण r. 10th cl. (वर्णयति) 1 To colour, to paint, to dye. 2 To send or cast, to direct, to order. 3 To praise, to extol, to proclaim qualities. 4 To describe. 5 To spread or extend. 6 To grind or pound. 7 To make exertions. 8 To shine.
33729: वर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A tribe, a class, a caste, an order. 2 Colour, hue, tint. 3 Coloured cloth thrown over the back of an elephant, an elephant's housings. 4 Quality, property. 5 Fame, celebrity. 6 Praise. 7 Gold. 8 Religious observance. 9 The order or arrangement of a song or poem. 10 A musical mode. 11 Staining the body with coloured unguents. 12 Beauty, lustre. 13 Theatrical dress or embellishment. mn. (-र्णः-र्णं) 1 Perfume for the person. 2 A letter of the alphabet. 3 Form, figure. 4 Sort, kind. 5 Touch, the purity of gold, as ascertained by its streak on the touch-stone. 6 In arithmetic, a co-efficient. n. (-र्णं) Saffron. f. (-र्णा) A leguminous shrub, (Cytisus cajan.) E. वर्ण to paint, &c., aff. अच् or घञ्, or वृ to cover or screen, Uṇādi aff. नक्.
33730: वर्णक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 Perfume for the person, especially pounded or ground. 2 Sandal. mf. (-कः-का) A paint, a pigment, as indigo, orpiment, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A panegyrist, a bard, a poetical encomiast, by tribe and profession. 2 A circle, an orb. f. (-का) Touch, standard, fineness or purity of gold. E. वण to colour, &c., ण्वुल् aff., or वर्ण as above, कन् added.
33731: वर्णकवि m. (-विः) The son of KUVERA. E. वर्ण praise, and कवि a bard.
33732: वर्णकूपिका f. (-का) An ink-stand. E. वर्ण a letter, and कूप a well, कन् aff. of comparison, in the fem. form.
33733: वर्णक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Order of caste or tribe. 2 Alphabetical arrangement, the alphabet. E. वर्ण, and क्रम course.
33734: वर्णगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Coloured. 2 Described. 3 Algebraic. E. वर्ण, and गत gone to.
33735: वर्णचारक m. (-कः) A painter. E. वर्ण colour, चर to go, aff. ण्वुल्.
33736: वर्णज्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A Brahman. E. वर्ण caste, ज्येष्ठ elder.
33737: वर्णतस् ind. By or with colour, &c. E. वर्ण colour, and तसि aff.
33738: वर्णतूलि mf. (-लिः-ली) A pen. E. वर्ण a letter, and तूलि a brush; also with कन् added, वर्णतूलिका f. (-का.)
33739: वर्णद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Dying, colouring. 2 Giving tribe, &c. m. (-दः) Aloe wood or Agallochum. E. वर्ण, and द who or what gives.
33740: वर्णदातृ m. (-ता) Turmeric. E. वर्ण, and दातृ what gives.
33741: वर्णदूत m. (-त) A letter, an epistle. E. वर्ण a letter of the alphabet, &c., and टूत sent.
33742: वर्णदूषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Disturbing or violating the distinctions of caste. E. वर्ण, and टूषक what violates.
33743: वर्णधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The particular occupation or duty of each caste or tribe. E. वर्ण a tribe, धर्म्म virtue, moral merit.
33744: वर्णन n. (-नं) Describing, expatiating, explaining, pointing out qualities or excellencies, &c. 2 Colouring, painting, writing. f. (-ना) Praise, panegyric. E. वर्ण to colour, युच् and टाप् aff.
33745: वर्णनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be described, delineated, praised, &c. E. वर्ण to colour, अनीयर् aff.
33746: वर्णपत्र m. (-त्रः) A pallet, a leaf, &c. on which a painter mixes his colours. E. वर्ण a colour, and पत्र a leaf.
33747: वर्णमातृ f. (-ता) A pen. E. वर्ण a letter, and मातृ mother.
33748: वर्णमातृका f. (-का) SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech and eloquence. E. वर्ण a letter, and मातृका divine parent.
33749: वर्णमाला f. (-ला) The alphabet. E. वर्ण a letter, माला a garland.
33750: वर्णरेखा f. (-खा) A white aluminous fossil often confounded with chalk, of which it is considered a species. E. वर्ण colour, रेखा a line.
33751: वर्णलेखा f. (-खा) Chalk. E. वर्ण colour, लेखा a line.
33752: वर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having tribe, colour, &c. f. (-वती) Turmeric. E. वर्ण colour, मतुप् aff.
33753: वर्णविलोडक m. (-कः) 1 A plagiarist. 2 A house-breaker. E. वर्ण praise, and वि before लोड to be mad, aff. ण्वुल्.
33754: वर्णवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Metre regulated by the number of syllables. E. वर्ण, and वृत्त metre.
33755: वर्णश्रेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Of a good tribe, caste, kind, &c. m. (-ष्ठः) A Brahman. E. वर्ण, and श्रेष्ठ best.
33756: वर्णसंहार m. (-रः) An assemblage or mixture of the four tribes. E. वर्ण, and संहार assemblage.
33757: वर्णसङ्कर m. (-रः) 1 Mixture or confusion of castes. 2 A man or tribe of mixed origin, or from a father and mother of different castes. E. वर्ण, and सङ्कर mixture.
33758: वर्णसङ्घाट m. (-टः) An alphabet or assemblage of letters. E. वर्ण, हन to kill, with सम् prefixed, and घञ् aff., and घट substituted for the radical letters; also with घत, वर्णसङ्घात.
33759: वर्णसङ्घात m. (-तः) The alphabet: see the last.
33760: वर्णसि m. (-सिः) Water. E. वृ to surround, असि Uṇādi aff., and नुक् augment.
33761: वर्णहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Outcaste. E. वर्ण, and हीन void of.
33762: वर्णाङ्का f. (-ङ्का) A pen. E. वर्ण a letter, अकि to go, aff. अच्.
33763: वर्णाट m. (-टः) 1 A singer. 2 A painter. 3 An actor, a mime. E. वर्ण colour, &c., अट to go or be, aff. अच्.
33764: वर्णात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A word. E. वर्ण a letter, and आत्मन् the soul or essence.
33765: वर्णापसद m. (-दः) An outcaste. E. वर्ण, and अपसद who is or goes out from.
33766: वर्णापेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Degraded, outcaste. E. वर्ण, and अपेत devoid of.
33767: वर्णाश्रम n. (-मं) The class and state of a person. E. वर्ण, and आश्रम order.
33768: वर्णाश्रमधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duties of tribe and order. E. वर्णाश्रम, and धर्म्म duty.
33769: वर्णि n. (-र्णि) Gold. E. वर्ण to colour, &c., Uṇādi aff. इन्.
33770: वर्णिक m. (-कः) A writer, a scribe, a secretary, &c. f. (-का) 1 A pen. 2 Ink. E. वर्ण a letter, aff. ठक्.
33771: वर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Praised, eulogised, extolled. 2 Described, explained. 3 Painted. E. वर्ण to praise, aff. क्त.
33772: वर्णितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Relating, describing, was relating or related, &c. E. वर्ण to describe, क्तवतु aff.
33773: वर्णिन् mfn. (-र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) Belonging to a caste or tribe, of that caste, &c. m. (-र्णी) 1 A painter. 2 A scribe, a writer. 3 A religious student. 4 A man of either of the four regular castes. f. (-र्णिनी) 1 A woman, a wife. 2 Turmeric. E. वर्ण colour, &c., इनि aff.
33774: वर्णिबध m. (-धः) Killing or occasioning the death of a man of either of four castes. E. वर्णिन्, and बध killing.
33775: वर्णिलिङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) An ascetic, or one wearing the marks of a religious student. E. वर्णिन्, and लिङ्गिन् having a mark.
33776: वर्णु m. (-र्णुः) The name of a river and district. E. वृ to surround, Uṇādi aff. णु.
33777: वर्णोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having caste, tribe, &c. E. वर्ण, and उपेत possessed of.
33778: वर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who is or abides, exists, lives, &c. mf. (-कः-का) 1 A sort of quail, (Perdix olivacea.) 2 A horse's hoof. n. (-कं) A sort of mixed or bell-metal, commonly Vidri. E. वृत to be, वुन् aff.
33779: वर्त्तजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A cloud. E. वृत to be, aff. घञ्, वर्त्त abiding, and जन्मन् birth.
33780: वर्त्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fixed, stationary, stable. nf. (-नं-नी) 1 Staying, abiding, being, the property of a fixed presence. 2 A road, a way. 3 A ball at one end of a spindle to assist its rotatory motion. 4 Grinding. n. (-नं) 1 Livelihood, subsistence. 2 Occupation, profession. 3 Salary, hire, wages. 4 A ball of cotton from which the threads are spun. 5 A ball, a globe. 6 Appointing. 7 Turning. m. (-नः) A dwarf. E. वृत to be, to be fixed, &c, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
33781: वर्त्तनदान n. (-नं) Gift of a situation, of wages or means of subsistence. E. वर्त्तन, and दान giving.
33782: वर्त्तनविनियोग m. (-गः) Appointment or assignment of salary, wages, &c. E. वर्त्तन, and विनियोग appointing.
33783: वर्त्तनाभाव m. (-वः) Destitution, want of means of subsistence. E. वर्त्तन, and अभाव non-existence.
33784: वर्त्तनि m. (-निः) The eastern country, or eastern India. f. (-निः) A road. E. वृत to be, Uṇādi aff. अनि.
33785: वर्त्तनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be lived, or dwelt in. 2 What may be. E. वृत to be, अनीयर् aff.
33786: वर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being, existing, living, being present. 2 Dwelling or abiding in. n. (-नं) (In grammar,) The present tense. E. वृत to be, शानच् aff.
33787: वर्त्तमानता f. (ता) Being, being present, the property of time present. E. तल् added to the last: also with त्व aff. वर्त्तमानत्वं.
33788: वर्त्तयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Living, subsisting. 2 Dwelling. E. वृत to be, aff. शतृ.
33789: वर्त्तरूक m. (-कः) 1 A river so named. 2 A puddle, a pool of water. 3 A crow's nest. 4 A door-keeper, a chamberlain; it is also written वर्त्तरूढ.
33790: वर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्ती) 1 Perfume for the person. 2 The wick of a lamp. 3 A lamp. 4 A tent, a bougie. 5 A collyrium prepared from various substances and dried in a lozenge form; it is exhibited ground with water or milk. 6 A line, a ruled line. 7 The ends of a cloth. E. वृत to be, Uṇādi aff. इन्, ङीप् optionally added.
33791: वर्त्तिका f. (-का) 1 A quail. 2 The wick of a lamp. E. वृत to be, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. aff. टाप्; also वर्त्तक and वर्त्तका, or वृत the same, तिकन् Uṇādi aff.
33792: वर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Caused or made to be or exist. E. वृत to be, causal v., क्त aff.
33793: वर्त्तितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be lived. 2 To be dwelt, remained, or continued. 3 To be practised in. 4 What may be, possible, probable. E. वृत to be, तव्य aff.
33794: वर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 1 Abiding, fixed, stationary. 2 Being. E. वृत to be, aff. इनि.
33795: वर्त्तिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Staying, abiding, being stationary or fixed. 2 Facing (an enemy,) standing firm in battle. 3 A circle. E. वृत to be, इष्णुच् aff.
33796: वर्त्तुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Round, circular, globular, spherical. m. (-लः) 1 A pea. 2 A ball. f. (-ला) A ball of clay at the end of a spindle to assist its rotation. E. वृत to be, उलच् aff.
33797: वर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) 1 A road. 2 An eyelid. E. वृत to be, मनिन् aff.
33798: वर्त्मनि f. (-निः) A road, a way. E. वृत to be, अनि Uṇādi aff., and मुट् augment.
33799: वर्त्मावबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Rigidity of the eyelids, so that they cannot shut. E. वर्त्म, and अवबन्ध contraction.
33800: वर्त्स्यत् mfn. (-र्त्स्यन्-र्त्स्यन्ती-र्त्स्यत्) Purposing to augment. E. वृद्ध to augment, शतृ aff. with the future form.
33801: वर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) 1 A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi. 2 Increase, augmentation. 3 Cutting. n. (-र्द्धं) Red lead. E. वृध to grow or increase, aff. घञ्, or वर्ध to divide, aff. अच्.
33802: वर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Increasing, causing to grow or increase. 2 Dividing. m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi. E. वृध to grow, or वर्द्ध to divide, aff. ण्वुल्.
33803: वर्द्धकि m. (-किः) A carpenter. E. वर्ध to cut, अच् aff., कष to injure, इ aff., form irr.
33804: वर्द्धकिन् m. (-की) A carpenter. E. वर्धक cutting, इनि aff.
33805: वर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Growing, thriving. n. (-नं) 1 Increasing, growing, thriving. 2 Augmenting, causing to increase. 3 Cutting, dividing. f. (-नी) 1 A small water jar. 2 A brush, a broom. E. वृध to increase, or वध to cut, aff. ल्युट्.
33806: वर्द्धमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Prosperous, thriving. 2 Increasing, growing. m. (-नः) 1 The castor oil tree. 2 A lid, a cover, especially a shallow earthen platter or saucer, used also as a top to water-jars, &c. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. 4 A sort of riddle or charade. 5 The last and most celebrated of the twenty-four Jinas or Jaina teachers of the present æra. 6 A mystical figure or diagram. 7 A district and city, Burdwan. E. वृत्रि to increase, शानच् aff.
33807: वर्द्धमानक m. (-कः) A lid, a cover. E. वर्द्धमान as above, and कन् added.
33808: वर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Grown, expanded, increased, thriven. 2 Full, filled. 3 Cut, divided. E. वृध to increase, or वर्द्ध to. cut, aff. क्त.
33809: वर्द्धापन n. (-नं) Cutting, dividing. E. वर्द्ध to cut, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
33810: वर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) Increasing, thriving. E. वृध to increase, इनि aff.
33811: वर्द्धिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Increasing, growing, thriving. 2 Enlarging, expanding. E. वृध to increase, aff. इष्णुच्.
33812: वर्द्ध्र nf. (-र्द्ध्र-र्द्ध्री) A leathern thong or girth for securing a saddle. n. (-र्द्ध्रं) Leather. E. वृध to increase, Uṇādi aff. रन्; also वर्द्धी.
33813: वर्ध r. 10 cl. (वर्धयति) 1 To cut or pierce, to divide. 2 To fill.
33814: वर्पस् n. (-र्पः) Form, figure. E. वृ to choose, aff. असुन, and पुट् augment.
33815: वर्फ r. 1st cl. (वर्फति) 1 To move, to go. 2 To kill.
33816: वर्म्मकषा f. (-षा) A plant; also Carmakaṣā or Carmaghās.
33817: वर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Armour, mail. E. वृ to cover, aff. मनिन्.
33818: वर्म्महर m. (-रः) One who takes arms or who spoils another of them. E. वर्म्म, and हर who takes.
33819: वर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Armed, accoutred. E. वर्म्म mail, इतच् aff.
33820: वर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 Chief, principal. 2 To be applied to for aid or a boon, &c. 3 To be chosen or selected. 4 To be yielded to or indulged. m. (-र्य्यः) KĀMADEVA. f. (-र्य्या) A girl choosing her own husband. E. वर to ask as a boon, or वृ to choose, यत् aff., form irr.
33821: वर्व्वट mf. (-टः-टी) A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.)
33822: वर्व्वणा f. (-णा) A blue fly. E. वर् imitative sound, and वण or वण to utter, aff. अच्; also वर्व्वणा and वर्व्वणा.
33823: वर्व्वर mfn. subst. (-रः-रा or -री-रं) A sort of basil, (Ocymum pilosum, Rox.) m. (-रः) 1 A low man, one of a degraded tribe or occupation, an out-caste, a barbarians. 2 A region, a country, the country inhabited by barbarians. 3 Woolly or curly hair, as the hair of an African. 4 A shrub, (Shiponanthus Indica.) 5 A sort of worm. 6 The noise or clash of weapons. 7 A mode of dancing. f. (-रा-री) 1 A sort of potherb. 2 A small bee. 3 The Baya or Indian grosbeak, (Loxia philippensis.) n. (-रं) 1 Vermilion. 2 Gum myrrh. 3 A sort of Sandal wood. E. वृ to choose, Uṇādi aff. करक्ष्, or the same root, with अच् aff., in the reiterative form; it is also derived from बर्ब to go, and is variously written बर्ब्बर, वर्शर, वर्व्वर, and वर्व्वर, &c.
33824: वर्व्वरीक m. (-कः) 1 Curly or woolly hair. 2 A shrub, commonly Bamanaiṭhi. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 A sort of basil. E. वृ to select, Uṇādi aff. ईकन्, and the root repeated.
33825: वर्व्वरोत्थ n. (-त्थं) White Sandal. E. वर्व्वर the country of barbarians, and उत्थ what grows.
33826: वर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A sort of basil, (Ocymum pilosum, Rox.)
33827: वर्व्वि m. (-र्व्विः) A glutton. E. वृ to chuse, Uṇādi aff. विन्.
33828: वर्ष r. 1st cl. (-वर्षति) To be wet.
33829: वर्ष mn. (-र्षः-र्षं) 1 Rain, raining. 2 Sprinkling, affusion. 3 A year. 4 A Varṣa, or division of the known continent; nine are reckoned; Kuru, Hiraṇmaya, Romānaka, Ilāvṛta, Hari, Ketumālā, Bhadrāśva, Kinnara, and Bharata. 5 Jambu Dvīpa, or India. 6 A cloud. m. plu. (-र्षाः) The rains or rainy season, containing two months, according to the Hindu classification of the seasons, which some systems consider to be Śrāvaṇa and Bhādra, and others, Bhādra and Āśvina; the duration of the monsoon is however longer, being reckoned from Āṣārha to Kārttika, or from the middle of June to the beginning of October. f. sing. (-र्षा) A sort of gramineous plant: see पृक्का. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. अच्, or वॄ to screen, &c., Uṇādi aff. स.
33830: वर्षकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Making or producing rain. m. (-रः) A cloud. f. (-री) A cricket. E. वर्ष rain, कृ to make or mark, ट aff.; the cricket chirping-especially in wet weather.
33831: वर्षकोष m. (-षः) 1 An astrologer. 2 A month. E. वर्ष a year, and कोष a vocabulary, &c.
33832: वर्षज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced in the rains or rainy season. E. वर्ष the rains, and ज born; also वर्षेज.
33833: वर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Raining, rain. 2 Sprinkling. E. वृष to sprinkle, ल्युट् aff.
33834: वर्षणि f. (-णिः) 1 Abiding, staying. 2 Act, action. E. वृष to sprinkle, अनि Uṇādi aff.
33835: वर्षत् mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्) Raining, showering, sprinkling. E. वृष to rain, शतृ aff.
33836: वर्षधर m. (-रः) 1 An eunuch or attendant on the women's apartments. 2 A cloud. E. वर्ष rain, and घर what holds.
33837: वर्षधर्ष m. (-र्षः) An eunuch or attendant on the women's apartments.
33838: वर्षपर्व्वत m. (-तः) A mountainous range, supposed to separate the various Varṣas or divisions of the globe from each other: six ranges are enumerated from south to north; viz. Himavān, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgī or Śṛṅgavān; Meru constitutes the seventh; other names occur. E. वर्ष as above, and पर्व्वत a mountain.
33839: वर्षपाकिन् m. (-की) The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.) E. वर्ष rain, and पाकिन् ripening.
33840: वर्षप्रिय m. (-यः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. वर्ष rain, and प्रिय fond of.
33841: वर्षवर m. (-रः) A eunuch, a castrated attendant, one employed in the women's apartments. E. वर्ष seminal sprinkling, वर free from.
33842: वर्षशत n. (-तं) A century. E. वर्ष, and शत a hundred.
33843: वर्षसहस्र n. (-स्रं) A thousand years. E. वर्ष, and सहस्र a thousand.
33844: वर्षांश m. (-शः) A month. E. वर्ष a year, and अंश a part; also with कन् added, वर्षांशक.
33845: वर्षाकाल n. (-लं) The rainy season. E. वर्षा, and काल time.
33846: वर्षाकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Belonging to or produced in the rainy season. E. वर्षाकाल, and ख aff.
33847: वर्षाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A month. E. वर्ष a year, and अङ्ग a limb or member.
33848: वर्षाघोष m. (-षः) A frog. E. mfn. वर्षा, and घोष sound.
33849: वर्षाप्रभञ्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Rain-scattering. m. (-नः) A high wind, a gale. E. वर्षा, and प्रभञ्जन scattering.
33850: वर्षाभू m. (-भूः) A frog. f. (-भ्वी) 1 Hog-weed. 2 An earth-worm, (Iulus.) 3 A she frog or any small frog. E. वर्षा the rains, भू to be, aff. क्विप्.
33851: वर्षामद m. (-दः) A peacock. E. वर्ष the rains, आमद who rejoices.
33852: वर्षाम्भःपारणाव्रत m. (-तः) A Cātaka. E. वर्षाम्भस् rain water, पारणा attention, and व्रत observance.
33853: वर्षायुत n. (-तं) Ten thousand years. E. वर्ष, and अयुत ten thousand.
33854: वर्षारात्र m. (-त्रः) A rainy night. E. वर्षा, and रात्रि night.
33855: वर्षार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet MARS. E. वर्षा the rains, अर्च्चिस् light, visible in the rainy season.
33856: वर्षालङ्कायिका f. (-का) A plant: see पृक्का. E. वर्ष, and लङ्कायिक synonymous; conjoined.
33857: वर्षावसान m. (-नः) Autumn, the autumnal season. E. वर्षा the rains, and अवसान end.
33858: वर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Raining, rainy, relating or belonging to the rains. 2 Shedding, showering, pouring down. n. (-कं) Aloe wood or Agallochum. E. वर्ष, and ठक् aff.
33859: वर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 1 Raining. 2 Sprinkling. E. वृष to sprinkle, घिनुण् aff.
33860: वर्षिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Oldest, very old. E. वर्ष substituted for वृद्घ old, and इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
33861: वर्षीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very aged, or old. E. वर्ष substituted for वृद्ध old, and इयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
33862: वर्षुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Rainy, watery. E. वृष to sprinkle, and उकञ् aff.
33863: वर्षुकाब्द m. (-ब्दः) A rainy cloud. E. वर्षुक rainy, and अब्द a cloud.
33864: वर्षेज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced in the rains. E. वर्षे in the rains, and ज born.
33865: वर्षैक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Yearly, annual. E. वर्ष, and एक one.
33866: वर्षोपल m. (-लः) Hail. E. वर्ष rain, and उपल a stone.
33867: वर्ष्म n. (-र्ष्मं) The body: see the next.
33868: वर्ष्मन् n. (-र्ष्म) 1 The body. 2 Measure. 3 Height, elevation. 4 A handsome form. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. मनिन्; also with a final vowel वर्ष्म.
33869: वर्ष्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं) 1 To be rained or showered. 2 To be sprinkled. E. वृष to sprinkle, ण्यत् aff.
33870: वर्ह r. 1st cl. (वर्हते) r. 10th cl. (वर्हयति) 1 To speak or tell. 2 To kill or hurt. r. 1st cl. (वर्हते) 1 To cover. 2 To be excellent or pre-eminent: in this sense it is more properly वर्ह. r. 10th cl. (वर्हयति) To shine.
33871: वर्ह n. (-र्हं) 1 A peacock's tail. 2 A leaf. 3 A sort of perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. 4 Train, retinue. E. वृह to increase, aff. अच्; also वर्ह or बर्ह to cover, &c. aff. अच्; in the latter case it is written बर्ह.
33872: वर्हण n. (-णं) A leaf. E. वृह to grow, aff. ल्युट्.
33873: वर्हभार m. (-रः) A tuft of peacock's feathers at the shaft of a lance or handle of a club. E. वर्ह, and भार load.
33874: वर्हिःपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Ganṭhiāla, a sort of vegetable perfume. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and पुष्प flower, having a similar blossom.
33875: वर्हिःशुष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) A name of fire or AGNI. E. वर्हिम् Kuśa grass, शुष to dry, aff. मनिन्.
33876: वर्हिःष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A perfume, commonly Bāla. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and स्था to be, aff. क, growing in the same places: the Visarga of वर्हिस् optionally retained; also वर्हिष्ठ.
33878: वर्हिण m. (-णः) A peacock. E. वर्ह a peacock's tail, and इनच् aff.
33879: वर्हिणवाहन m. (-नः) The deity Kārttikeya. E. वर्हिण a peacock, and वाहन a vehicle; mounted on that bird.
33880: वर्हिध्वजा f. (-जा) A name of the goddess CAṆḌĪ. E. वर्हि for वर्ही a peacock, and ध्वज an emblem.
33881: वर्हिन् m. (-र्ही) A peacock. E. वर्ह a peacock's tail, and इनि possessive aff.
33882: वर्हिपुष्प n. (-ष्पः) A vegetable perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. E. वर्हि a peacock, and पुष्प flower; also वर्हिःपुष्प.
33883: वर्हिर्ज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A name of fire. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and ज्योतिस् light.
33884: वर्हिर्मुख m. (-खः) A deity, a divinity. E. वर्हिस् fire, and मुख mouth; most offerings passing through fire.
33885: वर्हिश्शुष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) Fire. E. वर्हिस् an oblation, शुष्मन् who dries up.
33886: वर्हिषट् m. (-षत् or -षट्) A Pitṛ or progenitor of a particular class. E. वर्हिष् Kuśa grass, अट् to eat, क्विप् aff.
33887: वर्हिष्केश m. (-शः) AGNI or fire. E. वर्हिम् light, and केश hair.
33888: वर्हिष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) 1 A perfume, commonly Bāla, perhaps a species of Andropogon. 2 The resin of the Pinus longifolia. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and स्था to stay, aff. क, the final of वर्हिस् changed to Visarga, and optionally rejected; see वर्हिःष्ठ.
33889: वर्हिष्मत् mfn. (-ष्मन्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्) 1 Having Kuśa or sacrificial grass. 2 Having fire or light, blazing, shining. E. वर्हिस्, and मतुप् aff.
33890: वर्हिस् m. (-र्हिः) 1 Fire. 2 Light, lustre, splendour. mn. (-हिः) 1 Sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) 2 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 Ganṭhiāla, a vegetable perfume. E. वृह to increase, aff. इसि, or वर्ह to excel, &c., with the same aff.; in the latter case this word and its corresponding ones are written with an initial consonant बर्हिस्, &c.
33891: वल r. 1st cl. (वलते) 1 To cover. 2 To move. 3 To surround or enclose. r. 10th cl. (वालयति) To cherish or maintain.
33892: वल n. (-लं) An army, forces. E. वल to surround, aff. अच्; see बल.
33893: वलक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) White. m. (-क्षः) White, the colour. E. वल to go, aff. क्विप्; वल् going, अक्ष to pervade, aff. अच्; also बलक्ष, and अवलक्ष.
33894: वलक्षगु m. (-गुः) The moon. E. वलक्ष white, गौ a ray of light, the final vowel changed.
33895: वलग्न mn. (-ग्नः-ग्नं) The middle; also अवलग्न.
33896: वलभि mf. (-भिः-भी) 1 The wooden frame of a thatch. 2 A turret or temporary building on the roof of a house. E. वल to cover, अभस् aff., इन् and ङीष् added; also वडभि.
33897: वलम्ब m. (-म्बः) A perpendicular. E. अव, and लवि to depend, घञ् aff., the initial rejected; also अवलम्ब.
33898: वलय mn. (-यः-यं) A bracelet, an armlet. m. (-यः) 1 Sore throat, inflammation of the larynx, &c. 2 A boundary, an inclosure. E. वल to surround, कयन् Uṇādi aff.
33899: वलयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, encompassed. E. वलय an inclosure, aff. इतच्.
33900: वलाका f. (-का-की) A small kind of crane. E. वल to surround, aff. आकन्; also बलाका.
33901: वलासक m. (-कः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 2 A frog.
33902: वलाहक m. (-कः) 1 A cloud. 2 A mountain. 3 A Daitya, a demon. 4 One of the Nāgas. 5 One of the horses of KṚṢṆA'S car. E. वलाका a crane, हा to go, aff. नु, deriv. irr.
33903: वलि f. (-लिः) 1 A line or streak made with fragrant unguents on the person. 2 Natural line or folds of skin, a wrinkle. 3 Offerings to the spirits of air. E. वल to surround, aff. इन्; see बलि.
33904: वलिक mn. (-कः-कं) The edge of a thatch. E. वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. इकक्.
33905: वलिक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Making lines on the person. 2 Making offerrings to all beings. E. वलि, and क्रिया act; see बलि, &c.
33906: वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Moved, constrained. 2 Surrounded. E. वल to go, क्त aff.
33907: वलिश nf. (-शं-शिः or -शी) A fish-hook. E. वटिन् a bait, शो to destroy, aff. ड, ट changed to ड, and ड again interchangeable with ल.
33908: वलूक n. (-कं) The root of the lotus. m. (-कः) A bird. E. वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. ऊक.
33910: वल्क n. (-ल्कं) 1 The bark of a tree. 2 The scales of a fish. E. वल to surround, कक् Uṇādi aff.
33911: वल्कल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 The bark of a tree. 2 A garment made of bark. E. वल to surround, कलच् aff.
33912: वल्कवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having scales or bark, wearing a dress made of the bark of trees, &c. m. (-वान्) A fish. E. वल्क a scale, &c., मतुप् possess. aff.
33913: वल्किल m. (-लः) A thorn. E. वल्क bark, इलच् aff.
33914: वल्कुत n. (-तं) Bark, rind. E. वल to surround, कुतच् aff.
33915: वल्ग r. 1st cl. (वल्गति) 1 To go or move. 2 To go by leaps, to jump.
33916: वल्गत् mfn. (-ल्गन्-ल्गान्ती-ल्गत्) 1 Going. 2 Jumping. E. वल्ग to go, शतृ aff.
33917: वल्गा f. (-ल्गा) A bridle, a rein. E. वल्ग to go, aff. अच्.
33918: वल्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Leaped, jumped, gone by bounds or leaps. n. (-तं) 1 Running. 2 A horse's gallop. E. वल्ग to go by jumps, aff. क्त.
33919: वल्गु mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) Handsome, beautiful. m. (-ल्गुः) A goat. E. वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. उ, and गुक् augment.
33920: वल्गुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Handsome, beautiful. n. (-कं) 1 Sandal. 2 A wood. 3 Price. E. कन् added to the preceding.
33921: वल्गुपत्र m. (-त्रः) A wild sort of pulse; see वनमुद्र.
33922: वल्गुल m. (-लः) The flying fox. f. (-ला) A sort of bird.
33924: वल्गूयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Become handsome or beautiful. E. वल्गु used as a verb, शतृ aff.
33926: वल्भन n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Food. E. वल्भ to eat, aff. ल्युट्.
33927: वल्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. वल्भ to eat, aff. क्त.
33928: वल्मिक m. (-कः) An ant-hill; also वल्भीक.
33929: वल्मिकि m. (-किः) An ant-hill; also वल्भीकि.
33930: वल्मीक mn. (-कः-कं) A hillock, ground thrown up by moles, &c., but especially the large accumulations of soil, sometimes made by the white ant. m. (-कः) 1 The poet VĀLMĪKI. 2 Elephantiasis, or swellings of the neck, chest, hands and feet, which break and discharge ichor in many places. E. बल to cover, or बल to live, कीकच् Uṇādi aff., and मुम् augment; in the latter case this word and the corresponding ones are written बल्भीक, &c.; also वल्मिक, वल्मीकि.
33931: वल्युल and वल्यूल r. 10th cl. (वल्यूलयति) 1 To cut 2 To purify.
33932: वल्ल r. 1st cl. (वल्लते) 1 To cover. 2 To move.
33933: वल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 Winnowing corn. 2 A Māṣa of silver. 3 A weight of three Rattis. 4 Prohibiting, prohibition. 5 Covering. E. वल्ल to move, &c., अच् aff.
33934: वल्लकी f. (-की) The Vīṇā, or Indian lute. E. वल्ल to cover, aff. क्वुन्.
33935: वल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Beloved, desired, dear. 2 Supreme, superintending. m. (-भः) 1 A lover, a husband, a friend. 2 A horse with good marks. 3 A superintendant, an overseer. 4 The chief herdsman. f. (-भा) A mistress, a wife. E. वल्ल to cover, अभच् Uṇādi aff.
33936: वल्लभपालक m. (-कः) A groom, a horse-keeper. E. वल्लभ a good horse, and पालक who cherishes.
33937: वल्लरि f. (-रिः or -री) 1 A compound pedicle. 2 A creeping or twining plant. E. वल्ल to cover, अरन् aff.
33938: वल्लव m. (-वः) 1 A cook. 2 A herdsman. 3 A name of BHĪMASENA. f. (-वी) A cowherdess. E. वल्ल covering, and व aff.
33939: वल्लि f. (-ल्लिः-ल्ली) 1 A creeper, a climbing or creeping plant. f. (-ल्लिः) The earth. f. (-ल्ली) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) E. वल्ल to cover, इन् aff., and ङीप् occasionally added.
33940: वल्लीज n. (-जं) Pepper. E. वल्ली a creeper, and ज born.
33941: वल्लुर n. (-रं) 1 An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creeping plants. 2 An uncultivated field or place overrun with wild grass. 3 A sand, a desart, a place destitute of water. 4 A field. 5 A compound pedicle. 6 A solitude, a wild. 7 A thicket, a wood. E. वल्ल to cover, उर aff.; also बल्लूर.
33942: वल्लूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं). 1 Dried flesh. 2 Hog's flesh, the flesh of the wild hog. n. (-रं) 1 An uncultivated field, or one overrun with grass. 2 A thicket. 3 A desart. E. वल्ल to cover, ऊर Uṇādi aff.
33943: वल्ल्या f. (-ल्ल्या) Emblic myrobalan. E. वल्ल to cover, यत् aff.
33944: वल्वज m. (-जः) A sort of coarse grass, (Eleusine Indica.) E. वल्ल to cover, deriv. irr.
33945: वल्ह r. 1st cl. (वल्हते) r. 10th cl. (वल्हयति) To speak or tell. r. 1st cl. (वल्हते) 1 To kill or hurt. 2 To cover. 3 To be preeminent; in which sense it is more properly बल्ह. r. 10th cl. (वल्हयति) To shine.
33946: वश r. 2nd cl. (वष्टि) To desire, to will, to wish.
33947: वश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Humbled, subdued, tamed, overpowered. 2 Enthralled, subdued by charms and incantations, fascinated, charmed, enchanted. mn. (-शः-शं) Wish, desire. n. (-शं) 1 Authority, supremacy, mastership. 2 Subjection, submission, the state of being completely tamed and over-powered. 3 Birth. m. (-शः) The residence of harlots. f. (-शा) 1 A woman. 2 A wife. 3 A daughter. 4 A cow. 5 A barren cow. 6 A female elephant. 7 A husband's sister. E. वश to desire, aff. अप्, fem. aff. टाप्.
33948: वशका f. (-का) An obedient and docile wife. E. वश subject, कन् added.
33949: वशक्रिया f. (-या) Subduing or overpowering by drugs, gems, charms, or incantations. 2 The drugs, &c. so used. E. वश subjection, क्रिया business or agency.
33950: वशग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Obedient, subject. f. (-गा) An obedient wife. E. वश subject, and ग who goes or is.
33951: वशङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subject, obedient. E. वश, and गत gone.
33952: वशम्बद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Submissive, acknowledging obedience or subjection. E. वश subjection, वद to speak, खच् aff.
33953: वशवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Obsequious, acting under subjection, or according to the pleasure of another. E. वश, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
33955: वशाद्यक m. (-कः) A porpoise, the Gangetic porpoise.
33956: वशानुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Obedient, submissive. E. वश, and अनुग who pursues.
33957: वशापायिन् m. (-यी) A dog. E. वशा subjection, पा to preserve, इनि aff., and युक् augment.
33958: वशि m. (-शिः) Subjugating, fascinating, bewitching, holding others in magical or mysterious submission to one's will. E. वश to desire (supremacy), and इन् affix; also with तल् and त्व affs. वशिता and वशित्वं.
33959: वशिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Void, empty. f. (-का) Aloe wood. E. वश to desire, इन् aff., and कन् added.
33960: वशिता f. (-ता) 1 Fascinating, bewitching. 2 Subjection, holding in order or subjugation; also वशित्वं. E. वशिन्, and तल् or त्व aff.
33961: वशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Subdued, subjugated, in subjection. m. (-शी) A sage with subdued passions. f. (-नी) 1 The Śami tree, (Mimosa Sama, Rox.) 2 A parasite plant. E. वश, इनि, and ङीप् affixed.
33962: वशिर n. (-रं) Sea salt. m. (-रः) 1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 A sort of long pepper. 3 Orris root. E. वश to desire, इरन् aff.
33963: वशिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) VAŚIṢṬHA, a Ṛṣi or divine sage of the first order; he is also a Brahmādika, a Prajāpati, and one of the seven stars of Ursa Major. E. अव before शास to govern, to instruct, (the other saints,) aff. क्त, the first vowel of the prefix rejected; also written वशिष्ट and वसिष्ठ.
33964: वशीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Subduing or overcoming by drugs, charms, &c., enchanting, charming. 2 Subduing in general. E. वश subduing, and करण making, च्चि augment, leaving ई.
33965: वशीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewitched, fascinated, subjected to another's will. E. वशी, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
33966: वशीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subjugated, subject to another's will. E. वशी, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
33967: वशीर m. (-रः) A pungent fruit resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis); also वशिर.
33968: वश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Docile, tame, humble, governable. 2 To be tamed or humbled. m. (-श्यः) A dependant, a slave. f. (-श्या) A docile and obedient wife. n. (-श्यं) Cloves. E. वश subjection, यत् aff.
33969: वश्यका f. (-का) An obedient wife. E. वश्या, and कन् added.
33970: वश्यता f. (-ता) Humility, subjugation, disposition to, or fitness for subjection. E. वश्य, and तल् aff.; also वश्यत्वं.
33971: वश्यात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Of subdued mind. E. वशी, and आत्मन् spirit.
33972: वष r. 1st cl. (बषति) To kill or hurt.
33973: वषट् ind. An exclamation used on making an oblation to a deity with fire. E. वह to bear or convey, aff. डषट्.
33974: वषट्कर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The priest who pours the oiled butter into the fire at a sacrifice. E. वषट् an exclamation, &c., and कर्त्तृ who makes.
33975: वषट्कार m. (-रः) Burnt-offering, oblation with fire. E. वषट् the exclamation used on this occasion, and कार making.
33976: वषट्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Offered or sacrificed with fire. E. वषट् as above, कृत made.
33977: वष्क r. 1st cl. (वष्कते) r. 10th cl. (वष्कयति) 1 To see. 2 To go.
33978: वष्कय m. (-यः) A one year old calf. E. वष्क to go, अयन् aff.
33979: वष्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow bearing many calves. E. वष्कय a calf, णी to have, aff. ड and ङीष्; also वष्कय, with इनि and ङीप् aff., वष्कयिणी.
33980: वस(औ)औवस r. 1st and 10th cls. (वसति वसयति) To dwell or inhabit. r. 2nd cl. (वस्ते) To cover with dress, to wear as clothes. r. 10th cl. (वासयति) 1 To be affectionate, to love. 2 To cut or divide. 3 To kill. 4 To accept. (इर, उ) इरवसु r. 4th cl. (वस्यति) To be straight, to be unbending; literally or figuratively. With अधि prefixed, To sit upon, to occupy. With उप, To fast. With नि, 1 To dwell in or inhabit. 2 To dress. With प्र, To dwell abroad. With सम्, To cohabit.
33981: वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सती-सत्) 1 Dwelling, inhabiting. 2 Wearing, as clothes. E. वस to dwell, शतृ aff.
33982: वसति f. (-तिः or -ती) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 Abiding, abode, residence. 3 Night. E. वस to dwell, अति Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
33983: वसन n. (-नं) 1 Cloth or clothes. 2 Covering, clothing. 3 A dwelling, a house. 4 An ornament worn by women round the loins. E. वस to be clothed, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
33984: वसनसद्मन् n. (-द्म) A tent. E. वसन, and सद्मन् a dwelling.
33985: वसन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Vasanta, the season of spring, or its deified personification. 2 Dysentery, diarrhoea. 3 Small-pox. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. झच्, as applied to the season, when love is especially present on earth.
33986: वसन्तकुसुम m. (-मः) A tree, (Cordia myxa and latifolia.) E. वसन्त spring, and कुसुम a flower; blossoming in the spring.
33987: वसन्तघोषिन् m. (-षी) The Indian cuckoo or Koïl. E. वसन्त spring, and घोषिन who sings.
33988: वसन्तज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the spring. f. (-जा) A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month Chaitra. E. वसन्त, and ज born.
33989: वसन्तदूत m. (-तः) 1 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 2 The month Chaitra, (March-April.) 3 The fifth Rāga or musical mode, called also Hindola. 4 The mango tree. f. (-ती) 1 The trumpet flower. 2 A large and beautiful creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. वसन्त spring, and दूत the messenger.
33990: वसन्तद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) E. वसन्त spring, and द्रु a tree, or वसन्तद्रुम; the mango blossoms in March or April, and is then an object of great beauty.
33991: वसन्तसख m. (-खः) KĀMADEVA or CUPID. E. वसन्त spring, and सखि the friend.
33992: वसन्तोत्सव n. (-वं) The celebration of the return of spring, formerly held on the full moon of Chaitra, but now on the full moon of Phālguna, being identified with the Dola yātra or Holi. E. वसन्त, and उत्सव a festival.
33993: वसा f. (-सा) 1 The serum or marrow of the flesh, considered by some authorities as distinct from the marrow of the bones, though regarded by others as the same substance. 2 Adeps, fat, suet. E. वस to divide (in the body), अङ् and टाप् affs.
33994: वसाद्य m. (-द्यः) The Gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus Gangeticus;) also वसाद्यक and वशाद्यक, the last perhaps incorrectly.
33995: वसान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearing, putting on, (as clothes.) E. वस to clothe, शानच् aff.
33996: वसापायिन् m. (-यी) A dog. E. वसा, and पायिन् who drinks.
33998: वसि m. (-सिः) 1 Dwelling, abode. 2 A dwelling. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
33999: वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stored, (as grain.) 2 Dwelling, inhabiting. 3 Put on, worn. n. (-तं) Abiding, residence. f. (-ता) The power of subduing all things: see वशिता. E. वस to dwell, &c., aff. क्त, or वशिता as above, and श changed to स.
34000: वसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what wears. E. वस to put on, तृच् aff.
34001: वसित्वा ind. Having put on (as clothes), wearing. E. वस to wear, क्त्वा aff.
34002: वसिर n. (-रं) Sea salt. m. (-रः) A pungent fruit, considered as a sort of pepper, (Pothos officinalis.) E. वस to abide (in the sea), इरन् aff.; also, as derived from वश to desire, वशिर, &c.
34003: वसिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A celebrated Muni. E. वस to abide (in the practice of religious austerities), aff. णिनि, वसिन् superlative aff., इष्टन् added, pre-eminent amongst the ascetics; also वशिष्ठ, &c.
34004: वसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) 1 Sweet, sweet-flavoured. 2 Dry, dried. n. (-सु) 1 Wealth, thing, substance. 2 A gem, a jewel. 3 A medicinal root, commonly Vṛddhi. 4 Water. 5 Gold. 6 A yellow kind of kidney-bean. 7 A sort of salt. 8 The number eight, i. e. the eight Vasus. m. (-सुः) 1 A kind of demigod, of whom eight are enumerated, viz. DHAVA, DHRUVA, SOMA or the moon, VIṢṆU, ANILA or wind, ANALA or fire, PRABHŪṢA and PRABHĀVA. 2 A name of AGNI or fire. 3 A ray of light. 4 The tie of a yoke. 5 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) 6 The name of a king. 7 A name of KUVERA. 8 A tree in general. 9 A lake, a pool. 10 A rein, a halter. 11 A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 12 ŚIVA. 13 The sun. 14 A kind of fish. E. वस to abide or dwell, Uṇādi aff. उ.
34005: वसुक n. (-कं) A fossil salt, brought from a district in Ajmere, Sāmbher salt. m. (-कः) 1 A shrub, (Gigantic Asclepias.) 2 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) E. कन् added to the preceding, or वसु wealth, कै to sound, aff. ड.
34006: वसुकीट m. (-टः) A supplicant, a beggar, a petitioner. E. वसु wealth, कीट a worm.
34007: वसुदा f. (-दा) The earth. E. वसु wealth, and दा who gives.
34008: वसुदेव m. (-वः) VASUDEVA, the father of KṚṢṆA. E. वसु a Vasu, a deity, the incarnation of one of the Vasus; or वसु wealth दिव to shine, aff. अच्.
34009: वसुदेवता f. (-ता) The constellation Dhaniṣṭha. E. वसु the Vasus, and देवता divinity; presiding over the asterism.
34010: वसुदेवभू m. (-भूः) KṚṢṆA. E. वसुदेव, and भू born.
34011: वसुदेव्या f. (-व्या) 1 The asterism Dhaniṣṭha. 2 The ninth day of the fortnight.
34013: वसुधा f. (-धा) The earth. E. वसु wealth, धा to have or contain, aff. क and टाप्.
34014: वसुधाधर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. वसुधा, and घर what holds.
34015: वसुधाधिप m. (-पः) A king. E. वसुधा, and अधिप sovereign.
34016: वसुधानगर n. (-रं) The capital of VARUṆA in the western ocean.
34017: वसुधारा f. (-रा) 1 A female Śakti peculiar to the Jainas. 2 The capital of KUVERA. E. वसु wealth, धृ to have, aff. घञ् and टाप्; some authorities read वसुभारा for KUVERA'S capital.
34018: वसुन्धरा f. (-रा) The earth. E. वसु wealth, धृ to have, खच् aff.
34019: वसुप्राण m. (-णः) Fire or its deity, AGNI. E. वसु a Vasu, and प्राण life.
34020: वसुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Wealthy, rich. f. (-ती) The earth. E. वसु wealth, and मतुप् aff.
34021: वसुरोचिस् n. (-चिः) A religious ceremony in which the demigods called Vasus especially are worshipped. E. वसु as above, रुच to shine, इसि Uṇādi aff.
34022: वसुल m. (-लः) A deity, a divinity. E. वसु wealth, ला to have, aff. क.
34023: वसुषेण m. (-णः) A name of KARṆA, the illegitimate brother of the PĀṆḌU princes. E. वसु wealth, and सेना an army; surrounded by hosts of beggars for his wealth, of which he was liberal.
34024: वसुस्थली f. (-ली) The city of KUVERA. E. वसु wealth, स्थल place or site, aff. ङीष्.
34025: वसुहट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The Vakapushpa, (Sesbana grandiflora;) also वसुहट्टक.
34026: वसूक n. (-कं) 1 Sāmbher salt. 2 The Sesbana grandiflora. E. see वसुक; the उ of वसुक optionally long.
34027: वसूरा f. (-रा) A whore, a harlot.
34029: वस्क m. (-स्कः) 1 Application, perseverance. 2 Going, motion. E. वस्क to go, aff. अच्.
34030: वस्कय m. (-यः) A calf of one year, a yearling. E. वस्क to go, अयन् aff.; also वष्कय, &c.
34031: वस्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow bearing many calves. E. वस्कय a calf, णी to have, aff. ड and ङीप्; also वष्कयणी, &c.
34033: वस्त r. 10th cl. (वस्तयते) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To go or move. 3 To ask, to beg, to solicit.
34034: वस्त m. (-स्तः) A goat. n. (-स्तं) A house. E. वस्त to kill, aff. अच्.
34035: वस्तमोदा f. (-दा) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen:) see अजमोदा.
34036: वस्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be dwelt in, or inhabited, resided, remained at, &c. E. वस to dwell, तव्य aff.
34037: वस्तान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) 1 Benzoin or storax. 2 A plant, commonly Ajaśṛṅgī. E. वस्त a goat, and अन्त्र entrail.
34038: वस्ति mf. (-स्तिः) 1 The lower belly, hypogastric or pubic region. 2 The bladder. 3 A glyster, syringe, or bag made of bladder or gut, with a wooden or metallic nozzle. 4 Abiding, dwelling, staying. plur. only (-स्तयः) The ends of a cloth. E. वस to wear as clothes, Uṇādi aff. ति, or वस to abide, क्तिन् aff.
34039: वस्तिकर्म्माद्य m. (-द्यः) The soap-berry, (Sapindus detergens.) E. वस्ति the ends of cloth, कर्म्म business, and आद्य principal; used in washing.
34040: वस्तिमल n. (-लं) Urine, piss. E. वस्ति the belly, and मल excretion.
34041: वस्तिशिरस् n. (-रः) 1 The neck of the bladder. 2 The pipe of the glyster bag. E. वस्ति, and शिरस् head.
34042: वस्तिशोधन n. (-नं) A diuretic. E. वस्ति, and शोधन cleansing.
34043: वस्तु n. (-स्तु) 1 Thing, matter, substance. 2 Natural disposition, essential property, nature, essence. 3 The pith or substance of any thing. 4 The main plot or subject of a poem or play. E. वस to abide, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.
34044: वस्तुक n. (-कं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. वस to abide (in the ground), उकञ् aff., and तुट् augment; also वास्तुक, वास्तूक, &c.
34045: वस्तुतस् ind. In fine, in fact, essentially, substantially. E. वस्तु, and तसि aff.
34046: वस्तुमात्र n. (-त्रं) Outline of any subject, skeleton of a discourse. E. वस्तु, and मात्र only.
34047: वस्तुहानि f. (-निः) Loss of substance or property. E. बस्तु, and हानि abandonment.
34048: वस्तूत्थापन n. (-नं) Producing any change or incident in a play by magic. E. वस्तु, and उत्थापन raising.
34049: वस्त्वन्तर n. (-रं) Another thing or subject. E. वस्तु, and अन्तर other.
34050: वस्त्वभाव m. (-वः) 1 Insubstantial existence. 2 Loss or destruction of property. E. वस्तु, and अभाव non-existence.
34051: वस्त्य n. (-स्त्यं) A house. E. वस to abide, ति aff., and यत् added; this word has many etymologies; it is also read पस्त्य.
34052: वस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 Cloth, clothes, raiment. 2 Covering, a cover. E. वस to wear as clothes, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
34053: वस्त्रकुट्टिम n. (-मं) An umbrella. E. वस्त्र cloth, and कुद्दिभ a hut.
34054: वस्त्रगृह n. (-हं) A tent. E. वस्त्र cloth, and गृह a house.
34055: वस्त्रग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) The string or twist by which the lower garments are fastened above the hips. E. वस्त्र cloth, and ग्रन्थि knot.
34056: वस्त्रनिर्णेजक m. (-कः) A washerman. E. वस्त्र, and निर्णेजक who washes.
34057: वस्त्रपुत्त्रिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet. E. वस्त्र cloth, पुत्त्री infant (as it were), कन् aff.
34058: वस्त्रभेदक m. (-कः) A tailor. E. वस्त्र cloth, clothes, भेदक who pierces or cuts.
34059: वस्त्रभेदिन् m. (-दी) A tailor. E. वस्त्र cloth, and भेदिन् who pierces.
34060: वस्त्रयुग्म n. (-ग्मं) A pair of cloths. E. वस्त्र, and युग्म a pair.
34061: वस्त्रयोनि f. (-निः) The basis or material of cloth, as cotton, silk, wool, &c. E. वस्त्र cloth, and योनि place of production.
34062: वस्त्राञ्चल n. (-लं) The end or hem of a garment. E. वस्त्र, and अञ्चल the same.
34063: वस्त्रापहारक m. (-कः) A stealer of clothes. E. वस्त्र, and अपहारक who carries off; also वस्त्रापहारिन्.
34064: वस्न m. (-लः) Price. n. (-लं) 1 Wages, hire. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 Wealth. 4 Death. 5 Abiding, dwelling. 6 Thing, substance. 7 Skin. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. न.
34065: वस्नन n. (-नं) An ornament for a woman's loins, a zone, a girdle.
34066: वस्नसा f. (-सा) A tendon, a nerve, a fibre, described as a hollow tube resembling a string, attached to the bones, and supposed to be for the passage of the vital air. E. वस्न skin, षो to destroy, aff. क.
34067: वस्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Hireling, mercenary. 2 Purchasable. 3 Relating to hire, wages, price, &c. E. वस्त hire, &c., and ठन् aff.
34068: वस्वौकसारा f. (-रा) 1 The capital of INDRA. 2 Alakā, the residence of KUVERA. 3 A lake attached to Alakā or Amaravati, and belonging to either deity. E. वसु the Vasus, ओकस् a residence, रा to contain, with आङ् prefixed, and क and टाप् affs., the favorite haunts of these demigods.
34069: वह r. 1st cl. (वहति) To bear, to carry, to convey or transport. (वहते) To flow as a stream. (इ) वहि r. 10th cl. (वंहयति) To shine. r. 1st cl. (वंहते) To grow or increase; this last root is more properly बहि q. v.
34070: वह m. (-हः) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Any vehicle or means of conveyance, as a horse, a car, &c. 3 The shoulder of an ox. 4 Air, wind. 5 A road, a way. 6 Any male river. 7 A measure of four Droṇas. f. (-हा) A river in general. E. वह to bear, aff. घ.
34071: वहंलिह m. (-हः) An ox. E. वह the shoulder, लिह to lick, खश् aff.
34072: वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Assuming, taking. 3 Wearing. 4 Having, possessing. E. वह to bear, शतृ aff.
34073: वहत m. (-तः) 1 An ox. 2 A traveller. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. अत.
34074: वहति m. (-तिः) 1 An ox. 2 A friend, a counsellor. 3 Air, wind. f. (-ती) A river. E. वह to bear, अति Uṇādi aff.
34075: वहतु m. (-तुः) 1 An ox. 2 A traveller. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. अतु.
34076: वहन n. (-नं) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Flowing, as a stream. 3 Any vehicle. 4 A raft, a float, a boat. E. वह to bear, ल्युट् aff.
34077: वहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be carried or borne. E. वह to bear, अनीयर् aff.
34078: वहन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 An infant. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. झच्.
34079: वहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Having, possessing. 3 Flowing. E. वह to bear, शानच् aff.
34080: वहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Hard, firm, compact. n. (-लं) A raft, a float. E. वह to bear, aff. कलच्.
34081: वहलचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A climbing and milky plant, (Asclepias geminata.)
34082: वहिःकुटीचर m. (-रः) A crab. E. वहिस् externally, कुटी crookedly, चर what goes.
34083: वहिःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) External, outer. E. वहिर्, and स्था to stay, ड aff.; also वहिःस्थित, वहिःस्थायिन्, &c.
34084: वहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, celebrated. 2 Borne, conveyed. 3 Obtained. E. वह to bear, aff. क्त.
34085: वहित्र n. (-त्रं) A raft, a float, a boat, a vessel. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. इत्र; also with कन् added, वहित्रक n. (-कं.)
34086: वहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Bearing, conveying. f. (-नी) A boat, a vessel. E. वह to bear, णिनि aff.
34087: वहिरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 An outer or external part, limb, member, property, &c. 2 A stranger, an indifferent person. E. वहिस्, and अङ्ग a limb.
34088: वहिरिन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of sense or perception, an organ of action, as the eye, hand, &c. E. वहिर्, and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.
34089: वहिर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone out or forth. E. वहिर्, and गत gone.
34090: वहिर्गमन n. (-नं) Going forth or out. E. वहिर्, and गमन going.
34091: वहिर्देश m. (-शः) 1 A foreign country. 2 A place without a town or village. E. वहिर्, and देश place.
34092: वहिर्द्वार n. (-रं) An outer gate. E. वहिर् for वहिस् outer, and द्वार door.
34093: वहिर्द्वारप्रकोष्ठक n. (-कं) A portico, a covered terrace before the door of a house. E. वहिर्द्वार an outer door, प्रकोष्ठ an elbow, aff. कन्.
34094: वहिर्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced externally. E. वहिस् outwardly, and भव born.
34095: वहिर्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being out or without, expelled, excluded. E. वहिस्, and भूत being.
34097: वहिर्लम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Obtuse-angular. E. वहिस्, and लम्ब a perpendicular.
34098: वहिश्चर m. (-रः) A crab. E. वहिस् externally, and चर what goes.
34099: वहिष्करण n. (-णं) Expelling, excluding, excepting. E. वहिस् out, and करण making.
34100: वहिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, excluded, excepted. E. वहिस्, and कृत made.
34101: वहिस् ind. Out, outwards, external. E. वह to bear, aff. इस्.
34102: वहीरु m. (-रुः) A tendon, a nerve, a muscle.
34103: वह्नि m. (-ह्निः) 1 Fire, or its deity AGNI. 2 Lead wort, (Plumbago zeylanica.) 3 Marking-nut plant. 4 Appetite, digestion, the metaphorical fire of the stomach. E. वह to bear, (the oblations presented to the gods,) and नि Uṇādi aff.
34104: वह्निकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Making fire, lighting. 2 Stomachic, giving appetite. f. (-री) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. वह्नि fire, (appetite,) कृ to make, aff. अच् or ट, and टाप् or ङीप्.
34105: वह्निगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Incense or resin. E. वह्नि fire, and गन्ध smell.
34106: वह्निगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A bambu. f. (-र्भा) A sort of Mimosa, (M. Suma, Rox.) E. वह्नि fire, and गर्भ embryo; taking or producing fire by friction.
34107: वह्निदीपक m. (-कः) Safflower. E. वह्नि fire, and दीपक what shines like or resembles.
34108: वह्निनामन् m. (-मा) 1 Marking-nut plant. 2 Lead wort. E. वह्नि fire, and नामन् appellation; the synonyms of fire being equally applicable to those plants.
34109: वह्निभोग्य n. (-ग्यं) Ghee or clarified butter. E. वह्नि fire, भोग्य to be consumed or enjoyed.
34110: वह्निमन्थ m. (-न्थः) A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa.) E. वह्नि fire, and मन्थ churning.
34111: वह्निमारक n. (-कं) Water. E. वह्नि fire, and मारक destroyer.
34112: वह्निमित्र m. (-त्रः) Air, wind. E. वह्नि fire, and मित्र the friend.
34113: वह्निरेतस् m. (-ताः) ŚIVA. E. वह्नि fire, and रेतस् semen.
34114: वह्निलोह n. (-हं) Copper. E. वह्नि, and लोह iron.
34115: वह्निवधू f. (-धूः) The wife of AGNI or fire. E. वह्नि, and वधू the wife.
34116: वह्निवर्ण n. (-र्णं) The red water-lily. E. वह्नि fire, and वर्ण colour.
34117: वह्निवल्लभ m. (-भः) Resin. E. वह्नि fire, and वल्लभ friend.
34118: वह्निवीज n. (-जं) 1 Gold. 2 A particle, to be repeated as the peculiar prayer of fire in the Tantra system: the syllable Ran रं. E. वह्नि fire, वीज seed.
34119: वह्निशिख n. (-खं) 1 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 2 Saffron. f. (-खा) A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.) E. वह्नि fire, and शिखा crest; also अग्निशिस्वा.
34120: वह्निशिखर m. (-रः) A flower, coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.) E. वह्नि fire, and शिखर a crest.
34121: वह्य n. (-ह्यं) 1 A vehicle, a conveyance of any sort. 2 A cart. f. (-ह्या) The wife of a Muni or saint. E. वह to bear, aff. यत्.
34122: वा r. 2nd cl. (वाति) 1 To go or move. 2 To blow as the wind. With निर् prefixed, To blow out, to extinguish. 3 To hurt, to injure.
34123: वा ind. A particle of, 1 Comparison, (as, like, so;) 2 Alternative or option, (or, either, else, sometimes;) 3 Doubt and consideration, (or, whether;) 4 Exception, (only, no other;) 5 Asseveration or confirmation, (indeed, even, very;) 6 A conjunction, (and.) 7 An expletive. E. वा to go, aff. क्विप्, the व is sometimes changed to ब, and the word is read बा.
34124: वांश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Bambu, of or belonging to, made from a bambu, &c. f. (-शी) The manna of the bambu. E. वंश a bambu, and अण् aff.
34125: वांशिक m. (-कः) 1 A flute-player, a piper, a fifer. 2 A bambu-cutter, &c. E. वंश a pipe, aff. ठक् or ठन्.
34126: वाःकिटि m. (-टिः) A porpoise. E. वार् water, and किटि a hog.
34127: वाःपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Cloves. E. वार् water, and पुष्प flower.
34128: वाःसदन n. (-नं) A large water-jar. E. वार् water, सदन abode.
34129: वाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a crane. n. (-कं) A flight of cranes. E. वक, and अण् or अञ् aff.
34130: वाकुची f. (-ची) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. वा wind, and कुच् to contract, क aff., form irr.
34131: वाक्कलह n. (-हं) Quarrel, dispute. E. वाच्, and कलह disturbance.
34132: वाक्कीर m. (-रः) A wife's brother. E. वाच् a speech, a phrase, and कीर parrot: having giving rise to a proverb; as a cock parrot is, so is the hen; i. e. of the same breed and disposition.
34133: वाक्चपल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frivolous, inconsistent, (in speech.) E. वाक्, and चपल changeable.
34134: वाक्चापल्य n. (-ल्यं) Gossipping, chattering, idle or improper talk. E. वाक् speech, चापल्य unsteadiness.
34135: वाक्छल n. (-लं) Prevarication, equivocation. E. वाक् speech, छल disguise, fraud.
34136: वाक्छलान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Equivocating, evasive. E. वाक्छल, and अन्वित possessed of.
34137: वाक्पटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Eloquent, able in speech. E. वाक्, and पटु skilful.
34138: वाक्पटुता f. (-ता) Eloquence. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, वाकपटुत्वं.
34139: वाक्पति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Eloquent. m. (-तिः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. वाक् speech, and पति master.
34140: वाक्पथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Suitable or seasonable for discourse. E. वाक्, and पथ path.
34141: वाक्पारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Abuse, scurrility, defamation, wordy violence or assault. E. वाक् speech, पारुष्य violence.
34142: वाक्य n. (-क्यं) 1 A sentence. 2 A rule or aphorism. 3 Speech. 4 (In astronomy,) The solar process for all astronomical computations. E. वच to speak, ण्यत् aff.
34143: वाक्यखण्डन n. (-नं) Refuting or criticising an assertion. E. वाक्य, and खण्डन breaking.
34144: वाक्यप्रयोग m. (-गः) Employment or application of speech or language. E. वाक्य, and प्रयोग application.
34145: वाक्यविन्यास m. (-सः) Syntax, order, or arrangement of a sentence. E. वाक्य, and विन्यास disposition.
34146: वाक्यविशारद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Eloquent. E. वाक्य, and विशारद skilful.
34147: वाक्यस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Contained in a sentence. 2 Obedient, attentive. E. वाक्य, and स्थ what stays; also वाक्यस्थित, &c.
34149: वागपहारक m. (-कः) 1 A stealer of books. 2 A reader of prohibited works or passages. E. वाक् speech, अपहारक seizer, stealer.
34150: वागर m. (-रः) 1 A sage, a holy man, one desirous of final emancipation. 2 A scholar, a Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman. 3 A hero, a brave man, one who is intrepid or fearless. 4 Certainty, ascertainment. 5 A whetstone. 6 An obstacle, an impediment, or cause of obstruction. 7 Submarine fire. 8 A wolf. E. वाक् speech, ऋ to go, aff. अप्.
34151: वागसि f. (-सिः) Sharp or searching speech. E. वाच्, and असि a sword, piercing men's thoughts.
34153: वागारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Breaking promise or faith, disappointing, a disappointer or deceiver. E. वाक् speech, ऋ to go, उण् aff.
34154: वागीश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Eloquent, well spoken. m. (-शः) 1 An author, an orator, a poet, &c. 2 BRAHMĀ. E. वाक् speech, ईश master.
34155: वागीश्वर m. (-रः) 1 An orator, a learned man. 2 A Bauddha deified sage; also MAÑJUGHOṢA. 2 BRAHMĀ. f. (-री) SARASVATĪ. E. वाक् speech, ईश्वर lord.
34156: वागुजी f. (-जी) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. वाच् speech, गुज to sound inarticulately, aff. क, form irr.
34157: वागुण m. (-णः) An acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.)
34158: वागुरा f. (-रा) A net, a snare, a noose. E. वा to hurt, उर Uṇādi aff., and गन् augment.
34159: वागुरावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Catching wild animals. E. वागुरा a snare, and वृत्ति practice.
34160: वागुरिक m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-catcher. E. वागुरा a net, aff. ठक्.
34161: वागृषभ m. (-भः) A learned or eloquent man. E. वाच्, and ऋषभ best.
34162: वागृषभत्व n. (-त्वं) Eloquence, learning, erudition. E. वागृषभ, and त्व aff.
34163: वाग्गुद m. (-दः) A sort of bird. E. वाक् speech, गुद to sport, aff. क.
34164: वाग्गुलि m. (-लिः) The betel-bearer, an officer or servant whose business it is to have the box of Pān ready for his prince or master. E. वाक् speech, (command,) गुर to obey, कि aff., and र changed to ल, or गृ to swallow, deriv. irr.
34165: वाग्गुलिक m. (-कः) A betel-bearer. E. ठक् pleonasm, added to the preceding.
34166: वाग्डम्बर m. (-रः) Graceful or eloquent language.
34167: वाग्दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 Reproof, reprimand. 2 Restraint or controul of speech. E. वाक्, and दण्ड punishment.
34168: वाग्दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Promised. f. (-त्ता) A virgin betrothed. E. वाच्, and दत्त given.
34169: वाग्दरिद्र mf. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Of few words, speaking little and humbly or guardedly. E. वाक् speech, दरिद्र poor.
34170: वाग्दल n. (-लं) A lip. E. वाक् speech, दल a leaf.
34171: वाग्दुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Abusive, ill-spoken, speaking ill, either morally or grammatically. m. (-ष्टः) A Brahman who has past the proper time of life, without receiving the initiatory Mantra, the investiture of the thread, &c. E. वाक् speech, दुष्ट bad, faulty.
34172: वाग्देवता f. (-ता) 1 VṚHASPATI. 2 An eloquent man or writer. E. वाच्, and देवता divinity.
34173: वाग्देवी f. (-वी) A name of SARASVATĪ. E. वाक् speech, and देवी goddess, the goddess of eloquence.
34174: वाग्दोष m. (-षः) 1 Speaking ill, defamation, abuse. 2 Ungrammatical speech. 3 Uttering a disagreeable sound. E. वाक्, and दोष fault.
34175: वाग्बन्धन n. (-नं) Silencing, stopping any one's speech. E. वाक्, and वन्धन obstructing.
34176: वाग्मिन् mfn. (-ग्मी-ग्मिनी-ग्मि) 1 Loquacious, talkative, speaking much. 2 Speaking well, eloquent. m. (-ग्मी) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. वाच् speech, ग्मिनि aff.; hence also वागिमन्.
34177: वाग्मूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having root or origin in speech. E. वाच्, and मूल root.
34178: वाग्मात्र n. (-त्रं) Mere speech, words alone. E. वाच्, and मात्र only.
34179: वाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 Speaking little, and cautiously or humbly. 2 Speaking truly. m. (-ग्यः) 1 Humility, self-disparagement. 2 Doubt, alternative (?) E. वाच् speech, यत् aff.
34180: वाग्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reserved in speech, taciturn, silent. E. वाक्, and यत restrained.
34181: वाग्यतस् ind. Silently. E. वाग्य speaking little, तसि aff.
34182: वाग्याम m. (-मः) A dumb man, one silent from necessity. E. वाच् speech, यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
34183: वाग्विनिःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Emitted or put forth by speech. E. वाच्, and विनिःसृत issued.
34184: वाग्विलास m. (-सः) Graceful or elegant speech. E. वाक्, and विलास sport.
34185: वाग्व्यापार m. (-रः) 1 Manner, style or habit of speaking. 2 Customary phraseology. E. वाक्, and व्यापार usual practice.
34186: वाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The ocean, the sea. E. वङ्क a bend or creek, aff. अण्.
34187: वाङ्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Eloquent, rhetorical. n. (-यं) 1 Eloquence. 2 Rhetorical composition, rhetoric, belles lettres. f. (-यी) SARASVATĪ. E. वाक् speech, and मयट् aff.
34188: वाङ्मुख m. (-खः) The opening of a speech, an exordium. E. वाच् speech, मुख principal or beginning.
34189: वाच् f. (-वाक्,) 1 Speech. 2 Speaking. 3 SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech. 4 A phrase, a proverb or adage. E. वच to speak, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel made long.
34190: वाच m. (-चः) A plant: see मदन.
34191: वाचंयम m. (-मः) A holy sage, practising rigid taciturnity, devoid of passions, and unmoved by pain or pleasure. E. वाच् speech, यम to restrain, aff. खच्.
34192: वाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Declaratory, explaining, speaking. 2 Verbal, expressed by words. m. (-कः) 1 A word, a significant sound. 2 A speaker. 3 A messenger. E. वच to speak, aff. ण्वुल्.
34193: वाचकता f. (-ता) Expressiveness, significance. E. वाचक, and तल् aff.; also वाचकत्वं.
34194: वाचकपद n. (-दं) A clear and explicit term. E. वाचक, and पद a word.
34195: वाचनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Verbal. 2 Textual. E. वचन, and ठक् aff.
34196: वाचसाम्पति m. (-तिः) VṚHASPATI, regent of the planet JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods. E. वाच् speech, in the second case pural, and पति master.
34197: वाचस्पति m. (-तिः) VṚHASPATI: see the last. E. वाच् speech, in the sixth case, पति master.
34198: वाचा f. (-चा) Speech. E. वाच् as above, and टाप् added.
34199: वाचाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Talkative, talking much and idly or blamably. E. वाच् speech, आटच् aff.
34200: वाचाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Talkative, chattering, gabbling, talking much and idly or blamably. E. वाच् speech, and आलच् aff.
34201: वाचिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Verbal. n. (-कं) News, tidings, intelligence. E. वाच् speech, aff. ठक्.
34202: वाचिकपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A letter, a despatch. 2 A newspaper, a gazette. E. वाचिक news, and पत्र a leaf.
34203: वाचिकहारक m. (-कः) 1 A letter, an epistle. 2 A messenger, a courier. E. वाचिक news, हृ to convey, aff. ण्वुल्.
34204: वाचोयुक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Speaking much or well. E. वाच् speech in the sixth case, and युक्ति joining, fitness.
34205: वाचोयुक्तिपटु m. (-टुः-टुः or -ट्वी-टु) Eloquent, speaking much or well. E. वाचोयुक्ति as above, and पटु skilful.
34206: वाच्छ(इ)वाच्छि r. 1st cl. (वाच्छति) To wish or desire.
34207: वाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 Vile, bad. 2 Vile, contemptible, low, outcast. 3 Fit or proper to be spoken or said. 4 Attributive, adjective, to be predicated of any thing. 5 Declinable as an  adjective, taking the three genders. n. (-च्यं) 1 Blame, reviling. 2 A predicate, that which may be said of any thing. 3 (In grammar,) The voice or mode of a verb: कर्त्तृवाच्यं the active voice, कर्म्मणिवाच्यं the passive voice. E. वच to speak, aff. ण्यत्.
34208: वाच्यता f. (-ता) 1 Infamy, ill repute. 2 Blame, reproach. 3 The quality of that which may be said of any thing. 4 Conjugation. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, वाच्यत्वं.
34209: वाज mn. (-जः-जं) A wing. m. (-जः) 1 The feather of an arrow. 2 Speed. 3 Sound. 4 A Muni. n. (-जं) 1 Ghee or clarified butter. 2 Water. 3 A Mantra or prayer which concludes a sacrifice. 4 Rice offered at a Śrāddha or obsequial ceremony. 5 Rice in general. 5 The acidulous mixture of ground meal and water left to ferment. E. वज to go, aff. घञ्.
34210: वाजपेय mn. (-यः-यं) A particular sacrifice. E. वाज the acetous fermentation of meal and water, and पेय to be drank, (by the gods.)
34211: वाजभोजिन् m. (-जी) A particular sacrifice: see the last. E. वाज sour gruel, भुज to eat, aff. णिनि, and the radical vowel changed.
34212: वाजिगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The name of a plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. वाजिन् a horse, and गन्ध smell; also वाजिगन्धक.
34213: वाजिता f. (-ता) 1 The condition of having wings. 2 The nature of a horse. E. वाजिन् a horse, &c., तल् aff.; also with त्व, वाजित्वं.
34214: वाजिदन्त m. (-न्तः) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.) E. वाजि a horse, and दन्त a tooth, to which the flower is compared; also with कन् added, वाजिदन्तक.
34215: वाजिन् m. (-जी) 1 A horse. 2 An arrow. 3 A bird. 4 A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.) f. (-जिनी) A mare. E. वाज speed or a feather, &c., and इनि poss. aff.
34216: वाजिन n. (-नं) Curd of two milk whey, or the whey from which the curds have been separated. E. वज to prepare, aff. इनन्.
34217: वाजिपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) Globe amaranth. E. वाजि a horse, and पृष्ठ back.
34218: वाजिभूमि f. (-मिः) Place where horses are bred. E. वाजिन्, and भूमि place.
34219: वाजिशाला nf. (-लं-ला) A stable. E. वाजि a horse, and शाला a hall.
34220: वाजीकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Aphrodisiac. E. वाजिन् a horse, कर what makes, च्चि aff.
34221: वाजीकरण n. (-णं) Stimulus or excitement of amorous desires by aphrodisiacs, &c. E. वाजि a horse, करण making, and च्चि augment.
34222: वाञ्छत् mfn. (-ञ्छन्-ञ्छन्ती-ञ्छत्) Wishing, desiring. E. वाछि to wish, शतृ aff.
34223: वाञ्छन n. (-नं) Desiring, wishing. E. वाछि to desire, ल्युट् aff.
34224: वाञ्छनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Desirable, to be wished for. E. वाछि to wish, and अनीयर् aff.; also वाञ्छितव्य and वाच्छ्य.
34225: वाञ्छा f. (-ञ्छा) Wish, desire. E. वाच्छि to wish, aff. अच्.
34226: वाञ्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. E. वाच्छि to wish, क्त aff.
34227: वाञ्छिन् mfn. (-ञ्छी-ञ्छिनी-ञ्छि) Wishing, desirous. f. (-ञ्छिनी) A libidinous woman, a wanton. E. वाञ्छा desire, इनि aff.
34228: वाट् ind. An exclamation on making an offering of boiled butter.
34229: वाट mfn. adj. (-टः-टी-टं) Made of the Indian fig tree, of its wood, &c. subst. (-टः-टी-टं) 1 An enclosure, a piece of enclosed ground, whether a simple enclosure, as a courtyard, or one for trees and plants, as an orchard, a garden, a plantation, &c. 2 A road. 3 A mud wall, a bound hedge or any enclosure of a town or village, &c. 4 A sort of grain, (Panicum spicatum.) 5 The groin. f. (-टी) 1 The site of a house or building. 2 A house, a dwelling. 3 A plant: see वाट्यालक. E. वट to surround, aff. घञ्.
34230: वाटधान m. (-नः) The descendant of an outcast Brahman by a Brahman female.
34231: वाटशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A sort of chain enclosure or fence (?). E. वाट an enclosure, and शृङ्खला a chain.
34232: वाटिका f. (-का) 1 The site of a house. 2 A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) 3 A garden, an orchard. E. कन् added to वाटी.
34233: वाटिदीर्घ m. (-र्घः) A sort of grass, commonly Icadā. E. वाटी an enclosure, दीर्घ long.
34235: वाट्य mfn. (-ट्यः-ट्या-ट्यं) Belonging to a house or garden, &c. E. वाटी, यत् aff.
34236: वाट्यपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Sandal. 2 Saffron. f. (-ष्पी) A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) E. वाट्य belonging to a house or garden, and पुष्प flower.
34237: वाट्या f. (-ट्या) A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) E. वाटी a garden, यत् and टाप् affs.
34238: वाट्याल mf. (-लः-ली) A herbaceous shrub, (Sida cordifolia:) see the next.
34239: वाट्यालक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Bariyāla, (Sida cordifolia). E. वाटी a garden, in the sixth case, अल to adorn, with अण् aff., and कन् added, the ornament of a garden.
34240: वाड(ऋ)वाडृ r. 1st cl. (वाडते) To bathe, to dive and emerge: the best authorities read this बाडृ.
34242: वाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Much, abundant, exceeding. 2 Hard, firm. adv. n. or ind. (-ढं) 1 Much, excessive, excessively. 2 Very well, well, (assent, promise.) 3 A particle signifying conclusion, deduction. E. वह to take, to bear, aff. क्त, and the form. irr.
34243: वाढविक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Powerful, very strong, mighty. E. वाढ, and विक्रम prowess.
34244: वाण m. (-णः) 1 An arrow. 2 A name of fire. 3 The name of a sovereign considered also as an Asura or infernal being, the son of BĀLĪ, and destroyed by VIṢṆU. 4 The udder of a cow. 5 Alone, solitary. 6 A pipe, a fife, a flute. mf. (-णः-णा) 1 Blue Barleria. 2 The root or feathered part of an arrow. E. वण or बण to sound or go, aff. घञ्; whence this word and other derivatives are sometimes also written with an initial ब.
34245: वाणदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom. E. वाण an arrow, and दण्ड a stick.
34246: वाणनिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pierced, wounded by an arrow. E. वाण, and निकृत hurt.
34247: वाणपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Armed with arrows. E. वाण, and पाणि the hand.
34248: वाणपुर n. (-रं) The capital of VĀṆA Rāja. E. वाण, and पुर city; also with the final consonant वाणपुर्. f. (-पूः)
34249: वाणमोक्षण n. (-णं) Shooting an arrow. E. वाण, and मोक्षण letting fly.
34250: वाणवार m. (-रः) 1 Armour. 2 A breastplate, a cuirass. E. वाण an arrow, वृ to cover or screen, aff. घञ्.
34251: वाणसुता f. (-ता) UṢĀ, the daughter of VĀṆA, and wife of ANIRUDDHA. E. वाण, and सुता daughter.
34252: वाणहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. वाण VĀṆA Rāja, and हन् destroyer.
34253: वाणारि m. (-रिः) VIṢṆU. E. वाण the demon, and अरि an enemy.
34254: वाणाश्रय m. (-यः) A bow. E. वाण an arrow, and आश्रय receptacle.
34255: वाणासन n. (-नं) A bow. E. वाण an arrow, असन throwing, or आसन a seat.
34256: वाणि f. (-णिः or -णी) 1 Weaving. 2 A species of the Aṣṭī metre. E. वण to sound, aff. इनि.
34257: वाणिज्य n. (-ज्यं) Traffic, trade: see वाणिज्य.
34258: वाणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) 1 Having an arrow. 2 Speaking. f. (-नी) 1 A sharp or clever woman, an intriguing woman. 2 An actress, a dancer, a Nāc girl. 3 A furious woman, one literally or figuratively intoxicated. E. वाण an arrow, or वाणि speech, इनि and ङीप् affs.
34259: वाणी f. (-णी) 1 SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech. 2 Speech, sound. E. वण to sound, aff. इञ्, and ङीप् or ङीष् added.
34260: वात r. 1st cl. (वातयति) 1 To go. 2 To serve. 3 To be happy. 4 To give pleasure in travelling. 5 To blow gently, to fan or ventilate.
34261: वात् mfn. (वान् वाती वान्ती वात्) Going, moving. E. वा to go, शतृ aff.
34262: वात m. (-तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 Rheumatism, gout, inflammation of the joints. 2 Air, wind, as one of the humours of the body. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. तन्.
34263: वातक m. (-कः) A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. वात wind, कृ to make, aff. ड.
34264: वातकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Rheumatic, gouty. E. वात inflammation of the joints, and इनि aff., कूक् augment.
34265: वातकुण्डलिका f. (-का) Scanty and painful flow of urine.
34266: वातकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) The part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal sinuses. E. वात wind, and कुम्भ a receptacle.
34267: वातकेतु m. (-तुः) Dust. E. वात wind, and केतु a symbol.
34268: वातकेलि m. (-लिः) 1 Speaking in murmurs, especially amorous converse. 2 The marks of finger nails on the lover's person. E. वात wind, केलि playing.
34269: वातगामिन् m. (-मी) A bird. E. वात wind, and गामिन् who goes.
34270: वातगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 A gale, a high wind. 2 Acute gout or rheumatism. E. वात wind, गुल्म a cluster, a quantity.
34271: वातग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Epileptic. 2 Rheumatic. E. वात, and ग्रस्त seized.
34272: वातघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing disorders from wind. E. वात, and घ्न who destroys.
34273: वातज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or arising from wind. E. वात, and ज born.
34274: वातज्वर m. (-रः) Fever arising from vitiated wind. E. वात, and ज्वर fever.
34275: वाततूल n. (-लं) Cottony flocks or seeds floating in the air. E. वात wind, तूल cotton.
34276: वातथुडा f. (-डा) 1 A gale, a high wind. 2 Acute gout or rheumatism. 3 A handsome woman. 4 A disease, a sort of small pox. E. वात wind, हुड to reap, aff. क, deriv. irr.
34277: वातध्वज m. (-जः) A cloud. E. वात wind, and ध्वज banner.
34278: वातपित्त n. (-त्तं) Rheumatism attended with fever. E. वात, and पित्त bile.
34279: वातपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A name of BHĪMA. 2 The monkey HANUMĀN. 3 A cheat, a swindler. E. वात the wind, and पुत्त्र a son.
34280: वातपोथ m. (-थः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. वात rheumatism, पुथ to hurt, aff. अण्; also वातपोथक.
34281: वातप्रमी m. (-मीः) A swift antelope. E. वात the wind, प्र before मा to measure, to surpass or outgo, Uṇādi aff. ईप्.
34282: वातफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Inflated, puffed up with wind. E. वात, and फुल्ल blown.
34283: वातफुल्लान्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Cholic, flatulence, borborygmi. E. वात wind, फुल्ल swoln, अन्त्र the intestines.
34284: वातमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Going in or against the wind. m. (-जः) An antelope. E. वात wind, अज to go, aff. खश्.
34285: वातमण्डली f. (-ली) A whirlwind. E. वात wind, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप्.
34286: वातमृग m. (-गः) A swift antelope. E. वात wind, and मृग a deer.
34287: वातरंहस् mfn. (-हाः-हाः-हः) Swift, (as the wind.) E. वात, and रंहस् speed.
34288: वातर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Windy, stormy. 2 Swift, (as the wind.) E. वात, रा to get, क aff.
34289: वातरक्त n. (-क्तं) Acute gout or rheumatism. E. वात wind, and रक्त blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of the blood and the aerial humour.
34290: वातरक्तघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A plant, commonly Kukurmurā. E. वातरक्त gout, and घ्न destroying.
34291: वातरक्तारि m. (-रिः) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. वातरक्त acute gout, and अरि a foe.
34292: वातरथ m. (-थः) A cloud. E. वात the wind, and रथ a car.
34293: वातरायण m. (-णः) 1 An arrow. 2 An arrow's flight, the discharge of an arrow, a bow shot. 3 A saw. 4 The peak of a mountain. 5 A mad man, one wild or intoxicated, either literally or figuratively. 6 An idler, one who lives to no purpose. 7 The Saral, a sort of pine tree. E. वातर, and अयन going.
34294: वातरूष m. (-षः) 1 A gale, a breeze. 2 The rainbow. 3 A bribe. E. वात wind, रूष to rage, aff. क.
34295: वातरोग n. (-गं) Rheumatism, gout. E. वात wind, and रोग disease.
34296: वातरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Rheumatic, afflicted with gout or rheumatism, especially of the acute kind. E. वातरोग acute rheumatism, &c., aff. इनि.
34297: वातर्द्धि m. (-र्द्धिः) 1 A sort of cup or vessel made of wood, with an iron foot or stand. 2 A mace, a club or stick bound with iron. E. वात wind, ऋद्धि increase.
34298: वातल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Windy, stormy. 2 Flatulent. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of pulse, (Cicer arietinum.) 2 Wind. f. (-ला) A morbid state of the uterus. E. वात wind, ला to get, aff. क.
34299: वातलमण्डली f. (-ली) A whirlwind. E. वातल windy, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप्; also वातमण्डली.
34300: वातवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Windy, gusty. E. वात, and मतुप् aff.
34301: वातवलासक m. (-कः) Nervous or low fever.
34302: वातवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Suppression of urine. E. वात, and वस्ति the bladder.
34303: वातवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Swelled testicle. E. वात, and वृद्धि increase.
34304: वातव्याधि f. (-धिः) Any morbid affection attributed to disorder of the wind. E. वात, and व्याधि disease.
34305: वातवैरिन् m. (-री) The castor oil tree, &c.; see वातारि.
34306: वातशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The lower belly. E. वात wind, शीर्ष the head or source.
34307: वातशूल n. (-लं) Cholic with flatulence. E. वात, and शूल cholic.
34308: वातशोणित n. (-तं) Acute gout or rheumatism. E. वात wind, शोणित blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of these two.
34309: वातसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Gouty, rheumatic. E. वात the disease, and सह bearing, suffering.
34310: वातसारथि m. (-थिः) AGNI or fire. E. वात wind, and सारथि charioteer.
34311: वातस्कन्ध n. (-न्धं) The portion of the atmosphere where the wind blows. E. वात wind, स्कन्ध part.
34312: वाताट m. (-टः) 1 A horse of the sun. 2 An antelope. E. वात the wind, and अट who goes.
34313: वातानुलोमन n. (-नं) Forcing the wind downwards, as in inflating the lungs.
34314: वातापि m. (-पिः) The name of an Asura devoured by AGASTYA. E. वात wind, पा to drink, aff. कि, and आङ् prefixed.
34315: वातापिद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) The Muni AGASTYA. E. वातापि, and द्विष who hates; also similar names, as वातापिसूदन, बातापिहन्, &c.
34316: वातामोदा f. (-दा) Musk. E. वात the wind, आमोदा a diffusive fragrance.
34317: वाताय n. (-यं) A leaf. E. वात wind, अय to go, aff. अच्.
34318: वातायन n. (-नं) 1 A window, an eyelet or loop-hole. 2 A porch, a portico, a covered shed, a pavilion. m. (-नः) A horse. E. वात the wind, and अयन going.
34319: वातायु m. (-युः) An antelope, a deer. E. वात wind, (like,) अय to go, aff. उण्.
34320: वातारि f. (-रिः) 1 The castor oil tree. 2 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. वात rheumatism, अरि hostile.
34321: वाताली f. (-ली) A whirlwind, a gale. E. वात wind, आली a line.
34322: वाताश्व m. (-श्वः) A swift horse, or one of a good breed. E. वात the wind, and अश्व a horse.
34323: वातासह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Rheumatic, gouty. E. बात rheumatism, and आसह who bears or suffers.
34324: वाताहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stirred or shaken by the wind. 2 Affected by rheumatism. E. वात, and आहत struck.
34325: वाताहति f. (-तिः) 1 The action of the wind. 2 The occurrence of arthritic pains. E. वात, and आहति striking.
34326: वाति m. (-तिः) Air, wind. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. अति.
34327: वातिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Windy, stormy. 2 Rheumatic. 3 Produced by or proceeding from wind, (disease, &c.) n. (-कं) Fever or inflammation ascribed to a vitiated state of the aerial humour. E. वात wind, &c., ठक् aff.
34328: वातिग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Acquainted with or working in minerals or fossils, &c. m. (-गः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वाति wind, and ग who counts, from गण with ड aff.
34329: वातिङ्गण m. (-णः) The egg-plant. E. वाति wind, गण to count, aff. खच्, curing rheumatism, &c.
34330: वातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Windy, relating or belonging to wind, &c. n. (-यं) Sour rice-gruel. E. वात the wind, छ aff.; acidulated by air.
34331: वातुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Gouty, rheumatic. 2 Mad, crazy. m. (-लः) A whirlwind, a gale. E. वात wind, &c., and उलच् aff.; more commonly वातूल.
34332: वातुलि f. (-लिः) A large bat, commonly the flying-fox. E. वात wind, उलि aff., form irr.
34333: वातूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Gouty, rheumatic. 2 Mad, insane, inebriate. m. (-लः) A whirlwind, a gale, a hurricane. E. वात wind, ऊलच् aff.; also वातुल; form irr.
34334: वातृ m. (-ता) Air, wind. E. वा to go, तृच् aff.
34335: वात्या f. (-त्या) Strong wind, a gale, a whirlwind, a hurricane. E. वात wind, यत् implying quantity.
34336: वात्सक n. (-कं) A herd of calves. E. वत्स a calf, वुञ् aff. of number.
34337: वात्सल्य n. (-ल्यं) Tenderness, affection, fondness. E. वत्सल affectionate, यञ् aff.
34338: वात्सीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A barber. E. वात्सी a girl born of a Śūdra woman by a Brahman, and पुत्त्र son.
34339: वात्स्यायन m. (-नः) The name of a Muni. E. वात्स्य the father of the sage, and फक् aff. of descent.
34340: वाद m. (-दः) 1 Demonstrated conclusion, reply, result. 2 Discourse, discussion, defined as the speech of one desirous to know the truth. 3 A plaint, an accusation. 4 Sound, sounding. E. वद to speak, aff. घञ्.
34341: वादकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Causing or making a dispute. E. वाद, and कर what makes; also वादकृत्, &c.
34342: वादन n. (-नं) Sound, sounding, (as musical instruments.) E. वद to sound, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
34343: वादयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Sounding, playing, (as on a musical instrument.) E. वद to speak, causal v., शतृ aff.
34344: वादयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Controversy, dispute. E. वाद, and युद्ध war.
34345: वादरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The religious fig tree.
34346: वादरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Adhering to or following a doctrine. 2 Addicted to controversy, disputatious. E. वाद, and रत fond of.
34347: वादरायण m. (-णः) A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas, and reputed author of the Purāṇas, &c. E. वादर a place of pilgrimage, अयन going, aff. अण्.
