34348: वादल n. (-लं) Liquorice, or the root of the Abrus precatorius, which is used for it. E. वा for वात wind, दल to disperse, aff. अच्; form irr.
34349: वादवादिन् m. (-दी) A Jaina. E. वाद result, truth, and वादिन् who declares.
34350: वादसाधन n. (-नं) Argument, maintaining a controversy. E. वाद, and साधन instrument.
34351: वादानुवाद m. (-दः) Attack and rejoinder, plaint and reply. E. वाद, and अनुवाद subsequent dispute.
34352: वादान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Munificent, liberal, &c. E. वदान्य, and अण् pleonasm added.
34353: वादाल m. (-लः) A sheat fish. E. वदाल the same, अण् pleonasm added.
34354: वादि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Wise, learned, skilful, sage. E. वद to speak, (wisely, &c.,) इञ् Uṇādi aff.
34355: वादित्र n. (-त्रं) A musical instrument. E. वद to sound, Uṇādi aff. णित्रन्.
34356: वादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Speaking, discoursing. 2 Asserting, declaring. m. (-दी) 1 A sage, an expounder of the law and the Śāstras. 2 A plaintiff, an accuser. 3 Leading or key note, (in music.) E. वद to speak, णिनि aff.
34357: वादिराज् m. (-राट्) A Bauddha sage; also MAÑJUGHOṢA. E. वादि a sage, and राज् chief.
34358: वादिश m. (-शः) A learned and virtuous man, a sage, a seer. E. वादि truth or true conclusion, and इशच् aff.
34359: वाद्य n. (-द्यं) Any musical instrument. E. वद to sound, aff. ण्यत्; to be sounded or played.
34360: वाद्यनिर्घोष m. (-षः) The sound of musical instruments. E. वाद्य a musical instrument, and निर्घोष sound.
34361: वाद्यभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 1 A multitude of musical instruments, a band. 2 Any musical instrument. E. वाद्य a musical instrument, and भाण्ड assemblage or vessel.
34362: वाध(ऋ)वाधृ r. 1st cl. (वाधते) To distress, to give pain: more correctly बाध.
34363: वाधुक्य n. (-क्यं) Marriage. E. वधुका a wife, ष्यञ् aff.
34364: वाधू f. (-धूः) A vessel, a boat, a raft. E. वह to bear, aff. ऊण्; form irr.
34365: वान mfn. subst. (-नः-ना-नं) Dry fruit. adj. Dry, dried. n. (-नं) 1 Living. 2 Going, moving. 3 A mat of straw. 4 A heavy sea, the rolling of water from wind, &c.; hence the high tide in the Indian rivers, commonly called the Bore. 5 A hole in the wall of a house. 6 A perfume, a fragrance. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to a wood, a house, &c.: see वन. n. (-नं) A number or multitude of woods. E. वै to dry or wither, aff. क्त; form irr.: in other of its applications वन to sound, aff. घञ्; or वन a wood, water, a house, &c., and अण् referential aff.
34366: वानप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) 1 The Brahman of the third order, who has passed through the conditions of student and householder, and has left his house and family for lonely meditation in woods and wilds; the hermit, the anchoret. 2 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 3 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. वन a wood, अण् aff., वान a solitude in the woods, &c., प्रस्थ who goes forth to, from स्था to stay, with प्र prefix, and क aff.
34367: वानर mf. (-रः-री) An ape, a monkey. f. (-री) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. वात what relates to a wood, रा to get, aff. क, a Sylvan; or वा implying resemblance, and नर a man, or वन a wood, रत to play, aff. ड, वनर, and अण् pleonasm added.
34368: वानरप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.) E. वानर a monkey, and प्रिय fond of.
34369: वानराघात m. (-तः) A tree, commonly Lodh, (Symplocos racemosa.) E. वीनर a monkey, आघात struck, injured.
34370: वानरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 The monkey chief, SUGRĪVA. 2 HANUMĀN. E. वानर, and इन्द्र chief.
34371: वानल m. (-लः) A kind of holy basil, distinguished as the black species of Tulasī, (Ocymum sanctum.)
34372: वानस्पत्य m. (-त्यः) A tree bearing fruits from blossoms, as the mango, eugenia, &c. E. वनस्पति a tree bearing fruits without blossoms, and ण्य aff.
34373: वानायु m. (-युः) A country to the north-west of India; also वनायु.
34374: वानायुज m. (-जः) A Vānāyu horse, considered as one of a particularly good breed. E. वनायु, and ज born.
34375: वानीर m. (-रः) A sort of cane or ratan, (Calamus rotang.) E. वन water, ईर aff., and the first vowel made long.
34376: वानेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Relating or belonging to water, &c. m. (यः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. वन water, ढञ् aff.
34377: वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Vomited, ejected from the mouth. E. वन to vomit, aff. क्त.
34378: वान्ताद m. (-दः) A dog. E. वान्त what is ejected from the mouth, and अद who eats.
34379: वान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Vomiting, ejecting from the mouth. E. वम to vomit, क्तिन् aff.
34380: वान्तिकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Emetic. m. (-कृत्) A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. वान्ति vomiting, and कृत् what makes; an emetic.
34381: वान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Emetic. f. (-दा) A medicinal plant, commonly Katiuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica; and Colotropis gigantea, BROVN.) E. वान्ति vomiting, and द what produces; an emetic.
34382: वान्या f. (-न्या) A multitude of groves or thickets. E. वन a wood, यञ् aff. of multitude; also with यत् aff. वन्या.
34383: वाप m. (-पः) 1 Shaving. 2 Sowing seed. 3 Weaving. E. वप to sow seed, &c., aff. घञ्.
34384: वापदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom. E. वाप weaving, दण्ड a stick; also वायदण्ड.
34385: वापि f. (-पिः or -पी) A large oblong pond, a pool, a lake. E. वप, to sow seed, (of the lotus, &c.) Uṇādi aff. इञ्, and ङीप् optionally added.
34386: वापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sown as seed. 2 Shaven. E. वाप shaving, &c., इतच् aff.
34387: वापीह m. (-हः) The Cātaka, a bird, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. वापी a pool, हां to abandon, aff. क; drinking rain water only.
34388: वाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be sown, what may or ought to be sown. m. (-प्यः) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. वप to sow, aff. ण्यत्.
34389: वाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Left, not right. 2 Reverse, contrary, inverted. 3 Beautiful, pleasing. 4 Vile, base, wicked. 5 Short. 6 Crooked. m. (-मः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 KĀMA or CUPID. 3 An udder, a breast. 4 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) 5 An animal, a sentient being. 6 A snake. n. (-मं) Wealth, possessions. f. (-मा) 1 A woman. 2 GAURĪ. 3 LAKṢMĪ. 4 SARASVATĪ. f. (-मी) 1 A mare. 2 A she-ass. 3 A young female elephant. 4 The female of the jackal. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. मन्.
34390: वामता f. (-ता) 1 Perverseness, contrariety. 2 Craftiness, wickedness. 3 Loveliness. E. तल् added to वाम; also with त्व, वामत्वं.
34391: वामदेव m. (-वः) A name of ŚIVA. E. वाम contrary, (to human institutions,) देव who sports.
34392: वामन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Short, dwarfish, a dwarf. 2 Depressed, pressed flat or down. 3 Low, vile, base. m. (-नः) 1 VIṢṆU in his character of the dwarf, in which he appeared on his fifth  descent from heaven, to prevent BALI from obtaining dominion of the three worlds. 2 The elephant that supports the south quarter. 3 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) f. (नी) 1 A female dwarf. 2 A sort of woman; also वामनिका. 3 A disease of the vagina. E. वम to eject from the mouth, and ल्यु or ल्युट् aff.
34393: वामनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shortened, flattened. E. वामन, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
34394: वामलूर m. (-रः) An ant or mole hill, especially the hillocks of ground thrown up by the white ant. E. वाम inverted, reversed, लू to cut, aff. रक्.
34395: वामलोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fine-eyed. f. (-ना) A handsome woman. E. वाम beautiful, and लोचन eye.
34396: वामाक्षी f. (-क्षी) A handsome woman. E. वाम beautiful, and अक्षि an eye.
34397: वामाचार m. (-रः) The doctrine of the Tantras according to one system. E. वाम left, and आचार institute; the left hand ritual, the use of flesh, spirits, &c. forming part of the Vāmācāra ceremonies.
34398: वामाचारिन् m. (-री) A follower of the left hand portion of the Tantras. E. वामाचार, and इनि aff.
34399: वामापीडन m. (-नः) A tree, (Salvadora Persica, &c.:) see पीलु.
34400: वामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch shell with the spiral turn running from right to left. E. वाम, and आवर्त्त a turn.
34401: वामिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Proud, haughty, intolerant. 2 Handsome, beautiful. E. वम to eject from the mouth, (the faults of others,) aff. इलच्.
34402: वाय m. (-यः) Weaving. E. वे to weave, घञ् aff.
34403: वायक m. (-कः) A number, a multitude, a heap. E. बय to go ण्वुल् aff.
34404: वायदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom. E. वाय weaving, दण्ड a stick.
34405: वायन n. (-नं) 1 Sweetmeats or cakes, forming a light refreshment, which is not supposed to be any breach of a religious fast. 2 Sweetmeats or cakes, part of an offering to a deity, or prepared on particular occasions, as marriages, &c. and sent as presents to friends and acquaintances. E. वा to go, ल्युट् aff.; also with कन् added, वायनक n. (-कं.)
34406: वायव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Windy, relating or belonging to wind. f. (-वी) The quarter or region of the wind; the northwest E. वायु air, wind, and अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्.
34407: वायव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Relating to the wind, sacred to the deity of the wind, &c. E. वायु wind, and यत् aff.
34408: वायस m. (-सः) 1 A crow. 2 Agallochum, (Amyris Agallocha.) 3 Turpentine. f. (-सी) 1 A species of fig, (Ficus oppositifolia, Rox.) 4 A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.) E. वय to go, Uṇādi aff. असच्, and the radical vowel made long.
34409: वायसाराति m. (-तिः) An owl. E. वायस a crow, and अराति an enemy; also similar compounds, as वायसारि.
34410: वायसेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A sort of long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. वायस a crow, and इक्षु the sugar-cane.
34411: वायसोली f. (-ली) A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. E. वायस a crow, उलच् aff.
34412: वायु m. (-युः) 1 Air, wind, or its personified deification. 2 The air of the body. 3 Morbid affection of the windy humour. E. वा to go, उण् Uṇādi aff., and युक् augment.
34413: वायुकेतु m. (-तुः) Dust. E. वायु wind, and केतु a symbol, a sign.
34414: वायुकोण m. (-णः) The north-west. E. वायु, and कोण corner.
34415: वायुगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Flatulence, indigestion. E. वायु wind, गडि to be a part of, aff. अच्.
34416: वायुगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Quick, swift, as the wind. E. वायु, and गति going.
34417: वायुगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 A whirlpool, an eddy. 2 A whirlwind, a hurricane. E. वायु wind, and गुल्म a cluster.
34418: वायुग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Affected by wind, flatulent, epileptic. E. वायु, and ग्रस्त seized.
34419: वायुघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Destroying or curing windy disorders. E. वायु, and घ्न what destroys.
34420: वायुजात m. (-तः) HANUMAN. E. वायु, and जात born.
34421: वायुदारु m. (-रुः) A cloud. E. वायु wind, दृ to scatter, aff. उण्.
34422: वायुनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Calm, lull. 2 Cure of windy disorders. E. वायु, and निवृत्ति stop.
34423: वायुपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A name of BHĪMA. 2 A name of HANUMAN. E. वायु the god of wind, and पुत्त्र a son; also similar compounds, as वायुतनय, वायुनन्दन, वायुसुत, &c.
34424: वायुफल n. (-लं) 1 The rainbow. 2 Hail. E. वायु wind, and फल fruit.
34425: वायुभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Eating air, fasting. m. (-क्षः) 1 A snake. 2 An ascetic. E. वायु wind, and भक्ष who eats.
34426: वायुभक्षण n. (-णं) Fasting, living on air. E. वायु, and भक्षण eating.
34427: वायुभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Becoming as the wind, going every where at will. E. वायु, and भूत become.
34428: वायुरोषा f. (-षा) Night. E. वायु wind, रुष् to rage, aff. अच्.
34429: वायुवर्त्मन् m. (-र्त्मा) The atmosphere, sky, heaven. E. वायु wind, and वर्त्मन् path or road.
34430: वायुवाह m. (-हः) Smoke, vapour. E. वायु the wind, and वाह vehicle.
34431: वायुवाहिनी f. (-नी) A vessel of the body, supposed, as the arteries were once imagined, to convey the aerial humour. E. वायु wind, वाहिनी bearing.
34432: वायुवेगसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Swift as the wind. E. वायु, वेग speed, सम equal.
34433: वायुसख m. (-खः) Fire. E. वायु wind, and सखि friend, aff. टच्; also without the aff. वायुसखि.
34434: वायुसम्भव m. (-वः) HANUMAN. E. वायु, सम्भव born.
34435: वायुसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Like wind, unsubstantial. 2 Swift. E. वायु, and सम same.
34436: वाय्वास्पद n. (-दं) Ether, atmosphere. E. वायु wind, आस्पद place, site.
34437: वार् n. (-वाः) Water. E. वृ to surround, aff. क्विप्.
34438: वार m. (-रः) 1 A multitude, a quantity, a flock or herd, a heap. 2 Occasion, opportunity. 3 A day of the week. 4 A moment. 5 A name of ŚIVA. 6 A door-way, a gate. 7 Achyranthes aspera. n. (-रं) A vessel for holding spirituous liquor. adv. A time, as वारं वारं many a time, repeatedly, often: see वारम्बारं. E. वृ to cover, to choose, &c., aff. घञ्.
34439: वारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Opposing, obstructing, an obstacle or agent of resistance. m. (-कः) 1 A horse's paces. 2 A horse. -n. (-कं) 1 The seat of pain. 2 A sort of fragrant grass: see वाल. E. वृ to choose, &c., ण्वुल् aff.
34440: वारकिन् m. (-की) 1 The ocean. 2 A horse with good marks. 3 An enemy. 4 An ascetic, one living upon leaves, &c. E. वारक an obstacle, &c., इनि aff.
34441: वारकीर m. (-रः) 1 A wife's brother. 2 Marine fire. 3 A louse. 4 A small comb. 5 A horse of high spirit, a war horse, a charger. 6 A bearer of burthens, a porter. E. वार् an obstacle, कॄ to scatter, aff. अच्.
34442: वारङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A bird in general. E. वार water, अकि to go, aff. अच्.
34443: वारङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The handle of a sword or knife, &c. E. वृ to select, aff. अङ्गच्, and the radical vowel changed to the Vṛddhi form.
34444: वारट n. (-टं) 1 A field. 2 A number of fields. f. (-टा) A goose; also वरटा. E. वार् water, अट to go, aff. अच्.
34445: वारण n. (-णं) 1 Resistance, opposition, prohibition, obstacle or impediment. 2 Defence, protecting, guarding. 3 Warding off a blow, guarding, warding. m. (-णः) 1 Armour, a cuirass, or mail for the body. 2 An elephant. E. वॄ to cover or screen, to defend, aff. ल्युट्.
34446: वारणबुषा f. (-षा) The plantain or banana, (Musa sapientum.) E. वारण an elephant, बुष or बुस to cast off, aff. क; hence it is written also वारणबुसा; also वारवुषा.
34447: वारणवल्लभा f. (-भा) The plantain tree. E. वारण an elephant, and वल्लभ beloved.
34448: वारत्र n. (-त्रं) Leather fit for or made into thongs. E. वारत्रा a thong, and अण् aff.
34449: वारनारी f. (-री) A harlot. E. वार, and नारी a woman.
34451: वारमुख्या f. (-ख्या) The head of a set of harlots. E. वार a troop, and मुख्या a chief.
34452: वारम्वारम् ind. Repeatedly, again and again. E. वार a day, a time, repeated.
34453: वारला f. (-ला) 1 A wasp. 2 A goose. E. वार a flock, a flight, ला to get, and क and टाप् aff.; also वरला, &c.
34454: वारवधू f. (-धूः) The chief of a set of harlots. E. वार a number, and वधू wife.
34455: वारवाण mn. (-णः-णं) Armour for the body or breast, an iron cuirass, or a thick quilted jacket worn for the same purpose. E. वार opposing, वाण an arrow; also वाणवार.
34456: वारवाणि m. (-णिः) 1 A player on the flute. 2 A singer, a musician. 3 A judge. 4 A year. f. (-णिः or -णी) 1 The chief of a set of harlots. 2 A whore. E. वार a multitude, वाणी speech.
34457: वारविलासिनी f. (-नी) A harlot, a whore. E. वार a multitude, and विलासिनी a wanton.
34458: वारवेला f. (-ला) A portion of the day in which any act religious or secular is suspended. E. वार, and वेला time.
34459: वारसुन्दरी f. (-री) A whore, a prostitute. E. वार the multitude, सुन्दरी a beauty.
34460: वारसेवा f. (-री) 1 A set of courtezans. 2 Prostitution, harlotry. E. वार the multitude, and सेवा service.
34461: वारस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A whore. E. वार the many, and स्त्री a woman; a common woman.
34462: वारांनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. वारां of water, and निधि receptacle.
34463: वाराङ्गना f. (-ना) A harlot. E. वार, and अङ्गना a woman.
34464: वाराणसी f. (-सी) The holy city Benares. E. वर best, अनस् water, affs. अण् and ङीष्, i. e. the Ganges on which it stands; also वराणसी.
34465: वाराणसेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Produced at or born in Benares, &c. E. वाराणसी the city, and ढक् aff.
34466: वारासन n. (-नं) A large water jar, a cistern, a reservoir. E. वार् water, आसन place of abiding.
34467: वाराह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Relating to a boar, belonging to, derived from, &c. f. ही 1 An esculent root, a Yam, (Dioscorea.) 2 One of the divine mothers. 3 A measure. 4 The earth. 5 A sow. E. वराह a hog or VIṢṆU, &c., अण् aff., and ङीप् fem. form.
34468: वारि n. (-रि) 1 Water. 2 A vegetable perfume, commonly Bāla. f. (-रिः) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech. 2 The place where an elephant is tied or fastened. 3 A captive, a prisoner. f. (-रिः or -री) 1 A water-pot, whether large or small, a pitcher, a jar. 2 The rope that fastens an elephant. 3 A hole or trap for catching elephants. E. वृञ् to surround, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
34469: वारिकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 Another plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) E. वारि water, and कण्डक a thorn.
34470: वारिकर्णिका f. (-का) A plant, (Pistia stratiotes) E. वारि water, and कर्णिका here meaning leaf or leaflet.
34471: वारिकर्पूर m. (-रः) The Ilīśa fish, (Cluponodon Ilisha, HAM.) E. वारि water, and कर्पूर camphor, to which it is compared in colour.
34472: वारिकुब्ज m. (-ब्जः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) E. वारि water, कुब्ज Achyranthes; also with कन् added, वारिकुब्जक.
34473: वारिक्रिमि m. (-मिः) A leech. E. वारि water, and क्रिमि a worm.
34474: वारिचत्वर m. (-रः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 A piece of water. E. वारि water, चत्वर expanse.
34475: वारिचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Aquatic, living or moving in water. m. (-रः) A fish. E. वारि water, and चर what goes.
34476: वारिचामर n. (-रं) A sort of weed, (Vallisneria.) E. वारि water, and चामर Chowri or brush.
34477: वारिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, born or produced in or by water. m. (-जः) 1 A conch shell. 2 Any bivalve shell. n. (-जं) 1 A lotus. 2 Salt. E. वारि water, and ज born.
34478: वारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hindered, prevented, impeded. E. वॄ to cover, क्त aff.
34479: वारितस्कर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. वारि water, तस्कर a thief.
34480: वारित्रा f. (-त्रा) A sort of umbrella, or portable shed of leaves carried on the head as one. E. वारि water, त्रा to preserve, affs. क and टाप्.
34481: वारिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) What yields water. m. (-दः) A cloud. n. (-दं) A sort of vegetable perfume; see वाल. E. वारि water, and द what yields.
34482: वारिद्र m. (-द्रः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. वारि water, दृ to take, aff. क.
34483: वारिधि m. (-धिः) The sea. E. वारि water, घा to contain, aff. कि.
34484: वारिनाथ m. (-थः) 1 The deity VARUṆA. 2 The ocean. 3 A cloud. 4 The habitation of the Nāgas, or serpent race. E. वारि water, नाथ lord.
34485: वारिनिधि m. (-धिः) The sea, the ocean. E. वारि water, and निधि a receptacle.
34486: वारिपथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Proceeding or conveyed by water. E. वारि water, पथिन् a road, ठक् aff.
34487: वारिपर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. वारि water, and पर्ण a leaf.
34488: वारिप्रवाह m. (-हः) 1 A cascade, a water-fall. 2 A current or flow of water. E. वारि water, and प्रवाह a fall.
34489: वारिप्रश्नी f. (-श्नी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. वारि water, प्रश्नि the same.
34490: वारिबदरा f. (-रा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. वारि water, वदर jujube.
34491: वारिबालक m. (-कं) A perfume: see वाल. E. वारि water, वाल a perfume.
34492: वारिमसि n. (-सिः) A cloud. E. वारि water, मसि ink.
34493: वारिमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud. E. वारि water, and मुच् what emits.
34494: वारिमूली f. (-ली) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. वारि water, मूल a root.
34495: वारिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Giving or shedding water. m. (-रः) A cloud. E. वारि, and रा to give, क aff.
34496: वारिरथ m. (-थः) A raft, a float. E. वारि water, and रथ a carriage.
34497: वारिरारव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Sounding like clouds or thunder. E. वारिर, and आरव sound.
34498: वारिराशि m. (-शिः) The ocean. E. वारि water, and राशि a heap.
34499: वारिलोमन् m. (-मा) A name of VARUṆA. E. वारि water, and लोमन् hair.
34500: वारिवदन m. (-नः) A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. वारि water, and वदन countenance.
34501: वारिवास m. (-सः) A distiller or dealer in spirituous liquors. E. वारि water, वास abode.
34502: वारिवाह m. (-हः) A cloud. E. वारि water, and वाह what bears; also वारिवाहन.
34503: वारिवाहन m. (-नः) A cloud. E. वारि water, and वाहन a vehicle.
34504: वारिश m. (-शः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. वारि water, शीङ् to sleep, aff. ड.
34505: वारीट m. (-टः) An elephant. E. वारि the trap for an elephant, अट to go, aff. अच्, form irr.
34506: वारीश m. (-शः) The ocean. E. वार water, and ईश lord.
34507: वारु m. (-रुः) A war elephant carrying a standard. E. वृ to cover, aff. उण्.
34508: वारुठ m. (-ठः) A bier, the bed on which the corpse is carried. E. वृ to cover, aff. उठञ्.
34509: वारुणि m. (-णिः) The saint AGASTYA. E. वरुण VARUṆA, and इञ् aff. of descent.
34510: वारुणी f. (-णी) 1 Any spirituous liquor, or more properly, a particular kind prepared from hogweed, ground with the juice of the date or palm, and then distilled. 2 The west, the region of VARUṆA. 3 The 25th lunar asterism, of which VARUṆA is the ruling deity. 4 A species of Dūrbbā grass. E. वरुण the deity VARUṆA, अण् and ङीष् affs.
34511: वारुणीवल्लभ m. (-भः) VARUṆA. E. वारुणी the asterism, and वल्लभ loved.
34512: वारुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The chief of the serpent race (?). mn. (-ण्डः-ण्ड) 1 The rheum of the eyes. 2 The wax of the ear. 3 A vessel for baling water out of a boat. E. वॄ to screen, aff. उण्ड.
34513: वारेण ind. Frequently, repeatedly. E. वार a time in the third case.
34514: वारेन्द्री f. (-न्द्री) Part of Bengal and Behar, or a tract of inundation north of the Ganges, and part of the present Zila of Rājṣāhi. E. वरेन्द्र a king, अण् aff.
34515: वार्क्ष mfn. (-र्क्षः-र्क्षी-र्क्षं) Made of or derived from a tree. n. (-र्क्षं) A forest. f. (-र्क्षी) The name of a female mentioned in the Mahābhārata, a sort of Dryad. E. वृक्ष a tree, अण् aff.
34516: वार्क्ष्य mfn. (-र्क्ष्यः-र्क्ष्यी-र्क्ष्यं) Made of or with trees. n. (-क्ष्य) A stockade. E. वृक्ष a tree, यञ् aff.
34517: वार्णिक m. (-कः) A scribe, a writer. E. वर्ण a letter, ठञ् aff.
34518: वार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Well, healthy. 2 Following any business or profession. m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Health. 2 Chaff. f. (-र्त्ता) 1 Tidings, news, intelligence. 2 Rumour, report. 3 Livelihood, business, profession. 4 Agriculture or trade, the proper occupation of the Vaiśya. 5 Abiding, staying, being. 6 The egg-plant. E. वृत्ति being, &c., aff. अण् or ण.
34519: वार्त्ताक m. (-कः) The egg-plant: see वार्त्ताकु, उ being changed to अ.
34520: वार्त्ताकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The peculiar occupation of the third or Vaiśya class, agriculture, trade, &c. E. वार्त्ता, and कर्म्मन् act.
34521: वार्त्ताकि f. (-किः or -की) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वृत to be, काकिन् aff.; ङीप् or इन् fem. aff., form irr.; also वार्त्ताकु.
34522: वार्त्ताकिन् m. (-की) The egg-plant; also वार्त्ताकि, &c.
34523: वार्त्ताकु m. (-कुः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वृत to be, काकु Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long by special rule.
34524: वार्त्तायन m. (-नः) A spy, an emissary, an agent, an embassador, an intelligencer, a newsmonger. E. वार्त्ता news, and अयन going.
34525: वार्त्तावह m. (-हः) 1 A chandler. 2 A messenger. E. वार्त्ता news, वह to bear, aff. अच्.
34526: वार्त्तावृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A householder. E. वार्त्ता news, and वृत्ति business.
34527: वार्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to news, bringing or conveying intelligence, &c. 2 Commentatory, explanatory, belonging to a comment or gloss, (as a rule, &c.) m. (-कः) 1 An intelligencer, an informer, an agent or envoy. 2 A man of the third or mercantile tribe. n. (-कं) A gloss, a commentary, especially a supplementary explanation added to a grammatical or philosophical aphorism, and its immediate elucidation, supplying or illustrating both text and comment; it is defined to be, the exposition of the meaning, of that which is said, of that which is left unsaid, and of that which is ill or imperfectly said. f. (-का) A quail. E. वृत्ति news, &c., or a comment, aff. ठक्.
34528: वार्त्त्रघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The prince ARJUNA. E. वृत्रघ्न INDRA, and अण् aff.
34529: वार्द्दर n. (-रं) 1 Silk. 2 Water. 3 The seed of the Abrus precatorius. 4 A conch shell. 5 A sort of curl on the right side of a horse's neck, considered as an auspicious mark. 6 Speech. E. वार् water, दृ to divide, aff. अप्.
34530: वार्द्दल n. (-लं) A rainy day, bad weather, &c. m. (-लः) An inkstand. E. वार् water, and द what gives, वार्द a cloud, ला to take, aff. क.
34531: वार्द्धक n. (-कं) 1 A number of old men. 2 Old age. 3 The infirmity, &c. of old age. E. वृद्ध old, वुञ् aff.
34532: वार्द्धक्य n. (-क्यं) Old age. E. वृद्ध old, and ष्यञ् aff.
34533: वार्द्धि m. (-र्द्धिः) The ocean. E. वार् water, घा to have, aff. कि.
34534: वार्द्धुषि m. (-षिः) A usurer. E. वृद्धि interest or increase, वृधुषि substituted, aff. ठक्, and the क rejected; also वार्द्धुषिक, form irr.
34535: वार्द्धुषिक m. (-कः) A usurer: see the last.
34536: वार्द्धुषिन् m. (-षी) A usurer. E. वृधुषि substituted for वृद्धि, and इनि aff.
34537: वार्द्धुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Usurious loan, usury, interest. E. वृद्धि increase, aff. ष्यञ्, form irr.
34538: वार्द्ध nf. (-र्द्धं-र्द्धी) A thong. E. वृद्ध to increase, to lengthen, aff. ष्ट्र, and अञ् added.
34539: वार्द्धीणस m. (-सः) An old white goat with long ears. E. वार्द्धी a leather thong, and नस for नासिका a nose.
34540: वार्भट m. (-टः) An alligator. E. वार् water, भट to maintain, aff. अच्.
34541: वार्म्मण n. (-णं) A number of coats of mail. E. वर्म्मण् armour, aff. अण्.
34542: वार्म्मिण n. (-णं) A number of men in armour. E. वर्म्मिन् a man in armour, and अण् aff.
34543: वार्म्मुच् m. (-र्म्मुक्) A cloud. E. वार् water, भुच् to let loose, aff. क्विप्.
34544: वार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be selected or appointed. 2 To be impeded, checked, stopped, &c. E. वृङ् to choose, aff. ण्यत्.
34545: वार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being prevented, impeded, prohibited, &c. E. वृ to select, passive v., शानच् aff.
34546: वार्य्युद्भव n. (-वं) A lotus. E. वारि water, उद्भव born.
34547: वार्य्योक m. (-कः) A leech. E. वारि, and ओकस् abode.
34548: वार्राशि m. (-शिः) The ocean. E. वार्, and राशि quantity.
34549: वार्व्वट m. (-टः) A boat, a vessel. E. वार् water, वट to surround, aff. अच्.
34550: वार्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-ष) Belonging to a year, to the rains, &c. E. वर्ष, and अण् aff.
34551: वार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Yearly, annual, or belonging to a year. 2 Growing, &c. in the rainy season, or fit for or suited to it, &c. n. (-कं) A drug, commonly Trāyamāṇa. E. वर्ष rains, or a year, and ठक् or ठञ् aff.
34552: वार्षिला f. (-ला) Hail. E. वार्ष belonging to rain, from वर्ष, with अण् aff., इलच् added.
34553: वार्षुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sprinkling, wetting, that which sprinkles, &c. E. वृष to sprinkle, उकञ् aff.
34554: वार्हत n. (-तं) The fruit of the Solanum jacquini. E. वृहति the plant, with अण् aff.
34555: वार्हद्रथ m. (-थः) A name of JARĀSAṂDHA. E. वृहद्रथ the father of this prince, and अण् patronymic; also with इञ् aff. वार्हद्रथि.
34556: वार्हस्पत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Sacred to VṚHASPATI. E. वृहस्पति, and अण् aff.
34557: वार्हस्पत्य n. (-त्यं) Ethics, morality. E. वृहस्पति the supposed original author of this science, and ण्य aff.
34558: वालक m. (-कः) 1 A bracelet. 2 A finger-ring. E. वल to surround, aff. ण्वुल्.
34559: वाल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्की-ल्कं) Made of the bark of trees. E. वल्क bark, aff. अण्.
34560: वाल्कल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Made of bark. f. (-ली) Spirituous liquor. n. (-लं) A dress made of the bark of trees worn by ascetics. E. वल्कल bark, and अण् aff.
34561: वाल्मिकि m. (-किः) The author of the Rāmāyaṇa; also वाल्मीकि.
34562: वाल्मीक m. (-कः) VĀLMĪKA or VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa. E. वल्मीक an ant-hill, aff. अण्, or with इञ् aff. वाल्मीकि; so immersed in abstraction as to be overrun with ant's nests.
34563: वावदूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Talking much, gabbling, prattling. E. वद to speak, Uṇādi aff. ऊक, the root reiterated.
34564: वावदूकता f. (-ता) Garrulity, loquaciousness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, वावटूकत्वं.
34565: वावय m. (-यः) A sort of Basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
34566: वावहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Who or what bears or carries much. E. वह to bear, कि aff.
34567: वावृत(उ) r. 4th cl. वावृतु (वावृत्यते) 1 To choose or select. 2 To serve.
34568: वावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Chosen, appointed. E. वृत to be, aff. क्त, and the root reiterated.
34569: वावृत्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Choosing, preferring. E. वावृत to choose, शानच् aff.
34570: वाश(ऋ)वाशृ r. 4th cl. (वाश्यते) 1 To sound. 2 To cry as a bird. 3 To call.
34571: वाशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Crying or singing like a bird. E. वाश to cry, aff. शतृ.
34572: वाशन n. (-नं) The cry or song of birds, bees, and the like. E. वाश to sound as a bird, ल्युट् aff.
34573: वाशा f. (-शा) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa:) see वास, and वासक; also with कन् added वाशिका.
34574: वाशि m. (-शिः) Fire. E. वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
34575: वाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, scented. 2 Sung, called, cried. n. (-तं) The cry of birds or animals. f. (-ता) 1 A woman. 2 A female elephant. E. वाष to call, or वास to perfume, aff. क्त, and स changed to श.
34576: वाशिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Relating to the sage VASIṢṬHA. f. (-ष्ठी) The Goomti river, which rising in the Kemaün hills, pursues a winding and south-easterly course, and passing Lucknow and Jonpur falls into the Ganges, below Benares. E. वशिष्ठ the saint, अण् aff., derived from him.
34577: वाशुरा f. (-रा) Night. E. वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
34578: वाश्र m. (-श्रः) A day. n. (-श्रं) 1 An edifice, a dwelling, a building. 2 A place where four roads meet. E. वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. रक्; also read वास्र.
34579: वाष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Large, great. m. (-लः) A warrior.
34580: वाष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 Vapour, hot mist, steam, &c. 2 A tear. 3 Iron. f. (-ष्पी) A drug. E. वा to go, or वै to dry, aff. प, form irr.; also बाष्प derived from वाध to oppose, and ध changed to ष.
34581: वाष्पका f. (-का) A drug, commonly Hingupatri. E. कन् added to वाष्प vapour; also वाष्पिका.
34582: वाष्पाकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Uttered or articulated with tears. E. वाष्प, and आकल what sounds.
34583: वाष्पाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Interrupted by tears. E. वाष्प, and आकुल perplexed.
34584: वाष्पिका f. (-का) A drug, commonly Hingupatri. E. वाष्प a tear, कन् aff., form irr.
34585: वाष्पोद्भव m. (-वः) Starting of tears. E. वाष्प, and उद्भव production.
34586: वास r. 10th cl. (वासयति) To introduce another quality, but especially fragrant odors, to perfume, to incense, to fumigate, &c. (ऋ) वासृ r. 4th cl. (वास्यते) To sound, especially as a bird.
34587: वास m. (-सः) 1 A house, a habitation. 2 Site, situation, abode, or place of staying or abiding. 3 Cloth, clothes. 4 Perfuming. mf. (-सः-सा) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. वस to dwell, aff. घञ्, or वास to fumigate, aff. अच्.
34588: वासःकुटी f. (-टी) A tent. E. वासस् cloth, and कुटी a hut.
34589: वासक mf. (-कः-का) A shrub, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. वास to perfume, aff. ण्वुल्.
34590: वासकसज्जा f. (-ज्जा) A woman dressed with all her ornaments, and having her apartments, &c. decorated to receive her lover. E. वास clothes, कन् pleonasm, and सज्जा accoutrements; also with कन् added, वासकसज्जिका.
34591: वासकर्णी f. (-र्णी) A hall, where public exhibitions, as Nāces, &c. are held. E. वास a house, कर्ण the ear, aff. ङीप्.
34592: वासगृह n. (-हं) The inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping room, a bed-chamber. E. वास abiding, and गृह a house.
34594: वासतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Habitable, fit or proper to be dwelt in. f. (-यी) Night. E. वसति abode, or night, ढक् aff.
34595: वासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for clothes, or a dwelling, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Perfuming, fumigating or perfuming with fragrant vapour, or with incense, &c. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 Abiding, abode. 4 A particular posture in which abstract meditation is performed; it is also a posture conceived to be peculiarly proper in princes and chiefs, and is then described as sitting with the knees bent and the feet turned backwards. 5 Knowledge. 6 A water-jar. 7 A box, a basket, a vessel, &c. 8 An envelope. 9 Any receptacle. 10 Steeping, infusing. f. (-ना) 1 The knowledge of any thing derived from memory, the present consciousness of past perceptions. 2 Fancy, imagination. 3 Trust, confidence. 4 Ignorance. E. वस to dwell, &c., aff. युच्; or वसन clothes, and अण् aff.
34596: वासनस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Packed, folded, enveloped. E. वासन a box, &c., and स्थ what stays or is.
34597: वासन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 1 Placed, situated. 2 Vernal, relating to the season of spring, suitable to it, produced in it, &c. 3 Young, in the spring of life. 4 Diligent in the performance of religious ceremonies. m. (-न्तः) 1 A camel. 2 The Indian cuckoo. 3 Any young animal, or a young elephant. 4 A catamite. 5 The southern wind, zephyr. 6 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) 7 The black kind of Moong or bean. 8 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) 9 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. f. (-न्ती) 1 A large creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 2 A species of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 3 Long pepper. 4 Trumpet flower. 5 A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month Chaitra. 6 A species of the Śarkarī metre. E. वस to dwell, aff. झच्, and the vowel made long; or वसन्त spring, and अण् aff.
34598: वासन्तक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Sown or growing in spring. 2 Suitable to the spring season. 3 Relating or belonging to it, vernal. E. वसन्त spring, and वुञ् aff.
34599: वासन्तिक m. (-कः) An actor, a dancer. E. वसन्त spring, aff. ठक्; the spring being the festival season.
34600: वासयोग m. (-गः) Fragrant powder sprinkled on the clothes, especially the red powder scattered about at the Holi festival. E. वास perfume, and योग joining.
34601: वासर mn. (-रः-रं) A day. m. (-रः) One of the Nāgas or serpents. E. वस to abide, in the causal form, Uṇādi aff. अर.
34602: वासरसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Morning. E. वासर, and सङ्ग connexion.
34603: वासव m. (-वः) INDRA. f. (-वी) The mother of VYĀSA. E. वसु a Vasu, and अण् aff.
34604: वासस् n. (-सः) Cloth, clothes. E. वस to cover or clothe, aff. असुन्.
34605: वाससज्जा f. (-ज्जा) A woman drest in all her ornaments to receive her lover. E. वास clothes, सज्ज armed, accoutred.
34606: वासागार n. (-रं) The inner or sleeping apartment. E. वास abiding, and आगार a house.
34607: वासि mf. (-सिः-सी) A small hatchet or chopper, an adze. m. (-सिः) Abiding, dwelling. E. वस to abide, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
34608: वासिका f. (-का) A plant. (Justicia:) see वासक.
34609: वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, scented. 2 Clothed, dressed. 3 Famous, celebrated. 4 Steeped, infused. 5 Spiced, seasoned, (sauces, &c.) 6 Peopled, populous, flourishing, (a country.) 7 Having, possessing. n. (-तं) 1 The cry of birds. 2 Knowledge in general, but especially that derived from memory. 3 Sound. 4 Rendering a country populous and flourishing, causing it to be inhabited. f. (-ता) 1 A woman. 2 A female elephant. E. वस to dwell, or clothe, causal form, or वास to call, (as a bird,) aff. क्त
34610: वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Abiding, staying. f. (-नी) A white sort of Jhiṇṭi, (Barleria.) E. वस to dwell, घिनुण् aff.
34612: वासिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Explained or composed by the sage VASIṢṬHA, a part of the Vedas or a particular prayer, &c. E. वसिष्ठ, and अण् aff.
34613: वासु m. (-सुः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 The soul, or the SUPREME BEIṄG considered as the soul of the universe. E. वस to abide (eternally,) उण् Uṇādi aff.
34614: वासुकि m. (-किः) The serpent VĀSUKI, sovereign of the snakes. E. वसु a jewel, क the head, वसुक here said to be a name of KAŚYAPA, aff. of descent इञ्.
34615: वासुकेय m. (-यः) The serpent VĀSUKI. E. see the last, aff. ढक्.
34616: वासुकेयस्वसृ f. (-सा) A name of MANASĀ, the wife of JARATKĀRU, and goddess presiding over snakes. E. वासुकेय the serpent VĀSUKI, and स्वसृ a sister.
34617: वासुदेव m. (-वः) 1 KṚṢṆA. 2 A descendant of VASUDEVA, the general appellation of a class of persons peculiar to the Jainas. E. वसुदेव the father of the deity, and अण् patronymic aff.
34618: वासुपूज्य m. (-ज्यः) The twelfth Jina or Jaina teacher of the present era.
34619: वासुभद्र m. (-द्रः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. वासु the soul, and भद्र auspicious.
34620: वासुरा f. (-रा) 1 Night. 2 The earth. 3 A woman. 4 A female elephant. E. वास to perfume, or वस to abide, in the causal form, aff. उरच्.
34621: वासू f. (-सूः) A young girl, (in theatrical language.) E. वस to abide, in the causal form, (to take to dwell with one,) aff. ऊ.
34622: वासोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives clothes. E. वासस्, and द what gives.
34623: वासोयुग n. (-गं) A suit of clothes. E. वासस्, and युग a pair.
34624: वासौकस् n. (-कः) The inner or private apartments. E. वास dwelling, and ओकस् a house.
34625: वास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ती-स्तं) Made or derived from a goat. E. वस्त, and अण् aff.
34626: वास्तव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Determined, demonstrated, fixed, substantiated. 2 Real, substantial. n. (-वं) An appointment. E. वस्तु thing, substance, अण् aff.
34627: वास्तविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Real, material, substantial, genuine. 2 Determinate. E. वस्तु, and ठक् aff.
34628: वास्तवोषा f. (-षा) Night. E. वास्तव an appointment, and ऊषा a libidinous woman: the season in which she makes an assignation.
34629: वास्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be abided or dwelt in, to be fixed as a habitation. 2 To be taken care of, (as a dependant.) m. (-व्यः) A kinsman, a dependant. E. वस to dwell, causal form, aff. of the future participle तव्यर्.
34630: वास्तु mn. (-स्तुः-स्तु) 1 The site of a habitation. 2 A house, a habitation. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. तुन्, and the radical vowel made long by special rule.
34631: वास्तुक n. (-कं) A potherb: see वास्तूक.
34632: वास्तुसंशमन n. (-नं) A ceremony or sacrifice performed on entering a new habitation. E. वास्तु, and संशमन consecration.
34633: वास्तुसंशमनीय n. (-यं) A ceremony performed on entering a new mansion. E. छ added to the preceding.
34634: वास्तूक n. (-कं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album, and other edible species.) E. वास्तु the site of a house, ठक् aff., and form irr. (growing there;) also with the vowel unaltered कास्तुक.
34635: वास्तेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Abdominal, relating or belonging to the belly. E. वस्ति, and ढक् aff.
34636: वास्तोस्पति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA. E. वास्तु the site of a dwelling, in the sixth case, and पति master.
34637: वास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः-स्त्री-स्त्रं) Cloth, made of or covered with cloth, &c. E. वस्त्र cloth, अण् aff.
34638: वास्प m. (-स्पः) 1 Vapor. 2 Tears; more correctly वाष्प, q. v.
34639: वास्पविक्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Weeping, bursting into tears. E. वास्प, and विक्लव distressed.
34640: वास्पाविलेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Suffused with tears, weeping. E. वास्प, आविल turbid, ईक्षण the sight.
34641: वाह(ऋ)वाहृ r. 1st cl. (वाहते) To endeavour: the root is preferably read वाहृ.
34642: वाह m. (-हः) 1 A horse. 2 A measure of capacity containing ten Kumbhas, or nearly equal to the weight of an English wey or a ton in freight. 3 A bull. 4 Air, wind. 5 The arm. 6 A buffalo. 7 A vehicle, a carriage or conveyance of any kind. 8 A bearer, a porter, a carrier of burthens, &c. E. वह to bear, aff. घञ्.
34643: वाहक m. (-कः) 1 A horseman. 2 A porter, a carrier. E. वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्.
34644: वाहद्विषत् m. (-षन्) A buffalo. E. वाह a horse, and द्विषत् inimical.
34645: वाहन n. (-नं) 1 A vehicle, a conveyance of any kind, as a horse, an elephant, a carriage. 2 Carrying, conveying, &c. 3 Marking effort or exertion. E. वह to bear, in the causal form, or वाह to endeavour, ल्युट् aff.
34646: वाहभ्रंश् mfn. (-भ्रट्) Falling from a vehicle, &c. E. वाह, भ्रंश to fall, क्विप् aff.
34647: वाहयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Employing, making use of. E. वह to bear, causal v., शतृ aff.
34648: वाहस m. (-सः) 1 A large snake, (Boa constrictor.) 2 A watercourse. 3 A potherb, (Marsilia dentata.) E. वह to bear, in the causal form, aff. असच्.
34649: वाहिक m. (-कः) 1 A large drum. 2 A car, &c. drawn by oxen. E. वाह bearing, and ठक् aff.
34650: वाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Exerted, endeavoured. E. वाह to endeavour, क्त aff.
34651: वाहित्थ n. (-त्थं) The part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal globes. E. वाहिन्, स्था to stay, aff. क, and स changed to त.
34652: वाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Bearing, carrying. E. वह to bear, णिनि aff.
34653: वाहिनी f. (-नी) 1 An army. 2 A body of forces consisting of 81 elephants, 81 cars, 243 horse, 405 foot, a cohort, a battalion. 3 A river. E. वाह a vehicle, &c., aff. इनि; fem. aff. ङीप्, comprising the conveyances of cars, horse, &c.
34654: वाहिनीनिवेश m. (-शः) A camp. E. वाहिनी, and निवेश encampment.
34655: वाहिनीपति m. (-तिः) 1 A general, a commanding officer. 2 The ocean. E. वाहिनी an army or river, and पति master.
34656: वाहीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Of burthen, bearing burthens. 2 Outer, external. m. (-कः) The name of a country, part of the Punjab. E. वाह bearing, or वाहिर् external, aff. ईकक् or ईकञ्, form irr.
34657: वाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be carried or borne. 2 Outer, external. n. (-ह्यं) A carriage, a vehicle. m. (-ह्यः) A beast of burthen, an ox, a horse, &c. E. वह to bear, aff. ण्यत्, or वहिर् external, यञ् aff.: see वाह्य.
34658: वाह्यतस् ind. Externally, solitarily. E. तसि added to the preceding.
34659: वाह्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being carried or conveyed. 2 Being induced, urged, incited, &c. E. वह to bear, pass. v., शानच् aff.
34660: वाह्लि f. (-ह्लिः) A country: see वाह्लीक.
34662: वाह्लिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in Vahli or Vāhlika country. m. यः A Turki horse. E. वाह्लि, and ज born.
34663: वाह्लीक m. (-कः) 1 A country lying north-west of Afghanistan, Balkh. 2 A horse from Balkh, considered as one of a good breed. 3 One of the principal Gandharbas or choristers of heaven. n. (-कं) 1 Saffron. 2 Asafoetida. E. वल्ह to be preeminent, इकन् or ईकन् aff., वह्लिक or वह्लीक; again, अण्.  pleonastic or derivative added, वाह्लिक; or वाह्लीक, the conjunct letters of the root being transposed; saffron, &c. are supplied still to India, especially from Kashmir, Khorasan, and the countries in that direction.
34664: वि mf. (-विः-वी) 1 A bird. 2 The eye. 3 Heaven. 4 The region of the wind. ind. A particle and prefix, implying: 1 Certainty, ascertainment, as विवेक्तुं to determine, to judge. 2 Separation, disjunction, as वियोक्तु to disjoin. 3 Aversion, repugnance, as विरोद्धु to oppose. 4 Impatience, intolerance, as विनृष्टं to be impatient. 5 Variety, difference, विशेष्टु to distinguish. 6 Cause, motive, विघातुं to prescribe or order. 7 Motion, progress, विचरितुं to go. 8 Privation, विणीतुं to take away. It generally corresponds to the English adjuncts, a, ex, de, dis, in, un, &c. and is frequently an expletive. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. इन् with the effect of डित् or ड, which ejects the final syllable.
34665: विंश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Twentieth. E. विंशति twenty, and डट् aff.
34666: विंशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Twenty, collectively, or an aggregate of twenty. E. विंशति, and ड्वुन् aff.
34667: विंशति always f. sing. (-तिः) Twenty, a score. du. (-ती) Two twenties. plu. (-तयः) Many twenties.
34668: विंशतिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Worth twenty, produced from or bought with twenty, &c. E. विंशति twenty, and कन् added.
34669: विंशतितम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Twentieth. E. विंशति, and तमट् aff.
34670: विंशतीश m. (-शः) A governor of twenty villages. E. विंशति, and ईश sovereign; also विंशतीशिन्.
34671: विंशिन् m. (-शी) Twenty, (collectively,) a score. E. विंशति, and डिन् aff.
34672: विक n. (-कं) The milk of a prolific cow.
34673: विकङ्कट m. (-टः) A plant, (Ruellia longifolia, &c.:) see गोक्षुर. E. वि apart, ककि to go, aff. अटन्.
34674: विकङ्कत m. (-तः) A small tree. E. वि apart, separate, ककि to go or grow, अतच् aff., or वि a bird, ककि, &c. as before; on which the birds roost.
34675: विकच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 1 Blown, opened, expanded, spread, (as a flower, &c.) 2 Bald, having little or no hair on the head. m. (-चः) 1 A Bauddha mendicant. 2 The planet KETU, or the personified descending node. E. वि apart, separate, कच to go, aff. अच्, or वि privative, and कच hair.
34676: विकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Large, great. 2 Formidable, frightful, hideous, horrible. 3 Large-toothed. 4 Beautiful, pleasing. 5 Changed in form or appearance. 6 Obscure, obsolete. n. (-टं) A bile, a tumour. f. (-टा) A female divinity peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. वि implying separation or expansion, कट to go or be, aff. अच्, or with कटच् aff.
34677: विकण्टक m. (-कः) A herbaceous plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. वि expanding, कण्ट a thorn, कन् added.
34678: विकत्थन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Speaking idly. 2 Praising ironically. 3 Vaunting, boastful. n. (-नं) 1 Irony, ironical or unmerited praise. 2 Praise in general. 3 Assigning any thing to an unreal origin. 4 Boasting. 5 Repeating, proclaiming. E. वि implying difference or extension, and कत्थन praising.
34679: विकत्थनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be praised, commendable. 2 Ridiculous, to be praised ironically. E. वि before कत्थ to praise, अनीयर् aff.
34680: विकत्था f. (-त्था) 1 Praise. 2 Irony, ironical praise. 3 Boasting. 4 Repeating, proclaiming. E. वि, कत्थ to praise, अङ् and टाप् affs.
34681: विकत्थिन् mfn. (-त्थी-त्थिनी-त्थि) Who or what boasts, praises, proclaims, &c.: see विकथन. E. वि, कत्य to boast, घिनुण् aff.
34682: विकम्प mfn. (-म्पः-म्पा-म्पं) 1 Trembling. 2 Heaving. 3 Unsteady, not firm or continued.. 4 Shrinking form. E. वि, and कम्प trembling.
34683: विकम्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Trembling, tremulous, agitated. 2 Palpitating, heaving. 3 Broken, interrupted, unsteady. 4 Shrinking from. E. वि before कपि to tremble, aff. क्त.
34684: विकर m. (-रः) Sickness, disease. E. वि implying difference, and कर making.
34685: विकराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Formidable, frightful. E. वि intensitive, and कराल frightful.
34686: विकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Ear-less. m. (-र्णं) One of the KURU princes. E. वि, and कर्ण an ear, or a proper name.
34687: विकर्णिक m. (-कः) Sārasvata, a district in the north-west of Hindustan, generally considered as part of the Punjab, though sometimes confounded with Kashmir. E. वि privative, and कर्ण KARṆA; aff. ठक्; the region from which KARṆA was proscribed.
34688: विकर्त्तन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 A son who has usurped his father's kingdom. E. वि before कृत to cut, aff. ल्युट्; having been shorn of some of his beams, by VIŚVAKARMA.
34689: विकर्म्मकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) 1 Acting illegally, one who does forbidden acts. 2 Busy in various ways. E. विकर्म्म, and कृत् who does.
34690: विकर्म्मक्रिया f. (-या) Illegal or immoral act. E. विकर्म्म, and क्रिया act.
34691: विकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Various business or duty. 2 Prohibited or unlawful act. 3 Fraud. E. वि, and कर्म्मन् act.
34692: विकर्म्मस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Doing what is illegal or immoral, engaged in prohibited acts. 2 Engaged in various business. E. विकर्म्म, and स्थ who or what stays.
34693: विकर्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Doing forbidden acts. 2 Transacting various affairs. m. (-कः) Clerk or superintendant of markets or fairs. E. वि implying variety, कर्म्म business, and ठक् aff.
34694: विकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Pulling, pulling apart or out. 2 An arrow. E. वि separate, कृष to attract, अच् aff.
34695: विकर्षण n. (-णं) Pulling, drawing, dragging. E. वि before कृष to attract, aff. ल्युट्.
34696: विकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Confused, confounded, agitated. 2 Defective, imperfect. 3 Decayed, impaired, withered, waned. f. (-ला-ली) A woman in whom menstruation has ceased. n. (-लं) The 1/60th of a Kalā, the second of a degree. E. वि privative, and कला a digit of the moon, &c.
34697: विकलपाणिक m. (-कः) A cripple with a crooked or withered arm. E. विकल defective, पाणि the hand, and कन् added.
34698: विकलाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Deformed, crippled, maimed. E. विकल defective, अङ्ग the body.
34699: विकलीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Spoiling, breaking, maiming. 2 Confusing, agitating. E. विकल, and करण making, च्चि aff.
34700: विकलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Broken, injured, impaired. 2 Sick, lame, maimed. 3 Confused, distressed. E. विकल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
34701: विकलीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Agitated, distressed. 2 Maimed, defective. E. विकल, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
34702: विकलेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having any of the organs of sense impaired or defective. E. विकल, and इन्द्रिय an organ.
34703: विकल्प m. (-ल्पः) 1 Error, ignorance, mistake. 2 Alternative, option. 3 Doubt, indecision. 4 (In rhetoric,) Antithesis of opposites. 5 (In grammar, &c.,) Admission of more than one form or rule. E. वि distinction, and कल्प making, &c.
34704: विकल्पयत् mfn. (यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Doubting, deliberating, weighing alternatives. E. वि before कृप to be able, शतृ aff.
34705: विकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made or acknowledged as optional. E. वि before कृप to be able, क्त aff.
34706: विकश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opening, expanding. E. वि separately, कश to go, वरच् aff.
34707: विकषा f. (-षा) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. वि before कष to injure, अच् aff.; also विकसा.
34708: विकष्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opening, expanding. E. वि before कष to go, aff. वरच्; also विकस्वर.
34709: विकस m. (-सः) The moon. f. (-सा) Bengal madder. E. वि before कस to go, aff. अच्.
34710: विकसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Opening, expanding. 2 Budding, blowing. E. वि before कस to go, शतृ aff.
34711: विकसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blown, as a flower, budded, opened, expanded. E. वि apart, कस to go, aff. क्त.
34712: विकस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opening, expanding. E. वि apart, कस to go, aff. वरच्; also derived from कश or कष, विकश्यर, and विकष्वर.
34713: विकार m. (-रः) 1 Change of form or nature, alteration or deviation from the natural state. 2 Sickness, disease change from the state of health. 3 Passion, feeling, emotion, transition from the natural or quiescent condition of the soul. E. वि implying alteration, कृ to make, aff. अण्
34714: विकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Changed, converted, made to undergo a changing. 2 Rendered unfavourable or unfriendly. E. वि before कृ to make, causal v., क्त aff.
34715: विकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Producing a change. 2 Undergoing a change. E. वि before कृ to make, णिनि aff., or विकार, and इनि aff.
34716: विकाल m. (-लः) Twilight. E. वि implying prohibition, (of peculiar ceremonies,) and काल time.
34717: विकालक m. (-कः) Evening, twilight. f. (-लिका) A perforated copper vessel, which is placed in a pan of water, and being filled at the expiration of a certain period, defines that period: a sort of Clepsydra, or water clock. E. वि before काल time, and कन् added, or वि before कल to go, aff. क्वुन्.
34718: विकाश m. (-शः) 1 Solitude, loneliness, privacy. 2 Display, manifestation, open or splendid appearance. 3 Opening, expanding. 4 Budding, blowing, (as a flower.) 5 Pleasure, enjoyment. 6 Ether, heaven. E. वि before काश to shine, aff. घञ्; the vowel of the prefix is more usually made long: see विकाश.
34719: विकाशता f. (-ता) 1 Appearance, display. 2 Loneliness. 3 Expansion. E. विकाश shining, aff. तल्; also with त्व, विकाशत्वं.
34720: विकाशन n. (-नं) 1 Expansion, extent. 2 Manifestation. 3 Blowing, (of a flower.) E. विकाश, and ल्युट् aff.
34721: विकाशभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Expanding, being full. 2 Blown, budded. E. विकाश, and भृत् who or what has.
34722: विकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Expanding, spreading. E. वि before कश to go, aff. घिनुण्.
34723: विकाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Expanding, &c. E. वि before कष to go, aff. घिनुण्.
34724: विकासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Expanding, opening, budding, blowing. E. वि before कस to go, aff. घिनुण्; also with कश or कष the same, विकाशिन्, and विकाषिन् as above.
34725: विकिर m. (-रः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A well. 3 A fallen fragment, a scattered portion. 4 Scattering. E. वि apart, &c., कॄ to scatter, क aff.
34726: विकिरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Throwing, scattering, sprinkling. E. वि before कॄ to scatter, शतृ aff.
34727: विकिरण n. (-णं) Scattering, spreading about or abroad. m. (-णः) Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) E. वि before कॄ to scatter, aff. यु.
34728: विकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Scattered, spread about, extended, diffused. 2 Celebrated, famous. E. वि implying extension, कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.
34729: विकीर्य्य ind. Having or being scattered. E. वि, and कॄ to scatter, aff. ल्यप्.
34730: विकीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being tossed, agitated, scattered, &c. E. वि before कॄ to scatter, pass. v., शानच् aff.
34731: विकुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Joyful, cheerful, happy. 2 Undergoing or making a change of form, &c. E. वि before कृ to make or do, चानश or शानच् aff.
34732: विकुस्र m. (-स्रः) The moon. E. वि before कस to shine, रक् Uṇādi aff., and उ substituted for the radical vowel.
34733: विकूणन n. (-नं) A side glance, a leer, a wink. E. वि before कूण to contract or close, (the eyes,) aff. ल्युट्.
34734: विकूणिका f. (-का) The nose. E. वि before कूण to sound, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. form.
34735: विकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Entertaining the feeling of disgust, averse, estranged. 2 Sick, diseased. 3 Altered, changed, either in form or feeling. 4 Imperfect, unfinished, incomplete. 5 Overcome by feeling or passion. n. (-तं) Disgust, aversion. E. वि implying reverse, and कृत made.
34736: विकृतवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having the face distorted. E. विकृत, and वदन face.
34737: विकृताकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Changed in aspect, form, or appearance. E. विकृत, and आकार form; also विकृताकृति.
34738: विकृताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Distorted, deformed. E. विकृत, and अङ्ग the limbs.
34739: विकृति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 Change of any kind, as of purpose, mind. form, nature, &c. either permanent or temporary. 2 Sickness, disease, change from the natural or healthy state. 3 Fear, apprehension. 4 Spirituous liquor. 5 A species of metre: the stanza consists of four lines of two syllables each, variously arranged. E. वि implying alteration or reverse, कृ to make, aff. क्तिन्.
34740: विकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pulled, drawn, (as a bow-string.) 2 Attracted. 3 Dragged, drawn, in general. 4 Sounded, making a noise. E. वि before कृष to draw, aff. क्त.
34741: विकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Bald. f. (-शी) 1 A small braid or tress of hair, first tied up severally, and then collected into the Veṇī or larger braid. 2 A woman without hair. E. वि severally or privative, and केश hair.
34742: विकेशिका f. (-का) A pledget, a piece of rag smeared with ghee or other substances and applied as a dressing to a sore.
34743: विकोष m. (-षः-षा-षं) Uncovered, denuded, unsheathed. E. वि privative, and कोष a sheath, a cover.
34744: विकौतुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Incurious, indifferent. E. वि, and कौतुक curious.
34745: विक्क m. (-क्कः) A young elephant. E. विक imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड.
34746: विक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Heroism, prowess, heroic valour. 2 Great power or strength. 3 Walking, going, proceeding. 4 Overpowering, overcoming. 5 Strength in general. 6 The name of a sovereign of Ougein: see विक्रमादित्य. E. वि before क्रम to go, to move, to walk, aff. घञ्.
34747: विक्रममाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 Overpowering. E. वि before क्रम to go, शानच् aff.
34748: विक्रमादित्य m. (-त्यः) The name of a celebrated prince, the sovereign of Ougein, and reputed founder of an æra still in use amongst the Hindus, commencing 56 years before the Christian æra; there are however many princes of this name, and it has been applied to Rāja BHOJA, to ŚĀLIVĀHANA, and PṚTHVĪ Rāja, as well as to five or six others; the name also occurs variously written, as VIKRAMA, ĀDITYA, VIKRAMASENA, VIKRAMASIṂHA, VIKRAMĀRKA, &c. E. विक्रम power, and आदित्य the sun.
34749: विक्रमार्क m. (-र्कः) A name of the sovereign VIKRAMĀDITYA: see the last. E. विक्रम heroism, and अर्क the sun.
34750: विक्रमार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, acquired by valour. E. विक्रम, and अर्ज्जित gained.
34751: विक्रमिन् m. (-मी) 1 A lion. 2 A hero. E. विक्रम strength, valour, इनि aff.
34752: विक्रय m. (-यः) Sale, selling, vending. E. वि before क्री to buy, अच् aff.
34753: विक्रयानुशय m. (-यः) Rescission of sale. E. विक्रय, and अनुशय doubt.
34754: विक्रयण n. (-णं) Selling, vending. E. वि reverse, क्री to buy, ल्युट् aff.
34755: विक्रयिक m. (-कः) A vender, a dealer, a salesman. E. विक्रय sale, ठन् aff.
34756: विक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A seller, a vender. E. विक्रय sale, इनि aff.
34757: विक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Valiant, mighty. 2 Overcoming, victorious. m. (-न्तः) 1 A hero, a warrior. 2 A lion. n. (-न्तं) Valour. E. वि before क्रम to go, aff. क्त, in an active sense.
34758: विक्रान्ति m. (-न्तिः) 1 A horse's canter or gallop. 2 Prowess, heroic strength and valour. 3 Great power or strength. E. वि before क्रम to go, aff. क्तिन्.
34759: विक्रान्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) 1 Valiant. 2 Victorious. m. (-न्ता) A hero, a victor. E. वि before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.
34760: विक्रायक m. (-कः) A vender, a seller. E. वि before क्री to buy, खुल् aff.
34761: विक्रिया f. (-या) Change of mind, form, purpose, condition, &c. E. वि implying reverse, and क्रिया action; see विकार.
34762: विक्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sold. E. वि before क्री to buy, aff. क्त.
34763: विक्रीय ind. Having sold. E. वि before क्री to buy, ल्यप् aff.
34764: विक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Harsh, rugged, or unkind, (as speech.) 2 Called out, exclaimed. n. (-ष्टं) 1 A cry of alarm or for help. 2 Abuse. E. वि before क्रुश to call, aff. क्त.
34765: विक्रेतृ m. (-ता) A vender, a seller. E. वि before क्री to buy, aff. तृच्.
34766: विक्रेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Vendible, saleable. E. वि before क्री to buy, aff. यत्.
34767: विक्रोशन n. (-नं) 1 Abusing, reviling. 2 Calling out. E. वि before क्रश to curse, ल्युट् aff.
34768: विक्रोष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) 1 Who reviles, abuses, speaks harshly, &c. 2 Who calls or cries out. E. वि before क्रुश to cry, तृच् aff.
34769: विक्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Overcome with fear or agitation, confused, confounded, lost, bewildered. E. वि before क्लु to go, aff. अच्.
34770: विक्लवता f. (-ता) Timidity, fear. E. विक्लव, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विक्लवत्वं.
34771: विक्लिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Old. 2 Withered, shrivelled, decayed. 3 Wet, moist. E. वि before क्लिद to moisten, aff. क्त.
34772: विक्षण adv. n. (-णं) Momentarily, for a moment. E. वि, and क्षण a moment.
34773: विक्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, hurt, wounded. E. वि before क्षत broken, torn.
34774: विक्षाव m. (-वः) 1 Cough. 2 Sound. E. वि before क्षु to sound, aff. घञ्.
34775: विक्षिपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) 1 Throwing, tossing. 2 Agitating. E. वि before क्षिप to throw, and शतृ aff.
34776: विक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Scattered, dispersed. 2 Thrown, cast. 3 Agitated, bewildered, perplexed. 4 Sent, dispatched. 5 Refuted, falsified. E. वि severally, and क्षिप्त thrown or sent.
34777: विक्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wasted, destroyed. E. वि before क्षै to decay, क्त aff.
34778: विक्षीणक m. (-कः) 1 The chief of a class of demigods, enumerated amongst those attached to ŚIVA, and the ministers of destruction amongst men by plague, pestilence, &c. 2 A meeting or assembly of the gods. 3 A place prohibited to eaters of meat. E. वि before क्षीण wasted, (by whom,) and कन् added.
34779: विक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Casting, throwing, or throwing away. 2 Sending, dispatching. 3 Confusion, perplexity, fear proceeding from ignorance or error. 4 Looking about vaguely or wildly, as of a woman for her absent lover. 5 Refuting an argument, establishing its falsehood. 6 Celestial latitude. E. वि before क्षिप to throw, aff. घञ्.
34780: विक्षेपण n. (-णं) 1 Scattering, dispersing. 2 Sending, dispatching. 3 Throwing. E. वि before क्षिप् to throw, ल्युट् aff.
34781: विक्षेपध्रुव m. (-वः) (In astronomy), The greatest inclination of a planet's orbit. E. विक्षेप, and ध्रुव are.
34782: विक्षोभ n. (-भं) 1 Agitating, shaking. 2 Conflict, struggle. 3 Fearing. E. वि before क्षभ to stir, and घञ् aff.
34784: विखण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Broken, divided. 2 Refuted. E. वि before खण्डित the same.
34787: विखुर m. (-रः) A goblin, a demon, a Rākṣasa. E. वि before खुर to cut, aff. क.
34788: विख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Noseless. E. वि privative prefix, and ख्य substituted for नस or नासिका; also other as arbitrary terms, or विख, विग्र, विग्र, &c.
34789: विख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, notorious, famous. 2 Avowed, confessed. E. वि before ख्या to say or tell, aff. क्त.
34790: विख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, celebrity, notoriety. E. वि before ख्या to say or tell, aff. क्तिन्.
34791: विख्यापन n. (-नं) 1 Confessing, acknowledging, avowing, declaring. 2 Explaining, expounding. E. वि before ख्या to say, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
34793: विख्रु mfn. (-ख्रुः-ख्रुः-ख्रु) Noseless; also विख and विखु.
34794: विगणन n. (-नं) Reckoning, computing. 2 Considering, deliberating. 3 Discharge of a debt. E. वि before गणन counting.
34795: विगणय्य ind. 1 Having deliberated or weighed. 2 Having reckoned. E. वि before गण to number, ल्यप् aff.
34796: विगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reckoned, calculated. 2 Weighed, considered. 3 Discharged, (as a debt.) E. वि before गण to count, क्त aff.
34797: विगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, departed, disappeared. 2 Separated, severed, parted. 3 Freed or exempt from. 4 Lost. 5 Gloomy, dark, obscured. E. वि implying disunion, (of light, &c.,) गत gone.
34798: विगतकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Pure, righteous. 2 Unsoiled. E. विगत, and कल्मष sin.
34799: विगतज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Exempted from decay. 2 Cured of fever. E. विगत, and ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.
34800: विगतराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Devoid of passion or affection. E. विगत, and राग passion.
34801: विगतश्रीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, unprosperous. E. विगत gone, श्री prosperity, कप् aff.
34802: विगतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Indifferent, devoid of wish or desire. E. विगत, and स्पृहा desire.
34803: विगतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) A woman past child-bearing. E. विगत gone, आर्त्तव the menstrual excretion.
34804: विगम m. (-मः) Separation, parting. E. वि apart, and गम going.
34805: विगर m. (-रः) 1 An abstemious man, one who feeds on wind. 2 A naked man. 3 A mountain.
34806: विगर्हण nf. (-णं-णा) Abuse, abusing, censure, reproach. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, युच् aff.
34807: विगर्हणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Bad, wicked, reprehensible. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, अनीयर् aff.
34808: विगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abused, reviled. 2 Low, vile. 3 Bad, wicked. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, aff. क्त.
34809: विगर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Blamable, reprehensible. ind. Having blamed or reviled. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
34810: विगर्ह्यकथा f. (-था) Scandal, abuse. E. विगर्ह्य, and कथा speech.
34811: विगलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Oozing, dropping, flowing. 2 Fading, dispersing, weakening, (as emotion, &c.) E. वि before गल to ooze, शतृ aff.
34812: विगलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fallen, dropped, oozed, flowing. 2 Removed, gone. 3 Dissipated, dispersed. 4 Decayed, impaired. 5 Slackened, untied, (as a knot.) 6 Loose, disordered, (as dress.) E. वि before गल to ooze, aff. क्त.
34813: विगलितकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Having the hair dishevelled. E. विगलित, and केश hair.
34814: विगाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Immersed, plunged, bathed, bathing. 2 Much, exceeding. 3 Flowing copiously. E. वि before गाह to bathe, aff. क्त.
34815: विगान n. (-नं) 1 Ill report, detraction, scandal. 2 Censure, reproach. E. वि depreciative prefix, गै to sing or sound, aff. ल्युट्.
34816: विगाह m. (-हः) 1 Bathing. 2 Plunging into, literally or figuratively, (as water, a crowd, &c.) E. वि before गाह to bathe, अच् aff.
34817: विगाहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Beholding, perceiving. 2 Knowing. 3 Bathing. 4 Going, proceeding. E. वि before गाह to agitate, aff. शानच्.
34818: विगाह्य ind. Having bathed or plunged in. E. वि before गाह to agitate, ल्यप् aff.
34819: विगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Contradicted, contradictory, inconsistent. 2 Abused, reproached. 3 Sung or said in various ways. 4 Sung ill. E. वि, and गीत sung.
34820: विगीति f. (-तिः) 1 Reproach, abuse. 2 Contradiction. 3 Singing in various styles. 4 Singing ill. E. वि, and गीति singing.
34821: विगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Void of all qualities. 2 Bad, worthless, having no merit. E. वि, and गुण quality.
34822: विगूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Concealed, hidden. 2 Blamed, reproached, censured. E. वि before गुह to conceal, aff. क्त.
34823: विगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opposed, obstructed, prevented. 2 Encountered, as in fight. E. वि before ग्रह to seize, क्त aff.
34824: विगृह्य ind. Having warred or contended with. E. वि before ग्रह to take, ल्यप् aff.
34825: विगृह्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being warred upon or contended with. E. वि before ग्रह to take, pass. v., शानच् aff.
34826: विग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Noseless. E. वि privative prefix, and ग्र substituted for नासिका.
34827: विग्रह m. (-हः) 1 The body. 2 Extension, diffusion. 3 A portion, a part. 4 Shape, form, figure. 5 (A grammatical term,) the proper application or sense of a compound word. mn. (-हः-हं) 1 War, battle. 2 Opposition, encounter. E. वि various, (happiness, &c.) ग्रह to take, aff. अच्.
34828: विग्रहावर n. (-रं) The back. E. विग्रह the body, and अवर the back.
34829: विग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be warred or contended with. E. वि before ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
34830: विघटिका f. (-का) Sixtieth part of a Gharī, equal to 24 seconds. E. वि, and घटिका a Gharī.
34831: विघन m. (-नः) A mallet, a hammer, an implement for striking. E. वि before हन to strike, अप् aff.
34832: विघट्टन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 Striking. 3 Opening, undoing, untying. 4 Offending. E. वि, घटृ to rub, aff. ल्युट्.
34833: विघट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed, touched. 2 Offended. 3 Struck. 4 Untied, undone. E. वि before घट्ट or rub, aff. क्त.
34834: विघस m. (-सः) 1 The residue of food offered to the gods, to the manes, to a venerable guest, or a spiritual preceptor. 2 Food in general. E. वि before अद to eat, aff. अप्, and घस substituted for the root.
34835: विघसाश m. (-शः) One who eats the remains of an offering. E. विघस, and आश eating; also विघसाशिन्, &c.
34836: विघात mn. (-तः-तं) 1 Impediment, obstacle. 2 Prohibition or prevention. 3 Opposition. 4 Destruction. 5 A blow. E. वि before हन to kill or hurt, aff. क्त.
34837: विघातसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Removing obstacles or impediments. E. विघात, and सिद्धि attainment.
34838: विघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Opposing, impeding, preventing. 2 Removing, destroying. 3 Wounding, killing. E. वि before हन to hurt or strike, aff. णिनि.
34839: विघुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Cried, proclaimed. E. वि before घुष्ट cried.
34840: विघुष्य ind. Having proclaimed. E. वि before घुष to cry, ल्यप् aff.
34841: विघोषण n. (-णं) Proclamation, crying. E. वि before घुष to cry aloud, ल्युट् aff.
34842: विघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 Obstacle, impediment. 2 The Caronda, (Carissa Carondas.) E. वि before हन to be injured (by it), and क aff.
34843: विघ्नकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opposing, impeding, obstructing. E. विघ्न, and कर what makes.
34844: विघ्नकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Impeding, obstructing. 2 Fearful, formidable, terrible. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and कारिन् causing.
34845: विघ्ननाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what removes difficulties, &c. m. (-कः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न, and नाशक who or what destroys.
34846: विघ्ननाशन n. (-नं) Removing obstacles. m. (-नः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and नाशन removing; the deity being supposed capable of either causing or removing difficulties and impediments, and being therefore especially worshipped at the commencement of any undertaking: also other similar compounds.
34847: विघ्नराज m. (-जः) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an impediment, and राज ruler: see the last.
34848: विघ्नलेश m. (-शः) Slight obstacle or impediment. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and लेश a little.
34849: विघ्नविनायक m. (-कः) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and विनायक remover.
34850: विघ्नसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Removal of obstacles. E. विघ्न, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
34851: विघ्नहारिन् m. (-री) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, हारिन् who removes see विघ्ननाशन.
34852: विघ्नित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, prevented, obstructed, impeded. E. विघ्न an obstacle, इतच् aff.
34853: विघ्नेश m. (-शः) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and ईश lord: see विघ्ननाशन.
34855: विच(औइर्)औ विचिर् r. 7th cl. (विनक्ति विंक्ते) 1 To differ, to be separate or distinct. To divide, to separate, especially in judgment, to discriminate, to judge.
34856: विचकिल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of jasmine. 2 A flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.) 3 A shrub, (Vangueria spinosa) E. वि before चक to be satisfied, इलच् aff.
34857: विचक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Clever, able, wise, sensible. 2 Proficient, skilful. m. (-णः) A learned Brahman or Paṇḍita, a holy teacher. E. वि before चक्ष to speak, (sensibly,) and युच् aff.
34858: विचक्षुस् mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) 1 Blind. 2 Sad, perplexed. E. वि privative, चक्षुस् the eye.
34859: विचय m. (-यः) Search, research. E. वि before चि to collect, aff. अच्.
34860: विचयन n. (-नं) Search, research, seeking. E. वि before चि to collect, aff. ल्युट्.
34861: विचरत् mfn. (-रत्-रन्ती-रत्) Wandering, roaming, going about. E. वि variously, चर to go, शतृ aff.
34862: विचर्च्चिका f. (-का) Herpes, scab. E. वि before चर्च्च to speak or tell, aff. ण्वुल्.
34863: विचल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Unsteady, unfixed, moving, going. 2 Conceited. E. वि before चल the same.
34864: विचलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Moving, going, shaking, waving. E. वि before चल to go, शतृ aff.
34865: विचलन n. (-नं) 1 Fickleness, unsteadiness. 2 Self-praise, conceit. 3 Deviating from. E. वि before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.
34866: विचलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, departed. 2 Deviated from, E. वि before चल to go, क्त aff.
34867: विचार m. (-रः) 1 The exercise of judgment or reason on a present object, investigation, consideration, deliberation. 2 Dispute, discussion. E. वि before चर to go, aff. घञ्.
34868: विचारक m. (-कः) An investigator, a judge. E. वि before चर to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
34869: विचारकता f. (-ता) Investigation, discussion. E. तल् added to the last; also त्व, विचारकत्व.
34870: विचारकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A judge, an investigator. E. विचार, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
34871: विचारण nf. (-णं-णा) Deliberation, investigation, the exercise of judgment, or decision after due examination or discussion. f. (-णा) The Mīmāṃsā system of philosophy. E. वि before चर to go, causal form, aff. युच्.
34872: विचारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be discussed or investigated. E. वि before चर to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
34873: विचारभू f. (-भूः) 1 The judgment seat of YAMA, the judge of the dead. 2 Any meeting for literary or judicial investigation. E. विचार discussion or judgment, and भू place.
34874: विचारस्थल n. (-लं) A logical disputation. E. विचार, and स्थल place.
34875: विचारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Judged, discussed, determined, decided. E. विचार discussion, aff. इतच्.
34876: विचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Judging, discussing. E. वि before चर to go, णिनि aff.
34877: विचार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be discussed, weighed, deliberated. &c. Ind. Having deliberated. E. वि before चर to go, causal v., ण्यत् or ल्यप् aff.
34878: विचार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being investigated or discussed. E. वि before चर to go, passive v., शानच् aff.
34879: विचाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Intervening, intermediate. E. वि disjunctive prefix, चल to go, aff. अण्.
34880: विचि f. (-चिः-ची) A wave. E. वि before चि to collect, क्विप् aff., also वीची.
34881: विचिकित्सा f. (-सा) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 Error, mistake. E. वि before कित to doubt, in the reduplicate form, aff. अच्.
34882: विचित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) 1 Variegated, spotted. 2 Painted, coloured. 3 Handsome, beautiful. 4 Wonderful, surprising. n. (-त्रं) 1 Variegated, (the colour.) 2 Surprise. 3 Speech implying apparently the reverse of the object intended. E. वि before चित्र variegated, &c.
34883: विचित्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Wonderful, surprising. n. (-कं) Astonishment, wonder. E. कन् added to the last.
34884: विचित्रचीनांशुक n. (-कं) Shot or watered China silk. E. विचित्र, and चीनांशुक China cloth.
34885: विचित्रता f. (-ता) 1 Wonder, wonderfulness. 2 Being variegated, variety of colour or tint, &c. E. विचित्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विचित्रत्वं.
34886: विचित्रदेह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) 1 Having the body painted, &c. 2 Elegant. m. (-हः) A cloud. E. विचित्र spotted, variegated, (with different tints,) and देह the body.
34887: विचित्रवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A sovereign, the 22nd monarch of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the son of ŚĀNTANU and husband of PĀṆḌU'S mother. E. विचित्र wonderful, वीर्य्य power.
34888: विचित्रवीर्य्यसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VICITRAVĪRYA by ŚĀNTANU; also of VYĀSA by PARĀŚARA. E. विचित्रवीर्य्य as above, and सू the mother.
34889: विचित्राङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Elegant, well-formed, handsome. 2 Having the body of various colours. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A peacock. 2 A tiger. E. विचित्र variegated or beautiful, and अङ्ग the body.
34890: विचित्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wonderful. 2 Painted, variegated. E. विचित्र, and इतच् aff.
34891: विचिन्त्य ind. Having reflected. E. वि before चित to think, ल्यप् aff.
34892: विचिन्त्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being to be thought of or considered. E. वि before चिति to think, pass. v., शानच् aff.
34893: विचिन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्) Thinking, considering. E. वि before चि to collect, aff. शतृ.
34894: विचिन्वत्क m. (-त्कः) 1 A hero. 2 Discrimination, judging. E. कन् added to the last.
34895: विचिन्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thinking, considering, deliberating. E. वि before चि to collect, शानच् aff.
34896: विचीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Entered. 2 Occupied or inhabited by.
34897: विचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unconscious, senseless, lifeless. E. वि priv. चेतना sense.
34898: विचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) 1 Sad, perplexed, unhappy. 2 Ignorant, stupid. E. वि implying privation, चेतस् mind.
34899: विचेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Investigated, ascertained, inquired into or looked after. 2 Inconsiderate, ill-judged. n. (-तं) 1 Evil or malicious act. 2 Exertion, effort. E. वि before चेष्टित sought.
34900: विच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown or slipped off. 2 Fallen or deviated from, neglecting, (as a duty.) 3 Sloughed. E. वि before च्युत fallen.
34901: विच्छ r. 6th cl. (विच्छायति) To go or approach, (the form is irr.) r. 10th cl. (विच्छयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak.
34902: विछन्द m. (-न्दः) A building of several stories, and surrounded by a portico, or having a portico to the east and west only; a palace, a temple. E. वि before छन्द wish, will; also with कन् added, विछन्दक, and derived from छृदि to be splendid, with वुन् aff. विछर्द्दक.
34903: विछर्द्दक m. (-कः) A large and handsome building, the temple of a god, or the palace of a prince: see the last.
34904: विछर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Disregarding. 2 Wasting. 3 Being sick. E. वि before छृदि to vomit, ल्युट् aff.
34905: विछर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disregarded, neglected. 2 Diminished, impaired. 3 Vomited. E. वि before छृद to vomit, क्त aff.
34906: विछाय n. (-यं) The shadow of a flock of birds. E. वि a bird, छाय a shadow, which in this sort of compound becomes neuter.
34907: विच्छित्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Cutting, cutting off, excision. 2 Dividing, fracture. 3 Separation or absence. 4 Loss, disappearance, destruction. 5 Cæsura, pause, in a verse. 6 The boundary or limits of a house, &c. 7 A property of the Nāyikā or mistress, carelessness or irregularity in dress and decoration through flurry and agitation. 7 Colouring the body with coloured unguents. E. वि before छिद to cut, aff. क्तिन्.
34908: विच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्नी-न्नं) 1 Cut, separated, severed. 2 Absent or separated from. 2 Divided, parted, portioned. 4 Shared, divided equally. 5 Crooked, curved. 6 Scattered, dispersed. 7 Hidden or cut off from view, intercepted. E. वि apart, छिद to cut, aff. क्त.
34909: विच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 Separation, disjunction, removal. 2 Prohibition, prevention. 3 Dividing, cutting. 4 The division of a book, a section, a chapter. 5 Space, interval. 6 Dissension, difference. E. वि before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.
34910: विच्छेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What separates, divides, cuts, &c. m. (-कः) A sector, a cutter. E. वि before छिद to cut, ण्वुल् aff.
34911: विच्छेदन n. (-नं) Separating, severing, dividing. E. वि before छिद to cut, ल्युट् aff.
34912: विच्छेदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divisible, to be divided or separated. E. वि before छिद to cut, aff. अनीयर्.
34913: विज(औ इर)औ विजिर r. 3rd cl. (विवेक्ति) 1 To be distinct or separate, to differ. 2 To separate or divide, especially by reason; to judge, to distinguish, to discriminate. (ओ, ई,) ओविजी r. 6th cl. (विजते, or usually with उद् prefixed उद्विजते) also r. 7th cl. (विनक्ति) 1 To fear, to be afraid. 2 To tremble with fear. 3 To shake or tremble. 4 To be agitated or distressed.
34914: विजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Private, lonely, solitary. E. वि privative, and जन man, people.
34915: विजनन n. (-नं) Birth, bearing, delivery. E. वि before जन to be born, aff. ल्युट्.
34916: विजनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Born, begotten. E. वि before जन to be born, aff. क्त.
34917: विजन्मन् n. (-न्म) Birth, separate or several birth. m. (-न्मा) A man born from a degraded Vaiśya. E. वि, and जन्मन् birth.
34919: विजय m. (-यः) 1 Victory, triumph, conquest. 2 A name of ARJUNA. 3 A divine car or chariot of the gods. 4 The father of the twenty-first Jina. 5 One of the persons named ŚUKLA BĀLAS by the Jainas. 6 The god of Hades, YAMA. f. (-या) The goddess DURGĀ. 2 One of the female friends or attendants of  DURGĀ. 3 One of the wives of YAMA. 4 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa,) or the tops of the plant used as a narcotic. 5 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 6 Orris root. 7 A peculiar lunar day; the third, eighth, or thirteenth of a fortnight; it is also applied to the tenth of the light half of the month Āśvina (Sept-Oct.), on which the image of DURGĀ, set up during the great festival in honour of her, is cast into the water. E. वि before जि to conquer, aff. अच्.
34920: विजयकुञ्जर m. (-रः) A royal or war elephant. E. विजय victory, and कुञ्जर an elephant.
34921: विजयछन्द m. (-न्दः) A kind of necklace, one of 504 rows or strings. E. विजय triumph, &c., and छन्द covering, from छदि, aff. अच्.
34922: विजयनन्दन m. (-नः) A sovereign of the race of IKṢVĀKU. E. विजय victory or a proper name, and नन्दन the son.
34923: विजयमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A large military drum. E. विजय victory, and मर्द्दल a drum.
34924: विजयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Victorious, triumphant. E. वि before जि to conquer, शानच् aff.
34925: विजयसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Success, victory. E. विजय, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
34926: विजयासप्तमी f. (-मी) The seventh day of the light half of a month falling on a Sunday. E. विजया victory, सप्तमी the seventh.
34927: विजयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Victorious, triumphant, conquering, a conqueror. E. विजय, and इनि aff.
34928: विजयिन n. (-नं) Sauce mixed with the water of boiled rice; also विजिन, &c.
34930: विजल n. (-लं) Sauce, &c. mixed with rice water or gruel. E. विज to shake, aff. कलच्; also विजिल, विज्जन, &c.
34931: विजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born severally. 2 Base born, of mixed origin. f. (-ता) The mother of children, a matron. E. वि severally, जात born, (from whom.)
34932: विजाति f. (-तिः) A different species or tribe. E. वि, and जाति sort.
34933: विजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Of a different caste. 2 Of mixed origin. 3 Dissimilar, of a different sort or nature. E. वि, जाती caste, छ aff.
34934: विजानत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) 1 Possessing various or extended knowledge. 2 Knowing, understanding. E. वि, and ज्ञा to know, शतृ aff.
34935: विजिगीष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Desirous of victory, emulative, anxious to overcome or conquer, &c. E. वि before जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, aff. अच्.
34936: विजिगीषा f. (-षा) Competition, emulation, wish to surpass, overcome, or subdue. E. जि to conquer, with वि prefixed, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
34937: विजिगीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to conquer or overcome. m. (-षुः) 1 A warrior. 2 An invader, an antagonist. 3 A disputant. 4 An opponent in general, &c. E. वि before जि to conquer, desiderative form, उ aff.
34938: विजिग्राहयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to excite to war. E. वि before ग्रह to take, desid. of the causal v., उ aff.
34939: विजिघृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Determined or wishing to encounter, oppose, fight with, overcome, &c. E. वि before ग्रह to take, desid. v., उ aff.
34940: विजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, defeated. E. वि before जित conquered.
34941: विजितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Victorious, conquering. E. वि before जि to conquer, क्तवतु aff.
34942: विजितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be apprehended or feared. E. विज to fear, तव्य aff.
34943: विजितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued. E. विजित, and आत्मन् self.
34944: विजितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what separates, divides, &c. m. (-ता) 1 A judge, a discriminator, a distinguisher. 2 A partner or co-heir. E. विज to separate, &c., aff. तृच्, and इट् augment.
34945: विजितेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of subdued organs or passions. E. विजित, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
34946: विजित्य ind. Having conquered. E. वि before जि to conquer, ल्यप् aff.
34947: विजिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice gruel, &c. (sauce or condiments.) E. विज to shake, aff. इनन्.
34948: विजिविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice water, or gruel, (sauce or condiments, &c.) E. विज to shake, aff. इलच्.
34949: विजिविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice water, (sauces, &c.)
34950: विजिहीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Wish or intention to take pleasure or sport. E. वि before हृ to take, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
34951: विजिहीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Wishing, or seeking for sport or amusement. E. वि before हृ to take, desid. v., उ aff.
34952: विजिह्म mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं) 1 Curved, bent. 2 Crooked in mind or purpose, dishonest, depraved. E. वि privative, and जिह्म straight.
