34953: विजिह्मता f. (-ता) 1 Crookedness. 2 Craftiness. E. विजिह्म, and तल् aff.
34954: विजृम्भण n. (-णं) 1 Pastime, sport, especially amorous. 2 Budding, blossoming, expanding. 3 Yawning. E. वि before जृभि to yawn, aff. ल्युट्.
34955: विजृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blossomed, expanded, opened, unfolded. 2 Yawning, gaping. 3 Sported, wantoned. n. (-तं) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Pastime, sport. E. वि before जृभि to yawn or open, and क्त aff.
34956: विजेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Victorious, a victor. E. वि before जि to conquer, तृच् aff.
34957: विज्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice-water or gruel, (sauce, gravy, &c.:) see विजिल; it also occurs विज्जिल.
34958: विज्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice-water, &c.: see विजिल. n. (-लं) An arrow.
34959: विज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Skilful, able, clever, conversant. 2 Wise, learned. E. वि implying separation, discrimination, and ज्ञ who knows.
34960: विज्ञता f. (-ता) Wisdom, learning. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, विज्ञत्वं.
34961: विज्ञप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Stated, reported, represented. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.
34962: विज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Information, representation, respectful communication of information, or opinion on any subject. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. क्तिन्.
34964: विज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Celebrated, famous, known, notorious. 2 Known, understood. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, aff. क्त.
34965: विज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 Knowledge, science, learning, worldly knowledge or wisdom, that which comprehends any subject, except an understanding of the true nature of GOD or BRAHMA, acquirable by abstract meditation, and the study of the Vedas; it also is described as conversancy with the arts of painting, &c., and with books, as the Smṛti Śāstras, or works on law, and other branches of science or literature. 2 Business, employment. 3 Music. E. वि implying variety, and ज्ञान knowledge.
34967: विज्ञानमातृक n. (-कः) A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion. E. विज्ञान knowledge, and मातृक parent.
34968: विज्ञानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Clever, skilful, conversant; also वैज्ञानिक. E. विज्ञान, and ठक् aff.
34969: विज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what makes known. m. (-कः) 1 An informant. 2 An instructor. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
34970: विज्ञापन n. (-नं) 1 Teaching, instruction, communication of knowledge not religious, &c. 2 Representing, informing. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
34971: विज्ञापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be made known, represented, taught, &c. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
34972: विज्ञापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Apprised, informed. 2 Instructed. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.
34973: विज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Cognizable, comprehensible, what is to be or may be known or understood. E. वि implying discrimination, ज्ञा to know, यत् participial aff.
34974: विज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Exempt from decay. 2 Free from fever. E. वि, and ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.
34975: विझर्झर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Harsh, disagreeable, (as sound.) E. वि before झर्झर clanging.
34976: विञ्जमर n. (-रं) The white of the eye.
34977: विञ्जोली f. (-ली) A line, a row, a range.
34978: विट r. 1st cl. (वेटति) 1 To sound. 2 To curse. (इ) विटि r. 10th cl. (विण्टयति) To decay.
34979: विट m. (-टः) 1 A catamite, a pathic. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 An attendant on a dissolute character or courtezan. 4 A paramour, a gallant. 5 A mountain. 6 The Khayar tree, (Mimosa catechu.) 7 A medicinal salt: see विडल्वण. 8 A rat. 9 The orange tree. 10 A branch and its shoot. E. विट to sound, aff. क.
34980: विटङ्क mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं) A dove-cot, an aviary. E. वि variously, टकि to bind, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added विटङ्कक.
34981: विटप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 The branch of a tree with its new sprout or shoot. 2 A new shoot. 3 A branch. 4 Expansion, spreading. 5 A clump, a cluster. 6 The perinæum or septum of the scrotum. m. (-पः) The keeper of pathics. E. विट a branch, &c., and पा to cherish, aff. क, or विट to sound, Uṇādi aff. अप, with the radical vowel unchanged.
34982: विटपिन् m. (-पी) 1 A tree. 2 The large Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) E. विटप a branch or shoot, and इनि aff.
34983: विटमाक्षिक m. (-कः) A mineral: see माक्षिक.
34984: विटलवण n. (-णं) A medicinal salt: see विट.
34986: विट्कारिका f. (-का) A kind of bird, (probably a variety of the Turdus Salica of Buchannan.) E. विट् from विष् fæces, and कारिका working.
34987: विट्खदिर m. (-रः) A fetid Mimosa. E. विट् fæces, and खदिर Mimosa catechu.
34988: विट्चर m, (-रः) The tame or village hog. E. विट् filth, ordure, and चर who goes.
34989: विट्पण्य n. (-ण्यं) Goods, merchandise. E. विट् a Vaiśya, and पण्य wares.
34990: विट्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A son-in-law, a daughter's husband. 2 A head merchant. E. विश् a Vaiśya, &c., and पति master.
34991: विट्लवण n. (-णं) A fetid salt: see विड. E. विट् ordure, लवण salt.
34992: विट्सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Constipation. E. विट्, and सङ्ग aggregate.
34993: विट्सारिका f. (-का) A bird, a sort of thrush; a variety of the bird, usually though inaccurately called Maina in Bengal. E. विट् fæces, and सारिका the same bird, or another species of the same.
34995: विड r. 6th cl. (वेडति) 1 To divide, to break. 2 To curse.
34996: विड् f. (विड्) A bit, a fragment. E. विड to break, क्विप् aff.
34997: विड n. (-डं) 1 Factitious salt, or salt procured by boiling soil found near the sea shore, or any earth impregnated with saline particles. 2 A particular fetid kind of salt, used as a tonic aperient, commonly called black salt or Vitlavan, or Bitnoben, prepared by fusing fossile salt with a small portion of Emblic myrobalans; the produce is muriate of soda with small quantities of muriate of lime, sulphur, and oxid of iron. 3 A part, a fracture, a bit. E. विड to divide, aff. क.
34998: विडगन्ध n. (-न्धं) The medicinal salt called Vitlavan: see the last. E. विड salt, गन्ध smell.
34999: विडङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Clever, able, skilful, conversant. mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गं) A vegetable and medicinal substance, considered of great efficacy as a vermifuge. E. विड to break, to curse, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्.
35000: विडम्बन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Afflicting, distressing. 2 Vexation, mortification. 3 Frustrating, rendering vain. 4 Imitation, copying, especially assuming a similar appearance or dress, disguise, masquerade. 5 The supernatural assumption of a borrowed form, transformation. E. वि before डवि to heap, aff. युच्.
35001: विडम्बनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be distressed or annoyed. 2 To be assumed as a disguise. E. वि before डवि to heap, अनीयर् aff.
35002: विडम्बयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Assuming, putting on, (as a borrowed dress or appearance.) 2 Imitating. E. वि before डवि to heap, aff. शतृ.
35003: विडम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Low, poor, abject, distressed. 2 Vexed, mortified. 3 Assumed, put on, (as a borrowed form, &c.,) simulated, transformed. E. वि before डवि to heap, aff. क्त.
35004: विडारक m. (-कः) A cat. E. see the next, the ल being changed to र.
35005: विडाल m. (-लः) 1 A cat. 2 The eye-ball. E. विड to divide, to tear, (rats,) Uṇādi aff. कालक; also with कन् added, विडालक, and ल being changed to र, विडारक.
35006: विडालक n. (-कं) 1 Yellow orpiment. m. (-कः) 1 Application of ointment to the external part of the eye, especially to the eye-lids, of which the lashes have fallen off or been ulcerated. 2 A cat. E. कन् added to the last.
35007: विडालपद m. (-दः) A measure of weight, the same as the Karṣa or weight of sixteen Māṣas. E. विडाल a cat, पद the foot.
35008: विडीन n. (-नं) One of the different modes of flight attributed to birds, imitative flight. E. वि severally, and डीन flying.
35009: विडुल m. (-लः) A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.)
35011: विडोजस् m. (-जाः) A name of INDRA. E. विड् a fragment; (splitting mountains, &c. with his thunderbolt,) or विट् from विश् a Vaiśya, (here meaning a subject or man in general,) and ओजस् strength, splendour; also विडौजस्.
35012: विड्ग्रह m. (-हः) Constipation. E. विट्, and ग्रह taking.
35013: विड्ज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced from ordure. n. (-जं) A fungus. E. विट्, and ज born.
35014: विड्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from ordure. E. विट्, and भव born.
35015: विड्भुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Feeding on ordure. E. विष्, and भुज् who eats.
35016: विड्लवण n. (-णं) A medicinal salt, commonly black salt, Vitlavan or Bitnoben: see विड. E. विड to divide, aff. क्विप्, and लवण salt; also विट्लवण.
35017: विड्वराह m. (-हः) A village or tame hog. E. विट् fæces, ordure, and वराह a hog.
35018: वितंस m. (-सः) A cage, a net, a chain or any apparatus for confining beasts or birds. E. वि before तसि to adorn, aff. घञ्; also वीतंस.
35019: वितण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A sort of lock or bolt with three divisions or wards. 2 An elephant. f. (-ण्डा) 1 Controversy, argument, the subversion of another's opinion or interpretation, and establishment of one's own. 2 Criticism. 3 An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) 4 Benzoin or styrax (?) 5 The Oleander plant, (Nerium odorum.) 6 A ladle, a spoon. E. वि before तडि to beat, aff. अच् and टाप्.
35020: वितत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stretched, spread, expanded. 2 Pervaded, diffused. 3 Lengthened. n. (-तं) Any stringed instrument. E. वि before तत stretched.
35021: वितति f. (-तिः) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 Quantity, collection. 3 A clump, a cluster, (of trees, &c.) E. वि before तन to stretch, and क्तिन् aff.
35022: विततीकरण n. (-णं) Spreading, stretching. E. वितत, and करण making, च्चि augment.
35023: विततीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stretched, spread, expanded. E. वितत the same, कृत made, and च्चि augment, leaving ई.
35024: वितत्य ind. Having spread. E. वि before तन to spread, ल्यप् aff.
35025: वितथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) False, untrue. E. वि implying reverse, तथ्य true, अच् aff., and the semivowel rejected; or वि before तम to desire, क्थन् aff., and म rejected.
35026: वितद्रु f. (-द्रुः) The name of a river, said to be situated in the Punjab. E. वि before तम to desire, aff. रु, and दङ् augment.
35027: वितनु mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु) Thin, graceful, delicate. E. वि, and तनु the same.
35028: वितन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A good horse. f. (-न्तुः) A widow.
35029: वितन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वती-न्वत्) Spreading, stretching, expanding. E. वि before तन to stretch, शतृ aff.
35030: वितरण n. (-णं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 2 Passing, crossing. E. वि implying privation, &c., and तॄ to cross, ल्युट् aff.
35031: वितमस् mfn. (-माः-माः-मः) 1 Light, free from darkness. 2 Exempt from the quality of ignorance. E. वि priv. तमस् darkness.
35032: वितर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 Reasoning, discussion. 2 Doubt, deliberation. 3 A teacher, an instructor in divine knowledge. 4 Consideration of probabilities, mental anticipation of alternatives, conjecture. E. वि implying discrimination, &c., तर्क to reason or doubt, aff. अच्.
35033: वितर्कण n. (-णं) 1 Reasoning, discussion, whether mental or controversial, argument, reflection. 2 Apprehension, doubt. E. वि before तर्क to reason, aff. ल्युट्.
35034: वितर्क्य ind. Having deliberated, considered, &c. mfn. (-र्क्यः-र्क्या-र्क्यं) Doubtful, questionable. E. वि before तर्क to reason, ल्यप् or यत् aff.
35035: वितर्द्धि f. (-र्द्धिः-र्द्धी) 1 A quadrangular building, or sort of covered terrace of wood in the centre of the court-yard of a temple or palace. 2 A quadrangular resting place made of wood, a seat, a bench. 3 A place in a court-yard for sitting in or standing under. 4 A floor on four posts in the midst of a quadrangular house. 5 A temporary stage or shed in the middle of a court-yard, for performing sacrifices, representing plays, &c. 6 A terrace furnished with pillars, a verandah, a balcony. 7 A covered temporary terrace on which idols are sometimes placed and worshipped. E. वि privative, तर्द to injure, aff. इन्; also ङीष् optionally added, and with कन् added in the fem. form वितर्द्धिका.
35036: वितल n. (-लं) One of the seven divisions of Pātāla, the second in descent below the earth. E. वि before तल to be low or deep, aff. अच्.
35037: वितस्ति f. (-स्तिः) A long span measured by the extended thumb and little finger, considered equal to twelve fingers. E. वि apart, तस to throw, Uṇādi aff. ति.
35038: वितान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Empty, pithless, sapless. 2 Empty, vacant. 3 Dull, stupid. 4 Wicked, abandoned. mn. (-नः-नं) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 An awning, a canopy. 3 Sacrifice, offering, oblation. 4 The sacrificial hearth or hole in which the sacred fires are kept. 5 A heap, a quantity. n. (-नं) 1 A form of the metre Anuṣṭubh, or verse of four lines of eight syllables each; each line of the stanza named Vitāna consists of two Iambics, one Trochee, and one Spondee. 2 Leisure, rest, interval of occupation. E. वि before तन to spread, aff. घञ्.
35039: वितानक n. (-कं) 1 An awning, a canopy, especially a cloth spread over a large open hall or court, or any open space in which dancing, singing, &c. are exhibited, at solemn or  religious festivals. 2 A heap, a quantity. 3 An expanse. E. कन added to the preceding.
35040: वितानीकरण n. (-णं) Covering, overspreading, (as a canopy.) E. वितान, and करण making, च्चि augment.
35041: वितानीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spread or extended over, (as a canopy.) E. वितान, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
35042: वितायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being overspread, covered, shaded, &c. E. वि before तन to stretch, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35043: वितिष्ठमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Staying, being. 2 Fixed, stationary. 3 Permanent. E. वि before स्था to stay, शानच् aff.
35044: वितीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Crossed, overpassed. 2 Subdued, overcome. 3 Effaced, rubbed out. 4 Conferred, bestowed. 5 Afforded, yielded. E. वि before तॄ to cross, क्त aff.
35045: वितुन्न n. (-न्नं) 1 A potherb, (Marsilia quadrifolia.) 2 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. वि privative, तुन्न pained, tortured; allaying pain.
35046: वितुन्नक m. (-कः) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) n. (-कं) 1 Coriander seed. 2 Blue vitriol. E. कन् added to the last.
35047: वितुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Displeased, dissatisfied. E. वि priv., तुष्ट pleased.
35048: वितृष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Content, satisfied, free from desire. E. वि priv., तृष्णा thirst.
35049: वितृष्णता f. (-ता) 1 Satiety, satisfaction. 2 Content. E. वि priv., तृष्णता cupidity.
35050: वित्त r. 10th cl. (वित्तयति) To quit, to abandon, especially by giving away, to give alms.
35051: वित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Judged, investigated, examined, discussed. 2 Known, notorious, famous. 3 Gained, acquired. n. (-त्तं) Wealth, property, thing, substance. E. विद to know, to discuss, to acquire, aff. क्त, form irr.
35052: वित्तद m. (-दः) A benefactor, one who gives away property. E. वित्त wealth, and द who gives.
35053: वित्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Rich, wealthy. E. वित्त, and मतुप् aff.
35054: वित्तहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, indigent. E. वित्त, and हीन void of.
35055: वित्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Discussion, discrimination, judgment, investigation. 2 Knowledge. 3 Gain, acquisition. 4 Probability, likelihood. E. विद to know, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
35056: वित्तेहा f. (-हा) Cupidity, avarice. E. वित्त, and ईहा wish.
35057: वित्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ती-स्तं) Frightened, alarmed, afraid. E. वि before त्रस to fear, aff. क्त.
35058: वित्रास m. (-सः) Fear, alarm. E. वि before त्रास fear.
35060: विथ(ऋ)विथृ r. 1st cl. (वेथते) To ask or beg.
35061: विथुर m. (-रः) 1 A thief. 2 An imp, a demon. E. व्यथ to fear, Uṇādi aff. उरन्, the semivowel changed to इ, and that unaltered.
35062: विथ्या f. (-थ्या) A plant, commonly Gojihwa.
35063: विद r. 2nd cl. (वेत्ति वेदि) To know. With नि prefixed, To be sad or depressed. With सम्, (संवित्ते) To meditate, to know, to gain holy knowledge by abstract meditation. r. 4th cl. (विद्यते) To be, to exist, to be present, to exist actually. r. 7th cl. (विन्ते) To consider, to reason. r. 10th cl. (वेदयते) 1 To be sensible. 2 To know. 3 To declare, to describe or explain; (in this sense नि is usually prefixed.) 4 To dwell, to inhabit. 5 To be fixed or steady. 6 To suffer pain. With नि, or वि and नि prefixed, To deliver, to impart or communicate. With प्रति, To deliver, to give. (औ ऌ) औ विटॢ r. 6th cl. (विन्दति-ते) To gain, to get, to acquire or possess. With परि, To marry first.
35064: विद् mfn. (वित्) Who or what knows. E. विद् to know, क्विप् aff.
35065: विदग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Clever, shrewd, knowing. 2 Sharp, witty. 3 Intriguing. 4 Undigested. 5 Burnt. m. (-ग्धः) 1 A libertine, a lecher, an intriguer. 2 A learned or clever man, a scholar, a Paṇḍita. f. (-ग्धा) A sharp knowing woman. E. वि before दह to burn, aff. क्त.
35066: विदग्धता f. (-ता) Sharpness, shrewdness, cleverness, wit. E. तल् aff. of the abstract, added to the last; also with त्व aff. विदग्धत्वं.
35067: विदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Wise, intelligent, learned, knowing. E. विद to know, aff. शतृ.
35068: विदथ m. (-थः) 1 A wise or learned man, a sage, a scholar. 2 A saint, a devotee. E. विद to know, Uṇādi aff. अथ, and the radical vowel unchanged.
35069: विदधत् mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्) Having, wearing, assuming. E. वि before धा to have, शतृ aff.
35070: विदर m. (-रं) Tearing, rending. n. (-रं) The Indian prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus.) E. वि before दृ to tear, aff. अप्.
35071: विदर्भ mf. (-र्भः-र्भा) A district and city to the south-west of Bengal, the modern Bara-Nagpur or Berar proper. m. (-र्भः) Any dry or desart soil. E. वि privative, and दर्भ the sacred grass; not growing in that country in consequence of the curse of a saint, whose son had died of a wound from a blade of the grass.
35072: विदर्भजा f. (-जा) 1 The wife of the saint AGASTYA. 2 DAMAYANTĪ the wife of NALA, and heroine of the Naiṣadha or poem so called. 3 RUKMIṆĪ the wife of KṚṢṆA. E. विदर्भ the country, and ज born.
35073: विदल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Opened, expanded, blown, (as a flower, &c.) 2 Rent, split. n. (-लं) 1 A shallow basket made of split bambus, a vessel of wicker work. 2 Split peas. 3 Pomegranate bark. 4 The cuttings or chips of any substance, that which has been pared or split. m. (-लः) 1 Dividing, separating. 2 A cake. 3 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) E. वि before दल tearing, splitting.
35074: विदलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rent, torn, split. 2 Blown, expanded, (as a flower.) E. वि before दल to tear, क्त aff.
35075: विदलीकरण n. (-णं) Rending, dividing. E. विदल, and करण making, with च्चि augment.
35076: विदलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Divided, separated. 2 Cut, split, torn, broken. E. विदल dividing, कृत made, and च्चि augment.
35077: विदश्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being bitten. E. वि before दशि to bite, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35078: विदा f. (-दा) 1 Knowledge. 2 Intellect, understanding. E. विद to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.
35079: विदार m. (-रः) 1 Tearing, rending. 2 War, battle. 3 An inundation, an overflow, the rising of a river or pond above its banks. f. (-री) 1 A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 2 A climbing plant, (Ipomoea paniculata.) 3 Bubo, swelling in the groin, &c. E. वि before दृ to tear, to divide, aff. घञ्.
35080: विदारक m. (-कः) 1 A divider, a render or tearer. 2 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream, dividing its course. 3 A hole or pit for water sunk in the bed of a dry river, &c. f. (-रिका) 1 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 2 A bubo. E. वि before दृ to divide, aff. ण्वुल्.
35081: विदारण n. (-णं) 1 Tearing, breaking, splitting, severing, dividing. 2 Paining, afflicting. 3 Killing, slaughter. nf. (-णं-णा) War, battle. m. (-णः) A tree, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) E. वि before दृ to tear, aff. युच्.
35082: विदारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Tearing, rending, dividing. E. वि before दृ to tear, शतृ aff.
35083: विदारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Torn, rent, split, broken. E. वि before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.
35084: विदारीगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. विदारी a plant, and गन्ध smell.
35085: विदारु m. (-रुः) A lizard. E. वि before दृ to tear, उ aff.
35086: विदार्य्य ind. (-र्य्यः) Having torn or rent. E. वि, and दॄ to tear, ल्यप् aff.
35087: विदाह m. (-हः) 1 Heat, burning. 2 Pungency. E. वि before दह to burn, घञ् aff.
35088: विदाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Burning, hot. 2 Pungent, acrid. E. वि before दह to burn, aff. घिनुण्.
35089: विदिक्चङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of bird. E. विदिश् a point of the compass, and चङ्ग handsome.
35090: विदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Promised, agreed, assented. 3 Represented, submitted, solicited. 4 Apprised, informed, who or what knows. m. (-तः) A sage, a learned man. n. (-तं) Information, representation. E. विद to know, &c., aff. क्त.
35091: विदित्वा ind. 1 Having known. 2 Having promised. E. विद to know, क्ता aff.
35092: विदिश् f. (-दिक्) An intermediate point of the compass. E. वि implying separation, and दिश् a quarter.
35093: विदीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Torn, split, burst or broken. 2 Expanded, opened. E. वि before दृ to tear, aff. क्त, form irr.
35094: विदीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being torn, split, broken, cut, &c. E. वि before दॄ to rend, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35095: विदु m. (-दुः) 1 The hollow between the frontal globes of an elephant. 2 The hippopotamus. E. विद to know, (the goad,) aff. कु; also with कू aff. विदू.
35096: विदुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wise, knowing, intelligent. m. (-रः) 1 A libertine, an intriguer. 2 A learned or clever man. 3 The younger brother and counsellor of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. विद to know, कुरच् aff.
35097: विदुल m. (-लः) A sort of reed, (Calamus rotang;) also the same growing in water, (C. fasciculatus.) 2 Gum myrrh. E. विद to know, &c., Uṇādi aff. उलच्.
35098: विदून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Agitated, distressed. E. वि, and दु to distress, क्त aff.
35099: विदूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very far or remote. E. वि intervening, and दूर distant.
35100: विदूरग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Spreading, going far or wide. E. वि before दूर far, remote, and ग what goes.
35102: विदूराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The name of a mountain. E. विदूर remote, and अद्रि a mountain.
35103: विदूषक mfn. (-कः-षिका-कं) 1 Facetious, witty, a wag, a jester. 2 Censorious, detracting, a detractor or abuser of other people. m. (-कः) 1 An actor, especially an interlocutor with the audience between the acts or scenes, a jester, a buffoon. 2 (In dramatic language,) The humble and jocose companion of the principal character. 3 A catamite. E. वि before दूष to be or make bad, aff. क्कुन्.
35104: विदूषण n. (-णं) Censuring, reviling, abuse, satire. E. वि before दूष to make bad or faulty, aff. ल्युट्.
35105: विदेश m. (-शः) 1 A foreign country, abroad. 2 Any place away from home. E. वि variety, देश place or country.
35106: विदेशगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone abroad. E. विदेश, and गत gone.
35107: विदेशगमन n. (-नं) Travelling, going abroad. E. विदेश, and गमन going.
35108: विदेशज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Foreign, exotic. E. विदेश, and ज born.
35109: विदेशस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Who or what remains abroad. E. विदेश, and स्थ what stays.
35110: विदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Foreign, foreigner, exotic. E. विदेश, and इनि aff.
35111: विदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Incorporeal, without body. m. (-हः) A sovereign of the family of JANAKA, king of Mithilā. f. (-हा) A district in the province of Behar, the same as the ancient Mithilā, or the modern Tirhut. E. वि privative, and देह the body.
35112: विद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pierced, perforated. 2 Thrown, cast, directed, sent. 3 Like, resembling. 4 Opposed, impeded. 5 Beaten, whipped. m. (-द्धः) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. विध to pierce, or व्यध to beat, aff. क्त.
35113: विद्धकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears pierced or slit. mf. (-र्णः-र्णा or -र्णी) A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra, Rox.) E. विद्ध pierced, and कर्ण the ear; also in the latter sense, with कन् added विद्धकर्णिका; also अविद्धकर्ण, &c.
35114: विद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being, being present or in existence. 2 Actual, real, in possession, (as property.) E. विद to be, 4th cl. and शानच् aff.
35115: विद्या f. (-द्या) Knowledge, learning, science, whether sacred or profane, though more especially the former: it is sometimes classed into fourteen divisions; or the four Vedas; the six Aṅgas, or grammar, astronomy, &c.; the Purāṇas as the eleventh class; and the Mīmāṃsā or theology, Nyāya or logic, and Dharma or law, as the remaining three. 2 The goddess DURGĀ. 3 A tree, (Premna spinosa.) 4 A magical pill or bolus, by putting which into the mouth a person has the power of ascending to heaven. E. विद to know, and aff. क्यप्.
35116: विद्याकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Giving wisdom or science. m. (-रः) A learned man. E. विद्या, and कर what makes, or आकर a mine: see विद्याघर.
35117: विद्यागम m. (-मः) Acquirement of knowledge. E. विद्या, and आगम coming.
35118: विद्याचण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Famous for learning or knowledge. E. विद्या knowledge, and चणप् aff. in this particular meaning.
35119: विद्याचुञ्चु mfn. (-ञ्चुः-ञ्चुः-ञ्चु) Famous for knowledge. E. विद्या knowledge, and चुञ्चुप् aff. implying celebrity.
35120: विद्यादल m. (-लः) The Bhojpatra tree. E. विद्या, and दल a leaf: being used for writing on.
35121: विद्यादान n. (-नं) Giving knowledge or science. E. विद्या, and दान giving.
35122: विद्यादेवी f. (-वी) A female divinity, one of a class of sixteen, peculiar apparently to the mythological system of the Jainas. E. विद्या science, and देवी a goddess; a goddess of learning or science, a muse.
35123: विद्याधन n. (-नं) Property acquired by science, as by instruction, &c. E. विद्या knowledge, and धन wealth.
35124: विद्याधर m. (-रः) A demigod of a particular order or class, a spirit of the air. E. विद्या a magical pill, as above, and धर who has or holds.
35125: विद्यानुपालन n. (-नं) 1 Patronising learning. 2 Studying, acquiring learning. E. विद्या, and अनुपालन encouraging.
35126: विद्यानुपालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Studied, acquiring or having acquired learning. E. विद्या, and अनुपालिन् who prosecutes.
35127: विद्यानुसेवन n. (-नं) Cultivating science or learning. E. विद्या, and अनुसेवन pursuing.
35128: विद्यानुसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Cultivating learning, engaged in study. E. विद्या, and अनुसेविन् addicted to.
35129: विद्याप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Acquirement of knowledge. 2 Acquisition made by or through learning. E. विद्या, and प्राप्ति gain.
35130: विद्याभ्यास m. (-सः) Study, diligent application. E. विद्या, and अभ्यास exercise.
35131: विद्यार्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Acquiring knowledge. 2 Acquiring any thing by knowledge, as by teaching, &c. E. विद्या, and अर्ज्जन gaining.
35132: विद्यार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained by or through knowledge. E. विद्या, and अर्ज्जित obtained.
35133: विद्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) Seeking for knowledge. E. विद्या, and अर्थ object.
35134: विद्यार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for knowledge. m. (-र्थी) A pupil, a student. E. विद्यार्थ, and इनि aff.
35135: विद्यालब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Gained by or through learning. E. विद्या, and लब्ध gained.
35136: विद्यालय m. (-यः) A school, a college. E. विद्या, and आलय a house.
35137: विद्यालाभ m. (-भः) 1 Acquisition of learning. 2 Acquirement by or through learning. E. विद्या, and लाभ gain.
35138: विद्यावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Learned, possessed of learning or science. E. विद्या learning, and मतुप् poss. aff.
35139: विद्याविशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Possessed of learning or science. E. विद्या, and विशिष्ट endowed with.
35140: विद्याविहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, uninstructed. E. विद्या, and विहीन deprived of.
35141: विद्याव्रतस्नातक m. (-कः) The Brahman who has finished his studies and period of studentship. E. विद्या, and व्रत a religious obligation, स्नातक a householder.
35142: विद्यास्नातक m. (-कः) The student who has finished his religious studies. E. विद्या, and स्नातक a householder.
35143: विद्याहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, uninstructed. E. विद्या, and हीन void of.
35144: विद्युत् f. (-द्युत्) Lightning. E. वि intensitive or privative, and द्युत light, lustre.
35145: विद्युत्वत् mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्) Having or containing lightning, electrical, (a cloud, &c.) E. विद्युत् lightning, and मतुप् aff.
35146: विद्युत्प्रिय n. (-यं) Bell-metal. E. विद्युत् lightning, and प्रिय beloved.
35147: विद्युल्लता f. (-ता) Zigzag lightning. E. विद्युत्, and लता a creeper.
35148: विद्योतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining, blazing, flashing. E. वि before द्युत to shine, शानच् aff.
35149: विद्योपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of knowledge. E. विद्या, and उपार्ज्जन collecting.
35150: विद्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by or through learning, &c. E. विद्या, and उपार्ज्जित obtained.
35151: विद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 A hole, a chasm. 2 Piercing, perforating. E. विघ to pierce, aff. रक्, form irr., or वि before द्रा to sleep, aff. क.
35152: विद्रधि m. (-धिः) Phlegmonoid inflammation; especially deep seated, or internal abscess. E. विद्र piercing, धा to have, कि aff.
35153: विद्रधिनाशन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera Morunga.) E. विद्रधि a bile or abscess, नाशन destroying, discussing.
35154: विद्रव m. (-बः) 1 Flight, escape, retreat. 2 Fear, agitation, panic. 3 Intellect, understanding. 4 Censure, abuse, reproach. 5 Liquefaction. 6 Flowing out, oozing. E. वि before द्रु to fly, aff. अप्.
35155: विद्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flight, retreat, running away. 2 Liquefaction. E. वि before द्रु to go, causal v., aff. घञ्.
35156: विद्रावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Liquefying, causing to flow or melt. 2 Driving away. E. वि before द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
35157: विद्रावण n. (-णं) 1 Causing to flow or melt, fusing, liquefying. 2 Driving away, chasing, defeating. E. वि before द्रु to run, &c. causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35158: विद्रावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Liquefied, fused. 2 Driven away, put to flight. E. वि before द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., क्त aff.
35159: विद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Liquid, liquefied, fluid, as an oily or metallic substance upon being heated. 2 Flown, fled. 3 Running, going fast. 4 Agitated, alarmed. E. वि before द्रु to ooze, &c., aff. क्त.
35160: विद्रुम m. (-मः) 1 Coral. 2 A tree bearing precious gems. 3 A young sprout or shoot. E. वि implying species, and द्रुम a tree.
35161: विद्रुमलता f. (-ता) A sort of vegetable perfume. E. विद्रुम coral, and लता a creeper.
35162: विद्वत्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Less learned, a little learned. E. विद्वत् learned, and कल्प aff. of diminution or inferiority; also with the similar affs. देशीयर् and देश्य, विद्वद्देशीय and विद्वद्देश्य.
35163: विद्वस् mfn. (-द्वान्-दुषी-द्वत्) 1 Intelligent, wise. 2 Learned. m. (-द्वान्) A sage, a seer, one who knows the true nature of the soul and of GOD. E. विद to know, वसु aff. in lieu of शतृ, the usual affix of the present participle.
35164: विद्विष् mfn. (-द्विट्) An enemy. E. वि before द्विष to hate, क्विप् aff.
35165: विद्विष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Hating, adverse, inimical. m. (-षः) An enemy. E. वि before द्विष to hate, aff. क.
35166: विद्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Hated, disliked. E. वि before द्विष to hate, क्त aff.
35167: विद्वेष m. (-षः) Enmity, hatred. E. वि before द्विष to hate, aff. घञ्.
35168: विद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Inimical, hostile, hating. m. (-षी) An enemy. E. विद्वेष enmity, इनि aff.
35169: विद्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what hates, adverse, inimical. E. वि before द्विष to hate, तृच् aff.
35170: विध r. 6th cl. (विधते) 1 To administer, to govern, to rule or command. 2 To pierce, to perforate.
35171: विध mf. (-धः-धा) 1 Form, formula, rule. 2 Manner, kind, sort. 3 Fodder, the food of horses, elephants, &c. 4 Prosperity, thriving. 5 Hire, wages. 6 Act, action. 7 Piercing. E. वि before धा to have, aff. क, or अङ्, and fem. aff. टाप्; or विध to rule, &c., aff. क; the masculine form, though it does occur, is not common, except in composition, when the word is used attributively, as द्विविध of two sorts. mfn. (-धः-धा-धं), &c.
35172: विधवन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling. E. वि before धू to shake, aff. ल्युट्.
35173: विधवा f. (-वा) A widow. E. वि privative, धव a husband.
35174: विधवागामिन् m. (-मी) One who has intercourse with a widow. E. विधवा, and गामिन् who approaches, (carnally.)
35175: विधवावेदन n. (-नं) Marrying a widow. E. विधवा, and आवेदन marrying.
35176: विधव्य n. (-व्यं) Trembling, tremor. E. वि before धू to shake, aff. यत्.
35177: विधस् m. (-धाः) BRAHMĀ. E. वि severally or every kind, धा to have, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and the radical vowel dropped.
35178: विधातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be done or performed. 2 To be done according to rule, to be observed as a rite or ceremony. 3 To be ruled or regulated. E. वि before धा to have, तव्य aff.
35179: विधातृ m. (-ता) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 Love or KĀMA. 3 Fate. E. वि severally, धा to have or contain, (all things,) aff. तृच्.
35180: विधातृभू m. (-भूः) NĀRADA, the Muni and son of BRAHMĀ. E. विधातृ BRAHMĀ, and भू offspring.
35182: विधात्री f. (-त्री) Long-pepper. E. वि before धा to have, तृच् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
35183: विधान n. (-नं) 1 Act, action, general or particular, though more especially the performance of such acts or rites as are prescribed in the sacred books of the Hindus. 2 Rule, precept, ordinance, injunction. 3 An elephant's fodder. 4 Form, mode, manner. 5 Sending, ordering. 6 Means, expedient. 7 Wealth. 8 Worship. 9 Active enmity or act of hostility. 10 Gaining, getting, taking. 11 Conflict or contrast of opposite feelings. 12 (In grammar,) Affixing, prefixing, taking as an affix, &c. E. वि before धा to have, शानच् aff.
35184: विधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having, possessing, assuming, wearing. E. वि before धा to have, शानच् aff.
35185: विधानक n. (-कं) Pain. E. वि before धा to have, ल्युट् aff., and कन् added.
35186: विधानग m. (-गः) A Paṇḍita, a wise or learned man or teacher. E. विधान action, the performance of those acts prescribed by the Śāstras, and ग who goes or performs.
35187: विधानज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A Paṇḍita, &c.: see the last. E. विधान, and ज्ञ who knows.
35188: विधाय ind. Having taken, assumed, put on, placed, &c. E. वि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
35189: विधायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Consigning, delivering, one who entrusts or deposits any thing, or causes it to be fixed or secure. E. वि before धा to have, (causal form,) aff. ण्वुल्.
35190: विधायकत्व n. (-त्वं) Consignment or delivery of any thing, making any thing firm or secure. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, विधायकता.
35191: विधायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Causing, occasioning, making. 2 Placing, fixing, securing. 3 Delivering, entrusting. 4 Establishing as a rule or law. E. वि before धा to have or hold, causal form, aff. धिनुण्.
35192: विधाव्य n. (-व्यं) Shaking, agitation. E. वि before घू to shake, ण्यत् aff.
35193: विधास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यती-स्यत्) 1 Purposing or willing to do, make, cause, &c. 2 Intending to direct, enjoin, prescribe, &c. E. वि before धा to have, शतृ aff. in the future tense.
35194: विधि m. (-धिः) 1 A sacred precept, an act or rite prescribed by the Vedas for effecting certain consequences. 2 Rule, form, formula. 3 Fate, luck, destiny. 4 BRAHMĀ. 5 Time. 6 Order, injunction, command. 7 A name of VIṢṆU. 8 Act, action, general or particular. 9 A text, a sentence in some authority of law or religion, prescribing any particular act or observance. 10 Kind, sort, manner. 11 Fodder, food for elephants or horses. 12 A sacred work, a Śāstra, scripture, the law, (by metonymy.) E. वि before धा to have, or विध to rule, aff. कि.
35195: विधिघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Who or what deviates from, disregards, or disturbs rules or modes of proceeding. E. विधि, and घ्न what destroys.
35196: विधिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Who or what knows the prescribed mode, form, &c. m. (-ज्ञः) A Brahman who knows the ritual. E. विधि, and ज्ञ who knows.
35197: विधितस् ind. According to rule. E. विधि, and तसि aff.
35198: विधित्सा f. (-त्सा) Wish to do or make, design, purpose, desire. E. वि before धा to have, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.
35199: विधित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to make, produce, &c. E. वि before धा to have, desid. v., उ aff.
35200: विधिदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) A priest whose business at a sacrifice is to see that every thing is done according to the prescribed rules, and to correct any deviation from them. E. विधि a sacred precept, and दर्शिन् who sees; also विधिदर्शक, &c.
35201: विधिदेशक m. (-कः) A priest who corrects errors at a sacrifice: see the last. E. विधि the proper form, and देशक who shews.
35202: विधिपूर्व्वक n. adv. (-कं) After or according to rule. E. विधि, and पर्व्वक prior.
35203: विधिप्रयोग m. (-गः) Acting upon or in conformity to a rule, &c. E. विधि, and प्रयोग application.
35204: विधिप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Application of or acting upon a rule. E. विधि, and प्रसङ्ग association.
35205: विधियज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A ceremonial act of worship. E. विधि precept, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
35206: विधियोग m. (-गः) 1 The occurrence of predoomed events. 2 Combination for any act or rite. E. विधि, and योग union, accession.
35207: विधिवत् ind. Agreeable to rule, conformably to established ordinances. E. विधि a precept, and वति aff.
35208: विधिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unauthorised, irregular. E. विधि, and हीन abandoned.
35209: विधीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being defined, enjoined, directed, &c. E. वि before धा to have, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35210: विधु m. (-धुः) 1 The moon. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 Camphor. 4 A name of BRAHMĀ. 5 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin. 6 An expiatory oblation. E. व्यध to pain or hurt, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the semivowel changed.
35211: विधुक्षय m. (-यः) The wane of the moon. E. विधु, and क्षय decay.
35212: विधुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned, relinquished. 2 Shaken, trembling. E. वि before धु to tremble, aff. क्त.
35213: विधुति f. (-तिः) Shaking, trembling. E. वि before धू to agitate, aff. क्तिन्.
35214: विधुनन m. (-नं) Tremour, trembling, shaking. E. वि before धू in the 10th cl. to shake, aff. ल्युट्, and the vowel short; also विधूनन.
35215: विधुन्तुद m. (-दः) RĀHU, the personified ascending node. E. विध the moon, तुद to torment, aff. खश् or क, and the nasal inserted, the cause of the moon's eclipse.
35216: विधुन्वत् mfn. (-न्वत्-न्वती-न्वत्) Shaking, tossing. E. वि before घु to agitate, शतृ aff.
35217: विधुपञ्जर m. (-रः) A scimitar, a sabre.
35218: विधुप्रिया f. (-या) A lunar mansion; in mythology, personified as a nymph, the daughter of DAKṢA, and wife of CANDRA or the moon. E. बिधु the moon, and प्रिया the beloved.
35219: विधुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Agitated, distressed, overcome with anxiety, distress, &c. 2 Bewildered, confused, (with fear, liquor, &c.) 3 Separate, absent from a mistress or lover. n. (-रं) 1 Separation. 2 Agitation of mind from terror or distress, &c. f. (-रा) Curds mixed up with sugar and spices. E. वि before धुर् a load, a burthen, aff. अप्.
35220: विधुवन n. (-नं) Trembling, tremor. E. वि before धू to agitate, ल्युट् aff., and उवङ augment.
35221: विधूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken. 2 Trembling, tremulous. 3 Unsteady. 4 Abandoned. 5 Tossed, waving. E. वि before धू to agitate, aff. क्त.
35222: विधूति f. (-तिः) Shaking, agitation, tremor. E. वि before घू to shake, aff. क्तिन्.
35223: विधूनन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling, tremor. E. वि before घू to agitate, aff. ल्युट्.
35224: विधूनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, (literally or figuratively,) agitated, alarmed. 2 Harassed, annoyed. E. वि before धू to shake, 10th cl. aff. क्त.
35225: विधूय ind. Having shaken, shaking, trembling. E. वि before धू to shake, ल्यप् aff.
35226: विधूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being shaken, shaking, waving, agitated. E. वि before धू to shake, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35227: विधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seized, held. 2 Withheld, restrained. 3 Having, possessing, assumed, taken. n. (-तं) 1 Disregard of an injunction or desire. 2 Dissatisfaction. E. वि before धृत held.
35228: विधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Compliant, tractable, governable. 2 To be done, what is or ought to be practised. 3 Proper to be enjoined as a rule or law. E. वि before धा to have, यत् aff.
35229: विधेयता f. (-ता) 1 Necessary or proper act or conduct. 2 Docility, submission. 3 Fitness for enactment as a rule or law. E. तल् added to the last; also विधेयत्वं.
35230: विधेयमार्ग n. (-र्गं) Attempting or seeking to do any necessary act. E. विधेय, and मार्ग seeking.
35231: विधेयपद n. (-दं) An affair to be done, an object to be accomplished. E. विधेय, and पद place.
35232: विध्यत् mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्) Piercing, striking, killing. E. व्यध to pierce, शतृ aff.
35233: विध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being pierced, struck, wounded, &c. E. व्यध to pierce, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35234: विध्वंस m. (-सः) 1 Aversion, disrespect, enmity, dislike. 2 Offence, insult. 3 Destruction. E. वि before ध्वंस to fall, aff. घञ्.
35235: विध्वंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Hostile, adverse. 2 Destroying. E. वि before ध्वंस to fall, घिनुण् aff.
35236: विनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, bowed, stooping. 2 Crooked, curved. 3 Humble, modest. f. (-ता) 1 The wife of KAŚYAPA, and mother of ARUṆA and GARUḌA. 2 A sort of basket. E. वि before नम to bow, aff. क्त.
35237: विनतासूनु m. (-नुः) 1 ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. 2 GARUḌA, the younger brother of ARUṆA. E. विनता the mother of these two, and सूनु the son.
35238: विनति f. (-तिः) 1 Bowing, bending. 2 Humility, modesty. E. वि before नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.
35239: विनद m. (-दः) 1 Sound, noise. 2 A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. वि, नद to sound, अच् aff.
35240: विनद्य ind. Having sounded, sounding. E. वि before नद to sound, ल्यप् aff.
35241: विनमन n. (-नं) Bending, bowing, bending down. E. वि before नम to bend, ल्युट् aff.
35242: विनमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bowed down, declined. E. वि, and नमित bowed.
35243: विनम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) 1 Bent, bowed. 2 Humble, modest. E. वि, and नम्र bowed.
35244: विनय m. (-यः) 1 Modesty, affability, humility, mildness. 2 Reverence, obeisance. 3 Decorum, decency, propriety, of conduct or behaviour. 4 Training, discipline. f. (-या) A plant, (Sida cordifolia, &c.) E. वि before णी to obtain or guide, aff. अच्.
35245: विनयग्राहिन् mfn. (-हि-हिणी-हि) Compliant, tractable, humble, governable. E. विनय humility, and ग्राहिन् who takes.
35246: विनयप्रमाथिन् mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि) Behaving ill or improperly. E. विनय, and प्रमाथिन् vexing.
35247: विनयभाज् mfn. (-भा) Modest, well-behaved. E. विनय, and भाज् who shares.
35248: विनयवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Speaking humbly or modestly. f. (-वाक्) Modest speech. E. विनय, and वाच् speech.
35249: विनयस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Compliant, tractable, governable. E. विनय humility, and स्थ who stays or is.
35250: विनर्द्दत् mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्) Sounding, making a noise. E. वि, and नर्द्द to sound, शतृ aff.
35251: विनशन n. (-नं) 1 Destroying, destruction. 2 A country, northwest of Delhi, Kurukṣetra, the vicinity of the modern Paniput. E. वि before नश to destroy, aff. ल्युट्.
35252: विनश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यती-श्यत्) Perishing, decaying, perishable. E. वि before नश to perish, शतृ aff.
35253: विनश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Perishable. E. वि before नश to perish, क्वरप् aff.
35254: विनष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Lost, destroyed. E. वि, and नष्ट the same.
35255: विनष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Disappearance, destruction. E. वि before नश to finish, aff. क्तिन्.
35256: विनस mfn. (-सः-सा-सी-सं) Noseless. E. वि privative, and नस for नासिका the nose.
35257: विना ind. Without, except. E. वि privative, ना aff.
35258: विनाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left, relinquished. E. विना except, and कृत made.
35259: विनाडिका f. (-का) The 60th part of an Indian hour. E. वि, and नाडिका a Nārī, or hour of twenty-four minutes.
35260: विनाथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Deserted, unprotected, unowned. E. वि priv., नाथ a lord or master.
35261: विनायक m. (-कः) 1 A Buddha, a Bauddha deified teacher. 2 GAṆEŚA. 3 GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 4 A Guru, or spiritual preceptor. 5 An obstacle, an impediment or difficulty. f. (-यिका) The wife of GARUḌA. E. वि before णी to conduct, to obtain, aff. खुल्.
35262: विनाश m. (-शः) Disappearance, destruction, loss, annihilation. E. वि before नश to perish, aff. घञ्.
35263: विनाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Destroying, a destroyer. E. वि before नश to perish, causal form, aff. वुञ्.
35264: विनाशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Destroying. E. वि before नश to perish, causal v., शतृ aff.
35265: विनाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed. E. वि before नश to perish, causal v., क्त aff.
35266: विनाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिणी-शि) 1 Destroyer, destructive. 2 Perishing, being destroyed. 3 Undergoing change or transformation. E. वि before नश to perish, णिनि aff.
35267: विनाशोन्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Ripe, mature. E. विनाश perishing, उन्मुख in the presence of; verging to rottenness.
35268: विनासक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Noseless. E. वि privative, नासिका the nose, or नासा with कप् aff.
35269: विनाह m. (-हः) The top or cover of a well. E. वि before नह to bind or tie, aff. घञ्; also वीनाह.
35270: विनिःसरण n. (-णं) Going forth or out. E. वि and निर्, before सू to go, ल्युट् aff.
35271: विनिःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone forth or out. E. वि and निर्, before सृत gone.
35272: विनिक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Tossed, thrown, sent. E. वि and नि, before क्षिप्त thrown.
35273: विनिक्षेप m. (-पः) Tossing, throwing, sending. E. वि and नि, before क्षिप to throw, घञ् aff.
35274: विनिघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्) Killing. E. वि before हन to kill, शतृ aff.
35275: विनिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Blown, budded. 2 Awake, awakened, sleepless. E. वि privative, निद्रा sleep.
35276: विनिद्रत्व n. (-त्वं) Vigilance, wakefulness, waking. E. विनिद्र sleepless, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, विनिद्रता.
35277: विनिधाय ind. Having taken or placed. E. वि, and नि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
35278: विनिपात m. (-तः) 1 Falling, falling down, (literally or figuratively, as from a height, or from dignity, virtue, &c.) 2 Calamity, unavoidable evil, the infliction of the gods or of fate. 3 Disrespect. 4 Pain, distress. 5 Death, destruction. E. वि and नि, prefixed to पत to fall, aff. घञ्.
35279: विनिपातशंसिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Portentous, announcing misfortune or destruction. E. बिनिपात, and शंसिन् what proclaims.
35280: विनिपातित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Killed, destroyed. 2 Thrown down. E. वि, and नि before पत to fall, causal v., क्त aff.
35281: विनिपात्य ind. Having killed. E. वि and नि, before पत to fall, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
35282: विनिमय m. (-यः) 1 Barter, exchange. 2 A pledge, a deposite or security. E. वि and नि, prefixed to मी to go, aff. अच्.
35283: विनियत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Regulated, restrained. E. वि and नि, before यम to restrain, क्त aff.
35284: विनियम m. (-मः) Restraint, government. E. वि and नि, before यम to restrain, aff. अच्.
35285: विनियम्य ind. Having restrained, checked, &c. E. वि and नि, before यम to restrain, ल्यप् aff.
35286: विनियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Separated, sundered or detached from, absent, parted. 2 Appointed, attached to. 3 Parted with for a specific purpose. 4 Applied to, employed in. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, क्त aff.
35287: विनियोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be employed in, applied to, &c. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, तव्यर aff.
35288: विनियोग m. (-गः) 1 Giving or parting with any thing for a consideration, or in expectation of some advantage. 2 Abandoning, leaving. 3 Separation or detachment from. 4 Impediment. 5 Appointment to any office, &c. 6 Application to or employment in. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
35289: विनियोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Appointed, appropriated, applied, (as to any particular duty or purpose, &c.) 2 Attached or joined to. 3 Deputed, appointed. 4 Employed. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, aff. क्त, with इट् augment.
35290: विनिर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone out or from. E. वि and निर्, before गम to go, क्त aff.
35291: विनिर्गम m. (-मः) Going forth or out. E. वि and निर्, before गम to go, अच् aff.
35292: विनिर्जय m. (-यः) Victory, conquest. E. वि and निर्, before जि to conquer, अच् aff.
35293: विनिर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, overcome. E. वि and निर्, before जि to conquer, क्त aff.
35294: विनिर्णय m. (-यः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. वि, and निर्णय the same.
35295: विनिर्णीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, determined, ascertained. E. वि before निर्णीत the same.
35296: विनिर्द्धूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Scattered, dissipated, dispersed. E. वि, and निर्द्धूत shaken.
35297: विनिर्धूय ind. Having dispersed, scattered, thrown off, &c. E. वि and निर्, before धू to agitate, ल्यप् aff.
35298: विनिर्मुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Liberated, let loose or free. 2 Exempt, free from. E. वि and निर् before मुच to loose, क्त aff.
35299: विनिर्य्यत् mfn. (-र्य्यन्-र्य्यन्ती-र्य्यत्) Going out or forth, issuing. E. वि and निर् before या to go, शतृ aff.
35300: विनिर्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Excited, occasioned, produced, occurring. 2 Completed, finished. E. वि and निर् privative or intensitive prefixes, वृत to be, aff. क्त.
35301: विनिवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Kept off, resisted, prevented. 2 Screened, covered, kept out of view. E. वि and नि before वॄ to chuse, क्त aff.
35302: विनिवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Stopped, ceased, ended, refrained, resting or desisting, &c. E. वि and नि privatives, वृत to be, aff. क्त.
35303: विनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Stop, term, cessation. E. वि and नि before वृत to be, क्तिन् aff.
35304: विनिश्चय m. (-यः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. वि, and निश्चय certainty.
35305: विनिश्चल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Firm, steady, immovable. E. वि before निश्चल steady.
35306: विनिश्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, determined, ascertained. E. वि before निश्चित the same.
35307: विनिश्वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Sighing. 2 Breathing hard. E. वि and नि before श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.
35308: विनिश्वास m. (-सः) Strong expiration, sighing, breathing hard. E. वि, and नि before श्वस to breathe, aff. घञ्.
35309: विनिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, wounded. 2 Overcome. m. (-तः) 1 A portent, a comet, a meteor. 2 A great or unavoidable calamity; the infliction of fate or heaven. E. वि and नि intensitive prefixes, हत struck.
35310: विनिह्नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hidden, concealed. E. वि, and निह्वुत the same.
35311: विनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Modest, humble, unassuming, unpretending. 2 Compliant, governable, tractable. 3 Placid, meek, virtuous, gentle, having the passions restrained, and the senses under subjection. 4 Well-behaved, decent, decorous. 5 Taken. 6 Trained, (as a horse or ox, &c.) 7 Thrown, sent, dismissed. 8 Lovely, handsome. 9 Led, conveyed. 10 Chastised, punished. 11 Plain, neat, (in dress, &c.) m. (-तः) 1 A horse trained for the manege. 2 A merchant, a trader. E. वि before णी to guide, aff. क्त.
35312: विनीतक mn. (-कः-कं) A mediate conveyance, as a bearer carrying a litter, or a horse dragging a carriage. E. वि implying sort or kind, and णी to take, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
35313: विनीतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 1 Well-behaved. 2 Humble, lowly. E. विनीत, and आत्मन् self.
35314: विनीय ind. Having taken. m. (-यः) 1 Sediment, dregs. 2 Sin. E. वि before णी to take, aff. क्यप् or ल्यप्.
35315: विनुद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being sent, ordered, dispatched, &c. E. वि before नुद to send, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35316: विनेतृ m. (-ता) 1 A guide, an instructor, a teacher. 2 A king, a ruler. E. वि before णी to conduct, aff. तृच्.
35317: विनेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be taken, to be taken away or separated, &c. 2 To be governed or directed, docile, governable. E. वि before णी to take or obtain, &c., aff. यत्.
35318: विनेश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Wishing or intending to take or take away, to deprive of, &c. E. वि before णी to take, शतृ aff. with a future sense.
35319: विनोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The rhetorical use of the word, ‘without;’ as, का निशाशशि ना विना What is the night without the moon. E. विना, and उक्ति saying.
35320: विनोद m. (-दः) 1 Eagerness, vehemence. 2 Play, sport, pastime. 3 Dismissing, abandoning. 4 Interest, interesting pursuit or occupation. 5 Pleasure, gratification. E. वि before नुद to order, aff. घञ्.
35321: विनोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dismissed, dissipated, sent or driven away. 2 Allayed, soothed. 3 Delighted, made happy. E. वि before नुद to send, क्त aff.
35322: विन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Who or what finds, gets, gains, &c. E. विद to gain, श aff., नुन् augment.
35323: विन्दु mfn. (-न्दुः-न्दुः-न्दु) 1 Intelligent, knowing. 2 Liberal, munificent. m. (-न्दुः) 1 A drop of water or any liquid. 2 A spot, a dot, a mark. 3 The bite or mark of a tooth. 4 The part of the forehead between the eye-brows. 5 A mark or spot of coloured paint on an elephant's face or trunk. 6 The dot over a letter representing the nasal termination. 7 A secondary but connecting incident in a drama. E. विद to know, to be, to be a part of, Uṇādi aff. उ, and the nasal augment.
35324: विन्दुचित्रक m. (-कः) The spotted deer. E. विन्दु a spot, and चित्रक variegated.
35325: विन्दुजाल n. (-लं) Coloured marks or spots on an elephant's face and trunk, &c. E. विन्दु a spot, and जाल multitude; also with कन् added, विन्दुजालक n. (-कं.)
35326: विन्दुतन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A die, a dice. E. विन्दु a dot, and तन्त्र chief.
35327: विन्दुरेखक m. (-कः) A kind of bird. E. विन्दु a spot, and रेखा a line, aff. कन्.
35328: विन्धपत्र f. (-त्रः) A plant, commonly Bel Saṇṭh.
35329: विन्ध्य m. (-न्ध्यः) 1 The Vindhya or Bindh mountain, or the mountainous range which runs across India from the province of Behar, nearly to Guzerat, and properly divides Hindustan from the Dekhin. 2 A hunter. f. (-न्ध्या) 1 A fruit, (Annona reticulata.). 2 Small cardamoms. E. वि implying opposition, ध्यै to think, and क aff., form irr.; the mountain is supposed to obstruct the course of the sun.
35330: विन्ध्यकूट m. (-टः) The saint AGASTYA. E. विन्ध्य the mountain, and कूट to give pain, aff. क, or with युच् aff. विन्ध्यकूटन; Vindhya the personified mountain, having once prostrated himself before AGASTYA his spiritual guide, was ordered by the saint to remain in that posture, as a punishment for the presumption, which had induced him to attempt rivalling the heighth of Meru and Himālaya. The legend appears to originate in the little elevation of the Vindhya chain compared with its extent.
35331: विन्ध्यवासिन् m. (-सी) The saint and grammarian VYĀḌI. f. (-सिनी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A village and temple sacred to DURGĀ under the forms of Yoga Māyā, and Bhoga Māyā, and a place of great resort amongst the Hindus, situated about three miles from Mirzāpur on the Ganges. E. विन्ध्य the mountain, and वासिन् who dwells.
35332: विन्ध्यस्थ m. (-स्थः) The name of a Muni; also VYĀḌI, a saint, and inspired grammarian. E. विन्ध्य the mountain, and स्थ abiding.
35333: विन्ध्याचल m. (-लः) The Vindhya range of mountains. E. विन्ध्य, and अचल a mountain; also विन्ध्यपर्ब्बत, विन्ध्यशैल.
35334: विन्ध्याटवी f. (-वी) The great Vindhya forest, which appears to have spread at one time from near Mathura to the Narmadā. E. विन्ध्य, and अटवी a forest.
35335: विन्ध्याबलीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A name of the demon BĀṆA or VĀṆA. E. विन्ध्यावली the mother of the demon, and पुत्त्र son; also विन्ध्यावलीसुत.
35336: विन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Judged, discussed. 2 Gained, obtained. 3 Fixed, placed. 4 Known. 5 Married, &c. E. विद to know, and aff. क्त.
35337: विन्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Placed, deposited, fixed. 2 Delivered. 3 Offered, presented. E. वि and नि before अस to be or throw, aff. क्त.
35339: विन्यास m. (-सः) 1 Assemblage, collecting, collecting or depositing any thing. 2 Site, place, receptacle, that in or on which any thing is placed or deposited. 3 Orderly arrangement or disposition. 4 Entrusting, depositing. 5 A deposit. E. वि, and नि prefixed to अस to take, to throw or place, &c., aff. घञ्.
35341: विपक्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Matured, ripened. 2 Fulfilled, come to pass, as the consequence of former actions. E. वि, and पच to cook, क्त्रि aff., and मप् augment.
35342: विपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Opposed or adverse to, contrary, inimical. m. (-क्षः) 1 An enemy, an adversary. 2 A disputant, an opponent. 3 Exception, (in grammar, &c.) 4 (In logic,) An argument or syllogism in which the proposition to be maintained is wanting. E. वि implying opposite, contrary, and पक्ष part or side.
35343: विपक्षतस् ind. Hostilely, inimically. E. विपक्ष, and तसि aff.
35344: विपक्षता f. (-ता) 1 Hostility, enmity, opposition. 2 Controversy, contradiction in argument. E. तल् added to विपक्ष; also with त्व विपक्षत्वं.
35345: विपक्षपात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Indifferent, impartial. E. वि priv., पक्षपात an adherent.
35346: विपञ्चिका f. (-का) A lute. E. कन् fem. form, added to the next.
35347: विपञ्ची f. (-ञ्ची) 1 A lute. 2 Play, sport, pastime. E. वि before पचि to extend, (causal form,) to diffuse sounds, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
35348: विपण m. (-णः) Sale, contract of sale. E. वि before पण to be of price, aff. घञ् or घ; also with ल्युट्, विपणन n. (-नं.)
35349: विपणि mf. (-णिः-णी) 1 A place where things are sold, a shop, a stall. 2 A fair, a market, a market place. 3 The street of a market. 4 An article or commodity for sale. E. वि before पण to transact business, aff. इक्, and fem. aff. ङीष्.
35350: विपणिन् m. (-णी) A dealer, a trafficker, a shop-keeper or merchant. E. विपण sale, इनि aff.
35351: विपत्काल n. (-लं) Time of calamity or misfortune, adversity. E. विपट्, and काल time.
35352: विपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Adversity, calamity, misfortune. 2 Pain, agony. 3 Death, dying. E. वि implying reverse, पत् to go, aff. क्तिन्.
35353: विपत्तियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unfortunate. E. विपत्ति, and युक्त joined.
35354: विपत्तिरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Properous, happy. E. विपत्ति, and रहित free from.
35355: विपत्सागर m. (-रः) Heavy calamity. E. विपत्, and सागर ocean.
35356: विपथ mn. (-थः-थं) A bad road. E. वि depreciative prefix, and पथ for पथिन् a road.
35357: विपद् f. (-पत् or पद्) Calamity, adversity, misfortune. E. वि before पद to go, क्विप् aff.; also with टाप् added, विपदा.
35358: विपदा f. (-दा) Adversity. E. see the last.
35359: विपदुद्धार m. (-रः) Extrication from misfortune. E. विपत्, and उद्धार lifting up; also विपटुद्धरणं, &c.
35360: विपद्ग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Overtaken by or involved in calamity. E. विपट्, and ग्रस्त seized.
35361: विपद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unhappy, unfortunate. E. विपट्, and युक्त joined.
35362: विपद्रहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Prosperous. E. विपट्, and रहित left by.
35363: विपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Unfortunate, declined, fallen into adversity or misfortune. 2 Lost, destroyed, annihilated. 3 Dead, defunct. m. (-न्नः) A snake. E. वि implying reverse, and पद to go, aff. क्त; also with कन् added विपन्नक.
35364: विपरिणाम m. (-मः) Change of state or form. E. वि and परि before णम to bow, aff. घञ्.
35365: विपरिणामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Undergoing or producing change of state or form. E. वि and परि before णम to bow, घिनुण् aff.
35366: विपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Turning back or away from. E. वि, and परिवर्त्तन turning round.
35367: विपरिवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned back or away from, reverted, averted. E. वि and परि before वृत to turn, क्त aff.
35368: विपरीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverse, inverse, opposite, contrary. f. (-ता) A lewd woman, a dishonest wife. E. वि and परि implying contrariety or reverse, before इत gone.
35369: विपरीतकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Perverse, contradictory, acting contrary to another's wishes. E. विपरीत, and कारिन् who does; also विपरीतकर, विपरीतकर्त्तृ, &c.
35370: विपरीतगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Going backwards or reversely. f. (-तिः) Inverse or reverse motion. E. विपरीत, and गति going.
35371: विपरीतता f. (-ता) Contrariety, reverse or opposite state or condition. E. विपरीत, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विपरीतत्वं.
35372: विपर्णक m. (-कः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. वि separate, पर्ण a leaf, and कन् added.
35373: विपर्य्यय m. (-यः) 1 Contrariety, opposition. 2 Reverse in general, and thence applied to that of which reverse is predicated, as misery, calamity, (the reverse of fortune;) error, misapprehension, (the reverse of reason or truth;) inverted order or succession, (the reverse of that which is usual or prescribed,) &c. 3 Destruction, annihilation. 4 Perverseness of disposition. 5 Change of purpose or conduct. 6 Enmity, hostility. E. वि and परि implying reverse, and इ to go, aff. अच्; also with घञ् aff. विपर्य्याय m. (-यः)
35374: विपर्य्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Opposite, contrary, reverse. 2 Conceived to be real (what is not so). E. वि and परि before अस to be, or to throw, क्त aff.
35376: विपर्य्यास m. (-सः) 1 Contrariety, opposition. 2 Reverse. 3 Investing imaginary things with real attributes, imagining what is unreal or false to be real or true. E. वि and परि before अस to be, aff. घञ्.
35377: विपल n. (-लं) A moment, an instant, either a Pala or second, or (1/6)th of it; a simple breathing or (1/16)th of the latter. E. वि, and पल a second.
35378: विपलायन n. (-नं) Flying, running away. E. वि, and पलायन the same.
35379: विपलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Put to flight, run away. E. वि before पलायित the same.
35380: विपव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cleansed or purified. E. वि before पूञ् to purify, aff. क्यप्.
35381: विपश्चित् m. (-श्चित्) A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher. E. वि before चि to collect, affs. क्विप् and तुक्, form irr.
35382: विपश्य n. (-श्यं) Knowledge. E. वि variously, पश्य seeing.
35383: विपश्यिन् m. (-श्यी) A Bauddha saint, the first of the seven principal Buddhas. E. विपश्य, and इनि aff.
35384: विपाक m. (-कः) 1 Cooking, dressing. 2 Ripening, maturing. 3 Flavour, taste.. 4 Unexpected or improbable result. 5 Poverty, distress. 6 Change of form or state. 7 The consequences of actions, either in this or in a former birth; the operation of time in maturing their results. 8 Assimilation of food, its conversion into a state differing from its original one, digestion. E. वि before पच to ripen, aff. घञ्.
35386: विपाण्डुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pale, pallid, white. E. वि, and पाण्डुर pale.
35387: विपादन n. (-नं) Destroying, killing. E. वि before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35388: विपादनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be killed, fit or proper to be destroyed. E. वि before पद to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विपाद्य and विपादयितव्य.
35389: विपादिका f. (-का) 1 A kibe, a sore or blister on the foot. 2 A riddle, an enigma. E. वि before पद to go, aff. ण्वुल्.
35390: विपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, destroyed. E. वि before पद to go, causal v., क्त aff.
35391: विपाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unattended, unguarded. E. वि priv., पाल a keeper.
35392: विपाश् f. (-पाट्) The Vipāś or Vipāśā river. E. see the next.
35393: विपाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Unnoosed, unfettered, freed from a noose or tie. f. (-शा) 1 The Vipāśā or the Beyāh river in the Pañjāb. E. वि privative, and पाश् or पाशा a noose, from पश to bind, causal form, with अच् and टाप् or क्विप् aff.; hence also विपाश्; the name applies to the river as having destroyed the cord which the Muni VAŚIṢṬHA had tied round his neck, when about to hang himself through grief for the death of his sons slain by VIŚVĀMITRA.
35394: विपिन n. (-नं) A wood, a forest. E. वेप to shake, Uṇādi aff. इनन्.
35395: विपुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Large, great. 2 Broad. 3 Deep, profound. m. (-लः) 1 The mountain Meru, or rather the western branch of it. 2 The Himālaya mountain. 3 A respectable man. f. (-ला) 1 The earth. 2 A form of the Āryā metre in which the line is irregularly divided by the Cœsura or pause: three species of this form are reckoned; the Ādivipulā with the pause in the first line, Antyavipulā in the second, and Ubhayavipulā in both lines. E. वि before पुल to be large or lofty, aff. क.
35396: विपुलक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Free from horripilation. E. वि privative, and पुलक erection of the hair of the body.
35397: विपुलता f. (-ता) Magnitude, extent. E. विपुल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व विपुलत्वं.
35398: विपुलरस m. (-सः) The sugar-cane. E. विपुल much, and रस juice.
35399: विपुलेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Large-eyed. E. विपुल, and ईक्षण sight.
35400: विपूय m. (-यः) The Munja grass, (Saccharum Munja.) E. वि before पुञ् to cleanse, aff. क्यप्; that which is to be cleaned before making into ropes, &c.
35401: विप्र m. (-प्रः) 1 A Brahman. 2 (In prosody,) A foot of four short syllables. E. वि before प्रा Sautra root, to fill or complete, (the essential observances,) and क aff.; or वप to shave, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
35402: विप्रकार m. (-रः) 1 Injury, contumely, abuse. 2 Wickedness. 3 Opposition, counteraction. 4 Retaliation. E. वि and प्र depreciative prefixes, and कार making.
35403: विप्रकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Opposed to, treating with contempt. 2 Retaliating. E. वि and प्र before कृ to do, णिनि aff.
35404: विप्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reviled, abused, treated with contempt or contumely. 2 Opposed, counteracted. 3 Injured, offended. 4 Retaliated, requited. E. वि and प्र before कृत made; made little or nothing of.
35405: विप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Abuse, injury, contumely. 2 Retaliation, retort. E. वि and प्र implying depreciation or mutuality, and कृति action.
35406: विप्रकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Remote, distant. E. वि and प्र before कृष to attract, aff. क्त; also with कन् added, विप्रकृष्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
35407: विप्रतिकार m. (-रः) 1 Contradiction, counteraction, opposition. 2 Reverse. 3 Retaliation. E. वि and प्रति before कृ to do, घञ् aff.
35408: विप्रतिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opposed, counteracted. 2 Requited. E. वि and प्रति before कृ to do, क्त aff.
35409: विप्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Perplexity, confusion. 2 Various acquirement. 3 Mutual connexion with or relation to. 4 Conversancy. 5 Contradiction, difference, discrepancy. 6 Contest, dispute. 7 Opposition of interests. E. वि privative, or implying variety, and प्रतिपत्ति knowledge.
35410: विप्रतिपद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 To be opposed, contradicted, contested. 2 To be acquired. E. प्रति before पद to go, यत् aff.
35411: विप्रतिपद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being disputed or contested. 2 Being in course of acquirement. E. वि and प्रति before पद to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35412: विप्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Bewildered, perplexed, confused, uncertain. 2 Conversant or acquainted with in various ways, severally or mutually. 3 Connected with. 4 Contested, disputed. 5 Contradicted. 6 Opposed, (as interests.) E. वि, and प्रतिपन्न ascertained, &c.
35414: विप्रतिसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Contradicted, opposed. 2 Prohibited, forbidden. E. वि, and प्रति implying opposition, and सिद्ध proved, perfected.
35415: विप्रतीसार m. (-रः) 1 Repentance. 2 Evil, wickedness, evil action. 3 Hate, enmity. 4 Rage, wrath. E. वि implying reverse, प्रति to or towards, सार going, conduct; the इ of प्रति optionally long; otherwise विप्रतिसार.
35416: विप्रदह m. (-हः) Dried fruit or roots, &c.
35417: विप्रदुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Spoiled, vitiated, defiled. 2 Bad, corrupt. E. वि and प्र before टुष्ट the same.
35418: विप्रदुष्टभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Bad, vicious, sensual, corrupt. E. विप्रटुष्ट, and भाव disposition or nature.
35419: विप्रमोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be liberated or freed from. E. वि and प्र before मुच् to loose, यत् aff.
35420: विप्रयाण n. (-णं) Flight, retreat. E. वि and प्र before या to go, aff. ल्युट्.
35421: विप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Separated, disjoined, sundered, away or absent from. E. वि implying separation, प्रयुक्त joined.
35422: विप्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Separation, absence, especially the separation of lovers. 2 Disunion, disjunction. 3 Quarrel, disagreement. 4 Deserving. E. वि before प्रयोग union, contiguity.
35423: विप्रलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Tricked, cheated, deceived. 2 Disappointed. f. (-ब्धी) A mistress whose lover is not true to his appointment. E. वि and प्र before लब्ध gained.
35424: विप्रलम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Tricking, deceiving, disappointing, deceiving by a false affirmation or by not keeping a promise. 2 Separation, especially of lovers. 3 Disunion, disjunction. 4 Quarrel, disagreement. E. वि and प्र implying reverse, लभि to get or gain, aff. घञ्.
35425: विप्रलाप m. (-पः) 1 Quarrel, wrangling, mutual contradiction. 2 Idle or unmeaning discourse, nonsense. E. वि and प्र implying contradiction or reciprocity, and लाप talk.
35426: विप्रलुम्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Rapacious, exacting, avaricious. E. वि and प्र before लुपि to cut off, ण्वुल् aff.
35427: विप्रवास m. (-सः) Residence in a foreign country. E. वि and प्र implying separation, वस to abide, and घञ् aff.
35428: विप्रवासन n. (-नं) 1 Residence abroad. 2 Banishment. E. वि and प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35429: विप्रश्निका f. (-का) A female fortune-teller. E. वि variously, पृच्छ to ask, aff. इञ्, with नङ् augment, and ठन् added.
35430: विप्रसात् ind. As, like as, one with, a Brahman. E. विप्र, and साति aff.
35431: विप्रस्व n. (-स्वं) The property of a Brahman. E. विप्र, and स्व own.
35432: विप्रापवाद m. (-दः) Abuse of a Brahman. E. विप्र, and अपवाद reviling.
35433: विप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Disliked, unbeloved, disagreeable. n. (-यं) Offence, transgression. E. वि privative, and प्रिय fond of.
35434: विप्रुष् f. (-प्रुट) 1 A drop of water, &c. 2 A spot, a mark, a dot. E. वि privative, प्रुष to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्लुष्.
35435: विप्रोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Absent, away from. 2 Banished. E. वि and प्र before वस to dwell, aff. क्त, the semivowel changed to उ.
35436: विप्रोषितभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband or lover is absent. E. विप्रोषित absent, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् aff.
35437: विप्रोष्य ind. Having been absent, returning, coming home. E. वि, and प्र before वस to dwell, ल्यप् aff.
35438: विप्लव m. (-वः) 1 Tumult, confusion, trouble. 2 Evil, calamity. 3 Rapine, extortion. 4 Sin, wickedness. 5 Predatory or irregular warfare. 6 Affray, scuffle. 7 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. 8 Confusion, perplexity, (of thought or speech.) E. वि before प्लु to go, aff. अप्.
35439: विप्लाव m. (-वः) 1 Deluging, inundating. 2 Devastating. 3 Causing tumult or public disturbance. 4 A horse's canter or gallop. E. वि, and प्लु to go, aff. घञ्.
35440: विप्लाव्य ind. 1 Having cast away, defiled, contaminated. 2 Having taught at improper seasons. 3 Having caused to be deluged, devastated, &c. E. वि before प्लु to go, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
35441: विप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Depraved, wicked, addicted to evil practices, as gaming, whoring, &c. 2 Committing any crime. 3 Contrary, adverse, averse. 4 Inundated, immersed. 5 Devastated, ravaged. E. वि before प्लु to go, aff. क्त.
35442: विप्लुष् f. (-प्लुट) 1 A drop of any fluid. 2 A spot, a dot. E. वि before प्लुष to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्लुष्.
35443: विप्सा f. (-प्सा) Repetition, succession: see वीप्सा.
35444: विफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Vain, idle, unmeaning, fruitless, useless. E. वि privative, and फल fruit.
35445: विफलता f. (-ता) Unprofitableness, fruitlessness. E. विफल, and तल् added; also विफलत्वं.
35446: विफलीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Frustrating, foiling, defeating. 2 Doing any thing in vain. E. विफल, and करण making, च्चि augment.
35447: विफलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rendered vain, frustrated. 2 Done in vain. E. विफल, and कृत done, च्चि augment.
35448: विफलीभविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Become unprofitable. E. विफल, and भविष्णु become, च्चि augment.
35449: विफलीभविष्णुता f. (-ता) Unprofitableness. E. तल् added to the last; also, विफलीभविष्णुत्वं.
35450: विफलीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become useless. E. विफल, and भत become, च्चि augment.
35451: विबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Ischury or constipation. E. वि before बन्ध to bind, aff. घञ्.
35452: विबाधा f. (-धा) Pain, agony, anguish. E. वि various, बाधा pain.
35453: विबुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Awake, aroused. 2 Unconscious. E. वि, and बुद्ध wakened.
35454: विबुध m. (-धः) 1 A god, an immortal. 2 A Paṇḍita, a learned man, a teacher. 3 The moon. E. वि variously, बुध to know, aff. क.
35455: विबोध m. (-धः) 1 Inattention, absence. 2 Intelligence. 3 Awaking. 4 Discovering any circumstance. E. वि privative or intensitive, and बोध understanding.
35456: विबोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Awakened. 2 Instructed. E. वि before बुध to know, causal v., क्त aff.
35457: विभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Divided, portioned, partitioned. 2 Separated, parted. 3 Dividing, sharing, a partner. 4 Distinct. E. वि severally, भज to divide, aff. क्त.
35458: विभक्तज m. (-जः) A son born after partition of the family property between his parents and brethren. E. विभक्त divided, (being or having been,) and ज born.
35459: विभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Part, portion, inheritance or share of inheritance, &c. 2 A division, a partition. 3 Inflexion of nouns, declension. E. वि before भज to divide, aff. क्तिन्.
35460: विभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Breaking, fracture. 2 Division. 3 Bending, contracting, (especially of the eye-brows.) 4 Expression or play of features. E. वि, and भजि to break, aff. घञ्.
35461: विभजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be portioned or partitioned. E. वि before भज to divide, अनीयर् aff.
35462: विभज्य ind. Having divided, portioned, &c. E. वि before भज to divide, ल्यप् aff.
35463: विभज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Divisible, portionable, to be or being divided or parted. E. वि before भज to divide, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35464: विभव m. (-वः) 1 Substance, thing, property, wealth. 2 Emancipation from existence. 3 Supreme or superhuman power. 4 Magnanimity, lofty-mindedness. E. वि implying variety, privation, &c., and भव being.
35465: विभा f. (-भा) 1 A ray of light. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Beauty. E. वि variously, भा to shine, aff. क्विप्.
35466: विभाकर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. विभा light, and कर who makes.
35467: विभाग m. (-गः) 1 Part, portion, share. 2 The share or portion of an inheritance. 3 Partition of inheritance. 4 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction. E. वि implying variously, and भाग a portion.
35468: विभागकल्पना f. (-ना) Apportioning or allotment of shares or portions. E. विभाग a division, and कल्पना a making.
35469: विभागतस् ind. Proportionately, according to a part or share. E. विभाग, and तसि aff.
35470: विभागभाज् m. (-भाक्) One who shares in a portion, of property already distributed, applied especially to a son by a father and mother of the same tribe, born subsequent to a distribution of property amongst his parents and brethren, in which case he inherits the portion allotted or reserved to the parents. E. विभाग a portion, and भाक् who shares.
35471: विभागशस् ind. Proportionately, according to a part or share. E. विभाग, and शसि aff.
35472: विभाज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Divisible, portionable, what may be divided or apportioned. E. वि severally, भज to divide, ण्यत् aff.
35473: विभात् mfn. (-भान्-भान्ती-भाती-भात्) Shining, splendid. E. वि before भा to shine, शतृ aff.
35474: विभात n. (-तं) Dawn, day-break. E. वि before भा to shine, aff. क्त; also विभातक n. (-कं)
35475: विभाव m. (-वः) 1 A friend or acquaintance. 2 One of the Bhāvas or classes of properties into which the objects of poetical composition are divided; the causative or exciting property, as dress, perfumes, &c. of amorous desire; extravagant gesture of mirth; distress or pain of tenderness; arms and tumult of wrath or heroism, &c. E. वि various, and भाव property, disposition.
35476: विभावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Discussing, shewing, illustrating. E. वि before भू to think, ण्वुल् aff.
35477: विभावन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Discussion, examination, discrimination. 2 Perceiving, seeing, distinguishing. 3 Conceiving, imagination. 4 Ascertaining or judging of facts. 5 Describing effects not arising from the usual causes (in rhetoric.) E. वि before भू in the 10th cl. to think, &c., aff. युच्.
35478: विभावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Distinguishable, ascertainable, to be judged or determined. E. वि, and भू to think, अनीयर् aff.
35479: विभावरी f. (-री) 1 Night. 2 Turmeric. 3 A bawd. 4 A harlot. 5 The shreds of a garment torn in a scuffle (?). E. वि before भा to shine, (with stars,) क्वनिप् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्, and रच् substituted for the final; also विभाव amorous excitement, रच् aff.
35480: विभावस् m. (-वान्) The sun. E. विभा, and क्वसु aff.
35481: विभावसु m. (-सुः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 The moon. 4 A sort of necklace or garland. E. विभा light, वसु being, substance.
35482: विभावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, perceived, marked. 2 Judged, discriminated. 3 Conceived, imagined. 4 Known, understood. 5 Proved, established. E. वि before भू 10th cl. to know or perceive, aff. क्त.
35483: विभावितत्व n. (-त्वं) The state of being perceived or judged. E. त्व added to the last.
35484: विभाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be seen or observed, remarkable, distinguishable. 2 To be conceived or imagined. E. वि before भू to be, ण्यत् aff.
35485: विभाषा f. or ind. (-षा) Alternative, either of two ways. E. वि alternative, and भाषा speech.
35486: विभासा f. (-सा) Light, shining. E. वि before भास to be luminous, अङ् and टाप् affs.
35487: विभासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, shining. E. वि before भास to shine, क्त aff.
35488: बिभित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing or purposing to hit or pierce. E. वि before भिद to break, desid. v., उ aff.
35489: विभिद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being wounded; pierced, broken. 2 Being divided or scattered. E. वि before भिद to break, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35490: विभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Pierced, wounded. 2 Broken. 3 Scattered, dispersed. 4 Mixed, intermixed, mingling. 5 Various, different. 6 Disappointed. 7 Bewildered, perplexed. E. वि before भिद to break, &c., क्त aff.
35491: विभिन्नता f. (-ता) The state of being broken, scattered, &c. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विभिन्नत्व.
35492: विभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fearless. E. वि priv., भीत afraid.
35493: विभीतक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. विभीत fearless, कन् aff.
35494: विभीषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fearful, formidable, terrific, horrible. nf. (-णं-णा) The property of exciting fear. m. (-णः) The brother of RĀVAṆA. E. वि before भी to fear, युच् aff., and षुक augment.
35495: विभु mfn. (-भुः-भुः or भ्वी-भु) 1 Omnipresent, all-pervading. 2 Always, eternal. 3 Firm, solid, hard. m. (-भुः) 1 A master, an owner. 2 ŚIVA. 3 BRAHMĀ. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 A servant. 6 Ether. 7 Space. 8 Time. 9 The soul. E. वि before भू to be, aff. डु.
35496: विभुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Bent, bowed, crooked. E. वि before भुज to bend, and क्त aff.
35497: विभुता f. (-ता) Power, supremacy. E. विभु, and तल् aff.; also विभुत्वं.
35498: विभूति m. (-तिः) 1 Superhuman power, consisting of eight faculties, especially attributed to ŚIVA, and supposed to be attainable by human beings, through a course of austere worship, attended with magical rites, in honor of that deity and his spouse DURGĀ: the eight properties thus supposed to be assumable at will are, अणिमा extreme minuteness or invisibility; लघिमा extreme lightness or incorporeality; प्राप्ति attaining or reaching any thing, as illustrated by the power of touching the moon with the tip of the finger; प्राकाम्यं the fulfilment of every wish; महिमा illimitable bulk; ईशिता supreme dominion over animate or inanimate nature; वशिता the power of enchanting or changing the course of nature, and कामावशायिता the accomplishment of every promise or engagement. 2 Power, dignity, dominion. 3 Ashes of cow-dung, &c. with which ŚIVA is said to have smeared his body, and thence used in imitation of him by devotees. E. वि implying change of form, &c., भू to be, aff. क्तिन्.
35499: विभूतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Superhuman. 2 Smeared with ashes. E. विभूति, and मतुप् aff.
35500: विभूषण n. (-णं) Ornament, decoration. E. वि implying variety, and भूषण adorning.
35501: विभूषा f. (-षा) 1 Lustre, splendour, beauty. 2 Ornament, decoration. E. वि before भूष to adorn, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
35502: विभूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adorned, decorated. E. वि variously, भूष to adorn, क्त aff.
35503: विभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Held, retained. 2 Upheld, supported. E. वि before भृत supported.
35504: विभेद m. (-दः) 1 Dividing, breaking. 2 Wounding, piercing. 3 Variety, distinction. 4 Bewildering, perplexing. 5 A division or separation. 6 Enmity, opposition. 7 Contradiction. E. वि before भिद to break, घञ् aff.
35505: विभेदन n. (-नं) 1 Breaking, dividing. 2 Separating, literally or figuratively, as setting at variance. E. वि before भिद to divide, ल्युट् aff.
35506: बिभ्रत् mfn. (-भ्रन्-भ्रती-भ्रत्) Having, possessing. E. वि before भृ to support, शतृ aff.
35507: विभ्रम m. (-मः) 1 One of the classes of feminine actions proceeding from the passion of love, flurry, confusion. 2 Error, mistake, blunder. 3 Hurry, flurry. 4 Doubt, apprehension. 5 Beauty. 6 Whirling, going round. f. (-मा) Old age. E. वि before भ्रम to err, &c., aff. घञ्.
35508: विभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Lost, gone. 2 Broken off or from, fallen, separated. E. वि before भ्रस्ज to be broken, क्त aff.
35509: विभ्राज् mfn. (-भ्राड् or -भ्राट्) 1 Elegant, richly dressed or decorated. 2 Splendid, luminous, shining. E. वि before भ्राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.
35510: विभ्राजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Resplendent, glittering. E. वि, भ्राज to shine, शानच् aff.
35511: विभ्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having, possessing. E. वि before भृ to have, शानच् aff.
35512: विभ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Hurried, flurried, erring, &c. through precipitation. E. वि before भ्रम to err, aff. क्त.
35513: विभ्रान्तशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mad, drunk, intoxicated, or insane. m. (-लः) 1 A monkey. 2 The disk of the sun or moon. E. विभ्रान्त wandering, and शील disposition.
