35514: विभ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Error, confusion. 2 Hurry, flurry, precipitation. 3 Whirling, going round. E. वि before भ्रम to err, aff. क्तिन्.
35515: विमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disliking, averse or hostile to. 2 Disagreeing, of a different opinion. m. (-तः) An enemy. E. वि adverse, and मत disposed.
35516: विमति f. (-तिः) 1 Dislike, aversion. 2 Difference of opinion, dissent. E. वि, and मति mind.
35517: विमत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unenvious, unambitious. E. वि priv., मत्सर envious.
35518: विमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) 1 Sad, perplexed, disordered, heartbroken. 2 Changed in mind or feeling. 3 Averse, disliking, displeased. 4 Absent, thinking of something else. E. वि privative, and मनस् the mind; having no mind or heart.
35519: विमनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Sad, bewildered, heart-broken, &c. E. कन् added to the preceding.
35520: विमनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Altered in mind or feeling. 2 Sad, sorrowful. 3 Displeased, offended. E. विमनस्, and कृत made with च्चि augment.
35521: विमनीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Changed in mind or feeling, &c.: see the last. E. विमनस्, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
35522: विमय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange. E. वि before मि to scatter, aff. अच्.
35523: विमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 The trituration of perfumes. 3 Touch, contact. 4 Destroying, killing. 5 A plant, (Cassia esculenta.) E. वि before मृद to grind, aff. अच्.
35524: विमर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, pounding, grinding. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 The trituration of perfumes. 4 Conjunction of the sun and moon, or eclipse. E. वि before मृद to rub, &c., aff. ल्युट्; also विमर्द्दक m. (-कः) and विमर्द्दना f. (-ना.)
35525: विमर्द्दार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) (In astronomy,) The time from the apparent conjunction to the end of an eclipse. E. विमर्द्द, and अर्द्ध half.
35526: विमर्द्दोत्थ m. (-त्थः) A pleasing scent. E. विमर्द्द rubbing, and उत्थ what rises.
35527: विमर्श n. (-र्शः) Discussion, investigation, reasoning, examination by reason. E. वि implying discrimination, मृश to perceive, aff. घञ्.
35528: विमर्शन n. (-नं) Investigating, discussing. E. वि, मृश to judge, ल्युट् aff.
35529: विमर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Thinking, deliberating. E. विमश, and इनि aff.
35530: विमर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Irritation, impatience. 2 Displeasure, dissatisfaction. 3 Interruption of the prosperous course of a dramatic story, reverse. E. वि before मृष to endure, aff. अप्.
35531: विमर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 1 Impatient, intolerant. 2 Averse, disliking. E. विमर्ष, and इनि aff.
35532: विमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Clean, pure, (either literally, as clothes, &c., or figuratively, as the heart or mind.) 2 Beautiful. 3 White. 4 Transparent. f. (-ला) 1 A plant, commonly Carmaghās. 2 A sort of soil. m. (-लः) An Arhat or Jaina deified sage. n. (-लं) Silver gilt. E. वि privative, मल dirt.
35533: विमलमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal. E. विमल clean, clear, and मणि a jewel.
35534: विमलात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Clean, pure. E. विमल clean, and आत्मन् nature, aff. कन्.
35535: विमलात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Pure, undefiled. E. विमल, and आत्मन् self.
35536: विमलाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) A particular mountain. E. विमल clean, or crystal, and अद्रि a mountain.
35537: विमलार्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Clear, clean, pure. E. विमल clean, अर्थ purpose, कन् added.
35538: विमस्तकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beheaded, decapitated. E. वि priv., मस्त the head, इतच् aff.
35539: विमांस mn. (-सः-सं) Unclean meat, as the flesh of dogs, &c. E. वि depreciative prefix, and मांस flesh.
35540: विमातृ f. (-ता) A step-mother, a father's wife. E. वि different, मातृ mother.
35541: विमातृज m. (-जः) A step-mother's son. E. विमातृ, and ज born.
35542: विमान mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A car or chariot of the gods, sometimes serving as a seat or throne, and at others carrying them through the skies self-directed and self-moving. 2 Any car or vehicle. 3 A horse. 4 A palace, the palace of an emperor or supreme monarch. 5 Disrespect, dishonour. 6 Measure. E. वि before मन to understand, with घञ् aff., or मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्, or वि priv., मान honour.
35543: विमानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dishonoured. E. विमान, and इतच् aff.
35544: विमार्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A broom, a brush. 2 A bad road. 3 A wrong road, literally or figuratively, evil conduct. E. वि before मृज to clean, aff. घञ्, or वि privative, and मार्ग a road.
35545: विमार्गण n. (-णं) Searching, seeking. E. वि before मृग to search, ल्युट् aff.
35546: विमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Loosed, liberated. 2 Hurled, thrown. 3 Quitted, abandoned. 4 Issued or let loose from, given vent to. E. वि before मुक्त the same.
35547: विमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Liberation, especially final emancipation from future existence. 2 Separation, parting. E. वि before मुक्ति the same.
35548: विमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 1 Averted, having the face cast down or turned away. 2 Opposed. E. वि reverse, and मुख the countenance.
35549: विमुखता f. (-ता) 1 Disappearance, departure. 2 Turning away. 3 Opposition. E. तल् added to the last; also विमुखत्वं.
35550: विमुखिता f. (-ता) 1 Turning away from, enmity. 2 Departure. 3 Opposition. E. विमुखिन्, and तल् aff.; also विमुखित्वं.
35551: विमुखिन् mfn. (-खि-खिनी-खि) 1 Averted, turned away. 2 Hostile, averse to or from. E. विमुख, and इनि aff.
35552: विमुखीकरण n. (-णं) Turning away from, leaving. E. विमुख, and करण doing, च्चि augment.
35553: विमुखीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned away from, averted, departed. E. विमुख, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
35554: विमुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Bewildered, absorbed. E. वि before मुह to be bewildered, क्त aff.
35555: विमुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being let loose or liberated, in the act of spreading abroad. E. वि before मुच to be loosed, शानच् aff.
35556: विमुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Blown, budded, opened as a bud or flower. 2 Unsealed, unclosed. E. वि privative, मुद्रा a seal.
35557: विमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Bewildered, discomposed. 2 Foolish. 3 Beguiled, led astray, seduced, tempted. E. वि, and मुह to be foolish, aff. क्त.
35558: विमूढसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Senseless, unconscious. E. विमूढ, and सज्ञा sense.
35559: विमूढात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Beguiled, foolish. E. विमूढ, and आत्मन् self.
35560: विमृदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed. 2 Ground, pounded. E. वि, मृद to rub, क्त aff.
35561: विमृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be discussed or reflected upon. ind. Having considered. E. वि, मृश to reflect, युच् or ल्यप् aff.
35562: विमृश्यकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Acting after due deliberation. E. विमृश्य, and कारिन् who acts.
35563: विमोक्ष m. (-क्षः) Liberation, freedom, being or letting loose. E. वि before मोक्ष the same.
35564: विमोक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) Quitting, abandoning, resigning. E. वि before मोक्षण the same.
35565: विमोचन n. (-नं) Liberating. E. वि before मुच to set free, ल्युट् aff.
35566: विमोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Liberated, set free. E. वि before मुच to liberate, causal v., aff. क्त.
35567: विमोहन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) Fascinating, seducing, bewitching, tempting, (the instrument or agent.) n. (-नं) Seducing, tempting, confounding the mind and exciting the passions, (the act.) E. वि before मुह to be foolish, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
35568: विमोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fascinated, beguiled. E. वि before मुह to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
35569: विम्ब mn. (-म्बः-म्बं) 1 The disk of the sun or moon. 2 An image, a picture, a shadow, a reflected or represented form. 3 The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha. nf. (-म्बं-म्बा or -म्बी) A cucurbitaceous plant with red fruit, (Momordica monadelpha.) E. वि to go, to shine, वन Uṇādi aff., and मुस् augment, with the radical vowel made short.
35570: विम्बक n. (-कं) 1 The disk of the sun or moon. 2 The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha or the plant itself. E. कन् added to the last.
35571: विम्बजा f. (-जा) The Momordica monadelpha or the gourd. E. विम्ब the plant, and ज born.
35572: विम्बट m. (-टः) The mustard plant, (Sinapis dichotoma, Rox.) E. विम्ब as above, अट to go or grow (like), aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
35573: विम्बागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reflected. E. विम्ब, and आगत arrived.
35574: विम्बिका f. (-का) 1 A cucurbitaceous plant bearing a bright red gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.) 2 The disk of the sun or moon. E. कन् in the fem. form, added to विम्ब as above.
35575: विम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pictured, imaged, reflected. E. विम्ब, and इतच् aff.
35576: विम्बु m. (-म्बुः) The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)
35577: विम्बोष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Red-lipped, having lips like the Vimba fruit. E. विम्ब as above, and ओष्ठ the lip; also विम्बौष्ठ.
35578: विम्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Fresh, pure, free from soil or decay. 2 Refreshed. E. वि priv., म्लान decayed.
35579: विम्लापन n. (-नं) 1 Cleaning, wiping. 2 Refreshing, reviving. E. वि priv., म्लै to decay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35580: वियच्चारिन् m. (-री) A kite. E. वियत् the sky, and चारिन् who goes.
35581: वियत् n. (-यत्) Sky, heaven, ether, atmosphere. E. वि privative, यम to refrain or cease, aff. क्विप, and तुक् final.
35582: वियति m. (-तिः) A bird. E. वि before यत to endeavour, कि aff.
35583: वियद्गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Ganges or river of heaven. E. वियत् heaven, गङ्गा the river.
35584: वियद्गति f. (-तिः) Moving in the air. E. वियत्, and गति motion.
35585: वियद्भूति f. (-तिः) Darkness. E. वियत् the sky, and भूति superhuman power.
35586: वियन्मणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. वियत् the sky, and मणि a gem.
35587: वियम m. (-मः) 1 Forbearance, restraint. 2 Rest, cessation, stop. 3 Pain or distress of various kinds. E. वि before यम to check or restrain, aff. अप्; also वियाम.
35588: वियात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shameless, impudent, ill-behaved. E. वि implying prevention, and यात wished; wishing for what is prohibited or improper.
35589: वियाम m. (-मः) 1 Forbearance, restraint. 2 Rest, stop, cessation. 3 Pain or distress of various kinds. E. वि before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
35590: वियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Separated, sundered. E. वि privative, and युक्त jointed.
35591: वियोग m. (-गः) 1 Absence, separation, especially of lovers. 2 Disunion, disjunction. E. वि privative, and योग union.
35592: वियोगभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Suffering separation. E. वियोग separation, भज् to serve, to be subject to, causal form, aff. क्विप्.
35593: वियोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Separated, absent, remote, apart. m. (-गी) The ruddy goose. E. वियोग separation, and इनि aff.
35594: वियोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Separated, disjoined, disunited. 2 Parted from, deprived of. E. वि privative, योजित joined.
35595: विरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Averse, indifferent, free from inclination or affection. 2 Stoical, void of attachment to worldly objects. 3 Empassioned, interested, feeling passion or regard for any person or any thing. E. वि privative or pleonastic, before रञ्ज to feel passion, aff. क्त.
35596: विरक्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Disinclined to, disliking. E. विरक्त, and भाव quality.
35597: विरक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Aversion, disinclination. 2 Absence of affection. E. वि before रञ्ज to affect, क्तिन् aff.
35598: विरचत् mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्) Making, composing, fabricating, embellishing, &c. E. वि before रच to make, aff. शतृ.
35599: विरचन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Making. 2 Composing. 3 Embellishing. 4 Embellishment, any artificial and ornamental fabric or contrivance. E. वि before र to make, युच् aff.
35600: विरचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, prepared, effected. 2 Written, composed. 3 Trimmed, ornamented. 4 Contrived, constructed, arranged. E. वि pleonasm, and रच made, क्त aff.
35601: विरच्य ind. Having made. E. वि, रच to make, ल्यप् aff.
35602: विरजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Free from dust. f. (-जाः) A woman who has ceased to menstruate. E. वि privative, रजस् the menses.
35603: विरजस्तमस् m. (-माः) A virtuous man, one free form the two properties of ignorance and passion. E. वि privative, रजस the quality of passion, and तमस् that of ignorance.
35604: विरजा f. (-जा) 1 A plant, commonly कवित्थानी. 2 A sort of grass, commonly Dūb.
35605: विरजीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Exempt or freed from passion. 2 Clean, freed from dust, &c. E. वि priv., रजस् passion, &c., कृत made, च्चि augment.
35606: विरजीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Free from passion, pure, holy. 2 Clean, clear. E. वि priv., रजस् passion, भूत become, च्चि augment.
35607: विरञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) BRAHMĀ. E. वि before रच to create, aff. अच्, and नुम् augment, more properly विरिञ्च.
35608: विरट m. (-टः) 1 The name of a king. 2 The shoulder. 3 A black kind of Agallochum.
35609: विरण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthum.) E. see वीरण.
35610: विरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, ceased, rested. E. वि before रम to stop or rest, aff. क्त.
35611: विरति f. (-तिः) 1 Stop, cessation, term, rest. 2 End, term. E. वि before रम to play, क्तिन् aff.
35612: विरमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 1 Resting, stopping. 2 Sporting. E. वि before रम to sport, शतृ aff.
35613: विरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Fine, delicate, thin, (but with interstices.) 2 Loose, relaxed. 4 Apart, wide, separated by an interval. 4 Remote, rare, occurring at distant or repeated intervals of time. n. (-लं) Sour curds. E. वि apart, रा to go or be, aff. कलन्.
35614: विरलजानुक m. (-कः) A man with bandy legs. E. विरल wide, and जानु the knee, कन् added.
35615: विरलद्रवा f. (-वा) Gruel made of rice or other grain, with the addition, of Ghee, &c. E. विरल apart, द्रु to ooze, aff. अच्.
35616: विरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Insipid. E. वि, and रस flavour.
35617: विरह m. (-हः) 1 Separation, parting, absence, especially the separation of lovers. 2 Forbearance, cessation, relinquishment. E. वि before रह to abandon, aff. अच्.
35618: विरहय्य ind. Having abandoned. E. वि before रह to quit, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
35619: विरहार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained by the absence of a lover. E. विरह, and आर्त्त pained.
35620: विरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned, deserted, relinquished. 2 Void of exempt, or free from. E. वि before रह to abandon, aff. क्त.
35621: विरहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Separate, sundered, absent or apart from. f. (-हिणी) 1 Wages, hire. 2 A woman absent from her husband or lover. E. विरह absence, इनि aff.
35622: विरहोत्कण्ठिता f. (-ता) A woman whose lover or husband is absent. E. विरह separation, उत्कण्ठित afflicted.
35623: विराग m. (-गः) The absence of desire or passion, indifference, philosophy, the disregard of all sensual enjoyment either in  this world or the next. E. वि privative, and राग passion, desire.
35624: विरागार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Void of passion or desire. E. विराग the absence of desire, and अर्ह worthy.
35625: विरागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Void of passion or desire. E. विराग, and इनि aff.
35626: विराज् m. (-राट्) 1 A man of the regal or military class. 2 Splendour, beauty. 3 The first progeny of BRAHMĀ, who having divided himself into male and female, produced from the female, VIRĀJ; VIRĀJ then by himself produced the first Menu or SVAYAMBHUVA, who was the progenitor of the Prajāpatis, and the secondary framer of the visible world: in other places VIRĀJ is the same as BRAHMĀ, and assumer of the androgynous form in his own person. E. वि severally or separately, &c., राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.
35627: विराजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Shining, splendid, handsome. E. वि, and राज to shine, aff. शतृ.
35628: विराजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Splendid, brilliant, handsome. E. वि before राज to shine, शानच् aff.
35629: विराजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Illuminated, irradiated, splendid. 2 Manifested, made visible. E. वि before राज to shine, क्त aff.
35630: विराट m. (-टः) 1 A country, one of the midland divisions of India, probably Berar. 2 A sovereign. E. वि before रट to sound, aff. घञ्.
35631: विराटज m. (-जः) An inferior sort of diamond, said to be found in the country Virāṭa. E. विराट the country, and ज produced.
35632: विराणिन् m. (-णी) An elephant. E. वि before रण battle, aff. अण्, and इनि added.
35633: विराद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Treated with disrespect, reviled, abused. 2 Opposed. 3 Offended. E. वि before राध to accomplish, क्त aff.
35634: विराद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ) 1 Thwarting, opposing. 2 Offending, injuring. 3 Abusive, calumnious. E. वि before राध to accomplish, aff. तृच्.
35635: विराध m. (-धः) 1 Opposition, prevention. 2 Vexation, annoyance. E. वि before राध to accomplish, घञ् aff.
35637: विराध्यत् mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्) 1 Opposing, thwarting. 2 Offending, annoying, injuring. E. वि before राध to accomplish, शतृ aff.
35638: विराम m. (-मः) 1 End, conclusion, cessation, term. 2 Rest, cessation from labour. 3 Stop, pause. 4 Interval between words or sentences. E. वि before रम to stop, aff. घञ्.
35639: विराल m. (-लः) A cat. E. विडाल as above, and ड changed to र.
35640: विराव m. (-वः) Sound, noise. E. वि before रु to make a noise, aff. घञ्.
35641: विराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Shouting, roaring, crying, &c. f. (-णी) 1 A broom. 2 The name of a river. 3 Weeping, crying. E. विराव noise, इनि and ङीप् aff.
35642: विरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Purged. E. वि before रिच to void by stool, क्त aff.
35644: विरिञ्चन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ: see the next.
35645: विरिञ्चि m. (-ञ्चिः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 ŚIVA. E. वि implying various kinds, (of beings,) रच to make or create, इन् aff., the radical vowel changed to इ, and नुम् augment; also with अच् aff. विरिञ्च, and with युच्, विरिञ्चन; some authorities omit the change of the radical vowel, and write विरञ्च and विरञ्चि, but these seem to be less accurate.
35646: विरिब्ध m. (-ब्धः) A note, a tone. E. वि before रेभ to sound, क्त aff., इट् augment, form irr.
35647: विरुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Broken, bent. 2 Blunted. 3 Destroyed. E. वि before रुज to be sick, क्त aff.
35648: विरुद m. (-दः) 1 Crying. 2 Proclaiming. E. वि, रुद to cry, क aff.
35649: विरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Opposed, hindered. 2 Reverse, contrary, opposite. 3 Inconsistent, (in argument,) incongruous, a nonsequitur. 4 Opposed in quality, as sweet with sour, &c. 5 Disagreeing with each other, (as articles of medicine or food.) 6 Hostile, adverse. 7 Excluded, disqualified. 8 Surrounded, blockaded. E. वि before रुध to stop, aff. क्त.
35650: विरुद्धता f. (-ता) 1 Opposition, contraiety. 2 Incongruity. 3 Enmity. E. तल् added to विरुद्ध; also with त्व, विरुद्धत्वं.
35651: विरुद्धभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Eating incompatible things. E. विरुद्ध, and भुज who eats.
35652: विरुद्धभोजन n. (-नं) Incompatible food. E. विरुद्ध, and भोजन eating.
35653: विरुद्धान्न n. (-न्नं) Incompatible food. E. विरुद्ध, and अन्न food.
35654: विरूक्षण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Astringent, drying. n. (-णं) 1 Censure, blame, reviling, abuse. 2 Oath, imprecation. 3 Contracting, roughening, acting as an astringent. E. वि before रूक्ष to be rough, aff. ल्युट्.
35655: विरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Budded, blossomed. 2 Born. E. वि before रुह to grow, aff. क्त.
35656: विरूप mfn. (-पः-पा or -पी-पं) 1 Deformed, monstrous. 2 Unusual in form or nature, unnatural. n. (-पं) 1 Irregular or monstrous shape. 2 Difference of nature or character. f. (-पा) The wife of YAMA. E. वि implying variety, and रूप form.
35657: विरूपक mfn. (-कः-पिका-कं) 1 Frightful, hideous. 2 Deformed, mis-shapen. E. कन् added to the last.
35658: विरूपकरण n. (-णं) Disfiguring. E. विरूप, and करण making.
35659: विरूपाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 One of the Rudras. E. वि implying reverse, रूप form, and अक्ष the eye; having three eyes.
35660: विरेक m. (-कः) 1 Purging, evacuation by stool. 2 A purgative. E. वि before रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट्.
35661: विरेचन n. (-नं) 1 Purging, evacuation by stool. 2 A purgative. E. वि before रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट्.
35662: विरेचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purged, evacuated. E. वि before रिच to purge, क्त aff.
35663: विरेच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be purged. E. वि, रिच to purge, यत् aff.
35664: विरेफ m. (-फः) 1 A river in general. 2 The absence of the letter र. E. वि privative, रेफ the letter र, &c.
35665: विरेभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, uttered. E. वि before रेभे to sound, aff. क्त.
35666: विरोक n. (-कं) A hole, a chasm. m. (-कः) A ray of light. E. वि before रुच to shine, aff. घञ्.
35667: विरोचन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. 4 The son of the sovereign PRAHLĀDA. E. वि before रुच to shine, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
35668: विरोचनसुत m. (-तः) BALI, the sovereign of Mahābalipura. E. विरोचन the son of PRAHLĀDA, and सुत son.
35669: विरोचिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Shining. 2 Illuminating. E. वि before रुच to be light, इष्णुच् aff.
35670: विरोध m. (-धः) 1 Enmity, animosity. 2 Restraint, check, controul, confinement. 3 Opposition, contradiction. 4 Preventing, hindrance. 5 War. 6 Calamity, misfortune. 7 Surrounding, investing, siege, blockade. 8 Impediment to a successful progress of the story (in a play). 9 Antithesis, contrast. 10 Opposition of qualities (in articles of food or medicine, &c.) 11 Inconsistency, (in argument.) f. (-धी) Fixed rule, ordinance, institute. E. वि before रुध to stop, aff. घञ्.
35671: विरोधन n. (-नं) 1 Opposition, resistance, contradiction. 2 Hindering, obstructing, preventing. 3 Incongruity, inconsistency. 4 Taunting, provoking. 5 Encountering or defying peril. 6 Investing, blockading. E. वि before रुध to stop, aff. ल्युट्.
35672: विरोधिकृत् m. (-कृत्) The forty-fifth year of the Indian cycle. E. विरोधि opposition, कृत् making.
35673: विरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) 1 Inimical, adverse, hostile. 2 Opposing, preventing. 3 Obstructive. 4 Exclusive, disqualifying. 5 Contradictory, inconsistent. 6 Quarrelsome, contentious. 7 Of opposite and incompatible quality, (food, medicine, &c.) 8 Besieging, blockading. m. (-धी) 1 An enemy, an opponent. 2 The twenty-fourth year of the cycle. E. विरोध enmity, aff. इनि.
35674: विरोधोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Quarrel, dispute, mutual contradiction. E. विरोध contradiction, and उक्ति speech.
35675: विरोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, destitute, forsaken. E. वि, रुह to ascend, क्त aff.
35676: विल r. 6th cl. (विलति) 1 To wear, to put on, to clothe or cover. 2 To break or divide. r. 10th cl. (वेलयति) To throw, to cast, to direct or send.
35677: विल n. (-लं) 1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity. 2 A cave, a cavern. m. (-लः) 1 One of INDRA'S horses. 2 A sort of reed or cane, (Calamus rotang.) E. विल to divide, &c., aff. क.
35678: विलक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Astonished, surprised. 2 Abashed, ashamed. 3 Markless, having no mark or aim. 4 Contra-indicated, having a character or mark contrary to what is usual or natural. 5 Having no characteristic mark or property. E. वि before लक्ष to see, aff. अच्.
35679: विलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Other, different. n. (-णं) 1 State or condition for which no cause can be assigned, vain and causeless state. 2 Seeing, observing. E. वि privative or negative, and लक्षण a mark or sign.
35680: विलक्षत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Shame. 2 Surprise. 3 Absence of mark or aim. 4 Absence of distinguishing property. E. त्व added to विलक्ष; also with तल् aff. विलक्षता.
35681: विलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, observed. 2 Affected without a cause. 3 Undiscriminated, unmarked. E. वि inten. or priv., and लक्षित marked.
35682: विलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Joined or attached to, fixed on or connected with. n. (-ग्नं) The waist, the middle. E. वि before लग to be connected with, क्त aff., form irr.
35683: विलङ्घन n. (-नं) Overstepping, transgressing. E. वि before लघि to leap over, ल्युट् aff.
35684: विलङ्घनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be transgressed or overstepped. E. वि before लघि to leap over, अनीयर् aff.
35685: विलङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Transgressed, overstepped. E. वि before लघि to leap over, क्त aff.
35686: विलज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Shameless, impudent, unabashed. E. वि privative, लज्जा shame.
35687: विलज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Modest. E. वि before लस्ज to be modest, शानच् aff.
35688: विलपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) 1 Speaking, talking. 2 Prating, talking idly or wildly. E. वि before लप to speak, शतृ aff.
35689: विलपन n. (-नं) 1 The dirt or sediment of any oily substance, as of clarified butter, &c. 2 Talking, chattering, talking idly or wildly. E. वि before लप to speak, aff. ल्युट्.
35690: विलपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said. 2 Chattered. 3 Lamented, spoken in grief, spoken idly. E. वि before लप to speak, क्त aff.
35691: विलम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 Falling or hanging down, pendulousness. 2 Slowness, tardiness, delay. E. वि before लबि to go, aff. अच्.
35692: विलम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Delaying, retarding. 2 Hanging on or from, depending. E. वि before लबि to go, ल्युट् aff.
35693: विलम्बमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Suspended on, hanging on or from. E. वि before लबि to go, शानच् aff.
35694: विलम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Falling, pendulous, hanging or fallen down. 2 Slow, tardy, retarded. 3 Slow, (as time in music,) adagio. E. विलम्ब delay, &c., इतच् aff.
35695: विलम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) 1 Delaying, retarding. 2 Pendulous, depending, hanging on or from. m. (-म्बी) The thirty-second year of the Indian cycle. E. विलम्ब slowness, delay, इनि aff.
35696: विलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Gift, donation, giving. E. वि reverse, लभि to get or gain, aff. अच्.
35697: विलय m. (-यः) 1 Destruction of the world. 2 Destruction in general. 3 Liquefaction. E. वि before ली to liquefy, aff. अच्.
35698: विलयन n. (-नं) 1 Destroying. 2 Corroding, eating away. 3 Liquefying. 4 Removing, taking away. 5 Attenuating, (as the fluids of the body.) 6 An attenuant. 7 An escharotic. E. वि before ली to melt, ल्युट् aff.
35699: विलला f. (-ला) A sort of Sida, (S. cordifolia, &c.) E. वि before लल to shake, aff. अच् and टाप्.
35700: विलवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living in a hole, burrowing. m. (-सी) A snake. E. विल a hole, and वासिन् who inhabits.
35701: विलशय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Living or burrowing in holes. m. (-यः) A snake. E. विल a hole, शी to sleep, aff. श.
35702: विलसत् mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्) 1 Shining, beautiful, splendid. 2 Sportive, wanton. E. वि before लस to shine, &c., aff. शतृ.
35703: विलसन n. (-नं) Sporting, dallying. E. वि before लस to shine, ल्युट् aff.
35704: विलसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sportive, wanton. n. (-तं) Wanton pastime or gestures. E. वि before लस to shine, क्त aff.
35705: विलाप m. (-पः) Lamentation, the language of grief and distress. E. वि before लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
35706: विलाल m. (-लः) 1 An instrument, a machine. 2 A cat. E. वि before लल to desire, &c., aff. घञ्, or विडाल as above, and ड changed to its congener ल.
35707: विलास m. (-सः) 1 One kind of feminine action, considered as proceeding from and indicative of amorous sentiments; change of place, posture, gait or look, on the approach of the lover, as hiding at his approach, assuming a look of displeasure, &c. 2 Sport, pastime, play, especially amorous pastime, dalliance, wantonness. 3 Grace, elegance. E. वि before लस to desire, aff. घञ्.
35708: विलासकानन n. (-नं) A pleasure ground. E. विलास sport, and कानन a wood, a grove.
35709: विलासमन्दिर n. (-रं) A pleasure house, a summer house, &c. E. विलास sport, and मन्दिर a building.
35710: विलासवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sportive, dallying, wanton. E. विलास, and मतुप् aff.
35712: विलासिका f. (-का) A drama in one act on any light subject or adventure. E. वि, लस to shine, ण्वुल् aff. fem. form.
35713: विलासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Wanton, sportive, dallying. m. (-सी) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. 4 A sensualist, an enjoyer. 5 A snake. 6 ŚIVA. 7 KṚṢṆA. 8 KĀMA or CUPID. f. (-सिनी) 1 A woman. 2 A whore, a harlot. E. विलास pastime, &c., aff. इनि or वि, लस to shine, घिनुण् aff.; also read विलाषिन्.
35714: विलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Anointed, plastered, smeared. E. वि before लिप to smear, क्त aff.
35715: विलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Liquid, liquified, semifluid, as melted oil or butter, &c. 2 Disappeared, perished, removed from sight, either temporarily or permanently. 3 Imagined, formed or infused, as in the mind. 4 Contiguous to, in contact with, united or blended with. E. वि before ली to melt, &c., aff. क्त.
35716: विलुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Seized, taken. 2 Cut off. 3 Lost. E. वि before लुप to cut off, क्त aff.
35717: विलुभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bewildered, disturbed, agitated. 2 Shaken, (by the wind.) E. वि before लुभ to beguile, क्त aff.
35718: विलुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tremulous, shaking, waving. E. वि before लुल to agitate, क्त aff.
35719: विलेखन n. (-नं) 1 Digging, delving, rooting up. 2 Dividing, splitting. 3 Making marks or furrows. E. वि before लिख to write, aff. ल्युट्.
35720: विलेप m. (-पः) 1 Ointment, unguent, especially fragrant unguent of Sandal, Agallochum, &c.. 2 Mortar, plaster. 3 Anointing, plastering. (-पी) Rice-gruel. E. वि before लिप to anoint or smear, aff. घञ्.
35721: विलेपन n. (-नं) 1 Perfume for the person, unguent or oil of Sandal, saffron, camphor, bdellium, &c. 2 Smearing the body with fragrant oils, &c. 2 Plastering. f. (-नी) 1 A woman adorned with perfumes, &c. 2 Rice-gruel. E. वि before लिप to smear, aff. ल्युट्.
35722: विलेप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be spread or plastered. m. (-प्यः) Ricegruel. E. वि before लिप to smear, aff. ण्यत्
35723: विलेवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living or burrowing in holes. m. (-सी) A snake. E. विल 7th case, वासिन् who dwells.
35724: विलेशय m. (-यः) 1 A snake. 2 A rat. 3 A hare. 4 Any animal living or burrowing in holes. E. विल a hole, in the seventh case, and शय who sleeps or dwells.
35725: विलोक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Solitary, lonely. E. वि priv., लोक a person.
35726: विलोकन nf. (-नं-ना) Sight, seeing, looking. E. वि before लोकृ to see, युच् aff.
35727: विलोकनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Agreeable, beautiful, fit to be seen or looked at. E. वि before लोक to see, अनीयर् aff.
35728: विलोकनीयता f. (-ता) Loveliness, beauty. E. तल् added to the last.
35729: विलोकयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Seeing, looking at. E. वि before लोक to see, शतृ aff.
35730: विलोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. वि before लोकृ to see, aff. क्त.
35731: विलोचन n. (-नं) The eye. E. वि before लोच to see, aff. ल्युट्.
35732: विलोचनपात m. (-तः) A glance, a look. E. विलोचन, and पात alighting.
35733: विलोचनाम्बु n. (-म्बु) Tears. E. विलोचन, and अम्बु water.
35734: विलोटक m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Clupea cultrata.) E. वि before लुट to roll on the ground, aff. खुल्.
35735: विलोडन n. (-नं) 1 Agitating, shaking, churning. 2 Rolling or tossing. E. वि, लुड to agitate, ल्युट् aff.
35736: विलोडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Agitated, churned, shaken. 2 Rolling or tumbling on the ground. E. वि before लोड to be tremulous, aff. क्त.
35737: विलोपन n. (-नं) 1 Destruction. 2 Deluding. E. वि before लुप to cut, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35738: विलोभ m. (-भः) Attraction, delusion, seduction. E. वि before लुभ to delude, aff. घञ्.
35739: विलोभन n. (-नं) 1 Allurement, attraction, temptation, seduction. 2 Beguiling, perplexing. 3 Praise, commendation, especially by contrast with inferiority. E. वि before लुभ to delude, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
35740: विलोभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Allured, beguiled. 2 Deceived. 3 Praised. E. वि before लुभ to delude, causal v., क्त aff.
35741: विलोभ्य ind. Having beguiled, fascinated, &c. E. वि before लुभ to delude, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
35742: विलोभ्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being fascinated, overcome, beguiled, &c. E. वि before लुभ to beguile, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35743: विलोम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Reverse, opposite, contrary, backward, against the hair or grain. m. (-मः) 1 Reverse, opposite course or order, &c. 2 A snake. 3 VARUṆA, regent of the waters. 4 A dog. n. (-मं) A water-wheel or machine for raising water. f. (-मी) Emblic myrobalan. E. वि implying difference, &c., and लोम the hair of the body; also with कन् added विलोमक.
35744: विलोमक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Doing any thing backwards or in reverse order. 2 (In arithmetic,) Rule of Inversion. E. विलोम, and क्रिया act.
35745: विलोमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born of a father of an inferior caste and mother of a superior. E. विलोम inverse order, and ज born; also विलोमजात, विलोमोत्पन्न, &c.
35746: विलोमजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) An elephant. E. विलोम reversed, जिह्वा the tongue.
35747: विलोमत्रैराशिक n. (-कं) Rule of Three inverse. E. विलोम, and त्रैराशिक rule of Three.
35748: विलोमवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A man of mixed or inferior birth. E. विलोम contrary to the proper order, (of marriage, &c.) and वर्ण a class.
35749: विलोमविधि f. (-धिः) 1 Inverted or reversed ceremony. 2 (In arithmetic,) Rule of Inversion. E. विलोम, and विधि rule.
35750: विलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Shaking, trembling, tremulous. 2 Fickle, unsteady. 3 Rolling, (as the eyes.) 4 Tossing, waving. E. वि before लुल to agitate, aff. घञ्.
35751: विलोलता f. (-ता) 1 Tremulousness. 2 Unsteadiness. 3 Rolling, (of the eyes.) E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विलोलत्वं.
35752: विलोलन n. (-नं) Shaking, stirring, agitating. E. वि before लुल to agitate, causal v., aff. ल्युट्.
35753: विलोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated, tossed. E. वि before लुल to agitate, causal v., क्त aff.
35754: विलौकस् m. (-काः) Any animal living in holes, a reptile. E. विल, and ओकस् abode.
35755: विल्ल n. (-ल्लं) 1 A pit, a hole. 2 Asafoetida. E. विल a hole, लच् aff.
35756: विल्लमूला f. (-ला) A sort of yam: see वाराही.
35757: विल्व m. (-ल्वः) A fruit tree, commonly named Bel, (Ægle marmelos.) n. (-ल्वं) 1 The fruit of the Bel. 2 A measure, the same as the Pala. E. विल to divide, Uṇādi aff. वन्.
35758: विवक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Wish, desire. 2 The wish to speak. E. वच to speak, in the desiderative form, aff. अच्.
35759: विवक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Purposed, intended. 3 Literal, not figurative, (a word or phrase.) 4 Intended to be spoken or said. n. (-तं) An object desired. f. (-ता) Purpose, wish, what one wishes to declare or speak. E. वच to speak, desiderative form, क्त aff.
35760: विवक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to speak. E. वच to speak, desid. v., उ aff.
35761: विवञ्चिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Crafty, deceitful. E. वि before वञ्च to trick, desid. v., उ aff.
35762: विवत्सा f. (-त्सा) A cow whose calf is dead. E. वि priv., वत्स a calf.
35763: विवदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Disputing, contending. 2 Litigating. E. वि variously, वद to speak, शतृ aff.
35764: विवदमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Disagreeing, contending, maintaining different arguments. 2 Litigating. E. वि before वद to speak, शानच् aff.
35765: विवध m. (-धः) 1 A road, a highway. 2 A yoke for carrying burdens. 3 A load. 4 Storing grain or hay, &c. 5 An ewer, a pitcher. E. वि before वध to strike, aff. घञ्; also वीवध.
35766: विवधिक m. (-कः) A chandler. E. विवध storing grain, ठन् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also वैवधिक.
35767: विवन्दिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous or wishing to praise. E. वदि to praise, desid. v., उ aff.
35768: विवर n. (-रं) 1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity. 2 Fault, defect. 3 Separation, disjunction. E. वि before वृञ् to choose, to cover, &c., and अच् aff.
35769: विवरण n. (-णं) 1 Explanation, exposition, gloss, comment. 2 Interpretation, translation. 3 Uncovering, exposing, laying bare or open. 4 Detailing, describing. E. वि before वृ to select (the meaning), aff. ल्युट्.
35770: विवरनालिका f. (-का) A pipe, a fife, a flute. E. विवर a hole, a perforation, नाल a pipe, कन् added, fem. form.
35771: विवरिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to make manifest or declare. E. वि before वृ to choose, desid. v., उ aff.
35772: विवर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Abandoning, leaving, shunning. E. वि before वृज to leave, ल्युट् aff.
35773: विवर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be avoided, shunned, quitted, &c. E. वि before वृज to abandon, अनीयर् aff.
35774: विवर्ज्जयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Avoiding, leaving. E. वि before वृज to quit, शतृ aff.
35775: विवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, abandoned, avoided, shunned. E. वि before वृज to leave, aff. क्त.
35776: विवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Low, vile. 2 Bad coloured. 3 Wanting colour. 4 Changing colour. m. (-र्णः) A man of a low caste, one of degrading occupation, an outcaste. E. वि privative, and वर्ण caste.
35777: विवर्णवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Pale-faced. E. विवर्ण colourless, वदन face.
35778: विवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Assemblage, collection, heap or multitude. 2 Dancing. 3 Going or turning round, revolving, returning. 4 Human error, worldly ignorance, the confounding of truth and falsehood, or the mistaking of unreal objects and conceiving them to be what they are not, as mirage for water, a rope for a snake, &c. 5 Modification, various or altered state or condition. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. क्त.
35779: विवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Going round, circumambulating an altar, &c. 2 Revolving, turning round. 3 Whirling, causing to go round. 4 Returning. 5 Passing through in succession, as various lives, various hells, &c. 5 Being, abiding. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. ल्युट्.
35780: विवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Turning back or round, recoiling, revolving, returning, &c. E. वि before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
35781: विवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Revolved, returned. 2 Whirled round. 3 Turned back or away. E. वि before वृत to be, क्त aff.
35782: विवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Increase. 2 Cutting, dividing. E. वि before वृध to increase, to cut, ल्युट् aff.
35783: विवर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Increased, enlarged. 2 Cut, divided. E. वि before वृध to increase, to cut, क्त aff.
35784: विवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Subject, subjected. 2 Independant. 3 Apprehensive of death, unwilling though about to die. 4 Desirous of death, sedate at that period, or having the soul free from worldly cares and fears. 5 Uncontrouled, unrestrained, unsubdued. E. वि before वश to wish, aff. अच्.
35785: विवस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Unclothed, naked. E. वि priv., and वस्त्र clothes.
35786: विवस्वत् m. (-स्वान्) 1 A god. 2 The sun. 3 ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. 4 The seventh or present MANU; also VAIVASVATA. f. (-ती) The city of the sun. E. वि implying variety, वस to cover or hide, affix क्विप्, विवस् here said therefore to imply various covering, as a garment of light, i. e. the rays of the sun, and मतुप् poss. aff.
35787: विवात् mfn. (-वान्-वान्ती-वाती-वात्) Blowing, blowing gently. E. वि before वा to blow, शतृ aff.
35788: विवाद m. (-दः) 1 Contest, contention. 2 Contest at law, a legal dispute, litigation, a law suit. E. वि before वद to speak, aff. घञ्.
35789: विवादानुगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disputed, litigated. E. विवाद a law suit, अनु according to, and गत gone.
35790: विवादार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for a dispute or quarrel. m. (-र्थी) A litigant, a prosecutor, a plaintiff. E. विवाद, and अर्थिन् who seeks.
35791: विवादास्पदीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Litigated, contested at law. E. विवाद, and आस्पद place, भूत become, च्चि augment.
35792: विवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Disputing, contending, a litigant. E. विवाद, and इनि aff.
35793: विवार m. (-रः) 1 Dilatation, expansion. 2 Open or expanded state of the organs of speech for the articulation of vowels and sibilants. E. वि before वृ to cover, घञ् aff.
35794: विवास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Without clothes, naked. m. (-सः) Banishment. E. वि priv., and वास vesture or abode.
35795: विवासकरण n. (-णं) Banishing, transporting. E. विवास, and करण making.
35796: विवासन n. (-नं) Exile, banishment. E. वि away, वासन abiding.
35797: विवासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Banished, expelled. E. वि, and वस to dwell, causal v., क्त aff.
35798: विवास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be expelled or transported. E. वि away, वस to dwell, causal v., यत् aff.
35799: विवाह m. (-हः) Marriage. E. वि mutually, वह to take, aff. घञ्.
35800: विवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Married. E. वि before वह to bear, causal v., क्त aff.
35801: विवाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Marriageable, to be married. m. (-ह्यः) A son-in-law, a bridegroom. E. विवाह marriage, and यत् aff.
35802: विविक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Lonely, solitary, desart. 2 Pure, faultless. 3 Separated, distinguished, disjoined, detached. 4 Discriminative, judicious, a judge. 5 Discriminated, judged. 6 Profound, (as judgment or thought.) 7 Intent on. E. वि before विच to be or make separate, aff. क्त.
35803: विविक्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Intent upon any object. E. विविक्त, and भाव disposition.
35804: विविक्तसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Solitary, retired, recluse, seeking or affecting solitude. E. विविक्त, and सेविन् who serves or pursues.
35805: विविक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षती-क्षत्) Wishing or purposing to enter. E. विश to enter, desid. v., शतृ Aff.
35806: विविक्षा f. (-क्षा) Wish or purpose to enter. E. विश to enter, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
35807: विविक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing or intending to enter. E. विश to enter, desid. v., उ aff.
35808: विविच्य ind. Having considered, discussed, judged. E. विच to judge, with वि prefixed, and ल्यप् aff.
35809: विविदिवस् mfn. (-वान्-द्युषी-वस्) Obtaining, getting. E. विद to know, वसु aff., with इट् inserted.
35810: विविद्वस् mfn. (-द्वान्-दुषी-द्वस) Knowing, wise. E. विद to know, वसु aff.
35811: विविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Various, multiform, of many sorts. E. वि before विधि sort, kind.
35812: विविशिवस् mfn. (-वान्-श्युषी-वस्) Entering. E. विश to enter, root rep., वसु aff., इट् augment.
35813: विविश्वस् mfn. (-श्वान्-शुषी-श्वस्) Entering, who or what enters. E. विश to enter, वसु aff., root rep.
35814: विवीत m. (-तः) An inclosed spot of ground, abounding in grass, wood, &c., a preserved pasture, a paddock, &c. E. वि privative, and वीत gone.
35815: विवीतभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The superintendant or owner of a preserved pasture. E. विवीत a paddock, &c., and भर्त्तृ a master.
35816: विवृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Abandoned, left. f. (-क्ता) A woman disliked or deserted by her husband. E. वि before वृच to abandon, aff. क्त.
35817: विवृत m. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expanded, extended, extensive, large. 2 Evident, displayed, made manifest. 3 Exposed, discovered. 4 Opened. 5 Explained, interpreted, expounded. 6 Open (as the organs of speech for the articulation of vowels and sibilants.) f. (-ता) A disease, an ulcer attended with much pain and heat. E. वि before वृ to be, aff. क्त.
35818: विवृताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Large-eyed. m. (-क्षः) A cock. E. विवृत large, अक्षि the eye, and अच् aff.
35819: विवृति f. (-तिः) 1 Explanation, exposition, gloss, comment, interpretation. 2 Making clear or manifest. 3 Discovery, exposure. E. वि before वृ to prefer or choose, aff. क्तिन्.
35820: विवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Turned or twisted round, whirling, revolving, rolling. E. वि before वृत to be, क्त aff.
35821: विवृत्सत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Wishing to be. E. वृत to be, desid. v., शतृ aff.
35822: विवृत्सितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what wishes to be. E. वृत to be, desid. v., तृच् aff.
35823: विवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Turning round, rolling, whirling, tumbling. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्.
35824: विवृद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Augmented, increased. E. वि, and वृद्ध the same.
35825: विवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Growth, increase, augmentation. E. वि before वृद्धि the same.
35826: विवेक m. (-कः) 1 Discrimination, judgment, the faculty of distinguishing things by their properties, and classing them according to their real not apparent nature; in the Vedānta system, it is applied to the power of separating Brahma or invisible spirit, from the ostensible world, truth from untruth, or reality from illusion. 2 Discussion, investigation. 3 A reservoir, a bath. E. वि severally, विच to judge, aff. घञ्.
35827: विवेकता f. (-ता) Judgment, discrimination, the faculty or property of judgment. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विवेकत्वं.
35828: विवेकदृश्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Discrimination, discernment. E. विवेकदृश्वन्, and त्व aff.; or with तल्, विवेकदृश्वता.
35829: विवेकदृश्वन् m. (-श्वा) A wise or discerning man. E. विवेक, and दृश्वन् who sees.
35830: विवेकिता f. (-ता) Discussion, discrimination, discriminativeness. E. विवेकी discriminative, and तल् aff.; also विवेकित्व n. (-त्वं)
35831: विवेकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Judicious, discriminative. m. (-की) A sage, a philosopher, a judge. E. वि before विच to judge, घिनुण् aff.
35832: विवेक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be discussed or judged. E. वि before विच to judge, तव्य aff.; also विवेच्य and विवेचनीय.
35833: विवेचन n. (-नं) Discrimination, judgment, distinguishing truth from falsehood. E. वि before विच to judge, aff. ल्युट्.
35834: विवेचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be judged or discussed. E. वि, विच् to judge, अनीयर् aff.
35835: विवोढृ m. (-ढा) A husband, a bridegroom, a lover. E. वि before वह to obtain, aff. तृन्.
35836: विव्रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वती-वत्) Silent, refraining from or refusing to speak. E. वि privative वुवत् speaking.
35837: विव्वोक m. (-कः) Affectation of indifference, one of the branches of amorous dalliance, or feminine actions, tending to excite love or desire. E. वि before वा to go, aff. कु, विवु said here to mean a particular gait, and ओक house, place, site.
35838: विश r. 6th cl. (विशति) 1 To enter, to pervade. With आङ् or प्र prefixed, 1 To go in, to enter. 2 To occupy or engross. With उप, 1 To sit, to sit down. 2 To approach. With नि, 1 To dwell, to abide. 2 To place or station. With नि or अभि and नि, 1 To rest, to halt, to sit down, especially before or in presence of. 2 To conceal. With निर्, To go out or forth. With परि, To, place before, to present. With सम, To lie down, to repose. With सम् and नि, To be near, to be close to or in the neighbourhood. With सम् and आङ्, To introduce.
35839: विश n. (-शं) The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily. E. विश to enter, aff. क.
35840: विश् m. (विट्) 1 A man of the mercantile tribe. 2 A man in general. f. (विट्) 1 Entrance. 2 A daughter. E. विश to enter, aff. क्विप्.
35841: विशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless, undaunted. E. वि, and शङ्का fear.
35842: विशङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा or -टी-टं) Great, large. E. वि the particle, and शङ्कटच् aff. in this sense.
35843: विशङ्कमान mfn. (-नः-ना-न) Fearing, apprehending. E. वि before शकि to doubt, शानच् aff.
35844: विशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Entering. E. विश to enter, शतृ aff.
35845: विशद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Of a white colour. 2 Clear, pure, pellucid. 3 Evident, apparent, manifest. 4 Beautiful. m. (-दः) White, the colour. E. वि before शद to wither or perish, aff. अच्.
35846: विशय m. (-यः) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 Refuge, asylum. E. वि before शी to sleep, अच् aff.
35847: विशयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Dubious, uncertain. 2 Doubting. E. विशय doubt, इनि aff., or वि before शी to sleep, णिनि aff.
35848: विशर m. (-रः) Killing, slaying, slaughter. E. वि before शृ to injure or kill, aff. अप्; also with ल्युट्, aff. विशरण n. (-णं).
35849: विशल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Free from thorns or spikes. 2 Free from care or pain. f. (-ल्या) 1 A twining shrub, (Menispermum cordifolium.) 2 A sort of potherb, the kind not ascertained. 3 A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) 4 Another, commonly Teori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) 5 A sort of fruit, Langaliya. E. वि privative, and शल्य a stalk or stem.
35850: विशल्यकृत् m. (-कृत्) A plant, (Echites dichotoma, Rox.)
35851: विशसन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaying, slaughter. 2 Dissecting, cutting. m. (-नः) A sabre, a crooked sword. E. वि before शस to hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
35852: विशसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hurt, killed. 2 Cut, dissected. 3 Wellmannered. E. वि before शस to injure, aff. क्त, and इट् augment.
35853: विशसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Killing. 2 Dissecting. E. वि before शस to kill, तृच् aff.
35854: विशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Praised, celebrated. 2 Arrogant, ill-mannered, rude. E. वि before शस to praise, aff. क्त.
35855: विशस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Disarmed, unarmed. E. वि, and शस्त्र a weapon.
35856: विशाकार m. (-रः) A plant, (Euphorbia of various kinds.)
35857: विशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Branchless. m. (-खः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. 3 A solicitor, a petitioner, a beggar. 4 A spindle. f. (-खा) The sixteenth lunar asterism, figured by a festoon, and containing four, or according to some, two stars, one of which is α or κ Libra. 2 A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica charantia.) E. वि without, शाख a branch, or विशाखा the asterism, (by which personified the god was cherished,) अण् aff., and the vowel unchanged.
35858: विशाखज m. (-जः) The orange, (Citrus aurantium.) E. विशाख the asterism, and जन् to be born; aff. ड; coming into season, when the sun is in this asterism, or about the end of October.
35859: विशाखल n. (-लं) An attitude in shooting. E. विशाखा the same, and लच् pleonasm.
35860: विशाय m. (-यः) Sleeping, and watching alternately. E. वि intervening, शी to sleep, aff. घञ्.
35861: विशारण n. (-णं) Killing, slaying, slaughter. E. वि before शॄ to injure, aff. ल्युट्.
35862: विशारद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Learned, wise. 2 Confident, bold, presuming. 3 Famous, celebrated. E. विशाल great, extensive, (fame, &c.) and दा to give, aff. क, the ल changed to र.
35863: विशाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Great, large. 2 Broad. 3 Great, eminent, illustrious. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 A sort of bird. f. (-ला) 1 The city Ougein. 2 Bitter apple, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. वि particle, and शालच् aff., or विश to enter, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.
35864: विशालकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Well born. n. (-लं) An illustrious family. E. विशाल, and कुल race.
35865: विशालता f. (-ता) 1 Width, breadth. 2 Magnitude, bulk. 2 Eminence, distinction. E. विशाल large, तल् aff. of the abstract; also विशालत्व n. (-त्वं)
35866: विशालत्वच् m. (-त्वक्) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. विशाल large, and त्वच् skin or bark.
35867: विशालाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Having large or beautiful eyes. m. (-क्षः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 GARUḌA. f. (-क्षी) PĀRVATĪ. E. विशाल large, and अक्षि the eye, टच् aff.
35868: विशिख m. (-खः) 1 An arrow. 2 An iron crow. f. (-खा) 1 A spade, a hoe. 2 A highway, a broad or carriage road. 3 A very minute arrow, a sort of needle or spindle. 4 A barber's wife. 5 A sick room, or the dwelling of the sick. E. वि implying possessed of, &c., and शिखा a crest.
35869: विशिञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding. E. वि before शिजि to sound, शानच् aff.
35870: विशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sharpened. E. वि before शि to sharpen, क्त aff.
35871: विशिप n. (-पं) A palace, a temple. E. विश to enter, अप Uṇādi aff., and इ substituted for the pen. vowel.
35872: विशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Endowed with, possessed of, having, inherent or attached to. 2 Excellent, superior, distinguished. 3 Especial, peculiar. 4 Having distinctive and exclusive properties. E. वि before शिष to tell qualities, aff. क्त.
35873: विशिष्टता f. (-ता) 1 Excellence, distinction. 2 Individuality, having distinguishing or characteristic qualities. 3 Peculiarity, as of duty, &c. E. तल् added to the last; also विशिष्टत्न.
35874: विशीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Dry, dried up, withered, decayed. 2 Wasted, impaired. E. वि before शॄ to injure, क्त aff.
35875: विशीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To crumble or fall to ruin, likely or fit to. E. वि before शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
35876: विशीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being wasted or destroyed, decaying, perishing. E. वि before शॄ to injure, pass. v., शानच् aff.
35877: विशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Ill-behaved, indecorous, immoral. E. वि priv., शील behaved.
35878: विशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pure, purified, clean, cleansed, free from vice or fault. 2 Pious, virtuous. 3 Humble, modest, compliant. 4 Corrected. E. वि intensitive prefix, and शुद्ध pure, clean.
35879: विशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Purity, purification. 2 Equality, similarity. 3 Removal of doubt. 4 Correctness. 5 In Algebra, a subtractive quantity. E. वि before शुद्धि purity.
35880: विशुद्धिभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Pure, free from soil or vice. E. विशुद्धि, and भाज् who shares.
35881: विशृङ्खल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unchecked, unrestrained, unfettered, (literally or figuratively.) E. वि privative, and शृङ्खला a chain.
35882: विशेष m. (-षः) 1 Sort, kind, manner. 2 Difference, individual or specific identity and consequent distinction from every other individual or species. 3 (In logic,) The peculiar attribute, (predicabile proprium,) the cause of perception of exclusion. 4 Excellence, superiority. 5 A limb, a member. 6 A mark on the forehead with Sandal. 7 A figure of rhetoric, distinguished as of three kinds, all implying variety of means or effect. E. वि discriminative prefix, शिष to attribute or distinguish by attributes, aff. घञ्.
35883: विशेषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Discriminative, distinguishing, attributive, characteristic. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A mark on the forehead made with Sandal, &c., and worn either as an ornament or sectarial distinction. 2 An attribute, a predicate. 3 An arrangement of poetical composition. E. वि before शिष to attribute, or distinguish, aff. ण्वुल्.
35884: विशेषकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Amorous, desirous. E. विशेष, and काम who desires.
35885: विशेषगुण m. (-णः) An object of a single and distinct kind, as the soul, mind, time, place, and the atoms of earth, water, light, and air. E. विशेष, and गुण property.
35886: विशेषज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Wise, intelligent. E. विशेष, and ज्ञ who knows.
35887: विशेषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Discriminative, attributive. 2 Distinctive, (as a property, &c.) n. (-णं) 1 Distinguishing, discriminating. 2 An epithet, an attribute, an adjective. E. वि before शिष to distinguish by attributes, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
35888: विशेषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be discriminated or distinguished, what may or ought to be marked as distinct. E. वि before शिष to distinguish, अनीयर् aff.
35889: विशेषतस् ind. Especially, particularly, specifically. E. विशेष, and तसि aff.
35890: विशेषधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Peculiar or different duty. E. विशेष, and घर्म्म duty.
35891: विशेषभावना f. (-ना) 1 Reflecting on or perceiving differences. 2 (In algebra,) Composition by the difference of the products. E. विशेष, and भावना considering.
35892: विशेषलक्षण n. (-णं) Specific or characteristic mark or sign. E. विशेष, and लक्षण mark.
35893: विशेषवचन n. (-नं) Special or different text. E. विशेष, and वचन a text.
35894: विशेषविद्वस् m. (-द्वान्) A sage, a philosopher. E. विशेष excellence, and विद्वान् learned.
35895: विशेषविधि f. (-घिः) Special rule or observance. E. विशेष, and विधि rule.
35896: विशेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Divided, distinguished, separated. 2 Predicated, attributed, having as an attribute or being distinguished by it. 3 Excellent, superior. E. विशेष sort, kind, &c., इतच् aff.
35897: विशेषोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 A figure of rhetoric, coupling cause with effect, so as to explain any peculiar manner or condition. 2 Panegyric, recapitulation of merits. E. विशेष sort, kind, and उक्ति saying.
35898: विशेष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) To be distinguished or discriminated. 2 Distinguishing, to be discriminated by. 3 Principal, primary, chief. m. (-ष्यः) A name, a substantive. n. (-ष्यं) The object of a predicate. E. वि before शिष to distinguish by its attributes, and ण्यत् aff.
35899: विशोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Without grief, happy. E. वि priv., शोक sorrow.
35900: विशोधन n. (-नं) Cleaning, purifying, freeing from soil, defect, or sin. f. (-नी) 1 A plant, commonly Nāgadanti. 2 The capital of BRAHMĀ. E. वि before शुघ to be pure, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35901: विशोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cleaned or purified, to be freed from soil, fault, &c. E. वि before शुध to be pure, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विशोधितव्य and विशोध्य.
35902: विशोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified, cleansed, freed from soil, &c. E. वि before शुघ to be pure, causal v., क्त aff.
35903: विशोधित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Cleaning, purifying. 2 Clearing, freeing from obstructions. E. विशोघिन्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, विशोधिता.
35904: विशोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) 1 Cleaning, purifying. 2 Clearing. E. वि before शुध to be pure, causal v., णिनि aff.
35905: विशोषण n. (-णं) Drying, desiccating. E. वि before शुष to be dry, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35906: विशोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dried, dried up. E. वि before शुष to be dry, causal v., क्त aff.
35907: विश्न m. (-श्नः) Lustre, shining. E. विच्छ to shine, नङ् aff.
35908: विश्रणन n. (-नं) Gift, giving, donation. E. वि before श्रण to give, ल्युट् aff.; also विश्राणन.
35909: विश्रब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Trusted, confided in, confided to. 2 Patient, tranquil. 3 Lowly-minded, not lofty, not magnanimous. 4 Excessive, exceeding, much. 5 Firm, steady. 6 Rested, reposed. E. वि before श्रम to be weary or स्रम्भ to trust, &c. aff. क्तः see विस्रब्ध.
35910: विश्रब्धता f. (-ता) Trust-worthiness. E. विश्रब्ध, and तल् aff.
35911: विश्रम m. (-मः) Rest, repose, cessation from fatigue or work. E. वि privative, श्रम to be weary, aff. अच्; also विश्राम.
35912: विश्रमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wearied, exhausted. E. विश्रम, and इतच् aff.
35913: विश्रम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Trust, confidence. 2 Affection, affectionate inquiry. 3 Festive or sportive noise or tumult. E. वि before स्रम्भ to trust, aff. घञ्, and the initial optionally changed; also विस्रम्भ.
35914: विश्रम्य ind. Having rested. E. वि before श्रम to be weary, ल्यप् aff.
35915: विश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Abode, asylum. 2 Dependance upon. E. वि, श्री to serve, श aff.
35916: विश्रयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि) 1 Living or dwelling in. 2 Serving, depending on. E. वि before श्री to serve, घिनुण् aff.
35917: विश्राणन n. (-णं) Gift, giving, donation. E. वि before श्रण to give, r. 10th cl. aff. ल्युट्.
35918: विश्राणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bestowed, given. E. वि before श्रण to give, r. 10th cl. क्त aff.
35919: विश्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Rested, reposed. 2 Ceasing, desisting from. 3 Calm, composed. E. वि before श्रान्त the same.
35920: विश्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Rest, repose, cessation from toil or occupation. E. वि before श्रम to be weary, aff. क्तिन्.
35921: विश्राम m. (-मः) 1 Rest, repose. 2 Pause, stop, cessation. 3 Tranquillity, composure. E. वि before श्रम to be weary, aff. घञ्.
35922: विश्राव m. (-वः) 1 Fame, celebrity. 2 Flowing, dropping. E. वि before श्रु to hear or to drop, aff. घञ्.
35923: विश्रावण n. (-णं) 1 Causing to flow or drop. 2 Bleeding. 3 Apprising, causing to hear. E. वि before श्रु to ooze, &c., causal v., ल्युट् aff.
35924: विश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, celebrated, notorious. 2 Known. 3 Pleased, delighted, happy. 4 Dropped, flowing. E. वि before श्रुत heard.
35925: विश्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 Celebrity, fame, notoriety. 2 Oozing, flowing. E. वि before श्रु to hear, aff. क्तिन्.
35926: विश्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, relaxed. E. वि before श्लथ loose.
35927: विश्लथाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Weak, relaxed, nerveless. E. विश्लथ, and अङ्ग the body.
35928: विश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Separated, disunited. E. वि before श्लिष to unite, क्त aff.
35929: विश्लेष m. (-षः) 1 Separation, distance, especially of lovers, or husband and wife. 2 Disunion, disjunction, separation in general. 3 (In arithmetic,) The converse of addition. E. वि before श्लिष to unite, aff. घञ्.
35930: विश्लेषजाति f. (-तिः) (In arithmetic,) The assimilation of difference, the reduction of fractional difference. E. विश्लेष, and जाति kind.
35931: विश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) All, entire, whole, universal. n. (-श्वं) The world, the universe. m. (-श्वः) A deity of a particular class in which ten are enumerated; their names are VASU, SATYA, KRATU, DAKṢA, KĀLA, KĀMA, DHṚTI, KURU, PURURĀVAN, and MADRAVA: They are worshipped particularly at the funeral obsequies in honor of deceased progenitors in general, and receive an oblation of clarified butter at the daily and domestic Śrāddha. nf. (-श्वं-श्वा) Dry ginger. f. (-श्वा) A tree, the bark of which is said to be used in dying red, commonly Atis, (Betula.) E. विश to enter, to pervade, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
35932: विश्वकद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) Wicked, vile. m. (-द्रुः) 1 A dog trained for the chase. 2 Sound, noise. E. विश्व all, कन् pleonasm, द्रु to run, to pursue, aff. डु, or विश्व with कदि to cry or call, aff. डु, and र augment.
35933: विश्वकर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 1 The sun. 2 The son of BRAHMĀ, and artist of the gods. 3 A saint. E. विश्व universal, कर्म्म work, act.
35934: विश्वकर्म्मसुता f. (-ता) SAṂJÑĀ, one of the wives of the sun. E. विश्वकर्म्म the artist of the gods, and सुता the daughter; also विश्वकर्म्मजा, &c.
35935: विश्वका f. (-का) A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.) E. विश्व all, कै to cry, aff. क.
35936: विश्वकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Who or what makes all. m. (-कृत्) 1 The creator, the maker of all things. 2 The carpenter or architect, and artist of the gods. E. विश्व all, and कृत् who makes.
35937: विश्वकेतु m. (-तुः) ANIRUDDHA, an incarnation of KĀMA, as the son of PRADYUMNA. E. विश्व universe, केतु a banner.
35938: विश्वक्सेन m. (-नः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A particular form of that deity, to whom the fragments of a sacrifice to VIṢṆU are offered. f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. विश्वक every way. and सेना an army, more properly विष्वक्सेन.
35939: विश्वगन्धा f. (-न्धा) The earth. E. विश्व all, and गन्ध fragrance.
35940: विश्वगायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Spreading or going in every direction. E. विश्वक् and आयत् going.
35941: विश्वगोप्तृ m. (-प्ता) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 INDRA. E. विश्व all, and गोप्तृ preserver.
35942: विश्वङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-creating, making all. m. (-रः) The eye. E. विश्व all, and कर making.
35943: विश्वजन n. (-नं) All men, mankind. E. विश्व, and जन people.
35944: विश्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Good for or suitable to all men. E. विश्वजन, and ख aff.
35945: विश्वजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Suitable or relating to all men. E. विश्व all, जन mankind, छ aff.
35946: विश्वजन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Fit or good for all men. E. विश्वजन, and यत् aff.
35947: विश्वजित् mfn. (-तित्) All-subduing. m. (-जित्) 1 A particular ceremony or sacrifice. 2 The cord or noose of VARUṆA. E. विश्व all, and जित् what subdues.
35948: विश्वञ्च् mfn. (-श्वङ्-शुची-श्वक्) Going every where. ind. or adv. n. (-श्वक्) Every where, universally. E. विञ्च all, अञ्च to go, aff. क्विप्; it is more usually written both in simple and compound forms विष्वञ्च, from a different etymology.
35949: विश्वतस् ind. Every where, all around, universally. E. विश्व all, and तसि aff.
35950: विश्वदेव m. (-वः) A Viśvadeva, a deity of a particular class: see विश्व. f. (-वा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. विश्व all, दिव to sport, aff. घञ्.
35951: विश्वद्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Moving every where or universally. E. विश्वक every where, अद्रि substituted for the final, अञ्च to go, aff. क्विप्; also विष्वद्र्यञ्च्.
35952: विश्वधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) All-sustaining. m. (-री) A deity. f. (-रिणी) The earth. E. विश्व all, and धारिन् upholding.
35953: विश्वनाथ m. (-थः) A name of ŚIVA, especially as the object of peculiar adoration at Benares. E. विश्व the universe, and नाथ lord.
35954: विश्वपा m. (-पाः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. E. विश्व, and पा who nourishes.
35955: विश्वप्सन् m. (-प्सा) 1 Fire, or the deity of fire, AGNI. 2 The moon. 3 The sun. E. विश्व all, प्सा to eat, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्.
35956: विश्वबोध m. (-धः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint. E. विश्व all, and बोध who explains.
35957: विश्वभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) 1 Enjoying or possessing all things. 2 Eating all things. E. विश्व, and भुज् who possesses.
35958: विश्वभू m. (-भूः) The third of the seven Buddhas, according to some systems. E. विश्व all, and भू being.
35959: विश्वभेषज n. (-जं) Dry ginger. E. विश्व all (diseases), भेषज a medicament.
35960: विश्वभोजन n. (-नं) Eating all sorts of food. E. विश्व, and भोजन food.
35961: विश्वभोजस् m. (-जाः) One who enjoys all things. E. विश्व all, भुज to enjoy, Uṇādi aff. असि.
35962: विश्वमदा f. (-दा) One of the seven tongues of fire. E. विश्व all, मद to intoxicate, aff. लङ् and टाप्.
35963: विश्वम्भर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-sustaining. m. (-रः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 INDRA. f. (-रा) The earth. E. विश्व all (things), भृ to support or nourish, खच् aff.
35964: विश्वम्भराधिप m. (पः) A king. E. विश्वम्भरा the earth, and अधिप ruler.
35965: विश्वयु m. (-युः) Air, wind. E. विश्व all, यु to join, aff. क्विप्.
35966: विश्वराज् m. (-राट् or -राड्) A universal sovereign. E. विश्व all, and राज who rules.
35967: विश्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Taking all forms, existing in all forms, universal, omnipresent. m. (-पः) VIṢṆU. n. (-पं) Agallochum. E. विश्व all, and रूप form.
35968: विश्वरेतस् m. (-ताः) BRAHMĀ. E. विश्व all, and रेतम् seed.
35969: विश्वरोचन m. (-नः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) E. विश्व all, रोचन digestive.
35970: विश्वविधायिन् m. (-यी) A deity, a creator. E. विश्व, and विघायिन् who makes.
35971: विश्ववेदस् m. (-दाः) A sage, a saint, one who knows all things. E. विश्व all, विदि to know, aff. असि.
35972: विश्वव्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) All-pervading, every where diffused. E. विश्व, and व्यापक what pervades.
35973: विश्वव्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) All-diffused or pervading. E. विश्व, and व्यापिन् what spreads.
35974: विश्वव्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Universal diffusion or permeation. E. विश्व, and व्याप्ति spreading.
35975: विश्वसन n. (-नं) Trusting, confiding in. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, ल्युट् aff.
35976: विश्वसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) All-enduring. f. (-हा) 1 The earth. 2 One of the tongues of fire. E. विश्व all, सह to bear, aff. अच् and टाप्.
35977: विश्वसारक n. (-कं) The prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus, Rox.) E. विश्व all, सार essence, and कन् added.
35978: विश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trusted, believed or confided in. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, aff. क्त, with इट् augment.
35979: विश्वसृज् m. (-सृक् or -सृग् or -सृट् or -सृड्) BRAHMĀ. E. विश्व all (the universe), सृज to create, aff. क्विन्.
35980: विश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusted, confided in, faithful. f. (-स्ता) A widow. E. वि implying kind or sort, or in the fem. form, privation, and श्वस to live or breathe, aff. क्त.
35981: विश्वस्रष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) The creator of all, GOD. E. विश्व, and स्रष्ट्ट creator.
35982: विश्वाची f. (-ची) One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga.
35983: विश्वात्मन् m. (-त्मा) BRAHMĀ. n. (-त्म) The soul of the world, the universal spirit, GOD. E. विश्व all, and आत्मन् soul.
35984: विश्वाधायस् m. (-याः) A deity, a god. E. विश्व all, आङ् before धा to hold or support, असि aff., form irr.
35985: विश्वामिच m. (-चः) A Muni, the son of GĀDHI, originally of the military order, but who became by long and painful austerities a Brahmarṣi, in which character he appears in the Rāmāyaṇa, as the early preceptor and counsellor of RĀMA. E. विश्व all, मिच the friend, and the vowel of the prefix made long in this sense; if attributively used, the compound is विश्वमिच.
35986: विश्वामिचप्रिय m. (-यः) The cocoanut tree. E. विश्वामिच the saint VIŚVĀMITRA, and प्रिय beloved, having been created by the saint.
35987: विश्वावसु m. (-सुः) One of the Gandharbas or celestial singers. f. (-सुः) A particular night.
35988: विश्वास m. (-सः) Trust, faith, confidence. E. वि before श्वस to breathe or live, aff. घञ्.
35989: विश्वासकारण n. (-णं) Cause or motive of trust. E. विश्वास, and करण cause.
35990: विश्वासकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Inspiring confidence or faith. E. विश्वास, and कृत् who or what makes.
35991: विश्वासघात m. (-तः) Violation of trust, treachery. E. विश्वास, and घात destroying.
35992: विश्वासघातक m. (-कः) A traitor, one who betrays confidence. E. विश्वास, and घातक who destroys; also विश्वासघातिन्.
35993: विश्वासपात्र n. (-त्रं) A confidential agent, one worthy to be trusted. E. विश्वास, and पात्र vessel.
35994: विश्वासप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Inspiring confidence. E. विश्वास, and प्रद who gives.
35995: विश्वासप्रतिपन्न m. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Confiding, trusting. E. विश्वास, and प्रतिपन्न possessed of.
35996: विश्वासभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Breach of faith, violation of confidence. E. विश्वास, and भङ्ग breaking.
35997: विश्वासभूमि f. (मिः) An object of trust, a person worthy of confidence. E. विश्वास, and भूमि soil.
35998: विश्वासस्थान n. (-नं) An object or person of trust or confidence. E. विश्वास, and स्थान place.
35999: विश्वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inspired with confidence. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, causal v., क्त aff.
36000: विश्वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Trusting, confiding in. 2 Honest, trusty. E. विश्वास, and इनि aff.
36001: विश्वास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be trusted or depended on, to be believed. 2 To be encouraged or inspired with confidence. ind. Having encouraged or inspired with confidence. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, ण्यत् aff. or causal v., and यत् or ल्यप् aff.
36002: विश्वास्यता f. (-ता) Trust-worthiness. E. विश्वास्य, and तल् aff.
36004: विश्वेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. विश्व all, and ईश lord: see the next.
36005: विश्वेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA, under a form or appellation in which especially he is worshipped at Benares, where a celebrated temple is appropriated to him in the character of lord or god of the universe. E. विश्व the universe, and ईश्वर god; also similar compounds, as विश्वेश, विश्वनाथ, &c.
36006: विष r. 6th cl. (विषति) To pervade. (औ) औविष r. 9th cl. (विष्णाति) To have no occasion or use for, to separate or withdraw from. (उ) विषु r. 1st cl. (वेषति) To sprinkle. (औ इर ऌ) औ इर विषॢ r. 3rd cl. (विवेष्टि विविष्टे) To pervade, to spread or extend through nature, &c.
36007: विष् f. (-विट्) 1 Fæces, ordure, excrement. 2 Diffusion, spreading. E. विष to pervade, aff. क्विप्.
36008: विष mn. (-षः-षं) Poison, venom. n. (-षं) 1 Water. 2 The fibres attached to the stalk of the lotus. 3 Gum myrrh. 4 A vegetable poison, (Aconitum ferox.) f. (-षा) A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing of a red colour. E. विष to pervade, aff. क.
36009: विषक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Clinging or adhering to closely. 2 In contact with. E. वि before षञ्ज to embrace, क्त aff.
36010: विषघा f. (-घा) A twining shrub, (Menispermum cordifolium.) E. विष poison, हन् to destroy, aff. ड, and घ substituted for the final.
36011: विषघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Antidotic, an antidote. m. (-ती) A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) E. विष poison, and घातिन् removing.
36012: विषघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Antidotic, an antidote. m. (-घ्नः) 1 A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) 2 A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 3 Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) f. (-घ्नी) 1 A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) 2 A plant, commonly Bichhati. 3 Turmeric. 4 Bitter apple or colocynth. E. विष poison, and घ्न what destroys.
36013: विषजुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Poisoned, suffering from poison. 2 Poisonous. E. विष, and जुष्ट united with.
36014: विषणि m. (-णिः) A sort of snake.
36015: विषण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The fibres of the stalk of the water-lily.
36016: विषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) Dejected, desponding, spiritless, disinclined to exertion. E. वि before सद to go, aff. क्त.
36017: विषण्णता f. (-ता) Dejection, lassitude, want of energy or spirit, especially as one of the effects of unsuccessful love. E. विषण्ण relaxed, तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व, विषण्णत्वं.
36018: विषण्णवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking sad or dejected. E. विषण्ण, and वदन face: also विषण्णमुख, &c.
36019: विषतुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Fatal, deadly. E. विष, and तुल्य equal to.
36021: विषद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Yielding or giving poison. 2 Shedding water. m. (-दः) A cloud. n. (-दं) Green vitriol. E. विष poison or water, and दा to give, aff. क.
36022: विषदंष्ट्रा f. (-ष्ट्रा) A medicinal plant and antidote, commonly Sarpa or Sāmpkaṅkāli, or snake skin. E. विष venom, दंष्ट्र a tooth.
36023: विषदन्तक m. (-कः) A snake. E. विष poison, दन्त tooth, and कप् added.
36024: विषदर्शनमृत्युक m. (-कः) A kind of pheasant. E. विष poison, (perhaps put for the snake,) दर्शन seeing, मृत्युक who dies.
36025: विषधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Venomous, poisonous. m. (-रः) A snake. E. विष poison, घर who has.
36027: विषधात्री f. (-त्री) The wife of Jaratkāru, and goddess presiding over snakes. E. विष venom, घात्री a nurse.
36028: विषनाशन m. (-नः) 1 A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) 2 An antidote. n. (-नं) Removing or curing poison. E. षिव poison, and नाशन destroying.
36029: विषनाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Antidote. f. (-नी) A plant: see विषदंष्ट्रा. E. विष venom, नाशिन् destroying.
36030: विषनुद् m. (-नुत्) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. विष poison, नुद् to eject, aff. क्विप्.
36031: विषपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) n. (-ष्पं) The blue lotus. E. विष poison, and पुष्प flower.
36032: विषपुष्पक m. (-कः) Sickness or disease induced by eating poisonous flowers. E. विष poison, पुष्प a flower, or विषपुष्प the Vangueria, &c., कन् aff. in this sense.
36033: विषप्रयोग m. (-गः) Employing or administering poison. E. विण, and प्रयोग application.
36034: विषभक्षण n. (-णं) Taking poison. E. विष, and भक्षण feeding.
36035: विषभिषज् m. (-षक्) A dealer in antidotes, a snake-catcher, or one who pretends to cure the bite of a snake. E. विष poison, and भिषज् a doctor.
36036: विषभुजङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A poisonous snake. E. विष poison, and भुजङ्ग a snake.
36037: विषभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Venomous, poisonous. m. (-भृत्) A snake. E. विष, and भृत् who or what has.
36038: विषम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult, (of access,) rough, uneven. 2 Difficult, &c. (of comprehending,) as a book. 3 Painful, difficult, troublesome, (in general.) 4 Odd, (in numbers.) 5 Unparalleled, unequalled. 6 Wicked, dishonest. 7 Fearful, frightful, awful. n. (-मं) 1 Difficulty, pain. 2 Unevenness, inequality. 3 Oddness, (in numeration.) 4 An inaccessible place, a thicket, a precipice. 5 (In rhetoric,) Description of unusual or incompatible cause and effect. E. वि privative or contra-indicative, before सम even, smooth, equal, &c., and स after the इ of the prefix, changed to ष.
36039: विषमकर्ण m. (-र्णः) The hypothenuse of a right angled triangle, formed between the gnomon and the two sides of the shadow. E. विषम, and कर्ण hypothenuse.
36040: विषमकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) 1 An odd or unparalleled act. 2 (In arithmetic,) The finding of quantities from their difference or that of their squares. E. विषम, and कर्म्मन् act.
36041: विषमखात n. (-तं) An irregular excavation or one with unequal sides. E. विषम, and खात excavation.
36042: विषमचतुरस्र n. (-स्रं) An unequal four-sided figure, a trapezium. E. विषम, and चतुरस्र four-angled.
36043: विषमछद m. (-दः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) E. विषम odd, and छद a leaf; having seven leaves on a stalk.
36044: विषमछाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoxes. E. विषम oblique, and छाया shadow.
36045: विषमज्वर m. (-रः) 1 A violent fever. 2 Irregularly remittent fever. E. विषम, and ज्वर a fever.
36046: विषमत्रिभुज m. (-जः) A scalene triangle. E. विषम unequal, त्रिभुज triangle.
36047: विषमनयन m. (-नः) ŚIVA. E. विषम odd, नयन an eye; having a third eye in his forehead.
36048: विषमन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A snake-catcher, one who by pretended charms, &c. attracts snakes and cures the bite. n. (-न्तं) A charm for curing snake bites. E. विष poison, मन्त्र a charm.
36049: विषममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Resulting from or produced by inequality. E. विषम, and मयट् aff.
36050: विषमरूप्य mfn. (प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Resulting from or produced by unequal quantities or qualities. E. विषम uneven, and रूप्य aff. in this sense.
36051: विषमविभाग m. (-गः) Unequal division of property amongst coheirs. E. विषम uneven, विभाग portion of inheritance.
36052: विषमशायिन् mfn. (-यी यिनी-यि) Sleeping irregularly. E. विषम, and शायिन् who sleeps.
36053: विषमशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Unjust, unfair, (division.) E. विषम, and शिष्ट left.
36054: विषमशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Uneven. 2 Uneasy, difficult. E. विषभ, and शील having.
36055: विषमसाहस n. (-मं) Temerity, daring. E. विषम, and माहस violence.
36056: विषमस्थ mfn. (-स्थः स्था-स्थं) 1 Standing unevenly. 2 Inaccessible, safely posted. 3 Being in difficulty or misfortune. E. विषम uneven, and स्थ who stays.
36057: विषमाशन n. (-नं) Eating irregularly, either as to quantity or time. E. विषम, and अशन eating.
36058: विषमाक्ष m. (-क्षः) ŚIVA. E. विषम odd, अक्षि the eye, aff. टच्; having a third eye, or one in his forehead.
36059: विषमायुध m. (-धः) KĀMADEVA. E. विषम odd, आयुध a weapon, armed with five arrows.
36060: विषमाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Crafty, dishonest. E. विषम, and आशय asylum.
36061: विषमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made or become uneven, irregular, &c. E. विषम, and इतच् aff.
36062: विषमीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Produced or resulting from inequalities. E. विषम uneven, and छ aff.
36063: विषमुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A kind of shrub of medicinal properties, commonly termed Biṣdori or Karsinh. E. विष poison, मुष्टि a handful.
36064: विषमृत्यु m. (-त्युः) A sort of bird, a kind of pheasant. E. विष poison, and मृत्यु death.
36065: विषमेक्षण m. (-णः) ŚIVA. E. विषम odd (three), ईक्षण eye.
36066: विषमेषु m. (-षुः) KĀMADEVA. E. विषम odd (five), इषु an arrow.
36067: विषय m. (-यः) 1 Any object of sense, any thing perceivable by the senses, as colour, form, flavour, odour, and sound. 2 An object in general, as of affection or desire, &c. 3 Worldly object or pursuit, affair, business, transaction, &c. 4 A country, whether inhabited or uninhabited. 5 Refuge, asylum. 6 Department, sphere, element, home, province, that which is peculiarly known or frequented, as a particular study by its professors, a particular town by its townsfolk, water by fish, air by birds, &c. 7 A collection of villages. 8 Any thing indigenous or peculiar to a province, &c. 9 A religious obligation or observance. 10 Semen virile. 11 A lover, a hus band. E. वि before षि to bind, aff. अच्.
36068: विषयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to, concerning, (any object.) E. विषय, and कन् added.
36069: विषयकत्व n. (-त्वं) State of an affair, circumstance or thing. E. त्व added to the preceding.
36070: विषयकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Worldly concern or act. E. विषय, and कर्म्म act.
36071: विषयकाम m. (-मः) Desire of worldly goods or pleasures. E. विषय, and काम desire.
36072: विषयात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Identical with or affecting sensual or worldly objects. E. विषय, and आत्मक own.
36073: विषयवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Engaged in the affairs of life. E. विषय, and वासिन् who abides.
36074: विषयायिन् m. (-यी) 1 A king. 2 An organ of sense. 3 KĀMADEVA. 4 An epicurean, a sensualist, one heedful of objects of sense or attentive to worldly objects. 5 A materialist, one who disbelieves the existence of that which is not cognizable by the senses. E. विषय an object of sense, अय to go, to follow, and इनि aff.
36075: विषयासक्त m. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Attached to objects of sense, devoted to the world. E. विषय, and आसक्त attached to.
36076: विषयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Attached to objects of sense, carnal, sensual. 2 Conversant with or interested in worldly occupations or enjoyments. n. (-यि) An organ of sense. m. (-यी) 1 A king. 2 The deity KĀMA. 3 A sensualist. 4 A materialist, one who denies the existence of any thing which is not an object of sense. 5 A man of business or of the world. E. विषय an organ of sense, aff. इन्.
36077: विषयोपसेवा f. (-वा) Sensuality. E. विषय, and उपसेय addiction to.
36078: विषल m. (-लः) Poison, venom. E. विष poison, लच् aff.
36079: विषविद्या f. (-द्या) The administration of antidotes, the cure of poisons by drugs or charms. E. विष poison, विद्या science.
36080: विषविधान n. (-नं) Administering poison judicially, or by way of ordeal. E. विष, and विधान rule.
36081: विषवेग m. (-गः) Absorption of venom, as shewn by some bodily effects or changes. E. विष poison, and वेग natural excretion.
36082: विषवैद्य m. (-द्यः) A dealer in antidotes, one professing by charms, &c. to cure the bite of a snake. E. विष poison, and वैद्य a physician.
36083: विषशूक m. (-कः) A wasp. E. विष venom, and शूक a parrot.
36084: विषशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A wasp. E. विष poison, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि poss. aff.
36085: विषसूचक m. (-कः) The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.) E. विष poison, and सूचक informer.
36086: विषसृक्कन् m. (-क्का) A wasp. E. विष poison, and सृक्कन् the corner of the mouth.
36087: विषहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) An antidote, removing venom. f. (-रा or -री) The goddess of the serpent race, the sister of VĀSUKI, and wife of JARATKĀRU. E. विष venom, हृ to take, aff. अप् or टच्.
36088: विषहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Malicious, malignant, cherishing hatred or hostility. E. विष, and हृदय the heart.
36089: विषह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be borne or endured. ind. Having borne. E. वि before षह to bear, aff. यत् or ल्यप्.
36090: विषा ind. Aptote noun. Intellect, understanding. E. षो to destroy (ignorance), with वि prefixed, and ओ Uṇādi aff.; see विष.
36091: विषाङ्कुर m. (-रः) A spear, a dart. E. विष poison, अङ्कर a shoot.
36092: विषाण subst. mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 The horn of an animal. 2 The tusks of an elephant. 3 The tusk or fang of the boar. f. (-णी) 1 A plant, the fruit of which is compared to the horn of a ram, &c. commonly Meṣa Śṛṅgī. 2 A medicinal root: see क्षीरकाकोली. n. (-णं) A sort of Costus (C. speciosus.) E. वि before अस to be, चानश् aff.; the initial of the radical rejected, and स changed to ष; otherwise, वि before षण to serve, aff. घञ्.
36093: विषाणिका f. (-का) A sort of plant, commonly Meṣa Śṛṅgī. E. विषाणी as above, and कन् pleonasm, fem. form.
36094: विषाणिन् m. (-णी) 1 An elephant. 2 A bull. 3 Any animal with horns. E. विषाण a horn or tusk, and इनि aff.
36095: विषाद m. (-दः) 1 Lassitude, dejection, lowness of spirits, want of energy, especially as the result of unrequited love. 2 Distress, affliction. 3 Disappointment. E. वि before सद to go, aff. घञ्.
36096: विषादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Dejected, disconsolate, sorrowful. E. विषाद, and इनि aff.
36097: विषानन n. (-नः) A snake. E. विष poison, and आनन the face.
36098: विषान्तक m. (-कः) ŚIVA. E. विष poison, and अन्तक destroyer; having swallowed the poison that was produced at the churning of the ocean.
36099: विषापह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Antidotic, an antidote. f. (-हा) A kind of birth wort, (Aristolochia Indica.) E. विष poison, and अपह removing.
36100: विषायुध m. (-घः) A snake. E. विष poison, and आयुध a weapon.
36101: विषार m. (-रः) A snake. E. विष poison, ऋ to go, aff. अच्.
