36102: विषालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Venomous, poisonous. E. विष, and आलुच् aff.
36103: विषास्य m. (-स्यः) A snake. f. (-स्या) Marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) E. विष poison, and आस्य face.
36104: विषीदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Sorrowing, despairing. E. वि before षद to go, शतृ aff.
36105: विषु ind. 1 Many, various. 2 Equally, same, like.
36106: विषुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having or possessing various or uniform motion or extension. E. विष्वञ्च going every where, न poss. aff., and the final consonant of the primitive rejected.
36107: विषुप n. (-पं) The equinox: see the next.
36108: विषुव n. (-वं) The equinox. E. विषु equally, (the night and day,) and व or प aff.; also विषुप.
36109: विषुवछाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoctial points. E. विषुव, and छाया shade.
36110: विषुवत् n. (-वत्) The equinox. E. विषु equally, (long, the day and night,) and मतुप् poss. aff.
36111: विषुवदिन n. (-नं) The day of the equinox. E. विषुव, and दिन day.
36112: विषुवसङ्क्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) The passage of the sun to the next sign at the equinoxes. E. विषुव, and सङ्क्रान्ति sun's entrance into a sign.
36114: विष्कन्तृ mfn. (-न्त्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Going, going in various directions, dispersing. E. वि before स्कदि to go, तृन् aff.; also विस्कन्तृ.
36115: विष्कन्द m. (-न्दः) Going, dispersing. E. वि before स्कदि to go, अच् aff.; also विस्कन्द.
36116: विष्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Gone. 2 Gone in various directions, dispersed. E. वि before स्कन्द to go, क्त aff.
36117: विष्कम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 The first of the twenty-seven astronomical periods, called Yogas, or Yoga star of the first lunar mansion, 2 Obstacle, hindrance, impediment, resistance. 3 Spreading, extension. 4 Act, doing any thing. 5 A posture of the devotees called Yogits. 6 One of the performers at a dramatic entertainment, either an actor who in the intervals of the scenes explains to the audience the progress of the story, or one or two of the personages of the drama, who do the same in a soliloquy or dialogue. 7 A tree. 8 The bolt or bar of a door. 9 A post, the roof-tree of a house. 10 The diameter of a circle. E. वि before ष्कभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added विस्कम्भक.
36118: विष्कम्भक m. (-कः) A Yoga, &c.: see the last.
36119: विष्कम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) Obstructive, impeding. m. (-म्भी) The bolt or bar of a door. E. विष्कम्भ obstruction, and इनि aff.
36120: विष्किर m. (-रः) 1 A bird in general. 2 Pulling or tearing to pieces. E. वि before कॄ to scatter, and क aff., with सुट् aug.
36121: विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Entered, penetrated, pervaded. f. (-ष्टा) Fæces. E. विष to pervade, aff. क्त.
36122: विष्टप mn. (-पः-पं) A world. E. विश to enter, (into which,) प aff, deriv. irr.; also विष्टभृ.
36123: विष्टभ n. (-भं) A world. E. विश to pervade, अभच् aff., and the vowel unchanged; deriv. irr.
36124: विष्टब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Hindered, obstructed. 2 Stayed, fixed firm, well-supported. 3 Placed in or upon. 4 Paralysed, made stiff or motionless. E. वि before स्तभि to stop, क्त aff.
36125: विष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Impediment, hindrance, obstacle. 2 Stopping, staying. 3 Placing in or upon. 4 A disease, obstruction of urine or fæces, ischury, constipation. 5 Paralysis, loss of motion. E. वि before स्तभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ्.
36126: विष्टम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Stopping, impeding, what hinders or obstructs. 2 Checking (as perspiration), chilling. 3 Making motionless. E. वि before स्तभि to stop, घिनुण् aff.
36127: विष्टर m. (-रः) 1 A tree. 2 A handful of Kuśa or sacred grass. 3 A seat, a stool, a chair, a couch, &c. 4 The seat of the Brahman, either real or in effigy, as presiding at a sacrifice. 5 A bed. 6 A seat made of twenty-five straws of Kuśa grass tied up in a sheaf. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप, and स changed to ष.
36128: विष्टरश्रवस् m. (-वाः) KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. विष्टर a tree, श्रु to hear, aff. असुन्.
36129: विष्टरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Sitting on a seat, or reclining on a bed of leaves. E. विष्टर, and स्थ who stays.
36130: विष्टार m. (-रः) A form of metre, a species of the order termed Paṅkti, consisting of a verse of four lines, the first and last of which consist of eight syllables each, and the second and third of twelve each. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. घञ्, and स changed to ष.
36131: विष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Working, labouring, a workman. f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Unpaid labour, working without wages. 2 Occupation, act,  action. 3 Hire, wages. 4 The seventh of the variable Karaṇas, or astrological periods so termed, each answering to half a lunar day. 5 Sending, dispatching. 6 Consigning to torture, casting into hell, &c. E. विश to enter, (into pain by it,) and क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.
36132: विष्ठल n. (-लं) A place situated remote or apart. E. वि implying apart, स्थल a place, and स changed to ष.
36133: विष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Fæces, ordure. E. वि before स्था to stay, (in the intestines,) aff. अङ् and टाप्.
36134: विष्णु m. (-ष्णुः) VIṢṆU, one of the three principal Hindu deities, and the preserver of the world: during the periods of temporary annihilation, he is supposed to sleep on the waters floating on the serpent Śeṣa: BRAHMĀ is fabled to have sprung from a lotus, which originally grew from the navel of VIṢṆU, and the holy river Ganges is said to spring from his foot: the different Avatāras are considered as emanations of this deity, and in KṚṢṆA, he is supposed to have been really and wholly incarnate: LAKṢMĪ his wife, and he is usually represented as a mild and benevolent deity. 2 AGNI or fire. 3 One of the demigods called Vasus. 4 A pure or pious man. 5 The name of an ancient law-giver. E. विश to enter or pervade (the universe), नु Uṇādi aff.
36135: विष्णुक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A flower, (Clitorea ternatea.) E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and क्रान्त overcome; prized by or sacred to that deity.
36136: विष्णुगुप्त m. (-प्तः) The saint KAUṆḌILYA. E. विष्णु, and गुप्त hidden, having been concealed by VIṢṆU when pursued by ŚIVA, whom he had incensed.
36137: विष्णुगृह n. (-हं) The name of a city or country; also Stambapur. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and गृह residence.
36138: विष्णुदैवत्या f. (-त्या) The twelfth lunar day of each fortnight. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and दैवत्य divinity.
36139: विष्णुपद n. (-दं) 1 The sky, heaven, atmosphere. 2 The sea of milk. 3 A lotus. f. (-दी) 1 The Ganges. 2 One of the twelve Saṅkrāntis or periods, at which the sun enters a sign of the zodiac, especially the first sign after the equinox. E. विष्णु, and पद् abode, or foot; where VIṢṆU resides or rests, or proceeding from his foot.
36140: विष्णुरथ m. (-थः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. विष्णु, and रथ car or conveyance.
36141: विष्णुलिङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A quail. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and लिङ्ग a mark, ङीप् diminutive aff.
36142: विष्णुवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Beloved by VIṢṆU. f. (-भा) 1 A plant, (Echites caryophyallata.) 2 A small fragrant shrub, (Ocymum sanctum.) 3 LAKṢMI. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and वल्लभ the beloved.
36143: विष्णुवाहन m. (-नः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. विष्णु, and वाहन vehicle.
36144: विष्पन्द m. (-न्दः) Throbbing, beating. E. वि before स्यन्दि to go, अच् aff.
36145: विष्फार m. (-रः) The twang of a bow. E. वि before स्फर or स्फुर to expand, aff. घञ्; in the latter आ is substituted for the vowel, and स is changed to ष, also विस्फार.
36146: विष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Deserving death by poison. E. विष venom, and यत् aff.
36147: विष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Flowing, issuing, trickling. E. वि before ष्यदि to go, अच् aff.; also read विस्यन्द.
36148: विष्यन्दमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flowing-trickling. E. वि before ष्यदि to go, शानच् aff.; also read विस्यन्दमान.
36149: विष्व mfn. (-ष्वः-ष्वा-ष्वं) Injurious, mischievous. E. विष to pervade, Uṇādi aff. व.
36150: विष्वक् ind. Every way, all around: see विष्वच्.
36151: विष्वक्सेन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. विष्वक् every where, सेना an army.
36152: विष्वक्सेनप्रिया f. (-या) 1 A sort of yam, (Dioscorea.) 2 LAKṢMĪ. E. निष्वक्सेन VIṢṆU, and प्रिया beloved by, sacred to.
36153: विष्वग्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone all about, spread, extended. E. विष्वक्, and गत gone.
36154: विष्वग्गति f. (-तिः) Going all about. E. विष्वक्, and गति going.
36155: विष्वच् or विष्वञ्च् mfn. (-ष्वङ्-षूची-ष्वक्) Going every where, allpervading. n. (-ष्वक्) The equinox. E. विषु variously (in various directions), or equally, अञ्च् to go, क्विन् aff.; it is also written, but less accurately विश्वच्.
36156: विष्वणन n. (-नं) Food, eating. E. वि before स्वन to sound, (with the lips, to smack the lips,) and ल्युट् aff.
36157: विष्वद्र्यच् or द्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Going every where. E. विष्वच् every where, with अद्री augment.
36158: विष्वाण m. (-णः) Eating, food. E. वि before स्वन to sound, aff. घञ्.
36159: विसंयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Separate, detached. 2 Omitting. E. वि priv., संयुक्त joined.
36160: विसंयोग m. (-गः) 1 Separation. 2 Omission. E. वि priv., संयोग union.
36161: विस r. 4th cl. (विस्यति) 1 To throw, to send. 2 To put forth.
36162: विस n. (-सं) The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily. E. विस to send, to put forth, aff. क.
36163: विसकण्ठिका f. (-का) A small crane. E. विस the fibres of the lotus stalk, aff. अंच्, कण्ठ the throat, and कन् aff. fem. form, implying comparison.
36164: विसङ्कट m. (-टः) A lion. E. वि and सम before कट to encompass, अच् aff.
36165: विसछेद m. (-दः) A part of the fibres of the lotus. E. विस, and छेद a section.
36166: विसज n. (-जं) A lotus. E. विस the fibres of the stalk, and ज born.
36167: विसज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Lifeless, bereft of sense. E. वि priv., सज्ञा sense.
36168: विसनाभि m. (-भिः) A quantity of lotuses. E. विस the fibres of the stalk, and नाभि navel.
36169: विसनासिका f. (-का) A sort of crane. E. विस the film of the lotus stalk, and नासिका the nose or beak.
36170: विसपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A lotus. E. विस the stalk, and पुष्प flower.
36171: विसप्रसून n. (-नं) A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.) E. विस the fibres of the stalk, and प्रसून a flower.
36172: विसम्बाद m. (-दः) Disappointing, deceiving, falsifying one's word, deceiving by a false affirmation or not keeping a promise. 2 Contradiction, disagreeing. E. वि implying reverse, सम्बाद agreement.
36173: विसम्बादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Cunning, crafty, fraudulent. 2 Disputing, contesting. E. विसम्बाद, and इनि aff.
36174: विसर m. (-रः) 1 A multitude, an assemblage, a flock, a herd, a crowd. 2 Spreading, extending, going forth or abroad. E. वि before सृ to go, aff. अप्.
36175: विसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Abandoning, relinquishment, getting rid of or free from any thing. 2 Departure, going away. 3 Separation. 4 Gift, donation. 5 Final emancipation or beatitude, exemption from worldly existence. 6 Evacuation of excrement, voiding by stool, &c. 7 The soft aspirate or Visarga, marked by two perpendicular dots (:), and as the substitute of the letters स or र, the termination of various inflections both of nouns and verbs. 8 A division of the sun's course, the southern course. 9 Light, splendour. E. वि before सृज to let go, aff. घञ्.
36176: विसर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Quitting, relinquishing. 3 Sending, dispatching. 4 Dismissing, sending away. 5 Throwing the image, &c. into holy water, as the concluding rite of the festival of a deity. E. वि before सृज to let go, aff. ल्युट्.
36177: विसर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be left, abandoned, given away, &c. (proper or fit to.) E. वि, सृज to leave, अनीयर् aff.
36178: विसर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abandoned, left. 2 Given, given away. 2 Dismissed. E. वि before सृज to let go, क्त aff.
36179: विसर्प m. (-र्पः) 1 Spreading. 2 Going. 3 Going variously. 4 Flying, gliding. 5 Unwished consequence of any act. 6 Erysipelatous inflammation. E. वि before सृप to go, घञ् aff.
36181: विसर्पण n. (-णं) 1 Spreading, extending. 2 Going gently. 3 Flying. E. वि before सृप to go, aff. ल्युट्.
36182: विसर्पत् mfn. (-र्पन्-र्पन्ती-र्पत्) 1 Going, going along. 2 Flying gently. E. वि before सृप to go, शतृ aff.
36183: विसर्पिन् mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि) Spreading over or along, gliding, going gently. E. वि before सृप to go, घिनुण् aff.
36184: विसल n. (-लं) A shoot, a sprout. E. वि variously, सल to go, aff. अच्.
36185: विसार m. (-रः) 1 A fish. 2 Going smoothly, creeping, gliding. n. (-रं) Wood, timber. f. (-री) The region of the winds. E. वि before सृ to go, and घञ् aff., or वि priv., and सार pith.
36186: विसारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Effected, performed. 2 Set on foot, occasioned. E. वि before सृ to go, causal form, aff. क्त.
36187: विसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Flowing, gliding, creeping. 2 Spreading, diffusing. m. (-री) A fish. E. विसार going smoothly, and इनि aff.
36188: विसिनी f. (-नी) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. विस the fibres of the lotus, इनि and ङीप् affs.
36189: विसूचिका f. (-का) 1 Spasmodic cholera. 2 Symptom of a disease. E. वि, सूच to apprise, ण्वुल aff.
36190: विसूरण nf. (-णं-णा) Sorrow, distress. E. वि, and सूर to hurt, युच् aff.
36191: विसूरित n. (-तं) Repentance. f. (-ता) A fever. E. वि before सूर to hurt, aff. क्त.
36192: विसृजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) 1 Abandoning, leaving. 2 Giving, giving away. E. वि before सृज to let go, शतृ aff.
36193: विसृज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) To be left or abandoned. ind. Having dismissed, left, got rid of, &c. E. वि before सृज to let go, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
36194: विसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spread, extended, expanded. E. वि before सृ to go, aff. क्त.
36195: विसृत्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going smoothly, gliding, creeping, flowing. E. वि before सृ to go, क्वरच् aff.
36196: विसृमर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Creeping, flowing, gliding. E. वि before सृ to go, क्मरच् aff.
36197: विसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Expelled, cast off or out. 2 Abandoned, relinquished, got rid of. 3 Given away. 4 Dismissed. E. वि before सृज to let go, aff. क्त.
36198: विसृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Leaving, quitting. 2 Giving. 3 Dismissing. E. वि away, सृज to leave, क्तिन् aff.
36199: विस्कन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Going, going away, dispersing. E. वि before ष्कदि to go, तृन् aff.
36200: विस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) Going, dispersing. E. वि before स्कदि to go, अच् aff.
36201: विस्त mn. (-स्तः-स्तं) A weight of gold, a Karṣa of sixteen Māṣas, about half an ounce troy. E. विस to convey, aff. क्त.
36202: विस्तर m. (-रः) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 Prolixity, detail. 3 Affection or affectionate solicitation. 4 Number, assemblage. 5 Abundance, quantity. 6 A seat, a stool. 7 A bed. E. वि before स्तृ to spread over or cover, aff. अप्.
36203: विस्तरशस् ind. Fully, at length. E. विस्तर, and शसि aff.
36204: विस्तार m. (-रः) 1 Spreading, extension, diffusion. 2 Vastness, expanse. 3 Breadth, amplitude. 4 Amplification. 5 Diameter of a circle. 6 The branch of a tree with its new shoots. 7 A shrub. E. वि before स्तृ to cover, aff. घञ्.
36205: विस्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Large, great. 2 Spread, expanded. E. वि before स्तृ to cover or spread, aff. क्त.
36206: विस्तीर्णता f. (-ता) 1 Diffusion, extension. 2 Vastness. E. विस्तीर्ण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विस्तीर्णत्वं.
36207: विस्तीर्णपर्ण n. (-र्णं) A sort of esculent root, (Arum Indicum.) E. विस्तीर्ण large, and पर्ण leaf.
36208: विस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spread, diffused, extended. 2 Broad, expanded. 3 Ample. 4 Diffuse. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. क्त.
36209: विस्तृति f. (-तिः) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 The diameter of a circle. 3 Breadth. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. क्तिन्.
36210: विस्पर्द्धमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Emulating, envying. E. वि before स्पर्द्धं to envy, शानच् aff.
36211: विस्पष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Apparent, manifest, open. 2 Plain, intelligible. E. वि before स्पष्ट apparent.
36212: विस्फार m. (-रः) 1 The twang of a bow string. 2 Trembling, agitation. E. वि before स्फर to shake, and घञ् aff.
36213: विस्फारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, trembling, tremulous. 2 Evident, apparent. 3 Twanged or drawn as a bow-string. E. वि before स्फर to tremble, aff. क्त.
36214: विस्फार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Being made open or manifest. 2 Being drawn or twanged as a bow-string. E. वि before स्फर to tremble, pass. v., शानच् aff.
36215: विस्फुरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Swelling, enlarging. E. वि before स्फुर to swell, शतृ aff.
36216: विस्फुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, tremulous. 2 Swollen, enlarged. E. वि before स्फुर to tremble, aff. क्त.
36217: विस्फुलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती लत्) 1 Going briskly or merrily. 2 Shaking, trembling. 3 Appearing. E. वि before स्फुल to shake, &c., and शतृ aff.
36218: विस्फुलिङ्ग m. (-गः) 1 A sort of poison. 2 A spark of fire. E. वि before स्फु imitative sound, लिंग to go, aff. अच्.
36219: विस्फूर्जथु m. (-थुः) Thunder. E. वि, स्फूर्ज्ज to thunder, अथुच् aff.
36220: विस्फोट mf. (-टः-टा) 1 Boil, pustule. 2 Small-pox. E. वि before स्फुट to hurt or break, aff. घञ्.
36221: विस्मय m. (-यः) 1 Wonder, surprise, astonishment. 2 Pride, arrogance. 3 Doubt, uncertainty. E. वि before स्मि to smile, aff. अच्.
36222: विस्मयाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bewildered, astounded. E. विस्मय, and आकुल perplexed.
36223: विस्मयान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Astonished, surprised. E. विस्मय surprise, अन्वित affected.
36224: विस्मयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Astonished, surprised. E. विस्मय, and इनि aff.
36225: विस्मरण n. (-णं) Forgetting. E. वि before स्मृ to remember, ल्युट् aff.
36226: विस्मरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be forgotten. E. वि priv., स्मृ to remember, अनीयर् aff.
36227: विस्मर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be forgotten. E. वि before स्मृ to remember, यत् aff.
36228: विस्मापन m. (-नः) 1 Deceit, illusion. 2 A magical or enchanted city, one that appears and disappears unexpectedly, or in unexpected situations, a city of the Gandharbas. 3 KĀMA or CUPID. 4 Astonishing, surprising, causing wonder or surprise. E. वि before स्मि to smile, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
36229: विस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Astonished, surprised. E. वि before स्मि to smile, aff. क्त.
36230: विस्मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Forgotten. E. वि privative, and स्मृत remembered.
36231: विस्मृति f. (-तिः) Forgetting, forgetfulness. E. वि priv., and स्मृति recollection.
36232: विस्मेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Astonished, surprised. E. वि before स्मि to smile, र aff.
36233: विस्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Flowing, trickling. E. वि before ष्यदि to flow, अच् aff.
36234: विस्र n. (-स्रं) A smell like that of raw meat. E. विस to send, aff. रक्.
36235: विस्रंस mf. (-सः-सा) 1 Relaxation, laxness. 2 Debility, decay. E. वि, स्रंस to fall, अङ् and टाप् affs.
36236: विस्रंसन n. (-नं) 1 Loosening, unfastening, untying. 2 Falling. 3 Flowing, dropping. 4 A laxative, an aperient. E. वि separate, स्रंस to fall, ल्युट् aff.
36237: विस्रगन्धि m. (-न्धिः) Yellow orpiment. E. विस्र the smell of raw meat, and गन्धि smelling.
36238: विस्रता f. (-ता) Rawness of smell. E. तल् added to विस्र as above; also with त्व, विस्रत्वं.
36239: विस्रब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Trusted, confided in. 2 Placid, tamed, humble. 3 Steady, diligent. E. वि before स्रंभ to trust, aff. क्त.
36240: विस्रम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Trust, confidence. 2 Affection, regard, affectionate solicitation. 3 Acquaintance. 4 Killing. E. वि before स्रम्भ to trust, aff. घञ्.
36241: विस्रम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) Trusting, confiding in. E. वि before स्रम्भ to trust, aff. घिनुण्.
36242: विस्रसा f. (-सा) Decrepitude, the infirmity of old age. E. वि before स्रंस to fall, aff. अङ् and टाप्, and the radical nasal dropped.
36243: विस्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Loosened, detached, fallen. E. वि before स्रंस to fall, क्त aff.
36244: विस्रावण n. (-णं) 1 Causing to flow. 2 Bleeding. 3 Distilling. 4 A spirit distilled from molasses. E. वि before स्रु to drop, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
36245: विस्रावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bled. 2 Caused to flow. E. वि, स्रु to flow, causal v., क्त aff.
36246: विस्राव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be bled, requiring bleeding. 2 To be made to flow. E. वि, स्रु to ooze, causal v., यत aff.; also पिस्रावितव्य and विस्रावणीय.
36247: विस्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spread, stretched. 2 Dropped, flowing. E. वि apart, स्रु to go, क्त aff.
36248: विस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Discordant, unharmonious. E. वि deprec., स्वर sound.
36249: विस्वाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Insipid, flavourless. E. वि priv., स्वाद flavour.
36250: विहग m. (-गः) 1 A bird. 2 A cloud. 3 An arrow. 4 The sun. 5 The moon. 6 A planet. E. विह for विहायस् in the sky, and ग who goes; also विहङ्गम, &c.
36251: विहङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Going swiftly, flying. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A bird. 2 A cloud. 3 An arrow. 4 The moon. 5 The sun. E. विह for विहायस् in the air, and ग who goes: see the next.
36252: विहङ्गम m. (-मः) A bird. f. (-मा) A pole or yoke for carrying burthens. E. विह for विहायम् in the air, गम to go, aff. खच्, whence the nasal is inserted; also with the final rejected, विहङ्ग, &c.
36253: विहङ्गराज m. (-जः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. विहङ्ग a bird, and राज king.
36254: विहङ्गिका f. (-का) A sort of pole or yoke for carrying burthens. E. विहङ्ग a bird, and कन् aff., fem. form.
36255: विहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opposed, impeded, resisted. 2 Hurt, killed. m. (-तः) A Bauddha or Jaina temple. E. वि before हन to hurt or kill, aff. क्त.
36256: विहति f. (-तिः) Striking, killing. m. (-तिः) A friend or companion. E. वि, हन to strike, क्तिन् aff.
36257: विहनन n. (-नं) 1 Opposition, obstruction, impediment. 2 Injury, hurting. 3 Killing. 4 A bow for cleaning cotton. E. वि before हन to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
36258: विहर m. (-रः) Separation, disunion, absence. E. वि before हृ to convey, aff. अप्.
36259: विहरण n. (-णं) 1 Taking, taking off or away. 2 Going about for pleasure or exercise. E. वि, हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
36260: विहरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken away. 2 To be rambled or sported. E. वि before हृ to take, अनीयर् aff.
36261: विहसन n. (-नं) Laughing gently, smiling. E. वि, हस to laugh, ल्युट् aff.
36262: विहसित n. (-तं) A gentle laugh, a smile. E. वि before हस to laugh, aff. क्त.
36263: विहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Confounded, perplexed, bewildered. 2 Wise, learned. E. वि without, हस्त a hand, helpless, &c.
36264: विहा ind. Aptote noun. Heaven, paradise. E. वि before हा to abandon, Uṇādi aff. आ.
36265: विहापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Given. 2 Extorted. n. (-तं) Gift, donation. E. वि before हा to abandon, causal form, aff. क्त.  giving being considered as the abandonment of the thing given.
36266: विहाय ind. Having left or abandoned. E. वि before हा to quit, ल्यप् aff.
36268: विहायस् mn. (-याः-यः) The sky or atmosphere. m. (-याः) A bird. E. वि before हय to go, causal form, aff. असुन्.
36269: विहायस mn. (-सः-सं) Heaven, sky, atmosphere. m. (-सः) A bird. E. अच् added to the last.
36270: विहायसा ind. Heaven, sky, atmosphere. E. the third case of विहायस् used as an aptote noun.
36271: विहार m. (-रः) 1 Walking for pleasure or amusement. 2 Wandering, roaming, going about. 3 A Bauddha or Jaina convent. 4 Play, sport, pastime. 5 The shoulder. 6 A sort of bird. E. वि before हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also वीहार.
36272: विहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Taking pleasure or relaxation. E. विहार sport, &c., and इनि aff.
36273: विहास m. (-सः) A gentle laugh or smile. E. वि, and हास laugh.
36274: विहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, deposited. 2 Improper, unsuitable, unfit. 3 Done, acted, made. 4 Appointed, fixed. E. वि before धा to have, aff. क्त, or वि priv., and हित applicable.
36275: विहितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Doing, performing, making. E. वि before घा to have, क्तवतु aff.
36276: विहितागस् mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः) Faulty, offending, wicked. E. विहित done, अगस् sin.
36277: विहिताञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Making a respectful obeisance. E. विहित, and अञ्जलि salute.
36278: विहित्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Done according to rule. E. वि before घा to have, क्त्रि aff., and मप् augment.
36279: विहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Abandoned, left, deserted, deprived of. E. वि before हा to abandon, aff. क्त.
36280: विहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sported, played. 2 Expanded. n. (-तं) One of the feminine acts or properties indicating love, hesitation, reluctance (in a female) to avow her feelings to her lover. E. वि before हृ to take, aff. क्त.
36281: विहृति f. (-तिः) 1 Opening, expansion. 2 Sport, pastime. E. वि apart, हृ to convey, aff. क्तिच्.
36282: विहृत्य ind. 1 Having sported. 2 Having or being spread. E. वि before हृ to take, ल्यप aff.
36283: विहेठ m. (-ठः) Hurting, injury. E. वि before हेठ to annoy, aff. अच्.
36284: विहेठक m. (-कः) An injurer, a reviler, one who inflicts pain or injury on another. E. वि, हेठ to annoy, aff. वुन्.
36285: विहेठन n. (-नं) 1 Injury, hurting, wounding, killing. 2 Rubbing, grinding. 3 Afflicting, distressing. 4 Pain, sorrow, affliction. E. वि before हेठ to annoy or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
36286: विह्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Agitated, alarmed, overcome with fear or agitation, beside one's self, unable to restrain one's self. 2 Distressed, afflicted. 3 Fused, liquid. E. वि before ह्वल to shake, aff. अच.
36287: विह्वलता f. (-ता) Agitation, anxiety. E. विह्वल, and तल् aff. also with त्व, विह्वलत्वं.
36288: वी r. 2nd cl. (वेति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To pervade. 3 To conceive, to be impregnated. 4 To desire. 5 To throw or send. 6 To eat. With सम् prefixed, To invest, to inclose, to cover or wrap round or over.
36289: वी m. (-वीः) 1 Going, moving. 2 Covering. E. वी to go, aff. क्विप्.
36290: वीक m. (-कः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A bird. E. अज to go, वि substituted for the root, कन् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
36291: वीकाश m. (-शः) 1 Solitude, privacy. 2 Display, manifestation. E. वि before काश to shine, aff. अच्, and the vowel of the prefix long, by special rule.
36292: वीक्ष mf. (-क्षः-क्षा) Sight, seeing. n. (-क्षं) 1 Surprise, astonishment. 2 A visible object. E. वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. क.
36293: वीक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) Sight, seeing. E. वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. युच्.
36294: वीक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Visible, perceptible. E. वीक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.
36295: वीक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Seeing, looking at. E. वि before ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.
36296: वीक्षापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Astonished, surprised. E. वीक्ष sight, आपन्न disturbed.
36297: वीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. n. (-तं) A look, a glance. E. वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. क्त.
36298: वीक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 Visible, perceptible. 2 Astonishing, wonderful. ind. Having seen. n. (-क्ष्यं) 1 Wonder, surprise. 2 A visible object. m. (-क्ष्यः) 1 A dancer, an actor. 2 A horse. E. वि before ईक्ष to see, aff. यत् or ल्यप्.
36299: वीङ्खा f. (-ङ्खा) 1 Going, moving, locomotion, progress, proceeding. 2 Dancing. 3 A particular mode of moving. 4 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 5 One of a horse's paces. E. वि before इखि to go, aff. घञ्.
36300: वीचयन n. (-नं) Research, enquiry. E. वि before चि to collect, ल्युट् aff., and the vowel of the prefix made long.
36301: वीचि mf. (-चिः-चिः or -ची) 1 A wave. 2 A small or rippling wave. 3 Pleasure, delight, happiness. 4 Leisure, interval, rest. 5 A ray of light. 6 Small, little. E. वेञ् to weave, Uṇādi aff. ईचि, and the radical vowel rejected.
36302: वीचिमालिन् m. (-ली) The ocean. E. वीचि a wave, and माला a necklace, aff. इनि.
36304: वीज n. (-जं) 1 Seed, (of plants, &c.) 2 Cause, origin in general. 3 Semen virile. 4 Receptacle, place of deposit or preparation. 5 Truth, divine truth, as the seed or cause of being. 6 Marrow. 7 Algebra, analysis. 8 The mystical letter or syllable which forms the essential part of the Mantra of any deity. 9 The origin of the business of a drama. E. वि variously, जन to be born or produced, (from it,) aff. ड, and the vowel made long; or व्येञ् to cover, aff. क्विप्, वी covering, जन to be born, aff. ड; or वि implying possession, ई LAKṢMĪ, or prosperity, जन to be produced (by it), with the same affix: there are other derivations.
36305: वीजक m. (-कः) The common citron, (Citrus medica.) n. (-कं) Seed. E. वीज seed, and कन् aff.
36306: वीजकोश m. (-शः) 1 The seed vessel of the lotus. 2 Any seed vessel. f. (-शी) A pod, a legume. E. वीज seed, and कोश or कोष receptacle; whence also वीजकोष m. (-षः) वीजकोषी f. (-षी) &c.
36307: वीजगणित n. (-तं) Algebra. E. वीज, and गणित calculation.
36308: वीजगुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) A legume, a pod. E. वीज seed, गुप्ति concealment.
36309: वीजतस् ind. From or according to the seed. E. वीज, and तसि aff.
36310: वीजन n. (-नं) 1 A fan. 2 Thing, substance. m. (-नः) 1 A sort of pheasant. 2 The ruddy goose.
36311: वीजपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Common citron. 2 A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. वीज a seed, and पुष्प a flower.
36312: वीजपुष्पिका f. (-का) A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.) E. वीज a seed, पुष्प a flower, कन् aff., fem. form.
36313: वीजपूर m. (-रः) Common citron or a variety, (Citrus medica.) E. वीज a seed, and पूर what is full of.
36314: वीजपूर्ण m. (-र्णः) Common citron, or according to some authorities, a large kind of lime. E. वीज seed, and पूर्ण filled.
36315: वीजप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Sowing seed, &c. m. (-दः) Generating, or a generator. E. वीज, and पद what gives.
36316: वीजप्ररोह m. (-हः) Growing from seed. E. वीज, and प्ररोह growing.
36317: वीजमातृका f. (-का) The pericarp or seed-vessel of the lotus. E. वीज seed, and मातृका parent.
36318: वीजरुह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Growing from seed. m. (-हः) Grain, corn. E. वीज seed, and रुह what grows.
36319: वीजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Who or what has seed. E. वीज, and मतुप् aff.
36320: वीजवर m. (-रः) Kidney-bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.) E. वीज seed, and वर what screens.
36321: वीजसू f. (-सूः) The earth. E. वीज seed, and सू parent.
36322: वीजा ind. By or with seed, sowing with seed. E. वीज, and डाच् aff.
36323: वीजाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ploughed or harrowed after sowing, (a field, &c.) E. वीज a seed, and कृत made, with डाच् added to the first.
36324: वीजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sown with, having for seed. 2 Fanned. E. वीज, and इतच् aff. or वीज to fan, क्त aff.
36325: वीजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Having seed, origin, &c. m. (-जी) A father, a progenitor. E. वीज semen, and इनि aff.
36326: वीजोत्कृष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Good seed. E. वीज, and उत्कृष्ट excellent.
36327: वीजोदक n. (-कं) Hail. E. वीज origin or original, उदक water.
36328: वीज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) 1 Sprung from some family. 2 Sprung from seed. E. वीज seed or origin, and यत् aff.
36329: वीज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fanned. E. वीज to fan, pass. v., शानच् aff.
36330: वीटिका f. (-का) 1 The betel plant, (Piper betel.) 2 The preparation of the Areca nut with spices and chunam, and enveloped in the leaf of the Piper betel, Betel, Paun. 3 A tye, a fastening. E. वि before इट् to go, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form; also वीटि or वीटी.
36331: वीणा f. (-णा) 1 The Vīṇā, or Indian lute, a fretted instrument of the guitar kind, usually having seven wires or strings, and a large gourd at each end of the finger board; the extent of the instrument is two octaves: it is supposed to be the invention of NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and has many varieties, enumerated according to the number of strings, &c. 2 Lightning. E. वी to go, &c., Uṇādi aff. न, form irr.
36332: वीणादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The neck of a Vīṇā or lute. E. वीणा a lute, and दण्ड a stick.
36333: वीणानुवन्ध m. (-न्धः) The tie of a lute or lower part of the tail piece, where the wires are fixed. E. वीणा the lute, and अनुवन्ध appendage, tie.
36334: वीणावाद m. (-दः) A player on the Vīṇā, a lutanist. E. वीणा a lute, and वाद who causes to speak or sound; also with कन added, वीणावादक.
36335: वीणास्य m. (-स्यः) NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and inventor of the Vīṇā or lute. E. वीणा, and आस्य the countenance.
36336: वीतंस m. (-सः) 1 A cage, a chain or net, &c. for confining birds or beasts. 2 An enclosure for tranquillising or taming them, an aviary, a menagerie. 3 A place for keeping game, a preserve. E. वि before तसि to adorn, aff. घञ्, and the vowel of the prefix made long.
36337: वीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, departed. 2 Exempt or freed from. 3 Loosed, let go, unbound. 4 Tranquil, quiet, tame. m. (-तः) 1 A horse or elephant, untrained to or unfit for war. 2 Goading an elephant. E. वी to go, aff. क्त.
36338: वीतकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Free from sin or soil. E. वीत, and कल्मष sin.
36339: वीतकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Free from desire. E. वीत, and काम desire.
36340: वीतदम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) Humble, lowly, not proud. E. वीत gone, दम्भ pride, &c.
36341: वीतन mfn. (-नौ) The sides or cartilages of the larynx.
36342: वीतभय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearless, undaunted. E. वीत, and भष fear.
36343: वीतराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Exempt from passions or affections. 2 Bleached, colourless. m. (-गः) 1 Any sage with subdued passions. 2 A Bauddha deified sage. E. वीत gone, and राग passion, desire.
36344: वीतविरुद्धबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Peaceable, without hostile intentions. E. वीत, विरुद्ध opposed, and वुद्धि understanding.
36345: वीतशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless. E. वीत, and शङ्क fear.
36346: वीतशोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Free from care or sorrow. m. (-कः) The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) E. वीत gone, and शोक sorrow.
36347: वीतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Free from desire. E. वीत, and स्पृहा desire.
36348: वीति f. (-तिः) 1 Going, moving, motion. 2 Eating. 3 Engendering, producing. 4 Cleaning, cleansing. 5 Light, lustre. m. (-तिः) A horse. E. वी to go, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.
36349: वीतिहोत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 AGNI or fire. 2 The sun. E. वीति a horse. होत्र clarified butter, the usual offering or oblation with fire; also वीतिहोत्रक.
36350: वीतोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unable or disinclined to reply, having no answer. E. वीत, and उत्तर answer.
36351: वीथि f. (-थिः or -थी) 1 A road. 2 A row, a line. 3 A terrace in front of a house. 4 A stall, a shop. 5 A sort of drama, in one act, and by one or by two performers, the dramatic narration of an amatory story or intrigue. E. विथ to ask or beg, aff. इन्, and the vowel made long; also ङीष् optionally added, and with कन् aff., fem. form, वीथिका.
36352: वीथ्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Dialogue, &c. suited to, and constituting the dramatic entertainment called Vīthi, though employed in other kinds, as quibble, equivoque, jest, abuse, and the like. E. वीथि, and अङ्ग a part.
36353: वीध्र mfn. (-ध्रः-ध्रा-ध्रं) Clean, clear, pure. E. वि before इन्ध to shine, Uṇādi aff. रक, and the first consonant rejected.
36354: वीनाह m. (-हः) The top or cover of a well. E. वि before नह to bind, aff. घञ्; also विनाह.
36356: वीप्सा f. (-प्सा) Several or successive order, the arrangement of things or properties each by each, or in succession, as वृक्षं वृक्षं सिञ्चति he waters tree after tree. E. वि before अप to go, or get, desiderative form, अच् aff.
36358: वीभ (ऋ) वीभृ r. 1st cl. (वीभते) To praise; also read चीभृ q. v.
36359: वीर r. 10th cl. (वीरयति) To be powerful or valiant, to make heroic or irresistible effort.
36360: वीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Excellent, eminent, (used chiefly in composition.) 2 Heroic. 3 Powerful, mighty. 4 Strong, robust. m. (-रः) 1 A hero, a warrior, a champion. 2 Heroism, the heroic Rasa or feeling, as an object of poetical description especially. 3 The last Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present æra. 4 An actor, a mime. 5 A flower, (Nerium odorum.) 6 Fire. 7 Sacrificial fire. f. (-रा) 1 A matron, a wife and mother. 2 A sort of perfume, commonly Murā. 3 A medicinal root, commonly Kṣīrakākolī. 4 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 5 A drug, (Elavāluka.) 6 Plaintain tree. 7 A sort of Asclepias, (A. rosea.) 8 Opposite-leaved fig tree. 9 A sort of Convolvulus, (C. paniculatus, the white and dark kinds.) 10 A small tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 11 Spirituous liquor or a particular kind of it. 12 The aloe. 13 A plant, commonly Atis. n. (-रं) 1 A reed, (Arundo tibialis.) 2 The root of the ginger plant. (?) 3 Pepper. 4 Rice-gruel. 5 The root of the Costus speciosus. 6 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. अज to go, and वी substituted for the root, रक् Uṇādi aff., or वीर to be powerful, aff. क.
36361: वीरजयन्तिका f. (-का) 1 A war-dance, a dance performed by soldiers after a victory or on going to battle. 2 War, battle. E. वीर a hero, जि to conquer, झच् aff., fem. form, and कन् added.
36362: वीरण n. (-नं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) f. (-णी) A side glance, a leer. 3 A deep place. E. वि a bird, ईर to go, and ल्युट् aff.
36363: वीरतर n. (-रं) 1 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) m. (-रः) 1 An arrow. 2 A distinguished hero. 3 A corpse. (?) E. वीर powerful, तरप् aff.
36364: वीरतरु m. (-रुः) 1 A large tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna, Rox.) 2 A shrub, (Barleria longifolia, Rox.) E. वीर a hero, and तरु the tree.
36365: वीरता f. (-ता) Heroism. E. तल् added to वीर; also with त्व aff. वीरत्वं.
36366: वीरधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) KĀMA or CUPID. E. वीर a hero, and धन्वन् a bow.
36367: वीरन्धर m. (-रः) 1 A peacock. 2 Fighting with wild beasts. 3 A leather cuirass or jacket. 4 The name of a river. E. वीर a hero, धृ to hold, खच् aff.
36368: वीरपत्नी f. (-त्नी) The wife of a hero. E. वीर a hero, and पत्नी the wife.
36369: वीरपाण n. (-णं) The drink of warriors, taken during the battle for refreshment, or before it, to elevate courage. E. वीर a hero, and पान drink; the न is optionally changed, whence it also occurs वीरपान.
36370: वीरभद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice. 2 A distinguished hero. 3 A fragrant grass, &c. वीरण. 4 One of ŚIVA'S attendants. 5 One of the Rudras. E. वीर a hero, and भद्र auspicious.
36371: वीरभद्रक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.) E. कन् added to the last.
36372: वीरभार्य्या f. (-र्य्या) The wife of a hero. E. वीर a hero, and भार्य्या a wife.
36373: वीरमातृ f. (-ता) The mother of a hero. E. वीर, and मातृ mother.
36374: वीरमुद्रिका f. (-का) An ornament or ring worn on the middle toe. E. वीर a hero, मुद्रा a seal, कन् aff.
36375: वीररेणु m. (-णुः) A name of BHĪMASENA. E. त्रीर a hero, and रेणु dust.
36376: वीरवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a champion or hero. f. (-ती) A woman whose husband is living. E. वीर, and मतुप् poss. aff.
36377: वीरवत्सा f. (-त्सा) The mother of a hero. E. वीर, and वत्स the child, (of whom.)
36378: वीरविप्लावक m. (-कः) A Brahman, who performs his oblations with money, procured from the lower or Śūdra tribe. E. वीर sacrificial fire, वि before प्लु to go, ण्वुल् aff.
36379: वीरवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 The marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) 2 A large tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) 3 A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.) E. वीर strong or a hero, and वृक्ष a tree.
36380: वीरसू f. (-सूः) 1 The mother of a hero. 2 The mother of a male child. E. वीर a hero, and सू mother.
36381: वीरसेन m. (-नः) The father of NALA Rāja. E. वीर a hero, and सेना a host.
36382: वीरसेनज m. (-जः) NALA, a prince and hero of several celebrated poems, as the Naiṣadha, Nalodaya, &c. E. वीरसेन the father of the prince, and ज born.
36384: वीरस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A buffalo. E. वीर powerful, स्कन्ध the shoulder.
36385: वीरहन् m. (-हा) A Brahman, who has suffered the sacred domestic fire to become extinct, either from carelessness, impiety, or absence. E. वीर sacrificial fire, and हन् who destroys.
36386: वीराशंसन n. (-नं) 1 The post of danger, the place in battle which is most perilous and exposed. 2 Keeping watch. E. वीर a hero, आङ् before शसि to wish, aff. ल्युट्.
36387: वीरासन n. (-नं) 1 Sleeping out in the open air, a bivouac. 2 A field of battle. 3 A kneeling posture. E. वीर, and आसन sitting.
36388: वीरुध् f. (-रुट् or -रुत्) 1 A creeper or spreading creeper. 2 A branch and shoot. E. वि before रुध to impede, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel of the prefix made long; also टाप् being added, वीरुधा f. (-धा.)
36389: वीरेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 VĪRABHADRA, one of ŚIVA'S attendants. 2 A great hero. E. वीर a hero, and ईश्वर lord or chief.
36390: वीरोञ्झ m. (-ञ्झः) A Brahman, who omits offering burnt offerings or neglects his sacrificial fire. E. वीर fire, उञ्झ to abandon, aff. अण्.
36391: वीरोपजीविक m. (-कः) A Brahman, who claims alms or presents, on the merit of having preserved his sacrificial fire. E. वीर sacrificial fire, and उपजीविक living by.
36392: वीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Strength, vigour, power. 2 Dignity, consequence. 3 Fortitude, firmness. 4 Semen virile. 5 Splendour, lustre. 6 Heroism, valour. 7 Seed, (of plants, &c.) E. वीर a hero, and यत् aff., or वीर to be strong, and अच् and यत् aff.
36393: वीर्य्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Strong, stout, robust. 2 Overcoming, victorious. E. वीर्य्य strength, मतुप् poss. aff.
36394: वीर्य्यविरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Devoid of prowess or vigour, &c. E. वीर्य्य, and विरहित deprived of.
36395: वीर्य्यविशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Possessed of courage, vigour, &c. E. वीर्य्य, and विशिष्ट endowed with.
36396: वीर्य्यहानि f. (-निः) 1 Loss of vigour or courage. 2 Impotence. E. वीर्य्य, and हानि loss.
36397: वीर्य्यहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Seedless. 2 Cowardly. E. वीर्य्य, and हीन void of.
36398: वीर्य्यावदान n. (-नं) Effecting any thing by prowess. E. वीर्य्य, and अवदान end.
36399: वीर्य्यावधूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overcome or surpassed in prowess. E. वीर्य्य, and अवधूत shaken.
36400: वीवध m. (-धः) 1 A yoke for carrying burthens. 2 A burthen. 2 Storing or heaping corn. 4 A road: see विवध.
36401: वीवधिक mfn. (-कः-की) 1 A chandler. 2 A man or woman carrying a load by means of a yoke. E. वीवध as above, ठन् aff., and the first vowel unchanged.
36402: वीहार m. (-रः) A holy place, a temple, a sanctuary, but especially a Jaina or Bauddha convent. E. वि before हृ to convey, aff. घञ्; also विहार.
36403: वुग (इ) वुगि r. 1st cl. (वुंगति) To except, to leave, to abandon.
36404: वुट r. 1st and 10th cls. (वोटयति) To hurt, to kill.
36405: वुध (इ) बुधि r. 10th cl. (वुन्धयति) To injure, to hurt, to kill.
36406: वुस r. 4th cl. (वुस्यति) To throw or cast off; also बुस.
36407: वूष r. 10th cl. (वूषयति) To kill, to hurt or injure.
36408: वृ (ड,) वृङ् r. 9th cl. (वृणीते) To serve, to do homage or worship, to conciliate by service or adoration. (ञ) वृञ् r. 1st cl. (वरति-ते) r. 5th cl. (वृणोति वृणुते) r. 10th cl. (वारयति-ते) 1 To choose, to select, to prepare. 2 To appoint, to invite. 3 To screen, to invest, to cover. With अप prefixed, To cover, to screen, to shield or defend. With आङ्, To inclose, to cover, to surround. With नि or निर्, To cease, to refrain from, to finish or end. With परि, 1 To surround. 2 To depend upon. With वि, To become evident or apparent, to open or appear. With सम्, To conceal. With सम् and आङ्, To wrap up, to involve.
36409: वृंहण mfn. (-णः-णा or -णी-णं) Nourishing, fattening, nutritious. m. (-णः) A kind of sweetmeat made of sugar, milk, spices, &c. fried in Ghee, and powdered with coarse sugar or treacle. E. वृहि to increase, and ल्युट् or युच् aff.
36410: वृंहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be nourished, what ought to or may be. E. वृहि to grow, अनीयर् aff.
36411: वृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Grown, increased. 2 Cherished, nourished. n. (-तं) The roar of elephants. E. वृहि to grow or increase, aff. क्त.
36412: वृक r. 1st cl. (वर्कते) To take or accept.
36413: वृक m. (-कः) 1 A wolf. 2 A crow. 3 The Vakapushpa tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) 4 A Shakal. 5 Turpentine. 6 Compounded perfume. f. (-का) A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. वृक to take, aff. क, or वृ to hide or screen, Uṇādi aff. कक्.
36414: वृकदंश m. (-शः) A dog. E. वृक a wolf, and दंश who bites.
36415: वृकधूप m. (-पः) 1 Compounded perfume. 2 Turpentine. E. वृक the same meanings, and धूप incense.
36416: वृकाराति m. (-तिः) A dog. E. वृक a wolf, and अराति an enemy.
36417: वृकारि m. (-रिः) A dog. E. वृक a wolf, and अरि an enemy.
36418: वृकोदर m. (-रः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 Name of BHĪMA. E. वृक a wolf, and उदर the belly.
36419: वृक्ण mfn. (-क्णः-क्णा-क्णं) Cut, divided, broken. E. व्रश्च to cut, aff. क्त, form irr.; also read वृक्न.
36420: वृक्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Cutting, severing. E. व्रश्च to cut, क्तवतु aff.
36421: वृक्ष r. 1st cl. (वृक्षते) 1 To appoint. 2 To cover. 3 To take or accept.
36422: वृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree in general. E. वृक्ष to cover, (to shade,) aff. घञ् or व्रश्च to cut, and स Uṇādi aff.
36423: वृक्षक m. (-कः) 1 A small tree, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 2 Any tree. E. कन् added to the last.
36424: वृक्षकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A wild cock. E. वृक्ष, and कुक्कुट a cock.
36425: वृक्षखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A grove. E. वृक्ष, and खण्ड a part.
36426: वृक्षचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Going or living in trees. m. (-रः) A monkey. E. वृक्ष a tree, or any other synonym, and चर who goes.
36427: वृक्षछाया f. (-या) The shade of a single tree. n. (-यं) The shade of many trees, or a grove. E. वृक्ष a tree, and छाया shade; in the second sense, it takes the neuter gender.
36428: वृक्षतल n. (-लं) The foot of a tree or ground about it. E. वृक्ष, and तल below.
36429: वृक्षधूप m. (-पः) Turpentine. E. वृक्ष a tree, and धूप incense.
36430: वृक्षनाथ m. (-थः) The Indian fig tree. E. वृक्ष a tree, and नाथ lord.
36431: वृक्षनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) Gum, resin. E. वृक्ष, and निर्य्यास exudation.
36432: वृक्षनिवास m. (-सः) Dwelling or living in a tree. E. वृक्ष, and निवास abode.
36433: वृक्षपाक m. (-कः) The Indian fig tree. E. वृक्ष a tree, and पाक what ripens or perfects.
36434: वृक्षभवन n. (-नं) A hollow in a tree. E. वृक्ष a tree, and भवन a dwelling.
36435: वृक्षभिद् f. (-भिद् or -भित्) An axe. E. वृक्ष a tree, and भिद् breaking, cutting.
36436: वृक्षभेदिन् m. (-दी) 1 A carpenter's chisel. 2 A hatchet. E. वृक्ष a tree, and भेदिन् what breaks.
36437: वृक्षमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Abounding with trees. E. वृक्ष, and मयट् aff.
36438: वृक्षमर्कटिका f. (-का) A squirrel. E. वृक्ष a tree, मर्कट a monkey, कन् aff. of comparison.
36439: वृक्षमृद्भू m. (-द्भूः) A sort of cane or reed, (Calamus fascicularis.) E. वृक्ष a tree, मृद् earth, and भू born.
36440: वृक्षरुह mf. (-हः-हा) A parasite plant, (Cymbidum tessalloides, &c. E. वृक्ष, and रुह growing, having its roots attached to the trunk or branches of another plant or tree.
36441: वृक्षरोपण n. (-ण) Planting trees. E. वृक्ष, and रोपण planting; also वृक्षारोपण.
36442: वृक्षवाटिका f. (-का) A garden, a grove, one belonging to the residence of a minister of state, a courtezan, &c. E. वृक्ष a tree, and वाटिका or वाटी an enclosure; hence also वृक्षवाटी.
36443: वृक्षश m. (-शः) A lizard, a chamæleon. E. वृक्ष a tree, and शी to sleep, aff. ड.
36444: वृक्षशायिका f. (-का) A squirrel. E. वृक्ष, शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.
36445: वृक्षस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) What is or stays in or on a tree. E. वृक्ष, and स्थ who or what stays, also वृक्षस्थायिन्, वृक्षस्थित, &c.
36446: वृक्षाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The top of a tree. E. वृक्ष, and अग्र top.
36447: वृक्षाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) The root of a tree. E. वृक्ष, and अङ्घ्रि foot.
36448: वृक्षादन m. (-नः) 1 A carpenter's chisel or adze. 2 A hatchet, a chopper. 3 The Indian fig tree. 4 The Piyāl tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) f. (-नी) 1 A parasite plant, (Epidendron.) 2 A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. वृक्ष a tree, अदन eating or food.
36449: वृक्षादिरुहक n. (-कं) Embracing. E. वृक्षादि trees, &c., रुह ascended, and कन् aff. of comparison; entwining as a creeper round a tree, &c.; also derived from रुह with क्त aff. वृक्षादिरूढ n. (-ढं).
36450: वृक्षाम्ल m. (-म्लः) The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.) n. (-म्लं) Acid seasoning, or the fruit of the tamarind so used. E. वृक्ष a tree, and अम्ल sour.
36451: वृक्षारोपक m. (-कः) A planter of a tree. E. वृक्ष, and आरोपक who plants.
36452: वृक्षारोपण n. (-णं) Planting trees. E. वृक्ष, and आरोपण planting.
36453: वृक्षालय m. (-यः) A bird in general. E. वृक्ष a tree, and आलय abode.
36454: वृक्षावास m. (-सः) 1 An ascetic, one who lives in the hollows of trees. 2 A bird. E. वृक्ष a tree, आवास abode.
36455: वृक्षोत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Growing on or borne by a tree. E. वृक्ष, and उत्थ what rises.
36456: वृक्षोत्पल m. (-लः) A large handsome tree, commonly Kaniyar or Karṇikāra, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) E. वृक्ष a tree, and उत्पल a lotus.
36457: वृच (ई) वृची r. 7th cl. (वृणक्ति) 1 To cover. 2 To quit, to abandon, to shun or avoid.
36458: वृज(ई)वृजी r. 1st cl. (वर्जति) 2nd cl. (वृक्ते) 7th cl. (वृणक्ति) 10th cl. (वर्ज्जयति) 1 To quit, to shun, to avoid, to except, to abandon. 2 (In the 7th cl.) To cover. With अप, To relinquish.
36459: वृजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Crooked. n. (-नं) 1 Sin. 2 Sky, atmosphere. m. (-नः) Hair. E. वृज to quit, &c., Uṇādi aff. क्यु.
36460: वृजि f. (-जिः) A country, probably that to the west of Dehli and Agra, or the modern Bruj. E. वृज to quit, aff. कि.
36461: वृजिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of the district of Vrij or Bruj, (as a dialect, a native, &c.) E. वृजि as above, and कन् added.
36462: वृजिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Crooked, bent, curved. 2 Wicked. n. (-नं) 1 Sin, vice, wickedness. 2 Red leather. 3 Distress, affliction. m. (-नः) Hair. E. वृज to cover, Uṇādi aff. इनच्. and the vowel unchanged.
36463: वृण r. 6th cl. (वृणति) To please, to gratify. (उ) (वृणु) r. 8th cl. (वृणोति) To eat.
36464: वृण्वत् mfn. (-ण्वन्-ण्वती-ण्वत्) Choosing, electing, preferring, (especially as a husband or wife.) E. वृ to choose, शतृ aff.
36465: वृण्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Choosing. E. वृ to choose, शानच् aff.: see the last.
36466: वृत (उ) वृतु r. 1st cl. (वर्त्तते) To be, to exist, to stay, to stand, to be fixed or stable. r. 4th cl. (वृत्यते) 1 To choose, to select or appoint. 2 To serve. r. 10th cl. (वर्त्तयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak. With अति prefixed, 1 To surpass or overcome. 2 To pass over or beyond. 3 To transgress. With अनु, 1 To follow, to imitate. 2 To proceed. With अप, To turn back or round. With आङ्, 1 To turn round, to revolve. 2 To do repeatedly. With नि, To make artificially. With नि or निर्, To stop, to cease, to complete or terminate. With परि, 1 To surround. 2 To exchange. 3 To excel, to be pre-eminent. 4 To advance. 5 To retreat or return. 6 To turn round. With प्र, To engage in any active pursuit. With प्रति and नि, To go away, to depart. With वि, 1 To roll, to whirl, to turn round. 2 To revolve. With वि and नि, To return. With वि and परि, To revolve, (in the mind.) With सम and अभि, To leap.
36467: वृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Chosen, selected, preferred. 2 Agreed or assented to. 3 Served. 4 Covered, screened, defended. 5 Affected by. 6 Vitiated, spoiled. E. वृ to prefer, and क्त aff.
36468: वृति f. (-तिः) 1 Selecting, choosing, preferring, appointing. 2 Soliciting, asking, requesting. 3 Surrounding, encompassing. 4 An enclosure, a place enclosed for particular cultivation, and especially that of the Piper betel, which in many parts of India is surrounded and screened my mats. 5 Hiding, secreting. E. वृ to choose, aff. क्तिन्.
36469: वृतिङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Surrounding, encompassing. m. (-रः) A plant, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) E. वृति surrounding, कृ to make, खच् aff.
36470: वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Chosen, selected, appointed. 2 Done, performed, engaged in or undertaken. 3 Past, gone, been. 4 Over, finished. 5 Dead, deceased. 6 Read, studied, read through. 7 Covered. 8 Round. 9 Firm, hard. 10 Unobstructed, unimpaired. 11 Famous, celebrated. n. (-त्तं) 1 Verse, metre. 2 Conduct, observance of enjoined practice in private or social life. 3 Practice, profession, means of gaining a subsistence. 4 Procedure, event, occurrence. 5 A circle. m. (-त्तः) A tortoise. E. वृत to be, &c., aff. क्त.
36471: वृत्तखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Sector or segment of a circle. E. वृत्त, and खण्ड part.
36472: वृत्तज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Who or what knows men's actions. E. वृत्त, and ज्ञ who knows.
36473: वृत्ततस् ind. In or relating to observance or duty, by caste or duty, not implying agency; as वृत्ततः पापं "by or according to caste, a sin". E. तसि substituted for the termination of the third case.
36474: वृत्तपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cadamba.) E. वृत्त round, and पुष्प a flower.
36475: वृत्तफल n. (-लं) Black pepper. E. वृत्त round, and फल fruit.
36476: वृत्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Discharging the duties of caste or calling, correct, well-conducted. E. वृत्त, and मतुप् aff.
36477: वृत्तसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Well-behaved or conducted, behaving with propriety. E. वृत्त duty, and सम्पन्न perfect in.
36478: वृत्तसादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Worthless, mean, vile. E. वृत्त, and षद to go (from), घिनुण् aff.
36479: वृत्तस्थ m. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Discharging the duties of caste or calling. E. वृत्त established practice, and स्थ who stays.
36480: वृत्ताध्ययनर्द्धि f. (-र्द्धिः) Holiness, sanctity, resulting from observance of the rules of life and study of scripture. E. वृत्त conduct, अध्ययन study, and ऋद्धि prosperity, increase.
36481: वृत्तानुवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Obedient, conforming to rule. E. वृत्त, अनु according to, वर्त्तिन् abiding.
36482: वृत्तानुसार m. (-रः) Conforming to prescribed practice. E. वृत्त, and अनुसार following.
36483: वृत्तानुसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Conforming to established rule or practice, doing what is enjoined or proper. E. वृत्तानुसार, and इनि aff.
36484: वृत्तान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Tidings, rumor, intelligence. 2 Sort, kind, difference. 3 Mode, manner. 4 Whole. 5 Interval, rest, leisure, opportunity. 6 Topic, subject. 7 A tale, a story. 8 Property, nature. 9 Alone, solitary. E. वृत्त observance, &c., and अन्त, end, term.
36485: वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Livelihood, profession, means of acquiring subsistence. 2 Style or character of dramatic representation, or composition, considered to be of four sorts, or Kauśikī, which exhibits love or passion; Bhāratī, which appears to implies declamation especially; Sātvatī, of which the subject is virtue and heroism; and Ārabhaṭī, which treats of magic, delusion, wrath, and battle. 3 Style in general. 4 Gloss, comment, explanation, exposition. 5 Being, abiding, staying. 6 Seizing, stopping, withholding, restraining. 7 Circumference of a circle. E. वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्.
36486: वृत्तिकर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attracted by or impelled to for the sake of subsistence. E. वृत्ति, and कर्षित attracted.
36487: वृत्तिता f. (-ता) 1 State of existence. 2 Profession, subsistence. E. वृत्ति, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वृत्तित्वं.
36488: वृत्तिदान n. (-नं) Giving maintenance, &c. E. वृत्ति, and दान giving.
36489: वृत्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Abiding, stationary. E. वृत्ति, and मतुप् aff.
36490: वृत्तिहेतु f. (-तुः) Cause or means of subsistence. E. वृत्ति, and हेतु cause.
36491: वृत्तौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जा-जः) Mighty, irresistible. E. वृत्त, and ओजस् strength.
36492: वृत्त्य mfn. (-त्त्यः-त्त्या-त्त्यं) 1 To be chosen, preferable, eligible. 2 Excellent, eminent. 3 To be abided or stayed. E. वृत to select, aff. क्यप् or वृञ् with the same aff., and तुक् augment.
36493: वृत्त्यर्थम् ind. For the sake of subsistence. E. वृत्ति, and अर्थम् for the sake of.
36494: वृत्त्यनुप्रास m. (-सः) Alliteration suited to any style or expression. E. वृत्ति, and अनुप्रास alliteration.
36495: वृत्त्युपाय m. (-यः) Means of subsistence. E. वृत्ति, and उपाय means. ##
36496: वृत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 An enemy. 2 Darkness. 3 A demon slain by INDRA. 4 A cloud. 5 A name of INDRA. 6 The name of a mountain. 7 Sound, noise. E. वृत to be or abide, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
36497: वृत्रद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) INDRA. E. वृत्र the demon, and द्विष् the enemy.
36498: वृत्रभोजन m. (-नः) A kind of potherb, described by some as a sort of cucumber. E. वृच INDRA, and भोजन food.
36499: वृत्रहन् m. (-हा) INDRA. E. वृत्र a demon, and हन् slayer.
36500: वृत्रारि m. (-रिः) INDRA. E. वृत्र a demon, and अरि an enemy.
36501: वृथा ind. 1 Useless, fruitless. 2 Wrong, incorrect. 3 In vain. 4 Compounded with articles of food, it implies they are hot. E. वृ to choose, &c., aff. थाक्.
36502: वृथाकथा f. (-था) Idle talk. E. वृथा, and कथा speech.
36503: वृथाघात m. (-तः) Striking or killing any being unnecessarily. E. वृथा, and आघात a blow.
36504: वृथाट्या f. (-त्टा) Going about or travelling for pleasure. E. वृथा, and अट्या roaming.
36505: वृथादान n. (-नं) Unprofitable donation, gift to encomiasts, harlots, wrestlers, money lost at play, &c. E. वृथा vain, and दान giving.
36506: वृथापशुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The slayer of an animal except for sacrifice. E. वृथा, and पशु an animal, घ्न who kills.
36507: वृथालम्भ m. (-म्भः) Cutting or plucking unnecessarily. E. वृथा, and लभि to get, aff. घञ्.
36508: वृथोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born or produced in vain. E. वृथा, and उत्यन्न produced.
36509: वृद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Old, aged, ancient. 2 Full grown, large, expanded to the proper size. 3 Wise, learned. 4 Heaped, accumulated. 5 Increased, augmented. m. (-द्धः) 1 An old man, or one past seventy. 2 A sage, a saint. f. (-द्धा) An old woman, either one past child-bearing, or one with grey hair. n. (-द्धं) Benzoin, (Styrax benzoin.) E. वृध to increase or grow, aff. क्त.
36510: वृद्धकाक m. (-कः) A sort of crow or raven. E. वृद्ध old or large, and काक a crow.
36511: वृद्धत्व n. (-त्वं) Old age. E. वृद्ध old, and त्व aff. of the abstract; also वृद्धता.
36512: वृद्धदारक m. (-कः) A climbing plant (Lettsomia neryosa.) E. वृद्ध old, and दारक tearing.
36513: वृद्धनाभि mfn. (-भिः-भिः-भी-भि) Pot-bellied, corpulent. E. वृद्ध large, and नाभि the navel.
36514: वृद्धप्रपितामह m. (-हः) A paternal great greatgrandfather. f. (-ही) A paternal great greatgrandmother. E. वृद्ध old, प्रपितामह great grandfather.
36515: वृद्धप्रमातामह m. (-हः) A maternal great greatgrandfather. f. (-ही) A maternal great greatgrandmother. E. वृद्ध, and प्रमातामह maternal greatgrandfather.
36516: वृद्धभाव m. (-वः) Old age. E. वृद्ध, and भाव quality.
36517: वृद्धराज m. (-जः) A kind of dock or sorrel: see अम्लबेतस्.
36518: वृद्धवाहन m. (-नः) The mango tree. E. वृद्ध large, and वाहन vehicle or stem.
36519: वृद्धविभीतक m. (-कः) Hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.) E. वृद्ध old or large, विभीतक myrobalan.
36520: वृद्धश्रवस् m. (-वाः) INDRA. E. वृद्ध aged, and श्रवस् hearing; who listens to the old or wise; or वृद्ध large, and श्रवस् the ear.
36521: वृद्धसंघ m. (-घः) An assembly of old men, a council or meeting of elders. E. वृद्ध an elder, and संघ assemblage.
36522: वृद्धसूत्रक n. (-कं) Flocculent seeds flying in the air. E. वृद्ध old, and सूत्र thread, aff. कन्.
36523: वृद्धसेवा f. (-वा) Reverence for old age. E. वृद्ध, and सेवा service.
36524: वृद्धाङ्गुलि f. (-लिः) The thumb. E. वृद्ध large, and अङ्गुलि a finger.
36525: वृद्धारण्य m. (-ण्यः) A place where the Purāṇas, or other sacred works are read and expounded. E. वृद्ध a Paṇḍita, a scholar, and अरण्य a forest.
36526: वृद्धावस्था f. (-स्था) The condition or period of old age. E. वृद्ध, and अवस्था state.
36527: वृद्धाश्रम m. (-मः) Roaming, travelling, wandering about. E. वृद्ध, and आश्रम order or state of life.
36528: वृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Increase, augmentation in general, as in bulk, consequence, wealth, &c. 2 The third of the three conditions or objects of regal power, extension of power or revenue, or any indication of progression. 3 Rise, ascending, mounting. 4 Prosperity, success. 5 One of the eight principal drugs or medical roots, described as mild and cooling, sweet and bitter, &c., as a remedy for phlegm, leprosy and worms. 6 The eleventh of the astronomical Yogas, or Yoga star of the 11th lunar mansion. 7 A particular period or division of time. 8 The increase of the digits of the sun or moon. 9 Enlargement of the scrotum, either from swelled testicle or hydrocele or other morbid affections. 10 Interest, usury, especially returning the principal, (as in the case of seed corn lent,) with a proportionate increment. 11 Happiness, pleasure. 12 A heap, a quantity, assemblage, multitude. 13 Wealth, property. 14 Cutting off, abscission. 15 (In law,) Forfeiture, deduction. E. वृध to increase, aff. कि, or in the two last senses वर्द्ध to cut, aff. कि, deriv. irr.
36529: वृद्धिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Yielding or causing increase, &c. E. वृद्धि, and कर what makes.
36530: वृद्धिका f. (-का) A sort of drug: see वृद्धि. E. कब् added to वृद्धि.
36531: वृद्धिजीविका f. (-का) The profession of usury. E. वृद्धि usury, and जीविका livelihood.
36532: वृद्धिपत्र n. (-त्रं) A kind of razor or lancet. E. वृद्धि, and पत्र blade.
36533: वृद्धिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Augmented, increased. 2 Rich. 3 Prosperous. E. वृद्धि, and मतुप् aff.
36534: वृद्धिश्राद्ध n. (-द्धं) A Śrāddha or sacrifice to progenitors on any prosperous occasion, as the birth of a son, &c. E. वृद्धि, and श्राद्ध ceremony so termed.
36535: वृद्धोक्ष m. (-क्षः) An old bull. E. वृद्ध old, and उक्ष a bull or ox.
36536: वृद्ध्याजीव m. (-वः) A usurer. E. वृद्धि usury, and आजीव who lives.
36537: वृध (उ,) वृधु r. 1st cl. (वर्द्धते) To increase or grow. r. 10th cl. (वर्द्धयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak.
36538: वृधसान m. (-नः) A man. E. वृध to grow or increase, aff. असानच्.
36539: वृधसानु m. (-नुः) 1 A man. 2 A leaf. 3 Act, action. E. वृध to increase, असानु aff.
36540: वृध्न m. (-घ्नः) Bubo in the groin.
36541: वृध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be increased or augmented. E. वृध to grow, aff. क्यप्.
36542: वृन्त n. (-न्तं) 1 The footstalk of a leaf or fruit. 2 The nipple. 3 The stand of a water jar. E. वृञ् to choose, क्त aff., and नुम् augment.
36543: वृन्ताक mf. (-कः-की) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वृन्त footstalk, and अक to go, aff. अच्.
36544: वृन्तिता f. (-ता) A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) E. वृन्त a stalk, इतच् aff.
36545: वृन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) All, many. n. (-न्दं) A heap, a multitude, a quantity, an aggregation. f. (-न्दा) Holy basil, (Ocymum sanctum). E. वृण to please, aff. दन, form irr.
36546: वृन्दार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Beautiful, handsome, pleasing. 2 Eminent, reputable. E. वृन्द a quantity, and आरक aff. implying pre-eminence.
36547: वृन्दारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Handsome, agreeable, pleasing. 2 Best, excellent, chief. 3 Much, great. 4 Reputable, respectable, eminent. m. (-कः) 1 A deity, an immortal. 2 A chief, the head or leader of a crowd or herd, &c. E. वृन्द a heap, and आरकन् aff., implying pre-eminence.
36548: वृन्दिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very beautiful or charming, very excellent or elevated, very reputable or venerable. E. वृन्दारक chief, excellent, वृन्द substituted, and इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. super.; also with ईयसुन् the same, वृन्दीयस.
36549: वृन्दीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very eminent or excellent. E. see the last.
36550: वृश r. 4th cl. (वृश्यति) To choose, to prefer or select.
36551: वृश m. (-शः) 1 A rat. 2 A flower, (Justicia ganderussa.) f. (-शा) A drug. n. (-शं) Ginger. E. वृ to choose, शक् Uṇādi aff.; also वृष.
36552: वृश्चिक m. (-कः) 1 A scorpion. 2 The sign Scorpio. 3 A hairy caterpillar. 4 A crab. 5 A sort of beetle found in cow-dung. 6 A centipede. 7 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 8 The month when the sun is in Scorpio. f. (-का) A potherb, (Basella.) E. व्रश्च to cut, Uṇādi aff. किकन्, and the semivowel changed to the vowel.
36553: वृश्चिकप्रिया f. (-या) A potherb, (Basella rubra and lucida.) E. वृश्चिक a scorpion, and प्रिय fond of.
36554: वृश्चिकाली f. (-ली) 1 A line of scorpions. 2 A shrub, (Tragia involucrata.) E. वृश्चिक a scorpion, and आली a line.
36555: वृष (उ) वृषु r. 1st cl. (वर्षति) 1 To sprinkle. 2 To hurt or kill. 3 To weary. 4 To give. r. 10th cl. (वर्षयति-ते) 1 To conceive, to be impregnated. 2 To possess supreme or supernatural power. 3 To be powerful.
36556: वृष m. (-षः) 1 A bull. 2 The sign of the zodiac Taurus. 3 Virtue, moral merit. 4 Virtue personified, as a bull or the bull of ŚIVA. 5 A man of a lecherous disposition, one of the four descriptions into which men are divided in erotic works. 6 A rat. 7 A drug, commonly Ṛṣabha. 8 A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) 9 (In composition,) Excellent, pre-eminent. 10 A name of KARṆA. 11 VIṢṆU. 12 An enemy, an adversary. 13 Particular ground, judged proper for the foundation of a house. 14 Love or KĀMA. 15 A strong or athletic man. n. (-षं) A peacock's plumage or tail. f. (-षा) 1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) 2 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) f. (-षी) The seat of the religious student or one used by ascetics, formed of Kusa grass. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. क.
36558: वृषण m. (-णः) The testicles or scrotum. E. वृष to sprinkle, (seminal fluid,) aff. क्यु or युच्.
36559: वृषणकच्छू f. (-च्छूः) Ulceration of the scrotum. E. वृषण, and कच्छू a root.
36560: वृषणश्व m. (-श्वः) The horse of INDRA. E. वृषन् INDRA, and अश्व the horse.
36561: वृषण्वसु n. (-सुः) The treasure of INDRA. E. वृषन् INDRA, and वसु wealth.
36562: वृषदंशक m. (-कः) A cat. E. वृष a rat, and दंशक devourer.
36563: वृषध्वज m. (-जः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 GAṆEŚA. 3 A virtuous man. E. वृष a bull, a rat, or virtue, and ध्वज emblem.
36564: वृषन् m. (-षा) 1 INDRA, as god of the firmament. 2 KARṆA, the hero. 3 Pain, sorrow. 4 Insensibility from extreme pain. 5 A bull. 6 A horse. E. वृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्.
36565: वृषनाशन m. (-नः) A medicinal plant, commonly Vireng, (Embelia ribes). E. वृष a bull, and नाशन destroying.
36566: वृषपति m. (-तिः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A bull set at liberty. E. वृष a bull, and पति lord.
36567: वृषपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. वृष a rat, and पर्ण a leaf; fem. aff. ङीष्.
36568: वृषपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A demon. 3 A wasp. 4 A sort of grass, (Scirpus kysoor.) E. वृष a bull, &c., पर्वन् a joint.
36569: वृषभ m. (-भः) 1 A bull. 2 (In composition,) Pre-eminent, excellent. 3 The orifice of the ear. 4 An elephant's ear. 5 A drug; also Ṛṣabha, described as a root resembling the horn of a bull, brought from the Himālaya mountains, of cooling and tonic properties, and serviceable in catarrh and consumption. 6 The first of the Jaina pontiffs of the present era. f. (-भी) 1 A widow. 2 Cowach. E. वृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. अभच्.
36570: वृषभगति m. (-तिः) ŚIVA. E. वृषभ a bull, and गति going.
36571: वृषभध्वज m. (-जः) ŚIVA. E. वृषभ a bull, and ध्वज emblem.
36572: वृषभासा f. (-सा) The capital of INDRA, and the immortals. E. वृष the bull of ŚIVA, भास् splendour, and टाप् added.
36573: वृषय m. (-यः) An asylum, a place of refuge or shelter. E. वृ to screen, Uṇādi aff. कयन्, and षुक् augment.
36574: वृषल m. (-लः) 1 A horse. 2 A Śūdra, or man of the servile tribe. 3 The sovereign CANDRAGUPTA. 4 Garlick. 5 A sinner, a reprobate, a wicked or unrighteous man. f. (-ली) 1 A girl twelve years old, in whom menstruation has commenced, and who is unmarried. 2 A barren woman. 3 A woman during menstruation. 4 The mother of a still-born child. 5 A woman of a low caste. E. वृष a bull, or virtue, &c., and ल to take, aff. क, or वृष to sprinkle, कल Uṇādi aff.
36575: वृषलत्व n. (-त्वं) The condition or state of a Śūdra. E. त्व added to वृषल.
36576: वृषलात्मज m. (-जः) The son of a reprobate. E. वृषल a wicked man, and आत्मज son.
36577: वृषलीसेवन n. (-नं) Intercourse with a Śūdra female. E. वृषली, and सेवन frequenting.
36578: वृषलोचन m. (-नः) A rat. E. वृष a bull, and लोचन the eye.
36579: वृषवाहन m. (-नः) ŚIVA. E. वृष a bull, and वाहन vehicle.
36580: वृषशचु m. (-त्रुः) VIṢṆU. E. वृष KARṆA, and शत्रु the enemy.
36582: वृषस्यन्ती f. (-न्ती) 1 A lascivious woman. 2 A cow in heat. E. वृष a man of a particular class, or a bull, forming with the increments सुक्, and क्यच a nominal verb, implying desire of such a man, &c. participial aff. of the present tense शतृ, fem. aff. ङीष्.
36583: वृषाकपायी f. (-यी) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 2 GAURĪ. 3 SVĀHĀ, the wife of AGNI. 4 ŚACI, the wife of INDRA. 5 A shrub, (Asparagus racemosus.) 6 A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. वृषाकपि VIṢṆU, &c., ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.
36584: वृषाकपि m. (-पिः) 1 KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. 2 ŚIVA. 3 AGNI, or fire. E. वृष virtue, अ not, कपि to shake or agitate, इ aff., and the radical augment rejected; or वृषा INDRA, अकपि untrembling, as before; or वृष virtue, or वृषा INDRA, and कपि an ape, being the ape as it were of the greater gods: other etymologies occur.
36585: वृषाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A pious man. 3 Marking-nut plant. 4 An eunuch, one employed in the Zenana. E. वृष the bull of the deity, or virtue, and अङ्क mark.
36586: वृषाङ्कज m. (-जः) A very small drum, held in one hand, and played by means of a string attached to it. E. वृषाङ्क ŚIVA, and ज born, made.
36587: वृषाञ्चन m. (-नः) ŚIVA. E. वृष a bull, and अञ्चन going.
36588: वृषाणक m. (-कः) A form of ŚIVA. E. वृष a bull, अन to be, and कन् aff.
36589: वृषान्तक m. (-कः) VIṢṆU. E. वृष virtue, अन्त end, and कन् aff.
36591: वृषाहार m. (-रः) A cat. E. वृष a rat, and आहार food.
36592: वृषिन् m. (-षी) A peacock. E. वृष his plumage, and इनि aff.
36593: वृषी f. (-षी) The seat or cushion of an ascetic; also वृसी.
36594: वृषोत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) Setting a bull at liberty on occasion of a sacrifice or obsequial oblation. E. वृष, and उत्सर्ग letting loose.
36595: वृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Rain. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. क्तिन्.
36596: वृष्टिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Raining, sprinkling. E. वृष्टि, and कर what makes.
36597: वृष्टिकाल m. (-लः) The rainy season. E. वृष्टि, and काल time.
36598: वृष्टिघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) Guzeratty cardamoms. E. वृष्टि rain, and घ्न destructive, fem. form.
36599: वृष्टिजीवन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Nourished or watered by rain. E. वृष्टि rain, जीवन living.
36600: वृष्टिभू m. (-भूः) A frog. E. वृष्टि rain, and भू being, or being born.
36601: वृष्टिमत् mfn. (-मात्-मती-मत्) Rainy, full of rain. m. (-मान्) A cloud. E. वृष्टि, and मतुप् aff.
36602: वृष्णि mfn. (-ष्णिः-ष्णिः-ष्णि) 1 Heretical, heterodox. 2 Angry, passionate. m. (-ष्णिः) 1 A ram. 2 One of the descendants of YADU. 3 VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 4 A heretic, a sectary. 5 A ray of light. 6 INDRA. 7 AGNI. 8 Air or wind. E. वृष to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. नि, and the vowel unchanged.
36603: वृष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) 1 Errhine, aphrodisiac, provocative, (food or medicine.) 2 To be sprinkled or aspersed. m. (-ष्यः) Kidneybean, (Phaseolus radiatus). f. (-ष्या) A drug, commonly Ridādhi. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. क्यप्.
36605: वृह r. 1st cl. (वर्हति) also (इ) वृहि (वृंहति) 1 To grow or increase. 2 (In the second form only,) To roar, as a wild beast. r. 1st and 10th cls. (वृहति वृहयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. (ऊ) वृहू r. 6th cl. (वृहति) To make any effort or exertion.
36607: वृहच्छरीर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Large bodied, gigantic. E. वृहत्, and शरीर body.
36608: वृहच्छल्क m. (-ल्कः) A prawn. E. वृहत् great, and शल्क scale.
36609: वृहज्जन m. (-नः) A great or illustrious man. E. वृहत्, and जन a person.
36610: वृहढक्का f. (-क्का) A large drum. E. वृहत् large, ढक्का a drum.
36611: वृहत् mfn. (-हन्-हती-हत) 1 Great, large. 2 Great, much. f. (-हती) 1 A small kind of egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) 2 A kind of prickly nightshade, (Solanum hirsutum.) 3 A large lute. 4 A form of metre, the stanza of which consists of thirtysix syllables. 5 A mantle, a wrapper. 6 A reservoir, a place containing water. 7 Speech. E. वृह to grow or increase, Uṇādi aff. अति, with the effect of the participial aff. शतृ.
36612: वृहतिका f. (-का) 1 An upper garment, a mantle, a wrapper. 2 A small sort of egg-plant. E. वृहती as above, कन् added, fem. form.
36613: वृहतिपति m. (-तिः) VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods. E. वृहति speech, eloquence, and पति lord.
36614: वृहत्क mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं) Large, great. E. वृहत् the same, and कन् added.
36615: वृहत्कन्द m. (-न्दः) A bulbous root, considered in some places as a large kind of onion, in others as a sort of garlick. E. वृहत्, large, and कन्द a root.
36616: वृहत्काय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Large bodied, bulky, gigantic. E. वृहत्, and काय body.
36617: वृहत्कालशाक m. (-कः) A shrub, (Cassia purpurea, or a large variety of it.) E. वृहत् large, and कालशाक the same.
36618: वृहत्काश n. (-शं) A large kind of the grass Kāś, (Saccharum spontaneum). E. वृहत् large, काश the same grass.
36619: वृहत्कुक्षि mfn. (-क्षिः-क्षिः or क्षी-क्षि) Corpulent, large or pot-bellied. E. वृहत् large, कुक्षि the belly.
36620: वृहत्तृण m. (-णः) The bambu. E. वृहत् large, and तृण grass.
36621: वृहत्त्वच् m. (-त्त्वक्) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) E. वृहत् large, and त्वच् skin or bark.
36622: वृहत्पाटलि f. (-लिः) Thorn-apple, (Datura metel.) E. वृहत् large, पाटलि the Bignonia.
36623: वृहत्पाद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Large footed. m. (-दः) The Indian fig tree. E. वृहत् large, and पाद foot or root.
36624: वृहत्पुष्प mfn. (-ष्पः-ष्पा-ष्पं) Having large flowers. f. (-ष्पी) Crotolaria of various species. E. वृहत् large, and पुष्प a flower.
36625: वृहदङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Large bodied, bulky. 2 Large limbed. 3 Having many parts. m. (-ङ्गः) A large elephant, such a one as is usually the leader of a wild herd. E. वृहत् large, and अङ्ग body.
36626: वृहदम्ल m. (-म्लः) A fruit tree, (Averrhoa carambola.) E. वृहत् large or much, and अम्ल sour.
36627: वृहदसृङ्मति m. (-तिः) An evil spirit, a goblin. E. वृहत् large, असृक् blood, and मति inclination.
36628: वृहद्गृह m. (-हः) A country, described as lying behind the Vindhya mountains, near the province of Malva, and perhaps comprising Bundelkhand, or the adjoining district. E. वृहत् large, and गृह a house; also read वृहद्गुह from गुह a cave, the country being mountainous, and the people probably having been Troglodytes or dwellers in caves.
36629: वृहद्गोल n. (-लं) A water-melon. E. वृहत् large, and गोल round, or a ball.
36630: वृहद्द्युति f. (-तिः) Radiance, splendor, a great light. E. वृहत्, and द्युति light.
36631: वृहद्धल n. (-लं) The furrow made by a plough. E. वृहत् large, हल a plough.
36632: वृहद्भद्दारिका f. (-का) A name of UMĀ or DURGĀ. E. वृहत् great, and भद्दारिका princess.
36633: वृहद्भानु m. (-नुः) AGNI or fire. E. वृहत् large, many, and भानु a ray of light.
36634: वृहद्रथ m. (-थः) 1 INDRA. 2 A sacrificial vessel. 3 A particular Mantra. 4 A division of the Sāma Veda. f. (-थी) The name of a river. E. वृहत् large, and रथ a car.
36635: वृहद्रावी f. (-वी) A small owl. E. वृहत् great, much, राव cry, ङीष् aff.
36636: वृहद्वात m. (-तः) A grain, generally eaten by the natives of India, (Andropogon sorghum.) E. वृहत् much, and वात wind, supposed to generate this humour.
36637: वृहद्वीज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having much or large seed. m. (-जः) The hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.) E. वृहत् large, and वीज seed.
36638: वृहन्नल m. (-लः) 1 A large sort of reed, (Arundo gigantea.) 2 ARJUNA. 3 The arm. E. वृहत् large, and नल a reed.
36639: वृहन्निवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Large, bulky, protuberant. E. वृहत्, and निषेश place.
36640: वृहस्पति m. (-तिः) The regent of the planet JUPITER, identified astronomically with the planet; in Mythology, he is the son of AṄGIRAS, and preceptor of the gods. 2 The name of a saint and law-giver. E. वृहत् great, illustrious, (as the deities,) and पति master or Guru, सुट् augment, and the final of the first member rejected; it also occasionally occurs वृहतांपति.
36641: वृहस्पतिचक्र n. (-क्रं) The cycle of 60 years. E. वृहस्पति, and चक्र a cycle.
36642: वॄ r. 9th cl. (वृणाति) 1 To choose. 2 To support or nourish, (in this sense it is more usually written with the labial initial.) (ञ) वृञ r. 9th cl. (वृणाति वृणीते) 1 To choose, to elect or select. 2 To cover, to screen.
36643: वे r. 1st cl. (वयति वयते) To weave.
36644: वेकट m. (-टः) 1 A youth, an adolescent. 2 A sort of fish, (perhaps the common Bekti.) 3 A jeweller. 4 An actor.
36645: वेग m. (-गः) 1 Speed, dispatch, velocity. 2 Impetus, momentum. 3 Stream, current. 4 Sudden impulse, transition of mind. as from passion to apathy, &c. 5 Determination, promptitude, energy, that effect of mind which is considered as the source of action. 6 Pleasure, delight. 7 Love, the sentiment or passion. 8 External indication of any internal effect, proceeding from passion, medicine, poison, &c., as convulsion, horripilation, sweat, &c. 9 Expulsion or evacuation of the  natural excretions. 10 Semen virile. 11 The flight of an arrow. 12 The fruit of a kind of mango. E. वीज to go, aff. घञ्.
36646: वेगतस् ind. Quickly, speedily. E. वेग, and तसि aff.
36647: वेगनाशन m. (-नः) Phlegm, the phlegmatic humor. E. वेग activity or speed, and नाशन injuring, inducing corpulency.
36648: वेगरोध m. (-धः) 1 Check, remora. 2 Obstruction of the natural excretions. E. वेग, and रोध hindrance.
36649: वेगवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Quick, expeditious. 2 Agitated. E. वेग, and मतुप् aff.
36650: वेगवत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very quick. f. (-री) A species of metre, having nine syllables for the first and third pādas, and eleven for the second and fourth. E. वेगवत्, and तरप् aff.
36651: वेगवत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Very quick or swift. E. वेगवत्, and तमप् aff.
36652: वेगविधारण n. (-णं) 1 Stopping, retarding. 2 Constipation, &c. E. वेग, and विघारण withholding.
36653: वेगसर m. (-रः) A mule. E. वेग speed, सर who goes.
36654: वेगाघात m. (-तः) 1 Stop, check. 2 Obstruction of the natural excretions. E. वेग, and आघात resistance.
36655: वेगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Quickened, expedited. E. वीज to go, causal v., क्त aff.
36656: वेगिता f. (-ता) Speed, quickness. E. तल् added to the next; also वगित्वं.
36657: वेगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Swift, fleet, rapid. m. (-गी) 1 A courier, an express. 2 A hawk. E. वेग speed, इनि aff.
36658: वेचा f. (-चा) Hire, wages. E. विच to distinguish, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
36659: वेजानी f. (-नी) A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
36660: वेटा f. (-टा) The abode of the Vaiśya tribe.
36661: वेडा f. (-डा) A boat. E. विड to curse, aff. अच्, and टाप् added.
36662: वेण (ऋ) वेणृ r. 1st cl. (वेणति-ते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To know. 3 To reflect or remember. 4 To discern. 5 To hold or take a musical instrument. 6 To play on an instrument. 7 To take. The root is also read वेनृ.
36663: वेण m. (-णः) A musician, one by birth, the son of a woman of the Ambaṣṭha, and man of the Vaideha caste. E. वेण to play on a musical instrument, aff. अच्.
36664: वेणि f. (-णिः-णी) Unornamented and braided hair; the hair as worn especially by widows and women whose husbands are absent, when it is simply collected from the forehead and temples as well as the back of the head, and twisted together into a single braid, which is then suffered to fall like a tail down the back, no sort of ornament being worn on the head; the term is also applied generally to any braid of hair, or to a braid of the long hair, of which many are made, and the whole are then twisted together, and worn as a sort of rose or flower at the back of the head. f. (-णिः) 1 Assemblage of water, as the conflux of rivers, &c. in that case it rather implies their parallel course, ending in a common point of union; as at Allahabad, where the GAṄGĀ, YAMUNĀ, and as is supposed, the SARASVATI, all coming from the north, unite; this and other similar places, thence receive the name of Triveṇi. 2 Weaving. (-णी) 1 Stream, current. 2 A ewe. 3 A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratum.) E. वी to go, Uṇādi aff. नि, and in some cases ङीप् added.
36665: वेणिका f. (-का) Braided hair. E. वेणी as above, कन् fem. form, added.
36668: वेणु m. (-णुः) 1 A bambu. 2 A flute, a pipe. 3 A king so named. E. वी substituted for अज to go, aff. नु, or वन to sound, कु aff. form irr.
36669: वेणुक n. (-कं) A pike used for driving an elephant. E. वेणु a bambu, and कन् aff.; having a bambu shaft or handle.
36670: वेणुकर्क्कर m. (-रः) A thorny plant, commonly Karir or Karil. E. वेणु a bambu, and कर्क्कर hard.
36671: वेणुध्म m. (-ध्मः) A player on a fife or flute. E. वेणु a bambu, ध्मा to blow, aff. क.
36672: वेणुनिस्रुति m. (-तिः) The sugar-cane. E. वेणु a bambu, and निस्रुति oozing.
36673: वेणुपत्री f. (-त्री) A plant, one synonym of which, Hingupatri, appears to relate to the Asafœtida or some similar plant, whilst the corresponding compound Banspatra both in Hindi and Bengali, is applied to a species of Amaranthus, (A. lanceifolius, Rox., or A. atro-purpureus, Rox.) E. वेणु a bambu, and पत्र a leaf, fem. aff. ङीष्, having long slender leaves, like those of the bambu.
36674: वेणुवाद m. (-दः) A player on a flute. E. वेणु a flute or pipe, वाद who sounds.
36675: वेतन n. (-नं) 1 Hire, wages. 2 Livelihood, subsistence. 3 Silver. E. वी to go, तनन् Uṇādi aff.
36676: वेतनदान n. (-नं) Hiring, paying wages. E. वेतन, and दान giving.
36677: वेतनादान n. (-नं) Non-payment of wages. E. वेतन, and अदान not giving.
36678: वेतस mf. (-सः-सी) The ratan, (Calamus rotang.) E. वेञ् to sew or weave, Uṇādi aff. असच्, and तुक् augment.
36679: वेतसपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The leaf of the ratan. 2 A lancet. E. वेतस, and पत्र a leaf.
36680: वेतस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) Reedy, abounding in reeds or canes, (a place or soil, &c.) E. वेतस् a cane, मतुप् aff.
36681: वेताल m. (-लः) 1 A sprite, a goblin, especially one haunting cemeteries and animating dead bodies. 2 A door-keeper. E. व in the seventh case वे in air, and ताल habitation, fixation, from तल् to fix, aff. घञ्.
36682: वेत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्री-त्तृ) 1 Knowing, understanding, acquainted with. 2 Who obtains or acquires. m. (-त्ता) 1 A sage, one who knows the nature of the soul and GOD. 2 A husband, an espouser. E. विद् to know, तृच् aff.
36683: वेत्र m. (-त्रः) A reed, a cane, the Ratan. n. (-त्रं) A stick, a staff. E. वि to go, Uṇādi aff. त्र.
36684: वेत्रकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) A bounding with reeds or canes. E. वेत्र a cane, छ aff., and कुक् augment.
36685: वेत्रधर m. (-रः) 1 A door-keeper, a warder. 2 A staff-bearer, a mace-bearer. E. वेत्र a staff, and धर having.
36686: वेत्रधारक m. (-कः) 1 A door-keeper, a warder, a porter. 2 A macebearer. E. वेत्र a stick, and धारक having.
