E. वि and आप to pervade, aff. क्तिन्.
37248: व्याप्तिज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge of the existence of a substance from observation of the presence of its inherent properties. E. व्याप्ति, and ज्ञान knowledge.
37249: व्याप्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Diffusive, pervading. E. व्याप्ति, and मतुप् aff.
37250: व्याप्तिलक्षण n. (-णं) Sign or proof of the existence or non-existence of an inherent property or attribute. E. व्याप्ति, and लक्षण indication.
37251: व्याप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 Permeable, penetrable. 2 Capable of containing any inherent property. n. (-प्यं) 1 An instrument or agent. 2 The thing or substance which may be the site or subject of attributes or inherent properties. 3 The subject of an inference, as fire inferred from the presence of smoke, &c. 4 A drug, (Costus speciosus.) E. वि before आप to pervade, aff. यत्.
37252: व्याप्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Capacity of being penetrated or essentially affected by. E. व्याप्य, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, व्याप्यता.
37253: व्याप्यत्वासिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) (In logic,) Imperfect conclusion, one not comprehending all the points of the argument. E. व्याप्यत्व, and असिद्धि nonconclusion.
37254: व्याभ्युक्षी f. (-क्षी) Gamboling in water, bathing for pleasure. E. वि, आङ् and अभि before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. अच् and ङीष्.
37255: व्याम m. (-मः) 1 A fathom, or the space between the tips of the fingers of either hand when the arms are extended. 2 Disregard, disrespect (?) 3 Smoke. E. वि before अम to go, with आङ् pref. and aff. अच्.
37256: व्यामन n. (-नं) Disregard, disrespect. E. वि before अम to go, with आङ् prefixed, and ल्युट् aff. or वि privative, म्ना to mind, आङ् pref. and अच् aff.
37257: व्यामर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Rubbing out, erasure. 2 Impatience. E. वि and आङ् before मृष to rub, &c., घञ् aff.
37258: व्यामिल्य ind. Having closed and opened, having twinkled, &c. E. वि and आङ् before मिल to twinkle, ल्यप् aff.
37259: व्यामिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Mixed, blended, mingled. E. वि and आङ् before मिश्र mixed.
37260: व्यामृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Rubbed, rubbed out, effaced. E. वि and आङ् before मृष to rub, aff. क्त.
37261: व्यायछमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Quarrelling. E. वि and आङ् before इण् to go, शानच् aff.
37262: व्यायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Busy, occupied. 2 Long. 3 Hard, firm. 4 Much, excessive. E. वि and आङ् before यम to stop, aff. क्त.
37263: व्यायाम m. (-मः) 1 Fatigue, labour. 2 A fathom, measured by the distance to which both arms extended reach. 3 Gymnastics,  athletic exercise, as playing with heavy clubs, wielding a bow with a chain in place of a string, alternate rising and falling at full length on the ground, &c. 4 Manhood, manliness. 5 A difficulty. 6 A difficult or impassable defile, &c. 7 Business, occupation. E. वि and आङ् before यम to refrain, aff. घञ्.
37264: व्यायामशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Active, robust, athletic, taking exercise. E. व्यायाम, and शील practising.
37265: व्यायामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Taking exercise, undergoing fatigue, active, athletic. E. व्यायाम, and इनि aff.
37266: व्यायाम्य ind. Having exercised, practised as gymnastics, &c. disciplined as troops. E. वि and आङ् before यम to restrain, ण्यत् aff.
37267: व्यायोग m. (-गः) A kind of dramatic exhibition or composition in one act, the subject of which is some contest or war of a heroic kind, and of which woman is not the cause. E. वि and आङ् before युज to unite, aff. घञ्; in which the valiant are associated.
37268: व्याल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Wicked, villainous, bad. 2 Cruel, fierce. m. (-लः) 1 A snake. 2 A beast of prey. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 A vicious elephant. 5 A king. 6 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. वि and आङ् before अल to adorn, or अड to make effort, aff. अच्; also व्याड.
37269: व्यालक m. (-कः) A vicious elephant. E. कन् added to the last.
37270: व्यालग्राह m. (-हः) A snake-catcher. E. व्याल a snake, and ग्रह to seize, aff. अण्.
37271: व्यालग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A snake-catcher, one who lives by catching and exhibiting snakes. E. व्याल a snake, and ग्राहिन् who takes.
37272: व्यालतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Very injurious, cruel or fierce. E. व्याल and तमप् aff.
37273: व्यालमृग m. (-गः) A fierce or wild stag. E. व्याल, and मृग a deer.
37274: व्यालायुध n. (-धं) A sort of perfume; see नखी. E. व्याल a beast of prey (a tiger), and आयुध a weapon; compared to the claw of the animal.
37275: व्यालिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्) 1 Drawing lines, delineating, scratching, piercing. 2 Extending to, in contact with. E. वि and आङ् before लिख to write, शतृ aff.
37276: व्यालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thick, clustering. E. वि and आङ् before ली to waste, क्त aff.
37277: व्यालोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tremulous, shaking, waving. E. वि and आङ् before लोल to shake, अच् aff.
37278: व्यावकलन n. (-नं) Subtraction, (in arithmetic.) E. वि with आङ् and अव before कल to count, aff. ल्युट्.
37279: व्यावकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subtracted. E. वि with आङ् and अव before कल to count, aff. क्त.
37280: व्यावक्रोशी f. (-शी) Mutual imprecation. E. वि with आङ् and अव before क्रुश to cry out, aff. णच् and ङीप्.
37281: व्यावभाषी f. (-षी) Mutual abuse or imprecation. E. वि implying reciprocity, and अव depreciation, भाष to speak, affs. णच् and ङीप्.
37282: व्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Going round, revolving. 2 Encompassing. 3 Choosing, appointing. 4 Ruptured navel, (umbilical hernia.) E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, घञ् aff.
37283: व्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Rolling round, revolving. 2 A volute, a fold, a band. 3 Encompassing, surrounding. E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
37284: व्यावहारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Usual, customary. 2 Juridical, judicial, legal, relative or referring to judicial procedure. m. (-कः) A counsellor, a minister. E. व्यवहार litigation, ठञ् aff.
37285: व्यावहासी f. (-सी) Mutual or reciprocal laughter. E. वि and आङ् before हस to laugh, णच् and ङीप् aff.
37286: व्याविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of various kinds or sorts. E. वि and आङ् before विघ sort.
37287: व्यावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered, screened. 2 Removed, excepted. E. वि and आङ् before वृ to choose, क्त aff.
37288: व्यावृति f. (-तिः) 1 Exception, exclusion. 2 Covering, screening. E. वि and आङ् before वृ to choose, क्तिन् aff.
37289: व्यावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Chosen, appointed. 2 Encompassed, surrounded. 3 Fenced, screened. 4 Removed, uncovered. 5 Excepted, excluded. 6 Praised, hymned. 7 Rolled backwards. E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, &c., aff. क्त.
37290: व्यावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Praise, eulogium. 2 Rejection, exception, exclusion. 3 Choice, selection. 4 Screening, surrounding. 5 Rolling back. E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्.
37291: व्यास m. (-सः) 1 A celebrated saint and author, the supposed original compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas; also the founder of the Vedānta philosophy. 2 Diffusion, extension. 3 Detail, distinction, severalty. 4 A measure. n. (-सं) The diameter of a circle. E. वि and आङ् before अस to pervade, aff. घञ्.
37292: व्यासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Bewildered, confused. 2 Connected with, attached or devoted to. 3 Detached, separated. E. वि before आसक्त attentive.
37293: व्यासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Confusion, perplexity. 2 Separation, detachment. 3 Attachment, addition. E. वि and आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, घञ् aff.
37294: व्यासिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Prohibited, forbidden. 2 Contraband, not allowed to be sold but to particular persons or in certain places. E. वि privative, and आसिद्ध perfected, accomplished.
37295: व्याहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Confused, alarmed. 2 Repelled, repulsed. 3 Driven out, expelled. 4 Disappointed. E. वि and आङ् before हन to strike, &c., aff. क्त.
37296: व्याहार m. (-रः) 1 Voice, speech. 2 A word, an articulate sound. 3 Jest, joke, humorous speech. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
37297: व्याहरण n. (-णं) Uttering, pronouncing. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
37298: व्याहरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Speaking, uttering, pronouncing. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, शतृ aff.
37299: व्याहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered, pronounced, said. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
37300: व्याहृति f. (-तिः) 1 Voice, speech. 2 A word, an articulate sound. 3 A mystical word or sound, as Om, Svar, Bhūr, Bhuvas, &c., which are the Mahā Vyāhṛtis, and commence the daily prayers of the Brahman. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, aff. क्तिन्.
37301: व्याहृत्य ind. Having said or uttered. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
37302: व्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sewn, woven. E. वि before उत woven; also व्यूत.
37303: व्युति f. (-तिः) Sewing, weaving. E. वि before ऊय to weave, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.; also व्यूति.
37304: व्युत्क्रम m. (-मः) Inverted order, irregular arrangement. E. वि and उत् before क्रम order.
37305: व्युत्थान n. (-नं) 1 Independence, following one's own inclination. 2 Opposition, contradiction, doing that which is prohibited. 3 Obstruction, prohibition, hindering or opposing any one. 4 Completion of religious contemplation, the end. of a period of abstraction. E. वि and उत् before स्था to stay or be, aff. ल्युट्.
37306: व्युत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Science, learning, conversancy with or proficience in literature or science. 2 Formation of words, derivation, etymology. E. वि and उत् before पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.
37307: व्युत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Learned, studied, conversant or proficient in literature. 2 Completed, finished. 3 Derived, formed as a derivative word. 4 Generated, begotten. E. वि and उत् before पद to go, aff. क्त.
37308: व्युदस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Put off, thrown aside, (especially as feeling or affection.) E. वि and उट् before अस to throw, क्त aff.
37309: व्युदस्य ind. Having thrown off or put away, (as desire, feeling, &c.) E. वि and उद before अस to throw, ल्यप् aff.
37310: व्युदास m. (-सः) 1 Indifference to, disregard for. 2 Making ill or unprofitable use of any thing, throwing away. E. वि and उद before अस to throw, घञ् aff.
37311: व्युपदेश m. (-शः) Pretext, deception, plausible but false council. E. वि priv., उपदेश advice.
37312: व्युष r. 10th cl. (व्युषयति) To abandon, to reject.
37313: व्युष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Burned. 2 Dawned, become daylight or dawn. n. (-ष्टं) 1 Dawn, break of day. 2 Day. 3 Fruit, consequence. E. वि before वस to abide, aff. क्त, and व changed to उ, or व्युष to burn, when it is more properly read व्युष्ट.
37314: व्युष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Fruit, consequence. 2 Increase, prosperity. 3 Praise. E. वि and वस to abide, aff. क्तिन्, and व changed to उ.
37315: व्युस(इर)व्युसिर r. 4th cl. (व्युस्यति) To leave, to abandon.
37316: व्यूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Arranged, arrayed, placed in order or array. 2 Compact, firm, well-knit. 3 Large, great. E. वि before वह to bear, &c., aff. क्त.
37317: व्यूढकङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Armed, mailed. E. व्यूढ arranged, and कङ्कट mail.
37318: व्यूढोरस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Broad-chested. E. व्यूढ, उरस् the breast, कन् added.
37319: व्यूढि f. (-ढिः) Array, orderly arrangement or disposition. E. वि before वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क्तिन्.
37320: व्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Woven. E. वि before ऊत the same.
37321: व्यूति f. (-तिः) 1 Weaving. E. वि before वेञ् to weave, aff. क्तिन् and व changed to ऊ.
37322: व्यूह m. (-हः) 1 Military array, the arrangement of troops in various positions; as दण्डव्यूहः the array in line, भोगव्यूहः in column, मण्डलव्यूहः in circle, असंहतव्यूहः in mixed order; also various fanciful forms, as the शकटः or car-shape, मकरः or marine monster-like, पताका flag-shape, &c. 2 A flock, a multitude. 3 Logic, reasoning. 4 Making, manufacture. 5 The body. E. वि before ऊह to reason, aff. घञ्.
37323: व्यूहन n. (-नं) 1 Arraying, array, arrangement. 2 Structure of the body, disposition of the members. E. वि before ऊह to reason, ल्युट् aff.
37324: व्यूहपार्ष्णि m. (-र्ष्णिः) The rear of an army. E. व्यूह array, and पार्ष्णि the heel or back.
37325: व्यूहभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Throwing into disorder, breaking an array. E. व्यूह, and भङ्ग breaking.
37326: व्यूहभेद m. (-दः) Piercing or breaking an array. E. व्यूह, and भेद breaking.
37328: व्योकार m. (-रः) A blacksmith. E. व्यो an imitative sound, and कार who makes.
37329: व्योमकेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. वोम heaven, and केश hair; also with इनि poss. aff. added व्योमकेशिन् (-शी).
37330: व्योमचारिन् m. (-री) 1 A god. 2 A bird. A saint. 3 A Brahman. E. व्योम heaven, and चारिन् who goes.
37331: व्योमचारिपुर n. (-रं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended midway between heaven and earth. E. व्योम heaven, चारि going, पुर a city.
37332: व्योमधूम m. (-मः) A cloud. E. व्योम heaven, and घूम smoke.
37333: व्योमन् n. (-म) 1 Sky, heaven, atmosphere. 2 Water. 3 A temple, sacred to the sun, or place where he is especially worshipped. E. व्येञ् to cover, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्, form irr.
37334: व्योमनासिका f. (-का) A sort of quail. E. व्योम heaven, and नासिका the nose.
37335: व्योममञ्जर n. (-रं) A flag, a banner. E. व्योम the sky, and मञ्जर a stalk.
37336: व्योममण्डल n. (-लं) A flag, a banner. E. व्योम sky, and मण्डल place.
37337: व्योममुद्गर m. (-रः) A gust of wind. E. व्योम the sky, and मुद्गर a club.
37338: व्योममाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measuring the sky, high as the heavens. E. व्योम, and माय what measures.
37339: व्योमयान n. (-नं) A carriage of the gods. E. व्योम the sky, and यान a vehicle.
37340: व्योमविस्तृत n. (-तं) The expanse or firmament. E. व्योम, and विल्तृत spread.
37341: व्योमसद् m. (-सद्) A spirit of heaven, a divinity. E. व्योम, and सद् who goes.
37342: व्योमस्थली f. (-ली) The earth. E. व्योम the sky, and स्थली base or site.
37343: व्योमस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Sky-touching, lofty. E. व्योम, and स्पृश् what touches.
37344: व्योमाभ m. (-भः) A Jaina deified saint. E. व्योम sky, and आभ shining.
37345: व्योष n. (-षं) The aggregate of three spices, or black-pepper, longpepper, and dry ginger. E. वि variously, उष to burn, aff. अच्.
37346: व्रज r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रजति व्राजयति) To go, to travel. With परि prefixed, To wander about, as a mendicant. r. 10th cl. To prepare, to perfect.
37347: व्रज m. (-जः) 1 A cow-pen, a station of cowherds. 2 A road. 3 A flock, a herd, a multitude. 4 The district about Agra and  Mathurā, the scene of KṚṢṆA'S juvenile adventures. n. (-जं) Wandering, roaming. E. व्रज to go, aff. घ.
37348: व्रजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Going, roaming. E. व्रज to go, शतृ aff.
37349: व्रजन n. (-नं) Going, roaming. E. व्रज to go, ल्युट् aff.
37350: व्रजभू m. (-भूः) A tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.) E. व्रज a cow-pen, and भू being.
37351: व्रजाजिर n. (-रं) A cow-yard, a cattle fold or pen. E. व्रज, and अजिर a yard.
37352: व्रजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, going. n. (-तं) Roaming. E. व्रज to go, क्त aff.
37353: व्रज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 Wandering about, either as an act of religious austerity or in quest of alms. 2 March of an assailant, attack, invasion. 3 March in general. 4 A class, a flock, a tribe. 5 A theatre. E. व्रज to go, क्यप् aff.
37354: व्रज्यावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Wandering, roaming. 2 Going gracefully. E. व्रज्या, and मतुप् aff.
37355: व्रण r. 1st cl. (व्रणति) To sound. r. 10th cl. (व्रणयति) To wound.
37356: व्रण mn. (-णः-णं) A tumor, a boil; an ulcer, a wound. E. व्रण to wound, an abscess, aff. अच्.
37357: व्रणकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Making a sore, wounding, ulcerating, corroding, &c. m. (-कृत्) Marking-nut plant, (Semecarpus anacardium.) E. व्रण a sore, and कृत् what makes.
37358: व्रणद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. वृण a sore, and द्विष् hostile to, healing.
37359: व्रणधूपन n. (-नं) Fumigating a sore. E. व्रण, and धूपन burning incense.
37360: व्रणवस्तु n. (-स्तुः) Part liable to ulcerate, as skin, flesh, &c. E. व्रण, and वस्तु substance.
37361: व्रणवेदना f. (-ना) Pain of a wound or sore. E. व्रण, and वेदना pain.
37362: व्रणशोधन n. (-नं) Cleaning or cicatrising a sore. E. व्रण, and शोधन cleaning.
37363: व्रणह m. (-हः) The castor oil tree. f. (-हा) A sort of creeper, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. व्रण a sore, and हन to destroy, aff. क.
37364: व्रणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Having a boil, a sore or wound. E. व्रण, and इनि aff.
37365: व्रत mn. (-तः-तं) 1 Any meritorious act of devotion, the voluntary or vowed observance, or imposition of any penance, austerity, or privation, as fasting, continence, exposure to heat and cold, &c. 2 Eating. E. वृ to choose, aff. अतच्, र substituted for the vowel, or व्रज to go, (to heaven by it,) घ aff. and the form irr.
37366: व्रतति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 Expansion, spreading. 2 A creeper. E. वृत to abide, अति aff., the vowel changed to its congener.
37367: व्रतभिक्षा f. (-क्षा) Soliciting alms, as one of the ceremonies accompanying investiture. E. व्रत the observance of investiture, and भिक्षा begging.
37368: व्रतलोपन n. (-नं) Violating a religious vow or obligation. E. व्रत, and लोपन cutting off.
37369: व्रतसंग्रह m. (-हः) Engaging in any act of devotion, taking on one's self some voluntary religious obligation. E. व्रत a vow, and संग्रह taking.
37370: व्रतस्नातक m. (-कः) The Brahman who has completed his term of studentship. E. व्रत, and स्नातक a householder.
37371: व्रताचरण n. (-णं) Observing a religious obligation, especially continence, as the duty of the student. E. व्रत, and आचरण going.
37372: व्रतादेश m. (-शः) Investiture of a youth of either of the first three classes with the characteristic cord. E. व्रत the observance, and आदेश pointing out.
37373: व्रतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Engaged in or observing a religious vow or obligation. m. (-ती) 1 An employer of priests. 2 An ascetic, a devotee, one engaged in the observance of a vow or penance. 3 The religious student. E. व्रत a vow, and इनि aff.
37374: व्रतोपवास m. (-सः) Fasting, a fast, (as a religious penance or obligation.) E. व्रत, and उपवास fasting.
37376: व्रश्च(ओ उ)ओव्रश्चु r. 6th cl. (वृश्चति) To cut.
37377: व्रश्चन m. (-नः) A small saw or chisel. n. (-नं) Cutting. E. व्रश्च to cut, aff. ल्युट्.
37378: व्राजि f. (-जिः) A gale of wind. E. व्रज to go, इञ् Uṇādi aff.
37379: व्रात m. (-तः) 1 A multitude, an assemblage. 2 The descendant of an outcaste Brahman, &c. 3 The company and attendants at a marriage feast. n. (-तं) 1 Manual or bodily labour. 2 Day labour, employment of a precarious kind. E. वृ to choose, aff. अतच्, and the vowel made long; or व्रत a religious observance, or व्रात्य an outcaste, aff. अण्.
37380: व्रातीन m. (-नः) 1 A cooly, a hired porter or labourer. 2 One who has no fixed or stated employment. E. व्रात bodily labour, and ख aff.
37381: व्रात्य m. (-त्यः) A Brahman, or man of the three first classes, in whose youth the customary observances have been omitted, and who has not received his investiture with the sacred thread. f. (-त्या) A female of a fallen Brahman, &c. E. व्रात, and य aff.
37382: व्रात्यता f. (ता) The condition of one who has lost caste by neglect of the initiatory observances. E. व्रात्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, व्रात्यत्वं.
37383: व्रात्यस्तोम m. (-मः) A particular sacrifice performed to recover the rights forfeited by an improper delay of the ceremony of investiture. E. व्रात्य one not invested, &c., and स्तोम a sacrifice.
37384: व्री r. 4th cl. (व्रीयते) r. 9th cl. (व्रीणाति or व्रीणीते) 1 To choose or elect. 2 To cover or screen.
37385: व्रीड r. 4th cl. (व्रीडयति) 1 To be modest, to be bashful or ashamed. 2 To throw, to direct or send.
37386: व्रीड mf. (-डः-डा) Shame, bashfulness. E. व्रीड to be ashamed, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
37387: व्रीडन n. (-नं) Bashfulness, modesty. E. व्रीड to be ashamed, and ल्युट् aff.
37388: व्रीडानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, hanging down the head with shame. E. व्रीडा, and आनत bowed.
37389: व्रीडान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest. E. व्रीडा, and अन्वित possessed of.
37390: व्रीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, modest. E. व्रीड to be ashamed, क्त aff.
37391: व्रीस r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रीसति व्रीसयति) To hurt or injure, to kill or wound.
37392: व्रीहि m. (-हिः) 1 Rice of various kinds: eight principal sorts are enumerated by native authorities, but the varieties are more numerous. 2 Rice ripening in the rainy season. E. व्री to choose. हि aff.
37393: व्रीहिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having rice, bearing rice, &c. E. व्रीहि rice, and ठन् aff.
37394: व्रीहिकाञ्चन m. (-नः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum lens or hirsutum, &c.)
37395: व्रीहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Having rice, (a field, &c.) E. व्रीहि rice, इनि aff.
37396: व्रीहिभेद m. (-दः) A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum.) E. व्रीहि rice, and भेद sort.
37397: व्रीहिमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of rice. m. (-यः) A rice cake offered with ghee as an oblation. E. व्रीहि rice, and मयट् aff.
37398: व्रीहिराजिक m. (-कः) 1 Panic seed, (Panicum italicum.) 2 Another species, (Panicum miliaceum.) E. व्रीहि rice, राजिक shining, excelling.
37399: व्रीह्यगार n. (-रं) A granary, a shed where rice or other grain is stored. E. व्रीहि rice, अगार a house.
37400: व्रुड r. 6th cl. (व्रुडति) 1 To cover. 2 To heap. 3 To sink.
37401: व्रूस r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रूसति व्रूसयति) To hurt or kill.
37402: व्रैह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Made of or with rice. E. व्रीहि rice, and अण् aff.
37403: व्रैहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for or sown with rice, (a field, &c.) E. व्रीहि rice, ढक् aff.
37404: व्ली r. 9th cl. (व्लीणाति or व्लीणीते) 1 To choose or select. 2 To cover, to screen. 3 To go, to move.
37405: व्लेक्ष r. 10th cl. (व्लेक्षयति) To see. श
37406: श The thirtieth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and first of the three sibilants; it is termed the palatal sibilant, and corresponds to Sh pronounced softly, as in Shun; in the Roman character it is distinguished by an accent, as S.
37407: श m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A weapon. n. adv. (शं) or ind. (शं or शम्) Happy, happily, auspiciously. E. शी to sleep or शो to pare, &c. aff. ड.
37408: शंयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Happy, prosperous, fortunate. m. (-युः) A sort of snake. E. शम् happily, and युस aff.
37409: शंय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Happy, fortunate. f. (-य्या) Knowledge, understanding. E. शम् happily, यस् aff.
37410: शंव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Fortunate, prosperous. m. (-वः) 1 The thunderbolt of INDRA. 2 The iron head of a pestle. E. शं good fortune, and व poss. aff.; also as differently derived, read शम्ब and सम्ब, &c.
37411: शंवर n. (-रं) Water. E. शं happily, वृ to choose or cover, aff. अरप्, more usually read शम्बर, q. v.
37412: शंस (उ,) शंसु r. 1st cl. (शंसति) 1 To praise. 2 To hurt. 3 To wish. 4 To calumniate. With अभि prefixed, To accuse wrongfully. With आङ् 1 To hope. 2 To speak. With प्र, To praise, to flatter; this root and its derivatives are sometimes read with the palatal sibilant final or शंश, &c.
37413: शंसा f. (-सा) 1 Speech. 2 Wish, desire. 3 Praise, flattery, eulogium. E. शंस to praise, &c. aff. अङ् and टाप्.
37414: शंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Certain, ascertained. 2 Calumniated, falsely accused. 3 Said, declared. 4 Praised, celebrated. 5 Wished, desired. E. शंस to wish, aff. क्त.
37415: शंस्तृ m. (-स्ता) An encomiast, a panegyrist, a flatterer. E. शंस to praise, तृन् Uṇādi aff.
37416: शंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Happy, prosperous, well-faring. E. शं happily, स्था to stay or be, aff. क.
37417: शंस्था mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Happy, prosperous. E. शम् happily, ष्ठा to stay or be, aff. क्विप्.
37418: शंस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 Desirable, to be wished. 2 Meritorious, to be praised. E. शंस to praise, &c. aff. क्यप्; also शस्य.
37419: शक r. 4th cl. (शक्यति-ते) r. 5th cl. (इर ऌ) इरशक्तृ (शक्नोति) 1 To bear patiently, to endure, to be patient. 2 To be able to effect, to be competent or powerful. (इ) शकि r. 1st cl. (शङ्कते) 1 To think probable, to suspect. 2 To fear, to apprehend. With आङ्, to dread.
37420: शक m. (-कः) 1 A sovereign, any prince who gives his name to an era, especially applied to Śālivāhana. 2 A particular caste, the followers or descendants of ŚAKA, or Sālivāhana. 3 A country, or m. plu. (-काः) The inhabitants, the Sacœ, the Scythians. 4 An era: see शाक. E. शक to be able, aff. अच्.
37421: शकट mfn. subst. (-टः-टी-टं) A cart. m. (-टः) 1 A Daitya slain by KṚṢṆA. 2 A cart load. E. शक to be able, अटन् Uṇādi aff.
37423: शकटहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA. E. शकट the demon so named, and हन destroyer; also similar compounds, as शकटारि, &c.
37424: शकटाल m. (-लः) The minister of NANDA: also read ŚAKATĀRA.
37425: शकटाह्वा f. (-ह्वा) The fourth lunar asterism, Rohiṇī, the stars of which are represented as a cart. E. शकट a cart, आह्व appellation.
37426: शकटिका f. (-का) A small cart, a toy-cart. E. कन् added to शकटी.
37427: शकल mn. (-लः-लं) A part, a portion, a piece. n. (-लं) 1 Skin. 2 Bark. 3 A kind of (black) pigment or die. 4 The scales of a fish. E. शक to be able, कलच् Uṇādi aff.
37428: शकलिन् m. (-ली) A fish. E. शकल skin or scales, and इनि aff.
37429: शकलीकरण n. (-णं) Parting, dividing, cutting or breaking in pieces. E. शकल, and करण making, with च्चि. augment.
37430: शकलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Parted, cut in pieces, wounded. E. शकल, कृत made, augment च्चि.
37432: शकशकायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Rustling, making a noise (as the leaves of a tree in the wind.) E. शकत् imitative sound, nominal verb, शतृ aff.
37433: शकान्तक m. (-कः) 1 The prince, VIKRAMĀDITYA. 2 The name of SĀLIVĀHANA. E. शक an era or a Scythian, and अन्तक destroyer.
37434: शकाब्द n. (-ब्दं) 1 A year of the Śaka era, or era of SĀLIVĀHANA. E. शक, and अब्द a year.
37435: शकार m. (-रः) A silly brother in law of a Raja.
37436: शकारि m. (-रिः) VIKRAMĀDITYA, the celebrated sovereign of Oujein. E. शक a Saca or Scythian, and अरि the foe.
37437: शकुन m. (-नः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A kind of bird, either the Indian vulture or the common kite, (Falco cheela); it is also applied to the Pondicherry eagle, (Falco ponticeriana.) 3 A sort of hymn or song, sung at festivals to solicit or secure lucky events. n. (-नं) Any lucky or auspicious object or omen. E. शक to be able, उन Uṇādi aff.
37438: शकुनज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) A small house lizard. E. शकुन a bird, and ज्ञ who knows.
37439: शकुनि m. (-निः) 1 A bird. 2 The maternal uncle of the Kaurava princes, and counsellor of DURYODHANA. 3 One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas. 4 The Indian kite or eagle, (Falco cheela.) f. (-नी) A hen sparrow. E. शक to be able, उनि Uṇādi aff.
37440: शकुनिप्रपा f. (-पा) A trough or little well for watering birds. E. शकुनि a bird, प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
37441: शकुनीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of GARUḌA. E. शकुनि a bird, and ईश्वर chief.
37442: शकुन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A bird. 2 A kind of bird, the Indian vulture. 3 Another sort of bird, described as of aquatic habits, perhaps a kind of maritime or fishing falcon. 4 A sort of insect. 5 The blue jay. E. शक to be able, उन्त Uṇādi aff.; also शकुन, &c.
37443: शकुन्तला f. (-ला) The daughter of MENAKĀ, the courtezan of Svarga, by the sage VIŚVĀMITRA, brought up by KAṆVA the hermit, and afterwards married to DUṢYANTA, by whom she became the mother of BHARATA, the sovereign of all India. E. शकुन्त a bird, ला to get, aff. क, and टाप्, being born in a solitary forest, and protected by the birds till found by KAṆVA.
37444: शकुन्तलात्मज m. (-जः) BHARATA, the sovereign of India. E. शकुन्तला as above, and आत्मज the son.
37445: शकुन्ति m. (-न्तिः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A kind of bird: see शकुन्त, &c. E. शक to be able, Uṇādi aff. उन्ति.
37446: शकुन्तिका f. (-का) A locust, a cricket. E. शकुन्त a bird, कन् aff. of comparison.
37447: शकुल m. (-लः) A fish. E. शक to be able, aff. उलच्.
37448: शकुलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of fish, the gilt-head.
37449: शकुलाक्षक m. (-कः) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon), with white blossoms. E. शकुल a fish, अक्षि the eye, अच् substituted for the final vowel; the blossoms being compared to the eye of a fish.
37450: शकुलादनी f. (-नी) 1 A medicinal plant, commonly Kaṭuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 2 A creeping plant, (Jussieua repens.) 3 A drug, commonly Kāyaphal. 4 An earth worm. E. शकुल a fish, अद to eat, aff. ल्युट्.
37451: शकुलार्भक m. (-कः) A sort of gilt-head, (Sparus emarginatus.) E. शकुल a fish, and अर्भक a young one.
37452: शकृत् n. (-कृत्) Fæces, excrement. E. शक to be able, (to expel,) Uṇādi aff. ऋतन्.
37453: शकृत्करि mf. (-रिः-री) A calf. E. शकृत् ordure, कृ to make, इन् aff. in this sense.
37454: शकृत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making ordure or fæces. E. शकृत् ordure, and कार who or what makes.
37455: शकृद्वार n. (-रं) The anus. E. शकृत् fæces, and द्वार passage.
37456: शक्कर m. (-रः) A bull. f. (-री) 1 A river. 2 A zone, a girdle. 3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each. 4 A woman of an impure caste; it is also read शक्वर, q. v.
37457: शक्करि m. (-रिः) A bull; see the last.
37458: शक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Able, capable, strong, powerful. 2 Speaking civilly, able to please by the manner of speaking. 3 Diligent, attentive, intent. E. शक to be able, aff. क्त.
37459: शक्तता f. (-ता,) Ability, power. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्तत्वं.
37460: शक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Power, regal power as resulting from majesty, perseverance, and counsel. 2 Power, strength, prowess. 3 An iron spear or dart. 4 The energy or active power of a deity, personified as his wife, as GAURI of ŚIVA, LAKṢMĪ of VIṢṆU, &c. 5 The female organ as the counterpart of the phallic personification of ŚIVA, and worshipped either literally or figuratively by a sect of Hindus, thence termed Śāktas. 6 Allaying or appeasing opposition. 7 Force or signification of words. E. शक to be able, aff. क्तिन्.
37461: शक्तिग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 KĀRTTIKEYA. 3 A spearman, a lancer. E. शक्ति a spear, and ग्रह who holds.
37462: शक्तितस् ind. According to power or ability. E. शक्ति, and तसि aff.
37463: शक्तित्रय n. (-यं) The three ingredients of regal power; or king, minister, and vigour. E. शक्ति, and चय triad.
37464: शक्तिधर m. (-रः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A spearman, a lancer. E. शक्ति a spear, and धर the holder.
37465: शक्तिपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. शक्ति strength, (giving it,) and पर्ण a leaf.
37466: शक्तिपाणि m. (-णिः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA, the Hindu MARS. 2 A spearman. E. शक्ति a spear, and पाणि the hand.
37467: शक्तिभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA, see the last. 2 A soldier armed with a spear. E. शक्ति a spear, and भृत् who holds.
37468: शक्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Powerful, mighty. E. शक्ति, and मतुप् poss. aff.
37469: शक्तिवैकल्य n. (-ल्यं) Inability, deficiency of power or strength. E. शक्ति, and वैकल्य imperfection.
37470: शक्तिहीन mfd. (-नः-ना-नं) Powerless, impotent. E. शक्ति, and हीन abandoned.
37471: शक्तिहेतिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer, a soldier armed with an iron lance. E. शक्ति a spear, हेति a weapon, and कन् added.
37472: शक्तु mn. (-क्तुः-क्तु) according to some authorities only m. plu. (शक्तवः) The powder or flour of barley and other grain, first fried and then ground. E. शच to go, &c. तुन् aff.; also read सक्तु.
37473: शक्तुफला f. (-ला) The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) E. शक्त farina, and फल fruit; also शक्तुफली, and सक्तुफला.
37474: शक्त्यपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Being according to, or having reference to, ability, power, &c. E. शक्ति, and अपेक्षा regard to.
37475: शक्न mfn. (-क्नः-क्ना-क्नं) Speaking civilly or pleasingly: see the next.
37476: शक्नु mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु) Speaking civilly or kindly. E. शक to be able, (to please by speaking,) aff. क्नु; also with the vowel rejected शक्न, and with क्ल aff. शक्ल.
37477: शक्मन् m. (-क्मा) Power, strength. E. शक to be able, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
37478: शक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Possible, practicable, to be effected or done. E. शक to be able, aff. यत्.
37479: शक्यता f. (-ता) Possibility. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्यत्वं.
37480: शक्यप्रतीकार m. (-रः) A possible remedy or counteragent. E. शक्य, and प्रतीकार remedy.
37481: शक्र m. (-क्रः) INDRA, the chief of the inferior gods, and ruler of Svarga or paradise. 2 A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. शक to possess power, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
37482: शक्रक्रीडाचल m. (-लः) Mount Meru. E. शक्र INDRA, क्रीडा sport, pleasure, and अचल a mountain.
37483: शक्रगोप m. (-पः) An insect of a red colour, (Coccinella or ladybird of various species.) E. शक्र INDRA, गो light, &c. and पा to preserve, aff. क.
37484: शक्रज m. (-जः) A crow. E. शक्र INDRA, and ज born.
37485: शक्रजात m. (-तः) A crow. E. शक्र INDRA, and जात born.
37486: शक्रजित् m. (-जित्) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. शक्र INDRA, and जित् victor.
37487: शक्रधनुस् n. (-नुः) The bow of INDRA, the rain-bow. E. शक्र INDRA, and धनुस् the bow.
37488: शक्रध्वज n. (-जं) A pole or flag set up in honour of INDRA. E. शक्र, and ध्वज a flag.
37489: शक्रनन्दन m. (-नः) ARJUNA. E. शक्र INDRA, and नन्दन son.
37490: शक्रपादप m. (-पः) A sort of pine, (P. devadaru, Rox.) E. शक्र INDRA, and पादप a tree.
37491: शक्रपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A sort of potherb; also Viśalyā. E. शक्र the Pentaptera arjuna, and पुष्प a flower; having similar flowers.
37492: शक्रभवन n. (-नं) Sky, heaven. E. शक्र INDRA, and भवन abode; being the god of the firmament: it also occurs शक्रभुवन, from भुवन a world.
37493: शक्रभिद् m. (-भिद्) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. शक्र INDRA, and भिद् defeater.
37495: शक्रमूर्द्ध्वन् m. (-र्द्ध्वा) An ant hill, a hillock. E. शक्र INDRA, मूर्द्ध्वन् the head.
37496: शक्रवाहन m. (-नः) A cloud. E. शक्र INDRA, and वाहन vehicle.
37497: शक्रशरासन n. (-नं) The rain-bow. E. शक्र INDRA, शरासन a bow.
37498: शक्रशाला f. (-ला) A place prepared for sacrifices to be offered in. E. शक्र INDRA, and शाला a hall.
37499: शक्रशिरस् n. (-रः) An ant hill E. शक्र. INDRA, and शिरस् the head.
37500: शक्रसारथि m. (-थिः) The charioteer of INDRA. E. शक्र, and सारथि a coachman.
37501: शक्रसुत m. (-तः) 1 The monkey king BALI. 2 ARJUNA. E. शक्र INDRA, and सुत the son.
37502: शक्रसुधा f. (-धा) The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, or gum olibanum. E. शक्र INDRA, and सुधा ambrosia.
37503: शक्रसृष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) E. शक्र INDRA, सृष्ट created; springing originally, it is said, from the ground on which INDRA spilt a drop of nectar as he was drinking.
37505: शक्राणी f. (-णी) SACĪ, the wife of INDRA. E. शक्र INDRA, ङीष् aff. and आनुक् inserted.
37506: शक्राशन m. (-नः) A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) E. शक्र INDRA, अशन food: created by him; springing from the drops of Amṛta, which fell on the ground from the bodies of the monkies slain in the war with RĀVAṆA, and who were restored to life by INDRA by a shower of Amṛta, or the liquor of immortality.
37507: शक्रोत्सव m. (-वः) A festival in honour of INDRA on the twelfth of the month Bhādra. E. शक्र INDRA, and उत्सव a festival.
37508: शक्ल mfn. (-क्लः-क्ला-क्लं) Speaking civilly or kindly. E. शक to be able, (to delight simply by speaking,) and क्ल Uṇādi affix; also शक्न and शक्नु.
37509: शक्वन् m. (-क्वा) An elephant. E. शक to be powerful, and वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
37510: शक्वर m. (-रः) A bull, an ox. f. (-री) 1 A finger. 2 A river. 3 A zone, a girdle. 4 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each, and comprising many varieties according to the different feet of which the lines are composed. E. शक to be able or strong, क्वरप् aff., or वनिप् aff. with र augment, and the final rejected: the feminine form is also derived from शक्वन् with ङीप् affix, and र augment, and the word is also read शक्कर and शक्करी.
37511: शङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A draft ox. f. (-ङ्का) 1 Fear, terror, apprehension. 2 Doubt, uncertainty. 3 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. शकि to fear, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
37512: शङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Doubtful, questionable, to be doubted or apprehended. E. शकि to fear or doubt, अनीयर् aff.; also शङ्कितव्य and शङ्क्य.
37513: शङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness or good fortune. m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 The name of a celebrated teacher of the Vedānta philosophy. f. (-री) Bengal madder. E. शं good fortune, कर making.
37514: शङ्करप्रिय m. (-यः) The francoline partridge. E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and प्रिय dear, beloved.
37515: शङ्कान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Apprehensive, doubtful, afraid. E. शङ्का, अन्वित possessed of.
37516: शङ्काभियोग m. (-गः) Accusation or charge on suspicion. E. शङ्का, and अभियोग charge.
37517: शङ्कामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fearful, afraid. E. शङ्का, and मयट् aff.
37518: शङ्कास्पद n. (-दं) Cause or matter of doubt or apprehension. E. शङ्का, and आस्पद site.
37519: शङ्काहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Free from doubt or apprehension. E. शङ्का, and हीन free from.
37520: शङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Alarmed, frightened. 2 Weak, unsteady. 3 Doubtful, uncertain. E. शङ्का fear, इतच् aff.
37521: शङ्कितवर्णक m. (-कः) A thief. E. शङ्कित frightened, वर्ण a caste, कन् aff.
37522: शङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 The trunk of a lopped tree. 2 A javelin. 3 A pin, a stake, a pale. 4 The gnomon of a dial, usually twelve fingers long. 5 A long thin column in front of a pagoda. 6 The penis. 7 A number. 8 The small fibres of a leaf. 9 The scate fish, (Raia Sankur, HAM.) 10 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi. 11 A goose. 12 An ant hill. 13 A goblin, a demon. 14 A Gandharba attached to ŚIVA. 15 A name of ŚIVA. 16 KĀMA. 17 Sin. 18 Fear, terror. E. शकि to doubt or apprehend, aff. उ.
37523: शङ्कुकर्ण m. (-र्णः) An ass. E. शङ्कु a javelin, and कर्ण the ear.
37525: शङ्कुतरु m. (-रुः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. शङ्कु a stake, and तरु a tree.
37526: शङ्कुवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Śāl tree. E. शङ्कु a pin or stake, and वृक्ष tree.
37527: शङ्कुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Formidable, fearful, frightful. E. शङ्कु fear, रा to give or cause, aff. ड.
37528: शङ्कुला f. (-ला) A pair of nippers, used to cut the betel nut into small pieces.
37529: शङ्कोच m. (-चः) A scate fish; also शङ्कु, शङ्कुचि, and शङ्कोचि.
37530: शङ्क्य mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं) To be feared or doubted. E. शकि to fear. यत् aff.
37531: शङ्ख mn. (-ङ्खः-ङ्खं) The conch shell used by the Hindus, in two ways especially; offering libations with it, or when perforated at one end blowing it as a horn at sacrifices: used in this manner also, frequent, mention of it occurs in the battle pieces of the poets, each hero being provided with a Conch as his horn. m. (-ङ्खः) 1 One of KUVERA'S treasures. 2 The temple or temporal bone, sometimes comprising however the frontal bone also. 3 A perfume, commonly Nakhi, apparently a dried shell fish. 4 A military drum. 5 One of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla, described as of a yellow colour. 6 An elephant's cheek. 7 A large number, ten or a hundred billions. 8 The name of a saint and legislator. 9 A poet, one of the nine gems, &c. E. शम to pacify, &c. Uṇādi aff. ख.
37532: शङ्खक n. (-कं) A bracelet, (often made of the conch shell.) mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The conch shell. 2 Pain, and heat with a puffiness in the temples and forehead. 3 The temples. E. कन् added to the last.
37533: शङ्खकार m. (-रः) A worker in shells. E. शङ्ख a conch, and कार maker.
37534: शङ्खचरी f. (-री) Sandal marks on the forehead. E. शङ्ख the forehead, and चर to go, aff. टच् and ङीष्.
37535: शङ्खचर्च्ची f. (-र्च्ची) Sandal marks made across the forehead. E. शङ्ख the forehead, चर्च to anoint, affs. अच् and ङीष्.
37536: शङ्खज m. (-जः) A large pearl, of the shape of a pigeon's egg. E. शङ्ख a shell, and ज born.
37537: शङ्खध्म m. (-ध्मः) A shell blower. E. शङ्ख a conch, and घ्म who blows.
37538: शङ्खनख m. (-खः) 1 A small shell. 2 A perfume, commonly नखी. E. शङ्ख a conch, and नख the nail.
37539: शङ्खपाल m. (-लः) 1 The sun. 2 A Nāga or serpent of Pātāla. E. शङ्ख a conch, &c., and पाल who nourishes.
37540: शङ्खपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) E. शङ्ख a conch, पुष्प a flower, ङीप् aff. implying resemblance.
37541: शङ्खप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Spots in the moon. E. शङ्ख a shell, and प्रस्थ pre-eminent.
37542: शङ्खभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Having a conch or shell. m. (-भृत्) VIṢṆU. E. शङ्ख a conch, and भृत् who possesses.
37543: शङ्खमुख m. (-खः) An alligator. E. शङ्ख a conch, and मुख face.
37544: शङ्खिका f. (-का) A kind of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) E. शंख a shell, कन् implying resemblance, fem. form.
37545: शङ्खिन् mfn. (-ङ्खी-ङ्खिनी-ङ्खि) Possessing or having a conch or shell, &c. m. (-ङ्खी) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The ocean. 3 A shell blower. 4 A worker in shells. f. (-नी) 1 A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 2 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 3 A description of woman, one of the four classes into which females are divided in erotic writings: the Śaṅkhinī is described as tall, with long hair, neither stout nor thin, of irascible disposition and strong passions. 4 A goddess or Śakti worshipped by the Bauddhas. 5 A female spirit or goblin. E. शङ्ख a shell, इनि aff.
37546: शङ्खिनीवास m. (-सः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera.)
37547: शच r. 1st cl. (शचते) To speak articulately, to say or tell. (इ,) शचि r. 1st cl. (शंचते) To go, to move.
37548: शचि f. (-चिः or ची) 1 The wife of INDRA. 2 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) 3 The astronomical Karaṇa or period named Viṣṭi. E. शच to speak articulately, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also सचि, and सची.
37549: शचीपति m. (-तिः) INDRA. E. शची the wife of the deity, and पति husband.
37550: शट r. 1st cl. (शटति) 1 To be diseased or sick. 2 To divide, to pierce or separate. 3 To go. 4 To be low spirited, to be weary or dejected. r. 10th cl. (शाटयति) To flatter, to praise.
37551: शट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Sour, astringent, acid. E. शट to pain, aff. अच्.
37552: शटा f. (-टा) An ascetic's clotted hair: see सटा.
37553: शटी f. (-टिः or -टी) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet,) otherwise considered as a synonym of the Ambahaldi, or Curcuma Amhaldi, the mango-smelling ginger, so termed because the fresh root possesses the smell of a green mango. E. शट to divide (remove disease), aff. इन, and ङीष optionally added.
37554: शठ r. 1st cl. (शठति) 1 To cheat, to defraud or deceive. 2 To kill or hurt. 3 To suffer pain. r. 10th cl. (शाठयति) 1 To finish. 2 To leave unfinished. 3 To go or move. (शठयति) 1 To speak ill. 2 To speak well. 3 To abstain from speaking. (शाठयते) To flatter, to coax, to praise.
37555: शठ mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं) Wicked, depraved, perverse, dishonest. m. (-ठः) 1 An umpire, a mediator, an arbitrator. 2 A rogue, a knave. 3 A blockhead, a fool. 4 An idler. 5 A false husband or lover, one who pretends affection to one female whilst his heart is fixed on another. 6 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) n. (-ठं) 1 A sort of root, commonly Tagara. 2 Saffron. 3 Iron. E. शठ to be wicked, aff. अच्.
37556: शठता f. (-ता) Wickedness, depravity. E. शट wicked, तल् aff.; also शठत्व n. (-त्वं.)
37557: शड (इ) शडि r. 1st cl. (शंडते) 1 To disease or disorder. 2 To hurt or wound. 3 To collect, to heap together.
37558: शण r. 1st cl. (शणति) 1 To give. 2 To move.
37559: शण n. (-णं) 1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 2 Bengal Saṇ, a plant from which a kind of hemp is prepared, (Crotolaria juncea and other kinds.) 3 An arrow. E. शण to give, aff. अच्.
37560: शणतन्तु f. (-न्तुः) The thread or string made of the flax of the Crotolaria juncea. E. शण, and तन्तु string.
37561: शणतान्तव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made of Saṇ string. E. शणतन्तु, and अण् aff.
37562: शणपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) E. शण Saṇ, and पर्ण a leaf, having similar leaves.
37563: शणपुष्पिका f. (-का) Crotolaria of several species. E. शण the Saṇ, पुष्प a flower, aff. ङीष्, and कन् added, fem. form, implying resemblance; also शणपुष्पी, &c.
37564: शणसूत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The fibre or flax of the Saṇ plant, or string made from it. 2 A net made of hemp or of Saṇ, or the thread of the Crotolaria juncea. 3 Cordage, twine. E. शण hemp, &c. सूत्र a thread.
37566: शणीर n. (-रं) 1 A rock or small island in the midst of the river Śoṇa. 2 An insular spot inclosed by the branches of the Serjū, where it falls into the Ganges above Cūprah, at Bhṛgurāśrama or Bageressan; called also, the bank of the Dardarī.
37567: शण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A bull at liberty. 2 A eunuch. n. (-ण्डं) A multitude of lotus flowers. E. शण or षण to give, aff. ड, hence also षण्ड, and differently derived, शण्ठ or षण्ट the more usual form.
37568: शण्डता f. (-ता) 1 The state of a bull let loose or at liberty. 2 Emasculation. E. शण्ड a bull at liberty, &c. तल् aff.
37569: शण्डिल m. (-लः) The name of a Muni, and ancestor of a particular family of Brahmans. E. शण्ड a eunuch, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
37570: शण्ढ m. (-ण्ढः) 1 A eunuch. 2 A eunuch or emasculated attendant, as employed in a Haram or seraglio. 3 An impotent man. 4 A bull at liberty. 5 A mad man or a drunken man. E. शम to bear or endure, Uṇādi aff. ढ; also षण्ढ and शण्ड, &c.
37572: शतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A hundred. m. (-कः) A century, a cento, a collection of one hundred stanzas, &c. E. शत a hundred, and कन् aff.
37573: शतकीर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A Jina or Jaina pontiff of the last age. E. शत a hundred, and कीर्त्ति fame.
37574: शतकुम्भ n. (-म्भं) Gold. m. (-म्भः) The name of a mountain. f. (-म्भा) A plant, (Phyalis flexuosa.) E. शत a hundred, and कुम्भ a water jar.
37575: शतकोटि m. (-टिः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, and कोटि edge.
37576: शतक्रतु m. (-तुः) INDRA. E. शत a hundred, क्रतु sacrifice; a hundred Aśvamedhas or sacrifices of an unbroken horse, elevating the sacrificer to the place and title of INDRA.
37578: शतगु mfn. (-गुः-गुः-गु) Possessed of a hundred cows, with as many, &c. E. शत and गु for गो a cow.
37579: शतगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A hundred times, a hundred fold. E. शत, and गुण a time.
37580: शतघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) 1 A weapon; it is generally supposed to be a sort of fire arms, or the ancient Indian rocket, but it is also described as a stone set round with iron spikes. 2 A female scorpion. 3 A plant, (Galedupa arborea.) 4 A disease of the throat, apparently enlargement of the tonsils. E. शत a hundred, हन to kill, aff. अण् and ङीष्, and the radical letters changed.
37581: शतच्छद m. (-दः) The wood-pecker. E. शत a hundred, च्छद a feather.
37582: शततम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Hundredth. E. शत a hundred, तमट् aff.
37583: शततारा f. (-रा) The constellation Śatabhiṣā, q. v. E. शत a hundred or many, and तारा a star.
37584: शतद्रु f. (-द्रुः) The Setlej river, which rises in the Himālaya mountains, in the vicinity it is supposed of the Rāvanhrad or lake, and running to the S. W. unites in the Pañjāb with the Beyah or Vipāśā, when it forms the Hyphasis of the Greeks, and falls into the Indus below Multan. E. शत a hundred (fold, or in a hundred branches), द्रु to flow, Uṇādi aff. कु.
37585: शतद्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hundred-gated, having a hundred or a number of doors or outlets. E. शत, and द्वार a door.
37586: शतधा f. (-घा) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) ind. In a hundred ways, a hundredfold. E. शत a hundred (blossoms), धा to have, क and टाप् affs. or शत the same, and घाच् aff.
37587: शतधामन् m. (-मा) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, (i. e. many,) घामन् body; being multiplied in as many shapes as the creation exhibits.
37588: शतधार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Flowing in many streams. 2 Having many edges, &c. n. (-रं) The thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, घारा an edge, टच् added.
37589: शतधृति m. (-तिः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 INDRA. E. शत a hundred, and धृति sacrifice.
37590: शतपत्र n. (-त्रं) A lotus in general, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphæa nelumbo). m. (-त्रः) 1 A peacock. 2 The Sāras or Indian crane. 3 A wood-pecker. 4 A parrot, the king parrot or Loory. f. (-त्रा) A woman. E. शत a hundred, पत्र a leaf or feather.
37591: शतपत्रक m. (-कः) The wood-pecker. E. कन् added to the last, q. v.
37592: शतपथिक mf. (-कः-की-कं) Following a variety of paths or doctrines. E. शत a hundred, पथिन् a road and figuratively a doctrine, aff. षिकन्.
37593: शतपदी f. (-दी) A centipede, jaulus. E. शत a hundred, and पद a foot, ङीष् aff.
37594: शतपद्म n. (-द्मं) The white lotus. E. शत a hundred (leaves), and पद्म a lotus.
37595: शतपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) A bambu. E. शत a hundred or many, पर्व्वन् a joint or knot.
37596: शतपर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) 1 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 2 Orris root. 3 The wife of ŚUKRA. 4 Day of full moon in the month Āśvina. E. शत a hundred, पर्व्वन् a joint or period, ङीप् aff.
37597: शतपर्व्विका f. (-का) 1 Bent grass or Dūb. 2 Orris root. 3 Barley. E. कन् fem. form, added to the last.
37598: शतपर्व्वेश m. (-शः) The planet VENUS or its regent. E. शतपर्व्वा the wife of ŚUKRA, and ईश lord or husband.
37599: शतपाद् f. (-पाद् or -पात्) A centipede. E. शत a hundred, and पाद् a foot.
37600: शतपादिका f. (-का) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. 2 A centipede. E. शत a hundred, पाद a foot or root, कन् aff. fem. form.
37601: शतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The poet BHĀRAVI, the author of the Kirātārjunīya. f. (-ष्पा) A sort of dill or fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शत a hundred, and पुष्प a flower.
37602: शतपुष्पिका f. (-का) Anethum, (sowa.) E. कन् fem. form, added to the last.
37604: शतपोनक m. (-कः) Fistula in ano with many external openings. E. कन् added to the last.
37605: शतपोरक m. (-कः) A kind of sugar cane.
37606: शतप्रास m. (-सः) A flower, (Nerium odorum.) E. शत a hundred, and प्रास a dart, to which the leaves are compared.
37607: शतभिषज् f. (-षक्) One of the lunar asterisms, see the next. E. शत a hundred, भिषज् a physician.
37608: शतभिषा f. (-षा) The twenty-fifth of the Nakṣatras or lunar mansions, containing 100 stars, one of which is λ Aquarii. E. शत a hundred, भिषज् to cure, aff. ड; requiring many physicians; as the Hindus say DHANVANTARI himself cannot cure any person affected with disease, whilst the moon is in this asterism.
37609: शतभीरु f. (-रुः) Arabian jasmine, (J. zambac.) E. शत a hundred (dangers), भीरु timid.
37610: शतमख m. (-स्वः) INDRA. E. शत a hundred, and मख a sacrifice: the performance of a hundred Aśvamedhas obtaining this situation.
37611: शतमन्यु m. (-न्युः) INDRA. E. शत a hundred, and मन्यु a sacrifice; see the last.
37612: शतमान mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A Pala of silver. 2 An ĀḌhaka or measure so termed. E. शत a hundred, and मान measure.
37613: शतमारिन् m. (-री) A man who has killed a hundred others. E. शत, and मारिन् a killer.
37614: शतमार्ज m. (-र्जः) An armourer, a cutler. E. शत a hundred, (many, weapons,) and मार्ज who cleans.
37615: शतमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 1 Having a hundred mouths. 2 Having a hundred openings or outlets. E. शत, and मुस्व mouth.
37616: शतमूली f. (-ली) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. शत a hundred or many, मूल a root, fem. aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added शतमूलिका.
37617: शतयष्टिक m. (-कः) A necklace of 100 strings. E. शत a hundred, यष्टि a string, कन् added.
37618: शतलक्ष n. (-क्षं) A hundred Lakhs, ten millions. E. शत, and लक्ष a hundred thousand.
37619: शतलुम्पक m. (-कः) A name of the poet BHĀRAVI.
37620: शतवर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Of a hundred years, a century old. n. (-र्षं) A century. E. शत, and वर्ष a year.
37621: शतवीर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) White Dūb grass, (Panicum dactylon with white blossoms.) E. शत a hundred, वीय्य seed.
37622: शतवेधिन् m. (-धी) A sort of dock or sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha or Rumex vesicarius.) E. शत a hundred, व्यध to pierce, aff. णिनि.
37623: शतशस् ind. By hundreds, a hundred fold. E. शत, and शसि aff.
37624: शतशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Having many branches. 2 Multiform, various. E. शत, and शाखा a branch.
37625: शतसहस्र n. (-स्रं) A hundred thousand. E. शत, and सहस्र a thousand.
37626: शतसहस्रशस् ind. By myriads. E. शस् added to the last.
37627: शतसाहस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्री-स्रं) Having a hundred thousand, bought with, consisting of, &c. E. शतसहस्र, and अण् aff.
37628: शतह्रदा f. (-दा) 1 Lightning. 2 The thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, ह्रद a ray of light, or ह्राद sound, and the vowel made short; read also, शतह्रादा.
37629: शताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Hundred eyed. f. (-क्षी) 1 Night. 2 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa). 3 The goddess PĀRVATĪ. E. शत a hundred, अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
37630: शताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A car, a chariot. E. शत a hundred, and अङ्ग a part.
37631: शतानक n. (-कं) A place where dead bodies are burnt or buried, a burial ground, a cemetery. E. शत a hundred, आनक a drum.
37632: शतानन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 3 The car of VIṢṆU. 4 The Muni GAUTAMA, the founder of the logical school of philosophy. 5 The eldest son of GAUTAMA, (according to the Rāmāyaṇa,) and Purohita or religious adviser of JANAKA of Mithila. E. शत a hundred or many, and आनन्द who delights.
37633: शतानीक m. (-कः) 1 An old man. 2 The name of a sovereign, the son and successor of JANAMEJAYA. 3 The name of a saint, the pupil of VYĀSA. E. शत a hundred, आङ् before नी to obtain, कप् aff.
37634: शतायुस् m. (-युः) A man a hundred years old, an old man. E. शत, and आयुस् life.
37635: शतार n. (-रं) The thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, ऋ to go, aff. अण्.
37636: शतारुस् nf. (-रुः-रुषी) A leprous disease of the skin. E. शत hundred or many, and अरुस् a sore.
37638: शतावर m. (-रः) A fine of a hundred (Paṇas, &c.) E. शत, and अवर inferior.
37639: शतावरी f. (-री) 1 A shrub, (Asparagus racemosus.) 2 The wife of INDRA. E. शत a hundred (roots), आङ् before वृ to choose, aff. अच्.
37640: शतावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving.
37641: शतावर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving, (appearances, or in the mind of his worshippers), इनि aff.
37642: शताह्वा f. (-ह्वा-ह्वी) A sort of dill or fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शत a hundred, and आह्ना name, appellation.
37643: शतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Indicative of a hundred, (as a sign or omen.) 2 Doing or effecting any thing with a hundred. 3 Bearing tax or interest per hundred. 4 Bought with a hundred. 5 Changed with or for a hundred, &c. 6 Relating or belonging to a hundred. E. शत a hundred, and ठक or ठञ् or ठन् aff.; also with यत् aff. शत्य in the same acceptations.
37644: शतेर m. (-रः) 1 An enemy. 2 Injury, detriment, hurt. E. शद to decay, to go, Uṇādi aff. एरक, and द changed to त.
37645: शतेश m. (-शः) The ruler or head man of a hundred (villages). E. शत, and ईश sovereign.
37646: शत्त्रि m. (-त्त्रिः) An elephant. E. शद to go, त्त्रिप् Uṇādi aff.
37647: शत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Bought with a hundred, &c. see शतिक.
37648: शत्रु m. (-त्रः) 1 An enemy, a foe, an adversary. 2 A political enemy, a neighbouring prince as being one with whom disputes are likely to occur. E. शद to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रुन्.
37649: शत्रुंसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing or patient with an enemy. E. शत्रु, सह to bear, खच् aff.
37650: शत्रुघात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Who beats or kills an enemy. E. शत्रु, and घात who kills.
37651: शत्रुघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Killing a foe. m. (-घ्नः) The second brother of RĀMACANDRA, the son of SUMITRĀ, and uterine brother of LAKṢMAṆA. E. शत्रु an enemy, and घ्न destroyer.
37652: शत्रुघ्नजननी f. (-नी) SUMITRĀ, the mother of LAKṢMAṆA, and ŚATRUGHNA. E. शत्रुघ्न ŚATRUGHNA, and जननी the mother.
37653: शत्रुञ्जय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Subduing an enemy. m. (-यः) 1 The mountain Vimala, or Girnār, or a mountainous range in Guzerat. 2 An elephant. E. शत्रु a foe, जि to conquer, खच् aff.
37654: शत्रुता f. (-ता) Hostility, enmity. E. तल् added to शत्रु; also शत्रुत्वं.
37655: शत्रुनिकाय m. (-यः) A number or host of enemies. E. शत्रु, and निकाय a quantity.
37656: शत्रुनिलय m. (-यः) The dwelling of a foe. E. शत्रु, and निलय abode.
37657: शत्रुन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Humbling or subduing enemies. E. शत्रु, तप to harass, खच् aff.
37658: शत्रुपक्ष m. (-क्षः) An antagonist, an enemy. E. शत्रु, and पक्ष side or part.
37659: शत्रुमर्द्दन m. (-नः) ŚATRUGHNA, the brother of RĀMA. E. शत्रु a foe, मर्द्दन destroyer.
37660: शत्वरी f. (-री) Night. E. शद to go, क्वरप् aff.; fem. aff. ङीप्.
37661: शद (औ ऌ) औ शदॢ r. 1st and 6th cls. (शीयते) 1 To perish gradually, to wither or decay. 2 To fall. 3 To throw down. 4 To go, to move.
37662: शद m. (-दः) A vegetable, any edible vegetable product, as fruits, roots, &c. E. शद to wither, aff. अच्.
37663: शद्रि m. (-द्रिः) 1 A cloud. 2 An elephant. 3 ARJUNA. f. (-द्रिः) Lightning. 4 Clayed or candied sugar. E. शद to go, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
37664: शद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) 1 Wasting, decaying. 2 Going, moving. E. शद to go, रु aff.
37666: शनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
37667: शनि m. (-निः) The planet SATURN or its regent. E. शो to destroy, or शण to give, aff. इन्.
37668: शनिज n. (-जं) Black pepper. E. शनि SATURN, and ज born.
37669: शनिप्रसू f. (-सूः) CHĀYA, the wife of the sun. E. शनि SATURN, and प्रसू the mother.
37670: शनिप्रिय n. (-यं) The emerald or sapphire. E. शनि SATURN, and प्रिय dear to.
37671: शनिवार m. (-रः) Saturday. E. शनि the planet, and वार in this and similar compounds, a day.
37672: शनैश्चर m. (-रः) The planet SATURN or its mythological personification. E. शनैस् slowly, and चर who goes.
37673: शनैस् ind. 1 Slowly, tardily. 2 Independantly, at will. E. शण to give, (to produce,) aff. ऐम्, and the consonant changed.
37674: शप् ind. A particle and prefix of assent or acceptance, as शप्करोति he accepts.
37675: शप r. 1st cl. (शपति-ते) r. 4th cl. (शप्यति-ते) 1 To revile, to wish evil or imprecations on, to curse, to swear. 2 To take an oath.
37676: शप m. (-पः) 1 An oath. 2 An imprecation, a curse, cursing. 3 A corpse; also शव. E. शप to curse, aff. अच्.
37677: शपथ m. (-थः) 1 An oath, asseveration by oath or ordeal. 2 An imprecation, a curse. 3 Cursing, wishing ill to. E. शप to swear, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
37678: शपन n. (-नं) An oath, confirmation of the truth by oath or ordeal. 2 Abuse, imprecation, cursing, malediction. E. शप to curse, aff. ल्युट्.
37679: शपमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Revilling, imprecating. 2 Swearing. E. शप to curse, शानच् aff.
37680: शप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Cursed, anathematised. 2 Sworn, taken as an oath. m. (-प्तः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum). E. शप to curse, aff. क्त.
37681: शफ mn. (-फः-फं) 1 A hoof in general. 2 The root of a tree. 3 The hoof of a horse. E. शम to be tranquil, aff. अच्, and the final changed to फ.
37682: शफर mf. (-रः-री) A small fish, (Cyprinus Sophore, HAM.) E. शफ a hoof, रा to give, (to resemble,) aff. क.
37683: शफराधिप m. (-पः) The Ilisha or Hilsa fish, (Ilisha clupanodon.) E. शफर a carp, and अधिप chief.
37684: शब्द r. 10th cl. (शब्दयति) To sound, to make or utter sound; with the prefixes प्र, प्रति, or वि, as well as uncompounded, this root means also:. 1 To promise. 2 To make clear or manifest, to explain. 3 To speak.
37685: शब्द m. (-ब्दः) 1 Sound in general. 2 A sound, a word. 4 (In grammar,) A declinable word, as noun, pronoun, &c. E. शब्द to sound, aff. अच्.
37686: शब्दकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making sound, sounding, sonorous. E. शब्द sound, &c. कृ to make, अण् aff.
37687: शब्दग्रह m. (-हः) 1 The ear. 2 Receiving or catching sound. 3 A fabulous arrow. E. शब्द sound, ग्रह what receives.
37688: शब्दचोर m. (-रः) A plagiary. E. शब्द, and चोर a thief.
37689: शब्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding, sonorous. (-नं) Sounding, uttering sounds. E. शब्द to sound, aff. युच्.
37690: शब्दब्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) Inspired writ, the Vedas as uncreated and identifiable with the supreme spirit. E. शब्द, and ब्रह्मन् the supreme.
37691: शब्दभेदिन् m. (-दी) 1 A name of ARUṆA. 2 The anus. E. शब्द sound, noise, and भेदिन् breaking.
37692: शब्दयोनि f. (-निः) A root, a radical word. E. शब्द, and योनि place of origin.
37693: शब्दवेधिन् m. (-धी) ARJUNA. E. शब्द sound, and वेधिन् piercing; terrifying his enemies by his shouts.
37694: शब्दशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Force or signification of words. E. शब्द, and शक्ति power.
37695: शब्दशासन n. (-नं) The rules of grammar. E. शब्द, and शासन regulating.
37696: शब्दशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Philology, grammar, &c. E. शब्द, and शास्त्र a science, &c.
37697: शब्दसंग्रह m. (-हः) A vocabulary, a lexicon. E. शब्द, and संग्रह collection.
37698: शब्दादि m. (-दिः) The objects of sense, as sound, form, scent, juice, contact; or what affords matter for the exercise of hearing, seeing, smelling, tasting and touching. E. शब्द, and आदि other.
37699: शब्दाधिष्ठान n. (-नं) The ear. E. E. शब्द sound, अधिष्ठान receptacle.
37700: शब्दानुरूप n. (-पं) 1 Conformity or proportion to the sound. 2 Imitation of sound. E. शब्द, and अनुरूप conformity.
37701: शब्दानुशासन n. (-नं) The acceptation or sense of words. E. शब्द, and अनुशासन government.
37702: शब्दायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding. E. शब्द sound, nominal verb, शानच् aff.
37703: शब्दार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 The sense or meaning of words. 2 Words and sense. E. शब्द, and अर्थं sense.
37704: शब्दालङ्कार m. (-रः) Rhetorical use of words; verbal figure, as alliteration, &c. E. शब्द, and अलङ्कार ornament.
37705: शब्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded. 2 Uttered, articulated. 3 Explained, made public or manifest. 4 Converted into a noun, &c. शब्द to sound, क्त aff.; or शब्द, and इतच् aff.
37706: शम r. 4th cl. (इर् उ) इरशमु (शाम्यति) 1 To be pacified, to be calmed or appeased. 2 To pacify, to calm. 3 To be tranquil, to have the passions tamed and quiescent. r. 10th cl. (शमयते) To look, to look at or inspect. (शमयति) To allay, to appease. (शामयति) To display. With उप prefixed, To tranquillize, to allay, to tame. With नि, 1 To hear. 2 To restrain or prevent. With प्र, 1 To destroy. 2 To be very tranquil.
37707: शम m. (-मः) 1 Quiet of mind, stoicism, indifference, the absence of passion, as one of the qualities of the Vedāntī or follower of the Vedānta doctrine; it is defined to be the exclusion of every idea not derived from the precepts of that philosophy, and is so far synonymous with abstract meditation on BRAHMĀ, or GOD. 2 Quiet, tranquillity, rest, calm, (in general.) 3 Final happiness, emancipation from human existence. 4 Cure, convalescence, alleviation of pain or disease. 5 Abuse, imprecation, malediction. 6 The hand. E. शम to be pacified or calm, aff. घञ्, and the vowel not made long.
37708: शमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Pacifier, pacificator, tranquillizing. E. शम to be tranquil, ण्वुल् aff., of attributive agency.
37709: शमथ m. (-थः) 1 Quiet, tranquillity, (see the last.) 2 A counsellor, a minister. E. शम to be calm, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
37710: शमन n. (-नं) 1 Killing animals for sacrifice, immolation. 2 Mental tranquillity, calmness, indifference. 3 Abuse, malediction. 4 Hurt, injury. 5 Chewing. m. (-नः) 1 YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus. 2 An antelope. f. (-नी) Night. E. शम to be tranquil, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
37711: शमनस्वसृ f. (-सा) Yamunā or Jumna the personified river. E. शमन YAMA, and स्वसृ the sister.
37712: शमनीषद m. (-दः) A Rākṣasa, an evil spirit, a goblin. E. शमन night, षद who goes.
37713: शमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Appeasing. allaying. 2 Terminating, stopping. E. शम to pacify, शतृ aff.
37714: शमल n. (-लं) Fœces, ordure. E. शम to be quiet, Uṇādi aff. कल,
37715: शमान्तक m. (-कः) The deity KĀMA or love. E. शम mental or devotional tranquillity, and अन्तक destroyer.
37716: शमि f. (-मिः-मी) A legume or pod. f. (-मी) 1 The Śami tree, (Acacia suma, Rox.) 2 A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. शम to pacify (sickness,) aff. इन्, ङीष् added.
37717: शमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pacified, appeased. 2 Quiet, tranquil, sedate, calm. 3 Alleviated, relieved. 4 Tempered, moderated 5 Relaxed, intermitted. E. शम to be pacified or calm, aff. क्त.
37718: शमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Tranquil, pacific, tranquillized. E. शम to be tranquil, aff. घिनुण्.
37719: शमिर m. (-रः) A variety of the Śami tree. E. शमी the Śami tree, रा to get, (to resemble,) aff. क, and the vowel made short; also शमीर.
37720: शमिरोह m. (-हः) ŚIVA. E. शमि for शमी the Śami tree, and रोह who ascends.
37721: शमीगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 A man of the sacerdotal class, a Brahman. 2 A name of AGNI or fire. E. शमी the mimosa, (the wood of which is essential for certain sacrifices, &c.) and गर्भ embryo.
37722: शमीधान्य n. (-न्यं) Pulse, grain which grows in legumes or pods. E. शमी a legume, and धान्य grain.
37723: शमीपत्री f. (-त्री) A sort of Sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. शमी Acacia Suma, and पत्र the leaf; having a similar leaf.
37724: शमीर m. (-रः) A small variety of the Mimosa Suma. E. शमी the Śami tree, and र aff. of diminution; also sometimes read शमिर.
37725: शम्पा f. (-म्पा) Lightning. E. शम् happiness, पा to drink, क, and टाप् aff.; destroying pleasure by its awful appearance.
37726: शम्पाक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of Cassia, (C. fistula.) 2 Bringing to maturity or ripeness, cooking, maturing. 3 The lac pigment. E. शम् pleasure, and पाक what matures; also सम्पाक.
37727: शम्ब r. 1st cl. (शम्बति) To go. r. 10th cl. (शम्बयति) To accumulate, to collect or heap together.
37728: शम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Happy, fortunate. m. (-म्बः) 1 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 2 The iron head of a pestle. 3 An iron chain worn round the loins. 4 The second ploughing of a field. E. शम् happiness, and ब possessive aff., or शम्ब to accumulate, aff. अच्: it is also read संव, शंव, and सम्ब.
37729: शम्बर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 A religious observance. 3 Wealth. m. (-रः) 1 A Daitya. 2 A sort of deer. 3 A mountain. 4 A fish in general. 5 War. 6 Best, excellent. 7 A Bauddha. f. (-री) 1 A drug or medicinal plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.) 2 A female juggler. E. शम्ब to accumulate, अरन् aff., or शं happiness, वृ to choose, aff. अप्; also read शंवर, and सम्बर or संवर.
37730: शम्बरसूदन m. (-नः) A name of KĀMA. E. शम्बर the Daitya, and सूदन destroyer.
37731: शम्बरारि m. (-रिः) KĀMA, the Hindu deity of love. E. शम्बर the Daitya, and अरि the foe.
37732: शम्बल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Provender for a journey, stock for travelling expences. 2 A bank, a shore. 3 Envy, impatience or dislike of another's success. f. (-ली) A procuress, a bawd. E. शम्ब to go, to collect, अलच् aff.; also शंवल, and सम्बल or संवल.
37733: शम्बाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed, (a field.) E. शम्ब a second ploughing, कृत made, and डाच् augment.
37734: शम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A bivalve shell. E. see शम्बूक below.
37735: शम्बुक m. (-कः) A bivalve shell: see शम्बूक.
37736: शम्बुक्क m. (-क्कः) A bivalve shell: see the next, शम्बूक.
37737: शम्बूक mf. (-कः-का) A bivalve shell. m. (-कः) 1 A conch shell. 2 A snail. 3 A Śūdra, who had become a devotee in the time of RĀMACANDRA, and was slain by him. 4 The edge of the frontal protuberance of the elephant. 5 The name of a  Daitya. E. शम to be tranquil, ऊकन् aff., and वुक् augment; also with the vowel short, शम्बुक, and the final consonant then rejected, शम्बु; it is also read, शम्बुक्क, and with the first vowel long, शाम्बूक, &c.
37738: शम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 2 The iron bound head of a club or pestle. 3 A happy man. E. शम् particle of auspiciousness, भा to shine, aff. क.
37739: शम्भली f. (-ली) A bawd, a procuress. E. शम् pleasure, भल to describe, अच् and ङीष् affs.
37740: शम्भु m. (-म्भुः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 A Jina or Jaina sanctified teacher. 4 A Siddha, a demi-divine being. 5 A sage, a venerable man. 9 A kind of Asclepias. E. शम् auspicious particle, भू to be, डु aff.
37741: शम्भुतनय m. (-यः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 GAṆEŚA. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, and तनय son.
37742: शम्भुनन्दन m. (-नः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, and नन्दन son.
37743: शम्भुप्रिया f. (-या) Emblic myrobalan. 2 An epithet of DURGĀ. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, and प्रिया beloved.
37744: शम्या f. (-म्या) 1 The pin of a yoke. 2 A sacrificial vessel. 3 A stick, a staff. E. शम to be kept quiet, य aff., fem. aff. टाप्.
37745: शम्यापात m. (-तः) The cast of a stick. E. शम्या, and पात alighting.
37746: शय mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं) Asleep, sleeping. m. (-यः) 1 A hand. 2 A snake, (Boa constrictor.) 3 Sleep, sleeping. 4 A bed, a couch. 5 Abuse, imprecation. E. शी to sleep, aff. घ, or टच् or अच्.
37747: शयण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) Asleep, sleeping. E. शी to sleep, अण्डच् Uṇādi aff.
37748: शयथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Asleep, sleeping. m. (-थः) 1 Death, dying. 2 A sort of snake, the Boa. E. शी to sleep, अथच् Uṇādi aff.
37749: शयन n. (-नं) 1 Sleep. 2 A bed, a couch. 3 Copulation. E. शी to sleep, ल्युट् aff.
37750: शयनगृह n. (-हं) A bed chamber. E. शयन, and गृह house.
37751: शयनागार m. (-रः) A bed chamber. E. शयन, and आगार house.
37752: शयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit for or suitable to sleep, to be slept on, &c. n. (-यं) A bed, a couch. E. शी to sleep, अनीयर् aff. of the future participle; also with कन् added शयनीयक n. (-कं)
37753: शयनैकादशी f. (-शी) The eleventh day of the light half of Āṣārha, on which VIṢṆU'S sleep commences. E. शयन, and एकादशी eleventh lunation.
37754: शयान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sleeping, asleep. E. शी to sleep, शानच् aff.
37755: शयानक m. (-कः) 1 A snake. 2 A chamæleon, a lizard. E. शी to sleep, आनक् Uṇādi aff.
37756: शयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Sleepy, slothful, sluggish. m. (-लुः) 1 A snake, the Boa. 2 A dog. 3 A Shakāl. E. शी to sleep, आलुच् aff.; implying disposition or habit.
37757: शयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asleep. m. (-तं) A plant, (Cordia myxa). n. (-तं) Sleep, sleeping. E. शी to sleep, aff. क्त.
37758: शयितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sleeping, asleep. E. शीङ् to sleep, क्तवतु aff.
37759: शयित्वा ind. Having slept. E. शी to sleep, क्त्वा aff.
37760: शयु m. (-युः) A large snake, (Boa.) E. शी to sleep, and उ Uṇādi aff.
37761: शयुन m. (-नः) A large kind of snake, (Boa.) E. शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. उनन्.
37762: शय्या f. (-य्या) 1 A bed, a couch, a sofa. 2 Tying in knots, stringing. E. शी to sleep, क्यप् aff., and अयङ् substituted for the vowel.
37763: शर m. (-रः) 1 A sort of reed or grass, (Saccharum sara.) 2 An arrow. 3 The upper part or cream of slightly curdled milk. 4 Mischief, injury, hurt. n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Versed sine of an arc. E. शॄ to hurt, aff. अप्, also सर.
37764: शरकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The stem of the Saccharum. 2 The shaft of an arrow. E. शर, and काण्ड stem.
37765: शरच्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The autumnal moon. E. शरट्, and चन्द्र moon.
37766: शरज n. (-जं) Butter made from new milk or milk one day old. E. शर cream, and ज born.
37767: शरजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शर a sort of grass, and जन्मन् birth: having been brought up in thickets of that grass.
37768: शरट m. (-टः) 1 A lizard, a chamæleon. 2 Safflower, the plant. E. शॄ to hurt, अटन् aff.; also सरट.
37769: शरण n. (-णं) 1 A house. 2 A preserver, a protector, what or who protects or preserves. 3 Preservation, protection, defence. 4 Killing, slaying. f. (-णी) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. श to injure, aff. ल्युट्.
37770: शरणागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Refugee, appellant, one who comes for protection or refuge. E. शरण protection, and आगत come.
37771: शरणापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Taken refuge. E. शरण, and आपन्न obtained.
37772: शरणार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Unfortunate, wretched, involved in calamity or ruin, and dependant on others for protection or aid. E. शरण protection, and अर्थिन् soliciting, requiring.
37773: शरणार्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, calamitous, distressed, ruined, (see the last.) E. शरण protection, aid, and अर्पक who causes to be afforded.
37774: शरणि mf. (-णिः-णी) A road, a path, a way. E. शॄ to hurt, अनि aff., more usually सरणि.
37775: शरणैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking for an asylum or protection. E. शरण, and एषिन् who wishes.
37776: शरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A lizard, a chamæleon. 3 A kind of ornament. 4 A rogue, a cheat. 5 A libertine, a lecher. E. शॄ to injure, (fruit, &c.) अण्डन् Uṇādi aff.; also सरण्ड.
37777: शरण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be protected or aided, poor, miserable, helpless. n. (-ण्यं) 1 A protection, a protector, that which or who affords refuge and defence. 2 A house. 3 Protection, defence. 4 Injury, hurt. E. शॄ to hurt, Uṇādi अन्य; or शरण protection, and यत् aff. of fitness.
37778: शरण्यु m. (-ण्युः) 1 A cloud. 2 Wind, air. 3 A protector, a defender. E. शॄ to injure, अन्यु aff.; also सरण्यु.
37779: शरत्कामिन् m. (-मी) A dog. E. शरट् autumn, and कामिन् desirous.
37780: शरत्काल n. (-लं) The autumnal season. E. शरत्, and काल time.
37781: शरत्कालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Autumnal. E. शरत्काल, and ख aff.
37782: शरत्पर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A festival, on the full moon of Āśvina, (September-October:) see कोजागर. E. शरट् autumn, and पर्व्वन् a holiday.
37783: शरद् f. (-रत् or रट्) 1 The season of autumn or the sultry season; the two months succeeding the rains; according to the Vaidikas, comprising the months Bhādra and Āśvina,  and according to the Paurāṇikas, Āśvina and Kārttika, fluctuating thus from August to November. 2 A year. E. शॄ to injure, अदि Uṇādi aff.; also with टाप् added शरदा.
37784: शरदा f. (-दा) 1 A year. 2 The sultry season. E. see the last.
37785: शरदिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Autumnal, produced in Śarat or the season of autumn. E. शरट् as above in the 7th case, and ज born.
37786: शरधि m. (-धिः) A quiver. E. शर an arrow, धा to have or contain, aff. कि.
37787: शरन्मुख n. (-खं) Commencement of the spring season. E. शरट्, and मुख beginning.
37788: शरपात m. (-तः) An arrow's fall or flight. E. शर, and पात alighting.
37789: शरपातस्थान n. (-नं) A bowshot, an arrow's flight. E. शरपात, and स्थान place.
37790: शरपुङ्खा f. (-ङ्खा) The feathers of an arrow. E. शर an arrow, and पुङ्ख the feathered part of it.
37791: शरफल n. (-लं) The blade or barb of an arrow. E. शर, and फल blade.
37792: शरभ m. (-भः) 1 A fabulous animal, supposed to have eight legs, and to inhabit particularly the snowy mountains. 2 A young elephant. 3 A monkey in RAMA'S army. 4 A camel. 5 A grasshopper. 6 A locust. E. श to injure, Uṇādi aff. अभच् or शर an arrow, भा to shine, aff. क.
37793: शरभू m. (-भूः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शर the grass, and भू born; being reared in this grass.
37794: शरमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or consisting of Śara grass, &c. E. शर the grass, and मयट् aff. implying in this and other compounds change of form for any purpose except food or clothing.
37795: शरमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A small bird, considered a sa variety of the SArika or Maina, (Turdus gosalica, BUC. Mss.) E. शर the Śara grass, and मल्ल to hold or occupy, aff. अङ्; some authorities have शरमन्द.
37796: शरयु f. (-युः-यू) The Seryu or Serjū river; it is preferably, and more usually written सरयु, q. v.
37797: शरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Upright, honest. 2 Crooked, fraudulent. m. (-लः) A tree, a sort of pine. E. सृ to go, कलच् aff.; and स changed to श; whence the word is preferably read सरल.
37799: शरलता f. (-ता) Uprightness, sincerity. E. तल् added to शरल; also with त्व, शरलत्व; also सरलता.
37800: शरव m. (-वः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A lid, a cover.
37801: शरवणोद्भव m. (-वः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शर saccharum, वन a thicket or jungle, and उद्भव born: see शरजन्मन्, &c.
37802: शरवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A flight or shower of arrows. E. शर, and वर्ष rain.
37803: शरवर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) Raining or shooting arrows. E. शर, and वर्षिन् showering.
37804: शरवाणि m. (-णिः) 1 The head of an arrow. 2 A foot soldier, an archer. 3 A maker of arrows. E. शर an arrow, वण to sound, aff. इन्.
37805: शरवृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A heavy fall or shower of arrows. E. शर, and वृष्टि rain.
37806: शरव्य n. (-व्यं) A mark, a butt. E. शरु a weapon, and यत् aff.
37807: शराघात m. (-तः) Shooting, (with a bow.) E. शर an arrow, and आघात striking.
37808: शराटि f. (-टि) A sort of bird, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. शर water or mischief, अट to go, aff. इन्; or from अत to go, शराति; and otherwise derived also शराडि and शरालि.
37809: शराडि f. (-डिः) A bird: see शरालि.
37810: शराति f. (-तिः) A bird: see शराटि, &c.
37811: शराभ्यास m. (-सः) Archery, practice with the bow and arrow. E. शर an arrow, अभ्यास exercise.
37812: शरारि f. (-रिः) A sort of bird, commonly the Āli or Śarāli, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. शर water or mischief, ऋ to go, aff. इ; also ल being substituted, शरालि, &c.
37813: शरारीमुखी f. (-खी) Scissars. E. शरारी, मुख mouth or beak, ङीष् aff.
37814: शरारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Mischievous, noxious, hurtful. E. शृ to hurt, आरु aff.
37815: शरारोप m. (-पः) A bow. E. शर an arrow, आरोप a receptacle.
37816: शरालि f. (-लिः-ली) Śarāli A kind of bird, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. शर an arrow, अल to be equal to, (in speed,) aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also शरारि, शराडि, शराटि, &c., and with कन् added, fem. form शरालिका.
37817: शराव m. (-वः) 1 A lid, a cover. 2 A shallow cup or dish. 3 A platter. 4 A measure equal to two Kuḍavas. E. शर mischief, (from it,) अव to preserve, aff. अण् or अच्.
37818: शरावती f. (-ती) A river so named. E. शर a sort of grass, मतुप् aff. fem. form, and the final of the first word made long.
37819: शराश्रय m. (-यः) A quiver. E. शर an arrow, and आश्रय receptacle.
37820: शरासन n. (-नं) 1 A bow. 2 Shooting arrows. E. शर an arrow, अस to throw, aff. ल्युट्.
37821: शराहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck by an arrow. E. शर, and आहत struck.
37822: शरिमन् m. (-मा) Bearing, bringing forth. E. शॄ to hurt, इमनिच् Uṇādi aff.
37823: शरीर n. (-रं) The body. E. शॄ to injure, to be injured, Uṇādi aff. ईरन्.
37824: शरीरक n. (-कं) 1 A small or delicate body. 2 The body. E. शरीर, and कन् diminutive, or pleonastic aff.
37825: शरीरकर्षण n. (-णं) Emaciating or afflicting the body. E. शरीर, and कर्षण attracting.
37826: शरीरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced by the body, &c. m. (-जः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 The deity KĀMA or love. 3 A son. E. शरीर the body, and ज born.
37827: शरीरजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born or produced of or from the body. E. शरीर, and जन्मन् birth.
37828: शरीरपाक m. (-कः) Decay, emaciation. E. शरीर, and पाक a ripening.
37829: शरीरबन्धक m. (-क) A hostage. E. शरीर, and बन्धक a pledge.
37830: शरीरभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Embodied, corporeal, having body. E. शरीर, and भाज् who shares.
37831: शरीरयात्रा f. (-त्रा) Subsistence, support. E. शरीर, and यात्रा going.
37832: शरीरयोग m. (-गः) Bodily union. E. शरीर, and योग union.
37833: शरीरशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Personal attendance. E. शरीर, and शुश्रूषा service.
37834: शरीरशोषण n. (-णं) 1 Drying up, withering. 2 Emaciating the body. E. शरीर, and शोषण drying.
37835: शरीरसंस्कार m. (-रः) Purification of the body by various ceremonies at conception, birth, initiation, death, &c. n. (-रं) Decoration or adorning the person. E. शरीर, and संस्कार making perfect.
37836: शरीरावरण n. (-णं) The skin. E. शरीर the body, and आवरण enclosing.
37837: शरीरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Embodied, corporeal, having body. m. (-री) An animal or sentient being. n. (-रि) Life or soul connected with the body, or incorporate. E. शरीर body, and इनि aff.
37838: शरु m. (-रुः) 1 Passion, anger. 2 The thunderbolt of INDRA. 3 An arrow. 4 Any weapon. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. उ.
37839: शरेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The mango tree. E. शर an arrow, and इष्ट desired; the blossoms of the mango being amongst those which tip the darts of CUPID.
37840: शर्करा f. (-रा) 1 A potsherd, the fragment of a broken pot. 2 A stony nodule, or gravel. 3 A soil or spot abounding in stony or gritty fragments. 4 Clayed or candid sugar. 5 A part, a piece. 6 Gravel, (the disease.) E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. करन्.
37841: शर्कराप्रभा f. (-भा) The hell of gravel according to the Jainas, the second division of Tartarus. E. शर्करा gravel, and प्रभा illustrious.
37842: शर्करावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Gritty, gravelly, full of stony particles. E. शर्करा gravel, and मतुप् aff.
37843: शर्करिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Stony, gravelly. E. शर्क्करा gravel, &c., and ठञ् aff.
37844: शर्करिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in stony or gravelly particles, (a spot, a place.) E. शर्करा gravel, and इलच् aff.
37845: शर्घ r. 1st cl. (शर्घति) To wound or kill.
37846: शर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) Farting, a fart. E. शृध to fart, aff. घञ्.
37847: शर्द्धञ्जह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Causing flatulence. m. (-हः) Any leguminous grain or pulse, as beans, &c. E. शर्द्ध farting, and हा to let go or loose, aff. खश्.
37848: शर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (शर्ब्बति) 1 To go. 2 To hurt, to injure.
37849: शर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring prosperity, making happy, propitious. E. शर्म्मन्, and द who or what gives.
37850: शर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Happy, glad. n. (-र्म्म) Happiness, pleasure. m. (-र्म्मा) A name or appellation common to and proper for Brahmans. E. शॄ to injure or destroy, (ill fortune,) मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
37851: शर्म्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Lucky, auspicious. E. शर्म्मन्, and मतुप् aff.
37852: शर्म्मर m. (-रः) A sort of garment or cloth. f. (-रा) A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.) E. शर्म्म pleasure, रा to give, aff. क.
37853: शर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Night. E. शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
37854: शर्व्व r. 1st cl. (शर्व्वति) To hurt, to injure or kill.
37855: शर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) ŚIVA. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. व; also सर्व.
37856: शर्व्वरी f. (-री) 1 Night. 2 A woman. 3 Turmeric. E. शॄ to injure, अरच् Uṇādi aff.
37857: शर्व्वला f. (-ला or ली) An iron crow. E. शर्व to go, कलच् aff.; also सर्व्वला.
37858: शर्व्वाणी f. (-णी) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. शर्व्व ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment; the wife of SARVA; also सर्वाणी.
37859: शर्व्वरीक m. (-कः) 1 A low or vile man, a rogue, a wretch. 2 A cruel or mischievous man. E. शॄ to injure, ईकन् Uṇādi aff., रक् augment, and the root repeated.
37860: शल r. 1st cl. (शलते) 1 To move, to shake, to tremble or stir. 2 To cover. (-शलति) To go, to move to or towards. r. 10th cl. (शालयति) To praise.
37861: शल mn. (-लः-लं) The quill of a porcupine. m. (-लः) 1 A name of BHṚṄGI, ŚIVA'S attendant. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 A kind of field. 4 A dart, a spear. 5 A stake. E. शल to go, aff. अच्.
37862: शलक m. (-कः) A spider. E. शल to go, aff. वुन्.
37863: शलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A king. 2 A sort of salt. E. शल to go, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्.
37864: शलभ m. (-भः) 1 A grasshopper. 2 A locust. E. शल to go, अभच् Uṇādi aff.: see शरभ.
37865: शलल nf. (-लं-ली) The quill of a porcupine. E. शल to go, to project, aff. कलच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
37866: शलाका f.
