(-का) 1 A javelin, a dart. 2 An arrow. 3 A porcupine. 4 The rib of an umbrella, the bar of a cage, &c. or any such small stake, rod, peg, or pin: it is applied also in common use, to a thin slip of bambu, serving when tipped with sulphur for a match; to a round pointed piece of wood or bambu serving as a toothpick, to a similar piece employed as a tent or probe, or to a larger one used as a ruler, &c. 5 A bone. 6 An oblong quadrangular piece of ivory or bone used in playing a particular game, a domino. 7 A fibrous stick used as a brush or pencil. 8 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 9 The Sārika, (Turdus Gosalica, BUC.) E. शल to go, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.
37867: शलाकापरि ind. Beat at a game played with pieces of stick. E. शलाका a match, &c., and परि implying in this and similar compounds, reverse.
37868: शलाकापुरुष m. plu. (-षाः) Sixty-three persons considered by the Jainas as sacred and divine, viz. the 24 Jinas, 12 Cakravartīs, 9 Vāsudevas, 9 Baladevas, and 9 Prativāsudevas.
37869: शलाट m. (-टः) A cart load, considered as twenty times one hundred Palas. E. शॄ to injure, aff. आटन्, and the र changed to ल.
37870: शलाटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Unripe, moist, (as fruit.) m. (-टुः) A kind of root. E. शल to go, आटु aff.
37872: शलालु n. (-लु) A sort of perfume.
37873: शलालुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Purchased with or procured for the substance termed Śalālu. E. शलालु as above, and ष्टन् aff.; also with ठक् aff. शालालुक, &c.
37874: शल्क n. (-ल्कं) 1 A part, a portion. 2 Bark, rind. 3 The scale of a fish. E. शल to go, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
37875: शल्कल n. (-लं) 1 The scale of a fish. 2 Bark, rind. E. शल to go, कलच् aff.
37876: शल्कलिन् m. (-ली) A fish. E. शल्कल a scale, and इनि aff.
37877: शल्किन् m. (-ल्की) A fish. E. शल्क a scale, and इनि aff.
37878: शल्भ r. 1st cl. (शल्भते) 1 To praise, to flatter or coax. 1 To talk, to boast.
37879: शल्मलि mf. (-लिः-ली) The silk-cotton tree: see शाल्मलि.
37880: शल्य mn. (-ल्यः-ल्यं) A dart, a javelin. n. (-ल्यं) 1 A bambu rod or stake. 2 Any stake or thorn. 3 An arrow. 4 An iron crow. 5 Sin, crime. 6 Difficulty, embarrassment, distress. 7 An arrow, a thorn, or other extraneous substance which has lodged in the body. 8 Abuse, defamation. 9 Poison. m. (-ल्यः) 1 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 2 A porcupine. 3 A hedgehog. 4 A peg, a pin, &c. 5 A boundary. 6 A king, the maternal uncle of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. शल to go, aff. यत् or य Uṇādi aff.
37881: शल्यक m. (-कः) 1 A stake, a thorn. 2 A dart, a pike. 3 A porcupine. 4 A hedgehog. 5 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. शल्य as above, and कन् added.
37882: शल्यकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A porcupine. E. शल्य a stake, and कण्ठ the throat.
37883: शल्यक्रिया f. (-या) The extraction of extraneous substances lodged in the body. E. शल्य, and क्रिया act.
37884: शल्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Shooting arrows. 2 Set with stakes. 3 Harassed with difficulties, &c. E. शल्य, and मतुप् aff.
37885: शल्यवारङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The part by which an arrow or the like lodged in the body is to be laid hold of for its extraction. E. शल्य, and वारङ्ग the place of seizure.
37886: शल्यशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) That part of Surgery which treats of the extraction of extraneous substances lodged in the body. E. शल्य, and शास्त्र science.
37887: शल्यारि m. (-रिः) YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. शल्य the prince, and अरि an enemy.
37888: शल्योद्धार m. (-रः) 1 Extraction of foreign substances from the body. 2 Cleansing or purifying a new house. E. शल्य, and उद्घार taking out or away.
37889: शल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A frog. n. (-ल्लं) Bark, rind. E. शल to go, लच् aff.
37890: शल्लक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) n. (-कं) Bark, rind. f. (-की) 1 A porcupine. 2 The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. शल to go, aff. क्वुन्, deriv. irr.
37891: शल्लकीद्रव m. (-वः) Incense, Olibanum. E. शल्लकी the Boswellia thurifera, and द्रव exudation.
37892: शल्व m. (-ल्वः) A country so named in the north of India. E. शल to go, क्वन् aff., more usually शाल्व.
37893: शव r. 1st cl. (शवति) 1 To go or approach. 2 To alter, to change.
37894: शव mn. (-वः-वं) A dead body, a corpse. n. (-वं) Water. E. शव to go, अच् aff.
37895: शवकाम्य m. (-म्यः) A dog. E. शव a corpse, and काम्य desirous.
37896: शवदाह m. (-हः) Burning a corpse. E. शव, and दाह burning.
37897: शवदाहिन् m. (-ही) A person who burns a corpse. E. शव, and दाहिन् who burns.
37898: शवयान n. (-नं) The litter or bed on which a dead body is carried to be burnt. E. शव a corpse, and यान a vehicle.
37899: शवर m. (-रः) 1 A barbarian, one inhabiting the mountainous districts of India, and wearing the feathers of the peacock, &c. as decorations. 2 Water. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 The hand. 5 A Śāstra, a sacred treatise. E. शव a corpse, रा to take, aff. क and टाप्.
37900: शवराल m. (-लः) A sort of Lodh.
37901: शवरालय m. (-यः) The abode of an outcaste or low tribe. E. शवर a barbarian, and आलय abode.
37902: शवरावास m. (-सः) The abode of an outcaste or barbarous tribe. E. शवर a barbarian, and आवास abode.
37903: शवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Variegated, of a variegated colour. 2 Imitative. 3 Articulate. m. (-लः) A variegated colour. f. (-ला-ली) 1 A brindled cow. 2 The cow of plenty, KĀMADHENU. n. (-लं) 1 Water. 2 A religious observance peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. शव to curse, कल aff., and प changed to व.
37904: शवलता f. (-ता) Variegation, variety of colour. E. शवल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शवलत्वं.
37905: शवलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated. E. शवल, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
37906: शवसाधन n. (-नं) A mystical and magical ceremony performed with a dead body. E. शव, and साधन implement.
37907: शवसान m. (-नः) A traveller, (in the dialect of the Vedas.) n. (-नं) A cemetery. E. शव to go, with असानच् aff.
37908: शश r. 1st cl. (शशति) To jump, to leap, to move by springing or leaping.
37909: शश m. (-शः) 1 A hare or rabbit. 2 The Lodh tree, (Symplocos racemosa.) 3 Gum myrrh. 4 A man of mild and virtuous character, but uxorious and woman-led, one of the four characters in which men are classed by erotic writers. 5 The spots on the moon, supposed to resemble the figure of a hare. E. शश to go by leaps or jumps, aff. अच.
37910: शशक m. (-कः) A hare. E. कन् added to the last.
37911: शशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Leaping, jumping. E. शश to leap, शतृ aff.
37912: शशधर m. (-रः) The moon. E. शश a hare, and धर having; either as an emblem on his banners, or fancifully, as the spots on the moon's face.
37913: शशप्लुतक n. (-कं) A mark or scratch of the finger nail. E. शश a hare, प्लुतक jumping.
37914: शशबिन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 VIṢṆU, or KṚṢṆA. 2 A sovereign. 3 The moon. E. शश a bare, and बिन्दु a spot.
37915: शशभृत् m. (-भृत्) The moon. E. शश a hare, and भृत् who cherishes: see शशधर.
37916: शशमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) As large as or of the size of a hare. E. शश, and मात्रच् aff.
37917: शशलाञ्छन m. (-नः) The moon. E. शश, and लाञ्छन mark.
37918: शशलोमन् n. (-म) The skin of the hare or rabbit. E. शश a hare or rabbit, and लोमन् hair.
37919: शशविषाण n. (-णं) The horn of a hare; any thing improbable or extraordinary. E. शश, and विषाण a horn.
37920: शशस्थली f. (-ली) The Doab, the country between the Ganges and Yamunā rivers. E. शश a hare, स्थल place, site.
37921: शशाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The moon. E. शश a hare, and अङ्क a mark or spot.
37922: शशाङ्कलेखा f. (-खा) A digit of the moon. E. शशाङ्क, and लेखा a streak.
37923: शशादन m. (-नः) A hawk or falcon. E. शश a hare or rabbit, and अदन what eats.
37924: शशिदेव m. (-वः) A sovereign, named also रन्तिदेव.
37925: शशिन् m. (-शी) 1 The moon. 2 The emblem of one of the Jinas. E. शश a hare, इनि aff.
37926: शशिपाद m. (-दः) A moon-beam. E. शशि, and पाद a ray; also similar compounds, as शशिकर, शशिकिरण, शशिमयूख, शशिरश्मि, &c.
37927: शशिप्रभ n. (-भं) The white esculent water-lily. f. (-भा) Moonlight. E. शशि the moon, and प्रभ shining, (blossoming,) or प्रभा lustre, light.
37928: शशिलेखा f. (-खा) 1 A digit of the moon. 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 A metre, a variety of the line of the Atijagatī stanza of thirteen syllables, or of the Atisaceari of fifteen syllables. E. शशि the moon, and लेखा a line or mark.
37929: शशिवदना f. (-ना) 1 A woman with a face like the moon. 2 A species of the Gāyatrī metre. E. शशि, and वदन face.
37930: शशिशेखर m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 One of the Jaina pontiffs. E. शशि the moon, and शेखर a crest.
37931: शशीश m. (-शः) A name of ŚIVA. E. शशि, and ईश lord.
37932: शशोर्ण n. (-र्णं) The hair of the hare or rabbit. E. शश a hare, &c., and ऊर्णा wool.
37933: शश्वत् ind. Again and again, frequently, repeatedly, perpetually. E. शश to go by jumps, वति aff.
37934: शष r. 1st cl. (-शषति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
37935: शष्कुल m. (-लः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.) f. (-ली) 1 The outer ear or opening of the external auditory passage. 2 Rice or barley water, &c. 3 A sort of pie.
37936: शष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Young grass. 2 Loss of intellect or confidence. E. शस to hurt, Uṇādi aff. प, and स changed to ष; also शस्य.
37937: शस (इ) and the preposition आङ् always prefixed आशसि r. 1st cl. (आशंसते) 1 To bless, to wish good to, to confer a benediction. 2 To wish, to desire. 3 To speak. (उ) शसु r. 1st cl. (शसति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. With अभि, To intreat.
37938: शसन n. (-नं) Immolation, offering an animal in sacrifice. E. शस to hurt, aff. ल्युट्; also शमन.
37939: शस्त (इ) शस्ति r. 2nd cl. (शंस्ति) To sleep, (peculiar to the Vedas.)
37940: शस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Happy, well, right. 2 Praised, eulogised. 3 Best, excellent. n. (-स्तं) 1 Happiness, excellence. 2 The body. E. शस to bless, aff. क्त.
37941: शस्तक n. (-कं) A defence for the finger of an archer. E. कन् added to the last.
37942: शस्तकेशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having much or beautiful hair. E. शस्त excellent, केश hair, कन् aff.
37943: शस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 A weapon in general. 2 Iron. 3 Steel. m. (-स्त्रः) A sword, a scymitar. f. (-स्री) A knife. E. शस to hurt, aff. ष्ट्रन.
37944: शस्त्रक n. (-कं) 1 Iron. 2 Steel. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and कन् aff.
37945: शस्त्रकार m. (-रः) An armourer. E. शस्त्र, and कार who makes.
37946: शस्त्रग्रह m. (-हः) Taking arms. E. शस्त्र, and ग्रह taking.
37947: शस्त्रग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A man armed. E. शस्त्र, and ग्राहिन् who takes
37948: शस्त्रघुष्टकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Clanging. E. शस्त्र, and धुष्ट sounded, कर what makes.
37949: शस्त्रजाल n. (-लं) A quantity of weapons. E. शस्त्र, and जाल a heap.
37950: शस्त्रजीविन् m. (-वी) A soldier by profession. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and जीविन् who lives by.
37951: शस्त्रत्याग m. (-गः) Throwing away a weapon. E. शस्त्र, and त्याग abandoning.
37952: शस्त्रधर m. (-रः) An armed man or soldier. E. शस्त्र, and धर who has.
37953: शस्त्रपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) A warrior armed, having weapons in the hand. E. शस्र, and पाणि the hand.
37954: शस्त्रपात m. (-तः) The stroke of a weapon. E. शस्र, and पात falling.
37955: शस्त्रपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified by arms, absolved from guilt by dying in the field of battle. E. शस्र, and पूत purified.
37956: शस्त्रप्रहरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Taking arms. E. शस्र, and प्रहरण taking.
37957: शस्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) An armed man, a soldier. E. शस्र a weapon, and भृत् having.
37958: शस्त्रमार्ज m. (-र्जः) An armourer. E. शस्र a weapon, and भाज cleaning.
37959: शस्त्रवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A soldier, a man at arms. E. शस्र, and वृत्ति profession.
37960: शस्त्रसंहति f. (-तिः) 1 A quantity or number of weapons. 2 An arsenal, an armoury. E. शस्र, and संहति assemblage.
37961: शस्त्रसमूह n. (-हं) 1 A quantity or number of weapons. 2 An arsenal, an armoury. E. शस्र, and ममूह a heap.
37962: शस्त्रहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck or killed by a weapon. E. शस्र, and हत hurt.
37963: शस्त्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) A man carrying arms. E. शस्र a weapon, and हस्त the hand.
37964: शस्त्राजीव m. (-वः) A soldier. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and आजीव who lives by.
37965: शस्त्राभ्यास m. (-सः) Military exercise or practice. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and अभ्यास practice.
37966: शस्त्रास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Use of weapons. E. शस्त्र, and अस्त्र a weapon, or means of offence or defence.
37967: शस्त्रास्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A soldier, a warrior. E. शस्त्रास्त्र, and भृत who has.
37968: शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The military profession, the use of arms. E. शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्, and त्व aff.
37969: शस्त्रिन् mfn. (-स्त्री-स्त्रिणी-स्त्रि) Armed, having weapons. E. शस्त्र, and इनि aff.
37970: शस्त्रोत्थापन n. (-नं) Raising a weapon, (as to strike.) E. शस्त्र, and उत्थापन taking up.
37971: शस्त्रोद्यम m. (-मः) Lifting up a weapon, (as to strike.) E. शस्त्र, and उद्यम lifting up.
37972: शस्त्रोपजीविन् m. (-वी) A soldier, a man at arms. E. शस्त्र, and उपजीविन् living by.
37973: शस्प n. (-स्पं) 1 Young grass. 2 Loss of confidence or understanding. E. शस to injure, प aff., and the sibilant unchanged.
37974: शस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 Excellent, best. 2 To be hurt or injured. 3 Desirable, to be wished. n. (-स्यं) 1 Fruit. 2 Corn, grain in general. 3 Good quality, merit. E. शस to hurt, aff. यत्; or शसि to wish, क्यप् aff.
37975: शस्यक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) A corn field. E. शस्य, and क्षेत्र a field.
37976: शस्यध्वंशिन् m. (-शी) A timber tree, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna.) E. शस्य fruit, and ध्वंसिन् injurious.
37977: शस्यभक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Graminivorous. E. शस्य, and भक्षक what eats.
37978: शस्यभक्षण n. (-णं) Feeding upon grain. E. शस्य, and भक्षण eating.
37979: शस्यमञ्जरी f. (-री) 1 The ear or spike of corn. 2 The fruit stalk. E. शस्य, and मञ्जरी pedicle.
37980: शस्यरक्षक m. (-कः) A watchman over a field of corn. E. शस्य, and रक्षक who protects.
37981: शस्यशूक n. (-कं) The beard of corn. E. शस्य corn, and शूक beard.
37982: शस्यसम्बर m. (-रः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. शस्य fruit, and सम्बर surrounding.
37983: शस्यारु m. (-रुः) A small variety of the Mimosa suma.
37984: शांशप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Made of Śiśu wood, &c. E. शिंशपा the Śiśu, अण् aff., and आङ् substituted for the first vowel.
37985: शाक mn. (-कः-कं) A potherb in general, any leaf, flower, fruit, stalk, root, &c. used as a vegetable. m. (-कः) 1 One of the seven Dvīpas or divisions of the world; the sixth, surrounded by the sea of milk or white sea. 2 Power, strength. 3 The Sirisha tree, (Acacia sirisa.) 4 The Teak tree, (Tectona grandis.) 5 An era, a period usually commencing with some celebrated prince, as YUDHIṢṬHIRA, VIKRAMĀDITYA, ŚĀLIVĀHANA, &c. thence denominated ŚĀKEŚVARAS, &c.; the term in ordinary use is applied especially to the era of ŚĀLIVĀHANA, commencing 76 or 78 years after the Christian era. E. शक to be able, घञ् aff.
37986: शाकट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) Relating to a cart, (a cart-load, a carthorse, &c.) m. (-टः) A draught ox. E. शकट a cart, अण् aff.
37987: शाकटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going in or on a cart. E. शकट a cart, and ठक् aff.
37988: शाकटीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Belonging or relating to a cart. m. (-नः) A cart-load as a measure of weight or value. E. शकट a cart, ख aff.
37989: शाकतरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.) E. शाक a potherb, and तरु a tree.
37990: शाकपण m. (-णः) A handful or similar quantity, as a measure of potherbs. E. शाक, and पण price.
37991: शाकरी f. (-री) One of the dialects of dramatic Prākṛta, that spoken by the Sakāra. E. शकार, अण् and ङीष् aff.
37992: शाकवालेय m. (-यः) A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi; also वालेयशाक.
37993: शाकम्भरी f. (-री) 1 DURGĀ. 2 A city, supposed to be the modern Sāmbher. E. शाक a potherb, भृ to nourish, aff. खश्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
37994: शाकम्भरीय n. (-यं) A fossile salt brought from a lake in the vicinity of Sāmbher, a town in Ajmere. E. शाकम्भरी the city, and छ aff.
37995: शाकलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having a piece or part. E. शकल a part, ठञ् aff.
37996: शाकविल्व m. (-ल्वः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. शाक a potherb, विल्व the Bel fruit; also with कन् added शाकविल्वक.
37997: शाकवीर m. (-रः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. शाक a potherb, and वीर eminent.
37998: शाकवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Teak tree. E. शाक the same, and वृक्ष a tree.
37999: शाकशाकट n. (-टं) A field of vegetables, a kitchen garden. E. शाक a potherb, and शाकट aff. in this sense.
38000: शाकशाकिन n. (-नं) A field cultivated for esculent plants, a field of vegetables, a kitchen garden. E. शाक a vegetable, and शाकिन aff. in this sense.
38001: शाकश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. शाक a potherb, and श्रेष्ठ best.
38002: शाकाख्य m. (-ख्यः) The Teak tree. E. शाक the same, and आख्या appellation.
38003: शाकाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Pepper. E. शाक a potherb, and अङ्ग a part.
38004: शाकिनी f. (-नी) A female divinity of an inferior character, attendant especially on ŚIVA and DURGĀ.
38006: शाकुन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Of or relating to birds. 2 Ominous, portentous. E. शाकुन, and अण् aff.
38007: शाकुनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to birds, omens, &c. m. (-कः) A fowler, a bird-catcher. n. (-कं) Interpretation of omens, dreams, &c. E. शकुन a bird, and ठञ् aff.
38008: शाकुन्तलेय m. (-मः) BHARATA, the sovereign of India. E. शकुन्तला the nymph, and ढक् aff.; being the son of ŚAKUNTALĀ and DUṢYANTA.
38009: शाकुलिक m. (-कः) A fisherman. E. शकुल a fish, and ठक् aff.
38010: शाक्कर m. (-रः) An ox. n. (-रं) A form of metre. E. शक्कर, and अञ् aff.
38011: शाक्त m. (-क्तः) A worshipper of the female principle. E. शक्ति the divine energy in its feminine personification, and अण् aff.
38012: शाक्तीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Speared, spearing, relating to or done with a spear. m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer. E. शक्ति a spear, aff. ईकक्.
38013: शाक्त्य m. (-क्त्यः) A worshipper of the female principle or Śakti. E. शक्ति the personified energy of a divinity, and यञ् aff.
38014: शाक्य m. (-क्यः) 1 BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion. 2 The name of a tribe. E. शक to be able, ण्यत् aff.
38015: शाक्यमुनि m. (-निः) A name of BUDDHA, the real or supposed founder of the Bauddha religion. E. शाक्य said to be the name of a family or tribe, originating with one of the race of Ikṣvāku, condemned to take up his abode in a forest of Sāka trees, and मुनि a saint.
38016: शाक्यसिंह m. (-हः) A name of BUDDHA. E. शाक्य the name of his tribe, and सिंह chief.
38017: शाख (ऋ) शाखृ r. 1st cl. (शाखते) To pervade.
38018: शाख m. (-खः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea.) f. (-खा) 1 A branch, the branch of a tree. 2 A branch or subdivision of the Vedas, consisting of the several Saṃhitās or collections of prayers in each Veda, as received in different schools, modified more or less either in the arrangement of the whole text, or in particular portions of it. 3 An arm. 4 A sect, a faction, a party. 5 Any subdivision. 6 Any part of an animal not endowed with sensibility, as a horn, &c. E. शाख to pervade, aff. अच्.
38019: शाखानगर n. (-रं) A suburb. E. शाखा a branch or subdivision, and नगर a city.
38020: शाखापुर n. (-रं) A suburb. E. शाखा a branch, and पुर a city.
38021: शाखाभेद m. (-दः) Difference of school or doctrine. E. शाखा, and भेद difference.
38022: शाखामृग m. (-गः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 A squirrel. E. शाखा the branch of a tree, and मृग a deer.
38023: शाखारण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A Brahman who has changed his Śākhā or peculiar school of the Vedas for another. E. शाखा a branch of the Vedas, रम to sport, ड aff.
38024: शाखाशिफा f. (-फा) A root proceeding from a branch, as in the Indian fig, the branches of which shoot downwards to the ground and take fresh root there. E. शाखा a branch, and शिफा a fibrous root.
38025: शाखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Branched, branching, having branches, (literally or figuratively.) m. (-खी) 1 A tree. 2 A Veda. 3 An inhabitant of the northern districts bordering on India,  a Turk or Tartar. 4 The name of a king. E. शाखा a branch, aff. इनि.
38026: शाखोट m. (-टः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera;) also with कन् added शाखोटकः.
38027: शाख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Branching, ramifying. E. शाखा a branch, (literally or figuratively,) and य aff.
38028: शाङ्कर m. (-रः) A bull. n. (-रं) A form of metre. E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and अण् aff.; also read शाक्कर.
38029: शाङ्करि m. (-रिः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 GAṆEŚA. 3 Fire. 4 A Muni. E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and इञ् patronymic aff.
38030: शाङ्कुची f. (-ची) The scate fish; also शंकुची, &c.
38031: शाङ्ख n. (-ङ्खं) The sound of the conch shell. E. शङ्ख the shell, and अण् aff.
38032: शाङ्खिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made from, relating to, &c. the Śaṅkha or conch. m. (-कः) 1 A shell cutter, a worker in shells. 2 A player on the Śaṅkha, a shell blower. E. शङ्ख the conch shell, and ठक् aff.
38034: शाटक mn. (-कः-कं) A petticoat. E. शट to go, (round the limbs,) ण्वुल् aff.
38035: शाटी mf. (-टः-टी) A petticoat. E. शट to praise or flatter, to go, &c. aff. ण, fem. aff. ङीष्.
38036: शाट्य n. (-ट्यं) Wickedness, villainy. E. शठ wicked, ष्यञ् aff.
38037: शाड (ऋ) शाडृ r. 1st cl. (शाडते) 1 To flatter, to praise, to coax. 2 To boast. 3 To float or swim.
38038: शाड्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in fresh grass, green, verdant. E. शाद young grass, ड्वलच् aff., and the final changed, also शाड्वल.
38039: शाण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Made of or from Bengal flax or Śaṇa. mf. (-णः-णी) 1 A touchstone. 2 A whet or grindstone. 3 A weight of four Māṣas. 4 A saw. n. (-णं) Coarse cloth, sack cloth, canvas. f. (-णी) 1 Ragged or torn raiment. 2 A new unseamed and single breadth of cloth, given to the religious student at his investiture for his upper garment. 3 A ragged garment given to the Jaina ascetic at his initiation. 4 A small tent or screen, used especially as a retiring room for actors, and tumblers, &c. 5 Gesture, gesticulation, making signs with the hands or eyes, &c. E. शण to give, aff. घञ्; or शो to sharpen, and ण aff.; or शण Saṇ, and अण् aff. of derivation.
38040: शाणाजीव m. (-वः) An armourer. E. शाण a whetstone, आजीव who lives by.
38041: शाणि m. (-णिः) A plant from the fibres of which a coarse cloth is prepared, (Corchorus olitorius.) E. शण Bengal Śaṇ, and ईञ् aff. implying descent or resemblance.
38042: शाण्डिल्य m. (-ल्यः) 1 A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) 2 A Muni from whom one of the three principal families of the Kanouj or Kanyākubja Brahmans is said to be descended. 3 A form of AGNI or fire. E. शण्डिल a saint, यञ् aff. of descent, &c.
38043: शात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Happy, well, prosperous. 2 Feeble, thin. 3 Sharpened, whetted, sharp. 4 Handsome, bright. n. (-तं) Joy, pleasure, happiness. E. शो to reduce or diminish, aff. क्त.
38044: शातकुम्भ n. (-म्भं) Gold. m. (-म्भः) A plant, (Nerium odorum.) E. शतकुम्भ said to be the name of a mountain, and अण् aff. implying production.
38045: शातकौम्भ n. (-म्भं) Gold. E. अण् pleonasm, added to the last.
38046: शातन n. (-नं) Withering, decaying, becoming thin or small. E. शो to wither, aff. ल्युट्, form irr.
38047: शातपत्रकी f. (-की) Moonlight. E. शतपत्र a lotus, कन् added, and अण् aff.
38048: शातमन्यव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to INDRA. E. शतमन्यु, and अण् aff.
38049: शातमान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Bought with the measure of one hundred. E. शत a hundred, मान measure, and अण् aff.
38050: शातशिख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Sharp pointed, (as the nails, &c.) E. शात, and शिखा crest.
38051: शातोदरी f. (-री) A woman with a small belly or waist. E. शात, and उदर the belly, ङीप् aff.
38052: शात्रव m. (-वः) An enemy. n. (-वं) 1 Enmity, hostility. 2 A multitude of enemies. E. शत्रु an enemy, and अण् pleonasm, or aff. of quality or number.
38053: शात्रवीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Hostile, inimical, belonging or relating to an enemy. E. शात्रव, and छ aff.
38054: शाद m. (-दः) 1 Mud. 2 Young grass. E. शो to wither, द Uṇādi aff.
38055: शादहरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Green or fresh with young grass. E. शाद young grass, and हरित green
38056: शाद्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in fresh or green grass. E. शाद young grass, द्वलच् aff.
38057: शान r. 1st cl. intensitive form (शिशांसति-ते) To whet, to sharpen.
38058: शान m. (-नः) 1 A touchstone. 2 A grindstone. f. (-नी) A sort of cucumber. E. शो to make small or sharpen, aff. ल्युट्. also शाण.
38059: शान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Calm, tranquil, pacified. 2 Allayed, alleviated. 3 Meek, humble. 4 Purified, cleansed, freed from, (as soil.) 5 Stilled, hushed, (as wind, &c.) m. (-न्तः) 1 An ascetic, one whose passions are subdued and who is engrossed by meditating on the deity. 2 One of the Rasas or conditions of feeling, delineated in poetry or the drama, tranquillity or tranquil devotion, quietism, the assiduous exercise of meditation, &c. and indifference to all objects of pleasure or pain. n. (-न्तं) Appeasing, pacifying. ind. (शान्तम) A prohibitive particle or interjection, implying negation, aversion, disgust, (fie! for shame! Heaven forbid!) E. शम to be appeased, aff. क्त.
38060: शान्तचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ता-तः) Composed, calm, unanxious. E. शान्त, and चेतस् mind.
38061: शान्तता f. (-ता) Quietness, calmness, meekness. E. शान्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शान्तत्वं.
38062: शान्तनव m. (-वः) BHĪṢMA, the reputed great uncle of the Pāṇḍavas. E. शान्तनु a prince, and अण् aff. of descent.
38063: शान्तनु m. (-नुः) The 21st sovereign of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the father of BHĪṢMA by Gaṅgā, or the Ganges personified. E. शं good fortune, (personified,) तनु the body, and the first vowel made long by special rule.
38064: शान्तमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Exempt from soil, literally or figuratively. E. शान्त cleansed, and मल dirt.
38065: शान्तरय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Slackened in speed. E. शान्त, and रय rapidity.
38066: शान्तविवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Reconciled, appeased. E. शान्त, and विवाद dispute.
38067: शान्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Calm, composed, of resigned or composed spirit. E. शान्त, and आत्मन् self.
38068: शान्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Extinguished, put or gone out. E. शान्त, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
38069: शान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Quiet, tranquillity, stoicism, the absence of passion, and indifference to objects of pleasure or pain; it is especially applied to the tranquillity of devotion, or quietism, by which the mind is wholly fixed on the subject of its meditation or worship, and is utterly disregardless of external impressions. 2 Good fortune, auspiciousness, felicity. 3 Rest, repose. 4 Expiatory or propitiatory rites to avert any evil. 5 Preliminary ceremonies to avert inauspicious accidents at any religious celebration. 6 Remission, alleviation. m. (-न्तिः) 1 The sixteenth Jina or Jaina deified sage of the present era. 2 One of the Jaina emperors of the universe. E. शम to be appeased, aff. क्तिन्.
38070: शान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Propitiatory, expiatory. 2 Producing ease or quiet, &c. 3 Relating to quiet, &c. E. शान्ति and ठक् aff.
38071: शान्तिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Tranquillising, calming, appeasing, &c. E. शान्ति, and कर who or what makes.
38072: शान्तिकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्री-र्त्तृ) Conferring tranquillity, calming, appeasing. m. (-र्त्ता) Any divinity who averts evil. E. शान्ति, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
38073: शान्तिकाम m. (-मः) Desire of tranquillity and exemption from calamity. E. शान्ति peace, and काम desire.
38074: शान्तिगृह n. (-हं) A private apartment near the place of sacrifice. E. शान्ति devotion, गृह a house.
38075: शान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Tranquillising, calming, allaying. E. शान्ति, and द who or what gives.
38076: शान्तिहोम m. (-मः) Burnt offerings, to prevent or avert threatening or possible evils. E. शान्ति, and होम burnt offering.
38077: शान्त्युद n. (-दं) Water offered at sacrifices for propitiation. E. शान्ति, and उद water; also शान्त्युदकं.
38078: शान्त्युदकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A vessel holding lustral water. E. शान्त्युद, and कुम्भ a jar.
38079: शान्त्व r. 10th cl. (शान्त्वयति) To console, to comfort.
38080: शान्त्व n. (-न्त्वं) 1 Conciliation. 2 Comforting, consoling. E. शम to appease or allay (opposition), deriv. irr.; or शान्त्व to console, aff. अच्; also सान्त्व.
38082: शाप m. (-पः) 1 Oath, affirmation by oath or ordeal. 2 Curse, imprecation. 3 Abuse. E. शप to swear, aff. घञ्.
38083: शापग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Having incurred or suffering under a curse. E. शाप, and ग्रस्त seized.
38084: शापज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Arising from a curse, being the effect of one. E. शाप, and ज born.
38086: शापमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Freed from a curse. E. शाप, and मुक्त released.
38087: शापान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a curse or period of an imprecation. E. शाप, and अन्त end.
38088: शापास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) A Muni, a saint. E. शाप a curse, and अस्त्र a weapon; a curse denounced by such a personage, being formidable even to the deities.
38089: शापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sworn, made to take an oath. E. शप to swear, causal v., क्त aff.
38090: शापोद्धार m. (-रः) Deliverance from a curse or its effects. E. शाप, and उद्धार extricating.
38091: शाफरिक m. (-कः) A fisherman. E. शफर a kind of fish, put for any, and ठक् aff.
38092: शाब्द mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दी-ब्दं) 1 Sonorous, sounding. 2 Nominal, (as inflection.) f. (-ब्दी) SARASVATĪ, goddess of speech and eloquence. E. शब्द sound or a word, and अण् attributive aff.
38093: शाब्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to sounds or words. m. (-कः) A proficient in the senses and forms of nouns or words. E. शब्द a sound, and ठक् aff.
38094: शामन् n. (-म) Conciliation, appeasing, reconciling. E. शम to appease, aff. मनिन्, and the vowel made long; also शामन.
38095: शामन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Tranquillity, peace. E. शम to be pacified, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
38096: शामित्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Sacrificing. 2 Tying cattle. 3 A sacrificial vessel. E. शम to appease, इत्रन् aff.
38097: शाम्बरी f. (-री) A female juggler. E. शम्बर a demon, अण् added, and ङीष् fem. aff.
38098: शाम्बविक m. (-कः) A worker in shells. E. शम्बु, a shell, ठक् aff.
38099: शाम्बुक m. (-कः) A bivalve shell. E. अण् pleonasm added to शम्बु; also read शाम्बूक, &c.
38100: शाम्भव n. (-वः) 1 A sort of poison. 2 A worshipper of ŚIVA. The son of ŚAMBHU or ŚIVA. f. (-वी) PĀRVATĪ. E. शम्भु a name of ŚIVA, and अण् aff.
38101: शायक m. (-कः) 1 An arrow. 2 A sword. E. शो to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.; also सायक.
38102: शायिका f. (-का) Sleeping. E. शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.
38103: शायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lying down. E. शी to sleep, णिनि aff.
38104: शार r. 10th cl. (शारयति) 1 To be weak. 2 To weaken.
38105: शार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Variegated, (in colour,) 2 Yellow. m. (-रः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A piece or man at chess, backgammon, &c. 3 Hurting, injuring. 4 A mixture of blue and yellow, a green. 5 Spotting, variegating. f. (-री) Kuśa grass. E. शॄ to injure, अण् aff.
38106: शारङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of a variegated colour. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The Cātaka (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 2 A deer. 3 An elephant. 4 A bee. 5 A peacock. f. (-ङ्गी) A musical instrument, a stringed instrument played with a bow, a sort of fiddle. E. शार injuring or variegated, गम to go, or get, aff. खच्; more usually, सारङ्ग.
38107: शारता f. (-ता) 1 Variegation of colour. 2 Yellowness. E. तल added to शार.
38108: शारद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) 1 Modest, diffident. 2 New. 3 Produced in the sultry season. 4 Autumnal. m. (-दः) 1 A year. 2 Grain or rice ripening in the sultry season. 3 A sort of kidney bean, yellow Mūṅg. 4 Autumnal sickness. 5 Sunshine, (in autumn.) f. (-दा) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ. 2 A title of DURGĀ. 3 A musical instrument, a sort of lute or guitar. f. (-दी) A plant, (Jussieua repens.) 2 A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 3 Day of full  moon in the month Kārttika (October-November.) E. शरट् the autumn, and अण् aff.
38109: शारदिक n. (-कं) A particular obsequial ceremony, an annual or autumnal Śrāddha. m. (-कः) 1 Autumnal sickness. 2 Heat or sunshine in autumn. E. शारद autumn, and ठञ् aff.
38110: शारदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Autumnal. E. शारद, and इनि aff.
38111: शारदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Autumnal. E. शारद, and छ added.
38112: शारि m. (-रिः) 1 A piece or man at chess, draughts, Chauper, &c. 2 An elephant's housings or armour. 3 Fraud, trick. mf. (-रिः-री) A bird: see the next. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
38113: शारिका f. (-का) 1 A bird, the proper or hill Maina, (Gracula religiosa;) it is also applied to the small bird usually called Maina in Bengal, (Turdus salica, BUC.) of which several varieties are distinguished by the Hindus. 2 A bow or stick that may be used for playing the Vīṇā or any stringed instrument. E. शॄ to injure, aff. वुन्.
38114: शारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated, coloured. E. शार, and इतच् aff.
38115: शारिफल n. (-लं) A chequered cloth or table for playing draughts, &c. E. शारि a piece, फल fruit; also with कन् added शारिफलक mn. (-कः-कं.)
38116: शारिवा f. (-वा) A plant: as synonymous with Śyāma, (Echites frutescens), but more usually considered synonymous with Anantamūla, (Asclepias pseudosarsa,) the broad leaved variety, the root of which has been used as a substitute for Sarsaparilla, &c. E. शारि injuring, from शॄ with इञ् aff., and वन added.
38117: शारिशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A sort of die or dice, used for playing with. E. शारि a man or piece, and शृङ्खला a chain.
38118: शारीर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Corporeal, bodily, belonging to or produced from the body. 2 Spiritual in connexion with the body, incorporate. n. (-रं) 1 The soul or spirit whilst incorporate. 2 A drug(?) 3 Excrement, excretion. m. (-रः) Personal chastisement, corporeal punishment. E. शरीर the body, and अण् aff.
38119: शारीरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Corporeal, relating to what is corporeal. 2 Incorporate. E. कन् added to the last.
38120: शारीरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the body, corporeal. 2 Contained in the body, incorporate. E. शरीर, and ठञ् aff.
38121: शारुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, noxious, injurious. E. शॄ to hurt, उकण aff.
38122: शार्क m. (-र्कः) Clayed or candied sugar. E. शॄ to injure, aff. क.
38123: शार्कक m. (-कः) 1 The froth of milk, syllabub, cream. 2 A lump or ball of meat, &c. 3 Clayed or candied sugar. E. कन् added to the last.
38124: शार्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Stony, gravelly. 2 Sugary. m. (-रः) The froth or skim of milk. E. शर्करा sugar, gravel, &c. aff. अण्.
38125: शार्करक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Gravelly, stony, &c. E. शार्कर the same, and कक् added; also from शर्कर with ठक् aff. शार्करिक.
38126: शार्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Stony, gravelly, &c. E. शर्करा gravel, &c., and छ attributive aff.
38127: शार्ङ्ग mfn. (-र्ङ्गः-र्ङ्गी-र्ङ्गं) Horny, made of horn, &c. n. (-र्ङ्गं) 1 A bow in general. 2 The bow of VIṢṆU. E. शृङ्ग a horn, अण् aff.
38128: शार्ङ्गिन् m. (-र्ङ्गी) 1 A bowyer, an archer. 2 VIṢṆU. E. शाङ्ग a bow, इनि poss. aff.
38129: शार्दूल m. (-लः) 1 A tiger. 2 Another animal. 3 A Rākṣasa. 4 A sort of bird. 5 (In composition,) Pre-eminent, excellent. 6 A form of metre, a variety of the class Dhṛti, or stanza of four lines of 18 syllables each; also of the class Atidhṛti, in which there are 19 syllables in the line. E. शॄ to injure, टूलच् aff.
38130: शार्दूलललित m. (-तः) A species of the Dhṛti metre, of 4 lines of 18 syllables each.
38131: शार्दूलवाहन m. (-नः) A Jaina teacher. E. शार्दूल a tiger, and वाहन a vehicle.
38132: शार्दूलविक्रीडित m. (-तः) A form of metre, a variety of the class Atidhṛti or stanza, of 4 lines of 19 syllables each.
38133: शार्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Murderous, mischievous. 2 Nocturnal. n. (-रं) Darkness, gloom. f. (-री) Night. E. शर्वरी night, अण् aff.
38134: शाल (ऋ) शालृ r. 1st cl. (शालते) 1 To flatter, to praise. 2 To boast.
38135: शाल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of fish, (Ophiocephalus wrahl, HAM.) 2 The celebrated sovereign SĀLIVĀHANA. 3 The name of a river. f. (-ला) 1 A house. 2 A hall. 3 A large branch of a tree. E. शल to go, घञ् aff. or शाल to praise, aff. अच्; in several of the meanings it is also written, साल.
38136: शालङ्कायन m. (-नः) 1 The name of a saint. 2 ŚIVA'S attendant NANDI.
38137: शालङ्कायनजीवसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VYĀSA.
38138: शालज m. (-जः) A kind of fish, the Śāl or Sol, (Ophicephalus wrahl, HAM.)
38139: शालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) Resin, the resinous exudation of the Śāl or Shorea robusta. E. शाल the Śāl tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.
38140: शालपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. शाल the Śāl, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having similar leaves; also सालपर्णी.
38141: शालभञ्जिका f. (-का) 1 A doll, a puppet. 2 A whore, a harlot. E. कन् added to the following.
38142: शालभञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) A doll, a puppet. E. शाल Śāl wood, भञ्ज to rub, (to plane, &c., in order to make dolls,) affs. अच्, and ङीष्; also with कन् added शालभञ्जिका.
38143: शालवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Resin, the resin of the Śāl tree, used as incense, &c. E. शाल the Śāl tree, and वेष्ट exudation.
38144: शालसार m. (-रः) 1 A tree. 2 Asafætida; also सालसार.
38145: शालाकिन् m. (-की) 1 A surgeon. 2 A barber. 3 A spearman, &c. E. शलाका a probe, a dart, &c. अण् aff. of reference, and इनि poss. aff. added.
38146: शालाङ्की f. (-ङ्की) A doll, a puppet. E. शाला a hall, अकि to go, affs. अच्, and ङीष्.
38147: शालाजिर mn. (-रः-रं) A hollow earthen cup or saucer. E. शाला a house, जॄ to become old, अच् aff.
38148: शालाञ्चि f. (-ञ्चिः) A creeping plant, the leaves of which are used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra.) E. शाला a house, अञ्च to go, aff. इन्.
38149: शालानी f. (-नी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. शाल the Śāl tree, आङ् before नी to get, (to resemble in the leaf,) aff. क्विप्.
38150: शालामृग m. (-गः) A Shakal. E. शाला a house, and मृग a deer.
38151: शालार n. (-रं) 1 A ladder, a flight of stairs or steps. 2 A birdcage. 3 The claw of an elephant. E. शाला a house, ऋ to go, aff. अच्.
38152: शालावृक m. (-कः) 1 A monkey. 2 A dog. 3 A Shakal. 4 A deer. 5 A cat. E. शाला a house, वृक a wolf.
38153: शालि n. (-लि) 1 Rice in general, but especially in two classes; one like white rice growing in deep water, and the other a red sort, requiring only a moist soil: there are a great many varieties of this grain. 2 The civet or pole cat. E. शाड to float or swim, aff. इन, and ड changed to ल.
38154: शालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to a hall, the Śāl tree, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A weaver. 2 A village of artificers. 3 A toll, a tax. f. (-का) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. शाल the Śāl tree, कन् fem. form, aff. of comparison; or शाला a hall, ठक् aff.
38155: शालिञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A creeper, the leaf of which is used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.)
38156: शालिता f. (-ता) 1 Possessing, having. 2 Confidence in, relying upon. E. शालिन्, and तल् aff. or with त्व, शालित्वं.
38157: शालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Belonging to a house, domestic, &c. 2 Possessing, having. 3 Shining or resplendent with. E. शाल a house, and इनि aff.; in the second form it is the same as शील; the इ being changed to आ when used in composition.
38159: शालिपिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Crystal. E. शालि rice, and पिष्ट ground.
38160: शालिवाहन m. (-नः) A sovereign of India, whose capital was Pratiṣṭhāna in the Dekhin, and institutor of the era now called Śakā, beginning 76 or 78 years after CRIST. E. शालि from शाल the Śāl tree, or a proper name, that of a Yakṣa transformed to a lion, on which the prince rode when an infant, and वाहन vehicle.
38161: शालिहोत्र m. (-त्रः) A horse. E. शालि rice, corn, and होत्र an oblation; also with इनि added शालिहोत्रिन् m. (-त्री)
38162: शालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Ashamed, bashful. 2 Like, resembling. m. (-नः) An opulent householder, one who devotes his attention to worldly affairs. E. शाला a house, ख aff. (fit or worthy to enter it.)
38163: शालीनत्व n. (-त्वं) Modesty. E. त्व added to the last, also with तल्, शालीनता.
38164: शालीनत्वविवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Immodest. E. शालीनत्व, and विवर्ज्जित devoid of.
38165: शालु m. (-लुः) 1 An astringent substance. 2 A sort of perfume, commonly called Cor. 3 A frog. n. (-लु) The root of the water lily. E. शॄ to hurt, उ aff., and र changed to ल.
38166: शालुक n. (-कं) The root of a lotus: see the next.
38167: शालूक n. (-कं) The esculent root of the different kinds of Nymphæa or water lily. E. शल to go, to shake, Uṇādi aff. ऊकन्; also with a short vowel शालुक.
38168: शालूर m. (-रः) A frog. E. शल to go, ऊलच् aff. and the radical vowel made long; also शालुर.
38169: शालेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for rice, (a field, &c.) m. (-यः) A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शालि rice, and ढंक् aff.
38170: शालोत्तरीय m. (-यः) A name of PĀṆINI, the inspired grammarian. E. शाला a house, the house of his preceptor, उत्तरीय latter, last; having been expelled it for stupidity, and acquiring his subsequent science by his worship of ŚIVA.
38171: शाल्मल m. (-लः) 1 The silk cotton tree. 2 One of the Dvīpas to divisions of the continent. 3 The gum of the silk cotton tree. E. see the next.
38172: शाल्मलि mf. (-लिः-ली) 1 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 2 One of the seven Dvīpas, islands or great divisions of the known continent; denominated from the tree first mentioned, said to grow there: it is surrounded by the sea of Ghee or clarified butter. E. शल to go, causal form, क्विप् aff. शाल् exuding, emitting, मल to hold, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also with अच् aff. शाल्मल, and with the first vowel short, शल्मलि, &c.
38173: शाल्मलिन् m. (-ली) GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU, f. (-लिनी) The silk cotton tree.
38174: शाल्मलीवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The gum of the silk cotton tree. E. शाल्मलि the tree, and वेष्ट exudation; also with कन् added शाल्मलीवेष्टक.
38175: शाल्व m. plu. (-ल्वाः) The inhabitants of one of the central divisions of India.
38176: शाव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Tawny, (of that colour.) 2 Relating to the purification of defilement from the contact or consanguinity of a corpse, &c. 3 Relating to a dead body. m. (-वः) 1 Tawny, (the colour.) 2 The young of any animal, see the next. E. शष a dead body, and अण् aff.; or शव to go, aff. घञ्.
38177: शावक m. (-कः) The young of any animal. E. शाव, and कन् added.
38178: शावर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Low, vile. m. (-रः) 1 Fault, offence. 2 Sin, wickedness. 3 The Lodh tree, (Symplocos racemosus.) f. (-री) 1 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 2 A sort of Prākṛta, that spoken by barbarians. E. शवर a man of low or degraded caste, and अण् aff.
38179: शावरभेदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) Copper. E. शावर relating to a low race, भेद class, and आख्य appellation.
38180: शावाशौच n. (-चं) Impurity from the demise of a relation. E. शाव, and अशौच impurity.
38181: शाश्वत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Eternal, perpetual. m. (-तः) 1 A name of VYĀSA. 2 ŚIVA. 3 The sun. n. (-तं) Heaven, ether. f. (-ती) The earth. E. शश्वत् perpetually, अण् aff.
38182: शाष्कुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Eating flesh or fish. E. शुष्कुली flesh, अण् aff. form irr.: see शौष्कुल.
38183: शाष्कुलिक n. (-कं) A multitude of pies. E. शष्कुली a sort of pie, ठक् aff.
38184: शास (उ,) शासु r. 2nd cl. (शास्ति) 1 To instruct, to inform. 2 To order, to direct, to enact. 3 To rule, to govern. (शास्ते) 1 To wish or desire: with आङ् prefixed, r. 1st cl. (आशासते) r. 2nd cl. (आशास्ते) To wish well to, to bless.
38185: शासन n. (-नं) 1 An order, an edict, a command. 2 A royal grant of land or of privileges, a charter, &c. usually inscribed on stone or copper. 3 A writing, a deed, a written contract or agreement. 4 A Śāstra or scripture. 5 Devotion, or devotional tranquillity, the government of the passions. 6 Governing, ruling, government. E. शास to order or direct, aff. ल्युट.
38186: शासनपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plate of copper, a stone or sheet of paper, &c. on which an edict or grant is inscribed. E. शासन, and पत्र leaf.
38187: शासनहर m. (-रः) A royal messenger, one bearing an edict or grant. E. शासन an edict, and हर who takes.
38188: शासनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be governed or directed. E. शास to rule, अनीयर् aff.; also शासितव्य and शास्य.
38189: शासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Governed, ruled. E. शास to rule, aff. क्त.
38190: शासितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Ordering, commanding, a governor or commander. E. शास to order, तृच् aff. with इट् augment.
38191: शास्ति f. (-स्तिः) 1 A command, an order. 2 Governing, ruling, ordering. 3 A sceptre. 4 Correction, punishment. E. शास to govern, aff. क्तिन् or ति Uṇādi aff.
38192: शास्तृ mfn. (-स्ता-स्ती-स्तृ) 1 A ruler, one who rules or governs. 2 A teacher, teaching, instructing. m. (-स्ता) A Buddha or Jina, or the deified teacher of one or both those sects. E. शास to govern, &c. aff. तृच्, and the augment omitted.
38193: शास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 An order or command. 2 Scripture, science, institutes of religion, law or letters, especially considered as of divine origin or authority: used singly, it implies works of literature or science in general, and it is therefore customarily connected with some other word to limit its application, as the Vedānta Śāstras, or treatises of philosophical theology; the Dharma Śāstras, books of law, &c.: it is also applied to less important branches of knowledge, as the Kāvya Śāstras, or poetical works; Śilpi Śāstras, works on the mechanical arts; and Kāma Śāstras, or erotic compositions; in the singular number it is also used comprehensively to signify the body of all that has been written on the subject, as Dharma Śāstra, the institutes or code of law; Kāvya Śāstra, poetry; Alaṅkāra Śāstra, rhetoric, &c. 3 A book in general. E. शास to govern or teach, aff. ष्ट्रन्.
38194: शास्त्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) 1 A Ṛṣi, a holy personage of divine character. 2 An author in general. E. शास्त्र a Śāstra or scripture, &c., and कृत् the author; the principal compositions in Hindu religion, law, and literature, being attributed to sanctified and superhuman personages.
38195: शास्त्रगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A general and superficial scholar.
38196: शास्त्रचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) Grammar. E. शास्त्र science, and चक्षुस् the eye.
38197: शास्त्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Acquainted with the Śāstras, skilled in the knowledge of law and religion especially. E. शास्त्र a sacred work, and ज्ञ who knows.
38198: शास्त्रज्ञता f. (-ता) Knowledge of the Śāstras. E. शास्त्रज्ञ, and तल् aff.; also शास्त्रज्ञत्वं.
38199: शास्त्रज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge derived from the study of sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and ज्ञान knowledge.
38200: शास्त्रतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The truth or true knowledge taught in sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and तत्त्व truth.
38201: शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Understanding the works of sacred science. m. (-ज्ञः) An astrologer, an astronomer. E. शास्त्र sacred or astronomical science, तत्त्व the truth, and ज्ञ who knows.
38202: शास्त्रतस् ind. After or according to the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and तसि aff.
38203: शास्त्रदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Skilled in sacred science. E. शास्त्र Śāstra, and दर्शिन् who inspects.
38204: शास्त्रनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Revilling or denying the authority of sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and निन्दा reviling.
38205: शास्त्रप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The subject of the Śāstras. 2 Discussing works of sacred literature. E. शास्त्र, and प्रसङ्ग attaching to.
38206: शास्त्रवत् ind. Conformably or according to written authority. E. शास्त्र and वति aff.
38207: शास्त्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having or following sacred institutes, &c. E. शास्त्र, and मतुप् aff.
38208: शास्त्रविट् mfn. (-विट्) Understanding or conversant with the scriptures, skilled in sacred science. E. शास्त्र a Śāstra, and विट् who knows.
38209: शास्त्रविधान n. (-नं) Sacred ritual, ceremonial precept. E. शास्त्र, and विधान direction; also शास्त्रविधि.
38210: शास्त्रविप्रतिषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to law or religion, illegal, forbidden. E. शास्त्र a Śāstra, and विप्रतिषिद्ध prohibited.
38211: शास्त्रविप्रतिषेध n. (-धं) Any act contrary to the legal and religious institutes of the Hindus. E. शास्त्र an institute, and वि and प्रति contra-indicative prefixes before षिद्ध to accomplish, aff. घञ्.
38212: शास्त्रविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to law or religion. E. शास्त्र, and विरुद्ध opposed to.
38213: शास्त्रविरोध m. (-धः) 1 Opposition or deviation from sacred authority. 2 Contradiction or incompatibility of different systems. E. शास्त्र, and विरोध contrariety.
38214: शास्त्रशिल्पिन plu. m. (-नः) The people of Kashmir. E. शास्त्र a treatise, and शिल्पिन an artificer.
38215: शास्त्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Established or proved by sacred institutes or divine works. E. शास्त्र, and सिद्ध established.
38216: शास्त्राचरण m. (-णः) 1 Versed in the scriptures, well read in the works of sacred science, a Paṇḍita. 2 A follower of the Vedas, one whose conduct is regulated by their precepts. E. शास्त्र a sacred treatise, and आचरण who goes through or studies.
38217: शास्त्रातिक्रम m. (-मः) Behaving ill or immorally, transgressing, acting contrary to the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and अतिक्रम surpassing.
38218: शास्त्रानुष्ठान n. (-नं) Following the Śāstras, conforming to the law or ritual, &c. E. शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठान conforming.
38219: शास्त्रानुष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Who or what obeys or follows sacred institutes, &c. 2 Established or authorised by the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठित following.
38220: शास्त्रानुसार m. (-रः) Conformity to sacred ordinances. E. शास्त्र, and अनुसार following.
38221: शास्त्राभिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Learned, versed in the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and अभिज्ञ who knows.
38222: शास्त्रिन् m. (-स्त्री) A Paṇḍita, a teacher of holy science, or one skilled in it. E. शास्त्र as above, and इनि aff.
38223: शास्त्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Scriptural, authorised by or conformable to sacred institutes. E. शास्त्र, and छ aff.
38224: शास्त्रोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said or declared in a work of sacred authority. E. शास्त्र, and उक्त said.
38225: शास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be regulated or ordained, to be enforced, to be provided for by any act of government or judicature. 2 Punishable, deserving punishment. E. शास to govern, aff. यत्.
38226: शि (ञ,) शिञ् r. 5th cl. (शिनोति शिनुते) 1 To make thin or small. 2 To whet, to sharpen.
38227: शि m. (-शिः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 Auspiciousness, good fortune. 3 Peace, composure, calm. E. शि to whet, or शो to destroy, aff. कि.
38228: शिंशपा f. (-पा) A tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) 2 The Asoka tree. E. शीघ्र quick, or शीर्ष the head or top; पा to cherish, or पत to fall, &c, aff. क or ड, deriv. irr.
38229: शिक्कु mfn. (-क्कुः-क्कुः-क्कु) Idle, lazy, following no business or profession.
38230: शिक्थ n. (-क्थं) Bee's wax; also शिक्थकं and सिक्थकं.
38231: शिक्य nf. (-क्यं-क्या) 1 The string or loop suspended from either end of a pole or yoke to receive the burthen. 2 The burthen so carried. 3 The strings of a balance. E. श्रंस to fall, Uṇādi aff. यत्; शि substituted for the root, and कुट् augment.
38232: शिक्याधार m. (-रः) The hook or eye at each end of a pole or beam, to which the strings of a yoke or balance are fastened. E. शिक्या as above, and आधार receptacle.
38233: शिक्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended or carried in a sort of loop. E. शिक्य a loop, and इतच् aff.
38234: शिक्ष r. 1st cl. (शिक्षते) To learn, to acquire science.
38235: शिक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A learner, a teacher. E. शिक्ष to learn, ण्वुल् aff.
38236: शिक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taught or learnt. E. शिक्ष to learn, अनीयर् aff.
38237: शिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 One of the six Vedāṅgas or sciences attached to the Vedas: the proper pronunciation of the vocal sounds which occur in them, as explained by PĀṆINI. 2 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 3 Learning, study, the acquisition of knowledge. 4 Modesty, humility. E. शिक्ष to learn, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
38238: शिक्षाकर m. (-रः) 1 VYĀSA. 2 An instructor. E. शिक्षा the science of pronunciation, and कर making.
38239: शिक्षाशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Dexterity, skill. E. शिक्षा discipline, and शक्ति power.
38240: शिक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Skilful, clever, conversant. 2 Modest, diffident. 3 Disciplined, exercised. 4 Tame, trained, (as an animal.) 5 Docile. 6 Studied, learned. E. शिक्षा studying, इतच् aff. or शिक्ष to study, aff. क्त.
38241: शिक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taught or learnt. E. शिक्ष to learn, and तव्य aff.
38242: शिक्षिताक्षर m. (-रः) A pupil, a scholar. E. शिक्षित studied, (by whom,) and अक्षर a letter.
38243: शिक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 To be taught, teachable. E. शिक्ष to learn, यत् aff.
38244: शिख (इ) r. 1st cl. (शिङ्खति) To go, to move or approach.
38245: शिखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The tail of a peacock. 2 Locks left on the crown or the sides of the head, at the period of tonsure in children: see the next. E. शिखिन् a peacock or any crested object, अम to be or belong to, ड aff., and the form irr.
38246: शिखण्डक m. (-कः) Locks of hair left at the time of tonsure; three or five locks left in children in general, or especially those of the military class, in which latter case, the hair is left in a semicircular patch on each side of the head, covering rather more than the temporal bones, and following much the same outline: see काकपक्ष. 2 The crest or lock of hair left on the crown of the head. 3 A peacock's tail. E. शिखा a crest, अण्ड an egg, and कन् pleonasm, or aff. of comparison; also शिखाण्डक and शिखण्ड.
38247: शिखण्डिक m. (-कः) A cock. f. (-का) A lock of hair on the crown of the head. E. शिखण्ड a crest, &c. aff. ठक् or कन् in the fem. form.
38248: शिखण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 1 A peacock. 2 A peacock's tail. 3 A cock. 4 An arrow. 5 A Ṛṣi, either of the seven represented by the stars of the greater bear: see चित्रशिखण्डिन्. 6 The son of DRUPADA, by metamorphosis: see below. f. (-नी) 1 A kind of jasmine, (J. auriculatum.) 2 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 3 The daughter of DRUPADA, afterwards changed to a male. E. शिखण्ड a crest, and इनि poss. aff.
38249: शिखर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The peak or summit of a mountain. 2 The top of a tree. 3 Point, end, top in general. 4 Horripilation. 5 The armpit. 6 A piece of a ruby or a gem, described as of the colour of the ripe pomegranate seed or a bright red. 7 The edge or point of a sword. f. (-रा) A plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings were made, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. शिखा a crest, and रच् poss. aff., and the vowel made short.
38250: शिखरवासिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. शिस्वर the peak, (of the Himālaya.) and वासिनी abiding.
38251: शिखरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Crested, peaked, pointed. m. (-री) 1 A mountain. 2 A tree. 3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 4 A strong-hold, a hill-fort. 5 The lapwing. f. (-रिणी) 1 A form of metre, a species of the class Atyaṣṭi or verse of four lines of 17 syllables each. 2 A dish of curds and sugar with spices. 3 An excellent woman. 4 Arabian jasmine. 5 A line of hair extending across the navel. E. शिस्वर a point or peak, and इनि aff.
38252: शिखलोहित m. (-तः) A plant, commonly Kukurmurā.
38253: शिखा f. (-खा) 1 Point, top in general. 2 A crest. 3 A peacock's crest. 4 A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 5 Flame. 6 A radicating branch. 7 Any branch. 8 A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya. 9 Chief, principal. 10 Fever, proceeding from libidinous excitement or love. 11 A ray of light. E. शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. ख, and the vowel made short.
38254: शिखाण्डक (-कः) Hair left on each side of the head: see शिखण्डक.
38255: शिखातरु m. (-रुः) A candlestick or lampstand. E. शिखा flame, and तरु a tree.
38256: शिखाधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Crested, pointed. 2 Having a top knot. m. (-रः) 1 A peacock. 2 A Jaina deified saint. E. शिखा a crest, and धर who has.
38257: शिखाधार m. (-रः) A peacock. E. शिखा a crest, and धार who has.
38258: शिखामूल n. (-लं) A carrot, a turnip, or any root with a tuft of leaves growing from it. E. शिखा a crest, and मूल a root.
38259: शिखावत् m. (-वान्) A name of AGNI or fire. 2 The personified descending node. 3 A lamp. f. (-वती) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. शिखा a crest, and मतुप् poss. aff.
38260: शिखावर m. (-रः) The jack fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
38261: शिखावल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crested, pointed. m. (-लः) A peacock. f. (-ला) A flower, (Celosia cristata.) E. शिखा a crest, and वलच् aff.
38262: शिखावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The stand of lamp. E. शिखा flame, and वृक्ष a tree.
38263: शिखावृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Usurious interest payable daily. शिक्षा a tuft of hair, and वृद्धि interest; growing constantly.
38264: शिखिग्रीव n. (-वं) Blue vitriol. E. शिखि for शिखिन् a peacock, ग्रीवा the neck, अच् added, being of the same colour.
38265: शिखिध्वज m. (-जः) 1 Smoke. 2 The deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शिखि a peacock, or fire, and ध्वज an emblem.
38266: शिखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) 1 Crested. 2 Having a lock of hair on the top of the head. m. (-खी) 1 Fire. 2 A peacock. 3 A bull. 4 An arrow. 5 A tree. 6 A cock. 7 KETU, the personified descending node. 8 A horse. 9 A mountain. 10 A Brahman. 11 A lamp. 12 A religious mendicant. E. शिखा a crest, and इनि aff.
38267: शिखिपुच्छ n. (-च्छं) A peacock's tail. E. शिखि a peacock, and पुच्छ a tail.
38268: शिखिमण्डल m. (-लः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) E. शिखि a peacock, and मण्डल district.
38269: शिखिवर्द्धक m. (-कः) A pumpkin gourd. E. शिखि a peacock, and वर्द्धक increasing.
38270: शिखिवाहन m. (-नः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शिखि a peacock, and वाहन a vehicle, the deity being mounted on this bird.
38271: शिखिशिखा f. (-खा) 1 Flame. 2 A peacock's crest. E. शिखिन्, and शिखा a crest, &c.
38272: शिखिशेखर n. (-रं) A peacock's crest. E. शिखिन्, and शेखर a crest.
38273: शिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) 1 A tree, (Morunga guilandina and hyperanthera.) 2 A potherb in general. E. शि to sharpen, रुक् aff., and ग augment.
38274: शिग्रुज n. (-जं) The seed of the Morunga. E. शिग्रु, and ज produced.
38275: शिग्रुमूल n. (-लं) The pungent root of the Morunga. E. शिग्रु, and मूल the root.
38276: शिग्रुवीज n. (-जं) The seed of the Morunga. E. शिग्रु, and वीज seed.
38277: शिघ (इ) शिघि r. 1st cl. (शिंघति) To smell.
38278: शिङ्घाण n. (-णं) 1 Any glass vessel. 2 The mucus of the nose. 3 Rust of iron. E. शिघि to smell, आणक Uṇādi affix, and the final optionally rejected; also शिंघाणक and शिंहाणक.
38279: शिङ्घाणक m. (-कः) Phlegm. mn. (-कः-कं) The mucus of the nose. E. शिघि to smell, aff. आणक.
38280: शिङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smelled. E. शिघि to smell, aff. क्त.
38281: शिच् f. (शिक्) The string of a pole for carrying burdens. E. श्रंस to fall, deriv. irr.: see शिक्य.
38282: शिज (इ) शिजि r. 2nd cl. (शिंक्ते) 1 To make an inarticulate sound. 2 To tinkle.
38283: शिञ्ज mf. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा) The tinkling sound of silver and other metallic ornaments worn round the waist, arm, or ancles, &c. f. (-ञ्जा) A bow string. E. शिजि to make an inarticulate sound, aff. अङ् and टाप्: also शिञ्जिनी, &c.
38284: शिञ्जञ्जिका f. (-का) A chain worn round a man's loins.
38285: शिञ्जित n. (-तं) The tinkling of metallic ornaments worn as rings, chains, &c. E. शिञ्जा inarticulate sound, इतच् aff.
38286: शिञ्जिन् mfn. (-ञ्जी-ञ्जिनी-ञ्जि) Tinkling, making a tinkling sound. f. (-ञ्जिनी) 1 A bow-string. 2 Metallic rings worn round the toes, an ornament of the feet. E. शिञ्जा a tinkling, and इनि aff.
38287: शिट r. 1st cl. (शेटति) To disregard, to treat with disrespect.
38288: शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thin, emaciated, wasted, declined. 2 Weak, feeble. 3 Sharpened, whetted. E. शि to sharpen, or शो to pare or whet, aff. क्त.
38289: शितता f. (-ता) Sharpness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शितत्वं.
38290: शितद्रु f. (-द्रुः) The Śatadru or Setlej river. E. शित weakened, द्रु to flow, aff. कुः see शतद्रु.
38291: शितधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sharp-edged. E. शित, and धारा an edge.
38292: शितशूक m. (-कः) 1 Barley. 2 Wheat. E. शित sharpened, शूक the beard.
38293: शिताग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Sharp-pointed. m. (-ग्रः) A thorn. E. शित, and अग्र point.
38294: शितास्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) Armed with sharp weapons. E. शित, अस्त्र a weapon, भृत् who has.
38295: शिति mfn. (-तिः-ती-ति) 1 Black. 2 White. m. (-तिः) The Bhojpatra or birch. E. शि to sharpen, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.; or शत to go, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; also सिति.
38296: शितिकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A gallinule. 3 A peacock. E. शिति black, and कण्ठ the throat.
38297: शितिचार m. (-रः) A potherb, (apparently Marsilea dentata, Rox.)
38298: शितिछद m. (-दः) A goose. E. शिति white, छद a feather; also सितछद.
38299: शितिपक्ष m. (-क्षः) A goose. E. शिति white, पक्ष a wing; also सितपक्ष.
38300: शितिरत्न n. (-त्नं) A sapphire. E. शिति, and रत्न a gem.
38301: शितिसारक m. (-कः) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. शिति black, and सार essence, resin, कन् added; yielding a strong black resin that is used for caulking boats, &c.
38302: शितेषु m. (-षुः) A sharp arrow. E. शित, and इषु an arrow.
38303: शिथिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Loose, lax, flaccid, flabby. 2 Languid, inert, feeble. 3 Ineffective, unenergetic. 4 Relaxed, slackened. 5 Not rigidly observed. 6 Loosely retained or possessed. 7 Abandoned, got rid of, shaken off. E. श्रथ to be lax or loose, Uṇādi aff. किरच्, the form irr.
38304: शिथिलता f. (-ता) Relaxation, looseness, being unfastened, &c. E. शिथिल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शिथिलत्वं.
38305: शिथिलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Let go, loosed, released. 2 Relaxed, loosened. E. शिथिल, and इतच् aff.
38306: शिथिलबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Weakened, relaxed. E. शिथिल, and बल strength.
38307: शिथिलवसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) 1 Reduced in wealth. 2 Shining with diminished rays. E. शिथिल, and वसु wealth, &c.
38308: शिथिलशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-शिः-क्ति) Impaired in strength or power. E. शिथिल, and शक्ति power.
38309: शिथिलीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Loosening, unfastening. 2 Impairing, weakening, reducing. E. शिथिल, and करण doing, च्चि augment.
38310: शिथिलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unbound, unfastened. slackened. 2 Reduced, impaired, weakened. 3 Let loose. E. शिथिल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
38311: शिनि m. (-निः) A proper name, a chief of the Kṣatriya tribe. E. शि to make thin or small, Uṇādi aff. नि.
38312: शिनेर्नप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A name of SĀTYAKI, one of the chiefs of the Pāṇḍus. E. शिनि a proper name, and नप्तृ grandson.
38314: शिपि m. (-पिः) A ray of light. f. (-पिः) Skin, leather.
38315: शिपिविष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 A bald man. 2 A man naturally void of prepuce. 3 ŚIVA. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 A leper. E. शिपि a ray of light, and विष्ट entered; also शिपविष्ट and शिविपिष्ट.
38316: शिफा f. (-फा) 1 A fibrous root. 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 3 A river. 4 A mother. 5 Turmerick. 6 The root of a water lily. E. शी to sleep, फक् aff., and the form irr.
38317: शिफाकन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) The root of a water lily. E. शिफा a fibrous root, and कन्द a root.
38318: शिफाधर m. (-रः) A branch. E. शिफा a fibrous root, and धर what has.
38319: शिफारुह m. (-हः) The Indian fig tree. E. शिफा a fibrous root, and रुह what grows.
38320: शिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A sort of large shrub, (Cassia alata.) f. (-म्बा) A legume, a pod; also सिम्बा. E. शि to make small, deriv. irr.; also शिम्बि.
38321: शिम्बि f. (-म्बिः-म्बी) A legume, a pod. E. शि to make small or sharpen, deriv. irr.; also शिम्बा, and सिम्बा.
38322: शिम्बिक m. (-कः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus max.) f. (-का) A legume, a pod. E. कन् added to the last; also शिम्बा, &c.
38323: शिम्बिपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. शिम्बि a pod, and पर्ण leaf, aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added fem. form शिम्बिपर्णिका.
38324: शिर n. (-रं) 1 The head. 2 The root of the pepper plant. f. (-रा) Any vessel of the body, really, or supposed to be, of a tubular form, as a nerve, a tendon, a gut, &c. E. शॄ to injure, क aff.: see शिरस.
38325: शिरःकपालिन् m. (-ली) A devotee carrying a human scull as his emblem. E. शिरस् the head, कपाल the scull, and इनि aff.
38326: शिरःपीडा f. (-डा) Pain of the head, head-ache. E. शिरस्, and पीडा pain.
38327: शिरःफल m. (-लः) The cocoa-nut tree. E. शिरस् the head, and फल fruit.
38328: शिरःस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having the head bathed. E. शिरस् and स्नात bathed.
38329: शिरज m. (-जः) The hair of the head. E. शिर the head, and ज born.
38330: शिरस् n. (-रः) 1 The head. 2 The top of a tree. 3 The van of an army. 4 Chief, principal, head. E. श्रि to honour, in the passive form, to be honoured, (by the other members,) असुन् Uṇādi aff., and the form irr.
38331: शिरसिज m. (-जः) The hair of the head. E. शिरसि seventh case, in the head, ज born.
38332: शिरसिरुह् m. (-रुट्) The hair of the head. E. शिरसि on the head, रुह् what grows.
38333: शिरस्क n. (-स्कं) 1 A helmet. 2 A turban, a hat or cap. f. (-स्का) A litter, a palanquin. E. शिरस् the head, and कप् added.
38334: शिरस्तापिन् m. (-पी) An elephant. E. शिरस् the head, तप to inflame, णिनि aff.
38335: शिरस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 A helmet. 2 A cap, a turban, &c. E. शिरस् the head, and त्रै to protect, aff. क.
38336: शिरस्त्राण n. (-णं) 1 A helmet. 2 A cap, a turban, &c. E. शिरस् the head, त्राण the instrument of defence.
38337: शिरस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Of or on the head. n. (-स्यं) Clean unentangled hair. E. शिरस् the head, यत् aff.
38338: शिरस्स्थ mfn. (-स्स्थः-स्स्था-स्स्थं) At or on the head, at the top, &c. m. (-स्थः) A chief, a leader. E. शिरस् head, chief, and स्था to stay or be, aff. क.
38339: शिरापत्र m. (-त्रः) The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantium.) E. शिरा a vein, and पत्र leaf.
38340: शिराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Veiny, tendinous, skinny, showing the tendons or veins. n. (-लं) An acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.) E. शिरा a vein, लच् poss. aff.
38341: शिरालक m. (-कः) A plant, (Cissus quadrangularis.) E. कन् added to the last.
38343: शिरि m. (-रिः). 1 A sword. 2 An arrow. 3 A murderer, a killer. 4 A locust. E. शॄ to injure or kill, Uṇādi aff. इ, and the radical vowel changed to इर.
38344: शिरीष m. (-षः) A kind of tree, (Atracia sirisa.) E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. ईषन्.
38345: शिरोगृह n. (-हं) A room on the top of the house, a turret. E. शिरस् top, and गृह house.
38346: शिरोग्रीव n. (-वं) The head and neck. E. शिरस् the head, ग्रीव the neck, the compound neuter.
38347: शिरोधरा f. (-रा) The neck. E. शिरस् the head, and धर what upholds.
38348: शिरोधि f. (-धिः) The neck. E. शिरस् the head, धा to hold, aff. कि.
38349: शिरोमणि mf. (-णिः-णी) A gem worn in a crest, or on the top of the head. E. शिरस् the head, and मणि a jewel.
38350: शिरोमर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्म) A hog. E. शिरस् the head, and मर्म्मन् vitality.
38351: शिरोरत्न n. (-त्नं) A gem worn in the crest. E. शिरस् the head, and रत्न a jewel.
38352: शिरोरुजा f. (-जा) 1 A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 2 Pain or diseased affection of the head. E. शिरस् the head, and रुजा sickness; a remedy being prepared from the leaves of the plant for head-ache.
38353: शिरोरुह् m. (-रुट्) Hair. E. शिरस् the head, रुह to grow, क्विप् aff.
38354: शिरोरुह m. (-हः) The hair of the head. E. शिरस् the head, रुह to grow, क aff.; also शिरोरुह्.
38355: शिरोरोग m. (-गः) Disease of the head. E. शिरस्, and रोग sickness.
38356: शिरोर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Pain of the head, head-ache, &c. E. शिरस् the head, and आर्त्ति pain.
38357: शिरोवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) At the head or top, &c. m. (-र्त्ती) A chief; one at the head of affairs or of an army. E. शिरस्, and वर्त्तिन् staying.
38358: शिरोवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The crest or comb of the peacock. E. शिरस् the head, and वल्ली a creeper; it is also read शिरोत्रन्दि.
38359: शिरोवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Pepper. E. शिरस् the head or top, and वृत्त surrounded.
38360: शिरोवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 A turban. 2 A cap. E. शिरस् the head, and वेष्ट what surrounds; also शिरोवेष्टन.
38361: शिरोवेष्टन n. (-नं) A turban. E. शिरस् the head, and वेष्टन enfolding.
38362: शिरोस्थि n. (-स्थि) A scull. E. शिरस् the head, and अस्थि a bone.
38364: शिल n. (-लं) Gleaning ears of corn. f. (-ला) 1 A stone, a rock. 2 Arsenic. 3 A flat stone on which condiments, &c. are ground with a muller. f. (-ला-ली) 1 The timber of a door frame. 2 A transverse beam, or a beam or stone placed across the top of a post or pillar. f. (-ली) 1 A small earth worm. 2 A dart, a spike. E. शिल to glean, aff. क.
38365: शिलाकर्णी f. (-र्णी) The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
38366: शिलाकुट्टक m. (-कः) A stone cutter's chisel. E. शिला a stone, कुट्ट to cut, aff. वुन्.
38367: शिलाकुसुम n. (-मं) Storax: see शिलाज. E. शिला and कुसुम flower.
38368: शिलाघन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Firm or hard as a stone or rock. E. शिला, and घन thick.
38369: शिलाज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in a mountain or rock, fossile, mineral. n. (-जं) 1 Storax or Benzoin, the resins of the Styrax benzoinum or S. officinale, which are usually confounded by the Hindus. 2 Iron. E. शिला a rock, and ज born; the balsams being supposed to be fossile productions, and to exude from the soil of mountainous places; being confounded with bitumen or petroleum.
38370: शिलाजतु n. (-तु) 1 Bitumen. 2 Red chalk. E. शिला a stone, and जतु lac; it is supposed to ooze from the stones of mountains in the hot weather.
38371: शिलाजित् f. (-जित्) Bitumen. E. शिला a stone, and जित् what conquers or excels.
38372: शिलाटक m. (-कः) 1 A room on the top of a house. 2 A hole. 3 A fence, an enclosure. E. शिला a stone, अट to go, वुन् aff.
38373: शिलातल n. (-लं) The surface of a rock or stone. E. शिला, and तल below.
38374: शिलात्मज n. (-जं) Iron. E. शिला a stone, आत्मन् self, and ज born.
38375: शिलात्मिका f. (-का) A crucible. E. शिला a stone, आत्मन् substance, कन् aff. fem. form.
38376: शिलादद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Bitumen. E. शिला a stone, and दद्रु herpes.
38377: शिलाधातु m. (-तुः) 1 Chalk. 2 Red chalk. 3 A white fossile substance; an aluminous earth of a white colour, and thence considered to be a sort of chalk. E. शिला a stone or rock, and धातु a mineral.
38378: शिलापट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A flat stone for grinding condiments, &c. E. शिला a stone, and पट्ट a flat surface.
38379: शिलापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A mullar or roller for grinding condiments, &c. on a flat stone. E. शिला a flat stone, and पुत्त्र child; also शिलापुत्त्रक.
38380: शिलापुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Storax or Benzoin. E. शिला a rock, and पुष्प flower.
38381: शिलाफलक n. (-कं) A layer or table of rock or stone. E. शिला, फलक a plank.
38382: शिलाभव n. (-वं) Storax or Benzoin. E. शिला a rock, and भव born.
38383: शिलाभेद m. (-दः) 1 A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) 2 A stone cutter's chisel. E. शिला a stone, and भेद what breaks.
38384: शिलामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of stone. E. शिला, and मयट् aff.
38385: शिलारस m. (-सः) Incense, Benjaminor Olibanum. E. शिला a stone, and रस juice.
38386: शिलावल्का f. (-ल्का) A medicinal substance said to be of cooling and lithonthriptic properties, commonly termed Silābāk; a sort of lichen or moss. E. शिला a stone or rock, and वल्क bark; also termed शिलावल्कल, शिलात्वच्.
38387: शिलावृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Hail. E. शिला, and वृष्टि rain.
38388: शिलाव्याधि m. (-धिः) Bitumen. E. शिला a rock or stone, and व्याधि sickness.
38389: शिलासन n. (-नं) 1 Benzoin or Storax. 2 A stone bench or seat. E. शिला a stone or rock, and असन abiding or आसन a seat.
38390: शिलासार n. (-रं) Iron. E. शिला a stone, and सार essence.
38391: शिलि f. (-लिः-ली) The lower timber of a door. m. (-लिः) The Bhojpatra or birch tree. E. शिल to glean, इन् aff.: see शिल and शिला, &c.
38392: शिलीन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 1 The flower of the plaintain tree. 2 Hail. 3 A mushroom. m. (-न्ध्रः) 1 A sort of tree. 2 A kind of fish; also चित्रफलक. f. (-न्ध्री) 1 Earth, clay. 2 A small earth worm. 3 A sort of bird.
38393: शिलीन्ध्रक n. (-कं) A mushroom, one growing out of cowdung, a fungus. E. कन् added to the preceding.
38394: शिलीपद m. (-दः) Enlarged or Tropical leg; also श्लीपद.
38395: शिलीमुख m. (-खः) 1 A bee. 2 An arrow. 3 A fool, a blockhead. 4 War. E. शिली a dart, (a sting,) and मुख the face.
38396: शिलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Like a stone or rock, as hard, &c. n. (-यं) Storax. E. शिला a rock, ढक् aff. and the vowel unchanged.
38397: शिलोच्चय m. (-यः) 1 A mountain. 2 A high mountain. E. शिला a stone or rock, उत् up, चि to collect, अच् aff.
38398: शिलोञ्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 Following more than one occupation. 2 Gleaning. E. शिला gleaning, उच्छ to gather or glean, aff. अच्; gleaning a subsistence.
38399: शिलोञ्छवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Livelihood gained by gleaning. 2 Extraordinary occupation. E. शिलोञ्छ, and वृति subsistence.
38400: शिलोत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Growing from or upon rock or stone. n. (-त्यं) Benzoin or Storax. E. शिला a stone, and उत्थ what grows.
38401: शिलोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from stone or rock. n. (-वं) 1 A superior sort of Sandal wood, either the white or brass coloured sort. 2 Storax or Benzoin. E. शिला a stone or rock, and उद्भव produced.
38402: शिलौकस् m. (-काः) GARUḌA. E. शिला a rock, and ओकस् abode.
38403: शिल्प n. (-ल्पं) 1 An art, any manual or mechanical art. 2 A sort of spoon or ladle, used at sacrifices to throw the Ghee or butter into the fire. E. शिल to be clever or skilled, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made short.
38404: शिल्पक n. (-कं) A sort of drama: one exhibiting magical and mystical rites. E. शिल्प manual art, and कन् aff.; also read शिल्पिकं.
38405: शिल्पकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Manual labour, handicraft. E. शिल्प, and कर्म्मन् act; also शिल्पक्रिया, &c.
38406: शिल्पकार m. (-रः) An artisan, a mechanic. E. शिल्प a handicraft, and कार who makes.
38407: शिल्पविद्या f. (-द्या) Art, mechanical or manual skill. E. शिल्प, and विद्या knowledge.
38408: शिल्पशाल nf. (-लं-ला) A work-shop, a manufactory. E. शिल्प art. and शाला a hall.
38409: शिल्पिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Manual, mechanic. n. (-कं) 1 Handicraft. 2 A sort of drama; see शिल्पक. E. शिल्प, and ठक् aff.
38410: शिल्पिन् mfn. (-ल्पी-ल्पिनी-ल्पि) 1 An artist, an artificer or artisan. 2 Belonging or relating to a mechanical profession or art. f. (-ल्पिनी) A drug or herb, a kind of grass said to be known by the name of Lahānasipi, and described as sweet and cooling, and bearing seeds of tonic and restorative properties; also शिल्पिका, &c. E. शिल्प art, and इनि aff.
38411: शिल्पिशाल nf. (-लं-ला) A work-shop, a manufactory. E. शिल्पि an artisan, and शाला a hall.
38412: शिल्पिशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A treatise or set of treatises on works of art. E. शिल्पि an artist, and शास्त्र book.
38413: शिव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Prosperous, happy. m. (-वः) 1 The deity ŚIVA, the most formidable of the Hindu triad, the destroyer of creation: the adoration of which he is the object, is of a more gloomy nature in general than that of the rest, and he is the particular god of the Tāntrikas or followers of the books called Tantras. 2 Final emancipation from existence, eternal happiness. 3 A pillar or post to which cattle are tied. 4 An auspicious planetary conjunction. 5 Scripture, the Vedas. 6 A drug, commonly Elavāluka. 7 A perfume, Puṇḍarīya. 8 Bdellium. 9 One of the astronomical periods termed Yogas. 10 Quicksilver. 11 The penis. 12 The phallic emblem of ŚIVA. n. (-वं) 1 Happiness, pleasure. 2 Auspiciousness, well being. 3 Water. 4 Sea or fossile salt. 5 Borax. f. (-वा) 1 The goddess DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. 2 The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) 3 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 4 Emblic myrobalan. 5 A shakal. 6 The mother of the twenty-second Jina. E. शी to sleep, Uṇādi aff. वन्, on or in whom or which, the universe reposes.
38414: शिवक m. (-कः) A post to which cows or calves are tied. E. शिव the same, कन् aff.
38415: शिवकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, making happy. m. (-रः) A Jina of the last age. E. शिव good fortune, and कर who makes.
38416: शिवकीर्त्तन m. (-नः) 1 An attendant on ŚIVA. 2 KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. n. (-नं) Praising or hymning ŚIVA. E. शिव ŚIVA, and कीर्त्तन celebrating.
38417: शिवगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Happy, prosperous. 2 Worshipping ŚIVA. m. (-तिः) One of the Jinas of the past age. E. शिव auspiciousness, and गति going.
38418: शिवघर्म्मज m. (-जः) The planet MARS. E. शिव ŚIVA, घर्म्म perspiration, and ज born.
38419: शिवङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, conferring happiness or good fortune. E. शिव good fortune, कृ to make, aff. खच्.
38420: शिवचतुर्दशी f. (-शी) A festival in honour of ŚIVA, on the fourteenth of the dark half of Māgha. E. शिव, and चतुर्दशी fourteenth.
38421: शिवज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Knowing what is good or propitious. 2 Worshipping ŚIVA. f. (-ज्ञा) A female devotee of the Śaiva sect. E. शिव ŚIVA, and ज्ञा to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.
38422: शिवताति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Propitious, conferring happiness or fortune. E. शिव happiness, तातिल् aff.; also शिवतातिक.
38423: शिवदत्त n. (-त्तं) The discus of VIṢṆU. E. शिव ŚIVA, and दत्त given.
38424: शिवदारु m. (-रुः) The Devadaru tree, (Pinus Deodar.)
38425: शिवदूतिका f. (-का) One of the Mātṛs or divine mothers. E. शिवटूती DURGĀ, and कन् aff.
38426: शिवदूती f. (-ती) DURGĀ. E. शिव ŚIVA, and टूती, from टूत a messenger, fem. aff. ङीष्.
38427: शिवधातु m. (-तुः) The milk stone, opal or chalcedony. E. शिव ŚIVA, and धातु a mineral.
38428: शिवपुरी f. (-री) The holy city Benares. E. शिव, and पुरी the city; being sacred to ŚIVA especially.
38429: शिवप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dear to or esteemed by ŚIVA. m. (-यः) 1 The Sesbana grandiflora. 3 Crystal. f. (-या) The goddess DURGĀ. n. (-यं) The seeds of the Eleocarpus. E. शिव, and प्रिय beloved.
38430: शिवमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The Sesbana grandiflora. E. शिव, and मल्ली jasmine.
38431: शिवरस m. (-सः) The water of boiled rice or pulse three days old, and undergoing spontaneous fermentation. E. शिव ease, and रस juice.
38432: शिवरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) A celebrated festival in honour of ŚIVA on the fourteenth of the moon's wane or dark fortnight in Māgha. E. शिव, and रात्रि night.
38433: शिववल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Loved or esteemed by ŚIVA. m. (-भः) 1 The mango tree. 2 Gigantic swallow wort. f. (-भा) The goddess PĀRVATĪ. E. शिव ŚIVA, and वल्लभ beloved.
38434: शिववाहन m. (-नः) A bull. E. शिव the deity, and वाहन vehicle.
38435: शिववीज n. (-जं) Quicksilver. E. शिव ŚIVA, and वीज semen, its supposed origin.
38436: शिवशेखर m. (-रः) 1 The Sesbana grandiflora. 2 The moon. E. शिव ŚIVA, and शेखर a crest.
38437: शिवाक्ष n. (-क्षं) The seed of the Eleocarpus. E. शिव ŚIVA, and अक्ष from अक्षि the eye.
38438: शिवानी f. (-नी) 1 A flower, (Celtis orientalis.) 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. शिव the deity, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.
38439: शिवाप्रिय m. (-यः) A goat. E. शिवा DURGA, and प्रिय beloved by.
38440: शिवाराति m. (-तिः) A dog. E. शिवा a shakal, and अराति an enemy.
38441: शिवालय m. (-यः) Red Tulasī or basil. n. (-यं) 1 A cemetery or place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. 2 Any temple dedicated to ŚIVA. E. शिव ŚIVA, and आलय abode.
38443: शिवि m. (-विः) 1 A beast of prey. 2 The Bhojpatra or birch tree. 3 A king so named.
38444: शिविका f. (-का) A palanquin, a litter. E. शिव nominal verb, to give pleasure or ease, aff. ण्वुल्.
38445: शिविपिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A name of ŚIVA: see शिपिविष्ट.
38446: शिविर n. (-रं) 1 A camp. 2 A royal camp or residence. 3 A guard or defence for the soldiers. 4 A sort of grain. E. शी to sleep or rest, किरच् Uṇādi aff. and वुक् augment.
38447: शिवीरथ m. (-थः) A palanquin, a litter. E. शिवी for शिविका the same, and रथ a conveyance.
38448: शिशयिषा f. (-षा) Drowsiness, sleepiness, wish to sleep. E. शी to sleep, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.
38449: शिशयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Sleepy, drowsy. E. शी to sleep, desid. v., उ aff.
38450: शिशिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cold, frigid, chilly, freezing. m. (-रः) Frost. mn. (-रः-रं) The cold season, comprising two months from about the middle of January to that of March. E. शश to go, (the sun, north of the equator,) किरच् Uṇādi aff. and the radical vowel changed to इ.
38451: शिशिरकाल n. (-लं) The dewy season; see the last. E. शिशिर, and काल time.
38452: शिशु m. (-शुः) 1 The young of man or any animal, a child, a calf, a pup, &c. 2 A pupil, a scholar. 3 A boy under eight years of age. 4 A lad, or boy not more than sixteen. E. शो to destroy, Uṇādi aff. उ, and the root repeated, with इ substituted for the semivowel to which the radical vowel is changed in its inflections.
38453: शिशुक m. (-कः) 1 A porpoise. 2 Another fish, resembling a porpoise. 3 A child, a young animal. 4 A tree. E. कन् added to the last.
38454: शिशुक्रन्द m. (-न्दः) The weeping of an infant or child. E. शिशु a child, and क्रन्द weeping; also शिशुक्रन्दन n. (-नं).
38455: शिशुक्रन्दीय m. (-यः) A book or work treating of infantine or juvenile grievances. E. शिशुक्रन्द as above, and छ aff. in this sense.
38457: शिशुत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Boyhood, pupilage, the period before sixteen. 2 Childhood, the period up to eight years of age. E. शिशु a child, त्व abstract aff.; also with तल् aff. शिशुता.
38458: शिशुपाल m. (-लः) The sovereign of a country in the central part of India or Cedi, opposed to KṚṢṆA and slain by him: his death forms the subject of one of the Hindu epic poems, thence named Śiśupāla Badha, by MĀGHA. E. शिशु a child, and पाल who cherishes.
38459: शिशुपालक m. (-कः) 1 A king: see the last. 2 A plant, (Nauclea cordifolia.) E. शिशु a child, पाल who or what pleases or cherishes, aff. कन्.
38460: शिशुपालहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA. E. शिशुपाल the king so named, and हन् destroyer.
38461: शिशुमार m. (-रः) 1 The gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus gangeticus.) 2 The heavenly porpoise, or collection of the stars and planets. 3 A name or form of VIṢṆU. E. शिशु a child, and मार what kills.
38462: शिशुवाहक m. (-कः) A wild goat. E. शिशु a child, वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्.
38463: शिशुवाह्यक m. (-कः) A wild goat. E. शिशु a child, वह to bear, ण्यत् aff., and कन् added.
38464: शिश्न m. (-श्नः) The penis. E. शश to move, aff. नक्, form irr.
38465: शिश्विदान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Innocent, virtuous. 2 Guilty, sinful, wicked. E. श्वित to be white, (pure or virtuous,) आनच् Uṇādi aff., त changed to द, and the reduplicate form of the root.
38466: शिष r. 1st cl. (शेषति) To hurt, to injure or kill. r. 1st and 10th cls. (शेषति शेषयति) 1 To leave a residue, not to use the whole. 2 (usually with षि prefixed,) To excel. (ऌ and with षि prefixed) विशिष्टृ r. 7th cl. (विषिनष्टि) To assign attributes or qualities to, to distinguish, to individualize, to specify.
