38467: शिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Obedient, docile. 2 Ordered, commanded, disciplined, trained. 3 Chief, principal, eminent, select. 4 Left, remaining. m. (-ष्टः) 1 A courtier, a counsellor. 2 A chief. E. शास to order, aff. क्त, form irr., or शिष to leave, क्त aff.
38468: शिष्टता f. (-ता) 1 Good behaviour, urbanity, civility. 2 Docility. 3 The property of being left or remaining. E. शिष्टि, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शिष्टित्व.
38469: शिष्टसभा f. (-भा) A council of state, an assembly of chief officers. E. शिष्ट, and सभा an assembly.
38470: शिष्टसभाचार m. (-रः) History or tradition of eminent persons. E. शिष्ट, and सभाचार account.
38471: शिष्टाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Well-behaved. m. (-रः) Good manners, proper behaviour. E. शिष्ट, and आचार observance.
38472: शिष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 An order or command. 2 Ruling, commanding. 3 Correcting, keeping in order. 4 Personal correction or chastisement. E. शास to order, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.
38473: शिष्ट्वा ind. 1 Having confessed publicly, or proclaimed. 2 Having governed, regulated, trained, &c. E. शास to rule or शिष to hurt, क्त्वा aff.
38474: शिष्य (-ष्यः) 1 A pupil, a scholar. 2 Passion, anger. 3 Violence. E. शास to order, aff. क्यप्, and the vowel changed to इ.
38475: शिष्यशिष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Chastisement or correction of a pupil. E. शिष्य, and शिष्टि correction.
38476: शिह्ल m. (-ह्लः) Incense, benjamin or olibanum. E. ष्णिह to melt, लक् aff.; deriv. irr.; more usually सिह्ल, also with कन् added, शिह्लक.
38477: शी (ङ) शीङ् r. 2nd cl. (शेते) To sleep: with अति prefixed, to be profuse or copious, to be much or more, to exceed: with अधि to abide, to be; with सम् to doubt.
38478: शी f. (शीः) 1 Sleep, repose. 2 Devotion, tranquillity, indifference to every thing but the object of worship. E. शी to sleep, aff. क्विप्.
38479: शीक r. 1st cl. (ऋ) शीकृ (शेकते) To wet or moisten, to sprinkle. r. 10th cl. (शेकयति) 1 To endure patiently, to be patient. 2 To touch. 3 To wet, to moisten.
38480: शीकर m. (-रः) 1 Thin rain, or rain driven by wind. 2 A drop of water. n. (-रं) A sort of pine or its resin. E. शीक to sprinkle, aff. अरन्.
38481: शीकरौघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Abounding with mist, spray or thin rain. E. शीकर, and ओघ a heap.
38482: शीघ्र mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्रा-घ्रं) Quick, speedy. m. (-घ्रः) (In astronomy,) Parallax. n. adv. (-घ्रं) Quickly, swiftly. E. शिघ to smell, रक् aff. deriv. irr.
38483: शीघ्रग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going quick. E. शीघ्र, and ग who goes.
38484: शीघ्रगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going quick or expeditiously. E. शीघ्र quickly, and गामिन् who goes.
38485: शीघ्रचेतन m. (-नः) A dog. E. शीघ्र quickly, चेतन thinking, knowing.
38486: शीघ्रजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.) E. शीघ्र quick, जन्मन् birth.
38487: शीघ्रता f. (-ता) Quickness, speed. E. शीघ्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीघ्रत्वं.
38488: शीघ्रवेधिन् m. (-घी) A good archer, a good shot. E. शीघ्र quick, and वेधिन् who pierces.
38489: शीघ्रायमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Becoming quick or expeditious. E. शीघ्र nominal verb to be quick, शानच् aff.
38490: शीघ्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Quick, fleet. m. (-यः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 The fighting of cats. E. शीघ्र quick, and घ aff.
38491: शीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cold, chilly, frigid. 2 Idle, lazy. 3 Cold, dull, apathetic, stupid. 4 Decocted, boiled. n. (-तं) 1 Cold, coldness. 2 Water. 3 Cold weather or the six months of the rainy, dewy and cold seasons. m. (-तः) A small tree, (Cordia myxa.) 2 A kind of ratan, (Calamus fasciculatus.) 3 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) 4 The Nīmb tree. 5 Camphor. f. (-ता) 1 The wife of RĀMA. 2 A furrow. E. श्यै to go, aff. क्त, the fem. form more usually occurs सीता, q. v.
38492: शीतक m. (-कः) 1 Cold weather or the cold season, winter. 2 A lazy man, one who is dilatory or dull. 3 One devoid of care or anxiety, a happy man. 4 A plant, (Marsilea dentata.) 5 A scorpion. E. क added to the preceding.
38493: शीतकाल n. (-लं) Cold weather, winter. E. शीत, and काल time.
38494: शीतकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Produced in winter. E. शीतकाल, and ख aff.
38495: शीतकृच्छ्र m. (-च्छ्रः) A religious penance, drinking cold water three days, cold milk three days, cold Ghee three days, and fasting three. E. शीत cold, and कृच्छ्र penance.
38496: शीतकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A flower, (Nerium odorum.) f. (-म्भा) An aquatic plant. E. शीत cold, कुम्भ a water-pot.
38497: शीतक्षार n. (-रं) Refined Borax. E. शीत cold, and क्षार nitre.
38498: शीतगन्ध n. (-न्धं) White Sandal. E. शीत cold, and गन्ध smell.
38499: शीतगु m. (-गुः) The moon. E. शीत cold, and गु neut. form of गो a ray of light, here forming a masc. compound.
38500: शीतचम्पक m. (-कः) 1 A lamp. 2 Pleasing, satisfying. 3 A mirror. E. शीत cold, cool, and चम्पक a flower.
38501: शीतता f. (-ता) Cold, coldness. E. शीत, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीतत्वं.
38502: शीतपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Cleome pentaphylla.) E. शीत cool, पर्ण a leaf.
38503: शीतपल्लव m. (-वः) A plant, (Ardisea solanacea.) E. शीत cool, and पल्लव a shoot.
38504: शीतपाकिनी f. (-नी) A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. E. शीत the cold (in a cold climate), पाक ripening, and इनि aff.
38505: शीतपाकी f. (-की) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. 2 A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) E. शीत cold, (in cold weather, &c.) पाक a ripening, ङीप् fem. aff.
38506: शीतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Sirisha tree. n. (-ष्पं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. शीत cold, (in the cold weather, &c.) and पुष्प a flower.
38507: शीतपुष्पक n. (-कं) Storax or Benzoin. E. शीत cold (in the snowy mountains), पुष्प a flower, कन् aff.
38508: शीतप्रभ m. (-भः) Camphor. E. शीत cool, and प्रभ shining.
38509: शीतभानु m. (-नुः) The moon. E. शीत cool, and भानु the sun.
38510: शीतभीरु f. (-रुः) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) E. शीत the cold, and भीरु afraid.
38511: शीतभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Eating cold viands. E. शीत, भुज to eat, णिनि aff.
38512: शीतमयूख m. (-खः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. शीत cool, मयूख a ray of light.
38513: शीतमरीचि m. (-चिः) The moon. E. शीत cool, मरीचि a ray.
38514: शीतमूलक n. (-कं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. शीत cool, and मूलक a root.
38515: शीतरम्य m. (-म्यः) A lamp. E. शीत cool, and रम्य agreeable.
38516: शीतरुच् m. (-रुक्) The moon. E. शीत, and रुच् light.
38517: शीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Cold, chilly, frigid. n. (-लं) 1 Green vitriol. 2 Storax. 3 Sandal. 4 White Sandal. 5 A lotus. 6 A pearl. 7 Cold, coldness. 8 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. m. (-लः) 1 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) 2 A Jina or Jaina teacher, the 10th of the twenty-four Tīrthakaras. 3 A religious ceremony observed upon the sun's entering Aries. 4 The moon. 5 A small tree, (Cordia myxa.) 6 The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.) 7 A sort of camphor. 8 Turpentine. f. (-ला-ली) 1 A plant, perhaps intending the Phrynium dichotymum, from the split stems of which a smooth, cool mat is made, thence termed Sitalpāti. 2 Small-pox. 3 The goddess presiding over or inflicting small-pox. E. शीत cool, लच् poss. aff., or ला to give or get, aff. क.
38518: शीतलता f. (-ता) Coldness, coolness. E. शीतल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीतलत्वं.
38519: शीतलप्रद m. (-दः) Sandal. E. शीतल cold, and प्रद who gives.
38520: शीतलवात m. (-तः) A cool wind. E. शीतल, and वात wind.
38521: शीतलवातक m. (-कः) A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. शीतल cool, वात wind, कन् added.
38522: शीतलषष्ठी f. (-ष्ठी) The sixth of the light half of Māgha, when only cold food is eaten. E. शीतल, and षष्ठी sixth.
38523: शीतशिव n. (-वं) 1 A sort of resin, (Storax benzoin.) 2 Rock salt. m. (-वः) 1 A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 2 The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) E. शीत cool, and शिव auspicious.
38524: शीतशूक m. (-कः) Barley. E. शीत cold, and शूक an awn or beard.
38525: शीतसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing or enduring cold. m. (-हः) A Pīlu, or tree so named, growing in the Himāla mountains. E. शीत cold, and सह enduring.
38526: शीतहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Removing cold. E. शीत, and हर what takes.
38527: शीतांशु m. (-शुः) 1 Camphor. 2 The moon. E. शीत cold, अंशु a ray.
38528: शीताकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Benumbed, frozen. E. शीत, and आकुल perplexed.
38529: शीताद m. (-दः) Scorbutic affection of the gums. E. शीत, and अद what eats.
38530: शीताद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The snowy mountains. E. शीत cold, and अद्रि a mountain.
38531: शीतार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Cold, chilled, shivering, suffering or shrinking from cold. E. शीत cold, and आर्त्त pained.
38532: शीतालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Cold, shivering, shrinking from cold. E. शीत cold, आलुच् aff., here implying aversion or impatience.
38533: शीताश्मन् m. (-श्मा) The moon gem, crystal. E. शीत cold, अश्मन् a stone.
38534: शीतीभाव m. (-वः) 1 Final emancipation. 2 Coolness, composure. 3 Cold, coldness. E. शीत cold, भाव nature, च्चि augment.
38535: शीतोत्तम n. (-मं) Water. E. शीत cold, उत्तम best.
38536: शीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Ploughed, tilled: more usually सीत्य. 2 To be cooled or chilled. E. शीत cold, or शीता a furrow, यत् aff.
38537: शीत्कार m. (-रः) Uttering a sound expressive of pleasurable sensations. E. शीत् imitative sound, and कार making; also with कृत made, uttered, शीत्कृत n. (-तं).
38538: शीधु mn. (-धुः-घु) Rum, distilled from molasses. E. शी to sleep, or rest, Uṇādi aff. धक्.
38539: शीधुगन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) E. शीधु rum, and गन्ध smell.
38540: शीधुप mf. (-पः-पी) A drinker of spirits, a dram-drinker. E. शीधु spirits, and पा to drink, aff. टक्.
38541: शीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thick, congealed, (as oil or butter.) m. (-नः) 1 A fool, a blockhead. 2 A large snake. E. श्यै to go, aff. क्त.
38542: शीफालिका f. (-का) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis:) see शेफालिका.
38543: शीभ (ऋ) शीभृ r. 10th cl. (शीभते) 1 To praise, to flatter. 2 To boast.
38545: शीभ्य m. (-भ्यः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A bull. E. शीभ to praise, यत् aff.
38546: शीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Going away, dissipating, dispersing, departing. E. शद to go, शानच् aff., शीय substituted for the radical letters.
38547: शीर m. (-रः) A large snake, (Boa constrictor.) E. शी to sleep, रक् Uṇādi aff.
38548: शीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं.) 1 Thin, small, slender. 2 Wasted, withered, decayed. E. शॄ to injure, aff. क्त, form irr.
38549: शीर्णता f. (-ता) Emaciation, withering. E. शीर्ण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीर्णत्वं.
38550: शीर्णनाला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.) E. शीर्ण shrivelled or slender, नाल stem.
38551: शीर्णपत्र m. (-त्रः) A tree, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) E. शीर्ण withered, and पत्र a leaf.
38552: शीर्णपाद m. (-दः) YAMA, the deity of Tartarus. E. शीर्ण shrivelled, and पाद a foot.
38553: शीर्णपुष्पिका f. (-का) A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शीर्ण shrunk, पुष्प a flower, कन् aff., fem. form.
38554: शीर्णवृन्त n. (-न्तं) A water-melon. E. शीर्ण slender, and वृन्त footstalk.
38555: शीर्णाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) YAMA, judge of the dead. E. शीर्ण shrivelled, and अङ्घ्रि a foot: being shrunk up in consequence of a curse of his mother's.
38556: शीर्व्वि mfn. (-र्व्विः-र्व्विः-र्व्वि) Mischievous, malignant, hurtful, savage. E. शॄ to injure, क्विन् Uṇādi aff.
38557: शीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The head. E. see शिरस्, for which it is substituted.
38558: शीर्षक n. (-कं) 1 A helmet. 2 The skull. 3 Judgment, award, sentence, the fruit or result of judicial investigation. m. (-कः) Rāhu, the personified ascending node. E. कन् added to the last.
38559: शीर्षकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Staying in or on the head. 2 Abiding by an award, agreeing to submit to the penalty imposed by it. E. शीर्षक, and स्थ who stays.
38560: शीर्षघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Beheading, decapitating. 2 Striking or injuring the head. E. शीर्ष the head, हन to strike, aff. णिनि.
38561: शीर्षछेद m. (-दः) Decapitating. E. शीर्ष, and छेद cutting; also शीर्षछेदन.
38562: शीर्षछेदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Meriting decapitation. E. शीर्ष the head, and छेद cutting, aff. ठक्.
38563: शीर्षछेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what decapitates. E. शीर्ष, and छेदिन् who cuts.
38564: शीर्षछेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Meriting death by decapitation. E. शीर्ष the head, छेद्य to be cut off.
38565: शीर्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) A helmet. m. (-ण्यः) Clean and unentangled hair. E. शीर्षन् substituted for शिरस्, and यत् aff.
38566: शीर्षरक्ष n. (-क्षं) A helmet. E. शीर्ष the head, and रक्ष preserving.
38567: शील r. 1st cl. (शीलति) 1 To meditate, to consider, to reflect profoundly and abstractedly. 2 To worship, to adore. r. 1st and 10th cls. (शीलति शीलयति) To practise, to exercise, (as the memory, &c.) to repeat. r. 10th cl. (शीलयति) 1 To wear. 2 To have or be endowed with.
38568: शील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Possessed of, endowed with, practising, versed in, &c. 2 Behaving, conducted. 3 Well-behaved, well-disposed. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Nature, quality. 2 Disposition, inclination. 3 Good conduct or disposition, steady and uniform observance of law and morals. 4 Beauty. m. (-लः) A large snake. E. शील to meditate, to learn, &c., aff. घञ्; or शी to sleep, and लक् Uṇādi aff.
38569: शीलत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Disposition, quality. 2 Conversancy. E. शील, and त्व added; also with तल्, शीलता.
38570: शीलन n. (-नं) Careful study of the Śāstras or sacred writings. E. शील to meditate, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
38571: शीलवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Of a good or amiable disposition. E. शील good conduct, मतुप् poss. aff.
38572: शीलवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Moral, steady, and uniform in good behaviour. E. शील, and वृत्त practice.
38573: शीलसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Well-conducted, of proper conduct or disposition. E. शील, and सम्पन्न abounding with.
38574: शीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Skilled, learned, conversant, exercised. 2 Having, endowed with. 3 Made or consisting of. E. शील to learn, &c., aff. क्त.
38575: शीवन् m. (-वा) A large snake, the Boa. E. शी to sleep, क्वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
38576: शीवल n. (-लं) 1 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) 2 Benzoin or Storax. E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलच् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also शैवाल, &c.
38577: शुंशुमार m. (-रः) A porpoise; more usually शिशुमार.
38578: शु ind. 1 Handsomely, brilliantly, elegantly. 2 Well, right. E. शुभ to be splendid, aff. ड.
38579: शुक r. 1st cl. (शोकति) 1 To go. 2 To touch.
38580: शुक m. (-कः) 1 A parrot. 2 The son of VYĀSA, the author or narrator of the Bhāgavata. 3 The minister of RĀVAṆA. 4 The Śirīṣa tree. 5 A plant, commonly Seyālkānta. n. (-कं) 1 A drug and perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 The ends or hem of a cloth. 4 A turban, a helmet. 5 A plant,  (Bignonia Indica.) E. शुभ to shine, कक् Uṇādi aff., and the radical final rejected.
38581: शुकछद n. (-दं) A fragrant root, of which various kinds are said to be known. E. शुक a parrot, and च्छद a cover or wing.
38582: शुकजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, commonly Sūya Tonta or parrot's beak. E. शुक a parrot, and जिह्वा the tongue.
38583: शुकतरु m. (-रुः) The Śirīṣa, (Acacia Sirisha.) E. शुक the same, and तरु a tree.
38584: शुकदेव m. (-वः) The son of VYĀSA; see शुक. E. शुक, and देव divine.
38585: शुकद्रुम m. (-मः) The Śirīṣa tree: see the last.
38586: शुकनामा f. (-मा) A plant; see शुकजिह्वा.
38587: शुकनास m. (-सः) 1 A tree, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 Another tree, Sesbana grandiflora.) E. शुक, and नास the nose, the flowers being compared to a parrot's beak.
38588: शुकपितामह m. (-हः) The sage PARĀŚARA, father of VYĀSA, and grandfather of ŚUKA.
38589: शुकपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) Sulphur. E. शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail; of similar colour.
38590: शुकपुच्छक n. (-कं) A perfume and medicinal root, commonly Ganṭhiāla. E. शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail, कन् aff. of comparison.
38591: शुकप्रिया f. (-या) The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.) E. शुक a parrot, and प्रिया beloved.
38593: शुकवर्ह n. (-ह) Ganṭhiāla, a perfume. E. शुक a parrot, and वर्ह a tail.
38594: शुकवल्लभ m. (-भः) The pomegranate. E. शुक a parrot, and वल्लभ beloved.
38595: शुकवाह m. (-हः) KĀMADEVA. E. शुक a parrot, and वाह who is borne.
38596: शुकादन m. (-नः) The pomegranate. E. शुक a parrot, and अदन eating.
38597: शुकानना f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Sūya Tonta. E. शुक a parrot, and आनन the face.
38598: शुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Sour, acid. 2 Pure, clean. 3 Harsh, hard. n. (-क्तं) 1 Flesh. 2 Sour-gruel. 3 Vinegar, acid, or an acid preparation made from roots or fruits, by steeping them in oil and salt, drying them, and then leaving them in water, where they undergo the acetous fermentation: the fluid produce is used as vinegar. 4 Crabbed or harsh speech. 5 A hymn of the Vedas. f. (-क्ता) A sort of sorrel. E. शुच to be pure, &c., aff. क्त.
38599: शुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 A pearl oyster. 2 A conch. 3 A small shell. 4 A cockle. 5 A sort of perfume, in appearance a dried shell fish. 6 A portion of the skull used as a cup, &c. 7 A curl or feather on a horse's neck or breast. 8 A weight of two Karṣas or half a Pala. A disease of the cornea, formation of specks on it. E. शुच् to sorrow, &c., aff. क्तिच्.
38600: शुक्तिका f. (-का) 1 A pearl oyster. 2 A sort of dock or sorrel. E. शुक्ति as above, or शुक्त sour, कन् added, fem. form.
38601: शुक्तिज n. (-जं) A pearl. E. शुक्ति the oyster, and ज born.
38602: शुक्तिपुट n. (-टं) The pearl oyster shell. E. शुक्ति, and पुट a bag or sheathe
38603: शुक्तिपेशी f. (-शी) The envelope of the pearl or pearl oyster shell. E. शुक्ति, and पेशी a covering.
38604: शुक्तिबधू f. (-धूः) Mother of pearl or the pearl oyster. E. शुक्ति, and बधू wife or female; in which the pearl, it is supposed, is bred.
38605: शुक्तिमत् m. (-मान्) One of the seven principal mountains or mountainous ranges of India. E. शुक्ति a pearl oyster, and मतुप् aff.
38606: शुक्तिवीज n. (-जं) A pearl. E. शुक्ति the oyster, and वीज a seed.
38607: शुक्तिस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) Dusky spots on a pearl, causing it to be of little value. E. शुक्ति a pearl, and स्पर्श contact.
38608: शुक्र m. (-क्रः) 1 The planet VENUS or its regent, the son of BHṚGU, and preceptor of the Daityas or Titans. 2 A name of fire. 3 The month Jyeṣṭha, (April-May.) n. (-क्रं) 1 Semen virile. 2 A morbid affection of the iris, change of colour, ulceration, &c. accompanied by imperfect vision. E. शुच् to grieve, &c., Uṇādi aff. रन्, deriv. irr.
38609: शुक्रकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Producing semen, spermatic. m. (-रः) The marrow of the bones. E. शुक्र seed, and कर what makes.
38610: शुक्रभुज् m. (-भुक्) A peacock. E. शुक्र semen, भुज to eat, aff. क्विप्.
38611: शुक्रभू f. (-भूः) The marrow of the bones. E. शुक्र semen, and भू being.
38612: शुक्रल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Spermatic, augmenting the seminal secretion. f. (-ला) A fragrant grass, considered by some as a sort of Cyperus, and by others, Zedoary. E. शुक्र semen, and लच् aff., or ला to get or give, aff. क.
38613: शुक्रवार m. (-रः) Friday. E. शुक्र ŚUKRA, the regent of VENUS, or the planet, and वार a day.
38614: शुक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sacred to ŚUKRA, &c. E. शुक्र as above, and घन् aff.
38615: शुक्रशिष्य m. (-ष्यः) A demon, a Titan, a powerful being opposed to the gods. E. शुक्र the teacher of this race, and शिष्य a pupil.
38616: शुक्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The regent of VENUS. E. शुक्र, and आचार्य्य teacher.
38617: शुक्ल mfn. (-क्लः-क्ला-क्लं) White, of a white colour. m. (-क्लः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 One of the astronomical Yogas. n. (-क्लं) 1 Silver. 2 Fresh butter. 3 A disease of the cornea, opacity, albugo. m. (-क्लः) One half of a month: see शुक्लपक्ष. f. (-क्ला) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ. 2 Clayed or candied sugar. E. शुच to be pure, &c., Uṇādi aff. रन्, and र changed to ल.
38618: शुक्लकण्ठक m. (-कः) A kind of gallinule or water-hen. E. शुक्ल white, कण्ठ the throat, and कन् aff.
38619: शुक्लकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Innocent, virtuous. E. शुक्ल white, pure, and कर्म्मन् act.
38620: शुक्लत्व n. (-त्वं) Whiteness. E. शुक्ल white, and त्व aff.; also with तल् aff. शुक्लता.
38621: शुक्लदुग्ध m. (-ग्धः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) E. शुक्ल white, दुग्ध milk.
38622: शुक्लधातु m. (-तुः) Chalk. E. शुक्ल white, and धातु a mineral.
38623: शुक्लपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The light half of a month, the fifteen days of the moon's increase, or from new to full moon. E. शुक्ल white, and पक्ष part or fortnight.
38624: शुक्लपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 The white variety of Amaranth, (Gomphrœna globosa.) 2 A species of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.) f. (-ष्पा) 1 A shrub, (Phrynium dichotomum.) 2 A sort of sun-flower. E. शुक्ल white, and पुष्प a flower.
38625: शुक्लपृष्ठक m. (-कः) A small tree, (Vitex nigundo.)
38626: शुक्लबल m. (-लः) A name, common to nine persons peculiar to the Jainas. E. शुक्ल white, and बल a BALADEVA, there being nine white BALADEVAS, corresponding to the nine KṚṢṆAS, or black VĀSUDEVAS, according to the notions of this sect.
38627: शुक्लमण्डल n. (-लं) The white of the eye, the cornea. E. शुक्ल white, and मण्डल a circle.
38628: शुक्लवर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A class of white objects, or the conch, pearloyster, and cowrie, &c. E. शुक्ल white, and वर्ग a class.
38629: शुक्लवायस m. (-सः) A crane. E. शुक्ल white, and वायस a crow.
38630: शुक्लाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having a white body or limbs. m. (-ङ्गः) A peacock. E. शुक्ल white, and अङ्ग body.
38631: शुक्लापाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A peacock. E. शुक्ल white, and अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye.
38632: शुक्लिमन् m. (-मा) Whiteness. E. शुक्ल white, and इमनिच् aff.
38633: शुक्लीकरण n. (-णं) Whitening, making white. E. शुक्ल, and करण making, च्चि aff.
38634: शुक्लीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made white, whitened. E. शुक्ल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
38635: शुक्लोपला f. (-ला) 1 Clayed or candied sugar. 2 Any white stone. E. शुक्ल white, and उपला a stone.
38636: शुक्षि m. (-क्षिः) Air, wind. E. शुष to dry up, Uṇādi aff. क्षि.
38637: शुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 2 The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.) f. (-ङ्गा) 1 The sheath or calyx of a young bud. 2 The waved leaf fig. 3 The awn of barley, &c. E. शम to rest or pacify, aff. गच्; form irr.
38638: शुङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) The Indian fig tree. E. शुङ्ग the calyx of the bud, and इनि aff.
38639: शुच r. 1st cl. (शोचति) To regret, to grieve for. r. 4th cl. (ई इर) ईशुचिर (शुच्यति) 1 To be wet. 2 To be clean or pure. 3 To stink, to be fetid. 4 To wound.
38640: शुच् f. (शुक्) 1 Sorrow, grief, distress, regret. 2 Calamity, affliction. E. शुच to regret, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added, शुचा f. (-चा.)
38641: शुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) 1 White. 2 Clean, cleansed, purified. 3 Pure, pious, exempt from passion or vice. 4 Correct, free from fault or error. m. (-चिः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 Purification by ablution, &c. 3 Judicial acquittal. 4 Mental purity, virtue, goodness. 5 Accuracy, correctness. 6 The condition of the religious student. 7 A faithful and tried minister or friend. 8 The month Āṣārha, (June-July.) 9 The month Jyeṣṭha, (May-June.) 10 The hot season. 11 The passion or sentiment of love. 12 ŚIVA. 13 The sun. 14 The moon. 15 The planet VENUS, or its ruler. 16 A name of fire. 17 A Brahman. 18 Oblation to fire at the first feeding of an infant. E. शुच to purify, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and the vowel unchanged.
38642: शुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sad, lamenting. 2 Pure, clean, cleansed. E. शुच to grieve, क्त aff.
38643: शुचिता f. (-ता) Purity, cleanness. E. शुचि, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शुचित्वं.
38644: शुचिप्रणी f. (-णीः) Sipping water, rinsing the mouth, &c. E. शुचि purification, and प्रणी effecting.
38645: शुचिमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal. E. शुचि white, and मणि a gem.
38646: शुचिरोचिस् m. (-चीः) The moon. E. शुचि white, and रोचिस् light.
38647: शुचिव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pious, virtuous. E. शुचि, and व्रत obligation.
38648: शुचिस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smiled, smiling sweetly, accompanied with a sweet smile. E. शुचि white, (from the teeth being shewn,) and स्मित smiled.
38649: शुच्य (ई) शुच्यी r. 1st cl. (शुच्यति) 1 To bathe. 2 To distil. 3 To express or squeeze out. 4 To churn. 5 To pain or distress.
38650: शुटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Heroism, prowess. E. शौटीर a hero, यत् aff.: see the next.
38651: शुटीरता f. (-ता) Valour, heroism. E. शौटीर a hero, तल् aff., and the diphthong changed to the short vowel.
38652: शुठ r. 1st and 10th cls. (शोठति शोठयति) also (इ) शुठि (शुण्ठतिशुण्ठयति) 1 To be prevented or obstructed. 2 To have any impediment to motion, to be lame, &c. 2 To be lazy, to be dull or slow. 4 To be or become dry or desiccated. 5 To dry, to desiccate.
38654: शुण्ठि f. (-ण्ठिः-ण्ठी) Dry ginger. E. शुठि to be stopped, (by it, phlegm,) aff. अच्, and fem. aff. ङीप्, or in one case इन् aff.
38655: शुण्ठ्य n. (-ण्ठ्यं) Dry ginger. E. शुठि to be stopped, (disease by it,) and यत् aff.
38656: शुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The exudation from an elephant's temples. f. (-ण्डा) 1 A tavern. 2 Spirituous liquor. 3 An animal called the waterelephant, the hippopotamus perhaps. 4 An elephant's proboscis or trunk. 5 The stalk of the lotus. 6 A whore. 7 A bawd. E. शुण to go, aff. ड, fem. aff. टाप्.
38657: शुण्डक m. (-कः) 1 A distiller. 2 A military flute or fife(?) E. कन् added to the preceding.
38658: शुण्डापान n. (-नं) A place where spirits are sold, a tavern, a dram shop. E. शुण्डा spirits, and पान drinking.
38659: शुण्डार m. (-रः) A distiller, a vintner. E. शुण्डा spirits, र aff.
38660: शुण्डाल m. (-लः) An elephant. E. शुण्डा his trunk, लच् poss. aff.
38661: शुण्डिका f. (-का) The soft palate. E. शुण्डा an elephant's proboscis, कन् fem. form.
38662: शुण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 1 A distiller, a preparer and vender of spirituous liquor. 2 An elephant. E. शुण्डा spirits, &c., इनि aff.
38663: शुतुद्रि f. (-द्रिः) The Śatadru river or Setlej; see शतद्रु.
38665: शुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pure, purified, clean, cleansed. 2 Faultless, correct. 3 Alone, only, mere, simple. 4 White. 5 Whetted, sharp, (as an arrow.) 6 Authorised, admitted. 7 Innocent. 8 Acquitted. n. (-द्धं) 1 Pure spirit. 2 Rock salt. E. शुध to be or make pure, &c., aff. क्त.
38666: शुद्धकोटि f. (-टिः) One of the sides of a right-angled triangle. E. शुद्ध, and कोटि flank.
38667: शुद्धजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) An ass. E. शुद्ध clean, pure, and जङ्घा the thigh or leg.
38668: शुद्धत्व n. (-त्वं) Purity, cleanness, freedom from soil or defect. E. त्व added to शुद्ध; also with तल्, शुद्धता.
38669: शुद्धदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) White-toothed, having handsome teeth. E. शुद्ध, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
38670: शुद्धधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Of pure understanding. E. शुद्ध, and धी intellect.
38671: शुद्धबध m. (-धः) Simple putting to death, i. e. in any ordinary way. E. शुद्ध, and बध putting to death.
38672: शुद्धमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Of pure or sincere purposes, honest, free from guile. 2 Intelligent. m. (-तिः) One of the Jaina pontiffs of the last age. E. शुद्ध pure, मति understanding.
38673: शुद्धवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Of a good colour, caste, &c. 2 Welllettered. E. शुद्ध, and वर्ण colour, &c.
38674: शुद्धवल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. शुद्ध pure, वल्ली pedicle, कन् added, fem. form.
38675: शुद्धवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Clean, having clean vesture. E. शुद्ध, and वासस् clothes.
38676: शुद्धानुमान n. (-नं) A figure of rhetoric. E. शुद्ध correct, and अनुमान inference.
38677: शुद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A seraglio, a Haram. 2 The private or women's apartments in the palace of a prince. 3 The king's wife or concubine. E. शुद्ध pure, and अन्त end, limit.
38678: शुद्धान्तपालक m. (-कः) A eunuch or an attendant on the women's apartments. E. शुद्धान्त the Haram, and पालक a guard.
38679: शुद्धान्तयुज् f. (-युक्) Change of mode or key in music.
38680: शुद्धापह्नुति f. (-तिः) A figure of rhetoric. E. शुद्ध correct, अपह्नुति concealment.
38681: शुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Cleaning, cleansing. 2 Purity, purification. 3 Correction, correctness. 4 Innocence established by ordeal or trial, acquittal. E. शुध to be or make pure, &c., aff. क्तिन.
38682: शुद्धिभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Clean, clear, free from soil. 2 Pure, virtuous. E. शुद्धि, and भृत् having.
38683: शुद्धोदन m. (-नः) King of KAPILA and father of ŚĀKYA. E. शुद्ध, and ओदन rice, food.
38684: शुद्धोदनसुत m. (-तः) ŚĀKYA, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. शुद्धोदन the father of this personage, and सुत son.
38685: शुध (ओ ऌ) औशुधॢ r. 4th cl. (शुध्यति) To be or become pure or purified.
38686: शुन m. (-नः) A dog. E. शुण to go, अच् aff.: see शुनि, श्वन्, &c.; also with कन् added शुनक.
38687: शुनाशीर m. (-रः) INDRA. E. सु good, venerable, नासीर van of his army, the स in each case changed; also शुनासीर, and more correctly, सुनासीर.
38688: शुनि m. (-निः) A dog. f. (-नी) A bitch. E. शुण to go, इक् aff. or श्वन् with ङीष् aff., and the semivowel changed
38689: शुनिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Suckled by a bitch. E. शुनी, and धे to suck, खश् aff.
38690: शुनीर m. (-रः) A number of dogs.
38691: शुन्ध r. 1st and 10th cls. (शुन्धति-ते शुन्धयति-ते) 1 To be or become pure. 2 To cleanse, to purify.
38692: शुन्ध्यु m. (-न्ध्युः) Fire. E. शुधि to purify, चुश् Uṇādi aff.
38693: शुन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Empty, void. n. (-न्यं) 1 A number of dogs. 2 A cypher. E. श्वन् a dog, and यत् aff., the vowel substituted for the semivowel, more commonly शून्य.
38694: शुभ r. 1st cl. (शोभति-ते) r. 6th cl. (शुभति) 1 To be splendid, to shine. 2 To be beautiful or handsome. r. 1st and 6th cls. (शोभति शुभति) To hurt or injure, to kill. r. 1st cl. (शोभति) To speak.
38695: शुभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Happy, well, right, fortunate, auspicious. 2 Handsome, beautiful. 3 Splendid, shining. 4 Eminent, distinguished. 5 Learned, versed in the Vedas, &c. n. (-भं) 1 Good, good fortune, auspiciousness, happiness. m. (-भः) One of the astrological Yogas. f. (-भा) 1 An assemblage of the gods. 2 A female friend and companion of the goddess UMĀ. 3 Bambu manna. 4 Bent grass. 5 The Śami tree. 6 A yellow pigment: see गोरोचना. 7 Light, lustre. 8 Beauty. E. शुभ to shine, aff. क.
38696: शुभंयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Happy, fortunate, prosperous. E. शुभं happy, युस् poss. aff.
38697: शुभकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Propitious, producing good, &c. E. शुभ, and कर what makes: also शुभङ्कर.
38698: शुभकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Pious or virtuous act. 2 Reputable occupation or employment. E. शुभ, and कर्म्मन् act.
38699: शुभग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Elegant, graceful. 2 Fortunate, propitious. E. शुभ, and गम to go or obtain, ड aff.
38700: शुभङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, conferring happiness or fortune. f. (-री) PĀRVATĪ. E. शुभ happiness, कृ to make, खच् aff.
38701: शुभद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Propitious, auspicious. E. शुभ, and द who or what gives.
38702: शुभदन्ती f. (-न्ती) 1 The female elephant of the N. W. quarter. 2 A woman with good teeth. E. शुभ handsome, दन्त tooth, ङीप् aff.; elsewhere read शुभ्रदन्ती.
38703: शुभफल n. (-लं) Happy result or consequence. E. शुभ, and फल fruit.
38704: शुभलग्न m. (-ग्नः) An auspicious moment. E. शुभ, and लग्न rise of a planet.
38705: शुभवासन m. (-नः) Perfume for the mouth. E. शुभ auspicious, वासन perfuming.
38706: शुभशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a good disposition. E. शुभ, and शील disposition.
38707: शुभस्थली f. (-ली) A room or hall in which sacrifices are offered. E. शुभ auspicious, and स्थल place.
38708: शुभाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Handsome, elegant. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 The wife of KĀMA. 2 The wife of KUVERA. 3 A handsome woman. E. शुभ handsome, and अङ्ग body.
38709: शुभाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Virtuous. f. (-रा) A female attendant on UMĀ. E. शुभ, and आचार observance.
38710: शुभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga:) see शोभाञ्जन.
38711: शुभानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Handsome, good-looking. f. (-ना) A handsome woman. E. शुभ, and आनन face.
38712: शुभान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Happy, prosperous, fortunate. E. शुभ good fortune, and अन्वित endowed with.
38713: शुभापाङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A beautiful woman. E. शुभ, and अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye, for the eye or face.
38714: शुभाशुभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Prosperous and unfortunate, good and evil. n. (-भं) Good and ill fortune. E. शुभ, and अशुभ unlucky.
38715: शुभेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Unlucky, inauspicious. 2 Evil, bad. E. शुभ, and इतर other.
38716: शुभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं) 1 White. 2 Shining. m. (-भ्रः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 Sandal. n. (-भ्रं) 1 Talc. 2 Silver. 3 Green vitriol. f. (-भ्रा) 1 The Ganges. 2 Crystal. 3 Bambu manna. E. शुभ to shine, रक् aff.
38717: शुभ्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) The thirty-sixth year of the Indian cycle. E. शुभ्र white, and कृत् making.
38718: शुभ्रदन्ती f. (-न्ती) The female elephant of the north-west quarter. E. शुभ्र white, दन्त a tusk, ङीप् aff.
38719: शुभ्ररश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The sun. E. शुभ्र white, and रश्मि a ray.
38720: शुभ्रांशु m. (-शुः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. शुभ्र white, and अंशु a ray.
38721: शुभ्रि m. (-भ्रिः) BRAHMĀ. E. शुभ to be propitious, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
38722: शुम्भ r. 1st and 6th cls. (शुम्भति) 1 To shine, to be splendid or beautiful. 2 To be handsome. 3 To hurt or injure. 4 To speak.
38723: शुम्भ m. (-म्भः) An Asura or demon slain by DURGĀ.
38724: शुम्भघातिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. शुम्भ the Asura, and घातिनी destructress.
38725: शुम्भपुर nf. (-रं-री) A city and district, perhaps the modern Sambhalpur, in the district of Gondvāna. E. शुम्भ the Asura, and पुर city.
38726: शुम्भमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. शुम्भ the Asura, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
38727: शुर (ई) शुरी r. 4th cl. (शूर्य्यते) 1 To hurt, to kill. 2 To be stupid or insensible; also शूर.
38728: शुर m. (-रः) A lion. E. शुर to injure, aff. क.
38729: शुल्क r. 10th cl. (शुल्कयति) 1 To speak. 2 To gain or acquire. 3 To create. 4 To abandon, to leave or forsake.
38730: शुल्क mn. (-ल्कः-ल्कं) 1 Toll, duty, customs or taxes. 2 A present made by the bridegroom to the bride, at the time of bringing her home to his family; a marriage settlement or dower. 3 Money given to the parents of the bride. 4 Money given at the purchase of any thing to ratify the bargain. 5 The profits of household labour, employment of domestic utensils, care of milch cattle, preservation of ornaments, superintendence of servants, &c. when considered as the perquisite of the wife and her own legal property. E. शुल्क to quit, aff. घञ्.
38731: शुल्कस्थान n. (-नं) Any object of taxation or duty. E. शुल्क, and स्थान place.
38732: शुल्कहानि f. (-निः) Loss or forfeiture of wages, dower, &c. E. शुल्क, and हानि privation.
38733: शुल्ल n. (-ल्लं) A cord, a rope or string.
38734: शुल्व r. 10th cl. (शुल्वयति) 1 To measure. 2 To create.
38735: शुल्व subst. mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वा-ल्वी-ल्वं) 1 A rope, a cord, a string. n. (-ल्वं) 1 Copper. 2 A sacrificial observance. 3 Institute, law. 4 A quantity of water. E. शुल्व to measure, aff. अच्; or शुघ to be pure, &c., Uṇādi aff. वन्, and ध changed to ल.
38736: शुल्वारि m. (-रिः) Sulphur. E. शुल्व copper, and अरि a foe.
38737: शुशुमा f. (-मा) The wife of ŚUKRA.
38738: शुश्रुवस् mfn. (-वान्-वुषी-वत्) Heard, having heard. E. श्रु to hear, aff. क्वसु.
38739: शुश्रूषक m. (-कः) A servant, comprehending five descriptions of persons, a pupil, a religious pupil or the member of a religious community under a common head, a hired servant, an officer or deputy, and a slave. E. श्रु to hear, desid. v., ण्वुल् aff.
38740: शुश्रूषण n. (-णं) Service, serving. E. श्रु to hear, desiderative form, ल्युट् aff.
38741: शुश्रूषा f. (-षा) 1 Service, serving of five kinds: see शुश्रूषक. 2 Saying, speaking, telling. 2 Wishing to hear. E. श्रु to hear, desiderative form, अच् aff., fem. aff. टाप्.
38742: शुश्रूषापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Diligent or attentive in service. E. शुश्रूषा, and पर intent on.
38743: शुश्रूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Obedient, serving, attending. E. श्रु to hear, desid. v., उ aff.
38744: शुष (औ, ऌ) औशुषॢ r. 4th cl. (शुष्यति) To dry.
38745: शुष m. (-षः) 1 Drying. 2 A hole in the ground. E. शुष to dry, aff. क.
38746: शुषि f. (-षिः-षी) 1 A hole, a chasm. 2 Drying. 3 The hollow or groove in the fang of a snake. E. शुष to dry, aff. कि.
38747: शुषिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Perforated, bored, pierced, full of holes or spaces. n. (-रं) 1 A hole, a vacuity, a chasm. 2 A wind-instrument. m. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 A rat. f. (-रा) 3 A sort of perfume, commonly Nalī. 2 A river in general. E. शुष to dry, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
38748: शुषिल m. (-लः) Air, wind. E. शुष to dry, किरच् aff., semivowel changed to ल.
38749: शुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) 1 Dry, dried. 2 Groundless, causeless. 3 Unproductive, unprofitable. E. शुष to dry, aff. क, or Uṇādi aff. कक्.
38750: शुष्कता f. (-ता) Dryness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शुष्कत्वं.
38751: शुष्कमांस n. (-सं) 1 Dry flesh. 2 Dried meat. E. शुष्क dry, मांस flesh.
38752: शुष्कल mfn. subst. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Dry flesh. adj. Eating fish and flesh. E. शुष to dry, कलच् Uṇādi aff. or शुष्क, and ला to take, aff. क.
38753: शुष्कवैर n. (-रं) Groundless enmity. E. शुष्क, and वैर enmity.
38754: शुष्कव्रण m. (-णः) A scar, a cicatrised sore. E. शुष्क dry, and व्रण a sore.
38755: शुष्काङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Emaciate, withered. f. (-ङ्गी) A lizard, a chameleon. E. शुष्क dry, अङ्ग the body.
38756: शुष्कान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice in the husk. E. शुष्क, and अन्न rice.
38757: शुष्कार्द्र n. (-र्द्रं) Dry ginger. E. शुष्क dry, and आर्द्र ginger.
38758: शुष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. शुष to dry, न Uṇādi aff.
38759: शुष्म m. (-ष्मः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 Air, wind. n. (-ष्मं) 1 Light, lustre. 2 Strength, prowess. E. शुष to dry, मन् aff.
38760: शुष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) Fire. n. (-ष्म) 1 Light, lustre. 2 Strength, prowess. E. शुष to dry, मनिन् aff.
38761: शुष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Drying. E. शुष to dry, शतृ aff.
38762: शूक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The awn of barley, &c. 2 A bristle, a spicula. 3 Compassion, clemency, tenderness. f. (-का) Cowach. E. शो to make sharp or thin, ऊक aff., deriv. irr.
38763: शूकक m. (-कः) 1 Barley, or a bearded kind of wheat resembling it. 2 The sentiment of compassion or tenderness. E. कन added to the last.
38764: शूककीट m. (-टः) A caterpillar. E. शूक a bristle, (the hairs on the insect,) and कीट a worm; also with कन् added शूककीटक.
38765: शूकतृण n. (-णं) A kind of grass. E. शूक an awn, and तृण grass.
38766: शूकधान्य n. (-न्यं) Awned or bearded grain, as barley, &c. E. शूक an awn, and धान्य grain.
38767: शूकपिण्डि f. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. शूक an awn, and पिण्डि a heap.
38768: शूकर m. (-रः) A hog. f. (-री) 1 A kind of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) 2 A sow. E. शूक an awn, (a bristle,) र aff., or शू imitative sound, कृ to make, with अच् and टाप् aff.
38769: शूकराक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A kind of moss, &c.: see the last; also वराहक्रान्ता.
38771: शूकवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Awned, bearded. f. (-ती) Cowach. E. शूक an awn, मतुप् aff.
38772: शूकशिम्बा f. (-म्बा) Cowach. E. शूक an awn, and शिम्बा a pod.
38773: शूकशिम्बि f. (-म्बिः-म्बी) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. शूक an awn, and शिम्बि a pod; also with कन् added शूकशिम्बिका.
38774: शूकापुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A gem, perhaps amber. E. शूक an awn, आङ् before पुट्ट to become small, अच् aff.
38775: शूकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Awned, bearded, (as grain.) E. शूक, and इनि aff.
38776: शूकुल m. (-लः) 1 A fish in general. 2 A kind of fish. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
38777: शूक्ष्म mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं) Minute, small, fine, subtile. m. (-क्ष्मः) 1 Fraud, dishonesty. 2 Universal spirit. E. स substituted for श in the more correct form सूक्ष्म, q. v.
38778: शूद्र m. (-द्रः) A man of the fourth or servile tribe, said to have sprung from the feet of BRAHMĀ. f. (-द्रा) A woman of the Śūdra tribe. f. (-द्री or -द्राणी) The wife of a Śūdra. E. शुच to purify or cleanse, Uṇādi aff. रक्, the vowel made long, and च changed to द.
38779: शूद्रता f. (-ता) The nature or condition of a Śūdra. E. शूद्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शूद्रत्वं.
38780: शूद्रधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duty of the Śūdra tribe, the service of the other three. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and धर्म्म moral merit.
38781: शूद्रप्रेष्य m. (-ष्यः) A man of the three first classes, who has become a servant to one of the fourth. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and प्रेष्य a slave.
38782: शूद्रभिक्षित n. (-तं) Alms begged or received from a Śūdra. E. शूद्र, and भिक्षित begged as alms.
38783: शूद्रभूयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Abounding with Śūdras. E. शूद्र, and भूयिष्ठ many.
38784: शूद्रयाजक m. (-कः) A priest who conducts sacrifices for Śūdras. E. शूद्र, and याजक sacrificer.
38785: शूद्रराज्य n. (-ज्यं) A country of which a Śūdra is king. E. शूद्र, and राज्य kingdom.
38786: शूद्रवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The duty or occupation of a Śūdra. E. शूद्र, and वृत्ति employment.
38787: शूद्रशासन n. (-नं) An edict or grant, &c. addressed to persons of the servile caste. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and शासन edict.
38788: शूद्रापरिणयन n. (-नं) Marrying a Śūdra female. E. शूद्रा, and परिणयन marrying.
38789: शूद्रापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The son of any man by a Śūdra woman. E. शूद्रा, and पुत्त्र son; also शूद्रासुतः, &c.
38790: शूद्रार्त्ता f. (-र्त्ता) A plant, Priyangu commonly. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and आर्त्त pained.
38791: शूद्रावेदन n. (-नं) Marrying a woman of the fourth class. E. शूद्रा, and आवेदन marrying.
38792: शूद्रावेदिन् m. (-दी) A man of the three first classes, who has a Śūdra wife. E. शूद्रा, and आवेदिन् who marries.
38793: शूद्राभार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The husband of a Śūdra woman. E. शूद्रा Śūdra woman, and भार्य्या a wife.
38794: शून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Swelled, increased, grown. 2 Morbidly swollen. f. (-ना) 1 A shambles, a slaughter-house. 2 The soft palate. E. श्वि to increase, aff. क्त, form irr.
38795: शूनावत् m. (-वान्) A butcher, one who keeps a place where animals are killed for sale. E. शूना a shambles, and मतुप् aff.
38796: शून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 Empty, void. 2 Lonely, desart. n. (-न्यं) 1 Heaven, sky, æther. 2 A dot, a spot. 3 A cypher. 4 A vacuum. f. (-न्या) 1 A hollow reed. 2 The prickly pear. E. शुन a dog, यत् aff. of fitness, and the vowel substituted for the semivowel, and made optionally long.
38797: शून्यगेह n. (-हं) An empty or deserted house. E. शून्य, and गेह a house.
38798: शून्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Vacuity, emptiness. 2 Unreality, the false or illusory nature of all existence. E. त्व added to शून्य; also with तल्, शून्यता.
38799: शून्यमध्य m. (-ध्यः) A hollow reed. E. शून्य empty, and मध्य the middle.
38800: शून्यवादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A Bauddha. 2 An atheist. E. शून्य vacuum, and वादिन् declaring; denying the existence of any thing.
38801: शून्यस्थान n. (-नं) An empty place. E. शून्य, and स्थान place.
38802: शून्यहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Empty-handed. E. शून्य, and हस्त the hand.
38803: शूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Swelling, enlarging, expanding. E. श्वि to swell, शानच् aff.
38804: शूर r. 10th cl. (शूरयते) 1 To be valiant or powerful. 2 To make great effort or exertion. (ई) शूरी r. 4th cl. (शूर्य्यते) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To be stupid.
38805: शूर m. (-रः) 1 A hero. 2 The sun. 3 A lion. 4 A boar. 5 The grandfather of KṚṢṆA. 6 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. शु to bear, Sautra root, Uṇādi aff. क्रन्, and the vowel made long, or शूर to be brave, aff. अच्.
38806: शूरण m. (-णः) 1 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum, Rox.) 2 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. शूरी to hurt, (some diseases,) aff. युच्.
38807: शूरणोद्भुज m. (-जः) A kind of bird. E. शूरण the Arum, and उद् before भुज to eat, aff. क.
38808: शूरता f. (-ता) Heroism, prowess. E. तल् added to शूर; also with त्व, शूरत्वं.
38809: शूरदेव m. (-वः) The second Jina of the future era.
38810: शूरमान n. (-नं) Vaunting, pride of prowess. E. शूर, and मान pride.
38811: शूरमानिन् m. (-नी) A boaster, one who thinks himself a hero. E. शूर, and मन to think, णिनि aff.
38812: शूरम्मन्य m. (-न्यः) A boaster, one who thinks himself a hero E. शूर, and मन to think, खश् aff.
38813: शूरसेन m. (-नः) 1 The country about Mathura. 2 The name of a prince. E. शूर a hero, सेना an army.
38814: शूर्प r. 10th cl. (शूर्पयति) To mete or measure.
38815: शूर्प्प mn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पं) 1 A winnowing basket. 2 A measure of two Droṇas. f. (-र्प्पी) A small kind of winnowing basket, a toy for children. 2 The sister of RĀVAṆA: see शूर्प्पनखा. E. शृ to injure, Uṇādi aff. प, and ऊ substituted for the vowel.
38816: शूर्प्पक m. (-कः) A demon, the enemy of KĀMADEVA. E. शूर्प्प to measure, aff. ण्वुल्.
38817: शूर्प्पकर्ण m. (-र्णः) An elephant. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and कर्ण the ear.
38818: शूर्प्पकाराति m. (-तिः) KĀMA or CUPID. E. शूर्प्पक a demon, and अराति an enemy; also शूर्प्पकारि, &c.
38819: शूर्प्पनखा f. (-खा) The sister of the Daitya RĀVAṆA. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and नख a finger nail, (having them as large,) fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्, whence also शूर्प्पनस्वी.
38820: शूर्प्पनिष्पाव m. (-वः) A measure (a basket) of winnowed corn. E. शूर्प्प, and निष्पाव winnowing.
38821: शूर्प्पपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
38822: शूर्प्पवात m. (-तः) The air as agitated by the shaking of the winnowing basket. E. शूर्प्प a basket, and वात wind.
38823: शूर्प्पश्रुति m. (-तिः) An elephant. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and श्रुति an ear; as large.
38824: शूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) An iron image, &c.: see the next.
38825: शूर्म्मि mf. (-र्म्मिः-र्म्मी) 1 An iron image. 2 An anvil. E. शु for शोभा beauty, and उर्म्मि a wave or line, ङीष् optionally added; deriv. irr.: also with इ rejected, and कन् added, fem. form शूर्म्मिका; again, as differently read, सूर्म्मि, स्युर्म्मि, &c.
38826: शूल r. 1st cl. (शूलति) 1 To disorder, to distemper or disease. 2 To make a loud noise. 3 To impale, to transfix.
38827: शूल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Sharp pain in general, or especially in the belly, as cholic, &c. or in the joints, from rheumatism or gout. 2 A weapon, a pike, a dart. 3 An iron pin or spit. 4 A banner, an ensign. 5 An astrological Yoga, that of the 9th lunar mansion. 6 Death, dying. f. (-ला) 1 A whore. 2 An instrument used for putting criminals to death, a stake for impaling them. E. शूल to disease, &c., aff. अच्.
38828: शूलक m. (-कः) A restive horse. E. शूल to distress, वुन् aff.
38829: शूलघातन n. (-नं) Iron rust or filings. E. शूल pain, and घातन what removes.
38830: शूलघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing or allaying sharp pain, sedative, anodyne. E. शूल, and घ्न what destroys.
38831: शूलधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) ŚIVA. E. शूल a pike or the three-pronged one, the trident of this deity, धन्वन् a bow, put for a weapon.
38832: शूलधर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. f. (-रा) DURGĀ. E. शूल a pike or trident, धर who holds.
38833: शूलधृक् f. (-धृक्) DURGĀ. E. शूल a trident, and धृष to be bold, aff. क्विप्.
38834: शूलनाशन n. (-नं) White Sochal salt. E. शूल cholic, and नाशन removing.
38835: शूलशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) The castor oil plant, (Ricinus communis.) E. शूल cholic, and शत्रु hostile.
38836: शूलहस्त m. (-स्तः) One armed with a lance or pike. E. शूल, and हस्त the hand.
38837: शूलहृत् m. (-हृत्) Asafoetida. E. शूल cholic, and हृत् removing.
38838: शूलाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Roasted on a spit, (meat.) E. शूल a spit, and कृत made, with डाच् augment, spitted.
38839: शूलाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The point of a pike, stake, &c. E. शूल, and अग्र end.
38840: शूलिक n. (-कं) Roat meat. m. (-कः) A hare. E. शूल a spit, and ठ् aff.
38841: शूलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Suffering sharp pain, having the cholic, &c. m. (-ली) 1 MAHĀDEVA. 2 A spearman. 3 A stakebearer. E. शूल a trident, and इनि aff.
38842: शूलिन m. (-नः) The Indian fig tree. E. शूल a stake, इनन् aff.
38843: शूलोत्खा f. (-त्खा) A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
38844: शूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Roasted, (on a spit.) 2 Deserving impalement. n. (-ल्यं) Roasted meat. E. शूल a spit, and यत् aff.
38845: शूष r. 1st cl. (शूषति) To bring forth, to propagate.
38846: शृकाल m. (-लः) A jackal: see the next.
38847: शृगाल m. (-लः) 1 A shakal or jackal. 2 A coward, a poltroon. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 An ill-natured or harsh-speaking man. 5 A demon so named. 6 KṚṢṆA. f. (-ली) 1 Flight, retreat. 2 A fox. 3 A she jackal. E. शृज to create or abandon, (deceit, &c.) कालन् aff., or शृंग a horn, अ negative prefix, ला to possess, aff. क, deriv. irr.; also सृगाल, &c.
38848: शृगालकण्टक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Seyālkānta or jackal's thorn, (Zizyphus scandens.) E. शृगाल, and कण्टक a thorn.
38849: शृगालकोलि m. (-लिः) A sort of jujube. E. शृगाल a jackal, and कोलि the jujube.
38850: शृगालजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 1 A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) 2 The fruit of the jujube. E. शृगाल a jackal, and जम्बू roseapple.
38851: शृगालिका f. (-का) 1 The female jackal. 2 A fox. 3 Running away, flight, retreat. 4 A plant, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. शृगाली as above, and कन् added.
38852: शृङ्खल subst. mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A belt or chain worn round a man's body. 2 A chain for confining an elephant. 3 A chain, a fetter in general. E. शृङ्ग a horn, here said to mean a link, and खल to collect, aff. अच्; or शिञ्जा the tinkling of a chain, and स्खल to go, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
38853: शृङ्खलक m. (-कः) A young camel with wooden rings or clogs on his feet. E. शृङ्खल a chain, and कन् aff.
38854: शृङ्खलता f. (-ता) 1 Connexion, concatenation. 2 Restraint. E. तल् added to शृङ्खल; also with त्व, शृङ्खलत्वं.
38855: शृङ्खलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, chained, fettered, captive. E. शृङ्खला a chain, इतच् aff.
38856: शृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A horn. 2 A mark, a sign. 3 The top of a mountain. 4 Sovereignty, mastership. 6 Dignity, elevation. 6 A fountain, an artificial one or jet d'eau. 7 A lotus. 8 Very sharp. 9 Minutely fine. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Jīvaka. 2 A Muni so named. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 Gold. 2 A fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.) 3 A plant, (Betula.) 4 Ṛṣabha, a medicinal root, shaped like a bull's horn. 5 Another plant, a kind of Rhus, with an excrescence or gall in the bark, compared to a crab's horn. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. गन्, and the vowel made short.
38857: शृङ्गक m. (-कः) A medicinal root, commonly Jivaka. E. कन् added to the preceding.
38858: शृङ्गला f. (-ला) A plant, a kind of Rhus, having an excrescence in the bark formed by an insect, which is compared in shape to the horn of a goat or a crab. E. शृङ्ग a horn, लच् aff.
38859: शृङ्गवेर n. (-रं) Ginger. E. शृङ्ग a horn, and वेर body or shape; also with कन् added, शृङ्गवेरक.
38860: शृङ्गाट n. (-टं) A place where four roads meet. m. (-टः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 2 A shrub, (Ruellia or Barleria longifolia.) E. शृङ्ग a horn, अट to go or be, aff. अच्.
38861: शृङ्गाटक n. (-कं) 1 A place where four roads meet. 2 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 2 A door. m. (-कः) A collection or mountain of three peaks. E. कन् added to the preceding.
38862: शृङ्गार m. (-रः) 1 Love, the passion or sentiment as an object of poetical description or dramatic representation. 2 Copulation, coition. 3 Marks made with red-lead on an elephant's head and trunk by way of ornament. n. (-रं) 1 Cloves. 2 Redlead. 3 Fragrant powder for the dress or person. 4 Ginger. 5 Agallochum. E. शृङ्ग eminence, dignity, ऋ to go to or obtain, and अण् aff.; being the chief of the poetical Rasas; or शॄ to hurt, आरन् Uṇādi aff. with नुम्, and गुक् augments.
38863: शृङ्गारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Horned, having a horn or crest. E. शृङ्ग, and आरकन् poss. aff.
38864: शृङ्गारभूषण n. (-णं) Red-lead. E. शृङ्गार love, and भूषण adorning.
38865: शृङ्गारयोनि m. (-निः) The deity of love or KĀMA. E. शृङ्गार the passion, and योनि origin.
38866: शृङ्गारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stained with red-lead, reddened. 2 Affected with passion. E. शृङ्गार, and इतच् aff.
38867: शृङ्गारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Feeling, or relating to the passion of love. 2 Stained with red lead. m. (-री) 1 An empassioned lover. 2 Dress, decoration. 3 An elephant. 4 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.) E. शृङ्गार love, इनि aff. of relation.
38868: शृङ्गि f. (-ङ्गिः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.) mn. (-ङ्गिः-ङ्गि) Gold for ornaments: see शृङ्ग and शृङ्गी.
38869: शृङ्गिक n. (-कं) A sort of poison. f. (-का) A plant, (Betula.) E. शृङ्ग a fish, &c., कन् aff.
38870: शृङ्गिकनक n. (-कं) Gold for ornaments. E. शृङ्गि the same, and कनक gold.
38871: शृङ्गिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Horned. m. (-णः) A ram. E. शृङ्ग a horn, इनन् aff.
38872: शृङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 1 Horned. 2 Crested, peaked. m. (-ङ्गी) 1 An elephant. 2 A mountain. 3 A tree. f. (-ङ्गिणी) 1 A cow. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 Heart pea. 4 Katuki, a medicinal plant. E. शृङ्ग a horn, &c., इनि poss. aff.
38873: शृणि f. (-णिः) The hook for goading an elephant. E. शॄ to injure, नि aff., and the radical vowel made short; also सृनि.
38874: शृण्वत् mfn. (-ण्वन्-ण्वन्ती-ण्वत्) Hearing. E. श्रु to hear, शतृ aff.
38875: शृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Boiled, (water, milk or Ghee.) E. श्रा to boil, aff. क्त, form. irr.; as applied to any other substances, the form is श्राण or श्रपित.
38876: शृध (उ) शृधु r. 1st cl. (शर्द्धति) To fart. (शर्द्धति-ते) To be moist or wet. r. 1st and 10th cls. (शर्द्धति शर्द्धयति) To insult.
38877: शृधू f. (-धूः) The anus. E. शृध to fart, &c., Uṇādi aff. कू; also read शृधु.
38878: शॄ r. 9th cl. (शृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. With वि prefixed, pass. v. (विशीर्य्यते) To be injured or impaired, to waste or decay.
38879: शेखर m. (-रः) 1 A garland of flowers worn on the crown of the head. 2 A crest. f. (-री) A parasite plant. n. (-रं) The root of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. शिथि to go, अरन् aff., and the nasal omitted.
38880: शेखरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crested, tufted, topped, peaked. E. शेखर, and इतच् aff.
38883: शेप m. (-पः) The penis. E. शी to sleep, प aff.; also शेफस्, also read शेपस् n. (-पः.)
38885: शेफ m. (-फः) The penis. E. शी to sleep, फ aff.: see the next.
38886: शेफस् n. (-फः) The penis. E. शी to sleep, (semine effuso,) असुन् aff., and फुट् augment; also with पुट augment, शेपस्, and with a final vowel, शेप or शेफ; again, व being substituted for प, शेव.
38887: शेफालि f. (-लिः-ली) A plant: see the next.
38888: शेफालिका f. (-का) A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor-tristis.) E. शेफा sleeping, from शी with फ aff., अलि a bee, fem. aff. ङीष्, and कन् added; also शेफालि.
38889: शेमुषी f. (-षी) Understanding, intellect. E. शे derived from शीङ् to sleep, with the aff. विच्; implying, ignorance or delusion; मुष to steal, to take away, affs. क and ङीष्; or शम to pacify, (the senses,) क्वसु participial aff., fem. form, deriv. irr.
38890: शेल (ऋ) शेऌ r. 1st cl. (शेलति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To shake, to tremble.
38891: शेलु m. (-लुः) A small tree, (Cordia myxa.) E. शिल to glean, उ aff.
38892: शेव m. (-वः) 1 The penis. 2 A snake. 3 Heighth, elevation. 4 Happiness. ind. (-वम्) Hail, homage, a term of exclamation or salutation addressed to the deities. E. शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. वन्.
38893: शेवधि m. (-धिः) A treasure as belonging to KUVERA, a Nidhi or substance of extraordinary rarity and value, possessed only by the god of wealth. E. शेव happiness, धा to have, कि aff.; or शे in future, अवधि boundary.
38894: शेवल n. (-लं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra:) see the next.
38895: शेवाल n. (-लं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वालन् Uṇādi aff.; also व being changed to प, शेपाल, and the pen. vowel shortened, शेवल; also शैवल, &c.
38896: शेश्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fast asleep, sleeping much. E. शी to sleep, intens. v., क्त aff.
38897: शेश्यितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sleeping much or soundly. E. शी to sleep, intens. v., क्तवतु aff.
38898: शेश्वीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Enlarging, expanding. E. श्वि to increase, intens. v., शानच् aff.
38899: शेष n. (-षं) Remainder, leavings, rest, balance; what is left, omitted or rejected. m. (-षः) 1 The king of the serpent race, as a large thousand-headed snake, at once the couch and canopy of VIṢṆU, and the upholder of the world, which rests on one of his heads. 2 A name of BALADEVA. 3 Killing, destroying, finishing. f. (-षा) Flowers and other things that have been offered to an idol, and are then distributed amongst the worshippers and attendants. E. शिष to specify, aff. घञ्.
38900: शेषकाल n. (-लं) The last term, the time of death. E. शेष, and काल time.
38901: शेषभाग m. (-गः) The last or remaining part. E. शेष, and भाग portion.
38902: शेषभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Who eats the leavings of others. E. शेष, and भुज् who eats.
38903: शेषभोजन n. (-नं) 1 Eating the rest of the food after feeding the family, guests, &c. 2 Eating the leavings of a meal. E. शेष, and भोजन food.
38904: शेषरक्षण n. (-णं) Taking care that an undertaking is brought to a conclusion. E. शेष, and रक्षण preserving.
38905: शेषरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) The last watch of the night. E. शेष the remainder, and रात्रि night.
38906: शेषान्न n. (-न्नं) Leavings of a meal, &c. E. शेष, and अन्न food.
38907: शेषावस्था f. (-स्था) The last state or condition of life. E. शेष, and अवस्था state.
38909: शैक्ष m. (-क्षः) A young Brahman in his noviciate, one who has begun to read the Vedas. E. शिक्षा the pronunciation of the language of the Vedas, अण् aff.
38910: शैख m. (-खः) The offspring of an outcaste Brahman.
38911: शैखरिक m. (-कः) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. शेखर a crest or top, ठक् aff.; also with ढक् aff. शैखरेय.
38912: शैत्य n. (-त्यं) Cold, coldness. E. शीत cold, and ष्यञ् aff.
38913: शैथिल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Looseness, laxity. 2 Flaccidity. 3 Slackness, remission. 4 Relaxation of rule or connexion. E. शिथिल, and ष्यञ् aff.
38914: शैनेय m. (-यः) SĀTYAKI, the charioteer of KṚṢṆA.
38915: शैरीयक m. (-कः) A shrub, (Barleria cristata;) also शैरेयक.
38916: शैल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) 1 Mountainous, mountaineer, &c. 2 Stony, rocky. m. (-लः) A mountain. n. (-लं) 1 Bitumen. 2 Storax. 3 A sort of collyrium: see रसाञ्जन. f. (-ली) A concise interpretation of a grammatical aphorism. E. शिला a rock, a stone, अण् aff.
38917: शैलक n. (कं) Storax or Benzoin. E. कन् added to the preceding.
38918: शैलकटक m. (-कः) The brow or slope of a mountain. E. शैल, and कटक flank.
38919: शैलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in or on mountains, rocks, &c. n. (-जं) 1 A fragrant resinous substance, (Storax or Benzoin.) 2 Bitumen. E. शैल a mountain, and ज produced.
38920: शैलजन m. (-नः) A mountaineer. E. शैल, and जन a person.
38921: शैलधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) ŚIVA. E. शैल a mountain, and धन्वन् a bow.
38922: शैलधर m. (-रः) KṚṢṆA. E. शैल a mountain, and धर who upholds.
38923: शैलनिर्य्यास n. (-सः) Storax, Benzoin. E. शैल a rock, and निर्य्यास exudation.
38924: शैलपति m. (-तिः) The Himālaya. E. शैल, and पति master.
38925: शैलभित्ति f. (-त्तिः) A stone-cutter's chisel or axe, an instrument for dividing or cutting stones. E. शैल a mountain, भिद to divide, aff. क्तिन्.
38926: शैलमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Rocky. E. शैल, and मयट् aff.
38927: शैलरन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) A cavern, a cave. E. शैल, and रन्ध्र a hole.
38928: शैलशिखर n. (-रं) The crest or peak of a mountain. E. शैल, and शिखर a peak.
38929: शैलशिविर n. (-रं) The ocean. E. शैल a rock, and शिविर a camp or palace.
38930: शैलशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The peak of a mountain. E. शैल, and शृङ्ग a horn.
38931: शैलसार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard, firm, as a rock. E. शैल, and सार essence.
38932: शैलाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The peak of a mountain. E. शैल a mountain, and अग्र top.
38933: शैलाट m. (-टः) 1 A lion. 2 A mountaineer, a savage, a barbarian. 3 An attendant on an idol. 4 Crystal. E. शैल a mountain, and अट to go, aff. अच्.
38934: शैलालिन् m. (-ली) An actor, a dancer. E. शिलालिन् a Muni, said to have been the author of the principles of acting, &c., अण् aff., शैलाल his institutes, and इनि aff. of profession or practice.
38935: शैलिक्य m. (-क्यः) An impostor, a pretended devotee.
38936: शैलूष m. (-षः) An actor, a dancer, a tumbler, &c. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 The master of the band, or one who beats time. 4 The Bel tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. शिलूष one of the early teachers of the arts of acting, &c., अण् aff. of descent.
38937: शैलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Produced in the mountains, &c., mountainous, mountaineer. 2 Mountain-like. n. (-यं) 1 A fragrant resin, (Storax or Benzoin.) 2 A vegetable perfume, commonly Murā. 3 Rock salt. m. (-यः) A bee. f. (-यी) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. शिला a mountain, ढक् aff.
38938: शैलोपशल्य n. (-ल्यं) The skirts of a mountain or low land at its base. E. शैल, and उपशल्य neighbouring space.
38939: शैल्य nf. (-ल्यं-ली) Hardness, stoniness. E. शिला a stone, a rock, ष्यञ् aff.
38940: शैव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating or appertaining to the god ŚIVA. m. (-वः) A worshipper of ŚIVA. n. (-वं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra). E. शिव the deity, and अण् aff.
38941: शैवल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant. n. (-लं) A drug, commonly termed Padamkāṭh. E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलञ् aff.; also शैवाल, शेवाल, &c.
38942: शैवलिनी f. (-नी) A river in general. E. शैवल Vallisneria, and इनि aff.
38943: शैवाल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वालन् aff., शेवाल, and अण् pleonasm.
38944: शैव्य mfn. (-व्यः-वी-व्यं) Relating to ŚIVA, &c. m. (-व्यः) 1 One of the horses of KṚṢṆA car. 2 A king and champion in the Pāṇḍava army. E. शिव, and यञ् aff.
38945: शैशव n. (-वं) Childhood, pupilage, the period under sixteen. E. शिशु a child, अण् aff.
38946: शैष्योपाध्यायिका f. (-का) Instruction of youth, tuition. E. शिष्य a pupil, उपाध्याय a preceptor, वुञ् aff.
38947: शो r. 4th cl. (श्यति) 1 To reduce or make small, to pare. 2 To whet or sharpen.
38948: शोक m. (-कः) Sorrow, grief. E. शुच to regret, aff. घञ्.
38949: शोकचर्चा f. (-र्चा) Indulgence in sorrow. E. शोक, and चर्चा search.
38950: शोकछिद् mfn. (-छिद्) Consoling, allaying, removing sorrow. E. शोक, and छिद what cuts.
38951: शोकनिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Afflicted, overcome with grief. E. शोक, and निहत struck.
38952: शोकभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Dissipating or removing sorrow. E. शाक, and भङ्ग breaking.
38953: शोकमूर्च्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Involved in distress, swooning with grief. E. शोक, and मूर्च्छित fainted.
38954: शोकस्थान n. (-नं) Site, circumstance, or occasion of sorrow. E. शोक, and स्थान place.
38955: शोकाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Overcome with sorrow. E. शोक, and आकुल bewildered.
38956: शोकाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Deep distress, violent grief. E. शोक, and अग्नि fire; also similar compounds, as शोकानल, &c.
38957: शोकाग्निसन्तप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Distressed. E. शोकाग्नि, and सन्तप्त inflamed.
38958: शोकापनुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Alleviating, consoling. 2 Being consoled. E. शोक, and अपनुद what drives away.
38959: शोकापनोद m. (-दः) A teacher of holy wisdom, a philosopher. E. शोक worldly care, अप away, नुद to send, घञ् aff.
38960: शोकापहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Allaying or dissipating grief. E. शोक, and अपहर्त्तृ what drives away.
38961: शोकारि m. (-रिः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Kadamba.) E. शोक sorrow, अरि hostile.
38962: शोकार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained, afflicted by sorrow. E. शोक, and आर्त्त pained.
38963: शोकोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from or caused by grief. E. शोक, and उद्भब produced.
38964: शोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing, sorrowful. n. (-नं) Sorrow, grief, grieving. E. शुच to grieve, aff. युच् or ल्युट्.
38965: शोचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be grieved or lamented, what may or ought to be. E. शुच to be sad, अनीयर् aff.
38966: शोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sorrowful, afflicted. E. शुचि to grieve, causal v., क्त aff.
38967: शोचितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be grieved for, lamentable. E. शुच to grieve, तव्य aff.
38968: शोचित्वा ind. Grieving or having grieved for. E. शुचि to lament, क्त्वा aff.
38969: शोचिष्केश m. (-शः) Fire or its deity. E. शोचिस् light, and केश hair, having locks of flame.
38970: शोचिस् n. (-चिः) Light, lustre, radiance, flame. E. शुच to be or make pure, Uṇādi aff. इसि.
38971: शोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 To be lamented or bewailed. 2 To be cleansed or purified. E. शुच to grieve, यत् aff.
38972: शोच्यक m. (-कः) A low man. E. शोच्य to be purified (from), कन् aff.
38973: शोठ m. (-ठः) 1 A fool, a blockhead. 2 A sluggard, an idler. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 A low man, one of a degraded tribe or business. 5 A villain, a criminal, a sinner. E. शुठ to be prevented or stopped, aff. अच्.
38974: शोण (ऋ) शोणृ r. 1st cl. (शोणति) 1 To be red. 2 To move or approach.
38975: शोण mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं) 1 Crimson, of a crimson colour. 2 Red in the face, from passion, &c. m. (-णः) 1 Crimson, the colour of the red lotus. 2 A horse of a reddish or bright chesnut colour. 3 The Śoṇa river, which rises in the table land of Amarakaṇṭaka, and running first northerly and then easterly for 500 miles, falls into the Ganges above Patna. 4 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) 5 Fire or its deity. 6 An ocean. 7 A red sort of sugar-cane. n. (-णं) 1 Red-lead. 2 Blood. E. शोण to be red, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ठाप् or ङीप्.
38976: शोणक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
38977: शोणरत्न n. (-त्नं) A ruby. E. शोण deep red, and रत्न a gem.
38978: शोणाक m. (-कः) A tree, (Bignonia Indica.) E. शोण red, अक to go or be, aff. अच्.
38979: शोणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Red, crimson, purple. n. (-तं) 1 Blood. 2 Saffron. E. शोण redness, इतच् aff.
38980: शोणितप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what drinks blood. E. शोणित, and पा to drink, क aff.
38981: शोणितपुर n. (-रं) The city of Bānāsur. E. शोणित red, and पुर city.
38982: शोणितोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stained or sprinkled with blood. E. शोणित, and उक्षित moistened.
38983: शोणितोपल n. (-लं) A ruby. E. शोणित red, and उपल a stone.
38984: शोणिमन् m. (-मा) Redness. E. शोण, and इमनिच् aff.
38985: शोथ m. (-थः) Swelling, intumescence. E. शु to go, (to grow,) Uṇādi aff. थन्; also with कन् added शोथक m. (-कः)
38986: शोथघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Discutient, removing swellings. f. (-घ्नी) Hogweed, (Boerhavia diffusa.) E. शोथ swelling, घ्न removing, fem. aff. ङीष्.
38987: शोथजित् mfn. (-जित्) Discutient. f. (जित्) Hogweed: see the last. E. शोथ swelling, and जित् overcoming.
38988: शोथहृत् mfn. (-हृत्) Discutient, removing swellings. m. (-हृत्) Marking-nut plant. E. शोथ swelling, and हृत् removing.
38989: शोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what cleans, purifies, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A refiner. 2 (In arithmetic,) The subtrahend. E. शुध to be pure, ण्वुल् aff.
38990: शोधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cleaning, purifying, &c., that which cleanses, refines, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Cleaning, cleansing, purifying. 2 Correcting, freeing from faults or errors. 3 Correcting, as a writing. 4 Subtraction, (in arithmetic.) 5 The refining of metals. 6 A sort of refining, practised for chemical or medical purposes; exposing the metals to heat, and then sprinkling them with the urine of cows, &c. 7 Payment, acquittance. 8 Fæces, ordure. 9 Green vitriol. m. (-नः) The lime. f. (-नी) A broom. E. शुघ to be or make pure, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
38991: शोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be corrected. 2 To be cleansed or purified. 3 To be refined. 4 To be subtracted. 5 To be liquidated (as a debt), due. E. शुघ to purify, aff. अनीयर्; also शोध्य and शोधितव्य.
38992: शोधयित्वा ind. 1 Having paid or discharged. 2 Having cleared, &c. E. शुघ to be pure, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
38993: शोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cleaned, cleansed. 2 Strained. 3 Corrected. 4 Refined. 5 Purified. 6 Discharged, liquidated, (as a debt.) E. शुध to clean, aff. क्त.
38994: शोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 To be purified, cleaned, refined, &c. 2 Payable, due. 3 To be subtracted. m. (-ध्यः) An accused person, one to be justified or tried. n. (-ध्यं) A constant number to be subtracted in some astronomical computations. E. शुध to be pure, यत aff.
38995: शोफ m. (-फः) Intumescense. E. शु to go, aff. फ.
38996: शोभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Handsome. 2 Bright. f. (-भा) 1 Light, lustre, radiance, splendour. 2 Beauty. 3 Distinguished merit. 4 A species of the Kṛti metre. E. शुभ to shine, aff. अच, fem. aff. टाप्.
38997: शोभकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Beautifying. m. (-कृत्) 1 The thirty-sixth year of the Hindu cycle. 2 Marking-nut plant. E. शोभ handsome, and कृन् what makes.
38998: शोभन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Beautiful, handsome. 2 Shining, splendid. 3 Richly dressed or ornamented. 4 Propitious, auspicious. 5 Virtuous, moral, decorous, good. m. (-नः) 1 The fifth Yoga. 2 A planet. 3 Burnt-offering for auspicious results. n. (-नं) 1 A lotus. 2 Shining, being splendid or handsome. E. शुभ to shine, aff. युच्.
38999: शोभनक m. (-कः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
39000: शोभनाचरित n. (-तं) Virtuous practice. E. शोभन, and आचरित done.
39001: शोभमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fair, splendid, shining. E. शुभ to shine, &c., शानच् aff.
39002: शोभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, commonly Sajinā or Sahajnā, (Hyperanthera morunga;) the legumes, blossoms, and leaves are esculent, and the root of the young tree is used as a substitute for horse-radish: in medicine the root is used as a rubefacient externally, as a stimulant internally, and the expressed oil of the seeds is employed to relieve arthritic pains, &c. E. शोभा beauty, अञ्ज to pervade or anoint, and ल्युट् or युच् aff; also शौभाञ्जन and सोभाञ्जन, &c.
39003: शोभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beautified, decorated. E. शुभ to shine, क्त aff.
39004: शोशुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing or grieving deeply. E. शुच to be sorrowful, intens. v., शानच aff.
39005: शोष m. (-षः) 1 Pulmonary consumption. 2 Drying. 3 Intumescence, swelling. E. शुष to dry, aff. अच्.
39006: शोषण n. (-णं) 1 Suction, sucking. 2 Drying up. m. (-णः) One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA, or CUPID. E. शुष to dry, ल्युट् aff.
39007: शोषयित्वा ind. Having dried up. E. शुष to dry, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
39008: शोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dried, dried up, desiccated. E. शुष to dry, aff. क्त.
39009: शोस् ind. A particle of reproach or contempt.
39010: शौक n. (-कं) 1 A flock of parrots. 2 Sorrowfulness. E. शुक a parrot, अञ् aff.
39011: शौक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं) Acid, acetic. E. शुक्त vinegar, अण् aff.
39012: शौक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Acid, acetic. 2 Relating to a pearl, &c. E. शुक्त or शुक्ति, and ठक् aff.
39013: शौक्तेय n. (-यं) A pearl. E. शुक्ति a pearl-oyster, ढक् aff.; also from शुक्तिका with the same, शौक्तिकेय.
39014: शौक्लिकेय m. (-यः) A sort of poison. E. शुक्लिक a country, ढक् aff.: according to some it is the venom of a snake of the Amphisbœna kind.
39015: शौक्ल्य n. (-क्ल्यं) Whiteness. E. शुक्ल white, ष्यञ् aff.
39016: शौच n. (-चं) 1 Purification by ablution, &c. from personal defilement. 2 Purification at given periods from defilement caused by the death of a relation, &c. 3 The state or property of freedom from defilement, purity, cleanness. E. शुचि purity, अण् aff.
39017: शौचविधि f. (-धिः) The rules of purification after defilement by the death of a relation, &c. E. शौच, and बिधि precept.
39018: शौचाचार m. (-रः) A rule of purification, the mode in which the person is to be cleansed by ablution, &c. after voiding any excrement or contracting any impurity. E. शौच purification, and आचार rule, rite.
39019: शौचेय m. (-यः) A washerman. E. शुचि cleaning, ढक् aff.
39020: शौचेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing or intending to be purified. E. शौच, and इप्सु desirous.
39021: शौट (ऋ) शौटृ r. 1st cl. (शौटति) To be proud.
39022: शौटीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty. m. (-रः) 1 A hero. 2 An ascetic, one who abandons the world. 3 A proud or haughty man, but of low tribe or occupation, an upstart. E. शौट to be proud, and ईरन् Uṇādi aff.; also as derived from शौड the same, शौडीर; also the short vowel being substituted for the diphthong, शुटीर.
39023: शौटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Heroism, prowess. 2 Pride, arrogance. E. शौटीर a hero, and ष्यञ् aff.
39024: शौड(ऋ)शौडृ r. 1st cl. (शौडति) To be proud.
39025: शौण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) 1 Drunk, intoxicated. 2 Fond of, addicted to, (as liquor.) f. (-ण्डी) 1 Long-pepper. 2 Another sort, (Piper chavya.) E. शुण्डा spirituous liquor, अण् aff.
39027: शौण्डिक m. (-कः) A distiller and vender of spirituous liquors. f. (-की) A female keeper of a tavern or dram shop. E. शुण्डा spirits, ठञ् aff.
39028: शौण्डिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Elevated, looking upwards; more properly, शौडीर, and शौटीर as above.
39029: शौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Śaudra, servile, relating or belonging to the last class. m. (-द्रः) The son of a man of either of the first three classes by a Śūdra woman, the last of the twelve sons acknowledged in the ancient Hindu law. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and अण् aff.
39030: शौद्धोदनि m. (-निः) BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. शुद्धोदन a prince of the family of IKṢVĀKU, and इञ् aff. of descent.
39031: शौधिका f. (-का) A white variety of panic seed.
39032: शौनक m. (-कः) The name of an inspired legislator older than MANU.
39033: शौनिक m. (-कः) 1 A butcher, a poulterer, a vender of the flesh of beasts or birds. 2 Chase, hunting. E. शूना a slaughterhouse, ठञ् aff.
39034: शौभ n. (-भं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended in the air. m. (-भः) 1 A god, a divinity. 2 The betel-nut. E. शुभ auspicious, अण् aff.
39035: शौभनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Sprung from a handsome mother. 2 Relating to any thing handsome or brilliant. E. शोभना a handsome woman, aff. ढक्.
39036: शौभाञ्जन m. (-नः) The Sajina tree. E. अण् pleonasm, added to शोभाञ्जन q. v.
39037: शौभिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a conjurer.
39038: शौरि m. (-रिः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 2 The planet SATURN. E. शूर a proper name or a hero, इञ् aff.
39039: शौर्प्प mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Measured by a winnowing basket, &c. E. शूर्प्प a basket, अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. शौर्प्पिक.
39040: शौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Valour, heroism, prowess. 2 The heroic drama, or that which treats of war, magic, &c. E. शूर a hero, ष्यञ् aff.
39041: शौर्य्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by valour. E. शौर्य्य, and उपार्ज्जित acquired.
39042: शौल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्की-ल्कं) Relating to customs or duties, levied as a tax, &c. m. (-ल्कः) A superintendant of tolls or customs, a custom-house officer. E. शुल्क a toll or tax, aff. अण्.
39043: शौल्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a tax, a toll, &c. m. (-कः) Superintendant of tolls or customs. E. शुल्क a toll, and ठक् aff.
39044: शौल्विक m. (-कः) A coppersmith. E. शुल्व copper, ठक aff.
39045: शौवस्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to to-morrow. E. श्वस्तन् of to-morrow, ठक् added, with तुट् augment.
39046: शौवस्तिकत्व n. (-त्वं) Ephemeralness, duration for a day. E. शौवस्तिक, and त्व added.
39047: शौवापद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Relating to a beast of prey, savage, wild, ferocious, &c. E. श्वापद a beast of prey, अण् aff., and औ augment.
39048: शौष्कल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Eating fish and flesh. n. (-लं) The price of dried meat. E. शुष्कली dried flesh, aff. अण.
39049: श्चुत (इर) श्चुतिर r. 1st cl. (श्चोतति) 1 To ooze, to drop or distil. 2 To sprinkle.
39050: श्चोत m. (-तः) Sprinkling, aspersion. E. श्चुत to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
39051: श्च्युत (इर) श्च्युतिर् r. 1st cl. (श्च्योतति) 1 To sprinkle. 2 To ooze, to drop or distil.
39052: श्च्युतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dropping, flowing. 2 Shed, sprinkled, issued, oozed. E. श्च्युत to sprinkle, and क्त aff.
39053: श्च्योत m. (-तः) Sprinkling, pouring forth, aspersion. E. श्च्युत to sprinkle, aff. घञ्; also श्चोत.
39054: श्च्योतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) 1 Oozing, flowing, trickling. 2 Shedding. E. श्च्युत to ooze, शतृ aff.
39055: श्मन् Aptote noun. The face, the mouth.
39056: श्मशान n. (-नं) A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. E. श्म substituted for शव a corpse, and शान for शयन place of repose.
39057: श्मशानवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) A ghost, a gole, a sprite, male or female, abiding in cemeteries, &c. E. श्मशान a cemetery, and वासिन् who abides; also श्मशाननिवासिन्, श्मशानवर्त्तिन्, &c.
39058: श्मशानवेश्मन् m. (-श्मा) 1 MAHĀDEVA. 2 A ghost. E. श्मशान a cemetery, and वेश्मन् abode.
39059: श्मश्रु n. (-श्रु) The beard. E. श्मन् for मुख the face, श्रि to serve, Uṇādi aff. डुन्, form irr.; also श्मश्रुन्.
39060: श्मश्रुमुखी f. (-खी) A woman with a beard. E. श्मश्रु a beard, and मुख the face, ङीष् fem. aff.
39061: श्मश्रुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bearded, having a beard. E. श्मश्रु, and लच् aff.
39062: श्मश्रुवर्द्धक m. (-कः) A barber. E. श्मश्रु, and वर्द्धक who cuts.
39063: श्मश्रूयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being as if bearded, having something like a beard. E. श्मश्रु used as a verb, शानच् aff.
39064: श्मील r. 1st cl. (श्मीलति) 1 To wink, to contract the eyelids. 2 To twinkle.
39065: श्मीलन n. (-नं) Winking, twinkling. E. श्मील, and ल्युट् aff.
39066: श्मीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Winked, blinked. n. (-तं) A wink, winking. E. श्मील to wink, क्त aff.
39067: श्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Viscous, thick, adhesive, as clarified butter, &c. n. (-नं) Smoke. E. श्यै to go, aff. क्त.
39068: श्याम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Black or dark-blue. 2 Green. m. (-मः) 1 A sacred fig tree at Prayāga or Allahabad. 2 A cloud. 3 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 4 A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) 5 Black, (the colour.) 6 Green, (the colour.) 7 Thorn-apple, (Datura metel.) mf. (-मः-मा) A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum). n. (-मं) 1 Pepper. 2 Sea salt. f. (-मा) 1 A woman, described as one who has not borne children; also described as a female of slender make; or one from eight to sixteen; or one who resembles in darkness of complexion, the blossom of the Priyangu, or its stalk, in shape. 2 Night. 3 Shade, shadow. 4 The Jumnā river. 5 A form of DURGĀ. 6 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 7 A sort of Convolvulus, (C. turpethum,) with black flowers. 8 A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) 9 Indigo. 10 A twining shrub, (Ichnocarpus frutescens.) 11 Turmeric. 12 Holy basil. 12 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 14 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 15 A small singing bird with black plumage, commonly Shāma, (Turdus macrourus.) 16 A cow. E. श्यै to go, Uṇādi aff. मक्.
39069: श्यामक m. (-कः) A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum, &c.) E. श्यामा the same, कन् added, m. form.
39070: श्यामकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A peacock. 2 ŚIVA. 3 A small kind of bird. E. श्याम black or blue, कण्ठ the throat.
39071: श्यामत्व n. (-त्वं) Blackness. E. त्व added to श्याम; also with तल्, श्यामता.
39072: श्यामपत्र m. (-त्रः) The Tamāla tree, (Xanthocymus pictorius.) E. श्याम black, and पत्र a leaf.
39073: श्यामभास् mfn. (-भाः-भाः-भः) Black as jet, of a glossy black hue. E. श्याम, and भास् shining.
39074: श्यामल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a black or dark-blue colour. m. (-लः) 1 Black, (the colour.) 2 Black-pepper. 3 The religious fig tree. 4 A large bee. f. (-ला) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. श्याम black, ला to have, aff. क.
39075: श्यामलता f. (-ता) A climbing plant, (Ichnocarpus frutescens.) E. श्याम, and लता a creeper.
39076: श्यामाक m. (-कः) A kind of grain generally eaten by the Hindus, (Panicum frumentaceum; also P. colonum.) E. श्यामा the same, कन् added, and the final retained.
39077: श्यामाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Black-bodied, black. m. (-ङ्गः) The planet MERCURY or its ruler. E. श्याम black, and अङ्ग the body.
39078: श्यामापूजा f. (-जा) Worship of ŚYĀMĀ or DURGĀ, on the new moon of Kārttika. E. श्यामा, and पूजा worship.
39079: श्यामित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blackened, turned or become black. E. श्याम, and इतच् aff.
39080: श्याल m. (-लः) A wife's brother. f. (-ली) A wife's sister. E. श्यै to go, aff. कालन्.
39081: श्यालक m. (-कः) A wife's brother. f. (-लिका-लकी) A wife's sister. E. कन् added to the last.
39082: श्याव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Of a brown colour. m. (-वः) Brown, (the colour.) E. श्यै to go, व aff., deriv. irr.
39083: श्यावतैल m. (-लः) The mango tree. E. श्याव brown, and तैल oil.
39084: श्यावदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Dark or black toothed, (naturally so.) E. श्याव dark or brown, दतृ for दन्त a tooth; also श्यावदन्त and श्यावदन्तक.
39085: श्येत mfn. (-तः-ता or -नी-तं) White, of a white colour. m. (-तः) White, (the colour.) E. श्यै to go, Uṇādi aff. इतच्.
39086: श्येतकोलक m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM.)
39087: श्येन m. (-नः) 1 A hawk, a falcon. 2 White, (the colour.) 3 Whiteness, paleness. 4 Violence, desperation. f. (-नी) 1 The female hawk. 2 A species of the Triṣṭubh metre. E. श्यै to go, इञ् Uṇādi aff.
39088: श्येनकरण n. (-णं) 1 Acting rashly or desperately. 2 Burning on a separate funeral pile. E. श्येन, and करण acting; also श्येनकरणिका.
39089: श्येनचित् m. (-चित्) 1 A hawk feeder or keeper. 2 A receptacle shaped like a hawk for a sacrificial fire. E. श्येन a hawk, and चित् what collects.
39090: श्येनजीविन् m. (-वी) One who sells hawks or lives by training them. E. श्येन, and जीविन् living.
39091: श्येनोपदेश m. (-शः) Recommendation or injunction to women, to burn on a separate funeral pile. E. श्येन violence, and उपदेश advice.
39093: श्यैनम्पाता f. (-ता) Hawking, hunting. E. श्येन a hawk, पात falling, ञ aff., with नुम् augment.
39094: श्योणाक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. श्यै to go, डुणाक aff.
39095: श्रक (इ) श्रकि r. 1st cl. (श्रंकते) To go.
39096: श्रग (इ) श्रगि r. 1st cl. (श्रंगति) To go, to move.
39097: श्रण r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रणति, श्राणयति) usually with वि prefixed, (विश्राणयति) To give, to present.
39098: श्रत् ind. A particle and prefix implying belief or reverence.
39099: श्रथ r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रथति, श्रथयति) 1 To hurt, to injure, to kill. 2 To let loose or discharge, to set free, to liberate. 3 To bind or tie. r. 10th cl. (श्राथयति) 1 To apply diligently, to endeavour sedulously. 2 To delight frequently. 3 To march. r. 10th cl. (श्रथयति) To be weak or infirm. (इ) श्रथि r. 1st cl. (श्रंथते) 1 To be loose or lax, to be slack or flaccid. 2 To let loose, to loosen.
39100: श्रथन n. (-नं) 1 Tying, stringing. 2 Loosening, untying. E. श्रथ to tie, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
39101: श्रद्दधत् mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्) Believing, having faith. E. श्रत्, and दधत् having.
39102: श्रद्दधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Trusting, believing. 2 Venerating, respecting. E. श्रत् particle of faith or respect, धा to have, शानच् aff.
39103: श्रद्ध nf. (-द्धं-द्धा) 1 Respect, reverence. 2 Wish, desire. 3 Faith, belief. 4 Purity. E. श्रत् a particle implying belief, &c., धा to hold or have, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
