39104: श्रद्धाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done with faith. E. श्रद्धा, and कृत done.
39105: श्रद्धान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Believing, faithful. E. श्रद्धा, and अन्वित endowed with; also श्रद्धासमन्वित.
39106: श्रद्धामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Believing, full of faith. E. श्रद्धा, and मयट् aff.
39107: श्रद्धायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Having faith, believing. E. श्रद्धा, and युक्त joined.
39108: श्रद्धारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distrusting, unbelieving. E. श्रद्धा, and रहित abandoned.
39109: श्रद्धालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) 1 Faithful, believing. 2 Wishing, desirous. f. (-लुः) A pregnant woman longing for any thing. E. श्रद्धा faith, आलुच् aff.
39110: श्रद्धावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Believing, trusting, having faith. E. श्रद्धा, and मतुप् aff.
39111: श्रन्थ r. 9th cl. (श्रथ्नाति) 1 To set free, to let loose, to liberate. 2 To gladden, to delight frequently. 3 To string, to tie together. r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रन्थति श्रन्थयति) To arrange, to place in order.
39112: श्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 Loosening, liberating. 2 Looesness, flaccidity. 3 Tying, binding, stringing. 4 A name of VIṢṆU. E. श्रन्थ to tie, &c., aff. अच्.
39113: श्रन्थन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Stringing flowers, &c. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 Tying, binding. 4 Loosening, untying. E. श्रन्थ to tie or unite, aff. युच्.
39114: श्रन्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, connected, bound together. 2 Overcome, surpassed, overpowered. 3 Hurt, injured. 4 Loosed, let loose. E. श्रन्थ to tie, or श्रथि to hurt, &c., aff. क्त.
39115: श्रपण n. (-णं) Boiling in a pot. E. श्रै to boil, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
39116: श्रपयित्वा ind. Having boiled or dressed. E. श्रै to cook, causal v., क्त्रा aff.
39117: श्रपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Boiled, (any thing except water, milk or Ghee.) f. (-ता) Rice-gruel. E. श्रै to cook or boil, causal v., aff. क्त.
39118: श्रम (ञि इर, उ) श्रमु r. 4th cl. (श्राम्यति) 1 To perform acts of austere devotion, to undergo mortification or penance. 2 To be wearied or fatigued. 3 To be distressed.
39119: श्रम m. (-मः) 1 Military exercise. 2 Weariness, fatigue. 3 Labour, exertion, toil. E. श्रम to be wearied, aff. अच्.
39120: श्रमजल n. (-लं) Perspiration from exertion or fatigue. E. श्रम, and जल water.
39121: श्रमण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Following a low or degraded business or profession. 2 Base, vile, bad. m. (-णः) 1 A religious character, an ascetic, a Yati, one devoted to meditation for the purpose of obtaining final emancipation from existence, probably the Sarmanes of the Greek writers. 2 A beggar, the religious mendicant. f. (-णा or णी) 1 Indian spikenard, (Valeriana Jatamansi.) 2 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) 3 A handsome woman. 4 A woman of low caste or business. 5 A female mendicant. E. श्रम to be wearied, aff. युच्.
39122: श्रमसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Accomplished by labour or exertion. E. श्रम, and सिद्ध accomplished.
39123: श्रमार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Exhausted, overcome with fatigue. E. श्रम, and आर्त्त pained.
39124: श्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Wearying, tiring, undergoing or incurring weariness or fatigue. 2 Laborious, diligent. E. श्रम to be weary, aff. घिनुण्.
39125: श्रम्भ (उ) श्रम्भु r. 1st cl. (श्रम्भते) To be careless or inattentive, to err, to neglect, to mistake.
39126: श्रय m. (-यः) Asylum, refuge, protection. E. श्रि to serve, aff. अच्.
39127: श्रयण n. (-णं) Asylum, refuge, shelter, protection. E. श्रि to serve, aff. ल्युट्.
39128: श्रयणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be defended or sheltered. E. श्रि to serve, अनीयर् aff.
39129: श्रव m. (-वः) 1 The ear. 2 Oozing, dripping. E. श्रु to hear, &c., aff. अप्; also श्रवण, स्रव, &c.
39130: श्रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Produced in or under the sign ŚRAVAṆĀ. mn. (-णः-णं) 1 The ear. 2 Hearing. n. (-णं) 1 Service. 2 Dripping, oozing. mf. (-णः-णा) The twenty-third of the lunar asterisms, represented by three footsteps, and containing three stars or α, β and γ Aquilæ. E. श्रु to hear, &c., aff. ल्युट् or युच्; or श्रवणा the asterism, अण् aff. of derivation, and the effect rejected.
39131: श्रवणपथ m. (-थः) The ear. E. श्रवण, and पथ for पथिन् path.
39132: श्रवणाधिकारिन् m. (-री) A speaker, an addresser. E. श्रवण, and अघिकारिन् connected with or acting on.
39133: श्रवणेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) The organ of hearing, the ear. E. श्रवण, and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.
39134: श्रवणोदर n. (-रं) The hollow of the outer ear. E. श्रवण, and उदर belly.
39135: श्रवस् n. (-वः) The ear. E. श्रु to hear, aff. असुन्.
39136: श्रवाप्य m. (-प्यः) An animal fit or proper for sacrifice. E. श्रु to drip, (Ghee,) आप्य Uṇādi aff.
39137: श्रविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Produced in or under the sign ŚRAVIṢṬHĀ. f. (-ष्ठा) The twenty-fourth lunar asterism, also called DHANIṢṬHĀ, corresponding to the DOLPHIN. E. श्रव an ear, मतुप् poss. aff., इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, and the possessive rejected; the attributive is formed by the aff. अण, and that again or its effect optionally rejected.
39138: श्रविष्ठाज m. (-जः) The planet MERCURY. E. श्रविष्ठा the asterism, and ज born.
39139: श्रा r. 2nd cl. (श्राति) 1 To boil, to cook, to mature, to ripen, &c. 2 To sweat. Causal form (श्रपयति) To render mature or ripe by cooking, &c. (श्रापयति) To heat, to cause to sweat.
39140: श्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Boiled, dressed, (any thing except butter, milk, or water.) 2 Moist, wet. f. (-णा) Rice-gruel. E. श्रै to cook, aff. क्त, form irr.
39141: श्राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Faithful, believing. n. (-द्धं) A funeral ceremony observed at various fixed periods and for different purposes, consisting of offerings with water and fire to the gods and manes, and gifts and food to the relations present and assisting Brahmans; it is especially performed for a parent recently deceased, or for three paternal ancestors, or for all ancestors collectively, and is supposed necessary to secure the ascent and residence of the souls of the deceased in a world appropriated to the manes. The following distributions of this ceremony are specified; the पार्व्वणं in honor of three ancestors, एकोद्दिष्टं of one, नित्यं regular, नैमित्तिकं occasionally, काम्यं for the attainment of some particular object, आह्निकं daily, वृद्धिः for the obtaining of increase of prosperity, and सपिण्डनं in which the balls of meat offered to the deceased individually and collectively are blended together. There are many other kinds: those for a person recently deceased are one on the day after mourning expires, and twelve others in twelve successive months; one at the end of the third fortnight, one in the sixth month, and one in the twelfth, concluding with a Sapiṇḍana, on the anniversary of the person's death; in general they are all performed in the course of the two or three first days, and the Śrāddha for the deceased is only annually repeated. There is also a sort of Śrāddha performed daily during the days of mourning, usually ten, on which a funeral cake is presented, increasing one or more each day till ten cakes are offered. E. श्रद्धा faith, अण् or ण aff. of possession or relation, as the abandonment or presentation of meat, &c. through faith of its efficacy, in behalf of the souls of the deceased.
39142: श्राद्धकर m. (-रः) The offerer of an obsequial oblation. E. श्राद्ध, and कर who makes.
39143: श्राद्धकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The rite or ceremony of funeral oblation. E. श्राद्ध, and कर्म्मन् act; also श्राद्धक्रिया, &c.
39144: श्राद्धकृत् m. (कृत्) The celebrator of an obsequial rite. E. श्चाद्ध, and कृत् who makes.
39145: श्राद्धद m. (-दः) The offerer of an obsequial rite. E. श्राद्ध, and द who gives.
39146: श्राद्धदेव m. (-वः) YAMA. E. श्राद्ध the funeral ceremony called Śrāddha, and देव deity; as judge and monarch of the dead.
39147: श्राद्धदेवता f. (-ता) A divinity presiding over obsequial rites, a Pitṛ or progenitor, or YAMA. E. श्राद्ध, and देवता divinity.
39148: श्राद्धभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Eating or partaking of the food prepared at a Śrāddha or obsequial rite. E. श्राद्ध, and भुज् who eats.
39149: श्राद्धशिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Food that has been presented to the manes. E. श्राद्ध, and शिष्ट left.
39150: श्राद्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 The object, receiver, or enjoyer of an obsequial oblation. 2 Anything relating to a Śrāddha. E. श्राद्ध as above, ठन् aff.
39151: श्राद्धिन् mfn. (-द्धी-द्धिनी-द्धि) The object or receiver of a funeral oblation. E. श्राद्ध as above, इनि aff.
39152: श्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Wearied, fatigued. 2 Calmed, tranquil. m. (-न्तः) An ascetic, one with subdued passions. E. श्रम to be weary, aff. क्त.
39153: श्रान्तसंवाहन n. (-नं) Affording rest or relief to the weary, giving them seats, beds, &c. E. श्रान्त wearied, संवाहन relieving.
39154: श्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Weariness, exhaustion. E. श्रम to be weary, क्तिन् aff.
39155: श्राम r. 10th cl. (श्रामयति) 1 To call, to summon, to invite. 2 To counsel, to advise.
39156: श्राम m. (-मः) 1 A month. 2 A temporary shed, or platform and canopy. 3 Time. E. श्रम to be weary, अण् aff.
39157: श्रामणेर m. (-रः) A follower or disciple and servant of the principal Jainas or Jinas.
39158: श्राय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sacred or belonging to the goddess ŚRĪ. m. (-यः) Refuge, reliance, shelter or protection. E. श्रि to serve, aff. अण्, or in the attributive form श्री the goddess, घञ् aff., and इ substituted for the primitive vowel changed to अय, and अ made long.
39159: श्रायस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Produced in or on the best, &c. E. श्रेयम् the best, अण् aff., and the form changed by special rule.
39160: श्राव m. (-वः) Oozing, dropping, flowing. E. श्रु to ooze, aff. घञ्.
39161: श्रावक m. (-कः) 1 The lay votary of a Buddha or Jina. 2 A crow. E. श्रु to hear, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
39162: श्रावण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Produced in or under the asterism Śravaṇā. 2 Relating to the ear or hearing. m. (-णः) 1 The month Śrāvaṇa or Śravaṇā, (July-August.) 2 A heretic, an impostor. n. (णं) Causing to be heard. f. (-णा) A plant, commonly Katuki. f. (-णी) Day of full moon in the month Śrāvaṇa. E. श्रवणा the asterism, &c., aff. अण्.
39163: श्रावणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to or produced in the month Śrāvaṇa. m. (-कः) The month Śrāvaṇa. E. श्रवणा the asterism in which the moon is full this month, and ठक् aff.
39164: श्रावणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be declared or pronounced, to be made to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
39165: श्रावन्ती f. (-न्ती) A city, also Dharmapattan. E. श्र to ooze, causal form, भच् aff.
39166: श्रावयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be declared, to be made to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, causal v., तव्य aff.
39167: श्रावष्ठीय mfn. (-यः-यं) Produced in or under the asterism ŚRAVIṢṬHĀ, relating to it, &c. E. श्रविष्ठा, and छण् aff.
39168: श्रावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken or read, caused to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, causal v., क्त aff.
39169: श्राव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be heard. 2 To be read or related, to be caused to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, ण्यत् aff., or causal v., and यत् aff.
39170: श्रि (श्रि) r. 1st cl. (श्रयति-ते) To serve. With आङ् prefixed, 1 To seek asylum, to depend upon, to have recourse to. 2 To be near to. 3 To use, to employ. With अप and आङ्, To quit, to forsake. With उत् or सम and उत्, To be high or elevated. With वि, अप, and आङ्, 1 To fall, to prostrate, to worship. 2 To expect, to rely upon, to trust to.
39171: श्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cherished, protected, refuged. 2 Served, honored, worshipped. 3 Joined with, contiguous to, connected with. 4 Covered, overspread. 5 Having, possessing. E. श्रि to serve, क्त aff.
39172: श्रितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Served, honored. 2 Taking refuge with. E. श्रि to serve, क्तवतु aff.
39173: श्रिमन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Haughty, confident in wealth, beauty, &c. E. श्री, and मन्य who thinks, the vowel of the first made short.
39174: श्रिष (उ) श्रिषु r. 10th cl. (श्रेषति) To burn.
39175: श्री r. 9th cl. (श्रीणाति श्रीणीते) To cook, to dress. r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रयति-ते श्रायति-ते) To satisfy.
39176: श्री f. (-श्रीः) 1 Fortune, prosperity, success, thriving. 2 Wealth. 3 Beauty, splendour, lustre. 4 Light. 5 The three objects of life collectively, or love, duty, and wealth. 6 Dress, decoration. 7 State, paraphernalia. 8 Superhuman power. 9 Intellect, understanding. 10 Elevation, consequence. 11 Fame, glory. 12 The goddess LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU, and deity of plenty and prosperity. 13 A name of SARASVATI. 14 The mother of KUNTHU, the seventeenth Jina of the present age. 15 The Saral tree, (Pinus longifolia.) 16 Cloves. 17 A prefix to the names of deities, forming a kind of invocation at the beginning of a letter, &c. and often used repeatedly, as Śrī Śri DURGĀ; also a prefix of respect to proper names of persons, as Śri JAYADEVA; also of works, as ŚrīBhāgavata: this use of it is elliptical; the possessive aff. मतुप् or adj. युक्त joined, &c. being understood, and the sense will then be, the splendid, the illustrious, the famous, &c. E. श्रि to serve, (i. e. whom the world worships,) क्विप् aff. and the vowel made long.
39177: श्रीकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A country N. W. of Dehli, or about Tahnesar. 3 BHAVABHŪTI, the author of the Mālati Mādhava, a celebrated drama. E. श्री prosperity or eloquence, कण्ठ the throat.
39178: श्रीकण्ठपदलाञ्छन m. (-नः) BHAVABHŪTI, the poet. E. श्रीकण्ठ, and पद the name or title, लाञ्छन a mark; he who is known by the title of Śrīkaṇṭha.
39179: श्रीकण्ठसख m. (-खः) KUVERA. E. श्रीकण्ठ ŚIVA, and सखि the friend.
39180: श्रीकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Giving fortune or prosperity. m. (-रः) VIṢṆU. n. (-रं) The red lotus. E. श्री fortune, and कर who makes or confers.
39181: श्रीकरण m. (-णः) A pen. E. श्री the word Śrī, and करण implement of making.
39182: श्रीकान्त m. (-न्तः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री the goddess, and कान्त husband.
39183: श्रीकारी f. (-री) An antelope. E. श्री increasing, (nourishment,) कर maker, aff. ङीष्, the flesh being considered as highly digestible and nutritive.
39184: श्रीखण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) Sandal wood. E. श्री fortune, and खण्ड part.
39185: श्रीगदित n. (-तं) One of the minor dramatic compositions, a piece in one act, dedicated chiefly to the goddess of prosperity. E. श्री, and गदित said.
39186: श्रीगर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री fortune, and गर्ब्भ womb or origin.
39187: श्रीग्रह m. (-हः) A place for watering birds. E. श्री wealth, and ग्रह taking.
39188: श्रीघन n. (-नं) Sour curds. m. (-नः) A Buddha or Bauddha saint. E. श्री prosperity, and घन a heap.
39189: श्रीचक्र n. (-क्रं) 1 A magical diagram. 2 An astrological division of the body, the uterine or pubic region. 3 A wheel of INDRA'S car. 4 The circle of the globe or earth. E. श्री prosperity, &c., and चक्र a wheel.
39190: श्रीज m. (-जः) The deity of love. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and ज born.
39191: श्रीद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring wealth, prosperity, &c. m. (-दः) KUVERA, the god of riches. E. श्री wealth, and द who gives.
39192: श्रीधर m. (-रः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A Jina of the past period. E. श्री the goddess, or good fortune, and घर who has.
39193: श्रीनन्दन m. (-नः) The deity of love, KĀMA. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and नन्दन the son.
39194: श्रीनिकेतन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री the goddess, and निकेतन abode.
39195: श्रीनिवास m. (-सः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री the goddess, and निवास abode.
39196: श्रीपति m. (-तिः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A king, a prince. E. श्री the goddess of fortune or rank, and पति husband or master.
39197: श्रीपथ m. (-थः) A highway, a royal road. E. श्री royal paraphernalia, and पथ for पयिन् road.
39198: श्रीपर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 A lotus. 2 A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa). f. (-र्णी) 1 A shrub, (Gmelina arborea.) 2 A medicinal plant, commonly Kāyaphal. 3 The silk-cotton tree. 4 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes). E. श्री beauty or the goddess, and पर्ण a leaf.
39199: श्रीपर्णिका f. (-का) A medicinal shrub, commonly Kayaphal. E. कन् added to the last.
39200: श्रीपिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Turpentine. E. श्री the Śarala or pine, and पिष्ट pounded, ground.
39201: श्रीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A horse. 2 KĀMA. E. श्री fortune, or the goddess, and पुत्त्र a son.
39202: श्रीफल m. (-लः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) f. (-ली) 1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 Emblic myrobalan. E. श्री beauty or the goddess, (to whom it may be offered,) and फल fruit.
39203: श्रीभद्र m. (-द्रः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and भद्र auspicious.
39204: श्रीभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A horse. E. श्री the goddess, भ्रातृ brother; being recovered as well as LAKṢMĪ, at the churning of the ocean.
39205: श्रीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Wealthy, opulent. 2 Pleasing, beautiful. 3 Prosperous, fortunate, thriving. 4 Famous, illustrious. m. (-मान्) 1 A tree, commonly Tila or Tilaka. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 KUVERA, the god of wealth. 4 ŚIVA. E. श्री beauty, &c., मतुप् aff.
39207: श्रीमुख m. (-खः) The seventh year of the Indian cycle. E. श्री prosperity, and मुख chief.
39208: श्रीयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Famous, illustrious. 2 Fortunate, wealthy. E. श्री prosperity, and युक्त joined with, possessing.
39209: श्रीयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, illustrious. 2 Fortunate, wealthy. E. श्री fortune, and युत joined.
39210: श्रीरस m. (-सः) Turpentine. E. श्री the Śarala tree or pine, and रस juice.
39211: श्रीराग m. (-रः) The third of the Rāgas or personified musical modes. E. श्री illustrious, राग the mode.
39212: श्रीराम m. (-मः) RĀMACANDRA. E. श्री celebrated, and राम the name of the prince.
39213: श्रील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Fortunate, prosperous. 2 Rich, wealthy. E. श्री fortune, लच् poss. aff.
39214: श्रीवत्स m. (-त्सः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A particular mark, usually said to be a curl of hair, on the breast of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, and represented in delineations of him by ❈. 3 A hole in a wall made for felonious purposes. 4 The emblem of the tenth Jina, or the mark above ascribed to VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and वत्स dear to.
39215: श्रीवत्सकिन् m. (-की) A horse having a curl of hair on his breast. E. श्रीवत्स the mark of VIṢṆU, कन् aff. of comparison, and इनि poss. aff.
39216: श्रीवत्सभृत् m. (-भृत्) VIṢṆU. E. श्रीवत्स the mark so termed, and भृत् having.
39217: श्रीवत्सलाञ्छन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. श्रीवत्स the figure so named, and लाञ्छन sign, mark, (whose.)
39218: श्रीवत्साङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) VIṢṆU: see the last. E. श्रीवत्स, and अङ्क mark.
39219: श्रीवराह m. (-हः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री illustrious, वराह the boar Avatāra.
39220: श्रीवास m. (-सः) 1 Turpentine. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 A lotus. 4 ŚIVA. E. श्री the Śarala or pine, or LAKṢMĪ, &c., and वास abode.
39222: श्रीवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. श्री auspicious, and वृक्ष a tree.
39223: श्रीवृक्षक m. (-कः) A curl or lock of hair on the chest of a horse: a various reading perhaps for श्रीवत्सक; see श्रीवत्सकिन्.
39224: श्रीवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Turpentine. E. श्री the Śarala or pine tree, and वेष्ट extract.
39225: श्रीश m. (-शः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 RĀMACANDRA. E. श्री the goddess LAKṢMĪ, also incarnate in SĪTĀ, and ईश husband.
39226: श्रीसज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Cloves. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and सज्ञा appellation, the names of the goddess being all applied to the spice.
39227: श्रीसहोदर m. (-रः) The moon. E. श्री the goddess, and सहोदर uterine brother; being reproduced with her and other objects, at the churning of the ocean.
39228: श्रीहस्तिनी f. (-नी) The sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, हस्त the hand, इनि and ङीष् aff.; held in the hand of the goddess.
39229: श्रु r. 1st cl. form irr. (शृणोति) To hear: form reg. (श्रवति) To go, to move, especially as a fluid, to drop, to ooze, to flow. With प्रति or सम् prefixed, To promise, to assent or agree to. With वि, To be famous.
39232: श्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heard. 2 Understood. n. (-तं) 1 Sacred science, holy writ, &c. 2 The object of hearing, that which is heard. E. श्रु to hear, aff. क्त.
39233: श्रुतकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated. m. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A divine sage. 2 A generous man, a benefactor, a donor. f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A river. 2 The wife of BHARATA. E. श्रुत heard, कीर्त्ति fame.
39234: श्रुतदेवी f. (-वी) SARASVATĪ. E. श्रुत that which is heard, (science, &c.) and देवी presiding deity.
39235: श्रुतधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Recollecting, remembering what has been heard. 2 Having or observing the Vedas. E. श्रुत, and घर who has.
39236: श्रुतर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi of a particular order; one by whom holy writ has been heard, not taught; as the author of the Suśruta, a medical work, the son of VIŚVĀMITRA, &c. E. श्रुत heard, and ऋषि a saint.
39237: श्रुतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hearing, having heard. E. श्रु to hear, क्तवतु aff.
39238: श्रुतश्रवोनुज m. (-जः) The planet ŚANI or SATURN. E. श्रुतश्रवस् one of the other sons of SŪRYA, and अनुज younger born.
39239: श्रुतादान n. (-नं) Citing the Vedas. E. श्रुत holy writ, and आदान referring to, taking.
39240: श्रुताध्ययनसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Well read in sacred science, conversant with the Vedas, and the branches of knowledge or philosophy, dependant on them. E. श्रुत heard, (knowledge of grammar, &c. that has been taught viva voce,) अध्ययन perusal, (of the Vedas,) सस्पन्न accomplished.
39241: श्रुतान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquainted with or conforming to the Vedas. E. श्रुत, and अन्वित possessed of.
39242: श्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 The Vedas, severally or collectively, scripture, holy writ. 2 An ear. 3 Hearing. 4 Intelligence, news, rumour, report. 5 (In music,) A division of the octave, a quarter tone or interval, of which twenty-two are enumerated; four constituting a major tone, three a minor, and two a semitone: the Śrutis are personified as nymphs. 6 The constellation Śravaṇā. E. श्रु to hear, क्तिन् aff.
39243: श्रुतिकट m. (-टः) 1 Penance, expiation. 2 A snake. E. श्रुति the Vedas, or an ear, &c., and कट to go, aff. अच्.
39244: श्रुतिकथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught or prescribed by the Vedas. E. श्रुति as above, and कथित said, declared.
39245: श्रुतिचोदन n. (-नं) Holy precept or injunction, the doctrine of the Vedas. E. श्रुति, and चोदन saying.
39246: श्रुतिजीविका f. (-का) Law, the code of laws. E. श्रुति the Vedas, and जीविका living; existing according to scripture.
39247: श्रुतितत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hearing, having ears. 2 Studying the Vedas. E. श्रुति hearing, or the Vedas, and तत्पर attentive.
39248: श्रुतिद्वैध n. (-धं) Disagreement or contradiction of any two passages in the Vedas, or of two Vedas. E. श्रुति, and द्वैध difference.
39249: श्रुतिधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Having, being versed in, or observing the Vedas. 2 Hearing. E. श्रुति, and घर who or what has.
39250: श्रुतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Hearing. 2 Observing, obeying. 3 Having or following the Vedas. E. श्रुत, and इनि aff.
39251: श्रुतिमूल n. (-लं) 1 The root of the ear. 2 The text of the Vedas. E. श्रुति, and मूल root.
39252: श्रुतिमण्डल n. (-लं) The outer ear. E. श्रुति, and मण्डल circle.
39253: श्रुतिवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deaf. 2 Ignorant or unread in the Vedas. E. श्रुति hearing, or the Vedas, and वर्ज्जित abandoned, lost.
39254: श्रुतिविषय m. (-यः) An object or doctrine of the Vedas. E. श्रुति. and विषय an object.
39255: श्रुतिस्मृतिविहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Scriptural, declared by the Vedas and the law. E. श्रुति, and स्मृति and विहित said.
39256: श्रुत्यनुप्रास m. (-सः) Alliteration. E. श्रुति hearing, and अनुप्रास similarity of sound.
39257: श्रुत्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said or enjoined by the Vedas. E. श्रुति, and उक्त said; also श्रुत्युदित, &c.
39258: श्रुत्वा ind. Having heard. E. श्रु to hear, क्त्वा aff.
39259: श्रुव m. (-वः) Sacrifice, oblation. n. (-वं) A sort of ladle used for pouring Ghee or oiled butter at a sacrifice. E. श्रु to ooze or leak, aff. क, more usually श्रुव, &c.
39260: श्रुश्रुतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hearing. E. श्रु to hear, reiterated, क्तवतु aff.
39261: श्रूयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Hearing, being hearing. E. श्रु to hear, pass. v., शानच् aff.
39262: श्रेणि mf. (-णिः-णिः or-णी) 1 A line, a row, a range. 2 A company of artisans following the same business. 3 A corporation, a company of traders or those dealing in the same articles. 4 A bucket, a baling vessel. E. श्रि to serve, नि Uṇādi aff.
39263: श्रेणिक m. (-कः) The name of one of the kings of Magadhā, contemporary with and patron of ŚĀKYASIṂHA. f. (-का) A tent. E. श्रेणि a line, &c., कन् aff.
39264: श्रेणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made or become a heap. 2 Arranged, set in rows. E. श्रेणि a range, भूत become, च्चि augment.
39265: श्रेधी f. (-धी) 1 A set or succession of substances. 2 (In arithmetic,) Progression.
39266: श्रेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Best, excellent, most excellent, ind. Well, most excellent. n. (-यः) 1 Virtue, moral merit. 2 Final happiness. 3 Good fortune, auspiciousness, prosperity. m. (-प्रान्) The 11th Jina or Jaina pontiff. f. (-यसी) 1 A plant resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis.) 2 A shrub, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 3 Yellow myrobalan. E. श्र substituted for प्रशस्त good, and ईयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
39267: श्रेयस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Conferring, or the means of, future felicity. 2 Propitious. 3 Making better or superior. E. श्रेयस्, and कर who or what does.
39268: श्रेयस्काम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desiring final felicity, &c. E. श्रेयस्, and काम desire.
39269: श्रेयस्त्व n. (-स्त्वं) 1 Superiority, betterness. 2 Final felicity, &c. E. श्रेयस्, and त्व aff.
39270: श्रेयांश m. (-शः) The eleventh Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era; also श्रेयांस.
39271: श्रेयोर्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Desirous of good, ambitious. E. श्रेयस्, and अर्थिन् who asks.
39272: श्रेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Best, excellent, most excellent, pre-eminent. 2 Oldest, senior. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 KUVERA. 2 A king. 3 A Brahman. n. (-ष्ठं) Cow's milk. E. श्र for प्रशस्त best, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
39273: श्रेष्ठकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) The main pillar of a house. E. श्रेष्ठ best, and काष्ठ timber.
39274: श्रेष्ठता f. (-ता) Superiority, betterness, excellence. E. श्रेष्ठ, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, श्रेष्ठत्वं.
39275: श्रेष्ठाश्रम m. (-मः) The householder. E. श्रेष्ठ best, आश्रम order or state; the householder being considered the best of the four orders, as he supports the other three.
39276: श्रेष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Best, chief. m. (-ष्ठी) 1 An artist eminent by birth. 2 The head or chief of a body of persons following the same trade or occupation, a president, a foreman. E. श्रेष्ठ excellence, इनि aff.
39277: श्रै r. 1st cl. (श्रायति) 1 To boil, to cook. 2 To melt, to liquefy. 3 To sweat.
39278: श्रैष्ठ्य n. (-ष्ठ्यं) Superiority, betterness, preference. E. श्रेष्ठ, and ष्यञ् aff.
39279: श्रोण (ऋ) श्रोणृ r. 1st cl. (श्रोणति) To accumulate, to heap together.
39280: श्रोण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Dressed, cooked, matured. m. (-णः) A cripple. f. (-णा) 1 The constellation Śravaṇā. 2 Rice-gruel. E. श्रोण to heap together, aff. अच्; or शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. न.
39281: श्रोणि f. (-णिः-णी) 1 The hip and loins. 2 A road, a way. E. श्रोण to heap, aff. इन्; or श्रु to hear, Uṇādi aff. नि.
39282: श्रोणिफलक n. (-कं) 1 The hip and loins, or the hip only. 2 The hip-bone, the os ilium. E. श्रोणि the same, and फल fruit, कन् aff. of comparison, or फलक a plank; also श्रोणिफल n. (-लं)
39283: श्रोणिविम्ब n. (-म्बं) A string worn round the loins.
39284: श्रोतस् n. (-तः) 1 The ear. 2 The current of a stream. 3 An organ of sense. E. श्रु to hear or to leak, aff. असुन्, and तुट् augment.
39285: श्रोतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be heard or listened to. E. श्रु to hear, तव्य aff. of the future participle.
39286: श्रोतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Hearing, a hearer, who hears. E. श्रु to hear, तृच् aff.
39287: श्रोत्र n. (-त्रं) The ear. E. श्रु to hear, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.
39288: श्रोत्रसुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Melodious, musical, sounding agreeably. E. श्रोत्र, and सुख pleasure.
39289: श्रोत्रादि ind. The five senses. E. श्रोत्र, and आदि etcetera.
39290: श्रोत्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Modest, docile, well-behaved. m. (-यः) 1 A Brahman versed in the study of the Vedas. 2 A Brahman following  a particular branch or school of the Vedas. E. श्रोत्र considered as substituted for छन्दस् the metre of the Vedas, and खन् aff.; or श्रोत्र the ear, said also to mean the Vedas, and घ aff.
39291: श्रोत्रियता f. (-ता) Conversancy with the Vedas, the duty of a Brahman. E. श्रोत्रिय a priest acquainted with the Vedas, and तल् aff.
39292: श्रोत्रियस्व n. (-स्वं) The property of a learned Brahman. E. श्रोत्रिय, and स्व own.
39293: श्रौत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Relating or belonging to the Vedas, to the ear, hearing, &c. n. (-तं) 1 Preservation of the sacred fire. 2 Any observance ordained by the Vedas. f. (-ती) Comparison expressed by a particle, so, as, like, &c. E. श्रुति the Vedas, and अण् aff.
39294: श्रौतस्मार्त्तक्रिया f. (-या) Acts conformable to law and religion. E. श्रौत and स्मार्त्त, and क्रिया act.
39295: श्रौतस्मार्त्तधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Duty enjoined by the Vedas and laws. E. श्रौत and स्मार्त्त, and धर्म्म duty.
39296: श्रौत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Conversancy with the Vedas. 2 The ear. E. श्रोत्र the ear, or श्रोत्रिय a Brahman studied in scripture, अण् aff.; in the second case the last syllable rejected as well as the pen. vowel.
39297: श्रौषट् ind. An exclamation used in making an offering with fire to the gods or manes. E. श्रु to hear, (the prayer being heard in consequence,) and डौषट aff.
39298: श्र्याह्व n. (-ह्वं) The lotus. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and आह्वा appellation, the goddess appearing in the first instance from within the flower, and thence deriving many of her names.
39299: श्लक (इ) श्लकि r. 1st cl. (श्लंकते) To go, to move.
39300: श्लक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) 1 Small, fine, minute. 2 Gentle, mild, amiable. 3 Honest, sincere. 4 Plain, even, smooth. E. श्लिष to embrace, क्स्न aff., the short vowel substituted for the penultimate.
39301: श्लग (इ) श्लगि r. 1st cl. (श्लंङ्गति) To go, to move.
39302: श्लथ r. 10th cl. (श्लथयमि) To be weak, to be relaxed, loose, flaccid. r. 1st cl. (श्लथयति) To hurt or kill.
39303: श्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Loose, flaccid, relaxed. 2 Dishevelled (hair). 3 Untied, unfastened. E. श्लथ to be relaxed, aff. अच्.
39304: श्लाख (ऋ) श्लाखृ r. 1st cl. (श्लाखति) To pervade.
39305: श्लाघ (ऋ) श्लाघृ r. 1st cl. (श्लाघते) 1 To praise, to eulogise. 2 To flatter, to coax, to wheedle. 3 To boast.
39306: श्लाघा f. (-घा) 1 Praise, panegyric, flattery, eulogium. 2 Service, obedience. 3 Wish, desire. E. श्लाघ to praise, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
39307: श्लाघित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended. E. श्लाघ to praise, क्त aff.
39308: श्लाघ्य mfn. (-घ्यः-घ्या-घ्यं) Venerable, respectable, praise-worthy, entitled to praise or veneration. E. श्लाघा praise, यत् aff.
39309: श्लिकु m. (-कुः) 1 A servant, a slave. 2 A blackguard. 3 A lecher, a libertine or debauchee. n. (-कु) Astronomy. astrology. E. श्लिष to embrace, Uṇādi aff. कु, and क substituted for the final.
39310: श्लिष r. 4th cl. (ञि ओऌ) श्लिषॢ (श्लिष्यति) r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्लेषति श्लेषयति) 1 To embrace. 2 To adhere or cling to. 3 To unite, to join or connect. (उ) श्लिषु r. 1st cl. (श्लिपति) To burn.
39311: श्लिषा f. (-षा) Embracing, an embrace. E. श्लिष to embrace, अङ् and टाप् affs.
39312: श्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Embraced. 2 Touched by, clung or adhered to. E. श्लिष to embrace, क्त aff.
39313: श्लिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Embracing, clinging, adhering to, being in close contact with. E. श्लिष to embrace, शवृ aff.
39314: श्लीपद n. (-दं) Morbid enlargement of the legs.
39315: श्लीपदप्रभव m. (-वः) The mango tree. E. श्लीपद swelled leg, and प्रभव production.
39316: श्लीपदापह m. (-हः) A plant, (Nageia putranjiva.) E. श्लीपद, and अपह removing.
39317: श्लील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Prosperous, fortunate, affluent, happy. E. श्री good fortune, लच् poss. aff., and र changed to ल.
39318: श्लेष m. (-षः) 1 Union, junction, the proximity of contact. 2 Association, society, presence. 3 Embracing, an embrace. 4 Adhering or clinging to, &c. 5 A figure of rhetoric, choice or connexion of words so as to admit of a double interpretation, a species of paronomasia or pun. E. श्लिष to embrace, aff. ण.
39319: श्लेष्मक m. (-कः) Phlegm, the watery or phlegmatic humor. E. श्लेष्मन् the same, कन् pleonasm.
39320: श्लेष्मघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing phlegm. f. (-घ्ना) 1 Arabian jasmine. 2 A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) f. (-घ्नी) Hogweed. E. श्लेष्म phlegm, and घ्न removing, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीप्.
39321: श्लेष्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced or proceeding from phlegm. E. श्लेष्मन्, and ज born.
39322: श्लेष्मण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Phlegmatic. f. (-णा) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.) E. श्लेष्मन् the humor, and न aff.
39323: श्लेष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) The phlegmatic humor, one of the three principal humors or fluids of the body. E. श्लिष to embrace or adhere to, (the body,) aff. मनिन्.
39324: श्लेष्मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Phlegmatic, abounding or affected with phlegm, &c. m. (-लः) A plant, (Cordia latifolia.) E. श्लेष्म phlegm, लच् aff.
39325: श्लेष्मह m. (-हः) A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal. E. श्लेष्म phlegm, and ह destroying.
39326: श्लेष्मात m. (-तः) A small tree, (Cordia latifolia.) E. श्लेष्मन् phlegm, अत to go, (to remove,) aff. अच्; also with कन् added श्लेष्मातक.
39327: श्लैष्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Allaying or exciting phlegm, phlegmatic. E. श्लेष्मन् phlegm, ठञ् aff.
39328: श्लोक (ऋ) श्लोकृ r. 1st cl. (श्लोकते) 1 To put together, to compose, as verses. 2 To be put together or composed.
39329: श्लोक m. (-कः) 1 A verse, a stanza. 2 Fame, celebrity. E. श्लोक to compose, (as verses,) aff. अच्; according to the Rāmāyaṇa, irr. derived from शोक sorrow: the first verse ever composed, having been the involuntary expression of VĀLMĪKI'S grief at beholding a bird killed by a fowler.
39330: श्लोकत्व n. (-त्वं) Versification. E. त्व added to the last.
39331: श्लोण (ऋ) श्लोणृ r. 1st cl. (श्लोणति) To heap together, to collect or assemble.
39332: श्वःश्रेयस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Happy, prosperous. n. adv. (-सं) 1 Happy, well, right. subst. 2 BRAHMA, the Supreme Being. 3 Happiness, prosperity. E. श्वस् particle, implying happiness, श्रेयस्  best, excellent, and a final अच् or vowel added to the compound.
39333: श्वक (इ) श्वकि r. 1st cl. (श्वंकते) To go, to move.
39334: श्वक्रीडिन् m. (-डी) A dog-feeder or trainer. E. श्व, and क्रीडिन् who plays with.
39335: श्वग (इ) श्वगि r. 1st cl. (श्वंगति) To go or move.
39336: श्वगण m. (-णः) A pack or number of dogs. E. श्व a dog, and गण a troop.
39337: श्वगणिक m. (-कः) A hunter. mf. (-कः-का) 1 A dog feeder. 2 One carried by dogs. E. श्व a dog, गण a number, and ठन् aff.
39338: श्वच r. 1st cl. (श्वचते) (इ) श्वचि (श्वंचते) To go, to move.
39339: श्वज r. 1st cl. (श्वजते) also (इ) श्वजि (श्वंजते) To go, to move.
39340: श्वठ r. 10th cl. (श्वाठयति) (इ) श्वठि (श्वण्ठयति) 1 To finish. 2 To leave defective or unfinished. 3 To go, to move. (श्वठयति) 1 To speak amiss. 2 To speak well. 3 To abstain from speaking: see शठ.
39341: श्वदंष्ट्रा f. (-ष्ट्रा) 1 A dog's tooth. 2 A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. श्व for श्वन् a dog, दंष्ट्रा a tooth.
39342: श्वधूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A jackal. E. श्वन् a dog, and धूर्त्त a cheat.
39343: श्वन् m. (-श्वा श्वानौ श्वानः) accu. plu. (शुनः) A dog. f. (शुनी) A bitch. E. श्वि to increase, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, form irr.
39344: श्वनिश nf. (-शं-शा) A night on which dogs bark and howl. E. श्व for श्वन् a dog, निशा night.
39345: श्वपच mf. (-चः-चा) 1 A man or woman of a low and degraded caste. 2 A dog-feeder or keeper. E. श्वन् a dog, पच to cook (for his food), or to cherish as his property, and अच् aff.; also with क्विप् aff. श्वपच् m. (-पक्) and with अण् aff. श्वपाक.
39346: श्वपद n. (-दं) 1 A dog's foot. 2 A mark like one, to be branded on the forehead of a thief. E. श्व, and पद a foot.
39347: श्वपाक m. (-कः) A man of a degraded and outcast tribe, the son of an Ugrā woman by a Kṣatrī male, and classed with the Caṇḍāla, with whom he is ordered to live out of the town, to feed from broken vessels, and wear the clothes of the dead; to possess no other property than asses and dogs, and to be excluded from all intercourse with other tribes; he can only be employed as public executioner, or to carry out the bodies of those who die without kindred. E. श्व a dog, पच to cook, (to feed on or to cherish,) aff. अण्: see श्वपच.
39348: श्वफल m. (-लः) The lime or citron. E. श्व for श्वन् a dog, and फल fruit.
39349: श्वभीरु m. (-रुः) A jackal. E. श्वन् a dog, and भीरु afraid of.
39350: श्वभ्र r. 10th cl. (श्वभ्रयति) 1 To live in misery or distress. 2 To go, to move. 3 To make a hole, to pierce or perforate.
39351: श्वभ्र n. (-भ्रं) A hole, a gap, a chasm. E. श्वभ्र to pierce, aff. अच्, or श्व a dog, भृ to cherish, aff. क.
39352: श्वयथु m. (-थुः) Swelling, intumescence. E. श्वि to swell, aff. अथुच्.
39353: श्वयीचि f. (-चिः) Sickness, disease. E. श्वि to increase, Uṇādi aff. ईचि.
39354: श्वर्त्त r. 10th cl. (श्वर्त्तयति) 1 To live in misery or distress. 2 To go, to move.
39355: श्वल r. 1st cl. (श्वलति) To run, to go quickly.
39357: श्वल्ल r. 1st cl. (श्वल्लति) To run, to go fast or quickly.
39358: श्ववत् ind. Like a dog, cur-like. E. श्व, and वति aff.
39359: श्ववत् m. (-वान्) A dog-feeder or trainer. E. श्व, and मतुप aff.
39360: श्ववृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) Service, servitude. E. श्व a dog, and वृत्ति practice.
39361: श्वव्याघ्र m. (-घ्रः) The hunting leopard or Ciṭa. E. श्व a dog, and व्याघ्र a tiger.
39362: श्वशुर m. (-रः) 1 A father-in-law, a wife's or husband's father. 2 A venerable man, one to be treated as a father-in-law. m. du. (-रौ) A father and mother-in-law. E. शु a particle, implying respect, अश to pervade, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
39363: श्वशुर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A brother-in-law, a wife's or husband's brother. 2 A husband's younger brother. E. श्वशुर a father-in-law, and यत् patronymic aff.
39364: श्वश्रू f. (-श्रूः) A mother-in-law. E. श्वशुर a father-in-law, the उ and अ rejected, र conjoined with श, and ऊङ् fem. aff.
39365: श्वश्रूश्वशुर m. du. (-रौ) Mother and father-in-law. E. श्वश्रू, and श्वशुर conjoined.
39366: श्वस r. 2nd cl. (श्वसिति) 1 To breathe. 2 To live. With आङ् prefixed, To recover or revive, to console. With उत्, 1 To open, to expand. 2 To console. With निर्, 1 To breathe out, to expire. 2 To sigh. With वि, To have trust or faith in.
39367: श्वस् ind. 1 To-morrow. 2 A particle, implying auspiciousness.
39368: श्वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सती-सत्) Breathing, sighing. E. श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.
39369: श्वसन m. (-नः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) n. (-नं) 1 Breathing, breath. 2 Sighing. E. श्वस to breathe, aff. ल्युट्.
39370: श्वसनासन m. (-नः) A snake. E. श्वसन breathing, असन food; eating air.
39371: श्वसनेश्वर m. (-रः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. श्वसन breath, and ईश्वर sovereign.
39372: श्वसनोत्सुक m. (-कः) A snake. E. श्वसन breathing, and उत्सुक delighting.
39373: श्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sighed, breathed, sighing, breathing. n. (-तं) 1 Breathing, breath. 2 Sighing, a sigh. E. श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.
39374: श्वसुत m. (-तः) A plant, (Conyza lacera, &c.) E. श्व a dog, and सुत a son.
39375: श्वस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Future, what will be to-morrow, &c. E. श्वस् to-morrow, ट्युल् aff.
39376: श्वस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) To-morrow's, what will be to-morrow. E. श्वस् to-morrow, and त्यप् aff.
39377: श्वस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Touched by a dog, defiled. E. श्व, and स्पृष्ट touched.
39378: श्वागणिक m. (-कः) A hunter. mf. (-कः-की) 1 A dog-keeper, one who lives by feeding or keeping dogs. 2 One who rides or is drawn by dogs. E. श्वगण a number of dogs, ठञ् aff.
39379: श्वादन्त m. (-न्तः) A dog's tooth. E. श्वन a dog, दन्त a tooth, and the vowel termination of the first word made long in this and similar compounds, as श्वाकर्ण, श्वापुच्छ, &c.
39380: श्वान m. (-नः) A dog. f. (-नी) A bitch. E. a various reading of श्वन्, q. v.
39381: श्वापद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Ferocious, savage, relating or belonging to a beast of prey. m. (-दः) A beast of prey in general. E. श्वन् a dog, आपद to resemble, aff. अच्; or श्वपद with अण् added.
39382: श्वाविध् m. (-विद् or वित्) A porcupine. E. श्वन् a dog, आङ् before व्यध to pierce, aff. क्विप्.
39383: श्वाश्व n. (-श्वः) BHAIRAVA, or ŚIVA, in a terrific form. E. श्व a dog, and अश्व a horse, being usually represented mounted on a dog.
39384: श्वास m. (-सः) 1 Breath, breathing. 2 Air, wind. 3 Sighing, a sigh. E. श्वस to breathe, aff. ण.
39385: श्वासप्रश्वासधारण n. (-णं) Breathing through the nostrils for a few seconds as a religious exercise: see प्राणायाम. E. श्वास inspiration, प्रश्वास expiration, and धारण holding or checking.
39386: श्वासहेति f. (-तिः) Sleep, sleepiness. E. श्वास breathing or sighing, and हेति a weapon.
39387: श्वासारि m. (-रिः) A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi. E. श्वास breath, and अरि hostile.
39388: श्वासिन् m. (-सी) Air, wind. E. श्वास breath, and इनि aff.
39389: श्वि (इर टु and ओ) टुओश्वि r. 1st cl. (श्वयति) 1 To move, to go, or go to. 2 To grow, to increase.
39390: श्वित (आ) श्विता r. 1st cl. (श्वेतते) To be white.
39391: श्वित्र n. (-त्रं) Whiteness of the skin, vitiligo. E. श्वित to be white, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
39392: श्वित्रघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A plant, (Tragia involucrata.) E. श्वित्र vitiligo, and घ्न destroying.
39393: श्वित्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Affected with vitiligo or whiteness of the skin. E. श्वित्र, and इनि aff.
39394: श्विद (इ) श्विदि r. 1st cl. (श्विंदते) To be white, to become or continue so.
39395: श्वॄ r. 9th cl. (श्वृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
39396: श्वेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White. m. (-तः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 The planet VENUS, or its regent ŚUKRA. 3 The sixth range of mountains, dividing the known continent, the white mountains separating the Varṣas of Hiraṇmaya and Romanaka. 4 One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world; in fable the White Island, identified geographically by WILFORD, with Britain. 5 A white cloud. 6 Cumminseed. 7 A conch. mf. (-तः-ता) A small white shell used as a coin, a Cowri. n. (-तं) Silver. f. (-ता) 1 A grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 2 A plant, Kāṣṭha Pātāla(?) 3 A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.) 4 Hogweed. 5 Bent grass with white blossoms. 6 Bambu manna. 7 Crystal. 8 Clayed or candied sugar. E. श्वित to be white, aff. अच् or घञ्.
39397: श्वेतक m. (-कः) A Cowri. n. (-कं) Silver. E. कन् added to the preceding.
39398: श्वेतकुञ्जर m. (-रः) INDRA'S elephant. E. श्वेत white, and कुञ्जर an elephant.
39399: श्वेतकेतु m. (-तुः) A Bauddha or Jaina saint. E. श्वेत white, and केतु a banner.
39400: श्वेतकेश m. (-शः) A variety of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. श्वेत white, and केश a filament.
39401: श्वेतकोल n. (-लः) The Saphara fish, (Cyprinus Sophore, HAM.)
39402: श्वेतखदिर m. (-रः) A white variety of the Mimosa catechu. E. श्वेत, and खदिर the Khayar.
39403: श्वेतगज m. (-जः) 1 A white elephant. 2 The elephant of INDRA. E. श्वेत white, and गज an elephant.
39404: श्वेतगरुत् m. (-रुत्) A goose. E. श्वेत white, and गरुत् a wing.
39405: श्वेतछद m. (-दः) 1 A goose. 2 A kind of basil, (Ocymum album, &c.) E. श्वेत white, and छद a feather or leaf.
39406: श्वेतटङ्कण n. (-णं) White or refined borax. E. श्वेत white, and टङ्कण the same.
39407: श्वेतदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A bent grass with white blossoms. E. श्वेत, and टूर्व्वा Doob grass.
39408: श्वेतद्विप m. (-पः) 1 A white elephant. 2 INDRA'S elephant. E. श्वेत white, and द्विप an elephant.
39409: श्वेतद्वीप m. (-पः) The white island, or a minor division of the universe so called: also termed Candra Dvīpa, and supposed by WILFORD to be Britain. E. श्वेत white, and द्वीप an island; also श्वेत q. v.
39410: श्वेतधातु m. (-तुः) 1 Chalk. 2 The milk stone, opal or chalcedony. E. श्वेत white, घातु a mineral.
39411: श्वेतधामन् m. (-मा) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. 3 Cuttle fish bone. E. श्वेत white, and धामन् a ray.
39412: श्वेतनील m. (-लः) A cloud. E. श्वेत white, and नील black or dark blue.
39413: श्वेतपत्र m. (-त्रः) A goose. E. श्वेत white, and पत्र a feather.
39414: श्वेतपत्ररथ m. (-थः) BRAHMĀ. E. श्वेतपत्र a goose, and रथ a car or conveyance.
39415: श्वेतपद्म n. (-द्मं) The white lotus. E. श्वेत white, and पद्म a lotus.
39416: श्वेतपर्णास m. (-सः) Holy basil, or a variety of it, (Ocymum sanctum or album). E. श्वेत white, and पर्णास the same.
39417: श्वेतपाटला f. (-ला) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. श्वेत white, and पाटला the same.
39418: श्वेतपिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A lion. E. श्वेत white, and पिङ्ग tawny; of a light tawny colour.
39419: श्वेतपिङ्गल m. (-लः) A lion. E. श्वेत white, and पिङ्गल tawny; see the last; also with कन् added, श्वेतपिङ्गलक.
39420: श्वेतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Vitex trifolia.) f. (-ष्पा) A Ghoṣa with white flowers. E. श्वेत white, and पुष्प a flower.
39421: श्वेतपुष्पक m. (-कः) A plant, (Nerium odorum, the white variety.) E. कन् added to the last.
39422: श्वेतप्रसूनक m. (-कः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) E. श्वेत white, (flowers,) प्रसूनक productive.
39424: श्वेतमरिच n. (-चं) The seed of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. श्वेत white, and मरिच pepper.
39425: श्वेतरक्त m. (-क्तः) Pale red or pink, (the colour.) E. श्वेत white, and रक्त red.
39426: श्वेतरथ m. (-थः) The planet VENUS. E. श्वेत white, and रथ a car.
39427: श्वेतरञ्जन n. (-नं) Lead. E. श्वेत white, रञ्जन colouring.
39428: श्वेतरास्ना f. (-स्ना) A plant, white Rasan: see रास्ना.
39429: श्वेतरोचिस् m. (-चिः) The moon. E. श्वेत white, and रोचिस् light.
39430: श्वेतरोहित m. (-तः) GARUḌA. E. श्वेत white, and रोहित red.
39431: श्वेतवचा f. (-चा) Orris root, (Acorus calamus.) E. श्वेत white, and वचा the same.
39432: श्वेतवल्कल m. (-लः) Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.) E. श्वेत white, and वल्कल bark.
39433: श्वेतवाजिन् m. (-जी) 1 The moon. 2 The prince ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, वाजि a horse, इनि aff.
39434: श्वेतवासस् m. (-साः) A religious mendicant, wearing white garments. E. श्वेत, and वासस् vesture.
39435: श्वेतवाह m. (-हः) ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, and वाह a horse.
39436: श्वेतवाहन m. (-नः) 1 The moon. 2 ARJUNA. 3 The Makara, a marine monster. E. श्वेत white, and वाहन a vehicle.
39437: श्वेतवाहिन् m. (-ही) ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, and वाह a vehicle, (a horse,) इनि aff.
39438: श्वेतशुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Barley. E. श्वेत white, and शुङ्ग awn.
39439: श्वेतसर्प m. (-र्पः) 1 A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) 2 A white snake. E. श्वेत white, सर्प what creeps or grows, or a serpent.
39440: श्वेतसार m. (-रः) A tree, (Mimosa catechu) E. श्वेत white, सार pith or essence.
39441: श्वेतसुरसा f. (-सा) A white variety of the Nyctanthes arbor-tristis. E. श्वेत white, and सुरसा the Rasan, &c. to which it is compared.
39442: श्वेतहय m. (-यः) 1 A white horse. 2 The horse of INDRA. 3 A name of ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, and हय a horse.
39443: श्वेतहस्तिन् m. (-स्ती) 1 A white elephant. 2 The elephant of INDRA. E. श्वेत white, and हस्तिन् an elephant.
39444: श्वेतार्क m. (-र्कः) Gigantic swallow-wort, (Asclepias gigantea,) with white flowers. E. श्वेत white, and अर्क the same.
39445: श्वेतोदर m. (-रः) KUVERA. E. श्वेत white, and उदर the belly.
39446: श्वैत्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Whiteness. 2 Vitiligo. E. श्वित or श्वेत, and ष्यञ् aff.
39447: श्वैत्र n. (-त्रं) Vitiligo. E. श्वेत to be white, रन् aff.
39448: श्वोवसीयस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Auspicious, fortunate. E. श्वेस and वस both particles implying auspiciousness, ईयसुन् affixed to the latter, and a final vowel added to the compound. ष
39449: ष The thirty-first consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and second sibilant, corresponding to Sh, pronounced in some schools Kh: this letter is usually the first element of the roots, the derivatives of which commence with स.
39450: ष mfn. (षः-षा-षं) Best, excellent. m. (षः) 1 A learned man, a teacher. 2 A nipple. 3 Loss, destruction. 4 Rest, remainder. 5 Loss of knowledge previously acquired. 6 Eternal happiness, final emancipation. 7 Heaven, paradise. 8 Sleep. 9 End, term. n. (-षं) 1 The embryo. 2 Patience, endurance. E. षो to destroy, &c., aff. क or ड and the consonant unchanged, &c.
39451: षग (ए) षगे r. 1st cl. (सगति) To cover: also written सग.
39452: षघ r. 5th cl. (सघ्नोति) To hurt or kill: also सघ.
39453: षच r. 1st cl. (सचते) 1 To wet, to moisten, to sprinkle. 2 To serve, to gratify by service. (सचति) 1 To be connected. 2 To understand thoroughly.
39455: षञ्ज r. 1st cl. (सजति) To embrace, to cling or adhere to, to be in contact or connexion with. With अव prefixed, to hand down from, to be suspended. With वि and आङ्, to struggle together. With आङ्, to be attached or devoted to. (उ) षञ्जु r. 1st cl. (सञ्जति-ते) To go.
39456: षट r. 1st cl. (सटति) To be a part or portion.
39457: षट्क mfn. (-ट्कः-ट्का-ट्कं) 1 Six. 2 Having six, six-fold, &c. E. षष् six, and कन् poss. aff.
39458: षट्कर्ण m. (-र्णः) A sort of lute. E. षष् six, and कर्ण an ear.
39459: षट्कर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 1 A Brahman. 2 An adept, (in the Tantras, &c.) n. (-र्म्म or pl. र्म्माणि) 1 The six acts proper for a Brahman, (collectively,) or teaching the Vedas, holy study, offering sacrifices, conducting them for others, giving, accepting gifts. 2 Six acts allowable to a Brahman for subsistence, or gleaning, accepting gifts, asking alms, agriculture, trade, and tending cattle, or according to some lending money at interest. 3 The six acts taught in the Tantras, or killing, infatuating, enthralling, expelling, exciting animosity, and the stopping or privation of any faculty. E. षष् six, कर्म्मन् act or duty.
39460: षट्कोण n. (-णं) 1 A hexagon, a six-angled figure. 2 The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. षष् six, कोण a corner.
39461: षट्चरण m. (-णः) A bee. E. षष् six, and चरण a foot.
39462: षट्ट r. 10th cl. (षट्टयति) 1 To injure, to hurt or kill. 2 To give. 3 To be strong. 4 To dwell.
39463: षट्त्रिंशत् f. (-शत्) 1 Thirty-six. 2 A work on law. E. षष् six, and त्रिंशत् thirty.
39464: षट्पद m. (-दः) A bee. mf. (-दः-दी) A louse. E. षष् six, and पद a foot.
39465: षट्पदप्रिय m. (-यः) The Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.) E. षट्पद a bee, and प्रिय beloved by; equally applicable therefore to the lotus, jasmine, &c.
39466: षट्पदातिथि m. (-थिः) 1 The mango tree. 2 The Champaka. E. षट्पद a bee, अतिथि a guest.
39467: षट्प्रज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A sage, one acquainted with the four objects of human existence, or virtue, wealth, desire, and final happiness, and with the nature of the world, and of divine truth. 2 A catamite. E. षष् six, and प्रज्ञ who knows.
39468: षडक्षीण m. (-णः) A fish. E. षष् six, and अक्षि the eye, ख aff.
39469: षडङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Having six limbs or members. 2 Having six parts, six ingredients, &c. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Six parts of the body collectively; as the two arms, two legs, and the head, and waist. 2 The six supplementary parts of the Vedas, or grammar, prosody, astronomy, pronunciation, the meaning of unusual terms, and the ritual of the Hindu religion. E. षष् six, and अङ्ग a limb or part.
39470: षडङ्गजित् m. (-जित्) VIṢṆU. E. षडङ्ग the six members, and जित् who subdues.
39471: षडङ्गपानीय n. (-यं) A infusion or decoction of six drugs. E. षडङ्ग, and पानीय drink.
39472: षडङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A bee. E. षष् six, and अङ्घ्रि a foot.
39473: षडभिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञ;) A Buddha or Bauddha deified sage. E. षष् six, (branches of learning or piety,) and अभिज्ञ understanding.
39474: षडानन m. (-नः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. षष् six, and आनन a face; having six faces, four directed to the four cardinal points, and two to the zenith and nadir, according to some accounts, though not generally so represented.
39475: षडूषण n. (-णं) Six spices collectively, or long-pepper, black-pepper, dried ginger, the root of long-pepper, the fruit of the plumbago, and of the Piper chavya. E. षष् six, and ऊषण a spice.
39476: षडृतु m. plur. (-तवः) The six seasons; also personified as divinities. E. षष्, and ऋतु a season.
39477: षङ्गव n. (-वं) A yoke of six oxen, or six oxen collectively. E. षष् six, and गो an ox, अच् added.
39478: षड्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Six-fold, six times. n. (-णं) An assemblage of six qualities or properties. mf. (-णः-णा) The six acts of a king, in his military character, or peace, war, marching, halting, sowing dissension, seeking protection. E. षष्, and गुण a time.
39479: षड्ग्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) A variety of the Cæsalpinia bonducella. f. (-न्था) Orris root, (Acorus calamus.) E. षष् six, ग्रन्थि a knot.
39480: षड्ग्रन्थिका f. (-का) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) E. षड्ग्रन्थ as above, and कन् added.
39481: षड्ज m. (-ड्जः) The fourth note of the Hindu gamut. E. षष् six, and ज born: supposed to require for its articulation the employment of the tongue, teeth, palate, nose, throat, and chest.
39482: षड्धा ind. In six ways. E. षष् six, and धाच् aff.
39483: षड्भाग m. (-गः) A sixth, a sixth part. E. षष्, and भाग share.
39484: षड्भागभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Entitled to a sixth. E. षड्भाग, and भाज् who shares.
39485: षड्भुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Six-armed, six-sided. m. (-जः) A hexagon. f. (-जा) The water-melon. E. षष् six, भुज an arm or branch, &c., aff. टाप्.
39486: षड्रेखा f. (-खा) A water-melon. E. षष् six, and रेखा a line.
39487: षड्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class or aggregate of six, as of six defects, desire, wrath, covetousness, bewilderment, pride, and envy. E. षष् six, and वर्ग a class.
39488: षड्वर्गवश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Subject to the six vices. E. षड्वर्ग, and वश्य to be subjected.
39489: षड्विध mfn. (-घः-घा-धं) In six ways, of six kinds. E. षष्, and विध kind.
39490: षड्विन्दु m. (-न्दुः) VIṢṆU. E. षष् six, and विन्दु a drop or spot.
39491: षण (उ) षणु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते) 1 To give. 2 To serve or honor; also written षन.
39492: षण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A bull at liberty. 2 A eunuch. 3 A multitude, a heap. mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A quantity of lotuses. E. षण to give, ड Uṇādi aff.; also शण्ड, षण्ढ, and शण्ड, &c.
39493: षण्डाली f. (-ली) 1 A measure of oil, the vessel holding a Chitank. 2 A wanton woman. 3 A pond, a pool. E. षण्ड a bull, a eunuch, &c., and अल to be able, affs. अच् and ङीप्.
39494: षण्ढ m. (-ण्ढः) A eunuch: see षण्ड.
39495: षण्मास m. (-सः) A half year, six months. E. षष्, and मास a month.
39496: षण्मास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Six months old, of six months standing, &c. E. षण्मास, and यत् aff.; also षाण्मास्य.
39497: षण्मुख m. (-खः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. षष् six, and मुख face.
39498: षत्वणत्व n. (-त्वं) The substitution of the letters ष or ण for स, and न in grammatical derivatives. E. ष and ण the letters, with the abstract affix attached to each respectively.
39499: षद (औ ॡ) औषदॢ r. 1st and 6th cls. (सीदति) 1 To wither, to wane, to perish gradually. 2 To be low-spirited, to despond, to be weary or distressed, to lack energy. 3 To break or destroy. 4 To go or move. With आङ् prefixed, औषदॢ r. 1st and 10th cls. (आसादति आसादयति) 1 To go. 2 To assail, to encounter. With अव prefixed, 1 To be exhausted or languid. 2 To finish. With आङ्, To obtain, to attain, to reach or arrive at. With उत्, 1 To ascend. 2 To destroy. With उप, To approach. With नि, 1 To sit in or on. 2 To stand. 3 To protect. With प्र, 1 To be propitious to, to favour or be pleased with. 2 To please or propitiate. 3 To purify. 4 To smile. With वि, To be languid or sorrowful. With सम्, 1 To attain. 2 To be in company or society with.
39500: षध r. 5th cl. (षध्नोति) To wish to hurt or kill.
39501: षन (उ) षनु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते) To give; also षण.
39502: षप r. 1st cl. (सपति) 1 To be connected. 2 To understand thoroughly.
39503: षम r. 1st cl. (समति) 1 To be unconfused. 2 To be confused. r. 10th cl. (समयति) To perplex or distress.
39504: षम्ब r. 1st cl. (सम्बति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (सम्बयति) To unite, to join, to collect or assemble together; also read सम्ब.
39505: षर्ज्ज r. 1st cl. (सर्ज्जति) To earn, to acquire.
39507: षर्व r. 1st cl. (सर्वति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To injure, to hurt.
39509: षल r. 1st cl. (सलति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To shake.
39510: षष् mfn. plu. only (षट् or षड्) Six.
39511: षष्टि f. (-ष्ठिः) Sixty. E. षष् six, डटि aff.
39512: षष्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bought with sixty. mf. (-कः-का) A kind of rice of quick growth. E. षष् six, (days,) ठन् aff. or षष्ठि sixty, and कन् added.
39513: षष्टिक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Fit for rice of quick growth, (a field, &c.) E. षष्टिक, and यन् aff.
39514: षष्टितम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Sixtieth. E. षष्टि sixty, and तमट् aff.
39515: षष्टिधा ind. In sixty ways. E. षष्टि sixty, and धा aff.
39516: षष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Sixth. f. (-ष्ठी) 1 DURGĀ. 2 The sixth day of the lunar fortnight. E. षष् six, डटि aff., and थुक् augment.
39517: षष्ठक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sixth. E. कन् added to the last.
39518: षष्ठान्न n. (-न्नं) A sixth meal, i. e. one in three days. E. षष्ठ, and अन्न food.
39519: षष्ठान्नकाल n. (-लं) The taking of food once in three days, as an act of penance. E. षष्ठान्न, and काल time; also with कन् added, षष्ठान्नकालकं.
39520: षष्ठान्नकालता f. (-ता) Eating once in three days, on the evening of the third day. E. षष्ठान्नकाल, and तल् aff.
39521: षष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Being or having the sixth (year, &c.) E. षष्ठ, and इनि poss. aff.
39522: षष्ठिमत्त m. (-त्तः) An elephant. E. षष्ठि sixth, (year,) and मत्त furious.
39523: षष्ठिहायन m. (-नः) 1 An elephant. 2 A kind of rice. E. षष्ठि sixth, हायन a year: then full grown.
39525: षस्ज r. 1st cl. (सज्जति) To move, to go.
39526: षस्ति r. 2nd cl. (सस्ति) To sleep, (this is not universally considered to be a root.)
39527: षह r. 1st cl. (सहते) r. 4th cl. (सह्यति) 1st and 10th cls. (सहति साहयति.) 1 To bear, to endure, to suffer or support, to forbear, to have patience. 2 To be content or satisfied. 3 To be able. With उत् prefixed, 1 To make effort or exertion, to persevere, to energize. 2 To be happy or delighted. With प्र, To be violent. With वि, To determine.
39528: षाट् ind. An interjection of calling.
39529: षाट्कौशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Enveloped in six sheathes. E. षट्, and कोश a sheath, ठक् aff.
39530: षाडव m. (-वः) 1 Sentiment, passion. 2 Singing, music.
39531: षाड्गुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 An aggregate of six properties or qualities. 2 The six acts of royal military policy. 3 Increase or multiplication, six-fold. E. षङ्गुण, and यञ् aff.
39532: षाण्मातुर m. (-रः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. षष् six, and मातृ a mother, अण् aff.; having been brought up by the six Kṛttikās.
39533: षाण्मासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to six months, half yearly, &c. E. षण्मास, and ठञ् aff.
39534: षात्वणत्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relative to the substitution of ष or ण for स and न, (as a rule, &c.) E. ठक् added to षत्वणत्व as above.
39535: षाध (उ) साधु r. 4th cl. (साध्यति) 1 To effect, to accomplish or complete. 2 To succeed; also साध.
39536: षान्त्व r. 10th cl. (सान्त्वयति) To console, to comfort; also सान्त्व.
39537: षाष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Sixth. E. षष्ठ the same, and अञ् aff.
39538: षि (ञ्) षिञ् r. 5th cl. (सिनोति सिनुते) r. 9th cl. (सिनातिसिनीते) To tie, to bind. With अधि and अव prefixed, To accomplish. With वि and अव, To transact as business. With वि, To be an object or purpose.
39539: षिच (औ) षिचा r. 6th cl. (सिञ्चति-ते) To sprinkle. With अभि prefixed, 1 To anoint, to initiate. 2 To sprinkle.
39540: षिट r. 1st cl. (सिटति) To disregard, to contemn, to despise, to treat with disrespect.
39541: षिड्ग m. (-ड्गः) 1 A catamite. 2 A libertine, a lecher. 3 A gallant. E. षिट to despise, Uṇādi aff. गन.
39542: षिध r. 1st cl. (सेधति) To go. (ऊ) षिधू r. 1st cl. (सेधति) 1 To command, to order. 2 To ordain, especially with respect to holy observances. 2 To do an auspicious act. or one indicating good fortune. (उ) षिध r. 4th cl. (सिध्यति) 1 To succeed, to effect fully or completely. 2 To complete a series of mystical observances by which supernatural powers are attained, to be an adept, to be initiated. 2 To be perfect, to be finished or accomplished. 4 To be right or correct. With नि or प्रति prefixed, (निषेधति प्रतिषेधति) To prevent, to prohibit. With प्र, To be celebrated or notorious.
39543: षिभ (उ) षिभु r. 1st cl. (सेभति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To speak. 3 To shine.
39544: षिम्भ (उ) षिम्भु r. 1st cl. (सिम्भति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To speak. 3 To shine.
39545: षिल r. 6th cl. (सिलति) To glean: more usually सिल.
39546: षिव (उ) षिवु r. 4th cl. (सीव्यति) 1 To sew, to stitch. 3 To sow, as seed.
39547: षु r. 2nd cl. (सौति) 1 To bear, to bring forth. 2 To possess power or supremacy. (ञ) षुञ् r. 5th cl. (सुनोति सुनुते) 1 To bathe, preparatory to a sacrifice. 2 To distil, to extract a spirit. 3 To churn, to stir or agitate. 4 To pain. With अभि, 1 To sprinkle. 2 To bathe. With प्र, To bear or bring forth.
39548: षुट्ट r. 10th cl. (सुट्टयति) 1 To disregard, to despise. 2 To be small or shallow.
39549: षुभ r. 1st cl. (सोभति) r. 6th cl. (सुभति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. 3 To hurt or kill.
39550: षुम्भ r. 1st and 6th cls. (सुम्भति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. 3 To be beautiful. 4 To hurt or kill.
39551: षुर r. 6th cl. (सुरति) 1 To possess supreme or superhuman power. 2 To shine.
39552: षुह r. 4th cl. (सुह्यति) 1 To bear, to endure. 2 To be content or satisfied. 3 To be able.
39553: षू (ङ) षूङ् r. 2nd cl. (सूते) r. 4th cl. (सूयते) 1 To bear a child, to bring forth. 2 To produce in general. r. 6th cl. (सुवति) To direct, to send, to throw or cast.
39554: षू f. (-षूः) Birth, delivery, child-bearing. E. षू to bring forth, aff. क्विप्, and the consonant unchanged.
39555: षूद r. 1st cl. (सूदते) r. 10th cl. (सूदयति) 1 To leak, to drop, to flow, to distil. 2 To deposit, to place. 3 To hurt, to wound, to kill or attempt to kill. 4 To promise. 5 (In the causal form,) To hallow, to make holy or pure.
39556: षूर (ई) षूरी r. 4th cl. (सूर्य्यते) 1 To be stopped or fixed. 2 To hurt or kill.
39557: षूर्क्ष r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्षति) 1 To respect, to regard, to treat with reverence or respect. 2 To disregard, to disrespect.
39558: षूर्क्ष्य r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्ष्यति) 1 To envy, to be impatient of another's rise. 2 To be intolerant or impatient of another's faults. 3 To disregard or contemn.
39559: षूष r. 1st cl. (सूषति) To bring forth, to bear; also सूष.
39560: षृभ (उ) षृभु r. 1st cl. (सर्भति) To hurt or kill.
39561: षृम्भ (उ) षृम्भु r. 1st cl. (सृम्भति) To hurt or kill.
39562: षेक (ऋ) षेकृ r. 1st cl. (सेकते) To go, to move; preferably सेक.
39563: षेल (ऌ) षेलृ r. 1st cl. (सेलति) To go, to move; also शेल, and सेल.
39564: षेव (ऋ) षेवृ r. 1st cl. (सेवति-ते) 1 To serve, to gratify by service. 2 To rely or depend on. 3 To worship. 4 To follow, to practise, to be addicted to.
39565: षै r. 1st cl. (सायति) To waste, to wane or decline.
39566: षो r. 4th cl. (स्यति) 1 To destroy, to put an end to. 2 To be destroyed, to perish.
39567: षोडत् m. (-डन्) A young ox, or one with six teeth. E. षष् six, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
39568: षोडश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Sixteenth. E. शोडशन् sixteen, डट् aff.
39569: षोडशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sixteen, (collectively.) E. शोडश, and कन् added.
39570: षोडशन् mfn. plu. only. (-श) Sixteen. E. षष् six, and दशन् ten.
39571: षोडशर्त्तुनिशा f. (-शा) Any one of sixteen nights from the commencement of menstruation. E. शोडश, and ऋतु menses, निशा night.
39572: षोडशांश m. (-शः) A sixteenth. E. शोडश, and अंश part.
39573: षोडशांशु m. (-शुः) The planet VENUS. E. शोडश sixteen, and अंशु a ray.
39574: षोडशाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A crab. E. षोडश sixteen, and अङ्घ्रि a foot.
39575: षोडशार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet VENUS. E. षोडश sixteen, and अर्च्चिस् a ray.
39576: षोडषावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch shell. E. षोडश sixteen, and आवर्त्त a twist or spire.
39577: षोडा ind. In six ways. E. षष six, उ substituted for the final, धा aff., and ध changed to ड.
39578: ष्टक r. 1st cl. (स्तकति) To resist or oppose.
39579: ष्टग (ए) ष्टगे r. 1st cl. (स्तगति) To cover.
39581: ष्टभ (इ) ष्टभि r. 1st cl. (स्तम्भते) 1 To stop or hinder, to oppose, to impede, to resist or prevent. 2 To be stupid or dull, to be inanimate or insensible. 3 To be fixed as a post. 4 To be astounded or stupefied. 5 To be paralysed.
39582: ष्टम r. 1st. cl. (स्तमति) 1 To be confused. 2 To be clear or unconfused. r. 10th cl. (स्तमयति) To confuse or annoy.
39583: ष्टिघ r. 5th cl. (स्तिघ्नुते) To assail, to assault, to attack.
39584: ष्टिप (ऋ) ष्टिपृ r. 1st cl. (स्तेपते) 1 To ooze, to drop, to distil. 2 To sprinkle.
39585: ष्टिम r. 4th cl. (स्तिम्यति) To be wet or moist, to reek, to steam.
39586: ष्टीम r. 4th cl. (स्तीम्यति) To be wet or moist, to reek, to steam.
39587: ष्टु (ञ) ष्टुञ् r. 2nd cl. (स्तौति or स्तुते स्तवीति or स्तवीते) 1 To praise, to eulogise. 2 To hymn, to worship with praises.
39588: ष्टुच r. 1st cl. (स्तोचते) To be clear, to be bright, to be pellucid.
39589: ष्टुप r. 10th cl. (स्तोपयति) To heap up.
39590: ष्टुभ (उ) ष्टुभु r. 1st cl. (स्तोभति) 1 To stop, to hinder. 2 To be stupid or dull.
39591: ष्टूप r. 10th cl. (स्तूपयति) To heap together, to pile up, to collect into a heap; also स्तूप.
39592: ष्टृक्ष r. 1st cl. (स्तृक्षति) To go, to move.
39593: ष्टृह (उ) ष्टृहु r. 6th cl. (ष्टृहति) To hurt or kill; also स्तृह, and ष्टृह.
39594: ष्टॄह (ऊ) ष्टॄहू r. 6th cl. (स्तृहति) To hurt or kill.
39595: ष्टेप (ऋ) ष्टेपृ r. 1st cl. (स्तेपते) 1 To leak, to flow, to distil or drop. 2 To sprinkle.
39596: ष्टै r. 1st cl. (स्तायति) To surround, to encompass.
39598: ष्ट्यै r. 1st cl. (स्त्यायति) 1 To sound. 2 To crowd or swarm. 3 To envelope.
39599: ष्ठग (ए) ष्ठगे r. 1st cl. (स्थगति) To cover.
39600: ष्ठल r. 1st cl. (स्थलति) 1 To stand. 2 To be firm.
39601: ष्ठस (उ) ष्ठसु r. 4th cl. (स्थस्यति) To dwell in, to inhabit.
39602: ष्ठा r. 1st cl. (तिष्ठति) 1 To stand, to stop, to be still, to refrain from moving. 2 To abide, to stay, to be. (तिष्ठते) 1 To apply or refer to, as an umpire or judge. 2 To indicate or reveal one's thoughts to another. With अधि prefixed, (अधितिष्ठति) 1 To excel, to surpass, to overcome. 2 To sit or stand upon or over. 3 To be placed or preside over. With अनु (अनुतिष्ठति) 1 To practise as a duty, to obey or follow as a law. 2 To apply or adhere to. With अव (अवतिष्ठति-ते) 1 To stay or stand. 2 To attend upon. With आङ् (आतिष्ठते) 1 To affirm or assert. 2 To apply; (आतिष्ठति) 1 To ascend, to mount. 2 To promise or engage. With उत् (उत्तिष्ठते) 1 To seek for, to endeavour to obtain; (उत्तिष्ठति) To get up, to rise as from a seat, &c. With उप (उपतिष्ठति-ते) 1 To propitiate (as a deity.) 2 To praise or hymn, to worship, to adore. 3 To embrace. 4 To treat in a friendly manner, to form a friendship or connexion with. 5 To pass or lie along or near to, that is, as a path or road. 6 To arrive at or near; (उपतिष्ठते) To hope to gain or acquire. With नि (नितिष्ठते) To be established. With परि and अव (पर्य्यवतिष्ठते) To be stationary or immovable. With प्र (प्रतिष्ठते) 1 To set off, to go forth, to depart. 2 To go to. With प्र and उत् (प्रोत्तिष्ठति) To get up, to rise. With प्रति, (प्रतितिष्ठति) To be erected for holy purposes, to be sacred or consecrated. With वि (वितिष्ठते) 1 To stand apart, to be separated. 2 To stay or be. With वि and अव (व्यवतिष्ठते) To decree, to pronounce. With सम् (सन्तिष्ठते) 1 To be well. 2 To be close to or together. 3 To be of the same inclinations or opinions, to conform, to agree. 4 To be completed or finished. With सम and आङ् (समातिष्ठते) To perform, to be engaged in. With सम and उत् (समुत्तिष्ठति) To rise or get up. With सम and प्र, To go forth or on a journey. With प्र in the causal (प्रस्थापयति) To send.
39603: ष्ठिव (उ) ष्ठिवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति) r. 4th cl. (ष्ठीव्यति) To eject from the mouth, to spit, to sputter, (the radical sibilant is unchanged in this root;) also ष्ठीव.
39604: ष्ठीव (उ) ष्ठीवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति) To spit or eject from the mouth.
39605: ष्ठीवन n. (-नं) 1 Spitting, ejecting saliva. 2 Saliva, spittle. E. ष्ठीव, and ल्युट् aff.
39606: ष्ठीवित्वा ind. Having spitten. E. ष्ठीव to spit, क्त्वा aff.
39607: ष्ठ्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ejected as saliva, spit. E. ष्ठीव to spit, क्त aff.
39608: ष्णस (उ) ष्णसु r. 4th cl. (स्नस्यति) To eject from the mouth, to spit.
39609: ष्णा r. 2nd cl. (स्नाति) To bathe, to purify by ablution.
39610: ष्णिह (ऌ ऊ) r. 4th cl. (स्निह्यति) To bear affection to, love, to regard, to be kind to or pleased with. r. 10th. cl. (स्नेहयति) To be unctuous, to be bland or greasy.
39611: ष्णु r. 2nd cl. (ष्णौति) To distil, to drop, to ooze or leak.
39612: ष्णुच r. 1st cl. (स्नोचते) To be clear or pellucid.
39613: ष्णुस (उ) ष्णुसु r. 4th cl. (स्नुस्यति) 1 To eat. 2 To take. 3 To disappear. 4 To eject from the mouth.
39614: ष्णुह (ऌ ऊ) r. 4th cl. (स्नुह्यति) To be sick, to retch, to throw up, to vomit.
39615: ष्णै r. 1st cl. (स्नायति) To surround, to encompass.
39616: ष्मि r. 1st cl. (स्मयते) To smile. r. 10th cl. (स्नाययते) To disrespect: with वि prefixed, to surprise or astonish.
39617: ष्वक्क r. 1st cl. (ष्वक्कते) To go, to move.
39619: ष्वद r. 1st cl. (स्वदते) r. 10th cl. (स्वादयति) 1 To taste. 2 To be pleasing. 3 To cover; also स्वाद.
39620: ष्वप (ञि औ) ञिष्वपौ r. 2nd cl. (स्वपिति) To sleep.
39621: ष्वर्त्त r. 10th cl. (ष्वर्त्तयति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To be wretched or distressed.
39622: ष्वष्क r. 1st cl. (ष्वष्कते) To go, to move: the radical sibilant is unchanged.
39623: ष्विद (ञि आ) ञिष्विदा r. 1st cl. (स्वेदते) r. 4th cl. (स्विद्यति) 1 To perspire, to sweat. 2 To be greasy or unctuous. 3 To be fascinated, to be tempted or deluded. 4 To quit, to yield. स
39624: स The thirty-second consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding to S.
39625: स m. (सः) 1 A snake. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 Air, wind. 5 The abbreviated name of the musical note ष ज्. 6 He, the nominative case masc. of तद the third personal pronoun: before many letters the Visarga is rejected. f. (सा) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 2 She, the nominative case fem. of तट्. n. (सं) 1 Knowledge. 2 Meditation. 3 A carriage road. 4 A fence. Ind. (In composition,) With, together with; being substituted for सम् or सह; combined with nouns it forms adjectives and adverbs; as सकोपः angry, सकोपम् angrily; सगर्ब्बः proud, सगर्व्वम् haughtily; सविनयः modest, well behaved, सविनयम् respectfully; ससम्भ्रमः flurried, ससम्भ्रमम् flurriedly, &c. सानन्दः joyful, सानन्दं joyfully. E. षो to go, &c., aff. ड.
39626: सं ind. (In composition,) With, together with, &c.; being the optional form of writing सम् before a consonant: before consonants of the first five classes, the Anusvāra may be again changed to the nasal of the class to which the letter it precedes belongs, as सं for सम्, and कल्प make सङ्कल्प, &c.: before the semivowels, the sibilants, and ह, it preferably remains unaltered; practice however is very arbitrary in this respect, and the change is expressed or not, in all manuscripts according to the pleasure of the writer.
39627: संय m. (-यः) The skeleton. E. सम् together, यस to restrain, aff. ड.
39628: संयत् mf. (-यत्) War, battle. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.
39629: संयत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Checked, restrained, controuled, suppressed. 2 Bound, confined, fettered, imprisoned. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. क्त.
39630: संयतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued, of well regulated spirit. E. संयत, and आत्मन् self.
39631: संयतेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of subdued or controuled passions and desires. E. संयत, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
39632: संयद्वर m. (-रः) A king, a prince. E. सम् before यम to restrain, ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.; or संयत् war, वर chief.
39633: संयन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Constraining, a constrainer. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. तृच्.
39634: संयम m. (-मः) 1 Restraint, forbearance. 2 Humanity, avoiding the infliction of pain on others. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. अप्.
39635: संयमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Curbing, restraining, subduing, who or what does so. E. सम् before यम to restrain, शतृ aff.
39636: संयमन n. (-नं) 1 Restraining, checking. 2 Forbearance, self-denial or controul. 3 Binding, confinement. 4 Holding, detaining. 5 A religious vow or obligation. 6 A cluster of four houses. f. (-नी) The capital of YAMA. E. सम् implying completeness, or entirely, and यम to restrain, aff. ल्युट्.
39637: संयमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Checked, controuled, restrained. 2 Bound, confined, held, detained. E. सम् before यम to check, aff. क्त.
39638: संयमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what checks, restrains, curbs, &c. m. (-मी) A saint, a sage, one who subdues or controuls his passions. E. संयम restraint, इनि aff.
39639: संयात्रा f. (-त्रा) Travelling into another island or continent, voyaging, travelling by water. E. सम् before या to go, त्रन् aff.
39640: संयान m. (-नः) A mould. n. (-नं) Accompanying, going together. E. सम् together, या to go or get, aff. ल्युट्.
39641: संयाम m. (-मः) 1 Forbearance, check, controul, restraint. 2 Humanity, abstaining from giving pain to others. E. सम् before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
39642: संयामवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Forbearing. E. संयाम, and मतुप् aff.
39643: संयाव m. (-वः) A sort of roll, or a thin cake of unleavened bread, fried with Ghee, pounded and again made up into an oblong form with fresh bread, sugar, and spices, and again fried with Ghee. E. सम् together, यु to mix, and घञ् aff.
39644: संयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Joined with, connected, attached. 2 Mixed, blended. 3 Endowed with, possessed of. 4 Accompanied or attended by. E. सम् together, युज to join, aff. क्त.
39645: संयुग m. (-गः) 1 War, battle. 2 Union, mixture. E. सम् before युज to join, क aff.
39646: संयुज् mfn. (-युक्) 1 Possessed of or endowed with good qualities. 2 Connected or associated with. 3 Joined, united. E. सम् before युज to join, aff. क्विप्, and the consonant unchanged.
39647: संयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Connected, joined, mixed, blended, attached to. E. सम् together, यु to join, aff. क्त.
39648: संयुयूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to mix, join, unite, to bring together in any way. E. सम् before यु to join, desid. v., उ aff.
39649: संयोग m. (-गः) 1 Intimate union or association. 2 Living with, being in company with. 3 Adherence, junction. 4 (In grammar,) A conjunct consonant. E. सम् before युज to join, घञ् aff.
39650: संयोगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joined, annexed, connected. E. संयोग union, इतच् aff.
39651: संयोजन n. (-नं) 1 Copulation, coition. 2 Joining, uniting. E. सम् with, युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.
39652: संयोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joined, attached, annexed. E. सम् together, युज to join, aff. क्त.
39653: संरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Inflamed, angry. 2 Empassioned. E. सम् before रञ्ज to be affected, क्त aff.
39654: संरक्ष m. (-क्षः) Care, preservation, protection. E. सम्, and रक्ष preserving.
39655: संरक्षण n. (-णं) Taking care of, protecting, preserving. E. मम् before रक्ष to preserve, ल्युट् aff.
39656: संरक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken care of, preserved, protected. E. सम् before रक्ष to preserve, क्त aff.
39657: संरक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) Fit, proper, or necessary to be taken care of, guarded, preserved, &c. E. सम् before रक्ष to preserve, यत् aff.; also संरक्षणीय and संरक्षितव्य.
39658: संरब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Incensed, angry. 2 Agitated. E. सम् before रभि to sound, क्त aff.
39659: संरम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Wrath, rage. 2 Pride, arrogance. 3 Flurry, agitation. 4 Swelling with heat and redness. E. सम् before रभि to sound, and घञ् aff.
39660: संरम्भपरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Exceedingly harsh, rough, or scurrilous. E. संरम्भ, and परुष harsh.
39661: संरम्भरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Angry, resentful. E. संरम्भ, and रस taste.
39662: संरम्भित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Wrath. 2 Pride. 3 Agitation. E. संरम्भिन्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, संरम्भिता.
39663: संरम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Proud. 2 Angry. 3 Flurried. E. संरम्भ, and इनि aff.
39664: संराग m. (-गः) 1 Anger. 2 Affection. E. सम्, रञ्ज to be affected, घञ् aff.
39665: संराधन n. (-नं) Propitiating, pleasing by worship. E. सम् before राध to accomplish, ल्युट् aff.
39666: संराधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Propitiated, pleased. E. सम् before राध to accomplish, क्त aff.
39667: संराव m. (-वः) Sound, noise. E. सम् before रु to sound, aff. घञ्.
39668: संराविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Roaring, shouting, making a noise or uproar. E. सम् before रु to sound, घिनुण् aff.
39669: संरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Checked, stopped, impeded, curbed, opposed. E. सम् before रुध to obstruct, क्त aff.
39670: संरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Confident, audacious, presuming. 2 Budded, blossomed. E. सम् before रुह to grow, aff. क्त.
39671: संरोध m. (-धः) 1 Hindering, stopping, opposing, preventing. 2 Impediment, obstruction. 3 Bond, fetter. 4 Curb, check. 5 Throwing, sending. E. सम् before रुध to obstruct, aff. घञ्.
39672: संलक्षण n. (-णं) Distinguishing, characterising. E. सं before लक्ष to mark, ल्युट् aff.
39673: संलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Marked, distinguished. E. सम् before लक्ष to mark, क्त aff.
39674: संलक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) To be marked with or by. E. सम् before लक्ष to mark, यत् aff.
39675: संलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Joined, united, adherent. E. सम्, and लग्न attached to.
39676: संलज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ashamed. E. सम् before लस्ज to be ashamed, शानच् aff.
39677: संलय m. (-यः) Sleep, sleepiness. E. सं before ली to join, and अच् aff.
39678: संलाप m. (-पः) 1 Conversation, discourse. 2 In the drama, high discourse, dialogue of profound or occult meaning. E. सम् with, together with, and लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
39679: संलापक n. (-कं) A species of minor drama, a controversial drama. E. संलाप, कन् added.
39680: संलापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Discoursing, conversing. E. संलाप, and इतच् aff.
39681: संलापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Discoursing, who or what discourses. E. संलाप, and इनि aff.
39682: संवंहयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Increasing. E. सम्, वहि to grow, causal v., शतृ aff.
39683: संवत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. सम् with, completely, and वत्सर a year; or सम् with वस to abide, सर Uṇādi aff., and त substituted for the final.
39684: संवद् ind. 1 A year. 2 A year of VIKRAMĀDITYA'S era. E. सम् before वद to speak, aff. विच्, or सम् before वय to go, क्विप् aff., य rejected, and तुक् final augment.
39685: संवदन n. (-नं) 1 Communication of tidings or intelligence. 2 Sight, seeing. nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Subduing by charms, overpowering any thing or person by magical compounds, or drugs, or mystical gems, &c. 2 A charm, an amulet, the article by which the above is effected. E. सम् with वद to speak, युच् aff.
39686: संवनन n. (-नं-ना) Subduing by magical drugs or charms: see the last. E. सम् before वन to ask, aff. ल्युट्.
39687: संवर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Self-control. 3 Covering, concealing. m. (-रः) 1 The name of a demon. 2 Collection, comprehension. 3 Contraction, compression. 4 A mound, a bridge, &c. E. सम् before वृ to choose, aff. अप्, more usually derived from शम्ब or षम्ब to collect, and then written शम्बर or सम्बर q. v.
39688: संवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Destruction of the universe. 2 Beleric myrobalan. 3 The name of a Muni. 4 A cloud. 5 Being, becoming. E. सम् before वृत to be, aff. घञ्.
39689: संवर्त्तक m. (-कः) 1 BALADEVA. 2 The plough of BALADEVA. 3 Submarine fire. E. सम् before वृत to be or abide, aff. वुन्.
39690: संवर्त्तकिन् m. (-की) BALADEVA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA. E. संवर्त्तक his plough, and इनि aff.
39691: संवर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) The new leaf of a water-lily. E. सम् before वृत to be, aff. इनि.
39692: संवर्त्तिका f. (-का) The new leaf of a water-lily. E. सम् near, (the stalk,) वृत to be, aff. वुन्.
39693: संवर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Augmenting, augmentative, prospering, an augmentor, &c. E. सम् before वृद्ध to increase, aff. वुन्.
39694: संवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Augmenting, increasing. 2 Prospering, thriving. 3 Bringing up, cherishing. E. सम् before वृद्ध to increase or prosper, aff. ल्युट्.
39695: संवर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cherished, protected, brought up, patronised, &c. E. सम् before वृद्ध to increase, क्त aff.
39696: संवर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fully armed. E. सम्, and वर्म्म armour, इतच् aff.
39697: संवलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, mingled. 2 Encompassed, surrounded. 3 Having, possessed of. 4 United. E. सम् together, वल to surround, aff. क्त.
39698: संवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. सम् before वस to abide, अथ Uṇādi aff.
39699: संवाटिका f. (-का) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
39700: संवात् mfn. (-वान्-वाती-वान्ती-वात्) Blowing, breathing, (as wind.) E. सम् before वा to blow, शतृ aff.
39701: संवाद m. (-दः) 1 Communication of intelligence, information, news. 2 Assent, concurrence. 3 Conformity, correspondence, sameness. E. सम् with, वद to speak, aff. घञ्.
39702: संवार m. (-रः) 1 Contraction, diminution. 2 Compression of the lips, &c. in pronunciation. E. सम् before वृ to choose, aff. घञ्.
39703: संवास m. (-सः) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 An open space, either within or without a town, for the meeting and diversion of the townsmen. 3 Company, society. E. सम् with, वास an abode.
39704: संवाह m. (-हः) 1 An attendant employed to rub and knead the body. 2 Rubbing the body. E. सम् before वाह to exert one's self, and अच् aff.; or when the action is implied, वह to obtain or bear, aff. घञ्.
39705: संवाहक m. (-कः) An attendant rubbing and kneading the limbs. E. सम् before वह to obtain, (pleasure or ease,) causal form, aff. ण्वुल्.
39706: संवाहन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing the person, kneading the limbs. 2 Bearing, carrying. E. सम् before वह to obtain or bear, (causal form,) aff. ल्युट्
39707: संवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rubbed, kneaded, (as the limbs.) E. सम् before वह to bear, causal v., क्त aff.
39708: संवाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be rubbed or kneaded. 2 To be borne. E. सम् before वह to bear, ण्यत् aff.
