40271: सन्तापित mfn. (-तः-तां-तं) 1 Pained, distressed, afflicted. 2 Suffering from heat. 3 Inflamed with passion. E. सम् before तप to burn, causal. v., aff. क्त, and इट् augment.
40272: सन्ताप्य ind. Having caused to be heated. E. सम्, तप to be hot, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
40273: सन्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 End, destruction. 2 Gift, giving. E. षण to give, क्तिच् aff.; also सति and साति.
40274: सन्तुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Delighted, pleased. E. सम् intensitive prefix, तुष्ट pleased.
40275: सन्तोष m. (-षः) 1 Joy, pleasure, delight, satisfaction, happiness. 2 Thumb and forefinger. E. सम् intensitive prefix, तुष to be pleased, aff. घञ्.
40276: सन्तोषण n. (-नं) 1 Pleasing, propitiating. 2 Comforting. E. सम् before तुष to be pleased, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
40277: सन्तोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Consoled, comforted. 2 Gratified. E. सम् before तुष to be pleased, causal, v., क्त aff.
40278: सन्तोष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be pleased, comforted, gratified, &c. सम्, तुष to be pleased, causal v., तव्य aff.
40279: सन्तोष्य ind. Having pleased or gratified. E. सम् before तुष to be pleased, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
40280: सन्त्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Left, abandoned. E. सम्, and त्यज to leave, क्त aff.
40281: सन्त्यजन n. (-नं) Leaving, abandoning. E. सम्, त्यज to leave, ल्युट aff.
40282: सन्त्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Frightened, alarmed. E. सम् before त्रस to fear, क्त aff.
40283: सन्त्रास m. (-सः) Fear, alarm. E. सम् before त्रस to fear, घञ् aff.
40284: सन्दंश m. (-शः) A pair of tongs or nippers. E. सम with, दंश biting.
40285: सन्दंशक n. (-कं) A pair of tongs. f. (-का) 1 A pair of nippers, or small shears or tongs. 2 A vice. E. सम् before दंश to bite or nip, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form.
40286: सन्दधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Having, possessing. 2 Being at peace with, making peace. 3 Fixing or placing in or on. E. सम् before धा to have, शानच् aff.
40287: सन्दर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 Weaving garlands, collecting flowers into a wreath or chaplet, &c. 2 Stringing, collecting, arranging. E. सम् with, together, दृभि to collect, aff. अच्.
40288: सन्दर्शन n. (-नं) 1 Looking, seeing. 2 Shewing. 3 Appearance. E. सम् completely, दर्शन seeing, or सम् before दृश to see, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
40289: सन्दर्शयत् mfn. (-न्य-यन्ती-यत्) Shewing, pointing out. E. सम् before दृश to see, causal v., शतृ aff.
40290: सन्दर्शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shewn, pointed out. E. सम् before दृश to see, causal v., क्त aff.
40291: सन्दान n. (-नं) A rope, a cord, (for tying cattle especially.) m. (-नः) The elephant's temples, or part whence the ichorous fluid issues when the animal is in must. E. सम् before दो to cut, aff. ल्युट्; or सम् with, दान the temporal juice.
40292: सन्दानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied. E. सन्दान a rope, इतच् aff.
40293: सन्दानिनी f. (-नी) A cow-house. E. सन्दान a rope for tying cattle, इनि and ङीप् affs.
40294: सन्दामितक n. (-कं) A poem of three stanzas.
40295: सन्दाव m. (-वः) Flight, retreat. E. सम् before दु to go, aff. घञ्.
40296: सन्दिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Doubted, questioned, doubtful. 2 Entertaining doubt, uncertain. E. सम् before दिह to augment, aff. क्त.
40297: सन्दिग्धमति m. (-तिः) A sceptic, one who is uncertain or doubtful of the results of religious observances, &c. E. सन्दिग्ध doubted, doubting, and मति mind.
40298: सन्दिग्धनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Confident in a doubtful matter. E. सन्दिग्ध, and निश्त्रय certainty.
40299: सन्दिग्धलेख्य n. (-ख्यं) A writing or document of doubtful meaning or authority. E. सन्दिग्ध, and, लेख्य a writing.
40300: सन्दिग्धार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 A disputed debt, either in its amount or existence. 2 Doubtful interpretation or meaning. E. सन्दिग्ध doubted, अर्थ property or meaning.
40301: सन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, tied. E. सम् before दो to cut, aff. क्त.
40302: सन्दिदर्शयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to shew. E. सम् before दृश to see, causal v., desid. v., उ aff.
40303: सन्दिशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती-शत्) Informing, telling. E. सम् before दिश to shew, शतृ aff.
40304: सन्दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Told, communicated, related as news or information. 2 Promised, agreed, engaged. n. (-ष्टं) News, tidings, information. E. सम् with, दिश to shew, aff. क्त.
40305: सन्दिष्टार्थ m. (-र्थः) A herald, a pursuivant, a royal messenger who communicated oral instructions or orders. E. सन्दिष्ट communicated, अर्थ meaning.
40306: सन्दिहान mfn. (-नः-ना-न) Dubious, uncertain. E. सम् before दिह to collect, aff. शानच्.
40307: सन्दिह्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Doubtful, uncertain, obscure. E. सम् before दिह to collect, pass. v., शानच् aff.
40308: सन्दी f. (-न्दी) A small bed or couch. E. सम् before दो to cut, aff. ड, and ङीष् fem. aff.
40310: सन्दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Seen, beheld. 2 Foreseen, anticipated. E. सम दृश, to see, क्त aff.
40311: सन्दृश्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being seen or looked at. 2 Being foreseen. E. सम् before दृश to see, pass. v., शानच् aff.
40312: सन्देश m. (-शः) News, tidings, information. E. सम् together, दिश to shew, aff. घञ्.
40313: सन्देशवाच् mf. (-वाक्) Communication of intelligence. E. सन्देश news, and वाच् speech.
40314: सन्देशहर m. (-रः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador. E. सन्देश tidings, and हर who takes.
40315: सन्देशहारक m. (-कः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador. E. सन्देश news, and हारक who conveys.
40316: सन्देह m. (-हः) Doubt, uncertainty. E. सम् before दिह to collect, aff. घञ्.
40317: सन्दोह m. (-हः) Assemblage, multitude. E. सम् together, दुह to fill, aff. घञ्.
40318: सन्द्राव m. (-वः) Flight, retreat. E. सम् with, द्रु to go, to run, aff. घञ्.
40319: सन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) 1 Possessing as an integrant part, intimately blended with. 2 Holding, possessing, having placed in or on. 3 Joined, united. f. (-न्धा) 1 Promise, assent, agreement. 2 State, condition, the steady continuance in any state, steadiness, fixation. 3 Intimate union or association, identification. 4 Twilight. E. सम् together, धा to have or hold, aff. क, or अङ् and टाप् fem. aff.
40320: सन्धातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be united or allied with, to be reconciled, to be connected, &c. E. सम् before धा to have, तव्य aff.
40321: सन्धान n. (-नं) 1 Holding together, uniting, joining. 2 Tying, binding. 3 Peace, alliance. 4 Association, company. 5 Supporting, reception, receiving, sustaining. 6 Mixing, joining, intimate union or combination. 7 A relish, something eaten to excite thirst. 8 Sour rice-gruel. 9 Pickles, &c. acid preparation of the Bel and other fruits. 10 Spirituous liquor. 11 Contracting the skin, &c. by astringent applications. nf. (-नं-नी) Distillation, distilling, the manufacture of spirituous liquors. f. (-नी) A braziery, a foundery, a place where the base metals are stored or wrought. E. सम् together, घा to hold, aff. ल्युट्.
40322: सन्धानकरण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Who or what heals, re-unites, allies, connecting, re-uniting, &c. n. (-णं) 1 Uniting, combining. 2 Healing. 3 Allying, making peace. E. सन्धान, and करण making, the act or instrument.
40323: सन्धानकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Uniting, connecting, healing, &c. E. सन्धान, and कर्त्तृ what makes.
40324: सन्धानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bound, tied. 2 Strung together. E. सन्धान holding together, aff. इतच्.
40325: सन्धानिनी f. (-नी) A cow-house. E. सन्धान a binding, इनि and ङीष् aff.
40326: सन्धारण n. (-णं) Holding, observing, practising. E. सम् before धृ to hold, and ल्युट् aff.
40327: सन्धार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be observed or followed. E. सम् before धृ to hold, ण्यत् aff.
40328: सन्धि m. (-न्धिः) 1 Union, junction, connexion, combination. 2 Peace, making peace, pacification. 3 A hole, a chasm. 4 A hole made in a wall or underneath it to enter a building for hostile or felonious purposes, a breach, a mine, &c. 5 Breaking, dividing. 6 The vulva. 7 A division of a drama, apparently applicable to each subject represented or sentiment excited, as considered severally and detached from the rest, though contributing to the connexion of the whole; contrast of incident, change of situation, transition of passion or emotion, &c. 8 An interval, a pause or rest. 9 A joint, an articulation of the body. 10 The union of letters, either at the end and beginning of different words, or in the middle of compound terms, to avoid dissonance or hiatus. 11 A period at the expiration of each Yuga or age, or one-sixth of its duration, intervening before the commencement of the next; a Sandhi, also, of the same length as the Satya Yug, occurs at the end of each Manvantara, and each Kalpa. 12 (Inmensuration,) The connecting link of a perpendicular. E. सम् together, घा to have or hold, aff. कि of either the act, condition or instrument; whence the word becomes applicable to a chasm, &c. as to an interval, which whilst it divides, also connects, two parts or places.
40329: सन्धिका f. (-का) Distillation. E. सम् together, घा to have, aff. क, and कन् added, fem. form.
40330: सन्धिचौर m. (-रः) A house-breaker. E. सन्धि a breach, and चौर a thief.
40331: सन्धिजीवक m. (-कः) One who seeks for wealth by dishonest means, especially as a go-between. E. सन्धि union, (of others,) and जीवक who lives by.
40332: सन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tied, bound, strung, fastened together. 2 Allied, united, reconciled. 3 Pickled. (-तं) Pickles and preparations of various fruits. E. सन्धा union, and इतच् aff.
40333: सन्धित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to be at peace or in alliance with. E. सम् before धा to have, desid. v., उ aff.
40334: सन्धिनी f. (-नी). 1 A cow with calf, or one which has taken the bull. 2 One who is milked unseasonably. E. सन्धा joining, इनि aff.
40336: सन्धिबन्धन n. (-नं) A tendon, a nerve, a ligament. E. सन्धि a joint, and बन्धन binding.
40337: सन्धिरन्ध्रका f. (-का) A hole or breach in a wall. E. सन्धि a breach, रन्ध्र a hole, कन् added, fem. form.
40338: सन्धिला f. (-ला). 1 A river. 2 Spirituous liquor. 3 A hole in a wall, a breach. 4 A chasm, a pit, a mine. E. सन्धि a hole, &c. लच् aff.
40339: सन्धिविग्रहाधिकार m. (-रः) War ministry, charge of peace and war. E. सन्धि, विग्रह war, अधिकार office.
40340: सन्धिविग्रहाधिकारिन् m. (-री) Chief political minister. E. इनि added to the last.
40341: सन्धिविचक्षण m. (-णः) An able negociator. E. सन्धि, and विचक्षण skilled; also similar compounds, as सन्धिकुशल, &c.
40342: सन्धिविद् m. (-वित्) A negociator, a minister. E. सन्धि, and विद् who knows.
40343: सन्धिवेला f. (-ला) A particular period, and one which connects the part of the day or fortnight, as morning, noon, and evening, new moon, the first or thirteenth day of the fortnight, and full moon. E. सन्धि union, and वेला time.
40344: सन्धिहारक m. (-कः) A house-breaker. E. सन्धि a breach, and हारक who carries away.
40345: सन्धुक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, inflamed, kindled. E. सम् before घुक्ष to kindle, क्त aff.
40346: सन्धेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be joined, united, &c. 2 To be reconciled or at peace with. 3 To be allied, connected, &c., what or who may or ought to be allied, &c. E. सम् before धा to have यत् aff.
40347: सन्ध्या f. (-न्ध्या) 1 Twilight, either morning or evening. 2 The period that elapses between the expiration of one Yuga or age, and the commencement of another. 3 A period of time, forenoon, afternoon, or mid-day. 4 Religious abstraction, meditation, repetition of Mantras, sipping water, &c. to be performed by the three first classes of Hindus, at particular and stated periods in the course of every day, especially at sunrise, sunset, and also, though less essentially, at noon. 5 Reflexion. 6 Promise, assent. 7 Boundary, limit. 8 Joining, union. 9 A flower; according to some the tuberose, to others, the jasmine. 10 Twilight, personified as the daughter of BRAHMĀ, and wife of ŚIVA. 11 The name of a river. E. सन्धि a joint, (of the day,) and यत् aff.
40348: सन्ध्यांश m. (-शः) 1 Twilight. 2 The period at the end of each Yuga. E. सन्ध्या as above, and अंश portion.
40349: सन्ध्यांशु m. (-शुः) Twilight. E. सन्ध्या, and अंशु a ray.
40350: सन्ध्याकाल n. (-लं) 1 Twilight. 2 The intervals of a Yuga. E. सन्ध्या, and काल time.
40351: सन्ध्याचल m. (-लः) The name of a mountain. E. सन्ध्या twilight, and अचल a mountain.
40352: सन्ध्यात्रय n. (-यं) The three periods of the day. E. सन्ध्या, and त्रय triad.
40353: सन्ध्यानाटिन् m. (-टी) ŚIVA. E. सन्ध्या evening twilight, and नाटिन् who dances.
40354: सन्ध्याबल m. (-लः) An imp, a Rākṣasa, a goblin. E. सन्ध्या evening, and बल strength.
40355: सन्ध्याबलि m. (-लिः) Any image of NANDĪ, the bull of ŚIVA, either of clay, wood, or stone, placed in a temple of the deity. E. सन्ध्या evening, (when ŚIVA is worshipped,) and बलि an offering.
40356: सन्ध्याभ्र n. (-भ्रं) A sort of red chalk, that called golden. E. सन्ध्या twilight, and अभ्र talc.
40357: सन्ध्याराग n. (-गं) Redlead. E. सन्ध्या twilight, and राग the colour.
40358: सन्ध्याराम m. (-मः) BRAHMĀ. E. सन्ध्या the daughter of the deity, of whom he became enamoured, and आङ् before रम to sport, aff. घञ्.
40359: सन्ध्यासमय m. (-यः) 1 Evening twilight. 2 The period after each Yuga. E. सन्ध्या, and काल time.
40360: सन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Shrunk, diminished. 2 Lost, gone. 3 Still, motionless. 4 Dispirited. n. (-न्नं) A little, a small quantity. E. षद to go, क्त aff.
40361: सन्नक m. (-कः) A tree, commonly Piyāl: see the सन्नकद्रु.
40362: सन्नकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) Choking, choked, scarce able to articulate. E. सन्न gone, कण्ठ the throat.
40363: सन्नकद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree, commonly Piyāl, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) E. सन्नक said to mean here, sharp, hot, and द्रु a tree; also सन्नक.
40364: सन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bowed down. E. सम्, and नत bowed.
40365: सन्नति f. (-तिः) 1 Reverence, obeisance, reverential salutation. 2 Humility. 3 Sound. E. सम् before नम to bow, and क्तिन् aff.
40366: सन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Armed, mailed, accoutred. 2 Arranged, arrayed, prepared for battle. 3 Murderous, felonious, provided with arms for the destruction of others. 4 Wearing amulets, provided with charms, &c. 5 Near, at hand. E. सम् before नह to bind, aff. क्त.
40367: सन्नय m. (-यः) 1 Multitude, number, quantity. 2 Rear, rear-guard. E. सम् together, नी to get or guide, aff. अच्.
40368: सन्नहर्ष m. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Destitute of joy, distressed. E. सन्न gone, हर्ष joy.
40369: सन्नाह m. (-हः) Armour, mail, either of iron or thick quilted cotton. E. सम् before नह to bind, aff. घञ्.
40370: सन्नाह्य m. (-ह्यः) A war elephant. E. सन्नाह armour, यत् aff. of fitness.
40371: सन्निकर्ष mf. (-र्षः-र्षा) Proximity, nearness. E. सम् together, नि before कृष to attract, aff. अच्, fem. टाप्.
40372: सन्निकर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Proximity. 2 Approximation, approximating, bringing or approaching near to. E. सम् and नि before कृष to make furrows, aff. ल्युट्.
40373: सन्निकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Near, proximate. E. सम्, and नि prefixed to कृष to make furrows, aff. क्त.
40374: सन्निक्षार m. (-रः) The Piyāl tree, (Buchanania latifolia.) E. सम्, and नि before क्षर to ooze, aff. घञ्.
40375: सन्निचय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Collected. E. सम् with, निचय heap.
40376: सन्निध n. (-धं) Proximity. E. सम्, and नि before धा to have, aff. क.
40377: सन्निधातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Receiving, keeping in deposit or near to, who or what places near to, &c. E. सम्, and नि before धा to have, तृच् aff.
40378: सन्निधान n. (-नं) 1 Proximity. 2 Appearance, perceptibility. 3 Placing, depositing. 4 Receiving, taking charge of. E. सम्, and नि before धा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
40379: सन्निधाय ind. Having placed or placed near at hand. E. सम् and नि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
40380: सन्निधि f. (-धिः) 1 Proximity, approximation. 2 Perceptibility, presence, appearance, becoming or being visible or perceptible. 3 Placing. 4 Receiving. E. सम् and नि before धा to have, and कि aff.; also सन्निध and सन्निधान.
40381: सन्निपतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Assembled, collected. 2 Mixed, blended. 3 Alighted, descended. 4 Come, arrived. E. सम् and नि before पत to go, aff. क्त.
40382: सन्निपात m. (-तः) 1 Collection, assemblage, multitude. 2 Union, junction, contact. 3 Mixture, miscellaneous collection. 4 Morbid state of the three humours. 5 Alighting, descending. 6 Arrival. E. सम् and नि before पत to go, aff. घञ्.
40383: सन्निपातक m. (-कः) Dangerous illness. E. कन् added to the last.
40384: सन्निबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound firmly, fast tied or fettered. E. सम् and नि intensitives, बद्ध bound.
40385: सन्निबन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Binding, tying. 2 Connexion, consequence 3 Effectiveness. E. सम् completely, or सत् good, निबन्ध fastening.
40386: सन्निबन्धन n. (-नं) Binding or tying fast. E. सम् and नि intensitives, and बन्धन tying.
40387: सन्निभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like, similar. E. सम्, and निभ like.
40388: सन्निमग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Immersed, plunged in. 2 Asleep, sleeping. E. सम्, and निमग्न immersed.
40389: सन्निमित्त n. (-त्तं) For a good cause, for the sake of the good. E. सत्, and निमित्त cause.
40390: सन्नियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Appointed, employed. 2 Attached to, connected with. E. सम् and नि before युज to join, क्त aff.
40391: सन्नियोग m. (-गः) 1 Attachment or application to, connection or union with. 2 Deputation, appointment. E. सम् and नि before युज to join, घञ् aff.
40392: सन्निरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Stopped, obstructed, checked. E. सम् and नि before रुघ to oppose, क्त aff.
40393: सन्निरोध m. (-धः) Hindrance, check, obstruction, suppression. E. सम् and नि before रुघ to hinder, घञ् aff.
40394: सन्निविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Near, present, at hand. 2 Entered into. 3 Collected, assembled. 4 Neighbouring. E. सम् and नि before विश to enter, aff. क्त.
40395: सन्निवेश m. (-शः) 1 An open space, either in a town or its vicinity, where the people take exercise or diversion. 2 Vicinity, proximity, neighbourhood. 3 Fabrication, manufacture, construction, preparation. 4 Putting in, causing to enter. 5 Union, junction. 6 Assemblage, collection. 7 The collective form or figure of an asterism. E. सम् and नि before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
40396: सन्निवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Ceasing, forbearing. 2 Stopped, ceased. 3 Returned, coming back. E. सम् and नि before वृत्त to be, क्त aff.
40397: सन्निवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Restraint, forbearance, avoiding, forsaking. 2 Returning, coming back. E. सम्, and निवृत्ति desisting, stopping.
40398: सन्निषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) Stationary, seated, halted. E. सम् and नि before षद to go, क्त aff.
40399: सन्निहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Near, proximate, at hand, present. 2 Staying. being. E. सम् together, निहित placed.
40400: सन्निहितापाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Transient, brief. E. सन्निहित, and अपाय loss.
40401: सन्मान n. (-नं) Respect for the good. E. सत्, and मान respect.
40402: सन्मार्ग m. (-र्गः) Good or virtuous conduct. E. सत्, and मार्ग a way.
40403: सन्न्यसन n. (-नं) 1 Abandonment of the world. 2 Entrusting to. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, ल्युट् aff.
40404: सन्न्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Abandoned, deserted. 2 Entrusted or delivered to. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, क्त aff.
40405: सन्न्यस्य ind. Having left or abandoned. 2 Having consigned or delivered to. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, ल्यप् aff.
40406: सन्न्यास m. (-सः) 1 Abandonment of all worldly affections and possessions. 2 Abandonment in general. 3 Deposit, trust, or relinquishment to. 5 Sudden death. 6 Indian spikenard. E. सम् and नि before अस to throw, to cast off, and घञ् aff.
40407: सन्न्यासिन् m. (-सी) 1 The Brahman of the fourth order, the religious mendicant. 2 An ascetic, a devotee. E. सन्न्यास abandonment of the world, इनि aff.
40408: सपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Winged. 2 Having a side or party. m. (-क्षः) A partisan, a follower, an adherent, one of the same side or party. E. स for समान same, and पक्ष party.
40409: सपत्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distressed, afflicted. m. (-तः) A wounded deer or other animal. E. स for सह with, पत्र the leaf, the barb of the arrow, and कृत made; also सपत्राकृत, &c. being metaphorically applied to distress or pain in general.
40410: सपत्राकरण n. (-णं) Excessive pain: see the last.
40411: सपत्राकृति f. (-तिः) Agony, affliction, excessive pain or distress: see the last.
40412: सपत्न m. (-त्वः) An enemy, an adversary. f. (-त्वी) A woman whose husband has other wives. E. स for समान the same, पति a husband, ङीष् aff. and नुक् augment, अच् added for the masc. form.
40413: सपत्नारि m. (-रिः) A sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.)
40414: सपदि ind. 1 Instantly, in a moment, at the moment. 2 Quickly, swiftly. E. सम् before पद to go, इन् aff. and the nasal rejected.
40415: सपर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Worship, reverence. E. सपर Kaṇḍvādi root, said to imply worship, यक् and टाप् affs.
40416: सपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kinsman, especially one connected by the offering of the funeral cake to either or all of the manes of the father, grandfather, and great-grandfather, and their wives respectively, as sprung from them in directly collateral lines; the relationship stops with every fourth person, as the fifth cannot perform the offering of a cake to the father even of the deceased. The following are enumerated as Sapiṇḍas; the son, son's son, and son's grandson; widow, daughter and daughter's son; the father, the mother, the brother, brother's son, and brother's grandson; father's daughter's son; father's brother's son and grandson; paternal grandfather's daughter's son; paternal grandfather; paternal grandmother, paternal grandfather's brother, brother's son and grandson; and lastly the great grandfather's daughter's son: these all present oblations in which the deceased is either included, or may participate: other enumerations, including the oblations he was bound to offer, &c. extend the connection of Sapiṇḍa to seven persons both in an ascending or descending line. E. स for समान common, and पिण्ड ball of meat, &c. offered to the manes of the deceased ancestors, at the Śrāddhas performed in honor of them.
40417: सपिण्डीकरण n. (-णं) Offering food to the deceased relatives called Sapiṇḍas: see the last. 2 Investing a person with the rights of relationship, indicated by offering the funeral cake. E. सपिण्ड, करण making, च्चि aff.
40418: सपिण्डीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Comprehended in the relationship of Sapiṇḍa or offering of a common cake. E. सपिण्ड, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
40419: सपीति f. (-तिः) Drinking together. E. स for सह with, and पा to drink, aff. क्तिन्.
40420: सप्तक mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) 1 Seven. 2 Seventh. n. (-कं) A collection of seven stanzas of the Ṛg Vedas. f. (-की) A woman's girdle. E. सप्तन् seven, (strings, &c.) कन् and घातु or ङीप् affs.
40421: सप्तजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) AGNI, or fire. E. सप्त seven, and जिह्वा a tongue or flame.
40422: सप्तज्वाल m. (-लः) AGNI or fire. E. सप्त seven, ज्वाला a flame.
40423: सप्ततन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A sacrifice, an offering or oblation. E. सप्त seven, (prayers, or the tongues of AGNI,) तन to spread, aff. तु.
40424: सप्तति f. sing. (-तिः) Seventy. du. (-ती) Two seventies. plu. (-तयः) Many seventies. E. सप्तन् seven, डति aff.
40425: सप्तदश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Seventeenth. E. सप्त, दशन् seventeen, aff. डट्.
40426: सप्तदशन् mfn. plu. (-श) Seventeen. E. सप्तन seven, and दशन् ten.
40427: सप्तदीधिति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire. E. सप्त seven, दीधिति a ray of light.
40428: सप्तधा ind. In seven ways. E. सप्तन् seven, धा aff.
40429: सप्तधातु m. (-तुः) The seven parts of the body, or chyle, blood, flesh, adeps, marrow, bone, and semen. E. सप्त seven, and घातु element.
40430: सप्तन् mfn. plu. only (सप्त) Seven. E. षप to be collected, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, तुट् augment.
40431: सप्तपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Seven-leaved. m. (-र्णः) A tree, (Alstonia scholaris.) n. (-र्णं) A sort of sweetmeat, made of the expressed juice of the grape, pomegranate and date, with sugar, spices, honey, and Ghee. E. सप्त seven, and पर्ण a leaf.
40432: सप्तपुत्त्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of seven children. E. सप्त seven, पुत्त्र a child, and सू mother.
40433: सप्तप्रकृति plu. (-तयः) The seven constituent parts of a kingdom, or prince, minister, city, country, treasure, force, and ally or friend. E. सप्त, and प्रकृति constituent.
40434: सप्तभद्र m. (-द्रः) The Sirisha tree, (Acacia Sirisa.) E. सप्त seven, and भद्र auspicious.
40435: सप्तम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Seventh. f. (-मी) The seventh day of the fortnight. E. सप्तन् seven, डतम aff.
40436: सप्तरक्त m. plu. (-क्ताः) The seven external parts of the body of a red colour, or the palms of the hands, the soles of the feet, the corners of the eyes, the tongue, the palate, the lips and nails. E. सप्त seven, and रक्त red or blood.
40437: सप्तरात्र n. (-त्रं) A period of seven nights. E. सप्त, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
40438: सप्तर्षि m. plu. (-र्षयः) The constellation Ursa Major, the seven stars of which are the seven great saints, MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, and VASIṢṬHA. E. सप्त seven, and ऋषि a sage.
40439: सप्तला f. (-ला) 1 Double jasmine, (J. zambac fl. multiplicatis.) 2 A plant, commonly Carmaghās. 3 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) 4 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) E. सप्त seven, (leaves, &c.) ला to get or have, aff. क.
40440: सप्तसप्ति m. (-प्तिः) The sun. E. सप्त seven, and सप्ति a horse.
40441: सप्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Of seven cubits. 2 Having seven hands, &c. E. सप्त, and हस्त a hand.
40442: सप्तांशुपुङ्गव m. (-वः) The planet SATURN. E. सप्त seven, अंशु a ray of light, पुङ्गव eminent.
40443: सप्ताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having seven members or parts. E. सप्त, and अङ्ग a part.
40444: सप्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः) Evil-eyed. m. (-र्च्चिः) 1 AGNI or fire. 2 The planet SATURN. E. सप्त seven, and अर्च्चिस् a flame.
40445: सप्ताश्व m. (-श्वः) The sun. E. सप्त seven, and अश्व a horse.
40446: सप्तास्र n. (-स्रं) A heptagon. E. सप्त, and अस्र an angle.
40447: सप्ताह n. (-हं) A week. E. सप्त, and अह for अहन् a day.
40448: सप्ति m. (-प्तिः) A horse. E. षप to be collected, (in a troop,) ति aff.
40449: सफर mf. (-रः-री) A small glistening fish, commonly Punthi, a sort of carp, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM.) E. श the initial changed to सः see शफर.
40450: सफल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Productive, fruitful, bearing fruit, yielding a profit, &c. E. स for सह with, and फल fruit.
40451: सबधूक m. (-कः) A man with his wife. E. स with, बधू a wife, and कन् added.
40452: सबलि m. (-लिः) Evening twilight. E. स for सह with, बलि offering of food to evil spirits; the proper hour for such ceremonies.
40453: सबाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Painful, hurtful. 2 Oppressive, extortionary. E. स with, बाधा pain.
40454: सब्रह्मचर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Studying together, being disciples of one teacher. E. स with, ब्रह्मचर्य्य studentship.
40455: सब्रह्मचारिन् m. (-री) A fellow student, one engaged in the same studies and observing the same austerities. E. स for सह with, and ब्रह्मचारिन् the religious student.
40456: सभय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearing, fearful. E. स with, भय fear.
40457: सभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband is alive. E. स with, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् and टाप् affs.
40458: सभा f. (-भा) 1 A house. 2 An assembly, a meeting. E. स for सह together, भा to shine, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
40459: सभाज r. 10th cl. (सभाजयति) 1 To serve, to gratify by service. 2 To please or satisfy. 3 To see.
40460: सभाजन n. (-नं) Courtesy, politeness, civility in receiving or taking leave of a friend. E. सभाज to please or gratify, aff. ल्युट्.
40461: सभाजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Treated with courtesy, gratified, pleased. E. सभाज to please, क्त aff.
40462: सभापति m. (-तिः) 1 The keeper of a gaming house. 2 The president of an assembly. E. सभा an assembly, (of gamblers, &c.) and पति master.
40463: सभावशकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Influencing or fascinating an assembly. E. सभा, and वशकर what subdues.
40464: सभासद् m. (-सत् or सद्) One of a company, an assistant at an assembly or meeting; (in law,) an assessor. E. सभा an assembly, and सद् who goes.
40465: सभास्तार m. (-रः) An assistant at an assembly, one of a company. E. सभा an assembly, and स्तृ to cover, aff. अण्.
40466: सभिक m. (-कः) The keeper of a gaming house. E. सभा an assembly, ठक् aff; also with the penultimate vowel made long सभीक.
40467: सभीक m. (-कः) The keeper of a gaming house: see the last.
40468: सभोचित m. (-तः) A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman or teacher. E. सभा an assembly, and उचित fit, proper.
40469: सभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) 1 Trusted, confidential, faithful. 2 Relating to an assembly, fit for or suitable to it. m. (-भ्यः) 1 An assistant at an assembly. 2 An assessor. 3 A person of honourable parentage. 4 The keeper of a gaming house. E. सभा an assembly, &c. य aff.
40470: सभ्यतम m. (-मः) A distinguished person, one who is an ornament of society. E. सभ्य, and तमप् affix of superl.
40471: सभ्यता f. (-ता) Politeness, refinement in manners. E. सभ्य, and तल् aff.
40472: सम् ind. A particle and prefix implying; 1 Union, junction, (with, together.) 2 Assemblage, collection. 3 Beauty or perfection. 4 Intensity. As a prefix it corresponds to con, co, com, &c. Before a consonant the final of this word is changed to Anusvāra, and is written सं.
40473: सम mfn. pron. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 All, whole, entire. (adj.) 2 Like, similar. 3 Good, virtuous. 4 Full, complete. 5 Same, even, equal. 6 Indifferent, impartial. 7 Mean. f. (-मा) A year. n. (-मं) 1 A figure of rhetoric, identity or sameness of objects compared to one another. 2 (In geometry,) A mean; a fourth proportional to the two perpendiculars and the link or segment. E. सम to be confused or unconfused, aff. अच्.
40474: समकन्या f. (-न्या) A girl fit to be married. E. सम complete, कन्या a virgin.
40475: समकाल n. (-लं) The same time, the same moment. E. सम, and काल time.
40477: समक्न m. (-क्नः-क्ना-क्नं) Going or moving equally, kept equal or together. E. सम् together, अञ्च to go, क्त aff.
40478: समक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Before, in presence or sight of, visible. E. सम् with अक्षि the eye, aff. टच्.
40479: समखात m. (-तः) An oblong excavation, thence also a parallelopipedon, (in geometry.) E. सम equal, खात dug.
40480: समगन्धक m. (-कः) Compounded perfume. E. सम same, even, गन्ध smell, कन् aff.
40481: समग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) All, entire, whole, full, complete. E. सम the whole, ग्रह to take, ड aff.
40482: समङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) 1 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) 2 A sort of fern, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) 3 A sort of sensitive plant. E. सम् together, अगि to go or grow, aff. अच्.
40483: समचित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Indifferent, unattached. 2 Equable, even tempered. E. सम, and चित्त the mind.
40484: समचित्तत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Indifference. 2 Equanimity. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, समचित्तता.
40485: समज m. (-जः) 1 A multitude of beasts. 2 A number of blockheads. n. (-जं) A forest, a wood. E. सम alike, जन to be born, ड aff.
40486: समज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Fame, reputation. E. सम all, ज्ञा to know, क and टाप् affs.
40487: समज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 An assembly, a meeting. 2 Fame, celebrity. E. सम् together, अज to go, क्यप् aff.
40488: समञ्जस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Proper, right, fit. 2 Exercised, experienced. 3 Correct, accurate, true. 4 Virtuous, good. n. (-सं) Propriety, fitness. E. सम् with, together with, अञ्जसा truly.
40489: समण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A potherb, a sort of cucumber.
40490: समता f. (-ता) Sameness, similarity, equality. E. सम equal, like, तल् aff.; also समत्व n. (-त्वं).
40491: समतिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Deviating from, transgressing. 2 Going over or beyond. E. सम् and अति before क्रम to go, अच् aff.
40492: समतिक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Surpassed, exceeded. 2 Gone over or beyond. 3 Transgressed. E. सम्, and अति before क्रम to go, क्त aff.
40493: समतिरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Much, exceeding, abundant. E. सम् with, and अतिरिक्त much.
40494: समत्रिभुज m. (-जः) An equilateral triangle. E. सम, and त्रिभुज triangle.
40495: समतीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Past, gone. E. सम्, and अतीत past.
40496: समत्विष् mfn. (-त्विट्) Equally bright or lovely. E. सम, and त्विष् light.
40497: समत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Envious, jealous. E. स with, मत्सर envy.
40498: समदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) Impartial, equally viewing both sides. E. सम, and दर्शिन् who sees.
40499: समदुःख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Sympathizing, feeling for another's woe. E. सम, and दुःख pain.
40500: समधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Exceeding, abundant, plentiful. E. सम् intensitive, and अधिक more.
40501: समधिगमन n. (-नं) Surpassing, overcoming. E. सम्, and अधि before गम to go, ल्युट् aff.
40502: समधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Equal or equivalent to. E. सम, and धृत held.
40503: समध्व mfn. (-ध्वः-ध्वा-ध्वं) Travelling in company. E. सम् same, अध्वन् a road, the final dropped.
40504: समनुज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Assented or agreed to, permitted. allowed. E. सम् and अनु before ज्ञा to know, क्त aff.
40505: समनुज्ञान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Permitted, allowed. n. (-नं) Assent, concurrence, permission. E. सम् and अनु before ज्ञा to know, ल्युट् aff.
40506: समनुव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Entirely devoted to. E. सम्, and अनुब्रत devoted to.
40507: समन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) All, entire, universal. m. (-न्तः) Limit, term, boundary, end. E. सम् intensitive, अन्त end.
40508: समन्ततस् ind. 1 All round, on every side. 2 Wholly, altogether. E. सम with, अन्त end, term, तसिल् aff.
40509: समन्तदुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) The milk hedge-plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli, &c.) E. समन्त every way, दुग्ध milk.
40510: समन्तभद्र m. (-द्रः) A Jina or Buddha. E. समन्त every way, and भद्र auspicious.
40511: समन्तभुज् m. (-भुक्) AGNI or fire. E. समन्त universally, भुज what eats or consumes.
40512: समन्तात् ind. All around, on every side. E. समन्त in the fifth case, used as a particle.
40513: समन्यु mfn. (-न्युः-न्युः-न्यु) Fierce, angry, enraged. m. (-न्युः) ŚIVA. E. स for सह with, मन्यु wrath.
40514: समन्वय m. (-यः) 1 Connected consequence. 2 Natural succession or order. E. सम्, and अन्वय order.
40515: समन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Possessed of, endowed with, possessing, affected with, full of. E. सम् intensitive or conjunctive, and अन्वित endowed with.
40516: समपाद n. (-दं) An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet even. E. सम even, पाद the foot; also read समपद.
40517: समबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Philosophical, stoical, looking on all things alike, calm, indifferent. E. सम, and बुद्धि understanding.
40518: समभाव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of like nature or property. m. (-वः) 1 Equability. 2 Sameness. E. सम, and भाव nature.
40519: समभिप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overwhelmed. E. सम्, and अभि before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
40520: समभिसरण n. (-णं) 1 Seeking, wishing, endeavouring to gain. 2 Approaching, going to or against. E. सम्, and अभि before सृ to go, ल्युट् aff.
40521: समभिहरण n. (-णं) Taking, seizing. E. सम्, and अभि before सृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
40522: समभिहार m. (-रः) 1 Repetition, reiteration. 2 Excess, surplus. E. सम् with, अभि before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
40523: समभूमि f. (-भिः) Even ground. E. सम even, and भूमि ground.
40524: समभ्यर्च्चन nf. (-नं-ना) Worshipping, reverencing. E. सम्, and अभि before अर्च्च to worship, युच् aff.
40525: समभ्यर्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Honoured, worshipped. E. सम्, and अभि before अर्च्च to respect, क्त aff.
40526: समम् ind. With, together with. E. षम् to be confused or unconfused, aff. अच्.
40527: सममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Of like origin, proceeding from the same cause, &c. E. सम same, मयट् aff.
40528: सममात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Of the same size or measure. E. सम same, मात्रच् aff.
40529: सममिति f. (-तिः) Mean measure. E. सम, and मिति measure.
40530: समय m. (-यः) 1 Time. 2 Oath, affirmation by oath or ordeal. 3 Established moral or ceremonial custom. 4 Demonstrated conclusion. 5 Agreement, covenant, contract, bargain. 6 Engagement, appointment. 7 Order, instruction. 8 Sign, hint, indication. 9 Religious obligation or observance. 10 Leisure, interval, opportunity. 11 Season, fit or proper time for any thing. 12 Speech, declaration. 13 Limit, boundary. 14 End of trouble or distress, (in dramatic action.) E. स for सम with, मी to mete, to measure, aff. अच्, or सम alike, इण् to go, aff. अच्.
40531: समयकार m. (-रः) Making an appointment or engagement, fixing a time. E. समय an agreement, and कार making.
40532: समयभेद m. (-दः) Breaking an agreement. E. समय, and भेद breaking.
40533: समयव्यभिचार m. (-रः) Violating or breaking an agreement. E. समय, and व्यभिचार improper conduct.
40534: समया ind. 1 Near. 2 Within, midst. 3 At such a time, at a fixed or appointed time. 4 Duly, seasonably, in due time or season. E. सम alike, इण् to go, आ Uṇādi aff.
40535: समयाध्युषित n. (-तं) A time at which neither stars nor sun are visible. E. समय time, अधि over, उषित abided.
40536: समर mn. (-रः-रं) War, battle, conflict. E. सम् with, together, ऋ to go, aff. अप्.
40537: समरज्जु f. (-ज्जुः) Mean string or soundings. E. सम, and रज्जु a string.
40538: समरमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The front or van of battle. E. समर, and मूर्द्धन् front.
40539: समरूप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Of like or same source or origin. E. सम same, रूप्य aff.
40540: समर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping, adoration. E. सम् before अर्च्च to worship, ल्युट् aff.
40541: समर्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Worshipped, adored, honoured. E. सम् before अर्च्च to worship, क्त aff.
40542: समर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Asked, solicited. E. सम्, and अर्द्द to ask, क्त aff.
40543: समर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Strong, powerful. 2 Connected in sense. 3 Fit, proper. 4 Able, adequate to, capable. m. (-र्थः) The construction of words. E. सम् with, अर्थ to ask, aff. अच्, or अर्थ meaning, sense.
40544: समर्थक n. (-कं) Aloe wood, (Amyris agallocha.) E. समर्थ fit, (for perfume,) कन् added.
40545: समर्थता f. (-ता) 1 Strength, power, prowess. 2 Ability, capability, adequacy. 3 Signification of terms. E. तल् aff. of the abstract, added to समर्थ; also समर्थत्व n. (-त्वं)
40546: समर्थन n. (-नं) 1 Deliberation, deciding on the propriety or impropriety of any thing; also समर्थना. 2 Perseverance in an arduous undertaking, attempting difficulties or impossibilities. 3 Reconciling differences, allaying a dispute. 4 Objecting, objection. E. सम् before अर्थ to ask, or request, aff. ल्युट्.
40547: समर्द्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Granting a boon. E. सम् before ऋधु to augment, aff. खुल्.
40548: समर्प्पण n. (-णं) Delivering, consigning, presenting. E. सम्, and अर्प्पण delivering.
40549: समर्प्पणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be delivered, presented, made over &c. E. सम्, and अर्प्पणीय to be delivered; also समर्प्पयितव्य and समर्प्प्य.
40550: समर्प्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delivered, made over, consigned. E. सम्, and अर्प्पित delivered.
40551: समर्प्पितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Giving or making over, delivering. E. सम्, and अर्प्पितवत् delivering.
40552: समर्य्याद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Bounded, limited. 3 Correct in conduct. E. स for सह with, मर्य्यादा a limit.
40553: समल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Dirty, muddy, filthy. n. (-लं) Fæces, ordure. E. स for सह with, मल dirt.
40554: समवतार m. (-रः) A place of pilgrimage, as a sacred stream, &c. E. सम् with, अव below, तृ to cross or pass over, aff. अण्.
40555: समवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Of the same caste, colour, &c. m. (-र्णः) Community of caste, &c. E. सम, and वर्ण caste.
40556: समवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती) YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus. E. सम all, equal, वृत to be or to select, aff. णिनि.
40557: समवनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bowed. E. सम्, and अव before णम to bow, aff. क्त.
40558: समवश्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone away, wasted, destroyed. E. सम्, and अव before श्यै to go, क्त aff.
40559: समवसर्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) To be let go or let out. E. सम्, and अव before सृज to loose, ण्यत् aff.
40560: समवाकार m. (-रः) A sort of dramatic entertainment. E. सम्, and अव with आङ्, before कृ to make, aff. घञ्; described, as that in which the chiefs are engaged in mutual conflict or contest.
40561: समवाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining, getting. E. सम्, and अव before आप to get, क्तिन् aff.
40562: समवाय m. (-यः) 1 Multitude, assemblage, collection, aggregate, quantity. 2 One of the categories or Padārthas of logic, intimate and constant relation, as of yarn and the cloth made of it. 3 Connection of species in a genus, or parts of a whole. E. सम् and अव before अय to go, aff. घञ्.
40563: समवायसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) Inseparable relation, as of properties with substances, material with manufacture, species with genus. E. समवाय, and सम्बन्ध connection.
40564: समवायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Multitudinous, aggregated. 2 Connected intimately. n. (-यि) Intimate and inseparable cause, as earth of pottery, thread of cloth, &c. E. समवाय, and इनि aff.
40565: समवायिकारण n. (-णं) Inseparable cause or relation, as of material with produce, &c. E. समवायिन्, and कारण cause.
40566: समवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Moderate, equable. E. सम, and वृत्ति practice.
40567: समवेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Mixed, mingled, blended. 2 Collected, assembled. 3 Connected with, related to, as properties with things. 4 Comprised in one genus. E. सम्, and अव before इत gone.
40568: समवेध m. (-धः) Mean depth. E. सम, and वेध perforation.
40569: समश्नुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Spreading over, pervading, extending throughout. E. सम् intensitive, अश to pervade, शातच् aff.
40570: समष्ठिला f. (-ला) A sort of potherb, said to grow in watery places; according to some authorities, a kind of cucumber, to others a shrub, called commonly गांडरद्धवी. E. सम together, स्था to stay, इलच् aff. deriv. irr. or सम with, अस्थि a bone, (a seed,) ला to get or have, aff. क, also समष्ठीला.
40571: समसन n. (-नं) 1 Contracting, contraction. 2 Combination, conjunction, formation of compound terms. E. सम् together, अस to throw or direct, aff. ल्युट्.
40572: समसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) Alliance or peace on equal terms. E. सम, and सन्धि union.
40573: समसन्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Allied on equal terms. 2 Bound or connected equally. E. सम, and सन्धित bound.
40574: समसुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) The end of the Kalpa, and destruction of the universe E. सम universal, सुप्ति sleep.
40575: समस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 All, whole, entire, complete. 2 Compound, compounded. 3 Abridged, contracted. m. (-स्तः) A whole, the aggregate of all the parts. E. सम् together, अस to throw or direct, aff. क्त.
40576: समस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Even, equal, level, uniform. 2 Like, similar. E. सम even, स्थ what abides.
40577: समस्थल nf. (-लं-ली) Level ground. f. (-ली) The Doab, the country between the Ganges and Jumna rivers. E. सम level, स्थल soil.
40578: समस्थलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Levelled, made level, filled up (as a marsh or river). E. समस्थल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
40579: समस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be collected together. 2 To be made entire or complete. f. (-स्या) Part of a stanza, proposed as a trial of skill to be completed. E. सम even or complete, क्यच् affix, and सुक् augment; or सम् together, अस to direct, ण्यत् aff.
40580: समस्यार्था f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza to be completed as a trial of skill. E. समस्य to be completed, अर्थ meaning.
40581: समांश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Entitled to an equal share. m. (-शः) An equal portion, a part. E. सम, and अंश part.
40582: समांशहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Sharing equally, a coheir. E. समांश, and हारिन् who takes.
40583: समांशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) A coheir entitled to an equal share. E. सम same, अंश part or portion, and इनि aff.
40584: समांसमीना f. (-ना) A cow bearing a calf every year. E. समा a year, in the second case, repeated, and ख aff.
40585: समाकर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) Possessing a diffusive fragrance. E. सम, and आङ् before कृषि to go, aff. णिनि.
40586: समाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Agitated, bewildered, confused. E. सम्, and आङ् before कुल to accumulate, क aff.
40587: समाकुलत्व n. (-त्वं) Agitation, anxiety. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, समाकुलता.
40588: समाक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Pervaded, spread. 2 Overcome, surpassed. E. सम्, and आङ् before क्रम to go, aff. क्त.
40589: समाख्या f. (-ख्या) Fame, reputation. E. सम् all, आङ् before ख्या to tell or declare, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
40590: समाख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famed, celebrated. 2 Notorious, public. E. सम्, and आङ् before ख्या to say, क्त aff.
40591: समागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Arrived, approached. 2 Met, encountered. 3 United, joined. E. सम् together, and आगत come.
40592: समागति f. (-तिः) 1 Arrival, approach. 2 Union, joining. 3 Encountering, meeting. 4 Similar condition or progress. E. सम् with, or सम् same, आङ् before गम to go, aff. क्तिन्.
40593: समागम m. (-मः) 1 Union, junction. 2 Arrival, approach. 3 Association, acquaintance, intercourse. 4 Encounter, meeting. 5 (In astronomy,) The occultation of a star. E. सम् with, आगम coming.
40594: समाघात m. (-तः) 1 War, battle. 2 Striking, beating, killing. E. सम् together, आघात striking.
40595: समाचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what observes, practices, proceeds, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before चर to go, ट aff.
40596: समाचरण n. (-णं) Following, practising, observing, proceeding. E. सम्, and आङ् before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.
40597: समाचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Following, practising, behaving, proceeding, &c. सम्, and आङ् before चर to go, शतृ aff.
40598: समाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Equal or like in virtuous conduct. m. (-रः) 1 Proper practice or conduct. 2 Proceeding, going. 3 Information, tradition, news. E. सम्, and आङ् before चर to go, घञ् aff.
40599: समाच्छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Covered with, involved in. E. सम्, and आच्छन्न covered.
40600: समाज m. (-जः) 1 A multitude, a number, (of any thing except beasts.) 2 An assembly, a meeting. 3 A convivial meeting, a club. 4 An elephant. E. सम् like, and अज to go, aff. घञ्.
40601: समाज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) Fame, reputation. E. सम् all, आङ् before ज्ञा to know, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
40602: समादान n. (-नं) 1 Receiving suitable donations. 2 Taking. 3 The daily observances of the Jaina sect. E. सम् with, आदान taking.
40603: समादाय ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Having accepted. E. सम्, and आङ before दा to give, ल्यप् aff.
40604: समादिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Enjoined, commanded. E. सम्, and आदिष्ट enjoined.
40605: समादेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Acceptable, to be selected or taken. E. सम्, and आङ् before दा to give, यत् aff.
40606: समाधान n. (-नं) 1 Religious meditation, restraining the mind from external objects, and fixing it in profound absorption. 2 Promising, declaring. 3 (In the drama,) The leading incident, that which gives rise sometimes unexpectedly to the whole plot. E. सम् intensitive, and आङ् before धा to have or hold, aff. ल्युट्.
40607: समाधाय ind. Having fixed upon, (the mind,) being intent upon. E. सम्, and आङ् before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
40608: समाधि f. (-धिः) 1 Deep and devout meditation, restraining the senses and confining the mind to contemplation on the true nature of spirit, &c. 2 A religious vow or obligation. 3 Silence. 4 Promise, assent, engagement. 5 Composing or reconciling differences, putting a stop to a dispute. 6 Requital, return, retaliation. 7 Attempting impossibilities; exertion or perseverance in extreme difficulties. 8 Storing corn on account of a dearth. 9 A Jaina saint of a future age. 10 A figure of rhetoric; connexion or proximity of two events accidentally connected, and expressed by a common verb and the government of the verb by a double nominative, as उत्कण्ठिता च कुस्तटा जगामास्तञ्च भानुमान् the disloyal woman went sorrowfully, and the sun (went) down. 11 Demonstrated conclusion. 12 The joint of the neck. 13 A tomb, a grave. E. सम् together, घा to have or hold, with आङ् prefix, and कि aff.
40609: समाधिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Contemplative, engaged in meditation. 2 Making a promise, announcing assent or permission. E. समाधि, and मतुप् aff.
40610: समाधिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Devoted to meditation. E. समाधि, and स्थ who is.
40611: समाध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blown or puffed up, inflated. E. सम् and आङ् before ध्मा to blow, क्त aff.
40612: समान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Like, similar. 2 Good, virtuous. 3 One, uniform, same. m. (-नः) 1 One of the vital airs, that which is considered essential to digestion. 2 A corresponding letter of the alphabet, as a long vowel to its short one, &c. E. सम all, अन to breathe, aff. घञ्, or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, aff. अच्.
40613: समानकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Occurring or produced at the same period. E. समान same, काल time, ख aff.
40614: समानगोत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Of the same lineage or family: see सगोत्र. E. समान, and गोत्र family.
40615: समानजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Of equal age. E. समान, and जन्मन् birth.
40616: समानजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a common tribe, sort, &c. E. समान, and जाति sort.
40617: समानजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of the same caste or species. E. समान, and जातीय of a caste.
40618: समानता f. (-ता) 1 Sameness, equality, likeness. 2 Community of kind or quality. E. समान, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, aff. समानत्वं.
40619: समानयत mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Making equal or like to. 2 Leading, bringing. E. समान used as a verb, or सम् and आङ् before णी to get, शतृ aff.
40620: समानयन n. (-नं) Bringing, conducting. E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्युट् aff.
40621: समानाधिकरण n. (-णं) 1 Common or generick property. 2 A predicament or condition including several things or persons. m. (-णः) A generick character. E. समान, and अधिकरण possession.
40622: समानाधिकार m. (-रः) 1 Similar or equal duty, office, or government. 2 Generick character. E. समान, and अधिकार office.
40623: समानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken, led, conducted. E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, क्त aff.
40624: समानीय ind. Having taken. E. सम् and आङ् before णी to take, ल्यप् aff.
40625: समानोदक m. (-कः) A kinsman, one who when distinct from the Sapiṇḍa is next in order and succession, and is connected by oblations of water only, to the manes of common ancestors; this relationship extends to the fourteenth in descent, i. e. the seven first or Sapin'da's presenting water as well as the cakes, are also Samānodakas, whilst the seven next presenting water alone are Samānodakas only. E. समान common, उदक water.
40626: समानोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood. E. समान same, उदर belly, यत् aff.
40627: समान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a year. E. समा a year, and अन्त end.
40628: समाप m. (-पः) Sacrificing, offering oblations to the gods. E. सम् same, आप water; in which libations of water are made.
40629: समापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Filling, completing, finishing. 2 Killing. E. सम् together, आप to get, aff. ण्वुल्.
40630: समापन n. (-नं) 1 Conclusion, completion, finish. 2 A section, a chapter, a division. 3 Killing, destroying. 4 Profound meditation. 5 Gain, acquisition. E. सम् with, together with, आप to obtain, aff. ल्युट्.
40631: समापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Finished, done, completed, concluded. 2 Got, gained, obtained. 3 Distressed, afflicted. 4 Killed. 5 Accomplished, perfect, (in any branch of study.) 6 Come, occurred, happened. E. सम् implying completion, &c., आङ् before पद to go, aff. क्त.
40632: समापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Finished, done, concluded. E. सम् before आप to get, aff. क्त, and इट् inserted.
40633: समाप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Finished, done, concluded, completed. E. सम् before आप to get, aff. क्त, without the augment.
40634: समाप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 End, completion, perfection, conclusion, finish. 2 Reconciling differences, putting an end to disputes, &c. E. सम् implying completion, आप to get or gain, aff. क्तिन्.
40635: समाप्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Finite, final, concluding, completing. m. (-कः) 1 One who has completed a course of holy study. 2 A finisher, an ender. E. समाप्त, and ठक् aff.
40636: समाप्त्यर्था f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza given as a task or trial of skill to be completed. E. समाप्ति completion, अर्थ sense.
40637: समाप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drenched, drowned. E. सम् and आङ् before प्लु to go, क्त aff.
40638: समाय m. (-यः) A visit, arrival. E. सम् and आङ् before या to go, ड aff.
40639: समायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lengthened, extended. E. सम् and आङ् before यम to restrain, क्त aff.
40640: समायात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come, arrived. E. सम् and आङ् before या to go, क्त aff.
40641: समायुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Joined, connected, attached to or united with. 2 Decorated, adorned. E. सम् and आङ् before युत joined.
40642: समाम्नाय m. (-यः) Totality, the aggregate. E. सम् and आङ् before म्ना to remember, घञ् and युक् affs.
40643: समायोग m. (-गः) 1 Union, junction, connection, association. 2 Heap, multitude, assemblage. 3 Cause, origin, motive, object. E. सम् and आङ् before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
40644: समारब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Begun, commenced. E. सम् and आङ् before रभि to begin, क्त aff.
40645: समारम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Commencement, beginning. 2 Undertaking. E. सम् and आङ् before रभि to commence, घञ् aff.
40646: समारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Ascended, gone up or upon. 2 Mounted. 3 Agreed to, determined. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to grow, क्त aff.
40647: समारोपण n. (-णं) Placing or fixing in or on. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to grow, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
40648: समारोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Placed in or upon. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to grow, causal v., क्त aff.
40649: समारोह m. (-हः) 1 Going up, ascending. 2 Mounting, riding upon. 3 Agreeing. E. सम् and आङ् before रुह to rise, घञ् aff.
40650: समार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) 1 Desirous of equality. 2 Seeking peace. E. सम्, and अर्थिन् who asks.
40651: समालम्बन n. (-नं) Resting upon, being supported by. E. सम् and आङ् before लवि to depend, घञ् aff.
40652: समालम्भ m. (-म्भः) Smearing the body with coloured perfumes, as with saffron, sandal, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before लभि to sound, aff. अच्; also with ल्युट् aff. समालम्भन.
40653: समालम्भन n. (-नं) Smearing the body with coloured fragrant substances: see the last.
40654: समाली f. (-ली) A collection of flowers, a nosegay, &c. E. स for सम् with, माला a garland, affs. अच् and ङीष्.
40655: समावर्त्तन n. (-नं) A pupil's return home after finishing his religious studies. E. सम् and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
40656: समावाय m. (-यः) 1 A multitude, a number, a heap or quantity. 2 Association. 3 Integral or inseparable aggregation. E. सम् and आङ् implying aggregation, वय to go, aff. घञ्.
40657: समावास m. (-सः) Residence, abode. E. सम् and आङ् before वस to dwell, घञ् aff.
40658: समावासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sojourning, taking up a residence. E. समावास, and इतच् aff.
40659: समाविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered or engrossed by, absorbed by, (feeling, passion, &c.) possessed by, (as an evil spirit.) 2 Entered, (as a mansion.) E. सम् and आङ् implying entireness, and विष्ट entered.
40660: समावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Surrounded, encompassed. 2 Covered, inclosed. E. सम् and आङ् before वृ to choose, क्त aff.
40661: समावृत्त m. (-त्तः) A pupil who has completed his studies and taken leave of his preceptor. E. सम् and आङ् before वृत to be, aff. क्त; also with कन् added, समावृत्तक.
40662: समावेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be announced or communicated. E. सम् and आङ् before विद to know, causal v., यत् aff.
40663: समावेश m. (-शः) 1 Affection, passion, emotion. 2 Possession by evil spirits. 3 Entrance. E. सम् and आङ् before विश to enter, घञ् aff.
40664: समावेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Placed, fixed. 2 Entered, penetrated. 3 Brought in or into. E. सम् and आङ् before विश to enter, causal v., aff. क्त.
40665: समाशङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Doubtful, fearing, apprehensive. E. सम् and आङ before शकि to doubt, क्त aff.
40666: समाश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Protection, refuge. 2 Seeking protection. E. सम् intensitive, आश्रय asylum.
40667: समाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Protected, defended, cherished, refuged. E. सम् intensitive, and आश्रित refuged.
40668: समाश्रित्य ind. 1 Depending upon, trusting to. 2 Having engaged in, agreed to, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before श्री to serve, ल्यप् aff.
40669: समाश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusting, confiding in. E. सम् and आङ् before श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.
40670: समाश्वास m. (-सः) Trust, belief, confidence. E. सम् and आङ् before श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
40671: समास् m. (-माः) A year. E. स for सह with, and मास a month.
40672: समास m. (-सः) 1 Contraction, abridgment, conciseness. 2 Composition of words, formation of compound terms, (in grammar.) 3 Composition of differences, reconciling quarrels. 4 Aggregation, assemblage, collection. 5 Whole. E. सम् together, अस to throw or direct, aff. घञ्.
40673: समासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Joined, united. 2 Reached, attained. 3 Marked, affected by, &c. 4 Combined, comprehended. E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज to be in contact with, aff. क्त.
40674: समासक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Union. 2 Comprehension, inclusion. 3 Affection, attachment. E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज to be in contact, क्तिन् aff.
40675: समासज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्) Joining, or connecting with. E. सम् and आ before षञ्ज to unite, शतृ aff.
40676: समासज्जन n. (-नं) Joining, uniting, union, combination, connection, contact. E. सम् and आङ् before षञ्ज to be in contact with, aff. ल्युट्.
40677: समासतस ind. Briefly, summarily. E. समास, and तसि aff.
40678: समासन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Obtained, attained. E. सम् and आङ् implying union or contiguity, षद to go, aff. क्त.
40679: समासभावना f. (-ना) Composition by the sum of the products. E. समास, and भावना contemplating.
40680: समासवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Abridged, contracted. 2 Compounded. m. (-वान्) The Tūn tree, (Cedrela Tunna.) E. समास, and मतुप् aff.
40681: समासर्जण n. (-णं) Delivering, consigning, abandoning. E. सम् and आङ् before सृज to leave, ल्युट् aff.
40682: समासादन n. (-नं) Attaining, effecting, accomplishing. E. सम् and आङ् before षद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
40683: समासादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, effected, attained, obtained, accomplished. E. सम् and आङ् before षद to go, causal v., aff. क्त.
40684: समासाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Attainable, what may be obtained or effected. ind. Having obtained, &c. E. सम् and आङ् before षद to go, aff. ण्यत् or ल्यप्.
40685: समासाध्याहार m. (-रः) Supplying an ellipsis. E. समास, and अध्याहार the same.
40686: समासार्थ m. (-र्थः) The sense of a compound. f. (-र्था) Part of a stanza to be completed. E. समास connexion, composition, and अर्थ meaning.
40687: समासीन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Sitting, seated. E. सम् before अस to sit, क्त aff.
40688: समासृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Left, abandoned, given, made over. E. सम् and आङ् before सृज to leave, क्त aff.
40689: समासेवन n. (-नं) 1 Following, practising. 2 Serving. E. सम् and आङ् before सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.
40690: समासेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Followed, practised. 2 Served. E. सम् and आङ् before सेव to serve, क्त aff.
40691: समासोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A protracted metaphor, (in rhetoric.) E. समास, and उक्ति saying.
40692: समास्या f. (-स्या) Interview, colloquy. E. सम् together, अम to be, ण्यत् aff.
40693: समाहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, wounded. E. सस् and आङ् before हन to strike, क्त aff.
40694: समाहरण n. (-णं) Uniting, combining, collecting, composition. E. सम् together, आङ् before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
40695: समाहार m. (-रः) 1 Aggregation, collection, assemblage, either in fact or thought. 2 Contraction, abridgement. 3 Composition of words (in grammar). 4 Conjunction of equal words or sentences, the power of the particle and. 5 A particular form of composition, a subdivision of the class Dvanda, in which several words are joined together, and the compound is a term in the neuter gender, as अहिनकुलं the snake and mungoos. 6 The combination of two letters of the alphabet into a syllable, which designates all the letters intermediate between the two of which it consists. E. सम् together, आङ् before हृ to take or convey, and घञ् aff.
40696: समाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Promised, agreed or assented to. 2 Absorbed in meditation, absent, abstracted or having the senses steadily held in subjection. 3 Concluded, demonstrated, following from what has been said. 4 Composed, reconciled, put an end to, as a contest or dispute. 5 Placed, deposited, delivered. 6 Pure, purified. 7 Finished, completed. 8 Cool, collected, firm. 9 Assembled. n. (-तं) (In rhetoric,) The expression or description of attentiveness. E. सम् and आङ् implying collection or perfection, घा to have or hold, aff. क्त.
40697: समाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Accepted, received, taken. 2 Collected, assembled, combined. 3 Compiled. E. सम् and आङ् before हृत taken.
40698: समाहृति f. (-तिः) Compilation, abridgement, an abridgement. E. सम् together, आङ्, and हृ to take, to bring, aff. क्तिन्: see समाहार.
40699: समाह्व mf. (-ह्वः-ह्वी) Calling out or to, mutual calling. 2 Acclaim. 2 Defiance. f. (-ह्वा) A plant, commonly Gojiwha. E. सम् and आङ् before ह्वेञ् to call, क aff.
40700: समाह्वय m. (-यः) 1 A match, a main, the conflict of animals or birds for sport, cockfighting, &c. 2 War, battle. 3 Calling out. E. सम् and आङ् before ह्वेङ् to call, घ aff.
40701: समाह्वान n. (-नं) Challenge. E. समाह्व to call out, ल्युट् aff.
40702: समिक n. (-कं) A pike, a dart. E. सम even, ठक् aff.
40703: समित् f. (-मित्) War, battle. E. सम् together, इ to go, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् final augment.
40704: समिता f. (-ता) Wheat flour. E. सम् before इ to go, aff. क्त.
40705: समिति f. (-तिः) 1 War, battle. 2 Assembly, company. 3 Association, meeting, union. 4 Sameness, likeness, equality. E. सम् with, इ to go, aff. क्तिन्.
40706: समिथ m. (-थः) 1 Fire. 2 War, battle. E. सम् together, इन् to go, थक् Uṇādi aff.
40707: समिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Lighted, kindled, set alight or on fire. E. सम् before इन्ध to kindle, क्त aff.
40708: समिध् f. (-मित् or मिट्) Fuel, wood, grass, &c. so employed. E. सम् together, इन्धि to kindle or inflame, क्विप् aff., and the nasal rejected.
40709: समिध m. (-धः) AGNI or fire. E. सम् and इन्ध to kindle, aff. क.
40710: समिन्धन n. (-नं) Fuel. E. सम् with, इन्ध to kindle, aff. ल्युट्.
40711: समिन्धान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Augmenting, prospering. E. सम् before इधि to increase, शानच् aff.
40712: समिर m. (-रः) Wind, air. E. सम् with, ईर to go, aff. क, and the vowel made short; also समीर.
40713: समीक n. (-कं) 1 War, battle. 2 A pike, a dart. E. षम to be sad or confused, ईकन् aff.
40714: समीकरण n. (-णं) Equalizing, making equal to. 2 (In arithmetic,) Equation. E. सम, and करण making, च्चि augment.
40715: समीक्रिया f. (-या) (In arithmetic,) Equation. E. सम, and क्रिया operation, च्चि augment.
40716: समीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Equalized, made even or equal. 2 Imitated, done in like manner, &c. 3 Added, summed up. 4 Balanced, equipoised. E. सम same, even, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
40717: समीक्ष n. (-क्षं) The Sāṃkhya system of philosophy. f. (-क्षा) Nature, essential nature, or according to the Sāṃkhya system, crude matter or any of its twenty-four essential parts. 2 Understanding, intellect. 3 Sight, seeing, inspection, looking. 4 Effort. 5 Search, investigation. 6 A book, a work supplementary to the Vedas, treating of the modes of sacrifice. E. सम् before ईक्ष to see, aff. अच् and टाप्.
40718: समीक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Search, looking for, investigation. 2 Seeing, looking at. E. सम् intensitive prefix, and ईक्षण seeing.
40719: समीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, looked at. 2 Considered, investigated. E. सम् before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
40720: समीक्ष्यकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Acting after due deliberation. E. समीक्ष्य having inspected, कारिन् who does.
40721: समीच m. (-चः) The ocean. f. (-ची) 1 A deer, a doe. 2 Praise, eulogium. E. सम् before इण to go, Uṇādi aff. चट्, and the vowel made long.
40722: समीचक m. (-कः) Copulation. E. कन् added to the last.
40723: समीचीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 True. 2 Right, correct. 3 Fit, proper. n. (-नं) Truth. E. सम्यक् true, aff. ख.
40725: समीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Yearly, annual, relating to a year. 2 Hired for a year. 3 After a year, a year hence, &c. E. समा a year, aff. ख.
40726: समीनिका f. (-का) A cow calving every year. E. समीन a year, कन् aff.
40727: समीप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Near, contiguous, proximate, at hand. E. सम together, आप water, and ई substituted for आ; analogous to the confluence of water.
40728: समीपग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Approaching, going or gone near to. E. समीप, and ग who or what goes.
40729: समीपतस् ind. Before, near. E. समीप, and तसि aff.
40730: समीपता f. (-ता) Proximity, contiguity. E. तल् added to the last; also समीपत्व.
40731: समीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Equalised. 2 Identified. 3 Equipoised. E. सम same, भूत become, च्चि aug.
40732: समीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of like cause or origin. E. सम same, छ aff.
40733: समीयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वः) Going to, arriving at, attaining. E. सम् before इण् to go, क्वसु aff.
40734: समीर m. (-रः) Air, wind. E. सम् every way, ईर to go, aff. अच्.
40735: समीरण m. (-णः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A plant, commonly Marüa. 3 A traveller. n. (-णं) Throwing. E. सम् completely, ईर to go, aff. ल्युट्.
40736: समीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tossed, thrown. 2 Gone. 3 Sent. E. सम् before ईर to send, क्त aff.
40737: समीहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. n. (-तं) Wish, desire. E. सम् before ईह to wish, क्त aff.
40738: समुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Eloquent. E. स with, and मुख a mouth.
40739: समुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fit, right, proper. E. सम् intensitive, and उचित proper.
40740: समुच्चय m. (-यः) 1 Assemblage, collection, either in thought or fact. 2 Conjunction of words or sentences, the power of the particle and, or also; but it implies the conjunction of different objects of one act or different acts with the same object, as ईश्वरं गुरुञ्च भजस्व worship GOD, and (or also) the Guru. E. सम् and उत् before चि to collect, aff. णच्.
40741: समुच्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what goes about or up, traverses, ascends, flies, &c. E. सम् and उत् before चर to go, अच् aff.
40742: समुच्चरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Going up or about. E. सम् and उट् before चर to go, शतृ aff.
40743: समुच्छेद m. (-दः) Destroying, destruction. E. सम् and उत् before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.
40744: समुच्छ्रय m. (-यः) 1 Opposition, enmity. 2 Height, elevation. E. सम्, and उट् up, above, and श्रिञ् to serve, aff. णच्.
40745: समुच्छ्राय m. (-यः) Height, elevation. E. सम् and उट् before श्रि to serve, aff. णच्, and the vowel made long.
40746: समुच्छ्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) High, elevated, lofty. E. सम् and उट् before श्रि to serve, aff. क्त.
40747: समुच्छ्रिसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sighing. n. (-तं) A sigh. E. सम् and उट् before श्वस to breathe, and क्त aff.
40748: समुच्छ्वास m. (-सः) Heavy expiration, sighing. E. सम् and उट् before श्वस to breathe, घञ् aff.
40749: समुञ्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, abandoned, quitted, resigned. E. सम् intensitive, and उञ्झित left.
40750: समुत्क्रम m. (-मः) Rise, ascent, going up. E. सम् and उट् up, क्रम going.
40751: समुत्क्रोश m. (-शः) An osprey. E. सम् intensitive, and उत् before क्रुश to cry, aff. घञ्.
40752: समुत्तरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Crossing, passing over or beyond. E. सम् and उत् before तृ to cross, शतृ aff.
40753: समुत्तेजन n. (-नं) Inflaming, inciting, irritating. E. सम् and उत् before तिज to be sharp, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
40754: समुत्तेजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inflamed, incited, excited, irritated. E. सम् and उत् before तिज to be sharp, causal v., क्त aff.
40755: समुत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) 1 Rising, risen, getting or got up. 2 Born, produced. 3 Occasioned, occuring. E. सम् intensitive, उट् up, स्था to stand, क aff.
40756: समुत्थान n. (-नं) Performance of work, occupation, effort, industry. 2 Positive indication or symptom of disease. 3 Rising, getting up. 4 Common growth or increase, (as of size or wealth, &c.) 5 Healing a wound or sore, cure or recovery from any injury. E. सम् intensitive, उट् up, स्था to stay or be, aff. ल्युट्.
40757: समुत्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, got up. 2 Increased. 3 Derived or obtained from. 4 Cured, healed. E. सम् and उत् before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
40758: समुत्पतन n. (-नं) 1 Going. 2 Ascending. 3 Making effort, energy, exertion. E. सम् and उत् before पत् to go, ल्युट् aff.
40759: समुत्पतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, gone up, ascended. 2 Exerted, vigorous. E. सम् and उत् before पत to go, क्त aff.
40760: समुत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Origin, production, birth. 2 Occurrence, incidence. E. सम् and उत् before पद to go, क्तिन् aff.
40761: समुत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born, produced. 2 Occurring, taking place. E. सम् and उत् before पद to go, क्त aff.
40762: समुत्पाट m. (-टः) Detaching, separating from, tearing from, &c. E. सम् and उत् before पट to go, causal v., अच् aff.
40763: समुत्पाटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Detached or severed from, torn from, &c. E. सम् and उत् before पट to go, causal v., क्त aff.
40764: समुत्पादन n. (-नं) 1 Producing, fabricating. 2 Effecting. E. सम् and उत् before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
40765: समुत्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Produced, effected. E. सम् and उत् before पद् to go, causal v., क्त aff.
40766: समुत्पिञ्ज mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) Excessively confused or confounded, bewildered, lost, overcome. m. (-ञ्जः) An army in great disorder. E. सम् and उत् before पिजि to hurt, aff. अच्; also समुत्पिञ्जल, and simply पिञ्ज, &c.
40767: समुत्सर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Leaving, abandoning. 2 Giving. 3 Evacuation of urine or fæces. E. सम् and उत् before सृज to abandon, aff. घञ्.
40768: समुत्सव m. (-वः) Festivity. E. सम्, उत्सव festival.
40769: समुत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sorrowful, regretting, missing or grieving for any one absent, &c. E. सम् intensitive, उत्सुक sorrowful.
40770: समुत्सेध m. (-धः) Height, elevation. E. सम् and उत् before षिघ to go, aff. घञ्.
40771: समुदक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Drawn, raised, lifted or thrown up from a deep place. E. सम् with, and उट् up, अञ्च to go, aff. क्त.
40772: समुदय m. (-यः) 1 Multitude, number, heap or quantity. 2 War, battle. 3 Assent, rise. 4 Rising, (as of the sun, &c.) 5 Effort, exertion, perseverance. 6 A day. E. सम् and उट् before इ to go, aff. णच्; also समुदाय.
40773: समुदागम m. (-मः) Knowledge in general. E. सम् and उद् before आगम knowledge.
40774: समुदात्रार m. (-रः) Intention, purpose, design, motive. E. सम with, उट् and आङ् before चर to go, aff. घञ्.
40775: समुदाय m. (-यः) 1 War, battle. 2 Multitude, quantity, number, heap. 3 Rise, ascent. 4 The rear or reserve of an army. E. सम् and उट् up, इण् to go, aff. णच्; also समुदय.
40776: समुदाहरण n. (-णं) Declaring, uttering. 2 Illustrating. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
40777: समुदाहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Declared. 2 Illustrated. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
40778: समुदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Risen, ascended. 2 Risen, (as the sun, &c.) 3 Produced, excited, occasioned. 4 Possessed of. E. सम्, and उदित risen.
40779: समुदीरण n. (-णं) Repeating, declaring, speaking, reciting. E. सम् and उट् before ईर to send, and ल्युट् aff.
40780: समुदीरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said, spoken, declared, recited. E. सम् and उट् before ईर, क्त aff.
40781: समुद्ग mfn. (-द्गः-द्गा-द्गं) 1 Who or what rises or goes up. 2 Who or what pervades entirely. m. (-द्गः) A casket, a covered box. 2 A stanza in which two or more of the Pādas correspond in sound, though in a different sense. E. सम् and उट् before गम to go, aff. ड.
40782: समुद्गक m. (-कः) 1 A casket, a covered box. 2 A sort of stanza: one, each half of which consists of the very same words but in different acceptations, those of one half being respectively the the attributives or adjectives to those of the other. E. सम् and उट् before गम to go, aff. ड and कन् added.
40783: समुद्गम m. (-मः) 1 Rising, ascent. 2 Birth, production. E. सम् and उट् before गम to go, aff. अच्.
40784: समुद्गयमक n. (-कं) (In rhetoric,) The repetition of the same words in different pādas of a stanza, but in a different sense. E. समुद्ग what goes completely, यमक alliteration.
40785: समुद्गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Brought up (as food), vomited. 2 Raised or lifted up (from a depth, &c.) 3 Uttered, exclaimed, raised (as a cry, &c.) E. सम् and उट् before गॄ to swallow, or sound, aff. क्त.
40786: समुद्दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pointed out, shewn. 2 Particularised, enumerated. 3 Explained. E. सम् and उट् before दिश to shew, क्त aff.
40787: समुद्देश m. (-शः) 1 Describing. 2 Pointing out. 3 Particularising, explaining, enumerating. E. सम् and उट् before दिश to shew, घञ् aff.
40788: समुद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ill-mannered, behaving ill or improperly, conducting one's self discreditably. 2 Raised or drawn up. 3 Upheld, supported. 4 Arrogant, proud, puffed up with pride, &c. E. सम् and उट् before हन to hurt or kill, aff. क्त.
40789: समुद्धरण n. (-णं) 1 Food vomited or thrown up. 2 Drawing up, raising, lifting (as water from a well, &c.) 3 Eradicating a  tree, &c. pulling up by the roots. 4 Extricating, lifting out. 5 Taking out from, as a part or share. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
40790: समुद्धर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Who or what lifts, raises, extricates, &c. m. (-र्त्ता) A redeemer, a deliverer. E. सम् and उट् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
40791: समुद्धस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Wiped off by the hand. E. सम्, and उट् before हस्त the hand.
40792: समुद्धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ill-behaved. 2 Thrown up (as food, &c.) 3 Raised or drawn up. 4 Extricated, lifted out or from. 5 Taken as a share, set apart, divided. 6 Seized, possessed of. E. सम् and उट् before धृ to have, or हृ to take, aff. क्त.
40793: समुद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced. m. (-वः) Production, origin. E. सम् and उट् before भव being.
40794: समुद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Born, produced, derived. E. सम् and उट् before भू to be, क्त aff.
40795: समुद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ready, prepared. E. सम् intensitive, उद्यत active.
40796: समुद्यम m. (-मः) 1 Commencement, onset. 2 Effort, exertion. E. सम्, and उद्यम effort.
40797: समुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Sealed, stamped. m. (-द्रः) A sea, an ocean. E. सम् before उन्दि to be wet, and रक aff.; or स for सह with, and मुद्रा a seal; also thence signifying a limit, (i. e. bounded by continents,) or a jewel, (the receptacle of gems,) or सम with उद्र an otter; or स with, मुद pleasure, or सम् together, उद water, and रा to give or have, aff. क, &c.
40798: समुद्रकफ m. (-फः) Cuttle fish bone. E. समुद्र the sea, and कफ phlegm.
40799: समुद्रकान्ता f. (-न्ता) A river. E. समुद्र the sea, and कान्ता the mistress.
40800: समुद्रग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Ocean-going, sea-faring. m. (-गः) 1 A trader by sea. 2 A seaman. f. (-गा) A river. E. समुद्र the sea, and ग who goes to.
40801: समुद्रगृह n. (-हं) A sort of pleasure or summer house, built in the midst of water, &c. E. समुद्र the sea, and गृह house.
40802: समुद्रचुलुक m. (-कः) The saint, AGASTYA. E. समुद्र the sea, चुलुक a pot; having drank up the ocean.
40803: समुद्रतट n. (-टं) The sea coast. E. समुद्र, and तट a bank.
40804: समुद्रतीर n. (-रं) The sea shore. E. समुद्र, and तीर a bank.
40805: समुद्रदयिता f. (-ता) A river. E. समुद्र the sea, and दयिता beloved.
40806: समुद्रनवनीत n. (-तं) The beverage of immortality. 2 The moon. E. समुद्र the ocean, and नवनीत butter: being produced or recovered by the churning of the ocean.
40807: समुद्रफेन m. (-नः) Cuttle fish bone. E. समुद्र the sea, and फेन froth or foam.
40808: समुद्रमेखला f. (-ला) The earth. E. समुद्र the sea, मेखला a zone; the sea girt; surrounded by the ocean as by a girdle.
40809: समुद्रयान n. (-नं) A sea voyage. E. समुद्र, and यान going.
40810: समुद्रयायिन् m. (-यी) A sailor, a navigator, a merchant trading by sea. E. समुद्र, and यायिन् who goes.
40811: समुद्ररसना f. (-ना) The earth. E. समुद्र the sea, and रसना a zone.
40812: समुद्रलवण n. (-णं) Sea salt. E. समुद्र the sea, and लवण salt.
40813: समुद्रवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) Submarine fire. E. समुद्र the sea, and वह्नि fire.
40814: समुद्रविजय m. (-यः) The father of the Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era. E. समुद्र the sea, and विजय victor.
40815: समुद्रवेला f. (-ला) A wave of the sea. E. समुद्र, and वेला a wave.
40816: समुद्रान्त n. (-न्तं) 1 The nutmeg. 2 The sea shore. f. (-न्ता) 1 A shrub, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 2 The cotton plant. 3 A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. समुद्र the sea, and अन्त end or boundary.
40817: समुद्राम्बरा f. (-रा) The earth. E. समुद्र the sea, and अम्वर vesture; clothed or invested by the ocean.
40818: समुद्रारु m. (-रुः) 1 A shark. 2 A large fabulous fish, perhaps intending the whale, hyperbolically described. 3 RĀMA'S bridge. E. समुद्र the sea, ऋ to go, aff. उण्.
40819: समुद्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Marine, oceanic, maritime. E. समुद्र the sea, घ aff.
40820: समुद्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Who or what lifts or bears up. 2 Moving up and down. E. सम् and उट् before वह to bear, घञ् aff.
40821: समुद्वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Lifting or raising up. 2 Moving up and down. E. सम् and उट् before वह to bear, शतृ aff.
40822: समुन्दन n. (-नं) Wetness, damp, moisture. E. सम् before उन्दि to be moist or wet, aff. ल्युट्.
40823: समुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Wet, moist, moistened. E. सम् before उन्द to be wet, aff. क्त.
40824: समुन्नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 High, lofty, elevated. 2 Full, prominent. 3 Exalted, dignified. 4 Proud, arrogant. 5 Lifted up, raised. E. सम् and उट् before नम to bow, aff. क्त.
40825: समुन्नति f. (-तिः) 1 Height, elevation. 2 Consequence, rank, dignity, exaltation. 3 Pride, loftiness. 4 Lifting up. 5 Increase, thriving, prosperity. E. सम् and उट् before नम to bow, aff. क्तिन्.
40826: समुन्नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Conceited of learning, thinking one's self learned. 2 Proud, arrogant. 3 Produced, born. 4 Tied up or above. 5 Supreme, lord or master. E. सम् and उट् before णह to tie, aff. क्त.
40827: समुन्नय m. (-यः) 1 Occurrence, event, advent. 2 Gaining, attaining. E. सम् and उत् before णी to take, अच् aff.
40828: समुन्नयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Attaining, gaining. E. सम् and उट् before णी to get, शतृ aff.
40829: समुपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Approached, approximated. E. सम्, and उप near, गत gone.
40830: समुपगम m. (-मः) Approach, approximation, contact. E. सम् and उप before गम to go, घञ् aff.
40831: समुपचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Collected, heaped, accumulated. E. सम् and उप before चि to collect, क्त aff.
40832: समुपजोषम् ind. Happily, fortunately. E. सम् and उप before जुष to gratify, aff. अम्; also read उपजोषम् and उपयोषम् or समुपयोषम्.
40833: समुपविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seated, sat down. E. सम् and उप before विश to enter, क्त aff.
40834: समुपवेश m. (-शः) Welcoming, entertaining, causing to sit down. E. सम् and उप before विश to enter, causal v., घञ् aff.
40835: समुपवेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Welcomed, made to sit or rest. E. सम् and उप before विश to enter, causal v., क्त aff.
40836: समुपस्था f. (-स्था) 1 Proximity, approximation. 2 Happening, befalling. E. सम् and उप before ष्ठा to be, अङ् and टाप् affs.; also समुपस्थान and समुपस्थिति.
40837: समुपस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Attained, acquired. 2 Brought or come near to, approximated. E. सम् and उप before ष्ठा to stay, क्त aff.
40838: समुपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. सम् and उप before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
40839: समुपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Come together. E. सम् and उप before इ to go, क्त aff.
40840: समुपेयिवस् mfn. (-वान्-युषी-वत्) Going, proceeding. E. सम् and उप before ई to go, क्वसु aff. of the present participle.
40841: समुपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Suppressed, restrained. E. सम् and उप before वह to bear, क्त aff.
40842: समुल्लसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Sporting, wantoning. 2 Shining, beautiful. E. सम् and उट् before लस to play, शतृ aff. of the present participle.
40843: समुल्लसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sportive, sporting. 2 Brilliant, beautiful. E. सम् and उत् before लस to play, क्त aff.
40844: समूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Heaped, accumulated, assembled, collected. 2 Crooked, bent. 3 Produced quickly. 4 Accompanying, associated, a companion. 5 Tamed, tranquillized. 6 Married. 7 Purified, cleansed. E. सम् before वह to bear, aff. क्त.
40845: समूर m. (-रः) A deer. E. षम to be confused, aff. ऊर.
40846: समूरु m. (-रुः) A deer, one of the sorts of which the skin may be used as a student's seat, &c. E. षम to be confused, ऊरु aff.; also with कन् added समूरुक. According to some, this sort of deer is distinguished by a white mane.
40847: समूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having a root, joined or in connexion with the root. E. स with, मूल a root.
40848: समूलघात n. (-तं) Utter destruction or eradication. E. समूल radical, घातं killing.
40849: समूह m. (-हः) Assemblage, aggregate in general, heap, number, multitude, quantity, &c. E. सम् together, ऊह to reason, or वह to bear, घञ् aff.
40850: समूहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Interests or business of a number, general affair. E. समूह, and कार्य्य affair.
40851: समूहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Collecting, gathering. E. सम् before वह to bear, aff. शतृ.
40852: समूहनी f. (-नी) A broom. E. समूह heap (of dirt), णी to take, aff. ड and ङीष्.
40853: समूह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be assembled or collected. m. (-ह्यः) 1 Sacrificial fire. 2 A place prepared for the reception of a sacrificial fire. ind. Having collected. E. सम् completely, वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क्यप् or ल्यप्.
40854: समृद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Happy, prosperous, thriving. 2 Grown, encreased, augmented. 3 Flourishing. 4 Full, entire. 5 Accelerated. E. सम् completely, ऋद्ध to increase, aff. क्त.
40855: समृद्धवेग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Very swift. E. समृद्ध, and वेग speed.
40856: समृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Thriving, increase. 2 Prosperity, success. 3 Power, supremacy, sway. E. सम् completely, ऋध to increase, aff. क्तिन्.
