40857: समेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Near, approximated, approached. 2 Agreed, covenanted. 3 Collected, associated. 4 Having, possessed of. E. सम् with, इत gone.
40858: समेधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Increased, augmented. E. सम् before एधित increased.
40859: समोदक n. (-कं) A mixture of half butter milk and half water E. सम equal, and उदक water.
40860: सम्प m. (-म्पः) Descending, falling, alighting. f. (-म्पा) Lightning. E. सम्, and पत to fall, aff. ड.
40861: सम्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Prosperity, success, increase of wealth, power, or happiness. 2 A sort of medicinal root. E. सम् implying perfection, पद to go, aff. क्तिन्; also सम्पट्.
40862: सम्पद् f. (-पत् or पट्) 1 Success, prosperity, increase of any favourable kind, or of wealth, fame, power, &c. 2 Advancement in good qualities, perfection, excellence. 3 A necklace of pearls, &c. E. सम् before पट् to go, aff. क्विप्.
40863: सम्पद n. (-दं) Standing with the feet even. E. सम् together, and पद a foot.
40864: सम्पद्धर m. (-रः) A king, a prince. E. सम् before पद to go, ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.
40865: सम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Accomplished, completed, effected, obtained. 2 Prosperous, fortunate, thriving, happy. 3 Possessed of, endowed with. 4 Mature, full grown. 5 Perfectly acquainted with or performing, (duty, &c.) E. सम् with, पद to go, aff. क्त; also with कन् aff. सम्पन्नक.
40866: सम्पराय m. (-यः) 1 Calamity, adversity. 2 Futurity. 3 War, battle. 4 A son. E. सम् and पर before इण् to go, नच् aff.
40867: सम्परायक n. (-कं) War, battle. E. कन् added to the last.
40868: सम्परायिक m. (-कं) War, battle. E. सम्पराय war, ठन् aff.; also सम्परायक.
40869: सम्परिशोषण n. (-णं) A withering or drying up. E. सम्, and परि implying entirely, शोषण drying.
40870: सम्पर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 Mixture, mingling, contact, union, junction. 2 Copulation. E. सम् with, वृच to be in contact, aff. अच्.
40871: सम्पर्क्किन् mfn. (-र्क्की-र्क्किणी-र्क्कि) 1 Mixed, blended. 2 Connected or united with. 3 In contact with. E. सम् together, पृच् to be in contact, घिनुण् aff.
40872: सम्पर्कीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Liable to come in contact, relating to contact or connexion. E. सम्पर्क, and छ aff.
40873: सम्पश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Seeing, beholding. E. सम् before दृश to see, शतृ aff.
40874: सम्पाक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Reasoning, a reasoner, a logician. 2 Impudent, shameless. 3 Small, little, low. 4 Lecherous, libertine. m. (-कः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. सम् completely, पाक ripening or maturing; also शम्पाक.
40875: सम्पाट m. (-टः) 1 A spindle. 2 The intersection of the prolonged side of a triangle by the perpendicular. E. सम् before पट to go, aff. घञ्.
40876: सम्पात m. (-तः) 1 Descending, falling, coming down. 2 Alighting, (as a bird.) 3 Going, moving. 4 The son of GARUḌA. E. सम् before पत to alight, aff. घञ्.
40877: सम्पाति m. (-तिः) The son of GARUḌA, a fabulous bird. E. सम्, पा intensitive, to cherish or drink, अति Uṇādi aff.
40878: सम्पातिक m. (-कः) The eldest son of GARUḌA, and like him a sort of fabulous and supernatural bird. E. कन् added to the last.
40879: सम्पादक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what fulfils, accomplished, &c. E. सम् before पद to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
40880: सम्पादन n. (-नं) 1 Gaining, acquiring, reaching, attaining. 2 Accomplishing, effecting. E. सम् before पद to go, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
40881: सम्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Attained, obtained, gained, gotten. 2 Effected, accomplished. E. सम् before पद to go, causal form, aff. क्त.
40882: सम्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Pounded, bruised, crushed, destroyed. E. सम्, and पिष्ट ground.
40883: सम्पीड m. (-डः) 1 Agitating, disturbing. 2 Sending, directing. 3 Pain, torture. E. सम् before पीड to give pain to, &c., aff. अच्.
40884: सम्पीडन n. (-नं) 1 Castigation, punishment. 2 Agitating. 3 Sending. 4 Pressing, squeezing. E. सम् before पीड to give pain, ल्युट् aff.
40885: सम्पीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pained, tortured. 2 Punished. 3 Agitated. 4 Sent. 5 Pressed, squeezed. E. सम् before पीड to pain, क्त aff.
40886: सम्पीति f. (-तिः) Drinking in company. E. सम् together, पा to drink, क्तिन् aff.
40887: सम्पुट m. (-टः) 1 A casket, a covered box. 2 A flower; also Kuruvaka. E. सम् together, पुट to contract, aff. क.
40888: सम्पुटक m. (-कः) A casket. E. सम् with पुट to contract, aff. क, and कन् added.
40889: सम्पूजन n. (-नं) Treating with great respect. E. सम्, and पूज to worship, ल्युट् aff.
40890: सम्पूजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be, what may or ought to be respected, &c. E. सम्, and पूज to respect, अनीयर् aff.; also सम्पूजितव्य and सम्पूज्य.
40891: सम्पूजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Honoured, respected. E. सम्, and पूजित worshipped.
40892: सम्पूर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Whole, entire. 2 Complete, finished. m. (-र्णः) Any mode of music in which all the notes of the gamut are employed. n. (-र्णं) Æther, the etherial matter or atmosphere. E. सम् intensitive, and पूर्ण full, finished.
40893: सम्पूर्णता f. (-ता) Fulness, completion. E. सम्पूर्ण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, सम्पूर्णत्वं.
40894: सम्पृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Mixed, blended, combined, inlaid, interspersed. 2 Joined, untied. 3 Close to, in contact with. E. सम् together, पृच to be in contact, aff. क्त.
40895: सम्प्रकॢप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Possessed of, having. E. सम् and प्र before कॢप्त made.
40896: सम्प्रणर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bellowed. E. सम् and प्र before नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.
40897: सम्प्रणीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought, conveyed. E. सम् and प्र before णी to take, क्त aff.
40898: सम्प्रणेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what guides, leads, &c. m. (-ता) A judge, a ruler. E. सम् and प्र before णी to get, तृच् aff.
40899: सम्प्रतापन n. (-नं) 1 Heating, burning. 2 Afflicting. 3 One of the twenty-one hells. E. सम् and प्र before तप to heat, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
40900: सम्प्रति ind. Now, at present, at this time. m. (-तिः) A Jina or Jaina pontiff, of the last era. E. सम्, and प्रति with respect to, &c. conjoined.
40901: सम्प्रतिपत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Agreed, convened, consentient. f. (-त्तिः) 1 Assent, concurrence. 2 Admission, acknowledgment, confession. 3 Agreement. 4 Co-operation. 5 Presence, company. 6 Assault. 7 Doing, performing, effecting. E. सम् together, प्रतिपत्ति agreement, assent.
40902: सम्प्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Done, performed. 2 Come, arrived. 3 Agreed, concurred. 4 Attached. E. सम् and प्रति before पद to go, क्त aff.
40903: सम्प्रतिरोधक n. (-कः) Durance, actual confinement or restraint. E. सम्प्रति present, रोधक what restricts.
40904: सम्प्रतीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Expecting, awaiting. E. सम् and प्रति before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.
40905: सम्प्रतीति f. (-तिः) Fame, notoriety. E. सम् before प्रतीति the same.
40906: सम्प्रदान n. (-नं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 (In grammar,) The dative case. E. सम् and प्र before दा to give, ल्युट् aff.
40907: सम्प्रदाय m. (-यः) 1 Traditional doctrine, what has been transmitted from one teacher to another, and is established as of sacred authority. 2 A sect, a schism, a peculiar doctrine and exclusive worship of one divinity. E. सम् and प्र before दा to give, घञ् aff., and युक् augment.
40908: सम्प्रधान n. (-नं) Consideration, ascertainment. E. सम् and प्र before धा to have, ल्युट् aff.
40909: सम्प्रधारणा nf. (-णं-णा) Determination, deliberation, the determining on the propriety or impropriety of any thing. E. सम् and प्र before धृ to have or hold, causal form, aff. युच्.
40910: सम्प्रपद n. (-दं) Roaming, peregrination. E. सम् and प्र before पद to go, aff. अच्.
40911: सम्प्रयाण n. (-णं) Departure. E. सम् and प्र before या to go, ल्युट् aff.
40912: सम्प्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Acquainted or connected with. 2 Joined, united with, &c. E. सम् and प्र before युज to join, क्त aff.
40913: सम्प्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Connexion, relation, mutual proportion, dependance or association. 2 Order, natural and connected series or arrangement. 3 Copulation. 4 Union, joining. 5 Magic. E. सम् and प्र before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
40914: सम्प्रयोगिन् m. (गी) 1 A libertine, a lecher. 2 A catamite. 3 A joiner or uniter, any one who effects a union or connexion. 4 A conjuror. E. सम्प्रयोग union in general, or coition, aff. इनि.
40915: सम्प्रवदन n. (-नं) Conversation, talking together. E. सम् and प्र before वद to speak, ल्युट् aff.
40916: सम्प्रश्न m. (-श्नः) Asking, enquiring civilly. E. सम्, and प्रश्न asking.
40917: सम्प्रवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Passed, gone by. E. सम् and प्र before वृत्त been.
40918: सम्प्रसाद n. (-दं) Trust, confidence. E. सम् and प्र before सद to go, घञ् aff.
40919: सम्प्रसाधन n. (-नं) Effecting, accomplishing, performing well or completely. E. सम् and प्र before साध to accomplish, ल्युट् aff.
40920: सम्प्रसारण n. (-णं) The mutual substitution of the letters इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ, and their respective semivowels, ब, य, र, and स्न. E. सम् and प्र before सृ to go, causal form, aff. ल्यट्.
40921: सम्प्रस्थान n. (-नं) Setting out on a journey. E. सम् and प्र before स्था to stay, ल्युट् aff.
40922: सम्प्रस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set forth, gone on a journey. E. सम् and प्र before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
40923: सम्प्रहार m. (-रः) 1 War, battle. 2 Striking, wounding, killing. 3 Going, motion. E. सम् and प्र before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
40924: सम्प्रहास n. (-सं) 1 Laughter. 2 Joy. E. सम् and प्र before हस to laugh, घञ् aff.
40925: सम्प्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Attained, obtained, gotten. 2 Effected, accomplished. 3 Become. 4 Arrived, come. E. सम् and प्राप्त obtained.
40926: सम्प्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining, getting, acquisition. E. सम् before प्राप्ति obtaining.
40927: सम्प्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well pleased, delighted. E. सम्, and प्रीत liking.
40928: सम्प्रीति f. (-तिः) 1 Attachment, affection. 2 Delight. E. सम् before प्रीति affection.
40929: सम्प्रेक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Deliberating, considering, investigating. 2 Looking at, seeing. E. सम् and प्र before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
40930: सम्प्रेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Considered, investigated. 2 Seen, beheld. E. सम् and प्र before ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.
40931: सम्प्रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sent, ordered. 2 Dismissed, sent away. E. सम् before प्रेषित sent.
40932: सम्प्रैष m. (-षः) 1 Ordering, commanding, directing. 2 Dismissing, sending away. E. सम् and प्र before इष to go, aff. घञ्.
40933: सम्प्रोक्षण n. (-णं) 1 Sprinkling. 2 Consecrating a temple. E. सम and प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, ल्युट् aff.; see प्रोक्षण.
40934: सम्प्रोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sprinkled, wetted, (especially with holy water.) 2 Consecrated. E. सम् and प्र before उक्ष to sprinkle, क्त aff.
40935: सम्प्लव m. (-वः) 1 Falling in various directions. 2 Submerging, inundation. E. सम्, and प्लु to go, अच् aff.
40936: सम्फाल m. (-लः) A ram. E. सम् before फल to bear fruit, aff. ण.
40937: सम्फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Blown, blossomed, opened, (as a flower.) E. सम् completely, and फुल्ल blown.
40938: सम्फेट m. (-टः) (In dramatic language) Wrathful encounter, defiance, combat.
40939: सम्ब r. 1st cl. (सम्बति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (सम्बयति) To unite, to join, to connect or collect; also षम्ब.
40940: सम्ब n. (-म्बं) 1 Water. 2 Twice ploughing. E. सम्ब to go, aff. अच्.
40941: सम्बद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Connected with, endowed with, possessing as a predicate or property. 2 Bound, tied, attached. E. सम् with, बन्ध to bind, aff. क्त.
40942: सम्बन्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) 1 Able, capable. 2 Fit, right, proper. 3 Adjunct, annexed or connected, inherent, &c. m. (-न्धः) 1 Prosperity, success. 2 Fitness, propriety. 3 Connexion, natural or essential connexion, as of a property with a substance, subject matter with a work, proper meaning with a word, &c. 4 Connexion by birth or marriage, relationship. 5 The application of authority, as of the Upaniṣads to prove a theological assertion, &c. 6 Mental association of objects, conceiving them in connexion with each other. 7 (In grammar,) The possessive case. E. सम् with, and बन्ध a binding.
40943: सम्बन्धक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to, concerning. E. कन् added to the last.
40944: सम्बन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) 1 Possessing good qualities, learned, amiable, liberal, &c. 2 Having adjoined or connected with, inherent. 3 Related to, a relation, a connexion. 4 Connected with, belonging or relating to. E. सम्बन्ध connexion, and इनि aff.
40945: सम्बर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Restraint, forbearance, self-controul. 3 A religious observance of the Bauddhas. m. (-रः) 1 The name of a demon or Daitya. 2 A deer. 3 A sort of fish. 4 A mountain. 5 A Jina, one of the pontiffs of the future age. 6 A kind of dramatic entertainment. 7 A bridge, a dam, a causeway. f. (-री) 1 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) 2 A medicinal plant, (Salvinia cucullata.) E. सम्ब to accumulate, अरच् aff.; also शम्बर and सम्बर.
40946: सम्बल mn. (-लः-लं) Provender or stock for travelling expences. n. (-लं) Water. E. षम्ब to go, aff. अलच्; also शम्बल.
40947: सम्बाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed. E. सम्ब a second ploughing, कृत made, डाच् augment; also शम्बाकृत.
40948: सम्बाध adj. m. only, but having the three genders when the last term of a compound adjective. (-धः) 1 Narrow, contracted, impassible, either from being naturally confined, or from being blocked up or crowded. 2 Crowded. Subst. 1 The vulva. 2 The road to tartarus or hell. 3 Fear, dread. E. सम् before बाध to impede, aff. अच्.
40949: सम्बाधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Crowding, contracting, pressing upon. E. सम् before बाध to obstruct, ण्वुल् aff.
40950: सम्बाधन n. (-नं) 1 A gate, a barrier. 2 The point of a stake or spit. 3 A door-keeper. 4 Obstructing, opposing. E. सम् before बाध to impede, aff. ल्युट्.
40951: सम्बुद्ध m. (-द्धः) A Jaina deified sage. E. सम् implying perfection, and बुद्ध wise.
40952: सम्बुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Calling or calling to. 2 An epithet. 3 The vocative case. E. सम् with बुध to know, aff. क्तिन्.
40953: सम्बोध m. (-धः) 1 Explaining, instructing, informing. 2 Throwing, sending. 3 Loss, destruction. E. सम् completely, बुध to know, causal form, aff. अच्.
40954: सम्बोधन n. (-नं) 1 Calling, addressing, calling to. 2 The vocative case, (in grammar.) E. सम्, and बुध to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
40955: सम्भली f. (-ली) A bawd, a procuress. E. सम् with, भल to speak, affs. अच् and ङीष्; also शम्भली.
40956: सम्भव m. (-वः) 1 Cause, origin, motive. 2 Birth, production. 3 Mixing, union, combination. 4 Capacity, appropriateness, adaptation, the conformity of the receptacle to the thing received, or supported to the thing supported. 5 Agreement, engagement. 6 Loss, destruction. 7 Acquaintance, intimacy. 8 Possibility. 9 Ability, adequacy. 10 Consistency, compatibility. 11 The third Jina of the present age. E. सम् implying perfection or co-existence, and भव being.
40957: सम्भव्य m. (-व्यः) The wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium.) E. सम् with, भव being, यत् aff.
40958: सम्भार m. (-रः) 1 Multitude, number, quantity, heap, assemblage. 2 Maintaining, supporting. 3 Provision, preparation, getting  every thing ready or complete. 4 Fulness, completion. 5 Apparatus, necessaries, things required for any act or affair. E. सम् before भृ to maintain, aff. घञ्.
40959: सम्भार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be nourished, a dependant. E. सम्, and भॄ to nourish, ण्यत् aff.
40960: सम्भावन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Considering, reflecting. 2 Fame, celebrity. 3 Fitness, suitableness. 4 Adequacy, competency, ability. 5 Possibility. 5 Worship, honour. 7 (In grammar,) The sense of the potential mood. 8 (In rhetoric,) The use of the verb in the imperative or potential mood. 9 (In Logic,) Doubt. E. सम् before भू to be, causal form, aff. युच्.
40961: सम्भावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Equal or adequate to, suited to or fit for. 2 Possible. 3 Considered, reflected. 4 Satisfied or occupied with. E. सम् with, भू to be, &c., causal form, aff. क्त.
40962: सम्भावितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Noble-minded. E. सम्भावित equal, आत्मन् self.
40963: सम्भाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Suitable, to be adapted to, made, or fit for. E. सम्, and भू to be, causal v., यत् aff. also सम्भावनीय, &c.
40964: सम्भाषण n. (-णं) 1 Conversation, discourse. 2 War-cry, watchword. E. सम् together, भाषण speaking.
40965: सम्भाषा f. (-षा) 1 War-cry, watch-word. 2 Conversation, discourse. 3 Contract, agreement. E. सम् together, भाषा speech.
40966: सम्भाषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said, spoken. 2 Spoken to, addressed. E. सम् before भाष to speak, क्त aff.
40967: सम्भिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Shaken, agitated. 2 Divided, broken. 3 Combined or united with. E. सम्, and भिन्न broken.
40968: सम्भु m. (-म्भुः) A parent, a progenitor. E. सम् with भू to be, डु aff.
40969: सम्भुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Bent, curved. E. सम्, and भुग्न bent.
40970: सम्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born, produced. 2 Equal, adequate. 3 Combined with, being together. E. सम् with, भू to be, aff. क्त.
40971: सम्भूतविजय m. (-यः) A sacred person peculiar to the Jainas.
40972: सम्भूति f. (-तिः) 1 Birth, production. 2 Combination. 3 Power. E. सम्, and भू to be, क्तिन् aff.
40973: सम्भूय ind. Having united or combined. E. सम् together, भू to be, ल्यप् aff.
40974: सम्भूयकारिन् m. (-री) A coadjutor, copartner, or colleague. E. सम्भूय, and कारिन् who acts.
40975: सम्भूयसमुत्थान n. (-नं) Partnership, association in trade, joint execution of work or conduct of business. E. सम्भूय, and समुत्थान performance of work.
40976: सम्भृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Collected, assembled. 2 Gained, got, possessed of. 3 Filled, full. 4 Complete, ready, prepared. 5 Nourished, maintained. E. सम् before भृ to nourish, &c. aff. क्त.
40977: सम्भृति f. (-तिः) 1 Nourishment, support. 2 Plenitude, fulness. 3 Preparation, provision. E. सम्, and भृ to possess, aff. क्तिन्, see the last.
40978: सम्भृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be nourished. E. सम्, and भृ to nourish, aff. क्यप्.
40979: सम्भेट् m. (-टः) 1 The confluence of two rivers, or the junction of a river with the sea. 2 Breaking, splitting, bursting. 3 Union, junction. E. सम् with, भिट् to break, aff. घञ्.
40980: सम्भोग m. (-गः) 1 Enjoyment, pleasure, delight. 2 Coition, copulation. 3 A Jaina or Bauddha Śasana or edict, &c. 4 One branch of the Śṛṅgāra rasa, or sentiment of love, happy or successful love, meeting or union of lovers. 5 A catamite. 6 Use, employment. E. सम् with, भोग enjoyment.
40981: सम्भोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) 1 Sensual, sensualist, &c. 2 Enjoying, as pleasure or property. m. (-गी) A catamite. E. सम्भोग enjoyment, इनि aff.
40982: सम्भोजन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Convivial, friendly, (as a dinner, &c.) n. (-नं) A meal, &c. partaken together, a convivial party. E. सम् together, भुज to enjoy, ल्युट् aff.
40983: सम्भ्रम m. (-मः) 1 Haste, hurry. 2 Fear, terror. 3 Flurry, confusion, haste or hurry arising from joy, fear, &c. 4 Error, ignorance. 5 Turning round, whirling, revolving. 6 Respect, reverence. E. सम् before भ्रम to revolve, &c., aff. अच्.
40984: सम्भ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Bewildered, agitated. 2 Flurried. E. सम्, and भ्रम to err, क्त aff.
40985: सम्मत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Assented or agreed to, concurred in, approved of. 2 Conformable to. 3 Attached to. E. सम्, and मन to mind, क्त aff.
40986: सम्मति f. (-तिः) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Order, command. 3 Agreement, assent, similarity of opinion, or purpose. 4 Approbation. 5 Self or real knowledge. 6 Regard, affection, love. 7 Respect, homage. E. सम् implying union or perfection, and मति mind, understanding.
40987: सम्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Happy, glad. m. (-दः) Happiness, joy, pleasure. E. सम् with, मट् to delight, aff. अप्.
40988: सम्मर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Trampling or treading on. 2 Friction, rubbing. 3 War, battle. E. सम् together, मृद् to trample, aff. अच्.
40989: सम्मर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिनी-र्द्दि) 1 Trampling. 2 Rubbing. E. सम्मर्द्द, and इनि aff.
40990: सम्मातुर m. (-रः) The son of a virtuous woman. E. सत् good, मातृ a mother, अण् aff.
40991: सम्माद m. (-दः) Phrensy, intoxication. E. सम् intensitive, मद to be mad, aff. घञ्.
40992: सम्मान n. (-नं) 1 Respect, homage. 2 Measure. E. सम्, and मन to respect, with घञ् aff., or मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्.
40993: सम्मानन n. (-नं) Worship, homage. E. सम् intensitive, मन to respect, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
40994: सम्मानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Treated with reverence or respect. E. सम् before मन to respect, causal v., क्त aff.
40995: सम्मान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Respectable, honourable. E. सम्मन् to respect, ण्यत् aff.
40996: सम्मार्जक m. (-कः) A sweeper. E. सम् completely, मृज to clean, ण्वुल् aff.
40997: सम्मार्जन n. (-नं) Sweeping, brushing, cleaning. f. (-नी) A broom. E. सम् before मृज to clean, aff. ल्युट्.
40998: सम्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Like, similar, same. 2 Of equal measure or extent. 3 Meted, measured. E. सम् with, मित measured, compared.
40999: सम्मिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Mixed, mingled, blended, joined. E. सम् together, and मिश्र mixed.
41000: सम्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा or -खी-खं) Encountering, facing, in front of. E. सम् with, मुख the face.
41001: सम्मुखिन् m. (-खी) A mirror. E. सम् with, मुख the face, इनि aff.
41002: सम्मुखीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Before, in front or in face of. E. सम्मुख the same, and ख aff.
41003: सम्मुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Fascinated, bewildered. 2 Stupified, astounded. 3 Beautiful. E. सम् before मुह to fascinate, क्त aff.
41004: सम्मूढ mfn. (-ढः-टा-ढं) 1 Heaped, accumulated. 2 Produced rapidly. 3 Broken. 4 Foolish, ignorant, senseless. 5 Bewildered, beguiled. 6 Stupified, astounded. E. सम् entirely, मुह to be foolish, and क्त aff.
41005: सम्मूढचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Foolish, infatuated. E. सम्मूढ, and चेतस् the mind.
41006: सम्मूर्च्छन n. (-नं) 1 Uniform or universal expansion or permeation, pervading, co-extension. 2 Height, elevation. 3 Fainting, insensibility. 4 Increasing, augmenting. E. सम् before मूर्च्छ to faint, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
41007: सम्मूर्च्छनोद्भव m. (-वः) A fish or aquatic animal. E. सम्मूर्च्छन insensibility, उद्भव produced.
41008: सम्मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, deceased. E. सम्, and मृत dead.
41009: सम्मृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Strained, filtered. 2 Cleaned, cleansed. 3 Swept. E. सम् completely, मृष्ट cleansed.
41010: सम्मोद m. (-दः) 1 Pleasure, delight. E. सम् intensitive, मुद to be happy, aff. घञ्.
41011: सम्मोह m. (-हः) 1 Ignorance. 2 Folly. 3 Beguilement, fascination. 4 Stupefaction. 5 Fainting. E. सम् before मुह to be foolish, घञ् aff.
41012: सम्मोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Beguiled, fascinated. 2 Enraptured, overcome with delight, &c. E. सम् before मुह to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
41013: सम्यक् ind. 1 All, wholly. 2 Properly, fitly, in the right manner: see सम्यच्.
41014: सम्यक्त्व n. (-त्वं) Accuracy, totality. E. सम्यक्, and त्व aff.
41015: सम्यक्दण्डन n. (-नं) Inflicting the penalty of the law, punishing in a legal manner. E. सम्यक् properly, according to the Śāstras, and दण्डन punishing.
41016: सम्यच् or सम्यञ्च् mfn. (सम्यङ् समीची सम्यक्) 1 True, right. 2 Accompanying, going with. 3 Pleasant, agreeable. 4 Same, common, identical, uniform. 5 Accurate, correct. 6 All, entire. E. सम् with, अञ्च to go, क्विन् aff.
41017: सम्यगुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Of equal weight or authority, (a precept.) E. सम्यक् proper, उक्त said.
41018: सम्यग्वर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Continuing in the discharge of duty, &c. E. सम्यक्, and वर्त्तमान being.
41019: सम्यग्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Steady and regular discharge of prescribed duties. E. सम्यक्, and वृत्ति practice.
41020: सम्राज् m. (-राट्) A paramount sovereign, one who rules-over other princes, and has performed the Rājasūya sacrifice. E. सम् all, राजृ to rule, aff. क्विप्.
41021: सयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Endeavouring, taking pains. n. adv. (-त्नं) Vigorously, assiduously. E. स with, यत्न effort.
41022: सयोनि m. (-निः) 1 INDRA. 2 Proximity to a wife. 3 A pair of nippers for cutting betel-nut. E. स for सह with, or सम् like, and योनि pudendum muliebre.
41023: सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what goes, occurring chiefly in composition, as अनुसर, अवसर, &c. m. (-रः) 1 The thick part or coagulum of curds or milk, cream, &c. 2 Going, motion. 3 An arrow. 4 Saltness, salt. n. (-रं) 1 A lake, a pool. 2 Water. mf. (-रः-रा) or री) A cascade, a water-fall; also शर. E. सृ to go, aff. अप्.
41024: सरःकाक m. (-कः) A gander. f. (-की) A goose. E. सरस् a pool, and काक a crow.
41025: सरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Going, moving, proceeding. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 Spirituous liquor, especially distilled from sugar, rum. 2 Drinking spirits. 3 A drinking vessel. 4 Distribution of liquor. 5 A continuous line of road. n. (-कं) 1 A lake, a pool. 2 Heaven, sky. E. सृ to go, Uṇādi. aff. वुन्.
41026: सरघा f. (-घा) A bee. E. सर one who is going, हन् to injure, aff. ड, and the radical final changed.
41027: सरज n. (-जं) Fresh butter. E. सर cream, and ज produced.
41028: सरजस् f. (-जाः) A woman during menstruation. E. स for सह with, रजस् the menses.
41029: सरट् m. (-ट्) 1 Air, wind. 2 A cloud. 3 (In the language of the Vedas,) A bee. 4 A lizard, a chameleon. E. सृ to go, अटि Uṇādi aff.
41030: सरट m. (-टः) A lizard, a chameleon, a guana, &c. E. सृ to go, अटन् aff.; also शरट.
41031: सरटि m. (-टिः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A cloud. E. सृ to go, अटिन् Uṇādi aff.
41032: सरटु n. (-टुः) A lizard, a chameleon, &c. E. सृ to go, अटु aff.
41033: सरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Going, moving, who or what goes or moves. n. (-णं) 1 Oxidized iron, either in the state of rust or filings. 2 Going, proceeding. f. (-णा or णी) 1 A plant, (Pæderia fetida.) 2 A sort of Teori. E. सृ to go, aff. युच्, or ल्युट् fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्; also शरण, &c.
41034: सरणि f. (-णिः-णी) 1 A road, a path, a way. 2 A straight or continuous line. 3 A disease of the throat. E. सृ to go, Uṇādi aff. अनि, and ङीष् optionally added; also शरणि, &c.
41035: सरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A rogue, a cheat. 2 A sort of ornament. 3 A bird. E. सृ to go, Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्, more usually शरण्ड.
41036: सरण्यु m. (-ण्युः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A cloud. 3 Water. E. सृ to go, अन्यु Uṇādi aff.
41037: सरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Going, proceeding. E. सृ to go, शतृ aff.
41038: सरत् m. (-रत्) Thread. E. सृ to go, अति aff.
41039: सरत्नि mf. (-त्निः-त्निः) A short cubit. E. सृ to go, कत्निच् aff.; more commonly रत्नि, q. v.
41040: सरपत्रिका f. (-का) The new leaf of a lotus.
41041: सरभस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Quick, speedy. 2 Delighted. 3 Agitated, distressed. n. adv. (-सं) Quickly, delightedly, agitatedly, &c. E. स with, रभस speed, &c.
41042: सरमा f. (-मा) 1 The wife of RĀVAṆA'S brother. 2 A bitch. E. सृ to go, अम aff., or स with रम sport, pleasure.
41043: सरयु m. (-युः) Air, wind. f. (-युः-यूः) The Sarju or Saryu river. E. सृ to go, अयु Uṇādi aff.: also शरयु.
41044: सरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Honest, sincere, candid, upright. 2 Straight. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of pine, (Pinus longifolia.) 2 A bird, (Pavo bicalcarata.) f. (-ला) A variety of the plant called Teori. E. सृ to go, (to spread fragrance abroad, &.,) कल Uṇādi aff.
41045: सरलद्रव m. (-वः) A fragrant resin, the exudation of the Saral or pine tree. E. सरल as above, द्रव what exudes.
41046: सरलयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Going in a straight line. 2 Upright, honest. f. (-नी) A plant with an upright stem. E. सरल, and यायिन् who or what goes or grows.
41047: सरव्य n. (-व्यं) A butt or mark for shooting at. E. सर an arrow, व्येञ् to cover, aff. ड; also शरव्य.
41048: सरस् nf. (-रः-सी) 1 A large pond or pool. 2 A piece of water in which the lotus grows or may grow. n. (-रः) Water. E. सृ to go (into, to bathe or drink), असुन् Uṇādi aff.
41049: सरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Tasty, juicy, sapid. 2 Comprising the expression of the poetical Rasas or sentiments, (a work, &c.) 3 Impassioned. n. (-सं) A tank, a pond, a lake. f. (-सा) A sort of Teori. E. स with, रस juice.
41050: सरसम्प्रत n. (-तं) A sort of Euphorbia, commonly Tiṅkātā Sij.
41051: सरसिक m. (-कः) The Indian crane. E. सरस a pool, ठन् aff.
41052: सरसिज n. (-जं) A lotus. E. सरस् a pool, (seventh case,) and ज born.
41053: सरसीरुह n. (-हः) A lotus. E. सरसी a pool, and रुह what grows.
41054: सरस्तीर n. (-रं) The bank of a lake or pond. E. सरस्, and तीर bank.
41055: सरस्वत् mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) 1 Juicy, sapid. 2 Elegant. 3 Sentimental. m. (-स्वान्) 1 The ocean. 2 A male river. 3 A buffalo. f. (-स्वती) 1 The wife of BRAHMĀ, the goddess of speech and eloquence, the patroness of music and the arts, and the inventress of the Sanscrit language and Devanāgarī letters. 2 Speech, the faculty or its exercise. 3 A river, the Sarsooty, which rises in the mountains bounding the north-east part of the province of Dehli, whence it runs in a south-westerly direction, and is lost in the sands of the great desart in the country of the Bhatti; according to the Hindus the river only disappears in this place, and continuing its course under ground, joins the Ganges and Jumna at Allahabad. 4 A river in general. 5 An excellent woman. 6 A crow, 7 The wife of a Muni. 8 A female divinity, peculiar to the Jainas. 9 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) E. सरस् a lake, and मतुप् poss. aff., or स with, रस flavour, taste, and the same aff.
41056: सराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Coloured, tinted. 2 Impassioned. E. स with, राग colour, &c.
41057: सराव m. (-वः) A lid, or a shallow cup or saucer, used as one: see शराव.
41058: सरि mf. (-रिः-री) A waterfall. E. सृ to go, इन् aff.; also सर, &c.
41059: सरिका f. (-का) 1 A drug, commonly Hingupatri. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 A woman going, or moving. E. सृ to go, वुन् aff. fem. form.
41060: सरित् f. (-रित्) 1 A river in general. 2 Thread. E. सृ to go, इति Uṇādi aff.
41061: सरिताम्पति m. (-तिः) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, (second case plural,) and पति lord.
41062: सरित्पति m. (-तिः) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, and पति lord.
41063: सरित्वत् m. (-त्वान्) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, and मतुप् poss. aff.
41064: सरित्सुत m. (-तः) BHĪṢMA, the son of GAṄGĀ. E. सरित् the river, and सुत son.
41065: सरिद्वरा f. (-रा) The Ganges. E. सरित् a river, and वर best.
41066: सरिन्नाथ m. (-थः) The ocean. E. सरित् a river, and नाथ lord.
41067: सरिन्मुख n. (-खं) The source of a river. E. सरित्, and मुख face.
41068: सरिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 Air, wind. E. सृ to go, इमनिन् Uṇādi aff.
41069: सरिल n. (-लं) Water. E. see सलिल, the ल being changed to र.
41071: सरीसृप m. (-पः) A snake. E. सृप to go, irr. reiterative form, and अच् aff.
41072: सरु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Thin, small, fine, minute. m. (-रुः) The hilt or handle of a sword, &c. E. सृ to go, उ aff.
41073: सरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Like, resembling. E. स for समान like, same, रूप form.
41074: सरूपता f. (-ता) Likeness, resemblance. E. सरूप like, तल् aff. of the abstract; also सरूपत्व n. (-त्वं).
41075: सरोग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Sick, diseased. E. स, and रोग sickness.
41076: सरोगिता f. (-ता) Sickness, disease. E. स, and रोगिता sickness.
41077: सरोज n. (-जं) A lotus. m. (-जः) A foot (in Prosody,) of six long instants. E. सरस् a pond, and ज born.
41078: सरोजन्मन् n. (-न्म) A lotus. E. सरस् a pond, and जन्मन् birth.
41079: सरोजल n. (-लं) The water of a pond or lake. E. सरस् a pond, and जल water.
41080: सरोजिन् m. (-जी) BRAHMĀ. f. (-नी) 1 A lotus. 2 A pond abounding in lotuses. 3 A multitude of lotuses. E. सरोज a lotus, and इनि aff.
41081: सरोत्सव m. (-वः) The Indian crane. E. सर water, उत्सव pleasure, delight.
41082: सरोध m. (-धः) 1 Loss, destruction. 2 Opposition, obstruction. E. स for सह with, रोघ hindrance.
41083: सरोरुह् n. (-रुट्) A lotus. E. सरस् a pond, and रुह् what grows; also with a final vowel सरोरुह n. (-हं)
41084: सरोरुहासन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ. E. सरोरुह a lotus, and आसन a seat; first appearing from the interior of a lotus in order to create the world; the flower is supposed to have sprung from the navel of VIṢṆU.
41085: सरोवर m. (-रः) A lake or large pond, any piece of water deep enough for the lotus to grow. E. सरम् a pool, and वर best.
41086: सरोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Angry, wrathful. n. adv. (-षं) Angrily. E. स with, रोष wrath.
41087: सर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 Nature, natural property or disposition. 2 Tendency of a thing. 3 Creation. 4 Effort, perseverance. 5 Assent, agreement. 6 Relinquishment, abandoning, letting go or getting rid of. 7 Voiding, as excrement. 8 A chapter, a book, a section. 9 Certainty, ascertainment. E. सृज to quit, &c., aff. घञ्.
41088: सर्गबन्ध m. (-न्धः) A principal or great poem, one comprising many Sargas or Cantos. E. सर्ग a section, and बन्ध a binding.
41089: सर्ज्ज r. 1st cl. (सर्ज्जति) To gain or get.
41090: सर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) 1 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) 2 Another tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 3 The resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सृज to quit, aff. घञ्, and the final consonant unchanged.
41091: सर्ज्जक m. (-कः) 1 The Pentaptera arjuna. 2 The Śāl tree. f. (-र्जिका) 1 Natron, alkali. 2 Borax. E. वुन् added to the last.
41092: सर्ज्जगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, commonly Rasan, supposed to be the serpent Ophioxylon. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl tree, गन्ध smell.
41093: सर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 The reserve or rear of an army. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 3 Voiding, as excrement. 4 Making, creating. E. सृज to abandon, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
41094: सर्ज्जमणि m. (-णिः) Resin in general, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl, and मणि a jewel.
41095: सर्ज्जरस m. (-सः) Resin in general, or the resinous exudation of the Śāl tree. E. सर्ज्ज the Śāl, and रम juice.
41096: सर्ज्जि f. (-र्ज्जिः) Natron, alkali. E. सृज to abandon, इनि aff.
41097: सर्ज्जिका f. (-का) Natron, alkali, or the impure carbonate of soda, commonly termed Sejji Mitti or Sejji earth, and used in India as a soap for cleaning linen, &c. E. सर्ज्जि the same, and कन् added, fem. form.
41098: सर्ज्जिकाक्षार m. (-रः) Impure carbonate of soda, alkali, natron. E. सर्ज्जिका the same, and क्षार ashes; also स्वर्ज्जिकाक्षार.
41099: सर्ज्जू m. (-र्ज्जूः) A trader. f. (-र्ज्जूः) 1 Lightning. 2 A necklace. 3 Going, following. E. सर्ज्ज to gain, Uṇādi aff. ऊ.
41100: सर्प m. (-र्पः) 1 A snake, a serpent. 2 Gentle or twining motion, gliding, flowing, creeping. f. (-र्पी) The female of the snake. E. सृप to go, to glide, aff. अच्.
41101: सर्पकङ्काली f. (-ली) A plant, commonly Sāmpkaṅkāli or serpent's skeleton. E. सर्प a snake, कङ्काल a skeleton, fem. aff. of diminutiveness or comparison, ङीष्; also with कन् added सर्पकङ्कालिका.
41102: सर्पगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, perhaps the same as the serpent ophioxylon. E. सर्प a snake, and गन्ध fragrance.
41103: सर्पघातिनी f. (-नी) A plant: see सर्पकङ्काली. E. सर्प a snake, and घातिनी destructress.
41104: सर्प्पछत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom. E. सर्प्प, and छत्र an umbrella.
41105: सर्प्पण n. (-णं) 1 Going, gliding. 2 The slow flight of an arrow nearly parallel to the ground. E. सृप to go, ल्युट् aff.
41106: सर्प्पत् mfn. (-र्प्पन्-र्प्पन्ती-र्प्पत) Going, gliding, creeping. E. सृप to go, शतृ aff.
41107: सर्पदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A snake's tooth. 2 A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) f. (-ष्ट्रा) A plant, (Tragia involucrata.) E. सर्प, and दंष्ट्र a tooth.
41108: सर्प्पफणज m. (-जः) The snake-stone, a gem or pearl said to resemble in form the berry of the Abrus precatorius, and to be found in the head of the snake. E. सर्प्प a snake, फण hood, and ज born.
41109: सर्पभुज् m. (-भुक्) 1 A peacock. 2 A crane. 3 A large snake. E. सर्प a snake, and भुज् who eats.
41110: सर्पमणि m. (-णिः) The snake-stone or carbuncle, or a jewel said to be found in the head of a snake, possessing also alexipharmic properties. E. सर्प a snake, and मणि a gem.
41111: सर्पमाला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly Serpakankali.
41112: सर्पराज m. (-जः) VĀSUKI, sovereign of the serpent race, inhabiting Pātāla or the regions under the earth. E. सर्प a snake, and राज a sovereign.
41113: सर्पसत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A name of the prince JANAMEJAYA, the son of PARIKṢIT. E. सर्प a snake, and सच a sacrifice, इनि aff.; having compelled by Mantras all the snakes to be present at a sacrifice performed for their destruction, in retaliation of the death of his father who was killed by the bite of a snake; all were destroyed on this occasion except a few of the chiefs.
41114: सर्पसहा f. (-हा) A plant: see सर्पकङ्काली.
41115: सर्पहन् m. (-हः) An ichneumon, a mungoose. E. सर्प a snake, and हन who kills.
41116: सर्पाक्ष n. (-क्षं) The seed of the Elæocarpus. f. (-क्षी) A plant, commonly Kaṅkālika. E. सर्प a snake, and अक्षि the eye.
41117: सर्पाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) E. सर्प a snake, and आख्या an appellation.
41118: सर्पाङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A plant, Sarpakaṅkālī or a variety of it.
41119: सर्पाराति m. (-तिः) 1 GARUḌA. 2 An ichneumon. 3 A peacock. E. सर्प a snake, and अराति an enemy.
41120: सर्पारि m. (-रिः) An ichneumon. E. सर्प a snake, and अरि an enemy, equally applicable to the peacock, &c.: see the last.
41121: सर्पाशन m. (-नः) A peacock. E. सर्प a snake, and अशत food: see the last.
41122: सर्पिन् mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि) Going gently or tortuously, gliding, winding, creeping. f. (-णी) 1 A female serpent. 2 A small medicinal shrub. E. सर्प a snake, or going, &c. इनि aff.
41123: सर्पिस् n. (-र्पिः) Ghee, clarified butter. E. सृप to flow, इस् Uṇādi aff.
41124: सर्पिस्समुद्र m. (-द्रः) The sea of clarified butter, one of the seven seas. E. सर्पिस् Ghee, समुद्र the ocean.
41126: सर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (सर्ब्बति) To go, to move.
41127: सर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बा-र्ब्ब) All, whole, entire. E. षर्ब्ब to go, aff. अच्; as differently read, with a final semivowel, सर्ब्बं q. v.
41128: सर्ब्बंसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Patient, enduring. 2 All-sustaining. E. सर्ब्ब all, सह to bear, खच् aff.
41129: सर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Sky, heaven. E. सृ to go, मन् Uṇādi aff.
41130: सर्व्व mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं) All, whole, complete, universal, entire. m. (-र्व्वः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 VIṢṆU. E. सृ to go, to pervade, (the world,) and वन् Uṇādi aff.; also according to some authorities preferably सर्ब्ब as above.
41131: सर्व्वंसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Patient, enduring. 2 All-sustaining, f. (-हा) The earth. E. सर्व्व all, (men,) सह to bear or suffer, aff. खश्.
41132: सर्व्वक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) All, every. E. कन् added to the last.
41133: सर्व्वकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) BRAHMĀ. E. सर्व्व all (things), कर्त्तृ maker.
41134: सर्व्वकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) All or every act. m. (-र्म्मा) A man of all work. E. सर्व्व, and कर्म्मन् act.
41135: सर्व्वकर्म्मीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Performing or conversant with every business, pervading every action, &c. E. सर्व्व all, कर्म्म act, ख aff.
41136: सर्व्वकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) The maker of all things. E. सर्व्व, and कारिन् who makes.
41137: सर्व्वकाल n. (-लं) All seasons or times. E. सर्व्व, and काल time.
41138: सर्व्वकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of all times or seasons. E. सर्व्वकाल, and ख aff.
41139: सर्व्वके ind. Every where, universally. E. सर्व्व in all, and अकच inserted before the final.
41140: सर्व्वकेशिन् m. (-शी) An actor, a dancer, a mime.
41141: सर्व्वक्षार m. (-रः) Any substance of an alkaline or soapy nature, as impure soda, pearl ash or potash, &c. which may be used in cleaning clothes. E. सर्व्व all, and क्षार impure alkali or alkaline salt or ashes.
41142: सर्व्वग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going every where, all-pervading. n. (-गं) Water. m. (-गः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 BRAHMA. 3 Soul, spirit. f. (-गा) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. सर्व्व all, and ग what goes.
41143: सर्व्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Omnipresent, universally diffused. E. सर्व्व, and गत gone.
41144: सर्व्वगन्ध n. (-न्धः) 1 A class of four aromatics, or Kakkol, cloves, agallochum, and gum benjamin. 2 A perfume in general. E. सर्व्व all, and गन्ध fragrance.
41145: सर्व्वग्रन्थिक n. (-कं) The root of long pepper. E. सर्व्व all, ग्रन्थि a knot, and कन् aff.
41146: सर्व्वङ्कष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) All-pervading, diffused, extended. m. (-षः) A rogue, a wicked man. E. सर्व्व, and कष to go, खच् aff.
41147: सर्व्वचर्म्मीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Made of every kind of skin or leather. E. सर्व्व all, चर्म्म skin, ख aff.
41148: सर्व्वजगत् f. (-त्) The universe, the whole world. E. सर्व्व, and जगत् world.
41149: सर्व्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Belonging or relating to all men, fit for all, &c. E. सर्व्व all, जन mankind, ख aff.
41150: सर्व्वजित् mfn. (-जित्) 1 All-subduing, irresistible. 2 All-surpassing, excellent, incomparable. m. (-जित्) The twenty-first year of the cycle. E. सर्व्व all, जित् who subdues or surpasses.
41151: सर्व्वज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Omniscient, all-wise. m. (-ज्ञः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A Jina or Buddha, or deified sage peculiar to those sects. E. सर्व्व all, and ज्ञ who knows.
41152: सर्व्वज्ञत्व n. (-त्वं) Omniscience. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, सर्व्वज्ञता.
41153: सर्व्वतःशुभा f. (-भा) A plant, (Priyangu.) E. सर्व्वतस् wholly, शुभ auspicious.
41154: सर्व्वतन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A man who has studied the Tantra Śāstras. E. सर्व्व all, तन्त्र a Tantra, properly with an affix of derivation. &c., as ठक्, and that again rejected.
41155: सर्व्वतस् ind. 1 Every way, all round. 2 Wholly, entirely. E. सर्व्व all, तसिल् aff.
41156: सर्व्वतापन m. (-नः) Love or the deity KĀMA. E. सर्व्व all, तापन inflamer.
41157: सर्व्वतेजस् n. (-जः) All-splendour or power. E. सर्व्व, and तेजस् light, power.
41158: सर्व्वतेजोमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made, comprising or consisting of all splendour or power. E. सर्व्वतेजम्, and मयट् aff.
41159: सर्व्वतोभद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Every where auspicious. mn. (-द्रः-द्रं) A temple or palace of a square form, with an entrance opposed to each point of the compass. m. (-द्रः) 1 The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.) 2 The carriage of VIṢṆU. 3 A bambu. 4 A form of military array. 5 A square mystical diagram, to be painted on the cloth which on particular occasions covers a sort of altar erected to VIṢṆU. 6 A kind of charade, in which the same word answers several questions. 7 A whimsical form of verse, so contrived that the same meanings and words occur, whether the line be read backwards or forwards, or in several other directions. f. (-द्रा) 1 A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 2 An actress or the wife of an actor or dancer, &c. 3 A sort of yam, (Dioscorea.) E. सर्व्वतस् on every side, भद्र auspicious.
41160: सर्व्वतोमुख n. (-खं) 1 Water. 2 Sky, heaven. m. (-खः) ŚIVA. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 Soul, spirit. 4 A Brahman. 5 Svarga, the heaven of INDRA. E. सर्व्वतस् on every side, मुख countenance, or chief, principal.
41161: सर्व्वत्र ind. 1 Everywhere, in all places. 2 Always, at all times. E. सर्व्व all, and चल् aff.
41162: सर्व्वत्रग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) All pervading, going every where. m. (-गः) Air, wind. E. सर्व्वत्र every where, गम to go, ड aff.
41163: सर्व्वत्रगामिन् m. (-मी) Air, wind. E. सर्व्वत्र always, गामिन् going.
41164: सर्व्वथा ind. f. (-था) 1 In all ways, by all means. 2 Assuredly, certainly. 3 Exceeding, mostly. E. सर्व्व all, and श्वाल् aff.
41165: सर्व्वदमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) All-subduing, irresistible. m. (-नः) BHARATA, the son of ŚAKUNTALĀ. E. सर्व्व all, दमन taming.
41166: सर्व्वदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) All-seeing. m. (-र्शी) A Buddha in general. E. सर्व्व all, and दर्शिन् seeing.
41167: सर्व्वदा ind. Always, at all times. E. सर्व्व all, and दाच् aff.
41168: सर्व्वदुःखक्षय m. (-यः) Final emancipation from transmigration. E. सर्व्व all, दुःख pain, and क्षय destruction.
41169: सर्व्वदेवमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or comprising all the gods. E. सर्व्वदेव, and मयट् aff.
41170: सर्व्वदेवमुख m. (-खः) A name of AGNI or fire. E. सर्व्व all, देव a deity, and मुख mouth; being the medium of oblations to the gods.
41171: सर्व्वधन n. (-नं) 1 Whole wealth or property. 2 (In arithmetic,) Total of a sum in progression. E. सर्व्व, and घन wealth.
41172: सर्व्वधर्म्मविद् m. (-विट् वित्) One who knows the duties of all tribes and classes. E. सर्व्व, and धर्म्म duty, विट् who knows.
41173: सर्व्वधारी f. (-री) The twenty-second year of the cycle. E. सर्व्व all, धृ to hold, अण् and ङीष् aff.
41174: सर्व्वधुरावह m. (-हः) An ox fit for any sort of carriage. E. सर्व्व all, धुर a burthen, आङ् before वह to bear.
41175: सर्व्वधुरीण m. (-णः) An ox, &c. fit for any carriage or draught. E. सर्व्व all, धुर a burthen, ख aff.
41176: सर्व्वनामता f. (-ता) The quality or condition of a pronoun. E. सर्व्वनाम, and तल् aff.
41177: सर्व्वनामन् n. (-म) A pronoun. E. सर्व्व, and नामन् name.
41178: सर्व्वनाश m. (-शः) Total destruction, destruction of all. E. सर्व्व, and नाश destruction.
41179: सर्व्वन्दम m. (-मः) BHARATA. E. सर्व्व all, दम to tame or subdue, खच् aff.
41180: सर्व्वपथ m. (-थः) Every way, every direction. E. सर्व्व, and पथ for पथिन् a path.
41181: सर्व्वपथीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) In or of every road or direction, (moving, passing, &c.) E. सर्व्वपथ, and ख aff.
41182: सर्व्वपा f. (-पा) The wife of the Daitya BALI. E. सर्व्व all, पा to drink, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
41183: सर्व्वपूर्ण्णत्व n. (-त्वं) Entire completion or fulness, complete preparation or provision. E. सर्व्व all, and पूर्णत्व fulness.
41184: सर्व्वप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Generally or universally beloved. 2 Generally friendly, loving all. E. सर्व्व all, and प्रिय dear.
41185: सर्व्वभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Omnivorous, eating all or any thing. f. (-क्षा) A female goat. E. सर्व्व all, and भक्ष who eats.
41186: सर्व्वभक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 Eating any thing or all things, (a child.) 2 All-devouring, omnivorous. E. सर्व्व, and भक्ष्य edible.
41187: सर्व्वभाव m. (-वः) Whole disposition, all one's thoughts and purpose. E. सर्व्व, and भाव disposition.
41188: सर्व्वभूत n. plu. (-तानि) 1 All the elements. 2 All created things. E. सर्व्व all, and भूत an element.
41189: सर्व्वभूतकृत् mn. (-कृत्) 1 The maker of all things. 2 The cause of all elements or beings. E. सर्व्वभूत, and कृत् who or what makes.
41190: सर्व्वभूतमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Comprising or comprehending all elementary matter. m. (-यः) The supreme pervading spirit. E. सर्व्वभूत, and मयट् aff.
41191: सर्व्वभूतस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Present in all elements or beings. E. सर्व्व all, भूत an element, and स्थ what stays; also सर्व्वभूतस्थित, &c.
41192: सर्व्वभूतात्मन् m. (-त्मा) Universal, all-pervading spirit. E. सर्व्वभूत an element, and आत्मन् soul.
41193: सर्व्वभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Cherishing or supporting all. E. सर्व्व, and भृत् who or what supports.
41194: सर्व्वभोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Enjoying all. E. सर्व्व, and भोगिन् who enjoys.
41195: सर्व्वभोगीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Good or beneficial for all, to be enjoyed or possessed by all. E. सर्व्व, भोग enjoyment, खश् aff.
41196: सर्व्वमङ्गला f. (-ला) DURGĀ. E. सर्व्व all, मङ्गल auspicious.
41197: सर्व्वमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) General, universal, comprehensive, comprehending. E. सर्व्व all, मयट् aff.
41198: सर्व्वमही f. (-ही) The whole earth. E. सर्व्व, and मही earth.
41199: सर्व्वमूल्य n. (-ल्यं) A Cowrie or small coin represented by it. E. सर्व्व all, (of all things,) मूल्य price.
41200: सर्व्वमूषक m. (-कः) Time. E. सर्व्व all, (things,) मूष to steal, वुन् aff.
41201: सर्व्वरस m. (-सः) 1 Resin, the exudation of the pine or Śāl. 2 A sort of musical instrument, a kind of lute. 3 A scholar, a learned man. 4 Saltness, salt, saline flavour or taste. E. सर्व्व all, रस taste, real or figurative.
41202: सर्व्वरसोत्तम m. (-मः) The saline flavour, saltness, salt. E. सर्व्व all, रस a flavour, उत्तम best.
41203: सर्व्वरात्र m. (-त्रः) The whole night. E. सर्व्व all, and रात्रि, अच् substituted for the final.
41204: सर्व्वरीकर m. (-रः) The moon. E. सर्व्वरी for शर्व्वरी night, and कर who makes.
41205: सर्व्वर्त्तुपरिवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A year. E. सर्व्व all, ऋतु a season, and परिवर्त्त a revolution.
41206: सर्व्वला f. (-ला) An iron crow. E. सर्व्व all, ला to take, aff. अङ् and टाप्; also read शर्व्वला and सर्व्वली.
41207: सर्व्वलिङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A heretic, an impostor; one who not belonging to the orthodox faith, wears the dress, and assumes the character of an ascetic. E. सर्व्व all, लिङ्ग mark, (of sect or caste,) इनि aff.
41208: सर्व्वलोक m. (-कः) The universe. E. सर्व्व, and लोक a world.
41209: सर्व्वलोह m. (-हः) An iron arrow. E. सर्व्व all, लोह iron.
41211: सर्व्ववल्लभा f. (-भा) A disloyal or unchaste woman. E. सर्व्व all, and वल्लभा a mistress.
41212: सर्व्वविद् mfn. (-वित्) Omniscient, all-wise. E. सर्व्व, and विद् who knows.
41213: सर्व्ववेद m. (-दः) A Brahman who has read the four Vedas. E. सर्व्व all, वेद the Veda, and अण् or ठक् aff.; the effects of the aff. being subsequently rejected.
41214: सर्व्ववेदस् m. (-दाः) A man who gives away all his property to the priests who have been employed by him at particular sacrifices, of which such a destination of the principal's whole wealth is an essential part. E. सर्व्व all, विद to gain, causal form, aff. असुन्.
41215: सर्व्ववेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Omniscient. E. सर्व्व, and वेदिन् who knows.
41216: सर्व्ववेशिन् m. (-शी) An actor, a dancer. E. सर्व्व all, वेश dress or decoration, इनि aff.
41217: सर्व्वशस् ind. Wholly, universally. E. सर्व्व, and शसि aff.
41218: सर्व्वशान्तिकृत् m. (-कृत्) The sovereign of India, BHARATA. E. सर्व्व all, शान्ति tranquillity, and कृत् who effects.
41219: सर्व्वशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 What remains of the whole. 2 What is to continue or to be added to all. E. सर्व्व, and शेष remainder.
41220: सर्व्वसङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) United or meeting with universally. m. (-तः) A sort of rice of quick growth. E. सर्व्व all, (by all,) सङ्गत known.
41221: सर्व्वसङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A general or universal collection. 2 Any collection. E. सर्व्व, and सङ्ग्रह collection.
41222: सर्व्वसन्नहन n. (-नं) Assembling, a complete army. E. सर्व्व all, (the parts, or elephants, chariots, horse, and foot,) and सन्नहन arming, accoutring.
41223: सर्व्वसन्नाह m. (-हः) 1 The universal and pervading spirit. 2 Arming or assembling a complete army. E. सर्व्व all, and सन्नाह arming, accoutring.
41224: सर्व्वसमता f. (-ता) 1 Sameness or identity with all things. 2 Equanimity, equal regard for all. E. सर्व्व, and समता sameness.
41225: सर्व्वसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) All-enduring, bearing all things with patience and firmness. m. (-हः) Bdellium. E. सर्व्व all, सह to suffer, aff. अच्.
41226: सर्व्वसिद्धार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Having every object attained, every wish gratified, &c. E. सर्व्व, and सिद्ध accomplished, अर्थ object.
41227: सर्व्वसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Universal success or accomplishment of all, m. (-द्धिः) A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. सर्व्व all, सिद्धि completion.
41228: सर्व्वस्व n. (-स्वं) 1 Whole property or possessions. 2 Substance, whole essence of any thing. E. सर्व्व, and स्व own.
41229: सर्व्वस्वदण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) Fined in all one's property. n. (-ण्डं) Confiscation of property. E. सर्व्वस्व, and दण्ड punishment.
41230: सर्व्वस्वहरण n. (-णं) Confiscation of a whole property. E. सर्व्वस्व, and हरण taking; also सर्व्वस्वहार, &c.
41231: सर्व्वस्वामिन् m. (-मी) 1 A universal monarch. 2 The owner or master of all. E. सर्व्व, and स्वामिन् a master.
41232: सर्व्वहार m. (-रः) 1 Total confiscation. 2 Seizing the whole. E. सर्व्व, and हार taking; also सर्व्वहरणं.
41233: सर्व्वाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 The whole body. 2 The Aṅgas or portions of divine knowledge collectively. E. सर्व्व all, अङ्ग a limb, &c.
41234: सर्व्वाङ्गीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Spreading throughout the body, diffusive, pervading. 2 Relating or belonging to the Aṅgas, or parts of science collectively. E. सर्व्व all, अङ्ग member, ख aff.
41235: सर्व्वाणी m. (-णी) A name of DURGĀ. E. सव्व ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.
41236: सर्व्वात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) All-pervading. E. सर्व्व, and आत्मन् self, कन् aff.
41237: सर्व्वात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 The supreme or universal spirit. 2 All beings collectively. E. सर्व्व, and आत्मन् self or spirit.
41238: सर्व्वात्मभूति f. (-तिः) All beings collectively. E. सर्व्वात्म, and भूति being.
41239: सर्व्वाधिकार m. (-रः) General control or superintendence. E. सर्व्व, and अधिकार office.
41240: सर्व्वाधिकारिन् m. (-री) A general or head superintendant. E. सर्व्वाधिकार, and इनि aff.
41241: सर्व्वानुभूति f. (-तिः) 1 A Jina of the last era. 2 One of the future era. 3 A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.) E. सर्व्व all, अनुभूति perception.
41242: सर्व्वान्नभक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Eating every thing or every where. E. सर्व्व all, अन्न food, and भक्षक who eats.
41243: सर्व्वान्नभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Eating all sorts of food. E. सर्व्व all, अन्न food, भुज to eat, णिनि aff.
41244: सर्व्वान्नीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Eating all sorts of food. E. सर्व्व all, अन्न food, ख aff.
41245: सर्व्वाभिसन्धक m. (-कः) A railer, a cynic, one who abuses all. E. सर्व्व, and अभिसन्धक who calumniates.
41246: सर्व्वाभिसन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) A cynic, a calumniator or reviler. E. सर्व्व all, अभि and सम् before धा to have, क affix, and इनि possess. added.
41247: सर्व्वाभिसार m. (-रः) Assembling a complete army. E. सर्व्व all, and अभि before सृ to go, aff. घञ्.
41248: सर्व्वार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Having every object or sense. n. adv. (-र्थम्) For or on account of all. m. plu. (-र्थाः) All objects, &c. E. सर्व्व, and अर्थ an object.
41249: सर्व्वार्थसिद्ध m. (-द्धः) Buddha, the founder of the Bauddha faith, E. सर्व्व all, अर्थ object, and सिद्ध perfect: his father's wishes being all fulfilled by his birth.
41250: सर्व्वावसर m. (-रः) Midnight. E. सर्व्व all, (things,) अवसर interval or cessation.
41251: सर्व्वाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Eating all things. E. सर्व्व, and अशिन् who eats.
41252: सर्व्वाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Giving shelter or protection to all. E. सर्व्व, and आश्रय asylum.
41253: सर्व्वाश्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Belonging or common to every order. E. सर्व्व, and आश्रमिन् belonging to an Āśrama or order of life.
41254: सर्व्वास्त्रा f. (-स्त्रा) One of the sixteen Vidyā Devis, or goddesses of learning, according to the Jainas. E. सर्व्व all, अस्त्र a weapon.
41255: सर्व्वाह्ण m. (-ह्णः) The whole day. E. सर्व्व all, अहन् a day.
41256: सर्व्वीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating or belonging to all, suitable or fit for all, &c. E. सर्व्व all, छ aff.
41257: सर्व्वेश m. (-शः) 1 Supreme or universal monarch. 2 The Supreme Being. E. सर्व्व, and ईश lord.
41258: सर्व्वेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A universal monarch. E. सर्व्व all, and ईश्वर lord.
41259: सर्व्वौघ m. (-घः) 1 Assembling a complete army. 2 Great speed or dispatch. E. सर्व्व all, and च्योघ a heap.
41260: सर्व्वौषधिगण m. (-णः) A class of certain principal drugs, consisting of Murā, Valerian Jaṭāmāṃsī, Orris root, Benzoin, Zedoary, Kurh, or Costus speciosus, red saunders, and Cyperus. E. सर्व्व all, औषधि a drug, and गण a class; also with वर्ग the same, सर्व्वौषधिवर्ग m. (-र्गः)
41261: सर्व्वौषधिरस m. (-सः) The juice or infusion of a number of plants as used at a royal inauguration. E. सर्व्व all, औषधि herb, रस juice.
41262: सर्षप m. (-पः) 1 A sort of mustard, (Sinapis dichotoma.) 2 A kind of poison. 3 A small measure of weight, a mustard seed so considered. f. (-पी) A small bird. E. सृ to go, अप Uṇādi aff., and षुक् augment.
41263: सर्षपतैल n. (-लं) Mustard oil. E. सर्षप mustard, and तैलच् aff.
41264: सल n. (-लं) Water. E. षल to go, अच् aff.
41265: सलज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Bashful, modest, ashamed. E. स with, लज्जा shame.
41266: सलिल n. (-लं) Water. E. षल to go, इलच् Uṇādi aff.
41267: सलिलकुन्तल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. सलिल water, and कुन्तल hair.
41268: सलिलक्रिया f. (-या) The funeral rite of washing the corpse. E. सलिल, and क्रिया act.
41269: सलिलज n. (-जं) A lotus. E. सलिल water, and ज born.
41270: सलिलनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. सलिल, and निधि store.
41271: सलिलरय m. (-यः) Current, stream. E. सलिल, and रय speed.
41272: सलिलराशि m. (-शिः) Any piece of water. E. सलिल, and राशि heap.
41273: सलिलेन्धन m. (-नः) Submarine fire. E. सलिल water, and इन्धन inflaming.
41274: सलील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wanton, sportive. E. स for सह with, लीला sport.
41275: सल्लकी f. (-की) The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. सल to go, वुन् aff., and the ल doubled; also शल्लकी.
41276: सव m. (-वः) 1 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 Offspring, progeny. 3 The sun. 4 The moon. n. (-वं) 1 Water. 2 The juice or honey of flowers. 3 Sprinkling the juice of the acid Asclepias. E. षू to bear, &c., aff. अप्.
41277: सवन n. (-नं) 1 Bathing, as a religious exercise, or preparatory to a sacrifice, purificatory ablution in general. 2 A sacrifice in general. 3 Extracting and drinking the juice of the acid Asclepias. 4 Bearing as children, bringing forth young. E. षू to bear young, &c., Uṇādi aff. युच्.
41278: सवपुष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Embodied, having a body or form. E. स with, वपुस body, टच् aff.
41279: सवयस् mfn. (-याः-याः-यः) Contemporary, of similar age or duration. m. (-याः) A friend, a contemporary. f. (-याः) A woman's female friend. E. स for समान equal, like, and वयस् age.
41280: सवर m. (-रः) 1 Water. 2 A name of ŚIVA. More properly. शवर, q. v.
41281: सवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Like, resembling. 2 Of the same tribe or class. 3 Of the same kind, homogeneous. f. (-र्णा) A name of CHĀYĀ, one of the wives of the sun. E. स for समान like, same, वर्ण tribe, colour, &c.
41282: सवहा f. (-हा) A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus Turpethum;) also read सुवहा.
41283: सवास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) 1 Scented, perfumed. 2 Having a dwelling. E. स with, वास abode, &c.
41284: सवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Clothed, dressed. E. स with, वासम् vesture.
41285: सविकल्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Admitting of an alternative or choice. 2 Doubtful. E. स with विकल्प option, कन् added.
41286: सविकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Expanded, extended, extensive. E. स for सह with, विकाश expansion.
41287: सविग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) 1 Embodied, having body or form. 2 Meaning, importing. E. स with, विग्रह body, &c.
41288: सवितृ m. (-ता) The sun. E. षू to send or cast, (his rays,) तृच् aff.
41289: सवितृदैवत m. (-तः) The constellation Hastā, the thirteenth of the lunar asterisms. E. सवितृ the sun, and दैवत godhead; the sun being the ruling deity of this asterism.
41290: सवितृल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Belonging or relating to the sun. E. सवितृ the sun, and ल aff.
41291: सवित्र n. (-त्रं) Cause or instrument of production or generation. E. षू to bear, aff. इत्र.
41292: सवित्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating or belonging to the sun. E. सवितृ the sun, घ aff.
41293: सवित्री f. (-त्री) 1 A mother. 2 A cow. E. षू to bring forth young, तृच् aff., ङीष् fem. aff.
41294: सविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Learned, wise, versed in science. E. स with, विद्या knowledge.
41295: सविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Of the same kind. E. स for समान common, same, विघ manner, sort.
41296: सविनय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Modest, well-behaved. n. (-यं) Modestly, respectfully. E. स with, विनय propriety.
41297: सविलास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Wanton, sportive. E. स with, विलास sport.
41298: सविशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Excellent, superior. 2 Having characteristic qualities. E. स with, विशेष excellence.
41299: सविशेषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Distinguished, marked, characterised, individualised by marks or properties. E. स with, विशेषण distinguishing property.
41300: सविशेषतस् ind. Particularly, excellently. E. स with, विशेषतस् especially.
41301: सविस्मय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Astonished, surprised. E. स for सह with, विस्मय astonishment.
41302: सवृद्धिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bearing interest. E. स with वृद्धि interest, कन् added.
41303: सवेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं). 1 Near, proximate. 2 Ornamented, decorated. E. स for समान common, or सह with, and वेश entrance, decoration, &c.
41304: सवेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Near, proximate. 2 Decorated, dressed. E. स for सह with, &c., and वेष entrance or decoration.
41305: सव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Left, left hand. 2 South, southern. 3 Reverse, contrary, backward. m. (-व्यः) VIṢṆU. E. ष to send, य Uṇādi aff., form irr.
41306: सव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Suffering pain. E. स with, व्यथा pain.
41307: सव्यभिचार m. (-रः) A reason or argument that is locally incompatible with the conclusion to be drawn from it. E. स with, व्यभिचार irrelevancy.
41308: सव्यसाचिन् m. (-ची) A name of ARJUNA. E. सव्य left, षच to be joined or attached, aff. णिनि; drawing the bow with his left hand, as well as his right.
41309: सव्याज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Cunning, plausible, pretending. 2 Fraudulent. E. स with, व्याज pretext.
41310: सव्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A charioteer. E. सव्ये on the left, and स्थ who stands.
41311: सव्येष्ठृ m. (-ष्ठा) A charioteer. E. सव्ये on the left, स्था to stand, ऋन् Uṇādi aff. with the effect of ड, स, and थ changed.
41312: सव्रीड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Modest, ashamed. E. स with, व्रीडा shame.
41313: सशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearful, doubtful. E. स with, शङ्का fear.
41314: सशल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्का-ल्कं) Scaly, (as a fish, &c.) E. स, and शल्क scale.
41315: सशल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Troublesome, difficult. 2 Pierced by a thorn or dart. E. स with, शल्य a thorn.
41316: सशूक m. (-कः) A believer, one who believes the existence of GOD, &c.
41317: सशोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sorrowful, sad. n. adv. (-कं) Sorrowfully. E. स with, शोक sorrow.
41318: सश्मश्रु f. (-श्रुः) A woman with a beard. E. स for सह with, श्मश्रु a beard.
41319: सश्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Wearied, fatigued. E. स with, श्रम fatigue.
41320: सस r. 2nd cl. (सलि) To sleep; also षस.
41321: ससंशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Doubtful, uncertain. E. स with, संशय doubt.
41322: ससत्वा f. (-त्वा) A pregnant woman. E. स for सह with, सत्व a living being.
41323: ससन n. (-नं) Immolation, offering a living victim. E. सस to sleep, &c., aff. ल्युट्; also शसन and शमन.
41324: ससम्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Happy, delighted. E. स with, सम्पद pleasure.
41325: ससाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Frightened, alarmed. E. स with, साध्वस fear.
41326: ससौष्ठव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Quick, fleet. 2 Excellent. E. स with, सौष्ठव speed, &c.
41327: सस्तर m. (-रः) A bed of leaves, &c. E. स for समान common, and लर spreading, covering.
41328: सस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Desirous, wishing for. E. स with, स्पृहा desire.
41329: सस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smiling, laughing. E. स for सह with, स्मित a smile.
41330: सस्य n. (-स्यं) 1 Fruit. 2 Corn, grain. 3 A weapon. 4 A quality, an excellence. E. सस to sleep, य Uṇādi aff.; also शस्य, &c.
41331: सस्यक m. (-कः) 1 A sort of precious stone, described as of the colour of the inner fruit of the cocoanut, (Opal?) 2 A sword. E. कन् added to the last.
41332: सस्यसंवर m. (-रः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. सस्य fruit, and संवर a covering.
41333: सस्याद् mfn. (-द्) Fructivorous, granivorous, eating grain or fruit. E. सस्य, अद to eat, क्विप् aff.
41334: सस्येष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Sacrifice offered on the ripening of new grain. E. सस्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.
41335: सस्वेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Perspiring, exuding. f. (-दा) A virgin deflowered, a girl who has committed a breach of chastity. E. स with, स्वेद perspiration.
41336: सस्त्रि mfn. (-स्त्रिः-स्त्रिः-स्त्रि) Who or what goes. E. सृ to go, इ aff., v. redup.
41337: सह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Patient, enduring, suffering, bearing, m. (-हः) The month Agrahāyaṇa. mn. (-हः-हं) Strength, power. f. (-हा) 1 The earth. 2 The Aloe plant. 3 A sort of bean, commonly Mudgaparṇī. 4 A drug, commonly Nakhi. 5 A plant; also Daṇḍotpalā. 6 Barleria, (the white sort.) 7 The ichneumon plant or Rasan. 8 A medicinal sort of moon plant. ind. 1 With, together with; a particle implying association, connexion; 2 Union, junction; 3 Increase, addition; 4 Presence, present time; 5 Completeness, entireness; 6 Resemblance, &c. E. षह to have patience, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्.
41338: सहकार m. (-रः) A fragrant sort of mango. E. सह with, कृ to make, अण् aff.
41339: सहकारिता f. (-ता) Co-operation, assistance. E. सहकारिन्, and तल् aff.; also सहकारित्वं.
41340: सहकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) An implement, an assistant or associate, that or who, by which or whom, any object is effected, &c. E. सह with, कृ to make, णिनि aff.
41341: सहकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Assisting, an assister. E. सह, and कृत् who does.
41342: सहकृत्वन् mfn. (-त्वा-त्वा-त्व) Co-operating, assisting. E. सह with, कृ to do, क्वनिप् aff.
41343: सहगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Accompanied, associated. E. सह with, गत gone.
41344: सहगमन n. (-नं) 1 Going with, accompanying. 2 A woman's burning herself on the funeral pile with her deceased husband. E. सह with, गमन going.
41345: सहगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going with, accompanying. f. (-नी) A woman who burns herself with her husband's body. E. सह with, गामिन् who goes.
41346: सहचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Accompanying, going or associating with, &c. mf. (-रः-री) Yellow Barleria. m. (-रः) 1 A companion, a follower. 2 A surety. f. (-री) 1 A wife. 2 A woman's female friend or confidence. E. सह with, चर to go, टच् aff.
41347: सहचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Accompanying, attending. E. सह with, चर to go, शतृ aff.
41348: सहचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Who or what accompanies, attends, associates with, &c. E. सह with, चर to go, क्त aff.
41349: सहचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) A companion, an attendant. E. सह with, चारिन् who goes.
41350: सहज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Co-existent, cognate, born or produced together. 2 Innate, inherent, natural. m. (-जः) 1 A brother of whole blood. 2 The natural state or disposition. E. सह with, and ज born.
41351: सहजमित्र m. (-चः) A friend by birth; as a sister's son, &c. E. सहज cognate, मिच friend.
41352: सहजारि m. (-रिः) A natural enemy, one hostile by birth; as the son of the same father by another mother, the son of a paternal uncle, &c. E. सहज cognate, अरि an enemy.
41353: सहजेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Incidental, accidental, not inherent or innate, (in the dual it may imply both innate and adventitious.) E. सहज, and इतर other.
41354: सहजोदासीन m. (-नः) A person, unconnected by birth, born neither an enemy nor friend. E. सहज cognate, उदासीन a stranger.
41355: सहत्व n. (-त्वं). 1 Sufferance, endurance. 2 Association, union. E. सह patient, or with, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, सहता.
41356: सहदेव m. (-वः) The youngest of the five Pāṇḍava princes. f. (-वा) 1 A plant, a sort of Sida. 2 A twining shrub, (Echites frutescens.) 3 Another plant, also Daṇḍotpala. f. (-वी) 1 A sort of Sida. 2 A shrub, bearing a fragrant seed, Priyangu. E. सह with देव who or what sports.
41357: सहधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Community of duty, law, property, &c. E. सह with, धर्म्म duty.
41358: सहधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) 1 Following the same law, acknowledging the same obligations. 2 Possessing same or like properties. f. (-णी) A woman married according to the ritual of the Vedas. E. सह with, धर्म्म the law, इनि aff.
41359: सहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Patient, enduring. n. (-नं) Bearing, enduring. E. सह to bear, युच् or ल्युट् aff.
41360: सहनर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing together in a circle, &c. E. सह together, and नर्त्तन dancing.
41361: सहपांशुकिल m. (-लः) A contemporary and friend.
41362: सहपान n. (-नं) Drinking together. E. सह with, पान drinking.
41363: सहभाविन् m. (-वी) A friend, a companion, an adherent or partisan. E. सह with, भाव quality, इनि aff.
41364: सहभोजन n. (-नं) Eating in company. E. सह together, भोजन food.
41365: सहमरण n. (-णं) Concremation, a widow's burning herself with the corpse of her husband. E. सह with, मरण dying.
41366: सहयुध्वन् mfn. (-ध्वा-ध्वा-ध्व) Fighting with or along with. m. (-ध्वा) A brother in arms. E. सह, युध to fight, क्वनिप् aff.
41367: सहयुध्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fighting with. E. सह, युध्वान fighting.
41368: सहरसा f. (-सा) A sort of bean; see मुद्गपर्णी. E. सह with, रस juice.
41369: सहरि m. (-रिः) 1 The sun. 2 A bull. ind. Resembling HARI or VIṢṆU. E. स for सह with, or समान same, हरि the deity.
41370: सहर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Envy, emulation. 2 Pleasure, delight. E. स with, हर्ष pleasure.
41371: सहस् m. (-हां) 1 The month Agrahāyaṇa, (Nov.-Dec.) 2 The winter season. n. (-हः) 1 Strength, power. 2 Light. E. षह to bear, असुन् aff.
41372: सहसा ind. Quickly, precipitately, inconsiderately, without consideration or pause. E. षह to bear, असा aff.
41373: सहसादृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seen quickly. m. (-ष्टः) An adopted son. E. सहसा quickly, दृष्ट seen.
41374: सहसान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Patient, enduring. m. (-नः) 1 A peacock. 2 Sacrifice, oblation. E. षह to bear, असानच् Uṇādi aff.
41375: सहस्य m. (-स्यः) The month Pauṣa, (Dec.-Jan.) E. सह to bear, यत् aff., form irr.
41377: सहस्रकिरण m. (-णः) The sun. E. सहस्र a thousand, and किरण a ray.
41378: सहस्रकृत्व ind. Repeatedly, reiteratedly, a thousand or many times. E. सहस्र, and कृत्वसुच् aff.
41379: सहस्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Liberal, giving by thousands. E. सहस्र, and द who gives.
41380: सहस्रदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus pelorius, BUC.) E. सहस्र a thousand, and दंष्ट्र tooth.
41381: सहस्रदंष्ट्रिन् m. (-ष्ट्री) A sheat fish: see the last. E. सहस्र a thousand, दंष्ट्र a tooth, and इनि aff.
41382: सहस्रदृश् m. (-दृक्) INDRA. E. सहस्र, and दृश् the eye.
41383: सहस्रदोस् m. (-दोः) KĀRTAVĪRYA, a prince so named. E. सहस्र a thousand, and दोस् the arm.
41384: सहस्रधा ind. In a thousand ways. E. सहस्र, and धाच् aff.
41385: सहस्रधार m. (-रः) The discus of VIṢṆU. E. सहस्र a thousand, and धार an edge.
41386: सहस्रनयन m. (-नः) INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, and नयन the eye.
41387: सहस्रनेत्र m. (-त्रः) INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, and नेत्र the eye.
41388: सहस्रपति m. (-तिः) The governor of a district, or of a thousand villages. E. सहस्र, and पति chief.
41389: सहस्रपत्र n. (-त्रं) A lotus. E. सहस्र a thousand, and पत्र a leaf.
41390: सहस्रपाद् m. (-त् or -द्) BRAHMĀ. E. सहस्र a thousand, and पाद् for पाद a foot.
41391: सहस्रपाद m. (-दः) 1 The sun. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 A sort of duck. E. सहस्र a thousand, and पाद a foot.
41392: सहस्रयुग m. (-गः) A period of a thousand ages. E. सहस्र, and युग an age.
41393: सहस्ररश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The sun. E. सहस्र a thousand, and रश्मि a ray.
41394: सहस्ररोमन् n. (-म) A blanket. E. सहस्र, and रोमन् hair.
41395: सहस्रवदन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. सहस्र, a thousand, and वदन a face.
41396: सहस्रवीर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon, the Agrostis linearis of LINNÆIS.) E. सहस्र a thousand, वीर्य्य splendor.
41397: सहस्रवेधिन् n. (-धि) Asafoetida. m. (-धी) A sort of cane, (Calamus fasciculatus.) E. सहस्र a thousands, and वेधिन् what pierces.
41398: सहस्रशस् ind. By a thousand or thousands, thousand-fold. E. सहस्र, and शसि aff.
41399: सहस्रशिखर m. (-रः) The Vindhya mountain. E. सहस्र a thousand, and शिखर a crest.
41400: सहस्रहर्य्याश्व m. (-श्वः) The car of INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, हरि green, and अश्व a horse.
41401: सहस्रांशु m. (-शुः) The sun. E. सहस्र a thousand, and अंशु a ray.
41402: सहस्राक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Thousand-eyed; used figuratively, vigilant, all-perceiving, all-inspecting, all-powerful. m. (-क्षः) INDRA. E. सहस्र a thousand, and अक्ष the eye: INDRA having been covered over with marks resembling the female organ, in consequence of a curse of GAUTAMA, those marks were changed subsequently to eyes by the relenting saint.
41403: सहस्राधिपति m. (-तिः) The governor of a district or chief over a thousand villages. E. सहस्र, and अधिपति ruler.
41404: सहस्रार n. (-रं) The top of the head, the seat of the soul. E. सहस्र, and अर a spoke.
41405: सहस्रावर m. (-रः) A fine of from five hundred to a thousand Paṇas. E. सहस्र, and अवर below.
41406: सहस्रिन् mfn. (-स्री-स्रिणी-स्रि) Having a thousand. m. (-स्री) 1 A body of a thousand men, &c. 2 Commander or prefect of a thousand. E. सहस्र a thousand, इनि aff.
41407: सहाचर m. (-रः) A yellow sort of Barleria, (B. prionitis.) E. सह with आङ् before चर to go, aff. टच्; also सहचर.
41408: सहाय m. (-यः) 1 A companion, a follower, an adherent. 2 A patron, a helper. 3 A sort of drug and perfume, commonly Gahantāpārali. 4 The ruddy goose. E. सह with, इण् to go, aff. अच्.
41409: सहायता f. (-ता) 1 A multitude of companions, a company of associates or followers. 2 Association, assistance, friendship. E. सहाय a companion, तल् aff. of number, or the abstract.
41410: सहायत्व n. (-त्वं) Fellowship, companionship, friendship. E. सहाय a companion, त्व aff. of the quality.
41411: सहायवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Befriended, assisted, accompanied, E. सहाय, and मतुप् poss. aff.
41412: सहार m. (-रः) The mango. E. षह to bear, आरन् Uṇādi aff.
41413: सहारोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Well, convalescent. E. सह with, आरोग्य health.
41414: सहार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Having one object. 2 Synonymous, having the same meaning. E. सह with, अर्थ object, &c.
41415: सहार्द्द mfn. (-र्द्दः-र्द्दा-र्द्दं) Tender, affectionate. E. स with, हार्द्द affection.
41416: सहासन n. (-नं) Sitting on the same seat. E. सह with, आसन a seat.
41417: सहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Accompanied by, in company with, associated with, &c. 2 Borne, endured. n. adv. (-तं) With, together with. E. सह with, इतच् aff.; or षह to bear, क्त aff., with इट् augment.
41418: सहितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Bearing, enduring. E. सह to bear, तृच् aff.
41419: सहित्र n. (-त्रं) Patience, endurance. E. षह to suffer, and इत्र aff.
41420: सहिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Patient, enduring, resigned. E. षह to bear, इष्णुच् aff.
41421: सहिष्णुता f. (-ता) Patience, resignation. E. तल affix of the abstract, added to the preceding.
41422: सहुरि m. (-रिः) The sun. f. (-रिः) The earth. E. षह to bear, उरिन् Uṇādi aff.
41423: सहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Good-hearted. m. (-यः) A Paṇḍita, a learned man. E. स with, हृदय a heart.
41424: सहेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Sportive, playing. E. स with हेल sport.
41425: सहोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A figure of rhetoric; either the employment of a word in a double meaning, or connecting different circumstances in one sentence by the use of the term सह with, along with. E. सह with, उक्ति saying.
41426: सहोटज m. (-जः) A hut of leaves, &c. inhabited by ascetics.
41427: सहोढ m. (-ढः) The son of a woman pregnant at the time of her marriage. 1 A thief caught with stolen property upon him. E. सह with, ऊढा a bride; or स with, होढ stolen goods.
41428: सहोढज m. (-जः) The son of a woman pregnant at the time of marriage. E. स with, ऊढा a bride, ज born.
41429: सहोदर m. (-रः) A brother of whole blood, one by the same father and mother. E. सह with, उदर the belly.
41430: सहोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Said or declared, comprehensively or collectively. E. सह with, उदित said.
41431: सहोर m. (-रः) A saint, a pure or pious man. E. सह to bear, ओरन् Uṇādi aff.
41432: सहोवल n. (-लं) Violence, aggression. E. सहस् and वल, both meaning power, strength.
41433: सहोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dwelling or abiding with, being together with. E. सह, and उषित abiding.
41434: सह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be borne or suffered. 2 Equal or adequate to. 3 Sweet, agreeable. 4 Powerful, strong. n. (-ह्यं) Health, convalescence. m. (-ह्यः) One of the principal ranges of the mountains of India; the mountainous country on the north-west side of the Peninsula or towards Poonah, &c., and in which the Godāvarī river takes its rise. E. षह to bear, aff. यत्.
41435: सा f. (सा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 The goddess GAURĪ. 3 She, (the third personal feminine pronoun or the feminine inflection of तद् that, &c.) E. षो to destroy, &c., aff. ड.
41436: सांयाचिक n. (-कः) A voyaging merchant, one who trades by sea, &c. E. संयात्रा travelling together, ठञ् aff.
41437: सांयुगीन m. (-नः) An able leader, a soldier skilled in war. E. संयुग war, and खञ् aff.
41438: सांराविण n. (-णं) 1 Shout, acclamation, the calling out of a number of people together. 2 Crying or complaining aloud. E. सम् together, राविन् who calls or cries, and अण् added.
41439: सांवत्सर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Annual, perennial. m. (-रः) An astrologer. E. संवत्सर a year, अण् aff.
41440: सांवत्सरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Yearly, annual, relating to a year, produced in a year, &c. E. संवत्सर a year, and ठञ् aff.; also with वुञ्, aff. सांवत्सरक.
41441: सांवादिक m. (-कः) A logician. E. संवाद dispute, ठक् aff.
41442: सांशयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Dubious, doubtful. 2 Uncertain, irresolute, in doubt. E. संशय doubt, ठञ् aff.
41443: सांसारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worldly, of or belonging to the world. E. संसार, and ठक् aff.
41444: सांसिद्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Spontaneous, effected naturally. E. संसिद्धि perfection, ठक् aff.
41445: सांस्थानिक m. (-कः) A countryman, an inhabitant or native of the same place. E. सम् together, स्थान place, ठन् aff.
41446: साकम् ind. With, together with. E. स for सह with, अक to go, अम् aff.
41447: साकल्य n. (-ल्यं) The whole, the entire, all. E. सकल all, and यञ् aff.
41448: साकाङ्क्ष mfn. (-ङ्क्षः-ङ्क्षा-ङ्क्ष) Wishing, desirous. E. स with, आकाङ्क्षा desire.
41449: साकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having form or shape. E. स with, आकार form.
41450: साकूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Significant. 2 Wanton. E. स with, आकूत meaning, wish.
41451: साकूतस्मित n. (-तं) A wanton glance. E. साकूत, and स्मित a smile.
41452: साकेत n. (-तं) The city Ayodhya, or ancient Oude.
41453: साक्तुक m. (-कः) Barley. n. (-कं) A quantity of fried grain, &c. E. सक्तु fried or parched grain ground, and ठञ् aff.
41454: साक्षात् ind. 1 Before, in presence, in sight. 2 As, like. 3 Evidently, manifestly. E. स for सह with, अक्ष the eye, अत to go or to be, aff. क्विप्.
41455: साक्षिता f. (-ता) Evidence, testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, साक्षित्वं.
41456: साक्षिन् mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि) 1 Witnessing, seeing, an eye-witness. 2 Attesting, testifying, evidence. m. (-क्षी) A witness, (in law.) E. स for सह with, (in presence of,) अक्षि the eye, इनि aff.
41457: साक्षिपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Examination of a witness's credibility. E. साक्षिन्, and परीक्षा trial; also साक्षिपरीक्षणं.
41458: साक्षिभावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made known by testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and भावित caused to be perceived or known.
41459: साक्षिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having or requiring evidence. E. साक्षिन्, and कतुप् aff.
41460: साक्षिलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Defined or proved by testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and लक्षण a mark.
41461: साक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Testimony, evidence. E. साक्षिन्, and यत् aff.
41462: साक्ष्यभाव m. (-वः) Absence or deficiency of witnesses or testimony. E. साक्षिन्, and अभाव non-existence.
41463: साखेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Friendly, amicable. E. सखि a friend, ढञ् aff.
41464: साख्य n. (-ख्यं) Friendship. E. सखि a friend, यञ् aff.
41465: सागर m. (-रः) 1 The ocean. 2 A sort of deer. E. सगर a king, and अण् aff.; to bathe the bones of SAGARA'S 60,000 sons the Ganges is said to have been led by BHAGĪRATHA, his great-great-grandson, to the ocean, at the place now called Gaṅgā-Sāgar.
41466: सागरगामिनी f. (-नी) A river in general. E. सागर the ocean, and गामिनी going to.
41467: सागरनेमि f. (-मिः) The earth. E. सागर the sea, and नेमि a circumference; surrounding the earth.
41468: सागरमेखला f. (-ला) The earth. E. सागर the ocean, and मेखला a zone.
41469: सागराम्बरा f. (-रा) The earth. E. सागर the ocean, अम्बर vesture.
41470: सागरालय m. (-यः) VARUṆA, deity of the water. E. सागर the ocean, and आलय abode.
41471: सागरोत्थ n. (-त्थं) Sea salt. E. सागर the sea, and उत्थ produced.
41472: साग्निक m. (-कः) A householder, who maintains a sacred fire. E. स with, अग्नि fire, कन् aff.
41473: साङ्कर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Mixture, blending. 2 The concurrence of various properties in one subject. E. सङ्कर mixing, यञ् aff.
41474: साङ्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Effected or produced by addition, collection, &c. E. सङ्कल collection, aff. अञ्.
41475: साङ्कुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Budding, in bud. E. स with, अङ्कुर a bud.
41476: साङ्क्षेपिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Short, summary, concise, contracted, abridged. E. सङ्क्षेप abridgement, ठक् aff.
41477: साङ्ख्य mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्यी-ङ्ख्यं) 1 Numeral, relating to number. 2 Rational, discriminative. m. (-ङ्ख्यः) The Sāṃkhya system of philosophy, ascribed originally to the Muni KAPILA. E. संख्या number, &c., and अण् aff.
41478: साङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Having all the members. 2 Comprising all the subdivisions. E. स with, अङ्ग a limb or part.
41479: साङ्गतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Social, associating, relating to or derived from encounter or society. m. (-कः) A visitor. E. सङ्गति acquaintance, ठक् aff.
41480: साङ्गम m. (-मः) Union, meeting. E. सङ्गम the same, अण् pleonasm.
41481: साङ्ग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Warlike, martial, &c. m. (-कः) A commander, a general. E. सङ्ग्राम war, ठञ् aff.
41482: साचि ind. Crookedly, awry, bent. E. षच to collect, इञ् aff.
41483: साचिविलोकित n. (-तं) A side glance. E. साचि, and विलीकित looked at.
41484: साचिव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Ministry, administration. 2 Friendship, fellowship. E. सचिव a friend, यञ् aff.
41485: साचिस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Crooked. 2 Standing or placed unevenly. E. साचि, and स्थित stood.
41486: साचीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made crooked. 2 Seen crookedly or tortuously, distorted, misrepresented. n. (-तं) Prejudice, distortion or perversion of mind. E. साचि crookedly, च्चि aff., कृत made.
41487: साञ्जन m. (-नः) A lizard, a chameleon. E. स with, अञ्जन unguent.
41488: साटोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Proud, haughty, consequential. n. adv. (-पं) Arrogantly, consequentially. E. स with, आटोप pride.
41489: सात् n. (सात्) BRAHMA, GOD. E. साति to cause happiness, aff. क्विप्.
41490: सात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Given. 2 Destroyed. n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight. E. सत to give, or षो to destroy, aff. क्त, form irr.: see सित.
41491: सातय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who or what causes pleasure. E. साति a Sautra root in the causal form, to cause pleasure, श aff.
41492: सातला f. (-ला) A shrub, commonly Carmaghās. E. सात pleasure, and ला to give, affs. अङ् and टाप्; also शातला.
41493: सातवाहन m. (-नः) The sovereign SĀLIVĀHANA. E. सात a Gandharba, changed according to the leg end to a lion, on which this prince was discovered riding when a child, and वाहन a vehicle.
