42742: सेवितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Who or what serves, worships, &c. 2 Addicted or devoted to. E. सेवृ to serve, तृच् aff.
42743: सेवित्व n. (-त्वं) Serving, devotion. E. सेविन् who serves, त्व aff.
42744: सेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) 1 Serving, obeying. 2 Pursuing, practising, using. E. षेव to serve, णिनि aff.
42745: सेव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be served or obeyed, to be worshipped or honoured. 2 What ought or may be practised, used, &c. 3 To be taken care of. n. (-व्यं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. m. (-व्यः) A plant, (Barringtonia acutangula.) f. (-व्या) A parasite plant. E. षेवृ to gratify by service, यत् aff.
42746: सेव्यता f. (-ता) Rank, eminence. E. सेव्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, सेव्यत्त्रं.
42747: सेव्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being served, waited, attended on. 2 Being practised or used. E. सेव to serve, pass. v., शानच् aff.
42748: सै r. 1st cl. (सायति) To waste, to decline; also षै.
42749: सैंह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Lion, leonine, lion-like. E. सिंह a lion, अण् aff.
42750: सैंहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Lion, leonine. m. (-कः) RĀHU, the personified ascending node. E. सिंह, and ठक् aff.; or सिंहिका the mother of RĀHU, (by adoption,) and अण् patronymic aff.
42751: सैंहिकेय m. (-यः) RĀHU, the personified ascending node. E. सिंहिका the reputed mother of this being, and ढक् aff.
42752: सैकत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Sandy in general. n. (-तं) A sand-bank or an island with sandy shores. E. सिकता sandy soil, and अण् aff.
42753: सैकतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Living in doubt and error. m. (-कः) 1 A religious mendicant. 2 An ascetic. n. (-कं) A thread worn round the wrist or neck, &c. to secure good fortune. E. सिकता sand, &c., ठक् aff.
42754: सैतवाहिनी f. (-नी) The Bāhudā river. E. सित white, अण् aff. and वाहिनी a river.
42755: सैद्धान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Connected with or relating to a demonstrated truth, one who knows the truth, &c. E. सिद्धान्त an established conclusion, and ठञ् aff.
42756: सैनापत्य n. (-त्यं) The command of an army, the dignity or duty of a general. E. सेनापति a general, and यक् aff.
42757: सैनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to an army, drawn up as an army, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A guard, a centinel, a piquet. 2 A body of forces in array. E. सेना an array, and ठक् aff.
42758: सैन्धव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Produced or born in Sindh. 2 Marine, aquatic, ocean or river-born. m. (-वः) A horse. mn. (-वः-वं) Rock salt. n. (-वं) In dramatic literature, musical expression of disappointment with Prākṛta words. f. (-वी) One of the Rāgiṇīs. E. सिन्धु a river, &c., अण् aff.
42759: सैन्धवघन m. (-नः) A lump of salt. E. सैन्धव, and घन thick.
42760: सैन्य n. (-न्यं) An army. m. (-न्यः) 1 A soldier under arms, one drawn up in array. 2 A guard, a centinel. E. सेना an army, and ण्य or ष्यञ् aff.
42761: सैन्याधिपति m. (-तिः) A general. E. सैन्य, and अधिपति ruler.
42762: सैन्याध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) A commander, a general. E. सैन्य, and अध्यक्ष supervisor.
42763: सैमन्तिक n. (-कं) Red-lead. E. सीमन्त the parting of the hair, (where a red mark is often made with minium,) and ठक् aff.
42764: सैरन्ध्री f. (-न्ध्री) 1 A female artist. 2 A name of DRAUPADĪ. see सैरिन्ध्री.
42765: सैरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating or belonging to a plough, &c. 2 Having furrows. m. (-कः) 1 A Ploughman. 2 A plough-ox, &c. E. सीर a plough, ठक् aff.
42766: सैरिन्ध्र m. (-न्ध्रः) A menial servant, one employed to dress and decorate the person and perform all servile offices; also who may be employed in the chase, snaring animals, &c. the offspring of a Dasyu by an Ayogava female. f. (-न्ध्री) 1 An independant female artisan working in another person's house. 2 A female attendant in the women's apartments. 3 A woman of one of the mixed and degraded classes. 4 DRAUPADĪ, the wife of the Pāṇḍu princes, and who upon the temporary servitude of her husbands, became workwoman in the house of the Rāja of Virāṭa. E. सीर a plough, धृ to hold or take, aff. क, and मुक् augment, अण् added, and the penultimate vowel changed optionally to इ; whence also सैरन्ध्री, or स्वैर independent, धृ to hold or be, aff. कन्, fem. aff. ङीष्, and form irr.
42767: सैरिभ m. (-भः) 1 A buffalo. 2 Svarga, INDRA'S heaven or paradise. E. सीर the plough or the sun, इभ an elephant, aff. अण्.
42768: सैरीय m. (-यः) A plant, (Barleria cristata.) E. सीर a plough, अण् aff., सैर relating to a plough, (turned up by it, &c.) and छ added; also with कन् added सैरीयक, and with ढक् aff. सैरेय or सैरेयक.
42769: सैरीयक m. (-कः) Barleria: see the last.
42770: सैरेय m. (-यः) A shrub, (Barleria cristata;) see सैरीय; also with कन् added सैरेयक.
42771: सैसक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Leaden, lead. E. सीसक, and अण् aff.
42772: सो f. (-सोः) PĀRVATĪ. E. षो to destroy, aff. क्विप्.
42773: सोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Borne, suffered, endured. 2 Patient, enduring. E. सह to bear, aff. क्त.
42774: सोढृ mfn. (-ढा-ढ्री-ढृ) 1 Patient, enduring. 2 Able, powerful. E. सह to bear, &c., aff. तृच्.
42775: सोत्कण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं) Regretting, bewailing, grieving. E. स with, उत्कण्ठा sorrow.
42776: सोत्प्रास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Excessive, much, violent. m. (-सः) A horse-laugh. mn. (-सः-सं) Irony, sneering praise and covert censure. E. स with, उत्प्रास excess or effort; it is also read सोत्प्राश.
42777: सोत्साह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Vigorous, energetic, persevering. E. स with, उत्साह effort.
42778: सोदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having or containing water. E. स with, उदक water.
42779: सोदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Accumulated, augmented, with interest, with profit. E. स for सह with, उदय increase.
42780: सोदर m. (-रः) A brother of whole blood. E. स for समान common, same, and उदर belly or womb.
42781: सोदर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A brother of whole blood. E. स for समान same or common, उदर belly, यत् aff.
42782: सोद्योग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Active, diligent, persevering. E. स with, उद्योग effort.
42784: सोन्माद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Mad, insane. E. स with, उन्माद madness.
42785: सोपकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Equipped, stocked, furnished or provided with necessary means or implements. 2 Assisted, abetted, befriended. E. स with, उपकार an instrument or assistance.
42786: सोपप्लव m. (-वः) The sun or moon in eclipse. E. स with, उपप्लव a portent, an eclipse.
42787: सोपवास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Tasting, keeping a fast. E. स with, उपवास fasting.
42788: सोपाक m. (-कः) A man of a degraded caste, the son of a Cāṇḍāla by a Pukkasī female, and only to be employed as a public executioner, &c. E. see श्वपाक, the sibilants being irregularly transposed, व changed to उ, and that to the usual Guṇa letter.
42789: सोपाधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Restricted, limited, qualified, special. E. स with, उपाधि discrimination, कन् aff.
42790: सोपान n. (-नं) Stairs, steps or a staircase. E. स with, उप above, up, and अन a going.
42791: सोभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga;) see शोभाञ्जन.
42792: सोम m. (-मः) 1 The moon. 2 KUVERA. 3 A monkey chief. 4 Air, wind. 5 YAMA. 6 One of the demigods called VASUS. 7 ŚIVA. 8 The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida, or Sarcostema viminalis.) 9 The acid juice of the Sarcostema. 10 A drug of supposed magical properties. 11 Water. 12 Nectar, the liquor of immortals. 13 Camphor. 14 A deified progenitor. 15 A mountain or mountainous range, the mountains of the moon. n. (-मं) 1 Rice-water or gruel. 2 Heaven, sky, æther. E. षू to bear, (as young,) or to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. मन्.
42793: सोमगर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) VIṢṆU. E. सोम the moon, and गर्ब्भ embryo.
42794: सोमज n. (-जं) Milk. E. सोम the moon, and ज produced.
42795: सोमतीर्थ m. (-र्थः) A place of pilgrimage in the west of India. E. सोम the moon, and तीर्थ a holy place.
42796: सोमदैवत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Presided over by SOMA. E. सोम, and दैवत्य deification.
42797: सोमधारा f. (-रा) Sky, heaven. E. सोम the moon, धारा having.
42798: सोमन् m. (-मा) The moon. E. षू to bring forth, (as young,) and मनिन् aff.
42799: सोमप m. (-पः) The performer of a sacrifice, or a sacrificer, who drinks the juice of the acid Sarcostema. E. सोम the plant, and प who drinks.
42800: सोमपत्र m. (-त्रः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.) E. सोम the Sarcostema, and पच a leaf.
42801: सोमपा m. (-पाः) 1 A drinker of the juice of the acid Sarcostema. 2 A Pitṛ or progenitor of a certain class, or those who are especially the Pitṛs of the Brahmans. E. सोम the acid Sarcostema, and पा to drink, aff. क्विप्.
42802: सोमपान n. (-नं) Drinking the juice of the acid Sarcostema, an essential part of sacrifices according to the Veda ritual. E. सोम, and पान drinking.
42803: सोमपीतिन् m. (-ती) A drinker of the juice of the acid Sarcostema. E. सोम the juice of the plant, पीति beverage, इनि aff.; it is also read सोमपीथिन् and सोमपीविन्.
42804: सोमबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The white esculent water-lily. E. सोम the moon, and बन्धु friend; expanding at night.
42805: सोमभू m. (-भूः) 1 One of the persons called VĀSUDEVAS, by the Jainas. 2 The son of SOMA, BUDHA, the regent of MERCURY, and supposed founder of the lunar dynasty. E. सोम the moon, and भू born.
42806: सोमयाग m. (-गः) Offering or sacrifice in which the acid Sarcostema juice is drank. E. सोम, and याग sacrifice.
42807: सोमयाजिन् m. (-जी) A sacrificer who drinks at the ceremony the juice of the acid Sarcostema. E. सोम the plant, यज to sacrifice, णिनि aff.
42808: सोमयोनि m. (-निः) A sort of Sandal of yellow colour and great fragrance. E. सोम the moon, and योनि place of production.
42809: सोमराजिन् m. (-जी) A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. सोम the moon, राज to shine, aff. णिनि, or with अच् and ङीष् added, सोमराजी; and again with कन् added, सोमराजिका.
42810: सोमराजी f. (-जी) 1 A medicinal plant: see the last.
42811: सोमलता f. (-ता) 1 The moon-plant or acid Sarcostema, (S. viminalis.) 2 The Godāvarī river. E. सोम, and लता a creeper.
42812: सोमवंश m. (-शः) 1 A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. 2 The lunar dynasty, or series of princes supposed to descend through BUDHA from SOMA, or the moon. E. सोम, and वंश family.
42813: सोमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Lunar, having the moon. 2 Having the Sarcostema juice. E. सोम, and मतुप् aff.
42814: सोमवत् ind. Like the moon. E. सोम, and वति aff.
42815: सोमवल्क m. (-ल्कः) 1 A white kind of Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.) 2 A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal. 3 A plant, (Guilandina bonduccella.) E. सोम the moon, and वल्क bark.
42816: सोमवल्लरि f. (-रिः-री) The moon-plant, (Sarcostema viminalis.) E. सोम the moon, and वल्लरी a creeper.
42817: सोमवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 A twining plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 2 A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) 3 The moonplant. E. सोम the moon, and वल्ली a creeper.
42818: सोमवार m. (-रः) Monday. E. सोम, and वार a day.
42819: सोमविक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A vender of the juice of the acid Sarcostema. E. सोम the plant, विक्रय selling, and इनि aff.
42820: सोमवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A medicinal plant, (Kayaphal.) 2 A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. सोम the moon, and वृक्ष a tree.
42821: सोमसज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Camphor. E. सोम the moon, and सज्ञ appellation.
42822: सोमसद् m. (-सद्) A Pitṛ or progenitor of a peculiar class, the progenitor of the celestial beings called Sādhyas. E. सोम, and सद् who goes.
42823: सोमसिद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 One of the Buddhas. 2 A rationalist of a sect of Śaivas. 3 A particular doctrine, a system of theological philosophy, followed by a branch of the worshippers of ŚIVA. E. सोम the moon, (as the teacher of the doctrine,) and सिद्धान्त truth, (whose.)
42824: सोमसिद्धान्तिन् m. (-न्ती) A follower of a branch of the Śaivas. E. सोमसिद्धान्त the doctrine, and इनि aff.
42826: सोमसुत् m. (-सुत्) A priest or sacrificer who sprinkles the juice of the acid Sarcostema at a sacrifice. E. सोम the plant, षु to sprinkle, aff. क्विप्.
42827: सोमसुत्वन् mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्) Having sprinklers of Soma juice, (a hermitage, a sacrifice, &c.) E. सोमसुत्, and मतुप् aff.
42828: सोमसुता f. (-ता) The Narmadā or Nerbudda river. E. सोम the moon, and सुता daughter.
42829: सोमाख्य n. (-ख्यं) The red lotus. E. सोम the moon, and आख्या appellation.
42830: सोमाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Soft, bland. E. सोम the moon, अल to resemble, aff. अच.
42831: सोमोद्भवा f. (-वा) The Narmadā or Nerbudda river. E. सोम the moon, (for the lunar race,) and उद्भव born; or सोम nectar, उद्भव production, (from it,) by conferring paradise on those who bathe in it.
42832: सोराष्ट्रिक m. (-कः) A sort of poison. E. सुराष्ट्र Surat, and ठक् aff.; also सौराष्ट्रिक.
42833: सोल्लुण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) Irony, ridicule: see the next.
42834: सोल्लुण्ठन n. (-न) Apparent praise and covert censure, irony. E. स with, उल्लुण्ठन the same.
42835: सौकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Hoggish, swinish. 2 Relating to a hog. E. सूकर a hog, अण् aff.
42836: सौकरिक m. (-कः) A hunter. E. सूकर a boar, and ठक् aff.
42837: सौकर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Facility, ease of effecting any thing. 2 Easy and extempore composition, or preparation of food or medicine. 3 Hoggishness, swinishness, the condition or qualities of a hog. E. सुकर doing easily, or सूकर a hog, &c., aff. ष्यञ्.
42838: सौकुमार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Youthfulness. 2 Delicacy, tenderness. E. सुकुमार, and ष्यञ् aff.
42839: सौक्ष्म्य n. (-क्ष्म्यं) Minuteness, subtility. E. सूक्ष्म small, fine, ष्यञ् aff.
42840: सौखसुप्तिक m. (-कः) A bard, a minstrel, one whose duty it is to waken the prince in a morning with music and song. E. सुखसुप्त sleeping pleasantly, and ठञ् aff.
42841: सौख्य n. (-ख्यं) Pleasure, happiness. E. सुख happiness, यञ् aff.
42842: सौगत m. (-तः) 1 A Saugata, a heretic, an atheist. 2 A Bauddha. E. सुगत the supposed teacher of these doctrines, अण् aff.
42843: सौगतिक m. (-कः) 1 A Bauddha mendicant. 2 The mendicant Brahman. 3 Doubt, unbelief, scepticism. 4 An atheist, an unbeliever. E. सुगत the founder of the sect, ठक् aff.
42844: सौगन्ध n. (-न्धं) 1 A fragrant grass: see कत्तृण. 2 Fragrance. E. सुगन्ध fragrant, अण् aff.
42845: सौगन्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fragrant, odorous. n. (-कं) 1 The white water-lily, (Nymphæa lotus.) 2 A fragrant grass: see कत्तृण. 3 A ruby. m. (-कः) 1 Sulphur. 2 A dealer in perfumes. E. सु pleasant, गन्ध smell, and ठक् added.
42846: सौगन्ध्य n. (-न्ध्यं) Odour, fragrance. E. सुगन्ध, and ष्यञ् aff.
42847: सौचि m. (-चिः) A tailor. E. सूची a needle, इञ् aff.
42848: सौचिक m. (-कः) A tailor. E. सूची a needle, and ठक् aff.
42849: सौजन्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Kindness, compassion. 2 Friendship. 3 Goodness. E. सुजन, and ष्यञ् aff.
42851: सौत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Preceptive, formulary, according to rule or precept. m. (-त्रः) 1 A Brahman. 2 A radical, the only application of which is to form derivative nouns, and not like other roots, capable of conversion into a verb. E. सूत्र a thread, a rule, &c., अण् aff.
42852: सौदामनी f. (-नी) 1 Lightning. 2 A courtesan of INDRA'S heaven. 3 Part of the Śudāman mountain: see the next.
42853: सौदामिनी f. (-नी) 1 Lightning. 2 One of the Apsarasas or nymphs of Svarga. 3 A particular sort of lightning. 4 A city so named. E. सुदामन् a cloud, a mountain, or INDRA'S elephant, अण् and ङीष् affs. with the augment इक्; also omitting the augment, सौदामनी, and dropping the penultimate vowel, सौदाम्नी.
42854: सौदाम्नी f. (-म्नी) Lightning: see the last.
42855: सौदायिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Received by a woman at her marriage from her father or mother or any relative as a mark of regard, and thence her own property. E. सुदाय a nuptial gift, and ठक् aff.
42856: सौध n. (-धं) 1 A mansion, a palace. 2 Silver. 3 Opal. E. सुधा plaster, and अण् aff.
42857: सौधार m. (-रः) One of the fourteen parts of a drama.
42858: सौधाल n. (-लं) A temple of ŚIVA, or in the form of Īśāna. E. सौध a palace, अल equal to.
42859: सौन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Belonging or relating to a slaughter-house, &c. n. (-नं) Butcher's meat. E. सूना, and अण् aff.
42860: सौनन्द n. (-न्दं) The club of BALARĀMA.
42861: सौनन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) BALARĀMA the brother of KṚṢṆA. E. सौनन्द his club, इनि aff.
42862: सौनिक m. (-कः) A vender of the flesh of beasts or birds. E. सून a place of slaughter, ठक् aff.
42863: सौन्दर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Beauty, loveliness. E. सुन्दर handsome, ष्यञ् aff.
42864: सौपर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 Dry ginger. 2 The emerald. E. सुपर्ण GARUḌA, and ठक् aff. of derivation.
42865: सौपर्णेय m. (-यः) GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. सुपर्णा the mother of this being, and ढक् aff.
42866: सौप्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Connected with or relating to sleep, somnolent, somniferous, &c. n. (-कं) Nocturnal combat. E. सुप्त sleep, (or the hour of sleep,) and ठक् aff.
42867: सौभ n. (-भं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA suspended in mid-air.
42868: सौभद्र m. (-द्रः) 1 The son of SUBHADRĀ. 2 A war occasioned by the carrying off of SUBHADRĀ. E. सुभद्रा sister to KṚṢṆA, and अण् aff.
42869: सौभद्रेय m. (-या) 1 Beleric myrobalan. 2 ABHIMANYU, the son of SUBHADRĀ. E. सुभद्रा the sister of KṚṢṆA, and ढक् aff.
42870: सौभागिनेय m. (-यः) The son of an auspicious mother. E. सुभगा an auspicious mother, ढक् aff., and इनङ् augment.
42871: सौभाग्य n. (-ग्यं) 1 Auspiciousness, good fortune. 2 The fourth of the astronomical Yogas. 3 Redlead. E. सुभग auspicious, ष्यञ् aff.
42872: सौभाग्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Auspicious, fortunate. E. सौभाग्य, and मतुप् aff.
42873: सौभाग्यवत्ता f. (-त्ता) Auspiciouness, prosperity. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, सौभाग्यवत्त्वं.
42874: सौभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga:) see शोभाञ्जन.
42876: सौभ्रात्र n. (-त्रं) Brotherhood, fraternity. E. सु good, भ्रातृ a brother, अण् aff.
42877: सौमनस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) 1 Floral, flowery, relating to flowers. 2 Agreeable, pleasing. E. सुमनस्, and अण् aff.
42878: सौमनस्य n. (-स्यं) Enjoyment, satisfaction. E. सुमनस् content, ष्यञ् aff.
42879: सौमनस्यायनी f. (-नी) The blossom of the great-flowered jasmine. E. सुमनस् the plant, फक् aff.
42880: सौमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Lunar, relating to SOMA or the moon. 2 Performed with the Sarcostema juice, relating to it, &c. f. (-की) A sacrifice performed on the day of full moon. E. सोम the moon, ठक् aff.
42881: सौमित्र m. (-त्रः) LAKṢMAṆA, the younger brother of RĀMA. E. सुभित्रा the wife of DAŚARATHA, and mother of this prince, and अण् aff.; also with इञ्, aff. सौमित्रि.
42883: सौमेधिक m. (-कः) A sage, a seer, one possessing supernatural knowledge or power. E. सु excellent, मेधा apprehension, ठक् aff.
42884: सौमेरुक n. (-कं) Gold. E. सुमेरु the mountain, with कन् added, and अण् aff. of origin.
42885: सौम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या or मी-म्यं) 1 Handsome, pleasing. 2 Mild, gentle, placid. 3 Sacred or belonging to SOMA or the moon. m. (-म्यः) 1 BUDDHA, regent of MERCURY, and son of SOMA or the moon. 2 One of the nine Khaṇḍas or divisions of the known continent. 3 A term applied to a pupil when addressing instruction to one. 4 (In anatomy,) The blood before it receives the red particles, the serum. m. plu. (-म्याः) Five stars in Orion's head. f. (-म्या) 1 A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 2 Heart-pea. 3 The Abrus precatorious. 4 The moon-plant, (Sarcostema acida.) 5 Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) 6 Arabian jasmine. E. सोम the moon, ण्यत् or यत् aff., or द्यण् aff., when the word takes ङीप् in the feminine form.
42886: सौम्यकृच्छ्र n. (-च्छ्रं) A religious penance, subsisting for five days, severally, on sesamum after expression, the water of boiled rice, butter-milk mixed with water, water, and parched grain, and fasting on the sixth day. E. सौम्य relating to the moon, and कृच्छ्र penance.
42887: सौम्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Beauty. 2 Gentleness, placidity. E. त्व added to सौम्य; also with तल्, सौम्यता.
42888: सौम्यधातु m. (-तुः) Phlegm, the phlegmatic humor. E. सौम्य lunar, and घातु element.
42889: सौर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Solar. 2 Celestial. 3 Spirituous. m. (-रः) 1 The planet SATURN. 2 A month, consisting of thirty rising and settings of the sun, a solar month. 3 A solar day, whilst the sun is in one degree of the ecliptic. f. (-री) The wife of the sun. E. सुर a deity, &c., मूर the sun, अण् aff., or सूर्य्य the sun, and ङीष् aff. for the fem. form.
42890: सौरभ n. (-भं) 1 Fragrance. 2 Saffron. E. सुरभि fragrant, अण् aff.
42891: सौरभेय m. (-यः) An ox. f. (-यी) A cow. E. सुरभी the cow of plenty, (the parent cow,) and ढक् aff. of descent.
42892: सौरभ्य n. (-भ्यं) 1 Pleasingness, agreeableness, beauty. 2 Fragrance, odour. 3 Fame, character, reputation of learning or other merit. m. (-भ्यः) KUVERA. E. सुरभि fragrant, pleasing, and ण्यत् aff.
42893: सौरसेय m. (-यः) A name of SKANDA. E. सुरसा DURGĀ, and ढक् aff.
42894: सौरसैन्धव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Gangetic, relating or belonging to the Ganges river. E. सुरसिन्धु the river of the gods, and अण् added.
42895: सौराष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) Surat. f. (-ष्ट्री) A fragrant sort of earth. n. (-ष्ट्रं) Bell metal. E. सु good or much, राष्ट्र dominion, अञ् aff.; or सुराष्ट्र the same, and अण् pleonasm.
42896: सौराष्ट्रक n. (-कं) A sort of white or bell metal. E. सौराष्ट्र Surat, and कन् added.
42897: सौराष्ट्रिक n. (-कं) A sort of poison, (that of a kind of snake according to some, but according to others, a vegetable or mineral.) E. सुराष्ट्र the country, and ठक् aff.
42898: सौरि m. (-रिः) SATURN. E. सूर the sun, and इञ् aff. of descent.
42899: सौरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Celestial. 2 Spirituous, vinous. m. (-कः) 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 A vender of spirituous liquor. E. सुर a deity, or सुरा wine, and ठक् aff.
42900: सौल्विक m. (-कः) A copper-smith, more usually शौल्विक.
42901: सौव n. (-वं) An edict, &c. in general. E. स्व own, proper, and अण् aff.
42902: सौवर mfn. (-रः-री-र) Produced or existing in a note of music, relating to it, &c. E. स्वर a note, अण् aff.
42903: सौवर्च्चल n. (-लं) 1 Sochal salt. 2 Natron, alkali. E. सुवर्च्चल a district, and अण् aff.
42904: सौवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) 1 Golden, made or consisting of gold. 2 Weighing a Suvarṇa. E. सुवर्ण gold, अण् aff.
42905: सौवर्णभेदिनी f. (-नी) A plant, commonly, Priyangu.
42906: सौवस्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Salutatory, benedictory. m. (-कः) A family Brahman or priest. E. स्वस्ति a term of salutation, ठक् aff.
42907: सौवास्तव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Pleasantly situated, erected on a good site. E. सु good, वास्तु a site, अण् aff.
42908: सौविद m. (-दः) A guard or attendant of the women's apartments. E. सुविद the same, and अण् pleonasm, or सुविद् a woman, and अण् aff.
42909: सौविदल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A guard or attendant of the women's apartments. E. सुविदल्ला a female, अण् aff., or सुविदन् a king, ला to get or have, सुविदल्ल a haram, and अण् aff.; also with कन् added, सौविदल्लक.
42910: सौवीर n. (-रं) 1 The fruit of the jujube. 2 Antimony. 3 Sour gruel. m. (-रः) A district, in the west of India, connected with the country along the Indus. m. pl. (-राः) The people of Suvīra. E. सुवीर the country so called, and अण् pleonasm or aff. of derivation; also with यञ्, aff. सौवीर्य्य.
42911: सौष्ठव n. (-वं) 1 Excess, exceedingness, much. 2 Excellence. 3 A part of a drama. 4 Lightness, fleetness. E. सुष्ठु excellent, &c., and अञ् aff.
42912: सौहार्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) Friendship. m. (-र्द्दः) The son of a friend. E. सुहृद् a friend, अण् aff., and both vowels changed; also with ष्यञ्, aff. सौहार्द्य.
42913: सौहार्द्य n. (-र्द्यं) Friendship. E. सुहद् a friend, ष्यञ् aff.
42914: सौहित्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Satiety, satisfaction. 2 Fulness, completion. E. सुहित satisfied, ष्यञ् aff.
42915: सौहृद n. (-दं) Friendship. E. सुहृद a friend, अण् aff.; also from सुहृदय, सौहृदय.
42916: सौहृद्य n. (-द्यं) Friendship. E. सुहृद् a friend, यञ् aff.
42917: स्कद (इ) स्कदि r. 1st. cl. (स्कन्दते) 1 To leap, to jump. 2 To inundate. 2 To lift up. 3 To shed or spill.
42918: स्कन्द (इर) स्कन्दिर r. 1st cl. (स्कन्दति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To be dry or arid. 3 To effuse or emit. With अव prefixed, To assail, to assault.
42919: स्कन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 SKANDA, or KĀRTTIKEYA, the son of ŚIVA, and military deity of the Hindus. 2 A king, a prince. 3 The body. 4 The bank of a river. 5 A clever or learned man. E. स्कन्द to go, (to fly before whom; the enemies of the gods,) and अच् aff.
42920: स्कन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Going, moving. 2 Purging, looseness. 3 Effusion. 4 Suppressing bleeding by cold applications. E. स्कन्द to go, aff. ल्युट्.
42921: स्कन्दयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Going. 2 Effusing, pouring out. E. स्कन्द to effuse, शतृ aff.
42922: स्कन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Going. 2 Effused, shed, emitted. E. स्कन्द to emit, aff. क्त.
42923: स्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 The shoulder, the head of the humerus. 2 The body. 3 The trunk of a tree. 4 A king, a prince. 5 A sort of  metre. 6 A multitude, a quantity. 7 War, battle. 8 Any article essential to the coronation of a king, as a jar filled with holy water, a parasol, a Chowri, &c. 9 Part of an army or a form of array. 10 Any one of five branches of human or mundane knowledge, or objects of understanding. 11 A road, a way. 12 A heron. 13 An engagement, an agreement. 14 A wise old man. 15 A learned man, a teacher. 16 Match or equality in the humps of a pair of draft oxen. 17 The five objects of sense, or form, taste, smell, &c. 18 A book, a section, a chapter. f. (-न्धा) 1 A branch. 2 A creeper. E. क the head, and धा to hold, aff. क, and सुट् initial augment.
42924: स्कन्धचाप m. (-पः) A sort of yoke for carrying burthens by a sling attached to either end. E. स्कन्ध the shoulder, and चाप a bow.
42925: स्कन्धज m. (-जः) A tree which grows from a principal stem. E. स्कन्ध the trunk of a tree, and ज born.
42926: स्कन्धतरु m. (-रुः) The cocoanut. E. स्कन्ध a stem, and तरु a tree.
42927: स्कन्धदेश m. (-शः) 1 The withers of an elephant, or part where the rider sits. 2 The shoulder. E. स्कन्ध the shoulder, and देश part.
42928: स्कन्धफल m. (-लः) 1 The cocoanut tree. 2 The Vilva or Bel. 3 The glomerous fig. E. स्कन्ध the trunk, and फल fruit.
42929: स्कन्धबन्धना f. (-ना) A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium.) E. स्कन्ध the stem, and बन्धन a binding.
42931: स्कन्धरुह m. (-हः) The Indian fig tree. E. स्कन्ध a principal stem, and रुह what grows.
42932: स्कन्धवाह m. (-हः) An ox of burthen. E. स्कन्ध the shoulder, and वाह who bears.
42933: स्कन्धवाहक m. (-कः) An ox of burthen. E. कन् added to the last, or स्कन्ध the shoulder, with वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्.
42934: स्कन्धशाखा f. (-खा) The fork or principal branch of a tree. E. स्कन्ध the trunk, and शाखा a branch.
42935: स्कन्धशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A buffalo. E. स्कन्ध the shoulder, and शृङ्ग the horn.
42936: स्कन्धस् n. (-न्धः) 1 The shoulder. 2 The trunk of a tree. E. स्कदि to go or collect, aff. असुन्, and द changed to घ.
42937: स्कन्धाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The stem of a tree on fire in consequence of attrition. E. स्कन्ध the trunk of a tree, and अग्नि fire.
42938: स्कन्धानल m. (-लः) The stem of a tree or any large piece of timber on fire. E. स्कन्ध the trunk of a tree, and अग्नि fire.
42939: स्कन्धावार m. (-रः) 1 An army, or a division of it attached to the person of the king. 2 A royal capital. 3 A camp. E. स्कन्ध a king or an army, and आङ् before वृ to screen or guard, aff. अण्.
42940: स्कन्धिक m. (-कः) An ox of burthen. E. स्कन्ध the shoulder, and ठक् aff.
42941: स्कन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) A tree. E. स्कन्ध a stem, and इनि aff.
42942: स्कन्धोपनेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be carried on the shoulders. m. (-यः) A form of peace-offering, in which fruit or grain is presented as a mark of submission. E. स्कन्ध, and उपनेय to be conveyed.
42943: स्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Fallen, fallen down or from. 2 Oozed, trickled out or down. E. स्कन्द to go, aff. क्त.
42944: स्कभ (इ) स्कभि r. 1st cl. (स्कम्भते) r. 9th and 5th cls. (स्कभ्नाति स्कभ्नोति) To stop or hinder, to impede, to block, to obstruct, &c. 2 To be dull or stupid.
42945: स्कु r. 9th and 5th cls. (स्कुनाति-स्कुनीते स्कुनोति-स्कुनुते) 1 To go by leaps. 2 To cover. 3 To raise or lift.
42946: स्कुद (इ) स्कुदि r. 1st cl. (स्कुन्दते) 1 To jump, to go by leaps or jumps. 2 To raise, to lift up.
42947: स्कुम्भ (उ) स्कुम्भु r. 5th and 9th cls. (स्कुभ्नोति-स्कुभ्नाति) 1 To stop or hinder. 2 To be dull or insensible.
42948: स्खद r. 1st cl. (स्खदते) 1 To defeat, to discomfit. 2 To cut. 3 To make firm. 4 To destroy, to hurt or kill. 5 To fatigue, to exhaust. 6 To eat, to taste.
42949: स्खदन n. (-नं) 1 Defeating, discomfiting. 2 Injury, hurting, killing. E. स्खद to defeat, aff. ल्युट्.
42950: स्खल r. 1st cl. (स्खलति) 1 To move, to go. 2 To slip, to stumble or fall. 3 To gather, to collect.
42951: स्खलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Stumbling, tripping, (either in motion, conduct, or speech.) E. स्खल to stumble, शतृ aff.
42952: स्खलद्वाक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Blundering, making mistakes in speaking. E. स्खलत्, and वाक्य speech.
42953: स्खलन्मति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Erring in judgment, foolish. E. स्खलत्, and मति understanding.
42954: स्खलन n. (-नं) 1 Stumbling, slipping, tripping. 2 Stumbling or falling from virtue. 3 Tripping in speech, making a mistake or blunder in speech or pronunciation. 4 Knocking or falling together, shock, collision. 5 Striking or rubbing one thing against another. E. स्खल to go, to drop, aff. ल्युट्.
42955: स्खलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Slipped, fallen. 2 Gone. 3 Shaken, agitated, disturbed. 4 Shaking, wavering, unsteady, (literally or figuratively.) 5 Drunk. 6 Stuttering, hesitating, (in speech.) n. (-तं) 1 Circumvention, stratagem, (in war.) 2 Falling, tumbling. 3 Falling or deviating from virtue or truth. E. स्खल to go, aff. क्त.
42956: स्तन (स्तनति) r. 1st and 10 cls. (स्तनयति) To sound, to thunder.
42957: स्तन m. (-नः) The female bosom or breast. E. स्तन to sound, aff. अच्.
42958: स्तनकुद्मल n. (-लं) The female breast. E. स्तन, and कुद्मल a bud.
42959: स्तनन n. (-नं) 1 Sound, noise in general. 2 The grumbling of clouds. 3 Breathing hard, groaning as a person in pain. E. स्तन to sound, aff. ल्युट्.
42960: स्तनन्धय mf. (-यः-या or यी) An infant, one at the breast. E. स्तन the breast, धेट् to drink, aff. खश्.
42961: स्तनपा mf. (-पाः) An infant at the breast. E. स्तन the breast, and पा who drinks.
42962: स्तनभर m. (-रः) A man with a breast like a woman's. E. स्तन a pap, and भर who possesses.
42963: स्तनमण्डल n. (-लं) The female breast. E. स्तन, and मण्डल a globe.
42964: स्तनमुस्व m. (-खः) A nipple. E. स्तन the breast, and मुख point.
42965: स्तनयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 1 A cloud. 2 Thunder, the muttering of clouds. 3 Lightning. 4 Sickness. 5 Death. E. स्तन to sound, in the tenth cl. इत्नुच् Uṇādi aff.
42966: स्तनवृन्त m. (-न्तः) A nipple. E. स्तन the breast, and वृन्त a stalk.
42967: स्तनशिखा f. (-खा) A nipple. E. स्तन the breast, and शिखा the crest.
42968: स्तनाग्र n. (-ग्रं) A nipple. E. स्तन the breast, and अग्र point.
42969: स्तनान्तर n. (-रं) 1 The heart, or its site, placed however immediately under the centre bone of the sternum. 2 A mark on the breast, indicative of future widowhood. E. स्तन the breast, and अन्तर interval.
42970: स्तनाभोग m. (-गः) A man with a large bosom, or one like a female's. E. स्तन a breast, and आभोग who enjoys.
42971: स्तनित n. (-तं) 1 The rattling of thunder, the grumbling of thunder clouds. 2 The noise of clapping the hands. E. स्तन to sound, aff. क्त.
42972: स्तन्य n. (-न्यं) Milk. E. स्तन a breast, यत् aff.
42973: स्तब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Stopped, blocked, or shut up. 2 Firm, hard, stiff, rigid. 3 Stupid, dull, insensible. 4 Paralysed. E. स्तभि to stop, aff. क्त.
42974: स्तब्धकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears erect. E. स्तब्ध, and कर्ण the ear.
42975: स्तब्धरोमन् m. (-मा) A hog. E. स्तब्ध firm, and रोमन् hair of the body.
42976: स्तब्धीकरण n. (-णं) Stiffening, making rigid, paralysing. E. स्तब्ध, and करण making, च्चि augment.
42977: स्तब्धीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stiffened, rigid, paralysed. E. स्तब्ध, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
42978: स्तभ m. (-भः) 1 A goat. 2 A ram. E. see स्तुभ.
42979: स्तम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A shrub, a plant that has no particular or decided stem. 2 A clump of grass, a sheaf of corn, &c. 3 The post to which an elephant is tied. 4 A mountain. n. (-म्बं) 1 A post, a pillar in general. 2 Stupidity, insensibility. E. ष्ठा to stand or abide, अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.
42980: स्तम्बकरि m. (-रिः) Corn or rice. E. स्तम्ब a cluster, and कृ to make, इन् aff.
42981: स्तम्बकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making or forming a heap or cluster. E. स्तम्ब a cluster, कृ to make, अण् aff.
42982: स्तम्बघन m. (-नः) 1 A small hoe for weeding or eradicating clusters of gramineous plants. 2 A sickle or instrument for cutting corn. 3 A basket for holding the heads of wild rice, &c. when cut. E. स्तम्ब a cluster, (of stalks,) a sheaf, हन to destroy, and अप् aff.; also with कच्, aff. स्तम्बघ्न, in each case घ being substituted for ह.
42983: स्तम्बघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Turf-destroying. m. (-घ्नः) A hoe or sickle, &c.: see the last; also स्तम्बघात.
42984: स्तम्बपुर् f. (-पूः) A city so named.
42985: स्तम्बहनन nf. (-नं-नी) A hoe or sickle for eradicating weeds, cutting or reaping corn, &c.: see स्तम्बधन. E. स्तम्ब a cluster, a sheaf, and हनन destroying; also स्तम्बहन्, &c.
42986: स्तम्बेरम m. (-मः) An elephant. E. स्तम्बे in a clump, (of high grass,) रम to sport, aff. अच्.
42987: स्तम्भ (उ) स्तम्भु r. 5th cl. (स्तभ्नोति) 9th cl. (स्तभ्नाति) 1 To stop, to block, to hinder. 2 To be stupid or insensible; also ष्टम्भ.
42988: स्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 A post, a pillar, a column. 2 A stalk, a stem. 3 Stupidity, insensibility. 4 Stupefaction from fear, joy, grief, &c. 5 Coldness, (corporeally,) want of feeling or excitability, paralysis. 6 The suppression of any faculty by magical means. 7 Hindrance, obstruction. E. ष्टभि to stop, &c., aff. अच्.
42989: स्तम्भकर m. (-रः) A fence, a railing, &c. E. स्तम्भ opposing, and कर making.
42990: स्तम्भकिन् f. (-की) A musical instrument, covered with leather. E. स्तम्भक stopping, and इनि aff.
42991: स्तम्भन n. (-नं) 1 Stopping, hindering, obstruction. 2 Suppression of any of the bodily faculties by magical incantations. 3 Stoppage of flow of blood, &c. 4 Any article so employed, a styptic, an astringent. m. (-नः) One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA. E. ष्टभि to stop, aff. युच् or ल्युट्.
42992: स्तम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stupefied, paralysed. E. स्तम्भ to be stupid, causal v., क्त aff.
42993: स्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who or what spreads, extends, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A layer, a stratum. 2 A bed. E. स्तृ to spread, अच् aff.
42994: स्तरिमन् m. (-मा) A bed, a couch. E. स्तृ to spread, इमनिच् Uṇādi aff.
42995: स्तरी f. (-रीः) Smoke. E. स्तृ to cover, Uṇādi aff. ई.
42996: स्तव m. (-वः) Praise, eulogium, panegyric, celebrating as a hero or hymning as a deity. E. ष्टु to praise, अप् aff.
42997: स्तवक m. (-कः) 1 A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. 2 A multitude in general. 3 Praise, eulogium. 4 A panegyrist, a praiser. E. ष्टु to praise, aff. वुन्, or स्था to stay, अवक Uṇādi aff., form irr.
42998: स्तवकाचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) In blossom, covered with blossoms. E. स्तवक, and आचित heaped.
42999: स्तवरक m. (-कः) A fence, a railing, &c.
43000: स्तवेय्य m. (-य्यः) INDRA. E. ष्टु to praise, एय्य Uṇādi aff.
43001: स्तावक m. (-कः) A praiser, a panegyrist. E. ष्टु to praise, ण्वुल् aff.
43002: स्तिमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wet, moist. 2 Unsteady, shaking. wavering, (literally or figuratively.) E. ष्टिम to be moist, aff. क्त.
43003: स्तिम्भि m. (-म्भिः) 1 The ocean. 2 An obstacle, an impediment. E. स्तम्भ to stop, Uṇādi aff. इ, and the radical vowel changed to इ.
43004: स्तीर्व्वि m. (-र्व्विः) A priest versed in the Yajur Veda. E. स्तॄ to cover, Uṇādi aff. क्विन्.
43005: स्तुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, penegyrised, hymned, glorified. E. ष्टु to praise, aff. क्त.
43006: स्तुति f. (-तिः) Praise, eulogy. E. ष्टु to praise, aff. क्तिन्.
43007: स्तुतिपाठक m. (-कः) A bard, one who accompanies a chief or an army, to recite the titles and praises of the one, and to inspire the other by chaunting martial exploits, &c. E. स्तुति praise, and पाठक a reader.
43008: स्तुतिव्रत m. (-तः) A bard, a herald: see the last. E. स्तुति praise, and व्रत observance.
43009: स्तुत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) To be praised, laudable, praise-worthy. E. ष्टु to praise, aff. क्यप्.
43011: स्तुभ m. (-भः) A he-goat. E. ष्टुभ to stop, aff. क; also read स्तभ.
43012: स्तुम्भ (उ) स्तुम्भु r. 5th cl. (स्तुभ्नोति) 9th cl. (स्तुभ्नाति) 1 To stop. 2 To be stupid.
43013: स्तुषेप्य n. (-प्यं) Excellence, preferableness, (in the language of the Vedas.) E. ष्टु to praise, क्मेप्य Uṇādi aff.
43014: स्तूप r. 4th cl. (स्तूप्यति) r. 10th cl. (स्तूपयति) To heap, to pile, to collect; also ष्टूप.
43015: स्तूप m. (-पः) A heap, a pile of earth, &c. E. ष्टूप to heap, aff. घञ्, or ष्टू to praise, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.
43016: स्तूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being praised. E. ष्टु to praise, pass. v., शानच् aff.
43017: स्तृंह r. 6th cl. (स्तृंहति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.
43018: स्तृ (स्तृ,) r. 5th cl. (स्तृणोति स्तृणुते) To cover, to clothe, to spread on or over, to strew. With वि prefixed. 1 To spread widely, to extend. 2 To be diffuse or prolix.
43020: स्तृणत् mfn. (-णन्-णती-णत्) Strewing, spreading over or upon, covering. E. स्तृ to strew, शतृ aff.
43021: स्तृह (ऊ) स्तृहू r. 6th cl. (स्तृहति) To hurt, to kill; also ष्टृह, &c.
43022: स्तॄ (स्तॄ) r. 9th cl. (स्तृणाति स्तृणीते) To clothe, to cover, to spread on or over: see स्तृ.
43023: स्तॄह (ऊ) स्तॄहू r. 6th cl. (स्तृहति) To hurt or kill.
43024: स्तेन r. 10th cl. (स्तेनयति) To steal, to rob.
43025: स्तेन m. (-नः) 1 A thief. 2 Thieving, stealing. E. स्तेन to steal, aff. अच.
43027: स्तेम m. (-मः) Wetness, moisture. E. ष्टिम to be wet, aff. घञ्.
43028: स्तेय n. (-यं) Theft, robbery. E. स्तेन to steal, यत् aff., the final न rejected.
43029: स्तेयिन् m. (-यी) 1 A goldsmith. 2 A thief. E. स्तेय theft, इनि aff.
43030: स्तैन n. (-नं) Theft, robbery. E. स्तेन a thief, अञ् added.
43031: स्तैन्य n. (-न्यं) Theft, robbery. m. (-न्यः) A thief. E. स्तेन to steal, ष्यञ् or ण्यत् aff.
43032: स्तोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Little, small. m. (-कः) 1 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 2 A drop of water. n. adv. (-कं) A little. E. ष्टुच to be clear or bright, घञ् aff.
43033: स्तोकक m. (-कः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. स्तोक a little, and कै to sound or cry, aff. क.
43034: स्तोककाय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Diminutive, dwarfish. E. स्तोक, and काय body.
43035: स्तोतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be praised, deserving or requiring praise. E. ष्टु to praise, तव्य aff.
43036: स्तोतृ mfn. (-ता-ची-तृ) Praising, a praiser, a panegyrist. E. ष्टु to praise, aff. तृच्.
43037: स्तोत्र n. (-त्रं) Praise, eulogium. E. ष्टु to praise, aff. ष्ट्रन्.
43038: स्तोभ m. (-भः) 1 Stopping, obstructing. 2 Disrespect, contumely. 3 A division of the Sāma Veda. E. ष्टुभ to stop, aff. घञ्.
43039: स्तोम r. 10th cl. (स्तोमयति) 1 To praise, to eulogise. 2 To flatter, to wheedle, to coax. 3 To boast.
43040: स्तोम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Crooked, bent. m. (-मः) 1 A heap, a number, a multitude, a quantity. 2 Sacrifice, oblation. 3 Praise, eulogium. n. (-मं) 1 The head. 2 Wealth. 3 Grain, corn. 4 A stick or staff bound with iron. E. ष्टु to praise, मन् Uṇādi aff.
43041: स्तौपिक n. (-कं) The small broom carried by a Jaina ascetic. E. स्तूप a heap, and ठक् aff.
43042: स्त्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Bland, soft, unctuous, smooth. 2 Thick, bulky, gross. n. (-नं) 1 Thickness, grossness, massiveness. 2 Idleness, sloth. 3 Echo. E. स्त्यै to sound, क्त aff.
43043: स्त्येन m. (-नः) 1 A thief. 2 Amṛta, nectar. E. स्त्यै to sound, &c., इनच् Uṇādi aff.
43044: स्त्यै r. 1st cl. (स्त्यायति) 1 To sound. 2 To collect, to crowd; also ष्ट्यै.
43045: स्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A woman or female in general. E. स्त्यै to sound, ड्रट् Uṇādi aff., ङीप् fem. aff.
43046: स्त्रीकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Attendance on women, or the women's apartments. 2 The business of women. E. स्त्री, and कार्थ्य business.
43047: स्त्रीक्षीर n. (-रं) Mother's milk. E. स्त्री, and क्षीर milk.
43048: स्त्रीगवी f. (-वी) A milch-cow. E. स्त्री a female, गो a cow, and ङीप् aff.
43049: स्त्रीघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A woman's murderer. E. स्त्री, and घ्न who kills.
43050: स्त्रीघोष m. (-षः) Dawn, daybreak. E. स्त्री a woman, and घोष sound.
43051: स्त्रीचित्तहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Pleasing or delightful to the female sex. m. (-री) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. स्त्री a woman, चित्त heart or mind, हारिन् what takes.
43052: स्त्रीचिह्न n. (-ह्नं) The vulva. E. स्त्री a female, and चिह्न mark.
43053: स्त्रीचौर m. (-रः) A libertine. E. स्त्री a woman, and चौर a thief.
43054: स्त्रीजननी f. (-नी) The mother of a daughter. E. स्त्री, and जननी mother.
43055: स्त्रीजित m. (-तः) A henpecked husband. E. स्त्री a woman or wife, and जित overcome.
43056: स्त्रीता f. (-ता) Womanhood, feminineness. E. स्त्री a woman, तल् aff.; also with त्व, aff. स्त्रीत्व n. (-त्वं).
43057: स्त्रीधन n. (-नं) Woman's separate property, which is held to be of six kinds: 1. Adhyagnikam, what is given before the sacrificial fire; 2. Adhyāvāhanikam, what is presented during the bridal procession; 3. Ādhivedanikam, what is given on her husband's marrying another wife; 4. Prītidattam, what is given through affection; 5. Śulkam, her dower allowed or perquisites made during marriage; 6. Anvādheyam, a gift from her own or husband's relatives after marriage. Other varieties are enumerated, as the pitṛ, mātṛ, suta, bhrātṛ dattam, what is given by her parents, son, or brother; bandhu dattam, what is given by her kindred; and some enumerate acceptance generally, and inheritance, amongst a woman's titles to property. E. स्त्री, धन wealth.
43058: स्त्रीधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Duty of woman. 2 The menstrual excretion. E. स्त्री a woman, and धर्म्म peculiar property.
43059: स्त्रीधर्म्मयोग n. (-गं) Laws or institutes concerning women. E. स्त्रीधर्म्म, and योग application.
43060: स्त्रीधर्म्मिणी f. (-णी) A woman during menstruation. E. स्त्रीधर्म्म menstruation, इनि and ङीप् affs.
43061: स्त्रीधव m. (-वः) A man, a male. E. स्त्री a woman, and धव a husband.
43062: स्त्रीनिबन्धन n. (-नं) A woman's peculiar province or domestic duty, housewifery. E. स्त्री, and निबन्धन conferring.
43063: स्त्रीपर m. (-रः) A libertine, a lover, a lecher. E. स्त्री a woman, and पर intent.
43064: स्त्रीपुंधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Reciprocal duty of husband and wife, or man and woman. E. स्त्री, and पुम् male, धर्म्म law.
43065: स्त्रीप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Liked or loved by women. m. (-यः) The mango tree. E. स्त्री a female, and प्रिय dear.
43066: स्त्रीमत् m. (-मान्) A husband, a wedded man. E. स्त्री, and मतुप् aff.
43067: स्त्रीरञ्जन n. (-नं) Pān, the mixture of betel-nut, Pān leaf, &c. chewed by the Hindus, and by women especially. E. स्त्री a woman, and रञ्जन delighting.
43068: स्त्रीरत्न n. (-त्नं) An excellent woman. E. स्त्री, and रत्न a gem.
43069: स्त्रीराज्य n. (-ज्यं) The kingdom of women, a country placed by some in the direction of Bhot. E. स्त्री, and राज्य kingdom.
43070: स्त्रीलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Feminine gender. 2 Female organs. E. स्त्री, and लिङ्ग mark, &c.
43071: स्त्रीवश n. (-शं) Subjection to women. E. स्त्री, and वश subject.
43072: स्त्रीविधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Uxorious. E. स्त्री, and विधेय to be ruled.
43073: स्त्रीविवाह m. (-हः) Marrying a woman. E. स्त्री, and विवाह marriage.
43074: स्त्रीवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attended by women. E. स्त्री, and वृत surrounded.
43075: स्त्रीसंग्रहण n. (-णं) Adultery, seduction. E. स्त्री, and संग्रहण taking.
43076: स्त्रीसभ n. (-भं) An assembly of women, a number of females. E. स्त्री a woman, सभा- an assembly, neuter in this compound.
43077: स्त्रीसम्बन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Marriage. 2 Connexion by marriage. 3 Relation or reference to women. E. स्त्री, and सम्बन्ध union.
43078: स्त्रीसेवा f. (-वा) Libertinism. E. स्त्री, and सेवा addiction to.
43079: स्त्रीस्वभाव m. (-वः) An attendant of the women's apartments, a eunuch. E. स्त्री female, स्वभाव nature.
43080: स्त्रीहत्या f. (-त्या) Murder of a woman. E. स्त्री, and हत्या killing.
43081: स्त्रीहन्तृ m. (-न्ता) A woman's murderer. E. स्त्री, and हन्तृ who kills.
43082: स्त्रीहरण n. (-णं) Carrying off a woman, ravishment. E. स्त्री, and हरण taking.
43083: स्त्रीहारिन् m. (-री) A ravisher, one who carries off a woman. E. स्त्री, and हृ to take, धिनुण् aff.
43084: स्त्रैण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Female, feminine. 2 Suited to or good for women. n. (-णं) 1 Womanhood. 2 The nature of woman. E. स्त्री a woman, and नञ् aff.
43085: स्त्र्याजीव m. (वः) One who lives by his wife's labours or prostitution. E. स्त्री, and आजीव subsistence.
43086: स्त्र्याभिगमन n. (-नं) Sexual intercourse. E. स्त्री, and अभिगमन going to.
43087: स्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Staying, abiding, what or who is or stays. E. ष्ठा to stay or stand, aff. क; this deriv. most usually occurs in composition.
43088: स्थग (ए) स्थगे r. 1st cl. (स्थगति) To cover; also ष्ठग.
43089: स्थग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Fraudulent, dishonest, a rogue, a cheat. 2 Shameless, abandoned. f. (-गी) A betel box. E. स्थग to cover or hide, aff. ल्युट्.
43090: स्थगन n. (-नं) Covering, concealment. E. स्थग to cover, aff. ल्युट्.
43091: स्थगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Covered, hidden, concealed. E. स्थग to cover, क्त aff.
43092: स्थगु m. (-गुः) A hump or protuberance on the back, &c. E. स्थग to cover, aff. उ.
43093: स्थण्डिल n. (-लं) 1 A level square piece of ground, prepared for a sacrifice. 2 A boundary, a limit, a land mark. E. ष्ठल to be situated, इलच् aff., form irr.
43094: स्थण्डिलशायिन् m. (-यी) A devotee who, as an act of mortification or penance, sleeps on the ground which has been prepared for sacrificial purposes. E. स्थण्डिल as above, शी to sleep, णिनि aff.
43095: स्थण्डिलसितक n. (-कं) An altar. E. स्थण्डिल levelled ground for a sacrifice, षो to destroy, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
43096: स्थण्डिलेशय m. (-यः) An ascetic sleeping on the ground: see स्थण्डिलशयिन्. E. स्थण्डिल on the ground, and शय who sleeps.
43097: स्थपति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Chief, best, principal. m. (-तिः) 1 The performer of the VṚHASPATI sacrifice. 2 A guard or attendant of the women's apartments. 3 A sovereign, a chief. 4 An architect, a master carpenter or builder. 5 A carpenter, a wheel-wright. 6 A charioteer. 7 KUVERA. E. स्थ who is or who is placed, and पति master, lord.
43098: स्थपुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Distressed, living in difficulty or distress. 2 Bent with pain, &c. E. स्थ what stands, or is, पुट to contract, aff. क.
43099: स्थल r. 1st cl. (स्थलति) To stand, to be firm; also ष्ठल.
43100: स्थल nf. (-लं-ली) Place, site, soil, dry or firm ground. nf. (-लं-ला) A spot of dry ground prepared by art or drained and raised, &c. n. (-लं) 1 A tent, a house of cloth. 2 A mound, a hillock. 3 Point, case, subject (of a description or discussion.) 4 Part (of a book.) E. ष्ठल to be firm, aff. अच्.
43101: स्थलचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what goes on land, terrene. E. स्थल, and चर what goes.
43102: स्थलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Terrene, terrestrial, what is produced on land. E. स्थल, and ज born.
43103: स्थलपद्म n. (-द्मं) A shrub, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. स्थल dry ground, and पद्म a lotus.
43104: स्थलपद्मिनी f. (-नी) A shrub, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. स्थल dry ground, and पद्मिनी a cluster of lotuses.
43105: स्थलमञ्जरी f. (-री) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. स्थल dry ground, and मञ्जरी a stalk.
43106: स्थलविग्रह m. (-हः) Battle on plain or level ground. E. स्थल, and विग्रह war.
43107: स्थलशृङ्गाट m. (-टः) A plant, (Tribulus lanuginosus.) E. स्थल dry ground, and शृङ्गाट a sort of trapa; also with कन् added, स्थलशृङ्गाटक.
43108: स्थलसीमन् m. (-मा) A boundary, a land-mark. E. स्थल dry ground, and सीमन् a boundary.
43109: स्थलीदेवता f. (-ता) A terrestrial demigod, as a faun, a dryad, &c. E. स्थली the dry land, and देवता a divinity.
43110: स्थलीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating or belonging to dry ground. E. स्थल, and छ aff.
43111: स्थलेशय m. (-यः) An amphibious animal, as the tortoise, otter, &c. E. स्थले on dry ground, and शय who sleeps.
43112: स्थवि m. (-विः) A weaver. E. स्था to stay, Uṇādi aff. क्विन्.
43113: स्थविर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Old, aged. 2 Fixed, firm, steady. m. (-रः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 An old man. E. ष्ठा to stay or stand, (a long time, &c.) किरच् Uṇādi aff., and स्थव substituted for the root.
43114: स्थविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्टं) Very fat or corpulent. E. स्थूल bulky, इष्ठन् superlative affix, the final of the adjective dropped, and vowel changed; also with ईयसुन् similar aff. स्थवीयम् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः).
43115: स्थाणु mfn. (-णुः-णुः-णु) Firm, fixed, steady, stable. m. (-णुः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A stake, a pin. 3 A post. 4 A spear, a dart. 5 A nest of white ants. mn. (-णुः-णु) 1 The trunk of a tree of which the branches have been lopped off. 2 The trunk of any tree. E. ष्ठा to stand, Uṇādi aff. नु.
43116: स्थाणुछेद m. (-दः) One who cuts down or clears away timber. E. स्थाणु, and छेद who cuts.
43117: स्थाण्डिल m. (-लः) 1 An ascetic sleeping on the bare ground, or ground prepared for a sacrifice. 2 A mendicant, a religious beggar. E. स्थण्डिल ground, &c., अण् aff.
43118: स्थातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be placed or fixed. 2 To be appointed or determined, to be ordained or agreed upon. E. ष्ठा to stay, तव्य aff.
43119: स्थातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what stays or stands. E. ष्ठा to stay, aff. तृन्.
43120: स्थान n. (-नं) 1 Place, spot, site, situation. 2 Stay, staying, continuance, being fixed or stationary and exempt from increase or diminution. 3 Likeness, resemblance. 4 Leisure, interval. 5 An open place in a town, a green, a plain, a square. 6 A house, a dwelling. 7 A section, a chapter, a book. 8 One of the three objects of government, the middle state, as neither loss nor gain, nor discomfiture nor success, nor expenditure nor accumulation, &c. 9 A town, a city. 10 Office, appointment. 11 Degree, station. 12 Halt. 13 Firmness of troops, keeping in array. E. ष्ठा to stay, to be fixed, aff. ल्युट्.
43121: स्थानक n. (-कं) 1 A basin or trench dug for water at the root of a tree. 2 A town, a city. 3 A bubble or a bead on spirits or wine. E. कन added to the last.
43122: स्थानचञ्चला f. (-ला) A plant, (Ocimum pilosum.) E. स्थान place, चञ्चला trembling.
43123: स्थानपाल m. (-लः) A guard, a keeper, a watchman. E. स्थान a place, and पाल who protects.
43124: स्थानभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Displaced, out of place, fallen or removed from the natural or usual situation. E. स्थान place, and भ्रष्ट fallen.
43125: स्थानयोग m. (-गः) 1 Assignment of suitable places. 2 Proper mode or place for preserving articles. E. स्थान, and योग application.
43126: स्थानाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The superintendant or governor of a place or post. E. स्थान a place, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
43127: स्थानासेध m. (-धः) Confinement to a place, imprisonment, arrest. E. स्थान, and आसेध durance.
43128: स्थानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Local, belonging to place or site. m. (-कः) The governor, or superintendant of any place or district. E. स्थान a place, and ठक् aff.
43129: स्थानिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Having place or fixation, placed, abiding, permanent, &c. E. स्थान place, इनि aff.
43130: स्थानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating or suitable to any place, fit for or belonging to it, &c. n. (-यं) A city, a town. E. स्थान place, and छ aff.
43131: स्थाने ind. 1 Properly, suitably, fitly. 2 Because, on account of. 3 Like, resembling, similarly. 4 Truly. E. स्थान place, in the seventh case.
43132: स्थापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Placing, fixing, regulating, ordering. m. (-कः) 1 The director of the stage business, a stage manager. 2 A founder, the erector of a temple or image, &c. E. ष्ठा to be or stand, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
43133: स्थापत्य m. (-त्यः) A guard of the women's apartments. E. स्था who stays, (in the haram, the wife or concubine of a man of rank,) and पति master, ष्यञ् aff.
43134: स्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Placing, founding, fixing, erecting. 2 Ordering, directing. 3 Fixing or concentrating the thoughts upon the object of meditation, abstraction, mental controul. 4 A ceremony performed in the month of utero-gestation. 5 A dwelling, a habitation. f. (-ना) Ordering or arranging as a drama, stage management. f. (-नी) A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. ष्ठा to stay or stand, causal form, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
43135: स्थापयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Fixing, placing, establishing. E. ष्ठा to stay, causal v., शतृ aff.
43136: स्थापयित्वा ind. Having placed, fixed, erected, &c. E. ष्ठा to stay, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
43137: स्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deposited, placed. 2 Ordered, directed. 3 Certain, established, ascertained. 4 Firm, steady. 5 Set up, erected. 6 Founded, endowed. 7 Placed in a post or situation. E. ष्ठा to stay or be, causal form, aff. क्त.
43138: स्थापितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Placing, having placed. E. स्था to place, causal v., क्तवतु aff.
43139: स्थामन् n. (-म) Strength, power. E. ष्ठा to stand or stay, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्.
43140: स्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Steady, firm, unchangeable, invariable. 2 Who or what stays, or is, &c. m. (-यी) A class of those feelings or passions which are the objects of poetic description: see the next. E. ष्ठा to stay, णिनि aff., युक् augment.
43141: स्थायिभाव m. (-वः) 1 Fixed or permanent condition. 2 A feeling or passion, which is the object of poetical or dramatic description, and is classed sometimes as one of three, but more usually as one of two orders of such objects; this order being opposed especially to the Vyabhicārī Bhāvas: the feelings or conditions termed Sthāyi are eight, viz. desire, mirth, sorrow, heroism, anger, fear, aversion, and astonishment. E. स्थायिन् fixed, and भाव property.
43142: स्थायुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Stationary. 2 Steady, firm. m. (-कः) The overseer of a village. E. ष्ठा to stand or be, उकञ् aff., and युक् augment.
43143: स्थाल n. (-लं) 1 A caldron. 2 Any culinary utensil. f. (-ली) 1 An earthen pot or boiler. 2 The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suaveolens.) E. ष्ठा to stand, Uṇādi aff. आलच्.
43144: स्थालीपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Boiled, dressed in a pot or boiler. E. स्थाली a pot, पक्व cooked.
43145: स्थालीविल n. (-लं) The interior or hollow of a boiler. E. स्थाली a pot, and विल vacuity.
43146: स्थालीविलीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit to be boiled or dressed. E. स्थालीविल the interior of a pot, छ aff.; also with यत् aff. स्थालीविल्य.
43147: स्थावर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Fixed, stationary, stable, immoveable. 2 Regular, established. m. (-रः) A mountain. n. (-रं) 1 A bow-string. 2 Immoveable property, land or houses. 3 Family property, jewels, &c. which have been long in a family, and which ought not to be sold or given away. E. ष्ठा to stand, वरच् aff.
43148: स्थाविर n. (-रं) Old age, any time after seventy in men, and fifty in women. E. ष्ठा to stay, (a long time,) किरच् Uṇādi aff., and युक् augment.
43149: स्थासक m. (-कः) 1 Perfuming the person, smearing the body with fragrant unguents, as of Sandal, &c. 2 A bubble of water or any fluid. E. ष्ठा to stay, स aff., and कन् added.
43150: स्थासु n. (-सु) Bodily strength or capability. E. ष्ठा to stay, or be, सु aff.
43151: स्थास्नु mfn. (-स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु) 1 Firm, stable. 2 Durable, eternal. E. ष्ठा to stay, स्नु aff.
43152: स्थास्नुता f. (-ता) Firmness, stability. E. स्थास्नु, and तल् aff.
43154: स्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Steady, firm, immovable. 2 Stayed, stopped. 3 Determined, resolved, decreed, established. 4 Upright, virtuous, steady in conduct. 5 Agreed, engaged, contracted, promised. 6 Risen, got up. E. ष्ठा to stay or be, aff. क्त.
43155: स्थितधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Firm, unmoved, calm. E. स्थित, and धी intellect.
43156: स्थितप्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Calm, content, free from desire. E. स्थित, and प्रज्ञा wisdom.
43157: स्थितप्रेमन् m. (-मा) A faithful friend. E. स्थित established, and प्रेमन् affection.
43158: स्थितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Staying, abiding, stationary. 2 Waiting, attending. E. ष्ठा to stay, क्तवतु aff.
43159: स्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Stay, staying, being fixed or stationary. 2 Correctness of conduct, continuance in the path of duty. 3 Limit, boundary, term. 4 Stop, cessation, pause. 5 Determination, order, decree. 6 Honor, dignity. 7 (In astronomy,) Duration of an eclipse. E. ष्ठा to stay or stand, aff. क्तिन्.
43160: स्थितिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Firm, stable. 2 Steady, (in purpose, or conduct,) upright, firm, virtuous. E. स्थिति, and मतुप् aff.
43161: स्थितिस्थापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what fixes, places, &c. n. (-कं) Elasticity. E. स्थिति, and स्थापक what causes to stay.
43162: स्थित्वा ind. Having stayed, stood, stopped, been, &c. E. स्था to stay, क्त्वा aff.
43163: स्थिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Firm, fixed, steady, immovable. 2 Hard, solid. 3 Permanent, durable, lasting. 4 Firm, steady, (morally,) uninfluenced by pleasure or pain, &c. 5 Cool, collected. 6 Constant, faithful. m. (-रः) 1 A deity, an immortal. 2 KĀRTTIKEYA. 3 A mountain. 4 A tree. 5 Final emancipation from existence. 6 The planet SATURN. 7 A bull. f. (-रा) 1 The earth. 2 A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 3 A medicinal root, commonly Kākolī. 4 Silk-cotton tree. E. ष्ठा to stay or be, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
43164: स्थिरगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.) f. (-न्धा) 1 The Pandanus odoratissimus. 2 Trumpet flower. E. स्थिर lasting, and गन्ध smell.
43166: स्थिरचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तं) Firm, resolute, steady, constant. E. स्थिर firm, चेतस् the mind.
43167: स्थिरच्छद m. (-दः) The Bhojpatra or birch tree of the Himālaya mountains. E. स्थिर firm, and छद a leaf.
43168: स्थिरच्छाय m. (-यः) A tree by the road side, &c. giving shelter to travellers or persons passing. E. स्थिर lasting, and छाया shade.
43169: स्थिरजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A fish. E. स्थिर immovable, and जिह्वा the tongue.
43170: स्थिरजीविता f. (-ता) The silk-cotton tree. E. स्थिर lasting (a long time), and जीवित alive.
43171: स्थिरतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Firm, fixed, stationary. 2 Permanent, durable, eternal. E. स्थिर firm, तरप् aff.
43172: स्थिरता f. (-ता) 1 Stability, firmness. 2 Moral firmness, fortitude. E. स्थिर with तल् added; also with त्व, स्थिरत्वं.
43173: स्थिरदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A snake. 2 VIṢṆU in the boar Avatāra. E. स्थिर hard, and दंष्ट्र a tooth.
43174: स्थिरपत्र m. (-त्रः) The marshy date tree. E. स्थिर lasting, and पत्र a leaf.
43175: स्थिरपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.) 2 The Bakul, (Mimusops elengi.) E. स्थिर lasting, and पुष्प a flower.
43176: स्थिरमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Steady, firm, deliberate. E. स्थिर, and मति mind.
43177: स्थिरयोनि m. (-निः) A large tree, one that gives shade and shelter. E. स्थिर firm, lasting, and योनि place of production.
43178: स्थिरयौवन m. (-नः) A Vidyādhara, a peculiar kind of demi-god. E. स्थिर perpetual, यौवन youth.
43179: स्थिररङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) 1 Indigo. 2 Dār-haldi, a sort of Curcuma. E. स्थिर lasting, and रङ्ग colour or dye.
43180: स्थिरांह्रिप m. (-पः) The marshy date tree. E. स्थिर hard or lasting, and अंह्रिप tree.
43181: स्थिरात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 1 Firm, resolute, unmoved. 2 Stable, steady. E. स्थिर, and आत्मन् self.
43182: स्थिरायु m. (-युः) The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) E. स्थिर lasting long, and आयु or आयुस् life, whence also स्थिरायुस् m. (-युः).
43183: स्थुड r. 6th cl. (स्थुडति) To clothe or cover.
43184: स्थुरिन् m. (-री) A packhorse, a horse carrying loads: see स्थौरिन्.
43185: स्थूणा f. (-णा) 1 The post of pillar of a house. 2 An iron image. 3 An anvil. 4 A disease. E. ष्ठा to stay or stand, न Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.
43186: स्थूर m. (-रः) A man. E. ष्ठा to stay, ऊरन् Uṇādi aff.
43187: स्थूरिन् m. (-री) A packhorse or one carrying loads on his back. E. स्थूल bulk, size, इनि affix, and ल changed to र.
43188: स्थूल r. 10th cl. (स्थूलयते) To increase, to fatten, to become big or bulky.
43189: स्थूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Fat, corpulent, bulky. 2 Stupid, dull, ignorant. 3 Large, great. 4 Coarse. 5 Clumsy. n. (-लं) 1 A heap, a quantity. 2 A tent. f. (-ला) 1 A sort of pepper, (Pothos officinalis) 2 A pumpkin gourd. m. (-लः) The jack fruit tree. E. स्थूल to be large or fat, aff. अच्.
43190: स्थूलक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Large, bulky. E. स्थूल the same, कन added.
43191: स्थूलकङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) A wild sort of kidney-bean. E. स्थूल large, and कङ्गु coix.
43192: स्थूलकण्टिका f. (-का) The silk-cotton tree. E. स्थूल large, कण्ट a thorn, कन् aff.
43193: स्थूलकन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) 2 Another sort, (Arum Indicum.) E. स्थूल large, and कन्द a root.
43194: स्थूलकाय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Large bodied, corpulent. E. स्थूल, and काय body.
43195: स्थूलकाष्ठधह् m. (-धक्) The trunk of a tree or any piece of timber on fire. E. स्थूल large, काष्ठ wood, and दह burning.
43196: स्थूलकाष्ठाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A large piece of wood on fire. E. स्थूल large, काष्ठ wood, and अग्नि fire.
43197: स्थूलक्ष्वेड m. (-डः) An arrow. E. स्थूल large, and क्ष्वेड a bambu rod.
43198: स्थूलचाप m. (-पः) A bow used in cleaning cotton. E. स्थूल large, and चाप a bow.
43199: स्थूलजीरक m. (-कः) Kalonji, (Nigella Indica.) E. स्थूल large, and जीरक cumin seed.
43200: स्थूलता f. (-ता) 1 Coarseness, bulkiness. 2 Dulness, stupidity. E. तल् added to स्थूल; also with त्व, स्थूलत्वं.
43201: स्थूलदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A sort of reed, (Arundo.) E. स्थूल large, दण्ड a stick or stem.
43202: स्थूलदर्भ m. (-र्भः) A kind of grass, (Saccharum munja.) E. स्थूल large, and दर्भ Poa.
43203: स्थूलदला f. (-ला) The Aloe plant. E. स्थूल large, and दल a leaf.
43204: स्थूलधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Dull, stupid. E. स्थूल, and धी understanding.
43205: स्थूलनाल m. (-लः) A large kind of reed. E. स्थूल large, and नाल a stalk.
43206: स्थूलनास m. (-सः) A hog. E. स्थूल large, and नास for नासिका nose.
43207: स्थूलनासिक m. (-कः) A hog, a boar. E. स्थूल large, नासिका the nose, made masc. in the compound.
43208: स्थूलपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) Cotton. n. (-ट्टं) Coarse cloth. E. स्थूल, and पट्ट cloth.
43209: स्थूलपट्टाक m. (-कः) Coarse cloth. E. स्थूल large, पट्ट cloth, अक to be, aff. अच्.
43210: स्थूलपाद m. (-दः) An elephant. E. स्थूल large, and पाद a foot.
43211: स्थूलपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.) f. (-ष्पा) A flower, a sort of mountain Clitorea. E. स्थूल large, पुष्प a flower.
43212: स्थूलबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Stupid, dull. E. स्थूल, and बुद्धि understanding.
43213: स्थूलभद्र m. (-द्रः) One of the sacred personages called Śrutā Kevalīs by the Jainas.
43214: स्थूलमरिच n. (-चं) A fragrant medicinal berry, commonly Kakoli. E. स्थूल large, and मरिच black pepper.
43215: स्थूललक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Munificent, liberal. 2 Learned, well. read. 3 Remembering both benefits and offences. E. स्थूल large, much, and लक्ष mark or note.
43216: स्थूललक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 Munificent, liberal. 2 Dealing profusely or indiscriminately. 3 Recollecting benefits and injuries. 4 Taking careless aim. E. स्थूल a heap, (of wealth,) and लक्ष्य to be remarked or seen.
43217: स्थूललक्ष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Liberality. 2 Aiming carelessly. 3 Retentiveness of benefits and injuries. E. स्थूललक्ष्य, and त्व aff.
43219: स्थूलवल्कल m. (-लः) Red Lodh, a tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent in tanning, &c. E. स्थूल thick, and वल्कल bark.
43220: स्थूलशरीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Large bodied. n. (-रं) The external or material body. E. स्थूल, and शरीर body.
43221: स्थूलशाटक mf. (-टकः-टका or -टिका) Thick or coarse cloth. E. स्थूल thick, and शाटक cloth.
43222: स्थूलशाटि m. (-टिः) Coarse cloth. E. स्थूल large, and शाटि cloth.
43223: स्थूलशिरस् mfn. (-राः-राः-रः) Large-headed. n. (-रः) A large head or summit. E. स्थूल bulky, and शिरस् the head.
43224: स्थूलशीर्षिका f. (-का) A large headed ant. E. स्थूल large, शीर्ष the head, कन् aff.
43225: स्थूलहस्त n. (-स्तं) An elephant's trunk. E. स्थूल large, and हस्त the hand.
43226: स्थूलास्य m. (-स्यः) A snake. E. स्थल large, and आस्य face or head.
43227: स्थूलिन् m. (-ली) A camel. E. स्थूल large, इनि aff.
43228: स्थूलीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thick, bulky. 2 Stupid. E. स्थूल, and भूत become, with च्चि aff.
43229: स्थूलोच्चय m. (-यः) 1 Incompleteness, deficiency, defect. 2 The middle pace of an elephant, neither quick nor slow. 3 Pimples on the face. 4 A hill at the foot of a mountain, or a rocky fragment detached from its primitive site and forming a separate projection or promontory. 5 A hollow at the root of the elephant's tusks. E. स्थूल large, and उच्चय lofty.
43231: स्थेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be fixed or determined. 2 To be placed. m. (-यः) 1 A judge, an arbitrator, one who decides upon a dispute between two parties. 2 A domestic priest. E. ष्ठा to stand, यत् aff.
43232: स्थेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Firm, stable, fixed. 2 Eternal, permanent. E. स्थिर firm, ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative, and स्था substituted for the adjective.
43233: स्थेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Firm, stable, fixed, durable. E. स्थिर firm, इष्ठन् aff., and स्था substituted for the primitive.
43234: स्थैर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Firmness, stability. 2 Firmness of mind, resolution, fortitude. E. स्थिर, and ष्यञ् aff.
43235: स्थोरिन् m. (-री) A pack-horse: see स्थोरिन्.
43236: स्थौणेय n. (-यं) A sort of perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. E. स्थूणा an image, ढक् aff.; also with कन् added, स्थौणेयक.
43237: स्थौर n. (-रं) 1 Strength, power. 2 A load for a horse or ass, &c. E. स्थूल large, bulky, अण् aff., and ल changed to र.
43238: स्थौरिन् m. (-री) 1 A pack-horse, one that carries burthens on his back like an ox or ass. 2 A strong horse. E. स्थौर strength, इनि aff., or according to some authorities स्थुरा a pack-saddle, इनि aff., deriv. irr.; it is also read स्थूरिन्, स्थुरिन्, and स्थोरिन्.
43239: स्थौलशीर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Large-headed, having or relating to a large head or summit. E. स्थूल large, शिरस् the head, अण् aff.
43240: स्थौल्य n. (-ल्यं) Bulk, size, coarseness, largeness. E. स्थूल, and ष्यञ् aff.
43241: स्थ्यूम m. (-मः) 1 Light, lustre. 2 The moon.
43242: स्नपन n. (-नं) 1 Bathing, ablution. 2 Washing, sprinkling, wetting. E. ष्णा to bathe or purify by bathing, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
43243: स्नपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sprinkled, wetted, bathed, washed. E. ष्णा to bathe, causal form, aff. क्त.
43244: स्नव m. (-वः) Oozing, dripping, trickling. E. ष्णु to distil or ooze, aff. अप्.
43245: स्नसा f. (-सा) A tendon, a muscle. E. स्नस to eject, aff. अच्.
43246: स्नात् mfn. (-स्नान्-स्नान्ती-स्नात्) Bathing, performing ablution. E. ष्णा to bathe, शतृ aff.
43247: स्नात m. (-तः-ता-तं) Bathed, washed, purified, (by ablution.) m. (-तः) An initiated householder: see the next. E. ष्णा to bathe, aff. क्त.
43248: स्नातक m. (-कः) An initiated householder, a man of the three first classes, who having completed the term prescribed for his studies becomes a housekeeper: if at the end of this period, he has not acquired a knowledge of the Veda, he is called Vratasnātaka; if he has acquired that knowledge earlier, he is termed Vidyāsnātaka; and if he finishes his regular studies at the same time that the period of study expires, he is named Ubhayasnātaka. E. कन् added to the last.
43249: स्नात्वा ind. Having bathed. E. ष्णा to bathe, क्त्वा aff.
43250: स्नान n. (-नं) 1 Bathing, ablution, purification by bathing. 2 Any thing proper for ablution, water, perfumed powder for the body, &c. E. ष्णा to bathe, ल्युट् aff.
43251: स्नानतृण n. (-णं) Kuśa, grass. E. स्नान ablution, and तृण grass.
43252: स्नानवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A cloth put on at or after bathing. E. स्नान, and वस्त्र clothes.
43253: स्नानशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bathing, performing ablution, (especially in sacred waters.) E. स्नान, and शील practising.
43254: स्नानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Ablutionary, fit or proper for bathing in, or to be used at bathing, as perfumed powders, &c. n. (-यं) Water or other article proper for bathing. E. स्नान ablution, and छ aff.
43255: स्नापक m. (-कः) A servant who brings water, or who applies it in bathing. E. ष्णा to bathe, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
43256: स्नायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) A bather, a performer of ablutions. E. ष्णा to bathe, णिनि aff., युक् augment.
43257: स्नायु f. (-युः) A tendon, a muscle, described as a tubular vessel attached to the bones at either end, and carrying vital air. E. ष्णा to bathe, उण् Uṇādi aff., and युक् augment.
43258: स्नाव m. (-वः) A tendon, a muscle.
43259: स्निट r. 10th cl. (स्नेटयति) 1 To be greasy or unctuous. 2 To fuse or melt.
43260: स्निग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Smooth, oily, unctuous, greasy. 2 Amiable, kind, affectionate. 3 Coarse, thick. 4 Cooling, emollient. m. (-ग्धः) A friend. f. (-ग्धा) Marrow. n. (-ग्धं) 1 Bees's wax. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Thickness, coarseness. m. (-ग्धः) 1 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) 2 Another kind, (Pinus longifolia.) E. ष्णिह to be unctuous, aff. क्त.
43261: स्निग्धता f. (-ता) 1 Affection, kindness. 2 Unctuousness, oiliness. E. स्निग्ध affectionate, तल् aff. of the abstract; also स्निग्धत्व n. (-त्वं.)
43262: स्निग्धतण्डुल m. (-लः) Rice of quick growth. E. स्निग्ध oily, तण्डुल grain.
43263: स्निग्धदारु n. (-रुः) 1 A pine, (Pinus longifolia.) 2 Another kind, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. स्निग्ध unctuous, and दारु wood.
43264: स्निग्धपत्र mf. (-त्रः-त्रा) The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. स्निग्ध unctuous, and पत्र a leaf.
43265: स्नु mn. (-स्नुः-स्नु) Table land, the level summit or edge of a mountain. E. ष्णु to trickle, (the water or snow from it,) डु aff.
43266: स्नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowing, dropping, oozing, trickling, distilled. E. ष्णु to ooze, aff. क्त.
43267: स्नुषा f. (-षा) 1 A daughter-in-law. 2 The milk-hedge plant. E. ष्णु to distil, Uṇādi aff. स.
43268: स्नुह् f. (-स्नुक्) The milk-hedge plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum, &c.) E. ष्णुह to vomit, (its milk being used as an emetic,) aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added, स्नुहा.
43269: स्नुहि f. (-हिः-ही) A plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum.) E. ष्णुह to vomit, (see the last,) कि aff., and ङीष् optionally added.
43270: स्नेह m. (-हः) 1 Affection, kindness. 2 Oil, unguent, grease, any unctuous or greasy substance. 3 Oiliness, lubricity, viscidity. E. ष्णीह to be unctuous, &c., aff. घञ्.
43271: स्नेहछेद m. (-दः) Cessation or loss of regard. E. स्नेह, and छेद severing.
43272: स्नेहन् m. (-हा) 1 A friend. 2 The moon. 3 A disease. E. ष्णिह to be affectionate, &c., कनिन् Uṇādi aff.
43273: स्नेहन n. (-नं) 1 Unctuousness, being or becoming oily, &c. 2 Anointing, unction, rubbing with unguents, oil, &c. 3 An emollient, an unguent, or liniment. E. ष्णिह to be unctuous, ल्युट् aff.
43274: स्नेहपक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Dressed with oil. E. स्नेह, and पक्व cooked.
43275: स्नेहप्रिय m. (-यः) A lamp. E. स्नेह oil, and प्रिय fond of.
43276: स्नेहभू m. (-भूः) The phlegmatic humor. E. स्नेह oily substance, and भू born.
43277: स्नेहभूमि m. (-मिः) 1 An object of affection. 2 Any substance yielding oil or grease. E. स्नेह, and भूमि site.
43278: स्नेहरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Sesamum. E. स्नेह oil, रङ्ग colour.
43279: स्नेहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Affectionate. 2 Unctuous, oily. E. स्नेह, and मतुप् aff.
43280: स्नेहविद्ध m. (-द्धः) A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. स्नेह oil, and विद्ध pierced, impregnated.
43281: स्नेहाक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Oiled, greased, lubricated. E. स्नेह, and अक्त anointed.
43282: स्नेहानुवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Affectionate or friendly intercourse. E. स्नेह, and अनुवृत्ति practice.
43283: स्नेहाश m. (-शः) A lamp. E. स्नेह oil, and अश what consumes.
43284: स्नेहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Kind, affectionate. 2 Beloved, the object of affection. m. (-तः) A friend. E. स्नेह affection, इतच् aff.
43285: स्नेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Affectionate, friendly. 2 Oily, unctuous. m. (-ही) 1 A friend. 2 A painter. E. स्नेह affection, &c., इनि aff.
43286: स्नेहु m. (-हुः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 The moon. E. ष्णिह to be unctuous, उ Uṇādi aff.
43287: स्नैग्ध्य n. (-ग्ध्यं) 1 Oiliness, smoothness, lubricity. 2 Affectionateness. E. स्निग्ध, and ष्यञ् aff.
43288: स्पद (इ) स्पदि r. 1st cl. (स्पन्दते) 1 To quake, to shake, to tremble slightly, to throb, to beat. 2 To go, to move.
43289: स्पन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Beating, throbbing, pulsation, quivering. 2 Quickening of the child in the womb. 3 Going. E. स्पदि to throb, ल्युट् aff.
43290: स्पन्दमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Throbbing, beating. 2 Going. E. स्पदि to beat, शानच् aff.
43291: स्पन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Throbbing, beating. 2 Gone. n. (-तं) Pulsation. E. स्पदि to throb, क्त aff.
43292: स्परितृ m. (-ता) The agent or active cause of pain or distress, as an enemy, an oppressor, a disease, &c. E. स्पृ to breathe, aff. तृच्, with इट् augment.
43293: स्पर्द्ध r. 1st cl. (स्पर्द्धते) To vie, to envy, to desire another's reduction.
43294: स्पर्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं) Envious, emulous. E. स्पर्द्ध envy, अच् aff.
43295: स्पर्द्धता f. (-ता) Enviousness, emulation. E. स्पर्द्ध, and तल् aff.
43296: स्पर्द्धा f. (-र्द्धा) 1 Envy, emulation, rivalry. 2 Equality, sameness. 3 Successive elevation. E. स्पर्द्धा to envy or vie with, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
43297: स्पर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Vied or contended with, defied. E. स्पर्द्ध to vie with, क्त aff.
43298: स्पर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिणी-र्द्धि) 1 Emulous, envious. 2 Superb, gorgeous. E. स्पर्द्धा, and इनि aff.
43299: स्पर्श r. 10th cl. (स्पर्शयति) 1 To take. 2 To unite, to join.
43300: स्पर्श m. (-र्शः) 1 Touch, contact. 2 The thing touching or feeling. 3 Gift, donation. 4 Sickness, disease. 5 Morbid heat. 6 A consonant of either of the five first classes of the alphabet. 7 An enemy, a disease, &c., the agent or instrument of pain, trouble, or distress. 8 Air, wind. f. (-र्शा) A wanton, an unchaste woman. E. स्पृश to touch, aff. घञ्.
43301: स्पर्शक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Touching, toucher, that which touches or is in contact with. E. स्पृश to touch, ण्वुल् aff.
43302: स्पर्शन n. (-नं) 1 Touch, contact. 2 Gift, donation. m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. स्पृश to touch, ल्युट् or युच् aff.
43303: स्पर्शनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) What is to be or may be touched, sensible, tangible. E. स्पृश to touch, अनीयर् aff.
43304: स्पर्शमणि m. (-णिः) A stone, the philosopher's stone, converting every thing it touches to gold. E. स्पर्श touch, मणि a gem.
43305: स्पर्शमणिप्रभव n. (-वं) Gold. E. स्पर्शमणि a stone, and प्रभव production.
43306: स्पर्शलज्जा f. (-ज्जाः) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. स्पर्श the touch, and लज्जा ashamed.
43307: स्पर्शशुद्धा f. (-द्धा) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. स्पर्श touch, and शुद्धा pure.
43308: स्पर्शस्पन्द m. (-न्दः) A frog. E. स्पर्श the touch, and स्पन्द who goes.
43309: स्पर्शानन्दा f. (-न्दा) One of the Apsarasas. E. स्पर्श touch, आनन्द delighting.
43310: स्पर्ष्टृ m. (-र्ष्टा) 1 Morbid heat. 2 The agent or instrument of bodily pain. E. स्पृश to touch, aff. तृच्.
43311: स्पश r. 1st cl. (स्पशति-ते) 1 To obstruct, to oppose. 2 To string together. 3 To touch. 4 To make evident or clear. 5 To inform. r. 10th cl. (स्पाशयते) 1 To take. 2 To unite, to connect, or join.
43312: स्पश m. (-शः) 1 A spy, a secret agent or emissary. 2 War, battle. 3 Fighting with a dangerous animal, as a tiger, a buffalo, &c. for reward. E. स्पश to inform, aff. अच्.
43313: स्पष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Evident, manifest, apparent. 2 Clear, easy, intelligible. E. स्पश to make clear, aff. क्त.
43314: स्पष्टार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Clear, perspicuous, intelligible. E. स्पष्ट, and अर्थ sense.
43315: स्पष्टीकरण n. (-णं) Making clear or intelligible. E. स्पष्ट, and करण making, च्चि augment.
43316: स्पष्टीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Explained, expounded, elucidated, made clear, and intelligible. 2 Made manifest, revealed, exposed. E. स्पष्ट easy, clear, च्चि augment, and कृत made.
43317: स्पाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Caused to be stopped, hindered, &c. E. स्पश to stop, causal v., क्त aff. form, irr.
43318: स्पृ r. 5th. cl. (स्पृणोति) 1 To please, to gratify. 2 To cherish, to protect. 3 To breathe, to live.
43319: स्पृक्का f. (-क्का) A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. स्पृश to touch, कक् aff., form. irr.; also पृक्का.
43320: स्पृश r. 6th cl. (स्पृशति) To touch, to take with the hand. With उप, 1 To tread upon. 2 To bathe, to sip water, &c.
43321: स्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Who or what touches. E. स्पृश to touch, क्विप् aff.
43322: स्पृशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती-शन्ती-शत्) Touching. E. स्पृश to touch, शतृ aff.
43323: स्पृशा f. (-शा) A plant, commonly Kaṅkālī. E. स्पृश to touch, अङ् and टाप् affs.
43324: स्पृशी f. (-शी) A prickly nightshade, (Solanum Jacquini.) E. स्पृश to touch, क and ङीष् affs.
43325: स्पृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) What may be or is to be felt or touched. E. स्पृश to touch, यत् aff.
43326: स्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Touched, felt. E. स्पृश to touch, aff. क्त.
43327: स्पृष्टव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is to be or may be touched, felt, &c., स्पृश to touch, तव्य aff.
43328: स्पृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Touch, feeling, contact. E. स्पृश to touch, क्तिन् aff.
43329: स्पृष्ट्वा ind. Having felt or touched. E. स्पृश to touch, क्त्वा aff.
43330: स्पृह r. 10th cl. (स्पृहयति) To wish, to desire, to long for.
43331: स्पृहयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Desiring, wishing. E. स्पृह to desire, शानच् aff.
43332: स्पृहा f. (-हा) Wish, desire. E. स्पृह to wish, अङ् and टाप् affs.
43333: स्पृहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Desirable, to be wished. E. स्पृह to wish, अनीयर् aff.
43334: स्पृहयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Wishing, desiring, cupidinous. E. स्पृह to wish, आलुच् aff., and युक augment.
43335: स्पृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be wished, desirable. m. (-ह्यः) A large kind of lime. E. स्पृह to wish, aff. क्यप्.
43336: स्प्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what touches, &c. m. (-ष्टा) 1 Morbid heat. 2 The agent or instrumental cause of pain or distress, as an enemy, a disease, &c. E. स्पृश to touch, तृच् aff., and the first ऋ converted to र.
43337: स्फट r. 1st cl. (स्फटति) 1 To open, to unfold, to burst. 2 To break or divide.
43338: स्फट mf. (-टः-टा) A snake's expanded neck or hood. f. (-टी) Alum. E. स्फुट to swell, aff. क, and the vowel changed to अ.
43339: स्फटिक m. (-कः) Crystal. E. स्फुट to expand, क्वुन् aff., and the vowel changed.
43340: स्फटिकप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Crystalline, transparent. E. स्फटिक, and प्रभा light.
43341: स्फटिकमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of crystal. E. स्फटिक, and मयट् aff.
43342: स्फटिकाचल m. (-लः) Mount Kailāsa. E. स्फटिक crystal, and अचल a mountain.
43343: स्फटिकाद्रिभिद m. (-दः) Camphor. E. स्फटिकाद्रि Kailāsa, and भिद what breaks, what shames, being whiter.
43344: स्फटिकाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) Crystal. E. स्फटिक the same, and अश्मन् a stone.
43345: स्फड (इ) स्फडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (स्फण्डति-स्फण्डयति) To jest or joke with, to smile or laugh at.
43346: स्फर r. 6th cl. (स्फरति) 1 To throb, to beat, to tremble. 2 To move. 3 To be manifest.
43347: स्फरण n. (-णं) Throbbing, trembling. E. स्फर to throb, aff. ल्युट्.
43348: स्फल r. 6th cl. (स्फलति) 1 To throb, to beat, to tremble. 2 To move. 3 To be manifest.
43349: स्फाटक m. (-कः) A drop of water. E. स्फट to break, वुञ् aff.
43350: स्फाटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Crystalline, made &c. of crystal. n. (-कं) Crystal. E. स्फटिक the same, and अण् aff.
43351: स्फाटिकोपल n. (-लं) Crystal. E. स्फाटिक the same, and उपला a stone.
43352: स्फाटीक n. (-कं) Crystal: E. see स्फटिक.
43353: स्फात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Swollen, enlarged. E. स्फायी to increase, aff. क्त.
43354: स्फाति f. (-तिः) 1 Increase, growth. 2 Swelling, intumescence. E. स्फाय to increase, क्तिन् aff., and the final rejected.
43355: स्फाय (ई) स्फायी r. 1st cl. (स्फायते) To grow, to increase, to become large or bulky.
43356: स्फार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Large, great. 2 Loud. m. (-रः) 1 Throbbing, quivering. 2 A bubble or flaw in gold, &c. 3 Twanging as of a bow-string. E. स्फर to throb, aff. घञ्, or स्फाय to swell, रक् Uṇādi aff., and the radical final rejected.
43357: स्फारण n. (-णं) Throbbing, shaking, trembling. E. स्फर to throb, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
43358: स्फाल m. (-लः) Throbbing, quivering, trembling, shaking. E. स्फल to shake, घञ् aff.
43359: स्फालन n. (-नं) 1 Shaking, quivering. 2 Rubbing, friction. 3 Rubbing or patting a horse. E. स्फल to shake, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
43360: स्फावयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Increasing, augmenting. E. स्फाय to increase, शतृ aff., वङ् inserted.
43361: स्फिक्घातनक m. (-कः) A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal.
43362: स्फिच् f. du. (-चौ) The buttocks. E. स्फाय to swell, डिच् aff. or स्फिट to hurt, aff. क्विप्, form irr.
43363: स्फिट r. 10th cl. (स्फेटयति) 1 To hurt, to injure, or kill. 2 To cover.
43364: स्फिट्ट r. 10th cl. (स्फिट्टयति) 1 To hurt, to injure, to kill. 2 To dwell. 3 To give. 4 To be strong.
43365: स्फिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Much, many. E. स्फाय to swell, किरच् aff. deriv. irr.
43366: स्फीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Much, many. 2 Swollen, enlarged. 3 Successful, prosperous, risen in rank or fortune. 4 Affected by hereditary disease. E. स्फायी to swell, aff. क्त; also स्फात.
43367: स्फीति f. (-तिः) 1 Increase, enlargement. 2 Prosperity. E. स्फाय to swell, क्तिन् aff.
43368: स्फुट r. 1st cl. (स्फेटते) r. 6th cl. (स्फुटति) To blow, to blossom, to open as a bud or flower. r. 10th cl. (स्फोटयति or with आङ् prefixed आस्फोटयति) also (इर) स्फुटिर r. 1st cl. (स्फोटति) and (इ) स्फुटि r. 1st cl. (स्फुण्टति) 1 To divide, to break, to tear, to pierce. 2 To hurt or kill. स्फुटि r. 10th cl. (स्फुण्टयति) To laugh at or with, to jest, to joke.
43369: स्फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Blown, opened, expanded, (as a flower.) 2 Apparent, manifest, evident. 3 Known, understood. 4 Plain, distinct. 5 Spread, diffused. 6 White. 7 Burst, broken. 8 Rent, torn. 9 (In astronomy,) True or apparent, as स्फुटसूर्य्यगतिः true or apparent motion of the sun. f. (-टा) The expanded hood of a snake. E. स्फुट to blow, as a flower, &c. aff. क.
