43370: स्फुटत् mfn. (-टन्-टन्ती-टती-टत्) 1 Bursting, blowing. 2 Becoming manifest or clear. 3 Evolving. E. स्फुट to blow, शतृ aff.
43371: स्फुटता f. (-ता) 1 Manifestation, evidence. 2 Blossoming. E. स्फुट, and तल् aff.
43372: स्फुटन n. (-नं) 1 Tearing, rending. 2 Opening, expanding. E. स्फुट to blow, ल्युट् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also स्फोटन.
43373: स्फुटफल n. (-लं) (In geometry,) Distinct or precise area. E. ष्फुट, and फल fruit.
43374: स्फुटवल्कली f. (-ली) Heart-pea. E. स्फुट burst, and वल्कल bark or rind.
43375: स्फुटार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Intelligible, obvious, significant. E. स्फुट, and अर्थ sense.
43376: स्फुटि f. (-टिः-टी) 1 Kibe, swelling of the feet. 2 A sort of melon, (Cucumis momordica, Rox.) E. स्फुट to open or break, and कि aff., with ङीष् optionally added.
43377: स्फुटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Budded, blown. 2 Broken, burst. E. स्फुट to blow, aff. क्त.
43379: स्फुड r. 6th cl. (स्फुडति) To clothe, to cover. (इ) स्फुडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (स्फुण्डति-स्फुण्डयति) To laugh at, to jest, to joke.
43380: स्फुत्कार m. (-रः) Crackling, burning. E. स्फुत् imitative sound, and कार making.
43381: स्फुर r. 6th cl. (स्फुरति) 1 To throb, to beat. 2 To move. 3 To swell.
43382: स्फुर m. (-रः) 1 A shield. 2 Throbbing, trembling. 3 Swelling. E. स्फुर to shake, &c., aff. क.
43383: स्फुरण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Trembling, throbbing, pulsation. 2 Quivering of the lips, throbbing of the eyes, &c. 3 Expansion of mind. E. स्फुर to shake, aff. ल्युट् or युच्, and the radical vowel unchanged.
43384: स्फुरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) 1 Quivering, trembling, shaking, throbbing. 2 Expanding, swelling. 3 Going, moving. 4 Going tremulously. 5 Darting, starting. E. स्फुर to swell, &c., aff. शतृ.
43385: स्फुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, agitated. 2 Trembling, heaving, throbbing, palpitating. 3 Swelled, swollen. n. (-तं) 1 Trembling or throbbing of the eye-lids. E. स्फुर to move or swell, aff. क्त.
43386: स्फुर्च्छ (आ) स्फुर्च्छा r. 1st cl. (स्फुर्च्छति) 1 To spread, to expand. 2 To forget.
43387: स्फुर्ज्ज r. 1st cl. (स्फुर्ज्जति) To thunder: more properly स्फूर्ज्ज.
43388: स्फुर्ज्जक m. (-कः) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. स्फुर्ज्ज to make a noise like thunder, (on being burnt,) aff. वुन्; also स्फूर्ज्जक.
43389: स्फुर्ज्जथु m. (-थुः) A clap of thunder. E. स्फुर्ज्ज to sound as thunder, अथुच् aff.
43390: स्फुल r. 6th cl. (स्फुलति) 1 To throb. 2 To heap or crowd. 3 To be manifest or apparent. 4 To go or move.
43391: स्फुल n. (-लं) A tent. E. स्फुल to expand, aff. क.
43392: स्फुलण n. (-णं) Throbbing, trembling. E. स्फुर to shake, aff. ल्युट्, and ल substituted for र.
43393: स्फुलिङ्ग mfn. subst. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) A spark of fire. E. स्फु for स्फुत् imitative sound, लिगि to go, aff. अच्.
43394: स्फुलिङ्गिनी f. (-नी) One, of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire. E. स्फुलिङ्ग a spark, इनि and ङीप् affs.
43395: स्फूर्ज्ज (ओ आ) ओस्फूर्ज्जा r. 1st cl. (स्फूर्ज्जति) To thunder.
43396: स्फूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) 1 The sound of thunder. 2 INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. स्फूर्ज्ज to sound, as thunder, aff. अच्.
43397: स्फूर्ज्जक m. (-कः) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. स्फूर्ज्ज to sound like thunder, (in the fire, from its abounding with resin,) वुन् aff.
43398: स्फूर्ज्जथु m. (-थुः) A clap of thunder, the sound of falling thunder, or that immediately following a stroke of lightning. E. स्फूर्ज्ज to sound as thunder, अथुच् aff.
43399: स्फूर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Thundering. E. स्फूर्ज्ज, and ल्युट् aff.
43400: स्फूर्ज्जावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Thundering. E. स्फूर्ज्ज, and मतुप् aff.
43401: स्फूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Throbbing, palpitating, shaking. E. स्फुर to shake, aff. क्तिन्, and the vowel made long.
43402: स्फूर्त्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Kind-hearted. 2 Tremulous, agitated. E. स्फूर्त्ति agitation, मतुप् aff., and the म retained.
43403: स्फेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very much or many. E. स्फिर many, ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative, form irr.
43404: स्फेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very much or many. E. स्फिर much, इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, form irr.
43405: स्फोट m. (-टः) 1 A boil, a tumor. 2 Breaking, bursting. f. (-टा) The hood of the snake. E. स्फुट to break or open, aff. घञ्.
43406: स्फोटक m. (-कः) A boil, a tumor. f. (-टिका) A sort of bird. E. स्फुट to burst, ण्वुल् aff.
43407: स्फोटन n. (-नं) 1 Tearing, rending. 2 Fidgetting with the hand, cracking the finger-joints, snapping the fingers, &c. f. (-नी) A gimblet, an auger. E. स्फुट to open, (as a flower, &c.) causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
43408: स्फोटायन m. (-नः) A Muni so named.
43409: स्फोटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Torn, rent. 2 Made to open or burst. E. स्फुट to break, causal v., क्त aff.
43410: स्फ्य m. (-स्फ्यः) An implement used in sacrifices, a piece of wood shaped like a sword, for stirring the boiled rice, or according to some for trimming the mound used as an altar.
43411: स्बृ r. 9th cl. (स्बृणाति-स्बृणीते) To hurt, to kill.
43412: स्म ind. 1 An expletive. 2 A particle which added to verbs in the present tense gives them a past sense, as हन्तिस्मरावणंरामः RĀMA killed (instead of kills) RĀVAṆA. E. षो to end or destroy, ङ्म aff., or ष्मिङ to smile, aff. ड.
43413: स्मय m. (-यः) 1 Pride, arrogance. 2 Surprise, astonishment. E. स्मि to smile, अच् aff.
43414: स्मर m. (-रः) 1 KĀMADEVA, the deity of love. 2 Recollection. E. स्मृ to remember, अच् aff.
43415: स्मरकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Lasciviousness, wanton pleasures. E. स्मर, and कर्म्मन् act.
43416: स्मरकूपक mf. (-पकः-पिका) Pudendum muliebre. E. स्मर KĀMA, कूप a well, and कन् aff. of comparison.
43417: स्मरगुरु m. (-रुः) VIṢṆU. E. स्मर love, गुरु the spiritual or natural father.
43418: स्मरगृह n. (-हं) The vulva. E. स्मर KĀMA, and गृह mansion.
43419: स्मरच्छत्र n. (-त्रं) The clitoris. E. स्मर love, च्छत्र an umbrella.
43420: स्मरण n. (-णं) 1 Recollecting, remembering, memory, recollection 2 Regretting, remembering with regret. E. स्मृ to remember, aff. ल्युट्.
43421: स्मरणापत्यतर्पक m. (-कः) A turtle, a tortoise. E. स्मरण memory, अपत्य offspring, and तर्पक who pleases.
43422: स्मरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit or proper to be remembered. E. स्मृ to remember, अनीयर् aff.
43423: स्मरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Remembering, recollecting, considering. E. स्मृ to remember, शतृ aff.
43424: स्मरध्वज m. (-जः) 1 Any musical instrument. 2 The penis. 3 A sort of fabulous fish or marine monster, the emblem of KĀMADEVA. n. (-जं) The vulva. f. (-जा) A bright moonlight night. E. स्मर KĀMA, and ध्वज emblem.
43425: स्मरप्रिया f. (-या) RATI, the wife of KĀMA. E. स्मर the deity of love, and प्रिया wife.
43426: स्मरमन्दिर n. (-रं) Pudendum muliebre. E. स्मर love, and मन्दिर abode.
43427: स्मरमोह m. (-हः) Passion, love. E. स्मर, and मोह fascination.
43428: स्मरमोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Overcome by love or passion. E. स्मर, and मोहित bewildered.
43429: स्मरलेखनी f. (-नी) The Sārika, (Turdus salica,) or Maina, (Gracula religiosa.) E. स्मर love, लेखनी a pen, a writing.
43430: स्मरवल्लभ m. (-भः) ANIRUDDHA. E. स्मर KĀMA, and वल्लभ beloved.
43431: स्मरवीथिका f. (-का) A harlot. E. स्मर love, वीथि a shop, कन् aff.
43432: स्मरसख m. (-खः) The moon. E. स्मर CUPID, and सख a friend.
43433: स्मरस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) The penis. E. स्मर CUPID, and स्तम्भ post.
43434: स्मरस्मर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) An ass. E. स्मर KĀMA, and स्मर्य्य to be remembered.
43435: स्मरहर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. E. स्मर the deity of love, and हर destroying.
43436: स्मराकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) In love. E. स्मर, and आकुल overcome; also स्मराकुलित.
43437: स्मरागार n. (-रं) The vulva. E. स्मर love, आगार abode.
43438: स्मराङ्कुश m. (-शः) 1 A finger nail. 2 A lover, a lecher. E. स्मर love, and अङ्कुश a goad.
43439: स्मरातुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Overcome with love or passion. E. स्मर, and आतुर perplexed.
43440: स्मरान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Infatuated with love. E. स्मर, and अन्ध blind.
43441: स्मरार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Overcome or agitated by love. E. स्मर, and आर्त्त pained.
43442: स्मरासव m. (-वः) Saliva. E. स्मर love, आसव wine.
43443: स्मरोत्सुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Devoted to love. E. स्मर, and उत्सुक fond of.
43444: स्मर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit or proper to be remembered. E. स्मृ to remember, तव्य aff.
43445: स्मर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being remembered. E. स्मृ to remember, pass. v., शानच् aff.
43446: स्मारण n. (-णं) Calling to mind, reminding, causing to remember. E. स्मृ to remember, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
43447: स्मारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Called to memory, caused to remember. E. स्मृ to remember, causal v., क्त aff.
43448: स्मार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ती-र्त्तं) 1 Legal, canonical, according to the doctrines of the Smṛtis or inspired codes of law. 2 Following or professing the doctrine of the law books. 3 Memorial, relating to memory. 4 Within memory, what may be remembered. m. (-र्त्तः) A Brahman following the revealed law. E. स्मृति law collectively, and अण् aff. of reference, &c.
43449: स्मार्त्तकाल m. (-लः) Time to which memory may extend; according to the jurists, as far as a century. E. स्मार्त्त, and काल time.
43450: स्मि r. 10th cl. (स्माययते) To slight. r. 1st cl. (स्मयते) To smile. Also ष्मिङ्.
43451: स्मिट r. 10th cl. (स्मेटयति) To slight, to disregard, to disrespect.
43452: स्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Smiling. 2 Blown, (as a flower.) n. (-तं) A smile, a gentle laugh. E. ष्मि to smile, aff. क्त.
43453: स्मितदृश् f. (-दृक्) A handsome woman. E. स्मित, and दृश् the eye.
43454: स्मितशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Smiling, laughing. E. स्मित, and शालिन् having.
43455: स्मील r. 1st cl. (स्मीलति) To wink, to twinkle, to close or contract like the eyelids.
43456: स्मृ r. 1st cl. (स्मरति) 1 To remember, to recollect, to call to mind. 2 To remember with regret, to miss. r. 5th cl. (स्मृणोति) 1 To please or delight. 2 To guard, to protect, to cherish. 3 To breathe or live. With वि prefixed, To forget.
43457: स्मृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Recollected, remembered, called to mind. E. स्मृ to remember, aff. क्त.
43458: स्मृति f. (-तिः) 1 Recollection, remembrance, memory. 2 Law, the body of law, as delivered originally by MANU, YĀJÑAVALKYA, and other inspired legislators, to their respective pupils, and committed by them from recollection to writing. 3 A law book, a code of laws. 4 Wish, desire. 5 Understanding. E. स्मृ to remember, aff. क्तिन्.
43459: स्मृतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Remembering, recollecting, having a good memory. E. स्मृति memory, मतुप् aff.
43460: स्मृतिविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Illegal, unjust, contrary to law. E. स्मृति jurisprudence, and विरुद्ध opposed.
43461: स्मृतिविरोध m. (-धः) 1 Opposition to law, illegality, impropriety. 2 Disagreement between two or more codes of law. E. स्मृति, and विरोध opposition.
43462: स्मृतिशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A work on law, a code, a digest, &c. as the Menu Saṃhitā, the Mitākṣarā, &c. E. स्मृति law, and शास्त्र an inspired treatise.
43463: स्मृतिहेतु m. (-तुः) The proximate cause of recollection, the act of the mind by which any thing is called to memory, association, recollection. E. स्मृति memory, and हेतु cause.
43464: स्मृत्यपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Illegal, unjust. 2 Forgotten. E. स्मृति law, or memory, अप implying reverse, and इत gone.
43465: स्मृत्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Enjoined, prescribed, laid down in codes of law. E. स्मृति, and उक्त said.
43466: स्मेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Smiling, laughing. 2 Blown, opened, expanded, (as a flower.) 3 Evident, apparent. m. (-रः) Manifestation, appearance. E. ष्मि to smile, रन् aff.
43467: स्मेरमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Having a smiling look. E. स्मेर, and मुख face.
43468: स्मेरविष्किर m. (-रः) A peacock. E. स्मेर smiling, and विष्किर a bird.
43469: स्यद m. (-दः) Speed, velocity. E. स्यन्द to go, घञ् aff., and the nasal rejected.
43470: स्यन r. 10th cl. (स्यनयते) To think, to consider, to reflect.
43471: स्यन्द (ऊ) स्यन्दू r. 1st cl. (स्यन्दते) 1 To sprinkle, to drop, to ooze or distil. 2 To go. With अनु prefixed, अनुष्यन्दते or अनुस्यन्दते to drop, &c.; the sibilant being optionally changed after this and other prepositions.
43472: स्यन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 Oozing, trickling. 2 Going, moving. 3 A car, a chariot. E. स्यन्द to go, aff. घञ्.
43473: स्यन्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Quick, expeditious. m. (-नः) 1 A warchariot. 2 A tree, (Dalbergia ougeinensis.) 3 A Jina of the past era. 4 Air, wind. n. (-नं) 1 Dropping, oozing, trickling. 2 Water. 3 Going swiftly. f. (-नी) Saliva. E. स्यन्द to go, युच् or ल्युट् aff.
43474: स्यन्दनद्रुम m. (-मः) A timber tree, (Dalbergia ougeinensis.) E. स्यन्दन a car, and द्रुम a tree; the wood being used to make wheels, &c.
43475: स्यन्दनारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted on or riding in a car. E. स्यन्दन, and आरूढ ascended.
43476: स्यन्दनारोह m. (-हः) A warrior who fights in a car. E. स्यन्दन a war-chariot, and आरोह who ascends.
43477: स्यन्दनि m. (-निः) A tree, (Dalbergia ougeinensis.) E. स्यन्दन a car, ञि aff.
43478: स्यन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) 1 Oozing, trickling, dropping. 2 Going, moving. f. (-न्दिनी) 1 Saliva. 2 A cow bearing twins. E. स्यन्द to drop or flow, aff. णिनि.
43479: स्यन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Flowing, dropping, or trickling. E. स्यन्द to drop, aff. क्त.
43480: स्यम (उ) स्यमु r. 6th cl. (स्यमति) To sound. r. 10th cl. (स्यमयति-ते) To consider, to think.
43481: स्यमन्तक m. (-कः) The gem worn by KṚṢṆA.
43482: स्यमीक m. (-कः) 1 An ant-hill. 2 A tree. 3 Time. 4 A cloud. f. (-का) Indigo. E. स्यम to sound, कन् Uṇādi aff. with ईट् augment; also with इट्, स्यमिक.
43483: स्यात् ind. It may be: implying doubt, as स्यादस्ति, स्यान्नास्ति it may be, it may not be. E. the verbal conditional form used as a particle.
43484: स्याल m. (-लः) A wife's brother. E. स्यम to consider, aff. अच्, and म changed to ल; also स्याल.
43486: स्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sewn, stitched. m. (-तः) A sack. E. (-षिव) to sew, aff. क्त.
43487: स्यूति f. (-तिः) 1 Sewing, stitching, working with needle and thread. 2 Offspring, lineage. 3 A sack. E. षिव to sew, aff. क्तिन्.
43488: स्यून m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 A sack. E. षिव to sew, Uṇādi aff. न, and यूच् substituted for the last two radical letters; also with the vowel of the augment changed स्योन.
43489: स्यूम m. (-मः) A ray of light. E. षिव to sew, मन् Uṇādi aff., and यूच् substituted for the radical finals.
43490: स्योत m. (-तः) A sack, a coarse canvas bag. E. षिव to sew, क्त aff., यूच् substituted for the finals, and the vowel changed; also स्यूत.
43491: स्योन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 A ray of light. 3 A coarse canvas bag or sack. n. (-नं) Happiness, pleasure. E. षिव to sew, Uṇādi aff. न, and यूच् substituted for the radical finals, and the vowel changed.
43492: स्रंस (उ) स्रंसु r. 1st cl. (स्रंसते) To fall down.
43493: स्रंसमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Falling, dropping, slipping off or down. 2 Fainting. E. स्रंस to fall, शानच् aff.
43494: स्रंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Falling or hanging down, pendulous, depending. m. (-सी) A tree, commonly Pilu, and applied to several sorts, (as to Careya arborea, and Salvadora Persica, &c.) E. स्रंस to fall down, aff. णिनि.
43495: स्रंसिनीफल m. (-लः) A tree, (Mimosa Sirisha.) E. स्रंसिनी pendulous, and फल fruit.
43496: स्रक (इ) स्रकि r. 1st cl. (स्रंकते) To go.
43497: स्रग्धर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wearing a garland. f. (-रा) A species of the Prakṛti metre, a stanza of four lines of 21 syllables, and each line divided into three portions of seven syllables each. E. स्रज्, and धर who has.
43498: स्रग्विन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Bearing a chaplet, &c. f. (-विनी) A species of Jagatī metre. E. स्रज् a garland, विनि aff.
43499: स्रज् f. (स्रक् or स्रग्) 1 A chaplet, a wreath of flowers worn over the forehead. 2 Any garland or string of flowers. E. सृज to quit, क्तिन् aff., and the vowel changed to its congener.
43500: स्रजिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Covered with garlands, profusely decorated with chaplets, &c. E. स्रग्विन् having a garland, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative and the possessive termination dropped; also with ईयसुन् aff. of the same, स्रजीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः.)
43501: स्रद्धू f. (-द्धूः) A fart. E. शृध to fart, ऊ aff.; more properly श्रद्धू.
43502: स्रम्भ (उ) स्रम्भु r. 1st cl. (स्रम्भते) To trust, to have faith or confidence in.
43503: स्रव m. (-वः) 1 Oozing, dropping, trickling, flowing, the gradual issue or progress of any fluid. 2 A fountain. f. (-वा) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. स्रु to flow or drop, aff. अप्.
43504: स्रवण n. (-णं) 1 Oozing, flowing, trickling. 2 Sweat, perspiration. 3 Piss, urine. E. स्रु to ooze, aff. ल्युट्.
43505: स्रवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) 1 Oozing, flowing. 2 Dropping, distilling. f. (-न्ती) 1 A river in general. 2 The situation of the spleen, the left hypochondriac region. 3 A drug. E. स्रु to drop, participial aff. शतृ.
43506: स्रवत्स्वेदजल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Perspiring much, covered with perspiration. E. स्रवत्, स्वेदजल perspiration.
43507: स्रवद्गर्ब्भा f. (-र्ब्भा) A woman or cow miscarrying by accident. E. स्रवत् falling, गर्ब्भ the foetus.
43508: स्रवद्रङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A fair, a market. E. स्रव moving, and द्रङ्ग a city.
43509: स्रष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) 1 A creator, a maker. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 ŚIVA. E. सृज to create, तृच् aff., form irr.
43510: स्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Fallen down, off, or from. 2 Separated, disjoined. 3 Loosened, relaxed, given way. E. स्रंस to fall, aff. क्त.
43511: स्रस्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Letting go, relaxing one's hold. E. स्रस्त, and हस्त the hand.
43512: स्रस्ताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having the limbs relaxed, swooning, fainting, falling. E. स्रस्त, and अङ्ग the body.
43513: स्राक् ind. Quickly, instantly. E. स्रै to cook or ripen, क्विप् aff., स्रा maturity, अक् to obtain, क्विप् aff.
43514: स्राव m. (-वः) Oozing, flowing, dripping. E. स्रु to go or flow, aff. घञ्.
43515: स्रावक n. (-कं) Black-pepper. E. स्रु to ooze, causal form, खुल् aff.
43516: स्रिभ (उ) स्रिभु r. 1st cl. (स्रेभति) To hurt or kill.
43517: स्रिम्भ (उ) स्रिम्भु r. 1st cl. (स्रिम्भति) To hurt or kill.
43518: स्रिव (उ) स्रिवु r. 4th cl. (स्रिव्यति) 1 To go. 2 To dry.
43519: स्रु r. 1st cl. (स्रवति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To flow. 3 To drop, to distil, to ooze.
43520: स्रुग्दारु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Flacourtia sapida.) E. स्रुच् a sacrificial ladle, and दारु wood.
43522: स्रुच् f. (स्रुक् or स्रुग्) A sort of ladle or long spoon, generally made of wood, and used to pour Ghee or clarified butter upon the sacrificial fire. E. स्रु to drop, (Ghee,) क्विप् aff., and चिट् final augment.
43523: स्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Flowing, dropping, falling, as a fluid. f. (-ता) A drug, commonly Hingupatri. E. स्रु to flow, aff. क.
43524: स्रुव mf. (-वः-वा) A ladle with a double extremity, or two oval collateral excavations, made of wood, and used to pour Ghee upon the sacrificial fire. f. (-वा) 1 A shrub, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) 2 A tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. स्रु to drop or ooze, (from or by it,) aff. क.
43525: स्रुवावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A plant, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) E. स्रुवा a sacrificial ladle, and वृक्ष a tree.
43526: स्रू f. (स्रूः) A sacrificial ladle: see स्रुव. 2 A cascade. E. स्रु to drop, (Ghee from it,) Uṇādi aff. क्किप्, and the vowel made long.
43527: स्रेक (ऋ) स्रेकृ r. 1st cl. (स्रेकते) To go, to move.
43528: स्रै r. 1st cl. (स्रायति) 1 To boil or melt; also श्रै and श्रा. 2 To cook or ripen.
43529: स्रोत n. (-तं) A natural or rapid stream: see स्रोतस्.
43530: स्रोतईश m. (-शः) The ocean. E. स्रोतस् a stream, and ईश lord.
43531: स्रोतस् n. (-तः) 1 A current, a natural or rapid stream. 2 A river in general. 3 The flow or course of water. 4 Water. 5 A spring. 6 An organ of sense. E. स्रु to flow, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and तुट् augment; also with a final vowel स्रोत, and palatial sibilant श्रोतस्.
43532: स्रोतस्य m. (-स्यः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A thief. E. स्रोतस् a stream, यत् aff.
43533: स्रोतस्वती f. (-ती) A river. E. स्रोतस् a current, मतुप् poss. aff.
43534: स्रोतस्विनी f. (-नी) A river. E. स्रोतस् a current, and विनि aff.
43535: स्रोतोञ्जन n. (-नं) Antimony. E. स्रोतस् a stream, and अञ्जन collyrium.
43536: स्रोतोवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Flowing like a stream or river. f. (-हा) A river in general. E. स्रोतस् a stream, and वह bearing.
43537: स्व Pron. mfn. (स्वः स्वा स्वं) Own. Subst. m. (स्वः) 1 A kinsman. 2 The soul. 3 Self-identity, individuality. n. (स्वं) 1 Wealth, property. 2 (In algebra,) Plus, or affirmative quantity. E. स्वन to sound, aff. ड, or षू to send or order, व aff.
43538: स्वक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Own, proper, peculiar. E. स्व as above, and कन् added.
43539: स्वकम्पन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. स्व self, कम्पन agitating.
43540: स्वकर्म्मकृत् m. (-कृत्) An independant workman, one doing business on his own account. E. स्व own, कर्म्म business, and कृत् who does.
43541: स्वकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) Own act, business, duty, conduct, &c. E. स्व, and कर्म्मन् act.
43542: स्वकर्म्मवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Suffering the consequences of one's own acts. E. स्वकर्म्म, and वश subject to.
43543: स्वकर्म्मस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Who or what adheres to its own business or duty. E. स्वकर्म्म, and स्थ staying.
43544: स्वकार्य्य n. (-य्य) Own business or duty. E. स्व, and कार्य्य act.
43545: स्वकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Of one's own family. 2 Own in general, as property, &c. E. स्व own, छ aff., and कुक् augment.
43546: स्वकुटुम्ब n. (-म्बं) Own family. E. स्व, and कुटुम्ब family.
43547: स्वकुल n. (-लं) Own family or race. E. स्व, and कुल race.
43548: स्वकुलक्षय m. (-यः) A fish. E. स्व own, कुल race, and क्षय destruction.
43549: स्वकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done or made by one's self, self-performed. E. स्व, and कृत done.
43550: स्वक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा or क्षी-क्षं) 1 Handsome-eyed. 2 Acute, sensitive, having keen organs. E. सु good, अक्षि the eye, or अक्ष an organ of sense.
43551: स्वग (इ) स्वगि r. 1st cl. (स्वंगति) To go, to move.
43552: स्वगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kept to one's self, apart, aside. n. (-तं) Aside (in theatrical language.) E. स्व self, गत gone, got.
43553: स्वगृह m. (-हः) A small bird, (Loxia Philippensis.) n. (-हं) Own house. E. स्व own, गृह house.
43554: स्वगुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Self-defended or preserved. f. (-प्ता) Cowach, (Carpogon pruriens.) E. स्व self, गुप्त preserved.
43555: स्वङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Handsome and well-shaped. E. सु excellent, अङ्ग body.
43556: स्वच्छ mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं) 1 Healthy, sound, convalescent. 2 White. 3 Pure, free from stain or soil. 4 Transparent, pellucid. E. सु exceedingly, and अच्छ clean, clear.
43557: स्वच्छता f. (-ता) Purity, transparency, &c. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, स्वच्छत्वं.
43558: स्वच्छन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) 1 Unrestrained, uncontrolled, self-willed. 2 Spontaneous. 3 Uncultivated. E. स्व own, and छन्द inclination; also स्वच्छन्दक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
43559: स्वच्छपत्र n. (-त्रं) Talc. E. स्वच्छ transparent, and पत्र a leaf, a layer.
43560: स्वज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Self-born, produced in or by one's self. m. (-जः) 1 A son. 2 Sweat, perspiration. n. (-जं) Blood. f. (-जा) A daughter. E. स्व own, self, and ज born.
43561: स्वजन m. (-नः) A distant kinsman. E. स्व own, जन man.
43562: स्वजाति f. (-तिः) Own caste, tribe, or species. E. स्व, and जाति sort.
43563: स्वजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of one's own tribe, caste, species, &c. E. स्व, and जातीय of a caste, &c.
43564: स्वज्ञाति f. (-तिः) Kindred, kin. m. (-तिः) A kinsman. E. स्व, and ज्ञाति kin.
43565: स्वठ r. 10th cl. (स्वठयति) 1 To finish. 2 To leave unfinished.
43566: स्वतन्त्र mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं) 1 Unrestrained, uncontrolled, self-willed. 2 Independant, free. 3 Full grown, of age, no longer subject to the authority of parents, &c. E. स्व own, तन्त्र inclination, will.
43567: स्वतन्त्रता f. (-ता) Independence, wilfulness. E. तल् added to the last.
43568: स्वतस् ind. 1 Of itself, by one's self. 2 Own, peculiar. E. स्व self, तसि aff.
43569: स्वत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Self-preserving. m. (-त्रः) A blind man. E. स्व self, and त्र who preserves.
43570: स्वत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Self-existence, independant being or condition. 2 Own right or property, ownership, proprietary right. E. स्व own, and त्व aff. of the abstract; also स्वत्ता.
43571: स्वत्वनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Cessation or loss of proprietary right. E. स्वत्व, and निवृत्ति cessation.
43572: स्वत्वबोधन n. (-नं) Indication or proof of ownership. E. स्वत्व, and बोधन making known.
43573: स्वत्वव्यभिचारित्व n. (-त्वं) Doubt or uncertainty of ownership. E. स्वत्व, and व्यभिचारित्व want of steadiness.
43574: स्वत्वहानि f. (-निः) Loss or forfeiture of proprietary title or right. E. स्वत्व, and हानि loss.
43575: स्वत्वहेतु m. (-तुः) Ground or cause of proprietary right. E. स्वत्व, and हेतु cause.
43576: स्वत्वाभाव m. (-वः) Non-existence of proprietary right. E. स्वत्व, and अभाव non-existence.
43577: स्वत्वावगम m. (-मः) Determination or ascertainment of ownership. E. स्वत्व, and अवगम certainty.
43578: स्वत्वास्पद n. (-दं) The subject or thing in which proprietary right is vested. E. स्वत्व, and आस्पद site.
43579: स्वत्वोत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Origin or production of proprietary right. E. स्वत्व, and उत्पत्ति production.
43580: स्वद r. 1st cl. (स्वदते) 1 To taste. 2 To be sweet or agreeable; also ष्वद.
43581: स्वदन n. (-नं) Eating. E. स्वद to taste, aff. ल्युट्.
43582: स्वदारनिरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uxorious, devoted to a wife. E. स्व own, दार wife, निरत attached to.
43583: स्वदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten, well eaten. n. (-तं) The term used after presenting food to the manes, asking if they are satisfied. E. स्वद to taste, क्त aff.
43584: स्वदेश m. (-शः) 1 Native country, home. 2 Own or proper place. E. स्व, and देश country.
43585: स्वदेशपरिधि m. (-धिः) Circumference of a circle of longitude in any place that has latitude. E. स्वदेश, and परिधि circumference.
43586: स्वदेशमध्यपरिधि m. (-धिः) Circumference of the terrestrial equator. E. स्वदेश, मध्य centre, and परिधि circumference.
43587: स्वधर्म्म n. (-र्म्मं) 1 Peculiar duty or occupation, as praying of a Brahman, fighting of a soldier, &c. 2 Property, peculiarity. E. स्व own, धर्म्म virtue.
43588: स्वधर्म्मच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Neglecting one's duty. E. स्वधर्म्म, and च्युत fallen from.
43589: स्वधर्म्मत्याग m. (-गः) 1 Neglect of duty. 2 Apostacy. E. स्वधर्म्म, and त्याग abandonment.
43590: स्वधर्म्मस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Attached to or performing one's peculiar duty. E. स्वधर्म्म, and स्थ who or what stays.
43591: स्वधर्म्मस्खलन n. (-नं) Neglecting or disregarding duty. E. स्वधर्म्म, and स्खलन slipping.
43592: स्वधा ind. 1 An exclamation used on presenting an oblation to the manes. (aptote noun.). 2 The food of deceased ancestors. f. (-धा) 1 A personification of Māyā or worldly illusion, the self-contained associate of the Creator. 2 A nymph, the food of the manes personified, and sometimes represented as the wife of AGNI or fire. E. ष्वद to taste, आ aff., and द changed to ध; or स्व self, धा to hold, aff. अ and टाप्.
43593: स्वधाकार m. (-रः) Pronouncing the exclamation Svadhā. E. स्वधा, and कार making; also स्वधाकर.
43594: स्वधाप्रिय m. (-यः) 1 Black sesamum. 2 AGNI or fire. E. स्वधा the exclamation used in making oblations to the manes, and प्रिय fond of.
43595: स्वधाभुज् m. (-भुक्) 1 A divine or deified ancestor. 2 A deity. E. स्वधा the food of the manes, and भुज् who eats.
43596: स्वधिति mf. (-तिः-ती) An axe. E. स्व self, धा to hold, क्तिन् aff.; also श्वधिति.
43597: स्वधितिहेतिक m. (-कः) A soldier armed with an axe. E. स्वधिति an axe, and हेतिक armed.
43598: स्वधीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well read, versed in. E. सु, and अधीत read.
43599: स्वन r. 1st. cl. (स्वनति) 1 To sound. 2 (स्वनयति) To dress, to adorn. With वि or अव prefixed, in a limited sense, the initial is changed, (अवष्वणति or विष्वणति) To make a noise whilst eating.
43600: स्वन m. (-नः) Sound in general. E. स्वन to sound, aff. अप्.
43601: स्वनगर n. (-रं) Own or native town. E. स्व, and नगर city.
43602: स्वनत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) Sounding. E. स्वन to sound, शतृ aff.
43603: स्वनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sounding, thundering. E. स्वन sound, मतुप् aff.
43604: स्वनाश m. (-शः) Self-destruction. E. स्व, and नाश loss.
43605: स्वनि m. (-निः) Sound, noise. E. स्वन to sound, इन् aff.
43606: स्वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, sounding, making a noise. n. (-तं) The noise of thunder. E. स्वन to sound, aff. क्त, or स्वन sound, and इतच् aff.
43607: स्वनुष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well or duly observed, practised, performed, &c. E. सु well, अनुष्ठित followed.
43608: स्वपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) Sleeping. E. ष्वप to sleep, शतृ aff.
43609: स्वपन n. (-नं) Sleep, sleeping. E. ष्वप to sleep, ल्युट् aff.
43610: स्वप्न m. (-प्नः) 1 Sleep. 2 Dreaming, a dream. E. ष्वप to sleep, न Uṇādi aff., तन् aff.
43611: स्वप्नकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Narcotic, producing sleep. n. (-कृत्) A potherb, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. स्वप्न sleep, and कृत् making.
43612: स्वप्नगृह n. (-हं) A bed-chamber. E. स्वप्न, and गृह a house.
43613: स्वप्नज् mfn. (-प्नक्) Sleeping, asleep. E. ष्वप to sleep, नजिङ् aff.
43614: स्वप्नदोष n. (-षं) Pollutio nocturna. E. स्वप्न sleep, and दोष fault.
43615: स्वप्ननिकेतन n. (-नं) A bed chamber. E. स्वप्न, and निकेतन a dwelling.
43616: स्वप्नविचार m. (-रः) Interpretation of dreams. E. स्वप्न, and विचार investigation.
43617: स्वप्नविचारिन् m. (-री) An interpreter of dreams. E. स्वप्न a dream, and विचारिन् who investigates.
43618: स्वप्नशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Sleepy. E. स्वप्न, and शील having.
43619: स्वप्नावस्था f. (-स्था) State of dreaming, applied especially to life or ignorance of worldly illusion. E. स्वप्न, and अवस्था state.
43620: स्वभाजन n. (-नं) Civility, courtesy, welcome or adieu. E. स्व self, भज to serve, causal form, aff. ल्युट्; also सभाजन.
43621: स्वभाव m. (-वः) 1 Nature, natural state, property or disposition. 2 Purpose, intention. E. स्व own, and भाव property.
43622: स्वभावज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Innate, natural, produced from, or by the natural disposition. E. स्वभाव, and ज born.
43623: स्वभावतस् ind. From or according to natural property or disposition. E. स्वभाव, and तसि aff.
43624: स्वभावदौर्जन्य n. (-न्यं) Natural or innate wickedness. E. स्वभाव, and दौर्जन्य badness.
43625: स्वभावद्वेष m. (-षः) Natural or inherent enmity. E. स्वभाव, and द्वेष hate.
43626: स्वभावोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Uttered or declared naturally or spontaneously. E. स्वभाव, and उक्त said.
43627: स्वभावोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Spontaneous declaration. 2 Description of living objects by circumstances or acts suited to their character. E. स्वभाव, and उक्ति saying.
43628: स्वभू m. (-भूः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 BRAHMĀ. E. स्व self, and भू born.
43629: स्वभूमि f. (-मिः) 1 Own land or estate. 2 Native country. E. स्व, and भूमि land.
43630: स्वयंवर n. (-रं) The public choice of a husband by a princess, from a number of suitors assembled for the purpose. f. (-रा) A girl choosing her husband. E. स्वयम् of herself, वर selecting.
43631: स्वयंशीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Fallen or dropped spontaneously. E. स्वयम्, and शीर्ण decayed.
43632: स्वयङ्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Self-formed, natural, spontaneous. 2 Done to one's self. 3 Done by or for one's self. E. स्वयम् self, and कृत made.
43633: स्वयङ्गुप्ता f. (-प्ता) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. स्वयम् self, and गुप्त preserved.
43634: स्वयन्दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Self-given. m. (-त्तः) A child who has given himself to adoptive parents. E. स्वयम् self, and दत्त given.
43635: स्वयम् ind. Self, spontaneously, of one's own self or own accord. E. सु auspiciously, अय to go, अम् aff.
43636: स्वयमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Voluntary declaration. 2 (In law,) Information, deposition. E. स्वयम्, and उक्ति saying.
43637: स्वयम्प्रभ m. (-भः) A Jaina of the future era. E. स्वयम् self, and प्रभ illustrious.
43638: स्वयम्भु m. (-म्भुः) BRAHMĀ: see the next.
43639: स्वयम्भुव m. (-वः) 1 The first MANU. 2 BRAHMĀ. E. स्वयम् self, भू to be or exist, aff. क, or स्वयम्भू BRAHMĀ, and अण् pleonasm or patronymic.
43640: स्वयम्भू m. (-म्भूः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A Jina or Jaina deified sage. 3 An emperor of the world according to the Jainas. 4 Time. 5 Love. 6 VIṢṆU. 7 ŚIVA. E. स्वयम् self, भू to exist, क्विप् aff., the self-existent; also read with a short final, or स्वयम्भु m. (-भुः)
43641: स्वयोनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Of kin, related by the mother's side. f. (-निः) A sister or near female relative. E. स्व, and योनि place of birth.
43642: स्वर r. 10th cl. (स्वरयति) 1 To blame, to censure, to reprove. 2 To sound.
43643: स्वर् ind. (aptote noun.) 1 Heaven, paradise, the residence of INDRA and the celestials. 2 Sky, ether. 3 Splendour, beauty. 4 One of the divisions of the universe, the space between the sun and polar star and region of the planets and constellations; in this sense, this word is one of the three mystical words, to be repeated daily at the morning ceremonies, &c., with the holy Gāyatrī. E. स्वृ to sound, to be in pain, विच् aff., and the vowel changed.
43644: स्वर m. (-रः) 1 An accent. 2 A vowel. 3 A note in music. 4 Air, breathed through the nostrils, snoring. 5 Sound in general. E. स्तर to sound, अच् aff.
43645: स्वरपत्तन n. (-नं) The Sāma Veda. E. स्वर an accent, and पत्तन a city: this Veda is chaunted according to a peculiar rhythm,  and the efficacy of its prayers depends chiefly on their accurate accentuation.
43646: स्वरभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Fluttering of the voice, &c. as indicative of agitation or feeling. E. स्वर a sound or note, and भङ्ग a breaking.
43647: स्वरभङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A kind of bird. E. स्वर a note, and भङ्गिन् who breaks or divides.
43648: स्वरमण्डलिका f. (-का) A kind of stringed musical instrument. E. स्वर a note of the gamut, मण्डल a region, कन् aff., fem. form.
43649: स्वरलासिका f. (-का) A flute, a pipe. E. स्वर a note, लस to be skilled, ण्वुल् aff.
43650: स्वरशून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Unmelodious, unmusical. E. स्वर, and शून्य devoid of.
43651: स्वरस m. (-सः) 1 Expressed or extracted juice. 2 Sediment of oil, &c. ground on a stone. 3 Proper or peculiar flavour. 4 Proper or peculiar taste or sentiment in composition. E. स्व own, रस flavour, &c.
43652: स्वरांश m. (-शः) A half or quarter tone in music. E. स्वर a note, अंश a part.
43653: स्वराज् m. (-राट्) 1 BRAHMĀ or supreme spirit. 2 A form of metre used in the Vedas, a verse of three lines, two containing eight syllables each, and one ten. 3 A variety of the same containing four lines. E. स्व self, राज to shine, क्विप् aff.
43654: स्वरापगा f. (-गा) The Ganges. E. स्वर heaven, आपगा river.
43655: स्वरारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Ascended to heaven. E. स्वर्, and आरूढ ascended.
43656: स्वराष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) Own country or principality. E. स्व, and राष्ट्र country.
43657: स्वरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Accented. 2 Articulated. 3 Sounded as a note, pitched. m. (-तः) The third or circumflex accent. E. स्वर a note or accent, इतच् aff.
43658: स्वरु m. (-रुः) 1 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 2 An arrow. 3 A sacrifice. 4 Shavings of the wood of which a sacrificial post is made. 5 Sunshine. 6 A kind of scorpion. E. स्वृ to sound, Uṇādi aff. उ; also with उसि, aff. स्वरुस्.
43659: स्वरुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) Wilful, self-willed, uncontrolled. E. स्व own, रुचि inclination.
43660: स्वरुस् m. (-रुः) INDRA'S thunderbolt, &c.: see स्वरु.
43661: स्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पा or पी-पं) 1 Wise, learned. 2 Pleasing, handsome. 3 Similar, like. 4 Of like purport or character. n. (-पं) 1 Natural state or condition, nature. 2 Natural and obvious purpose or conclusion. 3 Kind, sort. E. स्व own, रूप form.
43662: स्वरूपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having a like object or character. E. स्वरूप, and गत obtained.
43663: स्वरूपता f. (-ता) 1 Natural state. 2 Handsomeness. 3 Identity. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, स्वरूपत्वं.
43664: स्वरेणु f. (-णुः) One of the wives of the sun.
43665: स्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) Heaven, INDRA'S paradise, and the residence of deified mortals and the inferior gods. E. सु happiness, ऋज to go, or obtain, aff. घञ्.
43666: स्वर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone to heaven. E. स्वर्ग, and गत gone.
43667: स्वर्गगमन n. (-नं) Going to heaven. E. स्वर्ग, and गमन going.
43668: स्वर्गगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what goes to heaven. E. स्वर्ग, and गामिन् who goes.
43669: स्वर्गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Ganges of heaven. E. स्वर् heaven, गङ्गा the Ganges.
43670: स्वर्गजित् mfn. (-जित्) Obtaining or ensuring paradise. E. स्वर्ग heaven, and जित् what conquers.
43671: स्वर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone to heaven. 2 Dead. E. स्वर्, and गत gone.
43672: स्वर्गति f. (-तिः) 1 Going to heaven, future felicity. 2 Death. E. स्वर्, and गति going; also स्वर्गमन, &c.
43673: स्वर्गपति m. (-तिः) INDRA. E. स्वर्ग paradise, and पति lord.
43674: स्वर्गपर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Desirous of INDRA'S heaven. E. स्वर्ग, and पर intent on.
43675: स्वर्गभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्तां) INDRA. E. स्वर्ग, and भर्त्तृ sovereign.
43676: स्वर्गलोक m. (-कः) Paradise. E. स्वर्ग, and लोक world.
43677: स्वर्गलोकेश m. (-शः) The body. E. स्वर्गलोक, and ईश lord; the paradise of INDRA, being appropriated to corporeal felicity.
43678: स्वर्गवधू f. (-धूः) An Apsaras, a nymph or courtesan of INDRA'S heaven. E. स्वर्ग paradise, and वधू woman or wife.
43679: स्वर्गापगा f. (-गा) The Ganges. E. स्वर्ग heaven, and आपगा a river.
43680: स्वर्गारोहण n. (-णं) Ascending to heaven. E. स्वर्ग, and आरोहण going.
43681: स्वर्गारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Gone to heaven. E. स्वर्ग, and आरूढ ascended.
43682: स्वर्गिगिरि m. (-रिः) Mount Sumeru. E. स्वर्गि a god, and गिरि a mountain.
43683: स्वर्गिन् m. (-र्गो) 1 A god, a celestial. 2 (In law,) Dead. E. स्वर्ग heaven, इनि aff.
43684: स्वर्गिरि m. (-रिः) Mount Sumeru. E. स्वर् heaven, and गिरि a mountain.
43685: स्वर्गिवधू f. (-धूः) A nymph of paradise. E. स्वर्गि a celestial, and वधू wife.
43686: स्वर्गीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Heavenly, divine, relating to Svarga. E. स्वर्ग, and छ aff.
43687: स्वर्गौकस् m. (-काः) A god, a deity. E. स्वर्ग paradise, and ओकस् abode.
43688: स्वर्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं) Heavenly, paradisiacal. E. स्वर्ग heaven, यत् aff.
43689: स्वर्ण n. (-र्णं) Gold. E. सु excellent, ऋण to go or be, aff. अच्.
43690: स्वर्णक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Golden, of gold. E. स्वर्णं, and वुन् aff.
43691: स्वर्णकाय m. (-यः) GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. स्वर्ण gold, and काय body.
43692: स्वर्णकार m. (-रः) A goldsmith. E. स्वर्ण gold, and कार maker, worker.
43693: स्वर्णकृत् m. (-कृत्) A goldsmith. E. स्वर्ण gold, and कृत् who makes.
43694: स्वर्णक्षीरी f. (-री) A medicinal kind of moon-plant, said to be brought from the Himālaya mountains. E. स्वर्ण gold, (like or yellow,) क्षीर milk, or milky sap, ङीष् fem. aff.
43695: स्वर्णगैरिक n. (-कं) A kind of ochre, golden ochre. E. स्वर्ण gold, and गैरिक red chalk.
43696: स्वर्णचूड m. (-डः) 1 The blue jay. 2 A cock. E. स्वर्ण gold, चूडा a crest.
43697: स्वर्णज n. (-जं) Tin. E. स्वर्ण gold, and ज born.
43698: स्वर्णदी f. (-दी) The Ganges of heaven. E. स्वर heaven, and नदी a river.
43699: स्वर्णदीधिति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire. E. स्वर्ण gold, दीधिति a ray.
43700: स्वर्णद्रु m. (-द्रुः) A tree with yellow blossoms. E. स्वर्ण gold, and द्रु a tree.
43701: स्वर्णपक्ष m. (-क्षः) GARUḌA. E. स्वर्ण gold, and पक्ष a wing or feather.
43702: स्वर्णपद्मा f. (-द्मा) The Ganges of heaven. E. स्वर्ण gold, पद्म a lotus; bearing golden lotuses.
43703: स्वर्णपुष्प mf. (-ष्पः-ष्पी) The Cassia fistula. m. (-ष्पः) The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.) f. (-ष्पा) The gum Arabic tree, (Mimosa Arabica). f. (-ष्पी) A medicinal sort of moon-plant. E. स्वर्ण gold, and पुष्प a flower.
43704: स्वर्णयूथी f. (-थी) Yellow jasmine. E. स्वर्ण gold, and यूथी jasmine.
43705: स्वर्णरेखा f. (-खा) A streak of gold. E. स्वर्ण, and रेखा a line; also स्वर्णलेखा.
43706: स्वर्णवर्णा f. (-र्णां) Turmeric. E. स्वर्ण gold, वर्ण colour.
43707: स्वर्णवल्कल m. (-लः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. स्वर्ण gold, and वल्कल bark.
43708: स्वर्णविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A spot of yellow or gold. 2 VIṢṆU. E. स्वर्ण gold, and विन्दु a spot.
43709: स्वर्णसेफालिका f. (-का) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. स्वर्ण gold, and सेफालिका Nyctanthes.
43710: स्वर्णारि n. (-रिः) Sulphur. E. स्वर्ण gold, and अरि hostile.
43711: स्वर्त्त r. 10th cl. (स्वर्त्तयति) To be miserable or distrest.
43712: स्वर्द्द r. 1st cl. (स्वर्द्दते) 1 To taste. 2 To be pleasing.
43713: स्वर्नदी f. (-दी) The Ganges of heaven. E. स्वर् heaven, and नदी a river, and the न unchanged; also स्वर्णदी.
43714: स्वर्भानु m. (-नुः) RĀHU, the personified ascending node. E. स्वर् heaven, भानु shining.
43715: स्वर्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead, deceased. E. स्वर् heaven, and यात gone.
43716: स्वर्लोक m. (-कः) Heaven. E. स्वर् heaven, and लोक a world.
43717: स्वर्वधू f. (-धूः) An Apsaras. E. स्वर् heaven, and वधू wife.
43718: स्वर्वापी f. (-पी) The Ganges. E. स्वर् heaven, वापी a pool.
43719: स्वर्वेश्या f. (-श्या) A nymph of heaven. E. स्वर् heaven, and वेश्या a harlot.
43720: स्वर्वैद्य m. (-द्यः) Either of the twin sons of the sun by the nymph Aśvini, and physicians of Svarga. E. स्वर् heaven, and वैद्य a physician.
43721: स्वल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) 1 Very small. 2 Very few. E. सु very, अल्प little or few.
43722: स्वल्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Little. 2 Few. E. कन् added to the last.
43723: स्वल्पकेशिन् m. (-शी) Root of sweet flag. E. स्वल्प little, few, केश a filament, इनि aff.
43724: स्वल्पपत्रक m. (-कः) A kind of Mahwa tree, (Bassia,) with small leaves. E. स्वल्प small, पत्र a leaf, कन् added.
43725: स्वल्पवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Weak, feeble. E. स्वल्प, and वल strong.
43726: स्वल्पविषय m. (-यः) 1 A small matter or object. 2 A small part. E. स्वल्प, and विषय object.
43727: स्वल्पव्यय m. (-यः) Niggardliness, little expenditure. E. स्वल्प, and व्यय expence.
43728: स्वल्पव्रीड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Shameless, impudent. E. स्वल्प, and व्रीडा shame.
43729: स्वव r. 1st cl. (स्ववति) To revile, to abuse.
43730: स्ववश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Self-subdued, self-controlled. E. स्व, and वश subjection.
43731: स्ववहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Alert, active. 2 Automatous. E. स्व, and वहित impelled.
43732: स्ववासिनी f. (-नी) A woman, whether married or unmarried, dwelling in her father's house. E. स्व her own, (family,) वासिन् abiding.
43733: स्ववीज m. (-जः) The soul. E. स्व self, and वीज seed.
43734: स्ववृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Own, or peculiar duty or occupation. E. स्व, and वृत्ति profession.
43735: स्वशरीर n. (-रं) Own body. E. स्व, and शरीर body.
43736: स्वशरीरवत् ind. Like or as one's self. E. स्वशरीर, and वति aff.
43737: स्वसंवृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Self-defended, on one's guard. E. स्व, and संवृत covered.
43738: स्वसृ f. (-सा) A sister. E. सु before अस to be or live, Uṇādi aff. ऋत्.
43739: स्वस्क r. 1st cl. (स्वस्कते) To go, more generally read ष्वष्क.
43740: स्वस्ति ind. 1 A particle of benediction. 2 An auspicious particle. 3 A term of sanction or approbation, (so be it, amen.) E. सु well, अस to be, aff. क्तिच् or ति.
43741: स्वस्तिक mn. (-कः-कं) A temple of a particular form, with a portico in front. m. (-कः) 1 Any lucky or auspicious object. 2 The meeting of four roads. 3 A building or palace of a peculiar shape, described as surrounded by a terrace or portion, on the north, west, and south sides, and having the door or entrance on the east. 4 A kind of mystical figure, the inscription of which on any person or thing is generally considered to be lucky; it consists of 卐 and amongst the Jainas is the emblem of the seventh deified teacher of the present era. 5 The crossing of the arms, as resembling the preceding. 6 A kind of cake. 7 A libertine. 8 Garlic. E. कन् added to the last.
43742: स्वस्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Happy, auspicious. E. स्वस्ति, and मतुप् aff.
43743: स्वस्तिमुख m. (-खः) 1 A letter, a note. 2 A Brahman. 3 A panegyrist. E. स्वस्ति, and मुख beginning or the mouth.
43744: स्वस्तिवाचन n. (-नं) A religious rite, preparatory to any important observance, in which the Brahmans strew boiled rice on the ground, and invoke the blessings of the gods on the ceremony about to commence. E. स्वस्ति inceptive and benedictory particle, वाचन uttering.
43745: स्वस्त्ययन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Auspicious, propitious. n. (-नं) 1 The aversion of evil by the recitation of Mantras. 2 The benediction of a Brahman after presentation of offerings. E. स्वस्ति good, and अयन coming or bringing.
43746: स्वस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Confident, resolute, firm, relying upon one's self. 2 Well, at ease, in health. 3 Self-sufficient. E. स्व self, and स्थ staying.
43747: स्वस्रीय m. (-यः) A sister's son. f. (-या) A sister's daughter. E. स्वसृ a sister, and छ aff.; also with घ aff. स्वस्रिय, mf. (-यः-या) or with ढक् aff. स्वस्रेय, mf. (-यः-यी.)
43748: स्वहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Good for one's self. E. स्व, and हित good.
43749: स्वहितैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking one's own welfare. E. स्वहित, and एषिन् seeking.
43750: स्वाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having one's own form. E. स्व, and आकार form; also स्वाकृति.
43751: स्वागत n. (-तं) Welcome, salutation. f. (-ता) A species of the Triṣṭubh metre. E. सु well, and आगत come.
43752: स्वाच्छन्द्य n. (-न्द्यं) Wilfulness, independence. E. स्वच्छन्द selfwilled, ष्यञ् aff.
43753: स्वातन्त्र्य n. (-न्त्र्यं) Wilfulness, independence. E. स्वतन्त्र self-willed, ष्यञ् aff.
43754: स्वाति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 One of the wives of the sun. 2 The star Arcturus, or fifteenth lunar asterism, consisting of but one star. 3 A sword. E. सु well, auspiciously, अत to go or be, aff. इन्.
43755: स्वाद r. 1st cl. (स्वादते) To taste. r. 1st and 10th cls. (स्वादति स्वादयति) To be agreeable or pleasing. r. 10th cl. (स्वादयति) To cover; also ष्वद.
43756: स्वाद m. (-दः) 1 Taste, flavour. 2 Tasting, either food or drink, eating, drinking. E. स्वाद to taste, aff. अच्.
43757: स्वादन n. (-नं) Tasting, either as food or drink, eating, drinking. E. स्वाद to taste, aff. ल्युट्.
43758: स्वादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tasted, touched with the lips. E. स्वाद to taste, aff. क्त.
43759: स्वादु mfn. (-दुः-दु or -द्वी-दु) 1 Sweet. 2 Agreeable, desired. 3 Handsome. 4 Grateful to the palate, dainty, delicate. m. (-दुः) 1 The sweet taste or flavour, sweetness. 2 Treacle, molasses. 3 A medicinal root, commonly Jivaka. f. (-द्वी or -दुः) A grape. E. ष्वद to taste or be pleasing, उण् Uṇādi aff.
43760: स्वादुकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Flacourtia sapida.) 2 A sort of creeper, (Tribulus lanuginosus.) E. स्वादु sweet, and कण्टक a thorn.
43761: स्वादुकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Delicate in taste, dainty. E. स्वाटु, and कार who acts.
43762: स्वादुखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Molasses, raw sugar. E. स्वादु sweet, and खण्ड a fragment.
43763: स्वादुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A creeper, (Convolvulus paniculatus,) the dark sort. E. स्वाटु sugar, and गन्ध smell.
43764: स्वादुधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) KĀMA. E. स्वादु sweet, (flowers,) धन्वन् a bowyer.
43765: स्वादुफल n. (-लं) The fruit of the jujube. f. (-ला) The tree. E. स्वाटु sweet, and फल fruit.
43766: स्वादुमज्जन् m. (-ज्जा) A sort of tree, a Pilu growing in the hills. E. स्वादु sweet, मज्जन् sap.
43767: स्वादुमूल n. (-लं) A carrot. E. स्वादु sweet, and मूल a root.
43768: स्वादुरसा f. (-सा) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. 2 The hog plum, (the fruit.) 3 Vinous liquor. 4 A grape. E. स्वादु sweet, or sugar, &c., and रस juice.
43769: स्वादुशीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sweet and cool. E. स्वादु, and शीत cold.
43770: स्वादुशुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Rock or river salt. E. स्वादु sweet, and शुद्ध pure.
43771: स्वाद्वन्न n. (-न्नं) Dainties, delicacies, choice food. E. स्वादु, and अन्न food.
43772: स्वाद्वम्ल m. (-म्लः) The pomegranate tree. E. स्वादु sweet, and अम्ल sour.
43773: स्वाधिकार m. (-रः) Own or peculiar office or station. E. स्व, and अधिकार duty.
43774: स्वाधिपत्य n. (-त्यं) Supreme sway, royalty, sovereignty. E. स्व, and अधिपत्य supremacy.
43775: स्वाधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Independant, uncontrolled. 2 One's own dependant. E. स्व self, अधीन dependant.
43776: स्वाधीनता f. (-ता) Independence. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, स्वाधीनत्वं.
43777: स्वाधीनपतिका f. (-का) A woman independant of her husband or lover. E. स्वाधीन independant, पति husband, कन् fem. form added.
43778: स्वाधीनभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman who is independant of her lover or husband. E. स्व self, अधीन subservient, and भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् added; keeping her husband in subjection or dependance.
43779: स्वाध्याय m. (-यः) 1 Inaudible reading or muttering of prayers. 2 The Vedas or scripture. 3 Perusal or study of the Vedas. E. स्व one's self, अध्याय reading.
43780: स्वाध्यायवत् m. (-वान्) A student of the Vedas. E. स्वाध्याय perusing the Vedas, and मतुप् aff.
43781: स्वाध्यायिन् m. (-यी) 1 A tradesman, a citizen and dealer. 2 A student of the Vedas. E. स्वाध्याय muttering, &c., इनि aff.
43782: स्वान m. (-नः) Sound, noise. E. स्वन to sound, aff. घञ्.
43783: स्वानुरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Natural, inherent, innate. E. स्व, and अनुरूप conformity.
43784: स्वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Sounded, making a noise. n. (-न्तं) 1 The mind, the faculty of thought and feeling. 2 A cave, a cavern. E. स्वन to sound, क्त aff., deriv. irr.
43785: स्वाप m. (-पः) 1 Sleep, sleeping. 2 Sleepiness, sloth. 3 Paralysis, palsy, loss of sensation. 4 Ignorance. 5 Dreaming, a dream. 6 Temporary and partial palsy from pressure on a nerve, numbness, the sleep of a limb, &c. E. ष्वप to sleep, aff. घञ्.
43786: स्वापतेय n. (-यं) Wealth, property. E. स्व own, पति master, ढञ् aff.
43787: स्वापद m. (-दः) A wild beast. E. स substituted for शः see श्वापद.
43788: स्वाभाविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Natural, peculiar, inherent. E. स्वभाब natural property or nature, ठक् aff.
43790: स्वामित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Ownership, mastership. 2 Sovereignty, &c. E. त्व added to स्वामिन्; also with तल्, स्वामिता.
43791: स्वामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Owner, proprietor, master or mistress, &c. m. (-मी) 1 A master, a lord. 2 A sovereign, a prince, a monarch. 3 A husband, a lover. 4 A spiritual preceptor. 5 A learned Brahman or Paṇḍita. 6 KĀRTTIKEYA. 7 VIṢṆU. 8 ŚIVA. 9 The Muni VĀTSYĀYANA. 10 A name of GARUḌA. E. स्व own, आमिनच् aff.
43792: स्वामिकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) The business of a prince or master. E. स्वामिन्, and कार्य्य affair.
43793: स्वामिमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Depending upon, or originating from the master, husband, or lord. E. स्वामिन्, and मूल root.
43794: स्वामिसद्भाव m. (-वः) 1 Existence of a master or owner. 2 Amiability of a master or lord. E. स्वामि, and सत् being, or good, भाव existence or property.
43795: स्वामिसेवा f. (-वा) Attention to a master, husband, &c. E. स्वामिन्, and सेवा service.
43796: स्वाम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 Mastership, ownership. 2 Right or title to property. 3 Rule, supremacy. E. स्वामिन्, and यत् aff.
43797: स्वाम्युपकारक m. (-कः) A horse. E. स्वामि a master, उपकार assistance, and कन् added.
43798: स्वायम्भुव m. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Relating to Svayambhū. 2 Derived from the self-born. m. (-वः) The son of Svayambhū. E. स्वयम्भू, and अण् aff.; also स्वायम्भू.
43799: स्वाराज् m. (-णाट्) INDRA. E. स्वर् heaven, राज ruler; the first र rejected, and the vowel made long.
43800: स्वाराज्य n. (-ज्यं) 1 Final felicity, union with BRAHMA. 2 INDRA'S heaven. E. स्वराज्, and ष्यञ् aff., or स्वाराज् and यत् aff.
43801: स्वारोचिष m. (-षः) The second MANU. E. स्वरोचिस्, and अञ् affix of descent.
43802: स्वार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थ) 1 Pleonastic. 2 Having a plain or literal meaning, or similar force or sense. 3 Having one's own object. n. (-र्थं) 1 Property, substance. 2 Same effect or meaning, a pleonasm. 3 Own object or desire. E. स्व own, and अर्थ wealth or sense.
43803: स्वार्थपरायण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Selfish. E. स्वार्थ, and परायण diligent.
43804: स्वार्थलिप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous of having one's own way, self-seeking. E. स्वार्थ, and लिप्सु desirous of getting.
43805: स्वार्थसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Accomplishment of one's object, attainment of the thing desired. E. स्वार्थ, and सिद्धि completion.
43806: स्वार्थिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Expressing its own or literal meaning. 2 Having one's own object. 3 Done with one's own wealth, &c. E. स्वार्थ, and ठक् aff.
43807: स्वाल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पी-ल्पं) 1 Small. 2 Few. n. (-ल्पं) 1 Littleness. 2 Paucity. E. स्वल्प, and अण् aff.
43808: स्वाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Well fed. E. सु, and आशित eaten.
43809: स्वास्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Well spread. E. सु, and आस्तीर्ण spread.
43810: स्वास्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) 1 Health. 2 Content, happiness, complacency, satisfaction. 3 Fortitude, firmness, self-dependance. E. स्व self, स्थ who is, or stays, ष्यञ् aff.
43811: स्वाहा ind. An exclamation used in making an oblation to the gods. f. (-हा) 1 A personification of the preceding, as the wife of fire, and goddess presiding over burnt offerings. 2 A female divinity, peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. सु well, auspiciously, आङ् before ह्वेञ् to call, to invoke, (the gods,) and डा aff., or स्वाद to taste, aff. आ, and द changed to ह.
43812: स्वाहाकार m. (-रः) Utterance of the term Svāhā. E. स्वाहा, and कार making.
43813: स्वाहापति m. (-तिः) AGNI or fire. E. स्वाहा the goddess, and पति husband.
43814: स्वाहाप्रिय m. (-यः) AGNI or fire. E. स्वाहा the goddess, and प्रिय beloved.
43815: स्वाहाभुज् m. (-भुक्त्) A deity. E. स्वाहा the exclamation, and भुज् who eats.
43816: स्वित् ind. 1 A particle of questioning, (hey, what?) 2 An exclamation of doubt or surprise. 3 An expletive. E. सु well, इण् to go, aff. क्विप्.
43817: स्विदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sweated, melted. 2 Sweating, perspiring. E. स्वाद to be unctuous, aff. क्त.
43818: स्विन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Sweating, perspiring. E. ष्विद to perspire, क्त aff.
43819: स्वीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Assenting, agreeing. 2 Promising. E. स्व own, करण making, च्चि augment.
43820: स्वीकरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be promised. 2 To be admitted, consented, or agreed to. E. स्व before कृ to make, अनीयर् aff., च्चि augment; also स्वीकर्त्तव्य and स्वीकृत्य.
43821: स्वीकार n. (-रः) 1 Promise. 2 Assent, agreement. E. स्व own, कार making, च्चि augment.
43822: स्वीकाररहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Not agreed or assented to. E. स्वीकार, and रहित void of.
43823: स्वीकारान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Agreed to, consequent upon a promise or assent. E. स्वीकार, and अन्त end.
43824: स्वीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Agreed, assented to. 2 Promised. E. स्व, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
43825: स्वीकृत्य ind. Having agreed or promised. E. स्व, and कृत्य having made, च्चि augment.
43826: स्वीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Own, relating or belonging to one. f. (-या) A virtuous woman, one attached solely to her husband. E. स्व own, छ aff.
43827: स्वृ r. 1st cl. (स्वरति) 1 To sound. 2 To be diseased. 3 To pain or torture. With सम् prefixed, in an intransitive sense, the verb becomes deponent, (सेस्वरते) It sounds.
43828: स्वॄ r. 9th cl. (स्वृणाति-स्वृणीते) To hurt, to kill.
43829: स्वेच्छा f. (-च्छा) Wilfulness, following one's own purpose or inclination. E. स्व own, इच्छा wish.
43830: स्वेच्छामृत्यु m. (-त्युः) BHĪṢMA. E. स्वेच्छा wish, and मृत्यु death.
43831: स्वेच्छाहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Omnivorous, eating anything at pleasure. E. स्वेच्छा, and आहार food.
43832: स्वेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Warm, perspiring. m. (-दः) 1 Warmth, heat. 2 Perspiration, sweat. 3 Warm vapour, steam. E. ष्विद to perspire, &c, aff. घञ्.
43833: स्वेदचूषक m. (-कः) A pleasant and cooling breeze. E. स्वेद perspiration, चूष to suck or imbibe, aff. वुन्.
43834: स्वेदछिद् mfn. (-छित्) Cooling, allaying perspiration. E. स्वेद, and छिद् what cuts.
43835: स्वेदज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Engendered by heat and damp, as insects and worms. E. स्वेद sweat or warm vapour, and ज produced.
43836: स्वेदजल n. (-लं) Perspiration. E. स्वेद, and जल water.
43837: स्वेदन n. (-नं) 1 Perspiration, sweat. 2 Sweeting, causing to perspire. 3 A diaphoretic, a sudorific. E. ष्विद to be unctuous or sweaty, and ल्युट् aff.
43838: स्वेदनिका f. (-का) An iron plate or pan used as a cooking utensil. E. स्वेदन sweat, ङीष् aff., and कन् fem. form added.
43839: स्वेदनी f. (-नी) An iron plate or pan used as a frying pan, &c. E. ष्विद to perspire, ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.
43840: स्वेदमलोञ्झितदेह m. (-हः) A holy or sainted teacher of the Jainas. E. स्वेद perspiration, मल excrement, उञ्झित abandoned, and देह body: whose body is no longer subject to its original impurities.
43841: स्वेदविन्दु f. (-न्दुः) A drop of perspiration. E. स्वेद, and विन्दु a drop.
43842: स्वेदविप्रुष् f. (-प्रुट्) A drop of perspiration. E. स्वेद sweat, and विप्रुष् a drop.
43843: स्वेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sweated, heated. E. स्विद to sweat, causal v., क्त aff.
43844: स्वेदोदक n. (-कं) Perspiration. E. स्वेद, and उदक water; also स्वेदोद.
43845: स्वैर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Self-willed, unrestrained. 2 Slow, lazy. n. (-रं) Following one's own inclination. E. स्व self, ईर to go or be, aff. अण्.
43846: स्वैरवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Acting or living as one likes. E. स्वैर, and वृत्त practising.
43847: स्वैरता f. (-ता) Wilfulness, independence. E. स्वैर self-willed, तल् aff.
43848: स्वैरिता f. (-ता) Wilfulness. E. स्वैरिन् self-willed, तल् aff.
43849: स्वैरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Uncontrouled, self-willed. f. (-णी) 1 An unchaste wife, an adulteress. 2 A wanton woman. E. स्व self, ईर to go, णिनि aff.
43850: स्वोपार्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Self-got, self-acquired, (as wealth, &c.) E. स्व self, उपार्जित obtained.
43851: स्वोरस m. (-सः) Sediment of oil, &c. ground with a stone and muller. ह
43852: ह The thirty-third and last consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet; the letter H.
43853: ह Subst. mfn. (हः-हा-हं) Laughter. Adj. Mad, drunk. m. (-हः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 Water. 3 A cypher. 4 Meditation. 5 Auspiciousness. 6 Sky, heaven. 7 Paradise. 8 Blood. 9 Dying. 10 Fear. 11 Knowledge. 12 The moon. 13 VIṢṆU. 14 War, battle. 15 Horripilation. 16 A horse. 17 Pride. 18 A physician. 19 Cause, motive. f. (हा) 1 Abandoning, leaving. 2 Coition. 3 A lute. n. (-हं) GOD, the supreme soul. 2 Pleasure, delight. 3 Calling, calling to. 4 A weapon. 5 The sparkling of a gem 6 The sound of a lute. ind. 1 An expletive. 2 A vocative particle (ho! holla!) 2 A term of rejection or disdain. 4 A particle of abuse or reproach: see हा, ही, &c. E. हा to abandon, or हन to strike, &c., aff. क or ड.
43854: हंस m. (-सः) 1 A goose, a gander, a swan. 2 BRAHMA, the supreme soul. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 The sun. 5 A liberal or moderate prince, one not covetous nor ambitious. 6 A sort of ascetic or devotee. 7 A particular Mantra, or mystical or magical prayer. 8 A horse. 9 One of the vital airs. 10 Envy, malice. 11 ŚIVA. 12 (In composition,) Best, excellent. 13 Preceding, before, in front. 14 A spiritual preceptor. 15 A mountain. 16 A buffalo. 17 KĀMA. f. (-सी) A goose. E. हन् to hurt or kill, Uṇādi aff. स.
43855: हंसक m. (-कः) 1 An ornament for the feet, described as being made like a goose's foot. 2 The flamingo. E. कन् added to the last.
43856: हंसकूट m. (-टः) The hump on the shoulder of the Indian ox. E. हंस a goose, and कूट a peak.
43857: हंसगद्गदा f. (-दा) A woman speaking sweetly or pleasantly. E. हंस a goose, गद to sound, reiterated, aff. अच् and टाप्.
43858: हंसगामिनी f. (-नी) A graceful woman. E. हंस a goose, (or swan,) and गामिनी who goes, (like.)
43859: हंसदाहन n. (-नं) Agallochum. E. हंस a goose, and दाहन burning, exciting.
43860: हंसनाद m. (-दः) Cackling, the cry or noise of a goose. E. हंस, and नाद sound.
43861: हंसनादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Cackling, making a noise like a goose. f. (-नी) An elegant woman, one of slender waist and large posteriors, with the gait of an elephant and voice of a Koïl. E. हंस a goose, नाद cry, इनि and ङीष् affs.
43862: हंसपदी f. (-दी) 1 A scandent shrub, (Cissus pedata.) 2 Another plant, perhaps Clitoria ternata. E. हंस a goose, and पद foot; from a fancied resemblance between it and the flower; also हंसपादी.
43863: हंसपाद n. (-दं) Vermilion. f. (-दी) A shrub, (Clitoria ternata?) E. हंस a goose, पाद a foot, (to which they are compared in colour, form, &c.:) see the last; also in the fem. form, कन् added, हंसपादिका.
43864: हंसमाला f. (-ला) 1 A duck. 2 A flight or flock of wild geese. E. हंस a goose, माला a garland or wreath.
43865: हंसरथ m. (-थः) BRAHMĀ. E. हंस a goose, and रथ vehicle.
43867: हंसवती f. (-ती) A creeper, (Cissus pedata.) E. हंस a goose, (its foot,) and मतुप् aff.
43868: हंसवाहन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ. E. हंस a goose, and वाहन A vehicle.
43869: हंसाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) Vermilion. E. हंस a goose, and अङ्घ्रि the foot.
43870: हंसाभिख्य n. (-ख्यं) Silver. E. हंस a goose, अभिख्या beauty; being of similar colour.
43871: हंसिका f. (-का) A goose. E. हंसी the same, and कन् added, or हन to kill, सिकन् Uṇādi aff.
43872: हंहो ind. 1 An interjection of calling, (ho, holla!). 2 A particle of haughtiness or arrogance. 3 An arrogantly interrogative particle. E. हं and हो, both vocative particles.
43873: हक्क m. (-क्कः) The call of elephants. E. हक् imitative sound, कै to utter, ड aff.
43874: हक्कार m. (-रः) Calling, calling to. E. हक् sound of calling, and कार making.
43875: हञ्जा ind. (In theatrical language.) A vocative particle used in calling to a female attendant. E. हिडि to treat with disrespect or contempt, aff. आ, and the deriv. irr.; also with ए, aff. हञ्जे.
43877: हञ्जे ind. (In theatrical language,) a vocative particle to be used in addressing a female attendant. E. see हञ्जा.
43879: हट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A market, a moveable market, a fair. f. (-ट्टी) A petty market or fair. E. हट to shine, ट aff., form irr.
43880: हट्टचौरक m. (-कः) A thief, one stealing at fairs and markets. E. हट्ट a market, and चौर a thief, कन् pleonasm.
43881: हट्टविलासिनी f. (-नी) 1 A sort of drug and perfume. 2 A whore. E. हट्ट a market, विलस to wanton or delight, णिनि and ङीप् aff.
43882: हठ r. 1st cl. (हठति) 1 To leap or jump. 2 To be wicked. 3 To treat with violence, to oppress. 4 To bind to a post.
43883: हठ m. (-ठः) 1 Violence. 2 Oppression. 3 Rapine. mf. (-ठः-ठी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. हठ to treat with violence, aff. अच्.
43884: हठपर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. हठ Pistia, and पर्ण a leaf.
43885: हठालु m. (-लुः) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. हठ the same, and आलु a root.
43886: हडि m. (-डिः) A sort of stocks or wooden fetters.
43887: हडिक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a servant of the lowest caste and meanest function.
43889: हड्डक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a Mehter.
43890: हड्डज n. (-जं) The marrow of the bones. E. हड्ड a bone, and ज born.
43891: हण्डा ind. An interjection of calling to a low female: see हण्डे.
43892: हण्डिका f. (-का) An earthen pot or boiler; also हण्डी.
43893: हण्डिकासुत m. (-तः) A small earthen pot. E. हण्डिका an earthen pot, and सुत son.
43894: हण्डे ind. A vocative particle to be addressed in theatrical language to a female of inferior rank. E. हिडि to treat with contempt or disrespect, aff. ए, and the form irr.; also with आ, aff. हण्डा.
43895: हत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, hurt, killed. 2 Destroyed. 3 Departed, lost. 4 Ended. 5 Deprived of, devoid of. 6 Disappointed. 7 Multiplied, (in arithmetic.) n. (-तं) 1 Multiplication. 2 Hurting, killing. E. हन् to strike or hurt, aff. क्त.
43896: हतक m. (-कः) A coward, a poltroon. E. हत slain, कन् aff.
43897: हतचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewildered, astounded, bereft of sense. E. हत, and चित mind.
43898: हतजीवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deprived of life or hope, overcome with despair. n. (-तं) Despair. E. हत, and जीवित living.
43899: हतताप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Cool after great heat. E. हत, and ताप heat.
43900: हतसम्पद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Reduced to poverty. E. हत, and सम्पद property.
43901: हतसाध्वस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Fearless, free from fear. E. हत, and साध्वस fear.
43903: हताश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Cruel, merciless. 2 Desponding, despairing. 3 Vile, wicked. 4 Barren. 5 Weak, powerless. E. हत destroyed, and आशा hope, (in or by whom.)
43904: हताश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) Having the horses killed. E. हत, and अश्व a horse.
43905: हतौजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Debilitated, weak. m. (-जाः) A kind of fever, fever with debility. E. हत, and ओजस् vigour.
43906: हत्नु m. (-त्नुः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 A weapon. E. हन् to kill or hurt, कत्नुच् Uṇādi aff.
43907: हत्या f. (-त्या) Killing, slaying, (used chiefly in composition, as ब्रह्महत्या the murder of a Brahman, रिपुहत्या killing an enemy.) E. हन् to kill, क्यप् aff., and न changed to त.
43908: हत्वा ind. Having struck or killed. E. हन to hurt, &c., क्त्वा aff.
43909: हथ m. (-थः) A man dejected or in low spirits. E. हन् to hurt, क्थन् aff.
43910: हद r. 1st cl. (हदते) To evacuate as fæces.
43911: हन r. 2nd cl. (हन्ति pl. घ्नन्ति) 1 To hurt, to strike, to injure, to do any act which tends to the destruction of life, to kill. 2 To go, to move. 3 To put an end to in any manner. With अभि, To sound a musical instrument. With आङ्, To smite. With नि or परि, To destroy, entirely. With प्र, 1 To strike. 2 To place upon. With प्रति, To refute or destroy, an opposite argument. With वि and आङ्, To obstruct, to prevent, to hinder. With सम्, To slaughter: (घन् or ध्न is substituted for the radical letters of this verb in many of its inflections and derivatives; the root also takes most of the prefixes with little or no variation of the sense.)
43912: हन m. (-नः) A killer, a slayer. E. हन to kill, अच् aff.; also with क्विप्, aff. हन् m. (-हा).
43913: हनन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, destroying. 2 Injuring, hurting, striking. 3 (In arithmetic,) Multiplication. E. हन् to hurt or kill, aff. ल्युट्.
43914: हननीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) What may be or ought to be struck, beaten, killed. E. हन to kill, अनीयर् aff.
43915: हनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः or नूः) The jaw. f. (-नुः) 1 A drug and perfume: see हट्टविलासिनी. 2 A weapon. 3 Sickness. 4 Death, dying E. हन् to hurt or kill, aff. उ.
43916: हनुग्रह m. (-हः) Locked jaw. E. हनु, and ग्रह seizure.
43917: हनुमत् m. (-मान्) 1 The monkey chief HANUMĀN, the son of AÑJANĪ, by PAVANA, or the wind, the friend, ally and spy of RĀMACANDRA, in his invasion of Laṅkā. 2 A particular sort of monkey, (Simia sinica.) E. हनु the jaw, and मतुप् aff.; also with हनू the same, हनूमत् m. (-मान्.)
43918: हनुस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) Locked jaw. E. हनु, and स्तम्भ stiffness.
43919: हनूष m. (-षः) A goblin, a demon. E. हन to kill, ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.
43920: हन्त ind. 1 An inceptive particle. 2 An exclamation of grief, (ah, alas!) 3 Of pity. 4 Of pleasure. 5 Of hurry or haste. E. हन् to kill, त aff.
43921: हन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What may be, or ought to be struck, killed, &c. E. हन, and तव्य aff.
43922: हन्ताकार m. (-रः) Rice to be given to a guest. E. हन्ता a measure of food, and कार making.
43923: हन्तु m. (-न्तुः) 1 Death. 2 A bull. E. हन to kill, तु aff.
43924: हन्तृ m. (-न्ता) 1 A murderer, a slayer. 2 A measure of food, four times four double handfuls. E. हन to kill, तृच् Uṇādi aff.
43925: हन्तोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Tenderness, compassion. E. हन्त alas! and उक्ति saying.
43926: हन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Passed as ordure. E. हद to void fæces, aff. क्त.
43927: हन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being killed or struck. E. हन to hurt or kill, pass. v., शानच् aff.
43928: हम् ind. 1 An interjection of wrath. 2 An expression of courtesy or respect.
43929: हम्भा f. (-म्भा) The lowing of kine. E. हम् imitative sound, भा to shine, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
43930: हम्भारवविराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Lowing, bellowing. E. हम्भा, रव sound, विराविन् uttering.
43931: हम्म r. 1st cl. (हम्मति) To go, to move.
43932: हय r. 1st cl. (हयति) 1 To move. 2 To worship. 3 To sound. 4 To be weary.
43933: हय m. (-यः) 1 A horse. 2 A man of a particular class. 3 The number seven. 4 INDRA. 5 The Yak. 6 (In prosody,) A foot of four short syllables, a proceleusmaticus. f. (-यी) A mare. E. हय to go, or हि to go, aff. अच्.
43934: हयगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. हय a horse, and गन्ध smell.
43935: हयग्रीव m. (-वः) A prince of the Daityas, who during BRAHMĀ'S sleep at the end of a Kalpa stole the Vedas; in the recovery of them, he was slain by VIṢṆU, after his descent as the Matsya or fish Avatāra. E. हय a horse, and ग्रीबा neck.
43936: हयग्रीवहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. हयग्रीव the Daitya, and हन् slayer.
43937: हयङ्कष m. (-षः) 1 A driver, a charioteer. 2 INDRA'S charioteer. E. हय a horse, and कष to hurt, aff. खच्.
43938: हयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A horse-dealer, a groom, one who is a judge of the qualities of a horse. E. हय, and ज्ञ who knows.
43939: हयज्ञता f. (-ता) Horsemanship, knowledge of horses and their management. E. तल् added to the last.
43940: हयद्विषत् m. (-न्) The buffalo. E. हय, and द्विषत् foe.
43941: हयन n. (-नं) A covered carriage. m. (-नः) A year. E. हय to go, ल्युट् aff.
43942: हयपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A horse's tail. f. (-च्छी) A leguminous plant, (Glycine debilis.) E. हय a horse, and पुच्छ the tail.
43943: हयप्रिय m. (-यः) Barley. E. हय a horse, and प्रिय fond of.
43944: हयमारक m. (-कः) A shrub, (Nerium odorum.) E. हय a horse, and मारक killer; also with मार the same, हयमार m. (-रः.)
43945: हयमारण m. (-णः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. हय a horse, and मारण killing.
43946: हयमेध m. (-धः) The sacrifice of a horse: see अश्वमेघ. E. हय, and मेध sacrifice.
43947: हयवाहन m. (-नः) 1 The son of SŪRYA or the sun. 2 KUVERA. E. हय a horse, and वाहन a vehicle.
43948: हयवाहनसङ्कर m. (-रः) Mountain ebony, the red sort.
43949: हयानन्द m. (-न्दः) Kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. हय a horse, and आनन्द delighting.
43950: हयारि m. (-रिः) A shrub, (Nerium odorum.) E. हय a horse, and अरि inimical.
43951: हयारूढ m. (-ठः) A horseman, a rider. E. हय, and आरूढ mounted on.
43952: हयारोह m. (-हः) Riding, horsemanship. E. हय, and आरीह mounting.
43953: हयाशना f. (-ना) The gum Olibanum tree. E. हय a horse, and अशन food.
43954: हयोत्तम m. (-मः) An excellent horse. E. हय a horse, and उत्तम best.
43955: हर mfn. (-रः-री or रा-रं) Who or what takes or seizes, carries or conveys, &c. m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 AGNI. 3 An ass. 4 (In arithmetic,) A divisor; also the denominator of a fraction. E. हृ to take, aff. अप् or टच्.
43956: हरक m. (-कः) 1 A rogue, a cheat. 2 A person of reflection. 3 A taker, a conveyer, a seizer. 4 (In arithmetic,) A divisor; also division. 5 ŚIVA. E. हृ to take, वुन् aff.
43957: हरचूडामणि m. (-णिः) The moon. E. हर ŚIVA, चूडा the crest, and मणि a gem.
43958: हरण n. (-णं) Taking, (either in a good or bad sense,) accepting, receiving, seizing, carrying off or away. 2 A special gift, as a nuptial present, alms to a student at his initiation, &c. 3 The arm. 4 Semen virile. 5 Gold. 6 A Kowri. 7 Boiling water. 8 (In arithmetic,) Dividing, division. m. (-णः) The hand. E. हृ to take, aff. ल्युट्.
43959: हरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken, seized, accepted, &c. E. हृ to take, अनीयर् aff.
43960: हरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत) Taking, seizing. E. हृ to take, शतृ aff.
43961: हरवीज n. (-जं) Quicksilver. E. हर ŚIVA, and वीज semen.
43962: हरशेखरा f. (-रा) The Ganges. E. हर ŚIVA, and शेखरा crest.
43963: हरहूरा f. (-रा) A grape; also हारहूरा.
43964: हराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) Mount Kailāsa, the favourite resort of ŚIVA. E. हर ŚIVA, and अद्रि mountain.
43965: हरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) 1 Green. 2 Tawny. 3 Yellow. m. (-रिः) 1 VIṢṆU, or as considered to be the same deity, KṚṢṆA. 2 YAMA. 3 Air, wind. 4 INDRA. 5 The moon. 6 The sun. 7 A lion. 8 A ray of light. 9 A horse. 10 A parrot. 11 An ape. 12 A snake. 13 A frog. 14 ŚIVA. 15 One of the nine Varṣas into which the known continent is divided. 16 BRAHMĀ. 17 Fire. 18 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 19 A goose. 20 A peacock. 21 Green, (the colour.) 22 Tawny, the colour. 23 A golden colour, or yellow. E. हृ to take, to seize, (the world or men's hearts, &c.,) Uṇādi aff. इ.
43966: हरिक m. (-कः) 1 A horse of a yellowish blue tint. 2 A thief. 3 A gambler. E. कन् added to the last.
43967: हरिकेलीय m. (-यः) Bengal. E. हरि VIṢṆU, केलि sport, and छ aff.
43968: हरिकेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, क BRAHMĀ, and ईश lord.
43969: हरिगृह n. (-हं) A city and district, also Sambhalpur. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and गृह abode.
43970: हरिचन्दन mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A yellow and fragrant sort of Sandal wood. 2 One of the trees of paradise. n. (-नं) 1 Saffron. 2 Moon-light. 3 The farina of the lotus. 4 The person of a lover or mistress. E. हरि VIṢṆU, or yellow, and चन्दन Sandal.
43971: हरिण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Yellowish white. m. (-णः) 1 A deer. 2 Yellowish white, (the colour.) 3 White. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 ŚIVA. 6 The sun. 7 A goose. 8 A minor division of the world. f. (-णी) 1 A doe. 2 A golden image. 3 A woman, one of the four kinds, the same as the Citriṇī, or female of the man termed Mṛga. 4 A form of metre, a variety of the class termed Atyaṣṭi or verse of four lines of 17 syllables each. 5 Green: see हरित. 6 Yellow jasmine. E. हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इनच्.
43972: हरिणकलङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The moon. E. हरिण a deer, कलङ्क a spot.
43973: हरिणनयन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Deer-eyed. E. हरिण, and नयन the eye; also हरिण, लोचन, हरिणाक्षि, &c.
43974: हरिणनर्त्तक m. (-कः) A chorister of INDRA'S heaven. E. हरिण a deer, and नर्त्तक a dancer.
43975: हरिणप्लुता f. (-ता) A stanza having eleven syllables in every first and third Pāda, and twelve in every second and fourth.
43976: हरिणहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fearful, timid. E. हरिण a deer, and हृदय heart; deer-hearted.
43977: हरिणाक्षी f. (-क्षी) 1 A perfume, commonly Hāttavilāsinī. 2 A woman with handsome eyes. E. हरिण a deer, and अक्षि the eye, fem. aff. ङीष.
43978: हरिणाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The moon. E. हरिण a deer, and अङ्क mark or symbol.
43979: हरित् mfn. (-रित्) Green, of a green colour. m. (-त्) 1 Green, (the colour.) 2 A swift horse or a horse of the sun. 3 Kidneybean, (Phaseolus mungo.) 4 A lion. 5 The sun. 6 VIṢṆU. mn. (-रित्) Grass. f. (-रित्). 1 A quarter or region, a point of the compass. 2 Turmeric. E. हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. इति.
43980: हरित mfn. (-तः-ता or रिणी-तं) 1 Green, of a green colour. 2 Grassy, verdant. m. (-तः) 1 Green, (the colour.) 2 A lion. f. (-ता) 1 Bent grass. 2 Turmeric. 3 A brown or tawny grape. E. हृ to take, इतन् Uṇādi aff.
43981: हरितक n. (-कः) A potherb. E. हरित green, and कन् added.
43982: हरितछद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Green-leaved. E. हरित, and छद a leaf.
43983: हरितायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Becoming green. E. हरित used as a verb, शतृ aff.
43984: हरिताल n. (-लं) Yellow orpiment. f. (-ली) 1 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 2 A streak or line in the sky, (the milky way?) 3 A sort of creeper. E. हरित green, अल to possess or adorn, aff. अण्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
43985: हरितालक m. (-कः) The green pigeon. n. (-कं) Theatrical decoration, painting the person, &c. E. हरिताल orpiment, कन् aff.
43986: हरितालिका f. (-का) 1 A sort of grass, (Panicum dactylon, Rox.) 2 The fourth lunar day of the month Bhadra. E. कन् added to हरिताल, fem. form.
43987: हरिताश्मन् n. (-श्म) 1 Blue vitriol. 2 A turquoise. 3 An emerald. E. हरित green, अश्मन् a stone.
43988: हरितीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made verdant or green, coloured green, &c. E. हरित, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
43989: हरित्पर्ण n. (-र्णं) A radish. E. हरित् green, and पर्ण a leaf.
43990: हरिदश्व m. (-श्वः) The sun. E. हरित् green, and अश्व a horse.
43991: हरिदेव m. (-वः) The asterism Srāvaṇa. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and देव presiding deity.
43992: हरिद्रव m. (-वः) A powder of the blossoms of the Mesua ferrea.
43993: हरिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Turmeric, (either the plant or the powdered root.) E. हरित् green, द्रु to flow or ooze, aff. ड, or हरि VIṢṆU, &c., दृ to be regarded, aff. क.
43994: हरिद्राक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared or stained with turmeric. E. हरिद्रा, and अक्त anointed.
43995: हरिद्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A yellow bird. E. हरिद्रा turmeric, and अङ्ग body.
43996: हरिद्राभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Of a yellow colour. m. (-भः) 1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) 2 Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) 3 Yellow, the colour. E. हरिद्रा turmeric, आभ resembling.
43997: हरिद्राराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Fickle, capricious, unsteady, in affection or attachment. E. हरिद्रा turmeric, and राग colour, in opposition to the नीलराग or true blue; also with कन् added. हरिद्रारागक.
43998: हरिद्रु m. (-द्रुः) 1 A tree. 2 A plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhizon.) E. हरि a monkey, द्रु to go, Uṇādi aff. कु.
43999: हरिद्वार n. (-रं) The town of Haridvār, where the Ganges descends into the level land of Hindustan. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and द्वार gate; being the road to Vaikuṇṭha or VIṢṆU'S heaven.
44000: हरिनामन् m. (-मा) A kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. हरि the same, and नामन् appellation.
44001: हरिनेत्र m. (-त्रः) An owl. n. (-त्रं) The white lotus. E. हरि VIṢṆU, &c., and नेत्र an eye.
44002: हरिन्मणि m. (-णिः) An emerald. E. हरित् green, and मणि a gem.
44003: हरिपर्ण n. (-र्णं) A radish. E. हरि green, and पर्ण a leaf; also हरित्पर्ण.
44004: हरिप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Liked or loved by VIṢṆU, &c. m. (-यः) 1 A tree, (Nauclea Cadamba.) 2 ŚIVA. 3 A fool, a blockhead. 4 Armour, mail. n. (-यं) 1 A dark sort of Sandal wood. 2 The fragrant root of the Andropogon muricatum. f. (-या) 1 LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU. 2 Tulasi or basil. 3 The twelfth day of the lunar fortnight. 4 The earth. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and प्रिय beloved.
44005: हरिबालुक n. (-कं) A perfume and drug, commonly Elavāluka. E. हरि tawny, बालुका sand.
44006: हरिभद्र n. (-द्रं) A sort of perfume, commonly Elavāluka.
44007: हरिभुज् m. (-भुक्) A snake. E. हरि a frog, and भुज् what eats.
44008: हरिमन् m. (-मा) Time. E. हृ to take, इमनिच् Uṇādi aff.
44009: हरिमन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 A tree, (Premna longifolia.) 2 Chick pea. E. हरि fire or a horse, &c., and मन्थ agitating or churning.
44010: हरिमन्थक m. (-कः) Chick pea, (Cicer arietinum.) E. कन् added to the last.
44011: हरिमन्थज m. (-जः) 1 Chick pea. 2 A sort of kidney-bean. E. हरि a horse, &c., मन्थ churning, chewing, जन to produce, aff. ड.
44012: हरिय m. (-यः) A horse of a yellow colour.
44013: हरिले ind. A term of calling in theatrical language, addressed to a female slave.
44014: हरिलोचन m. (-नः) 1 A crab. 2 An owl. E. हरि green, and लोचन the eye.
44015: हरिवत् m. (-वान्) INDRA. E. हरि a horse, and मतुप् aff.
44016: हरिवर्ष n. (-र्षं) A division of the old or known continent; the country between the Niṣadha and Hemakūṭa mountains. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and वर्ष a division of the world.
44017: हरिवाहन m. (-नः) GARUḌA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and वाहन a vehicle.
44018: हरिवीज n. (-जं) Yellow orpiment. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and वीज semen.
44019: हरिवृष n. (-षं) A division of the continent: see हरिवर्ष.
44020: हरिशर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and शर an arrow; VIṢṆU having served him as the shaft which set the cities of TRIPURA on fire.
44021: हरिश्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A sovereign, the twenty-eighth of the solar dynasty in the second age, celebrated for his piety and liberality, and who on those accounts was elevated, together with his subjects, to heaven: having been insidiously induced by NĀRADA, to relate his actions with unbecoming pride, he descended from Svarga, a stage at each sentence, till stopping in time, and doing homage to the gods, he was fixed with his capital in mid-air. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and चन्द्र the moon.
44022: हरिश्चन्द्रपुर n. (-रं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA: see the last. E. हरिश्चन्द्र a name, and पुर city.
44023: हरिषेण m. (-णः) The tenth of the twelve universal emperors enumerated by the Jainas. E. हरि VIṢṆU, &c., and सेना a host.
44024: हरिसुत m. (-तः) One of the emperors of the Jainas; also named HARIṢEṆA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and सुत the son.
44025: हरिहय m. (-यः) 1 INDRA. 2 The sun. 3 SKANDA. 4 GAṆEŚA. E. हरि green, and हय a horse.
44026: हरिहरात्मक m. (-कः) 1 GARUḌA. 2 DAKṢA. E. हरि VIṢṆU, and हर ŚIVA, आत्मन् self, same, कन् added.
44027: हरीतकी f. (-की) Yellow or Chebulic myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula:) seven varieties of this are distinguished. E. हरि green, (colour,) इत gone, got, कन् added, fem. aff. ङीष्.
44028: हरेणु f. (-णुः) 1 A drug and perfume, commonly Reṇukā. 2 A reputable woman. 3 Pulse, peas. 4 A deer of a copper colour. m. (-णुः) 1 Laṅkā. 2 A creeper, marking the boundary of a village. E. हृ to take, एणु Uṇādi aff.
44029: हर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be seized, taken, accepted, &c. E. हृ to take, तव्यर् aff.
44030: हर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Taking, seizing, conveying, who takes or receives. E. हृ to take or convey, aff. तृच्.
44031: हर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Gaping, yawning. E. हृ to take, मनिन् aff.
44032: हर्म्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown, cast, sent. 2 Burnt.
44033: हर्म्मुट m. (-टः) 1 The sun. 2 A tortoise.
44034: हर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) A palace, a mansion, the habitation of a man of wealth or rank. E. हृ to take, (the mind,) यत् aff., and मुट् augment.
44035: हर्य्य r. 1st cl. (हर्य्यति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To desire. 3 To be weary.
44036: हर्य्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A lion. 2 KUVERA. E. हरि tawny or green, and अक्षि the eye, षच् aff.
44037: हर्य्यत m. (-तः) 1 A horse. 2 A steed fit for an Aśvamedha. E. हृ to take, अतच् Uṇādi aff.
44039: हर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Happy, delighted. m. (-र्षः) Joy, pleasure, delight, happiness. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. अच् or घञ्.
44040: हर्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Delighting, pleasing, delightful. m. (-कः) The name of a mountain. E. हृष to please, aff. ण्वुल्.
44041: हर्षकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Causing delight, gratifying, delighting. E. हर्ष, and कर who or what makes.
44042: हर्षण mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं) Causing delight, delighting, delightful, pleasurable, pleasant, &c. m. (-णः) 1 A cause of pleasure, any thing which confers pleasure. 2 The fourteenth of the astronomical Yogas. 3 A morbid affection of the eyes. 4 A deity presiding over Śrāddhas. 5 A kind of Śrāddha. n. (-णं) 1 Pleasing, making happy. 2 Rejoicing, being happy. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
