44043: हर्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Joyful, cheerful, happy. E. हृष to be pleased, शानच् aff.
44044: हर्षयित्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) Causing delight, delighting. m. (-त्नुः) A son, a child. n. (-त्नु) Gold. E. हृष to be pleased, Uṇādi aff. इत्नुच्.
44045: हर्षविह्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Overjoyed. E. हर्ष, and विह्वल agitated.
44046: हर्षसमन्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Joyful. E. हर्ष, and समन्वित possessed of.
44047: हर्षस्वन m. (-नः) A cry or sound expressing joy or pleasure. E. हर्ष gladness, and स्वन sound.
44048: हर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Happy, delighted, gladdened, made glad or happy. E. हर्ष, and इतच् aff., or हृष to be pleased, causal v., क्त aff.
44049: हर्षुल n. (-लः) 1 A deer. 2 A lover. E. हृष to be pleased, उलच् Uṇādi aff.
44050: हर्षोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Great happiness. E. हर्ष, and उत्कर्ष eminence.
44051: हर्षोदय m. (-यः) Appearance or occurrence of happiness. E. हर्ष, and उदय rising.
44053: हल n. (-लं) A plough. f. (-ला) 1 Vinous liquor. 2 The earth. 3 Water. E. हल to plough, aff. अच्.
44054: हलधर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Holding or having a plough. m. (-रः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. हस्न, and धर who holds or has.
44055: हलभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Having a plough. m. (-भृत्) A name of BALARĀMA. E. हल a plough, and भृत् possessing.
44056: हलभृति m. (-तिः) 1 Agriculture. 2 A saint so named. E. हल a plough, and भृति having.
44057: हलहति f. (-तिः) Ploughing, furrowing. E. हल, and हति striking.
44058: हलहलाशब्द m. (-ब्दः) Noise, tumult. E. हलहला imitative sound, शब्द sound.
44059: हला ind. A vocative particle, addressed in theatrical language to a female friend. E. हल to plough, आ aff.
44060: हलायुध m. (-धः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. हल a plough, आयुध a weapon.
44061: हलाह m. (-हः) A horse of mixed colour; also read हालाह.
44062: हलाहल mn. (-लः-लं) A sort of poison. m. (-लः) 1 A kind of snake. 2 A Jaina or Bauddha deified saint. 3 A sort of lizard or newt. E. हस्न to plough, अच् aff., अ negative, and हल the same; also हलहस्न, &c.
44063: हलि m. (-लिः) 1 A furrow. 2 Agriculture. E. हस्न to plough, इन् aff.
44064: हलिन् m. (-ली) 1 BALADEVA. 2 A ploughman, a cultivator. f. (-नी) A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya. E. हस्न a plough, इनि aff.
44065: हलिप्रिय m. (-यः) The Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba.) f. (-या) Spirituous liquor. E. हस्नि BALARĀMA, and प्रिय beloved.
44066: हलीन m. (-नः) The teak tree. E. हस्न a plough, ख aff.
44067: हलीमक n. (-कं) A sort of jaundice.
44068: हल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Ploughed, tilled. f. (-ल्या) A multitude of ploughs. m. (-ल्यः) Ploughing. E. हस्न a plough, यत् aff.
44069: हल्लक n. (-कं) The red lotus. E. ह्लाद to delight, ण्वुल् aff.; form irr.
44070: हल्लन n. (-नं) Rolling or tossing as in sleep.
44071: हल्लीष n. (-षं) 1 A minor dramatic entertainment, chiefly of singing and dancing by one male and eight or ten female performers, a ballet. 2 A dance performed by women in a circle. E. हेला wanton sport, लष् or स्नस to be skilful, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.; also हल्लीस.
44072: हल्लीषक m. (-कं) Dancing in a ring as performed by women. E. कन् added to हल्लीस or हल्लीष, whence it is also read हल्लीसक.
44073: हल्लीस n. (-सं) A dramatic entertainment, &c.: see हल्लीष.
44074: हव m. (-वः) 1 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 Call, calling. 3 Order, command. 4 Challenging, defying. E. हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, अप् aff.
44075: हवङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Eating rice and curds from a cup of bell-metal. E. हव sacrifice, गम to go, aff. खश्.
44076: हवन m. (-नः) Sacrifice, offering, oblation. f. (-नी) A hole in the ground for receiving a sacrificial fire. E. हु to sacrifice, ल्युट्. or युच् aff.
44077: हवनायुस् m. (-युः) Fire. E. हवन burnt-offering, and आयुस् life.
44078: हवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be offered with fire, fit for an oblation, &c. n. (-यं) Ghee. E. हु to sacrifice, अनीयर् aff.
44079: हवा or हवाव ind. A term implying undoubtedly, certainly: see हि.
44080: हविःशेष m. (-षः) The residue of an oblation of Ghee or clarified butter. E. हविस्, and शेष rest.
44081: हवित्री f. (-त्री) A hole in the ground for containing a sacrificial fire. E. हु to sacrifice, इत्रन् aff.
44082: हविरशन m. (-नः) Fire. E. हविस् Ghee, अशन food.
44083: हविर्गेह n. (-हं) A room in which a burnt-offering is made, a place of sacrifice. E. हविस् Ghee, and गेह a house or apartment.
44084: हविर्भुज् m. (-भुक्) Fire. E. हविस्, and भुज् who eats.
44085: हविर्याजिन् m. (-जी) A priest. E. हविस्, and याजिन् who offers.
44086: हविष्य n. (-ष्यं) 1 Clarified butter. 2 Rice mixed with Ghee. E. हविस् an oblation, यत् aff. of fitness.
44087: हविष्यभुज् m. (-भुक्) Fire. E. हविष्य, and भुज् who eats; also हविष्याशिन्, &c.
44088: हविस् n. (-विः) 1 Clarified butter. 2 An intended oblation, the article to be so offered, usually clarified butter. 3 Water. E. हु to offer in oblation, असि Uṇādi aff.
44089: हव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Fit or proper to be offered in oblation. n. (-व्यं) 1 An offering to the gods. 2 Ghee. E. हु to sacrifice, यत् aff.
44090: हव्यपाक m. (-कः) 1 An oblation dressed for the deities. 2 The vessel in which it is prepared. E. हव्य an offering to the gods, and पाक cooking.
44091: हव्यवाह m. (-हः) Fire. E. हव्य an oblation, and वाह who bears.
44092: हव्यवाहन m. (-नः) Fire. E. हव्य an oblation, and वाहन vehicle.
44093: हव्याश m. (-शः) Fire. E. हव्य an oblation, and अश who eats.
44094: हव्याशन m. (-नः) AGNI or fire. E. हव्य a burnt offering, and अशन food.
44095: हस (ए) हसे r. 1st cl. (हसति) 1 To laugh. 2 To laugh at, to ridicule: (this root does not take the middle voice when it implies reciprocal action, as व्यतिहसन्ति they laugh at each other.)
44096: हस m. (-सः) Laughter, laughing, laugh. E. हस to laugh, aff. अप्.
44097: हसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Laughing, smiling. f. (-न्ती) 1 A portable fire-pan, a small furnace. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 A Śākinī or female spirit attendant on DURGĀ. E. हस to laugh, aff. शतृ.
44098: हसन n. (-नं) Laughter, laughing. f. (-नी) A portable fire-place or pan. E. हस to laugh, aff. ल्युट्.
44099: हसनीमणि m. (-णिः) AGNI or fire. E. हसनी a fire-place, and मणि a jewel.
44100: हसन्तिका f. (-का) A portable furnace or fire-pan. E. कन् added to हसन्ती; see हसत्.
44101: हसिका f. (-का) Laughter. E. हस to laugh, ण्वुल् aff.
44102: हसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blown, budded, (as a flower.) 2 Smiling, n. (-तं) 1 Laughter. 2 Smiling. 3 The bow of KĀMA. E. हस to laugh, aff. क्त.
44103: हस्त m. (-स्तः) 1 The hand. 2 An elephant's trunk. 3 The thirteenth lunar asterism, designated by a hand, and containing five stars, one of which is γ or δ Corvi. 4 A head of hair, or abundance of hair. 5 A cubit measured by the hand and arm, or from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger. 6 (In prosody,) An anapæst. n. (-स्तं) A bellows. E. हस to laugh, Uṇādi aff. तन्.
44104: हस्तछेदन n. (-नं) Cutting off the hand. E. हस्त, and छेदन cutting.
44105: हस्ततल n. (-लं) 1 The palm of the hand. 2 The hand. 3 The tip of an elephant's trunk. E. हस्त, and तल surface.
44106: हस्तधारण n. (-णं) Warding off a blow, stopping, resisting, (in a conflict.) E. हस्त the hand, and धारण restraining.
44107: हस्तपुच्छ n. (-च्छं) The hand below the wrist. E. हस्त the hand, and पुच्छ tail.
44108: हस्तवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) In hand, seized, held, caught hold of. E. हस्त, and वर्त्तिन what abides.
44109: हस्तवारण n. (-णं) Resisting an assault, warding off a blow. E. हस्त the hand, and वारण prohibiting.
44110: हस्तविम्ब n. (-म्बं) Perfuming the person. E. हस्त the hand, and विम्ब a red fruit.
44111: हस्तसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A bracelet, one worn at the wrist. E. हस्त the hand, and सूत्र a string.
44112: हस्तस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) In hand, held, grasped. E. हस्त, and स्थ what stays or is.
44113: हस्तस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Held, in hand. E. हस्त, and स्थित staying.
44114: हस्तिकक्ष्य m. (-क्ष्यः) 1 A lion. 2 A tiger. E. हस्ति an elephant, कश to hurt, स aff., and यत् added.
44115: हस्तिकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 The castor oil tree. 2 The Butea frondosa. 3 A demi-god of a particular class. E. हस्तिन् an elephant, and कर्ण the ear.
44116: हस्तिकर्णक m. (-कः) A tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. कन् added to the last.
44117: हस्तिकर्णदल m. (-लः) A sort of Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.) E. हस्ति an elephant, कर्ण the ear, and दल a leaf.
44119: हस्तिकोलि m. (-लिः) A sort of jujube. E. हस्ति an elephant, and कोलि jujube.
44120: हस्तिगिरि m. (-रिः) The city Kāñci, a place of pilgrimage in the peninsula. E. हस्ति an elephant, and गिरि a mountain.
44121: हस्तिघोषा f. (-षा) A kind of creeper. E. हस्ति an elephant, and घोषा the generic name.
44122: हस्तिघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A man. E. हस्ति an elephant, घ्न who kills.
44123: हस्तिचारिन् m. (-री) An elephant-driver. E. हस्ति, and चारिन् who gives.
44124: हस्तिदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The radish. 2 A pin or bracket projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon. n. (-न्तं) Ivory. E. हस्ति an elephant, and दन्त a tooth; also with कन् added, हस्तिदन्तक.
44125: हस्तिद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) As big as an elephant, gigantic, elephantine. E. हस्ति an elephant, द्वयसच् aff.
44126: हस्तिन् m. (-स्ती) An elephant. f. (-नी) 1 A female elephant. 2 A female; one of the four kinds into which they are classed, and described as of low stature, corpulent habits, curly hair, dark complexion, libidinous appetite, and furious passions. 3 A drug and perfume; also हट्टविस्नासिनी. E. हस्त a trunk, and इनि aff.
44127: हस्तिनख n. (-खं) A sort of covered way, a raised place of earth or masonry, covering the access to the gate of a city or fort. E. हस्ति an elephant, and नख nail.
44128: हस्तिनापुर n. (-रं) Ancient Dehli, the capital of YUDHIṢṬHIRA and his brethren, the remains of which still exist, about 57  miles north-east of the modern city, on the banks of the old channel of the Ganges. E. हस्तिन् the name of a king, its founder, or an elephant, &c., and पुर city; also हस्तिनीपुर.
44129: हस्तिप m. (-पः) An elephant rider or driver. E. हस्तिन् an elephant, पाल to cherish or rear, aff. क.
44130: हस्तिपक m. (-कः) An elephant-driver or keeper. E. हस्तिप the same, and कन् aff.
44131: हस्तिपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A plant, commonly Moraṭā. 2 A sort of gourd, (Momordica mixta.) E. हस्ति an elephant, and पर्ण leaf.
44132: हस्तिमद m. (-दः) The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples when in rut. E. हस्ति an elephant, and मद the frontal juice.
44133: हस्तिमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 GAṆEŚA. 2 ŚAṄKHA, the eighth of the chief Nāgas or serpents of the infernal regions. 3 The elephant of INDRA. 4 A heap of ashes. 5 A shower of dust. 6 Frost, cold. E. हस्ति an elephant, and मल्ल a wrestler.
44134: हस्तिवाह m. (-हः) A goad. E. हस्ति an elephant, and वाह what bears.
44135: हस्तिशाला f. (-ला) An elephant stall or stable. E. हस्ति an elephant, and शाला hall.
44136: हस्तिशुण्डा f. (-ण्डा or ण्डी) 1 An elephant's trunk. 2 A flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. हस्ति an elephant, शुण्डा the trunk.
44137: हस्तेकरण n. (-णं) Marriage. E. हस्त the hand in the seventh case, and करण making.
44138: हस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) 1 Given with the hand. 2 Done with the hand, manual. E. हस्त the hand, यत् aff.
44139: हस्त्यारोह m. (-हः) An elephant rider or driver. E. हस्ति an elephant, and आरोह who mounts.
44140: हस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) Stupid, ignorant, a fool. E. हस to laugh at or deride, रक् Uṇādi aff.
44141: हहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison.
44142: हहा m. (-हा) A Gandharba or chorister of heaven; also हाहा
44143: हा r. 3rd cl. (ओ क,) ओहाक् (जहाति) 1 To quit, to leave, to abandon. 2 To wander or deviate: (ओ ड,) ओहाङ् (जिहते) To go, to move.
44144: हा ind. 1 An interjection of weariness. 2 Of sorrow, pain. 3 An exclamation of pleasure. 4 A term of reproach. E. हा to abandon, aff. क्विप्; the word corresponds to ah, alas, oh, ha, &c.
44146: हाटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Golden, of gold, (as a weight or coin.) n. (-कं) Gold. E. हट to shine, ण्वुल् aff.
44147: हाटकमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of gold, golden. E. हाटक gold, मयट् aff.
44148: हातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be abandoned, to be left. E. हा to abandon, तव्यर् aff.
44149: हात्र n. (-त्रं) Wages, hire. E. हन to hurt, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
44150: हान n. (-नं) 1 Abandoning, relinquishing. 2 Prowess, valour. E. हा to leave, ल्युट् aff.
44151: हानि f. (-निः) Loss, privation, abandonment, relinquishment. E. हा to leave, Uṇādi aff. नि.
44152: हानुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, hurting, killing. E. हन to hurt or kill, उकञ् aff.
44153: हान्द्र n. (-न्द्रं) Death, dying. E. हन to kill, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
44157: हायन mn. (-नः-नं) A year. m. (-नः) 1 A flame, a ray. 2 A sort of rice. E. हा to go or leave, ल्युट् aff., युक् augment.
44158: हार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what takes, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A porter, a carrier. 2 Taking, conveying. 3 A string or garland of pearls, &c. 4 War, battle. 5 (In prosody,) A long syllable. 6 (In arithmetic,) A divisor, also the denominator of a fraction. E. हृ to seize, (the mind, &c.) and घञ् aff., or causal form, with अण् aff.
44159: हारक m. (-कः) 1 A thief. 2 A cheat, a rogue. 3 Prose. 4 Science. 5 A gambler. 6 A tree, (Trophis aspera.) 7 A plunderer, a ravisher, one who carries off any thing. 8 (In arithmetic,) A divisor. E. हृ to take, aff. ण्वुल्.
44160: हारयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A necklace. E. हार, and यष्टि a staff.
44161: हारहूर n. (-रं) Wine, vinous liquor. f. (-रा) A grape.
44162: हारि mfn. (-रिः-रिः or -री-रि) Handsome, charming. f. (-रिः) 1 Defeat, discomfiture, either in war or gambling, &c. 2 A traveller's progeny or family. f. (-री) A pearl. E. हृ to take or steal, aff. इञ्, optionally in the fem. form ङीष् added.
44163: हारिकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठी-ण्ठं) Wearing or having a necklace. m. (-ण्ठः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. हारि for हार a necklace, कण्ठ the throat.
44164: हारिण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Relating to deer, (deer-flesh, skin, &c.) E. हरिण, and अण् aff.
44165: हारिणिक m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-killer. f. (-की) A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre. E. हरिण a deer, ठक् aff.
44166: हारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lost, relinquished, made away with. m. (-तः) 1 The green or wood pigeon. 2 Green, the colour. E. हृ to take, causal v., क्त aff., or हरित् green, अण् aff.
44167: हारितक n. (-कं) A potherb. E. हरित the same, ठन् aff.
44168: हारिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) 1 Stained, dyed, or coloured with turmeric. 2 Yellow. m. (-द्रः) 1 The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Cadamba.) 2 Yellow, (the colour.) E. हरिद्रा turmeric, and अण् or अञ् aff.
44169: हारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Taking, getting, who takes or gets. 2 Pleasant, agreeable. E. हृ to take, aff. णिनि.
44170: हारीत m. (-तः) 1 The green or wood pigeon, (Columba hariala, BUC.) 2 A Muni, and legislator. 3 Roguery, cheating, fraud. E. हार a necklace, or हारि defeat, and इत gone, got; or हरित green, अण् aff., and the vowel made long.
44171: हार्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) Affection, kindness. E. हृद the heart, अण् aff.
44172: हार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be taken, to be taken away. m. (-र्य्यः) Beleric myrobalan. E. हृ to take, aff. ण्यत्.
44173: हाल m. (-लः) 1 BALARĀMA. 2 A name of ŚĀLIVĀHANA. 3 A plough. f. (-ला) Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor. (-ली) A wife's younger sister. E. हाल a plough, aff. अण्, or हल to plough, aff. घञ्.
44174: हालक m. (-कः) A horse of a yellowish red, or tawny colour.
44175: हालहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see the next.
44176: हालहाल n. (-लं) A sort of poison; also variously read हलाहलं, हस्नहलं, हास्नाहलं.
44178: हालाहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see हास्नहाल. f. (-स्ना) A small mouse. f. (-ली) Wine, spirituous liquor. m. (-लः) A sort of worm or insect, a kind of newt.
44179: हालाहलधर m. (-रः) A small black and venomous snake. E. हालाहल poison, and धर having.
44180: हालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a plough, as a ploughman, cattle, &c. E. हल a plough, ठञ् or ठक् aff.
44181: हालिनी f. (-नी) A sort of lizard.
44182: हालु m. (-लुः) A tooth. E. हल to plough, उण् Uṇādi aff.
44183: हाव m. (-वः) 1 Any feminine act of amorous pastime, or tending to excite amorous sensations, coquetry, blandishment, dalliance. 2 Calling. E. ह्वेञ् to call, (to incite passion,) घञ् aff.
44184: हास m. (-सः) Laughing, laughter. E. हस to laugh, aff. घञ्.
44185: हासक m. (-कः) A buffoon. E. हस to laugh, causal v., वुन् aff.
44186: हासकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Laughing, laughing at. 2 Causing laughter, merry, ridiculous. E. हास, कर what makes.
44187: हासस् m. (-साः) The moon, (in the language of the Vedas. E. हा to abandon, असुन् aff., and सुट् augment.
44188: हासिका f. (-का) Laughter, mirth. E. हस to laugh, ण्वुल् aff.
44189: हासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Laughing, smiling. E. हस to laugh, घिनुण् aff.
44190: हास्तिक n. (-कं) A herd of elephants. m. (-कः) A rider on an elephant, an elephant-driver, &c. E. हस्तिन् an elephant, ठक् aff.
44191: हास्तिन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Elephantine, large, as big as an elephant, &c. n. (-नं) Hastināpura, ancient Dehli. E. हस्तिन् a sovereign, founder of the city, or an elephant, and अण् aff. of derivation, or abundance.
44192: हास्तिनपुर n. (-रं) Hastināpura. E. हास्तिन the same, and पुर city.
44193: हास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Laughable, ridiculous. n. (-स्यं) Laughter. laughing, mirth. E. हस to laugh, and ण्यत् aff.
44194: हाहल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see हलाहल.
44195: हाहस् m. (-हाः) A Gandharba, a celestial being of an inferior order.
44196: हाहा m. (-हाः) A Gandharba, a demi-god of an inferior order, attendant on KUVERA and the other gods, and especially the chanter of their praises. ind. An interjection of surprise, or grief, or pain. E. हा alas, interjection of sorrow, हा to abandon, क्विप् aff., or with असि, aff. हाहस्, or हा interjection repeated.
44197: हाहाकार m. (-रः) 1 The noise or uproar of battle. 2 Lamentation, sound of grief or pity. E. हाहा interjection of pain, कार making.
44198: हाहाल n. (-लं) A sort of poison: see हलाहल.
44199: हि r. 5th cl. (हिनोति) 1 To go. 2 To send. 3 To grow or increase. 4 To be in pain.
44200: हि ind. 1 Because, for, on account of. 2 Assembly, certainly, (assertion.) 3 Indeed, surely, (interrogation.) 4 A particle, implying difference or distinction. 5 An expletive. 6 Ah, alas. 7 An interjection of envy or contempt. 8 An interjection of hurry. E. हि to go, विच् aff.
44201: हिंसक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mischievous, malignant, ferocious, savage. m. (-कः) 1 A beast of prey. 2 An enemy. 3 A Brahman, who has studied the Atharvan Veda. E. हिसि to injure, वुञ् aff.
44202: हिंसन n. (-नं) Injuring, hurting. E. हिसि to hurt, ल्युट् aff.
44203: हिंसा f. (-सा) 1 Injury, mischief, &c.; it is usually distinguished as of three sorts, mental, (as malice,) verbal, (abuse,) personal, (striking, wounding, beating, &c.) 2 Slaughter, killing, slaying. E. हिंसि to hurt or kill, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
44204: हिंसाकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Incantation to destroy, or the practice of magic, or employment of mystical texts for malevolent and injurious purposes. 2 Any mischievous or malevolent act. E. हिंसा injury, and कर्म्मन् act.
44205: हिंसात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Injurious. E. हिंसा, and आत्मक self.
44206: हिंसारु m. (-रुः) A tiger. E. हिंसा injury, ऋ to go or affect, aff. उण्.
44207: हिंसालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Mischievous, hurtful. E. हिंसा injury, and आलुच् aff.
44208: हिंसालुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Mischievous, hurtful. m. (-कः) A mischievous or savage dog. E. कन् added to the last.
44209: हिंसीर m. (-रः) 1 A tiger. 2 A wretch, a villain. E. हिसि to hurt or kill, Uṇādi aff. ईरन् or ईरच्.
44210: हिंस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) 1 Mischievous, hurtful, injurious. 2 Murderous. 3 Formidable, terrible. 4 Fierce, savage. m. (-स्रः) 1 BHĪMA. 2 ŚIVA. 3 A beast of prey. f. (-स्रा) 1 Spikenard (Valeriana Jaṭāmāṃsī.) 2 A shrub, (Abrus precatorious.) 3 A sort of grain, (Coix barbata.) 4 A vein, a nerve. E. हिसि to hurt, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
44211: हिंस्रक m. (-कः) A beast of prey. E. कन् added to the last.
44212: हिंस्रपशु m. (-शुः) A beast of prey. E. हिंस्र mischievous, and पशु an animal.
44213: हिक्क r. 1st cl. (हिक्कति-ते) 1 To sound inarticulately. 2 To hiccough. r. 10th cl. (हिक्कयते) To hurt or injure.
44214: हिक्का f. (-क्का) Hiccough. E. हिक्क to hiccough, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
44215: हिङ्कार m. (-रः) A tiger. E. हिं imitative sound, and कार who makes.
44216: हिङ्गु mn. (-ङ्गुः-ङ्गु) Asafoetida. E. हि to go, deriv. irr., or हिम frost, गम to go, डु aff., form irr.
44217: हिङ्गुनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) 1 The Nimb tree. 2 Asafoetida, (the gum.) E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, and निर्य्यास exudation.
44218: हिङ्गुपची f. (-ची) A leaf, and drug, perhaps the leaf of the asafoetida plant. E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, and पत्र a leaf.
44219: हिङ्गुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, commonly Banspatri. E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, and पर्ण leaf.
44220: हिङ्गुल m. (-लः) Vermilion. f. (-ली) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena). E. हिङ्गु asafoetida, स्ना to take or give, aff. क.
44221: हिङ्गुलि m. (-लिः) Vermilion. E. हिङ्गु asafœtida, स्ना to take or give, aff. कि.
44222: हिङ्गुलिका f. (-का) A prickly night-shade, (Solanum Jacquini.) E. हिङ्गुली the egg-plant, कन् added.
44223: हिङ्गुलु mn. (-लुः-लु) Vermilion. E. हिङ्गु asafœtida, स्ना to give or take, aff. डु.
44224: हिङ्गुशिराटिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Banspatri.
44225: हिङ्गूल n. (-लं) An esculent root, a sort of yam.
44227: हिज्जस्न m. (-लः) A plant, commonly Hijjal, (Barringtonia acutangula).
44228: हिञ्जीर m. (-रः) A rope or chain for an elephant's feet.
44229: हिड (इ) हिडि r. 1st cl. (हिण्डते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To disregard or disrespect.
44230: हिडिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A prince of the Rākṣasas slain by BHĪMA. f. (-म्बा) The sister of Hiḍimbā carried off by BHĪMA: these names are also read हिडम्ब, हिडम्बा.
44231: हिडिम्बजित् m. (-जित्) BHĪMA, the second of the Pāṇḍus. E. हिडिम्ब a Rākṣasa, and जित् conqueror; also similar compounds, as हिडिम्बनिसूदनः, हिडिम्बभिद्.
44232: हिडिम्बभिद् m. (-भित् or भिद्) BHĪMA; see the last.
44233: हिडिम्बापति m. (-तिः) 1 HANUMĀN. 2 BHĪMA. E. हिडिम्बा a female Rākṣasa, and पति husband.
44234: हिडिम्बारमण m. (-णः) 1 HANUMĀN, the monkey friend and ally of RĀMA. 2 BHĪMA. E. हिडिम्बा a female Rākṣasa, and रमण husband.
44235: हिण्डन n. (-नं) 1 Wandering, roaming. 2 Copulation. 3 Writing. E. हिडि to go, ल्युट् aff.
44236: हिण्डिक m. (-कः) An astrologer. E. हिडि to go, aff. अच्, and ठक् added.
44237: हिण्डिर m. (-रः) Cuttle fish bone. E. हिडि to go, or despise, aff. इरन्; also हिण्डीर.
44238: हिण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A name of DURGĀ. E. हिडि to go, or despise, (the Asuras,) अच् aff., and ङीष् added.
44239: हिण्डीप्रियतम m. (-मः) ŚIVA. E. हिण्डी DURGĀ, and प्रियतम dearest.
44240: हिण्डीर m. (-रः) 1 Cuttle fish bone, considered to be the indurated foam of the sea. 2 A man, a male. 3 The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) 4 A tonic or stomachic. E. हिडि to go, or despise, aff. ईरन्.
44241: हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं). 1 Suitable, proper, fit, worthy, right. 2 Gone, proceeded. 3 Held, taken, seized, placed. 4 (In medicine,) Proper, as diet or menstrua, suitable to the case or the medicines taken. 5 Friendly, affectionate, kind. 6 Useful. m. (-तः) A good, a benefit. (-ता) A causeway, a dike. E. धा to have or hold, क्त aff.
44242: हितकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Friendly, kind, favourable. m. (-रः) A benefactor. E. हित, and कर who does.
44243: हितकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Wishing well to, kind or friendly to. E. हित, and काम desire.
44244: हितकाम्या f. (-म्या) Concern for another's welfare. E. हित, and काम्या desire.
44245: हितप्रणी m. (-णीः) A spy, a secret emissary. E. हित proper, and प्रणी who instructs.
44246: हितप्रेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Benevolent, benign. E. हित, and प्रेप्सु wishing.
44247: हितबुद्धि mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि) Well-disposed to, wishing well to. E. हित, and बुद्धि understanding.
44248: हितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Friendly, favourable, doing good to. E. हित, and मतुप् aff.
44249: हितवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Giving good counsel, directing or advising what is right. m. (-दी) A director, an adviser. E. हित proper, and वादिन् speaking.
44250: हितानुकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Kind. E. हित, and अनुकारिन् who acts conformably to.
44251: हितान्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking another's welfare. E. हित, and अन्वेषिन् who seeks.
44252: हिताहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Good and evil, beneficial and disadvantageous. E. हित, and अहित bad.
44253: हितैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing well to. E. हित, and एषिन् who desires.
44254: हितोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Compassion, clemency, tenderness. 2 Good advice. E. हित kind, and उक्ति speech.
44255: हितोपदेश m. (-शः) Friendly or proper advice. E. हित proper, and उपदेश advice.
44256: हित्वा ind. Having left or abandoned. E. हा to leave, क्त्वा aff.
44257: हिन्ताल m. (-लः) The marshy date tree, (Phoenix or Elate paludosa.) E. हीन defective, i. e. small, ताल the palm, deriv. irr.
44258: हिन्दोल m. (-लः) 1 A swing. 2 One of the Rāgas or personified musical modes. E. हि particle, दुल to shake, घञ् aff., deriv. irr.
44259: हिन्दोलक m. (-कः) A swing. E. हि particle, दुल to shake, aff. घञ्, and कन् added.
44260: हिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Cold, frigid. n. (-मं) 1 Frost, snow. 2 Cold. 3 Sandal. 4 Fresh butter. 5 Tin. 6 A pearl. 7 A lotus. m. (-मः) 1 The Sandal tree. 2 The moon. 3 Camphor. 4 The Himālaya mountain. f. (-मा) 1 Small cardamoms. 2 Reṇukā, a perfume. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) E. हन to hurt, मक् Uṇādi aff., and हि substituted for the root.
44261: हिमऋतु m. (-तुः) The cold season. E. हिम, and ऋतु season.
44262: हिमकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Frigorific, cold. m. (-रः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. हिम cold, and कर who makes, or a ray.
44263: हिमकूट m. (-टः) Winter. E. हिम frost or cold, and कूट a quantity.
44264: हिमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by cold, in the Himālaya, &c. m. (-जः) 1 The mountain Maināka. f. (-जा) 1 PĀRVATĪ. 2 Zedoary. E. हिम the Himāla personified, and ज born.
44265: हिमज्झटि f. (-टिः) Mist, dew, fog. E. हिम cold, ज्झट to be entangled, इ aff.
44266: हिमदुर्द्दिन n. (-नं) Winter, wintry weather, frost and snow. E. हिम cold, and दुर्द्दिन bad weather.
44267: हिमद्युति m. (-तिः) The moon. E. हिम cold, cooling, and द्युति radiance.
44268: हिमप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) The Himālaya mountains. E. हिम cold, and प्रस्थ abode.
44269: हिमबालुका f. (-का) Camphor. E. हिम cold, and बालुका sand.
44270: हिमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Cold, freezing, chilly, frosty. m. (-वान्) The Himālaya range. E. हिम cold, and मतुप् aff.
44271: हिमवत्सुत m. (-तः) 1 The mountain Maināka. f. (-ता) 1 The Ganges. 2 PĀRVATĪ. E. हिमवत् the Himālaya, and सुत son, or सुता daughter.
44272: हिमशीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very cold, frosty, freezing. E. हिम, and शीतल cold.
44273: हिमशैलजा f. (-जा) The goddess DURGĀ or PĀRVATĪ. E. हिमशैल the snowy mountains, and जा daughter.
44274: हिमश्रथ m. (-थः) The moon. E. हिम, and श्रथि to shed, अच् aff.
44275: हिमसंहति f. (-तिः) Ice and snow. E. हिम cold, संहति assemblage.
44276: हिमहानकृत् m. (-त्) Fire. E. हिम, हान loss, कृत् what makes.
44277: हिमहासक m. (-कः) The marshy date tree. E. हिम cold or winter, and हासक smiling.
44278: हिमांशु m. (-शुः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. हिम cold, अंशु a ray.
44279: हिमांश्वभिख्य n. (-ख्या) Silver. E. हिमांशु the moon, अभिख्या appellation.
44280: हिमागम m. (-मः) The cold season, winter. E. हिम cold or frost, and आगम arrival.
44281: हिमाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The snowy range of mountains, skirting the north of India, the Imaus or Emodus. E. हिम cold, and अद्रि a mountain.
44282: हिमानी f. (-नी) Ice and snow. E. हिम cold, ङीष् aff., and आनुक augment.
44283: हिमानिल m. (-लः) A frosty or cold wind. E. हिम, and अनिल wind.
44284: हिमाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Like frost and snow. E. हिम, and आभ resembling.
44285: हिमाराति m. (-तिः) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. E. हिम cold, अराति the enemy; also similar compounds, as, &c.
44286: हिमार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Chilly, cold, suffering from cold. E. हिम, and आर्त्त pained.
44287: हिमालय m. (-यः) The Himāla or Himālaya range of mountains, which bounds India on the north, and separates it from Tartary; the Imaus and Emodus of the ancients, giving rise to the Ganges, and Indus, and many other considerable rivers, and containing the highest elevations in the world: in mythology, the mountain is personified as the husband of MENAKĀ, and the father of GAṄGĀ or the Ganges, and DURGĀ or UMĀ in her descent as PĀRVATĪ, the mountain nymph, to captivate ŚIVA, and withdraw him from a course of ascetic austerity practised in those regions. E. हिम cold, or frost and snow, and आस्नय abode.
44288: हिमावती f. (-ती) A sort of moon-plant; also स्वर्णक्षीर.
44289: हिमाह्व m. (-ह्वः) Camphor. E. हिम snow, आह्व appellation.
44290: हिमाह्वय m. (-यः) Camphor. n. (-यं) A lotus. E. हिम cold, आह्वय appellation.
44291: हिमिका f. (-का) Hoar frost. E. हिम frost, कन् aff., fem. form.
44292: हिमेलु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Suffering from cold, chilly, frozen. E. हिम cold, एलु aff.
44293: हिम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) Frozen, snowy, cold, frigid. E. हिम frost and snow, and यत् aff.
44294: हिरङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) The personified ascending node.
44295: हिरण n. (-णं) 1 Gold. 2 Semen. 3 A cowry. E. हृ to take, ल्युट् aff., and इ substituted for the antepen. vowel: see हिरण्य.
44296: हिरण्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of gold, golden. m. (-यः) BRAHMĀ. n. (-यं) One of the Varṣas or divisions of the continent; the part between the mountainous ranges Śveta and Śṛṅgavān. E. हिरण् for हिरण gold, मयट् aff.
44297: हिरण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Gold. 2 Either of the precious metals, crude bullion, unwrought gold or silver. 3 Silver, crude or wrought. 4 A measure. 5 A cowry. 6 Semen virile. 7 Imperishable matter, that which is eternal. 8 Thing, substance. 9 Wealth, property. E. हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. कन्यन्, and किरच् substituted for the radical letters.
44298: हिरण्यकशिपु m. (-पुः) A Daitya, the father of PRAHLĀDA, for whose destruction, VIṢṆU descended in the fourth or NARASIṂHA Avatāra. E. हिरण्य gold, and कशिपु clothing, or food and clothing.
44299: हिरण्यकशिपुहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. हिरण्यकशिपु a Daitya, and हन् destroyer.
44300: हिरण्यगर्भ m. (-र्भः) BRAHMĀ. E. हिरण्य gold, गर्भं embryo; or the mundane egg floating on the water at creation, of that metal, or of similar colour, from which the deity issued, according to some legends.
44301: हिरण्यद m. (-दः) The ocean. f. (-दा) The earth. E. हिरण्य gold, and द what gives or yields.
44302: हिरण्यनाभ m. (-भः) The mountain Maināka. E. हिरण्य gold, नाम navel.
44303: हिरण्यबाहु m. (-हुः) 1 The river Śoṇa. 2 ŚIVA. E. हिरण्य golden, बाहु an arm.
44304: हिरण्यरेतस् m. (-ताः) 1 Fire. 2 The sun. 3 ŚIVA. E. हिरण्य gold, and रेतस् semen.
44305: हिरण्यव m. (-वः) A divine treasure. E. हिरण्य gold, व possessive aff. in this sense.
44306: हिरण्यवर्णा f. (-र्णा) A river in general. E. हिरण्य gold, and वर्ण colour.
44307: हिरण्यवाह m. (-हः) The river Śoṇa. E. हिरण्य gold, वह to bear, aff. अण्.
44308: हिरण्याक्ष m. (-क्षः) The name of a demon, killed by VIṢṆU. E. हिरण्य, and अक्ष for अक्षि eye.
44309: हिरुक् ind. 1 Without, except. 2 In the midst of, amongst. 3 Near. E. हि to go, रुकक् aff.
44310: हिल r. 6th cl. (हिलति) To express amorous inclination, to dally, to wanton, to sport amorously.
44311: हिलमोचि f. (-चिः-ची) A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) E. हिल sporting, मुच्च to loosen, इन् aff., ङीष् optionally added; also with कन् added, fem. form, हिलभोचिका.
44313: हिव (इ) हिवि r. 1st cl. (हिव्वति) 1 To be satisfied. 2 To satisfy or please.
44314: हिस (इ) हिसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (हिंसति हिंसयति) and 7th cl. (हिनस्ति) To hurt, to injure, to do any thing tending to the prejudice of another in word, thought, or deed.
44315: हिहि ind. An interjection of surprise or merriment.
44316: ही ind. 1 An exclamation or interjection of surprise; 2 Of fatigue or despondence; 3 Of sorrow; 4 A particle implying cause, (therefore, so.) E. हन to hurt, डी aff.
44317: हीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Deficient, defective. 2 Blamable, vile, bad. 3 Left, abandoned, quitted. 4 Wasted, worn, decayed. 5 Void of, free from. m. (-नः) An insufficient or objectionable witness. E. हा to quit, aff. क्त.
44318: हीनकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Neglecting, or not performing the customary rites, &c. E. हीन, and कर्म्मन् act; also हीनक्रिय, &c.
44319: हीनजाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Outcaste, vile, degraded. E. हीन abandoned, and जाति caste.
44320: हीनवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Of a low caste, outcaste, vile. E. हीन, and वर्ण caste.
44321: हीनवाद m. (-दः) Prevarication, contradictory evidence. E. हीन, and वाद speech.
44322: हीनवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Dumb, speechless. 2 Inadmissible, (as a witness.) 3 Contradictory, prevaricating. E. हीन left, or defective, वाद speech, इनि aff.
44323: हीनसख्य n. (-ख्यं) Keeping low company, associating with persons of degraded castes and occupations. E. हीन an outcaste, and सख्य friendship.
44324: हीनसन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) Destitute of peace or reconciliation. E. हीन, and सन्धि alliance.
44325: हीनसेवा f. (-वा) Serving or attending on low persons, associating with them. E. हीन, and सेवा service.
44326: हीनाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Crippled, maimed, defective. f. (-ङ्गी) An ant. E. हीन deficient, and अङ्ग the body.
44327: हीन्ताल m. (-लः) The marshy date tree: see हिन्ताल.
44328: हीर m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 3 A snake. 4 A necklace. 5 A lion. n. (-रं) A diamond. f. (-रा) 1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. 2 A cockroach. 3 An ant. E. हृ to take, क aff., and ईरु substituted for the radical finals.
44329: हीरक m. (-कः) The diamond. E. कन् added to the last.
44330: हीराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. हीर the diamond, and अङ्ग substance; being supposed to be the same.
44332: हीलुक n. (-कं) Rum, spirits distilled from molasses.
44333: हीही ind. 1 An interjection of surprise, (ah, ha!) 2 An interjection of laughter, (hee, hee!) E. ही repeated.
44334: हु r. 3rd cl. (जुहोति) 1 To sacrifice, to offer in oblation. 2 To eat. 3 To take. 4 To please or satisfy. 5 To throw or cast.
44335: हुङ्कार m. (-रः) Uttering a menacing sound, roaring, bellowing. E. हुम्, and कार making; also similar compounds, as हुङ्कृति, हुङ्कृत, &c.
44336: हुङ्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered or pronounced as an incantation. n. (-तं) 1 An incantation. 2 The roar or grunt of the wild boar. 3 Any roar. E. हुम् a mystical monosyllable, and कृत made.
44337: हुड r. 6th cl. (हुडति) To heap together, to collect or accumulate. (ऋ) हुडृ r. 1st cl. (होडति) To go or move. (इ) हुडि r. 1st cl. (हुण्डते) 1 To heap, &c. 2 To accept, to agree to, or assent. 3 To take.
44338: हुडु m. (-डुः) A ram. E. हुड to assemble, aff. कु.
44339: हुडुक्क m. (-क्कः) 1 A gallinule. 2 A drunken man. 3 A small hourglass-shaped drum. 4 A stick or staff, one bound with iron. 5 The bar of a door. E. हुडुक् imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. क.
44340: हुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A tiger. 2 A village hog. 3 A blockhead. 4 An imp, a goblin. 5 A ram. E. हुडि to collect, अच् aff.
44341: हुर्च्छ r. 1st cl. (हुर्च्छति) To be crooked, (literally or figuratively,) to be fraudulent. 2 To retreat, to hide or abscond.
44342: हुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Offered with fire, burnt as an oblation. 2 Called, invoked. n. (-तं) Oblation. E. हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
44343: हुतभुक्प्रिया f. (-या) The wife of AGNI or fire. E. हुतभुज् AGNI, and प्रिया the wife.
44344: हुतभुज् m. (-भुक्) AGNI or fire. E. हुत an oblation, भुज to eat, क्विप् aff.
44345: हुतवह m. (-हः) AGNI or fire. E. हुत an oblation, and वह who carries.
44346: हुतहोम m. (-मः) A Brahman who has offered an oblation. n. (-मं) An oblation. E. हुत, and होम sacrifice.
44347: हुताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Fire with which oblation is made. E. हुत, and अग्नि fire.
44348: हुताश m. (-शः) Fire or its deity AGNI. E. हुत an oblation, and अश who eats.
44349: हुताशन m. (-नः) 1 Fire or its deity. 2 ŚIVA. E. हुत burnt-offering, and अशन food.
44351: हुत्वा ind. Having offered in oblation. E. हु to offer, क्त्वा aff.
44352: हुम् ind. 1 An interjection of remembering, (ha, ah!) 2 Of repulse or reproach, (away!) 3 Interrogation, (hey?) 4 Assent, (yes.) 5 Doubt. 6 A mystical syllable of frequent occurrence in incantations. E. हु to sacrifice, डुम् aff.
44353: हुयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being offered in oblation. E. हु to offer, pass. v., शानच् aff.
44354: हुल r. 1st cl. (होस्नति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To kill. 3 To cover.
44355: हुस्नहुली f. (-स्नी) Inarticulate sounds made by women, especially a sort of Ululatus, though apparently employed upon pleasurable and not sorrowful occasions.
44356: हुहु m. (-हुः) A Gandharba. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डु aff., form irr.
44357: हुहू m. (-हूः) A Gandharba or chorister of heaven. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डु aff., form irr.; it is also read हुहु, हूहु, and हूहू.
44358: हू ind. An interjection of calling, of contempt, of pride, and of grief or weeping.
44359: हूङ्कार m. (-रः) 1 Uttering the sound Hum. 2 Roaring. E. हूम्, and कार making.
44360: हूड (ऋ) हूडृ r. 1st cl. (हूडति) To go, to move.
44361: हूण m. (-णः) A barbarian, a Hun.
44362: हूत m. (-तः-ता-तं) Called, summoned, invited. E. ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
44363: हूति f. (-तिः) 1 Calling. 2 Calling to in defiance, challenging. E. ह्वेञ् to call, aff. क्तिच्.
44364: हूम् ind. 1 A particle or doubt or consideration (humph, ha.) 2 An interrogatory particle, (hey, indeed.) 3 A particle of assent, (yes, well, so be it, amen.) 4 An interjection, of anger. 5 Of fear. 6 Of reproach, contempt, (equivalent to be silent, tush, pish.) 7 Of aversion, repulse, or dislike, &c. 8 A magical or mystical monosyllable. 9 An imitative sound. E. ह्वेञ् to call, aff. डूम्.
44365: हूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being offered in oblation. E. हु to offer pass. v., शानच् aff.
44366: हूरव m. (-वः) A jackal. E. हू a cry of fear or wrath, and रव, sound.
44367: हूर्च्छन n. (-नं) Crookedness, (literal or figurative,) craft, cunning. E. हुर्च्छ to be crooked, ल्युट् aff.
44368: हूहु m. (-हुः) A Gandharba: see हुहू.
44369: हूहू m. (-हूः) A Gandharba: see हुहू.
44370: हृ r. 1st cl. (ञ्) हृञ् r. 1st cl. (हरति-ते) 1 To convey. 2 To take or accept. 3 To steal. 4 To destroy or annul. r. 3rd cl. (हजर्त्ति) To take by violence. With अनु prefixed, To imitate. With अप, 1 To remove, to take away or apart. 2 To leave behind. 3 To steal. With अभि, To assault. With अभि and आङ्, To reason. With अभि and उत्, To deliver. With अभि, वि, and आङ्, To utter, to pronounce. With अव, 1 To regain. 2 To punish or fine. With उत्, 1 To raise, to lift or take up. 2 To expel. With उद् and आङ्, 1 To say or tell. 2 To illustrate, to exemplify. With उप, 1 To bring near to. 2 To give. With उप and सम्, To withhold. With नि changed to नी, To freeze. With निर्, To shew disrespect. With निर् and आङ्, To fast. With परि, 1 To reproach, to abuse or censure. 2 To leave, to shun, to abandon. 3 To resist. 4 To extract. With प्र, To strike. With प्रति changed to प्रती, To keep watch. With प्रति and आङ्, To think abstractedly by restraining the organs of sense. With प्रति and सम्, To disregard, to abandon. With वि, To sport, to ramble for pleasure. With वि, or वि and आङ्, To say, to utter, to speak. With वि and अव, 1 To transact business. 2 To litigate. With सम्, To kill. With सम्, or सम् and आङ्, To collect, to assemble. With सम्, अभि, वि and आङ्, To speak in concert. With सम्, उत् and आङ्, To relate. With सम् and उप, 1 To give. 2 To assemble, to collect. With सम् and प्र, To fight. With वि and अति prefixed and implying reciprocity (व्यतिहरते) To steal or plunder mutually. In the first sense (to convey), this verb governs two accusatives, as भारं हरति ग्रामं he takes the load (to) the village.
44371: हृच्छय m. (-यः) KĀMADEVA. E. हृत् the heart, and शय who sleeps.
44372: हृणिया f. (-या) 1 Shame, modesty. 2 Censure, reproach. E. हृणीङ् Kaṇḍvādi root, to be ashamed, यक् aff., and the vowel made short; otherwise हृणीया.
44373: हृणीया f. (-या) 1 Censure, reproach. 2 Shame, bashfulness. E. see the last.
44374: हृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, taken away, seized. 2 Accepted. E. हृ to take, क्त aff.
44375: हृतसर्व्वस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Robbed or stripped of all, entirely ruined. E. हृत, and सर्व्वस्व all.
44376: हृताधिकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Neglecting one's duty. 2 Deprived of an office, turned out. 3 Barred or deprived of one's right. E. हृत, and अधिकार superintendence.
44377: हृतोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Left without a reply. E. हृत, and उत्तर answer.
44378: हृत्पिण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The heart. E. हृत्, and पिण्ड lump of flesh.
44379: हृत्वा ind. Having taken, seized, accepted, &c. E. हृ to take, क्त्वा aff.
44380: हृत्स्थ mfn. (-त्स्थः-त्स्था-त्स्थं) Seated in the heart. E. हृत्, and स्थ what stays.
44381: हृद् n. (हृत् or हृद्) 1 The heart. 2 The mind, the faculty or seat of thought and feeling. E. हृ to take, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added; or हृद् substituted for the following.
44382: हृदय n. (-यं) 1 The mind, the seat or faculty of thought and feeling. 2 The heart. 3 Knowledge. E. हृ to take, कयन् Uṇādi aff., and दुक् augment.
44383: हृदयग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Captivating, engaging the affections. E. हृदय, and ग्राहिन् taking.
44384: हृदयङ्गम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Apposite and proper, (as speech.) 2 Affecting, touching. 3 Dear, beloved. E. हृदय the heart, गम to go, खश् aff.
44385: हृदयवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Good-hearted, kind, humane. E. हृदय the heart, and मतुप् aff.
44386: हृदयस्थान n. (-नं) The breast, the chest. E. हृदय the heart, and स्थान place.
44387: हृदयात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A heron. E. हृदय the heart, and आत्मन् self.
44388: हृदयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Good-hearted. E. हृदय the heart, and आलुच् aff.
44389: हृदयाविध् mfn. (-त् or द्) Heart-piercing. E. हृदय, and आविध् what pierces.
44390: हृदयिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Good-hearted. E. हृदय the heart, and ठन् aff.
44391: हृदयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Good-hearted. E. हृदय the heart, and इनि poss. aff.
44392: हृदयेश m. (-शः) 1 A husband. 2 A wife. E. हृदय the heart, and ईश lord.
44393: हृदयोदङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Heart-heaving, distressing. E. हृदय, उत् up, अंक what goes.
44394: हृदावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A curl or lock of hair on a horse's neck, or breast. E. हृद् the heart, and आवर्त्त a twist.
44395: हृदिस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक) Dear, beloved, cherished. E. हृदि in the heart, and स्पृश् what effects.
44396: हृद्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conceived, come to mind, designed. E. हृद्, and गत gone.
44397: हृद्गोल m. (-लः) The name of a mountainous district.
44398: हृद्गोलीय m. pl. (-याः) The military inhabitants of the Hṛdgola mountains. E. हृद्गोल as above, छ aff.
44399: हृद्देश m. (-शः) The heart or the region of it. E. हृद्, देश place.
44400: हृद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 Dear, beloved, cherished, desired. 2 Grateful, pleasant, agreeable. 3 Produced in or from the heart. 4 Affectionate, kind. m. (-द्यः) A Mantra of the Vedas for effecting any one's subjection or fascination. f. (-द्या) Vṛddhi, a medicinal root, so named. n. (-द्यं) Cassia bark. E. हृद् the heart, यत् aff.
44401: हृद्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The Bel tree, (Ægle marmelos.) n. (-न्धं) 1 Small cardamoms. 2 Sochal salt. f. (-न्धा) Great-flowered jasmine, E. हृद्य agreeable, and गन्ध smell.
44402: हृद्यता f. (-ता) Agreeableness, delightfulness. E. हृद्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, हृद्यत्वं.
44403: हृद्रोग m. (-गः) 1 Heart-burn. 2 Any disease of the heart. E. हृद् the heart, and रोग disease; also हृदयरोग.
44404: हृद्रोगवैरिन् m. (-री) A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) E. हृद्रोग the heart-burn, and वैरिन् hostile.
44405: हृद्वण्टक m. (-कः) The stomach. E. हृद् the heart, and वण्टक a part.
44406: हृल्लास m. (-सः) Hiccough. E. हृद् the heart, लस् to sport, aff. घञ्.
44407: हृल्लेख m. (-खः) Regret, sorrow for any object absent or missing. n. (-खं) Knowledge. E. हृद् the heart, लिख to write, aff. घञ्; also हृदयलेख.
44408: हृष (इर उ) इरहृषु r. 4th cl. (हृष्यति) To rejoice, to exult, to be pleased or delighted. (उ) हृषु r. 1st cl. (हर्षति) To lie, to affirm falsely.
44409: हृषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Astonished, surprised. 2 Pleased, delighted. 3 Exquisitely delighted, having the hair of the body  erect with pleasure. 4 Disappointed, baulked, deceived. 5 Bent, bowed. 6 Armed, accountred. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. क्त, with the augment इट्.
44410: हृषीक n. (-कं) Any organ of sense. E. हृष to affirm falsely, ईकन् Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel unchanged.
44411: हृषीकेश m. (-शः) KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. हृषीक an organ of sense, and ईश lord.
44412: हृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pleased, glad, delighted. 2 Laughing, smiling. 3 Having the hair of the body erect with pleasure. 4 Astonished, surprised. 5 Disappointed. E. हृष to be pleased, or to affirm falsely, aff. क्त.
44413: हृष्टपुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Well-conditioned, well fed and happy. E. हृष्ट, and पुष्ट nourished.
44414: हृष्टमानस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Happy, glad. E. हृष्ट pleased, मानस the mind, अण् aff.
44415: हृष्टरोमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-म) Having the hair of the body on end. E. हृष्ट delighted, रोमन् the down of the body.
44416: हृष्टहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Happy, light-hearted. E. हृष्ट, and हृदय the heart.
44417: हृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Delight, pleasure, happiness. 2 Pride, arrogance. E. हृष to be pleased, aff. क्तिन्.
44418: हे ind. 1 A vocative particle. 2 A particle of calling out to, or challenging. 3 An interjection, expressing envy or malice. E. हि to go, aff. डे.
44419: हेक्का f. (-क्का) Hiccough. E. हिक्क to hiccough, aff. अच्, and the vowel changed.
44420: हेट r. 1st cl. (हेटते) To resist, to oppose.
44421: हेठ r. 1st cl. (हेठते) (ऋ) हेठृ (हेठति) 1 To resist, to oppose, to contend with, to vex or harass. 2 To be wicked.
44422: हेठ m. (-ठः) 1 Obstruction, opposition, hindering, preventing. 2 Injury, hurting. E. हेठ to annoy or oppose, aff. अच्.
44423: हेड r. 1st cl. (हेडति) To surround, to encompass. (ऋ) हेडृ (हेडते) To disregard, to contemn.
44426: हेढ r. 9th cl. (हेढणाति) 1 To be past birth. 2 To produce young. 3 To purify.
44427: हेति f. (-तिः) 1 A weapon. 2 A ray of the sun. 3 Flame. E. हि to go, or हन to kill, aff. क्तिन्; the form is irr.
44428: हेतु m. (-तुः) 1 Cause, origin, motive. 2 The reason or argument for an inference or deduction. E. हि to go, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.
44429: हेतुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Causal, instrumental. 2 Relating or belonging to the cause or motive. m. (-कः) An active cause. an instrument or agent. E. हेतु cause, and कन् added.
44430: हेतुता f. (-ता) Causation, cause, causativeness, the abstract existence of cause or motive. E. हेतु cause, तल aff.; also हेतुत्व n. (-त्वं.)
44431: हेतुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Having a cause, proceding from one, acknowledging one, &c. E. हेतु, and मतुप् aff.
44432: हेतुवाद m. (-दः) Disputation. E. हेतु, and वाद dispute.
44433: हेतौ ind. By reason or cause of. E. हेतु in the seventh case, used as a particle.
44434: हेत्वाभास m. (-सः) (In logic,) Fallacious semblance of reason or argument, assignment of proof or cause which can be shewn to be incorrect; various kinds are specified. E. हेतु, and आभास semblance.
44435: हेम m. (-मः) A horse of a dark colour. n. (-मं) Gold. f. (-मा) 1 An Apsaras or courtesan of INDRA'S heaven. 2 A handsome woman. E. हि to go, मक् aff.
44436: हेमकन्दस्न m. (-लः) Coral. E. हेम gold, and कन्दस्न a shoot.
44437: हेमकार m. (-रः) A goldsmith. E. हेमन् gold, and कार who makes or works; also हेमकर्त्तृ (-र्त्ता,) &c.
44438: हेमकूट m. (-टः) One of the ranges of mountains dividing the known continent into nine Varṣas; this range is the second south of Ilāvṛta, or the central division, and is immediately to the north of the Himālaya, forming with it the boundaries of the Kinnara Varṣam. E. हेम gold or golden, and कूट a peak.
44439: हेमकेलि m. (-लिः) Fire. E. हेम gold, and केलि who sports.
44440: हेमकेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. हेम gold, and केश् hair.
44441: हेमक्षीरी f. (-री) A medicinal sort of moon-plant. E. हेम gold, and क्षीरी a name of several plants.
44442: हेमगन्धिनी f. (-नी) Reṇuka, a perfume. E. हेम golden, and गन्धिनी a perfume.
44443: हेमज्वास्न m. (-लः) Fire. E. हेम gold, and ज्वाला flame.
44444: हेमतरु m. (-रुः) Datura or thorn-apple. E. हेम, and तरु tree.
44445: हेमतार n. (-रं) Blue vitriol. E. हेम gold, तृ to pass, aff. घञ्.
44446: हेमदुग्ध m. (-ग्धः) The glomerous fig tree. f. (-ग्धी) A medicinal sort of moon-plant. E. हेम gold, टुग्ध milk; also with कन् added, हेमटुग्धक.
44447: हेमदुग्धक m. (-कः) The glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata:) see the last.
44448: हेमन् n. (-म) Gold. m. (-मा) 1 The planet MERCURY. 2 Winter. E. हि to go, मनिन् aff.
44449: हेमन्त mn. (-न्तः-न्तं) The cold season, winter, the two months, Agrahāyaṇa and Pauṣa, or about November-December. E. हन to hurt, भच् Uṇādi aff., हि substituted for the root, and मुट् augment.
44450: हेमन्तनाथ m. (-थः) Elephant or wood-apple. E. हेमन्त winter, and नाथ lord.
44451: हेमपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The mountain Meru. E. हेम gold, and पर्व्वत mountain.
44452: हेमपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 The Aśoka tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) 2 The China rose, the flower. m. (-ष्पः) 1 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.) 2 The Lodh tree. f. (-ष्पी) Bengal madder. E. हेम golden, and पुष्प a flower.
44453: हेमपुष्पक m. (-कः) The Champaka. f. (-ष्पिका) Yellow jasmine. E. कन् added to the last.
44454: हेममाला f. (-ला) The wife of YAMA. E. हेम gold, and माला a garland.
44455: हेमरत्नमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Full of gold and gems. E. हेम, and रत्न a gem, मयट् aff.
44456: हेमरागिणी f. (-णी) Turmeric. E. हेम gold, राग colour, इनि and ङीष् affs.
44457: हेमल m. (-लः) 1 A goldsmith. 2 A chameleon, a lizard. 3 A touchstone. E. हेम gold, ला to have or take, aff. क.
44458: हेमवल n. (-लं) A pearl. E. हेम gold, वल surrounding.
44459: हेमशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) VIṢṆU. E. हेम gold, and शङ्ख a shell.
44460: हेमशिखा f. (-खा) A medicinal sort of moon-plant. E. हेम gold, and शिखा crest.
44461: हेमसूत्रक n. (-कं) A necklace. E. हेम gold, सूत्र a string, कन् added.
44462: हेमाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 GARUḌA. 2 A lion. 3 The mountain Sumeru. 4 BRAHMĀ. 5 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.) E. हेम gold, and अङ्ग body.
44463: हेमाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The mountain Meru. E. हेम gold, and अद्रि a mountain.
44464: हेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be left, abandoned, avoided, &c. E. हा to quit, यत् aff.
44465: हेर n. (-रं) 1 A sort of crown or tiara. 2 Turmeric. 3 The illusion of a demon. E. हि to go, रक् aff.
44466: हेरम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 GAṆEŚA. 2 A buffalo. 3 A hero inflated with his own valour and prowess. 4 A Buddha or Bauddha deity. E. हे calling or defying, रवि to sound, aff. अच्.
44467: हेरम्बजननी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. हेरम्ब GAṆEŚA, and जननी mother.
44468: हेरम्बहट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A country included in the enumeration of the provinces of the Dekhin. E. हेरम्ब GAṆEŚA, and हट्ट fair.
44469: हेरिक m. (-कः) A spy, a secret emissary or agent.
44470: हेरुक m. (-कः) 1 An attendant on Mahākāla, or ŚIVA in that form. 2 An inferior divinity of the Bauddhas.
44472: हेलन n. (-नं) 1 Disrespect, disregard, contempt. 2 Wantoning, dalliance. E. हिस्न to disregard, aff. ल्युट्.
44473: हेला f. (-ला) 1 Wanton dalliance, lascivious endearment. 2 Disrespect, contempt. 3 Moonlight. E. हिल to dally, aff. अच् and टाप्.
44475: हेलि m. (-लिः) The sun. f. (-लिः) Dalliance, wanton sport. E. हिस्न to dally, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
44476: हेष (ऋ) हेषृ r. 1st cl. (हेषते) To neigh as a horse.
44477: हेषा f. (-षा) Neighing, (as a horse, or braying, as an ass.) E. हेष to sound, to neigh, aff. अच् and ठाप्.
44478: हेषिन् m. (-षी) A horse. E. हेषा neighing, and इनि aff.
44479: हेहे ind. 1 A particle of addressing, a vocative particle. 2 An interjection of calling aloud. E. हे the same, repeated.
44480: है ind. 1 A vocative particle. 2 An interjection of calling. E. ह्वे to call, डै aff.
44481: हैतुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Causal, causative. m. (-कः) 1 A follower of the Mīmāṃsā doctrines. 2 A sceptic, a causalist. E. हेतु cause, ठक् aff.
44482: हैम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Golden. 2 Frigid, freezing, cold. n. (-मं) Hoar-frost. f. (-मी) Yellow jasmine. E. हेमन् gold, or हिम frost, अण् aff.
44483: हैमन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Cold, wintry. 2 Growing in winter. 2 Suitable to winter. m. (-नः) The month Mārgaśīrṣa. n. (-नं) The winter season. E. हेमन्त winter, अण् aff., and the final optionally rejected.
44484: हैमन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 1 Wintry, cold. 2 Growing in winter, &c. 3 Suitable to the winter, (as abode or clothing, &c.) n. (-न्तं) The winter season. E. हेमन्त winter, अण् aff.
44485: हैमन्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Wintry, freezing, frigid. E. हेमन्त, and ठक् aff.
44486: हैमल mn. (-लः-लं) Winter. E. हिमल cold, अण् aff.
44487: हैमवत n. (-तं) Bharata Varṣa or India. m. (-तः) A sort of poison. f. (-ती) 1 PĀRVATĪ. 2 Chebulic myrobalan. 3 A medicinal kind of moon-plant. 4 A white kind of Orris root. 5 The Ganges. E. हिसवत् the snowy mountains skirting India, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्.
44488: हैयङ्गवीन n. (-नं) 1 Clarified butter prepared a day before it is used. 2 Fresh butter. E. ह्य yesterday, गोदोह milk, हियङ्ग substituted for them, and खञ् aff.
44491: हैहेय m. (-यः) A prince; also KĀRTAVĪRYA.
44492: हो ind. 1 A vocative particle. 2 An interjection of calling out to, or challenging. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डो aff.
44493: होड (ऋ) होडृ r. 1st cl. (होडति) To go, to move. (होडते) To disregard, to disrespect.
44494: होड m. (-डः) A raft, a float, a boat. E. हाड to go, aff. अच्.
44495: होडृ m. (-डा) A robber, a footpad or highway robber. E. हुड to collect, तृच् aff.
44496: होढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Stolen. n. (-ढं) Stolen goods. E. हुड to steal, क्त aff.
44497: होतृ m. (-ता) A priest, who at a sacrifice recites the prayers of the Rig Veda; one conversant with that Veda. E. हु to sacrifice, Uṇādi aff. तृच्.
44498: होत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 An article intended or fit for offering with fire, generally clarified butter. 2 Burnt-offering, oblation with fire. E. हु to sacrifice, ष्ट्रन् aff.
44499: होत्रीय n. (-यं) A place where oblations are offered. m. (-यः) A priest offering an oblation. E. होत्र an offering, छ aff.
44500: होम m. (-मः) Burnt-offering, the casting of clarified butter, &c. into the sacred fire, as an offering to the gods, accompanied with prayers or invocations, according to the object of the sacrifice. E. हु to sacrifice, मन् Uṇādi aff.
44501: होमकुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A hole in the ground or an altar, for receiving the fire for an oblation. E. होम burnt-offering, and कुण्ड a hole.
44502: होमधूम m. (-मः) The smoke of burnt-offering. E. होम as above, and धूम smoke.
44503: होमभस्मन् n. (-स्म) The ashes of a burnt-offering. E. होम as above, भस्मन् ashes.
44504: होमवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having performed sacrifice. E. होम, and मतुप् aff.
44505: होमाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Sacrificial fire. E. होम an oblation, and अग्नि fire.
44506: होमि m. (-मिः) 1 Clarified butter. 2 Fire. 3 Water. E. हु to sacrifice, मिन् aff.
44507: होमिन् m. (-मी) The offerer of an oblation. E. हु to sacrifice, मिनि Uṇādi aff.
44508: होरा f. (-रा) 1 The rising of a sign of the zodiac. 2 Part of the duration of a sign, the twenty-fourth part of a day, an hour. 3 A mark, a line. 4 A science or work in science, probably on astrology. E. होड to go, to proceed, affs. अच and टाप, and ड changed to र.
44509: होलाका f. (-का) The ceremony of throwing a red powder called Holi.
44510: होहौ ind. 1 An interjection of calling. 2 An exclamation of challenging or defiance. E. हो, and हौ both the same.
44511: हौ ind. 1 An interjection of defiance or challenge. 2 A vocative particle. E. ह्वेञ् to call, डौ aff.
44512: हौतृक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or appertaining to the Hotṛ or priest so named. E. हौतृ a priest, and ठञ् aff.
44513: हौम्य n. (-म्यं) Clarified butter. E. होम burnt-offering, यञ् aff.
44514: हौम्यधान्य n. (-न्यं) Sesamum. E. हौम्य relating to burnt-offering, and धान्य grain.
44515: ह्नु r. 2nd cl. (ह्नुते) To take away, to withhold or secrete. With अप or नि prefixed, To conceal, to hide, to deny.
44516: ह्मल r. 1st cl. (ह्मलति) To move, to shake.
44517: ह्यस् ind. Yesterday. E. अहन् a day, deriv. irr.
44518: ह्यस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Of yesterday, produced or occurred yesterday. E. ह्यस् yesterday, द्यु aff.
44519: ह्यस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of yesterday: see the last. E. ह्यस् yesterday, and त्यप् aff.
44520: ह्रग (ए) ह्रगे r. 1st cl. (ह्रगति) To cover.
44521: ह्रणिया f. (-या) 1 Censure, reproach. 2 Shame. E. हृणीङ् Kaṇḍvādi root, to feel shame, यक् aff., form irr.: see ह्रिणीया.
44522: ह्रद m. (-दः) 1 A deep lake, a large or deep piece of water. 2 A ray of light. E. ह्राद to sound, aff. अच्, and the deriv. irr.
44523: ह्रदग्रह m. (-हः) An alligator, a crocodile. E. ह्रद a lake, and ग्रह abode.
44524: ह्रदिनी f. (-नी) 1 A river in general. 2 Lightning. E. ह्रद deep water, इनि and ङीप् affs.
44526: ह्रस r. 1st cl. (ह्रसति) 1 To sound. 2 To be small or few.
44527: ह्रसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made little, diminished. 2 Sounded. E. ह्रस to sound, क्त aff.
44528: ह्रसिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very short or small. E. ह्रस्व short, aff. of the irr. superlative इष्ठन्, form irr.; also with इयसुन् aff. ह्रसीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः.)
44529: ह्रसिमन् m. (-मा) Smallness, shortness. E. ह्रस्व short, small, इमनिच् aff., form irr.
44530: ह्रस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) 1 Short, low in stature. 2 Short, as a vowel. m. (-स्वः) A dwarf. E. ह्रस to be small, and व aff.
44531: ह्रस्वगवेधुका f. (-का) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. ह्रस्व short, गवेधुका coix.
44532: ह्रस्वदर्भ m. (-र्भः) A short kind of Kuśa grass. E. ह्रस्व short, दर्भ the same.
44533: ह्रस्वपत्रक m. (-कः) A sort of Bassia. E. ह्रस्व short, पत्र a leaf, and कन् added.
44534: ह्रस्वाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) The gigantic Asclepias, (A. gigantea.)
44535: ह्रस्वाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Jīvaka. 2 A dwarf. E. ह्रस्व short, and अङ्ग the body.
44536: ह्राद r. 1st cl. (-ह्रादते) To sound, inarticulately.
44537: ह्राद m. (-दः) Noise, sound. E. ह्राद to sound, aff. अच्.
44538: ह्रादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Sounding, making a sound or noise. f. (-नी) 1 Lightning. 2 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 3 A river in general. 4 The Olibanum tree. E. ह्राद to sound, affs. इनि and ङीप्.
44539: ह्रास m. (-सः) Sound, noise. E. ह्रस to sound, aff. घञ्.
44540: ह्रिणीया f. (-या) 1 Censure, abuse. 2 Shame. E. हृणीङ् to be ashamed, aff. यक्, and the vowel changed to रि; also हृणीया, &c.
44541: ह्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Ashamed, modest, bashful. 2 Divided, portioned. 3 Taken, conveyed. n. (-तं) A portion, a share. E. ह्री to be ashamed, क्त aff., and the vowel made short; or हृ to take, aff. क्त, and रि substituted for ऋ.
44542: ह्रिति f. (-तिः) Taking, conveying. E. रि substituted for ऋ: see हृति.
44543: ह्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Being taken or seized. 2 Being captivated, attracted, &c. E. हृ to take, pass. v., शाभच् aff.
44544: ह्रिवेर n. (-रं) A perfume. E. see ह्रीवेर.
44545: ह्री r. 3rd cl. (जिह्रेति) To be modest or ashamed.
44546: ह्री f. (-ह्रीः) Shame, bashfulness. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्विप्.
44547: ह्रीका f. (-का) 1 Modesty, shame. 2 Fear, terror. E. ह्री to be ashamed, Uṇādi aff. कन्; also र changed to ल, ह्लीका.
44548: ह्रीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. m. (-कुः) 1 Lac. 2 Tin. E. ह्री to be ashamed, Uṇādi aff. कुक्; also ह्लीकु.
44549: ह्रीच्छ r. 1st cl. (ह्रीच्छति) To be modest or ashamed.
44550: ह्रीजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest, ashamed. E. ह्री shame, and जित overcome.
44551: ह्रीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Ashamed. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्तु, form irr.
44552: ह्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, bashful, modest. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. क्त, form reg.: see the last.
44553: ह्रीनिरास m. (-सः) Shamelessness. E. ह्री, and निरास throwing aff.
44554: ह्रीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Bashful, modest, ashamed. E. ह्री, and मतुप् aff.
44555: ह्रीवेर n. (-रं) A drug and perfume, commonly Bāla. E. ह्री shame, and वेर saffron.
44556: ह्रीवेल n. (-लं) A perfume: see the last. E. ह्रीवेर as before, र changed to ल; also with कन् added, ह्रीवेलकं.
44557: ह्रेपण n. (-णं) Putting to shame, excelling, surpassing. E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
44558: ह्रेपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Putting to shame, outvieing, surpassing. E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., शतृ aff.
44559: ह्रेपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made ashamed, put to shame. 2 Excelled, surpassed. E. ह्री to be ashamed, causal v., क्त aff.
44560: ह्रुड (ऋ) ह्रुडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रुडति) To collect.
44561: ह्रूड (ऋ) ह्रूडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रूडति) 1 To collect. 2 To go.
44562: ह्रेष (ऋ) ह्रेषृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रेषते) 1 To sound inarticulaly, to neigh as a horse. 2 To go, to move.
44563: ह्रेषा f. (-षा) Neighing as a horse. E. ह्रेष to neigh, affs. अ and टाप्.
44564: ह्रोड (ऋ) ह्रोडृ r. 1st cl. (ह्रोडति) To go, to move.
44566: ह्लप r. 10th cl. (ह्लापयति) To speak, to speak articulately: also ह्रप.
44568: ह्लाद (ई) ह्लादी r. 1st cl. (ह्लादते) 1 To gladden, to delight. 2 To be glad or delighted. 3 To sound, especially as a musical instrument.
44569: ह्लाद m. (-दः) Pleasure, joy. E. ह्लाद to be glad, aff. अच्.
44570: ह्लादन n. (-नं) Joy, delight. E. ह्लाद to be glad, and ल्युट् aff.
44571: ह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, happy. E. ह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.
44572: ह्लादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Happy, glad. f. (-नी) The Olibanum tree. E. ह्लाद pleasure, इनि and ङीष् affs.
44573: ह्लीका f. (-का) Shame, modesty. E. ह्नी to be ashamed, कन् Uṇādi aff., and र changed to ल.
44574: ह्लीकु mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु) Ashamed, modest. m. (-कुः) 1 Lac. 2 Tin. E. ह्री to be ashamed, aff. कुक्, and र changed to ल.
44575: ह्लेषा f. (-षा) Neighing, as a horse or ass, &c. E. ह्लेष for ह्रेष to neigh, aff. अ and टाप्.
44576: ह्वल r. 1st cl. (ह्वलति) To move, to shake.
44577: ह्वृ r. 1st cl. (ह्वरति) To bend, to curve, to make crooked.
44578: ह्वे r. 1st cl. (ह्वयति) 1 To emulate, to vie with, to wish to overcome or surpass. 2 To struggle or contend with. 3 To call. 4 To challenge. With उप, नि, वि or सम् the verb is deponent (उपह्नयते); also with आङ् if rivalry be signified, (आह्वयते) he challenges.
